comments_processed: The area is great, and I was able to walk from the subway at night and felt safe. But as you'll notice in the bathroom picture, there is no towel or even a washcloth. Aaron said he would Uber me a set, but they seemed to have been stolen off the stoop, so the next day he tried again, but I had already decided to stay with a friend and use his shower and bathroom. There is also no washer or dryer, so I was not able to wash the 2 new towels before use, and there was no wash cloth. I felt like the cleaner missed a lot, as there was dirt and leaves on the floor of the living room, a lot of long black hair on the bathroom floor and in the shower stall, and the kitchen sink, which I didn't use, had food in it and the drain strainer.  Overall, not so bad since I only spend a few minutes there other than sleeping during the 2 days I rented it, and he refunded me $50.

Inrich is a fantastic host and the apartment is was lovely.   Inrixh was really welcoming, gave us clear instructions and a flexible check in time. When we had a panic about getting locked outside one night, she was quick to respond (panic turned out to be over nothing). She gave us great recommendations when we asked for them and we felt we could come to her with any question.  We received som raised eyebrows from friends when we told them the apartment was in the Bronx as its historically had a lot of crime. However, the area this apartment is located in felt extremely safe (though lively). It's a very latinx part of town and has lots of families and nice food and bars. It's also 5 minutes to 2 metro lines heading south that run 24/7 so very easy to get to Manhatten / Brooklyn any time of the day (or night). The apartment itself was great - it had a well provisioned kitchen, clean bathroom and nice bedroom and living room with big TV and boardgames.  Would highly recommend and would love to go back!

My family originally had another reservation which was unfortunately cancelled last-minute and we scrambled to find a new place. Thankfully, we found Rejvi who was super accommodating and flexible and welcomed us into her affordable & comfortable stay.   The location is very close to the A-train which made it convenient to get into downtown. Some downsides: we occasionally heard loud music from passing cars/neighbors late in the night.  All-in-all, this spot was well worth our money, and we’re very appreciative of Reivi’s hospitality which made our NYC trip stress-free.

This Airbnb has a great location. Felt safe, nice neighbors. The space of the Airbnb was nice. We were disappointed with a few things. The apartment had a bad smell lingering the whole time we stayed. Kind of like cat pee, just unpleasant, pretty overwhelming scent. The fridge was left with half used food, maybe from the last guests? There was no hand soap in the bathroom or kitchen, except for dish soap. There were no blankets on the bed, only sheets. We ended up finding a quilt and a blanket bunched up in a bag in the closet so we weren’t sure if it was clean. It is winter so this was not very good. The smoke detector was questionable because the battery port was left open. There was a used joint sitting under the coffee table. There was a bucket filled with water and a mop left by the fridge. Andrew was very nice but we were overall unsettled by the cleanliness of the place. These all have easy fixes, so we hope the best for whoever stays next. It’s a great location, & nice space.

Victor was a responsive and very nice host. However, there were a few problematic things about the space. 1. The cleaning was subpar. There was dust and dirt on the floor, empty food containers and wrappers left behind from past guests that had not been cleaned. 2. The apartment was overwhelmingly hot and there was no way to control the temperature. The windows had to be left open to get cool air in. 3. Downstairs there is another apartment and there was a lot of noise transfer from the people who live there, we were woken up by a lot of noise from the people living there every morning. 5. There were empty closets for clothes, but no hangers. 6. This one is the most important: we were assaulted by a bum outside the home at 8pm. He threatened to beat me and my Mother up if we did not give him money, and he shoved me and tried to throw my phone to the ground when I tried to call 911. Luckily a neighbor came by and stopped him. Please be careful- this neighborhood can be very sketchy.

I booked this place and reached out to Victor to let him know that my daughter was between apartments and needed a place to stay.  He open his place and treated her as if she was a part of his family.  My daughter and her pet cat - Thomas had a home, and was relieved of the stress of being homeless.  Thanks Victor, you were able to help my daughter while we were stuck here in Texas.

I had a nice stay and an owner was so kind However, when we stayed here, a shower room was broken and we couldn’t use it. That mean we didn’t take a shower for at least 4d. And we arrived here kinda late/ over 12am at the first day to stay, even tho we were late, we were punctual because the rule says “check-in after 5pm, check-out before 12pm” but when we got here, no one replied on my message and we almost had to look for another Airbnb or hotel to stay after 12am. I know during holiday season even an owner should be relaxed and go somewhere but we paid for staying so at least I wanted her to reply on messages as soon as possible. And I’d like to use a hair dryer, but she didn’t put it clearly. That’s why we didn’t use it the first day.  At last, at the last day to stay, we have to leave home early so in advance I asked her where I should put the key but she didn’t reply soon. We had no idea.  In conclusion, the location is not dangerous and the owner was kind but it was bad.

The place is serviceable. For 150 per night the host could have done a better job. Don’t understand why people are saying that the place is clean - it’s not terribly dirty at the most. Dust, hair, dead roaches stuck in the lamps, black mold in the bathroom, a pile of random items in the kitchen corner… name a few. Pots and pans were quite old, and the host does not provide anything other than the bare minimum. It’s funny how the host put a duck tape of everything that guests were not supposed to touch (like oven for example). I think they turned off a bunch of ceasing lights to save money, but it made the place quite dark and unpleasant to be in. Also, there is no place to sit in the kitchen, which is not such a big deal but makes the place quite unwelcoming.   In addition, I got locked out of my room once, and the host never responded to my messages.  The area itself is a bit dodgy - probably okay in terms of safety, but there are rats running around the entrance and the entryway smelled terrible.  The room was decent, the bed and bed sheets were clean. Overall, it’s an okay place to stay for a night or so, but I would not recommend staying there longer.

It was my worst experience ever!   No instructions on how to get into the apartment. I texted the host and she didn't reply even until I left. We were locked outside at the building for an hour and luckily one of the residents came back home so we can get in after a long wait.  That was the early evening period in the winter of NYC. You can imagine how cold it was. And the host wasnever showed up.   After we got in, we found that it is not the same as posted. (I want to show my photos badly.) The apartment is very very very dirty, noisy at midnight, and smells of hemp. You do not want to touch anything at all. I am not a clean freak. Just unacceptable  Most importantly, an unexpected man was there the whole time. I experienced 3 times in just 3 days that a homeless wanted to get in to the building when I stepped out. I feel unsafe the whole time with my teenage daughter.   The worst and most unsafe experience I ever have had with Airbnb. This place should not be listed and rented out.

Overall, very nice/ high-end apartment in a residence with good amenities (quality in-unit Bosch washing machine/dryer - a huge plus for NY-, oven, blender, TV, etc.). The building has great facilities (gym, rooftop terrace, working space) and concierge services. Great location, it is very walkable and close to major attractions and restaurants.   Unfortunately, the apartment was infested with silverfish insects, although they are not harmful, but kind of unpleasant to see a couple of them every day. Furthermore, the host was not very responsive and considerate of our requests.   Overall an ok stay but could have been improved with better hosting.

I was in a bit of a tizzy with a last-minute cancellation from another Airbnb. I had my in-laws and my parents staying in town for my husband's graduation, and nowhere to put them up. Natalie was able to accommodate us with less than 24 hours' notice.   The space had adequate accommodations (3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms) for 4 people, with comfortable beds and air conditioning in each room (great for cooling down after a 100F day). The apartment also had a washer/dryer in the unit - my mum loved this, and did multiple loads of washing. The best part about the space was the outdoor area. It had about 6-7 chairs with shade from a big tree - excellent for an afternoon wine in the sun.  The only cons were the hot water did run out for 1 day, however, Natalie was able to fix the problem within an hour, and one curtain was missing from the main bedroom.   The only recommendation l would make is to add a toaster oven. Thank you for a great stay, Natalie. We'll definitely be back.

This was a great steal. I was in town and needed something quick. I was a little frustrated but Luciana made this trip better. Everything was clean and cozy. She responded quickly which made things a lot easier. I would definitely recommend! 5 stars

Stay at Alicia was pretty much great, she did let us check in early as we wanted. Some of the drawbacks that we felt was with the Air conditioning: we were told that the room includes AC but Alicia didn’t know how to work it. We were told that they will fix it the second day but instead they got us two new fans and never bothered ti fix it. The weather outside was pretty hot so that the fans were not helping much. Second thing we felt weird and scary was during the day of our stay when it was raining Alicia texted me asking to close the windows, but then since we weren’t home at that moment I texted her saying that the windows are closed (which actually was). But then later when we got home someone entered our room and removed the fan from the window to close it. I enquired about it with Alicia but she completely ignored my message. We were never told that who did enter our room without letting us know first. We have never experienced this before so that if felt very uncomfortable. But other than that we had a great time at her place.

I did not have a good experience unfortunately. There was a camera recording 24/7 being pointed directly at the bedroom I was staying in, and I felt very uncomfortable and unsafe. Also it’s clear he doesn’t live here, and it’s more of a crowded hostel situation. The bathroom was very unsanitary I had to clean someone’s Feces off the seat. Yes I have proof. I will not be staying in airbnbs anymore bc of this experience. There were way too many fines for any small detail, if u overslept 100 if you left luggage 100 etc list goes on. I am unsure if there’s even anyone who actually cleans the place. I didn’t stay there the first night & did not receive a refund. I’m extremely disappointed, and the internet wasn’t working. The camera was Very uncomfortable. And all the 1000 instructions in the apartment showing clearly the host does not live there and it’s just a business thing. Very sad.

Evan was so hard to get a hold of. His location is incredibly dangerous for this traveling from out of town seeing as how the air bnb is in the heart of Harlem. Locals strongly warn against even going to this location.   When Evan wouldn’t respond with checkin info and became difficult to get a hold of I had to book a hotel last minute. I worked with air bnb to cancel and get a refund and even wouldn’t even respond to them when they tried reaching out about the incident.   I do not recommend at all! Stay away from this one and save your money!

Even if the room was big and clean. The a/c was moldy and full of dust. It's smelled like basement in the room because of the mold. There is a pipe in the room that is hot as hell and not protected or isolated and so it is dangerous and also diffuse a lot of heat so you need to have the a/c on all the time if you want to be able to stay in the room

Mark was extremely friendly and helpful. He was quickly available and even volunteered to help with my mom's dog. The apartment was clean and had a sizable bedroom if a kind of small main area.  That said, there were a few drawbacks. Chief among them is that the descent to the door is unsafe: It has no railing, the light does not turn on until you are down the steps, and the steps themselves are dirty and bare stone with a dirty drain at the bottom.  The place also does not have laundry or a dishwasher and is kind of ill furnished given the price.  That said, there are not often places available in the area and it is a great neighborhood with easy access to several subway lines and some of the best breweries and restaurants in Brooklyn, and it is extremely safe with nice hosts.

This stay was incredible to put mildly. I visited my home place of Brooklyn NY for a very important and critical consultation for a very important procedure and Jaylin did everything possible to make my stay smooth and easy. From jump she was attentive, responsive, and kind. The apartment is so beautifully and carefully decorated, spacious, and VERY clean. I felt comfortable enough to walk around without being scared of dirt or grime. The kitchen was stocked with seasonings and everything needed to make my meals as I have tons of restrictions and rarely eat out. The lighting in the bedroom is amazing. Cozy bed, great furniture. Amazing water pressure and deep clean tub. You can tell great care was taken to make this as homey as possible. I felt so safe and very much appreciated the time spent. Jaylin, you did that girl! The nice touches of artists photos (we love Beyoncé chile yes mam!), magazines, bed trays, accessories.. all make it “home” LOVED this stay. 10/10 recommended!

《Recommend Mo, he is a perfect landlord and friend! 》 Mo is a very warm-hearted and friendly landlord .   He recommended me many tourist attraction and cared about my life, we like friends.  Mo's home  heartwarming, clean, bright and feels like home.  The apartment has an elevator, it's very convenient for travelers.  The location  very safe. I go home at 10 pm, I didn’t feel afraid,because the streets near home are bright and there are many supermarkets、diner.  《強烈推薦Mo，他是一位滿分的房東/朋友！》 Mo是一位非常熱情、友善的房東/朋友。他熱情推薦我許多景點、並關心我的生活，到後面我們如同朋友般自在相處。 Mo的家溫馨、乾淨、明亮，很有家的感覺。 這棟公寓有電梯，這對旅行者來說十分便利。 住家位置十分安全，好幾次我晚上10左右才回家，都不會害怕  住家附近街道明亮，有超商、餐飲小吃店。

The apartment is so cute and CLEAN, perfect for a girls trip. We were honestly amazed how updated and modern this place was! The livin/kitchenette was so nice and cozy, the rooms were so relaxing, the beds were supper comfortable with both room having its own air conditioner!We feel like we gotta steal for our money!   It was perfect , totally would recommend!

All good, just one mattress was to soft and the bed boards made a lot of noises . excellent airbnb in general . the neighborhood is not the best , and the house in the side is kind of creepy . far from manhattan and close to airport . if you are planning arrive in subway have in mind your gonna walk 7 or 4 street with your luggage and try to arrive early , on the night is scary ...

We had a fabulous Thanksgiving stay at this luxuriously-outfitted apartment. The best of everything - super comfy beds, nicely-appointed kitchen and lots of high tech amenities. The location is just a few blocks from several quick trains into Manhattan and fabulous restaurants and shops of Park Slope are just a short stroll to the corner.   We had everything we needed and more. Easy to access. Curtis and Rob were super responsive, but never intrusive. Great stay!
Great stress-free stay. Clear and prompt communication from the host, easy to find the place, and clean. Thank you!

This place is big and clean. Sergio lives here in the other room, so the place has more of a home feel than a hotel. Although he lived there, the bathroom, kitchen, and living room were kept clean.  The location is fantastic! We took the 7 train back from Manhattan late each night and never felt unsafe walking home.  We found an amazing pizza place next to the train station called Sunnyside Pizza. All the sell is pizza, with several options sold by the slice, but it is absolutely fantastic! We also really liked   The Brother’s Cafe, just a block away from the Airbnb, is also a great place to grab breakfast, coffee, and a couple bottles of water for the day. The place has been there for almost 20 years and is still run by the 4 brothers who started it. We sat at the counter to eat and chatted with them every morning.  We would stay here again.
Apartment very well located.  Cheking at the top.  Excellent communication and great understanding and kindness in holding our luggage until our flight.  I recommend.
The host is good but the room lacked ventilation (fan/AC) and the neighbour next door was very creepy.

This is a gem of a place to stay, location is safe, quiet and private. All stores and trains close by. Never once did I feel unsafe in the area or coming in or out of the apt. Eric is an amazing host, explains everything very detailed, he’s personable and very detailed with the amenities.

i loved staying here! miho was always responsive and all of her instructions made for an easy check in. this is such a steal of a spot for the price-was easy to hop on the G train from the apartment and explore brooklyn!

We stayed in this apartment with our 2 children aged 13 and 10 and we found all the necessary comfort there. We were very well received and our host showed us around the area as soon as we arrived (small supermarket, seller of very good pizzas, metro...) so everything was very simple for our stay. The apartment is functional, everything you need to prepare small meals, in short it was a very good stay. The metro is a 10-minute walk away, either 116 or 125 street, and you are quite quickly central in NY by line 6. The neighborhood is... surprising, initially a little impressive in its diversity but by no means poorly frequented. We regularly returned after 9 p.m. from the metro and never had any bad encounters. Certainly it's not the most chic neighborhood but no feeling of insecurity really!  A big thank you to fooad for his flexibility for our departure time, it was very appreciable. And thank you for contributing to this very good stay in New York with your availability, your visit to the neighborhood, your answers to our questions and your availability.

READ BEFORE BOOKING!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  Hello, I am so livid, and dont know who else can help me get some justice. These people need to be called out in a major way!!!!    I was a resident of 702 44th St, BK, the site of the huge 6 alarm fire in Sunset Park on Wed April 4. My family and I are safe, but we lost everything. I have a 5 month old baby, and we evacuated the building with nothing but the clothes on our backs.   I had my first day back from Maternity Leave on April 4, the day of the fire, and my mother is visiting to help with childcare, we booked this for her. After evacuating, my mother, newborn and I raced barefoot back to the AirBnB, while my husband stayed in the park with our 12 year old dog, Tilly. Tilly had a procedure at the vet Tues night and is currently wearing a cone, and on pain med. Upon frantically arriving to the AirBnB, we greeted our host, who was watching news coverage of the fire. We explained that it was my building and now my family, including my my baby and injured dog had nowhere to go. I told her my dog was potty trained, very old and quite, and she stated "Of Course. Anything you need. I am so sorry this is happening."  The following day, Thursday, my mom, baby and I were taking the dog on a walk when our host, Haydee, came out of our unit. She immediately yelled, "What is a dog doing here?" I reminded her of the fire and her saying its was ok. She said this conversation never took place and we all needed to leave immediately. I pleaded with her that my family, had no where to go, no transportation, and none of our belongings. She stated "This is not my problems. People have allergies and we cannot have a dog here."   I obviously became very upset, starting to have a panic attack. Our hosts daughter, Annette, then called me and said she was on the phone with AirBnB telling them we were breaking their rules and that we had to leave immediately.   Never in my life have I been treated so cruel. This fire is, by far, the most traumatic thing that has ever happened to me or my young family. My son is only 5 months old! My dog is old and sick!  Everything we have is gone, and this woman literally kicked us out on the street.   Not sure how you can use this story, but I feel like it needs to be told. Just righting a review about this does not seem to suffice the trauma it caused me.   Cant imagine anyone doing business with such cruel people.

Meeting Wendy: I want to start off by saying that when I first met Wendy, she immediately made me feel at home. She was very welcoming and inviting.   Check-in: Check in was smooth since she showed me how to get into the apartment before she left. There was a mistake on my part, as I confused the lodging dates, as my guests' arrived on different dates. It caused a minor delay with the guests that were staying in her downstairs apartment, but it was quickly solved when they rang the doorbell and I let them in. I realized that I had actually reserved the unit for 23-28, as opposed to the 21-26. Wendy and I played phone tag before we finally got in touch with each other about the situation. I could tell she was a little frustrated about it but at that point, there was nothing I could do but apologize for my mistake. Wendy then changed the dates on the reservation page.   The Apartment: The rooms were clean, however the bathrooms could’ve used a bit more cleaning. The kitchen was fully stocked with plenty of cooking utensils, however, Wendy did not clear out her refrigerator and so there was very limited space to put any groceries during our 5-day stay. Also, my parents stayed in the upstairs room off of the terrace and they got bug bites all over their arms and backs. This wasn't the case in the other two rooms however it was a little disappointing for my parents.   Check out: Wendy asked us to checkout by 10:00 am, and although I thought this was a little early, I just had to go with it since I already made the mistake with the wrong check in and check out dates. Wendy arranged for a cleaning lady to come at around 10:00 AM, so we felt kind of rushed, but there was nothing we could really do about it. The cleaning lady arrived as we were leaving and even thanked us for leaving the apartment so tidy.  Since we checked out: Two weeks after we checked out of the apartment, Wendy's sent me a text message asking about packages that were delivered to the house during our stay. I told her that I did see 1 small package delivered (put through the mail slot, along with her regular mail) however I did not touch the package, as it was not addressed to me. At first she said thank you, but then later sent me an additional message about how she was "very frustrated" because they were supposed to be presents for her son for Christmas. I kind of felt like she was accusing someone in my family of stealing her son's Christmas gifts and I was offended to say the least.   Overall: These few incidents aside, it was a decent stay. I appreciate Wendy opening up her home to my family during the holidays and I look forward to using AirBNB for future lodging around the world.

After relocating to NYC from LA, my boyfriend & I decided to try out Airbnb to test out different neighborhoods before deciding on a permanent area. We were incredibly lucky & stumbled upon Bobby's listing, and we stayed for 2 months!   Let me start off by saying how awesome Bobby & his wife are. They were always very quick to respond and were readily on top of everything we could have needed or asked for. Including coming to replace a broken part in the oven our first night there. They were always helpful, friendly, and incredibly accommodating.  The apartment is on a nice friendly street, is quiet, spacious, has amazing light, and is equipped with anything you could need for your stay. The bed is extremely comfortable, which is a huge plus! The apartment is close to trains, little grocery stores, liquor store, drug stores, etc. It generally would only take about 20-25 minutes to get into Manhattan, 15 minutes to Williamsburg. The neighborhood is up & coming, there are some older parts and then some newer spots with cute little coffee shops and bars.  The place very quickly felt like home, and we had zero problems while staying there.   All in all, we would definitely recommend Bobby's for your stay, whether it is short term or long term.
Her house was beautifully decorated. The bed was so comfortable, it felt like we were sleeping on clouds. The bathroom was an adventure to get to. If your tall, do not be scared to duck.

This place is a steal and a haven. You get 1 enormous room to yourself plus a sun room with it's own private entrance. Plus netflix lol, need I say anymore. I hope I can revisit this place when I return. Leah allowed me to drop off my bags early and other then that she remained ghost my entire stay unless I needed her.

The host is very accommodating and communicative! The house is just blocks away from the bus to New York. Brooklyn isn’t for the New York beginner (like I am) so make sure you know your way around the public transportation as it requires a bit of forethought. Especially late at night.  The room itself is clean and tidy and is a great place for a stow and go trip. It has an easy entrance that is secured with a code-lock.  The neighborhood is a little sketchy so I would make sure you are cool with that before checking in.
So I get to this place and there is Not a lock on your bedroom door. I was in shock. I felt rather unsafe. My stay was forced to terminate because it was impossible for me to sleep comdortable

Lovely home, fantastic host. Felt very welcome and house had everything we needed! Easy access to the city. A little scary to walk through the area at night but other than that fantastic and would be fine if you had a car.

I’m afraid if I share how fabulous this place is , the word will be out, it will be booked endlessly , and I won’t get a chance to stay here again. Seriously the best Airbnb for the price! Great for a small family vacation. Quiet tree lined neighborhood. Lots of street parking .

The rented apartment does not correspond to the standing of the photos published on the website. The furniture is not the same.  There is not the standing one would expect from the photos. Air  conditioning has been added but it is very old and very dirty.  Half of the electrical outlets are out of service. The ceiling lamps are disgusting, and it does not work in the living room (broken switch)!  The second bedroom is so small, it is not big enough for the double bed, only 15 inches left to enter the room.  The windows on the garden side are in very poor condition, very poorly maintained. It is not possible to open the windows or to lock them. There is no security. The window surrounds are very damaged.  The window on the right presents a real danger, it only holds thanks to adhesive tape.

Upon the arrival I felt like being cheated by this host. I sent a message two days ahead to mention that I will be arrive early morning and got no response. We went to NYC as planned anyway, by the time we arrived, nobody answer the door until 30min later. I tried to call her using long distance fee and again got no response.   30 min after had waited infront of the door, someone came out and had no clue which room I am going stay. He made a phone call to the host I guess?! and then walked us upstair. He banged the door so hard until the other guest open the door for us. The lady who opened the door, had been sleeping in our reserved room and had had no ideal where she should be. She then had to move to another room and left the bed all messy, we had to wait again for the bed to be done. More than one unpleasant hour passed :(.  The host then came by and introduced herself n pass us two towels. Then I never saw or heard from her again. Bathroom was left uncleansed and shared with other guest for the whole weekend. Trash can was completely full, everytime I opened to throw stuff away I have to pick up garbage coming out from there. Internet was not accessible and we had no clue who to search for.  On the positive side, location is very convenient to downtown and all. Three min from metro and back room was calm enough. I was looking for safe good location and didn't care much about the rest but still this is overrated and overpriced. Not recommended

We enjoyed our stay.  We felt well cared for and have no concerns or complaints.    Bobby was an attentive host and the space is comfortable and conveniently located near a grocery store, drug store, and subway stop.  Thank you.

We (family with 3 children) were looking for an inexpensive alternative to the overpriced hotels in NYC. We found this large apartment in Brooklyn. The apartment is 5 minutes away from the metro, from which 2 lines go to Manhattan. The area isn't exactly pretty but at least we didn't feel unsafe (huge hospital next door). There is a small grocery store near the metro station.  The apartment is fully equipped including air conditioning (essential in summer!!). Bed linen, lots of towels etc. - nothing was missing! Grace left us a huge pizza when we arrived, and she was always available via email.  From JFK to the apartment by taxi approx. 40 minutes (depending on traffic conditions), with public transport. Transport takes a good hour (recommendation: pre-order a taxi via relevant internet services, the journey to the airport by public transport is quite expensive and inconvenient as a family - you have to change trains 3 times). We liked it! Thank you Grace!

I had a lovely time at Pedro's place. He was very welcoming on arrival and  warm throughout my stay, always very accommodating and eager to give good insider New York tips. Also extremely flexible with arrival and departure times so guests don't have to stress about that. The flat is in a good location, near transport links and with lots you can do by foot around this lovely area. 5th floor by stairs. The room is good size with a nice bed and linen, very warm. Bathroom is good and clean with powerful shower. While I was there the wifi wasn't working reliably but I think they are working on it. I always tend to look for AirBnbs where the host seems to have had a lot of experience with it and Pedro definitely fulfils this criteria. Would definitely recommend.

Have to say... really a perfect place to stay if you want to be well located in NYC.  The immediate area seems safe (Walking there from subway at 2:30 am seemed fine). Everything one needs is close by, along with a nice park across the street, great coffee at home or espresso around the corner, best croissant in recent memory two doors beyond that.  3 blocks from subway transport to anywhere in the city. SUPER convenient. Pedro very open and helpful. Room and bathroom and kitchen are very clean. Nice old building. 5 floor walk up is not too taxing for folks in reasonable shape... or even sketchy shape like me.  I will certainly look them up again if I return...first place I would seek to reserve.

Nia was very gracious and willing to go the extra mile. She was very helpful and made what could have been a very stressful trip - less stressful. The location was great! It's located one block from multiple subway entrances and close to everything. I went to the Village, Manhattan, Flushing, Times Square and everywhere in between!  Thanks Nia!
Nicely accessible. Was a bit afraid of the noise. But the room I was in was at the other side from the train tracks, and I never woke up (nor had trouble falling asleep) because of it.

Jim was present as promised to provide access to the apartment. He also cordially drove us and our baggage to our next stop at a nearby apartment building when we checked out, and actually carried our luggage to and from his car! We saw this as going the extra mile.  While we were hardly first time visitors to NYC and did not require "tourist" information, no doubt Jim would be happy and very competent if requested. The unit was as advertised, clean and comfortable.  We appreciated that it included coffee and cream. The kitchen is well equipped. The location, while not scenic (Queens is not typically scenic) was very convenient for our purpose, and close to the 7 train which is one stop from Grand Central Station, which then provides access to the entire subway system.  The apartment was also a half block from Vernon Avenue, which features a variety of restaurants and other commercial establishments. And, there was a grocery store and drug store nearby. The climate control worked well.  The bath was large and modern with ready hot water.  For someone needing lodging in Long Island City this apartment should be high on the list.

We spent 10 days in this accommodation with 2 adults + 1 child aged 11.  The apartment is a 5-minute walk from the Vernon Bvd metro station (line 7) which takes us directly to Manhattan (Grand Central 3 minutes and Times Square 10 minutes). It's really very practical.  We take Vernon Bvd to reach the metro station and the apartment. This street has restaurants, bars and food shops which allow you to do your shopping when returning in the evening after a long day of walking. The apartment is located on a small one-way street perpendicular to Vernon Bvd. The apartment is on the ground floor of a small typical NYC building (3 levels) and the place is really quiet. Virtually no road traffic. It is well equipped for cooking and doing laundry. The apartment has wifi and air conditioning, which is essential in NYC in August.  We communicated very easily with Jim (email or text), he adapted to our arrival being delayed by one day (following a flight problem) and he was very accommodating on the day of departure (storing the suitcases while we enjoyed our last day and reserving the car with driver to take us back to the airport). In short, we don't regret our choice and we would probably book the same apartment if we returned to NYC.

Greg and his apartment are a one in a million find in NYC! The apartment is located on the same road as the Empire State Building, and a 5/10 minute walk to other local attractions like Broadway, Time Square and Hells Kitchen! There is also a Subway station a stones throw away where you can easily get down to the Brooklyn Bridge or up to Central Park/The Met/The Guggenheim very quickly to make the most of your trip! Greg was so hospitable letting us check in early and check out late without any stress and basically allowed us to have the entire apartment to ourselves! The view is spectacular and I wouldn't think of staying anywhere else other than here for our next trip to NYC.

Lovely place - one stop away from Grand Central, really comfy apartment with everything you could need - it even has a washer/dryer!  The place was absolutely spotless when I arrived. Jim is a fantastic host, and I'm so glad I chose his place to stay while in New York.  Area is very safe - even at nearly 10pm I didn't feel unsafe walking down from the subway stop. There're plenty of places to eat and bars nearby, plus enough grocery stores/supermarkets nearby that you won't starve even if you don't like eating out.
The room and the location was fine and communication went smooth. There were no unpleasant surprises. The host was nice and welcoming. I recommend Liubov's place.

Jim was a gracious and friendly host. He met us on our arrival (actually, he came around the block to find us because the taxi had left us at the wrong address!), helped us with our luggage, and gave us a short tour of his fantastic neighborhood (grocery and drug stores, his favorite restaurants, the riverfront). And he was super attentive to our questions and requests all week.  The apartment was perfect for my sister and me. The beds were comfortable (including the pullout sofa), the water pressure in the shower was great, and the kitchen was well stocked. We were thrilled with the neighborhood, which is lively and felt safe. The block is quiet at night. I wish we could have explored more, but we did visit MoMA PS1, a contemporary art museum a short walk from the apartment. All in all, it was a wonderful stay, and we'd love to return!

I love this room, small and cozy also i love the yard. Me and my friend got scammed, then we found this room, the “check-in anytime” really helped us! We booked this room, and the host responded so quick that we can went straight to check-in within half an hour. There’s also a lot of bars nearby, pizza places etc within walking distance. Definitely will be staying here again if i’m back in NY!

Very low maintenance of the apartment. No funny smells, but the building itself is poorly maintained.  The wiring and power outlets arround the apartment were a bit scary. Bathroom, kitchen and home appliances need an urgent improvement. Brilliant location.

We were in the city for only one night (unexpectedly, due to a missed flight connection) and Caroline kind of came to the rescue by responding to our request on the fly! She was super accommodating, her place was right in the heart of where we wanted to be. Cozy room with a super comfy bed, perfect for a good night's rest in the middle of some stressful travelling. Due to the last-minute nature of our stay, we also had her adorable cat as company, which made us feel more at home. Thanks Caroline!

I loved our stay here! The photos are exactly what you get when you arrive. Super clean and well looked after. Destiny was easy to contact and additonal coffee was dropped off which was an awesome touch! The place was very warm keeping us cosy in the cooler NYC temperatures. Neighbours are friendly too.   It's a cute little apartment on the top floor of a typical brownstone apartment. Really got to experience Brooklyn! Everything we wanted and needed here. It only cost us $40 from LGA airport and is only a 15 minute walk to the substation. I cannot compliment this place and Destiny enough. 2 of our party had their belongings stolen the night before check-out and Destiny was so understanding and made no hassle about the keys being stolen too! I will definitely be back here when I return to Brooklyn!  Thanks again Destiny!

Destiny's place was just perfect!! Although we never met, she was beyond informative and accommodating, she literally responded to my texts within 3 minutes. Her place is exactly as shown, beds were comfortable, shower pressure just right and location was convenient for the 3 train which takes you straight into Manhattan, Bronx and Harlem, literally a two minute walk to the station. It was also very walkable to restaurants, coffee shops, drug store, etc. I would definitely stay here again. Overall I would give it an A+++.
Clean place, responsible host. Consider exit from 116th street metro station is dangerous in the evening
It's sucks stay home or be homeless before goin there.

Christophe was kind and easy to deal with  in our long stay. He made everything easy for us as we had a long rental with him as a stopgap while we were selling and buying a new property. Our situation was stressful and he made everything easy for us.   He was communicative and accommodating.  His cats are lovely and friendly and the apartment is in the epicenter of Park Slope.  Many thanks!

Great find and a steal! Right by the Botanic Gardens and the subway. Felix was a great host; he welcomed us when we arrived, provided all the essential amenities and even gave us a list of restaurant recommendations. Highly recommend!

Christophe was charming, his place is lovely and the cats are delightful. We had a lovely stay, just quietly doing our thing; even the intensity of a Brooklyn heatwave didn’t dent our ardour, as the apartment is cool and shady, has a delightful back garden and the park is just two short blocks away. A thoroughly comfortable two weeks.

Very nice apartment, very quiet, well equipped, ideally located in Brooklyn, 5-10 minutes from the subway (restaurant and supermarket nearby) No insecurity, the residents of the neighborhood are very friendly. Daniella is very available and attentive but also very discreet. She ensured our comfort throughout our stay. Communication is very easy with this family who speaks French. We highly recommend this apartment.

Annie's place is nice and well located. The check in & check out was really easy, communication was good.  Some negative things : - the noise : there is a bar right down the building and you can hear the people at night in the street as well as the trafic - the curtains are really light so that you might be up early morning as the light comes in. - the place was not clean - some electric equipment are dangerous : you have some electric wires just next to the shower, which seems to be dangerous

Annie’s Airbnb was totally stylish and beautiful. 1 block away from L train (enough said). Situated in an adorable fringe of Williamsburg next to coffee shops and trendy restaurants. Annie was very responsive and gave great localbtips. She was also amazingly flexible with check out and saved us from a potentially stressful relocation of multiple luggage.  I would highly recommend booking with Annie for anyone wanting to visit NYC.

Its a nice place close to subway. Manhattan and JFK are accessible directly via subway. Place is really cozy and Ian is a perfect host who is committed to make your stay comfortable and stress-free. Cheers.
The building is old and a bit creepy but the house is clean. It's well communicated with Q metro line and the neighborhood is nice.

Great place, spacious, with modern design and home owner personal touch. For us it was perfect place to relax after day spent on visiting Manhatan. Hosts are very kind and helpful. quickly responding to questions. for us travel to Manhatan took about 1h, as we expected. With bus (bus stop next to the building) and metro. one thing to mention is that area where we transfer from bus to metro in Jamaica was not very nice, especialy after dark. there was visible police presence in the area so it was probably safe but nevertheless little creepy.  we decided to use uber on those occasions we want to come back late.  as for area of the apartment itself we had an  impresion it was safe. all in all, if you accept way and time of travel to Manhatan this apartment is defenitly worth to recommend to stay in :)

Such a cute place. I’ve been living in Manhattan for years so my expectations are always sort of low with air bnbs as far as accuracy but this was an accurate listing. Even exceeded what was promised!   I never saw the neighbors or even heard footsteps. It’s a quiet building but there is lots going on in the neighborhood. In general, I’ve always loved Williamsburg but sometimes it’s sketchy depending on which side of the neighborhood you’re on. This area was perfect. I felt super safe.    As far as communication, I had to call upon arriving and also needed her help with opening the fridge. There is a note on the fridge but I was being very tentative with opening it lol she instantly answers you when you contact.    I had family staying at my place in midtown so this was a perfect medium. Very accessible with the subway though I took a Lyft the entire time.    I can’t recommend this place more. Would love to stay at her other listings when I take a vacation.

Accommodation located in Brooklyn, about ten minutes' walk from the J line which will take you to Manhattan. In 30-35 minutes you will be on Wall Street and can fully enjoy NYC. Compared to the apartment, it is on 3 levels, the terrace is adjoining the bedroom on the 2nd floor. The main room is very pleasant. Harvin is an efficient host who will help you when needed and give you many good addresses. "Safe" neighborhood, don't be scared by Brooklyn, the neighborhood is very friendly and welcoming.

This was just a stop over for us, so we were looking for a cheap place to stay. It was quite the distance to the subway and city though. About an hour to Penn station and even longer to see the sites like 9/11 Memorial or Statue of Liberty. Felt a little out of our comfort zone in the neighborhood, we were pretty scared when we came to the place after dark. Jan was nice and meet all our needs.

I loved staying at Jan's! She was flexible and it was obvious that she wanted to help in any way possible. The bed was comfortable, the bathroom nice and clean, and the kitchen fully equipped. It is only a short walk to the subway which is also convenient. I never felt unsafe and everything was great!

We spend 5 nights at Jan's place. She is a very friendly and warm person. Jan works during the week so chances are you have more privacy then elsewhere. The apartment is very clean and comfortable. The shower and toilet are right next to the bedroom so you don't have to bother Jan walking through the apartment to use the bathroom. The bedroom has windows you can open with the sun coming through in the morning. The Bronx is what is is; a lively neighborhood where gentrification has not taken it toll. For some this might feel unsafe but I think that if you have travelled around and live in a city you know what to expect. Me and my girlfriend never felt unsafe at night and felt very welcome during the day. Would recommend anybody who's looking for privacy and a more real side of NYC.
The place was bit shady, but overall good experience !!! Subway, food are near to the place so it was ok

Jan is a great host and a very inspiring and hardworking woman. Toiletries are provided and the location is only 5 mins from the subway station. The Bronx is a good location to have a view on the non touristy side of New York, but not to be afraid of.

The apartment is beautiful. It looks exactly like the pictures but here are some things that made my stay unpleasant.   - Air conditioner: it was on when I arrived which was great I was greeted by a  cool welcoming  beautiful space. However,  it’s an old ac so it louder than the two I have at home.  A loud ac unit isn’t a big  deal normally. Until night when I was sleeping  unaware that the ac was on energy saving mode. So the ac fan turned off and on (very frequently and very loudly) through the night .  It’s wasn’t until 4am, after several failed attempts to sleep through it I dragged myself out of bed to change the settings. Once I changed the settings. It was fine, but  it took me another hour to go back to sleep. Then….  - construction: Now before I arrive she did tell me that there was construction around neighborhood the might make it difficult to park. I didn’t know that the construction was in front of her apartment and that it would mess with my sleep. Construction was so loud it woke me up at 7am. Now that isn’t her fault. However,  It would have been nice to know about the construction prior to booking the stay . She mentioned street noise… yeah it’s the city I expect that. Construction isn’t what I consider to be street noise.    - cleanliness; I found dust and crumbs on the tables that made  very nervous that the apartment wasn’t  properly cleaned prior to my stay. It made me fearful of the bed lining. I wasn’t sure if the lining had been changed but through farther inspection the sheets looked okay. She even provided extras. Although there was no real blanket provided just one small throw.   - No towels or wash cloths ; Now she didn’t  list that she offered that. I kind of assumed that she did because I have never been to an Airbnb listing that didn’t offer it. I didn’t bring my own because I assumed it was available. Not her fault, but it was just something I wish I knew before booking.   -projector; I was really excited to use the projector and that just did not go well for me. I could not prop the projector up on the right amount of books to make the picture show up properly on the screen. I  ended up scrapping the idea and just watching my movie on my laptop.    One a good note. The apartment is nice and the area is nice. Restaurants  and coffee shops everywhere.  Bee is very responsive and kind . She was very accommodating when I asked if I could arrive earlier.  I  like her , which is why I feel bad that my review isn’t more glowing.  She even offered a discount on a future stay for my troubles. However, I personally wouldn’t stay again, it left a bad taste in my mouth.

This is a scam and was the worst living experience I've ever experienced. Stay away. You're better off staying in a hotel.   Here is the list of things we faced: - Brown undrinkable water - Mice on the loose - Constant cockroaches, rodents, bed bugs, and other unidentifiable insects - Missing shower curtain - Lack of toilet paper - Broken toilet - Lack of soap - Dirty bedsheets with prominent stains  - Broken and beeping smoke detector - Fake bedrooms: the "rooms" are just beds with short curtains - there are no doors and no privacy.

We arrived and they gave us an apartment that was not the one in the photos, the entrance smelled bad, the sheets and pillows were dirty with the smell of humidity and dirt, the bathtub drain was blocked and it took half an hour to lower the water. At night rats came out, when we called to resolve the issue of the rat they only gave us adhesives so that the rat would remain stuck and we would take care of killing it and removing it from the adhesive. There was only one channel on television, the internet didn't work at first, and when they solved the problem it didn't reach the entire apartment, the curtains were dirty and the windows had no visibility because they were very dirty, they never cleaned them, on top of that when we arrived they charged us a cleaning fee that we didn't understand. The kitchen cabinets were falling apart and the bedroom closet, the door fell if you opened it with the risk of being hit, I could say a thousand more things but I would never return, a filth of an apartment When arriving at the apartment, I noticed pictures very different then actual place. Apartment does not match standards of pictures and I pay to have apartment cleaned and when I arrive the place was very dirty. When showering the drain was clogged and the water will not go down. Also the internet was extremely slow and only worked in the living room, you could not have access to internet in the bedroom also the tv only had one channel to watch so no cable or even basic television.   The cleanliness of the apartment was horrible. The pills were old, used, and dirty and the sheets and blankets were not clean either. Also worst part is there was a mouse running all over the apartment with glue traps around the apartment.   I do not recommend this apartment, you are not getting what you pay for and pictures are extremely deceiving. STAY AWAY!!!!

I lived in the Murray Hill Bedroom with 3 other girls. Given that there was only 1 bedroom, it was a bit of squeeze, but the pictures were accurate.   There were definitely many issues that we did not foresee and that were never resolved. One, wifi only worked for half the apartment and this was never fixed, despite multiple complaints and communications. There was no talk of a refund of price for this either. Second, the stove was broken and our host ended up only giving us a lighter to fix the problem. Also, the host was incredibly rude and cursed my roommates when they asked that these things be fixed. Third, mail couldn't be sent to the apartment. I actually had lost several packages before I realized this. However, I did send some to the host's apartment and he brought them over, which was nice of him. Fourth, the shower was clogged and the water kept switching from incredibly hot to incredibly cold.   All in all, it was a very uncomfortable stay given the number of people living and the oldness/issues with the apartment. It was incredibly hard to communicate with the host, and we had to swallow many of the issues we faced. Given how many experiences I've had with Airbnb, this by far the most unpleasant one. For the price, it was semi-expected especially for an old building. The only positive from all this was that it was in a great location.

My girlfriends and I booked this hotel for a girls weekend away in the city. We arrived late on a Friday night and started to play music off a laptop as we were talking and catching up. About 30 minutes in, we receive a call saying that we are being too loud and will be kicked out of the hotel if there is another complaint. As it was late evening, we immediately turned down the music and were confused as we did not think we were loud in any way. As adults, we were shocked that we were being threatened to be kicked out of a hotel we had just arrived at.   We spoke with management in the morning and they were apologetic but it tainted our experience and caused unnecessary stress. We did enjoy the lovely shuttle service and the great room, but I think the listing should be clearly advertised as a family hotel with a strict noise policy. The unrealistic expectations caused stress and tension in our trip that could have been avoided if the listing was clear.

The hosts are very friendly. My flight arrived very late, landed at 3am, but Maria was awake to let me in without being grumpy. Location is in a good area of Manhattan although it's a 10-15 minute walk to the subway. The room and bathroom are clean, bed was comfortable. No real negative. They do have a baby which in theory could be unpleasant for a guest, but they make sure he isn't disruptive and my stay was fine.
Marias place was awesome for our four day trip. If you're not scared to learn the subway system this is a prime location to be.  Bed was huge super comfy.

It was our first time staying with Fabrizio (I say "first" bec we'd definitely try booking with him again) who was a very lovely host. He was away during the stay but stayed in touch and arranged for check in/out with his friend, Anna.   *Great communication. Fabrizio and Anna were incredible at communicating throughout the stay. Both checked in multiple times to ensure that everything was going well. Anna even made a list of places throughout the city to visit, very thoughtful. *Apartment was very clean. All linens were like new, very fresh and fluffy and in perfect condition. The space was also exactly as presented in the photos. *Located in Chinatown. An easy walk to Little Italy and a 10 minute walk to Nolita and the Financial District. Plenty of coffee shops/restaurants/bars within a mile radius, which is very convenient. However, it may not be an ideal location if you're travelling solo - the apartment and the building itself was secure, there seemed to be some sketchy going-ons on the block at night time. Wouldn't suggest walking on your own past 9pm, but it's fun to walk around the block and the whole area during the day. It's a veritable foodie destination (of course, it's Chinatown!) and you're right next to Xi'an Famous Foods!

The apartment is close to the subway, it takes a while though to reach central Manhattan. Getting around in the neighbourhood is easy, there are lovely places to explore even for returning NY travellers.   Getting in the apartment was a bit complicated. Finding the keys and access card at the security box was good, but arriving at the apartment  we could not open the door also considering Emilys advise. Well, we got getting used to it...  The size of the condo is perfect for  a couple or friends for a couple of days. There are two super markets around, also a liquid store. 2-3 nice cafes. We did not see any nice restaurants or bars, but that may have been due to holiday. Also bakeries and subway were closed.  Unfortunely we did not find the apartment totally clean, especially in the bathroom. The cat was not in the apartment during our stay, there was lots of cat hairs though. Unfortanly also on blankets, what I -despite loving animals- very much disliked just as seeing them in the bathroom. We were pretty much afraid of bugs running around as described in Emilys house manual, but we did not see any.   Emily was very nice snd helpful. We did not meet personally, but she was available per sms and phone and mail all the time. She answered all questions very quick, moreover it was very nice to offer keeping our luggage some more hours on our departure day because of very late flight departure. The off  to make use of magazines, books, cosmetic stuff, yoga stuff, some things in the kitchen.... is very cool.

My friend and I had a great stay at Jets. The room was so spacious and clean and bright! It was also really cute and the bed very comfortable. We never felt unsafe walking in the area, even at night. It is a quick 15 min walk to the subway which takes you directly into Manhattan easily.  Jet was great to communicate with, giving all the information we could possibly want. We have no complaints and would definitely recommend!

Gregory welcomed us in a friendly manner and in German. His family is also very nice. Since we like cats, we were very happy about the tame tomcat who happily joined us. Everything was clean. We felt very comfortable in the accommodation, there is no need to be afraid in the residential area either. The subway station as well as breakfast and dinner options are within walking distance in just a few minutes. We would definitely recommend the accommodation.

Overall great location, and an excellent building with great amenities. I was not sent check-in instructions until the day of, which was an unecessary stress, especially after trying to reach the host several times beforehand. However, once sent, the instructions were clear cut and everything that was promised was delivered. Would consider renting again.

We had a wonderful stay at Mercy’s studio apartment in East Harlem.  First Mercy was very accommodating around my check in time ( I really appreciated that).  She was helpful with info about local transportation, grocers nearby.  The location was very convenient- only 2 blocks from subway. I never felt unsafe in the neighborhood.  The studio was very cute, the perfect size for 3 people.  The full kitchen was great.  The apt was clean, and the hot water in the shower was great.  There was some street noise, ( it is NYC after all), but not terrible.  The bed/ couch were a bit soft for us, but this was a minor issue for us.  I heartily recommend staying here.

Julia and Rich's  was incredible!  The house has lots of open space and has a very cozy feel to it.  Plus, the backyard is amazing!  We'll definitely be stealing some ideas from Julia and Rich about how to make our own home more appealing.  The location was very convenient and next to an incredibly vibrant area of Brooklyn.  5 stars doesn't do this place justice.  I couldn't be happier with the experience.  Thanks guys!
Our stay was amazing and stress free! Front desk is super responsive to questions and the rooms are beautiful. Thanks for a great stay!

What an awesome hotel! We got to the hotel and w head found out they bumped us up to the presidential suite, the nicest room in the hotel! We had our own private roof top deck that looked out onto the east side of Manhattan, beautiful! Nigel made check in easy! The recommended steal house was the best steaks We have ever had and they even provided a free shuttle, a beautiful new Mercedes SUV, to get their and back. The room was clean, and it felt like home! I didn't want to leave!

The Henry Norman is a gem!  We have been visiting Brooklyn a few times a year over the last 10 years and have stayed in a variety of hotels and rentals.  Their accommodations, proximity to where we wanted to be and space has made this one of our top favorite choices.  The deluxe room was spacious, cheerful and well layed out for work and leisure.  We found a wonderful grocery store and wine shop a block away and comfortably prepared breakfast and snacks.  Staff was welcoming and friendly and the polish bakery near by provided dangerous temptations. We will definitely return.

This is an extremely noisy accommodation. The avenue in front is very busy even at night. In addition, the wooden floor between the two floors is very poorly insulated, so the slightest noise from neighbors is felt. The front door lock is broken and not secure. The stove is dangerous because it closes poorly, and therefore sometimes has a strong smell of gas. Finally on the last day of our stay we asked Jason for a solution to store our luggage because we didn't have our plane until the end of the day. Answer “you must leave the premises at the scheduled time”

Harlem is a neighborhood that is a little far from the most commercial and tourist places in NY, however, there is no problem getting to and from the apartment using the subway since the service works exceptionally. The apartment is not located in an unsafe area, it is not dangerous to arrive at night and the neighborhood is beautiful and picturesque, do not be guided by negative opinions about the neighborhood. The apartment is comfortable, the heating works well in winter and it has several kitchen utensils so that eating there is not a problem. I stayed with my girlfriend and the truth is that we were very satisfied with our stay there.  However, I don't know if I would recommend it for 3 people, collusion in the same environment with so many people can become difficult, and the chair is not comfortable enough to sleep on. Guirlaine and her nephew were very attentive and even welcomed us very late in the morning on the day of our arrival and helped us with our luggage.

My stay was very good. I was afraid that the location would not be good, but in New York, being close to a subway station, you are close to everything. It is close to lines A and D, which are express and only stop there at night, to lines B and C, which always stop there and have a good frequency, and 3 blocks from the red lines 2 and 3. At one point we had a problem with the Wi-Fi and they solved it right away. Communication was always very good and Guirliane was always super attentive. He also brought us extra towels on his own merit. I would stay again without a doubt.

Everything about Jason’s place was perfect. He responds quickly and conveniently and does whatever he can to help you out with any problems. His staff members are very welcoming and kind. They make you feel at home and it was good to have that. It was clean and we were the first to have access to the 2nd bathroom which helped A LOT considering there was a bunch of us staying for the weekend. My only problem was it was just a really bad area flooded with crime. I’m not blaming Jason at all either because it’s not his fault. Just a warning to anyone that would want to adventure outside @ night lol. Felt safe in doors though, just not outside the premises whatsoever.

I made a last-minute reservation here so that I could attend a weekend event north of Prospect Park.  With two large suitcases and a backpack, the walk from the nearest subway station to the apartment took me 13 minutes (Google Maps says it takes 14 minutes). The location is perfect for anyone visiting the Prospect Park/Park Slope area.  The apartment is on the first floor in a nice residential neighborhood.  If you plan to cook, as I did,  just 3 minutes away walking is an active commercial street with a well-stocked (including very fresh fruits and vegetables) grocery store, and a large fruit/vegetable stand just down the street, etc.  I also counted  more than a half-dozen churches nearby . I was surprised that another reviewer felt unsafe.  That was certainly not my experience.  The apartment itself is quite lovely with a beautifully updated kitchen/dining area, fresh paint throughout, plenty of lighting and space, and nicely decorated.  The price is right for an entire apartment with 3 bedrooms and 4 large beds.  As the Airbnb website indicates, it costs about the same as a single room in some of the least expensive hotels in Brooklyn or Manhattan.  I was on my own this time, but would stay here again visiting NYC with my wife or with my wife and friends.  The subway ride to midtown Manhattan is about an hour, but for the cost, the amount of space, and the quality of the apartment make it attractive as a place for me (and friends) to stay when visiting the museums, the theater, etc in Manhattan.

Jason is very responsive both through messages and call. The place looks just like pictured and is very spacious and clean. He also let us leave our bags at the house even though we arrived a few hours before check in time. We specifically chose this place because it has two bathrooms and beds for all 7 of us (plus the addition of sofa beds). The house is about 15 mins away from the subway station and about 45 mins train ride to manhattan, but considering the traffic, a car ride would take about the same amount of time. The upstairs neighbor were very loud the first night we were there but Jason was very helpful in reminding them and we no longer had noise issue the rest of the stay. There were occasional distant police siren throughout the night but we did not feel unsafe at all while staying in the area. There are plenty of grocery and convenience stores nearby as well.
Perfect size for 2, maybe even 3, people. The apartment was clean and smelled nice. Not in the best area but I never felt unsafe in the apartment.
The apartment is clean and nice but the area is somewhat unsafe.

An absolute disgrace to Airbnb service, the host rooms discretion does not match the real situation, i swear this is the truth and nothing but the truth .  Ten reasons not to stay in this place ..  1- rooms does not fit a rabbit ( no place to stand / no place to put your bag / no separate AC to the room / not enough light only one tiny little very small candle light and thats it ) 2 - the bed does not fit humans. Less than 180 CM . 3 -There is only one bathroom that includes one toilet and two showers thats it ( the showers does not have a door only curtains  !!!! Same for the  the toilet it is not sealed door opening !!!!!!! And not clean at all . 4- the staff is the worst staff on earth ( two old creepy guys in my floor who speaks from their nose ) but the receptionists was nice all of them  5 - no elevators at all 6 - no garbage cans in the rooms and also no tissues !!!!!!!  7-No door lock for the room from the inside !!!!! Only auto lock not a key lock 8- the rooms are open from above ( any one can break your privacy at any time ) you can hear the breath of your neighbor. Also you can hear each and everything that happens around you, you cant even sleep at night due to the lights from outside.( horrible ) , doors slamming and opening all what you can imagine to hear!!!!  9- no safe in the room and the room cant be locked from out side !!!!!!! 10 -not allowed to eat in the rooms.  Simply it was the worst currency i have ever ever ever spent, it only worth 20 dollars or less per night.

This is a hostel with an interesting set up. Each floor is made up of multiple, tiny private rooms ('cabins), but the walls that separate all of them only go maybe  halfway to the ceiling. So all the rooms share a common ceiling area where both air and noise travels freely between cabins. For this reason, the cabins themselves are 24 hr quiet areas - no conversation with roommates or over phone, no TV or music unless you have head phones, etc. There are nice common areas including a lounge with TV and a really pleasant rooftop garden area where you can talk on phone, sit down to eat, etc.   24 hour front desk staff were extremely nice and frequently asked if I needed help with anything, especially getting transportation or finding my way around the city. Whole building seemed very clean and well kept. Bed was decently comfortable, the building was kept pretty nice and toasty (I visited in winter, brrr!).  I stayed from Wednesday night thru Sat morning, and the only time there was anyone making noise at night was Friday. Staff were pretty good at doing some rounds and telling people to quiet down. But people did continue to come in at all hours of the night and just due to the setup, you hear everything, including guests who obviously enjoyed the NYC nightlife. I would say honestly this is expected for a hostel, and it was still quiet enough that my sleep wasn't too disrupted.  The do provide a pair of earplugs in each room along with a bottle of water.   Location was super convenient to multiple subway stops including the J train (goes to JFK), F train to Brooklyn, and the 6, which can be used to get to go all the way to upper East side, and connects to almost all the other Manhattan lines at different stops. Locally, you are in easy walking distance to Chinatown, Little Italy, SoHo, and lower East side. Plenty of food, bars, and shopping in easy walking distance. The street the hostel itself is on seems a tiny bit shady, but I never felt genuinely scared or unsafe or anything, and I am not from a big city so that could also be my bias.   My only real issue staying here was that the water temp in the shower flipped from burning hot to freezing cold repeatedly even during my short shower. So, you know, just be prepared for that if you stay here, and take fast showers.

It's not bad.. I recommend BUT on the other hand it's not in the photos but at the ceiling level there is none..! they are grilles, so you can hear everything (as if you were sleeping with the neighbors) including snoring... and those who come in making noise. And big downside: I'm a girl and I was put with the guys. It really wasn't great. I didn't dare say it at reception but I was afraid. It's probably because they didn't know if I was a woman or a man according to my profile photo (and my nickname could be confusing...) but a minimum would have been to warn me, or to ask me... if I had been among the girls it would have changed everything, that's for sure. (snoring, smells, noises are not the same...)

Sorry but I can not recommend anyone to ruin their visit to NY by staying here. The front desk staff was very helpful and courteous but everything else was terrible and grossly misrepresented. The rooms are stalls without roof and too small and incredibly noisy. There are several flight of stairs and no elevator. One woman I met told me she moved floors because of bugs in her room. There was drug paraphernalia and heavy drug addicts by the front door. Unfortunately I did not have time to move hotels and didn’t sleep for three nights which made me sick.

Great place to stay! The loft is so cute, stylish and comfy. Toby and Drew were amazingly hospitable with such thoughtful personal touches like flowers, a card and champagne for an anniversary celebration.   We never felt unsafe in the area even when walking very late at night. There were metro stops a few blocks on either side of us. Getting around was super easy. Thank you Toby and Drew for everything! You made our stay super easy :)

We had a good and bad experience with this listing. First let me describe all the good parts:  The Good: 1. Host was fantastic with quick responses and resolution of issues 2. The location of the listing is close to the subway which takes you directly to Manhattan 3. Free street parking right outside the house  The Bad: 1. The house is not very clean. Bathroom was dirty, and we didn't feel like using the kitchen or the living room since our overall perception of the house was that it wasn't clean. For the price we paid - $143 CAD/night we didn't feel it was worth it at all.  2. The house is on the ground floor and entrance is through under a set of stairs which is a bit creepy with no lights to get in after dark.  Overall: We felt we should inform the host about our issues after the first day there. (We didn't live in at all, we ended up staying at a friend's place for the first night). After we informed Whitney, she immediately offered us a refund for the second night that was still unused. We found this to be fair.

Staying at Sandra's place was truly amazing! It is quite a walk up the stairs, fair warning for anyone taking lots of luggage, like myself. But I knew what to expect beforehand, so no biggie.   Checking in was easy, she gave me very thorough instructions on how to get the key and where the apartment was.   This was my first time traveling solo and I couldn't have asked for a more welcoming AirBnb host! Sandra made me feel right at home and was always very sweet, kind, and helpful. The pictures she posted accurately represent the place.   The rooftop area was awesome! I would have breakfast or even late dinners up there and it was just wonderful =)  I never felt unsafe in the neighborhood, even when coming or going early/late. Having NYPD next door helped, but even then...very nice neighborhood. Make sure to check it out, not just Manhattan. So much great food within just 15 minutes walking or less.   I will definitely be coming back with Sandra next chance I get!

Beautiful spacious apartment with everything you could possibly need for a home away from home kind of stay. We had some complications with our booking which caused some stress a few days before we were due to arrive, but I am glad we persevered as the apartment is lovely. Very convenient for the subway and good local shops and food places.

I had a very comfortable stay at David's airbnb. I really appreciated having a private entrance and my own bathroom, with a television. There are great restaurants nearby as well and they are in easy walking distance. The 77st subway is a number of blocks away which was fine but not good if you are running late.  The only problem was that David was not at the apartment when I arrived and I rang the bell many times. I did not have wifi or a sim card to get in contact with him, so I had to go to a restaurant and asked to use a waitress' phone. That was a very stressful situation but David came back to the apartment and showed me my room.

I stayed in the room for a month.. I loved it.. it was close to everything.. shops, restaurants, Starbucks.. you have to ask David for directions of how to find the keys in advace.. it was so beautiful to find this warm, cozy, room with flowers beside the bed.. David was there to answer all my emails, when I wanted anything.. mirrors all over the place made it look spacious, although I felt creepy sometimes.. to have your own private entrance and own bathroom is a great blessing..

We just finished a four month long term rental on the occasion of having a new grandbaby in the neighborhood.  This house was perfect for our needs.  Having the entrance on the street level was great, made it easier to get in and out of the house with our bags and groceries. Although each bedroom had some level of street/backyard noise, it was very effectively dealt with using ear plugs and/or white noise devices. There was no problem at all with noise between rooms. Even with both bedrooms in use, sound didn’t carry from one room to the other. We found we could come and go, early or late without waking sleeping family members.  The closet and dresser space in each room was very helpful for our extended stay-we ended up totally unpacking, putting our luggage in the upstairs closet, having bedrooms uncluttered by not having to live out of our suitcases. There’s also another spacious closet in the bathroom hallway for overflow stuff.  The shared full bath was sparkling clean, black and white tiled, roomy with a nice shower/tub.  Plenty of towels and washcloths, as well as extra bed linens and blankets.  I really appreciated the hardwood floors throughout the house.  Upstairs, the room we used most was the kitchen with adjoining dining area. Two tables that we used  for coffee/dining, working remotely, playing board games, working a jigsaw puzzle. The kitchen was well equipped for cooking-plenty of nice dishes along with pots & pans. We made good use of the dishwasher, and full sized refrigerator and gas range & oven.  The living area is spacious, great for watching basketball on the big screen tv. I really liked being able to open the blinds in that room, lots of good light.  Having a half bath upstairs was helpful-especially at bedtime when the full bath was in demand.  The channel options were great, and Denise was very patient as she talked me through using the remote. Once or twice we had WiFi issues which Denise resolved promptly. Helpful since we had several family members working remotely.  The upstairs overlooks the lovely backyard which did not get much use from us initially-too cold in February & March. But, on the first mild days of spring, it was the perfect place to hang out to make a call, or read. Nice outdoor furniture in place to make the space comfortable.  We did not use the basement for sleeping, but did use it for work space. It’s very quiet-great for the writer in the family.  The washer and dryer were invaluable, so glad we did not have to use a laundromat.  Lastly, we really liked the neighborhood. As I walked from the apartment to our daughter and son-in-laws, I saw and spoke with many of the residents, felt welcomed and comfortable in the space. There were a few late nights, when my son-in-law wanted to walk me home. But, I never felt unsafe.  The bus stop in front of the house-B-26 was very convenient, and now that you can use a credit card to pay, it was super easy. We were between two metro stations, Nostrand and Franklin. Took the Franklin shuttle (S) to Prospect park, totally delightful! Again, no need to purchase a subway card, just use your credit card or dip with Apple Pay at the turnstile.  We had very good luck with Uber/Lyfts. And, lastly we had our car some of the time, always able to find street parking.   My favorite shops were Metropolitan CityMarket for groceries, Mixtape Shop for coffee, Korean BTSMarket on Nostrand for yummy Korean food & snacks and great flowers,  Bombay Grill is a one minute walk around the corner for Indian food, Gates Beauty Lounge for nails.

A perfect place to stay is this Apartment at Michael and Bethany's! We stayed there for two weeks and felt safe all the time. Even when we got "home" late, we never felt unsafe. The metro connection is perfect! If you plan on going shopping in New York, there is a Laundry place right opposite of the apartment, so no need to pack lots of stuff ;) we could ask Michael and Bethany anything and got quick and friendly respond. We used the little garden for breakfast and cocktails in the evening and just loved it. Actually we didn't wanna leave:) loving NYC, loving Brooklyn and loved the Airbnb-experience! Thanks, Michael and Bethany! Anni and Suse
