Little corner of paradise in a popular neighborhood of Brooklyn (although the neighborhood may be surprising at first, we never felt unsafe). The apartment is perfect in terms of cleanliness, equipment, size and location (two metro stations providing easy access to Manathan + nearby shops). In addition, Michael and Bethany, a very friendly couple, leave a binder available with all the shops, bars and restaurants near the apartment. If we ever have to return to New York, we will stay here again without hesitation.

A really beautiful little place to stay! Public transport nearby was fantastic, and their recommendations were spot on, we definitely enjoyed stopping at the Daily Press in the mornings :)  Neighborhood may look a little scary at first, but we had zero problems, and the apartment itself feels really safe! I'd definitely feel confident staying here again.

David is a great host and his place is comfortable and stocked beyond belief. It’s New York but I found it a perfect fit. The mirrors on the walls make the room seem bigger and there is plenty of closet space. The bed is very comfortable and having 4 pillows was fabulous. I’m a pillow guy and 2 just won’t cut it so when I saw 4 I knew it was going to perfect. I don’t know where he gets his towels but they were they better quality than any hotel in which I’ve stayed. David provides plenty and there are extra bed linens in the closet. He has thought of everything. I really liked the water waiting for me beside the bed. In addition to the ton of closet space there’s a microwave and refrigerator plus amenities piled upon amenities. If you forget toiletries, the bathroom is stocked like a small store. I’m pretty self contained when I travel but had I forgotten anything, it would have been there. The bathroom and bedroom were exceedingly clean too. David was there to greet me on arrival and I didn’t see again until I left which was perfect. Had I needed anything though I knew he right across the foyer. It’s a 2 floor walk up and you have complete privacy. The value is incredible and the location excellent. I will definitely stay at David’s place on future visits if there’s availability. There are also places to eat, grocery stores and drug stores nearby. The Q line stop is just a couple blocks away. Thank you David!

The place was beautiful, close to the trains, equipped with everything you might need on a trip, very clean and comfortable (amazing pillows!!!!!).  We were a little afraid to use Airbnb but after reading the reviews decided to stay at David’s.  We regret nothing about it.  It was perfect and the host even saved our bags after we checked out because we have a late flight.  Totally love the place!! We highly recommend it!!!!

Very clean and convenient spot for visitors! They really have everything in the room. I was impressed how they could fit all those stuff in a single room but won’t let you feel crowded. For those who visit NY in winter, the sound of the heating pipe might scare you at night at first, but once you know that is the sound of a heating pipe, you don’t need to worry about it anymore! And thanks to David’s partner to help me check-in at almost 1:00am.

The location is very good, and David was very friendly at his reception. He helped us carry our luggage.   The building does not have an elevator and you have to climb super narrow stairs with very small steps to get to the room.   The building has not been properly maintained and the pipes make so much noise that we had to buy earplugs because the noise sounded like hammers hitting metal and we couldn't sleep.  The photographs of the place are much better than reality. Although the sheets and bedspreads were clean, the rest of the place looks in poor condition and lacks care and cleanliness. There are some dishes but they are dirty, as is the microwave. It can improve cleanliness in the shower. Soap and shampoo were missing in the dispensers.   The most delicate and dangerous thing is that the bathroom door has a broken mirror and we suffer cuts on our hands.   Also the door to the room does not close properly.   We always had privacy but these details force me NOT to RECOMMEND this place.

Cozy and homey apartment. Everything was as described and the location is perfect. Communication with the host was clear and timely, and check in was easy and stress free. Thank you both for your hospitality and I will definitely return to your place!

Great location and space for staying the in city for the weekend. The apartment was very clean with plenty of space for sleeping arrangements.   Kim was a great host: very easy to communicate with, and left very explicit instructions that were both easy to follow and took the stress off worrying about the arrangement would work.  Would highly recommend!

This was a great place to stay for us as it was central to the places we wanted to see and visit. The apartment was spacious and very accurately depicted in the photos. Gary was really helpful and accommodating and made the experience stress-less and worry-free! I would recommend this property and definitely stay here again.

My friends and I had a wonderful stay here! In a bustling city this apartment felt spacious and welcoming. The hallways leading up to the apartment were a bit creepy but the clean, bright space was a wonderful surprise!

Best place ever! Light, modern, clean. Great beds, comfortable seats and sofa, and except for the three floors of stairs, I cannot think of a disadvantage. We went out shopping for a day and could do that straight from the apartment. Never been this close to the subway. Fifteen mins to Central Park, if it is that long even. Even our favorite restaurant in Chinatown was only a twelve minute walk. Don't get scared off by the front door, it is a great neighbourhood to live for a week. Gary is quick and easy to communicate with. Thanx so much Gary, hope to stay here again next year!

Gary's apartment is located in the best neighborhood one could wish for: it's safe, and vibrant, and hip, but not too noisy. Dozens of great restaurants and coffee shops all within walking distance. Shopping is great too! That being said, it is extremely hard to go out of the apartment as it is immaculate, and spacious (we were a very active group of three and we did not step on each other's toes what usually is the case with us when there is not enough space), and stylishly decorated - a true gem! In addition to all that, having Gary as a host was a blessing: he pays attention to smallest details, stays in touch throughout your stay in case you have any questions and makes one feel so welcomed! The apartment being a four store walk-up turned out to be not so scary as we initially thought, and there is one big advantage to it: you are further away from the street noise (my mom who is a light sleeper slept quite well). It is a tremendously great place to stay and we will definitely come back when in NYC.

We spent two nights with two adults and two college aged kids.  Most of what you need to know about this space has already been written.  This is a great space!  Location downtown in Nolita (stands for North of Little Italy) is ideal.  The front door is scary; the climb upstairs is breathtaking; but the overall experience is perfect and represents superb value.  Lot's of dining options in nearby SOHO.  My favorite was Jack's Wife Frieda for brunch on Lafayette Street, a ten minute walk away.    Gary is mostly absent but always in-touch.  Try it, you'll like it.

Great location being in Nolita:  Whole Foods grocery store, subway stations, museums, Chinatown, Little Italy,  SoHo, restaurants, coffee shops (no Starbucks, but great local coffee cafes), shooping on Broadway are all very close. Very spacious studio for 4+ people. Gary is very responsive and check-ins often.  The internet is a bit slow. The large TV has regular channels and some movie channels. The street entrance looks a bit sketchy due to grafitti but it is part of NYC and not to worry. We never felt unsafe. We had a great 10 day trip staying here.

I absolutely loved staying at The Studio. Marty was a great host. Easy to communicate with and very accommodating! The stay was very comfortable and I slept well. The Studio had a wonderful and shady patio and is really well situated in the city. I can’t wait to stay again

I absolutely loved my stay Mae's place. It was actually the cleanest hotel I've ever been to in my entire life, no joke. And the room was very unique, not the same old boaring box of a room you usually get.  There was beautiful art throughout the entire building, a lovely public terrace overlooking manhatten, and the staff are all extremely helpful and hospitable. Bed was super comfortable.  For me, the location was great. It's about a 15 minute walk and you are in the middle of north Williamsburg / Greenpointe area. Amazing food. Amazing nightlife, super safe area.  I liked staying over here because you have a lot more room to breathe in comparison to Manhatten. It's just a lot less congested, but has a lot of the same perks of Manhatten.  Hand rolled bagels are amazing by the way.  The only thing I will say is that if you need to be able to step out of the hotel and automatically be in the center of it all, this may not be the place for you. But if you don't mind a short walk (or a free ride from the hotel) than this place is perfect.  You aren't going to find a place this nice and at this price point in the dead center of town. But for my needs I loved everything about this place, including the location.  And again I can't stress enough how awesome the staff are here. They are always ready to help you out and answer questions (24 hours a day), and they do so with a spirit of service. They never make you feel like you are bothering them, which I loved. This place does a great job of hiring quality staff who are also knowledgeable of the area.

The bedroom has 2 mouse traps which is pretty scary if you hate rodents like I do. Carol told me that she never had mice, and that the traps are there for prevention but the fact that she placed them means that the house has definitely seen mice in the past. The house itself has covered windows and is pretty dark. It is filled with old furniture and fake flowers. The bathroom has mold all over and the smell of chemicals is dominant. Nonetheless Carol was a wonderful host and is a sweet person. However, if I can give an advice to people traveling to NYC, stay away from the neighborhood where this house is located. The streets have mountains of trash, and the overall atmosphere makes you speed up at night when you are walking from the subway station. The neighborhood is truly scary, which made me leave Carol’s house days before my scheduled checkout.

Carol was really kind. Room is clean and neat, and has all amenities. The neighborhood might seem unsafe for single female traveler, but it is not. There is no need to worry.  It is a bit far away from Manhattan though, because it is really deep in Brooklyn.

I didn’t have a working light in my room my entire stay. I was told to fix it myself. That was not cool. My bedding was lacking, better sheets and blankets would have been nice. I took my trash out one night and ran into a huge raccoon! Very unpleasant. It was trying experience.
Location and value are hard to match. Kimyon was very hospitable and accommodating. A lamp shade and maybe some more bedding would have been nice. Kimyons art in the rooms improved the experience.

I was very disappointed with my Air BNB experience. After being highly recommended to Air BNB by friends who raved about the experience while still skeptical; I decided to give it a try. I found a property that advertised 4 beds so I messaged the property manager and informed her that I'd be staying with my parents, husband and two kids from Saturday to Tuesday in New York. We agreed on a price and never did she disclose that there was only one bed and a broken sofa bed. Even after, I messaged her and informed her that my in laws would also be joining us on the trip. I asked several times to be reassured we'd have adequate sleeping arrangements and even asked if she had another property available to make sure we'd be comfortable specially that my parents and in laws are older. When we arrived, we were greeted with this unpleasant surprise of only 1 queen bed and a broken sofa bed. The property manager only offered to bring an inflatable mattress to solve the issue. I am very upset and disappointed by this experience. We were uncomfortable and restless all trip long due to our sleeping arrangement. Not sure if I will use Air BNB again.

First off I want to say that I LOVED the location! It's walking distance, if not situated, in the heart of Harlem and it's close to both Markus Garvey AND Central Park! It was easy to get on and off buses and into the subway stations close by so I really appreciated the location. I never felt unsafe while we were there.  The actual place itself was also great!  Very clean and cozy! It was spacious enough for me to feel comfortable everytime I came back to rest my head. The bathroom was the selling point for me. I was very pleased with the bathroom. The shower got nice and hot which was great after a day of walking in 20 degree weather!  The wifi works best in the living room space with the pull out bed. And the pull out bed for us was broken on a bottom corner of the bed but it didn't bother my friend too much.  All in all, this was a great place and I will consider it for my next trip to New York! And I would recommend this place to anyone who doesn't mind being in Manhattan but not right next to Times Square. I actually preferred it this way.  Miouly was also great with responding in a timely fashion though we didn't have to contact her for much. She made things pretty explicit before we got there! Thank you Miouly for all your help!

Wow!!  I didn't know what to expect with my first trip on airbnb.  Miouly's place was PERFECT for us.  Situated steps away from Marcus Garvey park and on a private quiet street.  Her place was very clean and orderly. Four room apt was very spacious and her communication was impeccable.   We weren't sure about staying in Harlem but we fell in love with this area.  We love the varied ethnicities and ease of transportation.  You are right in between two major subway and bus stations.  Grocery store right around the corner and steps away from Jacob Soul Food-what a great experience.  We never felt unsafe.    We enjoyed the full kitchen and good hot water in the bath.  There is nice air flow from front to the back with screened windows.    We will recommend this place to others-thanks from Texas!

Lilia was very sweet and kind. She made us quite comfortable and welcomed us warmly into her home. She has a small dog that barks when you enter but once accustomed, he is quiet and cute. The room was fine for my friend and I and the shower was hot and strong. The locality was awesome for someone who wants the real local feel, not tourist central. The area is full of shops and several 24 hour or late night super markets and drug stores within an 8 minute radius. Restaurants and shops abound including great coffee, bagels and pastries. There is even a great little Japanese import shop for those of us who miss our snacks from   Japan. Only 10 minutes to Manhattan, about 30 to Queens Chinatown and easily to Park Slope and other parts of Brooklyn for an experienced train hopper. I would stay again if Lilia would have me! An easy stay!

Spacious apartment... Bathroom and functional kitchen... Miouly very responsive: after a small problem with the toilet flush everything was repaired during the day. Some people talk about the stairs, it's far from being an obstacle... we were 2 women of a certain age (132 years between us)... and that didn't scare us and even with our suitcases... what characterizes the apartment is its impeccable location for visiting Manhattan and even Brooklyn... a tip: bus 1 which leaves from Madison, parallel to 5th avenue and which takes us to stop 125... 2 minutes from the house... otherwise on the other side the metro... 2 and 3 either towards the western part of Manhattan... all the way to the end and to the ferry... or get off at central park north and possibility of getting buses for the eastern part... go down 5th av etc... towards the museums... at the same time this accommodation allows you to discover the atmosphere of Harlem... Miouly is French-speaking which can also be a positive point... so excellent stay....
Excellent stay at Mimi's. The only thing to mention is the issue of the lock, which has already been mentioned in other reviews. At first you may feel unsafe, but then it is a calm place.
Lilia was very hospitable and gracious. The location is convenient close to Manhattan and the area is not unsafe. Recommended accommodation for its cost and quality ratio.

Pros: Communication with the host was great, quick and effective. Mimi also allowed us to stay till 5pm on our last day which was very nice. Check-in is very easy. It's easy to get to the center by bus or subway.  Cons: 1) cleanness: dirty kitchen and floors; lots of expired products in the fridge and kitchen cabinets; dust everywhere. 2) The bed is ok, but the sofa is very uncomfortable (my husband ended up with a horrible back pain).  3) The neighborhood: lots of drug addicts, we were feeling unsafe even during the daytime. Lots of garbage as well.

Megan really made her home feel like home.  My sister and I came to NY to handle some stressful family matters but her home served as a respite for our unpredictable circumstances.  Her home was very clean and the bed was so incredibly comfortable.  The coffee was absolutely delicious and the company was pleasant.  I would definitely recommend staying here because we would definitely love to stay again during our next trip to Brooklyn.  The neighborhood has really transformed and offers several eclectic places to eat and relax.

This Airbnb was located in a safe, well lit,  quiet neighborhood. The host responded pleasantly, and efficiently to email messages. Not being from New York, I didn't know garden level meant basement apartment. With that being said there was an unpleasant damp mildew odor upon entering the unit and that lingered entire stay. You could tell that the unit had suffered some water damage by the stains on the ceiling in the living room. I think the odor could be remedied with plug in air fresheners and compact dehumidifiers. The linens were not bad but gave very used dingy vibes. All white like in hotels would give a cleaner feel. Lastly, I'm not sure when the unit was last occupied but there were a few natty bugs in our faces. The first bedroom off the entryway had several fast moving baby ants. Strategically placed ant traps will keep guests from getting the willies. Overall not a terrible experience. Leaves room for improvement.

Overall it was an okay place to stay. Pros: good location at affordable price, lots of space, and everything you’d need for an extended stay (kitchen and washer/dryer). Cons: needs some updating/fresh coat of paint/deep cleaning, noise from street can be annoying at night (not a dangerous neighborhood really but we heard sirens and loud car stereos every night), and tv doesn’t have anything but Netflix and you can login to your own subscriptions if you have them (like hbo and prime) but note those are up to you to have an account for. Host easy to communicate with!

It can be scary, taking a risk when booking a stay and not knowing what you’re going to encounter.  From the very beginning of booking our stay, to checking out, the host was very attentive with a speedy response. Smooth, easy access and checkin.  Amazing place, safe surroundings.  I highly recommended anyone to enjoy Elizabeth’s place.

Staying at Daniel’s place was probably the best month I’ve had in the last year of COVID craziness. His home is absolutely lovely and in the perfect location to get anywhere you need or want. So close to amazing restaurants, parks, shopping, etc. This neighborhood has stolen my heart. He is an exceptionally accommodating host, and an even kinder person to message with. I hope to return to Daniel’s again soon!!!

Daniel’s place is in a fantastic location - lots of restaurants/shops and a subway/bus stop very close for easy transportation!  There are pots/pans, towels, stove, microwave, and dishes to accommodate long-term stays.  For the price, this place is a steal for the location. However, it is a proper NYC first floor apartment - meaning no luxury included.  Daniel as a host was very quickly responsive to any issues that came up, and even to questions before the stay which was very appreciated.  However, I do have to tell the truth. We had two mouse encounters and one large roach encounter during the stay. When we told Daniel, he was very responsive and sent three separate inspectors out. There is clearly a building rodent issue, especially on the first floor, but I spoke with Daniel and I am confident that he will be taking proactive action to irradiate the rodent issues with the building, so I suggest you reach out to him if you have concerns!

Suzanne was an amazing host! Absolutely loved staying with her. Her apartment is clean and in a lovely neighborhood of Brooklyn. She was more than helpful throughout my stay providing ideas of places to eat, feedback of neighborhoods and places to go or not go and things to do around the city. She helped make me feel at home and was always available. Her friendly personality and gorgeous apartment make this deal a steal for the price. I would highly recommend this to anyone and will definitely be back again!

Arti is a great hostess.  Her place is clean & cozy, making it perfect for a solo traveler.  A short walk to the L train, Arti's apartment is, without a doubt, the most convenient place I've stayed in quite some time.   A few minutes walk in almost any direction and you're bound to find whatever you're looking for.  Arti herself is a traveler's dream; accommodating, affable & easy-going.  Interacting with her is stress-free & pleasant.    If you're on your own & need a place to stay in Brooklyn, I'd highly recommend staying with Arti.

Pros and cons are the only way to review this listing, as it was such a mixed bag.  Cons: not enough supplies. Two towels for each guest for two weeks isn't enough, especially with no laundry.  No facecloths, no spare keys (two guests who don't plan to be together all the time need two sets of keys, we had one cut), no instructions for recycling/garbage or bags for sorting, etc. The entire apartment needs a really good cleaning. Most surfaces were grimy and that was unexpected. From the photos we expected more...doors are grubby and need wiping down, light switches, bathroom in general, etc.  The studio is a very tiny room and smells musty. We didn't use it but set up a bed in the living room instead, where we had to hang something over the windows because there are no curtains in the room, and even if it had been used only as a living room, at ground level it wasn't comfortable to have the windows exposed.   And Ivy...well, she's cute but!  Yes, we were told she sheds but her hair is everywhere. The navy pillowcases and sheets on the bed were coated in white cat hair, as was most everything else in the place. We were told not to bother with the litter box but, for two weeks?  The little room that houses Ivy's litter box and food already smelled of urine when we arrived, so after two weeks or even a few days it would have been unbearable. We cleaned it every day.  Pros: the bed in the bedroom is super comfy.  The apartment is in a great location, so convenient for the short commute to Manhattan, and as two single ladies we felt safe and comfortable, which is most important. The neighborhood is nice, and everything is so convenient.  PS Pizza on the corner offers good food at excellent value. For NY it's quiet, only heard the sound of the train at night which isn't unpleasant and actually kind of soothing.  Amy is responsive and cheerful, always replying quickly to questions by text. Overall it was ok accommodation but we didn't feel we got good value because of the lack of attention to detail. I have never had an issue with a rental from this site, and would have taken it up with someone right away, but it was Christmas in NY and it would have been difficult if not impossible to find something else on short notice. That said, we were safe, and warm enough, so it wasn't an emergency, but we were disappointed in many aspects of the apartment.

Amy's place really lived up to our expectations and its price was a steal for such a beautiful house in a beautiful neighbourhood. There was never a dull moment during our weekend stay, as Amy and Astoria provided so many things to do; a loaded shelf of board games and books, a loaded shelf of fantastics and hilarious DVDs, a loaded strip of restaurants and other eateries.  Much like Amy herself, her place had *personality*, which doesn't just mean that her bedroom walls actually had colour. It's very obvious that she has put in the time and effort to counteract the aging Queens house and that shouldn't turn anyone away from staying. Amy's cat Ivy was also a gracious host and aside from the expected loving amounts of cat hair, she was never a burden; Amy's lint rollers made sure of that. Also, shout-outs to the click-on LED light that Amy bought so that we could find our way through her bathroom; it was much appreciated! We definitely loved staying there and would highly consider returning.

We were definately made to feel welcome and even though it was in a out of town neighbourhood, we didn't feel unsafe.  Very close to Halsey train line which we used often.  We felt right at home and enjoyed our chats with Robynne.

Wonderful wonderful stay!! Cesar is an amazing host! I had a lot of trouble getting from LGA to the airbnb because of airport traffic and miscommunication with my uber driver and ended up arriving 45 min later than I told Cesar.  He stayed up and waited for me and was really nice about it.  He even had a female friend wait with him so I wouldn't feel scared coming into a guy's airbnb all alone late at night. He also carried my VERY heavy bags up 2 flights of stairs. Amazing hospitality!! The airbnb is a very quick uber rider from LGA (after you weave through the traffic and actually leave LGA). It was perfect for an overnight layover.    The room was a little warm but the ceiling fan cooled it down well enough.  The bed was SUPER comfy! The pillows are memory foam or something...they were great! You can hear some noise from the street, but this didn't affect my sleep at all.  Would definitely recommend!

Best staying in NYC, especially if you are craving for Chinese food. It closes to subway like 5mins walking and you can find a lot to fulfill ur appetite🤤🤤. You can find everything you need in the room. The room is exceptionally clean, no dust and no unpleasant smell. Judy is very helpful and responsive during our stay! Everything is just right. Definitely a place want to stay again in the future visiting NYC.

The place is great, even more spacious than it looks like in the pics. The check-in was very easy and practical, no stress about time or late planes because the keys can be picked up at the nearby cafe. The apartment is very stylish and perfectly located to enjoy Williamsburg and to reach Manhattan. It features an amazing terrace as well, facing directly on the park.  The subway stop is just a few blocks away. The neighborhood is very lively and full of nice places for shopping, eating and having a drink. Nevertheless the apartment is super quite. Strongly recommend!!! I hope to come back soon and I have no doubts on where to stay 😊

Prior to my arrival I thought Tom and I had an understanding of the circumstances of my stay. I am a single mother visiting my sister in a new city with my son.  The house was clean and spacious, but the bed was very uncomfortable, I woke up the two nights I stayed in aching pain. My second night at the house my son and I heard tv noises coming from a door next to the stairs. Some of the doors were locked as stated in the listing but no where did it state that Tom was living in the home as well. My son was scared and at the age of 5 his imagination has no limit. I messaged Tom about the noise and he told me he lives in the basement. I felt very uncomfortable that he didn’t tell me until after I asked about the noise. Which made me wonder what his intentions were. We couldn’t find anywhere to stay and it was late at night so we slept in our room with the door locked. During that night my child was restless, worried about the mysterious man in the basement. Next morning I heard Tom inside the home, WITHOUT telling me he was entering. I messaged him explaining my discomfort and he explaining he’s reasoning but I didn’t find them to be justified. I felt like I should have the right to know he was living in the basement whether he is allowed to or not. Especially since I had my child with me. We couldn’t enjoy the rest of our stay because I felt like my privacy was violated and we ended leaving the home. Only staying for two nights instead of 4 nights and 5 days. I hope in the future he will provide this information in his listing. He may not have seen anything wrong with it but from my experience, it was a frightening and creepy situation that I wouldn’t wish on any one.  It been a week since our stay and last night my son mention “the man in the basement” and he made sure I checked his closet before going to bed. My child has never asked for that before and it honestly hurt me that he has been effected like this. I hope my review can help the next person to be cautious and ask many questions!

Our hosts where really comunicative and nice. The process to do the check in was clear and easy and they allow us a late checkout without any problem.  The apartment is located at a six minute walk from a subway station and two minute walk to thebbus stop, so it's really easy to get around. The neighborhood can look a little bit scary late at night, but we don't have any problem. For us it was a real NYC experience of the hood. The restaurant downstairs, Maxwell was really good,  as a It is  a Mexican restaurant  "El encanto de Lola".  It is a cost-efficient AIRBNB apartment, is big to NY standard (two bedrooms and two baths). The common space can be a little hot on August cause it doesn't have an A/C unit on the common areas.The building is under big renovations but it doesn't affect the apartment, we haven't noticed  any noise and the only signs of construction were the "naked" lobby and a plastic sheet over the new corridor rugs. The beds are comfy, and the bathrooms are clean, with the fastest hot water service we have ever seen.  The living room and the dining room have seen better times, but serves their function without any problem.  Our only concern was with the cigarette odor on the main bedroom. We know that maintaining control over that can be difficult, but it will be great if something is done with it.  I recommend this property as a real  NYC  experience on a fair price.

Tom, the host, was very kind, friendly, and accommodating. The house is large, roomy, and definitely a steal for the price.   The upstairs area can get hot and stuffy, but there is an air conditioner in the bedroom which makes it very comfortable in the NY summer.

Norma was a wonderful host! She went out of her way to make us feel at home. We stayed with her because our home was under construction, and staying with her really made a stressful time more relaxing. This was our first time using AirBnB, and it was a very pleasant experience.  The room is large and comfortable, and the private bathroom is convenient and a great amenity. The garden out back is a great place to sit and relax. The home is in a pretty, tree-lined section of the neighborhood. There are plenty of places to eat in the commercial district just a block away. There's a subway stop a few blocks away.  All in all, this was a great experience. Don't hesitate to book with this host if you're looking for lodging in Jackson Heights.

Tom is extremely communicative and very flexible with check-in and check-out. The house is perfect and the subway is very close. It was a great stay and I would definitely rent with Tom again! You will not regret it!  Just be careful with the subway after late at night because it seems a bit dangerous :)!

My experience with Tom was perfect. He is kind, welcoming, easy to understand, and very responsive and answered all my questions. He is a great gentleman just living life to the fullest. Always was happy to assist us if we needed anything, and very flexible with check in and check out time. His rules are well laid out and directions are very clear and easy to understand. This was my first booking on Air BNB and I couldn't be happier that i booked with someone so caring and polite. The bed was made basically military style & comfy pillows. The home was quiet and spacious. Tom was present at all times and i never felt scared. He made everything easy on me in terms of finding a great place to stay for our trip that wasnt super expensive. Everything was super clean and comforting. We felt very at home. It was nice to experience different culture in a bigger city that does things differently than we do. Thanks to Tom and his home we had an amazing trip. I highly recommend booking with him.

We had a very comfortable stay at Zovia's house in Staten Island. We absolutely loved the ample space and the modern style of the decorations of the house. The kitchen was awesome and fully equipped. As you know Staten Island is a little far from Manhattan, but Zovia's place is conveniently located at a 5-minute walk from the bus to the ferry. The neighborhood had everything we needed, from banks, restaurants, grocery stores, drug stores, etc. Communication with Zovia before and through our stay was very efficient.  Overall we were very pleased with our stay and we are happy to recommend Glorious Mornings Townhouse to everyone!

If you want to save money this place is okay. The neighborhood is a little sketchy. It takes 30-35 minutes on the bus to get to the ferry and then another 25-30 minutes to get to the lower end of Manhattan. At the end of a long day in the city, it's not fun to have an hour commute back to this unit. The upholstered furniture was dirty and rickety. Floor rugs were dirty. Third bedroom has no closet or dresser and not even a bedside stand. Kitchen is very nice and stocked well. Bathrooms were ok. Off street parking was good. Was quiet at night.

The communication with Tahirou was good and worked via Email. I had a very warm and nice welcome, got a towel, fresh cold water, wifi pw, the appartment keys and some information. The appartment is easy to reach from the 135th metro station day and night and I never felt in danger walking outside.  You have to walk some floors via stairs to reach it, did not see any lift so it might be difficult for some people to go up / down. The room was small but completely ok for some days with also an air condition device, shared bath room with Tahirou but no problems. I perfectly could dive immediately into the New York's nightlife from there. Thanks to the nice host Tahirou.

Dor is great host! - super responsive, efficient and helpful. The place is nice, it has personality and charm and last but not least a really great thick mattress. To note there is a single restroom and you could be potentially flat sharing with other airbnb guests taking the other room in the flat. The flat is well located in Manhattan, close to some of the must sees and there are several nearby metro stations to go further . Attention point is coming back very late at night where there could be homeless people in nearby side parks, though personally i have never had any problems with them. Also the building is quite safe, with cameras inside.

The apartment is cute and in a great location close to a lot of restaurants, drug stores, and shopping. It's two blocks to Union Square which is a cool place to hang out. It's within walking distance to pretty much anywhere in Lower Manhattan, and there's an 'L' train in front of the building to get on the subway.  The hot water in the shower took a little getting used to but we got the hang of it right away. The street is pretty noisy but that's not surprising given the great location.  The bed was firm and comfortable.

This is an amazing private room, with private bath, and entrance to the balcony. The location is awesome, with great restaurants, and bars within walking distance. Unfortunately we had a couple issues like, the wifi not working which caused the TV not to work. Yet, the biggest issue was us loosing power in our room! We were the only room in the entire apartment with no lights. When we tried to contact ronald he wasnt able to respond till 10am the next day, but we had already left the apartment. We had enough stress as it was getting dressed for NYE in the dark. In his defense it was NYE, so he probably was busy.

I’m glad I didn’t pass up this space based on the two negative reviews I read. The space was very comfortable and clean.  When I arrived the host took my temperature to assure Covid safety (thank you). After the temp check he provided keys (multi-day stay) and gave the rundown of the apartment from towels, bathroom and fixtures, and how to exit and secure the property.  Note: Due to Covid he has taken the discretion to not include the kitchen. Honestly, I wouldn’t have people cooking in my kitchen either BUT he does provide an awesome Ovente water heater and cups for tea (he gives you 2 tea bags) or coffee which I provided myself.  The shower has excellent water pressure and the bathroom is clean.   His mother is a very sweet lady and keeps the place clean—she was there but you rarely see either of them. As far as the truth goes—you are renting a room space and the use of the bathroom for literally the cheapest listing in Astoria. Don’t spend too much time worrying about who lives in the hosts home or if his Airbnb is legal or not. Relax and enjoy—You’re in New York City. If the closest you’ve witnessed as far as a crime in NYC is an illegal Airbnb then God has truly blessed you and this is the safest neighborhood you’ll ever be in. It’s like calling the police for stolen laundry—no one cares and neither should you.  On that note the host owes no explanation for his mother being in his house. Based on the previous reviews I knew she would be there and it’s not any of my business as to why she’s  and if she’s visiting or not. Just say “the lady you’ll see in the main part of apartment is my mother.”  Oh—THEY HAVE GREAT STREET PARKING!!!!!!!!!!! Parked every night with ease and no tickets.  As far as the rules. Please read them carefully. They’re not oppressive but are meant for comfort and safety. Just remember Airbnb’s are LIKE hotels but are NOT hotels. With stating that you are entering into someone’s home with their family as a GUEST in a ‘prearranged’ situation. Even with traditional Airbnb’s you are not allowed to bring in unannounced strangers. It’s for everyone’s safety. Don’t do it—you will be kicked out. Most hosts in NYC follows this practice.  Back to the fun part the apartment is in a good area of Astoria. Should you need any food recommendations in the Area please visit Titans Foods 25-56 31st St (around the corner) where they serve authentic Greek Food. You are also about 10 minutes from Jackson Heights where you can find many different ethnic Latin shops and Indian Food.  There is a 24-hr laundromat across from Titan Foods with Parking. If you (women) show the clerk a little attention he will give you a free scoop of detergent (as witnessed). For the men—it’s $1.25 from the machine in the back of the location.  To end this Please Rent this Space. The host is a great guy. Don’t expect a teddy bear. He’s very professional but he’s emotionally detached and I honestly believe he wants you to be comfortable...but ‘no conversation’. You don’t want to really be bothered and I don’t think he does either. But I could be wrong—like I said before I only saw him twice for less than 5 minutes combined.

This stay is not worth any money at all. Please don’t waste your time or effort to come here and stay at this location. The door had no lock which is very unsafe. As a guest I felt like any of my personal belongings could’ve been stolen at any moment. The bed is on the floor which is so cheap of him. A metal bed frame cost no more then $40 stop being so CHEAP! His mother is also there and she likes to set these rules that I don’t even know about. That basically makes her a cohost but I didn’t see he put that in the description. The host was also very rude to me when we first communicated and I felt like my money was basically stolen I didn’t like the atmosphere or the stay here. If I could give a zero star rating I would!

Space is exactly as described. Cozy, comfortable, and tons of character. The neighbourhood may seem a little rough at first blush, but don't be afraid to explore. I had several excellent meals at restaurants within a couple of blocks.

I have been lived in this house for two weeks with a daughter of 11 years. Very sociable and pleasant hosts. Responsive and friendly. The rooms meet descriptions and photos. Clean, without unpleasant odors. We got good neighbors)) In the kitchen, everything you need. To the bus 2 blocks. The metro is 20 minutes walk. There are three lines at a distance of 15-20 minutes by bus. A lot of shops, not so far shopping center. Very nice and safe quarter. My daughter and I often returned after 1-2 a.m. and we had feeling safe. If I'm back in New York, I'll be happy to stop at Larry and Nora. Thank you for a pleasant time in America)))

The Blue Lagoon room is great when you are students or you just want to spend whole day in the city. It is enough for sleep and also you have everything you need for cooking. You just need to accept, that your way to Manhattan will last one hour (by bus and subway). But we didn’t mind and it was great stay! Hosts were great, everything was clean and the locality was not dangerous. I definitely recommend it.

I had to leave and request a refund because the conditions were unacceptable. I thought the price was low, but not so cheap that I'd be staying in unsafe conditions. The building is in complete disrepair. The front door does not lock, so anyone could walk in at any time. There was an awful chemical smell inside the house. When we left and returned after a few hours, someone had been in the apartment and moved our belongings while we were gone. This may be a scam listing to allow for ongoing theft.

The photos are misleading. Looked nothing like we had seen. The location was OK but the whole building stink so bad I didn't want to enter. The oven was filthy and the kitchen was a mess. No cooking amenities. Unsafe stairway, dust and mold visible. Not worth the  money and do not recommend to anyone. Not even for one night.

I booked this location, it ended up being change to the apartment below without a balcony. I noticed in other reviews that Im not the first person this happened to. However, its strange that another person was staying in the apartment above that I booked with the balcony. When I arrived I told her the apartment smelled like people were smoking weed prior to my stay  just so I wouldn't be accused. Although, she has a cleaning lady I had to clean some sort of stain out the couch and wipe things down. When I asked for compensation for not having the balcony a few hours later, I was accused of throwing a party when I was just playing music off my speaker because the tv needs an upgrade too. I did turn down the music when asked. To make matters worse after checking out I was accused of damages for $500 stating that there were burns on the floor and wooden table when I wasnt near any sort of fire and I do not smoke. I would NEVER book this location again. I have booked other airbnb's & never experienced so much stress. Her communication skills are great because we were speaking so much throughout my reservation I couldn't even relax. The location is NOTHING near worth what is being charged. There no mirrors in the rooms & bathroom, shes uses a rug to cover up the kitchen floor tiles that needs some renovating. I couldnt believe I experienced this.. The apartment decorations and set up was nice and the location is cool aside from everything else.

This was to be a trip of a lifetime for our young granddaughter. Instead it was extremely disappointing because of the misrepresentation of your photos! Either change photos or update your unit. A little paint would go a long way in enhancing the look and feel of your unit. You might give a better first impression by placing the key for entry in a clean envelop! We have never been in a unit that has no top sheet ON the bed! We were forced to purchase our own towels because your mismatched towels looked and felt like something purchased at Goodwill. You need to fire your cleaning crew as a pair of underwear were found in the bathroom in the rear of the toilet area. The rickety toilet and the broken shower inclosure are unsafe! Looks like corners are cut with the one ply toilet tissue. The damaged floor is very unattractive as is one of the broken chairs (someone sitting in that chair could potentially be harmed) No full length mirror, and the mirror in the bathroom is high for a short person are other areas to improve. The terrace is great, however, the furniture is not usable, and does not meet BASIC expectations. There was no privacy as the one blind did not stay down and the other side had none- in the living area. For the price, we expected a more pristine environment. (As was shown in your pictures) Overall cleanliness was disappointing, especially in this time of COVID-19! Appreciated the early check in and the location is great, but upgrades would highly enhance your guests experience. Don’t expect what you see in the photos!

Great location and perfect for those who need two bedrooms. Giving 4 stars overall since I think there are a few items that could use improvement: 1) shade on the sliding door; 2) could use additional cookware in the kitchen like tongs and a cookie sheet; 3) bathroom is clean but a bit run down. With that being said, I would definitely stay here if visiting Brooklyn again.

Marta is an amazing host, she replies quickly the place was clean and she’s a very thoughtful person! I never felt unsafe in the neighborhood I was in which was a very important thing for me... given that it was my first time in New York. I loved having a lot of places being walking distance to me. Huge perk (especially when you’re not fond of the subway) Once again, thank you so much for making my stay in New York great

I chose Isabella's place due to the close proximity to the hospital where my mom had knee surgery done.  Her place is exactly as described and shown in the pictures.  She gave me a complete run down on her place and the neighborhood before I arrived via email.  This being my first Airbnb experience I didn't know quite what to expect, but Isabella was always prompt in responding to my various questions and requests.  Her place is accessible to public transportation and and the neighborhood is very safe.  My mom and I stayed there for an extended amount of time and felt like true locals.  I did encounter a problem returning the keys though.  The Keycafe service used for key exchange didn't recognize the fob on the keys and I was stuck there trying to figure it out while I had my mom waiting in a cab with the meter running to go to the airport.  I called the Keycafe customer service number and after 30 minutes was able to get one of the drawers unlocked so I can deposit the keys.  It was stressful start to my journey back home.

Just like the pictures.Very nice!  It was a warm, spacious, clean, safe flat just a 10 minute walk from the G train and right across the street from the neighborhood park with good access to food and markets.  Ariel was very responsive and set everything up so my stay was easy and stress-free.

The experience in the apartment can be very unpleasant because of the noise : it is as if there were no walls between the rooms and that we lived with the neighbors of the different rooms of the appartment : all in rent. The first 4 days we were awakened at 3/4 am. Then arguments and screams, not good at all. The last day someone very nice arrived, then it depends entirely on luck... There are airplanes passing by often and cockroaches in the kitchen and bathroom, but the location of the apartment in Queens is very good and the apartment is not expensive. Some positive and some negative ;)

My partner and I had a very bad experience. The place was not as described. Firstly, on the third floor, the steps are narrow so just be mindful if you have a wide suitcase. Our room was a little dusty and seems smaller than the picture, ideal for 2 days but not for longer stays. But the worst part was the ROACHES. Roaches were in the bathroom, kitchen, on utensils, literally everywhere. The second awful experience was the couple in the next room, who played loud music past 2am and also stole our food from the fridge. They used the bathroom meant for us, including our shower products which was disgusting. Ashlie told us they had a private bathroom in their room and yet they continued to use ours and make a mess. The main door to our floor was also unlocked after we locked it so it felt unsafe. Also we heard an airplane go by like every 5 min. All in all, felt dirty, unhygienic, noisy and very disappointing. Positive: easy to access with metro and Ashlie's prompt response within 24 hr

We were VERY DISAPPOINTED with our stay in this apartment!!  This apartment is not at all worth the fee for which we were charged.  We expected a much nicer, cleaner building and apartment than what we experienced.  We visit New York often,  and usually stay in hotels.  For the price we paid for this listing, we have stayed in very nice, comfortable national brand and local hotels. We were greeted at the apartment unit door by Maurice; we never met the listed host (Julia Grygori). The building is in very bad condition:  cracked, loose steps (dangerous!) that lead to the upper floors; soiled walls, doors, and floors, and trash cans adjacent to the outer entry door. The red sofa shown in the photo is very low to the ground and extremely uncomfortable. The bed (double sized) is very noisy. Simply rolling over causes creaking, crunching types of sounds.  The linens are old and the mattress pad (seen when we changed bed linens) was soiled.  Four old, thin, mismatched towels were the only bath linens provided.   As can happen in New York City at any time, the temperature outside dropped 30 degrees within 12 hours one day during our stay.  There was no way for us to turn on the heat, which made for a very uncomfortable, cold night. We were awakened, beginning at 2AM on two of our ten nights, by extremely loud, vibrating music from outside the building.  The first time we contacted Maurice his response was that he could do nothing if it existed outside the building, and he assured us that no previous guests had mentioned noise to him before.  The second night the loud music occurred, Maurice was more responsive, offering to call the police if he could locate the source of the noise. To sum up, we had to shorten our stay because we were so uncomfortable in this apartment.  For less than what we were paying Maurice per night we were able to stay in a spacious, sanitary, beautiful, comfortable hotel near Central Park-with maid service, doormen, and other amenities.

This will be the most detailed, truthful review about this apartment. Here are some things we were very happy with: 1. Very comfy beds 2. A lot of sun shining through your bedrooms - warm house 3. Very well located - you could walk almost anywhere! 4. When the lights, the toaster, the coffee pot were all broken, the host came to replace & fix out problems. He could be very helpful. 5. It was cheaper than other apartments in the area. Here are the rest - FYI ! 1. Elevators Don't be tricked - there are no elevators. We had only looked into apartments with elevators because we had SO MUCH LUGGAGE. But it wasn't there. When I asked about the elevator, "what do you expect from such an old house?" was what I got. I thought he might help for the checkout, so we told him what time we were going to leave. He said he would help, but AN HOUR AFTER we left the apartment, he asked us if someone came to help. No one had come. 2. You can smell curry in your shower. (There is an Indian restaurant on the ground floor) 3. Water pressure unbelievably low - the shampoo doesn't wash off unless you stay in there for 30 minutes. (He said he cleaned the inside to fix that but nothing changed) 4. The staircase is literally about to break down. You would be scared to walk on it with more than two other people. (I saw many cockroaches on it, too) 5. The frypan (all three of them) are in a horrific state. The host said it was not his fault and did not care for a replacement. If I get cancer I'm blaming those pans... 6. The wifi goes on and off. The host helps you with it when you ask, but i's just annoying to have to call for help every single time. 7. The sink - water takes AGES to go down. Dishwashing might flood the house 8. Sockets don't work - in one of the rooms only 2 of the 5 sockets worked. One had to be used for the room lamp (of course there were no other lights). the other two had no electricity AT ALL and the host just said that was how the apartment was built. A socket by the bed was extended from the living room behind the couch and whenever someone even goes near the sofa the socket wouldn't work, so we had to be careful using the couch, lol. You gotta bring extra plugs if you want to charge your phone near your bed. 9. Not enough room in the closet for 4 people. Should be good for 2. 10. The toilet is hard to flush. We complained, but he didn't seem to recognize the problem. 11. No balcony, no place to put your shoes, no vacuum cleaner, no washing machine, no dishwasher, fyi. ++ The host is not Julia, by the way....

My host was nice and always responded quickly but her location was close to some dangerous neighborhoods and overall I didn't have a great experience. Anyways this has nothing personal to do with the host. I never got to her place because of extraordinary events. But I really don't recommend the area.

I stayed 2-nights with my girlfriend to explore Manhattan.  This place is not appropriate for those who do not speak Mandarin (I was fortunate to get by with what little Mandarin I speak). Check-in was a bit complicated, as I booked with 'Amy', who directed me to contact her husband 'Jimmy', who then had to call his parents (elderly Mandarin folks) to let us in and provide keys. We never met Amy or Jimmy.  The bathroom was awfully dirty (strong smell of urine), the toilet was soiled, and the bathtub was grimy. We killed 2 cockroaches during our 2-night stay.  The bedroom smelled of cigarette smoke, despite being advertised as non-smoking. Overall, the 5-star rating was very misleading (how did they get so many good reviews?).  We appreciated the air conditioning in the bedroom with the summer heat, and also the privacy of the key-locked bedroom door. The location was good - only a 10-15 min walk across Flushing Meadows Corona park to Mets-Willets metro station (near Citi Field, home of the NY Mets) and a 40 min ride to Manhattan, but the park is listed online as the most crime-ridden park in NYC. We did not feel safe walking home from the metro station at night, and the neighborhood made us feel somewhat uneasy.

It is my first time to do an airbnb in New York for the reason that I am so short of my budget. Getting a place in the middle of everything with a very reasonable price is a steal. Anton was very good in communicating all the time and giving me all the needed directions even tips on which clubs to hit for my short stay... His place is very clean, accessible, and very comfortable. Cleanliness is a must to any guest.. his place is clean and very much accurate with his details. Rules are simple and easy to follow ... I love his place and I am planning to stay again at his place next time I visit New York City!

Eja is an amazing host; Airbnb should create a separate category just for him, he’s more than a super host. He made me feel at home immediately and was so friendly throughout all my stay at his apartment; plus he gave me a lot of useful advice about the city, restaurants and transportation. The apartment was super cozy and within walkable distance from the Empire State Building, Times Square and Hudson Yards. Don’t get scared about sleeping on a couch, Eja’s one is more comfortable than a bed. I would definitely recommend this place to stay, especially if you look for a good accommodation in Manhattan without spending too much.

James was a good host. The apartment was very clean and presentable. And it coincided with what was advertised. There were no unpleasant surprises. The building is very quiet, and you see very few people coming and going. And the neighborhood is too. It is one block from the Huson River and very close to the Quensboro Bridge, with beautiful views. I would only add one suggestion: include a toaster. It is very useful for those of us who are used to eating toast. Overall it's a good place to be. Greetings Ricardo Chaufan

Sevtlana’s apartment is beautiful, spacious, comfortable (we were 3 guests) and spotlessly clean. Definitely better than the pictures! Her boyfriend Dimitri lives downstairs and was readily available if we needed anything. Location is around the corner of a busy street full of markets and places to eat, literally one block from the metro (line 6) and within walking distance form Central Park too. Might not be the prettiest area but we never felt unsafe even when coming back very late at night, so have no fears on that front. Booking Svetlana’s apartment was definitely the right choice for us and we would do so again if we ever go back to NYC.

Svetlana's place was spacious, clean and quiet. I stayed with my 7-year-old son and 80-year-old parents and we all had a wonderful time. The apartment is 2 minutes from the subway and close enough to Central Park for a morning run with my son. The neighbourhood looks a bit gritty (it's true New York) but never felt unsafe. Svetlana's boyfriend, Dmitry, was very helpful, walking us to the local store (one block away) for groceries and helping arrange our travel to and from the airport. I will be bringing my family here on my next NY trip. Highly recommended.

Danica is not there when we visit but she has arranged for us to check in at ease even we are arriving late. The place is super lovely, very cool with AC , so perfect for my mom who is scared of the HOT summer temp. Very convenient location, 5 min walk to subway, and 2 stops to Mahattan. Will love to stay again to explore more of the hood.

Highly recommended! We had but a few hours at Dr Sally's as we were flying in and out of NYC within 12 hours (long story), but boy am I glad we chose her place! We - my husband, 14-month old daughter and I - were exhausted and just needed some comfort, which Dr Sally provided in spades! Although we arrived late Dr Sally was there to greet us and make us feel comfortable, and she was SUPER sweet with our daughter Clara. She really helped us out in giving us a ride to the airport the next morning too! The place itself is great, bigger than we imagined and very comfortable. The neighborhood is lovely too. Staying with Dr Sally was a real pleasure during what was a very stressful time for us, and we would love to see her again one day, because as all of the other reviews have also noted, she is wonderful :)

Dr. Sally was very friendly and didn't mind that we arrived late. We had fruit and cold water waiting for us. She got us set up with wifi and a few menus for local takeout places. She told us how to get to the metro for our trip to NYC. She let us leave our luggage there while we toured.  The place was exactly as shown in the pictures. If you arrive at JFK airport, you can take the airbus for free to the Lefferts Blvd stop then walk a short distance (about ten minutes) to her home. The area was safe (not all of Queens New York is scary).  You can hear the airplanes though. We closed the windows and turned on the fan and could still hear them. However, we were exhausted and so they didn't keep us from falling asleep.
Dr. Sally was the perfect hostess!  From the beginning, she made  us feel very welcome, and went out of her way to make our stay enjoyable and stress-free.  We had a great time, and would stay again.

The listing was better than advertised. The hosts were AMAZING!!!! Lyn was so welcoming and so warm, it made doing my rotation in Brooklyn so much smoother. The neighborhood was so welcoming and was a really laid back. Everyone I came across was super nice (outside the hospital of course).  Specifically, the home is a med student's dream as the host even has certain study guides and resources available for certain disciplines of medicine. It's a gesture that goes above and beyond and made studying for my rotation exam that much less stressful.  Especially considering how little I spent on housing, while everyone else on rotation got robbed for housing, I got a steal! I hope I get a residency in Brooklyn so I can come back!!!

Very nice apartment - I can only recommend it ! We stayed 1 full week with family of 4 (2 adults / 2 children). The apartment is fully matching the description and pictures. Big enough for 4 + luggages (and mess from the shopping !!) Very good location in Brooklyn, 5 min walk to Q and B trains that goes directly to Manhattan, and 10 min to local lines (convenient to go to financial district / departure for Liberty statue!). Shops and park close by. It is also good opportunity to discover Brooklyn, and not only Manhattan !! Denica is answering very quickly all questions we could have. Thanks to her ! From the ones that could be afraid of the law in NYC regarding Airbnb, I guess this will not be applicable to Denica's apartment as she is living upstairs !

My 17-year old daughter and I stayed with Dr. Sally for 8 days. While still planning our trip we saw from other reviews that many guests had stayed for shorter periods, and many were flying in or out of JFK, which is just a few minutes away. We were flying in and out of LaGuardia, and visiting as tourists. This meant that a lot of our time would be spent in Manhattan, so the home's location in south Queens was a concern. The many positive reviews, and the fact that we could essentially have our own efficiency apartment helped us decide to stay here anyway. We're so glad we did! The distance to central Manhattan is about 40 minutes on the "A" train, and the walk from the closest station to Dr. Sally's home is about 10 minutes. Maybe a small inconvenience, but we had already decided we were going to go everywhere by public transit anyway. The important thing is that it all felt safe, including the neighborhood. You wouldn't call the apartment and furnishings fancy, although they were more than adequate for us, and a really good value. But the best part of the whole arrangement was getting to know Dr. Sally and her husband, Dr. John. Yes, these are both professionals with earned doctorates, but the most down-to-earth and hospitable folks you could ever hope to meet. We got back one night after the local grocery had closed and they shared things out of their own kitchen. Dr. Sally drove to the subway station to pick us up several nights when we arrived after dark. And, believe it or not, she actually drove us all the way up to LaGuardia when it was time to go home. Of course we didn't ask for any of this, but she saw a need and insisted. There was also a very well-timed talk for my daughter about the value of education, courtesy of Dr. John. I'm afraid I was holding some stereotypes about what New York people are like, and it just blew us away to find such caring and giving hosts.

The apartment is really nice, very well kitted out with appliances, Netflix/cable, and even useful spices and foodstuffs left by other visitors. The location is super convenient for transport and grocery shopping. Danica is very nice and helpful and left us to our own devices which I prefer. The area appeared to us a little rough around the edges but this is because we come from a very different part of the world. In reality I didn't feel unsafe at all, and started to really enjoy the urban vibe by the time we left. Highly recommended.

For our first time using Air B&B we were very pleased! Danica was so kind and gave us some great recommendations. We are thankful to have someone help guide us through the craziness of NYC and it made it a lot less stressful!

Excellent 12 day stay at Danica's place. For our 2nd trip to New York we wanted to stay in Brooklyn and did not regret this choice. The apartment is very well located: metro station nearby, allow 1/2 hour to be in the heart of Manhattan.  Grocery stores, supermarkets, snack bars, restaurants in the neighborhood: something to stock up on at any time of the day or evening, open every day and Prospect Park (magnificent) right next door.  The apartment is spacious, a separate bedroom for two people (storage, wardrobe...only small downside: we found the bed a little too soft) through which we access the bathroom/WC, a single bed in the main room (there were 3 of us). Very well equipped kitchen, comfortable living room to relax in after a long day, very quiet and pleasant neighborhood (no worries about insecurity even late at night). We had 2 days of very hot weather and appreciated the freshness of the apartment even without using the air conditioning. Danica was very accommodating regarding the dates and times depending on our flights.  I will recommend this apartment to my contacts wishing to visit New York.

Thanks to Isabel and her kindness. We were very well received. Isabel answers all questions very quickly via what's app. The apartment is spacious, extremely clean, the beds are very comfortable. In the cupboards you will find salt, pepper, oil, sugar... On the table, apples, oranges, tea and small cakes were waiting for us. Isabel has prepared a map with nearby restaurants, bars and supermarkets.  On the corner is a small grocery store open 24 hours a day. The metro is less than 5 minutes from the apartment. This is line C which takes you to Manhattan (24/24) between 20 and 45 minutes depending on where you want to go. Moreover, this A/C line is direct from the airport (approx. 25 minutes) The neighborhood is absolutely not insecure day or night. We were with our 2 children for 1 week. We happened to return late at night, and we never felt unsafe, even on the metro. In short, what happiness!  Thank you to Isabel and her kindness. We were very well received. Isabel responds very quickly to questions by "what's app". The apartment is spacious, extremely clean, the beds are very comfortable. In cupboards you will find salt, pepper, oil, sugar... On the table there were apples, oranges, tea and biscuits. Isabel has prepared a card with restaurant, café and mini-markets nearby. At the corner of the street there is a small grocery store open 24/24 The metro is less than 5 minutes from the apartment. This is the line C brings Manhattan (24/24) between 20 and 45 minutes depending on where you want to go. Besides, this line A/C is direct from the airport (about 25 mins) The area is absolutely not unsafe day or night. We were with our 2 children during one week. We returned late at night sometimes and we did never feel unsafe, even in the train. In short, that happiness!

The stay was perfect, the apartment is really nice, we didn't know New York and were delighted. The metro is a 5-minute walk away and provides direct access to all of Manhattan, the best of the best! We took an Uber from JFK airport and it cost us €45. Small downside regarding our suitcases we were forced to pay a deposit to have them stored until our flight in the evening.

My family, my girlfriend, and I enjoyed our stay at Isabel's place. The best thing about it was the tidiness. It was super comforting to enter a cozy and clean apartment after hours of traveling. Isabel prepared all the essentials we needed, including cooking utensils, clean towels, and more. I could not ask for more. The only minor issue we had was that it's easy to hear the noise (footsteps) from upstairs in the morning. Other than that, the apartment was wonderful. Regarding the neighborhood, it is in the area that's considered as "relatively unsafe" on google map. However, it was not a significant problem since the place is close to main roads, a school, and a metro station. Overall, the stay was pleasant, and I'd recommend Isabel's place, especially to young travelers.

Isabel was a very friendly host. We had a delayed flight so Isabel waited up for us. Her help with organising our lost luggage was very much appreciated. Our apt (lower floor) was exactly as per the description.  The apartment was spacious, clean and had everything we needed.  We even had use of our own small patio to the garden so we could unwind with a drink after a hectic day. Bed Sty / Brooklyn was a typical suburban area with a cross section of locals.  We never felt threatened or unsafe.  The locals can be a bit noisy. The location of the subways were great and we used them everyday. We enjoyed our week here and would contemplate staying here again. Isabel and family were a delight.

Isabel is a cheerful host and very good advice. The apartment is as described and above all it is very clean and spacious. The metro is close which is very nice.  The area is quite confusing the first day but you get used to it quickly and there are no problems with insecurity. Positive experience Thank you Isabel

We stayed here with our 3 year old whilst visiting friends in NYC from England. Extremely spacious apartment and loved the use of Netflix and on demand channels (our daughter watched Coco on repeat). Very close to various subway stations and amenities. Full toiletries and other thoughtful touches provided. Made what could have been a stressful stay in NYC with a demanding toddler very easy!

Very clean, pleasant and spacious apartment, consistent with the description of the ad. Isabel and Lisandro were very welcoming and available if needed. The apartment is approximately 7 minutes from the Ralph metro station (Line C)... The other line is approximately 15 minutes walk. The neighborhood is pleasant. No feeling of insecurity even in the evening. Very satisfying stay. Thanks to Isabel who was very accommodating for our departure.

Our stay was really great. For the price and the space that you get in NYC, this place was a steal! It’s conveniently located next to two train stations and the neighborhood is right by Prospect Park. Tami was great with communication and the check in and check out process was so easy. Highly recommend this place!

Diane is truly awesome! Diane was so responsive, so kind, so patient, and so thoughtful. I had to email her back and forth many times while I waited for the Film Director to solidify things. I was afraid she thought I was pranking her, but she assured me she understood how preproduction for films are and kept constant communication with me - even after booking. I set out looking for a space that would make special accommodations being that most airbnb's do not allow "events".  In our case,  we were filming a Grad Student Thesis Film about 5 or 7 minutes nearby and needed a holding space for our film crew and cast members. Our main actors were teenagers and needed a safe space for their tutoring sessions. Her place does not have wifi, but Diane found a way to help the children have what they needed for their studies. She even set up a table and some chairs for them. She left them little snacks to keep them going. This was not expected, but certainly very appreciated. We also needed the space to accommodate  4 crew members who slept at the apartment overnight.  Diane brought them fresh towels and toilet paper rolls. She made sure everyone felt comfortable to let her know if there was anything we needed. This place was heaven sent. God knows what could have happened to our crew members if they did not have this place and would have  commuted by train or drove exhausted late nights to the Bronx and other distant areas. Everyone on our cast and crew was so grateful to have this apartment.  I visited the airbnb on the last night and got a great big hug from Diane. Our email exchange left us feeling like we had known each other.  I must say... I used the bathroom and it smelled like bleach, which i loved! Hahaha!  It lets me know that the place is clean! She also added a plug in for some great aromatherapy.  Diane, thank you again for opening your space to our cast and crew...not everyone was so open as you were. Much success to you Diane.  Raquel

We loved this apartment! The surrounding neighborhood (and upstairs neighbors) were a bit loud for our tastes occasionally, but we never felt unsafe or unwelcome. The apartment itself was clean, welcoming, and comfortable, and more spacious than we were honestly expecting.  Would stay here again!

Very very good !!! The flat was clean, the neighbourhood is a normal one, no dangerous, 0 problems, the girls were very very friendly, 5 minutes walking to the subway station, 0 noises and very pleasant to atay there, I would go back If I have !!! Definetely !!!!

We stayed in this apartment for a week, but we were unable to meet our hosts because they do not live in the apartment. It's actually a roommates' apartment. Unfortunately we were unlucky because the apartment was not clean when we arrived, sheets not changed, bathroom in a terrible state, cleaning not done etc. So a very chaotic start, Tee was understanding on the phone and sent her sister Morgan to restore the situation. After 3 days, things were back to normal. On the other hand, the apartment is located on the 4th floor without an elevator, so it is difficult with suitcases. Another negative point: the bedroom door doesn't lock, so it's a bit stressful. Bring kie balls for sleep because the street is extremely bright with very poorly soundproofed windows. There are no shutters on the windows either, so forget about sleeping in. The apartment is suitable, but it's a shame that it turned out this way.

We stayed in this place for a week in early June 2017. The place was very noisy and often felt unsafe when going back to the apartment at night as there were people who were always sitting on the front door smoking joints and making noise until late at night. Also the apartment itself was not that great, whenever anyone walks in the apartment or the apartment above, you can hear it. People above the apartment kept us up most night with the walking. Although we paid for cleaning our apartment was never cleaned during our stay.   From our experience I would not recommend to stay in this apartment.

Perfect,  Akemi is a fantastic host!! She invites me to her Jazz performance day. It was really great.  And Harlem is not really dangerous anymore I think, at least this area,  I walk around 12-1am sometimes, and with no issues   Her bathroom is a little bit need to be improved but be honest, it's NYC. Everyone has similar conditions bathroom😂  And the location is also great. Sub station is realllyyyyy close.  I visited the Central park almost every morning, and super close   Highly recommend, this place makes me feel exactly live in really NYC.

I highly recommend this place.  Harlem is no longer in danger.   This house is spacious and clean.  And it's very close to two subway stations and many bus stops.  There are also restaurants, supermarkets and laundrys that are open until late at night.      This house has a great view and plenty of sunlight. In particular, you can see a wonderful view in harmony with the lower sky, the large trees, birds, white clouds and building façades.  You can also see the downtown buildings.   You can see it from the room windows, but it's even nicer on the rooftop. There is an excellent rooftop. You can also see a wonderful sunset and a wonderful sunrise.   The location here is really really good.  The host is very friendly and nice dude. I highly recommend this place.

Nice place and affordable! My friend and I are happy with our stay! The apartment had Japanese books and manga, which was pretty cool to see. The bed was so cozy to sleep in with a feather blanket and feather pillows. I was glad that Ippei walked us though the apartment the day we arrived so we would know what to expect. My favorite part of the apartment was the toilet--it was one of those toilets that can heat the seat and has multiple settings to clean up! As for the neighborhood, it was a little scary to walk through around midnight if you're alone, but during the day it was pretty lively and really made you feel like you were having a Brooklyn experience. The train ride is a little long, but we only really noticed it at night when we were tired and ready to chill at the apartment. Overall, I would recommend staying here!

Johnny was an awesome host- very accommodating, helpful with directions and had lots of great food recommendations for the neighborhood. He was also very flexible with checking in and out of the apartment, which made our trip much less stressful. The apartment was very tidy and clean, charmingly decorated, and stocked with all the essentials. I would definitely recommend this place to friends who are looking for an affordable and comfortable place to stay in Brooklyn!

Luke's apartment is great, and just as described. It has such soul and character, with his art, books, and aesthetic touch which we all appreciated. Our family, with babies and toddlers included, had a really fun and very comfortable stay for the weekend.   The only complaint was a slight lack of privacy once we checked in. Luke had to return to get his dog and his belongings our first evening, and then asked to come get some personal items again the next evening. It was just a small added stress, but not a huge deal. Luke was very understanding when we explained we had small children that needed to sleep without any disturbance.   All in all, we would definitely recommend this place for families visiting the city!

Luke's place is quite possibly the best experience we've had on Airbnb. It's a wonderful place, located superbly in the bustling downtown Manhattan. The bed was SUPER comfortable and the amenities we're great.   Luke is great, friendly and approachable host who gave us some great tips on day one which really helped with our stay and despite him being invested in the final series of Game of Thrones, he was always on hand to answer any questions.  I can't stress how great the location is - for tourists it's just a short walk from the WTC and financial district, with Subway stops everywhere. There are some amazing restaurants on Stone Street, which is a 30 second walk.   We had a superb time in NYC and Lukes space made it even more amazing.
