The AC in the room only worked when the light was on, and it was very noisy. I could hear conversations in the hall. All in all, it was a terrible experience and AirBnB refunded my money. I am never staying there again.
Really great budget option. Very very comfortable beds. Location is a little bit scary, especially at night but security was good.

Horrible this is a scam the owner of the property said they never heard of this person please don’t use this person ever you will end up in the street with your luggage and nowhere to go and have to pay out-of-pocket hundreds of dollars to stay at a hotel in New York New York

The inside of the house was clean . The house on your approach looks very old . Peeling paint on the porch was not my style . I feel the host knew that the heat was not working and did not tell me . Someone was home , I heard them use the bathroom during the night . The neighborhood was unsafe . I got in about 12:30 the night and was followed to the door by a guy ( so weird). The host lives in the house but did not tell me until about two hours before my arrival . I was made to believe it’s a house not just a room . Though the guy that let us in at check in told me we can use the kitchen and living room . The bed is just really a mattress on the floor . If you are tall like me it’s just not comfortable to get up or sit on . No dresser to rest your things on in the room . The lamp in the room had no switch . I had to unplug it to turn it off . It was the worst stay I ever had at a BNB to put it clear .
Cozy room with very comfy bed. Bathroom uses spaces well. Internet is spotty at best and the location is not great with people doing drugs in the open on the block.

They certainly love a theme over at the Pineapple hotel! Pineapples pineapples everywhere, from the mosaic to the glassware to the towels. The designers somehow managed to fit barely more than a bed and toilet into the tiny rooms, but they certainly made the most of it and have creative solutions for space-saving. (suitcase drawer under the bed - folding doors on the bathroom - pullout shelf to use as a desk!) The main drawback of this place is the number of drug addicts you have to navigate past getting to it from Penn Station to 36th street. It truly is located right in the armpit of Manhattan. But once you get inside and up to the high floors it is pretty quiet. Also be warned: after you've paid your $400+ a night for 10 square feet of space to sleep they will charge you an "amenity" fee which is an additional $25 for the privilege of a bottled water and "free" wifi! How generous! The best part? The beds and pillows were very comfy, on the soft side, but it felt very clean overall. I'd spend your $400 on a much bigger place outside of midtown though, the location truly is horrid.

Fantastic place exactly as advertised. Very small room but extremely well appointed, comfy and clean. The bed, sheets, pillows and towels were truly luxurious (bed a little on the soft side and I normally like hard, but slept well). Some people complained about Homeless folks in the street, but - get over it, it’s NYC. We loved the area sandwiched between Hell’s Kitchen and MSG - where we saw a magical Brandi Carlile concert. Ice and water available throughout the stay and the lobby was always attended. I would highly recommend this place.

Wow what a great stay! After getting our other Airbnb canceled a few hours before check in we were able to find zainuls place and even check in early! After all the stress they made it feel like home and communicated very quickly! When we asked for advice they were quick to respond amazing places! The train was only 2 blocks away which made transportation quick and easy! We couldn’t have asked for a better stay for my daughters bachelorette party!

I was a bit disturbed by what I found under my mattress when I first arrived. Because it’s an NYC hotel, I of course check for bugs underneath the mattress and instead of finding bugs, I found something else that was quite disturbing that I don’t wish to describe here. The manager moved me to a different room with slightly more space (it’s Midtown Manhattan NYC, so all rooms are abnormally small compared to the rest of the country, and the upgraded room was of course limited in space but had a little bit more walking room than my initial room). I would’ve liked for the manager to have been more reassuring because I was so startled by what I had found and I had JUST checked in and therefore scared of what else I may find. However, instead, he just rattled off other disturbing things he’s seen in his line of work.  Also, I accidentally left my jacket in the closet and asked them to hold on to it for me so that I could pick it up. When I went to pick it up, they said they didn’t have it.

Nice location. I didn't think so at first, getting off the subway since it looks a little sketchy, but a block from there, our 14 minute walk at 1:45am, felt safe in this neighborhood. The place looked nice from outside, once we entered the room, it looked beautiful, clean and cozy! As my own personal opinion, the bed has been by far the most comfortable bed I've slept on when traveling! I loved the comforter omg I wanted to take it home lol. Esmeralda even offered us a ride to the subway station the following morning.   This is the first time I stay in a private room, it has always been a whole rental before, I was a little nervous about entering someone's home and sleeping their house room, but our experience was great, they didn't bother us, we didn't pump into anyone when going to the shared bathroom, we saw her till we were already out the door. Only thing was that the rule was no noise after 11pm, which we did amazing sneaking into the house at almost 2am haha, but we heard a lot of really loud noise from everyone at 7am 😑  Other than that, very recommended.

I would give 0 stars if I could. Canceled my booking last second on a new year's eve day in nyc. I traveled 3 hours to the place to find out that my spot was given to someone else even though i booked it weeks in  advanced. The worst experience I have ever had. Avoid at all costs!!! it's a scam and fraud.

This place was the cleanest Airbnb I’ve ever stayed at. Every inch of this home was clean. I went into the kitchen only to put a few drinks in the fridge but it was spotless. The room was a great size and it was comfortable and also very clean. If you wanted quiet though, the airplanes are nonstop and very loud but I personally didn’t mind them. Walking to a store is about a ten minute walk. The immediate area is safe but the further out you go, the sketchier it is. Overall, would definitely stay here again.

The inside of the hotel is beautiful! The rooms are standard no views or anything special. There wasn’t a fridge or microwave. The street it’s on is horrible .. you have to make it pass 100 homeless / working girls to get into the building . About a 5 min walk to Times Square.

Great stay. Rooms are small but perfectly laid out to make most of all the space. Bed very comfortable. There was water, coffee available in room and butler service for in room service. Bathroom was good size, all the amenities, including a comfy bath rob. Everything was clean. Check in and out super quick and easy. Location was good. Overall great stay for a solo traveller.

The location was very good. close to the subway station, and had mini supermarket nearby. Chek in was very smooth.   When we arrived the house, towels were not prepared. It took 2 hours to recieve reply of where towels are stored after our arrival. Which was a bit stressful after the flight of 14 hours. I suppose it was a rare case though. The owner said usually they prepare towels in the room.  The room is small. We could barely open our regular sized suitscase. So packing and unpaking was a bit hussle. I suppose the room is perfect for single traveller.

Very clean, new showers are always appreciated! Appreciated the full length mirror and multiple outlets that are all easily accessible. Good location in Flatbush with the Q line just down the block, a grocery store and drug store across the street, as well as a few restaurants and shops. This is a walkup with street parking, would only recommend driving/ parking to people accustomed checking the parking signs for street cleaning (definitely doable if you know what you are doing and have patience to look for a spot).

These guys are so creepy, immediately asked for my number and clearly gave it to other people they “work” with. I got a phone call and a text from a guy named Nick who said “you are staying in my apartment” when I asked these guys about who that was they gave me VERY conflicting answers. First they said they did not know him, then they told me that was one guys brother? THEN I was out during the day and the other guy texted me and asked for my location… I felt very unsafe and thought I was being trafficked.
Great 1BR East Village apartment.  Quiet street.  Clean and VERY well stocked place.  5th floor walk-up will stress your legs but make you a stronger person!

Jeannie is very lovely and helpful! The location is perfect you can go to Manhattan easily by bus! Don’t be afraid about the dog beel she’s amazing and lovely, in the begin she’s barks a lot, but she is a very good, girl 😻! The neighbor is good! Has a lot of restaurants an pharmacy and everything you need! Amazing it was amazing 🤩

It was a great and comfortable stay. I did not see anyone else in the house, so it was like it was only a dog and me. The bed is very comfy. Only one thing: I was afraid of entering the house for the first time because the dog was barking at me. Actually, I adore animals, especially dogs but still, at least add the info in the description that a dog may bark but is kind. By the way, the dog IS VERY kind! Do not be afraid.

It is a very cozy place and has everything you could need, Yoav is very helpful and always attentive to your needs or questions.   The accommodation is in a basement and his family lives upstairs, therefore, you can always hear the footsteps and sounds from above.   The area is very quiet and not dangerous at all. There is a very affordable train station to the city exactly 12mnts from the home, it has a City Bikes stop right on the corner, also bus stations, deli and supermarkets nearby.

The apartment was easy to access and it was very secure and clean. The area (Laurelton) is a good area without too much worrying about crime. I wish there was a tv in front of the bed but it’s acceptable that there wasn’t. Clean place. I give 4 stars because there was a baby on the second floor crying almost all night long and made it sort of hard to fall asleep. But overall good value for money, would stay again.

Jonathan was a great host, he made sure to always stay in contact. Kept checking on us prior to arrival and continue to do so afterwards. The house accommodates 7-8 people comfortably. The smaller single room is best for kids not much for two adults. The backyard is really nice, looks beautiful at night. We were scared for parking but surprisingly it wasn’t bad at all. One night we did Uber around town just to avoid to finding parking very late and Uber’s were not that pricy. Very comfortable mattresses in the bedrooms.

Manny was a great host and attentive to all maintenance needs I had. I stayed at his Airbnb for six months and it really made my time in NYC less stressful. He’s also great at providing recommendations of things to do in the city.

Everything was perfect, Manny is great host. Amazing to have a private studio for that price. I’m just unpleasant about cleanliness but I think it’s my fault. I kind of push many let me check-in at 9 am which is almost impossible for other hotels. I appreciate his efforts, thank you so much.

Large room, with lots of natural light, large, comfortable and complete bathroom. Close to the C subway that takes you directly to Dumbo, Brooklyn and a couple of stops later into downtown Manhattan. The key delivery system allows you to arrive at any time without fear of waking up the host. This is my second stay with Mike and I will keep coming back.

Kay is a courteous and helpful host. He helped me carry my stuff from the street to my room when I checked in. He generally stays out of your way unless you would like to get to know him better. He will let you know what you need to know and you can ask him anything. He is flexible and will generally accommodate. I had to shorten my original 2 month stay midway, and he agreed with no need for discussion. Just let him know any issues.  The apartment itself is clean and maintained. The kitchen and bathroom are usually stocked and you can cook with your own food. I brought my own cooking materials but I’m sure Kay would let you use whatever he had if you asked. Kay provides you with a set of towels when you arrive. And the room is as advertised.   The location is convenient. The Nostrand ave subway stop is right at the corner of the block 1 minute away and you can reach anywhere in the city from here. There can be some shady people and scammers on the street though. One guy tried to get me to buy him baby formula a few days into my stay. You just have to remember you’re in NYC and beware of scams and you’ll be ok. Sometimes the neighbors can be loud too. The whole apartment building had a loud party right under my window one Sunday late into the night, but I doubt this is a regular occurrence.   Would stay at Kay’s again if I had to!

Mike was a great host with a smooth system happening to accommodate your stay. The access to the kitchen was ideal and the electrical tea kettle was clutch for our morning tea.  The rules are simple and the house maintains a cleanliness thats welcoming to come back to after a long day in the city.   Everything really worked out well for me and my fiancé.  The room was spacious and the private bathroom was exactly what we needed!       Mike is a great communicator and will follow up on your requests with quick concern and support. When we arrived I could not find the remote for the amazing access to Amazon FireStick streaming!    I reached out to Mike via the app and he took care of it with several alternatives until ultimately replacing the remote which can be a bit challenging to pair.   (The original remote was most likely stolen from someone....because I searched everywhere! I really shouldn’t have to say this but GUESTS PLEASE DON’T steal remotes—it’s not a good look for the next guests or the host! Thanks)    All in all. everything was great. I will definitely be sharing your listing to others and look forward to booking with you again.   Until next time.

Plenty of space,  tv, wifi, comfortable bed. The private bathroom was particularly appreciated. The host facilitated everything and he was very communicative. Only awkward bit is that the neighborhood is a bit dangerous, but frankly, the inside of the house is so good that it really doesn't matter that much. Just, you know, keep an eye out.

So this was supposed to be an easy trip but instead it was a waste of money and stressful. The place was nothing like it was advertised. No beach access and only a/c in the bedroom. Plastic was on bed so it was very uncomfortable and hot. Rest of apartment was useless because there wasnt any air conditioning other than bedroom. Bathroom had a leak from flushing toilet; by the time i woke up from first night the shower wasnt turning on at all. Also didnt have a fridge or microwave or oven. Did have a table and sink but that didnt do me much good in the heat and nothing to keep things cold or to reheat. The place was not as it sounded. Close to highway but definitely not to the beach and definitely not private beach access. Dont stay here. The host was making the bed when we got there way after check in time and gave us the key and then claimed there was nothing wrong when i explained my complaints. We didnt even stay-we left couldnt stay another night there. She is new to abnb-dont let her become a regular. Dont waste your money

As a young girl in New York City by herself for the first time, I was scared and nervous and anxious all at once as soon as I stepped off the plane. But as soon as I got to Louann’s, she made me feel right at home and SAFE. Her place felt comfortable and homey with all her thoughtful touches. Public transportation was a breeze, I just downloaded the app and it was super convenient and walking distance from her house. It was clean and everything was perfect. And she had everything I needed, just Incase I forgot something like shampoo. Thank you for being a great host. Definitely coming back to Lou’s whenever I’m in NY again. :)

Good location and easy to call Ubers at any time of night or day to get throughout brooklyn and into Manhattan. The driveway is tight but we fit three cars in the back parking area. When I tried to call at check in time when we were having trouble entering the unit, I called five times and no answer from the host. They finally messaged back 4 hours later that their phone was dead. The Airbnb was a good size for 11 of us. No drip coffee, only saw a keurig and electric tea kettles. Kitchen was sparse so we had to bring our own baking sheets and other things to cook with. Some of the bedrooms were either blowing all heat or all AC so don’t know how it works (my bedroom showed error the whole time so I couldn’t adjust). Communication from host could’ve been better. Only thing that scared us was when the host opened our door and came in to ask us three times to ask if we parked another car in the driveway, which we didn’t do, but the host did not try to call, message, or knock before entering so that was very inappropriate. I’ve stayed in many airbnbs and the issues we had here are issues I’ve never experienced. Really could’ve been better with better communication, more basic supplies, and never entering the house without asking. Only good thing was location and size of the house.

Lou's place is as comfortable and wonderful as one can ask for. To me, it was a place of healing as I dealt with all the accumulated stress of my trip. It felt at home yet you could also have the privacy you needed. Would definitely recommend it if you're looking for a place to stay in this area.

We spent the Christmas holidays in New York. There were 11 of us in the accommodation. It is very large, well appointed, the beds are clean and comfortable. Hong always responded quickly to my questions. The house is 5 minutes walk from the metro, very convenient. The neighborhood can be scary at first, I wouldn't walk there alone at night... but we've never had any problems in a group. Good value for money.
Great AirBNB!!! Don’t be afraid to book you will have an amazing stay! Owners are very nice and work with you! 10/10 will definitely book again!

We were a small film crew that Anthony generously allowed to shoot in his lovely apartment for one day of an intense five day shoot. Everything was smooth except for our initial check in, where a crew member arrived early and was let in by the housekeeper but was not handed a key. Film shoots are intense, where there are a hundred moving pieces, small and large - in the midst of the craziness of the shoot, we realized that no one on our crew had been given keys.  Upon checkout we were asked for the keys and we shared that we never received them and were let in by the housekeeper. This fact was not acknowledged and there was no attempt on his end to clarify what the keys looked like or where in the apartment the keys had been left. We apologized to the host for this miscommunication, and said we would immediately search through all our props to see if we had accidentally taken the keys in our move but clarified no one had opened the lockbox or received the keys (we didn’t know what the keys looked like as we had never initially received them). He said that it was not a problem if the keys had been accidentally taken. We searched through all our props and found a key that had accidentally moved with the production design stuff (no one had received the key so didn’t know what it looked like and so it had been mixed up with props). In response, the host accused our producer of intentionally taking them and was unnecessarily rude in his communication when we located the keys. It was an unfortunate unpleasant interaction after having a lovely shoot otherwise in his apartment.

This place was just as described by Anthony.  We were glad to have been able to stay here.  It is very close to the train station making visiting NYC fun and stress free.  We would definitely return as well as  recommend it to others.

The best hosts are the ones you rarely see or talk to. Ca was great because everything was setup already so nothing further was required and if I had any questions he was fast to respond.  Only real dilemma was one of our friends who is quite tall (6’2) had to duck due to low ceilings. Keep that in mind if you are extra tall.  My only issue was there was no mirror in either bedroom - again, easy fix and nothing major.  This place is located in the true New York and away from tourist crap, so I appreciated it even more being so close to all the action and characters in Brooklyn and its surrounding neighbourhoods.  Trust me you will have fun, and dont be scared - people mind their business.   Thanks for having us Ca.

Just a scam royaltin got mt money and did not gave me my roon tgey did not let me check in because of a credit card but they did charged me just a fraud they did not refund a dollar back to me i lost 240 dllrs with them never going back
Great customer service , Nice hotel , just had issues with In the area with people climbing walls and looking into windows , was a bit scary to see that and the hotel was very unresponsive!

I read all these bad reviews and honestly I was scared to go. After going though I saw a completely different hotel than what these reviews talked about. Amazing staff, beautiful atmosphere, clean rooms, attention to the customer and a lot more great things. I’m more than satisfied with my stay and honestly I wouldn’t pay that much attention to these negative reviews because I saw a great hotel AND I got a cheap room. I expected bad quality for a cheap room but what I got was great quality for a one of a kind price.

I live in Manhattan, but have always enjoyed coming to Rockaway, so I decided to do a work from home/staycation in the Rockaways during this stressful year. I looked at a few places and this was the best deal and location. I did not want to be in an area that was super-crowded (like 98th or 108th). This is very close to the beach at 67th, which is primarily a surfing beach and less crowded. The apartment is on the 2nd floor of a walk-up about 5-7 minutes walking from the beach. There are long-term residents in the building, who were also very kind and helpful with whatever I needed. There are some great restaurants nearby and also a stop-and-shop grocery store and pharmacy. I rented a car for the month, and the owner provided me a parking spot in the driveway for an extra fee. But, there was also free street parking. The apartment is right next to the A train stop at 67th street, which is convenient. There is not a lot of traffic on the street, as it is a dead end street.   Despite the current situation, I was able to do a lot on the Rockaway Peninsula and surrounding areas - frequented various beaches, surfing school, Jacob Riis Park, Fort Tilden, great food in Sheepshead Bay, Whale/dolphin watching cruises, Kayak tours of Jamaica Bay, etc. The majority of the people I interacted with were incredibly kind and hard-working.   There was no downside to the stay, just maybe a few quirks that all worked out. My stay was during August, when there were a few parties on the street at night on the weekend. But, I didn't really mind, because it was the weekend in the summer of a really difficult year for everyone. A big storm caused the internet to go out, but the owner fixed/upgraded it right away. It was a great connection - I was able to stream work video calls, tv, music, etc. I also was a bit sensitive to the fan noise coming from the fridge, which the owner went out of his way to get it replaced for me. There was a slight issue with the hot water and both the owner and neighbor were helpful in fixing it.   It was a great stay. I was very sad to leave the Rockaways!

We booked a room about 2 months prior to our stay, and having been our first time visiting NYC, we made a special request for a “Room with a view.” Upon arrival, our room wasn’t ready yet and we ended up having to wait until 9pm to get a room. All that said, when we finally spoke with the attendant at the front desk, Elizabeth, to get our room and ask if our special request could be accommodated, she sure did deliver—got us a room on the top floor! Couldn’t have asked for better customer service!   The only unpleasant thing (apart from having to wait so late to check in) was the additional tax charged to us by NY state, even after having paid taxes on the AirBnB app. Make sure you read the “House Rules” for the hotel in the app. Seemed a bit sneaky to me at first, but turns it out is just NY, so can’t really blame the hotel for this.

The location can't be better. Next to Central Park and Columbus Circle. Lots of stores and restaurants, Deli's and drug stores. Right in the heart of the city. With the hustle and bustle of the and a peaceful oasis wich is Central Park. Most confortable bed and pillows ever. Street at night is very bussy so if you are a light sleeper like me it can be a challenge. Thanks to Sokha and Elizabeth for great customer service. There is an extra fee that will be charged to you at the front desk so make sure you read well or ask the hotel because is a considerable amount.

They decided to transfer me to another hotel that was awful and way less than what I paid without consulting me and just notified me 5 days before my arrival. Due to the change THAT I DIDNT WANTED I was charged ANOTHER $100. The worst experience I've ever had. If you want to be robbed, lied, and ask for help with no response, book here.  Español: Me transfirieron a otro hotel (terrible) sin consultarme con 5 dias antes a mi llegada. Por el cambio QUE YO NO PEDI me cobraron $100 adicionales. Es la peor experiencia que he tenido. Si quieres sentirte robado, mentido, estafado, que pides ayuda y nadie se hace responsable, reserva aqui.

From a New Yorker, July 17. 2019  Gabriel's place is a room in a hotel  on the West side approx. 36th St and 10 Ave. What you see in the photo is what you get. Hotel is small, with free NY bagels and muffins for breakfast.  The room is clean and the bed comfortable, AC works great and location is perfect if you want to be on the West Side. There are some homeless people at night in the vicinity but that is normal for NY. Bathroom wall paper has some spots that need repair. Overall I would recommend staying here it is worth the price.

Very convenient spot. Super close to Central Park and a few minute walk to Times Square. Right next to your morning coffee at Starbucks.   I was scared because of all the negative reviews on here but it was an easy check-in and check-out. They do ask you to pay $400.00 when you arrive but they gave me back more than half after leaving.   Great room, had extra towels and blankets, huge tv, working a/c, hair dryer, closet with safe, and other amenities.   It was an overall great experience. Do it.
Construction makes exterior suspicious. Interior absolutely fine. Vladimir provided a great greeting, tour, and explanation of the construction.

The room is clean and nice, but spartan.  No coffee pot, or mini-fridge.  The front of the bldg is off-putting. It is covered in graffiti, boarded up with a lock on it. Once you get past it, it is fine.  The most off-putting thing is the location. 36th between 10th and 11th is about as sketchy a neighborhood as they come. There is literally a homeless camp on the sidewalk a few doors down with people passed out, and needles on the sidewalk.

This Airbnb is a steal! Great value for the price. I was here for approximately 3 months. The apartment itself was very clean, although the other Airbnb guests would occasionally make a mess.   The area was safe and everything you need is within a short walk including subways, groceries, laundry, etc.   Just a side note, there is a bar on the ground level which can get pretty noisy Thur-Sat, but I learned to zone it out within the first week.   Highly recommend Kaz’s place!

This place is an absolute steal! I enjoyed everything about it mainly because the place itself was very clean and exactly what I wanted since I didn’t know how I felt about being in a house with a family. It is like a hotel appartment, you don’t have to worry about being in someone’s else home, roomates were very quiet, nice and clean. It is also 5 min from a metro station and all essential businesses like laundry mats, grocery stores, nail salon etc. There also is an amazing bar down the building with a live band which plays great music all the time!I had the misfortune of having to leave earlier than expected, actually exactly one week after I got there due to the Covid-19 pandemic, my home country decided to suspend all international flights without prior notice on a Sunday, so I had to rush to the airport and get on the last flight out to avoid staying stranded in the US and possibly overstaying my visa. I informed Kaz very last minute literally before I left the place and as usual they responded very quickly, were very understanding which was so reassuring as I had so many things to handle last minute before I left. Once back in my home country of Morocco, I contacted them to cancel the rest of the stay and possibly get a refund as this is considered as force majeur, they were understanding and also very helpful with the refund process. With the situation getting worse every day, refund policies were being changed constantly which was very confusing, Kaz stayed in touch the whole time trying to help me through this until he found a solution and did it from his end, which I truly appreciate. They were so professional and this is the type of host you want to look for, professionnal and understanding. Hopefully the situation gets better and everything goes back to normal for me to be able to go back to NYC and I will definetely only stay at this place for the next time and the times after. Regardless of the whole situation, they really made this the best experience I have ever had with any host. Thanks again to Kaz and to the whole team, Stay safe!
Very clean and the management staff made checking in and out very easy and stress-free!
Comparable to a SMALL dorm room that someone rushed to clean. Suspect all around. Staff was nice.

This is a really basic place to stay, but in a good location. Super quick access to public transit. The area just to the east, on 36th, is kind of sketchy, but if you approach from the south (Hudson Yards area, and a bunch of parks) it's great. Security was good. Cleanliness was decent.  The woman who was normally at the front desk was friendly and helpful.   Unfortunately, my bed was broken when I arrived. (The main side rail that supports the slats and  mattress was almost completely broken in half on one side. I told somebody from the front desk and he came up and looked at it, but didn't offer any real solution other than a flimsy and too-small cardboard box to put under it. I propped up the rail at the break with things I found in the room and stayed as far to the other side of the bed as possible.

Kristin is a wonderful host.  I was having some technical difficulties communicating thru airbnb...Kristin was extremely accommodating, and my checkin was very easy.  The apartment is super clean and comfortable.  There are no unpleasant surprises here!!!  It was a bonus to have a back deck overlooking a garden.  Private, quiet outdoor space when you need or want it.   Thanks again, Kristin!

After having a few places cancel me on top ever a long day of travel I was lucky enough to find Kristin’s place. She responded almost instantly and made sure I knew every detail about my stay and made a stressful travel day end with a stress free stay. Thanks again Kristin!

It’s posted by a company and we stayed in the different address from what Airbnb says, although it was in the same complex.  I had to contact three people, the owner, the manager, the check in agent to ask why the actual address is different from Airbnb. The owner gave me the wrong phone number for the check in agent, and made me think this could be a scam. At the end of the day, it’s not a scam, just a unit with poor management.   Features were similar to the listing, but you don’t want to spend too much time checking the posting pictures as you can stay in the different unit. The previous guest didn’t return the key and entered into the unit on our 2nd day using the key.   The living area is divided by the wall to make the 2nd bedroom and has limited natural light. The A/C in the main bedroom doesn’t blow cold air and toilet paper hanger is broken in the bathroom. After I asked the check in agent, the building sent someone to fix them, but he couldn’t. The location and the building are very good, but the owner needs to pay a bit more attention to the unit’s condition.
Don’t be afraid to ask questions, Jada responds quickly and does her best to find the best solution to any concerns.

Jada is a very friendly and responsive host. Don’t be afraid to send her a text for help or advice!  Location was perfect for my stay and there was a variety of different places to eat and get groceries.  Apartment was very clean and comfortable, I enjoyed my stay with everything provided.  I was treated with such friendly and professional customer service, & I wish to do business with her again!   Everything was perfect, I would highly recommended! 10/10!!!
The neighborhood is a bit sketchy but overall it's a decent spot for a few days.

Rashid is very friendly, the communication was quite good whenever we needed it, the place is good for 2, maximum 4 people, it has a subway station less than 2 blocks away, which allows you to get to the city easily, the airport is close and you can also find supermarkets around to buy food, the neighborhood is a little unpleasant, but it is okay considering the price and sometimes there is a lot of noise since it is a basement.

My father and his girlfriend were visiting from Florida and since my place is rather small I booked this air bnb thinking it would be a cute place for them to stay as well as have some privacy. In order for them to check in Karilyn had to let them in. There is no lock box/keycode. It was not mentioned at all in the posting that she lives on premise. That alone if mentioned would have discouraged me to book. In her pictures it shows a nice looking yard area to hang out in. The back area was not set up or cleaned and there was a table with a tarp that could not be used. In the posting it also said cooking could not be done, when I asked her she said of course we could use kitchen, yet in the post it said we could not. When I checked the post again, that part had "miraculously disappeared". My father asked her about the AC unit in which she said he would not need it, (there was a lock on it) but a portable one was there. You cannot dictate if someone will get hot or cold. There is a washer and dryer in the apt yet you cannot use it. Karilyn called me at one point to let me know to tell my father if someone rang the doorbell or  knocked on the door not to answer any of their questions. She mentioned property managers were around in the area and trying to shut down air bnbs and that they went to court and one the case. That sounded very sketchy to me as if she should not be using these apts as air bnbs or does not have the legal rights to for whatever reason. It seems like she has more than one listening and is renting 2 paces in the same location. Overall, this place felt very restricted and sketchy and the pictures made it appear so much different. Also, there is no Iron in the apt. When I asked her if there was one, she said no and that she would put some kind of steamer by the door. She never did.

We enjoyed our stay in the Harlem Apartment. The subway, a grocery store and the Central Park are really close. We had a little unsafe feeling about the neighborhood in the evenings, but on daytime everything was goods.

Pros: Great communication, easy self-checkin, lots of hot water, comfy bed, really affordable price.   Cons: The door to the apartment is a little flimsy and I couldn’t get the deadbolt to lock from the outside when I left during the day. Couldn’t get air con to work, but maybe that was me. Location is a little sketchy, but I never felt unsafe.
The place is nice but have mice which is dangerous for guests.
First visit to NYC, friends expressed concern about being in the bronx but we walked around and never ounce felt unsafe. The space itself is great every youd need for a quick couple day visit.

This was my first Airbnb experience and I was afraid because of many bad stories, especially related to NYC but now I see that I was wrong. Everything by Serenity was as described, beautiful studio apartment with many small details. Food stores, laundry, subway and bus station, everything was a few steps away. This part of the Brooklyn doesn't seem so safe, but we personally didn't have any problems. I would use this apartment again.

The place is very cozy. It was my first time in an Airbnb in NY. It is super easy to get around because it has a metro station just a few steps away. The location at night seemed unsafe, however nothing ever happened to us, nor were we in danger.
Definitely recommend this place as it is near everything you could imagine. Very clean area and not dangerous at all! Felt very safe!

I haven’t always had the best Airbnb experience, BUT…… Serenity’s place exceeded my expectations. The location is central to almost EVERYTHING. The train station is literally steps away from your door (less than a minute walk). The neighborhood is one big melting pot. You’ll see a little bit of everything. Very safe & diverse. A lot of cute shops & good restaurants in the area (Support your local businesses). Zaca cafe & Solbol were some of my favs. I’ve walked home at 12am to 4am & never felt unsafe. This location is solo trip friendly (Especially for female travelers). The actual unit itself is secluded, so privacy won’t be an issue. But…. you will burn calories from walking up the stairs lol Serenity made sure to check in during my stay, which I appreciated. The value you get for the price is unheard of especially in NYC. I’ll definitely be returning & highly recommend this place to  anyone looking for a safe & comfortable stay. Thanks for providing a great Airbnb experience Serenity. ❤️
Excellent location (the neighborhood is dark-skinned, but it is not dangerous and you have the literal train just a few steps away

Serenity’s place is in a great location: the subway is right outside the building which makes it super easy for you to go anywhere with the C line (direct Manhattan Time Square).  The neighborhood itself is really lively during day time; lots of shops and all sorts of people. We never at once felt unsafe there, even late at night. We really enjoyed the neighborhood and met lots of nice and friendly people there.  The appartement itself is charming. The bed is really comfortable, and clean. It’s very quiet at night, you will sleep well. It’s on the last floor, it’s intimate, and there’s a private patio. There’s a large flat screen TV.  Thé AC is a real plus in the summer.  However, it’s not exactly 100% clean: the AC filter is covered in dust, the freezer is half full of old ice, there’s no way to use it (the fridge in itself works fine and is convenient). The « worst » place is the bathroom. The shower curtain should be replaced, there is mold in the shower (on the tiles). The toilet makes a leaky noise (which we signaled but nothing was done, we had to turn the tap off at night so we could sleep). The toilet itself wasn’t really clean either. And the door of the bathroom is covered in stains of all sorts, and doesn’t lock. It’s too bad because all it would take would be a really good cleansing to make it great.  In the hallway of the building, we stumbled upon a big dead roach that stayed there for the whole time (4 days). It’s not exactly appealing.  I don’t usually point out negative stuff in the Airbnbs I go to, this place is globally really nice, but the lack of hygiene in the bathroom is a big issue.  If you’re just looking for a comfy bed and a good location, it will absolutely work for you. But if you’re a cleaning freak, you won’t be happy.

The stay for this place was relatively cheap for visiting NYC, but its only cheap for many reasons. The place is small and is in a unsafe neighborhood located in Brooklyn. As it’s my first time traveling after the pandemic, i was shocked by how unsafe the place was, receiving racist comments by people in the street and being greeted by homeless people. I didn’t feel at ease the entire trip and it’s not worth saving a few bucks just for this experience.   The place itself has three staircases, if you have lots of luggage then good luck. The room is as depicted in the pictures but very small and inconvenient, felt like I was being suppressed the entire time.  I ended up not staying here and booking my stay in a hotel at downtown Manhattan. Stay was nonrefundable but better safe than sorry!

Qing's place is a great little spot. The apartment is super clean, the bed is nice and it has a TV with Netflix and other options available. Although the area is a little far from New York City there are multiple public transport options less than 5 minutes walk away. The main strip seems a little dodgy but don't let the looks fool you, I walked through the main strip with the shops late at night every night of my stay and there was no feeling of danger. The area has plenty of great places to eat and I highly recommend going to Stellas Coffee Shop.   If I was staying longer in New York I would definitely stay here again, recommended for everyone.
This spot is lovely, tidy, convenient, quiet, comfortable.  So many details. Well designed.   I'm thrilled to have found it and suspect I'll be back again.  Thank you for an easy, relaxed stay.
Qing was impressively fast with communication, which made check-in and other aspects of our trip easy and stress-free. The place was clean, well-furnished and ideal for our one-night stay!

I had a decent stay at Matt's overall. The place was big and the AC was great, which is critical for NYC summer. Matt also added a new desk chair after I told him about the other chair made my back hurt. However, I had really bad check in experience because the hosts were not responsive. It gave me a lot of stress because I was traveling alone with 3 luggages.  One of the nights it was also very loud outside after midnight: music, people shouting, etc.

Unsatisfying experience. As someone who barely writes reviews I’d made sure I would write one because my experience at this place was horrible. I’m really unsure how this place has the rating it does because I wouldn’t even give it 1 star. The house looks like a run down scary place from the outside and not very well taken care of with extremely noisy neighbors but I didn’t want to judge based off exterior. Once I entered the room the pillow cases were very dirty and the bedsheets were dirty and unwashed. There was dog hair all over the floor and we were greeted by a barking dog upon entering, (the home owner had us wait outside until he got his dog situated and locked in a room); and it was an extremely noisy room. People were screaming and cursing outside the entire time we were there so much that we just got up and left 2 hours after entering. I was so disappointed. Would not recommend to anyone and will definitely not book again. Save yourself a few dollars and look for something better.

Qing is a responsive host. Great location and safe neighborhood. Early check-in is allowed. The bad thing was the upstairs tenants were constantly making a considerable amount of noise, just felt like they were kicking my door down. Even though Qing already told me this issue when I booked abnb. But it’s worse than I thought. It scared me and my bf a lot. However Would definitely recommend to people who are not sensitive to noisy situations.

I have used Airbnb for years now. I never complained about any experience I had because in general they have been nice but also I'm understanding and very flexible. Nobody is perfect.  But these hosts are the hosts from hell.  Ernesto and his wife are horrible hosts.  I had problems from day 1.  I arrived and the code of the key box was not correct. I had to struggle with it for a long time until I realized it was wrong. They didn't respond to my messages on the app or texts.  Even the host didn't know the code when I finally talked with him (after more than 1 hour).  One day I forgot the key of the appartment and I tried to call the host. I mentioned his name and Airbnb but he was pretending I had the wrong number. I had to go to a hotel that night.  The house smells of something dead and the hosts use heavy artificial odors to mask it. It is so strong that I had a headache the first few days of my staying.  Their dog is their main problem. It is not a dog that can be with people in particular strangers.  I have pictures of dog urine and escrements in the kitchen and other comment areas. I walked on dog urine several times during my staying (I had to take a shower after that) in the middile of the night.   Dog destoyed several times the door of my room, first a plastic a cheap foldable door that the dog destoyed piece by piece.  Then they built (making the place a construction site) a wooden and dryboard door. The god destroyed that door too.  There was sharp and dangerous debris everywhere that I had to clean and walk on. The dog barked continuously at night and it went in a frenzy when the owners arrived (they work at night, so it was usually 4 in the morning). Hosts also put regularly foot mats and dog bedding on top of the shared kitchen stove over pots and pans.  They are not in a position to host, ever. They have the courage to take pictures of our room. We had clothes out of closet because there was not even space to hang anything. They tried to be revengeful after we took pictures of dog desctructive behavior and they entered my room violating my privacy (trying to take pics of our belongings).  These people have serious problems. I have pictures to document everything I said.

Ernesto and Flor are great hosts!They allowed me to stay long term due to me moving to NYC from Texas for my job. They went above and beyond to help take care of me when I got sick. They gave me some medicine and Flor made me her home made remedy. Especially during scary times right now like the corona virus they have handled the situation gracefully and have allowed me to stay. The room is decorated really cute too! This is an old building so sometimes it makes noises but they take care of any problems. Highly recommend staying here they are great roommates!
I enjoyed my stay from start to finish. Check in was a breeze and Charles was very prompt with responses. The apt is comfortable and the price is a steal considering location.
Great place it's a must come and unwind after a stressful week.

Great host, good value for the amount you pay! Chantal did let me drop my things off early due to landing before check in time, I appreciated that! There is no AC as listed in the description but the ceiling fan worked just fine! There is a back door that kept getting left wide open by other guest late at night that I had to keep checking for safety purposes. Biggest suggestion would be to wipe down baseboards, walls, doors, and windowsills! They were REALLY dirty and the windowsills are right behind your head when you sleep due to the bed being right by both windows. also wish windows had curtains or better shades due to the fact that other guest hanging out on the back patio could see into the room even with the shade closed completely. Other than those two things everything in listing is accurate and host is a good communicator.

I loved my stay here. It was a really stressful time, and I always felt at home and love my roommates.  It's a beautiful apt, and the neighborhood is great. Very safe and walkable. It was a 40 min commute to my job in the city. 10/10 would recommend and stay again!!!

It's close to JFK and its located in a quiet street which makes it a good place to crash before your flight. However;   the unpleasant smell of cigarette smoke  in the bedroom will disturb your sleep 😴 if you are a non- smoker.   The occupants/ residents of the house were pleasant though.

Very shocking and unpleasant experience. Please consider reading through my whole review before you make your decision of staying here.   I walked into the apartment and it looked “cute”, but quickly realized when I looked closely how filthy the actual walls and stuff were. There was also a few empty beer cans on the table which I thought was weird for a host to leave behind knowing someone was coming to check in. I immediately had to go pee and realized once I had already started peeing the role was empty. Nothing under the sink except a paper towel roll that had the last piece stuck onto the roll that I had to peel off until some came off. The bathroom was filthy and I was really getting bad vibes.   I walked into my room and there’s legit a live cockroach to greet me on my bed. I immediately took a photo of this and also the toilet paper roll and sent to Steve. He apologized, but also gave me some silly story about that’s what you get in NY, which is definitely not true because I have stayed here PLENTY of times and have never encountered a cockroach. He also said he “wasn’t sure” if there was any TP left and he would reimburse me, which I thought was insane for a host to say.   Steve was communicative and immediately offered to give me a refund. He was kind, but also had so many excuses/reasons why his apt was filthy including long long long text messages with unnecessary information that didn’t apply to me whatsoever. He also stated he wished I would have just stayed and he could have compensated me some other way, which I thought was super odd for a host to say and I’m not really sure what he meant by that.  I am sorry to throw you under the bus Steve, but I would really hate for someone to have my same experience because I didn’t want to say anything. Like I said Steve was kind about the situation, but was a little too eager on having so many laid out excuses which I thought was fishy.   I had a late flight in resulting in me getting to Steve’s around 11:30pm. There was no way I was sleeping with a cockroach so I had to search around at midnight for what ended up being a super over priced hotel, including an extra $40 Lyft after paying $60 from the airports to Steves, which really made the beginning of my trip a total bummer.  Looking at his reviews other people seemed to have a great experience so maybe this was just a bad encounter.   I also reported to Air Bnb so hopefully Steve has taken the initiative to create a cleaner space for his guests.

Steve and Harold are both very nice and friendly and also gave tips for what to do in the evening in the area. The house has a strong hostel feel, if that's what you're looking for, you've come to the right place. The room is - especially for NYC - very spacious and clean. You have to know that the unfortunately very small bathroom with toilet is a whole floor below and is directly adjacent to other sleeping areas and the kitchen, which can be a bit uncomfortable at night and early in the morning or if you have to go downstairs at night if you want to quickly use the toilet. I then became comfortable with it, but it's important to know. Just like it's pretty noisy. As I said, it was totally fine for me, you just shouldn't be too picky. Otherwise I slept really well in the bed, I found the mattress incredibly comfortable. And on the last day it was perfectly fine to check out a little later. The boys are relaxed! :)

It was a gem to find Laura's Airbnb as a last-minute booking after finding out my original accommodations were canceled. Even worse, my partner and I ended up getting sick the day before the trip and our request to cancel was denied. We stuck it through but still had a great time here. Luckily, the home was supplied with all the essentials for our little stay vacation. It was close to grocery store and drug store, and easily accessible to the subway. The house was spacious and beautifully furnished with amazing art pieces.  Unfortunately, there are some areas of improvement needed. Mostly, communication and coordination were lacking as Laura was slow to respond to my messages. For check in, there was very little directions given. Some of the rooms were dark because either the lights didn't work or I couldn't figure out how to turn them on. There was no air conditioning but the fans were sufficient for the weather in October. Beware if you are a light sleeper, you can easily hear the upstair neighbor's loud footsteps.  For check out, you are expected to take out the trash, vacuum, run the dishwasher and wash the dishes. Also, supplies such as coffee, coffee filters, and toilet paper were asked to be refilled if exhausted. These are reasonable requests but surprising to me when there is a three hundred dollar cleaning cost. Overall, a great place to stay with a few nuances.

Very clean, the location is a little far from the main places to visit. But the subway station is a few blocks away and it takes you about 15 minutes to get to Times Square on the subway.  I recommend that if you plan to return late at night or early in the morning, use Uber or taxi. Since by meter it is a bit unsafe.

JP’s studio has the potential to be a 5 star place but a bunch of short comings, I would rate it at about 3.5 stars.   But let’s start with the good.  What a great location. Many great coffee shops, restaurants, and even a spa is within 2 blocks. Go a little further and you have the high line or the night life and comedy shows of Bleeker st. Yet it is still on a quite street and the view from the bed isn’t just of another building as you can see off in to the distance. The actual apartment is very spacious, one of the biggest studios, I have seen in NYC. The kitchen and bathrooms are beautiful. And JP has a great TV and desk space. Everything was put away and neat sans a few items below. I also have to say that JP was very quick to respond to any communication.   However there were some issues that individually seemed small added up. Let’s start with the ones that can easily be fixed. Starting in the bathroom, the inner plastic shower curtain really needed to be replaced as it had quite a lot of mildew. Personal care products like a razor and used soap bar in the shower) were left out either from a previous renter or the owner. The toilet paper holder continuously fell off every time you touched it. There was also no hair dryer which JP mentioned got stolen and offered to reimburse me if I bought one and left it there which was quite nice.   In the living room the pictures of the apartment show nice blankets and throw pillows on the couch of which none were present. The pictures also show 4 pillows for the bed but there were only 2 and neither were comfortable.   I think it is also key to note that the bed is setup in a way that the inside person can not get out without crawling over the outside person which wakes them up if they have to go to the bathroom in the middle of the night.   The apartment is also next to quite a loud elevator which you can hear from bed. We put on some white noise which solved this.   There was a doorman as well which we didn’t know at first knew JP was renting out his place so it was awkward as we felt we were sneaking around.   All in all I would stay here again if JP fixed most of the items above l, but for the price of a nice hotel room, I was expecting a little more.

Super clean and amazing location! You can’t go wrong. I stayed here for a month and had no issues navigating the city. It’s close to 2 different subway stations that can take you all throughout the city.   The ac blows cold, the bed is comfy and the wifi is good! Communication with the host was some of the best I’ve seen and she always responded quickly to whatever I needed.   The neighbors are quiet and at night the area is quite quiet as well, no shady characters at all outside. Overall a great experience and I would consider staying here again

Ludina’s place is a steal! It is a great location in Harlem! 10 mins to The Apollo Theater and Central Park. My boyfriend and I were greeted by Alfredo. He showed us around and made sure we had everything we needed. The place was extremely clean and big. Large and spacious bedroom with private bathroom. I was always able to be a hold of Ludina when I needed her. I would definitely stay at her place again!

The bed is comfy and it's perfectly clean. Lovely host. Very dangerous neighbourhood though. I was travelling alone and was scared when walking back at night, and had guys shouting at me as I walked down the street in the day. The key in the front door was snapped off by another resident earlier in the day too when I stayed, which I did not know and wasn't informed about, and couldn't get back in at night. I was trapped outside and it took a while to get let in, and I was terrified. There were also a couple of noisy guys who visited the flat one morning, and I was scared to leave the room until they were gone as they didn't sound very happy when talking to the host. If this flat was located elsewhere, I would have loved my stay, but I would never stay this far away from the centre of NY again. If you are travelling alone, definitely look for a different neighbourhood!

The apartment is very good, it is as seen in the photos, well equipped, good beds, well located, although because the area is under construction it is somewhat noisy to sleep since they start work early. But that situation is beyond the department.  In summary, our experience regarding the habitability of the apartment was very good.  Regarding the reception and delivery of the key, I cannot say the same.  I had previously notified the receiver that we would arrive around noon and he responded that there was no problem due to the schedule.  We arrived at the scheduled address, rang the bell and no one answered. After waiting outside for a while, I was able to go up and ring the bell, no one answered, and because we had been there for half an hour, I rang EVERY ONE of the apartments in the building, thinking that maybe there was some mistake and if someone knew the person.  Nobody knew him, after a while I received a message telling me to go to a bar one block away.  I went to the bar, asked people and no one knew him.  Meanwhile I have sent him messages about where I was. Then I received another message and he told me to go about 30 meters from the Bar and a friend would give me the key.  I went to the address and finally after almost two hours after arriving and (notified a few days before) another Mr. gave me the key.  At that point I had my doubts that another person could come claiming to be the owner and we would find ourselves in a very uncertain and unpleasant situation.  Luckily the apartment was nice and comfortable, that reduced my anger and dissatisfaction with the moment I experienced.  After a while I received a message in which he apologized and that for a certain reason he couldn't go and he asked me if we had a good night and if everything was ok.  (To all this I clarify that we found ourselves in another direction DIFFERENT from the one we had agreed to at all times. As a result, we had PREVIOUSLY hired a VAN that would take us to the Airport and we had to dedicate several hours and energy so that the VAN company (transport to JFK that we had already paid for) knew the REAL address and came to pick us up. Meanwhile the days passed, and we had a great time, the city treated us well, everything Wonders, except for this episode. Knowing the experience a couple of days before, I sent him a message informing him that on the 19th-9th we were leaving at 10:00 a.m. and I preferred to hand over the keys to Luiggi, more than anything so that he could check that the discount was in good condition. But I didn't get a response until I finally sent him another notice telling him that I was leaving the keys to the people at the rubber shop that were there. next to the entrance to the apartment. The VAN came to pick us up and almost arriving at the airport I received the first message from Luiggi telling me not to leave the keys at the shop. I told him that it was late (because of what was written above) and I sent him a photo of the man who received the key. When he saw the photo he told me that everything was ok. Anyway, as I said, the apartment is very good, it's worth it, and to Luiggi, if you are going to continue with this rental issue. I recommend modifying, above all, the form of contact at the reception, and at the exit so that you remember that people are in a foreign country, without knowing the language, and it is not at all pleasant to go through a sadness like the one I have told. MORE THAN NOTHING THAT EVERYTHING IS SOLVED WITH A SIMPLE CONTACT MORE IN TIME.

The location is absolutely perfect for any convention goers. It's 3 blocks from the Javits Center and there are plenty of restaurants nearby. The apartment is exactly as described in the listing. Small but worked for our party of 4. Noisy, but that's to be expected in NYC. Our issue with our stay was lack of communication from the host. We had trouble confirming check in/check out/luggage storage information in a timely manner adding an unnecessary amount of stress to the trip.

Better than you expected. good place to make fellow travelers, and bathroom was clean. It seems like it is cleaned everyday. It is located in a little bit scary area, and hot shower was not available for my 2nd day. Still it was a good place, and as you can see it has a good price compare to other airbnbs

All good.  Location was great really accessible and convenient. Is not a bad neighborhood, just that if you’re not used to... maybe will look creepy or insecure.  Bathroom was not re clean, and the shower was not hot.... like other comments of other host!  So I was expecting something like that.    Keep in mind that if you want to save money, it’s not a bad place! All the opposite. But remember that it’s a place where sometimes run with 10  people 8 guest and 2 full time in a flat of one toilet.   Think that one hostel of the same commodities can be the cheaper if you check with time.

Great location!! Two minutes from the subway. Good food nearby, so you don’t always have to rush off to Manhattan. Lots of space for 8 people. Wish there was more than 1 bathroom, but we made due. Super clean, which is always great (we visited during the coronavirus scare). I will definitely recommend this stay to other large groups who are traveling to NYC.
Cannot recommend this studio.  The neighborhood was sketchy, hallways smelled of cooking, clothes smelled like smoke even though it was supposed to be non smoking.  Beds extremely uncomfortable.

Excellent location, you can’t go wrong staying here. Easy check in, good communication. Someone previously mentioned in a review that the area was a little sketchy, truth is this is New York City and you will find that everywhere in NYC - you need to put this into perspective. We felt safe enough. Place had everything we needed. Recommended.

Real review* our first visit to NYC ( mid 20’s asian Americans) My wife and I stayed 24th-27th, checked in Friday night, checked out Monday morning. Highkey, we should’ve flew out that Thursday night and payed the extra night because it’s cheap enough that we’d rather have woken up and had that extra few hours to experience New York. - The place* The place itself is a studio so don’t expect a lot of space, roughly 400sq f. It comes with what you need though, a kitchen and bathroom. The 2 beds are a plus that could fit like 4 people comfortably. We just pushed them together for 1 big bed. The place came with a heater so that was nice! Like all most Apts I’d imagine in nyc, the building looks rundown. It was clean though. There is a tv but not many channels, I’d recommend brining a laptop and charger if you like to have background noise on like me while pre gaming or after a night out in the town. Bring your own toothpaste/brush shampoo/conditioner, bar soap. They supply shampoo and soap but they’re wack.  The water takes awhile to warm up in the shower so prepare for that. -  There’s a liquor store downstairs and an hmart/ cvs down a block. Super convenient!!  Time square is within a 10min walk and is beautiful on any non rainy night. If you have the chance, check out 230 fifth rooftop bar. Will not disappoint! Walking distance to clubs MARU and MISSION. If you want free no cover entry to mission text MISSIONVIP to 555888. (Top secret tip) they’re a bit irritable but nice to Asians. Just saying but you have to text the number like a week in advance to get free cover, it’s a one time thing so after that you’re set!. Don’t go right away at 12 unless you have a table or they have you wait for like 30min.  Go to Maru first then head over to mission at after at like 12:45. It’s live. Drinks are expensive roughly 15-20 per drink. So I’d pregame hard then go out haha  - Best advice I can give is to really make New York your own experience. Sure try the touristy things but don’t be afraid to yelp around and really take it in for yourself. Buy a 33$ metro unlimited card for a week and take the subway, it’s intimidating at first but you’ll figure it out. P.s don’t forget to eat LOS TACOS at lease once a day LOL fire af.

Great location! Small as expected but definitely needed to be tidied up a bit. I left nyc covered in bed bug bites so that was gross.  The building seems to have multiple companies that rent rooms, quite a few shady characters roaming around/congregating with the crackheads and dealers that stand a few doors down. All in all, wouldn’t stay again but definitely a great price for the area. Just watch your bags and buy bug spray before checking in.

The place, for its very cheap price given the location, was quite good.  The location is great, even though the street is quite dark and scary at night, it feels safe. It’s very close to nearby bus and subway station and there’s a Rite Aid, a Target, and a Trader Joe’s just around the block. Regal cinema is also within a couple miles distance. It’s also right next to Chinatown so there’s tons of small but great Asian diners nearby.  The building itself seems a bit sketchy and is really old, but the apartment room, despite its small size, is very cozy and warm.  The bathroom is sparkling clean and the hot water and water pressure are perfect for people with long thick hair. I was just looking for a place to sleep at night since I’d spend most of the day out, so this place did just the job.  There is also a super friendly and adorable house cat in the apartment, made the experience so much more special.

My stay here was very good overall. I was there for a month for school reasons so I was outside all day. The location is good since in less than 10 minutes walking you could reach the Ralph Av or Halsey Av stations, which made it easy for you to get to Manhattan, both the southern part and Midtown, in addition to being able to reach the west or east area, that helped me a lot when I could walk around and return until late at night, without problems. I also found the neighborhood pleasant, not at all unsafe. Sometimes they play loud music in the street but then they turn it off (only once was it an impediment to sleeping). The room is comfortable, very simple, but I think it has the basics if you are just looking for a place to sleep since you are on vacation. If your idea is to live for a long period of time, the recommendation would be different, since the room has a refrigerator and a coffee maker which helps a lot, but I think that if you are staying for long periods and you plan to cook, it would not be possible. But if your idea is to spend a lot of time getting to know each other and only get to sleep, it is undoubtedly a great option. The bathroom was always in good condition and with hot or cold water. Overall a good experience.

TJs place is the best if you‘re looking for a Brooklyn experience with both: You find hipster places as well as some real neighborhoods. The street is safe and sound and filled with very friendly and heart warming people (but I recommend checking places for a stroll, so there won’t be sketchy surprises; it’s still Brooklyn). The room was indeed small, but it was exactly what the description said (we brought a small Camping mattress, so one of us slept on the floor). TJ was very helpful and anytime available if we needed some infos or recommendations.

About the host: TJ is a great host, very attentive once you arrive. Before I got there I felt she was a little rude, she told me I needed to pay extra if I wanted to drop off my bag before check-in time.  Other than that incident she was making sure almost everyday that I was doing fine. She left some candies in the room  bc of Halloween, which is nice. Last day before I left she gave me a little present as a good bye gesture which I think it was very nice from her. About the place: Is an old town house with very little maintenance. The room looks a little different from the photos. It’s definitely more worn out, and the wooden doors on the window (to block the light) are all broken and can’t be closed all the way bc there’s an AC on the window. Using the bathroom on the hallway might be a little difficult in the morning, since 3 rooms in the same floor share it. It was surprisingly clean after that much traffic. About the location: After reading other reviews I thought the location was gonna be good, but is too far if you’re planning to spend most of your time in Manhattan. For me it usually took me like 1 hour and 30 min in the morning to get to the city. Going back at night I always used a taxi, the neighborhood feels a little sketchy. Overall I believe that if you’re on a budget is a great place.

The self check in was straightforward. The room was huge and a steal almost for the price and the location. Jack was super responsive and super friendly, I was in touch with him via only messaging and it was almost like I had the entire place to myself. Great experience and would definitely recommend!

Great host, perfect location, comfortable beds, affordable , safe and comfortable. I was scared about air bnb with a host but Ajmol was a great host and was super responsive with his communication, i highly suggest if you wanna stay on the out skirts of the big city this place because everything is so close for you to get any where, i suggest parking on the street and commute through transit. Five stars all day !
Thanks to its responsiveness, Ajmol provided us with a solution close to LGD airport even though our flight had been canceled

It’s a nice room, spacious and clean, note that it is quite dark even during the day. Great bathroom as well! One must like cats as Luke the cat likes to visit :) located on a quiet street, the only noise is from the air con in the building but it’s not very loud. Jack was a quiet and attentive host, I often didn’t notice him being home.   It’s close to the subway and a lot of restaurants, bars and such. Sure, the area is  a bit more gritty compared to the upper east side but I never felt unsafe walking around on my own.

What you see in the pictures is accurate, but it’s so much different in person. Not as clean/kept up as shown, and kind of in a sketchy area. Loud at night, very hot pipes that could burn someone if unaware, bathroom not very clean, and hard to get into due to the lock being hard to open. It definitely grows on you, but I wouldn’t recommend it at all.

Great space and a great rate. While the apartment isn’t in the middle of the action of NYC, it’s only a 10 min walk to the train which is just 15 min to Midtown Manhattan. Get your train card for $32 and travel everywhere if you’re staying for a week. Don’t be afraid by how complex it looks. It’s easy to use. The apartment has everything you need and way more space that you will get in Manhattan for far less. The bedrooms are spacious and the kitchen is stocked with everything you need. Living area is great if you’re staying in or to have a coffee with breakfast in the morning. There’s not a ton to do in Astoria, but there are some awesome restaurants on 31st and Broadway which are both nearby. Grocery store is close by to stock up if you’re eating in. We are breakfast in the apartment every day which was nice to save a bit of $ and then lunch and diner in Manhattan. There is a deli next door. Their sandwiches are great (and cheap) and $1.50 coffee before heading out for the day. We’d definitely stay again in the future.

This place was perfect for my trip to NYC. It's about a block from the subway station, so traveling without a car was easy. It's also near a coffee shop, a bagel place, and a drug store (which I needed for a last minute item). Place looks exactly like the photos. It's in the basement, so you will hear people walking above you and the washer/dryer out in the hall if someone uses it. Fortunately, it's quiet at night when you're sleeping so that wasn't an issue.

It's a good apartment in a great location! Lots of great restaurants! Broadway is just a couple blocks away. There are convenient drug stores and markets nearby. The apartment was nice and clean. It's everything we needed for a good stay in NYC!

Refusied to share the location until the last minute and then once the plane landed was told they “accidentally” provided the wrong address.  Was told that bc the host was going to be “out of town” we should only communicate with their “colleague” and via text, not through the app.  Was also told to lie and say we were friends of Ivan if anyone in the building asked. So the “host” is Milii, the apt actually belongs to Ivan and we communicated only with Eddie. So damn sketchy all around. They could have at least provided a couple extra pillows and amenities, etc to make the stay feel worth it. It was a dump with mattresses like hard wood. Clearly an illegal rental. Very disappointed. Hosts like this give Airbnb a bad name.  PS I’ve seen their responses to bad reviews saying the reviewer was lying. Expecting to see that here. Don’t buy it. (Only giving a  barely decent 3 stars for the location and the fact that it was a short stay.)

Loved my stay here in Brooklyn! The room was minimal and exactly as pictured, which is just what I wanted and needed for my stay.   I stayed here was to quarantine before staying with friends, so I was here for 8 nights. During my time, the other rooms had a few guests come and go, and it was wonderful to see and hear them make sure the rooms were clean and sanitized between guests. It gave me peace of mind!   I especially loved the kitchen. It had ample counter space, with all the pots, pans, dishes and utensils one could need. This included such things as a toaster oven, induction cooktop, coffee maker, microwave and mini fridge (with freezer). I felt like I had my own studio apartment in the city!   The door lock was great so I didn't have to keep track of a key (just a code) and it really made check in/out super easy. I'm a light sleeper, and I will say the walls are thin, but in all their rooms, they provide a white noise machine (with rain, thunder, ocean, etc. options) which was perfect for me as someone who needs that to sleep in my own home, too.   The bed is definitely firm, so keep that in mind if you need a softer bed. I don't mind a mattress on the firmer side, so I found it to be pretty comfortable. The bathroom was very clean and stocked with a few extra amenities like shampoo, conditioner, body wash and hair dryer.  Their house is located in a great area, too. Groceries, a drug store, a great bagel shop and more was all within a block or two. It was wonderfully convenient!  Overall, I really enjoyed my stay here. The next time I find myself in Brooklyn, my first choice will be Lee and Teri's place. Thank you!

Not recommend!! There is a strong smell of paint. After staying for half an hour, I had a headache and a sore throat. Stay in the room and you'll be poisoned. If I open the window,it’s so noisy and unsafe because it’s beside the street and on the ground floor. And if I closed, I will be poisoned. I didn’t sleep the whole night. So I had to check out ahead the time. And you should carry your luggages walk several blocks to take the key and also back it. The host is not nice. He/She told me “Be aware that no one else will be admitted inside the building. Any breach in the agreement will terminate the contract and you will be asked to leave right away.”before I check in.

Messaged host for early check in due to conflicting schedule and was not given clear answers. Leading up to check in, host stopped replying. Finally received key instructions an hour prior to official check-in time. Several hours later, had to reach out to host's contact as key didn't work on door at address in listing. Received further check-in instructions including correct address for unit rented. Check in process was extremely stressful and communication was difficult.

The place was really nice. I liked that it was easy to get into and how the space was laid out. It was very cozy and the mattress on the bed was amazing. The cat that had made noise in the kitchen scared me a bit in the night but it never took away from the experience. It was space I would like to experience again. ☺️l
I was afraid the front facing  bedroom would mean noises at night to keep me up. But pleasantly surprised that it wasn’t!

This place is horrible I would never stay here again & it’s a scam I paid $179.00 for the room then when you get there you have to pay another $87.00 for deposit and taxes for hotel. Then I check my bank after I return home the hotel charges me again for $286.00 this is a scam and demand my all money back.

The Manhattan Club offers an unrivaled experience in midtown Manhattan. Steps from Central Park and only a few blocks from Times Square, the Manhattan club is the perfect place to call home for your trip to NYC. Gorgeous building supplemented with very large hotel rooms adept to sleep well over just 2 people. Very friendly and helpful staff make your stay stress-free and not without some fantastic local recommendations.   Couldn’t have asked for a better first trip to NYC. Will be staying at the Manhattan Club every other time rooms are available.

The Manhattan Club is fantastic.  I am SO grateful we booked with this location.  It's a lovely place to stay, and for the price offered, an incredible bargain.  Some things to expect: The rooms, the lobby, everywhere is SPOTLESS.  The cleaning staff is just extraordinary.  The hotel is gorgeous, to boot, and feels very luxurious.  The rooms are not all the same size.
