We booked one room for longer, and then a 2nd room for when the rest of the family could join us; the first room was more like a suite, with a large living room area, and two large windows.  The 2nd room was smaller, more like a standard hotel room, and darker with only one window, but still the same great quality.  The smaller room had a bathtub in the bathroom; the larger room just had a shower stall.  If you have children who are shower-averse, make sure  to ask for a room with a tub.  The kitchenette in each room is stocked with coffee (both caf and decaf), and microwave popcorn.  The cabinets have plates, glasses, mugs, bowls, and silverware.  We washed dishes by hand, but there is a dishwasher as well as a microwave, and a sink, which is lovely to have for extra hand-washing if someone is using the bathroom.    Larger rooms have two closets with lots of hangers; smaller rooms have one.  The hairdryer is in the bottom drawer of the dresser under the television.  There are two luggage stands in the closet, which was very nice!  All the staff are friendly and helpful.  Don't hesitate to call the front desk or ask them for help in person - they are great!  Valet parking is available for $35 for every 24-hour period (your car stays in the parking area - if you get the car and then put it back, it re-sets the 24 hours, so you pay more) or period of time beyond the 24 hours.  This is a steal for NYC parking!    The hotel has a storage room for luggage, and you  can drop off luggage before check-in, or have them store it for you after you check out, so you can still go explore NYC for your last day, and pick up your luggage (and car, if applicable) at the end of the day.  If you are attending Carnegie Hall concerts, or performing in them, this is the closest hotel to the backstage entrance: it's less than half of a short block away.  It's also incredibly close to the  south end of Central Park.  A great location for exploring NYC!  The beds are *very* comfortable!  If you are using the sofa bed (necessary if  you have more than 2 guests for a room), be aware that the sheets are not made up ahead of time.  A pillow and blanket were in a zip pouch at the top of the closet in the small room, but we had to call to the front desk to ask for sheets.  In the big room, there was one bag with blanket and pillow, and another with sheets.  The sofa beds are a little hard to pull  out, but if you need help, I'm sure the staff would help.  :)    If you are planning timed activities, be aware that the elevators sometimes take a while to get to/from the upper floors (especially near check-out time).  Plan a few extra minutes to account for elevator time, or take the stairs down if you're able.    We had a wonderful stay here, and will definitely stay again if we do another overnight in NYC!

Like other reviews have said, you really can’t beat the location! We could not believe how close it was to Central Park! We stayed with our 3 little kids (5, 3, and 7mo) and went to Central Park everyday for at least an hour to let them run around, so that was super convenient.   Pros: -Location - super close to Central Park, Times Square, and subways. -the staff was so friendly!! The doorman always remembered us and the cleaning staff was very attentive. Our room was promptly cleaned every morning.  - check in was easy at the front desk. - The room: Super spacious with 2 closets and comfortable bed and pull out couch. It was quiet and had amazing black out curtains. Our kids slept in for once! :)  Cons: -The room was not as modern as the photos. I know the listing says to expect different layouts of the room, but even the style itself was different and much more dated. It was clean though and spacious as mentioned above.  - no blow dryer in the room. - The pack n play (crib) they provided did not come with a sheet. They gave us a huge thick wooly (itchy) blanket to lay down inside, which is super unsafe for small babies. I ultimately used one of our baby’s thin muslin blankets but it didn’t cover the entire bottom and so I didn’t sleep well because I was worried about him getting all tangled up. Lesson learned - I will always pack our own crib sheet now.   Overall, we loved this place and will stay again if we find ourselves back in NYC!

The place is clean, spacious, and kept in good condition.   I would not stay here again though. The hosts are loud at night, even though they knew that I wanted a quiet place to sleep. This was important for me. They watch TV at a high volume and had a friend over after midnight talking loudly and unpacking something. It was inconsiderate. This was my first unpleasant experience with Airbnb.  The last night the place was very cold, I woke up chilled.  You might like this place though, so I suggest not ruling it out completely.

The room  « casa Luna » absolutely do not match the picture advertised on Air bnb. The room is very tiny and narrow. There is no table, no chair. There is no space for moving in the room.  The room is very cold, there is no heat and no AC as well. And no Elevator  in case you have suit cases. The host is a Hispanic and she moody and  rude. She can lock out the guest for hours if she feels like even though your belonging are inside the rented room. I relied on previous reviews but none of them were proven to be true and accurate. The host do not speak or read any English. The communication is impossible if you do not speak Spanish. The host do not provide a key for the room however she rents other two rooms to group of male and female guests. Which made feel unsafe at night and during the day when I leave the residence. The host Maria is dishonest as she has hidden fees after you checked in and like to make false claims and demanded from the guets and from Air bib customer service, extra  fees for cleaning or for bringing imaginary extra guests. The price for the room is away too high for the actual value of the room. It need more cleaning. I will never go back to « Casa Luna » again. I should have checked in a hotel. It was a total disappointment and a waste of money. I had a bad experience.

Great location and service! This hotel only does valet parking, but it was only $35 for 24 hours. When we checked out the next morning, we were able to leave our bags and vehicle with the hotel until 24 hours after we checked in, so we didn’t have the stress of having to find somewhere else to park or keep our stuff the next day before leaving. Its a quick walk to just about everything, and the rooms were pretty nice. Only complaint is the price, but you pay for location in NYC and this was a last minute booking after another rental fell through. Would recommend!

Although we didn't learn we were staying at a different location until I reached out to Britt & Greg, they assured me the place was equally suited as the one we chose,  just a block away.  However, it was a bit disconcerting not knowing this ahead of time.   The house was clean, and minimalistic, which is what we liked, but even minimalistic in the sense that they offer the bare minimums.  So bring your coffee, or body wash, or your wine glasses (only 1 there) etc., because you might not find anything.  I happened to travel with all necessities, because I drove to Brooklyn.   There's a great cafe however, right on the corner.  The neighborhood looks sketchy, but seemed safe overall.  Maybe more than I've paid for in the past for a nicer location, but you live & learn. Parking on street wasn't so easy either. Oh!  And tv channels are very basic, although there's a fire stick, I was not about to sign in with my account.  I feel that for the price, they should at least offer cable or offer their amazon account...
Be aware of e bikes and motor scooters on sidewalks ,going the wrong way on one way streets,weaving btwn traffic. They are uninsured,unregistered and dangerous

Stayed for 7 days and this place was a DREAM. I’m very picky with level of cleanliness anywhere I’m sleeping and staying for long periods of time and this place over exceeded those expectations. All workers were so kind and so quick to help at any time . Staying solo as a female in the city can feel a little scary but this place made me feel so safe and secure and did really well with all COVID precautions . 10\10 would recommend

Unfortunately, the people who live here and clean the place have substance abuse issues. The smell of pot is in the air all the time where the window had to be opened. Also one of those toilets where used toilet paper is thrown in a waste basket because I guess over clogging the toilet. The room itself is just Ikea furniture bunk beds. One dude like lives there in a bunk bed and tries to start conversations. At night the area walking from the train may seem a little unsafe of you are not a New Yorker.
I didn't feel comfortable. I had trouble entering I found the area quite unsafe, dark. the bathroom wasn't clean.

Rose is an amazing host! She is accommodating, friendly & helpful. She made sure that our time at here place was the best it could be. The space even came complete with warm touches like a fresh rose!  The room exceeded our expectations, and at this price point it was a steal!  The place was in a good neighborhood, close enough to the subway, with some shops and things around.
Great and affordable place to stay. Host will come out greet you and he makes everything super easy and in stressful

If someone is on a budget (I wasn't this time) this could be a deal if you're willing to put in work trade or put up with very loud noise for hours and water streaming across the floor from the broken wall heater, no key for the patio when the door closes and locks you out, no carbon monoxide detector anywhere or smoke alarm in kitchen or bedroom. I'd recommend to someone on a budget who doesn't mind an extra half hour per day of time/stress and not sleeping well at night from the heater. Friendly other airbnb guests. The coffeemaker was nice to have. The kitchen was clean.

David was very friendly and helpful. Room was clean and kitchen had lots of appliances. Bathroom could be cleaner but was never occupied. Nice and mostly quiet area with a 5 min walk to the subway. My only complaint would be the stairs you have to go up to get to the room as they have small steps that are scary to go up and down, especially with luggage. There is an old fashioned radiator that makes noises throughout the night and sometimes leaked but very warm. Tv was nice to have on days we would get home early. Price is very good if you don’t mind sharing the kitchen and bathroom. Would recommend David. I also suggest trying Bagel Boy and Gino’s which are nearby.
Great apartment and very clean. Not ideal location if you have children- area is very sketchy

The appartment was very spacious, and spotlessly clean, great for a larger group. Very comfortable beds and pillows. conveniently located to a  subway station that takes you directly into Manhattan. The only downside is the neighborhood which is a bit sketchy. For people used to a city its fine, but if you are not used to that it might be a bit daunting. Parking on site was also great - but if you have more than one car it is a bit hard to find a spot.

This apartment is in a great location. Easy walk to the subway, Times Square, and more. Just below the apartment is a convenient market which is open all night and a chicken and waffle place that has VERY good food. We never felt unsafe, even when walking late at night. The beds were comfortable, the place was clean, we had everything we needed. My 72 year old mother counted 37 steps up to the apartment lol. She was able to do it but just good to know if you're traveling with someone older. I would recommend and would stay here again. Thank you Blanca and Marco!

Philip was a great host! He provided us with everything we needed to make our stay pleasant. The flat was very spacious that easily accommodated 8 people. Our only negative point was with the area as it is a bit shady, however, its only 3 blocks away from the subway.

Good option to get to know NY in a group in a much more economical way. The neighborhood is not the best but it is not dangerous at all. We had a festival with a parade those days and it was quite noisy, but the apartment is very good and spacious. I only missed hand towels and some other household items, there were no pans or dish drainers.

We loved the host! The metro is only a few blocks away and you are in the city center within 30 minutes. The neighborhood has a few small restaurants and shops. There is a kitchen available for you to make dinner or breakfast.  One of us is afraid of birds so the birds (small birds in a cage in the kitchen) were a little bit loud for us.  Overall it was clean and a nice stay!

Pros: Great location. Colors in unit are soothing after a long day sightseeing and visiting family/friends. Window a/c units were able to cool it down enough to sleep at night. Quaint kitchen. Cons: Mattress too firm, 1 hand towel in bathroom, due to a severe cat allergy as soon as we entered the unit we started sneezing, got itchy watery eyes and my boyfriend had an asthma attack so we knew a cat had been in the unit.  When looking for towels in bathroom we found a half used bag of cat litter under the sink.

Sams apartment was easy to get to, well appointed and comfortable. we booked to accommodate my parents who were coming to town to help with childcare while our home was a construction site. it was a very stressful time,  but Sam’s gracious and flexible manner put us at eas and the apt gave us a nice soft place to land after a day of chaos. will definitely book again and recommend this rental to anyone.

Upon arrival there wasn't adequate bedding, and only one towel provided for my two week stay. After requesting more I was given one extra. A friend stopped by, and we sat n the front  steps and rather than inquiring with me about whether this someone staying with me, I was sent an invoice for $100 for an extra guest. The area is sketchy at night, wouldn't recommend for women staying alone. A few days in I realized this and got another Airbnb and requested to shorten my tenure, that was denied by Jotham. Needless to say, I didn't have the best experience there.

Jotham’s place is in Brooklin, one block away from a subway station. The house is as described. There are two bathrooms, what makes things easier considering that there are more guests in the house. I had no problems getting back late at night, but there are some drug users around the subway station. Just be careful! The room was good. Nothing to complain. Thanks Jotham.

Juan was easily one of the best people I've had the pleasure of communicating with on Airbnb. He was very responsive and helpful. The space itself is small, but PERFECT for a group of 3 or less. My party had 4 and it was a tight squeeze but by no means does it make this place any less desirable. For the cost, cleanliness and location, it's a steal.

I frankly had the worst AirBnB experience ever here. The roommate was awesome and helpful and the location was as expected.   The problems began when I requested an early check-in a couple days before. No reply and I had to follow up early as I was traveling. I had contingency plans in place if that would not work. The host said it was no problem and I could contact a friend and never provided the info.   I arrived and could not enter. Waited an hour calling and messaging. So I left and eventually made contact and was let in by a very nice friend. The excuse was that his phone was dead, but didn’t give me contact information when we had exchanged messages that day.   Beyond that the bathroom is full of mold and is disgusting. I’ve lived with a houseful of disgusting men and this is perhaps dangerous.   I appreciate the condolences offered and the nice roommate, but this is a hard pass for me next trip to NYC.

Very good host, very clean and stylish flat. The subway vibration is not that disturbing however I am a bad sleeper. It was also perfectly offset by the amazingly comfortable bed!! The neighborhood is typical bronx but not dangerous at all or something. Especially thanks for the welcome drink :)! Totally recommended and I would go back again. Thank you!

We spent 10 days at Rahul's place and our stay in New York was great!!!! Rahul is extremely accommodating regarding departure and arrival times...something which is more than appreciable. In addition we could use the entire apartment and more particularly the kitchen.....like at home in a way!!! No worries about using the bathroom either. The apartment is located in a popular but safe area, we never felt unsafe even when returning at 2 a.m. There are lots of very nice little places to discover just a stone's throw away: little skips, Roberta's, birdy's to name a few. The apartment is very close to the metro (5 to 10 minutes depending on the stations): possibility between 4 lines (M.J.Z.L), basically we are 1 hour from JFK and 20 minutes from Manhattan. Even if Rahul is rarely at home, we can count on him and he gives good advice: don't hesitate to ask him for little addresses or tips. In short, we recommend Rahul without hesitation.     We stayed 10 days at Rahul's home and our journey in NYC was fantastic!!!! Rahul is really flexible in the check in and check out and we do appreciate that, especially when you have a long trip to do. We can use the whole flat, including the kitchen! Well, we felt ourselves at home!!! There was no problem with sharing the bathroom. The flat is situated in a "popular" district but safe, we never felt unsecure, even when we came back at 2 am. There is a lot of friendly little places in the neighborhood: little skips, Roberta's, birdy's to mention just a few of them. Metro is really closed (5-10' by feet, depending on the stations) and you have the choice between 4 lines (M-J-Z-L), well 1 hour from JFK and 20' from Manhattan. Even if Rahul is rarely at home, he is reliable and full of good advice: don't hesitate to ask him tips!!! Well, we advise Rahul without any hesitation!!!!! (Sorry for my english...)

Rahul is friendly and very discreet. Check out was able to be done at our convenience (our flight was scheduled for 9:30 p.m.) The area is very lively, think about earplugs to sleep (festive evenings on weekends). The subway is 5 minutes away on foot and you are in Manhattan in 20 minutes.

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE!!!  I was worried too when I was booking a place in NewYork, especially that new York is a bit sketchy. Mr. Rahul is a very good host if you are looking for a place to stay in new york. His house is very nice and calm. 7 min away from the metro station, good grocery stores and restaurants. Mr. Rahul is pretty straight forward  in his instructions, his price is reasonable, no stupid crazy cleaning fees, and he is helpful.  I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PLACE

Overall, the place was really nice and comfortable. If you aren’t Asian the people look at you funny for coming into the building. Made me feel uncomfortable. Host made me check out an hour early! Entering the apartment was so stressful and annoying. You had to put in so many codes.  i would recommend only because the place is beautiful

The location of the apartment with respect to the metro is very good, 3 minutes walk. The neighborhood can seem a little unsafe when you first arrive (especially if it's at night), but we never had any problems. The apartment is as shown in the photos and is really useful having 3 bedrooms with two full bathrooms. I didn't get to meet Carmela or Miguel in person, since check-in and check-out are done "automatically", but they assisted me at all times through Airbnb messages without any problem.

The place is lovely and pretty much as shown in the pictures. However, you could tell it’s a old house and we did encounter some small issues. The venting tube of the AC unit fell off once. We had a short power outage when I used the hair dryer in the bedroom (the outlets in the bedroom seemed to be all connected to the same power source so it probably got overloaded with the AC). The smoke alarm kept beeping for the whole night since there were some issues with the batteries. Anyway, I'm not saying I don't recommend living here I'm just saying it's an old house and be prepared there might be some issues like these. That said, Carmela & Miguel were pretty prompt in their reply and willing to help solve those issues. Carmela even got us an extra fan when we realized there's no AC in the living room. The neighborhood, though, felt a little scary and honestly we didn't feel quite safe, but it helped that the house is 2 mins away from the subway station so nothing bad really happened. Location-wise, it takes about half an hour to get to downtown Manhattan, but if you're going midtown or uptown it takes some extra time. Overall, this place is of great value especially considering its price. The house is nicely decorated, and the hosts were really nice too!

Nice place to stay in. Close to the subway and nearby parking places. The neighborhood is nice during the day with kids playing around and a lot of movement, during the night it can be empty and sometimes a little scary (but we had no trouble walking around at 2 am). We stayed for a weekend and it was perfect, went from the airbnb all the way to Manhattan and NY city without problems using the subway. Would definitely recommend.

We enjoyed staying at William's place and would recommend staying there. We liked having the whole apartment to ourselves, and the apartment had high ceilings and big windows that allowed for a lot of sunlight, which gave the place a very open feel. William decorated with a lot of plants which was a great touch.   We also liked the location of the apartment. There are a few restaurants and coffee shops that are about a 10 minute walk away, including a very cute coffee shop just across the street. There is also a great park that is just under a mile away. The apartment is located on the third floor, and there is an elevator. The street is mostly apartments so it is pretty quiet. You are in NY, so there is noise every now and then, but it was nothing we couldn't sleep through, and we are fairly light sleepers. I think over a week stay, the loudest thing we heard was the garbage truck picking up trash one morning.   Check-in was very easy. William's directions are very straightforward, and he was pretty good about responding and making sure we had all the information. The place could have been a bit cleaner. I think the cleaner missed a few spots here and there. We told William soon after arriving, and he was very apologetic. I doubt it would happen again in the future. There is laundry in the building, but it is in the basement, and it is shady down there, but not unsafe. Also, I am not sure if William provides a laundry card, but we didn't see one, so we had to pay $5 for laundry card, then had to put money on it. Still, it was way more convenient than having to take the laundry across the street.   Lastly, you are about a 5 minute walk to the G train, which can take you to a lot of places in Brooklyn! I did take the bus 1 or 2 times, and those stops were about a 7 minute walk away.  We do recommend giving William's place a try. It's perfect for a couple or even for a small group of people. You have a lot of space, so you don't feel on top of each other, and it is in a great location!

Carmela's place is a steal! Very spacious, comfortable beds, everything my group of 5 needed. Safe neighborhood close to the subway with pharmacies, restaurants, and grocery stores no more than a block or two away. I'd definitely stay here again next time I'm in Brooklyn.

Carmela's place is 100% accurate to the photos shown and looks even better in person. It was sparkling clean, the beds were super comfortable, and the space was the perfect size for my guests and I. Even the shower was amazing and the bathroom was super cute and clean. We were about 35-45 minutes away from the city and chose to uber to our destinations. There was a corner store up the block that sold EVERYTHING and had amazing food. The house is in a very great location and not once did we feel unsafe. I highly recommend this place. If I ever return to New York I would love to stay here again.

The space was immaculate. Very clean, very comfortable, and I'm a self proclaimed germaphobe.  Everything was so nice I was a little afraid to mess it up. We ended up having a horrible experience at the airport that delayed our arrival by some hours and he was incredibly kind and patient with us and even rearranged his schedule for a later check in,after we had requested an early check-in! Ugh. I still feel bad about that, but he was so kind. We could not have asked for a better host!    The apartment is in Soho, so there are a TON of local bars, restaurants, shops and neighborhood grocery stores.  Everything is walking distance. A few nights we were out late and felt totally safe in the area after dark. Most of the tourist sites are a reasonably short Lyft ride away or if you don't mind walking-which we didnt and is apparently what everyone in NY does too- there's a lot to do that's within a 30-45min walk. We were there for a work conference but it made the evenings a lot of fun!   The TV had Netflix and that was nice to wind down with a movie after a long day. The bed was great, I need my bed to be ultra soft and my partner needs it to be firm. This was perfectly in between! Neither of our backs hurt the next day. The shower head in the shower was probably the BEST thing of all! It's a rain shower and I felt like I was at a luxury spa! The only thing that might have helped us out a bit was to have a few extra bath towels. There were two bath towels, one for each, but we both have a lot of hair and after 4 days it was tricky. All in all I would highly recommend!

Don’t book this Airbnb. Do yourself a favor and just book a hotel.  I’m confused about the amount of positive reviews this Airbnb has received. I felt scammed when I got there.  Yes, it is a good location but that’s where it ends. The apartment is big enough but the furnishings are awful. The futon is broken. When you sit on it, it falls to the floor and is very very uncomfortable. The pillows and other decor all look dirty, dingy and like they’re from a thrift shop.  The bed was comfortable but the comforter was stained. The AC is still in the window (in January) which allows for you to hear the street noise as if the window was open.  With that being said, I would have just sucked it up and stayed all 4 nights. But on Monday morning I woke up to loud construction noises inside the building. I messaged the host who took hours to respond. I requested a partial refund but since then he has ghosted me.  This place has potential to be nice if the host put a little money and care into it.

I had wonderful time in NY. Liliana's house is nice, clean and comfortable, she and her family are friendly and helpful. I'm afraid the little doggie didn't like me to much :-) I loved the neighbourhood as well! It was a really pleasant stay.

This house looks small maybe because its downstair but its nice and enough for around 6 person since it has 3 rooms. The room is clean has enough kitchen equipment, has big refrigerator. Its walkable to the station, around 10mins. There is 1min walking distance convenient store however the seller or people inside was kinda scary for us, we just went there once and the rest we bought from other store :D but overall are good.

We planned a long weekend in NY with 6 friends. Location was perfect for us: Brooklyn & Manhattan around the corner, easy acces by public & bike. Williamsburg with his nice vibe on walking distance.   Apartment was also good for us, just what we needed: beds, kitchen and bathroom. Unfortunately the warm water for showering was not working, but Glenn & Ginger offered us to shower in their place, just on the other side of the entrance hall, very nice of course. Only there was cold water as well. ..Shit happens!! After 1 day it was all sorted, so no stress ;) We even go some refund, which is of course a very nice gesture of G & G, tanx again!  Communication was quick and constructive, would recommend everybody to stay here who is looking for a nice place to stay for a couple of days and explore NYC.

Our stay at the apartment was great! Since it’s in Bushwick we had a great time just exploring the area around the apt and checking out the public art! It was also very convenient that the subway station was super close to the building, we didn’t feel unsafe walking around the area coming back from our late night adventures. Inside it looked like Takanori had left post it notes all around that answered every possible question we could have had during our stay, which was super helpful! We had a great time and the airbnb was exactly what we needed.

Positive: quick connection to Manhattan, free storage of luggage possible after check out Negative: no personal contact with the host (within 7 days), which was a bit impersonal for us, heating clicks so loudly several times during the night that it wakes you up, no temperature regulation possible (either too warm or too cold), foil on mattress is uncomfortable, bed linen had to be removed yourself and garbage taken out (despite the included cleaning fee)

Great value for money, good communication from the host and location was great. Apartment is old but clean. But we did feel that some important details were not mentioned in the listing. We had difficulty opening the door as the front door key doesn’t dit in all the way and we were told the previous guests had broken it and had to pay for repairs themselves so it was quite stressful preventing this. There was a lot of noise inside the apartment: a constantly hissing tube in the bathroom and the radiator next to the bed will make a lot of noise in the middle of the night (waking us up in a fright). The matras is comfortable but covered in plastic (presumably to prevent staining. There are curtains but not ones that block the light. The apartment is listed as a private apartment but the host still lives there and we could hear her in the kitchen at night. Having said that, it was a good stay overal and definitely good value for money, but we felt like we didn’t get the full story.

Going anywhere with 2 kids under 2 is stressful enough as it is, let alone having to travel on short notice. Lory and Cindy made it much less stressful with quick communication and being accommodating and understanding to our needs. Check in and check out was easy and the apartment was beautiful, spacious and comfortably private. Would definitely recommend!

For a $200/night apartment my expectations were certainly let down. I will say the owner Chía was friendly at its a great location. But let's get into the bad...  First red flag is the listing tells you to not make any mention that you’re staying in an Airbnb. So it felt sketchy walking by the doorman multiple times per day needing to explain that we were staying with “friends”.   Bedroom light switch does nothing. Hard to figure out how to turn on single lamp in corner   Amazon Alexa had alarms set waking us up in the morning unintentionally.   Not a lot of cutlery. I think just two forks and two spoons. Clearly this is the apartment of a bachelor with no consideration for Airbnb guests.   Extremely cheap and uncomfortable industrial 1-ply toilet paper. This made me so upset that it triggered my review from a 3 to 2 star.   Literally no space to store food in kitchen. All cabinets are packed with unuseful personal items. We had to place our food items on the limited counter space.   Small fridge. Can store enough food for two people for probably three days. But owner left drinks and food items in fridge taking up valuable fridge space.   Toilet seat doesn't stay up. Was recovering from surgery and it was hard to sit down. But couldn’t pee standing up because of the lid kept closing.   Shower handle is in a weird location  and you reach in to turn it on, you will get sprayed with ice cold water each time. Very poor design.   Plunger (is that what it's called) in bathroom sink would frequently fall to the bottom so water wouldnt drain. Lever didn't work to push it up so needed to fish for it with my fingernails regularly.   All hand-soaps in bathroom and kitchen ran out within 3 days into a week stay.   Exposed cables in bedroom. Should this be a smoke detector?   Exhaust fan in bathroom doesn’t work. Stinky.

The place looks pretty much as the pictures. Location was not very convenient for me (there are metro and buses but it takes a while to go to Manhattan or other parts of Brooklyn). Also my brother and I felt a bit unsafe in the area specially when we where returning around midnight. Is super laud too over all night every day so keep that in mind if you have problems to sleep. (Police sirens and cars playing laud music non stop). Toilet was not very clean, same for some parts of the room. We haven’t seen the host (Tiffany) after the check in but the girl next to our room was not very friendly/ sociable (not even saying hello when we saw her) and that made us feeling a bit awkward about going downstairs to use the kitchen, so we stayed all the time on the room, luckily it has a independent door which make it feel like its a small studio flat. Tiffany was very fast as replying prior to our arrival but also fast for texting me when I apparently forgot the corridor light on, so be careful with that because you will get a text asking you to respect the listed rules. I totally understand the environmental reasons but she also mentioned her electricity bill and the whole thing just made me feel bad and uncomfortable, you don’t want to be told off for a little thing like that when you are on holidays.

I don't often write reviews. But this time I have to write one because it was the worst Airbnb experience for me ever. The whole house was dirty, smelly (With an odor of weed), noisy (Almost impossible to sleep), unsafe (Keys are not very solid), and dellusional (It describes itself as room for 3 but actually it was just a bedroom with two beds in it, one of which didn't work at all --- an inflatable bed which deflates itself at midnight and wakes people up. The host was clearly aware of that but deceived us. She texted me ahead, saying that the "Reinflation button is located blablabla..." but didn't remind us of any danger of that disintegrating bed.)  My family was exhausted and desperate after that stay. And that left a mark on our journey I'll probably always remember. I hate to say this but this is thhhhhhhe worst Airbnb room ever. I hope everyone else reading this can be aware of that and help yourself by staying away from this room.

It served its purpose, but definitely won’t stay there again. She was nice by letting us check-in way before time, but the place is in a sketchy/ very loud neighborhood. cleaning is definitely not their thing, the bathroom was filthy and moldy. I really think it should be a MUST for airbnbs to offer basic higiene stuff as shampoo and soap, this obviously didn’t. I’d say stay here if you’re gonna sleep from 2am to 5 am because that’s the only time there’s kinda silence in there

Pros: Location is amazing, lots of great places to eat and drink in the area. The place is exactly as describes, the apartment is quite large so lots of room, some dog hair but it is pet friendly which is why we initially chose this place although didn't end up bringing our pets. Everything you need is in the apartment. Easy lockbox entry, owner provides instructions well before arrival time. No a/c but has a wonderful breeze if you open all windows.   Cons: I believe construction is pretty typical of New York city, however they are literally building an apartment complex next to and behind this building, extremely noisy pretty much all day even on Saturday morning which was disappointing. No air-conditioning so later in the summer would be hard. The biggest frustration was the lock, the door doesn't actually lock, there is a gate that separates the business (lower floor) from the two apartments, so theres that but it was stressful knowing that the door was unlocked with all your stuff in the apartment. I didn't see any comments about this so be warned, I probably wouldn't stay here again just to avoid that stress.
Good stay sketchy area and there was a rat in the living room other than that it was decent
The neighborhood is a little bit sketchy (especially at night), but everything else was great!

We had a fantastic time at Danielle's apartment,  the place is very clean, bright and airy. We were very comfortable and made to feel very welcome.   The area has alot to offer in terms of places to eat and drink. It is also very close to a number of subway lines to take you anywhere in the city easily. It is also within walking distance to central park North.  Danielle went above and beyond to communicate clearly and make sure our trip was stress free.   We would absolutely come back and stay again, highly recommended!

I am typically not a picky person except on cleanliness. The apartment was not clean. That was the biggest issue. The shower was stained, had cracked grout, and mold. The floor was sticky across the living room and didnt seem like it had actually been mopped so we bought slippers to wear. The silverware had dried food stuck on it. The beds themselves were comfortable but extra blankets would have been nice as it was cold at night even with the AC off and thermostat set to room temperature. The living room was small but a good size for a group of 6 friends. The smart TV was easy to cast to. It would be helpful to let guests know that the living room AC is under the curtains. We were told not to open the curtains unless we're opening the window so no one found the AC until their chair bumped into it. The location wasn't unsafe but not the best - it is across from warehouses. The residential area begins from here.  Minor things - The kitchen sink faucet handle and the shower faucet handles were loose and came off easily when we tried to use it.
He's scam, take your money and no reply at all, no information or where to pick up the key, and his phone never works, he didn't pay the phone bill so no way to contact him. 1 star for sure

This place was great! Check in was easy, apartment had enough room and each bedroom had closet space which was awesome. Apartment entrance was secure and we felt safe in the building! Good location close to subways and bus stops. Restaurants and bars nearby are great too. Washer and dryer in apartment was a lifesaver. Only downside is there are a few sketchy characters around the building next door, and I had an encounter with one of them, but was not a big deal and should not deter you from staying here. We stayed for around 3 months and loved it! So great!

STOP! Look no further this is the place to stay. The location is perfect to get to any of the other boroughs without major stress. The price is SHOCKINGLY AFFORDABLE. The apartment unbelievablely CLEAN! Lastly and most importantly the host Rhita is a perfect host. Rhita is a pure delight she is quick to respond to any inquiries, serves delicious tea, coffee, and food. She goes beyond the normal airbnb 5 star treatment and gives you 10 star royal treatment. I was throughly impressed and appreciated the extras she throws in to make you feel at home. Book this place and thank me later   PS Rhita has 2 adorable, friendly, curious cats that frequently visit the bedroom. They are no bother at all, take your allergy medicine if needed and enjoy them.

Accommodation as advertised, very good value for money, a little far from Manhattan but much cheaper, a good compromise for those like us who are not afraid of taking a bit of the metro.  Shelliann is very caring and responsive.

Super recommended, the room is just like the photos. It has air conditioning that doesn't make noise, a super comfortable bed, you don't have to bring a towel, and hygiene items. Keep in mind that there are two floors per staircase.  You have the M subway line two blocks away and the J line 5 blocks away, from there you can communicate throughout Manhattan in approximately 15 m.  We were able to understand each other very well with Lara, since she spoke Spanish. She was always attentive to queries.  The neighborhood is very Latin (which is convenient if you don't speak English), we didn't find it dangerous.

I enjoyed my stay here as it had all the basics that I needed as a solo female traveller who was out all day exploring.   Victoria was very good at communicating and helped me out when my luggage delayed to arrive in nyc ie lent me a phone charger etc.   The location is pretty good and most places are walkable within 30mins. It is really clean too!    Somethings to note:  - During my stay, the house wifi didn’t extend to the room but a public wifi was available and reliable - Victoria offered practical solutions and this is unlikely to be an issue in the future I think.  - the block the house is on is relatively safe but there are some shady streets/blocks nearby  - I had some issues with the shower water temperature being a bit temperamental but it wasn’t a major but if it is, just communicate with Victoria.

Everything about this place and location was amazing! It is exactly as described.  Located in the heart of SoHo everything in the surrounding community is there. Shopping, amazing cafe and subway access is within walking distance; and by walking I mean a block or two at most.  We (my wife (54) and me (56)) stayed in this apartment, for 8 Days and 7 Nights.  It was clean. The air conditioning worked great. There were plenty of towels. The place never felt cramped. Late at night when we walked back either from a cafe or returned on the subway from a long night out; we never felt unsafe. The building is not open to public which is nice and the main door locks on the street. Truthfully I can't say enough positive things about this place.  I will say however because I read it in another review regarding the noise. If you live in the middle of silent nowhere; just remember this is the city.  There is noise from traffic and loud people having a great time passing by every now and then.  But overall we found that after 11p - 12p things quieted down.  In the end the sound in no way an issue and if anything the noise just help add to the overall NYC experience.  Loved our time there; I'm sure we'll be back.

Nice area but not worth 5300. That price was insane for the apt. It was cleaned but not clean there was snot on the walls it had a smell to it that even burning candles couldn’t get rid off. Dirt in between the stove and counter tops it was just not good for my OCD. The only reason I stayed here and paid the price was because I was scammed 2 times before finding this place on Airbnb. Secondly they wouldn’t rent to me unless I stayed for a full month. So even though I was staying 30 days they wanted me to stay till the next month if that makes sense so vacat the first of the month which made me have to pay more. And then when i needed to stay a week longer cause my apartment wasn’t ready they wanted me to book a month longer which was just annoying cause I literally just explained to them I just needed a week like who does that ? Lol and doubled down and said they would take the week. Which means they just took advantage of my prior booking because I was desperate at the time. Very nice! I won’t be using Airbnb again in general.

Totally 100% recommended. I thought the neighborhood was great, the location, with two stations very close (125 and 135) is great, not so long from the center. No danger or problem... The hosts are great. Willing to help with anything and attentive as much as possible. A 10!

Unfortunately, this was my most unpleasant Airbnb experience so far. I asked to check-in earlier as my flight arrived in NY at 8 AM, Rhita told me it was "no problem". Upon my arrival, however, she told me the guests were still in the bedroom so she offered me to sit in the living room,  we chatted for an hour and it was pleasant, she even asked me if I wanted breakfast. I still felt a bit awkward staying here as previous guests were still inside the room. Then, this took another turn - at around 10 AM, before the check-in time- Rhita went on a rant about how I shouldn't have stayed in her living room (she was the one offering me to sit there), that it is her personal space and that she thought I was only going to check my bags in and leave. I apologized for the misunderstanding, shower her that the message stated I wanted to know if I could check-in -not just my bags-. The rant lasted a good 10mins which made me feel extremely uncomfortable as I realized the whole time we were chatting and sharing experiences she just wanted me to leave. I kept my calm although feeling humiliated and asked her politely if she wanted me to leave. She said it was too late anyway and went out for grocery shopping. In the meantime, I felt so uncomfortable staying there (although it was only for 1 night), I started looking at other Airbnb options. When she arrived back from her grocery shopping, she told me that the guests actually texted her to tell her they left at 4 AM. She then apologized for the whole situation and was very sweet to me, but it was the first time I paid for a place and felt like I was not welcome. As I told Rhita, a great way to avoid this situation would have been to communicate better for 1. the check-in information (telling me I could only check my bags, which would have been perfectly fine by me) 2.  the check-out information (knowing when the previous guests left would have avoided this situation). Apart from this, the bed was very comfortable!

We really liked our stay here.  It was clean, well-appointed, and welcoming. The bed and pillows were really comfortable, and the WiFi worked well.  It was central for exploring Brooklyn on foot - so much to see, and getting into Manhattan was a breeze on the subway with the station at the end of the street.  We were impressed with how many vegan eatery and restaurant options there were . Vegan-friendly Van Leeuwen at the end of the street had some amazing flavours and was dangerous to have to pass each day twice!  We did not miss not having a TV for a week. We were out exploring every day and got online at night. It worked well.  Double thumbs up for a wonderful stay!

Rhita makes people feel like family. She is very conscientious, kind, thoughtful, and flexible (can’t stress the last part, sorry for our late night plane delay again Rhita!). The space was kept very clean and it was easy to go to and from at any time of day/night.

Excellent option if your budget is limited but you want to keep me comfortable and in a private space. Rita is very attentive and keeps the room and other spaces impeccable at all times. Astoria in a very nice and safe neighborhood, I walked from the subway to Rita's house in the early morning on more than one occasion and never felt unsafe or in danger. If your plan takes place mostly in Manhattan, the closest station is 30 av and it leaves you very close to most of the tourist places in Lower Manhattan in a matter of 25-30 minutes without transferring. I hope to return soon. Thank you Rita for all the attention.

BEST PLACE TO STAY. EVER. If there were an Academy Award - an AirBNB award for best hostess - Ladi would win it, hands down. Internationally, even.  From  sparkling clean rooms, morning coffee, cold bottles of water, nice cold A/C, comfy and clean bed,and breakfast if you are lucky, this is THE place to stay in NYC.  Affordable yet very safe - Roosevelt Island is a residential area housing professionals and never once did we feel unsafe there - just like home in TN.  And then there is Ladi and her sweet Angel - little Angel rode with me to the parking garage, and gave me some history about the island and where to find common things like restaurants and grocery stores on the short 1 1/2 block walk back.  Parking is $24/day which is so reasonable.  And you are only one subway stop, tram ride, or ferry ride (take your choice) from Manhattan!  There's also a free bus that takes you around the island. I hope to always stay here, and of course, with Ladi, on future trips to NYC.   Then there is Ladi the concierge - she tells you what subways to take, where to find this, that...and all only a phone call away for any questions you have when you are staying with her.  Honestly, you feel like you are staying with one of your favorite relatives!  Even helped us unload and load back up.  They are very considerate hosts and you don't even know they are there unless you seek them out to talk.  I can't say enough wonderful things about Ladi and Angel.   Have stayed in many nice Airbnb's over the past few years - Ladi is over the top amazing!   Love you both and your kind, generous hearts...unexpectedly, Ladi and Angel were the BEST part of an amazing trip to NYC!

Ladi is an excellent host, exceedingly generous and accommodating. She also was very quick about communicating, which took a great deal of stress out of my trip. The location is very pleasant and the accommodations clean and well-appointed. I had the best time!

Great choice for NYC accommodation! Much cheaper than hotels in Manhattan or Brooklyn. The apartment was larger than I expected, and was more than comfortable for two guests. Took about 50 minutes to get into the city each morning. Free parking is a huge bonus because most hotels charge $50 USD+ per night. We were mostly lucky with finding a spot but once had to drive around for 45 min to find a parking spot and then had to move our car the next morning before 8:30 am. We did see some bugs in the apartment so be aware to keep all your food tightly sealed! The full kitchen with a full fridge was awesome to have. Wifi worked great but the Roku and Netflix unfortunately were very glitchy and we weren't able to get them to work (plus the couch was a bit uncomfortable). The area seemed a bit unsafe to walk around alone at night so just be aware and vigilant. Lots of good food options within walking distance of the apartment which are open late. We didnt see Damien during our stay but he was very responsive over the airbnb app with any questions and he provided clear check in instructions. Overall would recommend, especially if you are traveling to NYC by car

We cancelled the stay after one night. My friend, who arrived a night before me, came to the apartment with a dead cockroach next to the bed, hair of previous guests on the floor, and some small plastic trash on the floor.  Damien was very accommodating though! Given the good cleanliness ratings, I assume our experience was a one-off experience after the cleaning staff changed. Damien was very understanding and refunded us an extra night beyond what we would have been entitled to per the refund policy.  Overall, the situation was unpleasant for us but Damien handled it very well.
I would stay here again. Convenient location in Brooklyn and we did not feel unsafe in the area.
Great location on a quiet, shady street. Lots of cute restaurants and coffee shops within easy walking distance. Communication with Dennis was easy. Met my needs perfectly for a month away for work.

Great place. Super stylish and comfortable. Best value for money I’ve ever had in NYC. Steps away from the J train - 30 mins to lower Manhattan/Williamsburg. Place could use a bit of a deep clean in certain areas (shower walls especially) but otherwise was very clean. It’s in a half basement so tall people be ware! I’m only 5’9” and I bumped my head twice in the entrance and had to bend down in the shower to wash my face and hair. Neighbourhood is pretty sketchy. Had some hoodlums sitting on their front steps next door the whole time, talking loud, listening to loud music, smoking weed. They were harmless but did nothing to make us feel welcome in their “hood” if you get my drift. There’s not much to do around but there’s plenty of places to get food and supplies ( pharmacy, coffee shops, delis, small restaurants, convenience store and large dollar store) all within a two minute walk. Our hosts live upstairs and were discrete. We found free parking right in front of the apartment and didn’t have to move it for the 4 days that we were there. Electronic keypad lock on the door made check in and check out simple and easy and we didn’t have to worry about taking a key with us into the city. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants to feel the authenticity of New York’s inner cities, however it is not the most family friendly.

The host has a dog in the apartment, which is not mentioned on the website, and my friend had allergic to dogs. When the dog is left alone in the apartment , it begin barking when you try to enter the building, which is really stressful. Another issue is that the dog pees and poops in the hallway, making the place stink. I do not recommend this place at all.

We had a great time with Mayra and her family. The accommodation was as expected. It might have been good to have been informed about the dog beforehand. That wasn't a problem for us, but the information in advance would have been relevant, especially for people who are afraid of dogs or have allergies.  The family is very friendly and helpful. Location also great! We would come back next time we are in NY.

This is a nice spacious room with a large bed in a shared space. The other two residents here are girls but they had overnight visitors.  I only spent three nights here and it would have been difficult for me to spend more nights. The bedroom is clean, but the duvet came with no cover and started to smell moldy after a night.  I was not given a towel nor was I shown where to access glasses in the kitchen.  I was not told how the windows open or how the air conditioner worked - but this isn’t hard to figure out. For first time visitors to NYC, especially after a long flight, it may be more challenging.  It felt a little disconnected to live here, being treated as someone passing through instead of some hospitality extended.  The check in had a window between 7 and 7:30 pm, I was late by fifteen minutes and had to notify of it... it was quite stressful to be honest. I’d say this place is ok for a night or two. The location served my purpose as I needed to stay here, but it would have been nice to be given some towels, complete bed linen, instructions for how to access drinking water and glasses etc.
Great place, super clean theres a couch bed and extra bed. Reasonably close to the MTA. But be careful parking on the street the side panel was stolen off our car.

Great location and beautiful place. Perfect for 3 people or 4. Beautiful and quiet neighborhood in a cool part of Brooklyn. Starbucks and deli on the corner is a must visit! Also great bagel shops and bars within a 10 minute walk! Subway station is a block away and easy to find. As far as parking we only had difficulty one night when street cleaning was the next day. There were 3 of us and we are all single ladies, but we never felt unsafe as there are multiple sets of doors to get into the apartment and the neighborhood was relatively safe for NY. Highly recommend this place if you can get it! Derek was an awesome host. Gave us some recommendations that were great when we would see him in passing! Stay here!!

Derek and Betsy's place is a steal! Check in is easy, the space is quite large and very clean (tho it's winter right now, so we didn't get a chance to take advantage of the outdoor space!), and the location is amazing (a block from the subway). I appreciated how flexible and responsive they were to our needs, it was the perfect place for an extended stay in Brooklyn.
This place is steal for the price! Beautiful, large, with a lot of character, one of a kind. Very helpful and attentive host! I'm hoping to come back, thank you!
The space is large and very comfortable, though the neighbourhood can be loud during weekends. Communication was poor before check in which caused some stress but we had no problems after that.

It was a bit of an unpleasant experience ... I mean the time when you asked me about who was on the reservation and didn't even say hello or good morning (it was rude and uncomfortable) the location was not bad, the kitchen was a bit dirty .

10/10 would recommend and would look for this place next time we are in town. Pictures don’t do it justice. It is perfectly located the apartment itself is absolutely wonderful and the hosts made the stay easy and stress free

My darling and I stayed for 8 days at Andrew's place. The apartment is ideally located in Brooklyn, just 200 meters from the subway (R line). There are two supermarkets not far away and a number of small restaurants. Andrew is a friendly, responsive, very accommodating host, attentive to our requests while being very discreet. He just comes into the apartment to feed his goldfish but for our part, we never met him apart from the first day when handing over the keys. The house is truly typical with its American flag on the facade. The apartment, located on the first floor, is very spacious, tastefully furnished and decorated and from the first minute you feel at home. There is everything you need for a pleasant stay, whether in the bathroom (towels, toilet paper, etc.), in the kitchen (superb stove, large microwave, American fridge, dishes, etc.) My friend particularly appreciated the fact that there are also the little "essentials" in the kitchen available such as salt, pepper, sugar, oil, coffee... it's really cool. Concerning the room, storage, good bedding, we have good slept... oh yes, I almost forgot, the neighborhood is rather quiet, we were afraid of being disturbed by the noise but no. The living room, great, we could have danced there, it's so big, giant screen TV, good wifi. There would have been a snowstorm for a week, it wasn't a problem to keep busy inside. In short, we will have great memories of our stay at Andrew's and if we ever return to New York one day, we will know where. house.

Dina was very responsive and helpful.  The only weird thing was that the door from the vestibule downstairs was never locked.  This was not a problem, but could be.  And if you needed to get in downstairs, the keys are only upstairs next to the door the apartment.  That was unclear.  I was looking for the lockbox on the first level inside perhaps near the mailboxes.  Felt a bit unsafe, though it is a generally safe neighborhood.

Morgan was very accommodating in checking me in late at night on the 8 th as I had a terrible experience at courtyard Marriott .  The place was exactly as described .  I had to tighten the hot water knob in order to get streams of hot water. During our stay there was suspect gas leak so we could not cook anything so we just ate out. We asked about compensation but was no successful in getting any but overall communication was good and she was attentive to my needs and try her best to accommodate .  With a few tweaks her place should be a gem .

Apartment has great location and spacious living room was much appreciated. Although the shower wasn’t easy to use, the heater make a strange and unsafe-like noise and moreover there’s a cold-tabacco smell impregnated in the whole apartment.  Host very flexible for check in and out.

I will start with the positives - this place is in a very convenient location. Its right near the corner of 2nd Ave and E86th st, so very handy for just about everything.  Now - for the rest of the place.... I felt quite uncomfortable during my stay here. It felt like the owners had just stood up and walked out and I was stepping into their home, just the way they left it (I feel like I know a bit too much about the owners/last people who stayed in this place, eg. there was an empty shopping bag and wrapping from somebody's recent visit to Agent Provocateur - I hope you are enjoying your new purchase..wink wink.. ) The bedroom was crammed full of furniture making access difficult and there was no floor space to put your suitcase. There was also nowhere to put your own things, the wardrobes and drawers were full of clothes. The bed was just a mattress on top of another mattress which was wrapped in plastic so if you get into bed with any sort of speed the top mattress will slide off the bottom one. The bathroom was also crammed full of personal products and toiletries - cheers for the dry shampoo and cue-tips, not sure if they were meant for me but they came in handy. There were used towels hanging on the back of the door and the "clean" guest towels had an unpleasant musty smell. Toilet broke at one point but my handy colleague managed to fix it.  The apartment was noisey at night - but maybe that is just all inner city New York apartments, don't know, but Bring ear buds.  All in all - fine to crash for a couple of nights if you aren't fussy all you are doing there is sleeping, but you are paying for the location - and that is it! I am young and a student so I have a pretty low standard for accomodation, I will stay pretty much anywhere, and this was borderline for me.

This adorable studio has all a single person or couple could need! Located across the street from Brookdale hospital, this studio is perfect for visiting medical students or traveling nurses. The proximity to public transit was also convenient (20 minute walk from the L train and 5 minutes from the bus stop). Also a 5 min walk from Key Foods and a laundromat.  The landlady Marsha stocked the apartment full of everything you could need (a couple days worth of food, more than enough toiletries, ect). She also messaged to check in and offer suggestions for places in the area.   The area isn't the safest. However, the apartment is in a well lit area and with the keypad lock I never felt unsafe.    The apartment is exactly as it looks in the photos! A/C unit and a couple fans so it wasnt too hot even in the summer.

Very well located, near two subway stations leading easily to Manhattan, the apartment is very quiet, and New York is very noisy. No feeling of insecurity, the police station is next to the metro exit. The neighborhood is typical and Latino. Very good address with modern equipment.

I am a bit reluctant to write this review because I'm afraid that people will flock to Tania's place, and then it won't be available when I want to visit NYC!  I've stayed at 5 different AirBnBs in NY, and this is definitely my favorite place.  It was my third time staying here in April 2021.  Tania is a thoughtful hostess who truly cares about the well-being of her guests.

Zain was undoubtably the best host I have ever had in Airbnb. He had had some upsetting previous guests who had done a lot of ruin his apartment. Despite this Zain spent 11 hours on the day of our arrival (whilst we were flying) cleaning and replacing stolen items to ensure he did not have to cancel our work trip. Myself and colleagues were blown away by his help, communication and beautiful apartment which was all brand new and upsettingly for Zain had been near destroyed the night before. The apartment itself is beautifully decorated, had everything for a comfortable and stylish stay, google play, huge tv, air-con in all rooms and is a short Uber from most places. The road is quiet, however we did not explore the surrounding area due to time constraints. Zain was a 40 minute drive away and drove  straight to us on one occasion to help us out. Thank you Zain so so much for letting us stay. We will certainly be back.

Zain was a magnificent host who was consistently available to contact, often replying to messages within minutes. He was very helpful with giving advice and tips on the surrounding area and where to visit.  When we arrived, the lock on the bathroom door didn’t work properly and even though we arrived quite late, we messaged him and he came round straight away and fixed it.  The apartment was modern, very clean, safe, comfortable and had good amenities nearby. We did not use the cooking facilities but there were plenty available.  Considering location, the subway stations were quite close. Easy to get to Manhattan and JFK. It was a diverse area meaning there were a range of different restaurants however we felt a bit unsafe walking at night. The area seemed a little run down and we were obviously tourists - it was a mainly Hispanic and Indian community.  Overall, the apartment was great, we really annoyed our stay and would strongly recommend Zain as a host.

This place was adorable. I am a fan of the Victorian age and this apartment decorated it with ornate pieces that brought the era to life. It was equipped with all the necessities; glasses for the champagne we bought, bathroom toiletries such as soap and shampoo. Watch out for the wooden mat set right outside the tub, it’s a beautiful piece but you can easily trip over it. I laughed at myself the couple times I did it. Also make sure when you leave the premises you take your phone and keys!! I ordered Postmates and the second door you walk through at the entrance closed and since I had no key I wasn’t able to go back in for some time. I eventually was able to contact Airbnb support and get the code to the doors but it was scary to think I wasn’t able to go back in. I would completely stay here again, it was such a great NY experience.

Great location to Laguardia Airport $14.00 by Ride Share.  Plenty of restaurants, drug stores and Starbucks all within walking distance. Walking distance to the subway and a very short ride into Manhattan. Zain was always attentive and prompt with all replies. My family and I enjoyed our stay.

The place is nice and well equipped. The train noises are surprising first but you get used to them fast. The street that is on is dirty and a bit sketchy, but you can easily walk to cool restaurants and bars, and the subway is also near. Overall I recommend it

This was fine for the last night of our trip because it was close to Newark airport but we weren't hugely comfortable. Air conditioning was loud and had to be on full blast in the main bedroom to reach the other rooms, the room with the day bed didn't have any sortof shade over the skylight which isn't ideal with a baby, some plug sockets were hard to use and seemed dangerous and not fitted well, the bath didn't have a plug and the pillows were very flat. None of the TV streaming had log ins so we couldn't use them. The fridge didn'tseem that clean and the garden was a bit of a mess. There was loud music and voices quite late in the neighbourhood. This is probably suited to younger people and without families. Communication with the host was excellent and quick.

I was extremely disappointed by the property and the customer service from Elevate Properties. A group of 4 friends and I had booked a stay at this property for my birthday weekend. There was a safety issue that made my friends and I feel so unsafe that we decided not to stay at the property and left 15 minutes after arriving. I then reached out to Elevate Properties and there response was essentially, “nobody else has ever had this concern before so we’re sorry you felt unsafe but there’s nothing we can (or will) do.” $540 dollars down the drain. So disappointing.

Would not recommend.tub was filthy  Neighborhood unsafe ,noisy Walls are super thin heard baby upstairs crying, heard neighbors outside .felt super unsafe left apt immediately! Did not stay there one night even though we booked for two!!

Newly renovated apartment was exactly as described.  We choose it based on off-street parking and proximity to the airport and subway system.  20 minute drive to airport, 5 minute walk to subway.  Parking is gated and locked and you are the only one using it so don't stress that you'll be blocked in.

The apartment was great! So clean and looked EXACTLY like the pictures. There were a lot of places that we could walk to and a subway station nearby. I’ve heard a lot of nightmares about airbnb in general but staying here was definitely a breath of fresh air. I felt like Venessa was my roomie for the week- she helped out with the subway, gave great recommendations for food and was very accommodating. She even let me in one night when I got locked out. Sarynette was also amazing when she popped by to water the plants. I felt very safe and she even was like a second mother after she gave me tips about which train car to get in if I ever felt unsafe. If you’re looking for great value for the location you’re in, definitely stay here. I’m already looking at coming back to New York for another orchestra in January and this will certainly be the first place I have in mind.

Ricky’s apartment was very clean and a quick 15 minute walk from the subway making commuting very easy!! I was able to find street parking directly in front of the apartment which made my stay less stressful. I would definitely stay here again!
The place is according to price, inside is fine but the accommodation is located in a complicated area. The nearby commerce is dirty and unsafe.

Zubia was a wonderful host. I was scare for a little bit because was my first time using Airbnb, I didn’t know what to expect. The place was nice, clean and the way was described. Our trip was a girl’s trip for shopping and everything went well. I will definitely will use Zubia again. We already planning our next trip… lol… can’t wait.

Where to begin? If I could give more than 5 stars I would! The outside of the home is well kept, in a very safe, clean neighborhood in Queens. We felt completely at ease walking to the diner and train station in the dark. The host made sure I had a place to park for our 3 day 2 night stay so we could leave my car and use public transit (which is CHEAP!). The host sent detailed check in instructions but was also at the house doing maintenance outside when we arrived so he helped us get settled, made sure we knew how to use the electronic keypad to get in, he even went so far as to put out snacks and a birthday balloon for me since it was a girls trip for my bday! He gave us ideas of free and low cost things to do, helped us to find the train (3 blocks away!) and even arranged our first ride into east village. The house rental was the entire first floor. There is a comfy futon that becomes the 3rd bed. 2 bedrooms with very comfy beds, huge closet in the hall, a nice size bathroom and a huge kitchen. There is a patio area out back and it’s kid friendly with some play things out side (no kids came with us. 3 adult ladies). The rooms are really big! The kitchen is huge and well equipped. Bathroom water pressure was great. The decor is pleasant and inviting. There are live plants in the huge bow window in the living room. Small touches like that make a very homey feeling and we all felt safe and at home there. There is a small corner store that makes food half a block away, a liquor store, bar/lounge, gas station, and diner all 3 minutes walk away. The J train in 3 ish blocks/6 min walk away. We never felt unsafe walking anywhere at anytime of the day/night. All in all a wonderful stay! Thank you so much for everything and we are looking forward to our next stay with you!

A good and cozy apartment. A bit noisy but NYC never sleeps therefore its totally normal. Location was a bit scary in the night but after few days we realized it was actually a good region to stay. We would recommend this place for sure!

The accommodation is good in general. The fact that it is two blocks from the subway is something very favorable. At first the neighborhood seemed a little unsafe to us, but then we gained confidence. The arrival process is somewhat complicated but by reading the instructions carefully we managed it, the only thing I didn't like was that the safe where you get the key was attached to a fence of the building where it smelled very bad and there was garbage. As for space, the room is a good size but the bathroom is small, mobility takes a bit of work. The room faces the street, which was somewhat noisy at night. I think the area to improve is cleanliness.

Positive point: The location is perfect! We walk a few minutes and you are in Time Scare. Negative point, communication with the host was difficult and entry and departure is not free...We have to wait to get and hand over the keys...There is also a note on the fridge asking us to say that we are friends if the neighbors ask...I would not have felt very comfortable if I had had the question.

The apartment is not exactly at the address indicated and clearly it is a prohibited sub-let because we are asked to say that we are "friends"... the location is great but the hosts do not respond to messages and do not indicate the problems which we will quickly discover! For example, the convertible sofa in the living room is broken, we had to complain to get an inflatable mattress to inflate every evening even though we said we needed the two bedrooms and the living room to sleep… we were promised a new sofa which never arrived. Then the advert (since modified!) specified a washing machine so we packed our bags accordingly but the same thing doesn't exist... and the icing on the cake is that no one responds anymore, neither on the site nor by text message... we had to stress until the last second because no information for arrival or departure... unnecessary stress with a host who answers me this evening while I'm at the airport and I've been waiting for his response since noon yesterday! We dream I have never seen such a lack of service for its customers. Communication is deplorable, it's pathetic to behave like this because usually we are always very well received by the hosts. In short, I am canceling this host who is not reliable at all and who only does this for the money... disgusting!

On arrival we had to book into a hotel after waiting hours as there was no reply to any messages or calls. Very stressful. We eventually got a message in the night saykng there had been afamily issue, but saw this in another review too and it only takes a minute to call or email. Minimal apology.  We moved in the next day and did get 1.5 nights refund. Flat not at addres advertised, possibly deliberately and we were asked to never answer the door. We never saw 'the host'and the whole thing seeemd very dodgy so we took all our papers and money out with us each time. Flat ok. Sofa bed broken if you need it, and one end held up with a bin! Furey friends in garbage area downstairs but not in flat. Location good. AC worked. Generally uncaref for and a bit grubby. AVOID

first of all, the location is unbeatable. close to timessq, theaters, hudson river piers, midtown and central park entrance, almost all subway lines and connection to other boroughs and airports. infinite variety of restaurants, bars and smaller shops. the apartment itself is small, but there´s a fully equipped kitchen (fridge and oven would need a cleaning), two double rooms. the sofabed in the living area can´t be used as it´s broken. air condition works well but terribly loud. huge bathroom, don´t be scared of moldy shower curtain. summarized: perfect location! good for 2 couples, smaller family or group of friends. price is very good compared to other aparments in the area, that´s why some of the mentioned details have to be accepted, I guess.  very important: make sure to clarify checkin details and confirm the concrete time, better three times! it´s not funny to wait calling and messaging during 3 hours in a bar to get an answer and finally the keys after an overseas trip (but we were offered a compensation then, which is highly appreciated!)

The host response was excellent. Howeveri encountered a very bad situation with another person smoking. Although I reached out to the host it appeared that nothing stopped the person from smoking. I had to vacate the space on two occasions so that my allergies wouldn't get too bad.  The place has potential but it's really dingy and outdated.  I had house flies sharing the space with me until I left.  This I didn't report.  I did not feel like it would make any sense.  The sofa bed needs to be replaced...very uncomfortable.   The AC needs replacing.  The bathroom is in serous need of updating including the drainage.  No rug! When you bathe you still feel unclean.   The kitchen countertop needs changing since all the burnt spots and marks made it looked dirty.  Loved the pots!  The space needed a good cleaning along with the dingy linens.  A suspicious door is next to the bathroom on the left which seemingly gives access from another space.  The lock appearsto be on the other side. The neighborhood is good. Space size is also good.  I would not return unless the space is updated.

When I checked in Thursday, November 10th, everything seemed ok at first. I noticed the only way to get the apartment door to close and stay closed is by locking the door. If you shut the door without locking the black box, the door pops right back open. I wasn’t planning on leaving the door unlocked, but my point is the door is not secure at all.   When I walked in I noticed the bathroom was pretty clean, but it had no soap to wash your hands and it didn’t lock. The host claims the door locks, but it doesn’t. I have pictures and video. My biggest problem with the door is there is a door on each side of the bathroom that appears to be other rooms within the property. Al claimed one room was for Air B&B supplies, but the other room was definitely not for supplies. I heard someone cussing and arguing on the other side of that door. It made me extremely uncomfortable because though the door was locked for me, it seemed they would be able to easily gain access to the listing I was in.   I saw two roaches when I returned from an outing with my fiancé. I also heard music blasting until 2 am one night and 1 am another night. I reached out to Air B&B because I needed resolution. They told me I should reach out to Al to let him know what I saw when I saw the roaches. I wasn’t comfortable talking to him about it because people have been going in and out of the other apartment door next-door to that one slamming doors back-and-forth. It was uncomfortable period. When I did reach out to him via the Airbnb app, his response made it even more awkward. He said “I find that strange.” He then proceeded to make things more awkward by telling me Air BnB was investigating me when all I asked him for was bug spray, new towels and a fresh set of sheets n blanket because it was freezing and there was only a sheet on the bed. I know it was nothing more than deflecting. They never have had any reason whatsoever to investigate me. He was defensive and mad, just because I brought to his attention the roaches. I left his listing the very next day and went and got another listing. which was nothing like his.  When I got to the new listing, I realized I left my coat in Al’s listing and a stew that I made for my fiancé. I went back and got my coat but he claims my stew was not there and I know full well I left it there along with whatever else was in the bag I packed of my items. I hope whoever ate our pot of beef stew choked on it. He then tried to get me to give a positive review based on getting my coat. What kind of sense does that make? This review is based on my experience and of course I was going to get the coat I paid for. Too bad some people don’t care about anything but the money… the listing was outdated and basic.
