The window seals were dirty and the wall unit has no covering and bugs can get in from the outside. The electrical tape covering a few of the openings on one side of the wall unit is not enough. The bedroom window facing the street has no screen and that too is unsafe. Thankfully I brought my own soap and seasonings…. if I could I’d post pictures and videos to prove none of this is made up.

Brad was a great communicator. Place was recently renovated. Could use better cleaning service though.  Location was very sletchy and unsafe. I do recommend staying there if you dont care much about your safety

Excellent host. Very nice appartment on 2nd floor. Walking distance of the ferry witch is very nice.  But very sketchy neighboor hood .. lots of gangs and cops warning us to be sure to lock doors and to not hang outside .. with little kids .. we almost canceled on arrival because of this.  But the cop told us they was a copcar parked infront of our block or 200 meters down the street 24/7 .. witch was true and that was the reason we decided to stay.  The fact that the appartment is 2nd floor with 2 doors to lock is also a good point.  Wouldnt recommand with kids

Quirky place with great location: Joe's Pizza (best in NY) is 100 yards away and we had Joes every other day. Main bedroom faces Houston St. The middle room is a kitchen/dining/bathroom(Shower!). The back bedroom has two couches that can sleep two kids. Finally, there is a very small toilet room right at the back.  Pros: * Communication was great; rob was v. responsive * Location is great: near many fantastic restaurants. Cons: * Pretty noisy at night and there are no curtains so bedroom is not very dark. * Heat level can only be adjusted with pliers or by leaving window open (but that lets in a lot of street noise) * Stairs to 3rd floor are uneven and narrow - may pose problems from some travelers. Pros: *  Bed & pillow were firm just as I like them. * Apt was clean and there were some appliances but no microwave.

Our stay was great and the apartment was clean and was what the Description read online. Parking was hard to find and the surrounding area were a little sketchy for my taste. We were able to find restaurants we could walk to and easily get an Uber from the apartment.
Absolutely love Rob, he was beyond easy to take to. So lovely and warm and beyond professional and personal. Thank you for having us. We would love to stay here again

This is a fun place to stay. The location is fantastic, in Greenwich Village, near Soho and Washington Square, also not far to the High Line. It’s a great walking area. I love the main bedroom, and my daughter was comfortable in the second bedroom too.  I haven’t seen such a funny toilet/sink combo like that in my life, and I have been around the block a few times!   The only con for me was night noise, but it was one night out of six. Rob is a super helpful and welcoming host!

Our stay was great. Rob is a phenomenal host, very communicative and accommodating!   The location is phenomenal. Greenwich, soho, west village are just great places to be if you’re staying in nyc for a few days. The apt is close to fabulous restaurants and cafés and popular late night spots. Very easy to get to the subway also, so

Our family of three - two parents and one teenager - enjoyed our weeklong stay here very much. We spent most of our time out and about. The location was perfect for accessing the bustling neighborhoods in Manhattan and transportation to other boroughs, too. Rob was a great host, checking in with us and offering friendly (and good) suggestions. The building and neighborhood felt safe during our comings and goings from 8 am to midnight. The AC kept the apartment at a good temperature even on a 100 degree day. We appreciated that this space was unique and authentic.

Check-in, check-out easy peasy, communication with Rob efficient and helpful, location, neighborhood perfect. Apartment was everything we needed for a comfortable stay, quirky in a good way, enjoyed and laughed about our first time experience of the shower/bathtub in the kitchen, good closet space. Everything in the apartment worked, and we hope to return to this same fun space again.
Wonderful apartment , with breathtaking windows facing downtown  There is everything you need and plenty of space.  Rob is  a very nice and helpful person
We had a great time staying here, Rob was an attentive host and the neighborhood couldn’t be more central.

We loved Narnia. It really was the perfect location and exactly as depicted in photos and in the description. No surprises. Super clean. Rob was there when we arrived and very easy to communicate with before and during our week’s stay. Everything was straightforward and uncomplicated. It was a flawless Airbnb experience. Thank you, Rob! We’re grateful and will be back!
There really isn’t a better location and the set up of the apartment is ideal - with two cozy sleeping areas with large beds. Apartment is well appointed and Rob is an incredible host.

Great location with lots in walking distance. But it is right over the road from a fire station so a lot of sirens and noise. Need to be careful with the height of getting in and out of the shower. Very cool decoration/artwork and funky vibe. Rob was also really flexible and nice to talk to - thanks Rob!

Absolutely best location in NYC. We go to NYC several times a year and I think we found our new favorite neighborhood. I was a little nervous because it's near Houston (which is busy), but it's actually set off on a side street (Bedford) so you don't get any of the downside of a busy location and you're just at the entrance to a series of small streets that lead into the Village. Lots of great restaurants literally next door and easy to get to the subway or West Side highway for running. We were doing a drop-off at NYU and I can't imagine a better location! The apartment itself looks just like the photos--one bedroom has a ton of light and the other is darker, but perfect for those sleeping in late (teens). The building itself was remarkably quiet and we always felt very safe walking around. Rob's a great host--the apartment is fully stocked and everything was easy to find. Highly recommend!!!

Rob and the house was perfect! Great communication at all times. Awesome location close to DD and a convenience a store. House was clean and very well stocked with anything you could need. Beds were comfortable and AC’s worked great. Basement was great for watching movies and games. Would def recommend for anyone looking!
Rob’s place is super cute, so clean and loved all the amenities. We had everything we needed and the parking spot was so helpful. Very thoughtfully laid out and a rare find in queens.
Rob was a great host!

Great place in Queens. Had a group of 10 guys and had plenty of room. Rob was a great host and made sure we had everything we needed. Also great location, 30 second walk to 7-11, pizza shops, liquor store, Dunkin etc. would definitely book again

Rob is very quick to respond & helpful for anything going on. The property is clean, plenty of space and was able to accommodate 6 adults and 4 children. The location is central to stores and public transportation and also a quiet neighborhood. Rob provided basic necessities that you would most likely not travel with e.g. hangers, iron and some toiletries were provided. It was great to have parking because my sister who stayed elsewhere received 3 tickets in 4 days. The highlight for our kids was the game and theatre room. It kept them busy instead of sitting around bored. We also got to use the popcorn machine which was a BIG hit as well. I would definitely stay here again when visiting NY.

Clean, organized and as depicted. The area is a bit creepy… neighbors veggies laid out on the driveway  make it hard to get in/out of  the  car. Area is noisy …. Overall great experience no issues arose and parking was a + especially for NYC
Great Airbnb and location. The home was clean and equipped with the things you need for your stay. Rob was very responsive with questions.

Rob really took care of our trip. We were a group of 10 people in his AirBnB and we had a great time.  Very clean house, quiet surroundings and neighborhood, nothing to say. When we arrived we found everything we needed and if the opportunity arises, we will definitely come back!  5 stars without discussion

We had a great stay at Rob’s! Everything is clean and as described. The location is very convenient, close to major highways, yet relatively quiet. You can hear cars going by but tolerable at night. Convenient drive to Manhattan and Flushing. There are enough sitting areas, both in the living room and at the kitchen island. The kitchen is fully stocked. To our surprise, we even found condiments that we didn’t think to pack. Parking is a also huge plus in the city! The basement is nicely put together and definitely a highlight for kids.   I wish there could be night lights in the hallway, as the rooms get really dark once all the lights are out.   Overall, we had a enjoyable stay.
Amazing, cozy place. Rob was very friendly from the very beginning and made my time there very comforting. Will pick this place again when I visit NY.
Rob’s place had everything we needed. It was absolutely amazing and we enjoyed every second of the stay. Very nice, safe, and private home. Would recommend!

This a nice place for a big family or a group of people. It’s in a quiet area of queens and has a 7-11, liquor store and Dunkin’ Donuts right around the corner. Place was nicely stocked with towels and everything you need. Rob was responsive and very nice.
A wonderful stay was given by Rob and the recommendations were so good!
Rob was a great host and very responsive. The game room was a hit with all the family and helped us bond even further!
Beautiful house,very spacious and comfortable,very clean,Rob is an amazing host …100 %recommended❤️🙏🏻.Thanks Rob for all your attention with us!!

We loved staying at Yash’s apartment! Flexible checkin and check out was much appreciated and we adored the neighborhood! So much charm and beauty in the upper west side. The apartment itself is older, but extremely spacious and fit our needs to a tee. We were afraid it would be cold, but it was actually very comfortable. The location is perfect, only a couple blocks to the subway and Central Park, and tons of places to eat nearby. We would absolutely stay here again.

first off when I got there I fell over the bed that was there as soon as you open the door. next place was not clean to perfection my socks got dirty in 10 mins. and placed smelled like cigarettes and weed since at the other entrance a few guys were hanging out and arguing. felt a bit uncomfortable and unsafe.  the king size bed was extremely hard no blankets were provided. then to top it off they try to charge me 350 for minor stuff when I already paid a 150 cleaning fee this was a sad experience used it for dressing for my sister wedding.
Well located in Manhattan, fruit for breakfast with water dispenser now, possibility of leaving your suitcase if you have a late flight!

DJ was such a sweet host! This location was super close to the train station which was very practical for getting around. Felt a little scary walking at night but that may just be unfamiliarity, as I often saw young people walking their dogs in the neighbourhood.

On the plus side: modern, clean, safe (inside the apartment and in the neighborhood), super comfy bed, easy to get to the trains, shops are nearby, and some phenomenal restaurants are within walking distance. ***MUST go to Soleluna; an Italian place nearby. It's AMAZING!  On the negative side: 1)The owner didn't respond to a single text from me - Not when I couldn't get into the building (had to buzz other tenants. Luckily the apartment inside the building was unlocked!), not when the shower didn't work (had to take a bath the whole time I was there), not when I asked him to turn up the heat or provide extra blankets, etc. - 2) it's MUCH darker than it appears in photos, 3) Didn't have basic accessories like a bath mat, face cloths, lamps (overhead lighting was retina burning), or extra blankets (I got cold and there's no way to turn up the heat), etc. 4) It's about 40 minutes by train to get to the best parts of the city. And the train system (of course, not the responsibility of the owner) is VERY complicated (but, cheap).  So, most people will have to Uber everywhere, which can get VERY expensive.   The main frustration was the lockbox was broken. So, as a woman traveling alone, locked outside in the dark for an hour, in an unknown neighborhood, I was a little scared. I had to buzz several other tenants before one came out and let me in.   ***Pro tip... take photos of the location, check-in instructions, and wifi information (before you leave your country of origin) if you're traveling to the US from another country. Your SIM card won't work, so you can't access data on your phone unless you're connected to public wifi - which is NOT recommended. There is private wifi once you get into the apartment, but in order to connect, you'll need the instructions - which are not provided in the apartment - so the photos are crucial for navigating everything once you land.

Having stayed at many hostels all over the globe I had established expectations. This stay did not meet those expectations. The cubicle is so small I couldn’t stand up comfortably with all my gear. The bed was 6’ long, I am 6’4”. The guy across the hall kept making a ton of noise in the middle of the night; ripping tape off boxes, opening zippers 40-50 times at 3am. Taking phone calls, alarms going off, street noise. I averaged 2 hours of sleep and finally moved to a different place my last night. Close to Madison Square Garden but sketchy people walking around at night.

Our stay at the apartment was perfect from the beginning.  Communication was super easy, she was always ready to help and give tips on what to do and places to visit.  The room is like the pictures, the bed was super comfortable and calm to rest well for a long day in the city, we had a closet to put all our clothes. During the entire trip the temperature in NYC was always high but if that wasn't the case we had heating in the room and an extra blanket available to use. We could use the kitchen but we never did because we left early in the morning for Manhattan and came back at the end of the day, eating out.  The bathroom was always clean and was good for both of us. The shower pressure and water temperature were very good.  Patrícia made shower products available in case we hadn't taken them. The location is close to several subway lines, which made it easy to travel to Manhattan, which was our intention on this trip. There are several restaurants, bars, grocery stores in the area and there is an NYPD station across the street. We always arrived home after 11 p.m. and from the station to home on foot we never felt any kind of danger, however, if you don't use Line M by metro, the distance is a little longer and you pass through some streets with poor lighting. Maybe I wouldn't advise walking alone on the street after 10/11 at night. During the day the area is full of life :) Patrícia shares the house with a friend but we only saw her once. There is a super affectionate cat living in the apartment but she is almost always in her own space.  Just like we talked to Patrícia, we had some difficulty opening the building's door, it was necessary to fix the lock, but from what Patrícia informed us, this is quite normal in older buildings in NYC.  (just so you don't think it's strange if the same thing happens to you).    I recommend the space for everyone who wants to visit NYC and wants to have a mix between what is the "real" city and the city full of tourists.  The space is very comfortable and I would definitely stay at Patrícia's house again :) Thank you for everything and much success :) Best wishes*

The people were nice but I ended up getting bed bugs. They said they didn’t see anything but I have bites. The first night it was just two and I thought maybe it was a rash. But then I woke up with more. I was moved and then I didn’t get additional bites but by then I had a lot already. I was moved to another place with a stained blanket. Overall the place isn’t clean enough. It really ruined my stay and after I was moved I was out the next day.  I think it’s great that they are feeding the homeless 3 days a week but the place are just not clean enough. I won’t be staying again.  I did document the dirtiness and bed bugs bites. Submitted it to Airbnb Support and did get a small refund thanks to Airbnb Support.

A simple and clean place to stay for the night. The cubicle was very small but I didn’t mind this as I was traveling alone and just there for one night. There are many cubicles in a big room and the cubicles have walls that don’t go all the way up to the ceiling, so you will hear other guests moving around/snoring and the bed may shake a bit when people are walking around. Host provided earplugs. I have to stress that you are staying here because of the low price and value of having a warm place indoors, not because it’s comfortable. Good for travelers who aren’t picky.

Amazing location in the middle of the city - it was so easy to get around NYC and free breakfast 24/7!  Please note the other reviews about the open ceilings - you can definitely hear other people in the building moving around, texting, talking, snoring, their alarms, as well as traffic and people on the streets. If you are a light sleeper, I would avoid longer than a night.   Some common areas could do another round of cleaning as it was 3 showers/3 toilets/2 sinks for approx. 20 people on the floor.    Also it does get a bit sketchy at night but there is 24/7 security at the front and they are also helpful with their luggage holding.
very easy check in and out, use of the kitchen was a big positive for us, and pet friendly! Honestly a steal for the price it's at. Grab a night or 2 while you can

We were searching for an Airbnb for a NY trip and this was the perfect spot for it. Even with a big group, the space was able to accommodate us in the rooms. We were skeptical about the size of the common area being too small for the six of us, but it wasn’t a big issue as we pulled the chairs.  We loved the high ceilings and the master bathroom was amazing! The communication with the owners were on time and helpful. It’s very clean and nicely decorated.  It was a short walk to couple train lines, and we didn’t feel unsafe walking around late at night either. Overall, great experience.
Clean, good value, & looks like the pictures. Neighborhood is a little sketchy  after dark… lol. Regardless, I’d stay here again in the future for sure.

Good location, close to subway. Comfy bed. Only downside was there was a creepy dude across the street on Porter yelling things at me and then trying to run across the street after me when I was coming back to the Airbnb (around 1am). So be aware of anyone acting weird nearby in case that guy frequents the area. Other than that, great communication from hosts.

Great stay! People are being very mindful about keeping the place quiet and clean. I had a peaceful and uninterrupted sleep at night  Bathroom and shower are clean. And I enjoyed the free breakfast. Lots of great restaurants within walking distance. Public transportation is easily accessible  It’s great to know that part of what I pay for the pod goes into providing hot meals for the homeless. I feel I contributed to something great! Good job Alex and Zeena for your good deeds!

This is a fantastic stay! I enjoyed how friendly everyone was in the area. The place is walkable, and there are plenty of great food options nearby. If you're worried about staying in New York, do not worry! The place has good security, and you are given a lock to your capsule room. Make sure to lock up every time you leave your room for maximum security (even if it's just to grab water). I never felt unsafe there, and I met so many people from around the world. This was my first time staying in a hostel, and I can confidently say that it was worth it. If you're exploring the city for a couple of days, this is a nice stay. Also, one of the employees--Jeremy--is super cool and kind! We bonded over some of our interests, and it was nice to strike up conversation with someone new.

Thomas and his wife were AWESOME! We weren’t familiar with city transportation and Thomas walked me through step by step on where to go and how to get there which really made it stress free! The location was perfect and very clean. I will definitely be staying there again when we go back. Thank you Thomas for all that you did to help our stay be awesome!

We stayed in the apartment for a week and I must say it was a really good time. It's placed right by the subway station and there are some nice restaurants and fancy shops within walking distance. The apartment was well prepared for our arrival, everything was spotlessly clean with all basic toilet and kitchen amenities provided. The bed was huge and the mattress was incredibly comfortable. Our visit was during wintertime, but the apartment was definitely well-heated and we had plenty of room in the closet to keep our sweaters.  It's worth mentioning for people with disabilities, that the apartment is on the 5th floor and I believe there is no elevator.   Rob as a host was really responsive and flexible when it came to unusual check-in and check-out hours. He made sure we feel good in the apartment and that we are not missing anything.   All in all, without a doubt I can recommend Rob as a host and his apartment.

If I could give a 0/5 star rating I would.  where do we start.   •Communication from the start wasn't good- this was my first red flag.  •I booked an Airbnb on 42nd St, but was given a check in address on 43rd St-2nd red flag.  •We sat outside for HOURS trying to check in and get a hold of the host while it was pouring.. supposedly he was "out of town".  •He kept telling me the lockbox code was wrong, when in fact it was correct. I verified the code was correct and all numbers aligned with a picture to Taz.  •Another guest came down to check us in/help when the host wouldn't help after standing outside in the rain for 3 hours. •After we get upstairs, there is another couple in our room (pictures of the room I booked & confirmation proved this) This could have been bad as someone else is now staying in a room with my credit card tied to it.  •This was a new listing. he's got 1000+ good reviews on another unit, but there is something shady/ not right about this unit. There's also a sign on the back of the door along the lines of " I'm helping my friend who is very sick and renting my room out. please do not say anything, please don't contact Airbnb, if you have any problems contact me, NOT Airbnb " . Is this a coincidence with everything that transpired and a different address given after check in? •This guy never cared one bit about anything noted above. He started scrambling, suddenly calling me and other guests, once he found out I was on the phone with Airbnb to rectify this nightmare.  Airbnb confirmed something isn't right with this listing and they've opened an investigation about this new unit. I was refunded immediately after providing them pictures with what I mentioned above.   This was a horror story you only read on Reddit, and it happened to be me.   0/5****  Book elsewhere and save yourself any issues.  I stayed at the Millenium Broadway after I got my refund. Located in Times Square and would HIGHLY recommend.   Hope this helped anyone reading this review.
We had a great stay at Aidan's place. At first the location seemed a bit sketchy and intimidating, but it turned out to be great, with a very short walk to the subway!

Vera's place is really nice as the pictures show. Great location, central to tons of shops and restaurants.   But Vera's place requires extra instruction (in addition to what she provides within AirBnb's portal) to access and she was unreachable for roughly 2 hours when I was traveling in from NJ and attempting to check in. This led to a stressful, difficult time getting inside without her support/instruction and really started my trip off on the wrong foot.  That said, her place is nice and comfortable. Just be certain to get as much instruction from her as you can on your way in. And the apartment is on the 4th floor and there is no elevator I could find. So just aware of that if you need more support going up flights of stairs.

Joel’s place was perfect as always. We’ve stayed here a couple of times now and Joel and his wife are wonderful hosts. They both went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable and stress free.  The unit is bright and freshly remodeled. They left welcome package and toiletries which were so appreciated. Fridge with freezer and microwave plus a nice size table made a convenient kitchenette. Beds were comfortable and the unit was spacious. Would definitely stay again for my next trip!

Whilst it's great there are affordable Airbnb options like this in a city as expensive as New York, a little more accuracy about what guests should expect here is much needed.  It was impossible to sleep in the room due to an incessant loud noise from the radiator piping which runs up the wall right next to the bed, which also created an unpleasant damp/humidity in the room. Combine this with a constant racket from the subway and vehicles/people on the street outside (the window was nailed into a constantly open position presumably to combat the moisture from the pipe) and you had noise, damp, warmth and freezing cold from all sides! Sheets were relatively clean but bedding was uncomfortable and the room obviously hadn't been hoovered in months. The bathroom/toilet was also miniscule and gross, shared with 3/4 others.   On the plus side, really cool part of town and right next to the subway...a couple days TLC and sort out the pipe situation and this place could be quite nice

Rob met us at the check in. And guided us to the building. The apartment was good! Although we mainly used it for sleeping, as we had plans all day, everyday.   If you enjoy walking this is definitely the place to be! We walked all throughout soho during our time, and didn’t mind the fifth floor walk up.   The location is the greatest part about our stay! Rob’s place is right in the middle of great food and shopping. We had a great time!
Apartment very well located (metro 2 minutes walk), large for New York, well equipped. Rob was very responsive throughout the stay.

We had such a fantastic stay at Rob’s apartment and could not recommend it highly enough. The location was amazing with; restaurants, bars, boutiques and the subway all within walking distance. The apartment is really cute, sparkling clean and was very comfortable for two people. It was fully equipped with all kitchen supplies, spare linen and towels. The bed was comfortable and by NYC standards it was super quiet, allowing uninterrupted sleeps. Check in was a breeze and Rob was very communicative and hospitable - even dropping off a hair dryer to us! This apartment felt like our home away from home and we would love to stay here again when we one day re-live our NYC dream!

Rob was really helpful and flexible, even allowing us to stay a little later because our flight was later in the day. The location was amazing and it was nice to come back to somewhere cozy after hanging out with family and friends all over New York.
great location, perfect to explore Soho and the Village! the flat is very nice, all the comforts are in, Rob is a very simpatico host. I recommend this place :)

Absolutely perfect stay and an amazing, responsive host. I will be returning and looking to book the same place. Everything was just as described and better! I loved my stay in Rob’s apartment- location is  brilliant, apartment is very well equipped- met all my needs. Thank you very much for allowing me to stay.

We loved visiting NY and being in Soho, especially in this apartment that felt like home! Rob was great and attentive, and flexible with check-in, which I really appreciated. Raoul’s and many other great restaurants are around the corner. Oh and great shopping is in walking distance which can get you in a bit trouble…but the good kind of trouble of course! Thanks for  hosting us! Can’t wait to come back to the city!

Nice clean cosy apartment in a great location for the bars and restaurants of West Village without being in noisy or hectic surroundings. Walking distance to Chinatown, FiDi etc. Good responsive hosting and all as advertised. Would happily stay again and recommend to other visitiors. Thanks for having us Rob.
Area feels and looks a little unsafe. We had an issue with the kids getting spooked by someone outside the door.
Coco’s place is great place for a NY family trip!  There’s local stores/shops nearby for quick meals and very close to subway stations. The assigned parking spot made parking stress-free

Super close to all terminals of JFK. Yet that Southern Parkway E is a decently dangerous road, gotta drive safely on that highway.  If you are headed to Manhattan from this place, make sure you take an alternative route to avoid that highway.

Spent a week in Enisha's place in late June 2022. The unit is in a fun and cool location, and we enjoyed that. Some things you may wish to know:   Although it sleeps four-five people (maybe more with an included air mattress), I don't think the unit is ideal for families. For example, the dining table has only two chairs and one stool, and there is a large mirror in the middle of the family room, which added stress since we brought a toddler. There are hangers, but not quite as many as we needed, and no drawers or luggage racks to help out othwerwise with unpacking. This is not someone's home, and the kitchen is pretty sparsely equipped, though it does have the basics. Still, if you are planning to cook meals, know that it's not set up for gourmet cooking. That said, there's lots to eat in this neighborhood, so maybe cooking is a waste.  One issue for us was that there is only one fob provided to enter the buidling. This means you need to coordinate pretty closely with your fellow travelers to make sure the person coming back the soonest can access the apartment. There is a failsafe, in that you can have Enisha let you in, but this wasn't something I felt that comfortable with, especially very early and very late.   The unit is on a super-busy street, which is fun. It is quite loud, but that didn't really bother us; we were there during some beatiful cool weather, but there weren't screens on the windows, so we ended up closing the windows and using the AC. We would have enjoyed some seating on the balcony so we could drink our coffee and take in the scene below.  Parking in this neighborhood is well nigh impossible. Like other reviewers, we eventually gave in and parked at the garage across Flatbush. At $30/day, this is a pretty good deal, but do calculate it into your costs unless you want to spend hours of your vacation looking for street parking.   Finally, for us, the cleaners arrived promptly at 11 (checkout time). Just good to know if you were hoping for any wiggle room!  Overall, we enjoyed our trip, and were comfortable in the apartment. Hope you find the above useful.

The apartment is great. Close to metro stops. The area seems unsafe but we have not had any incidents. You can hear motorcycles and police at night. Very modern and comfortable.  Supermarkets nearby. It has a roof terrace and gym. Very clean. Air conditioning works very well. We have had to insist on communication with the hostess, especially upon arrival. There are no curtains in the living room, you can be seen from the street. Recommended for quality/price.

Overall the apartment was clean, in a good location and the rooftop was a lovely addition! Enisha allowed us to drop our bags early and also leave our luggage on check out day so we could continue to explore on the final day which was greatly appreciated!   The street is a little noisy however it is to be expected in NYC and the neighbourhood is nice with prospect park only around the corner!   Some issues; there was only one key fob for a group of 4. This fob didn’t work during our 6 day stay and it required us to gain entry from Enisha or just wait until someone was entering the apartment so this was a bit stressful at times. Enisha did write to management regarding this but it wasn’t fixed during our stay. One of the showers was a little blocked but I managed to fix it with the plunger.   However despite this, it was a nice and comfortable stay and we enjoyed our trip :)

Beautiful place, great host! The location is close to Two different subway lines and several bus stops, as well as multiple restaurants and cafés. The place is gorgeous and available toiletries are top notch, decreasing the stress of travel. The host, Susan, is very responsive. Would love to stay there again if I were ever back in Brooklyn!

First this place is amazing! The neighborhood may seem a little sketchy but we were walking the street at night with two children no problem.  The place is very clean, spacious for just sleeping and relaxing. We found it was perfect for 2 adults, and 2 kids. Having a kitchen made this trip economical for a family on budget. There are two local food markets. One around the corner snd one on Franklin Ave near subway.  This renter is so kind and thought. There were complimentary travel items, towels, extra pillows, massage chair, printer and free wifi.  Just be aware that it is about a 6-9 min to subway but its perfect distance to go to Manhattan (20 mins) or Coney Island (30 mins). Primary use A or C train to get to most places.  I will definitely pass this place on to others and stay again.

To make it short, there was no clean bedding for us to sleep in, so we left without staying there. The bedding on the beds was dirty, with hair and stains. There was also no duvet cover for the top bed and a not very fresh looking sleeping bag duvet for the bottom bed, also without a cover. The pillow case was also stained and didn't smell fresh. She offered to change one sheet, the one with hair on, but otherwise had no other bedding options for us. The bathroom was also not really clean or up to hosting standards.   It was a stressful start to our NY trip as we arrived in the evening and had to find new accommodation late at night.  Previous to arrival her communication was good and quick but I cannot recommend to stay there following our experience
The host and the room was nice. But would not recommend if you’re a first time NYC visitor. Unsafe neighbourhood!

The room was clean and comfortable and great value. The host was very communicative and checkin and checkout was very easy. The neighborhood is a lower income neighborhood and a little raggedy, but I never felt unsafe and their were decent dining options nearby

Overall we had an enjoyable stay in Queens - good transport links to Manhattan, and as a mother and daughter we felt it was a very safe area and never felt unsafe once during our stay. The apartment is spacious and bright, with a nice balcony and check in/check out was very easy.   However this apartment would benefit from some more effort in terms of what is provided. We were lucky we happened to bring our own towels as there were no hand towels, shower mat. In the kitchen no salt/pepper even though it says its provided (we left salt for the next guests) no dish drainer,  the shelves were quite dusty and there was only one drinking vessel to drink out of the first two nights which is strange for a place that says it can host 5 people. In fairness I mentioned this to the host and when we came back one day he had bought 4 cups which we appreciated. The shower curtain was very mouldy and the shower space is very small - this would be fine if the shower curtain wasn't mouldy but for someone with bad asthma this wasn't overly pleasant. The TV channels didn't work and while the WIFI was good I had to keep resetting it as it kept disconnecting. When we arrived the floor was still extremely wet and without any bath mats we were worried one of us might slip and hurt ourselves, luckily we were very careful. One of the beds seemed to be a bit broken too. I think the listing also mentions a dishwasher and coffee maker are provided but these are not in the apartment (which didn't matter for us anyway).  The aircon was very good and the host was helpful in terms of places to eat in the neighbourhood. We absolutely loved NYC, what a fantastic city. With a bit more effort this place would be great, I would recommend staying if you are going to spend most of your time sightseeing in Manhattan. I have stayed in a lot of AirBnBs before and just in terms of the effort made I have seen in other places that I have rated 4/5 stars I can't say the same,  but with additional bits and pieces added in the future I could see it as a 4/5  star, so I think this is a fair review.  Thanks for the stay!

I don’t like to say negative things usually because I understand things happen. However, this is constructive feedback. As a Hospitality business,  people should feel welcome. The apartment is nice and has a lot of potential, but there is no effort to make it inviting. There is one glass, chipped cups, sticky floors, stained covers, cheap old towels, and uncomfortable furniture. The internet did not work, although  I had written two times in the past week before to insure it was working because my trip was  business and the internet is necessary for me. The answer from the host Prior to arrival was that the internet was good. I got there in the evening and with owner’s instructions tried to reset it, but it was a wiring issue that required the cable company to fix it. I had to leave next day and find a different place to stay costing me missed time at work, Uber charges to move luggage, and higher cost to secure another place last minute in New York. Stressful, we deserve better!

When travelling I have always use Airbnb, and never had a problem checking in. However, I was given the wrong address for this particular place and check in took longer than usual and was a bit stressful, especially as it was past 9pm and I had my luggage with me. Communication was ok, but if your looking for a somewhere to have a relaxing memorable trip this may not be your cup of tea, its perfect for quick stop in NYC, clean room but shower takes time to heat up. Comfortable bed, bathroom is a bit cramped and kitchen appliances are basic. There are other guest that are staying in the other rooms which was fine. This felt like a student hall of residence and communication wasn't great with the host. Subway is very close and good transport links but the area isn't great. Overall it was satisfactory but not for me.

Pretty fair place where to spend one night. The surroundings are a little sketchy but nothing too dangerous/scary for us. The room was extremely hot because of the heating we couldn’t turn off/regulate.

5 Stars!!! I couldn't have been happier with our stay at Sulamans. One bedroom apartment with a full bathroom and kitchen. This might have been the cleanest Airbnb I've stayed at. The neighborhood was nice too, plenty of parking and it seemed really safe. I would definitely recommend staying here. The host was very pleasant and accommodating. I honestly couldn't of asked for anything better and for the price it was an absolute steal.

Aaron was a very helpful host. He was quick to respond and provided snacks and shampoo. The unit is spacious and has 3 bedrooms with nice bedding and comfortable mattresses.     There also three bathrooms, which was a good extra for a lot of people. However,  it could definitely use some decorating, such as rugs, living room chairs, side tables, paintings and/or photos (there are none).  The exterior needs painting and tidying up and the backyard area, which was great to have, needs significant TLC.  The unit is located near coffee shops. I would not recommend the place for children because the railing seems dangerous. I would recommend it for adult guests.
Great place and for the price per night is a steal. Commute to downtown is around ~30 mins.

I went to my room at 4pm and I found some suitcases in my room. I wrote to owner of room and he said grab to suitcases to kitchen. I felt uncomfortable and unsafe because the customer before than me knows the password. Also first night I saw a mouse in my room and I tried to call to owner and they didn’t answered until morning. Location was good. Room was clean and you can use the kitchen.
A steal! The amenities alone are insane, the home is set up beautifully and very very clean. Shawn was an amazing host, very attentive and communication was fast and easy.

This place looked like a frat house when I was about to stay here (September 2022), and it doesn't look like the photos anymore. I would not say that it's clean or pleasant to stay in unless you'd like to live in a frat house for a few nights then this would be a great spot. Also, the TVs and microwaves were stolen right before my stay so stay as you wish.

Ralph's penthouse apartment in SoHo is hands-down amazing. If you have the opportunity to stay here, do not—I repeat, do not—pass it up.  After our hosts in Brooklyn canceled on us last-minute (literally hours before our plane was set to leave), I requested Ralph's place, and he responded within minutes, allowing me to book his place and alleviating the stress of arriving to New York not knowing where my family and I were staying. There were four of us traveling together ranging in age from 18 to 70, and this massive penthouse was perfect for a multi-generational family (and we obviously could have easily slept another couple people at that). Thanks to elevator access, the unit is accessible to those with mobility problems as there is one bedroom suite on one floor and two bedroom suites on the other (both floors have elevator access).  We were playing tourist, so we did not cook in the apartment, but the kitchen was large and very well-equipped for preparing meals. Everything throughout the apartment was brand new and luxe—including the bathrooms, showers and fixtures—giving the feeling you were staying in a Thompson Hotel or Four Seasons and not an apartment. It was also extremely quiet and peaceful, surprising given that we were staying in the heart of Manhattan. The apartment was just a few blocks' walk from many of the major subway lines, so we were able to get around Manhattan island and Brooklyn with ease and not rely on taxis and ride-shares.  But the best part of the whole stay was the views. The apartment looks out onto downtown, and you have a clear view of the WTC and Lower Manhattan skyline from two of the bedrooms, as well as the private rooftop deck, which was the perfect spot to wind down with a glass of wine after a long New York day.  Ralph and his son made checking in and learning the ropes very easy as they texted us videos on how to get in, take the elevator and get into the unit. They were accessible by text throughout our stay had we needed anything, and I appreciated the A++ New York hospitality. This is one of those once-in-a-lifetime apartment rentals that makes you truly feel like a New Yorker and allows you to stay right in the middle of all the action in SoHo, so again, if it's within your means, you absolutely will not be disappointed!

Brandon was a great host! I was in the middle of a move, and my stay here made the process much less stressful. It was really nice having a kitchen and a quiet place to do work. Would definitely recommend staying :)

This apartment is located underneath a railway line. The train passes every 5 minutes, it is deafening.   We were expecting the area to be chic, modern Williamsburg, it was a 15 minute walk away from what we were expecting. What we got was one of the most unpleasant areas of town. My elderly parents refused to walk in the neighbourhood after dark.  After informing the host that we could not complete our stay, we were not offered any compensation or even a partial refund.  Would not recommend.

An absolute pleasant surprise and a great place. Train is loud but if you grow up in a city…whatever, this place was a steal and is a gem and it’s not to loud as you can’t fall asleep. The bedrooms are on the other side of the apartment shut your door shut your eyes. Dimitri is a great host parking is great got nothing bad to say, would stay here again my next visit to the mirage.

Carlos and fam, thanks so much! Our initial stay at your place was the best and to have it so close to many amenities, we got see more of new York! The place was Clean and importantly felt like home and comfortable. Our unplanned extension was the stressful part however Carlos was a life saver. We were able to spend the rest of our time in nyc at this place because our next airbnb had cancelled on us. I'm forever grateful for your hospitality! I love forward to coming back, if I puld give you 10 stars I would! Thank you again!

I was lucky to find this total steal so close to the train. I have an autoimmune disease that makes me really tired during flares, so I was anxious about going through with this trip. Since Benjamin's place was so close to the train, it was EVERYTHING to be able to hop downstairs and get to the metro within 5 minutes. I am so grateful for the room, which was perfect for those with lots to do in the city, and grateful for the warmth of this host. Note: For me, the train noise is part of what makes NYC great! If you're not trying to be in the center of the action, not sure what you're up to out here :)

Very clean and accurate listing. Close to many restaurants and stores. My groups main concern was safety since we've never been to Brooklyn but never once walking around at any time of day or night did we feel unsafe. This BnB handled our group of 11 just fine and Frank was very responsive and helpful with any questions we had. Highly recommend!

There’s a 7 train if you walk about 5 minutes from this apartment, and the train goes directly to the Time square. The atmosphere of the neighborhood is like that of South America I guess..! and I liked it.  I worried about the safety, but it was fine until 11pm. We used to come back our airbnb by 10-11pm, but i didn’t feel dangerous(but you always have to careful). Lizeth and their family were so nice.  I enjoyed the staying and I became wanting to live in this town!  If you want to feel something different from Manhattan, I recommend this airbnb!

I loved staying here. The bed was so soft and comfy, and it’s in a well populated neighbourhood with lots of amenities and transit nearby. People who commented here taking issue with projects being across the street seem to be missing that the only scary thing about the projects is government neglect and misuse of funds - please spare us your probable racism. :) I will definitely return.

Benson was an amazing host with a cozy studio. The location couldn’t get much better either.   I stayed at Benson’s for about a month while I apartment hunted in SoHo amidst starting a new job and moving up to the City from down South. The space had everything I needed and more. I particularly made use of the WFH set up (especially the standing desk). The full kitchen helped me save some money on food which helped relieve the stress of juggling a new job and apartment hunting at the same time. There was also plenty of closet space for my work clothes and dresser room for my other belongings. The studio is also equipped with convenient tech like chrome cast tv, a Bluetooth sound bar and apple home lighting along with copious chargers strategically placed along the walls.   Benson was an extremely helpful host, very communicative and always happy to answer my questions.   Overall, this was exactly what I was looking for. The block is lively yet quiet and I enjoyed my stay so much that I signed a lease right around the corner. I highly recommend staying here if you’re in the middle of a move or looking to take an extended vacation in one of the coolest neighborhoods that the City has to offer!

Very clean space, just as pics showed! Bed was comfy, parking was easy to find. Location maybe not in the best area but I didn’t really feel unsafe in the day. Would recommend for the price and close proximity to transportation!

Karlyle’s place was a steal for the price. Communication was fast and professional. The place itself has been remodeled & although it’s small, they’ve made brilliant use of the space. We kept saying how much bigger it feel than we expected. About a 10 mins walk from the trains Utica or Ralph Ave. And the check-in went smoothly. Thanks Karlyle!

This was a great place to stay. My family and I enjoyed our time there. Here are the Pros and Cons:  Pros: -Clean and organized -Rooms were spacious  -Kitchen had appropriate supplies   Cons: -The lock to the main door did not work properly. Therefore, my family and I were stuck INSIDE of the apartment for many hours.   -The host also did not have a phone number anywhere listed in the reservation or messages. Therefore, we had to call Airbnb middle of the night to get them to reach out to her so that she can come rescue us.  -when we got locked inside a second time, that’s when the host had to use a drill machine to take OUT the door knob so that it doesn’t keep locking us inside.   The host was very nice though, so I’m confident that she will fix the lock sooner rathe than later as it can be a huge safety issue. Such as, if the apartment catches on fire, the people inside can’t get out. Or if someone needs medical attention and they can’t get out of the apartment.  Overall, a great place to stay, minus the stress that the whole family went through being stuck inside.

This place is a joke to be honest.  To start, the pictures listed are deceiving. The space is very small, hard to find, broken appliances, constant zooming noise from the toilet, very untidy and dirty. There weren't any toiletries prepared, not even enough towels. I had requested early check in a month prior to arriving as I had a long red eye flight from the West Coast. They said they would make arrangements only for me to get there and wait in the lobby for 3.5 hrs (in the heat, as their wasn't any AC or cooling system). When I inquired, they said that my request for early check in (that I made a month ago and was supposedly handled) was declined. Their excuse was that their cleaning crew was still working on cleaning (as if it takes 5 hrs to clean a shoebox of a room). On top of all that, staff was extremely rude, sassy, and not at all helpful. Even if we wanted to cancel the stay and rinse somewhere else that would accommodate us or let us check in, they wouldn't give us even a partial refund. It was extremely frustrating.  In addition, they kept calling me and texting me saying I could use their free luggage storage. We were never able to use it as it was always full and they wouldn't accommodate anything else. Instead, they told us there is a paid luggage storage they were partnered with down the street. That is okay, but they led us to a place 7 blocks away and the place wasn't there. We decided to do a quick search ourselves and in reality there was a storage place 2 blocks away from the hotel.  All in all, I feel scammed and wouldn't recommend this place to anyone that wants to have a pleasant time in the city.
Almost scary

Very good stay, cool (2 AC units) clean and comfortable.   turns out there’s rats in ny though and a few live in the outdoor space and scared us the first night!   Other than that - nearly perfect stay!

I cannot stress enough how friendly and helpful the crew of Stay and Smile was. Communication was excellent. We had few hiccups with the apartment, quickly resolved. As for the place, it corresponds to the description. The building is not great, and the apartment can get noisy but this was expected. The position is extremely convenient and the price was great for a two bedroom in Manhattan
The place was very welcoming..  The host she did a great job i will be going back soon location is really good me...no stress getting around... my stay was awsome...👍👍👍

The host is very nice and caring! My phone died and I had to contact him on my friends airbnb app through a separate listing and he was super quick to respond which alleviated so much stress!   He even told me he would give me some extra time past checkout if I needed.   The place is very clean and the living room area is big and cool!  The room was a bit too hot which unfortunately made it quite hard to sleep even with a fan. Also the couch bed is a bit small. Also it’s a bit of a noisy area early in the evening especially.   HOWEVER HOWEVER:  host has told me he’s installing an AC in the private room itself so this may not be an issue  for future guests. and the bed itself is quite big and cozy. And the living room couch is sleep-able and cool.

I would advise  to away from Sonder at all costs. this was  my worst experience during all my 6 years using Airbnb.   1- When I got to the front desk, I was informed my booking was cancelled and they were full so there was nothing they could do. I had not received any message from Airbnb or sonder informing me of that. I had to insist for over an hour, so I could finally be relocated to a different room. it was extremely stressful.  2- because they messed up my booking I had to split my stay in two different rooms, which in itself was already quite annoying. but I wish it ended there. when I got to the first room, the shower sink was clogged so I couldn't shower. I called the front desk, and they gave me instructions on how to *gasp* fix it myself. that's not the right service for a $600/night room. regardless, I tried to fix it and couldn't. so I stayed without shower.   3- when relocating to the second room, they gave me the wrong checkin instructions. so I had to wait for someone to come up and open my door to me, and another couple hours just to get the right access code.   overall it was a terrible terrible experience. the staff is disorganized, they don't care about their guests. an expensive stay for the worst experience of my life.
It’s noisy and the area itself is really dangerous especially when a lady traveling alone can’t go for a simple walk on that area because of the people outside using drugs and other substances.

Not all the rooms have mirrors in the bathroom or in the room itself. The hotel is located in a very dangerous area. The bathroom door handle came off while we were there and no one fixed it. The rooms are very small. I will not book this place ever again.
unsafe location.. you can smell smoking from outside and noise in the middle of the night.

The hotel was cheap but it wasn’t very clean. All their pillow cases have stains so if possible, bring your own please! I requested a refund because of this. The area is not good and very very sketchy so be safe.

Safi is very kind, very clean and discreet, you can be sure that your stay will go well with him! Despite the bad opinions we may have had about the neighborhood, we were 2 girls and did not feel in danger, contrary to what we think, it is very calm!  I recommend it, very good value for money!

Our stay with Safi was just great! From the moment we arrived till the moment we left it was a pleasure staying with him! We could ask him anything we want at all times. Also he gave us a lot of information about places that we should go to! Those were very helpful! 👍🏼  The room was clean and big for nyc! We could use the rest off the appartement as we pleased!   The neighbourhood is in the evening a little “unpleasant” but by day it is totally fine! This should not stop you from renting Safi’s home and meeting a great person!  Would certainly recommend and we definitely will come back some time.. 🥰

I had a wonderful stay! Sakeeb, the host, was incredibly helpful, and answered all my questions promptly. The house was clean and very nice, and Sakeeb even left a bottle of sparkling cider! I've never stayed in a city before, but I had a wonderful time, and a lot of my stress was reduced due to how nice the accommodations were. Thank you Sakeeb!

Where should begin? Karlyle's place was amazing. The pics don't do it justice.  everything was new and ready to use.    Check in was very easy  Communication was great and quick responses to my questions  The TVs are super cool with amazing backlighting.  Location was close to the subway and the neighborhood and neighbors were quite friendly and helpful when I got turned around  Kitchen was amazing, made it fun cook I used it.   there is nice backyard that I suspect willbe really nice hang out in once it's done.  I highly recommend this spot.    although a part of me wants to keep it a secret 😆

Karlyle when we pulled up to your Airbnb it was  not a a good first impression. There were garbage all in the neighborhood and the attacked house has lots of garbage in the front too . Just didn’t feel safe . Windows were left over and seat was moved to the from window we have to pack everything the first night and has to hood a hotel .

Nice staff, comfortable bed and clean room.  The neighborhood seems to be nice but other guests at the hotel made us feel a little unsafe. There were people shouting and slamming doors through the night. We could hear everything coming from the hallway. Didn’t have a pleasant stay.
There were spiders in the unit. The area is very sketchy. There wasn’t enough towels/linen. The ac didn’t work.

Very nice property. Great location between our family members. Incredibly responsive host. For those who don’t read the (obvious) description, the entry is on the ground floor to the right, beneath the stairs, rather than at the top of them as you might suspect from the outside pictures. Learned this after carrying our bags up the stairs and trying to open the wrong door. Host immediately answered my text by calling and corrected my error. We will definitely stay here for future trips! Thanks.

This was our first time at Kings Hotel.  We went to a great restaurant within walking distance (L’Wren).  The guy at the front desk was professional, kind & great under stress. Someone needed medical attention during check in and he was responsive and attentive.   The room is comfortable- soft pillows!

I don't think I'm very picky when it comes to where I stay because truly all I'm looking for is a place to sleep and shower. However, this presented a problem here. I was told the host was not actually in the city, and communicated instead with a relative. That was okay, except when I asked if there were towels so I could shower I never received a response until I was barraged with messages about checking out the day before I left. I understand some of the lack of communication may be due to the language barrier, because they were kind people. Upon arriving there was not hand soap or towels in the bathroom (having an en suite bathroom is such a privilege in an airbnb though!) so thankfully I just bought my own and used those towels for the shower as well. I left the soap behind so hopefully the next guests aren't as unfortunate. The bed is extremely firm so I ended up sleeping on the couch, which was much more comfortable for me. Finally, there were bugs crawling into the walls in the kitchen and a couple big roaches on the floor in the main bathroom. Nothing dangerous, and I think the roaches were dead, but it was still a little offputting to see. Overall, it's a great area extremely close to transit and a good value, but I've paid the same price for places in Queens that did not have these problems. So if you stay here just make sure to bring your own soap and towels!

Anthony is a great host. The space is exactly as it looks in the pictures. He provides clear instructions with pictures which makes finding the entrance simple. He also checked in with us throughout our stay to make sure we had anything we needed.  The space itself is clean and comfortable. It also has plenty of grocery stores, restaurants and drug stores all within walking distance. The subway station is under a 5 minute walk to the 6 train. It does take about an hour to get to the touristy places in Manhattan via the subway, but that was very manageable considering how much money we saved by staying out of Manhattan. We also to took the subway to and from JFK airport with all of our luggage and it was very doable. Overall, it’s a great value and we’d stay again.

the place is correct. Quite overpriced. it's located in the latin area of the Bronx. We went with 2 babies and we didn't felt unsafe. Subway is 10 minutes walking, with elevator. good for going with friends. If you plan to go with kids, maybe you want to keep searching

Robert place was as pictured . the address was bit tricky to find at first not to accurate when put into the gps . The Heat did not work my whole stay there which was a major down for me with the weather being below 40s and snowing . I had to purchase my own heater. but rob was nice enough to comp me extra stay in addition to the inconvenience. Also the bathroom sink was clogged and broke . took a while to go down . rob wasn't aware but i informed and assured he would get it fix . I do think your are paying for the location . It state QUEENS but its howard beach so that a bit off . overall my stay was comfortable me and my boyfriend enjoyed .

This is one of the worse places I’ve stayed at. The sheets were stained and smelly, the bathroom was stained, the location is extremely shady and not very family friendly. The building looked like a getaway for people to netflix and chill and have a wild nightlife. It was not a quite nor a comfortable stay. Sleeping is not that easy for light sleepers: the walls are so thin you think all the noise at night and opening and closing of doors is in your room. The window does not bring in any light it’s hard to tell if it’s morning or night.  In my opinion this is not a comfortable stay for respectful people who want a clean, comfortable stay.

Lucas is very very friendly and usually responds to your requests very quickly.  The location for those who are going to NY for the first time... is great. Very very close to the metro. The neighborhood feels very safe even at night, I wasn't afraid to walk at night along the main roads. There is a lot of commerce around the house. And I had dinner in two restaurants... very good.  The cleanliness and cleanliness...was excellent.  The bed and room 5 are gigantic!!!! And very very comfortable!!!  The photos are the same as reality.  I recommend this accommodation 100%.
When it comes to communication, Rosalyn is great! There were a couple cleanliness issues and unpleasant scents in the bathroom but overall I think it’s a great price point for accommodations in NYC.

the neighborhood is extremely quiet and the bed was extraordinarily comfortable.  very happy with my stay and I'll most likely be back when it's available again.  perfect location to the subway and a steal at the price.  Thanks Lucas and Natasha.  Very happy with my stay there.

Place was super quite and lowkey everything is about a 20-25 minute walk but about 5 in car, the place was kind of cold but once you get the heater running feels like home. Didn’t like now many unsafe and unsanitary some thing where especially if being changed a cleaning few. Some I teams where missing for the home that your classical has at home. Beside these thing we had a great stay and have no complaints !!

The stay was manageable until the last day. To start, the delayed check-in (4:30pm) because the space had to be cleaned was misleading. I made travel arrangements and appointments based on the check-in time stated on the booking site (3:00pm). It would have been nice to know the moment I booked that check-in wouldn’t be available until later than advertised. New York City is not a place you want to be with luggage after traveling all morning because you are waiting to check in, nor is it a place you can easily adjust your plans by one and a half hours. The Bronx is also so far from the rest of the city that dropping my bags off would have been more of a hassle.   The last morning of my stay, I woke up hearing sounds as if someone was in the space with me and I heard a door close. Like most women traveling alone, I immediately called my friends and family members and had even started to convince myself that I was hearing things. However that is not the case. The condition of the door was drastically different than it was when I fell asleep. The digital entry pad was completely ripped away from the door and the door wouldn’t even shut or close. To make things worse the host kept assuring me that I was “100% safe” despite my naming multiple times that I didn’t feel safe. The host dismissed my very real feelings of fear about a situation most people would be afraid of. Even if it really was a prior guest messing with the lock as the host named, it’s the host’s responsibility to make any repairs, etc. before the next guest arrives. I reported to both AirBnB and the host as soon as I saw the door (when a friend arrived and I felt safe enough to leave the bedroom and even approach the door). I didn’t appreciate being told “you should have told me sooner” by the host. I didn’t call the police because I wanted to get out of there as soon as possible. I quickly packed and called a Lyft. I didn’t even bother to shower at that point.   The many doors with large signs saying “Do Not Open” were also a bit unsettling. The place should be advertised as a room in a place rather than an entire place to yourself. The communication was good apart from the two instances I already mentioned. The space was clean. There were not many plugs in the bedroom and it was annoying to have to walk all the way to the living room to charge. The place is also a pretty lengthy walk to the nearest train station.

Honestly, the apartment itself was not bad. I was looking forward to enjoy it but my low rating is based on the host. In the description it mentioned that the host's mom and sister live in the apartment and I will be sharing with them, which I had no problem with. When I checked in, the apartment looked clean but when I had to use the bathroom there was toilet water all over the floor. I texted the host and asked were I could find a mop but no answer. I had to use the toilet paper to clean the floor... Later at around 10pm I was in my room and heard 3 male voices in the living room. I felt extremely uncomfortable and unsafe. The host did not mentioned anything about male guest coming over! I get that it is his apartment but as a host, your priority it to make sure your guest feels comfortable and safe. Also, I got a text around that time in regards to the toilet quoting "calm down, I just cleaned the bathroom!"... Very unprofessional. I decided to leave the next day because I didn't feel comfortable there but it has become such a big issue and no refund.

We arrived late at night after a flight (informing the host in advance). We were let in, not given keys and then we proceeded to the room. We felt instantly uncomfortable in the apartment for the following reasons: 1. It being incredibly dirty. There was a table with a tv that had mold on it. We were told to take off our shoes even though the floors were gross and sticky. There was dirt and grease on the door.   2. Having a strong odor that was a combination of incense, bleach, air freshener, and drying paint. The  host had even admitted to us that the room was painted the same day or the day before. Who does that knowing that you have a reservation scheduled 3 weeks in advance??!  3. A bed that was incredibly uncomfortable (air mattress) that was piled on pieces of wood over a frame that was falling apart. Also only one pillow was provided.  4. No place to put our clothes. (no dresser, closet, drawers, etc)  5. Windows with no incredibly sheer curtains viewable from the street which had no privacy. 6. Clogged sink and standing bleach water in the bathtub. Also no toilet paper. Also cigarette burn marks on the bathroom sink.  7. A refrigerator completely filled with the hosts' things. And a kitchen that was a mess. Completely unsanitary.  8. Safety issue of multiple exposed or sunken in outlets. 9. That this is a fourth floor walk up with no elevator was also not communicated or advertised.   All of this resulted in us not being able to sleep and me (being asthmatic) having multiple attacks that first evening. We had nowhere to go until we figured out other sleeping arrangements the next morning with a friend. Overall, this was absolutely the worst hotel / airbnb experience I've ever had in my life.

First of all, Adonis is a FANTASTIC host!  I cannot speak enough good of him.  During our stay, we ran into several serious issues (not on Adonis' part) that we were trying to navigate.  We asked him for help, and even though he didn't have to, he really went over and above for us.  He was super responsive, provided local recommendations to our issues, and showed the kind of empathy you really hope to get from an AirBnB host.  That alone made our stay SO worth it.  If you are looking to vacation into Manhattan, this is a spot with unbeatable value; you're so close to E 180 station.  Adonis supplies toiletries in his welcome basket, the bed is comfy, the shower water is sooo nice and hot.  I loved working out with Adonis' boxing set up, and you get plenty of space to spread out.  For those wondering, The Bronx is better than it used to be in terms of crime; just don't be naive and you'll be okay.  Lock your car, double check your street parking, don't be foolish with homeless, etc.

Good Airbnb. This is a property that’s been renewed so the outside and stairs look a bit “unfinished” but the apartment  itself looks really good. Everything was clean. The AC works fine. We didn’t have any issues with any of the appliances. The area seems pretty safe (we walked to and from the subway station at 1am most days and we never felt unsafe). It’s a Latin American neighborhood so it is mostly LA business and a lot of family houses. Some of the restaurants stay up pretty late (they were open at 1am on a week day) and there is one 24h market 2 blocks away.  The subway station is roughly 10min walking.

Great host. Easy check in. Great communication. Nice and spacious place. Great area. Great pricing!  Just a couple things. I think the place was not as clean as I would have liked. I also suggest that the railings on the outside balcony be fixed. It is very unsafe. We stood away from it. Also, I would recommend leaving a broom somewhere. I like to sweep and clean before leaving any airbnb but there wasn’t one. We did clean up as best we could.  Other than that, it was a great stay. We would definitely book again. Thank you for everything!

Like family in being highly attentive to our arrival and our stay. We definitely appreciate the area's safety, having a stress-free parking space, and the ease of public transportation. And yes; we thought of the airport being right next door that our sleep could be disturbed, but not to worry as you could hear a pin drop throughout the night.

Positive: very easy check in and great communication with Andrew, the apartment is quite new and decently clean, with a nice Bathroom, one big room with a fantastic bed and a very useful kitchen. The location is great, just 4 min walking to the Subway and 15-20 min to times square, a great alternative to the crazy Manhattan prices. The area is pretty humble with a few shops around but some streets can be creepy at night so if you stay out until late better grab an uber or Taxi to drop you off.  Negative: The Sofa/Bed is terrible, the mattress is old, it's been used a lot and definitely needs an upgrade asap.  This apartment is perfect for 2 people, but if you rent it for 3-4 people and 1 or 2 of them have to sleep on it it's going to make a big difference, we had to sleep on it for 6 nights and it was very bad. In addition, the apartment is very lacking in wardrobes, apart from the one in the bedroom, so another problem if you are 3-4 people, no room for everyone.  Finally we found the toilet seat broken, but looked that it was already broken and they tried to fix it with some glue that of course didn't work, and that kind of thing needs to be replaced asap​ because they are really important for the comfort of your guest. We also have same problem with the rubbish bin, it was  a big and modern one in the middle of the corredor but it was broken and we couldn't not close the lid properly, so we had to put some weight on top of it all the time to keep it close, that kind of things need to be fixed quickly, especially in those kind of apartments that has guest coming in and out all the time.

This place saved us after our late night flight was canceled and we couldn’t catch a flight until the next morning! Hosts were very responsive and even personally delivered us a bottle of wine upon our arrival, which was much needed after a stressful day! Would stay here again.

Host stated that the unit is walking distance to USTA tennis center but it is NOT because it is at least 40 mins walk away.  Had wifi connection issue in the morning.  There’s no convenience store  nearby for basic needs. The only option is to spend more for food delivery,  or take a bus to other place.  The bedroom has no fan, ac is located in the living room. The bedroom wooden floor is not solid enough and unsafe, like I’m gonna create a hole and damage the floor just by walking in it. Had to walk very slowly and carefully.  Considering the overall experience, the price per night (weekday) is a little expensive, and a BIG NOTE that the Cleaning fee and service fee  is too much.  The only positive thing is the host is responsive.

This place was amazing!! Just one small note, the water pressure is not great, but it got us clean so I’m not complaining! Beautiful interior decor that’s better than the pictures! It was quiet, easy access to public transportation, amazing communication and accommodation from the host! Would stay again in a heart beat. Highly recommend you book this if you’re looking for luxurious place in New York for a steal price and a good neighborhood!

Good and clean.  Don't like the camera inside, I requested the host to give me an extra 1 hour if I need an emergency needed he refused, which was not friendly behavior, and I don’t need an extra hour anyway, I was just asking just in case.  Some of the furniture is really light was scared if it breaks.
I strongly recommend this place. Neighborhood was little bit scary but thats ok. The place was awesome. Also hosts are super kind and answer you every time when you need them.

I’m writing this review due to a poor experience with the host.  Summary: host is trying to charge me $200 for a broken wine glass that she left in the sink. Apartment was old and trashed and wayyy overpriced for what it is. But good location.   Longer version: in the house rules, it is clearly stated to keep the sink clean and not leave any dishes there. The morning of check out, I went to clean a glass I had used for water. The sink was full of glasses and dishes so it was difficult to clean the water glass in the full/small sink. But still, wanting to abide by the rules, I began washing it. While doing this, I nicked a wine glass causing a crack. This was one of many wine glasses and other dishes just laying in the sink, likely left by the owner or one of the many friends she had over the night prior.   I told some other girl in the apartment - not the owner, I have no idea who this person is but some random person hanging out around the apartment. The friend said it was no problem as she got these glasses at a flea market.   A few hours later I receive a message from the host saying that I broke some fancy $200 wine glass and that I have to pay her for this. She said I should pay her outside of Airbnb and not to get them involved because it’s “easier”.  First, if you’re going to make a rule that guests should clean their own dishes, then create an environment where they can do that without risk of breaking something in the sink, and if not, take ownership for not allowing that. Second, who leaves $200 wine glasses in the sink? Third, I highly doubt anything in that apartment is worth more than $20.  Also - I asked if I could leave my luggage in the apartment for the day until my flight in the evening. She said yes, which I appreciated but she said to leave the keys in the apartment because she’d be around all day. When I got a message later that afternoon that I owed her $200 more, I wanted to get my things earlier because I was skeptical of her at this point. When asking if I could come earlier for my things she said that she wasn’t going to be around until later that day, and kept repeating this adding that I should have kept the keys. You just said in the message prior to leave the keys since you’d be around. Anyway, just overall sketchy vibes from her.  Besides the really negative experience with the host, the apartment is old and falling apart. Cockroaches, bathroom door doesn’t close, garbage just sitting in the kitchen. For a whole day there was no toilet paper so she just put a roll of paper towels there instead. There is no bed as indicated in the previous reviews so I’m wondering if she’s changed the room since those previously positive reviews. I just paid >$200 a night to sleep on an uncomfortable Walmart fouton. But honestly I wasn’t even going to leave a bad review until this girl tried to charge me  $200 for an old wine glass that she left in the sink.  Location was nice though.

The location was a neighborhood location but it was great. A block away from the 2 train that takes you straight to Times Square or the Apollo theatre etc. the space was clean and newly renovated, for the price it was the best value.  Patrick was a great host almost to a fault(while we were there he called so many times, got cable installed, brought fans, and did much more… but I almost was scared to have intimate time w my spouse because he was always coming by or calling).  There is a barbershop and nailery on the same block, there was many places to grab food and Patrick even put ash trays out on the porch to make sure we could smoke outside if we wanted to.  I think this is definitely a hidden gem that should be booked if coming to NY.  My only cons were that the heat for the whole building(he rents rooms in the rest of the building)was controlled from the BNB unit so you may feel trapped to heat or cold but Patrick did accommodate by bringing fans.  He was amazing and the space was a gem! Me and my boyfriend had a ball and was very comfortable! Don’t be scared to book this freak with Patrick I’m so glad I did!

A big thank you to Gregory, the owner and Natasha, the property manager, for being so pleasant, welcoming, and accommodating on our last minute booking!  The check in was easy and I loved that there was an on site parking space!  That was incredibly convenient and stress free knowing I didn’t have to search for a spot.  What a fun neighborhood!  We enjoyed watching the laughter and the friendly interactions between neighbors!  The home was clean and beautifully decorated, so inviting and comfortable!
