We all talked about and enjoyed the wall art displaying some of the beauty of NY.  The beds were so comfy!  especially liked the whirlpool/jacuzzi tub! There was plenty of cookware so we were able to make and enjoy a home cooked breakfast that morning (a big plus for this Texas family) but sipping a couple of glasses of wine by the fireplace that night was the best!  My boys loved the complimentary WiFi and big screen TVs in each room to play their video games on and watch movies!  We had a wonderful stay!  This will definitely be our home away from home on our next visit to NY!

Benjamin was an amazing host! The bed was comfy and the room I was staying in was very cozy and warm. It was my first time in NYC, and Benjamin had actually picked me up at the airport, which was a stress relief for me, because I wasn’t sure how to navigate the public transportation system!  Not only that, when arriving to my room, he had picked up some different snacks for me and ice cream to eat! Which I thought was a cute incentive!

Check in process was bad the description of the flat and which keys were not clear. This led to an unfortunate incident with a stranger on the porch of the property who was using drugs who had keys to the flat I had booked. After advising I wished to clarify the key situation with the host the drug user became agitated that I wouldn't simply fully trust him.  Eventually things were sorted and communication with the host was good and quick and during the rest of the stay I didn't have any more interactions or trouble with the drug using stranger.  Amenities were not good no toilet paper and no knives in the flat for spreading butter etc. The price was comparably good for New York properties and the location was great for access to public transport, but a few very basic changes could have proved things immensely.

The place was EXTREMELY dirty. There was a lot of water damage on the door, no one had vacuumed, very dusty, there were stains on the ceiling, tables were very dirty too. The beds looked clean and most linens too. Host was unresponsive on check in day so another tenant luckily was able to assist. Location was good. Not super sketchy. Super close walk (2min) to the subway line 7.

This was a great location for our city trip to NY. Allthough the neighbourhood looked a bit rough, the subway station was just a few minutes walking and brought us to Manhattan quickly, and we did not experience any unpleasant situations. The apartment was very clean and had enough space.

Pros: price (perhaps cheapest room in NYC close to Manhattan), comfortable bed, subway nearby, local cafes, jazz and even nicely decorated heavy metal bar nearby! Despite that subway bridge is just across the street it was not so noisy. There is also a city share bike parking at the beginning of Williamsburg bridge for easier commute. Cons: there are 3 guest rooms and also hosts live there but there is just 1 bathroom, so some waiting time may occur if you woke up not that early. Noise in the morning from construction site and street cleaners or something. Immediate surroundings of subway station are quite shady, and also it is not on the “main” line to Brooklyn so coming from Manhattan often may require a change Considering the price: you get what you’ve paid for

Based on my stay I do NOT recommend this place. I set my expectations very low based on the previous reviews for this room. Unfortunately those expectations were not met. All I really want from an Airbnb is a reasonably priced, safe, dry, warm room. Here’s how I felt each of those factors worked at this location. Compared to other places in NY this was a cheaper option but in my opinion is still very overpriced. I will say that I never felt unsafe at this location. Dryness was a serious issue in my room. After a day and night of heavy rain I woke up and stepped in what I would describe as a small pond covering virtually the entire floor of my room. The host responded by helping me dry the floor and offered to wash the clothes and cloth bag I had been storing on the floor that got wet. A repairman was called and the rain did not cause any further flooding. However, as I was staying in October when the weather starts getting colder the radiator was being turned on for the first time of the season. Apparently the host had recently had a new component installed but it had not been thoroughly tested. I found a puddle of black water that had leaked from the radiator all over the floor. When I told the host she said she would check on it. Unfortunately, she was unable to repair it herself and claimed the repairman kept cancelling. Every time the radiator turned on there was water leaking on the floor of my room. The amount of water varied from a small amount that could be picked up with a small towel to a centimeter deep across the entire floor. The first radiator leak was October 15 and when I checked out October 29 the issue had still not been fixed. Now you would think with all the radiator use the room would at least be warm but you would be very wrong. It was a very cold room and the leaking radiator did not seem to provide any heat. Overall I cannot recommend this room. I could share other things I did not care for but this is already a long review and I’ve covered what I consider the biggest issues.

Rodney’s place was very comfortable and in a really convenient location. The neighborhood feels very diverse, with lots of cool restaurants, bars and shops around.  It was a quick 12-minute walk to the subway with a 45-minute ride to Grand Central.   We are an interracial couple and were a bit concerned at first about looks in the area, but were really comfortable once we saw all of the diversity in the neighborhood. We got home late nights and walked from the subway around 1am and didn’t feel unsafe.   Rodney’s place was comfortable to come “home” to at the end of the day. We’d definitely stay here again when we’re in the city.

Super clean apartment, well laid out with nice living room and decent well-equipped kitchen.  Quality mattress and sheets.  Great location with dozens of restaurants, bakeries, banks, Trader Joes, and shopping within a few blocks.  Very safe neighborhood full of diverse families.  (Have stayed in the neighborhood many times because our son and his family are here.)  Located on a relatively quiet street by Brooklyn standards.  Apartment is on the first floor so you will hear people walking by and coming in and out of the building.  It's city living, and less than you'd hear in your hotel hallway.  Kitchen is well-stocked with decent cookware, quality gas stove/oven, large fridge, toaster oven, toaster, Keurig machine and French press coffee pot.  They provide Keurig pods and properly ground coffee for the press.  TV is equipped with Roku so you can access your own entertainment apps as you would at home.  Marvin and his business partner were incredibly responsive.  All my messages were answered within minutes.  After the first night, I messaged Marvin that we slept well but they may want to consider blackout shades in the bedroom because the apartment courtyard outside the window is brightly lit and the shades are translucent.  The next afternoon, his partner came out and installed dark shade liners to fix the problem.  He explained that they had ordered custom shades that had not yet arrived that would be even better for future renters.  Overall a quality space run by quality people.

This is a really cheap listing. But, the neighborhood is sketchy. The location is behind a dumpster. There are rats running around, lots of trash in the walkway. The entrance to the building is so bad. The apartment was clean. But people keep coming in and out every time. Lights were turned on pretty much the entire time. Too crowded with 13 beds. No privacy. No cleanliness near the bunk beds. The bathroom and the common area are kept clean. I would never recommend this place. If you just want to sleep, it would be okay. The listing is on the fourth floor and the security of the doors is also terrible. Even though there are locks to these, they keep it open most of the times.

To flee ! I stayed 30 minutes ! To begin with, the area is very unsafe. Secondly, the check in is very complicated, no one is there to help you with any difficulty. Then, the corridors look like a prison because of the dirt on the walls and the floor, it looks like an abandoned building. The "reception" by a certain john sitting in his sofa. As for the rooms, don't think you are 3-4 in them, there are more than 8 of us, no security for your stuff. The price is way too high for the quality of the service and the quality of the accommodation. I have never seen this! If I can give you an advice, spend in an accommodation a little more expensive to be sure to sleep well and to come back alive every night... I was forced to take another hotel because it was not possible to stay in this kind of accommodation. Of course, no possibility of refund, the host has no leniency!

When booking Gillian’s place I didn’t realize it was a shared rental space,I took it as a private room in a rental apartment but didn’t really get that another person would be there when I booked,I wrote the host and let her know it was a last min trip for a family emergency and the response time said 1hr for host response, took over 2 hrs to get a response at that point we weren’t so sure it wasn’t a scam, our money was taken right away but heard nothing in a timely manner, fortunately it was not a scam and we did finally hear from the host, She did apologize for the late response time, told me how to get into the property,then at the end told us we would be accompanied by 1 other female, to wake up the next morning to a man in the other room as well, which was a shock!! maybe a quick message to other occupants would be a good idea that others will be there too,we did have stains on our sheets,outlets in room didn’t work, and small space for cost,couple kinks to work out and it’s good

This was very clean and the host was very helpful. You need to be ok with alot of police cars and the train being right in your window. Also, this is no place for kids as there was alot of drug activity on the very steps that you have to walk through to enter. We were very unfortunate as we watched multiple men go in and out of the downstairs unit that shared a door with our unit. As a professional traveler, I cannot in good faith recommend this as a place to stay.
The neighborhood is kinda sketchy, especially the walk to the 4/5 station at night. Apart from that everything inside was nice and clean. I would recommend bringing earplugs.

I had a nice stay! The public area is clean. The host guy does the cleaning every day. People are nice and I made some friends here. Actually this area is safer than I thought. Sometimes I back around 10 or 11pm(a girl alone), it was okay, no strange people, nothing happened. Don’t need to be too scared but it’s always better to stay alert!  For the bad part, it’s not quite enough during the sleeping time. The air-con makes some noise and also you can hear other’s sound. That’s unavoidable for living in a dorm.  If you’re finding a cost-effective stay in NY, I recommend here.
This home was incredibly dirty and disgusting. There was underwear on the floor, piles of trash in multiple places and left us feeling very unsafe and uncomfortable. Would never recommend to anyone.

The back yard was full of trash bags and old dirty stuff  and the floors, carpets and stairs were dirty and were not browned properly. Very hard to find the car parking. TV remote was not working. The bathroom door gets stuck very hard and hard to open. We had paid for 2 nights stay but we left after staying only one night. My kids were scared and didn’t like the place.

I don’t usually leave reviews, but staying here honestly ruined my second stay to NYC. I dreaded going back here at the end of the day. The surrounded area is fine if not a bit ghetto and dirty. When we checked in the sheets were dirty, the host assured us this was because we checked in early and changed this, which I appreciated. However, this barely changed things. The nights were cold and uncomfortable as the heating wasn’t working and the pillows and sheets were hard as bricks. Being a single woman in a shady neighborhood I felt safer if I brought a friend to stay with me for safety reasons, for this, I was charged $40 a day, I feel like this was a made up price but I gladly paid it if it made I would feel safer and not get raped or killed. Which honestly? Shame on the hosts for that. The walls were paper thin so you could hear everything going on outside and in the other rooms. At the end of the day I paid $350 to sleep in a rough cold room. Next time, I’ll just stay in a hotel. Please save your money and book somewhere else.

Unbelievable two bedroom two bath. Great location surrounded by so many restaurants, shopping, drug stores, grocery stores and so close to Central Park. I would definitely recommend this place and will definitely stay there again and again and again.

I loved my stay at Mary's place! The apartment is very cozy and welcoming, the bedroom was super comfortable, everything was exceptionnelly clean. Mary is very nice, she explained to me how to get around and recommended places to buy food, it helped to take out some of the stress of traveling by myself! The apartment is located between the L and M trains, you can get uptown Manhattan in 30 minutes. The street is very quiet, there are many coffee shops, restaurants, bars and stores nearby, as well as Marsha P Johnson Park and Domino Park that have an amazing view of the bridge and the city. I'd gladly stay there again!

Although the location is good, your house needs improvements. As soon as we arrived, at 6pm, two hours after check in, we could not get in because the house was still being cleaned. We stayed at the door waiting. Another problem upon arrival was the entrance almost closed by garbage on the stairs. This garbage only increased during our stay. Nobody collected them. Only on the last day we left our garbage there. We had to clean up the garbage in order to get through. Some furniture is broken, like the dining table chairs. One of the guests even fell off a chair. There is a lot of cutlery missing. As there were six of us, we had to inflate some inflatable mattresses. To our regret, only one mattress was OK. We had a terrible first night, the mattresses deflated and we literally slept on the cold hard floor. The next day we asked Ashley for new inflatable mattresses and that problem was solved. The house has many cockroaches, including one of our guests woke up in the morning with a cockroach in her hair. Scary! Remember that we complained about the garbage at the door? To make matters worse we found a dead rat on the way out. We understand that the stay has a low cost, so we don't complain about the mess in the closets, the lack of pillows, torn sheets, lack of utensils in the house ... but we think that cleanliness is fundamental even for a simple place.  A warning for tall people: the ceiling is very low and much smaller than shown in the pictures.

We were in a group of 6 visiting the city and we just hoped to find a cozy place to stay q few nights. Ashley’s place was just so perfect, it was all we expected and more! The place is very comfortable and has everything you might need. We were scared to get cold at night lol but the place has as many blankets you want and the heater also works perfectly. Loved the stay and will DEFINITELY be back!

Great location that was close to Prospect Park and the Subway. The apartment itself is spacious and has what you would need (though we did need to buy soap/shampoo/etc). While we did not have any issues, the area did feel a little sketchy, particularly at night. We were not fully comfortable walking in the area at night with small kids.

This was the first of two stays we had at Jason's place. NYC Haven 1 was as described - spacious front room and kitchen and ample space for me and my family (7 in all) to move around in. The kitchen was well kitted out and included a filter coffee maker,  kettle and a modern range. The bedrooms were sized well, particularly the one with the double and single bed, and we found the place to be clean and tidy. A block away are ample shopping facilities - drug store, groceries, restaurants, etc. It was very cozy as well – even though it was bitterly cold outside, the apartment remained nice and warm throughout. A major plus was the parking to the side of the building – parking on the street is packed in the locality so it was good to know a guaranteed place was always available no matter how late we got back. Jason was responsive to our questions – he checked in with us on day 2 of our stay to make sure we were ok and we had also asked him to make sure a blanket was available for the sofa bed for our second stay, which he made sure was ready for us when we returned. One thing I would mention is that the property is located on a busy main road close to a cross road, which means that traffic noise is a constant, lasting through the night. Most of my family are heavy sleepers, so they slept through this fine but as a lighter sleeper, I had to use ear plugs to block out most of the noise. Overall, for the value, I would say that it was a good place and we had a  pleasant stay at NYC Haven 1. Without a doubt, it was a lot better than paying more than double for poky hotel rooms in Manhattan for all of us.

Now talking about the apartment and room! It is an excellent option. 1.- location, the train station is just one block away where you can take the Q train anywhere! Everything was very clean, everything is very comfortable and very consistent with its price, again you feel very comfortable at home. My wife and I would definitely return to Violette's house with great pleasure, it was a great trip!!!  Thanks!!! Jason made my trip to the city for a conference quite enjoyable- the space is large, airy and spacious and I found it exactly as advertised, with no unpleasant surprises! I stayed with three of my colleagues and we were all well accommodated. Jason was responsive and helpful during our stay.

This place is great value for money,  not too far from manhattan so ideal for people visiting New York and don't want to spend crazy prices on hotel rooms. Huge space for a group of people, everything you want and need in this place for the price it's a steal

Great, spacious loft in a great location in the city. It was a quick 5 minute walk from my office. The giant roof deck really sells this place.  I definitely took advantage of it given the nice weather I had while I was there. Marc was very helpful, gave me all the instructions I needed to navigate the place and tips on where to grab late night bites etc. The entrance to the place is a *bit* sketchy, (graffiti-ed door and garbage in the hallway) , but Marc has really done a lot of great stuff with the inside. It's outfitted with a speaker system, smart TV, smart lights and blinds.

Accommodation has its pros and cons. The best: it is a very spacious apartment, there were 7 of us and space was not a problem. The two bathrooms are very comfortable, the new one is very small but it gets you out of trouble. It has a washing machine and dryer which is very practical. It is a quiet neighborhood, there is not too much noise on the street, you sleep peacefully. There is a bus at the Church Av metro exit that leaves you one block from the house. The neighborhood doesn't seem safe for Europeans like us but everyone told us that it wasn't dangerous and the truth is that we didn't have any bad experiences. The heating works perfectly, it is very hot in the apartment. Jason is very attentive to everything and answers you right away Cons: the cleaning, of course, was the worst, the apartment had only been cleaned superficially and although there were anti-cockroach devices throughout the apartment, on the first day as soon as we opened the light the first thing we saw was that we would not be alone in the apartment, there were quite a few cockroaches running around on the kitchen marble. That already made us very uncomfortable. I have to say that from the third day onwards the cockroaches stopped coming outside and hid but we knew they were there. The wifi was very slow but after telling Jason it seems to have improved a little. If Jason improves the cleanliness issue, this is a good apartment.
he is very nice person and Answer my question quickly,but  The street little bit scare when I come back late and along

I can't stress enough how attentive Jordan was, it was an absolute pleasure to have one of my colleagues stay at his place. She enjoyed everything, said it was very peaceful and clean and looked just like the pictures on the site. Anything that she needed or any questions we had, Jordan responded quickly.  This is a gem and I will be using him in the future, that is if it's available.....his place is always being booked so if you've stumbled onto this page and like what you see, BOOK IT! Don't wait, because while you're trying to decide someone else will take your spot ;)

Wow, what an incredible experience it was staying at Jessica's Brooklyn apartment! I was planning my move to New York City and was looking for temporary housing, which would allow me to search for permanent housing and a job. I stayed in Jessica's apartment about three and a half weeks, and I couldn't have asked for anything better!  1) The Apartment: this is the perfect sized studio for one, or a couple. The bed is huge and there is even a sofa! As well as a large screen TV. There is a full kitchen with mini fridge, microwave, stove, oven. She even had available a pot and fry pan, which was really great, since I was staying long term and planned on cooking meals. She has a fabulous (color-coded!!!) library with a  wonderful selection of books. Her apartment is very tasteful and modern. The bathroom is great and has all one needs.   2) The Neighborhood: this apartment is located in Park Slope, which is a BEAUTIFUL community!! I had so much fun just wandering and walking around for hours. My favorite attraction by far was the Green-Wood Cemetery. It is more of a park than a cemetery, and is incredibly peaceful. The cemetery is about a 7 minute walk from the apartment. There are plenty of stores, restaurants, and cafes around (my favorite coffee was from Whoops! cafe). Her apartment is located between the Prospect Park station (which was closed for renovations during my stay but may be open again soon) and the 25th street station, both serving the R line. I love the R line!!! This line gets you to where you need to go, is hardly crowded, and the station is only a few blocks away from the apartment. MOST IMPORTANTLY, this neighborhood is very safe!! I am a young, single female and I walked around alone at all times of the night and day and never felt unsafe.   3) The Host: Jessica was absolutely great during this whole process. She replied to all my messages within an hour, even though she was on the opposite side of the world! Initially I was deciding between Jessica's apartment and another Brooklyn apartment that was a little cheaper, but ultimately I went with Jessica because of how responsive she is. She really cared about me and my stay, and that made all the difference.   You won't be disappointed staying at Jessica's. I am so grateful to her for the opportunity to have this wonderful introduction to life in NYC/Brooklyn! :)

Whenever you go to a new city or meet new people, you’re usually very tentative. When me and my friends got there, Tanya immediately made us feel welcomed. She made us feel right at home. She told us where metro and how to take it. She told us where the neighborhood store was and which one was the best to go to. In addition, she asked us what our interest were and based on that she informed us on a vast amount of amazing places and things to do while we were down there. The listing description was accurate. The entire place was extremely clean from the bedrooms, to the bathroom to the kitchen.  The neighborhood was perfect as well. We were in no danger at all. Everyone in the area was friendly and there were a lot of quick stores and food spots to go to in the area as well. All in all, Tanya made us feel as if we were living with a relative. She accommodated us in every way possible and just simply made us feel comfortable. Anytime I go to New York, I only booking with Tanya and no one else. We built a nice friendship and she helped us have the best time in New York.  I encourage everybody to book with Tanya. There's simply no other option.

Antonia is very nice and kind. She made sure to explain everything in detail. She left food in the fridge and snacka, which was a really nice touch. The apartment is small but quaint and one doesn't need a lot of space when visiting NYC. Antonia has a lot of suggestions of places to go and things to see. She is very respnsive by phone and text. The apartment is conveniently located, although at night it can be a little bit sketchy if come from the direction of 9th avenue. Really the only thing i wish i had known is that the apartment has previously been smoked in, and some people, like myself, could be very sensitive to the smell of cigarette smoke. My husband wasn't really bothered by it however, so really depends on how sensitive you are. Also, the bed is a pull out couch so be prepared for that. Overall the place has good value as it is very close to times square and many other locations.

Our experience in Antonia's apartment was TERRIBLE! Everything started well, she welcomed us with enthusiasm, left the apartment full of food and also gave us explanations of tourist attractions. But then, our experience started to be negative. He told us that the heating couldn't be controlled, so it was very hot in there. We opened the window, which did not have metal mesh, and that's how a RAT probably entered. The last day in the afternoon we started to hear the noise, so we called Antonia, she came over and said it was impossible because they always fumigate the building. We looked like we were the crazy ones. The same day at night, after a long and cold day in NYC, we arrived at the apartment and saw the Rat on top of the refrigerator, eating our food. We called Antonia again. He came closer, we showed him the photos and the noises, and he still didn't want to accept that there was a rat. Then he told us that he didn't understand why we were so afraid of a rat. For my girlfriend and I, it's totally disgusting. Imagine that the study is extremely small and that rat was walking on the bed and making contact with the food. We asked him for an urgent solution, at 00:30 in the morning, which he simply told us that he did not have one. We packed our bags as best we could and left. Luckily it was our last night and we headed directly to the Airport. We slept on the ground all night with 8 degrees below zero. A total disappointment in Antonia's actions. For a moment we thought there was going to be a solution, but no. Therefore, I recommend that future guests keep in mind that if they do not accept the presence of rodents and other pests, do not stay in this apartment, because otherwise they will end up sleeping on the floor of the airport like what happened to us, because the owner is not going to give you any solution other than returning 50% of the money corresponding to the missing nights. I hope the other 50% used it to fumigate that dirty apartment and its patio, so the same thing happens to them as it does to us. Keep in mind, it is located on a block where there are gastronomic establishments, a building under renovation with noise, etc. and you will continue to see pests. Remember, cheap ends up being expensive, and disgusting this time!!!

The location of the apartment is excellent, it is right next to Penn station, there is a supermarket very close and you have bars and restaurants throughout the area. The arrival was good, Antonia was very kind to us, explaining everything perfectly. I had left food for breakfast in the refrigerator for several days. For sleeping and showering it is acceptable, but nothing more, since we had an accident with a rodent in the room and that left us with a somewhat unpleasant experience.

The location is really good, close to several subway stops as well as Times Square, 5th Ave, the High Line, Chelsea art galleries, etc. If you are a walker then it is good jump off point for farther locations. Antonia's apartment is very clean and safe. The bed is a touch small for two people, depending on how you like to sleep. It was a bit short for my husband who is tall (6'4").  I ended up doing a job interview via Skype while on vacation and the wifi connection was excellent. That Antonia also provided breakfast and coffee made that morning stress free.  Antonia loves her city and offers a wealth of information. If you are at all confused on what you want to do, ask her for the details. She is an excellent resource! Check out was easy, which is exactly what you want when trying to get the most time possible out of your holiday city.

Antonia was very welcoming and nice host. The flat is really nice and has all the necessary commodities, at a few steps from the main attractions. However, the smell of cigarette was quite unpleasant. I wouldn't recommend this place if you are intolerant to the smell of cigarette.

This a very good alternative when traveling on a budget in New York. Pros: great location, near the metro, easy to access all the main attractions, near supermarkets and places to eat. Antonia is as well a great host, replied very fast and made sure we felt comfortable. You have a small independent apartment with everything you need, very clean. Cons: the street is not nice as well as the building, even a rat was viewed running around. You can feel unsafe or uncomfortable specially at night even though nothing bad happened while we were there. Despite that we would recommend.

If it's your first time in NYC you NEED to stay here. I think Lily deserves the best guests humanly possible! I was a little scared as this was my first solo trip and she put all my worries at ease. She was very helpful with advice about transportation and food to eat and even helped me out with recommendations when I couldn't sleep my first few nights. It was always relaxing coming back to the apartment. Lily is excellent at communication and I couldn't have asked for a better host ☺️  One thing to note: not anyone's fault because NYC bathrooms are ridiculous but the bathroom here isn't very fat friendly. If you're over a size W16 US I would say the bathroom will likely be uncomfortable and I wouldn't recommend for someone larger than a W20 US.

We stayed for a week in Yemi's accommodation and we were very happy since the room is large, the bathroom is private and you have everything that you need like a table and a small fridge. We did not meet Yemi but he was always aware and very kind of our well-being. Our Impresion was that the neighborhood was a little unsafe at night, but the quality / price ratio was very very good. Thanks for your kindness and everything Yemi

Lily is such a heartwarming host and makes you feel at home instantly. Check-in was easy and Lily was so accommodating for my stay. My flight got delayed for 2 hours and I already felt bad having to arrive so late on a Friday night, but Lily reassured me and made the whole process stress-free. She even gave some great tips/suggestions on places to eat in NYC.   The location is prime and close to everything you need in Manhattan. I felt safe travelling alone and Lily was a big help whenever I needed. She made sure I felt at home and comfortable, which I appreciated. I was working remotely during my time with her and she was accommodating and supportive of providing a quiet environment for me to do so.   I highly recommend anyone staying in NYC to stay with Lily. I would definitely stay with her again next time I'm in town.

Leecia was a wonderful host. She was friendly, accessible, and thoughtful. She gave us a hand drawn map of the neighbourhood so that we could find subway stops, restaurants, and grocery stores nearby. She gave us advice on using the subway. She was very accommodating in that she let us have an early check-in and a late check-out. The neighborhood was historic brownstones although it was a bit loud and sketchy at night. It was also a bit of a long commute to most attractions in Manhattan.

We stayed at Leecias home and it was great! The apartment had everything we needed for our stay and it‘s close to a subway station from where you get directly to Manhattan in 25 minutes. We can really recommend her place! The neighborhood appears to be a bit scary by night but everthing was okay!

Brad communicated very well off the start. I found the add very overstated as the place was not huge based on what we are custom to in Canada. All reviews stated that the place was clean which was not the case when we arrived although again could be to other peoples standards but by no means is it hotel quality.   We arrived Christmas day and Brad had first informed us that he was buying a lock box to place the key in once we arrived he told us it was placed under a bucket in front of the door. Now there was no lighting whatsoever so it was very difficult to find. Once we entered the apartment we immediately needed to go to the bathroom being we just flew 7 hours. My wife noticed no toilet paper and the toilet was broken. We immediately contacted Brad who told me he could Amazon prime us some toilet paper. We found this hilarious as it would take 2 days for that to arrive so we essentially got our own. As for the toilet being broken we basically got told how to get around the fact that the normal flushing procedure was broken, we had to stick our hands in to the back bowl of water and pull the black lever, not at all what we expected. Now let's move on to the Kitchen. The floor was sticky and ruined a few pairs of socks, microwave was filthy and the refrigerator was very dirty. Now on to the living room, low couch which was OK but it is a 3 piece which comes apart easy, area rug really needs to be vacuumed. The bed is cheap Ikea and also looks like it is falling apart. The closet was packed with the owners junk and we had to live out of suitcase. In the end we filled a claim with Airbnb and Brad was not willing to co-operate and we had to allow them to provide a resolution after Brad accused us of stealing and smoking which we do not do and is an insult since we are non smokers. Here is what Airbnb came up with as a resolution.  Hello Moe,  My name is Luka, and I'm a case manager here at Airbnb. Thank you for contacting us.  I was assigned to give you an answer to your refund request related to your stay with Brad in New York.  I am very sorry to hear that this listing was below your expectations.   Your pictures show that you have a point, specially the one of the fridge. As a courtesy, I will refund 2 nights and the cleaning fee. Please expect $440 CAD to be back to your PayPal in a couple in a maximum of 2 days.  I'm very sorry for what happened and I'd love to see you giving us another chance  Please take note of this very well deserved coupon I've issued for your next adventure with us.

We learned about this website from watching shark tank so we thought we'd try it, at first I was uncomfortable thinking what if the apartment has issues or what if what if what if..?? However this was truly the best and most fun experience ever. Across the street was whole foods so every morning we lived like true New Yorkers and got a fresh bagel at the other corner was the best pizza place ever.. A block and a half away was the subway, down stairs is the drug store it was just a perfect fun location.. Kevin is an awesome host we arrived to his adorable girlfriend it just felt like we had always known her.. They were both alway a text, email or call away.. The apartment is very comfortable and it was plenty of room for 3. Kevin went out of his way to make videos of everything which was extremely helpful and I was able to refer back to when we had a question about the shower and the coffee maker. The apartment was clean, warm and most of all the bed for so comfortable I came home and bought a new mattress.. I would rent this apartment again in a minute.. Best host and experience ever

That was my first experience with Airbnb and my first time in NY, so I was afraid a little bit. But the place was calm and nice. The room and the other places were like in the pictures. I really liked that I had my privacy, I could come and go when I wanted. It's easy to reach from JFK, but it's a little bit far from the downtown. It took ~ 60 min by public transport. Steve and his wife were very kind with me. I especially liked that they offered some little breakfast / snacks that they prepared.  I think it's a perfect place to stay for a couple of days.

Very spacious, comfortable place. Definitely would consider staying again.  Close to lots of restaurants, food stores & some drug stores. Great value. Very spacious.  Absolutely loved the towel warmer & elevator which  made it much nicer for older folks. Thanks so much.

Janelle was an amazing host. We were scammed on another unit when we arrived. She was so accommodating and understanding of our situation and made it work. The apartment was clean and in a great location to the Q line. Would rent again!!!

My partner and I stayed at Graces for 6 nights over Christmas, and were immediately impressed by the space - which is much larger in person than it appears in the photos. We were able to cook our own meals as Grace had everything we needed. The bed is a pull out sofa, but ample room for two people and very comfortable. We loved the fireplace, and the Christmas touches around the apartment, it was such a warm and cosy place that felt like home. Grace was also a lovely host who immediately made us feel so welcome. The area is only a few blocks to the subway, and there is a Target, an Aldi and Costco only a short walk away. Lots of food places are very nearby as well so anything you need you can get ie 7/11, Wendy's, pizza, Dunkin' Donuts, and various deli's and supermarkets. We found the area closer to the subway maybe a little unsafe coming back late at night, so just be cautious, same as anywhere, but we ran into no issues personally and thoroughly enjoyed our stay.  If you are looking for a cosy, comfortable, convenient stay with a local New York feel, you will not be disappointed with Graces place!
Very quiet and safe neighborhood. Beth and Mary (and their friendly cats) made our stay at their house stress free.

This positing is not the actual address. Gordon tried to get me to meet a stranger at a nearby McDonald’s to go to a lockbox to retrieve the key to a second location. He changed his story several times about details such as how many people were sharing the space and tried to cover up the fact that there was no viable options to secure my room with proper locks. He actually suggested that if I wanted to lock the door knob while I was gone, I could use a knife to jimmy the lock for re-entry. All this communication was done via What’s App as opposed to the Air BNB messenger per Gordon’s request. Out of fear for my safety, I chose not to stay with this host. After reporting the situation at length, Air BNB sided with the host and refused refund. Do not reserve this location. It is a scam.

Gordon and Mehmet are wonderful!! Trust the process if you are doing self check in. I saw someone’s negative review, do not pay attention to it.  You do have to walk 4 flights of stairs but they are not that bad-my husband who has a bad knee was able to do this without a problem. Just don’t pack a ton of luggage-you really don’t need to bc you have washers and dryers. We had one large suitcase a small one and two back packs-stayed 5nights- remember you are getting to stay in Manhattan for a great price! Pick your battles! 😉 subway is right on the corner so convenient quick and easy-do not be scared of the subway-it was our 1st time in an air bnb and using the subway. It was great and so easy. I had anxiety for nothing! Mehmet and Gordon are quick to respond and put your worries to ease. They are very polite and your happiness is their priority! Their SUV is super clean and being dropped off was awesome. We did a self check in with key box and it was a piece of cake! Again trust their check in process!😉 we will be staying again! Yes their may be other people in the other two rooms but it’s so quiet and you never really run into each other. Your here to see New York not hangout in the apt! He has two bathrooms so it’s no biggie. They are so clean! The washer and dryer make things nice too!

Caroline was very flexible with the arrival time which made traveling less stressful on a holiday weekend. It was really easy for us to come in and out and everything was provided for us! For the price, this was a great value!

This apartment is amazing!!! Aaron and Alissa are the sweetest hosts and made the entire experience easy and stress free.  The apartment is spacious and very comfortable and the location is ideal.  Highly recommended!

The COVID pandemic has made it scary to travel but I felt completely at home in ME's space. The neighbourhood feels safe and ME is a super crazy virgo clean freak - If I could give ME a Super Super Host status I would - I always travel AirBnB when I can and she just gives you outstanding service. Thank you ME and Lulu for a great stay. I will be back!

The good: This place is great to stay in. Very well located and has everything you need. There is no door between the two rooms which may be an issue if you plan on using the futon as a second bed. Good range of appliances - iron, hair dryer, toaster, kettle, etc.   The bad: the building manager (NOT Nissim) helps check you in and out and appears quite rude. The bedroom heater can be noisy if you don't twist the knob properly. The apartment is on the ground floor near the front entrance so you hear everyone coming in and out of the building. The good far outweigh the bad. I would stay here again.   Exrtra info: The futon was broken when we arrived and some light bulbs blew throughout our stay but we didn't complain because we appreciative to have the place and were able to make it work. (Nissim even discounted our stay slightly when the AirBnb quote went up unexpectedly just before booking it in order to match the initial advertised rate.) When we checked out, Nissim mistakenly accused us of breaking the futon because the building manager incorrectly said we did (we never brought the issue to Nissim's attention because we thought it was such an obvious defect in the futon that he couldn't possibly be unaware). The building manager must not have been diligent in his previous check out inspections and advised Nissim it must have been us. This situation upon checkout was therefore unnecessarily  stressful. This is not Nissim's fault as he was following poor advice and in Hindsight I should have taken photos and informed Nissim upon check-in. This was a lesson learned by me which all other AirBnbers should take note of!

Location is great close to public transportation and there are many restaurants that cater to any taste, the building is right next to the Hell's kitchen flea market if you fancy shopping around, although it can be a little noisy, area is safe despite the concentration of homeless people hanging around the area, but again this is NYC! Now that I know the area I would prefer to stay  near 50th st away from the port authority or a couple of blocks away near 10th/11th ave. Host was friendly and quick to respond
I do not recommend either the apartment or the dangerous neighborhood

We were 7 hours late due to flight delays which meant that we arrived at 2.30 am! Despite that Caroline was at the door to greet us and show is to our room. The airline also lost our luggage, Caroline's mum was available, and willing to be on hand to receive our bags in the days that followed. This meant that our sightseeing in NYC was not affected. I feel I should explain why I gave 4 stars and not 5.  When you enter the building, in order to get to the apartment you have to walk past the doors to the ground floor apartments in which there was obviously a smoker.  On all 3 evenings of our stay  we had to walk through thick smoke before climbing the stairs to the accommodation. That for us was unpleasant. Hence 4 star review.  Otherwise our stay was enjoyable.  Extremely friendly and accommodating hosts. Thank you!

We loved staying at Aaron's place! It's on a quiet block that was close to various public transit routes. We did not feel unsafe walking back at night. Plenty of pillows on the beds and a variety of blankets to choose from. My cell phone charger wasn't working, but there was a spare cord in the cabinet that I used. It rained while we were there and there were several umbrellas available. The hair dryer in the bathroom also came in handy when I had to dry my shoes. The neighborhood was cute; best find was definitely Harlem Shake! Great experience overall and would definitely stay again!

This apartment is larger than the pictures appear.  I stayed for 7 weeks with 3 of us (including my 4-yr-old), and found the space to be sufficient.  The hosts were very helpful in accommodating our unique sleeping situation request, and the queen bed, queen blowup bed, and toddler blowup bed all fit in the very large bedroom (thereby freeing up extra livable space in the living room).  The bed as well as the blowup bed are very comfortable, to a surprising degree.  And when sleeping in the bedroom, it is completely silent.   The shower has very good water pressure, which is a nice bonus.  I supplemented what was in the kitchen, but we also did much more home cooking than your typical NYC visitor.   In the neighborhood, our favorite places were the Tropical Grill around the corner for cheap and delicious Dominican chicken/rice/beans/flan, and Renaissance Harlem for their grilled octopus and curry/coconut mussels.  The hosts were friendly and kindly and quickly accommodated any issue that arose.   The location makes getting around NYC very easy.  6 min walk to the 2/3, 8 min walk to the A/B/C/D, and bus lines along Central Park and elsewhere made it very convenient.   I often returned back from work very late, and never felt unsafe.  It was a Covid bonus having our own little entrance area.  The backyard is not easy to access, but there were plenty of great playground and Central Park for my son to enjoy.  The laundromat is right around the corner and convenient.   There are multiple small-to-large grocery stores within a few minute walk.  I have stayed in Airbnbs all over the world for many years, and this one is well managed, better than expected, and I would definitely consider it again for my next extended visit to NYC.  It has earned its stellar reviews.

A gem! Some places look better in the photos - but this one is actually even better in person! It is spacious, very comfortable & stylish with a large bathroom and well stocked kitchen.  It also stayed cosy and warm during a very cold snap. The location is great - a lot of places and amenities are very walkable from here. I am a bit of a foodie and there are loads of yummy places close by - Banter (great breakfasts), Once Upon A Tart (coffee and snacks/lunch), Dante (cocktails and share plates), Dirty French (dinner -a few blocks away) and if you want a treat then head to the restaurant at the NoMad Hotel in midtown - pricey but worth every cent. You are also close to the subway, food stores and drug stores plus it is an easy walk down to Tribeca and the Hudson River. The bedroom does overlook Sixth Avenue so there is always going to be a little noise from outside - it is pretty sound proof but some noise is always going to get through. After a few days the wifi in the apartment went out - Jocelyn was away but responded instantly and we worked out a temporary solution.  Jocelyn is lovely to deal with and very accommodating and is also close by if there are any issues. I was in NY for a few days (about a week before) and stayed at The Beekman Hotel (nice place but small rooms) - this was similar dollars but a world better. I highly recommend this apartment and if coming back to NY would definitely stay here again.

This is a fantastic place to stay, I stayed a whole month and a bit more with help from the hosts and honestly can say I couldn't have hit a better place. The apartments spacious, homely and very comfortable and the hosts are kind and generous. Giving me advice when needed (I was relocating so local knowledge was key) and checking in on me.  The kitchens fully equipped so you can cook your own meals, air con in the bedroom made staying here in summer more than comfortable and the bed was extremely cosy. As I say i was here for a long time and during that time didn't at any time feel unsafe or out of place in the building.  In terms of quiet as well apart from the occasional sounds from the nearby basketball courts it's shockingly peaceful for somewhere which is located in the heart of Astoria.  Location wise it's right on the main street of Astoria so connected to ALOT of restaurants bars and eateries and very close to two main lines into Manhattan so it takes about 15/20 mins to get there. Perfect if your looking to go out and about.   Couldn't say nice enough things about this place and the price is more than reasonable for NYC. Fully recommend.

Yemi made us feel incredibly welcome, having supplied us with a few essentials upon arrival and being able to work with our schedules for check in and departure. The apartment was very comfortable and was exactly as it seemed, if not more so then the pictures implied. I never once felt unsafe within the neighborhood, and was comfortable enough to walk around on my own with just a short walk to the train station. I would stay here again, if given the opportunity, and would recommend friends to stay here as well.

Yemi was a great host. He is a positive and really nice guy who made sure me and my friend had everything we needed, and was very helpful. He wrote us now and again to check in on us and make sure we were enjoying our stay.  We were happy with our room which was nice and clean, and the TV with several channels.  The neighbourhood seemed a bit dodgy compared to what I am used to, but we never felt unsafe and I am happy we decided to stay in Brooklyn. And it was a plus that a train station was nearby.   The room was nice and cheap, and Yemi is as mentioned before a great host, so I would definitely recommend my friends to stay there.

This room is a steal for the price!  Robin is a perfect host. She is very friendly and engaging. Robin told us about some spots in the area to check out, as well as took the time to show us how to get around on a map.  The room itself was very cozy, comfortable and clean. I would definitely recommend staying here if you get the chance!

To be a guest at Robin’s place was a warm welcome to NYC for me. I won’t forget where and with whom I started my adventure in the US. Situated in the nice and lively area between Bushwick and Bed-Stuy, the flat was much more than just a room to stay for the night. In fact, Robin provided everything as a guide (rather: a mentor) to the neighborhood and the real culture of Brooklyn. As promised in the ad, Robin and Roland’s flat was full of books, opinions, advices, experiences, and culture – both written (most of them in longhand, taped with love to wherever your eyes turned to, from doors to walls to kitchen cabinets to chairs on the rooftop) and spoken out loud whenever you started a conversation with Robin. I really liked it!!! (and will miss it soon, I expect)  But the most important thing of all: Robin herself was an inspiring source and conversation partner of almost all issues of NY’s and American Culture. She gives you something you wouldn’t experience when you just follow the must-sees of the travel agencies or the advices of the media. Open your ears and heart and you will be rewarded with something great!  Like life itself, not everything was perfect: there were some recognizable discrepancies between insulation and heating, which seems to be an issue not uncommon in the land of power and power consumption. But I think Robin will raise her voice for that too, though it might need some time till this change of mind will show up in real buildings.  Last but not least, an all-clear signal: I was a bit scared about the bed first and spent my first nights on the ground floor. Later, I dared to sleep on the loft. Even though I could never get rid of the fear to die due to my nightly movements, it didn’t happen. Fortunately.

Robin's home is super conveniently near the J train and several bus stops. It has a lovely rooftop to lounge upon and our room was comfortable and clean. There are 3 different airbnb rooms in the apartment, which means we got to meet some very kind and interesting travellers. No one is more kind or interesting than Robin, who is probably the smartest person I have ever met. From the books on the shelves to the decor to the guide to Brooklyn that Robin gave us to the brilliant and helpful labels on all the lightswitches and kitchen cabinets, this place was great. If you're afraid of heights maybe see if another room is open because this IS a loft bed and it doesn't have any walls, but we didn't have any problems.

This place is really cute and convenient as it’s VERY close to the J Train. I was pretty nervous because I was traveling alone but I never felt unsafe walking to the apartment :) Would definitely recommend this place to any traveler.

Yemi is perfect host - goes out of his way to accomodate/help you, and responds in minutes. He even checked on us every few days since we were staying for 10 days. Apartment is clean and room is spacious, and has everything you need. Value for money really good. Subway is 5 mins walking and you'll be in most Manhattan locations you'll be visiting in 45 mins to an hour. Neighborhood is a bit sketchy but we didn't have any problems ourself, i guess if you only get to and from subway it should be fine.

Our Stay At "Serene In Sunset" Was 1St Rate.Dan Is A Wonderful Host Who Goes The Extra Mile To Make Sure Your Stay Is A Good Experience. Don't Be Afraid To Ask Questions.Dan Has A Vast Knowledge NYC And He Is Happy To Share With You.The Apartment Was Very Clean And Has All The Comforts Of Home.You Couldn't Ask For More.The Neighborhood Is Diverse And Welcoming.A Great Place To Explore. Access To The Subway Was Easy And The Subway Line Was A Good Line To Go Reach Your Destination In Any Part Of NYC. It Was A Great Experience!!!!

Enjoy a great time in Sunset Park. Actually go to the park. The view of Manhattan is breathtaking. We found out that you can get directly from Sunset Park to Wall Street with NYC Ferries. We used it every day and it wasn't as stressful as the subway.
Fantastic host, provided everything we needed, and being in such a perfect location, this place is a steal

Not many bad things to report about Iradj's place. Incredible food all within walking distance, a quick walk to everything in and around Times Square and quite, honestly, the #1 reason why I chose to book was because of the value. Iradj, is a genuinely warm person who really cares about the comfort of his guests, what more could you ask for? The only cons would be the lack of a stove, if you're used to cooking at an Air BnB, you won't be able to here. My daughter and I bought milk and cereal and yogurt and water upon arrival. There is a toaster oven, a fridge, a way to make coffee and a microwave but not enough room for a stove. Don't let that last comment scare you. only the kitchenette is small, the bathroom has a full tub and the living, dining and setting areas are more than adequate. Also the stairs. If stairs are an issue, you'll need to climb 3 floors upon entering this condo. I don't want to deter anyone from staying here, the place is awesome but, again, if 3 flights of stairs is an issue.....I will be booking this place in a heartbeat when I choose to return.

Gordon was super kind and the location was easy to find, considering it is really near to the metro station and to the one of the most important avenues of NYC, Broadway. The neighbourhood is a little scary apparently, but we did not had problems. And considering the cost benefit to stay in Manhattan, I consider it a good option.

Really liked staying at the room, it was tidy and the host was friendly, welcoming and even gave some advice on what to do/see in New York. Location was perfect, if youre planning to see the city for a couple of days. Area also didnt seem too shady and in the room it was very quiet (except for the Ac which was very loud but it worked well); wifi was top; kitchen/bathroom great. Only thing I really didnt like was the check in process. Took a lot of work from my side and very little cooperation from his. definitely something he can try to handle a bit better in the future

Comfortable room for 2. My husband and I stayed here for 3 nights, with 2 medium sized luggages. One was kept in the closet so we had enough room to open the main luggage for clothes and daily necessities.   Gordon was a wonderful host who kept in touch with us throughout our stay. He was very friendly and kind, and prompt with responding to our queries. He was late to meet us for check in, but came to look for us when we got lost, and even helped with one of our bags.   Location wise, while it was great for it’s convenience (5 mins walk from subway, 15 mins ride from Times Square), it wasn’t the ideal neighborhood for us. Felt a little unsafe walking back from the subway at night. The corridor and stairway of the building is smelly (stinks of urine), and neighbors can be very loud at times (talking loudly and occasional loud banging sounds at night). As previous guests have mentioned, you have to climb up a few flights of stairs to get to the apartment. If you have luggages like us, it may be tiring to lug it all the way up. However, if you don’t mind these, it’s really a great place to stay at! If you’re here to sightsee, you probably won’t spend much time in the apartment anyway! Just have to manage your expectations :)  Overall, we still had a pleasant stay with no big issues, and Gordon was a wonderful host.

Staying at Yemi was amazing, everything was very good. The room and the kitchen and bathroom were very nice and very clean. Yemi was very helpful and nice to us. He cared about us during all our staying. Maybe one thing was worse - the neighborhood was a little bit loud , especially at weekend nights, I recomend to take earplugs :-) I had been afraid of that part of Brooklyn, but everything was OK, we felt safely. But our experience was great.

The spot is very cozy and comfy. The bed is very confortable, the room and bathroom are clean . We didn´t use the kitchen but there´s one, and a meal room. The neighborhood is safe and vey close to a subway station. We walked around very late at night and never felt unsafe. There is also a deli on the corner, that works all day and night. I could meet personaly Viviana and Fred, and their relatives. They were kind, respectfull and Always attemptive to answer questions and to give some clues of Brooklyn and Manhattan. It was my first time out of manhattan, and for sure it was na excelent choice. I recommend and wish to come back soon.

Great space close to everything.  Safe location, cool place.  Iradj met us at the door and carried our bags up.   Only drawbacks are those 3 flights of stairs  and that there isn't much of a kitchen at all but it's not that big of a deal.  Plus, all the restaurants so close, there really isn't a need to cook anyway.   I traveled with my daughter and niece and we never felt unsafe, even walking late night.  Super clean, too.  Would definitely stay there again :)

The location was wonderful . Easy walk to deli’s , drug stores , target, and a ton of restaurants as well as Broadway and time square . Close accessible subway entrances to multiple platforms . Iradj was very welcoming and friendly and very attentive if we needed him and very quick to respond . The place was charming and had a lot of room . The entrance to the building was tucked in next to a diner (the Galaxy diner) that my sisters and I ate at multiple times on this trip . They were very nice and had great food and coffee . I will absolutely keep this place in mind for my next trip to NYC .

First of all, I'd like to say that Yemi himself is an amicable guy. He smiled a lot and I never felt uncomfortable being around him. We (my sister and I) only met him once for a few minutes and even though neither of us said much he took it all in stride. I appreciated that he didn't try to force conversation. We were given 3 keys, two to get in the apartment and a third for our personal bedroom. I liked that extra touch. It was nice to know I could leave something important in the room without worrying about it being messed with or stolen. Although afterwards my sister and I felt as though our things would be safe regardless, and we probably never needed to lock the bedroom. The bedroom had a private bathroom within the room. Both rooms were very clean. We were given towels, soap and shampoo for the shower and extra sheets for the second bed. There was also a big tv across from the bed. We were given access to netflix, hulu, cable tv. I feel like that was above and beyond and I appreciate that a lot. Yemi was also very flexible. I asked to arrive a little earlier than our original time and to leave a little later and he willingly obliged. That was really amazing of him because he really didn't need to do that at all. Lastly there was an older man living in the apartment whom I came across twice during my stay. He was very kind and seemed genuinely interested even though I kept the conversation short.  Overall I would give Yemi a 5/5 for a great stay. Thank you!

Yemi is a great host. He had everything ready to receive us, fast communication and willingness to help. Clean pleace, quiet neighborhood. We had to face very hot days and the portable A/C unit was strugglying to keep the room comfortable at night. Nearby subway station is really helpfull if you plan using public transportation; just take in account it can be somewhat unsafe at night.

Host was available to check in at agreed time. I wish the AC would work as it was one of the hottest and most humid day during our stay. Ashiv gave us wifi access  later in the evening, but having it on arrival in the morning would have been nice.  Some towels, soap. and shampoo would be nice to add to the value of this listing. There is no privacy through the kitchen window as it is open to the side walkway of the house without any curtain or window shade. Otherwise, host was very cordial, polite, and responsive to all my questions.

Amal is wonderful very responsive to answering messages and or questions...Very nice Brownstone on a quite street very close to grocery store drug store and subway...I would recommend this place to anyone
This is a no frills place, but it's a steal for the location.
Great host All amenities  Quick communication  Just cool awesome layed back This is a place you don’t wanna miss! It’s a steal truly enjoyed every second of my stay!

This apartment is beautiful, albeit needing some additional living room furniture to make it feel fully finished but the outside and the common areas make a poor impression. Following heavy rain, there was an unpleasant smell in the downstairs hallway. The two flights of stairs are narrow and steep. The local area shuts down completely from sunset Friday to sunset Saturday and there are few options available nearby other than fast food. We found a lot of street noise at the front of the apartment but the air conditioning was a huge bonus.

FILTHY beyond what I imagined possible. DO NOT RECOMMEND to anyone! Worse Airbnb experience of my life (and I have used Airbnb 15+ times).The apartment was extremely dirty. The floor was sticky everywhere and specifically by the dinning table there was an old  big sticky splash from what I assume was some sort of food. There was a bunch of hairs in the bathroom, the drain in the vanity was dirty, there were drips of dirt stuck to the oven and kitchen cabinets, dust all over the place to the point that I could draw with my fingers on it. Especially bad were the closets that I was hoping to use for putting our clothes but they were too dirty. The dinning table surface was not clean either, it had a patina of greasy dirt and again I could write with my fingers on it. The trash container also had drips of dirt. We were expected to stay for 5 nights and left after the first night. Only reason why we slept there is because we arrived late at night with 2 babies and limited options to find an alternative. Honestly, it was so dirty I felt uncomfortable sleeping throughout the night because I was not confident the sheets were clean either.... Also, all the doors were unlocked, which made us feel unsafe. I accidentally entered their home through the back door trying to find the right entrance.

We had a great time, the apartment is just like the published photos, everything was very clean.   The neighborhood considered it dangerous at first glance, but even though we arrived very late, nothing ever happened, plus the station was very close.  Kenny was very kind and communicated when necessary.

The apartment is very easy to find and a short walk around the corner from Kingston Throop subway station on the C line, just remember you will need to change stations if travelling from JFK airport where only the limited stop train will be available, but this is easily done and very quick.  The apartment is accessible by some steep steps and an electronic entry system.  The apartment was clean and well presented, there was plenty of space to accommodate our party of 3 adults and two teenagers. The kitchen area was well equipped and the Tetley tea bags were very welcomed!   The three bedrooms are downstairs, all were all very comfortable, warm and there were no complaints.  There are two bathrooms, one upstairs and one downstairs, both with showers which made life easy.  The train ride to Manhattan took around 30-40minutes, depending on where you wanted to be.  Looks can be deceptive as the surrounding area looked a bit run down but the locals we spoke to were all very friendly and we didn’t experience any issues or feel unsafe walking around and they were only too pleased to help.    There is a local supermarket a few blocks away which sold everything you needed, a few well know fast food places very close by too if you’re desperate, but some good research and help from Kenny and there are many great places to eat in Brooklyn, before or after a long day in the City.  Kenny was very friendly and responsive during the booking process and answered our questions thoroughly.  Whilst there we had a contact in case of problems and an issue we had with door entry system was resolved speedily without too much drama.  Overall, if you don’t mind staying a little way out from the action, then Kennys place is ideal, great value, spacious, comfortable, clean and lots to see in Brooklyn.

Miriam is very flexible and accommodating. Also very responsive. Was travelling from Ireland with three kids for the first time since before covid so stress levels were a little high.  It was good to feel that Miriam had our backs. The accommodation is spacious and quiet other than the usual street noises at the front. Very safe neighbourhood with a lot of families out and about. V quiet on Saturday due to sabbath with most places closed for several blocks. Subway from 50th street only 10 mins walk.

Jaclyn's apartment is perfect for a stay in NY. It is spacious, pleasant, very well located and close to public transport. The decoration is perfect and it is also very well equipped. Jaclyn is also very accommodating; We were able to leave our luggage a little later because our flight was late. We will come back with pleasure!

Rebecca's roommate Robin received us when we arrived.  The house is cozy and in my opinion, looks like the place of artists.    The other roommates are warm, friendly and welcoming.  Robin gave us guidance on how we can spend our time in New York, and was happy to help when we needed.  The room was reasonably cozy, however the bed could have been more comfortable.  The amenities were as listed, and the bathroom was clean.   I liked how passionate the housemates where about their art and what they do.  It was a cultural exchange for me more than anything.  The neighborhood looked safe, and we got back past midnight almost every day while we were there - there was no obvious danger or annoyance.  The place is very close to the subway station, and that made commute easy.  On the budget, it's a delightful stay!

Awesome apartment, really spacious and bright. Easy to get anywhere in the city, steps away from the subway and a great base for NYC adventure.  We didn’t have many questions but for each Jaclyn responded immediately and made the entire process stress free & awesome. I would stay again.
Rob was very quick to respond to all questions, and apartment was very clean! I will definitely come back.

Cathy's apartment is great. Very clean, functional and very well located! Cathy is a wonderful host, she responds quickly to messages and allowed us to stay longer in the apartment since our flight was late at night. We recommend!

The neighborhood and local community are welcoming and quaint. The location is convenient for getting anywhere via metro. There are coffee shops and restaurants within walking distance. There are several keypad locks in the entrance to the foyer and apartment, which made our stay secure. The host provided ample towels and linens and space in the connecting hallway to store our luggage on our last day after we checked out, before our flight. We booked this unit primarily for the convenience of a washer and dryer due to the length of our stay; unfortunately, we had issues. When we arrived, I was surprised to see that the washer and dryer were several decades old. When we tried to do our first load of laundry, the timer indicated 2 hours for a small load. While my wife and I were winding down in the bedroom that night, I made sure to stay awake for when the wash finished. About 50 minutes into the wash cycle, the apartment began filling with smoke - the washing machine had started smoking so severely that I was afraid it would catch fire. I had to find a PDF manual online for the washer to get it to turn off, as the plug was unreachable and plugged into exposed wires in the back wall. I was unable to locate any fire extinguisher. Luckily our clothes didn't get damaged. I contacted the host, and while apologetic and willing to provide their extinguisher the following day, it took repeated proactive communication to figure out how we would wash our clothes. The host gave access to a washing machine in the unit next door a day or two later; however, the old washer was a hazardous and unsettling experience. The washing experience is unfortunate because the apartment was otherwise spacious and charming - including a large fridge/freezer, dishwasher, dishes/silverware, and A/C unit. The shower space was impressive and luxurious - one of the best I've used.

Paula & Seth were communicative, incredibly gracious hosts, even from afar, for the whole month of our stay. Their home is one of a kind—my partner and I felt very lucky to stay there; it was a peaceful haven to return to after work or play, luminous from the skylights and windows, plants everywhere, and plenty of space. The weekly cleaning kept the place fresh and Paula connected us with easy local delivery services for laundry and fresh eggs/milk during our stay. The location is excellent for travel around brooklyn and an easy commute into manhattan. A complete, stress-free delight.

As an Air BnB host myself for the past few years, I know how this works. And as two (of three total) travelers, coming from SF, we know small apartments. But this was exceptionally small for three people. There is NO way it can sleep six, and should NOT be listed as such, but for only for 4 people if sharing the 2 beds. There is NO common space, NO table to eat off of, and the TV's that are only in the bedrooms were very difficult to use. By no means, is this a LUXURY apartment. Great interaction (text wise) with the hosts, however upon arrival to NYC, we were asked to lie and tell the neighbors we were friends with the hosts (which we felt to be a shady start). We were greeted late by the assistant to let us in, and she assumed we knew where everything was already, and had I not checked the keys to the front door prior to her departure, we wouldn't have had a set of working keys at all - she had to go make a set and return 30 minutes later. We only had ONE set of keys between the three of us and had to keep going back and forth to the apartment to let one of us in. The heat was ON and the windows wouldn't open, making it stifling inside, especially when the two rooms (with fans in them) had doors closed. Luckily, we did not come to NYC to stay inside the apartment much of the time.  This would be great for two separate friends/relatives or two separate couples, IF there was a newly created common space. This apartment is in a GREAT location, however NOT quiet - EVERY night one of us was awakened by noise from the street, since this apartment is on street level. For the most part, was clean, although overall, it was pretty run down. There were not enough outlets, no hair dryer, and we had to ask for a coffee pot that was taken from another apartment. I slept on the couch (which does not sleep two - it is NOT a pull out, as advertised), but apparently the beds were VERY comfortable. We appreciated the stay, but will not be returning next year. Sorry.
It was very comfy, less stress when traveling because the host stocks the fridge and bathroom with everything you need - towels etc

We highly recommend Lindsee and Peter's apartment. We stayed there for six days and found it hard to leave. The location is excellent, the apartment is stylish yet extremely comfortable. The rooftop garden is an absolute oasis and we were more than happy to water the pot plants during the hotter weather. It was also a treat to feed the little sparrows who visited each morning. It is definitely a place that will remain in our hearts when we return home to Australia. We're going to steal some of Lindsee's styling ideas! Thanks so much for a wonderful stay in Nolita.

Hazardous and unsafe roof in bedroom. On the second night, after a heavy rain, we woke under a sagging ceiling weighted down with gallons of dirty water leaking onto the bed and floor. Bed sheets were wet and the floor was slippery.  The nature of the water damage to this roof and ceiling clearly shows it has been a long standing issue and has never been repaired properly. This is a health hazard and a safety concern. I would not recommend anyone staying here until it is repaired correctly. Other than this serious issue, the apartment is as described. The host did not offer us any compensation.

Where do I begin?  All I can say is that I felt at home. The space was welcoming and the decor exhibited class. From beautiful china plates and coasters to immaculate Italian furniture. The decor was on point. Petrona herself was very caring and pleasant. Myself and family were actually in NY to carry out the funeral service and burial of my mother in law.  We spoke to Petrona about the situation and how stressful of a time it had been and would you believe she even swung by after work to show her support and send her condolences. She is a wonderful Host . You will not regret staying here.  Thank you Again for everything My husband and children were very happy at "home".

I am so happy to be David's first guest and write his first review ! He is a FANTASTIC host and was incredibly available before and throughout my stay! The booking process was really smooth and even though my check-in was delayed, David was there to welcome me in person and make sure I was comfortable. The apartment was recently refurbished and incredibly bright, roomy and cozy ! Can't stress that enough. Price and location are unbeatable ! This is not a share, you have full privacy with your own bathroom,  a very useful iron board but most importantly wifi at the speed of light :-) . Subway is right on the corner along with all the convenience stores you need. David, thank you for a memorable stay, I will come back again and recommend !

David was an unbelievable host! Let me tell you some things from our life in NYC with him:  At first, he tells me that the normal bed was broken, so he puts there a new one. At second, he noticed that I am a tall person, so he gets me an extra mattress!!  when we arrived, he unfortunately wasn't at home because of work. So we had to go to a key cafe, where we get the keys easily.  After we calm down in the apartment because of a stressful flight, we wrote him a mail to ask him everything we needed. He gave us quick responses, good instructions and perfect tips for sightseeing in NYC, also good tips for delicious restaurants.  He met us several times on the street, checking if everything is good. And it was.  Moreover, the apartment was exactly like the pictures on Airbnb. The wifi signal in this apartment is amazing, in Germany its not that fast.  This was our first travel with Airbnb and we hope that the other hosts will be as good as David! My buddy Michael and me, we cannot imagine a better host than chappy. Thank you for amazing 12 days in NYC, David! I hope we will see us again!

Chappy's (David's) place was awesome! I was pleased to find a small but clean apt tucked away in a safe part of town.  I had I very good stay. Would highly recommend for travelers on the go; who are looking for a simple, stress free, and comfortable experience. Will definitely stay at this property again!

It was a very nice and chill place. The house is nicely decorated especially if you like artwork. Kristy was very helpful & nice with the questions we asked. My only concern is that my wallet and my north face were stolen along with a hunk of cash. There are no cameras in the house for situations like that. The door was locked so I wonder if there is a problem with the key. Besides that the stay went pretty smooth.

I absolutely loved staying in Halona's home. In my opinion it was better than the pictures. She was very welcoming and helpful when I had any questions. French. press. coffee. That speaks for itself. This is somewhere you would stay when you want a comfortable, welcoming and eclectic place and not a cold, sterilized hotel room experience. She has beautiful art on the walls, a gorgeous view of her garden out of the bedroom window and lots of space to sleep or relax. On a nice night, sitting out in the backyard is quite relaxing. The walk from the closest subway is, at most 10 mins and the subway ride into Manhattan can be 15-20 mins.
