I would definitely come back and recommend staying here to anyone who wants to visit New York City. I can't stress enough how amazing Halona is.

The apartment is really nice and located in the most bustling part of Williamsburg, a lovely place. However the policy on using the apartment freely is very strict. There is also a security camera in the hall which feels a little creepy - someone is always watching your comings and goings. All in all it was a nice stay, but not the most relaxed atmosphere.

There were some issues at check-in but the host was very responsive and got issues resolved within 2-10 minutes.  The negatives: Windows were unlocked when I checked-in and could create unsafe situation given studio is next to a rooftop.   Windows were very tricky to lock/unlock so I just asked host to keep them locked.  The studio got stuffy and I couldn't open the windows b/c of the tricky locks.  Bathroom light made loud humming noise after being on just a few minutes.  The worst part for me - you can hear the subway train passing and it sounded right below the studio building - this kept me up at night.  Also, you can hear people entering and exiting the building and people opening/closing doors  - this also kept me up at night.  I do not recommend this place for light sleepers.   Best part - the location.

The location is AMAZING - everything you could possibly want (except gluten free veggie food apparently) is close by and easily walkable. The "one set of stairs" is quite the set, and very steep, so I felt a bit unprepared getting my bags up and down. The code entry made getting in and out easy. The room is small - you're definitely paying for the location - but the bed is ultra cozy. The only weirdness (for me) was the lack of top sheet, especially in such hot and sweaty weather.  The big issue for me though was the noise. I had NO idea just how loud it would be, and the partying I heard continued past 2am when I passed out from exhaustion, and then I woke up at 5am to the sound of trains or something. So while having the amenities close by is a plus, the noise that comes with them can definitely rob you of sleep if you have an early morning.

I was planning on staying here for 2 months, but ended my stay on the 12th nights because it’s roach infested. I would wake up every night  and see pinky sized roaches running around the place. Still haven’t got anything back from the 4300 dollars I put down . What a scam🙃

Eric’s place is nice and private , the amenities are great and also he provides access to an Smart TV if you want to watch movies , the restaurant Giovanni’s has good pizza , I wouldn’t recommend the burger (it was burned), in general the place if fine and give you a more real experience of New York , do expect garbage in the streets but that applies to all New York, the metro is near the place and is safe to ride, I recommend the use of gloves in the metro or to wash your hands after riding it , very dirty and you might encounter some homeless people ridding it. Eric gives very clear explanations to arrive to the place and the check out is easy. The WiFi is good , take in count this is a basement apartment  and you won’t have any view of New York , the place is clean and confortable .

Great little apartment for two people on a week vacation. VERY clean. Neighborhood was very quiet at night. Great location near the subway. A few things to note (but weren't worth taking off a star for):  1. Shower stream is very small. Not a water pressure issue, just a very small head. 2. No deadbolt on the door, door lock/jamb feels weak. Also got a key to an outer gate but it's broken and won't shut. We never felt unsafe, but people unfamiliar with bigger cities might. 3. As noted in other reviews, steam heaters make noise. We weren't bothered by this as we've lived in apts like this before but if you're one of those people who needs absolute quiet to sleep probably not the best place for you in the colder months. I wish there was a thermostat just for the apt but that would probably require some remodeling/wiring.   Overall very happy with the place and if we come back to the area again we'd look to stay here again.

My two cousins and I stayed at kayMaries place for 6 nights and it was a wonderful experience. It was a last minute trip and she was able to accommodate us pretty well. She met us at the house with they keys showed us around, her husband was very nice as well, the Tvs even came with hulu and Netflix. Closet space was great and everything was clean just like the pictures, probably even better ! She even left us a bottle of wine and our favorite chocolates. She made sure we were okay by offering fresh towels and told us if we need anything she lives close by so don't be afraid to ask. Overall our experience at this house was great.

The place is clean and warm, however the area where the house is located is not very good, in fact a little dangerous. Kay was attentive to the things we needed and provided us with things we needed during the stay.

My stay could have gone better, but unfortunately, I felt uncomfortable throughout the stay. Indeed, I recommend this accommodation to no European!  Lack of good manners and a lot of discrimination. In fact, the other resident roommates did not respect anything, they had all the rights which gives a bad image to this accommodation.   They smoked joints and perfumed the whole house, had parties with their friends until late at night, did not respect my sleep or my privacy by letting their friends sleep in the living room, never did the cleaning, left the dishes unwashed for days and days, I had to wash them myself to use the utensils, bathroom the same, they did not wash behind their passages leaving their hair everywhere and the living room in bulk with food everywhere. (this with proof on photo)  I found several cockroaches in my room, and there are missing curtains on the windows facing other accommodation. AND of course I am prohibited from doing the same thing (receiving friends). Did what I told you, but don't do what I do. Big lack of equality, of understanding, I am outraged this accommodation is too expensive for what it is.  (One evening, the host waited for me to come home and lie down on the sofa in the dark to see if I would bring friends? What? Super sneaky! Without saying a word, whereas the day before, he told me that he would come in 2 days and that he would let me know. That scared me, I just wanted my stay to end) Note that not bringing your friend back is not indicated in the rules. Here are the rules: I ask that you treat my house as if it were your own house. No eating outside the kitchen or on the furniture, cleaning up after yourself, No smoking in the apartment, and no extremely loud music.   Having already paid I had no choice but to submit and wait for the end of the stay. Their attitudes do not correspond to European culture   On the positive side, the room was spacious and plenty of storage! A renovated, designer and vintage apartment! Metro 2 and 6 are 7 minutes' walk away, 30 minutes from Manhattan, grocery stores nearby. Shops 10 minutes walk away, laundromat 2 minutes away.  Conclusion: the area is a bit scary at night, you have to be careful. And the price of the apartment is way too expensive for the location. Regulations must be applied for everyone (regardless of their origin) for the good cohesion of community life. OPINION from a French woman

I had a great time staying at Shannon's place. He's a great host and made his place open and comfortable for me. I would recommend his place to anyone looking to have a great time in NYC, it was my first time visiting the city, but I felt safe and welcomed. He also responded to my messages and questions fairly quickly. I booked his place last minute and was a bit scared of cutting it too close to my arrival, but he was helpful and extremely fast at responding and helping me get settled in.

What can I say - the price is unbeatable for NYC. Only takes about 20 min to Times Square & Manhattan. Great connections. The apartment is spacious. Area seems a bit shady/dodgy at first (especially when you arrive at night), but had no real problems. However, the host (Eric) seems a bit standoffish. Quick no nonsense introduction of the place and basically makes clear you won't really see him again. Place could be a bit cleaner (we found hairs on mattress & bathtub). And the entrance to the apartment was often found filthy from some plastic bottles & cups thrown over the fence. Host could have picked this up during the week we stayed there. Gatekeeping door to apartment is broken. Would be cool, if it were fixed, to feel a bit safer.

This was an amazing place to stay. The place was clean and beautiful. The amenities such as controlling light fixtures through Alexa was perfect. It enhanced our stress free, relaxing vacation. The host was awesome. We were so close to the local transportation which made it easy to get to and from midtown. Anytime I come back to the city I will definitely be requesting to stay here.

What I thought would be a great stay based on the reviews he had from other people was 7 mins of panic. The host wanted me to get off the phone his vibe was scary terrifying demeanor was off and he met me at the door of the basement apartment with a can atleast 20oz and a roll of paper towel blocking the doorway I asked was there anything else he said yes he was waiting for me to get off the phone all type of emotions ran thru head in those seconds I WAS IN FEAR OF MY LIFE!!!! He saw I was checkin by MYSLEF my boyfriend was on his way I asked if I can finish the call outside but my intentions was leave n run n dnt come back he agreed to give me a full refund a few moments after but I still called Airbnb support team to report this situation I’ve never encountered a moment like this before LADIES IF YOU BOOK THIS SPACE DO NO GO ALONE!!! Have a man with you! Neighbors over heard my conversation about the encounter and they described to me how the man looked and told me they did not like the man clearly he gives a negative energy to his neighbors please be alert

Eric's place is just as pictured. Although when entering the house, the outside area was a bit scary going down the steps (kind of reminded me of a ditch) and the window on the door that allowed you to see directly inside. I'd also reccomend a lock on the gates to make guest feel safer. But its Very spacious and well put together. I will say that the deck may need a powerwash. to get rid of the webs and dust and maybe cut the trees a little. There was also a bit of an ant and nat problem so be sure not to leave any smell goods foods, or snacks out. The king size bed was a plus as it was huge and extremely comfortable. You will get a VERY DETAILED tour during check-in so be sure to pay attention. Other than that, the place was great and I'd definitelystay again.
Clean, organized, no disturbances. Just the down stair homes was lil scary for me since I never been to New York.

Me and my mom stayed here for her birthday trip to NYC. We had a fantastic time! The pictures are super accurate, this place is so cute. I couldn’t see more than 3 people staying here as it’s really great for 2 people. The bedroom was super spacious and very quiet. We didn’t hear anything at night. The mattress was very comfortable as well. We were able to login to our Netflix and we watched that on the couch each night after a day/night out in NYC. We did walk back from a bar a few blocks away at night one of the nights. It’s a little bit of a sketchy area, but super well lit. I felt safe for the most part. Also be ware that you do have to bring your luggage up to the 4th floor as there is no elevator. Which was okay for us. I would definitely recommend this place for your stay in NYC!
Great little place! Slightly sketchy area but the place is clean and fresh looking. We slept 4 no problem, the only real struggle are the steep stairs but we’re probably just out of shape

the instructions for the smartlock were incredibly vague. once you attempt more than 3 or 4 times, the system will lock on you and you’re stuck outside. luckily, my friend was inside so I could call her to open the door but imagine if she wasn’t. it was late at night, in the south bronx.. thats a dangerous situation to be stuck outside in the middle of the night. next, the smell isn’t very pleasant and if you’re wearing white socks, expect them to be black after just 5 minutes of walking around. lastly and most importantly, one of the beds, specifically the bed I used was very poorly put together. I sat on my bed and the thing collapsed backwards making me hit my head on the headboard. upon taking a closer look, you could see that there were screws missing. i informed the host to which he replied that he would send someone to fix it. no one came and i had to sleep on the floor. now the host is attempting to charge me for damages. save yourself the headache, don’t stay here. not safe.

This space is very clean, orderly, and in a nice area right across from Central Park. The apartment itself is well-maintained and the building lobby is in pristine shape. I enjoyed my stay for the most part, with some key features being the incredibly comfortable bed and high-pressure shower head. It was very convenient how close the apartment is located to a train station, bike station, and within walking distance of Columbia University, Harlem, and the Upper West Side. However, it is important to note that this is not the safest area at night, especially near the train station (2 blocks away), where we experienced verbal harassment from a homeless person nearby. I want to emphasize that this is by no fault of the host, but it was part of my experience that felt necessary to share. While traveling in NYC, I recommend bringing some pepper spray or any self-defense tools to mitigate any risk when using public transportation at night.   My only complaint has to do with the difficulty in unlocking the door to the apartment. The lockboxes to get the apartment keys are hidden in plain site, but the instructions to unlock the apartment door were difficult to follow, as the door handle does not turn and you must push the door forward. It was also unclear whether guests should use the deadbolt, as there is no key provided to unlock it. In both nights that we had stayed, we had to knock on the door and wake up the other guest to unlock the deadbolt, as we could not do it ourselves and there was no clear indication or sign on the door whether we should or should not use it.   In all, I recommend this place if you are staying in New York City and want a convenient place near Central Park and the train station, but the less-than-ideal entry process definitely impacted my stay.

It was a great stay the apartment looked just like the photos. It was located in an okay area plenty of Asian based restaurants, shops, and culture everywhere. Check in instructions were perfect. The door to enter the apartment was very hard to open and not secure at all felt very unsafe at night. Overall 6/10. Jason was great.

Me and my 21 yo daughter stayed here for a long weekend (12/9/22).  Melissa was an awesome host!  Always responsive within a few minutes.  The apartment was just as the pictures show - nothing fancy at all, but everything you need. The Manhattan skyline is quite visible from the balconies, the kitchen area was great, and the beds were super comfy.   We uber’d from LGA right to the apt building door and it was a 10-15 min ride ($16) We got in after dark on a Thursday.  It’s not the best lighting at night, we couldn’t see the numbers on the building too good at first, but getting into the building was very easy.  We never felt unsafe walking, even after dark.  The police station is a short block from the apartment and on the way to the subway (2 blocks away). Getting to Manhattan by subway is super easy.  Also, you can experience Astoria in about a 15 min walk.  You must go to Brooklyn Bagels! The bagels are huge and it smells heavenly when you walk in the door!

Everything was very good, clean, comfortable, just as seen in the photos, we arrived early and they kept our suitcases, quick response time, it is a little far from the subway, but you can walk or take the bus, very close to JFK airport, far from Manhattan, you should be careful if you arrive after 11 pm, it can be a dangerous neighborhood to walk at that time
The room was not ready at all. The front desk was new and unprepared. To make matters worse, the host tried to scam me of $350. Tried charging my card 7 times after I checked out. Do not book here.
Great location clean apt no stress good comfort. Had fun

Great location & good value on a quiet street. We did come back once and there was a homeless person digging in the trash right outside our window but he was non threatening. Would def stay there again.

I have mixed feelings on this booking. The apartment was very clean and in a great location very near to public transportation in central Harlem. The host sent me a lot of information and E-Mails with house rules we had to acknowledge beforehand. We were not able to see her directly. We picked up the keys through a lock outside of the apartment. We were told that other people would also be there in the apartment but haven’t heard or seen anyone. However, we used the flat in a normal way and received a message about problems on our cleanliness. I only left a small, closed trashbag and I hung some wet clothes in the bathroom since there was no possibility to hang wet clothes somewhere else.  As that was in the middle of our trip, I was irritated by that. Normally, the cleanliness is checked after people check out.  Furthermore, there was a surveillance camera in the shared living room. I noticed that the host often sent messages to check on us. We did not feel good and felt spied out. Especially, because of one of her rules that says we are not allowed to open the door or answer anyone on the question of who we are. As mentioned in another review, there is an irritating sign outside of the apartment saying “No AirBnb, persons entering for this purpose will be charged with trespassing”.  I guess the hosts messages you several times a day to check if their landlord sees the airbnb activity. This must also be the reason for the camera.  Although the contact with the host was good and I liked the cleanliness of the apartment and its location, the stay felt unpleasant. You constantly had to worry about persons appearing in front of your door and about being involved in potential problems. The mattress and the pillows are very thin and uncomfortable. The cooler does not cool. The equipment seems to be the cheapest available. It also has only one chair at the breakfast table.  To sum up Advantages:  price, location, cleanliness, organisation of check in and check out Disadvantages:  Strict surveillance, possible legal problems, extremely thin uncomfortable mattress

I don't have the words to describe this scam.  If I had to start with the only quality of the apartment it is that it is located at a metro entrance which quickly connects to Central Park. We cannot deny that.  As for the rest, and to build on it: Video instruction sent 10 minutes before arrival. Impossible to watch with city wifi. We had to find a way to get into the stairwell in order to have access to the apartment's wifi. Fortunately we arrived during the day and the neighbors were kind enough to let us in… Impossible to open the bedroom window (it is clearly written on it, please do not open it) which creates a musty smell from the first day with no possibility of ventilation.  As for the highlight of the show: When we arrived with my partner, we had the very unpleasant surprise of finding a clogged bathtub with unspeakable dirt making it absolutely impassable. Impossible to put your feet there, even with flip flops.  We instantly alerted the host who pretended to take care of it... But nothing. Each day that passed we were angry to see that we would not be able to shower one more day. We restarted it every day... To no avail! In total we spent 3 nights and 4 days washing at the tap, as best we could... after days of intense walking in New York as you can imagine!  To finish by talking about the host... Her only quality is to be rigorous about the rules of life to be respected at home, mainly about cleanliness (lol), when she does not respect her commitments herself. What a charade!  Obviously wanting compensation, we turned to the Airbnb service which was trying to contact her… In vain. Unreachable! He is a disrespectful and dishonest person completely avoiding his responsibilities while other people arrived after us (having not even taken the trouble to alert them or cancel their reservation...).  In short, you will have understood, we sincerely recommend that you find other accommodation!
Great room with it's own fridge and located close to the subway. The neighbourhood is a little sketchy at night. The AC works really well and the communication with the host was clear and perfect!

My husband and I enjoyed our stay. We got in very late and the location of the keys was not ideal and felt the neighborhood is sketchy at night. The videos Cristine provided were helpful and checking in was easy once we found the key. The building itself is very secure and we felt safe once inside the building. The pictures are very accurate and the place was clean. I recommend bringing your own pillows, the ones provided are very thin, and an extra blanket. The window unit works very well on the coldest setting and on high.  The mini fridge provided was nice for all our drinks and snacks. Towels were provided. I wish there was a bath mat for the tub instead of a raggedy towel. With multiple guests the towel didn’t soak up water so the floors stayed wet. There were other guests staying at Cristine’s at the same time as us but we hardly saw them. We loved that the subway was so close to us making it easy to get around. She is also quick to respond.  If we had to stay at Cristine’s place again we would.

Not great but not terrible. We stayed 5 nights so we were there longer than most.  The Pros:  Beds are extremely comfy, 4/5 nights were quiet, shower was great, located above a small grocery store, down the street from a liquor store, there's an elevator, Whitney was super nice and responsive and let us set our luggage inside before check-in when it rained.  The Cons: Way more than "just steps" from a subway as it was a 20 minute walk through some sketchy streets, 1 night the neighbors had a rave until 2am outside on a small roof attached to the building, apartment is very small so be prepared to have no space if you bring lots of luggage, no one empties the trash if you're there long so be prepared for overflowing trash, by the end there were a few small cockroaches emerging, area around apartment is sketchy.  The Worst: The cleaning lady came in at 9:45am the last day telling us check out was at 10am when our confirmation said 11am. We panicked and began packing hurriedly. I got engaged the night before and wanted to shower/get ready so we could take ring pics but didn't get a chance due to us being rushed by the cleaning lady. I did end up telling the lady pretty rudely that our check-out said 11am so we are going to leave by 11am, which we did.   All-in-all, don't stay longer than 1 day, pack light, bring earplugs, shoot for leaving before 10am, and prepare to walk.

Stayed here for Halloween weekend 2022.  The house itself was great.  I can tell that Wanda cares for the property, she was part way in to a couple of renovation projects when we stayed.  The house was clean, orderly, and bug free. She is an awesome communitor.  Little touches made us feel very welcome.   The neighborhood is sketchy.  I did fear for the car and wished it had parking within the property fence.  However,  if you aren't driving then this place is a great deal.

A perfect place to stay for those who look for tranquility and relax. Nice neighborhood, plenty of spots to eat. Great and breeuy connection to Manhattan by NYC ferry. 10 minutes bus ride to Fort Tilden National Recreational Area with a great endless natural beach, dunes and birds. But the beach in immediate proximity to the Cecil and Ginas place is also perfect. Surprisingly this allegedly stressful city trip has turned for us into something very different and pleasant :)

Ali place is well located, only several minutes away from metro station, you can get to downtown in 20 minutes! Also there are plenty places around his place to go for jazz music or restaurants. The only drawback here that the neibourghood seemed a bit sketchy at first but everyone was very nice around the area so we felt safe.  Ali himself was very nice host. He was always available even if away to cover all our questions. He also provided us great recommendations about the places around.   All in all we were lucky to stay at Ali place!

Place is very beautiful and quiet only problem I had was the doors. When I first left the door upstairs wasn’t closing and locking I tried multiple times. Liberty Is. Very dangerous community or Place so With the door not locking made me frightened but Everything else was great.

Our stay at raquel was nice and cozy. The place is near central park and a subway station on lexington. Raquel is available and reachable, she even offered us an umbrella for a rainy day. The down side is that we didnt knew in advance that we couldn’t use the stove/oven even tho it was working. We were not expecting high temperature for our stay and it became really humid and hot. The description wasnt really clear on what’s ours and what is to share. Note that you’re booking a room and the other commun (bathroom/kitchen/seating area) areas are shared. Considering all of that, i would come back but dont be afraid to ask question about the stove or the sharing situation.

I want my money back. I feel scammed by this host. I made the booking online for one person. The host then requested I update it for two people. When doing so the price jumped up. I immediately cancelled the booking and requested my money back. To which the host did not respond to my request! I did not stay at the bnb. The host is very inconsiderate. Poor at communication and seems to be acting as though I followed through with my stay, which I did not ! Sir give me a refund stop scamming ! He answered every message before but seems to be ignoring the cancellation! Sir get it together!

I stayed here for 2 months during Summer. This place is located in the best location in Brooklyn. The surrounding areas are safe, quite clean, less homeless, and also have good both Mexican and Chinese groceries. A is located a 4-minute walk from the 59th st subway station where I can catch up both local and express trains directly to Times Square in Manhattan.   The kitchen is exceeding my expectation. Joshua has many pots, pans, and knives of all sizes. A stove is always clean. He also provides a ton of spices that I can use.  Joshua is very friendly and nice. He stays in a room next to my room so if I need anything, I easily contact him. I felt totally comfortable staying here for 2 months :))
Andrea was so nice and welcoming. It was my first night in NYC and it came with no hassle or stress the place was exactly what i needed for a night. She was a great host
Andrea was so sweet and nice. She made sure that everything was set up nice and stress free. Would def book with her again

The location is outstanding (easy access to subway, tons of restaurants including the famous Clinton st bakery, safe to walk at night), Olga is very nice and communicative, and if you don’t have any issues with your knees and can climb five sets of stairs, this place is an absolute steal for the price and location. If I come back to nyc, would definitely stay here again.

Andrea and her place was even better than advertised and I can't stress enough what an incredible location it was in! Walking distance to numerous subway lines and tourist destinations. Single train journeys ~ 10-20mins to the financial district, midtown, central park and Brooklyn. I could walk to Chinatown bars as well as Soho and Nolita dining and shopping, and even walked back from across the Brooklyn Bridge!   Andrea herself was very friendly, caring and always ready to help. Gorgeous furnishings, great bathroom (the shower was lovely!) and a very comfortable bed. If you want an authentic experience living in the lower east side I couldn't recommend this place enough. I would 100% stay again and really hope to do so in the near future :)

Four people (family members) decided to rent this room, we were tourists in NY, the bathtub was clogged and we were NOT able to bathe, very unpleasant and as an exhausted tourist after walking, it was worse!!!!! The room needs a lot of maintenance. Good location. But terrible services, internet only 01 cell phone could connect to WIFI. Sofa bed in very poor condition.

Very clean, newly remodeled, spacious 3 bedroom 2 bathroom. Walking distance to subway. The area around the property was quiet and well kept. The subway station is easy to get to but a little sketchy at night. I would stay again. Communication was great and check in was easy.

Very spacious and clean. It's also located very close to the subway station and a few food spots. Was skeptical about the area at first, but one day was all it took to change that. Felt safe and secure for the five days i was there and the host was one of the most kindest and considerate persons I've ever met. He let me check in early, he secured packages i had delivered there, and he went out of his way when I accidentally left a very expensive watch outwice. I notified him about it when I had left, and he immediately went there to secure it for me. I highly recommend this place. The accommodations made my first stay in New York stress free!

Raheem’s home is beautiful and immaculately decorated in a modern style. The luxurious private bathroom is such a steal in the nyc market. The shower is rainforest style. Would definitely stay here again! Deep in Brooklyn but the train station is about a 10 minute walk away. Also a residential area so parking was so easy.

Pros -Cleaning service comes weekly(only to main bathroom and kitchen) -Seperate bathroom -Spacious room -AC -Communicative host  -Nice wooden flooring  -Closet has key for safekeeping  -Close to LGA airport -Amazon Lockbox right around the corner -Multiple locks so felt secure -Neighborhood relatively safe and quiet   Cons -20 minute walk from train station  -Overall commute far from Manhattan as it's the last stop on the 7 -Apartment has weird smell throughout  -Bedding did not look like the pictures and felt cheap and used -Outside of building is not aesthetically pleasing and looks sketchy -No toilet paper, toiletries or towels provided -Room was very dusty including vents so this affected my sinuses  -Tenant directly above has a dog that runs around often as they play with it. You can hear the ball bouncing on roof.  -Room is way too empty and could use some type of entertainment  -Shower is a bit complicated to use -Shower had hair in it upon arrival  -No locks on door is pretty creepy considering you are living with strangers.   Overall it was okay for those on a budget.

Honestly, couldn’t have been happier with our place. It was a great little space that was way bigger than I anticipated! Rooms were spacious. Living area was perfect. Kitchen was beautiful (with amazing little snacks and drinks). The star was the back patio. Spacious. Beautiful. Perfect for our wind downs from exploring the near by shops and sights! Also a perfect place for our little bean to run around and get some energy out before bed. Highly recommend. Hope to visit again. And visit soon! My suspicion is it’ll be hard to rent again, because it is a completely perfect space and once the word is out it’s going to be always booked. Thank you to our host! Everything exceeded our expectations!

Location for this apartment is really good - can walk everywhere (if anyone hasn't warned you yet, NYC requires a lot of walking!). The check in process was really smooth. It's a small apartment - there's no denying that. I probably wouldn't recommend any more than 3 people stay here - depending on the setup!  Temperature: This apartment is really hot. There are exposed pipes on both sides of the apartment that let out a lot of heat (as in, having fans on during the winter in NYC). I'm sure this could be sorted.  Safety: There are small slabs of carpet on the steps up to the bedrooms that seemed pretty dangerous to us - they were not attached meaning you could easily slip and fall.   Overall - it's a good apartment but temperature and safety seem to be number one here.

We had a great time here! It was in walking distance to many of Manhattan’s attractions. Having two beds was great and the space was cozy. Our only issue was the stairs going up to the lofts was a little steep and felt somewhat unsafe. But as long as you’re careful it’s not a big issue. Overall it was a good experience and we would recommend others to stay here.

This is a really nice apt, in a perfect location. My daughter and I had great expection for this holiday. However, the central heating doesn't work during my stay. We surprisingly found the apt cold while first walked in. The maintenance team provide extra electronic heaters and warmer blanket, but still this brought us inconvenience at the first place. Then the next day something was wrong with the remote control for the window shade--we stayed for two nights uncomfortably exposed (higher tower right next to this apt building and several windows can watch us from above).  These are all surprises which can be not known beforehand. At such price, we could find a nice hotel without worrying these problems--something can be fixed or we can change rooms.
Nice host whom helped very quickly. House was clean and complete. Location feels somewhat shady, but no indicents happened.

This spot is clean and in a convenient location. Its a little small and a little cluttered but it was so comfortable and calming. I love the high ceilings especially in the bathroom. The A train and every store and restaurant you could possibly need located walking distance around the corner on fulton.  People traveling at night should be aware that there is a homeless shelter in the area therefor there are some individuals with mental health who seemingly wander on the block however I had no issues. I would stay here again. The host made the process easy and seamless. Cool spot
Amazing loft very clean and the pics are accurate I know a lot of people are scared because the pictures so t match the place most of the times but it’s not like that in this case it’s spot on

in photos it shows red couch and a cute coffee station, LIE It’s a staged photo it’s not in the apartment at all,  The smell that hit us when we opened the door was so HORRIBLE of musty sweat it was so unbearable we had to leave all windows open for an hour (35 degree weather) Caked on mud and sticky dirt on floors Yellow brown filthy shower curtain  Quarter of a bottle of body wash already open  No hand towels but they leave two towels for a two bedroom 4 person stay? One towel was as if they just rolled it and never washed it it was stale  I think blood smeared on the wall in the one bedroom where my spouse and I stayed in,  THE SHEETS SMELT AND STAINED I DONT THINK THEY ARE WASHED  they just make the bed it was so bad we had to try to grab them from the other bed and it didn’t help We only stayed 4 hours cuz THERE IS NO PARKING NO STANDING SIGNS EVERYWHERE. We checked in at 3am left at 7am due to parking infront of fire hydrant the only spot left DONT STAY HERE ITS A SLUM SCAM

The only good thing I can say about this accommodation is the location, it is well located, the rest is terrible, the cleaning is terrible, sheets, towels, floors, dirty bathrooms, full of dust, the smell of marijuana and cigarettes was horrible, no garbage bags, no soap, the towels were dirty and smelled like they were used by someone else. It was really extremely unpleasant. I wrote to the host about it and never received a response from him. The truth is, I was very dissatisfied with this accommodation, it was not what they show in the photos.

Belisa was a great host and her spot was exactly as advertised.  She was very responsive to all my questions and I was able to easily get in touch with her (even weeks before my actual trip).   The location is great and you’re not short of options of places to eat/drink as soon as you leave the door.    It’s not a dealbreaker, but good to be aware you have to walk down some stairs to get to the unit (no elevators). At no point did it ever feel unsafe so it wasn’t an issue for me.  Thanks again Belisa!

A lovely ground floor apartment in a quiet neighbourhood with lots of nice restaurants and bars. The beds were very comfortable and with the windows closed and the AC on, it was a quiet nights sleep. The biggest draw is the garden, which is as magical as it looks, with fresh herbs and even grapes! Aliza lives upstairs, and on hand if you need her. I appreciated the use of the laundry without any restrictions. The only drawback for me was that there wasn’t enough natural light, the living area itself has no windows and the bedrooms are not bright enough to pull the light in. I suspect this is a downside to two bedroom ground floor flats in the brownstones more generally. Having the garden helped, it was sunny so I sat outside mainly. Prepare to be bitten though, I was grateful for the bug spray provided but I needed something a little stronger! It’s a 13 minute walk to the A train and 15 minutes to the J. Fine if you are spending the day in Manhattan. It definitely felt like a safe neighbourhood and very diverse and vibrant. Definitely check out Stuy Burgers for the best burgers we’ve ever had and the nicest owner. It was one of a few black owned businesses in the area. I’d also recommend Bed Vyne for cocktails.

Christina was a great host! If you had any questions, you could always contact her both before and during your stay.  I was provided with lots of tips such as nice cafés or shopping opportunities, train connections and insider information. A big compliment to you Christina, I'll be happy to come back.  P.S.: the great view of the Manhattan skyline is also a huge plus.  You can get to Manhattan in no time by subway or tram - great location and a little quieter in the evenings. But by no means unsafe, I always felt safe. Thanks again and hopefully see you soon! :)

This was my first trip to the United States, it was my first trip to New York.  And it was also my first contact with American culture in everyday life.  First, Candice: Candice, this is not a PERSON, oh no… !!!!!  She is an EXPERIENCE!!! If in your life you had a best friend from high school, with whom you lost regular contact for random reasons, but decided to visit her in her new city.  This person is Candice.   The first minutes of contact give you the impression: "God, we haven't seen each other for so long, and I think she say bye yesterday and close the door to the classroom”.   About Candice, you can write a book.   And I think it would be a BESTSELLER.  Apartment:  When you comes to an apartment / room.  This star scale does not include Candice and Rob.  These are some cosmic values.  You are staying in an ultra-clean, comfortable, art-filled apartment.   MoMA ???  Pffff…. Please…..  Super comfy bed, beautiful NY-style bathroom.  It is a place where you feel safe and you can rest.   Area:  close to everything, two metro stops, great Italian and Asian restaurants.  Great shops, if you want to send postcards, the post office is also nearby.  After a week in NYC, I was sad to leave Candice's for another guests (jealousy).   I hope to come back to NYC someday and have this great opportunity to meet such dies wonderful people.   Advice for you traveler:  Listen to what Candice "recommends", she knows what ist the best for you and what your soul and mind need.

Staying with Candice, Rob and Tallulah is like living in the most magical movie happening in an artistic loft in Nolita/Soho Manhattan. It’s fair to say it’s one of the best decisions I made for myself this year.  Candice falls within the 0.01% of humankind who has the magic to transform people’s life in a fantastic way. All the new towels, toothbrushes, shampoo, great neighborhood and quiet room you might see mentioned in other guest’s comments are only small parts of what Candice offers to her guests. The wisdom, life attitude and the community she and Rob created are something really, really special. She takes pride in spreading joy, happiness and love. I would confidently say that she transformed my life in a positive way.   Staying with her means that you will know where the coolest parties, best restaurants and fun things to do in New York are. If you are traveling from another city, you will be instantly connected to the NYC vibe with the events Candice will send to you; if you are living in NY and want to find a gateway place to rest, Candice will help you look at New York with a fresh eye.   She made my stay so special, filled with joy, care, surprises and encouragement. I would give a 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 stars to her home if I could. She is the perfect example of how the finest human, artist and a New Yorker could be. Definitely will come back again and recommend Candice’s place to all my dear friends!   Thank you Candice, Rob and Tallulah for everything and the great memories!

Not only will you not regret booking this lovely huge room in Candice’s and Rob’s NYC Art loft but you will likely immediately think about coming back the second you leave…More than just a perfect stay for an outstandingly comfortable sleep in a pristine clean home, there is a lot of amazing energy in it with gorgeous paintings and sculptures very tastefully arranged in this art welcoming space where Rob paints chef d’œuvres day and night. The world needs more kind, chill, cool and charming people and if they happen to also be your Airbnb hosts, know that you are lucky and that your  stay will be inspiring on top of being extremely pleasant.

This is a pretty good Airbnb.   Pros: - There is a room in the basement to store a bike! No need to lock up outside to feel unsafe. This was a major major plus. - The location in Bushwick was ideal for our needs. There is a Deli right across the street. Quiet neighborhood. Short walk from two trains (L and M). - Julia was extremely attentive and good about communication, instantly. It was very much appreciated that we could reach out with any questions and expect a response within 20 minutes max. - Easy check in with keypad codes for the building door as well as apt. door. Felt safe.   Cons: - Although the bedroom has a window, it is directly underneath a very bright outdoor floodlight. Julia was thoughtful enough to put up a thick curtain, however, the curtain rod is sagging so light still seeps through, making it hard to get to sleep. - There are no chairs to sit at at the kitchen table - No coffee machine so we had to buy all our coffee (though, there are abundant bodegas all around)  Other: - The decor is very cold, clinical, without character. It looks and feels like your average, sterile Airbnb, and is totally out of place with the rest of the neighborhood.

Airbnb has two rooms, we stayed in the room with the bathroom inside, very small room but has everything you need. The bed is comfortable. 1 pillow was ok, the other felt like a sheet of paper. The apartment has a good kitchen, the apartment is very beautiful and well decorated. The big problem is the region, the neighborhood is dirty and appears to be dangerous for travelers traveling alone... Julia is friendly and allowed check-in an hour before. A great value for money for those who don't care about location.  Thank you Júlia for your stay.

My stay at Candice's was truly wonderful. She accommodated me from the moment I booked from suggesting places to go, being more than welcoming when I arrived to constantly making sure I had everything I needed whilst there. it was a dream to stay with Candice, Rob and Tallulah. the apartment was incredible with stunning art everywhere and all the little extra bits such as slippers, beauty products and breakfast made me feel super comfortable.  the location is amazing with easy access to all of Manhattan and Brooklyn. I would highly recommend staying here, just perfect!

Had an amazing stay at Candice's. Candice and Rob are amazing people with a lot of warmth and hospitality.  Candice was incredibly helpful throughout the stay with all her recommendations. Rob is incredibly friendly and all his artwork at the apartment adds a unique charm to the place. Talulah is the icing on the cake. One of the friendliest pets I've ever met in my life!  The apartment is incredible, nicely located and exactly what you would expect from all the pictures if not more. Would definitely recommend this place for anyone wishing to be in NYC! You will have a great experience.

Candice and Rob have a unique way of making their place feel like home. Candice has a warm and welcoming energy, Rob is super friendly, and Tallulah is always ready to get her ball and play fetch, and they're making want to come back very soon. The apartment is a huge loft, very clean and filled with beautiful paintings and sculptures. There's an endless supply of shampoo, towels, food and everything I could need during my stay. It's easy to get by in the city, there's 2 metro station nearby, and many restaurants in the area.

Loved staying here at Candice and Rob's loft; they are both such cool creatives. I felt welcomed and comfortable from the moment I arrived...like I was staying at an old friend's parents house for the week. I really enjoyed my conversations with them both.   There was more than enough toiletries, water, towels, and Candice even did my laundry when she really didn't have to. Partially regret not waking up early for breakfast during my stay, but if you are an early riser, the fridge will be stocked for you. Everything was also extremely clean which I very much appreciated.  If you are new to NYC, this is a great area to be in. Candice is a great guide to the best parties, shopping, and restaurants around the city.   Last but not least, Tallulah is the most adorable and playful little pomeranian! Bummed I couldn't take her with me.

Splendid Super hosts!  Want to feel special the minute you walk into your stay?  Then you couldn’t pick a better place than Rob, Candice, & Tallulah’s awesome artistic studio loft!  Candice has a talent and eye for detail in providing her guests with extra touches (I loved taking a shower and trying one of her many amenities that were provided-I loved smelling like a 🌹 after a long fun day in the city).   We enjoyed great conversation with both Rob & Candice while enjoying a few glasses of wine.  They are sincere, kind, incredibly talented, and interesting. Meeting the two of them was one of the best things we enjoyed on our trip.   Besides being super communicative, informative, clean, and helpful, we just loved the vibe of this lofty home!!  You will not be disappointed with your visit!  We can’t wait to come back and we recommend this artistry in motion loft to all our family, friends, and others who appreciate feeling like they are part of a super cool family!  Thanks a million!

Better than a hotel. Only my second time booking an Airbnb, and my goodness am I so happy I booked this one. First of all, Candice and Rob are the most kindest and sweetest people walking this Earth. The loft is just as described but if I'm being honest, the photos don't do it enough justice; it's like walking into an art gallery. Candice kept in contact my entire stay, sharing recommendations, and just making sure I was comfortable, which is most appreciated. Like I shared before I left, I've never been anywhere where I felt so at home, away from home. So for anyone looking for an amazing place to stay in NY, THIS. IS. IT! Oh....and I'd be remiss if I didn't share that the guest room actually has room to move around in. Other places describe their rooms as spacious and cozy but...ehhh not so much. But before I run out of space to write (because I can go on and on about this place), I just want to say to both of you, THANK YOU - and best believe I will be back!!! I appreciate you both.

Some beeping in the morning but otherwise a great stay for that price, especially if you split it. We arrived at 12:30 am and Casey was there to greet us. We also request last minute a third person and he got a futon ready. Very chill, stress free environment.

Cute, clean little place. The neighborhood was a little sketchy after dark but close to subways and convenient location.

Great hosts, location, and unit. Trecia was wonderful, checking in on us and responded quickly to any questions we had.  The neighborhood was wonderful and beautiful. I never felt unsafe walking even after midnight. At night everything was so silent even with our windows open.  Cool bars and music venues are walking distance.  The subway station is also about a five minute walk.  The unit itself is new, modern, well lit, and super clean.  Fully equipped kitchen.  Our stay felt like a hotel stay because the towels and linens were impeccable and soft.  Trecia even provided basic toiletries. Will definitely return.

Nice Apartment in the heart of Brooklyn and a block away from the Subway. Very Clean place and has everything you would need for a stay and not stress about packing. Very clean place. Trecia was welcoming and helped us with parking and checked on us to make sure everything was ok. Would definitely recommend.

Kim was very fast and kind with communicating, checking in was very easy. She would let us stay an hour longer at check out what was very generous.  We had plenty of towels for our 10 days stay and Kim provided plenty of consumables in the kitchen and wash room. We didn’t need to buy anything at all.  All over we had a good stay.   What we didn’t like was that the neighbors above didn’t lock the house entrance door as well as the second entrance door very often even in late night. The window in the front bedroom where the kids were sleeping could not be locked. That made us feel rather uncomfortable unsafe but of course it’s not at all Kim’s mistake or responsibility at all.   The layout of the apartment doesn’t allow for windows in the kitchen and in the rather small living room. So its rather dark there but the two bedrooms are very nice and there is enough space and hangers for all clothes.  Because of that and that in the back bedroom it is not possible to keep the window open for fresh air ( it would always fall back down), the kitchen is rather poor equipped with cooking gear and some furniture in the kitchen almost falls apart when you sit on it, I find the apartment overpriced.   Whatsoever we enjoyed the stay and when we booked there were only two 2-bedroom Appartements  left to choose from.

James‘ accommodation is ideal for a short stay. It’s a friendly and quiet neighborhood with many groceries nearby. You can reach the subway in a 10 minute walk (lines W and N at 30th Ave) which easily connects you to Manhatten in around 20 minutes.  Although the place has given me sketchy vibes at first, I will say that practically speaking there is everything you need from kitchen/bathroom equipment to reliable WiFi. The bed wasn‘t the most comfortable and the walls are thin but the rooms are spacious and fairly clean by New York standards. Check-in and -out was pleasant and James gives helpful instructions and quickly responds to your questions. Overall, it was a fair deal and I enjoyed my 2-nights stay.

Great stay! Louis was so accommodating! Let us drop our bags off early. She stocked the bathroom with toiletries and cleaning supplies. The fridge and kitchen had the basics to get you started with cooking meals. It was hot when we checked in and Louis left us a cool drink to cool down. Never felt unsafe or uncomfortable. 10/10 would stay again!

This place is a great space for a group get together. I thought we'd have issues with only having the one toilet for five girls, but it wasn't ever really a problem thankfully. Unfortunately it was a very hot weekend and it was hard to get the place to cool down the whole time we were there. There were AC units but because the layout is so large, it was hard to get it to a comfortable level. Everyone slept with their doors open to stay cool. There isn't a microwave, at least we didn't find one, so that was unfortunate because we had leftovers we had wanted to heat up but couldn't. There wasn't really a spot with good lighting to put on makeup.  The place had a smell from spices that was unpleasant but not unbearable, but you could definitely smell it when you walked through the door. We had an issue with the blinds falling down in the one room but that was taken care of quickly. The location and large space is really great and are the selling points for this house. It was walking distance to many fun places. Overall I would recommend.

Personally I didn’t have a great experience. I was unaware this was a group session. Granted I clearly didn’t read the fine print that stated this was a group session. He only reveals that this is a group session at the checkout point, which I in fact missed when I was checking out. Therefor, you only know that it’s a group shoot if you read everything when your checking out. Another detail I would like to add is that he’s well aware that a lot of people mistake this shoot for being a private shoot bc he messages each person to inform them it’s a group photo shoot. The scam he’s playing is that he waits to inform you that this is a group photo shoot till it’s nonrefundable. Meaning he waits to tell you so even if you are no longer interested he still gets to keep your money. I think how he goes about it is very sneaky and a scam  being that he obviously aware that a lot of people don’t know it’s a group shoot and that’s  why he reaches out to tell you but he doesn’t reach out until he gets to keep your money. Honestly my online experience with this man is that he’s a prime example of the scammers in New York City.

We’ve enjoyed the stay with Tian. Liked the neighborhood with abundance of places to grab sth to eat. It’s a 5 minute walk to subway 7 train which takes you straight into Midtown.  There was a big kitchen, tea, coffee and hot chocolate. The room was quite spacious and clean.  Considering all that and NYC prices it was a steal. Highly recommended!

The place looked as shown, however was not as clean. There was mould on the wall and there were items and furniture that were damaged, broken or falling apart (the toilet seat and lights were broken and the blinds fell on me and other ones were held together with plasters.  Host offered to get someone to look into it but it would be more than a days work to fix the issues.   It is advertised for 6 people, but it is in fact for 4. The sofa bed would barely turn into a bed and would just about fit 1 person, we had contacted the host about this and she was nice enough to provide bedding and duvet, however it was used, dirty and ripped.   The host was lovely and helpful where needed however I would not say this place is worth the amount it had cost.  The location is ok, a little shady and would not say is the safest of places, but subway is very close and you can commute in and out of the city fairly easily.

The location is great, but the room was tiny (not even room to open a suitcase) there is absolutely no insulation, you could hear everything that was happening in the corridor and the air conditioning made a very loud noise. Also opposite, two meters from the only window in the room, was the window of another room and we could see everything that was happening there (things that we would have liked to avoid seeing) so being opposite it was quite unpleasant.

This place was very disappointing. We received a completely different unit, then the ones shown in the pictures. I understand that this is a Hotel but I’ve seen better at Motel 6, the pictures were completely falsified. The bathroom was dirty and was not a walk-in shower, there was no view, the room was very tiny and the room REEKED of smoke and after being in there for an hour my daughter had an asthma attack. Airbnb helped us cancel this stay, I am surprised and disappointed by this. The only accurate thing is the lobby.

My wallet was stolen with my hotel key in it. When I called multiple times to ask for my hotel card to be cut I only got a voice mail and didn’t get a call back until the next day when I had already taken care of it. When I did get the card cut I asked the from desk person if they had seen anyone go upstairs that didn’t seem like they should have, he told me “I wouldn’t know, I wasn’t watching.” So that was concerning. When I asked for a late check out I was told that would be fine and that I should call the front desk the next day to have that confirmed. When I went to the front desk the next day I was told it wasn’t possible even thought the day before I was told it was. Both of those things made me unhappy with the communication and safety of hotel to a degree. Besides that everything was very nice and it was clean and relatively quiet.

First time in NY and was not happy. Space was way smaller than photos made it seem, the noise was ridiculous people were in and out slamming doors all morning every single day kids screaming. I got zero sleep our entire stay. Bathroom was so small my husband couldn’t even sit on the toilet the correct way. They wanted $5 for a cup of ice and $3 for a cup of hot water downstairs. The map was totally off on gps you couldn’t clearly see where the hotel was from the street. It was very stressful and way over priced for the deal we got. I’m disappointed I was so excited to visit NY

I recently stayed at an OYO hotel in Times Square and had a wonderful experience. The location was perfect for exploring the city and the room was clean and comfortable. But what really stood out to me was the exceptional customer service I received. On my last day, I had a late flight and the hotel was kind enough to hold my luggage for me after I checked out so I could continue to explore the city without the hassle of dragging my bags around. This gesture really made my trip that much more enjoyable and stress-free. Overall, I highly recommend this hotel and would definitely stay here again.

More like a one or two star hotel, definitely not a four star!! No amenities, no room service, super loud neighborhood and just sketchy-ness overall. We did not enjoy our stay. It was super nosey and the couple in the room next to us fought every night around 3 am where we were woken up and had to call security and the front desk to check on them. Would not recommend this place! Lots of hidden fees too!! Trust me, this hotel is not worth what you will pay.

I lived here for 3 months and came for work (travel nurse). It is a beautiful apartment, brand new, super clean and modern!! The bed was extremely comfortable!!   There were many things I had to purchase that the apartment did not have but Asi (Noomi owner) helped out to reimburse for most of it, however I still had to get a bunch more things out of pocket. The rent was extremely overpriced for the area, and for how many items I needed to purchase out of pocket.   There is a doorman at the front desk and security near the Apollo theater, which made me feel safe but the area in general is far from safe. Second week I was here there was a shooting few streets down. Harlem has a lot of crime, huge homeless population and unsafe in general. Walking to the subway, going to work, going to CVS or groceries I would get catcalled and harassed. I had to be extremely careful.   Along with this I never travel without my service dog and he did not allow me to bring mine without an additional $1,500 charge. She is extremely clean, quiet and makes no mess. Airbnb is supposed to allow service animals anywhere free of charge. I even have a doctors note. This made it difficult for me as I need her by my side. Also the building was very pet friendly as numerous people had dogs and cats there. I struggled not having my dog by my side.   Overal the building itself is nice. It has a small gym and washer/ dryer room. The people who live her are friendly and the doorman are super nice. Packages are locked and secured. City views are great!!

Syed is a great host and he has a lovely home. Beds are super comfy! He send timely automated emails with all the info you need and responds quickly to any questions. The subway is walking distance but sometimes walking on the south side (right side if towards Broadway) is crowded with people smoking and drinking. Recommend crossing street early. Then cross Broadway to walk along East side of street where restaurant are.  (Instead of hospital and Wendys were many homeless are) Broadway Pizza, Mikes Bagels, and Ramen restaurant are highly recommended!!!

The location absolutely cannot be beat! Literally steps to Central Park, and to transit.  Close to grocery and drug stores and restaurants.  Quiet, well equipped.  Our family had a great time at Mark’s place.

Great stay. The room is a steal. It’s  extremely clean, large, and very well maintained. The area could be nicer, but it was alright from my experience since i only walked to and from the subway station. I’ll definitely stay again when I’m in the area

Marina has a very clean home. Everything looked as pictured. I was comfortable in the clean bathroom (thank God!) the shower was great, clean, hot water, great shower head and space for toiletries. If I’m being nit picky the toilet paper may be tough for sensitive folks. The bed is firm which was great for me- I slept so well after walking 20,000 steps every day.  Quiet neighborhood- there was no noise at night which was awesome. I am a petite woman so coming back on the subway after 11pm on a weekday was a little scary with a few characters on the street but I walked fast and once I got to the street the place is on there wasn’t anyone to bother me.  I would highly recommend staying here and would come back again! Check in was very easy and Marina was very accommodating to my many requests. They have a little dog but I barely saw her and she never barked. They have clean filtered water and offered nespresso which was such a nice touch. There was room in the fridge for food I brought back and overall they treated me like a roommate and were very welcoming.  These guys are the standard for super hosts so great

The place was beautifully decorated and clean.  The host was nice and communicated the instructions and expectations for the stay.   Just a side note, the windows for the 2 bedrooms face the street, so you can hear noises outside when cars drive by and people talking, when passing by the window.  But if you're a heavy sleeper. that's not an issue.   Also, the stairs to go downstairs can be dangerous for kids.  There are a few steps that are more narrow on one side. I stayed with my one year old, so I had to make sure to hold his hand every time he uses the stairs.
Nice place, the pool table was fun. A little walk to public transportation but never felt unsafe.

We were 2 couples who stayed in Brianna's apartment for 9 days during our NYC visit.  Brianna always tried to fulfill our wishes and even minor problems were resolved within a very short time. We were amazed at the speed of the service! The apartment was very clean and functionally furnished. We especially loved the game room downstairs for hanging out after a long day visiting New York. The apartment is very well connected to the public transport network. In about half an hour you can be in Manhattan.   The residential area is not very attractive, but we didn't feel unsafe, even though there were quite strange birds (from the Caribbean) on the streets. There is a large police station right around the corner, which probably kept really bad guys away. We were never harassed or threatened. The people in the neighborhood were friendly.  We would book with Brianna again at any time, especially since the center of Brooklyn is very charming and the view of Manhattan from the Brooklyn Hights is magnificent.

Rachel was very kind, accomdating and commutative. This was my first ever time using Air Bnb and the experience was incredible. I'm very glad this was my first experience.   We ended up arriving very late in the night, she was very understanding of that, and made everything completely stress free! she was also very accommodating with my cat and provided him with some resources so I didn't have to bring even more down with me!   She also provided some amazing local recommendations and helped me out with parking, letting me know where to and not to park (I drove down). She was also very honest, which I really respected!  Now regarding the location, it's right in the center of Brooklyn so its a very good place if you're visiting to head down into the city or long Island. the drive into Long Island from her place is very smooth, only about 30/45 minutes depending on where you're heading, and it is not too far from  495 or the northern state! Making travel to Long Island very easy!+

Thanks to Kang and his cohost. They made us comfortable. Because the entry door and room had code we could check in whenever we wanted and that was really great for us. They were completely available on Airbnb for texting. I liked it. The place was clean. Just in the room there is no mirror. About location it was far from Manhatan . My friends told me it’s not safe neighborhood but I didn’t feel anything. It might be a little bit scary if you are alone and come in the middle of the night, otherwise it’s ok. I recommend it.

Great flat, slight confusion with the bed and rooms description however Garcia was able to respond quickly. The area itself is quite sketchy and there were loud parties going on outside during our stay.

Beautiful and spacious apt. Very clean and great for a family group. Garcia was a very communicative and responsive host! The free street parking was never available though, and it was stressful trying to figure out where to park, especially for my family who had never been to the city. We ended up parking at a garage about a mile away. Other than that, it was a great stay, I would recommend! Loved the neighborhood and close proximity to public transport.

My girlfriend and I stayed here for three days and loved it! She is deploying for 6 months and this is our last vacation before she leaves, and  Khayah took the time to set up balloons and bake her cookies as a goodbye gift! It made our trip super special!!  I would say if you’re going to stay here, make sure you’re comfortable with other guests staying as well. There were always other people staying, but everyone was super friendly and stays to themselves unless they’re using the kitchen to cook. It’s about a 15 minute walk to the subway, which isn’t bad at all but after a long day exploring New York, is a little tiring! Subway rides into Manhattan aren’t long at all, the longest one we took was 36 minutes and that was all the way to Central Park. Just a little tip, if the subways confuse you, go to go ogle maps and type in where you want to go it will give you step by step directions on how to navigate the subways (it was the only way my girlfriend and I could figure out how to get around).  Khayah replies super quickly to any questions or concerns you might have and she’s honestly the sweetest person so don’t be afraid to reach out!! House was clean, beds were comfy… I would definitely stay here again!!
The neighborhood is a bit sketchy.  No stores, food/coffee places near. The apartment is in the basement with very little light.

Everything was great, the place was clean and very comfy. Big rooms, two clean bathrooms and comfortable beds. The only comment I  have is that the neighborhood was kind of scary at night but nothing happend so it was ok and it is really close to the metrostation that can take you to Manhattan in 30 minutes.  Kay was very kind
Great place at a great value. We did see a mouse which was unpleasant but all else was great. Michael is a through communicator and always responds promptly.

Didn’t even get to stay at Success’ place because she cancelled while I was already outside of the apartment. She knew she would possibly have to cancel the reservation since the day before but she didn’t bother giving me a heads up. I would’ve like to known that there was a chance we might not be able to stay at apartment as soon as she found out. But instead she waited until the day of lol. Disappointed. But we couldn’t find parking anyways and the area did look a little sketchy so I guess everything happens for a reason.

Good affordable place close to Metro and a nice market around the corner. Night time seems a little sketchy but this was my first trip to New York City and the Bronx. Not sure what I should have expected. Felt secure staying here and riding in and out of the metro late into the evening.

The apartment is on the ground floor at street level and has many humidity problems that make it have a very unpleasant strong smell when you enter the house. Due to the dirt on all the windows when we tried to open them, it is clear that they never ventilate the rooms, that they cleaned and mopped the floor without opening the windows. In general, the apartment was very poorly cleaned. When we arrived we had to tell the host to come and change some sheets that were full of hair, and the bathtub was dirty and full of ants. We didn't need to use the kitchen, but the hob and fridge were really dirty. We only had one towel per person and we were going to stay for four days. Just the right toilet paper. The views from each of the windows were dirty places full of old furniture with broken wood, etc. The wooden floor in one of the rooms is broken and sunken, there were very dirty carpets in some rooms. The host answered us quickly and tried to find solutions, but the apartment does not allow quick solutions, it needs cleaning by someone who does it methodically and conscientiously and some investment.

The area is a little sketchy, the outside of the house is very poorly kept, missing window curtain panes, the remotes to the tv are very slow, and overall the house has a funky smell to it, which they try to disguise with air fresheners in every room. The host was very responsive but the house is just old, I would definitely not recommend this house nor would ever want to stay in q place like this eve again.
Bolivar is very friendly and responsive. Great price and honestly a steal very grateful for the price for my first visit to nyc.

Just one word „PERFECT“  If you are looking for the perfect Airbnb experience, search no more, you will find it here.   We have stayed 9 days in New York City and we always felt like home.  Jake and Catie are very nice and welcoming hosts and their dog Edison has such a lovely character. If you have any questions or need help, they will do their very best.  You will have your own beautiful spacious room on the 3rd floor and also your own modern bathroom. The bed and the mattress are so comfortable and we always slept like babies. And believe us, you will need your sleep after a long and stressful day exploring the big city ; )  Jackson Heights is in our opinion one of the best neighborhoods in New York. We often came home after dark and always felt safe here. If you are a Foodie you will enjoy your time here.  There are so many different restaurants with so much good food from different cultures.  We thank you so much for your hospitality and our nice trip to NYC.  We hope that we will meet again some day =)  Take care and best regards from Germany Eva and Andreas

Aaron was very helpful, and a great communicator. He provided us with thoughtful snacks upon arrival. However, the unit is not as advertised. The back yard was not usable, the front entry was unkept and un-swept with open garbage cans and a rat that greeted us.  The unit doesn't have a coffee maker, blow dryer or  luggage stand in bedroom. The bed was comfortable but didn't have a top sheet, just bottom sheet and comforter. The bathroom walls were not clean. The neighborhood and adjacent building was a bit sketchy. The unit was not worth the money but has a lot of potential if given significant TLC.

I am a successful business owner. I support local. It’s important to me to support an AIR BNB host rather than a big corp chain. I at time travel alone and am unaware of what to expect when booking.   For the affordable price I was open to experience any type of scenario.   Frankly, God knew I needed a homey stay, while in NY for biz. I was blown away by the cleanliness of Mrs Frans home. From the security (of safety on locks on doors), to amenities ranging from microwave, coffee maker, blender, towels shampoo, soap, flushable wipes, wifi all that you can think of she has. I felt right at home.   I had a tough flight coming in and she immediately helped me settle in. I was able to converse w her and fit right in. She to me is a “SUPER HOST” , she went ABOVE and BEYOND all air bnb expectations. I THANK HER SO MUCH for allowing me to feel safe and stress free while at her home. She is unlike any other host. And for that I encourage you to invest in your peace energy finances and safety    Affordable and luxurious all in one.   I WILL RETURN!   Thank you for allowing me a safe haven away from home.   -Leslie Z Ramirez owner of HOUSE OF RAMIREZ

Honestly, there is absolutely nothing negative about my stay what Julius could have changed. He was very flexible with check in and check out. He helped me out with dropping my stuff earlier without hesitation. Literally everything is taken care of; unlimited coffee and tea, laundry detergent, toilet paper, netflix, you name it. He is a great guy and definitely one of the best hosts I’ve had.  The only thing I struggled with is that though there is a window in the bedroom ( I stayed in room 1) because of the building next to it, there is no sunlight coming in. But like a said at first, this is not something Julius could have fixed for me.   Obviously it’s in Harlem. So do with that info what you want haha. I was completely fine with the vibe but preferred to go outside with someone after dark. Never really felt unsafe though.  Please don’t book here, I’d like to come back soon.

me and my partner stayed here for a month and we felt very comfortable and at home, our room was very spacious - looks exactly like the pictures. bathroom is nice and very convenient. only downside is that we saw a few bugs in our private room/bathroom so just be wary of that. we never really had an issue with any of our items being stolen or damaged. our privacy was well respected. yang is very helpful and responsive, :) shes a super chill host and she keeps the house pretty clean which is nice. you also get access to the balcony if that room is free. overall very lovely host and home. next to lots of convenient stores and delis. plus right across the street is the bus stop, and its around a 10-15 minute walk to the 7 station.

I would have used a lower number or a negative number for communication if there was an option. Communication from the hosts was unacceptable. My request for accommodation for a promised late departure was handled with accusations I was lying. When we wanted more than 4 mugs for 7 people I was asked if the mugs had been broken. We had a bathroom with a non functioning sink for the entire stay and we were told it was a minor issue and we could wash we could clean up in the other bathroom or the kitchen. Lastly they accused us of stealing something that was mistakenly packed into one of our suitcases. The communication from Bianca is full of naming calling, I did not feel safe continuing to engage her. I am sure that if you have no requests or concerns you can have a very wonderful stay here. The apartment is in a great location. It is very bare bones but comfortable except there is really no place for a group to gather and visit.  Cooking for a larger group was a bit of a challenge.  The neighborhood felt safe and is fun and interesting.

Location/ neighbourhood: 3/10  Homeless people walking around, hard working people love to drink beer on porches and staring at visitors. It is ok in the morning, afternoon, but it was scary to come out after sunset…   The good part of that apartment is nicely build kitchen and thats is it. I mean bedrooms are fine too, but because of window AC unit your window is basically always open and you can hear every word people saying outside. Also you will hear tour neighbours from first floor. Soundproof is bad…
A steal of a place! Plenty of room, very clean, and a gorgeous view of Sunset Park. Our hosts were extremely professional and responded to us in timely matters. Could not recommend enough!
Lovely apartment - has 2+ AC units so that’s amazing for summer. He was super nice and overall made our trip to NYC way less stressful!
Great location! Literally at the center of Big apple. Host responses within minutes. Nothing unpleasant.😃

Natalie’s place was the great! The location is perfect. It’s about a 5 minute walk to time square and easy access to the subway station. Each bedroom has an AC unit which turned out to be a life saver! The area outside  is a bit sketchy at night and there’s very little outdoor lighting. Once your inside there is a security system and multiple locked doors between the apartment and outside so we did feel safe. The kitchen area is quite small and doesn’t have much room to hangout but this wasn’t an issue for us as we spent most our time seeing the city. The kitchen is stocked with most essentials and the fridge came in very handy. The beds were a bit firm but we found them comfortable. Overall the place exceeded our expectations and we couldn’t ask for much better in this part of town. We look forward to staying here again!

Jason was so sweet and helpful throughout my stay. The tenants across the room were so sweet and helpful. The room and bathroom were very clean and smell really great. It was so perfect for my two-day stay in New York. Don't suspect the outside environment to be clean. It's New York! But your stay with Jason will make it worth it.  Thank you, Jason!

Nisheka’s home was absolutely beautiful! It looked exactly like the pictures. I stayed with three other people and we had more than enough room for all of us.  This home is right near the subway station, which made our trip much more stress free! Literally less than a five minute walk. If you’re considering booking this apartment, this is your sign to do so! Nisheka was very attentive, informative, and genuinely kind.

Tharciany was really nice and helpful, the only inconvenience i had with her that i did not get reply on my messages just the day before i travelled. That was a little bit unpleasant since i was travelling alone.  The room was nice and clean and i had the privacy which i really appreciate. Negative (maybe just for me), that the bed (matress) is very soft.
