What i would like to mention that in this neighbourhood (including the possibility of closing the apartment) i did not feel completely safe, although i did not experience any problem during my stay. It is possible that our security needs, type of locks are different. Overall the place was ok for this amount of money, close to the main attractions so very good from a transportation point of view.

The apartment itself is very nice. Clean, spacious, stocked with necessities. Very close to the train station. Communication was very good with the host. Easy check in process. Overall a very nice stay.   The issue, and this is out of the control of the host, is the overall neighborhood. It can feel unsafe at times. While this is technically still East Williamsburg, it is right on the border of Bushwick and Bed Sty. This is a very noisy and very busy area. Keep that in mind when booking.

This place reminded me a lot of where I grew up in East Flatbush. Very comfortable, quiet. On the first night we arrived my 4 year old was scared since it was a new place. By the time he woke up in the morning, he had made himself at home. The grocery store and a playground is right within walking distance. Heads up if you have never been to NYC before, bring your own bags when you grocery shop. There was a convenient shopping cart located in the closet by the door. Having personal ACs was a plus so each room could control its own temperature confort level. Street parking wasn't difficult to find.

I loved this place! So clean nice couch good price. I felt around this area is kinda sketchy at nighttime but it’s New York and close enough I think. I’m willing to stay here again when I’ll visit NY next time:)

Daniel’s studio is spacious and very modern with a walk-in closet and in-unit washer/dryer (which is so clutch). My boyfriend really appreciated the work desk and Herman Miller chair which made working from home more comfortable. I also really appreciated having an air fryer so that we could cook at home. Because of the building’s shared lounge, gym, and rooftop, my boyfriend and I managed to stay here for a month without any issues as we’ve always had enough space. Location is very convenient with multiple subway lines nearby and WholeFoods, Trader Joe’s, Target, and DeKalb market nearby. Barclays and Park Slope are also just within a 10-15min walk. However, there are a lot of late night street activity and homeless/crazies on the street. I even encountered some fights at the 24/7 McDonald’s across the street so you’d have to be vigilant about walking around the area late at night. Overall a good stay at a new modern building. Daniel was an excellent host who promptly responded to my inquiries.

This apartment is true to the pictures--the furniture and space in this apartment is as described and the communication and attentiveness of the host was genuine. I've lived in NYC for prior to this for a few years and for the apartment sublet there's a significant upcharge that if you're looking in the right places you'd be able to find a better apartment in a nicer building. The apartment location is in Harlem--just North of Central Park and alot of the buildings here are hit or miss.   This building had a few issues with pests--cockroaches (both in the apartment as well as the elevator and stairwell), a rat in the stairwell at one point. So, if you can't handle that you should know that they are likely there. At one point, the building had no hot water for almost a week--there was water but cold showers for that time.   Aside from that, I don't think there were any other legitimate issues. At one point, two officers came to the door on the report of an illegal sublet (which this wasn't to my knowledge) but none the less someone in the building likely reported it which means you may not be welcomed by everyone there. I found the neighbors nice and friendly--as well as helpful alot of the time. This is very different than more upscale apartment buildings and some of the charm available in Harlem.   As much as I've said that may make you think twice about staying here. I think you should know that Harlem has been one of my favorite neighborhoods--especially during COVID. It's a true community--Sidewalk BBQs, Music, Large gatherings and tons of restaurants. Many people you pass by are friendly and will say hello/morning/etc. and I've never felt truly unsafe.   If you're low maintenance this is a good place for you. Easy commute to many places in the city, the host is responsive, and it's a comfortable apartment.

The home is very spacious with high ceilings and what I suspect are original hardwood floors. It’s only a block from the Subway, so that’s very convenient. A few convenient stores and delis nearby. That part of Harlem looks pretty sketch at night, but I looked up the crime rate and there’s more petty crime near Times Square than in this area, so don’t be alarmed, but also don’t be walking by yourself late at night. The place is not updated with modern touches, but it works especially for its space and the two bathrooms.

We had a great time staying with Milton's apartment in Harlem. The apartment is excellent situated within a 5 minute walk to the 2/3 and the B line. You can be in Time Square within 20 minutes.  The apartment on the first floor has 2 very large bedrooms with each 1 single and a double bed and a separate toilet and bathroom for this floor. On the ground floor there was  a large living room, dining area, complete kitchen with all utilities and a small enclosed area with a double bed. The garden was also nice to seat and chill.   The neighborhood was ok and we never felt unsafe. Had a lot of talks with people on the street who were all very friendly and helpful. If I plan to visit NYC with a group of friends again I will definitely try to book Milton's apartment again.

This hotel was dirty and did not exhibit proper COVID-19 procedures. The room did not seem to have been cleaned properly and had an unpleasant smell. The lobby was cluttered with people and in some areas people were able to sit inside without a mask. I was not required to sign a COVID-19 symptom check form from the state.

So my friend and I stayed at this Airbnb for 2 nights the place was decent for a short stay. other then that I wouldn’t recommend. The balcony felt very unsafe. The rooms and the bathroom were decent, the communication was off , it was really hard to get in contact via phone, and on top of that we were coming from a different state and we had to wait for 30min for a code to get into our Airbnb which made us late for our event and although it said it’s a private room I still think they should inform you if other people are checking in on the same days of your stay because not everybody is going to be comfortable with that situation , which happen to us and also we ended up meeting the landlord on our stay and it was awkward she came to clean the bathroom and I’m guessing to check everything and didn’t even properly introduce herself or apologize for having us wait to receive the codes ..instead she was more concerns what was on her table. Overall we made the best of it.

The place is perfect for one or two people. It is clean and very cozy. We stayed for 3 weeks and they gave us fresh bed linens and towels every week. It is very lively neighborhood full of friendly people. Like said before, the place is located in Spanish Harlem, but we never felt unsafe in any way. The locals were very friendly, when they noticed we were lost they were very helpful to find our way again. (Interestingly, in some local places you might need your Spanish skills, but Google Translate helped us.)  Supermarkets are nearby, subway and busses got us everywhere.

Cool place. The place is clean and a bit stylish.  Although I waited a bit longer than expected to get into the home, the host was accommodating.  She was nice and showed me around the apartment. She even set up the portable air conditioner that had been disconnected or put away because the weather is getting colder. I like the neighborhood. I think El Barrio is one of the few remaining real neighborhoods in NYC. You will never feel scared or threaten.  When you look outside your window, you will see a soccer field and people playing soccer during the daytime, and at night it will be completely silent.  You will enjoy your stay.

We stayed for four nights. It was nice for Scott to let us in earlier than the check-in time. He is nice and responsive. The entire stay is good but a bit different from how it looked in the pictures - the building is old and the interior seem old too including the furnitures. The bedding is different from the pic and looked a bit dirty but it wasn’t too bad. Comforter is a bit small. The area seems safe but the walk from the closest subway to the place feel a bit unsafe to two girls. A bit far away (at least 30min public transit) from the urban city. No good restaurant nearby.

The only thing preventing me from giving this place 5 stars is the lack of communication with the staff. My partner and I had an incident happen that made us feel unsafe in our room, it took us half an hour to reach the lobby through the hotel phone because we were told we were being redirected, followed up the morning after and were told someone would get back to us and no one ever did. Otherwise, the place itself is nice, they let you check your bags in early/after you check out, and it is in a convenient location.

First Airbnb experience!  For everyone I think, it's always scary the first time... We were completely satisfied! There is sufficient space for 2 people. Especially if you want to visit New York like us. We linger in the apartment just to sleep and shower.  Monica is a superb host! Very available and attentive. She reacts very quickly to the slightest problem. She left us drinks when we arrived and even coffee for the morning... Little touches that really touched us! Simple but effective and reassuring. If you want to travel like us, highly recommended! Especially since the proximity to transport was correct.  Brooklyn has become a favorite city for us! We will come back... Thank you again for everything Monica, we can't tell you enough! xoxo

This place is was fantastic! An absolute steal in Manhattan. 5-8 mins walking to the A express train. Entire Place was spotless and clean, room was spacious and very private. The host was very warm and welcoming!  10 stars from me

Amazing, beautiful and very spacious lobby and lounge area. Nice to hang out or work for a bit between things. Room is small but space optimized, we really liked the layout— everything we needed for our short stay. Clean, bed + bedding super comfortable, and the staff is super accommodating and friendly. They held our bags both prior and after checkin/checkout, lowering our stress and really letting us enjoy the area. I love soho and arlo is a great homebase to walk to soho, west village, or tribeca. Would definitely recommend and stay again

My stay was ok. A little stressful since the heater broke twice, woke up to worry about being warm and watching the maintenance guy fix it, I left early so the room gets warmed up then it was not, broken & its the second time. & twice I requested my room to be freshen up, they forgot, the management sounded like blaming the guest and had anxiety the whole day. I am disappointed at the management they sounded manipulative, when I had an issue in my stay. Other than that, I would like to thank the front desk employees that genuinely cared about their guests and reassured we are comfortable.

Unqualified management, unresponsive Traumatizing treatment .. my deposit half stolen.. No joke I am shocked.  They will blame you if your AC is dripping on the floor, and the soap the first day was empty. There were dust under my bed i was coughing bed. The comforter smelled sweaty. Then they collect urban fees as a surprise-they edited the description after my arrival. Stop abusing.

I have tried multiple times to contact the host but have received no reply.  Despite numerous attempts to have the room serviced, the room was only cleaned once during my stay. Covid-19 protocols are not an excuse if  communication is ignored.   The shower drain was clogged and the room had constant ventilation noise, making comfortable sleep near impossible.   I also had to switch rooms upon check-in because the original room had an unidentifiable stench mixed in with the strong scent of a cleaning product.   To make matters worse, I was charged a daily fee for my entire stay, despite the AirBnb listing stating that the taxes and fees are included when booking.   Hard not to feel like this is a scam offering a sub-par service while double charging customers.

Ronnie was very respectful and attentive. He checked-in periodically to make sure things were going well. The room is also located in a very vibrant neighborhood with laundry, food, a park, and plenty of other things near by. Overall, I had a very easy, stress-free stay. Ronnie and his mother were lovely and the room was great; especially if you're doing some solo traveling like I was. Great first airbnb experience!

I was stuck at JFK airport for an unexpected overnight layover because they wouldn’t allow me to travel with my cat overseas. Lakshmee was very quick to accept the confirmation and the room was ready for me get within an hour of initial booking. She was there when I got there approximately one hour later and showed me around the place. She was very welcoming and answered all my questions. We chatted for a bit and she gave some suggestions for food as well. She also didn’t charge me the $25 pet fee due to my situation which was really awesome of her to do. The price is very fair and it was roughly 10 mins from the airport, area wasn’t bad at all and was safe. Awesome experience which made my really stressful day just a little easier. Thank you again Lakshmee!
small rooms, elegantly designed.  Very clean and comfortable. Friendly and helpful staff. Enjoyed my stay. Weekends a little scary - crowd check-in in small lobby. (Covid in mind)

Cute hotel. Perfect location!!! Our room was too small but the price is perfect!   The security guard Tim is abrasive and rude. He followed us out the door to make sure we didn’t steal the luggage cart. How insulting!   We’re latin and felt as if he was watching us to make sure we didn’t do anything bad every time we entered. We saw him almost get into a fight with a delivery guy in the lobby. He is Unprofessional!   Other than Tim the security guard this hotel is awesome!

Ivana was truly accommodating and kind. She answered all of my questions, and trust me I had a lot. She responds quickly and makes sure that she is attentive to your needs. Recommended things to do and was knowledgeable. The neighborhood was sketchy, but she cannot control that and when I walked outside there was a rat. Upon exploring New York this is a common occurrence, also something she could not control. The bedroom is somewhat small, but it is New York, all apartments are small. One thing that I did not like, there is no access to the television, or I couldn’t navigate it. She tried to assist, but it just wasn’t happening. That is my only gripe. Otherwise, you get what you pay for.
I was very happy with the ease in booking this stay last minute, and the space was modern, spacious and  clean. A steal at $75/night!!

Thick layers of dust all over the furniture surfaces and some stains on bedding. Not really the type to complain so we disinfected the room ourselves. It also seems like they let people who aren’t hotel guests roaming in the hotel. I was asked several times by different people to use my key card to go up the elevator. There were even fully armed cops in the lobby one night. Pretty sketchy if you ask me.

I had high hopes for this inn but it is in serious disrepair. Many basic fixtures, outlets and plumbing, haven’t been attended to in what seem like years. I had to move to a downstairs room because the upstairs was sweltering; the new room was filthy and had a broken outlet. I had to charge my phone and dry hair using an extension cord on the floor. The shower door seal is decayed and so the bathroom floor got all wet every shower. The only amenity is a dirty bottle of Head and Shoulders shampoo because I guess we all have dandruff? The linens are washed with industrial soap and smell horrible. The hot tub clearly hadn’t been serviced and barely functioned. The toilet moaned after every flush. The female innkeeper did change the sheets and tidy it up but the room still felt grimy and there was no housekeeping during the stay. Another innkeeper was always around me to the point that as a woman I felt very uncomfortable and borderline unsafe. The bed was comfortable, thank goodness.

This apartment really is a little gem.  It’s clean, incredibly well laid out and has super cute furnishing and super comfortable bedding.  Sandee is very easy to communicate with and made our visit to Brooklyn stress free.  This is our old neighborhood and I can’t say enough about how fun it is to be in this area.  JUST THE BEST.  Safe, convenient and full of great restaurants, bars and shops.  The green space of Brooklyn Bridge Park AND Prospect Park are both an easy walk or bike ride away and the Bergen Street F/G and the Hoyt Street A/C train lines are literally right down the street.  Thanks, again,  Sandee!  We loved your place and would stay here, again, in a heartbeat.

The accommodation is truly perfect. It's in a great location in a great area. The apartment is very clean, the beds are very comfortable. We had everything we needed available.  The accommodation is located 5 or 7 minutes on foot from the subways which take you to the heart of Manhattan and then only 30 minutes by subway. It's really very practical. It is located 25 minutes walk from the Brooklyn Bridge. There are plenty of bars and restaurants nearby. I came home alone in the evening at one point and I didn't feel unsafe. At no time.  Sandee was awesome and very accommodating from start to finish of our trip. She is easily reachable if you have any questions.  I recommend with my eyes closed and if one day I return to New York, I know where I would sleep :) Thanks again!
Space was fantastic for our family of 5, and it made the time we spent out exploring so much less stressful knowing we had such a lovely home base to come back to.

I enjoyed the stay at Kaz's Sunnyside place for 2 months. The place is very convenient: there are several supermarkets, wonderful restaurants, drug stores, post office, etc. nearby. Cross the road, there is a park, where you can exercise.  There is a small Asian grocery storer in about 3 blocks away. To Manhattan, it takes only less than 30 min to 53rd and Lexington Ave, where I worked, by 7 and E lines.  His place was clean and neat. I love his system, which provides a bin for bathroom and cabinets designated for each person. Cleaning is provided to the common space.  I was so happy to find his place in NYC.

Do it! Sandee’s place is exactly as listed. When you walk through the door you’ll feel like you are looking at the pictures on the listing. The beds are comfortable and there are plenty of amenities, if needed. We felt safe while walking in the neighborhood after dark. The nights were quiet. Subways for multiple lines were easily accessible and only a few blocks away. We were in the middle of Manhattan in minutes. Sandee’s place is a steal especially if you don’t want to be in the middle of Manhattan but want to still get the city vibe. Thanks, Sandee!

Collin is amazing, she responded in a timely manner. Like I stated if you don’t have a problem with homeless peep like my other friends the. You should be fine. Super close to everything especially the sight seeing.

Do not use third parties because they treat you as second class stayers. They told my girlfriend and I  that since we did not book through them, that our room is not available and won’t be until the next day. It was my first time on vacation due to the pandemic, along with my anniversary and birthday, and I had an extremely terrible experience with Arlo Soho. I was given the wrong room, had to switch rooms even during this pandemic, my AC did not work (it was 76 degrees in the room I DIDN’T book) — when I called the front desk to ask for a technician, he never showed up, and lastly they thought that 2 drink vouchers were going to make up for this terrible stay my girlfriend and I had to deal with. We wanted a relaxing time away, for it only to be the worst and most stressful time. Not sure I would come back here. The only nice thing is the terraces, but again that’s if they even put you in the right room.

Looks nothing like the pictures. Not clean at all, gave me and my friends a itchy feel. Creepy environment. I was coming up the stairs to go to my room and a man watched me the whole way without moving a muscle. Me and my friends ended up leaving early and i asked the host for a refund since i wasn’t staying and the response i got was “sorry we can’t do that”... Terrible place wouldn’t recommend.

Staff was great, room was beautiful, of course the Terrance was breathtaking ( As the staff mentioned before going up ) Outdoor shower, 😓 what a great touch.   Only downside, my Wife and I were attacked by mosquitos the second night.

We knew, by renting this accommodation, that we would not have splendid accommodation but just a place to rest, wash and eat. First of all, the room with only a sofa (see photo in the ad) is shared with another accommodation. The sofa bed and coffee table in the photos in the ad are not those present in the accommodation.  The accommodation is described as having been recently renovated; I don't understand this description: I don't think I've ever seen such unsanitary accommodation. We didn't leave it when we discovered it because we would have had no fallback solution, 6000 km from home and on top of that with 3 children. Dirty doors, questionable stains on the walls and ceilings, residual hairs in the bathroom, improbable bathroom furniture (dirty and broken), shower curtain full of filth, numerous molds in the shower bath, bed in the living room and sofa bed (very dilapidated) extremely uncomfortable, the noise of the refrigerator in the room where 3 out of 5 beds are located, some windows stuck with heavy tape (so very audible street noise), the blankets are not really blankets. (in winter, we would have been very cold), coffee table very wobbly, air conditioning unusable as it is due to dangerous electrical installation, no windows open so unpleasant humid air in the accommodation. Suspected bed fleas but we cannot confirm it at this time (strange spots on the body). The only positive points were the proximity to metro stations, secure doors and Netflix. Contact with the host was OK but nothing exceptional.  In short, if you are looking for an enclosed and covered place to put your suitcases and you are not concerned about the health of the place where you are, then this is the address for you. Otherwise, I advise you to save more and make sure you read all the comments on the ad for the property you plan to rent. Our mistake was this: turning a blind eye to the comments already present relating almost everything I have just described (numerous photos to support my descriptions).

Apartment located in a neighborhood full of Latinos and Indians, a lot of dirt in the neighborhood. a little dangerous at night, the apartment neglected and deteriorated. poor cleaning. The only notable thing is the subway station that makes communication with Manhattan convenient, due to the number of lines that pass.

You risk not getting what you’re paying for. I did not receive the room or facilities that were advertised. I booked a king room sky, and at check in I was given a different room with a queen bed. I could not access the room because the key cards didn’t work and had to wait over half an hour just to get in. The view was a brick wall, a construction site, a view into the room next to ours. You can not access the rooftop that is advertised without a separate reservation.   When I told the front desk that I had booked a king room sky the employee at the front desk said they’re fully booked, there’s nothing that they could do and to contact Airbnb. Customer support informed me that Arlo NoMad had multiple king rooms available and the host should be able to rebook me. Either they’re misleading customers on the platform or the employee is lying; shady business practices all around.

NY is a stressful, expensive place but We LOVED staying here. The view is breathtaking. A bit sad to go but we will be coming back! My favorite part besides the view? Leaving our mark in front of the elevator.

The room was cold and not really clean. The predominant smell of air freshener was unpleasant. We were 4 people and there were only 3 towels. There were no extra blankets.  I actually saw insects in the bathroom. Moreover this is probably the least cosy airbnb i've ever had. The neighbourhood is also not really nice, even dirty and dark. The only positive thing I can say is that the metro is close, in 20 minutes you can reach Manhattan.  Conclusion: I was really disappointed and would defenitely not visit again.

Very nice place with everything we needed. Very clean and tidy. Super close to the subway and everything else we needed - water, food etc. neighbourhood was cool too, very vibrant area and never felt unsafe whilst walking around, even at night. Kevin was quick to answer my queries and gave us some helpful tips for New York. Thanks Kevin

The place is really close to the Subway station which makes it super convenient. The neighborhood looked kind of scary but we didn't have any kind of incident during our stay so that's great! it has convenience stores close, as well as places to get food at later times of the night.  The place is worthy the price and the host was super kind and left us check in earlier than we planned so we could leave our luggage in place. If I ever travel back to NY I'd love to stay here again.

I could’t ask for a better location than Kevin’s apartment. Everything is just a few steps away- subway, grocery, restaurants and market. Kevin’s pantry is full of essential items.  He really stocked up on coffee pods and bottled water for our half month stay! My pilot son suddenly came to join us and Kevin welcomed him with no hesitation and no added cost! Communication is no issue at all. He would readily reply in less than 5 minutes. Thank you so much for making our stay very memorable and stress free. Definitely would recommend this place and would book again with Kevin for our future visits to Brooklyn.
Well located in Manhattan, but dangerous at night because of homeless people.

This is by far the worst airbnb I have ever stayed at, I don’t even know where to begin, wow! I have never seen a house so dirty in my entire existence, filth on another level. The caretaker only did a quick wipe down of a few things once every 2 weeks with more than 7 people staying in that house, I was there all the time i saw everything. It was disgusting, at some point I couldn’t shower or eat there because everything was dirty. I complained so many times, the guy renting next to me even complained to airbnb management and ended up abandoning his stay because he couldn’t take it anymore. There are barely any dishes or things to use in the kitchen to cook or eat for 7 people, so i had to go buy things at the dollar store. I couldn’t warm food I ordered for a few days because there was something rotting in the microwave. I tried to roast potatoes one time and found all these black grimey trays that hadn’t been washed in probably months hiding in there. I felt like i was gonna fall through the mattress, it was like those sponge ones they use in prison cells, holes everywhere and dirty. I hate this place so much it hurts. Then to top it off i got robbed on a train one night, came home after the police escorted me home to make sure i get there safe because i was in tears. I tell the caretaker and then the next day the owner tells me to give him $150 for the front door key, even though he changed it to a keypad door, i told them hell no. It costs a dollar to cut a new key. You are playing yourself if you stay after reading this review, no matter what the owner replies to this to defend themself. Im shocked by this experience.
Very spacious beautiful apartment that has a nice outdoor space to enjoy.  Clint and Jason were awesome hosts that made our stay very stress free.

The room was smaller than the photos showed. Nice, but small considering we were 2 people. It is not recommended for long stays: the closet is half full, and the same goes for the shelves. The neighborhood is dangerous and the entrance is very ugly, full of garbage and rats. Although it says that it is a shared apartment, it is never clarified that there are more guests in other rooms besides the host. At one point we were 6 people for a small bathroom. There is practically no place to have lunch or dinner, we had to do it sitting in bed. We assume that Jack exists and slept in the next room, but we never saw him in the 10 days we stayed.
Manhatten is around 30 min by Subway. Bronx looked for us a bit unsafe but we didnt made bad experiences.

Pros: Quite house, you hear nothing, shared bathroom always clean, you have everything inside your room including a sink Responsive host, they give you clean sheets every week, easy commute to anywhere in Manhattan  Cons; Pricy for a room with shard bathroom , I paid 3700 for 22 days, the area gets sketchy at night but still safe, you’re responsible for cleaning your room no room service,  All in all! Not bad for the crazy market right now ,  Good luck in everything,

Comfortable apartment stylishly furnished with two very comfortable beds.  Well linked with transport plus walkable distances as well to Central Park, mid town (20-30 minutes).   Starbucks, supermarket and 24 hour drug store close by with many eateries within walking distance.  Would definitely use again.  Thank you so much.
Great location and clean apartment. Steal for The price.
They robbed me of my refund After I cancelled my reservation HRS BEFORE CANCELLATION DEAD LINE!!!

Very modern and stylish location.  Extremely clean and awesome location.  Easy check in.  Only 2 working elevators and no ice machine is noted as lacking.  Across the street is a homeless shelter or something of that nature.  All in all a very nice hotel in a great location.

Amir’s place is perfect! Very clean, all the amenities and then some, including a washer and dryer, which is a huge bonus for an Airbnb. And you can not beat the location being only a few blocks from the free Staten Island ferry. Plus stress free parking! Great local places recommended and great communication from Amir, who even helped me with setting up a cab back to the airport. I will definitely book one of his listings again.
Arlo is great spot to relieve stress and focus on the tasks ahead .

My stay at Arlo was nice, the hotel is nice even though it looks bigger and brighter in pictures. The check in was really nice and welcoming but the checkout was unpleasant, no thank you was said to us for our stay. And the 30 or late 20th year old lady that seemed like a manager was rude. The hotel room is nice, but the phone was missing from our room and couldn’t order room service. Even though one pendant did not work the shampoo and body wash provided smelled amazing. Asides from the unpleasant lady, our stay was real nice.  Last thing is I wish they would have told us that the coffee and tea was complementary. We went our entire stay without knowing we had coffee to enjoy.

the place is fine if you want a quick stay. It is uninspiring and hygiene could have been better but you get what you pay for in a safe neighbourhood. host was responsive and I never felt unsafe. Area is super convenient. Would I stay again? depends. But it was good for what it was :)

I rented a room and i thought I was goin to be sharing the apartment with JK but there was more people, the bathroom was always occupied… there were moments i felt unsafe because of the amount of unknown people entering the apartment, really good location tho! And he responds quickly

Me and my boyfriend came to this airbnb and it was very nicely cleaned , we were very happy with everything at first . The second night at around 2-3:00a.m me and my boyfriend heard somebody trying to type in the combination lock and open the door. We saw a flash light flashing inside the house as well which had me terrified . My boyfriend came out and raised his voice trying to find out who’s at the door to find out it was the landlord. I found this very unprofessional and wrong due to the fact that they should have messaged me and my boyfriend letting us know that they will be checking the combination lock for whatever reason . I never reported this because I’m kind enough not to and because she apologized the day after . After our trip had ended we left a few pizza boxes, garbage in a bag and a few dishes . As a result to this the landlord messaged me requesting $500 and she stated that we left a very huge mess with a lot of damage which I found ridiculous because we were 2 people and we didn’t spend much time in the Airbnb. On top of that she attached a bunch of staged pictures making it seem like we caused a lot of damage in her house. Pictures with one broken wine glass( we didn’t drink once at the Airbnb) , lamp on the couch , broken plant and pot , candles laying on the table , chairs curved on the table , mirror on the floor and much more  . Everything was very staged and fake. I am very upset that they are trying to ask for more money because that is known as stealing . I am from Canada and my visit ended off very terribly due to this stay. I feel very unsafe and unhappy about my stay . Definitely will never return again .

We arrived from a 12 hour journey to a place that was nothing as the description and the photos. The sheets on the bed were crumpled and dirty with blood stains on it. They were also yellow and stained as the pillows and the mattresses. Everything looked disgusting. Most of the furniture was broken. The place smelled bad and looked bad. The windows were covered with dust and bugs and they even had hand prints from someone that came from the emergency ladder on them. Our children were scared the minute they entered the place. There was a homeless person sleeping on the stairs, and garbage in the entrance. The air conditioned was really old and dirty . The host was  rude, aggressive and not polite when confronted with the situation. We left immediately because it was impossible to stay at a place like that.

The place is really nice. Definitely worth the price. The location is pretty close to the subway (less than a mile), but it’s in the Bronx, so it’s not the *best* neighborhood. My younger sister and I stayed and we didn’t feel unsafe, but there are safer places. Overall great experience. I’d stay again!

The lock box containing a set of keys to the apartment was broken. I was greeted by a maintenance man who tried to pry it open. The door to the apartment was open and unlocked. Another man, either a super or the owner, I’m not sure, said he could not help me with the keys. He told me to leave the apartment open and unlocked. I entered the apartment which had a foul smell. Then proceeded to the room I’d rented. A man and two small children were in the room I’d be staying in. He’d informed me that he’d spilled soup on the mattress. There were no blankets on the bed. The condition of the room was not what I expected. I felt unsafe staying at an apt and a city I was unfamiliar with. I chose this listing because a woman was hosting and I wanted to feel safe. I canceled immediately.

Arlo nomad is amazing. Super clean, I cannot stress enough how clean this place is. Blown away. Tye space itswlf is beautiful, staff was amazing. I will definetly be coming back over and over. You guys pampered me, lol

If you want to have the worst experience in NYC. Please stay here. 1. The door is unsafe. You can open it without a key. 2. The place is dirty and with high humidity. 3. The bathroom, omg. Dirty dirty dirty, is disgusting to get a shower there, it was with fungus. I travel with a kid, and he could not sleep just with the smell pf the place. 4. The beds, it is the first time in my life I sleep in a bed like that ñ, dirty sheets, you cannot move because the sound was horrible, the other bed moved like a boat. 5. Also the host never answer me the message where I told him that I wanted to check out. At the end I had to move to another hotel, and so far today I just get the cleaning fee refund!. Please don’t stay in this place. Btw the tv didn’t work,

Not the most luxurious place in the world but it was perfect for a place to crash after a long day in the city. The location provides easy access to the subway. The neighborhood seemed a little sketchy at first but everything was ok as we got acquainted with it.

Location is great! Close to supermarkets, a large variety of stores and places to get food. Close to the Subway (very easy to get to other parts of NY like Manhattan) and an amazing Mexican restaurant (Sonora) just around the corner. Brooklyn has a lot of charm. The house has a lot of space and large rooms. Plenty of space for 5 people. The front door feels a bit unsafe as it seams very easy to open without a key. The bathroom-door is a sliding door that doesn’t slide so well. Minor things really. The only real big point of critisism (that can easily be improved) is the bathroom itself. It’s not very clean and hasn’t been in a while. The kitchen could do with a proper cleaning as well.  With some minor adjustments we think this place could be absolutely perfect. Kyle is quick with his responses and very friendly.  We would definitely like to stay here again and it’s a place we would recommend to others.

Great place. I’m from LA and our city streets are a bit different. Driving up I felt unsafe in the neighborhood, however, by day two I had made some friends on the stoop and felt very safe. I’m probably just a wimp, and the  appartment was very nice. The washer is also the dryer. Very cool.

FIRE THE ENTIRE NIGHT STAFF!!! The pictures advertised are misleading not one of the lounges was open, the rooftop lounge was closed as well no drinks at the ARLO, This hotel is more like a motel everything was either dirty, old or dusty. They don't do turnovers so don't expect your sheets to be cleaned on a daily . My room was dirty I mean white stains on the carpet, my sheets smelt like perfume already, no working phones and pee pee stains on the toilet . Valet is 55 per 24 hours and you have no IN AND OUT PRIVILEGES WITH YOUR OWN CAR . My food got stolen from the lobby with both security and hotel staff in the front ( was reimbursed my 44$ which the hotel credited to my valet). For the best views make sure you stay in any room above floor 20. PLEASE PLEASE DO YOUR RESEARCH BEFORE STAYING HERE . DO NOT STAY IN ROOM 1509 IF YOU WANT A VIEW YOU WOULD DEF GET CECILE HOTEL VIBES . GOOD LUCK AND BEST WISHES .

I love it’s clean with reasonable price.  The location is good and not far away from the metro station.   King bed and a comfortable shower you would enjoy. Only thing is one of the shade curtain is broken in my room. I woke up early anyway so it’s not a problem for me.

Great stay, room was smaller than expected but overall great for 2, the terrace makes up for it. everything was great until we ran into a problem. had a valet service for my car, my ez-pass transponder was stolen. i know that’s not the hotel’s fault but come on. other than that, everything was great. close to everything in town.

my car got robbed right outside of them home and i messaged about it to the owner. Seems like he didn’t care and all he cared about was the keys to the house which i stated i left upstairs. Will never ever airbnb around this place ever again.

The location of the Airbnb is relatively close to subways so it makes it easy to get to Manhattan, Williamsburg, etc.  while the area itself is not a choice one, it isn’t unsafe.  Directions to locate the key to get into the apartment was not accurate and difficult to understand, so don’t expect clear directions if you stay here.  The apt itself was clean, however, very very chilly and only when I inquired was I told one small space heater was available under the sink.  I was told to use the stove to heat the apt, which doesn’t seem safe to me. Don’t expect creature comforts like bottled water or Kleenex. This Airbnb has only the basics.

This was not the greatest Airbnb. I had to pay $50 up front to bring my bags in early which doesn’t seem right. While the hostess was nice she seemed a bit overbearing in her explanation of things, I’m an adult and I can figure things out myself. She also insisted that I not latch the door during my stay while I was inside which made my wife and I feel very unsafe. I did find a cockroach on my first day which was a pretty bad way to start. The space was fairly clean aside from a spare blanket and the bathtub. A few days into our stay the hostess confronted me and claimed I wasn’t using the plastic shower curtain (even though I had used it) and informed me that there was a leak that could have potentially dripped down into the unit below and into a chandelier which could cause an electrical fire…SUPER safe..there were a few other problems with the place but overall it was not worth the price we paid and we eventually had to check out early and are in the processes of getting a refund. If you’re looking for affordable stays in Brooklyn I would absolutely do your research.

Place was a described. Location was good, very close to metro station and great restaurants. We arrived several times late at night and it didn’t feel unsafe. The host was very responsive. If you are picky about cleaning better not to book here.

I am thankful for this location and hosts. They made my trip a LOT less stressful. They were very accommodating with checking in and out.  When traffic held me and my daughters up from arriving on time, they worked with us on obtaining the key. The place was CLEAN. Soaps, shampoos, towels, dishes, extra sheets all were made available to us. It felt like a home away from home. I would DEFINITELY stay there again.  With the Bronx Zoo so close, next time I will have to take a stroll with the children through one of the best Zoos in the country as well.
Good accessibility to public transportation. Good interaction with the host. Neighborhood a little bit special, seems to be dangerous although nothing happened

This place is so amazing I really enjoyed my stay. Not only that I would be booking again and not only that I felt so stress free at ease. I really recommend this place cause they welcome everyone with open arms and they customer service is up to part..

Location is in a very bad looking neighborhood. Hookers, drug dealers , homeless surround the entrance to the place. The inside looks great if you can make it pass the doors. I ended up not staying based on the surrounds of the building .

The deal is not so bad and the employees there are super kind. But, they are not necessarily honest (or at least with me). I was told after waking up to bug bites on my leg that I would be moved to a higher/larger floor but instead was moved 7 floors down to a room that had ripped curtains, was designed for the handicapped, the phone didn't work, and the view was incredibly unpleasant. This place is honestly a hit or miss.

this place was great, when booking in nyc you have to expect certain things like, ( parking, homeless people, noisey streets.. etc) i found this hotel to be in a perfect location, withing walking distace of everything we wanted. the corner store “Bread and Butter” was great average prices and was 24 hours! the room itself was small but for the city was great for me and my boyfriend, definitely will book again!!!

This host called the Airbnb corporate office and tried to cancel our reservation a couple of hours before check-in without notifying us after many attempts to reach out to the host without any response. Incredibly poor communication - would not recommend the hassle and stress that comes with booking this Airbnb property.

In my opinion, judging from the other reviews that I should have read and from my own terrible experience, this place and Jalynn are a scam.  She books the full amount and then doesn't communicate ANYTHING about how to proceed.  I think the scam could be to get you to cancel so that she can keep the money and then "rent" it again.   I don't know why Airbnb allows this to continue.  In the end, I had to get Airbnb to officially cancel my booking and I had to go to a hotel.  RUN, don't walk from Jalynn!!!
Stained sheets, stained towels, small ice box, super lumpy bed, the elevator sounds unsafe with all the rattling, there are no ceiling lights so it’s only lamps in the bedroom area.

We truly had a great stay at Lotay's place. I would give it a 4.5 if possible. My husband and I came to NYC with our 3 kids (7,9,12) and found the space to be great for us.  The good: proximity to the metro, plenty of beds, great space, really enjoyed the neighborhood and never felt unsafe, the microwave had went out on the guest before us and Lotay promptly got us one we were able to use so I know he is responsive. Wall AC units in each room definitely kept the place cool, and wifi was great.  The not-as-good: this isn't Lotay's fault at all but we really struggled with the street parking.  So just a heads up to be prepared (and don't park too close to a hydrant- we ended up with a ticket). This changed our plans a little because once we were in a good spot we didn't want to move it. The good thing is the place is really close to the metro, so we took it into the city very easily.  While I appreciated Lotay's kindness (I ran into several rude hosts as we were searching for an airbnb and Lotay is nothing but kind) and responsiveness through the vast majority of the process, check-in was one of the reasons for it not being 5 stars. We communicated what time we would be there and still waited about a half hour to be let into the unit after we arrived (which was an added stress on top of finding parking). There were a few amenities that we felt were lacking, but I have a feeling after communicating that with Lotay that those things will be taken care of and that didn't affect my review because I have no way of knowing if prior guests happened to take them. Overall, we had a great stay especially for the price and would definitely stay there again if we visit NYC again- but we might find alternative parking :)

Location is kinda sketchy.  Ad states towels provided , just upon check in there was 1 wash cloth and 7 towles for 5 people. Anything beyond that we had to provide ourselves. No washer.  Price changes depending per number of guest.  ad states standard cable TV,  lie, you must use your apps. There are 5 enter points into the apartment.  4 alone in the common hall and 1 directly to the backyard. did not feel safe. would not recommend. did not stay, left within hours of arriving and am not getting any of my $900 plus money back.

The Arlo NoMad is in great location for food, fun, and even travel (close to penn station). The room smelled like bleach so covid precautions are taken and the room was slightly bigger than I expected. Overall, it’s a steal for this price and I will be staying here again!

Lovely, clean, stylish apartment, perfect for singles or couples visiting NYC. Really chilled host who is quick to communicate. One note: I suspect the lock box which contains the key has been peed on a few times by the local canine community, so you might want some wipes to hand if that bothers you 😬😅

What you see in the description and in the photos is what you get, a really nice place to stay. Is a great location, at first I was kind of stress because I don’t know the city too much but with the subway was really easy and safe for me to move. There is also buses but they take more time to get to downtown

Arlo Nomad, for sure i will not return. They are not transparent in regards to all associated fees. They will charge you extra for every single amenity, and they will let you know once you are about to check out. These fees will be withheld from the $75 deposit charged when you check in. Consider a $11.3/night as an URBAN FEE for the hotel. When asked why they did not tell anything about this fee on Airbnb or when checking in, they will give you an automatic response. Let not talk about the cleanness of the room. The sheet had a terrible odor and stains could be seen in them, as well as the carpet and towels. The AC brings in odors from other rooms. They should consider increasing the transparency and do a better job cleaning the rooms. A terrible ambient just outside the entrance, crowds with junkies just standing in the doorway and they used to go in and out of the hall. We found a homeless guy sleeping in the shared area in the second floor. He was friendly, nothing wrong with him personally, but you never know who you run into. Definitely will not return. For the money paid you could choose a better hotel with better service.

Mike's a great communicator and very pleasant to interact with. I never met him, but seems nice over text. The place is about a 12-15 min walk from a subway station and is a corner unit in a part of town that is relatively unsafe. While the house and rooms have locks, the noise at night is unbearable. Sirens, people walking down the street, music, etc. It's very hard to sleep. There is also only one bathroom for 6-8 people which get's really bad, and it doesn't have hot water. The place is clean, and there were two towels, lots of pillows, etc, which I appreciate. The neighbours upstairs are really loud, and they walk around with shoes on so you can hear foot steps all night. Other guests mentioned this was not something that bothered them, so it could just be the blue room i stayed in. AC/fan would work sometimes, othertimes it just stayed cold. This place is survivable, just not livable. Also their are stains on the couches.
ArloNoMad is a very clean/comfortable stay. The staff is very nice. Parking can be a challenge & the homeless is around the area(no fault of theirs or the hotel).

This is a great find during a stressful time. My temporary "homelessness" was helped by feeling very comfortable here and having a great library space to do my work. Yes, the rooms are spare and small, but the beds are comfortable, the linens, towels  and most importantly the hospitality by the staff was nothing but top notch.  Also there is a fabulous roof deck for anyone who wants the full NYC experience. Any problem I had was addressed immediately and professionally. I would return in a heartbeat.

This apartment is exceptional! We loved every minute of our stay. Stylish & comfortable. You cannot have a better location-close to shopping, restaurants, bars, all main attractions & transport. This apartment will steal a bit of your heart. Cathy is an attentive host with A+++ communication. Do not hesitate to stay here.
Room was really tiny valet people are very rude asked me all these questions about my car thinking I was trying to steal. But other then that everything is fine
Ben is an excellent host, super responsive and really made the experience very easy and stress free

Where do I begin! Our stay with Juliette beat all expectations, and our standards are high.  The place: The entire place looked even better than the photos! Juliette's ability to find unique pieces and work them to fit her unique style is celebrated throughout the home. You will find yourself appreciating her curation and paying attention to the details. Our room and bathroom access are deep cleaned between visitors and the whole home is incredibly clean, even had some dressers available and closet space to store our belongings. The apartment sits on the street adjacent of a beautifully quaint park and has access to amazing bagels, bars, coffee, thrift, necessities, etc. within 5 min walking distance! Quick, immediate access to the subway made it easy for us to access all parts of the city and feel safe when getting home late.  The host: Juliette, a SUPERhost! Respectful of her home, visitors are not permitted much kitchen access, but every morning coffee/tea was set out for us to help ourselves and water bottles were set up for us to grab on the way out to our adventures. A sweet gesture we greatly appreciated.  If you need any pointers, or even if you don't i recommend asking, Juliette can provide all of the good spots! She provided us with various suggestions for food, drinks, shopping, tourist-ing and adhered to our interests. Incredible.  Her communication begins at booking and is clear, quick, and proactive!  Not to mention that our run ins with Juliette can be described as some of the most enjoyable coffee chats I have had the opportunity to engage in.  Incredibly grateful for the stay we had with Juliette in Brooklyn. Above and beyond human being. New York, Brooklyn, and Juliette have all stolen my heart-- you will be satisfied even if you leave with half of the experience we did.

The apartment itself was as described and suitable for what we required - clean. Very comfortable beds and everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Michel was very accommodating and quick to respond when we had any queries as well as letting us check out late which was wonderful. The only things to note is there is only one wardrobe so very little space for clothing if you have a long stay and the area although isnt unsafe, it isnt exactly anywhere you want to be walking around alone at night. Overall it was a good stay.
Very dark brown water. Could not shower, take a bath, or brush teeth the entire stay. Water got a little bit lighter but still had a tint to it. Very scary and unsafe water.

I stayed here for my birthday weekend. I first booked for just the weekend but then decided to book an extra day earlier. The place is nice I love the aesthetic of everything. The private terrace is such a good touch to the room. It’s super big! However, the bathroom situation wasn’t the best the shower is literally the floor with a dingy shower curtain ... The whole bathroom ended up wet everytime we’d shower it was super messy. I’m pretty sure the shower is made to be accessible for disablities but it’s super unsanitary and unsafe to have just the floor of the bathroom be the shower! A proper shower door would be the right fit for the shower. Over all I loved everything else. :)
The place is very nice and spacious, perfect for two people. However, the location was not my favorite, the neighborhood was a little dirty and a little dangerous.
Farrel was a nice host, uncomplicated and quick to respond. We had our own bathroom and a super large and comfortable bed. Unfortunately we felt a bit unsafe in the area at night.

I walked in and immediately found bugs on the floor. Thankfully I didn’t see any on the bed, and at least the bathroom felt clean. Communication from the host was good, but I don’t know if I would choose the location again, since even my Uber driver warned me before dropping me off that it can be a sketchy neighborhood at night. But hey, it was definitely cheap!
The location of the place is terrible, it is a dangerous area

My husband and I stayed in room A for two nights. The AC and fan in the room was magical in the 100 degree heat. People mention the subway being so close - and it really is. A 2 minute walk max.  Also a deli & chicken shop on the corner, perfect for breakfast or late night snacks back from a night out 😅You notice the sound every now and again, but with the fan on you barely notice it after a while. Some people mentioned feeling unsafe at night.. I don’t think those people have ever been to Brooklyn before 😅 we found the community to be really welcoming and said hello to us. We were even invited to a karaoke night by one of the neighbours listening to Music outside!  So don’t judge a book by it’s cover! The room was exactly as described. Bed was comfortable. We were given towels and wash cloths during our stay. The bathroom even has shampoo & conditioner available. The spacious room and location is great for the price compared to other things on air bnb. If you’re expecting luxury then it won’t be for you. But it’s definitely homely.

Farrel’s place is a great place to stay but you have to take several key points before going there. If your plan is to spend most of your time in NYC center or downtown you may consider you have almost 50 minutes of subway to commute, + ~10 walk to take it. That is about D line, for the 4th line is a bit worse as three lines share alternatively the same path, respectively 6-8-4 so you may have to wait 15-20 minutes to get the right one. This may change sensitively your journey. If you plan to go out for a party you may consider Uber to get home as walking late in the neighborhood is intimidating. I am not saying is unsafe because I don’t know, and it probably not! but it’s definitely something. Despite those concerns Farrel is really lovely host and his place is really worthy to consider especially for more than 4 days.

I stayed at Cesar's place for a month. The room was really nice and clean, and the A/C works well. Cesar is super responsive and accommodating.  The apartment was in a really good location for me. I could walk to work (Columbia) in about 20mins~ and there was a really nice grocery store (Fairway) about a 10 minute stroll away. Riverside park runs beside fairway, and it's a really nice place to go running and whatnot.  The 137th street 1 line Subway is super close to the apartment. About a five minute walk. Near there is a good coin laundry place.  I felt safe while I was there. I didn't do too many late night returns, but there were always people around. I didn't see anything sketchy. Folks seemed really nice in general (seems like a lot of families living there).  Thanks Cesar!

The place was not clean. The neighborhood isn't safe at all. The host doesn't help with the checking-in, and the pictures are deceptive, taken probably 4-5years back.  We moved out within 45minutes of reaching the Airbnb, because the rooms were not well-lit and the space seemed very unsafe.   Don't be fooled by the good communication skills of the Host, the place is not what you see.

Nice place in a new building in the middle of a happening neighborhood. We found amazing food and nice people all around. The main street has a sketchy vibe, very noisy, but maybe only for Europeans like us. The apt is in a cross street away from the noise. We liked our stay here, we got exactly what we came here for.
Walker is a great host and runs an overall clean place. The neighborhood is a little bit sketchy if you are alone at night.
Looks just like in the pictures, very clean and cozy.  You have sketchy people in the neighborhood, just like everywhere else in NYC but I felt safe and I was traveling alone.
The house is in a prime location. Everything we wanted to do was near us. Surrounded by great restaurants, bars, and stores. Host is very nice and easy going, gave us no stress at all.

She should be more careful with words, she advise me that is not allowed to drink or use drugs during staying, just because i went to the bathroom more than once when me and my wyfe come back from streets and we did small noise, but we need take shawer and after that we visit the bathromm once more, but of course that I'll never drink or use drugs inside or outside her house, we never use it. The bathroom had bad small and during the shawer the bathroom became as a swiming pool, i complain and she send someone to fix but day after the problem continue. I always have good experience in Airbnbbut at this time i was very disappointed, i can't understand how well she was evaluated before, for me was the worst experience and im totally discourage everyone who are thinking to go there. She also answer me when i complain that according the price shes doing the best to do everybody happy. Maybe she was in a bad day or bad mood but she realy make me feel upset about my staying.

The perfect little Brooklyn oasis. We had a great stay.  Chyanne and Jermaine were such wonderful hosts, responding to every request almost immediately.   Everything was immaculately clean, the beds were super comfortable, and the place was tastefully decorated.  Whilst the neighbourhood is not exactly pristine, there are plenty of parks and coffee shops within walking distance. We found everyone to be very friendly and we never once felt unsafe walking around with our 2 year old in tow.

Gabe is by far the most communicative  and easy going host I’ve ever stayed with.  From check in to check out, he made the whole stay a breeze. The apt was tidy and neat with tons of closet space.  You’ll be able to unpack and stash all your stuff for the stay.  The back Yard is beautiful- if it’s warm enough to enjoy- definitely take advantage of it. The apt is well insulated, so it’s nice and cozy- plus it’s easy to control the temp with the apartments own dedicated thermostat.  Also- Large comfy bed is a plus. Great option for tourists and short term visitors who will be out and about. (Note- no microwave in the unit, so reheating takeout is a task.) Just a short walk to busier avenues with subways and more plentiful food options.  Overall- a total steal for a clean, safe space and a place to cook simple meals before seeing the sights.

Overall a good experience. Very basic.  A few glitches when we checked in from the cleaning service but owner was prompt to contact them when I notified him.  Nice to have kitchen and laundry.  Neighborhood is a bit run down but did not feel unsafe. 10 min walk to subway, 30-40 min ride into the city.  Do note, if you plan to use pull out couch to sleep, it is in the front room which is on the street, a little noisy and the curtains in there are sheer so see thru and do not block light if you were planning to sleep past sunrise.

Despite the smell of the bedsheets , being given an incorrect code for the door the stay was nice and I peaceful. When I arrived with my son the host was unsure it was okay although I put for 2 people , however  unlike what she expected he made little to no noise, the place is as described a railroad style apartment . There’s an animal somewhere in the other apartment because it made scary noises at night . I would like to recommend that the host calls when its time for checkout instead of banging on the door like she is the police.

I thank jacqueline from the bottom of my heart .. we arrived quite late because of our flight and jacqueline received us in the best way it is. She was very responsive throughout our stay, the photos are consistent and the place is very clean. comfort is there. We thank you for your sympathy and your availability. I recommend   Je remercie Jacqueline du fond du cœur. Nous sommes arrivés assez tard à cause de notre vol et Jacqueline nous a reçus de la meilleure façon possible. Elle a été très attentive tout au long de notre séjour, les photos sont cohérentes et l'endroit est très propre. le confort est là. Nous vous remercions de votre sympathie et de votre disponibilité. je recommande

This was my first time staying in the Bronx and prior to my arrival, I was a bit concerned it would be too far from the inner city. When I arrived, Eric was present and gave me and my guest an extensive tour of the place as well as several recommendations on eateries and getting around. During our time, we found the commute to be incredibly easy as the Airbnb was only a couple blocks from the subway. There is also an express train that takes you into the city in no more than 30 minutes. In the evenings, I thought I might have to grab a car for our commute back but we found taking the subway was perfectly fine and quick! As for the space, it was really nice and cozy. The amenities were also great with a large TV, fire stick, and Alexa for weather updates, alarm, etc. I had not realized there would not be a door but this was not an issue and Eric assured us the space would be private and to ourselves. There were a couple of quirks to the space such as the fridge that made knocking noise every so often (didn't bother us) and a slight smell of gas coming from the oven. Eric made sure to mention this and noted it was something he was going to fix (the fridge) and instructed me to make sure the stove knob on the right had to be in a particular direction. I will be honest, the gas smell was a bit concerning to me as I realized later there was not a carbon monoxide detector reported on site. Hoping this is something that is present or will be added in the near future! I worry about these kinds of things but it was minor and ended up being fine. Overall, I would definitively recommend this space. It's steal for the location! I can't believe how inexpensive it is compared to many other Airbnb's in NYC. It was incredibly nicer than I expected and I hope to stay here again if I ever find myself back in the area. Thanks for an easy and great stay, Eric!

It technically is a safe place but it felt unsafe at times. The bathroom is pretty tight. There was noise here and there throughout the night so if you're a light sleeper, bring ear plugs. Other then that, shes a great host. It's a great location. Parking is amazing. The bed is very comfortable.

The apartment is close to the metro, OK. The refrigerator makes an intermittent noise, this is bad. Cleaning is just where the "priest passes", it could be cleaner. Comfortable and heated apartment. Check in was Ok, at the scheduled time he was there to receive you. Eric ONLY responds via messaging from the airbnb app! In a moment of emergency, I looked for him personally and was scared by the aggressive way in which we were treated, he didn't pay attention and sent a message on the app right away. Could be more human and empathetic. This left us scared for the rest of the days.

This place  is absolutely perfect for a solo or couple traveler. It You arrive late, there are automatic lights which will guide your way to the private entrance, which was such a nice touch! It was sparkling clean! A great sofa for lounging. Such a comfortable bed. All the necessities such as coffee, tea, electric boiler, dishes/cooking wear, and plenty of clean towels! There are several grocery stores, drug stores, and laundromat nearby to meet your needs. You are right near the Metra stop which is a quick ride into Manhattan. Otherwise if you’re staying in the area, there’s the buses as well. I really enjoyed my stay here. This is great value for the amenities! The host is also very accommodating, kind, and responded promptly. I highly recommend this stay! Thank you Queen!

Queen's place was clean and cozy. The pictures are pretty accurate, except that the window in the bedroom was boarded up during our stay. The apartment is in a basement, so there are some narrow steps that you need to take before you go in. It wasn't a big issue for me, but it could be an issue for someone with disabilities.  There is a parking spot on site available. However, we were asked to move the car to street parking after we unloaded our belongings. I asked if we could stay in the driveway if we couldn't find a spot, and Queen graciously said yes. However, we were able to find a spot right in front of the house the next day so it was all good.  There is a full kitchen with stove and fridge and microwave, as well as cooking utensils, pots and pans. We were able to cook pretty easily there.   The living space is a comfy sofa with a dining table and TV console. The sofa was big and comfy, but could have used a few more cushions.  The bedroom was a comfortable and clean as well. There is a sign on the door asking guests to keep the door open for the heat to flow through, which we did. There is a small space heater in the bedroom as well.  We enjoyed our stay, and the only minor hiccups we had were that we were quite cold at the beginning of our stay, so we asked Queen if we could turn the heat higher. She recommended that we use the space heater and let the air flow from the heater in the bathroom to the rest of the space, which helped. After that, it was noticeably warner but you might still want to bring extra sweaters if you get cold easily like me.  We also weren't provided with much dish soap and only 1 roll of paper towels, so we ended up needing to go out to purchase more since Queen was away from the house (it was Christmas, which is understandable, but it would have been great if a family member could have come to give us more instead). Queen did help us get more dish soap the next day, but by then we had already gotten more supplies ourselves.  At the end of our stay, Queen unlocked and opened our door 20 mins before checkout time, thinking we were already gone, which startled me a bit but she went back outside after she heard me say we weren't ready. I'm not sure if she knocked, but I was scared and wish that she had called or texted me first to let me know she was coming downstairs.   The cleaning person came in 5 mins early, which made us feel a bit rushed. We left at 11:07, which was 7 mins past checkout time but Queen was gracious enough to not hurry us out and just told us to let the cleaning person inside to start cleaning.   Overall, the minor hiccups were just that - small and mostly fine. This space is great and we enjoyed our time at the Airbnb.

Not new to staying in Airbnb homes. I have have some great and some not so great. Prior to writing anything negative, I would call the host and share my thoughts about what did not work so well.  I have to say this particular experience was very unpleasant, I will share it as it is.  My husband and I froze in the apartment for the entire weekend. There was a heater in the bedroom ceiling close to the headboard working like a vent and that was not good. Hot air on your head while you sleep.   The leaving room area was an ice box and and another heater that was not working most of the time. Queen (host) came twice to address the issue. It did not work. I have to say that she (host) was available and came to help us.   The heating system was not working properly and it is not the best system for the home.  The couch was very hard. My daughter came to spend the night but could not sleep on the  Couch because it was so hard.   The mattress in the bedroom was too high I'm 5'7 and struggled.

Like any other accommodation source, typical AirBnB entries strive to set my expectations higher than reality, but Ryan’s description was nothing but honest and accurate. I was surprised to find a place that appeared exactly like the photos, and in some ways, better than expected. Spottlessly clean, not a bit sketchy or uncomfortable in any way. Definitely the best value I’ve encountered in NY regardless of where I’ve shopped for accommodations.

Summary - had everything I needed to accomplish the goal of my visit and then some. :)  Great location, great restaurants and nearby market came in handy. Loved Brooklyn! I mostly explored locally so things were fairly walkable. Owner and team was responsive and helpful, and I wasn’t afraid to ask for what I needed. Cool speaker that I connected to my calming Bluetooth music to drown out the ignore-able beeping noise. Also I didn’t realize til after that there looks to be a way to  connect to the WiFi through the Airbnb app itself, so make sure you get that squared away and understand how to do that Before you book if connectivity going to be a big issue for you. Luckily for me, it wasn’t :) bed was comfortable and space felt decently clean, I enjoyed using the tea kettle and making tea on cold days. Appreciated the light dimmer settings as well. That’s it, I hope this thorough feedback has helped you! I know it helps me.

it was a really awful house, there were people making noise all day long in the common area, people snoring in the common area until the morning. In addition, it was not specified that there was a common sharing area. The housekeeper, on the other hand, was a very rude person, asked us for a $25 tip because we were a little late at check-out, he said threatening words to us. In addition, the people in the neighborhood are quite dangerous, in short, I do not recommend this house to anyone.

Beautiful ground level location within a residential neighborhood close to everything near Fort Greene!  We loved being able to walk out the front door and immediately enjoy the wide, shady, tree-lined boulevard (in my opinion, one of the loveliest streets in all of Fort Greene). This is truly a residential area just off the main thoroughfare, so no loud or constant car traffic.  The unit was just as described.  I found the previous reviews helpful in setting initial expectations.  One crucial tip, as this wasn't obvious to us for some reason; you must push the button to the right of the front entrance doors  to exit.  It is clearly marked "PUSH TO EXIT".  The kitchen worked well for us to store a few refrigerated beverages, some yogurt and leftover take out.  Nice stock of glasses for our morning tea, happy hour wine and bourbon on the rocks. The electric teakettle was very much appreciated.  There was even some ice already made in the freezer.  The weather was so nice during our stay, we wondered why nobody puts a couple chairs out and sits in their front "yard"? (Perhaps it's not a Brooklyn thing as we come from the land of Adirondacks and firepits) We tried out Gary's excellent tv and sound bar system and watched the Michigan football game on a lovely fall Saturday evening. The blackout shades were very much appreciated as well as the very comfy mattress. Thanks for a lovely stay!

Everything about Frances’ place is as described and pictured. His place is located exactly where you want to be. Perfect walking distance to almost any attraction. It’s perfect size for 2 people and it was nice having access to the rooftop etc.  It was nice that the building had keyed entry. I can’t stress how great the location is. Right by all the great food. You must try Briciola & Maria Pia. Both great Italian restaurants right by the apartment. Thanks again Frances!

This is a great value for the price. The place was kept spotless and there is plenty of space. Also, an easy ride on the J train directly into downtown, which was very convenient. Check-in was very easy. The only downside is that the area around the apartment felt a little unsafe at night.

Multiple rooms in a shared apartment are rented out, so that the common spaces are shared with other people renting through airbnb. Each bedroom has its own additional lock. The space was clean throughout our trip and I always felt safe in my room. For a couple nights while we were staying here, we had some extremely noisy neighbors who used the common spaces a lot. Of course, this isn't a problem with Adeyemi or the apartment, and it was actually quite calm and quite for the rest of our stay.  I felt slightly unsafe walking around the area after dark, but for the most part didn't have any problems. The location is extremely close to two different subway lines which made transportation extremely easy.

It is a very quiet, very clean, very pleasant accommodation, in an area where you can move around alone in complete safety, day and night. The subway is a 5-minute walk away and takes you to Bushwick collective (the most beautiful graffiti in New York) in 2 minutes, (and also its best tacos restaurant Dos hermanos), then to Williamsburg in 10 minutes, and to Manhattan in 20-25 minutes. If you like Latin American cuisine, you will be spoiled for choice. For breakfast I recommend the Variety café, a hipster spot, with pastries to die for. Not speaking English very well, I communicated with Art, in Spanish. She is a very welcoming person, very kind, very pleasant, very available, very generous, very attentive and very discreet. My flight was unfortunately an hour late and he waited patiently for me until more than 1 a.m. when he had to get up at 5:30 a.m. to run the Brooklyn half-marathon. My stay with him enchanted me.

Good value for a cheap stay in NY, however, there are some things worth mentioning: - connection to Manhattan is really good, you have three different subway stations within walking distance - however, neighbourhood seems kind of sketchy and we did not feel 100% secure, I recommend not hanging around alone at night (esp. if you’re female) - the washer and dryer are in the basement and cost 7$ per load We had some (major) issues with the cleaning guy. After a small incident we reached out to the host for help who, apparently, then complained to the housekeeper. He came to us and was shitting on us for about 45min and it would have went on if we hadn’t been leaving. Next to blaming us ‘not to follow the rules’ he even accused us of being racist without any reason while being sexist himself as he would ignore me only talk to my boyfriend. He threatened us that he could easily access our room and steal our stuff because he has the keys and told as that he knows what it’s like to ‘not follow the rules’ as he has been to prison for 6 years. When we checked out he kind of apologised but through the stay, he definitely did not make us feel secure. It was overall one of the worst things I had to experience at airbnbs.  Adeyemi was a great host, very helpful, quick replying and friendly. If it wasn’t for the housekeeper I would come again!
The zone it’s a little dangerous but it has easy communication with the transportation

When booking this place it is important to remember that you are paying probably the cheapest price in New York city. The place it's self is clean, and the bathroom had everything I needed for my stay. The building was nice and the doorman very friendly and helpful. The bedroom was probably what you would expect for $20 a night.. small, unsafe and uncomfortable. I'm sure if it was below 80° I would have had a chance of sleeping but unfortunately it was a hot few days and the desk fan didn't suffice. The bad was uncomfortable and also blocked the door meaning you have to climb over the bed to get into the room (the photos used really flatter the room, with one taken from outside the room and the others with the bed moved). The one outlet in the room was very loose which made it hard to plug things in. All of the above mentioned things however are what I would expect for the price, therefore I would recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a budget trip to NYC! If you are looking for luxury (or safety) then maybe this isn't the place for you!

Summer or Winter- this is the place to be. I’m afraid to keep up the great reviews because I don’t want anyone else stealing it from me lol Seriously, Sandra and her family are great hosts and this room is a wonderful cozy little place to rest your head when visiting NYC. Have you all that you need for a safe comfortable stay! I don’t need any other place. I really don’t.

This location is walking distance(<5minutes) from 2 metro lines. We have used both of them during our 4 day stay and it was super convenient. The accomodation is located in nice street.
