Sharing their apartment with us was a port in the storm. Thanks too, to Stephanie who, it turns out knows our godson...Small world made pleasant by a lovely place to stay. With thanks Mary and Sandy!!!

Excellent location in the center of Manhattan and 5 minutes from Union Square, with several subway lines, many restaurants, market, supermarket... Very safe area, I was alone and at no time was I afraid. Excellent price quality. The apartment and the room are small, but enough to spend a few days in NY, as the accommodation is mainly used for sleeping. The room is not noisy because it faces an interior patio, you can only hear an air conditioning motor or similar from time to time. The only drawbacks would be that the shower faucet didn't work well, but they are waiting to fix it, and the building is old, has very narrow hallways and there is no elevator. Casper is a good host, responds quickly and is very flexible. In my case, he had no problem with me leaving my suitcase on the floor outside of check-in and check-out hours.

What made this place perfect for us was its location. My daughter was moving into the dorm right next-door, and it was very nice to not have to worry about having all of her door move-in stuff with us when we first got her key. There are significant steps and they are steep, but for us it was worth it to have to carry the luggage up and down just to be so close to Sty.  Other than that, the place worked just fine. Comfortable bed,  excellent air conditioning in the bedroom, pleasant atmosphere. Nothing fancy but it met all of our needs on this stressful move-in weekend. We particularly appreciate Casper letting us let him know at the last minute which nights one of us would be sleeping there, and which nights there would be two of us.

I didn’t stay with Casper, but instead, Joey. He was great and super kind, in fact we had opposite schedules so we saw each other twice over the duration of the stay, so basically like an apartment to yourself. I’m a 20 year old gal travelling by herself, the neighbourhood was amazing. Tons of young people, close to everything and I never felt unsafe at anytime! The bedroom is a perfect size, I had room for my luggage and everything, I could only see it being a problem if you had like 3 huge bags, but even then it would work. Shower was clean, bathroom clean, everything was great. I would 100% recommend staying here, especially if you are younger looking for a safe and reliable area :)

Hakim is a great host . i was afraid in the beginning lol only because i got lost but once i got to correct location it felt like home. for a guy i must say his home is so put together i love the room and so peaceful and privacy. Hakim made me feel very welcome . his home is very clean he ‘s a perfect host. thank you again for welcoming me
We had great time at her apartment. The room is very near to subway station, drug store, cafe and so on. Especially she is very kind to us! Thank you very much De!

Loved Kareem's home. His apartment looks exactly like his photos. I felt like I was in a trendy hotel. The key exchange was painless and though he wasn't there to give me entry his neighbor Adam was really nice and accommodating.   The neighborhood is typical Uptown/Washington Heights. If urban areas scare you then don't visit New York.   All in all I loved it. It was my first Airbnb experience and I've been singing is praises ever since.   Oh yeah and the apartment is literally on top of a wine shop! How much more awesome can it get. We were in town for my mom's birthday weekend and made much use of our downstair neighbor! Lol

Great place to stay when visiting New York! To be honest, I was a little nervous to stay in Harlem coming from the Midwest, but we never once felt unsafe and the area is really neat to explore. You’ll be within a block of a subway station, which we took downtown every day. The host is very quick to respond and will answer any questions you have about exploring the city, check in troubles, etc.!
I liked very much the apartment and easy access to line 1. Supermarket and liquor store just around the corner. The area is not nice but We did not feel unsafe at any time

Stay at Manon place was the best choice I could have done. It was my first time with airbnb: we are not talking about spending less money than an hotel (even in NY really helps considering prices and quality of hotels), but we are talking about travelling for real, that for my point of you is about discovering new place and  meeting people in a easy way without the stress to feel like a tourist. Manon and her friend Maelliz really help to make me feel confortable and I can just really thanks them for their afford. the location is really quite and with the underground (just behind the corner) you can reach all different nice area in Brooklyn or Manatthan or Coney Island. I'm sure that I will be back!  Geniale, prima volta con Airbnb e ho avuto la fortuna di essere ospitato da Manon per un weekend a Brooklyn. la location è perfetta, in 20 minuti a Soho e altrettanti per Coney Island, la metro giusto dietro l'angolo così facile da utilizzare. l'appartamento è esattamente come nelle foto. il valore aggiunto sono Manon e la sua coinquilina Maelliz, super socievoli  e veramente disponibili nell'aiutarti in tutto. se pensate che viaggiare sia legato al vivere esperienze "normali", vivere una città non come un turista e conoscere persone nuove consiglio vivamente questa sistemazione.

We loved Kareem's apartment, the art and vibe were great. We were able to get around to all the sites pretty easily. If you are driving and haven't driven in NY just be aware the parking (or should I say other people double parking) can make things a little stressful.

The booking had been made early in March, and the host had been informed of the approximate time of our arrival in advance, by email. However, when my colleague arrived, on the afternoon of the 25th March, in the pouring rain, he found that the host was not at the flat. He attempted to call her, but she did not answer the phone, and he was unable to leave voicemail as the service was full. He then messaged me, (I had just landed in Newark) and I attempted to contact her, and sent an sms. Finally, by contacting a friend who also rents through Air BnB, we were able to contact the host, who arrived at about 19.30. By this time, we had been waiting in the rain for two hours. On entering the flat, we discovered that it had not been cleaned, and that the bedclothes had not been changed. The refrigerator only had some diet coke. The host apologised profusely, and we left her to clean the flat while we went to find some food. The following morning the toilet blocked. Again, we were unable to contact her on the number she had provided, but realised that she in fact lived in the neighbouring flat! My colleague had had to use the towels provide in the flat to clean the mess in the bathroom. We left for work, and she promised to have everything clean by the time we came back. That evening I found that she had left one of the dirty towels festering in the bathtub. Not only that, but she had not supplied fresh towels for the other bedroom. The evening of the 29th we returned to find a greyish powder in the bathtub (see image). It turned out to be some chemical cleaning product which had not been rinsed. Late that night, my friend had an infestation of ants in his room. Fortunately, we were leaving the following morning. In addition to this catalogue of disasters, the flat was shabby, with an unprotected light fitting and a rusted, disused heater in the bathroom. (See images) It was poorly equipped, the coffee percolator needed to be balanced on a chair to reach the plug socket, and although the sheets had been changed in one room, we suspect that the single bed had not been changed. I have used Air BnB on many occasions, and in general have been pleased with the standards of the apartments, the helpfulness of the hosts, and the easy of using the service. This experience has left a bitter taste. I realise that the location of the property is highly desirable, but the apartment and attention were severely sub-standard.  Frankly, had we been able to leave, we would have done, but having a heavy work schedule and a tight budget meant that we felt obliged to stay and out up with the indignities.

I stayed in this apartment with a friend of mine for six nights and had a pleasant experience overall. We mainly communicated with our hosts through AirBnb, and had a brief chat with Tom upon departure. They were pretty helpful with the arrival instructions and also had a small document about the neighborhood in the place.   The apartment is on the ground floor of a house. It's located in a diverse neighborhood with a variety of shops and restaurants (mainly Spanish) in the vicinity. We did not feel threatened or unsafe in the neighborhood any way (although some of the adjacent neighborhoods that we saw on our way there seemed sketchy). The place has adequate amount of space for two people. The bathroom and kitchen were quite nice and clean. We found the microwave and the full-size fridge quite useful. It seemed well decorated and even had some books to read. They had a box that contained travel adapters as well which can be pretty helpful.  The downsides are that the place doesn't get too much sunlight, the portable AC isn't powerful enough for really hot summers and the queen bed may feel small for two people (but there is an extra bed in the room).   Overall, for the given amount of rent and the location it was a good experience.

All as expected. Great value. If you need a 2-bedroom place and don’t want to pay $600 for a real suite at a hotel, this place will work just fine. Very convenient location. Can catch a taxi in 15 seconds at west end avenue- a 30 sec walk from the place. The window ACs worked fine. You might want to lower the window shade a bit over them so they don’t blow directly at you when you on the bed. Don’t expect a chef’s kitchen there, but then who needs it. There is a sink and a microwave which is pretty much all you need to wash fruit and warm up restaurant leftovers. The fridge is newer and good size. The place isn’t exactly spacious but then what do you expect in Manhattan? It still cost probably well over a mil to buy. Short answer: if I needed to stay in Manhattan again and didn’t want to spend $1,200 more than this price on a hotel suite, I’d definitely stay there again.

We had a very good stay in New York. Tamar left us her apartment. It is fully equipped, it feels like home, we haven't missed anything. It can easily accommodate 6 people, two double beds and two bunk beds. As it is specified in the advertisement, the apartment is on the 3rd floor (4 for Americans because they count the ground floor as a floor) without elevator and at the end of the day it is a little difficult to go back up! The neighborhood is very Hispanic, a little noisy but we didn't feel in danger. There are two metro stations nearby. I highly recommend this accommodation.
A bit out of the way  No real amenities near by  Found it a bit unsafe for my liking  Long train ride to any attractions

Shahar's apartment was a perfect base for us to discover New York. The subway is handy, there are many restaurants and food stores in the vicinty and Central Park is just a short walk away. The apartment is very well-equipped and the bed comfortable. I would recommend this address highly. Note that it was practical being able to pick the keys up from the concierge, which meant there was no stress over our time of arrival.

Shahar's apartment was as advertised - very comfortable, clean and nicely decorated. It was nice to have a full kitchen, closet space and  bureau with drawer space in the bedroom, a desk and printer for the laptop and a flat screen TV with a DVR. His building has an elevator, good laundry facilities and a 24/7 person at the front door where we picked up the keys upon arrival.   We emailed Shahar, as he was out of town, to inquire if there was an iron in the apartment so we could press some clothes. He replied that he did not have one but he ordered one and it would arrive the next day and it did. An ironing board arrived two days later. That is very thoughtful and great service.  The apartment is very well located for the subway, good restaurants, a drug store and only a 10 minute walk to Central Park.  We would definitely return here on our next New York visit.  Paul & Dianne

Our stay in this apartment was great, and everything was provided for a long trip (washing machine, dishwasher, fridge etc.). The apartment was situated in a very convenient location (3 metro lines a few metres away), with a lot of shops around it (10mn max), it had a really great AC (I was afraid that it would not be enough with August heat but that was not the case!), and was really spacious for two people with big suitcases.  We stayed 10 nights in this apartment and never had any issue, whether it was about noise, heat or anything.  Kakuna was really nice and helpful as I received a package at her place, thank you again Kakuna :)  We really recommend this great apartment and will probably be back when we visit New York again :)

This was an amazing apartment and was just as described and looked on the photos. Shahar left detailed instructions on how and where to collect the keys and how to work the appliances.  Although we did not meet Shahar, we got a welcome email from him and he was only a message away if we needed him. I had previously asked for recommendations of where to eat, shops in the local area and he gave us great suggestions which we tried and were not disappointed with. Our favourite was Zabar's. What a shop, so many good things to choose from.  The bed and pillows in the apartment were soooooo comfy we had no trouble sleeping.  The location was perfect for us as first time visitors to the city as it was so central and only a couple of blocks from the subway.  We bought a subway pass for a week and made good use of it and also the apartment is only a short walk to Central Park.  We would have no hesitation in recommending this apartment to anyone.  Shahar also kindly let us leave our luggage in the apartment on our last day after check out time as our flight left in the evening. That gave us time to get last minute gifts stress free. We would want to stay in the apartment again if we visit New York in the future. Thank you so much Shahar.

We had a great time staying with Jay. The place was clean and he was glad to help us with anything we needed. We felt very welcome and enjoyed talking and joking around with him. The location is good, as you are quite close to two metro stations, but still the streets are quiet and there's no need to be scared. Grocery store on the way to/from subway and a lot of places to eat in walkable distance. We definitely recommend this place!

Didn't get to meet her in person, but the host was very helpful and the response were very quick. The apt. location was easy to find, the building was clean and tidy, it was close to the subway so access to the city was seamless and easy. Maybe because of the heat of summer, when arrived the house had some unpleasant odors, but fixable by opening windows and some air fresheners. Overall, great value and good location is the main attraction of this house. Would reccomend for and affordable, nice stay in the city.

BEWARE: THE CAT IN THIS APARTMENT IS VICIOUS AND ATTACKED ME WHILE I SLEPT.   I wish I had a better review for Zachary, who was very helpful before I arrived to the apartment, accommodated my arrival time, and has a lovely apartment that is much larger and more comfortable than most other airbnbs I've stayed in in NYC.   However, Zachary asks his guests to take care of his cat, and asks specifically that you leave the bedroom door open at all times so the cat does not scratch the door or whine. On my second night, while I was sleeping, the cat pounced on me and viciously attacked my arms and hands, leaving me with horribly painful and deep scratches that required lots of antiseptic and bandages.   Prior to that, the cat had been quite confrontational and had scratched and bit at me as well.   I would only recommend this unit if you are a cat owner and very comfortable dealing with them.

I've used AirBnB only abroad and typically for stays of at least one to three months. I've never shared an apartment, instead, always opting for a place of my own. Boy have I been missing out!  I arrived in NYC not knowing it was the week in which schools and universities held their graduations. There was not a hotel room to be had for less than $800, if there was one to be had at all.   I reached out to Erika at the last minute, and she jumped into action to get the room ready for me unexpectedly after the previous guest had just left.   After a long and stressful day, Erika's place was like a spa filled with delightful energy. It was spotless. I'm typically allergic to dogs, and there was not a hair anywhere.   If you're lucky enough to stay with Erika, be ready to hear interesting stories and spend time with someone who you'll want to become a friend. I seriously nearly booked extra days just to hang out some more.   I look forward to visiting again. Erika's home will definitely be my home away from home in Brooklyn.   I could not recommend this lovely home more.

My husband and I made our first ever trip to NYC and it was made better and more memorable by staying at Ben's apartment.  Extremely close to everything we needed (restaurants, bars, subway, coffee, etc.), Ben's apartment offered a stress-free and extremely convenient stay for our four-day trip, even though we weren’t in the apartment much.  The apartment is clean, extremely comfortable, and offers all the amenities one would need while staying in NYC.  We didn’t use the kitchen much but it was nice to have and the bathroom is extremely spacious for a studio apartment.  The A/C unit was particularly nice considering the odd, warm October weather we experienced.  The outside noise at night could be less desirable for those who are light sleepers but, let’s be honest, it’s New York- get used to it.  I, personally, found myself right at home and my husband who is a lighter sleeper didn’t seem to mind too much.  The location of the apartment is ideal: safe and as I stated earlier, close to everything you could need.  My husband and I were easily able to tour NYC all day and take the subway or cab back to the apartment to change for dinner.  In the morning, we could stop in at Starbuck’s on 8th and 16th for some much needed caffeine before crawling down the subway entrance right outside the door.  Ben was a gracious host and considering that we arrived to the apartment 30 minutes earlier than expected (and in the wee hours of the morning) he was extremely accommodating and easy to get a hold of.  Pre-arrival instructions were easy to follow and although we kept missing each other over the phone, we were able to get everything sorted out via email which ended up being better so I could refer back to it!  Again, Ben’s place only enhanced our first New York experience and considering this was our first time using AirBnB- we could not be happier.  As a host, Ben was awesome and made us feel very welcome.  Thank you, Ben, and we look forward to connecting with you again!!

Paulo was very friendly and helpful. It was our first AirBnB experience and we weren't sure what to expect....but Paulo made sure everything we needed was in place. Although our schedule didn't overlap with his, he messaged to make sure things were going smoothly.  The place was very clean with all the basics included as advertised. It is close to subways and various restaurants, a drug store, coffee shops etc. We were very pleased with everything.

My sisters and I stayed at Neil and Katie's to celebrate a milestone birthday of one in our number. Neil and Katie were super responsive from the beginning -- texting me immediately upon receiving my messages. Their home was as advertised -- clean, well appointed. It was wonderful to "pretend" to be NYC-dwellers for the day -- and save a little bit of money by making most of our meals in. As another reviewer noted, this is a very happening neighborhood, very close to public transportation. We never felt unsafe. I would stay again and would recommend it to others in a heartbeat.

Clara is a great host who met us at her apartment  and showed us how to work everything. She also left us treat. She is very personable and made us feel at home. The apartment is fascinating and comfortable. We enjoyed exploring the multicultural artwork and artifacts.  The neighborhood is quiet. It is a five minute walk to subway and ten minutes to Flatiron District.  There is a grocery around the corner, coffee shops on all corners and drug store within one block.
Very reasonable accomodation with good value/price ratio. Excellent location. Don't have to be scared of the shared bathroom, Ken never used that when we were present.

Just WOW! What a fabulous apartment. To say it is in the heart of the West Village for the "real" New York experience was an understatement! What a diverse, unique, charming, vibrant neighborhood. Tons of shops, bars, night clubs etc with an amazing live Jaz den right across the street. Sat on the stoop later in the evening and was captivated simply people watching.  The apartment was clean and welcoming with some great history and 3xactly as described.  Communication with Neil and Katie was the best I've had and made the whole experience stress-free. I would stay here again any time. 10 out of 10 for the whole experience. Loved it!

I must admit that we got a bit of a false start when we got to the apartment. There was a lot of garbage (including a family of rats) outside and worst of all, the key that was send to us didn't work. Fortunately, a neighbor came to the rescue and let us in. With the keys in the key box we could enter the house. Probably because of the garbage outside, but inside the hall and inside the house there was a really unpleasant smell. Neil&Katie were really easy in contact and offered a lot of help (including a cleaning service asap) to solve this problem. The apartment itself was not really what I expected, but I think I got my hopes up from all the super positive reviews. The apartment is old, and there are a lot of 'stuff' in there. Although it is clean, it doesn't feel really clean, due to old furniture etc. The bathroom could use some work.  However, besides these negatives, there are a lot of positives. First of all, the location. Wow. You are in the best neighborhood to sleep (and thus to eat and drink and walk around etc) in. The house of the popular show 'Friends' and the house of Carrie from ‘SATC’ is just around the corner. There are a million nice bars, coffee shops and it is just lovely to walk around. The apartment is 'big', with two separate bedrooms (the bed I slept on was really good!!) and a big living area. As stated in the description, there is noise from outside, but just bring your earplugs and you will be okay. And one thing you do not want to miss; the rooftop! The view is extraordinary. As stated in the description, it is “unfinished”, but that is half the charm. Just take a beer and a book upstairs, don’t get your hopes up, and enjoy the view and the feeling that you are really really really in New York.  Neil&Kate were great hosts, even though I didn’t get to see them in person. It is easy to get in contact with them and they are really helpful.  To make a long story short; I would love to stay with Neil&Kate again, but not in this apartment.

My second visit to this marvellous property. As usual, the hosts are fantastic and very responsive, helpful and accommodating in every way.  More than happy to assist with all queries we had and were very organised, they personally made sure we were settled properly when we arrived, and offered to help in any way possible. The apartment was spotless when we arrived, and was ready on time.   The apartment is absolutely flawless - perfect location to all nearby places of interest and popular areas, public transport, etc and has an amazing view of Central Park and is very spacious throughout. Laundry and Kitchen appliances/equipment are top notch which makes cooking one's own food easy and enjoyable if so desired. If you prefer to eat out, there is no end to nearby places to eat, and we were very impressed with Ocean Grill 20 blocks towards lower Manhattan on the same street. Whole Foods over the road is very convenient, they sell fantastic quality food and wine, and although a little expensive, still cheaper than catching a taxi to a cheaper supermarket. Duane Reade pharmacy downstairs is 24 hour and sell anything that comes to mind. We even got some documents printed there.   TV and entertainment system in the apartment is also very new and state of the art, smartphone & tablet compatible. Internet is provided, and it is fast.   I have stayed here both in warm climates and in cold, and the heating in the cold climates was more than sufficient.   Beds and linen are all provided and are VERY comfortable, and unlike most hotel rooms or other apartments in NYC, there is enough space to be comfortable even with a suitcase or two on the floor. Spaciousness is one of this apartment's biggest advantages considering how small some other places are.   There is little or no noise in the area to disturb the peace of the apartment - the added bonus of being 16 floors up.   Neighbourhood seems quite safe, and I suspect there is a police station a block away, as there are always a lot of police cars parked there. Hailing a taxi on Columbus Ave was never a problem, even on a Friday night.   Overall, this is an absolutely perfect 2 bedroom place to stay for any length of time in NYC. I cannot fault it or say a bad word about it, and I look forward to hopefully returning in the future.  Thanks Johno and Danny.

We had a great time thanks to this apartment.  It has several advantages:   - Air conditioning (vital in summer in New York) - Very well located in Brooklyn, but also for the whole city (next to major metro lines) - Quiet, you don't feel the stress of traffic or the constant noise - There are all the shops you need within 5 minutes - It has everything you need to cook on site  We will return and highly recommend it to anyone who would like a good experience in New York.

Valentine's home was just what we where looking for our stay in NY City. It was a home and not just any hotel room, and we enjoyed his place very much. The location was perfect for us. The subway station Marcy Av was just a few minutes from  the apartment, and in 15 minutes we where in Central Park. We explored Williamsburg, mostly by foot and it was  less stressful than Manhattan. On Bedford Av it was lots of cafes, restaurants, bars and shops. We met a lot of nice, open minded and helpful people during our week in NY. Skinny Dennis was a great place to hang out, especially if you like Honky tonk and country music

We stayed in Gila's apartment for about four weeks. She was very accommodating, responsive and very helpful about remedying the minor problem. Instructions were explicitly stated in the house and, moreover, it was easy to communicate with her. The location of the apartment is good, close to the subway, easy for shopping, laundry, etc., and to get everywhere in the city, and the neighborhood is very safe. We were surprised by the small dimensions of the studio, as the very artistic pictures of every corner, appearing at the web, does not help figuring out the whole size of the flat. Nevertheless, the studio is very nicely decorated and there is enough space for two people. The bed is very comfortable, and water pressure in the shower is amazing. There is a desk perfect for working with a laptop on it, and the Wi-Fi is really powerful.  However, it is to stand out that the surface electrical wiring scattered around the apartment was messy and, in our opinion, it could be unsafe.  We believe this would need to be solved for this flat to be fully recommendable.

Paige is a very gracious host who nonetheless respects guests' privacy. The beds are comfy, the AC works, the location is outstanding. Quick walk to park, bus lines, subway, great restaurants, grocery and drug stores. Apartment could use some renovation--but couldn't we all? Safe neighborhood with kindly doormen, efficient elevators.

Overall Gila's place was in a great location, we got around everywhere really easily as there are about 4 subway stops all close by. It also had everything we needed in it. We had a little difficulty getting into the apartment which was stressful, but then eventually worked it out. There is in fact an iron in the place, it was crossed off the list so we ended up getting out own but did not need it in the end. The only thing I would say is that it's quite hard to get fresh air into the apartment as the windows seem a little jammed.  All in all it was a good stay.

Me and my husband spent 2 weeks at Gila's apartment. Excellent location! Very close to Little Italy, SOHO, East side and easy access to almost every subway line. The apartment was very nice and cosy.  We could not reach Gila via Airbnb and her mobile before our arrival, so it was a bit stressful. We did not meet her personally, but communication via e-mail was easy during our stay.. Due to a problem with cleaning service, there was no clean towels and pillow cases, but Gila helped us immediately to solve the problem.    We recommend this place to other guests.  Sena & Muzo

The time with Roberto was definitely too short. As a host he is perfect in his openly interested way - without being stressful in any way. His tips for NY certainly saved us around $200 - $300. The apartment is safe, is perfectly located to the metro and buses and there are some good Mexican, Puerto Rican and small shops for buying groceries in the immediate vicinity. We will definitely stay at Roberto's next time we visit NY. Thank you again Roberto - it was a great time with you.

Lower east side adjoining Chinatown and Little Italy. Comfortable space for two. Whole Foods, Essex Market close by. 3 doors to get through and you never feel unsafe.  Handy to Delancey St subway stop.

Roberto kept everything as before down to the last detail and was very nice about it. Although Roberto is also in the apartment, he is almost invisible.  The apartment is, although it's almost hard to believe, exactly as shown in the photos.  It should be taken into account that you are in the metropolis of New York and that the city is also easy to hear, as windows in the States are generally not super insulated.  The location is a bit more relaxed and the buildings are not adjacent to skyscrapers. There are train stations in the surrounding area, but the area itself offers a lot. Madison Avenue is very long and is already a street with countless shops as you walk towards the city center.  By the way, there is absolutely nothing to be afraid of Harlem. Peaceful. Very relaxed.  All in all a great value for money, cheap and good accommodation and yet quite central.

We spent 19 days in Jack's studio and our overall experience was great: small but cute and cozy place, fully furnished with sheets, towels and kitchen equipment. The only minus is the income hall, it's not very well taken care of and the stairs are a little narrow/scary. The fridge was full when we arrived and we had enough food for breakfast for 2 weeks! Furthermore Jack checked in regularly to see if we needed anything, he's the kind of person you can trust at first sight, very kind and helpful. I strongly recommend the place and Jack as a host.

Jack provided a wonderful apartment for us, apart from the perfect location, his place was spotlessly clean and full of little extras which made our stay extremely comfortable and stress free... the fridge was stock with basics, the bathroom too, plenty of towels, hairdryer and a couple of heaters in case it got chilly. Jack even arranged a crib for our baby which was so kind of him. The iphone was an absolute treat to be able to use and Jack was so easy to get in touch with and genuinely cared about how comfortable during our stay with him. A superior host and would highly recommend his apartment!

Our stay at Karl and Catherine was not only our first time in NY city, but also our very first airbnb experience...and it was great!The location is perfect: the neighborhood is very quiet - but not sketchy at all - and very well connected to Manhattan. The room and the bathroom are just as pictured in the add: spacious and comfortable.  Karl and Catherine are truly great hosts. Even though we asked them to stay at their place at the very last minute and we got there pretty late at night, they made us feel welcomed in every possible way!They are always available if you need them, but not intrusive at all!  In a nutshell: highly recommended!

I highly recommend Kate and Wes’s place.  It was close to the metro, which I did not feel unsafe walking from at night.  The room was big with a large warderobe and a dresser (especially good for a longe stay if one wants to put away the suitcase). The room was to the backyard and quieter than I had supposed as it still close to the metro and streets. The bathroom was very nice and clean and so was the kitchen. Kate and Wes sent me a link to google maps with shops, restaurants etc in the area pinned to it which was very thoughtful and helpful. They were very welcoming and accommodating and flexible with the checkout time as they did not have a new guest arriving the day I left.  I would stay here again if I was to return to New York City.  And Butters is a great and charming co-host 😻
Kate has an amazing apartment that is close to the subway. The area is a little scary coming home after 11pm but that is to be expected. The cat is very friendly too!

Jenny, Kitty and the apartment were all amazing!  The apartment is totally clean and very comfortable.  It's a (comfortable) couchbed in the living room and the curtains Jenny has put up makes it private.  It's less than a 5 minute walk to the subway and ridiculously easy to get to from the airport.  Basically the perfect location if you are here without a car.  I travelled here as a single female and never once felt unsafe.  I even took the train home by myself at 3am on a Saturday and felt perfectly comfortable.  The place was quiet!  Jenny herself was great. Super friendly and easy to get along with.  We chatted a bunch, she came with me and showed me how to use the subway, gave me ideas of places to go and things to see, and we even went to brunch together!  I would recommend this place to anyone and would definitely stay here again in a heart beat.

This beautiful home is spacious, clean, comfortable and is located at a very convenient location. We walked to coffee shops, convenience stores, drug stores, banks and subway stations all the time. We felt at home right when we arrived. The best part of our stay was that we got to know not only our hostess Eleonora, but also her very cute pet dog Pupton. Eleonora was very warm, thoughtful and accommodating to our needs, she is also very generous to share everything, including Pupton, with my daughter and me. Her hospitality was definitely why we enjoyed our stay so much that we wish we could have stayed much longer. We spent a lot of time playing with Pupton, he's well behaved and a lot of fun to play with. During our four-night stay I totally fell in love with this warm, personal and adorable little friend of mine, in fact, I was in tears when I had to say goodbye to him.  We look forward to seeing both of you very soon, our dear friends, Eleonora and Pupton!

Daniela is great and very sweet and helpfull, I think she's the best host you can wish for. The area is fine and safe with the J and also the C train closeby. I'm a girl alone and I've not felt unsafe. The small room is good. I've stayed in there for six weeks and the room as no window, so in the end I kinda missed the fresh air. Also there's a club next door downstairs and you can hear/feel the bass through the floor, but only lightly. It only bothered me a few times, but I also think NYC is a noisy city and it's quite normal. Big ups: great host, clean, you'll meet nice people, close to airport and Rockaway Beach, close to two trains, laundromat around corner. Downs: no window in small room, noisy club (bring earplugs). I really enjoyed my summer at Daniela's! :)

Our stay in Brooklyn was nothing short of an amazing time! And most of it is thanks to Wilfredo and his place!  I can't say enough good things - good neighborhood, free street parking, just a few blocks from the L, and Wilfredo was an amazing host. I was so appreciative of him for so many reasons and felt very lucky that he even answered my request for the reservation so last minute! The apartment is great!!! It's exactly as it's described, but even more pleasant. It comfortably slept my four piece band, and it had obviously been upgraded and was in amazing condition and very clean. Wilfredo was there to greet us and give us a tour and made sure we felt at home. He gave us plenty of towels, the beds were nicely made, and he was ready to provide us with whatever we needed to make us comfortable.  We were out and about most of the time, and Wilfredo's place really was a great way to end our nights. As a band, we really appreciated being able to have a living room to hang out, rather than sitting in someone's hotel room! The place just had plain ol' good vibe, and when you're traveling as much as we are, that feels so good. Thanks again to Wilfredo for not being scared of a band hanging at his place and for being so kind and cool!  I could have summed this up easily: Whenever we have time off in NYC again, we are staying at this apartment! Wilfredo ROCKS!

Wilfredo is an excellent host! He welcomed us in a hurry since we had a problem in the other accommodation we had booked. He welcomed us late at night in an unpleasant situation for my family and Wilfredo gave us the best welcome, he made us feel calm and safe and really welcome in his home.  The apartment has many places to sleep comfortably and a large room to lounge, cook if you want. Very close to the L subway station that takes you to Manhattan in 25 minutes maximum. The neighborhood is a mix of cultures, very lively at night it seems, and friendly. We didn't have much time to get to know it on foot since we were only there for 3 nights. If I had known it would be so well received, I would have rented this place for my 9 days in New York.  Thank you Wilfredo for your kindness and warmth

Hello Wilfredo, good morning. I apologize for all the complaints and noise other residents may have experienced. As far as the outside door slamming, it really should be fixed. I must inform you about your overbearing and CONTROLLING tendencies, and how unsettling that is.  Constantly watching and complaining about everything show you have no consideration for privacy and really dampens the stay and experience. I was informed about the comments that were made about how you secretly recording and may need to add sound to the cameras when you confronted my workers this morning at 2AM. I was also informed about how you walked into the apartment this morning at 7AM without knocking. I see from your reviews this is something you do often and have little respect for privacy. It’s unsettling and scary! Especially being that there were majority women staying in your apartment. I don’t think air bnb is your niche and I’m sure we both can agree we are happy this stay is over. I absolutely do NOT recommend this stay!

It passed 12 days since I left Marias place and I’m very happy about it. It was the most emotionally abusive and mentally pressing experience of accommodation in my life (not only Airbnb, I traveled a lot). It feels like reviews in this profile have been written about two different persons and houses. It’s disappointing but I’ve got the “evil twin”. House was definitely not “neat and clean” as described. Always dark, unpleasant odors, compost bin on the kitchen table and flies across all house even 2nd floor. Once I met roach and heard a very interesting story that it must be guests fault. Sad that it’s impossible to attach photos, but I can send them privately upon request. Also there was scenes of animal abuse. Encaged cats, forgotten fish dying in the dark in the dirty half evaporated water, crying kitten that was scared of hissing adult cat and after that was hidden under the porch in the dark where was mosquitoes and homeless cats, also there was a wounded dove locked in the basement (and never delivered to the animal care center).  Maria wrote me messages after literally everything like a few drops of water on a counter after washing dishes. Also she repeated the same things in person before or after messages. There is a rule about “light cooking”, but I received messages about “only light cooking” even it was only fried eggs and piece of bread. I received messages about EVERYTHING. The whole house is covered with stickers. So it was impossible to relax and just live there.  Kinda when you at home you should always think what else you can do to avoid Marias messages or angry speeches. First days everything was just okay and Maria was friendly but later she became abusive. Step by step, drop by drop. And everyday it was worse and worse, so I left week earlier to save my mental health. I’ve tried to talk to Maria and to ask what’s going on but she was rude and blamed me in lies even if I sent the pictures of mess at her house. Scenes of animal abuse was “not my business” as Maria sais. She wasn’t polite or something. There was a lot of little uncomfortable situations. For example one day there was a problem with AC, it didn’t work for a several hours. So I tried to figure out how it works and after that I received a messages that “I should understand that I’m not in Russia anymore”. I’m sorry, but I think it’s offensive. Host was never interested WHY I started to discover how AC works.  Host was not interested in solving problems and being little bit more customer focused.  I’ve tried to be invisible due my stay, follow all the house rules, clean after myself and leave locations better than it was, but probably it was not enough.  I felt myself like unpleasant guest of burned out host who just wants money and tired of people.   I definitely would not recommend this place for people who have empathy, who has any ideas about hospitality, respecting boundaries, who prefer to live in a clean and quiet places and who has any ideas how to treat animals and humans to let them feel comfortable. Probably okay for a very short stays for people who have ‘iron nerves’ and come home just to sleep. In my case it wasn’t “home away from home”, it was something opposite.

Mine’s place was clean, convenient, and in such a great location! Super close to the subway, close to Morningside and Central Park, as well as coffee shops. My stay was so easy and stress free staying here. I would definitely recommend!

Marina is such a lovely person with good spirits and communication skills . She is responsive and attentive to needs.  She gave me a warm welcome and handed me the keys.  Check out was very flexible. I felt at ease. Her studio is in a quiet and peaceful location . Subway station is just a few blocks away so you do not feel unsafe at night. (fao solo ladies !) The apartment is old  but soulful which i like. The interior is cosy with personal touch. Cats add to the homey feeling plus they are sweethearts. I felt happy with their presence.  The house was clean and met my expectations.  Highly recommend.

The neighbourhood felt a little sketchier than I'd expected, and with Emily not being there when I arrived, the arrival was a little weird and traumatic.  Also the departure was odd, with the next person arriving before I'd properly vacated the room.  On another downside, the thin curtain meant that lots of light came in in the morning, but Emily has assured me a blind will be fitted in that room.  However, on the positives the room was very clean and comfortable, the shower is amazing, and it was really close to the subway, so overall had a comfortable stay.

Very good value for the area - I felt lucky to have booked here. Nice old home and large room & bath with thoughtful touches. FANTASTIC shower. Literally, the best part of my visit. Everything you might need for an extended stay - including extensive reading material, fridge, toaster, microwave, electric kettle, French press, umbrella & yoga mat was provided. Easy 15 minute walk to work and never felt unsafe. Fairly constant train noise but the air purifier provided effective white noise. Wifi was pretty weak & flat pillows weren't great. The wonky door lock gave me a bit of a worry one night. Trader Joes right around the corner. Unfortunately, because of work, my only area entertainment was seeing all the dogs playing in front of the beautiful courthouse every day on my way home.

I had such a great time here in NYC. Its a great place. Birens mom was there when I arrived. She was so friendly the whole time. I loved the room with the airconditioner! Biren gave me a map and wrote everything (!!) down for my first time here in NYC. He gave me fashion magazines (because I love fashion) and told me where to go. Queens was very save, I was alone and I was never scared to walk home - even not at 1am. I had such a great time. I am happy that I met this lovely family and could stay at their house for almost 2 weeks! Take care - maya :)

I didn't get to meet Biren, however I was warmly welcomed by his mother. I loved that decor of the house, it was breathtaking. The room is tastefully appointed, and looks exactly like in the photos. It is clean and tidy and so was the shared bathroom. The neighborhood is safe, not at all sketchy or skeevy as I suspected that it would be.

Place was very clean and as expected based on the description. Biren and his mom were very hospitable and informative in the brief conversations we had. The train station is a straight forward walk from the place and I was able to walk to and from at early and late hours (10/11 ish) without it feeling unsafe. If I’m ever in this area again I’ll have to check out Biren’s place again!

Biren’s place is well located, impeccably clean, very well decorated, and hosted by an incredibly kind and helpful host. Biren upon arrival has plenty of recommendations at the ready of places and restaurants to visit if staying local to Queens. The area of Jackson Heights has a lot of diversity, as well as a very accessible metro station with maaaaany lines running through it. The area complements the housing very nicely, and while it is a very active neighborhood the home and streets were very quiet, making it easy to fall asleep. The room is even greater than its photos, and the bed is incredibly cozy.  While it is a 10-15 min walk, and in the summer it can feel a bit brutal, there is heavy foliage which provide a lot of shade along the walk. I could not recommend Biren’s place enough!!

We loved everything about our stay in this apartment! Johno responded immediately to our initial inquiries, was flexible in meeting us when we checked in, and available throughout our stay -- although everything was so lovely and in good shape, that we didn't need to call on him. The apartment was comfortable, beautifully decorated, had a great view, and was very quiet (no street noise because the apartment is in the back of the building, and we never heard neighbors at all). The apartment is near two subway lines, a Whole Foods, a drug store, and much more. Great location! Overall, a wonderful experience. We have already recommended this apartment to one of our friends.

The house was as we see in the pictures. It is big and with 3.5 baths, was more than sufficient for our stay with 5 people . It was also clean, and had all the essentials we needed such as towels, washing machine and dryer, and kitchen utensils. It also had some basic food items such as coffee, sugar, butter etc, which made our stay convenient and easy. Marina had also left some basic information and some metro cards, which although we didn't need, was thoughtful. Taking over the house was also fuss free and handing over was as easy. Other than the time required to get to and back from Manhattan, which is about an hour or so each way, we are very happy to have stayed at Marina's house. It would have been a better arrival experience if Marina could have provided information on how to get to the house from Staten Island ferry terminal by train or bus, as that would take away the stress of asking around and figuring out our way to get there the first time. Nevertheless, we had a good experience overall and are very happy with our 3 nights' stay.

Nicole's place was amazing. A short walk from the Subway and close to a ton of restaurants and a nice coffee shop. I never felt unsafe walking home alone at night. The place was spotless and the bed was beyond comfortable. Will definitely stay here again!

Michael had Lenny meet us upon our arrival. He was very helpful with getting us acquainted with the surrounding area. I loved how laid back it was compared to our apartment we rented for a year in Times Square area. love the space to the studio. It was just right. The area offers nearby shopping and laundry. The library across the street came in handy as well. There is a lovely walking path/park nearby.  I had to purchase a broom, bathroom rug and living area rug due to splinters of wood in our feet. There was no mattress for the sleep loft; so we purchased bedding in which we left upon our exit. We also had to buy kitchen knives.... The main bed was very uncomfortable with popped up springs. Maybe a new mattress or nice topper..... The Wi-Fi would not stay connected. It would kick on and off, causing us to go over our own personal data. It was an unexpected cost. Would be nice to have a more comfortable chair to sit in. I kept going to sleep without meaning to, because I kept sitting on the bed. Ha!  The  other chairs were not as comfortable. More of a want than a need of course. Also very strong smoke coming from people smoking on the front steps maybe insulate the window better to block it out as well as the cold air.  Also, the window blind if it could open up to allow for some natural light or for those long days inside to look out; once again more of a want then a need.   Had a lot of door bells at 3-4am not sure why....? We never answered due to safety. Overall,  Never felt unsafe in the neighborhood though. Would absolutely stay here again!

This studio apartment is in a great location in Washington Heights. It's in a lively Dominican area. The neighborhood seemed safe and the people were friendly. It's within walking distance to everything you need. Several grocery stores, laundromat right across the street, a Planet Fitness gym (which is very affordable if you're staying for a couple months and need a place to work out), and like the rest of NYC, it has great restaurants and cafes. Across the street is the Jumel Mansion, which sometimes has live music in the evenings (check the schedule on the website). Some of the nearby subway stations were under construction, but it's very close to the A, C and 1 lines which take you downtown. I was working in Midtown for the summer, so it was very convenient. And the neighborhood has the real Mr. Softee trucks! It's also within walking distance of Yankee Stadium if you're into baseball. You can also go for a run along the Harlem River or walk a little further to Riverside Park and go for a run along the Hudson, which I did quite a bit.  As for the apartment itself, it's a charming little studio that apparently used to the be home office of Clement Silston, who ran the Silston Library in Antigua from here (I'm not actually sure if the room I stayed in was the office, but it has the look of a place that could have been used as an office). Has a functional kitchen with a gas stove. The fridge sometimes made scary sounds, but it worked fine. The bathroom had everything you can expect from a bathroom. The shower was nice after long days in the New York summer humidity. And it had in-unit AC. I couldn't get the ceiling fan to turn off separately from the light, but it wasn't an issue in the summer. The bed was functional and comfortable. There's a sleep loft if you have a guest stay over, but they're probably better off sleeping on the couch, which was very comfortable. There's a television with cable. I was provided a Hulu password even though I didn't need one. WiFi was dodgy. Sometimes I had no connection even though there was full signal. Switching to the 5G version of the network would usually solve that though. I can't speak for the heater since I never used it, as it was summer.  Michael was a very responsive host and went out of his way to get me things I needed. All in all, it was a great stay and if I ever need to book an extended stay in NYC again, I'll look here first.

Very nice and well-kept apartment on the edge of Williamsburg/Bushwick/Bedford-Stuyvesant. Room has a very comfortable bed, it's small but there is lots of storage space (we where 2people travelling with quite a bit of luggage which never got in the way). Very handy with own little fridge.  Victor and Luis made us feel at home.  Direct surroundings not the most charming, however nicer areas and restaurants are just within walking distance and it didn't feel unsafe.

We had a great time on our trip and it was so great to come back to a place that was nice and quiet. The city was a lot to take in so the fact that Luis and Victor had this perfect room with A/C and amazing amenities such as tv and cable was great! They were also extremely nice and helped us when we had questions about trains and loved conversing with them about what we had gotten accomplished on our days in town. They live in a really nice area, we would walk around late at night and not once did we feel unsafe. Highly recommend staying here!

Traveling alone, I chose the “Super Host” category to reassure myself. Very good choice, Gregory is responsive, friendly, welcoming and gives very good advice. The location of his apartment is very convenient for visiting Manhattan. The metro is very close and even when returning late at night, the area is calm and not scary. The apartment is very clean, the room is spacious and the mattress is fantastic for resting well after long days visiting New York. I highly recommend this address.

Luis and Victor’s place was absolutely amazing! My best friend and I really enjoyed our stay and would love to stay here again when we’re in the city. The hosts were extremely accommodating, quick to respond and over all a pleasure to stay with. We arrived a few hours earlier than check in time and they offered us to store our luggage at the apartment before check in time. When we arrived to the apartment we were overcome with kindness. They are the a nicest hosts I’ve ever come across and really know how to make you feel at home. A welcome basket was awaiting us in our room which included lots of travel brochures for the city, towels, soaps, tooth brushes, hand sanitizer, travel sized tissues and Snickers bars. There was full access to the kitchen and morning coffee readily available. The apartment was squeaky clean and offered a cozy atmosphere. The location of the place was very functional! Within a 5 min walk to the J train and about a 15 minute commute to Manhattan, this place has it all. It’s in an extremely safe area (we’re two girls in our 20s and didn’t feel in danger walking alone at night at 2am lol). This place rocks! Thank you so much Luis and Victor, we really enjoyed your lovely home :) 10/10 would recommend this beautiful apartment!

Our stay with Victor and Louis was perfect! The apartment is very clean, the bed is comfortable to sleep in and the location is perfect because the apartment is only about a 2-minute walk from the subway and you can reach all the sights from here! On the way to the subway there are cafes and supermarkets where you can shop! The environment is safe and you don't have to be afraid ;)! If we plan another trip to New York, we will definitely check in with them again! Victor is super nice and is available to give advice and help and tries very hard to ensure that everything is perfect! We felt very comfortable! Thanks again for the wonderful hospitality!

This AirBnb is a wonderful retreat on the 2nd floor of a historic brownstone in a charming neighborhood. My wife and I originally planned to stay for a month and ended up extending our stay by several weeks while we were in between apartment moves. Throughout this somewhat stressful process for us (during the pandemic), Daniel and family were extremely accommodating and gracious hosts, from extending our stay to making sure anything we might need was immediately taken care of. The place itself was spacious, comfortable, fully furnished and gets very good natural light. We were working from home during this time and fully enjoyed being in the apartment for the entire day during our stay and used the kitchen quite a bit to prep meals at home. The location is in a quiet neighborhood near restaurants, groceries, stores, pharmacies, etc. (everything you could need) and also just blocks away from Brooklyn Bridge Park and plenty of other parks nearby. Whether you are visiting for a short-term stay or a longer-term stay, this is a great option!

Trey was very helpful! He made the whole process super easy and stress free. He also gave us very good tips to move around. The apartment is great! just like shown on the pictures. The location also very good, and the neighborhood is great if you are looking to get the real Brooklyn experience. I totally recommend staying here and I will definitely consider Trey for my next visit :)

WOW. This place is so much more than expected! Beautiful flat, extremely clean and safe. My family felt like it was our own home away from home. There is a pleasant peace about the place with incredible views. The neighbourhood is family friendly with very easy access to buses and the subway. The public pool (steps away from the front door) is amazing, as is the playground and river walk next to it. Peter and Laurie were amazing hosts from beginning to end. We were greeted with food and drink necessities after a tiring flight from the UK. Any questions we had were answered within 12hrs. We were treated as friends, which made our family holiday stress free. We would definitely stay here again given the chance. Thank you for everything!!

Suzanne is a beautifull person, really. We could not have asked for a better host. She was always ready to help us with anything we need,  so sweet and kind. The appartment is amazing, so beautifull and confortable. The neighbourhood is really nice and you have subways and buses all around. If you are planning yo visit NY and want to avoid the stress, noice and tempo from de city, then bed-stuy is your neighbourhood and Suzanne your host.

I stayed with Suzanne for a month while I was moving to New York for the first time. She was a fantastic host, the room was great and the cat is adorable.  It made the stressful move far more relaxing that expected.  The breakfasts and teas are a nice touch and she even invited me to spend Thanksgiving with her and her friends. Highly recommend.
Sara was a welcoming host; she and her cat Olive (t feel unsafe in this neighborhood). I would recommend this to anyone visiting NYC!

The room was great. The apartment is small but very comfy. Tang and Jayu are great hosts and they answer you really fast, they provide you with all the information you need. And the make you breakfast! The neighborhood looks a little bit scary at the begging, but then you find its charm.

Everything was amazing, clear instructions for checkin, just got a hard time opening the door of the unit (lol). Didn't expect that the area will be in a Chinese Community which is i was a little bit afraid because of the nCov (just saying no offense). But when I see Tang's place everything was good coz it's extremely clean and the room is beautiful!

We were given the apartment that was in the second floor (APT 3) and windows facing 14th street so we can hear everything.  It was not the apartment shown in listing photos . The apartment is in a great location, close to everything ( restaurants, subway, pharmacy, walking to union square, laundry next door). Eran was very responsive to our requests.  The apartment condition is far from photo. Paints were peeling and we were afraid for health reasons on white particles from paints peeling.  Apartment was not clean and cleaning tools were not clean for us to use also.   Apartment staff were kind to assist us carry up and down our large suitcases. Two deliveries were lost due to faulty buzzer ( one food delivery and one amazon) . Wifi is speedy and stable all throughout our stay. I am not usually a person to complain but I had quite a list for this stay. Im just glad Eran was responsive and willing to work it out. Im now staying in another of his apartment.

I stayed with Natasha for 8 weeks. She met me at the apartment when I first arrived and I found her to be incredibly friendly and helpful, as she was throughout my stay with her. It was good to live with someone who knew the city and was happy to give advice about how to travel and what places to visit. Although the South Bronx doesn't have a great reputation, the apartment is located very close to a subway station, shops and restaurants and I never felt unsafe at any time during my stay. Being so close to the subway meant that it was very easy for me to get into Manhattan from the apartment, taking around 30 mins to arrive at Grand Central station. Unfortunately, about 4 weeks into my stay, I noticed that my room was infested with bedbugs. As I had had no previous experience with bedbugs, I was unaware of the tell tale signs such as blood spots on the sheets. I only became suspicious after becoming itchy from multiple bites and finally seeing a bedbug crawling on my bed. I informed Natasha and we found a large colony of bedbugs on a curtain above my bed. Reading about bedbugs on my return home, the bedbugs would have been in the room for at least 4-5 months to form that large a colony. To her credit, Natasha dealt with the problem immediately, using chemical treatments in the room, buying bed bug mattress protectors, and laundering all of my clothes in a hot cycle to try to eradicate the problem. I noticed two further bedbugs during the final month of my stay and each time she hot washed the sheets and sprayed the room again. Bedbugs are rarely eradicated after a single treatment and she assures me that she is continuing surveillance and treatment of the room. I hope that no future guests have to go through my experience. Bedbugs are relatively common in New York City and I advise anyone who travels to the city to inspect thoroughly any room that they stay in on their first night and be aware of the tell tale signs. If I had not been so naive then I would have been able to recognize the problem earlier. Apart from the bedbugs, staying with Natasha was a great experience. She let me use the kitchen and living room as I wished and even allowed me to have guests stay on the living room couch.

I stayed in this room for 16 nights. Had a great stay! Apartment and room were clean, room has AC which is basically a necessity in the sweltering summer heat. Both Sheena and Samantha made me feel very welcome. I asked them if I could eat with them a couple of times, which was not a problem at all for them. Samantha is a great cook. Sheena took me on an authentic Brooklyn bikeride through several neighbourhoods, which I really enjoyed. All in all, I feel like they went above and beyond for me. I spent quite some time at the apartment and they never made me feel like I was in their way.  As for the location: be prepared to travel. Apartment is close to 2 subway stops, depending on where in Manhattan you want to be, it will take you between 25 and 45 min to get there. New York is just that big. Room is on the front side facing a busy street, so if you are a light sleeper consider bringing earplugs. There is a supermarket right across the street and there are several places nearby where you can buy breakfast and lunch (Cinnamon girl/Blessings/Tugboat Tea Company). I didn't feel unsafe in the neighbourhood, just uncomfortable sometimes because I travelled alone. I would recommend this place to anyone looking to visit New York, you certainly won't regret it!

Unfortunately we had to cut short our stay at Sheena's place by two days to attend to a personal matter. However, we had a really great time whilst there.   The apartment is atop a retail space, one story up (so second floor) and accessible via a staircase, on the bustling and vibrant Flatbush Avenue. It's a very well appointed space, with the biggest kitchen I've seen in New York, a small but well-designed and fitted bathroom, and a cosy bedroom. All up, it's a 3 bedder, 2 bathroom apartment with an alcove and living room - pretty sweet! Its furnishings and decorations are clearly an expression of Sheena and Samantha's pop culture interests (which match our own!).  The neighborhood is the heart of a bustling Afro-Caribbean community. The smell of barbecuing chicken permeates the neighborhood and gets the mouth watering! There are great eateries within walking distance: Tip of the Tongue Baked and Brewed, Cinnamon Girl and a Mexican place on Lincoln Rd (El Patron). The Prospect Park train station on Lincoln Rd is very reliable - we used it to travel in both directions to Manhattan as well as further South into the outer environs of Brooklyn.   Sheena and Samantha were great hosts. Happy to chat and suggest things to see and do, as well as respectful of our privacy. We would very much like to visit them again next year.  Only one minor cavil - A bit more street noise than we're used to, but given it's Summer, and everyone is out and about, that is to be expected. I would suspect the street is quieter in colder weather.

We were hosted by Samantha since Sheena was traveling, and she was great! The room is small but WOW they've really managed to maximize the usable space in there so that you wind up not feeling cramped at all. Lots of smart little hacks, in addition to some really useful things (extra chargers and adapters, little snacks) for the traveler who may have forgotten something. Having our own bathroom was amazing, and the A/C was key for our comfort. The neighborhood is great fun! The flat is just a couple of blocks from the metro, and just a block away (in one direction) from delicious coffee and (in the other direction) vegan ice cream, so we were set for all of our needs. I should also add that we never felt unsafe, although people who aren't used to cities might not feel totally at ease walking home from the metro at night.  Overall we had a wonderful stay with Samantha and would recommend the flat to anyone who wants to get the flavor of NYC living without the total hipster vibe of some of the other Brooklyn areas or the massive tourist onslaught of Manhattan.

The apartment is in a good area and well connected with the subway just a few minutes away with three lines that run throughout A,ByC and Central Park next door, a couple of streets up there is a small supermarket and a 24-hour Deli, it is not recommended to go past 125th Street at night as it is a dangerous area but it is still far from the location of this apartment so there are no problems.  The autonomous arrival with a padlock with code that has keys to the apartment without any problem since it is easy and they give the code two DAYS before arrival, they also explained to us how to open the doors in simple ways and how to turn on the air and heating (I did not find the control panel) but it was not necessary either since the temperature was good.  Regarding the accommodation: We found the house with the refrigerator with food for two days or so since it did not look good (like half a half-rotten banana with peel). The bathroom was a little dirty since the sink was not clean and there were dirty towels in a small half-broken basket hanging on the door, there was no shampoo and we had to look for the towels on the floor, in the bathroom there was only a small one in an attic.  The bedroom was good, with a small closet for clothes, where there were also girls' things and some other clothes, the bed felt like the sheets hadn't been changed but they didn't smell bad so I hope they were changed.  The apartment says it has a washing machine and we didn't see it, I think it has one in the common area but since the host didn't answer we don't know.  Don't expect him to respond to us either, he didn't respond to any of our emails and I think he should do so in other places, they are more attentive.  It is noted that the host lives in that apartment and that when he rents it he leaves since there were their clothes, such as shoes and slippers, clothes, etc...

Vanessa's place is the steal of the century. It's in a great neighborhood near some of the coolest bars in Brooklyn, a beautiful park and lots of food and public transportation. The apartment itself is sparse but hip and definitely has everything you need and more. Check in was flexible and easy and check out was the same. Thanks!

The apartment was really comfortable, and we liked the full kitchen with gas stove. There's a nice view of Manhattan from the balcony and roof.  It was only a couple of blocks from a nice diner, a drug store and a grocery store and a quick lyft ride to Manhattan.

We were made very welcome by Luke, who took the time to explain everything that was necessary to operate the apartment. Luke was very available, and was perfectly responsive to any questions we might have had to ask him. He is an excellent host! The accommodation perfectly matches the description on the site. It is also perfectly located and very quiet at the same time. The apartment is spacious, perfectly appointed and very comfortable. For those who want to be a stone's throw from Manhattan without living in its stress, Luke's apartment is ideal. Just steps from the Bedford Metro station in the heart of Williamsburg, and you just have to cross the road to enjoy a magnificent view of the Skyline. Luke's apartment is definitely a place to recommend!

JP and Andrey were wonderful hosts! My wife and I spent a few nights with them and they could not have been better hosts. Everything was clean and tidy, they were very helpful with everything and always willing to lend a helping hand. I can't stress enough how wonderful it was to find hosts as great as JP and Andrey. Highly recommended!

JP is really great host.  He concern about us very much like a family. he even yielded his A/C to us. his house always smells so great and extremely clean.  Harlem was not dangerous than I thought, and I think it was pretty safe place.

Accommodation with this host is generally highly recommended, as the price-performance ratio is really good for New York. If you're not afraid of Brooklyn and would like to see more than just Manhattan, you've come to the right place. The property is approximately 30/45 minutes from downtown Manhattan via the Q Train. Get on and head to the Big Apple without changing trains. The only drawback of the accommodation is the direct location on busy Flatbush Avenue. This is extremely loud due to the notoriously bad US windows. But we finished running about 15km every evening anyway and literally fell into bed. The size of the bed was big enough for 2 and was spring-loaded. All in all, a fair, clean accommodation at a pleasant price.

This was the perfect place to stay during my trip to NYC. The apartment is beautiful and very comfortable with an abundance of amenities including snacks for the whole week I stayed! Leesa communicated with me frequently and provided helpful instructions. She was also very accommodating about check in and check out. Getting anywhere in the city was really simple with two subway lines within easy walking distance. I was in town for a bit of a stressful event with lots of running around. Coming back to the apartment, I felt like I could just relax and be a home. Highly recommended, and I'll definitely be stopping by on my next trip to NYC.

I spent 10 days in Leesa's brownstone and must say I really liked the place.  It was clean, well presented, comfy and in a great location just a 5 minute walk to the subway.  I returned home (a lone female) in the early hours of the morning on a few occasions and never felt unsafe.    Plenty of bedding / towels are provided. The cooking facilities are good. But, if you only want a cup of coffe before you go out exploring, then like me you will really appreciate the coffe machine, complete with loads of different types of coffee (and tea) pods. Not to mention the amount of food/drink that Leesa provides to 'start you off'.  The only issues with the apartment were the weak wifi signal, weak shower spray and the broken air-con in the bedroom.   Leesa is a great host. She met me on arrival with less than 30 mins notice and checked in with me regularly to ensure everything was ok.  In addition her mum and dad who live in the apartment below were really friendly and helpful. It was great knowing help was there if I needed it, and when I did, Leesa was really obliging. The flexible check-out was a great help too, meaning I didn't have to find somewhere to leave my bags/shower before leaving for the airport.  The area is great for shopping with 2 supermarkets (food) and number of high street shops (old navy, H&M, Gap, Marshalls etc all just a 10 minute walk away. I also noticed a number of restaurants and fast food chains McDs IHOP although I didn't eat locally.    This was my fifth time renting an NYC apartment and from a value for money viewpoint Leesa's was up there with the best of them. Next time I plan to stay in Harlem I will definitely be checking if it's available.   Thanks Leesa.

I would recommend staying here anytime. It felt like home away from home . I'm usually afraid to stay in hotels and other places because I worry about the cleanness of the place or if there are bugs ect. I always pack my own cleaning products , towels , blankets ect...but this time I did not have to worry too much about using  any of my products. Everything was clean and we felt safe and secure. This location was close to the places we waned to go. We walked around everywhere just about in Harlem . And caught Taxi's and Ubers everywhere else .Its was a great stay and great first time experience in NY and first airbnb experiences as well . Throughout the stay Leesa even checked on us making sure everything was good and we felt safe.

The location is convenient as close to subway,the house is a little bit old as regard to the steep and cracked stairs,certainly be a burden to climb for we take a big suitcase with us! In the morning or at night when we enter the front door,more often than not we were blocked by roamers,although we discovered later they were not dangerous. The house is clean and hostess is neat and has great environment   Protection awareness,and moderate, if you expect a great talker and very warm hearted,you maybe a little disappointed,but if you are quite and introversive , you will be rather delighted!

The accommodation was impeccable and located close to a metro station, making it very easy to get to the center of New York (allow 40 minutes to go from the accommodation to Times Square for example, without having to change metro lines). Sheena was very friendly and gave us recommendations on activities to do. I was afraid I wouldn't sleep well given that the accommodation is located on a busy street, but ultimately that wasn't a problem. We were happy to find a comfortable and pleasant environment in the evening after a long day of sightseeing. Thank you very much Sheena, if I ever come back to New York I will definitely come back to your place!! :)
Fantastic location to experience Harlem. Super fast responses and stress-free checkout. Leesa’s extended hospitality and the warm feeling of the space made my stay really special.

Ame and Sam made our trip to New York a real joy. Their home is beautiful, peaceful and cosy, and is in a really great part of Brooklyn that is both vibrant and yet feels really safe. The room itself was exactly as described, and was plenty of space for my mum and I to make ourselves at home in. The only downside is the bathroom, which is shared with another room on the same floor. Although there was rarely a problem in its availability, do be aware that there is a connecting door between the bathroom and the other room. This means we felt we really had to creep around so as not to disturb the other guests. Everything else about our stay, however, was great. We would definitely come back again.

This was a lovely place to stay! Inside was super nice, well stocked, adorable. Neighborhood was not the greatest when we were outside, but we never felt unsafe. Leesa was AMAZING! Great communicator, you can tell she really cares about you as her guest

Staying in Leesa's apartment is exactly as countless reviews have said here: the best experience you'll have on Airbnb. The apartment offers everything your heart desires and Leesa will regularly ask whether you are doing well and whether you are missing anything. On some long days of sightseeing, I simply spent the evening in the apartment - just like at home! The apartment is easy to reach by subway and I never felt unsafe. In 20-30 minutes without changing, you can get to all the spots in Manhattan. The only disadvantage: you won't want to go home after your stay with Leesa.  But I will definitely come back here! See you soon, dear Leesa!

Pictures don't do it justice. This place is simply wonderful. Extremely spacious and comfortable with all of the amenities one could need. Awesome backyard patio which is rare to find in this location.  This place was a steal and will definitely be making a return visit.

Mindy and Jeff's house is lovely! A great place to stay with lots of space. There's plenty of parking, and it's very easy to get into the city. The kitchen is well-stocked with dishes, coffee, and teas. The back yard is shady and peaceful. We would definitely stay here again.

This is THE place to stay -- not just because of the home, but because of the people that own it. Mindy and Jeff are amazing hosts and even though we never met them physically, these are the kind of people we would want as neighbors. We were looking for a place to stay pretty last minute and were definitely stressed out, but they made it easy for us. We also had a hectic schedule that required special considerations to remain stress free, and they accommodated without question and gave us their trust that we were asking for their generosity in good faith. The house is adorable, spacious, clean, comfortable, and has special little touches everywhere including little candy bowls, family games, and treats for new guests to enjoy.
