We are new to exploring this area and didn't know what to expect, and were so happy to find that the neighborhood is extremely safe and walkable with stores and grocery two blocks away. Our son is in college not far away, and this will be our home away from home so long as they aren't booked when we come. Thanks Mindy and Jeff for letting us share your amazing home. The love you have put into it is easily felt as soon as someone walks in!

I don't recommend this home for families or group of 5. Currently the maintenance have been abandoned and differs from the attached pictures. *Ceilings damaged *AC noisy and full of dust *Water pressure of shower really low *Blinds not functional *Air mattress for 5th guest  *Pillows not comfortable *Neighborhood with drunk/ homeless people *Food from previous guest Apartment is close to subway. Arround 30 min to Times square by metro

It was a nightmare! Still can’t believe it. Especially because of the few good reviews which choose this apartment, but it was completely the opposite. First there are NO 3 bedrooms as advertised. There are only 2 rooms. One big room with 3 beds in it. Second Michele as a host was very irascible and scared us. As two friends visited us for 2 days of a two month rent she screamed at us and were really raw. Although we agreed that we pay for the extra guest what she claimed, she came with a men we have never seen and kicked us suddenly out of the flat and said that we have to leave till friday. After this shock we looked for a new flat, but we even had the time because she changed her mind again and the next day the locks were changed - our flat open with all our staff in there. When we came back we were even more shocked and she said we have one hour to leave then she comes back with her neighbors. Couldn’t tell you how awful this stay was - I had never any kind of such an experience and problems - Better choose something else!!!

One of the possibly the best AirBNB we have ever stayed in.   It's located in a exceptional historical district in Bedford-Stuyvesant.  That designation is well deserved for both architectural and historical reasons.  Very close to the A train you have a very quick ride to downtown Brooklyn, and on into Manhattan.  The house is amazingly beautiful and while the top floor apartment isn't quite as awesome it's much better than any NYC AirBNB we've enjoyed.  Cheap too!  The apartment's layout is very nice, if a little confusing in the pictures.  There is a nice little kitchen and sitting area at the back.  The sitting area includes a very elegant small couch and table which seats four for your dinning.  The toilet is off of this area.  From that you can walk toward the front of the building thru a room that was probably once used as a study.  There is a single bed in this room.  The next room is the largest.  These two rooms are separated only by a curtain.  The large room is in the front of the building and is extremely attractive.  It has two large comfortable beds.  Two more rooms are attached to the this large room.  A room with your bathtub/shower and a full sized sink.  And a room that I suspect was a small bedroom, or possibly a huge walk in closet in the original plan.  This room also has a single bed in it.  Michele was a friendly delightful host who we enjoyed chatting with.

Staying here was wonderful. I had a horrible scare on my long drive from home to the location of the reservation and Ruben was in contact with me 100% of the time and made sure I had a place to stay at the end of it all. He made me feel more than at home and the neighbors did too (speaking Spanish helped me with that but definitely isn’t needed. Smiles work in any language) there’s artwork in the apartment and although it’s not the biggest it’s more than enough room to be extremely homey. I will definitely definitely be returning.

Very dangerous place, lots of street gangs harassing especially for girls. Unsanitary place, no parking, broken objects, poorly organized shower, toilet overflows, sheets are not washed/stained, noisy neighborhood, nothing matches the photos and description. Very stressful and not at all safe.  The place was very dangerous, a lot of street gang harassing especially for the girls… Unsanitary place, has no parking, broken objects, poorly organized shower, overflowing toilet, sheets are not washed / stained, noisy neighborhood nothing matches with the photos and description of the Aribnb. Very stressful and not safe!!!

This is a great place to stay! Clean, very convenient to stores, take out, ice cream(love Carvel!), and a major subway/train stop is killer! Lots of amenities, blow dryer, flat iron, coffee/ tea station, umbrellas, carriage so you don’t have to carry groceries. Hector was great at being available and if he wasn’t he gave an alternative number just in case, I can’t say how pleased we were with our rental! A little pricey but worth it since it was stress free!
Hector's spot is SUCH good value for the amount of space. the neighborhood is lively so don't be afraid to explore. quick 40 minute subway into Manhattan!

Great apartment in Queens and very close to the subway stations. It was very clean and tidy, great place to stay. The neighbourhood it’s a bit unsafe after 11 pm so I suggest to be careful in the nights but apart from that everything was great in the apartment !

For the most part I had a really good stay. It is very close to a lot of things (trains, buses, post office, awesome 24 hr deli, police/fire station, downtown Brooklyn). The room is exactly like it's pictured and is large. I really appreciated the decor and the spare twin cot in the room. There is a lot of storage for your stuff if you are staying long term. I also liked the dual washer/dryer. The roommates were great and very respectful. The kitchen was nice but I unfortunately didn't have enough time to cook during my stay. The only unpleasant thing was the continuous internet problems I experienced in my room. If I walked out into the living room, however, I got a better signal. I hardly saw Marlon myself, but he was really great with communication and with trying to trouble shoot any issues that came up. I also felt very safe in this area and actually got to know a few neighbors who were very helpful and nice. Overall I had a good stay at this location.

The room looks exactly as pictured it was nice with even some thoughtful touches like an umbrella if you forgot yours. The TV even swivels so you can watch it from the bed or from the desk. The roommates were really cool mostly stayed out of your hair but when we did talk it was Good.  It’s about a three or four minute walk to the subway and there are so many good mom-and-pop stores around, food clothes different things like that. Did took about 35 to 40 minutes to get into Manhattan specifically Times Square. The area was urban and comfortable. Not once did I feel like it was dangerous I did walk around at night a couple times and I didn’t feel scared I slept very soundly Every night, the neighborhood was quiet.

Home away from home, I enjoyed the stay. It is a really big loft with lots of space, communication with the host A+. I especially liked to be in a non-touristy part of NYC to soak in the real New York. Don't be afraid to be in East Harlem, it is as safe as anywhere else and I repeatedly spotted police officers every other block. Metro is 1.5 blocks away from the apartment and takes you downtown in 25 min. Go, take your chance, you won't regret it.

Kyle was the consummate host.  He was always within reach for any questions we had and at the same time, it seemed like we had the place to ourselves, quite the feat.  Watch out trendy hotels, you could learn much from him.  His girlfriend Pam is absolutely lovely and charming.  If we weren’t two gay guys, we’d steal her away to live in San Francisco.  (We have great wines here and Napa is only a half hour away Pam). Oops, sorry the digression. The location was perfect and the accommodations met our expectations. The bed was quite comfortable and there was ample storage for our “stuff” that included two tuxedos. Do yourself a favor, stay at this delightful Airbnb and you’ll be richly rewarded.

Kyle was an awesome host. The place was clean and nice. We did get some noise coming in from the street in the morning, but Kyle provides ear plugs and we didn't find it bothersome. The location is awesome, very close to Times Square and a bunch of great food (Kyle has great suggestions). We were out late every night and never felt we were even slightly in danger. All in all, a great experience. We highly recommend staying here.

Wonderful apartment, with everything you need (and more!), in a beautiful and very entertaining neighborhood. Golsana was a great host: timely, good in communication, willing to help out with everything and also to provide her guests with great tips for the area. Definitely a place to recommend to anyone who wants to visit New York and who does not want to stay in stressful and anonimous Manhattan.

Highly recommend and would stay again! It was great having a clean, spacious, safe place to rest after such long days exposing the city. We appreciated Rose’s humor, hospitality and for being attentive to our needs and safety. Check in was a little different than I’m used to but Rose made every effort to be accommodating. She offers to drive you around the neighborhood upon arrival and gives local tips/advice on subways, buses, etc. The neighborhood is heavily occupied by the Jewish community. They definitely keep to themselves but were nice when greeted. Lots of families and kids! The apartment was perfect for two people. It was the entire downstairs finished basement with a private entrance (through their laundry area) with a separate door leading to the private apartment. There was enough space for our bags while still having walking room (which is hard to find in NY). I was very excited for the shower as advertised, although the door is currently broken and I was afraid to use any of the features other than the red/blue light therapy. Also the water temperature is hard to adjust, so definitely check the temp before entering. It gets very very hot! Other than that, everything else is as advertised. She leaves a bowl of fruit or other snacks if you want. All in all, if you just need some room to breathe outside of the city and don’t mind the 40-60 min subway ride into the city, then this is the place for you!! Well worth it. Thank you Rose for a great stay! You’re the sweetest!

If you stay in Rose’s apartment, you will not be sorry! You can bring your car as there is free parking right outside! Her street is a dead-end street which makes it feel very quiet and serene. The neighborhood feels safe. I walked many nights alone and did not feel unsafe. The apartment is very close to two subway lines, the N and the F. There’s a great bagel place nearby and many other food options. Rose is extremely accommodating and easy to reach. The train to Manhattan is 30 minutes or more, depending on where you are going. If you don’t mind that, look no further than Rose’s place!!!!! She will treat you like family!

I was a New Yorker years ago and I wanted to Airbnb an apartment that’s convenient for me to hit up all of my favourite spots… hence I chose Alex’s place! The location is pretty awesome (near downtown brooklyn, Williamsburg, greenpoint, Clinton hill, Manhattan and a few other neighbourhoods).   Size wise, the apartment is pretty small, especially the bathroom, but very cozy and functional for a stay! Since Alex and her friend actually live in the apartment and were away, the place is fully furnished as well.  Check-in was also smooth as I just had to pick up the keys from a deli that’s round the corner.  Space aside, her cats are quite a handful! I’ve never lived with cats before  and I did not know how hyperactive they can be - waking me up daily through meows for food, sneaking up on me to lick my hair, often trying to steal dry food from the dispensary, etc. That aside, I definitely bonded with the cats over the days even though I was quite apprehensive of them in the beginning…  (I miss these fluffy ones already!)  A downside (which cannot be controlled) was the house heating. The radiators are old (same ones for each apartment in the entire building) and the sup came over to check on it when I was around. He explained to me that because there’s only one thermometer at the bottom of the building that’s measuring the heat in all apartments, and if the thermometer goes a little wonky, the heat doesn’t work well; this being said, heat was on and off throughout my entire winter stay and there was cackling sounds whenever heat came back on… but once again, it’s a building-wide issue. was hard for me to sleep well. Nevertheless, Alex was kind enough to offer her room’s comforter for me to use.

The host was unreachable when we arrived and throughout the entire trip. He didn't tell his roommates we were coming so no one was there when we arrived and the sheets were dirty and we did not have towels. The roommates also seemed annoyed that they didn't know we were coming although after addressing the issues, as finding a new place seemed more stressful, they went to the laundromat and cleaned the sheets and towels. The location and apartment was nice although I wouldn't recommend based on our experience.

The location is perfect, which is why the quality-price ratio is good since you can do many things on foot, saving you a lot of money on transportation, it is very safe and no matter the time, you can arrive without fear. The check in part was easy, they even allowed us to store our bags before the room was ready. At night you hear too much noise, we had the room that faces the street and it is very noisy, however, they give you ear covers to reduce it a little. Air conditioning worked and the bathroom had hot water.

The Airbnb has a great location and is really close to a great metro line. The room is clean and okay for a short stay. However ants were crawling in the living room and the host was stressful and pushy in his texts when talking about the reservation and the check out.  Gréât Overall

amazing apartment, loved all the decor :) good communication from Dominiks end and was super straight forward with instructions. the are itself is good but does get a little scary at night if ur travelling alone. but overall an amazing experience would definitely recommend. thank you Dominik!!!

We had a great stay here! Hanayo and Shay were very accommodating and friendly! They even went out of their way to help out with a delayed train situation due to bad weather and made an unexpected delay much less stressful.  We could not have asked for an better rental. The space itself is large, clean and well stocked; soap, dishes, toiletries etc. Not much needed to be asked about. Plus WiFi was easily accessible. The location was great with many shops and restaurants close by and most importantly, easy & quick access to the subway. The wonderful Prospect park is very close as well.  Everything about this apartment was perfect for our stay.  We would highly recommend it, plus Brooklyn is great!

This is a nice basement apartment, walking distance from Prospect Park. The apartment itself is pretty basic but very clean and Hanayo is such a great host that it really enhances your stay. Everything was responded to quickly and effortlessly and she is very accommodating. We stayed for 3 nights with our two young kids and it might have been nice to have a few more cooking utensils but there are tons of restaurants and takeout options in the area which serve some excellent world cuisine (Hanayo provides a list). The apartment was really close to a beautiful cemetery (not creepy - one of the big attractions of Brooklyn, lots of famous people buried there) which we didn't get a chance to go to, but we'll go there next time we stay with Hanayo.

Although we didn't get a chance to personally meet Roger, we did meet his roommate Olga and she was super nice to us. Roger was very nice too, he even mailed us the keys of the house before our stay because he was going to be traveling the day of our arrival.  The room was exactly as described and shown in the pictures. The bed was really comfortable, the apartment was clean, and their Nespresso machine was great :)  The neighborhood didn't feel unsafe but the subway stations were a bit further than advertised (10min walk to line 6, 20min walk to lines 2&3). It wasn't a big deal for us, but something to keep in mind especially during the cold weather.  Other than that, our stay was a great experience and we encourage everyone to stay with Roger and Olga! 😊

The apartment is charming, with large spaces and high ceilings, which is very nice for NYC. Despite the neat decor, the apartment could however be better maintained: wear and tear on the walls, furniture, etc.  Dominik, however, is particularly pleasant, responsive and accommodating!  Small downside about the neighborhood, which may seem unfriendly (especially in the evening), but which nevertheless remains safe, with nice bar/restaurant addresses nearby if you stroll around a bit. A real downtown New York lifestyle, further from the beaten track!

The overall experience was outstanding !  Irina is a very polite person who has shown high hospitality during my stay... She was always reachable and helped answer all my queries, whether home related or New York City queries.  The room was suspicious with large size compared to New York average, with an AC not that strong, but was good enough to cool down the room in this hot weather of NY at the time I stayed.  The room has also a small library of interesting books, that Irina allowed me to read during my stay.   Location of home is very convenient, as it was close to subway and transportation (less than a minute walking), close to few beautiful parks, and also not far from down town and major locations in New York.   One final comment that I really liked, is how clean the place was... Irina is someone who is mindful of the environment, and I learned a lot from her on how she efficiently manages food & water resources, and composting was something I learned for the first time in my life.  I would highly recommend this room for those who wants a quiet location, and still close to downtown, and those who appreciate having a polite and ethical host.

This apartment was great for a long-term stay. We loved living in Greenpoint, we loved the view, and the apartment was well stocked and had everything we needed during our six week stay.   We only had two complaints, the ladder up to the loft is really steep and kinda scary to climb every day. The loft ceiling is also low so it didn't feel like a proper second bedroom. The apartment is also quite dark in the evenings.   All-in-all, this is a great place with lovely hosts and we would stay here again.

Lee's place is amazing, really like a home away from home in the heart of Williamsburg, steps away from Soho so you get the best of both worlds. Lee was really caring and always in touch via text message, making our stay stress-free and convenient. Bonus point for the backyard which feels like the hippest bar's terrace, only much quieter and you have it all to yourself ;)

We went to New York to greet our new grand child.  Our needs were to be close to the M and stay in a nice oasis.  Lee's place is just wonderful and very convenient.  Tried a new restaurant everyday.  Tons of places to try within a 20 minute walk.  We loved the Brooklyn Tree and Thighs & Pies.  Lee's place is just super cool.  Tons of amazing art on the walls and books in the shelves.  The appliances are in great shape, there is a drug-store and grocery store around the corner.  The patio is magical.  Couch and chairs are super comfy.  Will stay here again.

Roger is by far the best host we have had in any country. Your house is very cozy and very clean! The location is very good, steps from the metro that connects everything! And it's not dangerous at all. LP I recommend 100%

We spent 8 nights in July at Katya's place. The room was bigger than it looks on the pictures and definitely big enough for two people. The bed was comfortable. Overall the room was really clean, AC was working great which was a blessing with the humid heat of NYC. Everything you would need like a table or clothing rack was included. The bathroom was also absolutely satisfying. We were also allowed to use the kitchen as long as we cleaned up after ourselves which turned out to be super convenient. Katya was a lovely host. She helped us whenever she could and gave us tips on what to do and how to get around the city. We had our privacy but when we needed her she was there. The whole atmosphere was comfortable and safe. We also got two pairs of keys which can be quiet useful depending on what you're planning to do if you travel as a pair.  The apartment is a 3 minute walk to the next subway station from where you can get around the city quite easily. A supermarket and a drug store are also really close. The park next to the subway was lovely and a good possibility for a chilled evening. A movie theatre is one subway stop away. We enjoyed our stay, coming back to the apartment felt like coming home (the most home you'll get in a foreign country) and we would definitely stay there again. Kathinka & Lilja from Hamburg

I had a wonderful stay at Margrethe and Stein’s apartment over Christmas! The apartment is so comfortable and attractive, with huge windows and lots of natural light! Very cozy, especially for being away from home (during the Omicron wave!) over the holiday. A quiet residential block, yet between 2 commercial streets with groceries, coffee, liquor, drug stores, restaurants … lots of choice. Close to the waterfront (& water taxi) and subway, too. I’m hoping it works out to be able to stay there again!

Good apartment in a very good location. Very easy to reach by subway and you can quickly walk to Central Park and you can go downtown by subway. Sasha was very nice and helpful and the dog is also very friendly. He is very well behaved and you definitely don't have to be afraid of him
Great location. For the rate, this apt is a steal

Mio's place is safe, comfortable, and in a great location. Very close to the subway, quick food, a drug store, and several sites.  Mio was a little bit more communicative than other airbnb hosts in my experience, but outside of making sure we understood the rules and giving us a 10 minute orientation over the more particular parts of his home, he left us alone and made sure we had everything we needed. The bed was comfortable, there was an AC that we used on a hotter night and extra blankets that we used on a cooler night. I loved using Mio's comfy recliner at the end of long walking days in the city.

The things I didn't like (I understand that some of these were advertised)  The 20 minute induction felt unnecessary and was at a very inconvenient time (11pm) after a long flight. Everything we went through was on the manual and basic things like light switches, turning off the stove etc.  Mio's communication was excessive. He was constantly checking in over nothing and when I didn't respond (I didn't have a phone and his internet wasn't working) he was annoyed and persistent. His own communication was poor during my check in time (I get it, sometimes things come up which is fine, but he didn't extend the same courtesy to myself when I was in a foreign country without a phone and busy with activities) Mio's apartment is very cluttered. It's full of old books, DVDs, bags of food (some of it out of date) and other stuff.  When you sleep in the bed, there are items piled up on one side above the height of the bed. When I lost an earring behind the bed, I found half drunk soda and out of date food.  When I was trying to reset the router, I also found a pair of underwear amongst the sea of cables. The apartment needs a good clean out as there are large portions that don't look like they have seen a vacuum for a long time. The bed is surrounded by mirrors, many of which look like they are about to fall off and others that are broken. I felt unsafe sleeping there and had to put a blanket against one edge to avoid touching the sharp edges.    The things I liked  Location is great, right near a subway and walking distance to a few more lines. The apartment has a doorman, air conditioning and a kitchen with bowls, cups etc. The lighting shown in the photos is nice

Mio’s apartment is amazingly located, 50m from the metro station, in a very living and nice neighborhood. This is the best advantage of the apartment and it is great. Decoration is old-style charming. Moreover, Mio was flexible with arrival and departure times, which we appreciated.  Unfortunately, the apartment shows major flaws. Most equipments are obsolete (e.g. various stuff in the bathroom, kitchen equipment, including cooking gas configured in a way that favors risk to open gas accidentally - it happened to us despite Mio’s warning, which is so dangerous!) when not simply broken (e.g. toilet flush, mirrors around the bed). The apartment is very dark. The Wifi doesn’t work properly. But what was the most annoying is that the apartment is not clean. A few examples, but the list could be so much longer: many personal stuff are stacked under blankets and have obviously not been moved for months; various corners of the apartment are dusty and you can find old products and dirty things if you explore them (e.g. if you pull the bed or try to access the Wifi router); floor is carpeted and obviously old and dirty. We also suspect presence of bugs: we got bitten every single night with bites more looking like spider ones than mosquito’s (we didn’t leave the windows open especially to avoid mosquitos).  Even though the price probably reflects mainly the good location, we were expecting a much better maintained and clean apartment at this price.  Finally, don’t forget your earplugs if you are light sleepers: the street is very noisy and the windows are old, thus don’t mitigate the noise at all.

Katya is very sweet. She has a very sweet cat, too. I have stayed at many AirBnB's and I have to say, this was a very disappointing experience. While the low price is commendable, I would have expected more. I did not stay there the first night of the trip as she initially canceled in the afternoon of the first day of my trip due to car troubles. I panicked for the next hour-plus on what to do. While she figured out a way to host me that night it was too late and I was too anxious to figure out how to change my slapdash plans again.   The apartment is cramped (though the room is fairly spacious). The kitchen and kitchenware are dirty. The noise was exceptional––loud neighbors, honking cars––and I've lived in NYC much of my adult life. (Note, it is on the first floor, street-side of a busy neighborhood.) She also hosted a cooking class in the kitchen one night and showed my room to potential subletters while I was there.   Lastly, the cat. While the cat is sweet and cute, it wants to be in the guest room all the time. I found myself constantly having to get the cat out of the room. Plus a very smelly litter box sits directly outside of the guest room. It was really unpleasant.   I can appreciate that this is Katya's home and she should feel free to do as she wishes, but I would not recommend this room for a visit.

Jeremy was very friendly and accommodating. Great place to stay, only a few minutes walk to the train station that takes you to New York. Safe neighborhood even at late night and his neighborhood guide helps reduce the stress of finding things to do nearby.  Will def stay here again when I visit New York.

Jeremy was an absolutely awesome host. He was really responsive to any questions I had before or during our stay and actually checked in a couple of times while we were there to see if we needed anything. The place was spacious enough for our group of 7 and was a total steal! I'll definitely check back in to see if it's available the next time I'm in NYC.

Linda is an absolute angel and made our stay so incredibly wonderful. My boyfriend and I were moving to New York and she was extremely helpful. She always offered to help with anything, offered her cooking spices so we could make dinners (we stayed for two weeks), and even helped us find an apartment! Little things like letting us print our lease or letting us borrow her measuring tape illustrates how giving she is and willing to help you. The house was immaculately clean, which is such a nice thing to come home to. I do have to warn you that her cooking smells amazing. Our two week stay was without fault and it was so lucky that we found her place. She is a 12 minute walk to the subway and there are loads of shops and great restaurants nearby. The neighborhood is a quiet, residential neighborhood and I never felt unsafe. Takes about 40 minutes to get to Soho from her house. She is a 15 minute walk to Prospect Park, which is really great. Her family is nice and always happy to chat as well. Linda is such a friendly and giving person, and I would recommend staying with her. The listing description was accurate, the room is quite large (we had 5 suitcases for the both us). She is just great.

bring your own bedding. we found he did not change the bedding as there was used male underwear in the bedsheet and lots of hairs etc. groased us out. also front door knob needs to be fixed as it hard to close/open (actually pulls out a bit and coulld be easily fixed). the smell of old garbage permeated the place on our second day, which added to our unpleasant experience. Andreais is a nice guy, and loves art (be prepared for a long detailed intro about his art, life, etc  We did not mind a short background, but not a full biography.

The truth is that Stephanie and her family are very friendly. They have been fantastic hosts. But the experience has not been all that good and not because of Stephanie. The couple who lives in one of the rooms (the one with the dog) has made our experience worse. They ate our food (we kept it in the fridge and it disappeared), they were very dirty using the bathroom, they always left stains and food remains where you brush your teeth. The room is very clean but I don't recommend the kitchen for cooking (there is no place in the refrigerator for guests, it's all mixed up with the people who live there), plus the cleanliness of the kitchen leaves a lot to be desired. Also, I went with a girl on the trip and it was very unpleasant for her to hear how the couple next door had sex at full volume... It would have been wonderful if it had only depended on Linda and her family, unfortunately that is not the case.

Mahesh's place was great. We had 4 people staying in it and we didn't feel like it we were walking all over each other. It is only 3 blocks away from the C line and it was easy to slip downtown town when ever we wanted to.  While there is lots of street parking available, finding an empty spot is difficult. We had to park in a garage a few blocks south for the first night but we were able to get the car onto the street the next day. Don't forget that the streets are swept twice a week and that you must move your car.  Everything that we needed was supplied. Wifi, towels, cutlery, dishes and much more. Mahesh has even prepared a nice binder of information about the unit as well as the neighbourhood.  The roof top access was nice. There isn't much to see up there however it was nice to be able to sit out and listen to the city at night time.  We felt safe in the neighbourhood as well. We didn't get in until 11:45pm and walking the streets to find the place was fine. On most nights we returned to the until after 11pm and we were never scared of anyone on the streets.  The building was fairly quite. We never ran into any of his neighbours and we were able to sleep with the windows open.   I would definitely recommend staying here. The price was great and the location wasn't bad at all. Between this place and staying in Brooklyn, the price is comparable but the convenience of staying on this island is worth it.

It was our first experience with airbnb and we are very satisfied. Mahesh was very cordial, he answered all the question we had. We had a Little problem to get the key when we arrived but it was solved quickly. The apartment is exactly as the pictures! Very comfortable, clean and it has all what you need. Anyway, we were 4 women at the apartment and the sofá bed is not comfortable for 2 adults. I think the apartment is perfect for 3 adults or for a couple with 2 children. Harlem is secure, we’ve never been scared. Consider not less than 30 minutes to get to Midtown to the local train. You have to get the express (we didn’t knew).

I never got a chance to meet Mahesh as he was away - but we stayed in constant communication. He even organised a friend who lived about 3 hours away to meet me to hand over the keys.  The apartment is small, but cosy. The apartment was well equipped, and really made me feel like I was living there. There is a bed that fits two, and a large couch that could also fit two. The wifi was fast, and there is an Apple TV with all the favourite apps. Mahesh also provided a very folder filled with details about the neighbourhood, sightseeing and places to eat.   The neighbourhood is very diverse - with a variety of culture and food available. There are many people that hang around the streets - but everyone minds their own business, and I never felt unsafe for a minute. It is a bit further away to the iconic tourist spots, but transportation was very easy. You could walk to Yankee Stadium from the apartment.  If you want a more 'lived in' feel, away from the hustle and bustle, and don't mind travelling a bit further - I'd recommend this apartment.

Mice everywhere.   This place was pretty great until the mice showed up. Like a lot of them.   The bungalow was built without proper sealing practices. Plenty of cracks and holes for critters to sneak through. Looking back on it we are pretty surprised it took so long to see them though we suspect they were there.   Thursday we stopped working in the main area for the night they started to come out. That night we saw at least 4 mice, because we saw 4 at the same time, there were more. it's hard to tell because they seemed to be everywhere and you don't really know with mice and I can only vouch for 4 we sawl running in different areas of the house.   It was a good 5/6 hours that night dealing with it. This includes collecting Pictures, cleaning, shooing mice and figuring out what the next moves were for our work trip.   I sent 24 hour support a message that night they sent me a message 8 hours later. I sent the hosts a message first thing in the morning they replied an hour later. I was there the whole day, they apparently were there, they said, no one came out to say what the issue was or apologize.   On Friday, I was packed up and cleaned the airbnb around noon. I started at 6a. The host never came out. The front door of the bungalow faces the back of their house. I saw someone at the table in the house everyday on their computer except that one. They weren't interested.   I booked through Saturday and They were interested in me canceling the reservation as soon as I left so they could put it back on Airbnb the next day. I guess they got all the mice.    They only refunded one night initially. when I asked about the night I discovered mice they said I didn't bring it up 24 hours after I discovered. BS. Then they said because I didn't wait for them to fix it it should be my problem. Then they tried to make me pay a cleaning fee for mice!  I left the place really clean. Not a dish left behind. All the sheets pulled from the beds. Trash taken out using the trashbags I bought because there was none there.   This place won't be stocked.   They act like it's a decision for the Earth but I think they just don't want to spend the money and the temperature of our Earth is a convenient excuse for then.   They tried to make me pay a cleaning fee and that's really all you need to know about who the hosts are.  Oh and you might be ambushed by mice.  Look I get that mice are out there but you should let me know that because I have the choice to stay at a mouse house or not and you shouldn't say that this is the first time it happened and Airbnb shouldn't allow it to be avail the next day.
Inez and A.B made my stay in New York so easy and stress free. They were so helpful, giving me tips about transport and the area. I felt right at home and was sad to leave. Highly recommend!

Came in to the Rockaways from California. Maribel & Carolina's bungalow was the perfection relaxing place to land. It's clean, it's cute, and there's a coffee grinder! The location feels safe—very walkable to the boardwalk or the bay side of the island. And so close to many great restaurants. Everything we needed was nearby, but the house is far enough from busy streets to be peaceful and cozy.  When we did have one issue during our stay, Maribel and Carolina were responsive and helpful. The issue was resolved quickly to our satisfaction and was no stress thanks to great communication from them.   10 of 10, would recommend this place for a relaxing beach getaway. I'll come back when I find myself this way again, and I will recommend it NY friends who will make it to the Rockaways more often than me.

I can’t even begin to express how above and beyond our host (and new friend) went to make our stay absolutely unforgettable. He went out of his way to get my grandmother a cake for her birthday and gave her an amazing piece of framed artwork as well as an in-depth tour of his beautiful home that resembled an art gallery. I can’t put a price on how memorable our experience was, worth more than all the money in the world. Whenever I venture back to NYC, I will definitely stay again. He was so accommodating, friendly, passionate and generous, better than what any hotel could possibly offer. Meeting him and getting the opportunity to hear the stories behind his art pieces was the highlight of our trip! If you choose to stay here, your expectations will be exceeded, I can’t stress how amazing this was.
He is welcoming and adjusting! Mannequins can be a bit scary though. Haha, anyway had a nice stay! I only stayed for 1 night

Hi! I wanna leave a comment about my staying. I lived with 2 girls, and this comment from all of us. For a start, I'll begin with all minuses which we had. 1.this apartment on ground floor. Owner not saying anything about it in the main information. 2.a lot of different insects. We've seen mice few times. In the beginning of our staying, owners called for some service to liquidate them. But after we just lived with mice. Good, we weren't scared of them 3.there was really cold. Last days (December) I slept in sweaters under 2 blankets. Can't imagine how it's gonna be in January and February. 4.our toilet was broken one day. We waited for fixing 2 days. So we couldn't use it for 2 days. 5.strong audibility. Apartment from above was family with children. We heard everything. How this children running, laughing, screaming.   Now pluses.  This apartment is big Garden Washing machine in the building  Owner Michel was really nice and tried to help. But the thing is we couldn't contact him straight. We had number of another woman only!

I was a lost tourist in the area and I had a pretty serious panic attack but the hostess helped give me the confidence I needed to believe I could make it to the air bnb driving. The entire family was very friendly and even the neighbors were willing to help us find our way around. We took several modes of transportation including ferry boat,  bus and uber. It was very convenient to JFK airport and is in a safe neighborhood. Also the family dog Lola is awesome.

Vitaly was a nice and helpful landlord. We (4 adults and 1 child) felt very comfortable in his apartment and it is larger than the photos suggest. Everything was neat and very clean. The residential area is ok and there is a small supermarket right across the street where you can get everything you need. The metro is also right on the street corner. Even though it was East Harlem, we weren't afraid to go out on the streets in the evening/night. All in all, we enjoyed our stay with Vitaly and can recommend his apartment with a clear conscience.

We spend 5 days in Vitaliys Appartement and it was our first trip with airbnb so we had no plan how things are going. Vitaliy was right from the beginning connected to us and the "check in" was very easy. The Appartement is really close to the next Subway, which brings you every 3 Minutes to all important places in town in not more than 10-15 minutes.  Everybody told us at the beginning harlem is a dangerous area to live in, but the people there were so friendly and helpfull all the time we had a question.  The Appartement itself is exactly how it is descibed in the announcment: clean, a great citchen with everything you need in it, two separate bedrooms and a really really big tv! It was always a good feeling to come home after a long and interesting day in the city. Thank you Vitaliy for making our trip so comfortable and easy!!  Tanja and Monika

Nowme and Ra were very easy to communicate with and very helpful during our stay! My only complaints were the cleanliness of the bedroom and rugs, and the overall neighborhood (a little unsafe if alone). Other than that, everything was as expected and it is a spacious place to stay!
Kat was very sweet helpful & responded quickly. She made my parents visit to NY as pleasant and stress free as possible! Thanks Kat!!

BEWARE - Reported host and moved to a different AirBnB due to safety concerns. Read hosts’s personal reviews (not just review for apartment since he reposts to hide bad reviews). Place was not ready for our arrival, was not cleaned adequately, and basement smelled like sewage covered with air purifiers. Was double-booked due to his shady practice of reposting. You do NOT have the entire apartment... owners walk through the apartment to access theirs at all hours ( 4/5am).  Safety hazard: Front egress blocked by owners packages. Kitchen egress completely blocked with spare beds. Apartment cannot safely and comfortably sleep up to 14 people as posted, although due to black mold in basement, no one should even stay here. Call AirBnB customer service like we did to get set up with a new place; do not stay here.

The location was nice and convenient and the place was big enough for me and my guests. Hill had a tenant staying in the above apartment, who had to pass by most of the bedrooms in order to enter and exit the home. This made me and my guests feel a bit uncomfortable and unsafe. There were also a few parts of the home that were previously broken (I.e: cabinet doors, tiles in the BR, the vent in the bathroom. Overall, I enjoyed my stay.

CREEPY, MISLEADING AND GROSS. Please do not stay here especially if you are a group of women. We were not informed that RANDOM MEN would be staying with us. YOU MUST READ THIS REVIEW:  When I first walked in, there was a swarm of at least 15 fat flies that flew at my face! And more kept coming in. The living area and basement bedroom reeked of mildew. When we asked for a discount due to the unpleasant incident we experienced within minutes of being there, Hill said no.  YOU DO NOT HAVE THE ENTIRE PLACE TO YOURSELF. He omits from the listing that his “apartment” is actually INSIDE of your Airbnb. You share the same front door and BEDROOM HALLWAYS as his room on the third floor. He has to walk past the living room and all of our bedrooms THAT DO NOT HAVE WORKING LOCKS  in order to get to his room.  Hill did not tell us that his friend Dylan was staying with us in Hill’s room until the night before our arrival. We were uncomfortable with it but we had to settle for it because Airbnb could not complete our request for a refund in time.  But wait. It gets worse….  At about 5am during our first night there, we hear voices of 2 OTHER UNKNOWN MEN UPSTAIRS in Hill’s room, and none of them were Hill !!! They walked thru our bedroom hallways very loudly and we could not sleep one bit. It made us women feel very UNSAFE that 3 random men were staying with us and our doors did NOT lock. Who knows what could have happened to us women if we stayed!  After one horrific night here, Airbnb Support finally gave us our money back to relocate and we stayed in a hotel for the remainder of the trip.   Avoid this place at all costs!

Amazing location, easy stay, everything you need in an apartment. Had no problems what so ever, very communicative host and I can't stress how amazing the location was! If you want a flavour of new york, stay here :)

Umut's place is very conveniently located and Umut was quick to respond to my messages. Check-in went smoothly and I had no issue accessing the apartment. The place isn't very big, but that's to be expected at this price point and is clearly communicated in the listing. It's definitely enough for two people and their luggage. The apartment is located in a fantastic area filled with great bars and delicious restaurants just around the block. Location-wise, I couldn't have asked for a better area to stay in during a weekend in Manhattan. The subway is a short walk away and a convenience store is just around the corner in case you need to grab any snacks, drinks, or essentials you may have forgot to bring with you.  However, I did run into a few issues during my stay there. We spent the first day with no AC in our room - the previous AC unit had broken before our arrival and was removed from the room. Forgivable and not the end of the world as we weren't planning to spend a ton of time in the apartment, but in humid 85+ degree weather, I would have appreciated a heads up before I got there. Umut was quick to let us know that a new AC unit would be installed the following day.  My girlfriend and I saw that we both got a lot of bug bites after our first night's stay, leading us to believe that there may have been bed bugs or that the bedding had not thoroughly cleaned, as the bed wasn't made when we got there when we arrived on the first day.  The replacement AC unit was installed on our second day while we were out, which was appreciated, but the drapes from the window were left on our bed instead of being taken out and cleaned. We woke up the next day with many more bug bites, which needless to say, was very unpleasant.  The checkout process was smooth and painless.  Under different circumstances, I would have given the AirBnB a much more positive review. Umut was very pleasant during our communications and responded near immediately. However, I have to be honest and I can't excuse the issues I had with the window drapes being left on the bed after AC installation and the abundance of bug bites that we woke to each morning. These were problems that could have been prevented - had these issues not have occurred, I would happily recommend this listing.

This place is amazing. Don’t be afraid of the word basement. Jonathan makes this place very accommodating. This is a great place for a small group ,15 minute walk from the subway and a very safe neighborhood to walk during the night. Food and bagels very close by!

We have spent 8 nights in the apartment and everything was great. The apartment is new and has absolutely everything, it is very comfortable and we loved the area, Harlem is an authentic and multiethnic neighborhood where people greet you as you pass and you have a supermarket and all kinds of stores. In the heart of Harlem, nothing dangerous, we are a couple with a 5-year-old child. You have the metro nearby, about an 8-minute walk away and you are on 42 in 15/20 minutes. Choosing this apartment was a success because it allows you to experience a real NY, not just the skyscraper area. We would repeat without a doubt.  Richard who lives upstairs is a lovely person, he made things very easy for us and behaved with us more than well.  I recommend it 100%.

This was my second time doing airbnb in Harlem and unlike the first place I stayed Richard's place was AWESOME.  Richard is cool, gave us privacy to the max and made unawkward convos during our passings lOl. Such a good deal considering the location....walk down the quiet block and you end up in a central busy part of Harlem. The place was clean.... Future guest: DO NOT TRASH THIS BEAUTIFUL PLACE... I plan to come back....and the shower that is not pictured is a nice surprise. It's huge! this treasure was a steal. Totally worth it!!!!

Aron's little family welcomed us very warmly and did everything to facilitate our arrival there (information before the flight, what to make breakfast for the next morning and the following days, an impromptu aperitif the next day in the cool on their terrace,...etc). We were also spoiled during our stay (homemade bread, cookies, etc.). In short, the best! The neighborhood is great: the subway to Manhattan or Conney Island just a stone's throw away, enough shopping for our evening meals just a stone's throw away, restaurants nearby, very quiet and very safe neighborhood. The apartment is very well laid out: two separate bedrooms, at both ends of the apartment, a very well-equipped kitchen, a sufficiently spacious living-dining room, a bathroom with a very pleasant walk-in shower after a day of walking! Aron and his family are available at any time if needed, and above all, don't hesitate to go eat, have brunch or have a drink in one of Aron's establishments! We recommend!

E + M are great hosts! They go above and beyond to make sure their guests feel comfortable and cared for. The bedding is super comfortable, which is really important to me - I slept great. This is NYC and the apartment is on a busy avenue, so you might hear traffic noise during the week if you're in the street facing room. Something to consider, if you are prone to sleeping in past 8:30am. But there are also plenty of rooms to choose from that aren't right on the street.  I didn't end up using the kitchen much, but it was made clear that was an option. All in all, a great experience with great people. I can't stress enough how nice the beds are, and all the spaces are very clean and comfortable.

Larry was a great host. He was responsive, and had the place pretty neat and prepped for my family and I. We only stayed one night. The area was a bit sketchy and there were several people fighting outside the apartment complex.  Otherwise our experience with this host was great. The apartment is conveniently located and it was easy for us to explore the city and get back at the end of the day through the subway.

Never thought I’d be #thatguy writing a bad review. Shower has a mini window in it, I felt a bit uncomfortable. Lock outs from apartment door happened occasionally. Me and other guests were stuck out multiple times. They also have trespassers enter the space without notifying guests, plus construction occurring leaving the front door open for anyone to enter. I felt pretty unsafe here. Host also threatened to call law enforcement on me. Again, I’ve never had issues to this extent and I’m usually a low maintenance person that is far too lazy to complain.

The room was clean, but there were cockroaches and that was very unpleasant for my entire family. I suggest fumigating thoroughly. I require a refund because we were only 4 people and not 5 as we initially indicated, and my son had an accident and therefore could not come with us. I await said return. He was not kind, he even said that we took the cockroaches! That's an insult to anyone! This host is very unpleasant. Don't admit your mistake!

I contacted the host early checkin day to infirm second person on the reservation would be checking in. “Eliza”said the first person has to check in an Airbnb rule. She refused to answer calls stating on a call all day to have air B&B handle it. Airbnb, agreed that the second person on the reservation was allowed to check in and they would reach out to the host to tell them. The host responded that they would not allow that, and didn’t care that I wasn’t in town yet even at all yet, and would not consider any resolution that either Airbnb, or I offered other than to cancel, lose my money and rebook, and pay again. We asked if we could switch to my daughters Airbnb account so she could check in, and they refused to do any kind of working with basically robbing us of over $700. We were ready willing and able to check in and the place was completely paid for, for out of town guests that flew in! She was nothing but rude and a thief. Totally just scammed for the money! DO NOT RENT

Prison is better. Lack of privacy, gangs, all strange male people and no communication from host, asked for help, no clean was like living inside a garbage can even if they charge you a cleaning fee 1 bath  for 20 people, 3 by 3 meters for 20 people, no room at all, is a kichen with beds, 20 people cooking, ypu get to smell 20 times their cooking plus night heavy conversations and tv.m and sicknes 20 people sick coughing COVID unfriendly !!! Buildong has lots os stories had to escalate forever!!!!!......VERY UNSAFE AREA !!!!!!!! Entire place Should be shut  down .....will report to public safety and health

Very good stay, excellent value for money!  There is a good atmosphere, people from all countries, some for a few days others for longer, I was a little scared because I am a single woman but I had no problem!  The common area is cleaned every day, and there is always a manager at the apartment.  Location-wise, the neighborhood is not idyllic but very well located in relation to the subway and you are in the center of Manhattan in less than 30 minutes, and contrary to the reputation of the Bronx: no drug addicts, no fights, no gunshots: it's safe :) If you're not big on privacy, this place is ideal! I recommend 100%

Our stay in Gin's place was okay however we had some issues that made the experience far from perfect.  Pros: The bedding and towels were clean and there were plenty of towels available.   The water pressure and heat in the shower and sinks were great.  There's a convenience store/bodega at the end of the block for any small or quick purchases you may need to make.  Times Square is a roughly 40 minute train ride from the studio.   Cons: Communication was ok - we asked for a late checkout and only received a response two months later, by which time we had made alternative plans. There was zero communication during our stay, not even to as if we had arrived or if everything was okay.  The apartment had some cleaning issues, e.g. the fridge and other kitchen appliances were dirty, and so were the bathroom wall tiles.  We also feel like we shouldn't be asked to run the dishwasher and strip the bed when we're paying an $100 cleaning fee.  Despite being noted in the listing, there were no salt, pepper, or oil so it was an inconvenience to make even basic meals.  We were only provided with two toilet papers for eight nights which ran out midway through our stay.  The blinds are see-through, far from ideal in a ground floor apartment where homeless people dig through the bins right outside the window.  We had to stick plastic bags on the windows to have some privacy.  Gin was responsive when we mentioned the cleaning issues and she agreed to refund us 50%  of the cleaning fee.  All in all, we feel there are many improvements to be made until we could recommended the place to others.

For my extended stay to begin my relocation, Marco & Jorge were beyond amazing hosts that made sure the unit was clean & comfy, they tried their best to remedy any unfavorable experiences. However, some were just out of their control.   For the first 5 weeks, the water was merely warm and not hot 90% of the time — Jorge did inform the super of this, but no real improvement until my final week.   If you’re looking to frequent Brooklyn or Harlem, it’s a bit far. Prep for a ride averaging 1 hour & 20 minutes per way by transit or $60+ per way for ride share.   The location is great for being in walking distance to stores of various types. However, the environment can be a bit intimidating & worrisome when there’s a random homeless man sleeping in the lobby or a few of them hanging on the stairs in the middle of the night. There would also be locals who did not live in the building— I asked — loitering & smoking on the stairs throughout the building. The neighbors would allow their dogs to urine & bowel on the stairs & if it happened during the weekend, it would sit there for days until it was cleaned. There would also be an occasional roach in the unit but I think that mainly comes with the building — nothing to do with Jorge & Marco.   I also had 2 Amazon packages stolen from in front of the 5th floor unit door, the neighbor informed me that drug addicts tend to head to the roof to “do their business” & more than likely took my packages.   All in all, I wish the pair owned another place in a better space. Im appreciative of the experience as NY is my new home but this borough/neighborhood is not best suited for me.

I really enjoyed my stay here! Jarmel and Nicolle were both really nice and accommodating, and I knew if I needed anything I could just ask and they would help me out. The room is pretty big and their place is clean. Checking in and out was easy, and it was in a good area with lots of markets and restaurants nearby, I never felt unsafe walking around. I would definitely stay here again next time I’m in BK. Thank you!
Don’t come here this place is Ass and steals ur money

The “exercise equipment” is just an exercise bike. The couch was missing a cushion when we got there… The bedrooms do not have windows, and the walls are paper thin so you can hear everything that is happening upstairs and in either room. There was an odd door that led to what I’m assuming was the owner’s laundry room. It was locked, but someone twisted the knob two different times over the course of our stay, as if they were trying to get in. It was a nice neighborhood, but odd and kind of sketchy entrance way, as the apartment is the re-vamped basement of their home. It was a satisfactory place to lay our heads for a few days, but not luxury by any means.

Amazing place to stay for a NYC trip (steps away from subway and bus stops). Fabio was an excellent host and helped take lots of stress off a trip to the big city. Room was clean and organized, and we were welcomed on time for a smooth check-in. Thank you for such great hospitality and friendliness during our stay!!
Stress-free

GREAT Clean Roomey Great Location Drive Right to Back Door to Load And Unload  Full Grocery Store 2 Blocks  Drug Store 1 Block Many Restraunents Walking or Short Drive Parking Garage Near By  I Have Stayed at MANY Air B&Bs Easily Better Then Most. Can't Think of A Better One Right Now

Very pleasant stay, perfect if you're looking for a complete apartment for your visit to NY without breaking the bank. Just be mindful that it will take 30-40min to get to NYC. Not the best area but also not the worst either, I never felt unsafe, even walking late at night (Closest subway stations are 5-7 blocks away)  Host was always very friendly and responsive, he addressed quickly any of my needs.

Our stay with Ivana and Juan was perfect! We had booked with another Airbnb host originally and it turned out to be a scam so Airbnb suggested we stay with Ivana and Juan and I'm so glad we did. Our holiday vacation turned out better than expected. We stayed in room "Lovely" and it included a roof deck we enjoyed during 4th of July weekend. The entire apartment, room, and bathroom were all very clean, modern, and simple. Everything in the apartment is labeled, including your own space in the refrigerator which was very helpful. Juan is very friendly, helpful, and super easy going. We are looking forward to staying with them again next time we are in NYC.

Ivana is very sweet and takes good care of the place. Pros from the place: - very close to a metro station. - easy check in. - space is clean.  Some things to consider: - you are sharing a bathroom so the cleanness depends on the other guest even if the host do their best. - bring earplugs if you are sensitive to noise (it’s a shared space as posted in the ad).  - it’s brooklyn: don’t leave anything in your car even if it’s of no value for thieves. They’ll take it anyways.  Thank you Ivan’s and Juan for the stay.

There is mold on the shower curtain. The light of the guest bathroom works intermittently and blinks. The lower shower head (or handle) in the bathroom is loose—when you try to switch (bring the water to the upper shower head), it might fall out and this is very dangerous cause you might turn on hot water then the handle fell out. Before you have time to put the handle back, hot water already flowed out and it almost burned my dad’s feet. Some unusual requirements for Airbnb check in and check out process which makes the process less seamless. They want you to provide ID before check in and doesn’t have a secured way for you to send your ID to them (they want you to send via Airbnb msg or email, neither of them are secured). I feel uncomfortable to send my Id pic and ask a FaceTime to show them my ID and they did accommodate me. They also ask ID for my parents but I don’t have that with me and they let it go. For check out process—they want us to tie all garbage bags and send pics of the bathroom and bedrooms before we leave. So if you are looking for a seamless check in and check out process—this Airbnb might take some time away from your family time.   Some other things I like about this Airbnb—good location for people who travel with a car because the house comes with a free driveway parking. The house is pretty spacious for a family. Quiet neighborhood. The floor/kitchen/fridge/bedrooms are clean. The door lock is very easy to use.

Kamelia is a consummate host. She was thorough and thoughtful in her communications and went above and beyond to make our stay stress-free. The space is stylish, straight-forward, and very clean. Everything needed or wanted is there and it was absolutely perfect for our needs. The bed was extremely comfortable, and the sofa bed setup in the living room worked great for my son. The 5 block walk to Whole Foods made it easy to prepare some of our own meals, and hopping on the subway to get downtown or catch a cross town bus was a breeze. I can't wait to stay here again!

Enjoyed our stay with Demetrius. Area isn’t bad but dangerous during nighttime so be safe! Otherwise we liked the local markets and how close it was to train station. I would recommend if you’re on a quick trip for a few days.

it was a pleasure being your guest.  Hospitality, support and communication perfect. Unfortunatly the apartment itself in the explanation was much better shown as in reality. Poor technical devices, old bathroom with broken faucet etc., non working elevator, honestly a bit dirty, dried flower pots, cabinets in bedrooms almost full stuffed with duvets, pillows. We had a higher expectation on comfort for that price. The area was more or less ok, even a bit scary. People were arrested by police in front of the building, screaming people at night, person walking down the fire stairs outside, looking into the apartment.  Not enough shower towels for one week as well as dish towels or dishcloths.  Honestly not recommended for people traveling with kids, like I did.  Maybe it helps.  best regards  Michael

The apartment is on the 3rd floor which is fine - upon arrival the elevator had broken down and wasn't fixed in the time we were there so be prepared to take the stairs if need be.  The apartment was very warm so we did run the window AC while we were sleeping to cool it down a little bit.  There are quite a few restaurants/bars within walking distance and the Subway is only a block away which makes getting around a lot easier. The neighborhood is a little "busy" but we never felt unsafe and walked into Harlem multiple times.  I would definitely stay here again.

Nice sized apartment within walking distance to multiple subways, very easy self checkin and checkout, TV with multiple streaming services. The location was a bit sketchy but we never felt uncomfortable except that we couldn’t get the windows to lock. The area is also very noisy at night and all into the early morning but it’s the city. Overall 8/10 would recommend Jeroys place. Extremely convenient.

This Listing is a side of a house , We heard the people upstairs walking around at 12-1 Am keeping us from sleeping, The door to the side of the house doesnt close all the way so we kept hearing it wack against the door like a big thud that scared not only my wife but me as well all hours of the night , I also left food sitting on the counter for about an hour and the next thing I know I look into my pizza box and see Ants throughout the whole thing and thru the garbage as well , He only left us 1 trash bag , 1 Towel each , Along with 1 Handrag , For 1 week stay? This needs work done and Im very upset

Emily's place is an absolute treasure: a real haven within the bustle of the city, and a genuinely lovely space that feels like home from the moment you arrive.   For the whole course of the stay, the apartment was comfortable, elegantly designed, well-stocked with essentials, and felt safe and secure. When small issues arose, Emily helped to deal with them instantly, and was a lovely and gracious host from the moment of (easy, contact-free) arrival, to the simple, low stress departure.   In terms of the space itself, the extremely tall may struggle a little with the apartment being designed more for a shorter person, but speaking as a 6 foot 4 person who spent a month there, these issues are far more superficial than fundamental: the place is great at any height, and has high ceilings! The bathroom is a little cramped, but totally worth the exchange for the excellent shower water pressure! Similarly, its a small-ish bed, but a comfortable one.   Small details made a big difference: the newly installed air conditioning was a lifesaver in a NYC July that was sweltering. The plentiful side lights and lovely art everywhere made the whole space feel incredibly warm and welcoming. It's just a lovely place, and well worth staying at!   All of which is to say nothing of the neighbourhood! Prospect Leffert Gardens is a fantastic area - so close to the park, and to multiple subway stops. There are fantastic coffee shops, bars, bodegas and restaurants within minutes of the apartment, and the whole area is incredibly full of life and pleasant to walk around.   If you get the chance, then - stay here!

The worst apartment I've ever been to. The bathroom was not clean at all. There was hair everywhere, I had to collect hair from the shower and there were just as many attached to the walls, to the sink, everywhere.  And that wasn't even the worst of it: the apartment is located above a nightclub that plays very loud music until 4 am. The volume was so loud that I had to look for another accommodation. The public attending this club is by no means recommendable and was clearly drunk and on drugs. I state that I have traveled to dangerous places and I am not looking for the latest fashion and posh apartments. I just needed a quiet place! I wish I could upload the pictures and the videos I shot in order to show you the mess I found! Furthermore, from the club kitchen downstairs comes a terrible smell of cooking and garlic that pervades the whole apartment. The owner shows no support whatsoever and she doesn't seem at all interested in the problems that can occur in the apartment. She never replied to my messages and I had to open a dispute with Airbnb for that. In summary, a place to be avoided in all ways!

Apartment is just as it looks online, really beautiful! it is in a commercial neighborhood that is quiet at night. If you are not afraid of public transit, there is a bus stop on the corner that can take you to the subway. Costco within walking distance. Host has good and fast communication! Downstairs neighbors are really nice. Great stay just outside the city. Perfect for our family of 4.

Loved the apartment, it’s exactly as shown in the picture. It’s not far from the city, but would recommend having a car. Uber and public transportation is also an option. Maddalena, the host, was super friendly, accommodating, and responsive. Other than expecting us to use common sense by treating the house with care, as our own, she didn’t have a thousand intricate rules, or brought any stress upon us, as sometimes found by other Airbnb properties. This alone was worth the booking, as it was so refreshing and stress-free. We respected the home, were friendly to the neighbors, cleaned up after ourselves, and left items where they belonged- simple. You can tell the host took a lot of pride in her property by offering multiple high quality bath towels, robes, shampoo/conditioner, soap, washing detergent, iron, as well as some basic kitchen items such as tea, coffee, sugar, salt, pepper, oil, water, etc. The property felt more like a fancy hotel. I would book this place again.

Raisa was very helpful, she was responding to every message, any question. We arrived later than we expected but the check-in solution is great. The apartment is great, very clean, feel like home with all of the stuff like books, comics, projector, Keith Haring stickers. Whereabouts a little scary for the first time, but after few walks you realize that it is totally safe neighborhood. We felt like we had a whole apartment for ourselves :D Bed is really comfy (I’m 190cm/6.2ft tall), there are no thick curtains in the bedroom so if you are coming to party in New York and sleep late maybe it’s not the best option, but if you’re sightseeing- it’s perfect, it helps to get up in the morning. Raisa provides coffee and various tea choice <3 It’s right next to metro line, so the communication is good (city and jfk). Oh and Raisa lent us umbrella when it was raining. She is great, I definitely recommend her place.

very clean and affordable home for the location! perfect for 2-4people and so much options for things to do because subway station is right at the corner. show locals love by shopping for your basic needs at the bodega and drug stores near by! 🤙🏽

Place was good in terms of the location in being central to everything in NYC - subway right around the corner and convenience stores nearby. We basically took the metro everywhere. Food was also not an issue. Staying in Harlem was a bit of a scare though since a lot of weird people walk around at night and when we were returning home from a long day it was a little scary. Other than that, it was okay! Pretty clean, and Femala was responsive. She forgot to give us the metro cards at one point but she made sure we had it for the next time we went out.

The stay was 5 days, the subway passes below the apartment and there is a connection to all of Manhattan, but it takes between 20 to 40 minutes depending on where you go. Femala is very attentive and organized, nothing to say about her. The area, although nothing ever happened to us, we were afraid several times, there are very strange people

The apartment was well located, it was an advantage to have the subway in the corner of the house. It is super well maintained and clean. The building is old and has an unpleasant smell, but the apartment was very functional and comfortable. Keep in mind that the apartment is located in the Harlem area, perhaps visually the streets and people are not like Manhattan, but we had no problems. I highly recommend it because of the ease of the metro.

Great stay if you don’t want to stay in the city! the apartment itself is quiet don’t let the location scare you! all the bodegas are walkable and across the street from location, everything else is about 15-20 minutes out :)

What you see is what you get.  The apartment is exactly like you see in the pics. The area is easy to come and go due to proximity to buses and subway.  Just make sure to check for basic items that should be available as soon as you get there. We did not have enough sheets for 3 days and there were no blankets (since it was end of summer we bought 2 and donate to charity the day we left) in the apartment.   Communication with host seemed fine until we had a problem:  Dont receive any online shopping on your door, cause neighbours choose the expensive ones and steal it.  A U$187 box got stollen whithin 2 hours of delivery.  Besides not being very interested in solve the problem, the host blamed us for being robbed, and also started to use a very passive-aggressive tone with us.  As, at this point we did not feel as safe anymore, We waited for our last day and filled a police report (and made sure to clarify that it is not a crime nor a federal offense to receive amazon packages on an airbnb, especially if we had the place for 30 days!!! ) to try to activate my insurance.

I will definitely return someday. This was the perfect jumping off point for all of my adventures & such a nice, cozy place to come home to.   Location is perfect. On a quiet street / safe building but with access to everything the city has to offer. Love the decoration inside, too. Everything you need to cook and hang out — but walking distance to a bunch of great restaurants etc. Spacious inside too!   My only caveat is for folks wanting a super corporate-feeling Airbnb. This is more like staying in a friend or relative’s place while they’re away— it’s clean, they leave you to have a great time/ are a phone call or text away, but there are traces of them them there. So it requires some mutual respect. I like that feeling, personally, but nowadays I think some people expect sterile / no personality hotel-like environments.    I thought it was really great — and it’s really a steal of a deal. Like I said, will return!

the place was not clean at all at arrival and it wasn’t like a last minute booking either. it’s kinda funny bc i seen the comment before mine talking about the cleaning status, and it scared me, but i didn’t think much bc they said it was a last minute booking for them. but i booked this place a whole two days before and it was still dirty. bro they literally swept a pile of dirt into a corner and didn’t even pick it up. idk what was going on with the cleaning but it was just way too uncomfortable to stay. they also mentioned having soap but there wasn’t any. there was a questionable stain on the bathroom floor doorway which looked like dried blood honestly too and the host had nothing to say about that part when brought up. although, they did mention the stain on the bathroom counter was permanent. there was more crusty stuff on the floor next to the toilet too which looked like throw up, idek what that was. there was just a lot wrong for no reason honestly but thankfully Airbnb helped me out and gave me the full refund back. Thank you Ralph!!!!! how do you leave a place like that for your guests and expect them to be okay with it? if i didn’t get Airbnb involved then i probably wouldn’t have gotten my money back. the place would’ve been nice though if it was just kept clean. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
The place is good but the location is not the best one. It is a little bit dangerous. The supermarket is very far and all day including nights you feel inside the apartment the marijuana smell.

Amanda's place is a steal. Beautiful apartment with all the character you'd expect in an old NYC apartment. Amanda was a great host with clear instructions which made check in and out go smoothly. The neighborhood is walking distance to a ton of good restaurants and bars, as well as Prospect Park nearby. The apartment was very clean and the internet was reliable which made it easy for us to work from there a couple days. I would definitely recommend staying here!
A very scary area.
Nice but can hear upstairs residents can be kinda creepy in the middle of the night.

It was such a pleasure to arrive and stay at Tara’s place! After a long and stressful day of traveling, it was such a relief to be in such a comfortable, clean and convenient place. I was glad to have the private entrance as I arrived late. Tara went above and beyond as far as thoughtful amenities and comforts. Tara was a great host and I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking to stay in Queens, NY- whether it be for the sightseeing or for convenient proximity to JFK Airport.

The apartment is cute, spacious and cozy. However, the first impression can be…surprising. The address wasn’t the one on Airbnb (unfortunately it was the building in front, that was more degraded..). The entrance is very old and not clean. We were welcomed by Omer. He was very sweet and helpful!  In terms of hygiene : there was a dirty Kleenex on the counter when we arrived, the toothpaste available was already open from the previous clients.. same for shampoo, coffee, toilet paper…. This was really disappointing.  Lastly, no tv and the heater seems broken and dangerous to use.

Great host, good communication and accurate listing.   The neighborhood can be sketchy is you are a newcomerwhich something the host can't change. If you're looking for a place to crash for the night, this is your place to be.

This apartment was both well located and maintained. However, because the apartment is on the ground floor (not mentioned in the description), there was a problem that made our stay almost unbearable. The problem wasn’t the noise of the hustle and bustle of the city (we are accustomed to living in large cities). The problem was the constant and interruptive noise coming from the loading dock (also not mentioned in the description) located a mere 15 feet away from the main room window. We contacted the AirBnb host, who only provided earplugs and an apology note as a fix. The solutions were not commensurate with the price of the apartment (our stay was $3000), and did not resolve the problem.  More frustrating: we were offered by the owner a discount on a future stay at one of their AirBnbs in NYC, but, like before, this did not make-up for the unpleasant circumstances of our stay.

So me and my friend went to NYC for the first time (first time America as well), and we couldn't had a better stay! Kirk's apartment is in Upper East Side of Manhattan, a great location since it's a nice neighborhood. Typical New York houses and streets, and not too noisy either. I was afraid it would be very noisy, but it really wasn't, and still so close to everything. Around 3 blocks away from Central Park (around 10 minutes walking), and with plenty of nice restaurants and supermarkets nearby. The apartment is also just perfect, it's big enough and still very cozy, plus Kirk is such a nice guy, very helpful as well. Really not your typical landlord, very relaxed and with interesting stories to tell. So all in all just perfect, the price for what you get and the location as well, is almost a bargain (for NYC standards). My next time New York will be in Kirk's apartment for sure.

Kirk was easily the worst host I’ve ever had to deal with on Air BnB. He ghosted my fiancé and I at check in time, so we had to contact Air BnB support. After finally being able to get in touch with him and check in 3 hours late, he took a full heel turn.
