Once he found out we contacted support, he grew increasingly rude with each consecutive message, insulting us and even accusing us of ulterior motives (i.e. trying to get a free refund back from Air BnB).   We did not end up even staying the full length of our reservation. Due to the hostile nature of his rhetoric with us, we decided to cut our trip short and NOT stay in the rental unit for our initially scheduled second night, as we felt unsafe and uncomfortable staying there again.   It’s a shame too since the unit itself was very nice and well-maintained, but the interaction with the host was not only frustrating, but truly appalling. We’re still trying to see if a resolution can be had with Air BnB over this stay.

i rented the apartment, but Kirk doesn’t sends me instructions for entering.  So… he also doesn’t react to my calls and messages about a whole day and at the next day. And i have to cancel my order via airbnb help assistant (about 5-7 hours) — i’m just want flying from Huston to NY and stay comfy at home  this day was extremely stressful for me and my husband.  hope your staying will be better

I stayed for 6 weeks and would definitely stay again. The building is fantastic and most residents stick to themselves except for when you meet in the kitchen to cook. The neighborhood feels neglected, but I never felt unsafe. It’s a trek to get to the parts of Crown Heights with more restaurants, bars and sense of community. There is a gym close by and that’s a plus. I appreciated that hosts helped me out when a housemate’s service animal would not stop barking causing difficulty for focused work. They helped me move to another room without having to pay a transfer fee.

Before check-in, communication was great. The moment I unlocked the door, I killed a roach. The apartment was not clean at all. Stains on the toilet paper, towels, and sheets, as well as spider webs, dust, and dirt. When I reached out to the host about cleanliness concerns, communication automatically stopped. They never responded. I had to clean the entire unit top to bottom, buy new sheets, towels, and toilet paper. The front door did not fit the frame properly allowing for bugs to crawl through. I killed roaches and spiders the entire stay. Upon check out, I went through all of the drawers to ensure nothing was being left behind and thats when I found drugs!!! I huge zip-lock bag of crystal meth and distribution baggies as if someone was selling dope out of the airbnb. I felt as though my life was in danger finding that amount of drugs. Anyone could of kicked the door in to get their meth back! I wouldn't recommend this stay to my worst enemy. Hopefully I'm issued a full refund as airbnb promised.  Update: Airbnb only refunded $199 for my horrible stay in park slope. Although I was told by Airbnb representatives on a recorded line that I would be fully refunded. Not only was I lied to by the host, but also by Airbnb themselves. Clearly they are not concerned for the safely of their guest only the money that we spend! Lesson learned!

Jacqueline made my first trip to NYC and Brooklyn a lot less stressful. She accommodated me and four friends, along with our two dogs who, at one point got the zoomies and disturbed the lovely neighbor below (again so sorry). Jaqueline emailed me to let me know it was loud and was so understanding and professional! She was incredibly welcoming and accommodating! Would absolutely stay there again when we are in town.
The place could really be cleaner, the room has an unpleasant smell, the kitchen & the living room is dark and quite a mess. Only the price can be of satisfaction

Good for a short term stay. Comfy bed, convenient location near the train, Prospect Park and grocery stores/cafes/pharmacy etc. Host was very responsive and tried to resolve any issues ASAP. Just one thing to note, one side of the street can be a little bit sketchy after dark even for Brooklyn standards.

Our last night in the US was terrible at this accommodation, not relaxing. I absolutely do not recommend it.  The room was very dirty when we arrived. Strands of hair, traces of soil and other unidentified stains on the sheets and cushions. Has it been changed? My partner was horrified to have to sleep on this. We had to spread clothes over us to avoid contact.  On the floor, the same sad observation: heaps of dust and dirt in every corner. Under the bed: waste and packaging, even a tongue scraper as a gift on the desk.  Let's not even talk about the bathroom... Tartar, dirt, dust... Everything to catch a yeast infection. Moreover, a bath towel is not much for this price! It is unacceptable to house people in these conditions.  I asked the next day for a partial refund from Frederick who immediately refused, being unpleasant, daring to declare that the responsibility was mine! What bad faith! The person who had been nice by messages before the journey then turned.  Fortunately, Airbnb heard me and refunded a large part. I don't know how to thank them for this adorable and fantastic goodwill gesture !

DeMarius did not respond to any message prior to arrival, even weeks before. The only time he reached out was 90mins prior to arrival to ask when we were thinking of checking-in, his check -in instructions were for after 3PM, so we would be checking in at that time; we were already on the road to Brooklyn from Philadelphia. Then there was no response for a while, until we received a message saying there was an emergency with the property and that it wouldn’t be handled until after the weekend. How convenient and sketchy.  The four of us were led to scramble with AirBNB support in finding a new place. Each and every attempt afterwards failed even hotels. Finally settled on an actual BNB that we found on our own.

the check in was extremely unprofessional. there was a rude homeless looking guy in a tank top that wouldn't leave me alone. much prefer contactless sign in. the room had no ac and the guy kept on insisting that was a feature. it was terrible. I was so annoyed and frustrated.  the room itself is alright. but like I said there no ac when I came in, hopefully they fix it. but it was so hot that day I couldn't stay and had to cancel and leave after coming in. thankfully the host was courteous to give us a refund.  she was fast in replying. and this Airbnb is cheap. but def get what you pay for.

The host was friendly and welcoming but the actual place was more than just unpleasant. The floor was dirty and sticky, one of the blankets wasn’t washable but it was obvious that it was used many times. The mattress on the bathroom floor was soaking wet and the bathtub was dirty and had some clumps of tissues in it. There were cockroaches everywhere and the kitchen wasn’t usable for us because it wasn’t hygienic at all. We tried to communicate with the host but there was no acceptable solution so we had to leave after the first night.

Llenifer and Rosa are wonderful hosts and the apartment is lovely. It's spacious and very clean and decorated with such detail and care. It's also a nice short distance from JFK, so we had zero stress the day we had to leave for the airport. Llenifer and Rosa were both easy to contact when I had any questions and very friendly. So glad we chose this spot!

The apartment is in terrible building and maintenance conditions. It has sheets, towels and mattresses in terrible hygienic conditions, they are completely stained. It lacked household appliances. Location is decent (except the drug dealers outside the door) but close to everything (10 min walk to a lot). And the one bed was decent, the check in went smooth and the internet (which was through the building and extra) was actually really good (don't have to do laundry, one load is $20, not Eliza's fault that's the building)  The positives end there. We had Mice and cockroaches as if that wasn't bad enough, we returned one night  to no power (it was turned off by the electrotion because there was an issue with the fuse and not safe, contacted Eliza, the solution call maintenance and they just turned it back on (we were leaving the next day so apparently that was ok), difficulty getting toilet paper (only had half a roll when we got there and it took two days to get any more and to get a wash cloth), very little water pressure, burnt out lights, no working fire alarms (litterally a bag over it) and lots of Mold. That's just the start, I could go on. Terrible stay! We've been trying to deal with the issues with Eliza and airbnb but still waiting (we have pics and video of everything) and after a week not getting far  we decided to post our review before other people book this room as we think they need to know (our two kids litterally asked us if we'd posted because they don't want others staying here). I was really sad, I looked for weeks for a 'good' place to stay, this seemed to be it, it WAS NOT. don't risk it, we tried not to let it but it ruined our holiday.

Eliza was extremely responsive. However, if you go in the winter make sure to ask for extra blankets. The heat was sketchy at best and the twin bed needs a new mattress. Otherwise, it worked very well for our events in the city.

Clean, great communication with host reacting on individual needs, location close to very tasty restaurants, I felt a bit unsafe with this neighbourhood - weird talks of people from street coming all night, unprotected fence.
The area was unsafe and we also had room number 1 and when everyone came in they tried to open it. a lot of noise in general

Very bad neighbourhood. Other guest where having an house party: loud music till early morning, people doing drugs outside and constant in/out downstairs/upstairs. Had a sleepless night. I was supposed to stay for 2 nights but I didn’t give it a second chance.

Lamarr has himself a Brooklyn gem. Super spacious with great amenities. Our group of 5 felt right at home. Our group spent most of our time in Manhattan and Williamsburg, so it’s a bit of a train hike to get out there, but we loved the authentic NYC experience of commuting back and forth. Everything is as advertised with no unpleasant surprises.

I really enjoyed my stay at Levian's airbnb! It is a really clean and cozy apartment with one bedroom and bathroom! Such a clean and cozy bedding and comfortable mattress . Kitchen has everything like pots, fans and all utensils which was very helpful. Bathroom was clean as well. Levian and Ashley were really communicative and helful. They let me leave my luggage before check-in time. Location was good and it felt safe. Before staying this airbnb, I stayed at sunset part where i felt kind of dangerous to walk around. But here is much safer and it felt safe walking around even after 10pm, closer to Metro as well. Would definitely recommended!

We had an amazing experience during our stay at Lucas place. It’s really easy to get to Manhattan, and around the Airbnb there’s everything you need like pharmacy and a great market. I saw here some people complaining about the Subway noise, but we couldnt hear a thing. Also, the host was very helpfull during our stay cause we had to leave our bags at the house before the check in and after the check out, and he helped us with that. The only negative Point was that the adress provided after we booked the place was wrong, and we almost had a heart attack when  we arrived at an abandoned building… but we called the host and he provided the right adress (one block away)… so pay attention to that.
House is very clean and comfortable, stress free and very, very convenient.

Makia was a good host during my time at her home. She was friendly, kind, understanding, and trusting. My train to NY was delayed by 7 hours and she went above and beyond by accommodating my late check in.   What made my stay warrant a 3 star review, however, was the condition of the property and the inaccuracies within the listing description. Simply put, there was an important amenity listed but it was not functioning during my stay. To be specific, the listing described a lockable bedroom for privacy and safety. But the lock was broken. It neither locked nor did it even keep the door closed/shut. For whatever reason, it was not repaired prior to my stay nor was the situation communicated with me at all before my arrival. It was quite disappointing as privacy and safety are very important to me; Id like to be able to leave my things in my room without having to worry about it being misplaced or stolen. To be fair, though, Makia did arrange for the lock to be fixed sometime during/after my stay. However, I did not want to risk my safety or the safety of my items/property any longer than I had to, so I cut my stay short. Because of this particular disappointment, I deducted one star from my review. But I expect and hope that for you, dear reader and prospective guest, the doorknob will be fixed by the time youd have read this message. I am only writing about it to keep in faith the spirit of transparency.   The loss of the second star is actually for a few other reasons:  1) The pictures on the listing do not reflect the state of the apartment (as of the writing). There was a lot more clutter in the areas not shown in the pictures. It was clean, just not particularly tidy.   2) Due to the age of the building itself, the creaky floors are obnoxiously loud. Youll find that most townhouses in NYC are the same way but the floors in this building were especially loud & creaky. I could hear those on the floors above and the floors below walking around their apartments and every time they flushed the toilet. It was a bit of an nuisance hearing that while trying to sleep. And on top of that, every time I would walk across the living room or to the bathroom, the creaky floors would announce my comings and goings to the neighbors as well.   3) The neighborhood felt somewhat unsafe at night. The streets were not lit well and the general feeling of the streets at night didnt exactly scream warm & welcoming, much less safe.   But what list is complete without the pros about this listing: 1) Close to the subway 2) Laundromat a short walk away 3) Close to the Brooklyn Botanic Gardens 4) Close to a grocery store
Really great space for the price with easy access to much of lower Brooklyn and NYC via the subway. The location was nice and make a first trip to NYC stress free. Would recommend.

Juliana’s place is perfect if want to explore NYC. Bus stop was around 5 min walk and in less than 40 min you were in the city.   Location is great, I would come back after midnight and never felt unsafe. Plus plenty of good restaurants within a 10 min walk.  Juliana is a great host, communication was great. She also was pretty flexible with somew changes I had to make. I would definitely stay here again next time.

Really great value and cool, large living space. The location is just absolutely awesome, can’t beat it. I loved how arty and Maria were so easy to communicate with- it made it such a stress free stay. Maria even brought over an extra towel for one of my kids, super nice. Would love to stay again!

Our room was robbed on the last visit day (as we guess by a cleaning lady or owner by itself). Stolen items include: ipad, apple pencil, apple watch, niches parfumes and other things (total sum of over 1000 euros). Additionally, individual rooms do not lock up, cockroaches and mouce in the apartament.  Be safe and do not book from this host!!!

Couldn't pick a better location. Walkable to everything. Lots of restaurants, coffee shops, and a grocery store right around the corner. The beds were remarkably soft and so were the pillows. The check in was super easy and flexible. Our neighbors were extremely loud and at times it sounded like they were in our unit but we never felt unsafe. We used earplugs and it was ok. The kitchen was great and just what we needed. The bathroom could use a bit of an upgrade but it was very clean. For the cost, the location and the cozy bed I'd recommend staying here.

Martha was an excellent host and was very helpful all throughout my stay. The air bnb was lovely, clean and comfortable. The location however felt a little unsafe especially at night, would not recommend walking around at night, especially if alone.

The place was awesome! Clean and tidy in a safe apartment complex. Whitney was easy to communicate with and nothing was too much trouble. Don’t be put off by the general area. Can look a little intimidating at first, specially if you don’t live in a city but everyone was friendly and did not at any time feel unsafe :) will come again
The area was a little sketchy for my liking. I come from a big city as well and I felt a little unsafe coming in the apartment at night. But overall a nice cozy place to stay while exploring NYC
The room was beautiful and clean, but the neighborhood was very dangerous. Careful.
the stay was pleasant, I was not uncomfortable but sometimes there were unpleasant odors, it would be good to control that!
Everything went well, yet the area is a little sketchy and Did not feel safe coming back to the apartment at night. Yet it is Harlem, maybe I expected too much?

Unfortunately I had a rough time here. Karen seems very nice, however the room itself seemed to have just been smoked in, I was given no household information (where the bathroom is, trash policies, check out policies, extra bedding, etc) and the couple pillows on the bed were clearly very old and just an inch or two thin. The odor made me quite sick, and the room was very hot. There was also mold growing on the caulk in the shower, which I was told was just a part of the wall falling off after I brought it up. Either way, it was a very uncomfortable and unpleasant stay.

I’m puzzled by the reviews of this place. You can normally trust those but this time, either things have gone downhill here or only a couple of them did justice to the place. Great communication with the hosts before checking in and during the stay, and that’s all. The location is not great with constant people high in crack and rats running around in the street totally unperturbed by people. The area does not feel safe either at day or night with shady characters outside the building and in the walk to the metro. That in itself ruined our vacation, but if the place would’ve been great, maybe it would have balanced it…. But nope. The apartment is very dark even on the sunny days we got. Both the kitchen and the bathroom need repairs and a major renovation. The beds could be nice but the spring mattresses are bended and uncomfortable. The bedding and the towels were clean though, but the headboard has not been cleaned since the bed was moved in here. Once in the apartment, it feels surprisingly quiet and safe but honestly, we dreaded coming out every morning and we dreaded coming back at night. For a cheap place and with the right disclaimers, it could have been an option, but at the few hundred dollars a night, the value is not there and definitely was not what we had expected.

The host's description is absolutely accurate, except that it is not a nice and safe neighborhood after dark. It's Harlem and I wouldn't recommend the accommodation to women alone. There were 4 of us, 2 men, and we're used to a lot from Berlin, but we preferred to play it safe and only took an Uber to the apartment in the evening. There is a love hotel next door and you will be asked right outside the front door if you would like to buy crack. Drug addicts and homeless people were constantly found around the apartment.  The house itself has a nice neighborhood and even with its ground floor location, we felt absolutely safe and comfortable inside. The connection to the subway was great and so was the proximity to Central Park. The supermarket around the corner had a better and fresher selection than in Germany ☺️.

Overall, we had a good stay at Carmichael. the apartment is well located north of Central Park and close to two subway stops. it is spacious enough for 5 people to spend 1 week there, the two bedrooms are also spacious.  However, certain points to review caught our attention: - the apartment deserves a refresh, especially the kitchen and the bathroom - there are few dishes and no tea towels to dry them - The street is frequented by drug dealers and drug users....

We had an excellent stay and for the most part, I highly recommend Carmichael's apartment! It is in a great location, close to Times Square and other areas we wanted to visit. Check in was easy and the owner/manager was very friendly via text. The apartment was spacious with plenty of room for all 5 of us and the building felt very secure. Regarding the area, our group of 5 women never felt unsafe. Take a Lyft, Uber, or taxi at night, use your common sense and take reasonable precautions and you shouldn't have any issue.   We found the front futon a little tricky to fold out but we did eventually figure it out. We were also only given 4 towels for 5 of us for the duration of our stay (checked in Tuesday and checked out Friday) and couldn't seem to find a supply of additional towels anywhere in the apartment. We made it work but if that's a concern, you may want to ask for extra before you arrive. Otherwise, this is a great place and we would stay here again. Definitely recommend!

We liked the accommodation, the location in Harlem was a good choice for our type of holiday because it shows you the real New York. The location is not for everyone (I think for example for a group of girls), of course you can see the presence of drugs everywhere in the neighborhood, but in our group of friends (two men and two women) we felt safe, the people were friendly, we have no negative experience

We were given an apartment with a broken bed. I tried to contact the host about this issue and my calls were being rejected, I then sent a text message and left just for them to respond late. The host was very rude and said that we broke the bed and now wants to charge us for that bed frame, we were only in the apartment for 10 min!. I had to contact airbnb to solve this issue since the host was not helping us at all, we also had to find a hotel to stay that same night. Definitely wouldn’t recommend staying here just because how the owner responded to the issue, the bed should have been checked before we checked in because it is very dangerous for any guest. On top of everything said, the apartment looks nothing like the pictures on the app.
The place is spacious and comfortable, very close to a metro station and the bus stop. The apartment is just like the photos. Entry was easy. I didn't feel unsafe walking at night.

Zeus' review: The TV was HUGE and the bed was comfy. 4 out of 5 stars.

I would love to leave a nice review since Manolo was a great host. Communication was quick, check in instructions clear, room just like on the photos (clean and big). Next to a deli with good coffee and some fast food options (i had pancakes and they are delicious).  But there are few things i need to mention. The room has great vibe, it is comfortable and well equipped. Shower is also great, we always had hot water, only problem was with the toilet, if you close the door you dont have much space for your legs. The neighbourhood was a littlebit dangerous for us, we didn't have any problem, but we felt scare outside.

Basma and Wanly… great hosts ….they answered all of my questions within the hour ….actually less than an hour…. They left munchies in the room for me… which was very appreciative… The bathroom is a little bit small and difficult to maneuver and  if you are not accustomed to the culture of the area it can be a little bit scary…. But it’s not my first time to New York… and I had no problems…. I liked my stay very much and would return… I was very comfortable …..Many thanks again for accommodating my late departure..

Please do not book here. I literally ran out this apartment last night… I had the worse scare of my life. Firstly the area is not safe. It took me 10 mins in the cold to get the door open. I had to physically push this big steal door open. It was dark and almost felt like I was going into an dungeon. I got to my room and my door hand seems loose.   I sad on the bed and then I head loud banging on the door and gate. I heard two men voices talking about keys and where to search. On then proceeds to open my door. I shouted and I could hear him saying, there’s someone in there.   I was so scared, I called an Uber. I ran straight out, only to realize all the doors and gates were wide open. I didn’t even look back. I requested and reported to air BNB immediately.

Honestly I would not ever come back here I didn’t get to check in untill 3am I kept trying and coming back to try and check in the first door that you go through the guy marlon says I have to use the last 4 digits of my phone number on the keypad to get in which is a lie the door was hold by a paint can  (which anyone that know where this place is can get in easy)  the key pad did not work it was dead . Once I got through the 1st door I could not even get through the 2nd door because it was locked I kept calling and emailing him to let him no and still no response I’m looking all around this place to see if it was a hidden key somewhere I’m upstairs banging on the doors still calling and emailing for about a good 20 mins possibly more then I’m banging on the 2nd door a girl answers to let me I n the second door  (the guy still has not responded) I get to the room it’s a whole diff room from the pictures the girl that was there was in the room that was red which is supposed to be my room so I just staying in the other room because clearly he booked 2 people in the same room .   So the girl tells me she put the paint can behind the door because she was scared there was no type of security on the door and the keypad did not work and she locked the 2nd door which is why I could not get in the 2nd door and didn’t check in untill 3am. AGAIN AFTER 11am check out I STILL WAS NOT CONTACTED FROM THIS GUY TO Apologize it was a waste of money . That I can’t get back
Great communication. Made my trip to see my family less stressful. Would definitely recommend.
Nice, clean place. Area is sketchy, but with cameras and locks I felt safe

Location: Was ok for us. It takes about 20 minutes to walk to the next metro, which didn't bother us. Buses leave just a few minutes' walk away.  Communication with the host: Everything worked out. A nice person. We were also allowed to check out later than 12 p.m.  Cleanliness: The most important point for us. Unfortunately not good. Even though the advert said smoking was forbidden, it smelled strongly of smoke. Not in our room itself. But every trip to the toilet/bathroom and outside was unpleasant. We had the feeling that the other two roommates (obviously term stays?) were smoking.  But it didn't just smell like smoke. There was another musty smell mixed in with the whole thing... Unfortunately, the overall cleanliness wasn't good either. There was a toilet paper roll and old socks under the bed. The socks weren't ours!  I still had to wipe away dust in a few places.  Facilities: The house and its amenities were generally rather old and run down. Only a few things (e.g. the sink in the bathroom) seemed newer. There was a kitchen, but without equipment. No dishes, plates, pans etc. Just a microwave and a kettle. The advertisement said: a kitchen with appropriate equipment.  Overall, we unfortunately cannot recommend the apartment. Unfortunately, the negative greatly outweighs the positive.

The apartment is nicely decorated and clean. The host is very responsive to any questions and he shows a pride in ownership of his home.  This apartment is centrally located to everything you need (restaurants, grocery store, drug store, bakery/coffee) and a great location for a walk along the river. In addition, there is ample parking for those with a care and near metro as well. I could not be happier staying at this home.

If you are thinking about splurging a bit on this place I’d really recommend it just for the balcony view! It was also very clean, quiet, and in a great neighborhood - staples like coffee and a drug store right around the corner, and easy access to BK and Manhattan. Narul welcomed us and was attentive and communicative.

Incorrect address: host knowingly lists an incorrect address for a unit next door when featuring this listing. AirBnb has been notified.  Noise: the apartments is located in a building with other units. It was unfortunately party central during our stay. Loud music continued until early morning.  Lack of furniture: not enough sitting down furniture and there was no rug or additional chair to sit on in the living room (contrary to the staged pic). There is 1 couch on each floor that can at max fit 4ppl. Apartment felt sparse. Two of the bedrooms only had beds and no other furniture - no side table, reading lamp, wall decorations or even a rug. Two bathroom lacked toilet paper holders (unsanitary) and towel bars or hooks.  Location: the neighborhood is extremely dirty and run down. You won’t be able to walk even a couple of steps down the street without garbage. Very noisy during the day as well with music, etc. Buildings in the neighborhood are covered in graffiti and appear neglected.   Parking: could barely get our compact car into the driveway to park. Street parking is tough to find and generally we felt unsafe leaving the car on the street overnight l. Locals often double parked on the street and blocked you in.  Host: slow to respond and attempted to ghost us when we complained.
Very nice and clean. The area is busy and seems sketchy at night but overall a nice place

paid for 3 night and ask for refund but refuse. just to  let you know , you need to walk to another store to get the key. neighborhood not good. its on the 3rd floor with no elevator. worst is common toilet. and common kitchen. i found it a scam

The apartment is located 15 minutes from JKF and an hour's drive from Manhattan.  The apartments are located in the Indian quarter, the area is quite dirty and unsafe (especially in the evening hours). Apartments have bedroom and shared kitchen and bathroom. Dishes and utensils were missing in the kitchen.  Overall cleanliness was low.

The app has a login system that hardly ever worked, so had to enter a long PIN code every time for all doors. Upon first entry, we already noticed how muggy the apartment smelled. Throughout the stay, it was so damp in the apartment that our towels hardly dried and when turning on the A/C (to cool) it started to produce mist. We had to keep the windows open for ventilation (the ventilation was broken) which let a lot of noise in from the trains that would otherwise be ok. We complained a few times, they told us someone would come to check it out but never came. Their communication is prompt and a request for towels was serviced quickly. Also, the cupboard was crooked and tilted forward. They came to put some extra glue behind but it was still scary. The shower curtain constantly fell. The location is great, so close to the trains and Manhattan.

We really enjoyed the stay! The view was really great, the place was clean and well equipped with and it was super easy to communicate with the staff. Will definitely stay again if i'm in New York. The only feedback I wanted to give was the shower curtain falling on us multiple times and in fact scaring us both with a loud sound. I did inform the staff at the location about it and they tried to fix the issue, however they couldn't find a replacement shower curtain in time i think. That said, they were helpful and quick to look into the issue. Overall a positive experience and I will stay here again if given the option

Honestly one of the more quieter spots in Queens. Yes, the trains at Broadway Station are visible and close to the house, but its very muffled and the neighborhood is very quiet as well. The place was clean and well-kept, had everything we needed in the kitchen, and had great AC too which was nice to come back to after walking and taking the subway everywhere in 90 degree weather.  Area wise, theres drug stores, bars, restaurants, the subway, and more within walking distance. Would 100% recommend this place!

Great localization, 10 minutes walk from the metro station, which heads straight to Manhattan. We spent 8 days there and never feel uncomfortable or scared in the neighbourhood during late come backs home. No problem with check-in even in late hours as the keys are left in the locker.  And there was an iron in the room, for me the great advantage! We can honestly recommend it for staying in NY :)

It was a short stay but we enjoyed the apartment and arthur's company! It's close to the metro station and it did feel a little sketchy but nothing happened while we were there. Arthur was very calm and the apartment was clean. We have stayed with hosts before in airbnb apartments and were uncomfortable, but we felt welcomed here!
Enjoy your stay. Easy to find location served by 3 metros between 10 and 15 minutes away. No feeling of insecurity in the area.

We loved our stay here, the room was nice, clean and had exactly what we needed! It was in a great location and only a 10 min walk from Halsey st station (L Train). We stayed for 5 nights and had a blast, would definitely come back again! Plus you get to hang out with Arthur, whose adorable and so sweet. Just watch out, he’s a little sock thief!

Flat was in neat and tidy condition with all amenities for a pleasent stay (very well equiped kitchen and bathroom). Located in Court Square right across the street from Line 7, 2min straight walking distance to line G and other 2min to lines M and E (useful for JFK AirTrain connection). A Trader Joe's is right around the corner. The area is OK and in 10 nights there we only felt a bit unsafe only once due to a sketchy trio that was leaving the subway but nothing happened. In any case, there's a Diner open 24h and the building has a clerk in the lobby for 24h/7. As for the noise, I used earplugs on the first 2 nights but I got used to it and didn't bother me at all afterwards.

really great hosts! we got the needed information and instructions before we arrived which made our check in really easy. The room/apartment and especially the bathroom was really nicely renovated and also super clean. The only kind of annoying thing was that the extra bed (we were 2 people) which had to be pulled out, kept rolling around/couldn’t be stabilized and the main bed was pretty squeaky. Another thing that I have to mention is that the neighborhood seemed a little sketchy/unsafe at times BUT that‘s not the host‘s fault at all!!! It’s just not the best part of Brooklyn. But all in all we had a really pleasant and easy stay and would stay there again!

Dear All,  If you try to find a good stay in NYC where you don’t pay too much money and you are willing to travel - go to Anny and Cesar! The apartment is even better than on the pictures. We had a tiny room but totally okay. The bathroom was shared and no more that clean after a few days (I guess that was our bad luck with the neighbors in the flat). There is not much to do what we have experienced in the area where the Airbnb is, you always need to do longer travels which is still ok in NYC, there is a good direct tube connection. The only thing is that we as two girls have felt a bit unsafe once it got dark to use the bus or the train in the area - we used an Uber instead (which is also fine, for a night out Uber you pay like 50 USD to travel back safe). Abby and Cesar are really friendly, are good in replying and always helpful.

Great value, relatively easy commute into Manhattan/ around Brooklyn. The two call outs would be:  1. This room is right next to the bathroom shared with 2 other guests. During my stay, the other guests have showered at 2 am or 7 am and you will likely hear some noise.  2. I do feel a little unsafe at night walking back from metro station by myself as a woman.

Everything was perfect about my stay! The building itself is located in a really good place, and it made it really easy for me to travel between Queens and Manhattan. I was a bit afraid about the train noises, because there are few comments about that, but I'm a light sleeper and I didn't have any issues sleeping peacefully at night, because the windows are soundproof and you don't hear any noise once you get used to it. The room was really bright, clean and spacious and the view was also great, so I enjoyed staying in when the weather was too bad to go outside. I'm hoping to visit NYC again, and I'll definitely stay at Sonder!
Really clean, great location! We were right on the bus route which took us exactly where we needed to be easily. The off street parking made our stay stress free.

We really enjoyed the house, everyone could have their own bedroom and bathroom. Very clean, bed linen and bathroom towels clean and provided. The roof terrace is the icing on the cake.  Points for improvement: The advertised kettle did not work and the advertised hair dryer was not provided.  The house offers a great oven but no dish that can go in the oven, it would be good to think about that.  The location of the house is in a very poor and noisy neighborhood of Harlem. So not the best place in Harlem. But no feeling of insecurity. The people in the neighborhood were very nice.  I recommend this house and I will return there if I have the opportunity to come back to NY.  Ben is a great host, easy to contact if needed.

I spent a total of 7 weeks in this great accommodation in the heart of Chelsea and can only recommend it!   The location is ideal: relatively quiet especially in the bedroom, close to many subway stations, very safe and with few sketchy people, vis a vis of a mini market that is open around the clock and so central that much can be done by foot.  The apartment is larger than it appears in the photos, has everything you need (including a large sofa, a TV, a spacious closet, two balconies with morning and evening sun respectively), a well-equipped kitchen and is located on the 5th floor so you even have some view.  Also, the wifi has always worked quickly and reliably - which was convenient for me during video conferences.  Noomi was a great landlord, always contacted me quickly and answered my questions informatively and friendly.   I highly recommend this apartment and hope to stay here again in the future :) Thanks for a great time NYC!

We had a family of 6 people (+1 toddler) in our party so it was a fairly large party. But the property accommodated us enough! Very clean and everything was working. They had stock of all the essentials in the bathrooms. I had forgotten my hairdryer and was happy to see that there was one in the bathroom. We were also attending a formal event and so was pleased with the iron/ironing board as well. The host was very communicative every step of the way and we appreciated that since it was our first time in New York.  The only things were that the wifi wasn’t reliable. It would disconnect us every now and then and it was just faster to use data. The property was also fairly far from the subway station (13 min walk), so coming home at night alone would have been a bit scary. Luckily I had a party of people so it was less so.  But otherwise we enjoyed our stay and definitely would still not mind booking the place again.

Had electricity outage, couldn’t sleep in the night and room is very small than I expected, good only for sleeping.  Communication is good, neighborhood is little bit shady, there is police station nearby. I had below average experience in Airbnb

Saw somebody get attacked my first night outside the apartment. It has nothing to do with the apartment so it still gets a good rating from me but it's a rough neighborhood. The room is as small as a closet but the host is attentive, hot shower, reliable wi-fi, and clean. Overall nice stay.

It looks like a scam, i have stayed a week didn’t find any amenities. The place is noisy due to nearby police station. The the windows are not good enough for winter.  They changed the front door pass without any notice and had to wait 20min during my stay.  They charged insanely unlawfully. They didn’t clean the room during our stay at the place.

The house was sufficient in providing a safe place to sleep. However, the pictures are quite misleading, as the place is much smaller than it gets depicted on the photos. The place has 1 real bed, there is a matress on the ceiling, but we didn't sleep there as we were afraid to fall, perhaps this is a personal thing.  This place is not ideal for three or more people. Bathroom had some hairs in it and showering essentials were not complete, neither were there enough spoons in the kitchen. It is a 2-3 minute walk from the subway station which is nice, at the same time the distant noise might be annoying to some. Also the neighborhood feels quite unsafe, it's not recommended to walk outside alone at night, definitely not as a woman or children.

This stay was an absolute gem and we felt such a steal for the cost. Check-in was easy, it was so clean and smelt lovely when we arrived, and it was beautifully decorated and so cozy. It was just a hop and skip away from the subway too, which was so great. Oh! And much more spacious than the photos even make it seem, which is amazing for NY!  Donna and Ethan were fabulous and responsive hosts.  When we come back to NY, we will definitely want to book here again! Couldn’t recommend enough.

Marlon is a great host, very kind, responsive and communicative. The room itself however is very average.  It’s located in the basement with no windows or AC which make it quite an unpleasant place to stay, and the bed in the room, even though it looks very impressive, is very uncomfortable. The neighborhood is also quite unwelcoming.

The photos do not match reality. very deteriorated the bathroom in very bad condition dirty and there is no hot water the kitchen deteriorated and the floor is in very bad condition it is broken it is dangerous to walk through it the cost benefit is not worth it she responds quickly

Everything very good. The accommodation was exactly the same as the photos, no more and no less. Good communication all the time, the host is quite concerned and pleasant.  It is definitely a nice and quiet place to rest. The exterior is a bit noisy from other apartments. There is a police station downstairs so it gives a feeling of security and protection. The only bad thing was a pipe that is inside the room, which started to make an exaggerated noise and release boiling water, which caused a lot of fear and due to the time (it was early morning) we had to improvise to calm this incident. Generally good. Recommended

This place is a shared accommodation with rooms for 3 other people. We had one room which was spacious and clean, however the bathroom was dirty from the use of other guests. On our second night one of the guests had a friend over and they were very loud which made it pretty inconvenient. The locality seems unsafe. Subway is a block away which was the only decent thing. The building is pretty worn out and old.  Although the host is very communicative, it was an average stay.

This was my first time using airbnb and I don't regret choosing this place.  -Good- 1. Cleanliness: As soon as I arrived, they were still in the progress of cleaning. Everything was in place and perfectly sanitized even the floors we step in. 2. Location: The train station that connects to the major subway platforms was within walking distance (5 min). 3. Communication: The host was very quick in replying to the message and was willing to help at all times. 4. Safety: I most came back to the airbnb after midnight and nothing seemed suspicious. There is a police station right next to the building.  -Bad- 1. Internet connections: I stayed here for four days but wifi wasn't working at the moment. I asked for the solution but it wasn't helpful.  It was just the wifi that I felt was not cool but overall, everything was great and I would like to choose this place again if I visit New York. If you have to move a lot and need a place for safety, this may be the choice you should make.

Being in NY, you want to see many different things and a hotel or an apartment is just for you to rest at the end of the day. That is why me and my girfriend found this small, cousy room accurate. It was clean, communication was excellent, and other people were nice and quiet. The only disadvantage was the location, because it seemed to be shady area so we were afraid to go at night. All in all, it’s a  good place.

Gerencie was responsive and maintained adequate communication throughout the stay. However, there were several inconveniences that made the experience unpleasant. These included, check-in date confusion on her part which resulted in having to spend a night at the airport, heaters not functioning properly during extreme cold temperatures, and power going out on the last day of my booking. All which were never really resolved in a timely manner or simply ignored. Definitely major improvements can be made to provide a better quality experience. Very unsatisfied overall, would not recommend.

This apartment 'Rogers Palace 1'  is extremely spacious with wood floors, nice kitchen with new appliances and three large bedrooms.  Everything was very clean and exactly as pictured in the photographs.  The kitchen had enough equipment to make simple meals, a dishwasher and a full size refrigerator. There were more than enough bath towels, the bed was very comfortable and the bathroom was spotless.  Garcia was great replying to our messages very quickly, and when the lockbox code didn't work he sent the new one within a few minutes.  What a shame that this apartment is in a rather run down dirty neighborhood; stores are shuttered with graffiti covered roll-up doors, bars are on many windows and paper rubbish is trodden into the sidewalks.  On our last night, a Thursday, the shuttered store directly underneath the apartment opened up to reveal a shining white interior which was transformed into a nightclub! The loud, floor-shaking music started at 4pm when they were setting up, was still going when we returned later - deafening music, disco lights, drinking, etc,  and continued until after midnight. Even after the music stopped the party continued outside in the street for at least another hour.  A neighbor told us that these nightclub events happen 'now and then' so you can take your chance if you wish! Although 'Rogers Palace' itself is a lovely 5 star apartment, I'm afraid that I can't recommend it because of the seedy noisy location.  We would not stay there again.

Perfect self checkin experience, clean and very spacious!   This has nothing to do with the actual Airbnb but while the place is close to the metro, I’d warn woman/femmes traveling alone from walking around at night. I was followed home when heading back late at night which was pretty scary. I would advise calling a ride straight to the door if it’s late.

I have never written a “bad0 review but wanted to preface this for fellow travelers that this is the kind of Airbnb I hate: the hosts don’t live near or on the property, (which is located in a gentrifying neighborhood), cheap furnishings in a home with no redeeming qualities or even tips or suggestions or even a host welcome note or guide… this Airbnb exists simply to host people for cheap.   Pro’s: great value in Brooklyn, very spacious (big enough for family of 3 with infant). Host was initially responsive but when we needed to change dates/shorten trip, suddenly was MIA.   Con’s: as an Asian female, I didn’t quite feel safe walking around the neighborhood mostly because there were a lot of homeless men around, home was dirty upon arrival (white dust coated the floor, dirty towels with brown stains, food particles in the kitchen sink, hair in the bathroom/toilet), the home was missing basic amenities like hand soap and a hand towel (had to borrow kitchen towel for bathroom and we Instacarted hand soap ourselves that night), no coffee maker or even a bottle opener. We asked host for soap and new towels which were delivered the following morning (towels were still stained).
Love the place and the subway convince. You are in little Jamaica. Not unsafe but it takes navigating. Leo was thorough and awesome with check in and communication.

Pedro and Mina are great hosts, and this apartment was just what we needed to stay in the city and have a great location for Parents Weekend at our student's school.  The unit is right on the park - we got two beautiful walks in!  And... right near the trains.  So though I might have liked to be closer to our student in theory, we really were as soon as we stepped on a train. The trains being right there and that they were the lines we needed was perfect.    It's true it's an interior unit as we read in advance, but it's quite cozy.  Also, the images are accurate.    You can't beat this location, and the hosts were available if we needed to ask about anything.  Very responsive.   The gym looked nice, but...  we just didn't have time to go.  I chose to be outside or with our student instead, and I'll plan to use the gym next time?  There were plenty of towels, which I appreciated as we kind of most often feel shorted on towels.  The TV is GIANT.  I wish we'd have had time for a movie!  The unit has some minor repair needs, but who really cares (and they're in the reviews, so we did have a way to know).  My home needs some repairs as well...  I see a difference between a corporate hotel room where you won't get many of these amenities and space, and someone's apartment.  (I don't get upset with my friends over a towel bar, for example... I'll admit the dishwasher door noise scared me, but just because I don't want to break anything.)     This worked out perfectly for us.  And the hosts are nice people.  I'd stay here again.

This apartment is wonderful and so wonderfully appointed! We enjoyed the park and the proximity to the Ferry landing for a ride to Manhattan. We also used the subway to get to Manhattan. All very easy. The neighborhood is lovely and very comfortable to walk in. All the apartment amenities were fantastic: great kitchen, comfy living area to relax in, and everything neat and clean.  The guide to the neighborhood and transportation the hosts provided was excellent! We felt very much at home and welcomed. Communication with our hosts was easy and stress free! A wonderful place!

Manhattan apartments, even when they cost an arm and a leg (from a non-Manhattan point of view), are always unpleasant, strange, poorly kept, dark, smelly, noisy, and sometimes even unhealthy.   To be able to afford those that look at least normal I would no doubt have to sell myself in serfdom, and I find no metaphor to describe those that look beautiful: totally, utterly, completely out of my reach for ever and ever.  After much disappointing Manhattan experience in AirBnB (and rentals) I could afford, this property gave me the absolute pleasure of a nice apartment, that looks cute and feels like home, that is silent and calm, that has integrated AC (instead of those cubes dangerously installed over window sills) as well as heating (instead of, I imagine, the frightening BANG BANG of central heaters from the 1920s pumping high-pressure steams in ancient pipes and radiators), and, unique feature in Manhattan, that has a washer and a dryer inside the apartment itself!   This is an absolute shocker of an apartment for Manhattan standards, a gem, a pearl, a joy. It's not a large apartment, but there's a place for everything.   It's on the 4th floor (with a walk-up, no lifts), but -- that could be news to Europeans -- 4th floors are reached in the US by walking up just three, not four, flights of stairs, as US people start counting floors from one instead of zero.  The bed is installed in the bedroom via an ingenious niche. I dread to think what happens should the bed frame break, but I guess bed frames might last longer than the typical rental contract.

This is, without a doubt, the absolute BEST Airbnb experience I’ve ever had. The host does an INCREDIBLE job at providing everything you could possibly need, while also creating the most inclusive and warm environment to stay in. Stylish, quiet, clean, spacious, lots of privacy, you will feel so welcome & comfortable you may never want to leave :) Yes. Seriously the nicest, and most genuine host ever. I had such an amazing stay. Definitely will come back. For real.  This place is great if you're looking for a home base where you can also relax. The host is also probably the nicest host I've ever had, and he's also full of interesting conversation and info about the city, and super wonderful to hang out with.   If you're looking for a place with personality this is definitely it; it's a home as opposed to a cookie-cutter Airbnb, I made wonderful friends through my stay here.   Price for what you get is amazing, and seriously such a steal. The bedroom is spacious and has anything you might need (closet space, morning light, full-length mirrors), access to the kitchen, bathroom, of amenities. What I cannot stress enough is how incredibly clean and organized everything is in this apartment - seriously, just top-notch cleanliness standards so you don’t have to worry about this at all!!!!!   The neighborhood is well connected, safe, and full of identity, and you’ll have a blast being in the East Village & central to everything and all the nightlife.   I would stay there again in a heartbeat, and you should too - I seriously could not recommend this Airbnb more highly!

Nathan was extremely hospitable. The flat is relatively clean and warm during the winter. I'm glad to use the kitchen for light cooking. However, the tub was grimy, I advise use cleaning supplies in sink cabnet before use. Microwave needs to be wiped. If guest have to pre-clean the bathroom, there shouldn't be a cleaning fee. Walls are very thin, you can hear neighbors and their dogs / the rest of the apartment.  I advise, don't leave any items in fridge, my Welchs drink was stolen by another bnb user that had a guest over and I can hear them do "the nasty" the morning of check out. I will let the host know so that guy can be banned. He violated terms, if I can't, you can't. That's unacceptable, get a hotel room.  Overall, I definitely recommend booking this flat. I just had to leave an honest review for reference. If this isn't for you, try expedia.

Great place to stay while visiting New York. So close to a beautiful park and easy to get the ferry to and from the city. The apartment itself was welcoming and cosy. Veronica and Matt were so quick to help if I had any questions, great with advice for getting about and very friendly. Definitely made our stay stress free. Thanks again guys! 😊

Everything felt very homey and the host was very attentive and kind. You will most definitely feel safe inside the apartment. The 2 train to get into Manhattan is about 2 blocks away. You are given a key to your room to lock up. The area is a little unsafe, but it’s worth it in my opinion. The host will contact you if you need anything. You can make your own breakfast in the morning if you desire. There’s a microwave, mini fridge, and tv with Netflix, Hulu, etc. The wifi is a bit splotchy but it did the job. The bathroom is clean for the most part and you have to make sure you clean after yourself by wiping down the seat and also rinsing the shower after you use it. There is body wash, shampoo etc if you need it. They provide you with sandals and a towel and wash towel. The bed is comfy they also provide you with silk pillow cases. This was a great stay, you won’t regret staying here!! It genuinely felt relaxing and peaceful.

Ben’s place is a great place to stay. It is clean, new and very well maintained. The area around the subway is a bit scary to walk at during the night but otherwise the place itself  is awesome! Thank you Ben

This place was incredible.  Can't beat the location if you're looking to experience Harlem. I was attending classes at Columbia and the walk to campus was stress free and nothing laborious.  Confidence was an amazing host(ess) she communicated in a timely fashion whenever I had questions.  The place was impeccable. Everything is modern and the entire feel is well thought out and put together.  I will definitely seek this place out again if/when I return.

Bens Place was clean and open. It’s a little far from the subway to walk to & from at night if you’re a tourist or a female(s). And not best area safety wise. He does ask to leave the key in the lock box outside the door so that’s it’s not lost - my roommate and I didn’t do this as it made us feel uncomfortable/unsafe. There is another Airbnb next to you/above you that he also rents out which isn’t a big deal but you can definitely hear people. The back patio is definitely a very cool feature that you won’t get with a lot of Airbnb and definitely not hotels.
Don’t book this! Profit pics lied. Empty building with homeless people sleeping around. Are Not safe for single female. Host don’t reply your message and not allow cancellation.

The positives:  Javier is a super nice guy, and an attentive host. He met me personally for the check-in, and made sure I had keys and everything I needed. Anytime I needed to communicate with him though the Airbnb app, he responded quickly.  Security - I never felt unsafe. The outer door to the apartment has a solid deadbolt, and my room itself has its own door lock, and I had a key to each one. And the building itself has a "modern" feel (it's not ancient anyway). So I never worried about safety for myself or my things.  Common area - there is basically a large common area with a sofa, a TV, a table and chairs, and a kitchen. This area seems fine, maybe because it doesn't get much use (I never saw the guests from the other rooms at all during my 2-night stay).   The negatives:  The overall disappointment for this place is the lack of cleanliness. Specifically, the bathroom. There is one bathroom with a sink, a toilet and a shower. This bathroom is shared among the occupants of the 3 rooms in the unit.   The problems were:  - Mold. You can smell the mold whenever you walk into the bathroom.  - There is mold around the ceiling of the shower and in the corners. There is a shower "pole shelf" in the corner for personal items, and there are a LOT of used bottles of shampoo, conditioner, body wash, etc. Even razors, body washing "scrubbies", things that you would not want to share with other people. It's clear that this shower gets a lot of use, so I'm assuming the occupants of the other 2 rooms are long-term guests and they just leave all of their stuff in the shower for when they need it. One of them even leaves their toothbrush on the sink - not in a container or holder or anything, just out in the open. I couldn't imagine having my toothbrush open on the bathroom sink while other people (strangers) are splashing around in that sink. But it's clear that the shower has not been cleaned in a long time (particularly the corner behind where all the personal items are sitting, which is where the most mold is).  - The toilet leaks from the base. So there were constant puddles of water at various locations around the bathroom floor. When I got up during the night to use the bathroom, I had to have all the lights on in order to be careful where not to step because I didn't want to track the leaked toilet water back to my room. The wooden foot of the sink cabinet is rotted away, apparently because of the constant exposure to the leaked toilet water.   I was only in NYC for the weekend, and I was traveling alone. My business was in Manhattan, but I was really looking to save some money by staying in Queens and Ubering in for the day. And it's true, this place was less expensive. But I can say that if my wife had been with me, she would have taken one look at the bathroom and we would have immediately booked a different place (or a hotel) regardless of the cost difference.    I chose this place mainly because of several positive reviews. If the bathroom was in the same condition for previous guests, I would have wanted to know about it. I hate to write negative things (I have stayed at lots of other Airbnb places, with almost all being positive experiences - you can read my other Airbnb reviews) but I have not had an experience with a lack of cleanliness like this one.

Fazia and her husband did a great job making us feel right at home. Even though our stay was short, they made sure we never had to worry about anything over those 4 days. The room was cozy with a smart TV, kitchen was never short of supplies, and the bathrooms were clean all throughout. The neighborhood was quite and the place itself was a 12 min walk away from the main subway station taking you to downtown. The subway exits right outside the NYPD station, so even during late hours, it never felt unsafe to walk that short distance.  Highly recommend this place with a very reasonable price and friendly hosts.

Good area, great place to stay, roomy, comfortable, very affordable. If you plan on driving/taking your car make sure to look for parking nearby because almost all the street parking has very strict time regulations. Besides that this place is an absolute steal when it comes to airbnb and we had a wonderful time.

Pros - upon arrival, I was kindly greeted by Rachel who was so kind and gave me a rundown on all things I’d need to know in regards to the apartment. The checkin process was great, the apartment and my rooms furniture were in prestige condition. Daniela also answered within a few hours every time I reached out which was appreciated!   Cons - If you’re not from NY, keep in mind this area is a little scary when you 1st arrive. It definitely takes some time getting used to, but as long as you keep an eye out at your surroundings and especially in the evenings as a female, you should be fine. FYI, it’s across the street from Sumner Houses. Unfortunately, the apartment had a small but persistent cockroach issue in the kitchen. We were careful not to leave food laying around, and although we communicated the issue having been present since day1 to our host, the traps that were laid out the 1st two times were not nearly strong enough to combat the issue. Only after a few weeks, and another tenant complaining, did an extermination take place. The cockroaches were still present despite this. I appreciate the host helping to try to fix the issue, but it was only after several outreaches. Also for the price I was paying per month, I think this shouldn’t have even be an issue to begin with. The host did allow me to cut my stay short to make up for this.  Overall was the place ok? Yes it was comfortable, but had a a few setbacks. If you’re ok with seeing a bug or two, then the place is not bad

Positive point - Located close to 2 metro stations - Located right next to a police station, so we feel safe - Rather well-equipped kitchen (missing such as a cutting board and colander) - It's great to have the washing machine and dryer! 🤩 - Comfortable bed Negative point - No hot water. Over 6 days we mainly had cold or lukewarm water... the same in the other bathroom in the apartment which one of the other travelers told me about - The door is not easy to open - The person who manages the apartment tries to tax you for everything, I found that unpleasant... even in hotels I have never seen that and I have been traveling for 6 months! We received messages like "when you leave if you don't leave me a photo of where you left the keys you will be charged $100, if you forget something and want us to send it to you it's $50...".

Very good stay. We were apprehensive because of many negative comments about the safety of the neighborhood but we did not feel any danger/risk. In addition, the proximity to the metros is really ideal. Good communication, very responsive when we had a lighting problem. The accommodation has all the necessary equipment, both kitchen and shower room.

She is a horrible host because she treats her guests unfairly and inhumanely. Even though I had a reservation for 8 days, I ended up staying here for only 3. Both the on and off settings of the heater produce uncomfortable temperatures in the room. After only 2 days there, my health began to rapidly decline. I had to return home early. I had to cancel my return flight since I accidentally booked the wrong flight. There was an 8-day reservation, so I texted the host to see if I could still stay the remaining days. The host would not let me in without the extra $75, though. I had to spend the night at the airport, so I got a ticket on the first flight back. She has been behaving in a heartless and unfair way. This establishment is situated in Harlem, one of New York City's 10 most dangerous areas. The room is too small to comfortably accommodate two persons. Images are often produced to provide the illusion of more space than actually exists.

Second time staying at Anna’s place and it was wonderful! She even added an ice tray to the freezer, she’s very attentive to detail. The beds are so comfortable. You have everything you need, don’t be afraid to book this place.

Renter beware. This place is a total dump and also unsafe. First thing we noticed upon arrival was that the basement unit absolutely reeked of sewage. This is because the drainage for all of the plumbing for the building is in the basement behind a closet door. When I informed the host of the smell, he said he would have someone "take care of it". When my friends and I returned to the unit later that evening, there was a single small air freshener in the corner. Worse than the smell, however, was the noise. The basement is below the main hallway for the home. Any time someone walked through the hallways upstairs, it woke up everyone in our unit. This happened multiple times every night. Safety was also a huge concern -- the door to our basement unit had no deadbolt. The first night we were there, someone opened our keypad door knob, took two steps into our unit, and turned around and left. The pictures are also quite misleading -- there is no shower in the basement unit, only two shared showers on the ground and second floors. Our bathroom also had no toilet paper, and there was nowhere to get a refill of it. The beds were covered in dust when we arrived, and the bedsheets were stained. The basement apartment is very clearly an illegal conversion,  very poorly done and dirty. Overall by far my worst airbnb experience and I strongly recommend against renting from this host.

The place was nice and homey. There are a couple steep flight of stairs to go up to get to the apartment, we were able to get our luggage up. But might be harder for an older person to get up and down the stairs.   I didn’t feel fully comfortable/safe in the place after a few days. Largely due to the window to the patio couldn’t be locked. It seemed other apartments could also access the patio. This could be a bit stressful for a lone traveller as it could be easy for someone to open it from the outside. I think we used a chopstick at night to “lock” the window.   The area itself felt a bit unsafe because it wasn’t very well lit at night. But it is 7-10min walk from the nearest subway stations. We would walk 10mins to Williamsburg to get dinner and breakfast, which was great.

Great location and cozy space. Had everything my husband and I needed. It is an older building and the floor in the bedroom is slanted but it wasn’t a big deal for us. The bedroom furniture was rearranged when we arrived so we didn’t have the issue of rolling into the person sleeping next to you like another reviewer said. The building was sketchy at first but we felt safe and even walked at night.

Upon arrival, we got the keys out of the lockbox - a keyring with 6 unlabeled keys. We had to guess the correct key in the dark in a sketchy-feeling neighborhood to unlock the front door (which there was no instructions for) as well as find the key for the apartment (also no guidance.) However, we didn’t even need that key because both the front and back doors to the apt were unlocked, as well as every window.  We didn’t party, but received a complaint from night one for “walking around” and “dropping things” after midnight (when we arrived). Meanwhile, we could hear the upstairs neighbors loudly moving around at 7am each day and the side neighbors using the bathroom (separated by us by only a door) and playing their music at night.  The beds had only duvets and fitted sheets - no flat sheets. The AC/heat didn’t respond - no matter how we changed it, the apartment stayed a stuffy 72.  When asked about all of this, the host sent short replies without any helpful information.

Absolutely no privacy I felt watched and stalked there's no parking u will be hounded if u park in the parking space entire block takes up all the parking. The host is literally above ur head watching every thing I cooked and he accuse me of smoking because the detector went off I assured him it was me cooking I washed the dishes clean the place and wash the linen left the place nice and clean...he tried to scam me and. Say his towels and linen was stolen and it was smoking so he ask for a $826 reimbursement which is impossible I was so discussed then he canceled that and ask for $400 his place was left very clean all rules were followed be extremely careful he's money hungry and you will definitely be stalked with no where to park the place was cool but the host definitely made the experience a nightmare I never had 1 bad experience with airbnb til now

If I'm being honest, I was disappointed but maybe I'm just not used to the lower quality NYC Airbnbs. There was constantly second hand smoke coming into my room every day. The kitchen doesn't have any windows so the air felt thick and there was always this bad smell when you entered the apartment since there was no air ventilation. The kitchen sink was also always clogged. No living room. You're not provided anything except bed sheets but I used my own since the bed sheets smelled bad. You're given 4 keys but you can't lock your own door. I had to ask Momoyo to change the door knob so that I can lock my room. Only the closet can be locked. The bathroom was super tiny. Not the cleanest place. There was this mysterious orange stain all over the bathroom and in the closet. There was also this huge bug that scared the life out of me. Not sure if it was a cockroach but it moved very fast/ had a lot of legs and went back under the wood at the window. I moved out earlier because I didn't feel comfortable there. I honestly didn't really feel cared for like I usually do at my other Airbnb stays.

The room only consists of a bed and a built-in wardrobe. To get to one side of the bed you had to squeeze between the wall and the bed. The room is directly opposite a school that was already playing music early in the morning. The building is designed like a student dormitory. Unfortunately the room was far too small for 2 people. The windows had little to no insulation and you could hear every conversation at normal volume. The garbage cans are right in front of the windows and through the tons of garbage you could hear the rats jumping around at night. Very unpleasant.  One bathroom for 5 rooms wasn't the best as the hygiene left a lot to be desired for some. The drain was often blocked.  The communication with Mia was great, she answered or completed all the colors and requests. That was great.  We were also able to leave our luggage in the apartment until departure. The apartment is a 5-10 minute walk away. There are also some good restaurants in the immediate vicinity.  Check-in was super easy.

I had a great stay at Courtney’s place visiting my kids and new grandson nearby. The apt was very comfortable, clean and had everything I needed for a five day stay. Courtney is very warm, kind and very easy and available to communicate with. She truly saved the day for me with a somewhat stressful parking situation! I really appreciated her very quick responsiveness and generosity!  I highly recommend Courtney’s apt. I would love to stay there again.

I truly hated this place. I think this whole building needs to get torn down. Do not rent anything here!!! 534 w 50th. Rats in the walls, roaches popping out of nowhere and jumping on you from a bath tub, horrible air conditioning, rooms without enough light in most of them, cheapest furniture that falls apart as you try to use it. No proper working wifi, piles and piles of garbage that is being taken out of the basement, reconstruction works without any warning and with a lot of noise, people throwing out their garbage right out of the windows. The whole building is owned by the same person, all apartments are for rent in Airbnb. And it a a proper scam. If you’re searching for a horror movie experience - that’s the place! If I had time and energy, I would literally file a compliant for Airbnb that this place is unlivable! Especially for so much money - it’s pathetic! And they lost two of my parcels. By saying lost I mean that they simply threw it away because they were so pissed that I was persistently asking them to deal with rats! Indeed, how could I dare to ask to get rid of rats in the ceiling? This is so much to ask, right?
Usually Hugo's mother Margarita took care of me. She was really kind. Someone might think this area is a little dangerous but there was nothing to worry about. I'm happy to have stayed there.

Comfortable and well located apartment in Harlem. Close to metro lines 2 and 3, good restaurants and supermarket. We recommend not driving at night with the green metro lines since that area seemed unsafe to us.

Be prepared for a space that is exactly proportionate to what you're paying for it--had a small heart attack with a critter on the floor, and know that you're sharing one bathroom across the entire apartment, but otherwise, private, clean, prepared, cheap, and more. Would go back again if I had to, but otherwise would spend more on a space elsewhere.
the area was a little sketchy but safe - the back does not look like pics (it didnt when we went, unusable) but all in all a very clean place inside and very modern.  plenty of sheets and towels

The home is great, clean and comfortable. Roman was nice and accommodating. However, he did not give me the proper refunds. The first time I booked the place it was $524 for two nights, then we decided to stay one more night and I gave him a month an half notice, with a additional charge of $368. About a week later I told him we cant stay longer so I wanted to keep the original 2 night for only $524. Roman responsed back thats ok. I even gave him the update of my confirmation on the day of checkin and i did told him the amount as well. He only refunded me $220, which is ridiculous, he didnt let me know ahead, his response was it was that he cant control the price of the two night that I originally booked, so it increased to $672, i was so disappointed and was not awared. Wish i was informed ahead. The sad part is he does have control of it, its not that he doesnt. I felt like I got lied to and robbed. So if you do booked this place, be very very careful of booking with his charges, make him sent you the result before confirming. My stay was good but ended with a bad feeling. As for me, will never come back.

This lovely apartment is quite convenient to the subway, a mere few blocks walk. We never felt unsafe in the neighborhood, even walking back late at night.  The rooms are a good size, large kitchen, fully stocked. Comfortable bed, futon in livingroom. The noise from upstairs carries quite well, so if you are a light sleeper earplugs are a must (but that's probably the case in all of NYC, I would imagine). Being winter, we didnt explore the backyard but it looked like it would be wonderful in better weather. All in all, well worth the cost, no complaints, highly recommend.

Hello future travelers!!! Unfortunately,  this is the first time on airbnb that I've rated any less then 5 stars.  Part of it may have been a lack of research on my end, but I wanted to write an honest review to assist travelers in the future. In my group's opinion, this wasn't a safe neighborhood.  Not only are there three doors just to get into the Airbnb (which should have been my first red flag), but there is even a sign in the Airbnb to leave a light on, "for your safety".  Multiple uber/lyft drivers expressed safety concerns for a group of females walking around/staying in this area.  After expressing this concern to the host, I recieved a combative response saying that I was incorrect for feeling this way and that they only had one other safety incident regarding a homeless individual.  I was very confused with the hosts response as I was expressing safety concerns and only asking for a partial refund even though we didn't even spend a full night there out of a three night stay (we had to book another place to stay in a better neighborhood).   To verify my safety concerns were multiple guides from the tours we took while in NYC as well as other locals we talked to during our travels.  The Airbnb itself is okay, but I would not feel comfortable booking this Airbnb in the neighborhood this is located in.

Overall, we had a positive stay at Chris' place in Harlem. The apartment was much bigger than anticipated, the bedroom and living areas were good sizes, the heating was on when we arrived on a chilly day and so it was nice and cosy,  on the whole the wifi was good (apart from a short blip) and it was about 5mins walk to the nearest subway station (125th). We also walked back from Central Park one day, it's about 15min walk from the very top of Central Park.   There were a few negatives which, in days gone by I would have overlooked, but I think they should be looked at by the host. Several of the electricity sockets (particularly in master bedroom) were very loose and I wasn't very comfortable using them. We have a young child who isn't yet crawling/walking and they don't look particularly safe, I'd be very worried about a child being near them. One of the chairs in the bedroom was propped up by books too. The bathroom was as clean as could be, but the tiles around the bath and shower were very much broken and cracked and need to be looked at. Aside from it being a leak/rot problem for the host, it's a little unsightly for a guest. There was also a small ant problem in the bathroom in the second half of our stay.   The kitchen (incl. hob, oven, microwave, fridge) was modern and functioned well. There wasn't a dishwasher and I wouldn't expect one, I like to do the dishes myself, there was washing up liquid but nothing to wash the dishes with (eg. sponge or brush). Plenty of dinner and side plates and cutlery, but bowls were few and what ones there was were mismatched and some were melamine.   Being on the ground floor, I was concerned about security before booking, but Chris reassured beforehand all the layers of security and access to the property, given we had a stroller, baby and suitcases. There was a solid metal gate at street level, then two further lockable doors until the apartment, the windows also came with secure bars - so we felt safe.
