There are only a couple of small steps down from street level and a porch threshold to overcome so in terms of ease of access, pretty straightforward. The porch itself did have quite a strong smell or urine - which seemed to get worse the longer we stayed. I've lived in cities before and I guess it's a hazard of the area, but was a little off putting. The lounge was comfy and cosy with a large sofa and two armchairs, the TV had all the on demand and live channels you could need.  The photos were accurate in terms of what the rooms looked like, but did hide quite how big the apartment was - something of a bonus. The photos don't obviously show some of the smaller details I've commented on in this review.  We walked to/from 125th St Subway each day we were there, around 5mins or so from the apartment. The apartment itself is on a quiet and safe looking street, but the area immediately surrounding the subway station was a bit sketchy - I fully recognise it's like that around stations the world over and we've travelled extensively - but I'm not as young as I used to be and now have a family, it wasn't something I was particularly comfortable with. We only travelled during daylight hours as we had to be back for evening routine with our son. That being said, I wouldn't be comfortable walking around the apartment after dark and would consider getting a taxi. Despite the awesome subway connections and proximity to LaGuardia Airport (where we flew out of), I think in future I'd potentially look to base myself elsewhere.  I only received the check-in instructions on the day itself, despite AirBnB saying I'd receive an email with details one or two days before. Given the length and detail of the check-in instructions, I'd like to have received it earlier as we weren't roaming and were reliant on airport WiFi only.  That being said, the instructions were detailed and we got in without an issue.   NY isn't a cheap city and we specifically wanted a 2 bed apartment as we were travelling with our child, we're fully aware it would limit our options and increase the price we would have to pay - something I'd fully reconciled with. For the size of apartment and price we paid, I would be reasonably happy. Some elements of the apartment were really well thought out, but those loose ends and rough edges did let it down a little and overall, made it feel a little overpriced.

We enjoyed our stay. Chris was very quick to respond to any requests that we made. There are two subway stations close by but at night they are a bit sketchy. We did not have any problems and we found it very convenient to get around. Overall the apartment met our needs as it was a spacious space for four adults.

The stay was everything Chris had described and offered all the amenities we were looking for, including towels, paper towels, dishes, soap, disinfectant wipes, games, tv, comfortable beds and blankets, nice shower and bathroom, kitchen, easy access to the street/outside, protection (gate and two doors that all locked), etc. The location easily accessible to the subway, restaurants, and Starbucks. The only thing that could have made our stay better was better parking options (we got a ticket for parking too close to a fire hydrant), but that is uncontrollable as NYC is very congested. The neighborhood could be a little sketchy, but we felt safe where we stayed, Chris made us feel at home and answered all of our questions.

Treasure was a great host! Very close in proximity which was wonderful when we had questions and concerns about the location and problems in the room. Good location, but a little scary to venture out alone at night in this neighborhood.

I just left the place after a 3 weeks stay and I feel like I just left home. Ana and William were AWESOME! I have moved to NYC for a job and they made the transition so easy. Always there quickly to answer texts or phone calls. The room was great as well big and spacious and all around comfy. Another reason it felt like coming home everyday.  The area is very safe. I came home all all different times and never felt any danger at all.  All the area is surrounded by yummy food places and coffee shops. Very easy to grab a bagel and coffee on your way to the #3 subway train and boom you're in Manhattan.  Again can't over recommend this place. Have fun and be ready to meet the real one in charge Miss Cafe and she welcomes you home everyday.

We recently rented this room for two weeks and I should say it was described as it's shown in the picture. Our bedroom included a big size bed, a bed coach, daily clean towels and a private sink.  The kitchen and the bathroom were shared with the same floor roommate.  Even though the bathroom seem unclean, everytime we asked for to be cleaned, our hosts were quick to do that task. The neighborhood was at first sight insecure, but once we walked around, local people seem polite and inoffensive. Personally, I did not even feel scared when I had to come back home alone at nighttime. There's even free WiFi in the Nostrand Avenue (the main street). Plus, there's a lot of convenience shops and food stores around (our favourite was the Wholefarmer Market Food, the staff and the food are quite good). The place is really well located, we used to get the Nostrand Ave station to go Manhattan and the A or C line go straight away to get there. I'd like to thank Ana and William, especially, for being two great and kind hosts. If you're not able to talk in English, Ana can speak in Spanish too. They tried to please us everything we asked for, that's the reason we were very comfortable. I strongly recommend their place.

We stayed for three months at Williams and Ana's place.  First of all, we had important sanitary issues, especially in the kitchen where we found numerous cockroaches and rodents. The owner’s dog also used to go poop in the bathroom and despite our numerous attempts to inform the landlord about the situation, the cleaning was always incomplete. Moreover, we informed the landlord about the holes in walls, where the mice came from, but he did not do anything about it and refused to even look at them. We ended up by finding a dead mouth in our room, just next to the bed.  The landlord did not always clean the common areas, particularly the bathtub and sink, when we were the only guests in the house. Sometimes we would have to wait for two weeks and the check-in of a new guest to find clean spaces. We also had bedbug issues in our room but William reacted quickly to our demand and replaced the bed right away.   Generally speaking, William and Ana were not friendly hosts. They frequently yelled at us when we needed their help or when something was not going well in the house, accusing us of lying and putting dirt in the apartment or not doing enough to clean the common areas despite our goodwill. We’ve been constantly talked to as children and not as adults or clients, which is deeply concerning. Also, we were sometimes verbally attacked by the landlord.   We tried our best to be easy-going, respectful, tidy guests. We did not feel welcome in this house since they would be really disrespectful to us. Every time we had a problem they would get upset, asking why we didn’t talk to them before about it when the problem just arose. When we had to call them for a bedbugs problem, William yelled at us and was clearly threatening.   At the end of our stay, we didn’t want to ask them anything to avoid conflict. That’s why we stayed for days with dirty bedsheets, no drinking water, etc. - knowing they wouldn’t do much about our problem and would just get angry. We had no wifi for 3 months even though William always promised to fix the situation and that it was included in the list of equipment. We told them from day 1. They didn’t do anything about it and yelled at us after some time every time we would mention the problem.

Felicia's space is a delight. It's close to our daughter's place, close to grocery stores, a drug store, and WONDERFUL places to eat. Check in is seamless. Clean and spacious living and sleeping areas. Well appointed with comfortable sheets and towels. I'm hoping to be a return guest there, because my daughter and son-in-law do not have enough space for guests.

Location ... Location ... LOCATION!!!  What an amazing location in Brooklyn ... within a half-block of a subway that takes you right into Times Square!  Close by a major drug store, restaurants and shops!  We had a great time!

Sue is a very passionate and friendly person, she told me a lot of things which will be good to see in  New York and she really like to talk that it is hard to get bored. I ask her a lot of information about the city and she gave me feedback very patiently and in detail . I the place is near the high line park,and it is nice to go there at night, I am kind of afraid of being outside at night , but it seems pretty safe there. About the room, just the bathroom is a little small, others are pretty good.if you are going to NY alone, it can be the choice to to stay.

Sue was amazing during my stay. She waited for me even though my flight was delayed and her apartment had decorations in my name, I felt very welcome. During my stay she gave me lots of advice for visiting and it was great to talk to her. Her apartment is very clean, well located (30 seconds from Subway!!) and although it is small, Sue has made it very practical. I can't recommend Sue and her apartment more, it was great.

Amanda's place was in a great location - walking distance to great places to caffeinate, eat, and drink as well as to the train to travel elsewhere. It was clean and check in was easy. Not sure if it's mentioned in the listing but it is street parking only. We got in on a Thursday evening and found parking a block up after stressful circling around the block a few times (the stress is more of a *me* problem, though). Overall, would recommend and stay again.

It's a small nook in Williamsburg, approx 20-30 minute subway from Times Square. The place was smaller and more worn than we expected but we liked it.   The area felt a little unsafe when we arrived but we got used to it by day two. And this is not something the property owner is responsible for.   If we return it wouldn't be our first pick but it was a great last-minute booking!!
My stay at Niko's place was stress free , location was perfect for exploring mid town New York , you can walk to visit many places for eating shopping and sightseeing.
I didn't get a chance to meet Rob, but I did meet his sister and family. They were all very nice and accommodating. The place was nice and clean with a great location. I would stay there again.

I felt very welcome at Rob's place. It was very nice, clean and comfortable.  The location is very good, close to the subway, and the neighborhood looks ok. Rod's family is wonderful, and always willing to help. I definitely recommend this place!

Nico is such an AMAZING host very friendly great communication and is very accommodating. The space is a PERFECT location and Perfect size just what we needed at a steal price. The room is very clean and beautifully furnished & decorated.

The common areas of the building positively reeked of marijuana. My wife and I are drug tested for work and this presented a concern for us. Returning with our daughter later in the day (a local college student) she also remarked on the pungent Marijuana smell throughout the building. The wi-fi did not seem to function, we needed this for work, we contacted the host and he was unable to help us with this. Overall this may be a good solution for some, for us it was unusable, we ended up getting a hotel room around the corner as we wanted to be in this neighborhood but these two issues were deal breakers for us. We contacted the gentleman who checked us in and with whom we inquired about the wi-fi not working to let him know we would not be staying in the apartment, and had left it entirely unused. I also sent him a text which read, "If you would choose to give us any consideration for the apartment being unused our address is......" to which no reply was given.  Of course he was under no obligation to do so, and I expected nothing, but was hopeful, as the price of the weekend for this apartment and a neighboring hotel room to have an acceptable place to sleep was difficult to stomach. The apartment was clean and the gentleman seemed to make a genuine effort to make the stay pleasant for us. Again, this may be a perfectly desirable situation for some, for us it was an expensive lesson on what not to do when going to Harlem.

I liked the location and Niko was nice. He let us in early since we arrived earlier than expected. I read from other reviews that the room is small, but I think it was reasonable compared to the average price of other NYC accommodations. However, the main issue was the smell of the bed and the room. I could smell something unpleasant as I entered the apartment, and since the pillows and bed covers smelled, we could not use them but to just sleep on the bed for a few hours.

There's a first time for everything, and this will be the first time I am writing a negative review. I'll start with the good things: the apartment is located in amazing Fort Greene, Brooklyn, and is a stone's throw away from what seems like a million subway lines.  It is also very sunny and spacious for a studio, and the bathroom was large and very clean.  It was also awesome to have a doorman.    But now on to the bad:   (1) The furniture and amenities.  The apartment did not include all of the furniture and amenities represented in the photos.  There was no dining room table, no two-piece coffee table, and no TV or corresponding TV stand.  Not such a big deal for me, but it may be important for some.  Also, a word of caution about the sleeping arrangements: the bed in the listing was a not a stand-alone bed, but was a Murphy bed that is over a decade old and that is literally on its last legs.  (More on that below.)  Also, while the futon can be used as a bed, it has no support on one side if you fold down the back and try to make it full-size.   Finally, there was a wicker chair in the apartment with a huge hole in the seat, which had been concealed by a cloth.  (2) Ungracious host.  I'm sorry to report that I had a very bad experience with Xihuitl--the first time after dozen or so experiences using AirBnb.  While Xihuitl was welcoming in the beginning, she was tremendously unreasonable when a problem with the space arose.  Remember that old Murphy bed I described?  Well, the short story is that the 11-year-old bed was in very poor shape.  (Not only did the bed pop back up into the wall as soon as you pulled it down, it had a detached support beam that had been tied on to the frame with fabric, leaving only two mismatched and non-buttressed legs as its remaining supports).  Unsurprisingly, it only took someone to sit on it to make it buckle during our stay.  Not only did Xihuitl fail to apologize or take any responsibility for the shoddy--not to mention dangerous--state of the furniture, she tried to charge me over $700 for it.  That amount apparently included the bed's repairs (though she had yet to even consult a repairman and obtain an estimate), and her traveling costs for coming back to her own apartment.    In short, buyer beware.  It's a cute apartment with a lot of booby traps.  You may be better off going elsewhere.

We found the apartment in a nice part of Harlem. The flat was big enough to accomodate 5 people. 2 in each bedroom and one in the living room on a extra bed. The doorbell did not work on arrival so we went to ancoffeeshop round the corner. After we phoned, James came to pick us up. We got lots of information about restaurants in the neighbourhood. The metro is round the corner and easy to reach Manhattan. We only communicate with James by mail. If we needed something he looked after it, but we had to ask for it On departure he organised a taxi for 5, ( #85)  which is much cheaper than 2 taxi's. One taxi is about $ 60. We had a very good time and have enjoyed NY much. the people were friendly . helpfull and polite all over N Y and also at the aeroport.  We had a New york city pass, which is a good pass to enter the highlights. Well James thank you for your advises and hospitality, I left some info on your table and hope we see you in our AIBNB in the Netherlands or in India Martien, Hannie, Truus, Rob, Riet

Lisa was a wonderful host, and made sure that my stay was comfortable. The place is located in a convenient location, however, the locality appears to be a little sketchy at night. The house could be cleaner as well. Communication, wifi, room size etc. was perfect.

The room was very good and comfortable. It was enough for four people. We really enjoyed staying this room. But the location was a little scary for women in the night . On the whole, this room was good.

David was a great host and we really enjoyed meeting him.  We were there to visit our oldest daughter and help her move into her new apartment.   Loved getting the lay of the land from him even though we are very familiar with East village.  The location was awesome and was right across the park from her apartment.  David’s space was ample for NYC apartments.  Very quirky with cool wood floors and brick walls.  It’s on the 2nd floor which was super nice.  Not gonna lie there are some major foundation issues and the bathroom is very awkward and needs major updating but had hot water for the shower which was nice.   Bed and pillows a little hard and we ended up going to target to buy a couple new ones.  Left the pillows there for future guests. There were some nice touches like an instant hot water for tea and kitchen had lots of supplies incase you want to do some cooking.   We so appreciated David’s hospitality as we had a situation come up that he graciously helped us with.   Definitely made our stay less stressful.  We enjoyed our visit over thanksgiving!

Ben was a very good host. Everything was like described and the apartment is really very comfortable.  The bed is fantastic, there was wine and tea and coffee for us and he even provided a transformator to charge our (german) mobiles and gadgets.  He was a great help whenever we had any questions and made sure we felt welcome.  Ben allowed us to park our bicycles in his yard so we didn't have to fear that they would be stolen. If there would be a cheaper possibility to rent bicycles in the area, it would be perfect.  To get to Manhattan it sometime takes a little longer because of the unreliability of the subway, but on the other hand it's quite near to Williamsburg (15 Min. by bike), where you get fantastic vegetarian food (by the way). To Manhattan by bike it takes about 20 Min.  We enjoyed very much and definitely want to come back some time. Thanks a lot Ben. Matthias and Pia

Ben received us very kindly and we had no communication problems. The apartment corresponds to the description. Located on the ground floor, it is not particularly bright. It nevertheless offers decent comfort. It takes 10 minutes to reach the nearest subway station (Kingston-Throop), from where the C line takes you directly to Manhattan. The area is not unpleasant and seemed safe to us.

For our long term stay (3 months) it was fine. To be honest, I wouldn't recommend it for short vacations (weekends to 2 weeks) as the location is very decentralized (1 hour from Midtown including a 15 minute walk, much longer with Uber/Taxi etc. because of the traffic). In addition, when it comes to cleanliness, you really can't judge it by European standards. It's definitely not sparkling clean, but it's not uninhabitable either and it definitely serves its purpose. Facilities are great, you have everything you need. Life needs other than a washing machine and dryer (next good laundromat about 20 minutes away by bus).   Unfortunately, the residential area is anything but beautiful and tends to be dangerous. It's not clean and you meet some dubious people, especially at night. Furthermore, you live right next to the hospital, so loud sirens at all times of the day.   All in all we are not satisfied and a bit disappointed for the price, but you also have to be aware that you are not in a 5 star St. Tropez hotel but in a simple residential area in Brooklyn and once you have dealt with that it is fine and you spend most of your time in the city anyway!

I had a perfect stay. My plane was late on arriving so i didn't have a chance to actually meet James for a couple days. However his hospitality was evident in the little touches; a bed side lamp turned down low in my room, two bottles of cold water waiting and a towel and washcloth set aside. The room was very small but well appointed. I had everything I needed. You can tell James takes pride in making sure his travelers are comfortable. The bathroom at first blush was a little scary but after a second look  I realized it was clean; it only looked like I had been doing the tiling ;). I definitely will stay here again.

Highly recommend this apartment and would definitely stay here again! This is a great clean space in a great location. Ben is a terrific host (among the best!). Super easy check-in and check-out. I was in NYC with two colleagues for 3 nights and this was an ideal spot for us. We had a car and had no problem finding parking on the block. We also used the subway for one day (easy and nearby!). Having a kitchen and large fridge allowed us to make breakfast each morning and store our road-trip food and beverages. We used the large bedroom so didn't have use of it as a living room. Kitchen was fine for hanging out in for our limited "hang-out" needs. Only downside is that there is one AC wall unit (a good one mind you - in the kitchen). We kept the apartment cool by leaving the bedroom doors open. Outside temperatures were in the 90s during our stay so I suspect normally this would not even be needed. We had fabulous dinners at Peaches HotHouse (southern cooking with a hip clientele) and at Tepache (Mexican with a lovely outdoor eating area). Thank you Ben!
The Appartement is verry nice, beautiful and exactly the Same as on Photos. But place in Brooklin is quiet dangerous and the streets are "dirty". But for this prize it is nice.

Air bnb itself was so beautiful and clean. So comfortable, such a stylish space. The only thing we didn’t love was the area did feel a little unsafe, and with further research discovered it wasn’t a great area. However we didn’t struggle getting Ubers to where we needed to be. Hosts were fantastic, extremely helpful and communication was fantastic.

Much worse than expected. If you go one block over you feel very unsafe. We left before our time due to the TERRIBLE cheap uncomfortable furnishings. My husband could not sleep the old foam mattress sinks you in the middle and the couch feels horrible! You have been warned stay anywhere else in the city. We were also woken up after being jet lagged by UPS trying to deliver their packages of the Airbnb host. I had a hard time getting in, directions were not clear. I was messaging with the host then tried to call and they didn’t answer!

Thank you Johnny for being a professional and flexible host to a wonderful stay in NYC, who accommodated for my late flight on the day I was leaving (thank you to Johnny's next guest too!). The apartment was comfortable and spotless. Times Square and other points of interest were relatively easily accessible by walking, the subway at Port Authority Bus Terminal or the M42 bus. As a solo traveller on her first visit to NYC, I never felt unsafe in the neighbourhood where Johnny's apartment was located -- there is even a police station right across the street. Highly recommended for any visit to the Big Apple.

Kanae was the perfect host; prompt, cordial, and respecting of ones' privacy. The apartment was wonderful. Clean, airy, comfortable, and in the best block in Williansburg. Every kind of cozy coffee shop, ethnic restaurant, and convenience was right there. It is the best neighborhood to explore and relax in. I recommend Roebling Tea Room, M Shanghai, Bozu, and Super Fancy. I was there for five days and it made it feel like a month just because it was such a feast arrangement.   The subway is extremely close but you can also walk anywhere in the neighborhood and find fun unique shops and restaurants. The kitchen, bathroom and bed were very nice. The bathroom was big for New York standards and had a great shower. The towels were clean. There was a small garden in the back as well.  The bed was super comfortable. I might bring my own pillow next time. I am particular about size and firmness, and the pillows were too squishy and small for me. But somepeople like that! I am a former New Yorker and felt right at home in Kanae's place. She keeps it very simple design which is so calming when you are traveling.  She even had a super nice meditation chair, which is a hanging rope chair to chill out in. The dining room table was really perfect for visitors. I recommend this place for singles and couples who want an private place to come back to after being in the hustle and bustle of the city. You can run out yo get a bite to eat, but just chill as well.  I don't think there is tv but you don't need one. The kitchen has all the basics. There is extra seating in kitchen to have tea. I would stock up at C Town supermarket if you are staying a week to have drinks and snacks ready.  I would definitely book this again. There are so many apartments but I feel very lucky to have found this one. It is the best of all worlds in terms of comfort, cleanliness, location, host, and proximity to everything. It worked out really well for me even though I was late from the airport. Kanae gave me a text to see if j was delayed which was nice. Sometimes the time it takes to deplane and get luggage is much longer than expected. Kanae was a patient host in terms of that which can always be stressful. If you are looking for a great street in Willismsburg that can be a terrific oasis at that end of a long day, then this is the perfect spot, I only wish that I could stay longer and make more day trips but being in Brooklyn is pretty great in and of itself. I am so happy I discovered the apartment and got to have do many incredible meals right in the young, accessible, interesting, neighborhood of Williansburg. I look forward to my next stay at Kanae's place!

This is one of those places you secretly don't want to tell anybody about because you're afraid it won't ever be available again! Everything about this place is perfect, as described or better and Kanae is a joy to get to know. I recommended very highly!

This apartment felt like home during our long weekend in NYC. With a 10 minute walk to three different subway stations, it was easy to get around and explore. We also had one really fun day just walking around the neighborhood. Check-in was easy and Kanae worked around our travel plans. The place was clean & comfortable and we loved having the shady courtyard on a hot afternoon. Thanks for being our home base!

I had such a great stay in New York at Johnny's place. Besides being a gorgeous and cozy apartment, it was perfectly located between Hell's Kitchen, Javits and the High Line, as well as lots of great restaurants and markets. The perfect spot to call home for a week!   Johnny was such a helpful and kind host. He had so many great suggestions of places to eat and visit and made a very stressful week so much easier. Looking forward to the next time I can visit NYC!

So fantastic. I am afraid to write a great review because his place will be booked for eternity!  Immaculate place as if a staged sale apartment.  I met Johnny twice and we immediately clicked. Most of the e time I had the place to myself but when Johnny was there not only was I comfortable but glad he was around.  A fantastic NYC place for the price. Thanks!!
Our stay at Peter’s loft was wonderful! The loft is well maintained, and exudes artisan / boho vibes (a true Brooklyn experience!). And I can’t stress more about the superb location!!

Paul and Marjorie made us feel welcome and were very accommodating. The place was wonderful and looked better in person. We had no problems while staying there and they were always there to help us in any capacity. They answered our questions in a timely fashion and made sure we were taken care of. Both of them left us a binder of all the details about the house, neighborhood and even nearby restaurants. They even made arrangements to ensure the snow was shoveled during the blizzard. We had no complaints and overall I loved living at the place since it's so cozy. It's so close to the train station which is only a short ride to Midtown. Neighborhood is a little sketchy but overall safe as there is always police presence around the area.

Our 3-month stay at Marjorie’s house was very pleasant. We immediately felt like home. The house is just as it looks in the pictures. The kitchen is provided with everything you could need and the spacious living room has a large and very comfortable sofa. The 3 bathrooms, as well as the washing machine and the dishwasher, are a big plus. The house is also provided with an internal garden, which is perfect to enjoy spring days.  The neighborhood, the poorest in Manhattan, could appear sketchy at first sight but it is safe. We have never experienced any problem. The subway is very close and you can easily reach Midtown in 25 minutes via 6 train. All in all, you have easy access to all NYC areas. Isabel, Marjorie’s neighborhood, was our contact during our stay. Both Marjorie and her husband, as well as Isabel, were always there to help us and take care of our needs. We really appreciated their kindness and would recommend this apartment to anyone staying in NYC, especially for long periods.

Marcello was a great host.  He was easy to reach both before and during my stay, and he was waiting for me when I arrived and carried my bags up the stairs.  The apartment was perfect for my needs.  It was well equipped (including snacks in the fridge), comfortable, and well located in a pleasant neighborhood in the Times Square/Theatre District/Port Authority area with lots of restaurants, drug stores, and subway stations just a few steps away.  (Port Authority gives access to the E train to JFK, which is  cheaper and faster than a taxi or shared van.)  Comfortable bed, plenty of hot water in the shower, plenty of toiletries, good hair dryer. The wifi worked great.  The other tenants in the building seemed civilized and quiet.  I ran into Marcello in front of the building while I was heading out one day, and we had a nice chat and he introduced me to a friend of his in the same building.  I would happily stay here again.

Nice place, Mark was great but the neighbors downstairs were horrible, they slammed the doors all night and was loud. I complained to Mark about this issue but it only became worse and made them angry, they waited whiles I came out the door and cursed me out, I was so scared I did not want to complain again to make matters worse I just wanted my stay to be over.  This was my first experience with Air BNB and it was horrified

This place was fantastic! If you're a theater fan like me, this place is close to all the theaters and a great home base if you're there for a theater trip.  It's a small place, but it just gives you that classic New York apartment feel.  Marcello was easy to contact with and very helpful with telling me about the neighbourhood and NYC in general; I never had an issue.  This was also my first time using AirBnB, first time in NYC, and first time solo travelling.  Never had an issue, never felt unsafe, and overall the great experience I had with Marcello and his place helped make my trip a great success.

Great place, a few steps from subway, very fast and easy to get to Manhattan. Marina and Andrey are great hosts, they made sure i had all the information i needed, the checkin process is very smooth and no stress. in the apartment and kitchen you have everything you need. Highly recommended. I have this place bookmarked for my future stays in New York.

Marina's airbnb is a very good place to stay. It is well located regarding the subway stations - but the area might be kinda scary for a (female) solo traveler.  A lot of supermarkets are nearby so you can perfectly prepare your meals in the kitchen which is definitely big enough. The whole place is very clean and the air condition makes it comfortable even in the summer time. Moreover, the room is large enough for two people.

This is a great place to stay.  All of the reviews were accurate.  Christine had her place super clean, had fresh flowers out, snacks and drinks were available and good tips on places nearby.  The only downfall which I knew before we stayed there was the street noise.  Not every night but at least 3 nights (we stayed 5 nights) there was super loud music and groups of people just hanging out on the sidewalks below.  I never felt scared in the neighborhood but had to keep windows closed at night and air on high so could go to sleep because of the noise.  You won't regret staying there.

I love this neighborhood! If you're excited to see Central Park and all the museums, this is a great home base. Everything you need is within a 5-10 minute walk, including public transportation, grocery/drug stores, and restaurants/bars. The apartment itself is quite roomy with nice details that makes it feel like you're staying with a friend, in all the best ways.

This were first time I was going to visit New York, and I was very worried, because it's such a huge city, I was afraid to get lost, to look for a long way to apartment... But Marcello was so caring and attentive, he told me everything in detail and even sent photos of the correct outputs on my way. I found everything so quickly, as if I'd been there many times before with his help! In addition, subway was near the entrance to the apartment. In the apartment everything is like on photos, there were fruits and some foods, tea and coffee. Marcello offered to show the surrounding area and it was the best place that possible for your excursions in new York. There is three minutes walk to Times Square. And Marcello was always in touch, and he always was ready to help in all situations. Thank you very much, Marcello!!! I had wonderful time!!! ◢  Отправить перевод

I do not write this lightly, if you are a Black person or a person of color I do recommend you  book this bnb. While the host was pleasant and everything was as described, his neighbors made my friends and I feel unsafe.  I asked Nick to host a dinner party for my sister (9 people all family or close friends) Nick agreed. The only reason there was more than 9 people at one point, was to help me set up the bnb for the occasion.  I was last to arrive, as I was cooking. All of the guests were Black or Latinx. Admittedly we were reckless transferring between our cars and the bnb as we did not wear masks. Luckily, we all live together in one way or another. Also, we were able to find parking directly in front of the building. As soon as my sister arrived, a neighbor came down and asked "Who are you?" She was the birthday girl,  this event was a surprise. She told the neighbor that I had booked that bnb. Was there a problem? He said he noticed no one was wearing masks. Reader, when the neighbor approached strangers to inquire who they were, he was not wearing a mask. My sister pointed out as much and reminded him they all came from the same place and to follow social distancing rules. He said he would "check inside to make sure everything was ok."  This interaction, from the start made my sister and her friends uncomfortable. When I arrived, I too, noticed the unwarranted stares from neighbors without masks. Because we are P.O.C. in this mostly white neighborhood and were already being antagonized we kept the music low and when it got late, turned off the music altogether. Most guests left after eating, leaving 5 of us remaining.  We were using the backyard to smoke, we were told by the neighbor who approached us about the masks the yard was not part of the bnb. So we came back upstairs. No music on, 5 of proceeded to converse quietly among ourselves as this is now the second time we've been chastised. Reader, I live in an apartment complex similar to the one we rented. My neighbors make all types of noise at all hours of the day, this is to be expected. We live in a compact city. 5 people in a large apartment, 2 having an intimate conversation and the other 3 casually conversing with music off should not be much of a disturbance no matter the time. Especially considering this was a week of civil unrest in our country. Everyone is home because of the pandemic, my friends and I had been going out to protest almost daily, we're not ready to go to sleep at 1 A.M.  Again, the same neighbor came downstairs and told us to keep it down. I pointed around and said there are only 5 people have quiet conversations, he said the window was open. Someone closed the window, he insisted we cut it out anyway.  Reader, I paid more than 300 to host my sister a dinner party where she could rest her head after her birthday. We all ended up getting in our cars and leaving. I realized that in the absence of police presence, white people try to become an enforcer of authority. It was extremely uncomfortable for us and I have never experienced anything like this.  Again,. we were cavalier about arriving in masks, even though the cars were right across the street, we should have worn them. But we were not excessively noisy. We were in fact, quiet somber. The apartment is as described, so you will definitely enjoy that.

Very good value for money, the neighborhood is not very nice, but we never saw anything strange nor did we feel in danger. Charlene is a charming host, very willing to help in any way she can and her apartment is very comfortable and clean. It's a pleasure to return home after a busy day in NY.
We were initially afraid of the neighborhood but we were quickly reassured and everything went well.

To begin with, Charlene is an incredible, kind person who you can rely on during your stay in NY. I lost my keys (never happened to me in my life) and Charlene was present to resolve the situation, without stress.  The apartment really is ideally located. Yes, it's Harlem, very popular but it doesn't feel dangerous at all. The apartment is a 3-minute walk from line 6. It is perfect. The accommodation is very clean with new sheets. And we were able to share the bathroom with the people in the other room without any problem.  I will go to Charlene's again on my next trip to NY.  Highly recommended!
Super accommodating host and a stress-free stay!

I stayed at Maria's studio at the biginning of december with my boyfriend.  We were very pleased with our stay, everything was as expected, no scary surprises whatsoever! Maria was very accomodating and answered all our questions before the trip. Since it was our first time in New York, she gave us lots of tips and ideas as to what to do and see in the city.  Unfortunately we didn't get to meet Maria during our stay, but her mother Natasha greeted us with the keys on our arrival.  The appartment is very easy to find and the location is great! Only a 3 min walk to the nearest subway-station with 2 express trains stopping there. They'll get you downtown in 10-15 minutes.  I checked out google earth beforehand to see what the street looked like, so we had no trouble getting there.  Natasha gave us the code to the building, so we went right in when we came. She waited for us in the appartmen to show us where everything was and how to convert the couch into a bed. She even offered to show us around the neighborhood to the nearest grocery store etc.  The sofa-bed was quite comfortable and more than enough for 1 week. The studio isn't that big, but that really didn't matter to us, as we spent most of our time exploring the city and not in the appartment. But it had everthing necessary, a fridge, a stove, a microwave... The internet worked just fine.  The only thing we didn't quite figure out was the TV, but I can't say we tried really hard and I'm sure Maria would have told us how it worked if we'd called her. We simply had no great use of it.  The neighborhood was great as well. We felt safe the whole time and there are plenty of small delis and other places to eat nearby. We also discovered some great bars with live music in walking distance from the appartment.   So to sum it up, we were very happy with our stay and would gladly stay there again on an other occasion!

For our first trip to New York and our first AirBnB experience we couldn't hope for better. The studio is charming, in the heart of Harlem with, next door, merchants for your breakfast or meal. The neighborhood is nice. Treat yourself to a gospel song on Sunday, it's a must! There are churches on every street corner. Maria was very understanding. Even though our flight was canceled and we could only arrive 24 hours after the scheduled date, she held our reservation and reassured us when we feared a cancellation. Her mother, a charming woman, welcomed us and even though we didn't have the pleasure of meeting Maria directly, she checked in on us by message to see if everything was okay. Don't hesitate and book!

We stayed at the apartment for 9 nights. We loved the neighborhood and the street where the apartment is located. Also the people in this neighborhood are very friendly and helpful without asking. We never had an unsafe feeling. The apartment is not big (plm. 25 m2). Very nice bathroom with a rain shower. and towels enough and when you ask Jan for more she will give you more. A small kitchenette with microwave and fridge. It's not possible to make a meal but you can heat something and cook water. The bed is small with a good mattress. The room has carpet on the floor. Only at the kitchen part there are tiles. There is a small window so there is not much daylight in the apartment but enough lamps everywhere. When we arrived Jan welcomed us and showed us the apartment. We also were lucky to find a Babka cake which was very nice of Jan and the cake was delicious!! We even bought two to take to Holland. She also remembered that I told her it was our wedding anniversary and she had a bottle of bubbles for us in the fridge. So sweet! Also there was some fruit on the table and some first drinks were there. Everything was very clean. Jan was very friendly and helpful. She was easy to contact and interested. She even bought a wifi extender when I asked her about the slow internet. When they went out of town for a few days she even offered us to use her backyard and her kitchen which was very very friendly of her. In the neighborhood are enough nice places to eat. Our favorite is Aita. Just two blocks from the apartment. The subway is nearby!

We had a fantastic time at Carlton Avenue. We really valued this stylish, spacious home-from-home - a really lovely way to experience the real New York. Coming home each day to a classic brownstone was a real treat.   The location was fantastic. Convenient for the subway and basic amenities like the supermarket, casual dining and so on... we suspect it’s even better for those unencumbered with a four year old!   The linens in this place have to be singled out for commendation - the bed and bath provisions were particularly good.   The apartment is in a very quiet area, despite being so conveniently located - we really appreciated this. Aircon was really effective, too.  Highly recommended. We loved our time here and can’t wait to return!

Celina was very nice at our arrival an explained us everything and recommended us a lot of restaurants and shops in the area. Harlem was a little bit scary at first, but after a while, we felt secure. The apartment is rather small, but this is due to NYC standards. It could have been cleaner as the other guests described and we had not really much space for our stuff like a closed or something like this and the metro could be reached easily and was very close. The streets and the surroundings were noisy also a few days at night, the house itself seems to be very safe but bit too clairaudient. Next time we would take an apartment in downtown because everything is much closer there. Thank you anyway Celina for our smoothly stay. All the Best.  Celina war bei unserer Ankunft sehr nett und erklärte uns alles ausführlich und hatte ein paar Vorschläge für Restaurants und Läden in der Umgebung. An sich ist Harlem eine sichere Gegend, doch nachts wollten wir nichtmehr unterwegs sein auch wenn wir uns sicher fühlten. Die Wohnung ist nicht sehr groß doch entspricht dem NYC Standard und war für uns vollkommen ausreichend. Es hätte etwas sauberer sein können, sie wie in den anderen Bewertungen geschrieben aber bei uns was dies leider nicht ganz der Fall. Da wir sowieso den ganzen Tag unterwegs waren und nur abends zum Duschen und schlafen in der Wohnung waren, konnte man darüber noch hinwegsehen. Uns fehlte auch eine Abstellmöglichkeit für unsere Sachen, wie einen Kleiderschrank oder eine Kommode. Das Beste war, dass die Metrostation gleich um die Ecke ist und man somit schnell nach Downtown kommt. In den Straßen ging es ziemlich laut zu, das morgens natürlich schon und abends war es teilweise auch ziemlich laut von der Straße her. Das Haus scheint sehr sicher zu sein aber etwas hellhörig. Für die Zukunft würden wir trotzdem lieber ein Apartment in Downtown wählen, weil dort einfach die meisten Sehenswürdigkeiten sind und alles in „unmittelbarer“ Nähe. Trotzdem vielen Dank Celina für unseren reibungslosen Aufenthalt.

Since the day we got at the apartment we felt amused. The space is very cozy and quiet. We were very close to the subway and we could get anywhere we wanted. Maria was so courteous and helpful with anything we asked her. In the end we felt that was a very good decision to stay in this neighborhood because it wasn't so stressful and busy like places we went to.

Absolutely fantastic location in the heart of Williamsburg. Very comfortable apt with ample accommodations for families, couples, and friends. The apt is nicely decorated with and features a fully equipped kitchen and really nice and private back yard to relax in the evening shade. Had a fantastic family weekend getaway and would definitely stay again!

The duplex on Bedford st was just the right for our small family of 3 to stretch out and relax. The decor was tasteful, the beds comfortable and the location super convenient to food shopping, boutiques and fantastic restaurants. Our communication with our host Aurelis was always prompt and thoughtful.  We managed to live through the freezing polar vortex temperatures comfortably and actually enjoyed the extreme weather once we’d planned our day skipping from subway to destination. When that all became too much we were happy to chill in our warm apartment and listen to jazz on the radio. Our teenager was in his room watching YouTube - so great WiFi!  We didn’t cook that much but there is a fully equipped kitchen for those who need it. The trash was straight forward to sort, there wasn’t enough room for us to fit everything in the bins outside so we had to leave some of it inside (in the trash cans) when we left.  Before we arrived Aurelis warned us that the 2nd bathroom wasn’t working and that the heating was acting up. We knew what to expect so there were no unpleasant surprises when we stepped through the door. None of these things affected us negatively but the might be a downside for another group.  Many thanks, Francesca, Sean and Jude

Disclaimer this was my first time renting a room as opposed to the entire unit/apartment. That said, the transparency and accuracy of the description seems all the more important when sharing a space with others. Rosa's home is in a great location and very accessible via the subway. In addition, there are great food and bar options within walking distance.  Unfortunately for me the entire experience left a lot to be desired from the beginning, the day of check-in she asked me to provide a negative Covid test (luckily I was negative) which added some additional stress last minute. Upon arriving she immediately started with house rules of no shoes inside the apartment, no food inside my room, no beef/meats in the shared fridge because she's vegan, the doors had to be kept closed, the air was to be set only when I was in the room, and lastly she let me know another guest was staying in the room adjacent to mine. In my opinion, this is where things truly took a turn because she overshared how the other guest had been a handful and a bit of a problem. It was disconcerting given that I would be sharing a space with said individual. To add to this, none of the doors in the apartment have a lock, my room and the bathroom door could be closed but did not lock and the other room didn't even have a door. In my opinion the lack of locks should be called out in the Airbnb description to set expectations from the beginning.  Overall I was made to feel like I was a burden and not a guest who is paying for a service. I suppose one could argue you get what you paid for but I still think transparency is key to know exactly what you're getting for the price.

Chelsea’s Place had everything we wanted in an Airbnb. We do wish we were a bit closer to the city. Garbage trucks come around 2 or 3 am in the morning. The neighbors were friendly and suggest things to do. There are a lot of Mexican restaurants around not much of any other choices near by you would have to catch the train to get other cuisines. Walking distance to Denny’s. The turtle was a nice touch to the place however the tank had an odor which made being in the living room unpleasant. Overall great stay.

We had to get the key from a different location which, given the fact that it was rush hours and raining, made the taxi ride 40mn longer than it would have been if we had gone directly to the flat. No impact on the price of the taxi as it was a fixed price, but after such a journey from Europe, spending  1h40mn in a taxi instead of 1h didn’t feel great. The building is nice from outside but the common part are a bit shabby. There is a dog barking a lot in the apartment right below. Apparently he is not there all the time, but when he is, he barks a lot… very annoying. Apart from that the flat is quiet although you hear everything happening in the stairs. The apartment was exactly as stated and as shown on the pictures although a bit worn at the edges. The beds are particularly comfortable. The shower has good water pressure and hot water at will. Regarding the amenities though, we had the unpleasant surprise to see that the tv was out of order. Despite the fact that the tv was out of order for at least 2 weeks, nothing had been done and they didn’t let us know in advance and we stayed all the stay without a tv. We didn’t go to NYC to watch tv but after visiting all day long, watching news or a movie at the end of the day is certainly something we missed a lot. Not to mention we were travelling with a 12 years old… Also, the flat has central heating but not individually controlled so when the temperatures dropped during our stay, we could do nothing to raise the inside temperature. When alerted, Sabina had someone to deliver a small electric heater within 24h but we spent one evening, one night and one morning in a quite cold environment. Given the impossibility to regulate the heat in the flat, the mini heater should have been there from scratch.

We really enjoyed our stay at Melissa's apartment, and it proved to be a great base for exploring NYC being only a 30 min subway ride into Manhattan. The apartment was clean and comfortable and Melissa left clear instructions that made our arrival at the apartment stress free. The local area has a few bars and places to eat, but we found that we spent more time in Manhattan or other areas of Brooklyn. Great value for money, thanks Melissa!

The apartment was inside her house. The room had a full kitchen, restroom, small sitting area, and the bed. Nicely decorated. Neighborhood was unsafe, people yelling and arguing outside, and was far out in Brooklyn.

The apartment was nice, comfortable and clean, furthermore it had everything we needed. Katja was very cordial, polite and especially helpful! Unfortunately, the apartment is very far from  the main attractions and also from brooklyn center, morever the neighborhood is unsafe in the night as it has been confirmed from many taxi drivers.

Katja place was very clean. We enjoy our stay at her home. The place was super clean and pretty just like the pictures. The only problem we had was the location of her home. We felt unsafe walking to her house from the metro stop. But we are not from big city so, it might not be a problem for everyone. It's about 30min commute to Manhattan. Katjs Thank you for having us.

Myself and 5 others women stayed at Elizabeth's home for my bachelorette weekend. When we arrived, Elizabeth warmly greeted us and gave us a tour of the home. We had everything we needed in the home, including beverages left over from the previous guest. On the Saturday of our stay, I hosted my bridal shower that held up to 20 people in the quarters. I have to say so far so good. Everything was picture perfect.  Sunday is when things went slightly sour. My original guests sat in the living room contemplating where to go for brunch when we heard a scuffle at the door. Thinking it was one of my girlfriends who ran out for an errand, I immediately jumped up to help her get in (the door was a little tricky). When I looked through the window I noticed it was a man and a woman. I asked them through the door if they were lost and if I can help them and the indicated that they stayed there the week prior and left some belongings. Elizabeth allegedly knew they were coming. They showed the keys to the unit. I asked them to call the host as we were not made aware of anyone coming by especially with a set of keys. The couple went into a summary about how they are actually the tenants of the home and that we were in fact in violation of NY law and they were going to call the police. They threatened to enter the premises every time I closed the door. We immediately called Elizabeth who explained she was in a current legal battle, albeit placing us in the middle. Elizabeth came to discuss the matter and offered us our money back for that evening should we leave since our safety was our concern. Where were we supposed to go last minute on a Sunday? We decided to stay and felt compelled to remain in the house out of fear that this couple would come back and steal our belongings. This really put a damper on what should have been a memorable weekend. I'm not sure if this is something that could have been avoided by any means, it just occurred while we were there. I'm just happy it didn't happen during my bridal shower.  We went to bed that night with a chair in front of the door to ensure that no one could enter, none of us slept well that night. We left early the next morning to board our flights and texted Elizabeth to let her know that we left. We didn't even get a message back from her, likely bc she was embarrassed by the situation. We even left her cupcakes and a thank you note. Although not completely within her control, I just wish she was a little nicer about it considering the circumstances. Otherwise the first two days of our stay were great!

A great house for 9 people, if there are more it will be a bit uncomfortable as the 10th person then has to sleep in the common room/living room. Otherwise there is enough space and it is stylishly and comfortably furnished. The kitchen is great to use and the balcony also looks very inviting. The next subway station is in the immediate vicinity (5 minutes on foot).

Great and comfortable place! We didn't feel unsafe here at all. It had everything we needed for our weekend trip. They even had pots and pans to cook in the kitchen. It was about a 5-10 minute walk to the subway which was like about a 50 minute ride to Grand Central! I would definitely book with Katja again!

The contact with Katja was really nice. She answered very fast and helped us fast when we needed something, otherwise we had our privacy and could come and go whenever we wanted. The House is totally cute, and is the prettiest on the street. The apartment was exactly as shown at the pictures and clean! We soon felt like it's our little home. We stayed for 10 Days and felt like becoming a part of the neighborhood. Sometimes as we walked to the trainstation people great us. First we were afraid to take the train back when it's dark as two women alone in this big city but the area felt pretty safe and after taking a taxi once we were sure it's the right (and very cheap) option to take the train. The trainstation was very close, like a 5 minute walk and the train took like 40 minutes to Chelsea Market and Highline Park. We really loved this vacation, the city and staying at this place. When ever we come back to the city we want to stay here again!

It's a shame not to have met Katja. The apartment is suitable for a couple on an excursion; small bathroom, kitchenette, and living room. Clean except for dishes, and well located with metro lines.  If it is your first time in southern Brooklyn, I would not recommend it (there is nothing to see in the area where the apartment is located and it is a 'complicated' neighborhood).  If you know what you are exposing yourself to - you have been in the area before and feel safe, go ahead. I want to mention that I live in New Orleans, and few things usually scare me.

Kumar's accommodation is very well located in Harlem, very close (less than 5 minutes) to a subway station which allows you to be in southern Manhattan in less than 30 minutes with the express subway. No problem of insecurity (we were 3 girls). The building appears to be completely renovated - like many buildings in Harlem - but Kumar's apartment is clean and functional. Perfect value for money: IKEA layout ;) therefore functional. Kumar was very kind, sending us messages to see if everything was okay, which reassures us if we are a little lost sometimes; good exit advice and super nice. I therefore recommend without any worries!

This place offers a very good cost/value, the apartment was clean, spacious and well equipped. There are a few convenience stores (small delis and a Family Dollar) and a laundromat close to the apartment. The only inconvenience is that it is far from Manhattan, but there are several metro stations closeby. I suggest you to avoid the Livonia Av. metro stop, as its surroundings are very sketchy. Other than that we felt safe in the neighboorhood. I would recommend this place to other people.

- The house is really nice. - The location is safe (not as dangerous as expected). - Convenient transportation (5 mins away from subway) - Inferior design is stylish with lots of kitchen equipment. - Clean bed sheets and towels. - Hot water is not enough for bathing if there’s too many people

This is a great house to stay in! So historic, and grand! Elizabeth was the most helpful and awesome host. She provided all the information we needed ahead of time so there was no stress of checking in. The neighborhood is historic Harlem, and close to famous delicious restaurants. It was only blocks away from the red subway line and a bus line. The only thing I would say is if people want to travel by cab, those were a little harder to get if you are using the curb app. They are not as readily available. It was a fun stay and a fun experience.

The home met our expectations and comfortably housed our group of five. However the neighborhood we had to walk through from the subway to get to the house was a little sketchy. We didn't always feel safe on that walk. Could just be that we were five women from Iowa with not much big city experience.

We didn't get to meet Katja in person but she responds quick to messages.  The location was super convenient and close to trains. There were a few nights where we got home at around midnight and not once did we feel unsafe. There was also 2 corner stores nearby so it was super easy to just grab a sandwich or some water. If I'm ever in New York again I would definitely stay here!

The Host: Kumar was a great host. There was great communication between he and I whether it was by text, email, in person or by phone. He made my stay very stress and hassle free.  The Apartment: I had a key to the apartment and could enter and go as I pleased. Everything was just as it was described. The apartment was clean and stocked with the necessities.  Location: The apartment was in a great location, close to many shops, restaurants and bars. I was able to go out and night and did not feel unsafe. I would definitely recommend this apartment to other Airbnb users!

The apartment is nicely decorated and clean. Katja is really very accommodating and responds quickly to messages. The description of the apartment and the photos are consistent. A little far from Manhattan by metro (around 40-45 minutes) but given the price and the quality of the service, the quality/price ratio is excellent. As said in previous comments, the neighborhood is quite poor and can create a feeling of insecurity but we were not bothered once and the neighbors are polite. A place to recommend.

This is a great place to stay in New York for three people. It has everything you need, is very clean and Kumar is one of the best hosts I've ever experienced. The house is very close to  the subway and the trip isn't too long if you catch an express. It's a bit longer from downtown if you're not on an express train.   We found the area had things we needed in it - a great cafe (Sugar Hill Cafe), an awesome laundromat, a supermarket. We did find that when we came back one night there were a few groups around the subway station who were drinking and made comments to us which was a bit unpleasant but every other night was fine.   There were a few small negatives - it was very hot in the house and there are few windows. Even with the air con on we found it hot and we had a few troubles with the air con. We also found you could hear noise from upstairs a bit (people walking around). Also note the bathroom is off the main bedroom - so the third person had to walk through the bedroom. This didn't bother us really but it's worth noting.   Overall good value for money in New York City and an outstanding host! Thanks Kumar!

What an amazing experience I had at Oksana place. I felt as if I was at my sister place. Her bed and her shower are out of this world and her decoration. It was all I needed after a stressful day. It was hard leaving! However, nothing tops Oksana vibe. She is so sweet, caring and friendly, I’ve felt like she was family every time we talked. It was an honor! Hope to be back soon!

The host was absolutely amazing! Patricia made us feel very welcomed, safe, and accommodated. There was a lot of stuff in the kitchen -- tea, coffee, hot chocolate, sugar, baking supplies, orange juice, milk, water, etc. Everything was new, so you knew that Patricia had those prepared just for our trip. Patricia was always reachable. She lives on the ground floor, so whenever we had a question or a quick fix with the apartment, she was available. Also, Patricia owns the 2nd and 3rd floor, which are 2 apartments she uses for airbnb. We were on the 3rd floor, and when the 2nd floor wasn't occupied, Patricia let us use the 2nd floor's bathroom and living room. She was really generous with our stay, and she was just an incredibly warm, wonderful host.   The neighborhood wasn't that dangerous. As a group of 8 with 4 guys, we never felt uneasy about the neighborhood. The subway is literally 20 seconds from the apartment, so it's a convenient commute. However, the D train is a bit intimidating, and this is the only train that goes to this neighborhood. But... you're in NYC. You can't be afraid of diversity!

The house was clean when we arrived,everything was in order. Got enough beds for a big group like us. I may say it was the most complete accommodation I've ever seen---plates,utensils,plenty of towels and face towels,even kitchen spices. Washing machine, dryer, dishwasher and A/C are all in working condition. Patricia was always available when we need her and she's got all the maps and infos about NY. Staying there made our holidays more fun and stress-free. Will definitely recommend to a friend.

Not only is Harry’s place an absolute gem.,  but they are also the ultimate  hosts.  We were welcomed in person and walked through every single detail in the apartment.  Their home is well appointed with everything you need to enjoy a stress free NY stay, from the kitchen to bath amenities.  They are very responsive and great at communicating.  Location is great in the heart of Soho shopping and surrounds.  I highly recommend.
S’s space is a wonderful NYC vibe. Excellent location, with amazing views.   Our family usually needs two hotel rooms. At NYC prices  this rental’s price is an exceptional steal.

I lived here for a month. The place is located in Ft. Greene, which is an awesome neighborhood.  It's accessible to everything.  It is within walking distance to many trains, grocery stores, bars, restaurants, etc. It's also very safe. There are lots of young ppl and families. As a woman I never felt in danger walking home alone at night.   The place is very clean, which was great for me because that's how I like to live. That being said, there are many rules and expectations in place to keep it that way. I received a reminder about sponge placement, for example.  The room itself is very spacious.  As Taya put it "You could do yoga in here!".  (I did not take advantage of yoga, but it was nice not feeling cramped).  Taya is very knowledgable about the neighborhood (read: she told me where to find the laundromat, coffee, food and general merriment). She also checks in every so often to see how things are going.   I spent a nice month here and would recommend this place for temporary or long term travelers. If you are a temporary traveler, keep in mind that while all trains are within walking distance, they are all more than a block.  The C and G trains are closer, around 8-10 minutes walking, but all of the other trains are about 12-15 min, depending on the speed of your stride.  Cheers!

Bill was an awesome host!   Neighborhood felt safe, lots of activity on the streets but not unsafe.  Friendly neighbors.   If you have trouble with stairs may be a problem for someone as they are steep and narrow.  No other issues.

Kumar was an incredible host, and he truly made our stay so much less stressful! He was extremely helpful in telling us of local places to buy groceries, the best subway line to take for my husband to get back and forth to the hospital, and just overall so kind. His communication was so fast. The house was super clean and much more spacious than we thought it was going to be. The area was very nice. Amenities were super close by. Overall, we couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay for such a stressful time for us. We will absolutely book again if we have to come back for our son.

All is perfect. We love the stay greatly. All beds are comfortable and the space is well decorated. Bill was very responsive and caring. The transportation is convenient too. The only concern is about the safety. Though the house itself is located in a decent community, we had some trouble when reaching to the metro station nearby.    There were someone who tried to scare us. But all in all there's nothing harmful.

We LOVED staying at Catia's sweet apartment! It is perfectly located for exploring all things NYC...easy walking distance to the subway and dozens of restaurants and shops, plus a few short blocks to the High Line. Warmly decorated and cozy, it was a much welcome retreat after long days of site-seeing. To make for an extra special stay,  Catia was incredibly helpful leading up to our trip, offering tips, reminders, and custom details upon arrival to ensure optimal comfort and enjoyment of not only her apartment, but of the city as well. She was responsive and kind to all questions, and truly helped make for a stress-free holiday in the city. We highly recommend her apartment!

This place was perfect! It was exactly what I expected and was great for a couple of gals who really wanted to spend most of our time out on the town. Jane was super nice and it was really east to make it all happen. No stress!

This is an awesome place to stay!!  It's a very clean space, updated with a great kitchen, spacious floor plan, and with kind and gracious hosts.  I absolutely recommend staying here.  We found it to meet all of our needs.  Plus, the location was handy to grocery and drug stores and local eateries.  And finally, we really appreciated our wonderful hosts.

Harlem is a lively neighborhood, very pleasant to live in...   The persistent idea that Harlem is dangerous dates back several decades... We felt as safe there as in Paris or Madrid!  The apartment is very well located, a few steps from the 145th Street metro station, served by several lines; in less than 15 minutes, you are south of Central Park...Edgecombe Avenue is lined with characteristic buildings with many local shops. This accommodation is clean and bright, perfectly arranged; the bedding is of excellent quality; recent household appliances. And Patricia is a charming woman, present without being pushy; she is available with the aim of helping if necessary! We arrived at the apartment around 1:30 a.m. and Patricia was waiting to welcome us!  I recommend this rental without hesitation!   Gilles

Patricia was waiting for us on the steps to welcome us. The apartment matches the photos. The neighborhood is quiet day and night. We returned by metro around midnight and felt no fear. Patricia was always responsive very quickly before and during our stay. Fruit juice and milk were available in the refrigerator along with bottled water. Small appreciable attention when we arrive. Small downside, the apartment is an old apartment renovated, but the blinds do not block out the light enough, especially in the rooms which overlook the street, if there are neighbors above you can hear them well, and the doors opening onto the stairwell do not sufficiently isolate the noise coming from the passage in the stairwell. This apartment remains a sure value even if you should know that it is quite far from the center. The A and C metro station is very close as well as a fairly large grocery store.

Very nice and comfortable apartment. The doormans and neighbors are really friendly. The location is amazing with a lot of places to eat, groceries and metro stations near by. Josh was very helpfull and always respond quickly. Josh also leave some water and granola bars! The bed and pillows are super comfortable. The AC works well, but it is a little noisy. The only small drawback that I can find is that there is some light leaking through the window shade. If I could, I would come again to this place the next time I visit NY!

Luis' place was great. The bed was comfortable, the shower was clean and I had lots of privacy. We haven't interacted much because I was mostly out in the city, but whenever we did interact - he was very sweet and accommodating. Note that it takes about 40minutes to get from his apartment to *west* Manhattan via the subway (if you want to get to east Manhattan you can get off 5 stops earlier and it's faster). I was afraid it would be too long of a journey, but it actually worked well for me!

Filip was a really friendly host. He gave me directions for everything I needed. The apartment was located in a family neighborhood so no need to be afraid. Close to subway stations to go either to Manhattan or  to JFK airport

Grace was a fantastic host during my one month stay. She actually went out of town for 3 weeks, but made sure I had everything I needed for a great stay. This location is just north of central park and next to the 2 and 3 trains and a little further are the C, E, B and 6 trains. This makes it really easy to visit the West side, East side and lower Manhattan. Local food is scant so expect to travel a lot if you are a foody or socialite. If not, there are some select places on 8th avenue. The neighbordhood is in Harlem, but appears to be experiencing some degree of gentrification. I never felt threatened or unsafe, but as with any part of the world, avoid walking around in the early AM hours. Nights can be a bit noisy as some of locals tend to sit out on the stoops snd have conversations. Overall I recommend this spot for anyone looking for a long term stay in a more laid back part of town.

Well, there are several advantages: the price is good (the value for money is reasonable), it's close to the metro, the rooftop is super cool. Additionally, there is a supermarket next door. Filip is super accommodating about schedules and provided us with two keys which is really great. Filip responds quickly to emails.  But I'm disappointed... it's not really the Airbnb spirit but rather a youth hostel. You are not with Filip, but strangers. Filip does not live here contrary to what he implies.  We cannot close the room doors and there are no lockers.  It is said that it is 20 minutes from the center, but it is more like 40 minutes if we take the real center (see 1 hour in the evening). The neighborhood is average, and the room is super noisy.  Unfortunately the wifi doesn't work very well downstairs (no Skype possible, or go on Instagram) and doesn't work in the upstairs rooms.  There are a lot of ants in the room, in the kitchen.... and mold in the bathroom. There is also 2/3 of a curtain in the room.  Furthermore, we had put food in the shared fridge with our name on it, but it was stolen...  In short, it's a low budget room in a mini hostel 45 minutes from the center.

The host did a great job communicating and answering my questions. As a first time user, I felt confident that our stay would go smoothly. Everything was as it was listed. My friend and I enjoyed the AC and the wifi after a long day exploring and a concert at Coney Island.  The room itself is fairly spacious and plenty of room for two. The common area we did not use, but had easy access to the bathroom. The only issue was the walk from a nearby subway station (only half a mile away) late at night. It felt more unpleasant than during the day. So having a buddy is a good idea. Overall it was a wonderful experience and I'd suggest this host to anyone staying in the area.

Rusty's place is the best! Rusty is such a kind, helpful person.It was our first time in NY , and we were afraid about some things, but being with Rusty was so great. First, the bed is SUPER comfy. The place in general was ver nice and cozy.The bathroom and kitchen very clean.Secondly, we loved the neighborhood. The subway was easier than we thought. And Rusty always informed us about changes in the subway, and the possibility of taking the bus. Finally, we loved talking to you Rusty.You were so kind to help us finding the  stores were we needed to go. We are infinite thankful for you, because you made this trip so much better.

Since we arrived it was perfect, Rusty guided us from a distance since we were a little lost, he helped us more than he should, the bathroom was very clean, sheets and towels with a pleasant aroma, there is a lot of silence at night so we could rest peacefully, Every morning there was coffee. The surroundings are very safe, until late at night we never saw anything unpleasant or anything to worry about, there are many places to eat and do supermarket shopping, the subway station is close, very easy to get to any place you want and it is very safe and clean, we thank Rusty very much for the good treatment and making us feel so comfortable.

Our stay at Rusty’s was great! The apartment was close to a subway station which took us to the center of Manhattan in 15/20 minutes: great value for money! The area in which the apartment was located was very quiet and secure (we were 2 sisters on vacation and never had a feeling of insecurity). Even though the sofa bed we slept on was in the living room, Rusty was able to give us our privacy! He also provided very good advice to guide us through our little week in New York.  In short, we highly recommend Rusty's apartment for a stay in New York and we will happily return!!

Rusty was an excellent host. He was very responsive and communicative. He graciously allowed us to check in early, which really helped relieve stress in our travel plans. He was super friendly and gave great recommendations. I actually ended up getting food poisoning during my trip to NYC and he was extremely accommodating and kind, gave me snacks and medicine, let me use his things, etc. All in all Rusty is a REALLY great host and just a wonderful person. Would highly recommend staying with him.

It was my first experience.i was coming from Canada and i was scared to think of what i rented..ive never been to new york either..it was very clean and i was so happy when i got there...i would stay there again!!....parking is a bit hard..but we found a spot...you will be very happy with the space😀😀

I stayed in this room for many days if u dnt wanna pay too much and have the opportunity to go around and explore NYC it's is a nice room where u can sleep and there is a closet and the ac too. The neighborhood is pretty good I never felt unsafe even when came back home at 2am. There is the underground just one block away and it take around 30minutes by local. The family is friendly and Ociel replies fastly. If u don't want to have bad surprises and u are OK in what u see in photos... Then this is perfect for u.. I would recommend this place.

Great place to stay! About a 12 min walk to the subway and you pass lots of great restaurants and bars on your way. Immaculately clean house. Decorated very cute. Loved that each room had a keypad to lock. Very respectful other guests.   Shuly was a great host and was flexible on a few things I requested (check in time and baggage storage after checkout) which saved me stress and hassle. She also has two lovely cats who seem to be kept in the owners room most of the time, but I saw them when I came in late at night - they were SO friendly and sweet! Perfect for when you miss your own fur babies 🤗  Will be staying here again! Great value.

What a terrible host that I have never seen before in my life. Never go to this place, Unless If you want to experience the life-threathening things assault during your holiday. The room and toilet were dirty. Bunch of dusts on the bathroom when I wipe the floor with my bare hands.  And the bed linen is worn out with weird discoloration something looks like body fluid that I don’ t where it come from. Disgusting. This host even did not provide accurate information.  I got only 1 towel for 1 week. For 1week.  And for the last I copy and paste the original message from the host. I would stay here again! At first I got little scared of the area but then I realized that there is nothing bad there even though it’s southern part of Bronx.
