I was coming home in the evenings and nothing bad happened and it was just in my head because you know..Bronx. It’s very safe, great bus or subway connections to Manhattan. Ociel is very quick to respond to any question you have. There was an issue with beeping smoke detector and he even came to change batteries at 11pm! Also it got a little bit cold so upon my request they provided me with warmer blanket and heater which made the nights very cozy! Thank you for everything!

The surrounding area feels sketchy, but we never had any problem with it. The hosts keep the place incredibly clean, and are very responsive to any problems you might have. Both of them are very kind. I would recommend this place for the price that it’s at.

The apartment is amazing, everything is clean and nice. Victor also had a great welcome book with tips on anything and everything New York in terms of food, transport and how to use items in the apartment. The neighborhood is sketchy, and would recommend travelling with someone, but other than that, everything was awesome and very close to public transport

Victor's place is likely to be the most stylish and well-appointed place you'll ever stay - the apartment and furnishings are gorgeous, and the flat is spacious and well-equipped. The TV provision is great (Netflix etc) and the beds are comfy; the place was spotless, and Victor ensured that the access arrangements were completely stress free.  We stayed as part of a US holiday with our kids (11 and 14) and it was an excellent choice.  It's sensible to point out that the apartment is in a low-income urban area and there's a lot of street noise. But we never found the environment remotely threatening, and a lot of the activity on the street was just local families hanging out. Although there were a lot of noisy cars and music etc, we managed to sleep OK.   There's a good supermarket a short walk away, and there are lots of options for getting the metro or train into NYC. The one way traffic system is a bit perplexing at first, so if you're in a car give yourself a bit of extra time when your first arrive: it may take a few goes to get on the right bit of the street in the right direction - but once you've worked it out it's fine.   All in all, this is just a brilliant place as a base for stay in NYC. Highly recommended.

I stayed in this place with my mom, and I can say that although the neighborhood seems a little dangerous, the location is good as it is close to the metro station to be honest, the house is smaller than I expected, but very comfortable and accommodating  Thank you for the hospitality!

You were very accommodating. The place was clean and cozy. We really enjoyed staying in this diverse area. It made for an authentic Brooklyn stay and we loved it. Jenny was very flexible with our arrival which made traveling less stressful. ( our flight was substantially delayed)        The beds were comfy and everything was great. This was our first Air B & B stay and we would definitely do it again. It was a nice change from hotels. It’s a great location to catch the subway pretty much anywhere. We spent much of our time in Manhattan. This was a little further out, but we just planned on a little extra time to get where we were going.  Overall it’s a great place to stay.

We stayed at Jenny's house for a week. She is an accommodating and helpful host. Check-in and check-out were easy. The apartment is spacious and bright. There is enough space for 3 adults. The pictures shown correspond to the apartment quite well. However, during our stay in March it was very cold from the windows. The water pressure in the kitchen and bathroom made our stay a little more difficult and there was a constant smell of gas in the apartment, which wasn't dangerous, just unusual. The apartment was surprisingly loud from the windows and the stairwell - even though we are not sensitive to noise (we live in the city center ourselves). The apartment is well located; You can reach the metro towards downtown in about 5 minutes on foot, and from there it takes about 30-45 minutes. Price-performance ratio is right for New York standards.

This place was a steal! The space is large and had accommodations for everyone. The apartment was walking distance from a lot of places to eat and small stores to gather snacks. Victor communicated very quickly and offered suggestions for accommodations that were not available, like private parking. The neighborhood had great energy and made my family feel like we were from there. I definitely plan on staying again when I come back to NY.

COLD SHOWERS!!!!  The airbnb looks the same in real life as it does the pictures. It may look slightly bigger in the pictures but that didn’t matter to us.  The location also was not bad,  we never felt unsafe in the environment around the house, it’s just that the Bronx was a decent trip from all of the activities we were interested in doing in NYC.  The problem with the location resides in the things that you can’t see in the pictures. For example, there was only one roll of paper towels, no hand towels in the kitchen, and no refill rolls for after the first one was done. We did not use dishes while we were there until the day before we left, and when we opened the dishwasher, it was completely filled with stinky dishes that had been left unwashed from before we arrived. I don’t expect Airbnbs to have full cabinets and supplies for us to use, but I’ve never been to one where there wasn’t extra paper towels and only one extra trash bag.  The reason why it’s only receiving two stars is because I took the coldest shower I’ve ever taken in my life in that Airbnb. And to make it worse, when we reached out to let the owner know that the handle wouldn’t turn to reach the hot water in the shower, he basically told us we were using it incorrectly and just had to turn the knob. I think with 6 people, we’re smart enough to realize when a knob won’t turn any further. The shower was definitely broke and they never sent out a plumber or anything to fix it,  just insinuated that we weren’t smart enough to work the hot water.   Unless you plan on just using the space for a backdrop for pictures, then I would recommend finding another location with hot water.

Ryan's place is a nicely appointed 2 bedroom, very clean and with a good kitchen. Checking in was hassle-free, and Ryan and his partner were very responsive and considerate during our stay. It is relatively straightforward to travel to Manhattan from this location, with the subway a short walk away. The surrounding area within Brooklyn has good amenities; a nice grocery store and a few restaurants on a nearby street. If you are very sensitive to noise, you may want to consider ear plugs as there is a busy overpass nearby. However, NYC is a busy city and I suspect there will be a bit of noise wherever you stay. I would recommend this place to family and friends, and personally would like to stay again should I ever visit NYC in the future.

Zaher's place is brilliant, and Zaher himself is an excellent host. Although we never met, Zaher was super attentive, available and made the check-in process really easy and stress-free.  As for Zaher's place itself, my girlfriend and I genuinely considered barricading ourselves in and never leaving - it was everything we wanted from a cool, Williamsburg apartment. Great bed, great living room (such a nice TV too), a full kitchen (that we never used; not with all the great food in the area) and a cosy but very usable bathroom.   The location was just perfect as well - so many great coffee spots in quite literally a stone's throw away, great bars, great restaurants (gotta check out Fette Sau) and large supermarkets like Whole Foods just 10/15 minutes away.  We can't wait to come back!

I love this host family! This is the best memoly I've ever been in NY!! And, location is very good, safe, energisch, easy to go Manhattans. I did't scare even if after 10pm in this area.  到着が遅くなり土地勘もない中で夜10時にチェックインで少し不安でしたが、町は賑やかなアジアのような雰囲気で、とても安全でした。 また、駅から家も近いです。 ホストのベロニカさんは明るく、最高のホスト家族でした！ また会いたいです！

Albena is a very nice person and gracious host. I stayed with her for 1 month while I worked at a local hospital.  The bedroom is large and private with lots of outlets, two fans, and a small desk. Unfortunately the bedroom faces the street, where there was often loud noises (loud music, dirt bikes, lots of honking horns, etc.) one evening I went outside to ask a group of 8-10 people blasting music from a parked car to please turn it down as I had to wake up early the next morning for work. If I wasn't 6 ft 4inches tall and a male I don't know how comfortable I would have been doing that.  Albena hosts cats for people when they go on vacation. During my stay she was hosting between 3-12 cats at a given time. This was unexpected and at times it felt as if the cats ran the place. Only once did a cat sneak past my feet and get in my room. The cat litter boxes are in the hallway leading to the bedroom so there is a very unpleasant smell whenever you leave the room and sometimes the litter box pellets get on the floor.  On the topic of pets, there was also a MASSIVE cockroach infestation while I was there. Turning on the kitchen light would send literally hundreds of cockroaches scattering. Opening a cabinet would do the same or cause them to fall onto the counter. Interestingly the cats wouldn't pay any attention to the cockroaches, if anything they would scratch at your bread or cereal if you turn your back and then the cockroaches would get inside your food. I quickly started putting everything in the fridge as it seemed to be the safest place.   The bathroom is right next to the bedroom which is nice, there is space for your things. There were some cockroaches in the bathroom but not nearly as many as in the kitchen.  Despite the cockroaches, the kitchen is a bit run down. She lacks basic appliances like a microwave, coffee maker, toaster etc.  Overall this was far below the expectations that I've developed over my time using Airbnb. I think a lot of is stems from Albena's living style. She is a very nice person and gracious host, however her lifestyle, cat boarding business, and living conditions do not make for a good renting environment.

Rose is an ideal host because logistically she has everything running very smoothly, and she is nonetheless very accessible and attentive throughout the stay. Her apartment is extremely serene, comfortable, and  clean, and the neighbourhood is also great. I would definitely recommend Rose to anybody who wants a stress-free, pleasant stay in New York.

Rose's place is truly a gem in the heart of an intense city. Originally from NY, I am not suprised by much, though this place is quite unique! I found it an oasis, a safe haven to get back to at the end of the day, amidst a very scary time in history (COVID-19). The cleanliness of the apartment stood out to me as did the overall serene vibe, which was what I was looking for. As others have stated, it is quite a small place (as are others in NYC, not fair to compare to a hotel), yet Rose has utilized the space in an amazing way. I loved having so many plants around. Communication was stellar. Easy check-in and out with perfectly laid out directions. Great local recommendations (Divya is my new fave!). Should I need to travel back to NYC, I will absolutely look to stay here again.   One last note: due to 3rd floor walk up around a curved set of stairs and no elevator, it's not at all handicapped accessible (common sense). As the wife of someone who is temporarily handicapped, I feel it necessary to mention. If a non-issue for you/your family, stay here! Location is stellar!

I highly recommend LarryRaul's place.  It was clean, nicely decorated and in a great location.  We were hesitant to book because there were no reviews and we were so glad we took a chance!  LarryRaul was the perfect host, friendly, informative and hospitable in just the right way - not too much!  I wouldn't wait on booking this one because it's a steal.  Location, host and price make this a deal you don't want to miss. Highly recommend this Airbnb!

It was an amazing experience! The location is perfect; in the heart of Manhattan, near Times Square. Really good place. Larry and Raul were amazing with us: friendly and very helpfull. They gave us advices for taking the subway or for finding some good places to eat or to visit. Before I was a little bit afraid by dog in general but when I met KJ the dog of this house I felt in love with him hahaha. Really good and sympathic dog. The place is clean and comfortable. You feel very good in this place and it is really easy to be here to go everywhere. I recommend without hesitation this Airbnb. It is a really good choice. Enjoy your travel here :) !!

BOOK THIS NOW! (Or don't because you might steal dates that I want to re-book it.) My maid of honor & I just returned home a few days ago from a stay with Larry, Raul, & KJ.  It was our first time doing an airbnb with the hosts present, and I honestly cannot imagine a better experience.  The check in process was easy and flexible, as was check out.  Everything we needed was available to us and the location was prime.  So many amazing restaurants just steps away and a short walk to attractions like Times Square and Central Park.  Larry & Raul were so friendly and accommodating, but they also gave us plenty of space.  The living area of their home is very comfortable and all for you as a guest (& your new best dog friend) to enjoy at your leisure.  KJ is a sweetheart and we loved having a dog away from home.   We left our stay with a few new friends and will definitely be returning for another stay with Larry, Raul, & KJ.

Tiny room in great location with friendly, helpful host.  Branch library just around corner, shady park two doors down, large Marcus Garvey park about 10 minute walk, Jimbo's hamburgers making large, good breakfast, and less than two blocks from major subway stop; it's a good place to become acquainted with Harlem.

Joshua is a great host who made us feel very welcome. I mostly appreciated his check-in/check-out flexibility and "no stress" attitude. His place is also quite well situated, less than 5 minutes from the 125th St. metro station.

The room is exactly as described, extremely small but the bed is comfortable. The bathroom is shared but the shower is delicious. The location is good, two blocks from the metro. The neighborhood doesn't seem to be the safest, when leaving the metro I felt a little scared, however, the building is next to the police station. Joshua always responds quickly and was very helpful. Good choice for those who need to choose a good price at the last minute.

Josh is an incredible host and most importantly, a genuine person--definitely the best Airbnb host I've ever had (having a handful). You can expect consistent and reliable communication,  good local recommendations, check-ins to ensure your stay is comfortable and safe, and honest conversations.   Prior to being in East Harlem, I heard it was dangerous, but it was fine. Just like any new area you haven't been to, make sure you are conscious and not disruptive in public.  The room and space was what you see in the photos; expected. It can be a tight space, but it worked out well for us.

This small room is not for long term stay, only few days. You enter the room and just lay on the bed.  Smell was terrible in the room and in whole apartment. I opened all the windows. Had to sleep with open windows cause of smell but it was very noisy. All the time sirens and reconstruction in front of my window that starts at 6 am working days. Even if you close the window the noises will wake you up at 6am.  The area was very dirty with terrible smell and full of homeless or addicted people.  Nobody cleans the apartment, only roommates clean after themselves. Roommates were very good and kind, 2 Afro American men.  There’s no place for your clothes, except small shelf and the closet in the kitchen which is also smells terrible and full of clothes. As Joshua said I can put my clothes there.  I informed Joshua 16 days before that I wanted to leave 1 week earlier. He said ok and asked would I leave positive review. I was so happy that I can leave even for 1 week earlier. And I thought he’ll give me back money for the last week and I’ll leave positive review cause I was thankful for letting me leave a week earlier. I informed 23 of august and was going to leave on 8th of September. But he said no refund, and he thought that I was just asking permission to leave cause I didn’t mention about money. That’s so stupid.  I called Airbnb and canceled my reservation and finally he agreed to refund only half week. And I already left on 5th instead of 15th.  If you are going to stay long time, after 1 week you’ll be fed up. Even if you absent all day. I worked from 10am to 10pm. I wanted to come and relax feel at home, but it was better to stay at work.

Winnie and Andy's place is an absolute steal for the price. The room has A/C, insanely comfy beds, and it's own private entrance. The shared bathroom is spotless. On top of this, Winnie and Andy are absolutely wonderful hosts. It was my first time using Airbnb, and they made the process easy with quick responses. The ONLY bad thing I can say about the place is its location. It's roughly a 45 minute to an hour subway ride from Manhattan and I definitely wouldn't have felt safe in the area if I was a woman. With these things considered, I would give it a 9/10 and I will definitely stay there if I visit again.

Excellent Airbnb and excellent host!  Precise, responsive, attentive, everything you could hope for! I was quite stressed that it was a scam but we communicated a lot before my arrival, which reassured me a lot! The room is very pleasant and regarding the location, it is perfect! Right next to a metro line that connects the center in 15-20 minutes! The neighborhood itself is very nice, there are places to go shopping, pretty graffiti… I 100% recommend!

What a steal. I liked this apartment even more than I thought I would. It's so reasonable for price in NYC and the location is great. Great vibe in the neighborhood. The apartment was also surprisingly large- much bigger than I had anticipated.  Our family had plenty of room, which was particularly surprising given how reasonable the room price was.   One thing people should know is that this is like the antithesis of a NYC Times Square vacation. One of the things I love about Airbnb is that I get to feel like I get some approximation of the lived experience of people who actually live there and I got that from this. The neighborhood was interesting, dynamic, and off the beaten track. As others have noted, it's a bit of a hike to the nearest subways- which I actually liked. We still did the Statue of Liberty, the Met, and a show in Times Square but the rest of the time we felt that we were living kind of how people in the city do- or people who are fortunate to live in funky stylish llittle areas of the city.   Marie is super friendly and accommodating.   We were there on the weekend and got off-street parking and so that was free- which was an amazing deal.   I liked the mini pool table- it was an interesting touch but I think I would have preferred a dining room table to eat at in its place.   The apartment is such a great deal for the city and I highly recommend it. Great way to explore the city and to feel a little like  a local.

My husband and I booked this place on a whim for an NYC trip. The home is close to the 7 train that runs all the time. It’s a half mile walk, and there’s an hourly run bus stop literally steps outside the door. The area seemed safe to us during the day, but we were home by 9:30 every night. There was a crime incident nearby on our last night that occurred at 11:30 pm, but I think that’s uncharacteristic for the area.  The room was actually very cozy. The light coming in from the window was gorgeous, and the room was a great size. The only complaint I had was noise from the heater, but I’m a very light sleeper, and I think Nulifer May have lowered its usage at night after I brought it up with her, as I heard it a lot less frequently after that!  Our sweet hostess made us cake one day and went out of her way to be accommodating and available for us. I would definitely book with her again and absolutely recommend her. This room was top notch as well.

I am happy I chose to stay at Nilufer’s place. I was a bit worried it might be dangerous area but it was a quite safe neighborhood.  It was super easy and fast to reach Manhattan from the house. The house and the room was very clean, the bathroom indeed. I usually have a hard time using the bathroom if it is not clean, small or unconventional but it was perfect. When I arrived the house Nilufer met me at the gate and also offered some food. She is a quite lovely host and It was a pleasure to meet her. I would definetely love to stay at her place again, thanks Nilufer!

The room was smaller and less stylish than it looked in the photo. It is in the basement, which is on the same level as the garden. The bathroom is directly opposite, small, but everything is there.  You shouldn't expect a high standard, the photo makes you expect more. But the room was clean, the bed was comfortable, and the neighborhood was totally pleasant. We never felt unsafe, even late at night!  Nilufer and her husband were super friendly, very welcoming and we spent a very nice evening with family and friends.   Questions were always answered super quickly, even late arrivals were no problem, a clear recommendation!  Hosts super friendly, feel at home, neighborhood absolutely safe, even late night walking and subway. Bus around the corner, cake as a greeter, we'd come back anytime!

To preface, I stayed at this Airbnb for 2 months. I started a job in the city and needed a moderately long-term place to stay. I debated between a shared room vs. private room, and ultimately decided upon here due to it fitting my budget and having good reviews.   Pros: - Fantastic location in a safe neighborhood. I’m a cis male, but I never felt unsafe or witnessed any third party acts of hatred / crime in this neighborhood or nearby places (restaurants in the area, grocery stores, laundromats).  - Down to earth hosts. I’m always wary of slimy brokers, landlords, and hosts. These are real people. They are kind and understanding.   - Kitchen. Local markets are pretty cheap (if you shop at the right spots) and I easily lived spending less than $30 a week for groceries, cooking myself 3 meals a day (with intent to be frugal).  - location. Close to a 7 line subway station and grocery stores, which is mainly where I’d go   Cons: - bathroom has relatively short ceilings. May want to visit in person or avoid if you’re 5’11” or taller (for reference, I’m 5’8” and felt like I maybe had an inch or two before it may have been a bit small) - no A/C. Maybe not a big deal for other months but I stayed here during the summer, and it was rough without it. Still livable (basement floor), but a test of endurance - 7 train can be unreliable. This was during the COVID-19 pandemic, so subway lines weren’t running their “normal” schedules, but there were often delays, repairs, and maintenance on the 7 train in particular. But it’s MTA, so it’s kinda to be expected   All in all, I would absolutely recommend this place to stay for anyone trying to stretch their dollar and live in a long term (more than two weeks) stay in nyc. All housemates I’ve dealt with have been nice and relatively clean. The value, location, and hosts are unbeatable.  It is not a 5 star hotel (nor does it advertise itself being one) but the value it gives is, to me, unbeatable.

If you're thinking about booking this spot, do not hesitate.  Photos are incredibly accurate and  true to the actual property.  No issues with anything inside the unit and all the amenities at our disposal were functioning and enjoyable.  The neighborhood might be less than savory for some but its NYC.  I didn't feel unsafe at any point but if you're looking to take a pleasant stroll in the evening, Bed Stuy probably isn't your neighborhood in the first place.  Location was very convenient to a train stop which made hopping around the city very easy.

besides the undisclosed cat and my boyfriend’s resulting allergic reaction, we had a nice stay.  location is convenient, movie theater set up was a great consolation to bars/restaurants being closed because of covid, and the steam room shower combo was wonderful.  definitely feels like a local’s stay, just wish we didn’t have the stress/disappointment of the building smelling like cat pee, being woken up in the middle of the night by meows/scratching at the door, and my boyfriend not being able to breathe.

Place was nice. Nicely renovated bathroom, especially for New York's standards. Entertainment systems were good quality. Entrance was in the bedroom, which was odd to me, but it's also Brooklyn NY; overall a good apartment. I felt like the hosts were kind of weird, they requested a picture of me when booking the reservation. Airbnb requires enough identification to identify/charge guests given hosts have any issues with guests, so sending a picture so they felt better about letting me stay there was creepy. No need for that. I've been using Airbnb as a guest for years and recently became a host for one of my properties in another state; can't see why requiring a selfie is justified. Nonetheless I sent it lol not worth a fight but definitely  worth complaining about.

Leah’s place was lovely however the location and process were far from ideal. Master bedroom mattress was amazing! WiFi password was not provided, nor building security number. The check in process was flawed because the building tenants are not allowed use Airbnb. The location is directly next to the New York projects. Even though Leah said the area was safe, the fire department 1 block away said it was not safe to walk around at night. We walked back from Whole Foods and felt incredibly unsafe as we walked through the project buildings. Lastly host was unavailable frequently which made communication difficult.

Due to flight cancellations I last minute needed somewhere to stay an extra night in New York and I had a very early flight. Louise’s place was exactly what I needed- comfy, clean, cozy, quiet, & MINUTES from the airport. Staying there turned a stressful experience into relaxing night to myself that was a perfect end to the two weeks I’d just spent in the bustle NYC

If u want a place we’re the rules are u absolutely can’t do anything.. Enjoy. Host has entirely too many rules. U have to whisper after 10pm, Minutes after being there host was complaining about loud talking. You can’t even step outside to smoke a cigarette. 30 degrees outside the night I was there & host expects u to walk & wonder a neighbor u don’t know to not smoke on the property. It was just very uncomfortable for 100$ a night. I stood in the room ten mins and asked host to cancel which she could WITH NO PENALTY but she rather give me the run around to keep my money knowing I wasn’t staying in that creepy room where she mysteriously is in the house listening to what your doing. Never again. This was my very first time trying Airbnb & this host may of made it my last. Not sure yet.
Louise was very quick to respond to my messages, and the apartment was very clean and comfortable! Being so close to JFK also made my travel plans so much less stressful. Thank you Louise!

We loved our one-week stay here. We were a group of four adults and four kids (ages 5-7). The kids loved staying together in the room with the bunk beds and double beds. The living area and adjoining room, deck, and separate bedroom areas all provided plenty of space for us to hang out together or separately when we needed private space. We enjoyed using the grill and eating on the deck in the evenings - our own beach umbrella fit right into the picnic table to provide some shade, which was great. The supermarket is closeby, and we made many trips and prepared most meals at home. We could find almost everything we needed in the kitchen (would recommend adding some oven mitts, if possible).   The kids loved the movie screen and projector for group movie nights - so did the adults! Took about 15 minutes to walk to the beach with the little ones and a wagon full of supplies. We also walked to the 90s for ice cream a few times, and that was a reasonable distance as well. Overall, the bungalow was bright and airy, and the breeze in the evening kept us cool with the windows open and ceiling fans. We highly recommend this home for the space itself, the location, and Joe's hospitality.

Nicely furnished home just like the pictures, the owners live upstairs but you have your own entrance. Quite spacious (would stay with 2 max tho) and has all the stuff you need for a couple of days or as we did for 10 days. Subway is 5 minutes walking and Manhattan is 25-35 minutes in the subway. In the direct neighborhood are a couple  of shops and places to eat. We went to  cocoa grinders every day for coffee on the way to the subway. At night the vibe on the street changes a bit, but we did not feel unsafe as everybody minds their own business. All in all a very good place to explore New York sleeping in a more residential non touristy neighborhood.

I loved staying in Shuly’s house — the entire house was spotless, there was AC, it was close to LGA and the subway, the beds were comfy, and it’s a great value. I originally was only going to stay for one night, but then my flight got unexpectedly cancelled, so she worked with me to let me stay in another room she had available in the same house, even though navigating the app was a little confusing and stressful. I don’t think many hosts would go out of their way to do that, so Shuly is something special! She helped me avoid the headache of having to find a completely different Airbnb to stay in for that night. Both of the rooms I stayed in were clean and comfortable and the entire house is huge and so beautiful. I absolutely recommend staying here!

Lavonne's place was better then expected. For the price and location it was a steal! They would offer ride and directions when we needed help getting around. Her and her family are so thoughtful with everything they do. Will definitely be coming back during the next time we come to New York!!!!

Fantastic place!  Exactly as pictured.  Private space, safe neighborhood and well equipped.  Hosts very responsive.    The patio has shade and a nice breeze most of the day.  Full size washer, dryer and dishwasher, comfy bed and good water pressure in the shower.  Would definitely stay here again.

What a wonderful place to stay! I spent a week here visiting family and working from a home away from home, and it was perfect in every way. Great location (not just for me, but for walking around in Brooklyn and easy access to downtown.) Easy street parking (I could always find a place within a couple of blocks, often closer and sometimes right in front, and except for Thursday/Friday street sweeping I didn't have to keep running out to move the car.) Lovely space that was comfortable and gracious, and despite spending a lot of time inside, it always felt roomy. The kitchen was quite well equipped and enjoyable to use. The balcony was a huge plus and a great place to exercise, with direct sun in the mornings and shade in the afternoons. Check in/out was easy and the house manual was clear and thorough. This will always be my first choice place to stay in this area!

This apartment is beautiful and super cozy - not cozy as in “small” because in terms of nyc apartments it’s a steal for the price. Kristin was very kind, quick to answer any questions, offered some great neighborhood suggestions and even checked in to see how my stay was going. The neighborhood is great-easy walking distance to cafes, restaurants, bars and trains-and is also just a nice pretty area to stroll through. The space has pretty much anything you would ever need with helpful notes throughout the apartment, even phone chargers for guests to use! Kristin has obviously taken the time to think about her guests with all the accommodating touches around the place. All in all this place is perfection and I just hope it’s available the next time I come to the city!
This SPOT IS a steal

Pros:  Place is fully equipped!  What you see on pictures is exactly what you get!  Jacuzzi Tub! Private entry! Bed is super comfortable! Wifi and cable Flexible check in/out Host was nice and super helpful! Neighborhood is safe and quiet  Street Parking was easy to find!    CONS: Its Basement, only a door separates owners house its like they are upstairs and you are downstairs! They can come in at any given moment!  Had to let the mother in through our entrance multiple times! (Very uncomfortable)  Freezing cold inside house!  Some ppl came to do maintenance work that was supposed to take an hour ended up taking 4 hours, i couldn’t shower in peace for it being some random men in our area!  Not a lot of privacy considering my whole stay i had someone in our space!  Ppl upstairs very very noisy! Sounds like rollerblading on hardwood at 4am!   Overall wouldn’t be my first choice to stay again. The place itself is great and i think the host is very nice and sweet but the experience wasn’t great! To be in a basement and have a person banging dramatically on the door late at night where you cant see anything is a bit scary. Not once but twice on 2 different days! 🥺 The host did apologize when i expressed my concerns. This may not be something that happens regularly but id thought id share my experience!

Hi Lavonne, I first want to say thank you for being accommodating upon my arrival. However , after a long road trip me and my friends were very unsatisfied with our stay. We saw multiple coach roaches in the home who were not afraid of us at all. One of the roaches were in one my friends purse. They were crawling all around the kitchen and bathroom. As if this was not bad enough , while we were sleeping on our last night , your mom rudely kept banging on the door and when I opened it brushed in totally invading our space. Asking us what we were doing when clearly we were all clearly sleeping. She kept banging on the upstairs stores for you to open and forced me to call you after I told her she needed to leave. And kept cussing. This is the reason for my low rating.

-We arrived, the toilet didn't flush.  -The bathroom is very old.  -superficial cleaning -Apartment poorly insulated, you hear everything, you have to speak quietly and walk slowly.  - strong smells of cannabis rising through the heaters.  -The owner is not accommodating, we wanted to leave our suitcases for a few extra hours because our flight was late in the evening, she refused. I am very disappointed with this rental and especially with the cleaning which was superficial

Krystal and her parents were super accommodating and friendly. They made my stay in Staten Island much more enjoyable and stress-free. They were always available by phone and/or in person. The unit is exactly as described with no concerns of cleanliness. I am very grateful for their hospitality and appraochability throughout my stay!

That was the best Airbnb experience. Her place was cozy clean and comfortable.  Parking was a little sketchy sometimes. But that comes with city living.  But overall she gets 5 stars.  She was a fabulous host.

Sky is the most amazing host I’ve met in the near past. He is very helpful and replied to all my questions (and there were quite a few) within minutes. We could rely on him. The apartment is nice, it can easily accommodate 3 people. The neighborhood seemed a bit scary for the first glance, though, but as soon as the second day it turned out to be only our prejudice (however it is not the most quiet neighborhood) The place is about a 30 minutes subway ride from Manhattan, so it’s really convenient.

it is a great location and close to the subway. the apt is cozy except for the little critters(roaches), which is pretty typical in nyc i guess but bring some roach motels for sure, they're creepy. theres is no t.v. so if you need entertainment of that sort bring a laptop.

The price reflects what you get. There are loud noises into the late hours of the night (buses, bachata, you name it), every morning the neighbors cooking wafts in (and it doesn’t smell like a 4 star restaurant if you know what I mean), and to top it off the wall outlet electrocuted my charger (which is now burnt). However, it was cheap and close to the subway. So if you can overlook those other things and aren’t afraid of being in a cultured part of town, this apartment is for you.

This was the worst experience in my life the apartment was disgusting there was urine all over every bed it was open condoms on the side of the mattresses there was drug leaves on the side of the mattress is bandannas the sink was disgusting the dishes were disgusting everything was just disgusting

Lovely place tucked in a residential area and great value for money. Nothing fancy around and all the good places are far. Book only if you don’t have anything else happening. It’s a little scary to walk outside at night time for me if you’re alone. If you’re indoors it’s safe.

The accommodation is excellent. Very spacious and one and a half blocks from the subway. The area may seem unsafe to someone who is used to staying in Manhattan.  The reality is that nothing bad happened and the price difference justifies it. I recommend it.

Very nice and spacious place.  It is close to the subway, groceries, pharmacy and other stores. We saw some people loitering around the area but Kelly assured me that they are just homeless people and not dangerous . Kelly is a wonderful host, very helpful, communicate and knowledgeable of the area.  I would recommend Kelly's place and happily stay again.

It was a wonderful stay at his place. All the things were amazing. The only reason I am putting it on 4 star is the location of this airbnb. The neighbourhood felt kinda sketchy plus its right by the subway so you have to hear the noise of subway everytime it pass. But otherwise its a perfect stay!

It’s the cheapest in NYC and Brooklyn so don’t expect too much. It was doable but the bed wasn’t very comfy, neighborhood pretty sketchy, especially when you’re a woman. I was lucky I’ve been here with my boyfriend so I felt kinda “safe”. During the day is a lot better then during the night obviously. Wasn’t as clean as it looked in the pictures either. All in all really just an OK. Sorry Lou, you’ve been very friendly so there a big plus!

Perfect accommodation in a very good area and not dangerous. Very good stay, with air conditioning in the rooms, a multitude of details from Cassia (Netflix, bicycle, terrace, museum passes, etc...) and very good cleaning. Metro 10 minutes walk. EXCELLENT STAY.

Luis is a host who responds very quickly to message! We were out of toilet paper and Luis was there within 30 mins. We also requested hand towels and Luis had them stocked speedily!  The location of this airbnb is within walking distance to a number of metro stations. It was very convenient to travel to and from. Lots of great food places nearby, and there's a McD on the corner is 24h if you need late night grub. We also had a Duane Reade on another corner for amenities.  The place is very plain and no frills. Housemates are quiet and you barely see them. I would recommend if you plan to use the metro a lot to explore the city! Area also seemed safe (no sketchy figures) and within walking distance of Penn Station (like 5 mins away) and Times Square (20min walk).  Lots of flower shops on that street so you wake up, go out and get refreshed within minutes. I was very tempted to buy flowers to bring back to the apartment. It was like a garden stroll sometimes.  I would recommend this place and I would be willing to stay here again.

The apartment is very clean, beautiful and comfortable. Stacy and Simon are super friendly and attentive to their guests. On the days I was staying, all guests complied with the rules (which are few and minimal) for a great shared environment.  Although the apartment is far from Manhattan, it is very close to the subway, so I didn't find it dangerous even when returning home at night/early morning. I highly recommend staying in this apartment, the value for money is extremely good in my opinion.

I seldom use airbnb but due to Covid-19 I was forced to find temporary accomodations on short notice. I LOVED staying at 88 Autumn. It was convenient transportationwise for getting to the city. The hosts were extremely friendly and compassionate with me extending my stay on short notice due to personal difficulties. Checking in was easy.   The space is beautiful, clean, and well lit. This was a very stressful time period and 88 Autumn was an oasis of peace and calm for me.  I don't think I can adequately express how much I enjoyed my stay. Simon and Stacy are wonderful hosts.

Ronald is a fraud and a thief. He let me book the room and did not respond to multiple attempts to contact him. I could not get in or even see the room, yet alone stay there. I had to book another room for the night. I then contacted Airbnb for a refund, and get this - Ronald straight up lied to them and said that I stayed at his place! He is a FRAUD. Even if this apartment exists and he lets you in, are you going to be comfortable sleeping in the same apartment as a guy like that?

My flight was delayed by the airline (I arrived at 12:30am- 3hrs later than planned). I notified Ronald to confirm this was ok 2 days prior to my arrival and he confirmed my arrival at anytime was ok. I asked for check-in instructions but never received any and there was none on the listing and I was unable to follow up him up as I was on a plane. When I arrived, there was still no response so I messaged Ronald by air bnb messaging, text and called multiple times but his phone message bank was full. I arrived to the apartment and had to look through the names on the apartment buzzer and rang several times with no answer and I waited on the street with multiple people on drugs wandering around and approaching me. I ended up calling 5 hotels to try and find an available room and got a message from Ronald an hour later to say he misplaced his phone. I cancelled my booking with Ronald and will stay at the hotel for the duration of my stay due to the unreliability of being stuck outside again.  I would like a refund of service fee plus first nights accomodation as I have lost money from taxi + new hotel booking at late notice.

Melissa is easy going and easy to communicate. Her apartment is clean and cozy.   Location is excellent,  Upper East side is more safer than west side and lower side,   even walking on the street at night, still feel safe.  Many restaurants nearby.  The transportation is convenient. Before I came, I was a little afraid to take the subway, especially the #2 and #3 line. Later, I found that the Q line  near the apartment is extremely safe, and I can go to Brooklyn and Penn station transit to another city, which is very convenient for my trip.  Bus M15 is also a good option going down to south , the bus stop only 2 mins walk from the apartment.   Highly recommended !

We stayed at Bushwick to go to Williamsburg. The house of Armando was wider than the picture. We didn't adjust to jet lag, so we went around a lot at night, I liked the restaurant, bar, and supermarket at the late hour. Many people lives in Bushwick.  There are many interesting shops, too. Though careful, it is not a dangerous town. There is a small bookstore in front of the house, and it is always full of cool people. Armando is very kind. Thank you for the kindness of Armando and I highly recommend the Armando’s room and Bushwick.
This is a very nice location—never felt unsafe even though I was traveling alone. The room is comfortable and I always felt like my privacy was respected. Maggie is a lovely, positive host.

WHAT AN AMAZING PLACE! To be honest, when I first started searching for a place to stay I was a little bit scared because I was looking for a long stay (2 months) and  I wanted a place close to Manhattan that would stick to my budget. Then I found Nilufer's house and felt like it was a good option. From the beginning I could tell they were that kind of people that you can build a special bond with. First of all, my flight was delayed and I couldn't make it home at the time I was supposed to, they didn't hesitate and waited for me to arrive. She would fix a delicious cake every once in a while for us to have. The house looks just like the pictures and she keeps the common areas clean and neat. She will always ask if everything is ok or if you need anything at all. THEY EVEN FIXED SUPPER WITH THE WHOLE FAMILY ONE NIGHT!!! Seriously, this house is highly recommended, either long or short stays, it will feel like your home in the City.

Great cozy little place near several markets and a subway station. Area is nice, but can get a little sketchy after 11pm. The place itself felt very clean and taken care of. The only troubles  we ran into was a couple unwelcome bugs and the internet wasnt strong enough to stream anything on our devices, but the TV options are pretty great so it wasnt bad. Walls are a bit thin and we could hear the neighbors, but we really only used the place for sleeping so it wasnt ever an issue. All in all, its a great place for exactly what we needed for exploring the city!

The place is small, but it has everything you need, from kitchen supplies to toilet paper. It's pretty clean. Radhames is a very helpful host, when we got there the code for the front door wasn't working and he fixed it immediately, he also takes no time answer emails. The neighborhood is nice, and we didn't feel in danger at all coming back late at night. It is very easy to get to Manhattan with the subway, the only problem is that it is a bit far, it takes more than an hour to get there. I would definitely stay again

I do not recommend this listing for anyone to stay. I chose this accommodation because the price seemed economical for a studio apartment, however be aware that the apartment is not clean. There is mold and rust in the bathroom, dust and hair in the bed area. Rust and dust on the fan/AC unit. Also the outside appearance of the building is run down, sketchy looking -not welcoming at all. The neighborhood isn’t the safest so be careful if traveling alone or new to NYC.

The place was exactly as announced and just a few blocks to the train, which was great.  The host was very nice and attentive, always answering quickly to all of our messages and helping when we needed. The front door neighbours were a bit noisy sometimes, even once having a fight late at night that woke us up afraid something had happened.  Overall, it was a good experience and a place to spend the month. I recommend it for people wanting something simple but good.

This is a great place to stay but there are some pros and cons   Pros  Near train stations  Near a lot of food shops Laundromat close by  One fried chicken spot is open til 5am for the late night munchies   Con Bathroom is tight not for the plus size individual  Two dogs next door will scare you if not a dog lover  Air conditioner in window was a bit annoying just because when I stayed it was winter and cold air was coming in   but in all a great spot and the owner is very quick to respond to issues

The room was clean and orderly as well as the common area. There was AC in the room, which was greatly appreciated! There is room in the common area to store some refrigerated goods and a few dry goods. The apartment is easy to find from Subway A, C, or 4 (about a 10 minute walk). Quite a few little local places to eat or grocery shop within a 10 minute walk, as well. The neighbors we courteous and we never felt unsafe

Nice accommodation in a somewhat wild area. But we didn't experience it as unsafe or dangerous. The subway is not far away, there are also supermarkets, but not so much nice delis or restaurants. The price/performance ratio of this accommodation was great, Jessica was also super nice, friendly and helpful. Since the apartment is rented out entirely to guests, you can also talk to others. Still, I would personally stay closer to Prospect Park or Bushwick next time.

The building is very old and has lots of graffiti on it. The stairwell is creepy and the light gets dimmer as you get up. You can also hear everything in terms of footsteps. Also the skylight is also the rooftop patio so beware of people looking at you when you wake up

Small apartment as specified in the ad, but very functional. The apartment is located in Brooklyn on the edge of Queens, in an area with restaurants, supermarkets... very well served (metro, bus...). I left with my sister, the area posed no problems for us during the day, but we were a little afraid to return at night (after midnight). Before, there was no problem. Despite everything, I highly recommend Rhadames' apartment who was very responsive and discreet during our stay. Thank you very much, and we look forward to coming back.
Redhames's place was definitely a steal. Small (as expected) but had everything I needed. He responded to my messages quickly and I was able to check-in/check-out seamlessly. Thanks for a great stay!

5 Star all round. Location is near everything you need. The room has all the essentials even down to food seasonings and cooking oil. The room was clean, well equipped and is much bigger and spacious in real life. Area isn't noisy or dangerous and subway stations are within walking distance that can take you straight to Manhattan.  The host left all instructions (wifi password, his own number and general info) clearly printed on a paper in the room when you arrive as well as a clear welcome email with all general information. If you are looking for something affordable with great value  and only a 10-15minute drive from JFK airport then this is the spot.   Would highly recommend.

Stayed there for 4 nights. Studio is acceptably clean, there is air conditioning and a small kitchenette for the essentials. Supermarkets are a 5-minute walk away, as is the “Cypress Hills” subway station.  It usually takes almost 1 hour to get to the center (including travel time). Totally ok for us.  Neighborhoods are mixed, louder during the day and generally quieter in the evenings.  Homeless/drug users are common in the NY suburbs. We had no negative contacts and felt safe.  If you want to stay cheaply and well connected in New York, you're in good hands here.   Have fun on the trip (C+S/29+31J)

Perfect owner. We were delayed in our flight and Mary was responsive and found a solution so that we could still get the keys. The apartment is a real luxury in this city. Better than a hotel and much cheaper. The metro is just over 5 minutes away on foot and everything is available to eat near the apartment. It was our first and we had a great trip, especially thanks to this accommodation!!

This was my first Air BnB experience and it was a success. My gf and I came down to the city for my birthday weekend and Monica did an excellent job of accommodating us. Upon arrival we were in dire need of some solid NYC pizza and she recommended a local spot. It was on point and one of the best white pizzas I’ve had in a long time. My gf is not from NY and it blew her mind. Monica text us the following morning to make sure we had everything we needed and told of us of some great local clubs and bars. She made the first experience very enjoyable, she was available when needed but gave us our privacy. The bnb was a warm cozy spot much like the ad, it fit our needs perfectly. Best part of the bnb was it’s proximity to a metro station. We parked our car all weekend and took the 5 min walk to the station for all of our travel needs. Many people are often weary of the BX but not once did we feel unsafe or in harms way. The neighbor hood was perfect. Thanks again Monica for a great first experience!

Monica’s studio was great. Perfect location in the Bronx.. a minutes walk from the 6 subway station which can get you into all the main tourist parts (e.g. Manhattan) quite easily. There are all kind of shops near the apartment, some open 24/7; The area did not feel unsafe at all, of course like everywhere you go in the world just be careful and don’t go places you’re not supposed to! Couldn’t put it any more simple than that. People shy away from apartments in the Bronx because of what they hear about it but honestly I’ve never felt so comfortable anywhere else in New York City and I’ve been a few times now.  The place was perfect for 1 or 2 people sharing. It is connected to Monica’s house (the basement) but you have a private entrance and if you don’t need Monica she will not bother you. We only met twice in 2 weeks but she was always welcoming, helpful and only a text away with very quick responses. Upon arrival it was very clean, the Fridge was stocked which was a nice touch and the apartment was way better than I expected. The bed was very comfortable too and the TV was very useful as it has a Netflix account linked to it.  if I had to say anything negative just bare in mind there’s a slight drainage smell sometimes after a shower, and If you are easily bothered by noise at times you can hear monica and her family upstairs as she has 2 young kids but nothing too bad. And there is no bathroom sink!! All in all my favourite stay so far in New York and I will definitely want to stay here again. Value for money is what got me here!

Scary Experience: I let myself in late at night, after going to a Mets baseball game, according to instructions of the host.  The host later clamed I’d been in the wrong room for this one night stay.  I would have had no way of knowing this when I entered because the room fit the basic description.  The living room I had to maneuver through, which connected to a couple bedrooms, had been left pitch dark.  So even if it had been the wrong room, this was primarily the fault of the host.  The directions should have been more clear if it was going to be completely dark.  I couldn’t find a light in the apartment.  The host knew I was going to be coming in late. It was totally quiet in the house and I fell asleep.  Much later, however, I was woken up by loud banging, yelling and someone trying to enter my room.  I had earlier tried to lock the door to the bedroom both with handle lock and the door chain, but apparently the handle lock didn’t work and it was only the door chain that was preventing the person from coming in my room, without warning and without asking for permission in the middle of the night!  They were slamming the door open back and forth, as far as the little chain connected to the wall would allow it to go!   Startled and confused, but still groggy from having just been woken up, I stumbled over towards the door.  I hadn’t met the host, so I didn’t know who this person trying to push open my door was or if they were just some random intruder.  In fact, I still don’t know who the person was, and I don’t think it was the host.  The person didn’t even identify themselves, and I could hardly understand what they were trying to tell me in the broken English being spoken, other than that they wanted me to open the door.   Obviously, for safety reasons, I wasn’t going to open the door for some unknown person who seemed agitated and was acting like a maniac. This place was not in the best neighborhood anyways.  I didn’t even turn the light on in the bedroom.  They returned a short time later with another brief period of banging and yelling.  I still couldn’t make out what they were saying, but was determined to wait silently until morning when it was light outside and seemed safe to quickly leave.  Of course, even if I’d been at fault and accidentally gone into the wrong room, the response should not have been to angrily take some retaliatory action towards the guest.  It’s not as if someone was politely knocking on the door and trying to inform me there might be a problem.  The actions taken, whether it was by the host themselves or just directed by the host, seemed as though they were intended to terrify a guest staying in a private room.

This place is so cute and WHAT A GREAT LOCATION! It's close to so many great restaurants, drugs stores and just 3 min walk to the 14th St. station. Elizabeth was very responsive and a great host. The apartment building is clean, and cozy and ...did I mention what an awesome location this is??
Building is scary and unsafe. Host made false accusations to get more money.

Ashley’s loft is amazing! It’s so gorgeous and squeaky clean. She was very communicative and answered any and all questions I had quickly and with kindness. She’s also very thorough with her directions and check-in procedure which was great; both check-in & check-out were easy and stress free. We had an absolutely perfect stay there. This was a fantastic find! Thank you Ashley for making this such a wonderful visit.

This has to be the quietest, most comfy NYC apartment ever! Located on the first floor & a short walk to the R train, this place is definitely a New York feel without the hustle and bustle. If you are looking for quiet and to mosey around, this is your place. If you are looking to get into manhattan regularly and be a part of the city life it might not be. It took us anywhere from 40min-1.5hrs to get into the city one way! The neighbors were polite and never did we feel unsafe. The only thing that I didn’t like, was that the neighbor upstairs walked super heavy and was pretty loud, but hey, that’s apartment living! The washer and dryer was a plus and the shower..... omg.... the shower... AMAZING!

Natalia's place is super cute and exactly as per pictures. The area is quiet. There is about a 20min walk to the train station but then you are quite fast into Manathan. Natalia was super accomodating when our flight was cancelled and answered questions straight away which in this stressful time was appreciated. Would definitely book this accommodation again.

The apartment is very well located in Fort Greene and easy access to all of Brooklyn and Manhattan (less than 2 blocks from the Clinton stop on the A C train). The bed is very comfortable and the kitchen is well equipped and beautiful. There is also a lovely outdoor patio. Communication with the hosts is prompt and they were amenable to a late check-out. We had a confusing back and forth correspondence about my adding a 2nd guest that was unfortunately a minor stress during my stay.  Otherwise, I enjoyed my stay very much.

My friend and I chose this location because we needed separate bedrooms. The day we arrived it was 92 degrees in Brooklyn - and probably 85 degrees in the apartment. Nowhere in the description did Katie mention that the apartment was not air conditioned and that only 2 windows could be opened. There was one small window air conditioner in one bedroom which barely cooled that room but had no effect whatsoever for the rest of the apartment. My friend and I were forced us to share  the bed which was very uncomfortable for both of us. The other rooms were unbearably hot so we essentially slept, ate, and planned our days in one room.   There were other problems like no toilet paper when we arrived, only one washcloth for 2 people, no coffee, no ice cube trays to even make ice for a cold drink, a torn pillow case on one bed, and an electrical outlet that did not function properly and is unsafe. We booked 4 nights; on the second night we came home at midnight to find out that there was no water in the  shower. We booked a hotel and left the next morning.   We were extremely disappointed in this accommodation: basic amenities like toilet paper, ice cube trays etc need to be there and Katie needs to be upfront on her site that this 4th floor walk-up is NOT air conditioned!  People should also know that there is only one entrance/exit to the apartment.  On a 4th floor that could be a serious situation should you have to evacuate the building quickly.  August, 2018

At the very beginning I would like to mention positive side such as location- it was close to subway good link to other parts of NYC. Check in was quick and fuss free!   Apart from this two facts we got pretty much disappointed, and probably won’t come back to Dora’s apartment and choose another AirBnb or hotel over it.   When we arrived the apartment was unfortunately not very clean, floor was sticky, microwave, oven, fridge weren’t clean- also cutlery, glasses, plates weren’t clean. In oven I found dirty, greasy oven tray. Appliances were dusty.  Gas hob was dusty, and greasy as well. Sofa/ couch has crumbs on and under pillows. TV Stand has been not fully straight to wall. Bedding didn’t smell like freshly changed- it smelled like someone sleep on it before us-  carpet in bedroom wasn’t vacuumed- neither the floor. In bathroom; toilet, mirror, and sink hasn’t been cleaned- there were hairs on toilet and sink(they were black so for sure not ours as we both has fair hair)  mirror has got toothpaste and water marks on it, lampshades and extractor were very much dusty. Shower was ok- it needed rinsing before use tho.- no one really check it before our arrival if it meet basic cleanliness standards.   We would like also to mention missing light in bathroom over the shower.   Host didn’t really care about us- didn’t check if everything is ok at any point until we sent a message with information we’re gonna check out early because early flight.  Fridge doors are unable to fully open as well as oven doors.- they’re way too close to wall/ furniture.   Front doors were catching the floor when Opening. Missing screws in plug holders, some plug sockets were pretty dangerous- as pushed in at odd angle.   Bed was pretty much uncomfortable we can say it was very firm like a rock. And we just got thin blanket/ sheets  when outside one night was about 10 Celsius degrees.   Apartment is actually a basement, all steps and voices as well as washing machine were easy to hear- very thin walls.   We’re really sad we got that much inconveniences  at our first Airbnb ever. :(
Charles’s place is great! Close to the subway and convenient shops! Charles was very helpful and quickly responded to any inquiries! Very low stress highly recommended!
Pretty Nice appartnent , fantastic neighborhood , medium  cleaning  , beds that squeaks , a broken leg of the table that was dangerous . In complex pretty good

Kevins apt. was cozy, clean, and spacious. Big kitchen and the family room had a comfy couch with a big tv! Neighborhood can get a little sketchy at night but it’s a quick uber to east village’s local bars/restaurants/shops. Apt. itself felt homey and safe and kevin was quick to answer any questions or concerns. Would stay again!

This Airbnb is amazing! Jim & Barbara went absolutely above and beyond in setting up this space. The place is just gorgeous and it feels luxurious, cozy, and private. It looks exactly as it does in the photos, or maybe even better. It's the perfect place to unwind at the end of the day. Traveling can be so stressful, but this airbnb experience was completely stress-free - everything is set up for you, the location is incredibly convenient, and the hosts have made sure that any amenity you could need is provided. Also, communication with them is easy and they respond quickly.

Great price for the location as you can tell from Google map. Neighbourhood is pretty decent: not too much traffic but also not scary to walk late at night. Although modest, the place is kept very clean and is quiet at night. Two single beds shares the living room while the hostess lives in a separate room. One advice would be to double check the amenities list and don't expect anything not on the list to be there.

The stay was great. First I was a bit scared because it is in the Bronx but the train station is very close so no one has to be afraid. Shera was a very nice host and tried to calm me down when I was afraid someone could breake in because one window is not able to lock. So thx for that;) It could have been cleaner but there were some cleaning stuff in the room so I cleaned it by myself.All in all I can tell you guys that the stay  is awesome for this price.
This was a neat and affordable stay. I enjoyed it and didn’t feel unsafe at all. I will book again when I come back to the city.

The bed was off balanced and creeky. There is NO HEAT and the windows blew in cold air. I was really disappointed in this room and left the room as such.  The host seem like a drama queen. And you read their reviews, other guests would agree.  If there is some type of disagreement, the host will say to "follow the rules", yet those rules you are suppose to follow are unwritten rules, nowhere to be found. Again, read their reviews.  This place is ghetto and an unsafe environment. There is a real reason it's so cheap. Spend the extra money and go somewhere else.  Guest BEWARE.
Good place to stay, comfortable, no complaints - only that the location/neighborhood feels a bit rugged/unsafe.
Amazing for a steal price

Really nice apartment to stay, everything was clean and we had everything we needed there. However, for European, this part of Brooklyn is looking a little sketchy, at least for a first sight.. it is located just 2 blocks from subway so it is not a big deal.. we spent there 2 days and we were really satisfied!

Their place was awesome until last night.  Bed bugs which is you cant see but they can bite you, bite us. We also saw 3-4 ants on the pillow or bed. However, before last day everything was good. Subway is not far. you have to walk for 8-10 min. around of subway and walking way to subway are scary. Sometimes, we had to walk fast. Good value to stay if they clean ants

The location for the price is an absolute steal. I was so close to all of the major landmarks of Manhattan and was happy to have an easy subway trip back to my bed here. And Mizue was such a phenomenal and accommodating host, she even let me hold my bags at the place later than checkout since I had a later flight! Only thing is as the listing says, you are sharing a room with 3 people of ALL genders with little privacy so be sure you’re comfortable with such arrangements. Would definitely stay here again!

Definitely a hidden gem! Initially I was a bit concerned about the location because it’s said to be a bad neighborhood, but upon arriving I did not feel uneasy or unsafe at any point during my stay. It’s a beautiful Airbnb packed with all the necessities to have a worry free vacation. You cannot beat the value for the price. Definitely recommend!

The room and common area was very clean and neat. Motion detector lighting in common area lights your way when you come down hallway from your room to the bathroom or common area, and when you enter from outside, which is a nice aid in getting around in a strange surrounding.  If you're not familiar with what is like in NYC/Brooklyn, you might be put off by the appearance of the neighborhood, but it's really not bad, and you'll realize this once you get acclimated to it. I didn't feel unsafe in the neighborhood.

If you are needing a room for just to sleep and not be there much this is it for you. You share the apartment with 2 other people. Each has a room. The walls are very thin and you can pretty much hear everything from the other rooms. You share bathroom as well. I mean for $73 a night in NY. Nothing beats it but be aware of the noise. And might be getting woken up early in the morning to someone cleaning and speaking very loudly. Had some other tenants arguing and screaming and was scared for my life. Had to contact owner to have them be quiet. I will say the owner has fast response and I liked that. Also literally down the street is the subway. So that was a plus! Great places to eat around too.

Thank you Hamza and your Assisstance Axel so much for the great services you have provided to us especially the cleanliness. Everything is as expected, the place is so clean, prompt response and communication, place is specious, Neighborhood looks suspicious and first instance but is so quit and deserve the value.

We stayed here for a week while looking for our next NYC apartment. The 6 train was a quick walk away which provided easy access to Manhattan. The place itself was very clean and exactly as listed. We used the stove multiple times and basic cook utensils were provided. There was a back lawn area, but no furniture to sit on out there. We used Citi bike to bike around Randall's Island which is a great park area. As for the area, it was a little on the sketchy side. I would not have felt safe staying here alone, but since I was with my boyfriend I was fine. We purposely stayed in Friday/Saturday night so we wouldn't have to be walking around that late. If your comfortable with the area, then I would recommend the airbnb.

Very attentive host, we were able to leave our luggage on the day of our departure because the flight was not until late in the evening. Very good location, nice neighborhood with the metro 1m away. The room was spacious and clean and the bed very comfortable. We recommend 100%!

Location!! Location!! The location is perfect you can pretty much walk to all the main attractions in Manhattan, subway is downstair. We got room in building B which was inside so very little noise except if you get a loud neighbor.  House was really clean!!  Cons:  - We were not told that for a long-term stay they do not provide any amenities to cook (oil, salt, pepper, etc) and toilet papers.  - The entire building is Airbnb and Hostel on top floors.. so except some sketchy people outside your building...   Overall I would recommend this place!!

The studio is very good, the location helps a lot when going out shopping and using the subway, even if you want you can walk to some of the most iconic places in NY. It is very comfortable if you go with friends or family but adults. I do not recommend traveling with children to this location since at night there are many drug sellers and the atmosphere becomes heavy (it smells a lot like marijuana).   As in other reviews I confirm that the wifi did not work, but since I bought a SIM with unlimited data that was not a problem.

Great location- only bad experience was apparently the building is controlled by one thermostat. Upon walking into Airbnb I almost had an asthma attack and checked the temperature was over 85 degrees. I contacted host and they told us to turn on the AC unit and open the window which we did and it did help but it was so noisy having to sleep with the window open. The location is extremely convenient to grand central terminal and was clean.

The studio is exactly as one would expect from the pictures, and has a very welcoming air to it from the moment you step in. Trinize herself was a perfect host who made me feel at ease and calm after a stressful day of travelling. I highly recommend staying here to anyone who's travelling alone and on a budget, and doesn't mind sleeping on an air matress, as long as the company is nice!
The host is great guy, always active with a quick response. Although the location and neighborhood is so comfortable, especially the neighbors. A family person will feel unsafe in this location.

Our experience was less than satisfactory! I did not receive check-in instructions until the date of my arrival, at that time Emily informed me that her lease was up at the end of the month (something she must’ve know for a long time) and the broker(a friend of hers) would be coming in to show the apartment, but they’d be gone before I arrived, so of course I didn’t have a problem with that. That was just the beginning! She then contacted me the next day saying that they needed access to the apartment again for about 30 minutes in the evening, all of the guests had arrived by then (there was four of us staying there) and all of our belongings were in the apartment! None of us were comfortable with this, I communicated that to her, and refused to let the broker in when they came knocking. She then told me that the broker needed access to the apartment for a HALF OF A DAY in the middle of our stay! They were actually going to have an open house (random people coming in and out) with all of our valuables just strewn about the apartment! Again none of us were comfortable with that, and when we refused she threaten to cancel our reservation (an act that would essentially leave us homeless in New York)! We immediately took this over to AirB&B, and after hours of back-and-forth over an entire day of our vacation we were able to have an AirB&B representative cancel the remaining days of our stay and issue a refund. All the while the hostesses boyfriend, who she apparently gave my personal phone number to was texting me! I’m guessing that the landlord was putting heat on her, and she herself didn’t have much of a choice in the situation, so I feel for her in that way but it still does not make the turbulence regarding our lodging during that trip any less frustrating. I definitely can’t recommend.

Amazing place! Great Host! Safe and quiet neighborhood! Very close to 125th street Harlem which is 20mns from Time Square. Trinize is really generous and her very affordable studio is a steal...! I Will definitely book this clean, warm nice place again. Mister Shake
Trinize was a wonderful host and it was great staying at her place. She is very easy to communicate with and I had a stress free experience during my stay. Highly recommend

We had a great stay! It's a steal in a great Brooklyn neighborhood. A few snafus with the air but everyone was doing whatever they could to fix it. She was so quick with responses, even when we locked ourselves out like dummies! The famous donuts from Dough are around the corner, as well as a nice bar called Dynaco. The G train is super close!  The apartment was stunningly clean, the room even smelled like fresh laundry. She let us check in early which was a saving grace from carrying our bags around Manhattan as it rained.  Cant wait to visit again!
Great value & location! Super close to the subway and lots of nice shops, cafes and restaurants nearby. The room was comfortable and private. For the price, it’s a steal!

If you’re looking for a place on the UWS, it’s hard to beat Susan’s! This place is a real steal for the location. Minutes away (walking) from the best places on the UWS—zabar’s, shopping, coffee shops, and boutiques. Steps from the metro. For non-locals, the apartment is a pre-war building so that means much more space and light than a newer establishment. Susan has added some lively antique and retro touches to make you feel right at home!   One minor thing (that is not Susan’s fault at all:) the passenger elevators were under construction (and have been since February) so that means you have to text the elevator operator every time you want to go up or down. Not a big deal, just be aware that this may be a possibility.   Thanks Susan!

I stayed here for one month and it was awful. I would not recommend staying here.  1. One big issue was the sound. You are on a busy corner - dump/other trucks go down Metropolitan, city buses go down Manhattan. Deafening sound. My dog and I laid awake many nights. I’m working remotely and it was stressful to be on conference calls with my boss asking where the heck I was with that noise. Headaches.  2. Lock situation. Both locks on the door were so loose they weren’t working. She said not to lock the door handle or it will fall off... after complaining to airbnb (she stopped answering my texts at one point) I think she got the neighbor to fix the deadbolt lock. 3. The shower. Drain was stopped up the entire month, even with asking her to please unclog. After a few minutes in the shower, you’re standing in water up to your ankles. So freakin gross. 4. Everything is messy and falling apart! The apartment looked chic in the photos, but I wouldn’t have friends over in person. Drawer on the desk fell off (had been taped together with office tape), kitchen cabinet constantly fell off (another tape job), there was a super unsafe looking light clipped up by the wire above the stove.... junk piled on top of the fridge, also cleaning supply buckets blocking the front door from opening. 5. Lights. Bathroom light went out right after I moved in and was never replaced! Tried to shower in the day but had some dark showers. Light in my room went out, too.  Leah is a friendly person, but she is not a good airbnb host. Her description should have mentioned the noise and also the steep stairs. I worked with Airbnb to try and get out of the place but they wouldn’t approve a move.

Lisa is a wonderful person and her residence is nice, but unfortunately I cannot say the location is nice. If it weren’t for this incident, I would easily give a 5 star rating.  On our last night, my girlfriend and I were walking from my car to the airbnb. Two men were strolling down the dark street, maybe drunk or on drugs. They dressed and walked like gangsters so we were already on guard. As my girlfriend and I passed by them, they glared at us, and one of them growled “I’m gonna fuck her!” to her face, it sounded almost like he was angry. It was the most disgusting sexual harassment I’ve ever witnessed. We went back into the airbnb as quickly as possible.  So, I cannot say the location is great. In fact, that one incident kind of spoiled the entire experience. If we never encountered those men I wouldn’t hesitate to give a good rating.

Overall the stay was okay , the only reason for the 3 stars is the last day we mixed up the check out fats , we thought we was leaving on Saturday and not Friday . Once we got the call from customer service we immediately stopped what we were doing and went back to the Airbnb to get our things . We were not on the apartment for 10 minutes before her husband came knocking on the door . We gave the keys back and apologized for the mix up . Then things went left . Lisa proceeded to tell us how she has to change her locks because now she is scared for her safety(while she stands in front us and her husband stands behind us) for about 7 minutes. As we are finally walking out her husband followed us all the way down to the sidewalk and waited till we got into our car . There really wasn't any reason for him to follow us nor the verbal lashing after we apologized and were leaving . We fully take responsibility for the mix up
The apartment is perfect for staying in the city, it is not recommended to arrive late at night as it can be dangerous, otherwise it was perfect.

Very good place to stay if you’re traveling in a budget like we were. A bit far from downtown but using the subway will get you to main attractions in 40-45 min. Also, neighborhood looks ok in the day but during night seemed a bit dangerous. Incredible view from the 29th floor.

The house was great very modern with lots of character. A lot of space and was perfect for us with a group of 7 ladies. The location was pretty close to upper east side so we were able to walk to things nearby. It is located in East Harlem so if you walk a few blocks away it seemed to be a rougher neighbourhood. We didn’t feel unsafe at the home though. Overall would recommend.
