The place is exactly as in the photos. I really liked the apartment. The host responded whenever I communicated with him. You can cook there. There's a Target nearby and good stores. They also provide a fridge in the room for you. The two boys who live there are friendly and helpful! The apartment and room are clean. There are two subway lines nearby (175 line A / 181  line 1 on sundays sometimes line 1 was closed). It usually takes 30 minutes to get to times square. The neighborhood is Latin, located in washigton heights, I didn't see anything that put me in danger and I went home one day at 1 am, but keep in mind it's not like midtown. I really recommend this place to stay.  Great cost/benefit!

Eduardo and his roommates were excellent hosts. The apartment building exterior is rough, but the apartment itself was excellent, it doesn't have ac, but the heat during fall and winter stays will be a comfortable. The apartment restrooms, bed room, living room, and kitchen was clean. You're 10 minutes away from the  A and 1 subway routes: spend the money, 34 dollars, for the mta 7 day unlimited card. The neighborhood is Washington Heights area, it's ghetto, but a Latino cultures blend, and I never felt I was in danger. I would stay in this rental again. This Air b and b rental made my NYC visit affordable. I highly recommend to star stay at this rental.

-Great accommodation, nice big rooms, comfortable beds, very clean.   -Basic supplies were missing (towels and dishcloths, salt and pepper, etc.).   -We also did not find any trash bags and few pots and cooking utensils.   -Difficult to find because the address was not visible. Near Central Park, but still quite far from the action and an area that didn't seem very safe (near Harlem).     -The train passes continuously and this was not very indicated in the announcement. May be disturbing for some people.    -Near a metro entrance, it’s convenient.    -It was a little stressful not knowing in advance that we could leave our suitcases. Finally we were allowed to drop off our suitcases 2 hours before entry time.   -The tenants before us had not respected the regulations and that caused problems.  It wasn't the owner's fault at all and it was sorted out fine.

The room and appartement are ok. Smaller than expected and different from the pictures but clean and has the necessary for a short stay. This being said we had the cleaning lady in the appartement at 10. She started to clean everything and vacuuming while we were still in (the check out time is supposed to be 11). She like started cleaning the bathroom while we still did not finish using it and basically everything . It was really inappropriate and we felt super uncomfortable. Also the host (which I think is a compagnie or something but not Jacky) never responded to my messages asking if we could leave out bags there. For an extra 2h. It felt like all the messages you receive are automated.  And to finish the area is close to soho which is nice but the area itself can be kinda scary.  I would go back there and won’t recommend to a friend.

You have to be kinder to your clients, since remembering that one is paying to be in that place is not free, much less a favor. I asked him for information on how to get there and he wrote to me, see Google Maps, then he didn't receive me there, I had to ask for a phone number to be able to call him since I had told him that I didn't have internet or minutes, because I come from Chile, the place was comfortable but his attitude made the stay unpleasant, he went to bed in the living room (couch) at 12 if you were there he would send you to bed, the next day he slept until after 10 am and he didn't like it They had to turn on the TV because he was sleeping anyway, the bathroom was dirty and papers were piled high. So guys, why did he want to spend his holidays there, I don't recommend it, you're going to have a bad time. Not only did I have that time, but also a boy from Puerto Rico felt uncomfortable in the apartment.

The place is the same you see on the photos. It's too close to the subway, around the Harlem neighbohod and near the Central Park. You can go and back anytime. In the evening, arund the subway station looks like dangerous, but no problem. There is just some homeless or some drunk people. Tha place is good, clean and has a good price if you know that you are in Manhattan.

Owen’s place was clean and cozy. One thing I was a bit disappointed with was that my shampoo and conditioner were stolen during my stay. I know it’s not his fault, but I would suggest that you don’t leave any of your stuff in a shared space.

Jackie's place was exactly as I expected and more. His place is about a 5 minute walk to several subway lines and I didn't feel unsafe at all walking at night. Check in was super easy and the place was very clean and had everything I needed during my stay. He does warn people about the noise at night but I found that it wasn't at all bothersome. Jackie responded very fast to my questions and even sent me some suggestions on things to do. I had a very easy and pleasant stay at his place and would definitely consider booking again if I get the chance to come back. Thanks for all your wonderful help Jackie! :)

Perfect place for my partner and I. The neighborhood, the building, and access to transit was fantastic. We loved our stay and the atmosphere of the apartment. Cool little coffee table books that are nice to skim through as well as gas burners in the kitchen and vanity mirror setup in the bathroom. Little details like that really made our Airbnb stay unique and welcoming. Thank you again Jackie for making our short stay so stress free and hospitable:)

This is a very small room in a very small apartment. The location is pretty sketchy. I had to ask for general things that are usually available like soap and washcloths. They don't provide that. There is no table for eating. If you are single and will be out all day, this may work but the price I paid for this is ridiculous. Outside noise is VERY LOUD. They provide earplugs but it doesn't help. bathroom is dusty and falling apart. My worst experience so far on Airbnb.

This place was a disappointment. The only things I was happy about were that the door keys were relatively easy to find and that the place was near the subways and close to the financial district.   I was immediately disappointed as I came in the room: the floor was very dusty - after walking a couple of minutes after taking off my shoes my white socks were already dark. There was no heating and for the winter it was cold. My room was much smaller and dirtier than shown on the photo, and moreover, it had an unpleasant oder. The bathroom had no floor mat so if you're not careful you'd slip. The soap had someone's hair on it. No hand soap. The temperature in the bathroom was freezing. Also, there is no work place, unlike advertised on the listing. The two armchairs in the shared room/kitchen were dirty.   The host needs to put some more thoughts into how to make this a more welcoming place.

My friends and I had a pretty terrible experience here. Not with the space itself, but with the owner of the Air Bnb. TLDR: He made us feel very uncomfortable and unsafe after an encounter we had. Here’s the full story:  One evening I went back to nap around 5:30 pm and there was very loud EDM music coming from the upstairs neighbor. I thought “that’s fine, it’s early so I understand that this nap isn’t going to happen.” However, when we returned to the bnb late that night around 11 as a group to go to sleep, the music was still going and there were partygoers stumbling out of the upstairs apartment. My husband knocked on the ceiling of our bnb with a few knuckles to indicate that we could hear the music. Immediately, the neighbor came downstairs and knocked on our door. Matthew was clearly very drunk, extremely condescending to my two female friends that answered the door, trying to intimidate them and accused us of “slamming on the walls”. When they said “Hi we just knocked on the ceiling, we don’t live here so we don’t have your number,” Matthew laughed at them and said “I know you don’t live here.” All the while still not telling us that he was the owner of the air bnb. I have no idea why he was so cagey about this. The owners had never previously indicated that they lived above us, otherwise I would have simply sent a message about the noise on the app. We didn’t figure it out until I opened the app and showed my friends the profile photo of Lisa and Matthew and they said yes that’s him. He also proceeded to send me rude messages via air bnb, and said his tenants usually stay out until 4 am so he can be loud. Then changed his tune to cloyingly sweet later (guessing this was Lisa knowing they’d get a bad review). Definitely would not recommend!
decent airbnb - has all the basic amenities and isn't too far (8 min from subway), but definitely felt a bit sketchy coming home at night.
Great stay & great communication. From check in to check out everything was stress free! Good location near everything you may need or want. Very quiet neighborhood as well!

This place is AMAZING, it looks exactly like the photos! The place is very clean and the kitchen has all of the necessities. We loved the balcony and the decor made the place feel even more well put together. Javier was very accommodating to us, responded to our messages within a decent amount of time, and made our stay stress free. We will definitely be booking this place again when we visit the area in the future.

I chose this listing mainly due to its great location. It is close to the Central Park and I had some appointments in the neighborhood.  There are restaurants, supermarkets and drug stores nearby which was convenient.  The building is not new but the kitchen was well equipped and the bed was comfortable.  The host promptly responded to all my queries and concerns and overall communications was great.

The pictures on Airbnb site are not representatives of the reality. There is no table, no chair … there is no place to move: the bathroom sink is in the bedroom, the room is so narrow that the bed fit just between the walls (really). So there is only one possibility to pass from one side of the bed to the other side: climb on it!  The air conditioner produce so much humidity that it is very unpleasant.  Particularly on Saturday night the music from bars is so loud that you can’t sleep.  The wifi was out of order.

I got much more than I expected, sparkling clean wooden floor and just about everything in my room,  comfortable bouncy bed, amenities for 2 though I stayed by myself, Netflix in addition to regular TV channel, leaflet for restaurant close by. It's a steal staying at David's place.

Overall, the place is as described. It is a short walk from the metro (less than two blocks I believe) which was super convenient, too. The neighborhood did look a little sketchy, though - dirty with trash all over street and sidewalks, but l didn't feel concerned about my safety when walking to the house from the metro at night.   The temperature in the house is quite warm/high. It just retains a lot of heat. I was there at the end of September so can't imagine what it's like in the summer. But there's an AC in the room.   Cleanliness in the bathroom and kitchen could be improved - Hair around the bathroom floors, food leftovers in the kitchen sink drain, and some dust around the bedroom nightstands, but overall was okay.   The lockbox was easy to use - the instructions were clear and I received my code a few hours before check-in. There is a tall, steep staircase to get into the apartment, so keep that in mind if you have lots of luggage or have trouble climbing up and down.   Her kids were also quite friendly to me, especially her eldest one. And Basia would kindly ask about my day whenever we'd meet.  Overall I think this was good value for money and would recommend her place for a quick, short term stay.

Very welcoming as long as your kind and also very bold women. Not afraid to get to know you. Had a small scare where I was threatened with police but it was my fault I was sleepy and forgot to cut bathrooms light on and she busted right in thinking no one was there. When I heard her threatening to call police I got Very nervous and also decided I would tip them for that mistake I made. Other than that everything went smooth there could’ve been more interaction between us but we were on 2 opposite sides of home And even though I wanted to I never got to enjoy the comfy living room but there’s always the next time. Great place I give 5 stars

There was enough about this experience in the 24 hours leading up to staying here and the first night that concerned me and my partner enough to pivot and find somewhere else to stay after 1 night there.  I submitted the following to Airbnb Help for resolution assistance — while they ruled in Kyle's favor on all points, I think it is worth republishing the complaints here so that anyone coming into this listing, comes to it with set expectations.  In my opinion, best case, this listing capitalizes on location while the owner does what is minimally necessary to be a host.  Worst case, this host and this listing take advantage of loopholes in Airbnb's policies — knowing that no matter what this listing will make money whether you cancel the res, change the res, leave early, or stay full time and the guest won't have a real path to recourse — thus disincentivizing real thought and care in making this a comfortable and stress-free experience.  1) The listed check-in process was not the same as the actual process Kyle asked us to undertake. [It has since been updated after I filed a complaint.] That raised serious security flags for me — if we had known this on booking, we would not have booked this place. The listing claims this is a place with a smart lock; instead, we were told 24 hours before that we had to meet the housekeeper to pick keys up.  2) Upon arrival the place had repair needs that did not make us confident that it was up to hosting standards. There was major water damage in the bathroom.  The shower and tub were extremely rusted and corroded.  The water in the bathroom sink would just sit in the basin and not drain for several minutes.  3) Cleanliness and amenities.  While the place had just been "cleaned", it was not lost on us that the glassware and mugs had films of dirt on them, the towels were old and spotted with stains, and details about amenities (like the network name for the internet) just didn't match information that we had been provided or saw in the listing.  At best, it felt like this was just a bare minimum effort to have an Airbnb listing, and at worst, coupled with the process up to that point, the owner may have been making intentional misrepresentations.  Airbnb Help said that the cleanliness was a violation based on what we provided them, but we would have needed to stay there longer and get additional evidence in order to help them assess the severity.   4) The listed address is different than the one the host provided. Airbnb Help said that this is allowed on the platform; however, I think it is an interesting question of hosts' security versus guests' security.  From my perspective, having the procedure vary for check-in, with the place under a different address, and an unresponsive host other than canned messages out of context of the questions I was asking, erode trust overall, and are signs I should be thinking about my safety.  5) Poor communication. These four concerns were all compounded when I asked Kyle a question about why the procedure didn't align with what was in the listing. For 24 hours I heard nothing back, and it wasn't until we were already there at the place that I heard back from Kyle, with a message suggesting that we had not arrived and the housekeeper was waiting on us.  Meanwhile, we were observing and seeing his responses to his housekeeper in real-time as we asked questions during the key exchange as she sought his response to questions she couldn't answer.  So it felt odd to hear nothing from Kyle from his initial "when are you arriving" message through check-in, only to get a message 30 min after we checked in saying "where are you, you haven't checked in yet", even though we were physically there while he was communicating with the housekeeper.  This message sent would also be the key for Airbnb Help in determining that Kyle was indeed responsive as a host, despite the context and history of the limited exchange because he was the "last one to send a message".  We didn't feel comfortable staying there more than a night and had to pivot.  Unfortunately, we are having to eat the cost of that, but ultimately feel like it was the right choice.  So again, I would think twice about this listing — the location will lure you in, but not really sure the host has any incentive to provide more beyond that.

We really enjoyed our stay at Walker Hotel. We wanted to be in the Village and somewhere quieter, and it was the perfect. Those who want to be on the steps of Times Square won't want this location, but if you're looking to be in a more residential area, this is the place to go. It is close to Union Square, where basically every subway line stops. We've been to New York a lot and have always struggled with street noise. It was very quiet, and we slept really well. The hotel was clean and modern, and the staff was great. There is a great little cafe/bar downstairs that was fun to get a drink in. It was a great price and a steal for the level of service we received. This is a gem in the city, and we will definitely be back!

This hotel was a nice find.  I was happy they listed it on Airbnb as I love the area.  The rooms are very small but cozy.  They could have better pillows.  Breakfast was ok, but not great and definitely a bit overpriced.  The fireplace in the lounge at night was great and they had very nice live music in the lobby several nights in a row.   The location was FANTASTIC!  My main gripe about this property was how it was listed on Airbnb and the customer service I received:   I found this booking a bit deceptive.  The taxes were not listed anywhere in the fine print at my time of booking in Airbnb. I read the Airbnb site and they said some properties have taxes and they ask hosts to write that in the description if there will be additional fees not rolled into the nightly rate.  After booking, the receipt I got emailed from the hotel equaled the amount I paid on Airbnb INCLUDING the taxes shown.  So my total equaled the room rate plus the taxes.  Logically, I assumed I was set.  When I checked in I was told I was "all set and had paid in full online."  They took my credit card and said it was for incidentals only.  When I checked out they charged me $242 in taxes, without my authorization or any explanation (which I'm honestly not even sure is legal since I had not authorized my card to be used for anything other than incidentals). Of course I don't mind paying the taxes but this all felt shady and not upfront.  No one on the property cared when I brought it up. They told me it was in the listing.  I showed them the listing and it wasn't there.  They shrugged.  Not impressed with the customer service on this one! I'll stay somewhere else next time I'm in town.

The building is indeed close to everything and the area is quite commercial but the building halls and the street where the building is located are a bit sketchy, specially at night. Wouldn’t recommend it if it’s your first NY stay, if you have kids, or if you want a peaceful and relaxing stay.  Inside the building there are several rental offices and therefore the lobby is quite chaotic sometimes with a bunch of people trying to check in.  We had some issues to check in but it was resolved by the host within an hour.  The room itself was pretty clean and as described but we had several issues with the wifi at the beginning, which were fixed by the host a few days later.  In summary, the place is ok if you already know NY and if you’re familiar with that part of Korea town, just try to arrive before 5pm for an easier check in.  I have to highlight that we had to extend our stay and the host was pretty accommodating and helpful.

We booked this apartment by looking at the rating but were shocked to see the poor condition of the apartment. Not clean,  had adhesive tapes to cover holes to the walls and around air-conditioning unit, stinky blankets. Basic exhaust is not there and smoke alarm keep on buzzing  even for basic cooking. We booked this apartment to have a kitchen to cook food as we were traveling with our 3 year old kid. Location of the building is the only plus point. This apartment is definitely not for families traveling with kids. And Studio plus never responded to my messages before check in. Very unpleasant experience for us. First bad experience with AirBnB.

Nothing but good things to say about my stay here. The home is located in such a safe, convenient location -- there are restaurants, bars, shops, food markets, cafes all easily accessible the second you step foot outside. The 4th Ave - 9th St stop is only 1.5 blocks away or a 3 minute walk. I drove in Friday night from Jersey expecting the parking situation to be stressful and time consuming but all the side streets which are residential areas, all had a plethora of spots open and they are free.   The home itself was an absolute dream. For anyone like me who has a green-thumb, you'll most definitely appreciate the liveliness the home has with all the gorgeous house plants in the living room, bedroom and backyard space. On top of that, everything was in pristine condition -- the rooms, decor, furniture, appliances. Super bright space with a lot of natural light and incredibly homey ambiance. I also very much enjoyed the peaceful outdoor space to relax and get some work done. It was definitely one of my favorite features of this place. You can tell the owners take very much care of their home, so if you're looking for somewhere to be rowdy, this isn't it.   There are also so many thoughtful touches -- towels, toiletries, detergent for laundry. Russell was also kind enough to allow us to use his kitchen, but we opted to dine out for all of our meals instead.  He is a great host -- welcoming, attentive and responsive to all of our questions. We spent a good chunk of our days outside exploring the city, but I wish we could have stayed longer to enjoy the home more. I'll be back to Brooklyn soon to attend more events, so I'll absolutely be staying here again in the future!

The place itself is very charming. Great place to start a night out or  to stay in with the pool and a reasonable sized living room/kitchen. Location felt safe and is about 10-15 mins from a train station and then an hour ride to Manhattan which is not bad other than a bit stressful finding parking at the train station.  Parking at the actual house was not a problem.

My family and I had a great stay at Lisa’s place in NYC!! I can’t stress how much me and my 3 daughters love Lisa’s decor—just enough glam and bling to make the place feel like a boutique hotel with modern extra cute kitchen. The two super plush comfy full-size beds were just right for us. The pool and deck were just icing on the cake! My family converged on Queens for my grandma’s 100th birthday celebration. Lisa’s place is under 2 miles from JFK  and right off the Belt Parkway. So me and my girls were only 7 minutes away from the hotel most of my family stayed at and it was so convenient to return my rental car and get on my way this morning. Lisa was super responsive and even though she and her family live right upstairs, they gave us our privacy unless we needed something.  Overall, our stay at the Oasis in Queens really made our trip great! I would recommend over a hotel room any day!

The location is good, the bad thing is that it is a fourth floor without an elevator, the stairs are quite steep and the building itself is somewhat neglected. The TV NEVER worked for us. Besides, air comes in through the windows and they never sent us the blankets we asked for, I had to buy a blanket (of course I brought it with me). The door is uneven and in a corner at the bottom there is a gap and it is scary for an animal to get in.

This was the worst experience I have had with Airbnb.  Blueground is horrible with communication and responsiveness. They will get nothing done and ignore you until you are able to resolve the issue yourself.   We had countless appliances broken or not working in the apartment that took over 3 weeks to resolve. These were major things that affected our everyday at the apartment.  -shower flooding  -broken dryer  -broken lights  -broken bathroom cabinet  -broken microwave/oven  -broken stove  -broken toilet seats -broken faucet -dirty/discolored water  -mold in dishwasher/washer  -dust in vents and AC filters were disgusting  -not enough towels -missing bathroom necessities  We were reimbursed slightly for the above- but not as much as we should have been given how major some of the appliances were and how long everything remained broken.   I had to get the owner of the apartment, building management and Airbnb involved. This still did not do much. The supers were rude, lazy and slow. The elevators are janky and dangerous. People riding the freight elevator dropped multiple floors and were injured.   We were also not made aware of construction going on in the building which made it really noisy and inconvenient. Workers were not wearing their masks either.   The only good thing about this place were the people working at the front desk. But the building itself is dirty, not well maintained and old. Locationally is also very far out of the way.   WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS.

My family and I really enjoyed our stay at the palace. All the beds were so so comfy. Eduardo was a great communicator before and during our stay. The parking spot was so clutch! It was amazing not to stress about parking each night. We will definitely stay there again when we need a place in Queens!

Keith and masa are amazing!!! This was my first time leaving the home base and I wanted to explore New York and see the city! This spot was perfect for me so good!!! I absolutely loved each and every night at my stay of this beautiful brownstone apartment!!  It even topped my expectations because I knew it would be nice but it turned out even nicer :)  Just a really cozy and homebody vibe inside the home I felt so comfortable I didn’t even leave the area one day!! I just stayed home and cooked food and enjoyed the beautiful backyard and the park down the street!!!  Everything here is so convenient, the stores nearby, the train station nearby, all the food you need and markets (some 24hrs) , basically everything you need to live for a day or two is here for you at your disposal!! ( I stayed for a week )  Keith is very good at communicating and helping you out if you need anything!! Don’t be afraid to just ask he is so nice :)  I really had a good time reading all the history on the area too with the books and art that were there for me a very nice touch to add on to the home vibes!   I would really recommend this spot to any one whether it be a day stay or a week stay!! I know I will definitely be coming back to stay again and have another great experience!!! Thanks again Keith and masa!!

Clean and comfortable place. Check in was seemless and communication was prompt. Place was exactly like the pictures. Location is decent and around 800 metres from the subway that goes to downtown Manhattan. Only slight negative would be that the place as well as the subway gets secluded and feels a bit unsafe if you are returning late night and not in a group.

My family and I traveled from Atlanta to attend a funeral, our accommodations fell through at the last minute. We turned to Airbnb and had another two cancellations in all within less than an hour. Did I say we travelled from Atlanta Georgia... when I reached out to Joel at the last minute he accepted my requested and we went from being homeless in our truck to his wonderful apartment. He was very accommodating, his place is exactly how it is pictured, in fact even better in person. Thank you for allowing us to stay at your home during such a sad time in our lives. All the extra touches you provided were appreciated and welcomed.  Petra & Marcus

Jianren was kind and incredibly responsive. Very flexible and even allowed us to drop our bags off early on the first day. This Airbnb was very easy to access and walkable to multiple subway stations making travel very easy. The neighborhood was quiet (except for the sounds of the city and the subway occasionally) and we never felt unsafe walking in the neighborhood.

I am so glad I went with Eliot’s place to stay! Everything was exactly as described/in the photos.  Eliot was extremely responsive, helpful, and easy to reach. One day I thought I smelled some kind of weird fumes in the building. Within approximately five minutes Eliot had asked me follow up questions, touched base with neighbors to see if they were experiencing the same thing, and updated me! I was staying at Eliot’s while I waited to close on my own apartment nearby and Eliot was even kind enough to refer me to a contractor.  Here are top pros/cons of staying at Eliot’s:  PROS -spacious, super clean,  very nice furniture!  -everything you need for it to feel like home without feeling like you’re in someone else’s space. it’s cozy and warm without being cluttered or full of another person’s stuff.  -super easy access to multiple subway lines, 20min to 14th street most days  -great new kitchen with everything you need to cook. this is my ultimate pet peeve at Airbnb’s, when there is nothing for you to cook with! At Eliot’s I was able to make all my meals from home like usual.  -very quiet building and street, easy to sleep. I work from home and it was easy to get work done and focus as well.  -great heat and AC units well placed and keep the whole place whatever temp you need  -since Harlem still gets a bad rap sometimes I’ll say it - it’s very safe!! Walking alone at night, to/from subway, etc. Not dangerous.  CONS -the water is not drinkable in my opinion. it even made my hair/skin feel different after showering. this is unusual in NYC. there is a filtered water dispenser on the fridge but it’s very slow. I went and got my water filter pitcher out of storage to avoid buying water all the time.  -the building has some sort of internal vent system with vents in the bathroom and kitchen. when neighbors cook, which they do a lot and often at weird hours, it really stinks up the apartment! it is not that hard to deal with once you know what to expect, but was especially annoying/startling when I would be trying to shower at night and the bathroom would be getting pumped full of stir fry smells! lol.   Overall I loved staying at Eliot’s. The small annoyances are super easy to adapt to and you have to do that literally anywhere. Amazing experience. Thank you Eliot!!

Everything is excellent, very tidy and clean, the heating is good. Only the place is a little dark and over a bridge that seems to be dangerous, but apparently it is not so dangerous. Additionally, if you don't take a car to NYC, then the subway is a 6-7 minute walk away, the station is called Cypress.

Everything was as expected from the pictures, description, and reviews. It was a great place to stay however the neighborhood looks a little sketchy but it's a very quiet place. It's definitely street parking so make sure you can parallel lol. Its a quick 10 min walk to the station 6 which was super convenient. The unit overall is very clean, appreciated that towels and shampoo+conditioner was provided since a couple guest forgot theirs! The only downfall is that there's no kitchen sink but the bathroom sink made do. The check-in was no problem all though the door does get jammed a little but Hamza does give you a ends up about it. Over all we do recommend booking!

The apartment was very nice and spacious for 6 people and we overall enjoyed our stay. I think it is slightly better suited to shorter visits - the lack of sink in the kitchen did become slightly cumbersome and the kitchen only has a very small trash can which became full after the 2nd day. The beds were very comfortable.   Unfortunately, there was an issue with the lock on the first day and it took 2 hours to establish contact to resolve as we were initially given an incorrect code for the lockbox and the electronic lock didn't work. This caused a bit of undue stress which could have been avoided with more regular verifying of the check in info/removing the not working electronic lock entirely and providing the correct code for the lockbox.  In terms of location it is handy to get into Manhattan though it's in a very quiet, industrial area which made walking around at night feel a little unsafe though it is 10 min walk from Cypress ave station which was very useful for getting into the city in the morning. All in all it was a positive stay, and I hope there are more measures introduced to make sure the correct information is given to safely lock the apartment.

Lakshmee’s home is amazing for a short stay. We had our flight get cancelled until the next day and we found her place while in the airport. She was very easy to reach and communication was very quick. Once we got to our room it was very peaceful and quiet. She was very helpful with ideas and recommendations for things to do and eat while we were there to occupy our time and get our mind off the flight issue. She is very down to earth and personable. She also helped us with early check-in and made sure our room was clean.   Lakshmee is doing an incredible service with her listings. She helped to make our stressful situation a more peaceful one with providing a roof over heads and a bed for the night.   If you are in need of a place to stay for the night from the airport then definitely book with her.   Thank you for everything, Lakshmee!
Do not rent from him!  It’s a scam!

be sure to check-in after 3pm. If you don't, they will charge you. If you need hairdryer, bring it. it looks so old. To JFK, it takes about 7min. If you have early time flight, I think here is good option. neighboorhood is not that dangerous. sound from other room comes in well. big enough bed.

My worst experience with Airbnb to date. When I first opened the door to the apartment, I immediately closed it - thinking that I entered an occupied room. The trash was so full that the floor was scattered with rubbish, the bed was unmade (still with the sheets from previous travellers!!), the towels were used and wet, the floor was dirty... What an unpleasant surprise after a 12 hours long travel. Apparently the cleaning lady 'forgot' to come. I had to take the trash out, change the bedsheets and change towels myself.   The cleaning lady came the place the next day, but didn't do much except changing the bedsheets that I changed the day before. The floor was still dirty - she obviously didn't even bother to sweep the floor. I can tell you that one of the previous travellers had long dark hair...   When I texted Taina the first day to explain her the situation, she seemed to be sorry and proposed to reimburse me if I wanted to leave and find an hotel. I told her that it was too late and I was too exhausted to find an hotel. She didn't even bother to check on me the next day to see if everything was okay.  I strongly not recommend this place.

The apartment is exactly as you can see in the photos. It was really clean and Hazma put some things like a tea or coffee in the kitchen. The communication with him was unbeatable and really helpful.  The only negative think that we want to mention is that the location looks a bit unsafe for us. However, we didn't have any problem with any neighbor neither with the way from the subway to the apartment.
Good value for your money but location may be a little sketchy. Otherwise, clean and spacious apartment.

Convenient location for travelling to Manhatten. The local area feels unsafe at times - you just need good situational awareness. The walls of the apartment are paper thin so be mindful that conversations may not be private. Overall, it was good value for money.
Check in check out is really easy they are very good communicators if you have any issues I’ll get right back with you. the area is a little sketchy but, other than that everything was great.

A bright, clean and comfy apartment. Area seemed a little sketchy but the neighbours were very friendly (albeit a little loud!) The location was close to the subway for easy access into NYC; also easy with an Uber. We found a lovely, friendly local bar restaurant. Great communication throughout with easy check in/out.
Great host with very timely communication. The place was very clean and stocked with toiletries and everything I need for my stay. This is a steal!!

Pros: 1) The home is very close to JFK. 2) The bed is comfortable. 3) Lakshmee provided clear instructions for entering the home and finding the room.   Cons: 1) The room is very small; it seems to have originally been intended as a large closet that had been repurposed as a bedroom. 2) The room was uncomfortably warm during our mid-July stay; if there is central air conditioning, it was not in use during our stay and the portable unit in the room did not work very well. 3) The home is in a bit of a shady area. We walked to a nearby restaurant and encountered a variety of sketchy characters along the way.

Quite a good place to sleep over for a one or two nights. But nothing comfortable to stay over day and longer time. The room was really clean and everything was as described, but it was so hot in there. The area felt a littel bit unsafe to me, the taxi driver said to me, it is a quite dangerous place at night. It was really close to airport

This was a great spot to stay for two people for a few nights in the East Village.   Pros -  - The apartment was clean, quiet, and had a great view from the bedroom. - We really appreciated the amenities: nice shower soap/shampoo/conditioner/hand soap/lotion, access to extra toilet paper and paper towels, plenty of room in the bathroom medicine cabinet and bedroom dresser to unpack, a hair dryer provided, washer/dryer, and a few coffee pods and some sugar for the coffee maker. - The air conditioners worked great in both the living room and bedroom.  - The bed was really comfy and the blinds kept out a lot of the light. - Key pickup was complicated with KeyCafe (nothing to be done about how their app kind of sucks), but it was amazing that the location was open 24 hours, so we didn't have to worry if our flight got delayed or we needed to leave early the morning of check-out. It didn't go smoothly, but it was helpful. - Location! Perfection!  Cons -  - There are THREE very steep flights of stairs (which is standard in the East Village, but good to know if you have mobility issues). The host told me that it was a 3rd floor walk-up (which would be 2 flights of stairs) and it's not, it's on the 4th floor of the building. That felt a little shady when we arrived, but it was fine, and turned out to be nice being up that high for the view and the quiet. - The wifi was slow and would cut out a lot. It wasn't a problem for us, but if we'd been traveling internationally it would've been a problem. - The comforter is made of down feathers, and our host wasn't sure if it was or not before we booked. So if you're allergic (like I am), be aware.  All in all, we had a great stay here!

Well I had an unpleasant experience. I loved my room ( until someone moved in to the closet next door and I could here every conversation, every yawn, burp etc because the walls were so paper thin, but it was very pricey for the balcony. I never met Meele and the communication was very poor. I only saw the cleaning staff there once for the whole month and a half and they took my cleaning supplies I bought that were in the bathroom. It’s very unwelcoming with sticky notes everywhere telling you what not to do. She took pictures of me in the kitchen trying to prove a point saying “we are not a maid service” and I was only cleaning up and a lot of times it wasn’t even my stuff!! She didn’t wait for me to respond to a request to enter my room to install an AC and strangers entered anyway when I was at work!!! I couldn’t believe that! I didn’t see the notification and she should have texted or called me. That was totally uncalled for. Be prepared to share the house with ALOT of people, there’s like 9 bedrooms!! Also you’ll get a knock on your door if you don’t wear your mask. It’s a very unfriendly place, don’t go here!!
Rob's place is well located and perfect East Village spot.  Kitchen is small but top tier, bathroom and laundry are great.  loved it

Rob’s place was absolutely amazing and clean! The bed was super comfortable and the location is very close to really great food/bars in East Village. I actually thought the apartment was better in person too! The check in process wasn’t as bad at all either. I would recommend getting set up before arriving at the key location then it’ll be pretty quick. Overall, I highly enjoyed my stay here and would recommend it!

Robert’s place is easily a 10/10. I would absolutely recommend. The location is perfect. The building is quiet and safe. The apartment itself is fully equipped. Rob loaded the bathroom with plenty of toiletries for our convenience. I even booked this place for our next stay in the fall.

Rob’s place was great! We were here for a week and worked as well. The WiFi was super speedy and we enjoyed how cozy the place was. The location is CLOSE TO ALL OF THE GREAT FOOD and the neighborhood is so fun! Everything is walkable (including the subway entrances) and love the ice cream shop on the same street! We can’t wait to come back!

Really great place. Excellent location, clean, perfect size for two people. Also really appreciated the prompt and super helpful communication with Rob. Would recommend this place without hesitation!
Robert’s East Village location was a perfect stay. The unit was clean and had every amenity I needed for my week stay. Rob was extremely quick to respond to my inquiries even ones at off-hours.

This is a shared space, a shared boarding house to be exact. This space is blocked off by a stand alone shade, instead of a wall with a door. Your things won’t be secure so be sure to only expose things you know will be at risk. Place was also not the cleanest, very different from other Airbnb’s I have stayed at. There was half eaten food in the fridge, and  many personal items and clutter all over the place. Would not recommend for the price we paid

DO NOT BOOK HERE!! doesn’t look anything like the pictures shown, the home is loaded with roaches, bed sheets weren’t clean, the whole house was dirty. I didn’t stay all the days, and they tried to scam me with my refund and say I stayed there an extra 3 days!! And then said it’s because they won’t have enough time to clean so that’s why they charged me for it when we left the home spotless!! they do not want to give me my correct refund, the thermostat did not work the house was under 40 degrees every night we stayed!  All Our kids got sick. There’s not even a door in the front anybody can come in as they please. Felt very unsafe the whole safe I do not recommend!!

There are fire hazards at this address. 1)The staircase is blocked at several points. A bicycle locked on the railing by the front door would impede exit by residents as well as entrance by firefighters. 2) The landings are used for storage which impede entry and exit. 3) There is no fire escape and no access to the roof from the unit and no other way to get our except down the stairs 4) As described, the space does not have a front door. There are blinds and a paper shade to create a unsecured barrier which is unmarked and may not be immediately visibile to first responders. Also, the unit can be accessed by anyone who has a key to the other three rental spaces on the top floor. There is no lock on the bathroom door. This creates an additional crime hazard to guests. 5) There is one smoke detector that are within 10 feet of the primary bedroom used for sleeping. However there is no smoke detector in the rest of the space or within 10 feet of another bed located in the living room. 6) There are no smoke detectors on the long flight of stairs. I don’t know if that is against code but it seems this would create a delay in notifying the 4 Airbnb rentals on the upper floors if there is fire below.  I reported these safety issues to the AirBnB host. He responded with a phone call as well as an email through the AirBnB system. He seems like a nice guy. He stated his concern and said he would address these issues. He is currently in Japan but did provide a number to reach his brother for issues related to the rental.  So hopefully these issues will be resolved immediately. I’ve never given a negative review before and I really don’t like having to do so. I just feel like people booking this spot should be aware.
The space was top notch. Modern, stylish and surprisingly spacious.  If you’re looking for a stay in Brooklyn this place is a steal.

The space is clean/looks like photos. Bed is v comfortable. 1 pot and 2 pans in the kitchen, 1 roll of toilet paper and 1 roll of paper towels for month long stays. Appliances are clean and new. Host is nice but very involved.  To get in to the apartment there’s a vestibule w/2 doors, 1 to the unit and 1 to the basement used by hosts & sometimes their guests which the host will notify you about. Host was informed I would arrive 1 day late, but after I arrived asked to come take photos of damage from a previous stay despite having around 24 hours between when their previous renters left and before my late arrival. Furthermore, she complained about how dirty the guest was and how long it took her to clean after they left. It was more information than I needed.  At the beginning of my second week I got sick and didn’t leave for a couple days causing her to text me telling me about the nice weather and why I hadn't gone out. I suspect that besides being useful for safety the cameras + alarm alert her of movement in or out of the place and she's taking note. When she text she also mentioned the temp inside of the apartment viewed on nest. It just oddly felt like I was being monitored. I shared that I was feeling sick, and she kindly gave me a covid test which ended up being positive. Though she was nice throughout she emphasized her husband would suffer significant financial harm if he got sick multiple times after I tested positive. This struck me as weird since it's probably not smart to host strangers who are probably going to nyc to be out and about during COVID if you could lose a lot of money if you get sick.   When I left the apartment because I was losing my mind isolating she would text for updates and mentioned that her husband was no longer going to the basement so as not to get sick. Though none of it was said rudely, I really felt like I was being monitored and it just added more pressure when i'm already far from home and alone while really sick.  Out of respect, I isolated, wore a mask in the shared space, and wiped anything I touched. I would have done that anyway, but all the contact just made me feel worse about being sick.  I didn’t want to get sick, I'm 3x vaccinated, and getting sick ruined my time in NYC altogether which is no one's fault, but being uncomfortable in the place I had to stay made a bad situation worse. As soon as I felt well enough and tested negative I chose to leave their place a week early. I would have left sooner had I tested negative sooner. I sent a text informing her I had left and why, then blocked her number because I had already had entirely too much communication with her. She chose to refund me for the week I left, which I was not expecting.   Other people seemed to have a lovely time at her place, and I'm sure that's possible but I decidedly did not.
Check in was stressful and she seemed frustrated but the stay was great!

I have never given a bad rating for our Airbnb stays. But this place was Absolutely disgusting! It was so dingy. Maybe their level of cleanliness and mine are different but you could see the dust on and underneath all the furnishings. there are so many stains on the sofas that you’re afraid to sit on it. Not knowing what you’re sitting on.  of course there are people staying above you. so you share that entry door. You have no privacy whatsoever aside from a curtain. But you can hear everything upstairs. And even when I asked if they could please close their door it seemed like they made more noise in spite of.  So the renter upstairs comes through the door; he has a backpack and as he turns around the backpack hits this unsecured shelving cabinet and I’m sitting at the table and that thing could have fallen on me if the guy hadn’t quickly reacted. Safety hazard! I notified Thomas… of course you’re not dealing with Thomas you’re dealing with some guy named David. Thomas responded later That David in the renter would come secure the cabinet/shelving. But that never happened You’re probably wondering why I didn’t call and report it to Airbnb. Turns out my husband arrived there first and I didn’t get there until the fourth day. Which was way too late to report it. So we were stuck there for 10 days in that filth.

Albert and Andrey’s place was awesome. The two twin beds and larger than normal upstairs living space was a steal for the price. The bathroom was super clean. The check-in process was very easy and Albert was super communicative the entire time. It’s a short hike to Manhattan (35-40 minutes, but there’s a subway entrance about two and a half blocks in either direction from the Airbnb. Overall, this was a great value.

We highlight the cleanliness of the place and the good connectivity of the apartment (there are 2 metro stations very close). On the other hand, we had problems checking in and the neighborhood seemed a little unsafe. In addition, the apartment is a little far from the most tourist places (for example, it should be around 50 minutes to Central Park).

We had a pleasant stay in Andrey's accommodation. The beds are very comfortable and the room spacious. Being able to leave your luggage for the day is a plus, even if it is just in the living room of the apartment, we had no problems. The area is not unpleasant, close to the metro and the bus, and a few nearby stores as well.

The place is nice but don't suffer with asthma or allergies. Their approach is direct and repeated a lot and it almost made me feel uncomfortable but I gave him a pass because everyone is scared of covid. And I left chicken to burn which I apologize for. Other than jumping the price up a hundred and fifty dollars from one week to the next was just insulting because in that area stop it. But the worst thing was when he told my son that he would lower it back because he didn't get any one to rent it yet and when I looked the price was listed at 150 above what I had been paying so we left...

I experienced many BNB’s and this by far was the worst. I do not recommend this property to anyone especially during this coronavirus pandemic because this house is filled with Individuals who the host did not explain will be there and the communication and professionalism was not there as a whole. I checked into the property at 4 PM and by the time 9 o'clock came I was completely checked out of the property because I felt unsafe. no social distancing was followed and the way that the property was displayed on Airbnb was not the way that it is in person. I will never recommend this property to anyone.
Definitely great for the price, but I wish I spent a little bit more for a better place in a better area. The neighborhood was a little scary

the area is not dangerous.  the house is located next to the metro.  express train will take you to Manhattan in 20-25 minutes. The host is friendly and disposed to him.  answered all questions in correspondence in a timely manner.  very useful parking on site for $ 10 per night.  the accommodation is clean, the abstraction is friendly, the atmosphere is comfortable.  photos of the room correspond to reality.  I will be glad to stay with Andrey again next time.  thank

Accurate description and pictures. Room and bathroom was clean as pictured. One thing that I would be careful is the neighborhood. It is convenient, but can be very sketchy and dangerous. Other than that, room was nice and clean! Andrey and Albert were super nice and helpful

Really shady. Women traveling alone and or any group just be careful. Be ready for the door not to open, and don't get back really late. That's pretty obvious because it's Brooklyn but ..... just don't be late.

Great little place outside of the city. We loved the neighborhood!  I traveled with my daughter and Yaya and never felt unsafe. The road noise can be loud but the white noise machine that was provided helped a lot. Highly recommend.

Sophie’s home is an absolute steal. This carriage house is cozy but with excellent utilization of space. It’s super cute, well-located for transport both within Brooklyn and to Manhattan, and incredibly clean and well-maintained. We were here to relax, enjoy the neighbourhood between moves (from LES to Fort Greene), and have a convenient home base to stay in while we gallivanted around the city celebrating a birthday. Sophie’s space met every conceivable need. For the price point I can’t imagine it getting much better. Thank you so much for having us!

This is a dangerous place.  There was several violent confrontations between the hosts and at least two different women. Quote” I don’t have to wear a mask in my own house “ said the host. Hello Covid 19!!!  One woman who appeared to be personally involved with the host told the host “ the reason I don’t live here is because you are too violent “. There was several violent confrontations over the cleanliness of the flat between the hosts and one woman that was a quest.  The quest is correct how nasty her room was.  That room looked like Saturday night sex gone sideways six times!   NASTY 🤮. I kept my door locked and 911 on speed dial.

*** Short Notice Booking****  You get what you pay for, Shared property definitely was not for my husband and I as we had so confusion during check-in, we weren't on the list!  but this was later resolved.  Had to kill time while room was cleaned as someone else had thought they would be staying there for another nitght.  When hubby got up to use the bathroom early in the morning,  and found someone was asleep on the sofa in the living room communal space.  met at least 4 different people staying in the property, and had one of those 4 walk into our room accidently (Scary).  There was only one bathroom, and had to wait for it to be vacant before I could use it. Train feels like it coming into the room so you defo need earplugs.  But as our other booking had disappointed us, we had no choice but to book something cheap for our last nite in the city.  Thanks Basia, for taking my booking in such short notice.

When I first arrived, the host had me waiting outside in the cold for half an hour, although I told her the day before what time I would arrive. When I finally got in the apartment, the host immediately starts screaming at me (literally screaming like I was a child) for stepping on her carpet with shoes on. I had to leave them outside. The place is dimly lit, has an odd smell and is extremely overdue for major renovations. My first night there, I couldn’t sleep because I was hearing scratching noises in the walls, I was afraid of what it could be. The next morning, the host decided to babysit 11 children so it was very noisy. The kitchen was left very unclean with food splattered all over the counters for the ENTIRE day. Because of this I couldn’t cook a meal for myself. There isn’t any well known restaurants or stores in the area aside from a Rite Aid. The bathroom ceiling is covered in what appears to be mold and there was no toilet paper, only Kleenex. I booked for 6 days but left after 2. I’ve stayed on almost 10 different airbnbs and this is my first time leaving one early. The host tried to apologize for being rude but at that point I was ready to leave. I tried to modify my reservation to only 2 days so it wouldn’t be a complete waste of money but the host declined. I’m working with airbnb to get a refund but hopefully they remove this listing altogether. Book at your own risk. Would absolutely not recommend.

Sophie's carriage house was in a great location and easy access to the subways. We walked to the Brooklyn bridge. Here's a tourist tip... Take the Staten Island ferry and you cruise right past Ellis Island and the Statue of Liberty, and has amazing views of the city. It's free both ways and runs every 20 minutes, 24 hours a day. We never felt unsafe walking anywhere. I always write honest reviews because I think it's important. The carriage house didn't feel clean to us. I let Sophie know and she was apologetic, she was traveling so she wasn't able to check the house after the cleaners, before we arrived.  The bedding and towels were very worn and stained.  This carriage house is adorable and has so much potential. It just wasn't for us.  We did leave water in the fridge for the next guests. :)

What can I say…. Location - perfect, communication, check in, recommendations - perfect. See where I’m going with this…. Great, comfortable space, safe neighbourhood. Look no further - guaranteed stress free accommodation in the heart of midtown. I ❤️ this place. If she’ll have us…we’ll be back

FABULOUS! Home away from home!  Trust me, I trawled through a LOT of hotels and apartments in a similar price range, and they ALL seemed to have some glaring issue or another. This one seemed to be the best place I could find for my budget and I was convinced by other glowing reviews. I was sceptical at first as it seemed too good to be true, but it did not disappoint! (Save yourself some time and book this, really!)  It was VERY CLEAN! Zero nasties. Spotless throughout, which instantly put us at ease. Nice and homely, pleasant vibes and all the space and facilities we needed for a week’s stay.  Margarita/Lyla’s communication was really excellent, before and during the stay. Prompt to respond and extremely helpful, informative, and friendly. (Thank you!) This made a huge difference to our trip overall, and took away a lot of hassle and stress, so I’m very grateful indeed.  Location suited our needs pretty well - especially for the price, you’re pretty damn central.  It was safe in the neighbourhood - we were two women staying alone and we felt very safe coming and going / walking around at all hours (we were out until around 11pm).  Of course, there is some street noise. It’s NYC! We stopped noticing this after the first night and slept pretty well through the stay.  Will miss this lovely little place - 10/10 would stay again.  I thought it was great value, spacious, well-equipped, and a great choice in comparison to anything else I could find.  It met all of our/my requirements and made a huge contribution to the overall enjoyment of our trip.  The boho chic touches were cute too!

Lawanna's place is a steal! Clean, charming, cozy and comfy. Great location near public transportation and an array of delightful restaurants.  A home a way from home. Spectacular host!  She is super friendly and gave me great suggestions of things to do in Brooklyn and the City. Going back to NY soon, hope to book with Lawanna again. Thanx Lawanna for such an awesome experience.

I thank Meela for the private bedroom, the room was extra clean and safe (solo woman) with air conditioner. Opening by code which is so perfect.  Nothing to say about the Kitchen, very clean.  Concerning the bathroom, it was always clean until some of the other tenant doesn't made their part of the job. so very often there was hair. but Meela was so responsive that 30min later, someone came to clean.  Thing to know: the sound of the tv of the over bedroom could be very unpleasant, but it's not the fault of Meela  All things considered : It worth it and I recommand.

First time booking and I cant stress how pleased I was! Lynette was a great communicator. She accommodated me with some request I had. The apartment is absolutely gorgeous. From the cleanliness to the value, I was extremely impressed. I will be staying again!

Great! Small room but the a/c unit was perfect and cooled the room down super fast. There was a MASSIVE spider on the drapes on my second night, I texted Meela about it INSTANTLY, and she got back to me right away and sent somebody to take care of it. The guy came and hit it with his shoe, and it disappeared… we don’t know if he killed it or it ran away… whatever the case, I was more afraid of not knowing where it was after he hit it… I had a nightmare that night LOL! But overall, it was a good stay :) spiders are scary but not worth taking a star away from my stay!

Excellent location close to several subway stations, full of varied shops around and with a super easy time to Manhattan. The house has all the locks with a password, which provides a great feeling of security. On the day of check-out, our flight was at night and she allowed our bags to stay in the house until it was time to go to the airport and when we returned from the street to pick them up, she still let us take a shower. Incredible experience, great value for money, I recommend it without fear.

Our stay was great! Inside the Airbnb was clean and had everything we needed. The only issues we ran into were the neighborhood is a little sketchy and the Airbnb smelled slightly like weed throughout our trip.

First, the good things:  + Wonderful location in the Upper East Side + Exceptional price for such a central location and in such a well-to-do neighborhood + Nice building with an elevator + The apartment has nice fixtures and is equipped with everything you might need + Good water pressure in the shower (turn it all the way to hot and then nudge down once you get hot water, it's very quick this way vs. nudging it up from cold you might be waiting a long time)   Things I didn't like:  + I was told *after* I paid the booking in full that the bed is an air mattress + I was not made aware that the stove doesn't work until I received the house manual + You have to either ask your taxi/Uber driver to stop at a 7-Eleven so you can pick up and drop off the keys, or you have to walk 0.3 miles with all of your luggage. I have a lot of luggage so I opted for finding Uber drivers who were willing to make the stops, but it was stressful for them because they had to wait in a bus stop or in front of a fire hydrant across the street. It was also stressful for me because I had to leave all of my belongings in the car with the driver and hope that a bus didn't come along and chase him out of the bus stop. The Key Cafe facility was not particularly quick and easy either—I was given a code with letters and numbers but there are only numbers on the key pad (eventually figured out that I could enter my mobile phone number instead, no idea how they expect you to enter a code with letters in it) and the fob scanner didn't work (eventually had to override the non-working scanner and type in the fob's serial number instead).   I can see a strong argument that having an entire apartment to yourself in this location for this price is worth the above three hassles, but I personally would not book again.

David was a great host! Our reservation was very last minute and late in the evening and David was quick at responding and letting us in the house.  The Airbnb was nicely furnished and the rooms were clean and tidy. The common areas were kept clean at all times and I felt very comfortable there. Comfortable beds and the AC was running very good. If you are looking for events, David will definitely help you out with that and any time we needed help with something he answered his phone every time. There’s a 7-eleven on the block about a 2 minute walk and a laundry mat 2 minutes away if needed.  Many people assume NY has dangerous neighborhoods but everyone minded their own business and didn’t cause us any problems. Several Mexican Restaurants around and the subway station is about a 5 minute walk. Great location in my opinion, takes about 15-30 minutes to get into any central location of NY. Would recommend, enjoy your stay.

David is a charming, kind and always smiling host. The apartment has been repainted, kitchen and nice space. Lack of insulation (street noise) the address was not the right one which causes stress. The bathroom is dirty the rest is clean.

Taio is a pretty responsive host. He respond my text really fast and he is pretty helpful when we need some help on the wifi or have any additional requests. He also allowed us to check in early.   His place is pretty closed to the subway, just 5 minutes walk and also closed to many local grocery stores.   His room is clean and large to fit three people. However, please note that the bedroom door cannot lock. It is just a partition door and it can make you feel unsafe.

Listing has the wrong address so we met a very frustrated resident of another building. Second try it was the building adjacent to the address we received from a cohost. The “room” is just the living room of the residents already living there repurposed. Which I didn’t know until I was abruptly met by one after using the bathroom which had no toilet paper and water for soap. The doorway to the room is a sliding sheet and a curtain, the heat was on full blast and the only bed in the room is pressed up against the vent which had a blanket on top of it which generated almost dangerous amounts of heat onto the pillows. The mirror in the bathroom has the daily stains of the residents and the mirror in the room was on the floor. The noise levels were fine on the weekdays, but on weekends it’s unbearable with the church across the street. The fridge was full so no groceries. Make sure to ask them how to unlock the front door, the cohost didn’t tell us so we were locked out late at night.

Staying at the Sonder was overall a good experience. However our AC was broken apart when we arrived and wasn't working. So it got pretty hot in the afternoon and at night.   We tried contacting and someone did get sent out, but we weren't informed beforehand so asked them to come back. They never did.   The sink in the bathroom also has some issues with drainage, it takes a long time for the water to go down which can be unpleasant when brushing teeth or washing your face.   Another thing we let them know about was the chair, I'm a very small person and I sat on one of the chairs. It snapped, but I believe it was already broken before I sat down.   Other than that, everything was amazing. Im currently in Jersey now and I wish I was still there. The location feels very safe and it's a walkable distance from many places.   The lobby is so clean and the attendants were all very kind to me.   The rooftop is amazing and I miss it! It's a very good place, our room just had a few issues is all.
Great place to stay in FiDi. Clean and well organized. Minimal stress stay which was ideal!

I stayed here when I first moved to the city and it made the transition so much easier. I was able to extend my stay multiple times, and the team always responded quickly. I’m someone that’s been very covid conscious so it was a little scary stepping into a new space, but it was evident when I walked in that the room was cleaned thoroughly and I felt safe the entire time. I’d definitely do it again, I fully recommend!

You were a great host up until the point we had to leave. We had a few hiccups because our ride to our next place fell through. So she basically kicked us out plus my dog because she was more worried about her next guest than to ensure we reach our next place safely (plus it poured rain all over us and our stuff while we were waiting on our Uber). I was out grabbing my check from work and told her I would be back, but I was late due to trains, so she took upon herself to move all of our stuff out to her car and put my dog in a hallway of stairs where it leads to another home or out the door, and sent me pictures of all that having me worried. She kept complaining that we were holding her up and stoping her from being a great host to the next people when she could of showed a little more concerned for us. She also cooks breakfast every morning which is great but not when there’s roaches and baby roaches flooding the kitchen. Every time I would move her plates around there be another roach popping out scaring me. I hate bugs so much and for her not to maintain that part and leave food out for guest while she has a roach problem isn’t the best thing in my opinion. I would of loved to eat some of the breakfast she cooked but could not bring myself too because of her roach problem. Other than the last day we were there and the roaches, her place was beautiful and almost perfect. She is a very sweet woman but was basically asking me to give her a 5 star rating..as much as I would love to do that, I cannot because of her roach problem, and the fact check out went all wrong and she didn’t show much compassion. She was more upset that she may not be able surprise her next guest with chocolate chip cookies because of our dilemma and in my eyes after we just paid you that’s disrespectful. We appreciate you accommodating us and I understand we were your second guest but life things pop up and you were not accommodating for us during check out. We will not stay here again, due to personal issues. I’m sure she’ll be the best host to others but she was very weird to us. Thanks again though for letting us stay at your home.

AMAZING!  I have been traveling to NYC for years and stayed at so many gross hotels and dirty Airbnbs.  This is exactly what the modern urban traveler is looking for!  Super clean which is huge for me.  All of the amenities you need.  Helpful staff.  I felt super safe (especially compared to some sketchy midtown hotels I've stayed at haha).  Highly recommend!

Gen had a very great location and it was a very nice neighborhood and surrounding. Many people think NY neighborhoods are dangerous but everyone minded their own business and didn’t bother us at all. Gen was good at communicating and fixing things when something was broke.  On the other hand, the house is cluttered with excess things and the smell is not good when you walk in. The shower drain was clogged and still clogged even after she fixed it. It’s very dark in there, so if you like natural light I would not suggest this.  Also, there is a pest problem. There are mice living in that apartment. I have seen one in the room I was staying in and you can hear the mice squealing and making noises in the common area. This is the reason we left immediately after we noticed this. Once we contacted Airbnb, Gen came and basically kicked us out late in the evening without giving us a chance to figure out a stay for the night. To sum it up, location was great but the bathroom was filthy and there’s a pest problem.

I had the most frustrating check-in experience with Sonder. Sonder requires you to upload a picture of the front and back of your license and of multiple angles of your face (but then why use Airbnb, Sonder? Airbnb already checks this stuff - what a time waste). I did as asked, and sent in the above information on their app about two weeks prior. The app confirmed it was sent and was being verified. Fast forward to the day of check-in, I realize they did not send my access code, so I have to call after a 5 hour flight and they inform me that they never received my license and selfie. Strike 1 - their app is garbage, and they said other guests have had the same issue. So then they send me a new link to upload my info again. Their app gives the option to take a picture with the camera or upload a picture. I uploaded a picture of my license I had ready from my phone, took a picture of the back, and took selfie pictures of my face angles. They proceed to tell me that I cannot use a picture from my camera roll. Strike 2 - they don't know how their stupid app works, and how it allows you to upload a picture from your camera roll OR take a new picture. Strike 3 - they made me do the whole process a THIRD time, with me taking new pictures every time. This is the most frustrating check-in I have ever experienced in my life.  The fact that they need this information at all is very heavy-handed and makes me worried that someone could potentially steal this license and/or selfie and use it elsewhere. Also, why if they never received my information the first time, did they not reach out to get it prior to the day of check-in?  The place itself was fine and clean, but I will not be staying with Sonder again based on this check-in experience. For the staff to be so officious about the exact format of the pictures, after their app had failed, made a stressful situation utterly ridiculous.

A HORROR. The accommodation has a construction site next door, right next to it. We woke up every morning with the floor moving because of the excavation they were doing. A danger, not to mention the noises that woke us up at 6 a.m. every day. The most unfortunate thing was the host's response saying that it was just noise from the street and that he recommended that we put earplugs in our ears. We spent 12 days demanding that they change us or give us our money back so we could go somewhere else, we never had a response, neither from them nor from the platform.

This place is lovely! Truly magical energy. I stayed for a month and the hosts helped me make it cozy and happy. The bed is extremely comfy and the views on either side are divine--trees and open streets and beautiful backyards, all with birds chirping just the right amount. The small touches are beautiful and make the apartment even more special. If you love reading, there's an amazing book collection. I didn't use the TV during my stay because that's not my thing, but it's very big! The AC doesn't reach the kitchen as easily on hot days, but the bedrooms can be kept cool as can be for a good night's rest. The hosts were extremely competent, accommodating, and quick to help if I needed anything. The man who lives downstairs, son of the owner, creates confusion and misdirection (and maybe stress), but as long as you just communicate with the hosts, both of whom are almost always immediately responsive, all will go well. I loved my stay at William's place!!!! It was so fabulous. I would 100% stay here again and I suggest that anyone who wants coziness, joy, and peace in their life. Have fun!

The apartment is in an amazing area that is close to everything you need. Within 2-3 blocks you can find a subway, multiple grocery stores and restaurants, shopping, Central Park, drug stores, post office, street food, etc.    It’s really a great size … especially for Manhattan. It was spotless, had plenty of supplies and storage and the bed was really comfortable with nice bedding.   Izi greeted me at checkin and responded immediately whenever I needed anything or had a question. I really can’t say enough about what an incredible stay I had here or what a great host Izi is.   I highly recommend this apartment or any other property Izi hosts.

The apartment is located in the basement of the building, this should be specified in the advertisement. However, the room overlooking a small interior courtyard is very quiet apart from a few inconveniences due to knocks on the heating pipes passing through the room very early in the morning during our stay. No doubt this should be resolved later according to Erv, our host. The apartment conforms to the description of the advertisement and is very clean. Bath towels were made available to us. Access to all kitchen equipment is very valuable. I really enjoyed my discussions with Erv who was very responsive and gave me good tips in the neighborhood. Erv is a very accommodating host because he welcomed us at a late hour even on a Sunday evening, which is very appreciated after a long haul flight. The apartment is well located because it is just 5 minutes from the C subway line which allowed us to connect Lower Manhattan in just 30 minutes, or even less by express train version. For the price and quality of accommodation, I recommend without hesitation.
Great place to stay! Very clean and we loved the area! Be careful when using the ap to find the address. We found ourselves in a shady part of Brooklyn.

The basement apartment has tall ceilings and big windows. It was clean and the kitchen was decently appointed. Nearby Nostrand Ave subway stop gives local and express access to the blue line. There are details about the apartment that could be better and we informed our hosts of them. But, overall, it was a good base of operations for a family of four and a place to socialize with friends.   We didn’t feel unsafe in the neighborhood but police presence is a regular sight. Garbage handling is a NYC-wide problem and it’s noticeably bad here: we had a number of rat sightings. (Airbnb’s garbage handling is good.)  One neighborhood highlight is the Children’s Museum a short walk away, including a large park.  Lastly, it should be noted that while hosts’ communications were a little lacking at time, they were very generous by loaning us a travel crib, baby bathtub, and an iron.

I was definitely afraid it wasn’t gonna be cute but when we got there we instantly loved the vibe we got when we checked in it was so beautiful and when we go to our room we loved it it was perfect for the two of us thank you for making our first night together special I will never forget will definitely book again 😊

For the price I paid, I'd say this place was a steal.. i wasn't a fan of the 100 bucks I had to pay when  I got there to secure the room..i guess I missed that part in the ad, the room was very nice and clean and the TV had cable with a nice selection to choose from.. the door key often had problems in the elevator, but other than that I enjoyed my stay..thank you

Chy's place was great - spotless and you can see she pays a lot of attention to the details. There was plenty of space for two couples, and the two bathrooms (one of them en-suite) came really handy.  I gave location only 4 stars because all the metro lines that go into Manhattan are 15-20 mins walk away. The neighbourhood itself is not the cleanest but we didn't have any issues or felt unsafe while walking home at night.  Not 100% sure about the situation of the building - it has three floors with three separate entrances. The host lives downstairs, this AirBnB is on the ground level, and there's another floor above it. Throughout the week we heard no noise from any of the other accommodations, but on our very last morning a group of people came to stay in the apartment above us. They kept pacing up and down while we were packing our things and it was really loud, you could clearly hear every floorboard creek. As I said this only happened on our last day so it wasn't an issue for us but I can imagine it's quite annoying if you keep hearing it for a week.  Overall we were happy with the accommodation and would be happy to stay at Chy's place again.
