Arlo SoHo is a steal! This place was way nicer than the price tag suggested. Location was perfect, staff were friendly and helpful, and the rooms (tho a bit small but that’s NYC for you) were clean, comfortable, modern and had great views! The rooftop, lounge area, courtyard and the market were an added bonus and we were able to get drinks at the bar or champagne at the market which was very convenient! 10/10 would recommend and would stay here again!

This had to be the worst stay ever! Bathroom was disgusting only because there was a creepy man who has been there for over 10 months he made the whole hallway and bathroom smell like cats he was so disturbing. He would come out of his room all throughout the day and night and stand by my door. It was scary because my door had a crack in it and you can see straight through. My brother had to approach him and ask him was he okay cause he was doing weird things. Besides that there was no heat!! I got a really bad cold because of it. And for over 9 hrs there wasn’t any hot water and I had somewhere I needed to be and had to cancel. I’ve learned my lesson with Airbnb’s I’ll just book a hotel next time. The room was beautiful but I did find things in the room from previous guest which was upsetting.

My family had a fantastic stay at Sarah's (5 days). It was our first time traveling with our baby (5 months) and Sarah was gracious to let us use any of her baby's items. This really helped take away my travel stress and it was a lot easier to have a nice crib, change table, baby bath, play mat, and books for baby.   This is a beautiful corner apartment in Williamsburg and it was such a great neighbourhood to explore the shops and restaurants. We were only a short walk (several minutes) to major subway lines at Marcy Avenue to get anywhere. We felt right at home and comfortable in the apartment - the plants, wall art and interior were very well done and cozy. The beds were nice and firm. The front door staff were very helpful whenever we had questions. The place was very clean and spacious, and it was really nice to have two washrooms. We would definitely stay at Sarah's again.

Best part about this Airbnb was that it’s right across the street from a train station so travel was so easy and convenient! The Airbnb itself was very clean and the perfect amount of space for two people. Only reason why I gave it 4 stars and not 5 is because the area it was in was a little sketchy.

Me and my partner stayed at Hershey's place and we loved it so much! Their flat was super clean, tidy and cosy. Also the bathroom was new and very clean. They provided everything we needed for our stay, including some lovely restaurant recommendations in the area.  The check-in was extremely smooth,  stress free and the communication was also great, Hershey has been always reachable.  Location was 10/10 too!  We can't recommend this place more, we will definitely come back!
Nice place but the 40 dollar fee was an unpleasant surprise.

Amazing spot! Incredibly clean and the hosts were so easy to reach. The apartment had a lot of space. The beds were very comfortable, and the neighbourhood was quiet. Lots of great restaurant and Ubereats options in the area as well!   The subway is close by and it takes you directly into Manhattan within 4 stops! We found it very accessible. There are local buses you can use as well, but we were able to make do with the subway. Just note that after dark the neighbourhood can feel a little sketchy.  We have stayed at a lot of Airbnbs and the hosting here was so incredible. I highly highly recommend Easton and his property!

Easton was a great host. He went out of his way to fulfill our request and was great at communicating with us. A few things to note for future guests is expect high Uber/Lyft prices if you’re trying to get to city or 45 min to 1 hour trips if you’re taking public transit to the city. Plan accordingly as it is a bit far from the Airbnb location. Wear comfortable shoes, a lot of walking was involved in our trip. The Airbnb is on the top floor of a four story building which means there’s a lot of stairs to climb. Besides all that it is easy to get around using public transit and there are a lot of restaurants and shops nearby. We never felt unsafe in our location and overall had a good experience. Thanks again Easton for being a wonderful host!   -Sergio & friends

We’ve spent a week in Happy’s place. It was exactly how it was advertised. The beds and bathroom were clean. We have felt like home. The only downside is that the neighborhood seems a bit unsafe, however, we haven’t experienced any threat. It was worth it.

My stay at Rob's place was great! The location was pretty convenient as it had some nice restaurants not too far away and the subway into town was really easy. The tv was big, couch that acted as a sofa as well was comfortable and good for watching tv after long days of walking around New York. Lots of different channels available to choose from as well.   Check in was really easy and the heater warmed the place up really quickly in the middle of winter which is exactly what you want! Towels were soft and complimentary toiletries and water were a big plus! it's those little things that you forget to buy that really help. The storage for drawers and clothes to hang was ample, more than enough for 3 people staying 13 nights so we were pretty happy with that. The kitchen also had everything we needed to eat in or cook something quick.  As a host, Rob was auper easy to communicate with, checked in to see if we needed anything and always responded to messages within a few minutes whenever I had a question. He was also very kind and welcoming of us into the apartment. We were also able to extend our stay with ease. Thanks so much for such a lovely stay, I'd recommend this as a spacious apartment to stay at and would stay again.

Rob’s apartment is very new comfortable and clean,  transportation is convenient subway is 3 minute away, Various stores are 10~20 minutes around the community，The kitchen is amazing has everything you need and Rob is willing to help and responded quickly. Shower is little difficult due to small amount of cold water，The front door‘s key is a bit difficult to open.

Everything was great, a great value for the place, in a VERY good location for going to Columbia, Central Park, and everything in West Manhattan.  I’m always scared of airbnbs at first, but Mir’s place and his staff is legit and a great value Airbnb for Manhattan!
Pretty good! But It was a little bit dangerous when I climb up to bunk bed. Overall, wonderful experience!

Nice place in a great location. very close to Central Park and subway stations. I didn't feel unsafe while walking at night around the site. I shared room with other two people, they were nice, so didn't have any issues with them. Bed was comfortable for me. I was able to use the kitchen which is great.

This air bnb felt unsafe and I have used this app many times in the past and have never felt this way before. We were a group of 9 girls and we felt like we were being watched by one of the neighbors. One of the times they left a creepy sign on the door as soon as we left to grab some food. Additionally, one of the doors was broken and didn’t fully lock, which added to our anxiety about feeling unsafe.   There were some pros, such as the 1 free parking space and Tawhid (host) being super responsive and attentive. Unfortunately, the cons outweighed the pros though.

This place is at a great location - on the northern edge of Central Park, and is super-close to the subway line. Violeta was a very responsive and friendly host, and her place is very clean and well-kept. The bummer for us: the place doesn't have cooling (to be fair, that's mentioned on the listing), but the room didn't have a fan either. We were visiting in June, and given how warm the weather was, it wasn't a very comfortable experience for us. And the wi-fi was a tad sketchy - we were out in the city most of the time, though, so it wasn't a big concern. Thanks for hosting us!

Overall amazing apartment. The location was a little scary I would never recommend going out at night however they had 2 locked doors to the apartment and they were extremely clean. Wifi was fast, tv was wonderful, and the bedrooms were very clean. The people upstairs were very loud at night and it became an issue a couple of times but other than this this was very good, 5/5 stars

Easton was a good host. He responded quickly and also did his best to fix the issues I had on the first night with the towels being stained and what I thought was mould in the shower. I have to be honest though, the place really wasn’t what I expected. The neighbours living above were often walking heavy footed around the place and being loud. This unit is quite dated, especially the shower, which, no matter how much was scrubbed, still smelled unpleasant. There’s gaps and cracks all over it, which are very hard to ignore, and there’s no place to put any toiletries, so you’ll need to put them on the floor. Sadly it all just feels extremely low effort for the price. There’s a stretch of carpet taped to the entry way that’s oddly laid out to stop you walking through with shoes on . There’s no full length mirror at all, so you have to make sure your outfit looks okay before you leave. It’s really disappointing to say the least; I would avoid it if you’re looking for somewhere of good value. Despite all that, it’s in a decent spot in Brooklyn, easy to access Manhattan and the Airport via Uber/Lyft or even public transport.

This is the best Airbnb you can possibly hope for! Not only is the location great and easily accessible, the apartment itself is spacious and clean, even by none NYC standards.  But the highlight was the gorgeous backyard space that we were able to use and enjoy during a very hot June weekend.  It’s very well kept and provides the perfect amount of shade. The owners live upstairs and are nothing but the most outstanding hosts, that are quick to respond and accommodate as best as they can.  Would stay here again, and would recommend to all my friends and family!

The little corner of water behind it was just relaxing. I took morning walks at the water's edge to see the bustards and ducks telling each other their stories. We felt safe there.  Mondy's mother was just wonderful ready to meet your every need. Everything was clean. I even extended my stay after a problem I had with my flight, and I'm ready to relive the experience next time I'm alone in New York.  Thanks to you

Katya as a host is amazing and very accommodating. If she hosts in a better location, I would definitely stay. If you're a Manhattan lover, you won't like this place. The room is very clean as in the listing/photos.   Pros  1. Clean bathroom  2. Clean Kitchen 3. Clean room, without any leakage or molds.   Cons 1. Room is too small. Maybe 65-70 sqft. That's it.  2. The area is too shady. There is garbage lying everywhere every time the moment you get out on the streets. 3. Both the metro stations, Bedford and Marcy Ave are atleast 15 mins walk. So, not at all close to subways which is a big issue for me.

My partner and I stayed for 2.5 months and had a great stay.   -The stay was very clean, and had a good amount of space.  -We had no issues with parking.  -The wifi was able to accommodate both of us as we worked from home and held video calls.  -Ivan was very responsive if we had any questions.  -We felt safe and there was a park nearby.   some things to note for guests not from NYC: - there is a toll leaving and entering SI to Brooklyn (~$6.50 each way)  - Don't leave anything valuable in or on your car. Our bikes were stolen after we left them on our vehicle for a couple :(

Just a heads up, the lockbox is very small on the side of the staircase. Place to enter the AirBnb felt kind of worn down and someone was living downstairs. Had trouble with the door because the deadbolt got stuck. There was no soap available and the shower didn’t drain which posed an issue for the four of us that stayed there. Host didn’t respond for a while and kept saying that he never had an issue with the door and that we could still shower. Understood where he was coming from but felt defensive, wish he understood more that these issues were very stressful to deal with on top of traveling. We couldn’t shower without the water going almost to our knees, so no we weren’t getting clean. He came to check it out but said he couldn’t get anyone to fix it the 5 days we were there. Was clean and had towels. Spacious. Looks like the pictures. Affordable.

Let’s start with the good points as I hate giving bad reviews- there is lots of space and the beds are relatively new and firm. The appt. is close to the subway with multiple buses to take you to it. However this stay was horrendous. On check-in the Internet did not work and the host asked us to troubleshoot. it took two days for it to get repaired and we the guest had to wait with the technician while repaired. host said he lived too far. Really not a good experience for a guess! Five minutes after the Wi-Fi was fixed the electrical in the room went out, and host never fix even though he promised to come fix. So no internet for the stay and no lights in the bedroom for 3 nights  Bad- Very noisy area, you can hear the cars drive by at night. The appt. is very dirty and hasn’t been cleaned for quite some time. Oven /toilet does not work. Smells like cigarette and musty carpet. There was mouse droppings in the kitchen cabinet and there’s cockroaches in the apartment.really unpleasant

We recently had a disastrous experience with this AirBnB on a trip to New York City. We were in NY for business appointments and a surgery. There were problems with the apartment, but we were eager to work with the host on them, but unfortunately he was dishonest.  We had to cancel all of the appointments the first two days (Day 1 we went searching for towels and Day 2 we met with the owner) to address the stained towels, dirty pillows, and the non-working shower. He promised us in person to refund the first night because of the spoiled textiles.   My husband and I struggled for three days with the faulty shower valve. The host admitted multiple times in writing it had been an ongoing issue and a problem before. He wrote: “Please let me have someone come tomorrow to adjust it and show me how [the shower] works. As I mentioned we had an issue before and it was fixed. If by tomorrow it doesn’t work I will refund you in full.”  He wrote that he would accompany a worker to repair the shower. We arranged in advance and in writing to leave the apartment for 24 hours and go to a hotel (since he had promised to refund us the first day) to give him time to fix the problem while I had surgery. We gave him written permission in the app to access the apartment while we were gone. I was in surgery all that day.  The problem with the shower wasn't addressed or fixed. He later tried to blame us for not being there to let the workers in! He said we should have known intuitively to have left the key behind for the workers, but he never instructed us to do so in his messages. Rather, he wrote us HE would be there with the workers (e.g. “Tomorrow my worker and me will be there first thing tomorrow morning."). [Airbnb told me he had said to them he didn’t want workers in there alone in case they steal?!?] In sum, he offered in writing to refund us if it couldn’t be fixed, and he had promised verbally to refund us for the first 24 hours. But he retracted both promises and wrote we were “awful” as an excuse for his failure to let the workers in. I saw he had similar complaints about the shower and dirty linens in his other reviews (look at his other listings for that building).    I am happy to share screenshots of the entirety of our communication.   I wrote when I got out of surgery and saw his app message that the workers had been there but he had not let them in, “Leo, How unfortunate we didn’t know to leave keys in a lockbox. Thank you for offering to refund our stay. […]We left the place tidy and neat, so that helps move things along too…Our stuff is contained, there is nothing of ours in bathroom. Clothes and suitcase are in the closet. We have food in the fridge and cooking and cleaning supplies on the counter in a bag, so Jack will be able to quickly collect things.  The apartment is going to be amazing and you were smart to get it in a lovely and friendly neighborhood. I am sure you will be a big success once the shower and textile issues are mastered.  But in the interim, I hope you can help us wrap up our stay and refund us.”  He wrote back that we are “awful” and to get out and he will NOT refund us and “good luck” finding a place to stay.   We were forced by these circumstances to leave the apartment three days into our stay. I have enjoyed Airbnb for years, but this one really shook us. My husband even had to leave the hotel at midnight to take a taxi ($166 RT) to get our belongings to move us out the evening of my surgery (I was supposed to be continuously supervised the first 24 hours post surgery but we had no choice) under duress we scrambled to move out and find hotels in NYC for the next seven days while I recovered. The story ends well with NYC hotels and staff being big-hearted!

Leo was a good host.  entering the unit was easy and instructions were clear. The unit is fairly modern, small but comfortable.  Most of the living area was fairly clean, however the carpets were dirty with hair. There is a strong cigarette/ marijuana smell in the building. The apartment was reserved for a total of 5 guests and we only found 2 large and 2 small towels making it difficult when we all had to shower. the towels were mixed with the cleaning supplies which made us question the cleanliness. The apartment description was misleading when discussing the location.  BE VERY CAREFUL WHEN BOOKING THIS PLACE. The apartment is located in the HOOD. The metro is around the corner, however the area is very dangerous and we were strongly advised against walking around after 8pm due to high crime rate. Be ready to spend a LOT of money on Uber/lyft. On average 50-60$ each way to Manhattan.  Overall, I did not have a good experience and would not return.

We arrived late at night but instructions were good and made checking in easy. Good central location. It does look a bit sketchy from the outside but once inside the unit it’s all good. Very clean and has pretty much all you need including an umbrella which we needed. Buy some coffee - there is a coffee maker and filters available which we used. Very easy access to subway and lots of shopping.

this spot is honestly a steal if you don’t mind taking the train and are somewhat of a New York connoisseur like myself who isn’t afraid of a little culture. the neighborhood is lively and as far as the place goes, it was very clean and spacious enough for 2, would definitely stay again.

The stay at Jeans was amazing and we will be coming back again. His communication was amazing and fast, he was a very understanding and accommodating host as we needed to check in way early and he was understanding and instantly made it happen. The apartment was exactly as described, so much so that I felt I had already been inside once we arrived. Clear and concise directions on how to enter/exit the house. The location was great as there was a market no more than two blocks away and a deli on every other corner. Not to mention getting to the subway from this place is a breeze( and that’s coming from a first time user of the MTA/ subway systems). The community was welcoming and helpful, never felt unsafe or unwanted when walking around the community.  Every time me and my sister were staring in confusion at our iPhone directions a member of the community would step in and give us direction and tips to help us navigate this beautiful city. I would 100% recommend Jean as a host any day.

We had a late flight so it was a bit intimidating finding the key, apt door and entry. We were also a little intimidated by the homeless couple (they were very friendly) who were camping at the apt exit door. Truly non-threatening.  Great location.  Close to the subway.  Once it was daylight we truly enjoyed our location and the atmosphere.

Great apartment! Pretty close to Madison Square Garden, which was the main purpose for our visit. We did have some trouble with people lingering right outside the front door which was slightly worrying as two girls trying to get into the building. Other than that, none of the men were outwardly rude and they did move on after we waited a few minutes on the opposite street corner. I would just be aware of this if you are looking at Maria's place. Overall we had a wonderful time and we didn't feel unsafe inside the building.

Our flight arrived at night, so I warned that I would arrive late at the apartment. When I arrived I couldn't open the safe that had the keys (the box was broken) I contacted Maria to explain what was happening but she told me that she couldn't do anything because it was late (it was 12 at night) and that I would have to go to a hotel. So I had to go out at that time to look for a place to sleep. The neighborhood is central, and close to everything, but it is full of homeless people and dangerous/uncomfortable situations with people taking drugs, etc. So at night having to look for a hotel was very unpleasant. The next morning they resolved the problem and Maria immediately refunded my money for one night. Of course, the amount did not cover what I had to spend and it also did not remove, in my opinion, the bitter taste of not being able to enter the apartment.  Otherwise the apartment is just like the photos, very nice, very clean, comfortable, with nice light. It has beautiful decor, the bed is very comfortable, and the rest of the stay was fine. I hope that from now on they can have options to offer a solution to guests if they have a problem, like on this occasion.
We had a great stay at Maria's apartment. It was close to subway and Times square, lots of restaurants. The only thing to note is that you will encounter lots of homeless in the area.

Easy access to the Javits Convention Center--short, straight and fast walk.  Such a clean apartment and spacious, quiet and more than enough room to make yourself at home for a few days.  Great restaurant at the corner of the block, lots of delis and markets. Up some flights of stairs, and lots of homeless around but that's given with the area---but still felt very safe, comfortable and had everything that we needed!

My partner and I recently spent a week at Maria's apartment.  I highly recommend the apartment. The location, quality and price were fantastic and I would stay there again.  I have been to NYC many times so I wanted to stay in walking distance to Broadway shows.  It was a fantastic location for Broadway, Times Square, Herald Square, the High Line and Hudson Yards.  Whole Foods was about 8 blocks away but there were also food markets on the same block and many restaurants in the area.  The laundromat around the corner had a good value wash and fold service (we collected our clean laundry within the day). There was also a store across the road which had a secure luggage storage service for $1.50 per bag per hour.  They opened at 10:30am, so we waited there after checking out at 10am on our last day and stored our bags for a few hours as our flight wasn't until the afternoon.  We walked to most places during our stay and the subway was about a 10 minute walk away.  If it's raining, you can use the bus terminal entrance on 9th Avenue as a short cut to access the subway.  Some other reviews mention homeless people out the front of the building. There were homeless people in the area and in most places around the city.  We didn't have any issues in this regard. We felt safe in accessing the apartment.  Everything in the apartment was well maintained and as per the photos.  The bathroom and kitchen were in good condition.  The kitchen had everything you need for cooking (stove, oven, pots, pans etc), a full size fridge, microwave and also some additional condiments.   The bed was really comfortable.  I am a light sleeper, so I would recommend ear plugs.  The air con blocks out some of the city noise but there is the occasional siren, truck or drunk person on the street who can wake you.  I am hoping to stay at Maria's apartment on my next visit to NYC.     Thanks Maria.  You were a fantastic host.
5 ***** Gerardo is a great host... With a  great place very clean don't let the camera in the living room scare you He's very cool and understanding Always a text away

Sida’a place was great! Very spotless and the property manager Tsherin was awesome too. I would stay here again. There was also another gentleman who helped with the Apple TV I just am forgetting his name.   The TV and the applications on it could have been updated, and some construction happening was unpleasant. But Overall, Sida did what she could to make us happy, and we are thankful! Book her for your large groups

Sida's home is renovated to high standards, with true & working AC; we've stayed in Aug, experiencing humid and challenging temperatures of F 98-102 / C 35-39. Don't be afraid of skipping the mainstream zones of NYC -  this part of Queens is safe, affordable, offering very, very good public transport connections to Manhattan. Queens Museum, a true hidden gem (free admission), is  just around the corner, next door to Flushing Meadows : US Open / Grand Slam and home to Jets (baseball).
An awesome place at an awesome location. The entire process was as stress-free as possible - as it should be. The hose was extremely amiable on top of it all

Highly recommended! It is exactly how it is shown in the photographs, the apartment is very spacious and cozy, comfortable bed, quite spacious bathroom and everything you need and a little more to spend the stay very cozy. The neighborhood is very quiet, especially at night, we always return around 1 am and it's super quiet around, you don't feel unsafe at all.

The apartment is just as described in the photos. Communication with Kimberly was very fluid at all times. The apartment is on the 3rd floor via stairs. As for the location, it is an 8-minute walk from the nearest metro station, however arriving at night can create an unsafe environment.

We were never able to check in because instructions were never shared and the host was unresponsive. I messaged Paola the day before our check in to see if we could check in an hour early. Didn’t hear back, so the morning of our date of check in, I messaged again. No response. At this point I was boarding my plane to NYC and getting a little nervous. The check in instructions for my reservation said “check with host”.   I called Paola at around 9:30, but it went to voicemail and the inbox was too full to leave a message. I called Airbnb at around 10 am before boarding the plane (check in is stated at 3). They confirmed that they couldn’t find any check in instructions and would try contacting Paola and would give her until 1pm to respond.  I landed in NYC at 1:30, and there was still no check in info. At this point, I had nowhere to stay for 4 nights and booking ANY hotel or airbnb close to LES or Soho was not feasible so last minute.  I called Airbnb again, they asked that we give Paola until 2:30 to respond….30 minutes before the set check in and 30 minutes AFTER I requested to check in.  At 2:30 there was still no response so Airbnb refunded me. Waited in the airport for an hour trying to sort that out and then scrambled to try to find a new place to stay. Luckily I found one, but the only place that was remotely similar in price and standard was a hotel in Williamsburg. Very different trip since I had planned my whole visit around the Airbnb in LES.  Paola did end up messaging me at around 4:30 saying she had meant to press send on the check in message but forgot/something happened. She also offered a free night but at that point, it was 1.5 hours after the set check in time and 2.5 hours after my requested check in and I had already checked into the hotel.  A VERY stressful start to my trip. Who wants to land in the airport and realize they have no lodging for 4 nights?    I honestly have never had a host just ghost me the day before check in. Really frustrating and I would not recommend.

Someone had broken into the unit when I was not there.  My friend and I locked the doors upon leaving for the evening, and when we returned, there was evidence that someone else had been inside the unit while we were not there.  This means that someone was able to break in, or they had a copy of the keys.   We left the unit immediately after seeing evidence that someone else had been (or was still) inside.  We then flagged down 2 police officers. They were able to escort us into the unit while we gathered our belongings.  They said they would wait for us outside; however, they left immediately after.   I relayed all of this information to the host, and they were concerned and apologetic. Because my friend and I could not stay there for because we believed it was unsafe, I requested a refund for the remainder of our trip. The host refused saying that we did not have a police report or evidence. We were not able to obtain a police report as they had left us as we were gathering our things.  The host also said that they had camera footage.  If that is true, then they would have seen my friend and I enter the unit, leave immediately, and return shortly after being escorted by NYPD.   They should have also seen an unauthorized person enter the unit as well. That should be evidence enough to deem our safety at risk, but apparently that is not the case.  I am sharing this because all of the doors were locked when we left, but someone was still able to get inside.  Someone was able to pick the front door or back door lock, or they had a copy of the key.      This was my first Airbnb experience with this type of incident. I understand that things like this happen; however,  the lack of resolution from both Airbnb and the host is very disappointing.  I would also be wary about staying here, as this is a garden unit.

Listed in their ad they had a crib stated in their description and I was privately messaged/it was confirmed it would be in our room when we arrived. Upon our arrival there was no crib in sight and no message stating where to find it or any heads up. When we realized this we reached out & didn’t get a response until the next morning. I’m never one to complain where I stay, but traveling with a baby is stressful enough and this made our trip very difficult in the beginning. They ended up ordering us a pack n play later which I do appreciate, but I don’t appreciate how long the response times were & how there was no prior communication.   Overall after this incident we had a good stay, we were just disappointed and wish we had better communication with our host.
for the price it is amazing for 2 to 4 people. the carpet squares need to be set or taken off the stairs they are unsafe

Marco was very friendly and his family members helped us when we needed it right away. Altogether, the place is in a great location - just 20 mins out of Manhattan. There are many grocery stores and shops nearby and also the subway.  There was free parking on the street which was great!   The washroom had some insects in it which we wish weren't there but shower worked fine. We also came home one night and the heating was not working which was scary because there was a blizzard that night. Marco responded quickly though and his kind brother fixed the situation for us. One more thing is I wish the door wasn't always left unlocked to the main apartment - anyone could get in which we found odd. The value was pretty good for the place - it just needs a few touch ups.

Lesa is my angel!!! She helped me a lot for my first time trip to NYC. When I couldn’t find the place she picked me up and saved me from danger! She is such a nice lady with kind and care! My bedroom is clean and comfortable. I slept very good like home. The bathroom is nice with hot water. I feel 200% safe in Lesa’s home.  It was a lovely stay there! Thank you Lesa for everything!!!
AMAZING! My fiancé and I travelled to NYC for the first time and staying with Ava made it so easy and stress free! She was truly an amazing host :)

Pros: The house is spacious and comfortable - it has a separate dining and living room apart from the bedroom. It has all the amenities that you may need. The location is also excellent - right in the middle of Hell's Kitchen and close to several bars/restaurants and other areas such as Times Square, Broadway, Central Park.   Cons: We had two main issues during our stay - (1) there was a mouse problem in the house which the owner informed us of only during check-in. He told us we should not leave any food outside - and we made sure to keep any food in the fridge and left nothing outside. Yet the mouse entered our bags and suitcases, chewed on things like the cigars we bought and spread it inside the suitcase. We could see and hear the mouse all the time. It was generally stressful and unhygienic to live with a mouse in the Airbnb. I think the owner should inform guests of this issue before they make the payment. (2) There is a noise issue - the house is right above two bars and since it is on the second floor, you can hear people loudly talking and screaming till 4 am. We couldn't sleep without earplugs.  But overall, we enjoyed our stay.

This place was amazing! It was much better than what I thought. The apartment is super clean and nice. The furnitures are comfortable as well. It has everything you need. Feel free to ask the host if you need something. He helped me a lot with the stuff I needed. He lives downstairs. I was a bit scared of the location but the location is actually really good. The surroundings are full of schools and courts. Feels safe to walk around. Also the subway station is like 5-10 minutes away. It’s super quiet during the night, this was the reason why I picked this Airbnb. There is some close food places as well like Burger King, Starbucks, Chipotle etc. there is a lot of street parking front of the building.   I had no issues staying here and would love to stay here again if I go back to NY one day. Highly recommend this place.

Well, this was the worst Airbnb experience I've had over the past five years- I feel hoodwinked. The location is fair for proximity to interesting events but in an alley that is filled with industrial businesses and trucks with significant traffic, creepy men, and significant noise during the day Monday-Friday, but fairly quiet at night and on weekends. The check-in process was confusing as the actual place is hard as it is above a commercial garage and to find among the many businesses and there are multiple doors, keys, and codes to navigate. Wifi login information was not readily available and I had to call the host for this. The pictures online are very flattering and this place is not nearly as nice in-person and it looks like an old industrial office that was converted to an apartment without any upgrades or consideration to make it comfortable beyond some half-dead plants. Overall, it has no style and is very drab and like a shabby bachelor pad with just the bare necessities that are generally low quality. No art to be found. This is a shame as it could be a cool space. Furthermore, it's not well maintained and we couldn't open the rooftop door nor close one of the windows. The showerhead popped off the first time we tried to use it and sprayed water all over me and a plumber had to be called.  The host told us the oven wasn't working, which was not critical for us but then there was a natural gas leak the second night that made us sick and we had to leave immediately. We wanted to leave the first day as it was not what we were expecting and should have because waking up to an extremely potent natural gas smell and finding another place to stay at 4 am was not how we wanted to spend our vacation. We had headaches and were nauseous for the rest of the day and had little sleep. Pros: Sean, the host, is kind and highly communicative, a close walk to trains and music venues. Cons: Everything else is pretty awful and potentially an unsafe space. Don't waste your money or your precious time here. We went to a 5-star hotel nearby for $50 more a night, and I regret not doing this sooner.  The host told us after people had complained about that smell but he didn't know why and was looking into it. Overall, just go somewhere else for your peace of mind and safety.

We stayed with Sean for a weekend of shows in the area. The space is absolutely huge (especially in comparison to similar rentals in the Brooklyn area) and the private rooftop was such a nice feature to have (it is quite big). Sean also had a collection of living plants scattered around the apartment which made for a nice experience. Check in / check out was easy and straight forward. Although the area has a lot of graffiti and when we first arrived we second guessed if we were staying in a good area, we never felt unsafe during our stay. Living in Baltimore city for 6 years, I think there is a big difference between run down and unsafe. The area is a bit industrial and can come off as a bit rough on the edges, but we ran into people living on the block and really did feel safe the entire time. If we come back to the city for a show and are in the area, we'll most likely request for another stay.

The place was clean and the location was nice! We selected and requested to bring our cats and apparently how Airbnb shows it online Pharo missed it. The other guest in the space complained about our cats due to his girlfriend’s allergies, which almost caused us having to leave and finding another place for the night. Fortunately Pharo allowed us to stay for the one night we booked, but the scare definitely didn’t leave the best aftertaste. Lesson learned, for any Airbnb you book, make sure to mention your pet selection in direct messages in addition to your selection before arrival. 👍🏼

My stay at this Airbnb was very disappointing. To begin with the place was NOTHING like what is advertised. The place is SUPER small and very disappointing. The unit was so cold I might as well sleep outside. The room was not cleaned, the room had dusty and hair everywhere. The blanket that was provided was useless, I had to get my own blanket to keep me warm. My first day was horrible and very hard to get a hold of the host but once I did he did start communicating at a decent time. I asked him if I was the only one staying in the unit, he assured me I was. That was a lie, the next morning when I was using the bathroom I walked into the next guest which scared the hell out of me because I wasn’t covered up properly, since I was suppose to be there alone.  Place needs a lot of TLC. It looks run down, nothing like the pictures and horribly built. The host was pleasant he tried to accommodate me by offering wine or water and a free extra day . I wouldn’t recommend or stay here again.

Amazing,such a treat,perfect location,felt safe at night n so close to metro n good coffee.the balcony was so rad n it was wildly spacious. Small shower n could use art but overall a totally steal!would love to stay again for future visits.

I just want to start out by saying, I don't usually give back reviews because I do my home work, this was a fast booking. I was not impressed with the area at all, dirty and absolutely no parking. the communication with the host was terrible, I was assuming they could not speak English because I sent a few messages and I did not recieve a text back. The place is located In an chinese area so to get help from anyone isn't the best, because they didnt or acted like they never understood me. It was pouring outside when I arrived, there are a few buildings that have the same number 42 on them so in the rain with a baby was very hard to find the building, so I asked a few people but none would reply, I did not know how to translate to Chinese. I did eventually find the box hanging on a fence , there was several boxes. I went to the lock box that was already unlocked so that was a security issue for me. I made sure I took the key out and change the lock box code so it doesn't stay unlocked. I went upstairs to find little drug bags on the stairs case in front of the door.  mind you when u unlock the door u have to turn left and not right, right will unlock it but the door will not open, left will open the door but once letting go it locks it right back, I did not know so at first I couldn't get in. I called and called.  Jason I assumed called me back when I ran back to see if there was another key in the lock box so I missed his call.  I did figure it out. I sent Jason a text apologizing for the call I did get in finally. I actually waited till today to hear back from Jason, all now Jason has  not replied back.. I explained my concerns all now I have not heard nothing. I didnt give him a low score because the place is clean, but the couch and white chair do need shampooing, especially the white chairs it's very dirty. there's some sort of pest in the house because I seen traps. I do usually stay in exceptionally clean places and this was mid. The only thing I didn't check out was the cooking utensils, it was such a short visit I didn't cook. 1 more thing, when I went back to put the key back in the lock box it was unlocked again! I text him once again, showing my concerns, still no reply. It's very concerning if someone around the neighborhood knows the code because they can easily copy a key and be inside waiting for a person like me, I did not travel with my other. I did have 3 of my children with me, 1 was a baby. I'm sorry Jason but I do have to leave a honest report.  I did wish you contated me back with my concerns.

Just ask if you will have access to the entire place before you book.  He has a very vague way of answering direct questions.  This is in no way me attacking Mar just go over what your getting and watch out for hidden fees.

My stay here was excellent! The quick and precise communication from Brenda made my stay easy and stress free. The location is  great. It was quiet and relaxing. I would come back here, no questions asked!

The place is as you expect, a  hostel. In terms of hostels, Michael did a pretty good job of housing. He is a very hospitable host and also very accommodating. It is also comfortable for a smaller person (5'6"). Temperature was not a problem for me.   Now for some small critiques.  1. The rooms are a bit tiny. For me, it worked, but I can see for someone over 5'10", it might be a tad tight.  2. I wish the bathroom were bigger and more comfortable. The stalls, showers, and sinks are pretty tight and tiny. Everything is in one area for a floor of 20 I believe. It can be a little uncomfortable. But otherwise, it's relatively clean.  3. Each room has a meshed ceiling, but I would have preferred a closed top for more noise cancellation. Not sure if that is a safety thing or not, but I would liked it.  4. This is not an issue for the establishment, but there are a couple homeless people as you step outside. Not ideal, but also, not a dealbreaker.  5. My stay ended up being on the 4th floor with no elevator.  It is what it is, and if this is what you are going for, I believe it will work for you. Michael is great and deserves the superhost title.

MaElena was extremely helpful in getting us to her place easily and stress free. She was fully available for information about the bnb itself, as well as local restaurants and events, without being intrusive.  The location was great for our purposes related to Columbia University.  It had everything we needed. It was quiet even though it was on an dynamic street, again everything one could need right in the neighborhood.

I didn’t stay long, but for the price it’s a steal of a value. Anyone would be lucky to stay at Jakob’s place. He’s very friendly and accommodating and the room was nice and peaceful with a bathroom right by it. Would definitely come back.

This was THE BEST Airbnb I have ever stayed at!! MaElena is the kindest, most welcoming host. She met me at the apartment when I arrived and showed me around the place. She made sure I felt safe and answered all my questions as this was my first time staying in NYC by myself. She also was very flexible with timing, as I arrived at the apartment later than originally planned. She was very communicative and told me to not stress and take my time getting there. She is SO kind and truly made the experience amazing!  STAY HERE! The welcoming nature you will be met with will make your stay in NYC feel like home. Thank you, MaElena!!!

It is important to clearly explain the location of the property. I would’ve appretiated If I would’ve known that it was located on a lonely area in the back of the house. It was noisy, a baby crying the whole night, every night, people screaming in the house, I did not feel safe and definetly not good value for money ratio. This was the worst experinece I’ve had in my time using Airbnb. The host was not receptive to any of my request and of course, refused to refund. I originally boodked 5th to 10th but had to leave the property on the 7th due to I felt unsafe, the host rejected to refund the 3 remaining nights eventhough we left at 11 am on the 7th, I felt cheated. This was a very bad experience indeed.

What a steal!!! Blessed to find a spot open on one of the busiest weekends !!! For under $100 in the heart of NYC I’m still dreaming cause can’t believe it was real. Thanks a a million , room was perfect for my size lol but never complained had cold water after a nite of drinking to sober me up. And slept like a champ with my headphones on.

Amy and Dan have been very friendly at all times. The location is very good to be able to get away from the center of Manhattan with its prices and the apartment is fully equipped and everything works perfectly. As a big defect, in the two months I was there I found a cockroach up to 3 times. I think it is not so much because of the cleanliness of the apartment itself but rather that it came from outside but it was very unpleasant. A shame because otherwise it is very good.

So... This is a hostel, not a traditional airbnb I would think, which was a little shocking when I got there.  Pros:  1. Hosts are very nice and pleasant to talk with. Mike was there in the evening and Michael in the morning. They stayed in the pod next to mine and I felt quite safe. 2. Location is great.  3. The value is unbeatable in NYC, especially for single traveler like me, checking in late night, sleep, and checking out the next morning. 4. It's relatively clean and quiet. Most guests respected others and kept noise down at night. 5. It feels like an old dorm if you like that feeling: guests share 3 shower stalls, 4 restroom stalls and 2 sinks.   6. When I asked Michael if it's safe to walk around at night alone, he said should be fine especially there was a concert nearby that night and he said "just walk fast". I was like holy cow what did I do to myself. But I actually felt quite safe. I checked in almost 10pm and it was busy and bright on the street.  7. Free street parking- on a busy day, if you don't get a parking spot by the apartment building, you may park at a commercial parking spot, which means you will need to move your car by 7am (like me...) 8. They have security cameras inside and outside and the hosts monitor it closely. Women and men stay in different floors, and the entrance to each floor has a lock, which made me feel safe. Cons: 1. It was a little scary at first when I got there. It's a whole floor divided into many tiny pods and felt a little crappy... Ventilation didn't seem very well so air was not fresh.  2. The trash can in my room was not emptied. 3. Restroom can be cleaned a little more often.  In summary, this is not a top-notch airbnb as you may have experienced somewhere else, and for this price, I wouldn't expect that either... it's a great value and served my purpose. Strongly recommend to people with a tight budget.

Unfortunately this ABB was not as advertised. Your description and instructions were quite inadequate or incorrect. It was difficult to get into the ABB. It was not clear which lock box to use (there are 3), the lock to the gate was a pain to try to open. It was so hard to open, we almost left without even getting in to your unit. It was unsafe to have us lock this gate and doors at night if there was a fire, there was not a quick escape. The gate was horribly hard to lock and unlock. We did not know which door in the hallway to enter to get into the ABB, very confusing after a long day of travel. There are NOT TWO beds, there is one bed and a broken Sofa. There is not a Garden View. We found two dirty chairs and table under a dirty porch with horrible stuff all over it. Again, it Was not a garden view. The front window blinds were broken when we got there and the bottom of the backdoor, kitchen area was already chewed up. There was not a hot tub! There was not an ironing board, safe, ceiling fan or air conditioning.  I did not see the ethernet connection, fire extinguisher, first aid kit, patio or balcony, back yard (that you list in your amenities) The TV did not work, nor was there any internet. There are no instructions on safety exits for your ABB, especially with bars on all the windows and having to lock the gated door and front door. My husband got sick every night because of the stuffing air in the room. He could barely sleep here. We paid you a lot of money to stay in your ABB. So hoping it was as wonderful as you stated, especially for our future visits to NY. But your description is inaccurate and misleading. We paid for more than we got that is for sure. The location with great, the full stock kitchen was great and the cleanliness was much appreciated. But unfortunately there was so much NOT great.

As described. Will come back. Reasonable priced. Great host  Host is a very nice welcoming person. Happy to meet him. Place was confortable.  Neighborhood is a little rough very late at night, as described; but did not felt unsafe. People are doing their own business; you should too.

It’s a nice place, The host wasn’t there so their girlfriend let me in and they were cool Ig.  it’s right next to a train track and they pull the horn all day and night.  it’s clean and really close to a subway station.  The neighborhood is a little scary and loud but everyone is mind their business. ( I saw someone shit on the sidewalk)  one thing happened, their roommate forgot or didn’t have a key into the building and woke me up at 1:00am.
Unsafe neighborhood, people dealing drugs in front of the front door.

The communication with Trenton was perfect, he is a prompt host. The apartment is organized and the room is confortable. Stay in Central Harlem you seems to be a  feel unsafe, but for me brazilian that I'm used to São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro I felt more safe than in Brazil.

We had a great stay at Aileen’s! The apartment is in a great location—lots of bars, coffee shops, and restaurants nearby, pretty close to Prospect Park, and a 10 minute walk to the subway to Manhattan. We walked back from the subway pretty late at night a few times and it never felt unsafe or uncomfortable. The apartment is clean, spacious, and had everything we needed.  Be aware that there’s only a window AC in the bedroom and a fan in the living room. We were there during a heat wave and it still wasn’t a problem—the bedroom AC was good for sleeping and we didn’t spend much time in the apartment during the day. If you’re planning a hot-weather trip where you’ll be inside a lot, just keep that in mind.
Great home. Well located, I did not feel unsafe there at anytime despite hanging out pretty late. Very nice host, understanding and helpful! Would book again.

I regret choosing this place in Brooklyn. The outside area is scary. When I arrived the access was confusing and I wrote to the host, without having answers. I knocked on doors of other apartments in the building and one of them opened. A man came out who was in his room smoking and acting confused. I asked him and he showed me a door that wasn't mine, so I left. Then the same man told me I was online via video call with my host and found my stay. But when I entered that place in the basement, the feeling of insecurity invaded my mind. The doors weren't secure enough and everything smelled funny and bad. I felt like my life was in danger there. And that's why I left, even knowing that I wasn't due a refund. My peace of mind is worth more than what I paid. The host answered me after half an hour. It was truly a horrible and scary experience. I had to go to a hotel and lost the money.

Group of 8. Our host kept us waiting outside the apartment for an hour and a half. She left no instructions on how to get in to the building, said bluetooth “couldn’t connect” which is why she couldn’t buzz us in, and had us waiting for an additional half hour as she had to come and unlock the door manually. The area of the apartment is sketchy, with half drunk men and drug dealers standing outside and trying to speak to us. We were worried for our safety. When the host arrived, she acted like she hadn’t inconvenienced us and just unlocked the door to the apartment building, while also letting in the drunk men with us. When we got inside, she said that she had left our apartment unlocked (What?!) It looked NOTHING like the picture. Tiny living room that could only host 8 people if we were stacked on top of each other. Air mattresses had holes in them, and we had to keep refilling them. It was uncomfortable, very loud from all the people outside. We felt unsafe. We left the next morning

My stay with Jonathan was amazing! The home was very clean, and very spacious as there were 6 of us staying for the week. The walk to the subway is about a 5 minute walk which is very convenient. I will say that the area isn’t very nice and I recommend not staying out as late. I was with a group so walking back at 3am didn’t scare me but I know that if I was alone or even with just my boyfriend I would’ve been a little creeped. Over all though I really enjoyed the place.

this airbnb is nothing like the description. it vaguely looks like the pictures as the entirety of the apartment is not clean. they also did not explicitly state that the common area was shared in the description. the kitchen was visibly dirty.  upon arrival, the common area had a weird, unpleasant smell (like feet or cat litter?). there was no loose sheet on the bed and it was very clear the place had not been thoroughly cleaned. stray black hairs were everywhere, surfaces were clearly dirty, the comforter had stains on it, the shower/tub was dirty, lots of dust, the pillows were flat, and there was no remote to the smart tv. the toilets did not flush properly and we had to lift the lid up to flush the toilet multiple times. we even had to clean after we got there for our own comfort and safety, especially being in the midst of a pandemic.   to top everything off, we only had one roll of toilet paper and ran out of soap hours after arriving (the host was reimbursed us, but it was an inconvenience nonetheless to have to walk to duane reade to buy toilet paper and hand soap). to note, “breakfast included” means use their food and cook it yourself.   moreover, we were awkwardly confronted by the doorman who informed us that the host renting out a room to airbnb guests wasn’t allowed in the building.   the view is impeccable and the space itself has immense potential, it just feels very wasted.
super sketchy no answer from host felt unsafe in a basement with lockbox’s for locks other guest super noisy think i didn’t spend nomore than a hour in this space until i booked another airbnb

We spent a 10-day stay in this very cozy and comfortable accommodation and we felt at home. Very bright, clean and identical to the photos. We did not meet Edward but he was very responsive to our messages and calls to facilitate our arrival. Edward was accommodating to shift our departure time according to our return flight to France. We highly recommend this accommodation, very well located 5/7 minutes walk from the metro, which is appreciable given all the kms on foot covered. The neighborhood is typical and we felt safe.  Don’t hesitate a minute about this choice!

Hello .  You don’t go there . He is super Cruel he didn’t  like  me . He didn’t accept me out of the blue. He is creepy. He told me come to 2 pm to dos Check in then he says   no then yes . He is bipolar . I call Airbnb and then they gave me my money back after many calls . DONT STAY HERE ever . 🙏🙏🙏

PLEASE READ  *NO STOVE  First, after booking a 5 day stay ,  I received a long list from the host about what not to do such as don’t be loud when coming in because of elderly neighbors.  Also, I was told don’t speak to the neighbors but if they speak to us to not say we are staying in an AIR BNB but instead say we are staying with friends (whatever that means).  Upon entering the smell of the plug in aromas was so overpowering I had to unplug all of them from each room.
