Due to that they issued us s full refund and we had to cut our stay short to one night.

Faysal was a great host! We needed to quickly vacate our apartment for a few days due to a pipe burst and he made it easy/stress free. Great location and area.  Be sure to FULLY read the house rules and expectations. You will be held accountable.   -Thank you again for everything!!

This place was the worst Airbnb my family and I have ever been to, we had to request a cancellation as soon as we enter but had to stay for 2 days while we confirm another location. As soon as we enter the place smell of feces, stove has a lot of black smelly dirt around it, the fridge is rusty with drinking glasses on it, my kids were bitten by various bugs, the mattresses on the beds are extra thin with flat no good pillows, no tv or closets in rooms, after check out host accused us of stealing 3 towels and demanded $45. This place will only fit the requirements of a Junkie, beware!!!!

Valeries place was beautiful. Cozy and very clean. She had extra blankets and towels for us. The pictures matched the place very accurately. The first 2 days we traveled by subway which was a first time experience for us. The walk was about 2 or 3 blocks so not bad at all. The only thing about that is I felt a little afraid at night in the neighborhood and we were a little further away from downtown Manhattan than we had anticipated. We had quite a few stops by subway which made it a little harder especially after we had been out shopping. Our last 2 days we decided to rent a car. The downside to that was parking. It took us 20 minutes just to find a spot we circled the blocks a few times til we finally found a spot and had to walk to the house. Other than that everything was great. Valerie was a great host and quick responses. I would recommend. Thank you Valerie🙂

This is NYC, so the mindset to begin with is: be thankful for any habitable shoebox you can find. I arrived with the right mindset, however, I traveled with my 14 year old daughter and the environment especially at the building entrance to the apartment is somewhat too harsh reality for a girl her age. I would not go back there. the building is shared by about five different renting companies and there's sort of an improvised long hallway to reach each reception and elevator. It is crowded and a part of the population made it feel unsafe.  The thing I regret the most is the fact that looking at 3 or 4 star hotels the day before traveling I found great options for half the price. In the apartment, the sheets and towels seemed old and have been used many times. there was discoloration on all towels. The shower had hot water but was very dark, though not unsafe. The toilet seat was rocking every time I sat on and for some reason its water pipes were constantly noisy. City location is very good; close to Penn station and to many subway lines.

Pros: The place was clean & as described.  Parking was fairly easy depending on the time of day.  The floors are thin & creaky so take that in to consideration as there is another residence immediately under.  CONS: The keypad to enter the home didn't work so we always had to call security to be let in & again to lock the door when leaving, which was EXTREMELY annoying.  Eventually they gave us app access instead.  TRIPLE CHECK the lock after entering/exiting to make sure its actually locked.  I woke up a few times in the middle of the night with the downstairs door to the outside WIDE open, which was scary considering that I had a toddler in the home with me.  I called security so often about the lock (& sent a video for proof of it being faulty), that they eventually did a 3-way call with the actual manufacturer.  If you experience any issues make sure to resolve them before checking out - I've been trying to reach the host for 4 days regarding promised reimbursement to no avail.

Mike’s place is perfect for short or long term stays. I spent my first month in NY here. The place is exactly as described and accurate to the pictures. It’s a safe residential-feeling neighborhood and 10-15 min walk from great restaurants and bars. Subway is an easy 15 min walk, it’s 5 mins walk from the waterfront and an easy 10-15 min walk to Astoria park which is beautiful. Mike is an exceptional host - very quick to respond and help with any questions or issues, proactive and well organized. The place is really clean and very well stocked with everything you need. Instructions are clear and simple. All in all this is a no frills, low stress, very comfortable and well located stay. Highly recommend!

Fabiola did everything possible to solve any problems with the accommodation. She is an excellent host. The place is just as in the images. It is a quiet neighborhood but you can't trust it, on the main street (Liberty Av.) there are many nightclubs and spending the night can seem unsafe. I recommend walking along the street below (107th Av.) as a precaution. I returned late many times (01:00AM) and nothing ever happened to me. Even so, reducing the risks does not hurt. Nearby there are many places for food, clothing, supermarkets, among others. The accommodation is about 15 minutes walk from the nearest metro station. If you want to save on accommodation to visit New York and you don't mind leaving early to start your day of adventure, I recommend this accommodation for the price-quality ratio. The room is comfortable, the bed is comfortable and the shower has good pressure and hot water.

This is one of my favorite parts of Brooklyn and Paul’s spot is right in the heart of a fun, walkable neighborhood along with being an easy subway ride to Manhattan. He was super responsive and provided easy instructions for getting around and finding his place. For the price, this is a steal if you’re looking for a comfy room in Greenpoint.

I rely so heavily on reviews when making a booking decision. I usually will only book an air b and b with 40 plus stellar reviews. When I booked this unit had no reviews but it was in walking distance to my child’s dance program so I felt it was worth taking the risk. I think its always important to list what was good first.  The good *Fairly priced. *Depending on your travel reasons you may like that its close to the hospital. *The listing says pet friendly if you have a pet. *Key fob access building  *Giselle is fairly responsive. *Laundry on site.  *Close to a bodega and coffee shop *Very close to subway and markets *Unit is pretty quiet inside with mostly offices inside *Couch that previous review mentioned being broke looks replaced.  The not so good and why I rated this listing a bit lower. *Each day I saw questionable people outside the unit sitting right out front of the unit often doing drugs. In the morning there was often remains of it on the dirt of the nearby trees. Inside the unit it felt safe. * The building is not lux (listing should have said old building with updates) this felt like false advertising. It is a very old building with updates but still incredibly old. The photos look different than in person. The hallways looks very rundown but its just old not their fault but by no means a lux experience.  *Pillows and towels were stained looking and need replacement. I actually soaked the towels in a bucket of oxiclean to remove most of the staines and re-cleaned the entire unit a day after I checked in. It could have been cleaned better. *It was not managed only by Giselle. Property management was involved and a superintendent. I mention that because on check in for whatever reason the code was not working for us and we were left outside and the area is pretty sketchy at night. There were junkies and mentally ill people approaching us and Giselle had the propery manager call us and I really did not have a way in the building until a tenant saw me and my daughter standing outside in the dark with questionable people approach us and let us in. Giselle later told us the code did work and other renting got in and there was not a willingness to come to the unit and see if we were safe. Even if there was a code entry error on my part which we tried multiple times after talking to air b and b they felt she should have come to the unit to help us get in.. Air B and B did let me know a host should do this and she is not able to use a property manager or superintendent as her listing did not disclose this. They said it went against their host guidelines and asked for permission to correct her on this but I felt really uncomfortable staying there if they were going to talk to her so I asked them to follow up after I checked out.   The unit advertises access to a laundry room but when you come in their is a rules list that tells you that you need approval from property management to use the laundry room and when you comtact them you cannot use it on weekends. Air b and b did say this was a false listing they asked me to send a screenshot. They told me once again Giselle did not disclose the property management part. If you have an issue your also asked to call property management and if they can’t reach the super they say “sorry there is nothing I can do he’s not answering his phone.”  The listing also mentions the use of PPE form cleaning personal and this was not the case. I am seriously immune compromised and this was the main reason I booked the unit. We had a clogged toilet and the super entered the unit without a mask. The cleaning lady does not wear a mask. I know because she knocked on my door at 9:52 on checkout was 10 am I felt pushed out of the unit when I was gathering my final items and she was not wearing a mask. I am going into all these details because my daughter did get ill on her stay and the lack of safety measures were evident and that was the main reason we choose this unit. We wear masks everywhere even in 100 degree weather outside.   *The area was pretty sketchy especially in the evening but there is some security outside. One afternoon a man pulled down his pants and exposed his private parts to me as I was walking by. I don’t feel this is Giselle’s fault you can’t control an area but I think because of the location of the hospital it does attract a mentally ill population and likely those trying to score perscription drugs and its good to know what you may see if you stay here. *There was a roach in our unit and one in the laundry room. When I asked Giselle why pest control skipped coming she said they came the week prior while I was out but this was not true as we did not leave the unit the week before due to my daugther being ill. When I told her this no reply.   Giselle was quick to reply half of the time she was super helpful and other it felt dismissive. I think she did try as much as she could I just think having so many people manage this unit lessened the experience for us.  There are reviews on some of her other listings that state similarly on helpful versus not so helpful responses. She also gets many positive reviews so I think its important to share that some of had different experiences than us at other locations.

Was a super nice place for me and my girlfriend to stay at for a few days the area seems dangerous or whatever but it’s actually pretty chill and really close to NYC the jacuzzi is lovely and relaxing not really anything to complain about :)
Apartment was really clean and lovely. Sofia and Leah were kind and quiet. Excellent location!!! Cannot stress that enough.

Space very clean & cozy! Love the set up & efforts put into keeping entertained & safe. I had a mommy-getaway set up for my wife & the steal was a sign lit with words “It Was All A Dream!” It was all a dream for her indeed 😃 Would definitely book again!

Neighborhood is the best i've seen in brooklyn. Extremely safe! 7 minutes walk to subway station  House is really good, Leah takes care of it. She also takes care of you as a guest  I am oriented on details. I know what good product means. But Leah is just unbelievable. She will make you feel like home, shares everything and helps in everything. She does not treat you like a client, but like a family member.  Her dog Toby is amazing, i am very sad that we could not reach friendship. He is very afraid of people

The apartment is super well located, just a few seconds from the metro. I was afraid it would be tedious to reach Manhattan but in 25 minutes, we are in Time Square and we don't see the time passing. Small bonus, we are barely half an hour from Coney Island, which we certainly would not have visited if we had been staying elsewhere! Right next to the subway entrance, there is a super convenient convenience store and opposite the apartment there is an entrance to Prospect Park. Access to the apartment is very simple and Ayanna is available, responsive and very friendly! The apartment itself is very large, very well heated, the kitchen is well stocked and you can easily cook. Ayanna had provided us with a basket with hygiene products (perfect for my partner who had forgotten his toothbrush at home :D). The noise of the metro did not bother us at all and the bedding is of very good quality! In short, I recommend!

The place is exactly the same as in the picture, just space for two people. There is an air-conditioner that was very useful for avoiding the heat of the room in summer. There is also a TV with Netflix and other streaming services that was nice to watch some movies. The bathroom is okay (the shower worked good), but the door is too hard to close (you have to push it hard to accomplish it), but is not imposible. The kitchen has the minimum tools to cook, but we could managed to do it twice eitherway, so it fullfilled its duty. About the neighborhood, there are supermarkets, stores, a laundry just in the 1st floor ($2.75 per wash), and you have the Little Italy and a couple of subway stations nearby (distance walking). The only thing we didn't like was the amount of homeless people that you can see here, there is a lot of them in the nearby square, but they are not really dangerous at all, they just will ask you for money and that's it. In summary, it's an affordable place to stay if you want to almost just sleep or spend the night in here, but you also can try to cook if you want and save some money.

Clean and affordable room to rent. Parking is available and easy even for my truck. Kinda sketchy neighborhood at night though. But have to go through Security fence with lock to get to rooma and there are dead bolts on room doors. Felt very secure when in room. Thanks Wanly!
Michael is a generous and informative host. The rooms are clean and cozy. This place is a steal if you're looking to stay in Manhattan.

Lol, it was false advertising. It’s a hostel and the shared bathroom was awful. And to top it off - the host was evicted by NYC authorities! Lol. I was taken care of by the caretaker landlord, but the eviction caused so much unnecessary stress. The caretaker landlord ended up being way more hospitable than the (evicted) hosts themselves.

The floors were sticky, there was a whole in the wall, used products in the bathroom, nasty shower cap, used razor in the bathroom, unstable ac unit, the tv was stuck on wide when i plugged in my console, there was a creepy bull picture facing the bed and a mirror facing the bed with a room behind it covered by a curtain inside the studio, the bathroom drain looked displaced in some way. Overall this was a bad experience for me. As well as I didn’t like the neighborhood I was in.

The apartment was clean. The location was fantastic and provided me with an easy commute downtown each day. The hosts checked in frequently to ensure that my stay was going well. For the price I stayed at, this place was a steal. I would stay again and recommend others do the same.

for the price it was okay. Place needs maintenance and could use a whole deep deep cleaning though. There was a very weird pungent smell the whole time we stayed, it was really unpleasant. I don’t know if it’s the drains or what but that really sucked 😅 The floors being sticky comment is very true..I don’t think the floor is dirty maybe it’s the flooring material ? Idk.  I never saw wanly but I wrote to him only twice and both times he was nice and replied right away. His instructions on how to check in and open the place were pretty clear I didn’t have any issues with that 👍🏽     6.9/10

Comfy and clean apartment. Beds were as well comfortable. We had everything we needed and more. Supermarkets and coffee shops in the area.  It’s a bit faraway from Manhattan located but you can reached it with an express subway just some blocks away or 3 minutes walking you have a local subway that goes to the city and you could also switch to the express train. We didn’t feel unsafe in the neighborhood. The communication with Ray and Marcela was clear and fast.  Very much recommended it.

I stayed here for three months, it was a great long term stay and communication was great. The rooms and kitchen are spacious for NYC.  The pictures very accurately depict the space too. The wifi was good and everything was very clean when I arrived (there was even extra towels and sheets and things). The package system was a bit difficult, I was not home very often and could not have packages delivered without worrying about them being stolen. I just shipped anything I needed to a friend's. The laundry room was also not very clean and did not have enough washers and dryers for the number of tenants. I would recommend going to a laundromat instead. That being said, this was still perfect for my long term stay and I would recommend it to others!
The place is clean, spacious and cozy. Definitely a steal.

The place is nice and in a secure building.  There are a lot of security cameras throughout the building. The area surrounding is ok, but sometimes there are shady people standing on the street, at one point my girls and I were spoken to in a very degrading sexual manner.  We ignored it and kept walking but it made us a little bit more on edge as we walked that street.  That happened on the first day and didn’t happen again.  It’s in a good location to walk to many places like the subway, 5th Avenue, time square, and Empire State Building.  Coffee maker is an espresso maker not an American coffee maker.  You need espresso coffee.  Be mindful of that.  Overall a good stay.
I haven't stayed in this place. The service was unpleasant. I am asking for a refund!

This place is great in a pinch. It's in a great location and it's a decent value for your money, but don't treat this as anything more than a home base. The building itself is a little sketchy, but the apartment itself is clean and comfortable.

Bed was not clean. I asked if the sheets could be washed again since it had stains and she said if I’m not satisfied I can leave tomorrow. Do not go in the winter. Central heating was out & snow would creep under the door leaving a pile of snow in the airbnb (WITH A BROKEN HEATER). I complained about it and she told me that there is a space heater. The space heater was small and could only heat the place to 40°. One month was $2200 to stay in a freezing airbnb. The couch is broken and caved in. Poor communication. The area is not the safest. The window is on the street (where the bed is) so you hear people digging in the trash at night. The window is broken. There is no divider like in the pictures. You will not get a refund. No stove. It’s really not safe. Not worth the money either. She had no reviews for this place for a reason.

Place is clean, exactly as expected as the pictures posted on AirBnb. Well located and very close to Central Park West and the subway (line B and C). The manager is very responsive and so as the cleaning crew that is very helpful. Stayed there with my girlfriend for a month and a half and almost everything went good. The only problem is the people wandering in front of the building basically all the tome whether morning or evening (smoking weed, listening to loud music). Never felt in danger but was concerned for my girlfriend whenever she would go alone to the apartment because she told me she would get stared at or whistled or even talked to right in front of the building. Besides from that, everything went super!

The accommodation actually has 3 bedrooms, a small supermarket is located across the street (very good)... But what else did we like? I was happy to leave, and I don't have good memories of this accommodation.   The area is not very pleasant (I do not recommend the nearby metro with children). The businesses in the building are closed and tagged: it’s sad and not very welcoming. The common areas smell of cannabis. The vacuuming of the carpet should never have been done There is no privacy: a poorly installed sliding door allows those in the living room to know what is happening in the toilet There was no equipment advertised in the ad: no washing machine in the accommodation, no hair dryer, no toaster, no coffee, no crockery for eating for more than 2 people, not the kitchen essentials advertised in the ad. The oven is locked and cannot be used. No cloth, no sponge.   No parking, you park on the street, where you can find it.   The common dryer is located in the basement where I was afraid to venture there (there were young people).   At night we heard animals scratching, maybe mice I can't tell you... The heating was pleasant until someone raised the temperature on the last evening to the point where we couldn't sleep even with the windows open.  The apartment is located on the 2nd floor without elevator.  The neighbor let us enjoy his music and his TV... There was no intention on the part of the host and also the answers given by the host did not suit me: I did not insist but I had the impression that I was being taken for an imbecile.  To the question can we get a toaster: this one was On order... I didn't know it was difficult to get a toaster. The host told me to use the oven, what humor because the oven door was locked.   In short, I cannot recommend this accommodation to you.   Strange that this accommodation had no reviews, I think the ad had just been republished recently. Perhaps other disappointed people had published negative reviews?

A super charming, minimal, very romantic, quiet room (birds singing) and located in a very nice neighborhood, a mix between hipsters and families. Greenpoint is originally a Polish neighborhood. It is well connected to Manhattan, as well as to Williamsburg. If you are not afraid of a narrow and steep wooden staircase, I highly recommend it!

The check-in was easy, and Hady is responsive whenever I needed to contact him. It’s clean and they gave us complimentary snacks, a travel toothbrush set, and travel shampoo/bodywash bottles which was nice. Despite my Uber driver’s warnings, I never felt that unsafe in the area as there are always people around most hours. There is a store with most essentials (food, toiletries) right next to the entrance, not to mention the subway with the B/D train right around the corner. The bed itelf was smaller than I expected (a twin bed) but my friend and I are small so we didnt have a problem with that. The shower water pressure is nice lol. At night it was kind of loud because of the people and cars outside but its to be expected so near to a main road and it didn’t bother me.

Please read full review prior to booking.Owner asked me to not write review in exchange for promised refund! Photos and description were 100% inaccurate.There was chunks of dust and hair everywhere,was not clean at all.There was hairs on the pillows and comforter and they smelled awful.The bathroom looked like it had not been cleaned for months.There was urine and hair on the seat.The room had a metal heater that was on all night so it made the room extremely hot. It did not have a cover or warning sign that it was extremely hot and  I burned my foot on it.The area is not a safe as stated.There is so much trash and homeless people outside at all times, and very loud. There is no subway near by.You must take a bus first in order to get to the subway.Owner did not respond to me requesting full refund, and only wanted to provide half.Upon check out, I requested a receipt. She then asked me not to write review in exchange for my refund.Worst experience and host I have ever experienced!

Jackson's place was very clean & had everything you needed to get settled in.  My discomfort was in the layout: a bit claustrophobic with the narrow hallway... The air freshener automatically goes off, scaring me each time, as it sounded like someone was unlocking front door, but what bothers me most about that, are all the smells.  I'm very sensitive & it bothers my skin... They're there to mask damp odor & I get it, but I don't like all that fragrance.

The room may be suitable when it's 20 degrees outside, except that there it was less than 10 degrees the first day, around 0 the second and -4 the last. But the room is not insulated... Honestly, given the location of the apartment and the price, I normally wouldn't have said anything, but this is just dangerous. I came out of this stay feeling ill because I was forced to sleep with a hat, sweater, big socks, pants... as if I had gone on an expedition in a period of extreme cold. I mentioned this temperature problem to Taz the day after the first night, he offered to bring back additional heating (the heating in the room was off and impossible to turn on individually apparently...), but he did nothing at all. Very poor communication.   Finally, the kitchen light also turns on the bedroom light. What a joy to be woken up in the middle of the night, with the light in your eyes, by other people staying in the accommodation passing by... And regarding the bathroom, we make do with it but the flow of water is difficult and the cleanliness is questionable... And let's not forget the apartment door which doesn't close...

Let me start by the good things - place is indeed in a very good location. The room itself was clean. And Taz is a very responsive host, which I am thankful for. But unfortunately the rest of things were simply appalling... First - upon booking I had asked if there will be other people in the apartment. I was told I will be the only one (because of low season). I guess my fault for believing it, but still... Upon arrival it turned out there were other people in there and I felt unsafe.  Second - bathroom is extremely dirty. There were human body hair all over the place and mat by the bath was so wet that stepping on it made sounds like jumping in a puddle.  Third - the request for secrecy. Basically you must not tell anyone from the house that you are in for airbnb, but should tell you are a friend. Just makes you wonder if you would like neighbours like that...  Would not suggest and would not stay again.

My experience was extremely hit or miss. The host had myself and the other 2 guests staying in the apartment meet him at an address different than the one on the listing, which was a huge red flag as a woman traveling alone. Thankfully the apartment DID match the images on the listing, and I'm thankful for one of the other guests who offered to walk me to the room to check and make sure the images matched. I don't think the host understood how sketchy it is for the addresses to not match, which was a bit uncomfortable.  Check-in aside, the place was clean, the door locked, and it was good for the price. I would consider staying again if not for how the check-in went, it was fine as a place to crash for the night.

Perfect location in NY. However the host was not in town, so check-in was done through another guest and that created deep miscommunication about the room location and keys. I waited in the street for the keys. The checkin process was weird as visitor to NY especially the host asks for contacting him on private (not through Airbnb) which I felt unsafe. The room is small but enough for one person. The building is old but location is great. On the other side, host was reachable and helpful when I contacted him at time of check-in. He also offer remote help when the keys were mixed up. overall, the room is good for overnight stay in New york for solotrvellers.

This place has its ups and downs.  First of all, it's too small for a party of 5 or 6. 4 would be doable, but not more. The bedrooms and bathroom are top notch. The kitchen is well enough stocked with kitchenware and has an awesome fridge and freezer (including ice maker), but it lacks in basic tableware. We managed to get by, but just barely.   The good thing about this place is its location. It's very close to the subway, there's a lot of great places to eat around there and there's a good supermarket just one block away. It's also only 5 blocks away from the ferry, which is an awesome way to go to the city. My kids loved it. The neighborhood is quiet and I never felt unsafe.   I would definitely come back to this place once the problems I outlined are solved, though.

The home was really nice, cozy, and welcoming! The room and shared bathroom were both very clean and tidy. Both Terry and her partner were so kind and welcoming as well. Although we only saw them a couple of times, it was always a kind interaction; even our pup who is very shy and afraid of strangers felt comfortable around them.   They were very kind to offer us a garage parking space for our car, so that was very convenient to not have to worry about parking. The home is in a great location of queens with a grocery store down the street from it.   Overall a great experience!

BROOKLYN GEM.  WHERE IS THE OPTION FOR 10 STARS? I WAS AFRAID TO BE TRAVELING ALONE WITH 3 KIDS AND I WAS WORRIED I WOULD NOT CHOOSE A SAFE LOCATION FOR US TO STAY WHILE MOVING MY DAUGHTER INTO HER DORM FOR THE MONTH AT THE NEW YORK CONSERVATORY IN BROOKLYN HEIGHTS.  THIS LISTING IS 100% ACCURATE AND SUCH A RARE GEM. I HAVE STAYED IN SEVERAL OTHER AIRBNBS BUT THIS BY FAR EXCEEDED OUR EXPECTATIONS.  IT WAS A GREAT MODERN SPACE, COMFORTABLE, UPDATED, CLEAN, STOCKED IN THE KITCHEN AND BATHROOM, HAD COMFORTABLE BEDS , A BEAUTIFUL UPDATED BATHROOM WITH A RAINSHOWER, AND WAS JUST AROUND THE CORNER FROM THE SUBWAY. THE NEIGHBORHOOD HAS SEVERAL RESTAURANTS AND SHOPPING OPTIONS AND IS A MINUTE FROM THE RITEAID PHARMACY WHERE THE EMPLOYEES WERE SUPER NICE AND HELPFUL.  BROOKLYN IS SO FUN AND THERE IS SO MUCH TO DO AND SEE IN THE AREA.  WE DISCOVERED BAY RIDGE PIZZA AND LOVED CHATTING WITH OWNER GASPER SEVERAL TIMES THROUGHOUT THE WEEK AS IT WAS OUR LATE NIGHT GO-TO.  BROOKLYN WAS VERY WELCOMING AND THE PEOPLE ALL AROUND WERE SO KIND.  A COUPLE BONUSES IN THIS APARTMENT WERE THE FULL SIZE REFRIGERATOR, NICE SIZED BEDROOMS, LARGE AREAS TO HANG AND KEEP FOLDED CLOTHES WITH LOTS OF HANGERS PROVIDED IN THE BEDROOMS- THANK YOU!!!! THERE WERE PLENTY OF DISHES, A TOASTER, MICROWAVE, AND OVEN.  WE SLEPT VERY WELL AT THIS APARTMENT (YOU COULD HEAR SOME TRUCKS AND PEOPLE AS THEY WOKE UP AND WENTO WORK OUTSIDE BUT IT IS NYC AFTERALL) BUT WE FELT SAFE HAVING A LOCK ON THE OUTSIDE DOOR AND ANOTHER LOCKED DOOR TO ENTER OUR APARTMENT.   IT WAS NICE TO HAVE THE TRASHCANS JUST OUTSIDE FOR TRASH REMOVAL, AND WE REALLY LOVED THE CUTE BROOKLYN NEIGHBORHOOD .   WE COULD HAVE USED A COUPLE MORE KNIVES AND SPOONS BUT THAT IS THE ONLY NEGATIVE THING I HAVE TO SAY.  ALICE WAS REACHABLE FOR QUESTIONS AND WE DID NOT HAVE ANY ISSUES THAT NEEDED TO BE ADDRESSED REGARING THE APARTMENT.  WE LOVED IT SO MUCH AND ALTHOUGH WE ARE RETURNINIG TO NYC TOMORROW MORNING, THIS RENTAL IS NOT AVAILABLE AND THAT MAKES ME VERY SAD.  IT WAS A REALLY GREAT PLACE TO STAY IN BROOKLYN DURING OUR AMAZING TRIP TO NYC.  THANK YOU TO ALICE FOR ALL SHE DOES TO MAKE THIS A WONDERFUL PLACE TO STAY! WE HOPE TO RENT AGAIN IN THE NEAR FUTURE!

I cancelled my reservation because of some reviews I read. A woman left a review that the address listed in the airbnb reservation was different from the actual address where the host took her to stay. That is so shady to me. No single woman wants to arrive late at night after a long day of travel to have the host meet you at the listed address then takes you to a completely different location! Another reviewer said the light switch in the kitchen turns on the light in the airbnb room, which was also something I did not want to deal with. If you look at all of the properties this host rents in NYC on airbnb, many of the reviews say the property was NOT as advertised. For a single woman, this was too much risk for me so I cancelled the reservation (and did not get a refund).

The room is ideal if you need it to sleep and enjoy 100% NY. The location is excellent, close to everything and the subway stations.  Regarding the bathroom, most of the time it was clean, but I think it has a lot to do with how the other guests use it, since the first days it was always good, and it was noticeable when there was a change in the accommodation. Although there are only stairs, they are not many steps and Taz was very kind and helped me with my luggage. Due to its location, many times I was able to return in the middle of my day to freshen up with a shower or a mini nap to replenish my energy and continue enjoying NY. Having a place open 24 hours a day next door, there are always people in the area. I never felt insecure. It has a kitchen for common use with a refrigerator, microwave and electric kettle, but at least I did not find kitchen items in case you want to cook something, such as pots, pans, etc. But that was not a problem, since you return exhausted from walking all day. I recommend 100%.

Taz was friendly n approchable. Clear Instructions. - host was not present on my arrival.. asked me to walk to another location-next street to  access my room. Address on Air BnB dont match actual address.  - nil lift - u must walk up 3 flights of stairs. - Toilet: hairs on the floor. -Hallway only 1 ceiling light works.Dumping ground for unwanted things. - Room was in a sorry state. Bedframe was a make-do lean agst the wall. It can fall off anytime.  - Mirror cracked. hanger nil nail on one side - loud sound from water pipe throughtout day n night..u really cant sleep. - key  to my room opens other rooms too. Very unsafe!

The stay was great the bed was beyond comfortable. The place was as pictured with the exception of some of the wall art. Very clean!!  There was unfortunately construction going on in the apartment above us the whole stay which at times would sound a little scary. Shanique did message me the day we were to arrive and let me know to expect some noise because of construction but I don’t think she knew how loud it really would be.  Her place is conveniently located in case you forgot something, no worries, there’s a few supermarkets close by for major things as well as plenty of little markets. There’s also convenience stores and a couple hair stores all within walking distance.  If you are not familiar with New York and are planning on going to Times Square or other sites I suggest a car unless you don’t mind a long ride on public transportation because we wanted to take the train to Times Square which on a Sunday after none was projected to take a little over an hour. She has a parking spot for you if you decide to get a car or even drive up like we did.

Great place to stay I PROMISE, won’t disappoint. The location is great and only a 2 minute bus ride to the 2 train that takes you straight to Manhattan. Shanique communicated with me weeks in advance which made our stay stress free. The apartment comfortably fit myself and 3 others. 10 out of 10. Highly Recommend

Had read previous reviews of the room from others, so when host sent address of building and it was a full block south of advertised address, it wasn’t something that surprised me. (And no, it wasn’t just a different entrance on a side street but still the same building. It was a completely different building on a completely different street.) However, it was still a block off Times Square, and the room was exactly as the host had advertised.  I was just looking for a place to sleep overnight right in the heart of my weekend trip to see some shows. The room fit that bill at an unbeatable price.  Was a bit taken back by the host insisting on communicating outside the app with instructions on how to get in. I typically only communicate through the app at AirBnb’s recommendation. When host insisted that videos wouldn’t send through the app, I relented. However, then host texted written instructions. Seemed a little shady. Overall, happy with the price, and irregularities didn’t ruin trip.
This neighborhood is REALLY DANGEROUS. I had the worst experience of my life.

An amazing house. Bedroom was clean and comfy. Bathroom clean ( you gotta wait a while for the hot water to come in). Neighborhood was a little sketchy. I would definitely stay again. BreAnne is extremely understanding, nice and straightforward.

I want to say the Elisha is a very responsive and accommodating whenever msged. The location is also very good very short walk to go public transit. The place is very roomy and didn't feel cramped even by non-NYC standards.  Elevators are quick and open up right by door, also the place is very quiet, even with the windows cracked open. There is very little traffic and a park across the street so not very many cars with great view from balcony. The building and neighborhood felt safe with a person at the door 24/7 and I never felt unsafe walking in or around the building. The building is not crazy old I believe built in the 70s but apartment is a little weird with all the wire that run along the ceiling that have been painted.  The only issue I really had with the place was the cleanliness, It just didn't feel clean or at least to a level I would hope.  I can look past old building, weird wiring and bad paint jobs if it feels clean.  Other than cleanliness we had no issues.

Great value for location and space, and Kareem was helpful and responsive. As expected, there was some noise from the highway nearby, but I was able to block it out with AC and a white noise app. My only real issue was not having a substantial curtain or shade to block out the light coming into the bedroom in the morning (though I eventually figured out how to hang some towels so I could sleep). Otherwise, I did have a good stay and would still stay here again.

I have never felt more unsafe at an Airbnb stay like I did this one. I came into the city for an event and just needed a place to crash. I asked Leela a question through the airbnb message board about the guest policy because I had an appointment that the artist wanted to come to me, but totally fine if that wasn't possible. She reported me twice for asking that question and not checking in even though I communicated with her what time I'll be in.  There are rules taped to the walls throughout the apartment about what you cannot do,  kitchen is off limits and you need to keep your trash seperate from theirs, as well as seperating your trash from recyclables.    The window faces the street, has the AC unit attached and no insulation, I was able to stick my hand out the window. both nights I was woken up at 3AM from trucks driving by and constant honking throughout the morning.  It overall was extremely unwelcoming stay and I don't think any guest should be subjected to that from a host

Stood for about a week. The location is near a train station which is cool but the area doesn’t have too much to offer without traveling a bit. There is a drug addiction facility a few buildings away and there are addicts that do linger near the building and even ask for money religiously which was a turnoff . The apartment and building are still under renovation and the set up of the apartment is a bit weird but once you’re inside it is peaceful. The room offers a decent size tv and you do have the place to yourself which makes up for the cons. There is a back area that you can go to, for air, or to even smoke if you will. If you are by yourself or a couple i would recommend. But, I don’t recommend for families. The hosts are nice and accommodating. They live on the premises so they are not too hard to reach. Overall if you just want a place to stay that’s private. This is a good fit. And the price is pretty good.

Michelle and her husband are nice people, and I am sure they are doing their best. But honestly, we didn't like the area and the house.  This flat and building seem like they are still in construction. I think it is a bit early to do Airbnb for this house.   We also didn't like the area either. It doesn't seem safe place at all. At night there was a lot of noise from the street. We could not even open the windows even though it was a hot day. Because they were homeless people in the street, and they were very close to our window as the flat is at the entity level. The only good thing about the location is 3 mins from the metro station.   Sorry to say it but I wouldn’t like to stay here again because of the area and the building.

Fine place to stay that is close to a subway to the city, but in a sketchy neighborhood. Upon arrival, we were informed that we did not have the room that we booked available to us, and we’d have to use two separate rooms for the first night with one bed each, which wouldn’t work. Communication was terrible, but the hotel was nicely updated with bare bones necessities that you’d see at a normal hotel.

The real expression Cost X Benefit! Simple place, without luxury, but new, well maintained! Comfortable beds, spacious bathroom, clean and new sheets and covers! The region can be a little shocking, but nothing that will bring you any danger! They take orders, they don't have coffee, but there is a dining area! I recommend!
Reviews are a scam

This was a very nice place for the value . The host was very accommodating and, responsive. Not too close to the trains but, not to far either and, the neighborhood at night could be A little sketchy if you’re not used to being in New York City. But over all a great value for the money!
It was a nice place to stay. The house was very clean and nice. It was in the a bit sketchy part of Brooklyn. But its was a good place.

Vivian was always responsive and willing to help ,  the house had two sets of locks just to get in which made us feel safe and comfortable. The neighborhood can seem a little sketchy but we never had any problems there. The house was spotless and clean and the having a private bathroom was a great. Overall a great stay and great bargain for the cost.

Hi place was very clean and neat. Organized and a person was always there to help if you needed in terms of handy man.   Wouldn’t recommend the location it’s dangerous at night and you have to come back before 5 pm   Thanks

We've chosen Vivian's place because it seemed reasonably close to the JFK airport (cca 1h 10 min using metro - as after reading stories on the internet, we were afraid of the bus). Unfortunately, metro had some stations closed so the trip from the airport took us 3 hours instead (!).. so not too close. Midnight walk from the station also didn't feel safe, but thanks to precise photos, we found the place & got in without any issues. However wouldn't recommend the area.  Place itself is fine, just as described - just the walls are a bit thin (we got woken up by other guests coming back late). Also, no possibility of slightly later check-out (it's 10 am sharp).

It's been great! The neighborhood could be a little scary but no problem. Communication with the center is perfect thanks to the fact that the metro stop is literally an 8-minute walk away. Otherwise the house was great, everything clean, comfortable and clear, I would repeat without a doubt!
the place was amazing value and felt safe even though the neighborhood is a bit sketchy. very clean and great host. walking distance to L and 3 subway lines

Jane was is a host that many aspire to be. She went above and beyond to make sure that my nephew’s stay was stress-free, clean and relaxing. From the smooth check-in, to the spaciousness of the stay(which looks like the pictures and is a great price for a NYC stay any day of the week) and it’s location, to her warm and thoughtful communication, we couldn’t ask for anything more. I couldn’t recommend Jane and her stay more!  Incredibly impressed. She’s what makes Airbnb amazing.

I returned to the apartment late at night and the door lock broke, I could not get in. The host was already asleep and there were no hotels with rooms available, so I had to be out in Brooklyn, alone, with nowhere to go all night. VERY UNSAFE! Afterwards, the host said I would get a refund but the refund didn’t even cover one full day of the room.  Do not trust this room. Also, it’s not actually a private room, it’s just a section of the living room partioned off with a curtain.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️  I initially stayed with Teresa and Paco for a month upon first moving to the city. It was such a great experience that I extended my stay for a few months after that!  Couldn’t ask for more from a host, Teresa was always responsive and communicative at all times for anything I needed. But honestly I didn’t need much because you can’t beat this location!  There’s tons of restaurants and groceries within a couple blocks. The express 4 train is literally a block away. I stayed there and commuted into Manhattan Mon-Fri and it was always a quick 25 min commute! (Also great if working from home they have super fast and reliable internet). It’s great because you get the true NYC vibe (and prices!) of Brooklyn but can quickly be in Manhattan whenever you need to.  Overall, I highly recommend staying here and it’s a steal for the price trust me!   ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The room is beautiful, the lighting is amazing and also the attention to details. The room has no lock but it has a door, it’s very private and nothing wrong ever happened, it was just in the back of my mind a couple of times, be aware of a 15 min walk to the train station, please take the b62 and b 57 to move to jay station at night. The bed is on the soft side borderline with a bit used, but in all honesty I slept like an Angel with the many pillows and comfy duvet, the fridge on the room is a game changer, the water filter is an one of a kind amenity for NYC airbnbs. I shared houses with Rei and one other person we were all respectful and helpful.  I cannot stress how much I recommend this beautiful place ❤️

Worst air bnb I ever stayed at place smells like drugs  no hot water most times and location is a very bad area host is a very weird guy he was harassing me about the bathroom being clogged because the water pressure is low host started knocking on my door at 7 am in the morning woke me up and kept on harassing me and had a horrible attitude would not recommend

I was accused of stealing 2 towels and is charging me money for something my group never took!! Because only 1 person took a shower and we hang up that wet towel up. They’re  doing bad counting or they missed placed before cleaning and renting to someone else ridiculous I have never been accused of stealing in all the many airbnbs I’ve been to.  Besides The place was nice and seem clean very comfortable to fit 6 people, in the morning I did found 2 big roaches in the floor   I booked this place last minute to crash and sleep for the night to join my family next morning she is responsive.

Overall a good stay so I'll round up to 5 stars. Location was a bit sketchy at first. A block away and on the way to this AirBNB, there were about ten people and one of them were throwing objects at people. A couple of hours later I noticed a police car was there instead and the group had disbanded. At night, a generator was brought in to light up that area with extra flood lights. The next night two police officers were standing around past midnight at the apartments across the street  At check-in time, a was guy sitting on the stoop stairwell that I had to navigate around to find the padlock. Multiple padlocks looked  the same so it took a couple of minutes. This was all during the weekday and day time

Second time staying. Would recommend for a short budget stay. Always clean and super easy check in! The neighborhood may appear a little sketchy but it’s actually really nice lots of families, good vibes (music lol) and close to train.

The place is nosy due to the many people staying there (I get that happens sometimes), but among all my airbnb stays, Gerardo has been the most unhelpful, uncooperative and disinterested. There is an AC unit inside the apt that is not mounted to the window--obviously unsafe and a potential hazard to use. This should be disclaimed to customers. Also, bed is very uncomfortable. I left the property 2 days early because of how uncomfortable I was. I have dealt with good and bad hosts, but I unfortunately have to say this has been the   worst in terms of communication. The communication feels robotic--he will only reiterate things that are already stated on the website, even when it has nothing to do with the issue you are bringing up. My advice, look somewhere else.

If you are planning on traveling to New York, this is genuinely the biggest steal you can find. Catherine and her crew communicated very efficiently and responded in record time. It was my first time in New York and I was worried about safety, but the apartment made me feel completely secure and safe. It is about 40 minutes from the theater district and times square. Thank you so much Fay for an amazing trip!
Very nice place. Very spacious room, very reasonable price and accommodating hosts. Had to move out earlier than planned due to unsafe neighborhood.
This place is a steal! You’re lucky to stay here!

DO NOT STAY HERE!!!  Unless you want to be price gouged with completely uncalled for and made up accusations in addition to being verbally attacked and physically threatened.  For starters, On my first night staying there, her and her family (who lived downstairs) made food that made the apartment smell so horrible I couldn’t sleep all night which is honestly incredible considering I had all the windows open. I highly recommend to Lakeisha to pursue a new profession or hobby- (kickboxing or a corrections officer?)

Wow - my recommendation is to RENT THIS PLACE.  It is a short 50 minutes to Times Square on public transportation.  We drove in, parked the van and used public transportation the whole time.  Walk 3 blocks to meet bus Q33 and then it takes you to the Train stop.  From there all of Manhattan is at your feet!  The neighborhood is safe to walk (we walked home after Broadway shows ended about 12:30 at night and never once felt unsafe).  Some neighbors we met on our walk to the bus stop were chatty and welcomed us to the city - very family-oriented feel.  Last time I was in NYC I stayed on Manhattan at $450 a night for a shoebox.  I thought I'd be better than riding the trains into the city.  I was wrong then.  This time we did it right.  The trains gave us a good time to plan (into the city) and to decompress (on the way home).  Don't waste your money on a tiny box in the city when you can have a full apartment in Queens.   As to the place - NICE!  First, as Texans - we know what "good air conditioning" really is.  This place is perfect.  Three units in the apartment meant that every room was comfortable even when we visited during a heat wave.  The place is super clean and obviously newly remodeled so all the amenities are sparkling.  The washer and dryer saved us as we'd packed light and so we could wash each night or two and keep the luggage to a minimum.  There were booklets of neat things to do in the neighborhood as well as NYC in general.  The WIFI let all three teenagers upload pictures each night and stream movies without interruption.  There is Netflix and other apps on the TV but we spent most of our time out and about.   It's right by LaGuardia but there was NOT A SINGLE incidence of airport traffic noise!  The hubby flew in and took the FREE purple bus to the corner - we didn't even have to Uber to the place.  He got there early (two hours early) and as the previous guests had checked out early the place was already cleaned.  Asad and the family let us in early - what a nice gesture!  One night we accidentally locked a bedroom door at 1:00 in the morning and the hosts came up to let us in!  Now that is service - I wouldn't have faulted them for not even answering the phone at that time but they did.  Also, I had several questions prior to arrival and Asad answered within minutes - really.  I will be back and I will stay here.

Beautiful house, very rustic vibe to the house. Be careful with the stairs though, they’re kinda tight and waxy so it can be kinda scary moving up and down. All the rooms were super spacious and the location was close to the highway. Parking was a hassle but it’s New York. Would definitely stay again.

it is cheap and good location which is very closed to subway. But the place itself is not a peaceful area. It is quite danger for the solo or girl if you go back to home at the midnight. But the Host and his wife are very kind and helpful. You are welcome to ask them any help. One thing may need to improve which is some dog hair on the bed. As he has 3 big dogs with him. If you love dogs, then the place is fine to you, otherwise you might not suitable for this place.

A fairly clean, really conveniently-located crash pad near the airport.  That said, there were some issues.  Parking was not available as promised, forcing us to street park.  We did contact the owner, who later claimed it was his car and he could have moved it - but by that point it was too late.  The floor immediately below us seems to be undergoing renovation, but someone was rooting around it at midnight (which was super creepy).  The second keypad only intermittently works, it seems, leaving us slightly worried we were going to be locked out.  The beds are cheap and uncomfortable, though clean.  There were some weird aspects of this place, like a too-small toilet seat.   Honestly, the lack of actual parking alone would have led us to pick a different spot.  For the price, none of this was a dealbreaker, I suppose.

the location of the apartment is ideal in Brooklyn, close to the L subway line for quick access to Manhattan, close to the ferry stop (15' journey to south Manhattan. The roof top with barbecue and view of the sky line is unique. The apartment is spacious, quiet and bright, very well equipped. Many restaurants, bars and Whole Food Market supermarket in the immediate vicinity. Barthelemy welcomed us on the roof top with grills and cans of beer, after 8 hours of flight we appreciated it! He regularly worried about whether everything was going well and he also speaks excellent French!!!

Great scenery and awesome area. The space was the perfect place to stay for a little, while you explore the city. The only issue was the frequent creepy sound of the boiler. The toilet could of been a lot cleaner as well. Beside this it was a short nice stay.

The place was so clean and renovated! Very beautiful and spacious. Never had an issue and was very comfortable at all times. The area is very quiet and only about 7 minutes walk to the train station. Never felt unsafe and really loved how Katya was always available to answer any questions.

We had a wonderful time staying with Ji and her super sweet Shiba Inu BooBoo. Location was great near the G and C lines, a bunch of nice restaurants on Dekalb and Myrtle, and right next to Pratt’s campus.  Neighborhood is nice and didn’t feel dangerous at night walking around even on the later side. Only thing I would advise is if you have any MOBILITY ISSUES, the shower/ bath is going to be hard to get in and out of.

The apartment was handy to the subway approximately 3 blocks and 25 minutes to downtown to the city. Photos of the foyer/entranceway certainly flatter as it was quite run down. However once you enter the apartment it was lovely, really appreciated the bottled water and Victor who greeted us was very helpful. The neighbourhood is very diverse so maybe not everyone's cup of tea, we however enjoyed the change and did not feel unsafe at any stage.

No exaggeration, this was one of the best Airbnb’s I have ever stayed at and I use Airbnb very often. The space was so beautiful and spacious! The pictures don’t do it justice. Everything was clean and up to date. The location was ideal and made getting around very easy. Constance was out of town but was still accommodating in every way possible. I would DEFINITELY recommend you stay here when visiting NYC. It’s honestly a steal for the price point. SO WORTH IT! Thanks, Constance!

A super great apartment in the heart of East Harlem with the best connection to the subway. You shouldn't be put off by the area, we never felt unsafe there. Alli is a fantastic host who will help you with advice and support. The apartment is super clean and well furnished. It offers enough space for two people and their luggage. The highlight is certainly the jacuzzi in the bathroom. We will definitely come back! ###### A super great apartment in the heart of East Harlem with easy access to the subway. You should not be put off by the area, we felt at no time uncertain. Alli is a fantastic host who will help and advise you. The apartment is super clean and very nicely decorated. It offers enough space for two people and their luggage. The highlight is certainly the jacuzzi in the bathroom. We will definitely come back!
Really good place, close to restaurants and subway. A bit scared by the dog !!!! But finally was good. Ji is a very nice person. Was a great journey

I was in New York for work and spent three months here. It was just what I expected, clean and comfortable. Sanyika and his brothers were accommodating, available by text, with quick replies. The room was exactly what the photos show. I mentioned that there wasn't a small chest of drawers where I could store my clothes and they purchased one within days. It's in a changing area in the Bronx and may look a little sketchy. But I came and went as late as midnight and beyond and had no issues. (I was careful, of course, but that goes for anywhere.) You'll be less than five minutes from a D train stop which takes you right into Manhattan. I worked in Chelsea and it was never more than a 40 minute commute. All in all, I'd be happy to go back...and may, because I'll be in NYC again for two months during the summer.

This was my first time using an Airbnb account myself as I usually travel with friends that do the booking. But for the full month of May I was to study art history in NYC and needed to find a place to stay on a very tight budget. That being said, I emailed several hosts with general questions and to see if it was okay for me to have a guest for 4 days during my stay at no additional cost. I decided to go with this listing because Brizzo seemed nice via Airbnb messenger and although she was relatively new as a host there were a couple of reviews that said the place was clean plus she had all the amenities I required such as an AC, private room, and kitchen access – and it was within my tight budget. During my stay I noticed tons of thick dust, cobwebs, and grime everywhere. The unit was not cleaned at all. There was no AC – I had to buy a fan. Brizzo was nice at first until I started having questions about the radiator (how to turn it off/why it was leaking water – I am from the south and know nothing about heating radiators), rodent droppings scattered about the unit, there was no hot water when I showered in the evenings, broken toilet seat, repair men letting themselves into the unit (no one was there but me and I had no notice), rats/mice burrowing in the ceiling above the bed, etc. When I first arrived she said I could text her 24/7 about anything, but when I started having these questions she became very aggressive, controlling, and insulting. She said that because I was new to Airbnb I had the wrong expectations and that she had already let my boyfriend stay for 4 days (she agreed to via Airbnb messaging before I booked the reservation) and in doing so had gone out of her way enough for me. She proceeded by saying I was a liar, passive aggressive, and problematic (breaking house rules and causing problems – all of which is untrue). Additionally, she would go into the “private” room where I was staying and prop open windows, close blinds, turn on the fan I had purchased, and retrieve personal items she had kept in the room. This too was very uncomfortable as I expected a fully private room, but was too scared to say anything to her about it after the way she reacted to the problems I was having within the unit. After this abrupt change in her demeanor towards me I felt extremely uncomfortable staying there, but I was in classes all day every day (except Sunday) and felt like it would be more trouble to leave than just wait it out. After all, I was basically only sleeping there and I didn’t think I could find a place for the same amount I already paid. This listing is hazardous and falsely advertises amenities. Moving...

Awilda is very attentive and makes herself available to her guests. She waited for us until 1 a.m. on the day of our arrival and held our luggage for us on the last day because our flight took off very late. The apartment is very clean, the bed very comfortable, everything is there (sheets, towels and toiletries, dishes, small welcome cookies, etc.) The apartment is in a very quiet area of ​​Brooklyn, in the basement of a charming brownstone.  In short, everything is there to have a good stay! In any case, we will go back!
Super clean and the perfect place to stay. Very flexible with checking in and out made this a low stress trip.

For the price, the location is worth it. There are a few issues with the main door. You really have to use some force to open/close it. And beware of low ceilings since the location is in the basement. Overall, the neighborhood was quiet and is very close to the subway. I enjoyed my stay in NYC. It’s quite a steal for what is offered.

HP has been a good host, the apartment is good, it is clean, well located with respect to the subway and the distance to Manhattan (although we have not had any problems, it is true that several have told us that the area is dangerous, so inform you beforehand)

Alli was spot on and wonderful. The apartment was just like the pics. Clean and spacious. The area at night was a little sketchy but other than that we could not have asked for a better experience. We DEFINITELY recommend Alli’s Air BnB

Yes, it was good, chat communication on time, with instructions and recommendations on time. I think having a Family Dollar is the best, we had everything in the house. There is a somewhat dangerous subway station but it is recommended to always get to Rockaway Station. Next time I think I will go closer to Manhattan so as not to take the subway at night. Thanks for everything.

The accommodation is located near several subway stations, very advantageous for getting anywhere in New York (Manhattan approximately 45 minutes). Clean and practical accommodation with everything you need. The host is responsive, we spent a week for the holidays without any problem! The only negative points are that the neighborhood is not very welcoming (not dangerous but rather gray and not very clean) and the apartment is poorly insulated because you can hear the neighbor upstairs.  That said, if you plan to visit New York and are just looking for a place to sleep, this accommodation is more than enough! Thanks again to the host!

We love Ali's apartment. It is exactly as described in the pictures. The bed is delicious and the kitchen super-equipped. The tub after a day of walking around New York is an invitation to relax. The neighborhood is not the most beautiful and at first moment we were a bit scared of the beggars and people on the street. But, it's super close to the metro, has plenty of policing and we were not bothered by anyone. In terms of value for money it pays off a lot. I recommend. We will be back for sure!

Alli's place is clean and comfortable with all the amenities you need for a pleasant stay in NYC. There is a small but outfitted kitchen, a comfy queen bed, and comfortable furniture to relax on. Alli provides lots of nice quality linens and towels too. In addition, she went the extra mile to provide a queen airbed for my father who stayed a couple of nights during my stay, and with a bit of furniture re-arranging, it fit very nicely.  The bathroom is lovely too with a nice shower and jacuzzi. The location was convenient for me as I needed access to the Metro North train, but in general the neighborhood has a fair number of chain restaurants and stores. However, you can walk West on 125th St. to find more appealing local restaurants, bars and shops.  There were a fair number of homeless men on that part of 125th St., I think because of the Salvation Army Center nearby so just an FYI for women traveling alone.  Overall, I had a good experience and would definitely stay there again.

The apartment of Alli is very cozy and also welcomingly furnished, there is everything you need in everyday life and the bed is very nice. The bathroom and especially the jacuzzi, where you can relax after a long day, is a big plus. There are enough cupboards and dressers to accommodate all the clothes properly. Enough restaurants and shopping can be found throughout the area. We have never felt unsafe, contrary to all fears and stories about the area. Definitely a good place to explore New York City with all its diversity.

Very good compromise between comfort and location when you cannot stay in the central hypermarket, however the accommodation is located above a nail salon which gives off disturbing odors (polish remover etc.), sensitive noses refrain! Very nice whirlpool bath after a day of walking, and very comfortable bedding! We had no feeling of insecurity in the neighborhood and we had a very good stay!

Lia was one of the best hosts I have ever stayed with. She was always quick to respond if I had any questions and provided a great list of surrounding restaurants and amenities in the charming area of 62nd street. She and her team were the warmest and most hospitable people. They always cleaned the apartment to perfection and made me feel at home. I stayed in the Madison Suite, a quaint and stylish apartment that felt like a home away from home. It reminded me of a set of a Meg Ryan movie. Everything had personality and charm to it. In addition, it was always the best coming back from a long and stressful day at work to this cozy and quiet place where I could relax in the warmly lit library living area area drinking my cup of hot chocolate. I strongly recommend staying here. The location is convenient and close to the best spots in Manhattan. You just can’t go wrong. Lia and her team are the nicest and most generous people. I created the best memories staying there and look forward to visiting again in the future!

This beautiful air bnb is just minutes away from the E 125 metro which takes you to downtown Manhattan, Brooklyn or Uptown to the Bronx. The flat has a beautiful jacuzzi and shower of which is perfect temperature abs pressure. The bed was a dream to sleep in and the kitchen had almost all the supplies you could need or want. My only suggestion is if you are staying alone - do get back before dark as it is quite a rough area around the station and can feel unsafe but once you are in the flat building it is more than okay. I would highly recommend this to couples and small families.

Best. Bed. Ever!  Allison is an incredibly accommodating and concerned host, with a beautiful room in a great location.  I've traveled to NYC every four to six weeks for a year now - and I'm really wishing I'd found her place earlier.  I will be back for sure, though I suspect she will stay booked constantly.  OMG that bed!

Enjoyed the New York living feeling.   Cozy apartment on the fifth floor without an elevator.  Amazingly quiet except for trash day.  Walkable with great dining options, drug stores and the famous corner stores.  Near bus stops and subway stations made zipping around town easy.  Great recommendations for getting to destinations

Daniella’s place was perfect! The subway line was directly across the street and was incredibly convenient for traveling anywhere in the city. The neighborhood was friendly and quiet and we never felt unsafe, even being out late at night. Daniella was SO quick to respond to all of our questions; I’ve never had an Airbnb host respond as quickly as she did. The cats were all  very cuddly and friendly and welcomed us as part of their family as soon as we walked in the door. I highly recommend Daniella’s place to anyone and everyone looking to stay in a quaint neighborhood in Brooklyn!

I stayed as a solo traveler at Nikolai's place for 2 nights, and it was perfect/ample for my needs. I was looking for a place close to the home of a family member, who walked me to the apt at night (after midnight). I didn't experience anything that made me feel unsafe. Note that the building door needs to be closed properly or the lock doesn't engage.  Check-in was easy, the apartment spotless and spacious, and the building quiet. Nikolai was quick to respond whenever I had a question and even arranged for me to be able to check in early, which I appreciated.   The window A/C in the bedroom let in some cold air and street noise, but I turned on the heater and used a white noise app on my phone and slept fine. I also used an eye mask.  The bathroom is narrow/awkward (there's a tiny sink on top of the toilet tank that runs cold water when you flush), but workable. There was also shampoo, a hair dryer, and a pitcher of filtered water in the fridge.
This place was perfect! It had everything we needed and nothing more. This made our stay stress free! Thank You Bruce and Grace. Hope to see you again soon. Peace.
Looks like the pics. Heating system made loud scary noises
Very nice home.  The space was very clean and looks just like the pictures.  My only issue was with the others staying in the home at the time that I was, they were very creepy and loud.

LOCATION! LOCATION! LOCATION! Located in the hip Lower East Side, this place is located next to a lot of great bars, restaurants, drug stores, coffee shops, etc. It was super accessible to the subway to get to other neighborhoods, i.e., 10 minute walk. A bit of city noise outside to wake you in the morning, but that's to be expected when living in the city.   Marina provided lots of towels and toilet paper, which for all of us ladies--we know that is essential. Good pressure on the shower although getting the right temperature was a bit temperamental. The Nespresso was a super great bonus if you need some zing first thing in the morning. We came in December and the apartment was very warm and cozy (but each bedroom has window ACs if you're looking to come in the summer). Marina even provided some umbrellas in case you forget yours. Super spacious with a kitchen, huge living room and two rooms for privacy. Lots of interesting art. The linens and especially the pillows were heavenly!
Very unsafe location,  16ppl in 1apt, very crowded. Very noisy hard to sleep. Also staff not enforcing the rules.
John was helpful and accommodating and Joseph was generous. Walkable distance from subway, not as scary as I thought even tho it’s in the Bronx. Felt generally safe

We had a good time at Tareb’s place! Very clean. Plenty of amenities stocked for guests. Our main complaint was that the water in the shower wouldn’t heat past lukewarm. If that’s not an issue for you, then this place is perfect. We appreciated the multiple doors to get in to the apartment, it added to our feeling of safety. Not a sketchy area of the Bronx, and easy access for buses and the subway. We had a great time!
Yemane place was suspicious, upgraded, comfortable and private.
The stay was good but the neighborhood was scary and I will not recommend for families

We had an excellent stay with Solitude, she was very kind and always attentive to whatever we needed. The room was everything we needed for our trip. The place is very close to the bus stop and approximately two blocks from the subway. At no time did I feel unsafe in the neighborhood so whether or not I would be left alone again. Just perhaps as a recommendation that the kitchen had a kettle to heat water for tea or coffee. But everything else very impeccable.

Stay would have been more comfortable if there was toilet paper, bath soap, and stand for television (television  was given to us that night, after I informed Soledad that I needed it for work) Soledad did give us her/his personal television to set up but with no stand….the room was clean but the whole entire stay was very cold.. also was difficult trying to lock the door when leaving and checking out… bathroom could have been cleaner as well.. this stay is across from 40 projects/ city housing in Jamaica Queens.. (pretty dangerous)

Tony is an excellent host. He made sure I had everything I needed for a comfortable stay, but he also added a lot of little touches that made the stay 5 stars. His place is not too far from the 7 train, and is in a very safe neighborhood. I never felt unsafe coming home at any time. I would stay here again given the chance. Thanks Tony!

I found this place to be very clean, comfortable, and perfectly sized for two people. The bathroom and shower was excellent. The backyard patio gets amazing sun and shade. The bedroom also gets really strong sunlight for hours all afternoon. You could tell that Berry made sure that the apartment is ready. I honestly think this is a bargain. I am looking forward to staying here again one day.

Cute, quirky and cozy home in Brooklyn. The inside of the home was spotlessly clean and looked just like the pictures. The host provided lots of thoughtful and convenient supplies and toiletries to make you feel like a home away from home.   The surrounding community is a little rough around the edges but, we never felt unsafe.  If you don’t like walking or using public transportation, then this may not be the place for you. The subway station is about a 10 minute walk. Takes about 45 minutes to get into the city and about 30 minutes to DUMBO.  We didn’t mind the walking, so it was ok for us.   Overall host was so wonderful and very accommodating.

Overall, for the price, I am satisfied with my stay. There were some minor inconveniences, but the apartment served its purpose. I stayed here with two friends during "Christmas in NY" season. I was told by several locals that crime significantly increases during warmer months, and I'd be concerned staying in this area, especially with children and as tourists. It is advertised as Queens, but it is actually Long Island City. Thankfully, we did not have any issues. If we returned at night, we would Lyft. During the day, we took the bus, which is a short walking distance. The apartment itself is very basic but meets needs for a short stay. Sharing one small bathroom mirror among three women was a challenge. It would be helpful if there was another in the apartment. The unit advertises as laundry accessible, but our host had to unlock the basement door when he was available, so it's not freely accessible.
✅️ very friendly Host, cozy and clean room   ❌️2 guys cursing each other out at 3 am and ringing the doorbell continiously, so i couldnt sleep and my gf was very scared

My stay was great for the location and purpose. To visit my son who lives close by. But leading up to it was stressful. On the day of check-in I did let the host know that I probably wouldn’t get there till late afternoon and he refused to let me know what the lockbox number or the apartment number was. The check in information. He told me I could not have that information until I actually arrived at the building, which made me very stressed out because I was driving from Maine and I was like is this going to end up being some kind of scam. Ive rented rentals from Vrbo and was always given the lockbox number if there was one or the information on how to get into the rental on the day of checkin. So I did not even know that information, until after I arrived and parked, and after a long, 8 Hour Dr. in traffic, because it was Thanksgiving holiday it was stressful. And I even let him know that on the ride down there, that I was kind of annoyed that he wouldn’t give me the check in information and he was making me wait until I arrived. So when I  did arrive. I parked in the garage across the street. My son, who lives a block away, met me, and we walked across the street, and I let the host know that I was there, and he gave me the code to open the lock box for the key, and he gave me the apartment number and I had my hands full so I told my son what the lock box number was because he was staying there with me and someone was standing very close to us on the phone, and he was listening in on our conversation and told whoever was on the other end of his phone that I said the lockbox number out loud. I assume that was somebody who worked with the host because when we came back down a short while later to find some dinner, the lockbox was gone from its location   So I was very uncomfortable. Felt like I was being spied on. Though I totally get removing the lockbox and changing the code between renters. That makes sense. Just don’t do it in front of the person that’s renting it. And has already paid for it The apartment itself is great and had almost everything you need. Except No wine opener. No can opener. No ice. There was a tiny little ice tray for eight ice cubes and there were only two towels for a three night stay for two people, so that was a problem as we both like to shower each day and both have thick curly hair. So I had to keep washing the towels. And lastly, there is a noise coming from somewhere within the apartment. I think the refrigerator, but it happens every couple of hours and it sounds like someone is knocking at the door so many times I had to get up to see if someone was actually knocking on the door until I realized it was coming from one of the appliances or something. So I suggest the owner spend some time in that apartment to figure out what that noise is coming from because it sounds exactly like someone is knocking at the door.  Otherwise the building is gorgeous and the apartment is great for a short stay. But if two people are staying at a rental, they should always be more than two towels. Usually hospitality calls for two towels per person plus one hand towel per person, and one face cloth.

To be honest, the place was a steal. It looked, smelled and felt amazing. The host was great. And I would return continuously when I visit Brooklyn. Jay If this is you standard, you will have great fortune.
Can’t stress enough how much I loved this place. Clean, wide and Manhattan right under you!
Eve is a great host . As our first time in NYC I was a little scared but she made our stay very comfortable .I recommend to everyone Thank you so much for having us❤️❤️❤️.

Eve was very friendly and responsive. We were five blocks away from the metro station. Grocery store and pharmacy were available near by.   Area was noisy and a bit sketchy at night, but we felt safe in the apartment.
