The accommodation itself was very nice and the first contact was also very friendly. Unfortunately, nowhere in the description did it say that the accommodation was in a very dangerous area! It was very scary for two girls, one of whom was pregnant, and we didn't feel safe for a second. On the way from the metro to the accommodation, several homeless people followed us and harassed us. Something like that should be in a description that it is not a civilized area. We spent the first night there and asked Kathleen to check out earlier, but we were not accommodated at all. Of course we wouldn't have expected the full price back, but €100-200 would have been at least reasonable. So we paid €600 for just one night. They had absolutely no understanding for us and assured us that the area was safe, but they should always lock the door. The hallway was also very creepy and the elevator smelled strongly of urine.

I would rate my experience with this property as fair to good.   Initially I was concerned about the possibility of being scammed because the first messages that I received were links to register off of the Airbnb platform. After contacting Airbnb to confirm that this is against the terms of service I felt comfortable going ahead with the reservation. "Kristina" was quick to reply when I pointed out that I wished to keep all of our contact on the Airbnb app they were accommodating.  You are required to arrange a check in time. Be prepared to pay extra for a late check in.   It is stated that they provide limited towels. This means that you are provided one bath towel per person and nothing else. no hand towels, washclothes, or a bath mat. There was no door on the shower so the floor got wet and slippery. This was a safety concern during our stay.  Overall, this was the least expensive option I could find for an Airbnb in New York between Christmas and New Years. it served its purpose.
the area seemed a bit dangerous

Avi is a fantastic host, who made our stay completely stress free. Apartment is placed in quite nice neighborhood in Brooklyn and is decently equipped with all necessary things for longer stays. If your travelling in a larger group (in our case 5 adults and 5 kids), I can definitely recommend this place.

*AVOID THIS LISTING!*  Bait and switch will land you in hostile and dangerous environment. Avoid this listing at all cost.  Instruction for access will direct you to a vintage fashion store where you'll pick up keys and "welcome packet" in including the following note.  "Floors are wavy, pretend you're surfing to normalize. Turn the fan off in the bedroom before using anything in the kitchen that plugs in or power will shut down and will have to go down to 1R and ask the man to flip switch in the basement. If anyone asks who you are in the hallway, tell them you're friend of Kates and keep on walking baby. In winter the heat can be too much in the night....it goes on.   When I entered the building a man who lived on the first floor aggressively and belligerently yelled at me, physically pushed me, and demanded why I was in the building. I spent 5 minutes in Kate's cigarette infused apartment to find a new place to stay and was again attacked at on my way out. Cleary not a legal ABNB.
Ahmed was a great host! this place was very clean and cozy, made my New York trip less stressful
This stay was exactly what is offered, clean space, responsive host, and subway was a couple blocks down. Great food around the area and seemed low crime.

Didn't want to leave... felt like home! It's a lot cozier in person, super clean and easy to find all of the extra amenities. Jacqueline is a great host, super nice & kept updating me as soon as she got a chance. The location is safe and quiet, I was able to take some walks around the neighborhood and not feel afraid or self-conscious of my surroundings.  a good 20-30 minutes away from main attraction areas. Will definitely be booking this place for the next time we visit New York, thanks Jacquelyn!

The host is honestly amazing. She was very helpful with checking in and responsive to when we needed towels. But unfortunately the lack of lighting, dirty appliances, and unidentifiable nuggets in the few lights available made this an overall unpleasant trip.   I hate to really dig in on such a nice host but there are really a lot of things that bummed me out about this bnb. The washer that’s in the apartment is filled with trash, the walls are undecorated and obviously yellowed, the hilariously small tv(I always use my laptop, but the size of it was extremely funny), trash bags filled with someone’s clothes in the closet, the inconsistent heating, the stiff spring mattress with cheap and sweaty blankets, and the multiple (either broken or shadeless) lamps randomly placed/plugged into outlets.   This is probably the most depressing bnb I’ve stayed in to date and I really hope the host actually improves their listing with these comments.    If all you need is a bed, this is your place.

I do not recommend it, I traveled from Ohio for 9 hours with my small children. When I got to the accommodation, I called him and he answered only one call. He left me on the street with my children. We had to sleep in the car in the cold. Then we got a hotel the next day. He is irresponsible. He does not answer your calls. He never communicated. He just wants to collect money. Steal money. Don't rent it so you don't have to sleep on the street.

I will discourage everyone from using the service of this host. He is a thief and a liar. There are no keys to the room and the bathroom is outside somewhere on the staircase that you have to share with some other tenants. He will ignore your calls and messgaes if you complain there are no keys. He will then deceive you he is driving to town to meet you which is a lie. Now the room was unsafe and i checked out. He took my money and refunded just a peanut. I pray God will punish this liar and Criminal.

Weifeng's house on Staten Island was a great place to stay and I'd recommend it highly.  Our visit was during the Christmas and New Years holidays and we found staying on Staten Island to be very convenient.  It's an easy 10 minute walk to the ferry (which is free) and my kids loved riding past the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island twice a day as our vacation "commute".  It was also far less crowded than everywhere else in New York City.  The apartment is one of three in a house that has been updated very nicely, and was easy to find.  It's across the street from a school, but since it was the holidays, that didn't affect us at all noise-wise.   The neighborhood appeared safe and there were a couple small grocery stores, a laundromat also within walking distance.  I have three teenage kids, and we never felt unsafe.  Weifeng was quick to communicate and very friendly.  Overall an excellent place to stay.

Great communication. Clean and well stocked with kitchen items and consumables. Located 2 mins from Metro station. Location appears a bit sketchy from the outside, but actually it was fine. 3 blocks to grocery stores and restaurants. Remember house shoes or slippers, as the tile floor can be cold. Great aircon.

Absolutely stunning apartment and a quick and easy walk up the street to the Subway. I never felt unsafe, even coming back later in the evening.  Maria responded quickly and was very kind. Would definitely stay here again!

I have very mixed feelings about this place. Location was perfect, the place was impeccably clean, the owner did the best to ‘dress’ it. Too high a price. It is on ground floor - feels like a basement- no windows. The bed is not at all comfortable. The check in procedure was sketchy, including problems ‘due to cold weather’, two different access codes communicated to me.   Shower nearly impossible due to extremely small space..more so due to ‘rain’ shower head that only is good if you want wet hair. I would not return.

Andrés was such an amazing host! The Studio was spotlessly clean and very well decorated. The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the room kept nice and warm in the cold. He made the whole process so much easier and stress-free. I highly recommend him as a host.

would only suggest this place if you have no other options. during our stay she entered the property prior giving a notice when we werent present.... . this happened twice and kind of unsafe when you have your belongings in the house . she keeps coming now and then which felt more like an inspection as she stays right next door and maintenance issues with the restroom and air conditioning....overall not a comfortable exp with the host and the service

Unpleasant trip... 1- No heat in December. Advertised central heat, but there was one radiator that was ice cold- no thermostat. 2- Host requested later check-in for cleaning. The bathroom was NOT cleaned. 3- No microwave- as advertised. 4- No hot water as I was preparing to leave around 630-7 am.

When I return I’m def going to reserve Jimmy’s place if it’s available! 10/10 recommend! It’s clean, fresh easy decor, extra pillows extra blankets extra towels all the extras kept it so cozy! A ton of really smart adds- coffee, creamer, sugar, chargers for phones, a bottle of wine all in place I literally did not need to go out for anything extra however close by walkable stores and restaurants was also pretty nice making his place an ideal location close to the subway to get to anywhere you want ! The front door staff were always friendly and so helpful! The buildings amenities arcade and gym were super useful. Parking is available around the building it’s all really simple easy taking all the stress out of travel, keeping it fun! The door locks itself when it closes- I locked myself out not realizing this:/ Jimmy was available immediately and was so kind about it all amazingly helpful!  Jimmy’s place is a fantastic place if you’re wondering if you should reserve it just do it !
Great stay in Manhattan! East Harlem is developing but I never felt unsafe and the building was very quiet, safe, and comfortable.

When I went to the apartment the area seemed pretty shady. Also the lobby was having no lights in the night. Apart from this; the host was not responding at all due to which I had to stay outside building for about an hr.  The apartment stinks with some bad smell don’t know what.

Manuel is a very good host, his place was very nice inside, just as I show in the photos. The entire check in and check out process was easy. He was always attentive to our needs and tried to make us feel comfortable at all times. The only negative thing about this review is the neighborhood, I didn't find the surroundings pleasant and it looks a little dangerous to walk around at night. But maybe Brooklyn is like that.  For everything else I am very pleased and recommend it.
Absolutely wonderful stay, if we come back to NYC, we will definitely reach out to this place again. Host was great, very kind and responsive. The price and location were a steal.
The lady who lives there was rude and seemed to be off drugs

Save your money!!! Honestly I dont do reviews often but I felt That I had To… this room is by far the worst air bnb experience I’ve ever had … i think they should start sharing a little more details about location because had i have known i wouldve never chose this block, the entrance to the place was a joke, some red rope was holding the gate closed. The front door looked like it barely closed, my room happened to be downstairs in the basement. The door to my room look like it had been shredded and put back together. I was Shocked! The floors were disgusting concrete maybe no carpet or tiles, chipped pain on walls and nothing like described. I felt embarrassed, unsafe and taken advantage of to be honest, air bnb needs to really monitor these accounts cause I’m starting to see alot more of these apartments where they have these remote entrances to the room and wifi doesn’t work and you can’t really do anything about it. Smdh do better air bnb and shame on you for charging what you did

Ben is a great host- responsive, clear communicative, friendly and flexible. hi apartment beautiful, lots of light and great city views.  I was in Brooklyn for a family emergency. after long, stressful days, Ben's apartment was the perfect sanctuary for recharging my batteries.  The bed was very comfy. the kitchen was  well equipped. a nice bathroom w Trader Joe's toiletries. I could go on!

This place should be taken off airbnb, the building itself scared the heck out of me. Looked like an abandoned building, where drug addicts wld go to back in the days. I got in the apt., immediately notice there was no heat. I contacted the host he said “ he will have the owner turn on the heat downstairs, and said there was a portable heat in bedroom.( it was a desktop heater ). After a 6 hr drive to get there, I went to take a shower, NO HOT WATER, was forced to take a cold shower. Went to tcb, came back about 8PM , went to the abandoned building, and still no heat or hot water. That’s when I contacted the host and told him I couldn’t stay there and was getting an hotel. His response was “I didn’t mean for this to happen) I bet he didn’t, guess that’s why there is a no cancellation policy for this rental. Lucky I was only booked for that one night. I been to plenty of Airbnb in that area for the same price and they was great, I would never rent from him again

We had a fantastic stay at Shayara’s apartment. My husband and I are actually Astoria locals that needed a place to stay with a guest while our apartment was under construction. Shayara was really responsive, the house was comfortable and clean, and the garage was a huge perk (though a bit tight to get in and out of as a crossover-SUV.) We had a lovely stay during an otherwise stressful week. Thanks, Shayara!

So the stay was ok but if you can stay somewhere else do so the people there was very rude she left guest upstairs in her house that was very rude screaming stomping it scared my daughter it’s a basement it’s not the entire house as promised doors was locked no privacy no where to park as promised the place is a box no at all like the pictures she was very fast with answering the phone but don’t smoke near the house unless she will lie and say you where smoking when she has other rude guest upstairs I don’t recommend

Place was great, looked like the pictures. The only problem was not able to use the tub ,did not look like it was secured to the drain properly and was afraid to fill it and drain it. Did not want water to leak into downstairs apartment.
Noisy upstairs, too many unsafe hazards. Inconsiderate and the heater don’t work.

The neighborhood was good, I enjoy the Queens area. The hostess was responsive when I reached out to her. However, there are some things that I did not like. The lock to the door was very tricky and if the hostess does not tell you how to lock the door properly it will be open which is unsafe. I was told to quiet down while getting ready during daylight hours around 2pm , however there were many people above me that I could hear all night. On my last night at the stay, random guest were able to walk in since they booked the home later that day which is also unsafe. Upon letting the hostess know she just said they had a booking later and did not apologize or make me feel safer. After the trip the hostess also asked me why I used to many clean sheets . I’m not sure why that would be a concern when clearly safety needs to be addressed and there is no crime to use extra sheets or blankets if needed. I would not recommend this stay unless you absolutely need it!

First, I'm going to be honest. I think I underpaid. This place is an absolute steal. This quaint spot is located in Ridgewood, close to the boundary with Bushwick. It was a lovely, quiet and diverse neighborhood with restaurants and stores a minimum of 6 to 7 minutes away (many close around 8 or 9). The L train is a 14 minute walk, the M train a 12 minute. If you would rather wait for buses, those were all literally around the corner. Folks are very friendly in the area and even though there are two other separate units in the space, you rarely if ever see them. The smart TV was nice, I was able to watch my YouTube videos and fall asleep. The fridge and bathroom is pristine, and there is an available iron/board if needed. Amenities are proper like the hot water boiler kettle, ample TP/paper towels, bath items, etc. Enen and his wife (20+ years in NYC) were amazing. Super responsive when my flight was delayed, they drove me to CVS to get lotion and toothpaste!! Great hosts 6/5 stars!

Emj was great, honest, and super responsive. The house is perfect for large parties who don’t mind twin and bunk beds. There is a queen master bedroom as well. It’s also seems newly renovated.   Linens were provided. Enough bath towels for everyone. Wi-Fi worked. TVs worked. Everything was great.  We were attending New Years Eve at the House of Yes and this townhouse was perfect for our needs. We simply needed a comfortable place to crash since all of us were from out of town.   The area it’s located in can appear a bit sketchy. There was also a fight at the corner of our block. All in all it didn’t detract from our experience but I’d be cautious with any families with small children.   If your a group from 21-35 looking for a clean and comfortable place to crash, this is perfect. Would stay here again!  Thanks Emi!

I must say, overall I enjoyed my stay at this location but they’re are a very things that I was VERY unsatisfied with! #1 was the heating. The apartment was very cold throughout the night and the thermostat didn’t help at all when we tried too turn it up. #2 the linen/bed sheets in the first room had smelled like that hadn’t been cleaned very thoroughly. They had a slightly unpleasant odor to them. But other than those two things, i very much enjoyed my stay. Just please improve on the linen and the heating.

Alan is awesome, very friendly, we felt welcome and comfortable, we were offered clementines after our long travel day, and their dog was very laid back.   The place itself was as advertised and cozy.   Neighborhood is nice and has a lot of cool cafes and restaurants, we really like the kolache place a few blocks from here. Be careful at the Bedford Nostrand stop though, there is a guy who frequently tries the “broken bottle scam” there.

The host is very awesome and so is the place. Straight five stars. Just some tips for people: -Harlem 125th st is not the safest and there was a street individual that rushed towards us in a sudden that was kind of scary. But the good thing is the location is very close to subway station, right downstairs. Please try to walk with another person and not too late. -Remember your password! You will be locked outside if you forgot it while your phone is not available.

Michaela was in incredible hostess and was able to help me with check in issues late at night. She made me feel safe and also accommodated a late checkout for me as well. Her space is well furnished, clean, and beautifully decorated. ALSO, lot bigger in person than in the pictures! The bnb has an elevator and is quite close to the metro, Starbucks, and is really a steal. Would love to come back for another stay!

Hi Paul, I do appreciate your efforts and willingness to take care of all my issues in the listing. I just think the place needed to finish being worked on before being made available to guests.  To those looking to book, I highly recommend you confirm that the heating & venting has been purified bc the dust made me terribly sick. The place was spotless when we arrived except for a dead roach and dead mouse smell (I didn’t mention to host bc I figured it would go). Well these were signs of things to come. Never saw a mouse but we had a serious roach issue and had to leave early due to that and dust. Some people find roaches common in BK but that’s never been my experience.  It’s a really nice space and close to the train. They did a wonderful job with layout and getting all new stuff (TV, towels, bed sheets, kitchen appliances). The neighborhood is definitely on the uptick which I love to see. More work is needed w keeping the neighborhood clean but I never felt unsafe.

BEWARE!! READ OTHER REVIEWS ABOUT FEELING UNSAFE!  30+ minutes struggling to enter the apartment. When he did answer we was rude and unhelpful. Told us that if we read the instructions it would have been easy, as if we didn’t do that. We eventually got in, no thanks to Marc. 2/3 locks on the door to the apartment were broken, and the door to the NYC apartment wiggled so much, anybody could have kicked it in. We have video of the locks not working, even though he “assures” they were. I already felt unsafe and extremely uncomfortable. There was an internal door with a desk in-front of it, no lock on the guest side, only a key hole. I felt like I couldn’t talk because we felt the space could have been shared despite listed as an entire space. The photos are extremely deceiving, it is not clean as the photos shows and there was stuff left in the fridge. We left the space immediately because of safety concerns. None of the concerns were resolved until past 5:20AM when submitted at 7:45PM.

Host is nothing but a liar and a thief. He told me his apartment would be one way and changed it up on me making me stay with his sister with one less bed than promised. I would not recommend this spot to my worst enemy. If you hope to fuck over your worst enemy please recommend Haim.
Was unable to contact Gaston. So we were unable to checkin.  Location was a scam. Hope it doesn’t happen to anyone else with this location.

It was a cozy apartment. Good location. He was responsive. Something that was odd to me was that it seems that it was his personal apartment. He left his belongings out. Then when we left, I felt he got annoyed that someone stayed at this place… that he rented out. However overall it was a good experience. Love the west village.  Love,  Rob

This spot has its pros and it’s cons, both of which I will list here.   Pros:  -LOTS of restaurants near by -near the subway/public transit  -sidewalks everywhere so it’s friendly for that.  -not many homeless people flooding the streets like other parts of town.   Cons: -stairway to 4th floor not mentioned. I’m 6 months pregnant and going up crooked stairs was not expected. VERY ran down building.  -it’s very noisy both outside and inside the home. The window is single pane and you can hear every single thing from cars to peoples conversations downstairs. Water pipe in the bathroom makes loud noise as well.  -no control over how warm or cold the place is. Ad states there is a window AC unit but there isn’t (I sleep very hot so would have been nice)   Anna, the co-host was quick to respond when there was an Issue with the door lock and the toilet. I SUPER appreciated that.   Thank you for letting us stay in the home

Close to the green line, making Manhattan easy to get to. Overall we enjoyed our stay. The stay itself is quite simple and small, but for a budget trip was well worth the price. All of the basic amenities are present. The neighbors we met were nice.   Only downside I can think of not present in the description and pictures would be that the heating unit can be loud, and at first glance then entrance can be a little sketchy looking for as it is down an alley.

The place was extremely cold. The temperature read below 55 when I arrived. The host did not inform there was no elevator in this place. You have to walk up five stair cases that look like they can break at any moment. Host was communicative, but it doesn’t fix that the place was just incredibly uncomfortable.   No toilet paper on arrival. Random people knocking at the door asking for stolen property. Musty smell. Wood floors feel like they are going to cave in. The place is stuck in some back alleyway with the shadiest people walking in and out. No elevator at all. The heat is terrible, and the power went out.  AirBnB promotes hosts like this. I’ve never had issues on this app before ever. I can’t even imagine why they refuse to help. They also didn’t post my review. I stayed at the place for four hours even though I booked it for days. Why should I risk catching hypothermia in a cold shady building or worst become a statistic because some person comes knocking on the door. Stay away
The apartment itself was good. However, the location was not ideal. Not enough to do around and it felt unsafe to walk from the subway station.

I had a very brief stay at Aaron’s place, which offers amazing value, it is cozy and is located very close to the subway. I found it very useful to have a fully equipped kitchen and laundry facilities. The neighbourhood may seem a bit rough at the edges, however I have not felt unsafe. This is a great option for a stay in NYC!

supermarket nearby which is good. public transit isnt the best so plan to stay local, uber or drive. unfortunately, the room was freezing upon arrival I had to ask for the heat to be turned on (twice). I woke up one morning with the sniffles and my phone was super cold too. I was given an extra blanket upon request which I appreciated considering how cold it was during my stay. There were quite a few days when I heard unpleasant noises from the house next door (perhaps large items being dropped and definitely conversations amongst people) but it stopped after a few days. I expected my stay to be more quiet than it was but overall okay for maybe 1-2 nights.

Jacqueline’s home was perfect for my family of 10.  I had 7 grandkids. Sin, Jacqueline’s son, was there to greet us for questions.   I am not sure if they took my large family into consideration but the dining room space was set for a fancy sit down dinner. Both living and dining rooms had a Roku projection TV and it was just perfect for the kids to enjoy movies and play games. 4 bedrooms/2.5 bathrooms, enough beds for all was even better. No one slept on the floor. My highlight was the kitchen, huge stove and space to prepare food for my family.    The location in Brooklyn was close to everything we wanted to do as a family.   It’s New York, so parking, complete with moving for street cleaning, can be stressful. Believe when Jacqueline shares on her page, ‘street parking is first come.’ Bring your patience.

Our stay in Natalie's apartment was an emotional rollercoaster ride. There were many sketchy things happening - I never talked with her on the phone nor did I meet her, instead there were 4 other people "taking care" of stuff. Basically, I felt unsafe as a woman in that apartment for various reasons and I told Natalie so. I would have expected that a woman would handle the situation differently. I can see that she's verified but it seemed like I was talking to a company behind the account.  My story is too long for this review, so I'll make it short:  Strange smell in the apartment; got locked out of the building at 3am at night bc the lock was stuck; heating broke for an entire day+when it worked again it was hot like a sauna bc there was no dial; someone came over to fix stuff while I was away and left the apartment door unlocked; there's only a lock preventing the knob from turning but the big mechanic lock is not attached to the wall and useless; someone tried to get access once.

Jason’s place more or less looked like the photos, but the outside of the apartment was scary and hard to locate and enter . It seemed like a bad neighbourhood. The door to the complex was open and could not shut leaving anyone to enter . The walls are super thin and you can hear the neighbours talking and it was very loud and disturbing for us as we couldn’t sleep. We also noticed how the heater was leaking water throughout my stay. There were paper plates and plastic cups. And only two towels and no change of bedsheets. And dust surrounding the kitchen table. And the bathroom had hair and dirt on the walls . The location was not ideal if you want to get to places as it’s very far away and the last stop on the train. The heaters were super hot and hard to turn off and the AC basically never blew out air . I hope the host takes more care before another person books this .

Very nice, recently renovated 2BR apartment with easy subway connections into Manhattan. Description and photos are accurate. Extremely clean! Comfortable beds, little to no street noise in the bedrooms (at the back of the building). Mauricio responded very quickly to us and was helpful to correct a problem with the internet router. Be prepared to drive around a bit to find overnight street parking. The neighborhood is mixed residential/commercial and bit gritty, but we did not feel unsafe. Overall, a good place to stay to explore New York City.
Lots of noise upstairs you can’t even sleep, you feel unsafe because she watch your every move and for anything wrong that you do she charges you more money. There’s basically no privacy.
we enjoyed our stay. host is friendly and responsive to our questions. the apartment is clean and tidy as advertised, no unpleasant surprises at all.
Homeless people living outside. Didn't feel safe going in or out of the building
I really do not recommend this place. It is in a very dangerous place. I do not recommend being there.
Jido was very responsive and was on time for my check in. Place was very clean and the space was a decent size ! Close to everything in NY. Steal of a deal .

Excellent service. Both Claire and Blair were always attentive to everything and made sure my family and I felt at home. They helped us whenever we needed it, and quickly. The area is really quiet, and not dangerous, with access to everything nearby. We leave very satisfied, looking forward to returning soon 👌

Rodinei is such a considerate host! Very tactful and intelligent, he does everything to make your stay as comfortable as possible. Wonderful apartments, fresh and clean sleeping accessories and towels, all self-care accessories, including shampoo, shower gel, soap, everything for dental hygiene and candles! I travel a lot and for me the main criterion is to find a cozy quiet place to reduce stress from frequent flights. Rodinei’s house is just such a place! I love reading and in the room where I lived, there are several shelves with wonderful books.  I'll be happy to come back again! Thank you for an amazing time spent in your home

The place itself It's nice,  good access to public transportation to Manhattan and any place in NYC, the house has many rooms with other guests and shared kitchen and bathroom, the problem with this room was that the air-condition vent was open, missing a screw, we came when it was -24°C so our room was very cold and we couldn't close the window vent, and felt a bit unsafe plus was very very noisy bc of the street and airplanes. But I have to say that we found a electric heater in the closet so it helped. I'd say that if the host fix that vent issue, the room would be perfect. Warm and quiet.  Thank you

Gabriel’s place was immaculate and was located in a very good corner right by morning side and Central Park. Gabriel made my stay very stress free and allowed me to check in and check out depending on my schedule. Will definitely be coming back

This is hipster, yeah? Like super cool and hipster, but also hipster. What is hipster, you might ask? Their era was 2000-2020, probably now RIP, replaced with... TikTok influencers? Back then, people really wanted to be misunderstood geniuses. Now they really want to be... popular. Anyway, this loft is next to literally the coolest restaurants in NYC: win son, baby blues luncheonette, panameria bakery, brooklyn ball factory, yun hai, winona's... and when you show up at the loft at night to check in, it looks... scary. And basically you go to the next door non-descript supermarket Brooklyn Harvest Market, you get the most hipster beer ever because hipsters have a steady diet of 100% beer. So, yeah, a hipster loft. I'll be back. Hasta la vista.

As Yara mentioned his place is indeed minimalistic. But what he did not mentioned is that it seems as if all of the little furniture he has was found in garbage. I got horrible bites from sitting on the couch. Which was covered in stains. I was very afraid I got lime desease, had to go to hospital, where they ruled out lime desease. I am still recovering from itchy bites. House does not have enough plates and utensils either. Yara was very responsive host. Only problem was that since the first minutes I have arrived he got the idea that someone else was gonna stay with us and kept asking about that, kept closer look who was coming and going and spending how much time. It felt like he was over my shoulder all the time. That’s why I added extra guest and paid extra to easy that watch. It worked. Otherwise location is convenient. Close to subway and all. Also water basically is not running in bathroom in fossil for washing hands. Shower works slightly better.
Simply superb. I felt that I stayed with a friend of mine. Great person rob!

I will definitely be booking this listing with Anthony again. The place was very clean and fresh! He provided everything we needed for our stay including extra linens. The entry and stairway was a little sketchy but thats pretty standard for NY apartments based on my experience. The house is about a minute walk to the train station and 4 minutes from the bus if you plan on using public transportation. There is also a couple delis and restaurants a couple blocks over. The home was beautiful and looks just like the pictures.

Great place to stay! The subway is right across the street which makes it super easy to get everywhere around Manhattan, Brooklyn, and Queens in just a few minutes. Also, super easy to get to the airport. Trust me you’ll save a lot of money rather than getting a taxi/Uber/Lyft. Good area with lots to do, close to everything. I never felt scared to walk alone on my way to the apartment after midnight. Mauricio and Javier are very friendly, super helpful, and they truly care about their guests. Mauricio is always making sure you are having a great stay, he is super responsive, and goes above and beyond. The place has everything you need, you’ll feel like a local right at home. I absolutely recommend! And I will def stay here again on my next trip to NYC.

We absolutely love this apartment. I live in NYC & I booked it for 4 of my cousins visiting from overseas. I was so in love with the space that I decided to stay with them there. Pictures don’t do justice to this place. Beside the luxury of design & choice of furnishings which felt super nice. It’s also super clean & spacious, the 5 of us slept very comfortably there & the 2 full bathrooms made things easier & more convenient accommodating 5 girls prepping for a long day of sightseeing.   As for the location, I was surprised how close Manhattan was by train, only 20 to 30 mins.  The neighborhood felt very safe, everyone was friendly. The subway was couple of blocks away from the apartment. We didn’t feel unsafe commuting late at night.   I’m so happy we got to be the first guests to stay in this apartment & everything was just perfect, from check-in to check-out. I will definitely book this place again whenever I have guests over.

I hate to have to leave this review but the host did not provide check in instructions until about 4 hours before check in when he told me the property was damaged and he would have to put me up somewhere else. I went through hours of a run around of him basically trying to scam me before finally he told ME to cancel my reservation. I was out of a place to stay on arrival and luckily was able to sort it out quickly myself w no help from him. I highly recommend avoiding this host at all costs as he seems to be fraudulent.  I did not stay in his property as I do not believe he even has a property.

I was afraid to try a shared space for safety reasons but Heather’s is truly a haven for female travelers. Where do I begin?  The Shared Space: As soon as you enter your greeted with this amazing scent throughout the place. Luxury finishes in the  fully stocked kitchen with complimentary coffee+ Tea. I rejoiced to see the bathroom sparkling clean. The shared space had cute lockers, room for luggage, and my bunk bed was so neatly made with fresh white towel set… it felt like a hotel. The quiet hours were a saving grace for my sleep and I also loved the balcony for some me time.  What’s around: 5 min walk to N  train so getting to the city was easy. Parking was not a problem and tons of local deli’s and quick eats. I think I had the best coffee from the yafa cafe, also a 5 min walk.    The Host: If I needed anything Heather was on it and did everything with a genuine care.  SUPER sweet host, this is officially my go-to spot.

If you are looking for cheap in NY, this fits the bill. The area is nice, local to plenty of shopping and restaurants. Our experience could have been a one off. It should still be shared though. The room is in the basement. You will hear all movements upstairs. It is a basement… so understandable . There is a dog. When we returned from dinner she  barked for a few hours until her human returned. That was alittle stressful as we were there to rest before a track meet. Host was responsive to our messages and the pup did calm once they returned. The space was on the colder side. The thermostat is controlled by the host. When we tried to adjust the heat ourselves we were locked out of the system. That’s fine. I understand not wanting it too high but we tried to put it to 69-70. For a basement I don’t think that’s unreasonable. Needless to say we woke up VERY COLD. I messed host, they responded quick, apologized and turned the heat on. Appliances were dirty/ stained but we didn’t use them.

Christina was a great host! The place was clean. She communicates quickly and is always helpful.    There are lots of little charming things like utensils, spices, pots, toiletries, etc.   Lots of natural light from windows but too bright in bedroom. Needs dark curtains.  Downsides are it is upstairs.  +many little things that need repair. (Like toilet seat; toilet tissue holder; lightbulb in the fridge, stairs, and dining; exposed wires on a light switch, some outlets not working; hard springs make the bed uncomfortable, etc.)   The water heater goes out from time to time. Can take up to a day to get switched back on.   We also had some challenges. My wife & dog were attacked by a dog downstairs, but Christina took care of it! She also let us directly extend our stay for a few days.   This'll be a cute little spot once it's all fixed up!   She has multiple properties & a great host. We'd prefer one of her other locations.   We definitely recommend & would be her guest again.

Great stay at Emanuele's, we were made to feel very welcome. Accommodation near the metro, not dangerous area.  Emanuele is very kind and gives very good advice for activities or restaurants.   It was a pleasure to discuss his Italian culture and our French culture with him.  I highly recommend this accommodation.

Hey the bnb was very clean and May be one of the best looking bnb in the area . The host was nice and friendly , the bathroom was spotless . The kitchen was big with a new stove and sink . New fridge too. This is a steal tbh. Would always recommend

I felt very safe in the neighborhood as a female traveling. Easy to get to the M train. Apartment is tiny but clutter free & clean. It is a walkup as described but it wasn't bad after getting my luggage in. Plenty of space in the closet with organization. Bed was very comfortable. The key to open the apt was a little tricky but I figured it out. Sercans roommate was WONDERFUL! The neighbors could sometimes be a little loud but they quieted down at night. The radiator on the bedroom scared me at 1st because it makes some noise when it kicks on but I got used to it & slept right through after the 1st night. The room was very peaceful & I was able to get good rest. For an NYC apt, it was great! Remember it's not a hotel & if it's you're 1st trip to the city, you might be shocked by the size but I found it quite charming. I'd stay again!

This listing is a scam. Most horrible experience on Airbnb, I checked out immediately on the first night. Upon arrival the reception was empty, and there was people waiting. After checking in to my room it looked like nothing like the one in the picture and it was very dirty, lots of prints and stains in the couch. I immediately expressed my concern to the front desk and they explained they have been having issues with this Airbnb host listing because it falsely advertises the rooms. I even offered to upgrade on my end and they were out of rooms. Lots of noice from outside, no water, dirty room, missing amenities listed. Don’t recommend to book. 2/10

I had a fantastic stress free stay at Michels place.  The apartment looked like the photos, every room nook and cranny was spotless clean, and it was quiet and peaceful. Everything worked properly and it was within walk-in distance to two different subway lines as well as Montefiore hospital which proximity was the reason for my stay. I didn’t dine in at any local restaurants but there were so many good restaurants to choose from nearby on DoorDash and ubereats. The bed was very comfortable and the streaming TV choices were great. The hosts were very responsive and kind. I’d definitely stay again.

My stay was quite pleasant. Bella was very considerate and accommodating   with my arrival time. I needed to drop off my bags earlier than check in and they were very understanding in allowing me to drop off my things before the check in time. It is a shared space with one other room available for tenants and I had no problems whatsoever getting in and out of my room. A key is provided to lock the room you booked assuring safety and security for all of my personal belongings during my stay. The keys were easy to access and Bella and her husband are a call away if any questions or problems were to arise. The location is right in the heart of chinatown/ Lower east side and close to a strip of restaurants, clubs, and metro. It was the perfect stay for if you are trying to explore the city and need a place to sleep. Coming in and out of the shared space throughout the day was easy and I ran into no problems with the other tenants or noise levels. This airbnb made my stay in ny stress free

Would highly recommend felt right at home soon as I walked thru the door just clean and there went any type of unpleasant smell and oladunni air bnb was somewhere u would find very comfortable and great time to go to when your in town visiting!!!!

With great disappointment the space was extremely smaller than anticipated, The balcony door has a major draft which caused the room to be extremely cold. The room was very bright would have preferred darker shade. The (weed)smoke from the other units seeped in through the balcony door which was very frustrating and uncomfortable to say the least. would not recommend if you are looking for something quite and relaxing.

The worst host I have ever encounter with rude disrespectful ignorant robbed us for our money then kicked us out  then called police I would not recommend on top of that it was like a jail cell in the basement with many people down there and not the best conditions overall the place was horrible on top of his attitude and I was there 10 mins too before he decided to kick us out which was his plan all along making up lies I would not suggest going there

The bedroom was very clean and comfortable. The apartment was pretty far from downtown but I was able to take the subway anywhere I wanted to go. It was a bit uncomfortable sharing the apartment with only the male owner but I never felt unsafe. They also have a lock on the bedroom door which I appreciated.

The location next to the subway was perfect.  The shower was fantastic which rejuvenated us after a long day in the city.  Bed was comfortable.  TV was sketchy, but in the end, it was nice to get away from the news for a week!  It's great if you are looking for a no frills place to lay your head at night.

The apartment was perfect and the host was very responsive. The surrounding neighbourhood may have the appearance of being unsafe but all the people in the area are nice and welcoming.   Make sure you plan your days as travelling out to main tourist attractions can’t take over an hour on the sub

Aminah’s place is an absolute bohemian sanctuary in Brooklyn. Loved the feel and energy of the space, and close AC lines got us everywhere we needed to go. It’s very comfortable, and cozy, and aside from the random sirens from time to time, it’s really quiet. The surrounding areas were a bit sketchy, and we didn’t feel we could comfortably explore around but if you’re just using the space as a landing pad, it’s perfect. It’s also super close to JFK, which was really Convenient. Aminah was very friendly, responsive and supportive and we’d highly recommend her as a great Airbnb host!

STAY AWAY FROM THIS AIRBNB!   I travel around the world using Airbnb and unfortunately this was the worst one yet.   1. Marketing photos are not accurate: missing bedding, no art, missing pillows, closet door broken, some amenities in photo are not listed, apt is MUCH older, futon is stained and furniture is different (no yellow chairs no coffee table)  2. Andre’s is a slow communicator. It took 1 week to remove the a/c unit that was promised to be taken out at check-in. Because of this there was a large gap in the window which made it unsafe and cold in the apt in December. He tried using a cardboard box to patch the hole but it was off during my check in. He had an excuse for everything.  3. Bed is very old. There is a clear dip on the right hand side of the bed which made it uncomfortable to sleep. 4. I walked in (after check-in time) to the cleaning person still cleaning. I had her vacuum the apt again since the carpet was clearly dirty. She told me the vacuum was too old.
I was charged 4 times for a two day stay , total scam
Quiet, stress free environment. Hospitality was great. Definitely was a great host and great location. Felt private and no bothers my whole stay.

The best thing about this apartment is its very close proximity to JFK Airport - about 3-4 minutes away. I had to make a very early morning drop-off, and staying here made it stress-free. That said, people unfamiliar with New York City's high rental prices might be surprised at how modest the accommodations are, given the price. I didn't appreciate the half-used toothpaste tubes in the bathroom and partially used/deformed sticks of butter in the fridge, but the place was clean and quiet, and Wycliffe was helpful. Future renters should know that you need to tell him in advance if you want the single bed set up. I had thought it was a day-bed, available for use if desired, but it's a fold-up roll-away in the closet. Also, there aren't any places nearby to get a bite to eat at 8:00pm on a Sunday evening,  this being primarily a residential neighborhood.

This apartment was perfect for my two month internship in NYC. The location is perfect, having access to most places in midtown within 10 minutes and a great subway station that can get to basically anywhere in or out of the city. Juan (the super) was an amazing asset during my stay, being available at all times to help me out with anything. Saul worked with me and had a quick response time whenever I had a question.   It is so quiet for living in Manhattan, and I never felt unsafe in our around my apartment. The rooftop was such a nice feature that should be used if you decide to stay here!

My family and I decided to do a stay-cation in NYC in order to get a new change of environment. Upon arrival at the unit we were VERY disappointed with the unit received. When we called the service line we were told that there is a stipulation in the description the unit we receive can be different than the one advertised on airbnb. I understand that there can be small differences here and there but what we received was DRASTICALLY different from what we thought we would get. The living room was so small we could not even use the pull-out couch. The listing stated there is a queen and king size bed - we were given 2 queens. The listing falsely advertises in-unit laundry - this is false. Washer and dryer is in the building and it costs $6 to do one load.  After going back and forth all day on the phone with Sonders, they reached out stating that they now saw the error between what we were given - and stated that they were giving us an “upgrade” we were switched into another unit that had much more space but was technically a 1 br + den. The Den was a room with no windows and a see-through door. Given the size of our party, we decided it was best to switch. However, it is still very frustrating to have been advertised something and expect it, only to be very disappointment. On top of that, the staff try to convince us that they were upgrading us - when in reality they never gave us the correct listing to begin with and the switch was still subpar to what we originally paid for. The inconvenience of moving between rooms on day 2 of our trip was also stressful given that some in the party were working or attending school remotely.  In terms of other things that was very disappointing, they advertise blazing fast wifi but disagree. Repeatedly the wifi would cut off Facetime calls, video streaming unto the TV, video calls. The bandwidth was not strong enough to reach the second bedroom. We originally planned to stay for two weeks and assumed that we would be given amenities to last for two weeks. We were given only two trash bags, a small bottle of dish soap, and some dishwasher soap. We asked for more which they only provided trash bags and dish soap. When we ran out of dishwasher soap we asked Sonders for more and they state they have a policy where you can only get one “courtesy” per stay - just be aware of that before booking here.   Other very irritating and honestly quite disrespectful experience happened during week two of our trip. We decided to extend our stay for one week. We completely paid for it and it was reflected in our booking online. Sonders aggressively sent someone to evacuate us on our original check-out date. When we informed them that we had extended our stay they left. However, we then received text messages and Airbnb messages asking that we show proof that we extended our stay. I had to then send screenshots to them to prove that it has already been paid!! I am very confused why they would be so aggressive and not refer to their own website for confirmation. After all they were the ones that approved the extension of our stay.   One of the individuals staying with us quickly left the building to go to a corner store. When he came back, he was questioned by security if he had a room in the building “Do you live here? Do you have a unit here?”- keep in mind that you need a code to enter into the building. Not only was this a micro-aggression against a black man, it was a racist remark to assume that a black man, who rightfully entered the building with his own key code, would not live in a unit in the building. I have never seen anyone else questioned in such a manner when entering into the building.   The last thing I will say that it is difficult working with Sonders. The customer service representatives are nice over the phone, however there seems to be a huge disconnect between Airbnb and Sonders. The Sonders customer services representatives would repeatedly mention that they are unable to see or have access to Airbnb system which made it very difficult for anything to be really done. The system isn’t set up for success which made it very frustrating to get anything done.
Just finished a great family trip to NY. The apartment is centrally located downtown and the stay was stress-free, helped by really good communication from the host.
Tommie’s place is super clean and definitely a steal. The location is close to public transit, took about 45 mins to an hour to get to some of the places on my list.

I had an amazing stay at Felipe and his family home. House is squeaky clean Very quiet. Very respectable and respectful people. It’s feels like instant home.The Great Dane is so sweeet the sweety dog she still think she’s a puppy even though she a Great Dane lol she wouldn’t hurt anyone I loved that dog if you are  truly not an animal person don’t book. Cause if you’re scared it would stress her out. Amazing House Amazing People & the Queens Mall is literally right there restaurants trains to the city and other areas are within blocks. 🤍

This was my first time renting an Airbnb space to visit NYC and celebrate my twin daughters birthdays. The size of the room were small and the picture featured a king size bed in the master suite which it did not have and it was a family size of 6 of us and there was no dining room sitting space for us to sit together as a family and eat. The AC unit in the living room space did nothing waiting resulting in the entire apt unit to be extremely hot as we visited in August. Maintenance did nothing arrive to fix the AC unit midday the next day. Upon checking out my daughter forgot two of our expensive hair curling irons costing $300 each in the master bathroom the items were in plain site and could not have been missed by housekeeping. I immediately called the customer service Dept at Sonder once I was made aware our items were accidentally left behind so housekeeping can remove them from our room and I could make arrangements to collect them.   I had the WORST experience getting sometime to talk to about my belongings all communication was through texting with several different people saying housekeeping did not find my items but found two camera stands! I never possessed any camera equipment and I know my items were stolen by Sonder’s housekeeping staff!  The was by far the WORST STAY I ever had in my life and I have been traveling for the past 20 yrs with my family never going through an experience like this. I would NEVER stay at a Sonder property again nor will I refer any family or friends! DO NOT STAY HERE! They steal your items if left and it’s overpriced for low budget space and non working fixtures!

Where do I even start.   I will say there were multiple issues with this property. The house isn’t clean, the sheets feel like sandpaper, (literally we went and bought sheets because they are so bad), the towels also sandpaper, the whole house had marks on the walls, bathroom counters were gross and marked, the rugs felt like literal straw, the house didn’t have enough trash bags, paper towels. Oh and the oven and stove were out of order so couldn’t cook the entire time. I mean to be honest it is a pretty awful place but that isn’t even close to the worst of it.  Unfortunately our flight got delayed die to weather and we had to extend to take the next flight out which meant overnight. I extended through my existed reservation which was more expensive then the original one and thought all was well. This is when pure chaos ensued. First a housekeeper came into my condo and told my nanny that her and my one year old son needed to vacate immediately. Then after having a conversation with a representative as Sonder I was told they had made a mistake and we’re sorry to bother me. This is where it gets really bad. I get back from my office and I’m inside with my baby and 7 random strangers walk into my rented apartment. If you can imagine the sheer panic and mother protection that ensued. I didn’t know what was happening. We’re they robbing us? What is going on? I was told by one of the women in this group of people that this apartment was theirs and once again I needed to get out. I’m now panicking and asking these people who are unmasked around my unvaccinated 1 years to get out of the apartment while I call Sonder and figure it. These people refuse to leave and tell me security is aware and told them to come in my unit. What in the world is going on. I finally tell them if they don’t leave I am going to call 911 and I basically have to push them out of the front door. Can you imagine how horrible of an experience this is?? I have a baby with me!!!!!! After hours of phone calls with Sonder I’m told the extension didn’t register on their side and they will call me with 50% compensation for my stay. (The first offer was 100 bucks) ha! Yeah right. Well it’s now the day after and again I’ve heard from no one. This place is a completely mess and I actually felt more than disgusted with the space, I felt unsafe. I felt like my family was put into Jeopardy and competed disregarded by their entire team. I would strongly suggest not stay at this or any Sonder accommodation.

Good location with good price! The house number was wrong although the right picture was shown. It would confuse customers. The Great Dane dog is very gentle and sweet although she looks intimidating for people who are afraid of dogs. Overall, we enjoyed our stays and the room was clean.

Exasperating Host & Experience We reserved a 2-bedroom unit for over a week with a king and queen size beds and a pull-out couch bed. This was not the unit we were placed in. Our unit had a queen and double size beds in the bedrooms. I reached out to Sonder and it took almost 4 full days to resolve the issue and multiple communications disrupting our family vacation.  It was very frustrating!  Each communication was with a different customer service rep.  Their responses were all of over the map and much of the time condescending saying “we’re sorry you’re confused’ other responses included….  “We don’t have that reservation for you” “Well, our beds are in UK measurements so their smaller than U.S. beds” “We greatly apologize and we will relocate you in 3 days” “Actually, we will not be relocating you or giving you a refund” Then communication went silent.  We had to file a complaint with Airbnb to get some resolution. We finally got Sonder to give us the correct unit after 3 days, but then they would not allow us to move into the new place until 11pm the next night.  After more back/forth communication we were able to move into the new place around 7:30pm on the 4th day.  This is some of the worst customer service I’ve experienced.  Not the usual host our family has found using Airbnb.   The two units were fair.  The beds were comfortable, except the pull-out couch was a thick foam which was not comfortable.  The table chairs in the first unit were pretty worn and uncomfortable to sit in.  The second unit had little better furniture and definitely more space with an open floor plan.  In both units the radiators were very noisy and made it hard to sleep at times.  All the showers were like heavy mist sprays so difficult to wash hair.  No ventilation in bathrooms which was unpleasant and stuffy.  The places were clean and had good bedding and pillows.  The only other strange issue was our check-out time was 11am and a Sonder person came to our door at 10:50am to make sure we were leaving.  They stood outside the door and waited for us.   Airbnb has usually been great experience, but this is not a place/host we will return to and do not recommend to others.

We stayed for 10 days, and in our opinion the room is perfect even for longer stays.   If your goal is to be mostly out and about, the room has everything you might need and Felipe (and his family) are always happy to help! There's enough space for two people and you get your own toilet (bathroom itself is shared, but we had zero trouble with that!)  Felipe's dog Lily might be scary big, but is timid, lovely and very well trained. She is curious (as is every dog, lol) but not obtrusive and will not bother at all. We loved her!  The place is very close to Central Park, two giant malls and many places to eat out. It's an insane value for money!  You will have a lot of privacy, but keep in mind that right outside of the room is the kitchen/family room and the sound isolation is quite poor. We weren't bothered by any noises at all, but keep it in mind if you're looking for something more secluded.  I would definitely recommend, and if we're ever back in NYC, we would love to stay at Felipe's place again.

At first I was afraid as it was the first time I took a room in an Airbnb. But in the end I felt at home =) Very welcome and I love their dog Lily and their baby ^^  I thank them for their hospitality
We enjoyed our stay and shady is the cutest little dog!
I m a travel nurse in columbia ER   Hospital is in just couple blocks away and neighborhood is quiet enough to rest well:) very nice host couple and doggo shady  Will comeback for another staying!

Harry’s private guest house was clean and accommodating. I stayed two weeks and never felt unsafe. It was a quiet neighborhood, but within walking distance of great restaurants. There’s a thermostat to control the temperature. I was the first guest to stay. The only thing I was missing was a microwave. I asked Harry if he could get one and he made it happen quickly with no issue. The place is extremely close to Coney Island, if interested. I was within close range of everything that I needed during my stay. The only thing I would take into account is the ceiling. If you’re a very tall person, you would have to duck inside. I would say it’s definitely fine if you’re 6 ft and under. Street parking is available if you have a car. Harry was very friendly and responsive to my needs. Great host. I would definitely stay again!
I had an amazing time at Ruben’s! It was very clean. Ruben was great at communicating and the whole process was very easy and stress-free.

Great place for the value.  2 blocks from the train.  Took us about 45 min to get to Chelsea market from door to door.  The neighborhood didn't feel unsafe at all.  We parked our car on a side street and left it there for the entire weekend.  A lot of room in the basement apartment.
I can’t stress enough how convenient this location is!  Aminah was a great host! Awesome communication, super easy check in. It was super clean and my sister and I loved it and would be back!!!
Rustic feel to the apartment. Ladder leading to your bed. If your scared of heights, this may be a problem.

This was such a great experience to stay here!! The price is unbeatable. My friends and I stayed here for a few nights and would definitely stay again. Everything is accessible as we walked to junction station every morning and night and didn’t feel unsafe. The host was also sooo great with communication and helpful as we had lost baggage being delivered from the airport. 10/10 recommend and if you stay here, I definitely suggest going to Buccaneer Diner for breakfast :)

flat 812 suffers for high noise. I suspect that all 12 flats of all floors are similar. too close tothe elevators or to other noise source all night long ! took us a lot if effort to move from there..

The apartment is spacious, has a wonderful smell and facilities and located in a good location.  The online Sonder team was responsive and the housekeeping team was nice and welcoming.  Besides that, we had very unpleasant experience with the guys at the reception. They didn’t want to help, gave as vague answers and have bad attitude. Hope they will be replaced ASAP.

Amazingly comfortable  Back bedrooms quiet One is over the karaoke bar so it can be noisy… however we were too tired from our long adventure days to really care The outside seems a little sketchy but you step into a beautiful apartment with all the mod cons and very comfy beds Amazing value  Can’t recommend enough!!!
Major steal for this neighborhood! Huge space, great amenities and easy check in.

Our stay in NYC was fine. Unit was nice in a good location, but I can’t recommend Sonder. Amenities that I was told were available were not and after reaching out for help many times, nothing was resolved. The correspondence from their end seemed to be computer generated and their claims of being there to help were disingenuous and annoying. It made for a difficult and stressful trip. Sonder is in the business to make money, and hospitality is not one of their values. If customer service is at all important to you, you will be disappointed.

The apartment is at a great location and close to most of the places you’d want to visit in NY, though not walkable. The entry gate was not working well and had some issues while going in or coming out. Yasunori was very prompt in replying and helping though the lock wasn’t changed during our 3 nights stay. The apartment was clean and as described. Only 2 rooms has AC unit but the other 2 rooms and living room has only portable AC units which by the way were not working well. It was equivalent to a regular fan. Couldn’t sleep in those 2 rooms at all, it was very warm even during the night. The apartment would be much better with some renovations and some mirrors. I was glad there was water (hot/cold) dispenser. The skylight windows in 3 of the rooms don’t have shade so the rooms get brighter very early in the morning. Also the reason those rooms get very hot during the day. Overall as I mentioned it needs some work. I really appreciate how Yasunori was very quick to reply and help.

Such a relief to have found this Airbnb in the Bronx. Its as beautiful and cozy as it looks in the photos. Its Quiet and Feels very safe (for a woman bc some other airbnb’s seem sketchy).  Emily was very kind and promptly responded to any questions i had.  I will definitely look to booking this place again if I’m ever back in the Bronx.   Thank you Emily!

There was no bed. There was a tiny sofa bed that was pretty dirty and only had room for one person. We had to use an airbed which we had to blow up ourselves when we arrived and had to blow it up again in the middle of the night because it deflated again. The cat wasn't a problem at all and the host responded quickly. However, the fact that there is no bed and we still paid about 180 a night seems like a bit of a scam.

first off, did not know what to expect since Google map reviews kind of scared us. when we got there we had very good service from security and front desk. room check in wasn't until 4 no early check in. room was very spacious and smelled clean. enough room for 6 people very comfortable. did not mind  what other people complained about. construction in NY started at 8am but we were so tired from excursions we slept well in all rooms and futon. very easy access to all subways and close to convenience stores. very much enjoyed our stay at sondor

Good location, the apartment corresponds relatively well to its description.  One of the bedrooms does not have a window. Complicated if you are claustrophobic. Please note there is no washing machine in the building. What I found very unpleasant: the obligation to transmit personal data on the Sonder site once the rental has been paid via AirBnB (copy of the identity document, front and profile photo via the camera, etc. etc.) under the pretext of ensuring our security. It is impossible to access the apartment if this is not done and the person who represents Sonder on site cannot resolve the problem.  Online process only.

I was kind of afraid when booking an AirBnB in New York due to the high level of last minute of cancelations (I was travelling with many other little groups and many of them got cancelled). Saying this, Rich's place seemed to nice to be true. But it was true. It is an amazing apartment, right next to Times Square and it is the perfect solution for accomodation if you want to experience all major NYC highlights (Times Square, Fifth Avenue, USS Intrepid, Central Park... all within walking distance).  The apartment is new and fully equipped and fits 6 with no problem. The contacts and conversation with the owner where swift and the key system is so convinient: it allows you to arrive at any time. Recommended!

The unit itself was as described in the listing and pictures. However, the timing of our stay was terrible. The construction noise directly next-door to the building was unbelievable starting at 7:30 AM and lasting all day, back up beeping sounds hammering, sawing just terrible noise. The rooftop or outdoor space was closed because of the construction, and unfortunately it’s not well documented when you’re searching to stay here yet somehow appears in the listing on your phone once you are already signed up and paid for. It’s obvious that our unit had not been cleaned in sometime. I personally swept three full dust pans full of sand and dust bunnies the first night we were there. So for a unit that charges over $500 a night to walk into that type of lack of decent standard just tells you all you need to know. The Sonder reps were all great. The people that are walking around and near the doors most were scary and begging for anything you could give them, but we saw that all over NYC.

-When you check in for the first time, you are given a unit with a strange layout that is completely different from the room you booked on Airbnb.  -The kitchen and living room were completely separated, so it was a very uncomfortable because kitchen was too far away.  -The dining table was for 2 people and there were only 2 chairs. but we were 5 people. So I had to sit on the floor and eat at the table in front of the sofa.  -The layout what I booked was a unit in which the kitchen and living room are attached in a straight line, and the dining table is also placed in between. They lure the people into nice rooms and then making them pay , and then give them  weird rooms. this is a SCAM...  I had to spend 4 out of 7 days of our family trip in a room I didn't booked.  Haha.  I  paid $2200 for this stay and they refund $21 only. This is crazy.. And Airbnb says they can't refund more because the host didn't break the rules. Yes . this is SCAM..

This Airbnb made our New York trip amazing! The location was less than a mile from a lot of what we wanted to do so walking was made easy! The owners were quick to respond and were very helpful with any questions. This place was definitely a steal. I doubt we could have ever found a place that was priced as well as this place for the location we were in.

Overall it was a good stay. Great communication with the host, very helpful people around. Clean and close to the subway although no direct connection to Manhattan. Neighbourhood was ok, but we made a great mistake taking J line from JFK in the night. We strongly recommend not to do it, because it might be dangerous.
Great location in UES, close to food stores, drug stores and restaurants.  Q Line subway access nearby.

My stay at Haz's apartment was one of my best Airbnb experiences ever. I stayed for a month after moving out of my apartment in Manhattan, and it was an oasis of calm after a stressful time. The apartment is spacious and thoughtfully furnished. The kitchen and bathroom in particular were delightful and looked brand-new. I also ended up loving the neighborhood -- both 7th Ave and 5th Ave have SO many restaurants and small shops, and everywhere had a really friendly feel. All of Haz's restaurant recommendations were spot on, too. I highly recommend getting the chicken pho from 5ive Spice for a cozy winter takeout. The apartment is also super close to the B/Q and only a 10 minute walk or so to Atlantic Ave, which has tons of subway lines, so it's really well situated!

The Airbnb as a whole is clean. The bathroom, used by sometimes more than 8 people, is cleaned regularly and therefore hassle-free. There are often people who wash when we want to wash, it's a bit annoying but people are respectful and wash quickly. The Airbnb is really close to the metro and the area, which seems a little dangerous at first glance, posed no problem for us. The street is safe. Be careful, the surrounding stores for shopping are extremely expensive, you should plan to go a little further by taking the bus. I am satisfied with the Airbnb. Good value for money.

Nina was a great host. She was incredibly accommodating and anything we needed, she provided us with directions or accommodations to do so. She was a great communicator and we were never afraid to shoot her a message with any questions we had. The only downfall was having one key to the door and with it being a large group of us, it was a tad inconvenient, but we made it work. This location is about a 15 minute walk to two subway stops that can take you to Manhattan, Brooklyn, etc. This location was also close to Citi Field.

Jenny was a great host. Very communicative and the space was immaculate when we arrived. The location is a steal if you can abide by the ferry schedule, but note that the last service is around 8 or 9pm. Getting back after the ferry stops is longer and far more complicated. Overall great stay!

Nice apartment with the great location (but not very nice experience).   This is really a kind of a review I would be thankful to read before the stay - unfortunately, there were no with sufficient description at that time.   The apartment is exact on the photos, which is great and without any surprises. If you like bright interior - you’re welcome, personally for me was a bit pressing and hard to feel cozy inside.   The location is fabulous, close to the Central Park (15 min walking), 6 and Q train, located right on the second avenue, 2nd floor walk up by stairs with no elevator.   Equipped with all the appliances, washer and dryer in unit (which is great), dishwasher, please note - no hair dryer (do not understand why, frankly speaking).   Very nice manger and a landlord when facing them at the office - but not when you are trying to call. As a visitor, you do not always have a local phone number, so I suppose there has to be a way to call the landlord / management by any other means. I didn’t succeed when there was an emergency situation and that was awful experience.   The heating turns on when it’s getting colder outside and one day at 3 am in the night the radiator started leaking with steam and water. I wake up because it was in the bedroom and impossible to sleep, it was so loud that even heard outside of the apartment. I tried to call the emergency number for 9 times but was not able to succeed. The noise and leaking was so awful that I had to sleep at the coach and close the door to the bedroom, put my AirPods with sound proof. It continued for almost 12 hours.  Later the day, the management told that it’s ok when the radiator makes noise (and that’s true but not SO loud with steam coming from it), but sent a men to fix this. I hoped it would be better, but every next night when it was cold outside, I was experiencing the same situation again and again (thanks god it was really warm October). The leaking was not so bad, but the noise was unbearable. Can’t imagine staying there in the winter.   And there was one more unpleasant situation (I hope though this will not happen again, but have to write this for the complete review).  A mouse was running in the apartment. In the evening, it ran into the bedroom from the kitchen when I was reading on the bed and then ran back to the kitchen. I was really shocked.  I contacted the host via AirBnb the next day (remembering it’s useless to try calling them at night), they sent a men and fixed the hole that was behind the dishwasher (why isn’t that possible to check for such big holes before check-in????).  I understand this happens, but my experience was not perfect at all.. Overall, I would recommend Afi and their apartments (I am sure they have a lot) maybe It was me who was not so lucky for the things to go smoothly.
Great host. Loved the room. Beautiful, clean, and comfortable. Also smelled amazing. A total steal for how cheap it was. Will definitely come back if I need an airbnb in the area again.

Yolanda is a great great lady. Sweetest and warmest soul. The room and the house is very clean. There’s a nice closet with sufficient hangers, laundromat is in the basement which was very helpful! Overall, loved my stay here!!   P.s. for solo female travellers, I’d say walking alone after 10 can be a little scary in that area. But to be honest, thats true for the whole of NYC.

This place looks exactly like how the pictures make it out to look. The area is so pretty, nice, and calm. Loved that the subway was not to far away and we were able to get to places quickly. Alexandre was nice enough to recommend us some good places to eat by providing us a guide so don’t be afraid to ask for suggestions because they will provide some great ones! The response time is also amazing which we loved because we didn’t feel ignored! Ashley helped out a lot as well by that! Will definitely be booking this place again on our next visit!

Kris has a steal of a place in a great neighborhood in Brooklyn. Quiet, friendly neighborhood within walking distance of just about anything you could want/need in New York. A short walk and train ride will get you just about anywhere in the city. Kris himself is one of the nicer, more communicative hosts I’ve ever stayed with. And the place itself is exactly what we were looking for! More than comfortable enough to spend time at his home (working from home while traveling?), which I often find is not the case with most Airbnbs

Beautiful spacious apartment completely renovated with an excellent geographical location and very well served by transport, but therefore extremely noisy 24 hours a day so earplugs essential. 4 extremely small rooms (with very thin partitions between rooms) and no owner on site. Cockroaches in the kitchen and rats in the hall of the building: commonplace for NY but still unpleasant. No elevator, 2 very steep floors. The exact address was two blocks from the one on the map. No reception, keys available via a locker in a nearby grocery store.

This was an impromptu trip from LA to NY for my husband and I due to our daughter having an unplanned procedure.  I was looking for something that would be comfortable for 3 people while she was in recovery and Dee's place definitely fit what I was looking for.  Nestled in a cute community in Staten Island is a beautiful apartment that is clean, spacious and full of thoughtful touches.  Our booking was  short notice and our arrival time kept changing but Dee handled it with grace and even kept checking to make sure all was well.  After a horrific experience with the procedure, release and transportation to the apartment we were all exhausted and overwhelmed but once we stepped into the apartment all of the stress was washed away.  The apartment is well laid out. Due to the chaos of the day we hadn't eaten but to our surprise there were snacks available for our use.  The beds were comfortable,  shower was great and her communication was excellent... this place was the best part of what started out as a horrible situation.  She offered a parking space but as we didn't have a vehicle we discovered that the transportation was very easy to navigate.  Just one short bus ride to the ferry which is free and gives a beautiful view of the Statue of Liberty then your in the city.  Now that our daughter lives in NY we will be planning trips to visit and I already know where we're going look first. Thank you for everything!

This place is a gem in Park Slope/Windsor Terrace. Almost afraid to give it this review for fear that it will be sold out forever!
