Tish is a great host and has a beautiful place. The location is high crime area with lots of noise in the morning from construction being done less then 150ft away. Also there are surveillance  cameras inside the home watching you. That doesn’t bother everyone, just always be dress appropriate.
Very clean and well taken care of. Never felt unsafe.
Excellent accommodation! Very spacious and quiet. Super complete kitchen and impeccable room! The neighborhood is not very nice to walk at night, many homeless and crazy people on the street.

Upon the day of check-in, the host then informed me of the check-in instructions. She was aware of the time I was going to check-in as she had asked the day before. Her check-in instructions were unclear. Considering the host was communicating from Florida and her plan was to have her housekeeper hand over the keys, I expected her response rate to be much quicker. Instead, I was met with having to leave voicemails and writing one-sided messages. I used my friend's phone to call her again and the host was still unresponsive. I had to reach out to Airbnb Support as I thought this listing was a scam. She then called back an hour later saying that she thought the housekeeper had given me the keys already. I then waited 30 more minutes until the housekeeper came with the keys. The apartment was simple and clean. 1 of the 2 bedrooms did not have any curtains/shades, so prepare for the sun to be in your eyes. Check-out instructions were also unclear, as I had to reach out for the procedure.

The place is small but well distributed, it has everything you could need and the location is really accessible for getting taxis and food.   However, if you are a light sleep you might not have a good rest here, the heating makes some noise and it’s imposible to know where it will start or stop. And the apartment upstairs has music running almost all day long and it starts really early in the morning. It’s not unpleasant music and it’s also not really loud but it’s something that kept me from sleeping comfortably.

The apartment is great and Jaden was a very helpful host. The unit is big and has everything you need for your stay, including strong WiFi. There was construction going on the outdoor patio and workers walking back and forth outside the patio door and window, which can be scary. That said, my stay was great and I would recommend this airbnb.
Everythingwas clean and neat and the hosts supported us when we were scared that we would be locked out after losing the keys.

After being scammed on Airbnb 3 times trying to book a NYC stay, I was very skeptical of hosts and the experience - BUT my experience with Natalie and this property totally reset my confidence in Airbnb and human kind.  Natalie was incredibly responsive, kind and trustworthy!  The property was a great spot for our family of 4 to have a wonderful thanksgiving stay allowing us to be together in a home.  We all felt safe and comfortable there.  Natalie is the real deal and i would stay here again without hesitation!  Thank you Natalie!

Aggressive cat. (Host refused to remove cat after several biting and scratching incidents.) We got an eviction notice from the management during our stay.  (Host replied: don’t answer the front door anymore)   Urine and feces (human) in the stairwell of building. Dangerous drivers in the neighborhood.   No purified water.  Host eats guest food in fridge and changes rules about kitchen utensils or common areas at her own whim. Drawers, bed area, and corners of “private room”were filled with host’s personal items: makeup, stage lights, cat hair and dust.   Host needed to access drawers in private room for other guests bedding. Laundry facilities generally unavailable. One shared towel in bathroom. No ventilation in kitchen or bathroom. Very loud upstairs neighbors stomping and baby crying all night. UNSAFE. Do not book.

This shared apartment was kinda nice and clean, tho I really hated the neighborhood. VERY LOUD, dirty and from what I found out on the internet kinda dangerous. We also heard shooting at one night. Obvi it’s not the property owners fault, but it’s important to know before.

The “cozy” apartment was decorated nicely and had a home feel as it’s the owner’s private residence. However, there was a broken vent right on the living room floor with a gaping whole and detached spokes/bars. Not only is that an eyesore, it’s unsafe; if you have small feel, you could actually fall through and hurt yourself. Also, the stove is not a standard size stove, it’s very small. My daughter called it an “easy bake” oven. Additionally, the owner privately shared that the oven doesn’t turn off until 20minutes after it’s actually turned off!

Great stay, exactly as advertised! I didn’t see a single person in my 3 days there (which was great for me lol). Didn’t have an issue with the wait for the bathroom I’m AMs like other reviews, but I was getting up at 7:30 and everyone was still asleep. 5 minute walk from Subway and key bus stops. I could see how some people would feel unsafe walking around the neighborhood in the evening, but I had zero issues!

Sam was a wonderful host and we both really enjoyed our stay. We appreciated the amount of consideration that came into providing us clean towels, slippers, and soaps. The room was a bit chilly so the heater was a much needed and appreciated addition to the room as well. When we arrived the room and bathroom were clean. The kitchen also came with plates, cups and pans to cook which was helpful too! Our only critique would be that the location itself can be a bit sketchy and loud at night so it was a bit hard to sleep. As well, the guests we had were a bit loud one night and the noise traveled into our room. Sam as a host was very responsive and accommodating when we needed to rebook an additional night and with refunds. Check in process was also very clear and simple to follow. Other than that we had a lovely stay and would recommend and book again.

Highly recommend! This is a steal. I had the whole place to myself for the price of a room. It was spotless clean, easy access to subway, very warm. The mattress was great. The hosts were kind and supportive. Responded instantly. The wifi was a bit slow a couple of times - stayed a week. Took 42 minutes to Union square. Two train lines 1.5 blocks away. A very easy commute. Very happy I booked. Will be back. Thank you guys!!

Dina's place was very cozy and homey!  It perfectly fit 8 people, the details of the house was unique. Honestly I knew nothing about the country Kazakhstan, I learned quite from this house which represented not only history but traditions and culture.   Outdoor deck was spacious, furniture is perfect for 7-9 people, we had some grills ( they have 2 grills, one on the charcoal and another on gas).  Evening are chilly in Pocono and get in hot tub which was quite hot with some bubbles.   We burn some woods in outdoor space and started telling some scary stories by scaring each other to death 😅😂 Later we continue the fire at home.  The fireplace always makes home special.   Overall, it's great place for family.  Thanks for hosts for great work!

Clean, comfortable, and affordable. I had a really nice time staying here! Its close to the 6 trains to get you anywhere in the city! The area is a little sketchy at night, but during the day its fun to walk around. Would stay here again on my next trip!
Sam was a great host and made sure check in was easy! Location is great but the neighborhood is a little sketchy at night. Would stay here again!

We had a problem during our stay at Daniel’s since he mixed the codes for other hosts with the other apartment. We had a family walk into the apartment in the middle of the night and that wad quite scary. On top of that we had no wifi at all during our stay which was a disadvantage. The house is perfect for 6 people but the cutlery and accessories is only meant for four.  Apart from that the apartment looks like the pictures and it is clean and tidy.

This Airbnb is even more pleasant than the pictures reflect. It is an excellent place to relax and unwind. The apartment itself is very well laid out and pretty spacious (which is a steal for Manhattan). The location is unparalleled, right in the center of everything, but yet very cozy and quite. The kitchen contains all you need to cook your own meals, and the bedrooms are very comfortable.   The host was very responsive comminicator too. Highly recommend, would definitely stay again next time I am in New York!

We were excited to stay in this rental. The place was nice looking however we did not enjoy the stay as there was constant noise coming from the upstairs unit which the owner lives in. The first 4 days there was constant noise till 12:30am people yelling, partying, dogs barking, furniture scrapping on the floor and thumping sound. We also felt weird there was a room labeled storage room  however there was constant going in and out of the room. We would be sitting on the couch and see the light flip on and hear people grabbing drinks from it super sketchy. The rooms were hot we were looking for the ac controller but could not find it. One night we opened windows however had to close it cause there were people smoking weed outside upstairs.

Location was cool to be, but the place was kind of deceiving in the sense that the apartment isn’t as clean and glamour as in the photos. Lots of trash in the entrance of the apartment, lots of noise sometimes. I also got lots of packages stolen in the lobby after delivery, and host was totally irresponsive when I declared it. He basically told me to fend for myself and call the police, even though I had asked for instructions for safe delivery upon arrival.
Small bathroom. The heating pipe in the bedroom seems dangerous to me. And going up to the fourth floor was heavy with suitcases

Book Now!!! Staying with Mp was the best experience we’ve had with Airbnb! Plenty of space, quiet and private!!! There’s a massage chair, which we all enjoyed very much! Walkable to stores and places to eat! Added bonus was the parking for our rental car!! Only 15-20 mins to JFK depending on traffic! Excellent kitchen and backyard space! The heat worked great and my kids absolutely loved the nice attack setup with a disco ball! Truly an enjoyable Airbnb host and stay! Plenty of beds/bedrooms and 2 bathroom made it Amazing spending the Holidays here in Queens! We drove into Manhattan in 35 minutes! Don’t hesitate to stay here and we will  definitely stay here again. Thank you Mp!!

Positive sides  1. The location and value of the price are reasonable. 2. The place is clean and quiet. 3. Maltoni, Trevor's helper, was very nice and friendly. 4. Private bathroom.  Negative sides:  Even though the place overall is good I regretted booking with Trevor. Their communication style lacks clarity and respect for their guest.  I Trevor that I arrive at 9 pm. At first, they told me that Maltoni would let me in but after some time when I was on the plane, I received a message "self-check-in".  I received the directions to find the keys and open the door only around 9:20 pm when I was already there struggling to find where the keys were hidden (it was dark and raining) and then which key opens which lock (also in the dark).  The directions to find the apartment were not clear.  It's a multi-store building and there are no apartment numbers. That is what Trevor sent me:   "Enter, go upstairs, right Inside, right down hallway Room straight ahead. Open".   From this description is not very clear what floor is it. Is it right inside? Apartment on the right? When it's not your building and you're tired and have suitcases it's very frustrating.  Overall I spent about 40 minutes trying to get to my room all because of poor communication after a long journey from California.  When I pointed out my frustration to Trevor, they said "Don't blame me if you misunderstand". It is not a nice way to treat your client. All that stress was absolutely unnecessary.

RI was very communicative and accommodating -- excellent to work with.  And by-and-large, the apartment was as-advertised.  Two issues, though.  First, maybe a fluke: for the first ~24 hours of our stay, there was no hot water.  The entire building was without hot water, but it really put a damper on things (ice-cold showers), especially because it was during the cold snap over Christmas.   Also, the bathroom lights were all non-functioning, and we had to position a table lamp from the living area in the bathroom which was cramped to begin with.  Second, the apartment was very cluttered, and there were very few spaces to put things down (for example, there were multiple laptops left of desks and the coffee table, and all their toiletries took up most spaces in the bathroom).  In fairness, three people live in this apartment, so we should have expected it to some degree.  Just don't go expecting to be able to unpack.  I need to stress that RI was very apologetic and accommodating.

The place was absolutely stunning, every room has its own ac. There is actually a total of 6 bed that was not mention in the description that can be found under the bunk bed. There are 2 different train station that are both a 10 min walking distance. However the neighborhood could be a little dangerous and sketchy if you are walking late at night due to the lake of street light and the location.
The place was welcoming, Petra was super responsive and super welcoming. Surrounding area is not the prettiest but we never felt unsafe.

This was an easy and pleasant stay. The building and room are both very nice. Communication was great and a breeze.   The room was bigger than I thought and a nice size full kitchen was a plus as was the huge windows with a view of downtown. The bed was a little creepy and prob not great for 2 larger people. The location couldn't have been better. Subways close by. A nice bakery right downstairs and several good eating/drink spots within walking distance. If you want to see times square, it's only a couple blocks away. There's also a rooftop sitting area. It was closed for maintenance but an added plus for anyone who gets to enjoy it. Oh and the beverages in the fridge were my favorite! what a surprise!! We had a fantastic stay and would def stay again when we're in town.

Cute and cozy! Loved it here. Had everything I needed felt right at home. Good location for UES, nice neighborhood near shopping and bars. Marc gave clear and detailed check in instructions which made getting into the apartment very stress free and easy.

Very unpleasant stay. We had to go find another place after one night because this experience was so bad. Uncomfortable with thin pillows on a hard bed, loud, on the first floor with a car park across the street and constant car alarms going off. The unprotected windows, on the first floor, were a regular hang out location for local smokers with no air circulation otherwise made it stifling hot even though the outside temps were in the 60’s. Would never stay here again and don’t recommend you do either.

Ryan hosted us during Thanksgiving. We were worried about parking, but parking had to been the easiest we’ve found since we’ve been coming to NY for the past 5 years.   The place was cozy and close to a beautiful park for the dogs.   The roof terrace added an extra amenity, especially because the weather was so warm during thanksgiving.   The beds and pillows were so comfortable that we had to look to see what brand they were.   There was a couch and a chair that folded down into a bed, which was nice to lay in the living room to watch a Christmas movie.    Contacted Ryan to find out if he had any baking pans or cutting board but he did not. He was willing to have them delivered within 2 hours but we advised that wasn’t necessary. We went to the grocery store that was walking distance around the corner and purchased disposable tin pans. (Saved pm washing dishes.)   The subway was literally a min walk from the house. The neighborhood was quiet and never felt unsafe.

This apartment had no heating controls. We could no sleep and the heating was so high we felt like we were getting boiled. We messaged the host and their answer was to just open the window. We then felt unsafe sleeping with the windows open, aswell as the noise levels.  We ended up checking out 2 days earlier and booking accommodation elsewhere as we were sleeping drenched in our own sweat each night. Extremely uncomfortable experience and no compensation or help from owners!

This accommodation is very clean and very functional. There were 6 of us and we didn't feel cramped despite the living room being a bit small.  The beds are very good and the bathroom is very pretty. We had a nice quantity of towels and linens.  The area is a little noisy but not far from metro line 6. There are many local shops nearby.  The host was very accommodating regarding the departure time due to our flight.  I recommend.

We had a great stay at Sandra’s place. It was super comfy and clean. Loved all the updates in this historic home. The only thing that was a small bother is that we could hear the neighbor coming up and down their stairs like it was in our part of the building. Scared us the first night, we thought someone was in our place. Just wanted to warn others so they will expect it. The neighbors were very nice though! They helped us out with parking and were very friendly people. I would definitely recommend this spot to others staying in the NYC area!

This place was okay for us just needing somewhere to sleep for the night but I wouldn’t go here for anything more than that. When we arrived there was a drying rack full of dishes, from the previous guest that weren’t put away? The dishes also had stuff on them so we cleaned before use. We were looking for the sheets for the sofa bed as we could only find a comforter and a pillow case under the bed and the host messaged that it was under the bed, and called to ensure I found them which was nice. I think it’s ridiculous to list a place for 6 guests with a sofa bed that had no pillows just pillow cases and a comforter, no sheet to lay down on the sofa or anything. The door in one bedroom didn’t shut properly but it got way too hot so we had to sleep with the door open anyway. For the “essentials” there was one bottle of Pantene and a bar of soap. The bathroom on the first floor was claustrophobic. The lack of decor/ curtain on sliding door(no privacy?)made the place feel a bit creepy.
Amazing trip and amazing place! Will stay here again for sure! Great communication! We got scammed on another Arbnb rental after arriving in NYC and they saved the day! Thank you John and Gracie!

This woman isn’t accommodating at all, wouldn’t refund me after I told her I wouldn’t make it out there in time. So I got robbed out of 300$  Also if you don’t mind staying the pjs for however long your stay, book here! I searched this address after I thought my flight was a go. I was able to see where it was-The owner of this Airbnb is renting out of the projects and if you don’t know what that is- it’s public housing. Good luck and peace out

Pamela does not seem to like honest feedback especially when negative. Feedbacks to some extent makes one better and improve on our services. I left her place in a hurry to avoid issues. She did not deem it fit to even acknowledge that I have checked out. It was really an unpleasant experience!!

Moe’s place was amazing! They have lots of amenities just as the listing and the bed was absolutely comfy. Instructions for check in was very clear and easy for us to enter the building. The only down side is the sketchy neighbourhood but if you are in a group it should be fine. I would definitely rebook again!

Enjoyed our stay at Jacqueline’s place! Very clean, accurate description, easy to locate and had everything we needed! In a decent location about a 5-10min walk to subways to get you all over the city. The host was very easy to communicate with and helpful with any questions we had! On the weekends it could get a little loud on the street, but we are heavy sleepers and it was pretty quiet the weekend we were there. My only issue, it was a little sketchy in the streets surrounding the apt, but we felt safe with there being 2 of us at all times. The place felt secure once we were in too.  A highlight from the stay was CloudM cocktail bar a 15-20min walk from the apartment. Incredible views and relaxing atmosphere! Thanks again for a great stay!

We were the first tenants of this apartment. Everything was new, we even took the plastic out of the oven so it was great. We didn't want for anything, it was clean and comfortable. The hosts gave us an arrival gift which was really appreciated.   Three points slightly inconvenient;  It is extremely hot in this accommodation since it is managed by the building. I was afraid of opening the windows too much since there is nothing on the window to prevent critters from getting in. 😅 on the other hand we were offered fans.  We only had one key since we were traveling with 3 adults and 1 child, a second one would have been practical.  The street is split in two and only one metro line goes there. The first night we were lost since some subways go on this street but really higher up. Despite an hour of walking, we ended up by taxi. Make sure to take line 1. Otherwise it was perfect!!

It's the best accommodation ever! The room and living room are very spacious and basically very sanitary. Also, there were enough dishes prepared, and garbage bags were all prepared, making it convenient to dispose of garbage. There were many toothpaste, shampoo, and treatments, and it was easy to do laundry because there were washing machines and dryers. Of course, detergent is included. And There is a big TV installed in the living room and each room, and you can watch Netflix and YouTube. The subway was a six-minute walk away, so the transportation to Manhattan was very convenient, and it wasn't that dangerous at night. The host upstairs was very kind, and his child was very cute. If I go to New York again, I will want to reserve this accommodation. If you are Korean watched this review, I recommend you to make a reservation for this accommodation.

This is the most amazing house EVER! My family had the best time here. The location couldn’t be better, and the house is perfection. The owner is so so nice and beyond helpful. It was a challenge for our family to find a home in NY that could accommodate us, and we ran into many scams on Airbnb (be careful). This house was a miracle, and we are so thankful to the owner for being so reliable and kind. We highly recommend this house and, if the owner allows, we will definitely rent this house again in the future! 5 stars!
Room and apartment was clean when I arrived. Has two ways to lock the door so I felt very secure and safe. The area is not too sketchy very creative and seems like a community. Would come here again!

Enrico communicated well, and getting in was easy enough. But our key wouldn’t work when we returned late at night, and although Enrico was able to fix this remotely, at the time it was really unnerving. If this is additional security. we would have liked to know up front. No fault of the host, the location is really noisy and feels unsafe at night. The apartment itself is a great open space with high ceilings (the industrial vent heater is also noisy.) Dig the hammock! FYI the red splats on the floor are paint, we hope.

The place was clean, and check-in was smooth but unfortunately we felt an unpleasant smell in the hallways and the bedroom. We weren't sure where it came from but it's definitely not of food. The host was kind enough to respond to our midnight request and pointed to a room freshener that was available. If not for that, we wouldn't have been able to fall asleep. Also the vehicles on the street were very loud which hindered a peaceful sleep. Street parking could be an issue if you are checking in late in the night.

She's truly such a sweetheart, a wonderful woman who seems to care a lot about the people who stay with her. She offered me dinner and coffee at different points during my stay, and while I was too exhausted from the flight in to accept the former, it was so great getting to chat with her over coffee. She even buzzed me in at 1 AM on a night I had a little too much fun at an event and couldn't remember how to get into the apt complex, but still she was super sweet and reassuring about it.  The neighborhood is lively and you can hear music floating up to the room from time to time - for me, that was a feature and not a bug. Never felt unsafe. Older building - again, this was a feature to me, and something I liked! - but the room was cute and clean with plenty of space. I slept so well here at the end of each day in the city. I looked at several listings before choosing Ana's, and I'm so glad I did - I can't imagine having stayed anywhere else during this trip! Really did feel like home.

I’m writing this because I wish someone had written an honest review to warn me. First the big thing is that the block is infested with huge rats! I’m not joking. I was scared to walk down the block late at night because there were so many of them. The second big thing is that Brooklyn literally did not respond to any of my questions. This is so unprofessional and just plain rude. The apartment is okay. It’s clean, but there is no WiFi and the shower only had 1 sliding door so water splashed on the floor as I showered. Also no rugs on the floor in the bathroom to step out on, only a small dirty towel. There was also no bedding provided, only sheets and 2 small throws that weren’t warm and it was 30 degrees when I visited! It was freezing and the heater barely lets out heat. I had to use the small space heater. Just stay in a hotel. This place was overpriced and almost ruined my trip.

Really really impressed with Richard's loft. Comfy, chic, cool. The bed was so relaxing and despite being in a busier section of brooklyn with lots of night life, I did not feel at all unsafe or anything. Definitely will look to book again on return trips to Brooklyn

the place was good overall. it was v clean n nice aesthetics. the pillows were v v flat which wasnt very comfortable sleeping wise and the neighborhood was kinda scary to walk around in. the place nicely opposed it tho and the mattress itself was comfy.

This place was great for our big family! We traveled with three adults, two teenagers, a ten year old and a seven month old. Four private bedrooms, and a living room. Designated dining area, full kitchen, and a washer and dryer! This place was perfect! It’s on a quiet street, in a quiet building. It’s super close to the 110th/Cathedral subway entrance which will put you on the 1 Train up and downtown. Also, not far from Central Park. Easy to walk to the drug store, market, coffee shops, and restaurants. This place had it all!  Only thing I wish it had was a few more bath towels and wash cloths…not a huge issue with the washer/dryer,  just would have been nice to have the extras.

I would like to start off by saying that the place itself was pretty good. Now, on to the host, who is trying to charge me a extra guest fee for the whole 14 day stay instead of the 2 days my guest stayed over.  I asked him to be fair and considerate of the charges he was requesting but he doubled down on this issue. My guest never used any of the resources in his apartment besides the using the bathroom. Heck, never even took a shower or used the kitchen in 2 days of stay. We were quiet and minded our own. It wasn't really hard to comprehend, all I ask is to charge me for the 2 days my guest stayed over instead of 14 days. I had to leave 3 days earlier before my reservation ended just because this situation has caused me a great deal of stress. Airbnb was siding with the host despite no communication of the guest fee in the listing and in the house rules, all of which was clearly edited after this incident.

You will not find a better more affordable place to stay. Super close to the subway and LGA airport. the place is super nice, super private. Well equipped kitchen. We were out late at night and returned from the subway with no problem or a scare. Neighborhood is quiet. He was also flexible in allowing us to leave our bags and come back for them later in the evening.

Thanks so much to the host, Michelle! I truly enjoyed my time at this Airbnb.  I had a quick last minute trip back to NYC for business, and luckily was able to make last minute accommodations at this Airbnb! It was super convenient for me to get to and from JFK with an easy walk to the train/subway. Michelle was very responsive and clear both prior to and post booking. The place looked just like the photos and everything was as listed. In a time when you can't trust a lot of the Airbnb's out there, this space put me at such ease and brought calm to a stressful business trip. The backyard was definitely a favorite space of mine. The whole place was such a gem!  Overall a great stay and will definitely be back again! (Hopefully it won't be booked up when I plan to come again next time, but wouldn't be surprised if it was!!) Thank you again Michelle!
I loved my stay. It was stress free and the hosts were swift in answering any questions I had. I wasn’t super fond of the location. Just a bit far from transit but over all it was a good time
It's expensive for what you get. And a lot of stress to find because the address is not good

Would recommend this place to anyone looking for a convenient and affordable (rare!) spot to stay in Brooklyn. Located in between two convenient train lines and next to a solid bodega. The space itself is great and comfortable, and our hosts were always quick to respond and accommodate. Definitely a steal at this price.

Great Property; Few Wrinkles along the way but still a beautiful home.   Recommended but use cautious against the unlisted rules and Parking  Responsive host. Beautiful home.   Located in a neighborhood with very little to no parking. Parking was literally 1-2 hr drive around sometimes as far as 15 blocks away.   The block is very quiet but the surrounding area is a little tough. Not that it appears dangerous but if your not use to inner city life travel in groups.   NY is a newly recreational marijuana state. Please be careful smoking outdoors and coming inside as the host will try to charge you for smoking. Housekeeping will go through the trash and accuse you of smoking IN HOME if u leave TRASH (cigar guts, empty baggies, or jars) in the trash can. The owner has cameras on the balcony and kitchen, HOWEVER they will not review the footage before attempting to charge you a cleaning fee.   Since the state is new i believe the host should update the rules to provide clarity to guest.

I do admit I was a bit unsure about this listing when I first found it. A listing with an en-suite private bathroom for such a reasonable price in NYC. It just seemed a bit too good to be true. Because it was a new room there wasn’t any reviews. But then I find out that Siri is a Super Host and the room is under Airbnb’s AirCover. So if anyone else is unsure about this room then rest assured. This listing is legit and is a hell of a price.  I’d say the room is perfect for a solo traveler, but can easily fit in a second person as the bed is way too big for a single sleeper. But the room itself would be a bit of a squeeze for a second person, which shouldn’t be an issue if you only plan to sleep in and nothing else. You get a desk and a chair if you need to do any laptop work. There is a huge TV on a wall mount where you can watch all your favourite shows and videos on YouTube and Netflix which I definitely took advantage of. There is a wardrobe to hang your clothes (hangers included) when unpacking. The en-suite bathroom is very clean and yes you are the only one that has access to that bathroom.  I love the little touches that Siri and her team provided. When I checked into my room I was provided with a small pack of cookies and a small Fuji Water. Face cleanser, shampoo, shower gel, hand soap, toothpaste and a toothbrush was included. Toilet roll and kitchen roll is provided within your room. I don’t remember it being included on the listing, but a hairdryer is also included within the room.  The flat itself consists of 3 rooms including this one. There is a communal kitchen area where you have access to the stove, sink, fridge and a freezer. There is a recycle bin and your own designated bin for your rubbish. Siri’s team consists of Charlotte and Nina. Who make sure the communal area is always clean and the rubbish being removed. Because the flat once in a while has different guests the team will come into the flat and do cleaning. But they will never enter your room or disturb you.  There is also a washing machine and dryer in the next building in the cellar available to use. They cost $2 (8x 25c) per use and both take 45 minutes from start to finish. Laundry Detergent and Anti Wrinkle sheets are provided by the team.  In terms of travel. It is literally a 2 minute walk from Jackson Hts - Roosevelt Av subway station. You could take a direct E train from Jamaica to get here, which is super convenient. The E train will also take you to Time Square in around 20 minutes. The beauty of this subway station is that there are many subways you could take. You could also take the 7 train into Manhattan or into Flushing. You could even take the 7 train to Court Square Station only transfer onto the G train and make your way into Brooklyn.  Your building is located in a very busy area and is very safe. I never once felt unsafe in the area. There are plenty of food options around the area, including plenty of fast food joints. There is also a target for daily items a 4 minute walk from the building.  Overall a great experience for me. I couldn’t recommend this listing more. Thank you to Siri, Charlotte and Nina!
The location was in a really bad and sketchy neighborhood but inside of the place was decent.

A great place to stay. Javier made our entire experience easy and created a cozy atmosphere. Kinda felt like we were robbing him with how great the place was for the price. Can’t recommend enough. 10/10

Sara was so sweet she let us have a late checkout since she was still tidying up the place when we got there which was literally no big deal to us but she made us feel really welcome 😊 our dog has really bad separation anxiety and we were scared that her barking was gonna be a issue but Sara was really reassuring and understanding the place was super clean and not too far from where we needed to go overall 10/10

Price is matches what you will get, neighborhood was very shady, no parking, smoke alarms disabled, unwashed bed sheets and comforter, poor air conditions. Was supposed to spend the weekend but my girl friend had an asthma attack from all of the dust lingering in the area. We ended up cutting our trip short by 2 days. Host responded on time but has very little understanding of English so makes it extremely hard to communicate.
Fulfills what was promised. We didn't have any problems, great host, however the area seems a little dangerous at night

Great spot overall. The whole questioning of our ETA multiple times was a bit much for a “self check-in” unit. Please revise this practice in the future for your guest. I too am an Airbnb Host in Los Angeles and I’ve never taken that route. If you are sketchy of the booking, contact Airbnb or just cancel it. Other than that, everything else was amazing. Thank you for accommodating us :)

Do not stay here. The people watch you on the cameras and listen to what you say and they were messaging us things that we were saying in the air bnb. Super weird and they continued to call my phone all morning every morning to complain about us leaving the front door cracked for air flow since their ac did not work. They would call at 7 am 100 times and at 2 am 100 times complaining. The house is in bad area there’s no open delis or train stations anywhere near by. Bad stay all together including them turning off the hot water the night before check out, please stay away from this place” total scam

Our group enjoyed our time in NYC! It was very clean and was stocked with plenty of amenities! There were ample linens and toiletries and we ran into no issues during our stay. Sonia and Jhon were very welcoming and responsive during our stay. Check-in and check out were easy and stress-free. Parking was easy to find around the house. The location was very convenient for getting into the city, where we were able to and support our friend in a local play. I would highly recommend staying here to anyone looking for a home base for a NYC vacation! Thanks Sonia & Jhon!!!

Please people do not rent from this lady. She tried to scam us for $300 and then she apologized and at the end she did the same. First of all the place is ridiculously horrible And filthy you have no idea we were traumatized

Do not even entertain this property if you have kids with you, upon arrival we were greeted by a junkie looking for money, he then proceeded to talk to the 5/6 guys smoking joints outside the drug den situated underneath the property, when we eventually got the door open and got inside to find the Wi-Fi wasn’t working, the second bedroom was so small you could barely walk down the side of the bed, the toilet was in a closet (touché to the photograph for making the place look so big) we decided not a hope was this for us, I contacted the host, aired my grievances with her only to be basically told tuff luck, we left after 1.5 hours to find a hotel and now the host and Airbnb are refusing a refund, if I could give less than a 1 star I would, avoid at all costs

Great location if you are ok with the ferry. It is located 1 min from the free train to the ferry which is also free. 25 minutes from Manhattan.  If you buy Metro Card, it is said that it’s free for children under 44 inches, but there is not really check ups so if your children are a bit taller but still young, don’t waste your money on a Metro card for them.  It was clean, beds are really comfy. Enough dishes, cool fridge with ice and cold water, tv and wifi worked well. Kind host who answers fast.  The neighbourhood is a little bit creepy, but we walked at night and it was ok.

It’s very clean, they had some coffee there and a couple toiletries. The pillows are rough, the beds are rough, the TV system is rough. It’s hot at night and cold in the morning with no options to control the heat. They communicated seamlessly and were a pleasure to deal with.  It’s not far from things to do, the surrounding area looks sketchy but it’s not.

Ms. Marisa gives all the info quickly and politely; we did not meet her in person. The apartment is really big and cozy. The kitchen is well equipped, AC in every room can be regulated perfectly. The grocery stores and the small restaurants are close enough to walk there. The first impression of the neighborhood seems a bit creepy to Europeans, but it was all fine.

Me and my friends stayed here and it was so great! It’s in a really cool area and there’s a lot more space than we expected. The bunk beds looked small in the picture but they are full sized and very comfortable. The queen bed was able to fit 2 people and the mattress was nice.  The shower, bathroom, and kitchen were very clean and easy to use. The subway station is less than 5 minutes away which was very convenient. We found great restaurants nearby. The host had very good communication and made the stay very easy. We were  girls and never felt unsafe. The self check in was easily accessible and the check out time was very flexible. Thanks for a great stay!

If you want a clean, stylish, and affordable place to stay on the island, this is it! Elena gave wonderful suggestions for food and drinks around the Airbnb and was always making sure we were doing good.  I would rate staying here a 4.9/5. The only thing I'd say is the commute was a bit lengthy on the train, which made coming home on it at night a bit sketchy. Just keep that in mind.  However, for the fair price, we did not mind at all!

We truly experienced a 5star stay at Ellen’s house! The house is extremely spacious  for Manhattan standards, well appointed and super clean! It felt so nice coming back “home” after a long day of exploring NY! The house feels like a real home, since it has everything that you might need, it’s SO well equipped. It doesn’t feel at all like a standardized Airbnb place. The kitchen is perfect for cooking, and there is a whole foods market very close by where we went for groceries. A HUGE plus is the washing machine and dryer, which were very useful to us, since we were traveling for a long time. The king size beds are very comfortable, and the heating worked perfectly. Tribeca is very nice and convenient and is one of the safest neighborhoods in NY. Ellen was an amazing host. Her emails were very thorough and explanatory, and the self check in was easy, stress free  and efficient. Thank you Ellen for everything! We LOVED our stay, and can’t wait to come back! Don’t hesitate to book this place!!!
DIRTY, UNSAFE, ABUSES

Had a great stay.  Great location in the heart of New York! The apartment is on the 4th floor without an elevator. A little uncomfortable when arriving and departing with a suitcase, otherwise not a problem.

Darko’s a nice fella, really hospitable and welcoming. The surrounding area didn’t always feel super great considering its distance from Manhattan and also just the general vibe. It’s a sketchy part of town, honestly, but your mileage may vary. For what it’s worth, however, the Airbnb itself was quite comfortable, clean and accommodating. If that’s what matters most to you, you can’t go wrong here. Darko even offers to make you coffee in the morning! Not shabby at all.

Dan is an excellent host. He greeted me with smiles, and we had an interesting convo mins after I had arrived. He made sure I had everything that I needed, and made me feel welcomed. The apartment is extremely clean and organized, which is refreshing! The location was perfect and only a short walk to the JMZ / G lines. The Neighborhood is very safe and relaxed, I had never felt unsafe, even at night. I highly recommend this listing and would happily stay again in the future :)
Dan’s place was clean, accurate, neat and comfortable!  I really appreciated how close it was to the subway station.  The neighborhood was quiet and I never felt unsafe.

Had a lovely stay, and the location was in a really nice, diverse area that carried different kinds of food and culture. While it is a long way down to the Metro train to take you to Manhattan, there was a direct bus to take you there and it’s less than 7 minutes. If you are staying for more than 4-5 days, I suggest getting the unlimited 7 day pass as that gives you both the bus and subway rides, which is perfect for this and you’ll get your money’s worth.  After a long day, it was just so nice to turn on the AC (which worked very nicely, it’s so hot in NY) and there was a nice big TV and there were many free channels to choose from.   David and John were very helpful, whenever I had a question David always answered instantly. Super friendly and accommodating! No issues checking in and everything went smoothly.  My only issue was that there was nowhere to hang my towels in the second floor toilet, I think it would be nice if there was a rail. Another is that WIFI was weak in the room we stayed at (#2), but it worked fine from the toilet or kitchen. Other than that it was all a comfortable stay.   All in all, very satisfied with my stay! Definitely recommend for a cheap place, nice area, never felt unsafe or dodgy. Will rebook again!

I had a really nice stay!  Pros: - The room is very well done and feels homey. There's even a view of a tree through the window and a surprising amount of light. - Dan was super responsive and friendly. - Dan, who lives in the apartment was very quiet. I stayed for a week and never saw him outside of check-in, so you really feel like you have the place to yourself sometimes. - Super easy walk to the subway (like 4 min) and a really easy walk to a lot of the activity in Williamsburg.  Cons: - the Airbnb is on the edge of a Hasidic Jewish (IIUC) neighborhood. The women dress conservatively. Walking around the neighborhood and even just out of the Airbnb in leggings and a crop top, I felt disrespectful and hence a little uncomfortable wearing clothes that I wanted to try on. - This might just be me being a solo naive girl traveling to NYC for the first time, but I didn't love the walk back from the nightlife in Williamsburg to the Airbnb. One route went through the hasidic Jewish (IIUC) neighborhood, which felt disrespectful walking through, and the other route took me to a small strip with some somewhat uncomfortable things (angry screaming homeless man, someone with a full face mask on but not in a costume way), but there were always people around when I went through that area, which helped, and the crime rates for the nieghborhood are actually quite low, so probs just me. - I saw what I think were two very small cockroaches, but I mean, it is NYC soooooo

Stayed here for 10 days and would definitely recommend! Apartment is close to the train station. Area around the train station does feel a bit sketchy.  The apartment itself is super clean and just the right size when you're travelling by yourself.  Also communication was easy and fast.

Dan was very friendly and helpful when I first arrived. While I didn't see Dan much during my stay in NYC, as I was out most of the time, he still went out of his way to send me clear instructions on how to get in the building and what not. The room was small, but for the price, its a steal. I'd recommend anyone to check out Dan's place if they ever want to visit NYC. It is a 5 minute walk from a subway line and is in a safe area.  My only suggestion is that if you are a taller person, then this might not be the place for you. I'm only 5'7 and my feet were almost hanging off the bed and touching the wall, so if you are 6ft+ it might be an issue trying to sleep in the bed. Other than that everything went well and I couldn't ask for more for such an affordable price!

Great stay overall!! One thing I will say though is it is located in a high crime area which I will say did spook me after doing research but everything was fine and everyone is friendly and very helpful. Beautiful decor and nice comfy queen sized bed, honestly can sleep 5-6. Host was very attentive and always responded in a timely manner. Would definitely return!!

Eduardo's unit is extremely quiet - I saw that fact mentioned in another review and thought maybe it was a fluke, but it was dean on. Staying in the unit felt more like we were sleeping in the suburbs and not the city!  We were very pleased!  The neighborhood is transitioning but felt completely safe and family friendly.  All three of the beds were comfy, the shower had nice pressure and the place was very clean.  There were enough towels for the three of us and plenty of dishes to eat takeaway.  We didn't cook so I can't speak to that.  Do note that he does not supply things like shampoo, conditioner and soap in the shower so you will have to pack from home (or drop by a drug store nearby).  It wasn't a hassle, as there were options nearby to acquire.  Just be sure to budget space in your luggage or time to go get what you need when you arrive.  Check in was simple - he met us at the unit and explained what we needed to know about the heating and such and gave us simple check out instructions.  He has a very friendly and disarming personality.    The only quirk to be aware of was that the air conditioner was still in place and was improperly installed causing an inch wide gap directly to the outside.  We had to stuff with a bag and a pillow so my daughter wasn't subjected to the cold air outside (the room was quite cold without our low tech fix.  He said he would fix after we checked out, but I would suggest that you ask him if has been addressed prior to your stay.  Overall very nice unit - perfect for a couple with two kids.  Everyone gets their own bed and a great night of sleep.  I would definitely recommend to others and would stay there again!

Just a few things I think you should consider.  Dressers in the bedrooms as the rooms are so small we could not access the closets so lived out of our suitcases which was not ideal.  The Blue bedroom has a broken leg on the base so the bed was lopsided.  Same bedroom the lamp shade has holes in it and I think for $4000 a week you could provide a decent trash can in the kitchen and the bath room.  I think an accurate exterior photo of the building would be useful as we were quiet surprised when we arrived.  The photo that you have in the listings is what we were expecting.  Otherwise we had a good visit to New York.

This is in Far Rockaway, which is relatively close to JFK, and at the very end of the A train line. Gary was communicative throughout the reservation process, which I appreciates. The room I stayed in was tidy and secure. The bathroom had clearly not been cleaned in a while, so that was unpleasant. I just needed a place to shower and crash before catching a very early flight, and this served that purpose.
Gilmar is a lovely and communicative host, and the place is just a nice! Conveniently close to several subway lines, good markets, and good restaurants. A very comfortable and stress-free stay.

Beautiful, comfortable and clean apartment!  The apartment is exactly as it looks in the pictures, and even more spacious. It’s stocked with everything you need for a short or a long stay (in my case a month and a half)! Also I can’t stress this enough how CLEAN it is, and this is coming from a clean freak.  Gilmar is also the best host ~ always responded within minutes and is just the sweetest.  10/10 would recommend and stay again.

This stay is in a very convenient location, near several subway stops. The neighborhood felt safe, and there were great restaurants and bars within walking distance. The hosts were very nice and communicative. The place is a steal for how much they charge.   However, the place could use some sprucing up/cleaning. The sheets/towels were clean, so that was great. But both the ceiling fan and the bathroom fan had an insane layer of dust built up. There are holes in almost every wall, the ceiling, and behind the toilet. You can also hear almost everything going on upstairs - foot steps, music, even TV shows and conversations sometimes. However, once we asked the hosts to turn down the music, they did so immediately - like I said, they’re super nice and responsive.

Great neighborhood with wonderful food options and a playground nearby for kiddos. The unit is spacious and clean with a shady back patio, and check in is straightforward. Street parking wasn't plentiful but was not as difficult as I thought it might be.

Joe's Airbnb is a hidden gem, tucked away in Queens village. From check in to check out, the entire stay was very pleasant. There is parking on the premises as stated, getting in and out with own dedicated entrance was very easy as well. Joe provided instructions before check in to help us get acclimated to the stay. Would definitely book here again. Book here if you want a stress free and enjoyable stay!

Do not let people scare you about Brooklyn and this area. We felt very safe, The host is very helpful and will help you in all ways to find entertainment and any other need you have. We had all privacy, comfort one may need to enjoy the stay. Location is good with all you may need in easy reach. We recommend to any one in a budget to visit NY. It is earmarked to stay again if we go to similar visit in N York.

Petra is amazing and does a good job with communication. The apartment itself is everything that the listing promised.  The area where this apartment is located is unsafe. During the 5 minute walk from the subway station to the apartment we encountered big groups of creepy men that were staring at us, doing drugs, and some were even passed out in the streets. Our local family friend dropped us off one night, and was worried about our safety. Friday night we couldn't sleep because there was a lady singing in the street for over 3 hours. We decided to start coming back to the apartment before sunset because we didn't want to get robbed in the dark. I would not choose this location again, and especially can't recommend it to any single female travelers. I had two grown men with me, and it was still terrifying for us.
Petra's house is super nice and clean, it is comfortable. The only thing that the place does have is a lot of beggars and what I recommend is to arrive before it gets dark and walk a little quickly.

As a foreign, I found this trip unpleasant. I asked my native friends to check the description. None of them could tell me that I need to live with another person. And the host didn’t give me enough information for what I should and shouldn’t do in her room. For example, when I removed the chair and already left the room for over 24 hours (I booked two nights and only stayed there for one night), she told me I scratched her floors. All of these things maybe caused by miscommunication, so if you are a foreign, don’t live there.

We loved the rooms and accommodations. We were very uncomfortable with the neighborhood. We witnessed a drug deal one morning walking out the front door. And the distance from Manhattan was a bit far. I should have done my homework better.

We had a great experience in Yvonne's apartment. It was about 5-10 min from the subway, and it took us 15-20 min to get to the main attractions in NYC. It was very clean, warm and comfortable. The bedroom and bathroom are located in Yvonne's house, in the upper level, which has separate door from hers. We never used the kitchen, which is in the lower level, but Yvonne said we could freely use it! It is located in a quiet street, and we never felt unsafe, despite being two girls walking in the street at night. I would recommend it.

Perfect stay, María answers instantly, the apartment is completely clean, the kitchen and bathroom are equipped, even though it is cold outside, the temperature is perfect inside, upon arrival there was plenty of water, coffee and chocolate for the days of stay, great detail, it was my first time in NY and I did not have a single complication to go to Manhattan, you only walk 15 minutes to the subway and you only need to take a subway to Times Square, the area is very busy, nothing dangerous, there are shops and places to eat in the surroundings and as a plus there is a dive bar on the way back from the house in case you wanted to party. 100% recommended.

It was such a beautiful space! I was hesitant about renting a room but it was almost like I had my own space. They both were so considerate with decorations, cleanliness, and noise. I hardly knew you they were home most of the time. It’s in a great location in Brooklyn and I can’t stress enough how sparkling clean it is!

Every thing happens for a reason and believe I was meant to stay here to discover an awesome restaurant - Pita Point - seemed to be the only restaurant in walking distance that accepted credit card. Neighborhood could be sketchy, get your food and go ‘home’ early!

Yanina’s place is okay. Easy access to the train station, area does seems a little bit sketchy. Room does not have any sunlight therefore if you like sun lit rooms you might not like this. Door lock is tricky; You can only lock the door when you are in the room but not when you leave. The check-in process was a little bit confusing, because the instructions were not clear however I called Yana and she was able to check me in. She can work on being a little bit nicer but she is okay in general.

Great place to stay, a quick 15 minute walk to the subway and plenty of places nearby for food or whatever else you need (markets, laundry, drug stores, etc.). Communication was fast and easy and the apartment is cute and comfy. I’d definitely recommend it!

The apartment is large and in a great neighborhood.   The LR sofa was huge and comfy. The bathroom was updated and had a shelving for me to put toiletries and my hair dryer. I was comfortable in the master BR.  I wish the closest subway wasn’t the G since it requires transferring or an Uber home from the station a little further not on the G, but I’m adaptable. This is NYC so that’s life. (I used to live in Manhattan 20 years ago). It barely took any time for the Uber from DeKalb metro station and much cheaper than an Uber from Manhattan. (These comments are just if in a perfect world…)   My kids fought over the front BR with the twin and damaged the door.  Of course I expected to reimburse and did. But if you have difficult children, be forewarned the doors are hollow and not like that of a hotel. They were pushing on either side of the door and my son’s knee made the damage. It’s not like it would happen if people are acting like civil human beings. It took force. The kicker is neither one slept in the room for a full night. My son didn’t like the mattress and my daughter was fine with the mattress but felt scared in the room. There’s nothing scary it’s just her being age 10.  If Emma would have me, I’d definitely stay again but hopefully without my kids — who I love dearly — so that I could really  enjoy my “vacation.”  Make sure you take a 20-30 min walk or Uber to Water st and Washington St to DUMBO for one of the best views of Manhattan and the Brooklyn Bridge.

The neighborhood where this place is located is quiet and is a few steps away from N train station, there’s a grocery store, a 24-hour pharmacy nearby, an IHOP and a few shops and restaurants  The place is a basement so expect some noice from footsteps people above early morning that might wake you up.  We have a few issues regarding the cleaning of the bathroom because of a bad smell upon our arrival, that were soon addressed by Rupan’s mother once notified.  Found a small cockroach in the bathroom the second day of our stay, but after that unpleasant encounter and after killing it we had no trouble with those bugs anymore  If you pretend to cook food be aware that the kitchen takes way too long to cook something. We tried boiling water for 30 minutes and it never boiled.  It lacks of cooking ware, there were a frying pan and a cooking pot, no lids. So in order to boil water a bit faster we had to improvise using the frying pan as the lid of the cooking pot.  So preferably eat out, order food or just cook food not that elaborated.

I  would not have had anything wrong to say but there was a huge urine stain on the mattress pad and it was disgusting so when I reached out to the owner he flat out called me a liar and asked to come see it. We took pictures that are time stamped to our arrival. We did not request money back and worked around it but if you tell this guy something is not good he CANNOT hear it. We did not allow him up because we chose to only be there due to COVID safety precautions and privacy (hence why we went with an Airbnb and not a hotel). There is also a LARGE amount of water damage all over the apartment and if you step on the deck it’ll scare the pants off you because there’s air space between the concrete and whatever is stickered to it and it feels like your going to cave through.

The apartment was nice and spacious, but lacked in kitchen equipment and the gym was really noisy throughout the majority of the day. There was no lamp shade for the lamp which was the main source of light for the living room which made it blinding during calls or just for ourselves.

This is a small room in a great location with a great host and great value. It’s near wonderful restaurants and Westside Market (lots of fresh produce), as well as pharmacy and drug stores, and the metro. Columbia University is a short walk away as well. For this price it meets basic needs.

Carla is just such a wonderful bubbly host. Airbnb is as described and she responses promptly which I appreciated. Her home is very nicely decorated. Room is upstairs with your own bathroom to use. Check in and out was easy breezy.  Location is 6-8 mins walk to the nearest station and 3 mins to the nearest bus stop that gets you into the touristy Manhattan area like Midtown.  I did not feel unsafe walking around the area, even at night with a girlfriend (though it’s always good to be aware of your surroundings when travelling!). Thanks for hosting Carla!

Jenifer responds as quick as possible to her messages and was very accommodating. My friend and I caught a red eye and landed in New York early in the morning before check-in and Jenifer allowed us to drop off our luggage and freshen up for the day before our room was ready and the same when we were leaving. Our room, including the dining area and bathroom were both very clean and tidy. The neighborhood felt very safe, and I did not feel like I was in any danger while staying there. If you are looking into staying in Brooklyn, do not hesitate to book your stay with her.

This spot is a steal. Do yourself a favor and treat yourself to the relaxing vibe, with thoughtful touches like luxe bath products, a tub, candles, and easy walking distance to the subway and hip Bushwick spots.
Ishmam's place was a steal for the price. Great hospitality and very good with responses about things to do in the city.

First thing to say is that Noe’s place is a good value for the price we paid. It comfortably houses three couples in their own bedrooms, and there was plenty of hot water so sharing the bathroom wasn’t a big deal. The neighborhood is just as described, vibrant, colorful, and with lots of restaurants and bodegas. We also liked the location which was surprisingly quiet and peaceful, and not far from the north end of Central Park.  The beds were comfortable and we slept well every night, even though we were there on a weekend.  A bit more attention to detail and Noe’s place would be a real steal.

We don’t recommend this place for families that include small children. AND for people that have their own rental car because of the fact that parking in New York is very difficult. It was our first time there and of course we had no idea. Noe did tell us that there was street parking and a parking garage two blocks down but the “garage” wasn’t accessible to the public which forced us to hunt down a parking spot every single night we were there (not easy when it was pouring rain with kiddos) The bedroom sheets had an unpleasant odor and the kitchen wasn’t clean. We aren’t a picky family and will basically make anything work, but this was by far our worst experience. A hotel will definitely be considered next time we are in the city.

The apartment was clean but the beds was not in good condition was afraid will break at some point. They asked me if I want to extend for one more day i said i wish but my flight was on time but our flight was delayed due to airlines reasons. And I asked to check out at 3 pm they refused I even offered to pay the entire day the even refused and we had a baby with us was a bit difficult to leave the house early they gave us one our to leave the place but thank god I rented a big car we stayed in the car till evening till the time for the flight :(

We are a family of six, we stayed for 5 nights over New Years 2020. The apartment is super clean, warm, in a great location and there is plenty of space for a family. The location is excellent, there is a subway station a few minutes walk away and a grocery store/deli on both corners close by. The neighbourhood is friendly and we never felt unsafe. We would definitely choose to stay again.

Apartment very well located in a quiet neighborhood in Brooklyn.  The metro is just a few steps away, ideal for commuting.  Javier is very available and responsive when I sent him messages for information.  I highly recommend her Airbnb. Very clean apartment with typical American decoration.  Having a late return flight, I left my belongings in the hall which is secure after my check-out. I came back a few hours later to collect them as Javier had told me.  The comments I read before booking validate my total confidence in Javier.  THANKS.

What a great Airbnb! My group of 6 never felt unsafe in this neighborhood. The space also was just as advertised and felt spacious. The short 3 minute walk to L train was also a huge perk. Only minor issue was my group was working from home and the wifi couldn’t handle all the traffic from our meetings, which is understandable. Other than that, everything was amazing.   Javiar and Haidy were communicative and helpful with any questions I had. We would stay here again!

Inna is a great host, very available and always there for any issue or trouble. I had the pleasure to stay in Inna's apartment for 4 months and the experience overall was good. As a Columbia student, the position is just perfect (10-15 mis walking distance from campus), however the neighborhood can be a little sketchy. The apartment in the pictures looks bigger than it is in reality and it is overpriced  for what it is. Enjoy your stay at Inna's!

Excellent place, well located, super clean, well furnished. Stayed for a month and it was extremely convenient. Close to 3 subway lines,  markets, drug stores, clothes stores and less than a minute to central park entrance. The two bedrooms with office chairs and desks were excellent for working remotely as me and my wife were able to use each one as an "office" and be on meetings simultaneously. Having a washer/drier on the apartment was extremely helpful. The contactless check-in/out also is a relief during social distance times.

We had a great visit! Location was perfect for us and the apartment was quite nice. Maybe it should have been obvious to me from the description but there is no sink in the kitchenette so mentioning that in case others miss that from the listing. It was fine though, they kindly washed any dishes we used for us. The garden was shady and pleasant, the use of the washer/dryer was great, and it was a lovely stay overall.

TERRIBLE! Even though (in theory) the apartment is similar to the description, Marlo failed to mention that  upon entering the building you must walk down a set of stairs and into the back corner of a courtyard to get to the front entrance. Once there you are in a vestibule and then you must put in a code to make it into the building. I felt very unsafe there because while you are in the vestibule any body can follow you  and then you would be stuck out of eye or ear sight of anyone who could hear or see you. There are a lot of homeless people that hang out in a closed restaurant near the courtyard and any one of them or someone else could follow you to back to this area. The hallway of the apartment was filthy and smelled like weed. Once inside, Marlo has left a lot of her personal belongings in the apartment (including dog food in the kitchen drawer which smelled) The next morning when we tried to take a shower there was NO hot water. My husband and I ran both the bath and faucets for 1/2 an hour and it never even got warm. After my husband left without being able to take a shower...I found a roach in the apartment! Then I was DONE! I told Marlo that I was checking out after 1 day (I had booked 4). The apartment was dirty, without hot water and  unsafe, this was not someplace I wanted to stay any longer. Fortunately, I was able to find a hotel and moved out. I told Marlo why I was moving and asked for a refund for the remaining days that I had booked. Marlo flat out REFUSED and said "this isn't a 5 star hotel" I couldn't agree more! this was no where near a 5 star hotel, but any hotel that I have stayed in at least had hot water and no bugs! I am now in the process of working with airbnb to get some reimbursement. I would strongly advise against this unit!

I usually don't write bad reviews but this place was not great at all. I though it was going to be good because of the reviews I read before but it was not. The host is nice but the kitchen most of the times had unclean dish on the sink. Also there was a lot of garbage and in the common areas such as the passageway from the room to the kitchen there was bads of laundry. the location is not great neither. I booked this place for my mother but I felt unsafe. There was a shooting in front of the building which the front building door had several bullet holes. I understand that this is not something the host can control but the uncleanness of the place on common areas was very annoying at times where my mother try to fill the filter of water and she couldn't because the sink was full of dirty dishes. Also there were mices when we got there which is very disgusting maybe due to the unclean dishes from the sink. My mother stood in this place for a month but it was really a bad experience. I had book other airbnb in the past and I have not experience all this type of issues before.

The most scary experience in my life… place is located at one of the most dangerous area where lots of gun violence happening - didn’t realize until last min. I couldn’t cancel it. I was sent to 8 people room, where I paid for 4 people room… and this I co-Ed, meaning male and female sleeping together.

I’m not usually scared to stay in Airbnb but my first night there I was definitely scared. The location was in area with little light and at times is scary to walk by yourself at. Other then that it was a nice place over all. Unfortunately I won’t stay again not to do with anything the owner did but more for personal reasons then anything. Also the pictures need to be updated they are not very accurate.

Great hostel-style place, I enjoyed my stay. The host was friendly and communicated well, the space was clean has everything I needed. The location was good too- looks a bit sketchy but its safe and close to everything. Would recommend and stay again.

Its a very beautiful room, and a beautiful place to rent. But if you want to have guest over I WOULD NOT recommend this BNB. They will kick you out and make you find another BNB. Luckily I had enough money for a hotel room but If I hadn’t I would’ve been stranded in NYC. Not being from the area, that’s scary. I definitely did feel at risk and unsafe for my life after the situation this BNB host put me through. I will probably NEVER rent from this host again.

I LOVE this little studio! It's tiny and adorable. I stayed for seven weeks on a travel nursing assignment and it had just what I needed for my stay: Keurig, microwave, full size fridge, hot plate, comfy bed, heat/AC, and most importantly, a smart TV for my Netflix binges during the quarantine! :) It was my first time in New York, so I appreciated all the safety features: private entrance, motion lighting, many locks on the door, and the fire extinguisher. And I can't say enough good things about Adrian; he truly wants you to have an excellent stay. He doesn't hover, but he was ALWAYS available if I needed anything. He is very intuitive about what his guests might need, and checked in with me appropriately. I never actually met him, but I appreciated the privacy during my stressful stay as a nurse in New York. Best host I have ever had. HIGHLY RECOMMEND! Thank you, Adrian!
Definitely a place I would stay again. Super nice, clean, suspicious, good area, and great host.
The place was super clean. They were always available to help me with questions that I had about the city etc. Everything was great other than the location, it can be a little sketchy at night.

Our group of 5 fit very comfortably at Olivia’s place. Samira was the one who met us and allowed an earlier check-in even though she was still prepping the place. After our drop off of luggage, we came back to see she covered one of our travel mattresses with fresh sheets and a pillow. The heater unit worked great as it was pretty chilly when we came by. The location is amazing in the middle of so many shops, restaurants and cafes. Would def recommend if you want a stress-free stay in Brooklyn.

It's a small apartment, overall clean, tidy and simple; I think good value. It has all that it say it has. I also want to add that even though they don't show it in the pictures they have a small closet.  The check- in was super easy, they just left an envelope with my name on the front desk. On check-out I gave the key back to the front desk.  It's in a great location: walking I could get to Penn Station,  Times Square, the NY library, empire state, Rockefeller, to name some attractions. Also there's a subway station nearby, and a few rental bikes racks. You also don't have to walk too far to find food or drinks.   The only reasons I don't rate it 4 stars:  one could be fixed but the other may not be fixable but you should know in order to see if you accommodate to it: I think the mattress and pillows need to be changed. The mattress is sagging on one side and the pillows are just not comfortable. I wouldn't say I loved the sleep I got.  The other issue is that even though I was surprised to not hear the traffic (it's on the 7th floor), on the 4 nights I was there, there were always people yelling (also not helping with my sleep). It seemed it came from others inside the building. Lastly, a guy offered drugs right outside the building door. I saw this dude twice.  Overall,  it's good value and greatly located.

good location and pretty clean, beds were comfy and everything was working fine, definitely be careful if u plan on staying alone just because it can get a little dangerous and incidents have happened

Great location - two blocks from the Empire State Building. About three blocks from Herald Square and the 34th St Macy's. Three blocks from Penn Station and MSG. The apartment is perfectly fine and it certainly beat spending $500+ per night at the Hyatt Herald Square right next door. Walked all over the neighborhood and a big chunk of Manhattan and never felt unsafe.
Very responsive hosts.  Great value for staying in nyc.  Note: area would be sketchy walking home at night alone.

I stayed in this apartment for a month.  Pros: -Great location  -Super close to subways.  -As a host Isaac was amazing he responds very quickly and is always there when you need anything and would send help within a few hours if needed.  Cons: -The apartment is very old. It looks older then the picture. And its not as maintained as it looks in the picture.  -Super noisy location. There’s a hotel in front of the building that plays music non stop throughout the day and night.   -The tiles on the bathroom floor were broken  -The toilet doesn’t flush properly it clogs after 2 uses. The bathroom in general the bathroom was very icky.   Isaac did provide a plunger but I had to use it every time I flushed the toilet. Which was not an ideal situation for me and probably for any human living in the 21st century. I also let Isaac know about it all and I expressed my opinion of how this is very unpleasant and not fare since I payed for a bathroom that functions normally..and this was his reply > “You have had full service and we have attended to your needs right away upon notice.”

Johnny's apartment is great value for money and even more so for NY prices. The description in the ad is very accurate, I would even say that the bathroom is larger than what is seen in the photos.  The apartment is located a 3-minute walk from the Sterling St subway (line 2-5) to get to the center (Penn Station), it takes about 30 minutes. Right in front there was a Deli (store) with a lot of variety and that prepares some BaconEggChees for 10. Although the area may seem a little unsafe, it is not at all, we have been walking around the neighborhood at different times and no problems.    The communication with Johnny was very good, he had no place to store our suitcases but he let us leave a little later.  The only thing that could be improved a little is the cleanliness.

We are very happy with our stay with this host.  ARRIVAL: Arrival is independent and very practical and above all very easy to understand thanks to the very good communication of the hosts.  LOCATION: We were a little scared when we arrived in the neighborhood but in the end it was just a preconceived idea, we were never disturbed and we never felt in danger.  The proximity to the metro is a plus, we were really very close and that is important.  APARTMENT: The apartment corresponds to the photos, very pretty and clean.  COMMUNICATION: Very good communication, the hosts give good advice, facilitate entry into the apartment with photos... Ask if you need anything or make themselves available for you.  IN +: We thank the hosts because we had a very good stay and thank you for their attention.  I recommend 👏 Thank you and see you soon 🗽

The location was great, bed was comfortable, and there was plenty of hot water. Communication was a huge mess as there were multiple people and multiple platforms who weren’t even communicating with each other, there were no towels (and no response when I asked about towels), and the place overall seemed unkempt. The air conditioner was moldy, the bathroom vent was moldy, there was what looked like mouse poop in the fridge. I felt safe from others, but unsafe from the conditions of the studio. Had awful allergies the whole stay.
This appartment is really well located and is quite clean, the bed is really comfortable. However externally the house is quite unpleasant  with quite rubbish in the entrance.

Bertha is very communicative and nice. I was there only for a lay over less than 24 hours and so it was just what I needed:  a place to sleep.  The room was very clean and spacious.  The only feedback I have is that when I left to leave at about 444-450am to catch my plane I couldn’t open the door ( there were instructions on how to open and it was still confusing) . It was super stressful. They had to come and the door was stuck it took a couple of minutes.

Perfect place to stay for a lower/mid budget! It's located 2 blocks away from Subway so there is no place to feel unsafe (south Harlem is still safe), many choices to eat around and a person that will receive you with a big smile trying to make sure everything is exactly as you wanted!

I enjoyed my stay here during my trip! Couldn’t have asked for better hosts and amenities! Although, we only used the place to sleep. The area where the house was located was in a good area but a few blocks down it did look/ get a bit sketchy. I would usually Uber from the subway at night instead of walking.

We enjoyed a wonderful stay at Judie and Steven's. The location was fantastic, offering easy and quick access to the nearby subway entrance. Judie and Steven were incredibly hospitable and friendly (I suspect even going so far as to purchase another blanket for the comfy bed when we relayed that we were cold the night before - thank you so much!). And the room and en suite bathroom were modern and cozy. Highly recommended.

I had a lovely stay at Karina’s place. The booking was last minute because I had a change in my flight plans that made it essential to be as close to the airport as possible. Karina was very prompt in her responses to questions I had after booking. This alleviated a lot of the stress I had due to my travel issues.  It was very easy to check in.
