Karina also followed up to make sure I was in the unit. Upon entering, the space is very sleek and had modern finishings. Both the living room and bedroom were comfortable spaces that made it easy to unwind after a long day of travel. The entire space was spotless. I did not use the kitchen beyond the coffee machine, but it is stocked with everything you need if you plan on cooking.  Other things to note are the parking spaces in front of the house and the backyard. I got to take a peek of the yard before I left, and wish my stay was longer to get to use it. Overall highly recommend the space for the convenience and the customer service!

We loved our stay here. Nice neighborhood, 5 min walk to train station. It was a bit more like a fancy hostel than we anticipated with several rooms rented by other Airbnb guests but even so it had everything we needed. The bathroom was super nice and the hosts were very communicative and even ran to the drug store to get me some  thing they didn’t have from the bathroom. Above and beyond service! We had a great experience here.

The house was beautiful! The room was huge and very clean! The hosts were very nice and super accommodating to any inquiries we had. The neighborhood was also nice with food and subway all in a short walking distance. You could hear other people walking around the house as it was a little echoey but that didn’t detract from our stay. Overall this place is a real steal if you want to spend a few days exploring the city and I would definitely stay here again for future visits.

Hugh was a great host. The location is perfect and a bit central. it's 2 miles from central park and about a similar distance to times square. About 5 stops from the financial district area. If you have to go uptown a lot (Harlem area), it will take much longer to get there. It is in a safe area in town and not too loud or busy. We had some early mornings and late nights and never once felt like we were in "danger." There's a great pizza place around the corner and Curry Hill is close by too if you like Indian food. It was comfortable. We had full access to the kitchen, living area and the bedroom. There's a lot of space to just sit our and relax. The only thing was that the shower backed up quite a bit which kinda got gross with 3 people always showering back to back. But i'm sure this will be a quick fix. There was an iron! (which was awesome), more than enough towels, TV and an Alexa! (which was nice since none of us brought portable speakers). I'd stay again.

Hugh was a fabulous host. He helped  with preparing for our trip by offering an app for luggage storage. We were able to check in our bags while site seeing before check-in.  It made our first day in the city stress-free. He was there to greet us to go over everything. His place was very clean and within site of the Empire State Building. Loved the roof top view at night. I would recommend this Air B&B to others.

Tara and her son (who lives above the apartment) were wonderful hosts who went above and beyond to make sure we were happy and comfortable and fed when the first winter storm came. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed for the two week stay. There is the most adorable coffee shop on the corner of the street and the area is beautiful. There is an above ground train near by, but truly was so quiet that we hardly ever noticed it. I cannot stress enough how much we enjoyed our time with Tara and in this wonderful little home.

I had the most wonderful stay on N7. This spot is truly such a steal by location alone. The room is spacious, has tons of storage, a comfy bed, and a lovely desk/ work space!  And AT is such a tip top host - so thoughtful, kind, hospitable, and generous. Can’t say enough good things about it. Thanks, AT!

Pros:  - Relatively good facilities - Super location  - Fast connection to public transport  - Fast and uncomplicated communication with the landlord  - nicely furnished   Cons: - Broken doorbell, one was already partially woken up at 8 o'clock in the morning because the doorbell has rung - Relatively dirty when moving in  - Insufficient cleaning supplies when moving in (neither vacuum cleaner nor mop) - Woodlouse and earwigs in the bathroom under the carpet  - Mice holes everywhere on the walls on the floor  - Mice ate bread - Mouse caught, which the landlord did not dispose of himself - Cameras all over the house not working (one package of ours was stolen)  - the host came to our apartment 3x without our consent  - the layout of the apartment is terrible (you have to go through one bedroom to get to the living room and the other bedroom) - The floor is crooked everywhere except in the kitchen and in the second bedroom.  - One bedroom has no window connected to the outside to get fresh air.  - One bedroom has extremely bright walls so  that you wake up several times a night. - You can hear the neighbors arguing etc. Since the walls are very thin to the house next door  - the apartment is on the 5th floor without elevator - heating did not always work, was sometimes super cold

Super apartment, well decorated and bright. When we arrived, we were a little taken aback by the New Lots area but that didn't last! No feeling of insecurity, the metro around the corner and a great supermarket right opposite.
Location was a bit sketchy, but very close to public transit. They ran out of toilet paper halfway through my stay though. That should never happen, no excuse.

The space was  small but it was expected. We appreciated having the kitchen area. Only negative was no coffee maker. A big plus was its proximity to the # 6 subway line. At no time did we feel unsafe, and the people we spoke with were friendly.

It doesn’t look as good as it does in the photos. The area was very sketchy. You’ll hear noises when you try to sleep. The apartment is under some apartments and it’s noisy. At night, it looks like you have to walk down some creepy basement to get inside the apartment. The “apartment” and sheets were dirty, the bathroom was weirdly set up. I would not recommend this to anyone.
Besnik was a great host! He is responsive and very friendly. The place was a steal and so close to the train.

Like the vast majority of NYC apartments, this apartment is small but it is stylish and has everything you need. The brick interior and high ceilings allow for an open/bigger perception of the studio, and the windows let in lots of light and give you a classic Harlem view. The unit is on the very top floor, and I did not mind walking up and down the stairs, but do keep in mind it can be difficult carrying and maneuvering luggage up and down the stairs since they are very narrow. I appreciated how spotless and  clean this apartment was since I’m a neat freak and bit of a germaphobe. There are tons of shops and restaurants including a 7/11, Target (an easy 10 minute walk), and the historic Minton’s Playhouse a couple of blocks away. I did not feel unsafe whatsoever walking around. I’ll definitely be keeping this Airbnb in my list for a future Harlem stay!

This is our second stay with Besnik in Brooklyn. We stayed for the first time back in the spring, and were super excited to see the apartment available again for this trip.   For those of you concerned about the neighborhood or the fact that this is a “basement” apartment in the back of a house, let me assure you, it’s totally non-sketchy and safe. The neighborhood is urban, obviously, but we wandered around late at night without a worry. And please keep in mind, this is NYC, and this sort of basement studio apartment is common. In this area you’ll often find living spaces made out of unconventional digs. But, Besnik has made good use of the space here.   With that said, I do have one warning. When we stayed here back in the spring, we slept soundly and comfortably in the cozy bed provided. However, on this trip, the heat was on in the building upstairs, and the noise coming from the exposed pipes was loud enough to keep me and my husband awake all night. We were exhausted as a result, and cut our trip a little shorter than originally planned.   All in all, this apartment is a great deal. The location couldn’t be better, one block from the L. It’s clean. It’s got a little outside yard if you’re a smoker. We will definitely stay here again, but only during the spring and summer due to the noise from the pipes.

Overall this place was great for the 3 days I was in New York. However future guests should know that the place is in east harlem and was a little far away from the main sites. The person I stayed with felt unsafe in this area, but I felt it was okay.

Where to begin...   1. Please understand, this is a floor four WALK UP. No elevator. The stairs are steep, and narrow. You will be on the TOP floor. Three flights of stairs. Bringing luggage up and down is a nightmare, and after walking the city all day long going up and down stairs and walking miles you still have to go up 3 flights of stairs with around 15 steps that are STEEP.   2. The apartment is smaller than the pictures lead you to believe. It is cute, but your TV area is from the bed.   3. The AC unit does not work. They have a table top fan for you to use to cool off.   4. The bathroom shower corner is held together with white duct tape. The silver plate that goes behind the water/temp dial is not attached. You will have to figure out which way to turn to get warm/cool water. Also, it falls forward so you can see the hole behind the plate. Also, wasn't a fan of the fabric shower curtain as we weren't sure how often it gets replaced/washed.   5. Fridge wasn't cool when we got there, fiddled with it and finally got cold, but then was freezing our drinks.   6. Trash is in the basement. You have to walk down 3 flights of stairs to then go down another flight to the trash area. Which, you then have to separate the trash for recycling. :|   7. Neighborhood wasn't nearly as cute at pictures lead you to believe. We felt unsafe walking home late at night. The side of the block that the apartment is on most of the lights were out so you are walking in a very dark area. It's about 2.5 blocks from the subway.   8. View from the windows is of other buildings and the backside of the apartment. Not really sure why there were pictures of a pretty view. Also, the window closure from the inside of the apartment is only held closed by a long metal piece, not a lock.   9. No controls for the heat that we could find in the apartment.   10. We did appreciate them letting us in an hour earlier than the check in time since we got there earlier than expected. That was one of the few things we were impressed with.   We wouldn't stay here again, but to each their own.

We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment is lovely. It was clean and check-in was very easy. We loved the location. The small kitchen was similar to other apartments we have stayed in in NYC but was less well equiped (e.g. two plates, cups glasses etc.). We intended to eat out most nights but it would have been nice to have a few more things for dining in. The oven was missing one knob and it felt a bit dangerous that it was not easy to know when the gas was clearly off. Alexandra responded to this quickly and offered backing / toasting things in their appartment, which is in the same building, but we were on holiday and wanted to be able to do that in the place we ere staying, e.g. for toasting bagels for brunch. Overall it was great but we think it is important to make sure all of the oven switches have correct knobs on and the markings for off and different levels of on are added as most have now worn off.

A very simple space, and for the money the location is especially hard to beat. If you are looking for a cozy or moderately luxurious place, you should look elsewhere - the space is accessed through a basement-type entrance, there is only overhead lighting and one lamp with no shade, the instead of dining chairs there are four office chairs. It’s a good attempt at a comfortable space in a converted basement/utility room. I have dust and smoke allergies, and while the place was clean something set off my sinuses.
Good location reasonable price. Dont expect anything special. Dont be afraid of the hot water sounds.   Netflix available.   Liked it

His place is basic just meant for shower and sleep. Bed was comfortable but didn’t feel clean. I needed a place to stay just for one night, I wouldn’t have stood any longer. People upstairs were loud in the middle of the night, heater makes a loud scary noise too. Woke up in the morning to pee so I went to the bathroom and found roaches running around on the floors and walls, lots of spiders too which is a given since its a basement. I just didn’t enjoy seeing roaches. Theres a fire heater by the tv which is cute and i liked it. Overall this place is only meant to stay for a day or two depending on what you can tolerate.
Good location but I don’t think is worth the price. Place look creepy

We absolutely loved our stay! We had a concern with how late we were allowed to check in by and Besnik did a wonderful job with responding back to us. This made our whole time in New York less stressful for us. Loved that there was an arcade game in the room as well. Very quick check in and check out process. The room had everything that we needed. This is a wonderful place to stay and very close to the subway. My first choice place to book if we are ever in the area again. Much appreciated to Besnik!

This apartment is ok if you need a quick stayover in a convenient location. Honestly, I wouldn’t have stayed here if I were traveling alone. The entry feels creepy, there were odd noises coming from the pipes all night long, and generally feels unwelcoming. Warning that there are exposed pipes everywhere which get VERY hot and could burn if not careful. We just needed a place to crash for the night so this was fine, but we wouldn’t stay here again. We found street parking quite easily in the area.

Not as described, not safe. The listing said "minor noise". Well, we've been traveling to NY a lot during last 10 years, so I don't expect quiet, but I expect reasonable. I've found out that it was the first floor of the building before we even got there, so I thought I knew what to expect. The first thing we asked when we met the host personally was if it was quiet outside of the apartment, and Shalimar responded it was a quiet family neighborhood and she's never heard much noise in the hood.  We've moved in on Saturday, there was a party on the upper floor all night through 4 am, people going back and forth slapping the entrance doors etc. Again, expectable. I've contacted the host on Sunday morning asking if it was always like that, or it was only during the weekends. She suggested to wait and see if it gets any better during the week days. So we did, but on Sunday night around 11 pm  another party has started - this time outside, right by our bedroom window people have put a grill!!! The smoke and smell was going  into the apartment - the fire starter, the burned food etc. And the noise, of course.  Imagine a company of 7 adults and 3 kids having a barbecue at your window at midnight. I can understand this all - neighbors, parties - it happens. What I don't understand is people arriving at cars with open windows and music so loud - I could not talk over the phone with all the windows closed. And it's been happening days and nights, like 3 am, 7 am, 5 pm.  People smoking weed at your entrance door and homeless person sleeping right under your window are probably the “quiet family neighborhood” features as well. I don't even want to start on the issues in the apartment itself. Just want to mention that it does not have the basics - like a cattle you could boiled water with to make a cup of tea. We had to boil water in cups in the microwave. All the kitchen appliances were so old and scratched with rust on it (!) - I could not even cook basic stuff - which is sad as being able to cook is one of many reasons I choose airbnb above hotels.  There's no single storage place for guests - even a shelf in one single wardrobe. This was very unusual for me. I asked the host for a small place for storage and got denial. The listing does not say it has the kitchen with no safe to use appliances and no storage room is available for guests.  Finally, I understand that me and the host may have totally different perception of quiet, but I am absolutely confused with the way she's been behaving after we said we were moving out. We booked the place for 16 nights, but decided to move out as soon as we...

Not sure where to begin... I booked last minute cause I needed to go to Brooklyn for work and the host graciously tried to work with me by giving the keys to “her doorman” in Manhattan where I was at the moment. However, when I got there the doorman did not have the keys nor did he have anyone with her name living in that apartment. Then she proceeded to be mad at me and said that’s not her place, it’s her “family’s place”. First warning that something fishy was going on.  I then went to Brooklyn with all my things and she instructed me that she left her keys at the corner shop. Very kind of her. I got there and she was waiting at the deli for me, a little fishy... then she walked me to her place, we were behind someone else going in so I had no idea the front door key worked or not. I got to the apartment and everything was fine and I dropped my stuff and went back out. I came home late and THE FRONT DOOR KEY DID NOT WORK. Imagine that in the middle of the night in a sketchy neighborhood with all my things inside that the front door keys would not work. So I messaged her and Airbnb. At this point I needed to ring all the door bells and bother her neighbors to let me in. Fortunately, the apartment key at least worked and My stuff was still there. I quickly grabbed everything and had to go back to Manhattan.   Long story short, DO NOT STAY HERE

So lucky to have booked here. above and beyond, accommodating x100, great place and perfect location (The location dot sits on the hyphen to bed-stuy!). Also, house is set up great and full of everything you could ask for and more. It’s def hang/party pad ready if you want. the rules on that’s are a relief when she makes it known it’s no problem to have fun!  Beside all that what makes the place perfect is the host and her vibe that’s felt as soon as you meet her. So welcoming and great to talk to. Not just as the host but for fun convo.  For instance I tend to talk a lot, like too much. The second we met for the tour we chatted it up for like an hour before a focused tour could happen haha. What makes that example great is that it makes it feel like a friend that’s letting you stay at their place when they are away. This is an amazing dynamic to feel right away With that friend vibe brings so much respect to the host and her place. That’s  an instant trust  on both sides this creates. This In turn is great relief for vacation or whatever stay your having. It’s then comfortable and stress free on both ends which together intensify the satisfaction.   Choosing to basically be in a strangers house instead of hotel you never know what it’s gonna be/feel like which can affect your get away a lot! Was definitely luck of the draw to book with her. She’s definitely  a treasure to find on Airbnb. The location is perfect for any Brooklyn seeker (I’m from there so know the best neighborhoods I’d want to stay) As well I learned she has places elsewhere in NYC. So I would choose another of her places if to stay in the city just from the brooklyn experience.   We were so lucky to have found her and so pleased. Perfect and couldn’t have asked for a better experience or a better host.   Now if I even hear the word Airbnb I’ll think of her! Lol.
Easy place to crash, low stress

I stayed here after a snowstorm caused all the flights to be cancelled out of LGA. I needed a last minute place for the night. After a very stressful day, I was so happy that my reservation request was accepted almost instantly. The quick response was sooo helpful and exactly what I needed at the moment. They even came down and helped let me in when I couldn’t get the lock box open. The photos were accurate and for the price, the place is a great deal. The bed is very hard, but I didn’t wake up sore or anything. There were a few cleanliness issues (musty towels and blankets, dirty dishes), but since I booked so last minute I will definitely say that that could’ve been a factor in not being able to properly clean the room.

Jaqui and Mark's place is stylish, yet very cozy. Their place is conveniently located (about 6-8 minute walk to the subway station) in a residential neighborhood.  My husband and I walked from the subway station to their place a little after midnight, it was very safe and bright on the way. It was my first time exploring this neighborhood, and I really enjoyed the vibe.  Jaqui and Mark were very friendly and nice but not at all intrusive. They had some medical emergency when we just arrived at the airport, but Jaqui communicated throughly so everything went very smoothly. She tried her best to make us feel at home in a such stressful condition, which I highly appreciated. She messaged us on the last day if everything went well and wanted to say good bye before we left, and I thought it was very sweet gesture.   The only thing about this place is the bathroom does not have a door. It has a curtain to cover, so if you are traveling with someone you are not 100% comfortable with, you might hear.. Well, everything. I didn't have any problem during my stay, but I would have find it bit  troublesome if I was traveling with a friend. Other than the bathroom door, the space was very spacious and simple. And the bed was very comfortable, I slept like a baby the whole time I was staying here.   I would definitely recommend this place and to explore this neighborhood to everyone.

I am so glad we took a chance on this place! We had never stayed in this neighborhood before, but we loved the style of the place, the privacy, and the value. It turned out to be super close to the amazing Prospect Park, and just a couple streets away from the subway.  The place has such a cool minimalist style, and it has everything you need for a  stress free and peaceful experience. Though there isn’t an AC, the fan that was provided kept the entire place plenty cool enough even during the heat wave (over 100 degrees).  We will absolutely be back when we return the the city!

Vicente’s place is definitely a great place to stay when visiting NYC.  It’s like your home away from home:  it is kept tidy and clean all throughout your stay and it is easily accessible via the metro.  The location is perfect for those who like to make the most of their brief stay in NYC.    Vicente is very accommodating; he answers messages and addresses our littlest concerns quickly; he gives attention to details which make one’s stay truly stress-free and orderly.  If given the chance, it would be great to stay in Vicente’s place again.

This place was super clean and the hosts were incredibly accommodating. I had to go a Yankee game and needed to drop off my bags way earlier than check in time and Pema was completely accommodating about letting me leave my stuff early. The location was also one of the best parts. I cannot stress enough how convenient it was to everything. The amount of buses and trains that run out of 74th-Jackson Heights station is crazy. What a hub. And then on top of all that you are right next to LGA. as a New Yorker who was doing a staycation, i would totally recommend this place to an out of towner. thanks again!

Clean and comfortable, and surprisingly well insulated from the sound of aircraft, despite being in the landing pattern of nearby La Guardia airport.  Diner, drug store, and Dunkin’ Donuts located a block or two away.  Hosts live above and are responsive, though we never had a need to call on them.  Would definitely stay here again.

This place was clean and well taken care of. My family were out-of-town tourists staying for the week and Eva and Jacob did a wonderful job making them feel welcome! They were very responsive about check-in and throughout the week, making the stay stress-free. It was great to have access to the kitchen and outdoor garden space. The location was very residential and quiet, but a close walk to the train.

Everything was great and very satisfactory, except for the description of how to turn on the shower. Here I recommend trying it out first and, if necessary, contacting the hostess before standing naked in the shower and not being able to switch the water.  Unfortunately, the noise insulation is very poor, you can hear everything that's going on in the apartment next door, but that's very often the case in the USA, so nothing unusual. You just have to know it so as not to be unpleasantly surprised.

Jacob’s place was a great place for a girls weekend trip in the city. It is a few blocks away from the subway and we were able to navigate ourselves fairly easily into the city. I went with 4 women and we never felt unsafe walking to or from the stations. The space is clean and the hosts are very kind and welcoming!

Jammie was a great host. Checking in and out was simple and the space was well-furnished and great value. We did feel a bit unsafe walking home from the subway late at night, but it was a very short walk. The location is great, otherwise.
Jimmy was a nice Host and everything was clean. Would have been nice to know that there were also other guests. The neighborhood was a little bit scary at night but at day no problem.

Superbly appointed and stylish Airbnb - spacious, bright and secure. Immaculately clean. No complaints with the space itself. The neighbourhood was not my favourite - it's clear that the area is slowly being 'gentrified', but it wasn't the most glamorous or trendy area. I felt a little on edge/unsafe walking back from the subway stop at night with my friends. Having said that, we had no trouble at all and there were lots of convenient things nearby. Personal preference perhaps? Just to confirm though - the neighbourhood was historic and pretty in parts, as described, and the Airbnb building itself is stunning and well maintained. No complaints with the Airbnb space itself, it was fantastic.

This place is a steal. To get the obvious out of the way: Yes, the room is technically a "loft" and if you are over 5 feet 6 inches (or thereabouts) tall, you cannot stand up without bumping your head, and yes, there is not a proper door.  BUT.  For my purposes this didn't matter, as I didn't plan on spending hours and hours in my bedroom -- I mainly wanted a comfortable place to sleep at night, for low cost, and with easy access to the subway. This place fit the bill, and then some. There's far more privacy than you would guess from the listing, as the other roommates did a great job of creating a makeshift wall that shields you from the living room. I stayed for 7 nights, and at no point did I feel a lack of privacy. Bonus? The building itself is AWESOME. A solid gym, a pool, a sauna, and a large game room, of sorts, where you can chill. Two blocks to the L-train. Other bonus? The roommates are awesome. Next time I visit New York, I hope to stay here again. Recommended.

Hazel's place is a total steal of a deal. Great value.   What you'll love: - Insanely great view of the water and Manhattan from this condo  - AC - Luxury Building in Williamsburg - Less than 1 minute walk to Ferry to Manhattan  - Convenience store, coffee, views all under 1 minute away  - Subway about 5 blocks away   Hazel's place is great if you're looking to stay in Williamsburg.  She is very quick to respond to any questions you may have and extremely great at communicating key details to ensuring your stay in easy and enjoyable.   Hazel allowed me to check out at a later time to accommodate my late flight.   I highly recommend!

The apartment was nice and clean. However, we felt a bit unsafe in the area and the apartment doors didn't make up for this lack of security. We wouldn't have been able to move around the area alone. It was ok for two. But if you are unsure, you should think about it. The second room is directly connected to the kitchen and cannot be locked.  There is a small wooden window between the small room and the bathroom through which you can hear everything. So you should be familiar with each other.  Contact with Eva via the app was always there and she helped us quickly if we had any questions. Thanks for that, Eva!
A great space.  Hopefully the next tenant will not have to deal with the creepy crawlies because the host will make sure to fumigate the space.

We didn't knew, what to expect from our first Airbnb experience, but it all went smoothly and was easier, than I afraid. We arrived quite late and it was nice and easy to check-in and feel ourselves as at home. We found everything we needed. Our 6-years old son enjoyed shower and I enjoyed quick internet.

There is no TV. And I felt That having people meet me there was putting them out. In my opinion this would be a great place for someone there just to work or a place to sleep. Not a great place while on vacation and meeting up with people or needing to hang out while waiting to meet up with people. Mamiko is very friendly while her husband was a bit suspicious of people coming there to meet up with me. If you want very quite. This is  your place.

Jay's place was great! Nice studio apartment on the third floor with all the basic amenities you'd expect. It's actually really cool what he's done with the space. Pull out couch was perfect for a movie night-in. Jay was great and super communicative. Met us there when we arrived, showed us the space, all that. Check-out was easy and no-stress. I'd definitely stay here again.

I am a real estate agent, and I believe in full disclosure.  This condo has the potential to be an absolute great space, but there is serious work that needs to be done.  Beginning with the exterior appeal and work inwards.  The wood around the door is rotted out, the support banister leading up the stairs on the stoop is rusted out and unsafe.  The screens on the storm door needs to be replaced properly on the front door, and not held in place with duct tape.  The auto on/off lights in the hallway and bathroom,  needs to be disabled when guests are there.  They come on and off with the slightest movement, which almost drove us crazy.  There are exposed wires upstairs protruding from a hole in the ceiling where I believe is the absence of a smoke/fire detector  or carbon monoxide detector.  The marble floors in the bathroom are beautiful but needs rugs for safety precautions.  There also needs to be comfortable seating for each person that the space sleeps.  There is a round glass table with fold out chairs and a small breakfast dinette set with a bench in the living room.  There is a twin futon sofa and that is ALL the seating for a place advertised to accommodate 10 guests.  Fold out chairs are not comfortable to sit in for 2 hours while trying to watch a movie.  It would also add to the appeal if there were some photos on the walls....it is very sterile.  If you only plan to sleep in the unit, it's great, but if you plan to spend anytime relaxing, this (at the time of my stay) was not the best place to do so.  It is convenient to the train though.  I'm not trying to throw it under the bus, but I take reviews seriously.  I believe in being informed.  Although I never met Lou, his communication was prompt.

This place was great! Lots of space. Only about 2 blocks to the L train station and a family dollar.  Little sketchy neighborhood, but it is Brooklyn. I was there with my 4 teenage children and I never felt unsafe. It was clean and had all the essentials. We never met Lou, but always got a prompt response when we needed it. Thanks for   the great stay!

Antonis's place was very quiet and clean, we slept great every night on the comfortable beds and clean linens.  The house is cozy and we felt right at home, there is a nice outdoor patio and garden. Antonis was super easy to deal with and made our check in stress free.

the neighborhood is very dangerous, the photos they put are totally different. The first day we arrive, the keys are left in the street, by the tree. the environment of the room very, very poor, boxes thrown, dangerous wiring.

I have been so excited to write this review. We (4) stayed for 7 days, and this place was honestly perfect. Sure some people say it’s “further” out but once you get the hang out the subway, it’s all fairly simple. It’s really “upper Manhattan” if we are being technical. The host was very helpful and responsive. The subway entrance is in walking distance (5 blocks). There are a lot of good things to do in this area. There is a Dunkin Donuts that is easy to get to. There is also a place called “The Chipped Cup” which we enjoyed. They also have a lot of Deli’s that are open late which carry a lot of basics. A good restaurant, that has Dominican food is called “La Rubia” hands down THE BEST. Again, everything is fairly easy to get to.  It’s NOT dangerous at all. The only thing some people may have a hard time with,  is the flight of stairs...meaning. There is no elevator, and this room is on the last floor (6th). But if you are good with stairs, then it’s no biggie!. I would recommend staying here, a good price for where it’s at! Overall, we all enjoyed this location and I’m glad we found it.

I had a wonderful time staying here.  It is in the perfect location, plenty of delicious restaurants and cute bars (AlBadawi, Bohemian Bar, etc) along with a Trader Joes close by. Subway is a 15 minute walk and can get you into the city quickly. Cobble Hill is a very cute area and I never felt unsafe walking home at night. If I was working in Brooklyn for the summer again I would 100% stay here again! Jeannette is very kind and helpful, I locked myself out and she contacted me within 20 minutes to get me sorted. I definitely recommend.

Place is basically as described. Location is okay, area is a bit sketchy. Parking is on the street, not quite the same as free parking on premises. Hard to find parking at night. There were a lot of big fruit flies which was a little gross. Pretty dusty..could have been a bit cleaner overall. Beds were comfortable. It is a basement apartment so don’t expect windows or sunlight. It was okay for a one night stay for a show close by.
Very nice and friendly couple. Clean sheets and fresh towels. For the price to stay in the Big Apple is a steal.

Our experience was very different than many of the reviews we read. We did read a couple that mentioned cockroaches and we experienced multiple in the bathroom.  We appreciated the a/c being left on for us and the keys being left for us early.  We were scared because the police threatened to bang down the door if we didn't open it at about 8 P.M. They received a call saying there was an overdose in this unit. We did not know if anyone else was behind the closed door leading to the rest of the apt. The only response to this problem  I received from owner was " I have no idea" (via text).  Then at midnight the cops came back again and banged on door every ten  minutes, but from our room we didn't hear them announce themselves so we didn't know who was pounding. We were very afraid. I tried to contact the host, but again she was fairly unresponsive. Maybe twenty minutes later she texted only that this was about the next door neighbor again. Finally the host went to her door and told the police she didn't need to let them in. At that point I met her very nice son and he explained why this was happening. I appreciated his honesty. The small room we stayed in had no cover over the two light bulbs on the ceiling and they kept shorting out. I asked if a light bulb could be replaced. Five hours later she brought us a lamp.
Great communication with Simone! Could be a bit cleaner in the apartment (I'm afraid that sheets weren't 100% fresh), but it's fine for spending a night.

The place is close to metro but station was closed and we needed to go to another station which is several blocks away but it okay. The neighborhood looks like unsafe but no any accidents happened. The place is 30-40 minutes away from times sq by subway and jfk (by taxi). The room is as described, the bathroom is absolutely clean and there no any line despite another rooms were occupied by guests. Evrita and Liz are super hosts: communicative and very helpful. I recommend this place to stay

I had a great time with Rebecca and her dog Lenny. The apartment is beautifully furnished and you immediately feel at home. Rebecca was always there when I needed her. I've been very afraid of dogs since I was little, but Lenny is such a sweet (although big) dog who won't hurt a fly. The room size is reasonable if you're not going to be there all day (I also used the living room and dining area a lot and only slept in my room). I will definitely come back, thanks for everything Rebecca! :)

Rebecca is a very good host. Always available. She responds quickly to questions and makes herself available at any time for arrival and departure. Pleasant and smiling.  She often prepares coffee in the morning which she leaves available. However, as indicated in the description, she recently got a large dog, quite young and dynamic so not suitable if you are not comfortable with large dogs because he is in the process of being trained. The apartment is well maintained, always tidy and the common areas are relatively clean (apart from a few places so would not be suitable for fussy people either). Finally, the apartment is very well located, no feeling of insecurity, close to the subway so very easy to get to Manhattan. And no problem with noise, the apartment is quiet, no noise at night either.

I cannot say enough nice things about Lance's place. It was clean, fully stocked, close to the subway and much bigger than I expected. We arrive to a personalized note on the board with fresh lilies on the counter. The fridge was stocked with a bunch of waters, few sodas and a couple of beers. the cabinets had various snacks and plenty of dishware and cookware to be able to cook a meal or two. If you forgot toiletries no worries because the bathroom is stocked with whatever you may have forgotten.   The location of the apartment is right around the corner form the G train which made getting around so easy. There is a wine shop on the corner, a coffee shop across the street, a drug store down the block and a great Irish pub a few blocks down.   I was able to actually meet Lance and he had some wonderful recommendations for food, activities anything you wanted to know. He was also most accommodating in helping me when I lost my ID. Yep first night in town and I lost my ID. I had to have my passport overnighted to me and Lance was so kind to let me ship it to  his office to ensure it would get received.   We had such a wonderful time! if you get the chance stay at Lance's place you will absolutely love every movement.

The apartment is a nice size, perfect for a couple. Nice sized kitchen with full amenities.  I brought my own Apple TV with me and connected it to the TV. The little deck outside is wonderful and he building felt very safe and quiet. The location is great as well! Right on the same block is the G train. Around the corner there are great restaurants, bars, and McCarren Park! Stephanie is also a great host. Easy to communicate with and helpful. Definitely recommend staying here, it’s a steal!

Everything is as shown in the photos. The kitchen equipment is top notch! The balcony is exceptional: you can have coffee in the morning and an aperitif in the evening 😜! We are sheltered from street noise since the apartment overlooks interior courtyards. The air conditioning is fabulous and works wonderfully. The apartment is ideally located: a few meters from line G and access to Manhattan - Grand Central in 25 minutes with a change for line 7. A few minutes by bus from Williamsburg! No elevator but 2 floors, it's not unpleasant and no washing machine but a laundromat 2 blocks away! The street is very commercial with restaurants: a “Dollar Up” 2 blocks away and a few small traders with fruit and vegetable stalls open late in the evening! everything is said then “enjoy your journey”!

It's a nice, spacious apartment on the West side. A little messy and a few bugs but not too bad. The location is very convenient to the Port Authority and Penn Station. A little sketchy, at least while I was there, as a large group of homeless people seemed to be permanently camped out right down the street. But New York is in rough shape post-COVID in many places. All in all, a convenient place and good value for the price.
Like expected.  We slept well. No unpleasant surprises.  Recommendations to local restaurants were super helpful.

Location is perfect. The room was okay; I was afraid that it would be noisy or cold after reading previous comments but actually I slept really well, warm, and didn’t hear a noise. Not really a place to hang but good for a night stay. I haven’t met Piero, but he was responsive to texts.

what a terrible experience  first thing when I got to the appartment  my blanket smells like pee , and Feathers all over the floor , absolutely nobody cleans it , after that I asked for a new blanket around 4pm, he said he will give me another one , only at 12:30 am he gave me the blanket , I literally couldn't sleep and waited for him!  both rooms is right next to 39 and 9 ave , and the air conditioner make it feel like the window are open ,so you will be waking up every 5 minutes for a truck honking , or a homeless yelling,  the area is midtown but the is alot of drug dealers and homeless in the area , I even saw to guys punching another guy in the middle of the street right before the cops came (what a great experience) there is also a wood room where the living room use to be , and it look very cheap made ,  bottom line you get the worst for such a high price, if I added just 40$ a night I can get an HOTEL ROOM!!!!  tbh I'm not sure what's worse sleeping in this appartment or sleeping on the street  I've never believe that rooms like that listed on airbib

We did not feel comfortable staying at this location. It was not what I consider an Entire Suite. Not compared to the many others I've stayed in. They're usually a completely separate entrance and room. Privacy was a major concern here.  It should describe the door and entrance more. More details on the washer and dryer literally being right at the entrance of the room. Not just saying it's on the site. Others doing laundry are right in the room entrance. There was no mention that it only has a slider, with no lock. Also, the laundry room door that can lock guests in. There is no mention of the lack of private entrance. The camera watches guests coming and going through the entrance. It's not as much for intruders walking up to the entrance.  We felt like we needed to whisper so the host doing his laundry right outside the unlockable slider door that separated our room and the common washer room, couldn't hear our private conversations.   My mother had an anxiety attack realizing there wasn't really any privacy. The door that could lock us in really scared us too.  We left immediately that night without even staying an hour. I tried to contact the host about even a partial refund, but he has stopped responding. Communication has not been effective. We are staying at a hotel now.
Very nice, no stress, and great location. Very close to a lot of restaurants, drug store and of course, the metro!

Thought the place might be a little sketchy and was slightly worried in the beginning, but it turned out really nice!! Great location, clean & nice room, and Piero is a really nice guy!! Responds to my questions really quickly and is really chill ! It might be a little bit noisy outside at night since it's really close to the busy city part of ny, but it was overall a great experience and I would recommend!

Not my favorite airBNB experience. The common areas and bathroom were quite dirty and the whole place had an unpleasant odor. The living room was replaced by a third bedroom made out of thin sliding wood. There was very loud construction on the street below that started at 7am. I chose this place for proximity to Penn Station after arriving on a 2:30am train. It was a place to rest, but would definitely pay more for a hotel next time.

In terms of location and value this is pretty unbeatable. I can't stress enough the location value for New York. Additionally he is excellent at communicating and making sure your checkin etcetera is smooth. The only thing I would say was a little less than perfect is that it's very hot in the room; I suggested to him to just put a fan in. But it didn't turn out to be too major an issue and it was still again a great value and worked out very well.

Be careful, this rental is a scam, there are no facilities listed, no bedroom but a living room opening onto bedrooms, the bathroom, kitchen and front door of the accommodation. So if you like to sleep in a busy corridor it's perfect... The apartment is dirty, noisy (the restaurant below is equipped with blowers overlooking the windows) and the host is disrespectful and invisible... Avoid this scam, it's a very bad memory for us...

Piero is definitely nice and accommodating. He let us leave our bags after check out. The place is ideally located. Yet, according to the pics and the description, I did expect to be sharing the place with him and not with 4 other people. One bathroom for 6 people in the morning is not what I expect for the listing price. The wifi which is from the restaurant below doesn't work. I was also beaten at night by what I suspect to bedbugs.

Timo is soooo nice and helpful he made a stressful visit east and fun. The mattress is aMAYzing and with amenities like coffee, the extra sleeping area (it was me and my teen son so perfect!) garbage bags to protect my kids skateboard in the rain Timo goes the extra mile easily and kindly. He makes Brooklyn as friendly as his native Wisconsin. Thanks Timo!

I got the place for the location, but my first impression was already bad since the room doesn’t look exactly like the picture, the closet is not inside the room. Also the hallway is very dirty and smells really bad, there’s a homeless man who comes and stay there in the middle of the stairs, I felt really unsafe. Also I had an incident with the roommate, who wouldn’t respect my privacy and just open my door, he also puts really loud music at 8am and smoky food while he cooks causing the fire alarm to ring, it was very uncomfortable situation.

This is a wonderful place to stay! I'd never been to Brooklyn before so didn't realize quite how incredible the location is until I got there and was able to explore the neighbourhoods around Prospect Park. It is right off Flatbush Ave and Vanderbilt Ave, both of which have a ton of lovely stores, coffee shops, bakeries, and restaurants. It's very close to the park and all of the lovely neighbourhoods around it. The apartment itself is incredibly clean and the room is set up as a perfect AirBnB spot, with very clear instructions that mean everything is simple and stress-free. I highly enjoyed staying here and would say it's perfect for anyone visiting Brooklyn.

As positive aspects, it is worth highlighting that Eriko's accompaniment to facilitate both the arrival and the departure was very appropriate and helped us with everything. The location, for those who want to stop in Harlem, is excellent, 6 blocks from Central Park and 9 from the Apollo Theater and 125th Street, which is very commercial. The African and Dominican communities coexist in the surrounding area. We didn't find it unsafe at all. There are supermarkets and restaurants nearby. To go to Midtown, one of the subway lines is on the corner and the other is approximately 200 meters away. The apartment was very comfortable, beautiful and spacious; with adequate air conditioning at high temperatures. The bathroom is spacious and has a very good shower. As negative aspects, it is worth highlighting that it was not in adequate hygienic conditions. It also didn't have a bed but a sofa bed with a mattress divided into 2 parts. Also, since there was no double glass in the windows, the noise of transportation starting at 5:30 in the morning was quite annoying, although it subsided after 9.

Staying with Marie Louise is an excellent option if you are looking for accommodation that has a very good quality-price ratio. The room is spacious, bright, as seen in the photos. The bed is very comfortable. The bathroom is shared but is always impeccably clean. In approximately 20 minutes you can reach Time Square on the subway, which is less than a five-minute walk from the house. We have arrived very late at night every day and we have never had any problems or felt afraid. Marie Louise's family is very friendly too, they are always willing to help. You are sure to have a great stay if you stay here! Thank you Marie Louise!!!

Airik's place was wonderful. Spacious. Nice kitchen. Even a little porch. Everything you need in the kitchen to cook. CLEAN!   PROS: Airik was EXTREMELY available over text. Keys handoff went smoothly even though my flight was hours late! Very gracious, very generous with his time, very punctual when I needed him. Bed cot very comfy. Bedroom nice and big. Elevator quick and modern. Shower strong and hot. Very walkable to subways. Nice market right downstairs. Perfect place to see the city from.   CONS: A/C didn't work when I was there, but it WAS the first muggy evening of the year, and since the air is central to the building, maybe the super just hadn't turned it on yet for everybody? The windows all opened (as did the door to the porch) so the cross ventilation cooled us down ok. Also, this is not in the upper east. It's in spanish harlem. The neighborhood is a bit sketchy if you go out after 10pm, but if you're ubering, it's not a problem because the building/property felt 100% safe.   If the A/C is working, and you're not going to be walking around the neighborhood after 10pm, this place gets an A+. Airik as a host already gets an A+++. Thanks, Airik!

Delighted with the stay at Derick's house! Spacious place with very nice decoration, furniture in excellent condition and very warm. As for the location, it is a little far from the center but taking metro A (two blocks away) takes you wherever you want in 30/40 minutes. Very quiet neighborhood (I arrived around 2 am and it is not dangerous) and with a supermarket around the corner from the apartment to do shopping. I would always stay at Derick's again! Thanks for everything!

What a great place! Location is fantastic; room is clean, spacious, and comfortable; I slept great on the really nice mattress; and the price is so good I was worried it was a scam. It was not! I would happily stay here again.

The first night in the house we thought we saw/heard something. We then woke up to numerous problems.   A mouse was stuck in a draw all night running around in a bedroom drawer so much so that it made the person have to go downstairs and sleep on the couch to avoid hearing a mouse all night. Not only did this person have to sleep on the couch but during this, they saw another mouse in the living room. We then had to catch the mouse that next morning.   We left NO food opened on the counters, everything was SEALED. We all woke up to 90% of our food bitten through. This has caused such an extreme amount of food/money wastage. Although the owner sent an exterminator to come this still did not solve the problem.  Setting up traps and covering up the holes just left all of us all in an awful situation. I went downstairs in the morning to the sound of a mouse squealing stuck in a trap - which we then had to put outside.   In addition, because the holes were covered we could all hear the mice running around stuck in the walls. To the point that one member was so uncomfortable they went early to a hotel we were checking into at a later date.  We all feel that this was completely unacceptable and disgusting. No one should have to worry about mice crawling in our clothes/food, or scared to sleep every night because of the vermin that surrounded us. This was an awful experience for all.  This was one of the worse experiences we have had in travelling. You should not have advertised on Airbnb as I believe the owner had an idea of the situation at hand. The very small compensation of a cleaning fee is not enough to cover food and this type of inconvenience let alone leaving us open to possible illness from vermin.
She’s such a kind person and helps us find some restaurants and attractions. Apartment is clean and safety but the neighborhood is dark and quite scary to walk around at night.

I definitely recommend staying with Marie.  She's a great host.  The place isn't fancy, but it's certainly comfortable and stylish (without making you afraid of breaking something:), and Marie's even so thoughtful as to equip you with a transit pass (you have to pay to add to it, but you're spared the cost of paying for the pass itself).  As her listing notes, you  need to be prepared for some street noise coming off the highway.  I found that earplugs addressed it well enough for my needs.  Also, it's in a really interesting neighbourhood, but do be prepared for subway time getting to places.

The apartment was amazing, definitely worth its money. The neighborhood was good and safe, it wasn’t scary walking through the streets at nighttime. The WiFi was not working so good for the first couple of days, but Aracelis fixed it immediately after I told her about the problem. Also right now the L train is under construction until summer 2020 so on nights and weekends it might take a bit longer to get around, you should keep that in mind. All in all, I really enjoyed staying at this apartment. Aracelis is an amazing host and she was always available whenever I had any questions or concerns.

I have mixed feelings.. it's a great place and location to be able to stay in the city. It's as described, an old building and small spaces. The biggest issue was the communication for check in. No information was sent until 30 minutes before check in time. I was worried we may have been scammed and weren't actually going to have a place to stay. Also, note the check in time is later at 6pm and don't bother asking to check in early as it won't be accommodated so just plan to drag your luggage around all day.

A very great place to stay during your visit of NY. Marcus is very kind and helpful with information and tips. The place is very nice, clean, big, equipped and very good located. 2 subway stops reacheable in 5min and everything you need just around the corner. Maybe the neighborhood looks a little creepy, but it has very friendly people- it's not as bad as it looks at first sight. Totally reccomend this place!

First off this room was clean, comfortable and as described. There was no top sheet on the bed so I slept in my clean clothes for the morning.  I only had a slight mishap with communication. After informing Braulio that I would be arriving between 4-6 in my initial message I got an "Okay".  After giving him a heads up when I was about an hour away from the space, I did not hear any response from him. When about 20min from I realized there was no instructions on how to check into the space which I also asked with no response. When I arrived at 4:45 I knocked on the front door to no answer. I Called Braulio and was sent straight to voicemail. About 5 minutes after standing in the front someone opened the door and let me in. She was still cleaning the bedding for the room, fortunately I just needed to drop off my luggage. I didn't hear from Braulio until about 9pm when he messaged to see if he could put a mug in the room. All of this worked out but definitely added a bit of stress to traveling, and could have been worse had the one person not been there. Otherwise the room really was nice and comfortable. A bit out of the way but definitely worth the price.

Excellent location, very close to the subway and in a nice part of Brooklyn. Quite spacious for 2 people (might facilitate two couples easily). Overall nice hosts. What we didn't like is that twice there were some bathroom renovation works ongoing, for the first time we got the notice, for the second time it happened during our absence. In addition, we were made sure that our belongings would be watched all the time but in fact the apartment was left open with our private belongings unsafe (e.g. passports...) as we by chance learnt by coming in for a midday nap. This is something to be avoided of course.  Otherwise OK.

Sol was very responsive and helpful anytime we needed anything. The apartment was solid, noting that the bathroom is very small. There are rats that play outside in the backyard area at night. The apartment is also incredibly close to the subway which was ultimately its best feature. Since this is a long term rental spot, I’ll mention the mail/package situation. Packages here get stolen regularly and you need to have to packages sent to a nearby UPS store instead

She doesn't want African natives in her house. She is scare of Ebola and doesn't certainly get any nasty germs.  I don't know which experience she had with other black people but she definitely will treat you like a crap if you show up with your black skin and your African accent.
Because it was my daughters wedding, I didn’t want to let my feelings about the experience get in the way. But I felt very uneasy and unsafe the whole time.

Host Were Very clean & respectful. Room was clean and tidy, no issues at all with that. Room was represented as self check-in, which was not the case. I have nothing negative to say towards the host, jus didn’t appreciate how my reservation was threatened to be canceled due to me sending my female friend to the door to assure it was the right place, being that i didn’t wanna startle anyone. So if you book with the host, PLEASE COME ALONE!!!!! can’t stress that enough, even if it’s your ride, make sure they don’t even get out of the car. All in all would stay again, but don’t think I’ll ever be in the position too.

The artist retreat is absolutely wonderful!   Perfectly located in Brooklyn and around the corner from markets, wine shops, and our new favorite sushi joint Trad Room.  The space was clean and fully equipped with what we needed.  There was coffee and about 5 different ways to brew it!  The outside area was so adorable.  Sun and shade areas.  Perfect if you had a little pet!   Parking is easy during day hours, once everyone comes home from work you make have to walk a block but still not bad.  There is a small ac unit near the head of the bed and the noise did bother my husband but nothing a pair of ear plugs couldn’t fix!  Or sleep in the bed downstairs which was an added space I didn’t even know about!   I recommend this place.  If we come to Brooklyn again we are staying here!

Very hospitable host and neighbors. Amy left us some treats and went of her way to make sure we stayed in communication and that we were settled and taken care of. The apt is colorful, spacious,  homey. I hope to stay again in the future as it has ever needed for a low stress comfortable stay.

The room was clean & the apartment was lovely. However, the neighborhood is very dangerous. I paid for one month but left after 2 nights since I was accosted by a man demanding my money. The hosts not only blamed me but sent me a map of areas to avoid AFTER my rattling encounter. The husband sent me a number of very nasty messages but they did agree to a partial refund but they keep changing when I will get this refund. As of today, I have received no refund. These people are amoral, unethical con artists. I truly wish I had never booked that stay. I wasted $1800 & was berated by this so-called Superhost. Horrible people these two. Just awful.

Debbie and Roberto are really super nice hosts. They are communicative and always try to take care of the guests. We were in general very happy about our stay. The place was very clean and comfortable. It is well located as we could reach the metro station within 10 minutes. Regarding other reviews about the safety concerns, we could say that the area has a different vibe than for example Williamsburg. But we didn’t have any unpleasant experience. The presence of the police cars made us feel safe too.

When we started to look for a place to stay, close to LaGuardia but yet far enough away for everything else we wanted, this was a perfect fit. There is not one thing we would have needed that wasn’t provided. Made our trip stress free.

Smells like smoke, weed, and mold— NOT SAFE FOR ANYONE TO STAY. This place is nothing like described and not worth the value. I should’ve realized that when the host had an excuse/explanation to all the previous guest reviews. The host has not addressed any of the issues but instead opts to have a justification for all the issues.   Upon arrival the place reaked like smoke, weed, and mold/dampness, and we were unable to stay at the accommodation. The place is not listed as smoke-friendly. When we reached out to the host she was quick to deny it even saying the place was cleaned prior to arrival and “Plus the windows in the apartment were left open”. Clearly acknowledging that there was a need to have the windows opened due to the smell.   The smell was just one of the many issues. I am not the first to write a review addressing these issues. The place is not “newly renovated”— a majority of the appliances do not work, the fridge is full of old food, the sleeping accommodation are not as described, the cleaning job was half done, and the list goes on. It clearly didn’t take much to put this place together.  After being unable to stay at the accommodation, we contacted Airbnb customer service for a refund. The host refused to accept to refund the money after we were unable to stay any of the booked days.   Read the reviews carefully and the host’s response cause you’ll realize this place is a scam.

Robert and Liz are amazing hosts!!!  I appreciate all of the suggestions for food and parking, definitely the conversation, all of the hospitality, the organic soaps made by Liz, and I can’t stress the comfortable beds, down pillows, and blankets. Thank you for everything!!!! I will definitely be back.

Do not go during COVID -19  I called the morning of to make sure room was ready.. we got there punch in the code and there were other people staying in the room, their luggage was there they weren’t (made my stuff feel complete unsafe from the begging) offers us an “upgrade” the upgrades too had a king size bed that was a plus.... BUT the room was not clean at all.. I walk into the bathroom and the toilet alone was dirty... VISABLY DIRTY that all one had to do was flush the toilet. So I know it was down hill from there if not even the toilet was clean and as I began to look around I realized I was right.  We had to then wait for them to clean our room which cause a delay for us to get ready which we then missed our dinner reservation. I want my $50 “cleaning fee” charge back. Honestly I feel I should get a whole refund... they don’t care about there customers at all; during COVID there is no excuse as to why you wouldn’t have someone double check to make sure these rooms are CLEAN! If it wasn’t my BF birthday I wouldn’t have been so calm, would have made sure to get a refund and not even have stayed in the city at all (From Jersey)

I would not recommend this stay to anyone. I lived in NY for a while and left a month ago. I needed to stay for a weeks work. The room's AC stopped working the last 2 nights, after indicating this to the host and after talking they hung up the phone and asked me to rather text. So I did and we went back and forth from 11pm-2:34am when I was told to crack a window. After pushing back I was given a new room, this new room's bed had what seemed like pubic hair, more hair, dust or dirt and stains, and the heater was not working!! I immediately sent the pictures to the host and they stopped replying. After waiting and waiting I was forced to pay for another hotel in order to  sleep at a decent, CLEAN room. Communication was horrible, cleanliness was not good which is KEY during a PANDEMIC. The area is good unless you walk EAST where it is sketchy, be careful.

Great location! The check-in was easy, everything has numbered locks so you don’t have to worry about a key. The apartment is close to a bunch of outstanding restaurants and bars as well as the Subway. A 15-min ride into Times Square, I cannot stress enough the advantage of the location.   There’s kitchen access with a full-sized shared bathroom in the lower floor where I stayed. There was nothing I did not like. The host also accommodated a slight delay from my side in vacating the room on check out day. Thank you!

Not kool, but Sorry you found dust under your bed but I paid more than I should've to stay in that room as long as I did and your were also paid a cleaning fee TWICE!!! Only a towel was used and I washed it. Everything else was kept untouched and the way I found it. I got complaints about nonsensical things and stood there only at night. You got your money YES,  but your greedy and in need of a psychological evaluation.  Also tell your tenants to stop asking for drugs. I'm out there smoking cigarettes not drugs. I'm ultra clean and lucid. You DON'T know or your MOST LIKELY oblivious to it, & in the future I wouldn't tell high paying air bnb guests about your HPD problems. It's not their fault while you charge 1700 for that shithole fix it! Your rude and disillusioned because a few of us gave you a nice review.  Your greedy and a bit looney.  Please don't be offended. It's constructive criticism and should be looked into.

I did not feel safe in this Airbnb. When I arrived, I had a first floor room and the window to the street was unlocked and open. This means someone could have easily come in through the window. Then the first night I was there, a man kept trying to get into my room and was repeatedly knocking on the door and jiggling the handle despite me telling him to go away multiple times. This went on for an hour as the man kept returning. I called the provided phone number and they eventually sent someone to check on my room, but I feel that this incident could have been prevented if they had someone attending to the front desk only a short walk away from my hotel room door.  I was so scared I almost did not go out that night. I don’t know how he got into the hotel, whether he was a guest or someone from the street. The same thing happened again the second night, with someone else trying to get into the room. I don’t know whether these were intentionally harmful people or guests that were just lost, but I did not feel safe as a woman traveling alone- the whole reason I booked this hotel over a typical airbnb was for the security, yet it was obvious that security was lacking.   Hotel room was clean enough but a lot of the paint was missing on the doors and furniture. It was also hard to find an outlet to charge my phone, I had to move the bed furniture to find one that I could use. Shower flooded the bathroom.   Location was great and convenient to multiple spots in the east side, but overall I would not stay here again because of how unsafe I felt.

The room was clean, bed was comfy, the shower was really nice, great water temperature and water pressure. The location was amazing - quick walks to soho, Washington square park, Greenwich area, near the Brooklyn bridge, and right next to the subway. The view on the roof was incredible. The hosts were also incredibly helpful with check-in and accessing the room when we had some phone troubles and trouble accessing our mobile phone Airbnb account. They saved us from a lot of stress!

Rob and Debbie are extremely wonderful hosts who take extra care to clean the space and make sure its spotless. They respond quickly to any concerns and take care of anything that might come up during your stay! During COVID-19, they make sure to take extra care sanitizing and cleaning common spaces and we always felt safe in their place. We stayed for three months and couldn’t have asked for better hosts. It’s a wonderful room and they are wonderful people!

Spacious bright room. Great shared space with kitchen, nice clean bathroom. The area is a bit sketchy, can be loud at times, nothing much to do around and commute to the city is not super easy (I know that's not something the hosts can control though). Really close to JFK which is a plus.
Great hosts, very responsive👍 The house is very clean and the hosts are cleaning it twice a day. Neighbourhood is a bit sketchy, but overall I would say that this airbnb has a good price-value-ratio.

This home was so nice and beautiful inside & dope to have all to yourself! I only had it for one night, but I wish I had booked my entire stay here. The neighborhood is definitely in an all black/dominican neighborhood, i loved it. Never felt unsafe, Music going, lots of people out and about, an ice cream man that comes until like midnight, plenty of stores close by, including a target about a mile away. Good food and coffee is within walking distance on Pitkin or postmates delivery. The bed was super comfortable & good fans that kept us cool. 2 nice tv's with netflix on it and i LOVED the bluetooth in the bathroom to play music while getting ready. Nice kitchen with supplies and utensils if you wanted to cook.  The lock to get inside took me awhile to figure out to get the keys, but you have to put the code in and pull the numbers pad UP. i've never used one of these before so I had no idea and was trying to pull the lock part open lol And the bolt lock didn't work, just the lock on the door knob, which made me a little uneasy but the building itself is small and super secure, and the owner said they were going to repair that soon. Other than that, everything was great!

I recently had to cancel my reservation due to unforeseen weather conditions that made travel unsafe. When I contacted the hotel to cancel my reservation and request a partial refund, as stated in their cancellation policy, I was met with unhelpful and unresponsive staff.  Despite explaining the extenuating circumstances, the hotel refused to provide a partial refund and were unwilling to work with me to find a solution. Their lack of understanding and compassion for my situation was extremely disappointing.  I will not be returning to this establishment in the future and would not recommend it to others due to their lack of understanding and unhelpful attitude in the face of unexpected circumstances.

Great find! James is readily available for any issues or concerns for a very well maintained venue. The location is prime for transport and you can go up and about your day in 5minutes. This was a steal!

My phone got wrecked on my trip and I called The Ridge to confirm I could have my replacement phone mailed there. I was told it would be no problem. But overy my stay I noticed there is never anyone at the front desk - contactless hotel. So no one was there to receive the package, which barely got there before I had to fly home. Very stressful and misleading, and when I was able to speak to a staff member, he said it's very hard to have packages delivered there.   The room was SUPER tiny, much smaller than the listing seemed. And I thought there would be a kitchen in the common space, but it was just a fridge and some drawers with plastic cups and spoons - no pots or pans or condiments or anything. More like a staff lounge at a sad corporate office.

The stay was great. The place is small and cozy! I really felt like a New Yorker! When I had trouble checking in the response was immediate! Great customer service and I would definitely stay again! The neighborhood looks scary but that’s New York for you!
Very clean and very nice! Exactly like the pictures! The neighborhood is a bit sketchy but safe and close to a metro.

This is basically a room in a house.    Pros  - Host is very friendly  - Host provides useful information  - 10 - 15 min walk to train  - Good air conditioning + ceiling fan - Good TV options  - Proximity to shopping and dining - Fridge and microwave  - Hot water  - Good wifi - 15 minute walk to Flushing Meadows Park  Cons  - Very very small shower - Room near entrance door of house  - Ants in room (quickly addressed) - No blackout curtains/shade for sleeping  - Could be noisy at times   The room is on the first floor of a house right next to the entrance door to the house so you hear the front door opening and closing and any foot traffic.  You also might hear noise above you since it is a shared house.  If there are no other guests staying in the house, it should be quieter.

I understand the price went up because I stayed right before Christmas, so there was a peak for the holiday season. However, it was definitely overpriced for what I experienced. My boyfriend and I got there around 4 PM, an hour after check-in time. Our room was not ready. There was someone cleaning the room when we got there. My boyfriend told her to take her time, but she said she was nearly done. When we went inside the room, it looked like the surfaces were still wet from being wiped. The worst thing that happened was that the bathroom's door handle broke off from the inside and we thought my boyfriend was going to be locked in. No discount. I felt like a lot of our furniture was unsteady (bedside tables and cabinets were loose). I also discovered a circle cut out of our headboard and felt very unsafe. I wanted to keep my backpack in the closet but there was barely any room. Other than that, leaving and coming in was no issue. People review and say the location is nice. You're near a park, bars, and famous eateries. They're all walking distance. Something other reviews were right about is that you can hear everything. I woke up earlier than expected because I could hear the other side of the wall.

This is my second time staying here and I cannot stress how much this place brings a sense of peace and grounding. Coupled with that is the awesome Melissa who will always do anything to make sure you have a restful stay. Hands down my favorite place. Melissa, I’m definitely coming back again. Thank you for everything!

There is a hidden jewel of an AirBnb stay right before your very eyes in an unlikely spot in Brooklyn. From the interior of the place, I thought I was in Williamsburg, but I was actually next to Crown Heights-BedStuy. Real Top Value at Crown Heights prices.  A different part of Brooklyn, I am so glad we tried it,  that I'll be back soon!  It is located on St. Marks near Ralph Ave and Atlantic. It is a convenient location and a tribute to the host.  Hosted by Melissa, this spacious one bedroom apartment occupied the entire floor on the St. Marks  address. The place was replete with tasteful art in every room, a great Grand Room (very modern Kitchen & Living Room), a terrific bathroom (with tub & delightful shower), all the standard tasteful  amenities including comfy towels, bedding, perfect interior temperature with heating and AC.  And the backyard was the perfect size with all the colors of Fall  within the view of our coffee cups. The host went out of her way to accomadte us, to provide great recommendations for fun spots to visit in the neighborhood, and the means to find Prospect Park, Citi Power Assit Bikes,  Brooklyn Museum of Art, Manhattan, JFK  airport, and the best Artichoke Pizza in Brooklyn, etc.  My only disapointment was my work got in the way of meeting the Host, Melissa. So, I'll come back for my next stay and hope I have the pleasure of meeting the architect of this little gem. I also noticed a nice TV, games  and book library, but no stereo;  we never used them because we were so busy.  So, I am going to send her a little stero as a gift after I finish this review.  Yes, it was that good a stay.  At first glance,I was afraid of the area because I had never been in this blue collar gentrifying neighborhood, felt like it might a little sketchy.  I was so wrong to doubt, so glad we took a leap of faith. If you want value, convenient location, and a very pleasant accomodation, then reach out to Melissa.  You'll be glad you did !

Very happy overall with the month stay! The apartment was very clean and was great for one person. Cute bathroom and home decor. Walkable to bus/trains and shopping area with grocery, laundry, and shops.  Maria and her husband were so pleasant and gave recommendations for items to do in Queens.  Walk is slightly long to train but the place is a steal and worth the walk. There is area street parking as well for cars. Wish there was a stove in the unit.  Would recommend and would stay again. Thanks for being a great host.

Actual living environment is different from being told. There is a strong and bad smell in the apartment . Both bedroom and bathroom are very dirty. Bedding hasn't been washed at all as they are very dusty and old. We didn't want to argue with the host as we knew it would't change the situation as we have already paid and checked-in, so we did the cleaning by ourselves and used our towels to put on top of those dirty bedding sheets. An unpleasant living environment when compared to other airbnb we stayed.

Horrible experience. Couldn’t contact the host at all. Was standing in front of the building for 3 hours and couldn’t reach out the host. Don’t even have a room number provided. Had to contact the customer service center to figure something out. It ends up canceled and i had to rebook everything in the last minute and wayyyy more expensive to pay. DO NOT DEAL WITH THIS HOST IF YOU DON’T WANT TO BE HOMELESS. THIS SHIT RUINED MY TRIP SO BAD.

Great location, close to subway! Marcos communicated with us, and day of check in allowed us to check in early. The room was everything my fiancé and I needed for a 2 night stay. The room and bed was comfortable and furnished appropriately. The bathroom had toiletries that we needed. A hair dryer and a full length mirror was in the room along with hangers and plenty of storage for our belongings. The extra storage for clothes was helpful bc the room is small as one would expect from a New York apartment. The apartment overall was clean and organized. I especially  loved the pull down shade on the window in the bedroom with dark curtains to pull close over the shade, we were able to take a nap in the daytime before a long night out, and also had plenty of light to come in during the day with shade and curtain open. We would stay here again for sure!
Host was invasive and I felt uncomfortable and stressed during my stay. The apartment was great, but not worth the stress of dealing with Vangelis

We were a group of 3 couples and having a common space was important for us to hang out so this was perfect for that! The living room is beautiful. This is a great value if you need that common space compared to a hotel.   It was mid April and each bedroom was stifling at night without sleeping with the windows open (a lot of street noise as expected in NY.) We didn’t find any portable fans in the house.
