It’s a older house and has not been renovated. There is a master bedroom with an adjoining bathroom on the second floor. Second floor also has a small bedroom with a daybed.   The third floor has 2 bedrooms with a shared full bathroom in the hall. Walking up 3 flights of stairs to the bedroom got old really fast but good exercise? (Also heat rises).  The outside area was not clean and a pile of chairs and tables on one side and usually occupied with a few stray cats.   The subway stop (A, C) is about a 7 min walk away. Grocery store is nearby. Neighborhood is urban and does not feel more unsafe than the rest of NY.   It’s also strange to me that the host does not provide shampoo or conditioner for the money we paid.   Overall would stay here again with friends for the common space. But would have preferred a hotel.

There are better options for the same price, sketchy area and unclean. Our room was not cleaned at check in, housekeeping walked in without knocking, and not comfortable. There’s options for a better price.

It was a very small, no security, neighbors were noisy then complained about me playing music, lol. The location was not bad at all just lack of security and human employees in sight. I felt unsafe but hey maybe it’s just me.
This was the perfect place to stay when visiting NYC. Very affordable, great location, and so easy to get in. It's a steal!

A wonderful city space centrally located with plenty of room. Sumita obviously cares about the comfort of her guests. Clean & comfortable with a lovely back patio, the perfect place to put your feet up after a day downtown. Just a short walk to the subway as well as plenty of restaurants & bars, local groceries & drug store. It’s always wonderful to travel with family but this unit brought it next level. It was truly memorable.

Aweful unsafe neighborhood  No lock on bedroom door Common areas unclean The host was very welcoming and nice people  Not professional  But honest people Bedroom was bearable but the rest of the house was chaotic

Had a great experience at The Ridge! COVID rules to have no in person check in made the process easier and less stressful. Room looks like the picture, but would like to remind that it was a bit small. Really nice if you don’t mind the coziness. My favorite part is the rooftop view! Overall great place and near so many bars, restaurants, etc.

The value of the stay was awesome. This place is basically a hotel with less amenities. You have to pay for daily housekeeping. The rooftop was AWESOME. It was so nice to get back from a day in the city and be able to have a beer on a rooftop with a city skyline view. The front desk was not being used (maybe because of understaffing due to covid?). The beds were a little bit uncomfortable but the room was clean. It was nice to have a mini fridge, a microwave, a tv, and a safe. The area was a little sketchy but as you walk west, it gets better. I would recommend this place, especially for what you are paying.
Check in was incredibly stressful due to unresponsive host and overall the experience was less than great.

I wanted to give this listing an excellent review, but unfortunately due to the host’s lack of hospitality, I am unable to do so.  I will state facts that pertain to this listing.  Pros - Yes, it is beautiful.  - The check in is easy - The host does respond timely Cons - photos provided in listing do not depict actual scenario as far as bedding and extra towels are concerned.  - Listing states extra bedding and pillows are provided is a false statement. There were no extra bedding or pillows and when I requested an additional comforter and some extra pillows, the host denied my request and stated it was unnecessary. I told him I would have my family who was arriving from out of the country to find additional bedding and he stated “Wonderful”.  The weather dropped to the 30’s and 20’s at night during our stay as well.  - The host provided one towel per person for 8 days and there were no additional towels as depicted in the photos.  - The fridge door would not stay closed. When I informed the host, he only stated that the last guest must of damaged it and that he would report it to Airbnb. Never did anyone come to attempt to solve the issue and we lost all the food we had placed in there.  - I saw a bug I have never seen before and sent a photo to the host. He told me it was a water bug and not dangerous. It was in fact a centipede and they do bite.  - I’m from Florida. We normally do not use our heaters. So, apparently the heater (this is what host informed was making the noise) in the house makes an extremely loud clanging noise day and night. Especially between 1am - 4am.   Andre was the most inhospitable host I’ve ever experienced on this app. The home itself was beautiful, but my trip was dampened by his actions in not providing my family and I the items necessary to sleep at night especially due to the weather being experienced. His photos of the beds and bedding provided are inaccurate as well as the towels. Do better Andre. People travel from all over the world to your home. Your guests should not have to find a bedding store close to you ( which the closest one is about 35 minutes away) because you deem it unnecessary to provide 1 extra comforter and few more pillows.

This place was easy to check in/out of, had plenty of room for 4 people and had a nice backyard. It's a little far from shops and restaurants, but there is a Dunkin right around the corner. I wouldn't stay here again personally. This place would be fine for a person to stay a night or two at most, but long term became uncomfortable.   There was a lot of little issues that added up to make this a less than great experience. I agree with a lot of the long review below, we had a lot of the same problems.   The biggest problems we had are the hallway bathroom shower does not stay hot for long at all, even with the handle turned to 100% hot, it only will stay comfortable for 5 minutes or less. Andre helped us with the installed backwards, wiggly handle, but even after his calibration it was still cold. The master shower had no problems staying hot, but the glass wall isn't long enough to keep the water inside. Whenever I put my arms up to wash my hair or something water would perfectly stream off of my arms onto the floor. Maybe this is picky but I would seriously create a huge puddle even when I tried not to.   We didn't use the bath but it's faucet isn't even connected to the floor, it can be easily rotated so that it just pours water on the ground. Most of the fixtures were totally loose. The trench drains in both showers made the bathrooms have a mild stink, the hallway bathroom being worse. The toilet seat in the master bathroom is the complete wrong size for the toilet.. how does this even happen.  The master bedroom's bed was incredibly uncomfortable, it felt like a pull out couch, it was so thin and hard. We were also only given two pillows for that bed. The additional bed was fine, still not that comfy, but they got 4 pillows total. There were no extra towels, toilet paper, blankets, paper towels or washcloths. But when we asked we were quickly given extra tp and paper towels. The only extra bedding "might be dirty" A week isn't the longest stay in the world but I don't understand why there aren't refills for everything just available in the closest? We each got 1 towel and 1  washcloth for the week.   The fridge was broken at the time of our stay, and it looks like the previous guests had the same problem. The gasket is damaged so it cannot stay closed. He told us it would be fixed the day we left so hopefully it's fine now. I at least wish we were given a heads up or a brick to keep the door shut lol.  Another nit pick but why are there only 4 mugs (one chipped) for a place that can hold 6 people? The whole place felt like I was supposed to bring my own stuff from home. I have no idea how that other reviewer "made thanksgiving dinner" here, we didn't even want to cook eggs on the cheap nonstick pans. I didn't expect le Creuset but those pans really just exist to be able to check the "full kitchen" box on Airbnb.    The neighborhood was quiet at night and the closest station is about a 6 minute walk. Brooklyn proper is about 20-30 minutes away door to door and to the Museums in Manhattan is about 50+ minutes. This place was honestly a bit too far away from everything for me, and is really only close to the A and C lines. The other lines are a pretty long walk away. I looked this up beforehand but for people who aren't used to The Big City it was hard to really know the scale. Just a heads up for my fellow bumpkins.  Maybe I'm bougie but I thought I was paying for bougie amenities and it was like staying in a Days Inn that was painted a nice shade of green.
Amazing location, even more amazing rooftop! Room is definitely tiny but who cares. Bed is definitely uncomfortable, but otherwise this place is a total steal!

My boyfriend and I stayed at the Ridge so we could see around nyc and experience the nightlife, and although we planned on spending next to no time in the room, the time we did stay was pretty unpleasant.  The room looks similar to the photos, but there were quite a few things that made our stay uncomfortable.  First of all, the bed was super hard. They gave us three very flat pillows between two of us.  Also, it was shockingly noisy. Not just street noise but the walls were super thin and you could hear everyone in the middle of the night. We’re both pretty heavy sleepers and not a night went by where we weren’t woken up.  The bathroom only had two bath towels and one hand towel and no bath mat, and so the floor was always wet, and since they don’t come in to clean it got really gross quickly.  The location was close to the subway and near other attractions, which was definitely the best part. But we would not stay here again.

CSTM Haus was the perfect location for our small wedding reception. The team was super helpful in setting everything up and answering all of our questions, the space itself is incredible and also comes with all necessary rentals which made everything really stress-free. Our guests also enjoyed the speakeasy-style entrance to the space. We all had such a wonderful time and can’t wait to host our next event there!
Maria is an angel. She is so kind helpful and goes a above and beyond to make sure you are comfortable. The parking is a little sketchy, but Maria always manage to find me a spot always.

PLEASE KNOW:  there is NO DOOR or LOCK for the upstairs living space you are renting out. Based on the listing, my roommate and I were under the assumption the downstairs and upstairs were two units in one building with secured living areas. This was not the case. This is one house with an upstairs and downstairs that anyone could freely walk through without you knowing long as they have a key to the home. People lived downstairs during my stay and after realizing the scary situation we didn't have the funds to relocate. Apparently at one point someone from downstairs came to my upstairs area and put their food & drinks in the mini fridge and this made me very uncomfortable. The only lock I could depend on was my bedroom. There is no lock or door stopping people from downstairs going upstairs to use things, steal, or physically be in the space upstairs. I also thought we had a separate entrance but no. You share the same entrance as the people downstairs. As a young woman, I didn't feel comfortable or safe. Other than security & safety that wasn't 100% clear beforehand, the location was near great restuarants.

Although María is quite charismatic and responds to any need you have, the hygiene of the place is a little bad (7/10), there were fleas in the room and in the refrigerator we found a cockroach along with the presence of other insects in the bathroom, I suppose it is due to the heat wave that these insects emerge, even so it is an unpleasant presence to see in places where hygiene has to take precedence. Beyond that the place is good for its price and a location close to the metro.

DO NOT BOOK!!  I requested to book this place for 1wk for a work related trip to help out with the covid crisis in NYC. I received 1 message from the host that approved my request to stay and accepted my payment. He requested that I provide him with my travel arrangements so I could get access to the location when I arrived.   I provided him with all travel plans and updated him accordingly. Not one single response; for several days. I was worried something was up but I had no choice as this was for my job. The day of my flight I tried multiple times to contact him before during and after I landed. No reply. The phone number on the profile went straight to voicemail. The address to the location that was once available was no longer there.   I was stranded at the airport with nowhere to go or stay during a pandemic. And out nearly $700. I had to pay for a hotel that night; which several were booked up due to the increased amount of travel healthcare professionals in the area.   In order to receive a refund I had to contact air bnb and file a complaint and was on the verge of filing a police report for scam.   Long story short after several hoops and lots of my valuable time lost I was told I would get a refund. This was around 9pm I believe. It has been 2 days and the refund has yet to be processed back into my account.   Save yourself the trouble; book elsewhere.

Hello, thank you for you time. I am thankful this was available and close by to my Grandmother. Thank you for the top notch communication. During my stay I noticed it to be over cluttered and the bathroom are very poorly maintained! Cleanliness was definitely a negative, seeing motor oil jugs, dead dog pics and soooooooooo many personal items made me feel uneasy. The light in the bathroom also turns off mid shower- which will creep TF out of anyone!!   I hope you take into consideration that client are expecting a space for themselves not some corner of your house that looks like family is coming not a stranger! clothes, just iunk everywhere. I didnt appreciate that.   I only showered once to prevent any more time in the bathroom.   Thank you for being kind! -TM

Great location and the roof porch has a great view north toward midtown.  There are wonderful cafe's, bars and venues within only a few blocks and the subway is just around the corner.  You will hear every word of any conversation happening in the hallways and the doors slam if not held when closed but luckily everyone was very quiet at night when I was there.  The room was clean expect the shower gutter which was full of hair and other things I'd rather not think about.  Also don't expect any art on the walls in your room.  At least in mine it had been stolen or taken down.

This place was a good option for accomodation in NYC. There is a great view from the pleasant roof terrace, good wifi in the room and generally good amenities. The area is quite vibrant with good food options etc. The communication was mixed, with some messages responded to and others ignored. According to their listing, check in info is supposed to be sent 24 hours in advance but was not. I called them and was reassured it would arrive that day but still it did not and in the end it only arrived after me sending further mesaages and e-mails. I found this quite stressful as i wanted to receive this info before leaving the UK.

The location is very convenient, closed to whole food and train station. There are some restaurants and bars around. The check-in process is very easy and the email response is prompt. The price is fair. But if you are a light sleeper, you will find noise very loud at night because there is a bar downstairs across the stress. Also, soundproof is horrible and you can hear people talking very loud in the hallway. There are lots of dust in the vents/AC. The ceiling in the bathroom is failing apart. Additionally, the room is very small me and my boyfriend are 5 feet 6 and we just could turn around without knocking things down. But overall, it is decent in NYC.

Had a great stay here, this is a fantastic location in the East village with some great places to eat a very short walk away. Daniel was very welcoming and suspect if we had have needed him for anything he would have been all over it. Family of 3 stayed including a child age 9.

Adam's place was wonderful! I feel like we found a real gem. The neighborhood had tons of amenities within walking distance; we especially appreciated the delicious late-night vegetarian burritos from Natural Market just up the block. The apartment itself was clean, spacious and very comfortable. Having a kitchen during our stay in NYC likely saved us a ton of money and time in the mornings, and the HVAC made for GREAT sleeping during the heat wave. Walking to and from the subways was no problem at all; it's maybe 10 or 12 blocks and really straightforward. Adam was very communicative and easy to contact when we had a question. Other reviews mention the tiny bathroom sink, but don't let that scare you: the kitchen sink is huge and just in the other room. The price also felt totally reasonable. I really can't recommend this place enough and hope that we're able to book it on future visits.
Very easy and stress free checkin and check out. Great location!
Place did not look like pictures, especially the bathroom. Bed was unpleasant and common areas were not well maintained or cleaned.

The experience was not the best, you need to work hard in cleaning the apartment.  It doesn't require investing a lot of money, but it definitely requires having more commitment for guests to have a good time.  Specifically, one of the rooms was very dirty, the bed, sheets and pillows smelled very bad.  The bathroom was also not clean, with underground spaces and unpleasant odors.  Finally, the building smells like cat urine.  It is a matter of cleanliness and commitment to guests.

We stayed 5 nights in this place. We are a little bit balanced :   The flat is very comfy, newly and very well renovated, very clean... almost every thing you can expect for such a stay and feel like home. John and his wife are very nice and willing to help too.  On the other hand,  it is a quite noisy place (1 room is facing the 9th avenue, and the AC - very good to have AC 😀- engine is keeping the window open), so you really need some time to fall asleep, or can be awaken hardly by a police car, or a truck... not very convenient if you are a “light” sleeper. It was ok for me, less for my wife to be honest.  Then, we were probably not so lucky, as a group of 4-6 homeless guys (and taking drugs) have decided to stay every night in front of the door of the building. Even if they were not violent, when you are with kids and wife, this obviously gives some “unsecured” feeling....but nothing happened, so just live with it...  Overall, this was a very good stay, and we enjoyed our week in the city.

Stayed at Joan’s place for one month with our family and 5 children.  We had a wonderful time. The park across the street is a HUGE bonus. Great spot for our kids to blow off some steam. Good basketball court, tennis court and playground.   The neighborhood appears safe and secure to us. There are a few bad streets on your way to the Kingstoop Throops metro entrance but overall we never felt threatened or unsafe and we used public transportation every day. We would recommend using Utica Ave Metro stop instead.   The house was a wonderful setup for our crew. Kitchen downstairs was well equipped and we cooked at least one meal per day their. It had everything we needed. The 2nd level master was great for the parents and the additional 3 bedrooms provided plenty of space for our kids.   Joan was super easy to work with. Quick on communication and her house was lovely. Would recommend to others looking for a short or long stay in the Bedstuy area.
The location is on a very busy intersection so be prepared for traffic and honking. New Yorkers are not afraid to lay on the horn, even at midnight and 6am in the morning.

Amazing stay over all! Everything was super clean, all essentials were provided for, and the space itself is very comfortable. As a young female I was scared at first with where the place is located but thankfully I never experienced any scary situations. Would recommend!

This is a steal of a room for a trip to NYC. I was pleasantly surprised by how much I enjoyed the apartment. It actually felt a little bigger in person than from what I could see on the ad.  Livia was super accommodating and even let us use her umbrella because there was a surprise storm for part of our stay.  I couldn’t have had a better overall experience.

Kerri and John are lovely. Communication has been excellent. The apartment is great for 4 people. Not for five. The sofa is uncomfortable. There is a supermarket 2 minutes walk from Brooklyn Fare, but it is worth walking a little further and going to The Whole Foods in Hudson Yards, it is huge!! The location is perfect, very close to Tmes Square, but you will have to live with a large number of Homeless and drunk people. Sometimes we found some of us sleeping at the entrance of the building. That's what it's like to be in this neighborhood. But this isn't Kerri's fault.  I hope we can repeat it in the future.

My host Shakima is a very nice and eco friendly person. All the place was kept really clean, neat and beautiful everyday. The bedroom, kitchen, living room and bathroom was really clean. She cleaning all the place almost everyday. I felt little dangerous to waling around at night time but it doesn't matter. I wish i could stay there for the next time:)

It’s rare for me to write a bad review but this one really deserves one. Shakima’s place is in a very unsafe part of bed-stuy (and I’ve lived in the alphabet city before...).  Shakima‘s greeting was “take your shoe’s off, i’m a clean freak and we have customers come in for my detox business”. Then she asked me to not touch the towels in the bathroom as they were decorative and to keep the toilet seat down at all time again the customers are very sensitive... I was pretty confused but figured maybe the room will make up for such a treat of a host...The bed was small, squeaky and hard as a rock. Unlike the professionally taken photos, the apartment was dark and smelled like a yoga studio...Then her super loud blender started working which sounded like a jet engine. I thought if that’s just the beginning, i don’t want to see how it’s going to end. I got out of there immediately and only got half of my money back. A word of advice, always read “all” of the reviews, and document when things seem wrong so you can at least get your money back when you have experiences like the one i did

Hello Rosaly,  We are happy to stay two nights in your home. The room is clean and warm. And also you are very helpful and answer our question so quickly. And you are so nice. The only thing is a little bit scared when walked around the street at night time. I know this is not your problem.  Thank you very much and enjoy your life!

The space is conveniently located near several public transit options. It’s a bedroom in Pengfei’s apartment. The room is clean and there is decent space. It’s close enough to LaGuardia that one might hear planes fly by, but the plus is that it’d be a good option for travelers the night before a flight. Pengfei is friendly and responsive. One thing I will note is that the shower switches back and forth from warm to cold to hot, etc... but I didn’t mind too much. Also, I would recommend double checking with the host regarding the check-out time, in case it changes. When I booked, check out time said 1pm. When I arrived, Pengfei asked when I planned on checking out, and even though I said a time before 1pm, he said it wouldn’t work. There must have been a communication barrier because he repeated this when I asked “what time should I leave by?” It was very stressful for me not to know he might need the room back earlier ahead of time, especially since I’m flexible and always work with hosts to be out in time. It was stressful trying to do that, then being told “this is not going to work.” However, I rushed to leave as soon as feasible the next morning and things ended up working out. To avoid stress, I’d definitely recommend overcommunicating to make sure everyone has the same expectations before check-in day arrives.

Better than expected and super clean! I really enjoyed my stay here. Jabari and his sister (who lives in the same building) are very lovely and accommodating. With two a/c units in the unit, I had a very comfortable stay. I've seen previous comments about it being in a bad area, but I found it great and full of life. Everyone in the building and area was very nice and at no time did I feel "unsafe".

First I must say Jabari was great host. I booked this unit extremely last minute but he came through for me. It was very clean and comfortable. I had no issues getting around. Nor did I feel unsafe. All and all I had a great time and will be back. Thank you again Jabari

I spent a month at Jabari's airbnb for a medical rotation at St. Barnabas. It worked out perfectly. It's a colorful neighborhood and I never felt unsafe. Everyone was friendly in the building and neighborhood. There are some great food places and it's walkable to Arthur St. I also walked to the NY Botanic Gardens and Bronx Zoo. The Tremont subway station is around the corner and it was very easy to get downtown. Jabari was very nice and checked-in regularly. The apartment itself is larger than I expected, has a washer machine and dishwasher, and the kitchen has pretty much everything you need to make a meal. I was definitely comfortable and it felt homey while I was there for the month. Highly recommend.

Very close to everything!! Good access to the metro and the bus that drops you off at La Guardia airport. Rosaly is very very kind and will make you feel like family. The apartment is clean, the bathroom is a little small for all my creams hahaha and it was very hot when I took a bath, the neighborhood is good, quiet. It has good restaurants, but sometimes there are people on the street that scared me, but police pass by so it's safe.

We stayed at David's for 5 days and everything was great! The typically New York apartment has a lot of charm, impeccable cleanliness and nicely decorated. The bedding was very comfortable, we slept well. The neighborhood is lively but safe. The accommodation is located a few minutes from the metro and then it takes around 20 minutes to reach Times Square (express line).  And finally David is a great host! He welcomed us in the middle of the night (late flight, shuttle delay) and was very accommodating throughout the stay. We will definitely come back!!  I recommend this accommodation 100% if you also want to stay in NY without breaking the bank.

It is a private room of an apartment. I stayed here with my girlfriend for 3 nights.  Owner: Rosaly is a thoughtful and nice person. She was very caring and made sure we were having a great stay. Room: The bedroom and restroom are clean, better than my expectation. Bed was soft, linen smelled great. The room has an AC. Location: Many would be worried about the location. Yes, It is in the middle of Harlem. However, her location is 5 mins away from 125th street, the downtown of Harlem. I felt safe around 11 pm. If you see Starbucks and open stores around 11pm, it is not dangerous.  Overall, I would love to visit her place again next time.  P.S. 'Red Rooster' restaurant nearby. It is the best comfort food restaurant. You don't wanna miss it. It is only 5 mins away.

Excellent host, very friendly, the apartment is very clean and has everything you need to be comfortable, the little dog that lives with him is a sweetheart, it is an excellent place to spend the nights after touring the city, although it is a little far away and looks a little dangerous, nothing happened to us.  I recommend the room for young people who can walk and spend all day outside because of the distance and many stairs.  But excellent host and place!

A nice place but a few unsettling things.   1. I entered the property and there was a panel missing in the couch that was then duct taped into place. I thought nothing of it and it didn’t bother me as I didn’t spend time in the living room. However after my stay the owner tried to charge me for the couch which I obviously disputed. I texted him and he finally admitted that a previous guest made the hole and apologized. I wonder how many poor souls he tried to charge and they gave their money to him to save the headache. Furthermore I assume that the $300 he attempted to steal from me for the couch was charged to the real culprit who broke the couch. The money obviously wasn’t used to fix the damage but instead just duct tape it back together. Again further dishonesty  2. There’s a camera inside the apartment watching you.   3. The bathtub is clogged up and doesn’t drain.   Actually a nice place to stay but due to greed of the owner ,and humans’ insatiable need to get more and more from anyone and everyone, it left a bad taste in my mouth. He did admit to his wrongdoings but feel this review is necessary so he doesn’t try and pull it on any other lodgers that pay him very good money for his apartment.

Our stay here was an amazing experience! We were kinda of scared since it was our first time trying Airbnb. My family and I felt like home! Everything was clean, we had everything we needed and Joe was very hospitable giving us tips on the area.  When he was busy he had a friend check up on us. There is a close by grocery store and subway is super close! Being in a safe area was a plus! Definitely will Stay here again when I come to NYC! Thanks Joe!

Good location, a couple blocks from the subway in Brooklyn.  Area can be a little sketchy at night, but just be aware of your surroundings like any other big city.  Check in was a little bit hectic due to crisis that the owner was going through with his wife but other than that everything else went smooth.

The host is great and very accommodating. This was our 2nd time staying in this apartment.  This time we stayed for approx 3 weeks during the summer.  We have a 2 year old toddler, so this review is from the perspective of parents with a small child.   While the location of the apartment is amazing for bars, restaurants, and for generally soaking up the Lower East Side of Manhattan, I would say it isn't ideal for parents toting around a stroller. The apartment is situated adjacent to a great deal of drug dealing/using.  It's out in the open all hours of the day/night.  Not a big deal I suppose for NYC, and we pretty much felt safe the whole time, but I can't recommend it in good faith for those with small children, especially if you have plans to walk around at night.  We were there in the full heat of summer.  The bedrooms have dedicated A/C units and get very comfortable/cold if needed.  There's no A/C in the bathroom.  The common area, which has the kitchen, living area, and ample dining room table, has an A/C unit.  During the day, the coldest the area would get was in the mid 80's, so that area was very uncomfortable during the day.  At night we could get it to cool down a bit, but that area was definitely an issue for us, something to consider if you are heat-sensitive.  The apartment is on the top floor.  Our toddler played in the apartment and pretty much be a kid, dance around, run, etc...  This caused a disturbance to the downstairs neighbor who complained a few times to us.  We felt bad about it, and tried to contain our kid as much as possible, but since he's a toddler it proved to be an issue for us.  So all in all, I'd say avoid the apartment if traveling with kids.  I'd recommend it highly for say, a young couple or young group wanting to explore the Lower East Side for a few days.

The location: Located in a shady neighborhood, far east of Brooklyn near New Lots subway station. Takes a 5 min walk to get there. Easy to get around during day time but after sunset becomes very shady. Even though we did not have any personal untoward experience, made us feel very uncomfortable to walk from the station to the apartment. Cabbies, Subway train drivers and anybody we spoke to rolled their eyes when they heard we were living in New Lots Avenue area. They warned us multiple times and asked us to play safe. We were provided with one open spot for parking in the backyard. It takes at least an hour to get to Manhattan (No. 3 train) and even longer on the weekend when many trains get canceled. I would not recommend staying here with family (women and elderly) if you are planning to commute via subway only because of safety issues and the longish commute.  The apartment: Excellent, clean, spacious, great amenities. Felt like home while we were inside!

Joseph received us with great kindness and availability, fresh and washed fruit, fresh bread, juice, milk... awaited us after the flight. The house is spacious and pleasant in a nice neighborhood, very close to the New Lots Avenue metro station and also close to the airport. A very well stocked supermarket is directly opposite the house which is very convenient, with amazing shelves of high quality fresh fish, fruit, vegetables and meats. It is a very pleasant house to live in.

Very pleasant, clean and comfortable accommodation. Very close to the metro but still 45 minutes from Wall Street. Impossible to make several return trips during the day. Joseph made us very welcome despite the delay of our flight. He was available and attentive from the beginning to the end of the stay. We recommend it 200%!

Great place!  Super clean and very spacious appartment and a comfy home away from home.  Parking space on site is a plus.    As for location, the subway station (New Lots) is a 4 min walk and is very convenient.  The ride can feel a bit long after a exhausting day of walking the streets in Manhattan.  Late nights and week-ends lines are all mixed-up and it takes even more time to get back home.  (Close to 1h45min from Times Square).  The neibourghood can feel a bit shady at night but is still quiet.    Our family loved staying at Joe’s and we would recommend his place.  Thank you Joseph

Kate and Mark were very kind,  intentional, attentive hosts. The location is perfect, steps away from the A express but also BCD trains. Hamilton Park is quite possibly the most serene part of Harlem with a great community feel, great restaurants and coffee and amazing people. My only tip is the apartment is a garden floor apartment that faces north/south which means it’s naturally dark. Fantastic when you want to sleep in, very difficult when it’s time to get up. Fully stocked, furnished, spacious apartment perfect for long term stays. I am a woman traveling alone and never felt unsafe in the neighborhood. Unit is locked behind 3 doors. I will stay at this place again for my next long term stay!

The apartment is in fact squeaky clean, using the word “spotless” in the description is really no exaggeration! This is the cleanest apartment we ever rented! The beds are great, better than any hotel bed I ever slept in, and I have stayed in some pretty expensive hotels.  Our host Joe was extremely nice, professional, and maintained perfect communication throughout our stay.  At first sight, the neighborhood seems a bit shady, with a lot of trash in the streets and some trashy houses. However, keep in mind this is New York City. On the plus side, the neighborhood was surprisingly quiet during the night, more to that at the end.  The available parking spot behind the house is priceless! The subway line 3 will take you straight to Manhattan in about 35 minutes and is just a 5 minute walk from the apartment to the station.  We gave this apartment a five star rating and it absolutely deserves it in every aspect. However, I don’t think I would stay there again because we had extremely noisy upstairs neighbors with stomping, dropping things, moving stuff etc. every night until 3:30am. After three nights, we finally decided to contact Joe to ask them to be a bit more considerate, which he immediately did. Unfortunately, that night was the worst. I can only hope that the host will reflect this behavior in the other guests’ review. We probably just had bad luck with having these people above us, and these issues are beyond the host’s control. However, if you are a light sleeper, make sure to bring a white noise generator or ear plugs – just in case.  P.S.: If the upstairs apartment is similar to this one and available, I would definitely come back!!!

great neat, clean apt & centrally located to where we were visiting!  lots of shops and restaurants nearby too!  (our favourite is a fun family friendly bar called the hop shop that serves food  in their beer garden!) our only issue was one of the bedrooms was without a window shade at the time and our kids were woken quite early by the sunlight.  overall check in/out was a breeze and we were quite happy with our stay!
The truth is I had to go out, I didn't like it at all, the smell of marijuana is terrible and the area is not safe, I was almost attacked, very dangerous.

What a wonderful home, excellent location when it comes to the NYC subway and very great grocery store right across the street. I'm a runner, and there was a wonderful public track just a few blocks away place a great Planet Fitness nearby. This is NYC, of course, but we weren't expecting trash everywhere in the neighborhood. It was a sad situation and not the owner's fault. Their place and yard were spotless. Having the off road parking was a game changer. There is street parking, but you must move your car several times a week due to street cleaning rules. We never felt unsafe, just so sad for the messy neighborhood.

They are a great family. You can understand yourself in Spanish. They make your stay as easy as possible. The area is far from the center but has very good access by metro. It is not a dangerous area at all. It's impressive to see the people on the street, their way of dressing and those slightly shabby shops, but in general they are very friendly people. Also, being a Dominican neighborhood you can understand each other in Spanish. The apt. It is just as you see it in the photos. You have to go down a staircase to access it. The entrance is separate from Sharon's house and is a two-bedroom apartment in the basement. I took a single room. I was lucky and the girl who occupied the other one was very nice and clean. You share the kitchen, the bathroom, the living room. It doesn't have windows facing the street, but in reality when you arrive what you want is tranquility and you find that. It has a huge TV with a connection to Netflix.  When you arrive exhausted with some takeout, it's nice to relax and watch a movie on demand.  I have been for work, so I got to the apartment. It was a pleasure.  It is recommended, I hope that so much effort involved in managing an apartment like this in B&B and in NY does not take away from the desire and know-how of this family, who are doing very well.

We were offered a different roomvas host had to accommodate another guest due to an emergency. Electrical outlets in our room were not properly insulated and they were hanging from the wall. Bronx area was little shady.
This place is exactly what is described. I loved my stay here. It's very private and comfortable. Beware mosquitoes are very lively so be ready to be attacked if your aren't prepared.

Thanks Sharon for the stay!   The good: The place is nice inside, you can see that it was recently restored and almost everything works correctly. The double bed was very comfortable, but the one I had, the other one I tried and I didn't like it. The carpeted floor, beautiful. The kitchen is super good. The location is acceptable, you are 35-40 from Time Square.   The bad: I didn't have keys to my room, a danger. The room is in the basement, I expected something else.  It has no windows, so there was no good air circulation. In the bathroom there was a leak from the ceiling, there was a constant musty smell and pieces of wood were falling. One night at 2 am the fire alarm went off and I got up suddenly to turn it off, it was nothing, just a false alarm... Likewise, Sharon was always available to me and is very kind and the small problems she has are very easy to improve.   Thank you very much too!!  Tano

This was my 2nd time at Grant's. It's an adorable little spot, and pretty spacious for one guest. It has a basic kitchen, which was very clean with your usual cutlery. I didn't do any cooking since the place is so close to many restaurants, cafes, 24hr diners and drug stores. The bathroom is bright and clean, although some will call it small.   The bedroom has a great tv with awesome cable. The bedroom has a window air conditioner, which is a must for the summer. The bed is comfortable, with soft sheets. The wifi is reliable and pretty fast. There's also a desk and a couch, so there's plenty of space to relax in. The neighbourhood feels very safe, even at night, and I say this as a small-town girl! The space is also pretty quiet at night. I have literally no complaints!  Grant messaged me to make sure I was doing okay part way through my trip. He's a wonderful host. I'll stay here again, and again!

We were three French exchange-students living at Lamee's place. It was truly perfect. The location is 15 minutes walk to many subways (A, C, M, J, Z...), which is great to reach easily any place in New York. The neighbourhood is really safe, we stood for 3 months and came home late sometime. We never felt in danger or anything, quite the opposite! Also, Lamee is here to help. We faced ant's invasion but all products needed were already provide by the host. I would 100% recommend this place. It is not the more modern but all you need for your stay is here.

Valentina, her sister, and her mom were all wonderful.   They did everything they could to make my stay a pleasant one.     When the AC broke, Valentina quickly ordered a fan to be delivered within a day.  When the package with fan was stolen, she bought another.  She really was considerate and cared about my comfort.    The apartment, conveniently close to Coney Island hospital, was pretty quiet (I am sensitive to noise and was very happy about this.).   On the fire escape the birds (mostly pigeons) greeted me every day.  The view from Valentina's is of the green space between two buildings.  For this country woman, it felt like a little piece of nature and made me feel more "at home".    Although there is an elevator in the building, if you are looking for wheelchair accessibility, this is not your place (unless I missed a secret passage ramp in the basement which leads to the elevator, there are some pretty steep stairs to get to the 1st floor where the entry door is.)    Thank you Valentina for an excellent 9-night stay!

Valentinas was nice and place was convenient to Coney Island with a modern look, enjoyed seeing the pigeons on the fire escape.  I was however shocked to find it had cockroaches and I was sooo grossed out!   It’s nice her mom greets you but she cannot speak English which was not helpful it was stressful.  We had to ask for towels, TP and garbage bags since there was no extra provided and we were there for the weekend.  Her mother did come with garbage bags but that’s it.  Honestly this place is in extreme need of updating, the sink is leaking and buckling in bathroom, tiles falling off, paint peeling off, door locks were broken.  We made the best of it as where else could we go such short notice and it was my boyfriend birthday!

We had a wonderful time with Han and Denyce and we didn't miss anything. We were completely looked after and enjoyed our holiday very much. Every question was answered immediately, they always had good tips for us and there were more than enough towels. They looked after us very kindly, but were never intrusive. We also felt very safe and comfortable in the area. Only the length of the drive to Manhattan could be a deterrent if you have a short vacation and a tight schedule. Depending on where you want to go, it can take 45-60 minutes. We stayed for 2 weeks and had no stress. And at night it is very quiet, meaning you can sleep well and rest. We didn't care about the travel time, but the peace and quiet was more important. It also allows you to get to know the real life of New Yorkers. We can therefore absolutely recommend Han and Denyce's accommodation and would book again at any time.

This apartment is PERFECT. Clean, sleeps four, with a kitchen (and snacks as well as fresh milk!) and even a backyard to relax in. A private bedroom for parents and a pullout for the kids in the living room made this a super family friendly place to stay. Han and Denyce were the best hosts with tons of communication…they had tips on transportation, places to see and their neighbourhood. I really couldn’t have asked for better hosts in an unfamiliar city. Super quick response times and just really considerate, this apartment has everything you need to have a great vacation. Two different subway line stops just blocks away made getting around really easy as well. Thank you so much for making an incredible trip even better. I felt like I had a haven to return to each night after full days in the city.  For anyone who has read things about getting catfished by AirBnb listings, this is the real deal and was exactly as described/pictured. There were no unpleasant surprises :)

Me and my friend loved our stay here! The hosts are, even though we didn’t get the chance to meet them, very welcoming, nice and sweet. The communication was on point from start and we got all the information about the apt and keys, the area, tips about food and the metro etc. I wasn’t afraid of asking any questions and the answers came quickly. When we arrived to the apt, it was music playing and they had bought us some food. Due a flight strike, we came a day later and left a day longer then we had originally booked, but they were very flexible and didn’t crave any extra money. The apt looked steady, clean and was filled with all sorts of supplies for food making and for the shower. We couldn’t have asked for a better stay and host! We really recommend Han and Denyce!

Our first experience with AirBnb was good: Donald is a very nice person. He did his best to make our trip very pleasant. For example, we expected to arrive at Donald's home when he was at work so he let us his keys with explanation to avoid waiting. He is very discreet and quiet. He advised us a lot. His flat is near the line 5 of the subway but it's quite far from Manhattan (35-40 minutes).The neighbourhood is safe.  It's a one-room flat so we slept in the bedroom and Donald slept in the couch. It's a bit disturbing because we were afraid of bothering Donald especially when we got up early to visit New York. There are a lot of plants even in the room, there is also an aquarium in the room that is quite noisy.

for those looking for an economical option to get to NY in a place that is not dangerous at all. Close to the train station, very well connected to Manhattan (approximately forty-five minutes). Donald is a very kind and calm person, he left the apartment at our disposal almost all the time. We use it only to rest and take a good bath. I recommend it.

Donald seemed really sweet. We never met but his flexible check in and check out was super helpful for me. The location is not ideal if you're going to downtown but the neighborhood is nice and close to the nice parts of the Bronx. I would recommend for travelers who aren't afraid of the trains and need an affordable place in the city. Clean and a good deal for the city.

Donald is a great host, always concerned with guiding and helping those of us who stay in his apartment. The place is comfortable for resting, it is close to subway lines that take approximately an hour to reach the most emblematic places in the center of Manhattan. In addition, the neighborhood has a wide variety of services and commerce. The neighborhood is not dangerous to travel at night and has 24-hour metro service. The commercial establishments start operating very early in the morning.
Clean place, but in a noisy and perceptually unsafe location.

Check-in and communication with the host were easy. Location can make you feel unsafe at first but it is a really nice neighborhood with kind people. Privacy is a positive aspect of this place.  The hoster gives you water bottles and chocolate at the check-in. The room needs better curtains because it is so bright even in the night. The mattress has a plastic cover that makes every movement a noisy problem during the night. The host gives you clean bedsheets and towels. The bathroom cleanliness is 7/10. You can lock the house but you can not lock your room and, during my stay, I saw different people in the house, besides the host. There is no Wifi included. Although you pay a cleaning fee, you are asked to get rid of the bathroom and bedroom trash. Considering the price it was a good choice and I recommend it.
Good but the area is a little dangerous at night, even more if you're a woman.

The space is so quaint and lovely. The bed is a mattress on the floor, and although that seems like it might be hip, it was still a very comfortable bed - firm but plush on top.  The bathtub was great. Hot water a plenty, good shower pressure. CLEAN! There are no washcloths, so bring some of those if you use them. There is one blackout curtain and one sheer makeshift curtain, but it was dark enough for us to sleep. Neighborhood lively enough during the day, but quiet at night. Lots of artists in the area. We felt completely safe. There was space in the kitchen for us to use - we wish we would have cooked! Diana allowed the A/C to be turned down to 72 degrees, which was great for me since I run hot, especially at night. Great location close enough to the L & M lines, close to Myrtle & Broadway. A little sketchy there, but we had no issues. The washer and dryer next door are convenient, though the washer doesn’t spin the water all the way out, so drying takes longer, but it wasn’t a big deal and we were just glad there were laundry facilities on the premises. Can’t wait to stay with Diana again. Enjoyed her musical instruments and art everywhere!!! Such a friendly & kind person.

Diana and Perla are very welcoming and great chefs! The home is clean and you can find everything you need for your staying (an italian coffee machine too!). The neighborhood is quiet, the closest metro stop late at night made us feel a little unsafe sometimes but we never had problems. Around there are a lot of shops and bars to enjoy your stay and if you are lucky you'll have good live music at home by the owners :)

This location is fantastic! It was a Daddy daughter trip so I let my daughter pick the place, when I saw where it was I felt it might be too far out and I wanted to be more central. But, since she picked it I thought I should go with it.  My daughter picked a winner! and here are the highlights: Within 3 minutes walking distance are a grocery store, 2 laundromats, a drug store, the Morris-Jumel Mansion and most importantly.... the subway entrance! Jennifer's apartment is in a Dominican Republic neighborhood with lots of character also some Cuban and Italian spots, with lots of friendly people. There are plenty of bakeries, restaurants, and interesting spots to visit.  The apartment is located under Jennifer and Brad's apartment, it is very clean and plenty big, the bedrooms are small but private, with a fancy new bathroom in-between. There is plenty of storage and all the basic necessities for the kitchen are provided. We really loved staying here and we will be back. Jeff and Sara from Austin Texas.

We stayed here while a family member had surgery at New York-Presbyterian Hospital.  It was very convenient to the hospital -- about a 12 minute walk.  It was also super convenient to a grocery store, a Rite Aid drug store, and a laundromat.  The apartment was very clean, exactly as described, and located on a cute street.  We arrived during a historic cold snap, and Jennifer went to heroic lengths to find a space heater so that we would be warm enough.  It was a great experience.  Thank you!
Great place. Had everything we needed. Neighborhood was a bit scary for late night.

Lynn’s place was perfect for my NYC trip! She is a very generous and kind host, I didn’t get to interact with her that much but when I did she made me feel very welcome and comfortable. The living area and bathroom were both very clean which I really appreciate, so be sure you are tidy as well! The bed was a bit short but to be fair I’m a tall girl lol so I think this is only relevant for taller ones renting the space. The area was safe and convenient too I could walk anywhere comfortably and the subway station was minutes away, I never felt unsafe or not secure in her apartment or in the neighborhood. This is a great airbnb to stay in for a solo trip and a great hostess on top of that!

Lynn was so helpful and supportive, and her room is good location. I was worried about midnight sound from the Bar as her mention, it was certainly noisy, but I could sleep well by using earplugs and sleep-inducing drugs. And, it was difficult for me to use the outside door’s key which was needed tips, but Lynn always helped me. The Mexican food recommended from her was delicious!

Lynn stayed awake until late waiting for me; still she had a smile on her face when she welcomed me to her house. It is true that the bar downstairs is really noisy, but around 2 the music stopped and I slept like a baby. The house is charming and I found the bed really comfortable :) (The neighborhood was indeed a bit scary at night)
Pierce's place is bright, spacious, and perfectly located. What a steal for the location! He was very accommodating with check in and check out. We had an amazing time.

WORST PLACE TO STAY EVER I GOT SCAMMED SHE TOLD ME TO LEAVE AFTER 3 HOURS OF BEING THERE SHE ACCUSED ME OF SMOKING WHICH I WASNT AND THERES NO PROOF AND SHOWER DOSENT EVEN COME ON, THERES NO PRIVACY DO NOT STAY HERE SHULLY AND HER HUSBAND WERE BEING RACIST
After a last minute cancelation from another listing, John saved the day with quick responses and a same day check in! He made what was a very stressful situation incredibly easy.

Accuracy - 2 Cleanliness - 3 Check-In - 5 Communication - 4 Location - 4 Value - 2  We reserved this space for a group of 8 people and an infant. To say we were disappointed upon arrival is an understatement. The apartment was not as it was listed. There was an entire Queen size bed missing that was in the listing. The building and apartment itself needs alot of work. The floors in the bedrooms were not even, they were slanted which raised concerns about the foundation. The 2nd floor stairs leading to the apartment  are a hazard. It felt like we were about to fall through. The walls have been painted over numerous times and had major cracks in the walls. Doors were stained and one of the bathroom locks was completely broken - no privacy at all. Although the bathrooms are updated nicely, one of the bathrooms had water stains in the ceiling and the vent fan was in dire need of cleaning. The AC unit in one of the bedrooms wasn’t sealed in properly which caused openings that allowed flies to get and and not allow the room to cool properly. We had to keep the lights dim in that room and spray OFF bug repellant around thr window. The AC was on 68 but felt more like 72-73. The curtain rods were also not mounted which caused the curtain rods to fall and hit us when we tried to open the curtains. Some of the towels and linens had stains and the actual cover on the bed was an extemely thin blanket. There also wasn’t enough towels left for guests and no extra linens left. Instructions on how to operate the tv were not left and when we finally got the the tv operating, the chanel selection was extremely limited and were unable to access the smart tv apps (if it was a smart tv) because the remote to the actual tv was not working at all. Although handsoap was provided in all bathrooms  it was Dawn dish liquid soap in the handsoap dispensers. They do provide body wash but we were afraid to use that out of fear of it being dish soap. In addition to all of the above we also were locked out of the building entrance due to the door bolt being jammed on smart lock system. The host did repsond quickly but the person he sent to assist with getting the door unlocked was not knowledgeable of the smart lock system at all. Luckily, one of the guests staying is also an airbnb host who is familiar with the lock system was there to assist with disassembling the entire lock system and getting the door unlocked. The person the host sent mentioned that there were other complaints about the lock system so host was aware of this door issue. This was extemely concerning for us because we had an infant and would not have been able to evacuate in the event of a fire or emergency. The airbnb is in a decent location and pretty accessible to most things to do. It certainly isn’t worth the nightly rate. Walls, doors and window seals need a deep cleaning. There was signage in the kitchen asking us to remove shoes but the floors need to be cleaned alot better - our socks were filthy. A blowdryer was mentioned as an amenity but was not available. A handbook or house manual would be helpful and signage on doors would also be helpful. In addition, the welcome letter mentions a fully stocked kitchen that you would be able to cook thanskgiving dinner but we didn’t feel it was equipped for that. As an Airbnb host ourselves this listing was extremely disappointing and not as advertised. This host needs to really utilize Airbnb resources to add small touches that would make the experience better for guests. Host also needs to really dedicate time to fixing patches and cracks as well overall building upkeep. Clearer instructions/communication could be better and wall signage/guest letters also need to be updated - the welcome letter mentioned a piece of furniture being on back order until April but it’s August. This is a property we would not stay in again. I hope other guests are alot more honest with their reviews because we booked based upon other reviews. It’s clear that is not the experience we had. Also, this host violates Airbnb’s service dog policy. One of our guests was bringing a service dog and host tried to assess a fee. Per Airbnb’s policy, service dogs are allowed and a host cannot assess a pet fee.

Loved this place so much. It was really close to the subway which made it super easy to get around. Really loved the art and the decor, looks even better than the pictures. The only downside about this place is the neighborhood is a bit sketchy at night. I would highly recommend to travel with someone or to not refrain from walking around at night alone.

Very nice and clean stay! What you see is what you get. It’s just a hop and a skip away from the metro and it takes you straight to 42nd Times Sq (2 Train) without having to switch trains (most days)! Only 30-40 minute metro from Manhattan. Located in a very nice neighborhood, my sister and I (young 20s) never felt unsafe or threatened. Perfect for a place to stay if you want to explore NYC and Brooklyn! Only a 35 +/-min Uber from JFK if you’re looking to fly out of town.

The area where the apartment is located is quite far from Manhattan, so on a tourist level it does not compensate for the time lost coming and going. In addition, its surroundings are of dubious security... Crime, drugs and a bad image of the people around.  Regarding the apartment, full of humidity, much smaller than what is seen in the photos and the entrance very small, with stairs that are difficult to go down and extremely dirty. He had a shovel at the door and a drum full of cobwebs, dust and dirt. What a pity that we didn't even take photos because we obviously left there and looked for other accommodation somewhere else.  The host is friendly, although he is usually slow to respond. Quite a disappointment.
The place was beautiful to stay in. I like that the owner. They didn't bother us. Gave us privacy. Everything we needed was there. A very comfortable stress free stay.
Raquel place was a steal for me, great location, very private, and calm and you have everything you need for a quick stay, i will definitely come back again

Raquel was an amazing host! Very attentive and very (VERY!) quick to respond to all questions! She checked in throughout the trip to make sure everything was going well, and was flexible on check-out time! The apartment is perfect for two! All the necessities are available - towels, internet, kitchen appliances, sheets, tv. The place was clean and tidy upon my arrival. Check-in was smooth! 100% best place!  For those first-timers in New York, this apartment is perfect.About 30 minutes by train to Manhattan (near three subway lines!). The neighbourhood is filled with lots of families, up-and-coming, but SAFE! I never felt unsafe!

The apartment was cute and stylish, the price wasn't too bad. We thought our stay went fine until we received an accusation from Lex and Raun for property damage and asking for more money. Let me just say this was my first AirBnB experience and definitely my last, this accusation put such a damp on my 9 day long vacation that I spent in New York. Overall the apartment was very clean the only issue I had was the bed had a bit of a strange smell, I overlooked it but after the second night it made my boyfriend and I itchy and gave me a rash on my face. Another issue I had was the extreme noise level. I understand that these are old buildings however it sounds like there are people inside the home, its quite scary if you are used to silence in a home. We heard minimal noise from Lex and Raun upstairs however, the sounds coming from neighbors, street was very loud. On our check out date, Lex and Rauns dog was barking outside at 7:30 AM for about 30 minutes straight.  Throughout our stay Lex and Raun only communicated with us once. It  was to inform us that he needed to go inside our apartment one of the days because there was an issue with the heater. We answered promptly and said that it was no issue. He never followed up with if they went inside the apartment or not. Unfortunately, this experience ended on a terrible note when we were accused of property damage on the coffee table and bed sheet. I usually don't write reviews but I felt it was important to notify guests of this scam they are doing to try to receive more money from our stay. We barely spent time inside the apartment. Most of our time was spent out. The coffee table was never used. I never sat at the table or even placed anything on it. We never even had a meal inside your home. So I know for a fact that these accusations are false because there is NO way a table can crack during our stay if we didn't even use it. We followed your check out procedures and thoroughly checked everything before we left. My boyfriend even went to the extent of mopping your floors. Trust me if the table or bed cover was damaged we would have noticed. We did everything that was asked of us and more. Again, I don't usually write reviews on anything but this was a truly unpleasant experience.

The apartment corresponds to the description. Although on the mezzanine floor, it is not too dark. A little damp though. The bedding is very comfortable. Raquel is very responsive and friendly. The apartment is in a fairly safe area. We returned at midnight without being afraid. It is 10/12 minutes from the M and J subways which serve Manhattan in 20/30 minutes. Infrequent subways. Good value for money. The description is very reliable. Not too dark. A little humid. The bed is good. Raquel is friendly and answers questions very quickly. The area is safe. We used to come back at 12.00 pm and we were afraid at all.. We need 10/12 minutes to go to the subway stations M or J. Not many subways. Good quality/fare ratio
Spacious, pleasant accommodation. Good address for travelers who are not afraid to walk a little and take the subway to get to Manhattan

Phenomenal stay at Say's airbnb! Say is a wonderful host and made the whole visit stress-free. Location was perfect, easy check-in, and comfortable apartment. Tons of delicious places to eat nearby too!

Clean apartment, perfectly equipped and met our expectations. On the other hand, the heating was a real problem for us, it is very noisy and blows very hot air which is unpleasant to breathe. Programs are defined in advance so that it heats to a certain temperature (much too hot) at certain times of the day and we only understood this on the last day. Also the wifi network was catastrophic we only depended on it and it was much too slow or sometimes even non-existent.

We stayed 4 nights at Lex and Raun's place and we were very comfortable there. The place was clean, neat and well decorated. It was exactly like the photos with several items having been reorganized and a few more additional items added. They provided everything from dish soap, bath soap, hand soap, shampoo, cotton buds, hairdryer! Thank you! There were only paper plates, but we did not cook, so it was fine (and less dishes to wash by hands). They had lots of kitchen gadgets though (coffee maker, blender, pots and pans) so technically, you can cook. We had an issue using the code provided to enter the place, but they called us within minutes to us sending them a message on airbnb! Truly appreciate the responsiveness!  The home had everything we needed for our stay, we especially loved the fact it has in unit washer and dryer as we didn't want to bring too much clothes for the trip and we had a toddler with us. There was also a pack and play (we used for our toddler), a high chair, kids books and some toys too! We were very glad we reserved this place!   Please note that if you're very sensitive to noise, you would hear foot steps and people moving around, opening and closing doors as the rental unit is a downstairs unit and the owners live upstairs. They didn't bother us much as we're not very sensitive to noise.  We had to take the subway to Manhattan and the journey could take 40-50 minutes door to door, but it was manageable. The neighborhood was alright. The particular street where the property is located is clean and well lit at night, we never felt unsafe.  On our first night, we walked to Chez Oscar for dinner and some blocks leading to the restaurant felt sketchier, but there were lots of bodegas and local small hole in the wall restaurants (mostly takeouts) around and it felt very local which we also appreciate.  If we're ever back to visit NYC, we won't hesitate to stay here again. Thank you for hosting us, we certainly had a great stay.
Lex and Rauns place has excellent amenities and attentive hosts for a steal of a price. Also, only a few blocks from the subway. Highly reccommend staying here.

I have had numerous Airbnb stays in 5 countries and this was my first poor experience.  From being charged a different price than was shown on listing to cockroaches in the kitchen; from non-working appliances, shower, sink to lack of street parking; from inadequate air conditioning in Brooklyn in August to no coffee maker or nearby coffee shop, I would not stay here again.  The neighborhood is sketchy - especially at night.

Location: Very Good Close to subway (approx. 10 mins walk to Subway 3/ 3 blocks away). Approx. 50 mins by to Times Square. Basic groceries available closeby, plenty of places to eat around. Ghetto-looking area but quiet & safe during our stay.  Amenities: Poor to Fair (NOT all listed amenities were available at our time of stay) see below; TV - available but no working aerial/cable to get any reception Kitchen - Oven cooker & microwave available. However, no kettle, oven dish nor any oven cookware or bowl to use. Also, no dish drainer to leave plates to dry. Only 2 chairs & small table for dining, folding chairs would have been helpful for family of 4. (requested it after booking but sadly forgotten/ ignored) Essentials - Plenty towels available. Unfortunately were all smelly (we suspect it's because of the plastic drawer storage where bath moisture probably gets trapped in towels). Shower curtain with black spots (moulds?) from inside Pillows - if you are group of 4, you'll have to make do with 1 flat-pillow each. Can use the available throw pillows tho'  Bathroom - basically 1.5 only as shower in the downstairs is NOT available. Received text msg that it's not available the day we arrive NY. One of the reason we chose this place despite distance to Manhattan is having 2 bathrooms, so we don't waste time waiting to have shower.  Iron - available but take note, no functional ironing board.  Elevator - listed as available in amenities but irrelevant. It's in 1st floor & you would not need it.  Aircon - 1st floor with aircon, basement with 1 fan. Be prepared if visiting NY in summer time, bit uncomfortable sleeping in the basement as the aircon don't really reach bedroom there. Cockroaches - quite a number of them frequented kitchen /bathroom areas& made us jump everyday. Luckily, did not encounter rats. Rat trap seen outside front door.  Host- Unfortunately, never seen/met her at all. Keys were obtained  from a secured container outside apt. Understandable as may be busy but no reply received when texted about some questions we had on our first night. Did not persist with msg as it's not an urgent thing anyway.   Over all, would rate our experience "Fair" as they say you get what you paid for. It's cheap. Sad to say, would not recommend to my family & friends.

I definitely recommend Lex and Raun's cozy apartment! Among all Airbnbs in the world, I must say they have most exceptional check-in and check-out procedure. The place was very clean, functional and user friendly...all that just a few minutes away from a metro station! Communication was super efficient. This has made my stay completely stress free and there was simply no reason to dislike the experience.

Olu's place was very nice.  It was spacious, well equipped and very clean.  Olu was was very nice to work with.  She even walked me to the nearest drug store.  Even though she had to leave town she texted me to find out if everything was OK.

The apartment is located in a nice, quiet residential area with plenty of on stray parking. The apartment is beautifully presented and spotlessly clean. It offers all of the comforts of home. It made moving our daughter into college as stress free as it could possibly be. We also had the pleasure of meeting Olu and her daughter and communication was swift and precise. We will defiantly try to stay here again!!!

It was my first AirBnB experience and I was a little scared, but when we arrived and they gave us the keys, I felt secured.  Negra is a very good host and always sends us messages asking if we need anything. She has a great communication.  The apartment is the same as the photos. The neighborhood is quiet and the street is safe.  1 minute walk to subway and 15 subway to Manhattan. They bought eggs, cereal, bread and milk for us. Me and my girlfriend loved the stay and we recommend it. In our check out she gave us chocolate!

This apartment is cute, nice and cozy. The furniture's all pretty modern, the bathroom is tiny, but the bed is incredibly comfortable! It is just outside the city in a quiet neighborhood that feels safe, even at night. We would go out and arrive back to the apartment when it was dark and thought it would be scary, but the porch and door areas have a sensor light that's very well lit.   Negra was quick to respond to messages and texts and even check in on us! There were bags of chips and a couple bottles of water in the fridge, which was awesome upon arrival because we were starving and thirsty.  I'd recommend this place to anyone!

Jibari is a great host, he is 100% aware of your arrival, and during your stay, he has everything for you to have a great vacation, the only thing that scared us a little was the location, the streets were a little lonely at night and we were afraid that it would be dangerous, however nothing ever happened to us, the apartment has everything.

Me and my friend enjoyed this place a lot. Hopefully this review does some justice and helps others when choosing this place. Negra is very quick to respond to questions you may have. Sometimes so quick that it's scary and I often thought she had an automated response to FAQ's. First impressions: -The place is amazingly clean and the bed is a perfect size (super comfortable at that). -They provide a piece of paper with useful information as to nearby food places and attractions, contact info, rules about quiet hours (all very understandable and fair) -The bathroom may be small and fits one at a time but not really a concern (comes with shampoo, conditioner, shaving cream, plenty of towels and other toiletries). -There's more than enough space to put stuff away when you get there; drawers, walk in closet, etc. There's even a closet with a vacuum and other cleaning tools we didn't even think about being provided. -The ceiling is a bit low so if you're tall (6 foot?), maybe not so pleasant, but if you're short then it's pretty much paradise, being able to touch the ceiling without a chair or ladder felt great. -The TV comes pre-loaded with Amazon and Netflix so just log right into your accounts and the internet is really fast (did not have a problem once with disconnecting or buffering). Also the TV remote has a keyboard on the back (sometimes it's the small things I appreciate more than anything else). -Both cereal and banana's were provided and at first we didn't really need it but during a snow storm on one of the days I really came to appreciate them and all the plates, bowls, utensils. -The Fridge has enough space for small bottles (also comes with 4 bottles of water) and the microwave sits above it (didn't really need to use it though). -Cooking supplies (pots and pans) are in a cabinet around the dining table which is big enough for two people to sit and eat at. -The trash bins open with censors (like I said earlier, I appreciate the small things) -The couch in front of the TV is nice and comfortable. -The place has colorful carpeting so if aesthetics is your thing, then look no further. My friends flight was cancelled due to a storm and Negra was able to respond quickly enough to let us stay an extra night so I'm very appreciative of that. Overall the location is amazing (train station towards Manhattan is less than a block away). Grocery and other shopping stores are a few blocks away. The neighborhood was very quiet as well so you can sleep soundly at night even while being in New York City. Checking in and out was a breeze and they are very understanding and can be flexible around changing the times if possible. If you have doubts about choosing this place or another, just know that I wrote this lengthy review moments after leaving because staying...

Shasta's place looked better than the pictures. It was ready when we arrived. There was a shade off the window that he was in the middle of being replaced. Also, the toilet broke while we there and Shasta made arrangements for it to be repaired while we were out. It was a fine stay in a typical New York apartment and neighborhood .

It was an amazing stay overall! The house is tiny but spacious enough for 1 or 2 people. Everything is so accessible from Transportation to SuperMarkets for your basic needs and up to nice restaurants. It’s very near from all attractions in NYC.  Coming from LA, I appreciate the Metro a lot in NYC lol 😸 I don’t use the public transpo in LA bc I’m just afraid to do so but in NYC, I enjoyed it! The coolest thing is that the Subway Station from the house is just around the corner and pretty much every corners and they’re 24hrs open. I was able to do/go to all the places I wanna go to in my NYC To-Go or To-Do List. Negra is so easy to communicate with. I requested a late checkout and she granted it with no more further questions! She wrote some suggestions and tips and they’re all great. The experience is awesome and the stay is excellent!!! She and Edin even left a goodbye present at my doors, so thoughtful. I highly recommend this place in Astoria 💯

For the price, this is a satisfactory lodging. The home is older and, as such, not luxurious. It was certainly passable, and if you plan to spend the majority of your time in the city, and you are willing to rough it a bit, this will suit your needs. The host is very accommodating and provided excellent communication. The subway is only about ten minutes away, and we were able to easily walk there and back in the morning and evening without feeling unsafe at any time. The neighborhood is quiet enough that we didn't have trouble sleeping.

This is the place to be in Williamsburg. First of all, Stuart and Karolina are the most gracious hosts. They let us check in early because I wasn’t feeling well after our flight. They were super quick to respond any time we had questions and their directions were perfect. They also left helpful hints on the counter on how the gadgets at their place work! The place was spotless. Large living space, a huge balcony, tons of natural light (and blackout curtains for the bedroom). Y’all the bathroom: HEATED FLOORS and a luxury shower/tub. My boyfriend was pointing out all the ideas he wanted to steal for our place! The neighborhood was super nice and very quiet, we had no problems with noise. You could spend two full days at least in Williamsburg alone and we pretty much did! Just walk up and down Graham, there’s tons to see. We went to Grass Roots for juice every single day. For a great meal at a decent price go to Concord Hill or Mesa Coyoacan. If you need a pick-me-up check out Charter Coffeehouse and if you want curated goods commemorative of Williamsburg go to Upstate Stock, We See Stars, and Myths of Creation! We also really loved Alter and Known to Man vintage and stopped by multiple times. Everyone in this area was super great, we cannot wait to come back and we’ll definitely be staying here again if they’ll have us!
The place is beautiful, modern, and clean- and very very comfortable. Fast responses from hosts made the trip stress-free and super easy. The private terrace is a really nice touch.

If you are looking for prime BK location that is easily accessible via metro to the city then look no further. The neighborhood is exactly where you want to be with many shops, grocers, restaurants and bars within walking distance. The street is quiet, which was appreciated, and safe:) I’ll be honest and fair with my experience.... Prior to arrival I was texted an image of a lockbox ( for self easy self check in) and the code to access the keys. Simple, I’ve done this dozen of times at other Airbnb’s.  However, now I was faced with 3 lockboxes vs. one lockbox all next to each other. I tried the code on all of them. The last one was broken/jammed hard. We tried for 20 minutes to open it, shake it, until I had to contact the host Karolina. I texted but didn’t hear back, so finally I called as it was getting dark.
