I was told that perhaps the previous guest had jammed it and the keys were stuck. Ok.  I also asked which one it was, she knew there was a second lockbox added but was not aware of the third. Ok, this info should be shared with people prior to check in, transparency. She said that she will TRY to contact the maid for a second pair of keys. This was not reassuring. I was instructed to keep trying it myself in the meantime. I kept calling back, it shouldn’t be this hard and a second set of keys should be more easily accessible in the future. Simply a suggestion.  Karolina was sending over a friend to help open the lock by force, as tools would be easier than two sets of girly hands. I was told 5-10 minutes, 30+ go by and we are getting a little restless. The friend finally came (thank you!! I forget his name) he unjammed it and we were able to access the apartment :D The building is beautiful, had an elevator even for 4 floors and we felt 100% safe. The apartment it’s self is exactly like the images. Beautiful decor,heated bathroom floors, comfortable and stylish furnishings, a patio the size of many NY apartments. It was lovely.  We had trouble accessing the patio doors as we were unaware of the style of door. When tired a certain way it cracks the top and it literally folds back on the top hinge with the sensation of it falling over in you. It was tricky. The second set of doors in the bedroom was off the hinges at the bottom. I nearly had a heart attack as I don’t know how I could have broken a door by simply turning the handle. I called the host Stuart, he explained they were European doors and how to fully access the patio and the bedroom patio door was broken from the previous guest. It wasn’t me. This info would have been wonderful shared prior to checkin as I though I had done something wrong and I always want to be respectful of any place I stay at (do my dishes, fold all the dirty towels, tidy and leave no foot prints behind. Communication by one of them would’ve been appreciated:) I was also instructed to leave the keys on the kitchen counter rather than try to put them back in the broken lock box, 😅 phew! that was great news as I was stressing that we would have to tackle that again!  The bed is extremely comfortable, probably the best bed I’ve slept on in my travels and the black out curtains were a lovely touch. We were only there for two nights but they were very comfortable sleeps and the neighbors were quiet. We are older gals that were on a get away from our families and it was a perfect place to lay out heads after a day of exploring BK:)  I would recommend this apartment, just make sure that communication is clear and never feel shy to ask questions when in doubt:)

Laura was a fantastic host as she would reply instantaneously to any questions that I had. Her apartment was impeccably clean and beautiful. The location in terms of crime rate and distance to Manhattan, is easily one of the best in the city. Most hosts don't think twice of the comfort and well-being of their guests but I cannot say that about Laura.

My company sent me out to New York from San Francisco for a 6 month assignment. I signed up for this apartment for 2 months since this was the minimum amount of time you could stay, with the possibility of extending my stay for the additional 4 months.   In short, my stay was terrible and would not recommend staying here for any period of time. There are far better apartments to rent out throughout Manhattan. Here a little more information on the apartment and the reason for my poor review.  This apartment is a 5th floor walkup, meaning it's located on the 5th floor and there is no elevator in the building. The apartment is located next to a housing authority building (I believe it is Nathan Straus), so the area where the surrounding can be unsafe when heading home in the late evening.  When moving into the apartment, I quickly noticed that there were quite a few things wrong with the apartment, so immediately reached out to the my contact at USA Stay. They were quick to say they would address and fix all my concerns, but did not.  The washer/dryer did not work and they never fixed it. During the last week of my stay, they had a new one delivered, but it was left in the middle of the kitchen and the broken one was not removed. The dishwasher was not properly installed, so whenever you open the door, it would fall out from under then countertop. The pots, pans, and other cooking utensils were gross and unusable.   The blanket on the bed was not cleaned and sheets were stained. The soap holder in the shower was broken and the ceiling paint in the bathroom was peeling.   Overall, I had to spend over $200 to get new sheets, have the blanket cleaned, lightbulbs, pots, pans, and cooking utensils.  They could not even provide me with a mail key, which I asked for a number of times, so I wasn't able to get the cards my grandmother sent me.  Lastly, the apartment listing shows cable, but it's actually a Roku device and unless you have an active account with a cable service provider and login information, there isn't much you can watch.  To give them credit, the one request they did follow through with was providing me with a spare key/fab to the building and apartment, but no mail key.   Apologies for the ramble, but I just want to make sure that no other person has an awful experience similar to the one I had.

This apartment is great! Everything is very clean and up to date. The building is well-maintained, and I never felt unsafe. Never had any sound issues from the other surrounding units.   Yes, you do walk up 4 flights of stairs to get to this unit but: 1) This is NYC, most apartment buildings have lots of stairs. 2) GrubHub/Seamless still will deliver straight to your door. 3) Being higher up takes away a lot of the street noises.   I had no major issues during my 6 month stay, but whenever something did come up, USA Stay was extremely quick to respond. The in unit wash/dryer works great, and there's a dry cleaner right next door to the building. The TV has a roku, which means you can stream your own Netflix, Hulu, HBO accounts, etc.   The building is conveniently located just a few blocks from the subway, down the street from Starbucks, a couple blocks from Trader Joes, and great restaurants everywhere. It's accessibly close to the major tourists attractions in Midtown, but far enough away that it's not swarmed with tourists.    I highly recommend this unit for any business traveler looking for an apartment to stay during the work week. Great price for a great unit!

1. the washer and dryer is terrible. does not work well and accumulates too much lint and causes piling in clothes. terrible. 2. my packages were stolen from the apartment lobby. 3. the front door that was supposed to be locked was open for quite some time and seems to jam and break often 4. the water temperature is inconsistent throughout the unit 5. kitchen dishwasher reeked of mold or mildew 6. uncomfortable pillows 7. +++ positive: host was very nice and quick to respond. internet worked great. kitchen was well equipped for cooking.

My boyfriend, brother, and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Remo's cozy apartment. I found it's quite rare to find a place in New York with 3 different rooms/beds that's at a reasonably, affordable price, so I was pleasantly surprised by this crazy awesome find. His extremely clean, well-furnished and decorated place felt very spacious and comfortable. Besides the fact that the actual place was so lovely,  Remo went above and beyond as a host to make us feel cared for. He was extremely accommodating with check out times, allowing us time to store our luggage before leaving on our last day. When there was a problem/confusion with the heat, he called me to clarify and offer help within the hour. I was able to solve it right there on that call, but his earnest intentions to help secured us as hopeful, returning guests. We loved the place and would recommend to anyone looking for a clean, cozy place to stay in Brooklyn! It really was an easy approx. 8 minute walk to the subway, and travel into Manhattan was fairly easy and within 30 minutes to most of our destinations. Our stay was stress-free and highly enjoyable, due in large part to our lovely temporary home and host.

We were guests at Remo's for a week. We found the accommodation relatively quickly. It's best to get off at Utica Station. Then you walk for about 10 minutes. The apartment is nicely furnished and we especially liked the kitchen. The two large beds were also super comfortable. There were 6 of us and two slept in the smaller room. It was pretty tight here. I would therefore recommend that you book the apartment for a maximum of 5 people. Everything was clean and tidy. Many people wrote that it was very, very loud. Unfortunately I have to agree with that. We sometimes had the feeling that the train was passing through our room. So if you have sensitive sleep, you should consider this. Otherwise, value for money is great. You've been very lucky here, especially for New York prices.  Another tip for everyone: as tourists, please don't go further than MC Donals. We were told that you could get robbed here.

Hey, y’all don’t underestimate this apartment it’s really nice, Cody, cozy, warm, feel just like home, extra blankets, sheets, and towels. This house was fully furnished, clean, communication is fantastic with Mr. Norga so don’t be afraid to ask him for anything, he’s respectful, and give you all the space you need. I will say if you drive make sure you have money for parking don’t park on any side of the street over the hours your supposed to or you will get a ticket. However, on the good side he provides groceries and theirs plenty of deli’s and supper market on the strip along with other things

Anthony was a very nice, helpful and friendly host. The house is convenient, clean and quiet. Do not expect a luxurious house, but that is not what he offers. The neighbourhood is absolutely o.k., not dangerous, very convenient if you intend to use the metro.  We would always return!

Anthony is honestly the best host anyone could wish for. He is super nice and extremely helpful, which is great when you are arriving alone in an overwhelming city like NY. Just know that any time you need help, he will be there for you! I am so happy that I found his place and can only recommend it.   The room I stayed in is next to the kitchen upstairs. The cats live downstairs, so if you have allergies or don't like pets in the kitchen, don't worry. The room is spacious and sunny and the bed is really comfortable! There are two kitchens and three bathrooms in the house, so I never really had to wait to use one. The kitchens are equipped with everything you need. There are a washer and dryer in the basement, which is very convenient. You should know, however, that you will be living together with multiple other people who are generelly expected to clean up after themselves. As you can imagine, some people are more considerate of this than others. Anthony does clean the bathrooms and kitchens, but of course not immediately every time someone showers. I guess it just depends on who else is currently living in the house and their personal cleanliness, but that's just how it is with roommates.   The neighborhood is super interesting, with a mix of orthodox jewish families and people with Jamaican roots. I cannot stress enough how convenient it is that the subway is right across the street! There are some small shops and supermarkets nearby, as well as Cafés, Delis, and many other places to get food.   All in all, this is a great place to stay for a few months with an even greater host! Thank you for everything!

Sophia's apartment was great. It was well appointed, clean and close to everything I needed. Everything was well organized and she left out no details. She made getting into the apartment easy and was extremely accommodating to let me check out later. The neighborhood was safe and quiet and she gave a lot of great recommendations to places nearby. I am a 28 year old woman and I stayed here alone. Never had any problems getting around at night or feeling unsafe. Thanks Sophia, I would absolutely stay here again.

The apartment was exactly as described. Very clean, fully stocked, and quite large. The neighborhood is a bit sketchy but we didn't have any problems. Also found street parking very easily even though there are lots of apartments around.

Excellent welcome from Doug and his father. They were very available to inform us or even help us if something was missing. Hot and humid apartment in the middle of August but Doug installed an air conditioner.  Access to the garden is not very convenient but we did not miss it as we only returned in the evening to dine/sleep. Very well placed for shopping, take-out restaurants and especially the metro. No insecurity in the neighborhood. Street a little noisy some evenings (music). Allowed us to visit Manhattan thoroughly (weekly subway card + citypass). It was enriching to also meet the American population of the Bronx which has nothing to do with that of Manhattan. Everyone is keen to help you or provide information if they feel you are lost. In short, a good plan.

I highly recommend this rental for a trip to NYC! We landed in the evening, Douglas and his father Tom waited for us until 11 p.m., and when we arrived, a pleasant surprise awaited us: Metro maps + Metrocard, places of interest to visit hung on the map, explanations for how the metro works, and the best: a bottle of Californian wine! Just that! Throughout our stay, Douglas was available for any questions. Very flexible also on departure, we had to return the rental at 11 a.m. while our flight was at midnight, we were able to leave our luggage with him.  Metro is a five-minute walk away, very secure area, so don't be afraid of the Bronx, this area is quiet. We 100% recommend this accommodation, furnished like a loft, independence guaranteed!

We were very happy to meet Tom (Douglas' father) and stay at his place. Tom introduced the area very well, suggested things worth visiting and made us feel very comfortable.   All necessary things were provided. It was nice to see small soaps, shampoos and lotions in the bathroom :-) The kitchen corner was fully equipped, one could even prepare waffles :-) Umbrellas, iron and a little ironing board, shopping bags - they were all there and ready to use. That counts a lot!  The place is located in south Bronx, but there is nothing to be scared of. It was easy to reach the supermarket (nice choice!) and the metro station (trains 2 & 5 running every 3-5 min).   Overall, we had a great stay at Tom's place and we can easily recommend it :)  Thanks Tom!

host was really nice and able to give you good pointers for what to do in nyc. it was a nice and super spacious, with an oven and fridge.  as far as location, we didn't have any issues of feeling unsafe ( 3 females on this trip) but the area could definitely look better. uber rides were like 45$ to Manhattan (Chinatown, freedom tower, Chelsea market, times square)

We had a warm welcome from Thomas and his family, he gave us great advice (particularly the metro which is a 5-minute walk away, and also on visits to do). The accommodation is clean, a functional kitchen, comfortable beds (we were 2 adults and 2 teenagers) located in the basement of the house, a little lacking in light but it is enough to sleep. Nearby a super market 2 minutes away, which closes at 10 p.m. which is not negligible when you come home late in the evening. The neighborhood located in the Bronx can be scary at first, but never had a problem, it's a completely calm neighborhood. We thank Douglas (for the departure tea) for returning home during our next trip to New York. Thank you

The place in question is the basement of a very nice house in a working-class, very safe, neighborhood of the Bronx, a short walk from the 2/5 trains. The fact that it is the entire basement means that the area available is huge (though tall people need to mind their head: low ceilings)! The price it's listed at is an absolute steal for what you get -- you will find it difficult to find hotel/motel rooms and Airbnb listings offering this kind of value.  Beyond just the apartment itself, Douglas has obviously put a lot of work into making other aspects of the stay great as well. For those here mainly to see the sights, Douglas has prepared materials instructing guests on getting to and around the city, as well as tips for places to visit. And for those looking to feel more at home, there is a full kitchen with an oven and stove and waffle maker; some breakfast materials are included like oatmeal and waffle mix (we did have some difficulty locating utensils--they were in a somewhat-hard-to-find drawer in the dining table). Yes, we made waffles. International guests will be happy to find a few converter plugs lying around near power sockets.  Also included is a very large array of DVDs for guests' viewing pleasure. A nice personal touch: I told Douglas we were going to watch a few Broadway musicals, and were happily amused to find a copy of the movie version of Chicago already in the DVD player waiting for us.

Doug's place is a great option when traveling to the city on a budget. The unit was exactly as pictured/described and fit our every need. The beds and futons were quite comfortable. Doug was a great host who went out of his way to ensure that we had as best of a trip as possible. He provided a bottle of wine at check-in and some great recommendations. The area was convenient to the city, but as three mid-20 year old ladies we did feel unsafe at times while walking to the subway. Although not enough to deter us from staying at Doug's unit again. The cost savings on the unit greatly surpass the costs of calling a lyft back instead of taking the subway. Our lyft cost from Times Square was around $32. I'd also recommend taking the subway uptown and then calling the lyft. We did this a few times and it cut the lyft cost in 1/2. Overall great stay!!

We are from Florida and enjoyed our time visiting NYC. The Harlem Gem looked as nice as the pictures, in fact, probably the nicest on the block. Lisa's assistant Samantha met us upon arriving, made us feel welcomed and was very helpful.  The subway location only steps away was very convenient and provided easy access to everything in NYC. We figured out quickly that this was the best, most efficient way to see the city. By the way, we never felt unsafe walking to the subway to get where we needed to go. Grab a map and purchase the unlimited 7 day card! It would atually be better to figure it out before you go but we still managed. The first day we got really lost but then figured it out. And even if you get lost a taxi can get you back on track to your destination. There are two rambunctious children upstairs which wasn't much of an issue for us but might be for others during the day. You don't usually come to NYC for quiet and if you are like us you will probably spend most of the time in the city sightseeing. We never missed an opportunity to explore the city. We were up early and stayed out late most nights.There were some issues with the Ac but the apartment was still pretty cool. Lisa was attentive and was working on the issue. She gifted us tickets to the Apollo for the inconvenience which we ended up enjoying. On a side note. Two things that were really nice are the sofa bed with memory foam with the additional mattress on it. My teenagers thought it was very comfortable. At 6 feet they were to tall for the twin bed but slept comfortably together on the sofa bed. Also the small table in the kitchen actually unfolds to a larger table with additional chairs in the bedroom. We only used it once but it would be nice for a family spending more time in the apartment. Overall we enjoyed our stay!

We stayed for a week with my brother and my mother. The accommodation is in the basement, just above is Lisa's accommodation. There is little daylight but that is not a problem since we were not there during the day, most of the time. The accommodation is very clean with all the necessary amenities: towels, bathrobes, toilet paper, kitchen equipment, etc. The metro is nearby, the area is safe. The only problem we encountered was with the departure time. You have to leave before 10 a.m. but our flight was at 9 p.m., we had to pay an extra $80, or an extra half day. So pay attention to timetables or take your flight depending on the conditions.

My son and I spent a week at Lisa's apartment and had a wonderful time! Everything was spotless and very comfortable. A great starting place to explore the city. Lisa and her assistant were very accommodating and available with some great suggestions and tips for things to do. Highly recommended! We will definately be back! Rob and Ruben from The Netherlands

Douglas' place is clean, comfy, and practical. It's great for families or groups with a fully functional kitchen, great bathroom set up, and extras for small children like play pens and high chairs. The whole family is very welcoming and helpful, so don't be afraid to reach out to this host for anything.

We had a great stay. The place is small, but cozy and comfortable. We were 6 people and were able to accommodate well.  The host is very attentive and responds quickly to messages.   Regarding the location, it is about a 5-minute walk from the Prospect Ave subway station, where you can take the subway to Manhattan (about 15 minutes). Another important point to highlight is that sometimes we find some people who are impaired (probably due to the use of illicit drugs). I emphasize that at no time did they intimidate us.  In general, the accommodation is good and the host is attentive!

There are positive and negative things about this apartment.   First thing to notice while arriving in this apartment is that you feel the apartment very loaded and not very tidy because there is a lot of things in each room. I had difficulties to make run my luggage without collide something.  Jonathan lives with his aunt who has a dog and a cat. This is not a problem for us because we love pets, but there is a dog odor when entering the apartment which can be quiet unpleasant sensation. Happily in the bedroom, we don’t smell it.    The bedroom is not small but also very loaded, free space is really limited. However the bed is good and spacy so we spend good nights in it, and the place is very quiet. The bedroom is equipped with a fridge but this one was not really clean so we used it just a little.   The bathroom is old as the kitchen : during our stay, the shower was dripping…  Nevertheless the apartment is well located, about 5 minutes walking from the subway 96th street (red one) which is really close to midtown (10minutes in subway express).

David's place in New York was great! It was in a nice area surrounded by a ton of nice places to eat and s bunch of shops.  The location was very close to any sort of public transportation, but for the most part we either walked or cabbed it to other locations.  His apartment was very home-like and very clean.  David himself was a very positive and friendly host.  One problem we did have was getting into touch with David because the weekend before we arrived, his phone and laptop got lost/stolen, so there was no really easy way to get into contact besides email.  This became a problem when we checked in and out, but everything turned out fine!  He was there when we request and also held our bags while other guests checked in so we could spend the day in the city.  Overall, great experience and I highly recommend this location.

We really enjoyed our stay. We are a family of 5. The location is amazing. It’s close to the subway, very convenient for going to Manhattan. We enjoyed the restaurants nearby and the croissants at Nick +Son (those croissants were amazing). Excellent coffee places too. Luis was very kind, always available, always smiling, and he let us stay longer since no one had rented it that day. That was a great help to us.  The apartment is well furnished with shampoos, extra water bottles, and other things that were very useful. There is no dishwasher but we didn’t need it. I suspect most people wouldn’t cook anyway. It’s certainly a great value and great location. Luis made our stay very pleasant.
We really enjoyed our stay! Native is really warm-hearted and easygoing person and her cats are just the cherry on top! Everything went smoothly without any extra stress.

The room is great, big, very clean and fragrant. Guest entrance is common, but the hallway is separate, which gives more privacy. The bathroom was always very clean.  We felt welcomed throughout the entire period.  Arlene is very kind and friendly.  The place is very close to the subway. There are shops nearby.  The streets are a little dark at night, but it didn't give us the feeling of danger. We felt safe in the place.  The Wi-Fi works really well.  I highly recommend the place.
Neighbourhood is unsafe at night and a little far from manhattan but the room and toilet is clean and pleasent.

Place as described, what's not mentioned is that the neighbourhood is noisy, with music, traffic all night long. Wouldn't recommend for a girl to walk alone at night. On top of it I had some trousers missing from my room, only noticed when I was packing to leave. The lady that had done the checking with me said she didn't take them and didn't offer any solution. That made me feel unsafe. Go there at your own risk folks.

Terrible host and dishonest. Tried to scam us. I show up to check in and he takes me to an entirely different apartment that was not what I had booked. When I explained that this was not what I had expected and a completely different address - he tries to act like I was a problem and that he was doing me a favor. Then he left me and my bags back on the street in the pouring rain and told me he didn’t want us there and that he was cancelling our reservation - and then I had to scramble to find a new location same day for 6 people. Good thing I did not cancel as I would have lost almost $3000 - so I had to call Airbnb and they helped me so that he had to cancel - plus he also violated the Airbnb policies by asking me to pay him extra cash for our 6th person instead of requesting that thru the site. I had been communicating with them thru Airbnb messaging for almost a month - never once did they mention that I wasn’t getting the apt I booked in the listing. And not once did the listing say there was an additional charge for 6 people. This couple are scam artists so beware. On a more positive note - I was able to find a place for us a little further from where I need to be - but it is satisfactory for us - it is only for a few more nights.

The apartment is clean and comfy. Lots of stairs to get up there...The heating makes a lot of noise but nothing you can do about it. For information,  to access the bed on the loft, it's a bit dangerous, very steep and open stairs. Not for kids or old people for sure. Luis and Oriana were very responsive and Luis conveniently drove us back to the airport. Thanks again.

My fiancé and I absolutely loved staying here! Howard and Renata are incredibly friendly (and their accents are almost as charming as the apartment itself). The apartment is located in one of the quieter neighborhoods in Brooklyn but still well within walking distance of several awesome places to eat and other great attractions like the Brooklyn Botanical Garden and Prospect Park. However, we probably would have felt just as happy staying inside all day. It's really a fantastic space. You can really tell that Howard and Renata put a lot of thought into making the place comfortable but practical. (We already warned them that we'll probably end up stealing some of their design ideas for when we remodel our own basement someday.) It was so much better than staying in a hotel. The next time we go to NY, we'll definitely be checking to see if this place is available again!

The host: Maria is super friendly, responsive, easy to communicate with, and helpful with recommendations.  The apartment: clean, tidy, super cute and cozy.  The building: the walls are paper thin so you can hear everything from the neighbors. One of the neighbors was in the hallway smoking cigarettes several times during my stay.  The neighborhood: even though you’ll be close to the J and C trains, you won’t be able to use them at night because the neighborhood gets pretty sketchy. Expect to Uber in and out if you leave the neighborhood.  This is a budget-friendly option if you’re visiting friends in the neighborhood, aren’t going out super late (or willing to spend the extra money on Uber if you do), or just looking for a place to rest your head (bring headphones!).   If you’re planning on visiting Manhattan, you’re better off finding a place closer to or in the city and with safer public transportation.

The place was nicely renovated but they have a bug problem. I counted 4 cockroaches in my room (the Front Yellow).  Then the next day I had some kind of bites on my legs which must have been bed bugs but I am not sure.  The place was very cheap I think because I rented it the day before.  I suppose a good enough value even with the bugs.  I was very disappointed when I messaged Yesica about the cockroaches and she ghosted me though.  Lastly the street was kind of sketchy.  There was a syringe cap in the front area of the building.  Then when I left to get dinner down on Wilson (great place called Father Knows Best) there were two homeless guys snorting drugs in a doorway on Schaefer.  I did not feel unsafe per se but it was sketchy for sure. I would not stay here again even though it was cheap.  Had I spent what they normally ask for it, I would be asking for my money back.

So many good things to say. From the moment we booked, our host was responsive, accommodating, and just plain old nice! We were provided a Pack n Play by request which was so helpful given we didn't want to have to drag our own. The place was spacious, clean, and tastefully decorated. We were almost sad that we spent all our time exploring the city because we would have also been perfectly content relaxing in the home! The neighborhood is eclectic and we never felt unsafe. Subway access was super close, lots of fun bars and yummy restaurants around. Monica helped us out towards the end in a request she really didn't have to accommodate, which makes her a rare gem on this website where the focus is often more on business  than on the human element of travel. One of the best experiences I've ever had at an AirBnB.

IF YOU ARE AFRIAD OF RATS DO NOT BOOK THIS.. ALTHOUGH THE SPACE WAS BEAUTIFUL AND AS DESCRIBED COMING IN AND OUT OF THE BUILDING WAS A NIGHTMARE..THE LOCATION AT NIGHT IS NOT SAFE THE STREET IS DARK AND SMALL. THE STREET IS FULL OF RATS RUNNING EVERYWHERE AT NIGHT  !! OTHER THAN THAT IF YOURE NOT SCARED THE PLACE WAS 10/10 no rats inside and very clean.

This tiny home is truly a tiny home . If you are more than 130 pounds and taller then 4feet 5inch this is definitely not the place for you . You have to crawl though a hole which is cut out into a box shape to enter the room . As well as climb up stairs that’s is about 8inch wide . You are unable to stand or move around in the room. The only thing you are able to do is lay down and  sleep that about it. There is a bathroom with a toilet like  on a Greyhound bus, it does not flush. The smell when entering was very uncomfortable and scary it smelled like a funereal home . Honey responded very quickly. She seem like a nice lady until she lied to me. I informed Honey my guest and I was to big for her unit and we were unable to stay. She understood and said she’ll refund me which I didn’t ask for because it isn’t her fault we couldn’t fit , even though she doesn’t indicated a weight or height limit . The next day when I inquired about the refund she didn’t respond. The following day I informed Honey I knew she wasn’t telling the truth. She informed me that she did do the refund which wasn’t the truth. Airbnb was asking me to rate a say that I didn’t stay and should have gotten a refund for. Honey never respond. I had to reach out to Airbnb and send the messages between the two of us to get assistance.
The location is not very good, we found it to be an unsafe neighborhood

PLEASE do yourself a favor and DO NOT STAY HERE. The low price lures unsuspecting victims. The host is a predator. This property is a fraud. Completely misleading. We have filed a formal complaint with AirBnb.  1) The photos are misleading. The actual bedroom is NOT on the same level as the "pretty photos". The actual bedroom is in a dungeon like, unfinished, unclean, unsafe basement. We found roaches in the bedroom and bathroom.   2) The room was so small we couldn't even fit our suitcases! No nightstands, closets, nothing. The room is the size of the BED. Nothing more.  3) One of the windows in the dungeon like basement was jammed open. We could not close it. New York City is dangerous enough without worrying about a criminal breaking into your room at night.   4) The host stated he would refund 100% our money. Then he picked an argument with us and REFUSED TO HONOR THE REFUND!! He wanted to keep 100% of our 8 night stay, even though we left immediately AND he promised to refund us! This man is unethical and will not refund your money. We visited our Bank and thankfully got our money charged back.  This was the worst AirBnb experience.  Please don't support unethical hosts. They will steal your hard earned money. There are plenty of good hosts on Airbnb to support instead. Please Beware & Be Safe!

The apartment was as described. Location is good, close to the metro station and many touristic atractions. Everything was okay till the morning I woke up with a stranger in the living room. Long story short, a man has broken in the apartment saying that he had rented the place for that night. He also had the front door key,  and tried to steal our belongings. Hours later, a bunch of cops in our place and a trip to the police precinct, the man was arrested, and we had our stay shortened because we did not feel safe at all. Rudolf was attentive , comprehensive and responsive, he has never let us down since the moment we contacted him to tell what has happened. Other than the feeling of being unsafe, our frustration was with Airbnb clients service. We spent a long period on the phone explaining what happened, we exchanged messages and what we got from them was "we will reply  in 48 hours".  They only concluded my case 5 days after.
parking issues my car got towed and slammed with bs tickets! beware prolly a marketing scam...

Location was very convenient. Outside of the building itself was quiet and a bit dark but actually pretty safe (went out a few times past 10pm without any issues).  The shared kitchen was really nice, basically had all that you would need for cooking. Coffee, tea, and condiments were all provided as well.  The bed was really big and fairly comfortable. Desk was a bit small - just barely fits a 15" laptop and mouse. TV in room with a lot of services/apps provided. Bathroom was a good size.  When I moved in there were some pest problems that David was very responsive about to help resolve. Unfortunately, I am terrified of bugs, and a few ants, small roaches, spiders, etc. made my stay really uncomfortable. I stayed here for about a month, and a few days in I was too afraid to use the desk so I was using my laptop on the bed all day long instead. David did provide traps, sprays, filled in some cracks in the walls, and contacted pest control within a few days though, he was really nice about it, and helped clean a bit in the beginning when there were more of them around.  My only other complaint is that 90% of the nights, there would be a strong smell of smoke (tobacco / weed) in the room.  Overall - no complaints about noise (from people - there was plenty of plane noises), internet speed, location, safety, host responsiveness, and general cleanliness. Worth the value, and would book again if I ever want to stay in Flushing again :).

This is a great value for what can be found in the NYC area, particularly if you are planning to stay for more than a couple of days and need to go to different locations both in Manhattan and Long Island. The place is clean, kitchen is convenient if you need to cook, there are many transportation options nearby. My overall experience was very good for my 2-nights stay.  The room is fairly spacious, enough for one person, maybe a little tight for two. The restroom is clean, with adequate size sink and shower; shampoo, conditioner and body wash are provided; the towels are on the medium size. The room has amenities like a TV and AC that I did not use (it was cold outside during my visit). The desk is small. You can use the kitchen to cook and store food in the fridge.  Convenient public transportation nearby to commute to Manhattan and airports. The neighborhood has mostly Asian food options, is rather frenetic, and can get noisy; I can also see people feeling unsafe around (I did not)

We had a very pleasant family stay in New York at Frank's. His studio is brand new, very clean and very quiet, we slept very well there. It's small, but the beautiful outdoor patio with a table and chairs allows for extra space. The area is residential and not at all touristy, there is a large supermarket nearby, very practical. The subway station (J line which goes directly to lower Manhattan) is a few minutes walk away, it takes 45 minutes to an hour to get to Manhattan. Last but not least, we did not meet Frank but he was a very attentive and responsive host, responding quickly to our questions, allowing us to leave our luggage on the last day before our flight etc. Thank you very much Frank!

Chris was a really friendly and helpful host. He responded very quickly to any messages. The apartment itself was clean, spacious and perfect for me and my friend. It was close to the subway station and we didn't feel unsafe at all. Definitely recommendable!
Great place, with Benny help making our trip stress-free. Would highly recommend given the space, price and location. Thanks again!

This place was a perfect location for us to get to NYULH to keep an eye on a loved one having surgery. It is right across the street and closer than any hotel. Given AirBnB limitations in NY, the check-in arrangement was a bit shady as we had to be escorted to the apartment through a back entrance. The host was also not responsive to any questions leading up to the date so we had concerns until the day of about whether this apartment was legitimate. Overall it was clean, extremely spacious with 3 bedrooms, and had incredible views. The visit couldn’t have worked out better other than the uncertainty around communicating with the host given the location.

We were a family of 4, with 2 teens of 17 visiting Manhattan. The apartment is located near to the subway and it takes around 40 mins to the Brooklyn bridge station. Althought the neighborhood may look sketchy at first for European standards, it is safe to walk around. You even see Mercedes Benz cars parked at night along the street. I wouldn't describe the apartment as 'retro', but 'outdated', yet, all, kitchen, bathroom is in working condition. We found it clean,  which is very important for us.

the apartment was nice an clean as well as the rest room as for the room I stayed in which was room #2 smelled like rats and I could hear rats in the walls it was very unpleasant the location is great though!!

The location it’s great, the check in also great…  Could be nice that can tell how many people are staying  in the apartment because at some point I got scary of noises when someone get inside the apartment.   Regards

Me and my family thought this place looked nice from the pictures. ALOT OF THE PREVIOUS EXPERIENCES ARE TRUE AND REAL. There are alot of rats running around outside. The top lock doesn’t work so we felt unsafe. We found hair in both bed, in the bathroom and as well as on the towels ( he did respond and send over his cleaner when we complained). When we laid in the bed, in did  indeed cave in. We told him this and he told us to move some pieces from under the bed and we should be fine. We expressed that we were unsatisfied with our stay considering everything that was going wrong and his response was “ It’s only $159 for a 2 bedroom apartment”. I would not recommend. The place did look like the pictures but it should also say that it’s in a NYCHA building.
Convenient location for subway.  Excellent host and super helpful Super.  Clean, but ageing building.  Area felt a bit unsafe.  Still good value.

Belisa is great host. Super easy to communicate and very friendly. Place looks exactly like the pictures. Little cozy and nice room! Belisa was sweet enough to let me in bit early than the check in time.   I am solo traveler and I walked around the area all alone at 9ish in the night and never felt unsafe. Metro station is just in 8 min walk. Locality seemed very rich and silent!! I will definitely stay here again!!!

Marlene was great. The check in process was extremely smooth, and the 2 rooms felt like i was at home. It’s only a 1-2 minute walk to the subway station and local fast food joints which is a steal. I will definitely be booking with Marlene very soon, as she met and exceeded all my expectations!

Everything was as described, professionally cleaned before I arrived, and Martin was very helpful and responded quickly when I asked for an extra set of keys. The only issues have to do with the building and the neighbors, unfortunately there are often groups of men smoking weed and cigarettes in the hallways, trash is discarded everywhere, and the neighbors fought and yelled at their child a lot during the stay. The stay was overall okay and I never felt unsafe, but these are just a few things to consider for future renters. Thanks to Martin for everything!

She was very polite and sweet. She made me feel safe and comfortable when my anxiety was through the roof about sharing a space. The home was even more beautiful than the photos. It was amazing. Pristine everything. She was very helpful and kind. I can’t stress enough how amazing this place was. The bathroom was my favorite spot. So serene and peaceful. I highly recommend!!
Looked just liked the pictures. It was very clean and stress free

The place looked like it did in the pictures. It was such a cute and clean place. There was great communication and host even extended check out time as my flight was leaving later. Loved the privacy and location. The only thing would be that there is no lighting outside in the back where you have to enter,and it kinda scared me when I got back late at night.  Other then that was great place and very kind host.

Good place overall. Much cheaper than a hotel but what practically the same amenities. Room was accurate to the listing, check in and out was easy,  and the location was unbelievable for the price. Curtains could have blocked out more light and been longer, and the window didn’t block much noise. Recommend bringing a sleeping eye mask and earplugs as I did. It seriously helped my sleep. It has a palm reading ward in the lobby and that may creep you out, but it didn’t affect the stay for my wife and I. I’d give this place a 9/10. Thanks Kristina!

My parents stayed here and during their stay, they got a notice stating that the airbnb was illegal and that they should evacuate in the next 24 hours.  This obviously made my parents feel very unsafe.  The owner is not the owner of the unit, but a renter.  He said he would take care of it and we were not evicted.   The place was clean, but some of the lights weren't working and the bathroom sink did not drain properly, leaving sink usage a bit dirty and unpleasant.   Otherwise it was a clean unit.

Our stay at Alexi's place was ideal. Close to public transportation, restaurants and grocery stores, our week-long stay was very comfortable.  The apartment is spacious and was just the right size for two of us (but could easily accommodate a third).  An elevator building with safe and easy access was a bonus. Like others have mentioned, there is a mildly unpleasant odor in the common areas of the building but this ends the moment you enter the apartment, which is bright, airy, clean and welcoming. Communication with Alexi was smooth and clear.  He was very kind and allowed us to enter the apartment early, which was very helpful and greatly appreciated. We definitely recommend Alexi's place and plan on returning.

Don’t go there!!! It was our first time in nyc,  We booked yves place. Unfortunately the moment we got into the building there was unbearable smell of garbage inside the building- the smell was so strong we had to hold our breath all the way up… we told the guy who let us in to inform the owner. The smell only got worse- apparently the garbage room is inside the building and for some reason it was not evacuated for few days in NY heat it was overwhelming smell. After two days we decided to live. Yves suggested candles and smell diffuser… obviously he didn’t understand the severity of the situation. Yves is not willing to refund our money for the rest of the stay, 5 nights total- a lot of money!! We had to move to an hotel, pay double!  I’m writing this review because Im feeling robbed! I hope Airbnb take a step and solve this situation.

A lot of positives: When I asked Yves if we could do a late checkout (we had an evening flight) he was responsive and very helpful. Also, the place is close to everything, which is a huge plus. The apartment is above average, depending on your expectations. It's kind of dark and narrow and there's little air circulation. There's no elevator if that's important to you. Probably more suitable for young people than older folks. It looks better in the pictures than it actually is, but it's not bad, I'd call it adequate, serviceable. On the negative side -- like others have mentioned, it does indeed stink in the hallway and stairs, unpleasant and off-putting (but no bad smell inside the apartment).

+ Room was nice, spacious and exactly as describe + Access to your room has increase of level of security since you need multiple access code from many doors. + 2 bathrooms that is clean and well maintained + Kitchen area for your dining needs + Very fast wifi  + Large TV for your entertainment needs + Location has an accessible bus stop which is 2 mins walk only + Very responsive host  The only negative thing that mostly I heard is that "The Bronx" has unsafe areas and highest rate of violent crime in the city, On my week of stay, this neigborhood is much safer than other area  P.S. 1 For your laundry needs, its better to do it on QUICK WASH(Open 24/7) which is 7 mins walk/4mins via bus P.S. 2 For long stay, you can request new bathrobes from them

The space is super clean and tidy, and Hershey was a great host who communicated clearly and frequently offered his support.  The one thing to be aware of when booking is the location. It’s easy to get around (Metro stop is close) but it can feel a bit sketchy and unsafe at night.

Marcel is very polite and friendly, always available to help and answer questions, the apartment is exactly as in the photos, extremely clean, well decorated, great value for money, you can book without fear.

Exceptional!   what an amazing find! Literally 2 minute walk to time square. The location is absolutely amazing, a really cute apartment with everything you could possibly need.  The host was great to deal with. really quick on replies. He also provided us with a guide for local eateries..... absolutely golden!!! amazing local knowledge.   This place is an absolute steal! could not recommend highly enough! Really hoping to come back in the future.

Thanks to Dahiana who always responded quickly to all our requests. The accommodation is well appointed, very quiet, well secured. The metro and the supermarket are only a few minutes' walk from the apartment. The neighborhood is quiet and we never felt unsafe during our 15-day stay.

This was a great place, small but so cute. Pictures are as described. Location is great. Cleanliness - 5 stars. Usually when I travel I gotta have a clean bathroom and this one was. Although I couldn’t get the shower to the right temperature because it was steaming hot or super cold lol   Check in/ out process was the easiest and non stressful.   Unfortunately I didn’t get to meet Adam, but he kept up with communication and responded right away when I needed something and didn’t mind me checking in a little later or even getting back very late.   Didn’t get to experience the roof top because of the rain but will definitely be booking again soon!   P.S that door is tricky but I think it’s because I had a few drinks in me already haha *when unlocking the door it’s counter clockwise.

I really enjoyed my stay at Adam’s. He’s kind and friendly, helpful if you need recommendations. The check in instructions were clear and I had no issues finding the place or getting in. The location is great - it was super easy to get to wherever I wanted. If you have time, and weather is nice, I highly recommend you get up to the rooftop, the view is amazing.  The only thing I cannot stress enough if you have bulky/heavy luggage - the stairs are brutal! 😂 so unless you’re super fit, getting such luggage up those stairs will be a challenge. 😁

Comfortable space that has everything you need - microwave and fridge, AC, a mobile heater, and awesome TV/Netflix/etc. Don't let the neighbors' barking dog scare you when you enter the house (they live in another apartment in the same house). .

Exactly like in the photos. The automatic check is super practical and fast, making everything very clear. I was afraid of the shared bathroom but it was not a bad experience, I almost never met the other tenants. The Harlem area is not the most beautiful to walk at night, but during the day it does seem safer.

Location:  • Central park is very close its like 3 minutes walk, metro is just few steps away, however most of nyc attractions are located in downtown manhaten while the appartment is located in uptown manhaten. You will always have to take the metro to vist any of the attractions for an average to long rides • Super market and laundry very close to the appartment  • We did not feel safe in the area as the appartment is surrounded by nyc public housing from everywhere. Moreover it is located in an area called harlem which has significantly higher crime rates that the normal crime rates in NYC (you can check online it). We even sometimes had the intercom ringing after midnight we don't know who was ringing it but it was very scary for us   The appartment:  • The appartment can accommodate up to 4 persons with convenient kitchen and bathroom  • The furniture is extremely fragile and of very low quality to the extent that we had several broken drawers that we could not use. • The stair case is very narrow so I don't recommend staying in a high floor if you have children or elders or heavy luggage. (The host has several appartments in the building between the ground floor and fourth floor) The host: • The host showed great flexibility when we requested to change from a forth floor appartment to a first floor appartment because of the narrow staircase • We had to pay 75$ in cash for checking        in around 6 p.m, it was mentioned that we have to check in between 4 and 5  but it was never mentioned that we will  have to pay extra if we checked in after  5 p.m • We were informed by the host that a private exterminator will visit the appartment around one week before we leave. We were told that we will come between 10 am and 1 pm and that not only ruined our plans for the day as we couldn't go anywhere except after the visit, but also the major problem was that he put chemicals in the kitchen's sink and since then we had many cockroachs in the appartment which was very disgusting and scary for us. • Honestly I don't know if this is normal or not but it was stated that we have to pay extra 830$ to add extra person in the appartment. I paid the full extra fee although we were only 3 persons at a time during only half the stay. I did not mind paying extra for additional guest but I think the full 830$ is not fair as we were not 3 persons for the full duration • We were informed around the middle of our stay that the check out will be at 10 a.m which is a very early check out btw • We were already paying 400$ included in our reservation as a cleaning fee. The host wanted to charge us extra 400$ again after the check out claiming that we left the appartment in a horrible condition although we removed all the garbage from the appartment, we even swiped the floor only one day before our check out. That horrible condition from his point of view was that we left some empty supermarket bags, a bag full of sealed food that we wanted to give away but we did not have time, hand sanitizer and betadine, and shampoos, toothbrush and paste in the toilette. So he wanted 400$ for removing the stated items. We even checked out 3 days before the due date but he still wanted to charge us.   Overall I can say that I had  an      extremely unpleasant experience with the appartment and the host. I can give it a 3 out of 10 rating.

Wonderful place! My family and I stayed here for 3 nights - Air conditioners in all the bedrooms and in the living room (but we were mostly comfortable without any AC). They made EVERYTHING you need and possibly forgot available including shampoo, conditioner, toothbrush. There were plenty of towels for everyone. Beds were extremely comfortable and pillows were heavenly. This place is such a steal for the price. Uber took 1-2min max. There were 5 of us - and the bedding should comfortably sleep 6. Overall 5/5, couldn’t ask for any better. They even allowed our cat to stay and gave us a discount on the pet fee bc we only stayed 3 nights instead of a week. Eduardo and his cohosts were amazing!! So easy to communicate with and almost immediately responsive. We would love to stay again.

I went to this place due to I have not got any permanent stay in other place close to my campus in Columbia Univeristy. For a month stay, it was relatively ok. Nothing unpleasant as far as I stayed there, roommates were nice too.
Great apartment and room within a shady neighborhood. Would still recommend it to a friend!

The house was  good maybe i had a terrible time . First thing was somebody took our key , second thing was the door was open already . No lock or nothing felt so unsafe . It was a shared space but private room thing . Our room door didn’t lock & it looked like someone had been inside of it. The couple next door to us was having sex so loud . After about 2 minutes inside i was ready to go. The surroundings were good just the ppl inside. The host didn’t want to refund us . The house had such a odd smell, like a brothel 🥲

The host is extremely rude and inconsiderate. A booking was made at 1am and I contacted the host multiple times within the hour of having booked to let them know that it was a mistake and we wouldn’t be able to stay. I canceled the reservation after waiting for the host to respond & requested a refund hoping that the host would respond sometime the next day. The host never responded to any of my messages & when I contacted Airbnb, the host refused to refund the night we paid for that we never got to use. I would suggest booking with a host of a better ethical nature rather than scammers willing to make money by any means necessary.

Max was very kind when we met, even though the room I had actually booked was taken up by someone else. (awaiting a refund) You should know that this is not sharing with the 'owner' but them plus 3 other random Airbnb people. Most people were tidy and nice but I did have to clean up and/or deal with some unpleasant hygienes. The walk to the stations is 12 minutes not 8. But it was mostly clean and new, they are working out getting new things for the place.   Generally, it kind of depresses me because these are the sorts of Airbnb places that are causing accommodation crisis across the world. But NYC is very expensive so this shared airbnb was a solution.

The apartment is very clean and nice！with lovely coffee bar！Room is very new just like the picture！They have very clean shower towel for everyone.  location：10 minutes walk from subway station～ good to go out at daytime but a little dangerous in night girls watch out  privacy：private room with own lock code. Apartment door has a key. The gate of building has a code.  *remember to bring brushes and slippers
The apartment was really nice for the price! Hosts were easy to contact, only downside is the area is a little sketchy at night/early morning, but other than that it was a great stay!

Great place, location is really good, the neighborhood feels a bit unsafe, but nothing happened to us. We were able to easily walk to the subway (there are 2 stations only 2 blocks away), and there are a bunch of shops (some outlets with great deals), restaurants, supermarkets and more! The apartment was really good! There was a cleaning crew every day making sure everything was spotless in the common areas! We will definitely look to stay here again when coming back to NYC. Thank you!
Nice central location and a relatively reasonable price, the street is loud and sketchy, but it feels safe enough.

I loved staying here and we will be back!! The front desk people are really friendly and caring! They made sure we had enough towels and all the information to get inside the building at late hours. Each of our guest got their own key card. They also made sure to explain how to use the heater and the guy even turned the heater on for us so it’s warm when we get in!! So kind!! It was in a prime location close to everything! Literally a subway right outside on the left. The other people staying in the hotel were friendly as well and nothing sketchy happened while we were there. It was exactly what we needed.

Stayed here because it was cheap and close to where I needed to go to every day, but definitely not an ideal place to stay. European hostels are much better than this makeshift hostel. When you walk in it feels like a morbid hospital setup. Very creepy and wouldn’t recommend unless you need to save money that bad. Basically turned a small apartment into 10+ person bunk bed horror.

This was a scam. DO NOT BOOK WITH SAUL. We arrived at the property and had to wait 30 minutes to get into the building. Once we were in, the cleaning lady for the property management group who actually owns the apartment told us we were trespassing because there was no booking under our name. I’m still not sure how Saul is able to list the apartment, but we had to get a full refund and move into a hotel while we figured out our next move. Please don’t fall for this scam.

I did not even stay during the duration of my stay because I felt unsafe. The room was moist and felt damp. Unfortunately I spent 1100 dollars on this room and that money was wasted as I had to find new accommodations last minute. I was disappointed with the size of the room and would not recommend anyone to stay until they fix the hotel. There were strands of hair on the bed, and the bathroom was dirty with stained towels. I would not allow anyone I truly cared about to stay here.

Overall a good place to stay! Michelle was an awesome host although I never interacted with her in person and she gave very detailed instructions for check-in, which was so helpful! Be aware that there are two shared bathrooms for 6 bedrooms so it is more of a "hostel" situation.   The only thing that would keep me from staying here again was the neighborhood. The building itself is in a very nice residential area, but I had an unfortunate experience at the closest subway stop that left me feeling unsafe. This would be an excellent place to stay if traveling with someone else, but as a solo female traveler I would pick a different area next time.
Unsafe location in New York City and the host is not willing to accommodate in any way. Do not book here.

Vigil is an amazing host, and the apartment is generally very comfortable with full amenities. Housemates/other guests are very respectful and considerate.   The neighborhood is in central Harlem, for a single traveler like me I did feel a little wary, but no real danger if you keep an eye out.   The room window faces the street and it can get loud, but Vigil mentioned turning on a fan in the background will help. Walls are thin in the apartment so being on speaker phone will be disruptive to other housemates.   What’s probably the best thing for the price point is the convenient location near 125th,  The apt is about a 6 min walk to the train station.

It was a good accommodation. The Location was okay. it took me about 8 minutes to the C connection and 12 to the A connection. In the night the streets are a bit sketchy but during the day it was fine. The owner is friendly and don't get frustrated by the door. It just a bit hard to open for the first time.

The place was nice and clean,cozy. Its an old building, old furniture,very thin walls,looks a bit unsafe at the entrance and inside the building but all in all it was clean and everything was in order. Good value for the money,owner did the best with what he had, meaning for an old building the place was very clean inside.room was small but well heated.location was ok,exactly as specified, might look a bit shady after dark for someone who lives outside US maybe (like me).all in all my stay was ok for the money.

The apartment is very comfy and clean. There was good communication with the owners. Very easy to check in and check out. However, the neighbourhood is very closed to brownsville which is a very dangerous neighbourhood. We went there without knowing that and it was quite shocking. For the rest, it was fine.

Although we haven't met Jennifer face to face, she was easy to communicate with, always happy to help us with anything we needed. The location of the apartment is very good, there is a subway station basically in front of the apartment. There are toiletries, towels and a few beverages for the guests, which is highly appreciated. However, I am giving two stars because the apartment wasn't clean enough, there are holes on the walls (the apartment is very old) and the duvet was given without a duvet cover. There is another person who lives permanently in the apartment and one night, while we were asleep at 2:30 am, this person started singing very loudly with the music extremelly loud. This lasted for 2 hours, in which, of course, we weren't able to sleep. The experience was a scary one. Obviously, this is not Jennifer's fault (she was genuinly concern about the incident) and maybe it was just a one-time thing. All in all, if we ever go to NY again, we wouldn't stay here.

My wife and I stayed at this property on November 2022; the apartment was just as advertised, extra clean and very well maintained. Tareb communicated very well before, during and after our stay at the property. Metro station to the city is within walking distance and neighborhood was safe; in couple occasions we walked to property after 10pm and we didn’t feel unsafe at all. Great value for the price!

Unfortunately the worst experience for us so far with Airbnb. Prior to arrival, the hosts wrote us that they would "upgrade" us to a better apartment in the same house. On site we were shocked. Dried up stains on the desk, dirt in the kitchen and bathroom, and the fridge full of food from the hosts, just to name a few things. We were totally uncomfortable and ended up having to move, causing us stress and increased costs.

I loved the apartment itself. It was spacious for New York and had everything I needed. Robert was a good communicator. We had some issues with the apartment but Rob and the super helped me with the issues in a timely manner.

This is advertised as a “multi-unit AirBnb”- but it’s really just a hotel.   Downsides: the street noise from the corner room is VERY loud. Honking, semi-trucks, and sirens all day and all night long. It’s not typical “sounds of the city” level noise. It’s single-pane windows/no insulation, might as well be sleeping on the fire escape, level noise.  To make matters worse, I visited in November and couldn’t control the AC (the individual thermostats are inoperable) and the room was super warm. The only way to cool it down was to open the windows. (Which, have no screens or bars and could seriously be dangerous if they are open and you have kids!) The combination of the noise and the heat made it very difficult to sleep. I don’t like sleeping with earplugs, but HAD to use them after sleeping terribly multiple nights in a row.  Upsides: the hotel is right next to a subway stop. The people who worked the front desk were super nice and communicative. And the bed was decently comfortable.

The space is great, we all had our own double bed each, which for women 50 and over is great! We did feel very unsafe to walk around the area, which is not Innes fault.  I just think we should of researched more about The Bronx before booking.   We caught Ubers home from Manhattan, which was approx. $60.00usd between 5 people, so not expensive. We did feel safe inside the apartment, and we had everything we needed.  As always NYC never fails to impress me, I love its buzz!!

We had several things Max helped us with such as early check in and taxes for Airbnb that are unique to NYC (specified on Airbnb site and made clear prior to reservation).  The Airbnb was large just like pictured and made a comfortable home base for our extended family to explore NYC while visiting.  Great proximity to Midtown where a family member was performing.  There were countless restaurants, shops and attractions within easy walking distance as well as several subway stations for nearly every line getting us anywhere in the city quickly.  The older members of our party were able to catch Ubers almost immediately including a 1 min hook up at 4:30 am back to the airport.  I never felt unsafe in the area, what a great trip!  We will look for this place when we return to NYC.  Thank you Max!

Positives: amazing views. Great location  Negatives: The phots on Airbnb are not real since they are not allowed to use airbnb in the building. They send you actual photos after you pay. Check in time not flexible since you can not enter the building without the owner because they are afraid that management will catch them. Check in was very awkward since some guy checked us in who claimed to be the hosts boyfriend. Not very comfortable because we were told to lie. Master bath sink was broken. I had to fix myself. No heat in either bed room. Blinds broke and fell. Did not work. We were told maintenance would come but no one showed up. Upon check out host texted us a photo of a cracked glass side table that was already cracked when we arrived. Also a pic of tiny wine stain on the couch. We did not do this. We take care of every property we stay in. Host asked for a ridiculous claim amount.

BP Hosting provided a phenomenally convenient stay for someone new to New York city. Communication was clear and helpful, including notification of package delivery. The amenities were exactly as described and all areas were professionally cleaned and maintained daily. Altogether a highly professional, convenient, and stress-free experience. I will highly recommend BP Hosting to anyone visiting New York City wanting a concierge experience.

The host responded promptly to questions and was very engaging.  the room was clean.  The common areas were cleaned daily and were immaculate.  Bathroom and kitchen were very clean and tidy.  It's pretty decent for this price.  I just didn't like the environment.  Harlem side gets a little dangerous at night.

Diego was very responsive and friendly. Check in instructions were super detailed & foolproof which made it stress-free! Super cute space that had everything we needed for a comfortable weekend in the city.

I had an issue with my hotel in Chelsea and found this spot during a last minute frantic booking freak out.  The room was significantly smaller than expected, no closet and no in room heater and was drafty af.  There was a space heater running in the room that just seemed unsafe but if it was turned off the room was unbearably cold.  However given that I was in a bind I didn't really have much room to complain.  Booking was super easy as was checking in.  The building is in a great spot, very centrally located, the staff were super friendly and accommodating.

Comfortable. Heating a little sketchy but owners were very accommodating. Utensils were very small and somewhat difficult to use. Bathroom could be cleaner. Owners live upstairs.  They made the stay a little more comfortable so if you needed anything they did their best to accommodate you. Walk with wash cloth as they were none available. (Not sure if it was an oversight but l also did not mention that to them).... overall it was a comfortable stay.
Man was very rude over the phone we almost was scared to go(for our safety)..but overall the room itself is good if your looking for a good quiet sleep.

Someone attempted to break down our door at midnight, and the hotel changed our keys and never tried to fix either until we pushed them on it. It was a very upsetting event and the hotel didn’t own up to it until we brought it to their attention. And even then they waited hours after we messaged them before getting back to us. It was really unnerving and I don’t recommend anyone stay here. It’s one thing if it was a mistake and the hotel immediately apologised, but the fact that they tried to hide this and didn’t take any remedial actions until we brought it to their attention says a lot. Most of the room doors in the hotel are left open throughout the day and anyone could go inside them. The code to the hotel door is visible from outside too. It’s a very unsafe environment.   The rooms are fine, if incredibly small. I would not recommend it at all, and would tell others to avoid this place. It’s very loud and the blackout curtains aren’t great. This hotel must have the smallest luggage storage room in existence. We had to empty it for 10 minutes to get our bags by removing everyone else’s first. Staff are rarely at the front desk and your room won’t be cleaned until you leave. Spend some extra money to go somewhere else.  They wouldn’t even help call us a taxi to the airport when we left. They told us to take the subway and didn’t offer any helpful advice.

Janelle is such a sweetheart. I felt incredibly safe, warm and welcome at her Airbnb. I traveled to NYC for an event and I was all alone. I didn’t feel scared at all and Janelle made it her priority to continuously check on me/make sure my stay was good. I recommend this Airbnb ❤️
The place is ok. The room is minimal.  The dangerous location, at night you cannot go out on the street.  It is close to everything but in a very ugly place.

Unfortunately this was my worst Airbnb stay ever due to the roommate that lives permanently in that flat. He is socially very awkward, was loud every night and also touched my food.  one night when he was drunk and was listening to loud music and had sex with his girl (walls are super thin you can hear everything!!), I asked him to be a bit more quite. He got super upset and got into my room violently. He assaulted me physically by hitting me and pushing me on my bed and denied to get out of my room. I had to call the police. I was super scared and left the Airbnb the next day. It’s irresponsible to let someone stay in this flat as long as this guy is in there !!    Really sad for the host because besides that the Airbnb was really nice!

• airbnb: photos and descriptions of the airbnb were accurate. all amenities, such as the laundry in-unit and ac were easily accessible for guests’ usage. my absolute favorite was the marshall's speakers!! carlos's place was definitely my kind of aesthetic, so i truly enjoyed my stay.  • communication: check-in and check-out went very smoothly, as carlos was very clear about their instructions. throughout our interaction, carlos was very accommodating, chill, flexible, and responsive to my concerns and requests. despite their situation with having limited reception, carlos went above and beyond by informing about their situation prior to my check-in time and preparing ahead on how i would reach out to them, should i encounter any potential issues. in one situation, i encountered a mice issue. this was a frightening experience, as i had no experience of properly getting rid of mice. at that time, i was already informed that carlos would be out of town. carlos was generous enough to provide their neighbor's contact information, who was conveniently located downstairs. thankfully, the issue was immediately resolved. carlos was very empathetic about my situation, so they were kind enough to provide additional offers. overall, this demonstrates carlos's ability to be understanding, as well as solve problems in a timely and professional manner for their guests, which was much appreciated.  • location: M line via Central Ave station was conveniently located five minutes away by walking distance from the airbnb. J line was about ten minutes by walking distance, but guests can easily transfer to there from the M line, as well.  traveling from the airbnb to Manhattan was doable, but still inconvenient, especially during the weekends, when the M line had limited hours. Traveling around Brooklyn, particularly to Dumbo district, was also complicated, as I still needed to make transfers.  personally, i felt unsafe in the Bushwick area, especially during the night time, as the airbnb was located in a compact, unlit, suburban area, so do expect surrounding noises, such as sirens and drunk passerby.  this was just my personal preference, but also good to note for future guests!   • overall: if i was visiting brooklyn again, i would definitely choose to stay at carlos's airbnb! during my interaction with the host, carlos remained very positive, which was enough to convince me that my stay at this airbnb would be comfortable and stress-free. if this aligns with your expectations in an airbnb, i highly recommend to make a reservation here!  thank you for sharing your space, carlos!

it was an amazing experience inside a hidden gem in the heart of the south Bronx beautiful area full of multicultural restaurants and the host is literally virtually never seen!! a lot of quiet in the area also be aware if you are a smoker you might want to reconcider since the hosts keep tabs on in and out and are always watching cameras to see what guests are doing also ...  please make sure someone verifies if the bathroom ceiling has a little hole and I am afraid I will end up in darkwebs please someone look into this preferably another guest soon!

I was SO worried this place was a scam simply because of how affordable it was and how clean the pictures look. There was absolutely NOTHING for me to have been worried about! Everything is exactly as pictured but better!! The staff was incredibly helpful. A bit noisy but the provide earplugs if you need them. So thankful we found SoHoBlu!! 🙏🏻

Brianna’s place was beautiful! She’s an amazing host. Extremely responsive and accommodating.   However I consider that for the price the place was not clean. Noticiable dust by the widow. The bed and towels had stains. The bathroom was so dirty I’m glad I brought Lysol and cleaning wipes to clean the bath tub and toilet.   The floor was also dirty and dusty. It looks clean to the eye but a few minutes inside and you start to see how dirty it was. Behind the TV there was sooo much dust it was scary to look at. Also the certain to the balcony had a very dark noticeable stain on it and let’s not even talk about the frame to go to the balcony   With that being said this place has soooo much potential! If the host can get someone to clean it deeply  and fresh sheets and towels could elevate this place completely. As well as some curtains on the window on the bed.

We spent five great nights at Arlenny's.  The room is completely as advertised: the bed is large, the room small but sufficient. It was also clean, with sockets, USBs also, a small refrigerator and air conditioning. However, we couldn't get the television to work. The windows don't close perfectly in the room, but that doesn't bother you. The desk doesn't really allow you to work there, firstly because the refrigerator is on top and secondly due to lack of space.  Overall, the room is simple but good.  As the bedroom is in Arlenny and her sister's apartment, we have access to the bathroom and the kitchen. Everything is generally clean. The bathroom is a little old but serves its purpose well. The kitchen is good too.  Other tenants, a couple, also have a room in the apartment; they are kind and discreet.  Arlenny is very kind, warm, with a smile. She is a great host, although she could communicate more with her guests. For example, we didn't really know what to do when we arrived at the bottom of the building.   Finally, if the price of housing, according to the New York prism, is cheap, it is because the neighborhood is special. This is the real Bronx, with all that goes with it; we can feel a little insecure, even during the day, without this being a problem. You have to be aware of it.   We were really very satisfied in any case; very good value for money!

Check-in instructions were vague before I arrived. It ended up being fine but caused some stress. The hotel is on the corner of Broadway and Canal which I quickly found are quite busy and loud most of the time. Bath towels were like rags. Just uninspired.

Terrible. Prepare for sketchy behavior. We booked for 4 members of our team originally for a corporate offsite. They refused to add another 1 member to the reservation even though the listing accommodates 10 guests. Their response when we mentioned this would make our lives difficult and defeat the whole point of the booking? "You can go meet the fifth person at a coffee shop nearby." If that's the case, I don't know what I'm paying 1400/night for.  We left after the first night and they still are trying to charge us for all nights. Our company is investigating all avenues (including legal routes, and routes that involve escalation to the city housing commissions) to collecting our stolen funds for services not rendered. AirBnB has been completely useless through this whole episode.  Be careful of Doriane and Hamich (her husband who she will foist you off on after she checks you in). Absolute scammers. I've been using AirBnB for 8 years and this is the first time I've had such a poor experience with a host. It's hard to imagine wanting to use AirBnB again after not just a horrible experience with the host, but AirBnB support as well.  Buyer beware!

Let me start of by saying host was very responsive and helpful. I had trouble with the door lock a couple of times even after following detailed instructions provided before arrival. Host was able to communicate with me and walk me through it which was appreciated.
