The room was decent but the noise from the garbage bins outside were so loud as well as all the plumbing that runs the ceiling making it very hard to sleep. The bed was not very comfortable and found hair on the pillow cases. The bathroom was shared so it was constantly occupied by other guest and smelled of mold and floor was constantly wet. The shower curtain needs to be changed as it’s dingy and moldy. The place served its purpose which was to shower and sleep. We didn’t even go into the kitchen so can’t speak on it. We were locked out in the entry way at one point as a guest locked the door from the inside, was stressful as we had a long day of walking and we’re exhausted unable to go inside our room.

I will totally recommend Thai place to stay , have been there  from Thursday to Sunday not a problem at all with noise or felt any danger around it . It’s a pretty nice place to stay , clean with all the things you might need . I will stay there again if I come back to NY. Sam is a great kind person to communicate with.

I don’t want to discourage anyone from staying here, but I also want to write a  transparent and honest review.   Dahiana was a great host. Fantastic actually. She responded very quickly to my messages and needs. She also asked me personally what actions she could take to improve my stay. I shared with her, and she was very receptive.   When we first arrived there was a soiled towel left on the floor, and the trash was not taken out. I let her know, and she assured me it wasn’t normal and that the towel was left there by a worker that did work on the unit. We had three guest and only two bath towels available, minus the dirty one. I let her know and she brought towels down within an hour or so.   We had a major issue with the plumbing backing up for no obvious reason. I reached out to Dahiana (there was not a plunger in the unit) and she sent her husband down to attempt to fix. Him and one other person came down with a plunger, mop and snake. They were unfortunately unsuccessful at solving the problem. We were told the plumbing issue was from the street and not the unit. She explained that leaves clogged the main drain and she happily reimbursed me for one night stay.  I would stay here again despite the issues we had. Most things seemed like a one time deal, but more importantly, I want to stress how professional, proactive and efficient Dahiana was when it came to solving the problems.   The apartment was cute and cozy, though not much sunlight. A few things I noticed was the living room tv is hung up, but no outlet to plug in to power it. The bedroom tv was lowly rigged with a cable draping over the closet door, making it harder to move in and out of the closet without ducking down under it, or getting tangled in it. The kitchen was fully stocked, even with some spices.   Over all, my stay was great in the Bronx, and I would most likely stay again regardless of the issues we had. Dahiana was attentive and she truly cared about issues we had. She cared so much that she refunded me for one night without me even asking! Excellent service.
The entire experience was stress-free and as expected.

Kaveh is a WONDERFUL guest and I had a wonderful stay. I've stayed at many places in New York and this was by far one of the best stays I've ever had. Kaveh is so welcoming and a fantastic host. The room/house was clean and I really felt like I had a lot of space both in the room and the entirety of the house. The house is special and I thought Kaveh went above and beyond to be a really welcoming host. Traveling can be stressful but staying here was like coming home and being able to fully relax. Would recommend to any and all!!!!! Thank you!

The space is as described, Linoy and his sister were very attentive, understanding and helpful. I was warned that there were constructions on site but during the period I was staying they started very early, around 7 am, which was a bit annoying. Bed very comfortable, sofa not so much. Well equipped kitchen, large bathroom with very hot water. There aren't many shops or food options close to the place, it's a bit deserted, but I didn't feel unsafe.

The studio looked exactly as in the photos. It was clean and modern. We had everything we needed there and even more. A little bit noisy from the street and neighbours if they have a party (we were there on thanksgiving) but for us it wasn't a problem and a little bit cold on the day we arrived. Localization was really good for this price - close to subway which makes it super close to Manhattan. The neighbourhood wasn't ideal, after all it's the Bronx. However We didn't feel unsafe although we tried to not come back super late. I would recommend this place :)

Melissa was a great host and was always in touch. The apartment was beautiful and tons of space. Great view.  The apartment does face the sun, so it was VERY hot during the day. And this was during the winter, so keep the heat at the lowest temp.  A concern was the bathroom door. You feel like you’re locked in every time, but you just need to give it a hard tug.   The elevator to the building going down doesn’t stop on the main floor, so you need to stop it at the second floor and take the stair (which were scary at first but not bad after you get used to it lol)  Lastly, the internet is awful . The tv didn’t work at all after many attempts.   Please also understand with this review, this was over the thanksgiving holiday, so we didn’t address these problems with the host. She might’ve been able to address the wifi problems. But as a tech person. I rebooted the modem, etc. no help.

The room they gave us was not like the one shown in the publication. On the third day we had an inconvenience since they gave the keys to an unknown person who we found using our room with our belongings.  After complaining and warning us about the incident, they offered to clean the room. To which we objected and demanded that they give us another room. Luckily we didn't lack anything but the situation was very unpleasant.

Lower quality Air bnb.   - It was extremely cold in the room. Maintenance were called, but just taped the window, and taped the curtains to prevent cold air coming in the room… but this was the only window we had, so we had no view and no daylight.   - While showering, the water didn’t go down the drain properly so the whole bathroom floor got wet, I had to use one of our only 2 provided towels to soak up the water, there is no bathroom mat. So we had just one towel left for 2 people. I mentioned the water leaking out and was provided with one extra towel, to keep us having just 2. And like I mentioned, it was extremely cold in the bathroom aswell.  - Only TWO towels are provided, non for hands/face. There is no bathroom mat.   - When we got back to the room after a long day out, our door was open, nothing was stolen that I know of, even though we had computers, cash etc. in there.   - Kristina and Joao (housemanager) are very kind.  - Larger room with two big beds which was good.

Had a wonderful stay at Carmen’s! She is the host with the most!   Pros: - Carmen provided EVERYTHING! Even food, greeted us with a nice bottle of champagne, all towels, toiletries (minus toothbrush/paste)! - Literally a 1 minute walk to the subway station, extremely convenient to go anywhere and everything is close! - There’s a whole foods right in front and it closes at 10pm so if you need anything, it’s so convenient to just get it from there!  Cons: - As with any New York places, there were few cockroaches but not overwhelming - It is on the 4th floor and NO elevators and the stairs are quite uneven so if you don’t have a steady gait, it will be a challenge to go up - There are quite a few homeless people right around there but they keep to themselves - Check in requires a meet up so you need to coordinate with the host. It was a bit difficult in the beginning to know where exactly to meet as it is an apartment complex so it wasn’t communicated in the beginning to meet in front of the unit number or the complex. I’ve never stayed in an Airbnb where check in was in person so this was new.  Overall, it was a wonderful stay especially the convenience! Carmen was very responsive and answered all my questions accordingly.

I have never been in such a thoroughly clean space! It was hands down the most lovely space to walk into and to sleep in. It smelled so clean, not fake air fresheners clean but actually clean with no unpleasant odors! The beds were very comfortable. There were 3 couples in our party and all reported that the beds were amazing. The location was very safe and it was less than a 10 minute walk to the subway to catch the N train to Manhattan.  There was a wonderful little coffee shop across the street from us which was very convenient for early morning coffee and  breakfast. Overall it was a great experience. My only suggestion would be adding a couple of  comfortable chairs in the living room. Since there were 6 adults in our party, we found it hard to get comfortable when we were just hanging out together in the evening.

Such a steal for a quick stay in the city. It’s at a great location in Tribeca, but you do hear the sounds from the street. Complementary ear plugs are provided but I didn’t need them as I was pretty tired and a deep sleeper. The room was great and the check in and check out was a breeze.
I did not find until i pressed him that he was sleeping in same space. The picture in bio is creepy and no shirt on. I did not go and would appreciate a precentage back or full refund.

First off, Vincent was very communicative, quick to respond and overall very amenable. My biggest issue was the parking and Vincent tried his very best to make the situation better. However, it took us over an hour to find a parking spot and when we finally located one it was about a 12 minute walk to the apartment. Not a big deal but we had two dogs and had been on the road for 10 1/2 hours. The location was a bit questionable and scary at times but it’s all relative to what your exposure has been. I will say, you get what you pay for. Once arriving to the apartment, it was clean and there were treats for my dogs and snacks for us. It was a nice touch and very much appreciated. This was a hard review as I think that it just wasn’t the right fit, given the circumstances. In all, Vincent was a class act and I appreciated the effort from start to finish.

A real gem! Great value, cute apartment, quiet and cozy. If you're just looking for a place to crash at night this place is perfect - nice bed, nice shower. Coffee and snacks were much appreciated! Great location, easy to get to the Q and B and cool restaurants and bars just 10 mins away. Really a steal for the price and quality!

Room was dirty upon arrival. After I received my room door was open as I got upstairs. Room not as advertised. If I received a penthouse the other regular rooms must be extremely small because my room seemed as a regular hotel room no space. Overall just felt really uncomfortable and unsafe.

Mchael’s space was incredible to be in. From the moment I stepped outside of the house, I was greeted with tall bamboo, warm light and smiles!    Mchael was helping another airbnb on their way out with their luggage and also checked in with me. From this moment, I immediately saw the level of care and respect for folks who were staying, not only during but after their stay. After he made sure the other Airbnber was good to go, he greeted me again and helped me with my luggage up the stairs.   Instantly the smell of warm vanilla incense filled my nostrils and warmed my spirit. I saw the layout of the space and honestly it looked even better than the already amazing pictures. Everything that was listed on the listing was there and then more. The space was clean, linens, sheets, towels fresh. Beautiful Black art and mirrors carefully curated and decorated the space. There were multiple books focused on Basquiat, Saba, Hip-Hop, and more. It made me feel welcomed immediately and excited to engage with the space.   The bedroom itself was a nice size! The fleece blanket is super warm and marshmallow soft. The bed was so comfortable, it made me excited to jump in it especially after a long ride and days of packing. The room was well organized and decorated.   The bathroom was super cute and had a deep tub with a wooden organizer for a warm bath with candles. The bathroom was well stocked with toilet paper to q tips to body wash (If I listed everything it would take me a while).   The kitchen was gorgeous, marble kitchenette, filtered water. Everywhere I looked there was a kitchen or cooking appliance, perfect for people who cook and chef it up for themselves or their guests. The couch was extremely comfortable and the space was well ventilated with AC and windows open. Huge bonus was the printer in space.   The location was great and the train was nearby! Also located in a beautiful community which was what I was looking for. Mchael was super helpful and located downstairs if I or my roommate needed support. I heard him helping them with directions and he checked in with me multiple times without being overbearing.   Mchael and Raheem’s communication was quick, speedy, accommodating and to the point. I missed my bus and Mchael told me not to stress. These points of hospitality, care, creativity, and beauty in the space has me excited to book again. I left early due to having to find long term housing and Mchael checked in to see if everything was okay and also affirmed me on my journey. It’s very clear to me the amount of love, details and respect that Mchael and Raheem invested in the space, people and overall energy. Thank you all so much for this beautiful stay.

Nolan is a great host, very friendly and opened. His house is a place you can feel like at home :) the flat is really clean! It has it’s specific smell, but it’s not unpleasant or bad, just specific :) Rooftop access is a gem, Manhattan view is amazing, works great both for sunset and sunrise, might be back when traveling to NYC :)

Do not book this place, no matter how desperate or last minute your housing needs might be. I planned a long term stay in the apartment because I was between leases. The check in was easy and my bedroom was clean, but that is where the good parts of this place end. When I moved in, I noticed that all the common living areas were extremely messy and dirty (dirty floor in the kitchen, dirty fridge, absolutely messy and dirty bathroom). I wanted to take a shower after my travel, and found the bathroom messy and dirty with pieces of broken glass in the shower drain. I tried to clean up a little so I could at least shower, and when trying to flush the paper towels I used the toilet was clogging. When I tried to use the plunger, dirty water and feces came pouring out of it, spilling all over the bathroom floor and myself. I can only assume this feces water had been sitting in the plunger for a while since its last use, which is clearly a health hazard. After the broken glass and unclean plunger, I contacted the host and received no answer. When I went back into my room, I noticed that one of the roommates was acting erratic and loudly laughing and speaking, but I assumed they were simply on the phone and that it would end soon. I was wrong, and the roommate was not on the phone. They continued this erratic behavior from 4PM (my move in) until 3AM that night and then again at 7AM the next day until I moved out, preventing me from getting any sleep and leaving me feeling unsafe in the space. There was several empty bottles of alcohol in the house which paired with the erratic behavior made me feel uneasy in the space and unsafe leaving my possessions alone in the apartment as the rooms do not lock unless you are inside. I contacted AirBnB to start a case, and had to move out and book a same day flight home because I did not feel safe in the space and received no help from AirBnB finding another space. After many handovers of my case, I am getting a refund, but there was no guarantee of this until I followed up multiple times to make clear the state of the apartment. As a woman traveling alone, the neighborhood and the street the apartment was on did not feel safe, especially because the only door that locks is the main building door, and there is no way to lock the apartment door if you aren’t inside (which was not disclosed)  or lock on the bedroom door. You are unable to receive mail safely because any mail would have to be left outside the building and is very likely to be stolen.  Overall, please stay away from this place. I wish I had a review like this when i took a chance on the place to save me the headache and wasted money, but I hope it can help someone else.

It was ok. Location was great, and the early check-in time was very appealing. Unfortunately the early check in time was listed accidentally and the space wasn't ready when I got there. I was able to get sheets to put on my bed and they smelled clean but were covered in stains. The towel I received was ripped in half, which was kinda funny but would have been bad if I didn't have an extra. Also the blanket was clearly leftover from the previous person. The furniture/decorations in the images are not the furniture/decorations in the space, much poorer quality. There was hair in the shower drain and I had to plunge the toilet because it was a bit rickety. When I came home one night the door was wide open which was kinda scary. I probably would not stay here again.

Disaster…the place needs quite a lot of work…. The worst part was the dirt in the bathroom- it looked like it wasnt cleaned for months… it was not a decent place to stay at all. Looked more like a scebe from a scary moovie so after sleepless night we decided to leave early in the morning and asked Berni for refund for remaining days- the conversation was nice and seemed as we all understood everything and agreed on all. Unfortunately once we left she immediately changed her mind and started writing bad things… thank god we contacted airbnb support before leaving and had pictures and videos documenting all.. so airbnb decided in our favour to refund us.  Terrible and unpleasant experience…
Very nice apartment and conveniently located near a major subway stop. Amazing stay at a steal price.

The Emeline's room is really tiny, with some kind of a bunk bad with no lower one, which was apparently put there in an attempt to make best use of the tiny space. In the end, it is uncomfortable, even dangerous to climb and especiall get down by using the tiny ladder. As for the space below, well, I have no impression neither that it is well used now nor that it is at all possible to make a good use of it. So, I'd say the room would be much better off with a normal bed. There is only a central light in the room, so if you want to read in bed, you are obliged to go down by the ladder, turn the light off and then climb up again when you want to go to sleep. There are two electrical sockets in the room, but on the same place, to far from the highly placed bed, to, for instance, have a phone being charged and at hand at the same time.  The view from the window (which is obstracted by the bed itself) is not the best, actually a mix of a scarry and a good one (if you look a bit to the side, you can see the one world tower in the distance, but actually you face the ugly wall of an adjacent building at just a few meters away from the window). I really hated climbing to the bed, but on the other hand, the mattress is huge and comfy. The kitchen appliances are new and fine, but the kitchen is very small. The toilet and the shower are reasonable. My main concern was that the door lock needs pulling and pushing to get it clicked and being able to actually open and close the apartment. This was really frustrating, I ended up thinking of whether I would be able to enter at all, going home in the evening. The location is great, and seems to be safe, very touristy, yet there is no noise in the apartment, as it is oriented to the back yard. There is a great deal of restaurants and bars in the neighborhood. Emeline is nice and open to assist. Communication was efficient (mostly) and she was very kind.
Anna was responsive and helpful. The neighbourhood was a bit loud, but I think that's to be expected. We never felt unsafe.

I had an excellent stay with Dana.  I think it's very important when staying at an AirbBnB, that you get along with the host. Dana is someone, I think, could get along with almost anyone, and make them feel at home. She is easy going, kind and warm. Also she runs things efficiently, with easy communication, lifting a lot of stress from your travel.  The room is lovely - better than the pictures. Rather large too. Bed is comfortable, and the place is very clean. The Neighbourhood is really nice and quite, and safe, which was important for me, since I got home rather late in the evenings. Slightly farther from the city, but still well connected by train. I can't complain for the price...  I would happily recommend Dana's place, and only regret not booking it for longer...

Hands down the best AirBnB experience I have had to date!  The Brookstone apartment was impeccable, classy, comfortable, private, clean, etc. It was exactly what the hosts display and then some.  I will be going back and have already recommended it to my friends and family.  It's the the best steal in NY :-)  Thank you both.....

Judith and Tom were very helpful. The home was beautiful, as well as the neighborhood. Had all the accommodations I could wish for , from a short to long term stay. Quite a steal for such a lovely place. Thankyou so much for the wonderful stay and I hope to stay again one day !

Host: The place is very easy to find and my host Monifa are very ver nice to us! She responded very quickly to my messages, and tried her best to provide me with everything additional that I asked for.  Parking: Free street parking is certainly a plus if you are driving! (Don't forget to move your car to the right side as there will be street cleaning except for Wednesdays. I got all this information from my host.)  The apartment: The room is spacious! I stayed at this apartment with my parents. There is a sofa bed for me, which is very comfortable! There is kitchen, fridge, bathroom, washing machine (during my stay it's broken), dryer and basically everything.  The neighborhood: It seems nice and safe. There is some sketchy area nearby, but as long as you don't walk around too late, I guess it shall be fine! It's very very close to subway station, grocery stores, and restaurants! It's about 40 minutes to manhattan if you take subway. Cons: It can be a bit noisy as you will be staying on the ground level. You can hear footsteps and people talking upstairs--but overall, they are very quiet except around 10pm and 8am, which is totally manageable!  On the Christmas eve, there was a woman shouting outside of the apartment at around 4 am. Pretty scary, but it only happened once!

We spent 13 days and therefore 12 nights in Monifa's apartment in Brooklyn. This was our first experience on Airbnb and NYC. So it was all new to us. And honestly it was great. Monifa lives just above and is very available. She gives a lot of advice, she is always there to help if needed. The apartment itself is very spacious, the bed is large and comfortable and everything was very clean. The metro is a minute's walk from Nostrand Avenue station on an express line to reach Manhattan in 20 minutes.  The only negative point we found is that if we had to do it again we would have taken an apartment in Manhattan and not Sir Brooklyn because after a long day of walking we have to return to Brooklyn and then come out in the evening.  Finally, this is of course independent of the apartment itself. The neighborhood is a bit of a "neighborhood", it's not the prettiest but it's secure. We came home late every evening and were never bothered. In short, if you are not afraid of wasting a little time in the metros and you are looking for good value for money, I strongly recommend this apartment. Thanks again Monifa for everything it was Awesome! !! Thank you monifa

We had a great stay in New York staying with Saya and Diego. From our first email exchanges, contact was easy and their responses very quick! The accommodation is fully consistent with the description and we were able to take advantage of their small garden at the back in the morning to have a little coffee before our long day of walking in Manhattan. The fact that there was no kitchen was not a problem as we could have breakfast and we ate in town.  The best part of the accommodation is really the metro station two blocks away! Knowing that we walk a lot during the day, we are really happy to get home in the evening in just a few steps! The neighborhood is pleasant, the area is not very rich but we don't feel insecure at all! And there is everything nearby: bakery, laundromat ($1 for laundry!!!), and supermarket. In summary, we would return without any worries and will recommend to our loved ones!

This apartment is really spacious and the hosts are really nice. They respond very quickly to any concerns you may have. The apartment has no kitchen or means of preparing any food except coffee, tea and anything you can stick inside a microwave. That being said, it's a short walk to Utica Ave where there's lots of food for purchase. There's also a Popeyes and Mc Donald's within walking distance and the train is also within walking distance. The neighbourhood is very creepy and it's really dirty.... But I suppose most places in Brooklyn are dirty with trash all over..... And if you're renting a car, be ready to drive around to search for parking.

This accommodation definitely deserves the Superhost award! Monifa is a great host, very kind and helpful and has provided everything you could wish for! Even the fridge was stocked, a small basket of goodies on the bar, in the bathroom there were shower things and even lotion among all the other things - just great! It's like the pictures, actually even more beautiful. We immediately felt comfortable and really enjoyed our stay. The kitchen is super nice and practical, the beds are comfortable, the bathroom and everything else is very clean, the whole accommodation is just a joy. The metro is very close and it's pretty lively, but if you turn the corner towards the accommodation it's quiet and very neighborly. This corner of Brooklyn seems like a nice, family-friendly neighborhood with a lot of commitment to social projects and clean streets. The streets are like avenues and there are many churches of different religions harmoniously next to each other.  Every now and then you see residents sitting on the stairs reading the morning newspaper and are always open to kind words. I would describe the area as safe because it was our first time in New York and so we often returned very late. We were never approached in any way. Our daughter only felt a bit unsafe at the subway entrance, but that's common in large German cities. We would have liked to stay longer and definitely want to come back - and hope that Monifa and Saint will take us again :-)

Great house! I’m a lil bit surprised by the neighborhood because it seems scary but it’s not, I just came from Times Square around 12am & it’s kinda safe from me to walk from subway to the house. They all have the amenities we need. They always make sure that we have what we need. Thanks guys!

The basement unit is very spacious and clean! Internet is pretty fast and reliable as well. The closest metro station is an express stop so the ride to Manhattan is cut short most of the time!  The immediate neighborhood seems a bit dirty and unsafe, although we didn’t run into any issue during our two-week stay.

Elvis was a fantastic host! Everything was very clean, quiet, and accessible! Elvis recommended restaurants and gave us full use of the space, very nice 5th floor walk up. Neighborhood is a little rough but I never felt unsafe and the subways were very close. Surprisingly quiet and very, very reasonable price.

The apartment was great, spacious, clean and very sunny.  The apartment is located in a very beautiful neighborhood, we came home late at night and never felt unsafe. The Utica Av. station is ten minute away and in 20/30 minutes takes you to lower Manhattan. Katerina is an excellent host and I would highly recommend staying at her place.

Just like expected clean and functional. Neighbourhood was interesting but not scary at all. We felt very safe at all times while walking to the subway. Thomas and Gaby are superb hosts. We even found a bottle of wine in the fridge as this was our 25 year anniversary trip which was a lovely surprise :-)  The bathroom is great with a good shower. Not throwing anything into the toilet was a bit odd at first but we got used to it pretty quickly. As it was really hot during our stay we did miss an air-con however ;-) But listing did not include one and we did not pay enough attention to that fact. Thomas even gave us a ride on our way to the subway onthe last day as there was a thunderstorm. Overall a great experience!

Gaby and Thomas have been wonderful hosts. Our first AirBnB experience and they have helped us a lot.  The apartment is BEAUTIFUL. Clean, it seems like we just started it. The shower with perfect hot water, the MA-RA-VI-LLO-SA bed with a memory foam mattress, a kitchen with everything you need to be able to eat and cook well at home... TV, Wifi with a very good connection at all times and speed, a beautiful decoration (many books! magazines, photo and art books...(Especially Gaby's travel book is great!) They were waiting for us even when we arrived late at night, and with the luxury of a tremendous gift: many little things to be able to have breakfast and even eat the next day (milk, bread, jam, butter, pasta, soft drinks, rice... a thousand things!!!) A very detailed explanation of the services in the area, even a little booklet so we could review the closest tips and places within our reach. The house with great heating and a lot of silence to rest. The neighborhood is an area of working people and families. It's just ten minutes away and you have two subway stops to reach Manhattan in half an hour. Enjoy Brooklyn. If it's at Gaby and Thomas' house, BETTER!!!! We'll be back guys!!!! (thanks for the cough syrup when I got sick!!)

We met Thomas at check-in as an easygoing and accomodating host. We're sure he and Gaby would have been easily reachable if we needed their assistance during our stay. The basement flat has a low ceiling but is very spacious. The neighbourhood took us a day to get used to, but we never felt unsafe walking to/from the subway (also at night). We recommend their place for its great value!

A friend and I had a great stay in Katerina's apartment while on vacation in the US for a week. The place was quite spacious and nicely designed, and had all amenities you would need for a short stay. Communication with the host was perfect, and Katerina provides you with lots of information about her apartment so that everything runs smoothly from check-in to check out. While the neighborhood probably isn't the most glamorous in New York, we never felt unsafe there and would recommend it as a base for visiting NY if you are happy to take the subway into Manhattan each day.

hello everybody,  if you are just need a payable place to sleep, this is what you are looking for. Thomas is very kind and the price is the lowest you can get in this area. The apartment is in the basement of the house. It smells a bit odd and it is a little bit dark. The height of the ceiling is very low, so it's maybe not for tall people.  The neighborhood was not very clean and we felt a little bit unsafe. [Conclusion]: what you pay is what you get. [+]: The connection to lower manhatten is very fast by metro A. [-]: not so charming neighbourhood.

This place is so cozy and cute, and quite honestly a steal! Ariela and fam are so welcoming, I honestly felt like if I needed anything they'd be happy to help. It's a wonderful apartment and I really was sad to leave.

The space is nice, it is just like the photos and it is comfortable. Some kitchen and cleaning items are missing to make your stay more comfortable. As for the location, it is in a neighborhood that although at first seemed somewhat dangerous to us, since it is on the outskirts of NYC. It's very quiet and we never felt unsafe coming back at night. Gaby welcomed us well but then we didn't have much contact with them, except on the last day when Gaby helped us book a Taxi.  As for other things in the apartment, although it doesn't bother us, it is never made clear that it is located in the basement of the house. Therefore, it was necessary to go down some steps to enter and go up to exit. In terms of cleanliness, we received the apartment very clean. But then with the rain it was noticed that the entrance was filled with dirt and stagnant water which caused a bad smell. For that reason the apartment became very dirty. Something that seemed strange to us was that at the back, where we think the access to the patio is, there is a curtain that overlooks a hallway. And several times when we returned or woke up the next day we noticed that the hallway light was on or off. Giving the impression that they entered the apartment when we were not there.

The apartment is comfortable and pleasant to rest after a day of walking around New York, the subway station is approximately 10 minutes walking, there are some shops around, the neighborhood where it is located is not the most luxurious in the area but for the cost it is worth getting there, the streets do not feel unsafe to get to the home, the apartment has everything you need, a small kitchen with the essential items that allow you to prepare food, which allows you to save money and time before going out to explore the streets of the city. We never met Gaby but Thomas' attention was good.

I stayed here for about two months and overall my stay was exceptional. The place is roomy as it is the entire basement. There are a lot of nice touches and the kitchen was perfect for home cooking. The surrounding neighborhoods may look a bit sketchy but I never encountered nor saw any problems. The grocery and subway are a couple blocks away and Utica Ave had plenty of shops and eateries. The host was very quick to respond and made me feel at home. Would stay here again.

Gabby and Thomas were very well at communication and flexible with check in times . However, I am not sure if that makes up for some our terrible experiences during my time there. The sofa beds were just as bad as sleeping on the floor(maybe worse). The bed inside the room was manageable. During my first night I had to kill a cockroach and then saw another one later in the week. There were also two dead insects by the bathtub. Towards the middle of the week Gabby was arguing with a neighbor right in front of our entrance and we became slightly nervous as to why she seemed to be guarding our door. Additionally, as a result of Hurricane Henri we stayed in for a day. During that time they opened the entrance to our space and began hammering for a significant amount of time and were invading our space. To add, the neighborhood was not as safe as they made it out to be. Sure, people left you mostly alone, but there were certainly sketchy areas we had to go through during our walk to/from the subway station. All in all, you get what you pay for. It wasn’t the best experience, but it was okay for a week long stay. I do want to thank them for delaying our check out time due to our late departure.

The perfect apartment for your visit to New York! We felt very comfortable here and were able to recover well from the strenuous days.   Everything is as shown in the pictures. The environment is great, we never felt unsafe at any time.

We had a few issues during our stay. Ariela makes note in her listing that you may here her 3 year old from time to time, which was completely understandable and expected upon check-in, however she also noted that it's supposed to be quiet time by 10pm. But much to my dismay, one night there was very loud banging until around 2am and began again the same morning at 8am. So loud that even my friend who sleeps with ear plugs in could hear every bit of it. Which left us very sleepy and aggravated for our last day in the city. Also, upon arrival there were packages in the entrance hallway, when we asked Ariela to relocate them so we did not hurt ourselves she said we simply could avoid the hallway. I know this place was a steal compared to others in the area but if I am paying for the entire place, I would like to utilize the entire place and not worry about hurting myself walking through the hall in the middle of the night. Overall, place was cute and within a reasonable distance to the city but with the noise issues we will not be staying again.

I loved Arielle’s place! It was beautiful, spacious, and super comfy. Traveling with 2 dogs is always a hassle, and finding a pet-friendly place to stay makes it even more so. I was delighted with the size and layout of Arielle’s place! The door from the kitchen opens directly into the backyard, which faces the other neighboring yards, so it was perfectly secluded. There was a cute patio under the shade, nicely set up for a place to chit chat and drink coffee. In addition to a full kitchen and updated bathroom, there is also laundry & dryer! Lastly, i thought that parking in nyc would be a nightmare, but i was pleasantly surprised that we always managed to find parking-during the daytime and night! Granted, we stayed here on the weekday, so it might be different on the weekend. There were lots of cute restaurants open within a <1 mi. walking vicinity as well. All-in-all I am super happy with the place and our experience! 100000% would stay here again, esp when traveling w dogs!  Summary: - pet friendly - awesome amenities (full kitchen, updated bathroom w bath tub, laundry & dryer, etc) - spacious! - private entry & backyard space (You have the entire bottom unit) - parking was good (not amazing but would grade it as a B for the weekday) - restaurants, cafes, & parks in walking distance  - felt like a safe neighborhood (I walked my dogs at 2:30a w/o any problems) & neighbors were pleasant! - slightly further from downtown brooklyn so make sure you keep transportation in mind  - great communication from host & awesome, thorough instructions
Checkin was easy. Got the keys on time! Everything as it appears in pics.  Awesome neighbourhood.  Easy access to subway, grocery, drug stores and restaurants Andre is great host!

This was an excellent experience. The hosts (Audrey and the others) were very professional--welcoming and inviting but not overbearing. They provided us with everything shown on the listing and gave us tips about how to get around, where to eat, and anything else we asked them about.   The apartment was very nice. We were given a small bedroom and our own bathroom to use. What really made it was the location--unbeatable! We were right in the middle of Manhattan, just a few blocks from Times Square. Easy to get around via the subway/buses (we bought a 7-day Metro card, which quickly paid for itself). Close to incredible food and anything else you could need. In spite of the central location, the apartment is far enough back from the street that most/all of the street noise is eliminated. This place is perfectly located, especially for the price.  If you decide to drive to New York (as we did), do NOT try to drive into Manhattan. We left our car just across the river at a parking garage for ~$12/day (a fraction of what you'd pay in Manhattan) and then caught a ferry across the Hudson (see nywaterway.com for more info -- "Port Imperial/Weehawken" terminal). Saved us a ton of money and stress.   Overall no complaints, just a whole lot of great things to say about this place! I highly recommend it to anyone considering a trip to NYC. It's the perfect home base from which you can explore the city and all it has to offer.

Mike’s place is stylish and is situated in a convenient location with easy access to Times Square and other attractions/ subway within walking distance. Plenty of dining areas nearby. You will also get a friendly welcome by AJ Bandit...who has stolen our hearts. Definitely recommended to stay!

Julie welcomed us very friendly and openly when we arrived. She had already printed out a map of the area with all the shopping and dining recommendations, as well as a whole list of free attractions.  The train station is very close to the apartment and the neighborhood is very quiet and friendly, so it wasn't unpleasant to walk home even in the dark. The apartment itself is fantastic! Although it is advertised as a private room, it is actually its own separate apartment with a kitchen, living room, bedroom and a tiny bathroom. A little kingdom of your own, perfect for 2 people... You don't notice much of the other residents in the house unless you're looking for contact.  The stay was very great and I hope to be lucky enough to stay here again on my next visit!

Pros: The house had all the comforts needed, including washing machine and dryer. Garnet was an amazing host that always answered within 1 hour max. The sheets were clean, as well as the towels we found on the bed. The shower worked well and the temperature inside the house was perfect. The kitchen also had all the utensils that might be useful to cook and dine in or also to cook and take out (e.g. tupperwares) which was a great way to spare money.  Cons: there is only one problem: the neighborhood. Being two girls we were often scared as there are not the best people around, but If there was a man with us maybe we would have felt safer. Anyways if you usually don't worry about this stuff, It will be the perfect solution.

Victor's place is charming, artistic and authentic providing everything you need and is surely lovelier than a hotel room (although you might get afraid of the radiator's noises at night haha). Victor is a very friendly host that pays attention to whatever you may need including serving delicious bagels and coffee or tea in the morning. He had an answer to all of our questions and was around when we needed him. If you have the time for a little longer subway ride, you'll experience another side of the oh so busy NYC plus an adorable Airbnb stay!

As this was my first Airbnb rental, I wasn't sure what to expect. Matt made this experience stress-free and wonderful as he was in constant communication to ensure that I was comfortable with the entire process. He even went the extra step and dropped off keys with my local relatives so that we could go straight to the apartment and get settled when we arrived. The apartment was just as it was listed on the site and was the perfect space for my daughters (7 and 9) and I during our visit. His detailed house manual provided any and all information needed on how to function in the space. We will definitely be booking Matt's space again when we come again!

Our stay at Victor's place was perfect! He was so nice too let us check-out later and told us what not to miss in NYC. Location is great, close to the subway. We felt safe, the neighborhood was a little sketchy at night tho.
Victor is really nice and the room is cosy. sketchy neighborhood but not far from subway.

A great central location to explore and discover all areas of Manhattan. James is an excellent host and provided all the necessary amenities to make my stay easy and stress free. I would recommend his places to anyone coming to New York for any amount of time.

Jim seemed nice via text but he was unable to meet us at his apartment and we had to get the key from a friend a few blocks away.  The couch is unbearably uncomfortable.  Bathroom very small.  The bed is great.  I did not like to be informed of the downstairs neighbor's need for us to walk in stocking feet, not a big deal, just kind of an unpleasant thought to be concerned about. Seemed silly when there was a raucous party on Friday and Saturday, and we could hear the people thumping around upstairs.  No coffee maker, filthy microwave, a variety of bugs.  Next time I'm renting a hotel room for a few bucks more and saving myself the unknowns.

First, the good things about Stara's place. It's in a great neighborhood that's fairly safe and accessible to everything you'd ever want to do/see in NYC. It's quiet by city standards and nicely decorated, except for the old, tiny bathroom. Comfy bed and linens. Easy check-in and check-out.  The bad thing is the shower, which is dangerous. When my husband and I checked in, Stara stated that the water was hot and that the hot/cold knobs were reversed. Actually, the water was at scalding temperature, and I got a second degree burn on my back trying to get out of the shower. My advice is to turn the water off/on or adjust it only when you are completely out of the shower.

These five-star reviews don't even begin to do justice to the overall experience of staying at Jim's place! I traveled to New York for graduate school auditions and was looking for a quiet place to relax during a stressful week- this lovely space was perfect! From check-in to the moment I left, my experience couldn't have been better. Jim was a fantastic host- it seemed as though every small detail had been thought of and the space was welcoming and clean. I cannot recommend staying here enough- Jim is the perfect example of what an Airbnb host should strive for.
This was our first Airbnb and Jim set the bar so incredibly high that I'm afraid our next one will not be as good.  Everything was exactly as stated.  Jim was awesome and the apartment was great.

The stara department was a disappointment and the price-quality ratio is not reasonable. The location is the best, in the middle of Soho neighborhood, very convenient and easy access to anywhere in Manhattan. The first bad experience with Stara was after she confirmed the reservation, because before the deadline for payment occurred, the reservation fell and to my surprise, Stara replied that the apartment was not available any more. But I told her this was not correct, and against the rules. So she sent me again the confirmation of the reservation to be able to pay with any explanation. Once in the apartment, we found some surprises. The apartment is called "chic" but the "chic" is superficial: the bathroom is very uncomfortable as small as it is. The toilet was easily clogged (almost every day) and it once overflowed!! The shower jets very hot and then very cold water while you are bathing!! The whole bathroom is over painted and the paint is peeling giving a very unpleasant appearance. The kitchen is so small that you can not take advantage to prepare any food. There is almost no kitchen counter available to support anything. There is no kettle, no toaster, no microwave. The living room is comfortable (good sofa but very dirty carpet) and the bed is also very comfortable.  We found the apartment clean and tidy and with enough room in closets for our clothes. We had a very unpleasant experience with the garbage: the building in general is very dirty. The staircase and hallways are obviously not cleaned in months. There is no room for garbage but there is a place on the ground floor intended to leave the waste. The problem is that since there is no closed room, the smell of garbage is unbearable. One morning, the smell of garbage was so strong that I woke up in the morning with the smell coming up from the ground floor. In general the department does not have any type of indication and for every doubt or inconvenience had to write to Stara via Airbnb.
This apartment is not identical to the photos. Seems like a decent stay. However be prepared for a  very small, unpleasant bathroom. I lasted 3 hrs

Best Air BnB Stay ever! Since New York is a very expensive place to stay as a tourist and it is not easy to find an awesome place in Manhattan. This was honestely hands down the best Air BnB experince we ever had! Rob has made sure we feel like home and has helped me with any questions prior to our stay, transport and sights - so incredibly helpful and kind. He even left us a bottle of wine and helped us with the airport transport. The photos of the apartment actually don't do it justice - it is super modern, beautiful and super spacious. There is nothing that you will miss in this apartment - it truly was a home away from home. The apartent is super close to the 207 subway station (weekly pass only 30 $) which will get you directly to Midtown and even JFK airport, so handy! It will take probably abt 20 mniutes to get you to Times Sqaure - super conviniently. Also there are delis close by to stock up on food and groceries. There are also great restaurants in the neighborhood. It is so quiet which is amazing after long, loud and busy days in the city centre. This is a neighborhood where New Yorkers really live which I find great as an individual traveller. Its a super safe neighborhood and I would stay at Rob's apartment agian in a heartbeat. Could have not been better!!!! Thanks Rob for an amazing stay!

This was my first experience with AirBnB, and Rob definitely made it a memorable one! He is so considerate and kind, and made everything so easy. He communicated with me weeks before our trip, asking if we had any concerns and offering advice for local tourist spots, called me when we arrived at the actual building and walked me through how to get to his apt., and even checked in mid-trip to see what we were up to.   Rob is an amazing host with an amazing home! Pictures don't do it justice at all!! It is beautiful and spacious.    At one point in time, my girlfriend asked, "is there anything you don't like about this house?" and I had no answer for her. I strongly recommend this space.   Best,  Levi

We had a really terrific visit to Rob's place!  It was clean, quiet, comfortable with a very well equipped kitchen. Rob clearly went out of his way to provide excellent information on nearby services - restaurants, transportation, etc. And a few personal touches, including a very nice bottle of wine, made us feel quite at home.

Rob made me feel very welcome and the bottle of French wine that he provided was very nice and welcoming.  Rob's place is a gem. A very homey apartment and the location was great for me - only 10 minutes from my son's apartment and my new grandson and daughter in law too.  As it was very cold and often snowy I didn't get around the neighborhood. The park looked great and I'm sure it would be nice but not in the winter for me. I'm from Jerusalem!  The kitchen is fully stocked and I very much appreciated the special salt collection.  I can't recommend Rob's place high enough. It is great and I'd be happy to stay there again if the opportunity arises.  Great host, great apartment, a nice place to drop your head.

Definitely a 5 star review. Rob's apartment was impeccable, on a quiet corner. There are beautiful parks all around and great places to eat. Rob was exceptionally helpful and even checked in via text during our visit to make sure everything was going well. The bed was super comfy, the kitchen excellent, the bathroom super modern. Best AirBnB experience yet.

Booking Rob's apartment was our first airbnb experience. Rob was active as a host right from the start and asked if he could help us. We found him to be very courteous and helpful. The apartment looks exactly like the photos, we didn't feel strange at all. The location is perfect, the facilities are great, everything you need is there. A big thank you to Rob, we wish him all the best!

Rob's place was very clean and beautifully decorated. He reached out ahead of time to insure our trip was a success. He was very responsive to any need. My first airbnb experience and it was awesome. We enjoyed being able to stay in the same neighborhood that our daughter and her family live in. Thank you Rob for making it possible

We had the best time staying in New York in Rob's apartment. He was a very nice and caring host. We could always call him from his home phone, if we had any questions or problems.  Taking the A train from 207th Street into the city was perfect to get in fast. Once you're at Columbus circle you can easily transfer to other trains or go straight into the Central Park. The best grocery stores we found were Associated and some in the Bronx. In the evening we enjoyed cooking in the perfetly filled kitchen. We found everything we needed there and more. :) The nights were a little bit noise, bute we guess quite good for NYC and in the bedroom it got bright quite early (6:30am). But still we wouldn't have chosen any other place! It's been really lovely and made us feel at home. Rob, thank you so much for everything!  Best wishes  Jenny & Stephan

We had a great stay at Robs apartment. It is really gorgeous and spacious I would thoroughly recommend. Rob was available at any time to help and kindly left lots of information about the local area for us. There is not a bad word I can say about this place and it's great value too!   It is further away than the hot spots to stay in in NYC but it is very accessible by subway and taxi. If you are looking for somewhere close to the sights I would suggest staying more central.   Thank you Rob for a great stay :)

Honestly, there are no words that can describe the warmth and kindness of Maria and Rob. Not only did they welcome us with a bottle of wine but they were attentive to us at all times without being invasive. The apartment is BEAUTIFUL and super clean. The bathroom was IMPECCABLE and the bed was VERY COMFORTABLE. The location of the apartment VERY close to Metro A. The splendid area: residential, family-friendly, quiet at any time and day of the week and with many businesses and cafes just a few steps away. Beautiful parks surround the building. I hope to return on my next visit to NY. THANK YOU VERY MUCH MARIA & ROB!

Staying in Rob's apartment was a really good experience. Beside that he is such a kind and helpful man, the apartment was a comfortable place to stay. We had the whole apartment to ourselves. Whenever I had questions I could call Rob with his house phone. The apartment is first floor on the street side, which was great, so you don't have to worry if you take any suitcase with you. It also was a quiet place, no noise at all. It is situated close to the inwood park, there are a lot of squirrels who eat out of your hand, so cute! So bring some peanuts with you! We felt really safe as well, even though we came home late at night by metro. The metro station is approximately 5 to 10 minutes walking distance away. Within 20 minutes with the metro you're on broadway and times square. The metro is called the A-train and it takes you almost everywhere you want. It's the end station which makes it easy to find your way back. You can buy a week ticket for $30,- and you can travel as much as you like. Nearby the apartment there is a supermarket, a doughnut shop with coffee to go and a lunchroom. Rob left us a bottle of wine and on the day of departure he was so kind to extend the time of departure / check out because our flight back home was later on the evening. If you are looking for comfort, luxury, a lot of space, your privacy and the experience to be a New York citizen yourself, than this is the place to be. If your looking for a place close to all the tourist attractions and in all the rush and noisy surroundings, than you must take a hotel in the city center which is the upper east side or times square. PS: if you take a taxi from JFK airport to Rob's apartment it will cost you $55,-. Rob, thanks again for this great experience!
Nice flat,perfect for 2,quiet neighbours. Rob was always available for recomend us on everything we needed.

We really enjoyed our stay at Rob's apartment. The neighbourhood was lovely and such easy access to the nearby metro stations which were within 5 minute walk and run all throughout the night for the late nights.  Rob was great in keeping in touch prior and during our stay. Although Rob was not available to meet us he arranged for us to pick up the keys and kindly left a complimentary bottle of wine. The apartment is fully kitted out and it really did feel like a home away from home.

We have thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Rob's flat. We felt right at home. The neighbourhood is lovely and we benefited  form the short walk to the express train station. The bed was our favourite thing. It was soooooo comfortable , just perfect after a long day of sightseeing. The AC was ideal in the 30 degree weather. We made breakfast in the kitchen everyday and Rob's kitchen is well equipped for all sorts of cooking. Overall we really appreciated the communication. Even before our stay Rob sent us a manual for the flat and the area. The key handover was super flexible and very smooth. We would definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants to feel right at home in NYC.

We had a great stay in NY. A few days before we arrived Rob messaged us letting us know there was a small problem with the apartment, and despite it being fixable, it wouldn't be done by the time we arrived. Luckily, Rob had a spare apartment just 2 blocks away which he was able to offer us instead.  The new apartment was very spacious and had everything we needed - fully equipped kitchen, air con, wifi, large modern shower and a very comfortable bed. It was however slightly old fashioned and not as modern as we had hoped when originally booking.   It was in a very convenient location, close to 2 subway stops on different lines, which was useful. It took about 20 mins to central Manhattan and 45 mins to downtown. You could also get the subway to the airport which although took about 1.5 hours was very cheap. The apartment was near a nice park with lots of families around.   Rob was flexible with our check out time, and he provided us with a drink and basic food e.g. bread, jam, bananas on arrival. He answered any questions we had.   Overall we had a great time, despite the last minute change of apartment.

What a wonderful place to stay in NYC!!!!  Yes, it's not in the middle of downtown, but it's an easy train ride and the neighborhood is eclectic, with lots of green space and very safe.  The apartment is exactly as pictured: roomy, clean, great AC, comfortable bed, and lots of closet/drawer space to be able to unpack.   Upon arrival we were met by Maria who gave us the tour and answered questions about where to find things in the neighborhood.  In addition Rob supplied a packet of info which answered just about all questions.  Rob is a great host who called to check in to make sure all was well.  We loved staying in Rob's place.

Rob was a great host. He was very communicative and even contacted us when he hadn't heard from us for a few days to make sure everything was ok. The flat is fantastic and in a good neighbourhood with convenience to the subway. I would definitely recommend staying  there. The kitchen had everything you need to prepare your own meals and everything was very modern.

Thanks for an excellent stay! The flat is big and cozy. The street is nice and quiet, lots of first-need shops nearby & close to the subway going directly to Times Square. The kitchen, the shower - everything is perfect. Rob left us lots of supplies of everything we may need, and guides too, so we wouldn't get lost in the laundry & recycling stuff) Once again - thank you!

The apartment was roomy and very homely. We really loved the area and explored the local parks and views of the Hudson River. The restaurants in the evening with Dominican Republic vibe and delicious food were great. It was an easy subway ride into New York and we felt quite safe coming back at night. Rob was very welcoming and communicated with us really well. The bed is really comfy too!!  He had left a bottle of wine and two glasses out on arrival and we were greeted by his cleaner who showed us around. The kitchen has everything in it if you want to self cater. We primarily enjoyed the coffee grinder and percolator!  The apartment was really quiet at night and is near a lovely park with views of the Hudson River which are stunning. It's a very warm flat in the summer but he does have air-conditioning. Overall a great stay and a very welcoming host.

While we didn't get to meet Rob in person because he was out of town, he was excellent in promptly and cordially communicating with us. He encouraged us to call him with any questions, needs, or concerns.  He helped us understand how to get our Metro passes and his close proximity to both the A and 1 trains, and the bus was perfect for our many outings to various areas in Manhattan, Brooklyn, and the Bronx.  Rob gave us perfect instructions on how to get to his place and we used Uber from the airport.  His housekeeper Maria greeted us before we had our bags out of the car and was very friendly and helpful with the layout of the apartment and even the best pizza close at hand.  Rob contacted us a short time later to see how things were going and if we needed anything.  The apartment is absolutely beautiful in a quiet friendly neighborhood.  The bed is fantastic, the kitchen has everything you could possibly want and the complimentary bottle of wine was very nice.  We enjoyed walking in the neighborhood parks when not visiting further away.  We will contact Rob any time we visit NYC in the hopes that his home will be available to us!

Rob was an awesome host we had no trouble getting in and he was available by phone the day we arrived and communicated with me beforehand via airbnb as well. This place is awesome, amazing location just a quick walk to 2 subway stops that got us everywhere we needed to go, and easy access to the apt from  the street. We liked being a little removed from downtown too. A couple delis nearby for cheap breakfast, pizza, coffee, a bar with good dinner nearby too. Apt is great inside, plenty of room, comfortable bed, great water pressure, we would definitely stay here again.

Had an excellent stay here, easy access to the city but away from the noise at night, the Indian Road Cafe around the corner does great food. The bed was incredibly comfortable and the heating was just right. It was a great base for our trip. The directions from Rob to get there were spot on and we found the place easily. I would highly recommend this apartment to everyone.

The apartment was clean with a lovely, easy to use, kitchen.  Instructions for getting around to restaurants, stores and Midtown were clear and easy to understand. The location is close to a Saturday Farmer's Market and a  park for long walks away from the busy City. Rob is a friendly host with whom it was easy to communicate.

There is anything whatsoever that i could say i didn't like about Rob's place. For starters, it is near a subway station and located in a very calm neighborhood. As for the apartment itself, everything was very clean, well decorated, really confortable and - oh yeah - it has great water pressure, which makes for great shower! haha Also, while we didn't get to met Rob in person, he was always ready to help us with anything we needed; we really appreciated his attention to detail and he seems like a very nice guy. The place was absolutely perfect for resting after a day of exploration and we enjoyed our stay there a lot! Also, considering that the apartment is in Manhattan, it is rentable for a very good price. This was my first experience with Airbnb and it surpassed my highest expectations.

Rob's place is far better than i expected it to be, clearly Rob takes pride in having a quality apartment.  It is in very quiet neighbourhood with an easy 10 -15 walk to the subway and straight into town past a large park and a garden with really nice flowers.  I felt safe even arriving back after midnight and waking to the apartment.  The bed is really very comfortable so much so that it was hard to want to get up in the morning!  Everything is neatly ordered and in its place.  A wonderful place to stay that my wife and i would highly recommend.

Rob's Place was fantastic!  We loved our stay.  Stylishly furnished and very comfortable.  Basically all the comforts of home.  We felt very safe and enjoyed the park that was just a block away.  Easy access to the trains but far enough away from the hustle and bustle of the city for a quiet nights sleep.  It was great to have access to the W/D area in the basement. Everything we needed was close by.  Rob was a great host and checked on us many times.  Thanks Rob we loved your place!

Rob's place is just fantastic! Very cosy and comfortable. We enjoyed staying there and wish we could come back one day in future. Rob is an awesome host very accomodative and helpful. Communication was superior. We met Rob's mother who is such a nice personality. The location is a bit far away from midtown but New Yourk is huge and it is hard to find anything that located close to everything. We will absolutely recommend Rob and his place to everyone. Do not hesitate just book it with confidence! Thanks Rob for everything!

Rob was very easy to communicate with and had explicit instructions about neighborhood & his home. Neighborhood was quiet but not too far from the A & 1 subways. Very clean home, would come here again!

My wife and I were first time visitors to NYC. Rob's Place was perfect for us. It's a little farther north on the island than most, but we found it to be the perfect spot for us. There's a wonderful community in the area. We met many kind and helpful people during our visit. There are several restaurants in the area. We didn't find a bad one among them.  The apartment is spacious and comfortable, decorated tastefully, and fully stocked with what we needed for an enjoyable visit. Rob and previous guests provided a fully stocked kitchen with utensils, cooking gear, spices, and fresh ground coffee every morning. Staying north of "the action" on the island allowed us to experience the transportation system (subway). Being first-timers, we enjoyed that experience. We were free to wander around the island, China Town, Little Italy, 9/11 Memorial, Broadway Musical, Times Square, all were in our reach. Then, we head back to Rob's for rejuvenation and rest.  Rob's is a little north, and well worth the trip!

The Rob´s place is awesome. Everything is close (grocery store, train station, restaurants, supermarkets). The neighborhood is so quiet and safe. The apartment was so clean. The bed is so comfortable with enough different sized pillows. We loved this place!!

Super nice private apartment in quiet neighborhood. Close to parks and subway lines.  Stayed for the NYC marathon and had a very relaxing getaway from the city at Rob's apartment. About a 10 min walk to the A train. We got a 7 day unlimited metro card and took the subway everywhere. It takes an hour to get to the South Ferry and an hour to get to Brooklyn, but otherwise the travel times aren't that bad. If you are interested in the Met, I highly recommend the Cloisters, only 10 min away. Oh and there's a great farmers market on Saturday! (May be seasonal)  One of my only complaints about the neighborhood is that there aren't very many good food options, so get food before you head in for the night or do your own cooking. There are grocery stores within walking distance.

Rob's apartment is amazing! Not only for the style, cleanliness and organization, but for the hospitality of the host who, even far away, is always willing to help. It was quite an experience, in a quiet neighborhood and close to the subway. Although far from the center, the quality of the stay and the surrounding facilities make up for it! In addition to a beautiful park nearby -- which you can enjoy for sports or just contemplation.

A comfortable and stylish space with easy access to grocery shops, restaurants, a park, and two trains to get you in and out of central Manhattan.   We enjoyed our stay thoroughly, and found it easy to access all that New York has to offer from the local restaurants to all the hustle and bustle of midtown and lower Manhattan (a 45min train trip).   This is a good place to stay if you want a quiet place to sleep and don’t mind commuting for sight seeing...   Rob was an excellent host, was always easy to get hold of and gave us some great tips for our travels. A very pleasant stay!

We really enjoyed our stay with Rob, the apartment is conveniently located and Rob really thought of many of the details very lovingly. The bed is extremely comfortable and overall the apartment has a lot of charm. Typically New York!  We enjoyed the stay at Rob's, the Subway station with direct links to downtown Manhattan is just around the corner and Rob thought about everything. The bed is very comfortable and the apartment is very charming. Typically New York!

Near two metro starions. But i think it is tiring to take every day metro to go to manhattan and back . It is about 30 min for midtown. The neighborhood was ok the day, a bit scary the night. About the house, beds perfect, one bathroom perfect, the second one needs renovation.

My mom and I had a great time staying at Lumin’s studio apartment. My mom had wanted a private space, and this apartment has its own enterance, bathroom, living area w/ couch, and kitchenette. Plus it was squeaky clean, and had a nice kitchen area.  This studio has all amenities accept a laundry unit, which we didn’t need during a week long trip. Everything else: AC, dehumidifier, fridge, microwave, plates, kettle, induction burner, anything we could have wanted to use, was there!  I can’t stress enough how everything was very new and very clean, all the towels and linens seemed brand new. The shower is beautiful and all the bathroom fixtures seem new, though it is a little small (so maybe 4 adults would have a hard time sharing. I think any couple would be very happy staying here, or 3 people as the couch pulls out into a second bed. We shared the bed (very comfortable) so I can’t speak to the comfort of the pull-out bed. If you are someone who likes to hang out with your hosts or meet other travelers you might not like staying here. But if you are looking for more privacy and quiet then you’ll love this studio! There isn’t much natural light, so if you were planning on spending lots of time working on something or staying in then maybe stay somewhere else? Only 2 ppl with computers could work at the little dining table.  Hosts were very good communicators and responded to me always same day at the latest. They were really accommodating with our check in times.  The neighborhood has nearby grocery and cafes. We had coffee and breakfast near the apartment everyday before leaving from the subway station nearby. If you are sightseeing in Manhattan then you might not like the commute (our friends from NY thought we were really far away) but we didn’t mind spending time on the subway, especially since we came in the summer and it’s nice to have the AC. We would definitely stay here again!

Rob's place was clean and comfortable although a little far from the centre of town, there is a subway round the corner that will take you times square relatively quickly. I would recommend Rob's place.

Rob is very responsive and responds very quickly. The apartment is ok for the price. The area is quiet and even if you come home late there is no problem. Allow 10 minutes to walk to the metro and 40 minutes to get to midtown.

This apartment is great and I have no hesitation in recommending it. I would definitely stay there again if the opportunity arises. It is well appointed and has everything you could wish for. Rob is a great host an is always available at the end of a phone if you need any help.
Our stay at Rob’s place was perfect!!!

The appartment is nice, friendly and clean. Oliver is a caring host and offered me to use the living room and kitchen as well as toiletry. I didn‘t make any use of this, because I really just needed a room to sleep and rest and sometimes use the Wifi, which worked perfectly well for me. The description of the appartment was accurate, the handover of the keys easy. Oliver was even friendly enough to let me store my case in the appartment one day earlier. Hugo, the dog is very cute and absolutely harmless. He is not shy at all and will come and salut everyone entering the appartment:-) The neighborhood (Bed-Stuy) seems to be in the process of gentrification. It means there are a couple of nice Cafés and stores. If you walk a few blocks, however, the neighborhood seems to be a little bit sketchy, at least that‘s what my friends from NY told me. I never felt unsafe, and all in all it‘s a more genuine Brooklyn experience than Williamsburg (where I stayed for four days).

Rob's place was a comfortable and welcoming home away from home.  The neighbourhood was great - there is a subway within a 5 min walk, grocery store, liquor store plus restaurants and a pub.  The Inwood park is just down the block. The subway line was very convenient for getting downtown and also connecting to JFK airport. Rob was very clear in his communications and kept in touch throughout our stay.  The check in and check out was easy.    We would highly recommend Rob's place for anyone visiting NYC.

The best apartment you can get in Manhattan!!!!!!! There is a reason why Rob is a super host! The communication is fabolous, he has helped us with all information we needed. He even adjusted the check in for us. The apartment is spotless and so beautiful, you will feel rigth at home the moment you step in. The bed is mega comfy. Rob even had a bottle of red wine for us to enjoy. There are restaurants around the corner and the metro is just some blocks away. Make sure to check out the farmers market at the weekend and go for a run in the park which is just down the road. WE LOVED every minute of our stay here!
Awesome stay! Beautiful place and lots of care from Rob and wonderful  Maria. Way uptown in serene Inwood. Totally worth the time on the underground.

It was an amazing stay at robs flat. Rob was always very helpful and we could ask him everything. The conversation was perfect. We would recommend this accomodation to everyone. Thank you Rob, it was great. Verena and Nik
Rob’s place was just as he described. The neighbourhood was safe and friendly, we did a lot of walking late at night.  The location was easy to get to the subway.

The only words I have for Rob’s place is perfect! His home made our stay so comfortable and relaxing, his place not only made you feel right at home, but also had cool, quirky touches which I really enjoyed! He had a huge range of information about New York City and he is incredibly informative in his messages! Directions were clear and easy to understand as well. Thank you again for such a wonderful stay, anyone looking at staying in Manhattan should definitely stay at Rob’s place as you won’t be disappointed!

A very comfortable and spacious place. It has details of comfort and quality. It is very well supplied. Excellent bed and shower. Rob offered us a welcome bottle of wine. The neighborhood is very friendly and the neighborhood is quiet. It is highly recommended despite being 40 minutes from the noise of NYC. The site is a blessing
Rob's appartment is a lovely place. There are metro stations within a walking distance and you'll have everything you could possibly need for your stay.
We were in Rob's apartment for 8 nights and had an amazing time. The subway is near and it takes around 30-40 minutes to reach downtown Manhattan.

Rob’s place is spacious, comfortable and quiet. Very convenient to a small deli and a small grocery, as well as public transportation. There were always Lyft drivers available, at all hours, too!  I walked in the neighborhood and nearby parks both day and evening and, as an older woman, felt safe and comfortable. There was easy access to the apartment and laundry room, with the added perk of a key card to use the machines. The kitchen is loaded with spices, utensils and everything you could possibly need. This  is one of the best Airbnb places I have enjoyed!

I stayed at Rob’s place for 3 months for work and it was perfect! The space is clean comfortable and stylish. Rob is so easy to communicate with and does the most to make you feel welcome. I will absolutely stay here again if I am ever back in the area.

We were from out of state, and the landlord went far beyond what was required in making our stay stress free and pleasant.  The apartment was very well appointed; everything you could possible need was made available.  The facility was clean, modern, and fully furnished.  On a scale of one to ten, we would give it a 12.  We particularly enjoyed the wonderful Inwood Park which was only a block away.

Rob's place is fabulous. Comfy, clean, and very convenient. The A train whisks you downtown very quickly which makes it a faster journey than properties further south. It's very close to the park the wonderful Inwood Farm cafe and restaurant. I can't recommend Rob's apartment highly enough!

I’m definitely satisfied with the stay in Olivier’s Luminous Room. I stayed in NYC for almost 2 months and I have to admit it’s a perfect spot, no matter if you are going to work in Manhattan or just enjoy the artistic atmosphere of Brooklyn.   ***HOST*** Olivier is a friendly and easy-going host, who exactly knows what’s going on in the neighborhood. He’s also very accessible, even if outside the city. Olivier was waiting for me so I got access to the room immediately after my arrival to NYC. He also appeared couple of times during my stay to ask whether everything is fine.  ***LOCALIZATION*** The apartment is located in a vibrant and funky neighborhood, exactly between two well-connected subway stations (Bedford-Nostrand Ave's /G/ and Nostrand Ave /A-C/). It never took me more than 45 mins to go to Manhattan. There are also a lot of shops, stores and taverns around. This apartment provides genuine taste of everyday live in Brooklyn.   ***APARTMENT*** Definitely the best choice I could made before I came to NYC. The apartment is huge providing a lot of space for all guests. It is also very well equipped, which allowed me to do all usual house-activities (but for the laundry – however there is a laundromat in the next block). Air conditioning worked very well, especially during hot American summer. As far as the private bedroom is concerned – comfortable bed and other furniture are perfect for people who want to chill out after work. Whole apartment is new, elegant and very clean. Olivier created also kind of "common space" in the living room that helps the guests get to know each other without affecting their privacy.  ***ROOMMATES*** Don't be afraid about the amount of guests (4) living in the apartment simultaneously. On the basis of an interview before accepting the stay in the apartment, Olivier chooses only easy-going and cultural people. I could actually say, that after almost 2 months I got new friends – we sometimes went out for a dinner, to the club or even to the Yankee Stadium to see a match! Thanks to the additional restroom in the apartment there were no problems in the rush hours.  ***SUMMARY*** I strongly recommend Olivier's Luminous Room to all people who are planning a longer stay in NYC.
