We left early.  Host never responded to our concerns about the toilet nor our request for refund - they don’t live there nor own the building. Illegal in NYC? Let me know. Total scam. Stay away. David and Orli Air B and B Forest Hills, Queens. Look for my YouTube channel video of the wreck. go to You Tube and type in  GREAT LOCATION in NY! PRIVATE STUDIO with PARKING! Hosted by David and Orli
Is as listed. It did smell like cigarette smoke, which was unpleasant, but otherwise great value.

Unfortunately, we didn't get to stay in the cosy minimalist apartment, but in the elegant bohemian room hosted by the same person. We got the keys for the other room and in the details sent, there was no info on the apartment number. It was unpleasant when in the middle of the night other people were trying to enter our room, since they booked the Bohemian room. It got solved by the host eventually. It was a pity we didn't got to enjoy the apartment, but the Bohemian room had everything you could need. Everything was neat and clean. So, without the unfortunate event it would have been perfect!

Overall for the price the place is okay but we stayed in January and it was cold. In our three days there the heat hasn’t turned on once. When we contacted the host they told us that thermostat is in a basement appt and that they will try to ask ppl there to turn the heat up. When we came home second night it was colder than the first I notified our host that there was no change but never got a response. We slept fully clothed under 3 blankets.  The appt is also missing a fire alarm/detector which is unsafe

This was a really great place to stay in New York! There was a subway station really close by that took us straight to Central Park, Times Square and to the Ferry to Staten Island! Its the perfect place to stay if you want to spend your time exploring the city. The Wifi was also really fast which is always nice. Felix was so helpful and reached out during our stay to make sure we were alright which is nice especially as we were a group of girls travelling alone, which is obviously a little scary! I would recommend staying here if you are coming to New York.

The location was very close to the subway station which is really convenient. However, the door lock system was pretty confusing so check-in took a long time. There was a heating pipe right next to the bunk bed which was kind of dangerous. The host was responsive to any questions and usually replied within 1-2 hours. The apartment is priced very reasonably too.

Great location. Convenient, safe and quiet, there are several counselors offices next door or across the street. The apartment is clean and the beds are comfortable.  Though it has its inherent limitation of old NYC apartment, i.e, kitchen and bathrooms are a bit dated,  the decorations and room colors make the place feel bright and pleasant. Nikita is responsive and helpful, he accommodated our request of early drop off of luggage, and delivered a pot in the middle of our stay upon request.  Overall we had a wonderful stay. Tips: To skip the long line of Ess-a-Bagel, pre-order the night before for morning pickup. Minor note: we saw homeless sleeping in front of the gate underneath the restaurant tent during off hours. They left before restaurant opens leaving no  trash behind.

We were excited about our stay until the host cancelled on us as we were boarding our flight with an extreme story about having to call the police on people not supposed to be there. Now, things happen that’s fine… but the part that was terrible was the absolute horrible follow up and communication. He literally left us hanging with no where to go and no response. Total scam. It was one of the worst experiences. I hope this doesn’t happen to anyone else. Beware!!!

If you want peace and health avoid this place!! The stay was bad, including effects on my health and that of my friend, which persisted for a few days. The beginning of this unpleasant journey was the communication with Alex who failed to answer some important questions regarding check-in. After arriving at the place, we had to wait for about 10 minutes outside and with the temperature around -8º C, before 'being obliged' to GO UP TO THE FOURTH FLOOR WITH 4 LARGE SUITCASES, as we were NOT informed that THERE ARE NO ELEVATOR. After this crossfit of going up all the several flights of stairs with heavy bags (I was worried about the excessive noise that the stairs made), we managed to access the room and were already scared by the extremely hot temperature. The next day, we woke up with many health problems due to the heater that DOES NOT HAVE A THERMOSTAT, that is, it is not adjustable. The next day, the solution presented by the host was to sleep with the window open.

*Worse Airbnb experience I have ever had.*  The place is dirty. The bedroom was relatively ok - although the general state of the room is shabby - but the bathroom was disgusting, with stains on the toilet, hair by the sink and in the shower, gross floors, etc.  More alarming, a group of people inside the flat (no idea who they were: tenants? friends of the host?) were having a party in the room right next to ours. They played loud music from 5am to 10am, sounded very drunk and/or high, laughed and shouted hysterically to the point we were scared for our safety.  We felt like we had to lay low and avoid crossing their path. We ended up leaving as discreetly as we could in the morning.  Please do yourself a favor, and avoid setting foot in this crack den!!!

Sydney’s place was exactly that - dreamy east village apartment. It was clean and pleasant, and the bed was super comfy and big. Everything was as described, communication was easy. Sydney was accommodating, and I had to extend and change dates due to moving to NY which can be very stressful, and she was flexible with that. Over all, I highly recommend. Do bring earplugs though for some louder East Village nights, but overall it was fine and I had no problems with the noise.
Good location Not far from subway station too much Not scary at night at all

The first couple of days here were fine. The last night of my stay, the host messaged me before midnight asking me why his closet door in the hallway was open and whether I had brought company. He said he was going to check his cameras.   I didn’t touch his closet doors and I didn’t have anyone else in my room. When I asked him about this in person later, it seemed that he didn’t believe that I didn’t touch his closet doors and he also wouldn’t check the cameras to confirm this. I was really worried that there was a break-in and asked him to check the cameras and let me know. But he refused to do so. I was unable to sleep properly because of concerns about the security there if there had just been an intruder.   When I asked why he thought I had company, it turns out he heard me FaceTiming my family and thought there was someone else there with me in the room. He also digressed and started talking about how the last guest stole his debit card and is still using it. I’m not sure why he didn’t cancel the card but this was out of pocket and irrelevant so I didn’t want to pursue the topic.  He also claimed that before he messaged me, he asked me these questions in person earlier that night when I was leaving the bathroom. But I didn’t hear anything. Seems like poor communication all around.  All in all, the room was alright considering how much you’re paying. But the interactions with the host were poor due to poor communication and my stay quite unpleasant.

We had a fantastic stay from start to finish. The apartment is beautiful, spacious, clean, quiet, and comfortable. It’s easy to get anywhere in the city thanks to the proximity to the subway. We appreciated the stress-free keyless entry as well.  Finally, Tijana was super responsive and gave us a lot of great recommendations. Highly recommend!

The water was very cold in the apartment, the neighbors (above) was very loud & noisy especially in the morning hours. When you turn the heat on it was a very unpleasant odor that comes thru the vents. The tub needs to be replaced & also the shower curtain. The Wi-Fi was bad , barely could watch television because it kept disconnecting. Other than that the place was clean , location was very convenient

Ndive was a awesome host. It was spotless, fresh comfortable, quiet place that made me feel like I was home. He was very communicative and responsive. I can not stress it enough, if you’re looking for a cozy place I’d 100% recommend this place for you. I’m definitely coming back here. Keep up the good work.

Really lovely home, we felt welcome and it was so clean and spacious! Really great communication with shanti and everything is exactly as described! I stayed with my boyfriend and always felt safe when walking to and from the station but as a young woman walking alone at night I wouldn't have felt incredibly safe!  Shanti was great and gave me a pepper spray in case I felt unsafe, but nothing at all ever happened and I never felt unsafe but I think I would've wanted to know if I was thinking of staying here as a young woman alone!  Really great spot, really great hosts, beautiful, clean 10/10 for couples looking for a location out of the city with great transportation options! Would definitely stay again!! x thank you shanti and mo!

Can't stress enough how warm and polite the host was. We had access to our room and the living room when I and my wife were both at work meetings.  Wifi, ac, cold water for drinking, clean washrooms, everything was better than expected. Very flexible and accommodating.   We couldn't go out one day as it was raining so she even checked if we ate anything and offered some food which was really sweet of her. Highly recommend this place.   Very close to train stations and lots of street parking nearby.

Michelle is a great Host. Her place is so lovely. She recently remodeled and the place is gorgeous. Lots of space. The mattress was very comfortable and the place was extremely clean. One of the best things about staying here is you are able to park in the back. This is very rare. I cannot express enough how much stress this took off me by not having to try to find parking for my cargo van each night. I will be booking with her again soon. I was very comfortable. She thought of everything.

I love staying here. Absolutely love staying here. The place is always so clean and the decor is so lovely. I feel at peace here. I recently moved to New York and have been staying in several Airbnb’s until I find an apartment. It’s been very stressful, so when I spend time at Michelle’s while apartment hunting it is very peaceful and soothing to my peace of mind. I also love her bedding choices. Really lovely comforters and plush pillows. I can’t get enough of this place.

My father was able to stay minutes from my home in a quiet, clean apartment. This made our family Thanksgiving less stressful and more enjoyable. The elevator access was a plus, because my father has trouble climbing stairs. Only issue (for some) was that the building where the airbnb unit is located is large and a little warn down. However, the apartment itself is private, quiet, clean, spacious and well decorated.  Another bonus, the neighbors in the building are friendly, but otherwise keep to themselves. The location itself is within walking distance of a Target/Shopping Mall and a Bodega. It is also easily accessible by car, especially if driving to and from the Belt Parkway.  The nearest subway stop is a 13 minute walk. Chanel was always available by email when we had questions.

Everything was very clean and the appartment had everything we need for a good rest, it is not too close to the turistic area however is very well conected by trains. We were a little concern of the safety of the neighborhood , but Crystal was really suportive and after a couple of days we saw it wasn’t really unsafe

We had a wonderful stay here.  Right in the heart of all the wonder that is Bushwick.  Everything was within walking distance and it was much easier to walk around then try and navigate by vehicle.  The neighborhood was absolutely adorable and the access was easy to enter and leave with complete privacy without disturbing the neighbors.  Ask about the parking space…it’s worth it.  We had one minor issue with the plumbing that was addressed to our satisfaction by the owner without any due stress.  Will look to stay here again in the future.

Great value. Very hot in the apartment. We had to move the mattress into the living room where there was a window ac unit. No blanket on bed. Poor communication with host. He insisted that he would pick us up from the airport and charge us fairly. My girlfriend and I really did not want to do this as we were planning on just taking the train and because Gary had no reviews. Gary insisted ended up charging us twice what a taxi would charge. Neighborhood is okay, lots of iv drug use around.

Would stay again at Darren’s beautiful property in a heartbeat! ﻿Darren and his whole family were wonderful hosts, and if you’re looking for the ideal apartment in one of the most charming and interesting parts of Manhattan, this is your place.  Unusually large for the city, the apartment was very clean, elegantly furnished in a contemporary yet warm style, and has a ton of “smart home” features like Nest HVAC, nSonos audio, smart TVs with lots of content, etc.   The apartment is located in an upscale, quiet, safe building. The overall noise environment is favorable considering how loud other areas can be, and the views are bright, vibrant, and with the small-scale feeling of SoHo. The location can’t be beat.  This place has all the things you can think of: generously filled with tea, coffee, had lots in the fridge, fresh towels, and all the other items of everyday life. If you like to cook, you’ll be delighted with the very well-equipped kitchen. Two dishwashers!  The air conditioner quietly and unobtrusively maintained 72 degrees when it was 95 outside.  And there is an elevator that goes directly to the apartment, so you can get food deliveries dropped off in the elevator in the lobby and pull them right up to your living room.  The decor subtly reflects a meditative spirit, turning what can be hectic New York into a relaxing and romantic experience. The shower for two and large bathtub, open and adjacent to a large bed and sunny gigantic window (with electric privacy shade), bidets, and small peaceful aesthetic details, make everyday life feel more like a resort vacation than just an ordinary master bedroom.   Hosts greeted in person late at night for an easy check-in, and after leaving remained rapidly responsive and helpful.     This is a high-quality luxury apartment that feels like a real home yet is organized, neat, uncluttered and welcoming.  Looking forward to staying at Darren's place again!​

Paula's place is in a great location and the room was clean and comfortable, however, Paula was not there when I arrived and as a result I stood outside the apt for ages trying to get in. I was tired and wasn't even sure I was in the right place, so this was very distressing. I rang all of the buzzers and finally someone buzzed me in. Paula had sent me an email when I was traveling to say that she wouldn't be home because she was going out to dinner. Not having data on my phone at this time I was unable to receive this message and came "after 5", which were her instructions (although I had hoped to arrive earlier). I came "after 5" as she wished and met nobody. About 30 minutes after my arrival I discovered the apt was left open and I found my room door also open. I found the key on the desk and was able to finally head out myself for my own dinner. All of this was very stressful and upsetting. Communication was not clear at all. I think a definite check-in time should be set if the host needs to go out for whatever reason. I ensured I followed her instructions and came "after 5", but clearly this didn't work. Overall, the apartment was fine and location excellent, but it was very eerie as nobody was around the entire time (except for one other guest, who informed me he hadn't seen anyone around the entire time either). He had to show me how to work the keys. This was another huge problem. I was really hungry, but had no idea how to get back into the bldg. I was lucky to run into the other guest because by this time I was close to tears and had climbed the  three flights of stairs several times. I was worried I would go out and not be able to get back into the building. Once all of these issues were cleared up I spent a nice time there and I would stay there again, but I would definitely ask this host to give an EXACT check-in time... don't tell a guest "anytime after 5" when you won't be home. I felt I lost a lot of precious time in NY because of this mess.

Patricia's place just as advertised--stunning. Chilled sparkling water & beers on arrival, wine & chocolates, too. Also, no hot water issues, even w/multiple people taking showers simultaneously & not short on towels (often an issue even in nice, large places)--even had robes!  The location is great for Murray Hill, Murray Hill is just not my favorite.  We were so appreciative of Patricia's place b/c it was REAL. We stayed here after the OTHER AirBnB we had booked for our family of 4 & 2 sets of grandparents tried the bait-&-switch. We didn't fall for it, so the other AirBnB immediately refunded our money, but left us w/o lodgings on a weekend w/family coming from all over the country to watch our son play in Carnegie Hall. (The way these scams work, they contact you right before your res, saying they have to move you b/c of some issue. If you say "no" they refund you, but you can't leave a review. If you accept, you're stuck. The place is generally a hole, but no price change.)
Place looked like the photos, clear instructions from the host, near 2 subway lines, the neighborhood I felt it was a little dangerous  but it was a great deal.

We stayed four days with 3 friends in the room, it was very good. room was exactly as in the photo. clean bedding and comfortable bed. the bathroom was ok too. the kitchen is very good, all the utensils needed to make all types of food. we made dinner every day. super easy to find and on the street there is a small market that has several things. the neighborhood we found quiet, just the subway station closest to the house (Rockway) we found it a little dangerous but nothing major, it just needed to be more connected. Anyway, they were incredible days, Antônio was always very attentive.

WORST STAY OF OUR LIFE HOST TO FLEE!!!!!!  Never book accommodation with Antonio if you like cleanliness. We arrived in the evening very tired with only one desire: to shower and rest but impossible, a bathroom with mold, dust, yellow stains, dirt, hair, pee on the toilet bowl, it was disgusting (photos prove it, the host told us that he was not responsible since the bathroom was shared which is no reason to live in filth!) We went straight to sleep afterwards but there window was broken we slept in the cold all night with -22 degrees outside. The host was not responsive and even refused to refund us even though we only stayed one night with him instead of 14 days, we fled as soon as possible and he refused to refund our money. Never book this accommodation! To flee! Very haughty and unpleasant host and not responsive.

the place is close to two subway lines that take you to Manhattan, maybe a little dirty but in reality if it is something dangerous, nothing ever happened to me but in internet catalogs the neighborhood like this.  about the place has everything you need to get to sleep and bathe, so if you don't have any problem with that, it's your perfect option
Esra was a wonderful host, communication was super easy, great location for the price. Stress free !

Rishad place was nice! Better than the photos posted! This was a last minute book & I was so glad they were able to accept us as our flights got cancelled! He even lets us pay an extra fee to stay a bit longer because our bus didn’t leave until a few hours after check out. We did see some ants around the shower, but no other type of bugs were found! We did have a question about a door behind a shelf, whereas we were all females, not knowing what was behind the other side of the door was a bit creepy but we had no issues with it! We never met rishad face to face but he was sure to install A/C units while there! We met his lovely wife! She was great & very accommodating! I definitely wouldn’t mind booking with them again!! (:

A beautifully renovated and spacious accomodation located in a bustling neighborhood in queens just 2.5 blocks from the subway. Rishad seemed to have anticipated almost any need a guest might have. The apartment was impeccably neat and pleasantly clean. Rishad was very communicative and responsive making my stay comfortable and virtually stress free at a bargain price!

Arrival at the accommodation is a bit dangerous, due to the environment, the place is very dirty, mice in the street, that with respect to living, the accommodation complies with what is offered in the advertisement.

If you have a heavy luggage (e.g 50lbs), getting a room on the 4th floor is a challenging one.You can't even pick or request  a lower floor due to lack of availability.They don't have an elevator so be prepared to  take the stairs everytime to go in and out of the building.The place is quite old so it's a bit scary to walk around especially the stairs and even the room.Felt like it's gonna collapse any time.I think it needs renovation.The neighborhood is quite noisy too.You get what you paid for.

The area is very quiet, 10 minutes walk from the subway which connects to the center of Manhattan. On the other hand, the rooms are very poorly insulated. There are 6 rooms, everyone slammed the doors when they came home at midnight, which constantly woke us up, it was very unpleasant. Also two bathrooms for 6 accommodations, if the person decides to spend 1 hour in the bathroom in the morning, this can put us behind on our visits…

Functionally furnished room in a good location for shopping, bars and restaurants. The connection to Manhattan is also very good despite the distance via subway (if you are not afraid to take the subway at night).

The Michelle’s house is very pretty!! She and Jackson  are very nice, helpful and communicative. The house is very cooting. Around the house there are several restaurants, conveniences, drug store  and also 5 minutes (depending on the speed you walk) from the subway station that takes you anywhere in NY. They also have a very cute dog ☺️
Not worth the money… the entire place is dirty especially the bathroom (shower head broke) and it’s in the basement. Creepy vibes

NOT WORTH THE HEADACHE! I would give the biggest 0 stars if I could. The host claimed to be flexible with check in but was anything but! I informed him that we made it and were waiting to check in. It took over an hour just to get an initial response. We were told we needed to wait and did that for 3 HOURS! By the time we were told we could head to the property, we got delayed another 30 minutes because the host needed to get new sheets for the place! After hours of waiting, a family member decided to walk us to the property and wait for us because of a reservation that was quickly approaching. The host had us meet him at an address across the street from the property. Yet he waited down the block in his car, instead of meeting us at the agreed upon spot for us to receive the key. The host messaged me to say that additional people were an extra charge (mentioning my family members who were walking and talking with me). I told him that we knew the rules and that only the agreed upon number of people were staying (only 2 of us out of 3 had luggage).  He said ok and then asked me to come to his car to get the key, which was a big red flag. I told him that I wanted him to meet me with the key in front of the agreed upon meet up spot. He refused to get out and meet me, and kept insisting that I walk up to his car. Even after telling him that I wasn’t comfortable with that (especially being in such a busy city and new area), he said to forget about it and that he would cancel the reservation and sped off! So I was left without a place to stay and unable to book somewhere on such a short notice. When he decided ti cancel the reservation he told me that I would get a full refund but lied to Airbnb Support and told them I had additional guest in the property—when I never even got the key!! The dispute process took so long all because he was trying not to give me my full refund after saying he would—and leaving me high and dry in the city. It was giving scammer or trafficker, and so many more red flags.  I use Airbnb all the time and this was hands down the worst experience I ever had with the company!

The place looks exactly as pictured. They did a great job showing that. When you first walk in though there’s all their storage right at the front entrance I would suggest for them to cover that up. I know they are a new host and it will get better over time that’s just my input you see all there storage kids school project etc. there was a slight smell in the first walk way but it’s NYC in the dead of summer so there’s smells everywhere not a big deal. When I first walked into the unit it was EXTREMELY hot in there. I messaged the host asked if they had ac she said there is two fans. A small one in the living room and a standing rotating fan in the bedroom (which you can not change the temp on it only tells you the temp in the room which never went below 80 degrees) to turn those on and it would cool the place down quickly. I turned on both fans and left for the day came back around 3 am that morning the place was still extremely hot. So I left again and stayed somewhere else I couldn’t handle the heat and the place was entirely too hot to sleep in. The next day I came back gathered my things and went to the hotel I booked. I messaged the host and made her aware that I left because the conditions (the heat) where unbearable. If you have been to New York in the summer you know it is EXTREMELY hot outside so I top of that and the unit being hot it wasn’t suitable to stay. They need to get a portable AC unit or something because it was miserably hot in there. After I messaged the host to let them know about the heat she tells me she went down to thoroughly look at the unit and saw the heat was on full blast..that blows my mind. Why was a thorough investigation of the unit not done before the arrival of your guest. The location of the place is in a ok area it’s not fancy but it’s not very sketchy either the neighbors were very nice. However if you are wanting to be close to the city this isn’t the place for you it was a long ways ride to the city and an Uber on a weekend is going to run you close to 100 dollars. I would probably say this place is a good spot for the winter but unless they do more than just 2 little fans for this unit I would not at all recommend staying here in the summer.

It was hard getting in, the lock was a little complicated, but the host was helpful and quick to respond. The area is sketchy and I would not recommend walking around at night. The place was clean, but we had a few issues: the towels looked like they've been worn out, and didn't look the whitest/new. Also, there weren't enough towels for 7  people for 6 days. There is a washer, but the place didn't have any detergent. To add to that, there were only 2 rolls of toilet paper - super inconvenient! There was also a strong sewage smell that came from the basement every day. Furthermore, the kitchen had a coffeemaker, but no coffee was provided. The metro is about a 10 minute walk, so not too bad, but wish it was closer.

This hotel is a complete scam. They didn’t pick up when I tried to call so I couldn’t even check in. I had to find a last min hotel right next door and paid for this reservation plus the $250 for the other hotel. Not only that, but then these dumbasses had the audacity to try to charge me an extra $45 for checking in. Unbelievable. Literally the worst experience I’ve ever had with Airbnb. Do NOT book.

Pro’s:  Cristine responds very very fast, even if she is not present at the check-in, she is really prepared and she has all the instructions ready for her guests  Hot shower and warm temperature in the house  Location is good, you are 3mins walking from the nearest subway: there are a few shops, bars and churches around (good if you wanna watch a Gospel on Sunday!)   Con’s:  Check in is a bit complicated. We had to take a key from a park which was a few steps from the house but after 15h trip this is the last thing you wanna do  Also, Honestly, too MANY rules, I mean… we are here on holidays, we wanna relax.  Cleanings… We stayed for 5 nights and they provided ONLY one shower towel each. The house has two rooms so you need to share the toilet with others who may not be very clean (this doesn’t depend on Cristine obv)   You can hear noise from the neighbors, I woke up a few times during the night  Location may get a bit scary during the night when you get off the subway
There was mold in the apartment and the neighborhood was dangerous.

The place is nice. Bed was comfortable but the couch not so much so keep in mind if you want to rent this place for a bigger group of people. Towels and sheets seemed clean but I can’t say the same thing about the apartment. We found trash in random areas and the place didn’t look sanitized. You do have laundry machine and drying machine. Neighborhood is pretty creepy so careful at night. Overall we enjoyed our stay there.

Perfect sized apartment, beautiful, clean, and in an excellent location. Host provided the most laid back and helpful AirBNB experience I’ve had. Checkout day was relaxing and stress free. 100% recommend.

Katya's place was an exemplary experience! Very well-appointed, conveniently located, and absolutely perfect. Throughout the experience, the host was 100% in clear communication, everything was clearly in place and made for a terrific, stress-free stay.

Basically everything as advertised. Good value for money. Ok neighborhood, maybe a little bit sketchy late at night. Quite small bed for two people (140cm?), or it at least feels that way because the mattress is a bit worn so both of you end up in the middle.

I was so scared of sharing a place with someone I didn't know . Everything turn out so well after all I really enjoy my stay . Alicia really great at communicating with you I really appreciate that . Thanks again
the place is good, but the area felt unsafe, especially at the night

It was an interesting experience living in the Bronx and seeing the real New Yorker lifestyle (even though it can be dangerous at some places especially as women we had some issues there). Some places, like the floor in the bedroom or the bathroom weren't that clean.

The room was excellent, the check-in and check out is easy, is clean and the room has all what you need to stay in Manhattan,  just the doors are difficult to open and the neighborhood looks a little dangerous in the night.

A huge thank you to Indhira and Alex for supplying such a beautiful unit. With great connections and a short walk to the subway, the location was perfect. It was also lovely to be in Upper West/Harlem as we saw a side to NY that we might not have if we had gotten a hotel in midtown. It was one of the cheapest places we could find and also the nicest in its price range. We were so pleasantly surprised. Place itself is lovely- really warm and cosy. Access to a kitchen with a coffee pot and able to store things in refrigerator.  Flat itself was super quiet so never a problem getting to sleep.  Best shower ever 😍 On our late check-in, Alex was super helpful and lovely, as we had a chaotic arrival and met us much later than planned and he made it totally stress-free, and also recommended plenty of places he knows and loves!  We will hopefully be back to NYC soon and when that happens I won’t hesitate to grab this spot again!! Huge thanks again! Xx
Communication was very good. Everything was clean. Bad points: the wifi to my room was weak and I didn't like the location, it was very dark to get there at night and the area scared me

Marisol is an excellent host. She was very kind and helpful. However she didn’t tell us the bathroom was shared with two other guests, it was a surprise to us and it was not ver clean. However the room was quiet clean and the kitchen - which was also shared - had way more amenities to make all types of meals. The only other problem was the location was a little sketchy especially at night, but it was all part of the Bronx experience, and there was a lot of affordable food, transport and other shopping too!

Room was cold in winter. Had to use additional heater after reaching out to host. Neighbor is a lil shady using a m125 is a good option at night as it drops very close the place. Overall a good exp with host.

I should’ve known something was wrong when this listing didn’t have any pictures of the outside. Took forever to find a parking space and when we did find one 10 undercover police officers jump out to arrest 2 guys selling drugs in front of building. His listing is inaccurate saying that it was a 6 bedroom unit not units. I ask for a refund due to the fact that I had small kids with me and it was very unsafe to allow under age kids in a separate unit that I was unaware of. He would only refund me half of my money. Also he change listing after I ask for my money. Please stay away!! I will never book another airBNB without reviews again.
Place was accurate, parking is scare, but it didn’t stop our thanksgiving parade plans

I liked that The apartment was clean and modern. All supplies were provided. The communication with Avi was great, responding quickly to any questions. The part I did not like at all and the why of not so happy review is that the entrance to the apartment was in the back side of the building where they place all building trash and recycle. Not a nice entrance at all. We arrived at 10pm and it was extremely dark and full of trash which made it very scary for my mom and I.
Nice stay at Isabella's house. If you are not afraid of the ambiant noise due to cars & people in the street during night.

Satour’s place is exactly what you see in the pictures and more. The apartment is SO clean and I cannot stress this enough because it really is so well sanitized, the tub is extremely clean overall the bathroom is just spotless and it really makes it easier for you to feel safe as he has disinfecting products all around and he is always available to help you with anything you need. Great communicator and an outstanding host meeting all of the expectations to fulfill your stay as well as helping you with your check in process. I loved the open space concept that the apartment provides as well as the light that would come in, me being a morning person it really helped me start my day better and early with the light of the morning and seeing the sun rise from my window. Satour!! Thank you so very much for making me feel welcome and respecting my privacy, this place is definitely on my list of places I will revisit

The thing I love most about the place is the down to the Tee accuracy of how it looks in the pictures and in real life. The outdoor section plus the downstairs living room made you really feel at home. Like a goal to reach and live in a place like that. As someone from Bed Stuy, I missed being in this area which made it even more better. Had a bit of trouble when it came to heating up  food, but overall very hospitable. The central air gets very cold, and the look of the place with its art and overall calm atmosphere makes this a perfect place for the value. If anything it’s a steal for the price. You don’t want to leave after being there. I’ll be back Daryen I promise.

when  we arrived I was told there was no code on the lock box to the front door and that the door would be unlocked with key on the kitchen table...that did not make me feel very comfortable as I didn't know if I was gonna walk into the place with someone already in it due to the door being unlocked for hrs before we arrived...then upon entering it was FREEZING cold bc you need to turn on a space heater in the bedroom only 2 actually radiators in the apartment which was in no way enough to heat this place....one was right inside the second door and one in the bedroom none in the bathroom so there was no heat in there.....once I looked in the bedroom i found out that 2 of the beds where blow up beds and most times I probably wouldn't care BUT bc it was so cold I was terrified to sleep on them...hot water sucked so my shower would change from hot to cold and they have ROACHES...NEIGHBORS argued the entire time we where there and scared my children will never stay there again

At first not having a real full name of our host and getting the place information very close to arrival time was a bit unsettling, but everything went well with check in anyways. We solved the late check in issue by leaving our things in a luggage storage place around the corner.  The apartment is on the first floor after a very narrow and sometimes dirty stair. V asks guests to leave the window open when they finish their stay so when we arrived the place smelled of fried food as the window faces the block restaurant’s ventilations. This was really frustrating as the smell took a few days to leave because there is no other window to ventilate the place. There are also many things held with duct tape which gave a strange look (isolation for the window, in a door that seemed to lead to a fire exit stair, holding a brick of the wall and some things at the sink to name a few). Another con is the upstairs neighbor from whom you hear every step he/she takes as of 7, 6 or even 5 am every day… that together with the restaurants vents noise, make sure you won’t need an alarm clock.   For the pros, the place is less than 4 blocks away from Columbus Circle and really close to many subway lines and stations. There are many places to buy groceries and cooked food. Shower and bed was ok and kitchen is well equipped for 2. Would suggest improving floor cleaning as it looked dirty on corners and between furniture. Bathroom and closet were clean and spacious.   To sum up, although the building could seem a bit sketchy at first we didn’t have any problems besides smell and noise. Would recommend it just for the location.

Location & price great! Smaller than pics, but OK! Host wouldn't allow anyone but me to check in (all of us on reservation), & bc of schedule I was unable check in until after 10pm; my SIL's tried @5pm. They couldn't get in & one was pregnant & needed rest, it was super inconvenient & annoying. Host called & said it was Airbnb rule, but not found in listing or on Airbnb... Ran out of TP & requested more but never got it. Tiny thin towels that don't cover body; blankets thin & heat didn't work; 1 tiny mirror, 5 people couldn't get ready, etc. 1hr after checkout I get DM for $200 bc we "smashed the tv"?!? TV (not pictured in the listing fyi) is tiny, 6ft up on wall, & never touched by any of us. It was perfect entirety of our stay. We're 5 moms, don't consume anything that would alter our judgement, eyesight or memory. We didn't do it. Idk what kind of saw scam she's running, but it could be the greatest location in the world & it doesn't matter if the host is unreasonable & dishonest.

EXCELLENT location is worth the price. I only found the bath towels very thin and small, the toilet paper very thin, and sometimes they didn't turn on the heating. I wish there was a mop on hand to clean the bathroom as it gets the floor too wet and can be dangerous.
Great place ! Little sketchy area but definitely safe ! Was clean to a certain extent ! Just need to adjust some things & it would be perfect.

This is a great place to stay in Harlem. It is close to the station 116 st C line, which takes you all the way to Brooklyn in 40 minutes. On Frederick Douglas st, you can find a bar called The Fox (recommended by the host), and the Harlem Tavern. You can also walk to Central Park, and walk down to lower Manhattan. There is enough to do. Frederick Douglas may seem like a very sketchy street, but don’t worry, because it is New York after all. I totally recommend this place!

Super easy to find place. The white door is located behind the gate on the lower level. Almost got scared when I couldn’t find it. Great place. 6 Subway is close by and it is practically a straight line to all good stuff like Times Square and Grand Central. Hard to get lost. Abdon is great and attentive. Would stay again.

Great stay at this spacious and clean room. I booked a three-night stay to be near the testing site for the Bar Exam. Ismael and Rosa were very accommodating knowing it was a stressful and uneasy time. Although located in a vibrant and exciting neighborhood, the room is in a quiet — and safe — building. I was able to get to sleep with no disturbances every night. The entire space is well-maintained and feels cozy. I was able to feel at-home during my stay and used the kitchen as if it were my own.   The stay was everything I expected and more. Ismael and Rosa are not just great hosts; they are great people.

Salome’s place was a nice choice for our stay in NYC. It is about a 15 minute walk away from any subway so I would keep that in mind. Most of the walk is very safe but a little bit felt a bit sketchy and I’d be scared to go alone. The kitty is so so sweet!!!! I would like to mention that she has a male roommate as we did not expect this and we did not see Salome so we were with someone we hadn’t communicated with. It was a bit awkward as we did not get to introduce ourselves in person or anything, but the hosts and ourselves kept to our own spaces within the apartment. Overall, we enjoyed our stay.

I recently visited the Bronx from Jamaica with my family for a funeral (unfortunately). In the midst of what was an emotional & stressful time, Kiante was amazing. Her quick communication was superb. I bothered her about every little thing (especially seeing that we were a bunch of Jamaicans in New York on our own) and she was great. We needed a quick bite on our first night travelled and Kiante was there was transportation and meal recommendations STAT. The first night it was extremely cold, we asked for additional bed linen and Kiante had brand new linen delivered to us. I also thought the little details such as a shopping cart, scissors and tape for packing (just things to make traveling and shopping a little easier), access to an iron and ironing board etc. made Kiante a cut above a regular hostess proving a nice place to stay. This definitely was a great place to rest our heads on this trip, and I’ll definitely be using again should I ever visit the Bronx in the future.

The check-in process was a bit strange. The person handling over the keys was 15 minutes late and gave me the impression that the building did not allow subletting. I was told to mention a so-named "Gary" from a different unit if I was asked who I was staying with and mention this name in case I was ordering food. There were other signs that made me think the listing was breaking some rules. The cleaner also stayed around for 20 minutes after I checked in as he was not finished. This was all a bit unexpected since I was very tired from an international flight and wanted some quiet time right away. Besides all these issues, this place was spotless and a dream. It had everything you could hope for, but the check-in process made me feel the whole thing was a bit sketchy.

Made me wait 3+ hours from scheduled check in time, sketchy because she said superintendent does not know the unit is being Airbnb’d. Asked me to leave an hour early, made me wait an hour extra to give her keys, so basically she made me get ready early. Be ready to check in late & deal with mind games. Area is dangerous at night, had a homeless dude follow me a block for change.

Very central with all advantages and disadvantages. Very noisy corner, great for a short trip, it would be too loud and stressful for trips lasting several days. The hotel is very clean, communication is great.

It’s a very cozy place to stay. Both the bed room and the bathroom are nice and clean, it has everything you want. Gerry is a nice person and he always helping me with everything. The place is not far from subways, just 10-15 minutes away. Late night walk is not too afraid if you walk from Broadway Junction, it’s not as desolate as Rockaway station, but it’s nyc anyway so you got to be careful. Overall this is a very nice choice to stay if you travel on budget. It was a nice time staying here.

Gerry is a very nice and friendly house owner. I had a great time staying in his room. In the beginning, I was a bit sceptical as the place was new to me and I was also scared a bit. However, Gerry made me feel at home. He helped me navigate groceries, laundry and taking local transport. I found the place centre to train station and easy to commute to Brooklyn, Queens, and Manhattan. Coming back to the place -late at night (like 8:30-9 pm) was not a problem. Since I was scared to walk around in new york alone, I used the metro until Broadway Junction and took a taxi to the place which used to cost me only $10. I recommend this place to anyone who is a budget traveller and looking for a safe place to stay.

This hotel steals from its guests! I checked in at 4PM. I took my necklace off in the room. We went out to dinner and left the room at 6:30PM and came back to our room at 9PM. It only took 2 and half hours for them to come in and steal. Absolutely no reason why anyone should have came into our room. Only to violate their guests and rob them. I did not realize til the next morning when I went to put my jewelry on and it was gone. The front desk checked the cameras and ten minutes of the video was cut out. I was being gas lit and told I didn't have a necklace. So many red flags. It is heart breaking. If you still choose to stay here because it is super cheap and now I see why, make sure to not bring anything meaningful to you or worth anything. They will go thru your personal belongings. Ironically they have a love coffee and Jesus sign in the lobby so if the hotel staff will do the morality right thing and mail it back to me.

This place is centrally located between SOHO, Chinatown and Little Italy. There many great restaurants and shops. We did not feel unsafe in the neighborhood.  Keep in mind there are a ton of street vendors throughout NYC. No one was aggressive, but you will get asked about watches and handbags a lot.  Quick trips to both upper and lower Manhattan as well as into Brooklyn. Location made it easy to hop on the subway as there are stops on the corner.  The room is as described. No frills, but accommodating. Clean. Safe. Communication was great and host was friendly. Place is a little older so it has a few quirks, like getting the shower temp just right. But the water gets hot and the room is cozy. Would stay again for sure.

PLEASE DON NOT BOOK THIS HOME. This is the most honest review for this apt.  1- The address you have on AIRBNB is wrong after booking, it is a different one in the same street. While I am checking in, I received a message from Margo with different address. I got frustrated and felt unsafe and uncomfortable with wrong address.    2- The location is too far from the city. At least (90 minutes) 1 and half hour to reach Times Square or shopping area. In addition to subway station is 15 minutes away by walking.  3- We did not sleep well at night due to Ambulance sound at night as the home is by Hospital.  4- The apt was not cleaned well as expected. We saw mice coming from the outside heater. We were terrified to have like that.  5-There were no trash bin or recycle bin by the home or outside so we can through our trash bags outside the apt as well as the recycles. I had to take our trash away every 2 days to avoid pests problem. I checked with Margo to guide me and she said to leave all (recycles and garbage bags) inside the apt by checking out. After leaving,  she sent me a message to come back to clean the apt or she will be asking extra money for "unexpected" cleaning as she said. I asked her about the cleaning fee she collected with booking. She did not respond and filed a fake damage claim to collect extra money.    I have been using Airbnb 6 years and very rarely do I come into contact with such a delusional, vicious, and retaliatory host especially by checking out.  I have all evidences that there is no damage.   Please be careful and choose other listing even with high price to be comfortable.

The apartment itself is as listed and had pretty much everything we needed as a family of four with two young children. The communication was also great and Joga/Carupano were on hand if needed.  The location has great links to the airport (about 30 mins) and Manhattan (about 25 mins) via the L, J or C trains or the LIRR. We found there isn’t much by way of grocery stores or eateries around the apartment and that the neighbourhood, being quite industrial rather than residential (although it is opposite a school), could feel unsafe in the evening.

Gloria is really very accommodating and she takes all questions and needs seriously. No matter what time it is, it's really great. I got a second blanket straight away and they taped up the leaky joints. I was a little worried about the location (Bronx) at first, but it was never dangerous or unsafe. You can do that already.

Chris and Blair did everything to make our checkin smooth. Very responsive host and proactive. Absolutely great place for staying in NYC, you see only beauty and mighty of the city. But if you want to see homeless and crazy people, a lot of garbage and mixed cool and unpleasant views then just use a taxi and it will take 20 minutes to get there. We are satisfied staying here, no complaints. Next time I’d like to be here again.

Our apartment had a leak so we needed a place to crash for a few nights in the neighborhood. The description was accurate and the apartment itself is lovely and clean and well decorated. HOWEVER, we actually didn’t end up staying past the first night because the smell of marijuana was absolutely intense. My kid has asthma so this was an absolute no no for us. We ended up using the apartment to store a few things while our apt was being fixed. The smell was coming through the bathroom vent. Also the tall skinny dude whos the neighbor on the same floor FREAKED US OUT! Kept staring at us and definitely knew we were renting an air bnb and was totally creepy. I didnt bring my child after the first night. Also the listening device thats meant to detect “parties” and “loud noises” also freaked me out. This apt is definitely amazing for a single couple or a you g person but definitely not family friendly. The check in freaked me out as well. But its not worth going into.

The instructions were clear on getting into the premise and the space is mostly clean (minus a comforter that needed to be cleaned). The host doesn't live on the property, so be aware that you probably share the space with another guest/s. Despire this, my stay was unpleasant and overall a negative experience. I am hopeful the host will make some changes to ensure a smooth and safe stay for her future guests.
Nice place ! But very poor communication. It made the whole air bnb experience stressful. I had questions in which he did not answer till the day of .

We were Sonja and her co-host 1st guests at this Apt in Brooklyn. The actual apt was nice and matched the pictures, however in sketchy building that only has 3 other apartments in an old building. The apartment is on the 2nd floor and quite frankly a liability to even go upstairs as the stairs are steep and ragged. Although the APT was lovely, the hosts were very unpleasant after our stay.  We followed all protocols for the apartment before we left, yet some how, the host made up a list of damages to try and obtain additional money from us. If you do decide to book, please be sure to TAKE PICTURES OF EVERYTHING!!! We literally swept, mopped, recycled , took out the garbage and most importantly kept the apt in tip top shape… only to turn around to have these false accusations against us! Again if you do decide to book, take pictures if EVERYTHING and most importantly WATCH YOUR BACK! There’s no telling what lies these people would make up to get some extra coins. I’ve been staying at BNBs for ages and decided to take a chance on this new hosts and it back fired! I have filed an official complaint against these hosts! I’ve NEVER had any issues in all the years that I’ve booked through Airbnb… Never again!

Finger nails on the floors. Yellow sheets (unwashed) Washing machine not working. No way to use the building laundry room because host didn’t manage the card you need for the payments of using laundry machines. People (homeless’s) coming at the door, trying to enter and messing up all the area out the door; this because building door is always open and people know this and enter. Be aware, we always had worries during the day, while at night we heard people trying to enter.  I’ve been here two months, contacted the host multiple times (I have the conversations and pictures of the apt when I checked in) without any kind of help on any kind. Beyond that when it was time to earn the rent, they were very responsive and flashy. I don’t recommend this apt/host/company at all.  Let’s get to the good things. The neighborhood is great, fish place couple steps from apt that is great and subway just near the building. As you can see, nothing of the good things was about the unit.

Safe, quiet, clean room but the bed is 1/2 a cot and not stable. The fridge was dirty and the stove was covered in stuff and looked unsafe to use. No hot water in the kitchen  There was no desk and only 1 outlet.   Also, odd system of leaving the outside door unlocked during the day
Nice cheap place to go, no fear of crime ,quiet at night.

The Apartment is on the fourth floor with a very narrow stair case, dangerous with luggage Security code didn’t work and we had to wait hours outside on the walkway   No lights in the kitchen and tv works from wifi so always dropping out Price is heavy for what U get

My family and I stayed at Rahmel’s for the weekend and we truly enjoyed it. We were there for a funeral and the comfort of his unit gave no additional stress. Will be staying the next time we visit! Also, the neighbors were amazingly sweet!

I want to start by saying Katsiaryna really gave us an exceptional and one-of-a-kind Airbnb experience, this was BEYOND the best Airbnb host I have ever had the pleasure of dealing with! It is an understatement to say she was such an extremely accommodating host, she truly made my girlfriend and I feel at home in every sense. Though we only stayed there for a weekend, throughout our stay she would gift us fresh pastries from a local bakery, a couple cans of wine, and many servings of her delicious homemade banana bread! She even offered my girlfriend and I a ride home when we were out late at night in Brooklyn. I can't stress enough how much Katsiaryna took care of us, 5 stars isn't enough for her! I haven't even gotten to her studio yet! The check-in process was extremely simple, and Katsiaryna was very detailed in her messages and is an excellent communicator at all times of the day and night! Her space is lovely in every sense of the word! For starters, it's decorated beautifully and very visually appealing. The studio was extremely well-equipped, beyond any Airbnb I've ever stayed in! There is a smart TV in the studio, and the queen-size bed is very comfortable. In the bathroom, you'll find any and all essentials you'll need, and the shower was SO nice and comfortable, we never wanted to leave it! And to say the kitchen is fully equipped would also be an understatement! This place truly had it all, a full oven and stove, a toaster, blender, electric kettle, even an air fryer! She even had an assortment of snacks for us sitting in the kitchen, which we certainly took advantage of! The temperature was always very comfortable in the studio, even in the summer, as there's a big window AC unit to cool the place off when needed. The neighborhood is quiet, safe, residential, and conveniently close to the A train, which got us into the city within an hour. Just below the A train is a cluster of wonderful stores and food spots, we were bummed we couldn't visit them all! But if you're in for a classic New York slice, definitely visit Boardwalk Pizza, you can't go wrong! Just a ten minute walk down to the water from the place and you're at Rockaway Beach! All in all, this place is everything you could ask for in an Airbnb, a private, comfy, extremely well-equipped space, with an absolutely exceptional host. I assure you that you will not regret booking this Airbnb if you're staying in NYC. Our stay was as perfect as it gets, and Katsiaryna will make sure your stay is the same, if not better!
Rob was an excellent and responsive host,  great place and location.

The  bed was lovely and comfy.  The flat was OK, though I have made a few suggestions to Quentin for improvements.  Check in was very stressful, as Quentin had given us  inaccurate door codes.  The system is also quite complicated and needs better explanation in advance.  We eventually got in with the help of neighbours and Quentin on the phone

Beatriz was an amazing host, a really caring person … we traveled with 3 kids and she was very flexible letting us to do an earlier check in, also the place was clean and it looks exactly as the pictures, a great location in a very quiet neighborhood we didn’t see any homeless around the area, this is not our first time in New York, we love New York and definitely this will be our stay in the future. Thanks

The property was extremely clean and smelled great! When we pulled up the location seemed a little sketchy , however we had no issues. Only thing I would suggest is for  a space that sleeps up to 6 ppl , it would have been nice to accommodate more ppl to sit comfortably in the living room as there is only  a small couch that only seats about 3. The last night of our stay  we all wanted to eat and watch a movie together and it was a little uncomfortable. one of my guest also suggested  a nite stand in the middle bedroom. Other than that the property  was great and wld stay  again when in Brooklyn.

Nice place in a cool location in Brooklyn close to a lot of shops, restaurants and a few minutes distance from a metro station. It was pretty loud due to being on a big avenue though… Imrul has been a perfect host I must say, we had a few requests and he made sure they were all taken care of quickly so we appreciated that! The only other downside except for noise would be the neighborhood, we felt a bit unsafe coming home at night as it’s next to sketchy nightclub. However, I still recommend this place if you’re looking for a cheaper place to stay not far from Manhattan!
Perfect location. Safe neighborhood.  Prompt response from Rob.  Beautiful house and backyard.  Definitely 5 stars house.
Great stay! Rob was an awesome host. Place is clean, comfortable, and such a great location. So many restaurants and places to check out.
The place is beautiful, and Rob is an excellent host. He was very accommodating, and helpful. I would definitely stay there again or at any of the other properties Rob manages.

We loved Rob’s place.  The place looks exactly like the pictures, and the furnishings are all quite new.  The location in Brooklyn is right near various amenities (grocery, coffee, gym, etc).  We enjoyed the very large backyard area as well.  Highly recommended.
Rob was super quick to respond and very accommodating. The house was beautiful- out door space is to die for. Located in a great part of town. Will definitely be back again!

We had a great stay here during a long late-fall weekend. Easy access to great food, shopping and public transportation. Plenty of room for the 5 guests we had. Rob was very responsive and check-in/out was easy.

Had a great stay here! The living area is comfortable and cozy, and all of the bedrooms/ bathrooms are really nicely done and very well set up for guests. The kitchen wasn't super stocked but had all the basics needed. The house is in a cool area near some great restaurants and bars, and is less than a block from an awesome coffee/lunch/grocery spot that I ended up going to every day. The parking spot in front of the driveway was also a huge help. The backyard is really spacious and a great spot to hang. I did have a little trouble figuring out the hot tub but Rob was super responsive and helpful. The only bummer was it was very slow to heat up so ended up not being able to use it- just keep that in mind if you're staying in colder months. Would definitely recommend staying here!

This apartment was great for our stay through Thanksgiving.  Our party of 6 fit very comfortably. It very close to many restaurants and a block away from the L.  It was very easy to check in and Rob was available to answer our questions. The added bonus is the backyard with many more amenities.

The house was perfect for our group of 8! This was a women's gathering we do each year in NYC for the holidays, and we all enjoyed exploring this fantastic neighborhood in Brooklyn. There were plenty of shops and restaurants within walking distance, but the house is in a quiet, residential area. It is also a quick walk to the subway station and an easy ride into Manhattan. The house and furnishings are beautiful and so cozy and comfortable. The house was decorated for the holidays - which was a lovely touch! The layout was great for our group with room for us to all gather. Rob was a great host and very easy to communicate with. We didn't spend much time in the outdoor space, but if the weather had been warmer, we would have likely spent all of our time there. It is a fantastic space and an oasis from the city. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend the house to anyone who wants to partake in all the fun things to do in Williamsburg, but still get a good night's sleep

Me & my wife & KIDS  (18 month old, 8, 12 year old) Rob provided us a Pack n Play, Baby Walker, Stroller & much much more. It made traveling so much more easier, we are extremely thankful. Speechless everything was exactly as described. The beds super comfy & the home was decorated for Christmas, huge hit with the kids. Located literally next to everything & right next to public transportation. Wonderful area to explore restaurants & enjoy the Nightlife Lounges & Bars are plentiful here. Rob was responsive & went above & beyond. I will definitely book this home again.

The house is great and comfortably accommodated our party of 7. Rob is an extremely responsive host and was happy to let us drop/leave bags while the cleaners were there to tie in with our flights. It’s a quick walk to the subway, in a fun area of Brooklyn and near some very nice Italian restaurants. We really enjoyed our stay, thanks Rob!

All the prior reviews are spot on. This is a great location on the eastern side of Williamsburg. Quiet street, but close to many restaurants and a short walk to the heart of the neighborhood. Great coffee, cheese and snack shop (Campbell’s) on the same block just down the street. Liquor just store around the corner. Two blocks from the intersection of the L train (to Manhattan) and the G train (to many points in Brooklyn). VERY convenient to explore NYC.  The apartment was spotless and comfortable. It appears it had a fairly recent update, and Rob, the owner, has thought of everything….down to the abundant charging cords in the living room. Due to the cold weather we didn’t use the large back patio, but it is fantastic.  Finally, Rob is a great host, responds quickly, and provides good recommendations.  My only concern with leaving such a glowing review is that we run a greater risk of the apartment being booked during our next trip to Brooklyn. Couldn’t have been more pleased!
Rob was really helpful and his place is great! we stayed with family and it was very family friendly!

Had a great bday weekend staying at Rob's place! The location was very central, and it was easy to walk to all of our weekend activities. It was also super convenient to be able to have ample street parking, as we had multiple cars. The home was perfectly clean, all amenities included (linens, shampoo/conditioner/soap, cleaning supplies, etc), and it was so fun to have the backyard space. Would definitely recommend this spot!

Super cute Williamsburg apartment, well furnished, comfortable beds and very clean.  Rob was a very responsive host.  Although the description says the apartment sleeps 10, there are only 3 bedrooms and 4 beds (3 fulls and one king), so depending on the configuration of your party, it may only sleep 5-7.   There is a blow up mattress, for an additional bed.  Lovely comfortable apartment within walking distance to stores and restaurants.

Excellent interior conditions, obviously in the Bronx it is always a bit dangerous, good location, not far from the subway, a mini market in front of the very attentive dark-skinned gentleman, it is worth visiting NY without a doubt

Cheaper is not always better. I wouldn't recommend anyone stay here this is far from luxury. House needs a deep professional cleaning. First off when we did walk through of home bedroom door panel was broken, the bathtub was filthy and it was clogged up with hair. The toilet seat lid was broken off and beds well we didn't even used them because strans of hair were on covers two slept on couch and used one blanket from messy cabinet closet and the other had her own blanket and I stayed with a friend that's how uncomfortable we were in home. Had only one towel we used for the nasty bathroom floor she said it was damaged lol and no wash cloths luckily we brung our own. We were there for West Indian day parade and wanted to keep stress level low after a long ride from NC so we looked passed all of the above. Now i wasnt even going to write a review to save her from bad reviews until host stated that we broke panel off door, broken iron, cigarette hole in sheet and was texting wanting to argue with me saying we left her place in a mess. Its very unprofessional.

We were scared when we arrived because we didn't have a response from Damoya but she apologized and gave us a reduction on the rent! She is super nice and the apartment is clean and big.  Metro station 7 minutes walk away, very convenient.  The only negative point is the sound insulation, otherwise great.  Thanks again to Damoya for welcoming us

This really is a steal of a deal for the location and price. Amanda's place is less than a 5 minute walk to the subway so it was very convenient to get around. The neighborhood felt very safe and was actually very quiet which allowed us to get a good night's sleep. Amanda was very flexible with our check in time, which allowed us to drop our bags off after arriving on an early morning flight. We will definitely be back the next time we are in New York!

Great stay at Gary's apartment. The unit is very spacious and incredibly clean. As others have noted, the outside of the building looks a little suspect, but once inside, the building seems to be very quiet. We passed some of the neighbors in the halls throughout our stay and everyone was very pleasant. The street noise was only really noticeable during the day, but the street seemed relatively quiet for NYC at night. The apartment is also very conveniently located to lots of restaurants and shopping. The Whole Foods & wine/ liquor store across the street was great for when we wanted to enjoy meals & drink at the apartment. The bathroom had a couple minor cosmetic issues, but there was a note letting us know they will be fixed/ replaced soon, so hopefully that won't be a concern for future guests. We enjoyed our stay thoroughly and would definitely look to stay here again the next time we are visiting NYC.

The apartment is exactly like the pictures posted.  It is very clean, large and well decorated.  The neighborhood was fine during the day but a little scary in the evening.  We just made sure the we Uber'd back in the evenings.
It was a wonderful experience, and such a steal for being close to the transit system. Travel in the Manhattan area couldn’t be any easier!

I had an amazing time at Martha’s place. I flew in over the thanksgiving weekend and she was kind enough to invite me to have dinner with her family. She was kind and accommodating, I felt right at home. The room is just as described, perfect for those wanting to affordably stay in NYC for a few days. The location is as expected, a little further out than downtown but close enough to get to main places on the subway within less than half an hour, and Harlem is walkable. The bed was comfortable and easy enough to get in and out of the flat to come and go as you please. Perfect stay for what I was looking for, and a real steal for those on a budget! Thanks again Martha

Great apartment and Shosh is a great host. Check-in was easy, Shosh was responsive and we enjoyed our stay.  For those not familiar with NYC, East Harlem is a few subway rides from most places to visit. It can also be a sketchy area to walk around, even during the day and to the subway.

Sasha is a lovely and conscientious host. The apartment is well-situated close to everything one would need practically (drug & grocery stores) and in terms of entertainment. It is close to subways and bus routes and because it's so central, even cabs are relatively affordable.   The room itself is clean, big, sunny and the bed is super-comfy. Best of all? It's quiet! I would be happy to stay here again and my only regret is that I was running around so much (I was there on  business), I didn't have the chance to get to know  my host a little better! Next time for sure. If Sasha's room is available when you're travelling, book it.

This is a lovely spacious house. 6 adults shared this space for 1 week without any issues. The subway into Manhattan takes approximately 30 min, the station is a 6 min walk from the house. Most nights we didn’t get back to the house until 10-11 pm. We never felt unsafe walking back from the subway.  Antonella replies promptly to any messages and addressed any concerns immediately.

Check-in was smooth. Amy’s grandmother waited for us outside and walked us in, gave us a tour and explained everything. For the price, you get a good deal. Bathroom was ok, no big issues. Hosts made sure that all other guests kept noise level at a minimum. Parking was available. The bus runs really nearby to the subway or downtown. Walking late at night it didn’t feel unsafe. The bed was firm though, but that is really normal in Asian countries so if you have been to Asia you will be used to it like I am. Overall, it was a great stay. I recommend it.

Based on the past positive reviews and photos of Maryam and Hilal's apartment we were definitely convinced this was the best option for our stay in Brooklyn, the apartment looked very comfortable and inviting.  Great photos!! because seeing the apartment in person told a different story.  My review is not to deter anyone, but just to inform about our experience and what to expected from the apartment.  People have different opinions of "Great or Good" so this space maybe ideal for some. We spent 3-nights in the apartment and throughout our stay it remained cold inside, while the temp outside was in the mid 30's. We grew suspicious when the cleaning lady let us in and said we had to use the small portable heaters to heat the apartment, which never heated up a single room.  The radiators in the apartment did not provide any heat, my daughter, husband and I had to sleep in full clothing to stay warm.  We tried to freshen up when we arrived but after running the water for more than 10 mins the hot water did not come on.  We called and spoke to Maryam, she was very pleasant and explained we had to let the water run for a bit for the hot water to flow as it's an older building, this worked but was not convenient for time. The space is very tight and needs repairs, it's lacking many personal touches.  The sofa bed is not a true bed it's just a pull out extension of the sofa itself, which was not comfortable for sleeping.  The other disturbing thing is that there is mold on the bathroom ceiling. I later found out the mold has been in the apartment as stated in someone's review from a year ago.  This clearly should have been fixed after all that time.  The apartment did smell clean; floors, inside the shower and kitchen were all clean. At $159/ night we did not expect 3 or 4 stars, but it would of been nice to be warm and not have mold growing in the bathroom.  These were some of the issues that made our stay in the apartment uncomfortable.

To start, Matt was a completely accommodating and friendly guy to rent from! He was super responsive, offered to show me around the neighborhood when I arrived and would check in with me via text occasionally to make sure everything was working well. He was especially helpful working with my weird check in and out times!   The apartment itself is pretty bare, but for someone who was only looking to sleep and shower there, I didn't mind! It was very clean and Matt was kind enough to offer up anything in his apartment for use.   A few minor improvements could be made, but first with this caveat. This apartment is a steal for the price! This is a VERY good price for this neighborhood and I'd be happy to pay for it again. However, I'd be willing to pay even more if there was a way to get a little more cool air in the apartment. There is a window AC unit in the living room, but it just wasn't strong enough to do anything outside that room. There was a fan propped up to hit the bed, but it just wasn't enough to keep the hot summer evenings from being a sweat fest. Showers helped, but the hot / cold water is very finicky in the building (as Matt mentioned when I arrived), and the drain was slow. Again, none of these things were to the degree where I felt like I needed to call Matt; feels like relatively minor complaints for the price. Would definitely recommend if you need a cheap place to crash!

NIce location across from a park and within a few minutes walk of the subway to get you wherever you want to go. The room was clean and the bed was super comfortable! It was such a treat to get a homemade breakfast every morning. Instead of getting dressed and heading out for coffee as soon as I woke up, I could take my time which made my stay stress-free and relaxed. Just what I needed! Philbert and Faye are awesome hosts and quick to respond. Would definitely stay there again.

This was an amazing studio, the atmosphere of the apartment was incredible and secluded. The location is in between two trains, the L and the J, which made traveling New York very easy and stress free. This apartment felt like a home away from home and I hated to leave. Valeria was also very helpful for anything we needed and felt like just a message away. I would definitely recommend to anyone who is looking for an airbnb in the area.

We had a seriously great stay at Valeria's place! The apartment is super clean and all the furnishings, including the kitchen appliances, seem brand new. Valeria was very communicative and everything was arranged easily. I can't stress enough how hassle free the whole stay was, my wife and I will definitely stay again if we come back into town. A great stay and would definitely recommend her place to anyone looking for somewhere to stay in Brooklyn!

this place is pretty much accurate what is showed on the pictures. everything is right on the dot - smooth self check in, cleanliness apartment, and everything you need from there. if you want to use the kitchen if you're not in mood to go out eat restaurant ...theres grocery you can walk to. if you're in mood to go out eat restaurants theres near by ...like cafe or donuts for breakfast, for lunch or dinner you can option for pizza, mexican, vietnamese, turkish, & middle eastern all within a block or two. as for public transportation theres subway just two block down...it will connect you to JFK airport, to Dumbo, to Manhattan, to Central Park, to Yankee Stadium, and to Statue of Liberty. this area is kid-friendly and not one sight of homeless people there. the host is very effective on communication...to make sure you have all amenities  you need upon your arrival. great host!

The apartment is in a great location and very close to the subway! The host was very responsive and fast to reply. Only downside is that the apartment is outdated, wasn’t very clean and unfortunately, we had seen cockroaches every single day (although it can also be a New York thing). On the first night, there was an issue with the gas and we felt very unsafe but the host shut off the gas during our stay to keep us comfortable which we appreciated. Overall a decent stay for the price and the good location.

Jeremy was very communicative, friendly and helpful throughout the process. The place was super cute - tastefully decorated and spacious for NY. Appliances were updated, bed was very comfortable and it was awesome to have the Apple TV. The neighborhood was exactly what you'd expect in BedStuy and I didn't feel unsafe at all. Awesome spot to use as a launchpad for roaming around Brooklyn!

The stay with Valeria was very nice. Check-in was very easy. Everything was well thought out and super organized. The communication was very nice and always helpful. The garden is of course the highlight of the apartment. If New York is too stressful for you, you can end the day there in the evening very well and calmly.  We were completely satisfied. Thank you!!!

We stayed in Jeremy's apartment for 5 days. It is located about ten minutes from two subway lines, which makes it quite easy to be in Manhattan in about forty minutes. The accommodation is large and well equipped, with a bedroom and a bed in the living room. Jeremy was always available; whether for our arrival or to give us advice. He also made our departure easier by allowing us to leave our luggage in the apartment until our evening flight.

Rhonda's place is only a ten minute cab ride from JFK and was perfectly situated for my husband and I to rest up after a looong journey. Rhonda has thought of everything you could possibly need for a comfortable stay and her communication is great! Check in and out is stress free via a key code and it's quiet (apart from the odd plane overhead) as well as being private so you can get a good sleep. The sheets were silky, the bathroom was immaculate, towels were fluffy and we really appreciated the coffee and snacks! Thanks Rhonda we would definitely stay again.

We had a good stay. The entry to the basement rooms was very convenient with the code and no need to figure out how to get a key. The room was very private. Our only issue was an unpleasant smell (like gas). But the breakfast snacks were really great after we came in from our flight too late to be able to bring snacks with us.
