The bathroom was very clean.  A good place to eat close by is called Jamaican flavors - great take away food and service.  Good value for one night's stay.

My family and I thoroughly enjoyed Valeria’s apartment. I prefer to spend a lot of my time in Manhattan, and the commute there was easy enough with close connection to both the J and L train. The apartment is spacious and we especially enjoyed the outside space which had comfy seating and a beautiful canopy of trees covering parts of it where we could catch some shade on the hotter days. Valeria is attentive and welcoming, enabling a sense of security and comfort. Highly recommend staying here, regardless if you’re traveling with friends, family or solo.

Rhonda is an incredible host! My girlfriend and I were staying at another airbnb that ended up being very sketchy and I messaged Rhonda about staying at her place the following night so we could get out of that sketchy airbnb asap. She responded right away even though it was late at night and she even accommodated an early check in the following afternoon. There was ample street parking available and we felt very safe there. The space had everything we needed and was very cozy, with nice touches included. The location was close to a train station and not far from Manhattan. I'll definitely be staying here again when I visit NY!

I travelled to New York alone with my daughter which is why I chose to go through airbnb, my thinking was at least I would then know one person in the big scary city. I am so glad I did. From the moment I met Louise I didn't feel alone of scared of New York. She has been the perfect host and made me feel completely comfortable and at ease with contacting her regarding anything during my stay. Louise  is such a wonderful person to get to know while staying in NewYork.  When travelling it is the people you meet as much as the place that make up your experience and my has trip to New York has been all the better having met Louise. She is knowledgeable about New York, having lived here her whole life and is so willing to help with advice (which trains will get you where the quickest and where to get them etc.).  The location to the subway is great and feels safe to walk home from even late at night.  The neighbourhood is really charming as is the house and the room is newly constructed and well appointed with everything you will need and more.  I can't recommend Louise's home enough to other airbnbers.

We had a wonderful stay at Maria's place in Williamsburg, Brooklyn! Her place was super clean and very comfortable. The central location was extremely convenient - close to everything we wanted to explore in the area. Communication with Maria was a breeze as well - which made the experience even better - no stress, no worry! Finally, I want to share that the building itself was very quiet and we felt very safe at all times! I highly recommend!

Sophia was great and gave us a warm welcome to Brooklyn. Nice apartment…pretty spacious for NY living and right next to the subway.  She responded promptly to all my messages and helped make the trip stress free! Recommend :)

Sophia was very sweet. The check-in was easy and accommodated our red-eye flights. Apartment was clean. Neighborhood was a little louder and more unsafe than expected, but the train was close and the commute was not terrible to Manhattan as long as you are not trying to go there and back multiple times a day. Overall happy with our decision to book this AirBnB over paying a higher price for a hotel.

Louise's studio is very quaint and has lots of amenities for a studio, including a little kitchenette and cable TV. I found the place to be very comfortable and I had no trouble working remotely during the week. There are also lots of good restaurants and cafes just a short walk away. For Prospect Park South, this is a steal.

Jeniffer was unresponsive when I had a $500 pair of shoes stolen by another person from the building. I asked her over email and messenger if it was possible for security to look at the CCTV footage in the lobby at the time the shoes were stolen (it was a specific 5 minute period). She did not respond - and still has not.  I’m not sure if this building is safe given what happened to me. I stayed for 4 weeks.

I found it stressful  when asking about our arrival time at the last minute.  We had understood that we had until 11pm to pick up the key and we did not know exactly what time we would be there because we were coming from hours away so, that made us feel like things were going to be a problem.  Secondly, I think it would have been reasonable that we should have been expected to be told about the massive construction project directly across the street.  We would never have agreed to stay there had we known the level of noise we would be subjected to.  It was right across the street, we did not sleep.  Needless to say, our entire trip was impacted.      Thirdly, the apartment was dusty and the shower smelled of urine.

Cozy and charming apartment, very comfortable with plenty of space for your stuff. The location is good. I read previous reviews about the noisiness of the apartment, but I couldn't disagree more. There ia a small graveyard of some sort just across the apartment, so it is safe to say that the neighbors are quiet :) (if you find it creepy just keep the curtains closed). Check in/out was very easy, you just take the key from a safe and return it the same way. Even though you never meet the host, Shelby is super attentive. I had a lot of questions and she responded quickly and patiently to all of them. Thank you Shelby!

Jeremy’s apartment was perfect, in my opinion only a 5 star hotel can be better in New York...  No 3 and 4 star hotels in NY can match up to this place... The apartment is very clean, cozy and spacious. Both beds are huge and very comfortable. I visited NY at the end of February and beginning of March so we had some  pretty cold days and nights... The heating was perfect! We never felt cold and the apartment was always warm when we arrived home late at night...The best feeling! It's located very close to the subway...(The G train is at 5 minutes walking distance...) There is a pizza place and a chinese restaurant 3 minutes  away ( arround the corner) and 2 delis...In case you need get some food or drinks The neighbourhood is safe also, we came home every day walking from the subway late at night and there was absolutely nothing to worry about, no incidents what so ever! I am writing this because I saw some comments about the neighbourhood not being very safe... not true! People who consider this neighbourhood to be unsafe have no idea what an usafe neighbourhood is...In NY especially...:) Jeremy was a great host, during our 10 day stay I messaged him 2-3 times using  the  airbnb app and he always responded kindly and offered the best advice. I totally recommend  this place and I rate it as one of the best appartements I have ever stayed in using airbnb. I definitely would want to stay there the next time I will go to NY,  if it will be available.  PS: I forgot to mention that Jeremy left us european adaptors  so we can charge our devices in case we didn't have american ones and he also left us  2 power banks (charged and ready to be used) in case  out battery's die while we are out in the city! What a great host....! Thanks again Jeremy!

Jeremy was a fantastic host! Very friendly and will get back to you really quickly. His brownstone is on a very quiet street in Bed Stuy Brooklyn. I recommend using the G train rather than the J, since it’s closer and not as sketchy. Bed-Stuy is definitely an up-and-coming area, however I still would not go out at dark. Wonderful stay… great apartment with all updated appliances and lighting.

We loved our stay here! We knew we'd be out and about most of the time, so we wanted a quiet, clean, peaceful home base that was still conveniently close to everything, and this fit the bill. The bed was comfortable, the apartment was clean, the hosts were responsive and the check in and check out process was smooth. It was easy to get to the subway station from there, and the neighborhood was quiet and calm. (I saw a few reviews saying the neighborhood was sketchy and that made me lol -- maybe if you're from the suburbs or a rural area, but I live in a city too, and there is nothing sketchy about the neighborhood by city standards haha).I would definitely stay here again.

FIVE STARS! LUXURY AIRBNB stay with Polina in Prospect Heights.  Polina made my family's stay warm and welcoming.  She communicated with my family before, during and after the stay and I cannot thank her enough for hosting my family (through Blizzard Jonas!).  The apartment is even better than pictured (though it seems hard to believe).  Fully equipped chef's kitchen stocked with every tool you need (oxo tools, stainless steal pans, oil, salt, coffee grounds, french press, dish soap, dishwasher etc.).  The apartment is spotless with fresh towels, linens, cable, and shampoo/soap.  If you want to do laundry, you can take advantage of the brand new Maytag washer dryers.    If you're thinking about staying at a hotel with your family, please don't.  This apartment is conveniently located to all subways and a host that even shovels the Airbnb entrance during a blizzard.  My only worry is that it will get too popular :-) Thanks again, Polina!

Strongly not recommended if sensitive to dirt! I took this accommodation for 6 nights with my son and we were scared as soon as we arrived! First a welcome for a person other than the owner, a mess throughout the apartment, "beer corpses" everywhere in the apartment up to our room!! Visited the room: the old sheets were not changed and there was more than apparent dirt throughout the room; we had to clean up ourselves with the means at hand, tired and worried about where we fell. Positive points are that the apartment is well located, quiet with a beautiful view of Manathan; the rest is just filth!

Rosa contacted me right away and was sure to answer any questions I had before making the reservation.  The house is in a safe residential area, and we never felt unsafe walking to the subway or at night.  We even parked our car down the street for the entirety of our 3 night stay (for free!) and it was completely fine. Be sure to reserve some time to explore some of the great Jamaican & Jewish food you'll find right outside of your door! We saw jerk chicken being grilled right on the sidewalk - yum!  This should be listed as a shared space NOT entire home/apt. The bathroom is shared, and to be honest we found it a bit awkward trying to figure out what the best times to shower, etc. would be. The bathroom was nowhere as clean as the picture, and the shower you will use is not the one shown.  It is actually to the left of the toilet, and very small.  We did not see any of the roommates during our stay, and only heard them a few times inside their rooms and in the bathroom, but again, we felt very awkward.  The pictures of the house make it look like a clean and bright space, but in reality it was dusty and cluttered.   The room is nice and spacious and is as pictured.  The bed was great for two people but extremely hard.  Uncomfortably hard.  We loved that there were plenty of extra pillows and blankets, as it was colder than expected during our stay.  It takes anywhere from 20-40 min to get into the city by subway.  The subway station is only about a 10 min walk from the house.  Using the Maps app on an iPhone allows you to figure out what trains to take to get you where you're going - highly recommend!  If you are exploring the city for the first time, I recommend getting something closer. Going back in the middle of the day to rest a little or to take a nap wasn't an option since we were further away from the city.  Even when exploring Brooklyn, we were still 20 min away from everything we wanted to explore.  This listing is SO cheap for NYC, but please realize it does come at a price. If you are looking to explore NYC/Brooklyn on a budget, don't mind taking a little time to get to your destinations, and can handle sleeping on a rock, then this is for you!  Looking back, I wish we would have spent a little extra money for some added comfort and proximity.

I am almost hesitant to write my glowing review of this apartment as it was so perfect for our family that I’d be sad if it were taken the next time we’re in NY. Clean, spacious, perfect for a family of 4. Even had toys and books that were perfect for our younger son, and a Patti Smith book that was perfect for us. Great location close to trains, restaurants, drug stores, delis, etc. Highly recommend.
Claudia and Ian are amazing hosts! They really want you to feel comfortable and right at home. I stayed here as I searched for an apartment in NYC and this stay made my experience stress-free.

Claudia was great to coordinate our stay. The location was close to 4 subways lines (a couple of blocks away) to get to/from Manhattan (upper & lower). I wouldn't stay out too late and be walking around the neighborhood past 11pm or so. A little sketchy. I felt safer with the hospital & Fire dept. at the end of the street and a school across the street.  Ben's Bagels on the way to the subway was cheap, delicious, open early for breakfast. Also nearby was Burger King, Popeyes, McD's, Taco Bell and Walgreens. Overall, the Airbnb was in a perfect location for tourist traveling, but again very sketchy/dirty neighborhood. The building was dirty and grimy (wall way & stairs). But Claudias apt was tidy, clean, however it can use a fresh coat of paint. No visible signs of bugs or vermin.  Beds were ok (no bedbugs). Parking was street side only and we parked in front of the building and left it there all weekend without issues. The only bylaw visible was no parking btwn 11am-12:30pm Mon & Thur.

We did not have a positive experience here at all. The pictures in this post are extremely deceiving. To start off, it is a lot smaller than the photos indicated. You literally have to shuffle around for somebody to walk through the apartment. When you sit on the futon in the living room, the TV is mounted on the wall about a foot and a half from your face. I am 5’4” and I had to sit sideways on the toilet because my knees hit the wall when I sat down. None of the doors would open up fully because they run into furniture. The bed in the bedroom hits both sides of the wall, and there is very little room to store any luggage. We could’ve dealt with the size though, it was the filth that we could not deal with that ultimately lead us to leave at 9:30 pm on our first night there and check into a hotel, putting us out of a lot of money. The place didn’t seem clean from the very beginning, when Jennifer’s employee (Jennifer apparently was out of town) opened the door from the street immediately there was trash all over the entry way, and all the way up the 4 (narrow) flights of stairs. Then once we got into the apartment, it looked like the blankets and sheets had just been thrown onto the bed and futon, they didn’t even look washed or fresh. I could not have slept there comfortably without the fear of going home with bed bugs. In the bathroom, the shower was filthy, and filled with USED, yes used and open, shampoo and body wash sitting in the shower. Under the sink there were  loofahs and an open foot fungus cream. There were only 3 towels and one roll of toilet paper left for us, for a 2 night stay with 3 people. It turns out, Jennifer was out of town and didn’t contact us until the morning we were supposed to check out, asking us what time we wanted to check out. So I’m assuming if we would’ve needed more toilet paper or towels we would’ve been SOL. Also, as we were leaving to go to our hotel at 9:30 pm, we were standing outside waiting for our Uber and saw what we suspected was a drug deal going on right next to us. So the location might be great for food and entertainment but if you’re looking for a safe area, this isn’t it. We tried contacting Jennifer to explain our situation and hopefully get some kind of money back for the huge inconvenience, but we have heard nothing from her. I would highly recommend booking somewhere different.

My family and I absolutely loved the urban living that this flat provided us during our long weekend stay in NYC. Brooklyn is where it is and this apartment and its host did not disappoint. Sandrine made sure we were welcome from the start and we appreciated her welcoming us into her home. The location is near several subway stops and there are delis, supermarkets, drug stores, parks and a laundromat nearby.   If you're looking for a beautifully appointed, safe and clean location that's away from the hustle and bustle of the city, yet a train ride away, this is the place for you.   Thank you Sandrine for your hospitality.

Nice cozy  apartment with everything you need.  The backyard with the 4 place table is very useful. Very cool coffee place at 2min walking distance and pizza to order at 8min walking distance. The neighbourhoods is safe but could be perceived as sketchy.

We have just spent a week in Sandrine's accommodation.  The apartment is really very good, located in a quiet street, spacious with a small exterior, well equipped, clean, good bedding... Arrival is very simple with the secure key box, which allows you to arrive at any time without disturbing Sandrine (we had a late flight). The little extra that allows us to leave the luggage after returning the accommodation, while waiting for our flight, is really appreciated.  The accommodation is also close to the metro which allows you to reach Manhattan in 30/35 minutes.

Easy to recommend, close to subways and in a lively neighbourhood.  The Hosts: We had a few minor challenges, like a late arrival due to flights and a faulty key. In both cases the hosts were very accommodating, reachable and friendly. Which was very reassuring as guests. They are also good sources on things to see, places to eat etc.  The Apartment: Everything as advertised, the bed was comfortable, it was quiet and safe at night. You will be sharing the small kitchen with an elderly resident - so we found it a little difficult to use the kitchen properly.  Location in NY: If you don't know NYC, East Village can be a little unsafe after 11 pm, and we had some unpleasant encounters in the area - exercise common sense, and you'll be fine. It's a very lively and charming neighbourhood, with great restaurants, bars and helpful residents.  Would definitely recommend.

A fantastic spot well placed within East Village surrounded by a fantastic neighbourhood.  The flat was quiet, clean and a nice refuge at the end of a day of running around the city. Checking in with Renee was super simple and the whole setup was without stress.  Will be staying here again when coming back to NYC

The home of Pika and her family was fantastic. They are really incredible and gave us so much attention that we fell special. Roosevelt Island is a great place, a calm local near to stress and noise that is Manhattan. We stay there 15 days and was really good, if you are interested by this place, go without fear.

Great host, very pleasant and organized. Cozy place in a very quiet neighborhood. Very clean and cute. I loved the matress and the type of carpet. Its a steal for the money you pay and not too far from Staten Island ferry. Very happy with my stay overall and hope to come back.

I can't stress enough about how perfect their location is for exploring the multiple Boroughs of NYC! You're in the city but you're also surrounded by nature, the perfect balance.  Lovely hosts with a comfortable space, felt like I was staying with my favorite Aunty. Topi was so helpful with my special request to drop off my backpack early so that I could explore the city before my official check in time, and she shared some useful tips for navigating my way. A cool lady!  PSA: The space was clean...The space was CLEAN! (And I'm a neat freak) All the necessities were provided, plus more! The bed was comfy, room temperature perfect, and most importantly, it was quiet. (Yes, that's a perk of staying on an island in NYC)   All in all, it was better than I expected! Hopefully it's available for my upcoming birthday trip. 👀

Pika and Topi were the perfect hosts in a perfect location! Roosevelt Island is a quiet and BEAUTIFUL place to stay in the city while still having Manhattan within a couple subway stops. Pika and Topi’s apartment is lovely, private, comfortable, and absolutely spotless as well. When we walked in, it was easy to tell that they took the time to clean and prep everything thoroughly before we arrived. Topi even allowed us to arrive early and drop off our stuff so we could explore the city without carrying around luggage. We were greeted with a warm smile, instructions on how to use the door keys, and lots of fun suggestions to check out during our stay. We never felt unsafe while in the apartment or on the island; It is a stunning area and everyone is so friendly! It was also really nice to wake up to such a “homey” environment each morning: A quiet breeze coming from the window, the smell of bacon coming from the kitchen, and a nice conversation to be had as we headed out the door each day. On our last day, Topi allowed us to keep our luggage there while we grabbed breakfast. We really appreciated having the time to enjoy the island for a few more hours without feeling rushed out. We will definitely keep this AirBnb in mind the next time we visit the city, and will always remember Topi and Pika fondly!

Neida's location was everything we were looking for and provided a perfect place to stay on our 1st trip to NYC. Located within the Sugar Hill/Harlem/Upper Manhattan area, this spot is less than half a mile away from the New York subway making traveling within Manhattan a breeze. Our host was friendly and flexible and made our stay easy. We had full access to the kitchen and fridge and enjoyed the ability to take showers late at night after a busy day sight-seeing. The picture really does not do this cozy 3-bedroom apartment justice. We enjoyed our stay and the great price makes this spot a steal. Neida made us feel welcome and even took time out of her schedule to get to know us personally. Highly recommended.

Apartment with excellent value for money! Very clean and very quiet accommodation. The room has sufficient surface area. We found the bedding a little soft but that's a matter of personal taste. Neida is very welcoming and available if needed. The apartment is located on the northern edge of Harlem. It will take you 5 minutes to walk to take a metro but several lines are available to you including an express which will take you to Time Square in 20 minutes and to Brooklyn in 40 minutes. Even when returning at the end of the evening, we never felt unsafe in the neighborhood. We highly recommend this accommodation.

Wes was a fantastic host. She was very attentive from the very beginning. We had a few communication mishaps, but that happens. She accommodated both our early arrival and late departure. She provides towels and linens, so all you need to bring are toiletries. The bathroom was a little dirty, but nothing major. Wes had had a very stressful week, so it's understandable. The house and the room were both really clean.  The room is really big and nice. There's plenty of room for luggage and even some closet space to hang things. The box spring for the bed is smaller than the mattress, so the first night proved to be a little tricky as about 1/4 of the bed had no support. However, we realized that by moving the mattress to the center of the box spring, it could be improved.  Although she didn't have to, she brewed some coffee for us before leaving for work, which was super nice. She was very busy that weekend, but that didn't stop her from being attentive. We also got to meet Monkey, her new dog, and spend some time with them both.  Wes even made sure we'd made it back safely to DC. Sadly, we did not get to spend that much time with her as we would have liked. We would love to come back!

D was simply a great host. I booked her place for my parents visiting NYC for the first time. Even if they did not speak good English, the language barrier did not stop them from enjoying their stay in D place. They loved the way she treated them and will sure book her place again, next time they come.  Her little apartement is just perfect: clean and cozy. She offers everything you need: from towels to shampoos (and even bottles of purified water if you're afraid to drink from the sink). The place is just in front of the 3 subway station.   I highly recommend D for everyone who is looking for a warm, clean, and respectable place in NYC.
I liked the room, comfortable and clean. I didn't like the neighborhood, it seemed a little dangerous at night.

It was one of the best places we've been 😃the kindness and dedication was incredible. Close to everything by Metro you can go there with your eyes closed. Thank you for everything and for helping us (because we had to stay a little longer because of cyclone Irma), she was able to get us another flight to Miami.. Thank you thank you If we come back to New York it will be HERE 😉

Neida's apartment is a true reflection of her photos, the bedroom has adequate space for a passenger traveling alone.  It has a double bed with a good mattress and bedding.  The bathroom is comfortable and has everything you need.  For time, do not occupy the living room or the kitchen.  The only point against it is the security of the building. Before traveling, I asked Neida if I could make purchases and ship them to her address and she said it would be no problem.  However, the first shipment that Amazon made and that was delivered to your address was STOLEN by someone from your building. Since the building does not have a reception, the packages are left on the floor, at the entrance of the main hallway, so anyone who enters the building can take them.  I requested that they review the security videos and they were not able to say which person had illicitly appropriated my shipment.  If you are not planning to buy something with delivery to the apartment, it is still a very good economic option to stay in NY.

Neida's home is super clean and had all the amenities needed. I felt right at home as soon as I walked in. Check in was stress free and easy. As soon as I got there she gave me a friendly welcome, showed me to my room, and gave me a quick tour of her apartment. She makes her kitchen available for use as needed.   Neida's home is in a very safe area. The apartment is pretty high up Manhattan, but it is very close to two subway stations that can easily and quickly take you anywhere in the city from there. Don't let its location on the map fool you into thinking traveling to other parts of NY will be inconvenient or take too long. Neida provided me with excellent recommendations for things to do and places to eat, which helped enhance my trip. She is also very knowledgeable about NY among other things, which made our conversations very interesting and enriching. I would definitely book a stay here again.   If you are traveling alone and looking for a safe, clean, and well-priced place to stay with an amazing host, look no further and book Neida.  Can't recommend her enough!

This was the perfect place for my solo trip to NYC. Neida was a lovely host and her room was exactly what I needed. I didn’t feel unsafe in her neighborhood even when walking back late at night and she’s located with two subway lines within walking distance. I would stay with her again in a heartbeat!
I loved staying at Neidas! She was super kind and helpful and the place was sparkling clean and easy to find and she definitely made a scared first timer to New York feel right at home!

I had a great stay at Neida’s place. The room was clean and cozy—it was everything I needed for my solo trip.  Although the subway station is a couple of blocks away, I never felt unsafe while walking from the subway station late at night.   Neida was very hospitable and nice; she was also responsive to my messages.   In short, I would definitely stay here again.

Neida's place was a nice spot to stay in Harlem. It's between Amsterdam and Broadway so you can walk to lots of fun things and close enough to the bus and metro lines to be back in midtown in 20 minutes or so. We had a beer Friday night and I met her other guest but then I was on a mission to see as much as possible. I did a nice walking tour of Harlem and won a Broadway lottery ticket for a show. One thing Neida and the other guest recommended I do that I will definitely do on my next visit is the Staten Island ferry, to see the skyline and the Statue of Liberty. One thing I noticed was that though the bedroom door locks, it doesn't latch. I never felt unsafe in the apartment but the door doesn't latch so if it's locked it can still be pushed or pulled open. I'd recommend her place for good conversation (I was traveling alone) and the location in Harlem.

Neida was very accommodating and helpful. Her daughter was lovely too. The location was easy to get to and from. Only cons - the internet does not work AT ALL and there is a cat (as someone who is afraid of cats I would have appreciated if it was specified on the add)

Lydia is a very communicative person. She is decisive and cares about making the stay perfect.  The neighborhood is safe and if you walk a little there are many bars and restaurants nearby. Don't be afraid to stay in Bushwick since it is the best value for money.  Lydia's apartment has everything you need to be comfortable and not spend your time buying essential things like shampoo or basic kitchen items. It has a TV with smart tv. The bed is large and very comfortable. Lydia gives you 4 pillows, towels, hairdryer. There is everything. Also coffee maker.  The apartment is very clean and has a very welcoming personal touch. It is a 4 without an elevator but the stairs are comfortable. I would stay again without hesitation.

Jennifer & Ken’s place was excellent.  It’s exactly as described.   Great studio apt on a great block.  Don’t let the “Harlem” location scare you.  This is not the same Harlem I remember as a college student in the 80s.  Very diverse neighborhood with lots of great restaurants. Only a short walk to the 2/3, 4/5 and metro north 125th street trains.    Lots of great amenities...including washer/dryer and full kitchen with all of the instruments.   They even have a blender.    Highly recommended and I’d love to stay again if visiting NYC.

It is an apartment that is kept clean, the room is as seen in the photographs, with a perfect temperature at least in this cold season; The bathroom is shared only with D and it is always in perfect condition, Harlem has a stigma of being dangerous, but it is really a wonderful place to stay, much cheaper than in the center, the 148 st subway is right in front, it is line 3 that connects you with all the emblematic places and in 20 - 25 minutes you are there! We arrived at night and we never had a problem, only friendly people always, there is a deli business on the corner very convenient to buy for breakfast and meals of the day, they speak Spanish and are very friendly if you need any help. We love enzo!!! He's adorable, very well behaved!! And D is incredible, my experience in NY was truly wonderful and in part it was thanks to this great accommodation.

In general good, it should be noted that it is a shared accommodation with the host and the area where it is located is not very nice, even a little unsafe, but one advantage it has is that the subway station is right across the street and takes you practically anywhere in the center of Manhattan, D is very attentive to any need

Danett is absolutely great person ( I wish that all people be like Danett) ! Everything went perfectly. We were three girls and we can't fault anything. The dog was nice and well-behaved. If we came back to the flat late night, it was never a problem. THE Subway is just one minut by walk. The place where is the flat is safe. Danett is friendly and funny. We will miss her. You don't have to be afraid to communicate with her. Veronica 💖

Karen’s place is great for solo travelers. Really close to public transportation (don’t let the works in F line scare you, you can overcome them easily or take the N train!) and in a calm neighborhood. She’ll respect your space too if you are a more reserved person (; Thanks, Karen!

I had a really nice stay. Karen made me feel comfortable and at home. We used to chat from time to time but mostly she would give me some privacy and stayed in her room. The neighborhood was rather quiet and I never felt unsafe. The apartment is close to several subway stations and very clean. The couch I slept on is really small though. So I had to put the matress on the floor and enlarge it with a pillow so that my feet wouldn’t hang on the floor. But that was no problem at all. It was still really comfy and I slept well!  I can highly recommand staying at Karen’s. She knows exactly what her guests need and tries to make their stay pleasant!
Karen is very responsive. It is right by the subway. Neighborhood was typical NYC neighborhood. I was alone and never felt unsafe even late at night.

Stylish, cozy apartment on a legendary street. Nuyorican Poets Cafe is a few doors down from this oasis on the lower eastside. Comfortable and cozy vintage furnishings intermingle with stylish photographs,  art books, 70's & early 80s pop culture books. This space evokes the early disco, studio 54 vibe of NYC with downtown chic.  The building was easy to access and close to everything,  trains within walking distance, food, drug store. .. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

The place is well located but I wouldn’t say it’s located in Chelsea. It’s more in the midtown west of manhattan. The place is a little sketchy at night and the building always smells like tobacco. When I told michale if there was anything we could do to stop the smell, he said that he couldn’t do much ( I don’t know why because he is the owner of the whole building) . There are cockroaches ( but it’s a common thing in the city). The door doesn’t have a proper doorknob which made me afraid that someone was gonna break in                ( thankfully nothing happened). Despite all of these I was planning to extend my stay because it is very well located but when I approached Michael to tell him my plans he was really rude about it. I would suggest this place for someone that it is staying just for a couple of days.

We recommend this place 1000%. We spent a week there and everything was perfect: The welcome: Demetria and her children gave us the best welcome. Demetria is very responsive to messages, always available to her guests and concerned about their well-being. She is also very flexible on arrival and departure times, but also very accommodating with luggage depending on flight times. She has a lot of kindness and special attention to her guests: a different breakfast served every morning, plenty of clean towels for the bathroom, a bottle of rosé on our arrival, a drawer with all the addresses of sites to visit and restaurants to do in Manhattan and Brooklyn. Cleanliness: impeccable. Everything smells very good and clean when you enter the studio, everything shines in every corner.  Location: the area is quiet with a lot of amenities around. The apartment is located a 10-minute walk from the subway entrance to reach Manhattan in 20 to 45 minutes depending on the line taken.  In short, Demetria is a great host. You can go there with your eyes closed. This is our best Airbnb experience yet. We will not fail to recommend his apartment to our loved ones who would like to visit NEW YORK.

Mahogany suite is the best stay I’ve had since I started using air bnb 2 yrs ago. The style, the cleanliness, the atmosphere, the attentiveness. I celebrated my birthday there this weekend and was greeted with flowers balloons cake wine and a gift bag and I was sung happy birthday. I will be returning and using mahogany suite again. I can’t stress how great this place is!!!   Thank you so much for your amazing hospitality mahogany.
Sketchy area

I was impressed by the stress free atmosphere, cleanliness and the soothing sound of the fish tank. Barry was accommodating and cool even when I plugged my phone in incorrectly and tripped the circuit breaker! I was able to rest deeply before getting on the road for my return trip.

Our 4 night stay in New York was the first part of a more extensive trip and we wanted to find accommodation which had character, convenient for the main tourist attractions but also offer a relaxed and comfortable place to return to in the evenings. After a little research, we elected for Brooklyn and found 304 East 18th Street. This is a beautiful and charismatic house and went well beyond our expectation. Everything was scrupulously clean and well maintained and we noted the top quality of things like the bathroom fittings and bed linen all very welcome. Laura is a friendly and very efficient host, the process from first enquiry to arrival and departure worked seamlessly with no stress. The area is very interesting too with an eclectic mix of styles and facilities. The subway Q line is a very short walk away and gave us easy access to Manhattan, Coney Island and the two eastern airports (we came in JFK and left La Guardia). Also within walking range are Prospect Park and attractions such as the Botanical Gardens. A real unexpected find - the gem that is Brooklyn Public Library, we spend a couple of hours there, fabulous building. There are also some excellent cafes restaurants and shops a few minutes walk away. If we come to New York again will definitely try on book this as first choice.

Staying at Laura’s place was more than great. The way she hosts, she really made me feel like I had a home in Brooklyn to come back to after I went to the City.   Laura’s place is clean and cosy. I’ve had all the stuff I could have wished for to make my stay comfortable. The rooms were big and clean aswell. This room was equiped with an Airconditioning which did a great job. When I’d put it on, it took only a few minutes before my room was really cool and comfortable.  Getting to the city is very easy from Laura’s place, its a very short walk to one of the nearest stations. Laura’s place was clean and cosy. The area in Brooklyn itself is also really nice. It’s way more quite than the business of Manhattan which Makes it a great place to recharge yourself before going back into the city. I’ve never felt unsafe for a second in this neighbourhood  I would recommend this to Anyone. Especially when you re traveling alone like I did this time. Since you’ll also have a chance to meet other travelers/houseguests if she has them and you ll really have a place to feel at home while you’re in NYC.

We spent a week with Dorina who is adorable and very responsive when needed, the accommodation is spacious, very clean, the bedding is perfect, the breakfast is generous and suitable for all diets. The area is very quiet and not dangerous, we sometimes came home late and there was no problem, the metro is a good 10 minute walk away. We recommend this Airbnb. Thank you for everything Dorina 😊

The room was fantastic. Comfy and clean with plenty of space to enjoy the temporary home away from home. There was even a clothes rack with hangers if I needed it. It was a nice surprise to see a room be a bit better than it looked in pictures for once.   While I did share the bathroom with another guest across the hall for part of it, I never ran into any conflicts. The shower is a fantastic waterfall style, with optional side jets you can turn on. It does take a bit of fidgeting with but once you figure it out it’s quick to warm up.   In what is a very busy city the room was very quiet. We did reach some warmer day temps while I was there but an open window helped cool down the room. I spotted some window air conditioners I suspect are in use in the summer.   It was great to chat with Laura when we crossed paths, with her years of experience in the city. Her dog, Ash, may bark at first but he seemed very quick to warm up to you once you were inside. I wish I actually took the time to try out the kitchen, as it looks like a cool stove to work with but maybe another time  The subway was a quick walk and about 40 minutes to most of the Manhattan destinations, but definitely be sure to check local transit notifications for reroutes. Definitely had to catch a further stop on the weekend because of maintenance but this seems to only be a couple months of the year (blame Metro on this one). Still was a quick walk either way.  Overall it was a great visit, I’d definitely look for her rooms next time I’m in town.

We didn't get a chance to meet Felix but he was incredibly helpful and made sure our stay went smoothly... And his roommates were so nice ! The loft is ridiculously charming, the bed was comfortable, everything was clean, and it's not far from downtown Manhattan.  Perfect stay. Thanks Felix !  PS the neighborhood might sort of look like it would be sketchy but it's not at all, and we felt really safe. :)

Felix was more than helpful through my first airbnb experience. The space is great and much bigger than anything I ever would have expected in NYC. A great loft style apartment with high ceilings. His roommates were great and so helpful. There are many cool restaurants and bars within walking distance and the transit into the city could not be easier.  Make sure you check out the roof. Great for sunsets or just a casual drink; you can often find friendly neighbours doing the same. Citi bikes are located just a block away making for easy trips anywhere in Brooklyn or into the city. I never felt unsafe in the area but be aware of where you are. If you're not a city person you may feel a bit uncomfortable but I never had a problem with anything or anyone.  I would definitely recommend this space to anyone visiting Brooklyn/NYC for any reason. Its great location makes it so easy to get anywhere and gives you the full Brooklyn experience.
Fantastic place, service and host!!!! Only thing to be aware of is the housing projects you have to pass to get to the L-line (subway). Seemed a bit sketchy after dark. Otherwise NO Problems:):)

Absolutely loved this place! A real home from home for us as we loved the decor. Very comfortable. Wifi and Roku both great and fast. Very separate from the house and private which was fab. Area is lively but we love Brooklyn and never felt unsafe. Trains are around 10 minutes walk either direction, again was no time at all. Very quiet and peaceful little sanctuary in the heart of Brooklyn, loved it. We will be back, great value for what you get.

Our host Lindsey impressed me right away by guiding us down a Kubrickian hallway to our temporary home by walking backwards. I should have known that this delightful parlour trick was a ruse intended to distract from her dogs that pawed and licked their way to my heart. Zorro and Gus, I miss you, write me.  Lin-Zee, or should I call her ‘my hometown nemesis’, then had the gumption to bring us to get my first slice of New York pizza and school me on the ins and outs of cheese. Like how, mozzarella and goats cheese aren’t the same thing. You win this round, Lynsey. The next day LN-Z, had the balls to write us a list of NY recs so long there was no way we could do it all in one day. Guess I’m coming back to hang with those damn cute dogs?! Dear, LINDSAY, where do you get off? On the final morning we left, the Hostess Who Has Been Named, woke up to see us off at 6am, likely to make sure we didn’t steal the dogs. It was a sweet gesture but I could sense the animosity.  Unfortunately we didn’t see Nick as much but I could tell right away from his gait that here was a man with legs and a heart made of muscle. All in all I couldn’t recommend a place to stay more wholeheartedly to get a real insight into the minds of actual psychological-warfare artists. If I come back I know where I’ll be going.

Laura's home is beautiful! It was a perfect location and prefect place to stay! We felt welcome and at home the moment we stepped through the front door. Laura is very personable, easy to talk to, helpful, and accommodating. The house has a wonderful vintage feel and is very clean. Very comfortable bed(one of my concerns with staying in Airb&b's was if the bed would be comfortable), PERFECT softness for the pillows, amazing shower with side sprayers, extra blankets, easy front door code to check into the house, quiet at night, and super close (5 minute walk)to two subway stations, 30-40 minute subway ride into the city, but had a more residential feel than staying in busy/touristy Manhattan. Plus, it was MUCH more affordable!  The neighborhood is full of lovely, old homes from the late 1800's and feels safe and well kept. We didn't feel unsafe even when walking around late at night(two women). Plenty of places to grab a bite to eat. We really loved the breakfast at Madeline's restaurant on Courdelou Road near the subway station. We ate there almost every day during our stay! Laura told me of a few streets of vintage homes a few blocks from her house and I went exploring. They were beyond fabulous! Old, large(some were mansions)beautiful homes, the likes of which I didn't expect to see in Brooklyn.  I would definitely recommend staying at Laura's home and hope that I get the opportunity to come back and stay in the future!

I highly recommend this home to any future traveler. Laura made my stay stay stress free, always communicating with me if I had any questions or concerns. This property is a home and you will feel like your at home. The room was a great size, I had my privacy, I loved the bathroom, and always came “home” after a long day of walking ready to enjoy a sit on her wrap around porch.

A low-stress, comfortable and friendly place to stay. Laura's house is ideally located on a quaint, quiet street within 5 minutes of the Q-train (direct services to downtown Brooklyn and Manhattan). There are local shops and a variety of neighbourhood restaurants (and a couple of great cocktail bars) within easy walking distance. The house is a characterful older building with lots of original features, and an eclectic scheme of decoration. I had room 4, under the eaves with a large modern bathroom shared with one other guest room. The ample room was very clean with a comfortable king-sized bed and plenty of storage. The windows look onto the street so there is a little traffic noise - but much more tweeting from the local bird life! Arrival was simple, with keypad access as Laura was out when I arrived. She was very friendly and welcoming, as was her sweet dog Ash. I'd definitely consider Laura's house if I return to New York.

Place exactly how photos represent, very clean, bright garden apartment with easy access to a lush backyard with shade and sunshine for that perfect lunchtime break. Ronit was responsive and the lockbox access made checking in and out a breeze. An easy 7min walk to the C train and plenty of quick Uber availability even during peak hours.

The location was perfect. There are 2 different subway lines within a 10-minute walk and too many amazing restaurants to count. There’s also a full grocery store and drug store really close if you need it. P himself was communicative and the check-in process was super easy. However, the building is really old and the apartment is definitely due for a deep clean. The bathroom ceiling was crumbling, there was visible rust and mold in the crevasses, and random dirty marks on the walls. The living room rug smelled old and had dirt marks on it. I also was left with a dirty kitchen sponge that I had to replace, and I had to wash several of the pots/pans/cooking equipment before I used it because it was dirty. Not the worst, but not the best given what I paid.

Ronit’s home looks exactly like the pictures and is as described!! Super clean, upgraded, well furnished, and cozy. It’s in a very convenient location easily accessible to public transportation, not too far from downtown Brooklyn and easy to get to Manhattan. The only con is that the home isn’t in the best area. We arrived at night and the block isn’t the friendliest looking. As someone who travels to Brooklyn often I felt comfortable but maybe someone’s first NY experience or someone traveling alone it might be a bit scary. Other than that we had an overall great stay!

To start off, Neil was a fantastic host! My fiancée, her sister, and I stayed at this wonderful location for 5 days, during NYE. Neil was so helpful with telling us where to go in the city, what was around the neighborhood, and even went as far as to give my uber driver directions to cut out traffic. The unit is very private and you don't feel like your encroaching on anyone's space. Like stated by other people, his rooms are very clean and comfortable. All the amenities that you would need for an apartment is found in the unit, and I literally felt as if I was in apartment for 5 days, and not in someone's home. Being that this was my first experience in NY, I did not know what to expect, but I was not disappointed by a long shot. The neighborhood is very "New York" to say the least. Being from Florida, I definitely knew that I was not in Florida anymore. But, I did not feel unsafe at any moment and was very comfortable in his home and out. I definitely recommend staying with Neil to anyone, and hopefully if I do come back to NY his unit is available again.

We stayed here for a week and overall had an okay stay. A few things to note:  There were bugs in the apartment (centipedes and ants). Also construction work was done in the basement during our stay. One morning water was off. Would have been nice with a heads up. In general communication was spotty. Area around the subway stations can feel a bit unsafe especially at night.

Though we overall enjoyed our stay there were many centipedes in the home which was a bit off putting. At the end of our stay we pulled off the covers and sheets to help the cleaners. The mattress had cleanable stains and hair from others which was also unpleasant to see. Also note that the neighbors children were practically stomping with each step throughout the day which was really nosey.

Kathleen's 1 bedroom ground floor level apartment was perfectly located for what we were locating for. Authentic gems (markets, eateries, cafes) were sprinkled throughout the corners. So, for location, a 9 out of 10. Unexpectedly, but a nice surprise, her unit also provided some stocked kitchen and bathroom items that is great for those who may forget shampoos, bubble bath/salt, etc... Unfortunately, for us, the 2 most important things, and 1 of them being a selection decision, will be the negative part of this review.  First, the bed (which in-my-opinion is the most important part of an accommodation) needs to be upgraded. This includes the pillows and sheets, which all were very unpleasant to spend a few nights in. We were truly disappointed to find it to be the lowest quality and felt very used. The second, was the hot tub, which my wife and I very much looked forward to after having walked from lower Manhattan, cross the Brooklyn bridge and back to Clinton hills, had us quickly jump out of and into the (very nice & roomy rain) shower instead. Why? well, once the jets turned on, it was clear to both of us that it had not been well cleaned...or cleaned at all. I will spare the details (variety of hairs) for the sake of brevity. Time spent in hot tub during entire stay = 2 minutes.  In either case, at the end of the day, after having spent a few nights here, I've made a mental note that for all my future AirBnB bookings, I will be inquiring as to the type of bed the accommodation offers. We sincerely hope Kathleen will invest in replacing the bed and necessary housekeeping for her future guests.

Kathleen's apartment is really great! It corresponds exactly to the advertisement with very high-end equipment, particularly household appliances. The outdoor terrace is a very pleasant addition! The room is on the street side, it can be a little noisy for people with a little sensitivity and is equipped with blinds without shutters. The CLASSON metro station line G is a two-minute walk from the accommodation. Kathleen is very responsive in the event of a problem in the accommodation, a small leak in the shower was resolved within 1/2 day, moreover the accommodation was not reserved for our suite we were able to stay there until 4 p.m. our flight was at 7 p.m. I recommend this high-end accommodation, we had a wonderful stay!

Kathleen is an amazing host! Great place in a perfect location and the price is such a steal. In unit washer dryer came in handy and she’s very helpful if you have any questions. Would absolutely stay here again

David was a great host! He was very welcoming and was quick to respond to any questions we had. The room felt like home and it was tough to leave! The neighborhood was lively and had a nice grocery store only a few blocks away. We (2 persons) walked through the neighborhood on multiple occasions during the hours of 11pm-2am and did not feel unsafe. I would strongly recommend staying with David!

brittni and cristian are great hosts and have good recommendations for what to do around the city! Only thing I would say is taking the subway at night can be a little sketchy, so I ended up using uber after a certain time every night, so you might want to consider factoring that into your budget. That being said, even though the subway stations made me nervous at night, I always felt safe in the apartment!
Very friendly and very welcoming. He communicated clearly with us and told us everything we needed to. Had a wonderful weekend in Rob's apartment and I would do it again!
The welcome day was amazing, zamena is very friendly, im afraid to say this appartment is very good because i want it for the next year lol  Everything was better than i expected

Beautiful king size bed a lot of wash clothes and towels neighbors are nice. Due to Christmas a house had beautiful lights up. If you don’t like it close the shade. Quiet neighborhood easy to work remote place was clean. In the bathroom had everything from tooth brush to toothpaste. I would love to stay again
The place was clean and up to par. Host can be a bit too hands on but other than that everything was great. Parking can be stressful depending on time of day.

Airbnb was good but the host was very unprofessional and she was calling me multiple times for silly reasons. She made us go back to airbnb after check out to just adjust the position of the couch . When we were already out of airbnb she called and inquired about the number of pillow and told us that one pillow was missing. And again called us back saying that she found the pillow. We felt that she was trying to blame us for stealing the pillow. We travel so much and have been in so many AirbnBs. This has been the worst experience so far.

Guillermo’s place is exactly as described. It’s clean, warm, spacious and ideal for exploring the city without paying ridiculous Manhattan price tags. The apartment is not in the heart of Williamsburg, more on the outskirts but it’s only 5 mins into Williamsburg and 15 into Manhattan on the subway (the nearest station is a few minutes walk).   The area looks a little shady when you first arrive but we had no issues at all. There is a pizza place and other takeouts, grocery stores and a couple bars all near the subway station.  Guillermo was very responsive and provided us with all the info we needed in plenty of time. He also gave us phone numbers in case we needed them.  The apartment is lovely and spacious and the bathroom and kitchen were spotless. It was freezing when we visited and the apartment was always lovely and warm. The only notes I would make is that the blinds in the apartment aren’t very thick so if you are a light sleeper you may want to take a sleep mask. Also, there isn’t really any storage space for you clothes. It’s fine if you’re there for a week (like is) but might be a bit of an issue for people staying longer.  All in all it is a great base to explore the city and I would definitely stay again on my next trip to New York.

We’ve just come back from a great stay at Guillermo’s place for our honeymoon. The apartment was everything we hoped for, a great base for exploring Manhattan. The subway is only a short walk away and you can be in Lower Manhattan within 15 mins, about 30 mins to Times Square. The   Subway is regular and runs really late into the night. When you first arrive in the area it does seem a bit ‘shady’ but we always felt 100% safe even walking back at night so really don’t be put off by that. We’re from suburban England and we were totally fine and loved the arty area! We got loads of essentials from the grocery shop at the end of the road. The apartment was lovely: really comfy bed, nice hot shower with good pressure. The A/C kept the whole apartment really cool despite the 30 degree heat in August. Guillermo replied to any queries very quickly and he was an excellent host. Would definitely stay here again.

I was pretty disappointed with my air bnb experience after reading all the positive reviews on here. I've only used air bnb one other time, and that was in Chicago, but the experience was completely different. I was scheduled to arrive Friday night at 11:30 pm and Anthony had said he would be available to give me the keys, etc. He also asked for my flight information, to know if my flight would arrive early or not. Then, Friday afternoon, he emails me and says that he has to drop something off for work between 10:30-11 and won't be home for midnight. He told me I could wait in a dunking donuts a few blocks away. (clearly,. an exciting nyc spot I was dying to go to.) I told him I had plans with friends at midnight and asked if either I could get the keys from a doorman or a friend of min could pick them up earlier. He told me doorman in NYC didn't do that (which is not true - I have stayed with many friends previously in Manhattan and their door mans have either given my keys or let me knot their apartments) and that I could carry my stuff around with me and check in later than midnight if I wanted to stay out with my friends because he planned to stay up a little later. 1. What kind of job gives a few hours notice that you need to "drop something off" at that hour on a Friday? It made me feel very unsafe. 2. It would have been nice to know that I would need to wait earlier than the day of arrival. 3. My flight arrived early (which Anthony should have known since he told me he would tack my flight) and I texted him before 10:30 saying that I was in a cab on my way, asking if I would catch him. He stated he had already left. A courteous host would have seen that my flight landed early, and waited. I arrived at the apartment area around 11 and had to wait over an hour (he got home after midnight) for him. 4. My host in Chicago had a lock box at the outside of his building with the keys and texted me the code. Anthony could have done that and avoided this whole debacle. My boyfriend and I had to wait in a bar with our stuff (which was awkward) and miss our plans with our friends. Then, the place was not as great as the reviews implied. The bed was uncomfortable and small (my boyfriend is 6'2" and his feet hung off the bed). The bathroom was also not as clean as I would have hoped. And there were several mops in the bathroom, creating a weird smell in it and taking up space. Also, the bathrooms have no locks. Also, Anthony told us he would send us the wifi code upon arrival but he never did. Otherwise,...

There was no AC and it was super loud. People slamming the door and talking in the hall, fights right outside our window. The place was nice and roomy but the people in the building and outside were just too much. The blankets  didn’t smell clean and there was a big comforter thrown in the closet which we were not sure if we could use it, so we didn’t. The apartment was hot made sleeping very uncomfortable. The amenities said air conditioning and when I asked I was told it wasn’t installed because it wasn’t hot enough but I could install it myself.   There wasn’t even a fan.  We finally installed it ourselves. Also, you can’t use your phone to make phone calls in the apartment for some reason we couldn’t receive phone calls or call out but text did work. The cable didn’t work so we couldn’t watch tv. I wasn’t going to write a review but then the landlord question why his blankets were thrown in the closet, they were like that when we arrived, it was really rude to accuse me of throwing his blanket in the closet when it was like that...all we did was try to find enough pillows. The apartment was very roomy and looks just like the pictures and once we installed the ac unit it was very comforter.  If you take the C train the walk is fine but if you take the 2 it’s kinda scary.

Julie is awesome, always there to answer any question yet never bothering or invading personal space. Other guests were great also making the staying very nice and cozy. Great location and neighborhood full of nightlife, at first it may seem dangerous because 15 y ago it was a ghetto but now is a very hipster place, In general NY and bushwick is a safe place to be around at night. The room was perfect and the personal backyard made it really confortable. 100% recommended, I’ll definitely come back

This place was pretty nice! It has a private entrance and private bathroom which is really nice. The shower was a little dirty and the bathroom is very small, just fyi. Also as the other reviews mention, there is a cat and it will meow loudly and scratch at your door until you let it in the room 😂 overall though a good place to stay and I never felt unsafe walking in the neighborhood.

Post visit and for the last few weeks I had considered not writing a response but on this last day I feel it only necessary for the benefit of others. The apartment is small, quaint, and perfectly suited in Nolita. Surrounded by hipster cool. I was travelling alone and was hoping for a place that would afford evenings indoors, in a comfortable environment, resting from my planned long days exploring NYC. This was my expectation. The photos are accurate, but on arrival I was immediately confronted by the dog hair. There was a 'dog' cover on the yellow sofa, a sea of hair I might add, and it felt brooke had just left in a rush leaving the apartment in its typical condition.   Brooke contacted me shortly after arrival asking if everything was okay. I explained my disappointment. She made commented on the cleaners having been there the same morning and called them to confirm, however, I suspect otherwise and sensed an untruth. I'm not precious about my space. I have travelled extensively across continents backpacking off the beaten track but arriving in NYC, paying for a service ill fitting to what is offered, I find it unfortunate and disappointing.  Brooke offered to have the cleaners return, but the dog hair was throughout and in places only reachable by a lengthy and thorough clean. (Walking around the small space in my socks I collected so much hair I actually photographed the socks as a travel record of my experience.)  This changed my experience of NYC and rather than returning in the evening to rest and relax for the next day I only returned to sleep in the small bed upstairs. I avoided using kitchen for cooking instead eating out or buying prepared meals to have in the apartment.  I have no doubt Brooke will be disappointed with this review, as she commented during our email exchange about her clean record (pun not intended) and seemed concerned at the prospect. However I feel it only necessary for others.  This small apartment was expensive and had Brooke offered some kind of olive branch, offering for a reduced rate or otherwise this may have softened the blow.  My apologies to you Brooke....and to all others.......it might be worth finding out if your prospective host has dogs.   I am a dog lover...and whilst i don't mind places that are small and compact, I have problems with uncleanliness, and misleading listings.   I wish you all a pleasant Airbnb experience.  Robert  PS I would only give one star, but I gave a second for location.

Zaineb was a great host! Communication both before and during the trip was quick and friendly. She was even kind enough to agree to a small extra request we asked for prior to confirming our reservation. The room itself was spacious and clean. The private bathroom and separate entrance made a great addition. The only thing that was slightly unclear to us from the listing, was the fact that the room is actually directly connected to the livingroom/kitchen by the staircase. There's no door in between. However, this was hardly an issue, as Zaineb was rarely home and when she was, there was just some lovely quiet jazz playing in the background. Though the neighborhood seemed slightly shady when we arrived at night, it turned out to be completely fine. Plenty of delis open till late at night also available. All in all it was awesome quality for the money and I would definitely stay here again.

Loved everything & every second of my stay!   The room is exactly as described and pictured in the photos: long and wide, good natural lighting, a super comfortable bed, a good size closet, a couple of tables, and a small bathroom with a great shower!   The living room on the main floor of the house connects to the unit via a set of very steep stairs. This detail combined with Zaneib rarely being at home (or she's just really really quiet!) and also the fact that the unit has its own door provides guests with all the privacy they could ask for. To me that's a HUGE plus as it allows complete freedom in the come and go throughout the day and/or night.   I found the neighbourhood to be fascinating and with lots of options for all kinds of amazing food within a few minutes walk. Also, two subway stations are located nearby and can be reached by a short walk (roughly ten minutes). Not once during my stay and walk at different hours of day and night did I feel unsafe or nervous in the neighbourhood. However, with that said, like in any other big metropolis it's always good to be aware of your surroundings.  :)   With all of the above said, I wanted to note that this is my first experience with an AirBnB booking and thanks in big part to Zaineb's graciousness I'll probably become a regular user of the site. Zaineb was always very attentive, from the very first exchange of messages, passing through the welcome upon our late night arrival, the conversation during the first morning, and the constant touching base via text to ensure that everything was ok. She pays a lot of attention to small details in the unit, such as having hangers in the closet, a water bottle with glasses, clean towels, and even toiletries! This is only a small sample of things she does to make one feel welcome and at home.  :)   I was considering not writing a review out of pure selfishness as I wanted to keep this place and Zaineb as a "secret", so that would make my life easier for any future NY trips! However, I know it wouldn't be nice of me and I also know that it's simply a matter of time before guests need to start putting their names on a waiting list to stay here.  :)   I'm extremely happy to have found this place and very thankful to Zaineb for an unforgettable experience.   Thank you!

Zaineb is a very nice and responsive host.  The space is large by NY stds, the bed was very comfy, the private bath is very small but adequate (shower only) and the private entry was a nice bonus. We were grateful Zaineb was accommodating with our check in and check out times.  The place was centrally located, so we took public transit everywhere.  It was great for exploring Brooklyn and getting to and from NYC.  We would recommend sticking with the G train and nearby buses.  One night, we took the M train back one which required a little longer walk.  The area around the station was a little sketchy.  However, we felt completely safe in Zaineb’s area.  Brooklyn Blend is a great coffee shop around the corner on Tompkins, .  We had breakfast there 3 times, do not miss the Greenwood Smoothie and the Dekalb breakfast sandwich.  We wish we had one of these in Chicago.    Thank you Zaineb!

Adam is very available and responsive. He responded very quickly to our various requests, even last minute ones. The house was very comfortable, the bedding was of good quality. The size is ideal for 5 people, there are two bathrooms, which is very practical. The Wi-Fi is very fast. The metro is 15-20 minutes away on foot, and allows you to quickly reach Manhattan via the A express line. The neighborhood is very quiet, which is appreciated after a day in the "hustle and bustle" of Manhattan. We did not have a feeling of insecurity, even when returning after 11:30 p.m. People in the neighborhood spontaneously offer their help when they see us looking at a map. There are shops near the metro, and even a French bakery (but which closes around 3 p.m.) In summary, it was a great stay, flawless!

We had a great time at Adam's cottage in Brooklyn. As it was really hot in NYC, it was great to come back to a cool spacious apartment where we each had our own space to relax (family of four with two teenage boys). It was handy having two bathrooms too. The apartment was exactly as described, and the beds were comfortable; we slept well. Even though Adam was out of town for our arrival he was very responsive in answering our questions. His apartment was a bit of a way from Manhattan, but with the metro card the trips cost virtually nothing. The metro is also quite interesting for people-watching. We came back a few times around midnight and didn't feel that the neighbourhood was particularly dangerous. Definitely recommend as a hotel alternative!!

Carmia and Joe's rented place is a lovely basement flat separated into to stories with everything you need. It's super close to public transportation (the subway and busses) to get you right to Manhattan and Williamsburg and a good variety of supermarkets, drug stores and delis. The flat is equipped with bathroom essentials, there was basic food in the kitchen and in general the kitchen was pretty impressive and cool.  They were super lovely hosts and took every effort to make our stay as enjoyable as possible and were always helpful with any questions. I could not recommend this place enough!
Adam’s place is great! Some areas were a little sketchy for 5 girls in their early 20s but we made do. We enjoyed all the brownstones nearby as well, and really cool coffee shops.

Melody was most friendly and accommodating! I arrived at almost 1am and she came downstairs to help me with my luggage! It's a great deal if you are on a small budget! The trains are right there as well so it is conveniently located. I know the Bronx from before for years and as much as it might scare some people because they don't know better, but there is nothing to worry about even taking the train late at night.

Melody is very sweet, kind and willing to help with anything. My stay at her place was great.  5 min walking from the metro, line D. 30 min to Manhattan by metro.  The flat was clean and I could use the kitcken so I saved on meals out. I slept very well, really quiet on the nights, the bed was very comfortable (Mel how GOOD you made my bed the first day that I dind't have to make it again the rest of the 8 days!! lol). I lived 3 months in NY before and nothing to be scared about the area, not a touristic neighbourhood but the Bronx is safe like similar neighbourhoods in our cities.  Stay well!, hopefully see you again soon!. Fatima.

A second time now being hosted & spent 1 month at Melody's house , a great host of all times . I had a great stay , eye opening conversations , cooking & eating together on weekends since we both love food :) , running errands together most of the times. She helped me ease the stress of the exams , A month well spent. Will certainly have business with her in the future. All the best & blessings to you Ms Melody in everything you put your hands, mind & soul into ! .

Mouse in the apartment!!! Photos of the apartment are filtered, the apartments does not look the way it is presented. Garbage at the door, dirty floors (especially stairs), no filters on ac/heater, owner recommends his guests to set up filters (3 meters ceiling), first floor heater does not work, dryer does not work, lady’s shoe in a hallway, no parking at all - no chance, criminal neighborhood - be careful to walk. We stayed only one night (paid two) and left, unacceptable.

This is a cute little brownstone that is a close distance to shops, restaurants and the subway. Our family of five fit pretty comfortable in Adam’s place. A few things to note, the stairs can be dangerous for small children. The downstairs staircase is pretty narrow and could be a slip hazard, but my seven year went down them with no issues. The upstairs staircase doesn’t have rails, not issue going up, you just want to be cautious. The other thing that was a slight issue for us was the internet. Personally it sucked. We had planned to do a movie night with kids in the basement but the internet was so bad we had to abandon the idea. Overall, Adams’s place is beautiful and nicely stocked with the essentials.  Adam as a host was thorough and very responsive. I appreciated his hospitality.

I came to NYC travelling alone as a female and the environment was perfect for me, very comfortable. I was super scared going places by myself but Melody told me the safest routes to take and even gave me useful information to travel the city. I really enjoyed the service and Melody was super friendly.

We spent 8 fantastic days in NY. The apartment fully conforms to the description. It is very well equipped. Nothing is missing. In addition, it is close to various metros and small shops. Laurent and his partner are very welcoming and available.  On the last day, as the flight was delayed, we were able to leave our luggage at the apartment and thus fully enjoy the stay until the end. Our arrival at the apartment, soaked by the storm, will remain unforgettable! In conclusion, we highly recommend this base for a stay in NY.

The apartment conforms to the description, clean and very well located, a few meters from the metro and shops. Lively neighborhood. In addition, Laurent has always been responsive and accommodating, he allowed us to leave our luggage later because our flight was in the evening. We highly recommend!

We had a good stay in this apartment.  It is a great value and superbly located, with easy access to the subway, great food, laundromats, drug stores and groceries.   Its a very vibrant area. The apartment was very clean and the owners very helpful.   It did feel a little basic or "no frills" at times, but if you want more you might consider something at a slightly higher price range.

John and Rob were wonderful hosts.  John greeted us at the start and gave a rundown of everything we needed to know about the apartment and helpful tips about the area.    The apartment lived up to its description and photos very much.  It was spacious and clean and we had everything we could need as well as a some supplies in the fridge to keep us going until we got to the shops.    The Bayridge area was really nice and felt very safe and friendly.   The apartment was on a very quiet street and we were close to shops, restaurants and the subway.

Rob and John were consummate hosts. Not only was their home gorgeous and spectacularly decorated (classic American), they went out of their way to make sure of  visit was memorable. Would absolutely visit them and Brooklyn again.

John & Rob are truly amazing hosts! Me and my family spent three cozy nights in the artistically decorated house and we are so much grateful for their superb hospitality and hosting. We came across the stormy weather but John was so kind to drive us around the neighborhood to the bay ridge harbor and to the grocery store so that we did not have to walk in the cold outside. The personal welcome notes on the classical stationery were very special and touching. John was always there when we needed help or advice.  Best neighborhood in Brooklyn as we know of. Subway station 86th St is two blocks away. We also called car service now and then for short trips to Manhattan which cost some $20-30. The house is a genuine gem in Brooklyn, NYC. Again we would like to thank John & Rob for making our stay an unforgettable experience. We will definitely come back if we visit NYC again.

John and Rob are amazing hosts! We got there almost at midnight but Rob waited for us and showed us around the place which was beautiful and spectacularly decorated. The neighborhood is quiet and clean and we also found a lot of great places to eat. We used the subway almost everyday and the station was close by. We didn't want to leave, everything was above and beyond what we expected. Thank you for your hospitality. Muchas Gracias!

Had my Aunt and Uncle in from Italy for 2 weeks and put them up here at Rob and Gino's BnB. Hands down, just a gorgeous place. Close to everything (Train, Shopping, highway etc.) The BnB was clean, very  comforting and it accommodated their every need. Rob and Gino were very helpful and such down to earth and welcoming. I frequently have family in from Italy and have made this BnB my go to spot for them. Thanks again guys and see you soon!!
Tj and Andy are a very sweet couple and they present for there guests! Although the neighborhood  was a little bit scary at night, we felt welcome. We would recommend this place for futur guests! :)

I'm sad to say I have to leave a bad review. While Andy and TJ are both lovely to interact with, they're irresponsible hosts.   First and foremost, they don't have functioning smoke detectors in their apartment (this is probably because they're smokers - PSA: this place stinks of cigarettes) which is actually illegal and extremely unsafe.   Second, they were really loud. The informational binder they left in our room told us to leave a "do not disturb" sign on our door if we needed quiet time but they did not supply the actual sign. Thus, I had to go out in my pajamas to face three fully grown drunk men and tell them to be quiet, which was uncomfortable. THEN we were woken up at 5:30 am by pounding and yelling at the front door followed by a heated conversation right outside of our room. It was really hard to fall asleep after that.   I'm really disappointed and asking for a refund. I've also reported this host to Airbnb for safety concerns.

We haven't met Andy, so we can't really say something. TJ was really nice and always asked if we need something.  Our room in the apartment was great and big enough for two. The windows are really thin so it's extremely loud during the night (the city that never sleeps ;) ) so we can highly recommend using earplugs during the night. You have your private bathroom which is quite nice.  The location of the apartment is perfect as there are many busstops and the metrostation around the corner.
