Nevertheless we tried to avoid longer walks through the neighbourhood when it got dark as we were scared (we are two young girls). I wanna mention that there was no incident or so, nothing has happened and everything was fine - it was just our personal feeling. All in all we had a great time in this apartement and we can recommend staying there. Thank you Andy & TJ !! :)

The accommodation was very good. Everything necessary and organized. Surroundings there are clothing stores, food, restaurants and soon there will be a shopping center. The area is a little busy because of the people who are on the corner but there is always security (police). Don't be afraid Thank you 😊.

Rob & Gino are exceptional hosts, the apartment is spacious, comfortable and beautifully appointed, and the Bay Ridge neighborhood is safe, walkable and vibrant. Our hosts thought of every possible comfort and convenience.We will be return guests! Thanks to our hosts for sharing their spectacular home with us!

7 stars on a 5-star scale. We were told by friends (from New York) before we left that Brooklyn was good and address . The apartment  was amazing. Better than expected. Our trip was wonderful and started with Rob and John, even before we arrived. The spaciousness was unbelievable. Comfortably fit our family of four. Safe neighborhood. Car service was great and subway nearby. We used both. During our next visit to Brooklyn, we know where home is, our apartment in Bayridge.

Listing description was incredibly accurate. We had a group of 16 students that we were taking on a service trip in Brooklyn. There was certainly enough room for everyone to sleep on a bed. The security system is up-to-date so there was never a worry about being unsafe. Some posts claim the neighborhood in Bedford Stuyvesant to be dangerous. As we only traveled in a group, we definitely felt safe for most of the trip. The apartment is right next to a park, basketball courts, and a playground. It is literally a 5 minutes walk from the subway and the B46 bus. It could not have served our purposes better. There is a supermarket right down the street. All appliances (dishwasher, stove, oven, fridge, microwave) were in perfect shape. We cooked for 16 every morning and twice for dinner, and had a great experience. Brendan is also very available if there are any problems. Phenomenal host.
The home was beautiful! Everything was as is and I’d love to stay there again besides the stairs are very unsafe going up to the apartments.

The house is perfect but the kitchen and some rooms need to be cleaned rigorously and also the garbage must be collected because it accumulates day by day. Take your precautions at night, the train station can be dangerous.

We are return guests to this stunning brownstone apartment,spotless,equipped with everything we could possibly need.Our hosts Rob and John greet us like family. The holiday decorations were spectacular!Such a lovely, spacious place with urban and historic vibe. It feels like home after a NYC day! Highly recommend!!

Well we can't say enough good things about rob and John as hosts. They are without question two of the friendliest,warmest and most welcoming people you are likely to ever meet. Their home is a credit to them, it's warm,spotlessly clean,has every amenity you could want but most of all they made it feel like a home away from home. The neibhourhood has everything you would need during your stay,super markets, diners, cofees shops, the subway is just around the corner an it is also a really safe place for a stroll anytime day or night..we really couldn't recommend their home enough, but for us the biggest compliment must go to rob and John themselves. These guys are two great human beings,warm ,friendly ,kind and caring. They get a 10 out of 10 from us in every department, we will definetly be staying with rob and John again in the near future.  Thanks guys for a wonderful experience. Gary and Deby

Rob's and John's place was the  best Airbnb experience we have ever had. The apartment is luxurious, spotlessly clean. Bed is very, very comfy. The communication and welcome were flawless. Very kind and helpful hosts. Thank you so much Rob and John

Rob and Gino are great people. Staying at their place felt home, leaving left a certain sadness inside. I would recommend this place to stay for so many reasons, the most important being the warm greeting to New York. Immaculately clean. Wonderfully comfortable. A magical experience. I will most certainly. E back.

This place is a GEM!!  The apartment is beautiful, comfy and cozy.  The hosts provided just about everything you may need and more.  The location was great, with shops, restaurants, drug stores and the subway all within a couple of blocks, so it's definitely walking distance.  And to top it all off, the hosts were amazing!  I honestly have no complaints about this place.  Next time I need a place to stay in Brooklyn, this will be the first place I look (hopefully, the only).

We saw the pictures online, and the place was even nicer than the pictures.  The location is perfect, very near the subway and easy to get everywhere.  Walking through the local neighborhood was great fun.  We did a Brooklyn pizza crawl and Gino's was our favorite.  Rob and Gino were great hosts and if we ever return to NYC, we will only stay at their place, or we won't go! Loved, loved, loved it.  Jerri and John Morello

What an AMAZING place!Myself and two of my friends stayed here while visiting New York in the beginning of October. We wanted a comfortable place in an area where we felt safe, and that is EXACTLY what we got. Rob and John could not have been kinder hosts. From the very beginning my communication with them was courteous and helpful. They were also extremely accommodating when we had two other friends stay with us for a night. When we arrived, they met us at the door and gave us a thorough tour of the apartment. They even gave us a tour of the neighborhood which was so nice. Being three women alone in an unfamiliar city, we were grateful to be in a neighborhood where we felt so safe. The apartment was lovely and everything that is shown in the pictures is a totally accurate representation of what it’s like inside and out. We were about a 5 minute walk from the subway station, a Dunkin’ Donuts, and Starbucks (we’re teachers...coffee is important to us). There were many stores and restaurants in the area, so anything we wanted or needed was easily accessible to us. We had a fabulous time in New York and Rob and John’s hospitality certainly added to the delightful ness of our experience.

I’ve always wanted to “live” in a Brooklyn brownstone. This brownstone met all my expectations and more! The couple that owns it (Rob and Gino) are absolutely as gracious as you can get. They made me and my family so welcomed. Perfect gentlemen and beyond nice. The brownstone is very close to a subway station, shopping, restaurants, etc. you can’t beat the location!  I can’t recommend the Brooklyn Brownstone enough!

The pictures don't do this place justice. We stayed here for 9 nights over xmas and loved every minute of it. The place is beautifully decorated, extremely clean and it appears to have been renovated recently. It would have been great to use the outdoor area if it had of been warmer. There is enough kitchenware and bathroom are well equipped.  The location is awesome - only a short (5 min) walk to the subway which goes straight into Manhattan and 1 block from Grand St. There are restaurants and bars everywhere, and we never felt unsafe.  Andrew was very helpful and welcoming. He lives just up stairs but you wouldn't even know :) Him and his partner even left us a little present for xmas on our arrival.  We couldn't have picked a better place!

Well what can I say our perfect home away from home. Very clean in a great location. From the time we got there to the time we left it felt like family both Rob and John are great. They always had a answer and they were always available and full of jokes. It was nice to get a little background when we got there instead of here's your key see ya bye. Location is great and perfect and public transportation is not that bad as everybody says. We want to thank both Robert and John for being such great hosts definitely will refer them to other people. Definitely will stay there again. I highly recommend this place for anyone who decides to visit New York.

Another return visit for us to our all-time favorite!Our holiday visit was perfect...stunning decorations, beautiful space and warm regards from Rob and John, our exceptional hosts (and friends!) A true New York experience!

Rob and Gino are the most gracious hosts we have ever encounted...they have certainly raised the bar for future AIRBNB stays...thankyou for allowing us to share your magnificient home with us...the neigbourhood is quite...we felt completely safe at night...the subway is an easy 2 minute walk...if you want a quite, safe area then look no further...you will not regret staying at 523 84th Street, Bay Ridge.

Rob and John greeted us upon arrival and made us immediately feel more at ease about visiting the city. The apartment was spotless with so many personal touches. Linens were plush and beds were comfortable. There were plenty of pillows, blankets, and additional linens available for our family of 5. Location was a few blocks from the subway and the streets were busy enough that we felt safe walking to the apartment late at night. Tons of shops and restaurants were easily within walking distance and almost everyone offered delivery service! We would certainly stay here again if visiting  NYC/Brooklyn.

From the moment we were greeted by Rob & John, they were friendly and available to answer any questions throughout our stay—9 nights. Make this beautiful brownstone with ground entrance, in BayRidge, Brooklyn your choice if you are: -large family with children  or -two couples traveling  This home is just like the pictures and more. It is a lovely and welcoming place in a safe, well-kept neighborhood with  the feel of a small town. Neighbors are quick to greet you as well as offer suggestions of things to do. Bay Ridge is one of the nicest unspoiled neighborhoods in Brooklyn. This location allows you to explore more thoroughly Brooklyn Heights, Brooklyn Piers, Dumbo and cross the Brooklyn Bridge into Manhattan. Look into taking a ferry from Brooklyn for the price of the subway into Manhattan.  As a large family with 3 young children, we welcomed this spacious home which includes a well-staffed kitchen with good pots and tools to whip up a meal. Comfortable beds with very nice linen and white fluffy towels. Our kids loved the 2 TVs, AC, WIFI and candy bowl filled to the brim with an assortment of very American candies. A fridge stocked with water, English muffins, butter, juice as well as coffee pods was a very thoughtful touch. We had a choice of two markets on corner and in addition a 24-hour deli. There is a laundromat a few feet from the house that offers quick & inexpensive service (by the pound). Century 21, TJ Maxx and Victoria’s Secret to name a few shops on the way to the subway.  We got a 7-day Metro pass—kids 10 and under ride free. The R local is nearby with an express D connection directly across on 36th Street to Rockefeller Center. Rob has a good car service in the area that also makes pick ups in Manhattan.  This brownstone was a great choice for us and we will surely return!  Thank you, Rob & John 😃

Rob and Gino’s home is beautiful, very comfortable, and has everything you could need. They are quick to respond to questions about their home or your upcoming stay. We arrived to find English muffins and juice. They were attentive making sure we had everything we may need.
Thanks again for your warm welcome, great hospitality, and your thoughtful consideration with everything! Thanks for making our trip easy and stress free!

This townhouse was amazing. We needed to stay somewhere more cost effective for a trip to NYC but we were not sure which part of Brooklyn to pick. This townhouse is in a beautiful area of Brooklyn. Everything we need was within walking distance. We were not worried at all walking through the neighborhood at night. You spend a little bit of time on the subway but the R line takes you right into the city and pretty much any spot you want to see - ferry terminal, SOHO, Central Park etc....  and just one transfer to and from JFK.  It was the perfect line within walking distance to the townhouse. Rob and Gino did a wonderful job restoring a traditional brownstone and they also added some personal touches and amenities (toiletries, coffee/tea, OJ, muffins) to make our stay even better. They were very kind to check in with us to see if we needed anything and lots of fun to chat with during our stay.

If you are looking for the extension of your home on a trip, this is the ideal place. Robert and Gino are excellent hosts and the house is very cozy and charming with great facilities: comfortable beds, a very good shower, cable TV, internet, kitchen with all utensils and a heating which left us very comfortable. Oh, pretty close to the subway! They are always available to help and make your trip even better. I could write many, many lines about all the benefits ... We highly recommend and will certainly plan to return. Thanks, Rob! Thanks Gino! :)
A true home away from home.  So good, it's an ideal vacation for locals too!  You won't want to book another hotel after your stay.  It doesn't get any better than Rob & John's abode.

We had a wonderful time in NYC. Rob and John were amazing host. Their place was amazing and in a very safe location, we were walking all over the neighborhood and never felt unsafe. We  definitely highly recommend their place.  They are very accommodating. Thank you guys again!! London and Alvin said. Thank you.

My friends and I used Airbnb for the very first time and Robert and Gino made it an awesome first time experience for us! When we arrived, Robert met us as we were getting out of the uber. He gave a very warm greeting, showed us around the apartment, gave us information on local food, grocery and transportation, and told us if we need anything to just call them or ring the bell (he and Gina live upstairs). The place was very nice and clean and made us feel like we were at home! Rob even started us off with water, orange juice and English muffins. Also, theres tons of shopping, restaurants, and grocery markets literally within (very close) walking distance! The place is in a very nice area - we had no worries walking to and from the subway at night. Robert and Gino have set the bar for my first Airbnb experience!!! If I ever come back to New York, I will look for Robert's apartment. We thank you so much for everything!!
Rob and Gino’s place was great!! Highly recommend
One of the best memories in the US. Two of the sweetest people(Rob and John) I have ever met in the US.

Rob and Gino are fantastic hosts and the ground floor brownstone apartment is as beautiful as the pictures. The neighborhood wonderfully diverse and great dining and drinking establishments are within easy walking distance as is the 86th St. subway station. We particularly enjoyed “stoop sitting” every night enjoying the sights and sounds of the neighborhood. We were fortunate to have Gino join us a few nights and share his history in Bay Ridge as he greeted and introduced us to neighbors as they walked by. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and hope we can repeat it at sometime in the future.

Our 2nd stay in this fabulous  "Brownstone" accommodation, this is a really "special" Airbnb the best we have ever stayed in and sets the standard for the others. Rob and John are wonderful hosts, they make a point of being there to greet you when you arrive. Coffee pods, butter and other essentials are provided, we stay in many Airbnbs and so many fail to provide these thoughtful extras. The area is very safe we travelled by Subway into New York which is easily accessible about 1000 yards from the house.  The neighbours are friendly always saying "hello" and stopping to talk. The house is about 40 minutes into the City. The area has many restaurants, and takeaways Italian, Chinese, Middle Eastern and Asian as well as Delicatessens and Grocery shops, as well as major discount stores Century 21 etc.  We had a wonderful holiday so great to be staying in this lovely Apartment with such easy access to New York yet being able to return at the end of the day from the noise and "buzz" of New York to Bay Ridge and this wonderful Apartment.

This was my first time using Airbnb and I made the right decision staying at Rob and Gino's place. The pictures tell the entire story! There house is clean, elegant, a touch of historical items with modernism infused. The neighborhood is quaint with plenty of restaurants just down the street. Very quiet. You won't want to leave!!  Do yourself a favor and stop looking. This is the place for you. :)

Rob's apartment is large, clean and very comfortable.  The personal attention and breakfast basics make arrival and first morning very easy after traveling.  The neighborhood has dozens of stores and restaurants within blocks.  Bay Ridge looks far from Manhattan but the N train has few stops and takes no longer than the F from Park Slope.  I hope to stay again.

Communication before arrival was EXCELLENT and made the process of arriving completely stress-free. In addition, we arrived to find some unexpected treats (Thanks!) and an extremely inviting place. Easy to find and in a great neighborhood with lots of variety in shopping and food within a short walk. Departure was just as easy as arrival and we were able to come and go as we needed with no hassle. THANK YOU ANDREW! We will definitely be back and I highly recommend you choose his place.  Also, the private patio is perfect with plenty of furniture. A++++++++

Okay, everyone. This is it. This is the best AirBnB in Brooklyn. The apartment is incredible - spacious, comfortable, and beautifully decorated with care and character. Great TVs, nice bed, and an adorable kitchen with stove, oven, fridge, and microwave. There’s even a lovely dining area and workspace. I didn’t think it was possible for an AirBnB to be both extremely cozy and stunningly elegant.  Coming back to the apartment at the end of the day genuinely feels like coming home, and it is very clear that Rob and John care deeply about their guests’ experience. I would have been bowled over by this place even if I hadn’t had a chance to meet them - but I am so thrilled and grateful that I did. These guys are the absolute BEST. They are both incredibly warm, funny, interesting people with great stories to share, in addition to being communicative and accommodating hosts.  Seriously, if you are ever in need of accommodations in Brooklyn, come on ‘home’ to Rob and John’s place.

Robert and John have undoubtedly been the best host I ever had on an Airbnb experience. Their house is very nice, super clean, and equipped with everything you may need in a house. The neighborhood is safe and friendly, and you can find markets, florists, and various shops within walking distance from the house (<5 min).  I live in the US and I was there for 5 days with my family visiting from Italy. Rob and John have been welcoming, always kind, and made us feel at home since the beginning. My parents were enthusiastic and they are looking forward to coming back to the US again!
Rob and Jon were great hosts and we really enjoyed our stay in Brooklyn. The apartment had everything we needed, and was very comfortable and spacious.

As a professional singer I have to say: "Amazing (stay) how sweet the sound..." (to the tune of Amazing Grace) This place is a secret treasure cove in Brooklyn...an Edwardian heaven...peaceful and elegant all at the same time.  I can tell Rob and John have gone to great lengths to make this a sweet home away from home. How wonderful to go on vacation and escape the noise of the city in this peaceful abode. Many Thanks to Robert and John!  (PS- not only a very comfortable and welcoming place, but also, I need to add that  what feels like less than a block away, there are a plethora of great restaurants and shops. I hope to come back soon)  Professional Recording Artist, michelle gold

Thank you Andrew, you allowed us to have an excellent stay. Your apartment is very well equipped, it is well located. The bedding is very comfortable and especially the small court is very pleasant. We were able to have breakfast outside. You were responsive and flexible. (our daughter was able to join us and spend a night at no extra cost and you gave us the possibility of leaving our luggage after our reservation time because our flight was late... Don't change anything... you will make happy tenants.

Our stay was wonderful! The apartment was clean, cozy and charming. The subway isn’t too far away either. Rob and John were incredibly welcoming and helpful. We can only recommend their house to anyone looking for a lovely Brooklyn experience.

Rob and John’s Airbnb is not just a “place to stay” when traveling it’s a whole experience! From booking to check in and friendly chats in between our stay was absolutely perfect! We (my husband, daughter, and I) stayed at the beginning of December for four nights. This home is more like a nice big hug and definitely feels more like home compared to other Airbnbs we’ve stayed in. We had everything we needed and communication was never an issue. I loved all the little details in the early 20th century decor and the coffee, tea, and English muffins, juice, and butter in the fridge, comfy beds, and the beautiful, thoughtful, and hand made Christmas decorations outside that were lovely to just sit and look at. We felt very safe in the area too. Plenty of food options, bakeries, and stores in walking distance as well as subway entrances too! It just felt like home and I didn’t want to leave :) Would definitely book again!

Pamela and her husband were excellent hosts.  The bedroom and their apartment are spotless and well organized and are exactly as pictured in their listing.  Pamela graciously offered me coffee in the mornings and I had a great time chatting with her on my way out each day.  She and her husband were not intrusive in any way and provided clean bedding, towels, and wardrobe space in the bedroom.  This was my first time in this part of Queens and I found the area to be quiet and very convenient to the 7 train which is only a few blocks from the apartment.  There is a 24-hour CVS drug store, a Dunkin Donuts, and a 7-11 all within 1 block in case you are in need of any last minute items.  Long Island City and Manhattan were very quick and easy to get to by train from their home and it was also very convenient (less than 45 min. by bus and train) to get there from La Guardia Airport.  I would definitely stay here again.
Fantastic location, cannot stress that enough! Eran is very communicative, and cheerfully helpful. Felt very safe and comfortable. Would definitely recommend a stay here!

Location is terrific for buses to the West side and good subway connections about 10min walk. Kent & Nik were very helpful with directions to the place and local knowledge when they were around them although we did expect more details in the room about the area as a starting point on arrival. As our first Airbnb experience it was a very stress free experience.

I stayed at Kent & Nik place during the winter break and they were not there until the last day. The location is super safe (for those who can be scared of NYC), lots of restaurants around and an access to the subway in a 10' walk.  The room is big enough for 2. Only problem, the wifi isn't very good in the room and the kitchen but that's fine.  I had the pleasure to meet them just before leaving for the airport and they are super lovely. I would have loved staying with them the whole stay.

My boyfriend and I stayed here for 3 days and had an incredible time.  This floor is at the bottom of a brownstone and was extremely spacious- hard to find in NYC. The place was spotless and very welcoming. You have the entire floor to yourself. The bathroom towels were rolled up like a hotel which was a nice touch, and the rest of the floor was clean and homey.  Norga was there to greet us upon arrival and gave us a map of the city and a subway map.  There were also water bottles, eggs and grapes in the fridge for us. Some of the surrounding areas seemed a bit sketchy, however this block and the neighboring streets are safe.  The backdoor opens to the backyard and we loved letting fresh air in- another challenging thing to find in this city. This was a great deal for an up and coming area of town, and I would  recommend staying here.  Furthermore, Norga was an incredible host and added a great deal of value to the overall experience. He checked on us in the morning to see if we needed anything- and if we did, he immediately provided it. Norga has a great, positive and welcoming vibe.  On our last night, he took us to an incredible bar that has seriously the most killer view of Manhattan I have ever seen, and I lived in New York for three months prior to the trip.   Needless to say, you're in good hands with Norga and the brownstone was a treat to stay in.

Very convenient location and so many accesses to Manhattan. You get very relieved stay at Brooklyn , at the same time can enjoy an active life in NewYork!  All the people stayed at Martin's penthouse acted very polite and no stress for sharing the kitchen / bathroom.

John greeted us on arrival, helped us settle in and was a fantastic host. In my opinion the apartment is in the best location in Williamsburg you could ask for, close to the subway, restaurants, cafes an shops.  The apartment is large for NYC standards, very well set up travelling with a friend.  The apartment is clean and is accurately described, just as you see in the pictures.  I stayed here for 3 weeks with a friend and the apartment felt like home away from home. We had the best time staying here and would highly recommend this apartment. Thanks John, Rob &  Amy

Our stay in the room with the roof light was really good. Martin was there during our stay; he's really nice so it was pleasant to have him around. The check-in was easy and didn't have any problems during our stay. The room was big enough, with a comfy bed, and it was good to have a desk and space for our clothes. The room is light, but may be a bit noisy with there being an internal  high level window to the living room; Martin has loads of ear plugs though so no problem with sleeping.  Definitely enjoyed the view from the roof (despite being afraid of heights I got down too..) and the location was great - only a 5 mins walk to the other side of Grand Street, with lots to do in Williamsburg. Would recommend staying here!

Very pleasant stay, the house is as in the photos and perfectly clean.  Enough room for 3, the sofa bed in the living room is practical and comfortable. It's a shame that the garden is abandoned (not by mosquitoes, unfortunately), but you can have breakfast "in the green" on the terrace which has a small table and 3 comfortable seats. As with other visitors, the fridge was stocked, which is nice for those who arrive tired and hungry from a long flight, like us. A little more kitchen utensils would be welcome (a large draining board, other salad bowls and sharp knives, in particular), but we can manage. There are 2 small supermarkets with the essentials at the metro exit, so 5 minutes from the house, and they open very late. Metro A allows you to get around Manhatan quickly, except on weekends when it takes longer with road changes (read carefully the displays on the platforms on this subject). Very convenient arrival and departure to JFK with this line which joins the "airtrain". We also took the B25 bus which makes a pleasant journey to the Brooklyn Bridge. On the other hand, to go to Williamsburg, it's more difficult with the B44 which doesn't pass often and you have to take the "SBS" (so you have to get a paper ticket from the machine at the stop before getting on, even if you have an unlimited 7-day recharge on your metrocard). Norga was very friendly, we were able to leave our luggage after check out. Conclusion, we highly recommend this rental.

I definitely can't recommend this apartment. We arrived in Williamsburg, the apartment was easy to find and all the information the host gave us was correct. That was very good. When we reached the apartment, we where a little bit shocked about the stairways. They are extremely dirty and smelled like oil. But it was okay for us. There was no elevator, so it would have been nice if the host not only waited for us to hurry and come upstairs. It would have been nice if he offered his help with our suitcases. The welcome was short, quick and rough. No nice words, he only told us, how to behave, showed us our room, bathroom and the kitchen. The room has no window, what wasnt as we wished for. And it has no AC, what was stressful because it was too hot to sleep. When we arrived, the bathroom wasnt clean. The host told us, that he will clean it the next day - but that didnt happend (all week long).  But the worst thing was, that our room (and the rest of the apartment) smelled like oil. Not extremely as it was on the stairways. But too extreme to stay a long time in the room (without a window!) When we told the host about the smelling, he made a little fun of us. But afterwards at least he tried to get rid of the smell (it didnt work so well, but at least he tried). This was not my first experience with airbnb. Ususally I am very happy with it. But this was my first booking on airbnb on my own - and perhaps my last one.

Our stay was practically perfect for the first two nights.  The apartment is just as it is presented in the photos.  It was very clean.  Our host left out snacks and had some beverages in the fridge for guests which is a nice touch.  The lighting in the entrance is a bit dark.  We used our phones as a flashlight to see the lock.  We only saw one cockroach which was not a complete surprise being on the first floor.   On our last night, we had trouble with the air conditioner.  It had been a very warm day and when we turned it on upon our return, it flipped the circuit breaker off.  When my husband flipped the breaker back on, sparks flew out of an outlet in the bedroom.  It was very scary.  Our host returned our call and we were lucky that there was a fan we could use for the night.  She stopped by the next morning and was very apologetic.  There wasn’t really anything else she could do.  I would want to confirm that the air conditioner could be run for extended periods if I were to stay here again in the summer.  This was my first experience with Airbnb and I will definitely check for working smoke detectors and a fire extinguisher when checking into a unit in the future.

This is a clean, spacey and well-kept place. It is also conveniently located near the subway stop. If you don't mind some noisy, pot smoking people and some shady characters who sit in their cars all day on the dirty and ugly dead end street where the apartment is located, then this is a good place to stay.

For us it was important to have a self catered place which it was advertised as. The kitchen was the main bit that didn’t function well, there was for example too many dinner plates but no bowls and there wasn’t two knives to eat with. Also in the photo there was a microwave and bar stools that no longer seem to be there and have not been replaced. There was one old frying pan that meant it limited to us what we could cook.   It had only a coffee machine that requires filters (that weren’t offered) and no option of a saucepan to even boil water instead as there was no kettle.   Overall it feels like it could be a really nice air Bnb if someone just spent a weekend just updating the space, such as a paint and making sure what is advertised in the amenities is actually there like a hair drier, iron etc. As none of it was there.There was also a lot of rips in some of the furniture - slight repairs or replacements. Also worryingly the door to the flat wasn’t secure to the frame, which meant if someone want to break in it really wouldn’t be hard.   Also the nice coffee table in the photo was replaced with a really run down alternative, at least if things do swap I do think it should be like to like as per the photo.   One super positive was how comfy the bed was, in some ways if you are just literally to put you head for the night it was great!   Velma was a lovely host and very quick to respond and I get the impression she seemed quite a busy person but when there is actually lots of similar priced places in the area I think it needs to be a little more up to scratch I’m afraid! But I hope this will only be positive feedback to make it better in the future!

Our stay with Carrie was great. First, I was afraid of the location, but the subway goes fast (15 min midtown) and the neighborhood was safe.  The room was clean and the bed was comfortable. Everything was also provided.

- the room I was in has an uncovered (ie. no blinds) ceiling/roof window over the bed, brining in very early light from the sun, and ultimately leaving an unpleasant sleeping experience for the week I was there  - there wasn’t any ventilation in the bedroom; there are windows that connect you to the living room, which I presume is an effort to get the AC air, but also means you hear all the discussions in the living room from other guests etc. Not ideal, as it meant less privacy and a need to go outside for fresh air. I do believe the second guest room has windows, so you should be better off if you’re in that unit  - the bathroom bathtub was not cleaned. I arrived to guests leaving and there wasn’t any difference with the transition of other guests, including myself. My room itself had a small bin full of garbage when I arrived, although this was quickly solved when I asked where I could throw it out (since the kitchen bin was also full when I arrived)  - at one point it felt like a hostel, the prior guests were still there, and myself and the new guests occupying the second room were also there. The hosts then clarified that the prior guests had simply left their stuff for storage, which was a helpful clarification.  - the key pick-up/ drop-off is at a lockbox a few blocks away. Not far, but not ideal if you’re traveling solo with sizeable luggage. If you’re traveling light, should be fine. (If you’re traveling with luggage, heads up there are three flights of stairs, again, should be fine if you’re traveling light)  - besides the above, location is stellar.  - I’ve stayed in Airbnbs in NYC before, and it was great, this experience is certainly making me consider hotels going forward.

Carrie was amazing! The space was exactly what I expected. Very clean and cozy. During our stay, my friends wallet got stolen and unfortunately the key to the apartment as well. Carrie was extremely understanding and was so kind to us although it was an inconvenience to her. I will forever appreciate her kindness! Again, great host and amazing space.

Only stayed for a night and didn’t check in until late but it was a perfect stay. Everything was clean, check in was simple and he gave very easy instructions. Great size room and bed was very comfy. Loved that you could lock the bedroom door. Bathroom shower had great water temp and pressure and apartment is in a very prime location. Would definitely recommend and stay again! Only thing is like others have probably said is you can hear everything but that didn’t bother me and he provides ear plugs. Bonus for the rooftop although I was a little scared to climb up.

I had landed in NYC earlier than expected, for business. It was my first time staying in BK, as I always book places in Manhattan/Queens.   I made the HORRIBLE MISTAKE of calling Martin at 6am. (I wake up at 5am every single day, so I didn’t think it would be a huge ordeal). Nonetheless, he barked at me, and was extremely rude to me.   As an air bnb HOST, I felt as though his behavior/tone was extremely out of line. I apologized countless times, but he was, pardon my french, a complete dick.   Furthermore, this was NOT a “penthouse”— it was simply the top floor of a 4-floor walk-up!   “Rooftop” access was via a ladder from fire escape (very dangerous).   Anyways, I never write bad reviews but my thoughts had to be shared on this one.   Do better, Martin!

Carrie is an amazing host -- although she wasn't there when I arrived, she gave detailed and easy to understand instructions on how to get in to the place. I cannot stress enough just how great she is at communication. I had a few questions and she quickly, and patiently, answered each of them. We met only briefly at the apartment during my stay, but she's a very friendly person.  The room is exactly as described -- you can trust the glowing reviews! There's a big comfy bed, a closet to hang stuff and it's a spacious room. The bathroom just down the corridor is clean and everything works perfectly.  The neighborhood is also nice, with a park near the apartment building. It's a short walk to the subway station (less than five minutes) and I never felt unsafe at any time.  I can highly recommend Carrie and would definitely go back!
Martin’s a great host, very cordial, friendly and helpful. He made a stressful last minute process very easy.

Stefanie's airbnb is part of a bigger apt complex. Theres an elevator for those who dont feel like walking (its not so bad). The apt itself I found to be clean. I didnt meet the host on check-in due to schedule differences, but the process was fine. The kitchen has everything you need. Living room was spacious. And 2 rooms I found to be decent size. I noticed though for one of the rooms the ceiling light wasnt working, and the only light source was from a tiny lamp. I had read other reviews stating how dark the apt was...yes, it was at times. We didnt spend a lot of time inside, so I guess yes not a ton of natural light. There are post-it notes all over the apt referencing where to find things/how tos. Stefanie's roomate is the person who I communicated with & she was helpful. They listed out their numbers & made it known they were available for any issues. My stay was 2 nights, the times I did have questions the response was timely.  We ventured out to nearby neighborhoods for our stay.  The apt complex itself seemed sketchy at times- it was a Saturday night & Halloween weekend when we checked in- so Im sure it may have been livelier than other nights- you can hear music from ppls rooms. The halls smelled of weed at times. Again- nothing the host has control over but if youre looking for a place for a family/young kids not so sure if this is right for you. Overall good place. I think the neighborhood was ok-just enjoyed the close proximity of the park.

I stayed for two nights while I was taking the NY bar exam and it was perfect for my cram studying. The room had a big table with good lighting and easily accessible outlets to charge my phone and laptop. Her place was very clean, quiet, warm, and comfortable. Carrie was also really helpful with giving me directions. I would highly recommend for a stress-free stay while taking an exam or while on vacation!

Our two week visit to NYC was great, in no small part, because of our accommodations. The following describe our experience. The room and bath were clean, a good firm bed, plenty of hot water, large fluffy towels, and furnished to fill our basic needs including Internet service that supported two computers at the same time. The neighborhood is an active one and even late at night we never felt unsafe. The location is convenient to the basic needs including a pharmacy, grocery, and laundromat…half a block to the subway.  Our host was informative and responsive. We took advantage of several of his suggestions regarding restaurants or sites to visit. All in all this is a very good value and we heartily recommend it to any individual or couple seeking a comfortable refuge when visiting New York.  Thanks to John and Catherine. Sincerely Eric and Shari.

John is a very warm and kind host! He made sure check was easy and stress free. He went above and beyond by letting us know the best eateries in the area as well as providing us with breakfast! There are also 2 metro stations close by making it easy to get around the city. Place looks just like photos and would definitely recommend this host and place. All the best!

The place itself is nice, and Carrie was communicative. The only issue was check-in. I arrived later than I'd anticipated, and then when I did arrive I spent an hour trying to find parking. By the time I went to get the keys for the place (a little after midnight), the liquor store Carrie had left them at was closed.  When I contacted Carrie to see what could be done, she was weirdly hostile and aggressive, starting out the conversation by blaming it all on me for arriving later than I'd indicated I thought I would.   It had been a long day, and I was tired and just wanted a place to sleep.  I told her so, and she tried a couple of things, but the end result was I couldn't get into her place and I had to sleep in my car. And I couldn't even get in the next morning to take a shower until after 12 pm.  Fine, stuff happens. But Carrie's initial attitude was off-putting, as was the fact that she apparently (as relayed through Airbnb) wouldn't agree to any kind of refund for the first night, despite the fact that: (1) I hadn't actually slept there; and (2) she never told me I had to pick up the keys by a certain time or be out of luck for the night. Her apparent reasoning was that her posting said that check-in time was 3 pm, and I arrived after that time.  I think it's normal for people to arrive late, certainly after 3 pm, so her policy seems unreasonable. Not to mention that she never offered an apology or any empathy for the fact that I had no place to sleep at the end of a long day, but instead tried to argue and attack me.

Thanks Jeevan for being flexibility and convenient with my plan. He is very kind to allow me to early check in and check out late and also allow me to bring another visitor since my friend scare to go home after new year celebration. Additional point,  for maruku because it was so tempting and i feel a must to taste some and Jeevan is a kind enough to share it with me. Thank you for trusting me and give important tips to make my new year 2010 celebration more memorable. The house so clean and tidy and have everything that i could asked for. Even just few hours stay at his place, i can feel the serenity in d middle of the busiest city in the world.  Thank you so much for changing new bedlamp prior my arrival and offering additional heater for my use. The location is fantastic and the best location as located strategically in times square and so near to 42nd times square subway. Jeevan is responding very fast and easy to communicate with. Just next to groceries market. Great place and great owner. Thanks Jeevan. Will definitely come again..

Carrie was extremely kind even though we didn’t get to meet in person, she was extremely responsive and thorough with instructions on how to check in. Home was lovely and clean and far enough from the city that was peaceful but close enough to public transport that getting around was no problem ! For the price and location it’s a steal!

John & Catherine were extremely nice and welcoming, everything was really easy: communication, check-in, check-out. Nice room with private entrance and bath, which is extremely convenient. It's also really close to two subway lines. The only issue we had - a few homeless people being loud during the night.

You definitely get what you pay for with this room.  If you don't know New York well, I suggest doing your research before booking this location. It is a 20 minute walk to the L subway train, and an hour (at least) to get into Manhattan.   The room is advertised as being able to sleep 4, but I don't see how 4 people could fit in this room. The mattress on the bed is wrapped in plastic which doesn't make for a comfortable sleeping situation. My friend and I believed we would each get our own place to sleep, figuring one of us would sleep on the futon that is pictured. However, it was broken and very uncomfortable (and is actually leather which doesn't quite come across in the pictures), and we ended up having to share the bed.  Additionally, coming and going from the apartment was a bit of a hassle. The locks on the outside door are very tricky, and there is a very particular smell in the stairway that gets stronger as you get closer to the unit door. It was a bit unpleasant.  Nora and Larry were very accommodating and cleaned the bathroom and took out the trash every day, which was nice.

The apartment is well located (10 minutes walk from subway C which leads directly to Central Park in 50 minutes). The neighborhood is nice, typical of Brooklyn with brownstones, the people are nice. No danger returning at night (we took the metro at 12 a.m. to return at 1 a.m.).  Regarding the apartment, it is very clean, very functional. The room overlooks the garden, which is nice.  We only have two small downsides: - the noise coming from the apartment above (inhabited by the host). We could hear footsteps, fallen objects, pipes... etc - the lack of light.  Nick and Olivia are super friendly, welcoming, always ready to help and provide information. Olivia speaks French really well.  They gave us good addresses for restaurants and cafes in the area

No complaints here. Very nice and clean appartment in an upcomming neighbourhood. Could seem a bit rough first day but no worries. Never felt unsafe. 3 important metro lines are just a 10 min walk. Very good place to stay for a long week in New York.

We interacted mostly with John during our stay, and he was a delightful host. He helped us with the check-in process and then gave us the rundown of where to go and how to get there. It was a great start to our trip to have someone local tell us about what to expect. He was a very nice guy, and genuinely cared about us enjoying our stay.  The space itself is very quaint and comfortable. It’s perfect for two people, and has a nice bathroom with a tall shower head which is always appreciated. The area just south of the place is a little bit rough in the evening, but its close proximity to the main subway stops make up for that, and the street feels very safe. There’s also three doors that can be locked for the unit; we never felt unsafe.  The air conditioning was a big plus and cooled down the room quickly. We weren’t quite used to the humidity, but we slept quite comfortably. It’s not a deluxe place, but it’s a wonderful value that’s clean with kind hosts. I’m not sure what else you could ask for in a place to stay. Thanks John!

Nick's place is great, and as advertised.  It is basically 2 good sized rooms, so good for 1-2 people.  The kitchen is well stocked and everything was very clean.  Nick was very responsive - I messaged him to ask about the AC unit which was not there when I checked in and he had it brought in and installed right away, and checked in with me a couple of times during my stay to make sure everything was okay.  I will say that the neighborhood is - to borrow Nick's own word - somewhat scruffy, so be prepared for that, but I never felt unsafe even walking back late at night.

We had a great stay for a whole week. We enjoyed staying in a neighborhood with cute local restaurants rather than some hotel in Manhattan. So thankful that even-though parking the car sometimes took up a bit of circling the neighborhood late at night, it was at least possible (and for free)! And we never felt unsafe. With limited mobility we couldn’t have done it without the car. Beware, it’s the lower apartment, under the stairs/stoop. The garden is very pretty! Everything else is exactly as in the pictures and description. Thank you for being a very communicative host, Nick!

Alex and his wife are very nice. The first day we arrived I asked whether we can have one more blanket, Alex said yes and then bought a NEW one for us! They have good taste of art, and have a great collection of vintage lamps, as well as music and paintings. The neighbourhood is like a art area with great graffiti, which are better than I'ver seen in other places(I travelled a lot). Besides it's safe to live there. One night I went back in the midnight and it was totally OK, I didn't feel dangerous or what. The place is very close to the subway, so it will be easy for you to go to downtown. The only disadvantage is that we could hear people walking by in the corridor, so I used ear plugs when sleeping. But the neighbors were pretty quiet, so it's not a big problem.

in french first: Thank you Alexandra, for welcoming us to your adorable house, a true haven of peace, which allowed us to face the frenetic life of Manhattan without any problem. everything was as described, and therefore perfect;  no bad surprises, nothing was missing, there were eight of us (2 families of 4) and it was no problem for everyday life. the area is very quiet, and convenient to live in, shops nearby, metro F 5 minutes away; Manhattan 30 mins.... in short, a safe address where you can go with complete confidence! The only regret was that we didn't meet Alexandra and her family... but in all cases for the slightest problem she was always very efficient in resolving them via SMS. thanks to you dear Alexandra we had a very pleasant stay (9 nights) 1000 times thank you Marc & co in english now: Thank you Alexandra, for having received us in your adorable home, a true haven of peace, which allowed us to face without difficulty the frenetic life of Manhattan. All was in accordance with the description, and therefore perfect; No unpleasant surprise, nothing was missing, we were eight (2 family of 4) and it was no problem for the daily. The neighborhood is very quiet, and convenient to live, trade nearby, subway F 5mn; Manhattan 30 mins.... In short a safe address or you can go with confidence! Only regret we did not meet Alexandra and her family ... But in all cases to the smallest problem she has always been very effective to resolve them via SMS. Thanks to you dear Alexandra we had a very pleasant stay (9 nights) 1000 THANKS Marc & co

Alex’s place is a quintessential NYC apartment, stylish and chic. It was pretty far into Brooklyn but we liked Bushwick as an area. It’s 50 min walk to Bedford Avenue or there’s a subway super close to the apartment.   The apartment block seemed a little sketchy and there’s no lift. We had to drag our cases up to the top floor. It was also very loud - I recommend ear plugs. We were woken up both mornings to the sound of Indian music and there was a party on the floor on the Sunday night (who parties on a Sunday??!).  Communication with Alex was fantastic and he let us leave our cases there for a day after we had checked out - which we were very grateful for.

Cute, quaint space. Area surrounding the air bnb was a little sketchy at night, but during the day, it’s completely fine. Very close to the subway, which was convenient! There’s no elevator though, so be prepared to carry suitcases up four flights of stairs. We had a great time at this place!!
Kevin is super communicative and made the stay stress free!

We had a short an unpleasant stay with Angelo. For we had trouble with our rent-a-car we couldn't check in as preconcerted. Unfortunately at this appartement you don't get a key, if you stay only one night. This is most inflexible, not confident and inacceptable. In addition we were asked by Angelo to have dinner before arriving. These are very restrictive conditions. This airbnb address is not recommendable when you want to visit New York. Rose

Overall, the house is neat, clean and exactly what was mentioned in the AirBnb post. This is a house where the host actually resides when not used for an AirBnb. For future dwellers of the house (and first timers in New York/Brooklyn),  some points to keep in mind -  1. Since the host/owner actually resides there - we didn't find sufficient space to store our clothes and toiletries.  2. There is no privacy if you open the curtains. The house didn't receive much natural light at all.  3. The Airbnb location is marked as very unsafe according to Trulia. We wanted to reach the house before 8:30 PM, and as a result cancelled a couple of dinner plans in New York. I wish I had thought about this before booking the Airbnb!

My wife and I stayed in the apartment along with my wife's friend on the last week of October.  It was our 6th trip to NY,  and our friend's first.  We were met by Jeremy who gave us the key and showed us where everything was and made us feel very welcome.  My wife didn't want to deal with the loft bed so I took that (no problems) while she and her friend used the couches which made into beds, which they found very comfortable.  With 2 in the loft bed, 4 people could easily stay here.  Kitchen was very nice.  One of our concerns before arriving was if it was safe to walk home late at night as we always went to a play at night.  No need to be concerned, there are plenty of bars and restaurants open late along with three 24 hours drug stores in the neighborhood.  It was just about a 10 minute walk to the subway and just 2 stops to Times Square.  We were here for a week and it was a great New York experience.  Would not hesitate to stay here again.

Great place for my extended stay in NYC. Jed was very responsive to messages and left detailed instructions for everything I could possibly need. This was very helpful and made my stay stress free. Also the place felt bigger than it looked in the pictures, which was a welcomed bonus. I would definitely stay again.

Nora's home is a beautifully and stylishly renovated traditional house. It has a great deck out the back where you can catch the sun or have shade if you prefer ; perfect for just a morning coffee or, if you're like me, for having all your meals, even in the dark! As both Nora and Brent go out to work and in term time the children are in school, the house is a wonderful quiet, calm space to spend some time in away from the hustle and bustle of 'downtown'. One of the most surprising things for me, was how convenient it was to use the subway. The ABCD trains are very close, so its really quick and affordable to get downtown. Also, the A train takes you all the way to JFK airport. And if you feel like a walk, its only about 20 minutes to Central Park North.

I stayed at Rez's place for a weekend at the end of September.  I was visiting NY with my husband, and we had the place to ourselves.  The apartment really is huge, and it's decorated with very cool, funky decor.  We especially liked the poster above the sofa.  We had a minor snafu with getting into the apartment, but Rez was very fast at responding to my SOS text, and we were in in a matter of moments.  Communication with Rez was great, the apartment was great.  The neighborhood was mildly sketchy coming back at midnight, but not too bad (I might have felt differently coming back late at night if I were alone, though).

Rez' place was great for our  'Happy Birthday Renn'  Thanksgiving weekend NYC trip. We drove down from Boston, and parking was really easy, and the subway right around the corner was super convenient. The apartment was as advertised, eclectic and full of interesting stuff everywhere (neat freaks may feel different). The neighborhood might seem a bit sketchy on the surface, especially a few blocks south of the apartment, but everyone we met were really friendly, and we got lots of 'Happy Thanksgiving' greetings from random people on the street.

Rez's apartment is cool, quirky and fun, in a vibrant (albeit slightly questionable) neighbourhood and steps from the subway. Few concerns: - We arrived at Rez's place with 5 suitcases and there was literally no free counter space for any of our items. Drawers contained garbage, bathroom shelves and bathtub were rammed full and the floors in the living area were piled with Rez's belongings. I've been an airbnb host and guest many times and while it's expected that the host's personal belongings will be around, it's reasonable to expect a space for your items as well. I had to move some of her personal items even to minimally unpack, and clean out the drawers which had tampons, receipts etc. I put back what I could and left the rest for her to unpack in bags left in the appropriate room. - bathroom hadn't been properly cleaned and toilet, sink, bathtub and floor had scum and dirt. I mentioned it to Rez and she said she'd have someone clean it, but no one did, so I had to clean it myself. Kitchen was also dirty. - we told Rez bfore arriving that reliable wifi was critical as I work in IT support and need to be online late nights. She asured me it was reliable and told me to contact her downstairs neighbour in case of any problems, but when we arrived, we found the wifi connection used a repeater, and went down for hours at a time. This caused me enormous professional stress. I texted her neighbour twice (although the wifi gave problems far more often than that). When Rez found out I was "bothering" her neighbour, she asked me to stop. I had to pay for a coworking space that let me work late nights, and eventually her wifi gave out altogether. Rez offered no apology or compensation and instead seems to imply we caused the problems ourselves. Rez's place is great for a short stay, but for a longer stay, or reliable wifi, I would look elsewhere.

Really cute, creative apartment that felt relaxed and calm. The bed was extremely comfortable, and its very close to the metro! Madeline and her sister kept in communication and it was a very stress-free experience.

Vicki & David were outstanding hosts! They were so helpful in providing information about the neighborhood, transportation, and the city. Their charming brownstone is located on a quiet residential street in Park Slope in Brooklyn. Our room was very large and the bed was comfortable. We look forward to staying there again on our next trip to Brooklyn.  Margie & Rob Irvin

Angelo is a great host, he was very kind to us from the first to the last moment. His mother, who was also in the house, is lovely, we were able to talk to her several times and it was a pleasure. Both very kind and respectful. The house is located in a Greek neighborhood, very safe and on a very quiet street, without any noise.  We walked back every night from the metro (less than 10 minutes walk) and at no time did we feel any sense of danger, quite the opposite. Everything clean and in good condition. In less than 30 minutes on the subway you are in Times Square. Very good option if you are going to visit NYC for a few days.

This is a quiet, very private 2nd floor room on a quiet street that is 1/2 block from subway, drug stores and an ecclectic array of restaurants. The superior mattress and high thread count sheets were a balm after exhausting days in the city and the claw footed tub perfect for a soak (epsom salts available at the pharmacy!).  Morgan's BBQ was amazing. The crepes & juice bar on Flatbush was also a favorite, perfect for the health conscious. Park Cafe on 7th serves a huge breakfast and there are 3 credible sushi restaurants in walking distance.  Vicki and David are lovely, gracious people. I would happily stay with them again.

It is a good location for NYC- easy commute.  The house is generally clean but especially the furniture, fixtures, fabrics etc are very old. The furniture  seems to be put together from different sources one by one  - not matching each other . If you think that your plane may have a delay think twice to book this one - as check in time is 6 to 10 pm and the host is not very flexible. It may turnout very stressful for you to think that you may be left out or have to pay an extra fee. The host is not very communicative  but he will respond if you need something.  All in all- if you want to have a low cost stay in NY and don't care about some details you may opt for this one.

Nice neighbourhood. 10 minute walk to metro to manhattan. Couple of fine diners around. Room was ok. Furniture remembered better times.  Biggest minus is definitely restriction to check in until 10 pm unless you want to be charged extra 20$. Creating unnecessary stress and pressure on it. Especially if you arrive from the airport and you are first time in the city.

It's a great location in Brooklyn .and david was very nice and easy communicated.and the house was very clean and comfortable to stay.the wifi was erro but david fixed it in a second.and david let us checked out anytime we want at the end.so we don't feel stressful.thanks so much David.

Very pleasant and spacious accommodation in a very quiet area. 10 minutes from the metro, that's OK. The bed in the master bedroom is very comfortable with an adjoining bathroom which has been renovated. Can really do better on the beds in the other room/bedroom where you can sleep 4 more people: David really needs to change the double bed which is very uncomfortable (you will feel all the springs of this convertible bed). It needs to be changed urgently and this can make the stay unpleasant for those unlucky enough to come across this bed. Also only one bathroom, this can be a problem for a family with 4 girls...! We stayed a week and overall we would recommend this accommodation on the sole condition that the convertible bed is changed.  The fireplace can be used with wood provided, it's great. Check carefully with David so that the second entrance door always remains open, it was closed one evening with a great feeling of panic for us. In the end, it ended well.

Sandra hosted both my parents and in-laws (not at the same time, thank god) in her wonderful apartment over the course of four weeks in November/December 2020 after the birth of my son.   The apartment itself was beautiful, and perfectly located not just near my apartment but close to Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, independent local grocery stores (all helpful for making use of the kitchen) and the park. Had it been a time when we were more inclined to go out, that would have been easy too — all the restaurants on DeKalb and Fulton were a close walk away.  But even beyond the apartment this was a perfect Airbnb thanks to Sandra's warm hospitality. In the midst of a resurgent pandemic, it was a stressful moment both to have a newborn and to be welcoming relatives to the city, but Sandra was incredibly flexible, patient, and safe. When the baby arrived a few days early, she was easy to reach and happy to change our reservation, and met both me, and then, later, my in-laws at the apartment to ensure that we had everything we needed. The apartment was spotlessly and safely cleaned, both before the arrival of my in-laws and then in the interim before my parents moved in, and Sandra made herself available for quick responses to any questions or concerns, of which we had very few. I expect we'll be making use of the Airbnb again when family wants to come visit the grandkid!

Hello,  I have always had wonderful experiences with Airbnb, not only in the accommodation but in the customer service.  My experience with Telmo unfortunately was not like that, from the moment we arrived it was very bad. He didn't greet us when we arrived he just gave us check-in instructions. There were damaged things such as the towel holder and now that we finished our trip they want to charge us extra money. Even every time he asks for money he does it for different things (he has asked us for money for the cooler that we didn't even use, for a door that was already damaged when we arrived and for a dirty sheet), it is clear that he doesn't want to commit fraud.  In the first hours that we were in the apartment there was a person in a van keeping watch in a suspicious manner but we didn't take it as seriously until the end of our trip when he arrived along with another person who claimed to be Telmo's son. This generated a lot of mistrust and even fear in us.  When on the first day of our trip we went out for a walk, I remember that we left the lights on inside the apartment and when we returned they were off, someone who was not from our group entered the apartment.  The whole place was dirty, the walls, the floor. Plus the refrigerator and pantry had a lot of expired food.   On our departure from the place, when these guys arrived (the one who was watching us and Telmo's son) they asked us if we had damaged the cooler, we told them that we had not even used it given the weather in NY and now Telmo demands that we make him a payment.   I honestly don't know what happened to Telmo since he has many good comments on his profile, unfortunately for us it was a terrible experience.   I do not recommend this place at all, much less for a family atmosphere since at the subway stop that leads to Manhattan we had to see several violent acts.
The price what I paid was not worthy, i experienced an unpleasant situation with Linda's worker, and the Apartment is under repairments. The Bronx is unsecure.

Chuck's attention was very good, upon our arrival he was waiting for us and told us how all the things in the apartment worked (kitchen, bathroom, air conditioning in the room, etc.), the room is good, since the sofa bed that it has for two people is very comfortable, the air conditioning was perfect for us for the last two nights because it was hot, we specifically stayed for a week and since we spent the day away we only met Chuck for one night upon arrival and as always so kind, he asked us how the trip was going and what He wanted us to feel at home (he really did that). On the day of departure, as Chuck was at home, he was kind enough to call us a taxi to come pick us up at the door of the house. The location of the apartment is very good, it seems that it is a quiet neighborhood, we came walking at night and at no time did we feel like we were in danger, on the street behind the apartment there is a Dunkin' Donuts (we had a couple of breakfasts there and it was good) and next to one of the building a market open 24 hours (they also prepare sandwiches and coffee). In front of the apartment there is a Subway station, this station is very well connected, since in about 30 minutes you can reach Manhattan. Finally, Chuck had the apartment very clean and really met our expectations, we were calm and had great freedom when entering and leaving the building. If I had to go back to New York I would go to Chuck's house since it was a very pleasant experience. Thanks for everything Chuck!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

We were threatened by this host and racially profiled and did not feel safe on the premises of the property .We had 1,200 plus invested into a location where we felt unsafe and targeted.We have conversation threads and can verbalize what was said by the host over the phone when we attempted to enter the home and he refused to provide an access code. Telmo is a terrible racist host and if you stand for Black lives matter or is a person of color you would not book with Telmo. After refusing access Telmo refused to cancel the booking as,per air bnb policy once the host cancels you receive a full refund. We were refunded less then 1/8  of the original price,based on what Telmo thought we deserved. This refund happened 3days later.He was very aggressive on the phone and continuously accused me of throwing a party although I expressed in my deepest discretion i was experiencing a family emergency with my 5 year child. Telmo left us out in the heat for nearly two hours while badgering us.

I booked this house for a weekend in NY with my two employees. We wanted to visit Brooklyn and Manhattan. So we were looking for a well located base camp in Brooklyn.   The house is very nice and very clean. Joe and his wife were also very welcoming. But, I booked this place based on the super positive reviews I read here on airbnb. I feel as though the reviews do not reflect the reality. This is NOT a safe neighborhood! A taxi driver told us to never walk at night there and that people get shot all the time. We were so scared after the first night that we left first thing in the morning and booked a hotel in Manhattan.  Also, you should know the house is 30 min walking from the last train station, and like I said you don't want to walk in this area. It's a very long commute to anywhere you'll want to go to visit.   It's my own fault, I should have checked more info on the area before booking but the comments and reviews were so incredible that I based my decision on them, don't do the same mistake! I would recommend spending a bit more money and staying in the north west neighborhoods of Brooklyn or in Manhattan.

Joe and his family are some of the nicest people you'll ever meet. Unfortunately he was working when I arrived but his daughter was nice enough to check us in and show the place. She also fixed the Internet that evening even though I told her it was fine to wait until morning ... apparently they had just replaced their router which affected the wireless. Anyways I met Joe the next morning, then saw him again with his wife on the last day as we checked out.  The first thing I noticed about his place is that it is very clean and nicely furnished. Not sure, but I believe it has been recently re-modeled as it has an updated look to it. The beds were plush and comfortable, and the fridge was already stocked with some thoughtful items. If you are driving in, there is a gated driveway as well. Unfortunately, it was not wide enough for a minivan so I had to find street parking around the corner, but the furthest I had to walk was only a half block.  Place offers a lot of value. There might be a few things that would make it better but these are things outside the host's control. One, the neighborhood is not the nicest in Brooklyn. It was fine for me and I never felt unsafe, but others might not have the same perspective. Two, Internet is fast, but it was also occasionally spotty, with brief 5-10 sec periods where web pages would not load. Pretty sure the problem is on the ISP provider's network. Lastly, if you are visiting and plan to eat in a lot, then you may want to consider that the kitchen is a little small. It's fine for something quick and easy but I would have trouble cooking full meals in it.  Overall, a fabulous place and I'm appreciative of the host for its cleanliness and welcoming nature.

I appreciated the locality- subway, eateries, grocery stores & more were all in walking distance. Quiet neighbors. Felt safe at all hours. Detailed directions made staying there simple and stress free. Thank you for sharing your space with us!

Joe and his family definitely made our stay feel like a paradise. This was my first time visiting New York with my friends so I didn’t know what to expect. The moment we arrived to the location, we were greeted warmly by Joe and his wife. To top it off, they helped us take our luggage upstairs and they gave us a tour of the house. My first impressions of the house was definitely how clean it was and how cozy it felt! They also were very nice to leave us some food and other treats, which definitely helped during our stay. Just when I thought they couldn’t get any nicer, Joes wife gave me and my friends a ride to the bus stop the next morning and gave us tips on how to get there and what train we should take. Another plus about Joe’s paradise is how near it is to bus stops, shops, and restaurants. Me and my friends had no trouble finding places to eat for breakfast/dinner since most restaurants were a 5-15 minute walk (depending on what you were craving). I honestly cannot stress enough how wonderful these people are! They truly made my friends and I experience in New York one hundred times better and we hope to come back!

Mario (and Joanne) were the easiest and kindest hosts you could find.  We felt comfortable, welcomed and stress-free.  And we loved connecting with both of them.  They are interesting and interested, active, conscious and lovely people.  They have a great ability to share their home and make their guests feel at ease about coming and going.   The room was clean and comfortable.  And the neighborhood was ideal.

The place is beautiful clean and joe is a sweet guy and his wife is simply Lovely the neighborhood is great and quite parking is a bit scary to get but joes paradise has a driveway where we can park. We truly felt at home and will stay again if ever back in nyc.  Thank you joe for allowing us to have dinner with our family who live near by it was memorable. Many blessings

AMAZING LOCATION - so easy to get to everywhere, Union Square subway just round the corner and a couple of lovely restaurants on the doorstep.  Compact studio flat (i'd say better for one than 2) but provides most things you need.  Make sure you are fit as those flights of stairs are a killer! Its a little awkward getting suitcases up and down as well, just make sure you take that in to consideration when you book.  Otherwise, for the price and location its a steal - you wont spend much time there anyway, and it is a well placed base, with a comfy bed! :-)

We stayed at this studio for our week in New York. It is in the Harlem district which is quite nice and lively, especially when you go down to 125th where you will find different restaurant businesses. You can quickly access the metro which is very well served. The apartment was quiet and comfortable. Patricia is very responsive and very friendly (we were able to leave our luggage later than the scheduled time because our flight was in the evening). Good value for money we recommend.

The location in Brooklyn is very good. It is a 7-10 minute walk from many lines that take you to just a few stops in Manhattan. Places to have a good breakfast very close. Next to Prospect Park and the Barclays Center (NBA-NHL). Very safe neighborhood, we arrived at night around 11 at night and completely safe.  The bed is very large and very very comfortable (it is a king with two 90 beds together). There is a closet to perfectly hang the entire suitcase and more. A small table to support things or if you want to have breakfast there. It is a fairly spacious room. Natural light with a window. The cat is very friendly but if you leave the door open he does come into the room (but because he wants to play or not be alone, it doesn't bother him, but if you are afraid or respect him or allergic then I don't recommend it, but it hasn't been a problem at all because we like animals). The bathroom is fully equipped, with plenty of towels and clean. It's completely private, which clearly sets it apart from other shared accommodations in Brooklyn. You can use the kitchen without problems. There is a washer and dryer in the building. On the corner there is a DELI to load up on snacks or drinks for the day (or for returning at night). There are many restaurants in the area, it's Brooklyn!  They are very friendly and if you have any questions they help you. We left at night for Madrid and left our suitcases all day in their dining room, we met them in the afternoon, we picked them up and went to the airport. I clearly recommend it to you. When we return, we will stay here again. Thank you!!

Ivan and I stayed with Hector back in the beginning of May. We love staying here!! Hector is very friendly and makes sure that your stay is pleasant. When arriving if he isn't there his father will let you in who is very nice as well. The place isn't far from the subway station to the 7 Train. The photos look exactly like the room! Very clean place and very nice location. Never once felt unsafe. The kitchen is nice to have of you don't want to be paying a fortune on eating out. The bathroom is a little small, but very functional and never had any issues while staying there. We loved having privacy during our stay, and if that's what you want, this is a good place to get it!!

Joan was an excellent host and almost too kind to me and my friends. The house was very nice and cozy and I can’t stress the fact how nice Joan was towards us. She bought ya bagels and juice for the first days so we would have breakfast after our trip.   She was even gracious enough to let us check in earlier since our plane arrived a few hours earlier and offered to let us leave our bags at her home on checkout day if we wanted to do some last things before our flight.   The house was very nice and clean and excellently connected to both buses and the metro station at newkirk plaza. Only about 10 walk there.  Very happy about oir experience and would recommend anyone to visit Joan and her family.

Its my first time i used airbnb, and my experience could not have been better. I feel so much at ease, like at home .the daughter is adorable and the cat is so funny. Special atmosphere and vibes  The house  is design like a hippie style very cool, its clean, very quiet and calm and the neighborhood too.  Its well connected with the subway At five minutes walk is the Prospect Park,  its huge and very beautiful.  You can find Brooklyn Public Library, Brooklyn Museum, Brooklyn Botanic Garden... highly recommended  There is also an ice rink, a big lake and very nice places to walk around If you like watch the nature.  I think its a place to sing out of the stress from the city., among other things  Personally I learned interesting things in Japanese culture, On my opinion it's the best option if you are a calm and relaxed person

The apartment has an excellent location, near to a subway station line 1, several restaurants, farmacies and coffee shops. It's a very quiet neighborhood, first time I sleep in NYC without any sirens. My only concern are three, it could have been cleaner. Especially the main bedroom shades, bathroom courtains and second bedroom bed sheets, we had to buy new ones and kitchen (the garbage can was full). The second bedroom window needs a courtain or shade. We didn't have a problem with the fact that Mike has a dog, but leaving the dog bed in the bedroom, and the plates with food and water... Was not cool. I will definitely stay there again.

The place is superb, clean and cosy and Karen is a fantastic host. The place is a short walk to the Roosevelt Avenue subway stop and in a very diverse neighbourhood. I can't stress enough how good of a host Karen was, she even provided us with a folder full of information, local hints tips and guidance and was really easy to get in touch with and was quick to sort out any issues we had.  The only issue we did have was the flat being on the 2nd floor, the heat in the building all rises to that flat and it can get super hot at night, for our stay the night time temperature was around 82 degF each night and the air con is quite loud to sleep with on cooling mode. I'm sure this problem wouldn't arise if it wasnt really hot during the stay.  Overall, our stay with Karen in Queens was great and we would highly recommend staying with her!

The house was exactly as described. Very comfortable bed. Location was amazing, one subway line and you’re in Manhattan, about a 3 minute walk to the subway and a 5 minute walk to Target which came in handy.
