The building is pretty old, outdated and not as clean as you’d expect which is fine but something you should keep in mind. It’s the little things but there was a plant in the shower with a toe nail in it, it didn’t affect the stay much, but it’s something that stands out. Overall quick response with the host, we couldn’t really figure out the heater and they replied quickly to that one, had a question about the window that unfortunately went unanswered, but overall good communication. The location was alright at night, it didn’t feel unsafe, just watch your personal belongings and who you talk to. Check-in and check-out went fast. Pretty good stay overall!

Even though we had a small inconvenience upon arrival at our stay, they solved it very quickly.  We felt at home at all times, the bed was very comfortable and large. It has everything we need (toiletries for the shower, towel, power adapters). The neighborhood was a little scary at night, but nothing ever happened to us.   We feel at home, recommended. 100%.

Mike is a wonderful host and his apartment is well connected to the rest of the city. That part of The Bronx is a quiet one, haven't seen or experienced any unpleasant situations. Next time in NYC will stop at Mike's apartment.

Alex and Dre were great hosts.  They offered help and were very responsive whenever we reached out.  Check in and check out couldn't have gone any smoother.  The apartment is in very good condition overall and the photos do it justice.  The living room offers ample space and the bedrooms were good too in that regard.  We were actually able to fit a playpen for our 1 year old to sleep in in the second bedroom.  The bathroom, on the other had, felt very small, however the shower made up for it.  The shower has a glass sliding door, handles on the wall, and just felt very new and sleek.  Water pressure was good and the bath products (body wash, etc) there were very nice as well.  Onto the kitchen.  The fridge was large and equipped with an icemaker and water dispenser.  Our hosts were gracious enough to provide some soft drinks and condiments for our enjoyment (very nice touch).  Our favorite part of our stay, though, was probably the granite countertop bar.  We placed our kids' booster chairs on the stools and we were all able to enjoy meals together there comfortably.  There is plenty of space to prepare meals as well as you get to have the joy of passing food to your smiling kids on the other side of the bar.  We could have used another stool, but I didn't mind standing.  We did run into a couple of issues in our stay (door knob had to be adjusted, ceiling fan string broke) but, as I mentioned earlier, our hosts were always available and reached out to assist us.  With that said, there were a few things I think that could be improved.  The parking space is very tight and I had to let my wife and kids out on the street before fully parking since the car door wouldn't be able to open once I've pulled in.  One side note here, the blackberry tree across the parking spot attracts a lot of ants to the ground from all the fallen fruit so if you like to place bags on the floor while unloading your car, you may want to place them on the car instead, or just take them into the apartment directly.  Aside from the tight parking, the master bedroom door rubs on the floor when closing/opening it, so that could use some attention.  The bathroom door is also a bit noisy so if you are staying with light-sleeping kids, make sure to bring white noise.  That will also come in handy due to street traffic and of course air traffic (lots of planes in the area due to the proximity to the airport).  The last thing I will mention to anyone staying in a bayside property is... bring a bug zapper!  We arrived on a rainy day so we were attacked by several mosquitoes on the first night.  A bug zapper would have come in very handy for us, especially with young children who don't realize the mosquitoes are feeding off of them.  All in all, we had a great stay.  The kids really enjoyed it.  With a few improvements, I think this apartment will be even better.  In any case, I would recommend this place.  It is a 12-15 minute walk from the beach but it is a solid option for anyone who doesn't mind the walk.  Either way, you will be in great hands with Alex and Dre!

We had a wonderful stay. After having a very bad experience with a previous Airbnb and being stranded at a hotel, this host communicated with us quickly and clearly and then welcomed us within hours. Once we settled into the apartment, Mubashra was always available by phone if we needed anything. The apartment was always clean and peaceful even with shared spaces such as the kitchen. Because of the passcode system used for the doors, we always felt safe and secure. The neighborhood was quiet, clean and safe (a lot of family life). We never felt unsafe when returning home after midnight. The quality of the place was top tier. We could tell the space was new and well taken care of. Even the towels and bedding were super fresh.  We were about 1-2 mins walking away from a subway (line D) that took us everywhere. It's a station that is down the sidewalk and on the same block/street as the apartment. Our average travel time to places all over NYC was about 30-50 minutes. Groceries and laundry were never a problem because everything was within a walking distance (about 5-10 mins walking). We would definitely return and recommend this place to friends/family.

Overall very good stay for the price of the location. We paid roughly 300/night. It’s a 15 min walk from the nearest subway station, and abt 10 minutes from a grocery store/places to eat. The only unfavorable things I have to say is that we weren’t able to check in until 3:30 when the check in time was 3 ( don’t believe they were finished cleaning), as well as some pretty large roaches in the house here and there ( not a lot , very manageable) . Besides those two small things, it was a great stay. We didn’t have any problems with crime or anything of the sort
Amazing place!! Lovely and clean and hosts reply super quickly. No stress easy check in and out

This was the worst Airbnb experience I’ve had. The location was not as described. We had to wait in the street in our car for over two hours before we could be let in. The host said she forgot our reservation so there was no cleaning. She referred us to her manager who wanted us to wait another hour but eventually gave me the lockbox combo. Main door doesn’t lock. We were told to access apt 1A but the door would not open. We were then sent back to the lockbox for the keys to 3rd floor. There are rat traps everywhere. This location does not have a living room and it does not have offstreet parking. Not in Manhattan. The toilet will not flush all the way/mold in the shower. Kitchen does not have a dining set only a table w/small stools. We were offered $100. Refund for all three nights but we didn’t stay at all. We felt unsafe and move to Hilton. After we left the host messaged us promising a full refund but did not follow through. ABB took the complaint and issued us a full refund.

Roosi was responsive as needed. It was hard for us to find the key and find the apartment, but we were good once we found it. The apartment was clean except for the bathroom. You cannot control the A/C,but there is a window unit. As far as the location it seems a little sketchy at first, but had no problems.

We had a great stay! Bed was very comfortable, huge TV that you can watch in bed, very clean and updated rooms and appliances. Jodali was very quick in responding to any questions we had. Check in and check out was easy and smooth. There was great shade in the bedroom which gave us great nights of sleep. We would happily return. Thank you so much!

I stayed in this private room for a week, I thought it was fantastic.  When we arrived everything was very clean, the room was so impeccable that it seemed like I had arrived at a hotel.  Marisol has always answered my questions in minutes and always with kindness.  Arrival is very simple and check-in even more so.  You are located between two metro stations and whichever one you choose takes you directly to the center. There are many stores around the house where you can make your dispensation. Although the surroundings can be a little scary at night if you are not used to it, the entire neighborhood has been quite friendly. I didn't have the pleasure of getting to talk to anyone specifically but the last day I was there there was a street fair and it seemed like a pretty close-knit community!

Marisol’s place was perfect! It was like our own private hotel room. The beds were extremely comfortable. Marisol was very kind and allowed us to drop off bags before check in and leave them after check out. Location was very convenient, less than a 10 minute walk from the 6 or 2 train. Never felt unsafe.
Electric outlets in unsafe conditions and power surges when using appliances. Accommodated to make changes when things were subpar or not as advertised.

Our family of 7 (4 adults, 1 child, 2 infants) enjoyed our stay at MIian's apartment, which is nice and tastefully decorated. Highly recommend it for anyone needing an 2-3 bedroom place. Very responsive communication, and check-in was a breeze. The weather was quite hot during our stay and the 4 air conditioning units did an adequate job in keeping the entire place comfortable. The neighborhood is full of restaurants, convenience and grocery stores, nearby subway station, nearby garage parking which made our stay simple. The location is fine, although it can feel a bit sketchy at times. Nothing unexpected for a large city. The only issue we had is the loud street noise at noise that can be heard at night in the front bedroom. Keeping the air conditioning unit or fan on can help to drown it out. Overall, it's a great apartment and we will look to stay there again on future visits.

Lisa’s spot was a perfect last minuet accommodation to help solve our flight change issues. The location was amazing, very close to JFK maki my the commute a lot less stressful. The apartment was clean and looked exactly like the pictures. The bed was comfortable and for the price you cannot beat this deal! Lisa responded quickly to messages and was very friendly. Would definitely stay here again next time I have to travel.

Peter was an amazing person! He is the whole meaning of what a super host is. Very polite and kind, he is looking out for everyone he makes sure you have everything you need, you is always on point in terms of communication during your stay there are really no words to describe such person thank you Peter for making our stay so comfortable!!!   Regarding the area, it’s a quite place, there are no noises during the night. Mind the fact that everything are all opening after 9.00 am so in case your flight is early you won’t be able to find anything open there.   Great distance from the metro station just 2 mins walk and 5 mins walk from a bus station.   Very easy reach from the airport in just 30 mins max with the J line. And it is very easy to go to manhattan as well with J line.  There are many small shops for food and also a supermarket which is very convenient in case you need to buy stuff for the room.   The area was okay and quite but a bit creepy on the night , I highly recommend to get back by 6-7 pm tops..cause personally we faced an unfortunate incident at the supermarket we were shopping from next to our place.   Other than that it’s a Spanish community and everyone in the street are very polite and always say good morning to you.   Regarding the house, it’s an old building so not from the new constructions and not so convenient for people with movement issues or injuries, for instance there are a few stares you need to climb to before reaching the main area where you live and it’s something that needs to be known,  the room was very clean and very warm and it was indeed the same with the photos, it was a bit smaller than expected but we had a big wardrobe for the clothes and jackets and our own fridge which was extremely convenient. Peter was so kind to also make sure to fill it up beforehand with water and beverages for us as a welcome home. It has also a smart tv with Netflix which was also a very very good thing in case you come home early and don’t have what to do.   I can’t say a lot for the kitchen as we did not use it to be honest but it’s fully equipped which makes it perfect for cooking in case you feel like cooking and staying at home , just have in mind it’s a bit narrow.   Regarding the bathroom it’s a bit small but it does the job and there is always hot water, it can just get a bit inconvenient  if there are a lot of visitors, in our case we were six people wanting to use it, also a small advise would be to have your own personal shampoos and body washes. So it’s good for you to know that before deciding to rent a shared place.   Regarding the visitors we did not have any issues in terms of noise or anything you can hear them if they talk but nothing disturbing the only kinda inconvenient thing is the shared bathroom.   Overall our stay there was very pleasant and smooth I highly recommend if you go to NYC on a budget.

Aloe’s apartment is in a very nice part of BedStuy Brooklyn. Step outside and you’re in close proximity to excellent food, bars, cafes, convenience stores, supermarkets, and a large park - all wrapped up in that quintessential Brooklyn neighborhood vibe. the subway is bit of a hike at a 15-ish minute walk, but not bad.  As a host Aloe is very nice and highly communicative, generally quick to respond. She is evidently pretty new to AirBnB however. This is most evident with the apartment unit itself. As of July ‘22 during our stay, it was barebones minimalist. Not just no notable amenities, but not even curtains on the windows for privacy. Also worth noting, there is no air conditioning anywhere in the apartment, only a small fan. This can be rough in NY during July, thankfully its on the first floor at least. There were other positives though. The unit was clean overall, and its very nice that each guest or couple gets a private bathroom - thats pretty rare in NYC AirBnB rentals.  I suspect the apartment will be better in time - feeling more like a home and less like a new unfurnished leasing. We would certainly stay here again in the future, but for the state of the apartment as it was, I wouldn’t recommend it to a friend without a “know before you go” disclosure to what it was lacking.

The apartment is fine, pretty big. Communication with Lana was amazing and the check in very smooth. However, there were two main issues: 1/ cockroaches everywhere in the apartment (even in the bed, yes the bed, and inside my suitcases) and 2/ a "neighbour" who knocked our door saying 《open the door》and later we were told he seemed to be a criminal. The apartment is good and the location as well, but given these two things I wouldnt recommend it.

It was well furnished place with good temperature settings and amenities. I stayed for a month. It went well but the last 2 days had been distressing because of unavailability of wifi and clogged bath tub which was conveyed but no response. Area has a positive point that it is near subway and deli and grocery shops/eating places but Neighbourhood seems little unsafe at night.i think it is little pricey for its value.other wise the stay was smooth and convenient.

This space is a steal for how spacious and gorgeous it is! Ideal for big groups, we had a great time hanging out in all the different spaces, from the dining room to two separate living rooms to the huge backyard. Samantha was easy to communicate with and helpful. BedStuy is a perfect area to hang out in, with so many cool spots on Tompkins. A great choice!

This place was perfect for our weekend stay. We are a family of 4. 2 adults and 2 dogs. At first glance the house is on a quiet street. The property is minutes away from beaches, restaurants and convenience stores. The front porch is clean as can be and street parking was easily available. The home has 3 units set up like an apartment. This unit is located on the top floor. Upon entering the owner has aromatherapy at the door as you are greeted with a warm mist of essential oil. The stairs leading to the unit is carpeted making it nice and quiet for people to enter and leave. The place has cameras on each floor for safety which we really appreciated. The tenant on the 2nd floor was very sweet and helped us with some questions. Upon entering the unit we felt transported to a different place. The  air conditioning was cold, the place was cozy and spotless. There were cold water bottles in the fridge, free coffee and full kitchen. The bathroom had plenty of towels, and toiletries such as conditioners, shampoos and soaps. The bedrooms had cleaning white linen, a smart tv, and plenty of storage space for unpacking. I really appreciated how quiet and private this unit felt. The host was extremely sweet and accommodated our needs, she was attentive and very clear with check in and check out instructions. There were no unpleasant surprises just a cool, cozy vacation home. Thank you so much Diala we will definitely book again!

Fantastic stay.   Photos look a bit old and scary - but its really a very well thought out friendly, bright, artist loft.   I was positively surprised.     Host left detailed instructions for everything.  Very responsive.   Would absolutely repeat given the chance.

The place is in the center of Williamsburg, a hip neighborhood with an endless amount of incredible restaurants, coffee shops and nightlife. The neighborhood also felt very safe. I didn’t see one homeless person or any “beggars.” The L-train is only a two block walk     so it was very easy to get over to Manhattan.   The place itself was a split floor plan/ perfectly clean/two bedroom apartment with two bathrooms. The design of it is very up to date and it felt luxurious.   The master bed mattress itself is extremely comfortable, adjustable and even massages so, you can elevate your feet, lean your back up and find the perfect position for you. I slept great while we were there.   Overall, this place is 5 stars and when I come back, I won’t hesitate to book again.

Over I really enjoyed my stay and I was comfortable, I appreciated the host having extra amenities. The place was clean and smelled great, I wanted to steal a plugin air freshener lol. But in this description it states that it 3 bedrooms and 3 beds, but we only found 2 human sized beds and a piece of cushion with legs. The little bed was really tiny, but it was fine and we made it work. The next thing I would recommend for the host is portable heating for guests, in the cold months it was really cold and I thought I was over exaggerating but my other guests who never gets cold said they were freezing. The host does provide extra blankets so that was a plus, lastly is the stairs we had no idea about those 2 flight of stairs. We struggled to pull our luggage up and down those stairs, but overall I had a great stay and the host was nice and responsive to our requests.

We had made a trip from Oklahoma to New York. Everything is true to the tea with the pictures of the rooms d house are exactly what you get, and cleanness. The only thing is the parking. Not saying this in a negative way but you would have to find a parking somewhere on the street. Coming from Oklahoma And parking 5 blocks down is scary to me, doable though, but definitely enjoyed my stay and Rita’s communication was on point . Almost in the same hour, if not minutes, we had replies back with help with parking and asking if we needed anything 🥰 recommended 5/5

Great stay the place was nice and cleaned everyday. She kept great contact and made sure our stay was comfortable. Only downside was many people in and out the building wish we met them upon coming so we wouldn’t have gotten scared but everything else was fine

It is a spacious two BR apartment, clean, airy and bright. Sitting room is on the opposite end from Kitchen.  The 2 baths are side by side next to next kitchen, but the bath spaces are understandably tight given the Manhattan real estate constraint.  Public transportation is very convenient, less than 5" walk from the East Broadway Metro station. The location is in a vibrant area across from a public park on the edge of Chinatown.  Our stay occurred over Halloween and we were treated to a full measure of the high energy Manhattan hustle and buzzle into the early morning hours...I suspect our  short stay gave a glimpse of what it would be like living like a local New Yorker...

I felt right at home in Francesca’s place. The location is secure and close to a train stop. Safety is a huge priority for me and I never felt unsafe during my two nights here.   This place is PRISTINE as they come, I had no issues with cleanliness — everything was thoughtful and intentional. I’m so grateful that I found this spot and connected with Francesca. And I hope to be back soon!

Iliya’s apartment is what you see in the pictures. Even the intentions were good in the end the communication with her was slow and not easy. We did not get enough towels for all of us and the address was not the right one, the building is a closer one but much more worse than the one you can see when you look for the address you get when you book.  The worst was that Airbnb was not helpful at all when I could not connect with the owner and was not able to do check in. I am afraid I have to go back to Booking or other options available to find accommodation.

The property relies on the idea that everything can be automated.  It's a good theory and often works well but big issues can arise when the automation isn't working.   The first example of a tech glitch was with the simple act of being able to enter the building.  Although I believed I had completed all the pre-registration information the host required and had been sent a message that I'd receive check in and building access codes three days before my stay by the morning of my stay none had arrived.  When I contacted the host, the rep said I needed to complete the pre-registration ID verification.  Unfortunately, their site wouldn't accept my confirmation code or allow me access, so I couldn't do that.  No matter how many times the rep told me to try again, clear the browser, try another new code they sent - no access to the site.  And they had no ability to accept my ID (text, employee on site, email) in an alternate way.  After an hour when it still hadn't been resolved and I had to go to an appointment, the rep offered to refund my stay but I didn't need money I needed a place to stay that night when everything else had been booked.  Later that afternoon with the clock ticking (would I be able to enter the room I needed and had paid for or would I find myself standing on the corner of Brooklyn at 9 pm trying to figure out where I could stay?) I called their help number.  The employee was lovely, explained there was a system issue they'd been dealing with all day and I wasn't the only person experiencing this problem.  Another stressful hour or so but this employee was able to finally get the system working, my ID verified and the access codes sent.  She was unfailingly polite and also issued me a $50 refund for the inconvenience.  Although I was ultimately able to enter, the several hours of frustration and uncertainty were unpleasant and unnecessary.  This property needs alternate methods for guests to access the rooms they paid for if their automation is not working.  Along the lines of not critical but another example - the room did not have a TV, only a monitor.  So you can only watch TV if you have a device and streaming service.    How does all this work for a person traveling without a smartphone/computer, who has issues with their device, who has their device stolen or for those times when the Sonder automation is not working?  This host needs backup systems so basics like room entry can still occur if their automation is down.

This appears to be a scam. They require a full face scan and more private info to enter. A lot of bad reviews here: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/sonder.com  Be sure to look more into their policies if you plan on staying, wish I’d have known

He was very kind. Very good communication with her through chat. He is flexible and cares about making you comfortable. However, the neighborhood at night is a bit unsafe. For the attention received, I do recommend.

Cui was a great host who was very accommodating when I was running late for checkin. From the moment I arrived she welcomed me at the door and had snacks and clean towels laid out. I slept very comfortably and the shower had great water pressure and was very clean. I would definitely stay again. As a single traveler,  I Ubered at night because the neighborhood can be a bit unsafe. However, during the day I felt fine traveling alone.

Near Subway and great value -Host was extremely easy to communicate with; flexible check-in and even reached out to offer late-checkout free of cost (depends on schedule) -40 mins from LGA airport -Close (I.E. 1-2 blocks) away from both major subways to W. manhattan (I.E. empire state building, flatirone) &  E. manhattan (I.E. highline, broadway, hells' kitchen, 9/11 memorial, occulus) -Does have apartment keyed entry and occasionally security guard (I.E. need keyfob to enter the building)  I did not feel unsafe but was traveling with a companion. I definitely would not recommend for solo travelers or late-night returning after 11pm. Some homeless population at street corners which is true for much of NYC unfortuantely.   Would stay again if i am in NYC!

What can I say, neighborhood was a little sketchy at times, but overall my stay was great. The room was small, but clean. I expected that because that’s what Sonder let’s you know ahead of time. Plenty of places to eat and drink within walking distance. Public transportation accessible, right around the corner.  I did see a rat early one morning while smoking outside, but it’s NYC, it happens.

The Sonder is a scam. The rooms are nothing like the photos. We booked the Superior Queen room and they put us in a micro room with a full sized bed. And refused to partially refund or move us to a room with a queen bed. The room was disgustingly dirty - previous guest’s hair all over the bathroom and corners that hadn’t been cleaned in a while. And as you’ll read in other reviews, the shower is completely non functional. There is only a tiny wall separating the shower from the rest of the bathroom and water floods the entire bathroom floor every time you turn the water on.   And there is no customer service. We reached out to the number and email they provide but as soon as we asked for the correct room they quit responding. AirBnb surprisingly was of no help as well. We even purchased the travel insurance offered by Airbnb (with flights being cancelled so much lately) but they wouldn’t help us at all. I urge you, don’t be like me (cheap) and pick this place just to save the $20-30/night. Book the slightly more expensive place and save yourself the huge, huge headache.
Super clean and welcomed. But the area… sorry Ariel. My family felt kinda dangerous with the neighbors.

Low-stress communication and check-in process. Location isn’t handicap accessible or equipped with an elevator for folks traveling with a lot of luggage but other than that pretty easy to navigate.  Great for a quick weekend trip to the city. Lots of great food nearby.

well to be honest, I never stayed in a Airbnb house before, so I don't want to write a review which would tarnish some business, however since it's a house I expect to find every day items that are used. eg trash can outisde , no utensils, nor a mop. there is a AC unit in the room , but I sweat the 2 nights I slept there. The curtain was too long and I try to fold the curtain in order to feel the coolness from the AC.  it just didn't work out. I found it to be annoying. I left before my stay was up due to the temperature in the house. over all the place is small , I understand it's new york so I don't know if the value for the money worth it.  oh well I went shopping and that's all mattes then back to boston.  I was a bit scare I must say because I had to park to the front, then walk around the back. I wonder why I couldn't park in the yard since there is parking?  I really didn't ask but I think about it.  Ann respond to my messages, however I was a bit surprised she called my phone to remind me that its my last day.   is that normal?  people knows there  vacation time to leave the premises. am a boston girl so these things are new to me in a Airbnb house. I never had issue at the hotels  I normallypay little extra for parking and I think that's what Ann should think about, since the space is at the back yard plus there is a gate which can open.  thanks again Ann

The room was great! Everything was high quality and spotless, and the subway station to Manhattan was about 4 minutes walk away.  The area was very safe at night too. It was our first time in New York coming from Europe, so we weren't sure what to expect. We came back most days after 10 pm at the end of October and didn't feel unsafe whatsoever.

The Sonder building is conveniently located near a subway station and near many great neighborhoods in Brooklyn. The room is clean, well-lit, and spacious enough to move around luggage for one person, but I suspect the room would be tight with two people and luggage. Sound also travels among rooms more easily than I would have liked. However, the room is well-priced, in a great location, and significantly cheaper than local hotels. I would absolutely recommend to others and would stay there again myself.

Small but sufficient room. No air flow, no natural light. Easy to get in and out of the hotel and room. Staff was friendly when they were on duty, otherwise you are on your own. No parking, just street parking. Sketchy area.

Sonder was comfortable and clean and a perfectly fine 3 star however done expect much luxury. But you get what you pay for.   We had a stressful check in. I couldn’t receive the door and room code as it was sent to an old phone number. When the wonderful Latrina from Sonder called the Sonder help desk the guy on the phone said he couldn’t send our code unless I called from my phone (I couldn’t make calls as it was international). This caused us delay and stress however Latrina was very good and got us sorted.
The entrance can look a little sketchy, but the apartment is beautiful and fun and the host was super helpful.

We had a very comfortable stay here, and would recommend it to anybody! Noodling on the keyboard while sipping my (complimentary) morning coffee was a nice, welcome touch in an already cozy and well-designed space. Check-in instructions were a little complicated, but part of this could have been on us as we arrived at night, in pouring rain, after a long day of driving, so our brains were likely not at peak operating capacity. After we made it through the front door the first night, subsequent ingress and egress was a breeze.   One note for anyone driving: The listing advertises on-premise parking as an amenity, but that was not the case for us. However, It did not end up being prohibitively difficult for us to park on the street - we happened to find a spot around the corner when we arrived, and left the car there for our entire stay. But I do suspect that we were lucky, and others may have a harder time, especially if they need to use the car during their stay.   With that said, the location was absolutely ideal! Train access could not have been easier, so using our car wasn't necessary. 15 minutes to Manhattan, AND steps away from great bagels, pizza, bars, etc. We packed a ton of activity into our trip, and that was due in large part to our convenient and comfortable lodging, so thank you Michael for crafting such a nice space, and providing a lovely home base for our much needed vacation.

Overall a great stay for me. I work in the city near the empire state building, so was looking for a place where I could access Manhattan easily. The trip to the empire state area took about 45-50 minutes total, which was really good.  It was right in between the A and C train that will take you into Manhattan. It was about a 15-minute walk to the Nostrand Avenue stop that I took into the city. The A train was about 10 minutes walking.   Positives:  The apartment was clean and well maintained. The bathroom came with everything I needed for a solid stay!  The neighborhood was safe, and never felt in danger. Also a bunch of good restaurants and bars. Went to Zig Zag Tiki bar, and it was pretty cool. Great place for young people. And didn't hear much noise from the upstairs unit.   There were small grocery stores nearby to pick up food from. There was also a Crunch fitness about 8 minutes walking that I was able to go to. Day passes are like 10-15 dollars there, but you can also sign up for one month for cheap (around 30 dollars.)   There was a desk for me to work on, that was good for checking emails and such. Probably wouldn't work for a full day there, but great overall.   Having my own bathroom was very nice, and came with towels and such. Something about your own bathroom that makes life so much easier.   The host greeted me and gave me the keys. Was pretty flexible on check-in and check-out time.  I didn't use the backyard but it was pretty nice.   In the future would definitely stay here again.   Other things to note: (that were noted in the description).   1- The washing machine and drying machine are coin-operated, so make sure to get quarters from a bank (tried locally but no one wants to cough them up haha).   2- There is no air conditioning (wasn't a problem since she provided a fan, and it was listed in the description.)

Sonia was really nice and helpful about where to go and visit. Host and her partner often had violent screaming fights which included throwing things at eachother at late hours of the nights and early mornings which led to us feeling a bit unsafe and scared to go downstairs to the common area/made it hard to fall asleep.  When we first arrived; there were cockroaches in the dishwasher, shower hair from the last people that clogged the shower but once told them about it, they quickly unclogged for us. Overall Sonia was pleasant to speak to and the location was good

This was my very first Airbnb experience, and most likely my last. I was going to New York to compete on a popular cooking /competition show and found this location within walking distance to the TV studio. The location was amazing and the house was very clean.  I was hoping to get a good night's sleep, But at 9pm THE SCREAMING AND FIGHTING STARTED.....AND NEVER STOPPED. For hours the hosts yelled and screamed at each other. Just when I thought it couldn't get any worse,  someone decided it would be a great time to play the electric guitar. AT 3 AM. It was such an awfull, stressful night. I didn't sleep at all and had to be up at 5am. Needless to say the experience left me frazzled (and most likely affected my performance) Again, great location if you don't care about sleeping. Definitely bring earplugs!

Please do not waste your money on this dump. No TV or any comfortable place to sit and bed felt like lying on wood. There was only one wooden chair in the apartment that you could sit on briefly. There was a message on the arm of his coach "Not to lean on it because it was ripped and need of disposal.  He had many rules but offered  but offered no amenities such as coffee water, or even a radio.  The apartment was the only one on the floor and there was a distinct odor in the hallway. The building was low income and being an Airbnb is illegal which made him give different address than shown on the site. The apartment was in disarray with furniture that one would never claim if found on the street. I called him when I walked in to share my displeasure and that I could not stay there. I was told that I could not receive a refund and and to stop "insulting his apartment."  I checked into a hotel in the area and spent $1,400 for 5 nights.  The area is is deserted and unsafe t night.

This is a great location in Queens! Especially if you're a foodie. It's extremely close to the 40th St station on the 7 line and I regularly took it to get food in Flushing, Woodside, and all parts of Manhattan.  Check-in was really easy and Hector was great with communication. There were two very short flights of stairs to get to the apartment and it wasn't bad, but keep that in mind if you have a lot of luggage.  Room was nice and the bed was firm. It was also clean! (which is the important part for me)  Also keep in mind that there isn't a kitchen, but you do get a microwave and a mini fridge in the room. There are several stores/bodegas nearby that sell food. Also a couple restaurants.  I wouldn't recommend this for a family, but for individuals or couples looking to explore, this is a steal!

This is a wonderful Airbnb. It’s location is great because It is right if of hollins ave, which is a popular street in queens. This is really a steal considering the price. I highly recommend this Airbnb

This place is very affordable for accomodation near to NYC if you dont mind a 1.5h journey there and another back. Its clean and the beds are very comfortable. Can't go back late at night. Felt very unsafe as you need a bus from the subway to the house which is scary at night. Everyone looks like they want to mug you and when we went to get pizza at 10 there were gunshots

Yonette was a great, responsive host & her place was beautiful. Check in & communication was a breeze. We appreciated the robes, snacks, drinks, and slippers and loved that the different doors, light switches, etc. were clearly labeled! There were even ant baits thoughtfully placed to keep the summer ants at bay because you will see an occasional ant during the summer no matter how clean your place is (& as someone picky w/ cleanliness, I cannot stress enough how clean it was so that absolutely was no issue). We enjoyed our stay, can't wait to come back to NY, & would book w/ Yonette as our host again. Thank you!
We had a great time there. Easy check in, great place, fast communication.  But check out is 10 am and we somehow didn't see it so it was a bit stressful, otherwise a perfect host.

The apartment is nice, and very spacious as expected for this area. The host Hugo was very communicative. They did not have a lockbox as is common on other properties, so key pick-up and drop-off needs to be arranged. It would be more stress-free for all parties if this were simplified. The unit also doesn’t have A/C which was my oversight. The fan worked fine but as the temps get higher in summer it might be a bit sweaty inside. Overall, very good value if you don’t mind staying in Queens.

Ali is a very communicative, hospitable, and understanding host!  Our accommodation was everything that was advertised and then more!  Clean, convenient, and so many other amenities that were not really advertised, but truly appreciated, like the built-ins in the closet, the instant tea kettle and salted Carmel tea 💗-delicious and really convenient-and the location-deep in the city-was very peaceful!   Our personal issue was with parking. We were not familiar with the city and parking do’s and don’t, which lead us to have some stress, but we finally found parking around the corner.  I cannot thank Ali enough for an extremely positive first time visit to the Big Apple!  I look forward to coming back and seeking out one of Ali’s properties. He is an AWESOME host!
This is a good place for students; not for older women.  The hotel is older and the apartment is in the basement.  A bit scary

Overall this place was a great stay. Everything you could think of was at walking distance; markets, pharmacies, places to eat, & best of all the subway. One of the things I liked most was the fact that we were on the ground floor so we didn’t have to lug any luggage up the stairs. The area felt very safe at night it wasn’t sketchy at all. Needless to say I would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone and if I ever plan to go to NY I would definitely reserve this place again. A big thanks to our host Javier who was very helpful and accommodating

Ana’s place was a lovely, private, and very well appointed space. It was great to have two bedrooms and two bathrooms! We did find the scent of the plugins overpowering. The building is modern and well situated. The neighborhood is a little sketchy at night, but fine during the day. Otherwise everything was excellent. You are right by the subway and hear it and see it. But The view was great. We enjoyed just watching the night lights.

The room is a good size and gets a lot of light. They added a new desk and chair during my stay which I appreciated. The apartment is very basic with a small kitchen but it has everything you need in terms of cooking supplies. It's close to the subway station, laundromat and grocery stores. The area is safe although the USPS post office lost my package (not stolen) so be mindful! Kaz and his team are great hosts, they always communicate quickly and will help with any requests. It's my second time staying with them and I would again.

Ghazal was so nice and very accomodating. She is a really great host. The problem is the location. Its very very noisy and seemed quite scary and dangerous at night. We had a hard time sleeping because of this.

We loved our stay in Yvette’s place. She was responsive and kind throughout our visit. The place is well appointed, with good AC, a large and private outdoor area and a couple good hangout spots.   We found the interior locks to the bedroom doors a bit of a challenge but I suspect that’s an easy fix!

I’ve traveled all over the world and have stayed at many Airbnb’s .. but this place by far is the WORST experience I have EVER encountered . Andrew place was not like the pictures at all ! First off There is no “kids room” ! He locked it up bcs I guess that’s where he sleeps . And boy when I tell you that room is disgusting and creepy NO child would ever sleep there . It was like a scavenger hunt to locate a working key . There was NO blankets or sheets to cover yourself and we were in 10 degree weather during my stay ! So there’s 2 doors to get through , he left me 1 key . Upon arrival both doors was already unlocked . I stepped out to go and get food and locked the door behind me . when I returned the key he gave me couldn’t open the door I was locked out for an hour as I blew up his phone ! He finally texted back “hello” with an attitude and directed me to an ally where I can find another key to now open the back door . Moral of the story is he gave me a key that didn’t work . TBC .

Keep your expectations at a minimum.  The apartment is located really great. Good walking way to the cool spots.  BUT there are so many things to mention.  - The apartment was obviously not cleaned prior to our arrival. There were hairs and dust everywhere.  - Stairway: Steep stairs, be aware in case you have big, heavy suitcases.  - Kitchen: no pot, weak water, super loud refrigerator  - Living room: You can hear everything from the neighbors cos they live 30 cm infront of the house door. No TV  - Sleeping room: The windows are not closing properly, so it was too cold and too loud to sleep. The heating system doesn't work at all. Also you will smell everything from the outside, i.g. cigarettes, weeds etc. The bed has a sharp edge on the one side, seemed to be self built. Needed to cover it with the blanket so that we don't get hurt by it.  At last but not least, we had to get the key from the weed store next to it. It could be creepy and scary for some others. We were even asked if we wanted some.   Eventually, we had to move out earlier than booked due to the problems above. We even got cold, it almost ruined our trip.

The room is incredible, it is the same as the photo, comfortable and clean, in general the cleanliness is a 10. The neighborhood where the apartment is located is very good, but there is a street that while walking to the subway you feel a little unsafe, but there are many police officers, so I would repeat without a doubt. Malick is a great host and ready to help at all times.

I waited a few days to write this review because I wanted to let my experiences from my stay at April's place sink in before putting them in writing.  First the PROS: Comfortable bed; very good A/C; good water pressure and hot water in shower; good toaster oven; quiet environment (I could hear a train nearby occasionally during the day but not when I slept): Close to Grand Ave./Newtown subway stop; separate refrigerator for Airbnb guests; April was nice and a generally a responsive communicator; no cigarette or other smoking that I could smell;  CONS: No printed Wifi instructions. Had to ask April for them.  She said she would text them to me.  She forgot.  Gave them to me verbally before she went to bed.  I couldn't get connected so had to ask her to text them to me the next day;  My room was not the one pictured in the Airbnb ad.  The room pictured looked at trees out of the window.  My room looked at a brick building next door;  I arrived at night time and the lighting was poor making it hard to get in, including the motion light at the front door which would keep turning off when I was trying to unlock it; April sent me pictures of two of the doors I would need to enter to get in but sent me just pictures of the first and third doors.  So it was confusing not to have a picture of the second door.  Also, the room was upstairs on the second floor, which I wasn't aware of;  My room was inside a small hallway, which also had two other rooms that were rented to longer-term tenants as far as I could tell.  The only light in the hallway was a lamp on the floor without a shade that was blinding when turned on but the only source of light at night in the hallway.  My room did not have a light switch just inside the door.  I had to use my phone light to find the small lamp by my bed on the far side of the room to get some light; the electrical wiring in my portion of the house did not instill confidence.  There were many assorted wires/cords in the hallway outside of my room.  One wire was an extension cord that came under my door and powered the TV and charging station. My devices didn't seem to charge very fast using this charging station, perhaps because of diluted electricity;  the house is dated inside, which may not be a bad thing but there was a fair amount of clutter everywhere and things did not seem tidy, although April made a conscientious effort to keep the kitchen clean.  The bathroom area around the toilet was very untidy,  and seemed rather filthy on the righthand side between the shower and toilet; I shared the bathroom with two other people as far as I can tell.  This didn't prove to be a significant problem since I left early and returned late; April gave me a towel, but one towel was not enough for my seven-night stay so I bought a second one at Target,  which I left there.  I mentioned to April that I might need a second towel and she said something about not doing laundry; as far as I could tell, soap and shampoo were not provided so fortunately I had my own.  It was also confusing what toilet paper was supposed to be used so I bought my own at Target;  the carpet leading up to the second floor was dirty.

Amazing value and even more amazing space. The place looked exactly like the listing - basically a nice hotel but the cost is a steal for New York. The subway was a few minutes away, check in and check out was easy, and the space spacious and clean.
Wonderful stay at a great price point at Sonder The Dutch. Super clean, great interior design, chill/no stress vibe, and friendly staff.

I’ve had a great times at Wendy’s. She is nice, helpful and polite. My flight was delayed of 2 hours so I arrived after midnight and it was fine. She was responsive at 11pm to text me how to get the keys and get in the flat and the bedroom. Wendy also offered to give me a card I could use to go to a laundromat. When I asked if they had a charger adapter she was very quick to reply and to give me one for my stay.  This is a flat with three rooms, a kitchen a living room and one bathroom. Everything is clean and I think the place (common areas) gets cleaned everyday and the bin bags are changed everyday as well.   The bedroom was clean and tidy, bedsheets fresh. I slept well in the bed. The windows can be locked and are secured. Practically no noise disturbance from outside, at least no disturbance for me but I also live in a big city so it might differ for you depending on where you live.   The flat is at 5min from a metro station Myrtle Ave, you get to Manhattan simply and rather quickly (20 to 30min). You’ve got a few junk food places near the station for a quick meal. There’s a nice small coffee place (Brooklyn Whiskers). Mind you it is not the glamourest place in Brooklyn, but it is rather authentic and didn’t feel unsafe even when I came back to the flat by myself at 11pm.   The only minus I could give is you’ll have to take turns for the bathroom and it can be long. It could be helpful to have mirrors in bedrooms to finish getting ready in your own space.   Overall I recommend it. I’d definitely come back.
Its a scam! the apartment does not exists .

this man is a complete scam I've be stay at air bnb properties for over 4 years never had a experience like this he wouldn't give the code to enter and I waited 30 mins to be let in cause he was so high he forgot to check his phone , he led me to a cold room with no windows coverings and no shower or tub just a spot on the floor with a shower head hanging down , he was in the room side by side to mine and was smoke from a waterbong you could hear the bubbles from the water along with his coughing and whoever was in the room with him he left a dingy dirty towel folded on the bed and said it was all they had the kitchen was packed with junk but he said I could eat in there lol I am astounded that I bolted that trap house after 10 minutes and AIrBNB have yet to refund my cost , I will dispute it with my cc company this was as bait and switch by some corrupt stoner and I warn everyone to stay away from here
Nice studio apartment. Clean , clean towels/linen. Friendly host. Only negative is the parking in front of the apartment. The alley seems sketchy , is small and had a steep descend.

PLEASE READ BEFORE BOOKING!  My boyfriend and I stayed here for my birthday and it was a wonderful stay. It did everything I needed to; comfortable, quaint, and private. However, as someone who is NOT from NY I did not do my research on the area. It was way more dangerous than anticipated as well as pretty deep into Brooklyn. This isn’t your “quiet tucked away new york getaway” and youre not going to find any nightlife here either. Overall, the stay and the air bnb was great! Very clean and private and our host was very responsive and was just amazing. But if you’re like my boyfriend and I in your early 20s looking for a younger scene in a new part of brooklyn, this is NOT the stay for you.

Andrew is an excellent host. Super helpful with responding to requests and very flexible.  The property was exactly what we needed. Heater worked well and was a couple blocks from the subway. The main thing is that location can feel a little sketchy at night, but it was close to many good restaurants and cafes.

OUTSTANDING customer service! Can not emphasize enough how much we appreciate the great customer service from this host. We were a big group and when we arrived they were very responsive to our messages and questions  about sleeping arrangements. Soon after we arrived we realized we had lost the key to their home, possibly on the streets of NYC. We thought they would hate us, but they were so incredibly kind,  responsive, and reassuring. They came to the unit during rush hour New York City traffic within 1 hour to deliver us a replacement key so that we can enjoy ourselves and ease our stress. We were blown away by this level of customer support and incredibly thankful.   We enjoyed seeing pictures on the walls, the hosts have a beautiful family. There is a sign near the front door of the apartment that says “Begin each day grateful” and we took this message to heart. We were very grateful to spend cherished family time in one of the worlds greatest cities and in their home creating memories for a lifetime. Thank you very much!

This price for this place is a steal! The place is very cute and gave me a cozy vibe. I love there are games to play as I am a gamer. First thing you walk in and see the iconic Sephiroth poster! Raymonde left nice snacks and was very attentive to my needs. There was a gym workout wish I could utilize more. Overall, my stay here was awesome and would book again and tell others who are traveling to NYC that it's, once again a steal for the price :)
Great place, clean, with good bedrooms, a good shower, and a good kitchen, also the communication with the host was great and so helpful. At night the neighborhood was a little bit scary

If you don’t know New York you might be scared walking from the airport to this location. There were two houses in particular that looked a little dodgy, but it was an extremely quiet neighborhood one block away from a bus stop that would take you anywhere in the city. Walking distance to restaurants, and the hostess communicated so clearly and quickly before we arrived.

Let me begin by saying that this was my first stay by myself in NY, and I’ve only been one other time. I’m also still isolating myself most of the time. This was my first experience around people since the pandemic started. I say this because I’d like my review to be taken from that perspective. I expected the room to be small, but it somehow felt smaller than in the picture. Nonetheless, it was a comfortable enough stay. I think I woke up in the middle of the night to some guy that felt it was necessary to yell a conversation at the top of his lungs. It felt like he was in the room behind me. I had a sense that this might be the experience for anyone on the block, but that he might have also additionally been in front of the building I was staying in. But I suspect this is part of being in NY.  The location seemed good. I did a lot of walking. It was pretty close to the water, where the battleship Intrepid was parked, which was an interesting area. The host was one of the friendliest hosts that I’ve met. ( When I travel, it’s often on someone else’s air-bnb account, so I’ve met more than it might look seem. ) I had absolutely no issues with cleanliness. There was a/c. Building-filtered water was available on tap. Inside the space, it was very quiet — everyone staying there was very mindful of making noise. I didn’t really hear much noise above, below, or through the brick wall, which happened to be a border wall for the entire space. ( The room was one of about 3 or 4. )  There was some confusion as to which building it was that seemed to be caused by the map application I used for directions. The giveaway for me was that I was unable to follow the instructions to unlock the door because there was a different lock there. The host said that he was already working on fixing something with the listing to make it less confusing. He also said the address was correct on the email instructions. It’s no surprise to me that I missed this, I was pretty overwhelmed with NY. Again, the host was very conscientious.  Overall, a pleasant enough stay. I’d consider staying there again. ( I realize this is a very dry endorsement, but that’s kind of just how I am — more logical/factual than affective. )

I can't say anything more than perfect. Coco is a great host, you can trust the photos, the apartment is really great. And don't believe people who say that Harlem is a dangerous neighborhood because in Coco's neighborhood you can feel safe and come home at 1 a.m. without ANY problems. A supermarket 10 minutes away on foot, several metro stations which take you to Times Square Brooklyn or the Empire State Building 10 minutes away on foot. A laundromat 1 minute walk away and restaurants everywhere.  Apart from that Coco is very responsive to the slightest problem, she comes around and fixes the problem, she is very available and willing. We were able to stay a few more hours at the end of the stay because the plane was late in the evening without problems. Coco will show you places to visit and help you with some excursions! His apartment is very well equipped (everything for cooking, sheets, towels, TV with Netflix and wifi)! Really trust, go there with your eyes closed. Thanks again coco thanks for everything ❤️
I canceled my reservation without any refund as the host had not any profile pic, that made me confuse, suspicious and uncomfortable. I don’t recommend the host.
As in the review, the apartment is only for people who are used to slums. I can only advise against everyone else. I was afraid for my life in this house.

We had a great stay, the suite was exactly as advertised.  Easy self check in. Comfy beds, nice living area.  It is on the bottom floor, which can only help with the summer heat. Very close to the J train. Bushwick can be a tiny bit rough around the edges at night, but we never felt unsafe walking around! Marlene is a great communicator and very quick to reply. Super helpful host. Would stay again.

I loved my stay here! My friends and I road tripped from Texas and got in late, having a park spot was amazing!!! Especially in New York, we didn’t have to worry about parking once. We were out pretty late some night, it was great not to have to stress about driving or parking. The place was very spacious and clean. Very homey! We even stayed in one night because it was so cozy to just chill and watch movies. The rooms both have TV’s and so those the living rooms. The living room had those light up fire places, definitely helped set the mood. The restroom was beautiful. I enjoyed the shower because it had rain shower head. Definitely was surprised walking in at how much space we had. I’ve had airbnbs in New York that are super cramped. The kitchen was full stocked with tools to cook. Super clean. I can’t wait to stay again! The host came to says hello. She stays up stairs and was super sweet. One of my best Airbnb experiences :)
The room is okay, the apartment is sketchy

Host: Amazing host -- kind and accommodating. And very, very clean and tidy. Manuel lives in the apt with you in a separate bedroom and every few days he cleans the shared bathroom and kitchen. He also makes sure that there are toiletries (shampoo/conditioner/body wash/toilet tissue) available. I accidentally locked myself out of my bedroom once and Manuel promptly opened the door for me. Manuel is also great with responding quickly on the airbnb chat.   Laundry: You will not be able to do laundry in the apartment (it is not listed as an amenity, anyways), but there are at least 2 coin operated laundromats within a 1 minute walking distance.   Transportation: All the major subway lines are accessible within a 10 minute walking distance.   Groceries: You may have to travel a little bit to go to a real grocery store but there are many convenience stores and restaurants within a 5 minute walking distance.   Location: The neighborhood was fairly safe, albeit a little dark during the night. However, I never felt unsafe walking to the apt even during late nights. The unit is located within Hells Kitchen so there were many great places to eat within a short walking distance.

My sister and I stayed at Mikes over the Thanksgiving long weekend. We had an incredible experience with Mike. By far the best airbnb host. He is a very quick responder and checked in with us.  The spot is the perfect size for two people and could honestly comfortably have another person there. We felt like it was enough space to enjoy each other's company and still have our own autonomy.   We both had our share of anxiety as New York can be a stressful place and this was the perfect home away from home sanctuary for our needs. Would love to stay again. - Also, the bed was SUPER comfortable, we often questioned our plans and wondered if we should just stay in bed.

We used to live in Brooklyn six years prior.  We were long overdue for a return trip.  This space provided us with that opportunity.  We could not wait to get back to Brooklyn.  We arrived at night but did not feel unsafe upon entering.  The unit is above a pretty main street so you are right in the NY experience.  Future tenants should know this unit is above a train stop.  This means you may hear and feel the gentle comings and goings of the "C" train.  We had a slight hiccup in gaining entry, the hosts were quick to respond.  The space was great and easy to settle into.  We did not stay long, we had to get out into the streets again to find some local food.  The hosts would do well to set up a visitor logbook that may include local food menus, NY happenings, and basic instructions.  Our stay was way too short but it is good to know there is a space we may return to for future NY visits.    Enjoy

I had a couple issues with this place during my stay and ended up leaving 2 weeks early to stay with a friend instead.   There’s no self check in.    Host gets very agitated if you use the A/C, I’ve accidentally overheard him cursing me out for having it on, not knowing I was actually in the apartment. The room is like a greenhouse during the day with all the windows. They turn the A/C off at random times. This situation is way worse considering I had a Long haired cat that would pant and vomit from how hot it was in there, and I let them know this. This was taking place during a 104° august NYC heatwave btw.    Wi-Fi is very dysfunctional and may kick you off when more than two devices go online.   Many nights, there were people coming over to chat, play video games and/or smoke which I would not have a problem with but they’d talk for hours and yell til 2 AM. It’s extremely easy to hear everything through the door.    Host was reasonably friendly but I started avoiding him not too long after arriving.    I also overheard him talking about “getting rid” of some drugs to someone else who visited the apartment and that was my last straw.    The Private bathroom and Location were my main reasons for staying here. Beware who you book with on this app.

The place is absolutely stunning! Within a great neighbourhood which is less stressful and chaotic than manhattan. Ruby is a great host aswell, very supportive with everything. It was literally a perfect stay and I would come back any time. I can only recommend Ruby and her apartment :)
Great place to stay right in the middle of things, definitely a steal for the area!
When I got there the room was dirty and it seemed like there was someone staying there, felt very unsafe.  Great location tho, it has potential to be great but atm it is not

Nice Guy.  But the bathroom was dirty and messy, it was probably the other people.  When three rooms are rented at the same time, there must be shift rules for the use of the bathroom/kitchen and, above all, cleaning.  You can lock your room but not the flat???!!!.  It is always open??? , which made us feel unsafe.  Very good location.

Convenient place as it’s near major attractions and especially if you need to come home quick after theatre at night.   Hot shower but it’s a shared bathroom for 5 rooms of guests.   Room was dirty.  Location listed is different from actual location.  Apartment is at third level -  a tough climb with my luggage.  Stair case up was unpleasant with pee smell and from uncleared garbage at ground level.

Check in instructions were incorrect and late, could have been provided in advance via the airbnb message box as customary. The location of the apt was a 5. Cleanliness and especially the sheets quality was a 4. Cabinets not tidy and organized hard to find anything. The TV remote control in the basement only had 1 battery, so we could not use it.   There was no coffee as stated in the amenities even after assistant came by she did not replenish, and she left the door to the apt open and of course unlocked with all our valuables in there. There were empty bottles of lotion and shower gel so this was not replenished prior to our stay.  The matras of the bed downstairs was sagging right in the middle.  The opening where the duct of the portable AC is placed was open and we could not manage to close it when the heavy rain and draft kicked in.    The window unit AC in the bedroom upstairs (street side) caused us to feel very UNSAFE as the side panels were just loosely placed foam to close the opening of the window without hardwood or other hard material to strengthen and insulate. That insulation was later replaced (after our complaint) by paper-like material and also taped with what looked like office tape. From the side openings of the window one can easily force their way in. The only thing we had expected was a proper and safely placed  cover of the window as the basement window (street side) where the opening is covered with hard plastic.   Again the location is a TOP but will not return to Maria's apt.

Great communication, easy check in, fresh clean linens and well stocked kitchen.  We stay in NYC frequently.  worth noting that the  mattresses are foam on both beds and no box springs and the is no comfy couches or chairs. It does have plenty of space and outdoor space with is lovely. The neighborhood felt relatively safe however the weed and homelessness were every where. More than we had thought. Harlem has charming architecture and lots of amenities and restaurants and nice friendly people but it felt sad and we found that hard.

Chaim was a great host and quick to respond with a couple of concerns. Through no fault of Chaim's the location didn't match our expectations and with a family with 3 kids we decided to move early. Walking to/from the subway at night wasn't an experience I'd recommend. Again I stress, we should've put my homework into the location and this wasn't Chaim's responsibility. He was understanding in how we felt and we thank him for it.

The apartment itself was actually lovely and had a fully stocked kitchen which was ideal for my party's stay. clean open plan space which was nice.  Just beware of the area as there were many times myself and my party felt unsafe walking around. There is some shady characters hanging around outside and that can be intimidating.

I stayed in this Airbnb for two nights with a friend. I spent hours looking for a room, and I do not regret choosing this one. Very good value for the money!  The room was really clean and the bed was comfortable. The AC was functioning really well and made the room cold very quickly.  The shower didn't have a lot of water pressure, but it wasn't so bad. It had hot water. A towel, a facecloth, bodywash, shampoo and conditionner were included.  We didn't really use the kitchen, nor the living room, so can't really say anything about that, but they looked clean.  The neighbourhood looked a little bit sketchy to be honest, but we didn't have any troubles. There's a metro station pretty close by, which was really convenient.   Christina sometimes took some time to answer, but she always ended up answering. We had the opportunity to leave our bags before check-in, which was really appreciated. We met Jessica, who was really kind and accommodating.   Anyway, I recommend!

A nice and clean room with pleasant commune areas. Good value for money ! The communication was quick and easy with Christina. The only downside may be the neighborhood which felt, as two women, a bit unsafe at night but the apartment is quite close to public transport and has a good connexion with Manhattan.

A fantastic accommodation. It is identical to the photos: cozy, it does not lack a single detail to feel at home and it is extremely clean. For us the BUT has been in the beds, if you don't like soft mattresses you won't rest well at all; For us, they were extremely soft! Although I suppose this is a matter of taste. As for the neighborhood, it is ideal. It is a safe and quiet area that allowed us to breathe a little after the long days of walking through a stressful city. In addition, one street away there is a supermarket and some bars/restaurants so nothing is missing. Sam very decisive and kind.

Very nice apartment to accommodate 10 people, spacious accommodation Really lacking kitchen equipment and especially the lack of blankets or duvets in the beds with very poor quality of sheets No communication with the owner Dirty, noisy and sensitive neighborhood but at no time did we feel unsafe Perfect location because near the Utica metro

The location of the house is not so good, arriving at night could be dangerous. The apartment is located on the 4th floor, the entrance stairs are carpeted and have not been renovated. The air conditioning sounds very loud and does not allow you to sleep.  There is only one bathroom, this bathroom has two doors, one of them leads to a bedroom and it is not comfortable to use since the doors do not close properly. The good thing is that the kitchen is well equipped.

UNSAFE, DIRTY, ROACHES, GROSS! Would not recommend anyone to stay here. My partner and I frequently stay in Bushwick, so we knew that the area was good and we were happy with the location.  About 10 minutes to the J and 15 to the L. This place looked like the perfect option for us and our two friends, but we quickly realized upon arrival that this place wasn't up to par.  Communication was very spotty with the hosts before checkin. The fourth-floor walkup wasn't ideal, but hey - it's New York! If you don't want to climb up a few flights of stairs, don't stay in a brownstone. However, the carpeting was extremely dirty - like, brown and rotted. That was the first sign of trouble.   When we arrived in our room there was a pretty off-putting grime-mixed-with-febreze smell.  The walls were stained and dirty. The furniture was clearly brought in off the street - the couches were cracked and peeling, the dining room chairs were broken, our dressing room drawers were broken, and the bunk bed was facing the wrong direction so that there was no guard rail (NOT recommended for children, they can fall off and die). We saw several baby roaches during our stay.   This Airbnb is more affordable for the space, but wayyyy overpriced for how lazy the hosts clearly are. I don't expect much from hosts and I understand that most are working people who need extra cash. But dilapidated furniture, roach infestations, and a complete lack of cleanliness is inexcusable for the price tag. Oh, and there's a $250 cleaning fee. Imagine how we feel after forking over the cash for that! I wish the hosts well and I hope that they improve this space. I hate to leave bad reviews because I understand that it can effect people's income, but I would hate for anyone else to pay a $250 cleaning fee to stay in this dirty place.   Oh, and we used the lockbox outside to store our keys while we came in and out of the house. We do this for two reasons: to make sure we don't lose the keys while we're out, and so that anyone on the trip can come and go as they please without needing to keep a key on them. We put our key in the lockbox one night and realized there was a second set of keys in the box. When we came home, our set of keys was missing so we were locked out and had to wake up our friend at 2:00am to let us in and sleep knowing that someone in the building could just get in our apartment of three young women in the middle of the night. Not cool!!!
Great place and a steal for the cost, but don’t recommend for light sleepers. Right near a subway that can get pretty loud as the trains come by. As a heavy sleeper I was ok and had a great stay.

Great place to stay for a big group. Subway was close by (6 min walk) and it was about 30-40 min train ride into Midtown. House itself is on a quiet street, but can be a little sketchy walking around the neighborhood at night if you are alone or not in a big group.   5 beds was big enough for our group of 6. Kitchen was fully equipped with everything we needed. The couch was our personal favorite of the whole house!   We did a load of clothes in the wash and dryer, minor leaking in the left bottom corner but it still did the job. House was a great place to stay and super big space for very large groups.   Host was very attentive to our needs and responded to questions within minutes. Very pleased with our experience overall.

Location was great, but description was lacking because nowhere did it state that we would have to lug our luggage up 5 flights of stairs. The pictures don’t fully represent the state of the apartment and the shower is way too small, even for one person. Host was unpleasant during the checkout process and even asked us to take the garbage out even though we paid a cleaning fee.

The place is exactly as pictured. Check-in was a pain - multiple sets of keys, they weren’t labeled well, and it was confusing which to use and how to get into the building/apartment. The check-in instructions were also unclear so that was stressful. The apartment doors are not clearly labeled. Communication with the host was a bit tough. It’s a fifth floor walk-up, just an FYI.

The place was even smaller than it seemed from the photos. Each room is smaller than it looks in the photo. The bathroom is especially (comically) small. Your nose is 2 inches from the wall when you shower (and we're not particularly large people). There's no towel bar or hook in the bathroom so you have to leave hand towels and bath towels in the kitchen. If you're on the larger side, you will have a hard time getting out of the shower without rubbing up against the sink a lot. And we've both lived in Manhattan in our early twenties in tiny apartments so that is our perspective. This was the smallest apartment either of us has ever seen. There is also not a single closet in the apartment. And the bed was super hard and uncomfortable.  There was a malfunction of the building exterior door on our second day that made it impossible to open the door from the inside! Someone else in the building called the super and it was fixed within a few hours but still scary and problematic. And we never got a response from the host when we messaged him about it.  The TV also didn't work - just static. I never messaged the host about this one.  Other than that, it was in the location we wanted for a nearby wedding, and cheaper than a lot of other places, so that was good.  Gonzalo was responsive during the check-in process which was helpful (and necessary because the address on the listing is incorrect!!).

The place is as described, really really great for big groups and it was very clean.  Philip was super responsive in communicating and was very accommodating as well.    The area as a whole is a little sketchy, but for the price, size, it's the best one can do.   It's about a 7 minute walk to the closest train station, so that was nice.  JFK is your closest airport, but we came in from LGA and it was about a 30 min uber ride or 1.5h train/bus/walk.  You can hear the people's steps and walking that are occurring right next door if you stay on the bottom floor.  The kitchen is clean, has your basic dishes and appliances, but if you plan on cooking anything at all, you'll have to supply your own things short of salt and pepper.    Overall, if I came back with a big group, I would definitely stay at Phillip's again.

The apartment is very well located, it is comfortable. The bed and bathroom very good. You shouldn't get any unpleasant surprises because it is just as you see it and Adriana tells it in her review. I had contact with Fabricio who received us and responded quickly to our messages. ADVISABLE.

Ysabel’s place was perfect for location with just a walk away from the subway station and a 15 min ride to time square. We rarely had to use Uber/Taxi to navigate around the city. The Airbnb accommodated three couples well for sleeping and we were even able to cook breakfast one morning. The most appreciated aspect of staying at this Airbnb was Ysabel’s communication and accommodation. He was able to facilitate us for an early check in with clear directions for check in and check out which allowed for a stress free and smooth weekend. Would highly recommend and will be back to visit next time we are in the city!
Yonaton’s place is a steal. For a house big enough for 11 people in the middle of brooklyn, i was shocked as to how nice it was.

If you value your health, dont stay here.  Let me start off with from my interactions with Dan, he is a nice person & we had pleasant conversations. He was respectful of my space, showed me around & answered any questions I had. He made the check-in / out very easy as well.   Now I understand there is some level of dirt in any given house. And by all means, I am not the most clean person & do not demand that people go above & beyond on keeping their home space immaculate but this place was ghastly. I unfortunately had to stay here for most of my NY trip b/c the state regulated self-quarantine after flying from CA. After I received my negative results, I started looking for another place to stay.   When I arrived, the kitchen, bathroom & my bedroom was filthy & had the worst acrid body odor mixed with old oil and god knows what else. This scent is the worst I've ever experienced. It was everywhere, my room, the living room, my bed & sheets especially the bathroom where you get sucker punched by it every time. It had no limits. The scent permeated all of my clothes & left me feeling like I was covered in it every morning I woke up.   The first night there, I went out and bought fabreeze and attempted to rid the room, if even temporarily, of the scent I was smelling. It never worked.  My body would pick up all of the dirt & dust as I was stretching on the bedroom floor, giving more proof he did not properly clean or even attempt to sweep the floor. I even found a toe nail once, and it’s not mine b/c mine were painted.   The kitchen plus it's utensils / plateware, stovetop, sink & other appliances are covered in grime & dirt as well. I tried to find a clean bowl and cup to use during my stay however every thing I pulled down from the shelf still had come kind of food remnants on it. The on/off sink handles felt like it had years of grime on it, leaving my hands feeling sticky and greasy at the same time. I even bought a sponge & kept it separate from the one already provided b/c the original one looked like it was past due by a few months.   The bathroom was a whole other universe. There were pubes on the toilet seat almost every day. If you looked the toilet bowl & back by the flusher, it was guaranteed. Now it’s natural for some bathrooms to accumulate mold and this had maybe a little bit over the normal amount. However, I was legit scared to take a shower b/c I did not want to catch any kind of foot fungus. I bought flip flops in the middle of November, in New York b/c I was scared to take a shower barefoot.   I was more scared of catching some kind of sickness from this place than getting COVID.
