Thankfully, AirBnB was really supportive & helped me through this process.

Merlyn and Francisco are wonderful hosts. Check in can be as early as 10am and they live at the property so checking in and out is super easy. This was the most stocked Airbnb I have ever stayed in! Kitchen utensils, pots, pans, dishes galore! There was a keurig and pods for coffee plus other items like creamer, soda, juices, pancake syrup, ice, some frozen breakfast meals, oatmeal and hot coco packets. The bathroom had shampoo, conditioner, Lotion, even bubble bath. I could go on and on about how stocked things were, I was so amazed. At first we were a bit skeptical of the neighborhood. This was our first time in New York and we are from Chicago so we were unsure by the way things looked around the area. Merlyn assured us that it was safe and she walked around everywhere all the time. She was 100% correct we walked everywhere and never felt unsafe all the people in the neighborhood were very kind. The subway is only about a 15 minute walk and we took it everywhere after Merlyn was so kind to give us a subway map and gave us a crash course on what to expect. When I return to New York again I will definitely stay at Francisco and Merlyn’s corona gem!
Nice loft, modern as shown in the photos. The well distributed space. The only thing that seemed out of place was the neighborhood, which in my opinion was a bit dangerous.

Even in French, I believe that Molière's language does not contain enough adjectives to describe unsanitary housing. How can you offer accommodation like this on Airbnb?    Factually, I am not questioning the availability of the hosts or the communication. But only the poor quality of the place which caused us health problems (allergies, skin diseases, respiratory problems) and an emergency consultation with a doctor.  We are regulars at Airbnb but we are really shocked by this rental. To cite a few examples: - Holes in the wall - Mold in each room and particularly in the bedrooms - Water infiltration - Insecurity (No key, three-digit code to enter the accommodation but is it really changed after each reservation?) - Shower handles remaining in the hands during use - Broken bed slats - Electrical block without cover next to the headboard - No curtains in the living room - No door between the bedroom and the living room... In short, fortunately the weather was nice and we were able to enjoy New York.

This apartment in Manhattan is one of the best I’ve stayed in!! My girlfriends and I came for a long birthday weekend and found the space to be beautiful, very spacious and accommodating! And to have 2 full bathrooms for the 6 women was a huge help!! The kitchen was very well stocked with dishes, utensils and other essentials.  The other amenities were such a great touch as well...laundry essentials, body and hair wash and kcups.  We all felt very safe walking around the neighborhood. We were able to park on the street for a short time and then discovered that even though the city has not clearly marked the street in front, there is way to pay for parking thru an app for that zone. It ended up being easier, cost effective  and less stressful to park in the parking garage on the same street.  All in all a great time was had by all in this beautiful apartment!

We’ve stayed a quite a few Airbnb’s and this is one of the quietest. Besides being quiet, it was a great location, spacious and close to the park and some good restaurants. Mutale made check in and check out easy and he was easy to contact during the stay.   Our one suggestion to travelers, is to not be too quick with first impressions. It’s located on a busy street and the entry looks sketchy. The apartment is basic and not luxurious, but it worked great for us.

Was a horrible stay. There is alot of non Airbnb guests staying at this place.  The host is unporfessional and for the whole time I was there, I felt uncomfortable.   The host tries to charge you for everything. and constantly bothers me by knocking on the door.   it was just a unpleasant stay being here.
Anibal was a great host and very helpful.  The whole process was very stress free!
The place was super cute, very clean, and the location is absolutely perfect—a steal at this price in SOHO.

I was excited about this place but was sorely disappointed. The address was incorrect, the place was messy and the bathroom walls were crumbling. I woke up the second night covered in itchy bug bites. While I slept three men entered the apartment unannounced claiming to be there to do repairs. I was also asked to lie to neighbours because Airbnb clearly isn’t allowed. I don’t think this should be considered suitable to rent for the astronomical price I paid. The location was good, other than that I felt unclean and unsafe staying there and left 2 days early.

I had a wonderful time at Rob’s place ! He is an amazing host , responding immediately and he helped with everything. The apartment is perfect! Very sunny , clean with perfect views. I will definitely come back .

Spacious and comfortable studio apartment with beautiful lighting. The staircase is a bit scary for someone who travels alone with a big suitcase. However the skincare store next door does offer luggage storage at a small cost on Bounce. The location is absolutely unbeatable, close to popular restaurants, bakeries and subway stations. The neighborhood is safe to walk around even late at night.Host is friendly, caring and very responsive. Once the green plants in the apartment are replaced, it will be as perfect as it looks in the pictures. Highly recommend!!!

The Heart of Harlem. If you want to have a full Harlem Experience this location is spot on. A walkable neighborhood with many restaurants and fast bite options.   The Grounds are gated, well kept and secure. Green grass, the building set way back from the main street. A security kiosk at the front with security riding the campus in a cart 24-7. A friendly community. The neighbors were friendly and helpful. The building is clean and smells of clean laundry when you enter. Three elevators, never a long wait to leave or enter the apartment.   The apartment is exactly how it looks into photos. CLEAN. Solemn. Comfortable. Great natural light. Ample television streaming options. I can't stress enough the Quietness of the apartment. With so many apartments in the building you'd think it to be raucous. Not the case. Great night's sleep.   Marquiese was attentive from the moment we booked. Very responsive, knowledgable and friendly. Called before our check-out and stopped by to say hello right before we left. A nice touch. Very personable.

This place was great for what my friend and I needed. Steps into apartment are a little steep but they presented no problem for us, but for future notice to others. Beverley was there when we arrived and gave us a tour and was so nice. Made arriving on a rainy, cold day totally stress free. Subway is only a 10 min walk. It was in the teens at night and we were warm and cozy all 3 nights of our stay. Everything was clean and comfortable. We would stay again!

Stayed one night with my family, after a late flight from Europe. The house ist close to JFK, super clean and nicely furnished. There‘s 2 bedrooms, which is perfect. Unfortunately there‘s a steep staircase and no security measurements, which was a little difficult with our 1-Year-Old. During the night somebody tried to get into the house, which was really scary. But as we could find out writing with Phoebe, it was probably her husband, not knowing that there are guests. The house & Service is really nice, although the neighborhood wouldn‘t be my choice for a longer stay. Phoebe was really nice & supportive at all times!

The place was nice and cozy in a newly renovated house. Phoebe is a wonderful host. She responds promptly to any issues or concerns you might have. Check-in process was pretty smooth. If you're looking for a place to crash in the area and don't want to spend a fortune, this is a spot for you. Yes, neighborhood is kind of sketchy, but I knew that going in and didn't decide to take a stroll. Plenty of parking in the street. We would definitely be back if we're in the area.

Francis was super nice and helpful! The apartment was smaller than expected but very pleasant to live in and beautiful. The area seems a little dangerous at night but not directly on the street of the house but if you walk for 2 minutes and go into the street with all the shops. It takes a while to get to the city center (Timessquare…) (approx. 1 hour). Overall, a good price-performance ratio for New York! I can recommend it as a good alternative to hotels or expensive BnBs, especially for people who want to save something.
It was a pleasure staying at Phoebe's place. An entire home for such a cheap price is definitely a steal! She was very communicative and helpful with any questions, concerns, and suggestions. 10/10

ABSOLUTE TERRIBLE STAY WOULD BE AN UNDERSTATEMENT. IT WAS A NIGHTMARE!!! WHERE CAN I BEGIN? FIRST OF ALL SHE NEVER SHOWED UP TO MEET ME FOR THE KEY AND IN GENERAL. EVERY TIME I WENT OUTSIDE OF MY ROOM SHE RAN AWAY BACK TO HEE ROOM (I DONT KNOW EVEN KNOW IF ITS A GIRL OR BOY). ALSO ITS VERY CREEPY THAT YOU CANT EVEN CLOSE THE DOOR FOR YOUR ROOM. A BREEZE CAN PUSH THE DOOR OPEN. I HAD TO KEEP THE DOOR SHUT WITH MY BACK WHEN I WANTED TO CHANGE. BUT WAIT THERES WAY WORSE... WHEN I ASKED HER IF I CAN DO SOMETHING TO CLOSE THE DOOR, SHE FREAKED OUT SAYING SHE'S GONNA KICK ME OUT AND CALL THE COPS. SHE ALSO THREATENED ME THAT I WOULD BE SORRY IF I DIDNT LEAVE THE HOUSE IN 30 MINUTES. SHE OR HE IS A NUT JOB. IT WAS ALL BY TEXT BECAUSE SHE COULDNT SHOW HER FACE. I DO NOT RECOMMEND!

The place is located, the neighborhood seems a little unsafe and outside the apartment there are almost always men shouting outside the entrance to the building since there is a wine shop next door. If you are very picky about noise I suggest using earplugs. The space is not like the photos, it is not clear, it is an inhabited apartment. The room is like the photos but in our case it was dirty and so were the sheets. The mattress is comfortable. It was an emergency that we had to book here and it saved our night but it is just a place to sleep. It is not clean or at least that feeling left us. And check out is too early at 9am and Peiyi is very inflexible to wait an extra minute, if you go over the exact time by a few minutes he wants to charge you for one more night. If you're just looking to sleep and you're not bothered by cleanliness, I recommend it, otherwise I wouldn't go back. P.S. And you can't cook.  Thank you!

Room is small but thats perfectly fine it was cozy,smelled lovely and there is also a desk in room. She provides towel ear plugs water and hair dryer,also with a list of instructions .she will also send you a little info before as well.  I felt the place was clean didnt see anything to complain about specially since its someone home not a hotel. If you stay a day or night i reccomend you order food you cant use stove or oven so ordering is the best option here. There is a deli downstairs to.i know there were complaints about people in front of building,this is true however they fid not bother me and i wouldnt worry about it to much unless you encounter a situation. Is the area safe well its harlem and the projects are across the street im from brooklyn so this is normal to me so keep that in mind  didnt see any danger near by but of course always be alert In these areas. Only complaint i could make is getting the acces chip is not the best way  but understandable. And the key under mat to open home also not the best way i recommend taping it to a better rug or getting a lock that can hold a key that you need a combo to open and  maybe screw into door.however if there hasnt been any problem with it in the past its nothing to worry about.   I really enjoy staying here for a few hours and also have to say peiyi responds extremely quick thats a plus. Free wifi  a plus and the price hard to beat.

The space is great place to unwind with plenty of room for small family of four or just a space to unwind if your here for business. My colleague and I were here for a business trip and worked perfect. While it is out from central tourist areas, the train was close and 40 min you were deep in the city. Much easier than being in a car NY traffic.  While the neighborhood is not a trendy neighborhood, just your working class neighborhood, there are places to eat and buy groceries and the spot can serve a good base. Walking at night I did not feel unsafe, but it's the city! Always keep an eye open no matter where you go! For the cost, I rather stay here than the bloated Williamsburg or Manhattan hotel prices.

PLEASE READ THIS REVIEW! 🚨  Cherna seemed lovely and responsive when I initially booked. She offered a free night's stay, but I had to pay for it up front and she explained it away, saying she would refund it later.  This was great as I'm a travel nurse traveling this summer with my autistic child and cat. Security and advanced planning is very important to me.  The day before I was supposed to check in, she did not send the PIN to access the door as promised. In fact, she didn't respond to any of my messages. I knew from talking briefly she had small children and worked a lot, so I assumed she was busy and assumed she would send it in the morning first thing.  At 6:00, I messaged her reminding her I was checking in. Two and a half hours later, I chose to get AirBnB involved as she continued to ignore me. AirBnB contacted her and told her she had two hours to contact me, or the booking would be canceled since I was arriving that day with no indication I would be able to access the apartment.   Cherna didn't contact me until after 12, when she stated there wasn't even a PIN and just to show up any time after 3, not explaining the strange disappearance or why her listing inaccurately said there was a PIN pad. When I stated how distressed I was and that I wanted a refund, she immediately stated, "I don't have your money and will refund you after you check in." When I stated I felt unsafe and she had broken the agreement and I wanted a full refund immediately, she demanded we speak over the phone, presumably to try to extort more money.  When I refused, she began namecalling and using abusive language.   The interesting thing is when you use abusive language on a recorded platform, like AirBnB DMs, or on a recorded line with support staff, it often bites you. Good luck to any person who books with her. You're going to need it.

Mackenzie is a terrific host. She is prompt to respond, sensitive and accommodating to her visitors' needs and receptive to suggestions. For example, Mackenzie honored both our requests for early check-in and a fan for the bedroom which we are grateful for. The apartment itself was sparkling clean on arrival and matched the advertisement. The bathroom, in particular, was clean, updated and came with critical toiletries. The only issue we faced during our stay was with mosquitoes and bugs (likely on account of the apartment's garden-level location) but Mackenzie provided us with insecticide on request which was much appreciated. While we were cautioned that the location of the apartment is in a rough neighborhood, we never encountered any issues nor did we feel unsafe.  If anything, this made it easy to find street parking. In summary, Mackenzie's apartment was a great find and we will definitely consider staying in her apartment again.

Clean and tidy, relatively large studio apartment in queens perfectly located for subway and easy access to Manhattan. I never saw Lina but she always answered my questions promptly. I need to stress this is a basement apartment, and so if you really want natural light (especially in NY winter) then this isn't the place for you. There is also some intermittent noise from neighbors upstairs, but it mostly subsided at night. Nice big TV, super comfortable bed and couch, and a convenient and well stocked corner store nearby. Thanks Lina.

If you’re looking for an affordable yet stylish place to stay in New York, look no further. Jose’s place absolutely beat my expectations. The apartment is extremely well-kept; From its comfortable beds, great areas for guests to lounge, and a ready-to-use kitchen to chef up some incredible meals. The apartment is also FULL of thought-out modern décor, which I loved and appreciate…..it gives the place a whole lot of character.      Moving onto Location, Location, Location! Can’t stress this enough. The townhouse is so centrally located. Jose was kind enough to share a welcome package, with tips to plan the most special of days in NYC….Places to go for authentic food, New York’s most popular Museums, and a map to find your way around a busy city! The  townhouse sits right in between two main subway lines, which quickly get you to the heart of New York City (Most known as time square).   This place is one of a kind and in just one weekend of a stay, it felt like home. I can only thank Jose for the clear communication, for always being reachable, and answering all my questions. I truly recommend this gem of a place and just hope to stay here once again in the future. Thank you for sharing your home and for the great memories!

DO NOT RENT. I rented this place because of how Convenient the location was. When I got there you have to walk down to a very dirt basement looking area. There was a dead bug in the corner. Before I put any of my belongings in the apt I went and got bleach and other cleaning supplies. During our stay the bed dropped. When I looked underneath I realized there was boxes holding it up. There was also garbage and someone else’s flip flops. Our entire stay I wore sandals while walking around because the floor was dirty. Also we were forced to go to Kmart and purchase bedding because I was afraid to sleep with the bedding it had a fun smell. The air in that area is also very stale and muggy. I would not recommend to anyone for any reason!
Got so comfterble that i booked a few more nights here lol & if you not scared to kill a lil bug once in a blue then this place is right for you

As a Brooklyn dweller, I was familiar with the location of Ruby and Pat's place and it was exactly where I wanted my visiting family to stay! It's within 10 minutes walking distance to myriads of shopping and restaurant options, which are shared in a carefully curated booklet that is provided at the residence for out-of-town visitors. We were able to rent the brownstone in its entirety, and given my family could all be under one roof, as opposed to multiple hotel rooms, it was a steal, price-wise! Pat met us upon arrival and showed us all the rooms, available laundry facilities, pantry, coffee, and tea amenities, including the welcome book that listed all the house rules, guidance for local activities, and again, suggestions for ordering in and dining out. The place is STUNNING! Each room is beautifully decorated, and the bathrooms all had such cool details and decorations! The door handles alone were conversation pieces and it truly felt like a Victorian dream! There are loads of books to read, an electric fireplace and some games! My family felt safe in the neighborhood, and it's a beautiful area for a nice spring or fall walkabout! I will definitely stay here again, should the occasion arise, and I cannot thank Ruby and Pat enough for their warmth, while my family came to visit for my wedding!

Absolutely fantastic. We were in town visiting our daughter and we felt like we were at home. The 2 bedroom townhouse offers plenty of space, modern amenities and is located in a terrific spot. The neighborhood is quiet and it's hard to believe you are in one of the biggest cities in the world. You are several blocks from two subway lines and within walking distance to grocery stores, drug stores and many fantastic restaurants in Harlem. Amy Ruth's chicken and waffles are a must! Central Park is a short walk as well. Jose is a terrific host and it's obvious he takes great pride in his properties. I certainly will stay here when we return in the winter.

Absolutely terrific place to stay to visit the city.  Short walk to the 116th St subway 2 line.  A longer walk to the 116th street on the west side.  There were grocery stores and delis within walking distance.  Enjoyed Amy Ruth's for soul food and the Sugar Hill Creamery for great ice cream.  We are three generations of white ladies and did not feel unsafe.   The apartment itself is on the ground floor and very comfortable.  Each bedroom had a queen bed and it's own AC.  There was a sleep sofa and an air mattress.  We used them all.  All of the finishes and decor were first rate.  We could recommend this unit to anyone.

While Eva herself was polite, I must say, this listing is straight up disrespectful. Integrity is so important and this place did NOT uphold that. This is the absolute WORST place I have ever stayed. If you are like me, someone who really values your privacy, this place is NOT for you. Planning for my NYC trip, and seeing this listing, I thought it would be perfect for myself and my boyfriend. The pictures really do lie. Before booking any Airbnb, I always go to filters and click entire place, etc. The listing says “entire house” but that is not the case at all. Walking in, I found out that the bathroom was a completely separate room from where the bed and everything else was. I was under the impression that the entire space was one thing. To make things worst, there is a door to separate the basement from upstairs, and everyone in the house uses it. And yes, I said EVERYONE. When I asked Eva if we could keep this closed at all times, so we could have our privacy, she told me her tenants use our space as an entrance. I had NO idea she even had tenants. If you are in the bathroom, you can hear everyone in the hall.. which was very uncomfortable for us.. if you come out of the shower, there could be multiple strangers just walking through. We felt extremely unsafe. We didn’t know who was there with us or the type of people they are... I landed Friday night at 11 and did not go to bed till 3:00 AM because there was a cricket in the closet.The next day my boyfriend got ready for work and we went outside in the front by his car. He smoked a cigarette then left. About two hours later, finally getting cozy to take a nap, Eva started calling my phone nonstop. When I didn’t answer, she knocked the door. I opened the door to find her and her husband standing there. Maybe she brought her husband for “backup” I don’t know. She told me we couldn’t be smoking on the property. I thought this was extremely strange because the sidewalks and road belong to NYC. I told my boyfriend what occurred and we instantly started looking for another Airbnb.. Because it was extremely last minute, we could find nothing. Instead we had to suffer through the next 4 days. Observing from the front of the house, we saw at least four different sets of people entering and leaving. This wasn’t our space at all.. this was a fricking hostel. Not to mention the big cockroaches and different creatures in the bathroom. Eva, you need to be very honest about your listing... I would NEVER recommend this place to anyone.

Great place!  Price, comfort, and nice style for a short stay,   Neighborhood a little scary at night, but seems safe.  A little far from the city,  no climate control, and not much privacy. Other that that very good for the price.

Very friendly host and great location! Very close to the subway and never felt unsafe when walking to/from the station, even at night. Perfect place if you just need somewhere to crash/shower during your time in NY.

I was grateful to find this place after my last Airbnb experience where the apartment had a cockroach situation. Check in was okay. It would have been helpful to be told where the combo lock is. The room is small and sweet. Great view of trees. The bed is comfortable. The water pressure is good. There is a kitchenette in the bathroom. It’s fine for a short stay of a week or two but after that, the kitchen the bathroom stops being acceptable. The location is 10 blocks from Central Park. That was the best part. And the old house is charming with all the art. Harlem is fine. It’s cultural and cool and sketchy in parts. The ice cream place down the block was a great treat. Whole Foods is 5 blocks away. This is not a warm hosting situation. You are pretty much hosted and ghosted. The interaction with the host was mostly cordial until the end. Due to miscommunication/misunderstanding, I overstayed my checkout by an hour or two. Benat and his wife overreacted and became completely hysterical. It was. completely uncalled for and over the top!  Other than that, it was an enjoyable stay.

Good points   Convenient location  Easy check in and out  Large space Good communication from the host but didn’t expect to have to be communicating so much .   Points that led for us to a negative experience:  1 - Guests do not have control of the heating - you have to message the host who has to come to the building to alter it. This is extremely inconvenient especially as the weather outside can change quite a bit. We were there in winter.   2- If someone is going to be sleeping in the bed in the lounge it is very noisy. It is a main road with early 5am morning deliveries to the supermarket opposite and bulk bin collections .   3- The apartment lacked basic things for a pleasant stay such as bedside lamps so you had to get out of bed to switch on/off the main overhead lights. In the main bedroom the blind next to the bed doesn’t block out the light so you wake up at dawn. There was no kettle so you need to boil water in saucepans if you want tea.  In the kitchen there was a plug socket literally hanging out the wall with wires exposed. The bedding had large staines- the host said we could have changed this ourselves.   4- The stairs are VERY steep and not that wide so very difficult to get a suitcase up and down.   5 - There was unfortunately an unpleasant smell that was present during all our stay. It did  not originate in the flat but may have come from the deep fried Turkeys that had been cooking downstairs. . Our host brought round a candle and that  slightly helped.   We paid $1000 for 5 nights and that did not represent value for money at all. It was not a relaxing place to stay.   We are air bnb hosts and understand how important feedback is so We did message the host before leaving this feedback and unfortunately his response was defensive.

Nice, small bedroom up several stairs. (No elevator!) 😬 so if you’re like me with a 50 pound suitcase, be careful!  Very clean. Easy check in process. Host was very communicative and friendly.  I’m a solo female traveler, while the block itself this Airbnb sits on was a seemingly safe residential block, the surrounding blocks were a little sketchy at night. I biked on the citibikes, so had to walk a couple blocks each night after I returned the bike to the bike stand. Men congregate on the sidewalks and catcall the women as they walk by… just a heads up to my other solo travelers! I also used uber during my stay to get dropped off on the same block as the Airbnb. I felt safer doing this, but the bikes were more economical.

This is the second time I stayed at Benat's and it was wonderful.  I love how easy it is to check-in and out: no stress whatsoever there.   And even though I didn't see Benat this time, I knew I could reach out if I needed anything, as he really is great at communicating with his guests.  I would definitely recommend his place for anyone visiting NYC.

I think Benat and his family are genuinely nice and kind. Harlem may be a bit dangerous but Benat always made sure I felt safe and gave me tips so I could protect myself. I appreciate your hospitality, responsiveness, and kindness! Thank you! Wish you and your family nothing but the best :)

Very expensive Exorbitant costs which are not described at airbnb apart from the tax then there are other costs Noisy room Very cold Fan which does not adjust correctly A thermometer which does not work Apart from the gentleman at reception who was friendly Exterior not clean in front of the hotel stoners we approach you directly in front of the hotel My bed was not comfortable it sank on one side as if it was broken Little storage for clothes Very expensive lunch, a bottle of water €4, unheard of Elevator too long wait because of floor 41 Smell in the room when cooking downstairs or outside unpleasant In short, never again in this hotel

DO NOT STAY HERE - IF YOU DO, BOOK DIRECTLY THROUGH THE HOTEL NOT AIRBNB. We were told by police that we needed to be careful as we were staying in a “sketchy” area.  We were told we had to pay an additional $34.43 per night which was not made clear on Airbnb. The receptionist said that this was a common occurrence.  We booked with the service ‘breakfast is provided’ - this apparently does not mean that you are provided with breakfast but means that it is available if you book it. We did not see an area to pay for breakfast when booking. When we explained this to the receptionist he just shrugged. After complaining, we were given a token for one breakfast - it was disgusting. No gluten free options - my friend had to have a plate of eggs.  Rooms are small with poor views (we were on floor 11) and could only see into another apartment. The walls and curtain rails had dirty and dust on them. If you dare to stay, make sure you use the key card in the lift - we weren’t told this by staff.
There was a false alarm, we’re in the 34th floor , it was very scary

Place wasnt the worst as far as quick stay places, but far from great. With the Early morning  8am construction directly next to you of the row house style Apartment,to the host accusing me of stealing his low quality towels which i didnt even use on my 2 day stay where i went to a gig and sysyed by friends and bathed there he insisted i took the towel and wanted me to Zelle ot cash app him funds ...Ughhhh NOOOOO you will not scam me today sir So yea beware and plz Dont do anything out of App !!!!

The location of this airbnb is great, although it isn't at the address it says it is. Inside is awesome too although at this price point I'd expect things to be cleaner. Communication with the host also sometimes feels quite suspect. Having said all of the above we still enjoyed our time there!

Going off the reviews I thought this place would be what it was. Upon arrival, I thought the same thing until I saw a roach crawling down the side of her fridge. Then another roach crawling on the cabinet. I ignored it at first...then later in the evening I went back into the kitchen and there were more roaches and other bugs EVERYWHERE. I told her via text about the bugs and she never acknowledged it or did anything about it. I also asked for towels and she told me she was working....I didn’t take a shower until 8:15AM the next morning.   Upon cancelling this place I had to return to the place to get my things...she was very rude to me...yelling and then as I was exiting she told me “get the f*ck out of my apartment”   This is not behavior that should be exhibited. I would NOT refer anyone to stay here. The area is also unsafe.
Don’t go here. She only wants your money that’s why no refunds. She would try to rob/ steal money from you. This girl has a special place in hell.

Decent place to crash for a couple of nights. Easy access to public transportation and less than 25 minutes to just about anywhere you would want to go. We were in town for just a couple of days for our anniversary and the room served its' purpose. The neighborhood appeared rough, but we walked to and from very late at night and never felt unsafe.   The Room: The floor safe needed new batteries, the tub filled up with water quickly as the drain could not keep up and the A/C didn't cover the bathroom. We notified the front desk upon our departure and they said they would pass it along to management. The room is small, but more than sufficient for 2 people. Everything was clean and comfortable. We would stay again if our visit was short or we needed to be in that area.

DO NOT USE THIS HOTEL! They tell you to not worry about the check-in time and can enter whenever you’d like as long as you make it. I paid for 2 night but missed my check-in date due to personal issues and I get called the next from the hotel asking if I’ll be able to make it in. I told them yes I would and they were pleased to hear that. 30 minutes later I get called telling me that I no longer have a room because I never checked in the night prior. To top things off, they never canceled my reservation even tho they told me that I no longer have a reservation with them and are KEEPING my money, refusing a refund for the last day that they told me I wasn’t allowed there due to no reservation. How are you going to refuse a customer service for days that were paid for, then try to keep their reservation active, and keep their money? These people are thieves!!!
Just a very quick walk from the N/W line and always felt safe.  When you book without having been in that neighborhood, it’s a little scary for me... but it was great.  Very pleased with the value!

Our stay with Kathryn was perfect. We landed late at JFK and were afraid that it will be an issue but Kathryn was flexible.  She made us feel welcome, safe and confortable.  The room was spacious and super clean! Bonus point the house is near the metro few minutes walking distance.  We will definetly recommend! Thanks again Kathryn!  We hope to book with you again soon! Maurane and Thibault

The location was the best part of our stay.  There is a speakeasy and restaurant below which helps for getting a quick bite and drink.  The area around the hotel is more commercial and hosts  lot of fast fashion + consumer goods shops.  The bathroom was relatively clean with nice fixtures and features, though the water pressure left much to be desired.  The bathroom had lotion + soap dispensers, and a 3-in-one hair, soap, and conditioner bottle in the shower.  I found hairs on the bed upon arrival which was an unpleasant sight but not a deal-breaker.  Caution: each room has their own configuration, so don't expect to get what you picture (I didn't have a desk in my room, unfortunately).  I stayed in room 206 and the internet was good enough to take video calls.  I felt relatively safe throughout my stay, though the doors are thin and only locked with one deadbolt.  There was a late-night (~4am) altercation in the hallway that felt right outside my door, though it happened on the first floor and throughout the hallways (the person was traveling up and down the floors while screaming and yelling). Would suggest a property manager stay overnight on the premises to help with providing additional safety and well-being for guests.  I would consider staying again if I was in a pinch and was traveling during the weekday when there's less activity.

The location is great. Some things to keep in mind though:  1) I was in a room that was street view. It was extremely difficult for me to sleep at night due to noise at all hours on the street due to a variety of reasons. A) There was always construction going on for about my full stay (almost 3 weeks) that I lived there and this was not mentioned on the Chelsea Inn Airbnb page. I felt that this really impacted my experience and I felt tricked.  B) There seems to be a trailer park or something across the street, so the noise of motors is non stop.  C) At about 12 AM or 1 AM every day without fail there are some trucks that come to take out the trash of the building across the street so you can hear loud metallic clinking and motor sounds. This would wake me up every night. And then by about 8 AM the construction would start.  D) It's right above a speakeasy and so there's always people hanging out on the street.  E) There was ALWAYS a group of people hanging out downstairs playing music, and smoking weed. This was also irritating because they were often loud and inconsiderate of people sleeping above. I also felt unsafe sometimes coming home to a group of guys hanging out downstairs smoking.   I never once was able to get 8 hours of sleep here.   2) If you are planning from WFH DO NOT STAY HERE. The WiFi was sooo unreliable, I got disconnected from work calls several times and had to use my personal hotspot. I often had to go work out of a cafe because the room is so small it's claustrophobic for more than a few hours and then also the unreliable wifi.   3) Some other things: the check in is contactless, and there's often no one on duty directly at the premises. I did not have trouble checking in myself, and thankfully it was smooth for me. However, there was an instance where two people in one night hounded me to tell them the code to get in, and I felt guilty but unsafe letting them know the code. They claimed they lived at the Chelsea Inn but no one had told them the code. I called the receptionist, and overall he was pretty unhelpful and told me "don't worry about it." I was torn between trying to help someone that genuinely lived at the inn or fending for the safety of myself and the inn's other residents.   4) When available, the receptionists were generally quite helpful and nice.   5) The room was super super tiny, but I don't think this is false advertising since it looks pretty small on the Airbnb website too. Overall, I think this place is pretty expensive for what it is - it's quite ghetto.

I don’t usually write reviews but this experience was a first. The house was just as it was in the pictures. It was a beautiful home, however; it was constant noise from construction workers on the lower level on the house. I didn’t get any sleep during my stay. I reached out to the host about the noise and explained to her that I was very tired after my flight and couldn’t sleep because of all the noise. Lisa, my host said she would find out what time they were leaving and get back to me. I never heard from her regarding the issue. Every morning I was woken up by hammering and drilling that lasted all throughout the day. The workers were there from 9am to 9pm! ALL DAY!  On the day I was scheduled to check out, I was asleep and heard someone on the outside of the door punching in the code to get in. I jumped up to see if I was hearing correctly. I walked out of the bedroom and there was a man standing in the living room. I was absolutely terrified! He mumbled something about a rug and left. I called Lisa immediately to tell her what just happened and she casually told me it was just her husband. I explained to her how scary that was and that he should of knocked instead of coming in. We weren’t set to check out for another two hours. He knew we were still there. I told her I was in my underwear when I saw him standing in the living room and she just kept repeating that he only opened the door and didn’t come inside which was not true he was completely inside of the home with the door closed behind him. She really had no empathy for what I had just experienced and I’m still very upset. Had she been apologetic maybe I wouldn’t feel so violated but all she did was make excuses and downplay the whole situation. I thought I found my regular NY Airbnb but I’ll never go back. I didn’t have any peace and I certainly was not safe.
Cute place but the neighbourhood is a little shady and the host plays loud music throughout the day.

Awesome beautiful home! Exactly as shown full layout..Great location..best kept secret for all airline personnel needing rest! Private bath in room I had was full of extra amenities for use. comfortable bed, pillows & air conditioner. Well worth the cost..kitchen space to cook, refrigerator/freezer & so much more! Definitely felt like I had place to myself even with other guest. Sharon goes above & beyond the moment she welcomes you thru door. Unexpectedly I had to extend my time & Sharon just made it happen jus as stress free as I needed   I look forward to returning here & enjoying Tranquil Haven again

Great location. Clean room. Easy check-in. Prompt communication. Lacked a couple essentials though, like a full-sized extra blanket and cream(er) and sugar for the supplied coffee. (We asked, and were directed to a supply closet where we found a thin half-size blanket. We were told cream and sugar would not be provided.) We also encountered excessive noise in the form of a trash truck crew loudly processing a series of construction dumpsters for 20 minutes directly across the street—at 12:15 a.m. We expected to hear cars, voices, the occasional siren at night—it's NYC!—but this was an unpleasant surprise. We know that's beyond the control of the hotel, but it's worth noting as a possibility for future guests as it did diminish our experience.

Location is good, the AC and ceiling fan are the best part about the room. If you're looking for cheap lodging, this will work for you but you might have to deal with the TV turning off while you watch or having to flip the circuit breakers over the course of your stay so the plugs in the room will work. And even that won't help, my last night staying there, all of the plugs died in the room and my phone didn't get charged, making my departure much more stressful than it needed to be.
Great host ! Really clean and convenient. The neighborhood was a little sketchy at first but they made it a great experience!

This was a great location for my first NYC - visit as a solo traveler. The rooms are definitely only comfortable for one guest and were very clean. The only downside is it’s an old building with lots of noises and you can hear every noise outside and inside of surrounding guests. Elaine was  so kind and a wonderful help. She was able to extend my stay when I was in a pinch and my flight was canceled. She responded immediately during a very stressful moment and it was so helpful to know I had a safe place to return to as a solo traveler. Overall good stay in a great location!!

Yvette's place is an amazing place for a solo traveler working from home. The full kitchen, living room space, roomy closet, and open bathroom was super nice. I thought the designated workspace was super helpful during my stay.  As a young woman, there were times I felt unsafe traveling/walking to the subway stations when it got dark. Be advised, it's much more worth it to take an Uber out when you leave the place when it's dark out. Not as close to subway stations as other places I've stayed at (12-15 min walk to the A/C), but the B52/B46 line was right around the corner, which I thought was super convenient. Although it was kinda hard to get around at times, it fit what I was looking for--studio with full kitchen just in case I wanted to cook during my long-term stay.  Air conditioning unit is right by the bed and can be loud, so if you're a light sleeper, be advised!  Had to doordash my own body wash here which I thought was a little odd. Also doordashed my own toothpaste (makes sense), so beware! Although there's shampoo and conditioner if you want it, no body wash.  Towel rack is right by the toilet, also though the design was poor in this aspect, much better to put it against the wall by the shower.  Coffee shops are about a ten minute walk out.  While Yvette is not in the unit to assist directly, she was super prompt in responding to all my messages so I never felt left out in the dark. Great recommendations when asked as well.  Overall a great stay, although a little pricey for the location.

Chelsea Inn is beautiful for what it is and what it provides, however I have noticed unsafe behavior in this hotel. One day when I extended my check in- check out date, the room service lady knocked on my door and asked if I wanted any room service. I declined and went about my day inside this apartment/hotel. An hour later, I hear my door unlock and see the room service lady try to come in. Once she see’s the deadbolt lock is turned inwards(preventing her from coming in) she then apologizes as if she wanted to clean. Then after sleeping for a little over 2 hours,  she repeats the same thing and I wake up and get immediately freaked out and disgusted. I complain to Chelsea Inn through inbox and didn’t recieve a reply until I contacted Airbnb itself about the issue. (They did compensate, but not much for the issues we had) When contacting Chelsea around 3pm when the issue happened, I never got a response but the heat randomly turned on (that same night)and made my girlfriend and I, extremely uncomfortable, even after changing the Ac controls. Mind you, we stayed there, 2nights before and the heat wasn’t an issue. However I can not discredit the stay, it is beautiful and cozy, and clean. However there is NO stairs, each flight is pretty lengthy. Good luck, lol.

Located btwn Chelsea and Union Square- I cant stress HOW PERFECT the location is- and for such an affordable price! The rooms have exposed brick and have that “true NY” feel- even the tiny aspect of the rooms makes it feel like a real NY apt. Will recommend this space to all my friends!

We booked this home the first week in Nov. 2019, it was paid in full on time. Less than 48 hours from check in time I get a text from Sam stating that there had been a flood in the home. She was trying to make accommodations for us because it was last minute. I get a message from Sam 24 hours before our trip stating we would be staying in a 2 bedroom 2 bath townhome our first night and we could go to the original home we booked that Friday. ( it’s 9 adult women) Inconvenienced yes but we wasn’t gonna let it ruin our trip. We arrive at the town home and we were packed in there like sardines in a can. Two ladies slept on the floor, 2 on couches! So Friday morning I call Sam. She advises me that we need to be out of that townhome by noon and we could go to the original home we booked that evening at 7pm. So Sam wanted us to be homeless for 7 hours in New York, it was raining and it was cold...we from GA/FL so you know we were freezing! Mind you Sam has been paid in FULL and wanted us to be homeless for a whole 7 hours. Just walking around NYC with luggage. This is where all the understanding that I had been having went completely out the window. I advised Sam that this was unacceptable, and she was very unprofessional. We talked and she was apologetic and finally admitted that another family was staying in the original home we booked. She stated that they would be out around noon and she needed until 7pm to get the home cleaned. That is when I advised Sam we would be out the townhome as she requested by noon, and we would be contacting AIRBNB for a full refund! By the grace of God we found a very nice Hotel and us 9 ladies made that our new home for the next 3 days. I’ve booked with AIRBNB at least 7 times and never had an issue. I do want to give a big kudos to AIRBNB for issuing me and my party a refund for the home. It killed me to give this horrible review but I had to tell the truth and possibly save someone from booking with Sam.  Our trip was booked from March 5-8.

I absolutely loved the staff that handled my check-in. They were very friendly, polite, and gave me everything I needed. Unfortunately, I didn't love the room as much. The room smelled of weed and cigarette smoke (maybe from the people next door? or maybe from previous guests) and it was hard to get the smell out. Additionally, the bathtub was not very clean, and I found a few hairs as well as some black spots in the tub. Normally this wouldn't bother me very much, but add that to the extremely suspicious shampoo and body wash that they had....I wasn't happy. When I took my shower, I pumped some shampoo into my hand and there was something in the shampoo (and the body wash) that was NOT shampoo. It was red and icky whereas the shampoo/body wash was white and clear. Thankfully the conditioner didn't have the same substance in it, and I had brought my own shampoo just in case I had needed it. All in all - this hotel does its job of providing a place to rest your head, but in terms of providing excellence? Maybe book a different place.

I only stayed overnight, got there late and left early, a bit unpleasant to have the housekeeping coming 3 time to clean the room before checking out and waking us up the first time by entering the room, also some extra charges that weren't included in the airbnb total, location is perfect, room/ bathroom was clean and location was good so that's enough.

Decent location, but not worth the price after fees charged (there was an extra $160 of charges after the room fee paid here on Airbnb). No ice machine. Front desk people are not friendly and unpleasant.

A disaster that can ruin your vacation. Rooms more than dirty. You can't believe that in times of Covid they don't take the minimum care, we arrived at the room they gave us and the trash can was with the waste of previous guests and the floor with dirty swabs. We complained at reception and they changed our room, which this time we found with hair in the bathtub, a shame. It is not understood that the Government of New York, in the middle of a pandemic, allows them to work under these conditions. If you want to take a good shower, forget it, the water barely comes out. The beds seem elastic, the mattresses all sagging, you fall to the sides. When you see the rug you won't want to walk barefoot, I assure you. The attention of the people who work at reception is simply unpleasant. To make matters worse, in addition to what you are already going to pay for Airbnb, they are going to charge you another U$60 per day, no one tells you beforehand, so have the money ready. The location is good, yes, but don't be fooled, do yourself a favor and don't even think about booking at this hotel, then don't say that I didn't warn you. I have traveled for years stopping at places on Airbnb and never had a bad experience, this one was disastrous.

DO NOT BOOK THIS HOTEL ON Airbnb!! If you call the hotel directly the rates are A LOT cheaper. Please read this review prior to booking. This was my first time in NYC I was trying to get a really nice place. My  cousin and aunt were staying with me. My aunt is currently a Cancer patient and I was trying to do something nice for her in the city. The add on Airbnb was mis leading. The room isn’t as nice, the view from the window is anything like the picture in the add! One of the cabinets in the room wasn’t working properly. The room smelled like mold. These are just a few reasons not to book this room.   Whoever the host is for this add posted the price for $666 a night. I stayed two nights and paid around $1300. Anticipating to stay in a VERY nice place for that price. When I called the hotel to confirm my reservation the day prior to checking in, the hotel told me the rates for the nights I’m staying are $281... Airbnb charged me $666!! That’s a HUGE up charge!   On the Airbnb add is says the host is Park central hotel. Once I found out how much they were ripping me off I tried to contact the host to cancel the reservation, no one would respond to messages and when you would call the number on the add, no one would answer! Finally I sat down and let the phone ring for 25 minutes, someone picked up and said they’re a travel agency in MEXICO!! They advised me if I had any discrepancy I had to call Airbnb, I call Airbnb and they tell me I need to contact the host! I call the hotel for help but they can’t help me and tell me to contact Airbnb.. I’ve made soooo many attempts for assistance from the host in MEXICO! And have received none!This is definitely a scam! Plus when I checked out of the hotel they charged me an additional $262.50 due to fees and taxes. This was not disclosed as additional fees on the Airbnb add! This was a total rip off and a scam. Please don’t make the same mistake I did.. contact this hotel directly to book if you want to stay there.

What a fabulous time my guests and family had! This party venue is the most unique in Manhattan. It's spacious, private, has great seating and lighting and it's just perfect.   The cute bar counter with all the amenities makes it so convenient.   All we needed was to bring our food and drinks and everything else is perfect.   I celebrated my bithday with family and friends ( 26 in total) and to get this location under the stairs in the city... with the beautiful landscaping and lights .. is quite a steal and something very special.   The staff help with questions and are always around to help if you need.   We have our food and drinks delivered and there are many restaurants close by.

We stayed at Sam’s place to have an intimate wedding celebration with friends and family. The house was very comfortable and roomy for a party of eleven people having a bathroom for every bedroom. Walking distance to grocery stores, drug stores and Starbucks. It was very convenient to be able to regulate the temperature for every floor in the house. Sam was an amazing and gracious host replying very quickly to our questions. Definitely recommend it to anyone needing a big place to stay in NYC.
It is close to the ideal metro to visit New York all day and come to rest. Lively but not dangerous quartiee

House was clean as described. Very close to grocery store, drug store and coffee shop. These were all within walking distance. Our group felt safe in the area. We had a good stay and Sam was very communicative. Home is not as new as pictured but still very nice.
Small rooms and the people that work in the office are a little suspicious.

We were in town for me to run the NYC marathon, and this was the perfect place for us! The townhouse is absolutely incredible, and on a nice, quiet street. You never know in a NYC place how big it will be, but this is legitimately spacious, clean, open and very well maintained. The photos don’t even do it justice!  Sam was always accessible and followed up several times to make sure we had everything we needed. The kitchen is a dream, with modern appliances, a huge fridge and a big pantry. We have little kids and this allowed us to make several meals in the townhouse, plus Red Rooster is a short walk away for amazing soul food. The washer dryer was a plus for a family as well. So many sleeping spaces and the backyard was wonderful! Parking garage a half a block away if you’re driving, and Ubers are plentiful. There’s a drug store half a block away, a bodega on the corner, and a liquor store a 5 min walk away. We’d love to stay again!

Host is a scammer. She canceled my stay as soon as I booked it, then tried to get me to cancel the booking and claimed that she would send my money back so that I’d cancel it and she’d really get to keep the money, then she stopped responding to me as soon as she saw I wasn’t falling for it.

The place is in a perfect location. Close to the subway, grocery store, drug store, and restaurants. We loved the open concept of this 3-story place. Very easy check in/check out procedures.  If you stay, know that you may need to stock up on various essentials. It is very minimal. We needed to purchase bath soap, shampoo, salt/pepper, etc. Also, there are two TVs, but they are both located on the ground/1st floor (one in a sitting area; the other in the bedroom in that floor).

The good:  - walking distance to all the Chelsea area has to offer - a place to sleep  The bad: - crappy art - moldy shower head  - terrible communication  - noisy  - rude staff - broken furniture  - no early check in flexibility  - no hold for any bags after checkout  - staff on-site situation sketchy (they’re there sometimes, not others, and no communication of when these times might be)  It’s a place to stay, and expensive for what it is.  This is coming from someone who is used to staying in a true ‘Airbnb’ with a lovely host etc - if you just need a box to sleep in in the area on the (not really) cheap, it’ll do.  Could definitely do better and I most likely would not book here again.

very nice, neighborhood is quiet to walk. I didn't feel unsafe near the house. At train stations you have to be careful after 10pm. It has stairs at the entrance and to go to the room.  Car parking is complicated. the train is 12 minutes away. There is a boulevard under the train with many clothing stores, barber shops, etc. It's close to Manhattan.

Not sure how to write this. The hotel was fine but I had a problem.   The good: nice location, easy check-in/check-out.  The bad: it’s not exactly a hotel; there’s no one on hand when you need it.   I had a small bug infestation or something (these little fruit fly looking things, about 20 or so of them in my bathroom). When I told the hotel about it, early at 7am, they told me they’d send someone at around 9am. Which is…weird? Maybe I’m not used to this but if there’s a ton of bugs in someone’s room it probably requires immediate assistance?   Anyways. They came, cleaned it I guess (I wasn’t there because I needed to explore). I came back at night and there were still a few bugs but not as many. I wanted to shower but decided to wait too the next morning, I had an early wake-up though. My mistake for doing that. I woke up with a whole other infestation!!! I was so livid. At this point though, knowing they’re only going to come at 9 am (because why would a hotel have people on board for these issues) I left, without showering.   When I came back again that night, I was so scared of even entering the bathroom because I was worried that there would be even more bugs. I could not shower then either, and I came back after 10 so I knew I wouldn’t get the immediate help I needed.   There were so many bugs in the bathroom (probably like 40 at that point) that some even came out to my room. I tried to kill some but I hate bugs and just everything. I do have videos and pictures for further proof.   Luckily it was my last night. I slept with all my clothes on, covered my face and freaked out the whole night. The morning, I again avoided my shower (I haven’t showered in 3 days and I shower daily). I checked out, peaced out and vowed to never again in my life stay here.  Also no elevator is either good or bad depending on your perspective: I almost died each time going up 5 flights of stairs, especially the first time with my luggage. But so many calories burnt so at least one thing that was enjoyable.   So yeah, never again. I hope you fix this problem Chelsea Inn and not have others live through this nightmare I did.

Context matters so much for these reviews so I’ll start there: We used this place for a staff retreat. 4 of us gathering from around the world. This meant we used the space quite a bit for cooking, eating, working.  AWESOME: tons of space which is hard to find in NYC. Amount of bathrooms and levels made it comfortable for people to spread out and we had room to work. Great wifi. Super responsive host. Very clean. Location was great for us - grocery store, gym, drug store and restaurants right there. Easy to get to the subway - 25 mins to midtown.  MEH: definitely a corporate-run, ikea-furniture, bare-bones place. Again, nothing wrong with that depending on your tastes. Missing key things for cooking that I expected (basics like salt, pepper, coffee filters, etc), no dishwashing soap. Nice individual wash cloths in every bathroom but no soap or shampoo. No instructions on how to use the stove or other basics.

Situated in brooklyn, walking distance to subway and stores. Amazing part of brooklyn don’t be put off by the sketchy feel it’s safe It’s brooklyn! Pace university a few blocks away has an amazing garden to walk through with great sculptors. Food is anything and everything you could want just a short walk in any direction.   As the apartment it’s charming, clean, elegant and just perfect for our short trip.

This was my second stay at the Chelsea Inn because I had a nice experience last time and the location is convenient. We were placed in the first room when entering the building where the main radiator is also located. The radiator was visibly having trouble and caused us a restless night the first night, so we asked for it to be fixed so we could sleep easier the following night. However, it only got worse and became very unsafe with boiling water spewing out into our bed and making very loud noise. Management was very quick to respond and put us in a new room, however we were fully unpacked already so we had to re-pack and haul all of our belongings up to the 5th floor. Very steep stairs and no elevator. Quite an inconvenience, but better than getting burned by the radiator. I’m still awaiting a response from management about a discount for our stay. 4/5 stars this time.

It was nice renting an entire NYC apartment for just $38/night. But, it had a gas leak. And I woke up the first day with a headache. I suspect the two are connected.  Hopefully it will be fixed by the time you read this review. But if you smell gas in the apartment, please take precautions, particularly making sure tbe bedroom gets plenty of fresh air. "A trickle" of fresh air didn't help in my case. You don't want to get sick.  Once the gas leak is fixed this will be a charming stay in a prime location.

Great location, really problematic place - requires a lot of owner's attention (currently the window is dangerous, reported to owner and Airbnb support).  The heating system is really noisy and gets turned at night (12 AM and 5 AM) for 1hr and makes sauna from the room.  The room is smaller than you can expect from the photos,  recommend for 1 traveler only. The bathroom displayed on pictures is designed for other rooms, for this room is designed other bathroom, smaller and in worse condition.

Trevor was very good at communicating especially on how exactly to get there. The listing is what is advertised and a steal for the price and location. The location is nice, there's a grocery store in walking distance and it's a good change of pace if you've been in Times Square all day. If you're  adventurous and looking for a one night stay I'd say this is the perfect Airbnb.
Clean. Top of the line equipment. Stress free environment. That's all you need.
Honestly I don’t recommend this hotel for anyone this is a scam with the tax fees that was never mentioned the front desk never wanted to help much

THE ALLEN TRIED TO SCAM ME — Be careful! The receptionist tried to charge me extra when I arrived for “service fees” that did not exist. I spoke to Airbnb directly who confirmed the charges were false. I was able to convince the Allen to refund a portion of my money but Airbnb was forced to foot the bill for the rest. I ultimately received my money back but was treated poorly when I asked to see itemized charges or terms of conditions which the Allen could not produce.

When checking in, I did not bring cash, I gave my credit card to pay the deposit and taxes and they ended up charging me double for the accommodation.  They ignored that I had already paid through the Airbnb platform at the time of making the reservation.  This generates disappointment and misunderstandings for you. It makes you insecure and you may even feel cheated.  I still don't know if they are going to give me my money back and there is no one to answer.

Way too far from the city and the subway is not that good in that part of New York. The neighborhood is not that nice and can be dangerous (according to the comments we received from other people living in the area) We left the house before and found another spot for the last night we pay. There are too many don'ts in that place that is overwhelming and there are no supplies in the kitchen.
Great location, and spacious space. Just as described. The only stress point for me was they did not want guests congregating or waiting in front of the property.

Horrible experience everything was filthy the sink was clogged Henry wanted me to be his personal plumber. Filthy pots and pans put away.  the neighborhood is full of crackheads drug addicts worst Airbnb experience it was a section 8 building . I feel played for my stay. The first day ppl grilled me outside. The second incident was a violent crime over a parking spot ... When I tried to leave Henry did not want to refund me for this false advertisement. I cannot believe a super host delivered this unbelievably poor listing . Henry was so hungry for the month stay money . It was a last minute booking which he failed to provide a proper working listing. If I was aware ahead of time the apartment wasn’t ready I would’ve booked else where .

The worst experience at this place. Zero communication and zero responsibility. These people simply do not care about your time or money. The woman at the front desk is rude and has a attitude people. She was very aggressive and I felt attacked. Furthermore, you will get MUCH better at other places. PLEASE DO NOT DO BUSINESS WITH THESE PEOPLE.

I totally enjoyed my stay at paper factory. There hallways are filled with original artwork my room was huge with high ceilings, big windows and a comfortable bed . A Friendly, genuine,  easy going staff. Don’t be afraid to ask for the things you need;  they are happy to bring them to your room. The glass tile shower is a stand out! Also Astoria is a very short walk or inexpensive Uber away with tons of restaurants and shopping.
comfortable rooms. my only issue was that the heater was on when it was still warm outside and it is located in a sketchy part of town.

Creepy. Stayed with my partner for the holidays and everything was fine until she left the room to get snacks and next thing you know a random man starts following her to our room, he stayed outside our door for a bit till eventually he was out of sight.. to then call the front desk and they were very nonchalant about it .. security EVENTUALLY showed up but what was the point ? Later on in the night someone who supposedly worked at the hotel came to drop off a single towel in a plastic bag? To the point we stayed quiet to wait for him to leave and he was looking through his keys to open our door.. I eventually cracked the door open and he said we had called for towels? We never did .. let alone late in the night. We barricaded the door with the wooden desk in the room cause we did not feel safe falling asleep! It was our last night there.  Won’t ever stay there again or recommend this place again.

Our group of four enjoyed our stay at this beautiful home. The location is very convenient - walkable to major subway stops and to shops and restaurants, and Ubers were never more than 4-5 minutes away.  The space itself is lofty and bright is huge for NYC. It's decorated in a modern minimalist style, but has all the amenities. The kitchen is well kitted out, and the backyard is a great place to hang out - it feels like a shady, leafy oasis in the city.  The hosts are very helpful and responsive. They left us a nice note and a bottle of wine, which was so kind. Thank you for welcoming us into your home!  A couple of things to note for future guests - there are two cats who are very friendly and no trouble at all. There are a lot of stairs, which is great for getting your steps in but may be difficult for anyone with any mobility challenges.

Good place to stay in New York City. We didn't feel unsafe in South Bronx. Good connection to Manhattan (D or 4 trains from Yankee Stadium and then BX6 bus or 2,4,5 to Grand Concourse and then BX41 bus). We can recommend this basement apartment to other travellers. The host is very kind and responding quickly to messages.
It was good, pretty clean, as described. He responds quickly and provides good information about the area and how to get around. Parking was a little stressful but that’s NY it was safe though.

Andre was very nice, he kept contact with us and provided clear instructions. When we arrived to the airbnb we had issues with the gate, it was difficult to open. We did not know about issues with the gate prior to our stay. The gate had to be opened in a certain way which was not disclosed to us, so we were left to fiddle with it to figure it out. We had multiple issues with the gate which was not safe for when we came back late at night. The gate caused us to leave the airbnb early because we felt unsafe. As you step into the front door you are immediately greeted with a narrow and steep stairwell (initial entrance is not pictured. We traveled down the stairs and the basement was fine, clean and spacious. The bathroom is nice with hot water and the bed is very comfortable. The place was very clean. Another issue was the noise from the people upstairs. Running around, stomping, yelling, babies crying, etc could be heard. A quick note is that ubers will be about $50 into the city.

It is a very, very small space.  Comfortable for two, but Loft Bedroom 3 does not afford much privacy at all.  The door does not close fully due to the slanted ceilings, so other guests would be able to look into your room at any given time.  The stairs are also directly outside the door, which could be dangerous.  Due to the size of the mattress (incredibly comfortable and a king bed!), there isn't any walking or floor space.  You basically jump straight from the doorway onto the bed.  The door also does not open fully because it swings into the mattress given the tiny size of the room.  David is incredible at communicating, and getting into the house was very straight forward.

They are really nice hosts and answered to my messages immediately. There is a cute little dog. We enjoyed cooking on our own in the kitchen and there is a TV in the room you can access Netflix, Hulu, etc. You can feel unsafe to walk around at midnight, but there is a subway station really close (5 mins walk). It was a very nice place to stay. Thank you for being amazing hosts!

The place was clean, but after a few weeks I noticed some disturbing things: 1. Roaches in the kitchen & bathroom. 2. A terrible leak in the kitchen ceiling that flooded the kitchen floor when it rained hard outside.  3. The building is absolutely filthy. There was even homeless people sleeping in the lobby on a nightly basis.  4. The neighborhood is disgusting, not to mention dangerous. One morning I was awakened by gunshots in front of the building, and cops flooded the block making it hard to walk down the street.  5. The hosts were terrible and communicating ALL of their rules, before checking in, Which prevented me from extending my stay and caused a great inconvenience. 6. There also was no hot water in the bathroom on several occasions. Many times I was forced to take a cold shower in the middle of winter.

This is an AMAZING value for anyone looking to explore NYC on a budget. Marco and Jorge were great hosts! The listing/pictures are very accurate but what they don't show is HOW CUTE the rest of the apartment is! Upon entering your walkway is illuminated at your feet with automatic lights, the living room is modern and chic with art and color, featuring an adorable cow painting. It actually gives you the feeling of being the guest in someone's home rather than just a stranger renting a space. The room was clean and organized when I arrived as if it was photoshoot day for the listing. The AC is strong and cold, although if you're sensitive to light I'd bring an eyemask. The windows get a lot of sun in the morning and with the curtain on the right of the bed you choose either blocking the sun or the AC.   The area really isn't bad at all. The Bronx definitely has a reputation for being more scary/dangerous but it felt like every other borough I've stayed at in this price point. It's a block to the train station, and the nice thing about the commute out of the Bronx via the 4 train is it's above ground for quite a bit so you can stay entertained on your phone or search for your next food/drink. Plenty of amenities around, convenience stores, fast food, smoke shops etc for all of your odd hour needs. If you're looking for well rated food/drinks I found the biggest clusters in Bronx Little Italy by bus and near the river south of Yankee stadium. Also while commuting into the city it's a great time to check out east Harlem!

Awesome place to stay! Perfectly close to the bus station and subway station seriously like 2 minutes away! My sister and I traveled to New York and it was our first time there. We were worried about staying in a rough or sketchy neighborhood because we did not know New York very well. We felt safe the whole time! A flat screen with Netflix was in the room which was awesome! Host was also willing to help us if we needed which was great! We read the reviews and this place was everything the reviews said! Totally would stay here again!

I cant stress enough how great my stay was with Dakota. It truly felt like home. Also, there was a great restaurant/bar downstairs and I love that she doesn't require a laundry list of chores when you check out.  Five stars on every level. If you treat the space with the same cleanliness and care that you treat your own home, it'll be the best stay

I must say we were disappointed with our stay at this place.  My wife, our 8 year old son and I visited NYC the fist time and we all were beyond excited about our trip. We spent hours looking for the best match for our needs to stay, not much but a great location, safe and quiet neighborhood, clean flat with minimalist kitchen for our basic needs.  First of all, we've arrived with the understanding that this place was small but surprised to see that how much everything was old and dirty. The building's trash was kept in side the main front entry where you can not only smell it but also witnessed the pest problems around it! The location of the building was very good, but neighborhood was very noisy. There was a construction next door which started around 7:00 am every morning. While the host was responsive and helpful with all our questions prior to our check in but failed mention that there was NO elevator in the building. We had to carry our luggage to 4th floor. This should have been included in the add.  The carpet in the living room looked old and dirty, bathroom ceiling has some type of suspicious stains, shower water took several minutes to heat up. But, the biggest problem hit us on the 3rd night when we lost the power in the flat and had to check in to a hotel after very long day in town. The host was trying to be helpful and arranged a hotel, the whole situation was a mess.  We were very tired, but had to pack again and moved to a hotel in the middle of the night with a eight year old. On top of everything, we were surprised to see the extra $45 on the bill during the check out from the hotel! I must say the whole experience left a bitter taste in our mouth. It was our first experience with Airbnb, but, unfortunately a disappointing one!

Amazing location - you really are within walking distance  (say 20 mins) to a lot of places (Flatiron, Madison Square Garden, Union Square, Macy's) with a drug store around the corner for all the essentials. The subway stop for the 6 train is also really close. I walked back on my own at night a few times and felt very safe.  For the apartment itself - a decent size and would be large enough for two people without stepping on each other. Most importantly, the bed is super comfortable and the skylight over the bed is a lovely natural wake up! The 3 flights of stairs are quite steep, so as long as you are prepared for that it is all good.   Check in was also super painless - which is what you need after 20+ hours flying time!

We enjoyed our time here and loved the neighbourhood. Unfortunately the inability to control the heat was a deal breaker for me. I woke up every night in a pool of sweat even with the air conditioning on. I know it’s part of the New York charm and out of Jey’s control, but it was unpleasant and really impacted our comfort levels.
A steal for NYC! Located in a nice and safe area, would totally stay there again! Rhoda was so nice and helpful!

The house is classic american brick house,  it is very clean house, cleanliness floor, we appreciate very much to walk barefoot. It is not easy to use downstairs room because it is "scary". Anyway we enjoyed our stay very much. The airbnb does not mark the correct address. The house is NOT by DeWitt Clinton park as it is shown on airbnb map. But it is situated on the opposite site of Hudson river in West NY. Anyway using the bus right on the corner of the street is very easy, quick and cheap. It goes ever 5-10 minutes and cost USD 3,50 per person. The buses run all the day/night. Just ask driver to be sure "Boulevard east". That is all easy.  If you are reconciled to the fact that the house is not in Manhattan, then this is not a bad choice to stay in. If we return sometimes, we would propably stay here again.

The apartment exceeded our expectations and Joanna was quick to respond to every message! The place was clean and very comfortable. It's a really great ground floor apartment very close to the G and pretty close to the C, so it was very easy to get around. There is a family living above this apartment, so you will hear people walking around, but that's life - not much can be done about it and it didn't lead us to have a less than fantastic experience. Would definitely stay here again! The entire stay was stress-free. Thanks so much Joanna!

Adonis welcomed me warmly and showed me her basement then immediately drove me a few blocks to get take out and waited while I went to drug store. When I returned I hit my head on the ceiling of the short staircase! She warned me but I managed every time...! She invited me to her church with her which was so nice! I have an evening flight so wanted to check out late and she was very accommodating. I left the key inside and locked the door as she requested. All in all it was satisfactory!

First I just want to say HORRIBLE HORRIBLE DISGUSTING PLACE. #1. Can barely get in and out the exit. God forbid if there was a fire you might not make it out alive in Serious! #2. Walking up and down the stair you have to bend way down so you dont hit your head! HUGE FIRE HAZARD!!!! #3. In the pictures it doesnt show the FULL basement. The boiler is in the middle of the floor EXPOSED NEXT TO THE 2 CHILDREN'S TWIN BEDS! #4. The heat doesnt stay on. We texted the host MANY TIMES FOR HEAT and she ignored us MANY times or we waited a few hours for the heat to be put back on! It was literally below 30 degrees outside and we slept in our clothes under cheap thin dirty blankets. We asked for warmer blankets which we NEVER received as PROMISED! NO INSULATION IN THE BASEMENT ALL CEMENT which makes it even COLDER! #5. When the water in being used upstairs a loud frightening sound comes from the boiler for about 60 seconds. Imagine having to wake up to that 3/4 am???? #6. The BEDS are CHILDREN TWIN BEDS VERY UNCOMFORTABLE! We had to put the beds together to have more space to sleep which was a nightmare and unfortunate being my partner had Spine surgery and my Rotator cuff surgery recently. We are still suffering from the pain due to that but that is another issue that will be dealt with! #7. I went to make coffee and inside was old molded hard coffee it was DISGUSTING! #8. I had to light scented candles and buy Febreze because of the dusty dirty basement smell! It was COMPLETELY DISGUSTING AND DIRTY.
