WARNING.....WHEN SLEEPING COVER YOUR FACE CAUSE I WAS LITERALLY CHOKING OFF OF DUST!  I had to remove my child from this place because of the conditions and take her to stay with family. My daughter was MISERABLE! We requested a partial refund which the host refused but was accommodated for my troubles and I reported these unsafe conditions to NYC Housing Preservation. ROBBERY ROBBERY dont be fooled by the "Christian" PLEASE!
Joanna’s place was a great location/well set up for our stay in Brooklyn. She’s a great host who made or stay very easy, stress-free.

The location is great- close to a great bakery, many restaurants, grocery stores and the subway. The host is very responsive. The price is reasonable and there really are not any acceptable hotels in the area. The room was clean and the common areas were pretty clean. Sharing common areas with multiple people makes some things suspect so I bought some flip flops for the shower. The area is great for young people and the neighbors enjoy loud music mostly stopping at 10ish but one Friday night it was closer to 4am when a party ended. All that said I think it is a good value and under similar circumstances would stay there again.
I appreciated the how clean the apartment was and how fast the host communicated with us. The area was a little sketchy but I felt all NYC was sketchy.

Staying at Jo and Bri’s place was one the highlights from our trip! It was exactly like the photos, very modern, roomy, and clean. Many convenient amenities include the 1.5 bathrooms, washer/dryer, numerous household items available for use, and short subway commute. One of the main factors I look at when booking an Airbnb is safety, especially at night. When commuting from the subway station, I never once felt unsafe! They live in a quiet, lovely neighborhood, with restaurants and small shops right down the street. We bumped into the both of them a few times throughout our stay and they both were very welcoming and made sure our stay was up to par. They even allowed us to check in early. This experience is exactly the reason why I prefer staying here over a hotel! Will definitely recommend Jo and Bri’s place to anyone who’s looking to visit!!

Exactly as advertised. Very comfortable, spacious apartment. Walking distance to deli/coffee/grocery shopping. Easy parking and access to subway. Highly recommend if you are looking for comfort, safety and stress-free environment.

Chris's apartment is absolutely fantastic! Fully equipped with everything you could need and in a superb location close to everything you could need. On top of that Chris made getting the keys effortless so arrival was the completely stress-free. If you're sick of AirBNB's that are missing something crucial or just not a good experience then I highly recommend staying at Chris's.

Mayra's place was just what we needed for a getaway in NYC. The studio is super close to public transportation and to a lot of small restaurants and diners. The area is very safe, we were two young women and we never felt unsafe walking at night from the bus or metro stop to the studio.  She is great at communicating and was very attentive to our needs. The studio was clean and organized. She was flexible with our check in time so we could get the most out of our trip. Mayra and her family were great hosts and we would stay again there in a heartbeat. Super recommended!
Rob’s place is in a perfect location accessible to EVERYTHING, which made our stay more enjoyable! Rob ensured we had what we needed for our stay and was communicative throughout. Thank you Rob!
Very nice flat, clean and very convenient location. Rob was nice enough to let me late check-out. I very much recommend this flat.

I booked a reservation for an “entire apartment” and unfortunately I arrived to find that I was actually in a basement. I wasn’t expecting this so I headed upstairs where I assumed there may be an actual bedroom I was shocked to find that I was entering into a home. I was completely surprised. I arrived late for check in so it was very quiet my first night but the following day I could hear footsteps, voices, and children. That was when I was certain that I was in someone’s basement. This was not at all what I intended on purchasing I paid for an entire apartment not a basement. I felt very uncomfortable. I was reluctant to make noise during my visit because I felt like I would be heard. This is the most unpleasant experience I have ever had using Airbnb and for this price I would have just stayed at a hotel instead.

Sumitra’s apartment was absolutely fantastic, with excellent amenities and a wonderfully stylish interior. The location/area left a little to be desired - my partner and I felt a little unsafe at times - however that is in no way a reflection of the apartment itself, which was clean and excellent.   Sumitra was a great host, answering all our questions promptly and efficiently and I would definitely recommend this apartment.

Great studio in a quiet part of manhattan. Very close to subway stops that make getting around easy! Also very close walk to the main tourist spots (GCT about 15 min).  Apartment was as described in the listing. Easy to find. Rob was very attentive and helpful during my stay.  Bed was comfortable!  Recommended!
Very central & convenient and good coordination. Unfortunately the radiator didnt work and it was a rather cold inside but I am certain Rob will address it soon.
Rob's apartment is centrally located to all the best New York has to offer. He is a great host, too. Thanks for a great stay!

Spacious, clean apartment in a convenient location. Easy self check-in/out and good communication before and after my arrival to make sure everything was in order. Would certainly recommend Rob's place to friends.  Thanks!

I had a great stay here! It was close to transit and some main sites. The room was nice and cozy and looked exactly as advertised. Rob was also really great when it came to replying to messages and provided clear instructions for check in and out.

Rob was a great host! The space was as described and in a good neighborhood. Easy walk to the subway, and awesome food, grocery, and amenities close by. I highly recommend this for a single traveler or cozy couple. 😃

Perfect midtown apt. for visiting NYC and experiencing it like a local. It’s a nice spacious loft, & Rob has thoughtfully made sure to include everything you will need. The bed & air mattress were comfortable & the linens were soft. What an incredibly pretty view this spring from the fire escape!  It’s also located in an area with tons of restaurants within a short walk.
Good location, very easy to check in and out. Comfortable bed. Good water pressure in shower. Rob was very communicative.

Rob was very quick to respond and very accommodating with my hectic travel schedule. His studio is in a perfect location walking distance to great restaurants, cool rooftop bars, and subway transportation. My first time in New York and after staying here, will not be my last!

This spot is really a superhost! The stay was very clean, quiet and everything you need is available to you. Very spacious and the bed is super comfortable and you’ll sleep like a baby. The interior design of the room is beautifully done. Plus the price per night was a steal indeed! It’s only con is check in is after 6pm and check out is at 10am. For a late check in, check out should be late too. Overall I enjoyed my stay and would absolutely recommend this place to others!

Sarah’s place is awesome. Super closed to everything (or at least subway station).  She’s also very responsible and sweet. Gave me helpful tips to get around. The bed is pretty large for one person and goo d to cuddle for two;) Their kitties are super cute too:3 Definitely a steal for the location and price!

Robert’s place was very clean just like the pictures posted. Be aware that there’s a TV but no channels. The nearby subway location though was a little sketchy especially at night, but once you get to his apt complex we felt safe. The lock on their door was difficult to unlock. Other than that the stay was pleasant.

I stayed at Robert's flat for a month while in NYC for work. The flat is small, and minimally but tastefully furnished. Very comfortable bed and very fast wifi! Plenty of closet space too. The building and unit are new, so all of the appliances and fixtures are quite nice. Quick walk to 2 express train stops that will take you to either the east or west side of Manhattan, and of course plenty of Uber/Lyft type services come here.  A word about the safety issue that others mentioned: I lived in this area of Harlem for several years before relocating out of NYC, and specifically chose Robert's flat because I know the neighborhood well. In all of the years I lived there, and during the month I stayed this time, I had zero safety issues or ever even felt unsafe. That said, the building is across from public housing projects, and this area of Harlem is not a wealthy neighborhood like Soho or Tribeca. This does not de facto make the neighborhood unsafe, and like I said, as a single female I never had problems. However, if you are totally unfamiliar with NYC and are expecting a more recognized tourist neighborhood, this isn't it.

Review: I had a very comfortable stay at Rob’s place.  The place itself is well-located and well-maintained. Not only was Rob unfailingly courteous, he was very prompt and helpful with every one of my requests.
Great location! Rob is a wonderful host.

Rob's place was great. Check-in was easy and the space was very clean and welcoming. It's in a great location and I had everything I needed. Appliances, wi-fi, AC, etc. all worked well. The apartment looks exactly like it does in the pictures; it's nicely decorated. The bed was incredibly comfortable. I would definitely recommend giving Rob's place a try.

Rob is a great host who replied promptly and courteously to all my messages. The apartment was very comfortable, was very well located, and had everything needed for a great stay. From the amazingly comfortable bed to the superb hot water and water pressure in the shower, everything was great. Thank you!

Rob's Studio is as it is seen in the photos. The location is perfect, it has bars, restaurants and a 24 hs one block away. It is a safe area and we mobilize walking to all the attractions of Midtown. I had to attend a Summit in UN and it was 5 minutes by taxi and 15 minutes walking. The communication with Rob was quick I would go back to this place without hesitation!

Rob's place was IMMACULATE - so very clean, and prepared to receive me very late into the evening. The lock box is a great touch, allowing the guest to get in when needed, without bothering the host. The Google Document he provides is extremely clear and overly communicative - and he is fantastic with response. Would certainly stay there again!
Lovely and clean!  Location was fabulous!  We asked for early check-in and Rob was very obliging and accommodating.  We would definitely stay here again!

Had this trip been just for my husband and I it would have been just fine, But with two kids this wasn’t ideal for us. Rob responds fairly quickly but isn’t nearby for trouble shooting problems. We ended up not finishing our stay here but Rob was pleasant and we resolved everything civilly. I would recommend for individuals or couples but not families. It’s 3rd floor and a small space. But it was pretty clean and well stocked. The area is good, safe and pleasant for walking to food and shopping.

Rob is very quick to respond with hospitable warmth and knowledge of the area. The unit is quite spacious for an efficiency. I was pleasantly surprised by the amount of space. All in all a great location and experience.

The place was absolutely clean and very well equipped!! Ez was communicating very well!  Unfortunately the place is right opposite of the station with a lot of people who Obviously seem to have serious drug issues. That was the only down part. Everything else is absolutely recommendable.

It has been amazing to stay in Ez’s apartment during our 10 days in NYC! The apartment has a perfect location (other writes that there is a lot of homeless people - There is but it is not only near the apartment - It is all over Manhattan). A sweet man is often sitting outside the apartment - His name is Freddie - So kind. We gave the rest of our food and soda to him and he was so happy about that. The apartment smelled so clean when we arrived. We didn’t experienced that much noise from the streets. The apartsment is big and has everything you need on you holiday. The bed is comfy. The aircondition has a bit noise so we turned it off in the night. I would really love to stay here again. You can’t find a better place to stay! Ez was kind and so fast to response to our questions. He also followed up and ask if everything was okay - Big recommandation! Best regards from Louise, Denmark.

2 things that all travelers want is safety and relaxation.  Pros: Great location near the Port Authority  subway and a nice size bathroom. Dresser for storage   Cons: ran out of TP (no spares), no Paper Towels, and the no extra blankets. We were cold. There is NO 2nd bed , but one sleeping place. *The pictures on airbnb are old, it does not look this nice. One bed with a very light sheet and blanket on top. We were cold.  The location is great, but the key situation and feeling safe was just not there. Multiple rooms are being rented out, not just this one apt. Many people have the lock box code.  There once was a door and I think it got unsafe, so they added a cage acround the door. The Asian restaurant is closed and under construction, so it is creepy. The a/c unit allows ALOT of noise in and wind, nothing you can do. The couch in the pics is not there... the pics are not the whole story.  If you are single and traveling alone this might work. I traveled with a child and would not do it again.

HIGHLY recommend this place! Great spot to stay for easy access to NYC. Outside of the apartment was a little sketchy, but most of downtown NYC is- I don't think staying anywhere else would have changed that. Apartment is sparkling clean, has everything you'd need to cook/relax, and the location is ideal for any visitors needs.

When I first pulled up to the Airbnb, it looked a little sketchy. But after going inside and seeing the place, it definitely looks like the photos it was clean and pleasant so dont let the outside fool you! I have no complaints. The noise from outside can get a little crazy but it dod t bother me. EZ was a great host, he was responsive and polite. Thank you for renting us your place.
Very clean and spacious place. The neighborhood is a little sketchy and it’s loud so bring earplugs or use white noise. Convenient to theater district and Times Square.

Sharon and her husband were amazing! Due to the weather leaving us stuck in New York they were able to accommodate the extra time we needed. In addition they are super cool and very nice. When we arrived they walked us through maps and gave us food recommendations. Mostly they made sure we had every thing we needed and were comfortable and as stress free as possible. I would definitely stay again the next time I visit New York.

Not only was Heather a gracious, patient, and helpful host, but her home is simply exquisite. It is stocked with every item you might need (for us, access to a pack and play was exceptionally helpful) and her design choices are just beautiful. We felt like royalty staying in such an incredible location with access to everything Park Slope has to offer, but in the quiet and convenience of our own apartment. Would recommend bringing an eye mask if you are going to stay in the main bedroom--the streetlit views are incredible, but it's a lot of early morning light for country bumpkins like us. The other bedrooms have incredible shades, so they're perfect for little kids who need the blackout shade experience. Also shout out to the fishtank--such fun for our kids to feed the fish, and the most exquisite blue bathroom tile of all time. Better than a hotel. Thank you Heather!
This was a great value for a very clean and stress-free place to stay in Brooklyn. Really nice to be able to walk to the park, and free laundry is great!

Mary has a beautiful and comfortable apartment.The bedroom is large and the private half bath is a real bonus. The location was perfect for us...a quite, shady street with wide sidewalks just steps away from bustling Washington street and a short walk to subways and the Brooklyn Museum. Mary was great to deal with. We plan to return.

In short, it was an okay place to stay, but not worth the amount that we ended up paying. Paid more than $250 for 2 days, but totally not worth $250. Its not a bad Airbnb to stay, but it worth the price.  Positives:  Big enough room considering it is in NY Good interaction with the aunt of the host Okay location (7 minutes walk to the nearby subway station, grocery stores nearby) Independent air-conditioning  Negatives: No water to drink, option was to drink water from the tap in bathroom, so had to buy bottles of water (although she mentioned it was some issue that happened a few days back, still that wasnt notified to me until I asked her about it once I reached there!) WiFi wasn't working well. It kept on disconnecting on phone and laptops. Had a single remote for all the air conditioning! (Which isn't a big issue, but considering the amount that I paid, I expected better) Room door was almost impossible to open. Everytime I opened, I was scared I would break it because it was stuck on top and the wooden door felt very old. The door had glass window which did not give us privacy! And the blinds did not go all the way down too! Around 1/6th part was open! Although I didn't expect anyone to peep into the room, I wasn't comfortable with it. The room had a closet, but again the door was almost impossible to open. I have never seen such a closet. It's tough to even explain here! But again, I stayed there for 2 nights, so I didn't care about it. There is no microwave oven to heat food. So just be vary about that. No body wash, shampoo or conditioner is provided, so you need to carry that with you.  Overall I felt it as an okay place to stay. For a lower rate, I would surely stay there again.

Very beautiful apartment, tastefully decorated and faithful to the photos. It is well located, close to the metro and the Ferry. Unfortunately we were not able to meet Kalina, but we communicated very well via AIRBNB. She was very accommodating, especially the evening of our departure when we missed our flight. I highly recommend this apartment.  Very nice apartment, tastefully decorated and faithful to the photos. It is well located, close to the Metro and the Ferry. Unfortunately we have not been able to meet Kalina, but we have communicated very well via AIRBNB. It was very accommodating especially on the night of our departure when we missed our flight. I strongly recommend this apartment.
My stay was very comfortable and no stress at all! There were no problems and I would recommend this host to anyone!

Asad helped us out in a bind when we were kicked out of Laguardia at night. Unbeknownst to us, they close through the night after the last flight at 11:30 pm. They reopen at 4 am, so if your flight is any later you cant get in before then, and if you're there they'll tell you to leave and go into non-secure areas of the airport, checkin lounge or baggage claim. Staff recommended we sleep in wheel chairs in the departure lounge since checkin and baggage claim don't have any carpet or seating because of homeless people. Thanks to all that's holy, there's airbnb joints right across the street or we'd be sleeping in the checkin lounge next to bums. This house is among others offering Airbnb rentals on a street literally a quarter mile from Terminal D at Laguardia. When it says steps from Laguardia, they're not lyin. You get off the plane, catch the Purple route airport shuttle to the first stop (500 yards) and walk a short distance from there. The room we rented is in a shared space apartment setting. We had our own room but a living room and kitchen and bathroom to share. The house is on a horseshoe street, so there's only local or no traffic at all. Definitely no foot traffic. Outside the house on both side of the street is an overlook park, with benches overlooking Grand Central Parkway, Laguardia airport and NY city skyline in a distance. The bathroom is excellent with bath tub. Even though I prefer to carry my own toiletries, this place was well supplied, name brand everything, you literally don't need to bring anything but your food here. The bedroom had one queen bed, very comfortable with a comforter and memory foam pillows. Had a good night sleep. Nice and quiet. There's a small restaurant called Laguardia cafe, across the street from a Deli/general store a block from here, you can get dinner at the cafe and breakfast/lunch at both places. You can walk to car rental places on 95th Street. On 94th and 23rd Ave you can get a bus (Q33) to Jackson Heights subway terminal a block from there, and R train straight down to South Ferry/Times Square/Manhattan and E or R train back. You can not beat the convenience of this rental. Overall excellent experience. Incredibly quick response. Good luck and god bless Asad.

I had a great stay! Charlie was very helpful. The room was exactly as advertised and the bed was luscious! Charlie checked in on me throughout my stay and made sure the place stayed spotless and clean. I had a layover and it was very close to the airport making it a very convenient and stress free transfer. She provided snacks and coffee which was a nice touch especially because I arrived late at night. I definitely recommend this place and will stay here when I return to New York!

Everything about our experience was amazing! The private bedroom and private bathroom were super clean and well maintained. That bed was amazing - I don't think I've ever slept better! Ashley and Andy were MORE than welcoming and not only did I instantly feel like I'd been friends with them for my whole life but they gave the greatest tips on where to get the best breakfast and lunch, and on shopping and anything else fun to do in the area. They also provided super easy and well detailed instructions on how to take the train to the Javits Center which is where we had to go while we stayed. We were there in the winter so we didn't get to use their ginormous patio but it would be an AMAZING spot in the summer. This place is definitely a steal and a whole package deal - great hosts, great apartment, great area and great price! Cannot beat it.
Rob was an absolutely wonderful host with a great place in the heart of Manhattan. You couldn’t ask for much more and I’d recommend to anyone!  Thanks, Rob!

Good location between UN & Times Square with all required shops around like CVS market.  Rob is super fast in response when required. AC is excellent. The building as well as the apartment is not new and be aware that you will get critical update hours before check-in and you need access to the net without knowing that update, you will not be able to enter the apartment.
Rob has been a good host and very easy to communicate with. We found the place rather comfortable and also well-located. The stay was rather comfortable and good value for money.

We really enjoyed our stay! The location is amazing. Only a few blocks from 5th Avenue. We visited several attractions by walking. It's really a quiet and safe neighborhood. The apartment was clean and the beds comfortable. The kitchenette was perfect for breakfast. There are paid parkings nearby. Excellent communication, very fast response. Rob is a fantastic Host. Thanks again!

My friends and I had a wonderful stay at Robs BnB, from the get go he was very clear with instructions on check in and how to use everything.  The location was great only 5 mins to local subway stops and many cafes. Perfect mid town location to get to all of manhattan and even Brooklyn.  Rob was incredibly prompt with responses to our messages when we required anything.  Beds were super comfortable and the place was clean and tidy!  Thanks for a great stay.

A very nice stay. The apartment was beautiful and very clean! Loved having the k-cups for coffee! The shampoo, conditioner and body wash for each of us was also a nice surprise. The location is excellent! Very nice and safe neighborhood! My autistic son and I walked around everywhere. We would definitely stay again! Thanks Rob!
The apartment is ideally located, very clean and very quiet. Rob is available and responsive when needed. Thanks to Rob for contributing to the success of our family stay.

The location of the apartment is great, it is very close to Rockefeller, and 4 stops from Times Square. The apartment is clean, and Rob answers quickly. We would definitely return to stay in this apartment again.

Rob’s place is cosy, comfortable and so close to all of the attractions you may want to see in NY! As a first time traveler to this city Rob’s communication was super helpful and appreciated! Would definitely stay again!
Rob‘s place is super clean and the location is awesome! Rob responded super fast and I would recommend staying at his place!

Our stay at Rob's was excellent. We had six people staying here and there was enough room for us all. We enjoyed having the kitchen to do most of our own cooking. The location was ideal for getting to where we needed to go and there was a  grocery store and other cafes very close by. Wifi worked well and was helpful for planning our days/transportation. A small note - the weekdays are more quiet than the weekends in this building. Overall a great place though and would definitely stay again.

A bit disappointed for the environment. There was noise during the night and you can hear people talking/ walking outside the door. The front door of the apartment is not always locked that personally don’t feel safe about it. The cleaning of the house can be improved too, it was messy and not arrange-well. However, Rob gave clear instructions guide to the stay, and the place is very very very close to Gyu-Kabu (the most satisfying part!).

We loved to stay in Rob's place! The apartment was comfortable and well located, near the grand central terminal and the most important skyscrapers of NYC! The kitchen is well equipped, we can use it easily. The flat was a bit cold, because there were some drafts from the window, even if they were closed. And the heating system consists only of some electric heaters. Despite this, we strongly suggest to choose Rob's place for your trip to NYC!

Rob is an amazing host! Always available when needed and provided  all the necessary amenities. Great place as well! Very “New Yorker” feel with the brick wall in the unit. Only advise is if you get a rental car, make sure to learn the parking rules to avoid tickets. Makes sense that no one has a car in NY lol!

Rob‘s place is in a great location for different bars and restaurants.  The subway is close (one block in either direction) and you can get around Manhattan easily from his place.  The main sites (from battery park in the south to central park further uptown) are all accessible within 25-30 minutes at most.  We found it to be a great starting point for exploring the city.  It is not huge but depending on what you want to do in Manhattan it is enough for 4 people comfortably and can even fit six with the air mattress.  Rob was easy to communicate with and always had an answer for my questions.  Enjoy your stay and makeover memorable!
Rob is very hospitable and helpful and is quick on responses. Deserves a recommendation. Thanks!
Great little spot in Manhattan. Rob is a great host and communicates well.
Rob‘s place is nice, small and you‘ll find all you need!  It was wonderful to stay there. Thanks!

The photos do not reflect the horror that is this department.  They show you only one room (the largest). Only one suitcase fits into the other room. It consists of an addition to the apartment for a lucrative purpose without thinking about the structure of the apartment, since the hallway to the bathroom is so small that a large person cannot fit there. A disaster.  To check in, the night before I sent a message to the host asking how to enter the apartment. He never told us what floor the apartment was on. He sent us photos of a public telephone where there is a padlock with a code, where the keys are inside. Very unsafe!!! He also asked us that in case the neighbors ask us who we are, to say that we are his friends.  The cleaning of the apartment was a disaster. Not to mention that the host never showed up and that on the day of check out, a person with a very bad attitude showed up to make us leave.  I don't recommend it.

Less than a 5 minute walk from one of the subway stops on the 6 train which made this room very convenient to stay at. You pay for exactly what you get here which I think is a steal considering that it’s in Manhattan. We only planned to use this air bnb as a place to sleep at night which it was absolutely perfect for. Elliot also responded very quickly which was great. He let us keep our suitcases in the room past our checkout time before our flight out of NYC which was really nice of him. It got down to the low 20s and the heat was on which made for a very cozy stay. The use of the fridge and microwave let us easily keep leftovers and heat them up as meals or late night snacks later. Overall our stay here was amazing!

I would highly recommend. Elliot was a very great host. He was always willing to answer any questions I had, and was overall very helpful. This made my trip significantly less stressful. Checking in was very seamless and quick. He was very great at communicating. This was a great deal considering the location. It was near the subways, and there was a bus stop right around the corner. This made public transport a total breeze. It was about 15 min to Times Square via subway. If I find myself taking a trip to NYC again this will be my first choice!!

Location location location! Elliot's place is worth the price just for where it's at. Close to the subway and several bus routes. Communication is 20/10. Place is perfect for a solo traveler or a couple. Isn't the fanciest but it's a steal for being in the middle of Manhattan. Lots of food choices in the surrounding area. Definitely recommend and will certainly be the first place I look at when I go back to NYC!

Kevin is a great Host! We didn’t meet him in person but he replies very fast and you can call him whenever you need something. We were afraid of walking back to the apartment at night and asked him for the safest way home and he offered to get us from the train station so he is very kind! Just the bathroom was a bit dirty but that’s alright.

The room is clean and well furnished.  It is close to metro and rail. But the neighborhood is not that good. My family got scared of the streets. Furthermore checkin time is 4 pm.  My family had to idle around more than 2 hours in the dilapidated neighborhood with most shops closed on Christmas. And note that the apartment is on 3rd floor. You need to carry your luggages all along two stairs up.

Abbas’s and Sere’s place was very clean, spacious, with an easy check in. The beds were comfortable and there were amenities such as a kitchen and fridge, etc. other reviews described the area as safe but we did not feel safe in this area, as we had some issues with people on the streets, and people yelling out of their cars at us. As two women we felt unsafe in this area and moved on to another hotel. We should have researched the area more and came to a conclusion before booking. The place itself is good.
Great visit to Asad. The accommodation is 15 minutes walk from La Guardia airport, very well located when you have a flight and good value for money

Absolout Recommendation! When i arrived in NY it was bittercold and i travelled alone so i felt a bit lost when i came out of the airport. But as soon as i came to Diana's Place my Feelings changed. They heated up the Room and i had a rest in the very comfy and clean bad. Diana took Care of anything. you have everything you need in the flat, i took the umbrella when it was raining another day. it is a real airbnb-experience, not like a lot other flats where you just get a key and thats it. The area is also really nice...because i am always scared about everything i thought the area is too far away i don't feel safe. But it was the opposite: you are very fast in manhattan if you like and i never felt uncomfortable, it is a really nice area...maybe not as fancy as some places in brocklyn but a place with charm. i Really want to come back when it is getting warmer outside :)  and i absolutely recommend Dianas airbnb to everyone...i don't have much comparison but this is  the best place to Stay in this fabolous City!

It was a little hard getting ahold of the host at first and trying to get into the apartment. It's in the 4th floor, 42 stairs up. The odor of Marijuana on the 1st floor hits you immediately when you walk onto the building. I held my breath in case I got hit with a mandatory drug test when I got back to work. Love the cat in the apartment. I guess the owners were out for the days I was there because I never saw them. I wasn't aware that there was another room rented out to other guests so it was a bit awkward. I was by myself so it was a good place for me to lay my head the one night I was there. There was no window covering so I dressed in the corner trying to have some privacy. The bed was comfortable. The trash in the kitchen and bathroom were both full and practically overflowing Soni had to use the bag that I got when I got water from a store. There was no water in the fridge and no ice in the freezer. Theses aren't major things but just writing this so people will know and not be prepared. It's a good location close to bus and train. From what I recall, there wasn't any sites very close, besides the museum. Super nice couple. Would stay here again.

As two young French girls travelling alone in New York, we were a little bit afraid about our trip but the kindness of Diana made us feel very comfortable. She is the most welcoming and caring host you’ve ever meet! Plus, the apt is very well located, in a quiet neighborhood and near the subway.  Our trip has been absolutely awesome thanks to Diana and her very clean and nicely decorated apt.  Wish you the best and hope to see you soon!

Sarah was a great host who replied quickly and was super friendly. The location was great, within walking distance to many restaurants. Also a quick ride away from fun bars and shopping. The house being behind an apartment building added an extra sense of security although I never felt unsafe in the neighborhood. I would definitely stay here again!

We did not meet Asad, but his wife made sure we were taken care of. She was very kind, welcoming and informative. This place was a steal! We only needed a place to sleep and it was a perfect spot especially because it was right down LGA. If you don’t mind the walk, it’s only about 10-15 min or a 5 min or so Uber ride for $5-6. If you’re going to the city, just take an Uber to the 7 train for about $5-6 and it can take you all the way to grand central for $2.75 one way. I love how they provide a little breakfast station with bread, bagel and cereal every morning. Do bring your own water, juice, soda, etc as those are not free. They do provide an option of purchasing cans and small water bottles for $2 a piece. Even though it was a shared space, it was very quiet. The other people in different rooms are respectable and everyone minds their business.   Thank you again and I would definitely come back. A+
Do not be scared from first sight, mainly in night :D House from outside looks like uninhabited, but ist not and inside is really nice. Everything was allright.THANKS

Asad was fantastic, very flexible with our check in time. He was not available when we arrived but provided detailed instructions including exactly which door to use, the wifi password etc. He replied very quickly to my questions and was incredibly pleasant. There were more rooms in the apartment than I had expected; there ended up being nine guests total which meant sometimes there was a little wait for the bathroom. The front door was left unlocked for guests arriving at different times. This worried me a little at first but I never felt unsafe. Fantastic location for an early flight, and a light breakfast was put out: a great touch! Overall a nice place for a quick stay at a great deal. Thanks Asad!

Mario's place was perfect! We were less than two blocks from the Subway so it made getting to midtown super easy! I never felt unsafe in the neighborhood either. It is a super cute and clean place to stay and I would 100% stay here again!

Home is as it looks in the pictures. Very well done remodel! The home was perfect for my wife and three daughters. Plenty of room and everything you need for a great stay. This was our first time staying in Harlem. It was a great experience for our family. Don’t be scared by the neighborhood. The people around the home were the friendliest and nicest in the city. I even walked down to Whole Foods at 10 pm New Years Eve without issue. Uber rides to theater, upper West or East side are very quick and easy.

Amazing Airbnb! Thoughtfully set up, there's attention to detail present throughout the entire process, and the hosts made sure to keep the place spotless and well-appointed. Mario's place is truly a gem! Only thing is that the location is far from all the touristy stuff, so if you're in town for the more standard touristy things, I recommend looking for a place closer to the action. Nearby subway stop felt a little unsafe at night, but it's worth it for the great rate and the experience. 5/5 stay!

Perfect place !.... Near 2 subway lines going to Manhattan, 1 is direct from/to JFK airport. Grocery stores, shops and restaurants are close. DUMBO area, East River and Brooklyn bridge are at walking distance. The Promenade and its amazing view on Manhattan is at 2 blocks only. The apartment was perfectly clean, the bedding (bed and sofa) also. We found everything we needed in this apartment. We met Erin and her husband at our arrival. Very nice people. They live upstairs and are available if you need help. The street is rather quiet. And Don't be afraid of the school on the other side of the street. It doesn't make so much noice. We spent a really good time in this apartment and are ready to come back again for a next trip in New York

Good value for money. Fab vegan cafe around the corner. Enjoyed the area but felt unsafe at night. One night a party on the street kept me awake for a couple of hours but this is common in Brooklyn. Neighbours upstairs also very loud at night.

My wife and I visited NYC for a quick weekend trip to celebrate our wedding anniversary and Mary's place provided the perfect location for all we wanted to do while there. Her place is just a few blocks from the train and a short walk from the food, culture and shopping of Manhattan's Lower East Side and Greenwich Village. Mary was very responsive to the questions I had in the days leading up to our trip, full of great recommendations for places to grab a bite or a drink, and was very accommodating of our timeline, meeting up with us after we spent a full day walking and sight-seeing around Manhattan.  Mary's apartment is on the fourth floor of an apartment building located in Chinatown - important to note because you will be walking up to her apartment and unfortunately some unpleasant smells filled the hallways and stairwells of the building. Not to worry though because Mary's apartment did not share the same odors and this obviously is something outside of her control. To sum up, Mary's apartment is comfortable and conveniently located, and Mary was a communicative and accommodating host. Would definitely stay again and would recommend to others.

It’s a little sketchy that the host doesn’t lock the doors at all to the Airbnb. It was hard to contact the host and said that they are always watching the cameras to the door, but we stood outside of the Airbnb waiting for them for 20 minutes after contacting them on the app, text, and 2 phone calls without response and had to knock on the other doors of the building . There is always loud noises happening from 10pm-4am as if construction is going on, so it’s very hard to sleep.

Kelly was extremely communicative, kind, and supportive when an unfortunate travel hiccup led to me shortening the length of my original stay. The check-in process was clear and simple, and the loft itself is cozy and cute, with an extremely comfy bed, a gorgeous view of the Manhattan skyline (the private roof deck is AMAZING), and truly one of the coolest cats I have ever met! Snuggles from Zion, Kelly’s sweet kitty/co-host, helped my travel stress melt away and made an unexpectedly short stay truly memorable :) Thank you, Kelly!
Absolute gem of a place. The pictures do the view of NYC no justice. Going to miss hanging out with Zion. Definitely a steal of a deal.

We were set to check in at 2pm as the description states. Two of the other girls in the group were to check in, as I did not make it in until evening. When I called shortly after 2 to ask how the place was, my friends said they were not in yet because the host said something was broken and they had to fix it. My 2 friends checking in had to wait 30-40 minutes before they were able to check-in. Upon checking in the host mentioned if they saw oils or liquids dripping from the walls not to be alarmed; they had to anoint the place from evil spirits and energy brought in from other guest. I actually did not learn this commentary was made at check in until later when usual events happened. On our first night we went out for thai and dessert in the city. I got dressed and pulled out my shoes from my suitcase and put them on as we were about to leave for the night. Within me walking from the bedroom to the bathroom to wash my hands and the living room to grab my allergy medicine on the table, I had a message from the host askimg to please take off my shoes, she could here me walking and it was loud downstairs. Admittedly, this was my fault as she clearly has a sign to remove shoes when you enter the house. I was going through the motion of pulling out my outfit for the night and in doing so, I took out the shoes that went with it and put them on. I completely forgot I had to wait until I was at the door to leave to put them on. She was nice in asking me to please remove them, but this is how we learned she was living below us. Later on that 1st night is when we began to get uncomfortable. At about 12:15am I got a message asking if were home I said no and the host responded that they needed to come into the unit because they left something in the closet and needed to get it. I did think the time of receiving the message was inappropriate and secondly it made us uncomfortable because we had our belongings out including valuables/money. It seemed that it was almost timed to be when they did not hear anything upstairs to ensure we weren't home to have to go up into the rental. 12:15am, such an odd hour to request this from your guest. Upon arrival back to the rental, one of my friends began to change into her pajamas and noticed the crotch was wet. She was confused on how it got wet but went on to another pair of sweat pants. Turns out that the crotch, and ONLY the crotch area of all her bottoms had been wet. She got scared and asked if someone went threw her things. Myself and the other girls...

Staying at Sydney's place was great. It was like getting home after a stressful day. To bad we were not able to spend to much time to relax since we were going for a family wedding and everyother day was just hectic. But everything is like its pictured. My family really love it. Defenetly recommended it for a large group. Thank you Sydney.
Please make sure you check before you lay down, because you never know what type of creepy crawls might land up on your body in the morning.

Decent place for the price.  There was no soap in the showers which was a little frustrating. The area is a good location near jfk but was a little scary. Sydney was very nice and communicates quickly which was great. Can’t expect too much more for the price but it would not be my first choice to stay again.

We decided to stay in the area at the very last minute.  Sydney was very accommodating.  We were met by her father who is a police officer in uniform.  We both got scared for a moment that something was going on with the air bnb with an officer in uniform at the door, but once we realized the situation, all was well.

When we arrived the outside of the house was undergoing renovations which through me off because it was sketchy looking. The house door was also unlocked. Nonetheless the bedroom and other living spaces were nice and clean. The host was able to accommodate me checking out an hour later which was really kind of them as well! Overall it was a solid Airbnb.

This place was a great place to stay. It’s perfect for two people and I don’t think you would want to add a third even if you were allowed. It’s about as large as you would picture a NYC apartment. It’s longer than it is wide, but it’s still spacious enough.  Edgar met us to let us in and gave us the lowdown of the neighborhood. He suggested grocery stores, coffee shop, restaurants, and even where to buy wine. He was extremely friendly and helpful.   The location of the apartment is right near the 6 train which is extremely great. Its also about 0.4 miles away from the NQ train. It’s easy to hop on and go on your adventure for the day. It’s also fairly close to Central Park, so walking to it isn’t bad. There’s a CVS nearby which sometimes has better deals on food and drinks that the grocery stores so be sure to check it out if you plan on cooking in the apartment.   I know many people worry about location when it comes to NYC because of safety reason. I felt extremely safe in this location. It is south of Spanish Harlem. We only once ventured into Spanish Harlem because we swung by 7-eleven during the day. Aside from that, we stayed on 97th and below 97th. The walk between 6 line and the apartment and the walk between NQ line and the apartment were both safe routes. We took those routes both during the day and at night, and we didn’t have a moment when we felt we unsafe.
I didn’t like the place. Kind of unsafe the neighborhood.

Reina's place is in a great location and the simple room is great for budget travelers who want a place to crash without having to worry about their stuff being stolen (there's a lock on the room door). Only downside is city noise (if you keep the window open),  some kiddo noise in the morning from the family downstairs and other AirBnB-ers in the adjacent room. It's nothing major, just bring earplugs if you're a light sleeper. A hot water kettle is provided, but no coffee, so BYO instant coffee or tea if you need that before leaving the house. Otherwise there are plenty of coffee spots on the way to/from the short walk to the subway.

Niecia has a nice apartement with all the essentials that you need. The place was clean and looked better than shown in the pictures. Furthermore she has a big TV with Cabel and Netflix. Relating to the area we felt a bit unsafe as europeans at the beginning, but if u come home before nightfall it‘s all fine.  Niecia herself is a lovely host who responded quickly.
Awesome private space that's comfy and cozy! A truly personal space away from home.  Guaranteed to have a stress free relaxing stay!

Keisy was a great host. He took the initiative in communicating arrival times etc and was really flexible about my late check out (5pm). For those who might care, neither the bedroom nor the bathroom have locks on their doors, but I did not feel unsafe.

She was a great host and very personable.   However, the bed was extremely uncomfortable and we had one blanket and no top sheet. The pillows were flat and lumpy. They were clean though.   There was a good variety of channels on the tv and it was good sized.   We were woken up multiple times throughout the night by banging from upstairs, as this is a basement studio.  Parking was on the street and it took 3x around the block to find a place to park, even though the driveway was empty. It seemed to be in a very unsafe neighborhood. (Truth be told though, I lived in North Long Beach, California, so I didn't feel too uncomfortable.)  Water pressure was good in the shower, but there were roaches in it.   There was a few dishes in the strainer a dirty coffee pot and a couple random non perishable items in the cupboards.   Overall, she was a very kind person but I cannot recommend it if you're looking for comfortable restful sleep.

Do not recommend staying in this private room during coronavirus. It's confining with no access to sunlight, or access to rest of condo.  Room smelled like moth balls.  Bathroom is clean but not connected to room.  Addy - one of the  cohost is not friendly at all.  They also accused me of being aggressive with a cough.  I was being direct and we were not sick at all.  Also, they watch you in the condo with cameras - very creepy.  Thank God for moving to the Soho James down the street - which was a great move & great visitor experience.

Jeanette's place is exactly as advertised. I stayed there for a few days because it was incredibly conveniently located next to Armory Track. For all future NY Bar Exam takers, seriously consider this spot! I was able to walk back and relax away from the stress of the exam location. Literally a 10 minute walk to the exam location.  Beyond  this, Jeanette and her apartment are also very pleasant! She is very friendly and welcoming. We didn't get a chance to talk too much since I was in and out with the exam and everything. She provided all the necessities though. She also has a very friendly cat which is always a bonus.   As far as the neighborhood, it is the best, but I'm a bit biased. I grew up in the South Bronx and Washington Heights is basically like the place I grew up. So I loved the nostalgia of walking around the place. If you are into ritzier New York, that is also very close by subway. Really easy to get to Harlem and the Bronx as well. All in all, an awesome experience !

Overall, the apartment was as depicted: two separate bedrooms, a living room with TV, one full bathroom, and a kitchenette (only with a small fridge and a microwave) in the third floor. The host provided fans, which were very useful since NYC is quite hot in August. Plus, the house is 10 minutes away from a subway station (Cortelyou), so you can get around quite easily. However, we had a couple of problems. The apartment wasn't too clean, the bedroom floors were full of dust and lint, and we found a big cockroach running around. Also, one day the host's dogs came upstairs and messed around the kitchen, so when we came back at night the trash was on the floor. Anyway, the biggest issue was that, one night, Alex had a party at home, but he hadn't informed us. The music was really loud (you could hear it from two blocks away), and there was a lot of people around the house. I asked him to turn down the music, since it was quite late, but he told me that the party would continue. When I complained again, he didn't even reply, and he didn't apologize the next morning. The experience was quite unpleasant, so I wouldn't recommend it.

Nice place for a reasonable price. The bedroom is spacious enough and it was adequately clean. We didn't see Jeanette or her family a lot, but they were very kind the few times we met at the apartment. The building is located in the Latino neighborhood, it might seem a little dangerous but we didn't face any problems. There are lots of places to eat, buy groceries or even do the laundry. You have to walk less than ten minutes to get to the nearest subway station.

I felt unsafe inside the apartment, as well as disturbed but the subfloor showing and the space being void of any personality. I did not stay for more then a couple minutes, and she refused to give me any kind of refund. Her cat was also very scary and hissing at me. I just don’t think this was at all an acceptable place to even sleep. I came to NYC to have a wonderful Christmas trip and this Airbnb wasn’t at all nice or welcoming. I ended up having to stay somewhere else. This is probably the last time that I will ever use Airbnb because it seems people are all about the money on sub living spaces. I was actually scared to stay there as well as thinking of waking up to use the bathroom and the cat attacking me. I tried to talk to Airbnb and Jeanette and neither one really cared.

Alex was an exceptional host. We had an issue with a lost passport on our way to the airport and had to bang on the door at 4.30am to get back in. We were welcomed back and made to feel very accommodated during a stressful time! The place is far bigger than expected and really easy to get around Manhattan and Brooklyn from. I would stay again and recommend to anyone.

The bed is very comfortable. TV and towel come with the room.  Gerry, answers promptly and  is very kind. I recommended staying here for a couple of days.  The neighborhood can be somewhat sketchy but if you are only staying there to sleep and not walk around then you’re fine!

Gerry is a lovely host. He is extremely friendly, helpful and quick communications.  The area is considered high crime. But I had no problems. Plus didn’t go out at night. A comfortable stay. Thanks Gerry.
Gerry's hospitality and the room were superb! Be careful in the neighbourhood at night, though – Brownsville has a dangerous reputation.

The only positive thing about this specific unit was the proximity to the subway station, but other than that we felt unsafe in the location after discovering several drug paraphernalia pipes under the sink in plain sight. The room also was not as clean as we thought, with underwear being found in the pull out couch. Overall it did not feel very clean space to sleep in, but thankfully we spent most of our time in the city and not in the room.

Rob is a super helpful host.  We booked the place for a long stay (one month) and had to cancel because it is on the 4th floor and unfortunately with a stroller it was complicated. That’s on us but Rob was very helpful in discussing with airbnb so we could get a refund despite the non cancellation policy.   On the apartment itself: - easy to find - very well located near McCarren Park and metro L - calm

The house was nice and clean. The backyard is nice as well. The only thing to be aware of is that the area can be pretty sketchy at night. My friends and I decided to take Ubers when coming/going here after having a bad experience the first night.

Good location, clean enough room and friendly people. but sonder people don’t give me promising words like “I cannot promise you or I don’t know for sure” so it was a little bit stressful     Also the sonder app is not helpful at all. My request and chat history didn’t forward well so that I need to speak in person anyway.
Cool guy, neighborhood is creepy at night. be careful out there.

Bi was responsive and the room is as pictured. However the room is less an eclectic collage than a patching over of a building in disrepair. The common space of the third floor apartment where our room was located was alarming and creepy with a large heap of  objects taking up most of the room, and poorly concealed by a curtain. Strange paintings/murals on the walls and door added up to the disturbing quality of the space. The bathroom was not very clean, and we’re not at ease to take a shower. We did not feel comfortable at all here and left as early as we could the next morning. Of course, NY is super expensive but the value of this place for what it costs is ridiculous.

The place is as described in the listing. Very spacious, well-equipped, and comfortable for a party of three. Kitchen was well stocked with cutlery, coffee and tea. The entire place was quite clean and well maintained. Great location too!  Only a short walk from restaurants, Broadway and Times Square.   Few things to keep in mind: 1. The apt is located on the 4th floor of the building with no elevator (common in NYC) Something to keep in mind, depending on the guests in the group. 2. The bedroom is close to the window and all the noise from the street carries into the room. You can hear superbikes, sirens, cars pretty much through the night, even with earplugs on. Not pleasant if you're a light sleeper. 3. We had some issues with the check-in. The host was away and not communicative/responsive which made for a slightly stressful check-in process. We didn't receive the check-in details until 5 min before our check-in time. Thankfully, all sorted out in the end.

Beware when booking at this location.  The host relies on small sticky notes to make up for a lack of facility features/fixes, one of which in this case resulted in an incident where my partner and myself ended up very frightened in the middle of the night, and feeling very unsafe around the host. We decided to leave after our first night (barely having slept 3 hours) and the host only refunded less than half of what would have been our second night after we reasonably requested half our payment back for a two night stay.  The only positives are that the bed was comfortable and the toilet has a bidet, otherwise the bathroom is gross, there are no hand towels, the pillows are old and flat, and you can hear everything from the outside.  Host needs to invest some money into repairs and amenities to justify the cost of guests staying there.  Cannot recommend at all.

I was nervous about doing Air Bnb for the first time, but Uri was wonderful. Check in and out was very smooth, the area was super safe and welcoming, communication was always timely, the place was clean and homey feeling. The location was perfect too, being close to the subway station. Made visiting NYC less stressful and a fun experience. I would very much recommend this place!!

Keino is a great host and always very quick to respond. Location is really unbeatable, 7-10 min walk to the nearest train to get you into manhattan. Buses all over. The area is not as bad as it looks. There isn't a ton of foot traffic at night, but i never felt unsafe. The room is also very clean. 100% would stay again.

This was absolutely thee worst Airbnb experience ever! The place is directly across from a homeless shelter where the people are outside begging all day at the corner store The space is listed as a first flier flat the apartment is tiny with a waterfall shower head with no pressure . disappointments  It started out nice then I was told the washer and dryer in the listing was only available if I stay a week  the host tried to tell me there is no way to not include the washer/dryer in the listing which is crap  The kitchen essentials were not there at all Then the very next morning I left to go to the store and someone put on a roach bomb with NO VENTILATION I HAD TO SPEND AN ENTIRE DAY WITH MY EYES NOT BEING ABLE TO OPEN THE NEXT MORNING THE VERY SAME THING HAPPENED  THEN THE GUY I WAS SPEAKING TO ALL WEEKEND TURNED OUT TO BE THE HOST BUT HE DID NOT IDENTIFY HIMSELF AS THE HOST UNTIL THE LAST DAY  THEN TRIED TO TELL ME HE DIDNT KNOW WHO DID IT YET BOTH TIMES HE WAS COMING FROM THE BASEMENT WHERE THE BOMBS WERE SET SO FRUSTRATING

Be careful. This is a scam. You book and immediacy have to pay. If you try to cancel, even a month in advance still need to pay. I had to take it. Go to the area- total slams. Still trying to get half the 150$ back. Do not fall into that trap.

This was the worst experience ever! The doors in the building didn’t close. The pipes were broken, the windows were not working properly and there were cockroaches all over the place! Really unsafe and unhealthy!!!!! The host sleeps in the hallway what she never mentioned before. The neighbourhood is not safe to walk around even during the day, please do not rent this place!!!!!

The apartment was not very clean. The deadbolt does not work. The towel rack fell apart every time I put something on it to the point where I just gave up. There is minimal furnishing and only one very old and torn up comforter, so I spent much of my time there cold.  Even though it was 50 degrees when I was there, the ac unit in the window let in a lot of cold air. I asked for either blankets or for the ac to be removed and neither occurred, despite being told they would.  Ana was uncommunicative and unresponsive. I didn’t receive check out info until AFTER I had arrived at the airport, and that was only after I messaged her with what I had done. In response she sent me a disrespectful and shady message, even though communicating check out procedure in a timely fashion is the hosts’s responsibility.  I do not recommend anybody stay here or at Ana’s other locations. It’s extremely cheap for a reason and you can find much better places in the same area for a little bit more a night.

The first 20 days we were there with a colleague.  I am staying in this AirBnB for another 30 days.   The apartment is as described.  Clean on arrival but could be a bit cleaner for my liking, am very picky.  Chris and Shantel are always helpful and open to any question.  Especially with Chris and his nephew it is fun to chat and to chill out.  Unfortunately, the area is comparatively very noisy: parties until late at night, loud motorbikes and cars.  It's very rare to meet white people in this area, but I've never felt scared or discriminated against as a European.  I would definitely book this AirBnb again and recommend it to everyone!

I think paying a $75 cleaning fee to find stained sheets, hairs on and in the towels/bed, and a roach problem is pretty disappointing.   Also, while Ana is very responsive (which I appreciated), she sent a message asking me to lie to literally everyone and say I was “visiting a friend” rather than staying in an Airbnb because of the “crackdown” in NYC —which is just incredibly shady.   For the $225 total for one night I should’ve just stayed in a hotel.  Certainly not going to book this place again.

Cozy apartment, which offers all amenities. You will find yourself there, if not at home, but almost since you will not miss anything. Perfect value for money. Rob and Cathy, the owners, are very available while remaining discreet. Excellent communication. I recommend it.

A friend and I stayed at a new house in St. Alban’s, which is an area in Jamaica, Queens. It’s a lovely, safe and quiet neighborhood, and it really is about a 12-minute drive to JFK. This is like a house on top of another house, with separate entrances side by side. Our 3-bed/2-bath is on the first or ground floor. There are a few steps up to the front door but none inside.  The Internet connection was solid and fast. Parking was free where you can get it. I may have been lucky but I found parking every time within a couple of minutes’ walk from the house.  What sold me was the place is new and I loved the dining table photo. It was so luxurious and we thoroughly enjoyed sitting and chatting there. I liked the dining area, the mattress was really comfortable, a soft memory foam but with good support. I liked the spaciousness of the open plan kitchen/dining/living area. The heating worked well and the house was cozy.  I also like to be fully prepared before I leave for a trip. So it was anxiety provoking to learn that I didn’t have Internet information in my printouts. The host doesn’t provide this until two days before the stay, so I didn’t have it and felt badly texting the host late at night for the information. I got it using my phone to access the site on AirBnB. There is a typo but you can figure it out.  A couple of things relevant to me were absent. There were no extra blankets or pillows though these are listed among the amenities, and if you’re a bit picky about bed linens (like me) you might want to bring your own. The beds were dressed with a bottom sheet and a poly comforter without a cover. Also missing was a drip coffee maker. There was instead a coffee pod dispenser with some flavored coffee pods. The pod dispenser and electric kettle had been overlooked in the cleaning and were not usable at that time.  There were no fewer than 6 plugin scent devices and an additional standalone device that spritzed automatically throughout the house. It took a while to clear the air once unplugged and it was hard to fathom why they were being used. They were not masking any other unpleasant odor. Finally, the walls are quite thin. I was kept awake until after 2:00am by an upstairs neighbor who was simply walking across the floor, chatting and watching TV on my first night. And on the following day, as we sat at the table, the other entrance was used and I would swear someone was coming into our part of the house. What I thought was a locked closet door appears to be a connecting door to the other part of the house.  The host returned messages and appears to be managing the business remotely. The house is new and doesn’t have a lived-in feel or what you would expect to find in a kitchen (like scissors). But it is safe and very comfortable and free parking is available. Overall it was a good experience and I recommend it.

Ronald did not notify us until the day of check in that there was another visitor staying. We were under the impression that all beds would be available. On top of that, felt pretty unsafe to share a space with another stranger. Space was clean but two mice were present.

Julia's place was as described.  She is very responsive to her guests questions and needs.  I couldn't have found a better location.  Very centrally located to small convenience story, restaurants, drug store, bagel shop.  Less than a block from my daughter's place, which was a huge plus for me. I hope to stay there again when I come to Bayridge.

Was greeted by an unflushed toilet. Felt unsafe as a solo female, was glad there was a key provided. Jhon was very responsive and offered a refund if I wanted to leave. It was late and rainy so I ended up staying at the location, but kept the door strictly locked the entire time. Price was reasonable and the location did the job for a night but I was happy to leave in the morning!
The neighborhood was a little dangerous because of the poor lighting but the rest was great, Kara was very friendly during my stay

I would stay here again in a heartbeat. Howard was welcoming, friendly, and made my stay in New York amazing and stress free. The check-in process was simple, everything was very clean and new, and the overall experience was exactly what I was looking for.

A liar, This person tries  to steal people’s money and cancel reservations. I was told that I can’t get a refund for my reservation after I paid. Thinks like this make me think twice about using Airbnb in the future. I hope the company pays attention to people like this and stop fraudulent hosts from stealing people money.

The apartment is as described in the ad. Perfectly clean, the beds are very comfortable. We stayed there for 1 night as we were in transit for a flight. There were 5 of us, 2 adults and our 3 children aged 16, 14 and 10.  It was perfect.
Don’t recommend to book this place, really dirty and smelly place. Unsafe area.

My friend and I (both 24 and female) asked Luciana prior to our stay if the area of the Airbnb was a safe area, to which she replied yes. Yet is was very near Brownsville (one of the most unsafe areas of ny).  At the arrival we didn’t feel safe  in the neighborhood nor in the apartment. We got catcalled (we were wearing oversized joggers) and harassed (with labels like btch, “white hoes”) by the locals while waiting for our uber to get away from the place. We arrived with the apartment door unlocked and the keys at a visible place to be taken by anyone.  The door of the room also was just glass and wood, which didn’t seem like a safe door to close. I felt fooled by the host, since we chose to expand our stay after her labeling the place as “safe” prior to our arrival.  After contacting Airbnb regarding this issue we first received a response that a refund wouldn’t be possible as the host had a high rating. I DO NOT recommend this place nor the host as I feel lied upon asking a safety question.

Clean house. Convenient location. Wish they had sent the information on how to check in sooner and not an hour before check in. Parking situation was a bit stressful. Was difficult to find the house because the house number was not visible. Good place for a quick place to just have somewhere to sleep for the night.

Place was clean and kee responds fast we had some trouble getting into the apartment and she was SO quick at responding and helping us out! We were super scared to book a room rather than the entire place but everyone was so respectful of each other and it felt safe! I would say this place is perfect for someone who literally plans on being out and about all day and just needs a comfy bed to sleep in. I’d definitely stay here again! Thank you Kee!

The flat is exactly like the photos, 3rd floor (stairs), well equipped and nicely decorated. Communication was fast and easy. The only problem is that I couldn’t check-in at the time I requested in advance, so landing with big luggage after two long flights and not having a place to crash was complicated. Apart from this inconvenience, I had a lovely stay. The neighbourhood is cute and less stressful than other parts of Manhattan. Plenty of cafes, restaurants and grocery shops around it. I already recommended the flat to a coworker and would stay there again.

Pros - The apartment is a really good location if you are planning to do a lot of activities in Manhattan but don’t have the budget to just get a place in Manhattan or all of the good places are booked.  - The apartment is really Instagram friendly. It’s designed for photo ops.  - This place has self check-in so it was very convenient since you did not have to wait for anyone.  - Keyless lock. Also very convenient. No physical keys to stress about.  - The blinds in the bedrooms are practically blackout so you don’t have to worry about the morning light ruining your sleep (or daylight ruining your power nap). - Each room has its own temperature control. This is easily the best feature of the apartment. I had packed a separate travel fan so my friend would not have to put up with me wanting to set the AC to a super low temperature but this wasn’t necessary since the AC can be set individually for each room. The AC in each room was super effective too so I could sleep in a really cold room and shut it off to wake up and move about. Pièce de résistance: all of the AC units have a remote control. I kept mine by the bed for ease of use first thing in the morning. As someone with really strong feelings about temperature control this was a really nice touch.   Cons - Check-in/Check-out times are not that flexible. If possible arrange your flight or travel first before booking this place so that if you have an extremely early flight this can be accommodated.  - You are offered a chance to drop your bags off in a side storage closet outside of the apartment but it’s already pretty packed with stuff so there may not be room for your luggage if you are a heavy packer. Asked for a picture of where the storage closet was located for convenience and ease and did not get one.  - While everything in the apartment looks great, the furniture doesn’t feel great. Like once you sit on the couch and it’s not that comfortable. Sit on the mattress and it’s okay but feels cheap.  - Key functional touches were kind of missing in the apartment. For instance my bathroom did not have a towel hook for me to hang my towel. I ended up hooking my towel through the shower door handle. Also, there are no hangers. This wasn’t a problem for me since I traveled with a garment bag so I had them but my friend didn’t and sorely missed them.   Overall I enjoyed my stay in this AirBNB and would do this one again if I was looking for a place to stay in NYC for the future. Nicole is a pretty responsive host and was relatively understanding (not adjust check-in/check-out time understanding, but you could talk to her if you had an issue). I would rate this place a solid 4.5 stars but AirBNB doesn’t let you rate in half stars.

Even though this place is old and cluttered with old furniture items and many old things, the room is clean, the bathroom is clean, the bed ware and towels are good too. The price is one of the cheapest. Location is perfect, close to subway, surrounded by various restaurants and grocery shops.  Take ear plugs because street is loud. My bedroom (with twin size bed) was in the section with another bedroom, each of it had its own door but without a door lock,  and we had one common door with the door lock. So, I couldn’t lock my individual door. It went safe though, my neighbours didn’t steal anything. Lol. But I thought I should mention that in a review because for some people it might be important.

DO NOT STAY HERE!! This place is very unsanitary! My gf and I stayed here for a month, and let me tell you, we were completely miserable. First off, the room was very small for $1,600. Second, the blanket was full of stains! Then, we look in the fridge and there is old vegetables with mold on them. Btw, the same vegetables were still there when we checked out. In the bathroom, there was mold on the shower curtain and old molded sponges. It was so bad that I had to give him a shower curtain to put in the bathroom. The bathroom was disgusting. The shower upstairs was freezing! So we used the shower downstairs. The toilets were stopped up all the time. We saw a mouse, and when we told him about it he told us he would do something about it. He then texted me asking me not to write him on the Airbnb app which to me was very suspicious and made us feel very uncomfortable. They only came to the house twice to clean for the whole month that we were there. This is by far the worst Airbnb!

First of all we were afraid because when booking, the AirBnB site did not locate the apartment in the real location. The apartment is 5 minutes from the Metro line R "Bay Ridge Avenue" Quite a pretty neighborhood with typical local houses, very quiet and secure (I was with my 2 very young teenage daughters) we stayed there for 1 week and will come back here next time! We loved it: Angela welcomed us, discreet but accessible to communicate if we needed anything. Food stores nearby, it's quiet at night. The apartment is on the ground floor accessible by 2 doors closed by code (no keys to carry around!)

Great place for a short stay. If you’re not used to traveling in the Bronx, I’d recommend getting a rental car or Uber from the nearest train station. Keep in mind, the neighborhood is lovely but the street location has limited lights, so at night, if your by yourself, you may or may not feel a bit unsafe. Finding parking is not an issue Ms  I stayed two days and it’s perfect for just that. The kitchen has almost everything - no microwave though. The bed was very comfortable and the WiFi was reliable.

the kitchen and bathrooms area was great.  we unfortunately had a couple of issues during our stay that made us feel unsafe. The day that we arrived and were in our room someone was trying keys in the door to find the key to unlock it.  on another night two separate parties arrive expecting to stay there but their room was not available. we had to deal with these people and try to help them figure out what had gone wrong as they knocked on our bedroom door. it felt a bit strange that people were able to enter the house when there weren’t any rooms. we understand there was an issue with one of the guests but the lack of communication was very confusing for us. overall quite an uncomfortable stay and we found it hard to relax.
Rented Andres place for 3 of my employees.  1 arriving every week.  It has been an easy and stress-free experience. I will use this place again for my traveling employees

This was a great stay! Room was pretty tiny but neat, kitchen was a good, usable space. If you're not familiar with the area, it's a little on the rougher side but not unsafe. Friendly people, lively streets, short walk to the nearest subway station. Lots of delis, convenience stores, and street art :)  The only slight downsides were that the only light in the room was veryyy bright, and we had to ask another guest to borrow an AC remote after no reply from the hosts. Not a huge deal really, and they were very accommodating otherwise!

This is false advertisement and  a Scam this place doesn't look like in pictures and doesn't offer nothing that it says ! i booked the place cause i had people visiting from europe and the host asked me if i can babysit her cats and then kept harassing me with texts if i wanna rent her place for a long time! the place was the dirtiest and smelliest apartment ive ever seen the sheets weren't changed,there was cat hair everywhere and she left a used bar soap,no toilet paper and the fridge was filled with moldy food! i told her about the place and she texted me that she was gonna venemo me the money if i wanted to clean it !

Traveling in New York on a budget, I kept my expectations low. I was pleasantly surprised to find neither rats nor roaches, nor danger in the neighborhood, nor any trouble getting to other parts of New York. In fact, clean and functional, this room was as pleasant as any I've stayed in, the nearby bodega clerk gave me an unsolicited discount, and my travels to Westchester and Manhattan were surprisingly easy.

dirty, smelly, the "internet connection" is as slow as a 1992 computer. creepy santa figure is set up by the bed. host was in another state even if i did need him. spider webs in the spot & all on the steps you gotta go down to get in there. dirty lookin cabinets & just about everything. alot of rust. all around inconvienience.👎🏾

A great place to stay, the space is very comfortable and the size  is just right for two people! The hosts are absolutely amazing, they wrote a personal welcome letter and provided some complementary snacks for us. The apartment is very clean and highly maintained.  I would definitely recommend staying here if you have a vehicle as there is good street parking available. the nearest train station is a little bit of a walk so a car definitely helps with that. Overall an great and stress free experience, would highly recommend.

Truly don't know where to begin. To not lose the readers I would first summarize by saying that the host is great and flexible,  Bella Studio is awesome. We are all aware that many Airbnb locations are accidental. People just fix up free spaces here and there and push out to make extra income. Some get it right while most just create more stress for the renters. Bella Studios was designed from scratch for comfort and convenience. I am a bathroom person and I wasn't disappointed. Shower heads are huge and powerful, bath walls, tub, wash hand and toilet bowl are quality amenities. The kitchen spaces are ideal with best of materials.
