The refrigerator and microwave are built-in with closets. The sink and underneath are quality durable materials. Enough drawer spaces and ideal lightening at each area. Washer and Dryer combo for convenience. With access control console I could monitor, manage any visitor. Location is safe and full of shops. I wonder how so many same shops survive so close. Close walk to the subway.  Worth the price and I would recommend for myself and others. I was even allowed to check-in early based on availability. Thanks Fran for being a great host. Cheers.

NOT RECOMMEND AT ALL!!! Definitely not worth the money and HORRIBLE for families!!!! Incredible noisy, drunk and screaming people at all times, at check in two drunk people sitting at the front door, loud noise until late closing hours from restaurant/bar in the back. Extremly loud neighbors, dirty dirty dirty place. Things broken and unsafe in the kitchen, radiator definitely broken (steaminh vapor coming out of it!!!!) floors are so uneven your tripping all the time. Rooms are way smaller than in the pictures, 2 front doors right next to the rooms super noisy and uncomfortable. Felt super unsafe, and as we requested a change because we were unable to stay at this place because our kids were unable to sleep in this conditions, we were denied without any empathy. JUST A MONEY GREEDY GUY!!! Extremly disappointed by Lucas. SHOULD HAVE WARNED US IS JUST FOR PARTY PEOPLE WHO BARELY USE HIS PLACE!!!!

This is a very nice, spacious apartment close to a great grocery store, drug store, and the subway. Jose was a very responsive and gracious host. This was a new rental, so it was still in a little bit of startup mode. When we arrived I noticed that there was no coffee maker, which is a must for our family! I messaged Jose about this and he immediately sent someone over to bring us a brand new one. I would definitely come here again, or look for one of Jose's other properties. This place is a great value, especially for a large group.
Great stay for groups. Mostly separated bedrooms. Very clean. The neighbourhood is quite scary sometimes, but if you plan to go by Uber or car it is not too far from Manhattan.

This place is a great place to stay in Brooklyn for both short-term and long-term.  I had stayed in his place for a month during my trip to NYC. This is what I can tell you about Kin's place.  Check-in process was easy. The room size is small but it is normal for NYC standard. The room is equipped with windows AC, desk, chair, fan and an overhead cupboard. The bed is comfortable. There is a private bathroom inside the bedroom. There is a shared kitchen which is equipped with refrigerator, stove, and microwave.  Kin's place is very close to R line subway. Just around 5 minutes by walk. The neighborhood is friendly. Everything is in the walkable distance including laundromat, drug store, and tons of food.  The best thing of this place is Kin. He always make sure that everything is clean and organized. He offered to change towels and bed sheets regularly. He answered all my messages and solved all my problems in timely manner. His place is very safe due to every tenant gets their own private door lock passcode and he cancels it every time after anyone checked out.  If I have any chance to visit Brooklyn, I will definitely stay at his place again.

The room and the bedding had a smell of male underarm odor. The host was swift to change the bedding but it persisted. He should consider changing the pillows and mattress altogether. Given how hit-or-miss hotels and stays in NYC are, this could be a promising room but it was unpleasant with the musky pillows and mattress!

When we first saw the entry door, which looks a bit shady, we were skeptical. But then we walked through the hallway (with garbage cans) and opened the unit’s door to find a gem. While not posh, it was clean and well-appointed. And great tape murals on the walls!  And for us, incredibly well-located. Not only was it just a couple of blocks from our daughter, but also only a couple of blocks from the subway station — and within walking distance of everywhere we went. (If you know this area of Brooklyn, you know there are umpteen restaurants and coffee shops nearby.)  While the address is on a major thoroughfare, the unit is off the street so surprisingly much more quiet than we expected. Parking in this area is always iffy, but we found parking within a block. Just pay attention to the parking restrictions.  Beware that the spiral staircase might make carrying larger suitcases up and down awkward, but we had only small carry-ons.  Check-in and check-out was as easy as could be. And Danny was great at communication. He seemed eager to make sure that we were comfortable and happy.   Thanks for a lovely weekend!

First when we arrived to the place on the Airbnb home page it did not have the picture of the proper apartment. 2. To get into our apartment it has a safe lock and it was not charged and co host had to Come in and fix it for our safety because it would have been like dangerous according to him. 3. The bathroom tub had a massive leak that would put towels under in the Bathroom.4 the marks on the floor look so old, it’s not from us. 5. None of the beds were clean and the sofa bed had crumbs. So I truly believe this host scammed us and he’s trying To get more money out of us.

Decent apartment, small enough for 2 but it does the job the huge problem with this accommodation is really the huge construction site which is blocking the apartment and which makes a lot of noise in the morning so no grace morning during the week. It will also be necessary to add curtains because the 4.5 windows surrounding the room do not have any so the sun wakes us up at dawn (if it is not the construction site). you should also think about putting a duvet because covering only with a simple sheet is clearly not enough, especially in winter. the heating is also not often active. The bathroom is really very low if you are over 1m90 forget it because I was even 1m85 and touched the ceiling of the bathroom. Otherwise I found the accommodation in a quiet area which can initially scare you, the people in the area are very nice. The enormous quality is the Metro A a few minutes from the accommodation on foot 10min max which will take you directly to Times Square.  Some small business near the accommodation which is very useful!

The apartment was ok however it was a bit underwhelming. The building and apartment are quite run down and in serious need of refurbishment and repair. The electrical switches did not all work, and the light buttons were pushed in and unsafe in the bathroom. The floor was very greasy and we did not want to walk on it without shoes on. The location was ok but a bit lacking in charm. There are very good deli/ small supermarket options nearby. When I removed the sheets from the bed it looked like the bottom sheets had not been replaced as there was quite a bit up of hair and general debris presumably from previous guests. The sheet for the pullout had stains on them. The beds were very comfortable. The housekeeping kept repeatedly knocking on the door for us to leave from an hour before checkout. We felt quite hurried. The place is ok if they were to charge less but frankly the hotel  we stayed in prior to this was far better and in a little more expensive.

Ryan’s place was absolutely beautiful. The space was the perfect size, the bed was incredibly comfortable. The place was decorated beautifully and had all the amenities needed for a short or extended stay.   Greenpoint felt very safe as a woman traveling alone. I did not feel unsafe walking at night in that neighborhood. It was also close to the G which was convenient. If you’re trying to get around during rush hour, however, keep in mind the G is the only subway in that area. It was PACKED.   The view from Ryan’s place is a show stopper. I couldn’t believe I had both a private balcony and a private rooftop both with incredible views. It doesn’t look real. There’s both a liquor store and a coffee shop on the first floor as well as a supermarket across the street.   This place is a steal and i would highly recommend it to everyone.

This unit has a mix of pros and cons -  Pros- unit is very spacious and convenient in terms of location.  Common areas (kitchen/dining/living are huge).  Very affordable compared to other comparable listings. Unit was clean.  Cons- there are window AC units in the bedrooms only -which by default were loud (bring ear plugs if you are sensitive to sound when you are trying to sleep). Unfortunately there is no air conditioning in the common areas so at times we were hot (we rented in July).  In terms of check in we had challenges as the address listed on Airbnb was incorrect and communication with the two hosts was challenging on check in day.  Maybe it was a one off experience, but it caused some initial stress with our group.
Perfect location. Surprisingly quiet too. Fast communication. No stress.

A very pretty apartment in the photos. Terence will contact you asking you to download an application that will not be useful to you in the end. Remember not to step on the garbage that clutters the entrance to the apartment. And bring dishes to reheat because only the oven works. The garden and the jacuzzi are dreams you will never achieve. But instead an experience in a construction site with white paint on the ground and spiders everywhere will be there.  In addition, the jacuzzi will be at the bottom of a cabin under rubble and it will be up to you to clean it up to use it. The neighborhood is dangerous. I don't recommend this place. TO AVOID!!!

This room isn’t even a real room, its a makeshift room with cheap plastic walling you can probably get off of amazon that had massive gaps in it. When I checked in I noticed this and could see the disgusting piping through those gaps but made the mistake of not raising the issue right away. I periodically kept seeing small roaches for the next few days and it all culminated to the most massive roach I had ever seen on day 4. I asked my friend to come and help me pack in the middle of the night and she saw creepy crawlers all over the gap behind the dresser. I cancelled my 15 night stay after that and the host was terrible claiming my DECLAWED (adopted her that way) cat left scratches on her.. toilet??? Refused to accommodate in any way whatsoever and when I offered to pay for the days I stayed she complained that there isn’t enough time for the other days to be booked again? What? SHE WANTED TO RELIST THE PROPERTY WITHOUT ADDRESSING THE ROACH INFESTATION AND GAPS IN THE WALL? Yikes, stay away. Even without the roaches the place is so very small, no windows, claustrophobic, nothing around the area, far from any trains, because its in someones basement there is CONSTANT noise everywhere and kids screaming. Its absolutely terrible. Thankfully my bank agent had the good sense to tell me to dispute the charge. RUN!

We really liked the location of the airbnb. It was very close to Grand Central and that is where we normally walked to for the subway. We loved Mamen coffee shop that is close by on 44th and is on the way to Grand Central. There is an Amish Market and a drug store extremely close by. I had never stayed on the east side and I enjoyed getting to know that side of the city.   The bed is very comfortable and we slept well. We did not have any issues with noisy neighbors as other reviews noted, but I did take ear plugs. Maybe those other units are airbnb units and that is why it's not always noisy. The water does take a long time to warm and not a lot of pressure. Just plan ahead and turn it on well in advance of when you need to shower.   Overall, we had a great stay and I would recommend it.

The room was clean, and it looked just like the photos. Very nice wifi, beds, and the bathroom was also nice too. However, the entire building is Airbnb, and there was a lot of noise as some were partying right next door. There was one incident where a drunk person from next door was banging on our door nonstop in the middle of the night at 3 AM, and this definitely scared us all a lot, but the host was very responsive even at that time and perfectly managed the situation by calling the cops, calling us to reassure us, etc. Overall, pleasant stay.
Samuel has not stolen his super host status. We recommend

I stayed at several Airbnb's managed by Hiroki and associates past 12 months.  Here are my take aways: they are mostly for low-budget stays and there are many tradeoff's (ie, sanitation/vermine control/roommates):  This particular one is slightly different in that while still being frugal -- no common area or minimal amenities -- it looks fairly new and relatively clean.  Unlike other places, the cleaning lady actually comes twice/week and does a good job taking garbage out and keeping things clean in general, but, like Hiroke's all other places, it wasn't free from roaches and mice (two entered my room by eating through the wall in my room).  Reporting them to host (Hiroki) did very little in my case.  So those choosing to stay long-term prepare to do some DIY pest-control. Lastly, your roommates/fellow guests next door: for the most part, they are considerate and private, but I decided to move from the 3rd floor b/c the guest next door was a drug addict who smoked some stuff indoor from sunrise to sunset; and brought unannounced guests time to time.  The shared bathroom can also be a slightly annoying scheduling problem when there are 2-3 guests occupying a room, which, in this particular case, means you are effectively sharing the same bathroom with 4/5 other people.    Two things I like about this place: very close to Skyview Mall/Target and AC.

Fabulous!  Beyond that, there are too many words to describe how wonderful my two weeks stay was :-)  I would stress that the apartment is much bigger in reality; the pictures don't do it justice.  I loved the garden too! The morning following my arrival, as I was enjoying my coffee looking out to the garden, a beautiful Cardinal flew by and landed on the fence... Well, did you know that the sight of this vibrant red bird is an uplifting, and happy sign? What a great symbol to describe the experience which awaits those lucky enough to stay in this gorgeous home, far away from home. Thank you Ursula :-)
The location was a bit sketchy, but the host was very responsive and proactive.
Great host, very clean unit and extremely comfortale with great views of the city. Neighborhood is a bit sketchy but i felt safe getting in and out of the building everyday.

This place was amazing, an oasis literally steps away from the beach. A lot of rentals in the Rockaways can be near the very crowded touristy beaches, but this stay is super close to very chill and serene beaches. The yard is lush and magical and gives you a lot of privacy after a hot day at the beach - we loved grilling and sitting in the shade. Would definitely stay again on a beach trip. Dmitri was an accommodating and responsive host. .

Location wise you can’t go wrong I was able to walk from La Guardia to this Airbnb.   Washroom had hair in it and I saw a couple of cockroaches in the kitchen so even though the room was clean I was kind of suspect about cleanliness of the sheets etc.  Basically I learnt what $100 gets me so next time I’ll just dish out more money or go for a hotel.

The place is walk distance to LGA, which makes life very easy since I do not like the stress of commuting to airports to catch a flight. There are many free buses that take you to very close to the place. Rosy is nice and communicative. The price is good for the place.

Communication with Samanatha and once on site is great. The pros: amazing views, good location, comfy beds. Great amenities like soaps, extra towels, snacks upon arrival and waters, and definitely clean though the walls and some doors need a fresh paint job. Cons: We were told to not speak to the front desk staff, to avoid them, which felt really sketchy, and we were taken through the back way upon arrival, also odd.  Having only one key fob (requested a second but did not have one) meant our young adults had to take the service elevator (no fob needed and what we were told to do) and when coming in at 2am, it was not running due to maintenance every night so we were up every night going down to the lobby to let them in. We could not use the balcony, which we had looked forward to. Some appliances did not work and lights which we discovered on our last morning.  All in all, If the check in and key fob situation were remedied, the rest is not that big of a deal compared to the views and overall good qualities.  Samantha and Asher were very kind and quick to communicate and easy to work with!

Great place, location is iffy. Expect drug addicts, rats and pea but this is NYC folks. Amazing porch, apartment. Basically beautiful inside but as soon as you walk outside you are in the ghetto of Harlem Central

Pros: Felt at home, condo was clean, safe neighborhood, snacks and fruit provide were appreciated. Communication with Güney was great, and he was responsive. Cons: Condo units share same address, the exact unit # wasn’t provided. We accidently choose the wrong unit and scared his neighbors. Luckily the neighbor was understanding. Welcome packet asked not to flush TP in toilet. When inquiring about the TP, I was told the bldg has old pipes and tends to clog easily. This issue wasn’t divulged until after the cancellation period had passed. I really try to respect someone’s house rules as I like the same done in my home. As a woman who deals with the once-a-month female issues, I would have had a hard time adhering to this rule if I was traveling during that time of the month. Luckily that wasn’t the case. I do think renters should be told this information upfront and let them make the decision about the rental.  Overall, we enjoyed our stay and you do spend more time out and about.

This place may well be worth the money given other available options, but I would have been happier if it hadn't been titled "Lovely 3-Bedroom" and hadn't raised my expectations for that.   What was great about it was the closeness to LaGuardia for someone with an early morning flight the next day.  But I wouldn't describe it as a "lovely 3-bedroom."  It would be more accurate to say a "tidy, small room in a shared 3-bedroom."  Yes, you share the bathroom with 2 other strangers.  Also, if the proprietor is in the hospitality business she should be more familiar with local eateries.  My request for info on that score was met with the ungracious and irrelevant comment not to eat in my bedroom.  Why on earth would I eat in my bedroom if I asked where to eat out?  To be fair, the host did name a couple of locations nearby where restaurants could be found.  But the LaGuardia Q70 bus driver was the one to give me a great recommendation:  for the Airways Pizzeria on Astoria Blvd., a nice 4 block walk away.    (Good news for the host:  I ate all of my calzone at the restaurant, and the tiramisu on the walk back).   Finally, the photos omit any photo of the room I was in, which was not as nice as the other two rooms depicted.  And the bed was slanting head-wards, so I had to reorient my body with my head at the foot.  The host also forgot to leave me any towels or wash cloths, as were depicted in the photos of the other rooms.  Finally, the light switch in the downstairs hallway was partly uncovered (unsafe?)--and hard to see in the dark.  And the light switch in my room was hard to figure out.  Too many things to press, and one time when I went to bed, the light turned on by itself in the dark.  This was most unsettling.  Oh, and finally, the air conditioner is loud, and you can't really close the curtains all the way.  Is one expected to undress in the dark?  The alternative is to do a striptease for neighbors directly facing the apartment, across the street.  None of this is stuff that can't be fixed, so I hope and expected that next time, the person who gets my room will be much happier.   I will say, it was very nice to be only a couple blocks from LaGuardia.  And it was a very clean place.

Hi, I stayed here just for a few hours then had to leave very early in the morning due to intruders invading this Airbnb. 2 young guys and 1 young woman apparently who weren’t booked came in and were drinking and cursing very loudly. There was a couple that left a few hours after they checked in due to their noise level and then an hour later I decided to leave. It was 4 a.m. when I left and I didn’t get any sleep. Not to mention I’m a woman and felt VERY unsafe having to pass them as I left the house. At least I had my pepper spray. I was falsely accused by Rosy of being affiliated with the vandals and clearly I wasn’t. As I communicated with her days before the booking and was very transparent. I came in about 4 hours before them. I didn’t appreciate the treatment I received at all. And I wasn’t going to write a review but I have to stand up for myself and others. Thank you very much. God bless 🙏🏽

I’ve stayed here once before this is becoming my favorite place when I plaza through New York. It’s affordable, efficient, comfortable and clean. It’s a steal to stay in the city and not empty the bank doing so. I highly recommend this host and her beautiful space she shares with us travelers.

I have never written a bad review, however, I had a few problems with Stella's Airbnb. Firstly, I understand you do not pay for a hotel experience, however, the kitchen was extremely dirty, especially the microwave, and it made things very unpleasant. My main problem was an incident that happened while we were staying there. The boiler broke and hot water was not available for two nights and the last morning we were there. This meant no shower (not even cold). This was EXTREMELY unpleasant for travelers spending all day walking in the cold and just wanting a shower when we got home. Despite being international tourists in NYC, we were expected to just deal with this problem. Stella did not offer any sort of help. We then asked if we could possibly get any sort of compensation for this inconvenience. She took this badly and very rudely denied our request and even threatened to give us a bad review for asking. After making some rude remarks, she agreed to give us $25 (our stay was $600).

The apartment wasn’t so dirty that we immediately left but dirty enough we were afraid to touch anything.  It’s significantly nicer in photos. Walls in bedroom are filthy. Shower is covered in black mold spots and just general filth. Bed “was made” with a thin cheap “Walmart like blankly.” And the smallest cheapest shower towels I’ve ever seen.   We were looking for an inexpensive stay. What I expected was a clean place with no frills but someplace I would invite a friend to stay. This was cheap, quiet and safe. Also the bed was comfortable. But I would be horrified if anyone visited my home and it looked like this.

Magnificent apartment in Brooklyn close to public transport for walking everywhere in New York and its surroundings.  Allow on average 45 minutes to get to the Manhattan side depending on the targeted area.  The neighborhood is lively and we never felt unsafe, quite the contrary. Everything was clean and the decoration is very tasteful.  The bedding is great, the apartment is bright, ideal for resting after long days of sightseeing in New York.  The hosts were very responsive and very accommodating regarding our departure time. They also took the trouble to deliver us a set of clean towels during our stay.  Everything is available in terms of equipment to allow you to have a pleasant stay (air conditioning, fans, washing machine, dishwasher, microwave, kettle, etc.) you quickly feel at home!  I therefore recommend this accommodation with my eyes closed ☺️

I reached out to host because we needed a wheelchair accessible place my son could be discharged from his recent hospitalization & he assured me easy access with an elevator. I asked to extend stay and he said only way was to book a 2nd reservation. He asked me to pay via other but I didn’t. We couldn’t get in the building because he never provided a code and was very slow to respond. Thank God my niece & nephew drove us because we would’ve been waiting in the cold outdoors & entr for hours. We had to wait for hours because elevator was broken. Repair man “temporarily” fixed elevator & had to ride up w/ us. Once in I had to go back out to buy tp and paper towels. There were only 2 pillows for 3 guests & no wifi info was provided. We felt unsafe & called AirBnB immediately. We left ASAP next morning & got that reservation refunded. Host refused to refund 2nd reservation. Not all “super hosts” are super. First terrible experience with AirBnB after many excellent experiences for years. 0%

Vera is a very thoughtful, gracious host. The historical brownstone is located in the Little Haiti neighborhood of Brooklyn and the block was judged the greenest block in Brooklyn in 2007 and 2011. It is a visual treat walking along the street. Very tidy and lovely AirBnb room equipped with a small refrigerator, a small coffee maker and complimentary tea bags, soda drinks and juices. A good bed and clean bathroom. Vera is there when you need her but leaves you to enjoy your privacy. She loves in the brownstone with the friendliest cat I have ever come across.  The communication was quick and the room looks exactly like it does on the pictures. The neighborhood is conveniently located about 8 minutes walk from the Beverly Road subway station, which is served by the 2 train at all times and the 5 train on weekdays. But be aware that it will take you between 45-65 minutes to get into Manhattan, depending on where you are going. If you love walking, you could get to Prospect Park in about 30-35 minutes. As a woman by myself, I did not feel unsafe walking to/from the station or in the neighborhood late at night. The AirBnb is very quiet, though you should be aware that there is a chicken pen in the backyard and if you are a light sleeper, the early morning rooster crowing could wake you up earlier than desired.  If you are planning to work remotely from the Airbnb, the bandwidth of the Wifi could become an issue, though it never prevented me from doing my work except for a little inconvenience. If you are into watching Live News, the bandwidth issue sometimes leads to buffering every few minutes. The bathroom is equipped with hair dryer, shampoo & conditioner, body wash. An iron and ironing board is also provided in the room. There are hangers in the closet and a long mirror on the wall.   Would absolutely recommend to stay there!

Elena was extremely responsive and helped me get the room temperature just right. The beds were comfortable to sleep in and I had everything I needed for my long weekend stay. The location was great as the Q train was just a block and a half away! My only feedback for future renters is that while the unit is non-smoking, a lot of marijuana seeped through the floor boards which I found overpowering at night and unpleasant. To each their own!

Everything was ok. Staff are very polite and the housekeeping very careful and especially kind. The only big problem was the hidden fee of the "Facility Fee" of 34.43 per day, was a very unpleasant surprise and would be perfectly well accepted on the total price if not charged separately. My next stay will take this into consideration and be denied if still practiced.

First of all, the unit number (1b) wasn’t included in the description which took us awhile to locate the house.  We tried to contact the host via text and phone call, there was no response at all.  In addition, the kitchen was filled with gnats and flies when we walked in, and one the bathroom doesn’t have enough shampoo/body soap and toilet tissue.   I think this location is great, but all those things I mentioned just made it an unpleasant stay.

The home Liz provides is very cozy. You won’t hear much noise while you’re sleeping. You may hear some light street noise but that can be expected from the city. The steps leading to the apartment can be quite steep so be careful when arriving at apartment - wear sneakers or flats. When taking a shower the Color scheme is flipped so you will have to engage the opposite to get hot water. All total it was a lovely stay. Very safe community and you won’t feel at all unsafe while staying with Liz. So happy I could be her very FIRST House Guest 🏠💕

Beds were full size, not queen, it was a bit uncomfortable to sleep like that. The shower was clogged and the pressure of the water was at medium force.  We were told by the butler to not park the car outside because there is too much crime and it was safe to pay and park it in a public parking.  NYC is not what is was a few years ago, there is a smell of weed in every corner and lots of people selling it. It’s like a skunk sprayed everywhere in the city. That was the disappointment of the city that I knew.  There are lots of people in Disney outfits trying to scam you with pictures in Times Square, please stay away from them, a healthy advice.

Pros:  Very modern and comfortable living space, with a great kitchen space.   Quiet at night and was able to get good rest (you can hear the train passing but it is not that loud, and in the rooms not audible)  Spacious and good value for 3-4 people (with 2 full sized beds)  Probably ideal for a group, that does not mind being a bit farther from things and prioritize a comfortable interior.   Cons: Was impossible to find parking (we arrived on Friday late night). We circled around several blocks for 20 minutes and could not find any spaces, so we had to find a parking garage and ride share back to Airbnb. If you are driving, this is definitely something to keep in mind.  Also note that although it is technically Brooklyn, it is still 1 hour 10 minutes train ride from most attractions in Manhattan. If you're staying out late, it can be a grueling trip back.  Not too many places nearby to walk to for food. Some streets seem a bit rough and not the most pleasant to walk around at night.   There are two gates, one front door, and the upstairs door leading to the Airbnb. Total of 4 gates/doors that you have to go through to get home, and 3 of them require physical keys to unlock. So it is a little tedious having to do this every time you leave and return. The keys are also not labeled, so it took trial and error to figure out which keys went to which doors. Overall, our Millennium Broadway trip was a mixed bag. I'll start with the positives:  - The location cannot be beat. If you want to see a lot of Broadway shows and be centrally located near Times Square, it is perfect. Walkable from so many theaters, and very close to subway stations all around. - The rooms (especially ones without lots of windows) were quiet. This was definitely a concern of ours staying in Times Square, but the noise insulation was quite good and we never had issues with noise. - The hotel was LOVELY in allowing us to keep our bags at the hotel before check-in. We dropped them off around 1pm (check-in wasn't until 4pm) and since we were out late with friends, we came back around 1am and were able to get our bags no problem from a locked, safe location where they had stored them for us. Excellent service! - Many of the reviews complained about the rooms themselves: honestly, this was completely fine. Sure, the building is a bit dated (aren't most buildings in New York quite old?) and some of fixtures could use some TLC. But the water pressure was great, the showers and sinks were all functional and warm, the bed was comfy, and who cares if the room you're staying in is super modern and up to date? If you're coming to New York, then you likely shouldn't spend much time in the room.  Now onto the not so great. I feel that I've been fair in singing the praises of this hotel accordingly, and I share these details for the benefit of future potential visitors.  - On the 4th night of our 7 night stay, there was a live cockroach in our room (20th floor). We called the front desk to get it taken care of, and it took upwards of 20 min (given that it was 2:30am, understandable) for someone to come up with a vacuum to try and catch it. - The most frustrating part (on top of dealing with a disgusting cockroach in your hotel room) is how the hotel initially handled it. I went to the front desk to ask for a partial refund due to the health concerns and disgust of a potential infestation, as well as a new room (nothing nicer, just an equivalent room) and the night manager tried to tell me that it was "just a water bug, harmless." I did my research (and have photo/video proof that was shown to the staff) that this was not a water bug, but was actually a Palmetto Bug, aka the American Cockroach. It is well known that shady landlords in NYC try to downplay a cockroach infestation by calling them "water bugs" instead. Only after pushing back that this was indeed a cockroach, and that they were trying to lie their way out of it, did we get a partial refund. In particular, we got 3 nights of the $35 a night facility fee waived. - Other reviews have mentioned, but be warned that you will be charged an additional $35/night fee. We anticipated this, and only after the cockroach incident did we try and get all 7 nights of the fees waived given the severity of a cockroach infestation (and having to look through all our bags to confirm no eggs or other roaches were present), but the hotel would only allow 3 nights to be taken off (total of $105) value. Instead, they "upgraded" us to another room (41st floor) which, while it had a better view of Times Square, was actually smaller and a little more in need of TLC than the room we were in before. Since we are light sleepers and had no intention to stay in our rooms, we didn't care about the view and simply wanted an equivalent room with fewer windows (better sound insulation), but the best the hotel could do was say that the $$ dollar equivalent of the upgrade was actually their solution to the cockroach problem.  At the end of the day, the hotel was expensive for what it was. I don't plan to ever stay in Times Square again (there are SO many nicer neighborhoods that are still centrally located!) and the hassle and headache of dealing with disingenuous hotel staff isn't worth the trouble. I acknowledge that much of the hotel staff did the best that they could under the circumstances. Enter at your own risk.

This place is apparently under new management as of late November / early December, 2018. We made our reservations through "Gabriel" on AirBNB and ran into none none of the surprises that some people seem to have issues with earlier in the Fall of 2018. We were offered a hotel room but would have to pay the extra and in the end took a generous refund and got our own hotel. (Still over the amount refunded.) We appreciated that it wasn’t intentionally double booked and he did what he could when he realized it was, but the stress it caused for our trip doesn’t allow me to give 5 stars.

A fair warning to potential guests; the images in the listing are of the entire building not the unit. It is still large for a NY space but doesn't comfortably fit 4-5 adults. The beds that were available felt smaller in person and much more uncomfortable than expected (1 queen, an inflatable mattress in the closet, 1 twin and a twin-ish bed that rolls out from underneath). I am 6 feet tall and my feet hung off the bed on the wood.  There wasn't any soap in the bathroom, so may need to coordinate with the housekeepers to make sure that things are restocked before you arrive. The housekeepers also do not respond to text messages but only calls.   Overall the unit was clean, but the sheets didn't seem to be washed and there was a cobweb above the fridge.   Warnings:  - There isn't a key to lock your unit. You share a code with the housekeepers who could technically enter at any time. - The unit is nicely renovated but located in a shady area. We did not feel comfortable walking at night or even in the daytime sometimes.  - The washer/dryer, iron are not inside the unit. - The building is not handicap accessible despite being listed as so.  For the price, it did seem too good to be true. If you compare the newly renovated unit to its neighborhood, I guess you could say it is "luxurious". But you might be better off just booking something closer to central Manhattan or downtown for similar pricing.

The accommodation is the strong point: clean, functional, well equipped, good value for money and above all extremely well located (4 minutes from the subway, plenty of restaurants and grocery stores around, 25 minutes from the heart of Manhattan). So a bargain for a stay in NYC.  On the other hand, in terms of communication, a big failure on the part of the host.  He changed the reservation by removing 2 nights without any explanation, barely a week before departure. He is not present for the management of travelers and refers to a friend: the latter will not be met either since it is a 3rd person who will welcome us. We don't know who to communicate with and when we send a message to the host, the only response is to check with your friend. For departure, a departure time is set: we wait, no one. So it's a little disappointed that we come away from this experience: really great accommodation but stress before departure following the modification of the reservation and clearly poor communication. We hope this is just a bad exception.

Carlos was really nice/accommodating, can see why he’s a Superhost. Just 2-3 minutes to a subway stop that goes into Manhattan. Neighborhood seemed a little sketchy, but I felt safe with a police station on the street nearby. AC in the bedroom was a godsend as it was a hot, humid summer weekend. Walking distance of a Walgreens, dollar stores, etc. for any essentials. The shared bathroom was clean.   However the pillows were very hard/firm/uncomfortable, I suggest bringing your own if you can. I found a stray blonde hair that wasn’t mine on the bed when I arrived. I thought it would be easier, but it was far (45 min-1 hour each way) to get into parts of Manhattan or some trendy parts of Brooklyn via subway/bus/Uber/Lyft.

The stay was perfect.  Carlos and his family are very friendly, reliable and uncomplicated.  The property is just a few steps away from the J/Z Metro. This means you can be in downtown Manhattan in about 20 minutes, day or night. The airport can be reached in about 30 minutes. There are many shopping opportunities and restaurants on the doorstep.  You share the house, but everything is very discreet, quiet, you have your own space and you rarely meet.  The room is very spacious, clean, air conditioned and quiet.  I traveled alone a lot and never felt unsafe in the area. However, one should not forget that this is not the Upper Eastside.  But you can feel the spirit of Biggie and there is breathtaking street art on every corner.   I will definitely come back to Carlos on my next trip to New York.  I can only recommend it.

I am very upset that this place was even on air bnb. Upon arrival, in a horrible neighborhood, I was told the wrong address and got no reply from Nancy when I messaged multiple times asking where it was. I finally found a lockbox outside a completely different address which then let me inside. This “apartment” seemed to be the old mailroom or office managers area. The door had a turn lock on it with no deadbolt or anything(and it was the first door when you walked in the bulding). The heater blew out smoke, shower had yellow stains and was completely broken, windows weren’t fit to the wall so breeze was coming in(windows had no locks), there were footprints on the walls and gross stains absolutely everywhere, the linens were dirty, I can’t believe this place is available to rent. Upon reading the reviews they are all completely different and speaking of skyline views and rooms-they seem fake. I ended up canceling my one month reservation. I was very scared and unsafe in this place, I really hope no one else has to go through what I went through. I also hope air bnb will take this listing off. They were very helpful when I told them I felt unsafe-so thank you to air bnb.
Smelled bad Dirty apartment Not homey at all No furniture in the living room Very creepy place Should be 20$ a night

Unsafe!  Our room door was opened upon arrival and would stay closed. The room does NOT look like the pictures. It is dark and dingy.  The bed had an old purple quilt. I didn’t even want to put my bag down on it.  The bathroom was gross.  It was an unsafe environment. I couldn’t possible sleep comfortably in the room.    I tried contacting the host via email and phone upon arrival and never heard back. My husband and I had to leave and find another hotel.  I tried asking for my money back and heard nothing.  I contacted Air B and B and they got no help.

Please do not stay here, it's a room with four walls and that is it. No kitchen no shower. And then they will up charge you to plug in a small heater 150 dollars!!!  They seem nice but this is a scam and I was really disappointed!!!

The Lux Condo was true to its description and really provided all that I needed. The Dollar Tree is right downstairs, which was perfectly convenient for me whenever I needed any temporary household supplies. In addition, the subway station is just about a 10-minute walk away with plenty of cafes, restaurants, and grocery stores nearby.  Ultimately, the Lux Condo was a great place to stay in at its value––affordable, clean, convenient and not too far from the city, located in a safe neighborhood (I was never scared going back late at night), and very cozy, much like home.

I honestly think the host should take this location down, I was here for a week and it was TERRIBLE. There was multiple roaches and there is black mold all over the walls that will make you sick by breathing it in, she said the mold is recent but she also tried painting over. Her husband or father literally came into the space without knocking or announcing he was coming in  and stood in the hallway which is real creepy. Her house rules say no guest from 10pm to 7 am she seen my girlfriend at 1pm and charged me an additional 192 dollars based off her assumptions. And the Airbnb platform was very unresponsive you have to beg to speak to a supervisor to get half of your money back. Besides that she was nice thru text
Scammer
This is the Worst Place I ever stayed never again she’s  a Scammer ‼️‼️

Olga is a very kind host, she responded really fast and was really nice in giving any type of help I needed in my stay. The place itself is a steal for the price it is. Nice space and it’s clean would recommend to anyone

We loved staying here!  The apartment building was very nice and clean, with a 24 hour door man.  It was simple, stylish and in a GREAT part of Williamsburg, close to the water where you can view the skyline, within short walking distance of 2 subway lines, and MANY restaurants and bars.  Too many to count!  We are sad we only stayed a week and didn't get to try more of them!  Grocery and drug stores close as well.  We felt very safe in this neighborhood and would absolutely stay here again.  My only caution is that you grab an Uber to and from the airport.  Getting to the apartment from JFK as well as back there was convoluted, and we should have just gotten an Uber.

Be aware and read description carefully, you won’t get multiple rooms, for every 4 people you’ll only get ONE room. The listing is very misleading. Off-street parking was almost impressive to find. When I arrived with my fiends (both men and women) late at night, we were told to sleep in the same room. Apparently we couldn’t, so we had to leave and find a hotel in the middle of the night, which was very inconvenient and way more expensive. Fortunately the host returned our money. Very unpleasant experience overall.

You can expect to be living in a beautiful home what you see is definitely what you get. The room were very clean and they are kind enough to restock us with towels when we needed it. The host also was very kind and gave me and my boyfriend our privacy. All the appliances work and backyard has a cute little set up for 4 guest to come and relax in the shade. I highly recommend this place just make sure you have the money for it.

The room is spacious and bed was comfy, bathroom was clean. Windows were sound proof which was much needed because neighbors play loud music.  Self check-in instruction isn't quite up to date, but the host was prompt to provide correct code. It was a bit confusing which room belonged to me, but it all got resolved via messaging. Location is a bit shady & not the cleanest, however the L train Wilson stop is 5 minutes away.  It's a bit far out from the city. For 1 or 2 nights, it's a decent stay.
The place is really convenient to every place in NY. The one unpleasant thing is it's too noisy at night.

Clarissa is a truly warm person  and did everything to make my stay enjoyable. Her apartment is close to 1st Avenue which has some nice restaurants as well as drug stores and everyday establishments that were really useful. Citibike stations are just a few minutes away and the 2nd ave subway is a nice 10 minute walk.
Spacious room. It's not that close to the subway. I heard some people say that it's a reasonably dangerous area, although it was a little tense, I didn't see anything like that.

We stayed in Brooklyn because it is cheaper, the neighborhood is what I imagined, it is not the worst, it is not the best either. At no time did I feel unsafe. My stay was for two nights and it served its purpose, which is just to spend the night. The bathroom is good and in good condition, the room is also good. Tj was very nice, I don't remember because we were texting and we talked about the weather, it was cold and he told me he would leave an extra blanket for us. That was super COOL.

The location of this place really can’t be beat. For spending a day at The Met or walking in Central Park it’s fantastic. It’s an older building in need of an upgrade (they really do mean shabby). For solo female travelers, note this host does rent out other rooms in the apartment. There is a flimsy lock on the door to each room but I was glad I brought my own. I never felt unsafe, but was surprised to meet the other guest in the hallway and he was surprised to meet me as well. It’s a great price, but not having access to the kitchen, even to store a drink or leftovers was tough. But there’s not much choice on the UES so I was happy to have found this place.

The check in process was straight forward. Krystal made sure to provide clear check in instructions with photos. The neighborhood has everything you need especially when it comes to trains for commute. You have all the trains that can take you to Manhattan literally in walking distance from this Apartment. My friend and I stayed at this apartment for 4 days and it was worth every penny. The decorations are beautiful, the space was clean, and private. Don’t sleep on this deal because its hard to find a steal like this anywhere in New York. Thank you again Krystal!

Only stay here is your top priority is the price being low. Yo be fair, the location was incredible, extremely close to the Empire State, including a two minute walk to the subway   The space was clean and as advertised, but everything else was disappointing. Firstly, the shower didn’t drain correctly and left a tik of black residue everytime you finished showering. The main issue, though, was the shady nature of the building itself. I know this may not be the people who rent the Airbnb’s fault but it is certainly a factor thwy need to be aware of. There are several shady and homeless characters hanging around at all hours, and they seem to have some sort of relationship with the security. The security is very nice, but they don’t take their jobs seriously. They also don’t enforce the mask mandate well and often wear their masks incorrectly. One guy sat in front of the building smoking a hookah at 7 am for multiple days. Besides this the place is just LOUD. The heater makes a shrill noise through the night, people play music extremely loud, and our floor featured someone having a 4 hour long fight with profanity that made us vey uncomfortable, and the security did absolutely nothing about it. Our host was nice when he did respond, but overall it was not a pleasant experience because of the overall atmosphere.

My stay was so fantastic that I honestly am afraid to give all the details!! From the moment I stepped foot into that heavenly place, I was spoiled to the T! Everything...and I mean, EVERYTHING, super perfect! It was like being HOME!!! Faith my experience at the Mogul one that I will treasure for a lifetime! Needless to say, this is my go-to spot when in New York! What a magical time!!! Just Wow!

Was a little skeptical booking this place due to the reviews saying no AC, black mold in the shower, loud radiator and sketchy loud people outside, but this place was great! We found no problems with this place and none of these were true and overall was a great stay!

Checking in was easy and we were able to drop off our luggage when checking in early.  Pros: Near subway station, lots of shopping near by.  Cons: Like everyone said, the heater makes a lot of noises throughout the day and it's loud outside. There are groups of people standing near the entrance and it was kind of sketchy but they never approached us when in a group.

The place is nice, accurate with the pictures.  We had a problem with a rat but staying in New York I get to understand that's part of it.  Cindy helped us with the matter and we did everything we can till we solve the problem and ended up with no more unpleasant visitors. Even though is far away from Manhattan, the neighborhood is really quiet and there's a park and stores nearby.
This Airbnb is such a steal.  literally right next to the train station and it was an easy commute to Times Square

The place was clean when I arrived and was maintained clean during my stay. The location is great, close to the public network, shops and restaurants. Many of the restaurants are of Latino origin and had great food. There were three laundromats within 5 minutes walk as well. The neighbourhood isn't as nice as some of the other (more expensive) places in New York, and friends warned me that I should be careful, but during my stay I haven't encountered any unpleasant incidents. Overall, a great place to stay, affordable but still close to Manhattan.

First time on a plane, first time traveling, first time on a solo vacation trip, First time to New York. And first time using Airbnb.   My trip was awesome! Anna made me feel right at home! Her apartment was nice and tidy and clean.   Above all, she was a great host! She is very friendly and smart. She would have awesome conversations and recommend local spots. I’m afraid to book again and not find another host like her! Thanks Anna!

SCAM!  Avoid this host at all costs! I had the worst nightmare ever interacting with the host: 1. Host asks to call her to avoid airbnb fees. This will take away your lever to resolve issues through airbnb. I refused and asked her to cancel my booking. Host agreed to do so.  2. Host did not cancel booking through airbnb (whose fees she previously tried to circumvent). She asks me to cancel via airbnb myself, which I did.  3. Host then declined calls and ignored my messages, until official cancellation window expired.  4. Finally, host refuses to any refund!   The booking fee I had to pay is stolen money! Be careful with this host, and please avoid falling into the same trap!

No free parking, as spent half an hour to look for parking, yet still getting two tickets totaling 230 dollars. I had extremely loud guests and I felt very unsafe being there. Considering it is many guests in the same building, I would not consider noise to be just a one time thing.  The rest is okay.

The apartment exceeded expectations. Very cute and small space for couples or friends. Great location, very close to public transportation. Available parking right out front of premises with limited stipulations. The instructions for check in were clear and made the beginning of our trip start with no stress. There is a brand new a/c in the apt and was kept very clean with a smart tv (roku) for entertainment. There is also a small balcony that one can sit on just outside of the window. Thoughtful amenities such as dishes, soap, pillows, blankets, and other useful things. Overall we loved the place and will be staying again.

When we arrived at the accommodation we wanted to leave as quickly as possible. Lots of homeless people, dog poop in the middle of the pedestrian walkway, the whole street was dirty. A very unsafe area, it's better to stay away from!! The Uber driver also confirmed this to us. Since we got to the apartment before the regular check-in time, we immediately looked for a hotel and didn't check in. We explained to the host that we felt very unsafe and therefore didn't want to check in. He didn't come to meet us at all - no, he made stupid comments at us asking if we were kidding him.
Emmanuel was more than kind and quick in communication which was a great touch to a stress free vacation. Great amenities and subway stops are not too far of a walk. Overall, would highly recommend!
I mean it’s a very small space, scary with no lights.

The location is kinda scary if your not use to the City life. I wasn’t, almost freaked me out.  So it’s close to the train that will take you almost everywhere. Plus this is the easiest way to get around. The apartment was hot even with the windows up and fans on.  Either way it was clean and okay once you got use to your surroundings. Thanks for all your help.

Samanta’s apartment was lovely! It was sparkling clean, the mattresses were super comfy, the shower had great pressure, and she had the bathroom necessities. She was wonderful for the check in & check out process. The subway access was great - about a 10 min walk - and I never felt unsafe walking at night. Would highly recommend this apartment!

Our stay at Paget‘s apartment was amazing! Paget was incredibly hospitable, very responsive and had a lot of good recommendations (restaurants, museums etc.). The apartment is very beautiful and close to multiple subway stations with good connections to all the hotspots in the city. The bedroom is facing the backyard so it is quiet which is good after a stressful day in the city. The apartment also includes a well equipped kitchen and a nice bathroom. Overall, we had a great time at Paget’s apartment and we would be happy to stay at her place again - highest recommendation!

Stayed for 10 days.   Pros 1. Biggest pro is the location - very convenient to walk to key sights such as Times Square. Subway few minutes walk away.  2. Apartment was clean and relatively well equipped.  3. Neighborhood felt safe.  4. Good selection of pubs and restaurants within walking distance. We ate in Il Melograno nearby and was lovely.  5. Orel is fast to reply.  Cons 1. While the bed is creaky and you hear it each time you move, the mattress is a memory foam and lovely and comfortable.  2. Toilet became blocked (we didn't put anything unusual or excessive in it) and Orel's response was that we needed to fix it ourselves. That was an unpleasant and time consuming job.   3. Apartment lacks a can/tin opener, doesn't have a coffee/Moka/espresso pot so only instant coffee if you're a coffee drinker.  4. Area is beside many pubs/bars so be assured that it’s very noisy at night.  5. The heating malfunctioned while we were there and it became extremely hot in the rooms, luckily there was aircon.   It took multiple messages to get the heating issue sorted.   While we enjoyed our trip and sightseeing in New York, we would look for different accommodation for the next time.

When weighing purchase options for stays in Manhattan vs outside this city, this was a great selection to save a lot of money. Easy access to the subway made it simple to be downtown every day for us in about 25 minutes. Geographically, it is a decent spot, but there certainly was not a ton a "city-feel" things to do within walking distance of the Airbnb. The neighborhood actually felt rather sketchy and dirty, even though this is probably considered a soon-to-be "up and coming" neighborhood. If you're willing to get past that for Brooklyn location, this is an awesome value. The townhouse was exactly as advertised, there was plenty of cozy amenities, and we enjoyed the outdoor patio and board games in our downtime. Recommended stay.

Fantastic booking! My wife and I stayed with Gina for 4 nights and it was very cozy, clean, and safe. We were her first guests since the pandemic began and Gina went above and beyond to provide extra little amenities to make our stay stress-free. Gina was also flexible with our requests. If you want to stay at a place where the host makes you feel welcomed and respects privacy, book here!

This place is good if you need a place to crash in New York, was comfortable and the family was very nice. I would note that if you are a single woman it can be a little scary walking home from the train station in that area. I was catcalled a lot every night I had to walk home and I felt very unsafe. If you are with someone it should be okay but if you're alone I would advise you to make sure you're on the phone with someone as you are walking. That's New York for you though.

Omer and Inbar are amazing!!! Their place is actually so perfect and big. Hands down the nicest Airbnb I've ever stayed at. The art, furniture, everything! Seriously a steal for what you are getting.   The apartment has literally everything you could possibly need. Even a smart TV so you can access Netflix/Hbo/etc. Having A/C was HUGE too especially on hotter days.  The only thing I didn't love was the location. I would've preferred to be closer to the shops/restaurants in North Williamsburg, but it was only about a 15min-20min walk to that area.    Omer and Inbar were very accommodating to my early check in/late check out requests as well. Would definitely stay here again next time I make the trip out to NYC.  Thank you Omer and Inbar!!!!!

Small room with noisy air condition. Location is quiet but can be very shady at night. No elevators so you will have to carry your heavy luggage up by yourself. The metro entrance is nearby and is only open in the day. If you're coming back from the 181 St Metro at night, you'll have to walk about 10-15minutes from the further exits.

Overall it was ok. I wouldn’t recommend this location for the soft hearted however, upon arrival we see what seemed like gangs all over the complex. Even the four year olds looked like they wanted to rob us, Good thing for the police heavily patrolling lol seemed like that was a permanent post for them.        Steven was a great host with awesome communication. The place was clean, could definitely use like two more AC’s though, some water, and towels/soap. I booked like 4 hours before hand so for the last min traveler it was a quick and convenient place.        It was a fun and interesting experience staying in the concrete jungle, I can probably relate to 50 cent or Jay Z much more now. All in all I would recommend this place for one night only, the price we paid wasn’t worth it. And if you stay, you should probably get your Muay Thai skills up beforehand lol.

Vanessa’s Airbnb was just as expected from the listing details and from others’ reviews. The location is convenient, there’s plenty of space to cook, work from home, and chill on the couch. It was perfectly clean on arrival. Communication with the host was very good, Vanessa answered anything I needed to ask. Important to note that Vanessa controls the A/C and heating remotely, and you’ll have to ask her if you need it adjusted.  There was some noise from neighbours downstairs and upstairs, but I expected it from reading the reviews. No unpleasant surprises!

My wife and I (and our little Chiweenie pup) stayed at Brandon's apartment for a new year's trip to Brooklyn and had an amazing time. From the get-go, he was very prompt in replying to questions before and during our stay, and provided us with a well stocked kitchen and bathroom amenities. His apartment is extremely clean and charming–which made our stay very comfortable–and well located in downtown Brooklyn. There's a ton of great coffee shops, bars and restaurants near by as well as several prominent train lines. Traveling with a dog can be stressful, but Brandon's building is very pet-friendly so it made our trip much easier. I highly recommend Brandon as a host and staying in his apartment for future trips to New York. Thanks again for a great trip!

Carlos' home was better than what we could have hoped for when renting in NYC. The apartment was clean, the amenities were updated and functioned great, the location was perfect, and above all, Carlos was extremely kind and welcoming. He was quick to respond to any questions we had and even gave us a complimentary bottle of wine. I would recommended Carlos' home to anyone that's looking for a stress-free stay in NYC.

A pleasant apartment with lots of services around (bus, metro, restaurant, bars...). A good base for discovering Manhattan just a few blocks from Time Square. Carlos was very responsive in organizing the check-in despite a flight delay of almost 24 hours. THANKS
Good living apartment, well equipped. A lot of space. Neighborhood is a little bid scary), might be not safe to stay outside at night. However good connection to JFK and Manhattan.

Great location near 42st and nothing too shady near by but does look kinda catfished cause the room is definitely wayyy smaller but comfy bed and say no smoking but I can clearly smell smoke throughout the halls. The patio is impossible to get too. But if you’re out for most of the time you should be fine!!! Great stay

This place was perfect for us - safe and stylish, with a full functional kitchen, shower and washer/dryer, everything sparkling clean.  Interesting decor - large furniture in a little condo but somehow it worked, partly because the quality and colors were very good, with eclectic touches.  Very good diner with healthy food and a good grocer (with incredible baklava) and general pharmacy were either across the street or a short few blocks walking or free shuttle bus ride away.  Roosevelt Island has one of the lowest crime rates in NYC, yet we were literally a half a block from the F train subway and the tram, so getting to the city proper only took a few minutes without needing any extra cabs or bus. So convenient!  And amazingly quiet, for NYC.  We did not meet Gina in person (the building has a doorman who checked us in), which is fine with me because when I am not out being a tourist in my many years ago NYC birthplace,  I just want to kick back and relax without having to be social, but she was available by text with no problem.  All in all I will definitely check this place first for availability for any future NYC trips.

Spacious 3 bedroom apartment in Bushwick, approximately 40 minutes from Manhattan. The rooms overlooking the small courtyard are not noisy, only the room overlooking the avenue is quite noisy. Francklyn is very accommodating because he offered to leave our suitcases before our flight. A key box allows for independent and late arrivals, which is very practical! If you want to discover Williamsburg and the street art of Bushwick, everything is directly accessible by this metro line.

Apartment very well located for good value for money... We are a family of five and we already know New York so not afraid to move away from Manathan for the metro... Three bedrooms.. Bathroom Kitchen fitted living room Maybe a few extra cutlery and plates would avoid running the dishwasher too much Correct for the price and the Distance from Manathan (20 to 30 minutes)

Overall, I was satisfied with the living condition of this apartment. It was difficult for me to find one-month rental in NYC during this pandemic period to see my family. I was really appreciated that the host agreed to let me stay for one month with a discount. The host was always responsive to my inquiries and tried their best to solve the problems.   The apartment was compact but exquisite. It was tidy and clean when I checked in, and the host prepared almost everything including kitchenware, basic ingredients, stuff used in the restroom. The apartment building had strict administration. Definitely, it was good for the purpose of safety, especially during covid-19 pandemic period. I really appreciated their hard work.  The only suggestions I come up with is that the hosts can think more about details for long-term rental if they want to.  Since it is the long rental period, I want to make sure everything is fine upon my checkin, and I don’t want to be responsible for those who happened before. I may be overthinking or picky about the condition of the apartment during the first few days, but I am being responsible for my physical health and make sure things are in their own condition.  In addition, the host can provide instructions of using the stove on the webpage. I have never used the stove with fire (probably by gas) before, and I was a little afraid if I made anything wrong during the first time. In addition, the edge of kitchen cup board was quite sharp. I tried to be careful, but I still got cut by it several times, and my girlfriend also got cut once when she put the plates back to the cupboard. Although the host said that I was the first one to report such issues, it was worth mentioning that I was probably also the first person to stay at this property for one month. It was more likely for me to use the kitchen compared to those who only stayed for several days. Therefore, problems related to kitchen might arise, but it didn’t necessarily imply that they should be ignored.   Anyway, I recommend this apartment to other people who would like to stay in NYC. It was not so crowded as the stays in Manhattan, but it was very convenient to take public transit to go to anywhere. It was really challenging for me to find the parking spot in the Roosevelt Island, but I managed to find a public parking structure across the Long Island city in which I could take the NYC ferry for one stop. The neighborhood areas were safe and were patrolled by police cars 24/7. I felt comfortable taking a walk at night.   Thank you for hosting me for one month.
Excellent host, Cindy accommodated our last minute reservation and the process was simple and stress free. Thank you so much!

The apartment is not nice, the furniture is pretty finished, dark and there is some rubbish behind the windows. The address is wrong, we can only guess why, we searched for over 30 minutes, the phone number doesn't seem to be right and it was only by chance that we found the woman who was supposed to take us to the apartment. After 10 minutes we were asked to move to the other apartment downstairs. Unfortunately, the concierge couldn't speak English and was very unsure about everything. The bedroom is musty, the apartment is actually clean but not recommended at all.

DO NOT STAY HERE IT IS A SCAM I have been using Airbnb for over five years and never had an experience as horrible as I had here. Upon arriving to the building we were locked out for two hours attempting to open the apartment with the keys provided in the lock box. It was the right key for sure but the door itself would not open, we had multiple people attempt to open the door with the same keys thinking we must be doing it wrong somehow. Host was completely unresponsive. We had no choice but to call a locksmith after two hours attempting to get the door open. Turns out the lock was completely broken and the locksmith company had told us multiple times in their professional opinions there was absolutely no way for us to get in without having changed the locks completely. We did not want to do this because it was not our home but we payed over 500 dollars for a three day stay and had no other choice. It was 400 dollars out of pocket, we informed the host of the issue in great detail the entire time, and had no response until four days later after our stay that we were not to be refunded and would be charged another locksmith fee she was charged claiming to have been locked out of her own apartment even though we left her the new keys and informed her of exactly what had happened to us. We were spoken to very rudely, she was completely unsympathetic of the issue and threatened to charge us more money. To this day we have not been contacted by the host after multiple attempts to sort the situation out.   Lock issue aside this place is not worth nearly the amount that is being charged. The entire building is completely noisy at every hour of day and night. The hallways had cat feces on every level. Trash in the hallways as well and residents smoking cigarettes on stairwells constantly. Inside the apartment the cat box (right next to the kitchen) had not been cleaned in what looked like weeks, i felt so sorry for the sweet cat. Anytime he would use his box the entire apartment would smell of cat pee and poop. The beds were very uncomfortable and there is no fan or privacy when using the bathroom or shower due to the apartment being very small in itself. We had payed for a two bedroom apartment but this place is completely unsuitable for more than one or two people. With all the stress and money spent over the course of our stay you might as well pay for a hotel room or rent a single room on Airbnb. Nothing about this place was worth one cent or one minute of our time, all we did was leave with a horrible experience having lost 400 dollars to fix this girls broken door, and to be threatened days later to have more of our money taken from us.

A great place to stay if you have more than 3 friends. The interior is greatly furnished but the house a bit old. It’s kind of scary to go out at night by walk since it seems not be a very safe neighborhood but it was fine during the day or when you arrive by Uber directly without using other public transportation means. The rest was great, clean and it’s equipped with all necessary kitchen tools.

I cannot thank Giancarlo enough for his grace and communication on one of our worst travel days. We traveled during winter storms across the east and mid-west, with flight delays and cancellations lasting nearly 24 hours. His flexibility with check-in time provided comfort during an otherwise stressful arrival. The apartment is wonderful. We had everything we needed and the patio was a treat. It’s a lovely place in a great location. We would love to return for another stay.

Jon's place is great. You're getting exactly what it's described for not. Not more, no less.  You'll be staying at real New York appartment where you can feel the vibe of the city. the apartment has everything you need to live in for an extended period of time and the roommate is super helpful if anything doesn't work super smooth.  For this price this place is just a steal - I'd come here again at any time !  thanks Jon for having me here. it's been a blast.

Great place. Calm neighborhood. Harlem is the same as movies without the "danger" shown each time. The subways are 2 min top chrono and serve the most tourist places. Maxime is a very kind and extremely helpful host. responsive and very close to you. Unique moment in New York.

Every thing was amazing and the place was very clean!! Host was very nice and accommodating! All extra stuff you could need even down to a tooth brush was provided, because of course I forgot mine so it was great. Only reason I can’t give it a 5 star is because of the location. Don’t get me wrong it was very close to jfk but very sketchy area and didn’t seem safe to be around alone or at night. Had to plan when to be back by and a lot of cops would drive around all night. Not sure if that’s a great thing or bad thing lol. But overall a great day and stay in NY.

The place was exactly like the pictures. Very clean, very accurate. Check in was super easy, they were very fast with replying with any questions. There were snacks and water in the fridge which was very helpful. Location might look sketchy but it isn’t bad at all.  Would love to stay here again.

Things I would would tell my friend if they were going to reserve this space: To begin with the positives, I do feel that the pictures accurately depict what the overall space looks like. It is indeed smaller in person than specific angled photos would have you believe, but most listings are, so that’s almost expected. The owner put -slight- effort into remodeling the apartment, which did look extremely sloppy and cheap, but the attempt to make it look even a little nice at all was still noted and appreciated. The shower water pressure was really good. That’s about where the positives end. First, the location is extremely ghetto and unsafe feeling. The apartment is connected to and above a smoke shop/mechanic (all in one) business. Luckily I brought my German Shepherd service dog that was able to make us feel a little safer when people saw us walking him down the street, but had it not been for me bringing him I genuinely would have never felt safe going outside of the apartment unless to go directly to my car, and hopefully able to get a close street parking spot. I would honestly have to recommend traveling with a buddy if booking here, otherwise you just simply don’t feel safe. First impression when walking in is that the place had an overwhelming smell of food, so much so that we regret not packing candles to light. Eventually you get used to it and don’t notice it anymore, but something to consider. Also there was leftover Chinese food in the freezer, as well as ice trays with hair and food frozen in the ice cubes. Needless to say the freezer should be avoided. Plan to either always be in the bedroom or out and about because the futon in the living room is hard as cement. Lastly, and almost most importantly (next to the unsafe location, that is), is that the bed and pillows were extremely uncomfortable. We were literally racking our brains around wondering where you can even possibly buy a bed and pillows that feel so uncomfortable. So uncomfortable, it’s like you had to put effort into making it this way. Because trust me, I have stayed in plenty AirBNBs and hotels everywhere, never really being bothered by anything regarding my actual sleeping arrangement. A bed is a bed, almost any pillow is mostly do-able. NOT HERE. I don’t know how it’s physically possible for it to be so bad, but plan to not get an ounce of sleep because this bed has less than zero support and the pillows feel like a loose sheet rolled up into a pillowcase for your head. This place defines the saying “you get what you pay for” to the deepest core. So fellow AirBNBers, you’ve been warned.

A very good stay - everything as expected. The apartment is located around 10 min walk from J line train which can get you to Manhattan or in other direction to JFK which is very convenient. It was quiet and during 9 day stay we didn`t witness any dangerous situations in the neighbourhood. The space heater available in room is a great feature as we faced couple of coldish nights.  Unfortunately we didn`t get a chance to meet Jose but he was always available via Airbnb app. Generally a good value for money.

It was a wonderful stay. The appartment is even better as shown at the pictures. Steve and his wife were a great hosts.   For Brazilians,  O apartamento consegue ainda ser muito melhor do que mostrado nas fotos. Bonito, aconchegante, moderno e limpo. Possui todo tipo de utensílio necessário para ter uma estadia confortável e até mesmo econômica. Inclusive, cozinha completa. A cama é um capítulo a parte. Que conforto!   A rua é bastante calma. Isso quer dizer que não há muito barulho de tráfego e pessoas. Por perto do apartamento, há alguns bares e restaurantes interessantes. Gostei muito do Fancy Nancy.   Meu único senão foi em relação a localização. Para quase todo lugar de Manhattan, era necessário pegar duas linhas de metro e realizar viagens de pelo menos 40min. Ok, a estação de metrô ficava a 3min de caminhada e funcionava 24h (não são todas as estações que funcionam 24h). Essas viagens de ~40min eram um pouco cansativas.    No mais, na vizinhança há alguns prédios mais deteriorados outros até fechados pela prefeitura. Não é a vizinha mais perfeita para turistas. Mas, em nenhum momento, me senti inseguro.   Por fim, estou super satisfeito com a estadia. E voltaria a me hospedar com Steve.

The location on a busy road and nestled in among businesses may present this place as a "sketchy" area, but it's not. There are many, many private homes, condos, and nice apartments on the streets around this main road, the main street itself was quiet through the night, and I felt very safe arriving by Lyft after midnight.  And did I say that I loved how close it was to the airport?!  The apartment is accurately presented in the photos. It helped me to know from reviews of the place that there are skylights in the kitchen/living area to brighten up a windowless room. The bedroom had good curtains to block out the majority of the light from the street through the night.   The snacks and drink options in the kitchen were a nice touch. There were extra towels, a few toiletries, and even a package of new toothbrushes in the bathroom.   The bed was comfortable. The futon that our daughter used would not have been as comfortable if she hadn't used the extra mattress overlay that is provided. Not a quality sleeping option for someone with back pain, but as the extra bed in the apartment, it was more than adequate.   The hosts communicated well via the Air B&B app, and were very friendly.   I will definitely look for availability here the next time I have an overnight near JFK.

We had an unexpected overnight layover in JFK. Better Home's super quick response to our request made it a low stress situation. It was located super close to the airport and easy to check in and out. Perfect and comfortable little apartment.

The place is great and the hosts were very thoughtful.  There are free snacks, fruits, eggs, water, everything you need.  You could tell the host takes great pride in their place.  The stairs is a little steep if you had big suitcases like we did.  Check-in was easy.  It gets a pretty noisy at night because it was in a busy street but the host provided ear plugs for that purpose.  On our first night, the people in 2R came home at almost midnight and were stomping on the stairs and were yelling and screaming all night that ended at 8a.  We were too scared to complain.  We chose this place because of its proximity to JFK but the area is a little sketchy.  We did not feel safe until we were inside the black metal door and the main door locked behind us.  If it was in a nicer area, this place would be so much better.  We only used the place to keep our stuff and to sleep so it was enough for what we need it for.

Jose’s place was a perfect home base for our week in Brooklyn. The room was exactly as described and was clean and comfortable (and the exposed brick!) Best of all Jose was incredibly communicative.
