We landed during Hurricane Ida and he helped us navigate that scary situation.  Bushwick is lovely, and the nearby L and J train allow you to get everywhere.

My stay was not good unfortunately the pictures will fool you! The walls were very very dirty and a lot of things were falling apart in the room and bathroom from the flooring to the bed frame. The bathroom was not clean. The bed was very firm and so squeaky it felt like it was going to break just from turning over. There’s only one light shade for the whole room.  The location was not great especially during the night it’s a bit scary. There was trash and screws on the floor outside the front door of the building. I was disappointed because reviews said it was great. I’ve stayed at many affordable places and this is the worst.

If you’re just coming to New York City, then the location is out of the way. However, it was very convenient for us as it was close to our son’s apartment. The neighborhood is kind of rough, but there are a lot of good places to eat and we met a lot of great people from the neighborhood. We never felt unsafe walking around and we would definitely stay here again. I think Jose might only rent out two rooms in the apartment, so we only briefly saw one other person, but even so, it was great to have a private bathroom.

Xie’s place was just as described in the listing. When you enter up the stairs, there are two bedrooms - One to the right and one to the left. There is also a small eat-in kitchen to the left stocked with essentials and a spacious bathroom to the right also stocked with essentials. Our bedroom had two closets and a tv, iron, ac, heater, 4 pillows, towels, etc. Our stay was very comfortable. I would definitely book again and recommend this place. Thank you Xie for a stress free and affordable stay.   Just a heads up, the house is a bit old so the water in the bathroom sink does gather up and take its time to go down and the heater makes very loud noises when its on. It was pretty warm in the room with the heater off since its an upstairs unit and the only window had an AC in it so we made use of the AC during our fall/winter stay.

Amazing stay--my partner and I were looking for a place to stay after flying into JFK, and this has been a very stress-free experience. Host is super responsive and the apartment had everything that we needed.

I asked the host to extend my stay for 1-2 hr due to my late connection flight and he threaten to add fees if i don’t leave the house on time, which i understand. But i don’t understand brining worker hitting the wall and making a lot of noise during my stay. When I highlighted what happen, he acknowledge there were workers but refuse to be sorry. He refer that I’m reacting because he did not extend my stay. This guy did not get that i could not sleep or work because his lack professional/respect behavior- of brining workers during my paid stay. I paid a lot of money to have comfy stay not to deal with such disrespectful behavior   Beside his behavior I would like to assure you the following;  1- the area is ‘’super’’ unsafe. People are gathering right next to the main entrance  door selling and buying drugs  2- the area is ‘’super’’ unsafe - repeating number (1) as a reminder  3- the house wall is too soft, you can here everything outside including noise and traffic - if you are a light sleeper,  I urge you to find different place  4- the actual house is super different from the posted pictures. Limited space and furniture is too old  5- the house building is too ‘ too old’ and still did not get why he charge such amount

If you are visiting to NYC and thinking about staying here, DO NOT DO IT!! The area surrounding the unit is very unsafe, extremely loud in the morning and at sometimes at night. The walls make a weird creaking, but water like sound. The unit had a unpleasant odor. And it is extremely inconvenient to get to the city. You can take public transportation but it’ll cost you a bus ticket, air train ticket and subway to get to the city, and it’ll take you 1hour minimum. Or pay for an Uber or taxi for $60-$90 and it’ll take 40-50 minutes. It’s better to just stay in a hotel or Airbnb in the city, pay a little more and walk everywhere. Every part of my trip to NYC was great except for this Airbnb. This is my worst experience with Airbnb

This is a one bedroom apt with the bedroom in the basement and a nice living in the main floor.  The basement is warm and dry with high ceiling and a second bathroom.  We picked this over the many options in midtown or downtown for the location.  It’s in a beautiful neighborhood and quiet at night.  The host did not leave very much basic essential items but you could get them at the drug store around the corner.

Apartment in a great location, communication has been wonderful. The room was a little noisy due to the heating pipes, if you are an easy sleeper you won't have a problem.  The neighborhood is perfect to make your stay better outside of the stress that is Manhattan, the subway line is two blocks away to be 15 minutes from downtown Manhattan.   Thank you so much Dana for everything.

My stay at Andrew’s was outstanding and very much exceeded my expectations. Andrew is a very thoughtful host with excellent communication. He was there to welcome me and walk me through the entire space. He then sent me a list of local recommendations, of which I tried two and were well worth it. The room is exactly as pictured, it was very comfortable and had everything I could need, including a mini fridge and hair dryer! Frankly, between the amenities and location this place is a steal. I’ll definitely be coming back, thanks Andrew!

Perfect for a night before or after a flight.  Please note, the host offered to store the luggage for $10, which was a good idea for us to visit a little before leaving. Be careful, quite noisy due to the proximity of the airport and the number of possible co-travelers (3 bedrooms + 2 berths in the living room).

Our stay was enjoyable because we paid close attention to the accurate listing, photos, and reviews, so our expectations were realistic. I can see how folks who don’t study the listing may be disappointed.  Pros: Location is ideal for getting around Brooklyn and NYC by public transit. The apartment is clean, functional, surprisingly quiet, and in a safe area. It is spacious, bright, and with good air flow with windows open. TV and kitchen setups are good. And the host is accommodating and responsive (see important details below!)  Cons: As advertised, it is an old building, and the apartment has not been renovated: cracks in walls and paint, sloping floors, small tub shower with low water pressure, worn furnishings. Bedroom has a single air conditioner window unit for the entire apartment, which proved insufficient on the two very hot days (of six) we stayed, and the bodega lights keep the bedroom a bit bright at night even with the room’s blackout curtains. Minor inconveniences for us, though.  Back to the (very) positive: Yana deserves 5 stars as a host because she responded almost immediately, professionally, and with due diligence to our message reporting a gas odor in the building hallway. We notified the bodega’s staff while she persisted contacting neighbors and the building owner, who eventually traced and fixed the source, which was another tenant’s stove. All the while Yana kept me updated about her actions and progress, which eased my mind since I was obviously anxious about the danger for us and neighbors – and about overreacting or (worse) under-reacting. We were able to open windows wide and minimize our time in the apartment until resolution a few hours later (it took her a while to reach the building owner). Good collaborative effort.  I would expect no less from any Airbnb host dealing with a potential safety emergency for guests, but I bet some would fall short. Not Yana. Her open communication and persistence toward resolution, presumably while working her day job, are testaments to her professionalism as a host.

Yocasta’s home served our needs perfectly for a friends trip to NYC. It was reasonably located/priced, spacious and clean. There are two subway locations within a five min walk and adequate front door security at all times. The apartment is located in a decent part of town, but the walk back from some of the subway entrances can be pretty sketchy at night. Yocasta went above and beyond in making sure we were taken care of during our entire stay and really added value to our experience. She was quick to reply to any of my questions, was easy to work with and provided good recommendations during our entire stay. This was my first time staying in an Airbnb in which the owner actually lived there when it wasn’t rented. That being said, we had complete privacy and this in no way took away from our experience. However, it would have been nice to have this detail in the listing description. I would recommend Yocasta’s home to groups looking for spacious and affordable accommodations who don’t mind taking a subway/ride to anything worth visiting in the city.

Clean, comfortable, aesthetically pleasant space. Steps away from Harlem highlights and fantastic restaurants. Andrew is among the most exceptional and caring hosts I’ve come across — check-in was stress-free, his communication was seamless, and he even assisted me in finding free street parking. Would highly recommend!

The place looks exactly like the pictures. In our opinion a little bigger than expected. We had a mediocre stay though. When we arrived. check-in went great, and looked promising from the outside.   Yet when we went in, the place looked "cleaned" on first sight, but when we opened the refrigerator and some kitchen cabinets we found a bunch of old food that was left in there, most of it even spoiled.  We also dealt with a fly-problem which the owners surely pushed off of their shoulders as if the problem could not happen in their BNB. Even when the garbage was out we still had the issue, starting with small fruitflies till the bigger usual fly. The drain in the kitchen also smelled weird.  The living room was nice with a big tv with enough ports for consoles, etc.. and a nice pull-out couch.  The bedroom was fairly clean even tho we found some spots on the bottom side of the bedsheet.  The bathroom was nice with a dual-head shower. we did find some Mold in the 2nd drawer which we aren't sure the host knew about  Last point we have is the fact that we felt the entire BNB was hosted under secrecy of the people above us (being a basement). We were told that we could not talk with the people around or in the house. This gave us some suspicion it was hosted secretly.   This review is as accurate as we could write it. there are some minor details not stated in the review.  A final and Important thing i would like to add :  We were asked to leave a 5* review and not mention any troubles for a 100$ payback.

Andrew is a great host, helpful and friendly. The room corresponds to the photos and the bathroom is shared but always kept clean, you could tell that it was cleaned every day. The room was with a good temperature, my only comments against it are that the bed makes a lot of noise and that when leaving the room there is a particular smell that is not to my liking, but it is apparently something common in NY but inside the room there was no that smell so it was good. The building is very old but inside the room everything is fine. It is 2 blocks from the subway that easily takes you to any destination, the bus is also nearby. There are supermarkets, pharmacies and restaurants. There are a lot of homeless people near the metro but nothing ever happened to us. We are grateful to have had a good stay. It is a good place to stay.

my stay with Wayne was more than terrible. he new that  i was with baby but still when i arrived apartment was not clean, sheets were used and rumbled. i was finding dirty towels in every corner of apartment. i asked hundred times and he changed towels only. not sheets... the shower is awful. the bed is broken. the locket is terribble. i wasnt able to close the door. if i close i wasnt able to open it, i was leaving door open and everytday when i was coming back to home i had a fear that my things will be stolen but thanks god, it didnt happen. the stairs!!!! soo many stairs. i  almost died during check out when took my luggage... it was my first and last experience renting apartment on airbnb. i could rent hotel with this budget....it was terrible.

My father of 70 and I stayed 5 days at Oda’s amazing place. It was a very convenient and comfortable place. The amenities were good. We slept very well in the beds, although the hospital is on the other side of the road, so I was afraid the ambulance sirens would keep us awake all night. Not the case at all. We had a big delay when we arrived and Oda was very helpful with guiding us into the city and gave us recommendations for dinner spots. Would definitely stay here again!

Close to the center of Williamsburg, BK. Relatively convenient parking. Key missing from lockbox at check in, even after I let the host know I was arriving very late after work. Host arrived 20 minutes later to let me in. Still very inconvenient and stressful situation. There were loud noises in the apartment late at night. Wear the earplugs on the nightstand or you'll be woken up by late arriving guests who are presumably drunk. Decent size room. I didn't feel comfortable using the shower. Not the cleanest looking bedding. Not so comfortable either.

We had 5 people stay here and it was actually a decent fit. It comes with a parking space, and there’s street parking if you get lucky. Near a lot of drug stores, cafes. Nice quiet area. Beds were comfortable and the TV had Roku access. Has utensils and cookware. Would stay anytime!

We had a good stay in this apartment, as in the photos, very spacious, plenty of storage space and cupboards. There were 4 of us, 2 adults and 2 children aged 11 and 15. Access to the small garden is a plus in the city! Downside, a little lack of equipment in the kitchen (tea towels, oven mitts, kitchen mats, and bowls for breakfast for example). Lively and friendly neighborhood, no insecurity felt, many small shops nearby, which saved us from going to large shops, with the added bonus of a change of scenery in terms of products, lots of exotic fruits! Washing machine and dryer, available on the ground floor.  As for Yves, a very pleasant person for his fair play! We encountered small problems with the door code, and was immediately responsive and provided solutions. A great meeting, which will leave us with very good memories!

I would not recommend this airbnb. I booked it because it was one of the cheaper manhattan spots and the closeness to Central Park (definitely the best part of it). We had appliances issues (stove didn’t work for first week) among other issues such as water dripping from apartment above in the bathroom. It’s in upper west in an ‘ok’ area it’s not the nicest but not dangerous. Easy access to target/other typical stores which you’ll need cause they don’t supply most things you’ll need like paper towels/cooking things/utensils…. the Wi-Fi seemed to disappear after like 10 if you having any gaming that requires internet. I used this place to find an apartment in manhattan and left as soon as the lease started and not looking back.

There was nothing about this place that wasnt mentioned in the listing. It is " Cozy." Two of us stayed no problem, there is another bed for two more, its not impossible , but not ideal either. All we really needed was a clean place to crash. Thats exactly what we got. I always worry about finding " critters" anywhere I go , but it was CLEAN as can be. If you like your shower as hot as possible, get a shower at night. Huge difference!  Its NYC. This is not the luxury price point. Any occasional noises I heard were just standard neighborhood noises. A door opening/ closing occasionally etc. Hallway for room has nice fresh paint job. Good central location for getting around.   5/5 . No unpleasant surprises. Everything clean. As advertised.  Good communication! Ty!

Well- it’s not my favorite air bnb I’ve stayed in.  The location- awesome. Very centrally located- I was able to access a lot by bike- and the train station isn’t far at all.  But I didn’t hear from the host until we’ll after my stay was done about a couple issues I had,  A homeless guy being where I was supposed to retrieve my key, and communication on where I could leave my bags while I explored the city. I ended up using Bounce,  a luggage storage site, but this took an hour out of my day, which was frustrating when she told me there was a place. Other than that it was great. Oh, you might want to bring a pillow and a towel- the linens are skimpy.

The bunkbed was quite flimsy and the lower mattress was very uncomfortable. There were a few holes in the mattress which made sleeping on it unpleasant. The window even closed was letting cold air in during the night so we had sleep with a heater, which was quite loud, turned on every night during our stay. The bathroom and shower were cleaned every morning but with usage during the day it never stayed that way. The location was great, everything was a walking distance away. Koichi was friendly also very responsive throughtout our stay. For the price I would‘ve prefered a bit more comfort and would choose differently next time.

This was a real steal consideringit’s sohard to get cheap places to stay in the city. It’s located in a very central location that is great and safe. You can go one street over and find a variety of great restaurants in Koreatown. Overall it was a pretty good experience.

The worst Airbnb I have ever stayed at. When I was looking at where to stay, I came across Eliza’s listing. It had great reviews and the pricing was reasonable. Little did I know that it would be the worst Airbnb experience I have ever stayed in.   I had a few issues with this place and the host. The first issue was that there were cockroaches in multiple areas throughout the studio apartment. My cousins and I arrived at our Airbnb around 12:30 AM. When we got there, we saw four cockroaches. Two in the kitchen and two by the front door. We thought we killed them all, but we were wrong. When we got back from dinner around 3 AM, we saw MORE cockroaches. There was more by the front door and a few in the closet. Once we saw this, we messaged Eliza (the host) and told her about what we were seeing. Throughout the night, my family and I had a hard time sleeping knowing that there were probably more cockroaches running around the room. What freaked us out more was that it could’ve gotten into our luggages or on our beds while we were asleep. Unfortunately, we were unable to sleep throughout the night because we were extremely scared and uncomfortable. Not to mention, there were multiple people running loudly up and down the hallway around 5 AM. Eliza called me the next morning and immediately started the phone call gaslighting me and telling me that I was being dramatic about the cockroaches. She was defending her place and said that she was “200% sure that there was maybe 1 or 2 roaches, not 6” I had told her about. She didn’t believe me until she heard my cousins screaming because we saw another roach coming out of the closet. She even made a sly comment about the pictures of the roaches I sent to her saying that her husband described them as “cute”. I am from Florida and have never seen that many roaches in my life. If there were that many while the lights were on, I cannot even imagine how many roaches are crawling around that place when no one is there and the lights are turned off.  The second issue we had was the towels were disgusting. There was white stains on some of the towels. When we touched the towels, it was damp. We asked her about this and she said they might be wet because whoever cleans her Airbnb sprays Fabreeze or something like that on it. Why would you need to spray Fabreeze on your towels if they are clean? Also why are they still damp since check in was at 4 pm and we arrived 8 hours later? The blankets are super thin and does not keep you warm whatsoever.   Not only was the room gross, Eliza’s interaction with us was not professional at all. She was trying to tell me that I was wrong and imagining things when I have photographic and video evidence of the roaches. She also claimed that the photo and video evidence we took could have been taken elsewhere. Eliza did end up refunding us for the night that we did not stay. She refunded us for half of what she received. I messaged her and told her I wanted the rest of the half we paid for. She said she was unable to do so. I told her no worries I would message Airbnb for the DIFFERENCE. She did not understand what I meant by difference and kept messaging me and said it was not ok for me to message Airbnb for more money. Speaking to friends and family about the situation, everyone said we should get a full refund. We were there for less than 9 hours. If you’re looking to find somewhere comfortable and clean to stay, DO NOT STAY HERE.

Karina’s place was a gorgeous respite from a hustle and bustle of LES. It was immaculate and thoughtfully designed. No detail was spared and we felt like we were in a five star hotel, but much cozier. Forgot a toothbrush? Karina’s got you covered. Started your period or gave yourself a small cut? Look under the bathroom sink. Extra disposable masks, disinfectant wipes, and hand sanitizer? She’s got you covered there too! If you need anything else, Target and Trader Joe’s are just down the street.   The street itself is a little busy and for some, might be a little scary at night, but Karina’s apartment feels like a warm hug as soon as you walk up. It’s is in a very convenient location with lots to do and see within walking distance. You really won’t be disappointed.

I was looking for a last minute long term stay on AirBnb and was lucky that this place popped up. It was newly listed at the time and I was pretty unsure about it at first but the place looked too good to pass up on so I went ahead and reached out to Rob and Andrea to book it. This place was definitely the BEST Airbnb I've had so far. The hosts were great, the place is AMAZING, and the location CANNOT be beat.  They were both very responsive and transparent with the place and were nice to talk to. Communication remained very open between me and them while I was there and any of my needs were very quickly addressed.   The apartment is SPRAWLING, with high ceilings and huge windows. Even the bathroom is bigger than many NYC bedrooms! The place is really clean too. When I got there everything was super well cleaned and neatly arranged. There were even cleaning materials I could use so that I could clean up after myself.    The whole space also looks AMAZING and impressed any of my friends when I had them over. The whole place was all very well designed. The lighting of the space is great in the day, and especially nice at night. All the furniture, the art, and everything is really cute. The kitchen is also pretty well stocked with cookware, plates, and all the cups you'd need.   I was out A LOT so the main come-on for me was the LOCATION. It was a 5 minute walk from Bedford station which is one stop away from Downtown Manhattan. Despite staying in Brooklyn, I spent lots of time going out in the lower east side so this worked great for me. It's also within at most 15 minutes walking distance to so many great Brooklyn restaurants like Sunday in Brooklyn, 12 Chairs, Juliette, etc. There's also lots of great shopping literally just down the street like APC, Rains, Le Labo etc.   I know this may seem like a lot of praise for an airbnb review but I was honestly so happy with the place and still cannot believe how lucky I was to find it. It's honestly so hard for me to find any fault in it, the hosts are great people and manage a great space, and honestly a good review is the least I could do. It'll definitely be at the top of my list of places to stay in when I visit NY again in the future.

All the information was just perfect! I had asked in advance for a room with a great view - at the time the 1301 was available and what can I say... the view straight from the bed was great!  The room itself was very clean, a large bathroom with a great shower. Lots of space for NYC standards and there's also a soda maker right in the hallway.  Great location in Bowery with all necessary subway connections. You don't have to be afraid at night either.  Gladly again!

Rob and Andrea's place is awesome - I had a great stay.   The place is much bigger and more spacious than it looks in the photos - super high ceilings and big windows. It get's great light and has everything you need facilities wise. There's a space setup for working and good wifi, comfy bed, proper kitchen etc.  The apartment is in a secure building in a really good location, you have everything you need right on your doorstep - restaurants, bars, shops, the works.   Rob & Andrea were super communicative and helpful, answering any questions I had promptly.   This place was a real find. I'd defo stay here again and would highly recommend to others.

Easily the worst air bnb I've ever stayed in.  For New York and "cheap" places the neighborhood is fine, a little scary at first but it's fine.  The actual place however was not fine. So first of all, Jasmine didn't understand what I was saying on the phone and I couldn't understand what she was saying either when I was trying to check in.. I understand there can be a language barrier but I was asking her basic questions which I would answer and she would ask them again.. even my Uber driver had a puzzled face.. anyways..   We got there and payed for the early check in which she was late for, we got there and she was barely changing the old sheets and "cleaning" the room before we came in, we sat on a chair while we waited in the hot room  Then she gave us a tour of the place and gave us 3 keys which was totally fine cause I like the extra security Then I noticed that other guests wouldn't lock the doors she clearly told us to lock, when I would get home at night some of the days they were opened and as a woman, obviously this is scary  Our room was not very clean when we got there, we had to buy Clorox wipes and I actually wiped one of the shelves she had and it was DIRTY, the floor wasn't swept, the bed was hard as a rock, the blanket on the big bed smelled.. why am I paying a cleaning fee if there seams to be no one who cleans??  And don't even get me started on the bathroom!! It stank!! It wasn't even a pee smell, it was just a dirty old towel smell if that even makes sense. There were old towels and sponges hanging, the plastic curtain in the shower has mold on it and the tub is just.. ugh.. the hand soap was also pure water  We left our Clorox wipes in the bathroom to not have to be carrying them around each time we went and I don't know if it was jasmine or another guest but they took them so we had to buy more  And overall we had a pretty bad experience, mainly because we just didn't feel we were in a clean place, especially with the monkey pox going around right now.. there should be more safety regulations.   My friend and I spent one week at the place and never got used to the bad smell or anything   Take my advice and pay the extra 150-200 dollars for a better place if you're staying for a week in New York.
For me a great location, 10 mins walk to subway, but area was a bit sketchy late at night.. I had no problems but thinking of Solo female travellers, I would stay here again

In the publication I saw it said that there were two rooms, one with a double bed and the other with two double beds, which in this room the two beds are not doubles but twins, it was unpleasant to find this wrong since it had the space of the double beds.  The good thing was that it had sofa beds that were used to replace the space of the beds.  Difficult to find parking. He highlighted the cleanliness and good treatment of this person.

Kito gets an A+ for hospitality! I enjoyed my stay & felt like I lucked out with him. The unit served it’s purpose for adapting me back to work in my hometown of Brooklyn, NY- which I hadn’t lived in for almost 20 years! And Kito’s kindness & responsiveness were a part of that. I wanted my first month in NYC to be stress-free & close to work, so that I could focus with my erratic work schedule, and it was. I’m grateful for that. The unit had all the amenities you need to make yourself at home- plus, the bed was extremely comfortable. I’d recommend this to anyone that works or wants to stay in the downtown Brooklyn area or needs easy access to Manhattan & Queens (the 3 and C trains are both short walks away). High quality value at an affordable price.

I really enjoyed staying with Keisha, her place was perfect for what I needed. It's situated extremely close to JFK which makes it ideal for relieving the stress of making an early morning flight. The location was quiet, and the rental spotless with everything you need to rest and feel comfortable.   I would definitely stay again

She is trying to keep this air bnb a secret from her neighbors. It’s in an apartment complex. She kept telling me to tel neighbors I’m her friend and I didn’t come from air bnb. So it’s probably on fixed rent housing. Her communication was horrible. When it was time to check out she was rushing us out early because she said she had to get to cleaning bc she had an early check in. Very sketchy

Jessica’s place is beautiful on the inside but if you’re a tourist looking to get the New York experience of everything “New York”, this is not the place for you. This neighborhood is authentic Brooklyn and can be dangerous in some areas but Jessica’s place is very safe, with three locked doors, between your residence and the outside. But beware, it gets very hot in the basement/underground in which you stay. We were able to fix it by opening windows during winter time. We had some electrical issues our last night but Jessica was quick to respond.

We found Lauren's apartment to be clean and comfortable. The apartment is in an ideal location for taking the L into Manhattan, or exploring Williamsburg. Unfortunately, Lauren did not respond to messages regarding check-in procedures until several hours before our scheduled check-in, which made for a stressful start to our stay as we did not know whether the unit would be ready/whether she could honor our booking.
Beautiful flat with an amazing(!) view. Great location as well. More importantly, Eric was so easy to talk to, made the whole process very simple and stress free. Would 1000% recommend

Our stay at Rob and Olga’s was great. The place itself gets great sunlight and is pleasant to be in during the day. I worked remotely from here for 4 weeks and it was a good experience. The apartment has all the essentials we needed for our stay (pots/pans/cooking utensils/salt/pepper, etc.). And they threw in some nice touches like coffee, tea, olive oil, soft and nice towels. You’re on a popular street in Williamsburg so city noise is totally to be expected. It’s also very close to the L line so it’s easy to get around. Rob and Olga attended to any issue immediately and were very courteous. They made our stay comfortable and enjoyable. We even tried to extend our stay but they were booked, we’d definitely stay there if we need to go back to the area.
Spacious apartment with lots of sunlight and very high ceilings. Close to Montrose L stop. Comfortable bed. Rob is very good with communication. Thanks for having me!

Apartment is nice - high ceilings, warm, well designed and has all the needed amenities (and a great coffee set up!). Wanted to also highlight that the bed is really comfy.  Location is good - in the immediate viscinity you have delis, bodegas, and some restaurants. Also pretty close to a large grocery store Food Bazaar. You’re close to both Williamsburg and Bushwick. The Montrose L stop is really close by, and the G, J, and M trains aren’t too far either, so accessing other places isn’t a problem.  Rob and Olga are great hosts, and very attentive. Overall a great stay, thanks again!
We had a great stay in Rob’s place. The apartment is comfortable and in a great location, close to cool restaurants and bars and close to the subway

This apartment brightened up our stay. Traveling around New York can be tiring, so returning to this cozy nest every evening was a treat.   The apartment is exactly as in the photos, except the roof was even better. We were very comfortable there for a week: the kitchen is functional and the metro is just a stone's throw away.  Rob and Olga respond very quickly by message and had prepared a small list of places to go.   Our favorite places in the neighborhood were: Chiara’s Pizza for huge slices of Pizza, Roberta’s for whole pizzas and Beacon’s Closet for second-hand shopping.   Thanks again ❤️

We enjoyed the stay   Rob and Olga are very responsive and helpful   The place is greatly located amidst all activities in Williamsburg and around.   Nice restaurants around   The place is great for couples although it could be noise from the road during day time.

Rob and Olga provided detailed check-in information and were super responsive throughout our stay. The location is superb with multiple bars, restaurants, and grocery stores in the neighborhood. Access to Manhattan was also really easy with the subway just a few minutes away.

Great place, near subway stations and easy to get into Manhattan. We found excellent bagels, ramen and secondhand shopping in the area! Rob & Olga were very quick and efficient with any communication or questions I had. Really appreciated how clean this apartment was. Highly recommend!
Perfect flat and location. Rob is easy to reach and makes your life also easy. For example, he nicely allowed us a late check-out. I recommend fully this palce
Great apartment and location. Olga and Rob could not have been more accommodating - highly recommended!

Rob and Olga are great hosts! They are really quick in answering and always available for information, advice or listening to your requests! The apartment has everything you need for a stay in nyc. It is also very close to the subway and you can easily reach both Manhattan and JFK airport.
Rob’s listing was in a wonderful location and had all the listed amenities! Super clean and bright and only a 5 minute walk to the station. Highly recommend!
Beautiful apartment; responsive, helpful host. Thank you very much Rob and Olga!

We stayed in Olga and Rob's place for a few days. We were in NY for our honeymoon and the place was just lovely. We had all we needed, it is in an excellent position to travel to Manhattan and around the city. Rob and Olga also gave us great advises on places to eat. Communication was always quick and helpful. Should we be back to NY, we'd surely try to rebook their place!

Great place to stay if you are not wanting to be in Manhattan whilst you visit.   Had a great stay here at Rob’s place. He is very communicative and makes sure you have everything you need.  The subway is 2 blocks away, making everywhere pretty commutable.   The area can get a bit loud and we saw quite a few fights break out between kids because there is a school down the street.   But some good little restaurants nearby.
Rob and Olga's place was great! Perfect location in a walkable area of Brooklyn and only 2 blocks from the subway to Manhattan! And the spot was a cozy place to rest and relax during our trip!

Really great place!  High ceilings and direct sunlight make it airy and bright.  Rob and Olga were very responsive and friendly.  Fun neighborhood with lots of bars, cafes and restaurants.  Close to subway (L train) so it's convenient and easy to get around.
Rob and Olga were great hosts. The place was clean and somewhere I would come back to.
Rob was an awesome host, I thoroughly enjoyed staying at the place he hosted and would definitely stay there again if presented with the chance.

Rob’s place was perfect for a weekend getaway in Brooklyn! Spotless apartment and had all the amenities we needed. Had a little trouble with the key & Rob and Olga responded asap! Great hosts- would definitely recommend.
Rob was very responsive and helpful as a host. Location was great and apartment was very clean.

Rob & Olga’s place is conveniently located for an authentic Brooklyn experience. The accessibility to coffee shops (Win Son), bakeries, restaurants and bodegas makes this an easy place to anchor yourself. The only struggle we had was with the shower curtain falling down on us a couple times. Otherwise, this is a great place to stay.

Julia was the perfect host. She was well- prepared for our arrival and was extremely responsive and helpful. Got us anything we needed. She even took us out for a night on the town!   The home itself was great. Very clean. The two rooms were very spacious with a nice aesthetic. Large kitchen and common area. Honestly a steal. Also, it’s great being beside the L and a short walk from the J.   We made some wonderful memories over the month we stayed here.

So this place really is a steal for the area. There were a couple of cleanliness issues, but nothing of huge concern. Edy was incredibly responsive and willing to go out of his way if there was an issue. If you have problems, just reach out! Other than that, it’s Brooklyn and a cheap place. Can’t get better than that!
Great place! Very nice and spacious. Spent a few days here and it felt like home .Parking is a bit of a hassle but other than that this place is a steal!

We loved everything about our room (#1307). The attention to design is incredible. The use of space is brilliant. Loved the simplicity-all the details.  The lighting soft and lovely.  The bed was super comfortable. Thanks for having a little fridge.  All of the touches were perfect.  Coming to NYC used to be stressful- but not anymore. We will be back to this delightful place!

Simple room, comfortable to sleep in and great location. The complimentary waters and Roku TV are great touches!   The bathroom could have been cleaner, it felt like I needed shower shoes to use it. Making eye contact with folks on the street while bathing was a little strange, installing a shade would help with that. Definitely recommend a new rug for outside of the tub 🤢  Overall, a decent stay and a good value. Installing some shelving / hooks in both the bedroom and bathroom will help greatly with hanging clothes, towels and storing toiletries. I think these folks might be new to AirBnb, but with a few minor upgrades to the bedroom and a bathroom overhaul, they’ll be Superhosts in no time!

Used it for one night only. The room is clean, bed is comfy and AC is necessary is summer time, so it was available.  Water was provided. Clean towels and even fresh bouquet of flowers 💐. Such a nice host!  He also put some notes and rules that are great and simple and necessary for guests!   The downside for me: 1. Creepy entrance to the building, stairs and surrounding area in the building. I was a bit afraid entering that building.  2. Couldn’t use shower bc of how old it was and I didn’t feel comfortable getting in there.

Uriel’s place was really just fine. I was in town working for a few days, and it provided me with a place to crash at night. While the bedroom seemed clean enough, the common area was being remodeled, so tools and such were strewn about. It seemed like people were in and out of the place, as the door to the apartment was often left unlocked / ajar.   Other reviews I’d read were spot on for the bathroom. I tried to limit my time in the shower, as I felt it wasn’t quite possible to really get clean in it.   Overall I’d say this is a 3-star place. Being a large man used to city life, I didn’t feel unsafe in the apartment / neighborhood, but I can see how a smaller femme might not feel the same. The place was cheap, and I suppose you get what you pay for here.

This is an excellent stay if what you’re looking for is quick and easy access to all NYC attractions. For the location, this stay is a steal! The room was pretty small, but the photos are pretty accurate in showing that. We had two beds and our private bathroom, which were clean. There weren’t any additional amenities, but it was the perfect location to walk to several attractions and the subway was right around the corner.

We were so pleased by the level of service and quality of stay at their property. It is an amazing property with great amenities and location. The communication was easy and simple, no fuss and no stress, check in and check out was seamless, and most importantly we had a very comfortable stay.

The place is very clean and a great location. However, this airbnb is unauthorized by the building and you have to sneak around the door people and lie to them upon entry. The hosts taped over the lock for what they said was a reason due to the building "changing the codes" but claimed they didn't know what the new codes were. When I felt uncomfortable leaving our belongings in an unlocked unit (due to the taped over lock) we took the tape off and got locked out. They did not answer our messages for help until mid morning the next day, after we had to get a hotel for the night. Huge hassle and disappointment. If you want to stay somewhere you have to sneak around and be made to feel uncomfortable with sketchy situations like your hosts taping over the lock, this is the place for you.

A lovely stay!  This is a beautiful two room suite in a well-maintained apartment in Greenpoint, Brooklyn.  There was much more private space than we expected - the whole living room area was ours with a door we could close!  The bathroom was shared, but immaculate with very nice soaps, shampoo, and conditioner.  The bed was very comfy and there was lots of space in the living room, I was even able to do some yoga!  Our host was very accommodating and communicative.  She let us in when we arrived and offered us coffee in the morning!  The only thing that is a bit disconcerting is that the door to the building has no doorknob…but it did seem to lock…this isn’t super surprising being in one of the many up-and-coming areas of Brooklyn, though.  The area is a definitely a bit rough around the edges, but I didn’t feel unsafe during the day or at night when I was with my Boyfriend.  I don’t think I’d have wanted to walk alone at night, but that’s par for the course in most areas of Brooklyn.  There are lots of cute shops and restaurants nearby.  We had some delicious Matcha and Coffee at Rose Wolf Coffee, enjoyed a gorgeous rooftop and eclectic drinks at Night of Joy, and we ate at Five Leaves for dinner AND breakfast, because it was so good!  This area is also a short walk to Williamsburg, and there are lots of parks in the area.  Easy to get to the L and G trains, which connect to all other train lines, so it’s no problem getting around.  It was 30-45 min into Manhattan depending on the time of day.    If you’re looking to stay in the Greenpoint area, you won’t find anything better for the value!  Highly recommend!

Nice small place to stay, host is very nice and responsive. The place is very noisy early mornings (5am) with a lot of people walking around and it goes on until 9am. The area is located in a very sketchy neighborhood, doesn't really feel like a place you'd want to take a night stroll by.

Came for my birthday weekend, and the property was clean, looks a lot like photos alittle smaller than expected, neighbor [ a lady ] was very rude when it came to parking we drove and asked can we share parking she basically wasn’t OK with that and insisted we park in the garage storage. We had to walk 10 mins late night 2blocks away to Airbnb from parking lot the entire stay and both days the lady who shared driveway with didn’t even park in driveway she park n the street in front of Airbnb which mean instead of having us use the driveway or park in front of driveway she rather we walk to parking lot that was very unsafe late night veryyyy. So If you driving I recommend don’t.  That lady was ignorant than she puts a sign saying [no parking] on the gate if the driveway the day we was leaving. How pathetic is that!!! Inside bedroom was only two flat pillows and a fleece blanket very thin and small. Had to use towel to cover the rest of body. Hard sharing little fleece with me and another person. No comforter,  no extra blankets, no extra pillows, no extra towels or rags. Everything was near by like mall, food spot, stores it was local to certain clubs and bars it’s perfect location. Besides the rudeness of whoever the lady is that lives n that apartment building, everything was OK. Enjoy my stay despite the parking. Wish he would’ve told us About the parking n the area and driveway.

We stayed one month here and it was great. The street is very quiet so sleeping wasn’t an issue (bed was also very comfortable). The room wasn’t large but we had enough space for two and the desk allowed me to work remotely. The shared living room also adds a lot of space. Their is also an adorable cat who will act as a great host as well, but never imposing (if you’re not too fond of cats he seems to be able to tell and leaves you alone). The only issue we would say is that the water pressure in the shower was a bit low, but other than that it was okay.  The area is very calm, but there are several cool bars in walking distance and the metro is a 5 minute walk away. Also close to Prospect Park which is huge and a nice break from the city if you need it. My girlfriend never felt unsafe in the area. She never came home really late (after midnight) alone though so we can’t speak to that.  Finally, Sayra is a great host. She was very accommodating and readily available when we had any questions/concerns.

Sway and Tash are very gentle and they make you feel as in home, the room was perfect and comfortable for my trip, I was tired and this place was great to stay and rest. They have a dog that you should tell him to go to his bed when come in the house, I was scared (don’t know why) but they come immediately to be there and help me to be confident with him :). Thank you guys

This is my first unpleasant review of my 10-day stay. It began well, so I will try to be fair-minded. The listing is fairly accurate in that you get a clean bedroom and towels. The place is cozy and a few blocks from the subway, so it's convenient. Check-in is smooth and effortless. However, what began as a nice stay quickly spiraled since Sayra's cat, Raja, who was very sweet and affectionate in the first few days began to get increasingly erratic with his behavior. He bit the other guest whose stay overlapped with mine and broke skin (bit me the day before this, but didn't break skin thankfully) and twice he made his mess outside the litter machine, on the bathroom floor and the kitchen floor. When I contacted Sayra, who was out of the country, she was quick to respond to me and offered to send someone to clean up but I had done so by then (had to get ready for the day and the bathroom doorway had poop and vomit). But when I asked if someone could look after Raja if he's so stressed since its not a guest's responsibility to do so, she took serious offense and escalated things within the hour to ask me if I wanted to move out (3 days to go in my reservation) and she'd contact Airbnb to see if we could do that. Worried that the reservation might be canceled unilaterally since I was on the train and a stream of msgs came in getting more and more aggressive once I got out, I contacted Airbnb support.  They got involved, and since the host seemed keen on ending the reservation (first offered a cleaning fee refund, then withdrew that offer), and I didn't want to deal with an aggressive host anymore, I chose to move out the next day and check in at a hotel. That cost a pretty penny, only partially covered by the eventual refund through the dispute resolution of Airbnb support.    The bathroom situation is less than sanitary given that the cat's litter machine is there. No odor, but litter sand often spilled on the floor as the cat went in and out. Sometimes I'd find it in the bathtub also and wash it down before getting in. The cat made a mess on the bathroom mat one night which was removed the next day by someone by the time I woke up (maybe it was the other guests or someone who came in to feed the cat) but no replacement was put in. So, if you're ok with that, these things won't bother you as they did me.

This was a great spot in Brooklyn for my partner and I to stay for a visit. We were immediately greeted by Raja the house cat, who was very friendly. The apartment was cute, bright, and inviting. It's not a hotel, and you can tell it was lived in, but that made it feel cozy, like staying at a friend's. The room itself was clean, private, had a lock, and included a window ac unit if youre there in the warm season. The bathroom is not attached to the room and is also used by the host. This was not an issue for us, but something to know if you're wanting a totally private experience. We were really only there in the evenings, and it was a great spot to relax after a day out. It was close enough to the subway that we could walk and use transit the whole week, and we never felt unsafe walking the neighborhood at night. Great experience overall!
Enjoyed my birthday weekend at NYC and booking a place to stay was stressful however having a great place to stay and great host made it a lot easier. Would recommend.

I loved this place! This was my first time visiting New York. My travels ended up being more stressful than planned so this cozy nest was the perfect place to relax. I especially loved the rooftop view. Elizabeth checked in daily to make sure I was comfortable. Her instructions on accessing the building were also seamless and helpful. The apartment itself is so cute. Highly recommend.

I have no words to describe Elizabeth and her place. First of all: don’t search anymore, this is the Best place to stay in NYC. Elizabeth’s pent house is located in a REALLY good area, totally safe, near to the subway, bakeries (try Paris Baguette! Amazing!!!) and drug stores. It’s a small place but perfect for 2 people, comfy, cozy, quiet and exactly like the pictures. The towels and the bed comforters are the softner I ever touched. Seriously!! There are Netflix and other available too. And of course, the terrace is A GREAT difference, so lovely!!! 😍 check in and check out are very easy and practical… And Elizabeth answers your questions so quickly.. she is unbelievable! She’s an Angel!! She saved my live not once but twice!! Definetly recommended!

This place did not work for us. I booked for my adult son who was traveling to New York for work. We booked a private room. Prior to arrival, we were told there was a leak in his room and he would be move to a new room. When he arrived, he was told there was no rooms available and he was to sleep on the couch or bean bag (which I guess are also available for rent) in the living room just off the kitchen. No private room, just a couch by the kitchen. I tried reaching out to the host without response. I booked another hotel, and tried reaching out for a refund with no response. I then contacted AirBnB to begin the refund process and then was immediately contacted by the host. My wife spoke with him and he would not offer a refund and stated there was a communication error. We continued working with AirBnB until our refund was issued. We knew this had a slight chance of being a sketchy rental but with a private room we took a chance. The price is good, and if you're ok with more a a communal living arrangement that may or may not be clean, then this might work for you on a budget. Just be sure you know what you're getting into and the possibility you will be placed in a bean bag for sleeping upon arrival. Good Luck.

Do not stay there! The apartment doesn't look like the pictures at all. The door of the bedroom was broken. The whole apartment smells like marihuana and there was even drugs in the table. It's dirty and even the walls were disgusting. I just stayed 10 minutes and got out running asking for the reimbursment. I didn't even got to see the bathroom. Seriously do NOT stay there.

first off, Alberto is amazing at responding to you whether you have an issue, question, comment or concern.  Right off the bat Alberto made us feel at home and provided us some treats upon arrival.  He was amazing at communicating and the stay was stress free! The home is very beautiful and the beds were amazingly comfy! The airbnb is conveniently located around little shops and the train stop! Had an amazing stay!
Had issues with check in and had to purchase an additional night of hotel at going rates. Check in was stressful. Host  was unreachable until the next day where they tried to help.

I feel the add is not how the apartment is actually portrayed. I reserved what I thought was more then a single bedroom for 3 people, thankfully one of my friends canceled, the other friend arrived earlier and checked in, when I got there I asked Jasmine for more than one blanket which she refused to give me and I ended up sleeping on the floor with a sheet. The next day she gave me a blanket and I shared the single queen with the friend.  The area is sketchy and the front door is left unlocked and open most of the time, even at night, the room has a door lock but is a cheap interior door that could be easily broken into.  I would only stay here if it was your only option and you're fine with one bed.

It was horrible.  The first bad thing was the dirty floor even when the lady gave me slippers.  Then it just got worse and worse.  Dirt and rot in the bathroom, untidy kitchen.  I stayed there for 30 minutes and  immediately left and found another place to stay.  The location is also bad, I was afraid there myself.

This is a fantastic room right in the heart of Brooklyn and a real steal. Lester was immensely helpful getting checked and was always available if I needed him. If you love natural light and plants, this is definitely the place for you! A couple minor things: - If you're picky sleeper make sure to bring your own pillows or make a request, the ones provided are high quality (Bamboo) but very large.  - While it wasn't an issue for me, if you have a sensitivity to dust make sure to check with Lester ahead of time to make sure there's no construction going on. All of the guest areas were finished, but there are additional renovations in other parts of the property that might be an issues for sensitive people. Lester provides a high quality air filter in the room too, so it's not as if most people need to worry. - The natural light is very bright in the mornings! Either bring a sleep mask or plan on getting up with the sun. =D

Apartment is just as it looks in the pictures. Nice, clean and suitable for one person or a couple. I used the gym a lot which was a bonus. Having a washing machine and dryer in an apartment in NY is rare so this was very much appreciated! Communication with the host wasn't the best but that didn't ruin my stay. The location is great, though sometimes can be a little sketchy. Just be street smart and aware of your surroundings. Walking distance to Whole Foods, Target, CVS, cafes and restaurants! Would stay here again.

1. Not ideal for 5 people. It is good for 2-3 persons only.  2.The 2nd level bed was not stable. It was scary to climb over it. 3. Toiletries were not enough for 3days for 5 people. 4. Shower head was leaking. 5. Hair dryer was not working. 6. In kitchen only one coil was working. 7. kitchen supplies (Salt and pepper) was not provided as mentioned.

Neighbourhood was a little bit scary. There is no sunshine in the house I think it was the worst condition about place. And cleaning was good. Katie was good comunicative and she helped us for late check out.

This is a perfect place for 2 people. It gave a very homey feel which makes it easy to be comfortable. It has almost everything you could ask for so it saves the stress of having to pack too much. The host is very good at reaching out to make sure you’re okay and also responding to any problems you may have; very thoughtful. This is my first positive Air BNB experience. I would 100% book again.

I used to live in NYC and have stayed in a lot of Air B&Bs. Adriana’s spot is simply the best! Spotless, adorably decorated, in a super safe neighborhood, and a steal for value! Plus, Adriana goes above and beyond as a host in communication and friendliness. Would love to book again!!!

Pros: Ok location towards downtown/financial district. Fairly spacious for NYC. Subway is a quick walk to get anywhere and it’s close to the seaport district and battery park. It has huge windows for great light and city views.   Cons: check in process is convoluted, but as it turns out it’s likely because there aren’t supposed to be Airbnbs in the building, as confirmed by the doorman, who confronted us and the poor cleaning lady when we first got there. Sweet talking the doorman helped, but it was an unpleasant way to start the trip. The rationale given for checking in at a different location (“drivers and GPS can’t find it”) is factitious as no drivers or other services had any trouble finding the building.   The place needs a deep cleaning. Badly. It’s superficially clean, but the shower curtain was disgustingly moldy and doors/molding were dirty and peeling as examples of the TLC this place needs.   The listing indicates there are two pull out cots but only one was available.

For the price, it’s not too bad but I think there are better options out there. I’d say the price doesn’t   The check in process is complex, the cleanliness was not good, when we reached out the host, we didn’t hear back from them until 8-9 hours later at 1 am. His response time was shown to average an hour, so we were surprised that we got no response. They mentioned someone would come fix the heater. They never did. We were literally trembling from how cold it was and had to sleep in the other room with another couple.   The bed, floor, and dishes were not clean. I tried to drink out of a cup and there were food particles in there.   This morning when checking out, instead of calling or texting us, they simply tried to open the door and come inside without knocking. It scared us and we were confused. There were 2 minutes till 11. That’s not ok. Especially with no warning.   Otherwise, the location is ok if you’re mostly doing things located nearby. Very quiet streets for the most part.

Flat was amazing, Anthony was really nice, friendly, and responsive. He was checking on me even before I arrived at his house. Flat was beautiful, and nice, kitchen is amazing, exactly what I was looking for.   PS: I think the room needs some upgrade to attract more guests. For e.g: would've been better if the mattress was on a bed. Also, if there was a desk and a lamp shade. TV would also be a significant addition to the room and I'm sure It will attract guests even more!!     Overall it was a good place, worth what you pay for!
Convenient and very close to everything. Uriel was very kind and helped me resolve my stay since I had been scammed elsewhere.

The apartment is new but there are many changes that need to be made.  Upon check in the fridge was not working, there was no connection to cable on the TV, and we were given incorrect password for Wi-Fi. You have no control over the heat in the apartment as there is no thermostat or heating apparatus so it is often extremely cold. The mattress in the master bedroom was soiled with what smelt like animal urine. There is a small dog downstairs that barked the majority of my stay. The dog was often left outside to bark at the back door sometimes for 20 minutes at a time even late night. Aside from the dog there’s also a lot of children that play loudly downstairs so you’re constantly hearing kids. The host Veronica is dishonest. I canceled my stay after a few weeks which apparently angered her because she tried to charge an additional $550 for cleaning fee even though I cleaned the apartment before I left. I even left behind cleaning supplies. I also had to buy better quality bedding, in addition to towels and other things that the apartment was lacking. However she still tried to charge me a a $550 fee alleging the apartment was dirty which is untrue as I have a video for insurance reasons. If you decide to stay here and keep in mind that there’s a heavy animal smell in the building, no heat and a lot of commotion downstairs late into the night. Document your stay with pictures as a host will try to scam money from you.

This apartment is in an absolutely great location.  It is exceptionally clean and uncluttered.  Everything is new.  It feels airy and bright.  The air conditioning works great--even on a hot July day and the ceiling fans were wonderful. When you first enter the building, it seems a bit sketchy, but the apartment is beautiful and it soon feels like home. Nice to have an elevator up to the fourth floor.

My family and I had to book a last minute trip for a funeral and Diamond made that process less stressful. This place is exactly as pictured and SUPER clean! Perfect location walking distance to eateries which was a big plus. Perfect spot  Thank you Diamond for everything

If I could give this place 0 stars then I would. The building is decrepit and foul smelling. The elevators and the unit itself smell like black mold. The host told me “you are being dramatic” and “that is not my concern” when I mentioned these things to him. The neighbours are awful, they smoke and are extremely loud. The beds are not possible to sleep in without waking up in pain. Finally on our last day we actually discovered cockroaches in the unit and realized that had been eating through food containers in the fridge. I have photo evidence of mold inside the microwave. To make matters worse, we all got extremely ill after staying at this Airbnb and the host called me a scam and a liar despite the photographic evidence I have provided. Save yourself some money and don’t book this Airbnb or any of his other airbnbs!
Clean house but very small space, location kind of sketchy but overall accurate description

It’s a great place to stay. It’s cheap and convenient. The towels smelled great and the beds were comfortable. However I saw policemen showed up on the same street and I heard someone yelled “help!” loudly at night when we got off the car. It was kinda sketchy to me.

I think if Stas had been there, it would have been a better experience.   I arrived at 7 pm, there was someone cleaning at that time. I went to dinner while he cleaned, but the overall cleanliness was lacking. He left on the A/C, however it probably had mold in it, which left a very unpleasant odor in the room. I slept on the couch. There were lots of dead fruit flies in the fridge, the shower was clogged with someone else's hair. The towels were left uncleaned. The overall smell was pretty strong, I understand why candles were burning.   Stas did not communicate about the light app, so at 12 am, I used a 10' ladder to turn it off.   The only real positive,  a pretty great location.

We had a great time. We explored a lot of different parts of NY as we were a 5 min walk from a subway station that took us right into the centre of NY. Marlene was lovely and checked in with us to see if we needed anything. The fridge was a bit noisy as it's a studio flat that could have an impact on sleep but we just got some earplugs and we slept really well. The bed was really comfortable and we enjoyed having access to a TV with loads of streaming platforms. Check-in and check-out was super easy. We had a great time, without any stress. Would recommend!

This place is absolutely fantastic! What you see in the pictures is exactly what it is with no filters or weird angles. It was much bigger than I thought and we had a big, comfy bed, kitchen with fridge, stove, sink, microwave, big bathroom, closet, and two couches. It has a very big TV (which we didn't use much, but enjoyed having). The place is sparkling clean and the bathroom looks new.   The place is strategically close to JFK airport, for affordable Uber rides, and at a 5-minute walking distance to the subway station to Manhattan(where we spent most of the time)(rides to Manhattan take close to 1-hour, you should plan for that). We never felt unsafe inside, and you have many delis(new yorker for convenience stores), fast food, and dollar stores right there, to stock up on supplies for the day(New York is a VERY expensive city so having this close was perfect).  Marlene is an excellent host, very easy to communicate with, friendly, fast response, and even helped me quickly with an issue I had locking myself out(my fault). Checking in and out of the place is as easy as 123. We were on a budget, so this place was perfect without compromising amenities you only get in 5-star hotels. If you are visiting NYC, you can't go wrong with this place and Marlene will give you a 5-star hotel treatment. Thank you Marlene, I hope you keep getting more guests that enjoy their stay as much as we did.

you really enjoyed our stay with Brian !everything went as planned the Airbnb was clean the neighbors were quiet the shower was amazing on the other hand it was very hot at night , a fan would be nice to have we woke up sweating a few times. and also if you’re planning on traveling to the city a lot make sure you have a rental car because commuting is slightly stressful if you are not from there but overall we really enjoyed our stay. Brian was very nice he introduced himself to us and we immediately felt more welcome.

Nen’s place was very comfortable and clean. It was just a couple blocks from the train station, with only one stop to the ferry. Very convenient. The neighborhood seems a little sketchy, but people we saw on the street were friendly, and told us the area was very safe. We had no problems walking early in the morning or late at night. Nen and her husband called and texted, checking on us throughout our visit, and gave us some helpful advice on getting around in the city.

Gorgeous and very spacious!   Check in was very easy, just a code on the door that had no issues, and we had the entire place to ourselves.  The shower was very cool, it was one of those immersive showers that have multiple spouts of water, we all really loved it, however as someone with a general phobia of other peoples showers, I will note that some of the tiles could have used a nice scrub, but it wasn’t gross by any means.  There are a bunch of beds and AC in every room.  Asad was very communicative and responds right away, even unexpectedly when I texted him around 2am haha, we booked very last minute so I was just so happy to have such a gorgeous home to stay in after a long, stressful drive.   Note: This is NOT a home you should book just to throw parties or expect to have people over, the owners put a lot of work into keeping the space clean and safe, so you are not allowed to have any guests over and you need to contain your noise level past 10pm.

Mineva's place was a nice break away from hime. A lot of supplies were included out of sincerity that wasn’t expected. Double locks at the front and personal door made me feel home. Everything was surprisingly clean and at no point did I feel like I was in a dirty or unsafe environment. TV also included a fire stick and fridge had two waters waiting for me upon my arrival. Small touches that go a long way. Thank you!

My first stay with Airbnb and what a nightmare right away! The host was unpleasant and rude from the get-go. Despite myself being a grown woman she made me feel like a child who misbehaves all the time. Instead of a warm welcome I got a bunch of strict DONT’S that didn’t match the description of the listing. The house (including my bedroom) reeked of cigarettes and weed. There was no dedicated workspace anywhere in the house. I inquired about it in advance and was reassured that there was an adequate table in every room. Instead the host told me that I should use a nightstand as my desk for an 8 hour workday. I was also offered to work at a small round dining table surrounded by barstools which was littered with her personal belongings and food and clearly was not a dedicated workspace. Next issue was with the mattress and linens. The sheets were as polyester as they come when in her listing she claimed that the room came with 1000ct Egyptian cotton set. And for some odd reason the mattress had its factory packaging (a thick plastic wrap) covering it under a mattress protector and a fitted sheet. I’ve never seen anything like it before. Sitting or lying down on it was unbearable (imaging sleeping on a plastic bag). The noise and the heat retention kept me up all night. But the last drop was in the morning. I messaged the host in the middle of the night about all the issues. For a reason unbeknownst to me she decided to come bang on my door and attempt to enter the room at 7am. After that happened I promptly called Airbnb customer service and safety line. They were able to get me out of there, provide a full refund, and book me a new place with no issues. At the moment I’m enjoying the new Airbnb and having zero issues. I guess it was just bad luck with the first place

BOOK THIS PLACE!! You will not regret it,  this place was beautiful! Katia is a wonderful host and the place that she offers is spotless, super tidy, and actually bigger than it may seem on screen. There are some stores around so if you want to grocery shop, it's just a 2-3 minute walk. The metro is about 10-15 minutes walking, but it's a safe neighborhood; even at night, you will not feel unsafe. I had a great time with my sister, and she was very responsive! It's great for the money!

No complaints, this stay was great for my month-long stay in NYC. It met all my needs. The area is nice, with lots of restaurants and not sketchy at all. Subways are about a 10-minute walk.   The host is responsive, had a small problem with the mattress and it was resolved very promptly.

The hosts are friendly, responsive and reliable. Parking was very easy. The only complaint that I have is there were  people banging on our door and being loud late at night, made me feel unsafe and didn't know what's going on out there. But overall, it was a good stay.
Dorian is a very responsive host. The communication between us was easy and clear ! The location is perfect if you want to escape the stress of manhattan.

Clean, comfortable accommodations for a single person visiting the area.  Katia was always responsive in her communications and answered any of my questions. She and her husband were very welcoming.   The sleeping area is small with a twin bed, mini-fridge, light, and closet. The kitchen and bathroom were well-kept common use areas. Hallways lights and noise from other occupants may disturb light sleepers.   Location is nearby restaurants, ATMs, and drug stores. The train is about a 15-20 min walk.   I enjoyed my stay, thank you.

I didn’t end up staying because, while Katia and her home are lovely and welcoming, the room is not fully private in that the walls don’t go up to the ceiling.  That, in combination with the lack of a window, made it COVID unsafe in my opinion.

My husband and I stayed here for six days while visiting family in Brooklyn. The location was good for us. The place was clean. The neighborhood is very diverse, and kind of gritty, but we didn't feel unsafe here. It was mostly quiet at night, although one of the neighbors had  a huge party one night, with a live band, that went until midnight or so. The beds are very comfortable, and the towels were good. The giant TV works well, and there are lots of options to choose from.  Despite the number of beds, though, I wouldn't recommend this place for more then two or three people, at most. There's not much closet space, the bathroom is very tiny, the kitchen area is small and not well-equipped, and the place is very sparsely furnished. Although it worked out fine for the two of us, we didn't think it was worth what we paid for it.

This is the worst host ever. First upon check in, the neighborhood is so unsafe with people hanging directly in front of the property at all times. In addition, there’s no parking at all and outside there were cars spray painted on with broken windows. Upon entering the front door, the door was really loose to where it barely closed. Not to mention when you get inside the property It’s super small to where you can barely place your belongings. Soon as you get inside first thing you see is bugs. If you have luggage keep it closed. It was so uncomfortable I had to leave the property within the first 5 minutes of check in. I attempted to remedy the situation with the host, however he took days to respond and when he did he was so unwilling to accommodate me with a refund. I would advise you not to stay here!!!

I got a confirmation twice and this host canceled a few hours before my arrival. I had gone through the trip with luggage and a child to find he has issues with his hotwater. I asked a neighbor if this was truth and it was not. I lost one day searching for a hotel with a low battery cell. It was the worst nightmare of a trip. I would stay away from this profile completely. Sketchy and nothing professional.

I have stayed at quite a few Airbnb’s in New York over the years but this one was BY FAR    the BEST!!!   The place was clean, in a great location and spacious compared to others in the area.  Harold wins for best host as well!!  Super fast response time, extremely friendly and so accommodating!    After a stressful drive from Virginia during a winter storm it was a welcomed surprise to have such a nice place and fabulous host.   Will 1,000% stay here again!

I feel as though I need to be 100% candid about my experience with this Airbnb rental. IT IS NOT SAFE. THE OWNER TRACKS YOU WHILE YOU ARE THERE AND WILL ENTER THE UNIT TO SLEEP IN IT DURING YOUR ABSENCE.  FURTHER DETAILS BELOW:  During our stay we noticed that the keys that were provided to us had an Apple AirTag attached to them. We figured that this was to make sure that if the keys were lost they could be found. We left the unit one day during our stay, and were gone for most of the day, but when we returned, we found the host was sleeping in the loft space inside the unit. He had entered the unit without us being there and with no prior communication informing us that he would be entering it because HE WAS TRACKING OUR LOCATION and WAITED UNTIL WE LEFT before entering to sleep in the loft space.  He made no attempt to communicate that he would be entering the unit in our absence, and we were extremely disturbed and upset to find him there. He played it off as if it were just him stopping by to find a charger, but we know he was there to sleep in the upstairs unit with us being out of the unit because he had left clothing around the door as if he was settling in for a bit, which he must have figured he could pulled off from tracking our location.   I have never had an experience like this with Airbnb, and I am extremely disturbed by this situation. Like I said, I don't believe that I am the first person that this host has done this too due to the fact he did it so brazenly, and I am extremely upset with my experience because of the sheer invasion of privacy.   When we caught him inside the unit, he pleaded with us to forgive him for his intrusion and offered to full refund us for the entire trip. At the time we only asked for $100 refund, but in retrospect, the only reason he would have felt comfortable invading the unit in our absence was likely because he had done it before and had the means to track us with the AirTag.  I am happy to report that nothing was stolen, but this invasion of privacy is extremely upsetting in retrospect.   I wouldn't feel right not reporting this to the users of this app. I will say that the unit is wonderful, and it is in a centralized location in Brooklyn, but if you don't feel safe going to sleep at night because the property owner can just enter whenever they please and without warning, and especially if they're always tracking your location, I don't believe that this unit is safe for anyone.

Great flat. Exactly like presented. Right next to the subway, 2 minutes walking which is pretty convenient. Manhattan is on the metro line. Williamsburg neighbourhood and Brooklyn not too far on walking distance. We did not felt unsafe but were careful in the neighbourhood nevertheless. I was travelling with two of my girl friends. Great communication with Harold, before and during. Quick response everytime.

I could not stay there as I was disappointed of what I had paid for.  I questioned Austine's brother who was in there to show me the room and his response was "You paid 39 dollars. What did you expect?. I found the response quite scary and I felt unsafe to be there. My friend who helped me to find the location agreed with me that it might not be safe as the response could have generated an argument.   So I did not use the accommodate. I went to look for a hotel nearby for the 2 nights.  As a result of my experience with Austine's place I did not want to go to my New Jersey Airbnb. I stayed elsewhere for 2 days before going to check at Joel's.

I don’t know why they have so many mirrors and door panels in the apartment. It felt so creepy when you staying alone. The bedroom had no light. There was no towels in the bathroom. The ac was so noisy. Anyway it did not worth the money.

Kiril was a little bit hard to catch due to a broken phone so I had a stressful check in experience. However the place was clean and easy to walk to public transport and shops. It's fitted out differently to the photographs but still comfortable.

This boat was absolutely charming! It's a perfect little getaway as a couple. You could do four people but it would be tight. It's really nice to fall asleep with the slight rocking of. the boat and wake up on the water at the marina. Very quiet and serene. It was bright in the. mornings, so I would suggest a sleep mask if you want to snooze a little later. The upper deck is great to hang out on after the sun goes down a bit, as the only thing missing up there was shade, however not sure if that is a possibility.  Blair and Brian are great with local suggestions, quick with communication and very clear with the house rules. They even left us a little gift of Prosecco for our anniversary <3  Make sure you read everything carefully that they note, as boat life is unique! It truly is a house boat that is docked, which is much different than a floating home when it comes to water, bathroom use, weight distribution, etc....Super fun experience.

This is a good choice for a short stay before/after/between flights from JFK. It's a relatively clean two-room setup in the basement of a family house with a locking door. I only saw one room, but it seems like they're the same. There's a twin bed in there and a small desk. The bed was fine, but the linens could use a change and there's plastic on the mattress that you can feel and hear (but hey, what do you expect for $45/night? :)). There's one bathroom for both rooms, soap/towels, and access to a refrigerator stocked with drinking water and a microwave.
