This gem of a place is a steal! The space is comfortable, cozy and sprinkled with intentional and thoughtful items and trinkets. It is a 5 minute walk to the subway which connects to downtown Brooklyn and Manhattan. The pharmacy, liquor store and convenience shops are also a 5 minute walk from the spot. Matt was a very kind and helpful host who gave us amazing restaurant and grocery recommendations during our stay. Next time we’re in the city, we are definitely going to be staying here!

The spacious apartment situated between different subways stations is well situated to explore manhattan if is ok for you to spent some time on the train. The flat is well equipped, furnished, decorated and clean. We found a few things in the kitchen like coffee, butter, toast and other things that made it easy to start. We were allowed to leave our suitcases in the appartment till the evening on the check out day. That was a big help and made us feel even more comfortable. Thank you for that. The only things we missed during the one week stay was a large mirror and a bit more of daylight as the apartment is in the souterrain and has only tiny windows. If the air-condition is not running the apartment gets a bit of an unpleasant smell. ____________________________
It was great stay! This house is located in a residential area so I didn’t feel any dangerous things. I’ll come again when I visit to NYC!  Thank you chiara!

The location was great.  It was quick and easy to gain access to the space.  We had two different couples staying in the other bedroom while there.  They were both nice and respectful of our space.  We couldn't hear any neighbors and the building felt safe.  There are many restaurants in the area, subway entrance iss very close, and trendy spots are within a short walking distance.  The dirty sheets were a very unpleasant shock and I wonder how long it had been since they had been washed as I've never seen sheets like that.  A lack of cleanliness of something as basic as bedding (although the kitchen wasn't clean either) has left a lasting impression on us and for this reason, it is tough for us to recommend the space.

The apartment has a great location and is very artistically designed, as you can see from the photos. Kenneth is a super nice host! Unfortunately, the communication in advance takes place with Nora, which has proven to be difficult in terms of the speed of response and the passing on of information. Unfortunately, during our stay there was a construction site in the next apartment, which is why it was unpleasantly loud between 10 a.m. and 3 p.m. As a tourist, this is a period of time in which you are probably exploring the city. The room was very clean, there were mostly unwashed dishes everywhere in the kitchen and the bathroom just got a bit dirty over time. All in all, the facilities were good and the bed was incredibly comfortable. A highlight is the beautiful balcony. The Airbnb is highly recommended for a stay in New York, as it has great public connections or you can be in China Town in 10 minutes on foot.

What you need to know: you don’t get an entire house to yourself- it’s more like a basement space below a main house. The room guests actually stay in is actually around the back of the house, below the host and their family. Once you go around back, you must walk down a slope next to bags upon bags of black trash bags on the left side near the entrance. It’s a little creepy and messy. Definitely, not aesthetically pleasing. They should get rid of those bags. In the house, the walls are quite thin and you can easily any footsteps that the  host’s family makes. They aren’t particular loud but you are reminded that any noise you make can be easily heard.   Generally, I’d recommend this house if you’re okay with the location. The train station is roughly 15 minutes from the house which is deep in a suburban neighborhood. I didn’t feel comfortable walking back by myself. It’s not an unsafe neighborhood but the house is deeply located in the neighborhood. Not to mention that you also have to go around back to get into the room. I always took Uber’s for safety and time saving reasons. If you can handle that, then it’s not a problem.   The room is great and the pictures online are accurate. It feels new and fresh and there’s a decent amount of space. It’s lovely and I liked staying there. It a nice space for about 2 people.    I’d give it a 7/10.

Very dirty place to stay. Black hair on the floors that accumulated on your socks. It was disgusting. There appeared to be blood on the sheets too. Room didn't look anything like the pictures we used to make our decision. Very misleading pictures. The Hilton Garden Inn just 1/2 mike away was a much, much cleaner place and was cheaper than this room. There was also no mention of being charged $45 to park across the street. Had to find the parking attendant who was actually sleeping in his car. Convenient to Times Square but a very unsafe feeling and dark place. Would NOT recommend staying here.

Very cool tidy space with lots of air and usable room. Great beds (not soft). Quiet and serene. Definitely recommending to others. Only thing to consider is the neighborhood. It gets sketchy after dark and subway station is a 10-min walk.

Great place. If you are driving to NYC, there’s plenty of parking space available.  Subway station is almost 10 mins walk.Also, safe and clean neighborhood. We Walked around the neighborhood at 3:00 AM and never felt unsafe.

Okay, bad stuff out of the way first: the outside entrance definitely has some sketchy city characters chilling at all times of the day. Doesn’t really bother me, but some you might find yourself uncomfortable. NEXT...I literally had to clean the entire place when I got in. Floors were sticky and black! Dirty fingerprints everywhere (on the doors and walls) and splatter marks in the kitchen. I was so disappointed and shocked at how dirty it was. I’m glad I brought sanitizing wipes. The outside patio had some trash and was definitely a lil dirty feeling but the view was on point. Couch feels like it’s going to suck you in. (I sanitized the couch too because yuck)   GOOD STUFF: the bed was very comfortable, the kitchen had wine glasses and some extra touches, bathroom was fine, and the patio is a great place to hang outside. It was surprisingly very quiet most of the time despite being in Times Square. Awesome choices of food/shopping around. Overall a good place to sleep/stay and I would do it again if it could just please be cleaned properly next time ✅

the room itself is just like the picture, however the rest of the building is a bit sketchy it kinda looks like a motel and it’s a bit creepy. we didn’t have any issues but i wouldn’t stay here again. i’d advise to bring your own towels and bedding, they seemed really used

Way to much expensive and hidden charge and fake advertising of rooms . Microwave wasn’t working and mini fridge also not working. Before check in you have to pay extra money to hotel at reception!! Bedsheets was dirty!!! Not worth it .completely scam

This is a great price for something only 30 minutes from Manhattan by subway. The reason the price is so great is that the neighborhood is quite shady. Julie is super nice and has really equipped all the rooms thoughtfully and in a practical fashion. Even though the room is very small, it is very convenient to live in due to Julie's thoughtful layout. All the rooms have a custom AC that you can turn on and off as you please.  The biggest issue with this room is noise. There's a paper thin door between this room and the next room and you can hear everything that happens in the next room (and they can hear everything you do) as if there was only a curtain between the rooms. The neighborhood is loud in general, people rev up their motorcycles in the morning, during the day, at night; people drive through the street slowly with thumping bass that's so loud that car alarms go off; the downstairs neighbors have a couple of kids that can be extremely loud and sometimes make an incredible amount of noise in the hallway in the middle of the night (midnight-2am). Definitely bring earplugs. I spent a good amount of time in this room on noise canceling headphones (during the day) or earplugs (during the night).  The door to the room can be locked but the lock is unbelievably flimsy. I think anyone who has any serious intention of getting into this room can get in easily, no matter if it's locked or not. The front door to the building often stays unlocked because people in the building do not lock it.  If you can handle the above, you'll get a great stay and an incredibly thoughtful and responsive host within 30 minutes from Manhattan at an unbeatable price.

This place was okay, but watch out – the price AirBnB charges is only a fraction of what they'll charge you. They have a whole section hidden in the "house policies" section with extra taxes & fees, including a mandatory "resort" fee which gets you "free WiFi" and access to the elevator? Apparently this is a thing a lot of hotels are doing lately, but it's shady.   The place was okay – room literally a foot or so bigger than the bed, mostly clean with a few little inconsistencies that as a frequent traveler I can deal with, but someone looking for a nice place might not. A miniscule spot on the otherwise clean sheets, wallpaper in the bathroom beginning to peel in an otherwise clean, bright white bathroom. Not a big deal depending on your expectations.   The staff was very friendly, and it was still a short walk to Penn Station. If it weren't for the shady extra fees I'd stay again.
Sketchy neighborhood extra charge when got there

The hotel is super close to midtown and the subway so everything is convenient. Aside from that, our host was very understanding of our traveling plans and allowed my partner and I to extend our stay. He took off so much unintended stress from our trip! Hoping to return when we come back to the city!

The hotel is not in a good neighborhood and has a sketchy looking entrance. (Wooden door with trash cans on either side). Rooms are so small that I couldn’t stand anywhere in the room except by the door. There was a lot of noise at night so we couldn’t sleep(no one at the reception as well). The hotel has definitely been misrepresented on Airbnb.

Fine experience overall. You get what you pay for.   The phone number on Google is disconnected. The listing on Airbnb also says check in limited to before 6pm so was worried I was gunna loose my booking or arrive and no one would be there to check me in. Pretty stressful when arriving on a 26 hour flight from Australia and flight delayed.   In the end it all worked out. Room was comfortable, cozy and staff were helpful and responsive once I had a working number.

Expect very clean rooms and common areas, convenient kitchen, nice bathroom. Don’t be afraid of transportation issues - there are a lot of city buses, very often and bus stops are very close to apartment.

This is a basic, simple place. It's in the East New York/New Lots neighbourhood. The rate of crime is technically high, but primarily due to grand theft auto, so I wouldn't recommend having a car here - other than that, it's safe to walk outside to get groceries, or to take the subway. But you don't need a car! It's a 90 second walk to the 3 line, about 35-40 minutes into Lower Manhattan. As for the apartment, it's very bare-bones but rather comfortable - a good sofa with Netflix, gas stovetop, and a comfortable bed. The owner responds quickly and the place is well kept. If you're looking for a chic, artsy loft in an adventurous area, this is NOT the place for you - however, it doesn't pretend to be. It's a cheap place that's plenty comfortable enough for a traveller just wanting a place to crash with decent proximity into the city. I had a nice 2-night stay. Thank you kindly!

Being as Honest as possible the place was decent.  Bottom line, at $55 a night in NYC You get what you pay for.  Here's a list of the Pros and Cons:  Pros. Private. barely saw other occupants  Bed was comfy Bathroom and Room was neat (looked clean but didn't smell it [needed airwicks or something to mask house smell for guest comfort]) Location was right next to train (i used uber anyway neighborhood was a little too sketchy to walk alone at odd hours)  Cons. A single Roach greeted me crawling from under the tv in the living room upon my arrival 😑  Host was non responsive and delayed responses so don't expect speedy service No small or extra towels as needed for bathroom floor (and host had the nerve to complain and put up a note up in the bathroom on dated 10/31 on "Sabathday" about the floor being wet but was i was told they were unavailable to bring a small towel. Had to bring my own blankets, which i usually do but (yu need to bring your own lien and tissue, paper towels, etc basically , youre on your own😩) Sent message after i requested a towel, about being unavailable on Sabathday on Sat. morning & not being available unless its an emergency in response to support needed. (Even tho I was only there Saturday 12am till Sunday at 5am), which was not disclosed upon my reservation. Heater must have been on 88 degrees the first night bc it was too hot to sleep at night.  Loud guest in common areas very early Saturday morning couldn't sleep well at all.  The train is loud & frequently too.  Bathroom had no tissue (then was refilled with less than a 4th of tisse roll)

Our WORST Airbnb experience, including 2 years of hosting and several trips as guests. Common areas were dirty(especially in bath everywhere was hair) and people doesn’t know they can not occupy bathroom for entire 2 hours of showering and listening to music and shout people about it. We didn’t feel safe in this place because this guest shouted at me when I knocked the bathroom door and scared me to death. Later, she had a terrible fight with someone else and her voice was all over the place. Airbnb advised us to leave the house and they will find another place after reaching out hosts. Unfortunately, hosts didn’t respond to calls from Airbnb(that’s what the case manager told us) and we had to wait for 8 hours. Our trip was ruined and hosts charged us for 2 nights, however we only spent 1 night at that place.

Weird experience I was doing my business in the bedroom & when I finish I walk out the room & there’s just a creepy white lady sitting by the door eating food IN THE DARK !! That was creepy as hell & then I say what’s up & she didn’t even say anything back straight weird

Our stay here was a little bittersweet. Elle was kind by letting us drop our luggage earlier, through an assistant, than our check in time since after we made our reservation the check in time changed to a later time because someone else rented the place the days before us and they had to clean it. Later on even before our check in we were accused of bringing an extra guest to the place and were charged more for it, but that was never the case, so I had to solve all this misunderstanding through the app with Elle. She was never at the place for the check in so we had to figure out everything on our own and mostly all the help was done through her assistant. The place itself was kind of nice, close to transportation which was a huge plus, the neighborhood was okay too, we never felt unsafe even though there were some days we were out till late in the night. The last few days of our stay the smartlock on the outside door was working poorly and even made us late to an appointment because we didn’t want to leave with the door unlocked, we never got a proper solution to it, we were just told the lock was been tricky because of the cold weather so it took it’s time to lock properly. We spent most of the day outside and arrived in the afternoon/night so of course we used mostly the front room at that time, but one day we were told off because we had the lights on in that room which we found really oddly and rude because we were paying for all the services. We eat and hang out in the front room, but every time we made sure to turn off any other light if we left the other rooms. Lastly, I made sure to told Elle in advance the time we were leaving just to made everything clear, we left much earlier than the supposed check out time and on our last few hours at the place the wifi stopped working, that made really difficult for us to take an uber to leave our reservation.

I wouldn’t recommend this place to solo female travellers because the area looks v shady. It would get v scary to walk at night since after 8 nothing is open.  There is no mirror in the room. No comforter.  The AC doesn’t really cool. It gets pretty hot at night. And there are no curtains, just blinds so the room gets super bright around 8am Tonisha and Kiana were nice to me. They let me stay till 5pm after checkout time since I had a flight at 9pm. So the hosts are definitely nice people. The common areas are also nice but the room itself does need some amenities and the area isnt the best!

This is the best place to stay if your in need to stay somewhere for the weekend! It’s very cozy , giving a great welcoming home vibe, stores are 5 minutes away walking and in a very quiet area! It’s great to travel with Uber and the apartment was extremely clean and everything was very nice for my birthday weekend, don’t be afraid to book it will be a great experience

It was a good space. I wish there were a curtain for the window because I had trouble sleeping. I was traveling alone and did not do a lot of research on the area, but it was kind of sketchy at night. So I didn't do much of staying out, or if I did, I ended up Ubering to the spot. For the price, however, I can't complain much.

This place is so confortable and clean. Hady had an amazing communication with us. Everything is like the description. Most confortable bed I’ve tried on Airbnb. Just check the location, bronx was a new experience for us. But is kind insecure because of homeless and freak people on streets.

This stylish and cosy apartment is the perfect base in NYC. Location is wonderful, the decor is eclectic and fascinating and the beds are so comfy. There were many thoughtful touches and the key pick up and drop off was stress free.

All was well with the AirBnB. The location was good in regards to access to the subway, while the area was a bit sketchy at night. It was warm, big enough for two or even three people, and was a good, quiet space to come back to after a busy day.

Let me start by saying WOW!!! Adeola is truly amazing!!! I can literally say her hospitality is by far the best I’ve ever experienced in an Airbnb’s ! I can’t stress how much of an wonderful host she was for me ! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND renting from her ! I truly enjoyed my stay at her beautiful home. me and my guest really had the time our lives lol I can’t wait to return to her home. Thanks again adeola I truly appreciate everything you’ve done during my stay. God bless you!!!

Kristie is a great host, and her place was cozy.  It's located near shops, restaurants, and other attractions, like the high-line and vessel.  Street noise could be loud at night, but I suspect that's probably the case anywhere in NYC.  Earplugs are a good idea.

Amazing stay in an amazing place! There are so many positive things I can say about this place. The apartment was beautiful, clean, and spacious. The space was pretty big for an NYC apartment, yet it still gave off an homey/cozy vibe. Check-in was a breeze. The bed and couch were comfy. The outside area gave a great view of the Chinatown area. All the best eateries and activities in Chinatown were within walking distance. It felt safe to walk around the neighborhood at night, with the F and D trains only being 7-12 minutes away and street lights everywhere. The noise-level was just fine and honestly, we didn't even notice any noise from the Two Bridges or public transportation around us while we slept. All the units worked properly. The amenities were perfect, from the washing/drying machines to all the other essentials provided. The host Shelby was super communicative, responsive, and nice about everything, and it is clear to us she cares a lot about giving her guests the best and most stress-free stay possible. We couldn't have asked for a better place and better host for our NYC stay!

This is a awesome value, location is very near subway and many shops. Min is very friendly, and doesn't get in your business.The fulton comfortably sleeps an adult six feet or under, if your taller maybe reconsiter. It's denfinately a steal for solo business traveler or someone that just need basic amenties. the sun roof access was cherry on top. I would defiantly stay again if in area. Thank you for having me over, Min!

If I could I would give Gabriel and his dump of a roach motel and fleabag Inn a -5 star. He’s crooked and should not be allowed to host anyone ever again. There was blood, urine, sweat and other bodily fluid stains on the bed covers and lining. We felt dirtier for having no choice (short of sleeping out on the park benches) but to stay here a night until we could find other accommodations. We left after our first night only because we didn't arrive to this motel until after 8:15pm and after trying for hours to get a refund and looking for another place to stay we had no choice but to stay in this ramshackled place for a night since we couldn't get into our Wyndham resort the next morning. The NYC taxes are not clear on booking under Gabriel’s house rules, but it's around 20%. You pay this additional extortion amount upon arrival and check-in, in addition to what you may have already paid on Airbnb for the room rate. Our taxes and resort fees for Gabriel totaled $174.72; $113 in addition to the $15/night or $60 for a resort fee for 4 nights. There's nothing about this place that feels like a resort, there are zero amenities and their breakfast is abysmal, a waste of money and a total joke and not gluten-sensitive-friendly at all, some crappy bagels and empty carafes of coffee to put a frown on your face in the morning mostly. So make sure you plan for an additional hefty amount for taxes and their BS daily resort fees. It was an addition to the $183.72 for 4 nights stay, which I made sure to pay in full up front for the base room rate before our trip. The floors creaked up and down the room and down the hallway. I felt like I was in a nightmare apartment here, I could hear the baby next door yelling and cooing and screaming through the wall. I could also hear people in the other rooms and their conversation from their rooms to the hallway to our room, it's as if they were in the room with us.  The room is smaller than my walk-in closet in my condo. The bed is not a queen, maybe a full. There's a couple of cracks in the tile in the bathroom, and many cracked tiles in bathtub tiles too, along with exposed wall anchors and exposed wire with conduit coming out of a hole in the bathroom wall, how completely decrepit can this place be. It's an old building and it shows everywhere and the walls are paper thin. I could hear a guy talking on his phone in the hallway and it sounded like he was in the room with us, awful. Gabriel is a crooked host, owner, do be aware and be cautious of him. We haven't been here a half hour and he would not give us a refund at all, but was totally willing to cancel our room and not honor a refund even if services were not rendered for us, he would be happy to be rid of us so he can book someone else in our stead and get paid twice for the room. Double dipping.  This place has the aura of an hourly seedy motel, it's been an utter disappointment and unbelievable headache and we haven't even been here for 2 hours.  The bathtub is moldy around the caulk, there are cracks where the handle bars were affixed on the four corners and the mounted curved shower rod is coming out of the walls or poorly tacked down and is drooped down so low and the sink is obscenely small, the same size as you would find on a cruise boat. In reality the room and bathroom isn't much bigger than the cruise ship rooms, all told. The red soap dish is cracked for our viewing pleasure.  The faux wood floors are dirty, grimey and warped in the bedroom.  There were foreign hairs found on the floor, and no they were not the color of my hair or my husband's, but then it makes sense since the floors felt dirty that they were clearly not cleaned; though they are clear about charging $50 for a cleaning fee after your visit.  The mattress springs are shot, creaky like a hand me down college dorm mattress from the latest dumpster dive at the nearby vacated lot in the midst of a gentrification project. The mattress cover on the mattress has several sweat or urine stains as well as 3 blood stains too. There are also bodily stains on the fitted sheet. My husband finds it amusing how much noise the bed makes with even the slightest of a turn.  There's a beautiful city view of the spiked rooftops of the building next door, what a gem.  The heat when turned on smelled like plastic burning. The box spring is filthy, discreetly veiled and hidden by the bed skirt. There are stains on the boxspring cover and it's ripped on a corner. I fear there are bed bugs in this place as it would not surprise me given the shambled state of the room.  I have stayed at nicer motels in up north Michigan than this cesspool of an excuse for a boutique resort hotel, this place doesn't qualify as a resort. If I were homeless I might not mind staying here at all. James was MIA, the 3 guests from 1002 called him on our behalf as well about checking out. He told us all to leave our keys at the front desk and thus we did with the guests for room 1002, he was nowhere to be found and wasn't close enough to be able to pick up our keys. BTW there's a miss on having a 24 hour front desk under the house rule, that they charge $15/day to the guests for and it was after 10am.

Had a okay stay overall! Thoughtful touches! Very clean! Bathroom area was a bit creepy, as it was outside of the actual living space , and has long white curtain sectioning off from the other part of basement. Other bothersome thing was loud noises/banging from upstairs all night and day. (no quiet time) and hard time finding parking.

It was a clean and calm environment, but the pillows on the bed were so small, nothing like the picture. Great location (just don’t walk towards 8th ave, so many homeless people) and friendly host. I had a nice stay. Thanks so much.

The hotel itself is nice and clean, and have a good service, but an important info is that while the pandemic, the hotels at the area become homeless shalters and from then till now there are a lot of homeless ppl and drug addicts at the hotel street. So it is not the nicest place  to walk in. If you are a woman - keep in mind. Maybe time will change it back.

Room is clean and convenient if a bit small, staff is professional and helpful. Location is convenient for Hell’s Kitchen/Midtown, Broadway shows, Times Square. Downside is that the place is undergoing construction (Hudson Yards neighborhood in general has  a more industrial/transitional feel) and the outside of the building/street LOOKS unfinished and sketchy at night. But was generally a safe stay.

If you’re looking for a place to stay around NY that is close to JFK/LaGuardia airport, NYC, Manhattan, korean restaurants, public transportation,etc. YOU FOUND THE PLACE. I seriously can’t stress enough how amazing our stay at Mike’s place. Considering that it was our first time renting thru AirBnb and our first time in NY, we had a blast! 💕 (Just book now, and I promise you, you won’t regret it! Mike is the best!)  Pros: -From JFK airport to Mike’s place- around 20-25mins, depending on traffic. -House is sparkling clean and really cute too! -Safe area, near restaurants, supermarkets! (You can walk if you’d like to do your exercises) -Weighted blanket, so cozy! -Basic necessities are provided, such as towels, bottled waters, cups, forks, spoons, shampoo, conditioner, toothpaste,hair dryer, etc.  -TV with netflix -2 beds & sofas  Cons: N-O-N-E   Host: Mike is very professional, helpful, kind, honest, considerate and great communicator! He even wrote us a letter welcoming us to his place with matching chocolates! So thoughtful! He went above and beyond to help us out! He even had a binder to guide us around the city!   Thank you so much, Mike for making our stay memorable. My friends and I had a blast with our first NY trip and hope to stay at your place next time again! I will recommend you to my friends! 😊

This spot was in a great location because it was around a bunch of different restaurants which was amazing. We drove to the restaurants since we had a car, but all of the food spots are within walking distance and on Northern.  We were worried about finding parking since it is in a busier area which makes it harder to find parking at night, but Mike arranged for us to have a parking spot in front of the place which was extremely helpful and relieved any stress we would’ve had from finding parking when coming back late. The place was so clean and we had our own bathroom! There was a separate entrance in the back which we loved since we didn’t disturb anyone else. There was a TV which we were able to watch amazon prime, netflix and hulu on. There were a bunch of toiletries around the bnb, so we didn’t have to worry about running out to get anything and there were also utensils in the eating area. Mike was quick at responding and gave us detailed instructions about how to get inside and even briefed us about how the bnb is cleaned between guests which we really appreciated. The price for such a great spot was also extremely reasonable and we would definitely stay here again in the future!  Thanks Mike!

This is a great apartment. The location is good, it is not far from the subway station and there are many shops and restaurants around. The apt is on the first floor, generally it is quiet though sometimes may hear footsteps from the upper floor, but I think it doesn’t matter. The decoration is wonderful, it makes you feel like at home. You can find everything you need, especially the cooking tools and materials in the kitchen. Rob is super kind, he answered our questions quickly and is willing to help. He even provided some snacks for us to enjoy! Overall we had an enjoyable experience in this apt and we definitely will come again the next time we visit New York.

The hotel is very well priced and conveniently located in the heart of the city. The staff was very courteous and professional during check in and check out. The room was very clean, however, it was also very small. It was also pretty noisy as it seems the walls are thin. I was able to clearly hear people talking in the hallway in the middle of the night which was distrubing and a little scary. The bed wasn't terrible, but certainly not the most comfortable either. I would say it is a no frills place to stay.
Great place. Very clean and easy to get to the city and also great good in the area!! And i believe it was a steal!! I would book again in a couple months when i go back.

There was some hiccups with check in but Yeelen tried his best to response ASAP. The place looks exactly as colorful as shown with a smell of vintage of course with all his collections from around the world, truly amazing. The building seems to be old with very thin walls? I can hear people walking from above and of course I was very conscious and tried very best not making any noise that will annoy the neighbour below, which on my arrival was complaining me with her/his broom. Overall this place is ideal for adventurous whos isn’t afraid. I mean the tiger and lion head paper-maché is pretty cute but can’t be quite scary for kids! :) I had a fun stay here!!

Chien-Ni was a fantastic host! She was extremely responsive and made it clear from the start she cared about my safety. She was sure to include details instructions that laid out exactly how to get to the apartment and the Airbnb room. If you consider this price point and location, you can’t beat it. It is a shared living space with others and it is a simple set up; so if you are looking for a place with tv, lounge area, etc. you might need to consider that, but the bedroom itself was cozy and comfortable. It was definitely an affordable steal in a great location!

The location of this place is great! It’s very close to Central Park and various restaurants. For the price and location this reservation is a steal. The host was always easily accessible and communication was exceptional. However, there was a bit of a hiccup on the hosts’s end in terms of cleanliness of the apartment. She said she paid someone to change the sheets before my arrival but there was a lot of hair and small black specs on the sheets when I arrived. Chien-Ni was quick to respond about my concerns and offered some solutions. Overall I recommend this place if you’re on a budget to travel.

It was much more than I expected.  Please note I’m describing experience with Chien-Ni’s room, as the rest of the space (kitchen and bathroom) is shared.   The biggest PLUS is the location.  Subway station was literally right around the corner. For those who plans to stay for several days - there are many grocery stores  with vegetable and fruit stands and coin laundromats in the area (the drier was not working at the time of our stay). Apartment window is not facing the street, so it’s quiet. The bed is comfortable and the room is clean.  I thought the hotel slippers were a very cute touch! Chien-Ni communicated promptly. Instructions for check-in and check-out were clear. I would agree with person who wrote a comment before mine - for the price this place is a steal. Our stay felt great - Thank You!

Super cozy house, fragrant, fridge full of goodies at our disposal. The neighborhood I found a little dangerous, I felt unsafe. But I didn't witness anything specific, it was just a feeling.  Very kind and attentive hosts. I just have to thank you. Great value for money. Great house.
a little sketchy but you get what you pay for. staff at the hotel were very nice.

Great little room! We were able to check in earlier and that was really appreciated. Great service! Perfect for my quick two night stay. Close to the metro. A little shady walking at night but we were just aware of our surroundings. Would recommend for the price.

Not very hospitable upon arrival, Coffee and lobby was cold and weak, Bathroom was not properly cleaned, Water leaking from ceiling on your way to the bathroom you encounter buckets full of water...  Not only is it on senneterre I put extremely dangerous especially on your way to the bathroom.. The Room was very small as expected when you're a New York City.. The location of the garage directly across the street from the hotel was probably the best thing that this hotel offered the others all I can say, I will not be staying here again
The place is very clean, the neighborhood at night is a little dangerous but we were going to the airport the next day and it was very fast and economical to find a van that would take us
Sketchy neighborhood

Bright,  great location to theaters, restaurants,  cafes, market, 24 hour drug store  next to apt building. About three blocks from metro. We were here on business and pleasure and it meet our needs well. Abe got back to us when we had questions or needed help very quickly.

The apartment is appropriate. It is equipped with all the basics that should be there (towels, sheets, dishes) and even shampoo and some food. All the descriptions in the ad matched what we found. Martina and Sheldon helped us and accompanied us throughout our vacation. The neighborhood was what complicated us the most, since it seemed dangerous to us (although we must admit that we never heard or saw anything). We recommend taking a taxi back from Manhattan if it is at night.

Amazing space and great value for money. The kitchen and bedrooms were particularly great with nice African decor, I would definitely come back! The neighbourhood, though a bit rough, felt much safer than I expected.  Areas of improvement: it got insanely hot (end of Aug) and the fans didnt seem to cut it (an AC would have been great) , also me and my friends got attacked by some insects (probably Mosquitoes) but I guess Shanti can't do much about them!

We had a very good week, great apartment. bedding more than the best (and after intense days we needed it 😉) Fans in all rooms.  Very clean In the comments we talk about dogs making noise and honestly I am hyperactive sensitive to noise and we heard them 3/4 times and again for 10 seconds just when we returned to the apartment.  I find that it is well located outside Ms not too far, supermarkets relatively close. (you shouldn't be afraid to walk miles in NY 😂) Possibility of leaving suitcases until departure.  The only negative point is the lack of natural light. I really recommend the accommodation

Shanti's place has a very urban chic vibe to it.The house is spacious and has all the amenities that one might need during their stay. It is located in inner Brooklyn.The area might seem a little rough but we did not face any issues. If you are comfortable in travelling 30 minutes to reach key places,this apartment is a steal! Surely recommended
Great host and great place only thing was the area was a little scary!!

Great place to stay. Cozy and comfortable with a short walk to the subway station. Jerry and his family greeted us upon arrival and were extremely kind and helpful. A binder was also provided with tips and suggestions for exploring the area. Very helpful. We never felt unsafe in the area.

My family, (myself, husband, and 2 kids under 10) spent a week at Joy's 2nd floor apartment, and it is exactly as pictured.  We arrived late, and both beds were made and waiting for us. Although Joy was out of town, she was very accessible via text and had someone available for any needs (though we had none). The kitchen was supplied well enough for breakfast and lunches, and though the bathroom is small, it was sufficient for the 4 of us. Parking can be a challenge late at night, but otherwise it was a nice and mostly quiet neighborhood-of course you hear the sounds of the city here and there, but that's to be expected, it's New York!  The area a couple of blocks north seem a little sketchy, but my family and I walked around it late at night, parked our car there for several days, and never once had an issue or felt threatened.  Joy's place is also very accessible to several train lines and buses.  Would stay there again.  Thanks Joy!!

This is the 1rst time I have to put a negative comment on an AirBnB host, but here it was difficult to have worst than this flat and this host. I have rented this flat (5150 euros for 46 nights) for my 19 years old son.   The late check in (7.00 pm rather than 1.00 pm) was due to previous tenants but Michael was extremely rude and disrespectful to my wife and my son (I even advised my son not to protest as he had no other alternatives) In all our previous rentings, we have never seen such a disillusion.  One rusty fork, one knife, one glass, 2 plates, one dirty pan (my son had to buy its own stuff! ) . Then a basic bed, a noisy fridge, A/C had to be switched off to be able to sleep, old valves made correct temperature impossible to get for shower, bath tub clogged.... At this level of price, despite good location, we are felt scammed. Michael had already got bad reviews but he assured me this was due to bad tenants. The quality/  price is outrageous and the welcoming is very far from AirnBnB's philosophy, so I prefer warning future tenants as I know that Michael has more flats on rent in the area.

The house is the same as the photos. It is located on a street with many large trees that provide shade. It is 10 meters from the main avenue with the M10 or M7 or M3 bus stop that takes you to Columbia with the corner of Central Park. The house is cozy with everything you need to live. It has a living room with 2 huge sofas with a dining table with 3 chairs. The bathroom has a bathtub. The room has a small sofa with a desk with 2 windows that give a lot of light all day. towels, blankets, sheets... Joy is a sweetheart of a woman, she was attentive at all times, worrying that everything was fine. What's more, I asked her for a favor to leave my suitcases and she let me... the street, like all of New York, is noisy with cars with loud music, ambulances, etc. but other than all that... nothing worrying. security... I never felt unsafe. I am a white European girl and I traveled by bus all month, night, afternoon and day... and nothing ever happened to me... if you go at your own pace and don't get involved in anything, nothing happens. There is a Lidl on the same street with cheap, quality food. The entrance to the house is independent, they have a box at the entrance with the keys.

We stayed in Emilia's place for 4 nights during our visit with my sister to New York. Emilia has been great in communication and a really nice host! She didn't bother us at all during our stay - but made herself available for whatever we needed her. The apartment is a studio of a very good size - a lot bigger than a hotel room in New York in all honesty! If you expect luxury this is not your place (it is a quite old and run down building) - but for us it was perfectly what we were looking for! It is super close to the metro (2 min walk) and in half an hour you are in Manhattan (also it connects to really good lines that can literally get you anywhere in Manhattan which is a huge bonus). I only wouldn't recommend for a girl alone if you plan to return very late at night - it is really close to metro but the neighborhood gets sketchy when it's late. Also, I didn't see air conditioning so it might be hot in the summer - but for May it was perfectly fine with the window open! We would definitely stay at Emilia's place again!

The place was nice, spacious and clean...exactly what the pictures show. They left us clean towels to use and even some complimentary beers which was nice. It was conveniently located a few blocks away to the J. However, the area can get a little sketchy at night and I did not feel safe walking alone at night. Overall good experience though.

We stayed in Chesters apartment for ten nights. The apartment is very clean and spacious. Also easy to reach by subway, which is four blocks away. Two blocks away there's a big grocery, and there are deli's almost on every corner which is convenient if you need something when you get back late at night. We had a great time in NYC (our first time) and staying in the apartment. A month before our trip our initial apartment was cancelled by that host, so we were relieved we could book another apartment on such short notice. This apartment was a bit further from Manhattan though. The neighborhood is fine, we never felt unsafe, most nights we got home around/after midnight. It might be a bit noisy during weekendnights (especially when the weather is good, as it was during our trip) because the neighbors like to hang outside and play music. But we were so tired that it didn't keep us up at night. One time the Wifi was down, but Chester fixed that quite fast. Chester was very friendly and let us know during our stay that we could get fresh linen if we needed to.  Final verdict: if you don't mind traveling a bit longer to Manhattan, and don't mind some music at the weekends it's a great place to stay!

We had a good visit in Brooklyn and Jerry’s place was very conveniently located!  The space was private, contactless check-in was easy and stress-free, and the studio had everything we needed for the 3 nights we stayed!

Chester is the perfect host, Was very kind And help us And we had The most Clean appartement i ve rented with Airbnb! The Only thing i would say is the neighborood is a little dangerous at night And noisy outside. Thanks a lot Chester And your Family!
The place is nice and clean, although it is very far from the tourist area and returning at night is somewhat unsafe.

Ruth is a truly super host! She is genuinely caring, generous, and warm-hearted. She treats people like family. She cares about guests more than making money. Stayed at her place for 3 nights, her hospitality relieved so much stress from me during my first NYC trip. I can’t thank her enough!  As for the place, it’s not a star hotel, but it certainly is a good place for travelers who don’t want to break their wallets in NYC. The location is convenient for public transportation, and the daily fresh breakfast is another bonus! Thank you again Ruth!

This was the first Airbnb experience for our hosts as well as ourselves. Wonderful!  Warm and welcoming hosts with lots of useful information. They met us at the ferry and showed us the area on the way to their place. Clean, comfortable and private like a large garden studio apartment.  They provide a coffeemaker, toaster microwave, small refrigerator and radio and tv.  Bed is a solid wood futon frame with a real bed mattress on it, more like a real queen bed. We slept very well. Clean bath with nice shower and fluffy towels.  They also gave us fruit, cereal, organic bread, peanut butter and jam, some bottled water, juice and coffee to brew. Also a variety of teas. Way more than we expected.  They also provided a lot of brochures and maps, ferry schedules and so forth. Ten minute walk to Staten Island Ferry to Manhattan (free). Perfect location to see New York!  We went out all day and touched bases with Rob and Elle in the evening for a bit sharing our experiences and getting pointers for the next day.  We recommend Rob and Elle and would go back without hesitation.

Juan was a really nice host who made our stay really easy and gave us some additional insider tips what to see and where to go out for dinner. The whole flat was very clean and it's just 5 minutes walking to the subway station. Only one negative thing: in the street were often some police men to see during night...don't know if I should feel more safe or afraid. Also one part of the window in our room was missing and was just fixed with a cardboard. But beside of this I can definitely recommend this room.

My girlfriend and I wanted to get away and found AirBNB. I was amazed how quick and easily I found Rob&Elle. For the price I say they went above and beyond, they were very pleasant hosts. They had food, coffee, tea, wifi and tv. I was also surprised that we had a private bathroom and a very comfortable bed on a futon frame.  I really enjoyed the stay all around!

Staying with Rob and Elle has been a wonderful experience. For the price they ask you get so much more than you would get in any hotel five times as expensive. They made us feel at home right from the start and went to great lengths to make our stay as pleasant as possible. They gave us valuable tips and information about public transport and sites to visit.   They made us feel very welcome while still giving us the freedom to move around by ourselves. We have joyed every minute of our stay with them and can recommend it to everyone to book with them.

We loved staying with Elle & Rob! They were excellent hosts, extremely kind & attentive to our every need. The space was very spacious and immaculate and came with a lovely basket of breakfast treats. We would definitely come back & recommend it highly to everyone wanting easy access to NYC.

This was an absolutely great place to stay when visiting NYC. Rob and Elle are generous hosts and they have obviously put a lot of thought into anticipating the needs and comfort of their guests. The room is comfortable, clean, and well-equipped – with everything you need to enjoy your down time and get a good night's sleep. This was definitely the best experience I've had with accommodation while staying in NY.   The neighbourhood is lovely, and it is very easy to get to. I found the ferry ride from Manhattan enjoyable. The short walk from the ferry is pleasant as well. I would highly recommend this room to anyone looking for a quiet place to retreat to at the end of the day.

Rob and Elle were very kind and thoughtful hosts. They have literally thought of EVERYTHING someone might need!!! Maps, ferry and bus schedules, breakfast, coffee (including decaf) AND tea, TV, DVD's, alarm clock, a parking space, fridge, microwave, EVERYTHING! They even let us know nice places to eat. It was our first airbnb experience and we were SO impressed, my partner never wanted to leave! The bed was wonderful as were the fluffy towels.  The space is large, comfortable temperature and clean. I could not recommend it more! It was brilliant!!!! If we go back to New York we would stay there.  Louisa and Jon

We enjoyed our stay at Rob and Elle's cozy room. They went above and beyond what we'd expected to make us feel at home in the very comfortable and spacious room and in New York City itself. The room is very clean and stocked with all sorts of amenities, including breakfast treats, coffee and tea. Elle will explain anything you need to know about Staten Island, Manhattan, etc., drawing from her experiences which are many and varied. After a little bike accident, I sustained a knee injury and Elle helped me in a number of ways that I will never forget. Thanks for such a warm welcome to New York!

It was our first experience with airbnb and we think Rob&Elle raised the bar really high for our next stay! Everything you read about them is true, they are welcoming, kind and really helpful. They know how to make people confortable. I wish I speak better English to have longer talks with them, they are really interesting and seems to have a lot to share!

i would no stay there again .IN the add they say nothing that it is a 5 story walk up, not good if you have health concerns, the pillows on the bed need to  go, take some of your earnings and go buy some down ones.The neighborhood has active drug dealing ,as seen on 2 nites.The loud yeling ion the block along with what sounded like gun shots was not after wood was not pleasant . I guess i was unaware that my host would be in MY ROOM ,no dresser or closet to hang anything !

My stay was amazing. The location is great and its easy to get to. The room is clean, neat and very spacious.  Elle and Rob are very thoughtful and they provide a light breakfast and refreshments which is over and above expectations. Elle is very knowledgeable about the city and how to navigate the transport system. They made me feel very welcome and I would definitely stay with them again on my next visit.

The entire experience with Rob&Elle, from initial communication to check out, was smooth, effortless, and enjoyable.  The space was thoughtful, efficient, and very pleasant.  Nearby amenities were in good quantity and of good quality.    For one person or maybe for two people this is the BEST option for a stay in NYC.    The rate was very reasonable. The SI ferry is very close and you can scoot into the city and then be in a residential neighborhood to recharge.    Host-to-guest relations were always very pleasant and most were invisible: A simple text was all it took if I needed anything (e.g., ironing board & iron) and when I got in several hours later the items were there.    I really enjoyed the stay, the location, and the privacy when I was done with the city or work.    Hoping to stay again later this year once or twice.    Don't hesitate - Book now.

It was my first experience of airbnb and New york. It was amazing. My hosts, Elle and Rob, were gorgeous host. We were so impressed by such a detailed explanation to get there from airport - they showed ways by driving us from ferry station to home. They gave us thoughtful considerations like snacks, water, light on the front door, bottles to drink, cleaning, bath stuffs and clear answers to our silly questions. We little bit worried the ferry before taking it in person, actually it enriched our trip by guiding statue of liberty and great night and day scenes of NY. We've felt great welcome and so grateful. I hope that I can visit Elle & Rob's house again. Thank you so much.

HOST:  Juan made us feel welcome by awaiting us at the door and giving us directions on what to do in the city from the moment we were settled in the apartment.   LOCATION:  The apartment is located in Harlem, and there's a subway very close by (2 min walk). The subway runs 24/7. There's some noise from the street, but I always wear earplugs when sleeping so that didn't bother me at all. The noise is a bare minimum for a city that never sleeps ;-) you should be able to get a good nights sleep!  About the area: even though we are two young girls and we came home at three in the morning a couple of times, we never felt unsafe walking through the area. People were friendly and apart from the occasional midnight catcall every one left us alone.   THE APARTMENT:  The apartment has 3 rooms (two rooms with a double bed and one room with a single bed). We stayed in one of the double rooms for a week. The room is small, but it has a comfy bed (keep in mind that a double bed in America is smaller than a European double bed - the bed is standard American sized). The room also has airconditioning, which is a must have in NYC in the summer. Towels are provided.  There's a fully equipped kitchen that has everything you need (there's cereal, coffee and pancakes Juan very kindly offers to his guest) and a bathroom with a tub (in the morning sunlight peaks through the window on your face as you shower, it's wonderful). Jean does a VERY good job at cleaning the apartment, the bathroom is cleaned daily.   We shared the apartment with two older men, who were friendly but sometimes a bit too friendly. Of course this is not Juans' fault, but it is something to consider that you do share the apartment with other people. In the common area of the appartment there's a coach, a table and a TV for all to use. There's also a security camera to monitor you. Juan didn't tell us about this, but we understand why the camera is there (to ensure the safety of his property). But still, it would have been nice if he would have told us. Keep this in mind if you would like to walk around naked in the comon areas ;-)   OVERAL:  A wonderful & clean apartment that offers you everything you need to have a pleasant stay in NYC. Juan is a friendly host who will try his very best to ensure that you have a great time! It's in an easy to acces area. I would recommend this place to anyone!
