Rob & Elle are lovely.  While they offer self checkin, they waited to greet us even though we arrived a little late. The fresh fruit, breakfast items and all the comforts of home were very much appreciated. The local information provided was very thorough. The location is great, so close to cafes and the park. The house is only a few minutes walk  to the ferry. We could not have asked for more for our brief stay. We hope to return again soon.

The house is very comfortable and very clean. It is located two blocks from the subway lines! The neighborhood seemed very comfortable, we never felt afraid! It has all the comforts for cooking!  I am very satisfied with Juan since at all times he was very kind and very attentive, always recommending places to go. The only bad thing I could say is that it doesn't have an elevator and the apartment is on the fifth floor and on the last day it was difficult for us to unload our suitcases! That's all !!

My wife and I stayed for 1 month when we first arrived in NY while looking for permanent accommodation.  The apartment matched the photos, it’s a very fun and interesting place which we enjoyed.  The street is pretty sketchy, my wife was yelled at a bit outside which was very unpleasant.  It is very close to a lot of places to eat and drink.  Unfortunately we were only given 1 set of keys which made coming and going on 2 different work schedules a bit of a nightmare. The furniture is incredibly uncomfortable, the sofa rock hard and the bed positioned in a way that one person has to climb over the other to get in and out making for some rough sleeps.  The place is fun but its a lot of money for the headaches.
Superb! Rob & Elle are very friendly and gentle people. We really enjoyed our visit in Staten Island. We highly recommend this accomodation!

Rob and Elle's place was great.  A clean and comfortable place to relax in after a long day in Manhattan. Very easy walk to the ferry. Elle provided thorough check in instructions and gave us lots of helpful information for our visit to NYC. It was a very nice touch to provide breakfast foods and snacks, and to tidy up the room while we were out. Safe neighbourhood to walk around. Would definitely stay here again!

I had a nice stay in Staten Island in Elle and Rob’s apartment. They’re so helpful and will make your stay better no matter what. Lot of supplies you can eat when your coming. I will definitely recommend this place to other people

Rob and Elle provided a fantastic space to my husband and I! The room was very large and had an attached bathroom to it. The bed was comfortable and everything was provided for our comfort. Rob and Elle gave us many maps and local tips to get around and the food on Staten Island is absolutely amazing. Would definitely stay again!
Best place to come home and relax from the busy city. We had a 2 year old who got sick the 1st night and they were nothing but understanding. Rob and Elle thank you!

Elle and Rob are very nice hosts! They consider everything and give helpful tips! They even thought of a charger with multiple USB ports! They also gave us suggestions for New Year's Eve and were available to answer any questions. The accommodation was exactly as described and spotlessly clean. Every day they cleaned the room and the bathroom and brought fresh towels. All in all a very pleasant stay... again at any time!

You can expect the Best when staying at Rob & Elle’s house. The apartment has everything you need. One of the best features is that your apartment is on the first floor, making it very easy to bring in your belongings. Everything about it is clean and crisp. Also Rob & Elle do an exceptional job of educating you about the neighborhood.   We ended up ordering out food from the Thai Restaurant 2 blocks away and it was great. And parking is pretty easy.   Also, I ended up being sick over the weekend with a recurring stomach issue, and the apartment was a perfect place to convalesce. Good to know! Hopefully next time I’ll be in better shape to explore this part of Staten Island.

Rob and Elle were great. They were very helpful and friendly. My wife, 2 daughters and I would definitely stay there again. Great location for easy ferry access and good local food and shops. Had a wonderful time.
Rob & Elles place was a lovely getaway on Staten Island.  Look forward to returning!

The accommodation is very well located a few blocks from the ferry that takes you to Manhattan (clarify that this ferry is free). The apartment is as seen in the photos, the items it includes are very convenient for breakfast at the accommodation and thus start the day.  The hospitality of Rob and Elle was impeccable, advising us on the day of arrival with convenient information and always being available for any questions, the cleanliness of the place was unbeatable. All this made us have a perfect stay.

We had wonderful holidays during our stay on Staten Island. It's a perfect spot to have both comfortable place to live and be close to Manhattan. Elle and Rob are very helpful and nice people! They give many advices about the city, what to see, how to get there, where to eat and so on. And the service of the room is unbelievable! It was totally like in a hotel! Towels, blankets, some cleaning, toiletries, breakfast stuff - everything you need is there, always on time and in a discreet way. We've been there with our daughter under 2 years. This was a perfect place for her! With a playground in neighborhood it was a perfect spot to keep her entertained everyday. And if you want some shopping - no better place to stay, there is new outlet center just 10 minutes walk from the house :) Thank you Elle and Rob for a great time! :)

Rob and Elle are great people! We have never been to the area and they had so many tips, maps, tourist advice that helped SO much. They are some of the nicest people you will ever meet, they are nice enough to empty the trash, wash the towels and restockthe snacks while we were touring the city during the day. Stay with them, you won't regret it!

I would recommend Rob and Elle's place to anyone! The most important thing for us on this visit to NYC was to be able to have free parking, as we drove out east. This was accommodated with no issues and was much appreciated! The walk to the Ferry takes 10-15 minutes, but I didn't realize how hilly Staten Island was! Elle is wonderful at showing you the routes and which bus to take to get back up the hill (in case, like us, after a long hot day in the city you're too exhausted to make the climb!). Very convenient and easy. If you're around for more than a couple days, get an unlimited metro pass which works for the subway in the city and the buses on SI. The space was exactly as advertised and had all the local information you could need for your stay. The view from the (free) ferry into, and back from, the city has amazing views! You'll have a mini-fridge in the room that is stocked with some drinks and snacks. Elle goes out of her way to give fresh towels, empty out trash, and restock fridge items. Very thoughtful and very appreciated!!! All in all, a great stay!!!

Do not hesitate to stay in Rob and Elle's place. You will not find a better value in NYC!The location is very convenient to the free Staten Island ferry,which is 25 minutes to Manhattan. The amount of space and privacy they provide can't be matched in Manhattan for the price you pay. She provides plenty of snacks and toiletries, and the bed was very comfortable. Would definitely stay here again when I visit the city. Don't forget the private bath,which many in the city don't offer. It is a complete no brainer.

I can not recommend this place, and hosts Rob & Elle, more highly!  It’s a great value for the location, just a short, free ferry hop to downtown Manhattan.  Better yet, it’s a spacious, cozy bedroom with private bath and lots of amenities (they even clean your dishes for you!).  My favorite: meeting my “junior host” Pippi, a sweet little kitten who also helped welcome me and make me feel at home! The restaurants around the corner were perfect for getting a dinner delivered after a long day of sightseeing, and the bedroom is quiet, comfy, and perfect for sleeping or just plain recharging. This will be my New York “home away from home” from now on!

Rob&Elle were wonderful hosts and their space was very clean and had lots of amenities.  Rob&Elle's knowledge of the area is excellent and recommended a few great places for dinner.  They but a quick walk from the Staten Island Ferry which makes getting to and from the city very easy (and free).  The views of the skyline are fantastic.  I would highly recommend staying here if you're not committed to staying in Manhattan.  It is nice to escape the hustle and bustle of the city at the end of the day.

This was our second trip to Rob&Elle’s. They are really nice and knowledgable about the area. It is a wonderful private space, really clean, quiet, and convenient to the city. I love the location especially for its distance from the noise and hustle of the city. An introvert’s paradise! If you drive in, you can park right in their driveway, which is a HUGE perk in NYC. We opted to take the bus home from the ferry one evening and it drops you one block from the house! The bed is comfy and there is a fan for those of us who need one to sleep (you know who you are). The fridge is a pretty good size and the room comes stocked with essentials like milk, water bottles, juice, snacks, coffee and tea. Elle even does your dishes (she will also wash and dry your clothes for a small fee)!  I cannot recommend this place more highly. You will not regret booking it!

Elle and Rob's place is clean, welcoming and cozy. It is well set-up and has everything you may need, even breakfast items and snacks. The location is fantastic, a little walk down to the Staten Island ferry, a nice way to start your day of exploring New York. Elle and Rob were very nice and welcoming, ready with suggestions what to do and see.

Rob & Elle’s was beyond anything we could have expected! Their hospitality was above par! This was our first trip to NYC and their information, tips, maps etc were complete lifesavers and made our journey so much easier!!! The space was exceptional and their thoughtful touches made it feel like home! We will definitely visit again!

We spent a wonderful week at Mack. We were very well received. Helpful and available host. He give good advices for visits and travel. He avoided a scam with a taxi on arrival. Thanks you to him and his wife. We recommanded it.

Excellent stay with Rob and Elle! A warm welcome, a perfectly clean room, all the necessary equipment, with the added bonus of a baseball game in their company! I highly recommend this address in Staten Island!

Magnificent, very clean studio with everything you need for a great stay in New York. The owners provide a whole bunch of documentation for visits, we were able to leave our car in Elle and Rob's driveway, which is a big advantage when arriving by car.    Lots of attention when we arrived with the fridge stocked with everything you need for breakfast. We highly recommend this accommodation which has nothing to envy of a hotel. Ferry is 10 minutes walk from the studio, in short an address to remember. We will come back. Thanks Rob and Elle.

We stayed at Rob&Elle's with our baby boy. We had a really good time during our staying 'cause Elle picked us up from the ferry (which is very close from the house) and also dropped us off when we left. The room is very comfy and has everything you need for an early start (coffee, bread, juice, fruits etc) The neighborhood is very quiet and safe. The ferry is a short walking distance from the house. We strongly recommend the place.

Our stay was perfect with Rob and Elle. We had everything we needed and more. It’s really nice to take the ferry in the morning and evening. The journey is easy at any time.  I highly recommend staying with Rob and Elle when visiting New York!

We really enjoyed our time with Elle and Rob and would like to highlight their quality as hosts. Both are personable and very helpful. Are immediately available to answer questions and provide advice. Elle has put together a great guidebook containing everything important in the house as well as information about the surrounding area. She even picked us up from the ferry and showed us the surrounding area and the route and briefly explained it to us. We didn't expect that. Small things for breakfast were also provided. We felt very comfortable. All in all, we have very fond memories of our time there and can only warmly recommend Elle and Rob.

Rob&Elle's room was super clean, well furnished and a perfect place to start our trip and discovery tours to Manhattan.  We felt really comfortable and would start our trip the same way again at any time.
This is a great airbnb experience in Rob&Elle’s. Thanks!
Rob and Elle are amazing host, they are really helpful. The place was extra clean, the bed so comfortable, I can higly recommend this place.

Elle & Rob's place is a joy to stay at. Better than any hotel. It was as close to home as anything I could imagine. Great mattress, great room, great towels, great location,  great price, privacy, & even greater hosts. You're 7-10 minutes from the ferry. Even closer than that to amazing food. We couldnt have asked for better. Clean, comfortable, affordable, spacious, & convenient. Stay here, you wont regret it. If their place isnt available next time, I wont visit nyc.

Rob and Elle were the best hosts anyone can hope for ! They are very nice and so is the little kitty :)  The place is homey and the location can not get any better: close to city but still very quiet. I would recommend anyone who is  looking to visit NYC to stay here because it doesn’t get any better ! A true home away from home.

This is a very well run Airbnb. You will not be disappointed in the accommodations. Large private room and full bath and an easy walk to the Staten Island Ferry. Rob & Elle were also gracious enough to provide things I didn't expect at all, like juice and milk in the fridge; a choice of cereals for breakfast, fruit, full size shampoo and body wash bottles in the shower. All-in-all, they are top-notch hosts!

Rob and Elle were such gracious and warm hosts. We felt right at home in the room which was spacious and well equipped. Besides providing breakfast, they even washed our utensils and plates. They reminded us about the weather, gave us a small gift for our special occasion, small details which added a personal touch, and made our stay exceptionally memorable.

We felt as if we were staying at a hotel! Rob & Elle were so nice and treated us with so much snacks, breakfast items, etc. The room was sparkly clean! I definitely recommend to stay at their place! The location is also great, about 5-6 minutes walk from the free ferry that goes to Manhattan.

Rob & Elle are wonderful hosts.  Their location is a quick walk and an easy ferry ride away from Manhattan.  They are lovely hosts and go above and beyond what you would expect.  The orange juice and water in the fridge every morning was a nice touch, as well.

The Lower East Side apartment was in a great location with a busy street life both day and night. Traveling alone in all hours of the day I never once felt unsafe in the neighbourhood. The apartment itself was well furnished, small and cosy - Great for someone traveling alone or as a couple. Julia was a great host, very quick and nice to respond to any questions and problems I had during my stay. I would recommend a stay at this apartment.

First I wanna say to Michael that thank you for everything! He was very kind to us!! And his breakfast is very nice! I thought almost of airbnb's host doesn't have breakfast.  We used airbnb the first time, so was afraid. but he also accepted the first time. So we were exciting!!haha  We were lucky to be the first time's customer! Anyway we could spend good time there! Thank you Michael again! We'll go back someday!

Rob & Elle's place was a wonderful get-away from exploring the city! We greatly enjoyed this large room with a private full bath!  Communication: Elle responded to my messages very quickly and gave me great tips. They were very thorough in explaining directions and rules of the home. The door outside has an electronic lock system with the guest room right downstairs for ease of access/privacy. There is also a guest book in the room explaining everything.  Cleanliness: Very clean and organized. Our towels were washed while we were away.  Amenities: Everything we could think of! Plenty of amazing complimentary breakfast items (fruit, bread with peanut butter and various jams, orange juice, milk, granola bars, yogurt, tea, coffee etc.), a few snack items, clean dishes, small refrigerator, microwave, TV,  mini electric fireplace, treadmill, clean towels, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, hairdryer, makeup remover wipes... loved their map of places all their guests were from and the trinkets people bring from abroad!  Transportation: Subway to Whitehall Terminal is easy on the red 1 train to South Ferry or green 4, 5 to Bowling Green. Riding the Staten Island Ferry is free and runs 24/7 with an awesome skyline view. Rob & Elle were gracious enough to meet us at the Staten Island terminal to pick us up and give us walking directions as well. It took us about 7 minutes to walk from the ferry to their home. There are maps in the room of the subway and surrounding area.  We had an amazing stay at our first air bnb! :)

Rob&Elle are the best hosts ever. The room is comfortable, clean with every amenity you need. It is within walking distance of the ferry and they even let you park in their driveway instead of on the street.

Clean and cozy apartment. The location was very convenient to get into Manhattan on the Staten Island Ferry.  The free off street parking was a huge bonus.  Rob and Elle were very welcoming and gave us great advice about getting to our theater on the subway.  Highly recommend this place.

Rob & Elle were amazing !! Super friendly ! They went above & beyond by far one of the best places we have stayed at ! Wish we could have stayed longer but we are def looking forward to booking with them again. There is a park right across the street which was perfect for my son he did not want to leave lol

Very cozy and clean place. The bathroom was loaded with toiletries. They left loads of snacks for us, too, which was sweet. We also had use of the driveway!  The location is really great. Very short walk to the ferry, shopping, and food/nightlife. There’s also a nice park across the street with a great  view of  Manhattan.  Thank you Rob and Elle for the cozy stay!

Rob and Elle are super hosts for a reason!! not only is their space absolutely wonderful but they are two great people. they took us in last minute and were accommodating every step of the way. the place is quiet, super clean, the bed is great. my partner and i slept like babies. there were lots of stylish/careful touches and we truly had everything we could’ve needed and more. — the location itself is amazing. a short walk from the st. george ferry which leads you directly to manhattan and there’s a nice park across the street that’s perfect for kids. thank you Rob and Elle! we look forward to staying at your place again.

We think is the best location we’ve rent, less than 10 minutes walking to the ferry. Rob&Elle we’re amazing, so kindness!! They call The Refuge, and it really is ! So cozy and Beautiful, the perfect place!!  Highly recommend!!

Thanks again for the awesome stay in the Manhattan area!  Rob and Elle welcomed us when we arrived and gave great information about the local area in addition to the plethora of visitor resources available in the room.  Loved riding the Staten Island Ferry back and forth every day.  A nice way to prep and unwind after a day hoofing and public transportation adventures in NYC!  Also, thank you for such a great space to come back to in the evenings as well as all the niceties (awesome guest book/guide, snacks, tour book access, fresh towels, etc.).  We hope to return sooner rather than later to visit again and have time to check out more of Staten Island!

Such an amazing place to stay. Super close to the ferry, parking in the driveway, very comfortable and clean, and all at a great value. Rob and Elle are so accommodating, helpful, and kind people! Would definitely stay there again and recommend to others.

It was a wonderful experience with Elle and Rob. Elle even gave us a free pick up service on the arrival. The room was neat and well maintained, including free milk, juice, yogurt, bread and cereals for Every Morning! The beds were super comfortable, the guide book was impressively thoughtful. Though it took some time to Manhattan every day, it’s like a sweet home there waiting for you. Ps, the free ferry is a friendly tool and nice journey to view the Statue of Liberty and the city from different places.

If you are looking for a spot to stay while you’re visiting NYC, this is a great choice. The room we stayed in was clean, well decorated and nicely furnished. Rob and Elle are great hosts and willing to answer any questions guests might have. Couldn’t recommend them more.
Rob & Elle's place was in a great location and just right for my budget. They were responsive, kind, and it was a pleasure staying in their home.
Third time we stayed at Rob&Elle. We are just as happy every time. Always helpful and knows everything about NYC. In addition, they are good musicians ..... Respectful to their guests. Thank You !

The accommodation is perfect! The room is really comfortable with a good bed, a TV and we were able to use the printer as we wanted. We came between two flights from La Guardia airport and for that the rental was perfect. Everything was very clean and well maintained. Thanks Giancarlo!

I will never stay in a hotel again!  Angelo was a fantastic host for our first time using AirBnb, we were scared, tired, and stressed by the time we got there and we couldn't have been happier when we arrived!  The listing is exactly as described and the subway station is just a quick walk down the street.  Great little bars and eateries are very close (Crescent and Vine would be our personal recommendation) and if you can't find anything you like, the train will take your right into downtown!  We'd never been in NYC before but having a subway station so close made the whole thing much better!  The room was perfectly clean when we arrived, as was the bathroom.  It's so quiet at night too in that area so if you're worried about the noise of the big city, don't be!  This is the PERFECT way to experience NYC, especially as someone who lives in a small town.  The locals give you that "small town" feel while being so close to the city.    Back to the room, the bedroom door could be a little finicky and having the windows open causes gusts that will make the door slam if you're not careful, this isn't a negative just something guests should be aware of.  I do believe we may have given the other guests a heart attack the first time it happened.  The bathroom was so clean that by the second night we didn't even bother wearing flip flops in the shower!  We only really saw Angelo when we were checking in but that worked for us as we had exploring to do, he always responded very promptly to any questions I had though, so that is great!  We also really appreciated the Gatorade and chips by the bed after we had toured some of the local bars, so that was a nice touch.  All in all, I couldn't be happier with how the whole experience went!  Stay here, you won't be disappointed.

The apartment is located a 10-minute walk from the Astoria - Distmard Boulevard metro station (line N).  The area is quiet and many shops and restaurants are nearby. Angelo was not available when we arrived but he made sure we could get the key. The room was bright and spacious and the bathroom was clean. Our return flight was very late so we were able to leave our luggage and pick it up later.

This was my first experience with airbnb. I had needed a place to stay for one night near JFK, but which was nice enough for me to be able to enjoy my last day in NY after a strenuous business trip. I picked Marek's place, because his apartment was near the beach, looked clean and was near JFK. I absolutely made the right decision to come here.  I arrived to the address by bus. The appartment was located about 20 meters from the bus stop, so no hassle.  The appartment itself was immaculate, and I was greeted with a bottle of delicious red wine. Marek and his son were totally accomodating.  I could not believe that such a beautiful place was all mine for the price! The bed was also comfortable.  The accomodation is literally just around the corner of Rockaway beach (about 50 steps from the door). The beach itself was clean and the area I was in was open for relaxation (but not for swimming, since the lifeguard was not on duty at the moment - however this made no difference to me, as walking through the water was allowed). I enjoyed myself thoruoghly. I collected seashells as souvenirs and forgot the stressfulness of the past few days. Interestigly, the beach was almost empty, and I had the whole area almost to myself (aside from a few joggers and their dogs). On the next day, I pulled my heavy suitcase in the other direction, and around the other corner (also only steps away from Marek's place) to the train station from which I arrived at JFK in a matter of 15-20 min. Again, absoulutely no stress! I would recommend Marek's place anytime, and would love to come again if I have business in the area. The only reason why I am giving 4 instead of 5 stars is because this is my first airbnb experience and I want to give a rating that still allows for space above.

Stay was fine as far as the room and the cleanliness.  Juan also provided a towel and toothbrush with toothepaste so that was very considerate. The neighborhood can be dangerous, as there were gunshots going off at the emd of the street around 9:00 pm on my first night there. Other than the gunshots the stay was fine.

Our stay at the loft was everything we wanted! The flat itself is exactly as it is on the images, spacious, quirky and clean. There is lots of light coming into the flat, with air con if needed and quiet at night. There is a lift upto the flat so don't worry if you have lots of luggage. The rooftop garden is absolutely wonderful, though it is locked from around 10:30pm - 8:30am. Being in South Bronx, we heard it might be a little sketchy at night but we honestly never felt or saw anything intimidating atall, the flat is on a main street pretty much around the corner from the subway stop which connects you into the city centre and other areas with no hassle atall. Even when we got our leaving date wrong (oops) Caroline was very understanding and allowed us a little while extra over our checking out time to get ready to leave! Overall, a perfect place to stay!

While I never met Caroline, she was very friendly through messages and willing to give advice on things both in central New York City and further afield at Long Island. Though I couldn't take advantage of some of the tips, I've kept them noted for my next visit.  The flat was amazing and just like the pictures (with the addition of a nice curtain between windows and bed to help separate the room). A great touch was the wee welcome book - full of little useful details like local supermarkets, nearby recommended events, nearby takeaways - together with a selection of tourist guides and a subway map. Heating and fans are available if you need them, and the heater definitely works fine (although due to the milder weather at the end of the week, wasn't needed that much!)  The neighbourhood was absolutely fine to stay in - the Bronx has a reputation but it never felt unsafe or unwelcoming during my time there. The only trouble I had was on the High Line in central Manhattan! It's only a few minutes walk from the regular 4/5 and 6 subway lines which both take you directly down east Manhattan, past Grand Central Terminal and on to Brooklyn, so it's ideally located for getting about NYC.  Great stay!

Communication with Caroline was good, Bar and kitchen upstairs were very good, the area is not so dangerous like its looks like, 7 min to metro station. Normal neighborhood in the building. Well equipped gym.

Caroline's airy loft is just as described. It is bright with street noise, so as she says - it may not be for you if dark and quiet is required for sleep.  There was some major construction going on across the street and they started pretty early with significant loud dump truck banging.  We stayed in the city until pretty late most nights, getting back around midnight. The building and neighborhood were quiet.   We used Metro at all hours and never felt unsafe. It is a quick walk to catch the 6 and you can connect to anywhere you need. Yes, South Bronx is an underprivileged and underserved area so there is more litter and less attention given to the neighborhood maintenance. This neighborhood seems to be changing - new housing being built and an increase in neighborhood stores/shops. An up and coming area with lots to explore.

I want to preface this by saying that our overall stay at Bradley and Clarissa's place was stellar. We had so much fun wandering Williamsburg and enjoying the view from the terrace. Their place felt very much like home and we were very appreciative to be allowed to have our dog with us. Brad and Clarissa's place is VERY close to a dog park which worked out perfectly for us; allowing the little man to run off some energy before exploring the city.   Our arrival/checkin was a series of unfortunate events; through no fault of Bradley and Clarissa. The previous Airbnb-ers had not left the keys where instructed and we were not able to enter the place when we arrived. Bradley and Clarissa were out of the country and unreachable, but their emergency contact responded immediately that she would be able to meet us in about an hour to let us in. Once we were able to enter, it was clear that Bradley and Clarissa's cleaning crew were also unable to enter. Luckily, we were able to locate fresh linens and towels. Clarissa and Bradley were finally able to get cell service to reach us and immediately worked to alleviate our stressful situation. Let this be a lesson to anyone who stays here - follow Clarissa and Bradley's instructions upon check out so that future Airbnb-ers can have a smooth checkin and visit. Bradley and Clarissa would have sent their cleaning crew the next morning, but we elected against it because of our pup.   I've seen a couple of people mention it, but it's true - the stairs are tough! Especially since we drove from Milwaukee (luggage/coolers) AND had our dog with us (potty breaks), the stairs were a challenge - but - not unmanageable. We elected to take cabs if we weren't planning to walk, but this place is VERY close to subway stops.   It's also important to note that we have A LOT of dietary restrictions and were able to find a TON of gluten-free and vegan options very close to us (including delivery). Overall, Bradley and Clarissa were fantastic. We completely understood that our unfortunate checkin was no fault of theirs and we were sure to follow their directions thoroughly upon our check out. We would stay here again in a heartbeat.

We had a great stay in Kieran's apartment. It is ideally located, a 5-minute walk from the Atlantic Avenue metro station. The bed is very comfortable and there is everything needed for breakfast. Very quiet, it is ideal if you want to spend some time away from the hustle and bustle of Manatthan :) The terrace is just magnificent! Be careful though if you have big suitcases, the apartment is on the 2nd floor without an elevator, and the stairs are not wide ^^ Kieran and his friend Eddie were lovely, we arrived later than expected but that was no problem. Then our flight was brought forward by a day and we had to stay an extra night: despite the presence of new guests, Eddie kindly gave us his room and Kieran lent us his bathroom so that we didn't have to change places. We recommend this apartment, Kieran is an available host and very responsive by message, and very pleasant to chat with :)

"

I stayed there for 4 months because of my exchange semester and the apartment was clean and had a good connection to the public transports.   Arnulfo was always friendly and helpful. You need about 45min to Manhatten. The neighborhood is quite and not dangerous. Would it recommend to others.   Thanks for all @arnulfo! It was a pleasure!

Great location! Half a block from the F train in a neighborhood with all the Brooklyn charms plus conveniences like Trader Joe's and Blue Bottle Coffee a couple blocks away. The apartment is just as advertised - clean, well organized, with essentials like dishes (nothing fancy), cereal, coffee, and netflix. It is not large; we stayed there with two adults and a two year old and with all the toddler gear we filled it up... Radiators provide a lot of heat in cold months, which is great, but for kids unfamiliar with hot radiators it can be dangerous - our toddler burned her back.   Sam was a great host and arranged a pack n play for the toddler to sleep in. The location is cool too, in a two story carriage house type building in the backyard of a normal apartment building. It is nice to have a garden outside your window! And it is quiet - no street noise. It is a shame that there's no picnic table or anything in that garden for the summer time.

in his description Sam says that the flat is bright,but  in fact the light must be on all day long,witch is very unpleasant in summer. In the kitchen there is not daylight because a too large refrigerator is blocking most of the main window and the blind is broken und can'tbe lifted. Why isn't repaired ? it would be easy ! In the bedroom it's the same. The blind is broken und can't be lifted. The electric light muss be on. We feel like in a prison. The garden is durty and quite in a mess. It is unpleasant ! All these remarks were allready in the comments of former visitors and Sam didn't anything.  positiv :- it is on the ground floor-it is very near of the Subway in a trendy area -we could stay until 7 p.m.

Marek was SO extremely accommodating, patient and helpful when I was initially trying to book his place, as I’m super technologically NOT advanced.  I didn’t have a lot of time during the day to call AirBnb, however Marek took time out of HIS busy day and called for me.    The place was immaculate, very close to the peaceful ocean and the backyard was an oasis of serenity.  It was a very stressful time for me, but the overall atmosphere, hospitality & thoughtfulness made it perfect for my needs.  There were many thoughtful touches thoroughly the place, like coffee, chocolates and wine.   The bus stop is half a block away, and it’s easy to take a bus to Beach 108th Street and take a short walk to the ferry to Manhattan (the ferry shuttle also runs by there too, just not as frequently).  The amazing culinary Whits End Pizza place is also half a block away by the bus stop.  Couldn’t be happier staying here, this was by far THE BEST AirBnb experience that I have EVER had.

Very conveniently located apartment in Cobble Hill, meters from the subway station with plenty of shops and restaurants around.  Area initially looks a bit shady but always felt perfectly safe. The apartment is quite small and a bit dark but everything you need for 1 or 2 people as a base in New York. Price is probably quite reasonable for location.  Communication and check in with Sam was very easy and he was quick to respond to messages. Definitely recommend.

I'm going to go against the grain here and say staying with at Marek's place was good, but not perfect. First, the pros: location is unbeatable. 100 yards or so to the beach (3 minute walk), right in the heart of town, and on a nice block. Also, the place is as sparkling clean as all the other reviewers have noted, something I very much appreciate. On these two things alone, Marek's place is probably a good pick for most people. But there were some cons, at least for me: First, check-in was supposed to be by keycode, but when I was already on my way there, Marek sent a note saying he was going to meet me in person, which was not what I was expecting. Now, in normal times I might not have minded this, but in the age of COVID, it's a different story. I think the listing needs to clearly state that you will need to meet him to check in. Second, the listing indicates all cooking essentials are available, but the only cooking oil in the house was peanut oil, which is not appropriate for most cooking needs. Again, in regular times not the worst thing, but I had to go to a not-so-nice and crowded local store for olive oil as a result, which was not a peak experience in COVID times. Third, Marek was very responsive before check-in, but during my stay he went completely off the radar, never replying to a message I sent him about a leak in the bathroom that was coming from the floor above the apartment. A rather decent-sized puddle of water pooled in my bathroom, and the ceiling was literally leaking on me as I stood in the room. It would have been nice for him to acknowledge my message and let me know what was going on. Fourth, I did not find it clear from the description that you have to cross a hall to get to the bathroom -- it's separated from the main part of the apartment. The whole downstairs is private, so not a big deal, but I did find it inconvenient and would have liked to have known about it. Fifth, and most importantly: although I was meeting friends in the Rockaways for days on the beach, I was staying in the apartment alone. Marek made a big deal about this and was constantly asking me every time I ran into him if I was "still alone." It was creepy and inappropriate. He also commented on me being "pretty" several times. If I thought he was any real threat, I would have reported him to Airbnb and left, but I don't think he is. I just think he's "old school" and probably hasn't caught on to the fact that in NYC in 2020, women aren't interested in his compliments. Personally, if I was ever traveling solo again, I wouldn't stay here. Heads-up to all my single ladies.

My daughter (age 18) and I spent eight nights at Anna’s apartment, which is bright, clean and exactly as shown. The huge windows and natural lighting was really nice. Unfortunately, we did not get to personally meet Anna but we were greeted by her friend Ximena, who is awesome, friendly and welcoming. She even had fruit waiting for us at arrival; that was a real nice touch. Both Anna and Ximena were always quick to respond to our communications/questions. Metro’s G train (Myrtle/Willoughby stop) is very close and made getting around easy and convenient. We never felt unsafe in the neighborhood, even when arriving back to the apartment late at night. You will find everything needed (e.g., iron, hair dryer, pots/pans, etc.) at the apartment for a comfortable stay. There are several stores nearby for groceries, too. We found Anna’s place a perfect choice for us; we would definitely stay here again. If you are not used to typical city noise at night, pack earplugs (I did).

The reviews don’t lie. Francine and Soon have a beautiful home, and they are the nicest hosts. If it’s your first time in NYC, like it was for us, this is a perfect place for you. They are happy to help you with recommendations whatever you have in mind so you won’t feel like a stranger in this big city. The location is great too, the subway station is right on the corner, so you can easily reach anything. Finally, don’t be afraid of Harlem, it’s a very friendly neighborhood! We were very happy with everything really :)

My stay at Rosa’s place doesn’t happened as I expected. In fact, I had to leave earlier.   The home was clean but I started to be allergic to something after a night there … maybe the heating or the dusty blanket is to blame … not really rosa’s fault but I prefer to tell it for allergic people.  I also didn’t feel confortable in the house.  First, because the place was really outdated. There  was no windows in the room and the heating was so high, that we had to open the windows all the time in the middle of winter. ( super ecological by the way …) This leads to a a stuffy atmosphere.  Also, I didn’t feel really welcome. You can feel that Rosa is not renting for pleasure of hosting. She welcomes you by asking the negative corona test and explain you the strictly rules of the home. Maybe if you are so scared about covid, you shouldn’t rent your room and keep your place safe…   But Rosa has also been flexible and let me leave earlier after a big talk. So thanks for that.

I was in NY because a family member was having major surgery at NY (Columbia) Presbyterian Hospital (he's home and doing well), not for a vacation.  The apartment is less than a 10-minute walk to the hospital, less than 5 to the pediatric section.  I was happy to be a block or two from 2 supermarkets, a major drug store, a McDonald's, a Chipotle, and several other restaurants.  Only 3 short blocks to the subway - 20 minutes to Penn Station or Times Sq, and not much longer for my one indulgence - the 9/11 Museum (see it!).  I didn't really have to talk about what's nearby because Wendy has done something extraordinary.  After your reservation is confirmed, she'll email a 5-page PDF, her own personal guidebook of stores and restaurants in the area, places to visit near subway stops, etc.  If I had been doing normal tourist stuff and not already been very familiar with NYC, it would have been a great help.  My familiarity allows me to vouch for its accuracy.  Also, Wendy was very open to my suggested addition, so it might be there waiting for you.  Unfortunately, I didn't meet Wendy.  I slept in her immaculate room on her very comfortable bed while she was visiting family.  (We kept in touch via frequent emails.)  I did meet her roommates, and, as someone old enough to be their grandfather, I enjoyed talking with them.  The basic rule of cleaning up after oneself was followed.  I rarely observed a dish in the sink, and they didn't last long.  One other thing that I found amazing:  all around the apartment were post-it notes identifying mostly "guest storage" and other relevant areas for my use.  One other point.  There was a time when parts of the area between Columbia's main campus and the hospital weren't safe.  That's no longer true.  My cousin, who works at the hospital and lives near the main campus told me that she doesn't hesitate to walk home after work.
Gillian is a responsive host and the whole process was seamless and stress-free. The location is Super awesome too!

Velma is a very sweet and pleasant host. Check in was excellent and flexible. The apartment is quite run-down and needs some refurnishment. We experienced a somewhat unpleasant house smell that might just be a result of an old building. One of the bedrooms does not have a door, but only a curtain towards the living room. There was a water leak from the ceiling during our stay. It can happen in any house if you are unlucky. Velma and her husband performed very professionally and pleasantly and did what they could to minimize the inconveniences. They are totally sweet and help you with everything that you ask. It is ten minute walk to Subway. A safe and colorful neighbourhood with a few local delis around.

Great location of this spacious Studio apartment - actually there are 3 divisions in the apartment:  living/sleeping area, bathroom and hallway and kitchen.  Elevator and laundry are key.  Located so close to food markets, drug stores, banks and restaurants - all one needs to get along.  Highly recommend if one is going to Brooklyn Heights!!  Host is very kind and easy to reach.  Thanks again.  Sorry had to leave so unexpectedly:(

Noise issues made this a less than a pleasant stay.   Host responsive and tried to address noisy upstairs tenants but could not.   Street noise pretty intense.   In between two 24 hour drug stores so continues all night.  Bed comfortable, kitchen well-equipped, lots of hot water and good water pressure.  If noise doesn't bother you, a nice place to stay.

We had a wonderful stay at Ray's place! The place is beautifully decorated especially the Paris themed bedroom. Clean and generously supplied.  The view is amazing night and day! The location is perfect walking distance to many sites, easy to get subway. Corner fruit stand, drug store and small market less than half block away. We were first timers to NYC so this was perfect! Ray checked on us to see if we needed help which was kind of him. A definite yes to staying here again someday!

Irena's place is PERFECT in so many ways. Loved the upper east side location, just a short walk to the express Q train. The ensuite bathroom was great and the room included lovely amenities (mini fridge, microwave, toiletries etc) that just made the stay that much better. A few minutes walk to drug stores, grocery stores etc.  Irena was friendly and responsive. It is also at the front of the apartment so you don't feel like you are bothering anyone leaving early or coming in late. Great place.

The location is great, the room is tight for 2 people and I felt a little uncomfortable that the door could not be locked. Also there was a strange guy on the 1st floor that kept moving furniture in and out almost every night we were there in a dark room, not sure if he was the super in charge but he was a bit scary.

Gina was very friendly and welcoming, and showed us around the neighborhood when we arrived.  She is quite responsive and contacted us when we needed to talk with her. She was also flexible regarding arrival and leaving times.  The location is very convenient to Central Park and public transportation.  The apartment was as we expected from the description, except that there was a serious infestation of cockroaches, which was an unpleasant surprise. We also had no hot water for two days; Gina tried and was able to resolve this problem, and the hot water was restored as we were leaving.

Had a wonderful time at Jon’s place- was one of our favorite air bnb experiences by far! For the location, amenities, and coziness it is a steal for a nyc rental. Also, Jon was super friendly and easy to communicate with and the place was really clean. Everything was perfect- highly recommend!

Never got to meet Kaytlin until the night before my check-out after a 10 day stay. Location is fabulous but the apartment does not deliver. It's one notch above camping with a hefty price tag. Didn't worry me that the shower recess was in the kitchen ( that was detailed in the listing), it was the deteriorating state of the shower recess itself which made it feel unclean and mouldy. Also bath mats and hand towels that had not been replaced after previous guest/s, kitchen lino which had not seen a broom or mop in sometime and it was certainly not a 'Bright" space, but it was quiet.  The gas smell in the 'private toilet' in the hallway is unbearable (and am unsure why no-one has mentioned it before in reviews as its pervasive in that space) so if you have already booked ask to use the toilet next to it. It has no key and no gas smell. Clearly all the other residents use it so I am not sure why Airbnb guests can't? Why do we have to put up with the smelly (and who knows, maybe dangerous) toilet space? Loved New York. Loved Greenwich Village. What a shame I can't say I loved this space.

I would give our stay a 4 out of 10. The neighborhood was really nice and felt safe. We were less than a 5 minute walk from Penn station so that was amazing. The apartment itself was pretty clean for the most part and the bed was comfortable. However during our first night I felt itchy in bed like there were bugs crawling on me. And I turned on the light and saw a little black bug jump across the sheets. For the remainder of our stay I continued to get bitten by bugs when I was in bed and I got a bunch of big bites. So if it wasn't for that I would have given the place an 8 or 9. But the bugs in bed made the stay very unpleasant.

Very nice apartment, neat but not comfortable for 2 people. It has good light and is one block from Central Park but in Harlem which makes arriving late very uncomfortable and the neighborhood is scary although one block away the avenue gives you peace of mind. There are 3 subway lines nearby and it is very convenient to get around wherever you want to go. Going back to the apartment itself, in the kitchen there are small cockroaches crawling on the cutlery, plates and all the things you use. We also found a cockroach on the living room furniture. My boyfriend and I feel very uncomfortable and we don't recommend it unless it doesn't bother you to be surrounded by cockroaches and at breakfast you find it on your cup.

Accommodation conforms to the description.  Ideally located, close to the metro, shops and many centers of interest.  We were very surprised by the calm! Traveling with a baby, we were afraid that he would be woken up at night by this city that never sleeps but no, no noise!  The apartment could do with a little paintbrushing and a slightly more modern decor but it is very comfortable and the bedding is excellent! We appreciated the baby bed provided to us!  Michelle is very responsive in responding to requests and everything went really well. And we appreciated the cold bottles of water when we arrived after long hours of travel! If I were to return to New York one day, I would not hesitate to use this accommodation again!

My husband and I travel to NYC frequently with our family and usually stay in a two bedroom in Harlem. This time it was just the two of us so we thought a studio would work. The description was wonderful and so many great reviews, we thought this would be the perfect place. Gigi was waiting for us when we arrived and showed us around. When she left she took luggage with her and said she was going to her boyfriends as this was her apartment. We felt like we were house sitting a friends place and not staying in a vacation rental. There was one drawer free for our clothes, a hanging rod for coats and other clothes.  We were there for two weeks. We rented this place on the assumption we could cook in the full kitchen and not have to eat out every meal. That was not the case. Although there were most of the amenities of a full kitchen; fridge, stove, oven, microwave, pans. There was no coffee pot ( I had to buy one) no toaster, no disposal, no storage space and very little room to maneuver. The dining chairs were all wobbly, the only window that opened was in the bath room that had missing tiles and a hole in the floor. On the positive side: The location was very close to our daughter's apartment, there were drug stores and grocery stores near by, Central Park was across the street. Gig was very pleasant, answered my questions quickly, offered suggestions when asked,  was very accommodating when our plans kept changing. For one person who just needs a good night's sleep, a warm shower, and a mini kitchen this is great. For a couple who wants to relax in a full apartment  versus a hotel and cook full meals, find a bigger place.

Michelle’s place was wonderful! Great location, clean and perfect size for my daughter and I. We loved the rooftop patio and ate our dinners there several nights. We never felt unsafe and we were welcomed by three other tenants. I would recommend this place to anyone!

What a great location! The 1BR place was also quaint and nice, and host was friendly + responsive to my requests. Overall, enjoyed my stay here!   Areas for improvement: • It was a bummer that the rooftop wasn't available for my stay. Not the host's fault, but I partly booked the place because of that (it was advertised). So I feel like others should know about it too. • The kitchen light wasn't working and it took a few days to get it fixed. Turns out there was broken wiring behind the wall that could've turned into a dangerous situation. Fortunately, the host acted quick and it got fixed. I wish that was resolved prior to me checking in.

A. agreed to host me with my housebroken dog. A. wanted me to pick up the keys at the restaurant “Grotta Azzura”. A man called “Sammy” handled the keys, asked me how long I’m staying. Sammy said he needs to repair the shower and get into the apt probably while I'm staying there.The apt is on the 5th floor of a very narrow stairway walk up with many stairs to climb. This is nothing acceptable for elderly/ handicapped people or guests with heavy luggage. I checked in on the 10th,I had an important surgery scheduled for the 11th. My surgery had to be done under full anesthesia. My dog walker stayed at the apt and walked my dog while I was gone for 6 h and i was fit enough to walk her. The shower wasn’t working, I noticed there is no cold or hot water indicator at the shower knobs and it was hard to get warm water and if it was running a little bit I didnt know how to turn it off in the end.I could not use the shower during my stay. From day 1 the radiators kept running while being warm outside on highest level. I asked A. how to turn off, he texted"by closing the radiator wheel"Then he added ”Open the windows turn on the AC that usually helps” The apt was cozy, the drawers weren’t cleaned in a while and somebody quickly took out their personal stuff to lock it in a storage. One boxer shorts was still in one drawers and dirt. ALL MIRRORS DIRTY, not cleaned. mattress had no bedbug cover. I’ve started cleaning. The bed is comfortable and I slept well with ear plugs. Day before check out Anthony was very pushy and asked me what time I am leaving bc the apt needs to be ready for the next guest to check in. I was checking out at 11.30am. I checked the apt."everything was fine"I took out the trash bags put new bags in.It was heavily raining outside. With my luggage, backpack and the dog walking in front of me I tried to get down the narrow stairway. It was a nightmare to get down safely. My dog worried and stressed out, when we finally arrived on the sidewalk she released some little brown water not poop. Nothing I could pick up or clean up, it was some little brownish water on a public sidewalk. The "Grotta" owner+landlord saw me.heard me explaining.He screamed loudly at me,saw my bandaged face but pulled on my clothing,shaking me.Tried to tell him that the rain will wash it away and its impossible to pick up, the luggage still in my hands.My driver took the suitcase. I tried to escape into the car, away from this man. He ripped off the car door, tried to grab me pull me by my clothing.I said "dont touch me", i "just had surgery" no mercy, kept attacking ,dialed 911. he left. A is not returning my security...

Josh and Mary's place was amazing, nothing short of perfect for our stay. They were extremely nice, accommodating and flexible. The little things like providing bagels and oranges, extra linens and toiletries, and recommended places to eat within walking distance made our trip so much more enjoyable and stress free. We highly recommend this place to anyone who wants to visit NY, and we would definitely stay here again. Also, other reviews said the place was sparkling clean... It was. :)

First and foremost, if you are looking for a room to stay in Queens, look no further. Petya’s listing is the absolute best option you can find for the price. It is clean, quiet, safe, conveniently located, and affordable.  You will be sharing the place with the actual owner of the apartment, a lovely lady Elena and her cat. Elena is an honest and hardworking person. She is an incredible host, who is willing to go above and beyond to make your stay comfortable and enjoyable.   The room is big, clean, and bright, with a ton of space to store your belongings. The bed is a queen size with a firm and comfortable mattress. Moreover, the room has a desk that can be used to get some work done. Despite the room having a queen-size bed, desk, two nightstands, and a big dresser, there was still some space left for me to do some basic exercises and stretches. High-speed internet and a TV with Netflix are also available. During my stay, I rarely heard my neighbors from behind the wall and could always get some rest and a good night of sleep.  The whole place is spotless and cozy. The shower is clean and always has hot water with strong pressure. You will be provided with a towel if you don’t have one. The kitchen has all the necessary appliances, like a microwave, refrigerator, stove, and even a panini press.   The neighborhood is quiet and safe. I walked through it many times at night and never saw anything suspicious or odd. There are restaurants, convenience stores, a laundromat, and a train station within walking distance or a short bus ride.  I was in New York for some contract work and lived at Elena’s place for two months. I’m so glad that I was able to find her place. Elena’s welcoming personality and friendliness made me feel home away from home.

This apartment was everything I needed. The little cooking that I did was well served by the kitchen, which came fully outfitted with dishes, silverware and pots and pans. The "living room" had a great couch for reading and watching the World Cup on the massive TV across the room. AC is in the bedroom, which keeps the room cool enough to sleep during NYC summer nights. As long as there's a fan in the next room blowing the cool air into the rest of the apartment, the temperature will be very pleasant.   The lower east side is a great neighborhood—full of young people and a vibrant night culture. It's only a few blocks away from Chinatown and Little Italy, which made for great areas to walk through. Washington Square and Union Square are both within 20 minutes by foot. Never did I feel unsafe walking around the area at night.   Ofer was a fantastic and gracious host. He consistently checked-in by text to see if I needed anything, but was never overbearing, as hosts during long stays can often be.   The pictures are very accurate. If you're looking for a small, but not super small, one bedroom in a bustling area, this apartment is exceptional.

We had a great stay at louisa's place ! We were really happy every night to Come  back in our cosy house after a long day of walking. The subway station broadway junction  is at about 3 minutes walking and has a lot of lines to get to other part of Brooklyn, Manhattan and the JFK airport. The flat was very clean and Louisa adorable. In negative we could say it's maybe a bit far from Manhattan but honestly it's more than fine !!!! Don't be afraid by the neighborhood at night that could look maybe ghetto , it's a real family neighborhood !   Thanks a lot Louisa !!! Ben & Rose

The apartment is really close to JFK which is one of the reasons I chose it in the first place. Louisa was always super quick at getting back to me and getting the key was no stress at all as it was waiting for us on arrival. The apartment itself is lovely and clean and well laid out with a comfortable bed. The transport links in the area are also a huge bonus as its easy to get to Williamsburg, Manhattan and even Queens from subways a short walk away.
We felt welcome due to the condition of the house that was really clean and tidy! However, honestly, we felt a bit unsafe when we entered the neighborhood area on the first day.

No surprises, accommodation exactly as described, we arrived 30 minutes earlier than expected and John (Marjorie's husband) was still there to welcome us. Right away he told us to make ourselves at home, to have the bedroom and bathroom as we wanted. We had the keys and we were able to live our lives peacefully (we barely met our hosts). Friendly welcome (clean towels, white wine and fresh water available).  We only saw Marjorie the last two days but she was very kind, we had no means of communication, so she took the time to show us restaurants, metro, and even lent us her computer to confirm our flight and print documents, the TOP.  The neighborhood seems very safe (Nothing to report in 4 days) and is rather quiet, it is very pretty, more residential than touristy, and located 10 minutes on foot from Times Square, it is perfectly placed for visiting Manhattan.  The small problem is that the apartment and the things in it are not very fresh... the cleanliness is not there in every corner, especially due to the accumulation of a busy past! However, if you are looking for welcoming hosts, tranquility and a good location to visit then you have found your air bnb.

The stay at Louisas appartment was great. We felt very welcome and at home. The checkin was very flexible and went well with a lockbox. There is enough space in the appartement and the kitchen is fully equipped, the bathroom is pretty new. Everything was clean when we arrived and the fridge was filled with water and fruit, which we appreciated very much. It is only a short walk to a major subway station, so there is not a lot of waiting time. To get to Manhattan, you have to plan about 45-60min on the subway, though.  The neighborhood was okay, we did not feel unsafe, though when being a woman alone at night maybe one might feel a bit uncomfortable (there was absolutely no incident whatsoever!). Louisa was always very quick with responses to any questions we had, super friendly and helpful.  We would absolutely recommend to stay there, thank you so much Louisa!

Femida was a wonderful host. Very kind-and helpful. She took the time to walk us outside and point out the key information (i.e bus routes/trains/food/shopping) to make our NYC trip fun and stress-free!  Room was VERY CLEAN and SPACIOUS. Great find!

After a stressful day which involved my flight out of La Guardia being cancelled after a 2 hour delay (thanks american airlines :p) at 9 pm on a Friday night and no hotel rooms nearby, I frantically signed up on this website and got in touch with Femida who graciously allowed me to stay at her place at the last minute! It was only a 10 minute ride to her place and only cost me around $11 to get there.  When I arrived, she immediately took me in and got me water and asked if I had any dinner or if I needed to get to the grocery store nearby!  It was such a welcome relief to receive such generosity and hospitality after dealing with a horrible airline company a few hours before that I was so overjoyed.  The room was as advertised with AC and the bathroom was well kept.  She also provided a towel and toiletries if you needed them.   I know this is my first time using Air Bnb but I would definitely come back to her if I was ever back in the city.  I know NYC isn't known for being generous but it's great knowing that there are people there who are the exception to the rule which includes Femida.  The only regret I had was that I couldn't stay at her place longer and gotten to know her better since I had to leave early in the morning.  I highly recommend her if you ever get a last minute flight cancellation at the airport or even going sightseeing in the city.  Thank you again Femida for rescuing me and if I could, I would give her 10+ stars for her hospitality!

It was okay but not as great as I expected. Communication, check-in was great. The biggest issue is the bed. The problem is the bed is broken: between the steel frame and the mattress there is a wooden frame which is broken in the way of traverse crossbars. It makes a weird creaking sound when you turn on the bed, like you're sleeping on your grandma's old 80's bed. There is no way I could sleep with this sound the whole night. Next morning I just put the big wooden frame off and put the mattress right on the steel frame. Eventually I could sleep at night.  Another issue is the mattress. It's a very bad mattress and I would say it's a big piece of a very soft foam-rubber, but not a sleeping mattress at all. After the night I had pains in my back because of non-comfortable bed and it was unpleasant experience for the whole day then. My recommendation is to replace this mattress asap as it's  impossible to use it as a bed.   Everything else was fine.

An ok place for people who are mainly going to be spending their time exploring the city. Based on the other reviews I booked this place thinking it was in a quiet and safe neighborhood, but when I arrived I immediately felt otherwise. It was a loud street where people were outside talking very loudly, driving by blasting loud music, and cars revving their engines all pretty late at night. The bed is extremely uncomfortable, if you are a light sleeper like me you won't get much sleep at all due to the loud creaking sound it makes anytime you move the slightest of ways. All in all I was disappointed. I felt unsafe, stressed, and as if I wasted money due to not being able to get any sleep and having to book another place for the remainder of my visit. Despite all of this, Louise is very kind and replies to messages quickly.

Me and my friend had a wonderful time at Thomas' and Gaby's beautiful apartment. We stayed at their place for 5 days for a work trip, and we were sad that we did not get to spend more time in this newly renovated, beautifully decorated gem.  Gaby and Thomas were wonderful hosts. They were very accommodating with respect to our late check-in time (due to our flight) and they had even put some food and drinks for us in the fridge. Very thoughtful! They also wrote a little manual about the apartment and the neighborhood, with all the numbers (take-out) and routes (to the metro for example) that you need.  The neighborhood is certainly one of the lower income ones in Brooklyn, but we never felt unsafe. We were walking home at 11 pm on the week end from the Ralph Ave metro, and there were issues at all.   The noise level at the apartment was very low for Brooklyn, but don't expect a chalet-in-the-woods type of quiet. But because it is in a residential street between two bigger ones, you are nicely shielded from those.  We felt very much at home during our stay and we would definitely go back any time. Thank you Thomas and Gaby!

Gaby and Thomas were great hosts during our stay at their house. The 8 of us felt comfortable at home, where Gaby and Thomas left food and drinks for us in the fridge the first night. They also oriented us with useful info on how to move around the neighborhood and NYC.   The house is well-furnished, well-illuminated and has useful things like a TV and Internet. Gaby and Thomas did also help us on anything we needed, providing everything they mention on the house listing.   We also liked the neighborhood, being it quiet and not feeling unsafe at all.  If you plan to stay in Brooklyn during your visit, staying with Gaby and Thomas will be a good decision!

Marjorie's place is awesome. The location is absolutely amazing. Subway, market, drug store, restaurants, Times Squares, Broadway theaters, everything  is just few blocks away. The neighborhood is quiet and safe, we didn't have problem with excessive noises. The space is pretty cool, comfortable, clean, and was perfect for me and my mom. Great pillows too! Marjorie is such a sweet hostess. She made everything easy since the beginning and her flexibility on the check in and check out times really helped us. We'll definitely stay here again next time we visit NYC. Thank you again Marjorie!
Close to the subway , a bit of a scary neighbor hood. I wold not have lived there without my bf.  Bed was not comfortable. Otherwise ok

Louisa was lovely and left us champagne and bagels. The location was the only thing that was a let down, true it is New York and some areas aren’t great but I wouldn’t recommend staying here if you are women on your own. We felt unsafe to walk the neighbourhood after dark. It was close to train stations and convenience stores however. Overall a very “genuine” New York experience.

Thomas & Gaby were incredibly friendly and accommodating throughout our entire experience – from booking to check-out, we couldn't have asked for more. The place was exactly as advertised, very clean and homey, which was great to come back to after long days of work. I definitely recommend this spot for anyone with a group of 3-5 people looking for some private space and who are adventurous. We loved staying in Crown Heights as it showed us a side of NYC that we wouldn't have explored otherwise. We never felt unsafe, we even  felt ok walking home late at night, but it is definitely not Manhattan! Access to the train is a synch, too. Great spot that is also affordable for your NYC adventure!

Nice and friendly couple which made our stay much better with the staple pantry that meant that we didn`t have to go shopping the first thing we did. They also gave us a nice verbal and written tutorial of what was in the area as well as went the extra mile and gave us an extra fan to use since it was nearing 95F outside and inside felt almost just as warm in the beginning.  The neighborhood was nice, considering it`s Brooklyn and us being from Sweden we didn`t really know what to expect but we found our routes to walk and our stores that we used (both the supermarket near uttica if coming from the metro and just needing some basics or left out the door and then take a right at the corner, that was most likely the best one) and everyone was nice that we talked to, never really felt unsafe or anything.  Would recomend staying here, the beds were decent and overall a nice place.

It’s a really nice place! Go for it without hesitation. Big and bright rooms, very comfortable bed and a friendly host. A 5 min. walk to subway (different trains) - the ride to lower Manhattan takes around 25-35min. It’s a safe district, we spent 12 days here, often came back late at night and didn’t see anything suspicious. There is a supermarket, a laundry, a cafe- all 6-7 min walk from that place. Louisa even left us some food and juice in the fridge - it was very nice of her :)

Louisa’s house is charming and welcoming. House is clean and neat. AC worked great during these hot days. It’s also two blocks away from Broadway junction subway. We stayed during weekdays and there wasn’t much noise outside, so we slept great.  I’m not familiar with Brooklyn neighborhoods so my first impression on the neighborhood was that it looked sketchy. However after a few days we realize it’s no different from any other urban zones.

Thomas & Gaby were fantastic hosts! The apartment is gorgeous just like the photos and we never felt unsafe in the area! ( Even when catching the subway at night) Thomas & Gaby were also very helpful when my boyfriend had to organise an emergency dental appointment! Very thoughtful hosts would stay again!

Thomas and Gaby are wonderful hosts, they are kind and polite and their house is clean and new. The beds are comfortable and the house's heating is perfect. The kitchen is fully equipped and Thomas and Gaby gave us some food necessities (like milk, water, eggs, fruit juice, butter, pizza, etc, and even wine!). Their place is exactly how they describe it on airbnb website. New York subway is absolutely efficient and the house has good location near Ralph Av stop (you should consider about 20min to Manhattan from Ralph Av, after a change in Utica to express train). Just few words about the neighborhood's safety: we didnt have any perception of danger but we came back home after 23.00 only one time during the whole vacation (we prefer to live a city starting from the early morning), so I cannot talk about the neighborhood's night time. I'm talking about that because at first glance the neighborhood may appear a bit scruffy. Thomas & Gaby see you in Bologna! ;)

A warm welcome, the rental is easy to find 15 minutes from line C RALPH AV. The apartment is quiet, spacious with its 3 bedrooms. There were 4 adults and 3 teenagers there. We also appreciated, after a 6-hour flight, that the fridge was well stocked for a first meal and breakfast. The neighborhood is quiet and safe. Thanks again to Gaby and Thomas for this rental.

When you stay with Marjorie, you can expect exactly what is in her listing.  The space is impeccably clean and charmingly decorated in boho chic style.  The location is perfect, so close to theaters, scores of restaurants of every type,  drug stores and groceries.  It is a lively neighborhood.  Even saw the carriage horses come down 48th St, under our window, on Saturday morning. We felt totally safe here.  Marjorie is attentive but never intrusive.  She is easily available by text if needed.  Otherwise, you are unlikely to run into her unless you’re lucky.  Then you most likely will have an interesting conversation.  It is truly your space for the duration of your stay, almost like being a “real” resident rather than someone insulated in a hotel.  We had arranged to arrive early but due to flight delays and traffic we were much delayed.  Marjorie kept track of us and was available when we finally made it to her place 4 hours later than initially expected. We loved it here and would book again.  Thanks, Marjorie!

Thomas and Gaby couldn't have been more accommodating. Gaby greeted our group after a late arrival and went through everything we might need to know about the apartment, local amenities and transport. The fridge and cupboards were stocked with basics and we left with a plate of vegetables and herbs from their garden one day. Gaby was available to answer our queries and offer help throughout the stay.  The apartment itself is clean, modern and has everything you could need. It's around a 10-15 minute walk to the nearest subway station and approximately 40/50 minutes to Manhattan, depending on which area you are travelling to. As my stay was for two weeks, the travel time wasn't a problem and was well worth the money saved on this very affordable accommodation.  I was told my various people about the neighbourhood being unsafe, however, we never had any problems and people were friendly. It's also interesting to see both ends of the spectrum, not just the wealthier neighbourhoods.  There's a nearby laundrette for longer stays and supermarkets. For relatively closeby nicer restaurants and bars, some can be found near to Utica Avenue.

Claude's place is really close to times square as advertised. There are many metro stations in the area that take you pretty much where you want to go within a few blocks from the apartment. It's in an older building, the place is not huge (suitable for 2 people and a child), but it's really all you need. Claude works pretty much all day and night until midnight usually. He made us breakfast for the morning before he slept, nothing fancy but it's a great little perk that made us feel at home. We arrived past 1AM and he was up to let us into the apartment! And when we left, we had a late afternoon flight and he said no problem to leave our bags there until we needed to leave. Great hospitality, great host, great everything. This place is a steal for the location!  PS if you stay in the winter, as we did, the building controls the heat so the place will be very toasty. Luckily you can open the window to let in some cold air to even it out.

We really enjoyed our stay here and would absolutely rent from Anne and Gary again in the future.  Check in was very convenient and flexible, Anne was very good with communication through the app and in person. When we got to the apartment they had bottles of cold water in the fridge and my wife was excited to see that there was ground coffee as well. Bed's were comfortable and the air conditioning was a huge plus considering we arrived in NYC during a heat wave that continued throughout our stay.  This apartment is on a quiet, shady street. There's a small grocery store two doors away and a couple of cool places to eat within short walking distance. It's a five minute walk to the A and C trains.  We drove to the city and were able to find free parking right on the street every day during our stay. The only time parking was an issue was late at night. If you're driving, be mindful that you'll have to move your car during the street cleaning times posted. I didn't notice this and came within a few seconds of a parking ticket.  I'm going to close by singing the praises of the shower in this apartment. It was one of the best showers we've ever used. Rent it and see if you don't agree.  This is a great spot. Highly recommended and I would absolutely rent it again.

Staying with Claude will alleviate any stress you might have about housing in New York City. Literally steps away from Times Square, and smack dab in the middle of the theatre district, you won’t find a better deal than this. Add to that the kindness, generosity, and understanding of Claude, the host, makes the nightly rate more than worth it.

Thomas & Gaby were great hosts. They were flexible with our check-in and we only saw them once during our week long stay. The apartment was exactly as described but I am glad that 2 of my group cancelled as it would have been very squished with 6 of us. It was just comfortable with 4. We were pleasantly surprised to find food essentials like milk, bread, butter, coffee and eggs supplied. The area is a bit rougher  than I expected and the smell of marijuana was everywhere, but that said, we never felt unsafe and we had no security issues. Our stay was great and I would highly recommend Thomas & Gaby’s place. Thanks x

We were made very welcome and yet we were delayed due to our flight. Anne offered us a tour of the neighborhood to drop us off in front of a restaurant. The apartment is very pleasant, nicely decorated, very quiet, comfortable bedding. Everything was provided for breakfast, coffee, tea, milk etc...
Brookline is very large city so Check the Area before going if it’s what your looking for. Felt unsafe walking at night but the apartment is excellent. Amazing space and very clean!

The house was charming and located in a great area of Brooklyn. My friends and I visited from Chicago and were very exited when we saw this Airbnb was available during the Juneteenth weekend.   Neighborhood Review The neighborhood is located in a primarily black and brown area (the non-gentrified part of Brooklyn) and was close to the subway. On the days me and friends came home late (9PM or later) we felt safe walking home from the subway. There were people outside hanging out but they seemed unbothered when we walked by. For the reviews saying that they felt unsafe or that the area itself isn’t safe, please don’t believe them. They’re probably sheltered white folks used to suburban living. It’s a great neighborhood!   Airbnb Review The Airbnb was nice but it didn’t offer much. You’re provided with the basics but if you forget to iron your shirt, you won’t find an iron at this place. The Wifi was spotty, the tv barely worked and the Roku is from like 20 years ago. If you’re looking for entertainment, it’s in the city, not in the apartment. Gaby was a great communicator and responded back in decent time. She was friendly and answered all our questions.

We had a very comfortable stay in NYC thanks to Gaby and Thomas’s Airbnb! The Airbnb was very well stocked with kitchen items and checking in was very easy - there was a digital keypad to get in and out.
