Each bedroom had its own AC unit which, for the heat and humidity of the summer, was very necessary. Gaby and Thomas were also very communicative before and during our stay, which made for a stress-free vacation. The apartment was also a convenient walk from the train station, which was perfect for getting to activities in Manhattan.

Excellent stay, the place was clean and quite spacious by New York standards. Easy access to by bus or subway. Not in the more affluent part of Brooklyn but we never felt unsafe and the locals weee extremely friendly.

Larry's house is full of charm (varnished parquet floors, wooden stairs, brick walls, etc.) and very well located in Harlem.  It corresponds to the description given on the site.  It is very spacious for a large family. Metro lines 1 and C are a few minutes' walk from the house and take you to Time Square in 15 minutes and Battery Park in 30 minutes.  The neighborhood is residential, quiet (far from the hustle and bustle of downtown Manhattan) and pleasant (no feeling of insecurity even when returning late at night).  Several supermarkets and various restaurants are located nearby.   Larry is a considerate host and responds very quickly to all questions.   We had an excellent week "like New Yorkers" thanks to Larry and his accommodation which we can only highly recommend. If we ever return to New York, we know our “home base”. Thanks Larry.

Location great for subway to get to down town New York. Very quiet cozy home even with 3 couples. (dated decor, beds comfortable) Plenty of space. Kitchen area very warm on HOT days. Neighborhood sketchy at times. Grocery store and restaurants down the street. We had to park in a parking garage 2 blocks away. Some of us used the subway pass some of us Ubered.

My husband, daughter and I enjoyed our stay in Shae's apartment. The apartment was as described and very clean.  The queen size bed was very comfortable; the pull-out couch that makes a single bed would be most comfortable for a child. A queen size air mattress is provided that we didn't use. It was helpful to have two full bathrooms. The unit's decor was contemporary and attractive. Our check-in went smoothly and Shae was available by phone for questions, and greeted us warmly the following day. The unit is located a short walk from the subway and was convenient for getting into Manhattan.  I did not feel unsafe in the neighborhood at any time and was able to find close by free parking on the street throughout our stay.  We were traveling with our small dog and I appreciated Shae's pet policy!

I booked this apartment for my mom and aunt and they were absolutely pleased. Both of them are clean freaks and went on and on about how clean and neat the place was: no bed bugs (oh yeah, they checked!) or anything unpleasant. The taxi driver gave the neighborhood a 6 out of 10 stars. My family felt safe and comfortable their whole stay. Will definitely be booking again if/when I travel to New York.  Thank you!

Pros: Cool place, great location, super clean and well set up. Stay was pretty nice after finally being able to get in (see below), and Shae messaged a few times asking if I needed anything, which was nice.   Cons: Check-in instructions state that a door code would be sent a couple of days before arrival date. Didn't receive the door code until the same day, and only after messaging the host a couple of times (A bit stressful when you're traveling from far away and you're not sure if you'll actually be able to check in successfully or not). Upon arriving, the door code given didn't work, so my fear of not being able to check in actually came true, unfortunately. Shae was unresponsive via the app and text message for nearly an hour, while I hung outside in the rain trying to figure out what to do. Ended up just going down the street and having coffee at Sunrise/Sunset (a cool hipster cafe/bar nearby if you should choose to stay here) while waiting for someone to get back to me. After almost an hour, received a message from Shae saying the door issue was resolved. Mostly smooth sailing after that, although I did receive an awkward message reminding me to lock the front door after I had already sent a previous message saying the lock button wasn't working.  I'm sure this kind of stuff happens from time to time, and it probably wouldn't have been as stressful had it not been raining. Would be a 5 star review if response time was better, and the check-in process was smoother.

Good location for Brooklyn connections to Manhattan though the area sometimes felt unsafe. The apartment was functional and easy to access though lacking in some basic items and high standard finish at the moment

I stayed with Alesandra for 5 nights. Even arriving quite late and as a single female traveller I felt in good hands and everything was very easy to organise with Alesandra. The room was great! Looked exactly like the photos and the matress was great even for my damaged, sensitive shoulder and a lot of space for me. I'll definetively recommend staying with Alesandra especially since I felt I had someone in the City I could count on and easily contact in an emergency. I also arrived often very late from my adventures in the City by Subway and had never any unpleasant encounters in Alesandras area - on the contrary and it's a great starting spot for runs in the Central Park!

We had a great stay with Alesandra. The apartment was nice and homely, and had everything we needed. Alesandra was very nice and helpful, and easy to get in touch with. The people in the neighborhood were friendly, and we never felt unsafe at any time.

My time in Alessandra's apartment was great. She was a great host and did everything to make me feel comfortable and at home. Apart from that the apartment was very clean and cozy. It was my first trip to the USA and the first time I used Airbnb. So I was very excited to see what to expect. But thanks to Alessandra it was a great experience. Even before I arrived, she contacted me and gave me tips on how to get from the airport to her apartment. During my stay with her, she also gave me helpful advice on what to see in New York or how to use public transportation. Even though I traveled alone, I never felt alone or unsafe. Instead, the part of town where Alessandra lives felt safe, the subway was only a few minutes away and every now and then Alessandra took time for personal conversations. This made the trip feel a bit like a vacation to a friend's apartment. All in all, I can absolutely recommend Alessandra!

It has been an amazing stay in NYC with Alesandra! The apartment is exactly like you can see on photos and read. It's clean and cosy, there's enough space in the room for 2 people with suitcases, it's located in a great neighborhood (some people asked if we felt unsafe in the neighborhood: not at all! the people in the streets and small shops are so nice and friendy! and it's so easy to take the 6 train to wherever you want to go), wifi works perfectly and you'll be sharing the bathroom, livingroom and kitchen with the best host you can have! Alesandra is great! She really took care of us getting to the apartment, texted a few times especially the first days to make sure we were finding our way in the apartment and in the city. Thank you so much Alesandra!!

I must say it served the porpose,. The place was convenient for everything, shopping, walking and/or commuting. The only thing that I found a bit scary was that the street was not lit at night and going down the stairs in heels to get into the apartment is not the safest but overall it was a good

We stayed at Desmar's for 3 nights. My partner and I want to share our (bad experience) with you. First of all, when we arrived we realized that the accommodation he offered us did not correspond at all to that in the photos. Desmar explains to us that it's because of a piping problem. The small studio he offers us is not very clean! An unpleasant musty smell emanates from it (normally we cannot open the only window to breathe). The condition of the toilets and showers is poor.  We didn't sleep well at all because of the dog upstairs who barked most of the night. Not to mention the cars passing right in front of our door with very loud music... the neighbor who lives permanently in Desmar's building is not discreet, she spoke very loudly in the hallway and woke us up several times. The area should be avoided; we did not feel safe. Positive point: the apartment is 3 minutes walk from the metro.  To end this stay in style we were bitten by bed fleas... I sent a message to Desmar for a possible gesture. He assured me that this was impossible since he had recently carried out an inspection. In the meantime, the fleas were present... in short, we will never go back there again... to be avoided!

Studio in a quiet neighborhood in the Bronx close to the subway on one side and a supermarket on the other. The people who checked us in and checked out were charming!  The availability was very pleasant because our flight was delayed and our arrival late. However, the studio was not the one in the photos, although very similar.  The studio is semi-basement, the window does not open, you have to turn on the click to counter the heating which gets too hot. Electricity works but one device at a time. Finally, the bed is slightly wobbly.. The studio is still very sufficient for a short stay in the city. Thanks again!
scammed me out of $70. He's a loser
Great apartment! very close to the subway, Desmar is super friendly and helpful. The neighborhood is a little sketchy, but nothing to be worried about

This was one of my favorite trips to NYC & staying at Dave's loft was a huge part of it. A beautiful giant space w/tons of natural light, every amenity and a terrific & fun location. We wound up driving down from Massachusetts through a lot of traffic but Dave & Tillie made our arrival completely stress-free. My 12 yo son had a friend with him & they loved everything about the place (maybe they loved the dart board & having the elevator option a little more than walking up the three flights of stairs, but the point is that at Dave & Tillie's you have an elevator option) What else? I had already gotten a reservation at the Fat Radish before I'd picked a neighborhood or reserved a place - imagine my surprise when we landed right across the street. It's hard not to go on & on - one of the NYC apts I lived in back in the day was 2 bdrms & 800 sq ft which seemed pretty palatial. 2000 sq ft? Fantastic. Highly highly recommend & plan to rent again someday if they'll have us.

Jackie was friendly and willing to help advise and recommend places to visit or eat.  The room is near china town and the subway was nearby, which is great for exploring. I was travelling with my daughter who had just finished school and whilst the area is interesting, the street, the building entrance etc felt a   little unsafe to me.   The area is residential and is probably great for students, however I found that we needed to travel (walking at least 15 mins or take the subway) to find fun, attractive places to eat in the evening. A good base if you want to get out and about in the city but as two women, I did not find it an easy place to rest.   The main bed was fine, but would suggest that the sofa bed is more suitable for one rather than two people, due to it's different levels, when set up.
Safe setup with easygoing and accommodating hosts. Made for a stress-free trip!

I truly enjoyed my stay. I was quite a needy quest at times and she was so patient with me and responded quickly which I really appreciate. The sheets were very soft. The space had a very calming vibe which I truly enjoyed to decompress after a long event before venturing on to my next event. I would totally recommend her place to friends and stay again if I am in New York looking for a place to stay! I was nervous of feeling unsafe and vulnerable being I was on crutches but I felt safe in the neighborhood which I was very happy about!

We stayed with Jackie for 6 nights and we really enjoyed it. We really wanted to live like “New Yorkers” in this great city. Jackie was very trusting and friendly, even when we arrived later than planned in the evening, he waited for us. Thanks again :-) The communication via email in advance was very friendly and quick. The room is a sufficient size, which is what you need in NY  yes, actually only at night. Wifi was perfect. The bed linen and towels clean and fresh. We were given our own space in the fridge. Great because we had breakfast in the apartment. That was okay for us sitting on the bed. A small problem in between was taken seriously and everything was done to remedy it. The area is great because it is very quiet there, even though you live centrally (subway within walking distance). Ear plugs are still helpful because the walls are thin. At no time did we feel unsafe in the area. The only negative thing is the cleanliness in the bathroom, not a place to feel comfortable. There is a need for optimization here! Still... we would stay at Jackie's again!!!

Our stay with Alesandra did not live up to our expectations. Indeed, although the location in Manhattan is well located, the room is too small for 2 people, the bedding is very average (mattress sloping, I had to put the pillow between the mattress and the box spring so as not to slip). As for the bathroom with its toilet bowl wedged between the bathtub and the sink, it is not shared between 4 people but "tolerated" for the 2 clients. The smallness of the place meant that we really had the feeling of being disturbed, in an unpleasant promiscuity. In addition, we had almost no exchanges with Alesandra and her companion; Not even a glass of “municipal” water when we arrived. For departure, an information email from the Airbnb website! In conclusion I will say that this offer is only business, not even up to 135 euros per night, and we stayed 5 nights! It is not my idea to be received and/or to receive by Airbnb.   In fact if our hosts had been more welcoming, warm, for 5 nights the discomfort would have gone better. I don't recommend it at all.

Our short experience was very unpleasant, an old building, poorly located, without numbers to locate it, it does not have elevators, and the advertisement does not clarify that it is a room in an apartment, it does not clarify that the host lives with someone else, he never introduces it, the apartment is super small in the tiny room the suitcases did not fit and us, it says that you rent 2 beds and you arrive and it is only one, dirty sheets, as well as the kitchen and the bathroom that have to be shared with a stranger, It is tidy, without ventilation, a stay that we do not recommend, nor the operation of the page that does not take care of anything in cases like this.

We stayed with Hashi for a week before Christmas. Hashi is exactly what you want from a host, especially for a family in a place as overwhelming as NYC. He was very communicative and helpful with ideas on how to get around, but respectful of our space. A few things stand out: He seemed personally invested in our visit to a city he has lived in for 40 years. His place was very clean. It’s also difficult for me to sleep on the road so when I requested a fan, he was accommodating. He also lives in the same building so while other locations might be suspect, I had zero concerns about the heat going out during our stay - a real advantage over other places I considered in the city. His place is also located in a quiet neighborhood with a laundromat and convenience store close by. Green line is a 5 min walk away and easily takes you north and south. We ubered a lot and most rides were $20 to anywhere we wanted to go. Thank you for your hospitality, Hashi!

Great location, very quiet apartment, super clean with lots of nice touches (including fresh fruit when we arrived).  Hashi was extremely gracious and hospitable, taking a half hour when we arrived to show us around and explain the detailed workings of the unit.    The queen bed was very comfortable, the foldout couch naturally a bit harder and could benefit from a mattress pad.  A nice well equipped small kitchen with a fridge large enough to hold our takeout leftovers comfortably.    There is a wonderful back patio with tables and chairs which gets partial good sunlight in the afternoon.  While the apartment is slightly below grade in the front, there is good sun coming in the front shade window, and there is a full walkout the back slider doors to the large patio with trees and ivy.    Very secure with both outside and inside doors.  Safe area with many restaurants and stores in a 2-5 minute walk, yet remarkably quiet and restful.    We would be delighted to return!

No hand soap, no toilet paper, bathroom was so gross. Steve was creepy and made me so uncomfortable to shower or go to the bathroom. Shower was either piping hot or freezing and it wouldn’t drain either. Nothing looked clean in the kitchen either. Worst air bnb I’ve ever stayed at.

Great stay for the price! Make sure you read all the description and check-in instructions and you’ll be set.  There wasn’t any hand soap or toilet paper in the bathroom when I got there. I messaged Steve and he told me where to find the toilet paper in the other room. He also said there had to be some soap in the bathroom because guests are always leaving some (there wasn’t). But it’s stress free if you’re prepared

Diego's room is a nice place in a very interesting district, with lots of restaurants and small businesses. The room is exactly as it appears in the pictures. the bathroom is small and shared with other roommates and/or Airbnb guests, so expect high traffic. The apartment is old. The room door has no lock. Our stay in new year's eve was a disaster because one of the roommates organized a party for 10+ guests. Diego gave us a heads up the same day of our check-in. At that point it was impossible to change plans. Diego tried to make amendments by offering a 50% discount on thaf night and the roommate promised to keep things relatively quiet and end by 0:30am. We warned him that we needed to rest because of my wife's pregnancy and our train leaving early the morning after. However, he utterly ignored it and went for 5+ hours of loud music and games right outside of our room's door. Uncomfortable, insecure, and even dangerous. Not trustworthy
Straight up scam

When I walked in, the first thing I felt was that I got scammed. there were crumbs everywhere on the kitchen floor and the floor was sticky and grimy. there were dead insect legs and dead insect on the floor along with some crumbs and mystery green goop. I went to go shower bc it felt disgusting and I was welcomed with the smell of urine. overall this was the Worst airbnb experience of past 5 years. upstairs neighbors stomps around at 11:30pm. one of the wifi doesn't even work and the other one can't be used in the room or the bathroom, only in the kitchen.

We recently stayed at the apartment building on 31st - as many other sites will say, this is very "no frills".  You're getting a fantastic location, although the area immediately outside the hotel is a bit sketchy (weed dealers nearby on the corner).  The place itself may have been a hotel of sorts at one point - there seem to be a few hosts who have several units all within the building.    Overall, the place has sort of a 'youth hostel' feel, and we saw plenty of younger travelers staying there.  We are a family of 5, and our requirements dictated we have a separate bedroom as well as allowing for a small pet.  This unit fit both those bills (there was a small fee for the pet).  We stayed when it was around 80 degrees in June and the bedroom stayed quite cool, where the window unit was installed.  The main room less so, and we needed to keep the door open between the two rooms so as to not make my sons' sleep too uncomfortably hot.  Shower had decent pressure and temp, but the bathroom/kitchen parts are both very "NYC Tiny".  Some clever appointments like plastic folding chairs mounted to a rack on the bedroom wall and a table that folded out helped to make the space more livable and provide somewhere to sit besides the 3 beds.  Mini room has a double bed on bottom, single bunk on top.  Bedroom is two double beds.  We wound up using the top bunk as a place to store clothes, etc as space is really at a premium.  Bottom line - if you don't need fancy, if you don't expect room service, if you just need a place to crash or unwind for a minute between outings, this place does the job.  Very close to one train station and about a 5 minute walk to another line.  The few times we needed to interact with the host, he was very responsive so no issues whatsoever with Fernando as a host.

New York City is expensive. To avoid paying top dollar on rent, you're going to take a hit, whether that be access to a quality subway line, a massive amount of stairs to traverse, or the safety of a neighborhood.   Eibhlin's spot represents the minimum number of compromises - it's a low-income, and thus fairly depressing, neighborhood (@ me), and the apartment is up a few stories of stairs, ~and~ the rooms are tiny, but the space itself is totally livable, the subway is quite convenient, and the neighborhood doesn't feel particularly dangerous, even at night, which I wouldn't say of anything north of 145th in Manhattan. Check out Kiwi's for a bougie grocery store in range, and drip for excellent coffee.  Which is all to say, it's a fair deal in the context of NYC's stupid-high rent.

The arrival was very bad, we were waiting two hours on the street with our suitcases for him to give us the code to the key box, we called him many times and he didn't answer thanks to the hairdresser next to the portal who helped us and let us be there and we were already looking for hotels because we thought we wouldn't get in.  Finally he wrote to me that he had run out of battery and gave us the code. The house was not bad, it is like in the photos and it is very close to metro 135 or 145 and the area is not so bad if you go along the 135 side. At first we were afraid of that area but after being there we liked it since there was no noise. The bad thing about the house is that they didn't leave us toilet paper and there is a gas stove and there were no lighters or anything to light it, nor did they explain anything to us about how it worked so we didn't use it. One day before we left, I wrote to him (Saturday morning) to see if we could stay until 2:00 p.m. and how we were going to get the key and he called me at 6:30 in the morning on Sunday saying what were we doing in the house that we hadn't paid for, that it was thought that we had left because of the first day... at no time did we say anything about leaving if we already had the key... then he saw that he did have the money and let us stay until 2:00 p.m. In short, the house is good, it was clean and close to the metro, but the communication with the host was quite bad, especially on the first day when we thought we were staying on the street.

Great location-short walk to the subway, restaurants, coffee, and a grocery store. We walked late at night and never felt unsafe.   Check in and check out was super easy.  The apartment is up four floors (there is no elevator) so you will get your steps in. There is great AC and a fan in the bigger bedroom. There are a couple TVs and Wi-Fi but we couldn’t get them to work. There’s a lot of room to sleep a bunch of people (one Queen, one bunk bed with a very large bottom bed, a trundle bed, and a little couch) if you have a bigger party.  The only real concerns we had was there was only two towels and two washcloths and half a roll of toilet paper for a week stay with two people. I think there’s a little room for the cleaning company to clean a little more but nothing that would make me leave.

Dr. Julien and his team were so great during my entire stay for my OBGyn rotation at Wycoff. The area was safe and I never felt unsafe while walking during my overnight shifts. There was always parking in the area. Dr. Julien was also very open to communication and always got back to me in less than a few hours when I had questions. There's a housekeeper that comes every week, and so it was nice that there was one less thing to worry about while on rotations. I only needed to bring my clothing and toiletries. Everything else was taken care of. I would highly recommend Stat Living.

Armin was very nice and the apartment is lovely but it was unclear that it was a shared space with he and his partner. While this started the stay off poorly, once resolved I was optimistic for a pleasant stay.   Unfortunately he and his partner were extremely messy. Food all over the kitchen floor, walked around the communal area undressed and generally an unpleasant stay.   Wouldn’t recommend unfortunately.

We had a great, stress-free stay at Carlynn’s place. Her home was clean and beautiful, with plenty of space. She was also super helpful during our stay and always made sure we were ok and asked if we needed anything by text. I highly recommend staying here!

This apartment is great for 1 or 2 guests. The AC is awesome and they have appliances available - hair dryer, steamer, iron, coffee pots. Checking in and out is super easy. The apartment is very clean and comfortable. It's very conveinently located near the train, grocery store and drug store. I would definitely stay there again!

You Definitely need a car to move around back and forth since location is far from Brooklyn and Manhattan.  Clean space, nice decor but it could use some professional touch ups,  The back room was very hot since there’s only one ac in the front and two doors that remained locked in the back and  to me , that was a little scary.

The host Abbe communicated very well.  I appreciated the privacy but knew if I needed something, Abbe would be there to assist.  The space you stay in is very well designed.  Abbe put a lot of thought into it.  My only complaint is the bathroom.  It is small. Smaller than I thought based on the pictures.  I’m also very, very picky and thought the floors could have been cleaned better.  I’m not sure the floors were cleaned prior to our visit.  There was hair on the floors.  Also you should be aware that since you are in the basement, there are some creepy crawlers.   We had to flush some spiders and centipedes but that didn’t bother me.

Adorable apartment, decorated with great taste and lots of attention. Abbe is a remarkably kind host, always available and at the same time discreet.  A strong point: the mattresses on both beds are excellent, I have rarely slept so well! The location is still quite far away and you should not be afraid of the transport times to reach Manattan. But bus 83 passes by the house and runs every 10 minutes. Another way to discover the USA, on the "real life" side...

Clean Hostel. We had the three bedroom. However, it's really two with a pull out bed. My friends and I are tall, so whoever sleeps on the couch bed will be mad. That part of queens is a little shady, but the house is safe. Nothing to complain about. If you're uncomfortable being around a rough area, then I would get another spot. We still had fun, but we were on edge a little bit.  Host was good. Contact him early so that you can get a response quicker.

The landlord and the house are great, but we don't like the location very much. There are many people nearby who make us feel dangerous, so we dare not go home very late.  But the room is really great, the landlord is very friendly, and there is a very cute dog.

Charles was a nice guy who made checkin easy. I was pretty disappointed though in the quality of the unit. The walls were very dirty, had massive marks and physical dirt on the walls especially right by the bathroom in the larger bedroom. A few of the sockets were  burnt and did not have covers which makes them unsafe. Old food was in the fridge and freezer.  The location is also just ok. You are very close to the Atlantic bridge and walking distance from Rockaway Boardwalk, though it is not very close to a physical beach

We had a great stay at Shanda's place. The place is as described. It's nicely decorated and the main bedroom is big. The second bedroom is smaller but fine too. The kitchen is big but as others have pointed out it could use a small dining table for 4 as at the moment there is only the bar top or tall table for 2 to eat at. But otherwise it's great. Location is good at about 8-10 mins walk to Franklin station (see below as to why there) and then about 15 minutes to DUMBO or 25 to Financial District of Manhattan.   We didn't meet Shanda but she was very responsive to any questions.   Bergen street is a nice street. The neighbourhood is very colourful - there is everything from nice streets like Bergen street, to more run down parts with homeless people etc. But that's Brooklyn - it's real, it's not as saccharin as Manhattan. We really enjoyed our stay and found it a refreshing change from staying in a hotel on Manhattan. One piece of advice - the walk from Nostrand Avenue station is not very pleasant. Instead, turn left out of the house and walk up Franklin Avenue instead to Franklin station which is a much more pleasant walk.   Final advice - Tom's Restaurant is a walk from the house and is the best diner for brunch.
This is perfect for an artist or musician staying in Brooklyn for a show or to get some inspiration. Especially with being 420 friendly, I had such a stress-free and productive work trip.

Don't pass this one up!  It is the absolute best AirBnB apartment in all of Ridgewood.  It has been completely renovated.  All new walls, flooring, appliances, furniture, bathroom (full with tub), etc.  It is conveniently located and within walking distance to everything in Ridgewood.  Fabulous restaurants, shops, clubs.  Only 4 short blocks to Forest station to catch M subway.  Take M to Broadway/Myrtle junction to transfer to J train into Manhattan. Or take M line and transfer to L at Myrtle/Wyckoff  to get to Williamsburg and beyond.  IT IS ALSO THE BEST VALUE!  Only $85 per night for a true one bedroom apartment.  I looked into other options in Ridgewood and hosts wanted $120 to $140 per night for only a private bedroom in owner's apartment. Here you have entire apartment to yourself.  It will comfortably sleep four.  Two adults in bedroom and two children on fold out sofa in living room. Or three adults. Marzena is very sweet and onsite if you need anything. And don't be afraid of the fact that it's on third story.  I am an OLD woman with two BAD knees and had no problem carrying my HEAVY bag up the stairs. There is no washer/dryer in building but there is a laundry directly across the street.

Really cute apartment! Very cozy and the location is nice. Easy check in and check out process. About 7 minutes to the M train (just right down the street) and 15 minutes to the L train. I came by myself and didn’t feel unsafe in the neighborhood.

Sonam is a great host and the place is very clean and Tidy. However the location made it almost impossible to find parking on the street and we struggled with that everyday which made our trip very unpleasant/hectic. If you don't have a vehicle, the  you will enjoy the location as there are shops and mall close by. Check in was smooth, host very responsive, place is sparkling clean.

Our stay at Esmés Apartment was very pleasant! Communication was super easy and fast, Esmé was always happy to help us out with any questions we had. The apartment was clean and very nice. The kitchen is very well equipped, although the rest of the furnishing is a bit sparse. But for the price it is completely fine! The location of the apartment is great and very convenient, only a few minutes by foot to the subway, and the very beautiful Moningside Park just around the corner. But especially at night, the area can be a little sketchy, my girlfriend said she wouldn‘t feel comfortable going out of the house alone.  In conclusion, we enjoyed our stay at Esmés very much and can only recommend her apartment.

The guest room and bath are pristine.  Perfectly designed and outfitted.  Antoni and Marie were there to greet me and give me keys.  They were very gracious sharing their home.  This was the only listing I found on the UWS that didn’t seem sketchy.  You were staying in someone’s home.  That alone made it worth the extra expense.  The room had nice sheets, pillows and quilt.  The room had its own window A/C.  The clothes rack and the tiny end table by the bed worked well as did the reading light.  The bath seemed newly remodeled with white wall and floor tile.  The bedroom could be locked.  Antoni has two excitable friendly labs.  I appreciated the doggy gate to the living room so I could get in and out of the apartment without letting the dogs out.  My daughter slept over the first night because she had a work shift at 4am in Manhattan and that saved her a trip home to Astoria so we could spend more time together.  I paid an extra $28.50 for those 7 hours.  Being a Superhost myself and never having upcharged  a guest if a friend of theirs wanted to share the queen bed in my cottage which sleeps 1 to 2, I was a little taken aback by this, especially since the listing was the priciest shared listing in the neighborhood.  But my listing is in California and this is NYC so perhaps the culture is different here.  I will reiterate that I noticed the care that had been put into the guest room and bath.  The building is well-maintained with a good elevator on a safe block in a good neighborhood.  I would stay there again.

Plus - Very convenient location walkable to Columbia U and Barnard C, subway, shops and restaurants at corner of 110th and Broadway, safe neighborhood. Room and bathroom were meticulously clean, not huge but I guess normal size for Manhattan pre-war building. Marie was super friendly, check in/out all very smooth   Neutral - going to the bathroom through the hallway was not as convenient, need to be properly dressed at all times because the two doggies could come up any time 🤪 not recommended for people afraid of dogs, they are super friendly but may scare people because of their size and they come up to play as soon as they hear the door opens, the room was close to apartment entrance so may hear everyone coming in and out, didn’t bother me as much as I was jet lagged and was up super early
Anna was very helpful, with excellent communication and very clear instructions. She made check-in stress free! Her place is cute and spacious, and in a great location.

Sd is truly an exceptional host. I felt so at home and welcome in this pristine, luxurious space. The kitchen is lovely to cook in, and the best little grocery store right across the street with so many options. With mother facing view you can see both East and west from the window. I sipped wine each night watching the sunset over the city and woke each morning to the brilliant sunrise. (Of course if you don’t like the sunrise you can close the shade:) I cannot wait to come back! It’s the most amazing view I’ve had of the city, and the location is perfect for walking by the river or around town. Lots of shopping near by and fun places to see. Thank you Sd! Excellent on all fronts!

DO NOT STAY HERE. THIS IS A SCAM. the actual apartment looks nothing like the advertisement and was a complete mess. It was pretty much a messy storage room and the apartment building was entirely different. There were multiple details regarding baggage storage, check in, and other fees left out of the advertisement and overall it was a horrible experience. My friend and I didn’t even end up staying here and had to spend $400 on a last minute hotel room.

Comfy beds, clean, good location. The outside is alittle off putting but don’t let that scare you. More towels  would be nice than one per person for 3 days. Extra sheets would be helpful as well. Overall, it was a good experience.

First and foremost the place was nice I did see one roach but other than that it was a decent place, host on the other hand was unprofessional. I did not stay the whole trip due to an incident but I never asked for a refund. During the stay a very flimsy towel rack broke in the apartment which I did inform him immediately after.. the following  day the host decided to show up unannounced which I felt was unprofessional, keys were also lost during my departure.. I informed the host I also was honest and courteous enough and told him I’d pay for any damages and the lost keys. Days later he sent me a receipt folded up with extra expenses aside from what we discussed trying to say the cost of everything was $250. He was being a scam artist which honestly bothered me. I’ve done a bunch of Airbnb’s and never had an issue with host(check my profile), but this gentleman was the most uncommunicative dishonest rude one I met! Not sure if I’d recommend to anyone but I definitely would never stay here again.

The location is really superb for a trip to the big apple! We had a problem with the beds as the bunk bed (especially the top part) was creaking and wobbling quite heavily. It felt a bit unsafe and uncomfortable to sleep on top. Koichi answered and wanted to come to look at it but didn’t come in the end.  It is really very well described how to get there, get in, and get by around the flat. The price is totally ok for New York, it is what you get when you book something in the center of Manhattan.

There are 3 things to keep in mind if you are staying here in NYC. NYC is very expensive and this is one of the cheapest spots I could find and it was still quite a lot for what you do get. Firstly, there are other people living in the building. I would say the building has a few “non-community members” living in the building. Specifically, walking up to my room there was an old man who left his door open while sitting on the floor and his unit was completely trashed. I got the idea that he was homeless however it was quite scary and you should keep this in mind if you are travelling alone. 2nd, my unit did not have a latched lock like the bathroom did. There was a spot it appeared there was a latch before, however there was none. The only lock was on the door knob which could be easily picked, and this made me feel very unsafe and difficult to fall asleep.  Lastly, the wall beside me on the top bunk bed was dirty and looked like someone had smeared their snot on the wall. Cleanliness of this unit and shared bathrooms: zero. Please bring flip flops for the shower. Do not walk around bare foot.

My friend and I stayed for a week. The location of his airbnb was good; places were at fairly close walking distances and having the train station around the corner was a big plus. The neighborhood looked a bit sketchy but was safe, even late at night. The bathroom and shower units are community, so bringing shower sandals is a must, but they were fairly clean, and were cleaned really often. The room was small, but big enough for 2 people to comfortably stay in. The room also contained a sink and additional closet space which was incredibly convenient. Checkin and checkout was really simple as well. Overall, the place was definitely worth what we paid for, considering we were only home to sleep/get ready, and occasionally just hang out and eat late dinners.

The room itself was clean and nicely decorated and the bed was freshly made.  Unfortunately, as two men measuring 1.85m and 2.0m, it was hardly possible for us to move. As soon as a suitcase was opened and left on the floor, the room could no longer be left.   The bed itself was okay - a bit noisy but still OK.   Unfortunately, the biggest drawback was in the bathroom. Here we found massive mold in both the public toilet and the shower. That was very unpleasant and for this reason we decided against staying there again.   Thank God Airbnb was so generous and gave us some of our money back.   Despite communicating with Airbnb, the landlord did not understand that we no longer lived in his apartment.   Luckily we quickly found what we were looking for and were able to move to another accommodation.

The space is fantastic and surprisingly decorated. Technology and comfort are everywhere. The experience was just not 100% because there is no customer service. They never responded to me on Airbnb and there is no direct way to contact them. When I got a response on Instagram, they gave me the wrong information. It was tremendous stress at check in.

Good for a large group but needs a deep clean. The biggest problem that made it not a great stay were the hundreds of gnats in the kitchen. They lived in the sink so every time you went over there they would scatter everyone. It was disgusting. The host has sticky traps and vinegar set out which didn’t do anything (obviously these aren’t shown in photos). The gnats would also travel up to the bedrooms and would be flying around and you could hear them while sleeping. Gross. We communicated this issue and the host wasn’t helpful. If we had known about the gnats we never would have booked this place. Unpleasant experience.   The other annoying thing about the place is no self check in so you have to call the host in order to get the keys which gets tricky with late arrivals although he did graciously stay up very late for us.

Cons: 1. The apartment door was not locked when we arrived. Seemed like a security concern. 2. Surfaces had stains, things looked a bit dirty, and it was a bit smelly. Definitely was not an enhanced clean experience (as advertised). 3. Although the listing said body soap, there was none. 4. We took public transportation with luggage to get to the Airbnb. However, the keys were stored at a different location. With full luggage on our backs, we walked half a mile from the subway to grab the keys, and then from the key location, another half mile to get to the Airbnb itself. On checkout, my partner, walked the 1 mile round trip while I waited at the front door of the building for him to arrive so we could use public transportation to go to the airport. I do not recommend this place if you intend to have luggage and are avoiding taxis. 5. The host didn't communicate check in details to us himself. Instead, he asked me if he could share my phone number with someone else who wasn't listed on the rental. I was surprised by this, and felt a little unsafe, but we also needed this place. It turned out okay, the person gave us the instructions for check-in. However, at the end, we ended up checking out early, and the person (who was not the host) texted me and said "You're not in the Airbnb, you returned the key to the lock box, are you intending to go back?" It was extremely strange to be tracked like that.   Pro: We booked the Airbnb and we arrived about 3 hours after we booked the place. So even though the place wasn't well-prepared for us, he allowed last minute booking. I would've preferred if he told us "Hey, I need just a bit more time to make the place nice for you. Can you please arrive just a little later?" Unfortunately, we arrived and we didn't have that great of an experience.

Joanne's place is exactly as described in the listing and the pictures. The check in and check out instructions were clear and we had no trouble using a lockbox. The place is on a busy street so it gets a bit noisy sometimes. We did not find that to be a problem.  The subway is a 5 minute walk which was very convenient. Joanne was very communicative and prompt in replying to our questions. We did have an issue the second night with the neighbor getting very noisy late night which made us feel a little unsafe. Joanne promptly addressed the situation which really helped a lot with rest of our stay.  Thank you Joanne!

We loved the apartment and parts of the neighborhood. The host was very communicative.   Close to everything you could ever need, but also loud at night so if you have kids, or need quiet will be hard.  The steps where kinda scary too lol, dont wear heels down them.

Great stay. My 2 pieces of feedback are that actually 5 people can sleep, and that if you are easily scared the area is not the best for you.   Very convenient location. Apartment was sparkly clean. Joanne is a great hostess with great communication
Excellent place to live for a group of 4. Though the area is somewhat shady it is close to the subway station from where you can easily explore the city. Very neat and clean!

As another review said, you have to manage your expectations. Everything in the apt is from Ikea, so the beds are super uncomfortable for me (but to others might be fine). The futon is also not the greatest for lounging to relax between your adventures. We had a buy a wine opener as there wasn't one. We also had 4 people staying, so we didn't have enough paper products and had to buy more (and ended up leaving the extra). The front bedroom is along the street, and the AC units aren't installed yet so it is either super loud with the windows open or super hot because the windows are closed. Either way between the noise, hot room and uncomfortable bed, I slept exactly 0 my whole multiple day trip. The kitchen cabinet doors are falling off the hinges, the faucet in the tub constantly leaks water and the bathroom is kind of meh. It has all the parts, but it just wasn't great. We did nothing but drink wine before dinner each night then sleep. The apartment is very dark with no light from outside so it's more like a bunker and unpleasant to be in other than to just relax and try to sleep. The middle bedroom also was super hot for the couple staying in there. They said the bed was okay. But there is a pipe that runs through the room, and they said it will just randomly start knocking waking them up. The first night I even heard it in the front bedroom it was so loud in their room. The neighbors above are kind of noisy, but with the lack of sleep due to everything,  it didn't even matter.  The only relief to how hot the front room got was  I found opening the bedroom door and having the living room windows wide open allowed some air flow into the bedroom. But when others are also using the apartment with you, it can be noisy or lack privacy. The apartment was very convenient to walk to anywhere you wanted. Lots of good food options nearby. As I said, you really just have to understand and expect that you're staying in NYC so it's loud, hot and old accommodations.  It is what it is, and I did not lower the rating due to it, but I did want to put it in the reviews so you can know what to expect. I'm sure once the AC units are in the windows, the noise and it being hot are no longer an issue. We didn't turn on or try the TVs so I have no idea if they work, and we couldn't ever figure out WiFi but there's fine cell service. Key pick up was easy enough from the laundromat worker across the street. We did have 1 toilet clog situation that we cleared up ourselves so just be mindful of the very old plumbing. Oh...and the address in the listing is not correct. It is not the corner apartment building when looking on Google. It is in the middle of the block.

NOT RECOMMENDED. Worst Airbnb experience of our lives. This apartment is poorly furnished and maintained. It's dirty and we had to leave a day early due to >>> Bed Bugs <<<.  The owner didn't even care that our daughter was bitten all over her body. We think this apartment AND the owner should be delisted from Airbnb because they are literally unsafe.

Basic apartment, nothing fancy. But very good value for the money due to the great location. We didn't spend much time in the apartment as we wanted to explore the city, so this was almost perfect for us.  Beds were okay, not super comfortable but also not bad. A/C in every room. Very good: mosquito nets for all windows, so we didn't have any of these unpleasant visitors.  Kitchen very basic, but enough to have cereals and bread for breakfast. Bathroom also basic, but again good enough.  Communication with host was very easy. The key pickup was at a 7/11 about two blocks away. Worked fine, but of course had to walk a little bit with the luggage. No big deal.

We had a great time staying here. The place was clean and as expected. I wish I could give 4.5 stars instead of just 4. The only reason it wasn’t a 5 is the location. It’s not exactly the best area. Not that it’s dangerous, just that the streets and sidewalks nearby are quite dirty. Other than that we loved it.

BEWARE — this listing is not as advertised. I have never before written a negative review of a listing. I feel compelled to write this because this listing is dirty, dangerous, and poorly maintained.   DIRTY: When we arrived, the master bedroom fitted sheet was blood stained. The kitchen appliances were covered in drips and smudges, and the doors and several light switches and walls were blackened with grime. The microwave door is missing a handle and cracked, and its vent cover is held on with greasy packing tape. The second bathroom had no shower curtain liner, so the heavy cotton shower curtain gets soaked and smells strongly of mold.  DANGEROUS: The floor of the master shower is 18” above the bathroom floor. All is tiled and there is no grab bar to hold on to, which is a recipe for a fall when wet. The tub in the second bathroom is also raised off the floor 6”, tiled, and lacks a grab bar.   POORLY MAINTAINED: The wifi stopped working halfway through our stay. Our attempts to fix it did not work and the host offered no help, saying it had never been a problem before. The plumbing is dysfunctional and we were expected to coordinate repairs with the building superintendent. We were awakened by a loud beeping in the master bathroom, which was a plumbing warning alarm embedded in the wall of the bathroom. It is clearly a known problem because there is a large, foam-board covered hole in the hallway wall to provide access. Later that day the second bathroom toilet clogged despite nothing but toilet paper being flushed. The superintendent said he knows this toilet is a problem. Later we were told that we should put toilet paper in the trash rather than flushing it. We were also awakened by a smoke detector running out of batteries.  To the host’s credit, she was responsive to our requests to do some additional cleaning, replace the stained sheet, and supply wash cloths, hand towels, hand soap, and more than two glasses — all of which were missing when we checked in.  She replied promptly to our messages but otherwise mainly put responsibility for the maintenance issues on us. When we indicated that we would like some type of refund for dealing with these issues, she said she’d met AirBnB’s requirements.  Please do not spend your hard-earned dollars on this listing.

This place and host were fabulous! The loft was WAY bigger than we were expecting & in such a great central location to everything we wanted to do. The checkin & checkout were exceptionally flexible which made our lives stress free. The host was so easy to get in touch with when we had questions and just all around very pleasant. If you’re considering this place, do it!

Charles place was really nice and clean. It felt a lil sketchy when I 1st arrived, but after getting inside - it was good. There was no furniture like a Couch or TV but it's well worth the price being charged.
It’s a very nice and comfortable basic place but on a scary street corner. I hope things continue to improve for the neighborhood.

The location is great. There are several subway stops in the immediate vicinity that take you quickly to various corners of the city. Check-in was easy and uncomplicated thanks to the key box. The room itself was fine and in my opinion is smaller than it looks in the pictures. The toilets and shower are shared with the neighbors on the floor. Unfortunately there is a very unpleasant smell in the stairwell. Our guess is that the smell came from one of the apartments next door. Here the door was a bit broken and the smell came from the named apartment. The window in the room could only be closed but not locked. So we always took our valuables with us. The building itself is a bit older and showing its age and it shows. Conclusion: great for someone who travels a lot and wants to be in the city quickly! For someone who wants to look forward to “home” and relax comfortably, not so much.
Very nice and clean and comfortable. ac worked great, bring shampoo and conditioner. Neighborhood is a bit scary for someone unfamiliar.

This place is amazing! Super clean and well-located. Down the street from a really nice super market, a park, bars and cafes. Just two blocks from the metro.   The place was spotless and stocked with all of the essentials. There’s also a backyard, with well-kept plants and grass, which is a great place to relax in the mornings and evenings!  Eydie was super helpful. There was never a time we couldn’t reach her if we needed something and she was able to accommodate our early check-in and late check-out requests, which took a ton of stress off of our arrival and departure.   Can’t say enough good things, honestly. If you’re looking for a safe, comfortable place to stay in the Bushwick, Brooklyn area—this is it.

Cory is a stellar host. He and his family have truly simplified the whole checkin/checkout process and have given attention to little details that make your stay really comfortable. Cory is really great about responding to your messages quickly, concisely, and with relevant information.  If you're seeking a low-stress location when checking out NYC and the surrounding areas, stay at Cory's.

The people that stay there are very inconsiderate and disrespectful. I couldn’t sleep from the noise. I made complaints and still continued. The parking garage are scam artist. You supposed to get a discount if you stayed at the hotel but no discount was given plus they charged oversized vehicle when I had a small SUV

Unfortunately, there were many issues regarding this reservation. I informed the host about it but he did not react.  1. Room was listed as private, but in fact it was impossible to lock it from outside (only from inside the room. There were unknown people in the flat, we did not even know if the owner lives there or not. When we accidentally meet in the kitchen he did not even introduce himself. We had to ask him if he is Kay. He only mentioned that in other room lives “cool guy from Argentina” but in fact we did not know who lives there. So we had to leave all our belongings in opened room in a flat with unknown people. When we wrote Kay about it he tried to convinced me that room was not listed as private. 2. There were no amenities that were listed: no soap, shower gel, shampoo. There were only 1 used roll of toilet paper which was very quickly finished. When we asked Kay about the amenities he said that there are cosmetic under the shower (used one, also used bar of soaps) and put ALREADY USED BY SOMEONE ELSE bar of soap at the bathroom sink.  3. Due to pandemic and according to information at Kay’s offer, he committed to Airbnb’s 5-step enhanced cleaning process—a set of standards developed in partnership with experts, for the times of COVID-19 and beyond. Here’s what Kay committed to doing before every stay: Sanitize surfaces Sanitize every high-touch surface, down to the doorknob Use approved products Use cleaners approved by health experts, like disinfectants with 70% alcohol or higher Thoroughly clean Refer to our extensive checklists while cleaning room-by-room Both room and the whole apartment were completely dirty and did not look liked cleaned with any directions, especially not with Covid ones. During our weekly visit we did not see anyone cleaning anything, they were also no disinfections liquids or anything like that. We had a private mini fridge in room, which has sticky stains inside. Room and flat were full of dust and dirt. There were spider webs in the room. Kitchen was disgusting, sticky stains and dirt all over the main fridge, dirty fridge from the outside and dirty oven. Broken ceiling. Bathroom was also dirty. Sink and bathtub was clogged. There were stains and dirt everywhere. Fan in the ceiling was totally full of dust and seems like it was NEVER cleaned.  4. Rubbish. The owner did not throw rubbish through our 7 days stay. Rubbish were staying and stinking in the kitchen. We were not informed where are the common dumpsters at the street.  5. There were 2 electricity plug ins in the room, only 1 was working.  6. Flat is very smokes friendly, almost everyday we could smell cigarettes and marihuana.  7. Windows are old and draughty (and also dirty of course) Wind and cold are coming into the apartment.  The owner was informed about all of the issues and he did nothing (except adding roll of toilet paper and disgusting used bar of soap). Conditions were not inconsistent with the offer and I did not received what I paid for. Conditions of the flat are dangerous to health, especially during current pandemic situation. I must admit that the owner promised to clean the house with special rules regarding Covid-19. Unfortunately, I can't recommend this place not only because cleanliness and conditions but also due to Kay's attitude.  Location is pretty ok, but room is really small (if you are in 2 don't even thing about taking 2 big checked in luggage, we had 2 problem to put everything inside the room with 2 small carry-ons). Not worth staying at all.

Kay was very responsive, and even allowed us to check in earlier since the room was already available and our flight arrived very early. Overall the stay is ok and if you want to spend some time in central park the LOCATION IS EXCELLENT, The room and apartment itself needs some basic maintenance. Pros: location is great lot of local delis, cafes and restaurants in the neighborhood. The price is fair for what you get, and virtual host responsiveness. Room for improvement: Room windows won’t close completely so lot of noise from the outside and room little cold at night. Closet’s door handle broken was hard to open/close every time. There was also a big jacket which steal space of the small closet, don’t know if forgot from previous guests or from host. Curtains missing and falling every day, I had to fix it several times during windy days. Garbage accumulated from other guests and little to no regulations. Same with the fridge.

LOCATION: This apartment has an amazing location for tourists. It's a few blocks from Times Square and only a half a mile from Radio City Music Hall. There are restaurants and coffee shops everywhere you turn and it seems family-friendly, (kids catching the bus across the street), and not  one homeless person spotted in the three/four days we were there.   BATHRM: There's one, and it's tiny. But, this is to be expected in NYC. The biggest inconvenience is that it's located in the kitchen / main living room, and there is no exhaust fan. So, this is not the time to try an exotic dish, unless you're very comfortable with the people you're staying with. The host did provide a large box of matches to mask any unpleasant odors.   BEDRMS: The bedrooms are a great size! They face the street and there is little insulation to the windows, so a sound machine/app is recommended. The window units also have fans on them that mask street noise at night.

Good place for a short stay just to get some sleep. Fantastic location, quiet and safe neighborhood with many restaurants and stores within walking distance, convenient and quick access to Manhattan. Very clear check-in instructions. The room is in the basement and, despite the full-length window, it is very dark inside, there is a need to turn on the light even during the day. Towels and bedding and blankets have an unpleasant, foul smell (those in the closet, too).   No matter what, if you are looking for cheap accommodation in a great location and need a place to just sleep I recommend this room! :)

This was my 1st visit to New York and it could not have been better!  My stay started with just me and my 9 year old daughter. This place is right across the street from the police station. We were in room 503 and when you look out the window you can actually see the police station.   We arrived pretty late due to our plane being delayed. I messaged the host he responded right away and upon arrival the check in process took 10min or less. This is a hotel setting and I did have to put a credit card up for damages $150.00.   Upon entering the room we found everything to be clean we had two queen size beds. Again normal hotel set up. The size of the room was not huge but it was very comfortable for myself, daughter and husband once he arrived.   They have a restaurant and bar in the lobby but we did not use it . We did order DoorDash the night we made it and had no problem getting our food delivered promptly.   Again this was our first time so riding the subway and easy access to the subway was important to me and I had a 9 year old with me . The closest subway was 34 Penn Station and it was maybe a 3 min walk . Most mornings I would use my Starbucks app and order breakfast by the time I walked to pick it up our order was ready and I could get to the subway from every corner. Our 1st subway ride was to get us to the American Girl Store and it took all of 15 to 20 mins. It was alway easy to find our way back just get to 34 Penn Station and once you get above ground turn your google map on walking and it will send you in the right direction would take no longer then 3-5 mins from any direction .   The purpose of our trip was sightseeing so when we left we never returned until night fall. I never felt unsafe at anytime. The lobby does not look like the Hilton in Hawaii but the room was very comfortable and to be honest I am so glad that I did not spend the extra money on the higher end hotels because we were never there.   I have rented at a hotel before but they did not follow the same protocol as the hotel but you just don’t know how HAPPY I WAS to enter into a CLEAN ROOM after walking 15000 plus steps a day.   This is a wonderful place to stay if your coming to get out and have fun ! If it’s a anniversary or honeymoon trip upgrade but if it a fun getaway Book Now !

This is a beautiful apartment, but the host is incredibly difficult to communicate with. Initially, there were a few misrepresentations of what to expect, such as free on site parking (which the host later said he meant there is street parking, notoriously easy to find in Brooklyn), the presence of exercise equipment in the photos and listing, and details on what their cancellation policy actually consists of. There is no check in instructions, such as where to look for a lockbox and which one of the 14 unmarked lock boxes is the proper one. On my second day, I was unable to turn their AC unit on as it was 95degrees that day, and had to vacate the premises until that evening. No response from the host all that day, and then it was a number to call a handyman even though it was now after hours. Truly, a very unpleasant experience, especially when the host accused me of “gaslighting” him for sharing a screen shot of their 24hr+ notice for cancellations, to which they replied that they couldn’t see it on their end, must be some default, let’s just wait for Airbnb to reply. Much unpleasant back and forth to what should have been a quick and easy trip, except I was frequently treated with hostility from this host, who seems to not know how anything in the apartment works. Again, beautiful space, but that’s about it.

We had a wonderful time at Laia’s place. The loft is gorgeous and SPACIOUS! We loved coming back after exploring and running around in the city. Kitchen is fully stocked including spice rack and the overall vibes are so calming. I loved the abundance of indoor plants!! The place was very clean.   When you go outside the neighborhood gives gentrification vibes. It’s definitely “edgy” and “rugged” outside but I did not feel unsafe per se. During the day I felt perfectly fine, but at night I was glad I wasn’t alone if I had to walk somewhere and that my sister was with me. This didn’t bother me though because I am used to major cities and urbanization.   Everyone we encountered in passing that lives in the building was very friendly. Water pressure in the shower is fantastic!
Don’t be at all afraid to book this one. It is exactly what it claims to be. Great place, great location. If it fits what you need, just do it.

Wouldn’t recommend this place. The shower wasn’t working, and the outdoor door was completely jammed - we got stuck outside and heard other tenants stuck and unable to exit. When I messaged the airbnb host she said no one else had ever complained about it and denied that the door had any issues. Without communicating she sent someone over to fix the door, and we weren’t expecting it because she didn’t communicate so it was pretty creepy to have a random man repeatedly knocking on our door for about 20 minutes especially as women staying by ourselves. I would usually say you get what you pay for however I feel like a working shower is the bare minimum. The host really lacked communication skills and was totally dismissive of anything we brought up.

My friends and I had a good stay at this air bnb. The space looked so much better than the pictures, and it was pretty comfortable for all 10 of us. Also, the location was center to grocery stores and drug stores which was very convenient. Alice was attentive to our needs and only a phone call away when we needed anything. Definitely recommend this place.

This place is just as advertised. Clean, stocked with extras, and in a safe neighborhood. We walked to the Ditmars station every morning and took the 30-minute N train to the city. Very convenient. There is a grocery store, drug store, and several restaurants nearby.

everything was perfect. the accommodation very clean. Jenny is, although very available, a very discreet host. Jenny and her family live above the accommodation but we never heard any noise.  the equipment is complete, the hygiene products provided were sufficient for our 10-day stay and for 5 people. everything is there; shower product, shampoo, moisturizing body lotion, toothbrushes, hair dryer, straighteners, clothes steamer, basically everything. breakfast was made available to us, at our request every day, the refrigerator contained, upon our arrival, drinks and ice cream, coffee pods and tea were also available. the accommodation is located approximately 25 minutes from Manhattan by the metro which is a 10-15 minute walk from the accommodation. the transfer from the airport to the accommodation is a bit complicated and long, we recommend taking a taxi or an Uber. THE day we left, Jenny allowed us to leave our luggage there, our flight being at 7:30 p.m., which allowed us to take one last walk in Manhattan. To conclude, we recommend this accommodation well suited for a stay in New York.

I had a great experience-- we had an event on the day of check-in, and we were greatly accommodated. We were able to drop our bags off before check-in, allowing so much stress to be alleviated from the day. Wifi worked great, I was able to do my school work while there. Communication was always great. Amenities provided were a life saver. Couldn't recommend more. Thanks for everything!

Jordan’s flat is nice, but we had an absolute nightmare checking in. The lock key would not open, and we arrived at 11pm. It took 45 mins to open in -11! The host also has only one key for himself and guests. It would have been helpful to have two keys so people would come and go as they please. The flat overall was very nice but the neighbour above drums very loudly most of the day which is a nightmare if you need to work. We also ended up leaving early because there were cockroaches in the bathroom which was the worst part and very stressful. After this, the host denied a refund through airbnb, despite saying he would in a private message. I would recommend the flat in terms of interior, but be ready for a precarious check in, loud drumming and a visit from some cockroaches.
Great place to stay! Area is a little sketchy but otherwise nothing to bad. The place was exactly as pictured although the linens weren’t clean. I would stay again.
Stress-free move-in and stay. The host is very considerate.

I can not express enough how great this AirBNB was. Louise's apartment was everything we were looking for and more.   First of all, I have never explored Red Hook in Brooklyn prior to this trip and I instantly fell in love. The community, the convenience, and the commute into Manhattan were stress-free and welcoming. I have been to NYC a million times and this was the most relaxed trip I think I have ever had.   Louise had a direct line of communication our entire stay and is beyond sweet and helpful. She sent a PDF guide prior to our stay on the ins and outs of checking in,  how to get the projector up and running, and other helpful information. Like local hospitals, stores, etc.   I am an artist so the decor and vibe of the place are literally everything. The apartment is gorgeous and clean and provided everything we needed. I loved having a washer and dryer on-site and I don't think I can stay at another Airbnb without being able to wash my clothes.   I have a medical condition that is most problematic for my legs so I was nervous about this being a 4th-floor apartment walk up but it was never an issue!  And I ended up used to climbing the stair by day two. I am mostly mentioning the stairs in the event stairs won't work for you or you have a hard time carrying baggage up multiple flights of stairs if you're a solo traveler.   The apartment is the coziest, coolest, chill spot in NYC! I personally can not recommend this listing enough if you're looking for a truly special New York City experience.

For the most part, our stay was absolutely great! The place looks nice and is just as pictured, it was clean, and for the most part I have no complaints. However, there's a few things I'd like to note.  I gave them 4 stars for accuracy, because even though it ended up benefiting us, the Airbnb wasn't exactly as described. Instead of a sofa bed and the bunk bed, the unit had a regular double bed and the bunk bed; again, this was actually a really pleasant surprise, but I thought I'd mention it since the same issue with lack of accuracy could've been very negative if something else was different than advertised.  Also, Francisco could've better communicated a few key details to us. When he mentions the listing includes washer & dryer, these are of course in the lobby, but don't be fooled - these aren't free of cost nor affordable. To sum it up, it's $3 per wash and $3 per dry on a "money card" that only accepts minimum payments of $10 (that was $4 automatically wasted for us) and costs another $10 to even obtain in the first place... Definitely our most expensive "souvenir" from New York. 💀 Therefore, you really just *have* to pay 20 bucks for something that should've cost 6. Long story short: don't rely on the complex's laundry area; you're much better off just finding a nearby laundromat.  Another hidden cost came with the luggage service Francisco told us we could make use of. When he told me about this, he never mentioned its cost of $5 per bag you drop off. Again, not a super huge cost, since you can leave your bags there the whole day for just 5 bucks, but I just think it would've been much better to know beforehand.  Lastly, the building is a *tiny* bit sketchy; it doesn't seem especially fancy by any means, so you might have a few neighbors that slightly creep you out. Luckily, we were able to avoid any unpleasant situations...  Other than those few complaints, our stay was amazing for the most part, and I'd definitely stay here again in a heartbeat, now that I'm aware of those few hidden surprises.  Ultimately, I think it's a good option if you're looking for good value for what you pay and can deal with these few inconveniences. :)

Alex’s apartment is beautifully designed, and has everything you need for a longer stay.  My girlfriend and I really enjoyed it.   I will go as far as saying that this is the best Airbnb apartment I stayed at! Alex himself is supper responsive, extra friendly and provided great instructions.   That being said, the neighborhood is a different story, on the upside it’s relatively close to Williamsburg and a quick-ish subway ride to Manhattan.   But at least in our experience, the neighborhood does not feel safe at night.  The street where the apartment is located is fine, but the way leading to the subway felt a bit sketchy.   Unfortunately we had a very unpleasant experience, where we got mugged and threatened when we exited the subway station one evening. Thankfully we didn’t get hurt, but avoided walking around the neighborhood, especially at night.  *again, this is only a personal experience*   My advice would be to take an Uber when going out in the evening hours.

I would do a triple check on where you are staying. This Airbnb is in a really sketchy part of town and they need to invest in things like blankets, a lock pad that works, and a few other things. Very baseline Airbnb but wouldn’t recommend it for going to the city because it’s just really a lot of work and time you have to put into trains.

Host was very welcoming and nice she lived upstairs . But the apartment wasn’t the best, the shower over flooded with dirty water that came up from drain one afternoon, the host cleaned it but left the dirt in the drain it was so disgusting I didn’t want to shower barefoot, she had to call a plumber also the shower head sprayed water all over the floor when turned on to take a shower so the floor was always soaking wet, the toilet stopped flushing one morning, her husband came to say someone turned off the water. the handle to stove was broke, the backyard was dirty and steps to dangerous to walk up especially at night. The tv froze I had to unplug the back to get it to work again, while watching tv the host kids put AirPlay on their phones and their video game came on the tv screen, the apartment is not self check in has stated and I felt rushed to check in  by host when my flight arrived at 5pm I kept getting asked when was I arriving. I would never stay there again

Good price for a good private room. The location is a bit sketchy, especially the entry of the building itself (there was a doped up sex worker sitting at the bottom of the steps who wouldn’t move when we arrived), but the apartment and the room looks just as pictured. Felt like we had to be super quiet since there are others staying in rooms next door to you in the same apartment, but we were gone most of the day anyways.  Other than that, there are a ton of great restaurants nearby! You can walk around even just a couple of blocks and find all kinds of cool and delicious places.

This host was extremely rude and lacked basic communication, often taking multiple hours to reply to basic questions that should have already been provided in the initial message. The host was also extremely sketchy: she asked if a tenant could come and see the room while we were there, which is extremely unprofessional. I asked her where the bathroom was and she accused me of “being high” and “having a party”?? It’s extremely noisy at night, and the curtain was really thin and didn’t adequately block light, either.

No microwave, no trash can in the room, there are 3 rooms total with 1 shared bathroom, during my visit one of the rooms had 2 people in it.. so sharing 1 bathroom between 4 people.. it wasn’t available so I had to use a restroom at a local market instead. Inconvenient. Bathroom door trouble locking properly.  Neighbor was drunk and touched my shoulder on my way upstairs, shouted at him not to touch me.. it was a scary situation. Not safe.

If you are looking for a great location with spectacular views and all the amenities you can ask, this is exactly what you are looking for! Check-in process was stress-free and easy. Hosts are patience and wonderfully communicative should any issues arise. We over looked the extra blankets in the closet and they were quick to help provide alternative and double check with the cleaning staff to make sure we had everything we needed. We all had such a lovely stay in NYC. Thanks so much!

The doormen are totally onto the air B&B secret the hosts are keeping. They stopped us in the lobby when they saw our suitcase and asked a bunch of questions. I had to think fast and message the host to text me pretending we were friends. Kinda awkward/shady.  The apartment itself is lovely. Nice linens and comfy bed. The open concept kitchen/living room was very nice.  The couch is more like a futon and was okay. The tv did not work but we have iPad pros so we just watched tv on it. Wi-Fi was fast and reliable.   Biggest negative was the heat. There was no way to turn it down and putting the radiator on fan mode didn’t do much to make the room cooler.  Second gripe was the bathroom had porous tiles so it smelled like urine.

Luxurious is questionable. Host didn’t provide the code during check-in time, so we waited outside the property with just enough time to see how sketchy the area was. People were literally getting arrested about 100 feet from the front door. I had my young daughter with me, so I knew immediately this wasn’t a proper place to stay.  The block is super active probably because there’s a school and a subway entrance literally across the street, so definitely something that should be noted on the listing.   Since the host still hasn’t provided the code, we decided to go get food. As we ate we looked for an alternate place to stay.  Immediately reached out to Airbnb the same night to let them know the situation as well as the host the following day. Left the property immediately the next morning before checkout time.   The host refuses to refund me for the 3 nights that we didn’t stay in the property nor will he respond to any of my messages to rectify this problem. Super disappointed with this visit.

Great place, value, and location in Harlem! Neighborhood wasn’t that scary for us non-NYers and there are plenty of subway stops and cute restaurants and cafes around. House was clean, neat, spacious, easily fits 5+ people comfortably! Two big rooms and one office downstairs with full kitchen and 3 bathrooms. Fantastic! Only random thing is that they do NOT have a hair blow dryer so bring your own!

Bad location , very dangerous neighboorhod . The pictures does not rely the apartment , ask actual photos if you want to try . There is no heating system working , probably no air system for the summer. Be careful . for the same price you can get an hotel near Times Square with all services.

Very rude host. She hawked us on the camera at the front entrance. We couldn’t speak entering the house or she would yell out at us that she has roomers on the 1st floor who were being disturbed. When we first checked in other guests walked in on us getting dressed and the host blamed it on us not manually turning the lock on the door when she should’ve ensured that she gave specific directions to all guest to where to go for their room and board. We had the entire 2nd floor to ourself. My friend had a medical emergency outside of the property. On the public sidewalk.
