She yelled out at us asking what’s going on in front of her property instead of being compassionate asking if we needed help. She then stated she was going to call Airbnb n report me. We were frustrated with her bc of her extremely rude approach to the situation. The house is also between kfc and a mechanic shop. And next to a bus stop. It was a very sketchy area to be standing outside at night. Given the high foot traffic.

Location can be a bit sketchy here… but other then that, the place was decent to stay at. There was some things that needed to be fixed here but Tiana made sure it was all settled within 2 hours. Good communicative host.

Great location, excellent service, cleanliness, most importantly - mattress was super comfortable. It felt like a second home. Would definitely stay there again. Other reviews mentioned this, the alley is really dark and empty so it was scary going back every night.
Very cute room close to China town and Little Italy. The ally seems a little sketchy, but we didn’t have any issues.

Ideal accommodation location, everything is nearby. Don't be too demanding with cleanliness, that's the downside. The bathrooms are shared (hairs in the shower, underwear lying around... dirty toilets) This accommodation is good but just for sleeping, in our case with two large suitcases and two bags, difficult to move in the room. Also don't be afraid of bunk beds with poor quality mattresses.

Not happy with this booking at all.  We booked a room with 2 bunk beds and the room had 1 loft bed and a sofa bed, which was shorter than a single, had a metal bar down the middle and was uncomfortable. We contacted Koichi after 2 sleepless nights and said we wanted to check out and please refund the next 3 nights, had no reply so started a dispute and AirBnb intervened and issued the refund and a credit on our account.   The bathrooms are technically clean, but much older and worn than the photos. Although it’s only a couple of blocks from Penn St station which is convenient, the streets surrounding the building are unsafe compared to other areas we stayed in Manhattan.

Max is a  great and friendly host! It was super easy to check in. The feeling in the Airbnb was amazing! The room was great, the lights and music was very nice and also the bathroom and kitchen was nice!  I would say that the location was really unsafe because of the homeless people and criminality! All in all was it a great visit! Thank you Max for the easy communication and lovely stay! :)

I never so a room and bathroom that clean. The room had everything I needed. A fridge and lots of space to put my things. The decorations were very sweet it made me feel at home :) The hallway of the house is just a bit scary and dirty but do not get the wrong impression. The room and appartement are really great!

I had a great stay at Thierry's house. Super clean house, very well equipped room with a large television, air conditioning and fresh water available in the minibar. I had a problem with my flight and I was only able to check in early in the morning, but Thierry was very friendly and welcomed me warmly despite the late hour. The only thing I didn't appreciate was the location, because I felt unsafe walking at night. But this is not Thierry's fault, but the crime in that area.  I recommend Thierry's house

The place is wonderful advertised as is close to alot of food spots and subway   But the host has hidden agenda u dont accuse someone for stealing a damn cup when they literally spend over thousand to book your place i just bought you 100 of them mfs  No smoking on the front or inside the home completely understandable but he tried to get me for that by taking products out the trash which is beyond me if that aint malicious intent idk what is

This was definitely a steal. I booked last minute for a family emergency (to make funeral arrangements) and was welcomed from the first email of communication.   The place was clean, check in was easy, patio was super accessible warm and cozy to chill with family and share memories! Nazeer and Assistance were on point with communication.    Flying in from Los Angeles to New York to bury my little sister who just passed at 28 yrs old in her apartment (police stated no file play ,no drugs involved, she got up to go about her day and collapsed in her kitchen) .  I like to be transparent and communicate when you meet good people like Mr Nazeer. I thank you again for allowing me and my family to use your home on short notice and your description of your home and professionalism allowed us some peace of mind🌻🌻🌻.

Where do I start. If you bypass this home , you will be missing out on a beautiful experience. We pulled up to the home , which is easily identified by the address. It is right next door to the barber  shop and a church. I read an earlier post that said the neighborhood was not safe. I found it to be real safe. We walked back and forth to the grocery store, which is stocked with everything you will need, dollar tree, and many restaurants. We spoke to the neighbors and they spoke back. We never felt unsafe. The house is exactly like the pictures. We walked in and were so amazed by the space. We were a family of five and there was plenty space for all of us. We were concerned about only having one bathroom, but as beautiful as that bathroom was, it worked out well. That shower will make you want to move in permanently. There was never a shortage of hot water. The bedrooms all had televisions and their own individual air conditioners. The house stayed cool and comfortable the entire time. Communication was wonderful. They are very nice and so professional. They accommodated us in every way possible. The Airbnb was surrounded by all different stores. Forever Pork was our favorite . We would catch a Uber to the Jamaican Center to get on the subway , but that is because we were too lazy to catch a bus. When I tell you that you don’t have to worry about transportation. This is a great place  to stay because it is in a great spot if you are going into Manhattan or anywhere else. The beds are so comfortable and the kitchen is stocked with everything you will need. This is a good place with good vibes. You better come on and catch it!!!!!

The place is very big, in the pictures looks as small place but it’s very big. The house have everything you will need and you maybe forget to take with you you will feel like home . The neighbourhood is not that beautiful because it’s like comercial zone, I was scared to leave my car outside but believe me is very save. There is a dollar tree store near. Gracias ☺️

The space was great everything was exactly as advertised. Everything needed was supplied including and a/c unit. The space was clean and spacious for two people. Mark was a great host, we stayed with him during a stressful move to NYC and in the middle of trying to find house he was very flexible about our stay in addition to being a great communicator. He always made sure we're taken care of, and went out of his way to answer any questions we had. Mark made for a great first experience in Brooklyn and I would highly recommend staying with him for both short and long-term needs!

This was my first time using airbnb so I was a little nervous about the process but it was completely painless. His responses were prompt, and his place is clean, spacious, and truly seconds away from the subway. For the convenience and comfort, it’s definitely a steal.

Would definitely stay here again! Stephen and his wife were excellent hosts. They were very responsive, and laid back.   The apartment was as pictured, spotless, and smelled very clean. The coffee, and plenty of bottled water were a nice touch. Comfy beds, and a cozy place overall.  Location to the subway was a big seller for us. Definitely less than a 30 second walk. Probably closer to 10 seconds.  I read some other reviews discussing the location. It's a working class urban neighborhood. We're smokers, so we spent some time outside, including late at night, and all of our interactions with locals were very normal. We were never made to feel unsafe.

Clell is amazing and went above and beyond for me and my guest. His place is spotless and exactly as advertised on Airbnb. He is friendly and very helpful, but will give you your space as granted. His place is close to a lot of stores, restaurants, and bars. I highly recommend if your in the area and need a place to rest your head for a night or even longer. I give him 5 ⭐️‘s and a 👍🏽 for being a great guy and a super host. Thanks again Clell you made our stay effortless and stress free. I wish you all the best and thanks for everything.
Great place, the subway is very close. I was alone and I wasn't afraid to come back at night. We didn't meet the landlord but communicated easily if needed. I come back.

Ives basement has everything we needed for a cozy 3 day stay. Line 2 metro direct to Manhattan is two blocks away, 30 minutes more or less to most museums. The neighborhood is not the gentrified part of Brooklyn which is great..you can get authentic Caribbean food if you walk a block or two in any direction. As far as accessibility- anyone taller than 5’7’’ will have to duck to enter, there’s a staircase down so baggage needs to be carried. The basement is a basement and there aren’t windows so if you need cooler air or ventilation, it gets hot in the mornings! The only issues we had with staying was the airbnb directly above us, one morning at 6 AM the people we’re moving furniture or luggage for quite a long time and woke us all up. (We were adjusting to a 4 hour earlier time difference from Alaska so it was not great since 6 AM is 2AM our time) and if you have a dog the cleaning ladies are scared of them so don’t assume to let your dog out into the yard! I felt perfectly safe in the neighborhood, day or night, we enjoyed our time and especially the hot showers at the end of the day and cozy bed. I think it’s a decent deal for NYC if your a small family looking for a private space.

Unfortunately, we had a less than ideal stay. Trouble with check-in left us walking around for an hour looking for wifi after a long flight, unclean sheets with stain, bug bites in bed, no toiletries (all empty), only 1 roll of toilet paper for 8 days, empty dishwashing liquid, unpleasant odor in apartment.  We stayed in a hotel after getting constant bug bites in the sheets and were highly disappointed when trying to bring our concerns to the hosts. First Airbnb we’ve really been upset with.   Pros - location is great and the apartment is spacious (true to photos). Airbnb were also very helpful with our claims.
It was an unpleasant stay, the place was dirty and messy. We had to fix it to be able to rest.

Nicholas's place was great for our group of 5 friends. The home was clean, spacious, and had everything we needed. The location was okay, away from the city, but there were some somewhat sketchy houses nearby. It was a little difficult to find parking, but we knew about that ahead of time and made arrangements to park elsewhere. Overall, it was perfect for our little weekend getaway.

We had a great stay at this lovely home in Maspeth. It is clean and comfortable inside and has been recently, beautifully remodeled. The owners were very attentive and responded quickly and kindly when we contacted them. There are many thoughtful touches around the house, like the toy bin for young children. We really loved it and highly recommend this affordable, clean, safe, comfy home.  ** It is not the owners' fault, but finding parking is an important limitation of this house.  When you plan your visit keep in mind that reliably parking a car on the street in the neighborhood is practically impossible. We had lived in Astoria for years, so we knew parking in NYC is a challenge. Plus the ad mentions the difficulty of parking. But the parking difficulty we experienced was way more than we expected. When we asked the owners' help (after getting a ticket and barely escaping two (!) towing scares), they were responsive and helpful and suggested we try parking in front of the driveway that their own house shares with another residence and leave a note with our contact information to ensure the neighbors would have a way to contact us if they needed our car to move. Even after we did all of that, we woke up to find an angry note from the neighbors about our car being in the driveway.   Bottom line: This is not the owners' fault, but the nature of the neighborhood mean that you will definitely not be able to park your car reliably here and it can get quite stressful not to know if you are going to be able to find your car where you left it. A better choice would be to park your car in a long-term lot somewhere and go to and from this house by public transportation or rideshare.

The location is close to the JFK airport, where you can take the Q3 bus to terminal 5 (cheapest way), or Q30/31 bus to sutphin blvd, then airtrain to the terminal (more expensive but faster). Stella's home was really clean and good for a stay if you need to catch a flight in the morning at JFK. She has a cat but very quiet and well behaved. Just a  bit unsafe when walking from subway to house and no elevator in the subway, which is not convenient to carry a big luggage.

Jaleh and her daughter were really nice. Jaleh responded to me very quickly after I was let down at the last minute in the late evening by another host. She was very helpful and accommodating turning what could have a been a disaster into a stress free trip and stay.

Teri is a good host. She's very flexible with check-in time and also answers your questions and phone calls. But her place is not worth the stay. There's street parking but you're taking a risk of either getting a parking ticket or your car being towed. The bathrooms are dirty and you can hear the traffic and people of NYC right in your room. Cars are honking, NYPD traffic officers blowing their whistles. Not to mention the host has roommates who live with her - it was just very awkward and uncomfortable staying the night with complete strangers. I didn't feel safe and I was afraid to leave my luggage and possessions unattended in the room. Other than that the room is big to accommodate 3 guests. The room is dusty and the floors are dirty. If you ever stay here make sure to take a pair of slippers and shower shoes. I wouldn't recommend this place. I will never go back especially for $200 for one night. NOT WORTH IT! You should stay at a hotel!

interestingly, if you have the chance to translate it into your language!!! 😌 The host was really flexible regarding arrival on site! We arrived around 11:30pm and there were no problems. Super nice welcome, the place is very easy to access and plenty of parking on the street. As for the surrounding area, you have to pay $15 to have access to Staten Island (unpleasant if you want to leave the island at several times). We found that there wasn't much to do nearby! There is the ferry 10 minutes walk away which can take you to Manhattan, free!! and allows you to see the Statue of Liberty🏙☺️, the places are clean, however you are in the basement, so you may hear walking from above!!! (small negative point) In general I recommend this place!

We had a wonderful stay in Staten Island. The apartment is clean and well equipped. It takes approximately 50 minutes travelling to Downtown Manhattan which is quite nice cause you travel with the free Staten Island ferry. And you have the advantage of being in a calm and nice neighbourhood without the stress and the hectic of the city. Would definitely go there again!

Yooo, hands down, Jonathan has set the bar for other B N B hosts. Not only was he a great host in terms of respect & communication he’s also very intellectual. Don’t hesitate to spark a conversation!! Before I got there, he took the time to recommend me eateries along with their location. Upon arrival he explained the transportation routes and how to get from A to B. Not only was he informational, he was on standby for any questions I had ready to assist. Mr. Jonathan made this trip stress free especially since I’ve never been to New York. Just off of his guidance, I felt as though I was from around. You can’t go wrong with this place. I’ll leave pros and cons below. Once again thanks !!!  Pros:  Quick & detailed response.  Comfortable bed. Towels, hairdryer, iron, hangers, are Included. Common area is kept tidy. Enough room in the fridge for you to store food.  The area is perfect.. I came home around 2 am every night and I had no reason to look over my shoulders.  Everything is about 30 mins away while there’s so much food places about 2 mins walking.  The bathroom is amazing!!! Gives me loft vibes. The train and bus stop are 5mins away.   Cons: It’s on the 3rd floor. The interior leading up to the apartment is on the older side.
A stress-free, drama-free host. A convenient location to Manhattan at an affordable rate. A quiet, clean room and shower. What more does one need?

I had a great stay at Jonathan’s! The room was perfect for me, one person who would be spending the majority of their time out in the city and needed somewhere to get ready for the day and sleep for the night. The room itself had its own AC and TV. It was also very clean (the whole place was actually).   Check in was pretty simple even though Jonathan wasn’t home when I arrived. He sent me step by step instructions that worked just fine! I had a question about one thing and he responded quickly as well.   The location was wonderful. There were tons of restaurants and things to do in the neighborhood. It never felt unsafe to me either. His place is also just a 3 minute walk to a subway station where you can get to Manhattan in maybe 8 or 9 stops.   Jonathan was very respectful and friendly! I would definitely recommend this Airbnb.

Choosing to stay at this gem in Astoria was one of the best decisions I could have made!   Location: The location of this spot was perhaps the best part. Just a few blocks away from Steinway/30th/Broadway, there was NEVER a shortage of restaurants or grocery stores to stop by or go for a walk. The subway station was also only a brief walk down the block, and connects to Manhattan in a pretty quick ride. Definitely the best spot for someone who wants to enjoy both Manhattan and Queens stress-free. Laundromat was 1 block up the street (Bubli) and they were super sweet, relatively cheap, and pretty quick.  Property: The place was well-stocked with amenities, full kitchen, bathroom, etc.. Which was a big help with only being in town for a relatively short time. The space was pretty comfortable for 1-2 ppl (we were a couple and found it well-sized). But there is also a recliner for another guest if possibly required. There was a large smart TV with Netflix, Hulu, YouTube, etc. which came in handy. There were no issues with pests, cameras, or anything else concerning, so all clear there. Occasional footsteps heard upstairs, but that's to be expected with a basement apartment.  Host: Charlie was super accommodating and responsive to any messages I sent over, and was always willing to lend a helping hand. Check-in and check-out process was super easy and all instructions were conveniently provided in a binder that I could reference at any time.   Overall: Great spot, great host! No complaints whatsoever. You won't regret it. 🙂

Oscar is very friendly and it was easy to communicate with him. Apartment is nicely decorated and has a lot of utilities, such as dishes, pots, spices and different bottles of shampoo/conditioner/etc. The neighborhood is OK, there live a lot of families and a grocery store is right around the corner.  However, we experienced a few inconvenient issues during our stay. The wooden floors are very noisy, you can hear every step from above, where the host lives. And it was really unpleasant to hear the dropping of some things after 11pm right above the bedroom.  Also during our stay WIFI was absolutely unreliable, it disappeared constantly and 90% of the time we used our mobile internet.

i can’t express how grateful i am to have hosts like Julien and his wife. the best hosts i’ve ever encountered in their luxurious condo. the price was a steal compared to the amenities it came with. truly 5 star hosting. God bless them. i messed up on the scheduling and they were understanding to help me out when i pick the wrong date by accident. i didn’t deserve this kind of hospitality. i look forward to using this airbnb again in the future!! best hosts ever

When I was looking for an apt in Brooklyn, it took me sometime.. But when I found Julian's place, I didnt hesitate to go ahead and reserve immediately. The reviews, the pictures and details of the house were perfect for us - and I was wondering, how one host has all those positive reviews on Airbnb? :) but when we arrived and stayed at the apt, we knew why! Julian and Sonal are AWESOME. They are super friendly and made sure we are home away from home. Gave us tips on getting around, finding the best deals and a lovely check-in gift. Other than the friendly get-togethers and fun-chats at their lovely garden/backyard.   We also stayed during a stressful time (after couple of days from check-in the entire NY State has been on a shut-down due to COVID-19). Yet the hosts made sure to reach out to us on a daily basis, made sure we are safe, and also offered help with supplies, getting around..etc. Not to mention, when my car got towed - Julian took the risk to get out of his quarantine and drove me to NYPD to help out with getting my car back.   Being a foreigner and staying with this lovely family made the trip an entire different experience. Julian and Sonal travel a lot - you would be lucky if they are there during your stay. The house has its own entrance and has a private hallway, you get 100% privacy. They just live on the second floor.   The house was super clean, has all amenities. We cooked everyday at the house, and honestly we needed nothing to bring in. Everything was there! Had extra sheets, towels, duvets, and everything you need for a comfortable stay.   The best part, they were super responsive and always there for us!  In short, we will never forget this trip. Thank you Julian and Sonal for everything. We can't wait to be back and spend more time in Brooklyn, and with you guys! Love to you both and your lovely princess! :)

Traveling can be stressful and where you stay can make or break a trip. Alanah and her home made the trip something to remember. It was nice little oasis and felt like I was at weekend spa as her home was stylish, relaxing, calming, and convenient to getting around the city.

The apartment was perfectly clean, spacious and exactly as pictured. The bed was super soft and comfortable and it would be a great place to for a longer term stay if you needed to cook for yourself, as the kitchen was well equipped. Although the apartment itself was spotless, the access to the entrance was almost blocked each day due to the trash piling up in front of the door, which didn’t make for a nice welcome. There was some noise in the early evenings from the children upstairs but it was already addressed in the property description and wasn’t too disturbing. Walking from the nearby subway stations to the apartment after dark felt unsafe and we chose to take an Uber home a couple of times to avoid this.

Apartment is good, beautiful design, big area, but it’s in basement, so no sunshine inside, anyway very comfortable   But district is not safety, a lot of drug users, garbage and homeless people. Nearest supermarket is very expensive

I had to go to the city for last minute professional business and booked the night before arriving. Joe was able to accommodate and communicated very well with check in. I didn't stay very long, but I've been to the city enough times to know that if I were staying for a couple of days, his place would be a steal! It's in the east village, so if you're into the foodie, bar scene and trendy lifestyle, you've hit the jackpot! His place is walking distance from some of my favorite restaurants in the city and only two blocks away from the L train. His apartment is also pretty awesome with the roof top patio. I chatted with Joe briefly, but overall he is a cool dude and I'd definitely recommend this place.
Fantastic, responsive host! This place is a steal

Convenient location & really great apartment. Tiffany was flexible with the check-in time (there’s a lockbox for self check-in) and she was easy to reach. I only wish that I was told that her apartment would be undergoing maintenance during my stay- my husband and I were woken up early after a late night by the maintenance team. Not a big deal, but it definitely gave us a scare :)  This was my first airbnb experience, and I’m grateful for how easy it was. Thank you, Tiffany!

Jose's place is a great value for visiting New York, sitting in a quiet neighborhood of Harlem, with easy access to downtown through subway or bus.  Jose was not there, but would  answer promptly to any request through text. Besides, his roommate Luigi was very welcoming and helpful.  The space is small but sufficiently comfortable for the value. The neighborhood may look a bit sketchy, but we didn't see anything that would concern us. Standard big city street smarts should be enough to keep anyone perfectly safe.

the house was as expected. clean and quiet. only concern was the area of the airbnb. it was a bit scary at night as there would be screaming going around sometimes but no one ever bothered us and it was overall fine.

Good place to stay if you want to safe some money. Digital check in system worked very well. Our check in time was 19.00 pm so check if that fits with your plans. The neighbourhood can be a bit scary and the apartment is a bit old but for us that was not a big problem.

Place was similar to pictures, amenities were as described. Cohost Luilly was friendly and helpful. Cleanliness was okay but can be improved. For Female solo travelers, the neighborhood may seem sketchy and you will be sharing the apartment with one or two guys. Overall stay was decent for the price.

René's home is absolutely beautiful! He's done a great job preserving this lovely historic home. The room is very comfortable and spacious. The bed was extremely comfortable. The shared bathroom is very clean and there was never a problem with the other guests. Check in instructions were a breeze. The location is superb! Close to everything Harlem has to offer and a few blocks aways from the nearest subway. Even though it was a hot summer, the lack of AC was not really an issue. The windows and fans offered plenty of fresh air, particularly since the windows look out to a large tree that provides plenty of shade. We felt as though we were in a tree house and it was so lovely to wake up to birds chirping right out of your window. As far as amenities go, no frills, but it is a clean, comfortable, and beautiful place.

I loved the quiet charm nestled in the bustling hub of Harlem, a neighborhood I’ve become extremely fond of. The accessibility to all the shops, restaurants, and the express train to Midtown and Penn Station made everything extremely accessible and stress free. I love the thoughtful restoration and the historic touches such as the decor and the radio playing beautiful jazz programs throughout the brown town and one’s room. Will certainly book again should my dates and availability synchronize! Thank you!

This room is located at the very very top of a 5 story walk up- if you have a lot of luggage, the stairs definitely suck. There’s also a private rooftop deck for Joe’s place which is rad and has a pretty view of the city.  When my boyfriend and I stayed here, it did feel a little awkward. Joe is present while you’re there and the space is really small so privacy is kinda ehhh. He was chillin with a friend and they were being super quiet (not something i really care about at all). I didn’t learn this until I was already in NYC and had paid for the AirBNB that most AirBNBs are ILLEGAL in NYC. I think the law is that the permanent tenant must be present for it to be legal, so word to anyone staying in the city- tenants will probably have to be present.  Joe had another guest in one of the rooms and he was chill. Sheets and pillows smelled dusty and a little weird- probably not totally clean. Overall, this experience was pretty average. Kinda wished I had stayed elsewhere but I also had food poisoning from NORMAN’S CAFE in Brooklyn (don’t ever go there) so my perspective may be a little skewed. I am skeptical in general when it comes to AirBNB hosts in big cities- I feel like a lot of them are creepy and I didn’t necessarily get that vibe from Joe, which was relieving.  The shower is gnarly- the slightest adjustment, and the water gets unbearably boiling hot. My boyfriend scorched his back and was real sensitive for a few hours. Water temp literally went from 0-100 real quick, and then back and forth on its own- so shower CAUTIOUSLY.

We traveled with 3 adults and a child aged 1 year and 3 months.  Ziggy and Rome provided a crib for my niece and they did it with great care. The house was very clean and has the basic accessories if you want to cook. There is no washing machine but there is a laundry room next door. There are two very spacious double bedrooms. The room is also very spacious. A 10-minute walk takes you to a good supermarket and there are several restaurants nearby. We didn't eat in any so I can't speak but the supermarket is very good. The house is 10 minutes from metro station L and about 13 from metro station M. In other words, it is very well located. In around 25 minutes you arrive at 14 Union. The nearby streets are a little dark because of the trees, at first you might think it's dangerous but it's not. We arrived late several days and had no problems. Anyway, I definitely recommend this accommodation.

A lovely clean comfort apartment which was bigger than we expected. Well located to get around NYC on the subway and we also loved the bus which runs alongside Central Park into the centre. Self check-in was easy and directions on how to do this very clear and sent in advance. Our only slight reservation was travelling back later at night. As two older women we found the area immediately around the subway a bit sketchy and used taxis. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would recommend this apartment to others.

Cat's place was a wonderful and my best experience on AirBnB! The apartment is spacious and has a very cute outlook on the back with a garden. If you're lucky, you'll get to taste David's great bread and home-made brioche, the best I ever had! The value for the money is also perfect. It's your ideal stay in Brooklyn. Even if the neighbourhood might look a bit sketchy, there was no moment were I didn't feel safe. Only drawback would be if you need to use a lot the subway and transport, as they are at least 10-15min away, but other than that it's really a perfect stay! My stay of predilection when I'll be back in NYC for sure!

Great place, easy walk to the subway everyday and quiet neighborhood. Check in was super easy even after a delayed flight and getting on the wrong bus, host was very gracious and understanding. Restaurant next door is amazing but it’s a short walk to other restaurants and bodegas. The stairs to the bedroom are a little steep but we never felt unsafe using them. The WiFi  was a little slow when trying to watch a movie but after walking around the city all day we knocked out in the middle of it anyway. Will stay again when visiting.

I can’t stress enough how amazing Cat and David were as host. Responsive in real time, accommodating and gracious people! Not to mention the place is well kept on amazing street full of great eateries and night life; all walking distance. I definitely did not want to leave and extended my stay a few days longer because it was hard to say goodbye to this gem in BedStuy. 10 out of 10 and would definitely book again!

I stayed one month at Pietro's place. Pietro is a very nice person and very helpful. I landed late in NYC and he has been waiting for me to arrive to give me the keys and information about the place.  The place is very well situated, close to everything and in a very safe and quiet area. I never felt unsafe even walking alone late by night. There is a big supermarket just across the street and lots of restauration places (Dunkin Donuts, Patricia's, Emilio's and Delis...). The laundraumat and the bank are close by as well. Morris Park Station is located 10min away by foot: the 2 train will take you to Manhattan.  The place is kinda small but cozy and has everything necessary for a good stay. The mattress is very comfy and there are lots of pillows !  I really enjoyed my stay and I will definetely book again if I ever need a place in the Bronx in the future. I highly recommend Pietro and his place.   Thank you Pietro ! You are an amazing host !

Chito and Xavier place is a great place for short or long stays; close to subway, train and bus. I liked the place, neat and organized with a good use of the small place and comfortable. At night, the neighborhood is quiet and some streets around are solitary; we found some crazy homeless 😝 but all good. I recommend this place if you want to have access to hot spots in New York without staying o the expensive area. Thanks Chito and Xavier for all the help!

Nice house, with plenty of space and storage. Indispensable household appliances present and functional. Lack of some products, such as shampoo and shower gel. The most unpleasant thing was the noise from some neighbors on the upper floors during the night and early morning, which didn't help the tranquility at all.
The room has no window.  WIFI is sketchy.  The main room, which one has to pass through in order to get to the bathroom, is also rented out.  Location is excellent and check-in/out was very easy.

The communication with Eun was great, however, I had a really bad experience in her place. I haven’t met her in person since she was away at the time of my visit. Her cousin was in the apt., so some of what I am saying might not represent the regular conditions. This is not a private room. This is much more like a shared room and should be published accordingly. There are no walls, there are some furniture functioning as walls. But some of them are movable and there are many cracks between them, so someone outside can see to the inside of the “room”. There is indeed a “lock”, but it is only for the outside of the room, and you can’t lock it from the inside when you sleep. Anyway, the furniture is movable so it is function-less anyhow. The room is located just across the main door for the apt. which means you hear everyone going up and down the stairs of the building. It woke me up a few times. In addition, the “room” is between the other bedroom and the bathroom. So, whenever someone is going between them when it is dark, the light from the bedroom was like a flashlight to my face when I was asleep (since the "wall furniture" doesn’t go all the way up). Her cousin was really trying to be quiet, but when she decided to take a shower at 4-5 a.m. twice, and once around 6 a.m., there was no way to stay asleep. In the first night of my stay I woke up 3 times and almost cried out of frustration. I don’t think I had a full night sleep while I was staying there. In addition, the cleaning issue was discussed several times on the description of the rules. That were things I was prepared too, not ideal, but ok if you say them in advance. A few days prior to my arrival I got a text message with detail about the apt. as well as some addition rules, such as that I must take my trash down every day. I can understand not wanted bugs in your place, but this is something that should have been said before. Furthermore, when I arrived at the apt. a page with even more rules awaited me. One of them is to pick my hair from the shower after every shower. Now, this is my limit when I am on vacation. So, when there are all these rules + you pay a cleaning fee, you would at least think the place will be clean, right? It wasn’t. The bathroom garbage can was full and has some trash around it. The kitchen counter was sticky. The room floor wasn’t even swept properly. The apt. was a mess. I was uncomfortable moving around, since there were pictures on the floor everywhere, just sitting there and not connected to anything, so I was scared to break something. One more point that is not...

Lovely host really available. Quick and stress free check in. Good space with all the amenities for everyday life. Street 130th is lovely. Loads of grocery shops from the subway station. Overall a very pleasant stay.

It was a very unpleasant experience. First of all, the room is very small. First, the room is very small, a small space separated from the kitchen by a partition. So small, you can't even fit a big suitcase. Second, the House is at least 20 minutes away from the Metropolitan Museum of Art, not a few minutes. The third is，the room does not provide a small refrigerator, there is no shampoo，not even napkins. Fourth，you can't cook in the kitchen, and there aren't any cooking pots available. And the only kettle they serve is very dirty. Fifth，the homeowner says not to bother her niece, but be careful if she does, because sometimes she comes home very  late and the bathroom is close to you. The sound of her showering and brushing her teeth can be big and will wake you up. And worst of all, When you have a problem with the owner of the consultation, she is not a good solution to the problem, but would like you to leave to find other place to live.I hope everyone has a good trip and won’t meet such a homeowner.

The apartment is very clean, well equipped and well located, Chito was present upon our arrival despite the delay of our flight and advised us on shops and life near the apartment, I highly recommend this place to stay in New York

Chito and Xavier's place was perfect for my solo stay in NYC. The apartment is within reasonable walking distance (10-15 minutes) to both the red and green subway lines. Although the East Harlem area can be a bit sketchy at times, the apartment requires multiple entries (both code and key) and the entrance is tucked away, so I felt very safe. Being alone as a young woman, I used rideshare if I was returning after 9pm.  The apartment was spacious, clean, and well-kept. Plenty of the basic essentials (towels, dishes, etc.), as well as a few extras (the umbrella was a lifesaver!). There is a self-controlled heater/air conditioner in the unit, which was perfect for the cold nights. The private patio was a nice touch as well. I met both Chito and Xavier during my stay and they were both incredibly friendly and helpful with any questions or concerns I had. I contacted them about some TV issues I was experiencing, and as they live right upstairs from the unit, they were able to assist that day. It really meant a lot to have such hospitable hosts. If I am ever back in NYC, I would not hesitate to stay at Chito and Xavier's place again!

Eun's place is a perfect place of rest after a long noisy day in the city. The space is small, but that's to be expected in NYC. The bathroom was nice and the shower was big. I'm a solo female traveler and I did not feel unsafe in the building or surrounding neighborhood. I think this is worth it's value and I would stay here again.

The place was perfect!!so good that we had a home after such full days. Spacious perfectly clean. Safe at a perfect neighborhood. The 72 underground stop. Walking distance to central park. Great price great food options supermarkets drug store and you get the vibe of people living there. For us greeks there is a fabolous greek orthodox church next street with an angelic choir. Choose it!!!

The stay here was good, the place had good infrastructure and nice spaces. The only problem is that there are some tenants stuck here who made my stay very unpleasant to the point of attacking me verbally and almost physically. So be careful, they want to take over the place and the owner of the apartment agrees with their attitude. Everything else was perfect.

This was a gorgeous place to stay - amazing artful decor, convenient location (about 15mins walk from Central Park, and 5min walk from a subway which gives express access into the city), and fun neighbourhood. Lots happening on Frederic Douglas Blvd, just around the corner. Also very safe!  Rene was very accommodating of our little family of three, which we were very grateful for - travelling with a teething baby can be very stressful! But he did everything he could to help.  Highly recommend!

The studio was comfortable and cozy and exactly we wanted in our first time in New York. We loved getting to walk around Harlem and also being so accessible to the rest of the city with the subway. Our trip was very much a success and Chito made it very easy to set everything up and made our stay very pleasant and stress-free.

Chito & Xavier’s Airbnb was very clean, comfortable, and easy to check in to. We barely communicated but when we did they responded right away and answered all of our questions. I will say, be weary of the area. There is a lot of crime in this area, somebody was stabbed outside the airbnb during our stay. Even though, I did feel safe inside the airbnb due to the 3 doors you have to go through to get into your room.

We had a very nice stay at Giselle's house.  The neighborhood, although many including me believe it to be dangerous, is not at all, we were able to walk through the neighborhood calmly even late at night.  Giselle is a very respectful and kind woman at all times, she attended to us with the greatest willingness. I recommend the place so that you feel warm within the immense city.

Jennifer's place is a centrally located apartment with beautiful natural light in the main living area. The loft is up some stairs that could be a bit steep for anyone with mobility issues, but I had no problem going up and down multiple times a day. I'm a pretty heavy sleeper, so this didn't bother me, but you can definitely hear what's going on in the living room if there are people there. If you're working, probably best to bring some headphones and you'll be set :) They also have a small dog who was friendly and very cute.  The private bathroom and w/d are a great touch, allowing me to fully work and live in my room which was pretty spacious, and I was welcome to use the kitchen to cook some small meals for myself and lounge in the living room. The only bummer (which is totally out of Jennifer's control) is that a building was built right next to the window in the room, so there's no natural light in the bedroom unfortunately. The rooftop was easy to access and seemed perfect for a breezy golden hour, but there's not much shade so if you plan to go up during the day like I did, make sure you bring some sunscreen.   Quick walk to the L train, lots of food stops nearby, and a small market close by in case you wanna do some grocery shopping.

Amazing hosts, great vibe, lots of space. I came here for an audition, which is always a pretty stressful event, and Dana and Justin were super helpful and made what could be a nightmare trip into a relaxed one. Definitely would recommend to any of my friends visiting Manhattan.

Dana she is so fast to answer my message, and also her home is so clean and safety.  That’s why there is make me comfy.  I travelled just alone, that’s why I little bit scared at night but police station is located near home. That was make me feeling more safety Don’t be hesitate to make a reservation!
There was an unpleasant smell from the kitchen downstairs.  Maybe from the cooking.  Other than that everything was just fine.  we had a lot of fun

The best aspect of Tiffany's unit is of course the location.  If you want to have easy access to both Manhattan and Queens, they are right there by ferry, tram,  subway, and if for some reason you drove, a bridge! It's quiet yet offers any convenience (food, library, drug store) that you can get in the city, plus an opportunity for more NYC history.  Crystal was quick to respond with any help or questions, the unit has a full working kitchen and the room we had had a large window with a spectacular view across the river.  I'd stay again!

Such a lovely room, spacious and wonderfully decorated exactly as the photos. Shower pressure was amazing and bed was super comfortable. Dana was a joy to talk to.  Only flaw is the location, which is far up north. It takes about 30-40m to get to downtown, which can be inconvenient for someone with a tight NY itinerary. If this is not an issue for you, this place is a steal and I would highly recommend.

Matt’s place was really clean and cozy we really enjoyed our short time there, the place is really private with all the amenities you will need. Everything was clean and as shown in the pictures, but the best part about this place is the host, Matt was wonderful with us; me and my friend had a really stressful and long day so we couldn’t check in in time but Matt waited for us until late to let us in! I’m so thankful for everything.

I'm almost afraid to write a very glowing report in regards  to my stay at Michi's place because I am sure it will become very popular and it may be difficult for me to get in to the apartment for future stays when I am visiting NYC.  But I will take that risk because  this little studio apartment is really a jewel and a great find in the city. I was brought up in Brooklyn Heights and this apartment was located one block away from my childhood home.  Yes I really felt like I never left the neighborhood. I enjoyed early morning walks down the famous Heights Promenade to Montague Street to have breakfast at one of the many restaurants there.  It's a short five minute walk to the Clark Street subway station from the apt where you can connect easily to the New York City subway lines.  The apartment has great Wi-Fi and also a nice TV with Netflix and Hulu available. The bed was very comfortable. I love a hot shower with good water pressure and the apartment did not disappoint  in that regard as well. The lobby area is kept very clean and it's quiet most of the time.  I highly recommend Michi's place.   Michi  was a great host. I had a couple of requests when I first moved into the apartment and  Michi's  response was and I quote  " I'm on it".  That's the kind of customer support attitude she provides.  She was also very flexible to let me check out  a little bit later in the day because I had a late night departure. That was very much appreciated. Thanks Michi for a great stay at your place.

This was the first time I ever got a airbandb which I was a little worried that I could get a scam specially because is NY , but I’m definitely glad I chose this place it was easy and quick process , when I got there I was able to check in before the time and Yngrind greeted us when We got there . had a handful of information, she very helpful and sweet, was worried to leave the car parked because of the rules and tickets . but that street is safe to keep it at / specially because she has cameras outside . I love NY and the vibe is always good to me. I recommend to leave the car parked and take the train (train available very close by) there is a lot of traffic. Overall, place was very cute , clean and comfortable . Host is amazing and available all the time for any questions you may have

Great place to stay, the host is amazing. Communication was always open, and responses were quick. Very clean and modern. The only thing is, if you’re planning on walking in the area, it’s a bit sketchy. So bring a car Lol 😂. Overall 💯

THIS IS EAST NEW YORK! If your not familiar with the area, such as myself before coming you will soon find out that this is one of the most dangerous areas in New York. It is situated in a place that is surrounded by poverty and violence. I did not feel safe what do ever. I have never had this experience at all. I didn’t even want to park my car on the street because there were cars up on blocks, people living in cars with no windows and tires, and also back windows busted out with garbage bags taped across them. I felt like I was in a nightmare. I am a traveling nurse who was looking for bigger accommodations at an affordable price for my monthly stay, other then a hotel. Let me give you some advice. IF IT SAYS NO REFUNDS ON THE BOOKING DONT DO IT! There is a reason! The place seemed to be nice from the pictures but when you get in the neighborhood you are questioning whether or not it is even worth it. I was told by locals at my hospital that that is one of the worst places in Brooklyn. The police have to patrol that area on foot for 6 months before they can be on their own. Half the time if you call the police, they take forever to show up. They even said they have a police station in the train station near by.  I was embarrassed when my coworkers asked me why I would even think to go over there. I told them I had no idea. They laughed at me, and stated I am lucky I came out untouched. I attempted to reach out to the owners to let them know that there was no possible way I could even stay there, my son was coming to visit for the weekend and he was so scared. While she offered another place about 5 blocks over, it was still bad, not as bad. She told me it was the culture. I said I get it it’s New York, but all of the people I work with laughed at me when I said culture and they said no that is the hood, the ghetto. The owner refused to let me cancel as I told her I was not staying there at all. She worked with me and only made me pay for 2/24 booked nights and cleaning fee. So I was given 2500 back out of 3000. I’m glad I didn’t lose out entirely. Next time I will make sure I book a couple days or day first before booking a whole month. That money lost could have paid a weeks worth at my hotel. While the place was very nice inside, ab&b should require photos of surroundings before because I feel like this was very misleading. Stay out of east Ny.
Accommodation sufficient for 3 people. Everything you need is there to take care of yourself. The neighbors in the area are all very friendly, we didn't feel unsafe. The way to the subway is not far.

The property is great! The area felt unsafe to be in. If walking or taking subway at night please go with someone else don’t walk around at night alone. It’s only a 4-5 minute walk to the subway, very convenient. If your going into NYC plan your day accordingly because your about an hour away so going back and forth is time consuming. Yngrid was great she checked on me and messaged quick. We had everything we needed for our 4 day stay. Just be mindful of the neighbourhood.
I really liked the location! It’s always busy at night, so I never felt unsafe even when coming back at 2am.   I also liked that you were very helpful and responded very quickly to messages

Ok place for a quick stay in Brooklyn. Furniture and miscellaneous fixtures need upgrading. 4 chairs in dinning room was very scared to sit in them. Used where they sink down like could fall through. Heating system make sure they explain it. Woke up after first night stay freeze because system I believe was on a timer!
Great place to stay with great host, NYC steal for those who want to be out and about in the city. Located in a great area, the apartment is cozy and Joe is awesome. Thank you for hosting!

Thank you so much for everything, especially going the extra steps to make our trip a lot less stressful! The apartment was perfect for what we needed, very clean and lots of places close by to eat or pick up a few items.

This place is a hidden gem!  We loved our time in the Bay Ridge neighborhood of Brooklyn.  The walk to the subway or nearest bus stop was so easy.  Our family of five walked as late as midnight (after a Mets game!) and we never felt unsafe.  The place is immaculate! The little kitchen was perfect for us and we were able to have breakfast there together every morning.... except for one morning when we decided to try the bagel place right on 3rd ave... and the bagels were SO GOOD!  From the apartment, we were able to take a bus or a subway to see all the sights... we went to the Statue of Liberty, Empire State Building, Times Square, the Intrepid, 9/11 memorial, Central Park, Museum of Natural History, Washington Square Park, Rockefeller Center, and we saw the Mets play.  It was a trip of a lifetime all made possible by the affordable, convenient lodging that Marco offers.  The ONLY small drawback is that we did have to ride the subway each day.... could be a 45 minute ride depending on where you're going.  And it was like an hour and a half from Citi Field.    STILL TOTALLY WORTH IT!  The Air Conditioning worked perfectly and was absolutely necessary during the heat wave that was taking place while we were there.  Beds were comfortable enough.  Having the laundry right there was such a nice bonus.  Love coming home with CLEAN clothes!  Marco is a friendly, welcoming host.  He is very quick to respond and flexible with check-in times.  We will definitely stay here again in the future.    Enjoy your stay in Brooklyn!
Thanks to Joe and his co-host, Rob, for another successful trip to New York.  The spot served its purpose.

Joe was extremely helpful and welcoming. Some times being a woman traveling alone can be scary but I felt extremely safe and comfortable at his place. The apartment is exactly as I had expected. Great location and neighborhood. I didn’t spend much time there at the apartment because I was busy running around New York.

I wish I could give Joseph's place 6 stars!! It honestly exceeded expectations. Check in was very smooth and he was super communicative via text, which I really appreciate... the place is SUPER clean, the bed comfortable and there was a super yummy espresso stash waiting for us. plus, it's on the same block as Five Leaves, which is pretty ideal as far as brunch, lunch AND dinner goes. lastly, Joseph was really flexible and allowed us to leave our stuff in the place till 2:30 - making our departure totally stress free. I will definitely be back!
Bathroom was scary 😟
Quick, timely, clear and helpful responses! Wonderful accommodation and flexibility. Aspano made our time in NYC stress free. We would definitely book again.

Aspano was wonderful about answering my questions before our trip and was friendly and greeted us upon arrival. He even left us some snacks which were appreciated. He seems like a genuinely warm and wonderful person.  His apartment was as advertised and was in a good neighborhood. The only thing I thought would be there that wasn't was a TV and washcloths. We also could have used a couple extra pillows and blankets. We stayed on a Saturday night and while the neighbors were not rowdy, the walls are thin so there was some noise which I'm sure New Yorkers are used to. The air conditioner worked great and the hum helped block some of the noise. The main problem we encountered which wasn't Aspano's fault is that someone from outside buzzed the apartment (which rings a bell extremely loudly inside the apartment) at 3:45 a.m which scared me to death. It buzzed again twice more until 4:15 a.m. It definitely scared me since I was traveling alone with my daughter and prevented me from going back to sleep. Aspano was very apologetic and said it was a mistake so perhaps it was just an unfortunate fluke but it's definitely unsettling that someone from outside pressed a button to be buzzed up to our apartment 3 times in the middle of the night.

The building is well-located on Manhattan's Upper East Side, convenient to many of the city's best and most popular restaurants, museums and and other cultural venues.  The apartment is reachable by stairs or a compact elevator (which will not accommodate a wheel chair.)  There are large windows which will allow abundant natural light, and a really great set of curtains and drapes which will scale the light back as you desire.  The bed was very comfortable.  Perhaps the best feature of this rental, though, is Aspano.  He is an incredibly thoughtful and accommodating host.  To steal a phrase: "You're in good hands with" Aspano!
Much peace, tranquility and respect. It is an oasis in a very stressed and stressful city.

Adi and Evangel provide a restful haven in the bustle that is NYC!  Soft instrumental music playing most of the time and fresh flowers in the living area added to the very peaceful feeling in the main area. I stayed for six nights and my room was very comfortable and quiet. I really enjoyed having the kitchen available and especially the hot water dispenser for making tea every morning and evening. I found the water handles in the showers to be a little tricky to adjust to hot water, but it was fine once I got the hang of it. There are two full bathrooms, and sharing between three guest rooms was no problem at all. The location is super convenient to the subway (about a 5 min. walk) and there are coffee shops, groceries, and many great places to eat within a block or two. A kitchen is available if you'd like to cook in.   A portion of the price of your stay goes to help feed the homeless in NYC. Win-Win!

We really enjoy our stay at Sam’s place. It was really cozy and clean. It’s little bit far from Manhattan, but it’s guiet and calm neighbourhood and we loved that. We have just one problem with locking front door, which makes us feel little bit unsafe.

I am not one to pick the "shared" or "room" feature of airbnb. I usually do "entire apt" but thank Goodness I picked this place. It was magical! The energy from the instant you walk through the door is pure peace and zen. I felt like I was transported into a santuary of some sort. Then I got to my room and saw the adjoining garden that was just for me! Heaven! You had me at hello! I will definitely recommend this place and Adi and Evangel were the best. You feel as if you have the place all to yourself and if you needed anything they were there for you. Highly recommend! And i commend the GOOD WORK and PAY IT FORWARD that they are doing with the homeless.
I had a very pleasant and calming stay :)   The place was great and the mission they are on for supporting the homeless community in New York is wonderful. Adi was very available and a pleasant host.
Clean and cozy. Very comfy beds. The neighbourhood is a bit sketchy - tourists shouldn't go out at night.

Susy and Song (her husbend) were very nice and helpful! the room was good and the bed was comfy and big. the house is about 20 min from Manhetan by subway (the station is about 5 mins walk). the house was big but not that claen, and the neighborhood is a bit scary, especially at night.

You can find J and L line quite closely but it takes more than 55mins to Manhattan area and the area is a bit dangerous and I found it noisy in the night time plus her dog is barking like crazy... the washroom looks clean but stinks.

Excellent value with some minor cons.  Like others said it’s about 10 minutes walk from a subway station, which was a single train for about an hour to Penn Station. I did that 10 minute walk a couple of times during the early morning/late night, and never felt unsafe. Street parking, but I arrived on a Thursday early afternoon and was easily able to get a spot (literally right in front of the building!) and when I left on Sunday afternoon there were a decent amount of open spaces. Host was flexible and let me check in a few hours earlier than the listed time.  Room was bigger than I expected from the pictures. The large desk and full-length mirror next to it were a big help in getting ready in the morning and doing my makeup. There’s a closet w/hangers and a hook on the wall for a coat. It’s the upstairs apartment of the building, host lives downstairs. There’s 4 bedrooms with a shared common area/kitchen and bathroom.  The cons: - The bed was comfortable, but something they used when washing the bedding had a very strong scent. I have a sensitive nose and it was a bit of an issue for me, I ended up covering the pillow with an extra shirt and putting the supplied extra blanket (which didn’t smell) under the duvet (European style bedding, so no top sheet.) If you think the scent may be an issue I’d suggest asking if they could wash the bedding without that product, or bringing your own fitted sheet/pillowcase/top sheet. - I wouldn’t go as far as saying the bathroom was dirty, but I wouldn’t say it was clean either. However that was the only area where I noticed some uncleanliness, and since the rooms were all booked there were at least 4 people sharing it, so for me it was understandable and I wouldn’t consider it a deal breaker. - A bath towel is provided, but it would’ve been nice to have an individual hand towel as well. - My key didn’t work the first time I went to unlock my room door. Called the host and she sent her daughter up with a different set that did work. I noticed at least one other reviewer that had this problem, so I’d suggest when you first arrive trying the key 2-3 times to make sure it consistently works. I don’t think the lock was the issue as I never had any problems with the second set of keys.  Even with those few cons I’d definitely stay again. If you’ve got questions/concerns the host is very responsive. 🙂

This is a great spot if you need a quiet, meditative space for yourself. The apartment has a nice energy, sometimes it feels like a temple. All the money you pay go to the food for the homeless which Adi and his friends cook and distribute three times a week.   If you are in a louder or party-like mood, probably it's not a good option, since they ask you not to hang out much in the living room - there are two other people living in the apartment and the audibility is pretty good, especially from the living room area.

Bobbi was a great host, made sure I had what I needed and always checked in. Location is decent and roommates are respectful and clean. A few packages got stolen and it is loud but also that's just the city!  Would definitely stay again.   Room is decently sized and everything is clean.

I stayed in Bobbi's place for 10 nights in December.   Location-wise, there is a nearby bus stop that goes to Brooklyn Downtown, and the nearest subway is a 10-minute walk (from there about 30-40 minutes to get to Manhattan). The area is safe even though it may look a bit shady, I was never bothered coming back (up to 11pm ish) walking from the subway station.  Wi-fi works great and hot water also works all the time (except for the 2 days when there was a cold wave and the pipe froze).  However the portable heater inside the room is warm enough.   I didn't get to meet Bobbi, but she was always helpful and responsive.   Some (minor) downsides: - room was a bit dirty, I could notice some debris on the carpet - the bed was like a sofa bed, there was some hard metal in the middle which might be uncomfortable for some - window in the room could not be opened - kitchen area was a bit messy and dirty -> I didn't cook so I was fine  Overall it's a great value for money.

We had a nice stay at Joe's home. He was very accommodating when we arrived our first night at 11:30pm - our room was ready for us, and he saved us a space to park in his driveway. As well, his home is near many markets, restaurants, and drug stores and very walkable to the Billie Jean King Tennis Center, the reason for our visit.

Enjoyed my stay at Ed's very much. Great host and very easy to communicate with. The apartment is an excellent size for 1-2 people, with plenty of space to sleep, lounge, cook, work. I never ever felt  claustrophobic and enjoyed being at the place most of the day. In fact, if I didn't have to step out I would have no issues being at the house!   The location is excellent and can't beat it. The area is under development and can be a little sketchy admittedly but it's still an excellent location. The beach is 5 minutes or less walking, pretty much around the corner. You got the Coney Island station which has 4 trains that will get you into Manhatten, Bronx and Queens very conveniently.   Plenty of places to buy food and other necessaties.   The value you get is spot on and I would recommend highly!

Location was great!!! 10 minutes walking  from beach, 5 minutes walking to the metro station that takes you anywhere if you’re using public transportation. Lots of local restaurants and grocery stores. Even though the first impression of the neighborhood is a bit scary if you’ve never been to Brooklyn, the people were very nice and warm. This was my first time traveling to NY and using public transportation but everyone was very helpful and we found our way through all NYC and Brooklyn with no problem. Thank you Ed for your hospitality and recommendations.
the condition of the apartment is unsatisfactory.  there is an unpleasant odor.  it is fashionable to bathe in the bathroom, but you don’t want to

After reading former reviews I was looking forward to staying here, however my experience was the complete opposite.  It started with them giving me the address to pick up the key and than changing it at the last minute.  We finally got the key from a pharmacy down the street,  but we thought the original address was still the same. The neighborhood was rough, it was after dark and we kept trying unsuccessfully to open the door.  I went back to the pharmacy and they gave me the Landlords phone number.  After talking to him, we got the correct information.  A simple phone call from him in the first place could've avoided all this.  We arrived after dark and couldn't keep stopping to read messages.   We finally get to our room when we hear a loud banging at our door.  We were terrified,  especially after walking in from that rough neighborhood,  we looked at each other and froze.  I was traveling with my daughter and my grandson.  a situation like this can be very scary for women traveling alone.  A few minutes later, the banging started again along w some yelling.  We finally heard the words airbnb and took a chance on opening the door. The woman proceeded yell at us and tell us who she was.  We asked a question or two and she answered (yelled) very rudely.  This set the mood for the rest of the week. We never met the Landlord, although he called next morning to see how things were going.  Of course, after the night before we just answered ok out of fear.  We were also very disturbed to find used bathroom products such as a dirty hairbrush, used toothpaste and mouthwash among other products in the bathroom cabinet.  The rest of the place was ok, although I would suggest they replace the very worn out leather couch w unmattching fabric cushions!!

Gondas place was really great, perfect location. Looks a little dangerous, but it's not. I loved the stay, only thing I would say is if you're a light sleeper it might be difficult to sleep due to the street noise (even though the apartments high up). Otherwise it's perfect and gonda was nice and responsive even out of the country.

Everything about Gonda's space was accurate. The space itself was great, super clean and exactly what we needed. It's close to an express stop which was a great surprise. We were unaware of the express train options prior to so it was wonderful to be able to speed into the city centre!  We'd also read the reviews before so were prepared for some more sketchy characters in the area. But just like was noted, everyone kept to themselves and we never felt uneasy.   Overall we were very comfortable and happy with our choice. Would definitely recommend a stay at this lovely spot!

Gonda is a fantastic host. She was very responsive and accommodating. The other reviews are right about the area. It's East Harlem, so it's rough around the edges, but I never felt unsafe. The place itself is just beautiful and a great value. The photos are accurate, the design is impeccable, and she keeps the place very clean. I would stay here again in a heartbeat!

The apartment is nice, clean and has everything included, what you need. It is not very big, but with it´s two bedrooms, there is enough space for 2 couples. The location is great. It´s not far away from Manhattan and the Metro is only a 5min walk away. So you can be in around 20min in the heart of NYC. The neighborhood is also fine. It´s a bit rough on the edges but we never felt unsafe. Gonda is a great host.

This is a tiny, no frills room with a nice firm twin bed, older but strong AC window unit, and great little mini fridge for storing cold drinks in the hot summer. It was a quick walk to the 46th street train stop and had a little market at the stop for supplies. The bathroom is down the hall and shared with three other rooms. It is older but the other tenants/renters seemed to keep it pretty clean, and I only had to wait for it once or twice. It’s a “no flushing toilet paper down the toilet” bathroom, so if that scares you be warned, but it’s really totally fine. I was visiting a friend for her wedding and would stay again.

My sister and I stayed at Chris's place on December 2017. The host family is friendly and kind, ie they made sure we had clean sheets and offered to give us a ride to the metro. The check-in process was also stress-free and quick to respond. You are also given an extra spare key so you can access the room without disturbing the family if you're going home late.   The room is very comfortable-- there's an extra portable heater, there's plenty of blankets, and the room felt very clean. The walls are filled with beautiful pieces of artwork (made by the wife) that are cool to took at.  The room is within a 10-15 minute walk from the nearest metro. The neighborhood is vibrant. I wish I could spend more time in the neighborhood because there were a couple of Tibetan and Afghanistan restaurants that I wanted to try.  New York is a beautiful city and staying at Chris's place will allow you to experience a piece of it. I definitely recommend staying here.

It was little disappointing that we couldn’t use the stove - only can boil water.  You have to turn on the gas and use the match to have fire and the fire is very low too... Felt very unsafe to use the stove top. The host advised not to use the oven as well. This should’ve mentioned in airbnb - had to find out upon arrival felt a little dishonest. As this is during covid time was hoping to cook but wasn’t able to….  Also was excited to use the back yard as seen in photo but couldn’t use it as it was very messy and didn’t look like it was for the guest.  Lastly, during our stay, it was a bit cold…. it would’ve been better to have the heater handy around the apt where it is visible. I couldn’t find it where the host advised to look for and had to sleep in the cold for one night.  the location was great. Love the neighborhood. The host was very responsive and didn’t hesitate to help out when in need of help.

The hosts are amazing. They give you huge recommendations with good details about the places in NYC. The apartment is located in a very convenience area. Maybe 15-20 minutes to Central Park and good restaurant are around the place. We felt pretty comfortable with coming back to the place even close to midnight. We had an uber from the airport and it took about 45minutes to get to the place. For picking up the key, you need to pick it up from a different building which is about 15min walking distance. The room was on 4th floor and the building does not have an elevator. When we got there, cleaning lady was still cleaning. I called the hosts and we found out that there was a miscommunication about our arrival time. They said we can still stay and make ourselves comfortable, but we did not feel comfortable staying there while she was cleaning, so we went out. When we came back later, there was a guy at the building door. He asked us if we were a new neighbor. The hosts have asked us before to tell we were visiting friends if someone asks us who we are. But the guy did not buy it AT ALL. He said "I know. You guys are using Airbnb. you know, we are trying to kick you guys out" and he shouted at the lady who was behind us "hey, they are Airbnb! I was just telling them we don't want them here." We said nothing but went up to the room. When we were about to open the door, we noticed that the guy from the 1st floor has followed us and he was talking to someone on the phone and telling the person about us. It was pretty scary for me and my husband was not happy at all. We called the hosts and told them the whole story. Seems like there was a history of the guy. The host offered us a full refund if we don't feel comfortable and safe staying here, but we chose to stay. The guy was harmless and he did not bother us at all after it. In night time, the area gets pretty quiet even though the building is in the busy area, we slept well all nights. Over all, we enjoyed staying at the place.

The entire trip was relaxing and stress free. Dan’s advice and suggestions were always spot on and definitely added to a memorable experience. Check-in was very simple and the location of the apartment was very convenient. Dan maintained communication and offered up tips and opportunities to see different attractions. It was like having a personal concierge. He responded to queries and concerns in a timely manner. I always felt that our needs were taken into consideration. The apartment was in immaculate conditional and upon arrival it was set up in a very welcoming manner. If you want to experience another side of what the city has to offer, I recommend Dan’s place for sure.
You can book without fear, top location and top 10 apartment.

My boyfriend and I stayed here for the last days of our stay in New York. The place does seem clean, but rats would come into the room. We noticed it at first in the middle of the night. When we adressed this to the hosts (Julio and his wife), who speak very poorly english, they did not believe us. Then they said that they would handle the issue "when we have left". Well, that wouldn't really matter to us then.  They then asked their daughter to call me at 11pm in the evening (!), and she said that we could get some of the money back, if we would leave the house that night. We didn't want to sleep in a room with rats, so we left.   When she gave us the money back, she told us not to post a negative review or contact Airbnb.   Very unpleasant stay. Don't book here. You work hard for your money, so find a nicer place to sleep.

Nika's apartment was very cozy. We arrived with a sweet welcome letter that included all her recommendations in Brooklyn. Her place was so interesting, lots of cultural art pieces and beautiful paintings, though the mask in the bedroom was a little scary. Contained everything that we needed like kitchen utensils, bath soap and towels, etc. Location was very close to subway station and convenience stores. It was a little loud- mainly street noise and music as it was right on the main road, but I think that added character to the experience. Colombian Parisian cafe downstairs had amazing strawberry cheesecake!

Matthew was traveling at the time, so I was having hard time reaching him.  It was quite stressful the first day because I had my luggage and I was waiting for instructions to check in and to get the key for the apartment.  I ended up having to stay at my friend's place because it was too late to book a new place.  I still like Matthew's apartment a lot, as I think it is clean, spacious for a studio, plus it is in a calm yet centrally located area of Manhattan - Gramercy park.  So I decided to keep the booking, and Matthew charged me one night less, which was great.   Other than the issue I had with checking in, I was very satisfied with the apartment, and had a great time spending two nights there. Doorman, neighbors are all friendly, quiet and helpful.  I can book this room again in the future.

A nice spot in Astoria that's right off of 30th St. The street is fairly quiet especially at night but there is some noise in the morning/afternoon when the school nearby gets recess. If you are a light sleeper this isn't the place for you. Sebastian and Andrea were great hosts who were responsive and even gave tips of the neighborhood. Astoria is a great neighborhood if you want to get away from the chaos that is Manhattan. It's not as convenient as staying somewhere on the island but was a good home base for us.  We never felt unsafe during our stay walking around. There are lots of cafes, restaurants, and bars all within walking distance. There are also a lot of grocery and drug stores nearby. The subway stations are each about a 15 minute walk and get you into the city in about 30-45 minutes.   The room itself was spacious and well furnished. The pull out couch isn't a mattress bed, mostly two pads, so it worked well for us but if you have pickier sleepers that might be hard. There is an A/C unit in the room that is directly above the pull out sofa so it blows down on that person, so again keep that in mind but the AC was nice since it did get stuffy.  There was adequate room for 3 people so it was a great size for us. Having a separate entrance and being right off the bathroom was perfect, it felt like a studio off the apartment. As with old buildings, ventilation isn't the best so smells get trapped in the kitchen from cooking and in the room.

Autumn was very helpful and quick to respond for the entire lead up to my visit and during my visit as well-- (even though she was on Shanghai time).  The studio was just as nicely put together as it looks in the pictures and felt like a steal for what I paid.  I will definitely think of Autumn and this studio the next time I need to visit NYC.
Mia's home is beautiful, really great design, convenient for a Brooklyn stay, and such a steal! We would definitely stay here again.

I contacted Autumn for a  short three nights vacation in New York along with my two sisters. Communication with her was very smooth, as she always replies with puntuality and education.  The small studio is clean, cozy and comfortable, furnished with style and elegance: appliances are in great working condition, the bed is comfortable and also the sofa-bed is suitable for a good night of sleep (even if for my tastes it was a little bit too close to the AC unit). The bathroom was clean and functional as well.  The room is on 6th floor, which can be daunting for people not too fit, but if you are not scared of climbing stairs it's not a problem.  The neighbourhood is colorful without being sprawling. Two subway stations are conveniently located at less than 2 minutes walking distance, so one can reach any part of NY with ease. Pubs and bars are in the area, so if one doesn't feel like going to go too far, there's still plenty to do. Maybe the scents at night are not the best, but that's a minor nuisance.  Autumn is very considerate of her guests: although we couldn't meet during my short stay, she gave me every information I needed, even an emergency phone number, provided us with a list of convenient locations we could access, like the nearby 24h deli store, a laundry, a luggage deposit and more.  I am very satisfied with our stay in her apartment, and would definitely consider her again, had I to stay in New York for a couple of days.
