We drove and didn't have trouble finding parking on the street, although I suspect that might've just been our luck.  In all, I would highly recommend Manny's place to anyone looking to stay in Brooklyn but still have access to Queens (Jackie Robinson parkway is maybe 5-10 minutes away). His apartment is very chic, even more so than the pictures can capture, and maybe next time we'll get to check out some of the dinning places he recommends in the area :-)

Peter and his family were great hosts!  Upon arrival we had a sweet welcome message with treats and even some milk, juice and goodies to get us started.    The apartment was exactly as described and even exceeded our expectations.  Even though a basement apartment, it did not feel that way at all.  The space was beautiful, spacious, comfortable and immaculate.  They supplied everything you could need for your stay-fully stocked kitchen, linens, every bath essential-more than any hotel.  The beds were very comfortable.  The shower had great water pressure and the A/C units cooled the place in minutes when we arrived back from our long day of exploring the city.    The street is quiet and you are a short 10 min walk from the subway.  We used the Ralph Av /Fulton St station for the C train the most and it was very convenient to get to anywhere in Manhattan.  You can also catch the A-C train from the Utica Av/Fulton St station not far down from Ralph Av.  Halsey St or Gates Av stations will get you on the J or Z trains to and from JFK.  We arrived back after dark every night and never felt unsafe walking back to the apartment.    Because we stayed during a busy holiday weekend, we were both out and about most of the time.  We didn't get the chance to connect with Peter and his family personally but easily communicated by texting when needed.  We received detailed instructions of everything so we had no issues getting into the apartment or finding anything we needed during our stay.  We knew if we needed anything, Peter was just a phone call away.    We were on the go every day that we didn't hang out much in the surrounding area but did get a chance to stop in the Healthway (organic grocery and deli with yummy sandwiches) and The Wilky (bar with beer selections and good food) on our arrival and departure days.  There are some 24hr convenient stores down the street for late night beverages and snacks as well that we stopped in on our way back.  This was our first visit to NYC, stayed 5 nights and literally powered through 14 hour days of adventure.  It was nice to come back to a quiet and comfortable place to rest.    We definitely recommend Peter's place to future travelers and hope you enjoy it as much as we did.

This was a perfect Air BnB experience from beginning to end, and made the entire trip stress free. Peter was brilliant about responding to emails and very fast with communication throughout our stay. Check in couldn't have been easier. The flat is lovely, and we couldn't fault it (even the air mattress is like a proper bed)! The shower was brilliant pressure and warmth. Everything was clean, and well maintained, and we often joked about how we wished we owned the place! Peter made lots of little extra efforts to make us feel welcome (snacks in a basket throughout our stay etc) - the perfect air bnb and host. Don't be put off by the shared basement corridor mentioned - it isn't a disturbance. The flat feels completely self contained and private. You will not find better than this place, book it now.

This is a separate room that has it's own bathroom. The room is very nice and comfortable. The host is also very helpful and she leaves you to be but if you have questions she gladly helps. It is close to the blue and red lines. Central park is 4 min away. Safe area, never felt in danger. Very good deal. Would recommend to couples who want to do sightseeing, theater etc.

I was a nice experience during NY. I don't forget a kindness. Thank you for your serve.  I have been staying in New York among Valentine's day, the weather was very dangerous cold. The room's heat boiler so noisy, but I understood this situation, because of boiler was full operating and very cold outside.

Jillian’s place is clean and has a convenient location. Suitable for anyone looking for a functional kitchen while traveling. We really really appreciated Jillian’s kindness of giving us flexible check in / check out times, which made our trip so much more enjoyable and stress free! Also since Jillian lives in the building she was able to respond to requests immediately, without compromising our privacy during the trip. Would 100% recommend this place to anyone and would definitely choose this place again in the future!

I had the best experience staying here! The apartment is super clean and comfortable and the neighborhood is amazing. It’s close to everything you might need including all major subway lines and you can pretty much walk to anywhere in lower Manhattan. I never felt unsafe walking alone, even at night. Ruby was really sweet, helpful and easy to communicate with. I definitely recommend this place!

I really don't know where to start... Anytime I am in New York from this day forward I will go visit Marilyn!  My stay was a therapeutic refresh from the stress of day to day hectic life. She made me an amazing dinner the first day I was there.  It was like I was family for the time I was there.  Cannot say enough great stuff about this woman and my stay.  Love, love, love Lady Venus!!!

We had to book a last minute room after an out of town trip didn't work out. Luckily we found Memo's place & what a dream it was. We were a bit further in Brooklyn than we hoped to stay but not a far subway or cab/uber ride away to where we needed to go. The room was clean! The restroom was super clean! There was central air & a fan so we kept cool the whole time! We had a blow dryer in the bathroom & soft towels provided to us. The bed was SO comfortable. The neighborhood wasn't sketchy either even though we didn't go out in it. Memo let us check in early which was beyond appreciated after our road trip flopped. The other travelers staying in the other rooms were quiet & respectful. We had full kitchen access, wifi & a TV with Roku! We unwound watching Netflix & enjoyed our nights in the city. It was the perfect place to stay & alternative to a hotel. Memo was also very responsive, polite & helpful. We would love to stay again!

I had an awesome stay at Marilyn’s place. She is a very nice host, it was my first time using airbnb and really liked the experience.  The location is great, i think less than a mile away from the Church Ave subway station that leads directly to Manhattan in about 20 minutes on Q train.   Very quiet and safe neighborhood, i stayed a week there, came back all days at 2 AM from manhattan, and no sign of danger at all.  The room is exactly like the pictures, very organized, comfortable and cozy, better than many hotels i’ve stayed before.  Overall, really great experience. I just felt like i was at my home on those days at NYC. I would totally recommend marilyn’s home to any friend that goes to new york. Probably i will be staying again whenever i go to New York.

Justin was a wonderful host during my stay, and was quick to respond to all of my questions and requests prior to and during my stay. The place is beautiful - I had the whole floor to myself, including a spacious bedroom, closet, bathroom, and kitchenette area. The area is located in a very residential area of the Bronx, and I never felt unsafe walking the streets even at night. The 4,6 and the B,D subway lines are about a 10 minute walk away, which made commuting to lower Manhattan a breeze. I stayed for 5 weeks since I was working at a nearby hospital, and I would definitely stay here again! I highly recommend this place!

Great host, attentive, and there for you if you have any questions. At first the neighborhood felt sketchy, but there are a lot of kids in the area so it felt safer. The area was easy to get used to and if you are with a group of people you should be fine. I loved my experience in this Airbnb and would go back again :)

We were very happy with this apartment! It is very spacious (more than it seems in the photo) and, despite the fame of the Bronx, the area is very quiet. We did not have any problems nor did we perceive that the place was dangerous. It is quite close to the metro that takes you to the city center in about 20-25 minutes. The host, very attentive. We had a problem with the shower curtain, which although it wasn't a problem for us, they went out of their way to fix everything very quickly. Communication with him very good. I recommend this apartment!

Justin was super helpful and answered all our questions fast. The neighborhood was ok, a little scary at night but definitely safe during the day. The apartment was clean and comfortable. Everything was there you needed!

Justin is a wonderful host. He gave us tips and was ever so helpful. The room is spacious. We never felt unsafe in the neighborhood. Check online whether there is a Yankee game. We just loved the ambiance. If possible we will certainly come back.

Thanks again for having us at this beautiful home! Everything was just perfect (especially the comfy bed);) We also loved the neighborhood and didn't feel unsafe at any time. It's a short 10 min walk to the subways, which take you downtown. Checkin and checkout was very easy and we had everything we need in the apartment! Justin is a really nice guy, who cares about his guests. Communication was very easy, he really wanted us to feel home, which we did! We definitely recommend it!

Justin scores 10. He always responded quickly to my questions and was very attentive in his responses.  The room is much larger than in the photos, it even has a mini kitchen separate from the room. Normal cleaning and the bed and bath linen are very fragrant. The distance to the metro is 10 minutes walking, the only downside is that Line D only runs until 9:30 pm, after that you have to take two lines.  The neighborhood is simple and a little intimidating, but I didn't feel unsafe at any time. Anyway, I recommend this space to everyone.
Justin is a very helpful host. The apartment is much more spacious and nicer than the photos show. The neighborhood is not dangerous at all.

We spent 9 days at Justin's house, the value for money is unbeatable. The accommodation was very clean and much larger than it looks in the photos. The house is about 15 minutes by subway from Midtown (always try to take the express subway otherwise it can double the time). The area is not dangerous at all, we arrive almost every day after 1am and we do not feel threatened at any time. I recommend this accommodation 100%. Justin is a great Host and always answers your questions quickly. I would repeat without a doubt.

Jared is very friendly, he tries his best to speak Spanish if you don't understand English. When I arrived, he lent me a tablet with internet so I could take it with me at all times and not get lost in the city. Like every traveler, I was afraid of arriving in an unknown country and with someone unknown, however, with Jared I had a totally positive experience because he is an excellent host, his house is very well located and the neighborhood is VERY quiet. I highly recommend it!!!!!

Overall, the unit was clean and exactly like in the pictures. We were initially a bit shaky about the neighborhood, but we ended up walking to Bravi Ragazzi at night without feeling unsafe (and the pizza was amazing!)

This place was no what I expected in the slightest. Our room was not cleaned well. On arrival we found stains on our comforter as well as the sheets. Luckily we brought our own sheets and pillowcases just incase (this was my first airbnb experience). We were supposed to have two beds though the second bed was not set up and the stuff for it was just thrown in the closet. The tv has a remote but no remote for the roku so we had to download the roku app to use the tv. The bathroom had a dirty soaking wet hand towel lying in the shower as well as a used bar of soap and dirt in the tub and on the shower walls. It says no smoking or drugs but as soon as you walk in it smells like marijuana very strongly. It also states no guests but one guest in the room next to us had random people in and out all day/night. They want you to take your shoes off to walk through the house but the floors are dirty. I don’t even walk through my own house bare foot. This house all around had a very uncomfortable and unsafe feeling for me which is why I ended my trip and left a day early even though I paid for two full nights. I felt extremely uncomfortable and beyond unsatisfied with how much I paid to stay there and what I received in return. It’s unacceptable especially with covid happening. Cleanliness is essential. I do not recommend this place.

Memo was a great host and was extremely communicative. The only issue was that there was another guest in the house who was a bit weird and was demonstrating erratic behavior that scared me. I communicated to the host and he was prompt in coming over to ensure I felt safe. He proceeded to ask the gentleman to leave. The location is great!

Great stay.  The studio apartment was clean, comfortable, light-filled, and notably quiet.  Its location near Broadway/Times Square and multiple subway lines was very convenient.    An was a very attentive host who, along with David, ensured that everything went smoothly even though he was out of the country.  The list of nearby eateries and grocery / drug stores An provided was as helpful as it was varied.  The experience overall was simple and relaxing.    Definitely will consider returning when we visit NYC.

The apartment was great.  We arrived early but our host made arrangements so that we could drop off our luggage and pick up the keys from the cleaning lady.  Things went pretty smoothly.  Location was central and ideal for our needs.  Walking distance to many attractions, theater and fantastic dining.  Close to lots of action and great proximity to many subway lines.  If you are a theater/Broadway buff you will love this location.  The unit was fine for the two of us.  We were a little worried that it would be too small, but it wasn't.  We were able to accommodate for our belongings in the apartment.  Even though it is a studio, we didn't feel cramped and managed well with all our luggage.  It felt large and roomy, probably because is is so bright with a pretty nice view.  Microwave was a little loud when in use, but otherwise the kitchen was sufficient and served our needs (we only ate breakfast in).  Bathroom was pretty nice too - one of those old fashioned showers with really, really good pressure.  Not a wimpy shower like we have at home (ha ha).  Neighborhood is maybe a little noisy, but that was easily addressed by leaving the fan/AC on as white noise, so really not an issue.  Neighborhood was fine.  No security issues and never felt unsafe.  The doorman from 4pm to 1am was an added bonus.  In general, we were very pleased with our first AirBnB experience.  We really enjoyed our time there.  We would strongly recommend the apartment and would give a rating of 9/10.

Jarad is a really helpful and nice guy. We arrived early in the morning, but it was no problem for Jarad to let us in that early and to let us feel welcomed. In general I would say it's very uncomplicated to stay in his apartment. For every problem, he finds a well suited solution. For example, we even got a spare key and Jarad also provided us with a phone and tablet with mobile internet during the stay. One of the beds was a little bit shaky, hence it might pose a challenge to climb onto it, but it was fine for us. Although the apartment is located in Brooklyn, one is relatively fast in Manhatten, since the subway station is near. Basic food stores are also in reach. The only downside of the stay was a not well functioning drain in the shower (but a plumber was already notified) and much dirty dishes in the sink making it a little bit unpleasant to use the kitchen. However, Jarad's openness and helpfulness remedies these two minor stains. 5 stars!

My husband, 15 month old and I stayed here for 4 nights. Tammy was very kind and quick to respond to any questions or concerns I had before our trip. I had spoken to Tammy many weeks prior to check in date to see if we could check in at 1 instead of 3. She said it was fine, however, when we arrived the apartment was dirty from previous guests. Tammy was out of town while we were there, so I  called her son Evan and he had no idea of our early check in, but sent the maid over right away to clean the apt and it was no big deal. The apt was just as the pictures show, pretty, spacious, and had all the amenities you possibly need. The heat, AC, water, all worked. However, one thing we felt was misleading was the area it was located. Yes, it was close to buses and subways, but the area itself was not the safest after dark. As a parent, I did not feel comfortable walking back in the dark with my baby. The apartment doors were not super secure, only a bar door protected anyone from entering if they truly wanted in. Usually noise does not bother my husband and I, we can sleep through almost anything and I understand it is a busy city, yet, there were loud voices, music, banging right outside the window all night long. The first night we heard loud banging on a door, and when my husband checked the apt the back door was open. The second night we heard voices, screaming, music, right outside, and an officer was shot and killed just blocks from where we were. The third night we heard running back and forth directly above us, along with doors banging. I had to message Tammy to confirm nobody was in the apt above us. The fourth night we finally had a restful night. My husband is an officer, and for him to feel unsafe and uncomfortable in an area says a lot. Tammy was very nice and concerned and was quick to try and out our minds at ease. I in no way hold anything against her, she was great, the apt had everything we needed. For New York and the price, the size and cleanliness of the apt is as amazing. Our only true complaint is the security of the doors and the location mostly because of our baby. This would be a great place for someone without a child, and we should have done more research on the location beforehand. Tammy truly is a great host.

I didn't meet the host junior, I don't think it was him communicated with him at all. Every time I called I spoke with a female , who was really nice by the way.  I did meet a lady (Julisa, I think) to get the keys upon arrival. The apartment is exactly what how it's described on here. The neighborhood is VERY New York. Which I don't mind because because the Bronx is my second home. But I would never stay in that neighborhood again. There is ABSOLUTELY NO PARKING . The first night I got there it took us over an hour to find parking, and it was the same thing every single day. Friday-Monday.  The parking issues made the trip stressful to the point of me  wanting to pack my bags and driving back to Boston.   I think the host can improve the apartment by adding a:  1. TV   2.  full body mirror  3. Kitchen cleaning supplies  - There wasn't any garbage bags in the apartment and we had to buy a new  dish washing sponge 4. trash pan for the kitchen area 5. New plastic curtain for the bath tub  The apartment just needs a mother's touch to it.  There's no "homely" feeling to it. It's had the bear minimum you need to survive.

Junior is very friendly and always responded quickly. The apartment is very nice, but very noisy. We had a police escort home from the supermarket in the evening because they were afraid that someone would attack us, so the area is very dangerous when it gets dark. You can hear everything through the bright walls at night, a night without a siren or an argument on the street was rare.  The metro is right around the corner, great connections, it was a great stay.

Tammys spot was absolutely incredible! I didn't want to leave. It's in the heart of Harlem, walkable, plenty of shops, restaurants, and public transit within walking distance. The space itself is a steal. Tammy communicates well and is welcoming. Highly recommend.

The hosts came down in the evening and gave us some helpful tips regarding the metro, shopping, restaurants and jazz clubs. The apartment is very clean and spacious for two people. There were drawers and a closet space. The bed was comfortable. There are two more sleeper sofas for more people. There is a small bathroom, with a good shower and enough space for our stuff. The toilet is facing a wall with a small space between it and the wall, making it awkward for a large person to use it. Bedding and towels were nice. The host left us a basket with a few snacks and water. We appreciated that. The neighborhood is not the best, but we never felt any danger even when coming back in the dark.

We had a great stay at Junior’s apartment in Bronx and could definitely recommend the place to anyone looking for off the beaten path stay in New York. The apartment is beautiful and fully equipped, and very clean. A couple of metro stations are nearby. Junior is a great host, very available to any questions or concerns. If you need all 3 bedrooms, keep in mind one is not private and has big glass doors with nothing to cover them. The apartment is pretty far away from any tourist attractions and we spent quite a bit of time on the trains. The neighbourhood is gritty and loud and there was a lot of very loud speakers blasting music from very early in the morning to late into the night. It’s a very communal area and locals hang out in little parties on the streets almost at all times - though loud party groups might seem intimidating, we didn’t really ever feel unsafe, even coming back to the apartment late into the night. None of that impaired our sleep though as the beds were extremely comfortable and we slept better then at home.

Linda and her family are definitely in a league of their own when it comes to Airbnb hosts! Let me start by saying that this is a wonderful place to stay for anyone looking for a little more space and amenities than the average NYC Airbnb can offer (a private apartment with it’s own bathroom AND a full kitchen!), in a great safe neighborhood with a fantastic multi-cultural personality. Linda goes above and beyond-more than just offering a place to stay, she enables you to have the smoothest visit possible and offers a lot of great extras like parking and pickup options and really goes out of her way to make sure you have what you need. Clear, fast communication and a friendly and efficient host. So for anyone traveling to the city, this is a great Airbnb.   But it’s particularly ideal if you are traveling with young kids. Linda and her family have set up the space to be comfortable for everyone in the family-lots of places to sleep, toys and essentials like packnplay, high chair, potty seats are available as well as thoughtful touches like childproofed furniture and device charging stations, removable soft floor surface for crawling babies and toddlers, etc. We were traveling with a 7 month old and the homey aspects of Linda’s place and her helpfulness in so many ways really made a trip that could have been very stressful much more smooth. What a lovely individual she is-we felt like friends rather than customers!   I also loved the area-although some have mentioned noisy streets, this was actually rather quiet for a city neighborhood and the apartment itself was very quiet inside-we had no trouble with street noise at night. The area is very safe and on the many pleasant walks we took we felt like it was almost like being in a dozen countries at once with all the different cultures represented in businesses, restaurants and places of worship and the families we interacted with in the parks and common spaces.   As far as getting into the city, I had business in Manhattan every day of our stay and found the commute very straightforward and easy-this line of the subway is easy to figure out and pretty fast since you don’t need transfers-a 30 minute subway ride after the 12 minute walk to the subway.  All in all a fantastic experience and we will definitely stay here again if/when we’re back in the area again!

Another Brooklyn miss for me. My flight got cancelled and so I needed a last minute place to crash and this place was available. Sadly I booked it. First all of the the neighborhood in my opinion was a little on the shady side...or maybe thats just Brooklyn for you. Either way I would not feel comfortable walking around there at night. But hey thats what uber is for. The much larger issue was the AC or the lack of I should say. Now the listing very explicitly stated the room had an ac unit. All the room had was a fan. The common area had an ac unit but sadly none of that cool air reached my room. Walking into my room was like stepping into a furnace. Keep in mind this is Brooklyn in the summer. I pinged the host about the situation and he never got back to me. Given how uncomfortable it was in that room and given the hosts non-responsiveness I spent the night at the airport. A very disappointing end to my NYC trip.
The place is exactly like showed in the picture. It's 10 minutes walk from the nearest subway. The place itself is clean and Iso is very responsive. The area though may look sketchy, but it was fine.

We had a good stay at Memo & Iso's place. Although we did not meet them, they were quick to respond and provided us with whatever we needed. The red room is okay for 1 or 2 guests; and although technically there was arrangement for 3 people to sleep in that room, it got pretty over-crowded (to be fair, we also had plenty of luggage!) It had a private bathroom, which is neat! We loved the living room-it was comfy, sunny and spacious! The neighborhood was nice and did not seem unsafe (not that we walked around at night!) It was a half-mile walk from the nearest subway station. Overall, I would say it is value for money.

Stayed here 4 days with my 17mo son and it was perfect for the 2 of us. There’s a good amount of toys to keep him entertained and she also had a lot of baby/toddler related things that we could use which helped me pack less for our trip, like a high chair and a pack-n-play. (There was also stuff that I didn’t use, but I’m sure would be helpful for the future, like a potty training toilet seat and baby shampoo). Linda (and her whole family) was sweet, accommodating and knowledgeable. I strongly recommend paying the additional money for a parking spot if you have a car, it made our trip a lot less stressful.

The host is quick to respond and polite, very helpful. We only stayed one night. The neighborhood has nice places to visit but it’s a bit sketchy at night. We felt safe at the house though and it’s next to a fire station. The room is a good size and convenient bathroom inside. It could have been more clean. If you stay for a long time I’d recommend bringing your own bedsheets.

Save your money and stay some where else. This property is located in Bushwick which if you are coming from an other state, is a very rough part of town. Not only that the property doesn’t exist, or at least that’s what it looked like to me as I spent three hours trying to find this place, and then still didn’t find it so I had to get a hotel for the first night and spend close to $300 because who wants to be in the middle of Brooklynn with no where to stay at 4:30 on the morning. Airbnb did a fantastic job of changing my reservation and accommodated quickly as soon as the next day l, but that first night I was so scared and felt so unsafe. Sooo if you’re looking for a non existing place in the middle of the most dangerous places in Brooklyn, then you have found your destination

The quality-price ratio of this apartment is correct.  Upon arrival, self-entry into the premises. Practical for when you arrive super early or super late, after a long trip. A staircase to go up to the accommodation, you have to take off your shoes. Nice common area with full kitchenette kitchen. You can leave your luggage on the day of departure to enjoy the last day without worrying about luggage. (With prior agreement from the host). The room: We found it good for the size (but for two!) because with four there would be no room for suitcases.  The bed was not made, there was a sheet and a duvet placed only on the mattress.  The paint at the window and everywhere is peeling.  We found the room not perfectly clean but sufficient for just sleeping and washing.  For two it suits perfectly.  The bathroom: practical and sufficient too.  The sink wasn't perfectly clean either.  Location: Ideal, 8 minutes from UTICA metro, secure. Night or day, you can go out without fear!  Located next to a grocery store where the burgers are very, very good! There is also a fire station nearby which is nice!  Overall I recommend this accommodation for people on a medium/tight budget but for two maximum!

My husband and I made a trip from MA to NY for our 8th anniversary. We have a four-year-old daughter and she felt really at home in Linda’s guest apartment with her own toddler bed and all the toys and books available for her. The rest of the place was clean and cozy, and Linda was very responsive and proactive with the whole check-in and check-out process. We also ran into a problem on the morning of our departure—our car’s battery had died overnight! Linda’s husband Rob generously took the time from his day give us a jump. They were so very kind and gracious and deserve all the stars possible! ⭐️ 🌟 💫 Thanks again Linda, and don’t be a stranger! ☺️😁

We were very happy at Tammy’s apartment. We had no problems at all. The amenities were great - all the essentials plus. She even left a little snack basket for us. The apartment is very roomy & all furniture especially the beds were very comfortable. Very clean & we loved the backyard even in chilly weather. Plenty of good restaurants with mass transit nearby. Grocery store, drug store, & dollar store  just a half block away. Neighborhood is friendly & safe.

I stayed in Tammy's apartment for a week in February 2019. Here is what you need to know: Tammy is a lovely host, she answers quickly, she is nice, she even left us water and snacks as a welcome and a local guide with maps and important transport music and food information!   As for the appartment if you are or if you are travelling with  a very tall  or big person I gotta tell you I don't think you are going to fit or be comfortable in the bathroom.  The living room and bedroom are quite big in comparison. Maybe small bathrooms are a New York thing, I don't know.  I am 5 feet and when I sat in the toilet my knees were only inches away from the wall. Also the bath tub was kinda small as well. I did feel like I didn't have much room to move freely.  The appartment is quite cold, but she did have a heater in the bathroom as well as two air conditioners with heating system, which was great!!!   The neighborhood is Harlem, I gotta tell you first day we didn't like it so much and It did seem kinda unsafe. But locals say Harlem is much more safe now than in the past. It is in a nice part of it near subway stations as well as the Apolo theater. And we didn't have ANY problems, everyone minds their own business. So in the end I ended up liking Harlem.   As for transport the subways we used the most were only four and seven blocks away! they are quite near yes.  We used mostly our metrocard to move around the city, but when we ended up late at night, even thought the subway is a 24 hour service we rathered spend some money and call an uber, just to be safe, just in case.  Which is what we are used to do back home as well.   We also liked that there was a supermarket right at the end of the street, just meters away from the apartment! That was so comfortable and dining in sometimes did  let us save some money, New York is quite expensive after all.   I think this is it, hope this was usefull information. If you don't mind about the small bathroom, I think you are going to like Tammy's appartment and have a great time just like my best friend and I had.

At first surprised to be at the bottom of the "building/house", we ultimately loved having this apartment to ourselves without being disturbed and especially without disturbing the residents.  The last evening we asked Tammy for a scale to weigh our luggage, we had it that same evening.  The rear part of the house which cannot be seen in the photos is very beautiful and maintained.  The neighborhood is lively in New York style while being calm enough to feel good there. (I, who have trouble sleeping with noise, felt very good there). Little tip: Watch out for the shower head! The bathtub is clean but I was surprised once (on several showers) to see the shower head fall from its support. (More fear than harm) There you have it, only good memories of our trip and partly thanks to our little "home" and the store (the jesus store as we called it!) Which is just at the end of the street!

Because of the schedule I didn't spend a lot of time with Mackenzie but it was really nice to to see her when I got her about the key of the room. She explained  me about the stay very well by the email. After I arrived I found so lovely room that I've never found in New York before. the bed was so comfy and I really liked it that I had toilet for myself and even the cat I met at the place was so adorable. the 5 floors that I have to walk up was little stressful but still this fabulous rooftop scenery makes me feel so good every morning. this is the best place to stay over in Manhattan if you would like to stay at somewhere in quiet peaceful neighborhood of course you can get to the Central Park very easily and that was the best point as well.

Leah's place was great! She was very prompt in getting back to me with all emails and texts. The location was nice, really close to a couple subway stations. The neighborhood was a tiny bit sketchy I may have felt a little uncomfortable if I was walking alone at night but I was with friends so it wasn't a big deal at all. In general very colorful dynamic neighborhood with lots of great restaurants and bars. Her place was nice, railroad style comfortable for two couples. My only complaint is there was no air conditioner and I really thought I had read that there was one. It happened to be very hot outside those two evenings. The bedroom door and all windows had to be open with fans going to make it somewhat bearable.  Leah left free coffee coupons for us that we didn't get a chance to use but that was very thoughtful.  She was super flexible with check in/out time which was sooooo nice! I feel terrible that my bus was running late and showed up 20 minutes after I had planned. But she was able to leave a key for us.  Thanks so much :)

The apartment was very spacious. The room was relatively small but cute and it was nice to have my own half bath. One glitch: The evening before my departure to NY it became unclear if someone would be at home the next day to let me in. This caused a bit of stress from my part, having to take a transatlantic flight. But it was solved and in her absence Zuzi's very friendly housemate took over as the host for the entire stay and was very welcoming. He also lent me a bath towel which was not in the room and I did not bring one. There's a laid back atmosphere in the apartment. Super conveniently located near the subway and a few good and affordable fresh juice bars. The area was so-so, I think Williamsburg would fit me better, but it was great as a very first acquaintance with Brooklyn.

Simon's place is great. The pictures really show what will be expecting you there. His property also has all the amenities you will need to spent some time in a rainy day (Wi-fi, TV with Apple TV, a stove etc...). Everything was clean as expected and we had no problems at all when communicating with Simon.  About the neighborhood: Harlem is safe, we did not had any trouble whilst in the streets. People might look at you differently, but there are some reasons to do so: 1) You are a tourist and 2) You are probably the minority in the hood, so you are different from average Joe. Yes, there are homeless people, people asking for money and drunk people, but hey, you will find them anywhere in NY.  About NY Subway: While we were there the subway had some work during weekend and during nights on weekdays, so yeah, maybe you will have to walk a little bit more than expected sometimes. The #2,3 red line subway is pretty close though.

We had a great stay!  This listing lived up to the description perfectly.   The apartment is sunny, clean and well-appointed.  Simon was available as much as we needed him.  Check-in and check-out were stress-free.   We felt completely at home without any of the stresses of home.  We look forward to staying here again.

Disclaimer: This apartment is on the third floor-it takes two STEEP flights of stairs to get to the 3rd floor. However, this building is SUPER safe; it takes two locks just to get into the building itself!  My husband and I stayed at Simon's apartment for our honeymoon in New York and it was WONDERFUL! The apartment was incredibly spacious and so comfortable. The bed was a perfect size (queen), the bathroom has a detachable shower head and great water pressure, there is a full kitchen and PLENTY of space in the living room (not to mention free Netflix! Score!) Being from Texas, I was nervous to stay in New York because of how 'dangerous' I've heard New York is. Though Simon's place is technically in Harlem, I never felt unsafe the whole time I was there. We were within walking distance of Central Park which was awesome! We didn't use the subways or buses, just taxis the whole time and it was always easy to get to and from our apartment. Due to extenuating circumstances, we weren't able to meet Simon personally, but he was EXTREMELY responsive via AirB&B. There wasn't anything we needed but he offered anyways. He even left us a bowl of snacks in the kitchen, which was a kind touch.  If you're in New York and looking for a home away from home, truly, stay at Simon's! I would definitely stay again.

Junior's apartment was a GREAT value. It looked like the pictures, remodeled with three nice size bedrooms, a small bathroom and sitting area and a beautiful kitchen.  We were on the third level and the two flights of stairs to get up were steep and narrow. The apartment has beautiful floors, a nice amount of windows and was pretty open for a New York space. It could use a little detailing as far as walls and bedding, some decor to be more cozy and possibly another tv or two (there is only one), but it was still a comfortable fit for my family and I.  There was enough space for my husband and I to have a room, our children to have a room and my mother in law to have her own room.  The apartment had the basics like dishes, pots and pans, soap, lotion, shampoo an iron and towels.  Although we didn't really need anything else because we had brought the details with us.  The Bronx neighborhood was lively.  Expect lots of sirens, music and people coming from the streets nearby.  There is food, stores and the subway all within walking distance. It's not the cleanest area if that matters to you, and we were told not to hang around too much at night.  But, again this was all expected and we were careful not to be bias or afraid of local people.  We are in their space and place!  Don't forget to pay close attention to the subways when going into and coming from Manhattan! Especially directions and if you should be on the numbered (2,4) or lettered (D) Subway. You will have great adventures in this place!  We had an amazing trip!

It was a nice stay in Junior’s apartment with all the advantages like quick replying from him, convenient check-in and out, family-friendly apartment rooms, short distance reach transportation and grocery stores, quiet neighborhood and affordable price. The only concern we have is that there are many cockroaches in both kitchen and bathroom. It won’t be a problem if you are not afraid of them. Overall it was a really good place to stay, considering New York’s average hotel price. We would possibly choose this apartment if we come to NYC again.

This apartment is just perfect! Clean, spacious and welcoming. Simon was really accommodating as we arrived early. We were able to left our luggage in the hallway until we had access to the apartment.  It’s still Harlem, so there is a lot going on outside, but we never felt unsafe. There is groceries stores and a cute winery store nearby.  It is also really easy to access the subway.   Loved my stay!

We had an excellent stay, the apartment was as advertised, communication was good even if we didn't have the chance to get to know each other. The area is lively, friendly and contrary to what one might believe, we did not feel unsafe even in the evening. I think it is an essential area to soak up the New York atmosphere. In addition, Tammy let us enjoy the apartment after 12 p.m. in relation to our return flight. If we come back to New York we will know where to go to stay.

This place is a hang out spot it is very unsafe there are all kind of ppl hanging out,drinking and smokingI the yard and when my mom said she didn’tfeel comfortable staying there JR refused to issue a refund! THE AREA IS NOT SAFE!

The room was cosy and in a great location. Troy was very nice and helpful. I was a bit afraid about the location, since it is quite noisy around the square, but it turned out fine, as the apartment is rather quiet. Overall it was just what I needed.

The apartment itself is great, the area might look a bit sketchy at first but we didn´t have any trouble. The subway is really close and it takes roughly about 30 mins from the apartment to central park wich is pretty fast.

I’m very surprised to see so many good reviews and NO ONE mention the amount of drug dealers and questionable looking people sitting right outside the apartment on the neighboring steps... as soon as I got out of my Uber I was approached by gentlemen asking if I wanted to “buy smoke and poppies”... if that wasn’t bad enough, it took an hour for Simon to respond as I was having a little trouble finding the spot due to my late flight... The loud music played all night along with their loud talking by the neighbors, and the smell of marijuana was coming so strong through our windows that we had to close them... we arrived to a hot apartment so we wanted fresh air but had to result to the ACs to avoid noise and the smell. and if that wasn’t bad enough, I woke up to Pop Smoke blasting at 8am...  Due to the price point I wasn’t completely shocked at the location being in the hood or even the obnoxious loud noises outside my steps but I was still willing to get through this very quick weekend work trip and still give it the benefit of the doubt...    To end it off, Simon then accused me and my husband of smoking in his apartment as if there wasn’t a group of people right next door outside all day smoking... he then kicked us out of the apartment in less than 24 hours, at 9pm at night. Frustrated, I was able to find accommodations by the grace of God, to find the next morning that Simon conveniently had our booking still listed as current and hadn’t notified Air bnb of the “smoking cancellation”. Ironic right? He kept it up until Sunday, when we were supposed to check out...  All in all, it is walking distance to shops and the subway, it is NOT in Manhattan or anywhere relatively close, the water gets super hot which is great, he had more than enough utensils, towels, toiletries and the rest.   the WiFi sucks.   Please DO NOT get sucked into this man’s finesse unless you absolutely have to...

The apartment is very clean. The host is very responsive. The check in was easy. The neighbors are friendly. If you aren’t from NYC you have to be aware that you are in Harlem, so you can’t be afraid of the neighborhood or the constant noise and can’t be shy so you can have the best experience. We had a great stay and the overall experience was memorable (I danced with the neighbors in front of the house ;-) It was my boyfriend’s very first time in NYC and he loved it. If you can find a local to show you around the city you’ll have an amazing time. Covid is still making the city very strict, so make sure to plan everything ahead of time. Restaurants, Bodegas, Bars, Retail stores have different hours and the city that never slept now sleeps at 10pm. If you aren’t comfortable wearing a mask you won’t have a pleasant time in NY as it is required in every single place you go. Some places give you more leeway if you can prove you have been vaccinated. Being from the Bronx, I can say, NY is just not the same anymore. I hope the city can make it back to how it used to be, until then you just have to accept it for what it is now.
Nice appartement. Great host.  Neighbourhood is sketchy. 5 minutes walk to subway was a plus.

Troy was a fantastic host. He was Very organized and friendly. Made our vacation to NYC a comftorable and stress free visit. Highly recommend! His place was literally right down the street from the center of Times Square. Amazing location in the center of everything fun going on in NY.

Chao was a wonderful host and made me feel very comfortable! His cat, Frank, was such as sweetheart and was a huge bonus during my stay.  Chao was very helpful and offered restaurant recommendations, opportunities to go out, and great advice.  If you want a yummy meal and beer, hit up Saraghina just down Lewis Street.  I also heard that Peaches was great, but never got the chance to try it.    The metro station is about 10-15 minutes away, so just make sure you have good walking shoes on.  The neighborhood may seem a bit sketchy, but overall I felt safe there.  Just make sure to use your street smarts and don't wander off late at night.  Bodegas are on every corner which made it very convenient.  I enjoyed my stay and have made a friend in Chao and Frank! :)

We stayed at Chao's apartment for 10 days. Overall it was a good experience. The pictures and the description of the accomodation are accurate. The private bathroom is a HUGE plus and we loved it! We only saw the host at the arrival and the departure but he was really responsive through text messages. Frank the cat is indeed very friendly, clean and cute and loves to cuddle :) The neighbourhood is ok, though in the late hours can get a little scary.  Only two things that bothered us a little: the cat wants to be in your room all the time, even jumps on the bed and on the table. Of course you can direct it out but that usually results in loud meow-ing and scraching on the door that is particularly annoying at 6 AM.  The other thing is the distance. 15 minutes walking distance to the A/C Train Station and then additional 20-30 minutes to Manhattan (it depends on which part you want to visit). So the distance is definitely something to think about.

Staying with Chao made our New York experience so much better. I'm thinking about moving to New York for school, so staying at an apartment instead of a hotel gave me a more genuine feel of what it's like to live there. The apartment was spacious and Chao gave us amazing privacy. We never saw him again after the first day. There's a cat named Frank that is obsessed with trying to get into/being in the room you'll stay in. The neighborhood seems a little sketchy especially at night but it's not too bad. There's conveniently a train to Manhattan like 10-15 minutes walking distance. The bathroom is clean and spacious and there's Netflix on the TV. Overall, we would definitely stay with Chao again!

My partner and I stayed one week in Chao’s place end of April 2016.  Pros  - We enjoyed our privacy as we saw our host only the day of the arrival and one time after that for 5 minutes.  - The room was spacious and had an electrical heater that worked pretty well. The private bathroom is definitely a plus!  - The cat Frank is very cute and loves to be cuddled.  - The apartment was clean and as shown in the pictures.   Cons:  - You have to walk 15 minutes to the nearest subway station. - Not a very quiet room, you can hear all the steps from the tenants upstairs (sometimes early in the morning or late at night) they must have an old wooden flooring so that you can hear everything. However most of the time we were too tired to care. - The view from the room is not very nice as it is some kind of garbage dump and can be sometimes noisy (some wood cutting… in our first morning) but got quieter the rest of our stay. The neighborhood can feel sketchy but we did not have any problems my partner and I while we stay there, even coming back late at night.  - Also, a proper blanket or quilt is missing in this bedroom, because it gets a bit chilly at night and even though we asked for an extra blanket (which was quickly provided) it was very thin and not warm at all, so that I had to sleep with a sweater on, and sometimes we would leave the heater on part of night, which is a bit of a waste of energy but I can’t personally stand to be cold at night  - The key to the building was not working properly so that we got a bit stressed of not being able to access the apartment, trying for 10 minutes to turn the key in the lock but Chao eventually changed it (on the last day) so it should not be a problem for the next airbnb people.   Chao was sometimes hard to get in touch with, and often replied in a very few words, so that it was not always easy to communicate, but he wasn’t unfriendly though. If you wish to exchange with your host, get to know the culture… you won’t get that in Chao’s place BUT if you want to have your privacy, like you would in a hotel, come and go as you wish (for a cheaper price) then Chao’s place is very good value!

This Airbnb was an okay stay and very close to time square which was amazing. But the host however, made me feel uncomfortable on arrival because of the lack of response, then showing up with his friends to greet me. He told it was ok for me to get there at 8am and showed up 30 minutes late. The apartment building that the Airbnb was in was a little sketchy walking in and out of, and the description was right about the stairs. Other then those details it was a good stay, but not sure if I’d stay again.

Chao went above and beyond to be helpful the few times we crossed paths during my stay.  The room and amenities were as pictures and as described.  Frank the Cat has lot of love to give, but I'm a little bit scared of cat's so I couldn't indulge him. More love for you!  The private bathroom was clutch and made this stay an amazing deal. I would definitely stay here again.

As prices in Manhattan are so high, we chose this apartment mainly from Debra's presentation and I have to admit that we were not disappointed at all. It's a very nice and comfortable place - better that what can seen from the pictures -  and Debra is the best hostess you can get! She's fun, caring and very friendly! One of the advantages of the location is that your're walking distance from 2 different subway stations-which gives you more choices -  and you can get easily to anywhere in Manhattan (in 15/ 25 minutes on the express train!).Another good thing is that near Debra's there's plenty of groceries stores (some with great prices), 24 h laundry mat, etc..with lot's of people day and night and I never felt unsafe (I even went to do the laundry at 1 am !!!). One more tip, if you are into shopping, don't miss Fulton Street in Brooklyn.  I would definitely stay at Debra's again because after a couple of days, It really felt home!

Debra made our stay super comfortable - we felt like we were staying with family. Anything you need, she's there to help and answer all of your questions. The lines of communication were great, she's super pleasant and funny. The privacy and space of her place is definitely a steal for the neighborhood, and it is located close to the train. Would definitely recommend!

Jason and Ondine are a very welcoming couple with a good sense to make every person feel comfortable and being welcome. The appartment is very tastefully and comfortably decorated and had everything, what is needed to feel at home. The kitchen is very well equipped and nicely decorated and allowed cosy meals. They had even filled the fridge with some beverages. Within walking distance to the Staten Island Ferry the appartment allows daily trips to NYC/Manhattan, but you have to calculate about an hour for one trip downtown (including subway). We can highly recommend Jason and Ondine as hosts and loved the appartment. It is a housing area, with little or no facilities for outside breakfast or nightly events, for those wanting that, we can not recommend the area. We loved the stress-free environment after our daytrips to Manhattan and stayed at home in the evenings. We loved the view from our bed to Manhattan skyline on a clear day. We loved the very typical American Housestyle.

Nina was a very nice host and responded quickly to any question I had. However, the apartment was very dark and dreary. I bought a few things for the kitchen, as it wasn’t sufficiently stocked for a long stay. There were also a couple of issues with the toilet becoming easily clogged. I will stress that the climb up the stairs to get to the unit is brutal. Definitely only book this place if you can handle four flights of steep stairs!

Clean  cozy place, great hosts, close to ferry. We had to find some place to stay in NY on a short notice. Jason and Dine responded right away. They managed to get the apartment ready for us the same day. And it felt like home. Quiet street, yet close to everything. Fully equipped kitchen. Comfortable beds. Thank you to our hosts!!! I am afraid they will become too popular (the price is right,too, for a budget tourists). Then we will have to book Jason's place well in advance))))

Our stay was perfect.  The apartment is large, spacious and well divided.  It has a large living room, bedroom with a very comfortable bed, equipped kitchen (it has practically everything you need), and a good bathroom.  Cleanliness was great, no unpleasant surprises.  The neighborhood is super quiet, very quiet.  The location is very close to the access to Manhattan by ferry.  It has shops, markets, pharmacies, laundries close by.   The hosts are wonderful, very friendly, cordial and helped a lot with very useful tips and information.  If we could we would give 10 stars.   We definitely recommend the accommodation.

Very spacious apartment. Great bathroom and very comfortable bed. The location is great, 2 minutes from the subway station and a few stops from midtown Manhattan (about 30 minutes)!   The only problem is the noise! We hear everything that happens above, the conversations, the sounds of footsteps on the floor, objects being moved. And it starts at 6am :-s!  The apartment is nice but the noise makes the stay a little unpleasant. It's a shame !

As a former New Yorker, I'm familiar with this general area.   This is a great location to stage an attack on Soho, Noho, Nolita, east village, China town.  Less so the west village, but doable for eager walkers.     The place is a perfect. Clean and decorated. amazing roomy arrangement considering the space and the patio is better than it appears in the pictures.      I never got to meet Esef- but he communicated great over email and made all arrangements as promised.    Will absolutely consider returning here for my annual visits.

Michael’s apartment is lovely, stylish and super clean. Situated close to the buzzing center of Williamsburg. Public transportation is easy to reach. Collection of keys was very easy and stress-free. We would stay again anytime. Thanks!

Myrdith was an amazing host.  Not only did she do everything she could to make our stay positive,  she went above and beyond proving is with a wealth of information we needed to deal with an unpleasant situation involving the death of my brother.  She truly is an angel.

We used Myridth's place for our trip to Afropunk. Her place is in a great location. It was convenient to many restaurants, and it was close to commodore park. Although location was A-1, the cleanliness of the apartment left a lot to be  desired. The fans were dusty  The kitchen was unlean, and there was clutter under the counter. It is an older place and it smelled of mold and mildew. Becareful if you have allergies. I left congested after my asthma attack. This is not a "entire apartment". Its more like a guest suite within a brownstone. If they were to pay more attention to cleaning the place I would be able to give her a better rating, but for now it could only get a 2 star rating from me.

This being our first Airbnb experience, we didn't know what to expect. Thankfully Brooke and Elias gave us a warm welcome in their Queens appartment. The appartment should be crowded with Brooke, Elias, his two brothers, Charlie the cat, Stella the playful kitten and a puppy dog, but during our stay it never felt cramped. The animals seemed happy to be benched or confined to a room. We hardly saw the brothers and Brooke and Elias were like lifelong friends. They gave us directions and info when needed and left us alone when we closed the door to our comfortable, clean room. We will happilly  send anyone to this Airbnb, that's how much we liked it! The neighbourhood is lively but did nog feel unsafe. It's close enough to the subway that goes straight into Manhattan. In short: the best way to spend a couple of days in New York.

The room is relatively large and has a bed and two sofa beds and is essentially the same as the photos.  The dog and cat were present as announced and behaved very calmly during our stay. They only came running when you wanted to go to the toilet or left the door open. If you are afraid of animals, this room is definitely not an option.  Brooke was very nice and made our stay as pleasant as possible. The communication was very uncomplicated and problem-free.  The only thing I didn't like so much was the location, the way to the subway wasn't that easy to find and a bit long for my taste after a day full of sightseeing ;-)

This was such a wonderful stay! Brooke was a delightful host, and her family was simply a joy. They are truly hospitable people who cared about our comfort throughout our brief time in NYC. Her pets were a lovely bonus coming home to after a long day exploring the city, but would make anyone wary of pets uncomfortable. Everything was as described. The space was cozy, clean, and spacious with nice decor. The subway was within walking distance, and was an easy transit to the city. We often returned late, but they were very accommodating, and we did not feel unsafe in the neighborhood. We recommend this place, and would return in a heartbeat!

I recommend this apartman to everyone, who visits NY. Apartman is very clean and comfortable. We felt like at home. You don't need to afraid of dog - she is very friendly. Thanks to Brooke and Elias for opportunity to stay there. Also thanks to cleaning woman for friendlines. You are great team and we enjoy it!

Great place to stay. Don’t be hesitant on staying because of it not being in Manhattan. Very easy to get around and really not too far. They were very helpful pre visit with any info we needed for the trip. Did not get to meet in person but loved the dog. Not a sketchy neighborhood, older of course and very ethnic. Thanks again for everything

Overall our stay at Danielle's place was average. The apartment is true to the pictures, and was pretty clean. Danielle is a great, friendly host, and was happy to provide recommendations for places to eat. For the most part, she was pretty responsive to our needs.   However, this neighbourhood is apparently one of the more unsafe ones in Brooklyn. Friends of ours from New York advised us not to walk anywhere, even to and from the subway, after dark. This required us to use Uber for our whole trip, which ended up costing us more than we had hoped to spend on transportation.

Host made me feel welcome, she kindly helped me move my bags up and down the stairs when I moved in and out. The neighborhood is pretty nice, with the subway right next door, a gym across the street, and a nice market and drug store very close by.  The room also had two sources of cool air, which was nice in the summer. Host provides toiletries if needed, which is convenient.  The building is also quiet and feels safe.

Overall- Really Good! Jessica's place is really spacious and gorgeous without being preintenous.  It's located walking distance to coffee shops &  groceries stories. I spent New Year's Day there with my two friends and really enjoyed how much space there is to move about. Rare in Brooklyn.   Could Improve The no shoe policy has no room for faults. So be really mindful. Like you will get a knock on your door about it even if it's an accident and your first time there.  That's  what happened with me. No shade to Jessica, I get it. I'm sure that keen awareness has keep her hardwood floors in good condition. Just for guests,  I would extend a little more courtesy for mistakes to happen.  The Best Part I texted her a few days after my stay asking her about a denim jacket I left behind.  She responded she would look it. She found it and we coordinated to get it back.

Located only a few minutes walk from the subway station, Leonarda's Harlem apartment is near to a busy thoroughfare where you can order Seamless (food delivery), make a quick visit to the Duane Reade (drug store) or grab a quick meal/snacks from an array of restaurants/bodegas.  I booked with Leonarda at the last minute, and she was more than accommodating with my request.  Her apartment looked just like the pictures, and she was kind enough to have a few healthy, snack options on hand for me.  The large windows in the bedroom bring in a nice amount of light, and the view is quite nice.  Most importantly, her bed is uber comfortable.  I definitely had a hard time leaving it behind on the next day.

I recently stayed at Vigil’s lovely home in Harlem for about 6 weeks while working in the area. I travel a lot for work, so have done many homeshares over the years. I can honestly say that my stay with Vigil was among the best, both because of the attention that was put into making the space comfortable for everyone, but also because Vigil is a truly lovely person. I recommend staying here without hesitation, and should I ever be back in New York I would gladly stay here again.   The space was very comfortable and had everything you might need—a closet, storage space (shelves and pullout drawers beneath the bed), comfortable bed, desk with shelves, mirror with small shelves that made it easy to do my hair or put on make-up. I was provided my own fridge and cupboard spaces and allowed to use cookware. The internet connected well and was fast and the shower always had hot water. The shared spaces were always very clean and tidy.  The location was also perfect—a few easy blocks to the main metro lines with lots of grocery stores, coffee shops, pharmacies, and restaurants in the area. The laundromat was right on the corner. I never felt unsafe in the area, even when walking back from the metro by myself at night or in the earlier mornings. There were always friendly people around. I loved living there.   Vigil was incredibly responsive to messages, even before I had checked in. Once there, she was very attentive in making sure I was comfortable, even pulling out a box fan for me when we had an unexpected warm spell and keeping the volume on the television low so as not to be distracting. Her apartment truly felt like a home to me, which was refreshing after some brutally long work days. My one regret about my stay was that a series of work problems consumed my time and I didn’t get to sit and chat with Vigil more often—she’s a wonderful person to talk with.  So if you are someone who enjoys staying in a peaceful, tidy and comfortable space with kind people, this is really the best AirBnB available

Vigil was lovely over my two week stay. As a solo female traveler it’s stressful going to an unfamiliar place and staying with someone you don’t know. Vigil could not have been any more kind, comforting, patient, and attentive during my stay. It was truly a pleasure getting to know her and learning all the tips about the city. I highly recommend booking with her.

This was my first experience utilizing Airbnb, The host was very friendly, responsive and accommodating. Her detailed instructions to coordinate and get to the location were great and easy to follow. She was very flexible during the whole arrangement and I was able to request and stay an extra night due to a last minute plan change. I was staying in NYC for work so I was out in the mornings by 7:45 and came back around 9/10 most nights. The location was perfect for me. I was able to get to midtown, Hell's kitchen, and times square super easy 20 minutes. There is a great grocery store Fairway right by the apartment if you need to grab somethings for  the work week. I also ran along the Riverside park trail along the Hudson River, which was right outside of the apartment. That was my favorite, stress relieving and such a beautiful view. I barely saw the host throughout my stay, although when I did, Svjetlana, is very pleasant and nice to talk to. She made me feel welcomed to utilized the space, kitchen etc. The apartment was gorgeous! Bright, clean, fresh & comfortable and exactly my kind of taste in a place. I would stay here many times again; it was a overall excellent experience! thank you Svjetlana!

The apartment was equipped as described and everything was clean. We felt very comfortable there. We used the kitchen and bathroom together and there was no stress. Cynthia was really nice and even got us a taxi driver to the airport. Thanks again for that...:-)

Gorgeous, immaculate, and the location a few minutes walk from everything one might need:  transport, groceries, great restaurants,drug store, banks; and Peter was instantly responsive to any questions I had.  I’ll always be checking here first when I visit New York.  Just great.

Clays apartment was great and the building is very modern and stylish. Great Rooftop area. The apartment is a short walk to the metro (never felt unsafe travelling alone).Clay and his roommate were very friendly - great hosts and will recommend to others.

Stayed for 11 nights. We did not stayed much at home but never had a problem. Good room and nice bed. Bathroom always available. Clean towels received the first day and lots of space for clothes. Bathroom cleaning wasn't done often thoug. The only thing that we did not like much was the way back to home at night. Many people smoking on the street and made us felt unsafe a couple of times but I had no problems at the end. There were also a store with 24hours music that was a bit annoying as it was really close from our room but I guess you will be so tired that won't have any issues to get sleep. Overall I would recommend this place.
Michaels place was great! New York can be a scary place, but this accommodation felt very safe inside.

This is a very clean and cozy apartment.Worth to stay here. 2 minutes walk to subway station and you need a half and hour to get to Time Square. 50 minutes walk to Central Park entrance. At the first time this area location seems to be unsafe for me...
Nice place and well located. At first, the hood could seem a little bit scary at night, but the truth is that it's totally safe. Justin and Clover  are great hosts. I 100% recommend the appartment.

It was as described... We did not meet Kristy but Steeve... He is really easy going and cool! it is  a dorm with rooms which require a bit more cleaning, at least the one we stayed! Though the beds were clean... East Harlem can be a good spot to stay depending on personal preferences... I do not say it is dangerous or anything but you might not feel safe at some point...

Susan's place was not only very, very clean, but it was also very spacious. The check-in was super smooth and easy and the amenities were lovely. She was also very responsive whenever my boyfriend and I had any questions/ queries. The only thing was that- sometimes, at night, walking home was a bit stressful because of the lack of street lamps. But, as the AirBnB is only about 5 minutes away from the subway- it was absolutely okay in the end! Thank you so much Susan & Richard~

A lovely apartment in a cool location, where you can pretend that you live in New York. Perfect for a family stay. We travelled with our two teenage boys and the amount of space, comfort and independence we got compared to a hotel was brilliant. The basement room with a projector for Netflix was well used! And the outdoor terrace for reading. Local restaurants mean that you don't have to spend all your time in Manhattan. We walked to and from the subway many times day and night without incident so I wouldn't say it was a sketchy area as some have said. It is a real area where real people live. We loved it.

We loved our stay at Julian’s place. There were unexpected construction issues that required some flexibility from all involved, and Julian was very communicative and remained an incredibly hospitable host in what was I’m sure a stressful situation for he and his family right before the holidays.   The space was exactly as pictured and so cozy. A few family members from all over the country came out to celebrate an early holiday with our brother who lives in the neighborhood. We had a toddler with us and Julian was kind enough to provide a Christmas tree to decorate and children’s toys for our nephew to play with! We noticed the needles were damaged on the record players, and Julian went out of his way to order replacements during our stay.   We can’t recommend this location enough. So walkable and the neighborhood is incredibly charming. Highly recommend!!

This flat is not the same as in description and photos. This is scam apartment. 1. Dust is everywhere - we have allergic reaction and fills bad 2. water splashes from Conditioner upstairs flat. I can send you video. 3. Vibration and no sound isolation from the street. They don’t said about it before. We can’t sleep 4. There was no sofa as in photos.  5. Walls was without arts, but there was just wholes.  6. No shelf as in photos. 7. No mirror on walls.  8. There was no disposable shower accessories. Just used shower bottles. 9. Brocken fire alarm  Our experience was awful. We sleep only a little bit, we are tired now, sorry but it’s a hole for money that we pay.

There was a gas leak and the owners acted very blasé about it. The whole house smelled of gas leaking but when we informed the owner, she only said she was sorry this happened to us and didn’t seem really bothered or caring to ameliorate the situation.   I had to be the one who called ConEd and they were able to confirm the gas leak. But couldn’t even stay because the house smelled of fumes. Again, Tricia didn’t bother to treat this like an emergency.  I live in Harlem but my visiting family — with kids — had a very bad stay that put us all in danger.

Initially I was afraid of the location and if it was actually a real place and everything. But trust me, it is exceptional. Erica and her husband were simply awesome. There were really helpful with every little thing. The place is exactly what it looks like. You’ll have all the amenities Erica has mentioned. In fact she provides with  so much more supplies. Check in was easy as hell. Any doubt or help; text her and u’ll get the reply in 5. Definitely would recommend her place.

We had no real issues that warranted a conversation with the host so I’m sure they’re nice people as the reviews stated. What I did enjoy was the culture walking to and from this location. The people here are very different from what I’m use to but no one bothered my partner and I. It was a very nice experience.  Is it the safest area - absolutely not. But if you have a little guts you’ll be fine. We chose Harlem specifically. I should also add that there are a total of 3 doors and 3 keys to enter the place. A little bit annoying but the safety it provides makes it justified. There are stairs leading to the first door from the side walk and a set of steep wooden narrow stairs that lead to the door of the studio apartment, your luggage is going to give you the business. Lol. The brownstone is close to great little deli’s and grocery stores with beautiful produce. What I did appreciate was that there are reusable bags available - we found them after we bought some and there are umbrellas provided which was great because it rained 6 / 7 days there. There were ice trays to make ice and a few dishes to make a meal but none to store cooked food. There was salt and pepper provided but that needs to be replaced. There was also oil provided. The place has a washer and dryer.   Notes and Dislikes: If you’re not from up North or have never been to New York you need to know that things here are extremely compact. The place is quite small so be prepared for that. Being prepared for the city noise is what tons of reviews said on several places so that I looked forward to and welcomed as I wanted a true New York experience. What I was not prepared for was the thin walls inside of the brownstone. We could hear others phones vibrating. We could hear their full conversations and televisions. The neighbor upstairs seems to have walked 2 miles Monday morning alone above us. You also have a very thin door to enter the apartment which as a female made me feel less safe due to the things you see right outside the main entry but remember those other 2 doors to gain entry. You will not sleep well due to these things in my opinion. If you are traveling as a couple, your comfort level to be intimate while on vacation is voided here unless you’re into having an audience. We stayed a night in the city just to feel “alone” and to get a good nights rest. We also didn’t sleep well because the mattress needs to be replaced. The springs jabbed us, the sheets were fine but the other added linen was of a hard towel consistency which we couldn’t use. We did find two fleece blankets that we used as it was cold during our visit. The bed is up against a window with a deep window sill therefore your pillows are not stabilized against anything so you’re chasing them throughout the night. The other sitting choices are a low futon or desk chairs. So taller people need to know this as well (your knees will thank me later).   I have to mention the statues in the garden area right outside the window over the bed. They are advertised as art and they are really nightmare inducers. They are just plain scary looking and the shade/blind stayed closed the entire trip because I couldn’t stand to see them. If one had moved a centimeter I would have had to leave. Ijs. Art is in the eye of the beholder here.   Am I bashing the place? Not at all. I just wish these details were included in at least one of the reviews I read so a better, more informed choice could have been made. I leave reviews often and love being open and most importantly honest. I would never purposely leave a false or bad review for anyone or anything. I hope this helps.

this idiot wants to falsely accuse me of taking a plastic mattress cover.  Nobody wants a used mattress cover. Furthermore, what cheap piece of plastic cost $60? also, strangers, other Airbnb guests that are brand-spanking-new have the liberty of going in and out of your room once you check out because he's not there to check you out.    I don't say bad things about people but because this stupid idiot is trying to rob me I would stay far away from this place. Look at my other review.   nobody ever complains about me.  Please

We thought the stay was great! Terry is really great and helpful! Even offered to cook something for us! Totally lovely! Great room! The bed was simply heavenly! ✨ The subway connections to Manhattan were so easy! Number 3 goes straight there. The environment was ok. Everything was great! But on day 6.7 (our stay lasted 10 days) our apartment started to smell funny. First like grass and then musty. Which was strange because when we arrived it smelled super fresh for 6.7 days because there were scent plugs in the room. These smells came suddenly. Then we noticed that the smell was coming from next door. There is a door in the room that leads to another room, which was always locked (I strongly suspect that it was also an AirBnb). There was a very unpleasant smell at the door and the smell went straight into our apartment. We always had to have the windows open. All our clothes, even our bags smelled (smell) of this smell. I guess we just had bad luck with these AirBnb guests. If you leave this aspect out, we were extremely happy with our stay. 👍🏼 I can really recommend it. 😊

Sketchy neighborhood, but good value for the money, place has all the basics , 2 guys live there with a lot of issues but were nice to me, Robert was generous up until the end when he tried to squeeze extra money out of me but he was accommodating in general
Host was very generous and understanding, no stress, responds on time and clean environment. Will definitely stay here again

The place was good! As advertised. It had everything we needed and I still give it 5 stars. The only thing is there were some roaches. We had read in previous posts about this. When I told my friend who lives around the corner in the same great neighborhood about this, she was not surprised. She lives in a very nice family apartment and says she deals with the same issue and has tried everything through the years. All this to say, place is fine. If a few roaches scare you, you might think about another apartment, or city for that matter. Overall, a good stay!

Superb spacious and comfortable apartment. Very well located, 10-15 minutes from several subway stations allowing you to be in Manhattan in 30 minutes and even go see a Yankees game. Grocery store nearby for shopping.  Ana is charming and available to provide information or help. Thanks to her for the helping hand when our flight was canceled.

This cozy room has everything one needs while in the city. I stayed for a month while on a school rotation and was very pleased with Lillian’s excellent communication (she even forewarned me when the super had to stop by one day while I was at work, just to let me know) and how clean the apartment is kept. The bathroom was always immaculate and even when most places in the city have some creepy crawlers, Lillian and family make a point to take out the trash and managed to keep bugs at bay.  The location is great, managed to explore Harlem Heights and is easily accessible to the subway.

I loved staying with Lilian, from the first moment she made me feel at home, the room is very cozy, you have a place for yourself in every room, the location is very good, nothing dangerous and the best of all is that the subway is 5 steps away, with the best routes to go throughout New York. It has a grocery store next to the building open 24 hours a day, you can buy anything and the prices are very affordable.
