I loved staying here, next time I come to New York I would definitely come back here :)

Lillian is the best host I have ever met. This has been head to toe the most comfortable Airbnb experience ever. Recommend everyone who comes to NYC to stay at her place.  She is so helpful and always responsive, made me fell right at home. Her place is extremely tidy and clean, everything smells super nice.  The bathroom, the sheets, the bed is amazingly cozy that you can fall asleep and never wanna get out of it!! And super close to subway station, 15 mins away to all the famous spots in NYC.   I have had Lillian’s permission to share and warn everyone of the taxi scam at the airport that happened to me.  DO NOT trust anyone that claims to work for the airport and lead you to some “airport taxi” pick up spot.   Always use Uber/Lyft/Public transportation.  He told me to wait for car driver that says No.5, then I got on, there was a girl in the car. Claimed to be tourist doing carpooling. Later he threatened me and charged $410 for a 10mins drive. Don’t worry I m physically unharmed

Thanks for letting me stay in the best place in Manhattan! Everything is so perfect and I could fully enjoy my stay and could get relax. Not only the room itself but also the shower room and kitchen are very clean and well organized. The subway station is much nearer from the apartment than I expected, I felt never dangerous even when I came back to the apartment around 11 pm. Pharmacy and supermarket next to the apartment are also nice. Lillian always asked me what she can do for me and is super kind. I’m pretty sure that she is the best host in NYC. I hope to be able to come back soon and stay there again. Thanks a lot!

I stayed at Amanda's while in Brooklyn for a few days to look for an apartment. I was so happy it was available and it proved to be the best place to retreat to in between showings and to escape the stress of the NYC housing market. I worked remotely with no issues with WIFI, noise, etc... In my zoom meetings everyone was asking where I was and asked for the rec for the next time they are in the area. She was very responsive and kindly accommodated my last minute request on a Saturday for a Sunday check in. It felt brand new- the bed and sheets were so comfortable, the kitchen had everything I needed to be able to cook, the bathroom heated floors were a luxury, not to mention all of the little touches that made it feel like home. This place may be my fav AirBnB ever.   My only regret is that I couldn't move in permanently but luckily found an apartment nearby. I will be putting my friends and family up at Amanda's when they come to visit- assuming it is available... it is a hot hot find. Thank you, Amanda!
Nice once you enter the apartment. Shower area could use some remodeling. Hallway is a bit sketchy but Min offers a great service and is very attentive

Overall we enjoyed our stay but will more than likely not return due to the location.   Pros - Apartment was spacious and very clean. It had all of the amenities that you could need.  - Bed was very comfortable - Apartment was not difficult to navigate to - Min allowed us to check-in early and check-out late which fit our flight schedule better  Cons - Location isn’t ideal - it’s very dirty outside of the apartment and there really isn’t anywhere to eat or drink that is less than a 10 minute walk. The subway stop is quite a trek and not as close as the listing makes it seem.  - The check-in and check-out process involved picking up and dropping off keys about a 12-15 minute walk from the apartment which was difficult with luggage and after a long day of traveling.  - Communication was difficult with Min. I didn’t get the check-in instructions until late the evening before our stay. She did message to check on us throughout our stay but then was kind of unresponsive when asked about the check-out process. It just made things stressful.  - The listing is for a different address which was confusing and made me nervous at first (although it was the apartment pictured on the listing)

My family of 5 stayed for a few days for my mom's burial that was taking place in Harlem. I am a native New Yorker so the location was great and the price was also great. We also stayed here during the covid pandemic by which I was concerned but Matthew reassured me it would be cleaned with new covid guidelines and it definitely was. The only suggestion I'd make is to add a basket of some sort to dump the dirty towels in. All my questions and concerns were handled timely and professionally. Thank you for making my trip as stress free as possible as I was already dealing with alot!

Wonderful stay. The place is just as described. My only recommendation: If female traveling alone best to try to arrive in daylight. It's a safe neighborhood, and lights will automatically turn on as you walk down the path to the door, but it can be a bit scary if you’re walking by yourself.

Lali and Rob’s place is great for a short or long term stay. I highly recommend! We stayed over a week, and had everything we could have wanted in this clean, modern  space. Lali and Rob were very responsive and easy to communicate with. The location is great for commuting to the city or exploring Brooklyn. The nearby park was a perfect retreat morning and evening for us and our pup.

Lali's place is a perfect location to explore nyc/brooklyn. It is near many subway stations that can take you to both manhattan and to other areas of Brooklyn. Lali is very responsive and accommodating--we were able to leave our luggage before/after check-in/out so that we can make most of our time while visiting. Both Lali and Rob were very understanding and acted fast when we misplaced our keys (and didn't find out until very late at night). I would highly recommend booking this place!

Great location, great hosts. Clean and as listed. Lalli and Rob are really responsive and there to help if need be. Could use a few more pieces of silverware, but the hosts generously provide hi end snacks and non Alcohol drinks. We’ll be back!
Really nice and clean apartment, only a short walk from Fort Greene, Clinton Hill and Prospect Park. Lali and Rob were great and friendly hosts, would recommend!
The hostess is very friendly. In the apartment you can feel free and relaxed. The environment is interesting and not at all dangerous. You can come into contact with people on the street.
Everything was very comfortable and clean, there are two metro lines nearby, you don't feel unsafe.

The place was spacious and we shared a living room space with other traveling guests. Fridge and kitchen access, you can cook your meals.   The only thing we’d like to heads up is that the area - Bronx - might be dangerous for some races. Notorious it was for criminal scene and now it is less, but Saw people picking fights in the subway, etc., We tried to make sure that we get the house early at nights.

I really enjoyed my stay on Van Buren and I slept really well for the whole time I was there. It's very safe, cozy and feels like a home away from home. It's a lovely place with loads of light coming into the space during the day.   The location is the number one selling point of this spot, a hop, skip and a jump into Manhattan - no stress at all on the J train Subway.   I especially liked all the artwork around the place.  Great showering and bathroom facilities.  Enough kitchen appliances to make/ prepare food.   Would certainly stay again!  Thanks Meow & co :D  Keep fighting the good fight

The studio was clean and comfortable! Included everything you needed to enjoy your stay, plus things you would not of even thought about! *take a couple Pennie’s from the coin jar with you when you go to some of the bigger museums so you can use the crank machine penny presses* The location was great and the balcony was awesome! Lot of cool bars and cafes around. Check out WonderVille for some fun and free arcade games and a beer or two. And the best part is, all of this comes second to our amazing host! They really saved the day and did everything possible to make our stay as stress free as can be. I made some mistakes while booking our flights and accommodation and ended up landing in NYC the day before our scheduled check in date. I’ve been super busy these past few months so I didn’t realize it until we were already in the city! We then got in contact with the host and they were able to arrange a last minute stay at another room on the property! And then during check out, our flights were pushed back to 8pm, luckily we were able to store our bags in a storage so we didn’t have to lug them around the city the entire day! I would 100% recommend stay here just off the host alone, everything use is just a welcomed extra!

A nice spacious room especially for ny! Jessica and Matthew are very nice and accommodating. Responded very well to issues that came up. Conveniently located next to G train and Pratt institute; however next to Brooklyn housing projects so area can be a bit sketchy at times. The room was clean but could get noisy at night, although earplugs were provided, if you’re sensitive to noise it’s not the best. Overall would recommend, a lot of open space for a ny apartment!

AMAZING place to stay! It’s quiet, it’s three streets from the subway and everything is around you. Plus, if you look on the crime map you will see there is little to none in that area of Brooklyn. He has everything you need right in the apartment. Dishes, silverware, pots and pans, towels, ect. The bed is super comfy and the shower is huge. I stayed about three weeks and Boris would check on me from time to time to make sure I was doing ok. The neighbors are so quiet and the building is nice and warm. The place is much bigger than it looks and it feels like a home. I will probably never stay anywhere but here from now on when I visit NYC.

I come came from England and my internet stopped working at the time I was arriving at the place, therefore I didn't have the codes to enter the property. I rang the door bell and Lakisha was speaking to me through a broken interphone.   I say broken bcause I couldn't hear and she could not hear me.   I kept on trying to tell her that I couldn't understand and I needed to use the loo urgently.   The only thing she seemed concern about was to let me know she wanted me to bring her package which outside the property!   I was tired , as I had walked a lot to fund the place with our my gosh working and needed urgently to go to the loo and get settle....   I had to get a US sim card to try to speak to her.   When I finally got into the property it was absolutely   Pitched dark, dangerous to walk up the stairs and to find the room, I need a tourch...  I was scared as the whole thing didn't seem right.   You would think that if a guest is arriving it would be bright enough to ensure safety,

the room is ideally located less than 5 minutes from a metro and approximately 30 minutes from Time Square by taking this one. safe, non-dangerous neighborhood. Ilias was very responsive to messages, dedicated person. Note the impeccable cleanliness of the premises and a certain calm in the street day and night.  THANKS :)

The host has recently redone the upstairs apartment in here building. The apartment itself is cozy and very nice. However, the common areas of the apartment are not clean and are in need of update. While I was staying in the apartment, there was a plumbing issue and the way this issue was handled made my overall stay pretty stressful and unenjoyable. I also felt the checkout was not handled in the most accommodating nor friendly of manners. Concerning the location of the apartment, it is great and the area has a lot to do.

I had a great stay at Giac's place. From the ease of late-night check-in using the lockbox, to accommodating my luggage storage for my evening flight. Giac was responsive and communicative, resulting in a stress-free trip.  The locations cannot be beat -- walking distance to Katz's Deli and walkable across the bridge to Williamsburg under an hour on a balmy night. The neighbors could be a bit loud on weekend nights, but otherwise the location is fairly quiet.  Would love to stay here again for my future trips.
Location? Amazing. Host? Kind and welcoming. Room? Stylish & cozy. Bed? Comfy.  All in all, an amazing (and comfy… cannot stress how good that bed was) experience. Highly recommended

This place was a great price and a great location, very close to the subway and many great restaurants. The host let us check in early, which was greatly appreciated. However, on the first night, another person was given the access code to the lock on our door and came in the room. The host reached out to apologize, but knowing someone else had the code to our room (and there being no additional locks on the room besides the coded one) made me feel unsafe for the rest of the trip.

Unit itself was amazing to stay in. Very well stocked with supplies and nicely decorated. We just had one problem with the location as it made us feel a bit unsafe being just 2 girls staying in the apartment. Be aware. Otherwise Fabricio is a great host

Excellent location and super kind hosts. The apartment was clean, safe and very close to the metro. I never felt unsafe and came back late at night via metro. The neighborhood has great restaurants as well. Definitely recommend staying here!

Great experience with Jon. So accomodating, friendly and had great local info. Ease of communication and check in were incredible and greatly helped my trip since it was a tightly scheduled, high stress business trip. I will definitely return when I train in Brooklyn again.

This unit has a great location and was central to so many great sights.  The unit itself had beautiful water pressure and was comfortable. The space has wonderful natural light from the large windows. It is not the same unit as shown in the photos.  I imagine they have photographed one space and because the architecture is the same they use it for all the corner spaces.  The unit that I was in, 223- has no beautiful crown molding above the windows.  The ceiling is in need of cleaning and repainting, there are dirty cobwebs hanging down from the lights and water marks from leaking floors above.  To get to the unit I was in you take an elevator but then you must manage to get your luggage up a half set of steep steps while trying not to smack your head on the low ceiling.  I smacked my head.  During my week I ran into a naked man in the hallway, I believe the building offers rooms that share a bathroom which were in the hallway.  The smell in the hallway was terrible during my entire stay. In summary,  the building location, lighting and comfort of this unit are excellent.  The unit is not the one shown in the photographs and is missing some key items of beauty such as the detailed molding.  Gaining access to the unit I stayed in was difficult and unpleasant. Unit 223 needs a good cleaning specific to the ceiling and  windows.

Really nice host! I lost my voice and she made me tea, which was super sweet of her. The location was a bit sketchy especially since I’m a female that clearly doesn’t live in the neighborhood. But, it’s a 10min walk to the station and another 25min to the city which was nice. Clean room, towels provided, and couldn’t ask for more. Thanks so much!!

the communication was great very. Quick response time.  The  check in was very easy read the instructions when sent.     Now the inside was to be desired.  mattresses were the worst.  the futon doesn't fit an adult.  the dirty fan was so full of dust we were afraid to turn it on for fear of the rain of dust on us   the beds were dirty and we itched for days for some reason.  not sure if the sheets were changed prior to our stay   it is just over priced for what it turned out to be.  if it wasn't this expensive I would have been ok with staying in what I would call a motel 6 room with less features.    it is easy access to great city activities.  our view was the corner of Broadway.  easy to walk to Empire State and the other mid town attractions.    We liked our NYC experience but wouldn't stay here next time, reason being to explore other areas of the city .

Overall the place was ok to stay in short term. However I had several issues mainly related not with the host or the place but the roommates. Even though everything was nice in person, they weren’t clean and it was my main concern. Cookware was old in the beginning however the host changed it to the new ones as per request. The place is decent if you don’t have high living standards, loved the location it is so close to the 7 train and you get to be in Midtown Manhattan within 25 minutes. The neighborhood was so nice so many places to eat and have fun. It was also very cold for me sometimes and the host was very kind to send additional heater that I used. Thanks! Only 1 incident occurred and my package got stolen but the host was very kind to support me and refunded the value of stolen package. I think with minor improvements to the place it can be better. Nevertheless the price for the place is still too high as it doesn’t have laundry in unit , and it’s an ok place.

The host is so quick with responses and so communicative which made the check in process so much easier. The place was so cozy, private and clean with modern and thoughtful touches. I really liked the coziness aspect of the room but the room was located in the basement and it was a bit creepy going in there. There wasn’t clear descriptions that the room is in the basement so it was a surprise but overall, it was a wonderful stay.

It is a nice place to stay for 1 or 2 days. It was a weird situation, I came to the room and someone was there. Which was tremendously scary. I told the host and the person left the room. Then this same person stayed to sleep at the living room; which was weird.

So I book 2 nights and only stayed 1 because it was worst than advertised. Am all about a good review but to be honest this was my worst accommodation ever. A washing machine beside the bed, the bed so noisy I am afraid to move on it. A broken shower handle which make it so hard to control the temperature I almost burn up myself taking a bath.
After a shady situation with another host went down, Amer accommodated me on short notice and made my stay as good as I can ask.

We had a bad experience at Uchena's apartment.  The place is nice, clean, big and comfortable, as seen in the photos, but the building is unsafe. We witnessed in two occasions people braking in to the building.  In the firs occasion we witnessed people from outside the building circulating in it, leaving doors open and going to the roof top. When the door to the rooftop was locked, we saw people trying to brake in, braking windows. It is important to say, that these people never got INTO the apartment, but as we heard noises, and saw all throw the door, it was completely stressful for us.   We had to leave the apartment early because we felt really unsafe.  Ucheena always responded quickly and kindly (He was never there because he was traveling), but we do not recommend this accommodation, if you want to have a relaxed and safe stay. We hope the problem could be fixed soon,because then the apartment could be a great place to stay.  We are very sorry to leave this comment, but we feel is important to warn the Airbnb community.  And really look forward to see this problem solved soon for the community to enjoy the stay.

An apartement with  “big city athmosphere” equipped with everything one can need -and some more- and you get full access to it all.  Uchenna puts trust to the Airbnb community. Everything worked very well and that  without any notes with instructions. All very clean which off course also makes demands on you. Easy 24 h check in procedure, comfortable bed and high speed internet and the nearness to the subway is on the positive side.    On the negative side is the location which we experienced a bit scary when the dark came. A narrow stair with 52 steps can be good for your health if you make it. Uchenna, whom we never met because he was on work,  was easy to communicate with via mail. We can absolutely recommend this apartment for others visiting NYC.  Thanks Uchenna Mikael and Carina

I absolutely love it here and hope to return again someday. Having an emergency trip can always be stressful so I knew that myself having to come to the city last minute I wanted a cozy place in my favorite neighborhood of Astoria. Rafaella is completely hospitable and responsive is timely and thoughtful. I loved the cleanliness of the space, the decor, and the porch area. It’s completely unique. I truly would love to make this place my go to air bnb. It’s so very perfect and welcoming. Loved every minute of my time there.
Raffaella’s place is super clean and comfortable and definitely a steal! We would highly recommend!

I really enjoyed the night that I spent here. It's very cute, clean and cozy! I got an air bnb to take two parts of a virtual CPC exam and I'm glad I did. There was peace and quiet, which made it that much easier to focus on my test, stress free. If anyone is looking for a cozy place to stay, I highly recommend this one!

AMAZING, SPECTACULAR SANCTUARY!!!. This place is the heart of New York that I highly recommend. First the area is a clean, safe neighborhood. There is a parking spot available for guest and the building is perfectly located near middle grounds of Brooklyn. Nearby Manhattan, just take the expressway. The area perfectly has everything to cater to your needs with restaurants, bodegas/grocery stores, rite aid, and subway. The Penthouse is located on the top 12th floor which elevators and friendly doorman that is more than happy to welcome you to the building and assist you with accommodated luggage. When you walk in, the apartment is spotless clean, bright and modern look. Marble floors and full kitchen. Bedroom is big enough and bathroom is perfect. The living room and roof top is setup for relaxation and romantic settings. I was here for a night and felt so relieved, stress free and zoned out. This place just gives you peace and tranquility. The tenants nearby are respectful and quiet. The rooftop is great for hosting dinner or meditation in the mornings. The sunset views are spectacular just like the night view is Amazing...Its like a fairy tale. I had time to do some work and the apartment was properly equipped with technology needs that help complete your work. Honestly there is nothing I can say other than I highly recommend this place and will definitely be back to book.

Andrews place is quite roomy, bright, comfortable and clean.  He has stocked the studio with coffee, teas, hot chocolate, water and snacks and also has a well stocked bathroom closet  if you need anything last minute....even a long soak in the bathtub!  It is close to subway and many resources, restaurants, Whole Foods, shopping, drug stores.  Parking was easy....within a block of studio either way.  Take a trip to Harlem and enjoy this special place and host.  You won't be sorry.

The large studio in Harlem was exactly that...large, bright and comfortable.  The location was great....a quick walk to subway, shopping, restaurants, drug stores...anything we might need.  We had a car and parking was fairly easy...always managed to park within a block of studio.  Andrew was so accommodating....he allowed us to check in early and provided so much information from the time we booked until the day we left.  He provided us with umbrellas to get through the few days of rain during our stay.  Offered plenty of choices for beverages; coffee, teas, hot chocolate, water and energy bars as well., Also a well stocked bathroom cabinet.  He really thought of everything.  My grandaughter and I were so comfortable and felt safe there.  Great location, easy subway ride to Broadway shows, downtown and midtown.  We stayed at studio upon arrival to NYC, then visited relatives upstate and returned for our last few days in city before flying out.   Great experience ....would do it again.

I stayed at Nick and Violet’s home for almost 6 weeks. There were plenty of things to love, but also areas that fell short.  Starting with the pros: very clean, safe, and walkable to the most amazing parts of Brooklyn; Though it’s along a busy street above a highway, the location cannot be beat. Some of the best food we have ever had is within a few min walk and the neighborhood is adorable; Dishwasher and fridge were great and the place is cute/makes good use of the small space; we were allowed to bring our dog; there was a plumbing issue at one point and they got someone in to fix it within a few hours.   Now for the cons: no A/C in the bedroom; the kitchen had many aspects that were unusable- guests are not allowed to use the oven. We were allowed to use the stove but the room filled with smoke quickly and would set off the alarm, I’m not sure if it was from the old pots and pans or if the space needs to be better ventilated. This made cooking  full meals very hard; The window in the bedroom has no curtain or shade, so the nyc street lights pour in at night; The bed linens weren’t luxurious looking like the pic and there was only one towel. We were happy that we brought our own linens; Parking is not on premises and was very difficult to find street parking on weekdays.

Phil was a flexible host and worked with our early arrival with no stress! The apartment was exactly as pictured, and was comfortable for two couples. The location was not our favorite, but it is close to A,C,3 lines so easy to connect to the rest of the city. Thanks!

Our stay at Andrew's place was an amazing experience! The location is great: lively but not loud, exciting but not dangerous and nice and close to the subway. The room and bathroom look exactly like you'd expect looking at the pictures provided here; the bathroom is cleaned on a daily basis. The bed was really comfortable as well. While we were there we could always count on Andrew for practical information, tips and trics. He's very kind, helpful and responsive. The perfect place to stay in upper Manhattan!
Our  stay was nice any questions or concerns were addressed and met. Street parking stressful at times but not the host fault or course, nice stay for short stay trips.

William was an amazing host. The time of response was short and he was very kind and opened for any suggestions we might had. The apartment was as I expected. The bathroom and the common area were the best parts of the apartment. The house looks a little bit creepy at the beginning but you get used to it fast. Good value for the money.  The apartment is also very well connected to Manhattan and the subway is 15 mins away. There are many small grocery stores near the house.

William was really helpful. He always answered our questions in e timely manner. Check-in was easy. The house is very, and I mean very old. It feels like in a scary movie. But that wasn’t the problem. The big problem was that the house was dirty! The lobby is full of old dirty furniture and everything is full of dust! No cleaning is done whatsoever! The room was better but still.. the bed sheets were not ironed and there were long hairs on the pillows. I am not sure they were perfectly clean. In the bathroom we found dead flies on the bathroom tiles. The whole room had that dirty, dusty smell, we had to sleep with the windows open. That obviously caused us to hear all the noise from the street. The house is just couple of blocks away from the subway. There are couple of places to eat in the neighborhood but we didn’t try any of them since they didn’t look trustworthy. The place could be a nice gem if they would give it a big makeover and a lot of cleaning.

Janes place checks all of our needs for a comfortable, CLEAN, convenient,  & stylish space. The bed is super comfortable, the street was quiet and safe at night. We read over Jane's restaurant reviews and choose an Italian restaurant a few doors down and had a phenomenal meal. Check-in and communication was prompt and clear. It was a total steal for the price. I have been hosting professionally for 7 years and consider myself pretty picky when it comes to Airbnb's and I hands down will rebook here when we return.

Christine has great communication skills, and  very outgoing. Christine made it priority to make sure that our stay was comfortable. Christine made sure that she was available at any time, if we needed her. Christine definitely deserves all five stars. If it was possible I would give Christine six stars. With all the stress and anxiety from everything going on in this world, Christine made it hard to remember. Thanks to Christine my vacation was everything I hoped for.

Valentine's place is comfortable, well kept, and most importantly extremely well located for getting around the city. Myrtle Ave station and other amenities are just two minutes away but not so close that the immediate area feels sketchy or overly noisy - ideal. Valentine is a thoroughly lovely dude, very welcoming and helpful with the comings and goings of a short stay in NYC. A pleasure!

Decent place to stay for a true NYC experience!  We were a little worried about staying here because there were no ratings or reviews, but we were pleasantly surprised with our experience and would consider renting this space again should we find ourselves back in NYC.  Overall, despite some hiccups described below, everything about our experience met our expectations.  We enjoyed staying here and pretending it was our little apartment in the Big Apple.  A more accurate description of the location is on Lexington Avenue between 27th and 28th Street.  The apartment is on the third floor of a multi-unit building and you must walk up a narrow stairway to get there.  Although the building itself is dated and grungy, once in the apartment you are met with a number of updated features and amenities.  Most everything appeared to be recently updated or new.  TV, sectional couch, furniture, linens, cookware and dishes, etc. were all new and in great condition, and you can see that in the pictures in the listing which accurately show this apartment.  Bed was comfortable and our two kids slept fine on the pull-out sofa.  Description of amenities was mostly accurate except that there is no stove, only a hotplate.  There were pots/pans to use with the hotplate so you should still be able to cook some limited meals if you need or want to.  This was not an issue for us though as there are so many great restaurants in NYC that we didn't plan on cooking in the apartment.  There are many great Indian restaurants just steps from the apartment.  Unfortunately, at the time we were there, the 28th Street subway station was closed for repairs which meant we had to walk to the 23rd or 33rd Street stations.  Even with this slight inconvenience and added walk this apartment is in a decent, centralized location.  You can see the Chrysler Building as soon as you step out on the sidewalk.  The Flatiron Building and Madison Square Park are just a few blocks away.  Even the Empire State Building is within walking distance.  Our host was accessible and quick to respond to any questions or requests we had.  Several days into our stay, and through no fault of the host, we woke up to the radiator for the heat leaking on the floor.  The host quickly assessed the situation and was willing to work around our schedule to resolve the issue.  This unforeseen circumstance was handled in a timely and very professional manner, but more importantly, in a way that did not interfere with our stay or add any stress to our vacation.  Overall, we had a great experience and I would consider renting this apartment again.

I do not recommend this place especially if you are traveling with kids.  I have booked Airbnb's before specifically because traveling with a 2 year old it is easier to have a kitchen, bathtub and room in NYC. But this experience was awful .  First off, after booking and paying all up front (risk you take with no refund policy- just hoping people are good), we never received the address for the location of the apartment til we had landed in NYC. This was difficult because I needed to book a car service for us to take us there with a car seat.  Once we arrived (after being passed off to two different "friends" to try and check us in and meet us, we waited in the cold, rain at night for 10 minutes on the street.  You then walk into the trash room upon entering the building and then climbing 3 flights of stairs that look like they are about to come crashing down to enter into the apartment. The apartment is as pictured, but what was not pictured is there was no heat turned on and the windows were broken open in January.  It felt chilly but it was late when we arrived on Saturday.  Sunday, we tried to close the windows to make it better, but then discovered that evening that the  radiator (one for the whole place as it is actually a studio with a wall that they put up to make it a "one" bedroom) - wasn't working. I also discovered that the bathtub did not hold water and so was of no use to us to be able to give our daughter a bath.  I got a response late morning that she would have the superintendent stop by to take a look at the radiator.  When he arrived...he discovered that the radiator was broken. (one of the previous reviews had mentioned this but I figured it would have been fixed by now).  There was a rug covering up water damage from what looked like a leaky radiator.  We were trying to get our kid down for a nap while they were doing this work on the place and I had to make the call as it was 11 degrees outside to move us to a hotel that night.  Christine obviously does not live in NYC.  Not quite sure the arrangement of this apartment or who has leasing rights of it, but it also seems to be a fire hazard as there are only 3 outlets in the apartment in which everything is strung together and plugged into.  If you are thinkng of charging anything, you might want to bring your own power strip to do so, not to mention it seems incredibly dangerous.  The location is great but the building and the conditions of this apartment are not worth it.  To not have a radiator turned on in January in NYC is unacceptable to me, not to mention all the other small things that added up to one of my worst experiences staying in NYC.  Having lived there previously, I understand the conditions of most of these places, but this, they are clearly trying to stretch the abilities of the apartment to charge you more for what is a studio.  If you were to stay there in the summer, your interior bedroom would not have access to any air conditioning units.  I do not recommend this place, especially for families.

This place was far below my expectation. The bathroom tile was broken and there was some cleanliness issues in the bathroom and kitchen. The most unpleasant surprise was how old and sketchy the building was. On the bright side, the host (not Christine, but a "co-host" named Jay) was responsive and tried to help. The location is good too. We paid the full price for 3 nights, but honestly didn't think it was worth the money.

My stay for a week was excellent. great location- for just about everything in the theater and Lincoln center districts.  the place itself is immaculate and tastefully done. everything you need to make your week comfortable and stress free. I was surprised at how quiet it was considering Hell's Kitchen location. I would recommend.

Save yourself a major headache. Go to the hotel three hundred feet to the east. You'll pay the same amount and have a place that feels like home. This unit (and I suspect all of their units are the same) is nasty, and the host is not helpful. A few highlights: Jack hammering from the street, mold around the tub, lightbulbs missing, curtains falling down. Eeks. Pass on this place. You'll be glad you did.

The location is good-close to 42nd street and Madison Square Garden, Macy’s, etc.  lots of food vendors and souvenir shops.  The actual building was strange. I’m not sure if it was a hotel or apartment or hostel. Lots of traffic coming and going and didn’t feel as safe as I should-security wasn’t paying attention to who was coming or going, there were a lot of younger people trying to get people to attend a party in their room and one person in the elevator indicated he had a gun. This is not the hosts fault, but again, the building had a lot going on and I don’t think it was very safe.   The beds and pillows were surprisingly very comfortable.   The bathroom tub leaked.  The room did exactly what we needed it to do but I would not book at this location again just because it was  sketchy.

The place was "seemingly" clean. The mini kitchen is convenient and plates and utensils came in handy.  There were used soap bars on the floor and in the shower, which was a bit off putting.   24 HOUR convenience store called Bread and Butter is a 3 minute walk from the building- SO HELPFUL!  Huge downside-- there is construction directly across the street that starts around 4am and the windows are paper thin. Walls are also paper thin and conversations in the hall and adjacent apartments are loud and clear.  The area is a tad sketchy and transients tend to hang around the entrance at all hours of the night. No one hassled us during our stay though and check in was quick and easy.   They let us stay past our check out time which was kind of them. Thanks for hosting us!

Fatal... The building from the moment you enter until you get to your room there is a very strong smell (stench) of marijuana ALL DAY AND every day we stayed (which was 5 days). We were 3 people and they only gave us 2 towels and 1 roll of toilet paper. The kitchen utensils were dirty with food stuck on them. The host never explained to us how to get to the room, he just gave us the key and that was it. He never explained to us how to control the “heater” of the room so as not to feel the room extremely hot. Every day the people in the other rooms next door were fighting, kicking down doors and screaming. Next to the building there is an extremely noisy construction that very early in the morning you couldn't sleep. My stay was totally unpleasant. I will never go back to StudioPlus again. And it is definitely not suitable for carrying children.

The room was exactly how it was in the picture but the building looked unsafe. The area wasn’t the greatest people hanging out at 2am drinking smoking and music. The second night there someone knocked on the door and nobody answered when I asked who was there and I felt very unsafe because the peephole doesn’t show who is on the other side of the wall and it’s not safe. Building looks like a shelter/hostel. I would not recommend a stay here . The only good thing I can take away from the Airbnb was the area , walking 5 minutes away and K town is there with some great restaurants and good vibes .

The room was ok. The air conditioner worked well. The room was decently clean. The bed wasn’t comfortable. There were only tiny packets of bar soap in the bathroom so you’ll need everything else. The building itself wasn’t nice. I’ve stayed in several different places in Manhattan and I’ll tell you that this building had me feeling a little unsafe. The hallways smelled bad. I ended up checking out early because I just wanted to get out of there.
Spacious apartment, regular equipment, excellent connectivity and location in a Korean neighborhood, a lot of noise and alcohol and drug consumption in the neighborhood.
I can say enough about the Host and Co-host very welcoming made sure all my needs were met. I can't stress enough how clean their home is spotless .

This air bnb is a steal! Right on 125th st in Harlem about a 10 minute drive from the metro north station, Ruth's apartment was clean, stylish, and more than accommodating for me and my group of friends. She gave us a nice tour upon our arrival, was very timely in response to messages, and lenient in our arrival and departure time. The apartment is decorated BEAUTIFULLY and actually looks nicer in person. We had everything we needed for our stay there. She was a wonderful host. I would definitely book again.

Me and my friend had a great stay at Ric's place! It's plenty of space with 2 bedrooms and the location is really great. It's less than a block away from the subway and never felt unsafe in that area. A lot of cool spots nearby are walkable and even Williamsburg is walkable or easy to access by subway. Manhattan is just a few subway stops away too! The heat worked great and the common area was nice too =) Would definitely recommend Ric's place and come back!

We booked Tfeila’s place for our son’s moving to Columbia University. We had visited NY so many times but always stayed in the touristic places ( first time in the area and it won’t be our last) The apartment is perfectly located in a very safe area surrounded for great places to eat ( we tried all Tfeila’s recommendations with great success) Since we have our car filled with our son’s moving stuff, we decided to park in the public garage (right on the corner) just because it was really hot and we arrived a few days before moving day. It was a personal choice to protect the things from the heat not because it wasn’t safe or we couldn’t find space on the street. The apartment was perfect for us. It had everything we needed it and more and, the pictures don’t justify how cute and spacious it was for our family of 4 Tfeila is a great host (Airbnb should appointed her Superhost by now) her communication skills were great. She kept in touch with us making our stay an easy process, although we didn’t have any problem but it was so nice to feel at home since we already had the stress and sadness of moving our son. Tfeila’s welcomed us with delicious treats that we kept buying from Levain’s place until the day we departed :) We definitely will rent Tfeila’s unit every time when we visit our son (if it’s available of course) Thanks for a wonderful stay! We highly recommend it.

The space is equivalent to the pictures that are posted. Everything is nice and clean and the neighborhood is quiet. Rena sent me an email with instructions for check in so that process was quick and stress free. I was also pleased with how quickly she responds to messages. Parking was a bit difficult to find but I also visited during Labor Day weekend. I’m thinking that may have impacted parking. I was parked in a bad place and Rena saw and messaged me. I liked that she looked out cause I could have gotten a ticket if the car stayed there.  Overall a pleasant stay considering how apprehensive I was to be staying in someone’s home. I definitely recommend the space.

Very nice host very clear and reliable just a lot of rules on a little index note pad in the room on the night stand also my guest suspects his money was stolen from his wallet due to his bag being adjusted differently and his wallet being cleared out and relocated when we stepped out .

This place was one of my best Airbnb experiences.  This place was worth every penny.   The decor was traditional and made me feel at home.  The beds have quality matresses where I got a good rest before work.   EVERYTHING I needed was in the home (pots, pans, towels, internet, etc). The host responded in a very timely fashion.  Parking was simple.  The backyard is nicely done.  The space and location was convenient to eateries, the parks, public transportation, and the expressway.   I never felt unsafe or disturbed by the family upstairs.  Very good visit and work experience.

In Short, AVOID this nasty, smelly, dangerous situation at all costs!  One positive thing is that I was granted early check-in.   *But I was extremely disgusted. Listing states that there are dogs, but there’s no mention of three full-sized dogs with VERY bad odor. I held my breath and my allergies were triggered by this. The whole place reeked...such as the walls, floors,  and covers. The linens and the whole place need a deep cleaning. Covers smell badly and dog hair was everywhere.   The loud barking also woke us up during a daytime nap. They kept the smelly and barking dogs right outside our door. That’s selfish and inconsiderate.   *Secondly, the room did not have a bed frame as listed. I had to remind the host of this more than once. I’m not an, ‘as is’ person and expect to get what I paid for. Also, there were too much personal and sentimental items in the room they were renting. I shouldn’t be reminded of that or have limited space to place my belongings. He finally offered a ‘bedroom upstairs’ which had no door and an even stronger odor. I declined to keep the room downstairs to have a little barrier between the scent as best as possible.       Thirdly, communication was also slow and nonexistent after check in, and the WiFi password didn’t work.     *Lastly, the area is extremely dangerous. The streets were blocked off by cops, and I heard gun fire all night! Not at all used to that.   I’m far from a filthy person and definitely did not appreciate this nasty situation! No one should be invited into a space like this. Leave ASAP even if you have a busy schedule with all day tours. You deserve more. This was THE WORST Airbnb experiences and I travel ALL over, A LOT and am usually pleased.  For your safety and comfort, keep looking!  Protect yourself.

The host does not respect boundaries. He pushed me multiple times to leave early and texted my personal number to ask me to checkout two days earlier than what I had booked. I was uncomfortable staying there longer and did end up checking out early. He promised to reimburse but did not. When I opened a resolution center ticket to request the money (which, I now know, is how you're supposed to exchange money through Airbnb and not by promising cash/venmo as Andrew did), Andrew made up a claim that I scratched his table. He admitted that he did not know who caused it but that I as the most recent tenant had to pay. He pushed me to not use the official resolution center but it's there to protect both of us.   As a woman traveling alone, he made me incredibly uncomfortable.  It's shady that he repeatedly pressured me to not use the official app. This has been my worst airbnb experience but I am glad that when I used the resolution center, they sided with me. He sent me one last bullying message after they sided with me.  If you still want to take your chances with this host, the apartment is not totally accurate. The monitor is not there for a workstation set up. The fridge in the kitchen is a mini-fridge which doesn't even fit a pizza box. The only way to heat up leftovers is the oven. He is correct by saying the location is quite loud. I would recommend taking pictures of every little piece of furniture so that he cannot frivolously blame you for anything.

I came home late, and could not find a parking spot near the location. Since the listing mentioned free street parking and the driveway was completely empty, I made the decision of parking in the driveway of the bnb. I realize that was a mistake, and that spot was for the host.  However, at 1:40AM, I woke up to the host loudly knocking on my door, and yelling at me through the door if the car in the driveway was mine. I immediately apologized, but then the host proceeded to yell at me and command me to remove the car from the driveway. I removed the car, and parked it elsewhere. However, after being yelled at in the middle of the night, it was very difficult to feel safe and fall asleep inside the house. I felt so uncomfortable that I checked out quite early the next morning.   Even if the room is nice and quiet, I absolutely can not recommend this place after experiencing such a scary encounter. I hope that the host works on communicating the parking situation better, and communicates with guests calmly rather than aggressively.

My partner and I are very pleased with our two-night stay at Rena’s place and we hope to return in the future, as well as recommend to others near and afar. Rena is a warm, attentive, respectful, direct, responsive, and dedicated host. The room is not only a great value because of price (for example, no cleaning/maintenance or hidden fees), but also because of the many amenities the room provides and possesses. Because here you’ll find everything you need and more for a stay that’s supposed to be simple and basic, the arrangements feel luxurious. The bed is brand new and so so comfortable; everything in the room is clean and in wonderful shape, with a bit of a classic look; the bathrooms are new and the shower heads what you need after a long day of travel or your quick local getaway. As someone who requires shoes off in her own home, I’m very appreciative that Rena has a shoe tray at the entrance of the carpeted and super clean room.  The private bathroom inside this particular room is amazing and Rena will go out of her way to support and accommodate special needs here. Be sure to read all her instructions before booking and, upon arrival, the little red guest manual on the desk. Yes, she has many rules, but after staying here I see that they only feel oppressive if people forget that while we feel like this is our little home away, what we do during our stay not only impacts her home and her business, but also  and especially the next guest (sometimes even the neighbors and the local community!) We loved the quietness of the neighborhood and at the same time how easy it is to get around, especially on both buses stopping at the corner and the L train not too far away. Rena’s place is not for everybody and I can say the same about myself as a guest. If you’re a smoker of any kind, do not book here; in turn, if you dislike cigarette/smoke odors you’ll love this place because you won’t find a hint of that or any bad smell here. This place is a hidden gem and exactly what we needed for a specific moment. We loved this stay and leave full of gratitude to have been guests in Rena’s place and for how the setup, the extra mile, and her kindness and support helped us navigate the challenges embedded in this particularly important and stressful week.

This place was excellent. It's exactly as it appears in the photos. Perfectly clean and smelled great. Nice bathroom with beautiful tiled shower, great water pressure, and plenty of room even for a very plus size guest like myself. Bed mattress seemed brand new and both the bed and the futon/sofa bed were comfortable and great to come back to after a long day wandering Manhattan. Samuel and Kim were so helpful and responsive to every message. They accommodated an early check-in request and when they couldn't do a late check-out (other incoming guests) they held our luggage safely for us so we didn't have to drag it around the city. It was a 3.5 block walk to the 3 train, GPS said 0.4 miles. Took us about 30-45 minutes to get into Manhattan from the closest subway stop. Slightly gritty neighborhood but we never felt unsafe, during the day especially when there are so many people around (although at night there's nobody around). Warm and cozy studio, great location for traveling into Manhattan, definitely worth the price!

Good place as advertised, neat and clean. It is not luxurious, but was not advertised that way. It was great value. There are many fast food restaurants close by. Also grocery and drug store. Samuel is a good host.

Jillian's place is clean, comfortable, and elegant. She is a very responsive host. The 116th St subway stop is about a 10 minute walk away, which is very convenient. However, the walk from the subway to the apartment at night can feel a little unsafe. Other than that, the place is great.

BEWARE of this hotel as they will charge you what they call state taxes and a daily fee for their continental breakfast (which is not much of a breakfast at all) of approximately $200 more!!! Appalling, that Airbnb allows this to happen and condones it when you try to dispute this with them. The Airbnb listing did not state that they will charge the extra amounts at the hotel in the main body of their listing nor did they itemize it when you go to purchase and book the stay.  I was only disclosed these hidden fees when I booked the stay and a confirmation message was sent showing it was hidden under Airbnb's House Rules tab that you need to click on so that it shows a drop down menu. As far as I know, State taxes and other monetary charges are not house rules where I come from and in general. House rules would be rules of conduct; such as, keeping the room tidy, keeping noise down after a certain time, etc., not taxes and fees!!  When my friend and I got to the hotel and questioned front desk about the additional charges, he pulled out a piece of paper with the taxes listed and highlighted with the entire page laminated. OBVIOUSLY, WE WERE NOT THE FIRST COMPLAINERS OF THIS!! I told him that it was a snakeish way of scamming more money from customers. He agreed with me that it was snakeish but would not cancel/refund our booking.  Therefore, we ended up staying in the hotel because we could not afford to lose out all our money on this scam hotel. Let me tell you the place was not up to standards of what they charged. The sheets had holes all over them and when we asked the concierge to come have a look, he saw that they had holes as though eaten up by a critter and said "well, housekeeping is gone for the day." Our response was okay but give us new sheets at least...duh!  The garbage can had a huge burned out section to it. Disgraceful they still used it. The housekeeping would clean at 7 am and the hallway is small and there is no insulation of noise from the rooms to outside your door. They began slamming doors and talking loudly right outside our door, disrupting our sleep. The buffet is nothing but bagels, muffins and juice and they charge an additional $15 daily fee for that.  Another major thing is that under Airbnb, they go under a different name as Hudson Yards Hotel and, therefore, you can't even find the hotel by name, Casamia 36. They most likely do this because of all the bad reviews about the hotel and that they will scam your money!!! DO NOT BOOK THIS HOTEL OR YOU WILL BE VERY DISAPPOINTED!!!

Good location, with shops and restaurants nearby. The cleanliness of the bathroom left a lot to be desired. There are no blankets and it is cold. Very unsafe to leave your belongings, there is no key, it is a lock that opens easily without keys, and you don't know who you are sharing the apartment with, but they can easily enter your room. No communication, neither we nor a couple sharing an apartment with us managed to contact the host in almost 24 hours. The room looks like the photos, it's not great but it's okay.

Centrally located in the East Village but has a number of issues: - The building next door is being demolished (obviously has been going on for a while) and there is extremely noisy construction starting as early as 7:20am (jackhammers) to the point the building was shaking. The noise level was extremely high and unsafe for prolonged exposure. - When we arrived, there was a notice on the building entrance door regarding exterminators being on site and requiring access to each unit. We were not notified of this by the host prior to or at any point during our stay.  - The lock in the bedroom door was not a secure key lock, as indicated in the listing description. The lock can be easily turned with a coin. We feel that our belongings were not secure, and as a result, we took our valuables with us when we went out. - The smoke detector was beeping intermittently, indicating low battery or another issue. We contacted the host about this, but he did not get back to us and the issue was not resolved during our stay. The beeping was such that it disrupted our sleep.   We felt that the host had been aware of these issues and had not properly disclosed them when we booked. He only tried to explain the situation with the construction once we discovered it during our first morning and contacted him about it.

We had a great stay in the flat of Nneka. The flat really fulfilled our exspectation. It is a nice, cosy and clean place - especially in the living room we felt immidately comfortable. Pictures and description of the flat were very accurate. So you don't have to be afraid of a bad  surprise. The communication with Nneka was wonderful and she answers super quick if you have a question.  All in all a really good experience. I just can recommand a stay at Nnekas flat.

Nneka's place is a great value for the price and she is an excellent host. She was patient with me as I had to make various requests and changes. This was my 1st time renting with Air B&B so I didn't really know the ropes.   The apartment is clean and has thoughtful amenities. The neighborhood looks like most urban areas of NYC. However, if you have never been to NYC, it may catch you off guard.  We never felt unsafe and it's a quick walk to the J train station. We even walked home at 2:00am from the station on a Saturday and had no trouble.    There are several local places to eat around the area. If you like food, giveMitchell's a try! They even have Uber Eats!

Super convenient to the airport in a quiet neighborhood.  This was just want I was looking for.  Check in was easy and convenient.  Based on the instructions I was afraid it might be confusing but it as straight forward as mentioned.  The place is private and in the basement.   There was a sizable living and eating area that I didn’t get to use.  I wa surprised to see condiments in the fridge and some junk in the junk drawer but it didn’t take away from my experience.  Getting to the airport was a breeze and I had a great slice of grandma pizza pie from Loui’s close by.  The hair dryer was brand spanning new!   As someone mentioned before there was no wash cloth or hand towels.  Just something to consider if that’s high on your priority list.   Backyard of the place looks awesome.

M Social is a young person’s game. I love the idea; the location and the modern, colorful aesthetic. All the staff we encountered were helpful and the other clients, a large pop of internationals were friendly. However, the things I didn’t like would keep me from going back: hard, lumpy mattress (ow); broken ice machine…on every, single floor (eh); looong wait line for breakfast (which was not included with the $267 room—breakfast was $106 for 3 tiny teen girls and me!!)(meh); and finally, broken elevators in a high rise (NO!). I am 59 with joint issues and heart issues and not in the best shape. Working elevators in a high-rise are a deal breaker. Even when they were working, they were SO packed, you’d have to wait for half an hour to catch one with room. I know $267 a night for a room in this location (Times Square) is a steal, but for me, it is a LOT of money. At the very least, I should not have to slug it up ten flights of stairs.

The only bad thing about Jose's apartment is you won't want to leave it. I have stayed in several airbnb's over the past few months and this one was by far my favorite. The lighting is bright in all the places you need it to be. The furniture is new and perfect. The couch has a chaise lounger but also folds out into a bed. It's perfect for stretching out and watching the huge smart tv. There are extra pillows and a comfy blanket for you too. The TV is on a swivel mount so you can easily turn it to watch TV from the dining room table.   The kitchen is amazing with all new appliances, including a toaster. It has beautiful cabinets, new pots and pans, silverware, spatulas and gorgeous dishes. There is also a keurig with a wonderful assortment of k-cups and green tea. Jose even provides sugar packets, to go cups with lids and stir sticks. There was bottled water in the refrigerator for us too!   The trash cans have sensors that automatically open and close for you when you throw something away.   The bathroom is gorgeous. Everything from the floors to the shower will wow you... the toilet even has a push button flush. You'll find a hairdryer and some cotton swabs which are easy to forget when packing but are super important.   The bedroom is extremely cozy. The bed is so comfy and the linens are soft. The closet is pretty big and of course Jose has you some hangers, an iron and an ironing board. This guy thinks of everything. The ceiling fan even has a remote for you because once you're in bed, you're not going to want to get up for a while.   It's a very quiet neighborhood. Noise of any sort was no issue to us whatsoever. It's really close to a lot of things, including a mall. I didn't feel like it took long at all to get to and from LGA.   So, to sum this up, I'd recommend Jose's apartment to anyone. He has went above and beyond to make this an amazing place to stay. I'm just afraid that once everyone starts realizing how great it actually is, it will always be booked and I'll have a hard time getting to stay again. ha ha!   Thank you Jose, for everything. Seriously, you have no idea how amazing you are!

Great space. Very affordable, located in the heart of Williamsburg around many places to eat and shop. Room is small but livable, with an AC, fan, heater, desk, office chair, dresser, and large lofted bed. Very creatively organized. The house (including kitchen and bathrooms) was kept pretty clean during my stay. Tomas is an excellent host, very accessible and quick to reply to messages. Don’t be afraid to spark a conversation with him or the other residents…they are interesting people!
Place was clean and mattress comfortable but the bunk bed was squeaky and unsafe so were the stairs leading up to the bunker

Definitely smaller than I expected, but he does give the exact size of the room so that's on me. Still super affordable for the area and perfect for on a budget travelers needing a place to sleep. Was very quiet! The stairs to the bed were scary getting down a bit but still manageable!

This place, and working with Julia, were both a “10!” The location was fabulous - 1/2 block from the Bedford stop of the L train, and the place was spacious for NYC, with great internet, TV, and really clean & neat. While there was a minor snafu in access, Julia immediately reacted & made sure I got in easily & instantly.   It was a great deal - I’d definitely stay here again!  Rob

I'm frustrated after staying in M, for a couple of reasons:  - Despite telling them, many times, that I don't want them to enter my room, they continued to do so. It was funny, I was in a work meeting, and I had to spend 5 minutes saying "No, don't enter". They even opened the door while I was telling them that I don't want them to enter.  - They also don't work with Airbnb. I tried to extend my stay, and they told me to do it through Airbnb. I tried through Airbnb, and then they said they don't have access to Airbnb, so then I did it through them, again.  - They also charged me an additional 40$/night after I got there... that wasn't part of their listing on Airbnb. They called it a "destination fee"... It's a pretty shady business practice to surprise guests to charge guests even more money after the reservation has already been made.   - Lastly, this hotel isn't sustainable, at all. They change your towels and sheets daily, err.  - The Wifi here is pretty bad. The upload speed and download speed are below 5mb/s, and sometimes less. This is not a great place to take Zoom calls or any important meetings.

Rob was an amazing host, attentive and hospitable. The Airbnb was extremely clean, modern, and comfortable for the 4 of us who came to visit NYC for the first time. Even the portraits were cool. Overall the place is what you see and more!

As advertised, clean place when we arrived, however depends on who you get as co-guests. Neighborhood is a little sketchy and people regularly had loud music blasting. Nick himself was super helpful and responsive, if you have no problem with East Brooklyn I recommend staying here.

Arlo Midtown is in a great location just off of the Lincoln tunnel. As tourist from Philadelphia, getting through the traffic at the Lincoln tunnel is extremely stressful so it was very convenient for us to immediately park and get to our room. Since this is a newer hotel, which debuted on May 27th, 2020 many of the amenities and rooms feel fresh and new. With the special deal for it's grand opening I highly recommend staying at Arlo Midtown over any other AirBNB establishment while you still can. I'll definitely be returning!

This hotel is great for so many reasons - fun ambiance, great location, very comfortable beds and amenities, easy access. The one big downside is the 'destination fee' - it really feels like a scam and really needs to be removed. It feels like the customer is being nickel and dimed and scammed. I'm sure barely anyone uses the free phone calls these days, free apps are numerous to accomplish this. The City Bike is a nice idea but why would non New Yorkers ride a bike in Manhattan traffic?! The $10/day bar allotment is actually a $10 credit *if* you get something from the bar. No comment about the city tours as we did not use them. It basically feels like I got charged for 2 days of wifi at $60 while I was barely in the room. They may not call it a scam but it sure feels like it.

This was my first time traveling to NYC and I was worried of being scammed however this hotel was amazing! The view, the customer service, the room was great! The bar/restaurant was so good! + the staff was amazing! Will stay here again!!

I stayed at this listing for 32 nights. Overall, I think this is great for a longterm rental. Ori’s place was (relatively) quiet for NYC and fairly priced  At the time I stayed, there were only 5 reviews and I wish that folks went a bit further into detail on what I could expect, so here goes:  1. Bring shower sandals - the bathroom is not dirty, but it is old and the tiles on the floor are coming apart  2. Don’t expect a microwave - despite the listing saying there is one. Ori did not respond after I asked 3 times 3. Check in - you will meet in-person with the building manager who will give you the keys  PROS - Place was large for NYC standards. Theres a small couch that wasnt pictured in the photos, and the layout of the apt is great for you to feel like you have a dining spot, working spot, lounge spot and kitchen - Kitchen amenities - Surprisingly had Tupperware, 2 Brita filters, utensils, wine glasses, and dishes  - The apartment is rear facing, meaning outside your window is a private patio, and relatively quiet! However, because it is rear facing, there is not much natural light that comes into the apartment, but great for sleeping in! - The windows are barred and there are screens on them if you do what to open the window, so no rats will come in! - There is both an AC unit and heat. There is central heating but it only turns sometimes, so there is a space heater - Easily walkable, convenience store around the corner, and so is the laundromat  - TV (bring your own HDMI cord) if you want to plug it in with your computer - The water heats up fast!! And the shower water pressure is fine - The wifi is ok (dropped a few times) but ultimately, you could work from home and take video calls with minimal disruption - Trash disposal is convenient and right outside the apartment - There are 2 closets: Coat closet and clothes closet, and there is a 3 drawer storage for your clothes - There was a trolley available (for your laundry or even groceries!)  - During our stay, there were no encounters with roaches or rats - Packages get delivered to the lobby, but you have to buzz them in    CONS - No microwave, blow dryer, trash bags or toilet paper upon check in. The host quickly ordered the blow dryer, trash bags and toilet paper for us - and for that I am grateful! No microwave was ever delivered despite the host saying he would send it - We noticed on the first day that there were very small ants under the TV stand, but we bought bait traps ourselves at the local convenient store and they were gone within 48 hours - Not enough hangers, we had to buy some. There’s Probably only 20 in the apt and a drawer to put your clothes, which could be fine for some people! - There are minimal details about check in and what to expect until the day of. I felt liek I had to bother the host with questions, but the host could help save time by giving a template on what to expect - When you book, you have 48 hours to modify your dates. I needed to change my nights from 32 nights to 31 nights due to a traveling in from a wedding, but the host was not responsive and ignored me for 48 hours, so I ended up having to switch my flight for the wedding in order to make my check in - Thin walls - you can hear everything. Especially people coming home or chatting on the stair case at 2 AM - You are next to a fire station so there is an occasional siren, but honestly it wasnt that bad, and we wouldn’t hear them in the middle of the night (just during the day) - There are loiters on the street, often. Towards the last 2 weeks of our stay, there was usually a homeless man sitting on our porch or 20 feet away from the home
Super location. Very close to the metro, food places & drug stores. Luke is very kind and accommodating. You will feel comfortable, safe, and happy here.

Luke was an enthusiastic and ever available host, he would always respond within a minute of texting him and was extremely kind regarding check-in and check-out timing flexibility which really eased a lot of my stress in terms of being able to stow my luggage earlier and explore the city. The bathroom in general was clean but perhaps this is only related to the fact that I checked in early, the shower had a few hairs in it (probably related to the prior guest) when I initially saw it however it was throughly cleaned by the time I got back. Luke also provided bathroom slippers in the dressing room. The place is centrally located and close to the major sites in Manhattan, it is a 2 floor walk-up. Bed was clean and comfortable and room could fit a suitcase or two. Like many buildings in NYC, it was a bit dated however it was great for a place to crash after a full day’s worth of excursions in the city and Luke made the stay very comfortable. Would stay here again for sure!

This place is an absolute steal. Walking distance from Central Park and Times Square, a gorgeous sweeping rooftop bar/restaurant terrace. You do not need dinner or drink reservations elsewhere, this place will provide you with a comfortable and lovely stay with the best amenities you could ask for in NYC. We enjoyed the view of Times Square from our room, loved the hotel bar and enjoyed an entire evening on the outdoor terrace. This is where you need to stay.
Room was great. Location was OUTSTANDING. I can't stress enough how great this place was. I found my new favorite place to stay in Manhattan.

This place was perfect. The host responds quickly. The neighborhood felt safe. I am from the city and parking and crime is ridiculous. We made the right choice staying at this BNB on our visit back home. I’ll be staying here again.

Do not do it, Piero is wicked not a good person.Where should I start this place is a livingroom cut off in a livingroom, yup u heard me he has no tv no bathroom or kitchen in this place. He will give you a key to someone else apartment to use their bathroom and kitchen which he hides he doesn't tell you that and its no in his amenities. Everything said in the positive reviews and descriptions was spot on. Such  a great room. Dangerous for a writer!  Loved it.

A++++ location and space perfect for a family home base while visiting NYC. I cannot stress enough what a lifesaver the central AC was during our visit during a particularly doggy “dog days” week in August. This perk is not common in classic brownstones, one of many modern upgrades in Tom’s home which blends the best of Brownstone Brooklyn period detail (decorative fireplace, etc) with modern upgrades (spacious bathrooms, excellent windows, dishwasher, w/d).  It was our pleasure to feed and cuddle with the family’s sweet cat, Sophie, and water the garden/plants. My children were particularly delighted by having a vacation pet, and a private two-level garden with basketball net on bottom. This patio feature was perfectly sized for our 4 & 9yo.  I should also mention how QUIET the building is. We were anticipating sound from residents above us, especially at night in the master which is on the main floor of the duplex, but we didn’t hear a peep at night. Of in the morning. Or ever! Not from above, or either side. Heaven for this light sleeper who travels with a white noise machine.  As former Brooklyn residents, my husband and I agreed that the small chores (yes, Sophie did like to bring us gifts from the rodent population enjoying the private garden) were more than compensated for by the pure luxury of having so much space and prime amenities (not to mention tasteful, funky style) in one of our favourite parts of the city at a great price.

Location is great, short walk to subway (M/R line). Also near by Walgreen open 24 hours. In the middle of the night, there were still people passing by, neither scary nor too isolated.  The bathroom is clean and renovated.  The disturbance was the sound of walking and running coming from upstairs where the family where young children lived.  Fabiana, co host, is helpful and trying to solve the problem when I reported.

An absolute steal! Nowhere this nice of an apartment can you find it for this inexpensive. The bedroom was fantastic, and actually quiet considering how busy New York can get. The host, Ian, does an excellent job all around; the floors are extremely clean, the apartment is kept at a perfect temperature, and the location is unmatched-- amazingly close to many restaurants, stores, and the subway. I highly recommend it here.

It was an adequate place and it worked in a pinch. The manager/staff are great and very responsive/helpful. Unfortunately, the place is also extremely expensive for what you get (broken sofa in a dark, small apartment next to an enclave of homeless people and piles of garbage), and if I had not been in the time-crunch situation I was in, I probably would have gone for something else. Will say the place is surprisingly quiet and the AC works great, though.

Steven was a great host! I was afraid that I would be a little late arriving after check-in time and Steven was willing to accommodate me. Luckily I was able to arrive right at 8pm. When I did arrive, Steven greeted me at the entrance of the lounge with a glass of wine (which was perfect after my drive), gave me a tour of the place, gave me the keys, and let me know to let him know if we needed anything during our stay.  One thing I LOVE is that he had a place for us to park which is amazing for New York. He was very sweet and our place was quiet and perfect for the few days we were there.  I love the decor and the lights everywhere. The bed was very comfortable and he even had some snacks in the kitchen for us in case we wanted them. Everything was perfect. Thank you again, Steven!

Overall good. But note some points below: 1. Distance from the Graham station is far. I didn't care first, however, it could be a burden after a trip at Manhattan sometimes. 2.  I thought that the load from station to home could be scary at night for someone who use subway. 3. Shower bath is narrow and the outlet in the bathroom didn't work. 4. The room was cold. White radiator is hard to use. Black small heater worked, but it was noisy and made the air too dry.

First off, Blake is a very nice host and very kind! Still, our experience was very mixed.  The location of the apartment is AMAZING! You are in a neighboorhood with great restaurants, bars, and little shops. 10/10 can recommend this area, everything is walking distance, you can walk to the famous neighborhoods like SOHO and have great public transit options around the corner. The wifi is also great and works perfectly.  However, there were a few aspects we were not happy with:  Noise: while The location was amazing, windows are very badly isolated, meaning that you can hear all the noise from traffic - there is so much honking going on, sirens etc that sleeping was difficult even with earplugs. also the blinds don't work smoothly, which is why the apartment was light also during the night  Cleanliness: The room had not been cleaned before: there was dust everywhere, hairs on the floor and in the closet. Also, there was still someone's clothes in two of the drawers, which were also filed with dust and hair (ended up cleaning the drawers and floor ourselves). This is something that made us feel rather uncomfortable. The listing says the apartment gets professionally cleaned once a week, however we stayed for a week and there were no cleaners. Also the bathroom was dirty, there was hair in the shower which also wasn't cleaned for the whole week we stayed. Additionally, the blanket didn't have a cover, which is first of all weird and it also showed that the blanked was highly stained.  The apartment furthermore is a little bit smelly, probably because it doesn't get aired a lot.  Room itself: the room is super small, so if you're two people in might be too tiny for a longer period of time. But of course, given the location this is what you can expect in most places I suppose! Unfortunately there was no full size mirror, which Blake then after asking about it provided us with.  Bathroom: the water pressure in the shower is super low, which is why for girls it can be a hastle to wash your hair. The shower takes about 5 mins to turn warm, which is no fault of Blake whatsoever, still can be annoying if you're in a rush  Communication: Communitcation in person was amazing, however checking in was a hastle, as the instructions didn't work. the provided phone number seems to be not connected which makes it stressful if you're arriving and something about the check in doesn't work  Safety: the stairs leading up to the house are very slippery, so one evening I fell down the stairs and broke my foot. Not Blake's fault at all, rather a heads up to be mindful when walking down.

This is a very nice, well-maintained studio apartment in a convenient location. The kitchen is well-equipped and the bed is very comfortable. Daniel was an excellent, very communicative host, and he made sure that check-in and check-out went perfectly. The only minor drawback is the location - this part of Long Island City doesn’t have much going on, and you’re likely to encounter quite a few homeless people in the area at night. However, the apartment is near several major train stops, so you can easily get to neighborhoods throughout Queens, Brooklyn, and Manhattan very quickly. While staying here, my commute into Midtown was often less than ten minutes. Would definitely recommend!

1. Lots of homeless outside the apartment. Super sketchy area.  2. Windows can’t close, and bugs come in and can hear homeless yelling at night.  3. Floor was dirty, and chair was missing upon checkin.  4. Host promised there would be washer and dryer in unit, didn’t happen. I wouldn’t have chosen this place if I knew that was the case.  5. Left medications and some other items when I checked out. Contacted the host immediately, but he would not let me go get them. No response yet about medications.  Overall, very bad experience. Do not stay here!
