This airbnb is located close to the bus and is only about a 7 minute walk to the subway - local and express options available- and the Long Island Railroad  (this subway station also has an elevator which is helpful if you’re using a stroller). The airbnb is also about a 5 minute walk away to a large grocery store and different stores (like Dunkin’ Donuts, dollar general) which was very convenient.  The space is sleek and modern, the floors are gorgeous, and the TV (equipped with Netflix and other channels) and large sofa is a huge plus as everyone was able to relax comfortably. We found the beds comfortable and the sheets/blankets provided were cozy. We also loved the keyless entry... we never had to be afraid of losing a key. This unit also has heating which is a must have in NYC in the winter, our host was very accommodating with turning the heat higher when requested as well. We would definitely stay here again.

You get what you pay for...Maybe I got it on a VERY BAD day but that place was so dusty and moldy smelling,  I checked out in 30 minutes...  Cost me a pretty penny to find a new place  with such short notice but goodness, how did that place get those reviews...I thought I was on Amazon for a minute.    The host quickly refunded the other nights and AnB took care of the rest...The host communication was good but please invest $100 to clean the moldy entrance and clean a carpet, not to mention the unsafe extension cord running directly infront of the door that I almost tripped over.
Sam entirely did not respond when I arrived in NYC. Extremely unprofessional behavior. Thankfully found a replacement Airbnb extremely last minute but was not worth the stress or hassle.

Michelene and Sara were wonderful. The stay was a bit unconventional, but the value of the stay really stands out. The location of their apartment is so close to the metro and in the heart of some of the city's best stages. Michelene was accommodating and extremely easy to communicate with. As a guest, I never felt inconvenienced or unsafe. I would be happy to recommend anyone to stay with them.

Michelene and Sara’s place was absolutely perfect! It was spotless clean, 2 min walk to the subway, coffee shops, drug store, Trader Joes, restaurants in the area. The neighbourhood was very safe and cozy! The door people were extremely pleasant! We will 110% stay here again!  The hosts were very responsive and we even made friends with them because they were so kind and accommodating. They were wanting to make sure we had everything we needed. The apartment was equipped with NY tour guides, maps, towels, sheets etc!   I can’t say enough about this place and the hosts! I am so happy and would fully endorse anyone staying here. You will be so happy you did!   - Sara and Bryna

We definitely recommend staying here, not only for the spacious clean room but to meet this outstanding host, Candace.  She was so flexible with accommodating us at the last minute.  Communication was excellent and check in/out process was effortless.  We felt like part of the neighborhood and  public transit is close,  subway is just a 7 minute walk. Candace you went above & beyond.  You made both my son & I feel like we've known you forever.  You have such a gracious and caring vibe to you that just makes everything much brighter, especially during such a stressful time trying to move my son from Texas to Brooklyn.   You connected me to local people that you knew and trusted to help my son's move go smoothly and you're still reaching out to this day to help my son and for this,  I am forever grateful for your kindness.  You will continue to be blessed for all you that you do to make other peoples lives better.   You are by far THE best host we have had out of our many stays through ABNB.  We will be sure to come back when we visit our son!
It was my first time using Airbnb I’ll admit I was kinda scared/nervous eat first but Candace really made me feel comfortable! I’ll definitely stay again, should’ve stayed the full weekend!

Eliza and Geoffrey were great hosts. However my friend and I both had issues with the room. Firstly, we did not feel as though it was a “private room”. The room has a glass door and a window that you can look into. The window has a curtain but the door leading into the room does not. We only felt comfortable changing in the shared bathroom which was fine but not ideal. We found old dried up dog feces on the floor as well as stains on the bed. The night we stayed in their home they had a guest over who was talking about doing illicit drugs and had a syringe with him that he said was for “medicine” which could be true but after hearing him talking about cocaine we did feel confident in that it was just what he said it was. The following morning I went into the bathroom and caught Geoffrey changing with his door open. I felt very embarrassed and like I couldn’t even go to the bathroom without something strange happening. My friend and I decided to leave early to go to a hotel.

I had the best time here! I’ve made true friends with Liza and Geoff. They made my move to New York less scary and much more exciting. Their place is amazing. It is so clean and welcoming. I throughly enjoyed my stayed!

Anthony is an A+ host. He personally comes to give you a tour of the place (and bright tulips!) and is a positive, bright spirit. His place is very clean with great natural light in an ideal location. We stayed there for two weeks. There are minor fixes that need to be done throughout  the place and some furniture that can be upgraded but beyond that this place is a steal. Recommend!

I stayed in Samir's apartment with my 3 children for 8 nights. The location is nice but I cannot recommend the apartment.  A few days before arrival I was asked to lie to the neighbors about the Airbnb if neighbors will ask me, and we had to deal several times with a blocked toilet including sewage on the floor.  But more importantly, on the first night at 3am someone opened the door. Fortunately we had secured the chain, and avoided what could have been an unpleasant experience. It took more than a day to repair the lock and Samir's response was simply "sorry" which I told him was not enough. At that point he claimed that I had not locked the door which was not the case...  In retrospect I understand it was a mistake to accept Samir's request to communicate with him through his private email, if I had insisted on using the AirBnB message portal we may have got better service.  In any case, not recommended, there are enough nice apartments around.
Great place! House is beautiful! The metro is a block away from the place. Very easy to get in and out of the city. The area is a bit scary BUT it really was not unsafe.

The place is very clean and comfortable. We enjoyed the grill. The hosts were very polite and quick to respond. The neighborhood  looks sketchy, but we felt safe once inside and didn't have any problems. Some of the neighbors play loud music.

This apartment exceeded all expectations and is actually even better than the pictures show!  It is perfectly located, beautifully decorated, homely, clean, functional with everything you could ever need for a comfortable and stress free stay and we really loved being there. Being away from home for a month can be tough but staying in this stunning apartment really helped.  Communications with the host were always prompt, helpful and friendly and they went above and beyond to make our stay everything we could wish for.  I cannot recommend this apartment highly enough and we would absolutely stay there again!
Generally quite clean and as listed. Neighbourhood can feel a bit unsafe for young blond women.  Could have hoped for a bit more communication with the host.

The apartment and the room are very nice, everything is designed which gives a very comfortable feeling. The room has light, air conditioning, good space to store clothes and a good bed, very good space for 2 people. Well equipped apartment. The apartment is two blocks from the subway, very easy to get to and well connected, many services nearby such as supermarkets, laundromats (which are very practical and easy to use), places to eat, etc. It is also very close to the north side of central park, which is very good, you can take a 30-minute walk through the park and get to the Guggenheim museum and the Met ;). The neighborhood is very Latin, it is not unsafe at all in my opinion, the people are always respectful. Alina is very respectful of personal space, we didn't see her much since she was probably working, but she was very cordial and kind. In short, it is an excellent place to stay in New York!
I totally love them and their house amazing time and beautiful home I can’t stress that enough also so help and caring I just truly love them and had such an amazing time

The space is a good size, clean and comfortable and just as pictured. Beds are comfy. Noise is not too bad considering you are in NYC. Sirens come with the territory. You will tune them out after a day or so. :)  The extremely loud bass  music late evenings and early mornings was a little annoying though. I’m not sure if that’s typical but it was not so easy to get used to.  I guess I get that some people think the neighborhood seems a bit rough around the edges.  But is also East New York. Not the UES. So you get a more real and gritty New York experience. We never felt unsafe getting to and from the subway which was a quick 5 minute walk away. C Train takes you right into Manhattan. Communication from Yngrid and Jiovanni was timely, friendly and helpful. They were very accommodating to let us check jn early to leave our bags on our arrival day. Overall a very good Airbnb experience. Thanks for sharing your space with us!

The home was lovely. The hosts were very attentive and kind and quick to respond. The neighborhood looks a little rough around the edges , and can be a bit noisy but never felt like it was unsafe to be outside. Overall a great value for a home.

The rooms were clean and relatively big for an apartment in New York. We walked around the neighborhood all hours of the day and never felt unsafe. Yngrid and Jiovanni replied quickly and were clear in their messages. I was worried of being catfished, but everything was as expected and the place was beautiful.

Antoinette was great, super communicative and the place was nice and clean, exactly as described. Our flight out was even delayed a day and within 15 minutes of finding out we were able to extend our stay one extra night, made a stressful situation super easy.

Small room across the hallway of the hosts flat. Minimalistic, clean, very close to the subway. You have everything you need there, but no luxuries. Hosts are always quick to respond, let me drop off my luggage before check-in. Area looks a bit sketchy, but is safe.

Great friendly hosts! Welcomed us to their home with a snack of warm buns and soy milk, had bottled water and clean towels ready for us. The place was rather clean, felt secure and host always responded quickly to our requests. Felt like home at the end of our 7 day stay.   Downsides was that the upstairs neighbours were a bit noisy at night, but with earplugs it wasn’t a significant problem. Another con is that we at times felt unsafe walking home at night. It was not bad enough for us to avoid staying out late, but I would not recommend a single female walking home at night alone in this neighbourhood.

This property is in a decent area. Did not feel unsafe. It is on 2nd floor with no elevator so make sure you are capable of carrying luggage up and down. Close to Food and Market which was nice instead of sit down or cooking myself. There will always be likes and dislikes. All I can say is always ask for more photos and complete descriptions of building inside and out anywhere you stay.

Overall, loved the apartment. It was a lot smaller and tighter space than I had anticipated; however my friends and I were able to sleep comfortably. Very clean, modern, and stylish. The neighborhood is very quiet as well as the building. One of the neighbors did creep me and my friends out but wasn’t a real bother. It served its purpose for our night, I would book again. Great location and many restaurants to order from near by.

Jerome's home is wonderfully cozy and feels completely like a home-away-from-home. The interiors were so well done with a boho-chic touch. The green goodness with interior plants, the bookshelves, the vintage touch with bulbs, radio/transistor, comfy leather couch are so well thought-out and placed. The overall amenities were just perfect. We stayed at Jerome's place for my birthday week and couldn't have found a better home to stay in NY! The subway station is 3-5 min walk and connects you all over NY and NJ once you have a MetCard. It never felt unsafe to walk around late in the night as the people around are either really nice or mind their own business which made it super convenient for us to explore the city all day.  If I plan to visit NY again for a vacation, I would book Jerome's place in a heartbeat!

Lica was extremely helpful and communicative with me from day 1! I was a little afraid that we would cause too much noise (my group is a bit rowdy) but since it was located in a great spot we had many places to hang out at late before heading back to the apartment. I really enjoyed my time, thank you Lica for hosting us!

Great location. Close to Times Square, Broadway, Central Park and public transportation. Well appointed apartment. Apart from the room facing the street, which was sometimes a little noisy (but we are in Hell’s Kitchen), everything was perfect. Very good communication with the host, full of little touches, and who knew how to adapt to welcome us, despite an arrival delayed by the flight... To recommend, without hesitation!

Our Airbnb trip was cancelled AFTER we arrived in NY and we're standing outside the apartment. The day we were to check in , myself and my companion arrived, were outside the Airbnb and the key box was missing. We contacted the host, who we do agree responded fast or had his girlfriend responding fast to us, thy made us send them a picture to prove the key box was missing. Since they are both away travelling alot and no one living in Queens that can assist then, they cancelled our trip. I'd like to add we were in town for a wedding and had a rehearsal dinner that evening which we both missed because I was on the phone with Airbnb for 5 hours arguing with them that waiting 5-15 days for a refund doesn't help us cover the cost of rebooking a new spot.  I am not saying this place is a scam. It was very suspicious though. In the check-in instructions the picture shows a lock box located very low on a fence near the ground. When we emailed the host about the lock box being missing they said it must of been stolen and would cancel the trip because there was no way for them to get us a key quick enough. The fence where the lock box should be however had a missing bar but it was in the he middle of the fence not the floor. I also need to mention I am originally from NY and book Airbnb there alot to visit family. First time dealing with anything like this.My only suggestion is first for Airbnb to have their host come up with back up plans if the host won't be available on site for your stay and also for the host to have personal near the location that can handle a situation like this if they will be away travelling.  Other than that, the host did reply fast when booking and answered all my questions. It's disappointing it turned out like this but more so I'm angry it took away from my bestfriend's wedding experience (who by the way handled it awesome and was supportive the whole time).

Our party of 3 humans and 2 canines was NYC bound for the AKC Meet the Breeds event in which we were all participating.  We were excited to find a host who was not only willing, but absolutely excited to host our two ~25lb Lagotto Romagnolo dogs.  We booked for a Friday and Saturday night stay so that we would have plenty of time to rest and relax before and after the big event on Saturday.  So much less stress than trying to accommodate the crazy demands of some hotels in the area!  Our host Sonia and coordinator / friend Luciana were both amazingly responsive to work with and totally understanding as we asked 100 questions ahead of time and worked to precisely dial-in our scheduling. Never had a problem or a concern asking a question and responses were immediate and fully addressed the questions asked.  This charming apartment is perfectly located! One of the best bagel companies is just down at the end of the block. There is a paid parking garage next door. Multiple subway lines and bus lines are all available within a block.  It took two of us 10 minutes to walk to the Madison Square Park dog run, located right next to Eataly and the flatiron building.   The efficiently-appointed 2nd floor apartment was sparkling clean when we arrived. We opted to indulge in a little NYC luxury; instead of cooking we ordered-in meals using a phone app that, for a few of us, contained more delivery options than we could shake a stick at or had seen in our app before!The internet definitely was easy to sign into and worked just fine for our needs, including some streaming video watching on the TV. The queen bed was comfortable for two of us and the couch provided one member of our party with a very comfortable two nights of 6 h+ sleep (a record!). We did feel that the air mattress and/or the pull out bed would not fit comfortably in the den area and leave enough room for folks in the bedroom to make it to the restroom.  This is indeed a NYC apartment so, if you’re from out of town, do understand that the space is efficiently used and most rooms are much smaller than you would think. This is not the magical fantasy apartment from “Friends.” This is a real apartment in a real building and, if you’ve ever wanted to know what’s inside those buildings you see in the movies that have the fire escapes out front, this is your chance! The pups enjoyed the space playing from living space to bedroom and back again and super cuddling on the uber-comfy couch.   We absolutely enjoyed our time in the apartment and the surrounding environment.  It definitely made a great launching pad to get to our event and a welcome place to return to when the event finished. Hopefully, we will be able to return to this place again the next year.

The apartment is super well located, the location is perfect. It's a seven-minute walk from Times Square. There are several metro lines available within 500 m of the apartment. It is located on the 23rd floor of a building with two elevators, which offers you a beautiful view. Milan has been a very responsive host to messages and requests. We managed to leave the apartment a little later than planned because our flight was scheduled for the end of the day, I thank him for that because we were able to enjoy the morning and early afternoon without our luggage which had remained at the apartment. The Negative point was the cleanliness when we arrived the apartment was not very clean so I let Milan know. He therefore scheduled the apartment to be cleaned by a company the day after our arrival. After the cleaning man came, the apartment was clean. I therefore recommend the Milan apartment, hoping that it will be clean upon your arrival.

Alexa's place is where you want to be! Shes is a wonderful host whom unfortunately we did not meet however her quick and timely responses were helpful when we needed something.  LOCATION: Her appartment is in a safe neighborhood roughly 10 minutes from Times Square and the subway. Her place is also located quite close to Central Park and the Rockefeller center with it being about a 15 minute walk. If you're naturally a city person, or don't mind walking, this is a great place for you. Uber's and Lyft's can get expensive so take the subway!   APPARTMENT: The appartment itself was located on the 3rd floor of a building. The stairs leading up to it are old and rickety so take caution when going up them. Once you get inside the appartment, it's your home away from home! There is a kitchen if you'd like to cook, a little bar area where you can eat, a livingroom with boardgames, books, even a TV. The bathroom was small, but did its job and was clean. Keep in mind that another guest is also sharing the appartment with you so do not get upset with the host if the bathroom is a bit dirty. The room looked exactly like the pictures looked. The bedroom which we stayed in had a lock for the room itself so while you're  out for the day, your belongings are safe. Room was clean and the bed was very very comfortable. Probably one of the most comfortable beds I've ever slept on. There was a huge TV in our room which I was afraid to knock over. There were extra pillows and towels in our room. There are also plenty of drawers and a closet for you if  you'd like to hang up and put away your clothes. The room is always a bit warm so we turned off the heater as we stayed in January and opened a window.  FOOD: I don't know where to start with this one because there are so many options to pick from. There is food everywhere you look outside of the appartment. Alexa provided a list of really good options to choose from. The appartment is steps from breakfast places, pizza and so on. If you like Italian, go to Tony's de Napoli on 43rd Street. 1 meal can serve 2-3 people.   ATTRACTIONS: We did everything on this list except for the Top of the Rockefeller Center for FREE. Like I mentioned above in LOCATION, Times Square is honestly a 10min walk. Central Park are about a 15min walk. Take the subway to the World Trade Center Memorial. From there we walked. Wall Street, The Staten Island fairy is free and you can see the statue of Liberty from the boat. From there we walked to the Brooklyn bridge. All of this is free. We did pay for the Top Of The Rock (Rockefeller Center) for amazing views of New York.   TL;DR: Amazing Host and Apartment in a Manhattan which is central to everything if you don't mind walking and aren't afraid of the subway.

The description is accurate and the best compliment I can give is that the previous guest’s reviews are read and accommodated too which is nice to know that a host is actually open to suggestions, greta quality to have as a host and person.   Being so close to the subway isn’t as loud as you would think, but the neighborhood itself is as expected for new york so if you like silence just shut the window.  A warning to future summer guest, the apartment itself is toasty. There isn’t an ac unit running in the common areas. The bedroom has an ac unit but you don’t want to run their electric bill through the roof so it’s a moral choice I guess.   Anton himself was off on travel, but his roommate Lika was very kind for the moments I did see her.   Those are my major notes, overall though the apartment and location are definitely a steal for the price being asked for. Easy access to grocery, food, train, and all the good stuff. If you are looking for convenience, this is your place just maybe in the cooler months.   If you are looking for a fun evening, definitely check out Wonderville right around the corner. It’s a sweet barcade sort of gig.

Very good for the price, good deal. Nice sized room, own bathroom is a win. Most travelers may complain about the area, but if you’re afraid of Brooklyn, don’t visit Brooklyn. This is a good spot, and I’d stay here again.

This is a very friendly, smiling and polite family. They treated me very well. They gave me hot chocolate, very good, and they gave me food. And they care a lot, if you have slept well or if you need something. The bus leaves you next to the house and the F train is express and very fast from 42nd Street. The area is very quiet and not dangerous. There is a Deli 2 blocks away, where you can buy coffee, etc. Everything in the house is new and has just been renovated, everything is very clean and cozy. I think it is the best Airbnb where I have stayed! There were no unpleasant surprises. Everything was as in the advertisement.

We were fortunate enough to find this place for a steal! However, what truly makes your stay is the host. We had a bit of trouble accessing the apartment our first night but even at 2:00AM Miao was friendly and attentive. Anything you could want/need is provided. Our only regret is not being able to stay longer.

Absolutely wonderful place to stay. Clean and very roomy. Never felt unsafe in the area. Dont think of Bushwick (Brooklyn) from an early 2000s standpoint. Today it is lively, all walks of life, younger crowd, and no one is going to attack you. The coffee shop at the end of the street(3 minute walk) is a great spot to start your day off. Then another 7 minute walk to the subway. Very easy to get into Manhattan. Came back to the airBNB many times after dark we weren't worried about safety. Just as you should anywhere, be aware of your surroundings. There are scarier people and places closer to times square. Maio was super friendly and accommodating. The ONLY thing we found wrong was the location of the TV. BE CAREFUL! Don't run into it. Other than that, this place is, in my opinion, the perfect location. And Brooklyn,Williamsburg,bushwick are actually a little more fun to us anyway. (Although we have already done all the touristy stuff on a previous trip) we will be back here for sure! ALSO! NYC is not strict on the vaccine mandates and no one wears a mask. So thats a plus!

Pretty cozy place to stay, Clean restroom, clean room and a large space for that kind of location in NY,  nice provision for kitchen and cooking, fresh breath of air but the guys upstairs kind of drop stuffs at random in the middle of the night and that’s kinda scary.  Communicate with the cleaners on time so as to clean and sanitize on time long before arrival of guest please.. I forgot to say there is Netflix and Amazon Video 24/7, bathroom is damn clean

This is a solid, comfortable place to stay. It is on a quiet street, but not far from some restaurants and grocery stores. It's a bit of a walk to the beach, and the neighborhood is a little rough, but not scary. Parking was available, but I had to drive around to find it.  I liked that the place is very clean and well-organized, that toiletries were available, and the towels were nice.  The studio is not large. There is one small window, but it doesn't let in much light. This makes it great for sleeping -- very dark and quiet, but didn't make me want to hang out there all day.  There is a coffee pot, but no coffee, so you'll need to bring or get that. If you're planning to go to the beach, you'll also need to bring beach towels -- only two bath towels are provided.  Overall, a perfectly fine place to stay.

I honestly cannot begin to describe what an amazing experience I had staying at Molly’s. Checkin was extremely easy and convenient. The keypad made it easy and I really appreciated the private and separate entrance. The place was bigger than I expected, and had a ton of overhead storage (plus under bed) which was convenient since I planned on staying for a month. Molly was extremely flexible with extending my stay, and I was so comfortable that I ended up staying much longer than I anticipated. Best of all there was always street parking literally right outside the door! Being so close to the beginning of City Island helped to alleviate any traffic concerns. The supermarket and laundromat were all within a block or so, and there are a ton of running trails I took advantage of that led straight to the beach. Molly was also so responsive throughout my entire stay (she even contacted me during a bad rainstorm to make sure I was okay and ask if I needed anything!) I was almost hesitant to leave such a positive review because I’m afraid the place won’t be available the next time I might need a little summer getaway! The main house does share a wall with the apartment so there is normal day to day noise, but honestly it’s much quieter than most apartments I’ve lived in and have a really homey feel. 5 out of 5 experience!

Great value, neat attic suite. Spacious suite, Bathroom will be tight for tall people. Only thing is the neighborhood is sketchy we walked from Arthur Ashe in the night wouldn't recommend the walk. Overall couldn't ask for better value for money.

Staying at Marina's apartment was an excellent experience. The apartment was sparkling clean upon my arrival. It has a small but well-equipped kitchen, a snugly bed, and a comfortable living room with a desk. The personal touch makes it feel like a home immediately. I enjoyed the liveliness as well as the many different restaurants and delis of the neighborhood. Try the baklava from the store at the next corner! Besides the delis, a supermarket and a drug store are in close walking distance. The nearest subway station, Astoria Blvd, is about ten minutes to walk. Marina was very responsive and helped me resolve all of my questions quickly.

Very nice and comfortable space. I arrived while it was raining with my 11 year old and my infant. Micheline was not at home at the time, but she made sure someone helped us in. It was a bit hectic at first because a long term tenant was moving out and since I came early, there was not a lot of time to clean. I left to get a bite to eat and returned to find Micheline cleaning the place herself! She also sent a text the next morning to make sure we were ok. she turned a potential stressful time into a nice experience because of her kindness.

You will get your money’s worth in this Airbnb. The check in was easy and comfortable. The train station is close by. The area can be sketchy sometime. We didn’t feel comfortable walking around at night. This hasnt been mentioned before so you should give bedstuy a quick google search to find out if it’s a good place for you.   All in all it’s worth the money, for a five star review housekeeping would need to be a little better ☺️

Highly recommended- be forewarned though... actual location of the place is a few streets/blocks away from what is advertised (disregard if host updated that info). A high-end "hostel" experience with lots of privacy and security!! The rate is generous/a steal, especially for a stay in Brooklyn/NYC. Must be willing to share common areas (kitchen, dining table, and TV room) and bathrooms. In this particular room, it has a (tiny, but cute) balcony, a small closet with 2 shelves, a small desk/chair, mini-fridge, a mounted flat-screen TV, full (double) mattress/two pillows, end (night) table with 2 drawers, and two hooks for your towels. Host communicates well and very accommodating!

It’s perfectly fine. It’s not fancy. It’s not instagrammable. But it’s perfectly livable.  I never felt unsafe and as it’s right near Broadway junction, there is plenty of subway access within walking distance. Also a corner store on the same block with all the basics.

Good place in Brooklyn for a cheap price although I’d advise checking in early, we had neighbors having a party at night in front of the gate and they asked if we wanted to buy drugs.  As we were trying to find the keys.   I think that moment could’ve been scary for some folks that are maybe new to the area. They were pretty inviting actually, but their timing wasn’t great.
Sofia's listing is perfectly located in Williamsburg! A space with everything you need, in a building with all the amenities you could desire, in an area that will steal your heart!

You get what you pay for here, and less.   What can I say? I've been trying to come up with an adequate review for this one for days but now I'm stuck dealing with Airbnb support trying to get them to fix the fact that this place was dirtier than the dirtiest hostel, was missing basic amenities, didn't have an adequate system for locking doors (front door always left open, backwards-installed lock meaning the place is totally open to intruders--someone's shoes were stolen during our stay), had an ever-dripping faucet, didn't supply towels or toilet paper or basic cooking implements, and had an ant infestation. Hair all over the floor. The kitchen hadn't been cleaned in about half a century and the stove was leaking gas/impossible to turn on properly.   This place is a 311 nightmare. But it does have a nice (and dirty) enclosed balcony, I'll give it that.  When we tried to contact the host he was minimally responsive and then stopped getting back to us altogether. Frankly, you'd probably be better staying in one of the hourly hotels near this place (there's plenty of them).   Don't bother unless you want to feel grossed out for a month and have to deal with Airbnb's inadequate "support" system during your stay. Yikes.

Alex/Alvin messaged me a month before our dates, wanting to cancel the booking which was very stressful. They offered me $50 if I was the one cancelling in order to avoid a negative review. This shouldn't be happening from a "Super Host".   The apartment looks better on the pictures: more brighter and cleaner.  The person upstairs was very noisy, we could hear them walking back and forth (on Sat night it lasted for hours). We also heard the subway from time to time.   The big plus is the location and the price we paid for it at that time.

He charged me $185 to add a guest to my reservation, in the middle of my stay repairs were done that prohibited us from sleeping in past 9 am. Very loud drilling, grinding, and construction sounds that made our morning very unpleasant.

The place was perfect for my needs. The garden was relaxing, the beds were comfortable, and the kitchen was decent. I was not there as a tourist, so I only went to Manhattan a few times. When I did, the connections were good. The G train is a few blocks away. Kian was available and friendly. I was in Brooklyn for a somewhat stressful situation; the place was comforting and quiet, and I felt grateful to have chosen to stay there.

Too far from everything, not very clean, super thin walls sharing with 4 other guys who seem to be up at 6am and having conversations which will wake you, only 1 bathroom is accessible because apparently the other one is an en-suite bathroom in one of the rooms.  Wouldn't recommend if you need to be getting to Manhattan on a regular basis.  Area quite dangerous and unsafe if you're walking around at night.

Everything as in description. Andres is very kind and responsive host and really polite person.  There are amazing paintings in the apartment made by himself. I liked, it’s like charming additions.  It was so good to came back here every day during exploring the NYC. He prepared brochure with very useful info.  I was alone, and firstly was scared of neighbors a little bit, but actually they are very nice people. Thanks, Andres!

This was a wonderful place to stay while visiting Brooklyn! I appreciated the clean, comfortable, room in a quiet walk up. I had kitchen access, with a perfect balance of privacy and hospitality. Cem is a quality host; he provided timely, excellent communication and worked hard to streamline the arrival and check-in for me. He made the process easy and stress-free. The convenient location was a bonus - close to the Prospect Avenue subway stop on 4th St. I highly recommend this place and look forward to staying there again myself!
Andres is very hospitable, which makes for a pleasant experience. Also, for the price, this place is a steal! I definitely recommend it!!

The apartment is stylish and cozy, it actually looks like the pictures. You can sleep well in bed. However, it is right next to the window, so one person has to climb over the other. Air conditioning is installed in this window.  All windows in the apartment face an inner courtyard, so you can always turn on the lights even when the sun is shining. But the light is nice and sufficient. The apartment is in a Hispanic area. It's quiet and safe. Two different subway stations are just a 10-minute walk away. You can also walk around at night without fear. You can get to downtown Manhattan in about 45 minutes by subway.

JUST BOOK IT. The photos really sold me on this incredibly stunning, one-of-a-kind airbnb. And the actual place did not disappoint upon arrival. But what really made my stay phenomenal was the two owners. It's amazing to be a part of another person's story. The owners Jarret and Dan have set their sights on completely renovating a 120-year-old Brooklyn Brownstone. The parlor (gosh I love how fancy I feel typing this) has been magicked into a glorious time-period-esque retreat with swanky modern touches. Really you'll have the time of your life just staying in and drinking your coffee in this gorgeous abode. The place is sparkling clean (me no like germs, so that's saying something) and there's an entire binder of tips for getting around and finding local bites. Jarret and Dan also had THE BEST communication ever and were available at the drop of a hat for any needs (hi I can't open simple locks). The icing on the cake? Jarret brought us APPLE PIE the day after Thanksgiving as we had been in town for the holiday. He also brought a good deal of sass and locals-only advice for exploring the city in the best possible way. You can't not love this man! Additionally can we talk about the SIZE of this space? It's truly a steal and you would easily pay a grand nightly for it in Manhattan. You'll really fall in love with this space and the lovely owners. BOOK IT. BOOK IT. BOOK IT.

Great stay. Bed super comfy, was a little sketchy arriving at 11pm and walking down the alley to get the lock box on first night but after that fine. I felt safe in the neighborhood and realized that I was fine walking everywhere I went. Will stay again for sure very soon.

We came in from Germany and couldn’t have had a nicer reception into New York. Jean was very communicative and made everything super easy for us. His place is super comfortable - the beds feel like the Westin - and spacious too. We loved the private roof terrace and complimentary fruit, which were touches that made his place extra special. Jean’s place is a seven minute walk from one Metro stop and 15 minutes from another one, with grocery and drug stores, etc. right outside his place. We only wish we could’ve stayed there longer!
If I could give 10 stars I would. Amazing location! What a steal, apartment is BEAUTIFUL and the host is amazing. Would stay here again!!

A beautiful and clean space in a NY brownstone home.   Dan and Jarrett were very welcoming and made the effort to introduce themselves. Their instructions on entering and exiting the property were very helpful too.  The decor is immaculate and the bed is very comfy too.  The property was perhaps a little far out for us tourists but it did make our experience somewhat more authentic.  Please be aware that the nearest Subway station and immediate area of Nostrand Avenue / Fulton Street did feel a little sketchy at times, perhaps more so to non-New Yorkers, but as I understand this is a problem with much of the Subway network.

My wife and I stayed at Dan and Jarrets place for 5 nights for our first ever trip to NY.   They gave clear and regular communication throughout and were quick to introduce themselves in person upon arrival. The flat was clean and well equipped, and the subway station is just a 5 minute walk.  However, we found the plug to be broken on the bathtub and so couldn’t fill it. The flat was also very cold at times and there were no instructions on how to turn the heating on. Both minor issues on the face of it, but I fell I’ll during the stay and these would’ve really helped.  Lastly, the location was not great. It’s hard for me to criticise, given that the hosts accurately advertise the location, but I found the location sketchy and very inconvenient. Travelling into Manhattan became a chore, travelling back late at night was worse.   The flat was great, but next time I’ll just book a place in Manhattan, or Williamsburg for the Brooklyn experience.

you should not be afraid of the outside environment the neighborhood does not seem serene at first sight the Americans are cordial and ready to help you at any time of the day see you more thank you have a good stay

Host was very friendly and helpful. Apartment is well located for the subway, but is fairly tired and could do with an overhaul, but some may see this as the charm. The area is pretty rough; it may be up and coming, but everywhere is very run down with homeless people hanging around and drugs and alcohol going on. However, we did not feel particular unsafe since there are quite a few tourists in the area. If you go expecting a real Brooklyn experience then you will not be disappointed. Free parking is available in the area, but you have to be prepared to move your vehicle day-by-day to avoid street cleaning fine; we got a ticket.

Andrew is really a superhost, and the apartment is superb. Well equiped, clean, ample. The only problem is the neighborhood. Dirty and dangerous.  Everyday we experimented fear walking to the subway. One day there was drugged people in our door or sleeping in the street. Another day three men beating one in the floor. A man approached us insulting and menazing with no reason. Thank god police was around and stopped that man and no phisical harm was done. Another day there was three Police cars and lots of cops, as surely something nasty happened. We are not used to that when on holydays. I am sorry to say that I will never come back near this neighborhood.

Andrew was nice and helpful, getting us really comfortable. The house could be cleaner, but it was cozy and well decorated. It was also well located, with a distance of 5 minutes walking to the subway. We could get to the center of New York in less than 30 minutes. We didn't feel insecure, although the area around the apartment seemed a little bit dangerous. It was a great experience, we got into the spirit of Brooklyn. We loved NYC and our stay at Andrew's apartment!

I enjoyed my stay with Tony and Maria. I was able to explore the City and interview successfully due to their hospitality. The price is a steal and it was very easy to communicate with the hosts. Overall a good experience and I wish them the best.

I was pretty scared coming to a place that had not many comments. I was really positively surprised! The studio was super clean (that was really important to me), the bed was super comfortable, the shower was even better than mine. Brittany was really responsive and gave us good tips for local restaurants and café. We could use her Netflix account amongst other. The best part for us was the location : walk 2minutes and you'll find the subway which will take you to Downtown Manhattan in 15minutes. You can be at the Empire State Building or Time Square in 30minutes. If I ever come back to NYC I'll be sure to return to this studio. I already recommended the place to a friend of mine!

Cute and clean, bed was very comfortable. For those of you who drive ,there  is street cleaning most weekday mornings so be careful to move your car well before the time it starts to avoid stress ! If you can’t find a spot , there is metered parking  a block closer to the beach

It is a small room just like as it described but its clean and neat. It has coffee machine, fridge and microwave. It is very close to subway, safe and quiet neighborhood, you won’t be scared to walk at night.

I rented this apartment for my mom while she was visiting her parents in the area. Bruno's communication was spotty from the beginning. The check in process was a huge mess. The keys were not in the lock box and a guest was somehow already checked into the apartment we rented. Bruno was slow in responding. Once he responded, he did try to figure out a solution (although he only texted and refused to talk on the phone). There was another airbnb unit in the same house that was empty, and he agreed to let my mom stay there for the entire length of the reservation. I confirmed this with him and also documented with Airbnb. He then calls a few days later and threatens to throw my mom out of the apartment. I had to confirm through Airbnb again that my mom is able to stay in the unit for the entire length of her already paid reservation. All in all, it was a very stressful stay in terms of logistics . The apartment itself (Unit 6) was clean and quiet and in a good location although extremely spartan.

Prime location for B and Q train, Brighton Beach and Coney Island. Parking is sketchy.  Quiet building, room is small, checkin was simple. Tv (Roku) worked half the time, shower curtain and bathroom rug were stained, no cups, creamer or sugar for coffee, hair all over the hamper- cleaning person should step it up. If you just want to sleep there- it’s good. I am typically a hotel person- I will not stay in an air bnb again.

Great place! It serves its purpose to provide you with a place to sleep while you explore what NY has to offer. The location is perfect for getting on the train. I was not fond of the unpleasant smell in the bathroom but overall a decent place.

This was a really great place to stay! My friends and I are from out of state and we loved living the NY experience!! One would think that waking up with the train next to you is a horrible thing, but we loved it!!!!   I would recommended traveling in groups and not alone. The area is a tad sketchy, but it’ll be great traveling with a group!
Amazing place at a wonderful value.  Super easy check-in.  The place was thoughtful, clean, and homie.  The host was very kind and responsive.  The price of the place makes it a steal.

Stephany’s place is very clean and cozy. We weren’t able to meet her but Mr. Mario was very hospitable when he showed us the place. They have a ceiling fan and an airconditiner. The bed is comfy and there is a walk- in closet with hangers and iron board. Very nice and helpful. The area and location is perfect. It was near the bus stop and we never feel unsafe. Thanks again, Stephany.
Had a great time staying here, beds are comfy and apartment building was generally quiet. Everything was communicated clearly and was overall a stress free stay!

Noriko was so sweet. This is a perfect spot for a quick  stay in NYC without breaking the bank or being somewhere unsafe ...this is nice gentrifying location...hipster.....clean inside with all you need for a comfortable stay....2 beds....stove... fridge...grocery store up  the street....quiet...I'll definitely stay again

Everything was alright. The actual accommodation was really great, a lot of space and clean. The instructions were pretty self-explanatory about the check-in and we had everything we needed.  Unfortunately the neighborhood is quite scary I’d say. This was our second time in NYC  and we didn’t feel that safe on hour way from the airbnb to the metro station.

The place is exactly what we needed! Private, cozy and convenient. Luis was very easy to communicate with and provided flexibility with check in time. The apartment was clean with a nice small kitchen. The beds were comfy and clean! It has everything to make our stay comfortable. The only “downside” is that the neighborhood can seem shady and noisy at times, but we didn’t encounter any problems at all. I would definitely recommend this place!

My wife, two small children, and I stayed here for about a month while our nearby home was undergoing emergency repairs. This was a bit stressful particularly during the pandemic. Fortunately, Julian and Michelle were fantastic hosts and we were very comfortable in the lower apt in their building. They were readily available and happy to help with anything we needed, and otherwise left us to ourselves (the apt is quite private with separate entrance).  The space is beautiful, sparkling clean, and very comfortable/functional. Central air is a rarity in NYC, and was greatly appreciated on hot summer days. The kitchen was even thoughtfully stocked with a few items to get us going -- including some cold beer which took the edge off our housing emergency nicely!   I very highly recommend staying here

I don’t know where to begin other than to say everything about Luis & this location was 5 stars all the way. From the cleanliness of the place, the location, the immediate response & attention by Luis. I stayed with my young daughters for 5 days and would come back extremely late sometimes and never once felt unsafe. The unit is literally a 5 minute walk from a shopping plaza or the grand concourse station that can take you anywhere in the city. I could go on and on but it comes down to if you’re looking for somewhere to stay, this is the place!!!!
Julian’s apartment was great. Very clean and spacious. Well equipped as well. Location however can be a bit sketchy at night so do take care.

It wasn't a great start when our taxi driver spent the whole journey telling us how dangerous Bed-stuy was, but how wrong he was! We had an amazing stay in Jule's place.   A beautifully renovated Brooklyn brownstone with lots of space and character. Jules was a friendly and helpful host, we would definitely recommend. Thanks for the bagels! Bed-stuy was a vibrant and fun neighbourhood to live in for the week, give it a go!  Thanks also to Jules for allowing us to check our bags in so early too, much appreciated.

First of all, I would like to thank the hotel staff, in particular Robbie, who was extremely kind and helped us a lot in our efforts to add extra nights following several successive flight cancellations. Again 1000 thanks to him and his professionalism.  Thanks to him we will not hesitate to stay at Sonder again.  The location is ideal, close to all metro stations for getting around Manatthan. 2 steps from the WTC, 10 minutes walk from the ferry to the Statue of Liberty and Brookling Pond.  Many restaurants, fast food, supermarkets, souvenir shops nearby.  For my 2nd stay in NYC, this is the best location to visit the city.  The hotel and the rooms are very clean.  The super large and super comfortable bed and the room is very well equipped.  A very good stay at Sonder.

Staying in Audrey's  apartment was a nightmare as her old door lock broke in my hand as i was locking  the door to go out  for my PCR Test on the 25th December..Audrey had gone to work when it happened  and she was very much upset when i reported it to her and she made me paid for a new lock which cost me $200..The locksmith reported that the lock broke because of wear and tear and also it was not a good brand .Audrey also  put a friend of hers  on a loud speaker on her mobile phone and insinuated that i had fiddled with the lock. This made me feel very  embarrassed  and stressful,and i  couldn't  sleep all night.To make matters worse,Audrey on several occasions put her TV on a high volume which consistently disturbed my sleep. Her attitude  and behaviour created  an impression that she offered me a room for free which was not the case .At one point she came to my room and removed a brown cable without asking for permission  Rather she said,' I want to take something from the room' ,which i felt that she did not respect  my privacy . Overall ,Audrey's attitude  and behaviour defeated my purpose of having a peaceful a holiday in New York.
very low-stress! easy check in and out and it had everything i needed :)

Audrey is incredibly nice and had wonderful communication, the room is quiet and comfortable, and if you're planning to spend your trip in The Bronx it's a great value. That being said, if you're planning on spending your trip more down in Manhattan or the other boroughs this one's a little tough to get to and the neighborhood is pretty sketchy at night. (Got threatened by some stranger coming into the building one night - but obviously that's not Audrey's fault) Also be aware that towels aren't provided.

it was a super place with all amenities!  the apartment was very cozy and warm.  the hosts left us a small present in the fridge.  And also, I remember very much (which speaks of the care of the owners about the guests), there were umbrellas in each room, in case (and this happened) it will rain.  we came from California and didn’t even think about buying an umbrella.  to the metro station 14 minutes on foot, there is also a bus, but sometimes you can’t wait for it.  in general, the area is quite safe, it was not scary to get from the metro even late in the evening (although there were still stereotypes about the bronx area in my head).  in general, we are very satisfied with our choice, value for money.  recommend

Great hosts and quick responses! The place was spacious and comfortable beds. My only complaint is the surrounding area at night. It got really uncomfortable to walk and there’s a lot of activity going on in the corner of the streets which made us feel unsafe. You get a real feel for being in the city if that’s what your looking for this is for you ! Other then that the place is private and quiet.

The hosts were fantastic! Very accommodating and responsive. Made us feel like we were right at home. My girlfriend and I had no complaints about the apartment or the hosts. Only complains we had were the family that either lived or stayed upstairs were very loud during night time and sounded like they were dropping stuff on the floor or jumping throughout the night. And then the 2nd thing was that we had a couple of sketchy encounters at night time in the neighborhood trying to walk from the train station back to the air BNB we did not feel safe. But if you want exceptional hosts this is the place to be for sure

About a 17 minute walk from Times Square! Good stay, good restaurants near by. Be careful with parking...got a ticket when I parked in front of the hotel. Very clean. Outsiders that hang around are kind of sketchy. Other than that cool stay! Would come again!

The place is at a very good location, close to everything you want. However, a lot of people (not guests) hang outside of the building and smoke weed, which made us feel unsafe. The building inside usually smells like weed too. The studio apartment itself was very beautiful and comfortable, but we felt that it didn’t have good kitchenware nor elements for personal hygiene.  Additionally, the AC and the fans weren’t very good

I was in NYC for a month-long clinical rotation in Brooklyn. Decided to stay in Manhattan to experience the city, and I'm so glad I chose this flat. It was a 10 minute walk to the subway I took Brooklyn everyday, and I always looked forward to the walk and the sites/smells along the way.   Favorite things about this stay: location, cleanliness, safety, and the laundry service. - Location: library across the street, coffee shop/bakery down the street, close to Brooklyn, SOHO, little Italy, a short train to central park, museums, etc.  - Cleanliness: housekeeper is amazing. She cleans the bathroom, empties the trash, sweeps on a daily basis.  - Safety: As a female solo traveler, I never felt unsafe walking in the area or going to/from the flat, even at night. - Laundry service: I chose to pay $10 cash/week to have my laundry done. Incredibly convenient. The housekeeper even folded the laundry and washed my bed linens 2x during my stay (no charge).  if it's winter, bring your warm PJs!!!

Check in: To preface, I flew in around 10:30 and arrived at 11. It was an earlier check in, so I was glad he was able to accommodate us. However, I was scared for a short period of time because I called and texted quite a lot starting when we landed and he didn’t answer until I was 2 mins away. And I had to call repeatedly to get an answer. Then once we got there, waited outside for about 10 mins for him to answer again. Not a huge deal because he did eventually answer.  Aside from that, he checked in almost everyday to make sure we had everything we needed and if we were comfortable, which I do appreciate.  As for the place itself: Small, but it’s NY so we expected that. Also it was just me & my bf so we didn’t mind at all because even though it was small, we had everything we needed. If you are sensitive to smells though, I’d probably recommend you find somewhere else as this Airbnb does have a strong mothball smell. I personally didn’t mind because I kinda like the smell, but I could see how others wouldn’t. This Airbnb is close to the train, maybe a 7 minute walk and from there you can pretty much go anywhere. Also lots of delis and a grocery store for basics. Overall a pretty good place. 3.5/5
Great location of you want to have close to everything. The neighborhood is in a little shady area but I did not have any trouble when walking home late. Subways really close!
My stay at Cliff's was very comfortable, pleasant, and stress free.

Dani was a very communicative host and was easy to get a hold of. The apartment is comfortable for a couple on a weekend getaway. It is railroad style and is below the street level. There are neighboring apartments, and since it is such a small space you do have to be very cognizant of your sound levels. Great location in central Chelsea. It’s an easy walk to many restaurants and bars, the Whitney, high line, and little island. The bedroom window faces the street and there is street noise that can be heard. The bathroom tub didn’t drain which made for a slightly unpleasant shower experience & there was no toiletries provided (shampoo, conditioner, body wash, etc). Overall clean and comfortable - was a good stay for the weekend!  Recommend!

Dani was an extremely communicative and and overall wonderful host. She had the place very clean for our arrival and did a fairly decent job of describing the place.   I was expecting the place to be a bit larger based on descriptions/pictures and while I see how it’s counted as a “closet” didn’t find the closet to be very helpful or accommodating with 2 people.   The area was a bit worse than what I had anticipated, which I understand is out of Dani’s control. We didn’t feel as safe as could be given some individuals that were hanging around, but we made due and we’re by no means in any danger throughout our stay.   The price point I thought was decently accurate given the are of Chelsea and the location within the city. I didn’t think it was worth the entire price of the unit, but Dani’s customer service and communication made up for it.   Overall, we had a lovely trip to New York and we so appreciated Dani opening up her home to us, as that is not an easy thing to do.   Thank you,

Staying at Dani's place was a truly wonderful experience. Not only was it in the perfect location for all my sightseeing, but the price point was extremely reasonable. As an added bonus, Dani himself really made the stay special, as he was incredibly friendly, professional and communicative from start to finish. His flexibility enabled me to extend my stay an additional day without any issues whatsoever - he certainly made navigating New York City so easy and stress-free! All in all, you won't find a more lovely place or host than Dani.

We definitely enjoyed our stay at Tony's. Would definitely booked for future visits. It's clean and a lil more  spacious than I thought. Neighborhood could be viewed as sketchy but we were good! Subway is a block away, super convenient if you don't want spend a ton on Lyft and Uber.

Elle was very accommodating and her place is a STEAL for what you get! 2 bedrooms, and a full kitchen with appliances! I like how the bedrooms are on opposite sides of the place to give some separation! Very clean and super nice, safe location! Local to a rite-aid and train station! About a 40 min ride to the city!

The apartment is in a great, safe neighborhood. The downside is that it is located right next door to the Dwight School, so there is a lot of noise in the AM and PM. Garbage pickup also comes every evening around 10:30 pm and every morning around 9:00am. The furniture is new, and the unit is well decorated. There were even fresh flowers on the table, along with snacks, 6 water bottles and a bottle of wine in the kitchen when we arrived. Some downsides are that the apartment is not well lit, and there is only one wall AC unit in the bedroom. The desk is a good size, but there is no light, so very difficult to work there. The shade in the bedroom and the living room needs to be switched as they are either too long or too short on the windows they are currently on. In the bedroom, the main light randomly turns on and off on its own. The shower caulking has mold, and the kitchen sink does not fit properly into the cut out therefore the faucet sprays water everywhere if opened all the way. Also, there is no vent, so when cooking the fire alarm starts to go off. A step stool would be convenient as I could not reach anything stored in the top cabinets and I am 5’5”. The tv cable turns off by itself and must reboot. If you are trying to watch live tv it is a struggle. More importantly, I was assured there was a newly installed AND functioning washer and dryer in the building.  This was NOT the case. However, Mark did accommodate by sending our laundry to the cleaner. For the most part Mark responded quickly when I messaged him. A book with explanations about trash, tv and other necessary information would have been helpful. There was no broom, dustpan, or toaster when we arrived. When asked, Mark did provide these items. He also allowed us to leave our luggage after the check-out time until our flight departed.

Love the location and apartment. Clean and comfortable. Great and quiet neighborhood. Smaller than what we imagined from the pictures. The stairs to the loft and laundry area are steep and can be a little intimidating if you are afraid of heights. We enjoyed our stay.

The only reason I had any trouble finding the place was because I forgot about Elle's earlier texts about the correct address 🤡. Even then, Elle wasted no time informing us of our mistake.  The neighborhood was very quiet and peaceful, so we could return late into the night without worry of any danger. It's also very close to the nearest subway station, so going to Manhattan for sightseeing was a breeze.  The apartment was clean and pristine, and the beds were very comfortable. This was possibly one of the best airbnbs I've ever been to.  If you are willing to take a little longer on the subway to reach other NYC boroughs, about an hour to Manhattan, in exchange for a relatively cheap but exquisite airbnb experience, choose this!
This is a scam! Don’t waste your money and time! There is no way this place should be elected to be Airb&b!

The apartment is nice and good value for money. But please search "Hull Street and crime" prior to booking so you know which hood you are entering. We had a lot of noise from the street during weekends (loud music, car alarms, screaming, etc.) but did not feel unsafe.

Do not rent he is a scammer! Locks were changed the second day I arrived on a month stay and I was forced to call police and locksmith to obtain my belongings! He refused to work with Airbnb on solving the issue thanks to them I was fully refunded

We returned very late several times and did not feel unsafe. The room has a large bathroom as well as a microwave and refrigerator (very convenient for shopping). In the common area, there is a water fountain (very practical for leaving with fresh water). Finally, the staff is very nice; they all do to understand us and for us to understand them.
