Sohji House was absolutely stunning. It was just the two of us and our pup Maze but the apartment could host much more. The living room was our favorite because we are able to camp out in there and be lazy. The bed in the next room over is actually two beds stacked on each other and we were able to move one easily into the living room so my husband can sleep while I watched tv.  We love the office area in the small room but do suggest they put up a shelf or two in that corner.  Nothing compares to sleeping in that king bed tho. The sheets were smooth and comfortable and the blanket was soft. It was just the perfect nights sleep. AC quickly chills the room. We do suggest them put two small night stands in tables if possible.  The kitchen was clean and had exactly what we needed. We didn't cook much as their restaurant suggests were too good to pass up. The Vietnamese place was a gem. We loved the pho and coffee there. The New Brooklyn Fashion is definitely a must for your trip especially if you love brands. Not to brag but I did find some great steals.   Michelle had dog bowls for my Maze and wee wee pads if needed. That was a very nice touch. We really appreciate small touches like that. Definitely recommend!

A true dumpster of an Airbnb!  You are not given a key to lock the apt or your room, which means there is no security for your stuff if you leave anything in the apartment.  No mirror in the bathroom.  Walls of bedroom smeared with dirt.  Garbage bags of trash in the hall and closet.  Random junk in “living room” area.  Felt unsafe, dirty, and sad :)

Only a few steps from 116 st subway station. A good place to just go to sleep and take a shower. The kitchen is well packed to cook if necessary. Lots of choices of restaurants around the room. The host was quick to respond to my questions. Something to consider: As a woman traveling by herself I did feel unsafe waking around this neighborhood at night.

Thank you Manuel for making such a great stay for my mother! Having my mum come to visit her grand child living in bedstuy whilst we have a small apt that’s not capable of hosting my mum as we have a young child and limited space (not to mention during crazy pandemic times) was pretty stressful! But we found this great place that was super close to us and was very clean and comfortable totally relieved our stress from a new grandmother and son trying to look after a visiting parent. Thank you again Manuel for ensuring a comfortable stay for my mum! Would definitely recommend for anyone! And it was a great deal too!

The stay with Davis was excellent. The apartment is new and the place was spotless when I arrived and remained clean for the duration. The bed and pillows were very comfortable with fresh, clean linens and towel. The bed is high enough that I was able to store my bags underneath so even though the room and closet are on the small side (although decent for NYC), the room didn't feel cluttered, and I had a lot of baggage. The windows are good quality and the room is quiet.  The heat and air worked well. The private bathroom is worth the price alone. It is small but spotless with contemporary fixtures, rain shower, etc. There is only one quest room and the layout is convenient with the guest room/bathroom at one end of the apartment and Davis's rooms at the other end, so privacy is ensured. There is an open-plan shared kitchen in the common space in between the rooms, with a sofa, TV and table for the guest's use. Davis used the kitchen but did not use or spend time in the common space, so I was able to set up my work station on the table. Bedroom also has a new TV. The kitchen has modern appliances and is kept clean.  My one suggestion would be a black out shade or curtain in the guest room as the the room faces the main street and doesn't get completely dark due to the street lamps. . All in all a great stay, I highly recommend this location.
Great small Airbnb. Perfect alternative for a hotel. Neighborhood was a bit dangerous after 10pm but other than that, no complaints.

They were super friendly, which is an asset for travelers on a stressful day. I had no problem with it but the place is not always kept exactly like the photos and they didn’t follow the house rules perfectly. It was an easy environment so no problem, but don’t rely heavily on those expectations. The room, bed, and TV were superb! Thanks!

Check-in is easy. It is spacious for six people, but it is not ideal for eight people since there are only two bathrooms. The house is beautiful and greatly furnished. They had everything we needed (extra pillows and towels, laundry, pots/pans, etc.). It is a quiet location, but it is hard to find street parking, especially at night. The house is very secure and feels brand new inside. It is close to the subway station (10 minutes walk), but a little scary to walk alone at night. The only real complaint I have for this place is the bathroom at the lower level - the door doesn’t lock. Overall, we had a comfortable and wonderful stay at Yonathan’s Airbnb.

Yonaton’s place is very good. It’s spacious and modern, but I don’t recommend it for more than 6 people. The place only has three full beds and the two couches (one upstairs and one downstairs) are rather small.  Yonaton was very quick to respond to all of my questions which was very helpful.  Parking was a little hard to find, but we succeeded nonetheless. Walking at night in the neighborhood to and from the train station was a little scary, but we were safe the entire time.

Yonaton was communicative and helpful and this apartment is clean. I didn't like the walk to the subway as it felt unsafe but if you are familiar with this neighborhood then it was fairly close to subway. The kitchen was lacking some tools to cook with but we loved the gas stove, microwave, coffee maker and toaster oven. Everything worked great. The living room looked beautiful but realistically it needs another stuffed chair or a more comfortable couch. We were only 3 people and it was difficult to relax and watch TV.

The place was exactly as pictured and included plenty of pillows, towels and toiletries. It was clean and mostly quiet and I would definitely stay here again. There are many grocery stores, liquor stores, and delis nearby. Aside from that, the general area looked a little shady but I didn't have any issues.

Beautiful apartment in an unusual but friendly neighborhood: we didn't feel in danger. Metro about 10 minutes walk. Apartment: beautiful apartment with large living room and bedroom on 1 floor and 2 bedrooms in the basement: this part is quite damp and smells of humidity. Damage. Concerning the equipment: a lot of shortage: for 7 people, we had 8 dinner plates, 8 small plates, 8 bowls, 4 cups, 4 glasses, cutlery, 1 saucepan and 2 frying pans......having contacted the owner, he brought us glasses and 2 frying pans. Very good communication with the owner
This house was really spacious and looks exactly like it does in the pictures! The location is a little sketchy, but we had no issues with that!

LOCATION: This Airbnb is located in Brownsville. It was my first time in New York, and in hindsight I should have done more research. Although Yonaton describes the airbnb as being "nestled in an inviting neighborhood", Brownsville is not the place you want to go as a tourist. A simple internet search will surface a plethora of articles stating that Brownsville is one of the most dangerous neighborhoods in New York.  The subway is a 15 minute walk, but it was unsafe as my friends and I received many looks and had names yelled at us from the people living there. On top of that, early one morning, we heard one of the neighbors shrieking for help. When we ordered through doordash, the delivery driver told us to be careful around there. My friends and I, being women, were extremely scared and regret staying here. We ended up having to spend a lot of money on ubers to avoid walking around there. HOST: Yonaton at first appeared to be very nice, potentially allowing us to check in early. However, when the time came, he was unresponsive. When my friends and I expressed our concerns about our safety on the first night, he was unhelpful and unempathetic. We were hoping that he would be open to working out a partial refund and an early check out so that my girl friends and I could find somewhere safer to stay. He was extremely dismissive of our concerns and told us he will talk to a manager to see if his other airbnb’s are open. Then, he never responds back to me for the rest of our 5 night stay.  AIRBNB itself: On the inside, the airbnb looks nice. After a closer look, you can tell that the remodel’s finishing touches must have been done quickly. Door knobs are crooked, bathroom locks aren’t functional and the upstairs shower head barely works. There were no curtains for any of the windows, including the bedrooms. In the downstairs bedroom, there was a disgusting amount of dead bugs (over 30) caked on the wall. In the upstairs bedroom, there were dirty handprints found on the wall. When checking in, I recommend going around and checking that all doors and windows are all locked as we found that the door downstairs that leads directly to the outdoors was left unlocked. Also, the front door hardware was loose when we checked in so we had to re-tighten the screws and had to do so a couple more times throughout our stay. The airbnb states that it can sleep 8. However, there were not enough pillow cases or blankets for 8. We had to go buy these items, which we ended up leaving there since we did not have space in our luggage to lug it back home. Extremely inconvenient since Yonaton knew that we were a group of 8. The kitchen was well stocked with plates, bowls, cookware, utensils but lacked basic cooking supplies like oil, salt and pepper. We felt that it was inconvenient to have to buy these things for a rental stay. Considering all of this, I would not recommend this place to those visiting. It is on the cheaper end compared to other airbnbs, but please just spend the extra money to make sure you are safe and to avoid having to work with Yonaton. Every single person, including locals, that we told about our stay in Brownsville expressed their concerns and warned us to be safe. I refuse to believe that Yonaton, who's lived in New York for 10 years, is completely unaware of the risks. I’ve stayed at plenty of airbnbs and most of the time, the hosts are extremely welcoming and treat you like guests. It was obvious Yonaton does not care and will treat you just as a source of income. This experience has changed my friends’ and I’s views on Airbnbs.

Came to New york for the first time with my boyfriend and sisters. Yonatons place was very clean and looked like the photos. Bedroom upstairs was a bit cold due to heater not working. Host is very responsive.   Area is a little rough, but definitely did not feel unsafe, no issues with neighbors, and people are barely on the street was nice and quiet. Just mind your business.

If you're anything at all like me, airports stress you out. And plenty. As time moves on, the whole airport experience only becomes more and more and more stressful. So what can greatly lessen the stress while also landing you a 12 to 15 minute bus away from Flushing as well as from Jackson Heights? Luciano's digs! And for all the folks out there who have never been to downtown Flushing (the Chinatown of Queens) or the most diverse neighborhood on the planet, literally (that's Jackson Heights), you're really missing out and should consider lessening your LGA stress by staying as these lovely and quaint digs. Particularly great for couples as well as late night jaunts, as it's exceptionally quiet (no planes can be heard!) and plenty private,  I highly recommend this abode which is pretty reasonably priced too. On top of being a pretty dwelling, and to make matters even better, Luciano is flexible, understanding, friendly and kind. I wound up having no complaints whatsoever and that's saying a lot considering I'm a native NYCer and one of our pastimes is being very critical (or, as some would say, complainers! ha!). Stay here and reap the rewards! :)

Luciano was a great host and the place was amazing, it’s great for a sweet time with your partner and the location is great. There was leftover food from the last guest in the refrigerator which was spoiled and that was a bit unpleasant and he was slow to respond to but overall great experiences

The location of the apartment is great, close to the subway and to various restaurants, bars, etc. Cleanliness levels are okay. WiFi in the room is patchy - I had data on my phone, so it wasn't a big issue, but it could be for you. The host shares the space with the guests, including the bathroom, for which she claims usage privileges for almost an hour three mornings a week from 8-9, so depending on your schedule that might be inconvenient. Check-in was a bit unpleasant: the listing's address on the app is not the same as the actual address, which to be fair the hosts do mention in early correspondence. However, that is followed by a vast collection of house rules and info, so it might get lost. When I arrived at the listing's address (I had just travelled across the Atlantic, so I wasn't at my sharpest) and messaged the host since I was unable to enter, instead of helping me, she just said that the actual address had been shared with me already, and that I should reread house rules and info carefully before entering the apartment. In that moment, it seemed like an off-handed comment when instead help would have been needed. Other than that: I guess you get what you pay for.

We didn’t feel very comfortable in the apartment, especially after one incident. We quickly wanted to get a charging cable from our room and brought our friend because we didn’t want her to wait outside in the cold. It took us not even five minutes to do that. Nova noticed it and directly attacked us in a rude way without letting us explain that we were just in the apartment to pick something up. She accused us to secretly bring our friend in the apartment (that was definitely not our intention) and repeatedly told us „not to try it again“.  It was not the fact itself that we are not allowed to bring guests but the way she spoke to us.  In addition to that we found lots of (black) hairs in our bed and the Wifi wasn’t working at all (e.g. watching Netflix wasn’t possible)

We enjoyed our stay at Erica and David’s garden-level apartment. The space is bright and clean. Bedrooms are roomy and comfortable. The kitchen is well-appointed, including nice touches like coffee and filters provided. Erica is communicative and helpful. The keypad access is nice. The best feature of this place is a marvelous back patio with lots of seating and an umbrella for shade. If booking in near future, just confirm with hosts about status of construction projects, which constrain the space a little. Note also that hosts live upstairs, so we experienced a little more “monitoring” than we’re used to in other AirBnBs. The apartment is on a lovely block walkable to good coffee, restaurants, drinks, and transit.

I had a rough night I got locked out of my apartment and I’m a female which can be scary at night. George happily accommodated me urgently and was very easy to communicate with and get in. Thanks very much would book again!

Sadly this beach house on Staten Island had more cons than pros.    PROS:  --property is completely fenced in and in a quiet neighborhood --five minute walk to the nearest beach --patio is equipped with some bug zappers  --huge grass area with a jungle gym for young children to play on, which my children definitely enjoyed.   CONS:  --delayed timely and clear check-in/check-out instructions.  --patio and propane grill were made available however no there were no grilling tools or umbrella as the listing mentioned.  --couch with significant wear and tear.  --first two steps on the first landing were clearly patched up as evidenced by the cracked paint and plaster  --one of smaller bedrooms had no working A C  in spite of the vents being completely opened.     Overall the house had a plethora  of up-keep issues that needed to be fixed to give renters a more deserving and comfortable stay as advertised and promised.    Although it wasn't a complete bust it definitely made our family vacation more stressful at times. We did our best to make it an enjoyable experience and were highly disappointed by the false accusations of damage made in spite of my family doing our best to treat the home with the upmost care and respect

I loved staying here although there were a few things that caused me to give 4 stars. This was from my personal experience so maybe some things will be different for some others but overall I enjoyed my stay! 😊  Pros:  -safe area -subway is a short walk away (just around the corner)  -spacious room -beautiful bathroom -AC was perfect (coming from a Floridian we need that lol) -Amazing communication from the hosts and was very sweet -offered a solution to a little bump that we ran into which I appreciated -very roomy overall  Cons: -all windows were open so you would hear the occasional sound from the street but not too bad -We had to wash (she offered and we took it up because at least there was a solution) some towels as they were left wet in the cabinet from the cleaning crew -the window is open in the bathroom and it was a little breezy so just be aware of that -the bed is pretty hard like cardboard. If you love a firm bed then this is the bed for you! If not then maybe bring a mattress foam? -the fridge made a loud popping sound that woke us up multiple times and scared us when we were awake and the first two days it wasn’t cold so weren’t able to store food in there.

Very responsive host who was able to answer our questions. Having a late flight, the latter agreed to keep the suitcase for us for the day so that we could enjoy our last day. Quiet environment close to many shops. Manhattan is accessible in 15 minutes from the accommodation via the metro. The negative point is regarding the kitchen utensils, only a pan for cooking. However, the accommodation is consistent with the photos and very relaxing after long days in New York!

The communication before we arrived was alright. Machel was nice, helpfull and always in touch. When I recieved the complete information about the check-in and etc. I was a bit surprised about that the keys aren’t at the apartment but somewhere else. (But not really a big deal) The size of the apartment is alright but its very empty and minimalistic. (But things you need for your stay like a bed, table and couch are there.) There wasn’t a microwave but the host insured me that there is a gas stove which heats up any type of food really quickly. On the second day we almost had a visitor- someone tried from building hallway to open the front door and we got pretty scared. When I sent a message to the host, she didn’t even react. After a week of our stay, the huge and main problem started. The stove completely stopped working. So we couldn’tcook and heat up any meal. For three days the host tried to blame me for causing the issue. I had to record videos, send pictures, she asked me things a service comapny is supposed to do and she did not try to fix the issue. She made me feel like I was some dumb person that doesn’t know how to turn a knob.(By the way the whole three days it didn’t work, there wasn’t any gas smell, which I tired telling her the whole time, but she kept trying to tell me there was gas because the time on the stove is on.) Finally on the third day I had to stay in the apartment in my free time from 1pm to 6pm and support the service guy and the gas company that came to fix it. It turned out that the gas in the apartment was cut off. Please be aware that the host lives on the other coast and she has no-one there that will fix any type of problem or issue. As this airbnb is on 25th St. off Broadway, it's understandably small.  The studio is conveniently located, reasonably priced, and quiet (for Manhattan).  There is some construction noise, but I've heard worse.  Check-out is at 10.  For an extra $25, guests can stay until 11.  Just making checkout 11:00 would be far more convenient and apprecited.  When on vacation, it's unpleasant to have to rush or to have to deal with paying a fee (even a $25 one, for an extra hour of downtime).  That said, I recommend this establishment.

I love Machel apartment. It is very big with high ceiling. I felt very comfortable staying here. The area is super safe and quiet at night. I did not felt unsafe walking to the train station by myself at night. The kitchen has all the things I needed. Machel was so sweet she helped me receive my packages because my dumb*** decided to shop last minute for my trip. I would definitely stay here again when I visit NY. Thank you Machel!
The property manager was really unprofessional and annoying. He was very adamant About me being in and out if the building. Very sketchy persons in front of building. World not recommend

I’ll start by saying I didn’t actually stay here. My boyfriend and I walked here and that’s when I realized if you don’t know NY you definitely need to be doing your research. This place is located in a very dangerous part of NY and I definitely think the communication is not there. I understand that it was my fault for not doing the research so I wasn’t offered a refund as it wasn’t until the day of that I walked there but i’m just hoping that this helps to stop anyone else from being put in the same situation.
There are no instructions with how to check in and the Host does not answer their phone. I was locked out for hours trying to get in contact with a host in an unsafe neighborhood

The place was ok, for me I think it’s in a sketchy area. Her Communication was horrible took her a hour or more to reply. My key got stuck when I was checking in and I couldn’t get in and I was texting her to let her know. Didn’t hear back from her but I eventually got in. I asked to store my bags but it took her so long to reply I just went into the city and stored my bags there. Which I’m really glad I did because if I did leave them with her and I needed to get back into the place it would’ve took her a whole hour or more to respond. But the place was ok to lay my head for a night.

Inside, the apt is good and the host is  kind. Since the bathroom is a shared space, maybe it should be cleaned everyday (I believe that'd justify the cleaning charge or maybe it is and I didn't noticed). Location is not bad but the neighborhood was dangerous (at least during my stay). I didn't feel 100% safe walking around. If you are a party of 2+ else, you could find something bigger and safer just for you.

Very Good connections for the price (even if the area is a liiittle interesting. (We never felt unsafe, it was just a bit active like hearing people argue outside and watching someone get arresten by the nearest station.

The accommodation is located on subway line 1 which serves all tourist areas and main areas of NYC. About twenty minutes from Rime Square by metro, which allows you to make connections.  The neighborhood is lively, not dangerous but not very frequentable at night. However, we had no problems. Many restaurants and supermarkets nearby. The hosts are attentive and available. The accommodation is clean. Ideal for those who want to discover NYC. I highly recommend

Everything was great but a bit too noisy at night i had to let them know it was a bit too noisy can they keep their party down  i stayed their for a month and they had loud parties a few times a week the building is creepy and bums sleep in it all and all it was an experience

This Loft apartment is large and in a great location with modern amenities It has potential to be great  Location on a major street corner it is  noisy so you have to factor that in if that bothers you  The worst part of the stay was the terrible communication from our host He was almost impossible to contact and did not provide us with the address or the instruction on how to enter till minutes before check in which left us in freezing conditions stranded with our bags  On final arrival the place was not cleaned properly. Wet washing , dirty laundry was left in washing machines and drier Wet covers were put onto beds, dirty towels were left in a bathroom , fridge and cupboards had unused foods  and opened packets left and the internet was not connected.  When finally in the loft host tried to have internet repaired but this was an inconvenience to us   NO instructions given or left written for any feature of the apartment  Stressful  experience even if apartment good

The hosts were extremely rude and unprofessional. They were unresponsive to my or Airbnb’s communication and I was not able to access the property beyond the first day. They were unresponsive to requests to change the reservation timeline and to requests to access the property. I had to book another hotel last minute. They refused to refund the time for which they did not give me access to the accommodation.  On the day when I stayed there, the accommodation and neighbourhood felt very unsafe. I had to wait a long time for the host to come out and hand over the keys. They were unpresentable and disoriented. This is the worst Airbnb experience.  It is a mistake to book this accommodation. Do not do it.

My adult daughter & I made this sweet little flat our home for 5 days (our second trip to Brooklyn/NYC).  It's a short 5 min walk to the subway to get you into Manhattan - very convenient.   There is a decent size grocery store a couple of blocks away, however we enjoyed finding a Trader Joe's and shopping there - prices were a bit more reasonable we thought.  You will hear some noise from upstairs, but that is to be expected as there are small children and this is a wonderful old brownstone after all.  I say some - it's really not bad. Expect it around 7/7:30 - it didn't bother us at all as we wanted to get up and get out and about, but you should consider this when making your plans. The bedroom has a very firm memory foam mattress - comfy.  The living room has a couch that can be made into a bed, however we didn't find the couch as comfortable to sleep on as we'd hoped.  Jessica was great at answering our request for a comforter to add as a bit of a cushion and softening the area where the couch split. The area is perfectly safe to wander around in.  The look of the streets (a few blocks away from the apt) might seem sketchy and there are homeless people that might ask for change/food - they are harmless and hungry so we had no issue buying supper for a few - but we seriously felt very safe, often not getting back to the apartment until close to midnight.  I only mention it so if you are planning to reserve this place, you won't be surprised or wary. Jessica is very quick to respond to any queries you might have.

Had a good multi-month stay at Central Park Inn. The staff was responsive to communications. The neighborhood can be loud at night, but it doesn't seem like an unsafe environment. I would recommend them for anyone staying on the Upper West Side.

A couple of things, but first I want to say the stay overall was OK.  1. The building is not accessible, and the stairs are STEEP and small, which could be dangerous. Not that there’s anything you could do to change that, but it should be noted on the add  2. The host was a bit impersonal. Sent short answers and the place didn’t have any type of coziness to it.  3. The two bedrooms with full beds are really tiny. The bed in our room kept slipping off of the frame and the headboard kept pushing off the bed. The beds were also really small if you’re sharing the bed.  4. If the stay allows for that many people, there should be more than two rolls of toilet paper provided.   5. Super old key system, one set of keys for everyone in the Airbnb. Other places have had an electronic system with a code and that would be much better for a place with so many bedrooms.

This unit is a clean tidy place to stay. I stayed for 3 months. I’m a travel nurse, I work at night, my job can be super stressful and so I like to relax when I get off. This place allowed me to do that, the bedroom is super cozy and dark and QUIET.   Oppositely, the living room is full of natural light in the morning. The kitchen is light and bright as well, good for cooking and watching tv at the same time.   Kaz and his co-hosts are all very responsive and able to accommodate their guest(guests), quick response time.   I told them I was going to buy more hangers and a clothing rack and they bought it for me. Asked when I was going to be away from the home and had it assembled/ready to use before I came back.   Heat was a little issue, so I told them and they brought me a portable heater.  Shower/Tub is great and gets nice and hot!  Tip: use pillows to make couch more comfortable!  5/5 service 🥅  Location was good, close to stores for shopping, subway entrances, Asian grocery store next door, around the corner from the gym and a fruit stand. Street parking is hard to find.

Overall, this place was ok. It was budget-friendly. My daughter and I were turned off by the bed linens and it was a little suspicious that the upstairs door to the remainder of the house stayed open throughout our visit.

Beautiful apartment; incredibly spacious for New York! It's a pretty Brooklyn brownstone with all the necessary amenities. The host is very helpful and made sure we had everything we needed and check-in was super easy. Location is 10/10 -- steps from the subway and the 7th avenue covering literally all the cuisines you could think of & nail salons & coffee shops, etc. So bustling. It's a steal for the price considering other options. Definitely coming back....

This place is amazing! Super clean, organized, and cozy also in a quiet and safe area in Brooklyn. Plenty to do around the area, and super close to a train station /citibike which was clutch! Easy access to get to Manhattan if needed, and easy access to get into the unit itself. Hosts are nice and very quick to respond if needed. The price too for this is a steal. Highly highly recommend!

Very great location to stay if you’re gonna be in Queens for sometime and need a place to stay. Neighborhood has a lot of character but never felt unsafe. Sunny is a good host and can help give advice due to being a certified local.

The room Sunny offers is perfect. It is very clean and has everything we need. The bathroom is shared with another bedroom. You should therefore know that the cleanliness of the bathroom depends on the users. A shared kitchen is also available and is very functional.  Location-wise, the apartment is in a safe area. We never felt unsafe. The metro is a 5-minute walk away and takes you to Times Square in 40 minutes.  Finally, Sunny was very discreet during the stay but was able to be present when we had questions. I recommend this accommodation with excellent value for money.

Great value and comfortable bed/room! Definitely be prepared to not shower, and the neighborhood is a bit trashy and feels dangerous after dark. That said, it is a great value for NYC and the room is nice!

Great easy to get to location in good neighborhood even late late at night it was totally safe and there is always a few people around the bodega to keep eyes and ears out for trouble for the nervous at night. Room is comfy with a nice lounge and a super comfortable bed I slept like a baby in and woke each day refreshed and ready to attack the day with energy and the wonderful New York City energy. Will stay there again for sure

Place is as describe, near the subway but it was also a short Uber ride into Manhattan, also a very short 30 minute walk to the water taxi which we did and enjoy very much.    We did not feel unsafe in the neighborhood during our day walks. And we felt very taken care of with our host checking on us to make sure we found our way around the apartment.

Easy to find and get into the appartement. The area is very strange and a lot of homeless. The appointment was ok clean (don’t look under your bed !!) There is a cup but no glass. Towels and soap/shampoo available. Very loud place, the people upstairs were extremely loud (walking, talking, clapping the door,… at anytime at night). And you have noise from the outside too!  The appartement is kind of 2 places, so you have 1 toilet in the hallway.. and 1 full bathroom in the bigger appartement. The only good thing was the subway not too far (7min walking)

We had a great stay at Runa and Tusher’s apt . The neighborhood was a bit sketchy and the drive through Manhattan to get there was a bit scary. The place was clean comfortable and adequate size for 4 adults and 2 20 year olds who took the bunks . Layout is odd . Kitchen adequately stocked except needed to get coffee filters and the coffee pot very small . Walking to and from Subway was convenient but would not recommend doing the walk alone at night . We found street parking ok but got the last spot . A few take out restaurants and corner store within walking distance .

Entering the building was not easy. Rather than let me into the building, the host expected me to ring the doorbells of random residents until someone let me in. Her words: "ring any doorbell they always open." Unfortunately, this method of entry did not work. When I did finally manage to enter the apartment, I discovered that the apartment did not have hot water. I asked the host if she could fix the problem and provide hot water, but the host was not helpful. She recommended that I heat water on the kitchen stove, and use that water for showering. That is totally unacceptable.  When I again asked the host to fix the hot water issue, she tried to sidestep. She said, "it's something that comes out of my hands right now it's Sunday and a holiday because it's Father's Day." I had to pursue the issue with Airbnb.      I have never written a negative review before, but this host does not communicate well, and does not appear to care to fix serious problems. She failed to provide basic resources. Consequently, this was a very stressful stay.

Odalina was a super nice and communicative host. However, I can not in good conscience recommend this apartment. She asks you to ring random apartments to get into the building, which seems both rude to the  neighbours and unsafe. Do they let anybody in who rings? Are there random people roaming the halls who don’t live there? I didn’t see any, but I’d be worried if I lived there. The building itself has a set-back entrance, perfect for junkies and unsavoury folk and, indeed, I saw people on two separate occasions during one weekend either passed out or drug tripping in the outdoor entry area. Super sketchy and unpleasant. The lack of hot water and crappy water pressure in the shower are a real bummer, and I know this is not a temporary problem since several reviews have mentioned this. I know we’re in New York, but you could hear music, loud conversation, honking, sirens, and traffic for much of the night. Would definitely not recommend for single women, families with kids, light sleepers, or anyone who enjoys a hot shower. I have used and enjoyed AirBnBs many times in multiple cities, but in this instance, I wish I’d sprung for a hotel.

When we arrived at Kiki Cottage we found the bathroom extremely dirty (especially the shower & bathroom floor) as well as the kitchen area. We bought a few cleaning products and scrubbed these areas before use. We also though the number of electrical cords around the floor was unsafe especially when walking to the bathroom at night. It would have been nice to have a side cabinet along side the bed. It was also noted that during our stay that the neighbour played his drums between 20:15 - 21:00 the 4 nights that we stayed. We further noted that the place had no garden view as advertised. We enjoyed NYC and the vibe of Queens (and other neighbourhoods) but were left disappointed with our stay.

Ming was incredibly responsive any time I had a question - the only thing I will say is that shoes were stolen from the hallway after I was told to leave them outside. Take your shoes off in the hallway and bring them inside !

The room itself is dark as it's a basement it has very little light, and the floor is cold. It's ok for a short stay but for long or work from home can be a bit taff.  The kitchen is ok, can cook simple dishes. The laundry is next door. The location is good, just 6 min walk from the metro, 30 min or less you are in Manhattan. The area regarding safety it's more or less ok, at night I would be more careful as I've seen homeless and drunk/drug people on my way home from the metro. In general, I recommend, the host is taking care of guests, and is friendly and available.

Parking is not easy if you get to the place after 6pm. Theres a driveway but it's extremely narrow and we couldn't get out of the car. Also there's about 50 + teenagers that hang out in front of the house, blocking the streets doing drugs and talking inappropriately.  ( we were traveling with 5 kids and they were very scared) the place is nice but very small. We couldn't fit more than 3 people on the couch so we couldn't watch a movie comfortably.  I'd say this place is good for 3/4 people max. Andre was nice and responsive once we were inside the place, but he never gave us entry information and we arrived late and had to sit in our car for a while to get instructions to enter. We were actually about to head to a hotel because the kids were scared and uncomfortable.

The drive into NYC/Brooklyn was a bit scary as I’ve never really driven in a busy city anywhere near as big as New York City. After finishing the stressful drive, walking into The Sunrise was such a nice and relieving feeling! The interior was absolutely gorgeous, and made us feel right at home! Definitely recommend The Sunrise to anyone looking to stay for a few nights in NYC/Brooklyn!

Really nice apartment in a horrible area. Does not have two bedrooms just one. I would not rent again as the entire time I felt very unsafe. Also area if very loud all hours. Not sure this should be listed on air bnb.

The place is great. The neighborhood could be dangerous as we witnessed some incident during our stay. However, it’s hard to find a safer place in Brooklyn.  On the other hand, the commute was very easy for me. Transportation is nice.

My wife and I were very excited about this trip with our infant son, however, the  time we stayed in this AirBnB was extremely uncomfortable due to the non-functioning AC. We were told about the AC not working the same day as our check-in (during our flight across country to NY) - too late to make any last minute changes/reservations, and could not find another reservation that was safe/comfortable etc for 2 nights.  So for 2 nights It was over 90 degrees in the humid apartment. we had very poor sleep, even with the second night when they brought a window cooling unit (this was helpful but the bedroom was still very warm itself and we had to leave early. This was not only a comfort issue but potentially a safety issue for my pregnant wife and 1 year old son. We were unable to enjoy any time in the apartment due to the heat. Because of this, we requested a refund of the two nights stayed at the apartment, but were denied any refund. we were only allowed to change our initial reservation from 5+ nights to just the two very uncomfortable nights there.  This created an extremely stressful environment for all of us, and we booked another residence as quickly as possible. AirBnB should absolutely assist with this refund, but they said it's all up to the owner. Now we now the risk we run with AirBnB I guess... my family will gladly use VRBO, hotels.com, or any of the other competitors who we have not had this kind of experience with in the future.

We are a family from Germany with two teenagers and had booked "The Sunrise" in advance from Germany for 4 days in New York. Since we weren't sure which subway station to choose when traveling by public transportation, we asked two police officers at Penn Station if they could help us. They strongly advised us not to go to this address (original statement: It's a shithole there, you'll be robbed"). After a passer-by told us something similar and it was getting dark, we looked for an overpriced hotel near Penn Station and then asked 5 police officers again how they thought we could go there or not. All 5 of them strongly advised us against it, saying it wasn't safe for us there. We then went with us We contacted "The Sunrise" to cancel our stay, but we were met with no understanding or accommodation. The message was that we should have found out more about where to book in advance. This is of course not so easy from Germany, we were not aware in advance that there are such big differences within Brooklyn as to where you can and cannot go Labor Day Weekend) and would like to pass this experience on to others. We may be more cautious than others, but if 7 police officers in a foreign city advise us not to drive to the address given and live there, then we stick to it.

This apartment was very clean and the rooms are beautiful! Just so you know, the closest subway station (Van Siclen Av, J and Z train) is 0.4 miles away, and there is a steep hill involved. For some reason, the GPS would always send us to the Broadway Junction station and had us walk from there, but that one is further away (0.9 miles). You can take the J train from Broadway Junction and go to Van Siclen. We felt safer arriving to Van Siclen Av, as well. The immediate area of the station is a bit sketchy but as you walk toward the apartment it gets better. We felt safe in the area where the apartment is located.   The AC/heat units were a bit tricky for us. Make sure that when you leave for the day, you leave the units in the temperature that you would like for the night because it seems like they take a while to heat the whole apartment. Overall we had a great time and we would come back!

Marianny was super attentive, checked in with us regularly during our stay made sure if everything was okay. The place had everything we needed, finding a parking spot in NYC could be very stressful and time consuming. This place has its own driveway so it's very convenient. Very neat and cleaned. Everything about this place has been great. Will possibly return in the future. Thanks again for having us. 😊
Main building was very dirty and sketchy. Small apartment, but good value overall.

It was nice to find an affordable place in such a great location, however we got what we paid for. It was very difficult to sleep each night of our stay due to loud banging noises coming from the pipes/heating. There was also a separate hissing noise coming from the radiator, which the host was able to help fix, however the loud banging noises remained for the duration of our stay. We were woken up several times each night. If this was a known issue, we should have been warned. If it was not, more could have been done to fix the situation or they could have offered a partial refund.  Outside of the noise, the unit itself is mostly clean and contains amenities as advertised.  The shower drains VERY slowly (sometimes over an hour) and so be prepared to stand in used shower water if using it after someone else.  This was our first time in NYC so we are not sure if this is a normal setup, but the building seemed sort of sketchy. The hallways are dark and dank, and the unit itself is interior-facing so your only view is other apartment windows and brick walls. The building is very close to Herald square and is in the middle of Manhattan, so the location is ideal if you want to explore the city - but if this is your first time in New York or a big city in general the area might feel a bit unsafe to you.  Honestly if it weren't for the great price, location, and inability to find something at a reasonable price while we were already in New York, we might have put up more of a fight/asked for a partial refund. All in all we had a great time in New York, however we would not choose to stay here again.

The place was clean but very small. The listing mentions that it hosts 4 people, but it felt on the small side for just two people. There is little natural light, as the windows face a wall.  The heating system is a bit noisy at night, and the AC seems to be installed in an unsafe way: there is a notice on a piece of paper warning guests not to open one of the windows, otherwise the AC would fall down.  The location was great, the host was very responsive, and check-in went smoothly.

Marianny’s apartment was definitely homie! It was my husbands and I’s first time in NYC and it was definitely a memorable experience. We were in contact with Marianny and Kacey (apartment manager) whenever we needed something (which we didn’t) only when we walked right past the building. The area to some may seem sketchy but we honestly felt safe and at home. The subway locations were close, one was a 7 minute walk and the other 4 mins but we got to both in what felt like 3 mins honestly. There is a deli right down the sidewalk that we ventured to for snacks, drinks. There was also a yummy little Chinese restaurant that was right down the way from the deli and that was so yummy! (Only took cash just an fyi) We even were out and about at 11pm to 1am the next day and we seriously felt safe. So just want to throw that in there don’t be thrown off by what you look up. Overall we definitely will be using Marianny’s home again when we come back to NYC and just can’t say enough about her!

Marianny’s place was absolutely beautiful! We couldn’t talk enough about the decor alone. It was extremely clean and homey as well. Our host was also very responsive / attentive. The driveway was a major+ too as it took the stress out of finding parking.

This space is ideal for a single or pair of travelers who want reliable apartment basics for an extended weekend trip. It is in a great location for exploring Midtown or Lower Manhattan, and not too far to Brooklyn. The host is a great communicator, making arrival and departure logistics stress-free.
I cannot stress enough how great the location is close to Columbus Circle. Doormen are fantastic. Building is secure and safe. Perfect place for a extended trip in New York.

Great location, nice apt with central heat/air, beautiful roof deck at the top of the building, clean, comfy bed, etc.   Zeid is also SO on top of things, even when he was 9 hours ahead traveling, and so communicative. I had my purse stolen (with his key!) and he responded quickly with a solution in a really stressful time. Highly recco.

I wish I didn’t have to write my first negative review. There was trash piled in the hallway the entire trip and when we arrived. The listing said air conditioning, but there wasn’t any when we showed up the week of a heat wave. Penny remedied that with two window box air conditioners the next day (after telling us to “crack a window” when all the windows were open), but only in the bedrooms. The rest of the place was sweltering. I also had to wipe a significant amount of dust and dirt off them. Whoever installed them left two of the TVs blaring and track lighting on, which scared the hell out of us when we got back. Something black and moldy fell from one of the ceiling fans in the living area. Maybe an old balloon? Looked like moldy fruit. The guy downstairs blared music/TV all hours day and night. Weed smell was so strong wafting up the stairs that it filled the apartment. And I’m not kidding you…. A few nights in, the bed broke underneath me. I don’t weigh that much. We also coughed a lot whenever we were in the apartment. I assume it was the dirt caked on the windowsills, but maybe there’s mold? Truly the worst Airbnb experience.

don't come here. they steal. they stolen my iphone on new years day. I woke up on vomit.  NOONE came to their place but me. they were other people in the house and they use not speaking english to steal from me. i'm writing this review because we all want safe stays without losing important belongings.
A very warm welcome from E&F J who waited for us despite the lateness of our flight at JFK and who introduced us to life in Brooklyn like no guide could have done.

If you want a calm spot where you can relax after the NY crowd, you are in the right place : a large appartement, very very (and I insist !) very clean, no noise at all, bright, in a nice area,  close to the subway who will take you downtown in no more than 20 mn, perfect !!   Francis was very helpful despite he was abroad for holidays, he replied very quick to every question I had. He left us the keys in a locker and it was very easy to access the flat.   A point I really appreciated at Francis' was the beds : as a tall person with back issues, it's always stressful for me to sleep outside because 80% of the time I experience back pain in bad airbnb beds. No the case at all in this flat !!! Really good beds :)   Well, really nothing negative to say. I will return at Francis for sure if I have the chance !

This is a perfect studio apartment for those looking to spend time in Brooklyn. Prospect Park was less than a block away and coffee, pastries, restaurants, drug stores, all within a couple of blocks. I hope to come back again.

We very much enjoyed our stay. The apartment is clean, tidy and well decorated. The facilities were also comfortable and homely.   It is a little far away from Manhattan, having said that there is a lot to do and explore in the Brooklyn area, so we had the best of both. There are also good connections on the C, J and Z trains to get you in the city. Would highly recommend visiting the Brooklyn brewery for free tour and catch a nets game nearby at the Barclays centre.   We made use of the bag storage and spoke with Francis via the app and Ring video doorbell to make checking in and out easy.  Great host, great apartment, great city!   Rob and Mark

Place was fantastic. The place around can look a little sketchy in the area but don’t let it scare you. We walked back from the Subway several blocks at 2 in the morning a couple times and never felt threatened or scared at all. Ha everything needed and would stay and probably will stay again next time !!!!

Best experience ever! I took my siblings and nephews as a gift for their birthday and graduation.   This was our first time in NYC and as the adult taking care of 4 made me nervous and scared. Marvin and Sophia picked us up from the airport and on our way to the house Sophia gave us tips and advice on places to visit as well as how to get there. They showed us around the home and after along 5 hour flight they had breakfast ready for us. Beagles, cereal, coffee and muffins! Sophia and Marvin were sweet and kind we felt safe throughout our stay they would message me to make sure we were ok they also made them selves available for rides if needed. That reassured me that we were safe! I knew if we were to get lost they were only a call away. The home was excellent exactly how it looks in the pictures very clean and well equipped fit 5 perfectly. The subway was 2 blocks away really easy to find. I can go on and on of how great and beautiful this home is not only the home the host's aswell but I'd rather you visit and see for your self. Marvin and Sophia made this experience a wonderful one to know that there is kind people that truly care and want your vacation to be a great one. They made us feel like family dropped us off at 4am at the airport and we said our goodbyes with a warm hug. I wouldn't call it a goodbye but more like a see you soon because there is no other place we'd rather stay but with them.

Marvin was an excellent host! From the moment we entered the city he made us feel as if we were family. He was always available and considerate of our needs. The apartment was very comfortable and contained more than enough space for my family (wife+3 kids). Public transportation is a short walk up the street which was our primary means of getting around during our stay. We walked back and forth many times during the day and night and never felt as if we were in danger. Bottom line is this apartment is an excellent deal for any trip to NYC!

Marvin was not at home at our checkin, but had everything perfectly arranged. We also appreciated the breakfast items. House was perfectly suites for the five for us. The neighbourhood did not feel unsafe at all us, even after midnight. We knew in advance that transport to / from Manhattan would take al least 45 minutes, so we had long days ;-).  We appreciated it very much we could let our suitcases in apartment the whole afternoon on the day of our departure!   Recommended to do: see a musical in Broadway (buy your tickets on the day itself in the TKTS office in brooklyn for 50%), go see a Mets baseball game and go eat at Ellens Stardust diner !

The apartment was well lit and clean for the most part. We checked out the bathroom as soon we got there and happened to find a centipede in the bathtub which scared us a bit. Neighborhood is not the richest part of New York but it's close to subway stations and about 45 mins via subway to manhattan. The place did have a weird scent when we arrived and two air fresheners that blew puffs of room spray through the day and night.

The neighborhood is kind of sketchy, but I didn't have any issues walking to and from the subway (3 blocks away). The place had a weird odor despite having multiple air fresheners. There was also quite a few centipedes during my stay. Marvin was a good host checking in if we needed anything. It was nice having simple breakfast provided (bagels, cereal, oatmeal).

This was my first trip in the USA. NY is so exciting and unsleeping city. The neighbors are safe even in the late night. I often come back to the home, but I didn't feel be dangerous there. Fatu is a nice and friendly host. She took me around neighbors when I arrived. I'm satisfied to stay there.

We had a good time at Marvins apartment. It was very clean and had all we needed. When we had questions he answered quickly. When it rained he left us umbrellas to use. The neighborhood is residential so there were no close restaurants. There were a couple fast food places a few blocks away.  The area did look a little sketchy,  but we stayed in a group and never had any problems.

The street and the area were rather noisy, littered and, with a 1 hour drive to Manhattan, a bit far away. The apartment itself was clean, but traces of mold have now appeared in the bathroom on the silicone edge of the bathtub and on the entire ceiling. The floor of the apartment took a lot of getting used to as it was very uneven, the direct entrance door to the apartment above was missing, which was very dangerous with small children. We solved this problem by putting our strollers in front of it. Otherwise, communication with Marvin went very well; our breakfast was provided for the first few days. The apartment is now a bit worn out, but is completely sufficient for overnight stays.
Apartment as described, no unpleasant surprises. Well located between two subway stations and close to Central Park. No insecurity problem.

Was a very good experience!! My stay with Carol was wonderful, I got more than I expected and I’m afraid I couldn’t say enough good things about her and the place. Carol took care of me during my stay, I have been texting her asking about the way and she was very helpful, when I arrived to her place she was waiting for me and my room was clean, quiet, nice and comfortable. The neighborhood is quite and nice, the bus is very close. Carol is a very welcoming, friendly, gracious and very generous; she has always fruits on the table and basics for breakfast, when I come back home hungry she always find some food for me,  Carol was also checking on me when I’m in the downtown and make sure that I’m fine, She was worry because it was cold and I didn’t bring enough cloths and she gave me a sweater to use it. I would like to stay more and certainly I would stay there again. I have been feeling that I'm at home. Thank you so much Carol!!

We, my wife and two kids, stayed for one month at Trang and John's apartment and were very very happy with our stay. They were really flexible and helpful to us and made sure we would feel at home, which we did.  The apartment was spacious, clean and had a nice atmosphere because of a lot of daylight coming in at the top floor. Very nicely preserved brownstone building. The location of the house was great, next to Morningside Park, playgrounds, lots of places to eat and shop, and subway (with elevators) around the corner. The atmosphere on the street was relaxed and not what you might think of Harlem. The idea of the neighborhood being unsafe is outdated. At least for the part where the apartment is located. I would surely come back here, when the opportunity calls for it.

Eric was a great host! Although we didn't meet him in person everything worked out perfectly. He was very uncomplicated and checked on us during our stay. Communication was easy as he answered in a few minutes every time we had questions. The apartment was clean (except for a few hair in the shower) and cozy. At night the area can be a bit scary but it was all fine.

Eric was very kind from the very beginning. The apartment was neat and convenient. We had a problem with the Wi-fi and Eric was very helpful to solve the problem. The neighborhood seemed to be scary, but we walked around at night and had no problems. There were 2 subway stations nearby. I recommend this apartment, and I would really like to comeback.   Eric foi atencioso desde o início. O apartamento estava arrumado e tem tudo que se precisa em uma viagem. Tivemos um problema com a conexão Wi-fi e Eric se mostrou prestativo e tentou resolver de imediato. O bairro pode assustar a noite para quem não está acostumado, mas era super tranquilo de caminhar e não tivemos nenhum problema com a vizinhança. Haviam duas opções de metro. Super recomendo e voltaria tranquilamente mais vezes

Don't stay here if you want to feel safe. The area is awful. Nothing but sketchy people walking on the street and ugly convience stores. Parking was awful. As far as the host, she seemed super nice. I wish I could have met her in person.  But as soon as I got to the area me and my two friends (who we were  previously sleeping in sleeping bags in random parks and felt safer than this neighborhood) decided the area would have been way to sketchy. I had my laptop camera and all that and would not have felt safe leaving in my car. Plus we wanted to be out at night, there is no way I would have felt safe walking around this neighborhood at night. I tried to get refunded but I still got charged and I didn't even stay the night ....

We enjoyed our two night stay here. The air conditioning was great after a long day of walking in the heat. The place was spotless. Out of consideration let the hostess know you have recyclables. Easy access to the subway one block away and a short 20 minute ride to Time Square. The street is low on crime. You can park for free on a street a block away on the street on weekends. The hostess can give you the name of the street. The beds are comfortable. My son, husband and I would definitely stay there again.

I'm afraid I didn't enjoy my stay at this apartment and ended it early. The host was absent and not very attentive. The apartment hadn't been properly cleaned and generally needs some work to bring it up to code (floors repaired, walls painted, new shower curtain, etc.). These issues might have been easier to live with if some effort had been made to make me feel like a welcome guest. But when I arrived all the closets were full of the host's possessions so there was nowhere for me to hang my clothes or put anything away; the fridge was full of food belonging to previous guests (most of which was opened and some out of date) and there was no room whatsoever in the kitchen cabinets for me to store my own food.  I was very surprised by the lack of attention to these basic issues as the previous reviews were generally positive. But sadly, my experience was not. It was a pity as the apartment was nicely furnished and could have been a decent rental if more effort had been made.
Very friendly welcome. Apartment well located 2 minutes from the metro. The metro is still noisy but didn't stop us from sleeping. No need to fear! the stay at Crystal's was great!

The apartment is big but not so comfortable (the window doesn’t open and the air conditioner didn’t work - it was hot).  We could use the kitchen any time, what was great.  At night the neighborhood is noisy and a lit bit dangerous (we could hear people arguing and breaking bottles in the street).   The host seemed a lit bit inflexible with the check out and to keep the luggage.

This was my first airbnb experience and I'm very much afraid that it spoiled me for everything to come.  The location was perfect: the very heart of DUMBO and a block from the incomparable Superfine Restaurant.  I was able to pretend I was a Brooklyn hipster without having to grow the ironic mustache.  The space was huge and beautiful and everything clean and comfortable.  I will be back if they'll have me!

The room is small but comfortable for two. Carlina is very nice and provide everything we need. However, there is a mouse in the room which scared us. In general, the room is good, but with the mouse, we can barely sleep.

My family and I's experience at Marcia's loft was incredible! It was our first time to share a place with the host and we extremely enjoyed it! At first, we got scared as it's our first time but when we got to converse with Marcia, we instantly felt home in her home <3 She welcomed my family and I and even exchanged stories! We loved having her rescued cat too! Her place was very spacious and reflective of her as an individual - creative to the max!! My brother and I even got inspired by the design of her loft! My family and I wish we had stayed longer as her loft was really beautiful despite the loud noice the subway made (it added up to the Dumbo experience I should say!) but we had a flight to catch and Marcia was kind enough to extend our stay for our late night departure. Thank you again, Marcia! We can't wait to go back because of your home! Would definitely recommend to my friends too :)

Good location with respect to Subway.  Good places to eat in the surroundings.  The spring water was available for only a few days. It's not a problem for Carlina to enter the room and move my things, as long as I let her know so as not to cause a scare when I return home...I thought they had broken into me!!! I was never able to have breakfast because there was no one there before 8 and they never explained to me where to get breakfast. The room is very warm and the beds comfortable.

The space is good, just as seen in the photos.  The cleanliness of the place is good.  However, the neighborhood is dangerous and most days there is a lot of noise in the street and it can be heard in the room, because the window is external.   Most days, especially from Thursday to Sunday there are street parties with a lot of noise, alcohol, smokers and music.  In front of the apartment there is a gas station and the cars have loud music until dawn.

We had an amazing stay in Sol apartment. I booked this place for 10 days with my friend.  Couch family and house is great. The rooms are nice and are of decent size, Location is good, close to different shops, restaurants, cafes and subway station. Listing description entirely accurate and the room are just like as in the pictures. We walked around the neighborhood both day and night, and never felt neither unsafe nor uncomfortable. Really felt like home. A trip into the city is an easy 30-35 min ride.   I would recommend staying here if you're looking to explore the city and want to stay in a vibrant neighborhood with lots of little shops and cafes at the same time. I will definitely return without any hesitation. In short, a great stay and a perfect choice for New York City. Highly Recommended  Thank you Sol and Couch. You were the best host. It was a memorable trip.

Enjoyed the stay at Marea, excellent location, in the heart of Manhattan with access to lots of good restaurants and bars, however very quiet. So for those who value a good rest, the apartment is great. Also, a generous inner-yard is a rare and highly enjoyable NYC find.  Marea is great, hospitable, and open. She has thoroughly put together a set of recommendations which are awesome.  The only point to mind is the fact that this is a legal Airbnb accommodation. On the one hand this saves you the hustle of getting different unpleasant interactions with neighbors or authorities, which is common for many ad-hoc accommodations which do not follow the formal process. However this implies also paying in cash a separate tax as Airbnb does not offer the option to cover this directly in the app.

The best thing about Elisa's apartment is that it is located a few steps from a subway station and very close to many of the best-known tourist attractions in New York. Although I didn't meet her personally, Elisa was very kind and told me as best as possible how to enter the apartment and other details. The silence and privacy are also notable, as are the small explanatory notes throughout the apartment. I can't complain about the lack of good sheets and a bit more cleanliness in the room because I requested the room very little in advance. Although when I arrived in the neighborhood (East Harlem) I felt unsafe, I didn't have any problems and the people were friendly. There is a large Hispanic community so Spanish is common in the area, in stores and restaurants. The only problematic and really tiring thing is going up and down the six floors of the building with a heavy suitcase because there is no elevator, something that, however, is not very serious. Thanks for everything Elisa!

Elisa's place is really super convenient form the subway station. And her room is clean and save, and the space is enough. Her response and attentive feeling is very good.   The area is in the beginning of Hispanic harem, I didn't feel scared, but Spanish is spoken mainly wherever I go, and the street is a little bit dirtier than even one street on the downtown side.  I think it's a difficult problem in all New York, but the only problem is that almost of apartments don't have an elevator and you need to go up the stairs with a large load. It seems that you may hire a person who will bring your luggage, but this is probably because there are circumstances, random, and I can not give official guidance, so I am not used to this mechanism I will eventually go on and go back on my own I took my luggage to the 6th floor, but not impossible.
Clean sheets and clean towels. Got a free ride to the subway. The area didn't not seem unsafe. Available to check-in on a short notice and flexible to check-out. A little far if coming from Newark
I felt very welcome and safe in their house. The neighborhood seemed a little unsafe and their daughters walked with me to get Chinese food. The room was really cozy and nice.

Dean made our stay very comfortable! It was the perfect spot to stay for our one night stop over in NYC, very close to JFK airport making it stress free for our early morning flight. Dean was kind enough to pick us up from the airport, and made sure we able to get some dinner the evening we arrived. The bedroom was clean and the bed was very comfortable. Thanks again Dean.

The communication was perfect with this the hosts. They were always available! The house was very modern and it has a nice washing machine. 2 minute walk to the metro station - M line. The neighborhood location is great but there are some shady characters around. There is a grocery store right around the corner, Mr Kiwis, that's open 24 hours. The house was clean enough for the value but it was somewhat loud at times, seeing as you're in the basement and that the neighborhood is not the greatest. Overall, if you can handle the local ruckus, it's a perfect spot with a friendly hosts, great location, and fast wifi. Enjoy!

My English is not good enough to say deeply thank you to Dean&Paula. We are from Vietnam and it is the first time we have been here. Last night, when I took luggage for my wife and my 20 months old, 2 men came to me in JFK terminal 8 and they asked me to find taxi. My son was tired owing to long journey and I said yes. After that they took my family to their car. My son cried a lot. Immediately, I thought something wrong here, so I took a video inside the car. They took us to Dean ‘s house, but we were worry about that. 10 minuets later, we were near Dean’s house as they said (I did not know it is Dean’s house or not), I asked them for paying Visa card, but they said only cash and the total is 180 USD (including tax). I thought they are not good men, however the weather was very cold and my son cried, so I paid them 2- 100 USD. 10 second later, they said that I gave them wrong amount , it was 2- one USD, not 2 - 100 USD. After thinking deeply, I decided to give them more other 2-100 USD. I asked them to do a favor a hand carry my luggage because we have a lot of baby luggage. After that, I rang a bell and Dean’s daughter took me to their home. I checked carefully and I knew that I gave them 400 USD (2 times - 200 USD) and they refunded 20 USD + gave 2- one USD. I sent a message to Dean, after 30’ minute Dean and Paula was in my room. They asked me the video, the picture, can I recognized 2 men. Then they took me to airport. To be honest, I had no idea that I can take my money back, I only wanted to avoid for other people in the future. Fortunately, when we came to JFK, terminal 8, I recognized one man, I told Dean, he asked this man who said that he did not know me. However, his face was very worry, he tried to call someone for helping. Dean was not afraid of 2-3 men, he said Paula look after me and took me to their car. Paula called police after that. I was in their car in a while. Dean came back car and took me my money - 379 USD. I was very surprised. Then they took me to police office to make report and gave police important information about 2 men car and what happened... Finally, they took me to their home. I met my wife and my son, and I was very happy. It is amazing, it is unbelievable. Dean and Paula acted as hero in movies that I watched in my country. I said to Dean that I was worry for him because they know Dean ‘s face and they can be avengers. Dean...

Apartment perfectly matching the photos, very well placed to reach Manhattan quickly. The area is popular but we never felt unsafe, including when we returned a little late in the evening. Very good bedding. Very good wifi. Cathy and Scott were very attentive and always easily reachable to answer our questions with great responsiveness; They gave us good advice for shopping and restaurants in the area. It's really a great place as a starting point for visiting New York.

Had a nice stay for three weeks at Ridgewood, Queens with Marina and other room mate.  The Airbnb is located within a five minute walk to two subway stations that are in different directions.  One station -  Myrtle-Wyckoff  has the L and M train.  Seneca AVE station just has the M train.  40 to 45 mins on train to 42nd street Bryant Park Station on the M TRAIN...that's where the majority of the Broadway shows are.   Cafe on corner called MILK AND PULL cafe ... Corner of Madison and Seneca Avenue 30 metres from your front door.  Washing machine and dryer in the basement level... One dollar for dryer, you need quarters.  One dollar fifty cents for washing machine.  On Seneca Avenue lots of dairies or convenience stores do nice eggs and bacon on a roll or Philly Cheese steaks on a hero roll.  Ridgewood is not MANHATTAN...but it is safe.  A very working class neighborhood.  Good value for money Airbnb.  Nearby Chinese restaurant and nearby Taco place off Madison that is cheap.  I never felt unsafe there, it's very Working Class Suburbia and lots of Latino people who were very nice. Thanks John Mathieson New Zealand

After a stressful two hour immigration wait and a yellow cab ride from JFK with what has to be one of the most useless drivers in the city, we arrived in a tired and edgy state. However, this was quickly remedied by a lovely welcome from Dean and Paula’s daughter who thoroughly and expertly briefed us. The apartment was very spacious, immaculate and beautifully furnished . The kitchen was supplied with everything needed for hot drinks and there were trays of sweets, a lovely touch. We met Paula, a lovely lady, the following morning and she very kindly offered us a lift to the airport. However, we simply took an Uber to the city. All in all, cannot recommend highly enough. Thanks.
Easy to get to, GREAT space, love the layout, relaxing in a quiet neighborhood, convenient to drug stores and grocery.

Erik’s house is an amazing place. Pros: Concerning its location, it has a drug store, and several markets available practically on your doorstep, one of which is open 24h. Public transportation is within walking distance. The home in itself is spacious, well equipped, and in a quiet area.    Cons: A lot of spaces certainly need maintenance (painting, plumbing, insect, and rat extermination). The largest inconvenience we faced was that during our stay Erik scheduled several of these small maintenance visits with painters, exterminators, and mechanics to fix several issues in the place with us in it. We didn’t feel we had that much privacy and this made us feel uncomfortable during the time we were there. Despite this, we were able to have some quality family time in this house.
Host is amazing. Parking in front of house consistently, that's saying something for NY. Place is ultra clean. Facilities are top notch. Yo, this is a steal. Just go ahead with it - MS3
Great area and didn’t feel scared to subways or buses. I would recommend staying here, the host was great!!! Make sure to bring walking shoes.

We did a long term stay at Sam and Graces (six months) and found them to be awesome hosts, very helpful and thoughtful and communicative. The apartment is so charming, the cleaner is excellent and always did a great job.   There is a washer, dryer and dishwasher which are so convenient and Feel luxurious in an old school apartment!  The neighborhood feels safe, and neighbors are very friendly. We did have packages stolen from downstairs, and It is loud at night time, which we struggled with with small kids, but these issues are probably typical in a NY neighborhood (this was our first stay in NY).   The location is a short walk into the heart of Williamsburg and conveniently located between the L&G trains, and the J&M, so everywhere you want to go to Manhattan And Brooklyn is easy and fast.  Overall I’d recommend this apartment for sure, but maybe not for young families like ourselves.

The garden apartment was perfect for our stay in Brooklyn! It is on a beautiful tree-lined quiet street and was easy to find. Amy provided all of the pertinent information for our arrival and even offered to help us with restaurant suggestions or other travel questions. A great host!  We found the apartment to be very neat and clean, ready for us to have a great night's sleep after being at our trade show all day. Kitchen items were available if needed, even basic cooking items that would have made cooking a meal easy.   The neighborhood is fantastic. Walking distance to plenty of restaurants, drug store, you name it. I wish I could have enjoyed it more!

Michael was very clear and communicative regarding the apartment instructions and was very accommodating when we asked for early check in (2 pm instead of 3 pm!) Unfortunately, that’s where the positive ended. We’re very familiar with NYC and have stayed in several airbnb’s (old, new, all over Manhtattan, in France and in Los Angeles) and this is simply the worst conditions we’ve ever experienced. The least of the problems beginning with the Hell’s Angels clubhouse across the street firing up their motorcycles all night long (which should have been mentioned in the listing.) The apartment was shockingly dirty to the point where we weren’t going to stay in the apartment at all but had no alternative because of our busy schedule in the city. The fridge was filthy and unusable, there was stench to the sheets and pillows that can only be compared to urine, there was a hamper full of the hosts dirty clothes and sheets next to the desk we planned on working from, there was no proper sheets for the futon, we were left with half a roll of toilet paper for 4 days and had to purchase our own, there was no smoke detector in the apartment and very sketchy wiring, the neighbors in the building were incredibly loud and both doors to enter the building had to have been entered and exited loudly 30 times in the middle of the night each night, bits of the ceiling fell onto our daughters head while sitting on the couch/futon and continued to fall on the futon all night. Last but definitely not least, the factor that caused us to leave before the end of our stay… RODENTS. We were woken up in the night to the sound of rodents chewing through and unopened bag of chips that was on the counter, we then also discovered that a rodent had been in my daughters purse that was on the chair in the living room and had chewed through a sealed granola bar that was in the bag. We ended up driving all night long back to Toronto to avoid spending another night in the apartment. Michael needs to consider hiring an actual cleaning team as well as pest control for the apartment to be considered rentable. A hostel would have honestly been a better option. Michael seemed like a great guy- but airbnb might not be his calling.

Kathryn and Mike were wonderful, friendly, funny, attentive hosts - my boyfriend and I can't say enough good things about their hospitality and the wonderful apartment they provided for our stay. They really care about the quality of their rentals. Our apartment was extremely clean, updated, quiet, and spacious. Our arrival/check-out was super smooth and stress-free (they even watched our bags for us after we checked out so we could enjoy more of NY before our flight AND waited for an Uber with us when we left!).   Kathryn was always available and responded really quickly via the Airbnb app which gave us peace of mind even though we didn't message her much. The Bed-Stuy neighborhood is a lot of fun (see a couple recommendations below) and close to the subway, about 5 blocks away. The ride into Manhattan is about 35/40 minutes but feels super fast. There are two locked doors to get into the apartment which made us feel extremely safe since both my boyfriend and I live on upper apartment floors back home and are not used to being on ground level.  The bed was comfy, the WiFi fast, the shower luxurious, the kitchen fully equipped, the TV with lots of great On-Demand shows when we came back after a long night. FIVE STARS - what a great first Airbnb experience. We'll be back!   A little plug for the neighborhood, as we made some friends at local eateries and already miss our favorite spots: Bar Lunatico is a fun, quaint bar with hand-crafted cocktails about three or four blocks away.
