They have live music every night and the staff is so friendly. Try the Creole Moon drink! Saraghina Restaurant became a favorite with their awesome pizza, wonderful brunch, and attached French bakery for a quick coffee and pastry in the morning. Lastly, Peaches is a wonderful, high quality restaurant for a nice, fresh meal as well.   Thank you, Kathryn and Mike! See you when we return one day.

We had a lovely stay in this apartment. The space is in a perfect location, walking distance to restaurants, bars, grocery, drug store, a park, public transportation.  It was very clean and updated. We have family in the area and have stayed in multiple Airbnb’s in Park Slope. This was the first one that was clean and bug free. I know it’s New York and all but I can’t do bugs lol  We look forward to staying here again in the future.  Amy was also a gracious host, available for questions and help if needed.

This place was very clean, very cute, and just a few minutes walk to time square/broadway. We loved the location. So many great places to eat and just across the street next to Starbucks is a place to sit outside in some shade and eat (where we ate our breakfast). Check in was so easy as well as check out. He has instructions posted all over the house and a folder with great places to eat as well. We followed several of these and they were all fantastic! He’s a very professional guy even made sure to check in a couple of times to see how our stay was going and if we needed anything. There is no elevator so keep in mind this is on the 4th floor and if you’re not 420 friendly then i would recommend staying at a hotel as most of the neighbors are 420 friendly and it permeated the hallways. Also had several tv viewing options as well for us to use on one of the rainy days we were there. Great great place to stay!

I had a wonderful 1 month stay with Lilian, Juan and their family. From the moment I arrived they made me feel welcome and comfortable. The room is clean, inviting and has everything you need. When I arrived it looked exactly as it does in the pictures. There were clean towels and sheets, plenty of closet space and the table in the room acts as a wonderful working desk. The refrigerator in the room provided me with more than enough room to store my groceries. The air conditioner helped to cool down the room on the few extremely warm days that I experienced. The bathroom is shared, but they do a great job at keeping things clean. As with any shared bathroom you may find a moment or two where you have to wait for the shower, but I never had to wait more than 15 minutes.  I worked until the evening and typically slept in during the mornings and had an initial concern that the room being near the bathroom and front door would be too noisy, however I was pleased to discover that I never once was woken up by noise outside my door. Lilian, Juan and their children are all wonderful, warm, inviting people that make you feel like a part of the family while at the same time respecting your personal space. The neighborhood was exactly where I wanted to be, having access to the A, C and 1 trains nearby making a trip to midtown only 25 minutes. I never felt unsafe in the area and you have grocery stores, delis and some restaurants within a few blocks. It's also in an area that only does street cleaning once a week, so if you bring your car parking is easier (though no parking in NYC is truly easy) than most neighborhoods. I have nothing negative to say about my experience and highly recommend staying at this gem in NYC.

Commentaire en français à la suite. Very handy location, the place is a mere 5 min walk from the subway. You can expect to be in the south of Manhattan in 20 min which is great ! 10 min walk to a Foodtowns supermarket. The apartment is well organised for 3 persons (double access to the bathroom ; drawers in the bedroom and wardrobe in the living room). Big fridge/ freezer and cooker. A little dim as it is a basement flat, but overall agreable. Mattresses could use a refreshment, but the location and equipments make it up for it. Andre was very accessible and always reactive to our questions or needs. He lives next door, which is a plus. Our flight back was on the evening, and he let us keep the apartment up until last moment, so we fully enjoyed our last day.   La situation de l'appartement est idéale, à 5 min à pied du métro. On peut être dans le sud de Manhattan en 20 minutes, ce qui permet d'aller se reposer entre deux lors des longues journées! 10 minutes à pied d'un grand supermarché Foodtowns. L'appartement est bien organisé pour 3 personnes (deux accès à la salle de bains, de quoi ranger ses vêtements dans la chambre et dans le salon). Le frigo et congélateur ainsi que la cuisinière sont en très bon état. L'appartement est un peu sombre en journée mais il reste agréable. Les matelas sont un peu vieux et pourraient être changés, mais la localisation et les équipements compensent. Andre est très réactif vis à vis des questions et demandes. Il habite juste à côté et s'est toujours montré disponible. Notre vol retour était en soirée, et il nous a laissé l'appartement jusqu'au bout : cela nous a permis de réellement profiter de notre dernière journée. Un bon rapport qualité prix.
This space was most definitely what needed as a stress reliever and a great center to vibe and work especially in pure comfort , so now it’s on my favorites list and will be used quite often

Lilian and her family are very kind and welcoming. They’re very friendly and fun to talk to, but they’re also good about giving you your privacy when you want it. They will do anything they can to help you, whether you need advice or some coffee in the morning. Lilian’s husband even killed a bug for me once (I’m very afraid of bugs). The apartment is very close to the subway and it’s very easy to get anywhere else in the city you’d like to go. Only takes about 20 minutes to get downtown. If you’re looking for a nice, affordable place to stay and don’t mind spending a few extra minutes riding the subway to get where you want to go, then this is the place for you!

Kiela is kind and easy to talk to. She made sure my stay was pleasant by calling and giving me a guided lowdown of all that came with the room the moment I moved in. The room looks like the picture - with the added bonus of great Feng Shui. I would say it caters to a female tenant-audience (in a positive way). The neighborhood is what you'd expect from Harlem: a little sketchy but right off the main drag of some very nice restaurants, so mostly safe and always alive. I am a young woman and I went out many times around 4AM to pick up food & drinks at nearby delis. (Just walk with some kick in your step.) The block itself was beautiful with a smooth townhouse vibe. I would not recommend the room itself to someone claustrophobic, as it is not spacious (but it's cozy!). Good for creative folk.

Our stay at Jesse's was great. Location in Harlem might look scary at first but it really wasn't. Location is great since you are in the middle of Manhattan in 20 minutes. Flat itself looked much better than in the pictures at the listing and Jesse was a wonderful host. Since he's using the flat as his office, we had much privacy. All and all a great experience.

I deeply appreciated my time in Kiela's apartment. The apartment is what it is, in the most New York fashion. Small isn't the word, but quaint is, because the space is charming, thanks to Kiela herself.  Convenience: It's about a 10-minute walk to the 2 and 3 trains (125th st.), which, I've you've come to NYC as a tourist, will take you to a reasonable majority of the places you meant to visit. A Whole Foods stands right beside the 125th st. subways — a thing of convenience to note.   Neighbourhood and safety: The Harlemites I bumped into were courteous and well... cool. As for the homeless situation, If you're approached by a homeless asking for some change, they won't get problematic if you decide not to entertain them.   Having been there for 13 days, I didn't have any problems walking to and from the 125th st. station entrances both day and night. I felt relatively confident walking through the area. I suspect that if you're a lady of smaller stature, you'll not run into any problems so long as you walk confidently and keep your senses engaged (I myself still avoid walking through the area real late at night though). It's a rough-er neighbourhood relative in New York, but it's not dangerous.  Notes: It's quite a procedure to obtain the keys and get into the apartment itself. It's not a deterrent, but just bare that in mind, especially during the winter and if you have large luggages. My only main comment is that, it being a very DIY experience and all, having had a few questions during the course of my stay, I found some replies from Kiela taking longer than expected, even despite her availability windows (might be because of the holidays). All in all, the best experience I could have had staying in New York.

10/10, 100% positive feedback. Poppy was a great host, the place was spotless, good pillows, well equipped.   I disagree with people who say the neighbourhood felt unsafe. It was calm and quiet; we walked around/took the subway after dark and there was no problem at all.

I really enjoyed my stay at Poppy's. She was a great host. Thoughtful, reacted to all of my queries/issues immediately, and checked in with me periodically to make sure that everything was going well. The flat itself is very large, and I would kill to have that walk-in closet in my own home. The J train is less than a 5 minute walk away, and the C train is a mere 10 min walk away. The only negative for me was the bed, which sunk down in the middle, so this was very uncomfortable. And the sheets/ bed covering had an unpleasant smell. Otherwise, I'd definitely stay here again, and can recommend a stay at Poppy's.
Todd's was in a great location. Close to the metro. Todd was there when we arrived. He and his wife were very kind. Being on the first floor is convenient, but you are subject to the stress noise.

Poppy is a superb host and the flat itself is perfectly lovely! We had great communication with her before our trip and during; we were nervous coming in during a spell of bad weather, and also of course COVID, but there was no reason to be.   The flat was spotless and the fresh antibacterial scent as we entered left me feeling very reassured and safe. It is furnished thoughtfully and lets you enjoy the city while having a quiet, non fussy place to come home to. The bed was extremely comfortable and I am picky! I have a condition that causes chronic pain and instantly wanted to snooze when I first sat on the bed. I believe it’s a double, so if you’re very tall or a couple that needs extra space, it may be tight for you, but we had no complaints. It was exactly what we needed after a stressful journey and busy days.   This is probably one of the best spots you can get in the city and I’m happy we went with Poppy’s place. I have a feeling it’ll be booked up and beyond popular soon, so I just hope we’ll be able to snag it the next time we’re in the city. We needed to be in practically all 5 boroughs and it was central enough to get us where we needed to be, and a real delight to come home somewhere so quiet, safe, and cozy for the night. Since we drove in, it was more than ideal to have street parking that we almost always got right in front of her home. And that’s with loads of snow and everyone staying in their homes.   This wasn’t an issue for us but it is worth noting because I know others could see it as one. It is a street level apartment that is built in/around/under Poppy’s home, which is a traditional brownstone. That means noise can carry over and you do hear the old bones of the home, as well as her toddler running playfully from time to time. We had no issue with this as it was perfectly quiet while we were asleep and I was able to have work meetings with no worries. If anything, we enjoyed the little one’s liveliness and laughed at their boundless energy. Again, we had no complaints, but it’s just a note in case you’re sensitive to this. I wouldn’t want someone who hates kids to stay and leave a nasty review because it’s not warranted! Seriously this neighbourhood is so quiet and we slept like rocks.   The only other thing I can think to note is that there is no microwave (both oven and stove top present) so it was tricky at times to rewarm food but nothing that would keep us from staying again.   Could keep raving but the best part of our experience is how attentive and helpful Poppy was with anything that came up. With COVID, everyone was home and she would immediately get back to me which meant someone was down to help us within minutes. We are really appreciative and grateful for our experience at her place. Would rebook in a heartbeat!  P. S. you can get into lower Manhattan in about 20-25 mins, it is also close enough to the Queens side that you can easily drive there if you want to grab food or have business there

Poppy was an excellent host. She was so responsive and helped me in so many ways. I was so needy this trip and Poppy did everything to help during our stay. My package was stolen from my porch back home and she allowed me to have Amazon send my package to her address since we wouldn’t be home for the delivery. She allowed us to leave our bags in the Airbnb after check out time just to have a safe place until our flight. The place is so cute and the bed is so comfy. Thank you Poppy!

We have recently stayed in Jesse's lovely apartment in Harlem, New York. This apartment is a very warm and pleasant one to stay. The room, beds and bathroom were clean and looked very well.  The location of this apartment is favorable. Within 10-15 minutes you can walk to the green or red line to take the subway through the beautiful Big Apple.  Important as well: the location of the apartment is a safe one to stay. Had no unsafe feelings in the neighbourhood during our stay. Jesse offers very delicious coffee which you can consume in the kitchen :)  When you would like to ask Jesse something about the activities to do in the city or there is something else you need/would like to know, Jesse responds very quick on sent messages. Unfortunately we didn't meet him during our week but that wasn't a problem of course.  Jesse, thank you for the unforgetable stay!   Dutch greet from the other side of the world..  Michel and Demi

Jesse’s place was very clean and it is in a very good shape. Everything worked perfectly and we had a great time staying there. Unfortunately we didn’t meet Jesse in person, because he was out of town but his instructions on how to enter the place were very clearly written and easy to understand. He also answered all our questions quickly and very friendly. The suggestion and information he has placed in the apartment were very helpful as well. The location of the apartment is a little far off. To get to lower or midtown Manhattan takes about 30 - 40min. by Subway, to Brooklyn about 50-60 min. But there are several subway lines within a 10 min walk that take you directly to those locations. We never felt unsafe or got in any trouble in the Harlem neighborhood even coming home late at night with the subway. The opposite is the case, it is a vibrant and diverse part of NYC. In total we had a great stay and would recommend this place anytime, also because of it’s great value.

I highly recommend this accommodation. Super well located (near metro) in an area that could be scary but on the contrary, we are really immersed in the other New York, not just the one for tourists.  The apartment is large and clean, everything you need is there. Jesse is super responsive.  You can go there with your eyes closed!
Very nice apartment, clean and with a nice style. Jesse was very attentive to us. The area seemed unsafe to me.

I came with my husband and my brother from Germany to NY for a sightseeing and we stayed for 5 days in Jesse’s accommodation.  Jesse is such a wonderful host. Even we didn’t meet each other, he replied to my questions very fast and was also helpful. The apartment was also super clean when we arrived, also thanks to the friendly house keeper lady for giving us some tips. We liked the coffee machine too, Netflix is also available.  The location seems to look unsafe but I guarantee it was not dangerous! The people around were friendly and when you walk at late night it’s really quite.  You can easily reach downtown, approx. in 15min with the express subway you are at the Times Square.  I recommend everyone to have a stay at Jesses accommodation! We enjoyed our trip very well!

Jesse offers very careful, cozy accommodation, with everything you need to feel at home. The room is spacious and the beds very comfortable. The bathroom is very clean and has everything you need (shampoo, hair dryer, etc.). It takes 10 and 15 minutes to get to the subway stations, the neighborhood seems unsafe but we never had a problem.  Communication with Jesse was fluid, the instructions were clear, although we did not talk personally he was very attentive.  Absolutely recommended, without a doubt!

Jesse’s place is great, and exactly as advertised. Super clean, great communication with the host, safe and secure with easy access. Jesse includes any toiletries you may need if you forgot anything, there’s coffee and water provided in the common area kitchen, and he included a book of curated information about anything you can think of, including his recommendations for transportation, activities, and dining around the area. Great personal touch from the host. He was super accommodating for us with an earlier check-in and later check-out for stashing our luggage upon arrival and before our departure.  Truth be told, the area surrounding the apartment is not the nicest, but you probably won’t be spending much time there anyway. It’s a sub-10 minute walk to two different subway lines with easy access to the rest of Manhattan. While we never felt unsafe walking to or from the apartment, Jesse’s recommendation is to get a car service after dark and I concur (Uber, Lyft, and cab all work well).  We would stay here again, and I would recommend this place.

Jesse is truly a great host, extremely available by message with immediate responses. Gives a lot of precise information on organizing accommodation and advice for stays. The accommodation is clean, comfortable and well furnished. The proximity of 2 subway lines allows you to go anywhere in Manhattan quite quickly thanks to the express lines (once you understand how it works!) And Harlem is a lively but not dangerous neighborhood. No problem during 2 stays of 1 week, and police presence like everywhere in the city. The only fault that justifies the reasonable price is the noise, especially from the train which passes very close and leaves around 6 a.m. in the morning. But the fatigue of our days made it much easier to sleep! Sharing the living room and kitchen with another couple was not a problem for us and the room is very spacious. In short for the price in Harlem if you accept the noise, it's perfect accommodation.

Sne-  My friends and I stayed with Sne for Halloween weekend and he made sure we had an amazing time. As soon as we arrived we were blown away by Sne’s incredible hospitality. He went out of his way to help us with directions, finding parking, unloading our luggage, and immediately made sure we were comfortable at his place. His home was super clean and even better it was advertised. We couldn’t believe how charming the neighborhood was. We never felt unsafe, even coming home late at night and had great experiences at the restaurants, bars, and cafes right outside Sne’s door.   We originally were going to book a hotel but decided to stay with Sne and it was the best decision we made on the trip!  I will be staying there when I go back!
The place is comfortable just like the photos, but the neighborhood at night seems dangerous.
The place is very good, very clean, well equipped, the host answers any questions very quickly, the only thing I would say is that outside the subway station it feels a little dangerous at night.

Sne was such a great host, very friendly and full of great New York information! He was so flexible with regards to our check in which made it less stressful and so easy. The room is spacious, clean and very inviting. He had many of the essential toiletries, towels and glasses waiting on the dresser for us plus house rules and a map of the area neighborhoods...so helpful. He greeted us with a cup of fresh pressed coffee and great conversation before we headed out to explore. I could tell he enjoys the company of his guests and wants them to be comfortable. The room had an air conditioner that worked great. The neighboring buildings are close in proximity, especially if there is a party but the fan from the AC was the perfect white noise. There is a small bar next door on first floor and a little mini market across the street. Lots of activity around the corner and close to SOHO. Take your shoes off at the door and enjoy this airbnb. We did!!

Although I had to leave the accommodation before the end of the stay due to several issues (detailed below), I will try to be as objective as possible: 1) After paying for the reservation, Arya informed me that he would not be on site the entirety of my stay and asked if I wanted the apartment for myself, for an increase of $300. Finally after discussion he waived this change and agreed that I come at the initial price.  2) Big downside: the cleaning was not done when I arrived and it was very dirty (I warned Arya who was surprised because he pays cleaners who obviously don't do their job). Far from being manic, I found hair, crumbs, etc. on the floor and my feet turned black if I walked barefoot... The shower floor was also very dirty, as was the shower curtain. Furthermore, the shower system was not functional as the hot water only came after many minutes of delay, so much so that I thought there was none (I would have liked to know that).  3) Since the air conditioning only worked in the living room, the bedroom was very hot and, in summer, it was difficult to sleep in such stifling heat. This is not Arya's fault but I mention it for people sensitive to heat. It must have felt close to 40°C and it was impossible for me to sleep, so much so that I decided to sit on the sofa in the living room to get some air from the air conditioning (which was difficult despite everything because it was very noisy). 4) After all these elements, one last point pushed me to leave the accommodation and book a hotel room at the last moment: while I was on the sofa, a large insect (I found the name afterwards: it was a large, fast scutiger) passed near my feet... I decided to leave because I am afraid of insects (even if it is not dangerous, it was too much for me to bear).  5) I booked a hotel room and packed my suitcase that same evening. The next morning I took a walk in the area (after a difficult night because I was afraid of seeing the insect again). When I returned to the apartment to take my suitcase and go to the hotel, there were two people sitting in the living room... Even though check out was at 11 a.m., Arya had neither responded to my messages nor warned that there would be someone else... I never heard from again (although my message was courteous and I told him that I hoped he understood my situation, I was never unpleasant, quite the contrary). Fortunately, the hotel was perfect (even if I would have preferred to avoid this unexpected expense) and I was able to enjoy my stay more.   NB: I mention one positive point despite everything: the apartment is ideally located in Manhattan, it's its strong point and I loved the neighborhood. However, be careful, the apartment is on the 6th floor without an elevator. It didn't bother me but you have to know that.

Sne is the most kind, generous, and thoughtful person with whom we have ever had the pleasure of staying. We arrived in the evening, around 7 PM; though Sne was out of town, one of his neighbors came to let us in right when we got to the front door. The apartment is exactly as shown in pictures—if anything, it's lovelier in person. The space is cozy and beautifully laid out. Sne makes the kitchen available to you for cooking and the living room available for lounging. While we didn't cook at all on this trip, it was great to have the option. The shower and bathroom were always available when we needed it; towels and linens were provided for us, and the only cleanup we needed to do at the end of our stay was to put the towels on the back of the bedroom door. The apartment always smelled incredible because Sne is an excellent cook. It's the little things.  Transportation between Sne's apartment and the rest of the island was simple: we were a quick walk from the Astor Place metro stop and 8th & NYU. We were about 20 minutes from anywhere we wanted to go. We also spent a fair amount of our time exploring the East Village, using Sne's guide. That's right: he has an immaculate printed guide to his apartment, and to the city, that he puts out for all his guests. We had great breakfasts, dinners, drinks, and treats as a result of his excellent taste. Most importantly, he helped to set the tone for our whole visit. We relaxed in our downtime, didn't stress about anything, and spent every moment of our trip well.   We ended up hanging out with Sne more than a few times during our stay because A) he is delightful and B) he had such great suggestions for what to do around the city! Every time we were hanging out, Sne offered coffee, wine, and water. When he made us a cup of coffee on our last morning in his home, the coffee came with a square of chocolate. It was, 100%, the little things that made our stay outstanding.

First of all - great location! Everything is super walkable from Sne’s place. We spent a lot of time in Greenwich Village, which was just 15 mins away. The check in process was easy - Sne is very accommodating, which definitely makes it smooth and stress-free. The apartment itself was very comfortable, kitchen is well-stocked (although we never ate at home - you are surrounded by such great restaurants :) ), and Sne’s recommendation booklet will come in handy for first time visitors. Definitely recommend staying here! Awesome location and reasonably priced (which is rare for NYC).

Really a perfect trip and stay. We were in NYC to drop off our oldest son at NYU for freshman move-in. Needed a reasonably-priced place to stay during a  high-demand weekend in the Greenwich Village area. And needed it to be big enough to house three people the first night, two the next, with a LOT of bags and luggage along the way, including storage for bags on check-out day while we finished up our business on campus. Sne’s unit covered every base perfectly. Plenty of room, fantastic location, and unit exactly as advertised. Communications and logistics were wonderful on both the front end and back end of the weekend. This was a trip that was going to be stressful and emotional, so we needed the “travel” part to go smoothly. Very much appreciate everything Sne (and his friend, Kathleen) did to make sure that was the case. Thank you!

I would definitely recommend this accommodation. It was my first experience with airbnb and I would come back to this place every time. It felt like home from the first second. Everything was absolutely clean and tidy. Garnet is the perfect host, always there if you have any questions or problems. He even bought some fruits, juices, water, bread and butter, which was very kind, since I had a long and exhausting journey to New York.  The room is exactly like the pictures show. There is enough space to put all your stuff and baggages. The subway station is also near by, just a 5 min walk to get there (25min to Manhattan) and if you need something, there are enough options to buy food or everything else. As a solo traveling woman I was a little bit afraid about the neighbourhood before I got there but that was totally unnecessary. The neighbourhood is really safe and there is no need to worry about it!

I highly recommend this accommodation, everything was perfect, from the location, the metro is a 3-minute walk away. Apart from the fact that the line it is on is very central both to get to Manhattan and to get to JFK airport. The room was very spacious, the bed was very comfortable, it had good ventilation and a large closet. Everything was impeccable from the room, bathroom, kitchen and other spaces in the house. Garnet has the detail of giving you the freedom to have some milk, juice, water, bread, fruit, coffee, etc. The neighborhood is very quiet, in my case I traveled alone and I never felt unsafe either day or night. The communication with Garnet was always very attentive and fast, she was always attentive from my arrival until the day I left the accommodation. The last day had a great detail that I will never forget, I had the opportunity to talk with him several times during my stay, he is a great host but above all a great human being. Anyway, I hope to be able to return to New York soon, I would definitely stay there again.

This is the second time we have stayed here because we like it so much. We love walking around this neighborhood, which has everything from great healthy juice bars, small cafes, and first class (but not most expensive) restaurants owned and run by so many innovative chefs We ran into some complications about having to do a cancellation which was stressful for all concerned, but with the help of Ame's son, who took over in her absence, we felt certain that it would be possible to work things out. He was right.
Excellent experience.  Sasha was a no-stress, very cool host, and she expressed clearly her expectations.  I loved my time in her space.

This Airbnb was not at all what we expected, there was a MASSIVE HOLE IN THE CEILING ABOVE THE BED. There was no privacy, it was not similar to the photos that we saw when we made the reservation. It was dirty and cold. It was messy and full of furniture, there was no space to move around, the bathroom was disgusting. The bed area smelled really bad and when we left we saw dog poop beneath the desk. The dishes and pots were dirty and so was the sponge, the bathtub had fungus and had a nasty rug that was unwashed.  Alexandra (Sasha) said that the hole on the ceiling happened days before we arrived and  said she didn't want to cancel us at last hour because she was really nice and thoughtful, but we noticed in the reviews/comments of the airbnb that someone was complaining about the same massive hole in 2018.  We felt scammed and unhappy staying at this place, so that is why we are asked for a full refund of our money. The host should take full responsibility, not only for us but for further guests. It is not fair for anyone to stay at a place like this.

I loved my stay at Ame's place! You will get a very classic-feeling Brooklyn experience from walking through her neighborhood -- brownstones, boutiques, and delis abound, and you could easily spend a week exploring Ame's neighborhood and the surrounding neighborhoods without setting foot in Manhattan. Ame's place is very close to Prospect Park, as well, which is a great place to take a walk or run in the fall.   However! Convenience to other parts of the city is also a big plus for Ame's place. I loved having several subway options nearby, including the Atlantic Terminal. Public transit from the airport (In my case JFK) was very easy. And when I did go into Manhattan, it was a quick ride over the bridge; I was at Union Square within 15 minutes.   I found Ame's place to be the perfect homebase for having things to do in both Brooklyn and Manhattan. It was generally very quiet -- I slept with the windows open every night and didn't need to turn on the white noise I usually sleep with. There was a little construction noise from elsewhere on the block during the day, but that was about it. The bedroom itself is sunny, HUGE, and comfortable. Take some time to sit in the rockers by the window and just watch the neighborhood go by. This is definitely an older house so it has some quirks (e.g., the bathroom door sticks sometimes), but to me that added to the charm. I felt lucky to find this place, and I suspect you will too!

We spent eight days in New York. The apartment is spacious and very well located. Rosario had left information for us about the neighborhood and the city. In order to reach Manhattan we preferred to go on foot to the Junction metro station then metro line 7 (contrary to what we had read, no insecurity, we were even very surprised throughout our stay by the great kindness of the people we met and the help they gave us when we were looking for this or that neighborhood). The que end where we resided is far from the fury of the city and very exotic. New York is a fascinating city when you take the time to feel its pulse. Ah yes, important information, the botanical park of the Bronx is magnificent to see, but be careful on Mondays restricted access (yes, we had not read the guide....) In summary... Only happiness

Monika’s place was perfect and her communication even better. We were so pleased with the safety we felt during this stressful travel time and couldn’t be happier with the protections in place regarding the current world health condition. We would not hesitate to reserve her other location or this one again.

Tyler rents out his room in apartment shared with one roommate. The room is located reasonably well, although the neighborhood is somewhat sketchy (as evidenced by police with assault rifles walking the streets at night). The fact that Tyler didn't respond in the 48 or so hours before our arrival meant we were walking around there with travel luggage and valuables at 10PM at night with no way to enter the apartment. Combined with the heat this was a thoroughly unpleasant but completely avoidable experience. The room is towards the back of the building. There are regular parties back there and there is a church nearby meaning that there is a limited number of hours during which it is actually quiet at night (altough this should come as no surprise in Brooklyn/NYC). The bed is comfortable and large and the room is clean. However, New York gets really hot during the summers (even at night) and despite the room facing relatively north, the temperature is downright uncomfortable at night. Tyler's roommate provided us with what he believed to be an AC (which was nothing more than an air filter which just adds more heat) leaving us sweating through the nights as well as the days.
Beautiful house and room! Very private and quiet despite being in a house with a few others. Neighborhood is a bit sketchy after 10pm and was racist against white people.

Everything was as described which is always a nice surprise haha. Easy to get in, although I had to buzz a few different apartments because I didn't have the exact apartment number but no biggie. Flat mates Shannon and Tessa were nice and welcoming. Very clean. Suspect it would be a great place for a couple on a trip to Williamsburg - if I was to book again as a lone traveler I might try and find somewhere with more people in just so I could socialise a bit more.

Althoug Stephanie during our visit was travelling through Europe, comunication with her was always fast and friendly. The location of the flat is great: vivid neighbourhood with all kinds of cultures, good bars and restaurants behind the corner and very close to the subway. The flat is nice but unfortunately not very clean. When we arrived we had to put the sheets by ourselves, which made us have directly an unpleasant look on the very dirty mattress. The shower was sticky for probably not being cleaned up for a while and the kitchen couldnt be used, because the sink was packed with dirty dishes during our week. Thank God we were out quite the whole time. Bring your on papers and firelighter so you can sweep up the rests of weed that the flatmates spread around the livingroom and smoke it, so you will be able to relax in all that dirt

Our host Eric, did everything he could possibly do to make this trip an amazing experience.  Our flight was delayed due to a storm, so our already late arrival was delayed even more and Eric made sure that the house was ready for us and that our son had a key so that he could be waiting there for us when we arrived.  We were exhausted and weary from a long, stressful night, but when we walked into the house at 5:30 a.m. we felt like we were "home"!!  Everything was just beautiful!  The pictures of the house did not prepare us for just how beautiful this home was!  The neighborhood felt safe and welcoming and the garden, oh my goodness the garden!  What a beautiful, lush, and magical oasis, right in the middle of the Bronx!  We spent hours together, as a family, in that garden, that we will cherish for the rest of our lives.  I do not have the words to totally convey just what a wonderful experience Eric provided for us at his home.  I cannot imagine having stayed anywhere more beautiful or comfortable or welcoming and I will not ever forget our time at Eric's house.  Every need was met, every comfort was provided, and everyone in my party felt exactly the same.  We felt very blessed to have found Eric and his lovely home on Airbnb.com.  We made a promise to visit again real soon and I can't imagine wanting to stay anywhere else.  We have not one single complaint, not one single suggestion for improvement, and my whole party felt very blessed to be allowed to stay at this welcoming, beautiful, and perfectly charming home.

The "garden" house isn't nearly what they make it out to be. There's many plants, yes, but it's more of an overgrown mess than anything I'd call a garden. Plants are unkept and untrimmed making it difficult to reach your entrance.   That isn't the half though. The apartment itself is nice, but BEWARE or the host and those living at the residence. It's advertised as a quiet oasis like space in the city, and it's far from that. They party at the house until all hours of the night (sometimes 3 or 4AM) and do random things in the middle of the night that keeps you up (like vacuuming at 2AM). Again, not the worst of it though.  The real trouble started when one of the OWNERS OF THE HOUSE got high on drugs and tried to break into our apartment in the middle of the night. He ended up passing out at the bottom of the stairs to our doorway. We went to leave one morning and there's the host, high on drugs, passed out in our stairway with his head leaning against our door. My wife screamed when I opened the door because she thought he was dead. After a bit of trying to wake him with no luck we decided to call the ambulance but soon after we called he awoke and looked like he was tweaking and out of it. He apologized and went up the stairs towards the front of the house, paused at the top of the stairs and then ran back down the stairs into OUR APARTMENT WE RENTED, and dove onto the bed shirtless. I was following him a little confused what the hell was going on and told him he needed to get the hell out because we rented the place. He paused again, apologized, and got up and left. We spent the last few days of our "vacation" scared to go to the house because we literally had no idea what the hell had happened. We contacted Airbnb, but and the story they got from the host was that he took drugs and there was a "reaction". For the remainder of our stay I wouldn't allow my wife and children to be there without me, so it very much became a place we just left our stuff and we felt extremely uncomfortable being there and sleeping there especially. This was our first trip to NYC with our 3 month old twins and the hosts made us feel afraid to be in our own place. They begged us not to leave a negative review and offered a full refund to us (tried to bribe us), only to change their minds about the refund. I would not recommend this place to anyone, especially someone with a family. They party until all hours of the night, the garden is overgrown and they might try to break into your apartment like they did with us. BEWARE! I have emails to confirm what happened.

neighborhood: very unsafe. we witnessed a shooting right outside the apartment that resulted in a 16 year old boy's death (very traumatizing). we also witnessed a physical fist fight that escalated to one car hitting another car on purpose 1 block away. I was also stalked by someone after not giving them money 1 block away.  building: very old and dated, not the cleanest, hallways smells stale, stairs are narrow for anyone with a disability  apartment: similar to pictures, but not as nice, furniture, bed, bed sheets, blankets, pillows are of bad quality (futon was practically falling apart, bed sheets are cheap, rough ones from IKEA, pillows, blankets are of poor quality), tall ceilings was nice though  host: it was a bit difficult to book this place because Benjamin tries very hard to optimize for occupancy rate. even though the apartment was available during my initial requested time, the host declined my request until I can adjust my dates so that there are no days where the apartment is unoccupied. this was terribly inconvenient. check in and other communication with host thereafter was fine. he generally responds within a day.  overall: NYC real estate is expensive, but $6k a month for this? no thanks. not worth it.

Rob was an excellent host! His apartment was extremely clean and the decor was adorable. We loved all of the artwork on the walls. The room was large and quiet, and the building felt extremely safe. It was just minutes from the A train and a 24 hour grocery store, which was very convenient. Rob was very helpful and sweet. We hope to stay with him again in the future!

This is a very clean, comfortable, and quiet walk-up apartment, less than one block from the "A" express subway train. Access to the building is through a lovely, gated courtyard garden. There are plenty of shops and restaurants nearby, along with Fort Tryon Park and The Cloisters art museum. Rob is a gracious host, knowledgable about getting around the city and finding things to do. He allowed me plenty of privacy and he was easy to communicate with. The price was nice too; I spent about the same for 3 nights that a hotel would cost for 1.

I'm so glad my first stay was with Rob - he was nothing but accommodating and had such a lovely home! The room was spotless and very spacious and comfortable, especially for the price and proximity to Manhattan. His home is literally within a minute of the A train and the 1 is nearby, so we never had trouble reaching downtown. My partner and I felt safe and very taken care of by Rob, I would highly recommend staying with him and stay there again myself!
Rob was a great host. He had everything ready when I arrived and made me feel very comfortable during my stay. His apartment is in the perfect location to enjoy a visit to NYC.

I stayed at Rob's place for two nights (originally three) while attending a wedding. I was a bit of a curveball guest - I had to cancel my first night, and I had to checkout at 4 AM on my last night. Rob was so gracious, flexible, and accommodating at every twist and turn! His space is gorgeous, and the neighborhood is really cute - although the A train is ridiculously close if you're venturing farther, an easy 30 min subway ride directly to the heart of Times Square. As a single female traveler, I felt safe the whole time I stayed in this place/walked around the neighborhood. Highly highly recommend getting a rare roast beef sandwich from the little deli on Broadway next to the subway station.

My stay at Rob's flat was a very nice experience! It was chill and cosy, I felt just like home! Rob is welcoming and funny, I absolutely recommand him for a stay in New York, especially if it's your first time there ;)
Rob responded quickly to my request to book his place. He was nice enough to accommodate my job interview schedule with check out time. The place was super clean.

We spent 3 perfect nights with Rob, a very delicate, attentive host who knew how to inform us about the city and guide us perfectly in our choices. A very neat, very clean apartment, in a quiet area, ideal for visiting Manhattan, Harlem, the Bronx, Central Park and these museums. One minute from line A...very convenient.

Rob's place was fantastic- super clean, as shown in the pictures, and located in a safe neighborhood! I stayed with Rob for a month while I worked in Midtown and the location could not have been better. The subway is close by and a very quick ride to elsewhere in Manhattan, but if you're looking to stay in Inwood there are many great restaurants and bars super close by! Rob was great about communicating with me throughout my stay and was always quick to respond if I had any concerns. He was also very helpful if I had any questions about navigating the subway and getting around. I would highly recommend staying here and I hope to stay again in the future.

My girlfriend and I spent 3 days at Rob's place. Rob was very kind and respectful, helping us with everything we needed. The place is very well located, very close to a subway station. The neighborhood has restaurants, bars, supermarkets, all in a walking distance. We enjoyed our stay and definitely would recommend to anyone.
Rob was a wonderful host and his place was exceptionally clean and great location to the tube. Had a great stay 😇

Rob has been a wonderful host and his apartment is a very comfortable home. His place is conveniently located close to the A metro line, it is decorated with style and kept very clean. The room is large, well furnished and with two bright windows. Rob has been generous with info and tips about the local area and NYC. I spent a very good time: highly recommended!

Rob provides a clean, comfortable, and quiet place to enjoy NYC. He offered little touches of snacks and teas that were welcome. Close to subway for getting around.. And the neighborhood is fun with a lot of parks. He is a good host!

Rob is a great host, and he responds fast. The place is beautiful and comfortable, and I liked how Rob respects privacy. The location is excellent, only a 1-minute walk from the A train station, saved me a lot of time commuting. I would recommend this place to other people, whenever they are visiting the big apple.
Rob is a good host and provide a good place and truly enjoyed the stay.
Rob is amazing host and we had great time in his house. If you decide to stay here, that means you gonna have great time in NY.

Perfect stay to explore New York City.  Rob is a super nice and helpful host. The apartment is beautiful and clean. The room was even bigger than expected and the bed was very comfortable. Absolutely nothing to complain about - 5 stars - Thanks Rob!

Rob was an exceptional host. He greeted me at the entrance, gave me a tour of the space and went over all the info needed to know, and also responded quickly to my communications from booking to checkout. The apartment/room was great - spacious and comfortable. So close to the subway and grocery stores! Would stay here again.

If you are looking for a place a little away from the city this would be a great spot. The location was very close to the subway and seemed  safe. There are nearby restaurants and a Starbucks a minute away. Rob made my stay very nice especially with it being my first AIrbnb experience. He was very responsive and accommodated my late night arrival and early checkout. He greeted me and carried my luggage. There were some nice treats and tea selection in the room and it was quite spacious. The area was quiet so I was able to easily get rest at night. The bed was comfy and there is also a nice sofa. Other nice things is that Rob walked me to the subway the first day and helped get my Metro pass. He was available whenever I needed help or had questions. I recommend staying at this Airbnb with Rob he’s a nice guy, keeps a good place and has great hospitality. Definitely check out the artwork collection in the apt. and the garden area outside!

Cosy, spacious, calm and very clean apartment. Rob welcomed us under the rain with an extra umbrella - very thoughtful. The location is perfect as you can catch an express subway and be in the city center in 20 minutes. Thank you Rob!
Rob is very attentive and responds quickly. Place is as advertised.

Rob’s place is really good! Clean and comfortable and Rob is a very nice and helpful host. The neighborhood is quiet and I definitely enjoyed the two parks which are located nearby the apartment. Perfect for a run or just a stroll. The subway is really close and you easily take the train  downtown. The kitchen is nice and has everything you need for cooking. I stayed for 6 weeks and I got everything I wanted. I would definitely stay at Rob’s place again!

Rob’s place is very cozy and welcoming! The location is great and very close to the subway, with many great spots to eat or grab a drink within reach. Rob had a late night work event, so Liz, his neighbor, let us in, and she was absolutely wonderful and helpful, as well. We very much enjoyed our stay and would stay again!

Rob was a gracious host.  Respected our privacy and gave us good information.    The place was very quiet and in a nice building. Beautiful courtyard.  Also very close to the subway, grocery, starbucks, restaurants.   The bed was comfortable but firm.

Friendly host, lovely dog. Small apartment, but nice facilities to be able to stay comfortably. Easy location with the subway close by and loved the proximity of Central Park. Some shady people on the streets around the appartement however. Didn't like it in the evening on my own as a young European woman.

Jackie's home is the perfect place for visitors who want to spend more time out enjoying the city and less time worrying about logistics. The apartment is super clean and the bed is very comfy, and you are only minutes away from the subway, grocery/drug stores, and other useful shopping like H&M, Sephora, and Best Buy. You don't have to worry if you've forgotten something though, Jackie is well stocked with all the toiletry essentials (and beyond!) plus an array of chargers/cables.   I was in town for two weeks working 12+ hour days and the convenience and extra amenities made my stay exponentially better!

Only one block away from the A subway line, so convenient for accessing all of Manhattan via subway. Inwood is quite an interesting location to visit anyway. Rpbs apartment is spot on as per his description. Only one block from the subway line, easy to get too. Clean, quiet, comfortable, and Rob himself is very welcoming and helpful

This is in pretty much every way a great Airbnb.  Rob is a really nice guy, super helpful, very fast with communications - all in all a great host.  The room is large and comfortable.  We slept very well in the bed after long days touring around New York!  The apartment is tastefully done with pieces of art and photographs on the walls.  To say that it was spotlessly clean would be an understatement.  The location is excellent,  It is three minutes from the A train subway, so you can be downtown in just over 20 minutes.  The neighbourhood has all kinds of restaurants, banks, grocery stores.  And yet as lively as the scene was at night the room in the apartment was very quiet.  Our sleep was never disturbed.  I’m sure it is much quieter than if we had been downtown, where there are sirens and traffic all the time.  The apartment is a few minutes walk from the Met Cloisters, and there are lovely parks along the river on the norther tip of Manhattan island.  When you compare to the cost of even cheap hotels, this Airbnb is a real bargain.  Highly recommended!

Rob's place is amazing - 2 mins only from Dyckman station. And trust me that is the only acceptable length of walk when you already spend whole day walking in town. And Rob's place actually only half an hour to downtown (central park etc) so I gave 5 star for perfect location! Not to mention that Rob's place is also sparkling clean.. you will love it when you arrived, just feel like home. I definitely recommend Rob's place if you wish to stay in NYC. Plus if you are Indonesian, you will easily find rice in Mofongo Restaurant (open 24 hrs), 2 mins walk as well from his place. Totally awesome!
Rob is really helpful  and the room is nice to live , hope can visit next time <

Rob is a marvelous host. I over packed and was so grateful for his help with getting my suitcase up the stairs. His place is very cool, clean as a whistle, quiet, and all the amenities you could need. He is conveniently located next to the 1 train and the A train which is literally 200 feet away. Inwood is a beautiful area in Manhattan and an easy shot downtown. I highly recommend Robs place.  Great host and great NYC apt experience.

Rob’s place is fantastic. The room is large, in a clean, warm and quiet apartment. The bed was very comfortable. The apartment is only 2 min from the Subway, which is convenient for visiting Manhattan. It is also easy and fast to reach other places in New-york (Brooklyn, the Queens).  The neighbourhood is quiet and safe, but also attractive. It has lovely parks, lots of shops, bars, restaurants. Some of them are open very late in the night (convenient if you need to grab some food when getting home late after touring in NYC). Would you prefer to cook, the kitchen in Rob’s apartment has everything you may need. Rob is very helpful and accommodating. I would definitely recommend staying at his place.
Rob's place is a clean, bright, large space that is warm, comfortable and safe. Very easy to be there.
Rob offers a nice clean room in his lovely Inwood apartment, and warm hospitality. The next time we visit we plan on staying again.

Excellent accommodations. Very clean and orderly!  Rob's place is exactly as advertised. Lots of stairs to get to it, but worth it  Big spacious room overlooking a nice courtyard. The location is outstanding; the entrance to the subway is just a few steps away from the building's entrance. Rob is very friendly and very respectful of his guests' privacy and comfort. Parking on the street is a challenge, of course (but it can be done!). I saw 2 parking garages within a reasonable distance of Rob's place--one for $40/day and the other for $26.50/day. I will definitely check to see if this listing is available when I return to NYC.

Rob's place is everything a visitor to New York could hope for: a safe, spotless, classy apartment, a spacious and well-provisioned bedroom with many amenities, and a really kind host who is conscientious of every detail that would concern a guest--and also very respectful of one's privacy, but also willing to converse and give tips about the neighborhood. And what a neighborhood! Beautiful parks just a short walk away, great food at every turn, an overall colorful and friendly environment.  I'm eager to go back!

Exactly what I was looking for! Really nice location in Inwood, on a quiet street, but still around the corner from the center of the neighborhood and from the subway. The room was very spacious (bed, couch, desk, and still lots of open space) and Rob was very generous and conscientious throughout my stay. Was nice to be able to use kitchen and feel comfortable to cook, etc. Thanks Rob!

This place is located in a great neighborhood with incredibly easy access to the subway! The room is spacious and has a desk to work at, along with a couch to rest on to relax. Kitchen and Bathroom are always kept clean and whenever I had an issue or a problem, Rob would be right on it. Definitely recommend staying here! P.S. the building the place is located in is quite old, meaning no elevators. The apartment  isn’t located on a crazy high level, but if accessibility and mobility are important to you, I would keep that in mind!

Rob's place was ideal for my wanderings around Manhattan. Metro station just around the corner, supermarket, restaurants and parks. I was surprised by the beautiful view on Hudson river/New Jersey from quiet Inwood park. The house is very clean and I liked the large table in the room and the supportive matress. Rob is excellent in communication and shared inviting recommendations and good advice.

Rob’s apartment’s pretty good, the room is spacious, bright during the day and clean! Rob’s pretty clear with the ground rules too (a handwritten list) ; There’s a 24hour supermarket around the corner which is pretty convenient! A line metro is also around the corner! Overall, great stay (:

The location was great. It was conveniently located next to a station and a 24hr McDonalds. It was clean, spacious, and exuded personality.  Rob was friendly, knowledgeable and responsive. It was all at a great value and I highly recommend.
Very convenient, super clean, tidy and thoughtfully decorated. Rob is very nice as well:)

Rob is an easy going host. He is always available for questions/clarifications and can give you great recommendations. The apartment is super clean, the room itself bright and spacious. Kitchen has everything you need to prepare some meals. Ground rules are easy and understandable. Access to laundry room available. Apartment is located next to A train, which brings you in around 30 min to most famous places in downtown, in a lively, but quiet neighborhood. Grocery shopping and restaurant all nearby. Would stay there again.

Rob is an excellent host. We didn't miss anything. The room is very nicely furnished and pleasantly quiet to sleep in. The 24/7 supermarket and the metro right around the corner are super practical. My 15 year old daughter and I can highly recommend Rob's accommodation.

Rob is super nice, friendly and flexible and his place is very nice and clean. My gf and I had an amazing time in NY. Rob’s place is also by the Metro. So taking the train was super easy and convenient. There’s also a bunch of Restaurants close by. I enjoyed my stay here with no issues.
It was a pleasure to stay at Rob's place.  Everything was clean, organized,  and quiet.  It was a great space for me to work! Rob was very kind, friendly,  and hospitable.
Rob is an amazing host ! Really kind and he gave us very good advices to live the best journey in New York ! His apartment is clean and perfect to host people.

Rob’s place was just as described, the metro line A one block away so easy to go everywhere, and he was responsive at all times. I was working so I wasnt at the house much, so for this kind of trip his place was perfect! Thanks so much Rob for having me!

Rob's apartment was incredibly welcoming, and I felt at ease from the moment I arrived and throughout my stay. The apartment is well heated, all the amenities are well maintained, and there is natural light and lovely personal and architectural features throughout the space. The room itself is large and comfortable, with ample space to work, exercise (if that's your thing!) and relax. As a host, Rob was a pleasure to interact with - he was warm, thoughtful and helpful and he communicated clearly at every juncture.   If there is a downside, it is in location, as the apartment is quite distant from most areas that visitors to New York are likely to visit - but this is offset by having an express train (the A Train) just around the corner, and frankly the price more than makes up for this.  I'm very happy to have chosen Rob's place for my first experience of New York and am sure that anyone staying here will have the feeling of being at home, which (for me) is invaluable when traveling.

Rob is warm, kind, attentive, polite, and respectful. I felt instantly at ease with him. The room not just by Manhattan standards but by any standards is spacious. The Internet was consistently strong. The amenities and neighborhood offer good value for the accessible price. I felt extremely happy and at ease the whole week.
Dion and his wife were excellent hosts. They were accommodating and warm.  The area they live in is quite diverse.  My daughter and I walked at night from the train station and didn’t feel unsafe.
So cute and cozy.  I explored by myself for a bit and didn't feel unsafe whatsoever.

Krys and Jeaneth were super quick with communication -check in and check out were stress-free. The apartment was decorated very uniquely and was comfortable.  My only caution, which may be already well known to regular city visitors is that it takes quite a long time time to travel into Manhattan from this location - averaged an 1-1.5 hour commute. Again, this is my naïveté and not, obviously, the fault of the hosts.

Amanda's place was spacious and we enjoyed our time there. Harlem was different and it certainly has future potential but be prepared for a cultural shock. We were slightly intimidated after dark but never felt unsafe. All in all a good place to stay and see NYC. Public transport was excellent and close by. A few minor changes to the unit ( bed and TV) would have made it even better.

This property is in a very convenient location, only minutes from the subway with easy access downtown.  There is a great bagel shop next door for breakfast.  There are a lot of down and outs around the area but we didn't feel unsafe at all and it was interesting staying in a residential area.  Don't miss the Amateur Night at the Apollo on Wednesdays - highlight  of our trip.  The property is exactly as described,  clean and comfortable and our host left plenty of toiletries for our  use and coffee etc.  A great stay.

Great stay for us.  The beds were so, so comfortable!  Not very common for an Airbnb.  Very well laid out apartment,  has everything you need to cook light meals.  Two bathrooms is another value add.  Amanda was very responsive and super flexible on accomodating an inconvenient flight time arrival.  Building management were very friendly and pleasant. There isn't a ton in the immediate neighborhood but the Bagel Tree is excellent.   There's Harlem pizza and a nice local wine store one block up on 125th.  Super easy transportation,  you have the 4/5/6 a few blocks away and the express buses a block either way.  Foodtown on 121st is well stocked for groceries.  There is a garage on the side of the building that prices out to $15/24 hours if you book a spot via ParkWhiz  before entering.  If you need easy access to a few different boroughs it's very convenient.  A few others comment on the neighborhood  and it is true that there are a few rough blocks around with homeless and addicts but this is unfortunately something happening a lot in NY these days with the economic impacts of the pandemic.  I would highly recommend this place, it was a really comfortable stay and the host was really nice.

lobby full of property violations & heroin addicts. in addition to no heat/hot water, we’re extremely inconvenienced by the following issues: dirty floors w cracked tiles, holes in walls/windows where bugs & air come in easily, unsafe (as inspected by nyc) doors that do not fully close, dirty/ non functioning stove & oven. non functioning refrigerator—was not cold. broken lock in which we had to wait weeks to be repaired & had no keys replaced. consistent wifi/power outages. an instance where a heater broke and started spewing water. the damage caused us to have to replace multiple electronics and chargers. with all this we had an unresponsive host. we encountered 2 privacy violations where the maintenance workers arrived unannounced, walked in on myself in the shower the first time, and to my bedroom whilst i was sleeping the second. we lost money having to buy food due to our inadequate fridge. we got sick because we had no heat. the host is extremely ignorant and never communicated

Maba was a great host. Any help we needed he provided immediately. He was friendly and flexible regarding keeping our baggage safe pre and post check in. We were able to enjoy a stress free and comfortable stay. I cannot recommend highly enough

Maba, who we did not meet, had organized everything for our arrival and departure (key box with code). She was very responsive when we asked for an extra mattress because the sofa is small for two and not very comfortable. The apartment is great, a stone's throw from the metro, we took a 7-day card for our 3 days (33 USD) which we almost paid for and which allowed us to walk around without the stress of reloading. A downside, the management of nocturnal nuisances due to the neighbors above between 0 a.m. and 3 a.m. Once reported by text message, it is up to the owner to manage. Apart from this incident, I recommend this apartment, we really enjoyed NYC.

This is my first Airbnb experience I typically would stay at an over priced hotel in Upper Manhattan but a friend recommended I try Airbnb . MABAS PLACE WAS amazing very clean & he provided everything that I forgot to pack (shampoo&soaps ) MY Family and I were in from Chicago and his place felt just like home . I totally recommend booking here Oh and someone mentioned the neighborhood being scary we were out past 4am and nothing seemed sketchy what so ever !

When we first arrived at the airport, (under Mabas' advice), we took an Uber to his home. This took approximately 20 Minutes and cost 58$ (56$ on the way back). We arrived in an area which wasn't very welcoming and a bit dirty but once Maba opened up his front door with a big smile on his face the outside was forgotten. The appartement is exactly like the photos (with a little bit more wear and tear) and there is everything you need  Towels, utensils for cooking etc.  The surroundings of the house during the first couple of days takes a bit of getting used to. A lot of drunks and drug users but you actually get used to it and they are totally harmless, and I say this as a mother of 3 children. I met the most friendly guy during a downpour who turned around and walked me back home under his umbrella , so goes to show that the neighbors are charming. The subway (3 & 4) are really close by and the subway is really easy to use. We stayed in Mabas' appartement for 10 days and we had the holiday of a life time. For the price it is totally worth it. If we had stayed closer to Manhatten or in an area that was more picturesque we would have ended up paying loads more and instead we took a helicopter ride which was just AMAZING and totally worth it. Hope that this can help for future New York visiters. Rhanks again Maba

It's a good gritty urban location and a spacious property. There were plenty of towels and a well stocked kitchen. The roof terrace is large with lots of plants. It's a slightly odd lay out. There were some unpleasant stains on one of the bed covers.

Martha's place is simply PERFECT!  The accommodations are charmingly beautiful and clean.  The location perfect - walked to the US Open (took 30-40 minutes), walked to the mall for breakfast at Paneras (5 minute walked), walked to catch bus Q23 (5 minutes) to head into Manhattan (took 1 hour total).  Martha and Michael are what I would classify as AMAZING hosts.  Their kindness blew me away.  They checked on me to make sure the various family members arrived safely as my son came in the next night and my wife and daughter came the night after that.  This was my first airbnb stay and I suspect that my experience with Martha and her place will not be surpassed for a very long time or at least until next year, when I stay at her place again.
Nice house but sketchy neighborhood. Temperature changed to 75° when we were sleeping & we all woke up sweating and had to change it. Other than that, good experience.

The hostess welcomed us well, she was very kind in anticipating check in as we arrived in NY early in the morning. The property is in a residential neighborhood in Queens. It is a studio in the basement that meets the needs of 2 people well. There is some noise from the upper floor which becomes unpleasant at times. We had a problem with the shower that wasn't working well. We reported the problem but it was not resolved and therefore we do not classify our experience as good. The place is very far from Manhattan and you need to take the train and subway, remembering that transport is not interconnected and needs to be paid for separately.

NOT A GREAT EXPERIENCE for us, long term guests.   When first arriving at our airbnb in Williamsburg we were excited. We needed a long term stay while our house was being renovated and knew this neighborhood and thought it would be a fun change. The house seemed ideal  to accommodate a family of four plus our dog.  Our first impression was a good one. 3 bedrooms, washer/dryer, outdoor space, things seemed in order, and in a thriving neighborhood surrounded by local bars and restaurants. However, after living in the apartment for a few days, it was apparent our first impression was incorrect.  We stayed at Claire’s place from January 23 to July 2,  beware, most of the furniture and everything in the apartment is worn out.  The staircase is steep and dangerous for young /older people and even pets.  A plastic baby gate (that is not securely attached)  is provided to place at the top of the staircase. Useless.  Noise at night happens from Wednesday to Sunday, manly from Clair's bar in the same building.  We had cold winter days and  warm summer days.  Highly inconvenient when Claire started asking for access to the house multiple times which happened from the first night on. She also asked for a video of her place a month before were due to leave.  Packages (big and small ) for her bar were being delivered to us.  They will knock or I would get messages asking if we had a certain package.  When you rent a place you expect to be left alone.  The vestibule in the apartment has a closet used for goods for the bar. The first night we were there, around 10PM ,the doorbell rang, it was the manager of the bar asking to access the closet, she came in and grabbed some bottles of liquor.  THREE TIMES in our stay I had to give access to the patio to  Claire and her AC repair people so they can work on the AC unit for the bar.  We are a busy family, with little advanced notice given I had to scramble to find someone to be there while work was being done.  Claire suggested to let themselves in and I said no , first because I don’t find it safe to let strangers in in a temporary  house (or my permanent house ) while we are not there. Second, I had to arrange for my dog to be taken to a different room or place as she gets territorial and would not welcome strangers.  A MONTH before our check out , Claire wrote to tell me  that she was going to be out fo town for our check out  (on July 2) and suggested to come to the house for a walk through with me to “address all the odds and ends” as she had already rented the apartment with a check in on July 3… the day after our check out !!   She did not organize her Airbnb calendar, or blocked a few days in between to make the place ready for her new guests.  The right and responsible thing to do would have been to take a few days to get things ready for summer rentals, fix the downstairs shower (she sent someone to fix it 4 days before we left but her plumber made it worst) or get new essentials or fix the patio which is in bad shape.  I declined the walk though, I reminded her that Airbnb does not call for a “walk through” before checkout.  Unheard of ! After this request the last month of our stay was not comfortable.  A VIDEO OF THE APARTMENT?  on June 22. (10 days before our check out)  she called to ask if I could send her videos of the apartment.  She claimed that a prospect tenant was asking for videos.  We were there for over 5 months, that last week the house was not organized, we had boxes everywhere, we were starting to pack to move out.  I said no to her video request. Even if I said yes , any video I could send with all those boxes and suitcases everywhere would not have made a good promotional video for her apartment.   Going back to the beginning and other details, after assessing the place and seeing the old/dirty rugs and bathroom mats we went to Ikea to get rugs, mats, sheets.  I vacuumed and mop the floors that first night.  The house did not feel clean. The next day I had a cleaning lady help me clean the rest of the house. It seems that this place is for investment purposes only, not for quality stays. NIGHT NOISE , we did not mind the music, we eventually got used to that.  Master bedroom is right next to the bar, when the bar closes the loud cleaning begins, Things are dragged, the the metal cover to the basement (out on the sidewalk) is closed loudly.   OUTDOOR SPACE is not enjoyable, the wood deck has been progressively corroding/falling apart, planks are loose and do not feel safe.  The wooden chairs and table feel like they can break at any time. The old grill doesn’t work well.  The noises from the AC unit for the bar downstairs and from the AC unit for the next door building and the crowd noise from the bar next door make the outdoor experience far from serene. Nothing makes the outdoor space welcoming. INDOOR TEMPRERATURE: the place gets very cold in the winter (it’s an old building with odd mechanics ) we had to bring space heaters.  In  the summer, the upstairs gets hot , the small AC unit in the living room is not enough to cool the kitchen/livingroom and mostly so if you are cooking or doing laundry.   We were willing to tolerate all the inconveniences because the location was ideal for our work and school commutes.  We were not ok with Claire being after us to accommodate her schedule.  She was

Sam and Britt’s place was very nice and clean. They let us check in early, which was great! There was a laundry room for us to use, but the hot and cold water were backwards so we accidentally washed and rinsed our clothes in hot water unexpectedly. It was spacious enough for two couples. It was close, within walking distance to 2 different subway stations that we used daily. And there was a nice grocery store within walking distance. The neighborhood was a little sketchy though so coming home at night, walking through the neighborhood, made me a little nervous.

My husband and I stayed here with our son and daughter in law for a long weekend. Perfect location to get to the subway. It was a two minute walk. We had an issue with a shade that broke and the manager got it fixed within an hour. He was very responsive. If you stay here, be sure to eat at Nick’s a couple blocks past the subway. It was excellent.

Sam and Britt's apartment, on the ground floor, is very secure (3 doors + 1 alarm), extremely clean and warm. The kitchen is spacious and well equipped. The comfortable sofa allows you to relax in front of Netflix for quiet time. The garden is a pure pleasure for having breakfast in the sun. The upstairs neighbors have a super cute little dog who will come and ask for a few cuddles on the terrace! We were able to check in late thanks to the key box, Sam and Britt even allowed us to leave our suitcases in the lobby before our flight home.  I recommend!

Location is great!  Subway Q line is just around the corner with a drug store next to it.  Our room is on the second floor (have elevator) facing inward. It's quiet and nice. Nick is super helpful, very responsive, and is always around.    We have early arrival flight and a late flight back. Nick is very helpful to let us store our luggage at the premise.    You will find everything you need in the flat. Washer, dryer, a proper kitchen (even though we didn't cook. We were out most of the time), even a rice cooker!  Ambel supply of towels and toilet paper, detergent, new sponge...etc too much to note.  The only drawback is the sofabed and the bathtub. We got a few bites over 4 nights stay. The bathtub drain is not working properly. Our feet have to soak in water during shower. Otherwise, everything is great!  Highly recommend it!

This place is super clean, comfortable, the room is very large. AC is perfect, the host is super nice. I checked in so late time but the host waited for me and helped me everything. She offered me breakfast, so nice! I 100% recommend this place!!!  But one thing this area (also all NYC) can be dangerous at night time, so if you are women, come home earlier!  Thank you Susan!! I miss you.

Loved it so much that I came back. Having stayed at both spaces, I have to admit that I liked this one more. This recently renovated space occupies the top level and has great privacy. There’s an extra lock on the bedroom door for added security. There’s a decent sized bathroom (shower even has a bench!), kitchen with plenty of counter space, a full sized refrigerator, island dining table and large tv (ton of on-demand options). For those staying longer term, there is a secure 24 hour self parking lot located in Rego Center mall on the IKEA side (24 dollars for 24 hours), laundromats nearby,  several chain drug stores nearby (Walgreens/cvs), grocery stores, Starbucks and more within a walking distance. Target and a large shopping mall (Queens Cemter) are both in a longer walking distance. You don’t really need a car or Uber to get anywhere as it’s not far from a lot. Queens is very walkable if you’re up for it. This particular Airbnb is in a great spot if you’re looking for a longer term stay! Highly recommended!

My stay at Susan's place was fantastic. Susan is an extremely warm and friendly person. I stayed here for about a month. She was very understanding when I had some unfortunate news about a family member in my home country.  Here's a brief breakdown:  * Room: The room was a lot more bigger and spacious than what I expected and the room was very warm. The bathroom kitchen and room were extremely clean.  * Location: Susan's home is  only a 10 min walk from Canarsie station. Whilst Canarsie is at the end of the L-Train line, it only takes 30 mins to get into Manhattan.  *Area: The area is very safe. I used to come in the wee hours, very late and never felt unsafe. Heaps of bodegas, delis, supermarkets and some really great Jamaican restaurants (Fisherman's cove is my pick).
Perfect place for a family of 4. Good crime free location. Would recommend to family and friends.

The flat itself was big and nice and very clean so I enjoyed my stay there.  I was there for business on my own and obviously had a longer way to go to get to mid-town but that was my choice. Its convenient that the station is right opposite because I would not necessarily recommend girls to run around that part of Brooklyn on their own so much. I did not feel unsafe though either. If you're a group of people and planning on spending lots of time in Brooklyn then I guess its perfect. I did not meet Adreinne but instructions were clear and it was easy to get in and out.   The matrass wasn't great and the road quite noisy but again that's not a huge issue.

Adreinne's place is mostly as pictured, it's got charm, it's close the the C train, and the neighborhood has lots of great restaurants nearby. There were just a couple of issues to take into account or check with the host on before booking. The unit is up two sets of somewhat steep, slightly scary stairs, some of the steps have come loose from the wall and the railing is very low and also loose. The place is pretty noisy, you can hear the neighbors and there is currently construction happening right next door.
