Rooftop is nothing to brag about. when you get up there from a ladder in one of  the rooms, one side of the roof has no protective guard railing. Very dangerous. There were sheets provided but no towels. There were only one pullout couch, a white one. No extra mattress as advertised. Just like others have said, it's weird to walk through the kitchen on the first floor when people who live there (?) are eating breakfast. You have to pass a couple rooms. Getting the keys were fine. Biggest complaint is that the front gate was locked when we were trying to leave. Serious fire hazard. Had to jump the gate and throw our bags over. Called Keith and he didn't return call until 2 hours late, too late. Initial exchanges were good.

Wow! There are not enough words to describe how amazing our first Airbnb experience has been. David and Rick are astonishing hosts that will go out their way to accommodate you. Apart from being extremely cordial, they will give you suggestions on what to do and in our case even invite you for a night out with them. The loft is exactly how it is depicted in the pictures. Very clean, stylish and organized is how you will find your temporary home. The room has a very relaxing environment which is crucial after a long day of shopping and taking pictures in the city. The neighborhood bursts with restaurants, galleries, retail stores, bars and breath taking views. As far as transportation there are plenty of train stations nearby in addition to the taxis and Uber drivers that can be found in the streets at any given time. I cannot stress how great David and Rick are, I have a strong feeling this is not the last time we will see each other. Thanks for the opportunity guys stay in touch.

The location was perfect for my family to stay the week before my wedding in lower Manhattan. It was super easy to check in and check out with no trouble. The space is big BUT there were not enough chairs for the dining table and barely enough sheets/blankets to accomodate everyone. The floor is not all one level. In fact there are three different levels on the first floor of the top two floors. This was very dangerous for my 2-year-old niece and my mother as they kept stumbling and falling. Another danger was the stairs. My mother slipped on the stairs and cut her finger, needing to be taken to the hospital. I had a bit of a scare on the stairs as well. Lots of fun things to do in this neighborhood but please take these things into consideration before booking!

My daughter and I recently stayed 5 nights at the Brownstone.  We were in town for college music auditions.    We were looking for a space that was large, safe and quiet.  That is exactly what we found.  Simon has taken great care in his building and it shows.  My daughter had her space away from the loud city to practice and I had the piece of mind of knowing that we were in a safe neighborhood.  The apartment itself is gorgeous.  Simon has gone to great lengths to ensure the comfort of his guests.  Any questions we had were answered promptly.  The pictures are exactly how it looks - spacious and classy.  The neighborhood is on its way up. We never felt afraid of our surroundings.  Cabs, subway and bus are minutes away.  We used a local car service that worked out very well for us.  If you are a fan of soul food, this is the place for you.  For the rest of us their are several fast food chains in the area as well as a local restaurant that served salads and wraps.  If you are a coffee drinker and prefer Starbucks, one is within walking distance.  There are a few small grocery stores withing walking distance for basics.  All in all I would rate Simon and his Brownstone a 10+.  We enjoyed our stay very much and you will also.  The Brownstone does not disappoint.

Very desappointed that unit we found was very different  from airy new apartment in pictures. Old,dingy furniture. Unsafe stairs with broken steps. Impossible to access with suitcases.Bedrooms and linens in sad condition. Overall depressing. We refused to stay in this repelling place and went to a hotel. Very sad experience.

We had a pleasant stay at Keith's apartment.  Of course it would be easy to list things that would have made the apartment better, it had a lot of unfulfilled potential in terms of comfort and style. But the main things to note are that it was clean, in a safe area with lots of restaurants nearby and spacious enough for 4 guests. If you go with an open mind, you will enjoy your stay there. Beware of the washing machine, the door is broken and we had a stressful experience trying to get our clothes out once washed. There's a laundrette around the corner. Also, it would be useful to get a spare set of keys as it was frustrating only having I've given the apartment is difficult to get in and out of.

The apartment is comfortable, quite similar to what is shown in the photos, the bathrooms are spacious and very clean, although the entrance and access to it is somewhat unpleasant and complicated (very steep stairs, ugly appearance). In general there is a strange and ugly smell, perhaps a product of the restaurant downstairs.  Although I was always in contact with Seith before our arrival and his responses to my queries were usually immediate, when on the second day of our stay (we stayed 11 nights) we found one of the inflatable mattresses punctured, I wrote to him to let him know, although I only received one response and then never again (despite my emails and my reminder that we were with children) did he write to me to give me a solution.   He had told us that we could leave all our suitcases before entering, but the cleaning girl only accepted three of us. We had to walk with the rest from 11 until 2 in the afternoon when we were finally able to enter.  The subways are relatively close (4, 5 blocks). The neighborhood -East Village- has a lot of nightlife with the strangest places!!

We stayed in this apartment for 2 nights in mid-October. All in all it was a positive experience. Can't beat the location (East village, minutes from St. Mark's). Had 4 adults and 2 babies, and there was enough room to accommodate all, even if not super-comfy.   Pros:  Location, location, location  Clean and well facilitated  Big enough for 6 people  Cons: 3 flights of steep stairs to get to the place. If you have tons of luggage - beware.   Sleeper couch in living-room is not so comfortable. Ok for kiddies, not so much for adults.   1 of the 2 (full) baths are located inside 1 bedroom and the other one is downstairs in the living area, which is a little weird if you need to use it during the night and go through someone else's bedroom (not so bad if you are all one family or close friends...)   Also: I read something that really scared me in one of the reviews just before we arrived and want to address it: we slept in all 3 sleeping spaces and didn't encounter any kind of bed bugs. Don't know if owner took care of that or it was never there, but we never had any problem like that during our stay.   Seith responsiveness was OK. Always got back to us within few hours and answered the dew questions we asked.

This place is great if you are in your mid 20s, like myself, looking for a place to crash for your trip. It's within walking distance from great bars, clean, and enough space to comfortably fit 6 people. However, for the older crowd (i.e. my parents and aunts I traveled with), or if you are looking for a nicer place to stay, this probably isn't the place for you. Pros: - Location -- near plenty of great bars and restaurants. nearest subway is within about 3-4 blocks away (near NYU). - Seith is flexible with check-in/out, depending on if the apartment is booked before/after your stay. - Remodeled bathrooms - Clean - Living room was a great space for all of us to hang out in. Couches everywhere for people to sit in. - Heating was essential since it was raining and very cold during my stay. The heaters in all rooms worked. - Plenty of hot water to accommodate all 6 of us. - Plenty of outlets for charging all our electronics. Cons: - Seith's communication is not great. Upon communicating with him about early check-in/late check-out, it was very last minute/if not at all. - The washer and dryer was broken. he recommended the laundromat across the street, which was $10. This could've been relayed to us before our trip -- it was clearly broken before we got there. - Steep stairs. The stairs inside the apartment are metal too. With the rain this was pretty dangerous. Keep in mind how much luggage you have. - Light for entrance stairway was broken. We had to leave the light on in the living room so we could see. - We are assuming this was due to the construction outside, but when we first turned on the water, it was brown. Once it filtered out, it was fine the rest of the trip. - Toilet paper only one extra roll in each bathroom for our 4 night stay, with 6 people -- one of which was waterlogged by who-knows-what. Disappointing. This was definitely not enough considering we needed to use them as tissue too. Luckily there was a market 2 blocks away. - Brown pullout couch is getting old. Wasn't the most comfortable. - The two steps in the living room that I overlooked in the pictures. One is right when you get out of the bathroom on the first floor - when unfamiliar with the place, this was HAZARDOUS. You can literally fall out of the bathroom if not careful. The other is randomly in the middle of the room. BEWARE!!! My family and I fell numerous times because of the small step. There is no line or warning for this. The floors blend in. Again, this place is for younger/more agile people. The review on this place is definitely dependent on the purpose of your trip. Because of the competitive pricing, space, and location, I'd probably stay here again but only with my friends -- not with my...

The accommodation corresponds to the description, except the furniture which has changed and which is not in very good condition. We had an unpleasant problem: one of the toilets became clogged. But fortunately we reached someone quickly who moved within an hour. The area is very interesting for restaurants, atmosphere and close to Soho, Greenwich, Meatpacking...

The property is perfect, exactly like the photos. Simon prepare the house with a nice welcome snacks and water. The bed is very comfortable and the sleeves very clean. All the equipment were working perfect, the ambient and natural lights complete the house. Simon also keep a "survivor guide" with a lot of information of the neighborhood  and NYC. The neighborhood is like the Harlem style, a lot of culture, beautiful streets, but sometimes because of "Project" you may felt very observed. If you are not used with Harlem streets I recommend use only metro lines 2 or 3 in the 125st. Sometimes the streets to get into metro lines 4,5 and 6 ( in the same 125st)  in East Harlem may look dangerous.

We had a great stay in Christiana's apartment from Aug 6-13. The location was excellent and was only a 3-5 minute walk to the Marcy Ave. station that is 1 stop away from the lower east side of Manhattan. We definitely got our money's worth one-week unlimited Metropass. A cab ride from LaGuardia cost us $25.   The neighborhood was pretty quiet and felt relatively safe amongst the many Hasidic Jews who live nearby. We came back well past midnight on the subway several times and didn't feel unsafe.  The place was a bit smaller than I expected from the pictures, but was still enough for two people. The bedroom fits only a full/queen bed and a few feet of space from the closet. The bathroom is small and has a tiny sink with not great ventilation. We encountered a few roaches in the bathroom, but there was bug spray there to help ward them off. The living room was a decent size and was a comfortable place to relax after a long day exploring the city. The kitchen is definitely suitable for cooking a meal, but there isn't much counter space and no microwave for reheating leftovers easily. The only thing I should have paid closer attention to in the listing description was that her apartment does not have air conditioning, which led to really warm nights when we stayed there. However, she did provide a fan right next to the bed, which helped a lot. Also, the internet connection was fast and reliable.

This was just great.  We are going to give Simon’s place 9.5 out of ten.  We had been planning this trip for some months and if you are new to New York we suggest you do the same. We got a mega large map and plotted on there what to do each day. The city is so spaced out and so exciting. We spent a whole day just doing Central Park. Yup it was some days exhausting doing 20,000 steps each day but we had a great place to return to and as long as we made the subway back to Times Square we knew our New York home was only a short ride away.   Harlem was everything and more that we expected it to be. In fact YES it was like being in the movies. If you have ever seen any Harlem films you will know what I mean. The place was buzzing with all sorts of amazing characters and we found ourselves people watching a lot. We never felt any danger and would definitely stay here again if we were to return to The Big Apple.  So. The place itself. It was so so spacious . We did a lot of looking at different places and different areas before booking Simons place and this was a true gem. The wonderful atmospheric lighting in the living area was so chilled at night and the sofa was really comfy , as was the bed and the space to store our stuff was more than adequate. Being a very homey couple we really appreciated the cleanliness of the apartment and loved the extra large fridge that we could chill our essentials in.   So why have we only given 9.5 ? The apartment is so perfect and so modern but the bathroom let it down a bit. Also  there was a weird smell outside on the stairway. We are pretty laid back and just made a joke about it!!!  Thank you Simon for trusting us with your wonderful New York Brownstones apartment. We loved our stay and would recommend it to anyone needing a retreat after long days sightseeing.  Much appreciated.  Lorna and Av

I had an awesome stay at the Brownstone apartment.  The space was located in a vibrant community, on a quiet residential street.  I was a woman traveling alone and I never felt unsafe in any way.  The apartment is really lovely, has a calm and stylish interior with all the amenities one would need.  I would definitely recommend this location and I would stay here again.  Thank you Simon!

Simon is a terrific host.  Good communication. The apartment was nicely furnished,  very quiet, clean, great location.  Pretty, shady street.  Many restaurants nearby.  Check in was easy with Simon’s  guidance. The third floor was a challenge but we made several trips upstairs with our luggage. The apartment was a good value.  We look forward to coming back.

The place is worth every penny. Great bang for your buck, AC, Wifi, lots of space which is hard to find in the city. You checkin and they have snacks, water and all the amenities you could need. They have an iron, big closets and storage space, plenty of extra tools etc. As far as location it wasn't bad at all. My gf was suspect to Harlem but I head heard the city was being gentrified. We had no issues. I walked round solo with camera equipment. Met some nice people along the way and even had a spontneus photo shoot with some girls we met. Overall great stay and good host.

Apartment conforms to what was announced in the photos and comments. We were very happy to occupy this spacious and pleasant apartment. Great cleanliness. Concerning the sector, the site is a little far from the center but nothing more and there are some non-dangerous individuals towards the nearest metros who degrade the image of the neighborhood.

The apartment is spacious and well-equipped. But for those who have not been to New York recently, the price of food, drink and taxis is eye-watering - double that in London. Although we expected Harlem to be edgy, be prepared for very visible beggars, drug addicts and people with mental health problems, although we did not feel threatened.

This space is clean and just what we needed. There are a lot of steps like other reviews said, but it wasn't a problem for our group. The host was nice enough to let us drop our luggage off before check-in, which was very helpful. The location was great, just a few min walk from the nearest subway station, and we never felt unsafe.

The unit is large, clean and comfortable. We enjoyed staying there except there are a lot of steep irregular stairs that would be difficult and dangerous for anyone not in excellent fitness and physical health. The areas outside the unit are dingy and in need of upgrade and repair.

Agnes is a very nice and attentive host, and I also liked the room: It is small (not very unusual in New York..) but clean with a very comfy bed and all facilities, even including cable TV and Wifi. For tourists who are afraid that Sugar Hill might be too far away from "the center": it´s definitely not, the apartment is a 2-minute-walk to the A-Train, which takes you to Time Square in about 10 Minutes. Agnes is always up for a chat if you want to, but she also leaves you your space. I would definitely recommend staying at her place. Thank you Agnes!

Agnes is the perect hostess. Takes good care of her guests.  From the homecooked healthy breakfasts to all the info and tips you need when visiting New York. Very accessible, but gives you your privacy. I liked that there were two bathrooms, and I had my own TV. Elevator in building, lots of stores and restaurants. Subway a block and a half away. Drug store and 24 hour market. Thank you Agnes, for making my visit stress free.  Have already booked a future trip with Agnes.

My boyfriend and I stayed at Agnes' apartment when we came to NYC this past weekend, and we had a wonderful time. Agnes was incredibly hospitable, attending to our every need. Our room was very nice and comfortable, and Agnes was helpful in giving us suggestions of places to visit around the city. Everything was super clean and tidy and the neighborhood was safe. We felt very welcomed, and we couldn't have asked for a better place to stay at in the city (especially for the price--this is a steal!). Highly recommended, and would stay there again!!

Keep this in mind: we are not seasoned New York City travelers. That being said, the place is tight for a lot of adults. The extra beds are hard to utilize with the space. There was clutter in the closets and behind the curtain upstairs. For us it felt pricey for what it was!  The good: we liked the location and never felt unsafe, the living space was adequate and the description of the stairs in the other reviews was very accurate!

Christiana's apartment was the perfect base for 11 nights in New York. It really felt like home and was always warm and cozy to come back to after a cold December day. I can't stress enough how close this place is to transport either!! The JMZ station is literally around the corner and the M train takes you straight to all the main spots like the Rockefeller Centre, 5th avenue shopping etc. Getting to Manhattan was easier than I could ever have imagined! Walking to Bedford avenue restaurants and bars was an easy 15 minutes as well if you want to hang around Williamsburg. Really sad to be leaving this place!! Thanks for being such a great host Christiana. Hopefully we'll be back one day :)

I am a long-time AirBnB traveler and host, so I hate to have to write a bad review of Christiana's place (my first bad review), but I do feel like folks should steer well clear of this listing.  First, I will say that the place is cheap. But the value is not as great as you might think. The place is in Brooklyn, not Manhattan, which should already bring the price way down. Also, I guess it's technically in Williamsburg but it's still a 5-10 min walk away from Williamsburg proper (Bedford Ave.). The neighborhood is nice and quiet, but nothing special.  When we communicated with Christiana regarding check in time, she asked if we would be ok with checking in after 8pm. Apparently she had some long-term guests staying in the place who had a late flight on their check-out day/our check-in day. I do not think it's reasonable to ask guests to check in so late to accommodate previous guests who did not plan their trip well. I communicated this to Christiana and although she agreed with me she didn't really do much to alleviate the situation. We were able to drop our bags off upon arrival but still had to wait until after 6pm for the place to get "cleaned." So, already the value proposition is not looking as great here.  With the admittedly low price in mind, I was not expecting the Ritz, but when we arrived after the 6pm "cleaning" there was very little different from when we first arrived to drop off our bags. The place is old and just not very nice inside. Again, that would be fine except it also needed a much deeper cleaning than what was done.  The floor was dirty, the mats in the bathroom hadn't been washed/replaced and were dingy, and although dishes had been washed they hadn't been put away. The sheets on the bed may have been clean but they were old and threadbare. There were flies in the apartment because windows had been left open (it was summer). The bathtub doesn't drain well so you end up standing in 6 inches of water by the end of a short shower. Only one of us could shower per morning/evening. Everything had a layer of grime on it that just made it kind of unpleasant. I could go on.  I've stayed in AirBnB places around the world, and never have I experienced one so dirty. I feel like a big part of the issue is, you'll notice, Christiana is keeping the place booked non-stop. She is not around to look at the place herself between stays so depends on somebody else who is not invested in providing a good experience and cleans a bare minimum.  Christiana should really be renting the place out to long-term tenants who would take care of the place. She can probably make more money (and avoid housing law) by flipping the place irresponsibly on AirBnB.

Christiana was always very kind and helpful and all matters requested. The apartment was comfortable and according to what we expected. Location is super nice, less than 5min walking to the subway and 1 stop from Manhattan! It really makes it reachable from the city and we saved time. The only unpleasant issue is that I found it noisy to sleep (it shouldn't be a problem other than summer when the windows are closed and it really makes it decrease).

Apartment is great, very close to two metro station, and is perfect for a couple. It is full of light and its exactly as appears in the photos. We spent a great time and we get used to the neighborhood very fast, we used to arrive very late at night (1AM) and we never was afraid of the area. Dana is a very highly recommended HOST, she was waiting for us, so she did a lot of recommendations and she helped us with a lots of tips.  Thanks for everything!!!

Fantastic condo!  Our group of four women loved this place. 2 bedrooms, 2 full baths, and extra beds/linens/towels if you have more people.  A great living room for gathering. The owner is super responsive and thoughtful. Walkable to plenty of coffee shops and restaurants and there's a convenience store on the corner. Never felt unsafe in the neighborhood.

Agnes place was very clean and fresh. We liked the complimentary breakfast. Good neighbourhood, me and my mom lived here without feeling unsafe. We appreciated the quick answers from the host and she was very thorough with giving directions from the airport to her home.

The accommodation is well suited for exploring New York. The room was OK, Agnes kindly provided an inflatable bed so that my son had his own bed. This meant there was little space in the room, especially since there was little space to store clothes (other than a clothes rail with hangers in a closet) and there was nowhere to put suitcases. But that didn't bother me. You share a bathroom with shower with Agnes and the guests in the second rented room, and an extra toilet only with Agnes. We found the loud air conditioning in the room unpleasant, but since it was very warm we turned it on every now and then. The kitchen has everything you need, we even cooked. Breakfast, snacks and drinks are provided. The subway is only a few minutes away, it takes about 20 minutes to get to the Empire State Building, but if you go to the south of Manhattan you can expect about 40 minutes. The property is located on a lovely quiet street. Harlem is an interesting neighborhood worth exploring. We felt safe there, even on the way home in the evening. Communication with Agnes was very good. We arrived very late from the airport, Agnes was very accommodating in this regard.

We were received with great kindness by our host, Giovanni. The apartment was spotless and he explained to us how the facilities worked (air conditioning, kitchen, TV, etc.). Very quiet, just a little noise from the metro but ultimately not annoying. The neighborhood is really nice and very relaxing after a long day in Manhattan. Our return flight was in the evening and Giovanni allowed us to keep the apartment until departure time. We thank him for that. In summary, an excellent stay and many thanks to our host.

My friend and I stayed here for four nights. The room was large and clean, had a television and wifi. No one disturbed us, although my friend found it bright in the morning and could hear some outside noise (she’s a light sleeper). I am a good sleeper and didn’t notice any of this.  We felt we had to be quiet when we came in at night as we knew there were other people there and they were very quiet, but we still watched a little tv at a reasonable volume and it seemed to be fine. Well, no one said anything to us anyways. Overall, it is a typical Harlem building (which has an old school, kinda scary elevator), but is clean, feels safe, and is super close to the metro.

Facts:  *the place is close to the subway buses and many restaurants *check in is flexible *water and a breakfast snack is provided by the host. *you get your own privacy while you are in your room. Cons:  * the host enters to your private room while you are out without permission. And when I asked her she said ah just for the AC, and then she said ah for cleaning and I have noticed she did this two days! *the neighborhood is sketchy and wouldn’t recommend it to a girl traveller not from NY. *check out is NOT flexible at ALL *the host live in the living room where that black couch is and it’s barricaded so idk why she still have this misleading picture of the living room since she lives there and sleeps there. *can not use the fridge it’s kinda lucked. *I think the host is super nice and flexible before you check in and then that’s it rules are rules.

If your trip  includes Brooklyn, Manhattan etc. This is a very convenient, cozy place to stay.  The hosts, Christopher and Constance provide an accurate description of the garden apartment on the AirBnB website, are easy to get in touch with  and make check-in.check out a simple process.  The space itself is very comfortable and is within short walking distances to coffee shops, restaurants, neighborhood pubs, The Barclay Center and the subway.   I suspect we will be travelling to Brooklyn more often now that we know about Christopher and Constances' garden apartment.

Everything was very good until the last day to leave the suitcases at check out and then pick them up. He treated us disrespectfully and rudely. If we couldn't leave our suitcases, we would have left with them.  It was unpleasant, we just asked and after trying to help us...suddenly shouting and bad manners!!

Clean and comfortable, as advertised.  There is a coffee shop / bike shop next door; and it is just a few blocks to market, drug store, and restaurants.  On-street parking was readily available the entire time we were there (mid-August).  The traffic noise might wake you up on weekday mornings, but it is OK at night and on weekends.  Annette responded well to messages, and she made check in/out very easy.

Thanks to Agnes for the welcome.  The room was spacious, with everything we needed for our arrival (water, snacks, toothbrushes, towels, etc.).  The bed is not of very good quality: we lean back when we sleep. A detail that stood out to us: the bedroom window and the air conditioning are not clean at all. There is a pile of dust on the window sill and on the air conditioning, this is very unpleasant because the bed is stuck to this dirt and when we turn on the air conditioning, the dust flies.   The bathroom is very good, with a shower, sink and toilet that we share with the occupants of the second bedroom. She is very clean.  We didn't use the kitchen, but it seemed like it had everything we needed. One floor of the fridge (not very clean…) was dedicated to us.   Agnes sent us from time to time information about the city and what there was to visit, we thank her. However, we moderately appreciated the frequent messages from Agnes who reprimanded us on various things that we were not at all concerned about: hallway light, air conditioning on, wet bathroom carpet, etc. This created stress for us that we would have liked to avoid.  We thank Agnes for her flexibility regarding check-in and check-out.
The parking lot is not safe, there are thefts nearby. Do a lot about where you park your car.

Great experience at Jessica's house! We have been at Jessica's house for 20 days and I recommend her 100%. The apartment is just as it appears in the photos, bohemian, cozy and very, very bright. The building is not new and it does not have an elevator, although that did not matter to us at all, however the views from the apartment and those from the roof totally compensate for them. The neighbors are very friendly. Jessica has been flexible with check-in and check-out and her friend Moira, who greeted us, is lovely. The neighborhood may seem a little suspicious at first, and perhaps I wouldn't recommend returning alone late at night, although the truth is that we had absolutely no problems and it has its charm, it is very authentic. There are plenty of metro lines just a stone's throw away, very convenient for getting around the city. There are also supermarkets and all kinds of stores to cover all needs.  The apartment is very close to some streets that are starting to become fashionable, with cool places and a very good atmosphere. Any problems? Well, perhaps both the building and the apartment itself would appreciate a little renovation. In short, highly recommended and unbeatable quality/price ratio. A real experience in New York, outside the traditional tourist spots and circuits, we would repeat without a doubt.  Thanks again to Jessica and Moira for everything!

Jessica has responded quickly and has always been available in case we need anything. The house is acceptable as a place to rest, ideal if you visit the city for tourism. I would recommend it to young people who are not very demanding with the characteristics of the property. It is a third floor without an elevator but it doesn't take much to get up there. It has good views. The neighbors are very nice. The bed is big enough to sleep two people and is very comfortable. The apartment was acceptably clean but could be improved, especially in the kitchen.   The neighborhood seems dangerous, we saw police on street corners at night but we didn't have any problems. Connections with Manhattan are good, using the subway you can get there in about 30 minutes. I think the price is good overall, but for a visit to the city for as short a time as ours, three days, I would recommend something more centrally located in Manhattan. We have had a problem with the key to the portal and especially the key to the apartment, the key did not fit well in the lock and it is difficult to open the doors.

We had a nice stay at Jessica's apartment - it was a convenient location for us and it was clean, safe, and a close enough walk to the subway and a bunch of good restaurants.  We -did- have some check in communication problems which made the start of our trip more stressful than I would have liked but Jessica was apologetic. She also was super flexible with our check out time, which made our last day of travel much easier. Would definitely recommmend.

Our stay was perfect. Everything was there and the house is wonderful, clean and spacious with a nice kitchen. We didn't use the outside space a lot, but it's great for those sunny mornings when you want to get some fresh air and there are hammocks :) The neighborhood is probably one of the most enjoyable in Brooklyn (and in New York City): plenty of shops, restaurants of all sorts, dive bars, music clubs, BBQs, cocktail bars, etc. Very friendly and safe to walk even late at night (if you are not scared of hipsters). The list is infinite and we enjoyed every single bit of it, including a great market on Saturday and Sunday. All of this just 2 or 3 stops from downtown Manhattan where you have the classic guide-book things. Definitely recommended.

We loved every single minute of our stay here. The apartment was lovely (clean, light, spacious, comfortable) and exceeded all of our expectations. It was perfect for our group of four. Williamsburg is a wonderful area and it was very convenient for Manhattan (via Bedford Ave Station).   Daniel was an excellent host. I cannot stress how helpful he was before our arrival as well as during our stay. We would definitely stay here again and hope it won't be too long before we can make a return trip to Williamsburg. Thanks, Daniel!

Selina Chelsea is a great place to stay. It's underneath the High Line, close to the water, clean, and well-kept. The staff were friendly and professional. We asked for fresh towels and linens daily and received them. I especially liked that the windows had two motorized shades- one a sunshade and the other a blackout shade. With a great lobby/foyer/bar/restaurant/common area, bang-for-the-buck, this place is superb.

The place is beautifulll! Even more beautiful in person. Clean, quiet and great decor. Nice amenities and  touches. Definitely a steal for the price. Andres was very communicative and available. Had an awesome stay!  I wouldn't change a thing about the place.

The place was beautifulll! Clean, quiet and great decor. Nice amenities and  touches. Definitely a steal for the price. Andres was very communicative and available. Had an awesome stay!  Will definitely book again!

If could rate Andres' place 100/100, I WOULD! I've stayed in the Forest Hills area before, but this location is perfect! It's right on Queens Blvd so everything is in walking distance! The train station is also literally right outside the door to the building. With that said, you can hear the hustle & bustle of the cars and the train, but it didn't bother me not one bit!   Andres is an amazing host who gets back to you within minutes! Check in was super simple, although I did have minor "confusion" opening the apt door (didn't realize I had to pull a little while turning the key to hear the 2nd "click") but it really wasn't an issue! The apt is just as pictured, love the decor, and for it to be an NY apt (coming from Miami) its very spacious! Everything was clean and well maintained, however there are a few slats of wood near the doors that open in the living room and on the left side of the bed in the room, that are loose/broken and when I stepped on them I caught a mini heart attack just for a sec because felt like I was falling through the floor (but also not a cause for major concern). Honestly out of all my airbnb experiences in NY, Andres' place by far is my favorite and I plan on booking with him every time I'm in NY (which is often)! Highly recommended! Thank you for everything Andres, I look forward to booking with you at the end of Feb!

the hotel overall is nice and in a fairly convenient location. Everything was as advertised but not the most clean (bedsheets and towels had holes, pillows having stains, etc...)  In the "about this space" section of the listing it explains of the taxes that will be charged however there is also a $20/night experience fee hidden in the "house rules" section of the listing instead. feels kinda shady that they didn't disclose all extra costs in the same section and hid those fees somewhere else

This was a great place to stay! I only have a couple of complaints -  I think the mirror in the pictures makes the room seem much bigger, I actually thought there was going to be a little living room area just based off of the pictures. But know that it is a bedroom just big enough for the bed and some luggage.  There is a $20 daily fee that isn’t listed anywhere until you book it and receive check in instructions.  And the shower is see through, which is an unpleasant surprise if you booked this stay with a friend like I did.   Besides those points, this is a nice place to stay. The location is within 10 minutes of walking to a few subway stations, they have awesome bars upstairs and downstairs, the rooftop bar is so cute and fun. The beds are comfy. The AC works and there is plenty of lighting. The staff were exceptional, especially Quay and our front desk girl ( I wish I had gotten her name). They were very sweet and helpful! They make you coffee in the mornings if you need it and they gave me new bottled water each day. Would stay again!

A very good value in a convenient location. But needs a bit of adjustment to for five stars. Kitchen cleaning was good, but a few spots were left uncleared, no big deal but…. Could use a bit more oversight from owners. No curtains in bathrooms, and they face a bunch of neighbors, so at least a shade would be appropriate. Thermostat controls lower, and this upper apartment simultaneously, so that is a bit messy to deal with.   Great location for dogs as park is a few minutes away.  Yes I would go back.

We were 2 families with 2 toddlers staying at Deborah’s appartement for 2 month. The appartement was perfect for us. It is very spacious, has an outside space, several sleeping options so that we could shuffle around mattresses and make beds for the little ones. The garden would need  to be cleaned and put into shape, but we didn’t care and were just happy of having an outside space. It is not the newest building, fanciest furniture, or cleanest place, but that was great as we weren’t so much afraid that the kids would ruin anything. The location couldn’t have been better, the area has lots of restaurants and cafes just around the corner, Fort Greene parc next door and lots of playgrounds. By bike we were in 15min at prospect parc, or at Peer 6, and connections to Manhattan by metro (from dekalb street) are fast and easy. Communication with Deborah was easy, fast replies for any questions. We would happily stay there again!

This host is exceedingly unprofessional and rude, and fosters an unsafe environment for their guests.   I was harassed by this host for weeks and eventually kicked me out of my room to the streets of NY at 10pm without any prior notice.   There were minor issues like going through my trash and answering questions I had, with comments like “this is how things are done in the US”. The major issue was how she declared there would be a room inspection during the middle of my stay, and that she did not want any luggage visible during this time. This was disruptive, and I did not want to store my luggage in a basement as she was proposing. Such an inspection was also not in the house rules, so I respectfully declined. Her reaction to me declining the inspection was completely out of line, and she approached me with anger and screamed that I was “insubordinate” and that I had “screwed her over”. She threw my wet laundry clothes at my door and locked the bathroom so I could not use it and made me leave at 10pm without prior notice. I have objective video evidences to prove this. Do not stay with this host as no one should ever experience such mistreatment and harassment. She will likely respond to this comment trying to tarnish my character as she has with prior guests that have left negative reviews, but please take this as a red flag and warning to not stay here.

I loved my stay at this hotel, it’s very well located just near to Times Square (2 mins walk). However, the host was very unpleasant. Plus, they added a $40/night fee I don’t even know why and it wasn’t written at all on the Airbnb description. When I asked the staff to explain what was this they were like “if you don’t pay this you can’t have the room, it was describe on the offer” but when I asked them to show me where they didn’t know and stopped the conversation. Anyway, the room is beautiful and very comfy though. But be warned of these fees!!!
Very accommodating hosts! Great location, stress free spot. Would definitely use again next time im in the area.

Easy self-check-in makes arrival hassle-free. Clean, well-maintained space with comfortable bed, well-equipped kitchen. Convenient location, quiet neighborhood. Highly recommended for a stress-free stay.

Both Sarah and her daughter was exceptional hosts. My sisters and my son definitely had a great time their with each other as well as our hosts. They are great people. The apartment is more than spotless. Stress free environment. Their additions to their family, Pumpkin and Zoey was more than awesome. Im very thankful for you all having us.

Our daughter lives on UES and wanted a 2 bedroom as close to her for November 2022 as having our newborn grandson. J1 block away was perfect.   Guests stayed 3 short stays so 2nd bedroom helpful.  Size adequate for NYC standards.   Bedding for both bedrooms fair. Got own sheets instead of 2 top sheets.   Kitchen supplies fair-good but needed skillet and mixing bowls. They got skillets quickly via Amazon. Mixing bowls and other needed stuff got from kids place.   AC poor and early November warm so uncomfortable. Mid-late much colder so opened windows. Shade broken in both bedrooms.   UES expensive anyway, so I felt price very fair compared to other 2 BR / 1B places.   1 TV in family room.   I would stay there again if need 30 day stay.

This message is strictly for information and knowledge purposes for future guests. There was not WIFI available at the time we arrived, no fridge and no microwave as shown in photo #17, there was issue with the shower of the bathroom that was corrected during our stay (wasn't verify it before our arrival), didn't have sheets and pillows for the sofa-bed, I requested and they left us later in the apartment. On the listing details say that the quite hours 10pm to 8 am, during the first nigh there were people running down the stairs, talking on the phone with the speaker ON, (it was around 11.20pm) and also people slamming doors. No smoking allowed says, (penalty $150 per day) but they received us with a strong and intense odor that the host confirmed me that was cannabis that it's being used and smoke by many of the people on the building, being allergic, how much should I penalize them? In the second night around at 11.58pm - when we are all supposed being resting, I suddenly woke up because someone was trying to open the door of the apartment to enter, tried twice, touching the doorknob and then (12.15am) they was trying to use the key to opened it, I opened the door and told them that to stop to bother us, because that apartment was still occupied.  I was very worried for that reason I started looking for a nearby hotel and we went with my son to another place the next morning.  I wrote the host that was very unsafe for us and let him know what happened. He recommended that would be better to staying in a hotel.

I stayed 10 days with Rofi and his family and had a very hospitable experience. There's plenty of natural light to creep in the windows in the morning which is the perfect way to wake up--  a full breakfast bar equipped with coffee, tea, and breakfast snack varieties is present to get your day started. The location is in a great and safe neighborhood with plenty of deli's, restaurants and diners in the area. This place would be ideal for those who are looking for a local staycation in the city or for out-of-towners looking for an affordable but enjoyable "hostel" style stay. 5 stars.

Wonderful stay here! The place is much bigger than I thought. The restroom is spacious, high pressure shower. The area felt very safe and there was so many good restaurants walking distance. Celestine was very helpful and provided a list of places to try nearby. Check in was by code so it was awesome to be able to do that. The place was quiet; I work remote and was able to peacefully complete my work on my laptop there using the big desk that’s in the bedroom. The neighborhood was quiet and I had no noise problems during zoom meetings. You can get to Manhattan in 20-30 mins via train. This is truly a steal price for NYC.

The unit is very spacious and unique! We loved the location. However please keep in mind that the occupants of this building are teenagers/young adults who use recreational drugs. There is a constant marijuana odor in the apartment and on the balcony. There is severe damage to the unit and it was not thoroughly cleaned. Some amenities were great such as coffee supplies and water bottles, however other basic amenities were missing such as lamps, extra towels, extra clothing hangers, etc. Communication with the host was friendly, but inconsistent and difficult.

This apartment would make a great Airbnb and has a lot going for it however, we encountered too many issues (read to the end). The owner appeared nice and allowed us to check in 3 hours early and 1 hour late at the end of our stay. We only found a handful of negative reviews beforehand so we couldn’t figure out how this apartment (apartment 3B) received so many positive reviews (unless the reviews are for other apartments in the same building). The apartment’s photo’s did not match the apartment’s furnishings (missing coffee table, bed differs, couch differs, A/C unit differs, layout is mirrored) and the apartment doesn’t look as clean. This apartment has cleaning and some maintenance issues as well (missing smoke detector, leaking shower door, sink drain stopper missing). The cleaners appear to be doing just the minimal and the apartment is showing signs of long term dirtiness (mold on shower floor, dirty windows, dirty A/C unit, crumbs in cabinet, unwiped surfaces). Also, there was a urine smell in the apartment. On our first night we took off the couch’s cushions to find out where the urine smell was coming from and we saw a large stain behind a cushion and the odor immediately took over the entire living room and kitchen area. We stayed in the bedroom with the door closed. The next day the owner said the cleaners must have missed it and offered to have them clean it however, we didn’t want to deal with any lingering odor so we asked for the couch to be removed and we finished our 3 day stay without a couch. Owners initial response appeared automated and didn’t acknowledge any issue. Was responsive after contacting Airbnb.  Pro’s: Train stop down the street Police station down the street Deli and dinner nearby Close to city Modern looking apartment   Cons: Entire apartment needs thorough cleaning (couch needs to be replaced) Not exactly like listing photos Laundry room is in scary basement garage View is on rooftop that has no patio furniture Wi-Fi unreliable Odor of marijuana coming from neighbors?
Communication wasn’t great at check in and was very stressful, but other than that you get what’s being presented accurately.
The room was small. Good for a one night stay. Front desk were very shady

Pros: location is a few blocks from the main subway lines/ great side bedroom Cons: Cleanliness was seriously lacking/ At night the location got sketchy, lots of noises (people arguing) down the streets until the middle of the night.  Impossible to access the building without internet access to buzz oneself in.  The place has a hostel vibe minus the great atmosphere.

My girlfriend, myself, and friend came to stay at Monica’s Airbnb for 3 nights, and I just wanted to leave as honest of feedback as possible, so future guests know what to expect and for there to hopefully be improvements made. Let’s get to it:  1) Written communication from Monica didn’t feel friendly or welcoming, and it lacked warmth. In my past experience, communication with super hosts is usually inviting and makes you feel as though they are truly happy to be hosting. It felt that Monica was too scared of her home being disrespected or damaged to be an inviting host, and that makes someone feel simply uncomfortable to be there. The amount of rules, how they are written, and constantly repeated does not make for a cordial host.  2) If you are coming in the summer, be prepared for a VERY hot and distressing stay. There is only a portable AC in each bedroom, and nothing in the living room, and when our stay was during 94 degree weather at its peak, the heat and humidity in the apartment was sweltering. Despite Monica it clear that there was no AC in the common areas, nothing prepared us for the actuality of how oppressive the heat would feel. Even taking a hot shower would make the common areas absolutely stifling. Monica is very strict about not running the AC when you aren’t in the apartment, and despite knowing this rule before hand, I feel an exception must be made during a blistering heatwave. Monica did offer us to turn on the AC for us 30 min prior to our arrival if she was around, but the issue here is that the bedrooms take about 1-2 hours to actually cool down.  3) The bed and pillows wreaked havoc on our backs. It is a standard mattress with some sort of foam topper, which accumulates an incredible amount of heat. The other issue is that there was only 2 pillows per bad and they are by far the most uncomfortable pillows I have used.    That being said, the apartment was incredibly clean, in a great location. I think if the above issues were sorted, this can be an incredible stay for folks.

Beautifully decorated and spacious. Our ‘staycation’ was during the HEATWAVE, felt hot like 100 in the shade! The AC Units were a total lifesaver just make sure to set it to the lowest temperature on Cool! We slept well due to comfy beds and blackout curtains. Lots of extras: games, books, umbrellas, bluetooth speakers & lots of toiletries. Trendy area with lots of restaurants, bars & music venues. Our host was super nice and responsive. We felt sad to leave!

We greatly enjoyed our stay at Monica’s apartment in Bushwick. Monica was a great communicator and made the check-in/checkout process easy and stress-free. The main bedroom is very spacious and the second bedroom was smaller but perfectly fine. The apartment is bright and Monica kindly provided some staples: coffee, milk, tea, etc. It’s a great location, very close to Myrtle Station. Recommend popping by Norbert’s pizza on the corner too for an amazing slice.

Great place overall. Biggest concern is that the keys to the building door take a lot of fiddling with to get them to latch (I’ve spent 5-10 minutes dealing with it), and given the area can be pretty unsafe late at night I highly recommend you get home early enough that you aren’t nervous messing with keys at the door for 10 minutes.
If you want to get scammed book this place

Jules day by day proves to me that he is the best host in the Brooklyn area. Ive been to many airbnbs and Jules consistently keeps up the valued consistency month after month. Ive been staying here for few months now because I love it so much. He even keeps  giving me a gratuity discount for all the time I've been here. I am so thankful and appreciative of this amazing airbnb. He is so understanding and always cleans the place. Any issues I have he resolves immediately. I highly suggest anyone looking for a long term stay in Brooklyn book Jules its a steal!

Not a good experience. Where to begin?   -  NO ELEVATOR. FOUR FLIGHT WALK UP WITH HEAVY LUGGAGE! HORRIBLE STEEP STAIRS. The ad should have made this explicit. And they were working on the stairwell and hallway when we had to check out and drag the luggage down.  - Red key for opening the door to the street BARELY WORKED. You had to mess with it and jiggle it and twist it until you lucked out and it would unlock. It sometimes took 10 minutes to be able to get in! VERY ANNOYING.  - The window near the bed FELL OUT INTO THE ROOM a couple times - VERY DANGEROUS. There is evidence of a crappy cheap attempt to tape it in place, which is UNACCEPTABLE. This apt should be delisted until this is  properly fixed. Luckily there was blue tape in a drawer - I used it to help secure the window - I was afraid it would fall on my head in the middle of the night!  - Misleading photos - the place is NOT a one bedroom - it's a long thin studio - should have been made clear in the description  - Place was dirty. Fan in front of the bed was filthy. Cubbies were dirty.  - ONLY TWO TOWELS?? SERIOUSLY?? VERY CHINSY.  - Clearly an illegal listing. We had to pick up the key at a dry cleaner across the street, and we were instructed not to mention Airbnb to anyone we met in the building - we were told just to say "we're friends of Jase"

The location and the bed are the only reasons I gave this place 2 stars. There is a lot of room for improvement on this place.   The host got my checkin  day wrong and forgot to send me the information on how it works until a few hours before I was supposed to check in. I had messaged him a couple times days ahead of time to no response. Definitely had a stress dream the night before bc I hadn’t heard from him.   I came back to a dripping ceiling a couple different days. It was a headache bc instead of getting to rest before the broadway show I was attending one night, I was drying the kitchen and entryway and trying to figure out all the different spots the leaking was coming from. I ended up dozing off during my show. Then I had to deal with the landlord coming in/him sending in repairmen, which made my friend and I feel less comfortable leaving our things in the apartment bc there are no secure places to put things. Still the day after the repairmen came, there was more leaking.   The key is a pain. You have to pull it slightly out and twist it clockwise.   Anyway this was the worst Airbnb experience I’ve ever had. I have stayed in several places across multiple countries. Hands down the least clean and biggest headache.

The place was nice and amenities were good, but it wasn’t very clean. I didn’t wear shoes in the house as instructed, but my feet would get dirty, I could feel dirt and other stuff as I was walking. The ground and bathroom (toilet) also felt sticky which was unpleasant and the bathroom also had an unpleasant scent to it. Otherwise, the host was nice and responsive.

DISASTER!  Where to start... The room we were sleeping in wasn't even pictured in the ad. The room is small, not insulated from the cold (broken window). The sheets were disgusting, and we had no towels available. The most disturbing problem is that in Paul's accommodation there are 3 people including him, his roommates who are rude and not included in the ad. These people lived in a 20 m square apartment and were drunk and drugged. A very unpleasant smell of salt. And above all music, that is to say that there is a big speaker, a TV that is playing and a set, 3 sounds that are just unbearable! 24/7, we even heard the roommate singing at 3 a.m.… There were 2 women sleeping in this squat and we were very scared EVERY night. In addition, the neighborhood sucks, in fact we didn't know but Bronx is a very bad neighborhood.  Yes this Airbnb is not expensive but at what price? Our safety was in danger...

This place is a SCAM!! Do NOT BOOK THIS ROOM!  Jase asked for my phone number, then stopped communicating with me.  Next thing I know, I receive a message from AirBnb asking how my Check-In experience went.  But I had Never checked-in!! Nor did I hear from "Jase" again!  I wasn't even offered an apology.  There has been ZERO communication on his end.  I was STRANDED in New York City with no place to go and ended up sleeping a few hours in the bus station but mostly walking around the city to any place that was open until the next morning.  What an awful human being.  DO NOT BOOK THIS PLACE!!!
Room is super tiny, no breakfast, no cleaning service, shady location not safe at all

Close to Times Square and bus route ! The staff are kind and helpful and they provided a room refresh during our stay , which I thought was a nice touch ! They do require a 200 dollar security deposit that is refundable separate from what you paid to reserve it and a 50 dollar early check in fee just some things to note if you are planning out your money , I felt really safe no sketchy characters lurking around, which I saw seemed to be an issue in other places . They also have a quaint cute lobby ( which requires a room key to get into which provides a nice sense of security ) with snacks and drinks and seems to be a nice place for people to hang out and chat. Would definitely stay again !

Great location. Room is decent, but not as polished as the photos and some advertised furniture was omitted. Building amenities were great. Misleading address. Kind of shady vibes overall, but it worked well functionally for me as I transitioned to NYC full-time.

Had a wonderful stay, the apartment is beautiful with great natural light. The host was responsive and accommodating. I cant stress how amazing the location of this stay was, incredibly easy access to many lines going into manhattan and even the G. That as well as close access to the park and a neighborhood that was never too loud but never uncomfortably quiet. Would love to stay here again.

Abena is exceedingly friendly and extraordinarily responsive to questions or concerns about the booking. When the weather became hot, she even installed an AC for the room. I could not have hoped for a better host.  The booking is accurate, and the location is within easily walkable distance to groceries and food outlets. I did not encounter unpleasant experiences even taking walks out late at night. Do be wary that there is a major road fairly close to the room, and can be somewhat loud. However, I did not find this troublesome for work or sleep.  The WiFi can be a bit too slow at times to Zoom call (I believe the 2.4GHz bandwidth is overcrowded by the neighbors), but I managed to bypass this with the provided ethernet cable and by setting up a local 5GHz hotspot routed through the ethernet. I think a change in router configurations might have been able to resolve the WiFi problems, but I didn’t bother with it. Abena might come up with other solutions though.

The place was simply amazing! I was surprised as to how it accurately matched with the photos. The place is spacious and good enough for two people. The check in and check out was also pretty smooth and the detailed email sent by Jennifer ensured that I had no issues (even though I checked in very late at night). It’s located in lower Manhattan and I discovered a couple of good restaurants nearby. I was warned about the surroundings but I felt pretty safe staying here. It’s definitely a steal for the price.

DO NOT STAY HERE!! THEY ARE THIEVES! I GOT NO SLEEP HERE!  Bogus charges on my card for things I "stole" Rude staff, specifically the manager David.  He probably told them to stole things because he's a jerk.  The only person who was decent was Wally. Broken AC and staff who blamed me for it and made me fight to change my room at 2 AM when I had to be up at 7 AM the next day Stinky hallways  Literally all I care about is a clean safe bed where everything works.  I am not a difficult person to please with a hotel.  This was a stinky place where things were broken and management steals from you.  I'm still working with Airbnb and my Credit Card on getting full refunds.

Juliana was really flexible in our check in and check out times. She let us stay longer as we had a late flight home and made sure Alex was there to greet us and get us settled. She messaged us quickly if we had any questions and was up front about any known issues with the property, such as the lack of parking, so we had no unpleasant surprises when we arrived.  Flat was clean and had everything in the listing. Plus there were a few sodas in the fridge and some snacks available. She even left us an NYC fridge magnet, which was really sweet.  The location is really good for getting around. There is a subway station about five minutes away that can get you anywhere you want to go plus a shop with essentials at the end of the street. The only downside is that there was occassionally some noise from the street outside, but it was never enough to keep us awake.  All in all, it was a really good stay and a great flat to use as our base of operations for our New York adventures.

Great apartment…10/10 would definitely recommend it to anyone who would visit NYC. It is a 5 minute walk from B and D train metro station and 7 minutes from line 4. Juliana was very helpful and friendly and provided us with burgers and a salad as a welcome meal. Very clean and well oraganised apartment. The location is sometimes at night a bit sketchy but because the apartment was very close to the station everything was excellent.

I did not have hot water for the night I was there and they charge a “resort” fee which is technically illegal in New York. Everyone needs to know that you’re allowed to question and push back on this. The price on AirBnB is not accurate and when you pay on here it’s the “all in” price that I expected. Just buyer beware…$400 for one night and no hot water and some shady fees…hmmm..I’ll probably skip booking here again.

This makes for a great crash pad but it is not "nice." The bathroom is small (and the shower/tub situation is a little scary and gross, but it's clean. There is no sink in the bathroom. The kitchen is strange and would be hard to cook in. There is a mirror as a backsplash? There are two sinks in the kitchen... a large one and a small one. Makes up for the lack of sinks in the bedroom, I suppose? The light in the bedroom does not work. The space was quite clean though!  That being said, it's a great price and Gonzo was very communicative. The building is just a bit old and needs an update. You get what you pay for!

Super responsive! The location and building is a little shady but the Airbnb itself is amazing! It’s a studio apartment, so I didn’t expect it to be super big. The WiFi was a little slow but it was manageable. If you book this Airbnb, remember to bring toilet paper, shower material and tissue! Towels were provided which is a huge plus. There’s also a huge tv!

Very clean and Mario is very quick to respond to anything. The subway is about a 10 minute walk, the bus stop is about a 2 minute walk. A drug store, grocery stores are just around the corner. The area seemed very safe and people are, of course, very friendly which is the New York way.
Really don’t appreciate the fact that they are accusing me of stealing a roku remote when there was only one remote there.
Great, clean and very well-located. Definitely a steal!

Great apartment in a good location. Close to transport and nice bar and restaurants! Everything you need in the apartment. It’s reasonably quiet, except for the usual NYC traffic.  There is a homeless shelter nearby so there are few homeless around however I never had an issue!  I recommend staying in this apartment!

It is a great place, everything as described. Good location, not far if you want to walk uptown. The only thing I would recommend to those using the train is to avoid Bowery J, especially at night it can be a little unsafe. This guy was asking for money and then tried to kick me..

Roy was very easy to work with throughout the whole process! AirBnb was great. Perfect for our trip. Never felt unsafe in the area we were in (we were a very large group though!). The actual apartment mostly matches the photos, but some furniture could do with some updating.  Overall, great experience!

Terrible Place ! If youre looking to book think of a basement & think of the movie saw ! The water comes out brown , water pressure is unbearable to shower in , also floods the entire bathroom floor , also has a stinch to it , it stinks very bad ! This place should be shut down literally , also watch out for the host shes not the lady from her picture also actively walks into the rented space violating privacy! Turns down television & turns off lights! Barely heat , i slept in a deep freeze, the bed is hard theres no comfort , does not feel like home or a hotel or a reasonable stay for a reasonable price , i wasn’t expecting it to be this bad ! But this place was totally scary ! Also cameras inside the bnb ! While trying to sleep theres a loud humming noise makes it hard to sleep , i believe this place should be shut down.. I wouldn’t leave a review like this but it’s needed .

I want to start by saying that the location is great and the rooms very very clean.   The communication felt careless. Night one there was smoke from one room that came into our room and woke us up. Couple other guests were out in the hallway because of the smoke.   For folks ordering packages, all of our packages arrived and went missing. With Amazon providing us pictures, the team we’re not able to assist. It felt unsafe because our packages went missing, meaning someone had a code to get in.   Lastly there is a random camera facing our windows and room. We tried to inquire but no answer.   It was clean and comfortable besides the things listed above.

Location was not the issue but everything else was. I don’t even know where to start. First thing first, the host does not live in New York. Her check in instruction was that her friend had to open the apartment for us. We had to wait a while for her friend. We were outside for a while. As soon as we enter the building, there was nasty cigarette smell and it was dirty af. Actual apartment door was so old that the key hole was lose and we were scared it would just rip off.  Once we enter, floor was not as clean. We wore our socks the whole time. Rugs were dirty. Couch was unstable and not maintained. All we used it was to keep our jackets and purse. Host only provided one roll of tissue in the bathroom and apartment was full of their personal stuff like used oil STORED IN A CONTAINER. Every closet was full of her personal stuff like EACH AND EVERY CLOSET! To make everything worse, the heater blew the steam one night and she said it was okay and safe! Lastly, pillows had nasty stains!!
Our stay was stress free and cozy. Would definitely recommend this spot to anyone looking to stay near the city! Great host and excellent communication.
Awesome!!  Really appreciate how easy it was to taylor our stay to our needs.  Kat was a breath of fresh air in a very stressful time for us.

Great experience! check in and out is hassle free and communication with Bernardo is easy.The apartment has old new york charm but has been renovated just enough that it's really comfortable. The apartment borders on a sketchy neighborhood, but the actual apartment feels totally safe. its any easy bus ride or walk to the metro. Would definitely reccomend booking !

Ozzy place is a steal of a deal. You get a large bedroom for the price. In addition to that location is Ideal for those that need to take the A,B,C, and D trains. Grocery stores and other necessities very close by. Roommates were other professionals such as myself which made the stay very easy. If a problem ever does arise, Ozzy is only a text away and is very responsive. In my 6 months in NY, this was by far my favorite place to stay.

what to expect? It's a tiny 3-br aptment with tiny common area - the listing indicates that the apt was renovated in 2018, but it looks like it was converted from a 2-bed to 3 bed.  The bedroom was not small, but there was no livingroom or common space to speak of and much of what little free space was already occupied by the perma live-in rommates.  There are also some inexcusable misses, for instance, mold in the bathroom and dirty shared utentils and cookwares which clearly have not been cleaned since 2018.  If you plan on cooking or eat-in, bring your own everything.  Sharing a bathroom with 2 other roommates can be challenging at times, but it can get out of control when there are 4 roommates sharing one bathroom.  I rarely cooked, but had to suffer harrassment from the live-in roommate couple who rushed out of their room to check if I'm stealing their food whenever I opened refrigrator.  Not that I was bothered or cared, but it was nonetheless very obnoxious and rude.  The location was much further from the public transportation than I had expected -- took 10min to 15min just to get to the 7 train station and another 15min-20min to Grand Central.

Perfect space for a weekend getaway, she responded very quickly and helped us when we had any questions. Definitely made our first visit to New York as stress-free as possible.

Adela is the type of host you WANT when searching through AirBnb! Honestly, this was such a great experience. Adela was always so quick to respond, she is super accommodating, and she let my friend and I stay a few extra hours so that we could have some extra time to pack. The check in and check out process was so smooth. The apartment is perfectly cozy and located in an amazing part of Manhattan with tons of places to eat and close to the Subway. I would most DEFINITELY stay here again and highly recommend it. Stress free and very comfortable. Thank you again for everything Adela!!

We stayed in Tema's basement apartment for three days. The advance communication as well as the communication on the day of arrival were optimal and very friendly. When an email from air-bnb didn't reach us straight away, she helped us straight away. Thank you very much for this.  However, we can actually confirm some of the comments from other visitors. The location of the apartment is in a safe, quiet residential area. It takes about an hour to get to Manhattan by bus and train, but it's easy to find. However, the apartment itself is very noisy, so you can hear footsteps from above through the ceiling. (We have to publicly apologize to Tema at this point, because she probably also heard our 7-month-old baby, who unfortunately cried/screamed a lot at night. We're sorry about that and it was very unpleasant for us.) Sleep. & living room size were good for us, although we mainly used the apartment for overnight stays.   Unfortunately, the smell of the apartment didn't appeal to us. Since it is a basement apartment and it certainly gets wet from time to time due to the weather, the apartment had a slightly musty smell to us. The mold on the ceiling in the living room or the entrance door to the bathroom (below) supports this assumption.  We were also missing a (filter) coffee machine for our morning coffee. But instant coffee was available, which was great!  For overnight accommodation in New York, this apartment is certainly cost-effective, you just have to take into account the things mentioned above.

TL;DR ok room, abusive housemate, unresponsive host  When I moved into the house, I was optimistic. My room was exactly what I expected, and I was looking forward to meeting my housemates. The house is an interesting mix of long-term residents and short-term Airbnb guests. It has a lot of potential.   Unfortunately, one of the long-term residents is a bonafide psychopath — and she does her best to make everyone angry. Our problems started when she blasted the stove fans in the middle of the night. They are very loud. But when I turned them off, she immediately turned them back on, and lectured me about the dangers of carbon monoxide. When I bought a carbon monoxide detector to double check, she threw it in the sink, and soaked it with water. When I asked her not to break my belongings, she broke into my room, and stole my prescription drugs. I had to call the police, and file a report at 5am.   As the situation was escalating, I regularly messaged the Airbnb host, but rarely received a reply. When I moved out early, and asked if maybe I could get a partial refund — no reply.  Anyway, I’d stay somewhere else. There are plenty of affordable places in Queens where you won’t have to deal with such drama.

The place was very close to the subway and there is lots of food within walking distance but there isn’t a lot to do in Jackson heights and some parts of the neighborhood are very unsafe at night. The kitchen had grease all over the cabinets and there not even hand towels available or paper towels.
Was a great place to stay in the heart of the city and for a great price. The other reviews are correct that the building is a little sketchy but we felt perfectly safe and the room was very clean.

We had an amazing stay at Tinas Airbnb. The location could not be better, just a few minutes walk from the center of town and lots of amazing shops, bars, and restaurants.   We rented the whole apartment but unfortunately, we were not notified that the kitchen was shared with strangers. Because covid is a thing, we were scared and confined to the bedroom in an effort to practice proper social distancing.   In these troubling times we really have to stick together and go through all these hurdles that we’re all facing as America’s and as people and we love and support the troops.   I really enjoyed the color coordination in the whole apartment, it was aesthetically pleasing.   With all this political unrest, we tool solace in the fact that we had a doorman protecting us from the chaos outside but I when I arrived at the door I was completely hopeless and alone because the doorman was nowhere to be found. We all need a little love in these hard times.   The balcony was nice with the pretty flowers. It was nice to find an apartment in NYC with a balcony. I really appreciated that.   I want to thank god, Tina and little Timmy for an New York experience I will never forget.

I thought Airbnb was private people renting from private people. But this was a business renting out several units... On the pictures on Airbnb web site I saw a studio apartment with a sofa, a bed, a desk and a kitchenette. On the day of check-in, I receive a call from one of the administrators saying that unit is not available and we have upgraded you to a deluxe unit. Obviously it was too late fro me to look for something else. So I had to accept it... Once I saw the place I could immediately see that by no definition this could be considered an upgrade. The entire room was occupied by two huge beds. A tiny desk and a kitchenette. There was no place to properly sit down. I needed this place for work and then relaxing after a few hours behind the desk. But not possible here. I am not sure how clean the towels were. They did not make a good impression. So I went out immediately and bought fresh towels. In order to do laundry you had to buy a card for $10 that was not refundable. Sounds like scam?  That is how I felt... This was not a comfortable stay I had hoped for. I would not recommend this at all. Never again will I rent from Nomad.

Such a cozy , convenient little apartment in a shady quaint neighborhood. I could walk to everyone I wanted to visit plus Lyft was there in minutes if needed . Huge TV and all the movies I was already watching .. a big bonus on a rainy day.

Poor communication skills. This host accepted my request knowing it was just minutes before expiration time. I've used several hosts and I have never had this type of run around. If hosts don't feel they can stretch or bend like many others. They shouldn't be a host or accept someone's payment.  A thief comes to mind
No window shields, very dangerous. Images did not match the room

Great location in midtown close and easy to get to everything.  The building and that street itself is sketchy but the security at the building were friendly and plenty of cameras.  Apt was very clean and comfortable

The room itself was as described and Nomad staff was responsive. However after only one night we had to leave due to worry for our safety as we witnessed violence, drugs and discovery that the building is also a homeless shelter. The building dirty, loud and reeked of weed. The photos in the ad of the building are misleading. Don’t trust the reviews. Do your research before you’re locked in.

The room itself was very clean and nice, but the building was pretty sketchy.  The entire building smells like weed. If Icame back past 7 pm there were mass groups of men drinking and smoking right by the entrance and the security gaurd didn’t seem to care at all.  Additionally I was woken up at 9 am becausethere was a domestic dispute in the hallway and police came.  The location is very convenient but as a solo traveler I felt very unsafe.  I will also say that I lived in NYC for 14 years and I moved during the pandemic.  These examples were very extreme for the city.

This ended up being a private room in a hostel/hotel of sorts. Everyone staying here is a traveler so if you’re expecting to rent out someone’s home this is not the place. Overall the stay went well, and everything was mostly as described. Check in was smooth and there was always a helpful attendant at the front desk.   The building itself seems quite old and is not the cleanest- as you’re walking through the hallways it gives off a shoddy impression, with dim lighting, smell of cigarettes, and almost seems run-down. You can occasionally hear people talking loudly in the other rooms.  Thankfully the rooms themselves are much nicer, renovated, and true to what is on the listing. However, they could have been cleaned better prior to move in- there was quite a bit of dirt and dust particles on the ground in the corners of the room. The sheets and towels are clean and you are provided with ample soap, shampoo, body wash. Our bathroom was newly renovated but also gave off a string smell of cigarette smoke. Configurable AC in the room was working at full blast and was a relief in the humid summer.  Overall I think this is a good place to be if you don’t plan on spending much time in your room. You will be located in midtown which is pretty central to Manhattan. We could see the Empire State Building from our window. The only downside is at times there is a group of shady characters who like to hang outside the entrance to the building at times. A couple of times some guys in that group tried to say something to us as we were on our way in but I’m not sure what they wanted because we just ignored them. Those were the only minor safety concerns I had; I usually felt safe while inside the building and did not think the other guests themselves were shady- it was a pretty wide array of other travelers.

Unsanitary accommodation with a lot of cockroaches on the walls, ceiling under and behind the bed. Cleaning was not even carried out. Multiple pubic hairs in the bed plus things that look like bed fleas. The box spring was made of small metal sticks. I weigh 100 kg. I was afraid of breaking the very poor quality foam mattress.
