Unsuitable kitchen inaccessible, because you have to move the bed and not enough items to cook and the end result, we were forced to leave the accommodation on Christmas Eve at 2 a.m. with our young children Ps -13 degrees, it was the worst experience of our lives 🥹 we could compare it to sleep merchants I forgot the smell of cannabis in the corridors which was impressive and very annoying for the children. A person having fun constantly tapping on the radiator, supporting videos and photos.

We spent 45 beautiful days in Maria's apartment and that probably was the best place we ever stayed in NYC (including our own places because we live here :D).  Firstly, the apartment has a very special relaxing atmosphere, it feels like your own place of paradise. There are a lot of plants and I'm totally in love with the master bedroom bed arrangement. Secondly, I can't think of a better neighborhood in NYC (and I've seen quite a lot!). There's Prospect park nearby, a lot of restaurants and places of interest, Brooklyn museum etc. Thirdly, the building itself deserves 5 stars. It's a historic 100+ years brownstone with a classic Brooklyn entrance and a beautiful wooden carved staircase. Last but not least, Maria and Rob were easy going and always available to help with any questions or concerns.

We stayed at Maria's place for 5 weeks and loved every minute of it. For context, we've lived in NYC for 6 years so we know a gem of an apartment when we see one.  The apartment was sunny and spacious, full of vibrant green plants, had a washer and dryer in unit (a big deal in NYC), and was in beautiful brownstone Brooklyn. Sunrise and sunset views from the roof were spectacular and Prospect Park was a quick walk away which was perfect for our pup.  We're grateful to have stayed in a space that was so well cared for and had a relaxing energy about it.  Thank you Maria and Rob :)

The house is big and eclectic and well laid out. Aside from the master bedroom, the other bedrooms are a child’s room and a thin mattress on the floor of an office.   The backyard is lovely, if abundant in mosquitoes during the time of year we stayed there, because the astroturf traps water.   It is very much a well lived-in, well-loved family home.  There was unfortunately an incident of violent crime on the street while we were staying there,  but the owners assured us that has never happened before, and the rest of the neighbors on the street were similarly shocked.   The Airbnb is listed as Clinton Hill, but we were later informed it is, indeed, in Bedford-Stuyvesant.

This space is very neat and Sharon is very accommodating. It’s great for a short stay and I would even consider it for a longer stay. It’s equipped a lot of household essentials that help make your stay more stress free.

Trey’s place was nice and spacious for my friends and I. Everything was just like the pictures and check in was very easy. The train is conveniently close and in walking distance making it easy to get access to downtown Brooklyn and other sites. I would say depending on the person the location can seem intimidating at night as we took Uber’s most of the trip but there are some sketchy characters outside of the train station. Police presence is heavy but I would still be cautious. Everything else was perfect though!
Ella was a wonderful host and gave lovely advice about local amenities. She was really accommodating of us and took all the stress out of our move to Brooklyn.

Very responsive host and clean environment. It’s a 5-star well deserved.  He saved us the stress of ordering food after a tiring journey as the kitchen was well stocked (though there was no honey).  We even left with a bowl of ice cream.  Will surely love to stay again.

We rented the apartment for 5 days and 4 nights, and as a group of 5 girls, we each had 1 big luggage with us and every available space was utilized, good thing we’re really organized so we didn’t have much trouble with all our stuff but if you rent this and you have a lot of things, you might find the place really small and cramped.   The location is really good, it is walking distance only to some of NYC’s popular places such as the Times Square, Empire State, Flat Iron Building, Harry Potter store, etc. It is a busy street but the street noise/sirens didn’t bother us at all.  They provided the basic necessities such as shampoos, hand soap, towels, toilet papers, kitchenwares, small electric stovetop, water heater, microwave and refrigerator, 2 electric heaters. The only thing i noticed is that they didn’t have a disinfecting spray but there’s a small convenience store just across the street so that’s okay. And also the AC is a bit dusty and dirty so if y’all are sensitive or allergic to dust, you might want to communicate these things with the host so they can clean those as well. The beds are comfy enough, they have a big table where you can eat as a group and the place was safe enough, at least when we stayed over we didn’t encounter anything scary or something like that. The hosts are very friendly and accommodating and easy to talk with too.  A highly recommend this place! ❤️
It was very scary experience… host was aggressive and made the experience one of the worst nights of my life. Definitely not a good person & I think she is racist!!! Be safe and stay somewhere else.

What a steal for the price! Located on a quaint street within 10 minutes drive to JFK. Monisha’s hospitality couldn’t be topped. I stayed over the 4th of July and her family was BBQ’ing. She offered me a plate and the food was outstanding!  Also there was ample coffee and water, and even a refrigerator if you needed cold storage. She gave me directions to a nearby park, and was always quick to respond when I had questions. If you need a place near the airport that is safe and economical, this is an outstanding choice!

We had a good time. Communication was great.  The place is on the third floor, the first flight of stairs is a bit old but the rest everything looks good. Most of the place was clean, except for a cockroach that was walking around the floor in room 6 on our first day.  We also had trouble with Wi-Fi. Was impossible to have a connection in room 5 with both networks that was available and in room 6 we could connect but was without internet most of the time, also in both networks. For the rest everything was good!  The place is 4 blocks away for a subway station, what is really handy. Close by the station is a bit dark during the night and you have some homeless people asking for money.  The apartment is silent. And the rest is exactly how it’s described.  Besides those issues I still recommend the price, it was a good price for the city of New York.

NEVER BOOK WITH HER! SHE DID NOT EVEN LET US IN BUT THEN TOOK OUR MONEY AND REFUSED TO REFUND US! THIS IS A SCAM! Seriously she is trying to steal your money and is rude and hostile. Also she is affiliated with the police!

These are the Pros and Cons of staying in this studio - I stayed for 3 weeks with a friend.  Pros:  The Host Julia has excellent communication skills. Her response time was super fast and she and her team did everything they could to make our 3 week stay great. She is really spirited, courteous and helpful.  The studio was fresh and clean, nice refrigerator, appliances, coffee pot, utensils, hot plate type electric heat for cooking and a superb modern micro-wave - that worked really great. Wifi is fast.  There is a nice & convenient laundry room on the main floor.  The area is centrally located and transportation is a breeze - lots of buses, trains and taxes. There are tons of restaurants & coffee shops. Wholefoods and the wonderful Bryant Park are a short walk up 6th Ave.  Cons: The studio was very clean but the building itself is old and run down. The studio is super small (looks bigger in the photo,) it can fit up to 4, and there were 2 of us and we just about fit.   There are long term tenants who seem like they've lived here for decades. But, for the studio I rented,  it is basically a crash pad for tourists who are so busy all they need is a place to sleep, a shower, basic meal and are on the go. Tourists seem to really thrive in the building because they're going to shows, Empire State Building, etc. But as a non-tourist, this studio and building are a real challenge and I wouldn't stay here again.  Smoke - although there is supposedly a "tough" no-smoking policy, you can smell smoke as some of the other guests are smoking in their rooms. Then, to make matters worse - people are allowed to stand right in front of the building and smoke - so every time you exit you're faced with streams of smoke sucked into the building.   There are pot & drug dealers on the corner - who smoke 24/7 - the good news is that they don't bother anyone, just keep to themselves. So it's relatively safe.  The TV - during my stay I didn't really have time to watch television, since I had computer work to do, but when I did "try" to watch it was terrible. The set up is not good, and in the 21st Century ALL guests should have, and demand, basic cable. In this studio, there are rabbit ears antenna on top of a TV that only gets Crime TV, old Westerns, shopping channel, channel 7, religious channels and some odd stuff. There is no good reason not to have MODERN DAY TV for guests who are paying these competitive prices.

For the price and location, this apartment sounds too good to be true, but having been there myself I can tell you that it is real. It is definitely no frills. For a visit to New York of 2 to 3 people, it is going to be hard to find a better value in a better location than this, with a full shower and kitchen and everything. That said, I wouldn’t want to live in this unit. Host was responsive to any questions. The building seems to be mostly Airbnb‘s, with people coming in and out all day. It wasn’t a problem, but did have a bit of a strange quasi-hotel vibe. The area is completely fine though, to anyone commenting that the area is unsafe, it’s extremely safe and a great area.

Though the property had their own empty driveway, I was told to park on the street. Road side parking was not available. We had to park two blocks away, which was unsafe. we were given one bottle of water for two peole. No AC just a noisy fan in the room. The bathroom doesn't have ventilation. Couldn't even find a napkin. Suggestions for future guests: you can book a hotel for 90 bucks instead of this stuffy room.
I am afraid after a while we are like robot . No communication, just online . Order food , work from away. No any style life .
place is small but cozy, location is a bit sketchy, but not horrible. price was right, nice personal touches,made you feel welcome.

Accommodation corresponding to the ad and photos. The independent arrival went very well thanks to the clear information received earlier in the day. The accommodation was very clean, and very well located less than 10 minutes by Uber from the airport. A few remarks however: impossible to have internet despite the WiFi connection, it said that there was no internet connection even if you connected to the box. Only 1 towel for two... Good accommodation despite everything to spend a night before a flight.

The unit was at a great location. It's in a quite neighborhood away from the noise of businesses, but also in walking distance of restaurants, stores, a 24 hour CVS and a train station. Checking in and out was simple and easy, however getting up and down the steep stairs was quite challenging with our luggage. The unit was pretty spacious for NY. Both the bedrooms had A/Cs but the living room didn't and it got swelteringly hot in there during summer. The biggest problem we experienced during our stay was the bugs. There were fruit flies, cockroaches and spiders in the unit that ended up on the bed and made our stay unpleasant. Full disclosure: I did not let the host know about the bug problem during our stay as I did not want anyone else entering the unit while we were there. However, everything else was pretty great.

This was my first trip to NY and I'm so glad we stayed here! The neighborhood is lovely and not scary at all even walking back around midnight. Close to the start of a subway and even if you feel confused it's the start of the line so you can't go the wrong direction. It was great having a kitchen because there were a bunch of stands nearby with really fresh produce. Apt was exactly as pictured and hosts were great.

We do not agree at all with the rest of the comments below regarding this accommodation!   Apartment bordering on “unsanitary” Dangerous staircase to access it, terribly dirty apartment without any or the extreme minimum regarding maintenance!  Stains and traces present on all the walls, disgusting bathroom (hair, hair and other mold).  We had to redo all the dishes because they were visually dirty.  A strong smell of food permeates the apartment.  Not isolated at all, all the noise from the street is in your room!   /!\ Electric shock problem when touching switches. /!\ We do not recommend at all!

The apartment was cozy and great for a couples weekend. However the neighborhood was shady and uncomfortable to walk around. Also, the wall in the apartment very thin and you can hear loud music from other neighbors.

Cheapest option and wanted a kitchen. Smelled like cigs each night wafting into room. Woke up by neighbors’ violent, drug-adled screaming 3 different nights from 3-5 AM (woke up despite ear plugs & window being sealed shut by host), someone pounding on door another night, and loud gathering where people kept showing up in the apt next to us, all heard through paper thin walls during a pandemic. In between apts, so needed a place BUT wouldn’t recommend this one unless you’re in a bind. Laundry has you buy a $10 card just to add money on it. WiFi worked great. Mimi fridge and stovetop was helpful. If you want something tiny and cheap, go to the Arlo Nomad (On Airbnb) a block away where we eventually moved.  Otherwise, embrace the chaos and bring plenty of sleeping pills.
An okay apartment. Pretty noisy and aways a sketchy group of people hanging out right outside the building.

The place has an excellent location.  Maybe the atmosphere of the building scares you a bit but we at least had no problems.  The room has the conditions you need and anything you need you can communicate with the owner.  I recommend it!  —   El lugar tiene una ubicacion excelente. Quizas te asuste un poco el ambiente del edificio pero nosotras al menos no tuvimos ningun problema. La habitacion tiene las condiciones que necesitas y cualquier cosa que necesites puedes comunicarte con el dueño. Lo recomiendo!
Everything about my stay was perfect, host/apt/cleanliness but the area surrounding  the location was hella sketchy. Be safe 🙏🏼

The reviews on this Airbnb can be somewhat deceiving as they primarily focus on the price. Yes, this bnb is located in a very good area and for the price is seems like a steal, but anything with this low of a price tag in NYC comes with its downfalls. If you are sensitive to mold, DO NOT stay here. The bathroom very strongly smells of mold, there’s mold growing on the wall beside the toilet, and the AC is all consumed with black mold. The queen bed has a large divot on the left portion of the bed and whoever sleeps on that side will sink into it and have terrible back pain the following morning (not ideal for the city). At night this place is surprising quiet but in the mornings other floor tenants tend to get loud (at least for our stay). Yulia is super responsive and flexible with check in’s and check outs. If you are a hypochondriac, germaphobe, or claustrophobic avoid this space. If you like a cheap stay in a great location and don’t mind the fear of mold/roaches, book away! (Note: our stay was only 24 hours and we did not see a point in asking the host to resolve these issues as they were likely not to be resolved quickly.)

Place is filthy! Bathroom sink is backed up! Window blinds are broken and filthy. Gum on the floor. I dropped a pillow in the floor and it was full of dust! Bed linens where dirty. We bought blankets and slept in them. Cigarette and marijuana strong smell in building and in the apartment! Party happened for 2 nights above us and they stomped up and down the stairs above us!  Very sketchy people in hallways! Only compliment I have is the location. I would never stay in this building! Not safe!

Worst stay on bnb to date. Host was rude and had late responses. Also forgot to return key and host harassed and threatened me. Apartment was small and I couldn’t even walk from wall to wal because there was literally a bunch of beds in the partment. Front desk was no help. My car was stolen from in front of the building and they wouldn’t even let me see video footage or call police. Had cops show up still were no help.
clean, reliable, well-kept. the flight of stairs up was kind of scary (esp raining with a suitcase), but overall it was a pleasant experience.
Unfortunately the amount of stairs was not clear from description. Also area feels unsafe for people and car.

This is not a standalone suite as advertised.  You have to walk through John's kitchen to get to your unit's entrance... Basically they have sectioned the house off by putting padlocks on all the different areas of the house and calling them "suites".  Also, when asked for full refund, I was still charged a cleaning fee for a room I never even entered whatsoever.  Shady doesn't even begin to describe this listing.

It was a lovely space that had everything we needed! John and Ann made a particularly stressful time quite pleasant!! There were lots of delicious snacks for the adults and my granddaughter!! They were very thoughtful!! Parking was easy for NYC! There was a dog park a block away! We loved the area and especially the outdoor space!! Highly recommend!
This is a steal if you are looking for somewhere nice and quiet

We lived here for the summer, and it was really great! The location was very nice, there’s lots of shops and places to eat. Doug was very accommodating and easy to communicate with. I was afraid that it would be humid during the summer since it’s a ground floor apt but the AC worked really well. Overall great stay!

During our stay we felt completely unsafe. On two separate occasions, we had the renter / tenant from upstairs enter the living room because they knew the code, and the owner was unable to address the issue after the first time it happened. One of the windows was broken and in general we felt like our belongings were not safe in the Airbnb. Would only recommend this place if you are in a pinch.

Hernan is an amazing host. He was incredibly nice and respectful. The apartment was very clean and in the perfect location. There are tons of great places in walking distance of the apartment. Hernan was also very lax about checkin/checkout which was a huge help for me since I was subject to my train schedule when arriving and leaving. The room was also an absolute steal. Such a great value, especially when considering how great of a host Hernan is and the area that the apartment is located. The next time I go to NYC I will definitely be hoping this room has some availability.
Great location. Easy to walk or get a cab to most places we wanted to go. Never felt unsafe.👍 Nice and clean. Good AC. Answered us quickly when we had a question :-)

Wonderful host. Deycke does her best to accommodate all of her guests. She let me check in an hour early. She was quick in responding to all of my messages, and recommended some great restaurants in the area. The G subway station is around the corner. It makes it easy to get around NYC. The room is actually quite spacious, which is great since it rained during most of my visit. I had a delightful, stress-free stay.

I will need to divide my review into two very different experiences: the apartment itself (good) and my interaction with Eric (miserable). Let me start with the positive because that is the kind of person I am. The apartment is beautiful and well located. Eric, however, was rude and untruthful. I’ll try to save you all the details but here is a summary: Eric had notified us a few days before we were scheduled to arrive that the city was working on the water main and that the street will be under construction; worse yet - the water will be shut off several evenings from 9 pm till 3 am. A major nuisance but not under his control, we understand. We had to live with that since there was not enough time to look for another place. The street was indeed a mess and we had no water for two nights. We took it in stride. When the water resumed, the pipes in the upstairs bathroom rattled terribly and the bathroom floor flooded. We turned off the toilet faucet and notified Eric’s assistant Carolyn. She promised to take care of it the next morning.  And the next. And the plumber couldn’t make it. And he’ll be there the next day... On and on - broken promises and lies (including Eric himself telling us bogus stories when we bumped into him).  Long story short - the toilet was never  fixed for the remaining 4 days we stayed there. Eric was extremely rude in his few communications with us (via text only), accusing us for being “complainers”; asking why we needed two bathrooms and not notifying him ahead of time  that we had medical needs making the second toilet essential, etc., finally, on the last day admitting the problem couldn’t be fixed until after we left (as if we hadn’t  figured it out). There was also an issue with a very splashy shower that had lukewarm water (at best) and turned cold when two persons showered at the same time in the two bathrooms. Mentioning it caused Eric to further reprimand us.  In summary - a rude owner of what would have been a nice place. We left with a very unpleasant impression.

Great location near NYP Columbia where I was working as a travel nurse. Location is half a mile away and easily walkable. I had a package stolen the last day I was there, so if you have mail delivered there, make sure you sign for it or have it held at UPS or USPS site.

You get what you pay for. Chris and Wesley are extremely detail oriented and conscientious hosts. Their home has any amenity you could think of. Their guide is super handy. They are super accommodating and went out of their way to make our stay comfortable: they let us come by and leave our luggage at the unit before our check in time (had to checkout in the AM from prior place). Bushwick is a super fun neighborhood for young people, a little gritty for families, but we never felt unsafe roaming around with our stroller.   The home is very well renovated (not flimsy and scuffed in anyway). The yard is undersold by the photos in the post. we all slept really well because the bedrooms are extremely sound insulated and dark and have quality bedding  (though the beds are small).  Would definitely consider staying here again if we wanted to do Bushwick round 2!

What can I say about my stay, other than an abundance of praise?!  I mean, to start...it was almost like the pictures doesn't do the place justice; just because of the small, random amenities that met the needs you didn't/wouldn't even know you needed. Like there's no picture of the cool-ass digital clock that switches up every minute or so...to inform you of the day & week's weather for the area; to inform you of the MTA trains coming & going at the very nearby Chauncey & Halsey street stations; to inform you of when sunrise & sunset takes place that day. There's no picture of the retail store style steamer, that I hadn't even ever come across again since working retail at Abercrombie & Fitch; I'd once thought I'd have a panic attack if I ever saw one of those again...but it was SUCH A BLESSING instead. The thermostat was even set to the perfect temperature that I love any spaces I'm in to be...a cozy, toasty 72 degrees fahrenheit; the perfect temperature for not needing to scurry to put on clothes when the sun sets, or when you need to run to the restroom in the middle of the night, or when you wake up and make that first cup of coffee while half-asleep. And for those worried about not being able to sleep, 'cause that temperature is too warm...THERE WERE DYSON FANS in each room, already on, blowing directly onto each bed at just the right speed & temperature setting. Like these are all the little added touches that weren't caught in the pictures...while the space does indeed look exactly as beautiful, clean, and put together as shown in the photos. But as someone who's worked in hospitality for a decade now, from hotels to restaurants to bars...even part of the soft & grand opening team of a few...I know extremely well what it means to anticipate a guest's needs, and fulfill those needs without the guest ever needing to ask. And I gotta say, 1. it's a very keen attention-to-detail that's still rare to come across in the world of hospitality, and 2. Chris & Wesley hit that sh*t outta the ballpark (they've got me over here using profane language on this respectable website/app) quite seamlessly...so much so, that I'd felt like they'd literally taken a survey from me before my arrival, and then adjusted the entire apartment to my specifications disclosed in said survey.  There were even at-home COVID-19 testing kits in the bathroom, so I could see if it was the torrential rain storm I got caught in Sunday night, that caused me to have the sniffles and a runny nose for the remainder of my time in NYC...or if it was the 'Rona, continually wreaking more havoc. And don't even get me started on the other products in the bathroom! I need to track down all the Aesop products now, after using that exfoliating handsoap...that you could feel the little, tiny beads doing their job each time you used it to wash your hands. Okay, I really gotta stop here...'cause I could truly go on and on and on and on. But on a final note, out of all the random ups and downs, some highs and quite a few too many low lows I experienced while on this very first trip to NYC, New York, and the east coast in general...Chris & Wesley's space was the one & only consistent, reliable, stable, and comforting positive aspect of the trip that I was always ready & happy to spend time in and return to. They too, themselves, were just as warm & welcoming, understanding, and great at communicating & responding. Moral of the story...go find out for yourself, or be stuck with the regret of wishing you had.

My stay was amazing. The apartment was exactly how it looked in the photos. Before booking I read a bunch of reviews and there was one that stood out to me about all the small details that made it feel like home. There were so many things that the photos didn’t capture. Every area in the apartment was stocked with so many little things that you normally forget to pack. The hosts were communicative and let me know when they were going to use the hot tub. The weekends weather scared us from utilizing the hot tub but the backyard was gorgeous. I would definitely book again it was worth every dime. If they ever considering renting their place for a more permanent situation I would gladly talk numbers with them. ❤️ thanks for sharing your space with us!

When I arrived the place was dirty, bags of trash everywhere. I called them and texted them that I had arrived but no response. I had to ask to find the place. Once I found it Sarah was the one that showed me to my room. She even apologize for the place being so dirty. Fast forward to later that day I asked her to show me how to lock the door so naturally when I left I did. Then later that night I get a text from Kaptan asking me why I locked the door. Naturally when one leaves you lock the door behind you so they don’t steal your belongings. His message to me was, and I quote “maybe you are turning in the wrong direction.” Fast forward to the next day, I had issues opening the door so I went through the one downstairs which was unlocked. Kaptan was there so I asked him to show me how to unlock it, apparently the key lock has an odd trick to it. Not your typical twist and turn. This time around the place was clean and didn’t have any issues with anything else. I liked the area but not this airb&b.

Do yourself a favor and avoid this host at all costs. Ro was a host nightmare.  After accepting my 8 week rental, Ro demanded a $2000 security deposit be paid to him via money order after I had already committed to stating in the unit: red flag #1!  I explained to him the AirBnB security deposit policy, which mandates that AirBnB deals with it, and AirBnB insurance policy and he was ok.  The nightmare continued once Ro got his first months payment.  He demanded the final three weeks within 24 hours via money order or he was ending my rental early, after 21 days: red flag #2!  AirBnB Support spoke to him to let him know the AirBnB long term rental payment policy, but he still refused to follow the AirBnB terms of service.  He sent his Aunt into the unit the next day to collect the $3,000: red flag #3! (Also creepy that others besides my host had access to where I was sleeping.  Needless to say I began putting the chain lock on my door because I was afraid someone would come in when I was sleeping, demanding the $3,000).  AirBnB Support continued to work with him to explain their payment policy.  He then told me that he informed AirBnB that he was cancelling the rental on the 1st since I did not pay him the $3,000 via money order within his 24-hour demand leaving me to find alternate accommodations at last minute. It was a nice unit but a nightmare host. I’m sure Ro will say that he was lied to by AirBnB that he would get all of the payment for the rental within 24 hours, but a quick online search displays the clear, concise, and transparent policies that AirBnB has as part of their terms of service. In all fairness, it seemed like his first time on AirBnB as a host so he didn’t know much about any policies, but continued to violate the Terms of Service after becoming aware of each one he broke. Good luck!

My first time booking an Airbnb and usually don’t write reviews but in this case I feel I needed to. Let me start by saying Rosan was a pleasure to communicate. However, upon checkin time we were very disappointed with property due to the lack of cleanliness and the maintenance of the property.  Pee stain  and hair was found on the master bathroom.  Kitchen air vent noisy and full of lent/ dust. The bed foot rails was held together with zip ties. Holes in the wall and the stair railing was coming off the wall. The pictures posted makes the property looks very nice on the surface but needs a bit more attention. I addressed my concerns to the host and it ended up us having to leave the place the following day by 11am. Totally unexpected and unprofessional. Had to scramble to fine a place. For a time to enjoy and not to stress this had been an horrible experience.

This Airbnb was a great location for what we needed! My family and I stayed at this two bedroom Airbnb during Labor Day weekend. The location was great as it was 15 minutes from the US Open tennis tournament which is where we spent our days. The outside area was a little bit sketchy but inside you did not feel that way. Our only disappointment was the cleanliness of the apartment. There was a something on the shower curtain which we cleaned off the first night and the rest of the apartment just needed a good clean. Other than that it was a great Airbnb!

This was our first trip to NYC and I'm glad we selected this location! Jeff's hospitality was more than we expected and his response time to our concerns was very appreciated. This place is exactly how it's dedcribed and photographed.   Some things to be aware of; the bathroom is the smallest space in the apartment. The flooring has some changes in level so be cautious of this. We didn't stay long enough to take advantage of the back yard space but what a great area for entertaining and younger children. Read the house rules and don't be afraid to ask questions or make a request. Although this location may not be ideal for people with physical disabilities (wheel chair or walker) my family and I will consider staying at this location again for future trips to NYC. 😃

I confirm all the positive things that I have read in other comments and which allowed me to choose this Airbnb for my 4-night stay in NY. Easy communication with Kaptan for an ideal check-in. The spacious room, the comfortable bed. The apartment is large, clean and tastefully decorated. All very calm. Great area for going out, lively restaurants and bars less than 5 minutes walk away. The hosts are very welcoming and there for you if needed. Flexible check out, my suitcase kept until my evening flight. Flawless!

This was our first trip since leaving NYC a year ago. I left because of a cancer scare (during which my child attempted suicide) and honestly never thought I'd return again. So...booking a trip was pretty emotional for me and my daughter. In my opinion, the home is magical.  The rooms are exactly as advertised. The beds are comfy. You feel like you're home. What makes it even better is that Jeff lives above the property but it feels like you have the whole place to yourself.  We had light company to watch movies while there and followed the noise recommendations...and honestly...it was just perfect. A perfect week in NYC.  Some things to note: The pandemic is still happening and people are just starting to be outside again in NYC. We mostly stayed inside other than going to the grocery store and one birthday party.   I can't tell you about local eats or activities in the City...but it didn't matter.  The house was truly like a home away from home - which we strangely needed after months of being cooped inside. Additionally, Jeff was so kind. He responded quickly and was around during the day like a friendly neighbor. But he was still somehow out of sight and gave us our privacy.  We are smokers and there is NO smoking inside. And it didn't matter. Smoking outside was cozy whether it was day or night. I'm super grateful. We even extended by one day, and he was fine with it.  When w come back to Queens, this is our spot. 5 star trip, all around!

The apartment was exactly as it looks in the pictures.  The apartment is large enough for two or three people to move around comfortably.   I did not watch the TV but I'm sure it worked fine.  The internet worked great and I was on zoom or Teams meetings from 9-6 Wed and Thursday. I used my iPad and streamed movies at night. I don't believe there was an outlet in the bathroom and there is limited outlets in the living area but I made it work.  The water for the shower was hot every day, if there was a problem in the past it has been fixed.  The location was perfect as my daughter lives in Washington Heights.  There were a ton of places to eat, high Dominican Republic and Spanish influences, I loved it!. There are also a ton og grocery stores and shopping all around including store fronts and street vendors. The subway (1 line) was close but was a little sketch at night (it is NYC). Although no one ever bothered me, there were quite a few homeless people out and about.  I know the A line was close but I never took this subway line.  The neighborhood felt safe, esp during the day. There are 3 flights of stairs plus the entry stairs, so keep that in mind if you cannot handle stairs.  This is not a hotel so not everything is perfectly sterile but I was comfortable the entire stay. I would definitely stay again.  You cannot beat the value. The host was very quick to respond!

This was my second stay. The first one was during June, and went impeccably. Can't say the same about the December stay.   While the place is in line with the listing, and is cleaned daily I believe, and is a comfortable, well-located place for a good value, I had 3 major issues with it that are deal-breakers for future stays:  1. The host is not communicative up to other Airbnb host standards. She does not pick up the phone if you have an urgent issue, and sometimes is unresponsive on messages as well. I had to message her twice to get an answer over 24 hours later.   2. The host has an unsafe practice with door codes. I stayed there in June and the main entrance door code was the same now as 6 months ago. This is a very unsafe practice as many guests come through the 8+ rooms in this house / hostel Airbnb. Furthermore, the ROOM CODES ARE NOT UPDATED IN 6 MONTHS EITHER! Huge red flag folks. Just read the reviews, many guests stay there more than once. This means other people in the house or vicinity potentially have a key not only to the building you stay in, but also to your room!  How do I know that? The host sent me an incorrect room instructions. When I got there, I checked in to the wrong room already occupied by another person. Luckily that person wasn't there and I quickly locked it. Tried calling the host, she didn't pick up. I had an appointment in Manhattan and had to leave ASAP, was already late. So out of desperation, I checked my messages from June and used the door instruction for the room I booked in June, which was next-door and I thought maybe the host made a mistake and the old room I booked was supposed to be reserved for me. The code was the same 6 months later! The room was made up, so I left my luggage and went to the city for my appointment. While on route, the host messaged me the instructions for another room, not the one where my luggage was in. I spent several hours worrying about the safety of my luggage being in another person’s room. The host moved it before I got there, which I appreciated, but it didn’t make the process smooth and carefree in any way.   Also, now I have the 'keys' to 3 rooms in this house. Imagine how many other guests have a heavy keychain like me. Would you feel safe staying there knowing that?  3. The heat - the host keeps this house at very uncomfortable temperatures. If you’re staying there in the cold months, either make sure you have thick skin, polar camping equipment, or avoid this place altogether. I asked her about the heat and she first didn’t bother to reply. When I asked again, she told me she follows NY’s law for heating requirements provided by landlords. I lived in NYC for 8 years and no reasonable landlord who wants to keep tenants follows these rules. They are inhumane. 66F during the day and 55F at night when outside is below freezing. I highly doubt the host treats herself to the same temperatures, yet somehow expects her guests to be comfortable. She is also not a landlord but an Airbnb host - big difference and these NYC heating laws are for landlords not Airbnb hosts. She offered me a refund for the remaining stay as a solution - really? My schedule was so packed there’s no way I would have tried to book a last minute hotel or airbnb mid-stay..I got the flu due to the uncomfortable cold temperatures, I couldn't sleep.     Other than the above, the place is just as described and if you don’t care about safety or comfortable heat in the winter, then it might just be the perfect place for you. I know I’ll be avoiding it on my next trip in February.

The apartment was perfect for us and our two kids. Very comfortable beds and fully equipped kitchen. Keyless entry made check in stress-free. The host was very easy to get a hold of and helpful.   Great location, close to metro and plenty of places to eat, grocery shop or get laundry cleaned.   Merci Artem!

Notified host there was NO HOT WATER the day we arrived.  She insulted me when she insinuated we were making it up as they “have never had that issue before..” There’s a first time for everything.  Host said she sent a plumber on our last night there but no-one checked in our unit on the 2nd floor!?  We told the host we were waiting for the plumber and she wasted our last night.  It doesn’t mean anything if there is hot water in the basement when we are on the 2nd floor.  Never got to shower or wash hands during winter and a pandemic; unsafe, very disappointing, and ruined our trip.  Wish I had known the house is being turned into luxury condos so the host doesn’t care to fix anything.  There was 1 small hot water tank for both rental units so if you are on the 2nd floor, hope the 1st floor people don’t shower or use it all up.  2nd bedroom is not legal and has no windows.  Good location but you couldn’t pay me to stay there again and deal with such a rude and uninterested host.
He is a very kind man. He has asked me first to put my bike in his kitchen area, which he thought that it could had been stolen. Also he responds to any requests very quickly.

Yero was a very friendly host who responded quickly to messages, gave us flexible check-in and check-out, and did his best to accommodate our needs. The room and the entire apartment were fine. It's not a 5 star hotel and it's not supposed to be. We were only there to sleep and it was completely sufficient for that. The apartment is in the Bronx, about an hour by train from downtown Manhattan. It didn't bother us. However, you did feel a bit unsafe on the way back from the train at night and I wouldn't recommend walking through this area alone at night.  As a German, I had an urgent need to ventilate after the first night. However, I couldn't figure out how to open the windows, so the room developed a slightly unpleasant smell during our time there. All in all we had a pleasant stay.

We were desperate to find a convenient place to get to a wedding in lower Manhattan after another AIR bnb host cancelled on us last minute. Maria was very responsive, really flexible, totally available, and made the stress of the cancellation (on Marathon weekend, no less!) dissipate. The place is located on a quiet street where street parking on a weekend was actually no problem, even when we got there late in the evening. That was unexpected and helpful. The apartment itself is a refuge, simple and elegant, with everything we needed. Maria was super-communicative, really understanding, and helped us to fully enjoy what would have otherwise been a really hectic weekend. Highly highly recommended!
Low stress registration and check in. Easy in and out, perfect for our needs and fair price point.

I wouldn’t consider this place for anyone who’s looking to stay without tv , bathroom being used by other Tenants wide open , as well if you are not bother by tenants and host being in your business . As the place is SUPER QUITE AND feel your just being watched and listen to from outside your own Door .  I suggest go somewhere else honestly . If your homeless this is a place for you other than that I personally would not recommend this place to any of my family or friends .

I tried to rent and the space was to small for my pregnant sister and I. We was 4 hours away from home and told Claudia we didn’t want to stay because of the size of the unit. My sister needed more space. Let alone she said don’t “said” you are here for Airbnb so my sister was already suspect. So we cancelled our reservation because we wanted a bigger space. We ask Claudia if we may please get a refund she said yes. I called the customer service number for Airbnb and they informed me Claudia refused the refund after we had explained my sister is pregnant and need another bigger space and we will need the money back to get another location. As to me she was more into The money than to actually care about our safety. I’m aware of the cancellation protocol but it was selfish of her to keep the money after we explained ourself. We had to stay in our CAR for over 3 hours trying to figure out where to go Let alone figure out how We would pay for a room for the night. Just didn’t feel safe when she said “DONT DAY YOU ARE HERE FOR AIRBNB let alone the space was small for us.

Maria’s place was an incredible stay and a steal in New York! Located right next to a major train line made it easy to navigate around the entire city. And Maria was incredibly responsive throughout my whole stay. She went out of her way to set up my stay to be comfortable, safe, and just like home. It’s even better than the pictures and the check in/check out process was really easy. This Airbnb is equipped with cleaning supplies, kitchen amenities, AC in the rooms, office space for those who might be working—all of which felt just like home. I would absolutely stay here again and recommend anyone to check out her place to stay at!

It’s very much an unfinished basement in Staten Island. I didn’t feel safe in the area as a woman alone. At one point a white van followed me down the street.   The host has also discontinued between-guest cleaning services and I didn’t know this until I got there. I feel like this detail needs to be more clear.   There’s no natural light in the apartment, and the few windows are blocked by clutter.   The tub and toilet broke during my stay and the tub spit up some strange black gunk. Even the key didn’t work when I first arrived. Flies also managed to get in somehow even though I was careful about following the trash disposal instructions.  For positives, the host was communicative. It’s roomy. There’s a refrigerator and microwave. If you’re a healthy, tough-minded student on a tight budget who isn’t afraid of much and doesn’t mind laundering strangers’ sheets during a pandemic, it’s ok. Just ok. Even then, not great. Just ok.  For what I spent on new sheets and extra ubers and cleaning supplies and showers, I could have just got a hotel.   Please. Consider just getting a hotel. They’re more affordable now. The toilet will work. The shower will be clean. They’ll wash the linens.

GREAT spot by JFK Airport. My flight came in delayed, all the hotel options were overpriced for how sketchy they were and so I asked Christine if I could stay at this location just for the night for my layover till I flew out the next day. Christine was very responsive, very kind and hospitable and it was definitely very cozy. Also, they have bottled waters! Which is very nice when you’ve spent the entire day traveling and are very dehydrated. 10/10 recommend!

Location, location, location!  Fabulous great sized apartment (for NYC) in mid-town Manhattan (Murray Hills area) within walking distance to just about everything! The apartment is very spacious with a separate bedroom with a very comfortable bed, good sized kitchen (with basic amenities - coffee, tea, sugar, salt/pepper), and a very large couch and large TV.  There is construction in the building next door which started every morning at 7AM (looked early on in the project so suspect 1-2 yrs before it is finished), so I recommend bringing excellent ear plugs if you like to sleep in.  The host is amazing and was  very quick to respond when we had a few questions. This place is awesome - I highly recommend booking it!

This accommodation was very clean and safe. Just a $10 Uber ride from jfk. The host was kind, thorough and communicative. All amneties were present. I was able to rest and then some before my long flight over seas. I cant emphasize enough how welcome and safe I felt in her home. This place is a steal and I recommend it to anyone especially those on a long layover at JFK. Merci bien Suzan!

Ying’s place is lovely. The surrounding area felt safe and comfortable and far from the craziness of midtown. I had no trouble with getting a seat or table at the area restaurants and bars. I cannot stress enough how safe I felt. I walked around with ease just taking everything in, feeling like a cool New Yorker.  Ying is very personable and was available for questions and brief conversation with out being intrusive.  I had the perfect mix of life by being able to leisurely bike through Central Park, or take a quick ride on the Q train into midtown.  Absolutely perfect!

Terrible host she left my request pending for 4hrs. Then confirmed 4hrs after I asked her to cancel. Refuse to give me a refund even though I didn't spend a night their. She is a straight up thief. I'm still trying to get my money back.

We are locals who needed to stay nearby during some construction to our place. I am beyond grateful to have found Shannon’s place. I mentioned we have a toddler and poof! there was a crib! And toddler tub! And high chair! And so many other really incredible and thoughtful touches that made an otherwise stressful time actually fun. Beyond that, the place was spacious, extremely clean (I’m the kind of person that notices everything, so that’s saying a lot), COVID mindful, and communication was immediate. If we were in a similar situation in the future I’d be relieved to come back to such a great place.

There could not have been a more convenient way to explore NYC while staying at Alison's apartment. She thought of things my family of 5 would never have! A basket of maps and attractions, and even half a dozen eggs in the fridge were little touches that warmed our hearts and kept us knowing we were not another transaction. The check in process seemed scary at first knowing we had to go to a third party location to pick up and drop off the keys, but after experiencing it first hand I wouldn't have had it any other way! Safe, secure, thoughtful, and very much appreciated. Thank you!

Great location!  Was perfect for 5 people. AC worked great in the 80 degree weather. The key pick-up/drop-off was a little stressful & confusing but we were able to reach Alison for her to help us so it all worked out. There was some pretty loud club music pumping a couple of the nights -- not sure if the building is connected to a bar or club, or where that was actually coming from? B/c the AC was running so loudly in the two bedrooms they didn't hear it as much as I did sleeping on the futon in the living room -- so I'd recommend bringing ear plugs to help disguise the noise.

Me and my girlfriend spent an entire week at Michelle's place. She and her family made us feel like home from the very first minute. The flat is actually bigger than what you would assume from the pictures. Everything was clean. The next subway station is roughly 10 minutes by foot and takes you to Manhattan in another 30 minutes. The area is mostly calm and quiet at night, we never felt unsafe. It was a pleasure for us to stay at Michelle's and I highly recommend the place to anyone looking for a warm-hearted host family!

I am so glad we picked Swanns apartment . Close to everything . Safe neighbourhood, cafes and restaurants only a short walk away..  can I stress how immaculate Swann keeps his apartment .. my 5 night stay was perfect . Could not fault a single thing  We will definitely be coming back Swann
Great places to stay in low stress location. Old Queen aesthetic thatadded to the overall experience of the trip. Swan was super Chill and made for a great host.

Swann is the next level host. Like everyone says he's very friendly and gives a lot of advice if you need it. If not, he will give you your personal space.. well not actually, because on our stay he was always at home.  We really appreciate that Swann let us in at late night and the last day he let us leave our luggage till evening. Thanks! Ok, if you need to know about apartment and comfort, lets jump in! Neighborhood is quiet and safe. subway is 4min away. Directed 20min to Manhattan. Apartment looks just like in the photos. bet is super comfy. But one thing.. really sorry to say that, Swann. In your kitchen are living cockroaches. They were scared me off all the time I needed to take something. In general I recommend this appartment. Thank you, Swann!

The place was lovely and very well taken care of. Clean and spacious. Walking distance to many convenient stores and restaurants.   Only thing I would change, or warn about, is the private exit. Not the hosts fault but it opens up to an alley type driveway. A bit scary to walk through at night when you’re returning. They do have motion sensor lights but you need to reach the very end of the driveway/alley for them to turn on. Other than that, loved the place and people! We definitely plan to use this place again!

Christian was a great host. I was only here for a night and was out for most of the night. I really only used the place to sleep for the night before my friends arrived the next morning. The place is AS ADVERTISED, with the exception that it definitely was a lot more spacious than I thought. I had read all the reviews before I booked the place and people mentioned how there weren't any windows to let in some fresh air and I totally understood what they meant when I stayed inside the room for longer than 30 minutes. Christian does a great job by providing a fan and air purifiers in the rooms, although you will need to go out once in awhile to get that O2.   Christian responded really fast and was there to greet me and let me know about all the shops and stores nearby. He was very helpful in directing me to certain places.   I enjoyed my stay here as it was short and sweet. I would recommend this place to anyone staying a night or two, or just needing to get some shut eye for the night. It's nice! + the rate for the room and living room is a great steal! The house is in a safe neighborhood and there are a few bakeries nearby.

I can recommend staying there.  1) It’s quite close and easy to get to many tourist spots or events; 2) There are some supermarkets around (one of which is open 24/7). 3) The best is comfy and the apartment is quite clean 4) The host is friendly and helpful with whatever questions you might have  Note: The apartment is located in a Jamaican neighbourhood and the area next to the metro might feel a bit sketchy because of homeless people (but nothing compared to the areas of Paris North for example), but the area next to the apartment is fine, so do not worry.

Kalani’s place was beautiful. We felt like we had walked into a magazine but it was also very practical to live in as guests. Kalani provides plenty of space for your own things. The neighbourhood is very friendly, very safe. It was a pleasure to walk to the deli just down the street and be greeted by so many people. The laundromat is opposite the deli. Coin machine at the laundromat was very handy. The next door neighbour is a taxi owner and was able to take us to the airport when we left.   A few times we walked from the train station to home very late at night but never did we feel unsafe.  Public transport is easy here. You have a choice of bus or train. It took us 15 minutes from our front door to platform.  We would be happy to stay at Kalani’s place again. Value for money, clean, great transport, quick communication and so forth. What a pleasure.

Diana’s place was super clean and comfortable! I was visiting NYC for 23 days for both work and leisure so needed somewhere I could work from home yet still be close to Manhattan to visit the office and friends. Closest subway station is less than 5 min walking and only takes on average ~38 minutes (two transfers) to get to Manhattan. The area really gives you a true Brooklyn experience. I personally didn’t feel unsafe but can see how some would not feel comfortable at night - it’s a city so take that as you will. Great food and cute bars in walking distance and open until the early AM! Diana herself was also super friendly and quick to reply whenever I needed something. Would definitely stay again!

Great hosts, clean and comfortable spot, decent price considering how insanely expensive it is to stay in NYC right now. Location is convenient and easy to travel to Manhattan and other parts of Brooklyn. The M/J stop nearby is a little sketchy and chaotic, but there is a police presence there most of the day/night and I didn’t have any major problems. Would totally recommend for someone planning to visit for a week or two.

I'm still getting used to being in others homes post(?) COVID intensity and the welcome here was fantastic. Their home is stunning and I loved the kitchen, lounge and overall decor vibes.   the bed in the room was super comfy and location wise it was super close to some familiar grocery stores and cafes. the overall location has big community vibes but the main road can feel a little scary if you're not used to the busy NYC streets.  my only struggle was because I was remote working while staying there the chair was a bit uncomfy for 6+ hours of computer work and the room doesn't get much natural light though it does open up to the garden which is great.  I would happily stay again but I wouldn't work from the room if I could find different location that felt good taking my work equipment to.

Beautiful house to stay. The room with a private bathroom is really comfortable. The neighborhood is nice, accessible and well connected. We can only say that the J subway station that passes through there is quite neglected and the area to get to at night can seem dangerous although we have walked there several times and nothing ever happened. I would definitely stay with them again on a future visit. Super recommended.

Great night in a luxury hotel for a very reasonable price.  This hotel is brand new construction, and it's got all the bells and whistles.  Cool wall-to-wall tiled shower.  They even had motorized shade controls.  Huge high-def TV.  Great hotel with no nonsense staff.  If you want a great night in Manhattan, this is a great value for you.

Honglip’s place is definitely a steal! The place itself is Very nice and big like in the picture. The host was very accommodating and Also owns a very cute cat. He was communicative and kind the entire time. I Would definitely stay here again when available!

A pleasant short stay for 6 young people who wanted to explore NYC a bit. Didn’t feel unsafe at all, subway  was a few-minute walk, the host was helpful and responded every time we messaged her. Would definitely recommend.

The apartment is very good for what it will be used for on a trip to New York since it is basically sleeping and showering. It is simple but clean and all the rooms in the apartment are comfortable and useful. Keisha responds to any questions or problems and her friend Tony is at your side for any questions or recommendations. It is about 15 minutes from the subway station and in 20 minutes you are in downtown, it is 30 minutes by subway to the airport. The Brooklyn neighborhood is very good, at no time did I feel unsafe and I can guarantee that the people are wonderful. There is plenty of local commerce such as bars and places to buy food a few meters from the apartment. In general, I would definitely repeat. The apartment has two rooms with a large bed and a sofa bed that converts into a 1.50 bed, so 3 couples would fit perfectly.

Keisha's apartment is everything you would want if Manhattan and Downtown  Brooklyn have become too noisy and stressful for you and you would like to enjoy some more relaxed days while still being very well connected to the centre! We really enjoyed our stay in this clean and well-equipped apartment. The area is lovely with little cafes and restaurants, a library and little shops. The subway takes you into Dumbo in 10 mins and Manhattan is only a 15-minutes ride. Keisha and her husband were very helpful and relaxed, and the communication was great. We would like to come again!

The airbnb was really nice, very clean and just like the images. However, Keisha didn't communicate with us before arrival.   So once we got there for check-in at 3:30 we tried to get into the lockbox and it wasn't opening. So we hoped to connect with the wifi and contact the host, but the password and username that was provided on airbnb was wrong (there is a different one in the kitchen).... So I had to turn on my data and hope that there would be a response as airbnb messenger was the only way to contact the host. Turns out the lockbox was broken. There wasn't any communication about this before checking in.   Mr. Tony came and saved us! Turns out the door was open the whole time and the keys just on the kitchen table. It seems obvious to check if the door was open, but it didn't feel obvious at the time because we are in the middle of NY, who leaves their door open with the keys right there?   Otherwise, the airbnb was great! Just lack of communication and stress of getting into the house changed the experience.

Everything is perfect except location. I didn't know why everybody avoid East Harlem. many homeless people near the house. but, Secure building and door man help it. overalls everything was perfect just I imagined.

My sister and I had a very comfortable stay at Cyn's place. The closest subway station is a 5 min walk from the apartment, so transportation is not an issue. The apartment itself has all the necessities and is very clean and stylish. The bed is extremely comfortable! You will get a good night's rest. The neighborhood is perfectly safe during the day time but I would advise to not walk alone after dark or in the late hours when the streets are more quiet.  Just advising  to exercise caution but I never felt unsafe.

This was a great place to stay! Conrad wasn't really at the apartment much, so we had the whole place to ourselves for much of the time. This is a very spacious apartment for NYC and we had everything we needed for cooking. It's also very nice that there is a concierge here, as the neighborhood is a bit sketchy. The location is good close to Central Park. We rented the Citibikes and biked around there every day. Conrad is a super nice host, would definitely recommend!
The apartment is nice but the area is remote and a little unsafe
Robbed me... private weird house.

The space was adorable, clean and home-y and in a convenient location, close to groceries etc. What sets this place apart though is Keren. She is spectacularly kind, helpful, hospitable, and accommodating. She responds quickly and does everything to ensure that her guests’ stay is comfortable and stress-free. Definitely recommend and would absolutely re-book with her in the future. Thanks, Keren!

Apartment in excellent condition, clean, safe and with the necessary amenities.  By bus it is between 45 minutes to an hour from Manhattan depending on traffic but it is fine, the same by subway.  Both the metro and the bus are nearby.  The surroundings of the metro don't look so nice but it's still not unsafe. In the end we had a good experience.  I recommend it

Joey, who welcomed us, was very kind, and he took the time to explain to us how all the devices worked. He tracks the arrival of your flight on the internet and welcomes you right on time to the apartment. The apartment is in a great location, 2 blocks from Times Square, right in the middle of the world restaurant district. Metro lines 1, A and C just a stone's throw away. 3rd floor. Clean and well equipped. Don't overload the toilets with paper (we clogged them on the first day and Joey helped us out within the hour!). USB sockets everywhere in the apartment, so no need for adapters to charge smartphones. Perfect WiFi. There were 6 of us who had no problem sharing the toilets and shower. The only downside is that the room and the sofa which overlook the avenue are very noisy. Because of the openings in the windows for the air conditioning, we are literally ON 9th avenue. Our teenagers slept well, but we should only put "all-terrain" people in this room or the sofa who are capable of falling asleep in all conditions! RAS on the neighbors side. Those below had two parties, but it was Halloween! And Joey takes care of the cleaning at no extra cost at the end; we just unmade the beds and put the towels on the chairs (we never ate there, but it would be possible because everything is in place to do so). Right opposite, Mom's Kitchen and very good for a meal or breakfast on the day of arrival. 5 Napskins, 3 blocks down, is excellent for burgers, onion rings and Coney on Draught.

Always love staying at Keren’s whenever we go to the Bronx, to meet friends. The home is beautiful. The yard is inviting, and has so many birds and squirrels. The location, is very peaceful and surprisingly quiet for the Bronx. I never feel unsafe there. The apartment itself is pristine. It smells wonderful, is very inviting and cozy. We will never stay at any other Air bnb when we visit the Bronx. Gratitude to Keren. ❤️

Patricia is an excellent host. She has thought of everything to make the stay comfortable and stress free. The location can’t be beat! Make sure to get a bite at Sayra’s Wine Bar. Delicious wine and food!

For NYC, the apartment is Amazing! The building and its concierge are a luxury!   As travelers in NY, we are lucky Ted allows us to stay at his personal home. Thank you Ted!  I would stay again at the place but I would be aware that Ted is a busy guy that takes a lot of time to reply, I had to write to him 3 times before getting one reply before arriving. Now I know he is busy and will reply late.   I booked the place starting on December 24th (I know difficult date because of Christmas, but that’s what I booked on Airbnb and paid for) but the host received us on the 25th at 3pm, so I had to book a hotel for one day. It was very stressful to plan that a week before my arrival.   But besides that, the place is great, incredible location, the building is a very good building for NYC standards, elegant entrance with concierge, laundry and a gym on the second floor.   Ted even has a standing desk! Really cool!   I highly recommend the place. It’s expensive like everything in NY.

The room looks just like the pics. It's very clean and well appointed! We never got the code ahead of time which was a bit stressful but the hosts picked up the phone at 10:30 pm to direct us. The room was very warm when we arrived and the a/c was noisy..(not to mention overhead noise in the room above us). The shower never got really hot but it was ok...Really for the price and convenience to LGA it was fine! Just not perfect.
we arrived at around 1 am. very sketchy neighborhood to park and walk in at that time of night.

I want to paint a fair and accurate description of Earl’s AirBNB.  As a superhost myself I would hope for nothing less.  If we don’t share fully and fairly the review system of AirBNB is a mockery.  When you walk in the building the lobby/mailbox area was strewn with trash.  When you walk into the apartment there is a long hallway - 12-15’ long.  I learned later it had a motion sensor light (about 50%) of the time.  But the first time I walked the entire length looking for a switch…. No switch… no light.  I pulled out my cell for the flashlight…. Then my daughter walks through and I guess the motion sensor works when the hall is illuminated????!!!!  Large.  What is the definition of large.  Now I understand that large is relative.  I also understand the NYC Real Estate Market because I worked in it from 1984-2016.  A large bedroom is not just 22” wider than a full size bed.  Also the tiny living room had a bike hanging on the wall - dangerous.    I didn’t feel comfortable taking a shower… there was yellowish grey discoloration and I wasn’t going to risk athlete’s foot.   There was cracked tile and a hole the size of an orange (blocked unsuccessfully by a drain hair catcher)  in the wall???  There were hairs on the sink…  There were no plastic toggles on a number of the light switches - just the metal part…  We arrived into the city later than we had wanted and decided to just deal with it… but then at midnight the smoke detector started to emit chirps every 45 seconds waking us from our sleep.   We found a step ladder - and I was able to stretch and reach the smoke detector (high ceiling) - and pulled out the 9 volt battery… (in doing so I pulled a muscle in my leg).  No 9-volts were to be found so we had to figure out what to do at that late hour with nowhere else to stay… and going out into the streets of NY at that hour with my 12 year old didn’t sound like a viable option.    I reached out to AirBNB and the host.  Airbnb didn’t respond with alternatives until almost 2 am and the host was snippy and wrote “what is going there I’m not gonna lie I’m getting slightly worried about your behavior ., why is the smoke alarm going off ??” - My response to the host was - "We were both fast asleep.  And it wasn’t going off for smoke it was going off for low batteries."  As a superhost myself I have a few suggestions -If you are going to be out of the country - enlist a co-host.  When I was at your AirBNB my co-host was there to handle any issues that might have come up.   -Use your dry erase board to leave a welcome letter including the information that guests need so it is handy to them (like WiFi info that didn't come through).   -Use the cleaning fee to find someone to actually clean the apartment. I would suggest you don’t leave food as you did in the fridge and freezer.  We returned the key Monday morning.  And found other accommodations for our second night.  In our communications Earl wrote “Listen I hope the apartment is up to your Stanterd but if it’s not i totally understand“.  I seriously question if this listing would meet AirBnb’s standards.  I await a full refund.

This place was incredible. My first air bnb experience and I couldn't have asked forms better time. It was a fifteen minute walk from times square, Broadway, the intrepid museum, decent parking, and the port authority main hub. Being in Hells Kitchen allowed for ton's of opportunities for excellent food and nightlife.  I would stay here again in a heartbeat. Rob was an excellent host, getting back to me quickly and truthfully, and his place was stellar. Ill be here on my next trip for sure.

Very cozy home and bathroom. Having never been in Queens, it was not as well lit and for young travellers can be a bit scary. 15 min walk from nearest train. Very clear instructions, very nice room. And I think the price was good, I think about as cheap as it will be in NYC.

We stayed here for a week after arriving in New York before we got an apartment. It was a truly wonderful stay-- the attention to detail was incredible, the house had everything we could possibly need, including a fully functional kitchen, mini fridge in the room, clothes iron, and hair dryer. The free snacks were a great bonus! Our room had plenty of natural light and a great view. There's decent wifi, and a work table if you want to get work done. The common living area is also a good place to work. The house was cleaned regularly.  Connectivity: it's a 20 mintue walk to the junction boulevard subway station, and just 5 minutes from a bus stop. There are plenty of small grocery stores, bakeries and food places around. It's a quiet, residential area with pretty houses and walkable streets. I never felt unsafe walking to and from the station, although I probably wouldn't want to be out on my own after 9pm.   One word of caution: you'll need to go up two flights of stairs to get to the front door, so if you have heavy luggage, be prepared to carry it up the stairs.   Overall, would highly recommend-- it was great value for the cost!

The apartment is 30-40 mins subway ride from the centre of NYC but the subway is very close. There are plenty of shops close and eating places close by.    However, we were very disappointed with our stay for the following reasons :   Check In Time This Airbnb is not suitable for anyone travelling on an international flight as there is no flexibility around check in.  If like me, you have been travelling for 36+ hours, this constraint causes too much stress as the time it takes to get through security and New York traffic is unpredictable.    The Host suggested that we should plan to arrive early and place our luggage in storage so we could be sure to be on time (albeit he didn’t say where that was).  Most people do not want this hassle after such a long flight.   Emergency Support  We locked ourselves out of the apartment as the lock was complicated and there was no instructions provided. We immediately sent a message to the Host expecting some help.  We did not get a reply - this meant we couldn’t get on with our day.  After 5 hours we decided to call the emergency line at Airbnb - they too couldn’t locate the host for a while.  Eventually they found him and gave us a message but the Host still didn’t call or text us.  We rang him ourselves and were not reassured by the conversation as he said he was in California and was unsure how he could get us a key.  The problem was eventually resolved but we found the whole situation very stressful.   Cleaning  We were charged $86.20 for cleaning and the apartment was at best superficially ok but vents and paintwork were filthy and I could write my name in the dust.  I suspect there has not been a professional deep clean of the apartment for many months/years.  Instructions  There were no instructions or information in the apartment other than the wi fi code and telephone number on the fridge.  We were unsure what was available to us to use in the apartment. Eg. Food, hairdryer, iron, coffee machine etc   Sleeping (Noise and Curtains)  The apartment is near to a main road and very noisy through the night and so it was difficult to sleep.  In addition there were no curtains in either room that blocked out the morning light.   Location The apartment is quite far way from NYC and for this reason doesn’t represent great value for money when you add on daily travel costs.

Living in the bronx may seem sketchy, but this listing was beyond my expectations. The room was clean. No grim or build up. The beds and pillows were so soft and comfortable. What's in the pictures is what you get! Along with snacks, dishes, and humble host.

The apartment was well above my expectations! From the moment I was shown around I knew this is what I was looking for! Brand new, fast internet, sparkling clean and very spacious for New York! The building is just half of a block away from a major Subway station and has a nice rooftop with a stunning city view, cozy lounge for working from home, laundry room, mail room, bike storage room and gym! The windows are noise proof so you barely hear the outside! The host provided us with all the essentials(and even more)! The area is very safe, we walked outside at various times of the night and never felt unsafe! Great food and drink selection around.  The host was very friendly, attentive and easy to communicate with!  If I need a place to stay in the future I will definitely come back!

The major highlights for our group were: working new/clean air conditioners (in each bedroom), size of the apartment and location. Beds are pretty firm and got mixed reviews in our group. Rear bedroom had severely cheap sheets that were 100 percent polyester and see through- I slept on top of the bed. Nothing in the way of darkening curtains so we hung extra bedding in order to keep extra heat and light out for better sleeping in conditions. Beds also did not have mattress covers which I found surprising. We had to buy a sponge and get extra bags for trash in the kitchen but the stove and fridge worked wonderfully. The place was generally very clean with an exception of an unpleasant odor in the bathroom. We could have used at least one washcloth and a hand towel or two but were supplied with only one bath towel each. Easy access to the yellow line and great neighborhood. We also used the laundromat that is right behind the building. I hope in the future there will be a few upgrades on the bed linens, bath towels and basics in the kitchen.

Run, run away.  This is a terrible Airbnb. The worst I’ve ever stayed at.  The loft is 20 degrees hotter than the other area.  It has a concrete beam 24 inches over the bed. You must duck the whole loft.  It has a fan no AC in the loft. The stairs to get to the loft are dangerous and no railing.  Completely out of code and the first step is 150% height.  Horrible place   Avoid

We would not stay here again! Our car service had a hard time finding the location as there were no address numbers on the exterior. Invisaligns (teeth molds) were left on the coffee table. Potential trip hazard with raised thresholds at both entries to main bedroom and restricted entry due to bed next to the doors. There was a lack of privacy as there was no curtain on the main bedroom window which let the light in at sunrise.   It was dangerous going down to the shower on the lower level as the top 2 steps were the same height and the 3rd step was an inch taller which is against code and could cause a fall.  The shower was near scalding with no way to make the water cooler. The place had extra guests: COCKROACHES! We understand it is hard to get rid of roaches in a multi-unit complex, but we hadn’t seen any mention of them in the description or in the other reviews. Because of the roaches, we did not bring food into the unit. It also made us nervous of a possible infestation of our personal items. The roaches made the kitchen unusable. We received a “ this number is blocked” message when we sent a text to leave. Finally got in contact with host to say we were leaving the keys in the mailbox as we couldn't wait any longer and we were told that was alright.   The description was not accurate regarding the train noise which was constant, not occasional as stated. It was a shame we couldn’t enjoy staying there as Ridgewood has wonderful and diverse places to eat, is easy to walk around, and, obviously, near public transportation.
It was a pleasure staying at Rob's apartment, it was in a great location and much nicer than the photos Highly recommended!

Rob was an amazing host and his place is a hidden gem in the city. I interned in NY over the summer and I felt I needed a nice and convenient place to stay. Rob’s place is spacious and super close to public transport, food, and shopping. He is very considerate and takes the time to really make guests feel welcome. I definitely recommend.
Rob's place is quiet, modern and centrally located. It really makes a trip to NYC so much easier, especially for a first timer. Highly recommend!
Robs place was awesome. Great comfy bed, good sized room, washer and dryer in the apartment and in a great location. Plus Rob was a great guy all round!

Rob is an awesome guy. He was very communicative, friendly, and accommodating. His place has a chill vibe and atmosphere and the neighborhood is one of the best in the city. Would definitely stay there again.

Thanks very much Rob for a great stay. The room is clean and the apartment has great amenities. Check in was smooth. The apartment is in a good location in the heart of little Italy. I would recommend.
A really great place!!! Rob’s place was super clean and he was very helpful with everything. I really enjoyed everything about my stay. Can’t wait to go back.

This is a great spot, and Rob was incredibly communicative. The bed was comfy, the shower pressure the best of any New York apartment I’ve stayed in, and the entire apartment was spotless. And the location can’t be beat! I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.

Some positives; The location was brilliant and convenient. The apartment was well stocked with coffee/water/toiletries. Carol was an amenable host and allowed us to leave our bags with her after checkout on the final day.  However, our stay at Carol's was not as comfortable as it could have been. We were woken early nearly every day by neighbours through the thin adjoining wall to the bedroom; the bed itself was a little uncomfortable, with only three pillows provided; and the flimsy lock on the apartment door honestly made us feel unsafe in an unfamiliar area and location.
