The apartment has some great potential but needs some proper attention in these areas. At the very least the door/lock should be replaced to make guests feel comfortable.  This being said, the apartment is budget friendly for guests wanting to spend more on the sights than the accommodation.

This place was fairly large and clean. Not too far from the bagel store (which has rainbow bagels) and many good restaurants. Also has a nice outdoor area. The only reason I rated communication poorly is because I found some paraphernalia in the bathroom (for harder drugs, not just your regular pot smoker) and when I messaged the host about it they thought I meant there was a plumping leak in the bathroom ( a different kind of pipe than I meant). After I specified what I meant there was no response at all. I expected some kind of response or some offer to have someone come remove it. I found it after we had already stayed one night but it did make me slightly concerned for my safety.

Do not stay here!!! I stayed her with my husband and two daughters (2yrs and 10 weeks old) over Labor Day Weekend. When we checked in, the apartment was much older and run down than pictured. The neighborhood was not safe for kids. For example, there was someone passed out on drugs in front of the unit. There were roach traps everywhere. They didn’t work because there were roaches in the kitchen. That evening I messaged the agent (never once heard from the owner) telling her about the roaches and that we were leaving. I asked for a refund. We then went out to the “private garden.” Absolutely not as pictured. Not even the same space. No greenery. Just a concrete patio with a plastic bench. Oh. And USED CONDOMS. My 2 year old daughter pointed to a used condom on the floor and asked “what’s that mommy?” The next day the owners agent showed up unannounced with her cleaning crew to get the apartment ready for her next guest. Mind you I had paid for that night and not received a refund. I still haven’t received a refund or response to my request from the agent. I had to find a place for my family to stay on a holiday weekend at the last minute. I spent hundreds of dollars for one night because of this. I loved Airbnb but I’ll probably never do it again after this atrocious experience.

Shady was very nice, the apartment was quite large and the building had a very nice rooftop and a gym with a beautiful view of NY. On the other hand, it was quite noisy due to the close proximity to the metro, which only disturbed us at night.

Ingrid’s place was perfect for our trip. There were two seperate bedrooms with very comfortable beds. Ingrid had some great personal touches such as peanuts available and was always super easy to contact and ready to help. Neighbour hood is still up and coming however with that said I didn’t feel unsafe at any point and there is a super cute bar at the end of the street!

Overall fine place. Sofa and bed were comfortable. It’s a little longer walk to the subway station at 10 mins on one side. The area is sketchy with garbage cans and mortuary nearby. The kitchen had good amenities and the host provided a high chair for the baby. The host was responsive as well. We were all bit by mosquitoes and had bumps from the bites.
This was a great find!  Spacious, very clean, and super cute apt! Marie was amazing and the price was a steal! Highly recommend!
Highly recommended! Very clean. Not a bad walk to the subway. Awesome amenities! Comfy bed. Would stay here again! Good neighborhood, never felt unsafe.

Four of my girlfriends and I stayed at Grover's home and it was a great fit for us.  We never felt unsafe and Stephanie was an amazing host and so quick to respond.  Check-in was a breeze and the house was great.  I did mention to Stephanie upon checkout that the air conditioner on the left bedroom was making at loud sound every 15-20 minutes that made it really hard to sleep.  She said they would get that checked out and I have no doubt that they will.  Great home, great hosts, great access to the 2/3 Subway lines, and an overall good decision for our trip in July 2015.  I will definitely look into staying again as long as that a/c unit is fixed! :)

Pam and Jullien's place was my first stay in Brooklyn, NY. I didn't get the chance to meet Pam as I'm sure she was busy with their new born. However, Jullien's hospitality was enough for the both of them! The description was accurate and the room is exactly as shown.  Bed-Stuy is a very unpredictable area and it takes an open-minded individual to appreciate it. I think the highlight of my stay was Sunday afternoon. Out of nowhere, the sounds of urban/african drumming began to play. What an unexpected treat! I couldn't really get my jam on because I was afraid the tenant below would've banged the ceiling. Instead, I let my windows up and embraced the culture. That is my advice to anyone staying in Bed-Stuy. There's a lot to be seen here and a weekend will not do. You will need at least a week.  Also, I got the impression that the neighborhood was in a state of revival which may explain the renovating going on in the area.  Other than that, it was what I needed, it was comfortable, and it was convenient. Thanks for having me P&J!  Warm Regards, William

Antonio was a great host, I enjoyed my stay at his place. He was friendly and helpful and smiles always. The description of his place was accurate so there are no unpleasant surprises, the neighborhood is decent and quiet, and the location is conveniently close to public transportation. Highly recommended.

Like the other reviews state, we also experienced Jullien's friendly help with luggage on arrival as well as many little details that make guests feel welcome after a long and exhausting flight (like carrying our bags up 3 flights of stairs, water in the bar fridge, use of an iron, hair drier, electric plug adaptor, enough space to hang our clothes, replacing the kettle with a new coffee maker and being willing to help when we had difficulties with excess luggage).   The area may be gritty, but we never felt unsafe (even late at night) and the nearby take away shops and pizza parlour were friendly and offered delicious food and quick service. The apartment and room were super clean and suitable for a comfortable 11-day stay. If there was loud traffic or music in the neighborhood, it was drowned out by the air conditioner fan that served as white noise. We slept well on the comfortable bed and silky sheets every night.  Pam (and cute little Jada) were also eager to assist when we had questions. As hosts, the couple were most accommodating, quick to respond and ready with suggestions when we needed assistance. Another big plus factor is the proximity to a metro station that makes all areas in New York accessible within less than an hour.   This was our first AirBnB experience and it was a truly pleasant, positive one. We had privacy and space to come and go as we pleased, never felt like we were intruding (although we were worried that our walking on the floors would bother other guests) and we knew that Jullien and Pam were within earshot and ready to give assistance. It is a comfortable and affordable option for exploring this great city. Our only regret was being too busy to spend more time with the hosts and getting to know them better.

The place is nice for someone looking for a short term stay in the city. It is conveniently located near a major subway line which helps for travel. I stayed for a week and was comfortable. I never felt unsafe staying there. Genesis was very sweet and I enjoyed meeting her.

Communication could be improved, we had almost no reply from Jullien when we texted him, except from the day of arrival.  The room was supposed to be ready for us at 4 pm, but it was not until an hour after that we were allowed in, since they were still cleaning the room. Luckily, Jullien let keep us our luggage inside while they cleaned.   Transport to almost everywhere in Manhattan was very convenient thanks to the subway, which is right next door. The neighbourhood seemed a bit sketchy at first, but it turned out to be ok, quiet and familiar.   The floor and bed were super squeaky and the mattress made way too much noise even by just sitting on it.   The bathroom was really good and the shower had just the perfect pressure and temperature and all amenities were included. The fridge was super convenient. There were some plug adapters in the place.   Overall the place was quiet except for the neighbour's Saturday night party which kept us up. The front door lock stopped working on our last day so we were basically locked out from the building at night. Thankfully one of the neighbours could open the door for us.  It's true that this is one of the cheapest places to stay in NY, so not everything can be perfect. Some room for improvement though.
Very quick to respond to any questions or concerns. Apartment near multiple restaurants, drug store and coffee. Would definitely stay here again.

Excellent communication.  Supermarket right across the street, plenty of drug stores nearby and subway is a block away.  Neigbourhood is safe with lots of local flavour.  Apartment building is very quiet but there is street noise so light sleepers should come prepared:  It didn't bother myself or my partner and we both slept very well.
Antonio is very friendly and helpful. He gives you your privacy. I did not feel scared or anything.

This was unfortunately a very unpleasant stay for me and my family. Wendy gave a tour of the house without wearing a mask. She consistently imposed burdens on us as her guests, such as forcing us to check out a day early because of a scheduling conflict with her cleaner, and didn’t even offer a refund. She complained about how much we were paying, but she or Airbnb were the ones who set the price! And she accused us of many things we absolutely did not do, such as claiming our daughter peed in the bed. The end of the stay was so uncomfortable we raced out of the house as quickly as possible!

We had to leave our trip early so did not have a full experience but will note a few things we would have liked to know before booking for future guests. Although the unit itself is private with lockable doors, the host and family live in the home (lower level) and I think there is another airbnb unit on the upper floor. Noise travelled easily so it was not as private as we are used to with similar rentals... could hear family in their day to day routine, eating/coming and going/arguing/laughing/etc. and other guests above us coming back late at night. The bathroom, although not shared, is not part of the unit. It is located in the hallway beside the unit which is part of the main home, next to the stairway used to access the main floor/front door and the upper airbnb unit. This made returning to the unit after showering and using the washroom in the night awkward. Additionally, there is no shower, although the tub has a long shower head attachment and full shower curtain so you can wash standing. Lastly, and I realize this is a total tourist thing and our fault for not researching further but although Brooklyn is known for recent development as a trendy area, Bed-Stuy is still considered an unsafe area (according to Google Safety Maps and local New Yorkers we met in Manhattan....This included a homeless guy helping us with the subway who looked utterly shocked we were staying there, indicating he used to live there). I went for coffee and bagels our first morning at a cute place down the street and the server made a derogatory comment about tourists (implying tourists don't know what "real money" is and try to use $50s). While I'm not sure if he was referring to me (I paid with a $20), we didn't feel overly welcome in the neighbourhood. Subhana was helpful and very responsive during our time there. The unit is beautiful and spacious, clean, comfy bed. All the good travel necessities available like hair dryer, iron & ironing board, umbrellas.

Great location and fine for a weekend. The bed is comfortable. But the photos are a bit generous. In the bedroom, there’s no space to hand anything. And the shared bathroom is rather dingy and unpleasant.

The first time I entered Adrianne's apartment I thought "WOW" this is wonderful! I loved it from the beginning and I've been surprised about the space and how clean it was. Both the beds are confortable and big enough for 2 people. The location (in central Harlem) is perfect, lovely area with joyful people and very close to Starbucks, Supermarket, Subway stations and delicious "Soul food" restaurants. Moreover Adrianne is lovely, always available for any help and suggestion about places to visit or where to eat. We travelled in 4 and we had a very very very (again, very!) good moment in this apartment. I would be really glad to come back again! and I strongly reccomend it to everybody, you will not be dissappointed, I promise! and don't get scared about Harlem, if you want a place for your visit in NY with the perfect balance between price and quality this must be your choice! Really thank you! we had a great holiday!

I highly recommend staying in this apartment, it is very comfortable, it is well located and Adriane is very friendly and will support you with whatever you need. We were 2 couples who stayed 5 nights. One couple stayed in the main room and the other stayed in the convertible (the convertible has large curtains that give privacy, only a small problem with them needs to be fixed, but nothing that causes discomfort, it would be better if they were a little longer but they already give enough privacy. From the first night, and after being welcomed and guided by Adriane we went to enjoy NYC and returned super night and since the subway station is very close we felt safe to walk almost at dawn through it Also, there is very little walking because the subway is close, and another thing we did was use Bus 7 that passes through Rockefeller Center, Bryant Park and 5th Avenue and drops you off right around the corner in front of a Macdonald's that is open 24/7. sleeps. Actually, since the very first night --and after getting welcomed by Adrianne-- we came back to the apartment very late at night (11pm, 12 am, 1am! ) --the subway station is less than 5 minutes walk so we didn't feel like in danger (however common sense it's always a must in every place you visit, the neighborhood wouldn't be like Central Park or Soho or Madison Square but it's not bad either actually during the day it's a lot of people by, some street vendors, and you have a 24 hour Mc Donald just around the corner ) The pictures are fair enough to have an idea of a well organized and cozy place. My wife and friends were happy because we were two couples with enough privacy for each couple (although it would be ok if she fixed the little issue with the curtains). easily when you need it). In general it's a great value for the price because it is well located (also Bus MTA 7 stops just around the corner and it takes you to/from Rockefeller Center) and you and your belongings will be safe.

The apartment is comfortable, pleasant, large. The beds are comfortable and Adrianne made us feel at home. We were able to sleep very comfortably, it has a heater, air conditioning, very good internet. We didn't spend much time in the apartment but we did walk around the neighborhood and although it is said to be a bit dangerous we were never unsafe. There are stores with various discounts nearby and very delicious places to eat, give yourself the opportunity to get to know the neighborhood.

The apartment is amazing, accurate with the pictures and is has been the cleanest airbnb that I've been to. You will fin on it whatever you need and more!. Is quite far from Manhattan itself and a bit far from the train stations (8 mins aprox either to A C or J) but is a reasonable price. It was genuinely a home far from home. super cozy.  Bedstuy is believed to be a dangerous neighborhood if you look in the internet but don't pay attention to that, in our experience it was great! we felt safe and surrounded by super kind people. You have as many stores as you imagine for whatever your needs are 😊 Nadine was always great! we will totally recommend this airbnb and coming back! GREAT EXPERIENCE!

Nancy is a great host! The apartment is like the pictures and very clean and well maintained. It was always very quiet in the area at night, only on weekends it was a little louder. There is no need to be afraid in the area, everyone was very friendly and helpful to us. As described, the subway and the supermarket were about a ten minute walk from the apartment.  Thanks Nancy for everything, we had a great time!

Very nice and convenient apartment, 5 minutes close to the subway. Adrianne is very kind and responds quickly if questions. A bit noisy for the room facing the street but it is NYC! Neighborhood seems bad at first because of homeless people and dirt, but people are friendly and it is cleaned every day. Good grocery store at the corner, very convenient. Building very safe, with a code at the door + second locked door. We really like our stay!

My honest review, please keep in mind I live in a pretty safe part of Toronto, Canada and don't visit the USA much.  Pros: -Good value for a place with two full beds in Manhattan.  -Very close to the subway. -Close to Central Park. -Im told the US tends to be more dirty then Canada homes, the fridge was very clean and the overal unit smell was fresh. -Double door security. -Some of the best food we are was in this area.  Cons: -Its a rough part of town.  Someone died from gunshots weeks earlier, their candle vigual was just a few blocks away. When you search this Apartments location it's closer to East Harlem then I originally thought. Really wish I'd known that ahead of time. I did ask the host about the general safety of the area ahead of time but my question wasn't answered.  Compared to other areas of NYC this one definitely felt neglected from core services, a lot of mental illness and homeless. On the last night we heard either a car backfire or something similar, making the rest of the trip pretty unnerving.  We absolutely did not feel safe leaving at night, and given the sun sets earlier that was a big buzz kill. Maybe post-pandemic hit the area hard, I know that's true for parts of Toronto.  -Black mold in the shower and on the ceiling, missing lightbulbs, a shocking amount of hairs in our bed, we moved the couch to watch a movie which was pretty dirty underneath, floors in general weren't that clean (we don't keep shoes on inside). Door lock was super loose giving us a bit of anxiety.   Overal, personally I wouldn't book again but if your fine with the cons it is good value for money.

At Nancy's place it was very very excellent!!!! The Appartement looks EXACTLY like the pictures and it is very clean and comfortable! We were there with 6 people and had a truly great time! Nancy is a jewel and everything happened beautifully from start to finish. The neighborhood was very welcoming and we felt safe and peaceful. We would highly recommend this place and we would gladly visit her again. Thank you very very much Nancy and say Hi to Omelfi....   ;-) !!!!!  Greetz Anja and Rob

This place is a steal for the quality, location, space, and everything you get! I LOVED the location SO MUCH. And I ended up extending my time here.  I loved my room, the apartment decor, the neighborhood and the host is wonderful. She’s super helpful and insightful on all things NYC. I especially love the little guide she gave me for the best places to eat and things to do in the area. The apartment is super cute and clean and tranquil and relaxing with great lighting. It was a pleasure living here and I thank you so much for this wonderful experience!!

The sofa bed was much more comfortable than I expected! Dana was very experienced and her instructions and directions were really precise and detailed so it was easy to follow. I was actually a little afraid of walking back alone from the subway at night as the neighborhood gets a bit rowdy but it was ok, at least nothing happened. Location of her place was pretty good too. Not too far from Times Square and direct train:)

I loved staying at Dana and Jason's! They were so nice and always made sure everything was ok for my stay. They're both very warm and friendly people, and always made me feel welcome. We had nice chats and they gave me lots of tips for theater plays in the city. The living room was spacious and the couch was comfortable.  Very easy to go anywhere in the city with 2 train stations just a few steps away. Never felt unsafe walking around the area. I will definitely consider their place in any future trips to NYC  Highly recommended! ;)

Dana and Jason were a delight to deal with! Their place is very cozy and well tended for. They were such life savers for the emergency maintenance on my apartment that left me "homeless" for a week. Very great on communication and i would highly recommend staying with them!

Nancy's house offers very good value for a stay of some days to visit New York with a group of 6 or 7. Very well equipped kitchen, good beds, nice bathrooms. The key lock system works very well. With the subway it is 20 min to Manhattan. The neighborhood is quite ok, we walked the 10 minutes from/to the subway several times during the evenings, with the whole family and kids, and never felt unsafe. But maybe don't do that at night. Great value, recommendable. We would stay there again.

This apartment looked pretty much as the photos on Airbnb suggested. We found the location, space, style and fittings and facilities of the duplex apartment a good solution for our 5 night stay in New York with our 19-year old son. We are familiar with the Upper West Side, and the apartment was quite conveniently located for the subway downtown and Central Park.    The main positives for us were:  the excellent space for both our living and sleeping arrangements, the well equipped kitchen and the use of a washing machine and drier in the apartment.     However, there were a few problems which had a material impact on our stay. The most critical issue was finding a mouse active in the kitchen trash bucket.   Fortunately, we were able to trap it and release it on the street away from the house.  We photographed the mouse and sent it on to Cedric as a record.  This was very distressing and alarming. We couldn’t help thinking there might be more pests around and it certainly limited our use of the kitchen from then on.  No one really wanted to open the cupboards for fear of what we might find.  We did not tell our son because he would have insisted that we move to a hotel, an option which was also on our minds.  We reported the mouse to Cedric but no remedial action occurred nor any conclusion or assessment to the pest situation which left us in a very uncertain and anxious state.  Other problems fall into the category of annoyances.  For one, the apartment was not ready when we arrived and a number of advertised amenities did not work. Again, although Cedric was responsive no remedial action took place while we were in residence. -There was rubbish on the stairs -The TV in the yellow bedroom did not work for cable TV stations -The clothes dryer didn’t dry our clothes  -One of the windows in the front was unusable (top half fell through to bottom and could not be adjusted).  Cedric was clearly shocked by the mouse and potential infestation.  He wrote to owners  Francesca and Jack about our experience to see if they would compensate us in some way in recognition of the severity of our issues but they were not willing to offer anything although they did apologise for the ‘scare’ and other complaints.  This was clearly more than just a scare and we left feeling overall dissatisfied with our experience.

Clean and comfortable, renovated 3BD / 2BA apartment with fully equipped kitchen. Flat-screen TV in all rooms + free WIFI. But the most important valuable thing there was Nancy!  The GRINCH (Air France / Delta) wanted to steal our Christmas, but thanks to her we got it back.  We were one big family with three young children (10 persons) and thanks to Nancy, we had lovely Christmas dinner and we felt safe in New York / Brooklyn. Thanks again for your great hospitality!

Dana was very hospitable. The place was just as described - the living space was completely private during the hours stated. Breakfast oats and snacks were provided. On one occasion there was a loud gathering on the street outside until late (Dana reassured me this was rare!), but fortunately the soundproofing was decent. The area did not feel unsafe for a male solo traveller. Fast connection to downtown via metro express A.

We were a group of 6 adults and have rented Nancy's place to celebrate our 30th wedding anniversary in NYC. The appartment is great, very clean and provides everything you need for a comfortable stay; the neighbourhood is fine and safe (we have never felt unsafe).  Easy access (walking distance) to nearby subway-stations that take you into any part of the city in no-time, but distant enough to not be disturbed by the sound of the metro when you are in the appartment. Nancy is a fantastic host and provides support whenever needed, she responds real quick and adequate when necessary. We highly recommend Nancy's place to everyone!!!

Apartment very well located 10 minutes walk from Myrtle metro station. After the first impression of insecurity at the foot of the station, you quickly feel at ease in the neighborhood. Parking for a second vehicle is easy on the same street. The apartment is spacious and well equipped. Nancy is available and very responsive. She called us when we arrived to see if everything was okay and if we needed anything more, which was appreciated. She also left us a lot of very useful information in a binder to help us eat in the neighborhood or get around, whether by bus or metro. Really had a very good stay with her. We recommend it without hesitation.

There were five of us in NY for a theater trip.  We appreciated the roominess and comfort of this apartment.  It was beautiful and nicely appointed and Francesca was very responsive to our needs.  The apartment is located 1/2 block from Central Park and an easy walk to many museums, the grocery store, drug stores and some fabulous restaurants and bars.

First I want to begin by saying how wonderful of a host Nancy is. From the moment we booked her place she made is feel welcomed and as the day of check in approached she continued to communicate with us and give us all information we could possibly need even as we arrived at the airport. The apartment was as described : clean , spacious, and with all needed toiletries, everything worked well. The only negative is the location. It is not the best nor did we feel like it was the safest. The second night, we were awakened by two couples fighting right outside the street in front on the apartment and all night we heard gunshots and police sirens. If you will be using public transportation we sure to be back before it gets dark because the neighborhood and surrounding areas are very scary at night. Also, be aware that the apartment is on the third floor and not handicapped accessible nor suitable for anyone with any walking or leg problems.  Besides that everything else was fine.

Claudia's place is a huge,beautiful  clean NYC apartment. It is also adorable and very Uniquely designed. Southwest had a major disaster and my flight was delayed a day and I was extremely stressed. She stayed up half the night to make sure I wasn't coming and she could let me in. She was very sympathetic, kind and understanding in a very stressful situation. Also the location is amazing and very easy to get around from. Lots of bars and restaurants and feels very safe. She also lives next door and is available for any questions you have right away. Thanks Claudia !

claudia's place was big and spacious. it was a bit Old-fashioned than i expected. for example, the door to the bathroom was very hard to close, there is a little balcony but we could not open the door to it. the main problem was difficulty communicating with the host. when we got to the place she did not answer the phone and for a couple of stressful minutes we did not know what to do. eventually we rang the intercom of the building and her house keeper let us in. I do have to mention that we had problems with the wifi connection and claudia took care of it.

This neighbourhood has everything right next to the apt. There is a drug store, grocery store, coffee shops and restaurants. Even access to the subway - love it!! The apt is clean and has everything you need. If you are a light sleeper bring ear plugs to drown out city noise or otherwise just accept the sounds of the big Apple

Zuffina is a great communicator. She is available at any time and is always available to answer any questions.   Although the apartment is located a few blocks north of Central Park and steps away from a Subway station, I felt that the reviews didn’t really mention a few highly important things before I booked my stay.   If you are visiting NY for the first time, you may not be aware of how noisy the city is. I’ve been to NY many times and never really had an issue of noise level.  In this area in particular, it was a bit louder than I hoped. Besides the 3am trash can pick-ups from the city and the local traffic, there seems to be a lot of yelling from pedestrians outside. The nosiest times are between 1 am and 5 am. A lot of verbal fights went on at night. I was here for 2 weeks and it was very unpleasant to not be able to sleep. A few days in a row the apartment complex across the street had parties and the music was blaring into the streets and into Zuffina’s apartment for hours on end. Also, if you happen to stay on the couch to sleep, don’t be surprised if you hear loud gurgling sounds from the sink every single night.   In terms of the neighborhood, I felt safe during the day walking to the nearby Starbucks and Grocery Store. However,  walking back from the subway at 7:30 pm, the dynamic switched a bit some nights, depending on the group of people or teens that like to hang out near the entrance of the apartment. Just be aware of your surroundings a bit more than usual is my advice.   Overall, I hope this helps people know smaller details that are important when booking your next stay.

Claudia and her husband were awesome! Very accommodating and ever helpful. The nicest hosts we’ve met so far! The place was cozy, clean  and central to everything we wanted to see in Manhattan. LOVED the air conditioning, considering the one day was 45C!  The apartment was also very safe and secure, which was a huge deal of ours. There was a few cool bars, pubs and restaurants in the area (literally down the street) and a 24 hour grocery and drug store.  You will not be disappointed.

Great place to stay. Everything is close by. Bus stop is close by. Very clean apt. Claudia and family were very friendly and accomodating. The apt has everything you need. There's a movie theater,  2 pharmacies, delis, a Starbucks, dunkin donuts, and a nice chill bar all walking distance from the apt. If you want good coffee or food there's Hill and Bay restaurant that serves breakfast, brunch, lunch and dinner. Its like a block down from the apt and the food is delicious and prices are reasonable. I really enjoyed my stay, I never felt unsafe. Would refer to everyone.

Lovely space, exactly as advertised, and very convenient to a lot of activities in Brooklyn. Lorna was lovely and helpful and very quick to reply to messages, check in was stress-free and simple, and I very much appreciated the touches of a few items left in the fridge/counter for me. Cheers!

Absolutely terrific. Once in a great while there is an Airbnb that makes me think "Wow, I wish I lived here!" and Claudia's place is one of those rare places. Claudia's apartment is inviting, convenient, and immensely livable for a Manhattan Apartment. The kitchen is very well equipped and even has a beautiful sub-zero refrigerator. The living space is comfortable and has plenty of space to stretch out, with a comfy couch and a nice long lounge chair. Wifi is strong and Claudia even left a few treats in the fridge. Communication was perfect - which was great because I ended up being very late, but she was quite understanding, which really reduced my stress. She always responded immediately to any messages and was always right there if I needed anything. The apartment is located in a fantastic spot, right across from Fairway and a Citibike station, and within a 5 minute walk of some amazing food and coffee. Like I said, I wish I lived there!! I would definitely return.

The loft is great. I thought that type of room is little bit dangerous to people who is order or afraid of high place. People have to through stair to go to bed. If not, just go ahead and chose this one. Tom and Lily are really good hosts. Living at their loft people feel like home. It is really good living experience. If is possible, I will come back. I appreciate Tom them and their loft. ❤️

This loft is beyond amazing and beautiful! I am kind of in awe that it really exists. It was very clean and comfortable. Tom and Lily were very welcoming and helpfulI and always quick to reply to any questions I had. The other guests were quiet and kept to themselves. Tom and Lily also have their MOMA cards out for any of their guests to use. I only give a four on location because I was alone and it was my first time seeing the city from where I live which is in Missouri. So it was quite the culture shock. Riding the subway wasn't a real issue or anything, and you do get to Manhattan quickly, but the walk to and from the apartment was a little bit scary. I saw some people that were questionable and made me a little uncomfortable. There weren't any cabs or police around that I could find. So sadly, I was a little uneasy about staying out too late in Manhattan just because of the walk around Brooklyn. I DO think however, if I was with a friend or a boyfriend, I would have felt fine. This is just me personally. The apartment however, is close to a good restaurant and a little market and a few other hot spots that they have listed. The artwork around Bushwick was amazing and definitely worth seeing. There is some true talent in there. All-in-all it was a cool experience, I kind of felt like I was truly living the New York life instead of just staying in an expensive hotel in Manhattan.

I really enjoyed my stay at Tom & Lily's loft. It was in an interesting location with loads of cafes and bars nearby and with some great street art. Tom & Lily were realy helpful and made sure your stay was comfortable. It was easy to get the subway into Manhattan as well and took about 20/30 min. You have the kitchen facilities to use, there's a laundry room and a spacious social area. The room was really cosy as well. The only caution is that the bed is accessed by a ladder which is against the wall and so if you are afraid of heights or will have trouble hoisting yourself onto the bed, then this might not be the best option. Otherwise, the loft was great and I would recommend it. I was a solo female traveller and felt perfectly safe.

It was really nice place to stay. The subway station was really close. All the kitchen supply was provided and also bath supply too. It was not dangerous at all when I walked around 12am. The Market was near station too.

Unfortunately i cannot recommend staying in ths place. The loft bed is incredibly dangerous. Im a healthy 25 yr old woman, and as I was climbing down (i was fully awake, not drowsy or drunk), I fell from a height of about 8 feet. I ended up having to call 911, Tom and Lily seemed too busy with some personal matters to accompany me in the ambulance. I was in a foreign country and had to deal with being hospitalised, booking another hotel all by myself. Unless some changes are made, i think this room is not fit to stay in.
1 of 3 rooms.  Friendly host, very responsive. Ladder to top bunk is a little scary to climb. Subway about 6 mins away.  Stairs no elevator. Host helped carry luggage up.

This was my first time using Airbnb, and I was a bit scared of what to expect, however Esgar was always in contact and provided all the information needed. And once we arrived it was great it was as described, the location was great, and the apartment was brilliant. The best thing though was the communication. Edgar would check up on us and made sure everything is good, and provided help when needed. All in all a great experience and a lovely host.

I am going to miss this place and only hope to come back one of these days. This house is probably the best offer you may find at this perfect location. It is right the west edge of Park Slope, the most homelike district of Brooklyn. Prospect Park, the younger brother of Central Park of Manhattan, is in 15 minutes of pleasant stroll through the scenic streets of brownstones between 5 and 8 avenues. Apartement is situated only three blocks far from busy intersection of 4 - 5 avenues and 9 street. Far enough to not to be disturbed by eternal noise. The place is very quiet and green. But it is close enough to get everything you need in a minutes - grocery and drug stores, laundry right the next block, café and restaurants of bohemian 5 avenue, three subway lines. F is probably the most stable train in the great mess of subway. Next stop after one R train brings you to Atlantic terminal, De Kalb avenue and Jay street where you can change for express trains to quick access to Manhattan. G is the only train brings you right up to Queens bypassing Manhattan - if you need to. Apartement itself match its photos, it is the whole top floor of the building. Note the private entrance. The layout of the space is very unusual. You can find any housewares in for comfortable living. One thing you have to bear in mind. In the next apartement on the ground floor, there is a small children's bedroom behind the thin wall right across the porch door. So you have to respect the evening hours, especially coming back home. Thanks to Edgar, the communication and responses are very quick, check-in and -out comes very easy. Edgar and his friends are always ready to help. He is a perfect host.

Alex and Ivy's apartment, perfectly located and exceptionally maintained,  made our trip to New York completely stress free.  We stumbled out the door to all the services and amenities we could have possibly needed:   great restaurants, the subway, shops, Whole Foods, parks, galleries and museums.  Alex and Ivy were friendly, prompt and thorough hosts, making themselves available to answer our questions, and taking the time to meet up - a nice personal touch.  Their apartment was spotless.  Access was easy.  Nights were quiet.  Overall, a great experience!  We would definitely book this lovely apartment again.

I would not stay here again if you paid me. The woman, room #1, seems to hover over the place, waiting for you to do something wrong. When you do, there’s door slamming. The worst was how she moved my things around, my personal property. So your boundaries are crossed. She actually HID my medication. It’s dangerous to live here. I was afraid after she did that. Playing games and harassment

Location, location, location...mixed with great hosts and a great place. When can we move in? Seriously, we had such a great stay with Ana Maria and I suspect we'll be back again.  The location can't be beat, so close to the park, great museums, funky shops and eateries, and playgrounds (if that is important to you).  My 8 year old daughter and I stayed 4 nights at Ana Maria's and easily explored the city from here, all the way down to Battery Park. Very close to bus and subway lines that will get you anywhere you need to go beyond the Upper West Side. The studio had all we needed (including coffee grinds in the fridge, thanks Ana Maria!) and is very comfortable for 2 people. We highly recommend Ana Maria's Upper West Side studio.

Book the apartment if it’s available! I stayed here for a month and have nothing but good things to say. Can’t stress enough how great the location was. Additionally, the unit was incredibly spacious and quiet. Alex and Ivy were very accommodating and friendly.

Rob and CS were great host. They were always very attentive and always available in case you had any question. I would recommend this stay to anyone looking for a place with convenience, close to public transportation and overall good accommodation.

We had a great stay in Rob's apartment. He is a great host, caring and very welcoming. The apartment is close to shops for small shopping, bus and metro.  We would definitely recommend it for a stay in NY.

Just back from a wonderful stay at Kimberly's apartment in Williamsburg. Kimberly couldn't have been more helpful and her correspondence ensured our arrival was stress free and our stay relaxing. We loved the beautiful apartment which was perfect for my husband and I and two teenage sons. It really felt like home. Williamsburg was the perfect base to explore NYC and Brooklyn. We even had an evening in Coney Island and a day trip to New Jersey. This was our first time using AirBnB and will certainly not be our last. I recommend Kimberly and her apartment without hesitation but please don't book it when I want to return to New York!
Kimberly did an amazing job setting up the place for us. It was very stress free and fun! I would love to stay there again.

Apartment located very close to Central Park and the Natural History Museum. Ideal for a couple or alone. Very pleasant neighborhood, quiet and close to the metro.  Ana Maria is very welcoming and accommodating. She even allowed us to leave our suitcases on the day of departure so we could enjoy NYC before our flight which was at 11:30 p.m.!!  Don't hesitate to book with her; a pleasant stay awaits you there.

We stayed at this apartment for a little over 2 months. Upon our arrival, the apartment was cleaned, and we were given fresh towels and linen. The place was as described in the listing - one large room with 2 full size beds, a smaller room with another full size bed, and a bathroom connected to the smaller room. Very basic, but it was fine for us since we didn't spend much time there. Michael was very responsive throughout the summer and checked in with me several times to make sure things were going smoothly. The building super, Tommy, was also helpful when issues came up. Would recommend to students / young adults working in the city short-term. One should note that although it is located in a convenient location (near Penn Station, Chelsea Market, etc.), the block the apartment was on was somewhat sketchy at night. Overall a pleasant stay and a good value space.

The host was kind enough to accept my booking last minute. She also let me use her Netflix so I thank her for that. However, I felt like she should had mentioned the noise that the heat makes. It’s fine during the day but at night, it can scare you and possibly give you heart problems. I also didn’t see the need to make the guess clean since I paid $125 cleaning fee.
We enjoyed our stay at Cliff‘s appartment. Communication was top, subway is close, the price for New York is quite cheap. Neighbourhood is a bit sketchy but we still felt safe.

For the price you can’t beat it. Close to public transportation and building is secure. Coming from a small town I thought the neighborhood was a little sketchy but my son lives close by and assured me that it was a safe neighborhood and safe to walk even at night. We enjoyed the stay very much. We had no trouble walking to and from the subway day or night. A short walk to the Franklin station and you can catch a subway train to Grand Central. Lots of nice eateries nearby. Short walk to Prospect park.

Great value for the money! The flat is spacious and clean. It’s nothing fancy but it’s comfortable and well maintained. Clif is a very good host and makes sure you have everything you need for your stay - he even lets us check out later when we realized our flight was later than we thought.   The upstairs neighbors did have a screaming child in the hallway, but it wasn’t noticeable when you are in the flat itself. The neighborhood is also a little sketchy, but its close to iconic Crown Heights venues.

Accommodation located in a reassuring area, quiet during the day but the traffic remains noisy in the evening between the horns honking at all hours and the sirens of police trucks or ambulances. Arrival is independent, we were able to take possession of the accommodation before the indicated time. We were also able to check out later than 11am because our flight was at 11:50pm. There are no tea towels to dry the dishes and the chairs are too high compared to the dining table. There is also a lack of spatulas and something to serve pasta for example. The host responded more quickly during our stay than before we left for NY. Perhaps you need to mark the keys to know which one to use at the right time (there are 3). When we arrived, there were 2 bottles of water and orange juice in the fridge (thanks for the attention).

What a cute little room! I wasn't sure what to expect, but for my intended stay this was just right. Perfect location! There is even parking available (even on a Saturday). Pam & Jamie, on behalf of Shelby were warm and welcoming and easy to reach. The process was simple enough and I hardly saw anyone there after the welcome, so it was nice to just be able to go in and out as I pleased. Also, for what it's worth, the price is a steal! I wasn't sure if there was AC or not and it got kind of hot in there but besides that - overall, seamless transition!   Thanks again guys!

It was close to the subway, got our keys on time. Bathroom needed to be cleaned and there was only 1 in the apartment. The apartment was on the 2nd floor, so it was still noisy outside at night.  Shelby was not there but Aaron was there to give us our key.  Aaron is from Jersey but was still able to give us a good idea of places to eat, subway prices, tourist attractions. Unfortunately myself and my cousin(we're both women) had some issues with security at Shelby's place. On our first night our door was locked and Aaron and his friend knocked on our door and tried to open the door. I guess they wanted to know if we were in there so that they knew that they needed to be quiet? Regardless they were very loud after coming home late at night. And it was concerning and scary that they tried that.

The room offered corresponds to the photos. Unfortunately, the window has poor sound and heat insulation and Lexington Avenue, which runs directly past the apartment, is a busy street. The noise is particularly unpleasant when sleeping, so earplugs are a must. Since it was relatively cold during our stay (sometimes below zero degrees at night), it was a bit too cold in the room throughout. Regarding the cleanliness of the apartment, we can say that overall it was good. Shelby wasn't in NYC during our stay, but her roommate was in the apartment the entire time.  Otherwise, everything organizational, i.e. key handover, etc., went very well. The apartment is in a great location and very spacious for its central location.

this was so bad it made me cry. i am a disabled person. when i came in the door and sat down, sole snorted at me and said why are you doing that? i said, i told you i am disabled. she said but what's wrong with you? i said it's against the law to ask me. and it's insulting and i don't want to talk about it. she said but i want to know. it continued like this for some time. ironically she has pictures of frida kahlo up in her bathroom. does she know frida was disabled? she also told me she doesn't help with bags even though in our prior communication she was well aware i am disabled, the only reason i chose her place because she had it listed as accessible, which is inaccurate, there are stairs. i noticed most of her reviews no one met her. this is probably why!  worst off all there are BUGS either fleas or bedbugs, i got so many bites. that has never happened anywhere i stayed. in the kitchen, the stove was broken so it was always on, a fire hazard. this place was not responsibly taken care of. the wall sockets had masking tape over them, dangerous.   the linens were so dirty i got a rash. the bath mat was too dirty to use. next to the bed were piled two cardboard boxes as a table so you couldn't put anything down or it would fall off. the wall sockets had masking tape over them, dangerous. she refused to tell me any directions or when checkin was, her mailbox was full, she just said she'd meet me there. i'd told her numerous times i was disabled but when i needed help with bags she said 'pfft i don't do that.'  i texted her i would check out at ten am. then she texted me starting at 11pm through 8am, even though i told her i am disabled and needed to sleep, badgering me to make it official on airbnb. this is weird and harrassment. also there was a used up roll of toilet paper so i had to buy more.  this place is in the middle of nowhere. sole had told me it was somewhere else, but i would advise to stay anywhere else. also she has never heard of the brooklyn museum. is this really her home? stay with a friend or in a hotel. this is not the place it is made out to be. bugs, a fire hazard, and que puta. The ac doesn’t actually cool the place down.

Blair was awesome and even made met with me near midnight when my flight came in. Apartment was very clean and modern looking. Neighborhood is a little sketchy but a quick walk to the subway into NYC. I would absolutely stay here again.

The apartment is pleasant and clean, equipped with everything necessary. The only problem is did not we got the right code to the front door of the building and then the code in the box with the key to the apartment. A little stressful when it comes after a long flight. Even the Internet access we received only after we sent mail. TV was not connected to cable, arranged after the Phone.  Pleasant environment and grocery stores and restaurants nearby, convenient transportation everywhere.  Apart than one night the neighbor celebrated in a party and you could sleep all nights were quiet and comfortable.  we would go for it again! Thanks a lot for the nice stay!

We stayed in David’s apartment for 10 weeks, from the end of October until early January, so hopefully we are well placed to provide an accurate and helpful review. First and foremost, the description provided for the property and the previous reviews are pretty accurate. Our headline conclusion is that this is a great place to stay. The Upper East Side is quite simply the best place to be located in Manhattan. The apartment is just a couple of blocks from the Q Subway line (opened just two years ago) which will get you reliably down to Times Square in about ten minutes. According to the NYPD, the apartment is located in one of the safest precincts in NYC, and it feels that way too. We never once felt unsafe walking around the UES. There are a wealth of restaurants, bars, yoga studios and cinemas all within just a few minutes of the apartment. Central Park is less than 10 minutes away. In terms of the apartment itself, David was extremely good in terms of communications. I don’t think we ever waited more than about half an hour for a response to anything. When we arrived, we noticed the shower curtain was a bit old and dirty and that the ironing board was missing. Within a couple of days, David had provided new ones for us, no arguments - very good service. The apartment has plenty of storage. Two built in wardrobes are double-depth. We had three large suitcases with us and were able to store them away, with lots of room for our clothes too. The bed is comfy, but a bit old and creaky. As per previous reviews, the heating makes a loud noise when it comes on each morning (about 4am). You can’t control the heating from within the apartment, it is just set for the whole block. So if it gets too warm, you have to open the window. No major problem though, the window looks out over a small, private, quiet garden. The kitchen is about as small as a kitchen could possibly be, but it had everything we needed to prepare our meals. The bathroom is fine. The shower is wonderfully powerful with plenty of hot water. We would have absolutely no hesitation about staying at David’s apartment again. Just two things to note that were not quite so favourable: if you want to receive United States Postal Service mail at the apartment you won’t be able to (unless you make friends with the postman, like we did). The post is placed in a locker which we didn’t have a key for and, despite asking for one, were told that USPS mail is not able to be received by guests. Fine if you’re just in town for a few weeks I guess, but if you’re here for longer it is likely there might be some mail you need. For us it was bank cards. This is just something to be aware of. The other thing is in relation to noise from other apartments in the block. This has also been mentioned in other reviews. It wasn’t wild parties or loud music, arguably it was just ‘normal’ noise for NYC living where the walls between apartments are paper thin. We were OK with it for a few weeks, but it did start to get quite annoying the longer we had to suffer it. The woman next door likes a loud phone call (not sure why she has to shout rather than talk normally) and for some reason has a treadmill in a tiny apartment, which makes quite a noise on a Sunday afternoon. Luckily it seems she only likes to run for a short time! Similarly, the person upstairs doesn’t seem to realise that wearing shoes on a wooden floor is an extremely selfish thing to do and walking up and down repeatedly at 4am is rather unwelcome. This noise issue wouldn’t stop us staying again and we were aware of it from previous reviews before we booked. We just mention it here to give a full and honest appraisal of our experience. Of course, there is nothing that David could do about this - so it is what it is. Also worth noting, we could only find two TV channels.  Overall: great location, comfortable apartment, would definitely stay again.

Great place! Feels like a home away from home! Responds fast and is very knowledgeable of the city. Did feel a bit unsafe walking home at times but it may have been a personal thing but otherwise everything was perfect!

Was an okay stay! Pretty stylish and clean. However, the toilet is loud, the oven takes long to heat up, there’s no basic seasonings for cooking, and when the heater turns on, it’s scary. But, it was nice and cozy! There was an incident with a ripped pillow, didn’t remember breaking it, but had no problem paying for it! It’s a nice place, but prepare for cigarette smoke from other apartments, and a loud busy street. It’s near a school! The instructions to pick up the key was a bit wrong so I was confused walking up and down the block, but eventually got in! Overall, I would still stay here given the option again!

The place was exactly as described.  Clean and comfortable.  Checking in was a breeze.  Took me about a minute to get from my car into the apartment.  Isabelle was very good with communication.  The best part (in my opinion) was the neighborhood.  Many dining options nearby as well as drug stores and grocery stores.  Will definitely stay there again.

D. was a great host always available, super friendly, and tended to our every need. The space was exactly what we had been looking for and for the price it's pretty much a steal! Perfect location for easy transportation throughout the city and right next door is a small restaurant with a delicious breakfast we always took advantage of. Overall amazing experience next trip we would definitely contact him again!
Super convenient to all things downtown! D was very helpful on suggestions. Make sure your not scared of heights! Climbing the ladder to the loft bed could be a bit scary.

This place is awesome! Check in and check out were ridiculously easy and the place is spotless! It is small but perfect for two people. The couch turns into a bed and it was very comfortable. The bathroom is very spacious by manhattan standards and the water pressure was great. We loved the neighborhood and never felt unsafe. Charles makes sure you have everything you could need, from shampoo and conditioner to an iron and ironing board! We will definitely be back.

This is a great place for couples to stay and explore New York. My wife and I stayed here for a week for our first wedding anniversary and loved it! It is in a clean and comfortable part of the city, we never felt scared or uncomfortable walking the streets near the apartment. It is located very close to multiple subway stations, and less than a mile from Penn Station. The apartment is a great value and the perfect place to stay for exploring New York.

My travel buddy and I really enjoyed our stay. We loved the location. We are two girls and we never felt unsafe in the neighbourhood. It was small but it was everything we needed! Very close to a subway and lots of cool restaurants and bars! Would definitely come back!

Julian was a great host and was there to welcome me during my second day.  Only feedback I would give is that he would show up unexpected and come in when we weren't there.  While he did come in to leave towels and some things for construction, it would've been nice to get a quick heads up.  Also, the neighbors upstairs are extremely loud.  It made it hard to sleep and we felt a bit paranoid at night thinking someone was going to come in.  The art in the airbnb was a bit creepy as well, especially at night.  Other than that, the loft was a short walk to the train and there were a few cool shops around.

It was a great studio apartment for a couple and it was super close to everything, which we loved! I will say, some nights were a little sketchy because some questionable people loitered right outside, but I think that’ll be true for any part of the city. All things considered, it was pretty safe. I do wish it was stocked with extra toilet paper and paper towels though, we had to buy some. The bed was hard, not going to lie, but for the price it was definitely worth it. We would stay again!

We had an amazing stay at Gudhi's place. Gaudhi is a really nice person and he is very funny and clever to talk to. We actually made a couple of new friends during our stay, Gaudhi and his friends are very cool, friendly and hospitable. But be prepared for almost anything such as loud music or a lot of people around. It was not a problem for us at all, because they are all so nice. But if you like a more quiet hotel experience, this wouldn't be the place.   Don't be afraid of Harlem! The neighborhood is really nice. The place is close to the subway, so you can easily access the whole city and walk to the park.   The room looks different than the pictures, which means that the bed is raised so there is more space, which is good.

Living out of a suitcase for weeks can sometimes leave you homesick. But the Loft instantly provides you with that missed comfort. It was definitely our home away from home. With fascinating artworks and hidden beds within the walls, it's still hard to believe that this urban oasis was placed smack bang in the heart of downtown Manhattan next door to the World Trade Center and walking distance to other icons like the Charging Bull and Ferries to Staten Island / Statue of Liberty. It was also only a short stroll to the Brooklyn Bridge, Chinatown, little Italy and SoHo. Not to mention the Subway station was right outside the front door, only a 20 min ride to Time Square. Alfredo's use of space is pure genius and could ultimately sleep up to 12 people if you tried. However, it is limited to only one bathroom, so I would recommend stays of more than 5 people only if you can hold your bladder in a queue or don't mind taking a dump while another person showers. Don't be afraid of Alfredo's Wildling looks, he's actually a great host and I would definitely recommend his amazing loft to others. Thanks Alfredo for letting us crash at your crib.

It is a perfect place for one person or couple if you are looking for an economical option and a place just to rest. It has an MTA subway station one block away and Central Park 2 blocks away. Very friendly and attentive. They also speak Spanish! The room is very small and the bed is high, so if you are heavy and have difficulty getting up, take that into account, the mattress is the most comfortable :) The neighborhood may look dangerous but it is not. Thanks Gaudi.

The place is perfect if you are on a tight budget. I doubt it's possible to find better things for that price, which doesn't mean the place is bad. It is incredibly well located, as there are several subway lines that connect to Times Square quickly (2 of those lines are "express"). Although initially the impression of the neighborhood may seem bad, I did not feel unsafe at any time, and it is highly recommended to get to know it in depth, it is great!  On the other hand, we mainly had contact with Gaudhi's brother, Italmar, who was very friendly at all times, facilitating flexibility for arrival time and departure time. Because we were only home to sleep and shower (there are so many things to do in NYC!!!), we weren't able to get closer.  The only negative thing is that during our stay we had problems with leaks in the bathroom. This is temporary and should not influence you to choose this accommodation, since the same day we were leaving they were fixing the leak. Furthermore, Italmar seemed quite embarrassed about the incident, apologizing repeatedly for the inconvenience it may have caused (which was not a big deal). These are things that happen even in the best houses!

Very good experience. The room was north of Central Park and right next door was a subway station that takes you to Times Square (only 10-15 minutes). The neighborhood is not scary and the people of Harlem are nice. Flexibility in arrival and departure times. Gaudhi's mother is very nice and gives ideas of places to visit. The quality/price room is very good. It has a huge plasma television with Netflix but since we arrived so tired we didn't use it. To visit NYC all day and get to sleep and shower is very good. Better than Hotel Pennsylvania.

We had a great „Christmas in NY experience”. We arrived from Budapest (HUN) and spent 10 days at Gaudhi's apartman. The location is really good! The Central Park, and metro 2/3 is in 3 minutes walk. We met Gaudi just once, but his mother lives in the apartment too, and while her English wasn't the best, she was very helpful; and whenever we needed more information, or something we got it through message from the host. 😊  There is also a big screen TV in the room. We didn’t want to cook anything there, but because of winter time it would have been good just drink a tea at home in rainy morning – we could manage it, although there is no kettle, or microwave oven.  There was an issue with the heating system: its not adjustable. So it was really hot in the room everytime – we could control the temperature just with opening the window… and actually the apartment has a bit strange smell also. We thought that its caused by the heating system – but not sure. So the ventilation is not the best at all.  Although its Harlem, we didn’t feel the neighborhood unsafe – everybody was really friendly and helpful with us.

Comfortable bed and pillows. Noise at night from the heating and since they are wooden apartments, you can hear the neighbor upstairs and the hallway inside the house.  The neighborhood at night can seem dangerous, although nothing bad happened to us, it is not very pleasant to walk there at night. In general, good for what you pay, but if you have a little more money, look for something more central.
Gaudhi never show up, just a guy who gave us the key and did not explain much. The neighborhood it’s kind of dangerous and in the apartment there’s a lot of people living there.

Nice and friendly host! Calm environment. Great location literally 3 blocks away from Central Park and a metro station, even though it’s not a very nice neighborhood/street (but not dangerous). Apartment is bit messy and neglected, but clean. You can expect bit less “visual quality wise” that those showed in the pictures. Otherwise price-quality it’s ok and fare. I did a long weekend trip and spend 3 nights and 4 days in NY with my wife and we would only sleep and take a shower to then be gone all day. Probably not recommended for long stays or if you are a more house oriented person or if you will use kitchen (it’s small full of stuff). Otherwise I would go back if I had to.

My husband and I were just in New York for Christmas and New Year's, our first time in the city, and our long stay with Gaudhi was comfortable and enjoyable.  Although in the photographs you can see the space is a little small, it is very well distributed. In general, everything was clean, and the bathroom was cleaned regularly.   Gaudhi was always attentive and responded immediately to any question or request. He and his roommate were very kind in giving us recommendations for food and places to visit.   There are usually many homeless people in the neighborhood, although they always seemed harmless, and there were usually police officers guarding the area. One block from the apartment is the subway station that connects with most lines in the city, so getting around the city was always easy and viable.

Myself and 5 girls stayed here this summer! The place looks exactly like it does in the photos. Vida and Kevin were more than willing to help out with any questions we had. Greenpoint is a great neighborhood. I recommend going to Peter Pan to get the best cake doughnuts you'll ever eat. I never felt unsafe walking home here. The subway station is a 10-15 minute walk away but after walking it a few times it didn't seem as long. The place had comfy beds and plenty of air conditioning. It was the perfect place for us to stay. We all commuted into Manhattan every day for work which could take up to 45 minutes. Everyone agreed that we got really lucky with this place. We also had a few problems with the shower drain and toilet but it was fixed quickly! I am honestly sad to have left. It really turned into a home for all of us. Kevin and Vida were great hosts and I would definitely stay through them again.

Mary was a wonderful host- not only did she accept our very last minute booking with her (we were in a pinch due to a booking scam with another host), but she even let us stay beyond our check-out hour to ensure we had a place to store our luggage.   The check-in process was very easy, her place was well-equipped with all essentials, and well-sized (that is, for a NYC apartment!). Her place is about a 20 minute walk from the happening "core" of Williamsburg- but if you don't mind walking and want to save a few bucks, then this shouldn't be an issue!  Thanks Mary, very much!

Let's start with the negative points: "the dirt" is incredibly dirty, there are 3 big cats, I would even say huge cats typically American, so hairs everywhere, in the room and in the bathroom, a cat urinated in the bathtub, the level of hygiene is unfortunately disgusting, then the "atmosphere" of the house is scary, a room opposite ours without a door with a TV always open with a mysterious person, a little creepy.   The positive points: "Skip" is a very nice person, he likes to know what we have done during the day and gives us good advice for places to visit, "the location" is well placed, in Brooklyn but not very far from Manhattan, a metro a few meters away, easy to access, the only downside is sometimes a lot of noise from Mexican neighbors.   To summarize, good location but very dirty apartment due to big cats, we will not be able to return...

The room was like in the picture, but the house was very (too) messy and dirty (living room and the kitchen full of stuff and garbage on the floor and on the furnitures. It was like a squat!). The bathroom was very old and We were even afraid to turn on and off the light (from time to time there were sparks...). We had no hot water for 2 days (up to 4) (but then Skip fixed it). Skip is a very nice person. He was very kind and gentle.  Sorry to say (bacause of Skip and his kindness) but - as we strongly believe in the usefulness of sincere comments in AIRBNB - We would not recommend it.

The accommodation was adequate. The space is limited, but it is clean and has everything you need to cook, a complete although small bathroom, nice decoration. We miss that there is no television, although the Internet is very good. The mattress could be more comfortable. Regarding the neighborhood, although it may initially seem like a dangerous neighborhood, it is totally quiet and has a good atmosphere.

Me and my boyfriend stayed 12 nights at Guillermo's place in Williamsburg. He was a great host and really communicative during our stay. We had some problems with the Wifi and with a broken blind and both were fixed really fast with accurate updates about the progress. He even payed for a 4G SIM card to bridge the no-Wifi gap! The apartment is located close to the Montrose Av L-train station and a 20min subway ride will take you straight into Manhattan.   The neighborhood is a bit rough but we had no problems with crime whatsoever. There was a party going a couple of houses down the road during our last weekend there which got a little loud. I've read here that other people complained about it too so I guess it's a bar or a concert venue of some sort. The apartment itself could use some AC tho as it got really hot there during our stay but that also could be due to one of the hottest NY summers in years with temperatures of over 35c.   All in all we had a great stay and we would definitely stay here again should we visit NYC another time.

What to say, not your normal NY stay but equally one I really liked. The area of Bushwick/ East Williamsburg isn't your classic tourist location (as pointed out by a number of locals) but that said this is definitely an area on the up and up with plenty of coffee shops, bars and enough restaurants close by to keep you interested for the most part of the week.   Well placed to hit Manhattan or mainstream Williamsburg (via the L line - 2 close by subway stations) I thought location although a little sketchy when first arriving was one I'd happily stay in again.

Guillermo is a great host and was available to us at any time. The apartment is very centrally located (5 minutes to the metro station, 15 minutes to Manhattan) and yet quiet and, with the small garden, ideal as a retreat from the stress of the big city. It was very clean and nicely furnished, check-in and check-out also went smoothly. During our next stay in NY, we will definitely stay at Guillermo's again.

Overall, the accommodation is quite ok! Photos promise more than the accommodation delivers. Very simple basement room that was converted into an apartment. Door locks don't always work smoothly and you shouldn't be afraid of spiders. The apartment is very quiet on a side street and is in a great location, as Manhattan is easy to reach by subway. The key handover also worked without any problems and Guillermo can be reached!  Price performance is therefore ok for NYC!!

This host is misrepresenting her apartment. On pictures it's clean and bright, but in reality it's dark, dirty, depressed place with scary paintings in the room. It's real hole. Even furniture is different and super old. Closet is full with some stuff so it's useless, bed creaks, there were hair on the liner and it looks and smells like it's unwashed. Apartment is very cold and tiny.  Host is at home 24/7. Bathroom also looks terrible. Sink have a huge crack, again her stuff in there so you even have no place to put your towel and bathrobe. As soon as I moved in all I wanted is to search for another place to stay. I didn't want to use kitchen or bathroom as it's untidy so I felt uncomfortable. I shortened my stay and left.
Lovely studio flat which is a great spot for discovering williamsburg and get easily into the city. Perfect if you want a stress free city break and you enjoy a good wander!

Lara and Michael are great hosts. Unfortunately we didn't see Lara, but Michael met us, showed and told everything in details. He was very helpful and attentive.   Appartment location is really excellent. Metro in 5 minutes walking, Times square in 15 minutes, central park in 10 minutes walking, etc. Very quiet and peaceful area. But there are a lot of restarants, bars and cafes in 5 minutes walking.  There are all you need in the appartments. But it is not clean enougth - it was the only unpleasant thing for us.  Animals. Lara warns about them and all of them do not cause any serious problems. You have to..or you must feed and water them. Thats all. But you have to be clear that cat is a cat. Lilly is adorable and affectionate cat, but it has her natural needs. It sharpens her claws and it can use your things or luggage for it. It goes to the toilet and can dirty a floor or carpet or sofa. It is not something bad, it is a real life, but a new guest should assess these nuances. We lived in the house full of cats, and it was not real problem for us.

I stayed at Leon's apartment for a weekend getaway with two of my female colleagues/friends to attend a show at the Bell House. We picked the apartment because of the proximity to The Bell House (20 minute walk) and most importantly because of the art work displayed throughout the unit. We absolutely adored his diverse style and found a piece of art that we all related to. The apartment is a clean small space (expected for NY) but Leon utilizes every square inch efficiently and we never felt crowded with the three of us. Two of us slept in the bed (very comfortable) and one person took the oversized couch which is equally as comfortable and roomy. The best part about the apartment, is the private deck! I believe we may have spent most of our time outside soaking up sun and taking in views rather than actually exploring! I will say that if you're not one for a lot of physical activity, you may want to consider a different location as it’s a five floor walk-up, but it’s DEFINITELY WORTH IT!  The neighborhood is quiet and we never felt unsafe walking around afterhours. If you need to drive, free street parking in the area was more of an abundance than I expected and we had no issues even in the late night hours.   Besides the actual apartment, Leon is amazing as well! We arrived late on a Friday night (after check-in time), but Leon was very flexible and worked with us to make sure we still had access to the keys. He is very quick at responding, so you will never feel as if you’re stuck figuring things out. He is also very hospitable and opened up his food and drinks to us as well.    I would highly recommend staying at Leon’s apartment and we hope to return to in future!

Dylan and his brother Peter were extremely accommodating, as I had an urgent / last minute need to find a place in New York and had just come in off a red eye - I.e. exhausted and roomless. So a big thanks for letting me check in early!  The apartment itself was very comfortable and conveniently located in the lovely West Village, and just happens to be very close to Umami Burger. (Dangerous)  If the weather wasn't so great I would have enjoyed spending some time with Dylan's comprehensive library.   The bed was big and comfy, shower was hot, the AC cool and check in was very smooth.   What more could you ask for? (Perhaps another truffle infused burger)

Clarina's place is a wonderful location where to stay in Brooklyn.  You will find everything you need for a long or short stay in the apartment! Clarina takes care of every single detail including sharing with you helpful information about grocery shopping, moving around and simply exploring! I have loved the neighborhood - nearby you have so much: subway, good pizza, hang out bars, good bagels and places where to run! Staying in NYC can become stressful but the apartment is located in such a chilled spot away from caos - I have loved my time in NYC and in Clarina's place!

A really good choice if you want to stay in Brooklyn! The apartment is like it's shown on the pictures. The bed is really comfortable, and so is the shower. The communication with Guillermo was great. The only downside is the noise of the boiler in the apartment, we woke up from it a couple of times. And although we didn't feel unsafe in the area, we get that other people did. But other than that, we really did enjoy our stay and we would totally recommend it!

Leon’s place is tidy and welcoming. He was very easy to get in touch with and it was convenient having two subway lines just two blocks away. It took us a bit to figure out how to unlock the apartment door, but we did it after a little key jiggling. It’s a nice neighbourhood full of brownstones with a park nearby. We never felt unsafe there.

'The Hancock' is a very nice place to stay at! The apartment is as depicted and even more nicer. It's clean and the beds are extremely comfortable.   It took us about 30-40 min to get into time square. From the house to the subway station is about 7-10 min. There is a bus that takes you there in less than 2 min, so we took the bus most of the time.   We stayed out quite late (1-3 am) and we never felt unsafe during our stay. ( We were a group of 4 girls)  There is a dog in the house, but in the 10 days we were there, we didnt notice the dog. A bark here and there, that about it. Two of us were allergic to dogs and Richelle and Pelà took that into account.   Now about the hosts. They are wonderfull, friendly and warm people. We dealt with Richelle most of the time. She is very fast in responding to the message. She goes beyond to make your stay as comfortable and pleasant as can be.   We enjoyed our stay very much and would defenitly recommend it to anyone that wants to hear and would stay here again!

Our host lived up to our expectations. Not intrusive but present if necessary. We were very sensitive to the fact that he gave us access to the apartment on the last day even though our flight was at 11:55 p.m., which allowed us to enjoy our last day without having to drag our suitcases. The apartment sufficient for 1 family of four. I highly recommend this address.

Perfectly fine place to stay in Brooklyn. It was clean and a decent size. It's a garden level, so a little dark and the low ceilings might be uncomfortable for tall people. Family with dog above made a decent amount of noise, but not enough to make the stay unpleasant.
This was my first experience on Airbnb and Alina, my host, made it a great one.  Her place was wonderful and she made my trip less stressful.  Alina, thank you very much.
Correct accommodation in a depressed and dangerous area

I really enjoyed my stay at Steve and Jim's place. The house is very clean, tidy and looks exactly like in the pictures. Steve and Jim or both very easy to talk to and very willing to help with whatever question you might have. The location is very central but at night it luckily was very quiet.
