I stayed with them during the 'Blizzard of 2015' (the storm never really happened), but the idea of being stuck in their house didn't scare me at all :)

This place is clean, cute and very quiet! Israel was very flexible with our check-in and check-out which made arriving and leaving relaxing and stress-free. The apartment is small but has everything you need, with a large, comfortable bed, great water pressure in the shower and a super convenient location just a block from the subway. Plus it's super quiet, so I slept really well there! Thanks for the great stay!

Steve and Jim are adorable, attentive and discreet hosts. Don't hesitate to ask them for advice, they were invaluable to us!!! The apartment is ideally located a stone's throw from line 6 which takes you to everything and 2-3 blocks from Central Parc! Neighborhood in its own right, but not an ounce of insecurity. The room is spacious and well equipped and the bathroom is great! Impeccably clean! Supermarket at the foot of the building and the Lexington social bar/restaurant just opposite is very nice at an affordable price! I highly recommend!

The time with Steve was simply great. He was very cool and gave us great tips (especially for my candy-loving girlfriend). The conversations were always relaxed and pleasant. The subway is right outside the door and goes downtown directly to most of the attractions in Manhattan and Brooklyn. A tip from us and Steve: Book the super shuttle from/to the airport, otherwise the arrival/departure will be stressful without knowledge of the subway. The room included everything you needed and more (air conditioning and fridge). Highly recommended!
Pleasant stay. But the host requested extra money for the second bedroom while we clearly rented two seperate beds on Airbnb and informed him in advance we are colleagues what felt like a scam.

I don't want to scare off anybody, I will try to be as fair-play as I can, due to what I experienced. Mrs. Harris seemed a nice person. She was very kind to show me around and take me to a special store, time that we used to get to know each other and I appreciated her openess. To be short: Strong points:  - place is large and easy to reach by subway and walking distance - you have the basics for an everyday living as in microwave, fridge etc. - water bottles in the fridge - supermarket just around the corner Weak points: - cleanliness is close to zero, floors were dirty, dusty and smeared in a hurry when I came, I had to dissinfect the toilet seat that was not even wiped but same, just smeared with something and the shower cabin that had human hair of all origins on the floor and on the walls of it, not to mention it wasn't white as it is supposed to be. Tried to oversee those and cleaned as well as I could so that I can live in, without tellin my host that, so that she doesn't feel bad about it - the whole time I stayed there, the guy upstairs from me constantly woke me up 7 am in the morning and late in night walking back and forth, making sleeping over 7 impossible. Even after talking to the host twice, show went on. -nextdoor building is in construction so expect boom bang every morning, also, and a lot of dust  -carpet in the bedroom was old, dirty and not vacuumed in ages, bedsheets were all nylon and the bed had a matress cover protection that made me feel like a baby that had to sleep on a pee protection. My 1st day and night there were a nightmare, couldn't sleep whole night, tossing and turnin, crying for spike of how in hell did I ever got in that place. Because we survive if we addapt, next day I bought new linen and got off the plastic cover off the matress. - even if the policy said "flexible", my getting out of there was one side established by my host, who kicked me out, even if I said I have a long, almost 24 hours trans-atlantic flight, and asked her if I can stay by 13.00 same day. She come up with the excuse she has to clean the house

My stay at Josh's place was nice. He has a great appartement with everything what's needed. The area around is cool,very colorful and nice people. We met some neighbors from next door and they were very nice too. The little market downstairs is perfectly close. The subways are easy to reach. The L-Line,just one block away, takes you to Manhattan and you don't have to be afraid coming home late. It's a good neighborhood. We couldn't ask for a better place to make our New York experience to a great one! Josh wasn't around ,but he had a friend coming to the house to give us the keys. Very nice. I have nothing to complain about and highly recommend his place!

I really enjoyed my stay at their place! Everything was super clean, simple yet stylish and the bed was SUPER comfortable!! It’s in a great location within Astoria and not too far from LGA (vía Uber). I definitely recommend to stay here. The price is such a steal!! Check-in is super easy. I appreciated the amount of secure key locks in the building and the room. Made me feel very safe. This Airbnb is quite possibly the cleanest I have ever stayed in! I can’t say enough good things, thank you!!

I do not recommend this air b n b. It is in a hotel which feels like more like a dingy motel. If it wasn’t unrefundable I wouldn’t have stayed.  The check in was smooth. There was a lady that helped me with my bags. My room was on the third floor and there was no elevator. She helped me carry my bags. She was very nice.  The room was shocking. It was DIRTY. The corners had dirt. The room smelt. It smelt like old carpet. It smelt like an old dorm room. I was worried to even sleep in the bed. It was not comfortable at all also.  The AC when turned on gives the most awful smell. The room felt off and dirty.  The hotel is right next to a homeless meet up spot. This place was disappointing. The overall vibe and feeling of this hotel is OFF. It is not even clean period. The tv doesn’t always work. Sometimes it does sometimes it doesn’t.   The only pros: - Good location  - Close to good foods spots  Overall I do NOT recommend this spot at all.

I feel we grossly overpaid for this accommodation. Fixture & fittings were cheap - toilet roll holder came off in our hand. No lift and we were on the 2nd floor. The hallways were depressing and smelt of vinegar. We were left outside for 10 mins trying to get in. Opposite the hotel was a Salvation Army hostel for homeless - not a great area. I thought it would be much nicer as we paid £1,984 for 7 nights!  We were so unhappy we left after 1 night as it was so depressing.

Amanda helped make exploring New York much less stressful. The amenities were exactly as describe and Amanda was clear, friendly, and communicative. She remained flexible with my changing schedule as well made the check-out process seamless. Highly recommend for a stress-free stay in the Upper West Side.

Andrew's room in Astoria is truly a rare find. I spent almost 2 months here to work from New York and really enjoyed my stay. The location is great. It's about 5 mins walk to the 30th AV station, which only takes 15-20 mins to midtown. It's quiet and safe without homeless people lingering around. There are also plenty of options of food and good restaurant nearby. Whether you want to have a 2-3-days or a month stay, this is a very good place to go with

wonderful guy, one of the most beautiful well maintained private roomsI ever stayed at! an absolute steal. very comfortable king bed, huge TV, microwave, fridge, silverware in the room, super private, we were completely in love with the place!!

The hosts are very good people and very friendly, but the area is a conflictive area of ​​Brooklyn and they should inform other users so that the same thing as us does not happen to them, if it is your first time going to the United States you have to know that this area is dangerous ⚠️

It was a well connected place to reach Manhattan. The neighborhood has a lot of Mexican/Latinos restaurants. I enjoyed the food which were cheap as well. Some people may feel a bit unsafe walking around at night, but luckily the subway is just 2 min walk. The apartment is big and well-furnished. But there is only one bathroom with attached toilet, and it is shared among (up to 6) guests from 3 rooms. So sometimes you have to wait a while to use the toilet/bathroom.

Listing originally said there were no security cameras on the property. I arrived to the Airbnb to find 5 cameras that I visually was able to find on/in the premises. The host changed the listing to say that there were cameras after I raised the issue but I as well as the other guests staying with me felt that was a huge violation of privacy. The host has multiple cameras inside the home as well as one in the basement which is a bedroom and they all are blink cameras which record video AND audio when they record. That alone has violated our privacy and raised our concerns for safety. I was lied to about the cameras and I absolutely would not have booked the Airbnb if I knew beforehand that they had cameras. I personally enjoy my privacy and knowing I’m not being recorded or listened to. Also I had 4 guests staying and 3 friends came to meet us there, not even 10 minutes later I receive a not so welcoming phone call from the host threatening me that I need to add the 3 people that just met us on to the reservation list or we would be kicked out.. what kind of host does that? $875 for 3 more people?? This is a money hungry, selfish, and terrible host. Did I forget to mention the owner goes by “Mrs.D” when it’s really a man that is posing as a female host trying to say he is her husband. I never once spoke to a female. The downstairs shower also did not work, it had almost no water pressure and the water that did come out was scolding hot. Also after I got scammed into paying the absurd amount of money for the 3 friends and we left, The host had the audacity to try to charge me extra for “clogging the toilet and ash in the sink” saying we smoked in the house when none of us smoked in the house. And somehow clogging the toilet is our fault?? If someone uses a toilet and it doesn’t flush does the hotel charge you more? No they come and fix it for you. Because a toilet is where you use the bathroom. It would be different if someone went in the sink or on the floor. But to be charged more for using the toilet?? I’ve never experienced such a bad and irresponsible host. I was lied to, mistreated, watched and listened to thru the cameras that weren’t supposed to be there, charged absurdly for friends that came over, threatened, and disrespected. I will never be going back there again and I hope you don’t either.

Tarik has a good size space for New York standard, the neighborhood was a bit sketchy for us, but subway was convenient within 4 block. Tarik is nice and helpful. A few instructions would make things smoother like WiFi etc.. but overall we enjoyed our stay.

The room is super comfortable and it is exactly as you can see in the pictures. The common areas and kitchen are perfectly equipped.  The location is great 4 blocks from the 7 train station. Although the apartment is very close to the train track, it is not noisy (you can hear the train, but in my case was not a problem at all). The building is clean and very quite. Kaz is a fantastic host: professional, communicative and considerate with their renters. Their team is fantastic and make your check in, stay and check out very easy and convenient. I would not hesitate in stay in his places again considering that many people in NYC will try to scam you.

The hosts were great and helped out with the check in process. The room itself was also nice. The main reason I am rating this low is because - the location seemed unsafe (I heard gunshots in the night) - heavy construction starting at 7.30 am right next door - room had mosquitoes

Jose’s place was fine. There was really nothing wrong with it. My issue is that Jose thew a party the second night of our stay, had people up the entire night. They were noisy and disruptive. Around 5-6am there was a literal fight that broke out, and all I know is I heard an immense crashing noise and opened my door and there was an overly belligerent man being restrained. From the sounds of it they kicked him out, but everyone was yelling at the top of their lungs for at least another hour. I couldn’t sleep because I am currently 5 1/2 months pregnant, and I had my 9 year-old child with me. I was scared for our safety. If I had been alone and not with child, my review would not be so negative. But this was a very unsettling situation to be in as a single mother by myself, not knowing anyone in the home my child was sleeping in. I’d like to pursue a refund. An air b&b stay should not make you fear for your and your children’s safety.
With an amazing bed and the biggest TV I've ever seen, Jose's lovely room felt like an even bigger steal than anticipated. The perfect private escape from the bustle of Bushwick.

Turned out really well...but didn't start that way, as learned at JFK Luggage Retrieval that I was *not* going to where I "bought," because of a water leak. So Eddie / Vlad arranged a stay 25-odd blocks South of where I *wanted* to be. My adult daughters feared "scam," as they'd read up on some AirBnB issues...but the new place was fine, hosted by Carol Anne (I think??), who was as charming and helpful as Eddie and Vlad. The room was comforable, very near Central Park, with a/c and fans in-room, good wi-fi, nice private bathroom, and in an elevator building. A decent deal, considering I'd come during Graduation Season.....

Apartment was nice but the neighborhood is not … first day when we were moving in … I see two people buying weed in front of me .. there was no police I got really scared … and whenever I used to go out of my building I used to see such and such people all the time. While checking out in the broad day light, one homeless lady approached me and asked me to give my bag to him, I got really uncomfortable. They changed my room and this was the new location. The lock on the door is so stuck… on the first day 15 min and on second day around 10 … it took me this much time to open the door … and of course it was hot and claustrophobic environment on the floor because it’s New York.

The location while convenient has a few issues. There are airplanes flying overhead all day and night.   There were mosquitoes and gnats throughout the house upon arrival. The beds were very uncomfortable. There was hair all over blanket in front bedroom.  The front bedroom also did not have blinds on windows. Neighbors could see into the room through the sheer curtains creating a lack of privacy  There wasn’t a lockbox or self-check in option as stated in the listing. The door was unlocked upon arrival with host meeting us there. The communication leading up to this was lacking with up to 2-3 days between response times.   The biggest concern was the faucet in bathroom was labeled incorrectly. Red-cold; blue-hot and the hot water was scalding hot burning my niece.  The temperature is unsafe for kids.   The best part was that and kitchen was nicely stocked and beautifully updated.   We would stay again if the host corrects these issues.
great stay . location around hotel is a bit sketchy but we never had any problems

Lovely stay! But I wonder why the host has cctv camera’s installed in different areas of the home and did not deem it fit to inform one prior to checking-in what the purpose is and what areas they should expect them.  It’s very scary and invasive. It doesn’t make one feel safe or like they have any sort of privacy. Asides that I had a very nice time and felt truly at home away from home.

Overall, the stay was ok. I can’t say it was great. That’s because electricity kept turning off in the kitchen and bathroom, so I was always worried about my food in the fridge. Also, it’s noisy from  the outside, so I had troubles with trying to fall asleep. I could do it only with white noise in my earphones. And there are at least 3 mousetraps in the apartment. There are no mice but the presence of the mousetraps made me a bit nervous, and it was unpleasant to see them.  I think I wouldn’t want to stay here again.

horrible person ... goes in the property when no one is there. scams on people tell the customer service you did something when you didn't. check the WALLS TAKE A PICTURE MAKE SURE YOU HAVE THE PROOF THAT HER PROPERTY HAD DAMAGES BEFORE GETTING COMFORTABLE!! HORRIBLE HORRIBLE HORRIBLE I DO NOT RECOMMEND

Beautiful spot, clean, and good communication for check in/check out. Perfect for a little get away and girls trip. The house was very modern and spacious for a city spot. Street parking was right out front! House had plenty of towels. The area was residential but was not the best area to do things with a group or walk around. The transportation was accessible though-  just 2 blocks walking from the subway and then about 25 minutes to Manhattan! Also just a 20 minute Uber to upbeat parts of Brooklyn. The door locks felt safe but we had someone under the influence standing outside of our house for about an hour acting suspicious and didn’t love that (out of the owners control!).  The owner does have cameras outside for safety, as I noticed I  was texted twice about some things ….ex: turning off the porch light (texted at 8 pm), and closing the front gate (texted at 445 am). We didn’t use the backyard but it looks really nice to be outside - has a big connect 4 and a fire pit.   Overall we loved our spot, and would recommend to a group!

Art Thank you very much for your responsiveness and your help, in particular for allowing us to leave the luggage in the basement before our 9 p.m. flight to Paris. We enjoyed it. We really liked your apartment which is very functional. THANKS
Love this place. Such an easy walk to the Subway! Even late at night never felt unsafe. Was a great place to stay!

This apartment was spacious and in a quiet location, however the day after we arrived we found a wasp in the house. The following day, we found 16 wasps, one cockroach, and one silverfish in the apartment. We suspect that there was an undisclosed wasps nest outside of the unit given the number of wasps found in the apartment. Luckily, the hosts were accommodating and provided a full refund.

DO NOT BOOK if you’re expecting a good experience and don’t want to lose your money. The host does not meet you directly, he sends someone else to meet you. Host acted very suspect, refusing to give out his name when we called. Upon arrival we found spoiled food in the refrigerator, a heater that didn’t work in winter, a broken windows, damaged flooring, dirty furniture and towels, a bag of old bloody costumes in the bedroom and no internet. It seemed like it hadn’t been cleaned since the last stay (arguably Halloween given the costumes) - not sanitary during a pandemic. There’s a reason photos don’t show the floors, windows or closets. When I reached out, the host’s solution was to turn on the internet and send someone to pick up the spoiled food (no further cleaning or sanitization). By that time we had to secure other accommodations and left. He refused to refund so I’m stuck with thousands of dollars for being there a few hours. Save yourself the trouble.

Great place to stay. The host was very responsive and the Airbnb was amazing. The only issue was the parking situation. Our car got broken into, our belonging were stolen and we had to spend extra money from our vacation fund to pay for damages. But overall this was a great stay!!!

It might not be the host's fault but I think it was sort of restrictive, most check ins are at 3 and check outs 11, if staying here check in is at 4 and check out at 9. The room I stayed in was cold as a breeze was coming through the gaps(that were not properly sealed) for the a/c unit  that is still here even though the weather outside is cold. There was also a name posted on my rooms door which made me wonder if I came to the right place when I arrived at this airbnb. It's also not allowed to have guests in or there is a 10 dollar fee even if they don't stay overnight I'm assuming. The place seems to be in a safe neighborhood that was important to me as I had to park my car. Also the hallway leading to the apartment had a strong unpleasant smell of food( the apartment I stayed in or the entrance to the building doesn't smell only the lobby and the hallway), I'm assuming somebody spilled food in the hallway or something. My plans changed and I wanted to make a change of the stay dates but there was a no refund policy even if you leave without using those days so I stayed to use the days that I paid for. Otherwise it is a good place if the only thing needed is a bed and bathroom for some nights.

This is a quaint accommodation that met basic needs but cannot be considered luxurious.  This was our temporary accommodation for 2 months as part of move to NYC and trying out the Brooklyn area.   Aesthetics: Nicely decorated with nice looking and good aesthetics but not always functional (e.g. chairs for dining table looks nice but not comfortable sitting on for extended period).  A mishmash of mainly Ikea furnishing with some possibly West Elm/CB2 furniture.  Bedrooms: The accommodation is not two separate two-bedrooms as there is one entrance to two sleeping alcoves.  One bedroom is sectioned off by curtains while another has a sliding door (small writing desk and bed).  The mattresses are Ikea on top of a raised platform and can be lumpy; pillows are also old and mishmash.  We had to request for darkening curtains as the pulldown shades did a poor job of keeping out the light.  Kitchen: Generally functional kitchen area that will meet your basic cooking needs but loose tiles underfoot.  Kitchen equipment (pots, pans, utensils etc.) are also Ikea.  The appliances are low-end Beko (gas stove that gave off a strong gas smell – not dangerous just some smell) but a decent LG fridge.  Also has a toaster, water kettle and coffee maker.  Bathroom: Nice large bathroom with a small deep soaking tub.  Water pressure is weak, showerhead was clogged and had to be fixed.  There are not many options for hanging towels, clothes etc. Most of the closets are in the bathroom.  Shampoo, Conditioner, Body Wash and Hand Wash were provided and re-supplied. Toilet paper(1-ply) was also re-supplied).  Shower curtain is well used.  Cleanliness: There was a layer of dust when we checked in and we felt more comfortable after a thorough wipe down and cleaning ourselves with our own Swiffer duster and wet sweeper.  Loose screws (leftover from furniture assemble) were in the closets in the bathroom and needed a proper wipe down. There is supposed to be a cleaner once a week to clean the general areas and remove the garbage but after two weeks in, the cleaner did not show up as we were the only guest.  We had to take out our own garbage weekly to the sidewalks (weekly collection) but there is a staff who will take out all garbage every two weeks.  There is a communal washing machine (free) that is handy but needed some cleaning before use.  Location: Walking distance and is close to business/shopping areas – very convenient to restaurants, butcher shop, and grocery stores.   Noise: The townhouse faces a large housing project area and popular basketball court.  At night, there is often loud music from vehicles parked on the streets and constant police presence is highly effective in deterring that (did not feel unsafe in the neighborhood.)  The townhouse is creaky, and you will hear your neighbors going in and out and up and down the stairs, talking etc.  Although we were lucky since the townhouse was only occupied probably the first two weeks we were there.  Other neighborhood noises like barking dogs early every morning; sirens etc (all the usual city noises.)  We had to purchase our own humidifier, bathroom rugs, knifes, cooking tongs, paper towels and a few other furnishings to make our two-month stay more comfortable.  The availability of “concierge services” to resolve issues (initial basic fixes to unit, blackout shades, missed snow removal) and online package deliveries to townhouse are available.  They were all highly responsive.  All in all, it was a good enough stay and we would recommend if you were staying slightly longer term and wanted the convenience of a kitchen with shared laundry.

We certainly enjoyed our stay at Amitai and Nicole's.  Great area with a lot of nearby amenities, great bars, never felt unsafe walking around. Also very convenient to have laundry in the basement! We stayed for a longer 7-week term. I think this place is better designed for shorter stays just due to the lack of storage space (no dressers, shoe rack, pretty bare in terms of kitchenware - however we LOVE to cook so all about perspective). But overall definitely a good experience! Would recommend to a fellow AirBnb renter. Nicole and Amitai were also very accommodating, and very quick to answer any of our concerns. Thank you for everything!!

This place is nice and cozy. Musa was a great host and was super patient with me when I had some outrageous demands (i had a panic attack) during my check in.   It’s in a great location. Walking distance from The Village and some great food spots!

Had a great experience, I was here for 20 days and had no issues with the apartment or the bathroom being outside the apartment. The apartment looked 100% like the listing. It was very clean & cozy, the shower was a good size and the refrigerator was big enough to store my snacks and leftovers. There are two restrooms (directly across the room) and one was always available. For the most part the bathroom was clean, just bring your own tp.   I was alone for most of the trip and never felt unsafe. My best friend did come to visit and stay a few nights and other than us having to share the one full length mirror while getting ready, there was enough space for both of us. She also commented that the futon wasn’t too bad to sleep on & there was an extra blanket & pillows in the closet that she used.   Anytime I had a question or concern Musa would respond within a couple of hours if not sooner. Overall I had a great experience here and would 100% book again!   Note: pack light! Don’t make the mistake I did by bringing a 50 pound luggage plus a carry and drag it up 3 very narrow long flights of stairs, it was exhausting.

If you want to stay in Gramercy and are only going to sleep in the unit, then go for it. I feel somewhat bad for only giving this place 3 stars. I can tell the host is a nice person and I don’t want this to affect their business but to be honest, this building is an old dump. Doors barely catch on their locks. Tiniest of tiny common bathrooms located at the end of a hall (I dont think the original listing even stated that it was not in the unit itself). Thick smell of smoke in hallways. Tons of bugs and flypaper dripping sticky fluid everywhere—but I get it, its hot and it’s summer in NYC. “Cozy” may be used as a euphemism here. The owner is definitely providing a deal for people wanting to stay in lower Manhattan, but I’m afraid I would not recommend it unless you are prepared to deal with what that entails. Other guest will likely not tolerate it, but I am a seasoned traveler so it was manageable.

Check in was easy, lock box with a key inside. Building is in bad shape. Stairs are a bit scary.  The unit was clean but small.  This is basically one step up from a hostel with outside of the unit toilet. Great location. 5 min walk to the metro and lots of restaurant around.  It worked for us but we travel back packer style.

Pros: This is a cute, minimal place to stay in an amazing location in Manhattan, for a great price! All the necessities you need if you’re just planning to use the apartment for a place to rest your head at night. Check-in and check-out instructions are clear and easy to follow. The toilet room is clean and hardly occupied. Just don’t forget your toilet paper each trip!  Cons: Our experience wasn’t ideal. We weren’t expecting/needing much, as we were only there to sleep and get ready to spend the day exploring the city. Anyway, after first opening the door to the apartment, day one, we were hit with an awful sulfur smell within the apartment. We didn’t think much of the smell at first, because the entire building didn’t smell great anyway. We just opened the window and tried to air out the place. The next day, the smell had got stronger. By that night, we were pretty sick. Headaches, sore throats and I blacked out and nearly fainted getting out of bed to use the bathroom. By then, we were worried for our health. It was 2 in the morning and I tried contacting the host to explain what was happening. Which it was late, so I understand the lack of response. But this was an emergency and we were fearing a gas leak and worried about our health and safety. So we called 911. They came and confirmed the gas stove within the apartment (which we hadn’t used), was indeed leaking gas into the apartment. They shut off gas to it and red tagged the stove. The fire department sent ConEdison (which I believe is the city gas company) as well. After they left, I sent a text to the host to update them on the situation. I received a text back around 10 the next morning from the host. They seemed upset that we had called the fire department. The host proceeded to tell me that I should have contacted them before calling out the fire department and they could have told us how to turn off gas to the stove. I responded that we were scared for our health and had no idea where the gas smell was coming from within the apartment. The thing that bothered us most, was the lack of concern for their guests. We were never asked if we were OK, even after explaining to them that the leak had led to us falling ill. All we were asked was “Is there a problem with your stay?”. We were just glad we never tried to use the stove or anything that could have led to something much worse happening!   Besides the above ordeal, our only complaints would have been the loud, popping noise the apartment made at night. And as other reviews have stated, the staircase is falling apart. Slanted and some steps are wobbly. Which, of course, the host has no control over. Just be aware and careful as you’re ascending!

The studio is very cute but the building as a whole is unsanitary, the stairs are crooked supported by metal bars which risk quickly collapsing. Cockroaches wander around the building and pass under our door eventually wandering into the room. The keys are handed over independently via a key box, very easy to access, however the host takes a long time to respond and informs us the day before how the keys will be handed over despite numerous requests from me. Quite a stressful trip.

Everything outlined is as expected! Location is perfect for those arriving and departing by Amtrak at the Penn Station. It is in close proximity to Time Square, Rockefeller plaza, restaurants, and is a steal!

This air bnb was highly overpriced compared to comparable air bnb in the area where you would get the entire place to yourself. The rooms were extremely small and not what I thought it to be. The manager on site threatened was obnoxiously knocking on our door at 11:30 pm for a “new” policy that was made 10 minutes ago. We asked what the policy was and she threatened us 5 times to call the cops for absolutely no reason. We ended up having to leave the same night because we felt VERY uncomfortable and scared to stay there . It was the biggest inconvenience ever as it was 1 am when we had to find new arrangements to stay in. I would not recommend this place at all. The manager is crazy and was making up stuff as she told it to us .

Melissa’s apartment was as wonderful as it is pictured. Right next to astoria’s most exotic restaurants. Just two blocks away from Subway. It is clean and the views are beautiful. The rooftop was a plus.  Definitely a steal for a couple getaway.

Very convenient for my personal needs. Just needed a safe place to sleep and cleanup. I was walking distance to my daughter’s co-op, convenience stores, drug stores, and the airport. Easy walk to transportation. Clean and safe.

Very good stay with our host José, despite the air conditioning in the building which broke down during our stay. José went out of his way to help us out and finally found us portable air conditioning. The apartment is located in the Bronx, right next to Yankees Stadium. The neighborhood is quiet and we never felt unsafe, the neighborhood is very nice especially when they notice your very “French” accent :-). 3 subway lines allow you to easily reach Manhattan. The equipment is complete and conforms to the description. I recommend.
Had an absolute blast here, amazing location and excellent cleanliness. If the price scares you don’t worry you get what you pay for. Amazing hosts with great communication ❤️

Although at first it was a little stressful that we had to wait 2 hours after the check in time, Adetunji was very kind and offered to pay for us to grab coffee while he finished cleaning at a local coffee shop. We were able to drop off our bags inside and take a short walk to the shops nearby.   The location is awesome! There are two grocery stores about 4 minutes walking distance, a pharmacy, McDonald’s, Dunkin and the J train. We were also able to walk about 20 minutes to a delicious bagel breakfast Knickerbocker Bagel almost every morning. You may take the train there but the walk is very nice. The area is great. The apartment is small but good to fit 5 people somewhat comfortable. Two beds and a futon. Access to Netflix & other paid apps. Backyard is nice to hang out at night and the apartment can get very cold with each room having its personal AC unit.  The master bedroom restroom is very small but the shower water temperature was the best there than the larger bathroom. We used the larger one to get ready and such.  A concern I had reading other reviews was the upstairs neighbors but surprisingly we didn’t hear them much at night when we did get back from our daily trips.   Overall it was good & easy to check in and check out.

Host was responsive but didn’t quite provide check-in instructions until asked. This place is in a great location, walking distance to a subway and some other stores. It’ll be a much more pleasant stay if it’s cleaner. The bed sheets and towels were pretty dirty and there are many flies around the house. The smell in the house is pretty unpleasant too. During our stay, we had trouble with water in 1 of the bathroom being extremely hot to take shower in. Overall, staying here wouldn’t be a problem if above issues are not something you worry about.

Didn't have a great experience here.   Pros:  Close to the station, lock on bedroom door and very effective A/C in the room.  Big bed and a desk in room.  The co-host Owl was easy to contact, friendly and let me into the building when I checked in.  Cons:  Unfortunately I had quite a few. - Communication: Micheal was out of town during/before my stay - good for him not so good for me.  My questions before arrival went unanswered for multiple days.  While traveling there I was worried I wouldn't be able to access the Airbnb as I had no check in details in advance.  Michael finally contacted me on the app right at the time of check in but then stopped replying again after he gave me Owl's details.   - Upstairs neighbour plays drums and woke me up a few mornings around 7am. - Shower wasn't working well - wouldn't switch between the tub tap and the shower head.  - Room was cleaned well before I arrived - floors were dirty, kept finding clumps of other peoples hair on my socks after walking around, stepped on someone else's nail clipping...  - Bathroom had no lock on door (with another separate AirBnB booking in the apartment this was a bit sketchy) - Bathroom wasn't clean - someones hair on sink and bathtub. - Had to buy my own toilet paper  - Trash in the bathroom and kitchen were both full to overflowing (bringing flies).   From other reviews it seems like when Michael is in town he does a better job of these things.  He was lovely on the phone when we did speak after the lock on the front door broke.  Maybe figure out if he will be in town before deciding to stay here.

I would come back to Michael’s place if I were staying for just a few nights, and/or just needed a place to crash at night. Location near the Q is very convenient, the room is quiet, and the price is relatively cheap. Most of all Michael is very communicative and nice. That said, here are some things to consider for anyone staying >3 days (I stayed for 2 weeks): - keep in mind the listing says no microwave, so you won’t be able to heat up any leftovers or frozen food. However Michael has said he is thinking about putting one in place at some point  -there was one night when I found a big roach in my room. Granted it was rainy and the building is very old. It’s NYC, so this isn’t shocking, but it did scare me when I saw it. Next morning though Michael’s cleaner came to spray the building with repellant. They were very responsive to my complaint and I appreciated that. - if you are planning to work/study at the Airbnb, the wifi at the unit is spotty. I had to take a remote online exam at my friend’s place instead of the Airbnb because the wifi was not reliable - be careful not to leave any crumbs on the desk, as the ants are very quick to form a line and find them. I left like two little crumbs on my desk after dinner, and within 30 mins I saw a bunch of ants going towards them. If your are neat and clean up after yourself immediately after eating, the ants won’t be an issue.  Those were the main issues I had during my stay. Overall though it was a high value Airbnb despite them. As I said, Michael is very kind and easy to communicate with, and honestly I think this is a great option for a temporary stay if you really just need a place to sleep at night in the city. I would just keep the above in mind if you are looking to stay more long-term.

The apartment is good for those traveling as a couple and don't need luxury. The internet is good and inside the cleaning is ok, the building and especially the common bathrooms could improve. The unpleasant smell comes from the common area and not from the apartment. I suggest that the person who cleans the apartment also cleans the window to make it more pleasant. The location is very good, close to everything. The host is very friendly, but there is a considerable delay in responding. The bed is comfortable and the bed linen is clean.

If you really want to be a New Yorker for a few days this is the best place to be. We drove, fortunately we found parking right next to the apartment. Nothing ever happened to our car during our stay. My wife and I would walk from the train station & back to the apartment and never felt unsafe. If you don’t bother people, people don’t bother you. Noise, will be a thing. So if you’re expecting quiet suburban stay, it’s not going to happen here. I’m a light sleeper, but I was so exhausted at the end of the day I was able to sleep through. Easy access into the apartment. Overall very welcoming, relaxed place to rest.

You can speak with Raymond in english and Spanish. The apartment looks better in person than in photos, it has 1 bedroom and a sofa-cama so I recommend this place for no more that 3 people. The neighborhood is super safe, I never felt in danger. There are markets near the apartment where you can buy food, drinks,  etc. The subway is just 8-10 mins walking, you can get to Manhattan in 30 mins on it. I would stay there again and the check-in + check-out was easy.  Thanks for the staying !!! 5 stars

Everything was very nice for the price.  I chose Hotel Hayden for it's price, location and rooftop bar.  After the fees mentioned in the description, the price was comparable to other deals in midtown (if you know where to look) but I love this location over other hotels.  You're surrounded by flower shops with the wares out on the street (even in winter), and you're out of the way enough not to be crowded, but close enough to get wherever you need to go. Subway stop right on the corner (red local).  Drug store on the corner too, which was a life saver with all the toiletries we forgot.  We go drink tickets for a beer and wine when we checked in, which was sweet.  Unfortunately when we got to the rooftop bar all the windows were fogged up, and we were quickly ushered back out.  Apparently it was reserved for a private party.  So be aware this could happen.  Restaurant downstairs serves as a substitute, but not why we chose this place.  Also there was no door in the shower, just a glass panel closing in half and half open.  Probably normal for hotels like this to avoid breakage, but felt very awkward.

I stayed here for 3 months and had a great time.   Pros: Location is excellent - about 5 min walk to both the south ferry and the Marcy train station, as well as a 10-15 min walk to north Williamsburg which has lots of restaurants, bars and shops. The building is well maintained, and I had lots of packages delivered there with no issue. Great high-speed internet, which I used to work from “home” 3 days a week. The unit is pretty quiet at night too. The best part of the place was the kitchen, which is updated and very well equipped - it was lovely to have a full sized fridge as well as a dishwasher! Shower works well and has lots of hot water. And the living room TV is big too.  Cons / things to keep in mind : the unit is on the ground floor. I never felt unsafe, it’s just something to note. The bedroom radiator can make quite the noise, but I usually turned it off anyway since the weather was getting warmer. The closest laundromat is a good 5 min walk. The bedroom and living room furniture could do with an update, it’s all clean, but just old. I ended up buying my own bedsheets and towels since I was there for 3 months anyway. Lastly, while the hanging space in the closet is large, there are no draws, so I ended up buying some temporary shelves to keep my smaller clothing items.  Last thing to note was that Martin a great host, and super responsive (usually responds within 30min-1hr)

This Airbnb is in a great location, very accessible to the subway and ferry. Martin and his brother were very responsive. The door knob is a little tricky and doesn’t open easily, once you get used to it, it’ll be fine! One of our packages got stolen in this apartment although the neighborhood felt very safe. We stayed there for a month and we felt that the kitchen had less utensils for a long stay. Martin and his brother are very friendly people and always ready to help!

Staying in New York is extremely stressful but Eli takes the sting out of that by offering a great place to stay for you and your family or friends. He’s there if you need him and will address any problem you might have right away. The place was clean and the appliances were new. He good at his job and you will feel good about staying with him. Thank you again Eli and nothing but the best my friend

The apartment is super well located and has a terrace— which likely is great for summer (it was too cold for us to use it). It is well decorated, and check in and communication with hosts goes smoothly. Our only complaint was that the problems we faced weren’t fully fixed— so much so, that we decided to leave early. In particular, we had mice in the unit and faced problems with the bathroom (it clogged). People were sent to look at both, we were told they were fixed, and again the problems emerged.  They sent new people who again said they were fixed, but we kept seeing mice and having the toilet clog. After this, we were on our own. We had to clean the floors filled with overflow, continually unclog the bathroom or go to restaurants just because we needed to use the toilet urgently… and buy Tupperwares to make sure that bread, etc were always sealed, convincing ourselves that mice were more scared of us than we of them and that this was an opportunity to get over phobias. So in short— location is awesome, decoration is great, and the hosts were responsive at first and somewhat tried to fix our issues. However, the apartment  l needs an extra push to ensure that things are properly fixed (and if you are scared of mice like I am, out of you are not the kind of person that can coexist with a couple cockroaches,  stay somewhere else! )

Nice tiny apartment with all the necessary amenities and a decent supply of cookware for extended stays. Best for solo travelers in my opinion. Very comfortable bed and pillows. As others have mentioned, there are cars that blast loud music as they sit at the traffic light outside the window; I found that it wasn't as loud in the night and morning as it was during the early evening, so it didn't affect my sleep much. There's lots of sunlight, a table for working, and the wifi is very fast and reliable -- 80mbps down, 45mbps up. I had minor issues with pests, but I was able to take care of them. Window locks could use some maintenance, but again nothing to worry about. The area around the train station about two blocks away is sketchy, but the street where the apartment is located felt pretty safe. I'd be happy to stay here again for the right price.

Nice studio, very clean, dishes and essentials are provided. I was there in December and it got pretty cold at night, but Erika provided a space heater.    A few other reviewers mentioned noise-- during rush hour it's pretty noisy outside (horns & music) but it gets quiet at night. The radiator does make noise when it switches on, and it's right beside the bed, but that sound didn't bother me.  I felt pretty safe walking around during the day/evening, but I don't know what the Little Guyana area is like at late night.  The A train is a little sketchy, I felt safer taking the Q10 bus up to the next station.   Overall, this is a great place to stay if you want to visit NYC on a budget!
One of the nicest AirBNB’s that I have stayed in. It’s clean, spacious and accessible by train! Literally a steal in NYC. I would recommend and would happily return!

Location is great and the place is fine for the cost! A bit shady having to get the keys from a distant lock box but it worked out. (Apparently that’s a thing in NYC) No problem with noise. Bring your own k-cups!

Carmen’s apartment design is the talk of the town: to state otherwise is to nit-pit and not appreciate the splendor thereof.   The place deserves 4.9, not 4.7.   We had multiple Airbnbs close out on us for a single day to place their families at for a single day, which caused severe stress for our trip up for my two people who are disabled. There were a myriad excuses on how it was our fault: those people should have taken their properties off the listings of this app.   Carmen was not any of the above paragraph. She was professional throughout the entire process and offered us an extra hour for check out complimentary so we weren’t freaking out catching our train.  Carmen is the epitome of a host. Everyone in New York should set by her example and take note at her splendor. Trust— I have a man and a woman who are nit picky when it comes to being a “clean space”: the entire scenario was clean.  #JustSaying
Inspirational but we’re homeless

The location is absolutely amazing. I wasn’t planning on spending much time inside so i wasn’t looking for an exceptional comfort and quality. I think the place is good, it has all you need (if shared bathroom in the hallway doesn’t scare you away), and   The host is very accommodating. The check in was very smooth and they let me drop off my bags before the official check in. They responded to my text about the wifi quick and made me felt like they were caring hosts.  I had no issues with the place. However, I’d mention that I could hear the neighbors well so if you are a very light sleeper you might want to grab some ear plugs. Overall, price and location make a fantastic combo in this case.

H was great with communication, and the location was a total steal. The shared bathrooms and shower were pretty clean, but extremely small. Our biggest issue was the bed - the mattress definitely needs to be changed. It felt like it dipped in the middle, creating an uneven surface. The apartment also had a strange smell, sort of like an old dollar bill. Would recommend for a one or two night stay max.

If you are looking for a clean, peaceful place to sleep/shower/recharge your batteries while visiting, you  won’t find a better listing. The location is perfect, the price is a steal, and the apartment is clean and quiet. Shared bathroom/shower are also clean and no noise from neighbors. All-around a as good as you’ll find.

accidentally booked for two and they were very accommodating and understanding since we brought a third. we were able to drop off our suitcases before our check-in time (which ended up being early) to explore the city. the location is super convenient, close to the subway, we were easily able to see everything on our list. overall amazing airbnb with everything we needed, such a steal too!! thank you so much :)

I was in there but I checked out before 2days   The person next door kept knocking on the door and shower room and restroom in outside, and so creepy so dirty  여기 진짜 존나더러워 화장실샤워실 전부 밖에잇음 옆방에서 벽치고 무슨 고시원같음

Place was clean— although I am very sensitive to scents and the plug ins used were extremely strong— I had to unplug all of them my first night. Location isn’t somewhere I felt safe walking around at night as a female. I walked from the subway to the Airbnb the first night and felt a little unsafe. I would likely try to stay a little closer to the water next time I go to Brooklyn as it’s quicker to get into Manhattan. However this is very close to jfk airport which is nice.

Shafeqa's accommodation was as described, peaceful even if at rare times we can hear the cars passing by and we sleep very well there. The bedding was so comfortable, worthy of a hotel! Quality sheets. The accommodation is secured by a code locking system so no hassle passing keys when you are in a group. Metro C is a 10-minute walk away (straight ahead) at night you don't feel in danger. To reach Times Square it takes 40 minutes. The heating was perfect, the shower very hot. Truly an incredible stay with Shafeqa who was a really pleasant host, and very caring! I recommend 100%.  Thank you Shafeqa for the welcome and the quality of the stay :)

Duration: 10 weeks in the summer  Reason: Housing during summer internship  The Local Stay's communication was GREAT, and they always responded in a timely manner and kept us updated throughout the duration of our stay! The property was very spacious and in a super convenient location that was near delicious restaurants and public transportation. The area felt very safe, and we never felt endangered by any means. Outside of providing more fans and cooling options, the property had plenty of cleaning supplies and other useful items for a long-term stay. The Roku was also a nice touch.  However, given that the property is a 5th floor walk-up, the steep and narrow walk to the property was pretty difficult. It was also incredibly hot, and there were weekends where we would come home from work and not stop sweating until we went back to work Monday morning. The property had 2 working ceiling fans, 2 window A/c units, and a box fan that we ran non-stop, but it still did not seem to make a difference. We were also disappointed to see that the property's dishwasher (highlighted in the listing description) did not work, and when we asked about getting it fixed, we were told "sorry for the confusion and that it is no longer under warranty." Not only did we have to hand wash dishes, but the dishwasher gradually started producing an unpleasant odor as our stay continued. Lastly, the shower was super weird and would randomly switch from scolding to frigid without any manual adjustments.  Overall, the property was affordable and suited our needs for the summer even if it was not exactly what we were looking for.

Terrible place. - Floor in the room is crooked, can’t sleep really well. Floor was all dusty when i checked in and the one and only curtain on the window was dirty and disgusting. I had to ask for a new one. - The host replaced the curtain after 2 days without asking permission to enter my room. I felt unsafe because they just entered my room without telling me and with all my things scattered all over the room. I just saw the new curtain when i got back from work.  - Anyone can enter the room by just sliding any card on the side of the doorknob.. so the keys from the host are practically useless. - There’s a cleaner once or twice a week for the apartment but the other people renting the other rooms are disgusting and dirty especially in the bathroom.  - I asked for a heater a lot of times. Host is taking too long to answer. He didn’t really bother answer to my messages. Good thing I found one heater in the storage room of the apartment. - There’s a built in heater inside the room but its now working and the temp control switch is nowhere to be found. - He’s fast to answer my messages when i asked if i can stay longer but i didn’t. I only stayed there for 3 weeks. I didn’t really finished my one month stay. - I don’t really recommend this place. I just had no choice since i am only staying for a month for a work training. - the only thing i liked in this place is the location. - subway and laundromat is just 3 minutes walk from the apt.

I stayed in Jen & Jay's apartment for 1 month and was really disappointed. Jen & Jay's communication was terrible. They didn't confirm the check-in details or address until the morning I was flying to NY, even though I had messaged them several times. I was relocating to NY and this added to the stress of the process.   The photos look nice - but the apartment is tired and the quality of the furniture is poor. And there were several issues.  - The bed frame was broken so the mattress was on the floor - The door handle to the bedroom was broken - There was a leak under the kitchen sink - The bathtub filled with water when I showered because the drain was blocked - When I tried to plunge the drain lots of black gunk would come up. Even after using a strong drain cleaner, the problems persisted - No batteries in the TV controls (took me ages to work out why the TV wouldn't turn on) - There were several dead plants in the apartment  - The lamp in the living space was broken  Working from the apartment was impossible due to maintenance work on the building and the building across the street. The noise from both meant that working from the apartment was impossible. I understand maintenance works need to happen, but I wasn't informed beforehand.   One day when I was working from the apartment there was a power outage in the apartment. Jay assured me he would contact the Super to fix the issue. But Jay's communication was terrible, I had to call him several times for an update. This resulted in him telling me at 10pm, whilst I was standing in a dark and cold apartment, he 'doesn't know what else to suggest'.   I told Jay I couldn't stay in the apartment and I would organise a hotel. Jay didn't offer any compensation and didn't even offer to pay for the hotel. The power was fixed the next day and I had to ask to be reimbursed for the hotel, which was only paid to me the day I checked out.   I never write bad reviews, but I was really unhappy staying here especially considering the cost of the apartment, all of the issues and poor communication.

I give this place three stars just for the location. It’s a good location near Hudson Yards, the High Line and a Whole Foods. It was nice to have Penn Station within walking distance, even though that area itself is disgusting. Even the block that the apartment is on has trash all over it, homeless people sleeping on mattresses, and a cannabis shop. The night noise will keep you awake if you’re a light sleeper. Sirens, car horns, people yelling all night long. I understand this is New York, so keep that in mind if you like quiet nights. But the apartment? Not great. I stayed here for 7 weeks. The check in process was fairly easy, but the cleanliness of the apartment was terrible. Stray hairs all over the bathroom and the coffee table. A squashed bug on the bathroom wall. Cut toenails on the bedroom floor. The refrigerator stunk so bad, I had to go out immediately and buy baking soda, which helped for the most part. The person who stayed here before me wrote that the heating didn’t work. Well, this was NOT fixed for my stay. Luckily there were only two nights where heat would have been nice. The remote didn’t have batteries. Again, a purchase I had to go make. I also had to go out and buy drano because like the person before me had written, the shower kept filling up with water because the drain wasn’t working. The place needs a paint job badly, the walls are all scuffed up. There were knick knacks all over the living room and kitchen that I had to put in a drawer. Not interested in other people’s clutter. The bed was just a mattress on the floor, not at all like what I saw in the pictures. Hopefully they’ll listen to what we’re saying in these reviews, because the place has potential.

Overall the place is located in what we think is one of the hottest spots ever in NYC, and that's great bc you can literally go around to the main suburban comercial areas in the city, and due to that reason we felt that's important to focus on the cleanliness of the bedroom and mostly shower which was really dirty when we arrived. Besides, the drainage wasn't working at all we had to clean the lots of bulky hairs stuck into the shower drain that made difficult for water to drain down correctly. We even had to also clean the bath ourselves so that at least we could feel at ease with what was advertised. Thankfully there were cleaning products in the vanity bath drawers. Also on the Airbnb ad was never posted that Greg wasn't going to be the live-in host, instead someone called Matt was going to be hosting (which was only communicated same date we arrived). Kind of making us feel skeptical and unsafe due to the lack of information and communication about important matters like that one, making us wonder the way this deal was handled  through the platform... In fact, Matt was never responsive to our questions or inquiries during our stay at all. The bedroom itself doesn't even live up to the pics posted on here, it didn't have plants, lamps and smelled really bad. Sadly we gotta say this was tasteless and unfaithful experience for such a high booking amount $$$.

A little dirty in the bathroom. The address listed isn’t the actual address which is sketchy. Matt, who was the person I was communicating with, was great. Responsive, help as needed and fairly friendly. Walkable to ESB, Times Square, MSG and Rockefeller centre.

Apartment itself is gorgeous. Love being up high. The view is spectacular, especially from the roof! Definitely go up there. Location was perfect, just a short walk to the nearest subway station. Street noise in the morning is significant, but kinda added to the “New York” ambiance for us. Nice touches. Comfy bed. Sparkling clean.   Beware of the parking. It is really bad. We arrived on a Sunday night and spent an hour searching for a spot, ended up a half mile away. We moved closer in the morning after more people headed to work. I understand it is what it is, just be prepared. Was a stressful way to start our stay.

The place was truly disgusting. Ants we're all over the kitchen and the rooms were damp and musty. Nothing was clean in the apartment, loose tools and equipment were lying around from the owner, and there was obviously construction occuring in the apartment. I chose not to stay overnight because of how gross and unsafe the place felt.
Scam listing. Resched the location and the doorman says they don't do Airbnb's. He tried directing me to another building which turned out to a consulate. Definitely a fake listing. Beware!

This place is just ok definitely not “luxury”.. booking this place months ago I didn’t see the recent reviews of the cold water. You would think she would’ve mentioned something to me but no, had to take a freezing cold shower all 3 nights of my stay. She claimed it was a broken part on the shower but the sinks don’t get hot either and somebody staying in the other unit complained about the cold water too. It’s a decent place, pretty close to the subway, ok price, good view of the bridge in the distance, not too sketchy, not too many restaurants to sit down unless you walk 10-15 mins one way, hair on the sheets when arrived with the pillows smelling like someone else’s head. I will say the bed was really comfy though. The place was decently clean, no bugs, the pictures are definitely not updated, all in all I think I could’ve found a nicer place for the same price and if you enjoy hot showers do not book this place

Great communication and hosts. Don’t be afraid to inbox them about anything, they’re friendly and willing to answer any questions or concerns you may have. The neighborhood was also better than i expected.

Djene is an amazing host. Shares detail information & directions. Answers all questions via messages & phone calls immediately. Apartment is spotless & rooms are spacious in a very nice park like setting. We felt very safe. The beds are very comfortable as is the living room furniture. Great water pressure for showers. Location is great - 1 block away from mass transits & restaurants, drug, grocery & liquor stores.

The stay has an extra heater you can plug in any room, and A/C units in each room in case you would like it hotter/colder! I loved that, they also have plenty of utensils and pots/pans for cooking use! The TV has Netflix, Hulu, and amazon prime included to watch all your fav movies/shows 🤩 it’s located on the second floor and the stairs are a bit wonky so if you are scared of that just be careful!

This spot is a steal for NYC (pricing, location, space).  The only thing I would mention is that the walls are extremely thin. We were able to hear the tenants upstairs as early as 6am. Not sure if the baby was running back and forth but that’s something to be aware off. You can hear every single footstep.   Besides that, the stay was great! France was extremely helpful and great at communication.

It is a small but functional place, it is a little removed from the main attractions of New York, it is a place where you can practically sleep, it is clean and tidy, the response to any questions from the host is quick I did not have any problems with the accommodation but the location seemed a little dangerous to me

Hosts need to be more transparent about who the hosts are. I was under the impression that I’d be hosted by either Daniel and/or Greg, but was surprised when I was told that I’d be hosted by Matt, who was not listed as a co-host at all when I saw the listing and made the reservation. This was not as concerning as when I was told the place was actually located in another building, not the one they had listed in my reservation. As for the actual place where I stayed, I would say that it overall needs better maintenance. Bathroom was dirty and there was a noticeable smell all throughout the place. The chair in my room was very dirty and there was some unpleasant clutter. The keys could have been better labeled, had trouble figuring out which was which for which doors.

4th Floor WITHOUT ELEVATOR, the stairs are in general bad conditions and cleaning. The reservation NOT REFUNDABLE, the cleaning of the BATHROOM NASTY, the pictures don’t correspond to the current status of the room. The smelt of the apartment is in general unpleasant.

Ana was really communicative and friendly. Check in process was low stress and Ana accommodated my late arrival. Room was super spacious, AC worked great. Location was lovely- quiet area of midtown, close to busses to the lower east side and trains.

George assistant Juan may ask you for a 400 dollar deposit when the maximum in the details is for 150. Someone is trying to scam the clients out of extra money. Why do you need a cash deposit. All of that should be included within the booking information. I had a hard time and I still having a hard time trying to reclaim my funds that I wasted since I did not stay on the property after being confirmed.

Antoine's place is perfect for someone visiting New York.  It's roomy, impeccable, and the host stayed in touch to ensure a positive stay.    He provided essentials that is so accommodating for guests.  It was a plus to be able to sit and relax in the back yard while the mature trees provided shade and kept us cool.  His hosting style exemplifies true hospitality.

This apt is very close to metro stops, drug stores, bars and restaurants.  As mentioned in the description, it does get noisy at night so if you are a light sleeper, this may not be the place for you.  Three flights of stairs.  Great communication with host....lockbox is across the street. Lots of graffitti on front door so look hard for address.  Apt was clean.  Host provided online list of activities/restaurants.   Living area a little worn...basically we used this as a place to sleep and spent most of our time exploring.

I stayed only one night even though i reserved four nights. The place is dirty, room is too small, i couldn’t even open my luggage. The area feels unsafe. For my check in I asked Esmeralda if she can come down to watch one of my begs until i bring the other upstairs (5th floor plus one more pair of stairs, no elevator) and she didn’t wanted. I canceled reservation first night,  paid her in cash and checked out in the morning. And one more thing, she told me that her husband drives taxi and that is $80 from JFK, while at the airport they told me that is flat rate $62 plus tax or fee (less than $70 all together. Wouldn’t recomend.

Greg was a great host and made sure we were well taken care of. I had an event in the Bronx and this was perfectly located for it. Came to the Boogie Down knowing it was going to be lively in ways I don't normally see in Minneapolis, but overall it was actually pretty quiet.   The apartment is on a bigger street in a residential neighborhood, so comes with everything you expect from that - bus stops on major routes, corner deli, daycare (right next door), Kennedy Fried Chicken (nah, son...), family-run restaurant, 2 nearby subway stops (Freeman Street was less than 10 minutes' walk - not an accessible stop, and has a tall stairway to reach the platform). Not very busy with traffic or noise, and enjoyed hearing the neighbors playing live music together on the weekend nights.  I know the Bronx has the reputation for being the wildest and most dangerous borough. We didn't see any of that during the stay, and we were moving around the Bronx and Harlem most of the time. Felt perfectly safe walking around during the day, and being on the block at night was just as chill. Probably advise using a cab when it gets late (about $4 from the subway stop to the door). Regular working-class neighborhood in a megacity. Stay alert and all should be good.   Will stay here again next time I need a spot uptown.

Excellent Airbnb, quality price. A little far from the city center but very close to the train, 7 minutes walking. At night it seems a little unsafe, but we had no problem. An excellent choice for the price of any kind. He let us CHECK-IN much earlier and CHECK-OUT much later than the related time.

We had a wonderful time. The location is a quiet, residential street with ample no-stress parking. The place was clean, with natural light coming in from all sides. The kitchen was well-stocked with everything we needed and in good quantity. It was a perfect, no-hassle stay booked at the last minute. Thank you very much, Larry!

I recommend this Apartment, it is very clean and had everything we needed, only negative point is the bed, it made some noisy during the night, but it was a great stay overall ! Gregory was very nice to us, the apartment is near the metro and I felt safe all the time in the region. I couldn’t find a place to park so I parked in a private parking lot for 20$ a day, streets of neighborhood are very dirty, but I didn’t feel it dangerous, it was all good for us! I also took the bus twice, because train lines were in maintenance, the buses are clean and very good, it’s not a problem at all to take the bus! It’s very easy to go to Manhattan taking the train!
Excellent location, space, and logistics. Very responsive and gracious hosts. Couldn't recommend more. A gem and a steal.

The apartment is in a great location and felt clean and spacious enough for  two people. Check in and out was a breeze. It’s kind of a strange place - a bit weird to sleep in a windowless basement. The only window to the outside in the whole place is right on the street and in front of the building’s trash cans so you have to keep the shade drawn. You can hear the upstairs neighbors talking and walking around so clearly it felt like we were all in the same apartment. Like I could clearly hear many of their conversations. But weirdest of all: when you’re sitting on the couch in the main room you can through a window see the neighbors come down the stairs from their apartment into the lobby of the building. And they of course can see you if the look at the right angle. So I felt a bit exposed.

This place was a great value for money. We were a couple visiting from Toronto during the week of July 4th.  The apartment itself was clean with no bugs, roaches or rats inside. We did see a lot on the street outside.  The bed was comfortable with clean sheets. We were also given two sets of towels but more would have been nice.  The temperature was in 90s and the air conditioning would take at least 30 mins to cool the space. The AC unit is placed away from the bed which we thought was inconvenient.  The apartment is about 4 mins walk from the subway station which is awesome. The Q train takes about 35 mins to the Times square/42nd st station and about 20 mins to the coney island. both ways was fantastic. The late night walk from the station to the apartment was somewhat safe. The street is well-lit and it looks like a peaceful neighbourhood. New York/Brooklyn are big cities and can be shady at times. There are three doors that we had to unlock and get in which made it feel safer inside the apartment. There is a convenience store and laundry right outside the subway station. We were given good walkthrough about the area, amenities and the apartment. A sheet of instructions was provided which was easy to follow and straight fwd.  The bathroom shower had mould and needed more cleaning. We did not use the kitchen sink, stove, or microwave. The fridge worked fine and we only used it to keep drinking water bottles.  With the AC unit running, you may not hear the train noise, but when in bathroom or kitchen you could hear it very clearly. Again, if you are light sleeper it can be a problem. Overall, it is a great value for your money. Very convenient and a big space.

Richard is a gracious host. I met him at our check-in and he is pleasant & professional. The neighborhood is quiet and safe. The apartment was clean. The window AC unit cools the place nicely (my husband and I were visiting at the end of May- first week of June).            Parking can be inconvenient if you have driven into the neighborhood. We were lucky that NYC Alternate Side Parking was suspended for the holiday (the end of Ramadan) -the car was parked in the shade at the end of the block & didn’t need to be moved during the three day stay.      The Q subway station is a close walk. Very convenient. We enjoyed traveling down to Coney Island to walk the boardwalk on a sunny day. On another day, we chose to walk through the Flatbush malls neighborhood and stroll past beautiful houses and gardens. Many of the houses have been featured in tv and film. I would recommend the Ox Tavern and nearby the Milk and Honey cafe for memorable meals.      The Q train does pass in front of the kitchen window (as another guest noted) but I enjoyed sitting at the kitchen table listening to the train while enjoying a morning coffee. The hallway from the kitchen, then bathroom to the bedroom offered enough sound barrier that sleeping was fine. This place is a great value and I would book again.

We stayed in this apartment for one week and were very pleased with it.  The location also was very good with grocery stores, drug stores and restaurants. The next train station heading to Manhattan is about 10 minutes by foot.  The apartment itself was very clean and well equipped. From a TV with a Chrome Cast up to charging cables for any device and travel guides for all NY sights. Also there was well working WIFI. There was one big bed with a mattress and 2 large comfortable and self inflatable airbeds.  The communication with Diana was very nice and she responds almost immediately. Also she was very flexible when it comes to the Check-In . She gave us good advice about the neighbourhood and tipps when going to manhattan.  We'd visit Dianas apartment again and we definately recommend her place!

Diana was amazing! We had a snow storm and she made sure to get my flight info in case I was delayed. We end up arriving late and she greeted us and made feel welcome after an stressful travel day. The place it self is as describe and close to the train and everything you’ll need.
Very good accommodation, lovely Michelle, the area is a bit dangerous

Diana was very accommodating with our check in and check out times which made our trip a lot less stressful. She was very good with communication as well. The neighborhood is very charming and we felt very safe walking around. The subway is a close walk away and takes you to manhattan in less than 20 mins. The neighborhood has a lot of good food options as well for late night eats. Would definitely stay again!

Michelle’s place is a gem! Location is very convenient, and the room is not only quiet but also has a great garden view! In addition, the rate is highly convenient. I’m afraid if I keep praising it, everybody will book it and I won’t easily find it available 😜

2 Words: Perfect Stay  --> great host (!), stylish & comfy apartment close to the subway, very clean room with a lot of small amenities, nice & calm but yet vibrant neighborhood - for us (a couple from Berlin, Germany) it was just perfect...  Tip: If you're scared of fish that stare at you: avoid Frank! ;)

This is truly a STEAL...not only is it so comfortable, and beautiful, but Jeffrey is a wonderful host who answered any questions we had right away. It's perfect! Even better than pictured, if you can believe that! lol! You're only a few blocks away from public transportation! Can't wait to come back and stay again, I highly recommend!
Great place, Jeffreys very thoughtful and the coolest host I've had so far.  The master bedroom is an absolute steal

It was as advertised, and Nicole was an awesome host. She constantly went out of her way to make sure we had everything we needed. The walk to the metro is quick and there's plenty of places to get stuff you might have forgotten within walking distance (5 minutes or so). The ONLY thing that wasn't expected was the amount of street trash...it's a pretty dirty neighberhood, but that's not Nicole fault. Having said that, we came and went early in the morning and late in the evenings and never felt unsafe, at all.

The apartment is large and very well located. The air conditioning was appreciated during the hot weather. Nicole gave very good advice regarding the neighborhood.  A shopping center and a large supermarket is nearby, as is the metro which is barely 5 minutes away on foot and the Yankees stadium 15 minutes away. Regarding the weak points, when we arrived, there was a very strong and unpleasant smell which remained all week (a week later, all our clothes and bags still smell very strongly). We then understood that this smell (sometimes unbearable) came from the dozens of anti-insect balls placed throughout the apartment. Added to this annoyance was the presence of numerous cockroaches (many small ones were hanging around in the bathroom, and other very large ones - the size of a thumb - were coming out of the kitchen). Nicole did not have a solution to offer us to resolve this problem other than emptying an anti-cockroach spray in the kitchen and the bathroom...this solution still kept the big cockroaches away for the last two nights but deprived us of a certain comfort. In conclusion, this apartment is good for one or two nights, and would be good in the longer term if this problem (of pests) was resolved.

This is a perfect place to be close to Manhattan (5min to subway and then some 20-40min depending where you need to be), have a spacious, private place that feels like home and have a good host available if/when you need her. Those who come from Europe and might be a little afraid to stay in Bronx- there is no reason to. It is just a usual living area, maybe not perfect but completely safe. Also close by you will find some interesting things to see- Yankee stadium and Zoo.

Nicole is responsive and very well organized.  The accommodation is pleasant, located on the 1st floor and not in the basement as the photos suggest.  The neighborhood is popular, we never felt unsafe.  The Target store 2 blocks away is ideal for shopping.  The metro is only a 5 minute walk maximum, even less.  You can reach the heart of Manhattan in just twenty minutes thanks to direct trains.  If the opportunity ever presents itself, I would not hesitate to rent from you again Nicole.

Cute little gem in the Bronx.  Although there are signs posted that it is in a quiet zone, evidently nobody pays attention to that as it can be a little noisy in the neighborhood.  I never felt unsafe and the walk to the metro was only a couple of blocks.  All in all, I had a lovely stay and would stay again if my travels take me to New York again.

We had a great experience at this rental unit. The check-in and check-out processes were easy (no-contact if you are concerned about that). Nicole communicated with us effectively and quickly responded when I messaged her. The unit itself was clean and looked like it was recently renovated. It was styled nicely. The bed was really comfortable, the water pressure was great, and the climate was comfortable. It was our first time visiting and staying in the Bronx, which was a little intimidating, but we never felt unsafe in the unit or the neighborhood. It’s only a 10 minute walk to Yankee Stadium and right around the corner from the subway station - very convenient! Nicole even allowed us to check in early so we could make it to an excursion we had booked. Overall, great experience. We would stay here again.

This apartment is seriously beautiful!!! The pictures really don’t do it justice. There is a private living room, kitchen, balcony, dining room, hallway, bedroom, and bathroom. Each section is so well decorated and updated. We had an amazing stay and the bed was super comfy. We will definitely be back! This is a steal!
