Unclean . Dirty upon arrival . Floor was completely oily and had to clean up ourselves because it was extremely unsafe trying walk around let alone bring up luggage through such a small space . She came off very unprofessional even when told about the oil everywhere and having to clean up ourselves and seems to be after money when you leave for cleaning that you will already be paying for that is set by her when first booking . If i could give her zeros I really would . Sheets don’t seem to have been washed at all nor the counters which had food left particles left from previous guest . She will be coming into stay while your there at night without being told until after you leave to say she’s locking a door that pre-locks which is very weird . Never again would I book her or this stay

Thank you to Mariam , she made my stay very smooth and stress free. She was only a phone text away and was very understanding and helpful. The home was exceptionally clean and very accurate to the images. I ended up staying longer :) I will definitely be back again !

Lovely space, stylish, great touches... that toilet.. hmmm, tried to steal it, just didn’t work. Go here, if nothing else, just to encounter THAT toilet, then thank me later.  Mariam and Vika are on a mission to make you fat, they give you Yummly chocolate. Will stay again.

This airbnb was extremely clean and a super steal for NYC. We really enjoyed our stay here and the room is clearly well maintained. The only reason we took off a star was because the water in the shower does not get hot- only warm (this did not bother us much since we were visiting during a warmer month but may bother those in the winter) and we were unsure of how to use the AC. It would be helpful to have directions to use the AC printed and taped above the thermostat. Overall, nice place to say in a beautiful neighborhood. A bit far from the subway (~20 min walking) but not too bad.

Vika & Josh's place in Brooklyn felt very secure in Brooklyn which I really liked. Plus I liked the ease of only needing to know some door codes rather than carrying keys around and worrying about losing them. As a foreigner I wasn't sure how concerned to be about the neighbourhood but after a conversation with Vika I felt like I didn't need to worry - she has never had a problem in 4 years of living here, and there is a police station close by which deters crime. The room is small but cosy and has all you really need. Also the laminated directions & local tips were a nice touch. Airconditioning unit in the warmer months is a bit noisy and means you can't open the window to let a breeze in, but as it got very warm during my stay I was grateful for the aircon! The shared bathroom is modern and I almost never had to wait to use it. All in all I would recommend Vika & Josh's place to anyone wanting to stay in Brooklyn, it was great.

Chester’s place was amazing and in a great location! Once we figured out how the subway worked, it was easy to get to the city. If I had any questions before, he was quick to respond in detail. It was also very nice that he had a binder including instructions on how to get around. When we were greeted, he was extremely friendly and even showed us around the house and provided extra amenities like soap, toothbrushes, and coffee. The street is very nice and quiet, however the area around it isn’t the best, but my friends and I never really felt unsafe, especially because Chester lives on site. The place was extremely clean and looks even better than it does on the pictures. Overall, especially because of the amazing price, I would stay here again!

Josh and Vika deserve all the superlatives in previous reviews of their listings. I spent four weeks at their home in Brooklyn, and couldn't be happier with my choice. The room itself was small, yes, but pretty and perfectly functional with enough space to stretch/do floor exercises. The bed was comfortable and there was plenty of storage space. The house is well-connected with the J train very close, the M train a fifteen-minute walk away, and a number of buses with stops around the corner. A small number of reviewers mentioned feeling that the neighborhood was sketchy, and while I shared this concern for the first few days, it wore off after that. I think this was because there are a number of folks who spend time outdoors in the neighborhood seemingly not doing anything, but I soon realized that they were not interested in passers-by and I found that if I said hello, they would invariably return the greeting, sometimes very cheerfully. Josh and Vika themselves were welcoming and very easy to communicate with right from the beginning. They are both kind people and skilled hosts, who know how to be attentive without crowding you. They went above and beyond to make me comfortable - including going to the trouble of placing a desk and monitor in my room when I mentioned that I'd be working a lot! They were also full of good advice for how to navigate the city in every way. I enjoyed their large collection of teas, and spent happy hours reading over good coffee at an unpretentious neighborhood cafe, Cup of Brooklyn, recommended by Vika. In summary: a beautiful home and fantastic hosts in a neighborhood with a down-to-earth, very personal vibe. This is definitely a place I'd be happy to return to in the future, and that I recommend whole-heartedly to others.

Najah is very sweet and helpful. Her place is very clean, nice and located in the heart of El Barrio. I would recommend this neighborhood for someone who wants to meet real NY locals (this neighborhood hasn’t been totally gentrified....YET!). There are many delicious and authentic latin food options and the 6 train is three blocks away for easy access to downtown or The Bronx. This area is also very quiet and peaceful at night compared to areas downtown. Although Najah and I encountered some stress when I accidentally lost her keys, she was kind enough to leave me copies even though she had to catch a flight. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a true Harlem experience.

Sebastian was such a great host.From before arriving to the day I left he helped me navigate the stressful city.The place was so cool and inviting.I was able to get good sleep at night and be at peace.I wanted to stay the entire time but for unseen reasons I had to go.But once again I highly recommend this place.

There was good communication with the host prior to our arrival, and we didn’t have to wait to gain access to the apartment. The space is very cozy with plenty of space, perfect for friends traveling together. The beds were comfortable, the bathroom was clean, and the kitchen is good for preparing meals when dining out gets expensive. The apartment is in close proximity to a nice grocery store and two subway stations. The area is nice and we experienced no problems coming back from the city at night after some drinks, however the Atlantic Ave station seems sketchy when dark out. Again we had no issues when traveling to and from the city during our week stay. I would definitely recommend staying here if traveling to New York.

I checked in Chester’s AirBnB around 4:30 or so. When going inside I immediately noticed no hand rails on his 4 flights of stairs and I’m disabled. So it’s not handicap accessible (which handrails are apart of the health and safety code). Without handrails the stairs are extremely dangerous. Furthermore we never got a chance to utilize the unit, because of an unforeseen event and I had to go to the emergency room and had to take the earliest flight home at 6:00am that upcoming morning. So I spent the whole night at the hospital never using the AirBnB. While in the emergency room I texted and called Chester multiple times to inform him of my situation and if I could get a refund, because we never used his place. But Chester wouldn’t give me a refund. Also, the surrounding area doesn’t seem safe so be aware. And please please please read ever description when dealing with Chester. If a unforeseen situation occurs don’t expect your money back dealing with him.

Ociel and Karla are amazing hosts! We loved their house and it really felt like home. We were a bit afraid of the location because so many people say the Bronx can be dangerous - do not listen to them! We were 20 minutes from the center, the Bronx is a place full of amazing restaurants, friendly people and after a couple of days people from the neighborhood were even saying "hello" to us, we absolutely loved it and will come back for sure! About the apartment: super clean, great bathroom and kitchen. Ociel gave us super nice towels, the room had a mini fridge, air con, and even a TV with Netflix! The room has no windows, only a skylight, that can be a bit annoying in the morning due to the direct light, but nothing an eye mask cannot solve!  Also, the price was a steal! Thank you Ociel and Karla!! Gracias!!

Our accommodation at Ociel and Karla's house was excellent!! We stayed for 10 days with my partner and the truth was that everything was perfect, from the day we arrived Ociel and Karla provided us with a very pleasant atmosphere, always being very attentive to every detail, they are a couple with 2 very nice small children.  The truth is that when we were looking for accommodation you were a little afraid of the area since I had heard that the Bronx is not very good, but the truth is that we were pleasantly surprised, the area is very residential close to a couple of schools which makes it very, very quiet and exactly 3 minutes walk from a subway station that allows you connectivity to any part of NY you go.  Our room had a fairly comfortable 2-seater bed, and the bathroom that was shared was always clean. As for the kitchen, the fact that we could cook made our stay much easier, and Karla and Ociel made all the utensils in the kitchen available.  We certainly hope to return to NY and clearly will hesitate to stay with Ociel and Karla again.

Accommodation met our expectations. We were looking for a room to just sleep and we spent all our time in the city. We didn't need to cook or use wifi to a greater extent (which was quite unstable, but it was enough for our purposes). So we were more or less satisfied. The room is part of a 4-room apartment and is very spacious. The windows are located in a quite noisy street, but in a few days we got used to it and we slept well. The bed is comfortable, but for two smaller (shorter) than we are used to from Europe. The only more unpleasant thing during the whole stay was the broken regulation of the water temperature in the bathroom, so that either icy or hot water flowed and just a little normal water in the meantime. After 14 days it was a bit uncomfortable and I can imagine that it would be a big problem for someone. Genae was helpful in everything she could and actively dealt with the necessary things with me through whatapp. She helped us plan our trip to the accommodation and on the last day she allowed us to stay in the room until the afternoon, for which we are very grateful. Thank you! Linda and Marek

Our stay with Ociel and Karla in NY was wonderful!! They were always attentive to help us.  Excellent location.  Around the corner from shops where we could buy things for breakfast, plus restaurants and places like dunkin donuts, Baskin Robbins.  Subway line 6 is a 4 minute walk and takes you to all the important sites in Manhattan!  I had my doubts about the area, but it was always safe to walk even late at night and with a eleven years boy. Although, sometimes you saw people wearing strange clothes but It was never unsafe.  The house was clean and comfortable. Room with fridge, microwave, hair dryer.  Hot water at the shower.  Also, on the last day we had a busy schedule (we were only in New York for 5 days) and Ociel kindly allowed us to store our bags and did not want to receive money.  I highly recommend staying with them, you will not regret it!  thank you for making it possible to have a good place to stay!

At first glance, the neighborhood may seem dangerous, but that's not the case. During our stay, we didn't have any problems with returning home late or carrying our cell phone on the street, so don't worry about that. Regarding the room, it is equipped as described in the advertisement, but there is no access to plates, bowls or eating utensils, so you should take this into account if you want to eat something in the residence. However, it does have a microwave and refrigerator. The piece may seem a little tight. The bathroom is shared, so it is recommended to get up early so that it is not busy or dirty. The house is located in a location with very good access to transportation, it is only a 3-minute walk to the subway, it is recommended to use this instead of the buses (at least in the Bronx area). On the other hand, Ociel is always present and has very good will, so if you need anything, do not hesitate to turn to him.
The room fulfills the function. The connectivity is very good, at first it may seem like a dangerous neighborhood but it is very quiet
The deal with Ociel and the location of the house were very good, even though it is in the Bronx, that area is not very dangerous.

the host is very nice and kind.  good communication and smooth check in the room we stayed in was extremely small and we didn't find it value for money there was noise from across the wall as there was a toilet  there the room was extremely small and bathroom shared amongst 4 rooms the location is close to subway station but the area is a little shady after dark

Reaaaally cool house. They’ve got this window on the roof allowing natural light to light up the space. Everything’s really stylish and modern in design. The location is good, close to grand central and fifth avenue. Prompt response to messages. The only drawback might be the fact that the building’s quite old. The laundry’s in a shabby corner of a basement and the elevator’s kinda creepy. But overall, very cozy

Ben's accommodation is very well decorated and laid out (we didn't expect such a surface area when seeing the photos)! A metro 300m away allows us to reach Manhattan in 20 minutes or Times Square in 30 minutes. A larger station is located 900m away and has more lines to reach less touristy places.  Close to a very busy avenue (on the right when leaving the apartment). Discovery a little late for us (we arrived on the other side) so we pass on the information ;) Big downside however on the cleanliness of the accommodation: constant unpleasant smell (in the apartment but also on the towels and sheets), omnipresent dust, bathroom which does not seem to have been cleaned before our arrival and a bathtub and a sink with major drainage problems...

DO NOT STAY HERE! I cannot stress enough how much you should not book this filthy, weird place. Before I get into this weird ex raver abandoned space BE WARNED THE OWNER IS MENTALLY UNSTABLE. She claimed neighbors told her my husband and I had a party? Uhhhhh we were barely in the unit and the whole place is other AIRBNBS so what neighbors? She was combative and a liar. In fact,  she continues to spin tales about her space and her “cleaner”. The “stocked” kitchen has two disgusting pans and three mason jars. Need a spoon? Not likely. The photos must have been taken YEARS ago as the place has half the furnishings and calling what is there “shabby” would be generous. It’s obvious she has lived there or been there in years. There is also NO HEAT. When we asked about this, she told us she lives abroad and “doesn’t keep track or the weather in New York”. What that has to do with the lack of heat is beyond me but there you go. We wanted accommodations for us and our puppy to visit our best friends and paid a premium for it for a gross and argumentative weekend. Disgusting.

everything was cool and normal with the air bnb as far as the essentials. but am i the only one thinking the painting and vibe was a bit creepy.  checked in at night, spooky.  day time was nice though.  sweet host.
Alex & Yoly’s place is a absolute steal!! Their apartment gives you a little sample of what it’s like to live in NY and it’s awesome!

Friday is a friendly guy and check in was super easy. The place is a bit run down but totally adequate. The neighborhood is a little sketchy at night. The caribbean restaurant down the street is great... by far the best food we found in the neighborhood.

Unsafe location   bed is so noise  mattress  is  bad conditions pillow is soft n good  no utensils  like forks  knife. No kettle to make hot water   good things  no parking problem  .apartment is so  silence   but   every 15 min police sirens  apartment smells 👎

A charming undertaking of a DIY shabby chic apartment on the ground floor of the historic brownstone in the quiet part of vibrant up-and-coming Bed-Stuy. A/C kept the temperature perfect throughout the heat of NYC summer. Stylish bathroom with a tub was one of my main reasons to stay in this AirBnB. The kitchen was equipped with everything for making a nice dinner. The gem of the property is a secret romantically overgrown garden, providing shade and relaxing green space.  The hosts were very helpful, leaving a ton of useful tips prior to our stay. We greatly enjoyed the jazz place they recommended, that was just eight minutes walk from the apartment. We felt very comfortable in the space and inspired by the neighborhood. Overall, a great stay!

We wanted a few days of “staycation” to be quiet and calm after such a stressful last 6 months. Julia’s place was perfect, like being in a warm and inviting cocoon. Stylish and comfortable, we enjoyed our stay!

Julia was warm and friendly, and very responsive to our messages during our stay. There was a strong, unpleasant smell in the apartment though that wasn’t mentioned in any other reviews. We think it was coming from the mold in the bathroom, which is rotting out the wooden shower structure. Unfortunately, although the apartment was fine overall and in a good location near to the train and a few good restaurants, we wouldn’t stay here again.

Unfortunately, this AirBnB did not meet our expectations. Although Peiyi  seemed to be really nice (we did not meet her personally) and quickly responded to us, we did not feel comfortable at her place: The neighborhood was a bit sketchy, it was extremely loud at night (she did provide earplugs though) and the bed sheets did not appear to be washed. We also only got cold water in the shower.

Had an awesome stay here!!  Peiyi is a gracious host and the apartment has everything you need. As others have noted, the neighbourhood can feel a bit sketchy, especially late at night (we never had any actual safety issues though), and there is street noise in the bedroom. If those are deal breakers for you, this place might not be for you. If you can get over those two things, this place is an absolutely amazing deal.

We were lucky to get in earlier check in as well as an option for a later check out. She was very communicative which is her best perk. She will always contact you back with any remarks. Although, the window in the living room was broken as the wind would easily swing it open making the room cold. Also, there being suspicious stains of fingerprints on the door and red marks on the floor. Otherwise, it was a pleasant stay and worth for what we were intending in having for our trip.

well the host never answer the phone only messages through airbnb. very bad communication when all you can do is text. also I was accuse of stealing from this host when I do airbnb every weekend so travelers be careful here.

How can I start.   If your okay with homeless, crack head people  around you and being around a rough neighborhood that makes you feel like something is going to happen to you then this the place for you. The value of the place was okay. Definitely not coming back here. I was very surprise by location.   The place inside was okay and beds were very Comfortable.

Great for a short stay, not so much a long one. My partner and I stayed here for two weeks. The place is clean, cozy, and checkin was so so easy. It's in a great location, close to a subway station with a train that goes to manhattan, and a bus that will take you to the junction. It's super convenient, lots of little bodegas within a block or two, lots of great local Haitian restaurants. I was never able to find the lounge downstairs listed in the pictures, although there was one night that it sounded like a bar was open late into the night, but it was only one night (Tuesday, for some reason) which was fine because my partner doesn't sleep well with background noise. But the unpredictable nature of the noise is something to consider.  Now for the place itself: like the reviews and site say, Jude was super accomodating and responsive. I messaged them before boarding my flight to ask a question, in the middle of the night for them, and they still responded. The place was super clean, and the residents of the building and the cleaning staff was super nice and helpful (the cleaning guy helped us figure out how to use the door, even). The air conditioner was a life-saver in the humidity of New York in July. The most disappointing part was, honestly, the kitchen amenities. Like I said, it would be perfect for a short vacation with lots of eating out and not much cooking. However, for money's sake, we decided we would cook most nights so as to avoid spending more than necessary on an already-expensive vacation. There were only 3-5 forks (I don't remember the exact number, sorry) and two glasses; there were plenty of pots and pans, even an egg pan and a grilled cheese pan, however the more-used pieces were flaking non-stick coating into our food. However, the knife that was in the drawer was nearly unusable, as the blade kept popping out of the handle and it was dull enough to be used in a middle school culinary class. We ended up buying a cheap knife from Target just so we could cut things. In addition, despite the listing saying "basic cooking supplies such as salt and pepper" my partner and I had to buy all our cooking supplies such as salt, pepper, oil, and other non-perishable cooking supplies. Additionally, the oven was broken (specifically because the interface with the buttons was broken, so the stovetop worked but the oven did not) and the part was on back-order, which isn't Jude's fault, but we only found out when we messaged them to alert them, despite the problem happening while the last group was staying. I would have preferred it if Jude had alerted us before we checked in, so we didn't buy flour and sugar and other supplies that can really only be used with an oven.  Altogether, despite the long review, these problems were mostly details that didn't make the place unlivable or even unpleasant. Mostly they were small inconveniences and I want to alert anyone else who might want to stay here for any extended period of time what to expect. This was my first time booking an airbnb, and altogether I think my experience was pretty positive, and Jude was a good host.

While the place itself was clean and tidy (as shown in pictures), the neighborhood felt very unsafe. We had a hard time accessing our unit, because there was a group of people blocking the door, screaming and fighting. Once inside, we were still able to hear the people outside yelling, and decided to cancel and find somewhere else to stay. We did not know the city well, and relied on Peiyi’s high ratings and reviews on air bnb, but were very disappointed when we arrived. She would not even refund us for the second night, even though it was reposted and we left without staying a single night there.

Bruce and Suzanne's apartment is gorgeous and every bit as beautiful as it appears on the website. It is clean, all of the amenities work without a glitch and the neighborhood is interesting and vibrant. We traveled as a family and even as a mom out on my own with my daughter after sunset, we never felt unsafe. The subway connection at 175th Street is incredibly convenient -- it is literally just 4 stops on the express line to Columbus Circle. Bruce and Suzanne's hospitality is exceptional: clear directions, quick responses, easy check-in and out and very warm welcome. I can only recommend a stay at their place and hope we'll have the chance to do so again in the future.

This place is incredible! 2 br, 2 bath, right next to the A line, and everything you ever need was provided. not to mention the apt is spacious and beautiful. even tho we didn't need it, a city guide was also provided. note that a questionnaire is given before the stay so the hosts knows how to best accommodate you. this is a steal, don't miss out!

Guys/Gals where do I begin. This is home sweet home.🏡 Anyone reading this review, Book book book!!!! Walking through the front door alone in a breath of fresh air. The patio makes you feel liks you're in the carribean, such a beautiful  perfect garden. This place is the perfect getaway and place to de-stress. Its so serene, peaceful and relaxing. The host MS. MARLYN IS A SWEET HEART❤️  Best airbnb ever, and mi nah ask christ! 🇯🇲

This was my first experience for Air B&B and I have to say that Allan and Tawanna's place have now set the precedent for me! I was travelling to New York for the first time and also travelling solo so was a little anxious however any questions I had regarding my trip were answered promptly by Tawanna her communication is again second to none!   I didn't have the pleasure of meeting Tawanna however it didn't make a difference as I practically communicated with her every day until I was at the airport and on my way back home!  I did have the good grace to meet Allan who's bubbly personality and cheerfulness actually made me crack a smile after travelling for half a day,  missing my plane and waiting for a delayed flight!  These guys do whatever it takes to accommodate you, Tawanna even offered to have me picked up at the train station to save me from pulling my case such is the care and attention that is given to each guest.   The rooms are exactly how the pictures look and my room was airy and very clean with a fresh supply of towels, flannels even little miniature creams a toothbrush and toothpaste.  I have stayed in a lot of hotel rooms  from 5 to 3 stars and I have to say that this little B&B has an extra touch of care as you can feel the comfort as soon as you step into each room.   The room is airy and has a ceiling fan as well as a desk fan and the art work on the wall gives the room a therapeutic feel,  it was nice just sitting by the open window or lying on the bed and listening to the sound of reggaeton  flowing in with the ceiling fan blowing around a warm breeze of New York in the fall.   The bathroom on my level was always clean however I have to stress that when you are staying in accommodations where it is shared bathroom it is important to keep the area clean after use especially when you can see the hard work that the host has put in to keep you happy it is only right to respect their space too.  The beautiful brownstone building is in a very good location where you can jump on the  Metro to Times Square and be there within 20mins, or get the bus to the Bronx in 30mins. If the idea of travelling by public transport is not your cup of tea then an uber from this location to Manhattan is around $10-15 dollars. There are also a spread of vegan cafes, pubs and restaurants that host breakfast brunch and sushi depending on your tastebuds literally around the corner.   I would say the neighbourhood is very safe and I travelled alone late night throughout my trip and always felt confident both on my own and with the locals.   I would most definitely book with Allan and Tawanna again and hopefully look forward to be staying with them real soon!   Thank you both for such a pleasant experience.
The neighborhood feels a little unsafe.

Beautiful appartment, well located with an easy access to the subway lines. Free parking in the street in front of the building. Perfect for a single person or a couple that want to enjoy the beauty of NYC without the stress of driving in town.  We highly recommend!

very nice stay at Jay's :) we had a little stress at the beginning because the nearest metro station was closed for work and unfortunately we didn't know it and arrived in the middle of the night. The apartment is large, equipped with the minimum necessary (maybe add cutlery like small spoons for coffee) and Jay had filled the fridge with bottles of water which is very much appreciated arriving like us in the middle of the night with 35°C outside ^^' There is a very practical laundromat nearby (2 minutes walk) and a large connected TV (this was not specified in the ad so we were very pleasantly surprised). Even with the metro station closed we had another one just 10 minutes away on foot and a bus stop just 1 minute away which is quite well served :) I recommend 100%. Just a very small downside (but I think that this is not linked to the apartment but to the American way of life because we have noticed it elsewhere): the bedroom windows give off a lot of light (at 5 a.m. it was like broad daylight) because there are no curtains and just blinds that do not protect from the light, so you have to bring an "eye patch" if, like me, the light prevents you from sleeping ^^

I had a friend visiting me from Seattle and my house, which I also Air BnB, was occupied, so we rented Melissa’s room. Unfortunately, I have to write this bad review and voice the conditions of this Air BnB.  Melissa's communication was great, and we asked for an early check-in, but were denied because there was a guest still there. When we entered the apartment 1.5 hours after our check-in time, the room was still not cleaned. Her roommate came out when we entered the apartment and said he was going to change the sheets. The room itself was not going to be cleaned. I almost threw up in my mouth. So, guests literally left a few hours before we checked in, we told Melissa we were headed over and the place wasn’t cleaned even after our slated check-in time, and the roommates' attempt to clean involved just changing sheets?? As an Air BnB host, I was appalled and drove away extremely disappointed and disgusted.  Additionally, when I parked my car outside, I felt very unsafe. This is still Brooklyn, and not a gentrified neighborhood, so when my car was surrounded by 8 men standing outside a building, I realized I did not feel safe in that neighborhood.  I would not recommend this Air BnB at all.

Positives:  You can expect to see exactly what the pictures look like!  Great view, you can walk to almost everywhere.  It's a good location and the building is nice, esp if you want a pool and gym area. Train is a few blocks away, uber picks you up across the street.  Negatives:  You have to live out of your suitcase because there is not any room in the closet and there is not any dresser for you to use.  This is actually Matt's apartment he is renting out and it is jammed packed with all their belongings.  Very uncomfortable and creepy.  There was not any "private" area for guests in this whole place- if it were a 2 bedroom then at least you'd have some privacy. There is pet hair everywhere - we did not have wi-fi the whole time we were there - we were told to say we were friends while checking in, and don't say anything about airbnb because they don't like it.   This was told to us when we went to check in.  Really?  I think this is prohibited in this complex.  We were supplied 1 towel each for 5 days.  The bathroom didn't even have a hand towel to use and forget about face towels, they don't exist - Matt told me he doesn't use them so I guess he figured nobody else does either!   So, if you book Matt's apartment,  just know your moving literally into HIS home - there is no room for you to unpack your own things.  This was uncomfortable for us.  We traveled many times using airbnb and vrbo with no issues - this place has issues I'm sorry to say.

This apartment is so chic and perfect for a girl's weekend with my sister. We each had our own beds and the sheets were soft and amazing. I'd actually love to know where to purchase a set of these sheets for my apartment back home.  We visited on such a warm weekend, and being from Colorado I'm not used to the humidity, so the AC at night was a god-send. There's also a cute little courtyard in the back filled with green trees and birds singing and there were people enjoying conversations out on their patios, which all felt very cozy and European.   We were right near Soho which is dangerous for the wallet but so fun - there was a ton of shopping and cute places to grab wine on the patio. I'm obsessed and recommending all my friends to stay down here next time they're in town for work.

We originally stayed downstairs in the Sol apartment and loved it so much that when our trip to NYC got extended we asked if they had any other rooms available. Little did we know that the Penthouse was open for the extra night of our stay! Usually it's a four-day stay but we lucked into there being a gap-night between longer visitors and the management was so welcoming and accommodating. Brian understood how stressful traveling could be and went out of  his way to make sure we were set with accommodations (whether with them or elsewhere).   As for the space:  I'm obsessed with this apartment. There are three bedrooms and two bathrooms downstairs, hair dryers, irons, and a full washer and dryer (which came in handy when I spilled coffee on my only t-shirt that morning).  The entire upstairs is a great common space with a GORGEOUS kitchen/dining room/ and deck area. It's absolutely luxurious. We actually stayed in for a night and ordered delivery so we could enjoy the deck space more.  I cannot say enough good things about this place. The apartment was cozy but spacious, and we felt like we were in our own little NYC bubble. The neighborhood is busy, but not swamped with tourists like where I usually end up staying for work. Two of the bedrooms face a private courtyard and it's absolutely silent when you're ready for sleep. I'm definitely booking this for my next work trip to the city and would recommend it to anyone who needs a central location but enjoys having a little more space than a standard hotel.   Thanks again East Village Apartments!

This was the best AirBnB stay I have ever had!!!! The hosts were responsive, caring, and lovely to work with. Our TV had an issue and it was immediately fixed by the nicest super in the world, all our requests and questions were answered immediately. The place is beautiful, it so exceeded my expectations of the photos, it is a light filled spacious apartment. I stayed there for almost a month for work and everything was perfect. Shopping in the neighborhood is accessible, it is close to subways, there are great restaurants, etc. It is perfect for a group of 5-6 (couples included). The amenities are exceptional , the kitchen has everything you need to cook and have small intimate dinners, the bathroom has a a large tub and both bathrooms have steam accessibility.They provide you with umbrellas, iron and ironing board, a shopping cart to go get food, it has a laundry and dryer (for my long stay that was key!)  I really can't say enough about how great the place is- some of the days in February were 60 degrees so I was able to use the terrace as well and I definitely want to come back in the spring/ summer sometime. I loved the layout of the place , the bedrooms are on one floor so those who are late sleepers have quiet , and the kitchen living area, terrace is on the top floor. The heat was great in February and I am always cold. The wifi is high speed which for my work is essential. The beds are great to sleep in , it is quiet and sometimes in the morning you hear birds chirping in the garden so you feel like you are not even in the city. It is the east village so it has the flavor of old New York, there are some characters on the street but I always felt safe and completely alright. It is a two floor walk up , and I am 58 and had no problem at all, my husband who needs a knee replacement and has knee pain was also was fine. In terms of two floor walk ups too it is not steep or super long staircases like some buildings in NYC I have been in. Clean clean clean too! There is a woman who comes to clean weekly and she is amazing and so kind- we loved her. This is a beautiful Airbnb , I am scared to say too much for fear of  it getting overbooked but I like the people who run it so much I want to say it as it is . FANTASTIC AIRBnB!!!!
Very clean and great location for people staying in flushing. Only thing for me was when the neighbor cook food, our apt got filled with unpleasant smell.

My daughter and I recently visited NYC for 9 days over Christmas and New Year's Eve and had a perfect stay that was wonderful and adventurous. A holiday built on socializing and cohesion.  The stay at Lara's apartment was perfect! The apartment itself boasted of culture and soul and helped create our stay in NYC for the wonderful journey it became.  The location of the apartment was perfect for us. A place to retreat to and not too far from the core of Manhattan. You are within a few minutes walking distance to many of the major metro lines, and only 2 stops away (10 minutes) from downtown Manhattan. The apartment is located in East Williamsburg which is well served by the New York City Subway. It is mainly served by the Grand Street and Morgan Avenue stops of the BMT Canarsie Line (L train). It is also served by the bus Q54 on Metropolitan Avenue, and the Q59 on Grand Avenue. The understanding of the metro was easy to understand, and it was easy to get to all the different destinations and quickly get there. Entertaining with musicians playing and dancers performing.  You are within walking distance to both shopping, attractions and activities. If you want a day out of vibrant Manhattan, discovering Brooklyn on a walk from the Brooklyn Bridge up to Lara's apartment is a recommended option. And after a long day it was lovely to be able to cross the street to the local bar Grimm. A beer mecca and not least a place of history.  The area itself felt safe, even on late nights when coming home. There were always nice people in the streets who were going somewhere. 24-hour Delis at the corners where you could find the most essential things. I had read beforehand that there could be a lot of noise in the street where the apartment is located and that is true. Nevertheless, I cannot emphasize enough that this is what you have to expect in New York and is part of the whole experience and charm. I myself love to hear life pulsating, but of course this is individual. What can be categorized as "noise" is the heavy traffic that runs between Brooklyn and Manhattan, but this was at certain times.  The building itself needs a little love and upgrading - but that's how many of the buildings in NY are, so that's just what one has to expect. The apartment is located on the 2nd floor and was furnished and decorated very personally and nicely. Cozy atmosphere and very personal and knowledgeable. We felt very at home. What emerges from the pictures that are posted matches very well with reality. The apartment was clean and well kept and I think it was large compared to apartments generally in NY. As stated in the description, this apartment had wifi and this worked very well. We had lap top with us which we could stream movies in the evening without any problems. The bedroom was large and room for suitcases without taking up the entire area. Everything you need is available. Bedding on the bed (the bed was lovely to sleep in with the choice of pillows, whether you like plain pillow or tempur). Soap and toilet paper on the toilet and towels provided on the bed on arrival.  Great value for money!  It was easy to find the apartment and both in and out check were stress free and a positive experience.  Lara as a hostess will have all the boast in the world! She is a hostess who follows you up without monitoring. I felt like I was in my own apartment and this because she showed confidence in me as her tenant. She communicates with you in advance of the rental and follows you up the day of arrival and the following day. The instructions are simple, and she sends you a very nice welcome letter with information and tips. I did not have the opportunity to meet her personally, but by the communication I felt that I still got to know her.   Remarkable, loveliest and supportive host! You can't ask for a better and more wonderful hostess.  Everything was for my part perfect and in my reflection and feedback I have nothing negative to say. 100% recommended, would stay here again when (not if) I come back :-)

Get what you pay for. A clean room really close to Arthur Ashe stadium. Only downsides would be sketchy surrounding area and cleanliness outside of bedroom. But overall very affordable and exactly what I was looking for

Michelle and Evelyn are the best , they are thoughtful and professional in everything especially in giving me tips on how to park outside, considering  you know how stressful it is here in flushing for parking . I’m grateful , thanks ! Definitely I’ll  choose this one for my next trip in Flushing .

C-van was pleasant until our flight was canceled and it was impossible for us to get to New York. She told me she understood but then she collected our money without being able to negotiate any reimbursement. We wanted to offer to pay for the first two nights but she didn't want to know. I recognize that it was not her fault but even less ours. A piece of advice be sure of your airline because you will not be reimbursed if you choose this accommodation. I am very disappointed with this host.

This place was great! It wasn't modern or fancy (and the facade was actually kind of sketchy), but the space itself was wonderful - quite large, especially for new york, with a homey feel, well-stocked kitchen implements, comfortable bed, patio, and a generous and responsive host. Also only a block from a major transit hub in Queens - 45 minutes to JFK or 20 to LGA on public transit, 20 minutes to midtown manhattan and direct access to most of midtown/downtown without having to transfer subways.

Super comfortable beds. Great porch and great location. Good value for the spacious top floor apartment. The rest of the house is cluttered and seems slightly unsafe with the piles of furniture but it doesn’t really effect the rental space. Sally is a very sweet and kind host.

For a two night low key trip to NYC, staying at this apartment turned into more of a hassle than anything. Coordinating with the host was overly stressful and unorganized. We were told day of that in order to get the key (which there was only one key available) we were to ask the cashier at the dollar store on the same block. When getting there, the cashier had no idea of any key.   We were let in eventually by the cleaning crew, who were still in the apartment two hours after check in time.   The toilet was broken, the faucet was broken, the shower rod fell immediately after one shower.   Plumbers had to come by to fix the toilet, but since there was only one key, we had to cancel our city plans to come back and let him in. And once again, the key was left at this mystery dollar bodega.   The host made us feel like we were more of an annoyance and inconvenience to her. She was on vacation so any and all communication was through 2 second phone calls. The gentleman host, Lee, was more of a help than anyone.   The sleeping situation was accommodating for 5 girls, if you don't plan on spending much time in the apartment because every inch of the living room is occupied by beds. Location was great, in Harlem, away from the hustle and bustle of the city. Average uber though to downtown was about $30-50.   Lastly, plan on packing light since the apartment is on the 5th floor with no elevator. You'll be adequately trained to climb Everest after staying here. I would not recommend this air BNB for anyone with scheduled plans in the city since everything seemed to be based on the hosts needs.

Lee and Grace had a clean, spacious apartment that had everything we needed for our larger group (towels, garbage bags, soap, etc.)! The apartment was just as it was in pictures and we all had a comfortable stay. Lee and Grace were super responsive and kindly accommodated our earlier check in time at 1pm. Checking in itself was very easy and convenient, as well as checking out. There was a drug store and a couple of deli’s nearby as well which made it easy to grab food or anything we might have needed. Would definitely recommend this space for anyone looking to hang out in upper Manhattan!

I came alone to NY and was a bit nervous. Right away they made me feel at home. I didn’t feel unsafe being in their home. Everything was nice! The bedroom in the loft was interesting and funky! I truly enjoyed the stay and how open they were to answering my questions. I would recommend!

Cool place, has everything that a traveller needs. Very good location, didn't feel unsafe once, shops and cafes close, subway close. Rooftop has an amazing view!  Only one thing: There's about 30cm gap between the bedroom wall and the ceiling (meaning it's kind of connected to the common area), so I recommend having earplugs/sleep mask if you want to have undisturbed sleep. But it didn't bother me!

This is a great place to stay, all the basics were provided. We even had figs on our window. Clean towels were provided and the bathroom had a shower and a tub and everything worked perfectly. Everything was clean and felt safe staying there. We didn’t get a chance to go downstairs but it was nice to know we had access to other things. The subway is nearby which was great after walking all day. People do gather around the neighborhood, being in NY I think that is very common and for our stay we didn’t feel threatened nor unsafe. I would recommend to be cautious either way. Overall, we loved the place and would stay there again if we visit NY in the future.
The host was awesome but the location is as dangerous as it can get

Host cursed me out when I asked if there was true privacy, I asked them to cancel the reserve. They said yes, then they only gave a refund of $25 after I had to get multiple costumer services get involved, they’re a scam

It was a great time in NY - also because of Leesha and her family hospitality. Location is very good - it is REALLY 60 seconds to J station. It takes about 30 minutes to reach Manhattan but it is a good location.  The breakfast is "real breakfast" - not a muffin and coffee-like-water. It was always prepared by Leesha - real homemade breakfast just before serving. And do not afraid to ask for something special. Leesha will do her best! We have got some welcome fruits, cake, and water. There is a separate frig in the room - just for you.   Leesha is very friendly as her whole family. We didn't feel wrong or embarrassed. Lovely family.
didnt help out with stolen item from place, overall clean?

Leesha's place is very quaint and accommodating for a weekend trip! She was very prompt with all communication and bathroom was especially beautiful. Just wish it was a full shower door...I was afraid of getting the floor wet! Rooms were nice and attached. She had some snacks, water, and cereal already stocked.  We added to the snacks as well for future guests. Thank you for a place to rest!
It looks scary from the outside but nice inside and the host is very nice

Leesha’s home was a home away from home, communication with her was easy, her home is minutes away from the metro station, very close to JFK airport, safe neighborhood. One hour from Manhattan, the beds were comfortable, almost a perfect stay. If something my only complaint is the bathroom, as it is located outside the rooms (next to their kitchen) it was unpleasant and uncomfortable to walk towards the bathroom and, seeing them on the way having to make conversation, specially if I any of us were not properly dressed (pajamas). Aside from that we are thankful Leesha shared their home with us

Great central location in the Lower East Side of Manhattan..its perfect if you are looking for somewhere to rest your head.  Having aircon in the room during the heat was a must and a great benefit.   Met Jackie when i arrived and was a great host and informative. Safety wise even though i had my concerns at first they quickly went away.. i found it no more dangerous than i might expect here in Vancouver as i would arrive late night after the bar at 3:30-4 some nights.  And even though there might have been people that i might have worried of i ran into 0 troubles.  Which is a lot to say about the Lower East Side of Manhattan and they should be happy to have such a great neighbourhood and feel lucky! The only thing i will say that i found a bit confusing was the doorway and i went to the first one on arrival downstairs not realizing it was two flights up that i had to go..so just dont make the same mistake i made(sometimes im a bit dyslexic on instructions) Theres too many fantastic places to grab a bite or drink to mention.  Being close to the Delancey Essex train station allows for fair ease travelling around.  New York has their stuff together with mobile testing available for free for antigen and PCR tests..though if you need quick you might have to pay.  I went to Mt Sinai hospital where the staff was accommodating and i was able to get a hard copy to travel back to Canada the next day!   You can have a great sandwich at the corner store half a block away and if you need laundry done you can drop it off around the corner and they will fold it and have it ready for you the next day if not earlier! Coolest coffee shop i found was Pause that has a great Tumeric iced tea while across the street the Clinton St baking co puts on a great breakfast but its so popular i got in once..the last time it was a 2hr wait so reso if you can. Duffys on the corner of broome st has great staff as does the The Flower Shop around the corner on Eldridge which is a 5yo great drinking spot(they have some food too but i didnt try)…  One thing i didnt have a chance to do is spend more time at the Met and that will def be my plan! Love the neighbourhood and people and would rebook in a heartbeat  -bill

The room was a comfortable stay for me and my friend. I didn’t realize it was just a room with roommates staying next door but that might be my mistake for not reading carefully. Overall i had a great stay besides the check in process. I was having trouble with our key and called the host multiple times with the call going to voicemail. Then we passed by a housekeeper and she helped us check in. But then our door was not unlocking , luckily our roommates found us later on and taught us how the door works. Overall great stay but would have been less stressful if our host was available on call.

Not the same as the picture, the room is a lot different, but over all good location, it’s just that it’s located in a old building and the front entrance looks really sketchy, I think that the price it’s a little high for the room, but it was my first time in NY so I don’t know much, jackie was really helpful.

Although the apartment looks shady from outside, its an awesome place once you are in.. Jackie had clear instructions for checkin and I had no troubles getting in. Thank you for making my stay comfortable !

Overall I’m happy with what I paid for after the discounted price. If it was the original price I think it’s better to stay at a hotel for just $30 more a night for a more comfortable stay ie. Have your own bathroom, safer location and better amenities. That being said $60/night was hard to beat in Manhattan. It is what you pay for - the room is in a rather old apartment with somewhat of a sketchy entrance (there’s no pictures of it for a reason) but the interior is small and clean. Jackie has a house keeper that comes every weekday and she does a good job of keeping the public areas clean. This location is walking distance to so many good restaurants and not too far away by foot to the Brooklyn bridge, shopping at SoHo and Chinatown. It’s connected to major streets like Bowery, Clinton and Grand - as well as east Broadway station. While the exterior is a little quiet because it’s a residential block, the nearby areas are pretty busy. Overall a good experience but please set accurate expectations when staying in a small room in an old apartment. The checkin experience is smooth but Jackie doesn’t reply to messages and doesn’t pick up the phone- everything is smooth and rarely do I need to. It’s just a small gripe I had to take note.

Europeans beware!! This apartment is in a unsafe spot in Brooklyn. More on that further down.  Melissa was nice to communicate with over the app and was always quick to respond, but (unfortunately )we never saw her around. The check-in was easy. There were no instructions for the check-out though. The room has plenty of space for New York standards and the apartment was very! clean when we arrived. We had enough room to open both of our big suitcases and still move around. The aircondition-unit worked fine. It would have been great to have a small reading lamp next to the bed. The bed was very short although we both are only just around 1,76 m and the mattress was very soft. But it really just depends how you like it. So the apartment and room are nice and are good value for the money.BUT!   Unsafe neighbourhood.:  First of all Melissa is not to blame for the neighbourhood, but it still needs to be said!: There was a man SHOT and murdered a couple of houses down in the same street just 3 weeks before our stay there! (We saw the candles and googled what happened) And on the third night we stayed there two men tried to steal the tires of a car right in front of the house. They had the car jacked up and were ready to steal when we walked by. Also the neighbours seemed not bothered by it too much. The Metrostation (Ralph Ave) stinks of urine and the streets around the apartment are very dirty. During the day the area is alright and seems safe enough, but at night its a different story.  There are the „projects“ as well...social housing blocks..where we saw police cars every night. As a european (and as a person that has never been to the „hood“) you have no idea what kind of neighbourhood you are entering. Since you cannot read the social cues if a situation is safe or not...people are safe or not...we would not recommend this neighbourhood and will not be coming back.

Great deal considering Manhattan prices. Great location, close to a subway station and a lot of bars and restaurants nearby.  Communication with Jackie was quick and helpful, room was as described. Apartment was mostly clean, but it was shared with several other guests, which can be stressful at times.  Overall great, true NYC experience for a reasonable price!

I’ve stayed in a lot of Airbnbs and this is probably the best experience I’ve ever had. With the private entrance & bathroom, there’s a lot of privacy but Mateo and his partner Greg were there for me if I ever needed anything. I was in NY for a family emergency, and their place was such a haven and resting place for me during a very emotionally stressful time. Their adorable French bulldog Apollo would come see me once in a while, and it was so comforting to hug him and have him around too. The room is equipped with a mini-fridge, TV with all the streaming options, and a kettle for boiling water, a comfy couch, and the bed is very comfortable as well. It’s a stylish room in a classic Brooklyn brownstone townhouse, on a quiet residential street that is also close to many restaurants and subways. I can’t recommend this place highly enough!!! Hope to be back soon. Hugs!

Mellissa's place is very quaint, but adorable and looks exactly as pictured in the photos. (Be warned though, there is a narrow staircase before getting to her place)  She ended up meeting me when I arrived and allowed me to check in earlier than normal. And she seemed like a lovely person. However, I got nervous about the area where the Airbnb is located, after receiving some warnings from my uber driver about the crime rate. And a subtle warning from Mellissa that if 'i looked too well-dressed I had a higher chance of getting robbed'. So because of that I ended up booking a hotel for the night in Manhattan, and canceled my reservation for the rest of my stay, before flying home the next day.   It wasn't exactly the vacation I expected, but it might be perfect for somebody else.

Melissas place is a great accomodation in New York City. Within 30mins you are in Manhattan. It is clean and the bed is really comfortable! The area around is quiet, but we were feeling a bit unsafe to be honest as we had some uncomfortable situations in the C-line metro in the evenings.
Amazing place, everything was exactly as described. She is also an amazing host, can’t even stress how amazing her place was. We had an amazing stay.

Beautiful, spacious, clean and stocked with everything you could ever need. This Airbnb made staying in New York City stress-free, which is rare!! I can’t say enough good about the hosts and how well supplied the apartment was. I dont even have the words to praise it as highly as I would like. Everyone should stay here!
Fun and stylish place! The beds were very comfortable. A great place to kick back and relax at the end of a busy or stressful day!
Although we didn't get to meet in person, Riva was an awesome, communicative host. Everything was easy and stress-free. I would highly recommend!

I did not meet Tyler but I met Stacy and what a total pleasure. She had the joy of my mother dying when I was in her home taking a shower and all the stress that goes into that before during and after. She handled me and my sister like the true pro she is and I couldn’t have had a better person at that place and time. There aren’t enough thank you’s in the world.
Great host. Our experience was stress free and everything was as sstated in the description. Would reccomend. Thanks Princess!

Great place. The apartment is beautiful and very well-renovated and maintained - especially the bathroom! Giorgia definitely took care to ensure we had everything we needed without having to ask.  The one downside is that the apartment is somewhat nicer than the surrounding area. Not that it felt dangerous at all - it didn't - but rather there weren't a whole lot of things we wanted to go to or places we would've wanted to eat that were within walking distance. As with just about all of NYC there's plenty of little spots around if you need to grab something from a store or want a quick bite to eat, but it's not the most trendy / stylish corner of Bed-Stuy.
The apartment was very spacious and the hosts are going above and beyond to keep guests safe and comfortable during these very scary times.

Justin and his brother are great guys, They responses are pretty fast. Neighborhood is ok, close to financial district. Guys next door are creepy but I've never have problems. Thanks for having me guys!

I had a wonderful stay at Lee’s place! It was exactly like the pictures. Very clean and stylish. There were a lot of thoughtful amenities such as dishes, a spice rack, water filter, cook ware, extra pillows, a smart tv, iron, umbrella, etc. I also was very happy to see that the bedding and towels were extremely clean as I can be a bit of a germaphobe. I enjoyed my stay here and was lucky enough to experience the beautiful snow in the wooded park right by Lee’s place. The only thing I didn’t enjoy was the location of the apartment but that’s my fault for not doing my research. The neighborhood was fine but if you go up about 1 block toward the nearest subway things would get sketchy especially at night. Also all the tourist attractions are a 30 minute to an hour subway ride. Overall if you don’t mind being a little farther from the touristy hot spots, this is a wonderful place to say and I highly recommend it!

We stayed here for a month in September and LOVED IT!   We have a dog and the Inwood park is simply perfect. Went on runs here almost daily and walks mid-day. Such a huge plus for the area/location.   Some other things we loved: - The place was huge for NYC standards. We worked remotely, so having a bedroom with doors that closed was ideal.  - There are about 3+ people helping to manage this place. They were always available via text and delivered anything we needed - extra toilet paper, even an air mattress last minute!  - We drove, and if we played our cards right we found free street parking nearby. The key was moving it on a weekday during work hours. We didn’t move our car much once we found a good spot.  - Location to the metro. For those of you wanting to stay “downtown” Inwood is definitely a bit far. BUT, with that said- the metro is a 4 minute walk away and it only takes about 25 minutes on the A line to get pretty much anywhere.   Also, I want to note this since I saw some reviews about it being an unsafe neighborhood. I did travel with my bf so I wasn’t walking alone late at night… but with that said- this neighborhood is FULL of families. I felt very safe going on runs alone in the park and walking around. The neighborhood is lively and I loved that.   The only negative thing to add is the deck is not new like the photos. With all the rain, the wood is beginning to mold a bit. We didn’t hang out there at all (but the park made up for this).   Thanks for a great stay!

New apartment, pleasant atmosphere, excellent location and cleanliness. The property had everything we needed, and the host was super attentive. This is a type of property that can be chosen without fear or error. I loved everything.

Lucyano’s apartment is the perfect place for someone wanting to see the city and experience life as if you lived there. It is also a fantastic spot if you are in town for Mt. Sanai Hospital on Madison Avenue.  It is a mere 1.5 blocks (2 minute walk tops) to the nearest subway station that will take you downtown. The ride to midtown is about 15-20 minutes and if you want to go all the way to battery park it’s about 40-45 minutes unless you transfer to an express train then it’s about 20 minutes if you catch it at the right time. Bus stations are also in abundance near the apartment. A metro card for one weeks unlimited use can be purchased right there for $33. As long as you are ambulatory this is a great place to stay that is much more affordable and likely more safe than downtown. No vehicle needed! If you drive into town there is free parking along the streets, however finding a spot is like finding the end of the rainbow. Plan on paid parking near the hospital (8 blocks away) that runs about $40 a day, or unload at the apartment then drive across the city to a cheaper parking area and take the metro back to the apartment. We arrived in the middle of the night and it was honestly a bit scary at first. However after a few days of walking around the area (a lot) we never once had a problem or felt afraid again. It seems to be a safe area anytime of day or night.  Another perk is that Mt. Sanai Hospital is a mere 12-15 minute walk away if you need to stay for family or friends in the hospital.  Central Park is just on the far side of the hospital so it is also walking distance. The location is north of the Jackie O. Reservoir so you are a bit away from the festivities of the lower portion of the park, but is still beautiful as you enter the park at the East Meadow where the Covid Field Hospital from Samaritans Purse was set up during the worst of the pandemic.  Another weird but noteworthy aspect is the water pressure and the hot water in the apartment are divine. As in you almost never want to step out of the shower. The bathroom is also quite spacious which is rare for a NY apartment.  Being that it is NY city I recommend ese plugs and/or white noise/sound machines to help you sleep. Being close to the subway and buses are great for getting around but can affect super light sleepers.  I highly recommend staying here if you want the real NY experience. It is not a 5 star hotel so keep expectations real. If you go in looking for an adventure and want the real deal living experience for those that are not multimillionaires in the city this is it. I loved it. Enjoy your stay.

I personally think this place was great for its value, however my friends pointed out a few things that could be improved so I'll include them in the review. Overall, my friends and I (total of 6 people) enjoyed the stay and loved New York! Can't wait to visit again.  Goods: --FREE Netflix!!! If you're having a lazy morning or want to watch a show before sleeping, then this feature is awesome! I had lots of fun watching shows with my friends. --There were enough beds to fit 6 people. There was 2 beds that fit 2 people each, a sofa (turned bed), and then an air mattress. The air mattress was quite comfy (based on my friend's experience) and could fit in the bedroom after pushing the bed over. --The kitchen has a lot of supplies. If you want to cook at home instead of eating out, there was a lot of appliances you can use. There was a blender, gas stove top, spices, pots and pans, spatulas, a microwave, a big fridge, and more.  --High shower head. Everyone in my party was pretty short, but I would assume tall people would love this feature. The shower head is taller than most other shower heads I have seen.  --There was AC and fans. The AC can be a bit loud, but it worked fine in keeping the place cold. --Location was great. It was close to a lot of grocery stores and restaurants. It is also 1 block away from the subway line 6 and parts of central park. --The host provides you with soap, shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. If you're not particular about your shampoo, this saves some space in the luggage. --Self check-in. Great in terms of flexibility for flights. --There's an electronic camera for the doorbell. If you're concerned about anyone knocking on your door late at night, you can see them through the electronic doorbell system. I never got to use it, but some may find this useful.  Could improve: --We encountered a few bugs in the room. There were 4 or 5 ants on the dining table and this one bug that was kinda scary (it's those beneficial crawlers that just looks scary but does no harm to humans). No spiders or cockroaches, just some ants (they eventually disappeared as well). --The lock box for the keys were kinda icky. I think some water got into the lock box and some rust started to develop. Had to wash the keys after taking them out of the lock box. --There can be a decent amount of noise at night since you live so close to the streets. If you're a light sleeper, I advise sleeping on the bed in the living room and not the bed in the bedroom. Not really a problem with the Air BnB, just an issue about New York (and big cities) in general. --The hallway was a bit narrow. Wasn't too much of a problem, but it definitely got crowded at times when 3 or all 6 of us had to sit down to eat breakfast. Not as much as a problem for smaller parties though.  I thought it was a pretty good deal for the price (split across 6 people) and the location, especially since you can use Netflix as well. Still would recommend this place to others, but maybe for parties less than 6 people.

Affordable place for a stay in Manhattan. Close to Central Park, in East Harlem. The neighborhood is nice during the day: lots of nice bars and restaurants, close to the museum of the city of New York, close to subway. It gets pretty sketchy at night though.   Check in and check out was super easy and pain free.

The apartment is really far from the Subway stations. It doesn't have a TV. The cost of cleaning is really high The patio door doesn't close properly When we left he accused us of having stolen an orthopedic pillow that we never saw.

Great cozy apartment in an old house with charme, far from Manhattans stress and at the same time only minutes away from it with the easy subway. It is in the heart of Williamsburg with lots of cafés and bars nearby. The apartment is very clean and well equipped. Communication with Yana was very easy, she is very flexible with check in and out times! Definitely a place to come back again!

Comfortable and roomy at same time.  shady porch and sun trap back yard a great place to stop on a visit to  Brooklyn / NYC easy connections through Q train to Manhattan, or Coney Island If you fancy a swim.

Such a kind host and great apartment space ❤️ unfortunately the price was a bit too high for me and the neighborhood was a bit scary for a young woman, otherwise I would’ve stayed longer! Thank you so much Dayra for everything!

The whole stay was fine. The place is very well located and is very easy to access the main tourist or work places. What you need to go to rest in the evening and prepare breakfast before leaving in the morning. The price and quality ratio is good... Communication was possible on time whenever necessary. You don't feel unsafe in the neighborhood.

Do not stay there! Horrible place in East Harlem, neighborhood is in terrible spot surrounded by bunch of homeless people and drug addicts. It is in the basement and literally people come and do drugs by it’s front door and leave their syringes. No windows with  any view, outside and hallway of the apartment is super nasty.

The photographs are totally real. The apartment is just as you see it. The only thing to keep in mind is that you share it with quite a few guests, so the noise (very thin walls and ceiling and you hear everything) and the lack of cleanliness in the bathroom area, makes the stay a little unpleasant. That is not the host's fault, since I myself have seen how Albert once went out to ask other guests to respect the schedules (with all the kindness in the world). I myself have gone out one night to ask that they respect that we were sleeping (noises at 1,2, 3 and almost 4 in the morning) it is important to highlight that we, the guests, respect the rest of the colleagues who live in the same apartment and pay attention to the requests that the host indicates.

This place is amazing!! It’s so comforting in this room, the whole space was very clean, Albert helped me out when I had any questions, I cannot stress this enough, this place is amazing! Also, we loved the Hollywood theme throughout, the attention to detail was so fun. 10/10

Phil was an amazing host and very quick with his responses....I’m 19 so traveling by myself was a little scary but being in Phil’s home made me very comfortable and made my trip a lot more easier. He had all the necessary places mapped out for me and although I didn’t use the train ubering around from his house to other places was convenient. I can’t wait to go back to New York and stay at Phil’s place again and I also recommend anyone traveling to the Brooklyn area to stay there as well.

Phil was awesome! Very communicative and was always readily available to answer questions. The location was great, right next to the Subway station. Never felt unsafe and in a nice Brooklyn neighborhood. Would recommend and would stay again.
Karen was an absolute delight! She was super easy and quick to communicate with. She even saved us a spot in the shade to park in. Her place was really clean and cute. We would absolutely stay again.
Disrespectful people I ever encountered in my life do not book them At all they are scammers and will rob you .

Jamie's home is gorgeous. Very convenient location for what we needed. Whole foods for coffee and breakfast every morning was around the corner just a couple minutes away. Same with the subway! We hadn't explored Harlem before so we didnt know what to expect but this area was great, never felt unsafe! The apartment is beautiful inside, the shower/bath on the main floor is AMAZING. The whole place was extremely clean and loved the little details throughout the home! They have a cute outdoor backyard too. As far as space, there is plenty! There were 5 of us staying here and didnt feel ontop of each other at all ♡ We loved it here and will definitely be back!

This house is fantastic for families if you want to stay in Harlem. The great things are that for New York, there's tons of space and they have everything that you need. The beds are comfy, the place is clean (save for some spiders). Our stay was for 5 weeks, and it felt like a second home after that long.  Some things to consider before booking. They added on almost $1000 in cleaning fees (two cleanings) that were not part of the original price. That seemed excessive for us, but hey, everything is more expensive in NY!   Be careful going out in the backyard, there were tons of mosquitos that we didn't realize were there until the entire family had bites the next day.   The place is located really close to Whole Foods and the 2/3 express subway, which made it very easy to get groceries and get downtown. We found a lot of great places to eat in Harlem. While we never felt unsafe in Harlem, there were lots of homeless and drugs on the streets.   Overall, a great stay, and the host was extremely responsive and took care of every minor issue we had. I would recommend this house if Harlem is where you want to call home base in NYC!

First of all I have to say, that Jennifer is not allowed to sublet her apartment by her landlord. I was instructed by her to not mention airbnb to anybody beforehand, which was fine, but one evening I was stopped by her landlord in the hallway and questioned about where I am staying, how long, where Jennifer is etc. Afterwards, although I didn’t say anything wrong, Jennifer freaked out about it, and I really thought for a few hours that I would have to move out and find another place to stay right away. From that point on I felt really unsafe there and always tried to hide from the landlord.   For my stay the apartment was also not ideal, there is no couch, only cushions on the floor and there is no real table and chairs. I had to work from home sometimes and could not really do it anywhere.  The place was really clean in general, only the bathroom and the shower were really not okay. Especially the shower curtain was mildewed.  The kitchen was clean and well equipped.  Apartment has an AC, which is definitely a pro.   Also, what should be mentioned , the hallway is really narrow and the stairs are quite steep, so with a huge suitcase not ideal, as the apartment is walk-up to the 4th floor.  The location of the apartment is alright, in my opinion it is a bit busy in that area and there are nicer places to live, bit that is just my personal opinion.

Had a great stay with Garon! You'll have a super cool and helpful roommate for the length of your stay, who just might cook you breakfast and make you tea in the morning. The neighborhood is really interesting and beautiful, worth spending some time just wandering around. I stayed for almost two weeks, often coming back late at night, and never felt unsafe in the area. The room itself has everything you need. And the apartment has two friendly cats :). If I were to come back to Brooklyn, I would definitely stay with Garon again.

Shun's appartment is in an excellent location. We had our privacy and the room was exactly as show on the photo. Very basic but clean. We probably only saw Shun 2 or 3 times during our stay. It was our first visit to New York and it would have been appreciated if Shun had at least on one occasion (perhaps upon arrival or the day after) offered some information about the area or check with us if we had any questions. We thought Shun was friendly but very reserved .Bottom line: great location, close to places of interest (we practically walked everywhere), clean but basic accommodation, however, don't expect a social, interactive host because once you've checked-in, you're on your own! Not an unpleasant experience overall.

Great Location, with different subway lines just a couple of blocks walking north or east. Shun was a very quiet host, but that doesn't diminish the great location and accessible price of the place. He  helped me a lot lending me an Apple Express to have wireless wifi while staying there. Really safe neighborhood and got everything near (places to eat, buy food, drug store, shoe repair, Fedex, etc) just by walking.   This is a perfect choice for people who want to save money and be in a quite central place.

Great Location, with different subway lines just a couple of blocks walking north or east. Shun was a very quiet host, but that doesn't diminish the great location and accessible price of the place. Really safe neighborhood and got everything near (places to eat, buy food, drug store, shoe repair, Fedex, etc) just by walking. This is a perfect choice for people who want to save money and be in a quite central place.

I arrived right around the time that I arranged with Shun to be there. Shun came down to the door and let me in. Perhaps he did this in order to lead me directly to the apartment the first time, as I might conceivably have gotten confused as to where the apartment is, due to the stairway and apartment layout. Anyway, first appearances of the building might be scary for some. It is rather run down. Indeed, the apartment must not have enough storage space because there are boxes lining the hallway leading to the main part of the apartment. The room is very basic, but is as advertised. There is a small refrigerator, some dishes and a microwave, a TV and WiFi. The apartment could use a cosmetic facelift, for sure, but apart from that, it was comfortable enough, though spartan. After introductions, I didn't see Shun again until shortly before I left. All in all, though I wouldn't necessarily recommend this for everyone, I would definitely return due to the convenience of location. Shun is pleasant, very quiet and reliable.

My sister and I stayed at Laurie's place for a week, and we had a very good time there. The house is beautiful and welcoming (and so is the lovely garden/ backyard). We stayed in the room with the two twin beds and we shared a bathroom with another guest, which worked out very well.  Laurie was a very welcoming and helpful host who provided us with lots of insider tips, maps, vouchers, and just very useful information on what to do, where to go, and how to save money on Broadway tickets, etc.  Not only were we delighted by the house and our host, we can also recommend this place because of its great location. Park Slope is a very lively neighborhood with a variety of restaurants, bars, cafés, small  shops, trees and beautiful houses. Last but not least, this place can be easily reached by subway and we never felt unsafe walking home ("away  from home").

Very beautiful house in a friendly neighboorhood with really good access to Manhattan and all other areas.... I was staying with Laurie for 10 days, the room was nice with a comfortable bed and air conditioning.  Laurie was very helpful with any issues I had during my stay... problems with the taxi driver, maps for New York, restaurants etc. Also she took care of my laundry, what was really nice. What is important for guests to know is that there are other guests on the same floor, so you have to share the bathroom.
