We only ever were uncomfortable when it was late at night, as some of the adults out there looked sketchy, so we chose to walk on the opposite side of the street and then cross over when we got closer to where the apt we were staying at was... all good. Besides that, the neighborhood seemed nice. I totally recommend using the train to get to Manhattan and investing in the unlimited weeklong metro card. It was $34 for each, but as tourists, we absolutely got our money’s worth. All in all, we had an awesome time, and being able to come back each night and unwind in Julian’s apartment elevated the experience.
What a wonderful place,At first i was little bit afraid to book this place but eventually it was over my expectations on the place was just fabulous

Nicholas was awesome, as was his room with a view! He was very helpful and gave us lots of information and guidance to make our first trip to Manhattan perfect and stress free. The room was great and exactly what we expected from his pictures. The neighbourhood is nice and the commute into Manhattan on the Staten Island ferry was quick and enjoyable(amazing views!). We just back and have already recommended his place to all of our friends! Thanks again Nicholas for everything.  Josh and Katie :)

We had a great stay in this cozy little apartment.  Edward was super thoughtful, friendly, and kind.  The room was perfectly clean and had everything we needed, including all kinds of helpful amenities, and  for anything else we needed,  Edward was quick to respond and happy to help. The place was a steal! Hard to find such a nice arrangement for so cheap in NYC!

The host met us at night around 10pm in the lobby, welcomed us, offered something to drink, and showed us around. Like others have said the host was very welcoming. We didn't have so much contact as we would leave early and come back late at night so we were barely there. He was gracious enough to let us leave our bags until our late night flight out but we had to leave the room at 10am which I thought was really early in terms of check out times. Neither check out time/check in time are stated in the posting. Moreover, the only time I felt things got awkward was the night before we left, in the middle of our conversation he took a photo of us for reason/s unbeknownst to us. That was a little strange. Aside from this, we had no problems with the host or our stay.   The listing was accurate however the place itself left much to be desired. I wouldn't say anything was dirty per say but it wouldn't have hurt to update the place with a fresh coat of paint. For example, the sinks have these strange green and black stains on them. The shower curtain had already turned yellow. As my fiance put it "it lacked a woman's touch" The room itself was in good condition and the bed was comfortable despite it being on the ground with no frame.   We came in at nighttime and the neighborhood is okay. If you walk be prepared for some uphill/incline walking. Some areas of the streets are dimly lit, doubtful and some could even say shady looking but that could be said of many parts of NY. Despite this, nothing ever happened to us not once were we ever approached for money or anything so the only thing I could say is be careful. Don't try to use the taxi they will give you a hard time it is very close and they will try to stuff you in with a bunch of other people so just take the bus or walk. The good thing is the whole time we were there we were able to sleep well because it was quiet but the downside is we always have to make sure we leave every hour or half past to make it to the ferry and account for the extra commute time. These are some things to keep in mind when staying in Staten Island.

Just 2 minutes from Subway Station. Great location and a very quiet and comfortable studio with your own kitchenette, a huge bed, lots of working space if you need a table and even supplies to get a simple breakfast. Marylyn was very hospitable and helpful. The shared bathroom is for this floor only so it was accessible whenever I needed it. Fast internet is a plus if you are doing lots of Skype like me. If you are new to New York do not be afraid of areas outside of Manhattan. That neighborhood is safe and I did a lot of walking at night, and later, even 2 AM and it is safe! It reminded me of my London place I rented a while ago. Strongly recommended. I look forward to come back!

My husband and I went on our first trip to NYC and stayed in this sute. The room is just as advertised.  The very spacious and clean bathroom is definitely the highlight of this place.  Quiet home in a peaceful neighborhood.  No more than a 10 minute walk to 3 different metro stations.  I never felt unsafe while walking with my husband through the neighborhoods to eat or catch the metro.  The owner is extremely helpful and gave us input on which train to catch and the fastest way to walk places, very kind.  There is a window A/C unit and there is cable TV as well.  I would easily recommend this to anyone wanting a nice quiet place outside of midtown to rest and have peace.

I stayed here for ten weeks while moving to New York.  I was able to book it immediately, because any time that shows as available really is available.  Most people on Airbnb don't actually have a place free for that long even though they show as open all the time, and many will take days to get back to you and say they can't do it.  The place is a decent sized studio apartment with a shared bath, up one flight of stairs (there wasn't much contention for the bathroom).  There are seven studios on three floors, and five of them are rented on airbnb.  Mine had a kitchinette with utensils and basic cooking equipment, good wifi, and an air conditioner that was absolutely vital in the summer.  It's not luxury but there was nothing missing - it's run a little like a long term stay hotel, Marylyn and Lloyd are right there living downstairs in case you need something.  The mattress is European style firm, which I actually like.  This studio has three north facing windows, which means it doesn't get a ton of natural light.  Two blocks away is a Foodtown grocery with decent prices and lots of quality food.  Grocery availability was great.  It's also quiet.  I couldn't hear the other tenants if I was in my room with the door closed.  I had three windows facing the street, but there wasn't much road traffic or noise.  Occasionally people in the neighborhood would play music loud outdoors, generally on a Friday night.  I often work from home so I know it's fairly quiet at all times of day.  A real plus with staying in a room that is always rented out is that it's "yours" while you are there.  You don't have to constantly worry about disturbing someone else's personal possessions, or deal with an owner that is hard to get in touch with.  Other than the dishes, everything there is durable and hard to break.  Basically, it was a perfectly fine place to stay for the duration and I absolutely recommend it.  This is one block from the Nostrand AC subway line.  This is a pretty good way to get into Manhattan.  It's less good to get to other parts of Brooklyn, because you may have to take the C local to Lafayette and then walk five minutes to Atlantic Terminal.  Note that most Airbnb places in Brooklyn do not have good subway service at all.  The G line is horrible, anything over 10 minutes walk from any line is horrible (this includes much of Clinton Hill).  The neighborhood is middle to lower middle class, and this is quite close to a main road so it's perfectly safe.  However, there are not a lot of good restaurants close by - I ended up traveling 20 minutes by foot and/or subway when I wanted more variety in my food.  When I ultimately got an apartment, I made sure I didn't have to take the subway to get everywhere.  A note based on an earlier reviewer who backed out because she didn't feel safe... this is literally a 2 minute walk from the subway.  NYC subways are quite safe, and Nostrand itself is a street with high foot traffic.  The place is 1/2 block from Nostrand (1 minute), on a well lit street filled with the people who live right there.  Not to put too fine a point on it, the neighborhood is 90% non-white and there are some low-income buildings on the street (which means that a bunch of people tend to hang around outside).  That makes some people nervous, even though Bed-Stuy does not actually have a lot of crime and this area is way too visible for random criminals to hang out in.  To get to Manhattan you walk 2 minutes to the Nostrand AC station, where both trains show up every 10 minutes.  Either line takes at most 15 minutes to get to Fulton St. in Manhattan, where you can transfer onto most other lines in less than 5 minutes.  This is actually better than average for Brooklyn, because most places are more than 2 minutes from the subway!  Better subway access, IF you are close to the station, can be had in the following places.  Williamsburg on the L line, if you are not too many stops into Brooklyn, because you come into Manhattan at a more convenient spot.  Any of the few 2345 stops (red and green lines at the same station), just because trains come so often you never have to wait 10 minutes.  Marylyn and Lloyd are pretty nice and helpful, although I settled in to New York fast and didn't really need much help.  I actually didn't see them much and almost never saw the other tenants, because we kept different hours.  Overall this was just what I needed, basically I would call it reliable and convenient.  Everything was taken care of and there were no bad surprises.   Hopefully this review gave you enough information that you won't have any surprises either!

Marylyn was a great host, the studio was great to stay in and everything that you will need is there. It is true that you have to share a bathroom but we never had any problems that it was occupied. Very close to subway and we never felt unsafe. The studio was clean and neat and we were even provided with breakfast cereal, bread, mineral water and soft drinks. I will recommend this to anyone.

The whole process was very easy to use. I've used other services like Airbnb and this was much better. I was able to find Marylyn's very nice studio and communicate with her directly via the site, text and email. I was able to keep her informed of my itinerary as it changed. She always responded quickly and let me know not to worry. She was there when I got there. The studio is clean with thoughtful items, like bottled water, milk for cereal, coffee etc.. These are things you have to earn a bunch of points at a hotel chain to get. :-) This wasn't a tourist trip, so I didn't need to worry about subways and nearby attractions and eateries, though there are plenty around where she lives and I'm sure Marylyn can give you some advice if needed.  All in all, I'm glad I booked her place and will definitely stay again in the future.   p.s. I have a sneaking suspicion that Marylyn and her family are excellent cooks, though I haven't eaten anything. The smell of homemade Caribbean food one afternoon made my mouth water involuntarily. :-) Too bad it isn't part of the room rate!

We were very pleased with the host, we didn't meet Marilyn but George was nice and helpful. The apartment was clean as the pictures shown. The neighbourhood seemed dangerous but we had no problem at all, we were at the block party and it was very fun.

The apartment was spacious and had everything that we needed for the weekend in NYC. The location did seem a little bit unsafe but we had a car so it wasn't a big deal. I can see how a solo traveller might be concern. We never got the chance to meet Marylyn during our stay. George, who lives on the first floor, was very responsive and showed us around when we arrived and even gave us tips on where to park. It was weird to have to leave the apartment to go to the shared bathroom but thankfully, we were the only guests during the weekend and had the bathroom to ourselves.

Upon arrival I was immediately greeted with a key and ushered upstairs. The place was great! Spacious, comfortable and felt like home. I saw a lot of complaints about the area feeling unsafe, and I guess it just depends on the person. I had no issue walking at any time of night to grab something to eat, head to Walgreens, etc. Everything you could need is within walking distance. Including the train which is literally two minutes away. I'd definitely stay again.

Carol is close by, easily reachable by phone, flexible and met us promptly when we called to check in. Place is as pictured, beautiful, filled with antiques. Spotlessly clean! Bed is comfy, AC and TV worked great, even sheets and towels high quality and soft. I felt very pampered. Bathroom is as pictured, very luxurious. Bath is directly off bedroom, one step up, and suite is very private with door that locks from inside. Only differences from pictures, is that fridge and alcove are outside suite in shared hall, but hallway itself is secure. Also suite is reached by front stairs that are straight and carpeted, instead of winding stairs pictured. For a senior this was a plus. House is very quiet, neighborhood is  residential, easily walkable one block to restaurants, markets, drug stores. Highly recommend (for those who can do stairs.)

The description includes a designated space where we could park our car next to the building but it turned out we couldn’t park there. Instead we had to park in a parking garage but the specifics of how to access the parking lot and the fees for the parking garage were not described nor given without our questioning. Nor was this information known by the host. Although our host was not there to let us into the building, there was a tenant or landlord who allowed us in and showed us around, and he was very kind and helpful. When we arrived we informed host but she was unresponsive. Our host started off communication strong by providing quick responses but as we got closer to our trip date, responses to our questions were very vague and unhelpful. The studio apartment was cute both inside and outside however, it was very small. The studio is quite old and vintage in appearance and furniture however, worked for us as we only intended to use it for sleep/rest. If you are looking to relax longer, I would not recommend staying at this location. I would also recommend not walking the streets in the area alone, especially at night. We experienced a scary situation our first night walking through the streets and felt forced to take a cab everywhere as a result.

This is a wonderful studio apartment in the heart of Brooklyn, right off the A C subway lines.  This was our first time in New York and we didn't have any problem using the train or finding the place.  Marylyn was quick to respond to our inquiries and let us check in early!  We didn't get to meet her, but Ingrid was very friendly and accommodating.  This studio apartment is located in an older walk-up brownstone.  We were on 2nd floor.  The bathroom is shared with another room, however, we did not see or hear another tenant so it wasn't an issue.  We didn't see or hear anyone upstairs either!  The apartment was very clean, big windows that could be left open for the breeze, full kitchen.  WiFi worked just fine for us.  We came in at all hours and we felt safe.  We felt like it was a steal and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a clean, safe place to stay whether you are resting your head (like us) or looking for something centrally located and plan on hanging out.  It is a small room, so I wouldn't try to cram any more than 3 people in (not sure how many are "allowed").  Thank you for such a great stay!

Marylyns place is nice if you’re looking for something close to a subway and traveling with no more than 2 people. The area is a little suspect at night as there are people at the corner store all day and night. No one bothered us but I wouldn’t have been comfortable by myself.   Also the a/c wasn’t the greatest especially in the summer. I’d say this is a great place in the fall when you’re going to be with a few people. Not super expensive. It’s a great place to book when you know you won’t be there a lot. Just to sleep.   Also, expect to share the bathroom with whoever is next door to you. I wasn’t fully aware of this when I booked the place. Again, nothing happened but i didn’t expect to share a bathroom with strangers.   Marylyn is a good host and doesn’t bother you. She’s accommodating and a quick responder.

We stayed for three nights. As first time travelers to NYC, we wanted to be close to or in Manhattan. We chose this property because it was close to the city but allowed us to escape the hustle and bustle. The property is only a minute walk from Courts Square metro and the subway goes directly into Manhattan. 15 minutes and you're in Times Square. It is quick, cheap (about $2.50 one-way) and convenient. An Uber or taxi from Downtown is about $30. The neighborhood itself is quintessential gritty Queens but did not appear dangerous and the street itself is beautiful and quite.  The room exceeded our expectations. We thought it would be a small space, but it was the size of a standard hotel room. It was clean. It has a mini fridge, microwave, couch, double bed and air conditioning. The bed was soft and the room was quiet. The bathroom was fantastic. A proper bathroom with big shower, plenty of hot water - plus a sauna feature.  Both Orestes and Cris were wonderful hosts. They were accommodating to our requests and were very welcoming with their home. They lived upstairs, allowing for privacy as well as access to free wifi and most of the whole bottom floor. We were also offered full use of the courtyard at the back, which would be perfect for breakfast in the sunshine or to read a book.  This place is a definite gem and we would highly recommend staying here again.  Thank you again, Orestes and Cris for your kind hospitality.

This has it all. Excellent location to Manhattan and down the block from the subway.  Very safe and quiet neighborhood.  The room was comfy and there is a beautiful outdoor patio with a shade garden to enjoy.  Orestes is a great host who gave us some NY insider tips on what to do and was quick to respond with any questions we had.
Projects with construction and cigarette smoke infiltrated the unit all day to an extreme from the outside. Dopeboys and crackheads everywhere. I barely left the unit due to the unsafe surroundings.

This space is eccentric and antique but it is not very well kept. It is dirty, dusty, grimy and definitely not being cleaned regularly by a service and if it is they should be fired. The beds were comfortable and warm and I hate having to talk about the bad stuff because the host was so sweet and responsive but the rest was difficult to handle and I believe people need to know what they are getting. There was a molding sandwich left in the refrigerator and expired food left in the pantry. The stairs to the third floor are falling apart and a little scary even for an able bodied person. The entryway is packed with shoes and other personal items and difficult to get luggage through. The ‘shower/bathtub is, for lack of a better word, unusable and very dirty. If you are looking for an interesting place to sleep for a night without a shower/bath, I’d say the price is ok for that but as a living space for more than a night it is not great.

I didn't get the chance to meet Doug as he was away for work. His place was extremely clean and very quiet. Location can't be beat in Brooklyn: this part of Fort Greene has ALL the subways + the LIRR in a 5-min walking perimeter. The room is small but functional. I could fit my huge luggage easily. The wall above the bedroom door is now completely plastered (the listing pictures aren't up-to-date), so that was good news. And the BOOKS! They definitely add a unique character to the space.  The second half of the week, there was 2 other guests in the 2 bedrooms around mine, which brought a bit of stress in the mornings as I needed to get to work and the bathroom was needed by all 3.  But overall a very nice stay.

Corey was a great host and the space was beautiful and accurate to the pictures displayed. Communication was easy and Corey was very quick to respond. I felt that checking in was easy and stress free. I felt safe and will definitely be staying here again. This is a gem.

My two friends and I came to town for a week to visit the city and to go to a music festival held by Citi field. This place was PERFECT for us. Very tidy and cozy with a wonderful rooftop area. The neighborhood felt very safe and neighborly.   It took us no time to get to manhattan from Anas place and we were able to WALK back from the festival each night which saved us a ton of stress and uber money.   I couldn't recommend this BNB with Ana more!   She was extremely easy to communicate with and ALWAYS had a big smile or her face that really made us feel welcomed.
Clean, good location, very convenient for a quick simple stay. Didn't bump into anyone while I was there and check-in was so quick and easy that I didn't feel unsafe doing so at 1am.

What a wonderful location in the heart of Williamsburg. Great restaurants and amenities at one’s fingertips. Lovely space and extremely quiet. Beds were really comfortable. Sina and Rob are wonderful hosts and very accommodating.
This place was amazing! I’ll definitely come back. Thank you Sina & Rob

When we arrived to check in there was a homeless person at the very front of the property because there was a lot of garbage in the front yard. The homeless person had their belongings on the front steps and was blocking us from entering the property. We arrived at night and the entrance was very dark because the lights were not turned on at the front door. We tried to call the Host and she did not answer her phone. Once we finally went upstairs the place was not up to our standard of cleanliness. There were stains on the bedroom sheets, on the walls, damages to the power outlet and drywall, broken blinds, rusting kettle. The fire alarm were also removed although it was shown in the listing. We decided to contact Airbnb and leave immediately due to the cleanliness, and our personal safety entering and leaving the property.
Great location and perfect for two of us and a dog for a long weekend! Thanks Rob!

A very convenient location near the subway, coffee places, restaurants and and grocery shops. The apartment is modern and clean. Thank you Rob and Ampere, I had a nice stay in your place. All my best to you!

Rob's place is a hidden gem. The house has been completely renovated and everything inside is new, modern, and sparkling clean. The location is perfect - public transportation (bus, subway) is a block away. Lot's of grocery stores around, including my favorite Food Bazaar. But the best part in my opinion is a quiet neighborhood feel. If you are a digital Nomad - look no further. This place has it all and you will feel like home.

Rob’s place is very clean and organized - he takes care of the place very well and communicates promptly. It offers great amenities and great value - everything was new. The hosts were kind, amazing people and made me feel at home. Many good advice, suggestions were given during my stay. He also shares his culture and food with us, which was the highlight of the experience. There is a subway station close by that takes you easily around town. I would stay here again next time in town.

Ampere and Rob were amazing hosts. Their home is so comfortable and convenient to everything. Ampere is incredible. He is generous with his time and food and so hospitable. This is the best place for an extended stay.

I can't write anything bad for this place. I lived at Rob & Ampere's place for 3 months and I felt like home. The internet is super fast which was very important to me because I work from home. The kitchen is good and supplied with all the appliances you need for cooking.  The bathroom is also great. They organize events with the house residents which I really like.  Both Rob & Ampere are very friendly and easy to talk to so they usually almost immediately help you with anything you need.  The house is a bit far from Manhattan but it's 2 mins away from the Forest Avenue M train station which takes you to Manhattan in 40 mins and its 15 mins away from the L train.  I highly recommend this place.
Great location with everything you could need, surprisingly quiet neighborhood at night, and rob made himself available to any questions. Awesome!

The apartment is located in Brooklyn but very close to Manhattan. It is about 500 m from a Metro line that connects you well. It has an excellent distribution if what you are looking for is that the bedrooms each have privacy as they are separated by the small room where the TV, the kitchen and the bathroom are located.  Rob delivers it in a clean condition and they spend their days comfortably there. It is a bit narrow because there is a lot of furniture. It is suitable for 3 people. I suggest asking Rob prior to your arrival to leave space on the shelves and closets so that guests can accommodate their belongings. We happened to arrive and find everything busy. We had to contact Rob to resolve that issue. Get the idea that you arrive at a friend's apartment who gives it to you with all his belongings, which implies an enormous degree of trust.

This place is the perfect place to experience Williamsburg!  It’s in the middle of everything, restaurants, shopping and any kind of nightlife you are looking for.  We walked everywhere the parks along the waterway are beautiful and a nice place to relax or have lunch.  Rob’s place is super clean and easy to find.  Communication was excellent and Rob went out of his way to accommodate us.  Thanks Rob!!

Micha’s place is super cozy and communication was super easy, the location is amazing, everything you need is around you. Don’t get scared by the building, that’s just ny, is actually super safe and neighbors are nice ;)
Amazing location in BK. It’s also very clean and Rob is a great host. I would 10/10 recommend to anyone looking for a central location!
Great place in a prime location. Rob was very accommodating and helpful. Definitely recommend if visiting NYC!
We had a great stay ! Rob was fast to respond to any questions.  Beds are super comfy. The location is prime !!! Thank you so much we would stay here again in a heart beat ! Thank you 🙏
I really enjoyed my stay. It was easy to access the metro and go to Manhattan. There’s also tons to do in the area. Rob was responsive & friendly! Would stay here again :)

We had a wonderful stay at Rob's Airbnb. The location was excellent, with many restaurants and stores nearby. The room was small but very cozy and comfortable, and Rob did a fantastic job decorating it like an artist. The host, Rob, was also very friendly and made me feel welcome. Overall, I highly recommend this Airbnb for anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay.
Great location for Brooklyn visitors. Rob is great.  The place is clean, and the size is comfortable to stay 4.

Oscar and Rossanna were very communicative and the whole process was very easy and stress free.  The studio is in a wonderful location and it’s easy to get to pretty much anywhere you want to go in the city! The apartment itself was clean and the AC and private bathroom were a huge plus. I highly recommend this place to anyone wanting to spend time in NYC!
I do not recommend it Unpleasant smell Very dirty Doors are safe Not the same as the photos

I like the room but the inside the building it's very sketchy, loud, and a lot of arguments went on while staying there. The host are great and looks like this room is the cleanest one in the building. You get your money worth!
Overall, good for the price and a great location. Suspicious substances on blankets.
Airbnb was beautiful. My friend’s purse got stolen at dinner one night with Airbnb key in it and German drove so we could get into our Airbnb that night.

Zero communication and response to airBnB messages the week of travel until I finally called a few hours before the checkin time to figure out what's going. Got a short abrupt response stating that the apartment was flooded and it's not available. Not a single effort to contact us until we got into town or help. Just told is you should cancel the booking in an attempt to differ the fault to is. I had to stay on hold with Airbnb for hours to get this sorted out and find a hotel last minute, in NYC. Sketchy overall. I would recommend to avoid this listing of you can.

Similar to previous reviews, I also received no communication until the day of, where I called Arnold directly and he claimed there the apartment above had flooded and that I would need to call Airbnb to figure things out. Pretty suspicious and even if its just unlucky that his apartment keeps flooding I would’ve appreciated some notice at some point instead of having to call.

Excellent place! the room look exactly like how it is in picture, cozy bed, roomy room.there is a personal TV as well as to watch. Lucky is a gr8 host.on the very first day, lucky took me to the tour around the area to familiarize me to the places nearby which was very kind. SInce he is fond of cooking, kitchen has all the equipment and even a few which we don't find in regular houses. He is a cleaning buff so the house is always clean and would advise you the same. He always takes care of your privacy and would even walk slowly by your room to not disturb you. He even made dinner too for one day and that too typical Indian style. Cat always stays in his room and barely comes out, so no worries if you are afraid of/ don't like cats. Gr8 neighbourhood as well Lovely place to stay in. Just try to keep everything clean!

Jonn's place is awesome if you are looking to stay in a lively safe place in Manhattan. We had a very comfortable and pleasant stay. Jonn was very helpful with the check-in and queries during the entire stay. The apartment is on the ground floor and it was very easy to access most attractions of the city. Further the apartment is very near the subway station and there are many good quality eating joints nearby.  For the first time visitors to New York Please note  1.0 Jonn's place is great value for money and safety. In general NewYork homes are super tiny, you may have a tough time getting used to the size of apartments in NYC; compared to the general standard Jonn's place is quite decent, be mentally prepared for a comfortable and cozy stay.  2.0 Be careful while ordering online for this address, there are many other occupants in the other apartments in the building and packages are left out in the lobby. Packages may get misplaced or stolen.

Camille’s space was beautiful and had everything I needed to enjoy my week long stay in Bedstuy. Camille was great at clear and consistent communication and also kindly accommodated my request for an early check-in which made my early flight to jfk so much less stressful. I highly recommend staying. The bed is super comfortable and the bedroom is cute , plus so many tasty spots near by .

Camille was super accommodating & responsive. We had a friend come last min & she was able to accommodate the 3 of us at an extra cost. The place itself was well decorated & cozy. The only caveats was that it’s an old building so the walls are paper thin & we could hear footsteps & babies crying from the unit above (when they were home) & below us. There’s also a school across the street & you can hear the kids at recess so I wouldn’t recommend this place for digital nomads as it can get really noisy. Lastly, the pullout couch had a loose leg that fell off while my friend was sleeping on it & the extra pillow had a lot of brown spots so my friend didn’t feel comfortable using it. Location itself was conveniently close to bus stops & the train station. However if you are a single girl walking to/from the train it can feel a little unsafe bc the streets are really quiet. Despite these caveats, this place would be great for a long weekend if you plan on being out & about the entire time.

I had a very good stay according to the price I paid, the best thing is the location and the good communication with Cris, I would definitely stay here again, the only point to improve is that at night there are many homeless in the area but well I think it happens in most of New York., thanks for everything.

This was the worst Airbnb experience I’ve ever had and I am extremely disappointed with the host Anna and the Airbnb customer service representative Joanne. My brother arrived to Anna’s condo first and once he entered the unit, he found that the place had not been cleaned (despite being charged a cleaning fee when booking the reservation). The condo had a stale, foul odor, there was hair all over the apartment (bedding, floors, and bathroom towels), food particles in the kitchen sink and on the refrigerator, as well as mold/mildew all over the shower curtains and the bathtubs in both bathrooms.   I emailed the host Anna about the situation and was told a cleaner would be sent to complete the deep cleaning that I request. When I arrived an hour later to join my brother, the place still had not been cleaned. After I’d been there about 20 minutes, the host Anna and some unknown man arrived with a mini vacuum used to clean hardwood floors.   They removed the shower curtain liners, but did not replace them, and removed one dirty towel with hair on it. Anna had absolutely no cleaning supplies and did not give this matter the attention it deserved, however after I complained to Airbnb, she lied to the customer service representative Joanne, saying she cleaned the place to the best of her ability.   To be clear - no cleaner was ever sent to the condo and Anna’s failed attempt to clean the place did not amount to anything. There was still visible hair all over the condo after the mediocre job done with the mini-vaccum and she did not change the bedsheets which also had visible hairs. We were left without shower curtain liners and could not take a shower. Joanne, the customer service representative assured me she would have the situation resolved within an hour after she was called at 7:25pm. We did not hear from her and after waiting for almost two hours, I called again to complain about the lack of follow up. Shortly after the second call, a full refund was issued.   The dishonesty shown by Anna and her disregard for guests is appalling. To provide dirty accommodations in return is a slap in the face. It’s even more disappointing to be given assurances by Airbnb customer service of a resolution, only to be left hanging without an answer. Both Anna and Joanne ruined my evening. Instead of going to dinner with friends as planned, I spent my night scrambling to secure hotel accommodations. I’m completely disgusted with this entire experience and will never use Airbnb ever again because nothing is worth this type of stress and aggravation.

There's few things I have experienced with this booking,  Bad things,  1. Weed smell was all over the place, starting from entrance, elevator was highly smelly and corridors are just terrible. everyday!!  2. Parking Fees was collected after we checked in, which was not told before. ($25 per day), although someone parked in front of us and the space is very compact for the cars. But felt worthy, only because it was raining and street is little shady, we had to have the parking lot for safety.  3. Place is compact, with limited amenities. Had 2 rooms but a little compact.  4. Unexpected sounds at the midnight from the top floor or beside apartment. (But wasn't repeating every night).     Good things,  1. Host is very quick in responding to messages and cleared the AC issue quickly.  2. Garage fob was given after paying $125 , so we didn't had to it manually.  3. Had someone helped us check in the place, we checked in late, but there was someone waiting for us!!  4. Overall, it was okay.
Great location and very clean!! Steal for the price. I would def stay again when I’m back in NYC   A bit noisy but it’s NYC - he provides ear plugs if needed!

Here is a place that in France we would call a slumlord. The location is correct and the staff pleasant but you will find yourself either in spaces closed by simple curtains, ventilated or heated by low-end heaters or closed "tiny spaces". In my case, the bedroom window was broken, sharp glass visible. In winter it must be excruciating, I understand better why they asked me to leave the curtains permanently closed. The finishes are non-existent with sharp Placoplatre studs and an unpleasant smell of humidity. Apparent cleanliness is a cover for poverty, in reality leaving room for an unsanitary place. The bedding is bad (10 cm foam mattresses...) in bunk beds which move because they are so low quality. Extension cords and multiple sockets run throughout the premises to serve pseudo private spaces and spaces closed by curtains, it's dangerous. I am a great host and I would honestly be ashamed to offer this to my guests. The sheets were clean, that's at least. Go your way.

Had a wonderful 3+ weeks stay at Anderson’s place. My stay was very comfortable and for a solo female traveler… I felt very safe here.  Anderson is an amazing host. She was very accommodating with my very late check in.  She also went above and beyond to celebrate my birthday. We had great conversations during my stay. The cats Lexi and Oscar are adorable ☺️  During most of my stay I took the A & C line to Manhattan so taking the bus B46 (a few mins walk from the house) to the train station was most convenient. The bus ran frequently so no issues there. Crown heights is a very diverse neighborhood with folks from varied backgrounds. Just be mentally prepared to live in such a diverse background and you will be fine. I loved it here.. loved all the food options around in the area. Lastly… I would like to say that staying anywhere in NYC can get very expensive. so given I was able to stay at such a reasonable price here for over 3 weeks, work remotely with excellent internet service, enjoy all the festivities New York has to offer and come back to a very reasonably priced accommodation was a steal! Could not be more grateful to have found this place. Will definitely stay here again in future and would highly recommend it to someone considering long term stay in NYC!

Not going to find much cheaper in Manhattan. It’s a place to sleep and not much more than that. Has a window air conditioning unit in the room. Window shade can be adjusted for privacy and to minimize lighting. One community bathroom: one room has a toilet and a sink, other room has large shower area with metal shelving unit to use for towel and clothes. Everything was clean. Close to Penn Station. Would stay here again.

Jordan was an extremely kind and helpful host. Zero stress, excellent communication, and very welcoming into his shared space. We felt right at home in his house, and felt well-rested after every night. His home is just as one would like it to be, a home.

Great place overall. Location is pretty well connected, however night time around this area can be a little sketchy. I never had anything happen to me, but I could see the occasional crime occurring in the area. Great breakfast cafe right below, easy access to subway.
Great location and views off of balcony and rooftop were amazing.  Bed was very comfy!  We didn't like the shade situation... or lack there of in the bedroom however.

The apartment itself was very correct and clean. The building though felt kind of unsafe with shady people. I only stayed a week but people were fighting in the hall several times. The next door was even sealed by the police.

This place is in a word PERFECT!! Is the perfect location, as clean as it can be, never felt unsafe during our stay, the host are very polite and helpful. I message them just once to ask for an additional service they provide and they answer in less tan 3 minutes and it was a Saturday night!!  We are very happy, and definitely we’ll be back and recommend this place to all our friends!

Very pleasant stay. The accommodation is spacious, comfortable and close to a subway line which allows you to be in Manhattan in half an hour. The instructions left by Christopher were crystal clear. Self-check-in proved very convenient with our flight to NY being delayed by several hours. Overall, an excellent experience!
Overall good. The internet didn’t work and the location was sketchy though.

Pros:  1). Location is great 2). Host is responsive   Cons:  1. Dirty comforters and bedsheets.  2. Bathroom was leaking and dirty. 3. Safety Concern:  homeless person entered the building and started asking for food and alcohol.  4. There is no free parking as advertised 5. Bad noise insulation , you will have hard time sleeping if you are a light sleeper

This was a perfect spot for NYC, small studio well designed to maximize space— 3 beds with plenty of pillows and blankets for each person! Small bathroom but plenty of space for showering— wall mirror for getting ready and full size fridge! Can not say enough about the location— steps from subway entrances, around the block from Macys, Empire State Building, and lots of restaurants! There is a nice little coffee and bagel cafe next door! Walk to Times Square or Penn District!! Even a quick 10-15 min walk to the 9/11 Memorial, The Edge, and other attractions! For the price I can’t imagine being in a better location! Host answered questions immediately- held our bags til check-in and after checkout until we had to leave for airport! Never felt unsafe or uncomfortable in or around area and security at front desk was always friendly and helpful!! We were a group of 5 adult women and couldn’t have a single complaint!

My best experience at an Airbnb. The host is super welcoming and friendly and would also give basic NYC travel hacks. The room was great, clean and all amenities were provided. The location of the place in Upper Manhattan is a steal at this price and is close to the 145th St subway which connects you to most of Manhattan. All in all, great stay!!

The room was just like it is in the pictures. The place is super clean. JP and Andre are very very hospitable hosts. We loved the stay with them. the bathroom is squeaky clean and you will not even know that you are sharing it with another person. JP's place is easily accessible by the subway and the subway station is about  a 5 minute walk. Getting around to touristy spots were around 20 -25 mins by the subway. JP and Andre give you so many suggestions on what to do and how to make your stay more fun. A special mention about the mattress and the sheets are so soft and of really high quality. You can tell that they have spent enough time and thought into setting this room up. From the locking of the door to controlling all the switches in the room is controlled via apps on your phone. They send you a detailed message on what to do with the apps before your arrival so you can be prepared. The surrounding area did not feel unsafe. I highly recommend JP's place for anyone visiting NYC.

The apartment is modern and clean and is located near several subway lines.   However I would not book it again for just myself because the area it is located in is quite unpleasant. If you are travelling in groups it is a good choice.

The good: The apartment is made for tourists, it has an electronic lock, very good facilities, everything very neat, better than a hotel. There is everything to cook, a good refrigerator, air conditioning, good TV, etc. Mike is a very nice person and answered all my questions. The subway is very very close so it is an excellent connectivity option and there are other subway lines that pass a few blocks away as well.   The bad: Since the subway is so close, the noise of the trains is really overwhelming. It was very difficult for us to sleep and it did not fulfill what we needed, which was to rest after a hectic day, for that reason alone I would not stay here again. Regarding the neighborhood: it is a super lonely, dark sector full of factories, car technical services, etc. so there were moments where I felt a little insecure.

The host was very communicative and accommodating. The place didn't have a stove top or cooking utensils which was a bummer and there was a lot of random condiments in the fridge. Also there's a creepy hallway behind the bedroom that leads nowhere and seems dangerous. Overall it worked for what we needed but could've been a little more functional.

JP and Andrew are great hosts. It was great to have somewhere to go back to each evening after exploring NYC where we felt comfortable and safe. We enjoyed the smart home tech - especially as we use a lot of similar stuff at home so that added to the home from home feel! The apartment location is good as it's a short walk from two stations plus bus stops, and there's a nice bar on the corner (Lucille's) but even the short walk to the station felt sketchy when it was dark, and it put us off staying out late in the city. We're really pleased we stayed here though and got to meet JP and Andrew!

Dino’s apartment is in a great area and very well kept. My family and I were looking for a place to stay for a wedding and it’s very difficult to find anywhere in the NY area with 3 bedrooms. Your search stops here! Dino’s 3 bedroom place, with queen beds in all rooms, was spacious, clean, and quiet. The bathroom is filled with any amenities you may need, as well. The bedrooms all have an AC unit inside which was a blessing over a very hot weekend.   My husband and I walked back to the Airbnb late a couple of nights and did not feel unsafe at all. The area was filled with friendly folks, fun bars/ restaurants, and within a 10 minute walk of the L train subway station that could get you anywhere you need to go.   Overall, a fantastic stay where we would definitely be happy to visit again.

Dev & Jen truly set us up for an outstanding stay, with their fast replies to any questions we had about the house or New York. I wish the pictures did justice of how big and beautiful the house is. Once you enter you completely forget you are in New York City because of the size and look of this place. This house slept 9 of us comfortably. The two bathrooms made getting ready in the morning easy, and not a fight to shower first. For the price you pay you are already set up for a steal of a deal, It was a no brainer when we saw this listing. We were not left with any disappointments, only smiles and great memories of a beautiful trip. Thanks again Dev & Jen!

Very clean place with friendly hosts, concerned about our comfort, the apartment is fully automated and that's a show.  The location is not the best, the neighborhood can sometimes feel unsafe at night and it's a bit far from Downtown Manhattan

My experience staying at JP’s was great! The room was exactly as advertised and JP was very communicative/always available!  The neighborhood feels a tad bit unsafe late at night, so I definitely avoided coming back too late.

Jordan’s place was cozy, quiet, and perfectly located for an easy Brooklyn stay. Jordan was also extremely responsive and accommodating. I would gladly stay again and recommend to anyone wanting to make their trip a little more comfortable and stress free.

DON'T DO IT!!! This place is roach infested and I have pictures and video of 3 of them. It has black mold in the tub/shower area, has visible black mold under the rim of the toilet, and the bathroom floor has a dirty film. There are homeless and high people hanging out in front of the building. There is no way this place should have been labelled with a 5 as the review score.  The air conditioner filter is full of dirt and dust which makes for very poor air quality. DON'T DO IT!

Studio plus was in a good location. One block away from Korea town and about 16 minute walk from times news squares. This area was always busy so you never felt unsafe. Although, the place was very small. The host didn’t respond quick to messages and wasn’t aware of our arrival time so we had to wait when we arrived to check in to the Airbnb. The place had trash from the last people when we arrived.

Great Value.. As stated on other reviews - it is an interesting building. But the location in the city is great, so close to subways. The view up 31st St was nice. We didn't necessarily feel unsafe during the 6 nights. There were a few extremely small inconveniences with the apartment that aren't worth making public. Overall the cleanliness was good.  No bugs in sight. Not even dust was visible on anything. Clean bedding and towels. All and all this place is good to sleep, shower and head out to visit the town. To be clear though this isn't really a B&B, The whole building is broken up different types of subletting. Not really important unless you thought you would interact with the host and get home feel.  Lastly, we did check out late on accident and the gentleman that knocked on the door was understanding and let us gather our things and head out. No pressure.

Not a good experience to share or a place to recommend. Missing basic items, cooking was impossible (and dangerous) and the chairs were dirty. Expensive place for the value received. I sent my comments to the administration so hoping they improve. Positive: the location and communication.

My group of friends and I really enjoyed our stay here. If we needed anything Benjamin was quick to respond. The area surrounding it can be quite sketchy, and the GPS had trouble locating the home but Benjamin quickly responded and offered to meet us and walk us to the house. Not far from the home was a subway entrance that took you to many of the main tourist attractions. I would definitely recommend Benjamin’s home for your next trip to NYC!

It took me a while to submit a review because I truly wanted to reflect on my experience.   I typically travel for work and it’s convenient to rent an Airbnb but I’ve never felt like I’ve had to walk on eggshells in any space like I did here.   The rules are  quite excessive and I’m not sure if it’s to protect the space or scare potentials  but it’s  almost uncomfortable to read.  There’s a almost a fee for everything.   I booked the space for 4 people and the listing showed a 2 bedroom with 2 beds in each. When we arrived, we didn’t have the 2 additional beds. We were forced to sleep with on another or on the couch and that wasn’t what we intended.   There was also no additional linings or bedding and we would have to pay for extra.   Then the crazy part was we could only turn the heat up 1 notch. So we were forced to stay in a fairly cold apartment.   I say ease up a little bit. Other than that, nice space.

Thank you Benjamin and Ethan for allowing us to stay in your renovated 4 bedroom 2 bath home.  Very attentive and friendly hosts.  Very welcoming and resolves any issues fast.  Highly recommend this Airbnb to larger groups visiting NYC.  At night it may  look scary as we get off the subway but we felt very safe since we had large guys in our group. Ethan and Benjamin very accommodating hosts.

Benjamin is amazing! His communication is amazing and he responds quickly making the entire process easy and stress free.  The rental was beautiful and a very short walking distance to the subway making travel super easy.  Plenty of space and very clean.  Shopping is a very brief walk which was super convenient and many great places to eat close by.

It’s a really great place to stay at if you don’t want to pay crazy New York prices. It’s about 40 min away from the center of New York on the subway.  It’s also a short walk from the subway to the house but the area is a little sketchy especially if you’re going to the house at night. The house itself is great. Everything is very organize and I would say clean. I was greeted by a kitty so if you don’t like cats then I would recommend for you not to stay at the house or request the rooms besides the Red room. I think the kitty really likes the red room.  She was in my room the whole time besides at night Bc I didn’t want her to by accident pee at night. She was mowing by my door at like 7 am to get in the room. So either she really likes the red room or she really liked me and could smell my two cats on the bag. Either way, I didn’t mind Bc I love cats and she was the best part of my stay. I did get a chance to briefly see the Blue room and I think it looked a little better. So if you don’t mind being on the same floor as two other guests then I would recommend the Blue room or if you want to be left alone by yourself on the floor then I would say the Red room and the kitty will be your partner 😌 I would recommend this place and would stay here again in the future!

This Air BnB is located in Harlem, this neighborhood is rather unsafe and there are a lot of folks with untreated mental illness roaming the streets. With that being said,  nothing bad happened and we enjoyed our time in NYC.

Overall, this is a good value for a 4 bedroom rental in NYC. There is a locked gate and 3 locked doors to get into this apartment. I thought it made me feel safer, but some in our group of 4 adults saw it as a concern. I never felt unsafe, but its good to know that this is Harlem and not the best neighborhood.  The bedrooms are small and basic - this is not a luxury rental. Overall, it was clean. Benjamin was a good communicator and brought extra towels when I requested more. There are two small bathrooms. Please note that if you have an elderly guest this might not be the place for them. My mom is almost 79 and did not feel safe to take a shower since there was no bath mat and nothing to hold onto to get into the tub.  There are window A/C in 3 out of the 4 bedrooms, but not in the living area. When the A/C was on in the bedrooms and the doors were open it did cool down the entire apartment very well (it was hot in NYC during our stay in July).   The outside back patio has a lot of potential, but is not very well kept and is pretty shabby. It was not an inviting place to sit. Its too bad because with a little bit of love this patio could really be a hidden gem!   The subway station is a block away and very good way to get around. We also used Uber which picked us up and dropped us off in front of the apartment. Please note that is costs between $35-$65 to get downtown by uber depending on the time of day you are needing a ride. We went to the Red Rooster for dinner one night which is very close to the apartment (one block away). The food was excellent! Also, Whole Foods was very close which was also convenient. The kitchen is not very well-stocked. We bought paper towels and napkins for the apartment, but luckily we didn’t eat too many meals here so it really wasn’t much of an issue. But be aware, this is not a great place if you are wanting to cook.  Benjamin was easy to communicate with and check-in was easy. This apartment would be good for a family wanting more bedrooms and wants a basic, no-frills rental.

First - the pictures don’t do the place justice. It’s a super cool (and super clean) place! There is a Smart TV with a bunch of apps and a Bluetooth speaker in the bathroom ceiling…both really nice things to have. The house has a private entrance with keypad so it’s easy to come and go.   It’s a 2 minute walk to the closest two bus stops, and about 20 minute walk to the subway without taking a bus. We walked to the house after midnight a few times from a few train stations on the 7 line and didn’t feel unsafe at all (about a mile walk). The immediate neighborhood feels very safe.   Edgar went out of his way to pick us up from the airport after our flight was delayed. We are more appreciative than we can say! He was great at telling us about the neighborhood, where we can get the bus to the train station and just very friendly. Clear timely communication all around and just a pleasure. You won’t find a better host!
Great apartment! Close to a variety of restaurants, bars and the subway. Drug store and groceries very close as well!

Benjamin contacted us upon arrival and stayed in touch during our visit.  The location was good, but not too far away it can get shady.  Easy access to Subway.  Not sure how long ago the remodel was but continued updates should be considered.  If we needed anything Benjamin provided it immediately.  Good value!

We had a great stay at this property! 4 rooms with 5 beds and having multiple bathrooms was great for our group. There is easy access to the subway and multiple doors to get in, and we never felt unsafe. Convenient location, definitely would recommend!

I stayed in this apartment Oct 2022, it was clean tidy and all it needed to be for 5 people, it could of had 6 or 8 if needed but there was the room. The bedrooms  and bathroom could do with a lick of paint and there could be more than 5 plates and cutlery to make it more suitable but we managed perfectly well. Bed was comfortable, location was right by 125th subway, yes there are some homeless people nearby but that is everywhere it’s not just there it was still safe enough to walk around and get around. Ben was a great host was available if we needed anything and always offering to help if any issues. I would recommend this stay

Good apartment, it fits perfectly for a stay in NY. The host was attentive to us at all times, responding quickly to any questions we had.  The neighborhood was quite deteriorated, with quite a few homeless people on the streets, but we have not had any problems, nor have we felt unsafe. We would choose it again!!

The location was great and the subway was an easy 2min walk which gets you to downtown pretty easily. However I would not recommend it for families as there were many homeless people and the neighbourhood does not seem safe. We encountered a person arrested just outside the place and many people asking for money. A man even tried to kiss my daughter! There were also people going through the trash.  The house was bare and we had to buy our own kitchen towels, dish washing detergent and hand wash. While the host sent us some after I asked, it was only done the next night. There was no washing machine but there is a laundromat around the corner but then again we avoided going out due to the surrounding. Overall the house was ok but I wouldn't stay again.

We had a lot of fun with our time in NYC and the place we stayed in was nice but it's also central Harlem so it's dangerous and loud at night, lots of fights in the street outside our window lol, but if you can keep to yourself you'll be all good!!!
The house was great everything good is just the location I didn’t like because to much homeless outside and Crazy people but house was great!

I went with a group of 8 to NYC. We loved how clean the place was and we were able to fit everyone comfortably in the space. Some of the reviews here talked about how unsafe it is but honestly, we didn’t feel unsafe at all! This location was more on the edge of Harlem going into Manhattan but it wasn’t a problem. The location of the BnB  perfect as everything was easy to walk to in the area. It’s located near easy to eat spots, transit, and some shopping. The transit part was the best! Can easily take the bus or the subway down into Manhattan or wherever you want to go. The host was friendly and communicative. Check in and check out was easy to do. I would recommend this place if you want to take a trip to NYC.

Overall our stay was great, centrally located, close to all public transportation, great restaurants, convenience stores and clothing stores. The place is a great deal for the number of people that it can accommodate. Remember it is located in central Harlem so you’ll have your fair share of homeless but that’s to be expected. There were a few things I privately messaged to host to make the next people’s stay even better!

Great location still pretty good value for what u get.   there are couple problems tho. firstly there’s photos of an amazing living room for chilling and that’s not available at all according to one of the ppl that live in the house long term, the other living room/room is occupied by another long term renter.  secondly the kitchen,   kinda not really a problem for me as i don’t really use it but could be cleaned up a bit. fridge was a mess i had some take out and was kinda afraid to move things aside for my food…   lastly could have had some more towels me and my girlfriend both have long hair and we only had 2 large towels which are on the smaller side it got kinda cold… plus we used one for a mat because the toilet floor was pretty dirty so really only used one for drying lol  but still all in all good value small stuff that could make it way better if the living room was available and had some bottled water would give a 4 star if all things mentioned fixed would give a 5   host was away so this may have caused these issue and i didn’t proof read this so yeah…
It was a shared apartment and was not organized or ready. Felt so unsafe with my two daughters, we decided to not stay there and booked a hotel instead. No refund was made. A worst experience ever.

Stay away.  Place not taken care off.  Please see photos.  Host unresponsive, as we left a private message to let them know.   No response to date.  Walls are dirty, dirty socks and other under the bed.  Place not cleaned well.  Smells like pot in the apartment and many shady folks in the lobby.  People do not follow Covid rules and people walk without masks from their lobby.  Made us very nervous.  Would never stay here again.

DONT STAY HERE!!! This complex is used as a homeless shelter. On 5/09/21 a murder took place inside the elevator! We had to move to a different hotel that night without any of our belongings do to investigation going on. Just stay away!

STAY AT THIS AIRBNB! Liz is a lovely and attentive host. She was incredibly communicative and responded quickly to our questions and issues, which was only one. The lockbox was frozen after a cold, rainy night, and I had trouble opening it to get the keys for the apartment. Liz was incredibly speedy in addressing the issue and sent her super nice boyfriend and adorable puppy, Piper, to bring us another set of keys. From there, my boyfriend and I were cozy in the apartment. It was sparkling clean with comfy blankets and towels. We felt at home there in the middle of Chelsea on a trendy block next to a variety of great restaurants, a McDonalds, Dairy Queen, Dunkin'/Baskin Robbins, a Duane Reade and a grocery store. Liz had coffee and tea ready for us when we arrived. We would have loved to use the backyard if it wasn't so cold, but we of course used the huge TV to stream movies and shows. For the rate we paid, this Airbnb was a steal, and we're so happy to have had the opportunity to stay at Liz's Airbnb. We definitely plan to stay here again in the future.

The barn is quite a unique experience. It has a lot of charm mixed in with modern amenities. The beds were extremely comfy. There was plenty of space for our 4 person family. Although we have two teenagers, they were fine with all of us sleeping in the loft. Jenna even provided us with an air mattress so each of my kids had their own bed and we all fit in the loft perfectly. The kitchen is VERY well equipped. Everything you need to put together a meal is available. The bathroom shower is very small. Larger stature folks should be aware that it may be a little uncomfortable. My family was fine with it though.  The plant based natural body wash, shampoo and conditioner was a nice touch. The wifi signal strength was a little sketchy which my kids were of course not pleased about, but since we were not there for work, it didn't pose much of a problem. Since the barn still has the original flooring, it is VERY creaky. When someone decides to walk downstairs you will definitely hear it. The air conditioning worked really well. It happened to be some of the hottest days while we were there, so the AC was a big bonus for us. Parking is very challenging in the neighborhood at night. Several nights were spent driving around looking for a spot. The location was very convenient. Close to lots of shopping (NIKE outlet and Target close by). Very quiet at night. Jenna was VERY responsive and kind. We really enjoyed our stay at the barn.

Roula's place was AMAZING!! Everything was excellent! The room was immaculate, it was an absolutely amazing location, and the doorman was always so friendly and made us feel so safe. The plethora of waters, towels, and décor was amazing and we felt so at home! It was absolutely perfect! Also, the amount of helpful tips and advice Roula gave was so valuable and made our stay stress-free! I would LOVE to stay here again! I can't recommend Roula's place enough!

Alex was a nice host and very accomodating. The place was pretty interesting, tho there were some confusing things about it (particularly light switches), and a couple things that didn't work quite right, like one of the shower doors. But those things were pretty minor. It was a bit of a sketchy neighborhood, but that didn't really end up being a problem at all. It would have been nice to make a note of that in the listing tho, for outsiders who don't know.

We had a great stay at Kevin’s apartment. Clean and accurate to photos. Bed is huge, however difficult to sleep as the pillows were too big, would have preferred normal pillows. Area felt a tad unsafe at night time but super close to the subway, Starbucks and McDonald’s which was super handy and convenient. The apartment is about 30mins on the subway from Times Square. Kevin was a great host, super responsive and communicated check in instructions and provided directions etc.

We never actually met Claire but she always responded to our communications quickly.  The welcoming person who let us in was very nice. I would like to point out a few issues that are totally redeemable, though...  1. Fruitflies were everywhere, not many but 1 or 2 in all the rooms we went into (bedroom,bathroom,kitchen)  2. There was no hand soap or conditioner in the bathroom   3. Either the walls are very thin or the permanent resident in the next room played his TV loudly late at night 4. The wood floors are super creeky & LOUD (not sure what can be done about that.. carpet/rug maybe?), so when people are walking in the hallway at 2am, it wakes you up 5. The light in the hallway is extremely bright and is kept on all night, so if you have to get up in the middle of the night to use the bathroom... 🎶blinded by the light🎶 lol  Also it comes through the door edges into the room 6. Nothing can be done about this and it's not bad but heads up... these buildings are extremely old and have no temperature control, so in the winter the radiators get very hot in the rooms so a window will need to be kept open.   Otherwise all was well.  We came and went as needed, resident dude was helpful when needed.  Towels were provided and full use of the kitchen if needed.  We never had to wait for the bathroom. And I'm totally stealing her remote light control idea which I absolutely loved!! 😁

No privacy, the property owner accused me and my spouse of smoking in the rental while I was at a meeting with a client. The place had such a strong aroma of air freshener that it gave me a migraine. Passive aggressive Notes everywhere in the rental. It just was completely unpleasant and I would honestly not recommend this to anyone unless you want to be treated like a child. The bed is uncomfortable, a fold out futon, the place is tiny for the price and location. We did not enjoy ourselves and actually spent the majority of the night with friends to avoid the rental.  I have never had a negative experience through air bnb until this.

MUST STAY!! We stayed here for our NYC trip and things were fabulous! we are from a small town in MN and this was the little bit of "home" that we needed. It was nice and cool with a/c running when we got there. comfortable living room. kitchen with all the appliances and dishware you need. the bathroom is spacious and tidy. the water gets nice and hot! the bedroom has the most comfortable bed with giant pillows. we snuggled in watching Netflix each night. the bedroom has an a/c unit so we stayed nice and cool. This place is a steal and we will definitely come back!!

We had an outstanding experience in our favorite city! Rafael is an extremely attentive host. he responds to inquiries very quickly, he took time to offer tips and advice, and he is very honest and up-front about costs so you don't get hit with unexpected charges.We  found this place to be clean, comfortable,and conveniently located. I experienced vehicle trouble during the trip, and Rafael went above-and-beyond to try to accommodate my needs given the unexpected and stressful circumstances I highly recommend Rafael and his place!

Marco and his place are both great. Outside of the apartment being located in a bit of a diamond in the rough, once you make it into the apartment itself, stress just melts away. The place has a very light and comforting energy about. I had no qualms with anything during my stay there, and if I had an inquiry, Marco was helpful in not only responding quite fast but answering any question very thorughly. I have no regrets staying there. Great space to center yourself. Nice little entertainment nook in the living room. And There's a rocking chair by the window with a great view of overlooking the street. Very tranquil at night. If you need some peace and quiet for yourself, or have good quiet times with a friend, this place is worth renting! If Marco would have me back, I'd definitely go back.

Exactly as described. And HUGE for the area. We live about 15 blocks away and were very jealous! My scared-of-New York City in-laws were very comfortable in Gustavo’s place (and he was very understanding of them!). The apartment is up one flight of stairs and they’re very easy to navigate, which we were a bit worried about for our older family members. But it was all a breeze!

The hosts are wonderful people, both kind & understanding. This is a quiet room in astoria, queens. Lots of families in the area. It was a clean place, and the kitchen was full functioning with usable dishes. The shower came with amenities, and you will be provided a towel. Be prepared to make a 10 minute walk to the nearest bus & train station to the city. The sheets and pillows felt exceptionally clean. However the towel had that dry old towel smell, I suspect from the rotations. Additionally, I must say I killed a small roach in the bathroom during my first night, but I never saw any other insects again throughout my trip. Wonderful stay for a great value

This place was great but there were some things that I wish they could improve on!   1) Self entry. As soon as I came they greeted me and told me what to do and what not to do which wasn’t bad but I travel a lot and I like to have my own space  2) The owners live right up stairs and the walls are very thin so you hear them a lot during the stay.   3)I opened the window to get a breath of fresh air and they immediately messaged me and said can you shut the window if you have the air on. Which alittle scary because I’m not sure how they knew that quickly.   Other than that this was a great stay, you can’t tell that they took their time on this place. It was also in a great location

I would avoid this place if you intend to stay longer than a weekend. The initial check-in was immensely stressful. We arrived promptly at 3pm and still had no instructions on how to enter. After numerous messages and a phone call we still received no response. It wasn’t until an older woman in the upstairs apartment came out and told us it was almost ready that we could breathe easy and felt the panic of being scammed subside. It wasn’t until forty minutes later that we could enter the space. The host sent instructions with a vague explanation that the previous guests trashed the place. While I can sympathize with that the lack of ANY communication was inexcusable. We were clearly just an afterthought.   Upon arrival the space was clean but had almost no essentials in the kitchen. We had to request cups. There was a few forks and knives thrown into a drawer and two pans. Thankfully there was a microwave. No dishwasher which I knew going in, but no dish rack or dish towels provided.   The space is dark and dismal since it’s a basement apartment. Made worse by the fact that 6 of the 12 lights were out when we entered. Again, no thought given to our arrival. We requested the lights get fixed and they were the next day along with the cups.   There was no a/c unit which we had to request as well, but I will say that was put in very quickly. The man taking care of all these requests was a delight though. His name is Jean and he deserves all the credit for the few positive moments we had.   All in all this host is woefully underprepared for her guests and puts no time into making the space a comfortable or cozy place to stay. For the price she’s asking it’s simply not worth it. The lack of communication made us question everything from the onset and she did nothing to make up for the time we lost. Much better areas and hosts out there for the money.

Basement is so dirty. The floor is clean, but bathroom is disgusting with doesn’t work sink and shower. Our friend has allergy so everywhere dust was a problem. Area isn’t safe - you must know about dangers in this part of Brooklyn. Host is realy nice - we could stay 2 hours longer what was so comfortable.

Be careful! It's far from Manhattan, it's a dangerous neighborhood, in a dirty, old building. I only stayed for 1 hour and had paid for 5 days, I preferred to lose the money over our safety. The apartment is ok inside, but outside it is very bad. They didn't return my money. I don't recommend it.

This place is good. Host has good communication. The place has everything you’ll need. It’s not far away from the subway. The neighborhood was okay, tho it gets a bit scary during the nighttime. Overall, it is good place and worth the money. Thanks.

The area is not very nice and dangerous, outside the house there was a lot of garbage from the same house, we had problems so the owner's customer service was not good, he did not help us solve our problems, cockroaches, dirty kitchen, garbage without bags in the trash cans, we could not put the air conditioning to our liking because it had a key,

Walking the streets of Brooklyn was a little scary for an outsider, but as soon as we walked into the apartment at night, we felt safe and at home. The living space is large and comfortable and we had a good time.

Was a good place to stay for my group of 6. Very reasonable price for New York but you do kind of get what you pay for. Not a super nice area but we never felt unsafe, just had to travel to really do anything. Place itself is just super basic, no frills, some updating definitely needs done before I would call the place “nice.” Just a good place to use to crash in the evenings.

Amazing place - huge windows with sunlight streaming through, gorgeous floors and brick wall.  It is also really spacious for a NYC apartment - 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, large common area.  There was easily enough seating for our entire family with a large table and two couches which comfortably seated all of us.  This was important to us because we were ready to sit comfortably after a busy day of sightseeing and there was ample room to do this.  The beds were comfortable and the air-conditioning was great.  Others commented on the area but we did not feel unsafe at all - it's simply urban, on a busy road and it's NYC so there is construction going on down the road.    Subway was a 5 minute walk and easily took us to our different destinations.  Communication was great and we enjoyed our stay.  Definitely recommend.

Petra was very quick to communicate. Her and her daughter were very nice.  However, the house smelled horribly of cigarettes the whole stay, and one night the smell of pot was completely overwhelming. It was very apparent that someone smoked inside the area that we were staying in.  The area is very sketchy. I would not have been comfortable walking to the subway alone.  Petra’s daughter was home from college and she was not very clean. Dishes were left out overnight and the bathroom was very dirty.  They were not quite. One night they came home and I could here them banging things around until 2:30-3 in the morning. And another night the daughter came down from her room upstairs and was watching a movie in the bedroom right next to ours at 2 in the morning.
Very convenient if you plan on taking the bus, location can seem shady late at night though. Mostly clean, highly recommend for short stays

Excellent location, great host and a clean space with very thoughtful touches! I stayed here for 7 nights and thoroughly enjoyed it. Can’t stress how great the location is. Silvana was very responsive and is a fantastic host. Highly recommend and would love to come back should I be looking to stay in Chelsea.

The reviews and description are spot on. Very clean & stylish room, communicative host, and nice amenities. I loved the pour over coffee in the room. They also allowed for a very early check in, which was so wonderful. Will definitely stay here again - it's a steal for NYC!

This place looked really good on picture so I was very excited to experience it. But after I got to the place, there were things that are not comfortable but cannot be told merely from picture. First of all, the LYRIC building is VERY close to the building across the street. I lived on the third floor and all I can barely open my shadows because I’m afraid of being seen from the building across. And I did not figure out what’s that building for, but it was very scary at night. Second thing. The room is very dark. It looked good on the picture, but when you actually have to live there you’ll realize how difficult it is to not be able to have light in the room. Third thing is fire alarm went off one night around 4am. Everyone came out of the building. Generally, not so great an experience.

Such a beautiful and clean space with plenty of room. Easy to get in and out, lovely neighbors, and a quick walk to the subway. It was so cozy and homey, and really was the cherry on top of our magical stay in the city. We felt right at home and slept great after every day's adventures. They have supplied pretty much anything you might need but couldn't pack! There's plastic dishes if you have kids, and umbrellas in the closet if it rains...really so many small perfect conveniences that you kind of just deal without when traveling bc you just can't bring everything.   There is quite the check list of things to do before checkout. We got up at 7a, and between eating breakfast, getting ready, packing all our things on top of what we were supposed to do before leaving, we were locking the door right as the woman arrived to clean exactly at 10a. That part was pretty stressful since there's a very hefty late checkout fee. It really was a lovely and charming place though! I totally understand wanting to keep it nice, it just would have been a lot more feasible if checkout was a little later.

Very nice 2 bedroom apartment in Chelsea. Very central location, very close to Highline and Chelsea Market.
