Easy access to West Village, Greenwich and Soho and subway stations nearby to get anywhere else in the city. Clean and spacious for a Manhattan apartment. A little noisy at night (especially in front bedroom that gives onto the street) but that is to be expected in Manhattan. 2 nice restaurants just under the apartment and many others nearby. Just be aware that stretch of 8th street near apartment is probably not the nicest in the city but we walked around with children and never felt unsafe.

Michael is very good at communication. He was there when we checked in at 2 am and helped us carry our luggages up to the 5th floor! The apartment is on the 5th floor with no stairs, so please be aware of that. The apartment has everything we need and it was very good value for money. The location was amazing - right at everything and very close to the subway. The downside was that it was close to Penn Station, so there are some homeless people. Overall, it was a great experience and a great exercise for us. Walking up and down 5 floors everyday definitely make me lose weights (which is great!)
The locating overall was great but there is a lot of activity out front that made it a little scary to come back by yourself. Great place for a large group sticking together

Kathryn’s apartment was not what I expected. The listing is inaccurate and many of the amenities stated were not included. On checkin, there were roaches, black mold in the AC, used douche bottles, mystery liquid, a used sex toy, and bad smells. There is also no available closet. The host is responsive, but tried to charge me $350 for a keycard replacement that actually costs $50. She does not actually own the apartment and manages it for her sister. I reserved the apartment for 6 months and when her sister had to travel back to NYC for an emergency, she kicked me out 2 months early, which was extremely stressful and inconvenient. When her sister came back, she tried to enter the apartment without my consent. Furthermore, the listing price is wildly higher than the actual value of the apartment. The apartment is ground level and looks out on the building courtyard, and for that reason is extremely noisy. I would avoid this apartment and wish I hadn’t given kathryn my money for it.

Al’s home was so so beautiful and spacious. The first time my group and I stepped in, we were like “No way this is an NYC apartment.” We appreciated the extra air mattresses provided, as not all of us wanted to sleep together on the beds. Al was very attentive and responsive to any concerns we had. The wifi didn’t work the first night’s stay but Al came by with a technician from the ISP when none of us could stay behind and wait. The neighborhood was very nice and felt safe, with many restaurants and bars literally footsteps away. For my non-native NYers this stay might be a little far from the closest subway for you if you’re trying to get in to Manhattan (especially if you’re carrying lots of bags/luggage). I’m used to the walking so it was fine for me, but others in my group were a little annoyed. Our only other concern was the getting into Al’s apartment. Although we felt safe because of the security of the building as a whole, we were constantly fighting with the entrance door to the apartment in the sense that 1) the door did not close fully, 2) it was hard to unlock and lock the door when entering/leaving, and 3) we thought it a bit unsafe that the only thing keeping the door secure was one lock that could’ve been broken in to. Other than that, we had a great stay and would definitely recommend this stay for groups!
Mint House ABSOLUTELY exceeded my expectations. This is, without a doubt, the best airbnb experience I've ever had, I can't stress this enough.

Robert's apartment is ideally located, a 5/10 minute walk from a metro station which then serves the most popular areas of New York. A 5-minute walk away is also a very beautiful park which allows you to take the ferry to reach South Manhattan. The accommodation is located in a peaceful and quiet area. The apartment is pleasant, tastefully furnished, functional and equipped with everything you will need. Finally, Robert is a great host! Always attentive, very responsive, attentive and full of good advice. Our flight was delayed and Robert kindly agreed to let us stay in the apartment longer. If we come back to New York, we will come back to Robert's apartment.
James made a place to stay stress free for our weekend trip. His apartment was very clean and it was the perfect amount of space for 2! We’ll be happy to return to his place when we go back to NYC.

SOooo, I don't usually do this, but I have to because everyone should read this review before booking. James place was literally the best AirBnb I've ever stayed in between Philly and NYC. I don't want to spoil the awesome surprises you'll see upon arrival, but this had me all cheesy and impressed. The super spot on communication was the first 5 star experience. Easy straight to the point, not creepy. The second was getting In and actually seeing that the apartment looks even better in person; I can understand  that the Photos cant fully do it justice. Drenched in sun, warm, and has central air. Super clean and amazing amenities (again, I don't want to spoil it, as they were pleasant surprises to me!) just know you can have a real BK experience here, he provides where to find drink, food, has the coolest apple remote that took me 30 minutes to figure out lol. I'll stop rambling but from the softness of the bed and sheets, to the nice fair size of the Studio, the only issue I found was that the door sounds like someone is coming in because of the wind, and as a small woman alone at first it scared me haha. But the only real issue is that I didn't book a month!

This place is exactly what it looks on the pictures. Super clean and comfy. The bed is perfect, the kitchen is super practical and the shower amazing.  Yes you can heard a little bit of music on week-end nights but nothing to be afraid of. However the light in the morning can be annoying. Curtains (or night masks) would make the stay perfect !  The location and the tips given were cherry on the cake.

We were afraid of the location far from Manhattan but ultimately it was perfect because the area is quiet and the subway is 100m from the accommodation. Jerrell is available and left us lots of good addresses when we arrived. The accommodation is impeccable! THANKS !!

The house is located near the subway, it took us a little while to locate it but we found it at the right time. There was a little noise at night, since it was close to an addiction rehabilitation center, it was a little scary, but the truth is we walked around and nothing ever happened.

Besinfe's place was very quiet and large and clean. I was staying there for interviews and felt like I could come and go comfortably and never had any issues getting sleep or using amenities. Because it's right on Broadway I found it easy to get to which is great for someone not familiar with New York. Besinfe is a thoughtful host and asked me many times if there was anything I needed. I really enjoyed the neighborhood and sitting on the fire escape with had lovely views of the water and the sunsets. There's a mix of cheap places to eat and more "hip" bars all within walking distance. It felt more like a place where people live and less like a tourist center which I enjoyed. The perfect place to stay to get a real New York experience! Totally a steal!

Well where to start! Jay was an extremely accommodating host, who was very helpful! This apartment though is in the Harlem though and not Manhattan at all.  The neighbourhood was sketchy.  The room was simple but not as clean as I would like.  As there were left over items under the bed and the white doors had dirty smudges and spots all over.  While we stayed we did see a few cockroaches which I was not very happy about.  There were no face cloths and no bedside tables in our room.  This place would do the trick if someone just needed to crash and then go.  It was ok but not what I was expecting.  The subway was very close and we were out from early morning until late at night which made our stay a bit more bearable.  Great city!!!

I found Besinfe to be friendly, courteous, very helpful and dedicated to his role as host, and a really nice person. For example, on my last day he not only called a very early morning taxi for me to get to the airport as pre-arranged, but also got up and helped me with my luggage out to the street.  I was grateful and impressed. I think it's a v good locality. There's a bus at the apartment building door, and the subway is about 5 minute's walk. I enjoyed the colour of having lots of different nationalities and languages in the street. I stayed a little more than a week and never felt unsafe, as some friends had predicted I would.  The apartment building is worn, a bit knocked about but tidy and safe. The apartment itself is fine -  spacious, well cared for, clean and tidy. I won't hesitate to go back there to stay. I enjoyed being there and enjoyed too my interactions with Besinfe.

To start off, he keeps a spare key right outside the door in plain sight. This is very unsafe. Anyone can enter the room. Moreover, My room's lock didn't work. When i asked the host, he said to not worry and that no one steals anything. Not only is the front door not secure, neither was my private room.  He also told me to lock a bathroom because it was out of service. I also ran out of toilet paper mid week. He told me to buy some more and he would reimburse me. I still never got my money back. The bathroom shower had long hair scattered on the floor. I never used the garbage at the apartment but there were still 2 full bags that were just left out for 3 days. He also has repeatedly contacted me to take this review down in exchange for money.   Be very careful when dealing with this man. He probably has contacted all the people who leave bad reviews and tells them he would pay $$ in order to get rid of them.  Over the phone he records the last part of the conversation and then threatens to send it to airbnb and states airbnb will take the review down due to "blackmail" however he will leave out the start of the conversation where he baits you into suggestion $$ for taking the review down. Extremely shady behaviour. Would not recommend.

I stayed here for 5months and it was a bad d experience for me. The location is sketchy, a lot of homeless around this area.  Also, there is additional gas and electricity fee of over $150 each month. The problem was the heater wasn’t working sometime on cold weather so i had to buy several blankets and still freeze. This building is nonsmoking building but other people at the building smoke a lot and I suffered from the smell of weed. I had to report this problem for like four times and they were like I am the only person who reported for smoking problem. I was very disappointed by their attitude. I do NOT RECOMMEND

Once your inside Tony's place it is fabulous!! His style and attention to detail is great.  Pros: lots of room, very comfortable bed and furniture, great internet and tv's, easy communication and check in and check out.  Easy walking to all areas of town. Cons: from the taxi to Tony's door is a bit scary for a girl who has only stayed in hotels in NYC before.  Really dirty sidewalk, doors, hallway and stairs.  Noise level was high, never a break from it. Bedroom is on the street side so it feels like your really in the middle of it all.
Stressful check-in, dirty air conditioner, old sofa bed

If you need a place to crash at the end of the day then this is it. It's a street away from the subway, it's clean, and the host is very lenient with check in time and check in arrangements. My wife and I arrived to the apt location very early in the morning and went into the city to site see a bit. In the midst of our sight seeing the subway line underwent a track construction that delayed us getting back to the rental in time to check in at 2pm. Fortunately, the host was awesome and checked us in and left the keys for us when we made it back.   Only negative I would say about this is the physical location. The Bronx can be a pretty sketchy place, as we discovered, but I would definitely stay here again if we decided to save a bit of money. If you stay here, make sure if you have anything planned in the city to leave at least 2-2.5 hours early. They are replacing the rails currently and it already takes about 53 minutes to get downtown    Other than that it was a decent place to return to at the end of the day and sleep.

I'd like to start by mentioning the positives. Justin was a quick communicator. His restaurant recommendations were spot on. We tried almost all of them, and he had a huge list! The location of his apartment was amazing, in the brownstones of West Village, steps away from the coolest bars, restos and coffee shops. We took the subway all the way in from JFK, and the stop was just a short two blocks from the apartment -- so easy. Comfy bed. Good water pressure in the shower. But ultimately, what sold me was the photos. This apartment had the charming touches that would let us live like locals for 6 days. However, it turned out those photos were no longer accurate.  When we entered for the first time, we almost thought the place had been robbed. 90% of the art on the walls was gone, with just the nails and bare spots left behind. So were the coffee tables, a side table, the stools for the kitchen counter, a bookshelf, the cool gold pendant lamp, the plant in front of the window with no curtain. Even the toaster he mentioned in the listing was not there.  The title and his description for his place stresses the word CLEAN, but the rugs weren't vacuumed and dustbunnies were everywhere. I don't think a professional is getting the cleaning fee.  The basics weren't there. We were allotted one towel each, for six days. There was no dish soap. And 1.5 rolls of toilet paper. Justin was kind enough to give us some more toilet paper and hangers when I asked, but he said he hadn't thought the coffee table would be missed.  We didn't have anything to put our drinks on when we sat on the couch. The night we wanted to Netflix and chill, we macgyvered a drawer on a suitcase, to make a table.  It wasn't what I was expecting. It wasn't the pride of hosting that I have experienced at other Airbnb rentals. I wouldn't recommend it to my friends. It's a decent place, but when it was so different from the pictures, it just felt like false advertising.

For the price, you can’t get a better experience than here. It was clean except for walking up the stairwell to the apartment. Smelled like musk, cigs, and weed. But, the smells are gone once you are in the place. The place was super clean. The shower has cute colorful lights with extra clean towels! Also, the sheets and blankets were clean along with a working air conditioning. I have bad allergies and I did not sneeze in the apartment. The kitchen is great and there is tea! I went with my mom and partner. My mom took the smaller pop up cot. She has bad back pain and the small cot was perfect and she slept very well. There are memory foam pillows. The bronx is stereotyped as being a very dangerous place. However, this location proved otherwise! The streets are very well lit. The subway is around the corner. The street parking is free and safe while there is one day for a few hours that you cant park. My family became regulars at the 24-deli store around the corner. The man who works there cooked up the best philly cheese steak ive ever had for only $4! He also would make us his special tacos. Also the fruit there is very sweet! Moreover, Golden Krust is around the corner too! Although we traveled all around NYC from Soho to Manhattan, we saved our stomachs for the local food in the Bronx. The subway to soho is about an hour. I thought it was worth it because I would never have gone to this area without staying there. I will be coming back!

Is good place to stay near Manhattan (45 min by metro) if you are in a budget trip, is clean, comfortable, very near to metro station, the area is ok but I would not recommend it for women alone, it look a little bit unsafe, but if you are a couple definitely I will go there. Thank you for all!

My stay with Glenn was great! He's a really nice guy and very hospitable. The price you pay for this location is a steal! About a ten minute walk to the heart of midtown. He worked with me for check in and check out and helped me get around the city with subway advice. Overall, great experience!

This was my second experience in an Airbnb. My first one hadn't been pleasant and I was scared about this one. But guess what, all what you can read about Glenn like how approachable, willing to help and make you feel happy and enjoy your time in NY is true. There's not trick. The only trick in my stay was how funny and ready Glenn is to have the best conversations with you.   The apartment is small and old, but it portrays the best New York style from the past. And if you are thinking about privacy for the shower or bathroom time, Glenn is invisible.   I would finish saying that as a traveler it is always great to meet people whose motivation is to make others feel happy and enjoy life. I will keep that in my mind forever besides the magnificent city New York is. Glenn is the best.

5 stars are not enough to express how great this trip was ! It was my second time in NY and I'm almost sad I didn't know about Glenn's place the first time : the place is very nice, the bed is the most comfortable one I have seen in years (it really is !), it's in a great area next to pretty much everything (I actually saved a lot in transportation fares!) but it is still surprisingly calm for Manhattan.   If you're reading the comments because you wanna know more about the shower thing , do not be afraid : Glenn is very respectful of your privacy and I did not feel weird taking a shower at any time. His cats are also great and they won't be any annoyance !  And finally, beyond the room, the best thing about this AirBNB is Glenn himself: he is a very nice person (the kind the world needs more of), very interesting and if you get the chance to go to one of his comedy shows, do it ; it was a real NY-style awesome experience ! 👏🏻   Thank you Glenn and if I ever come back in NYC, you can be sure you're the first person I will contact !

Great place to stay in NYC if you are on a tight budget. Minutes walk from  Times Square area. The neighborhood is very safe to walk around at night with tons of restaurants and bars. Glenn is very responsive to questions and respectful about your privacy. The place is clean from inside.  Couple of things that could have made it a 5 star stay for me: - Ventilation and natural light. At times , I found myself stuffy. - Ability to lock the guest bedroom at night. While Glen was very respectful of privacy, I found it a bit unsafe especially the first night that I could not lock the room

Glenn is definitely a Superhost and welcomes you everytime you come home if he's home. He makes sure you feel comfortable at his place and will give tips and help you if you need. He was easy to contact and very understanding of my flight being 8hr delayed that kept changing my check in time. He also let me check out as late as I need to. The place is exactly as described and in an extremely convenient area. I felt safe walking at night by myself (there are homeless people). It was an interesting shower experience and can be a little difficult to get out if you're under 5ft like me. Overall he made my first experience in New York easy and comfortable.

The bedroom we stayed was big enough and ok clean but the common space was not clean especially bathroom, and we weren't able to use the kitchen since there are left over food and uncleaned dishes...  Location is conveniently near the metro but it is so close that it was hard to sleep at night(If you are deep sleeper, then this place is perfect for you!). The neighborhood is ok, but I would probably prefer staying other parts of Brooklyn. It was a bit too dark/scary at night walking. Overall staying was ok thinking what they offered with their cheaper rate. If you are planning to be out most of time on your trip, then this place is a great place to stay.

The space at Dylana’s was such a great choice for me, when I needed to stay in the area for a meeting. Even though there was a slight anomaly with her check-in process, I was messaged an alternate process the day-of, which was easy to follow and understand, and not stressful. The space itself was comfortable and spacious. No frills, but plenty of space and resources to store or prepare my own snacks/food that I brought. Would love to return whenever I need to be in the area again. Thank you, Dylana!

Merci mille fois merveilleux Aida!  Spacious well appointed bedroom, with those touches that make a difference:  big functional windows that provide sunlight and fresh air, two sets of drapes both sheers and blackout, in the closet rod space, hanging shelves and a set of hooks on the back of the door, bedside tables with drawers, bedside lamps and nearby outlets for your electronics, firm bed and cozy down comforter even a comfy leather club chair to read in.   Aida is a warm and gracious hostess, friendly, helpful and happy to visit or give you your space as you prefer. Her two children are delightful, extremely well-mannered; it was a pleasure to meet them.  She is meticulous about cleaning the shared bathroom daily and navigating everyone's bath/shower schedule was simple.  Her apt is well located with subway lines number 2,3 steps away and another with even more lines a few blocks away.  Museum Mile (5th Ave) is 30 minutes away on foot and there are parks everywhere, Central Park, Marcus Garvey Park and Riverside Park to name a few. Lots of stores for essentials nearby (grocery, drug stores, clothing both independent and large chains), cafes, small restaurants and coffee shops for a quick bite are plentiful.  Harlem is a vital busy neighborhood and walking around early and late I was in good company---everyone walks in NYC! I felt welcomed by Aida and her family; they also respected my need to close my door and recharge before going out again.  I highly recommend a stay with Aida!

strongly recommend Aida's home！so comfortable and pleasant 4 nights stay for me. quite agree with previous visitors' comments about good room condition and aida's kind hospitality. I feel at home. sharing other space of home with aida and her 2 lovely  kids, no other guests, so don't mind my room can just be locked from inside.good transportation position, 3 min walk to metro express lines and 5-10min to buses. quiet at night. elevator saved my arms from heavy luggages. I was told by local people 116street is safe, and myself didn't meet anything unpleasant in my stay too. 真诚推荐！公寓区配套多，房子较新，房间宽敞，地铁巴士便利，房东热情真诚素质高，让我一个人的旅行不觉得孤单无助,像在家。本地中国人说116街区是白人与黑人混住区，挺安全的，我住的价格性价比很不错的。

My partner and I couldn't have asked for a better place to stay on our first trip to New York. Ferenc was out of town while we were there, so two of his friends actually checked us in and out, and stayed in contact with us throughout the stay. Communication was excellent and responses were speedy from both them and from Ferenc himself. The place was clean, homey, and extremely convenient. It's very close to two train lines, so getting around was a total breeze. There were also many bodegas and places for late night food and drinks within walking distance. The only thing that disappointed me slightly was the jacuzzi in the bathtub wasn't working. But other than that, the place is exactly as described and a total steal. We'll be back!

Pros - Location is great and a wonderful and safe neighborhood, with a variety of shops and good connectivity of public transport. Room is good and cosy, but doesn't not have any air-conditioning. Cons - Kamil is very responsive, but it's Peter who manages the place and sometimes communication difficulties between made the stay unpleasant for us. Kitchen isn't clean, and no effort was made to clean the microwave even after we asked twice. When other guests has left the bathroom dirty, even after informing, it wasn't cleaned for 2 days. And Peter wasn't open to letting us use the other upstairs bathroom.  Lack of air-conditioning in the room makes it difficult to regulate the temperature

The stay was very good, the place is private although you share a kitchen and bathroom, there was never a problem with anything, the room is very cozy and spacious, above all, it was clean. The place is a little far from the train station, walking about 10 minutes or if you don't want to and you're afraid of cemeteries haha, you can take the bus, which passes right on the corner of the house and leaves you at the door of the M station. In the area there is a lot of commerce, you can find a supermarket a few blocks away and several small restaurants. I hope to stay in this room again the next time I come to NY. Thanks Kamil and Peter!

What could be accurately described as the most fascinating home in the neighborhood! Our check in process was stress-free and we were stunned by the decor upon stepping in. Jeff and Erika were prompt with replies; I truly can not say anything bad about them, They recommended us a Jamaican pick-up restaurant with delectable jerk chicken. Total game changer! The only cons I can point out are the construction noises that woke us up from a late-night nap, but the place had curtains to dampen them. Nonetheless, we think Jeff's place is an absolute gem and our stay there was wonderful.

Everything as expected, loved the fact the keys access was automated 24/7 so I didn't need to stress about the fact I was arriving around midnight, the apartment was nice and clean, short walk from the center of manhattan.
UES location is perfect and hosts super responsive! The space itself was clean, comfortable and perfect for two. Cannot stress enough how great location is!

Dena is a great host and her place is even better. The outdoor space is a heavenly spot to start or end your day. Its lovely greenery and flowers along with the privacy were so appreciated! The apartment has everything you need for your stay in Brooklyn. It is super clean, has gorgeous textiles, a comfortable bed, cable tv and streaming channels.  The neighborhood is super safe. We walked home from our son’s apartment (over a mile) at 11:00 pm and never felt unsafe! Dena was available immediately to help us get settled and answer our questions. The checkin process is easy and you’ll feel at home as soon as you enter.  We will be back for another stay.  Oh, did I mention you are only a short distance from shops, cafes, bars, coffee, anything you want?? Perfect!

The location of this place is fantastic. There are great restaurants a block away (Osteria 106 and MACC 106 (say hi to Waskar, and tell him I sent you!). It's half a block from Central Park. Momma's Pizza is within a few blocks, ARCO cafe is close. I highly recommend these places.  There is lots of room - 4 singles and a double bed. The stuffed chair in the living room quickly became "my spot." Everything works - TV, dishwasher; the washer and dryer are like new.  There is lots of pressure in the shower. The stovetop is a little funky; you have to turn it on several times before the gas keeps flowing.   The super, Jack, is very quick to fix things. However, PLEASE tell him to get vaccinated!!! The story is he's afraid of needles. Anyway, he always wore a mask.   Now the downsides: One reviewer mentioned that it wasn't "cleanly". The couch in the living room has stains that won't come out. That makes it feel not quite clean. It is an old place - the floor in the hall to the master bedroom creaks when you walk on it.  The floors could use refinishing. The countertop has spots that are embedded in it. If you don't mind these things, it's great. The other downside is that if someone is living upstairs, you hear everything. The gen-z's upstairs had loud parties, and I was a little afraid the ceiling would collapse when they were all jumping up and down in unison. On the other hand, they were very polite, and would quickly end the party  at the slightest complaint. But they're gone, I don't know who you'll get. In the basement bedroom, you barely hear it.   Anyway, I would stay here again - I really loved the location, assuming the people upstairs are considerate.

Viviana’s place can definitely be recommended within this price range. Its very cozy, clean, full of small touches like free coffee and creamer or body wash. The amenities were fantastic; fridge, kettle, tv, towels and more. Viviana is very nice and communicative person. Her whole apartment is really nice. Huge advantage is also that subway station is just 2 min walk and closest supermarket 1 min walk away from the apartment. The only cons is a bit sketchy neighborhood, but it might be just my subjective opinion. Other than that I truly and honestly recommend. Me and my wife had a great stay in NYC.

David was always in great communication.  I booked the same day of my arrival and he responded quickly. upon arrival he offered me a drink of choice from the bar.  There was a refrigerator stocked with water and soda in the bedroom.  David also offered to cook breakfast.  The subway was about a 2 block walk from the apartment and you can get to anywhere in NYC from there.  The apartment is in a good location in Harlem.  I never felt unsafe.  Overall it was good experience.  I would stay there again.

I really found the space quite dirty, the kitchen in particular, microwave and refrigerator quite dirty, splattered with food and leftovers from previous tenants, the apartment had not even been mopped for a long time. The apartment is very dirty and full of dust, it does not have enough ventilation, a small window is truncated. The building in particular has an unpleasant look and smell from the moment you enter. The area and the area where it is located seemed very pleasant and central to me.

Perfect place for a stay in New York. Great location with citibikes round the corner and a hip healthy cafe next door. There were great bars within a 5 minute bike ride and up town Brooklyn a 20 min bike ride and manhatton 30 mins away 🚴‍♀️. The neighbourhood was quiet and Felt very safe. The house itself was very cosy, clean and had everything you may need. Agustina is a super helpful and organised host making the stay very easy and stress free. Would definitely stay here again.

Agustina's apartment is very convenient for a trip to NY. It is very well served by transport (bus, metro) and in a nice neighborhood (or at least not dangerous at all). The apartment was well equipped and we lacked nothing. Thanks again Agustina!

Michael's studio was a great little place for us to crash at night. Michael met us when we arrived, even though it was late in the evening (11pm), and handed us the keys. The location was great and was walking distance to the major areas that we wanted to visit, and there were enough people that I didn't feel unsafe at night.  The futon was a little bit uncomfortable, but it was clearly listed as a futon so we expected that going in. I would definitely recommend this to anyone who intends on exploring a lot and spending time in the room only to sleep.

Michael's place is clean and comfortable; it was a very warm and cozy place to stay during the snowstorm that hit this weekend. It's a New York City walkup, so don't expect over-the-top luxury, but it's a comfortable place to stay in easy walking distance to tourist sights and to major conference hotels. Plus, tons of good food in easy walking or delivery distance.  We had problems with communication that made my arrival very stressful and unfortunately colored my AirBnb experience; after messaging Michael the morning before my trip, I did not hear from him until just a few hours before check-in (well over 24 hours after my initial message, and after I had followed up with another message and a phone call). Then, check-in was late, and I was not given any reason for the delay or any time table to help me know what time I would be able to get into the apartment. But once I got in, again, everything was comfortable and cozy. With all the good reviews, I believe my experience must have been a fluke, but I thought it was worth mentioning here. Otherwise, the location can't be beat and the apartment is a great and convenient home base for for a trip to the city.

Michael’s is simply amazing. I stayed there for 6 days and I lived a proper Carrie Bradshaw dream with my own place in New York. Without Mr Big and Manolo Blahnik shoes thought.  The neighborhood is great and I never felt unsafe. The location is brilliant too.  Although I was by myself the apartment can perfectly accommodate 2 people. It was super clean, organized and tidy.  Everything worked and Michael was always available making sure I was ok or needed anything.  I will definitely come back and couldn’t recommend this place more. Great value for money.
Nice, quiet space for single or couple.  Close to Broadway District, delis and drug store.  No TV, but reliable wi-fi.  Neighborhood needs a coffee shop (and no coffee maker in unit when I stayed).

I had a mixed experience here. The apartment itself was fine and the bed was comfortable. I was frustrated by the communication from Michael because I sent a question and didn't get a response - it seemed the only communication he wanted to send was his pre-written form messages. On the first night there was also some suspicious activity that looked like someone had come in to the apartment. Nothing was missing and he did reply promptly to chat about this. He said he'd follow up with his building management to see if it had been them but I never heard another word about it. Considering I was staying solo for work, it would have been nice to have the feeling of security that no one was going in/out freely or that nothing more nefarious had happened.

From the start Althea's communication was great and continued throughout our stay. If we needed something in the apartment like Kleenex it was there very shortly.  The apartment is spotless and comfortable with a real queen size bed. The kitchen facilities worked well for us as did everything.  Having Netflix available to us was a very nice touch.  Internet service was very good.  The neighborhood is a very safe and an extremely walk able one. Parking is easy. The apartment  is close to the subway, food, drug stores, restaurants and of course Prospect Park.  If you are looking for a place in New York City/ Brooklyn start with Althea.

6 of us ladies in my family just got home from our girls weekend in NYC, and we stayed at Delroy's townhouse. This was our very first Airbnb stay, and I have to say that Delroy made it a fantastic experience!! He met us when we got there and not only did we get a thorough tour of the place, but he had a notebook with page after page of helpful information including cab company numbers, public transportation schedules, grocery store locations, take out food places, etc..he patiently answered all of our questions, gave us directions to various places, made several personal recommendations, and some useful tips to make our stay stress free. He had welcomed us with fruit, little coffee cakes, and juice and milk in the fridge. Very welcomed after our long drive.  The townhouse is beautiful! It was spotless, comfortable, and had everything we could possibly need for our stay. Since I drove, having a driveway to keep my car in was a huge plus. I parked it and didn't use it again until we left for home. I can't express how much more we were able to enjoy our time together than had we stayed in a hotel, we never even turned on the tv!! It was so welcoming and comfortable, it felt like we were visiting a friend. Delroy was easy to get a hold of, but we had no problems at all. We were so happy we stayed here, we will definitely stay again, and I highly recommend it to others.

Delroy's house was very nice to stay in. We were a group of 6 and we found it very comfortable. It was easy access and in a quiet area. We loved taking the ferry to go to New York. ( 5-10 mins. by car )We found it stress free and we were able to enjoy the scenic water route. Delroy was a great host, meeting with us on the first day and explaining everything we needed to know. The little touch of having fruits and some snacks when we got there was appreciated. The house is very nice, extremely clean and everything you need is supplied. It's like having a home away from home. We enjoyed our stay and would go back there again!

The address was wrong and the apartment didn’t match the pictures in the listing. The listing says that there are two beds, but the apartment I was brought to only had one, so one of us had to sleep on the couch. As soon as I brought up these issues, he reported me and claimed that I stayed an extra night and broke his TV. This guy is very shady. Please read through all of his reviews. Other people have brought up the same issues with this host.

This is a beautiful place!  Host, Delroy, is very helpful an accommodating. I was traveling with my young son and niece and never did we feel unsafe in this neighborhood. Short walk to the bust stop to take you to the ferry!  I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking in this area.

It is only 5 minutes from the bus stop away.  Some people advised us to take care in this area but honestly we ( two girls) walked there around in the night and never had the impression to be in danger. They even asked us if we need help as they noticed that we are tourists. Check in and out was really uncomplicated. We had a flight back late in the afternoon and had the possibility to keep our luggage there. We met Janelle twice in front of her house leaving the apartment. She was friendly to us. Maybe the kitchen can be better equiped ( not using plastic, big bowls aso) and also inside the drawer can be cleaned.

Janelle was very lovely and the place was as advertised, comfortable with great services. My only criticism would be the location. It is about a 15 - 20 minute walk to the train station from Janelle’s, which is fine and not that far, however I was harassed twice walking along the main road back to the apartment approximately between 5pm and 6pm both times. Once by a female who was yelling curse words at me from across the street and once by a male who was following me and saying very sexually lewd things about me whilst he followed me. I did not feel safe at all. I ended up trying to look for another place to stay but as it was Christmas I couldnt afford anything other than a hostel (Also unsafe for a young single female traveller) as the prices had skyrocketed. My only viable monetary solution was to take an Uber in and out of the apartment every day. All of my uber drivers commented on how unsafe the area is when they dropped me off.

Kofi has been a great host even though we eventually could not meet with him. He goes the extra mile to provide his guests with a great, personalized experience.  The apartment is spacious and bright and well removed from loud traffic. There is very good internet connection and entertainment available in the flat, although the biggest draw is the city outside.  The location seemed safe and calm. There are good restaurants in the vicinity, plenty of shopping and drug stores, and the metro is right around the corner. The Central Park is around a few more corners, which is a nice starting point for one's exploratory endeavors.  We were three people and could rest comfortably between the bed and the spreadable sofa in two separate rooms.

I'm hesitant to even write this review because this place is such a gem that I just want to keep it all to myself! Kofi himself is an incredibly responsive and easy going host. When we arrived he gave us a walkthrough of the property, had suggestions for what was open to eat, and also had a book filled with pamphlets and more details for our stay. We stayed for two weeks, so we had a couple questions come up, and every time he responded super quickly and pleasantly. We also had weird check in and out times, and he was very flexible.   As far as the property goes, this place is an absolute hidden treasure. Kofi has so many cool trinkets and books around the house that I feel like you could see something new every time you sat down. There's definitely no way to be bored here. I came to NY for brain surgery, so comfort and accessibility were huge for me, and this property aced both. There are no steps to the front door and an elevator with ample space for a wheelchair or walker. I used a walker and the doors were wide enough to accomodate me safely. I also felt perfectly comfortable on the couch and bed as both allowed a comfortable place to sprawl which is major in a place like NY. I also can't forget to mention how nice it was to have 2 tvs where Kofi kindly had all the major streaming services set up.   I should also mention that we felt very safe in the area. There is a place with Target, Costco, and some other stores that is about a 15 minute walk and we were able to walk that in the evening without feeling overly unsafe. Of course it's noisy, it's a city, but even then it was actually pretty quiet all things considered.    This place was a true home away from home and I can't thank Kofi enough for making such a stressful trip smooth sailing!

Yamin was an outstanding host.  Not only was the apartment lovely and centrally located, but Yamin provided personal touches with maps of the area showing restaurants, grocery and drug stores.  Great cable tv channels.

Patricia was a wonderful host during my 1 month stay in the provided bedroom. She's pleasant to talk and really went the extra mile to make sure my stay was comfortable. I really felt comfortable very quickly living with her and she was very helpful in helping me learn to navigate the city for the first time. She has a very agreeable and genuinely honest character that can't be understated.   The rented bedroom is on the opposite side of the apartment from Patricia's room, ideal for one person with about as much privacy as you could ever get sharing an apartment. Her two cats, Joey and Zac are full of personality and fun to see in the common areas once they get comfortable enough to come out! Nearly everything needed is provided for and if you need something extra Patricia is the type of host to make sure it's there (just be sure to have courtesy and give a heads up though). Laundry is also in building at the basement. The location of the apartment is wonderful too, you're just out of the crazy parts of midtown so the noise level isn't bad, but you're so close to Grand Central that you can basically get anywhere in NYC in under 30 mins. There's also a Duane Reade (drug store) right beside the apartment where you can pick up anything you mightve forgotten for your trip.   Over all this was everything I'd hoped for and at a very humble and competitive price that beats 90% of everything else for this area. Thanks for your hospitality and hosting me Patricia!

Excellent location. The hostess is friendly but a point to be aware of as it was extremely unpleasant: because the room was in the living room with only a sliding door that let you hear all the noises in the room, which was sometimes very noisy, in my last night the hostess and her friends woke me up at 11 pm with loud music and extreme noise.   There was little attention, care and lack of respect for rest hours.

Mimi, Andres and José welcomed us very well. We were very comfortable in the house. The photos they show match reality. They have very good vibes and were always there when we needed them. The place is very accessible to reach Manhattan. There is the Broadway station, on the N and Q lines, opposite and it takes 10 minutes to get to Central Park and 15 minutes to go to Time Square. The noise of the train does not bother you too much, not even for sleeping. The area is quiet, we arrived at 10 at night or my son left at 3 in the morning and there is no danger. I fully recommend it. It is a place that is worth it. Thanks to the hosts for their hospitality and good treatment!!!!

At the end of our stay Mimi introduced herself to us and told her that asking us for the identity of all the travelers by email 1 hour before our flight to New York, telling us that AIRBNB could cancel our reservation, was not at all reassuring. late. We were finally able to contact Alessandro, his nephew, who was remarkably kind and reassured us. When we left Mimi asked us to pack our bags at 10:00 a.m. for cleaning even though our departure on the contract stipulated 8:00 p.m. We obviously refused and finally, everything was arranged Mimi accepted our departure for 5:00 p.m. Concerning the accommodation, it conforms to the photos, very good and very clean. Noisy because of the metro and the air conditioning, but we get used to it. There are keys for the door entry and not an access code. The address is not the correct one, be careful..., we also had this problem at 11:30 p.m. when we arrived. Finally, we insist on the fact that Mimi is, despite the facts, very friendly and friendly and her nephew Alessandro is frankly very kind and was very attentive to us.

This is a great place to stay. Michelle had welcome balloons inside when we arrived which we loved. The neighborhood is very safe. My sister and I walked from and to the subway late at night and never felt unsafe. It's a few blocks away, but a straight shot. You can take the M or the R all the way into the city. There are restaurants and grocers close by. Michelle is available to answer any questions you may have. She responds quickly. The apartment is below hers and very private. We loved Astoria.

We were a group of 9 women that stayed at this place for a long weekend. We chose this place because of the location, accommodations,  and the great reviews from previous guests.  Location - 5 stars, it is very convenient to the subway (1 block) and lots of options for coffee, dining and groceries. There is train noise but it never bothered us. There were issues with the Wifi too so we needed to use our hotspots.  We did try several times to get some basic information answered to make sure that it would be an easy checkin -check out however it was difficult at times for us and caused stress.  We had to involve Airbnb multiple times and even up to the 24 hrs before checkin.  Please note that the host requires each guest to provide a Government ID to them beyond what is verified in your Airbnb profile. We were ok with creating profiles into Airbnb and uploading our ID's into Airbnb however since the host was unresponsive at times and the phone number was disconnected at one point, this made us very uneasy to provide the ID's to them directly.  I understand this all is in the house rules however I think potential guests would feel better before committing if they knew everything beforehand and not after payment.

We loved staying here! There are many subway stations within 10 minutes walking and many restaurants and cafes even closer. We never felt unsafe walking at night in any of the areas around. Her place was exactly as described and in a quiet part of town. The decor and thoughtful amenities made us feel at home. We would absolutely stay here again, we have no complaints! She was helpful and responsive, the place is beautiful and she thought of everything we could need. It was nice to stay out of Manhattan, but still be within 30 minutes of the main attractions. You can't beat this convenient and comfortable stay!

Michelle’s place was perfect. I came to New York to run the NYC marathon. Her house is a short walk to the subway, and then an easy ride into Manhattan. I really fell in love with the neighborhood of Astoria while visiting. The food in Astoria was wonderful!  Michelle’s place is an amazing place to stay if you’re looking to get out of the city and get a different experience, while still having the ease of enjoying Manhattan.   Her house had small touches, like coffee and shampoo to make the stay welcoming. My biggest fear is always a bed. The bed was comfortable with some of the most amazing sheets I have ever slept in!  I would recommend this place in a heart beat if you’re not afraid to travel to the city (about 25 minutes or so). When I come back, I’ll stay again.

Michelle’s place is great! It’s bigger than it looks like in the pictures and it’s super clean. It is conveniently located to the subway station (12 minute walk) in a quiet neighborhood. We would get back from Manhattan around 12-1am and we never felt unsafe. We would definitely stay here again!

Jen's apartment was the perfect picture of Brooklyn life. Amazing views over Manhattan from the promenade, lovely neighbourhood, safe area and a beautiful studio full of books. Jen kindly waited for my delayed flight and her family helped me out with a spare key when I had my wallet stolen. I would totally recommend this apartment as long as you don't mind a few stairs!

We can simply recommend this accommodation 100%. Our stay in New York exceeded our expectations. We would like to thank Leticia for her helpful and kind nature. The accommodation is sparkling clean and has everything you need. The apartment is also in a quiet area. It's about a 15 minute walk to the subway. Perfect transport connections to Times Square and Grand Central Station. Leticia was also available at any time and ordered us a taxi to the airport for $35 (unbeatable). We can only recommend everyone to book this Airbnb, as it is the perfect place to switch off from the stress of New York.

This was the first time I rented a room through Airbnb, I was a little scared at first, but the minute I stepped into Anna's appartment, I could tell already that I was in good hands. Anna is so caring, lovely and adorable and tries her best to make you feel comfortable at her place. Such a beautiful soul, I was so inspired by her. Her apartment is beautiful, neat and super clean. The heater is amazing, especially for people who come from warmer places like myself. Anna also knows everything about the city and is able to give you great tips. She suggested really nice restaurants, stores, transportation...everything! I am so so lucky to have found her and her place!

This 4th floor walk up sits in the perfect spot for anyone! The street is beautiful, and it’s a short walk to the laundromat, bars, restaurants, the gym, several shopping centers, the movie theatres, and several subway stations. It’s a prime spot for someone who likes to get around or stay close to home.   The room is plenty for one person, or could work well for a couple. The kitchen has most everything you could need, and everything is in good condition in the room.   A man named Enrique works in the building, he seems to be the go-to guy if you need anything. I never met the host during my three months here, but he was pleasant through our emails.  I always felt safe and comfortable.   I stayed during Christmas time, and unfortunately I did have two packages stolen from the doorstep and issues receiving mail, so I would recommend finding an alternative place to receive important mail while you stay here!  All in all I loved my time here and this apartment was perfect for my needs. Thanks again!

My boyfriend and I spent the Memorial Day weekend at Hope's place and it was an overall excellent experience. The location of the apartment was incredible- walking distance from several metros, excellent bars and great places to eat. It is walking distance to many great going out neighborhoods including the East Village, Greenwich, Chinatown and Soho. Check in and out was very easy and stress free. Hope was super helpful and responsive through the booking and our stay. She even left a thoughtful card to welcome us to the city, provided more than enough towels and toiletries, and her home was equipped with everything you needed for an extended stay in the city. The pictures also don't do this place justice because the apartment is not only very spacious but beautifully decorated. My boyfriend and I kept commenting on how nice the place was overall and it made the weekend very comfortable. Overall, this is a great find on Air BnB, Hope is a great host and we would certainly recommend this place.

We cannot recommend Hope's beautiful home enough! Close to the Subway and other attractions, restaurants, and bars; Hope's home was clean and comfortable. We love to travel on foot and were able to walk to Ground Zero, the East Village, and from Brooklyn with ease. Hope was quick to respond and very detail oriented so when we arrived while she was flying and out of service, she had emergency contacts lined up just in case we had any problems. Check-in/out was a breeze and our entire stay was stress-free. We highly recommend staying here next time you're in New York!

Definitely recommend staying at the Peaches Bungalow as one of the best lodging deals you can find in Manhattan. Easy (!) access to several train lines make trips downtown or to south Manhattan quick and easy.  Just to be very real... do not come into this place expecting a swanky experience. It's a one bedroom apartment with a kitchenette. I would not recommend trying to cook a full meal given the limited counter space and small sink. There is a full sized bed in its own bedroom and a daybed in the main common area. The bed in the bedroom is a pretty creaky. The wood floors are worn and the overall paint/decor is very cute.   We slept reasonably well every night, and had plenty of nearby eateries for walking or delivery when the weather was a bit rougher.  I rate this place overall at 5 stars just given the value. $150/night with easy subway access for the main arterial train lines through Manhattan and Brooklyn is hard to come by... and it was a relatively short ride to/from LGA. The staircases are a bit daunting but that's a walkup apartment for you. Almost everything was as clean as you'd expect in your own home... which is to say not perfect, but more than good enough. It feels lived in.  Also, big shout out to Etta, our host. She allowed us a very late checkout to make our last day less stressful with a late flight, and she (without us asking) brought a space heater up for us on the colder days. Super responsive and helpful whenever we had a question or request, including late the night of our arrival to coordinate check-in. Thank you!!

Tom and Lily's place was amazing. Clean and cozy. I loved a bed in tree house room so much. It's just few minutes to get a subway station. The neighborhood is also lovely. Never felt danger! And also I thank a lot to the roommates they are so kind and respectful. I would definitely stay there again when I go to NewYork.

This property is not worth your money. Whatever is shown in the picture is drawing room of the property. The room where ultimately end up is a small stingy 9*9, where two cots are kept. No other furniture or side table. You have to dump your goods on the floor. There is a ward rob in the room, which full of filth / garbage / old items of the house owner. There is no attached toilet. In the common toilet, the shower does not work. Towels are not cleaned and just folded and some scent is sprayed to give it a look of cleanliness. There is TV in the property, which doesn't work. If you have problem in climbing narrow staircases, beware. It may hurt you. The worst thing is that Mr Vladimir, the house owner doesn't listen to your problems.

This was a great stay.  We had fairly high expectations based on the photos, location and other reviews, but even those were exceeded.  The house is quiet yet convenient.  It's only two blocks from a stop on the A and C lines, which made getting around simple even for a non-NYer.  The neighborhood has been gentrified, but without eliminating the everyday lives of the longer-term residents. Grocery and drug stores are nearby, and the neighborhood is quite safe (even at night) and easy to get around.  The flat was pleasant and comfortable, well decorated but not overdone, with ample privacy for two friends traveling together.  Coffee, tea, milk and treats were provided. My environmental allergies gave me no trouble at all.  Ephriam provided hypoallergenic bedding and the flat was spotless.  Ephriam and Justice (his dog) welcomed us on arrival and were a quiet but welcome presence throughout our stay.  Ephriam gave excellent advice, immediately took care of everything we needed, and checked in to make sure we were happy and comfortable.  We'll be back!

I came to the city for a tiny reunion with a friend who i hadn't seen for  a very long time. I was incredibly pleased by the cleanliness and the profesionalism staying at Greg and Adriane's place. They weren't around at the time of my arrival, but the instructions getting in were very clear and very simple. The moment we walked in there was a lovely welcome letter on the door, and a whole list of things to do in the area. Which we also took full advantage of! We are a huge fan of new places to eat and they had some great recommendations.   So with my group, i was with two other 25 year olds and we are all working professionals. We are pretty relaxed individuals and the fact that Greg and Adriane had children and were actively around during the weekend we were there, was totally fine for us. We like to start our days early and take advantage of the day. Their apartment is cute, quite and very clean and very family oriented. The neighborhood is safe and i didn't feel like i was in any danger or felt uncomfortable.   As for the proximity to the city. It is great, and it's almost like you're in Manhattan but it is a distance away from the city. I didn't take the subway during my visit and solely used Uber/Lyft, which was roughly $20-30 to get to east village, almost $60 to get to upper east side. I used to live in Manhattan so i was well aware of what i wanted to do and where we were going to go. If you are kinda new to the city, this would be a great place to start, and Greg and Adriane would help you out on directions on how to get into the city.   I would definitely recommend this place to fellow travelers that want to experience a much more quiet and relaxed experience in New York!

The apartment is exactly as described in the photos. Very clean and comfortable. The bed is big and very good, I had a good nights sleep here. Despite being in Harlem (a little far from tourist attractions such as Times Square, World Trade Center, etc.) there is a subway one block from the house, which makes transportation around the city very easy. The neighborhood didn't seem dangerous to me, I walked around it calmly.  Only at night did I take greater care, as a precaution. Ephraim is extremely attentive, I would certainly stay here again.

If you are considering Ephraim's place - BOOK it, BOOK IT NOW! This place is fantastic. In fact, I want to move in. It's two blocks from the subway (I forget which lines, but they were perfect).  It was my first time in NY and although I wanted to experience NY as a NYer and experience more than one area, I was a little concerned when our Lyft driver dropped us off in Harlem from our previous place in Upper East Side. My bf and I didn’t stay out too late our first night there (because I was concerned lol), but came home super late the following nights after realizing it wasn’t scary – at all! I felt safe and the area is cool. The room itself is very clean and - perfect. The bed and pillows are comfortable, and the décor is awesome. The place is stocked with just about anything you might need and Ephraim is a FANTASTIC host! He’s very responsive, funny and super cool. He has the cutest dog named Justice who is an absolute sweetheart! I wanted to bring her home with me. This is an Airbnb we would most definitely stay at again and highly recommend! We were sad to leave, especially since Ephraim spoiled us by stocking his fridge with delicious soda (bahahaha). Thank you Ephraim!!!! Hope to see you guys soon!

I highly recommend Ephraim’s studio. It’s located in a calm and quiet street, near to the subway and to  restaurants, markets, drug stores... The studio is very well equiped and has a cosy atmosphere. Ephraim is kind and attentive.  Ephraim’s studio is a very good choice for those visiting NYC!

Greg and adriane were very accommodating! The apartment is very cute, pretty spacious and very clean! The price was a steal we thought for what we were getting! Location was good, close to the transit and cute coffee shops right around the corner! Overall, it was a really good experience!
Fantastic place with an equally fantastic host. Pamela was very accommodating for our crazy early morning schedule and the apartment is so close to food, fun, and transit that it's a steal!

I am a long time visitor to NYC and have stayed all over the city. Allen's place was huge, clean, renovated kitchen, comfortable beds and well stocked with everythigng you need. The biggest plus is the washer/dryer in the unit! Cons (minor) is the front b/r faces 10th ave which is pretty noisy. Honestly after a day I got used to it. This is a 2nd floor walkup,  which may be difficult if you have mobility issues. And just on a side note, the toilet took a day or two to get the hang of how to flush it haha. It has a different design to flush, push and hold the button on the side of the tank until the water level is below the bowl then let go.  Allen is an exceptional host! After a long stressful day of cancelled flights and changed arrival times, he was very flexible and accommodating. Made for the perfect end of a long frustrating day.  Big Mahalo! Highly recommended!

very clean room, clean towels , bed is very comfortable and clean department too. The apartment is located in a not very safe place , I think it a bit dangerous because you find people drunk on the streets and some gangs, anf you do not know if they are good or bad people. Personally I never dared to arrive after 10:30pm. about my host he was very friendly and welcoming before it arrives , but then I never heard from her until the day I left.

We had a pleasant stay in Greg&Adriane's apartment. The description is consistent with what we found on site. Greg&Adriane are very available and attentive to the well-being of their guests. Communication was perfect before and during our stay. Greg&Adriane do their best to accommodate you if necessary (our outbound flight was canceled, Adriane offered to postpone our arrival without difficulty). This apartment allows, after a long day of walking, to find calm and greenery in the very pleasant little garden. However, in your planning, you must take into account travel times to the city's main cultural sites: it takes 20 minutes to walk to access the A line and then around 30 minutes to reach the Manhattan museums. All of these conditions allowed us to have a very pleasant stay in NYC.

Loved staying at Malene's place! The place was comfortable, clean and stylish with lots of space for the two of us to relax. We enjoyed having two bedrooms with our own bathrooms to get ready in the mornings. We started off our days by making breakfast in the kitchen before walking the area or taking a short walk to catch the C-train. The area was very walkable and friendly. Never felt unsafe or uncomfortable during the days or evenings wandering around. Loved Cafe Zaca around the corner and the wine store a couple minutes away. Lots of great little local places to eat in the area with convenience stores on the corners and larger grocery stores only a short walk. Found it very quick and easy to get into Manhattan via the subway. Check in was easy with a lockbox for the gate and keypad for the door. Terry greeted us as we arrived and we ran into him again the next morning. Malene was easy to reach via messages and responded quickly. All in all, a beautiful rental in a superb location. Couldn't have been happier!
accommodation not very far from the metro. It is a popular area but not insecure. the building is not very well maintained but the apartment is perfect

A hidden gem in BK! Greg and Adriane were extremely responsive, easy to reach, and kind. Their airbnb were clean, tidy, and accurate to the listing. Both the master room bed and living room bed were extremely comfy! Our favorite part is the garden and the backyard. The only nitpick is that there seems to be a lot of mosquitos in Brooklyn in the summer so we weren't able to use it that much.   We never felt unsafe in the area and it is about 10mins to G and 15mins to C with lots of coffee places in between the walk.  Will definitely miss this place!

This place is excellent; what you see in the pictures is what you will find. We were afraid about finding parking, but that was never a problem, maybe you may have to walk a block, but that is it. We order take-out, but there are plenty of pots and pans if you want to cook.  We also enjoyed the espresso coffee place down the street.  A detail that was important for us was the mattresses; they are excellent, seem to be new (if you share a bed, you don't end up in the middle). Bathrooms were immaculate and had shampoo, soap, etc. We recommend this place highly.
Darcy and Ross's place was very nice! Location is excellent - quiet shady street and a short walk from Fort Greene Park, which our dogs loved exploring. Space was clean and as described.

This apartment is very conveniently located and well appointed. Quick note this is a full time rental not a home.   Darcy and Ross were very good communicators and even offered to check their community board for potential apartment listings since I was in town to look for a new place in nyc.   I was surprised to find the apartment is pretty much underground, with the bedroom and bath in the basement and just one skinny window for natural light. You can hear the family upstairs quite a bit inside the apartment. This is totally fine for short term stays but I personally felt a little claustrophobic without more light.   I really appreciated that it was dog friendly! Be advised the spiral staircase did not work for my dog, she was scared of it and couldn’t use the stairs, so I carried her up and down and left her downstairs in the bedroom with the door closed when I left her in the apartment. The stairs might be hazardous for some pups.   Overall a convenient stay very centrally located and clean!

He welcomed us with things to eat and have breakfast. The instructions on how to open the apartment were very clear. We expected the subway station to be closer, but it was a 15-minute walk to the brightest station, because the other nearby one seemed dangerous to us.
It's a very good apartment, clean and nice, the owner is very nice and helpful.  The location is a bit scary, across a gas station, and going out at night is not that nice.

Very accessible spot on a shady street in Fort Greene. Checking in and out was super simple. I had to work for a few hours in the apartment and found it quiet but a bit stuffy. I think this is mainly to do with a tremendously hot day in NYC. If you’re planning on being out and about most of your trip and really only staying at the place to sleep, it’s pretty perfect and a great deal.

The location is great and the place is very cute and tidy. However, a major issue during our stay was the noise.   I stayed here with my two sisters and truly the only issue we had during our stay was the noise coming from upstairs and in the hallways very early in the mornings that lasted for over an hour each time (opening and closing of upstairs door and front door, loud footsteps up and down the stairs, furniture moving and banging noises upstairs, conversations in the hallways, etc.) -- it woke us all up between 7-8am every morning we stayed because of how much the sound carries into the airbnb unit. We were out most of the days so not sure how much this happens during the day but it was the most bothersome to us in the AM, especially since it robbed us of sleep time.

Very good value for money. Neighborhood known to be dangerous but not at all. Very good location in relation to Manhattan and house very close to the metro and supermarkets. The basement is reserved for customers, which leaves a certain freedom, which is very appreciable. Good welcome from the host. Two downsides: sometimes the wifi is not operational and one evening the dryer was on until more than midnight. I recommend!

Vanessa was great! The place worked fine for us, getting back late at night was a lil sketchy, but never felt unsafe, partly because I was with my husband. This is a you get what you pay for kinda place, don't expect anything fancy with beautiful smells, because this is not the place. It's perfect for someone that literally just needs a place to sleep. It's really close to the subway, so that made it even better. I'll make one recommendation, if you are a light sleeper, bring ear plugs! The walls are pretty thin so you can hear them upstairs and also people can be pretty loud outside. Other than that, it was a decent place to stay and Vanessa was great and very accommodating!

So I stayed in Vanessa's place for a month as sort of a halfway house upon moving to the city while I found work and an apartment. It really was the perfect place for that. I essentially had the basement to myself. They have their washer and dryer by the room, so they would come down to do laundry, but they always tried to time it for when I wasn't home to maximize privacy. When we did run into each other, Vanessa's entire family was super friendly and accommodating. The neighborhood was a little shocking for someone from a very small farming town, but I never felt unsafe because there are cops on the block almost constantly and really well lit shops all the way between the subway station and the house. The 4 train is a 3 minute walk away, and there is a grocery store right across the street. The value in Vanessa's room really is the convenience of it all! Here are some things that didn't bother me at all but might bother someone pickier than me: -The bed is very, very firm. So if you require a perfect bed to get decent sleep then maybe bring a mattress pad.  -This is in a busy neighborhood, so you will hear noises from outside. It is just normal city noise that you would get anywhere other than a sound-proofed house, so again if you are light sleeper this might not be for you.  -The room is clean and there are plenty of kitchen amenities, but this is a family home, so they do have storage downstairs and will be down there at times. This is not a private apartment rent, and you don't have your own entrance.   Again, this was such a pleasant stay and I was happy to call it home for a month!

As for the location, at first I was a little afraid, because it was a little far from Manhattan and because of the neighborhood's reputation as being a little dangerous. However, the neighborhood made my trip better than I expected! Around the house there are several 24-hour stores (convenience stores), 2 supermarkets with great prices, 1 metro station next door and another 10 minutes away. Furthermore, the Bronx allowed me to experience the reality of New York. Regarding Vanessa and her family, they were wonderful! I needed to check in a little earlier and I had no problems, her husband who welcomed us was very attentive, he explained in detail how the key, refrigerator, wifi, etc. worked. and your mother is also very nice. A positive point is that the room has plenty of privacy, has a bathroom and a private kitchen. I will definitely be back, for the city, for the reception and for the Bronx.

The accommodation is pretty much exactly as described. You almost have the basement to yourself. The bathroom is completely sufficient and clean. The hotplate is a bit unsuitable for actually cooking something... if you are sensitive to noise while sleeping, the accommodation may not be perfect.  Vanessa and her family are very friendly. We didn't feel uncomfortable or unsafe in the area, the neighbors knew us after a few days and said hello... All in all: great for a cheap stay in the city!

Everything went well, the basement, renovated as an apartment, is completely functional. The neighborhood has no problems, we were not afraid and the people were friendly. To improve the humidity a little, since having only 2 small windows because it is a basement, it would be advisable to look for an alternative. Otherwise, the attention from Vanessa and her family has been unbeatable. They have helped us when we had a problem with plane tickets, with pleasure. They responded to our requests and gave us useful information about the neighborhood and New York. We spent 15 days, and we would return without hesitation.

Let me start with the best parts.   The air conditioning unit inside the bedroom seemed new and worked great. It helped us sleep better by drowning out the loud street noises with the much nicer sound of the a/c and keeping the room at a perfect lower temperature while sleeping.   We got more than just a bedroom, we got a private bathroom and a studio apartment with all the kitchen essentials that anyone would need, especially for anyone planning a long-term stay that includes daytime use of the kitchen, dining and laundry area.   For what you get, the price is unbeatable, as far as I know.   Vanessa, Isaac, Rosa and the rest of the family were very kind during the rare occasions that we interacted with them.   Although we were only there usually from 11pm until 8am, we had a lot of privacy in the basement. Not sure how it would be if we had stayed home during the day time.   The washer and dryer were a great addition to our stay and although we weren't originally planning on using them, we ended up washing most of our dirty laundry a few days prior to checking out and both machines worked perfectly. They seemed new as well. One less chore to do when we got home.   I would definitely consider staying here again, if the price stays low, as it is now, or lower.   With that said, I would recommend our hosts some very inexpensive and even free improvements to the unit, that would've made our stay, and would make everyone's future experience, much more pleasant:  * 1st suggestion: Buy the right size of toilet seat. The toilet bowl was the elongated type, but had the wrong size of seat, the small round type, which made it very uncomfortable to sit on, because it kept moving constantly to the right and left and wouldn't stay in place. I mentioned it to Vanessa after our 2nd night of our 13 night stay, but she replaced it with another wrong size round toilet seat, for which she apologized for via text and assured us she would get it replaced with the correct size the next day, but that never happened, so we had to deal with that inconvenience every morning and every night, when we needed to use the toilet, for the rest of our stay.   * 2nd suggestion: Buy a very inexpensive plastic *shower caddy* to hang over the shower head, so guests can put shampoos, body wash, etc.. instead of putting them on the shower floor. Also buy better *shower hooks* for the shower curtain. The inexpensive plastic type that close completely are better. The metal open hooks you currently have, kept coming off every time we opened or closed the shower curtain. The shower curtain itself was also too long and bulky for that shower. Maybe positioning the shower curtain rod a little higher would improve the problem, or getting a new one, since the current rod has rust.   * 3rd suggestion: Pay for Pest Control service, or DIY for very cheap, to prevent roaches and other pests. We killed one roach crawling behind the bed headboard and we found 2 more on the common areas. We also saw a very fast House-Centipede crawling by the linen closet, which I've read they eat other bugs likes roaches, so I decided to not kill it. There was also a small spider on the shower ceiling, which I also decided to not kill, since it was on a corner away from me and it didn't really bother me.   What I ended up doing, to keep roaches away while sleeping, was to buy a small box of laundry dryer sheets and placed them in the bedroom, to keep roaches and other bugs away. Bugs hate the chemicals used in dryer sheets. I've used that method for years and it works anywhere.   * 4th suggestion: Wash thoroughly and clean the entire outside entrance of your house. It smelled like dog/cat poop and it was very unpleasant every time we entered or exited the building.   * 5th suggestion: Remove the old carpet in the bedroom and replace it with inexpensive adhesive vinyl flooring or tile. It will help with the strong bad odor of humidity and other bad odors that are difficult to remove from carpets, especially after years of multiple guest stays. That would definitely also help with the pest/bugs problem.   * 6th suggestion: There was also a strong smell similar to mothballs in the entire basement, which was very unpleasant and if it's truly mothballs (napthalene or paradichlorobenzene), it can be toxic to humans. I would recommend finding the source of that odor and removing it.   * 7th suggestion: Invest in an inexpensive mattress topper, made of thick memory foam, or equivalent. Your mattress is extremely hard and for most people, very uncomfortable. My partner didn't sleep comfortably at all any of the 13 nights and woke up with muscle pain every morning. I, on the other hand, can sleep even on the floor comfortably, but most people can't, so I would recommend spending around $70 on a decent memory foam topper.   * 8th and last suggestion: Finish doing your laundry before 9pm. Sometimes the washer and dryer were still working when we arrived very late at night (almost midnight) and the constant beeping of the machines didn't let us sleep, so I had to get up and stop the machine to be able to sleep.   As I mentioned at the beginning, I would still recommend staying at this location because of its low price and extra amenities, but I would advise to take into account the flaws of this place before you make a decision. If you can manage all its flaws, you'll love it! but if you're used to more comfortable and cleaner places, and are not willing, or able to handle a few inconveniences, I would advise you to look elsewhere, even if you have to pay more.   I

We stayed at Melody’s apartment from the day before Thanksgiving until the following Saturday. She and her roommate were both away during that time, so we did not meet either of them. Melody was very accommodating, easy to deal with and easy to reach both before and during our stay. The price was unbeatable, and the location was great for us. I’d recommend it to anyone who needs an inexpensive place to stay in the Ridgewood area or prefers a neighborhood to a hotel and is neither a neatness freak nor a light sleeper - and especially to any musician who wants ready access to a grand piano while in NYC. The place was clean but cluttered. That didn’t bother me, but it does bother some people (e.g., my wife). The sound insulation in the building is not good. Some neighbors like to party late, and others rise early. The sounds that come through the walls and ceiling are not unpleasant, but neither are they conducive to sleep. We were able to get enough rest, but if you’re a light sleeper you might not.
