Clean and comfortable apartment.  Got upgraded to a larger room with no additional charge, which was great.  Super close to the subway.  Santiago is a very responsive and warm host.  Neighborhood lacks amenities though and feels a little unsafe at night.  Travel time to Manhattan is between 45-55 min by subway which is longer than advertised.

Santiago and his wife were great hosts they were very attentive and responsive.  His space was very clean and neat. The pictures of this room are accurate. The location of this space is extremely convenient it is one block from the train (very easy to take into Manhattan) and you are next to a variety of stores (market, laundry mat, nails shops, convenient stores, restaurant, and library). The neighborhood feels safe, I was able to go out for night jogs and came back late at night and not feel in danger.  The space also has a small kitchenette with a microwave and a fridge. Overall the stay was great, comfortable, and convenient. I would absolutely recommend this space.

Min & schatzi are wonderful hosts! Min gives great advices on where to go & gives you enough privacy. She is also very accommodating to your needs. Schatzi is well-behaved and you will love her even if you are afraid of dogs! The room is good for two people. It is very clean and bed is very comfortable. Thanks for everything Min & schatzi! :)

Min made us feel completely welcoming and at home! It was a great decision to spend our four nights at Mins' place. She is such a warm, positive, interested and helpful person. Especially her recommendations and advices helped us very much to have a fantastic time in NY.  In advance we got a couple of useful information. E.g. how to get to the apartment, good restaurants and shops in her neighbourhood, where to run in NY, free toilets in Manhatten... For breakfast she offered us everything what was in the kitchen - it was perfect and her fridge was always quite full. Schatzi is really charming as well. So even if you are afraid of dogs... don't worry! We are happy to got to know such an interesting person like Min and we warmly recommend everyone to visit her place!

Wonderful location. Wonderful host. Wonderful home. And wonderful lovely dog Schatzy! Min is a very very nice host and madam to get along with. She was so kind that she even prepared a well-written tourist booklet for our convenience, which is totally beyond our expectation! Living here just feels like staying at home.  Anyone who loves dog or is afraid of dog would like to play with Min's dog Schatzy. She is so adorable that even a person who used to be afraid of dog like me starts playing with it.

I won't have enough 500 words to describe the wonderful stay we spent, with my boyfriend, at Min's house. The place is very nice, warm, harmonious and the neighborhood itself in which the apartment is located is very quiet. We did not feel danger at any time.   Min is an excellent host, with me she spoke in English and with my boyfriend she practiced her beginner Spanish. The bed and pillows are comfortable, the room is very nice and the kitchen is a dream. He shared food with us and also helped us a lot when it came to getting around NY (transfers, meals, museums, etc). He recommended a bar to listen to jazz that left us crazy in love. We had a couple of rainy days and they very kindly lent us umbrellas. He recommended us the best place in NY to eat donuts and also gave us a hand when buying food or drinks from there, that are of good quality.   The apartment is located in an ideal area to go anywhere, they have two subways two blocks away, either one (the E) to go to Manhattan and the other (the G) to go to Brooklyn.  We had no complications getting around since the area is in a central point of the city.  I have nothing but incredible words to describe Min, her apartment and her dog, who is very tender, calm and loving. We feel at home. We didn't want to turn back. The truth is that if we returned to NY, we would choose Min again.   Thanks to her for all the love, respect and kindness with which she waited for us.

Min is a most wonderful host.  She is a great source of information for what to do and how to get there in NYC. which is so important for visiting a city like New York, after all it is the most exciting city on the planet. Min's always ready to help, which makes our holiday in NYC much easy. Saves our time, stress and money.  The location of the apartment is great, easy walk to the subway, which will take you into manhattan in 10 minutes, where the most attractions and activities are.  From JFK airport to the apartment is easy by subway, it is about half an hour ride, cost about $8 each person.  Min is extremely accomodating, she is so generous and  kind, she baked  yummy gluten free biscuits for us when she know we are on gluten free.   Her kitchen is so well stocked. even though  we didn't op for much of cooking. her place is extremely popular, so you need to book early and  very quickly. I would highly recommend Min's place. For the value that you will be getting, Min's place will be the first choice when we come back to NYC!

Min’s place was awesome! Great location,  just a short walk to the nearest train station. Never felt unsafe in her area or anywhere in the city, really. Min was such an excellent host! She was very friendly and helpful. She gave us all sorts of tips on getting around and also gave us a lot of suggestions for places to eat! She knows food, so make sure to ask her for some suggestions! She was also very quick to respond whenever I texted her for whatever reason. The place was cute and nicely decorated. The bed was amazing! Honestly could’ve slept in it all day! There was construction outside of her building, but didn’t bother us at all. Overall, it was a lovely stay and I definitely recommend!

I highly recommend staying at Min's place, she is very clean, our room was spacious, and stores, restaurants, etc., were within walking distance and easy to get to.  She was so helpful when we asked for advice on various things like subways and places to go, that our first visit to NYC ended up being really fun and stress free :)
Min’s place is excellent and it’s an amazing location. It’s clean, charming, and her knowledge of the city is super helpful. Stress free! We’ll have to come back again.

I had the most pleasant stay at Min's. The appartment is perfectly located with easy access to public transportation, just a few subway stops away from Manhattan.  The building itself is very quiet and I could soundly sleep on a very comfortable bed. Bathroom super clean and access to the kitchen, everything was perfect!  Min is a very generous and attentive host. While I had trouble finding my passport just before leaving for the airport, she assisted me and took the time to help me address the stressful situation.. Thank you so much, Min!

Everything was great at Chavisa house. Neigborhood was ok (not to scary) and close to williamsburg, about 3-4 stops and 30min ride from Manahattan.  Appartment was clean and really convenient (very nice book collection) I will definitevely go there again!  Thanks Chavisa!

The room itself was just what we needed, comfortable bed, nice bathroom and kitchen, perfect for two people.  It is located in a safe area and has connivence to a drug store just around the block.   The metro is located about 4 blocks from the apt so it was easy to get around the city from here.  There were two things that did get to us during our stay, we checked in at 2PM and the room was not ready until close to 530PM, normally this wouldn't be an issue but we had been traveling all day and wanted to just come home and rest but the cleaning lady was there three is a crowd in this apt, (daniel was excellent during this time in communication and was able to help us out in another way to make up for this, so thank you for that!)  The other minor annoyance was although its great to have the 24 hour doorman service, one particular doorman asked us every time he saw us what we were doing in the building and what room we were staying in.  I understand he is trying to keep the building safe but after we explained to him twice who we were he kept stopping us and questioning us every time we saw him.

I absolutely loved my stay at Daniel’s apartment! It was clean, cozy, cute and convenient! The doormen all were so friendly & helpful! I felt totally at home & very safe. The apartment is so nice and the balcony was the     frosting on the cake. I walked everywhere & found the location to be centrally located to just about everything. There were many delis, diners and restaurants close as well as drug stores for necessities. I would definitely reserve again!

Blue's place was everything we expected. He was very friendly when we met up, he gave us a quick run-thru of the place with good advices on NYC and made the stay stress free! The apartment was clean, comfortable and a steps to all of the restaurants and music clubs you could ever want and really close of the subway. Would stay here again! Many thanks!

I was needing to find a place very last minute (day before!) as I had a flight leaving from LaGuardia very early the next morning and realized I would have to leave New Jersey at 3 in the morning to arrive at airport on time. I wanted to be closer to the airport. The car ride from their place to Laguardia is around 12 minutes! I received from Cesar an almost immediate reply after booking the room on airbnb, what a relief! Janina and Cesar are gems (joyas!): incredibly gracious and lovely hosts: they made everything smooth and easy including a (paid) ride to the airport which allayed any stress about having to call and then wait for a cab. From the get-go the communication was clear and prompt. Janina gave me wonderful help with subway, directions, and restaurants. Their place is not more than about 40 paces from the subway stop on the 7 line.  The room was cozy, inviting, impeccable, and comfortable. This is a great value, and I will definitely contact Cesar and Janina again if I need to fly out from LaGuardia in future. I highly recommend this arrangement for early morning LaGuardia travelers coming from the tristate area.

Cesar and Janina were fabulous!  Cesar went out of his way to make me feel very welcome and safe in the big city of NYC!!  Cesar checked in with me the day before my arrival and the day of my arrival to make sure I knew how to get to their place and Janina was waiting for me when I arrived.  The room was exactly how it looks in the pictures.  The whole place was very clean.  I was pleasantly surprised to even have a little balcony off of the bedroom I stayed in...nice!  Cesar and Janina also made everything just easy for me...they have a little "cheat sheet" posted in the bedroom with the wifi passoword and had a bottle of water waiting for me in the room.  I was a bit intimidated by using the subway system, but Cesar and Janina were super helpful in telling me which trains would take me to where I needed to be and it turned out to be really easy and not so scary!  I would totally stay here again without hesitation.  Cesar and Janina are a very sweet couple and over the top accommodating!

Great experience at Cesar's place.  We didn't spend much time in the apartment but what we needed it for, it delivered.  The beds were very comfortable, air conditioned, and there was a peaceful balcony.  Cesar had the room very clean with plenty to get you through a trip, towels/TV/wireless/closet/drawers/etc.  The bathroom is shared which wasn't a problem during our stay. I was pleasantly surprised how close the room was to the Metro and fully expected a rather long trip into the city but felt that wasn't the case. There was never a time I felt unsafe in the area even when coming back to the property in the early morning.  Even more importantly Cesar was available by phone if needed.
Excellent apartment in an awesome location run by a top notch guy =)  Honestly, you won't find a better place than this, and it's at a steal of a price!  "I'll be back!"

Beautiful, clean, modern and quite large apartment, the area is very quiet, don't be afraid of the word Brooklyn, we returned home at 4 a.m. without any problem, the metro stations being nearby (500m). Ike is very welcoming, in short you will have no problems with him and I highly recommend this rental because there are quite a few things to do in Brookyln and the apartment is located 30 minutes from Times Square.  Good place good apartment good host. It's a great location not far to times square (30min).

This was a wonderful place to stay in NYC. It's in the best neighborhood in Manhattan, right by the subway and all conveniences, and was a steal for the price. Clean, comfy, and had a lot of character - and free laundry in the building to boot! Cameron also was a pleasure to deal with. I was so happy I stayed here and will definitely return.

The studio is located very central in Manhatten. You can reach shopping venues by foot, subway connections are about 2 blocks away. I don't think the location could be any better.  The studio has a good size for 2 people. The bed was clean and comfortable, and we felt relaxed after a night of sleep. The area seems pretty secure, even at night. So no shady things going on ;) Also, there is a doorman which makes it easy to get the keys and keeps an eye on who is going in and out.  Unfortunately, the bathroom was not as clean as one could hope for. It was ok, but I think a new shower curtain and a bit of effort could make this place an even better stay. Same thing with the kitchen. Also, the road beneath the appartment is quite noisy and the windows won't help much with that. So if you have troubles with sleeping, take some ear plugs along. Keep in mind though, that this is NY and you probably are not gonna find something as comfortable in this price range.  So, to wrap it up: Nice place to stay if you're looking for a centrally located appartment in the middle of manhatten and you're on a budget.

I arrived at Rob & Nancy's place around 9:30 pm on a Sunday, later than I had originally said, and Rob greeted me warmly and showed me around. I stayed for 6 weeks, and despite having to attend to a difficult family matter, Rob & Nancy remained gracious and attentive throughout my stay. The place itself is great; very modern, well-stocked, plenty of light and radiant floor heat too! The location is good, a very quiet street close to the center of Ditmars and the subway. I've spent a lot of time in the area, and I agree with Rob & Nancy that there are many cuisines, shopping, grocery and entertainment options.  Rob & Nancy's place will be the first listing that I check when I need to visit Astoria again.

This is one great studio flat than allowed me to have a lot of privacy and calm for myself after long busy days in Manhattan.  The bed is very comfortable, the kitchen facilities are great and the bathroom has everything it needs. Also because it's a basement and with AC, no matter how hot it is outside it always keeps a very nice temperature. It's about 10 minutes walk to Ditmars Boulevard Station, with 2 trains running to manhattan which makes the commute very easy, plus by the station it's plenty of shops, supermarkets etc. Nancy and her husband Rob were really nice, welcoming and helpful in any issues I had, which helped make my stay great.  Hope you guys enjoy;-)

This apartment is amazing! The sun shines in the front door window and lights the place up. Never do you feel like you are in a basement apartment. The full kitchen, beautiful bathroom, and the most comfortable sofa bed you will ever experience made it easy for me to stay with Nancy for four months. This area of Astoria is great, just a short walk to all the shops, restaurants and the N train on 31st street or go the other way to Astoria park. Walking along the east river with the awesome view of Manhattan was one of my favorite things to do during my stay.Nancy and Rob were very accomadating and helpful. From getting me pointed in the right direction upon my arrival to being there throughout my time there to answer any question and address any problem. Believe me, when I return to New York this apoartment will be my first choice in where to stay. Good luck to all and enjoy!

I don't know where to start with this review. I just love this apartment so much!  I literally walk in after work each day and just grin, happy to be here. The space is adorable and just perfect for one person. The fully equipped kitchen allows me to cook nearly every night. The sofa bed is so much more than your typical sofa bed - large and comfortable. Plenty of room to store your things between a sizeable closet and many nooks and crannies to put your personal things. The bathroom is gorgeous! The spa-like shower is so wonderful and luxurious.  And the floor heating is such a plus, especially with this bitterly cold winter we've experienced.   The location is about a 10-12 min. walk to the train, about a 20-30-min. subway ride to the first stop in Manhattan, and about 40-45 mins. to Times Square.  Getting here from the airports may be tricky if you don't know the public transportation system well, but it's a close taxi ride from LaGuardia, and not cost-prohibitive from JFK.   The immediate neighborhood is residential, so it is very quiet and safe.  Five blocks away, you're surrounded by restaurants and shops and three blocks away are two Laundromats and further down the main street is three major banks, more restaurants, grocery stores, etc.    Nancy and Rob are wonderful hosts, thoughtful in every aspect, from helping to care for the apartment to being available for any request, question or concern.  They are a very nice couple and have been very responsive and I've enjoyed getting to know them.   I will be here for a total of three months and will miss the space terribly when I leave.  It feels VERY much like home. The single drawback is spotty cell reception, but remedied by standing in the front of the apt. or at the doorway.  I absolutely recommend this apartment for a long-term stay...it is very nearly perfect!

Having just completed month two of a three-month stay at Nancy & Rob's fabulous apartment, I am still very happy here.  It certainly has been too cold since my arrival to explore much, but what I've seen of the area, I really like: I use the local library, the grocery store is great and I love the restaurant options as well as the Landromats nearby.  The area feels very much like a neighborhood, and I'm beginning to recognize people (and dogs!)  The apartment has remained warm and cozy through the most brutal of winters and I've truly enjoyed Rob & Nancy's company and hospitality.    I'll likely cry when I leave this place, as I do love it so!

I've enjoyed Nancy & Rob's apartment so much that I've decided to look for my own place right here in Astoria!  I couldn't have asked for a better introduction to the area or a place that made me happier to come "home" at the end of each day.    This has been such a great experience and I can't recommend Nancy & Rob's place highly enough.  Quiet, cozy, warm...and it has nearly everything you could possibly need for day-to-day life.  And it's easy to get to Manhattan.  Come here and experience one of New York's best neighborhoods while having a terrific apartment in which to do it.  You won't regret it!

I absolutely loved staying at Nancy and Rob's place! It was so cosy and organized, and Nancy would always do her best to make sure everything was fine. Just a few blocks from the subway, totally walkable and full of restaurant/market options. The neighborhood is very calm and lovely as well! I would come back easily =)
As always, Nancy and Rob are very hospitable, responding quickly to any requests, and otherwise very discrete, creating a peaceful space. Everything I need for a home away from home!

Awesome place to stay in New York. I was here for two months while working in Manhattan and it is perfect for that -- quiet and comfortable. Being near the first stop on the N and Q is great for commuting in the morning as you will always get a seat on the train, and rarely have to wait outside. Nancy and Rob were extremely nice and even managed to get the steps shoveled immediately after we got 2+ feet of snow. They were always helpful and available and interacting with them is a pleasure. The area is a good mix of quiet residential and some shops, and there's a park less than a mile away if you like to run. Highly recommended!
Nancy and Rob have been very kind and attentive from the start. The studio is exactly as described. It is a basement apartment so do not expect so much light, but it is very clean and cosy.

This was my second visit to Nancy and Rob's place and I absolutely loved my experience! It was so cosy and organized, and Nancy would always do her best to make sure everything was fine. Just a few blocks from the subway, totally walkable and full of restaurantand others relaxing places. I'm sure I'll be returning!

Nancy and Rob were excellent hosts. They very accommodating and quick in replying to messages.  The apartment was very clean and exactly as listed.  Nancy was very organized with all information needed for the Astoria. The location is an easy  commute into Manhattan.  The location is also an easy walk to the shops and restaurants on Ditmars Blvd.

We had a lovely extended stay in Jane's studio, it was spacious and always warm and comfortable returning at the end of the day. Jane and her husband Sante were very approachable and helpful with local knowledge. The location was also good and I suspect we would not have explored as much of Brooklyn if we had been staying in Manhattan.  We would be happy to return if ever in New York.

Where do I begin? Nancy's place was the perfect place to stay during my recent visit to New York. I felt very safe in the neighborhood which is conveniently located walking distance from juice & coffee shops. One night I accidentally left the windows down in my car and Nothing was stolen! Her place is also walking distance from the subway. My favorite thing about my stay was the bed. I honestly thought that I may have trouble sleeping on a sofa bed but to my delight, this was not the case at all! Nancy was very accessible and responded with every need. Although this is a basement apartment, there is a small frosted window in the bathroom along with a small window over the door which allows a little natural light to come in. The apartment also has heating in the floor which is perfect for me because I'm always cold! I will definitely book with Nancy the next time I visit New York.

I had an absolutely amazing stay! Nancy was a great host and made sure that I was living comfortably. She respected my privacy, which I appreciated. She is very kind and makes you feel at home (almost as if you’re a family friend!). Nancy and Rob’s place is a terrific location - super safe, an easy walk to the subway station and bus stop, and has lots of cool stores nearby. Nancy was always quick to respond to my texts and we kept in good communication throughout my stay. I highly recommend Nancy’s gorgeous suite in beautiful Astoria! You won’t regret it, trust me.

We had some trouble in the beginning to get hold of Victor, we were waiting for maybe 2 hours before we could go in and we tried to call, send messages over and over again, which was quite stressful since we never been in that area. Were about go back in to the city to get another room, when he responded me in a text and we could finally get in and he was home. And he did apologize to us many times and were supernice to us so it was no hard feelings. He explained why he couldn't answer. And things happen sometimes, so it was all good. Victor is a great host, so nice, helpful and welcoming. We felt like home! The room is supernice, big and clean. The apartment was great, the bathroom clean and kitchen. So nice with the big TV with movies, nice big bed and a lot of space. Apt is close to subway, in a calm area and close to restuarants. We would definately be stay here again :)

Victor's place is exactly what it's listed as...a nice room on the first floor of a building in the Bronx.  It's clean, has a very comfortable bed, great TV, cold air conditioning. Victor was there but we had our privacy and it was not an uncomfortable situation at all.   He brought us fresh bagels and coffee in the morning that were good and we appreciated them! He is a really nice guy! We never felt unsafe there at all.  It's close to the subway and he was nice to help us out with directions.  I highly recommend his place.  What a great deal! Thank you, Victor! This was our first experience with New York or Airbnb!

Kwabs flat was brilliant for me and my best mate to live in for the week. My first time in NYC and was great to experience th big scary flashy busy city from a proper Brooklyn neighbourhood. Though on the first day I was a little intimidated by the whole scene we soon realised everyone was very welcoming and chilled if you just gave a little nod and a wave here and there haha! Lovely beds, enough space to entertain guests. Fully functioning kitchen and loo etc. Shower water pressure was horrendous and water took a good five minutes to warm up but once we got over it and relished the hot water we were perfectly fine! (Also we couldn't work out how to change temperature on oven- a set of instructions would have been helpful) Would have liked a washing machine perhaps- or maybe tips on cheap places to wash clothes? But Kwab, although we never actually met was very quick to respond to any queries and was super duper helpful with every question. He left us to our privacy which was comforting even if we were a little loud! It was good to know he was only downstairs if anything did go drastically wrong haha!   Overall, brilliant brilliant value for money; really comfy, efficient, clean and spacious apt to experience new York the real way. In close distance of (slightly intimidating and rundown) supermarket that had EVERYTHING. LONG LIVE FOODTOWN. And close to subway, super super easy to explore Manhattan with short walking distance to subway . Literally A/C line up to port 48th st. We saw everything and more!!  Thanks again Love Violet (and Liam)

My friends (5 total) and I stayed at Charles place. The area looked unsafe at first but it turned out the neighbors keep to themselves and some are friendly. One even came in the restaurant to let us know how great the food was and suggested a dish. There is a convenient store about 20 seconds walk from the front door with all the basics you need beverages, beers and snacks. Down Lewis St about 2/4 min walk there's a Chinese take out with pretty good food and cheap prices (we ate there 2 nights haha). Charles was really friend and would gladly help you in anything you need. Apartment is over a 100 years old, was clean nice, has a home feeling and beds are clean and comfy. I would definitely stay there again. It's one of the better places to stay. I felt like we got really lucky with this apartment with a competitive price.

The picture describes exactly the same as the room it was. Public transit is very convenient. At the very beginning I was afraid that the place were not safe, well, I stayed for a week and I'm just fine. I met great people who are always being helpful. It is a great place to stay!

Had a great time in the Bronx & Victors place was a very cosy touch to being in NY. It does take about 30-40 minutes to get to Times Square from Kingsbridge Rd station but the time flys. A lot of dope places to eat round don’t be afraid to walk around the neighbourhood is beautiful during the day. Thanks Victor for accommodating us.   Kaan & Jas x

Kwab was a very discreet host; we only met him on the ground floor of the house in which the apartment is located. The photos and presentation are generally faithful to the reality of the apartment even if we could have hoped that the cleaning team would be a little more conscientious with regard to dust in particular or even the maintenance of the host. The apartment is super well located with the Utica metro which takes you to Manhattan in 25 minutes, the area is also very quiet with a few small convenience stores in the immediate vicinity of the apartment. Things to plan for if your flight takes off in the evening: how to manage your luggage? because at noon the apartment must be returned and Kwab does not have the possibility to keep the suitcases... a whole day with 20kg suitcases all before an 8 hour flight...

I traveled with my family(2yr old & 9yrs old) and was a little nervous at first but Kwab place is amazing he is such a great host, gave us some good tips, If you have any questions he is super easy to get a hold of and replys right away, quiet good neighborhood, really close to subway station, liquor store in both corners seem a little sketchy but really nice people (best sandwiches) I love the feeling of getting way more for what I paid for. Our overall trip was amazing had such a great time New Yorkers are super friendly would highly recommend visiting and staying at Kwab's place!

Al was pretty quick at responding. The appartment had all the basics and it was pretty easy to find street parking nearby. Al left some orange juice, fruit and water bottles, which was much appreciated. That being said, the appartement was pretty dirty, it seriously needs a cleaning and there were many huge black house flies (we killed 15 during our 4 day stay). The neighbourhood is sketchy and there isn't much to do nearby. The commute into the city is at least 45 minutes. So if you want a budget-friendly stay and dont mind staying in a dirty appartment, go for it!

Al's apartment was great. We had a good experience contacting Al, he was flexible regarding the check in time, the apartment was clean and maintained, very close to the subway and at a good price. Although the neighborhood could seem a bit sketchy, nothing happened when we were there. If you want a nice place at a reasonable price and could handle a 30 minute commute to Manhattan, that's the place for you.

Instructions of how to get in excellent, small problem with wifi sorted out very quickly by William who is a delightful guy and really helpful. We had a problem with ants coming in and again William couldn't do enough to help. Overall the accommodation is good, we chose to get a small kettle because one wasn't supplied and us Brits like tea and not just coffee. We have bequeathed the kettle to the next residents. Flat was very clean and comfy, a bit dark but then it is a basement flat and that is really to be expected. In the Bed Stu part of Brooklyn the flat is in an okay road, didn't feel unsafe, my best description that the area is an up and coming area that isn't quite up and coming yet. The subway G line is literally just around the corner which made getting into Manhatten very easy. If we had problems we just used what's app to contact William and he was always willing to help. Overall the accommodation did what it said on the tin and was fine. AL got in touch to see that we had arrived and had no problems but it was the lovely William that we dealt with if we needed something. The kitchen utensils were adequate but for example we tried to cook pasta and there was no colander to drain the pasta. The cups provided were small cups for coffee. There were no mugs, we actually brought two so that we could have a hot drink. I would say that the kitchen is adequate but not more than that. This of course could be an American thing so I realise I might not be comparing like for like. This isn't a moan as such this is more of an observation. We booked a shuttle to take bring us to the flat from Newark Airport. Please be warned that Brooklyn from Newark Airport is not exactly cheap, nor is getting a yellow cab from Manhatten to Brooklyn. Going down to DUMBO and the Brooklyn Bridge is a must, the Manhatten Skyline from across the East River is just amazing. Overall it was a good stay and a good choice of flat to stay in. What would be good for the future would be to have a flat manual about the running of the flat, when the rubbish is collected, how the air con works, what channels are available on the tv. Where the best grocery stores are etc. Please note that it was my choice to get the kettle and the mugs, I didn't involve William or Al in the decision. I only mention it because some people might think it a disadvantage.

Katherine and her place were perfect!  From the first communication to the last it was clear Katherine is committed to her guests' comfort and satisfaction.  Her apartment is just lovely and immaculate.   The area of the city is great.  I rely on cabs for my transportation and never had to wait more than a minute.  The door men where super nice.  There is a drug store, grocery store, movie theater, and a multitude of great restaurants within a block or two.   In a nut shell, I highly recommend Katherine / her fantastic apartment to anyone wishing for an easy going, enjoyable stay in the big apple!

Very good choice!!. The apartment looks exactly as it does in the pictures. It is nice, very clean, quiet and well located. Nearby there is a drug store (24/24 hs) and a multitude of great restaurants. Katherine is a great hostess, friendly and helpful. Definitely, we will be booking again!. We strongly recommend this apartment and its owner.

The apartment is totally faithful to the photographs, spacious, stylish, clean and very comfortable. Although at first we were afraid because of some comments we had received about the neighborhood, this image changed as soon as we walked around and discovered it. It has the metro stop nearby and there are many cool and cozy places, you can definitely tell that it is a neighborhood that is resurgent. It was a great success to take this apartment for the good fortune of getting to know another New York

Great location close to the G train, great value. It's got a grungy vibe, lots of patches and janky additions, but it's a large space, it's clean enough, and everything mostly works. Slightly sketchy area with people screaming and car alarms going off in the daytime, but it's not dangerous and you'll be okay unless it's your first time in a big city. Just don't go in expecting the Ritz-Carlton and you'll be fine, would come back again for a budget trip :)

I spent a week at Al’s apartment in Brooklyn. Check-in was quick and simple, the apartment was spacious, warm and well-stocked with cooking supplies. Internet was fast and easy to work from home. Neighborhood is trendy and has bars, restaurants and close to the G train and buses to downtown BK, and the street is quiet. Al is a responsive and kind host and his Airbnb is a steal! Highly recommend.

We stayed at Al-'s place over President's Day weekend. The apartment is very comfortable and was relatievely clean. The kitchen, bathroom, and bedroom were very clean. The living area was dusty and the sheets that were on the sofabed were stained. We are a family of four, a one year old and a six year old the sofabed was very difficult to set out and fold back up. It also folds up if you sit too close to the edge. It is not bad for the price and it is very close to the subway station.Neighborhood is very quite a few blocks away it seems sketchy but that particular street looked ok.

This was a very nice apartment with some unexpected amenities. It was well stocked with the basics.  Al responded to me timely & the check-in process was very easy.  Very close to a Subway stop on Nostrand so easy to get around. A couple locals warned us not to walk around the neighborhood after dark so I felt a bit jumpy coming home late, however we never felt unsafe. We found some great coffee shops & a diner in the neighborhood that were great. Of course there was a deli on every other corner so no problems finding nearby food & drink.

I really enjoyed my sty at Bias house she is a nice and always concerned an really fun host, the room was really huge I had a lot of space for my suitcases and everything for everyone who needs a tv on vacation - one of the biggest ones i've ever seen!  If you need anything don't be afraid to ask Bia knows a lot of restaurants, bars and amazing people!

Milan is absolutely the best! From before I arrived, he made sure to address any questions, needs or concerns I had. Upon arrival, Charles, the doorman, anticipated potential needs which made the stay very smooth, pleasant and stress free. Both were very hospitable, making me feel safe, comfortable and right at home. The apartment itself is great; clean, comfortable, safe, and shows better in person than in photos. Located in a great neighborhood. I highly recommend staying here.

I booked the place because I had to leave for New York the next day and it was an immediate transaction (no waiting), but then Dana messaged me to tell me that the place was no longer available. So when I asked him to cancel, he said he cannot cancel on his end WHICH WAS A LIE because the host has to cancel in order for the guest to get full refund. It was only after I told him that that Dana canceled the trip the next day and I was able to get my money back. Just wanted to put it out there as warning... I felt like if I didn’t check first and knew that the host had to cancel for me to get full refund, I would’ve been taken advantage of the money (because if I cancel, I only get cleaning fee back). Overall, this was super shady.

I am a medical student and this was a great place to study as well as unwind for 6 weeks. Barry was an extremely accommodative host and made the stay very comfortable. There is another roommate and she is extremely nice as well. Room is exactly as pictured with plenty of sunlight! There is a huge table with a great office chair, plenty of closet/drawer space, and the view from the rooftop of the building is stunning. I would love going up there to just relax and de-stress. Building/neighborhood are safe. There is a 24 hour gym (with all that you could need), a laundry room, a game room, as well as a laundry facility in the building. The place is great if you are looking to experience Brooklyn, work, or just get away. Barry was very welcoming, courteous, and I would wholeheartedly recommend staying with him.

Bia was amazing. Genuinely caring and helpful. The room was great.  However, I  was stuck stranded at front door for 1+ hr and she was unresponsive on her cellphone. She forgot to share key information about apartment keys. It was a simple miscommunication and I know Bia had all good intentions, but it still left a pretty sour taste in my mouth at the time.  In spite of that, I can't stress enough how amazing Bia is. Offered drinks, followed up after the trip, the whole deal.  I've given 4 stars for the checkin process because of the issue with keys, otherwise a perfect 5 star all-around. Would definitely stay again.

Clean and stylish pad in a great neighbourhood. Walking distance from vintage shops, cafes and well known restaurants/delis like Katz, Russ & Daughters and Clinton st bakery etc. Bathroom is not ensuite but was for the guest’s/my exclusive use. It’s also a few blocks away from Essex st station (F/J lines). Walked home late each night from the station and never once felt unsafe. The place is also near Williamsburg bridge so it was convenient to trip down to Brooklyn. Charlie the doorman was incredibly helpful with helping me check out and get a car to the airport. Milan was also very friendly and conversational and gave enough personal space. Will definitely be back

I had a great time in New York, the room is spacy and located in an interesting Latino neighborhood, very convenient to go to all the interesting places in New York. I never felt unsafe, even when coming home late at night. Bia is a great host, very friendly and forthcoming, always up for a chat. I really enjoyed my stay there.

Bia is a lovely and friendly host. I really enjoyed my stay during by business trip to NY. The room is clean and comfortable. The location is quite close to the subway, 7-8 minutes on foot. The neighborhood is safe and quiet, I've never felt in danger.The price is very good for what you get.  I would recommend this location to anyone who wants to save money and have a great staying in NY.

I really enjoyed my stay at Bia's home. Bia was a wonderful host. She really went out of her way to make me feel at home and comfortable. I have absolutely nothing to criticize. She is Brazilian and lives in NY several years, knows every inch of the city. The apartment is clean and the room is spacious with closet, a comfortable bed and a huge TV. Near to the subway (line 6) and 10 min-walk to central park. You have also everything in the neighborhood: a lot of deli and groceries, drug stores and banks.  Yes, I would definitely stay with Bia again the next time I am in New York. I recommend to everyone.

I felt comfortable in Bia's house, I had been before the previous year, she is friendly and explains everything to you, and if you need something you ask her and she advises you, the neighborhood is the typical East Harlem neighborhood, where at least for me it is very picturesque, full of Dominican people, Puerto Ricans, Mejocanos. I mean they speak your language, I was never afraid to go out at night, I felt very safe

Jessica and Jason were very helpful hosts. Jessica met us when we moved in and had several great recommendations for food and shopping in the area, including a farmers' market.  The stay was very pleasant throughout. The place was spotless when we moved in and well stocked with clean towels, bed sheets, and kitchenware. There was no intrusive noise from elsewhere in the building or from the street outside. We were lucky to catch some December sunshine and enjoyed having the use of the back garden. There were even some Steely Dan and classical CDs that we played while we were staying there, and various interesting books as well.  The area itself is well situated, with Manhattan a few subway stops away on the M and R lines. It is a safe, ethnically vibrant neighbourhood without the stress and noise of more high-rise areas. I would heartily recommend Jason's and Jessica's apartment to anyone who wants to feel at home for their visit.

Christy is great - highly responsive and very friendly.  Her apartment is exactly as advertised - perfect location at the intersection of Soho and Little Italy.  Can't stress how quiet the place is which is impressive considering it's just steps from bustling Little Italy.  Powerful A/C and extremely comfortable bed.  Thanks again Christy!

First thing to say is that I would DEFINITELY stay at Christy's apartment again.   It is exactly as you see in the pictures. It was clean, the bed was comfortable, the shower was hot and had good pressure, and it had good wifi. But most importantly it was SO QUIET. Because it is a rear apartment you are set back from the road and you genuinely cannot hear a sound from the road, even when there was heavy drilling going on nearby.   I was not in the apartment very much during my 4 night stay, but it provided everything I needed and everything I had hoped for when I made the booking. It is in the heart of Little Italy so there are plenty of places to eat all around you, and it's a five/ten minute walk to Broadway. Also you are in a busy part of town so you never feel unsafe in the neighbourhood.   I did not have much contact with Christy but she provided me with all details promptly and was generally as helpful as you would want.

Hello Matteo! Once again, Julie and I thank you for the pleasant stay you gave us in your apartment. No unpleasant surprises, everything was as expected! On top of that, contact with you is easy, cool, direct and you care about our well-being at home. So we recommend you to everyone! The location is perfect, secure, the metro nearby, the location is great, in short a perfect choice! Thanks again Matteo! Julie and Fabrice

Excellent accommodation. We spent 6 days. It has all the amenities to spend an incredible stay in NYC. The neighborhood is very quiet so you can rest very well. It has a police station right in front which makes it safer although I didn't find it an unsafe neighborhood at all. Although we have not met Matteo, the communication with him was perfect, a very good host and the check-ins and check-outs were very well explained and without any problems.

This listing needs to be updated!  I'm an active Airbnb user, but this was my first time terrible experience:  1. Windows.   The room isn't suitable for winter. Cold air is getting in the room because window is not fully sealed. It has AC unit in the window and on the sides of AC some material taped in, but the tape isn't able to hold wind and cold air from outside.  I was sleeping in my gloves, scarf, double pants, and hat on. But still got cold and had a headache for the next 2 days after it. It's the same feeling as you sleep outside, wind kept circling around the room for the entire night.    2. Heater.   On this listing it says that this place has a heater. But it doesn't say that it's not working everyday. Apparently the host doesn't have control over it. And plug in heater isn't offered at this place.   3. Cleanliness.   I arrived at 9pm, tired after 6h flight. But my room wasn't ready (wasn't cleaned after previous guest). But check in starts at 3pm, so theoretically it was supposed to be ready. I had to wait another hour for host to somewhat clean the room (please, note - there's no wet cleaning. Vaccum only. Don't think it's ok with all the Covid situation).   I was waiting in the living room between 5 or 6 bags of recycle/garbage next to me.  There were so many red flags already, but I was tired after the flight and didn't have energy to look for a different place that night.   And I still got the sheets with a big stain... kinda gross.    But the bathroom looked surprisingly clean!   4. Check-in.  I let the host know at what time to expect me, but she still wasn't ready for my visit.   I was giving her heads up ahead of time (when I departed, when I landed, estimate of arrival, etc.).  So, I was standing outside of the building for almost 20min. It was raining. And the host won't respond to me.... so I asked my husband to call her and see if she responds. She didn't reply either. We started thinking it was a scam,  because she was responsive before.   So I was standing at 9pm alone on the rain until a random couple let me in and said that it will be SAFER to wait in the building.  So I did.  And then finally the host arrived, and the story with room confusion and "Sorry,  I didn't have time to clean your room. I work hard" began. I work hard as well,  so I wanted to come to a ready room and get some rest. Didn't expect all of the surprises.    5. Room.  The room you see the first image of the listing isn't available for booking.  That's the host's room. So it shouldn't even be on the Airbnb listing.   There are 2 rooms with brown colors on the bed in this listing. Before I booked this place I asked the host which room was available for the dates I needed.  She said "brown sheets". I didn't even mention that there was another room down on the listing with brown sheets.  And first room has brown blanket,  not sheets.  Very confusing. The host should sent images of the exact room in the future to avoid situations like this.   And I found it out only in person...  That's not the way to do the business.    6. Honesty.   After the 1st night I realized that I have to find a different place, so I did.  And I asked the host to refund my money since the description on Airbnb didn't meet the reality. So she kept cleaning fee and service fee and told me that these fees were charged by Airbnb.  And I have confirmed with Airbnb that she told them to keep it.  So it ended up being $119.82 for 1 night at a place like that. And the host refunded me the rest (originally I was planning on staying here 4 nights).  But the fact that she said that Airbnb kept the fees.. I don't like when people don't say the truth.    I hope that the host will address these issues for the future visitors!

Our family had an awesome time in New York....This trip could not have been possible without Gordy...thank you so much for your hospitality and your warm welcome...you really made our stay in New York very easy and stress free...you were an awesome host...Thanks a bunch Gordy!!

Matteo was a really good host. Really quick to reply to any queries and we liked his step by the step instructions which meant easy to find the place and the keys, no chaos whatsoever. The place is as in pictures, no unpleasant surprises, but the location is more East Harlem than Upper Manhattan,however good shops nearby, Central Park 5 mins away and subway - 2 mins away. Great location! It is a bit noisy though, you can hear everything your neighbours are doing, could do with a better door and windows, and more blankets, but apart from that it was a good experience. Oh and there’s a police station opposite the building so felt safe. All in all it was good and we definitely recommend it. A clean Airbnb without any issues!

Matteo´s apartment is a wonderful place. The days we stayed there were just excellent. He´s a great host, very easy to contact. The newly renovated apt was a beauty. Prety clean, luminous and cozy, really close to the 6 line and central park. We highly reccomend Matteo. we just didn't feel very safe at the location. Even with a police station nearby, the where lots of suspicious people ate the metro station.

I didn't meet Gordy until the last minute as he was away on business. I'm sure the experience would have been better if he was there to show us around and talk about the neighborhood.   Overall, the place is clean and huge. Lots of beds. Not a ton of space to hang out, but Gordy says he is working on that. Perfect for large groups that need a lot of sleeping space. So big, you can almost hide from people.   Neighborhood is average. It's not Manhattan, but I didn't feel unsafe at anytime. We drove around a lot, and nicer parts of Brooklyn are nearby.   Bathrooms and kitchen were great. We didn't use the outside area at all, but looked fine.   As a bunch of middle aged guys, most of us thought it was fine and others wished we were in Manhattan. At this price point though, it is a great deal for a large group.   Gordy was very nice when I met him, and he even paid half of my parking fine for parking illegally which he didn't have to do.   I would recommend this place for a NYC trip for large groups. Travel to NYC by Uber was $25 at off hours and $75 during heavier traffic times. Subways available as well.   I hope this helps. I tried to be as honest as possible.

Gordy made us feel VERY welcome!!!  Meeting us at the house, always responsive to anything we need, and showing us great hospitality.  We had 26 people and it was more than enough space!  It was perfect.  We couldn't have asked for anything more.  It was near to two different subway lines and they ran right on time so it was super convenient.  We had small groups come in late at night and they never felt unsafe walking through the neighborhood.  The house was AWESEOME!!

Had a similar positive experience as described by other guests. The bed is comfy and water pressure is good.  As a tropical girl, I am afraid of cold. Though there is no heating in the house, Carol laid more blankets to keep me warm.

The best thing here is Gordy! He is so nice to us and is willing to help us when we have problems. Despite the fact that it is not located in the city, there is a subway nearby.  The thing you should concern is that environment at night could be a bit scary if you walk alone; if you don't walk alone, you should be fine!

First Airbnb, first out of Europe trip and first time in the US, in the Bronx even so we were a bit exited and certainly curious, not knowing what really to expect.  When we mentioned Bronx here in Belgium people thought they would never see us again. This perception was more than 100% wrong, we ended up in a very nice neighborhood in a just perfect apartment.  It certainly added a lot of real America or real NY city (that's more than Manhattan folks!) experience to our great trip.  The apartment is spacious, help on anything is nearby and given with pleasure, and you'll have at the same time a 100% private place with shops, food, subway all a few minutes on foot away.  If you would like to taste, as an European tourist, a bit of the real life I recommend this apartment for 100%, it has everything you need for a great price on a great location.  And yes, it's a bit far from Manhattan and you'll have to walk 5 minutes to the subway (or take the bus which is stopping in front of the apartment to the metro station) but hey, in Manhattan you'll probably walk a lot more and depending on where you should stay in Manhattan transfers with metro or yellow cab will take the same or even more time to get around so at the end  this is no problem at all, if you take the 5 train during rush hours you're in the city center before you know it.  And even when returning late it's really safe. We never ever felt any minute unsafe, my 16 year old daughter, went shopping on her own without any hesitation and that certainly means something.  The apartment itself has everything you need, the vintage bathroom (looked from an European point of view) is adoring, the beds are great, the kitchen well equipped.  The broadband wifi worked great, included in the price and not slowing down or expensive as you'll still find in a lot of hotels.  But certainly also the privacy, the freedom and even the nice garden  are great pro's for this place.  I'm recommending it already!  Isn't there anything negative then? No, not really or yes maybe one little thing, it's very hard to leave.

This place was such a steal! Cynthia and her housemate were very easy to correspond with. Arranging arrival and departure times was effortless, and getting to the apartment from Manhattan was relatively unchallenging. The room was perfect -- such a treat to have our own bathroom (and the complimentary hotel-sized bath products were a nice surprise since I hadn't brought shampoo with me). More than enough privacy. Everything was clean and in order without feeling unlivably pristine. We felt welcome to use the (gorgeous and well-stocked) kitchen but didn't, as cooking isn't the thing one tends to do when one has only three nights in New York. In any case we felt super lucky to not be paying hundreds of dollars a night for a hotel room that wouldn't have felt nearly as lovely to come home to. Thank you so much, Cynthia and Michael!

Christian and Carla's place was just as described, clean and full of everything we needed. A generous snack of fruits and an amazing coffee cake were waiting for me and my 5 friends. We slept 6 people in the apartment and although it was a little crowded, it was perfect for what we needed after attending concerts at MSG. Everyone had a bed or futon and we all slept great. It was quiet and a safe neighborhood; even when we took the train to the wrong exit and had to walk back a mile, we never felt unsafe. I highly recommend staying at this lovely apartment!

Our stay started off dreadfully. Because they have keyless entry, we were texted a code for the front door. Unfortunately, nowhere (at the time, it has since been changed) in the endless and repetitive "House Manual" did it say that there were in fact two different apartments in the same building, each with a different code. So, driving in from Philadelphia, expecting to be able to drop off our stuff and our dog and head into Manhattan on the subway for a memorial service, we were unable to access the apartment, and had to drive in on Super Bowl weekend. We were still dressed in street clothes, with the dog, and the traffic was so bad that we missed the service. But how did we make such a mistake with the door? It's actually pretty easy when the building number is on one door, along with a keycode entry, and the other,  in the basement, is not marked. Here are some pictures I took of each entrance: http://bit.ly/1boOWTP   http://bit.ly/1dZh0tB    When we couldn't in, I texted the host's parents (who were supposed to be our direct contact and live in the other apartment) and after having to leave for Manhattan, called Carla, who seemed very surprised that I was unaware of two separate apartments. Fine, this was a grievous misunderstanding. When we finally came back to the basement apartment 5 hours later, we discovered some minor problems and some major ones. The Kinect XBOX remote that is used for the TV didn't work, there were no batteries in there, but then it didn't work after being given batteries either. There were no facecloths in the bathroom or closet. And the "snack" promised in the directions was non-existent, unless the frozen melon balls, or whatever they were, were the snack. More importantly, there was no temperature control, and so on a cold day outside, it was also cold inside. The next day, it was too hot, but again, we had no control. The same was true of the truly erratic water in the shower. I have no idea where the smoke smell from above us was, but my asthmatic girlfriend was not happy about it.  The pet situation is also vague, AIRBNB knew I was bringing our dog (I called them in advance), but our hosts didn't. Did the booking price change by $50 because I specified that we needed a pet-friendly residence?  And so we got a passive aggressive text at 3:30 in the morning on the day of our stressful drive, "reminding us" of the pet policy and then a request via AIRBNB to change our agreement to charge more for an extra guest. That guest? Our dog. Were we supposed to pay the $50 fee in advance to the hosts' parents, who we happen to have run into once? Who knows, but don't pretend I'm trying to sneak one past you.          On the plus side, the apartment is cozy and mostly clean and the surrounding area is quiet.

The Box House Hotel was even more than we expected and we have HIGH expectations.  From the amazing decor, ambiance and hipster local community, what steals the show is the awesome customer service.  The staff provided car service and tips on restaurants and shops which made staying in Brooklyn for the first time easy and a lot of fun.  We can't wait to be back as this was the best vacation accommodation experience we've ever had!

We were made very welcome by Frank, even though we had arrived earlier than the 3 pm check in time.  Both he and Jacqueline introduced themselves and chatted while they cleaned... Frank gave us his mobile phone number in case we needed it.   The apartment itself was clean and the bed maybe one of the comfiest I have ever slept in.  The only down side I would say is the length of time it took on the subway to get into the city.  It suited us but maybe not a group who were in New York for the late nights...   On the positive side, we were a bit wary of the connotations of the Bronx area but never once did we feel unsafe, in fact the majority of the locals went out of their way to be helpful with directions and how to use the subway system etc.   Overall a very pleasant stay, in a very pleasant apartment, in a very pleasant area.

This was our first experience so we were unsure what to expect. The flat was very comfortable and clean. The beds were very comfortable. It was nice to have a king size bed. Our host was pleasant and helpful. Location was convenient in the sense that the bus stop was outside our door and it was a short ride to the subway. The no. 2 train took us all the way to Manhatten. We were about an hour away by subway. There was a good place for breakfast about 2 blocks away as well as drug stores and food markets within 2 blocks. Good location, good landlord, would recommend.

The hotel is beautiful with touches of old and new, while also being warm and welcoming. However, there were some issues had. And unfortunately, I have to write them down.   The rooms are beautiful and clean and I loved them. I'd live in one. They actually inspired our design process at our home!!  We were excited to experience great customer service that all the other reviewers have raved about but we did have some problems when we arrived. They delayed us by an hour, even though it was already 11pm, because he couldn't find where we already payed via AirBnB. Once we spoke to the manager, she too was confused by what he told us but c'est la vie. The second night, there was a pipe burst and the first floor flooded. After 2 1/2 hrs, and not-so-great customer service from the same guy, we were put in a new room(this was by 4am). Our room was large but there was dust everywhere and the heater emitted a smokey/musky smell which triggered an asthma attack. Now, with negative degree weather, this sucked. But this was not their fault. The room hadn't been used in a while and the pipe burst was not planned so we couldn't hold this against them. After the eventful evening, Jenicka(manager) came up and sat with us. We spoke of the experience and she was nothing short but understanding and empathetic. Honestly, were it not for her, we'd have left a much different opinion. I also need to mention Mike. This guy was running around while water was pouring down the hallway like a crappy revamp of titanic. He helped all the tired and angry patrons with sincerity. He also made sure to move everyone's luggage, help them find any item they couldn't find (we almost lost a cell phone), and he provided comfort.   The third night, we were placed in a new room with a working heater. The bed was comfortable, the appliances efficient. The couch was super comfortable and even though we were near the main road, it really wasn't loud. When a car would go by, we mistook it for wind actually.   Ceasar, the bartender, is amazing. So kind and genuine. If you get to meet him, spend 5 minutes with him and you'll want to be best friends. Tip him well, offer him a place to stay should he choose to travel. He deserves it.   It was an eventful vacation and one we definitely won't forget.   We might give it another shot someday, if we can catch it on a cheaper date.

Barbara's loft and her company were very grounding for me in what was a stressful point in my life. As she said, it was a place of healing. We enjoyed each other's company and I certainly left feeling much calmer than when I arrived. She is lovely to spend time with and prepared to accommodate the rhythms of another person's routine. Thankyou Barbara!

This was my first experience with an Airbnb and it was a very good one.  The property is  in a good location.   We were warmly welcomed.  It is in close proximity to your most basic needs, store, drug store, diners, and other eateries.  The apartment has your basic amenities covered.  It was a delightful experience.  Parking can be a  bit of a challenge. However, transit is nearby.

Barbara's loft was an absolute dream. My partner and I came to visit NY for it's richness in culture, art and charm - and Barbara's loft added to this experience tenfold.  This would be a great place for any travellers who require a "homebase" while visiting the city, but who also want a space that feels lived in and authentic (too many times we've been drawn into hotel-style Airbnbs with zero personality) This is not your average home, and that is a good thing!  Barbara was incredible in her communication, and was quick to provide anything that was needed to ensure we were comfortable during our stay. We knew exactly what to expect upon on our arrival, and that helped to make our check-in stress-free.   Perks: Close to the subway line, waterfront, and amazing eats!  Thank you again Barbara!

Promising option in Brooklyn with relatively new, fully furnished (everything IKEA) accommodation which is spacious for NYC. Unfortunately my stay was completely ruined by a billing dispute between AirBnB and the host, which led to a request for me to pay for my entire stay again, on day 4 of my 1 month stay. All this after my credit card had been charged for the full stay weeks before my arrival. After 3-4 days of arguments and discussion between all parties AirBnb and the host resolved the billing dispute. However, in the interim period I hated every minute of being at this property. I was fearful that either my credit card would be charged a second time by the host, or worse, I would return to the room to find I had been locked out. Treatment that I received was woeful and extended to not only being treated like a criminal, but being accused of being in the US illegally. I travel a lot for business, all over the world, and I would rate this my worst hotel experience of all time! I would have left earlier, however my request to cancel, with refund, was declined. For those looking for connectivity beware. The rooms have no telephones, there is free WIFI, but it is very patchy with frequent periods of no availability (up to whole days with no WIFI). All compounded by patchy (mostly no connectivity) to mobile networks (voice or data) from both T-Mobile and AT&T in the rooms. If you are looking for complete seclusion in NYC, with an inability for anyone to contact you in the rooms, then this could be the place for you. The rooms appear relatively new, but are still experiencing teething issues from initial construction. In my case, it included an exploding (and I mean violent explosion) glass shower screen door in the middle of the night. It literally sounded like a bomb going off, and I am sure woke not only me, but everyone else in nearby rooms. When I ventured into the bathroom - every inch of the room was covered in thousands of pieces of shattered safety glass. Leaving me with an unusable bathroom, until I changed rooms the next morning. To his credit the night manager was very apologetic and did accommodate with immediate access to another room, pending the move. The Hotel is located in an industrial street within an easy walk of two train lines. The 7 train is a walk across the Pulaski bridge which includes a climb up 4 flights of stairs which would be a challenge for some. The bridge is noisy, exposed to weather and frequented by heavy traffic. The amenities of Greenpoint, including restaurants and convenience stores, are within an easy 5-10 minute walk providing some reasonable options for eating and limited supplies. Onsite laundry (reasonably priced) and gym facilities (free) are a good convenience for those staying longer. I can understand why others do enjoy - but overall horrible experience for...

My daugher and I stayed 5 nights and were greeted warmly by Tunesia and John.  They are wonderful hosts!  The room was exactly as pictured with the addition of a comfy fold-out chair bed.  (The pictured bed was very comfortable as well!)  Lots of storage for our clothes.  We had a portable air conditioner to cool the room (the first 2 days were very warm but after that we only used the ceiling fans). Our room refrigerator was stocked with water bottles.  The wifi password, contact numbers, and house keys were all there for us.  We had access to the full kitchen outside our bedroom door and exclusive use of the downstairs bathroom.  John walked us to the nearby grocery store and pointed out recommended restaurants, the drug store and subway station.  The next morning we were headed to Columbia University, and John walked us part of the way.  Each day John and Tunesia checked on us, answered our questions, and gave us helpful tips and recommendations.  The neighborhood is convenient to Columbia U. and Central Park with easy access to the subway.  There are several restaurants nearby, and the atmosphere is lively.  We felt very safe even walking from the subway at night.  Stay here if you can!!

The room is exactly as described if not a little undersold.  The space is big with very high ceilings and everything you need for a comfortable stay.  The bed is super comfy and the room is nicely decorated and appointed with interesting art and furniture.  The room was really clean and the host was always available, helpful, and responsive to any requests.  The location is excellent.  Greenpoint is a nice neighborhood and there s a great market 1 block from the room.  There are also several really good restaurants  nearby and in walking distance.  The walk to the 7 train headed to midtown is about 20 minutes and over the Pulaski bridge.  My wife and I traveled with two teenagers and walked all over Greenpoint and to and from metro stations and never felt unsafe or uncomfortable.  I would definitely stay again.

I've been traveling the country for the past eight months and have staid at many different Air B&B in different cities. My stay at Christian & Carla's in Bronx has been one of the most peaceful and comfortable so far.  You get the entire first floor of the house to yourself and there's plenty of space not to feel crammed. The kitchen is very well stocked. I cook all of my meals every single day and I didn't have to purchase anything extra. Plenty of pots, pans, plates, utensils, kitchen towels, etc.   Large comfortable bedroom with two beds, good closet space and shelves/side tables for your vanity items. Plenty of towels and several sets of sheets.  Parking is super easy. I've been able to park literally in front of the house on Laconia without any trouble the entire month. There is street cleaning once a week and cars that don't get moved do get ticketed, so definitely pay attention to street cleaning signs.   There are several neighborhood grocery stores within about 10 min walking distance. There's also a large shopping center with larger grocery store (Stop and Shop), tons of restaurants, department stores, Sephora, Macy's, etc about 10 min drive.  Laundromat is about 5 mins walk (about 2 short blocks away). It offers drop-off service, which seems to be pretty popular.  There are a couple of Metro stations that will take you anywhere in NYC within  about 10-15 min walk, depending on how fast you walk.  There's a bus that stops right in front of the house as well.  Bronx can be a bit sketchy, but as a single female traveling alone I felt very safe in this part of the city.  There are a lot of families and school kids in this area and generally it has a pretty chill vibe. No loud venues with sketchy characters hanging outside at all hours of the day.   The hosts are very friendly and responsive. Overall a wonderful experience I'd recommend to family/friends.

We booked Lydia's apartment just hours before heading into New York. Lydia was super responsive, helpful and made traveling on such short notice a less stressful experience. The location was great, right next to a convenient subway stop, reataurants and bars, a great jumping off point for a busy weekend. The apartment was very tidy and clean with a really great bathroom. All and all very pleasant experience staying at Lydia's.

Andrew and Markus were so friendly and accommodating! The apartment was wonderful and just as described. The neighborhood itself seems a little rough, but it was very quiet and we never really felt unsafe. Overall, we had a great experience.

Really great host! The apartment is as described. It's very clean and has the perfect location in chelsea. Dan went to great lenghts to make sure that our stay was comfortable and met our expectations. In addition, hurricane Irene hit New York during our visit, and Dan continually kept us updated about the situation and helped us prepare. Truly valuable in a potentially stressful situation (we're from Sweden, where hurricanes aren't exactly commonplace).  Highly recommended!

Leslie's apartment is wonderful! I stayed for seven nights, and the only difficult part was leaving! It was amazing to have so much natural light in the living area, with big windows and a wide open view (we spent some time just lounging around and enjoying the excellent wifi). But the bedroom is nice and dark for sleeping. The apartment was high enough up to insulate us from the noise of the city, even with one of the windows open at night (well I did hear the odd siren, but it's New York). The building is very quiet, which makes the apartment a beautiful oasis after running around the city all day and evening. We enjoyed morning coffee on her balcony or on the building's lovely rooftop. All of the arrangements with Leslie were smooth and stress-free, and since it was my first Airbnb experience that was important to me. She left us plenty of space for our stuff, which meant we could really settle in. I almost felt like a real New Yorker ;) And, as most of the reviews mention, the apartment is in the perfect location. You can get anywhere in the city, including Brooklyn, very easily, but there are also so many great places right in the neighbourhood. I've usually stayed in Midtown and I much preferred this. Not that there aren't lots of people and tourists everywhere in NYC, but this has much more of a neighbourhood vibe and it was much easier to find great restaurants without ending up in tourist traps. If you're a coffee fiend like me, there are lots of great spots within a short walk - I didn't end up in Starbucks even once! And you really need to try a slice of Joe's Pizza - well, I may have stopped in there twice...

We found Antonio to be friendly, accommodating, and attentive. He is the ideal owner.   The apartment met all of our needs. The washer/dryer was a great convenience and the kitchen was well-supplied for cooking. The space is smaller than it appears in photos, but it is certainly spacious enough to comfortably house four people.   Subwaying it to Manhattan was not too difficult, but a transfer is necessary. It took us 45 minutes to an hour to get to/from the apartment and Midtown Manhattan (walking/subway combo). Not sure about bus options. Seriously consider taking a taxi when you arrive/depart if you have luggage, as getting to/from the apartment with it by foot and subway is no easy task.  There are a few small convenience stores nearby, and a larger grocery store that has the basics. The grocery store is small by US suburban standards though.  The only concern we had during our stay was the neighborhood. We did not feel safe and the neighborhood was largely in a state of disrepair. We are two Asian women in our mid-20s and on just our first night (before the arrival of my boyfriend) we were approached by a transient and were the target of some scary catcalls from some locals on a stoop. I understand that things like that are to be expected in urban settings from time-to-time, but that didn't make it any less frightening. As a foreigner I could not at first say if the neighborhood was unsafe, but even my boyfriend mentioned feeling uncomfortable. All was fine once in the apartment though, as we felt secure there.   In general, the apartment is a decent base from which to explore Brooklyn, Queens, and Manhattan.

Antonio was a lovely host, and the apartment was very comfortable and spacious for my friend and I.  We were greeted on arrival and Antonio had prepared detailed instructions on the location of local amenities and public transport etc.  The bedroom pictured with a sofa bed actually has a double bed and access to a rear backyard.  The subway is approx. a 10 minute walk from the apartment and if you're planning to visit other areas of Manhattan (besides lower Manhattan) such as Midtown or further north, allow up to an hour to get there by train as you'll have to change trains three times.  Other than that, the apartment is located fairly close to a grocery store and cafe/restaurants on Bedford Avenue.  I had read another review that guests felt unsafe in the area, although my friend and I (two girls) had no problems and felt safe walking home late most nights we stayed there.

The description of the house is just as O Dell describes it, very cozy and perfect for hosting 8 people, on our trip we were 6 people and we were very comfortable. I didn't find the neighborhood unsafe at all, on the contrary, all the people we met, supermarket employees, etc., were very friendly and helpful. As for O Dell, he is a great person, we had everything we needed without any problem, our flight was delayed upon arrival and he was there waiting for us. He guided us on how to get around the city perfectly, as well as the quickest route to get to the airport on the day of departure. He was always concerned about how our stay in NY was going. I advise you to choose this apartment to stay, you will not regret it. The description of the house is described as O Dell, cozy and perfect to accommodate 8 people on our trip we were 6 people and we were comfortable. The neighborhood did not seem at all unsure, on the contrary, all the people we met, employees of supermarkets, etc., were very friendly and helpful. As for O Dell, he is a great person, all we need what we had was no problem, our flight was delayed on arrival and was there waiting for us. He guided us in getting around the city perfectly, as the quickest route to the airport on the day of departure. Always worried about how it was turning our stay in NY. I advise that you choose this apartment to host you, you will not regret it. When I return to NY, I will stay there again.

Mr O'Dell is an excellent wonderful host who went out of his way to make our stay in New York and his apartment our best holiday so far.  He had to arrive at the apartment earlier than expected even in a very short notice. he picked and dropped us up at the airport saving my family stress and money.  His apartment was neat and homely. I am pleased to recommend his property to anyone who is visiting New York.
You feel very homely  Diana is never in your way  Place very clean  Very spacious  Lovely bathroom  Restaurants ,bars, drug store, grocery store are only a short walk away  Sunny bright Room Indeed

My experience and that of my family was very pleasant having chosen O'Dell's house as our place of rest for 10 days. The house is spacious enough for 6 people. The kitchen is quite equipped to cook everything from a light breakfast to a baked turkey. The kitchen pantry already had several food products, which we used to cook some meals. There was even fresh milk in the refrigerator.   The house is very functional and comfortable to rest at night. There is hot water all day for bathing and the water in the shower has enough pressure to enjoy a bath. There is air conditioning in the living room and master bedroom, which was good for reducing the heat.  Another great advantage that we found in the location of the house is that there is a minimarket right next to the house. The store opens from 7:00 A.M. and closes at 9:00 P.M. There we find everything we need to prepare light food for breakfast, mid-day lunch or dinner. The store sells fruits, vegetables, groceries, meats, bread, etc.  One more advantage that the house has is that there is a subway station just 4 blocks away. The average time from there to Manhattan was 40 minutes. Which was good because we were able to see many places of interest to us.  The neighborhood where the house is located seemed a little unsafe to us at first impression. But the truth is that during the 10 nights we slept there we were very calm and safe. There are some neighbors who play loud music on Saturday and Sunday, but at 10:00 P.M.
