So...stay at Casey's...his place is great value for money! I'd recommend it to friends any time!

If you want an eccentric, fun, adventurous area and Airbnb to stay at. Please check out Rob’s place. Not only will you get to enjoy Central Park only a few feet away, you can interact with as much or as little as you want with this host!  Very flexible guy who respects your space.

From start to finish this was a great experience. The place is amazing and just like in the photos. Very comfortable, warm and clean. Casey was extremely helpful and his neighborhood recommendations were great! This place is a steal! Nice neighborhood, quiet building! Great stay!!!  Thank you Casey!!!

Very conveniently located flat with lots of restaurants, supermarkets and subway stations around. Rob made the process very easy and was always ready to answer our questions.  The room, the living room and the bathroom were in very good condition. Would rent it again!!!

Everything was great and as described. Rob lives there but you have full privacy. The bathroom is across the living room and just for you. The bed was my favourite thing, super comfy after a long day. You have 3 subway stations just a couple of blocks away. I didn’t use them, but if needed there’s space on the fridge for you. The communication was very quick and efficient, definitely I would come back.
Casey's place and the check in/out prcoesses was exactly as I expected it to be, which made me trip stress-free.

I cannot recommend the Box House highly enough to one and all. I stayed with my two sons aged 9 and 6 for three nights, the room, effectively a well appointed apartment accommodated us easily. All pictures posted by the Box house are 100% accurate and the staff impeccably mannered and completely helpful. The Hotel was full, external to the Duplex noise was never an issue. Free transfers to the local subway are seamlessly arranged for those who would rather not walk the 10/15 minutes to Vernon Boulevard Jackson Avenue on the 7, with spectacular views of Manhattan on the way we generally walked.  Greenpoint is full of character with an eclectic and diverse charm, gives a real feel of the city more akin to Manhattan before it was in the main sanitised. That is not to say any of the neighbouring Streets or Avenues felt either intimidating or unsafe just real and earthy, a stroll down the length of Manhattan Avenue shouldn't be missed. Take advantage of the fact that local restaurants will deliver if your planning an evening in or wander over the Pulaski Bridge to the restaurants around Vernon Boulevard if not wanting a trip into Manhattan.  All in all a hidden gem, perfect for families, couples or singles alike. My sons continue to rave about the Box House as much as I do. Don't pass it by, I almost did, so used had I become on zeroing in on Manhattan as the only Hotel accommodation, relieved I didn't. Already planning to return. A boutique Hotel not to be missed with staff who absolutely understand what service means.

A perfect place to explore from. Just a couple of minutes from the subway (which run 'til late) and you can get to everywhere you need to.  A safe area, we were coming in and out at all hours of the day and even in the early hours never felt unsafe. The apartment itself is exactly as you see in the pictures, quirky and aged (in a good way), you feel like you're living the local lifestyle. Casey's communication was exceptional, we had quick and detailed responses whenever we needed anything. A great place to stay!

The Box House Hotel's driver (Josh) & one of its night attendants (I don't recall his name, but he is a tall, African-American man who works the night shift) went above & beyond for us. I have Stage 4 Cancer, & my daughter is a multi-organ transplant patient. The latter gentleman, whom I mentioned works the night shift, helped me when I had car trouble, came to our room at 4am to assemble the sofa bed for me (because I was having a difficult time getting comfortable, due, in part, to the aggressive dose of chemotherapy that I received earlier in the week), & he returned again at 4:30am to teach me how to adjust the thermostat, after I called the front desk in distress because I was suffering from chills & fever....   Dana, your staff is phenomenal! Each & every one of them. During our stay, my daughter became gravely ill, & members of your staff helped me to extend our stay for another night.  Moreover, on the day of our departure, my daughter was still gravely ill & hospital bound, & thus, the attendants at the front desk facilitated a late check-out for us, & hotel employees even volunteered to load our luggage into our car....   I am a retired physician, & I have spent the vast majority of my life working with other doctors, nurses, nurses' aides, & members of the hospital staff to bring comfort to the lives of our patients. Due to my decades of experience working as a physician (as well as my months of experience, fighting for my life on a daily basis as a cancer patient), I feel particularly qualified to speak on the topics of kindness, compassion, helpfulness & sacrifice. And I can say, without reservation, that I have never seen such a compassionate team of employees (in a for-profit/non-healh-related setting) as those that I came across at the Box House Hotel. Each & every employee that I came across was kind, eager to help, & compassionate "by nature." It wasn't something that seemed forced; it was just the way that these folks were naturally built. It's so rare for so many employees in one establishment to exude such magnanimous qualities; it's even rarer for these employees to exude such caring qualities while living & working in the busiest, most hectic & most stressful city in the world.   Kudos to you, Dana! You've put together the most incredible & rarest of staffs! My daughter & I cannot thank you & the staff at the Box House Hotel enough. You have our gratitude & our highest recommendation!

We were upset to see that the flat was not properly cleaned: there was hair on the floor in the living room and bathroom, the bath-tub looked dirty & old, bedsheets/ 1 pillow-case had some dirty old spots as well, 1 out of 2 towels given to us looked very used and unpleasant (even being washed). One side of the mattress was probably in worser condition then the other one, coz my friend was slipping down from the bed, so we had to change sides, as I am lighter & smaller in size. For me it felt better, but still we had to sleep closer to the middle of the bed, coz the mattress definitely needs to be changed. Upon our complaints, Katherine advised us to relax & enjoy the city, which we for sure did, but still would prefer to live in a better & cleaner flat. But later Katherine was kind enough to send us new towels & offered to check for spare bedsheets in the drawer - that we did, but still found dirty old spots & hair on them & decided not to use.  Overall our impression of the flat is way below average, mostly because of the flat not being ready to be lived in. So if you care about staying in a clean & tidy place I would not recommend you this one.

What a great place!  There were 9 of us and we all slept very comfortably!   A few  things I was annoyed about: -the tv's didn't work (the one on the main floor had 3 channels) and I specifically asked about that when I came as I had one guest who HAD to sleep with a tv on.  I was pretty pissed about this one. -I felt like the door code was so generic that they used it for everyone, which scared me a bit. -the towels were all over and I don't even know if we had enough...but we made due  The location was perfect.  The space was big.  Overall a great experience.

Claire's Carriage House Apartment fit our needs perfectly!!! It was so comfortable, spacious and tastefully decorated. The Queen bed in the one bedroom was so comfortable and the linens outstanding! I slept like a small child every night. The pull out couch was perfect for our daughter. We were there during one of the hottest weeks in the summer and the room air conditioners in the dining room and the bedroom kept us nice and cool when we were in the apartment. The bathroom was spotless and so cute and the shower wonderful.   Location! Location! Location! Beautiful brownstones on a tree lined streets within walking distance to the subway and a grocery store in an excellent area of Brooklyn. We walked everywhere and arrived back late at night and never felt unsafe.  We were so comfortable and would definately stay here again! Five stars Claire!!!

This rental was exactly as described. It was spacious, updated, comfortable, and convenient. I stayed here with a group of 8 others celebrating for a bachelorette. We could not have been more pleased with our experience. It was so great to have a common room to hang out in, but to also have enough comfortable beds for everyone (of course, we bunked up together!). The kitchen was perfect to store snacks and beverages, and had a great selection of plates and cutlery. In addition the location of this home was super convenient. It was close to Penn Station, as well as the subway and bus line. It is great when you can go out an enjoy your day and know you are coming back to a welcoming and warm environment. It takes the stress out of a busy trip! This home was perfect for us. Also, Jason was an excellent host-kind and responsive!

Joanna is an amazing host, you will be lucky to find someone as kind and welcoming to stay in her house. THis place is amazing : it was beautiful and very creatively decorated with lot of amazing art and furniture.   I can say with honest certainty that this is the best Airbnb I have ever stayed in, and here is why:  -liked i said before Joanna is a fantastic host! She doesn't do the bare minimum, she goes above and beyond to ensure that you have an amazing stay in her house . This house is in an incredible location! , a block away from several key metro stations, and near some fantastic restaurants and grocery stores, you could not ask for a more affordable place in such an amazing neighborhood!  The house itself is amazing!   it is an amazing aesthetic that you never want to leave! all the room are super clean and comfortable, so by the end of your stay, you'll want to just steal this house from her! .  thank you joanna !!!!i hope to come back !!!!

Claire was a gracious host! The place was exactly what we needed for our 2 night stay. A friend and I attended a show @ BAM and we were quite pleased with the proximity to it as well  as the Brooklyn bridge etc. If you're not afraid to walk - it's easy to also take the Manhattan bridge into downtown Manhattan, coming off near Chinatown. Parking was not too difficult - we didn't find the garage Claire mentioned, but we did find street parking and didn't have a problem. Great restaurant on the corner -Aita. Lots to do and see - many restaurants on Fulton - closeby. Recommend staying here - we'd stay again.

A lovely apartment in a leafy, quiet part of Brooklyn. It is on the first floor so feels very safe, and has a good sized open-plan living area. The bedroom is at the back of the apartment so is really quiet, and has both air con and a fan, which helped for our summertime stay. The kitchen and bathroom are quite basic, but very clean and functional. There is a sofa bed but it very quite soft like most sofa beds so we did not use it.  Clinton Hill is a lovely part of Brooklyn, with fantastic bars and restaurants nearby. Our favourites were Aita, Hops Hill, Sisters and Mayflower. There are two subway stops only 5mins away so good location, transport-wise.  Claire was a fantastic host, responding to emails efficiently, leaving us a platter on our first night when we arrived late and allowing us to leave our luggage on the landing when we had a late flight. Thank you for making our stay in Brooklyn so stress-free.

Myself and my mother spent 4 nights at the Carriage House In October / November of this year, meeting 'halfway' between Ireland and Vancouver ( where I am living).  We had an absolutely lovely time. There were a lot of special touches in the apartment, and the size was perfect for the two of us. We did a lot of self catering, and cooking facilities were great! There are lots of shops and restaurants extremely close by, and the subway is less than a 5 minute walk. While the C train was a very easy 30 mins or so Downtown, we found it extremely stressful trying to get back after 10pm. I believe they are doing work on the tracks, so a lot of the time the trains are running express, and by pass the Clinton Washington stop by 3 stops. Also the C train does not run at all after 11pm. The subway also decides mid journey that it will not be making local stops and runs express. Very confusing. This was definitely a low point for us, however it is most likely temporary.

Camille was very responsive and helpful in the weeks prior to my stay. She kept me up to date on everything on her end. Her husband, Daniel, greeted us when we arrived and he was cleaning the place. The apartment matched the pictures and the description, it looks much bigger in person! And we were pleasantly surprised to find that we would have the place to ourselves. The neighborhood is very nice and quaint. Quiet at night. We were a very short walk to the subway station, so we didn't feel unsafe coming back late at night. They provided us with everything we needed and graciously allowed us to use their netflix account. My girlfriends and I loved staying here and would love to come back again the next time we are in New York!

We had a wonderful stay at Camille´s appartement.  It is very spacious and looks exactly like the pictures. There are 2 bedrooms with double beds, a living room, kitchen and bathroom, all of them nice and clean! We stayed there with 2 adults und 3 teenagers and had plenty of room. One of the kids slept on a double air matress in the living room, which was also very comfortable -and right in front of the TV with netflix ;-) The kitchen is well equipped and there was everything there for making coffee upon our arrival. The bathroom was nice and clean as well and there was enough hot water for 5 people to shower (which is a problem sometimes, mostly in europe though). There is also free Wifi in the appartement. It worked perfectly all the time we were at "home" . Even though we arrived late and our flight was delayed, David was there to welcome us and to show and explain everything in the appartement. Communication via Airbnb messages was easy and we always got fast replies.  The neighbourhood is a safe, quiet residential area with mostly single family homes around and Brooklyn College across the street. The closest subway station(Q) is 2 min to walk and takes you to Manhattan in about 25 min and to Coney Island in about 15 min. We usually returned very late from Manhattan (past midnight) and never felt unsafe. There are also 2 Delis and a pizza place right next to the station.  We would definitely stay in this appartement again!! Thank you Camille and David :-)

Great place to stay in Brooklyn, quiet area, spacious apartment, clean, view over beautiful back garden with birds. Nearby gourmet supermarket and drug store. Claire is always available and keen to please.

BIG,BIG,BIG LIER!!!!! It was a family dinner, so everything was quiet and peaceful. No one got drunk, as the host says, he's a liar. I did not clean up the dishes, because I paid for the cleaning separately, and now it is required to pay extra for it. About a neighbor from the bottom, I suggested that he go out together or take photographs, he refused, and now lies that he can not get to her house. Originally the apartment was in terrible condition, and the owner was late twice for 20 minutes, the second time for 2 hours!The kitchen is not fully equipped for cooking, the stove does not work, the grill is so dirty that it was scary to use it! There are a lot of spoiled foods that he does not throw out, and you can confuse with your own. Bathroom with just one towel. The apartment is not fully equipped for renting.

Apartment is spacious and location really great, very silent. But it is clearly an apartment that is only rented out and it felt a bit homeless and clean. I like the Airbnb’s where there is a family five, decorated with small personal  things. So nothing wrong with it and for some people maybe better, just not our style.

The best location! Literally a short walk to the F train. I can't stress enough how location matters. It's in a safe area with lots of small grocery stores and lovely coffee shops nearby. Dikla and her husband were very kind and helpful *(I had a issue with figuring out how to find the wifi and use the TV remote). They were patient with us and lovely to deal with. The unit has 2 bedrooms and the beds are comfy. The unit is roomy has great heat and AC. My only suggestion would be new bed linens. This is a good place to stay if you're exploring and want easy access to the subway system.

We stayed for 8 days. at the home of George's Harlem;  The area may appear alarming and dangerous, but George reassured us on  We arrived in the evening at about 11:30, and despite the late hour on a business day, George has proved to be immediately available, also helping to bring the bags in the house;  George is a very helpful and friendly, and in 4 of our days spent at his home, he was out with his wife, so we had the whole house at our disposal, as also indicated by him.   In the room we found two large towels and a bowl with chocolates.  The room as well as the house was, however, presented very bad: there were the shoes at the entrance and from the start there has been a situation of lack of cleanliness;  We also found, in the room, the presence of a cockroach live or something like that. The dust was everywhere;  The bed is very low and appeared immediately, as well as from George I note, in bad condition or even broken one hand already on the second day.  The bathroom was in the same condition of the house, or dirt everywhere and in a poor state of maintenance.  The photographs included on Air BnB room does not reflect the current state of the same.  The kitchen had almost impassable right now, because of the presence of dirty pots and pans too.

Sabrina is a curious host.  First she is not available during the day because she needs to sleep as she is working by night, so somebody else is dealing with you on arrival & departure, ans is missioned to spy you anytime. Sabrina required a photocopy of my ID card, As explanation, she made reference to drug, narcotic, and told me that she did not want this kind of substance in her flat !!! I felt really insulted. Several times a week, Sabrina used to come in the flat with no notice, and surely she did come also when I was not there. Also she was calling me and harassing with text messages, late in the night, requiring my presence at a specific time in the flat for her visit. In fact she wanted to check if I had taken or moved her nude photos hanging on the walls otherwise she was threatening to keep money from the security deposit.  As Sabrina seems to be a very tortuous person, I took pictures to prove that I left the flat clean and tidy. Some Other things: The window was not close ng properly and ther was flood inside when raining, damaging my things nearby, the aircondionner is placed right to the bed makes unbearable noise, the kitchen has been fitted in a corridor making no access to the oven, there was no microwave and no toaster making it very difficult for breakfast or for lunch.

The place is very comfortable and complies with everything published. Considering that it was the first time that I used the services of the page, I had a pleasant impression of the place and the quality of the facilities. Although I read some comments that the neighborhood was not visually pretty, we liked it, it has a wide variety of businesses, which makes buying food easier. It seemed like a safe neighborhood, we walked at different times and at no time did we have any feeling of danger. I recommend them 100%.
Near from subway station, but we were a bit scared for walking the street in night time cuz that area is too quiet.

Andrew & Becky's place is FANTASTIC!  Looks just like the pictures, no unpleasant surprises, just a beautiful apartment in a perfect location.  The subway to Manhattan is 2 blocks away, the Brooklyn Museum & Botanic Gardens is 4 blocks away.  Lots of little shops nearby.  The bed was really comfortable and the apartment had everything we needed.  And Andrew & Becky were incredible hosts - responsive to any question we had.  Left coffee and OJ and a bottle of prosecco for my husband's birthday!  Super nice and friendly.  I would highly recommend staying in their place.  It was really perfect for us.

We are extremely disappointed with our stay at Prospect Heights Beauty 1BR w / yrd. When we got to the address, after 10 hours of flying, from Rio de Janeiro, we were scared and then angry. The whole building was in the works – a huge reform – with the exception of the apartment that we had rented. Although we had exchanged several messages with Becky (and her husband, Andrew), in the weeks prior to our departure, in no time they informed us about the conditions of the residence. The couple lied deliberately. We could not have a worse opinion than we have now on both. So, we had to face, in our first season in Brooklyn, noise, dust, discomfort and activity of workers who only ceased on Sunday. We have photographs documenting the deplorable state of the building, the yard, and what would be the front garden of the building, covered with dozens and dozens of bags of debris. Airbnb owes us an explanation about this situation. It is unacceptable that the company is not aware of the state in which the residences are offered through its website.  Maria Aparecida Rezende Mota Samuel Jurkiewicz

Cons: There was so much noise at night due to the club downstairs, we had terrible sleep each day except thanksgiving. we found two species of cockroaches inside the apartment. The apartment complex smelled terrible. The flyer about a lady getting robbed inside the entrance didnt make us feel very safe. The oven was gas and the knobs were broken so the gas was on while it was positioned as "off", very dangerous. Hard bed. Broken tiles and not well kept in general. Pros: Great location, well priced, great communication.

Our whole 5days stay at noelva's place is amazing! No stress! And truly a place u can consider a getaway from busy city! The place is so nice, color coordinated that is pleasing to the eyes! And a beautiful scenic view in the room's window u can see noelva's beautiful flowers! The garden is nice infront of the beach where u can unwind! Noelva's and her family is very accomodating and very attentive to all our needs! All the facilities at home were in great service it works well! The wifi, the cable etc. and the place and the neighborhood is quiet and peaceful! There many resto in the areas! If u are traveling public vehicle its very accessible! And overall i just sooooo love the place and if ever im going back to NY  i would definitely book this place again and i highly recommend it! U will never regret having this place as long as u be nice and follow the house rules you are good! If i rate it Out of 1-10,and 10 as the highest i would rate it as 10 up!

We've just got back from a week in New York at Joan and Fred's appartment and the experience was amazing. The apartment is exactly as on the pictures, conveniently located within 5-10 minutes walking distance from the metro lines (Q and F) which brings you within half an hour to Manhattan. There is the Prospect park next door for running (we were in NYC mainly for the marathon), several convenience and drug stores and the hosts are just great, including filling up your fridge with breakfast material. Strongly recommend and would come back anytime.

We didn't see Joan but were warmly welcomed by Fred. Everything is new and very neat in this apartment. And Fred is very precise in his presentation, really great. The TV is very beautiful, the WiFi very efficient.  For two it's perfect. The third person sleeps on a sofa bed in the main room and there is the fridge which is quite noisy. Nothing daunting that said.  Fred and Joan can be reached by a telephone in the apartment and Fred has always been available when we have needed to contact him. The metro is 10 minutes away via a very commercial and very popular predominantly Indian street (Church Str) (when we returned in the evening around 10 p.m., all the Indians were in the street, and the Indian clothing shops were still open, it was a bit like Little India, not unpleasant). That said, all communities are represented in this district and greengrocers stores are open all night. You can also go via Albermarle Road, a very pretty residential street. No security problems identified in this neighborhood even if seen with our French eyes the businesses are not very attractive. And Prospect Park is within walking distance. The little time we spent there enchanted us. We who were there to visit Manhattan really appreciated the calmer and more welcoming atmosphere of Brooklyn. I therefore highly recommend this apartment and if I were to return to New York, I would not hesitate to return there. Thanks to Lot, Fred.

Stewart, Gregory's son, welcomed us to the apartment and graciously showed us around, gave us instructions for the air conditioners, and a number to contact him if necessary, as well as the location for the nearest market. Furthermore, they were very accommodating with our arrival and departure times- stress free!

Fred met us when we arrived, helped us with our bags and gave us a brief tour of the apartment providing information on useful details including security issues, Wi-Fi password and more. He had also turned on the heat ahead of our arrival. It was cold outside for all of our stay but the apartment was always comfortable. Breakfast supplies were also provided, which was very useful, particularly on the first morning after our arrival. The listing was accurate thought I would stress it is a basement apartment with a relatively low ceiling. I am not tall but my hands would hit the ceiling in the bedroom most times I was putting on my jacket or coat.  The neighbourhood was safe and for us it was very convenient as it was 10 to 15 minute walk to two subway stations and a 3 minute walk from my wife's mother home.  This was our first Airbnb rental and it was a positive experience.

We had a great 10 days. We had a very late flight and Larry waited for us very kindly with drinks and fruit. Perfect welcome.  His apartment is ideally located near a subway entrance which provides excellent access to important areas of Manhattan. His apartment has every possible comfort. We had an excellent stay. For sure we will come back to Larry's if we pass through New York.

I was in NYC for a week to explore the city so I was looking for a hassle-free place to lay my head after long days pounding the city streets.  Jeremy and Kevin's place was perfect for me as it is calm, relaxing, friendly, safe, clean and stress-free. The bed is really comfy, they have everything you could need in the kitchen, and they have a good shower. I can't recommend staying here enough. :)  They both made me feel very welcome and were very clear about all the practical things (just as they are in the ad). Sophia their cat is also very nice! I liked the dynamic of the apartment - friendly but everyone gets on with their own things. I enjoyed Kevin's insights into NYC life and they both gave me some good tips of places to go in the area.  Getting into Manhattan it is super easy as the subway takes you straight there in no time at all. For exploring other parts of Brooklyn you are also well placed. What I liked about the area is that it is really diverse and not particularly gentrified. From here I could also easily visit interesting parts of Brooklyn such as Coney Island, Boro Park, and Cortelyou Road/Ditmas Park, as well as pretty Park Slope and the peaceful Prospect Park.  Thanks for a great NYC experience! :)

We were made very welcome by Larry Rushing. The apartment is pleasant, air-conditioned, very close to Central Park (less than 100m). When we arrived, Larry was waiting for us, had placed several bouquets of flowers in the apartment (in the living room, the kitchen and the bathroom. Larry was also kind enough to provide us with fruit (a well-filled bowl in the kitchen), coffee and water in the refrigerator. We particularly appreciated these attentions. The apartment is clean, decorated with paintings by the artist (Larry is a painter) and the bed is very comfortable (not insignificant for rest and well-being after a day of intensive walking and sightseeing). The apartment is very well served by transport, located a stone's throw from metro lines B and C and also line 1. I was able to go running several mornings in Central Park before starting the day's visit, it's really pleasant. Another positive point, on the last day, our flight was at 11 p.m. and Larry offered to leave our luggage at the apartment, to allow us to visit peacefully before joining JFK airport. An address to recommend, without hesitation.

I really enjoyed my stay with Jeremy and Kevin. I was visiting friends in Crown Heights, so this location was very convenient for me. Subway is super close, many food/drink/grocery store/drug store options in the surrounding blocks. Their apartment is very spacious (great high ceilings!), and the room had everything I needed plus some bonuses like a mini-fridge and tea kettle. And of course, Sophia is fun to have around! Thank you!

Jake was accommodating to our arrival/departure time and a pleasure to communicate with. Though he wasn't around during our stay, he made arrangements for us to pick up keys and checked in throughout our stay. His place is a steal for the area, with beautiful Prospect Park across the street and easy train access to the city. Thanks, Jake.

Everything went very well on our trip. The location is excellent for seeing the US Open and for exploring Manhattan; the bus stop is near and it takes you to the metro with which you can pretty much go anywhere you like. We also always felt safe in the neighbourhood, didn't see anything suspicious during the two weeks we stayed there. The nearby shopping center was good to have.  The apartment had everything we needed, the Mac Mini is a nice touch and very useful. Wifi was pretty good also. Whenever we needed to ask something Gonzalo or Nora were quick to answer our messages. We also got useful tips on how to get around and what to do in the city.  Thanks Gonzalo and Nora for making us feel welcome!

Autumn was very kind, but I can’t recommend her place to anyone.  The shower had black mold/hair in the drain and the bathroom hand soap was 95% water.  There are smokers in the house, and although they have a of couple “air cleaners” running, it still smells like smoke.  Worst of all: Our bedroom door didn’t have a lock on it, so the other Airbnb guests that roam the house could have easily gotten into our stuff.  Nothing got stolen, it’s just a bad set up.  The neighborhood seems very safe during the day… and questionable at night.

Good evening everyone ! What to say about our stay, Reception non-existent, apart from cockroaches in the bathroom which wander around (photos to support on request) Our host Gonzalo came in the evening at 8:00 p.m. and became aggressive upon seeing our two young children whom we had not declared when booking. Saying that it was his place and that we lied, he charged us an additional €381 for two children in addition to costs. If you plan to see Nora you have to go to Chicago (she rents another apartment there) Are we talking franchise?  Don't be fooled by the photo (we saw another lady living with him) And yes we rent more easily with a female first name as a profile. Be warned that this is a subplex apartment. The bedroom has no window. The two kitchen windows are boarded up (not present in the description). We are very close to La Guardia airport, it is not the noise of the planes that bothers us but the sound of footsteps on a creaking floor. And yes!! our host lives upstairs and seems not to sleep at night, waking us up almost every night around 2am. For an entrepreneur, the apartment needs a serious refresh, the ventilation of the bathroom is scary

Autumn is a very friendly host, and the room was fine if you don't plan to stay a lot in the room and cleaning isn't a big issue for you. The area has lots of cosy restaurants near by. The street seems a little creepy in the night but we actually didn't feel unsafe. All in all it was nothing special but fine for the price.

Autumn was very quick to respond Even as I booked hours before arriving and everything went very smoothly with my 4 day stay but you have to know what you are getting here before you decide to book.   You are getting a great deal for NYC (!)  but it comes with some caveats. Luckily they didn’t bother me at all but just to know before booking. The neighborhood is cool and good amenities but a bit far from the subway lines so Lyft is a good idea especially late at night. Also, the ceiling is paper thin so you hear loud footsteps all the time. There is an air purifier outside the room which was good at making white noise but if you are a light sleeper, this wouldn’t work for you. I had no problem luckily.  Also, as far as I can tell, there were a few rooms Airbnb’d as inside the apartment as well as Autumn and her boyfriend living downstairs but the bedroom doors didn’t lock from the outside. I didn’t feel unsafe and had no issues but just something to know ahead of time.  Also, Autumn and her boyfriend cook a lot and the kitchen is right next to this room so there is a lot of cooking smells in the apartment. All it did was make me hungry but if you don’t like the smell of Indian food, then again this might not be for you.   I would definitely stay again since it is a great deal and I wasn’t  in the room very often.

Very good stay.  The house is very clean and quiet. We stayed for 10 days and the EDO room was a bit small for long stays. The house has more rooms. The metro stop is about 13-15 minutes walk away and the neighborhood is not dangerous

IN BRIEF: Simo´s apartment is nice and comfortable and corresponds to the pictures of his ad, with a good location next to a subway station with many markets nearby. Unfortunately the host did not appear to have devoted the necessary time and care to properly prepare the apartment for guests, and we definitely encourage him to address this point at his next rental (not all guests are patient and understanding as we have been during this stay). IN DETAIL: The bedding and towels provided were clean, but not the apartment as a whole so we had to clean it ourselves. Upon our arrival we were overcome by a strong and unpleasant odor we later discovered to be 3 plug-in air fresheners that overwhelmed the small apartment with poor air circulation. Bathroom: only sink and toilet had been cleaned. The shower had a dirty washcloth and a used towel hanging from it. The tub appeared to have been rinsed out instead of thoroughly washed. A funky odor was due to mildew in the tiles and around the toilet base, dirty floor mats. There was no place for our toiletries as every available surface was taken by the host’s personal items, including the couple of hooks behind the door where his used bathrobe hung. Living Area: All 3 tables in this room were covered in dust. Bedroom: the bed side tables and frame were dust covered. The curtains smelled of smoke. The desk was unusable and crammed with items. No space was made in any of the three closets in the apartment for us to hang our clothes and there were no coat hooks anywhere in the apartment. Kitchen: a tiny galley with limited counter space. The toaster oven was so full of grime and grease that we were not able to use it from a hygienic/fire hazard perspective. All the cabinets were filled to capacity with no space for our groceries. The cleaning instruments were inadequate; kitchen sponge smelly and falling apart; a broom with no dust pan, a sponge mop with a completely worn out head, a Swiffer type mop without accompanying cloths and therefore useless for mopping, a carpet broom missing 1/2 of its handle. Amenities: only after having made the reservation we were informed that contrary to what advertised there was no cable TV; but we were told there was “a DVD player with a lot of great movies”. However the DVD player had been left disconnected to the TV, taking some 3 hours of our hard work through the clutter of cables to fix the problem. It then turned out that the TV too was defective..., showing a variety of vertical stripes in the screen, turning the vision of those great movies into a torture... Indeed we gave up and decided to forget about watching TV for the 5 days of our stay! Communications with the host: weren’t always easy, and he in some occasions he did not appear to display an abundance of courtesy (sometimes overreacting).

Apartment is large and convenient. The house location is in a safe area. The subways and buses are in front of the apartment. All house equipment work. Apartment photos reflect reality. Simo is very helpful and tolerant. All our questions were answered. He made efforts to help us. Even our homeless friends opened their homes. However, I always recommend that you take your own towels and sheets. Thank you Simo for everything. // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Kaldığımız ev geniş ve kullanışlıydı. Bizim için en önemli olan şey güvenli bir alanda olmasıydıki bulunduğu lokasyon güvenli bir alandır. Haritada uzak görünen metro istasyonu yan binanın önündedir. Tüm ev aletleri çalışmaktadır. (Saç kurutma makinesi yoktur) Simo, son derece kibar ve yardımcı bir kişidir. İlk gün rezervasyonda sorun yaşayan arkadaşlarımıza evini açmış ve beraber kalmamız konusunda hiç sorun çıkarmadan yardımcı olmuştur. Hem ulaşım hem ev konusunda rahatlıkla telefonlaştığımız ve bize destek veren biridir.  Tüm bunlarla birlikte halihazırda kullanılan bir eve gittiğinizi unutmadan elbetteki kişisel temizlik rünleriniz ve havlu, nevresim gibi ürünleri taşımayı ihmal etmeyin. Biz götürdük, sonra orada bırakarak evden ayrıldık. Simo, herşey için sana teşekkür ederim.

This was our first trip to NY and our first Airbnb experience. We stayed in the accommodation from November 6 to 8, 2014. Let's start with the positive comments. Well located. Security sector. Restaurants and services nearby. More on 30th Avenue than on Broadway. Easy communications with Yiota by email and his cousin by text and cell, as our host was not available. My partner had forgotten her purse in a drawer. When we returned, the housekeeper had put it on the table and handed it to us. We emphasize his honesty. Constructive comments and thoughts for Yiota and those planning a trip to NY. The noise: Although it was indicated in some comments that the train passed nearby, well, as soon as we arrived around 10 p.m., the floor shook as the metro passed. At 5:20 a.m. on Friday morning, and every 5 minutes thereafter, the bed shook and an unpleasant noise woke us up. So, if you want to sleep, this is definitely not the ideal place. The comfort of the bed makes up for it!!! Cleanliness: Although generally clean, the accommodation needs some renovations. The sheets are stained with oil or other greasy substances in several places. Several rings and mold on the bathroom floor and in the shower. Cold air enters significantly both through the windows and through the bathroom door giving access to the backyard. We can even see outside when it's dark in the bathroom. When we arrived late at night, the accommodation was freezing. The water heating was not on. We used auxiliary heating but it took a while before we regained comfort... The accommodation is located in the basement, you access it by an internal staircase, the common places to get to the accommodation leave something to be desired with goods stored everywhere. Location: To the rental costs, you must add cleaning costs and Airbnb fees. Do your calculations carefully in relation to hotel room or other in Manhattan. You have to count the metro tickets or the taxi. On Friday evening, leaving Times Square, taking the metro and walking to the accommodation, it took us about 1 hour. Parking: We arrived by car. Yiota had told us that we would not have any difficulty finding... Thursday evening, quite easy but on Friday morning, we had to change sides and that was difficult. We finally found a space in a public parking lot but got a ticket because we didn't renew the parking meter in time...! $35. In short, we were disappointed with our stay in the accommodation compared to the amount paid and what we were able to benefit from. The main factor being noise, the second being cleanliness. We cannot recommend it....

We had a good experience in NYC and the apartment was reliably close to subways to get us into the city.  Living in the city definitely provided more of an authentic experience than a hotel would have. There are perfect bagel shops, drug stores, banks, and an organic market within a block or two which was extremely convenient. We did feel uncomfortable some later evenings walking from the subway to the apartment, however there were only two of us girls as well.

My experience with Keturah and her home were amazing. She was quick to respond, friendly and totally welcoming. The space is wonderful, close to subway lines and takes so much of the stress away from travelling around the city. I'd totally recommend staying with Keturah on your next trip to Brooklyn!

Keturah's place is a gem in Brooklyn. The room itself is large, clean and fitted with air-conditioning, which provides for a great  reprieve from the unrelenting heat and humidity of summer in NY.   The shared bathroom is beautiful and always clean. The house is huge, but we rarely ever used any other common spaces besides the kitchen for meals; there was no need to since the room was already comfortable.   5 min walk to Prospect Park (and by extension Prospect Park Subway, which takes you to Lower Manhattan in less than 20 mins and Midtown in under 30). The neighbourhood was quiet, family orientated, and we never felt terribly unsafe walking around even at night.    Keturah was helpful and always jovial, which was very welcoming. The 3 dogs were adorable, and we truly enjoyed the pleasure of their company. ;)
This place was perfect! Perfect room for a solo traveler. Christina makes everything super easy and stress free!

correct description, spacious apartment, very good bedding, good welcome from our host who was present upon our arrival, available while being discreet throughout the stay. bonus: we were able to use the apartment beyond the scheduled departure time. perfect neighborhood, well located, no insecurity felt, proximity to the metro, shops and restaurants

The house is great, it had everything we needed. A very good location in Brooklyn, very well communicated with Manhattan through several subway lines, with some restaurants and bars around, and far from the stress of the city center. Bernard is an excellent host. He is friendly, and at the same time he gave us all the privacy we needed.  We had an excellent week in NYC hosted at Bernard´s house.

I had the pleasure of staying at Elisa's place for one month. If I could summarize my experience in one word, it would be appropriate to use the word PHENOMENAL. Right from the start, she made me feel very welcome. She's a cheerful, kind and respectful person. Her place is exactly how she describes it and provides you with everything you need to know about getting around the city. 103rd Street train station is a 2 minute walk away. The neighborhood is called the Spanish Harlem; it may look sketchy to you at first but in fact, everyone really minds their own business and I haven't had a problem not even once, even during late late parts of the night. There's a bunch of good restaurants around and a supermarket that has pretty much everything with modest prices. Elisa also has the most adorable cat called Milo. He's so friendly and lovable. I'd most definitely recommend staying at Elisa's place. Be respectful and kind and she'll be the best host you could ever ask for. Thank you so much Elisa! Looking forward to staying with you again!

We had a nice stay at Ayana's. The apt is conveniently located, close to the 1 and A-C lines, as well as LIRR. Manhattan is only 30min away.  Apt itself is big. 4 growns ups can comfortably stay. Kitchen is big enough to have breakfast/ lunch / dinner. If people are staying in the living room, you are still very comfortable for meal times in the kitchen.  Several grocery stores options, from low to organic quality. Just pick your favorite!  Laundromat (self and drop) are right around the corner. Again  many options so just pick the one you like the most.  We did not feel unsafe in the neighborhood though I would not suggest walking all by oneself past midnight. Use common sense.

Ayana’s apartment is truly beautiful on the inside, well-decorated, and has lots of character. It’s about an 11 minute walk to the subway, and surrounded by restaurants, coffee shops, and supermarkets. It’s not the cleanest or nicest neighborhood, but that’s kind of what you sign up for with NYC. We never felt unsafe walking around the area, and were happy with the proximity to lots of stuff.  In particular, we had an amazing bagel at Lula Bagel, and really enjoyed the food/coffee at Barista & The Baker.   As a host, Ayana was extremely responsive and helpful! We had a Wi-Fi issue on the first day and she worked hard to get it fixed as soon as possible! As for the apartment itself, the kitchen is well stocked, but not as clean as one would hope. The rest of the apartment was tidy, and the bed was sufficiently comfortable. The street is quite noisy, we were woken up a lot of times in the early morning, but that’s to be expected in a city that never sleeps. All in all, it was a good stay. Thank you, Ayana!

This is a basement apt with windows and door to the backyard garden. So not too bad. However , this is a very basic apartment.   Good stuff: very prompt response from the landlord, good community for food and shopping, very convenient to subway.   Bad stuff: pictures are far more nicer than the actual. As commented by other guests, the shower in the restroom is so unpleasant: water power is small with the small spray. Sound and noise from upstairs and trains are loud, especially at night. There is a TV in the room, but no cable and channels are available. The way to get the keys and return the keys in the lock is quite complicated. The cleaning is not complete: some stuff from previous guests are still kept in the fridge. The stuff provided for the shower stuff is so limited and incomplete. You better prepare your own stuff for shampoo and shower. Of course you can buy from nearby shops. Not convenient for night flight catcher as you will get a strict check out time at noon with no option to store your luggage.   In all, this is a basic and simple apartment, however in a community of convenience. If you just want to a bed and access to such conveniences, this is a good option. However, I still think the scope for improvement exists given the price charged.

Great neighborhood and extremely convenient to the subway and Manhattan. Bed was really comfortable. You get a buzz from the subway, but we got used it after awhile. Yiota's cousin Marilena kept in contact with us promptly with texts. We did have to grab some shampoo and soap from the drug store since none was provided. I did have an issue with the toilet in that the it was elevated above the floor (I'm assuming to fit in the plumbing), and it was weird to have to climb up on it and have your feet dangling off the ground (Mind you, I'm really short). Otherwise, our 5 day stay was good.

Awesome! Had such a wonderful time at Julie's space from the very beginning to thread of my trip. Amazing location,wonderful host,crazy cool cat! You have to see it with your own eyes! Living in an artist's loft in the middle of Williamsburg - unbeatable! Julie was so nice and helpful and we had more than one laugh attacks. I can't wait to come back to this place asap!

Overall a good experience and good deal for the location and convenience, checking in and out was very easy and stress free and the owner was quick to respond to communication. My only complaint is that the shower did not get hotter than lukewarm.

This place is great! Super easy to find, Yiota is super communicative and the check-in with a coded access makes it so nice and stress free.   Astoria is a superb area! Cool places to eat and drink and such a great to choice to be close to Manhattan without crazy prices.   Yiota’s studio is ideal. Really clean and comfortable. It has everything you need to be super comfortable and get ready to explore the City. Bed is comfy too!

The apartment is well located! Very close to the L train and only minutes from Manhattan.The cleaning lady (I'm embarrassed that I have forgotten her name) was SO sweet and helpful with tips on how to enjoy the city with a child. We did not meet Thomas but he has this down to a science.. we were never unclear of our itinerary and everything is as described. The sleeping lofts were cool but please keep in mind that they are better suited for kids or adults that are not afraid of heights! The apartment had great industrial feel views. The neighbors were nice. The building was clean and secure. Williamsburg is fun, hip and family friendly! We had our 9 year old with us and never felt unsafe walking in the streets late at night. Do yourself a favor and eat pizza from Carmines. I have taken a vow not to eat pizza again until I return to Brooklyn! My boys really enjoyed the Bagel Store too.. don't forget to check in on Yelp for a free bagel. The market on the corner came in handy more than once but was cash only. Strange concept for this native Californian, but I got used to it.  All in all, our experience at Thomas's apartment was a great one and we would definitely return.

We had absolutely no problem with Thomas' appartment! Very functional accommodation. (Beware if you're scared of heights, every bed is high unless the couch)  The quarter is very lovely. The L subway is at 4 mn walking what lead you to Manhattan inner city in less than 20 mn.  And finally the rooftop is amazing !!  Thank you Thomas.

This loft is really amazing. It is a beautiful and very cool designed loft. Very nice interior features. It feels warm and welcoming! Both beds (comfortable) are high up, so don't be afraid of heights :) The couch was ok to sleep in for 2 persons. The area is nice, quiet and felt very safe. Very pleasant to stroll around among great bars and restaurants.The subway station Graham (L line) is just minutes away and stops at for example Union Square / Manhattan. Bedford Avenue is two stops away (15 min to walk) and is really hip.  The private rooftop is neat and cool (exit via roofwindow from a high ladder) and the shared loft is absolutely amazing!! Must be seen at sunset with a glass of wine :)  The only thing I can comment is that if you are allergic to dogs you should bring your allergy pills. I could feel it even though it was not a big issue for me.  We never met Thomas but in our contact,with him he was very friendly and quick to answer any questions. Everything worked perfectly!    I highly recommend this loft to anyone.

This place is great! It's in a nice neighborhood (close to transit, restaurants, bars and perfect for strolling) and the apartment has lots of amenities to make your stay comfortable. The loft beds were great (very comfortable, no danger of falling out due to small flooring areas surrounding both beds) and the rooftop is amazing! Thomas responded immediately to all my entries and we had a great time here.

Although we never saw Thomas, he was very responsive. We didn't know some of the lights were on dimmers, so I sent a message to Thomas at around 9pm asking why the bathroom lights were so dim! He messaged me back within 5 minutes.  There are two beds that you have to climb ladders to get to. We are a clumsy couple, so we opted to sleep on the couch pull out during our stay. It was still very comfy!  The shared roof deck is beautiful, as is Thomas's private roof deck. The views are gorgeous!  Parking was very convenient. We were able to get a spot right in front of the building. We didn't drive it during our stay, so it was nice to be able to see that it was okay each time we walked by.  Thomas has everything you'd need at his place. We needed a wine opener, he had one. Scissors? Had that, too.  My only complaint would be about the decorative tall wood board wrapped in silver fabric standing across from the platform eating area. It isn't secured to the wall and fell on my head! On our wedding day! Luckily, I only bled a little. But this could be very dangerous for small children and pets. Just make sure you slide it somewhere safe and you'll be okay.  Overall, I'd recommend Thomas's place to anyone!

Andrew was very responsive- when we had an access problem with a different Airbnb that we had reserved, I pinged Andrew if his space was available and he got back to me very quickly. We also had to an extend a night and he was very quick to help with that as well. We were in the middle of a move and his responsiveness was so appreciated during a stressful time.   The apartment itself was spacious, comfortable and in a terrific location if you want to check out the many fabulous restaurants, cafes and bakeries on the neighborhood. Also bring close to Prospect Park is key. Great base for exploring Brooklyn. Having some backyard space with a little on was also a big plus!

Nice place to stay outside of the city. There are lots of great places to eat in Astoria and it is located right next to the Steinway subway station! We used the subway to go EVERYWHERE. We got a 7-day unlimited pass (even though we weren’t here the full 7 days), but it was so stress-free hopping on and off the Subway to go explore! Also, google maps was surprisingly accurate for navigating which train is best based on your destination.   The Airbnb felt safe, was quiet, had a good HVAC system (important since it was high 30s outside when we visited!). Hosts were easy to communicate with. Easy check in/check out. Cheap Lyft ride to the LGA airport ~$15.

The home is so stylish and well equipped with everything. It was the first time to stay Airbnb. It definitely could be a memorable experience. My twins were relatively scary to sleop in the loft. Except for that everything was great, especially walking distance to Graham Ave station.

Thomas’s loft is just amazing. If you want the real Brooklyn experience in an authentic industrial loft, this place is for you. It is not a huge space but the use of the space is so well thought and the decoration is very tasteful.  The apartment looks even better in real compared to what you can see on Airbnb. There are 2 mezzanine bedrooms so if you are afraid of sleeping up a ladder under the ceiling, it might not be for you but we personally loved it as it is what makes the loft different! You can also sleep in the sofa bed if you can’t be bothered climbing up the ladder.  The rooftop is just AMAZING! the view over Manhattan is breathtaking and you can enjoy a glass of wine in the comfy chairs whilst enjoying the sunset over the Manhattan skyline...  Thomas is super responsive, which is great! So if you love Williamsburg and look for a real experience, just book Thomas’ loft!
Beautiful apartment, private rooftop difficult to access for people afraid of heights, but the building's shared rooftop is great.

Thomas's loft is STUNNING. High ceilings, beautiful sleeping loft, huge bathtub. Very clean and user friendly. The loft is a vertical climb, so if you are afraid of heights there is a pull out sofa bed sleeping option. Building is easy to navigate and has nice outdoor spaces including the roof and ground floor outdoor patio. Close to everything you'll ever need and located in fantastic neighborhood.

Thomas's place is in an amazing location. If you are looking to hang out and walk around Williamsburg this is a great spot. Thomas is also super accommodating and quick to respond. My only note is for anyone scared of heights, the lofted bed is quite high.

We were a group of 4, first time New York travelers, and Thomas’s place was perfect for us. It’s a super cool, clean, comfortable space that is a pretty easy train ride to Manhattan. I fully recommend it to anyone interested in having a stress free NYC trip!

Thomas place was extremely lovely ! Right in the middle of shops, market, restaurants, subways and etc.   Would recommend it to anyone wanting to visit NYC (Williamsburg, Brooklyn).  Subways are close enough to go to any boroughs.   The home has everything you can ask for. I love the dimming lights giving it a more romantic and cozy feel to the place.   Beds are super soft and comfy.  Shower pressures were amazing.   Note: If you are afraid of heights, you will have to do a little climbing to get to the two beds above, but there is a pull out bed option.

(English version below) Thomas' apartment was perfect. Corresponds in every way to the photos. Super clean and quiet, we didn't hear any noise, didn't hear the neighbors, didn't hear any noise coming from outside. The apartment is really complete, everything is there, we even have access to a practical iMac to plan our days. The atmosphere in the apartment is really cozy and comfortable. The only downside to keep in mind is access to the beds located approximately 7’ above the floor. Access is via ladders. For our part (2 adults with 2 teenagers) access was not a problem but it is clearly not for everyone. Forget access to the private roof, with the ladder and the roof hatch to open it is practically dangerous. On the other hand, the common roof accessible by the elevator is great. Located 5 minutes walk from Graham metro station on the L line. If like us you arrive by car street parking is possible, no permit required, but you have to search a little, be prepared to walk and watch out for parking bans twice a week. To disembark and take on luggage it is easy to be very close to the apartment by parking for a few minutes in front of private entrances. Big favorite, we recommend without hesitation.  Thomas' apartment was perfect. Correspond in all points to the photos. Very clean and quiet, we didn't hear any noise from the neighbors or the streets. The apartment is fully equipped, everything is there, we even have access to an iMac. The atmosphere in the apartment is really cozy and comfortable. The only drawback to keep in mind is the access to the beds located at approximately 7' above the floor. The access is done by ladders. On our side (2 adults with 2 teenagers) the access does not cause any problem but it is clearly not made for everyone. Forget the access to the private roof, with the ladder and the trap door to the roof to open, it is practically dangerous. On the other hand, the common rooftop accessible by the elevator is great. Located at 5 minutes walk to the Graham metro station on the L line. If like us you arrive by car, street parking is possible, no permit required, but you have to look around a bit, be prepared to walk, and watch out for parking bans twice a week. To unload and load your luggage it is easy to be very close to the apartment by parking for a few minutes in front of a private entrance. We recommend without hesitation.

I stayed a month and 10 days at Yiotas and it was honestly one of the best locations! Everything is in a walkikg distance and you really are in the heart of all life in Astoria. The room is as described, bed is comfortable, small area to work, a small fridge and a microwave. You cant do a full load of groceries or cook but its enough space to prepare a meal, breakfast etc. There is plenty of light during the day but trust me being in this location you probably wont stay in the room all day, at least i didnt. Astoria park is a 30mim walk away, steimway is just a 5mkn walk. Theres drawers under the bed for your clothes and a walk in closet to hang clothes and store your luggage. The place was clean and yiota communicated well throughout my stay. You might want to bring disposable plates as washing dishes in the sink may not be as convenient for some but again the space is pretty spacious, good light, privacy and in the middle of a very lively neighborhood where i never felt unsafe to walk back at night. Needless to say there are two subway stations within 5-10min walk, access to J,E,M, R and F to the city. Internet was fine as well, i have my own business and had to be in video calls quite often and no issues. Id stay again :)

Damon and Kent are the sweetest and nicest hosts we ever met on airbnb ! They are caring and able to answer every single question you could have.  They welcomed us so warmly we felt immediately at home ! They offered us their help whenever we needed it, and they were easy to communicate with. As for the apartment situated on the second floor of their house, it is truly the most convenient and cosy place we had of all of our trip. The situation is perfect, very easy to catch the subway within 2 minutes of walk. If you arrive from JFK you have a direct subway line to Utica Ave which is a real bonus. The neighborhood is quite beautiful, quiet, and we never felt unsafe, even when coming home late in the night (we are two women aged 25). If you love walking as we do, you can reach by feet many areas of Brooklyn worthy of seeing on a beautiful day. Listen to their advices regarding the restaurants and food is the best thing to do if you wanna eat in the neighborhood. Actually we found Brooklyn much more interesting than Manhattan, so I would recommend to stay in Brooklyn to anyone eager to have a typical New-Yorker experience. Brooklyn is full of nice and lively areas, good places to see and chill in with friends and incredible places to eat. BTW the pizzeria few streets away is soooo good you have to go there !! The apartment itself is well decorated, there is a very cosy lounge and the light coming from the big windows is so soothing ! We loved it so much it was difficult to leave it. You can cook in the kitchen and you will find everything you would need. Truly the best place I've been through airbnb. You cannot go wrong with the Boldera. For sure this is the place I'll stay in whenever I'm back in NYC and I recommend it highly ! Thanks again Damon and Kent !
There are no unpleasant surprises. Nice apartment just as I expected.

The apartment is a great size, primarily as a ground floor space with bonus basement comprising of an extra living room, bedroom and bathroom. We mostly spent our time in the ground floor area, when we were working during our 10 day stay. We were hard pushed to find a space big enough for 4 of us for such a lengthy stay during October, but this apartment was more than big enough!  The area near the station is quite sketchy at night and had us on higher alert when walking back with all our camera gear. New York can be like this all over, but we did feel it more in this area. It is only about 7 mins walk to the house, however.
The place was very nice inside but the backyard needed lots of tending.  The neighborhood was pretty sketchy; you have to be okay with staying in this part of Brooklyn.

We had the private room at the front of the house looking out on the street, with 3 people. There is a bed meant for two people, but since we are all just friends, it was a little too cosy. There was a sofa-bed that was big enough for two people. The sleeping experience was sufficient, but not extremely comfortable, as the mattresses are very hard. Rosa is a very nice person and her appartment is situated close by the metro and you can get everywhere easily. The WiFi was very good. The bathroom was also very nice. It is very handy that there is a mini fridge and you can use the kitchen for breakfast and quick lunch. The room doesn't have great lighting, so if you are really into make-up, you might have issues. Astoria is also a very nice neighborhood, with enough shops and nice restaurants. Not shady at all. Overall, we had a great experience with Rosa and a lovely time in NYC.

Pros: Easy check in and check out, kind and flexible host, clear communication about the booking, great/safe/quiet neighborhood, very beautiful and convenient 2nd floor apartment, room for 3 (as posted), full kitchen (as posted), and overall truthful posting.  Cons: No AC or window unit in August isn't the best, but there's a small desk fan and the street is shady, so we were fine by the evening. Alix wasn't able to come by after the previous guests, so there were a few things that weren't prepared before we got there. We might have missed something, but it looked like there were only 2 pillows and one blanket for 3 guests, too.  Overall, this is a beautiful and affordable place for 20somethings looking to get a non-tourist Manhattan experience. I wouldn't recommend for families (as posted), simply because of the basic amenities. Alix was a kind and easygoing host, and the apartment is really homey and spacious, especially for being a studio. Thanks for hosting!

Great Experience! Alix was very understanding with our traveling needs with timing. Location was in a great spot, getting around the city through subway was very convenient. The street was shady and beautiful. Alix place was very nice and unique. The trip was just perfect!

I stayed at the lovely Family home of Karen and Joshua in brooklyn. The room was cozy and with The kitchen just outside of the room i had all The things i would need at hand. I had The freedom of coming in and leaving The appartment whenever i wanted and when i had questions about NY and it's highlights they where always exited to give me an awnser wich was really nice. Their two kids are adorabele and pretty quiet so it was not a problem at all that they where up early in the morning. I can recommand this BnB to everyone who wants to stay in NY for a while. Kind regards, Tijmen (Son of Rob)

Karen and Joshua are really nice people, and their two kids are adorable. They received us warmly, gave us lots of advice and told us interesting stories about themselves. Also, they tried to keep it as quiet as possible in the mornings, which is surely a challenge with two energetic little kids. Their apartment is really close to the subway (about a 2min-walk), which will easily take you to other parts of Brookly and Manhattan. There are two things that you should be aware of, however: the neighborhood seemed a  little rough to us, so that you should be careful at night. Since the walk from the subway to the flat is so short, it only bothered us the first night, when we were a little surprised at the number of policemen and shady people on the streets.  Also, as it truthfully says in the description, the room is very small and a little problematic for two people with big luggage. It is not a place where you would want to hang out very much; which should not be a great issue either, if you know it in advance and plan to be out and about all day anyways.   The whole apartment is rather small (it looks more spacious on the pictures), so that you have to feel comfortable with "intruding" on the family's much used living room, since the guest room is right next to it.

I had a wonderful three-night stay with Joshua and Karen. The room was very comfortable, and I thought it was plenty of space for one person with a few bags. The rest of the apartment is nice and comfy as well, and I appreciated that I was made to feel welcome to use the common areas when I was around. The apartment has only one bathroom but I never felt like there were any conflicts with getting time in the shower or anything. Location is fantastic--there's a subway station literally just round the corner and I found it very quick and easy to get into Manhattan every day. I honestly never felt all that uncomfortable with the neighborhood, as other reviews mentioned, but I guess that kind of thing is relative.  On top of all this, it really has to be said that this is just the nicest family. Karen and Joshua are so friendly and also really interesting people. I tend to be a little shy of strangers and sometimes find it stressful staying in a room in the home of a family I don't know, but Karen and Joshua never made me feel like I was intruding, and I had some really enjoyable conversations with them. Their two kids are also super cute and very precocious.   I would absolutely recommend staying here, and would happily stay here again myself on any future visit to the area.

The room is clean and cosy. It is fine for one person but two would be a bit of a squeeze. The room opens to the family's  living room and you will get a lot of free entertainment - the host sings and plays his guitar while his two adorable kids dance crazily- so it is value for money right there! It felt a bit intrusive on the hosts' family life being there, though the hosts are very friendly and helpful people. The flat is really near a subway station (with an elevator if you have luggage) and the neighbourhood disconcerted me at first as it looked a bit unsafe (host advised that the main streets are safe enough). I can't tell how safe it is at night as I never used the subway at night while I was there.

The host (Selam) was very kind and available, answering promptly every question or request. The apartment was very fine, clean and exactly as announced in the web-site. Also cozy, well decorated, and comfortable. There were no cable TV (as prevented by the owner) but the internet signal was very good.  The kitchen had everything needed to prepare any meal.  The building does not bear lift, but there are only two sets of stairs to reach the apartment. We could listen neighbors in normal activities, but no disturbing noise. Two of them were very friendly.  It is settled in a very calm street, totally residential, but just two short blocs from a commercial street with many types of shops, small markets and all kinds of goods. It is just three blocs from metro stations that can bring to Manhattan in 15 to 20 minutes.  Do not expect fancy and expensive shops, but a friendly and diversified variety of trade places, since very simple clothes of and indian immigrant owner  up to clothes in street-style, wines, and good but rare cafés and bars.  If you like ethnic diversity it is a place to visit. You will meet in the shops and streets people originally from many different places such as Senegal, Trinidad & Tobago, Pakistan, India, Nepal, China, Sudan, Caribbean sea and many others. You could eat also a variety recipes from abroad and there are fresh vegetables in many places.  Streets can be more or less desert  and dark after 10 PM, but they seemed to be very safe and we have never felt afraid or  threatened by anybody.  Two nice suggestions are the Vodou Bar, to have a drink at night and the Café Paris-Dakar for a nice cofee. In the same sidewalk of the café, there is a nice place to by a selection of wines.  For sure we would repeat the stay in this apartment.

Mixed experience... Positives: Location - just one block from the metro, lots of shops and restaurants on 125th. Very lively and safe area The welcome: refreshments and chocolates await you upon arrival in the studio.   The apartment: consistent with the photos, really very charming, well equipped (Apple TV, home cinema, documentation on New York is also available on site (, and clean (.... At first glance!) Negative points: Lack of cleanliness: the apartment seemed clean at first sight BUT we came across four cockroaches, one of which died in the fridge. The sheets were dirty and caused violent itching on several occasions. Bedding rather uncomfortable The entrance hall and stairs are dilapidated. To conclude, I would recommend this apartment if you are not too demanding in terms of cleanliness, because it is still very charming and well connected, otherwise move on Personally I think that if you pay €90 for cleaning costs you should be able to enjoy a cockroach-free studio.

My experience at Flat do Harlem was incredible! I've been to New York 3 times but this time it was completely different. The fact that I was staying in a flat made me experience the experiences of a New Yorker. Having brunch in Harlem, going to the supermarket, walking around the neighborhood makes all the difference in a trip. At first I was a little worried about the location of the flat because a lot of people told me that the neighborhood could be dangerous. I spent 7 days in the flat and didn't have any experience that caused me fear.  Positive points: - location: the flat is very well located, right in front is metro station 125, which takes you to Times Square station in less than 10 minutes and has connections with all other lines. In addition, there is a bus line in front of the flat.  Close to the flat there are several supermarkets, bakeries, local restaurants and large fast food chains such as McDonalds, donuts, Applebees. In addition, there are pharmacies, a supplements store (GNC), a multi-brand clothing outlet (Marshalls), an HM store, a Gap outlet and many other cool things.  - savings: staying in a flat helps you save a lot!! I spent 200 dollars from the supermarket and bought enough food for breakfast, lunch and dinner for 7 days! Just to give you an idea, a dinner for 2 people in an average restaurant costs less than 60 dollars!  - Harlem culture: another positive point is the local culture! Bars that play Jazz, Gospel music from churches, Brunchs served in local restaurants, women's clothes, hair, nails! Everything is beautiful! I loved!!! - apartment: everything in the apartment was well organized! Flagged! With the rules very clear! The conservation and decoration of the flat is wonderful. It's so worth it!  - host: Brinton is a wonderful person! He responds quickly to requests and is always available to help!  Regarding the negative points: I don't have any points to mention! My experience was incredible and I want to come back often.

Karen welcomed us when we get there. She is friendly. but the room is quite small that just one large bedroom fit in. the location is near metro but the neighborhood is quite unsafe and it took 40~50minutes to get to manhattan or so.

Karen and Joshua were great hosts! The communication beforehand and also during my stay was just excellent! Unfortunately I didn't get to meet Karen in person as she was out of town during my stay but Joshua looked after my wellbeing, making sure I was fine, recommending restaurants and giving all the useful tips you might need when staying in New York! Their kids were just adorable and "JJ" the cat got loads of extra cuddles from me :-) Karen and Joshua's home is exactly as described: 40-45mins by Subway into Manhattan (Midtown: Times Square, Theatre District ...), their place being actually located right in the 'heart of Brooklyn' gave me sort of a suburban feeling with its own vibes and even tranquillity as I barely heard any street noise at all ... waking up to birds singing in the trees and someone playing a piano lovingly in the distance is quite unusual in a City like New York, so that was a real treat during my stay!!! The bed was extremely comfortable, I overslept not only once during my eight-day-stay with them and having the luxury of 'my very own little fridge' in my room was definitely another Highlight!!! Travelling to and from Manhattan by Subway is really easy and I always felt safe ... even late at night or at 4am in the morning hours walking home all by myself, no need to feel unsafe at all! The Subway Station is located right around the corner (3min walk from Karen and Joshua's home!) and has also elevators which comes in handy when you're carrying heavy luggage! All in all I've had a fantastic stay at their place and can highly recommend it to anyone who likes to enjoy living on the other side of the Hudson :-)

We spent a week in Brinton's apartment. It is a house with several apartments, the second floor can only be reached by stairs (as correctly stated in the description).  We didn't meet Brinton when we arrived, but the description we received in advance by email was very precise and so there were no problems.  The Apple TV box connected to the television did not work. Brinton responded immediately to our message via the Airbnb app and came to our house within a very short time on Saturday evening to help us with it.  The apartment itself is tastefully furnished and sufficient for two people. There is a kitchenette and even fruit and water were prepared when we arrived.  The area itself can get noisy on weekends and at least in our case on weekends you could hear music from the street through the closed windows. During the week it was quieter, but you can regularly feel the subway that runs under the street near the house. Someone who is very sensitive might find this bothersome, but we got used to it after 1-2 days.  In close proximity to the apartment there are shopping opportunities and the "Harlem Shake", which offers classic American fast food.   You can reach several subway lines on foot, and Central Park takes around 15 minutes on foot. It is generally advisable to buy a multi-day subway ticket. The closest station is 125 St/Lenox Ave, where you can take lines 2 and 3, which will take you to Times Square in about half an hour.  Unfortunately, we encountered strange characters in the area several times. But we weren't directly threatened. Of course, you feel safer with someone else, but alone (especially as a woman) the situation could be uncomfortable. We were also only out and about during the day (until 8/9 p.m. max.), so we can't judge what the situation is like later at night.   We really enjoyed spending our New York week with Brinton and wish him all the best for the future!

Brinton's place is great. When I booked it I was a little skeptical (I always am when the bathroom isn't pictured) but the bathroom was modern and very clean, which was great (there was also a hairdryer, body wash, shampoo and conditioner- so reconsider packing these things if you decide to stay here!). The place is very well kitted-out with a kettle, microwave, toaster, dishwasher, pots and pans etc. so it was great to be able to cook when we didn't want to go out. The wifi is fast and reliable, and there is a code instead of a key (which is still available if you prefer) to get into the place, which turned out to be really easy and stress free- better than a key.  It's close to lots of little bars and restaurants as well as a supermarket and bottle shop. We slept with the aircon on because it was so hot, so all in all a comfortable stay and I would highly recommend! It's a bit smaller than it looks in the photos but my friend and I didn't feel at all cramped so this was a non issue. Thanks again Brinton!
