The apartment was cozy and nice. I was a bit disappointed I never saw the family as I was looking forward to a bit of community during my stay but they were in Jersey. Despite that, the super let me in and was very kind and helpful, the cat was charming and I felt lucky the other boarded was very nice. (at first I was nervous about staying in a house with a person I hadn't reviewed but I was lucky he was very kind). I was unknowledgeable about NYC geography and had a hard time finding that my commute to my conference in east village was about 50 minutes long and the place was about a 45 minute cab ride from Times Square.  If you are staying here just know to expect that. The apartment is only a short walk to the subway entrance which is very convenient and also good as sometimes it felt a bit sketchy in the neighborhood later at night. Karen was a good communicator and was good at answering any questions promptly.

I stayed at Victoria's for 11 days while on business. The location was absolutely perfect in regards to proximity to work and accessibility to the trains/the city. I loved the neighborhood as well; never felt unsafe or nervous walking around late at night. I also had a rental car and although finding parking in front of the building was sometimes difficult (i was coming and going at odd hours when most people already had spots), it would not deter me from staying there again. Very close to coffee shops, amazing restaurants, etc.  The apartment itself is beautiful and extremely comfortable. No complaints. I did have to run out and purchase toilet paper, but I was there for a longer stay.  Jamin (Victoria's boyfriend) was always in contact and checking in, which I appreciated. I would recommend staying here to anyone. I am definitely hoping to stay again on my next business trip.

The apartment was great, it had everything we needed inside. It met our expectations, it was clean, the bed and cushions were really very comfortable, right next door there is metro and a large store for shopping. We thought it was great. Afterwards it is true that the neighborhood is a little scary due to the surrounding population, we did not walk around Harlem late at night. But everything still went very well.

I found Rosana’s apartment to be a very nice and cozy place to stay for my 2 months in NY. The apartment is always warm during cold weather, as the neighbors upstairs like to keep the heating on. There is no air conditioner, but I’m sure one can be installed if you request one ahead of time. The microwave dosn’t work and is quite old, so I would also make sure to ask about that if reheating food is something you may want. Neighbors upstairs are quiet and friendly, but you can hear their heavy footsteps through their floorboards/the ceiling right above your bed during the day. It can be quite loud, but the noise stops before bed, so it shouldn’t disrupt your sleep.  Rosana was very friendly and helpful throughout my 2-month stay. If I had any queries, they were responded to within 24 hours.  The neighbourhood of Bay Ridge is quiet and peaceful, houses are lovely, people are friendly, and Rosana’s apartment is right opposite Shore Road Park (lots of greenery and cute squirrels jumping around) - with a view of NY Bay & Statue of Liberty in the distance. Bay Ridge is among the safest of neighbourhoods in NY, and is about one hour away from Times Square via the B9 Bus followed by the N train. I would definitely recommend this apartment if you are looking for a nice place to stay in New York and don’t mind travelling a little longer to get to Manhattan. There are also several nice Italian restaurants I enjoyed eating in in Bay Ridge –like  Zio Totto & Vesuvio.  The best thing about staying in this apartment for me was the fact that it’s situated in such a great location. It meant that I could get the best of both worlds – live right next to a long stretch of park where I could take peaceful walks in the sun and enjoy the view of the bay, or if I wanted the hustle and bustle of Manhattan, it was only 30 mins (SOHO/China Town) – 60mins (Times Square) away. And on top of that, Rosana was a really pleasant and responsive landlord, which made the overall renting process that much less stressful and enjoyable.

My experience of staying in Rosana's apartment was great. She is a very generous host; friendly and flexible. Always here for advice and ready to help with information about the neighborhood. The neighborhood itself is very safe, I stayed with my 1yr+ son, I used to come late about 11 pm but I did not face any troubles or felt unsafe.  The apartment is suitable for a couple or a small family with one child. I enjoyed the small back yard. Always there is a hot water, the bed room was warm as well.  The problem I faced was the laundry, it was about 10 min walking to the nearest laundry cleaners.  Also, we used to hear the sounds of the flour from the upstairs neighbors walking. I guess they need to fix it out as it was a little bit noisy. The kitchen was equipped with the optimum needs. She also kept some cleaning tools and an iron which made life easier.  Thank you Rosana for your hospitality.

our host was easily reachable by email before our arrival and welcomed us. She was there when we arrived. The apartment was ready, clean and functional. Very comfortable beds. We had to leave the apartment at 11 a.m. but Adrianne left us the keys until early afternoon so that we could have one last tour of New York without our suitcases. The neighborhood was very nice. Not dangerous at all. Close to the metro, a Mac Donald's and supermarkets.  on Sunday we attended a Gospel in the church next door. We recommend it. It's a unique and typical experience for Harlem residents.  Very honestly, if one day I return to New York, I will rent the same apartment.

Had a great 3 week stay in NY. Apartment was in a great location really close to the subway. I didn't have any issues feeling unsafe coming back at night. Elisa and her room mate were very friendly and helpful. Room was spacey enough for one and facilities in the apartment were good. Just be warned that it is on the 6th floor so will feel a long way up with a heavy suitcase!

Adrianne received us very well and was very helpful so that we could leave our suitcases on the last day while waiting for the flight. The apartment conforms to the description and very well equipped. The area is superb, we are 2 minutes from metro stations no. 2 and 3. In 1/4 hour you are at Time Square. A supermarket is 20m away and many restaurants are nearby. We returned several times after midnight without any problems. We have never noticed a possible problem. We will return to this apartment on our next trip to New York.

We were very well received by Adriana who is very friendly, kind and very attentive.  The apartment conforms to the description. It is made up of 2 bedrooms, each with a double bed and either a small bed or a sofa bed and a sofa bed in the living room.  5 of us stayed for a week.  It is actually located on the second floor without an elevator. The neighborhood is very nice, lively and therefore noisy like all neighborhoods in NY but without any problem of insecurity even when returning late at night. For junk food lovers there is a McDonald's at the bottom of the apartment, a supermarket and on the opposite sidewalk a wine store. It is often difficult to make choices on Airbnb, so I will be as objective as possible. The apartment was clean. The rooms too, the sheets very clean, very pleasant cotton as well as the pillows. On the other hand, the mattresses made a lot of noise and it was quite painful, impossible to move without waking the other person. The bathroom is perfect with more than enough towels, very clean and soft. The kitchen is well equipped although a non-stick frying pan for eggs for breakfast would be welcome ;-) The air conditioning is very noisy but like all state air conditioning, no split so the big engines purr loudly. The Wifi signal is very weak, so we always connected to LENNYAKS (free) or HARLEM WIFI (free) and it worked much better. The only downside is that the apartment is a little far away.  Lots of metro, 7 stops to go to Time Square with the express line and 1 hour to get off at Ground Zéro and Century 21.  We had a great vacation for our second stay in NY.

Following the attacks at Brussels airport our flight to New York was canceled and we had to postpone our trip for one day. Adrianne was very understanding and agreed that we postpone our stay, it was a real relief for us not to have to change all our plans! His welcome on the day of our arrival was warm, his apartment practical, pleasant and spacious. We appreciated the neighborhood and the proximity of the metro which quickly took us to various places in the city.

Spacious, quiet apartment, the kitchen is well equipped. Ideally located to reach the heart of Manhattan, close to 2 subway stations serving several lines.  Adrianne is very welcoming and friendly, plus she lives in the building which is very reassuring if needed. Arranging, for departure our flight being in the evening we were able to drop off our luggage and enjoy our last day. Address to recommend. Great host

Elisa was so responsive, very organized, very welcoming and friendly. Great hostess. The room is exactly as described, not much room around the bed but there is a small closet, dresser and some shelves. The key to this place is the AC wall unit in the room. Definitely a booking point for an NYC summer stay. The downtown subway station right around the corner was under construction and that would have been nice to know but you can still get back uptown since that track/exit is functioning. There's a cute deli/convenience store 2 buildings down and some restaurants on Lexington. Area seems safe during the day, can be a bit sketchy at night. Keep in mind this apartment is on the 6th floor with no elevator. Only 1 bathroom but we never had an issue even with Elisa, her roommate and the 2 of us. Our first Harlem experience and while it's not the Village of UES it's a good New York City experience for a good price.

Communication with the host has been very fluid and easy. Like everything, there are positive things and other aspects to improve. It is an apartment in a sixth without elevator, with three rooms where between one and two are rented to travelers. In our case 2 of the 3, so sometimes you can have the feeling of being in a hostel with a shared bathroom and everything that entails...The apartment is clean and well maintained, the sheets and towels are worn but clean. The room is small but comfortable, the bed very comfortable. Lighting could be improved. One problem is that it faces the kitchen, so noise and conversations can be annoying, in our case it only happened a couple of times, but the other travelers with whom we shared the apartment had our schedules and there were no problems. The sink and shower are clean except for the curtain which should have a change soon. As far as the situation is concerned, it is in a popular neighborhood with working people, but it is not dangerous (although the taxi driver who took us did not think the same) in my experience it is very good and very close to central park and a metro stop, to walk from the center it is far. Therefore we consider it more as a place to sleep than a place to rest at midday, because you lose a lot of time between going and coming back. We had no problems with the key system.

Disappointing, overpriced and potentially dangerous.  Great location and the place is massive and spacious. Peter was accommodating when we had to cut short our stay and quick to respond. The place it’s self, however, is interesting. It’s a ramshackle old warehouse with what seem like dangerous power points and bootlegged lights and fans all over the place. I felt like I was going to be electrocuted every time I switched the lights on.  The microwave was broken. The kitchen is really just a sink and one hot plate  The shower/bath drain was literally so blocked with hair that the bath filled half way whilst you were showering.  The bathroom was full of old half empty shaving creams and other various bottles. The “first aid kit” was just some Advil and a box of bandaids  The tv screen was so dirty you could barely see what was playing on the screen. No elevator access and being on fourth floor is pretty limiting also.   Also the bed is tiny. Barely a double. So if you’re taller than 6 foot, you’ll be sleeping with your feet hanging out of the bed.   For the price we paid and the $200 cleaning fee, I would expect A LOT more than what you get.   Very very disappointed.
Was okay. Elisa was kind and hospitable. Notice that the area is a little scary for people not familiar with the Spanish Harlem neighborhood.

Elisa is a lovely hostess who made me feel really welcome. She's very well organised logistically, which is something I appreciate. I loved her cat Milo and the room and apartment were comfortable - I didn't feel I lacked anything. The neighbourhood is somewhat 'edgy' as per previous reviews but as a single woman aged over 50 I never felt unsafe.

Adrianne has a very nice home. She owns the entire building, lives on the first floor and rents out #2 and #3. So I felt very safe. The home had a large bedroom with a pullo ut sofa and queen bed, tv in this room. Kitchen was fully stocked with dishes, and we had plenty of towels for showering in the single bathroom. (No shampoo or soaps were included FYI). Second bedroom was right off the small sitting area. I had 8 people staying total, and it was a little tight but we made it work! The neighborhood was a little dark and creepy at night, so be sure to travel in pairs in the dark. This was about 6 blocks from a street with many stores and food. Definitely good location and easy walking.

We initially walked in an area in the neighborhood that felt unsafe because we first met our son who was staying in NYC for the semester and the subway line near him didn’t go to the subway stop near this Home. We walked about 20 minutes to get to the house from where we were and wished we hadn’t.  Later, we were sure to use the main areas around the subway stops near the home, and then we always felt safe.
Very accommodating hostess and very communicative. She definitely made my sibling and I feel welcome and her flexibility made our trip considerably less stressful.

We stayed at Mary Annes appartment to visit New York for sight seeing and that was the best thing we could do. The appartment is really big and cozy and no comparison for the overpriced Manhattan hotels. Mary Anne was really helpful and provided us with everything that we need. The location is great as you have everything you need in really close walking distance and an express metro station that gets you downtown in no time is also just a 5-7 min walk away. We also got to enjoy the roof top area, which we would've done more often if the weather was better. The neighbourhood is friendly and we always felt safe (for those who are afraid of staying in Harlem) and the appartment was very quiet which is great to get away from the loud noises of the city. All in all we can just recommend and would come back anytime!!  Thank you for the nice stay!!

First, Liz is a fantastic communicator and was able to accommodate us on a very short notice after another host canceled with very little notice. Check in was easy, if a bit scavenger hunt-ish, kind of fun. The apartment itself is a very nice space, wide plank pine flooring, tons of books, very comfy bed. Steam heat, so it takes some getting used to in order to regulate the temperature, but once you get the hang of it, easy. This is a prewar building, so floors slope a bit. She has done a great job making the space usable and providing quite a bit of storage room. Espresso maker was a godsend. As for criticisms, the bathroom door is glass. It has some decorative paint, but it is very much clear... know any fellow guests well before using or you will afterwards. It's on the 5th floor and a couple of the floors have stairs that need some attention. I hear this is common in NYC but it was scary, especially if you're a heavy person. All in all, I would not hesitate to stay at her place again and we had a wonderful experience.

Clean, quiet, safe, bright, comfortable apartment in a great location and with a great host.  No elevator is the only real downside (though it wasn’t a problem for us), and the beds were a bit soft for my testy back muscles, but we thought it was great overall.  We never met Liz, but she went out of her way to accommodate our needs with respect to our travel schedule, which really made things stress free.  Would happily stay here again.

The apartment was very close to a subway stop, so we were able to get around Manhattan and to and from the airport easily. There was quite a bit of trash on the streets around the apartment because some people were living outside on the street. (We visited with some of them and never felt unsafe.) Everything was just opening up from shut downs due to COVID, so the apartment needed some attention (coffee pot didn't work, blow dryer was missing), but the host was attentive to the problems and fixed them during our trip. The description of the apartment showed three beds, in addition to the couches, but the twin bed was in the closet with the bed frame in pieces. Consequently, the twin bed was not useable nor were there linens for it. Regardless of these issues, we enjoyed our stay.

A very pretty, well decorated apartment with a small air conditioning and fans that must be left on to have just the right amount of freshness. Although far from the tourist center, the accommodation is well served by public transport. For the taxi to the airport, you must remember to order it 24 hours in advance, you will hardly find one in the neighborhood to hail. This one is very interesting, we did not feel insecure contrary to what we might have feared. Please note that a nearby laundromat is useful for changing laundry. We left a recharge card for the next ones. In short, a great stay where we almost felt American! Highly recommended accommodation.
Simple place with huge value! Great location close to the subway making it a steal as your only a short commute to Manhattan. Local feel, clean space, great communication.
Spacious studio, great location, and excellent host! Communication with Wilfredo was easy and stress-free. Overall a great experience!

I could give a MILLION words of praise about staying at Kevin's place.   One - the neighborhood. Park Slope is a great neighborhood, quiet and safe, but just a 5-10 minute walk from some of Brooklyn's best restaurants and bars. You've also got the B and R trains a few blocks away that run to Manhattan, PLUS Atlantic Avenue isn't too far away if you need other trains.  Two - this apartment is a steal. You get your own room and generous living room, so you have tons of privacy and space.  Finally, Kevin is a great guy and host. Laid back and fun to talk to, but also really accommodating. Seriously, stay here!!

Whoever said in an earlier review that Kevin and his place embody the spirit of airbnb got it spot-on. I spent a Friday night at Kevin's to go to an event at Barclays (a pleasant 10-15 minute walk away) and catch up with some friends, then tool around NY on my own the next day. Kevin was as accessible and accomodating as could be concerning my arrival and departure times, which was a big help because I tend to come to NY with a plan that consists solely of places to eat (of which there are many in walking distance) and fill in the blanks as I go.  I felt completely safe walking back alone at 3 am after enjoying some nightlife, and didn't worry about tiptoeing around when I got back in, as Kevin made it clear that I couldn't possibly disturb his slumber. The two rooms you're renting here are sunny and well-maintained, with good wifi, a comfortable bed, a clean shared bathroom and use of the fridge and kitchen. What else could you need?  Overall, I had a great time, loved the neighborhood, and appreciate everything Kevin does to make sure his guests have a pleasant, fairly priced, and stress-free stay. The next time I need a place to stay in BK, he'll be at the top of my list.

One of our best Airbnb experiences yet!  Kevin responded quickly both before and during our trip.  He was there to greet us when we arrived and the room was clean and ready for us to stay.  The room is spacious, clean and comfortable, and Kevin is a great host.  We enjoyed talking with him about the neighborhood - which is great!  This is one of the best NYC neighborhoods and you get to stay there for a steal.  Convenient to the subway (~25min ride from Port Authority) and walkable to everything you'll need (groceries, coffee, restaurants, pharmacy, etc.)  We went to a tournament at Barclays Center and it was an easy walk each day, and still centrally located enough that we could stop back home before heading into other boroughs for the evening.  Kevin really understands what Airbnb is about and this is a great choice for your travels.
Clean, well decorated and a steal for sure. Easy to get around in NYC.

Beautiful, clean, well maintained and peaceful little apartment. I'll definitely stay here again when I'm back.  I'm originally from New York, so the neighborhood doesn't bother me, but if you are not, you should be mindful that it is right across the street from the projects and you will see a lot of homeless and drug addicts in front of the apartment. As long as you keep your wits about you, you'll be fine. Just be mindful, especially if you're not from a big city.

My husband and I stayed at Takeshi's place this past weekend for his 50th birthday surprise! In the past visits, we have only stayed at hotels in Midtown. Venturing out and staying in the Lower East Side was a great way to experience the city like a local. I will say that there are some homeless folks right outside the front stoop and they do congregate on the sidewalk. I don't recommend venturing out alone at night, but if you have someone with you it will be fine. As far at the accommodations, they were really fantastic! The place was extremely clean and well appointed with essentials. There was even fresh creamer in the fridge for coffee! The bed is VERY comfortable too. Takeshi is probably the easiest host I have ever worked with for Airbnb or VRBO. I would highly recommend this place to anyone and next time we go to NYC will most definitely stay at Takeshis!

Rob’s place is a great place to stay, especially if you are planning to work from home during your stay. The room gets lots of natural lighting because of the large bay windows and is on a quiet street. It is located right on the M train so it is very easy to get to Manhattan. In-unit laundry is very convenient. Ampere, the cohost, was very helpful and responsive. My only complaint is that the room smelled a little musty - like it could use a deep clean - but it was not too bad, especially with the windows open. Overall, I would highly recommend staying here!
Very friendly and helpful host. The place is like promised. The neighborhood can appear dangerous at night, but all people we ran into were friendly

The Hidden Gem was very comfortable home away from home while we visited NYC from Oregon. Niko was very communicative, and while the neighborhood is certainly lively and off the beaten track, we never felt unsafe and found the quick walks to the bus stops and connecting subways were easy to navigate.

Takeshi’s apartment is all you’d ever need in a visit to NYC. Centrally located to the subways and ferry’s within a 15 minute walk. Great value with lots of great restaurants around. I highly recommend Scarr’s Pizza and Supper. Only point of note is there is a few homeless individuals that hang around the street and the stoop. However, the one encounter we had the gentleman was kind enough to move no problem and our further encounters were avoided by going through the adjoining building through the shared backyard
Accurate description Phenomenal communication  I couldn’t have asked for a better stay. Niko made this entire process stress-free!!!!!

Unsafe & Bait/Switch  Owner charged an outrageous $200+ key replacement fee when we lost a physical key to a digital lock that gets reprogrammed after every stay.   He also tried to add costs after our stay by charging us an outrageous fee for disposable Tupperware which was returned to the unit. Seems like a decent deal up front but is a bait and switch trap.   Lastly he tried to charge us for “marking his furniture” but it was completely filthy when we arrived as though it was brought in from sidewalk waste.

Takeshi is a great host, who took care of us and did everything to make us feel comfortable! The apartment is well located and very stylish. Everything is functional and we didn't miss anything. Ideal for visiting New York for 2. The subways are very accessible. Even though a few homeless people wandered in front of the building, we always felt safe.

This was by far the best stay I could have asked for out of an Airbnb! Takeshi was an amazing host and super easy to communicate at any point during our stay. He even was so nice to allow us to drop off our bags prior to our official check in time. Takeshi was only in the airbnb for a little bit in the beginning and then majority of our stay we had the whole place to ourselves which was super nice. The area isn’t super shady and we never felt like we were in danger at any point. The listing was very accurate and we felt like there was a lot provided to us. Overall we throughly enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay her once again in the future!

Takeshi is a great and accommodating host! It can be a little sketchy going in and out of the building at night, but overall it is a perfect home for a short term trip. The bedroom is so cute and cozy!

I would definitely stay at Takeshi’s place again in a heart beat.  Me and my boyfriend felt pretty safe during our entire stay here.  The people outside the block may look a bit intimidating but if you mind your own business and walk pass them they mind theirs too.  It was not troubling whatsoever.  He’s an excellent host and responds very quickly to whatever you may need during your stay.  His place is quite charming and elegant for a small space, and I love that because it just makes the place feel super comfy like you’re right at home.  There are some nights when it can be a little loud outside and you may hear the church bell ring at 10am on Sundays, but overall wasn’t really a bother for us and the pricing for his location and place is such a steal in my opinion.  Definitely by far one one of my favorite airbnbs stays and I’d recommend it for anyone wanting to stay in the LES.

The accommodation is very large by New York standards. It is equipped with everything you could need. Breakfast can also be prepared in the kitchen.  We found it super clean and Takeshi was always helpful as a contact for us. It's only a few minutes walk to the next subway station and you can get anywhere easily. There are some nice restaurants and pubs within walking distance. There are a few homeless people on the street itself, but they didn't bother us. We were very happy with this booking.

We loved everything about our stay! Takeshi has been such a friendly, attentive host and left no question or wish open.  The apartment was just perfect for us, nothing was missing (in fact we were surprised how thoughtful it was equipped, e.g. ear plugs, shampoo, extra pillows, coffee, spices…). There is a lot of room for your clothes and stuff, a bunch of fresh towels and explanations for everything. We used the kitchen a lot, again: nothing is missing. The neighborhood is vibrant and there are lots of small restaurants, stores and you are close to the subway. We were mentally prepared for the people sitting in front of the building but they are just harmless homeless people who never made us feel uncomfortable. Instead friendly and absolutely no reason to not book this apartment (we are two women and felt safe and to be honest, my home town in Germany is worse. We experienced no catcalling in the airbnb’s neighborhood).

Takeshi's place is a real gem. If you're hesitating on booking this place, do yourself a favor and reserve it now. It's one of the best Airbnb apartments I stayed at and the price can't be beat, especially in NYC. Never have we felt unsafe in the neighborhood. We always looked forward to coming back in the apartment. We were sad to leave this place after a week. Us being Asian, the only thing that we wish this place had was a bidet / water jet, but we understand this is not a thing in the US. Still, we will not hesitate to book this place again. Takeshi is a great host, always checking up on us and always willing to help and answer our queries. We can't thank him enough for accommodating us.

The apartment was very clean and check-in went smoothly. Takeshi communicated early and described everything perfectly.  The apartment is well equipped so far, even if it is a bit old and has minor flaws.  However, the environment of the apartment is terrible. It's very dirty, homeless people are always hanging around in front of the house. Pretty uncomfortable.
This is a steal.  You are very lucky if you get to stay here.  It is spacious and has everything you need.

The place is exactly like the pictures – really nice amenities and shared spaces, and the private bedroom and bathroom does their job nicely. Rebecca is also very responsive on text even during thanksgiving break, and she was nice enough to let me store my luggage in the living room after I checked out and before I left the city. There is one thing that bothered me, though – I saw two rats crawling out from the kitchen sink one morning and it was kinda scary, but other than that the place has never gone wrong and I really enjoyed the stay. Definitely would recommend!
Place is a scam won’t let you in takes your money doesn’t give it back

Overall, I think what Sophie did was fair. But still, I think this experience could have been avoided. First, she forgot to send me check-in information and I stalled for 30 minutes in front of the door, lost. For the duration of the stay, she just would not respond!   Also, I had put my dinner in the fridge, which I thought was shared by guests. 5 hours later, my food was gone. I asked Sophie about this, but she did not respond.   The neighborhood seems a bit unsafe. I could hear coughs or whispers from the next door. Basically no sound barrier.

The location was very comfortable and close to the metro.  The house was good but the ventilation issue is complicated and the smell when going down the stairs was unpleasant.  Communication with the host was fast on the first day, on the last day he took a long time to respond to us, although he was very kind keeping our bags for us until our return time.

I’ve never dealt with a host that is this unhelpful, inflexible and unpleasant. The entire experience of checking in and staying at this Airbnb was tough. First I was bombarded with many lengthy messages on how I must not talk to anyone or mention Airbnb, to lie about why we are there and pretend that we live there - there were signs in almost every room saying the same thing as well. Certainly not what you want to see or feel on holiday.  For check in, we were asked to contact the cleaner directly who didn’t pick up because she was on holiday.  The process eventually took hours. Finally we were given the code for the lock box to remove the key which is placed close to the ground and covered in pee.   The flat itself is very basic. When we got there, there were bags of trash lying around. Check in is also at 5pm with no flexibility, which feels too late.   The only saving grace is the location, which was good.

While the apartment was as seen in the photo’s for the most part, the level of cleanliness was not up to par. The towels were worn to the point where they no longer absorbed moisture and had huge dirt stains on them when we arrived. Due to covid, the area was quite unsafe and as two young women we felt uncomfortable in many instances and could not leave walking past dark. When we brought up our concerns to Kyra they were met with a condescending attitude and rude comments. Which did not make us feel anymore comfortable about the situation. The building itself was great and the large windows and sunlight are nice.

Scam alert! Very shady host. I got stranded with my elderly parents late night since some other guests were already at this Airbnb. I tried to reach out to Alejandro but he never answer the call, went to voicemail. We had to book a hotel at the last moment and higher price in emergency.
Great host, Beautiful Apt, Very Spacious, Great location close to store and transportation. Would Definitely use them again. Stress free trip!!
This was such a perfect trip! The room looks brand new and so clean, it was a stress-free experience in a great neighborhood!

The place was great- very bright and quite spacious for a studio… it had everything you need to eat, sleep and drink there for a couple of days.  Good sized fridge, microwave, kettle, sink and kitchenware… Sumerian had left some snacks and breakfast items which was a nice touch.    It seemed very clean but unfortunately we ended up sharing with some unwanted, New York sized, creepy crawlies… and found out the hard way when we woke up to them on tap dancing on the floor!!  There was a hot water issue when we were there too, which is not ideal when needing to shower during a New York summer.  Both of these factors tarnished the ‘value’ side of things but we would come back again, expecting that the next time we’d have hot showers throughout our stay and no cockroaches.

The place is everything you need for few days but I wouldn’t stay there for more than two days since it is really really small even for two people. You can’t really fit in the bathroom well even when you are alone.  There were not enough towels for us for the days we stayed there and to clean the floor after we took a shower…even you close the shower door completely, the water leaks to the other side, which is kind of dangerous and a pain to clean.  Everything seems to be really clean but the back floor of the toilet was really dirty which I didn’t like.  The smell of the room was like of weird when we came in…it didn’t smell like clean.  We heard the running and walking upstairs all the time which was really annoying if you want to relax or sleep earlier or wake up later… The place is fine and Sumeira allowed us to check in before which was really nice of her…the amenities are great and the bed was really comfortable.  The transportation is fine, the subway is close.  Thank you

My stay with Max exceeded all expectations. As a woman traveling alone it can be a little scary renting a room in an apartment versus an entire apartment. But his place made me feel secure, safe and welcome! I’ve stayed in Airbnb’s for personal and professional reasons, and this place is the gold standard. The place was secure, clean, and smelled heavily. Max had a ton of amazing technology to make the space functional and cool. He even waited to greet me after my late flight landed. My room had snacks, and a cute little hospitality package with items for a facial. I definitely would suggest staying with Max if you need a Airbnb in Harlem. The pictures don’t do the space justice.

The room was as described. However, the check-in process is a little sketchy. Also my room door didn't lock from the outside. I only stayed one night so it wasn't a big deal but that should be fixed. The room was a bit dusty for paying a cleaning fee. However the bathroom was immaculate! The shower was great. Max does a great job of providing clean linens that are good quality. The complimentary drinks are a plus and the location makes it easy to get to the subway. It was a bit loud - but that is New York for you. The price really can't be beat for all he offers.

This place is amazing. The room, house and amenities are clean and comfortable and I enjoyed living here. Max is the nicest host I’ve had and he never fails to provide and help when needed. The location is very convenient and there are many stores around the area. However, travelers should be aware of their surroundings when traveling around this area as it can get sketchy at later times of the day.

Danny and Brian were very accommodating during our stay. They answered all my questions promptly and any issue I had Danny personally stopped by to assist. There is a supermarket literally steps from the condo, and a drug store directly across the street. Condo has great WiFi signal, and big screen tv’s in all rooms. It’s located in the Parkchester area of the Bronx. We would definitely stay here again!

Everything is as described. The place is as it is in the pictures. Max is a very good and caring host, big plus for communications especially. It’s easy and quick to get everywhere from the place with the subway. I didn’t feel unsafe at the location, even when arriving late with the subway. Would highly recommend if you’re looking to save some money on your New York trip and still be able to easily access everything that the city has to offer.

Danny was extremely helpful! The condo was exactly as pictured. The parking was a bit stressful but Danny helped ease the stress quite a bit! My family and I enjoyed our stay here in the Bronx! I definitely recommend if you’re wanting to a nice and quiet place away from downtown!

Stay was all we wanted and more. I thought I would share the pros and cons of the location.   Pros:  Spacious:  the family area downstairs offered plenty of room for everyone to enjoys meals and movies together.  The kitchen well supplied the bathrooms were comfortable.  Rooms were well sized to sleep 8.  Four adults and four teens. Three bathrooms a huge plus.   Proximity:  the N line subway is right out your door and you can get to everything you want in 30 minutes. There are some really great eating spots within two blocks especially if you like authentic Mexican food as in Mexico City style.  There is also a super Italian place nearby. You are on top of a Dunkin’ Donuts so coffee, donuts, and breakfast is sooo handy.   Host:  friendly and helpful. Whenever I asked for something she was by there to drop it off in the night hours. She answered questions before our stay and was super helpful throughout.    Value:  you get a lot of room for the money.   Cons:   Street noise:  It’s New York the city that never sleeps so there is street noise. My daughters saw more out their window such as crime and fights. All the time though we felt safe and secure. When we walked the streets I never felt at risk even if we were out late.  If you need quiet to sleep I would pack some ear plugs or bring some white noise devices.

This stay was fantastic! The place is just as described and has plenty of room for 6-7 people. The amount of room in the place was really a pleasant surprise and helped make our stay that much better. My only complaint was the area the apartment was in, pretty sketchy area to be if you don’t know what you’re doing or don’t have a lot of people with you.

Very pleasant apartment located in the Harlem district (we did not feel any insecurity). A metro entrance at the foot of the building makes it easy to take public transport.  Remember earplugs, NYC is the city that never sleeps.  Also practical: a supermarket open 24/7 just a stone's throw from the apartment.

Great AirBNB with some few things to note  - you’re in Spanish Harlem/nyc. It’s going to be loud outside/ it’s diverse. Is it unsafe —no—but it’s not suburbia and you have to be street smart. I lived and grew up in this neighborhood and it’s  busy, lively and the streets cab be dirty (duh it’s New York). Check your expectations - bring ear plugs if you are a sensitive sleeper - each room had a split air conditioner which was great! - super convenient as it is literally above the 6 train and it is surrounded by tons of stores and great restaurants. Ladies right in front sell delicious tamales every morning (except Tuesday) I highly recommend them and we got them for breakfast daily - condo itself is modern, newly renovated, clean and well appointed. Certain things are showing mild wear but doesn’t affect the quality of the place  - kitchen has plates and some pots, toaster oven. Not really meant to cook big meals but you’re on vacation and you are surrounded by restaurants - fast internet - washer dryer in property was convenient  - host was responsive  Would stay here again

The ground floor is very good, but the upper floor is way too small for 9 people. Walls were very dirty as well as one of the bathrooms, which was also missing a mirrow and a hanger for a towel. I had to sleep two nights on the sofa, because the single extra bed requested for my child was not set. I think we should have got a discount for that.  It would have been good to have a welcome note with instructions upon arrival. There were many basic products missing, the clean towels were nowhere to be found, the Wifi password was finally found in the router in one of the bedrooms, ... A checkout message would also have been desirable.   The neighborhood is a bit scary at times, but the metro stop is very close and there is a great supermarket and taquería in the same street. The neighbors on the upper floor were very noisy from 7 am. The owner was in contact with us only by text, she was friendly and willing to help, but definitely not a super host.
This apartment while clean is in basement with no emergency access in case of fire.    Windows are blocked and basement steps are steep and dangerous

Booked the place for a friend to stay over from UK, honestly convenient. The only thing is it makes noice when the heat is on which kind of scared my friend but j had explained it is a common thing with private house so FYI. Over all very comfortable stay.

This is a rare find,not may places in NYC that have more than 1 bathroom,this has 3! Samantha's place is very spacious.We had 7 women in our party and we were comfortable & able to spread out.There were a few issues but we were able to work those out with Samantha. Before I booked this home I read all reviews,I recommend doing that because of the location its not for everyone.Spanish Harlem is a poorer part of NYC & is not the prettiest but that didn't bother us at all. There's street noise (NY in general is noisy) so if you are a light sleeper I suggest take a bedroom at the back of the house & bring earplugs. I need to add that we NEVER felt unsafe in this neighborhood & I knew what I was renting based on previous reviews.There's an amazing grocery store less than a block away &  Halal cart with the best Gyro's I've ever ate in my life! The 6 train is literally a 2 minute walk from the front door which will get you to pretty much anywhere in the city. I would rent from Samantha again

Such a beautifully put together studio, and in a really well connected spot. It was bigger than we’d expected too! We really enjoyed our stay. A few things I would have loved to know before we got there, so sharing for future visitors:  - 5 story walk up  - old building, don’t let the wonky stairs scare you, the studio itself is well maintained  - this is a lived in residence and has lots of personal effects around  - there are no curtains and the sound travels from the street a lot, so be prepared for light and noise

Location is excellent if you desire seafood; there are so many seafood places to eat.  There is a boardwalk type location where you can jog, walk or just sit and look out over the water and watch the sunrise, sunset, speedboats, sailboats, etc. Golfing nearby also.  Shopping only about a couple of miles away.  Because remnants of hurricane Ida was there during our stay flooding became very dangerous, but this does not seem to be a normal occurrence.  For this particular Airbnb, parking can be an issue because only one side of street can be used; and because of restaurant customers, but it manageable.  The residents in the neighborhood are friendly. The neighbors next door even shared their homemade blueberry muffins with us.  The house is not huge, but big enough for a couple or small family.  All the comforts of a small home.

This little place on the island is so nice and Amanda and Tanya are wonderful hosts. The place is much larger than I expected from the pictures and it’s such a great location. They helped us quickly with the only issue that came up and were very helpful upon arrival, providing snacks and breakfast items to help relieve some stress from our travels.   I would definitely stay here again and recommend you do!

Let there be no hesitation, if you are looking for a safe, spacious, well appointed, conveniently located and really comfortable place to stay on your trip to NYC, this is the place you want. We had a fantastic stay at Pete's place on our visit to my Dad's old stomping grounds. The house is so comfortable, there's room for everyone to have their own space. The beds are so inviting after a long day of sightseeing. The yard - yes, it has a yard!! - is good for the pups (and any kiddos), and also the patio would be a great place to relax in the afternoon and grill some of the wonderful offerings of the many butcher shops in the area. You could cook a great meal in the fully stocked kitchen with double ovens, and the dining room table is big enough for a family dinner, which is so nice.  The man cave, out back and fully separated from the house, would also be good if you have to work on your trip and need privacy. But the piece de resistance is the private driveway that awaits you behind a gate. You can go out and not have to worry about where you're going to park when you get back. The neighborhood is residential, never did we feel unsafe. It was a perfect stay for a perfect trip reliving all the memories of my dad's childhood. I've never seen him so happy, he was over the moon to be able to go out and walk to where everyone from his youth lived. Thank you Peter for the hospitality. We loved our visit.

Overall my stay at Red Autumn was great. The location was ideal for my vacation being that it was close to family and friends. The check in process was simple and easy. Contacting the host was stress free. The apartment was exactly as pictured , no surprises. For cleanliness I give a 4 only because I found the floors to be a bit dusty but nothing a quick sweep and mop couldn’t fix. There is a dog that barks a lot on the first floor so that at times was a little bothersome but not too crazy. But I would definitely stay again on my next trip to NYC.
Spaciouc, clean and well equiped apt, easy comunication with host. Scary and dirty locality. Close to JFK and metro station.

I would stay here again because of its proximity to JFK and the ease of using mass transit to get there.   This place is not in the best of neighborhoods but I NEVER felt uncomfortable or unsafe walking to the Caribbean restaurant (which was pretty decent)  on the corner, the bodega for snacks and beverages, or the subway.    For the price, it was okay, but it could  have been a little cleaner.

Overall, a good stay here.  PROS:  - Easy check-in, no issues getting to, or into the flat.  - Good communication with the owner, always quick to respond.  - Gave us great extra time to check-out, which was a life-saver.  -Washing machine, dryer, shower, air con in bedrooms all great.  - The flat is nice, spacious, well equipped.  - Easy to get to from the subway, near to other things you might need, and the nearby diner is AWESOME  CONS:  - It was pretty unclean when we arri ved. Most other reviews seem positive on this issue, so I'm assuming this was a one off, but it was pretty bad in some places. Splatters of -something- on walls and curtains, not clean under the sink or floors, and some big hairball left on a shelf in one of the bedrooms haha  - The area might not be suitable for all. I was traveling with two young teens on their first trip, and the area did make us nervous at times. (especially at night). I don't think we were in real danger at any point, but we were catcalled walking down the street, and had someone follow us almost right to our front door looking for spare change. This isn't a reflection of the air bnb itself obviously but it definitely made us return home earlier each night so it was a little less intense.  - The air con didn't do much to cool down the living areas, there was just a big fan in there which was only useful if it was right in front of you. We're Scottish and not used to the heat (haha) so we spent a lot of time locked in our bedrooms under the aircon trying to cope in the 32° heat.  Overall the experience was positive, though I did feel a little annoyed about the cleanliness issue. I did a little cleaning before we left as I was concerned we'd get blamed for it or something after we left - but once again - most other reviews mention how clean it was, so maybe this was just a one off. I'd recommend for a stay if you are comfortable in all types of neighbourhoods.

If I could give Antonella 10 stars I would! From the moment we walked into the apartment it felt like home.   The 2 bed/2 bath was extremely comfy, spacious and had everything you would need for your stay. A huge plus for us was with it being a garden unit with just 4-5 steps to enter the one floor apartment, my 83 yr old mother in law was able to maneuver easily down the steps and into the space. Having great WI-FI and Roku capabilities in the apartment was a huge plus as we were able to watch college football after a long day exploring Brooklyn and Prospect Park.   The apartment is located in a beautiful family neighborhood in Park Slope and is super quiet. We all had excellent nights sleep in the queen size beds. It was walking steps away not only from our son but to coffee/bagel shops, grocery stores, amazing neighborhood restaurants and transportation to Manhattan. My husband and I feel Park Slope is one of the most beautiful areas of Brooklyn and the place where we would want to live if we were moving to NY.  Antonella would always respond promptly with any questions I had about the apartment and the surrounding area.  Thank you Antonella for making our trip a memorable and stress free visit. We look forward to booking our next upcoming trip to the Big Apple and staying with you in Park Slope.

We had a great experience staying at Antonella’s. The apartment was comfortable and clean. Everything was as pictured. The location was perfect—a very safe neighborhood, in a quiet pocket but blocks away from the subway and a quick ride to Manhattan for activities. The host was communicative and accessible when there was a very minor issue that needed to be addressed. This is my first time using AirBNB and while I wish everyone had such a wonderful experience, I suspect we got particularly lucky.

This Airbnb is a steal! The location in Hell's Kitchen is very convenient (about a 7 min walk from the A/C blue train) and 10 minutes from Central Park/Columbus Circle. There are great shops and restaurants around as well. The description was very accurate and the apartment was exactly how it was described. Josh and co were very communicative and responsive. Check in was easy and they provided clear instructions. Additionally, I felt like the Airbnb was sufficiently stacked with enough essentials for my family and me for the five days we were in NYC. Such a lovely experience, would 10/10 recommend.

Antonella’s place was everything described and more!  Antonella is an awesome host, always responsive.  This place is in a beautiful neighborhood in Brooklyn.  Very close to a subway station where you can catch the R train and head towards Manhattan.  We did this daily to go site seeing.  The neighborhood has a sense of peacefulness.  We walked at night, in the morning and afternoon and not once did we feel unsafe.  Also, for those uncertain about the subway, There is police presence in the subways and after day 2 we felt almost like true New Yorkers.  There is a Bagel Pub about 2 blocks away where you will find the best, in my opinion, bagels, coffee and spreads in town.  There are also quaint restaurants all around.  The apartment is everything you see in the pictures and more.  My family and I had the best time and although there are thousands of options to select, I’m sure you will not be disappointed in this one.   Just got back to Texas and my family and I are ready to head back!
This was a great location for a great price. The check-in instructions were very detailed and helpful. It was a stress free, easy process and we had a great time! Thanks so much!

Thanks Glenn, you are a fabulous host and your place is awesome!! We were super delighted with how clean and tastefully decorated your place is. Thanks too, for the wonderful communication, it made our stay easy and stress free. We highly recommend. We’ll be back.

Love Laura’s place! This was our second stay. It’s within easy walking distance of my daughter’s apartment and, although on the ground floor, is on a quiet residential street that felt quite safe. It’s extremely clean, handicapped accessible if needed, and even has a parking spot right by the door. Lots of coffee shops, drug store, and restaurants nearby. Never waited more than 2 minutes for an Uber. Quick access to and from LaGuardia and Manhattan. There is a full kitchen that Laura has stocked with a coffee/tea bar, waters and sodas, snacks, and a lovely welcome bottle of wine. Very comfy bed. Small dining table if you decide to cook or eat in. Excellent WiFi and flat screen TV. Highly recommend!
Very clean room with large beds and comfortable.  However, the electricity was cut off many times and I felt stress.

There wasn't any heat ..I didn't stay there only on my last day not enough wash rag or towels tv didn't work and there wasn't any toilet paper when arrived and used wash rags and funny smell on first floor windows were open when arrived so it was very cold couldn't find thermostat and host wouldn't respond .. neighbor is really unsafe a lot of guys hang outside of house

I’ve stayed at Genevieve’s place several times and it gets better every time. Not sure how she tops each time, but she does.  She and Devin are awesome. Got stuck there on the day the Nor’easter hit and they were so gracious and helpful. Made my stay stress free. They even let me borrow their shovel (broke it-sorry guys) to dig out 3’ of snow that the plows helped pack in.  As far as the place goes, check out my previous reviews. Nothing has changed. They cover everything well. Def super hosts!

We have a terrific time in Arturo’s apartment.  It was charming, nicely appointed, clean, and conveniently located.  The communication was terrific and everything ran completely smoothly.  The back bedroom is very quiet.  The front bedroom gets some street noise but nothing a white noise machine or drug store ear plugs wouldn’t drown out.  Highly recommend.

We ended up leaving after the first night, primarily because we found the bathroom unusable.  Unfortunately, this apartment is not 100% usable for a lot of people.  And this is primarily due to the bathroom.  We understand that NYC apartments are small, and we were prepared to deal with that since we would be spending most of our time enjoying the city.  But in addition to being a tiny bathroom (it is the size of a small closet basically) the placement of the toilette makes it nearly unusable for some people.  From the pictures, you cannot know how small the bathroom is. I am not saying there is deception here, but what I am saying is that because it is so small as to be nearly unusable (depending on your size and level of claustrophobia), that the host should really inform people in some way in order to avoid awkward moments like we had and to be a better host. You will not know until you are there and try to use the toilette.  So how small is it? When you sit on the toilet (assuming you are petite enough) your left hip is pressed up against a pipe that is wrapped in insulation (which we hope is not asbestos).  Not only is this uncomfortable, but who goes #2 with their knees together?  Your right hip will be hanging over the bathtub.  The top edge of the toilette bowl extends over the edge of the bathtub. In fact the hand held water hose is attached to he side of the toilette! It is hard to believe that the building code even allows this (did they?).  There is literally zero space on either side of the toilette bowl - it touches a pipe on one side and extends over the bathtub on the other  There is about a 2 foot by 3 foot area (I am being generous) where you can stand, so when you get out of the shower a large person cannot even bend over to dry their feet without hitting their head on something.  We had to dry off outside the bathroom which is awkward when in mixed company.  The refrigerator is also unusable due to the fact that the door opens the wrong way and you cannot get into it without moving the small table and chairs and of course there is nowhere to move them to!  Again, I realize that NYC apartments are small, but things need to be functional as well.  Most refrigerators can be set up either way.  This is the second functional issue that has nothing to do with size and cleanliness and at least this one would be easy for the hosts to fix.  This apartment was clean enough, but Arturo could not stop reiterating how clean they keep it.  It was nothing to brag about. The pull-out sofa bed had something that looked like chocolate ground into the fabric.  The place was "clean" but by no means "spotless".  I suppose when compared to the hallways and streets of Manhattan you could say "clean".  And while the unit itself is fairly cute and clean, the building entrance, hallways, and stairs are downright filthy (and scary).  If we had been able to see what the hallways and stairways looked like we would never have stayed there.  Unfortunately we did not take a picture of that area, so you'll have to take my word for it.  Just be prepared.  Being on the second floor above a restaurant may be typical for NYC, but be aware that you will be hearing the sounds of what sounds like metal trash cans banging until about 2 in the morning as the restaurant cleans up.  I realize the city is loud, but a higher floor would be better, and due to large gaps where the window air conditioners are installed it sounds like the windows are open when they are not; the unit was also very cold for the same reason, but at least they provided space heaters.  There is always some risk when getting an Airbnb you have never seen before, so we usually look for a "superhost" status to help avoid a disaster.  Arturo was rated as a superhost.  He was very communicative and professional, but his reaction to our complaints/comments deserves to be shared here so others can take the existing reviews in the right context.  I sent Arturo a text to tell him we were leaving after the second day of four nights we had booked.   I said to him:  "we understand that NYC bathrooms are small, but we found this one unusable" and ... "If you could be so kind as to refund the last night's rent, we will be kind in our review".   That was his chance to avoid this part of the review (Although I think I am still being kind - just being truthful).   Arturo's reaction was to get super defensive with a long reply in which he emphasized all the time, effort, and expenses that have gone into the unit.  He kept mentioning his "superhost" status.  While I understand how people get defensive when something is a labor of love for them, this is not professional and it doesn't matter.  I don't give a hoot how much time effort and money you have invested.  This is a business deal.  Beware the emotionally driven business person.  But he went beyond defensive when he accused me of trying to scam him in his reply.  In reaction to me saying "If you could be so kind as to refund the last night's rent, we will be kind in our review", he said:  "you basically are trying to scam me"  Which I found quite annoying an ironic considering the next thing he said:  "I will refund the last night after you give a 5 star review".    Really Arturo?  You start by accusing me of scamming you based on the fact that I said I would be "kind" and then a few lines later

Arturo’s place in the heart of Hells Kitchen was the perfect crash pad for our girls weekend in NYC. Excellent check-in instructions and in Walking distance to Times Square, Central Park and for those who embrace the joy of walking, a totally doable walk to the High Line and on to Greenwich Village. Very comfortable beds and temperature controls in each room. Kitchen is fully stocked and everything was spotless. The back bedroom was especially quiet. Arturo was very accommodating to our schedule and allowed us to stow our bags many hours before check-in which was very much appreciated!! Would definitely stay here on a return visit to the city. Thank you for a fabulous stress-free weekend in the city!
It is quite small but to rest and go to the airport it is fine. The area did not seem dangerous to me, it is easy to walk to terminal B of the airport.
The room door does not close from the outside, leaving the guest unsafe when leaving. It does not correspond to private accommodation.

We had a good stay! Since we arrived, Genevivie sent us a message with all the details for check-in. The room with a very comfortable bed, clean sheets. The only thing is that it doesn't have air conditioning; but there is in the room! The bathroom was cleaned every time a new tenant came in, but I do have to say that the plastic curtain had an unpleasant orange coating on it, so I suggested to Genevivie that they change it or at least clean it. The subway stations were between 12 and 20 minutes walking! There are cafes, markets or pharmacies very close. Overall, I rate it 9/10.

This place was very clean ,and look just like pictures. Yoselyn greets guest, and seems to be a great host . We just had one problem , our car got broken into on the property and our jewelry and money stolen while parked over night in drive away ,and it was complications getting the camera footage from host to make a report . Other then our property being stolen , it is a clean and comfortable place , just make sure your car is secure,or park elsewhere .

What you can expect is to go down a dangerous set of stairs that go downstairs to the bathroom. and a dirty bathroom rug.  Communication was quick but nobody to greet us or even tell us nearby areas that we can go to.  The location is excellent,  close to train station and a lot of stores in the area and quiet neighborhood.  Oh, one roll of used toilet paper for the weekend and didn't know who to speak to in person.

My husband and I stayed at Keren’s place for work at a near hospital, during the coronavirus pandemic. The location was convenient, near pharmacies, supermarkets, liquor stores and centrally located between Central Park and the east side, which was great for a daily walk or a jog. The building’s amenities were great but unfortunately due to the pandemic, the exercise room, indoor pool and terrace were closed. The card laundry room was clean and organized. The only inconvenience was the fact the the building is near hospitals so the sirene is a normal daily thing and also the homeless people walking around the subway station asking for money. Other than that, it’s a lovely place! We loved the kitchen, where we could cook our meals since ordering food was a bit hard. The king size bed was very comfy but we thought the AC unit was a bit noisy.  Great location, close to 2 subway stations and walking distance to everything we needed. They are prompt in responding to any concerns we had.  We would definitely stay there again.  Thank you!  Andreia & Mike

I stayed here for a month and had a horrible first week there. I downloaded the app and requested an early checkin which was granted for 1pm. When I got there they were still cleaning the apartment and made me wait in the hallways until after 4pm. I asked the cleaning Person when I got there and she said she would be 10 min but that was not the case. I tried calling the phone line - don’t even bother calling you won’t be connected with anyone.   I went in there and there is no oven even though one was listed. The stove burners don’t work well. One of them takes forever to light. It keeps making that clicking sound and will sometimes work and sometimes not. Both the air conditioners broke in the first three days. I had a poor impression of the service they offer. They sent one person from sonder to fix the ac and he said he wasn’t capable of fixing it so they had to call the building person to fix it. Btw this building is split between residential and sonder apartments. When I talked to the other building person who came by he gave me the impression that the sonder maintenance guys were lazy and didn’t want to fix certain things so they’d say they can’t fix it. I thought that was pretty telling.   On the second day I went to the roof and this giant metal brick almost fell on my head. It was extremely dangerous. I asked the building guy what that was and he said it was a security lock. Honestly I would have gotten a concussion if it fell on me.   Finally a bunch of the elevators broke so there was only one working elevator on the sonder side the first week. That was really bad and very dangerous. The air does not circulate at all in the elevator. It felt very unsafe to be in there.   Overall would not recommend. The first week was really awful. Nothing off happened for the remaining three weeks but it was just so bad I would not do it again.   I also just feel like sonder must not be doing well financially during this time and they are underinvesting in support staff. You’ll likely have to wait 2 business days for any questions.

place was just as advertised. kinda like a hotel but having four beds was awesome. My three teens each had their own bed. location was perfect. we walked to times square and it was not scary walking home after the Broadway play. loved being next to the 42nd street terminal. so easy to pop on the subway. Pizza place and coffee place across the street were tasty and two grocery places right below us. Walking up three flights of stairs at the end of the night was rough but made us feel like New Yorkers lol. Marco was a huge help getting our luggage up and communication was great. Thanks again for a great stay!

Very clean area and very central as well. I was scared about parking but I was always able to find parking infront of the house. Alonzo was a great host. I will definitely look for this location when I want to head back to NYC.

We arrived after 12 hours of intense flight with 3 children including 2 years old. We were hoping to get a nice apartment but unfortunately it was the opposite! Stairs are very scared, mattress is so uncomfortable with air inside (the air comes out during the night), we had a cold in the apartment because the heating did not work continuously, in most of the apartment you should bend your head because the roof is so low. Besides, we left the apartment clean and Alonso intentionally soiled it to aggravate the situation that would look as if in the photos against us. Alonso promised to give us all money back and say to us that we have his word but he did not. We had a very bad experience! And we want everyone to get their money back! And do not recommend coming to this apartment. 😒

The apartment was exactly what we expected. It was really worth the price and quite convenient. It is also located very central in Manhattan and just a few steps away from Times Square. So very suitable for young people. BUT the neighborhood was a bit frightening. Many homeless people, stores for cannabis etc. quite near to the entrance. It always made us feel a bit uncomfortable when we arrived in the evening or in the night.

Omg where do I start?! I stayed here for 2 weeks and this place was a terrible experience. This is the most rude, disrespectful and borderline dangerous host I have ever come across in my many years of being an Airbnb guest. The host responds quickly when you're a potential guest but once you book, he takes  4-5 days to answer. When I arrived, there were no instructions. On the first day of my stay my bedroom door got locked and he refused to give me the key to it stating that if I lost the key it would be expensive to replace! My roommate and I spent hours trying to unlock the door until we finally did, and the host later told me that if I couldn't unlock it, I would have had to pay for the locksmith! A few days later, he insisted he wanted to bring potential guests to see my room and when I refused he got angry and asked me to leave. I had to contat airbnb and tell them what was going on and that I didnt have any other place to go to. Even after I refused to have guests visit my room while I was renting it, he sent people over to knock on my door late at night asking me to see the room! And since I didnt have the key to my room, I couldn't lock it when I was away so I didnt feel safe at all.   If you re looking to stay in NYC and want to feel safe and welcome, steer clear of this place, there are so many better options I wish I picked instead of having to go through this horrible experience.

Super cute place. My wife and I explored the area and had a comfortable place to land each night.  The host was communicative, and very helpful with any questions!  We loved the art, the charm, the quirks and all.. a creative space right in the middle of a hot spot. Expect nightlife/noise, lights, sirens. It’s NYC not a zen garden. It felt authentic and we had a blast!  We were a little worried about feeling safe, but the area was honestly fine. We never once felt unsafe, just paid attention to our surroundings and anyone outside just minded their business as we did. Thanks!!   Tip-the bagel place at the end of the street is perfect for a quick bite in the morning and make great cappuccinos.

A cosy, comfortable apartment in a vibrant neighbourhood. Its close proximity to multiple subway lines, and being a very walkable neighbourhood made getting around to explore New York easy. Anna and Michael's clear and detailed communication made everything about our stay stress free, and check in and check out was simple. We look forward to staying again!
this house was too perfect price is a steal! i didn’t want to leave

Location is close to Time square and other attractions.  Be careful at night because the surrounding area is a bit sketchy and shady people. Space is only adequate for a single person. Luggage for a few days can fit in closet but very limited. Bed is firm and bedroom gets hot. Window looks  out to a fire escape ladder and loud pigeons to wake you in the morning.  If you plan on dropping your stuff off and returning late at night intoxicated to sleep then this place works out.

Great host, nice condo, bed is very comfortable memory foam. I only had one problem that was not the host's fault. The next door neighbor saw me coming in the building and apartment and rudely interrogated me whether I was living there or just Airbnbing. I regret that I had to answer him rudely, but it's very disrespectful for a grown man to ask another grown man about his business in a private residence. He said he's been living there 30 years, so I'm guessing he knows who lives there, and he saw that I had a key, there was nothing suspicious about me being there. I'll leave it to your imagination to figure out why he was checking me like that. But this was not the host's fault, 5 stars, very friendly and welcoming and accommodating. I only mention the incident with a neighbor so future guests know to be aware.

The host is quick to respond and checkin with lockbox very easy. Location OK - near Clinton Hill, near a Key Foods and 7 mins from subway.  Cons: The door to the outside patio would not lock, which made us feel unsafe. The bed upstairs was very squeaky so it woke me up whenever my boyfriend turned during the night and mattress was not that comfortable (I’m a light sleeper) plus the neighbors were having a party Friday night which was loud.  For a couple days, for an affordable stay in NYC, this is a fine option.
Sophia was a friendly host, who was accommodating (allowed us to leave our luggage in the apartment when we went out because of a very late flight in the evening) Quiet location

Would not describe this as "Brooklyn's finest" or "luxury." The pictures in the listing were clearly taken the very first day this was listed however long ago. I booked this apartment for a long weekend as we were attending a wedding at the Brooklyn Grange. The good: This apartment was in a great location, had good outdoor space, and Curtis was very responsive when I contacted him about multiple issues. The bad: it was not what I would call clean. I don't expect to eat off the floors, but the whole apt/terrace could use some TLC and refreshing (deep clean, replace stained rug/furniture, coat of paint, properly screw in hooks/etc.)   The biggest issue by far though was lack of working showers. I understand from Curtis that it was a building-wide issue, which was out of his control. Thank God the sinks & toilets worked, but we were unable to shower before the wedding we were there to attend - luckily I had brought wet wipes and had to use those as an alternative. Due to the busy nature of the weekend (rehearsal dinner, other events) we had no time to figure out another option for showering so we made it work. We boiled water to use as a makeshift "bath" like we were on The Oregon Trail. At least there was no dysentary to deal with. Curtis let me know on Sunday (we checked in Friday) that the showers should be operational. Only the 1st floor bathroom shower managed to work, and I use that term loosely. The water pressure was super low, and it never got beyond lukewarm. And the ENTIRE time the shower was on, the pipes literally screamed. The noise alternated between sounding like a tornado siren and like I was summoning a demon. The upstairs shower never got enough water pressure beyond a trickle. Curtis was very responsive, and did give us a discount for the inconvenience (although it was less than a full night's cost, despite not having a working shower for basically the entire stay.)  Starting from the top: the couple we stayed with called the upstairs bed "the taco" - it was super soft and dipped when they layed on it. The curtains in the room were also about 6 inches short of the bottom of the window, meaning the room got bright as hell as soon as the sun came up. One of the lamps mounted on the wall was broken. They also said the sheets smelled of B.O. When I asked about additional linens, I was told there was a tub in the closet with linens. The tub had a cracked/half lid, and contained 1 fitted sheet and 1 blanket that appeared not to be clean as it had human hair on it & looked dingy.  The 1st floor bedroom: curtains were longer but in bad shape. The bed was relatively firm/comfortable though. The A/C unit was... cantankerous. When the fan was on it was fine, but if the A/C kicked in it sounded like a freight train. The bedroom door also did not lock. We were all provided with a total of 4 body towels, 2 hand towels and 1 washcloth. When I asked about more washcloths, Curtis said they stopped providing them b/c people either didn't use them or stole them. It would have been nice to have a complete set of towels per person, and maybe some extras on hand. My husband used a clean pair of boxers as his "washcloth" when he had to bathe in the sink before the wedding.   The kitchen and main room were laid out well, functional. The fridge could use some stainless steel cleaner (idk why there were so many scratches on it?? Perhaps racoons got in through the terrace door, which did not lock.) The rug should absolutely be replaced. The hanging shelf for the TV accessories was doing just that - hanging by a thread, and super scuffed up.   The terrace space was nice in that it was nice to have outdoor space. But the furniture was clearly worn (I get it, it's outside - but all the more reason to update/clean frequently) and there was just a lot of junk out there (mop heads, brooms, random dirty cleaning equipment behind the couches - a bin of something on the terrace, some trash left by previous guests I assume...just very cluttered.) The terrace door DID NOT lock. I told Curtis this and he assured me that it did lock and told me how to lock it. As the person who was actually there & tested it extensively, I can assure you that it does not lock. You don't have to be a NASA engineer to understand how door locks work. We found the terrace door opened randomly if you didn't shut it hard enough.   Check in was quick & easy, but only one key is provided for the unit. Would be nice to have at least 2, especially when travel with another couple so you don't have to do logistical acrobatics to figure out who has the key, who will be home when if you want to do separate things.   I suspect Curtis will respond to this review (as I have seen him do on other reviews that are less than positive.) Hopefully instead of being defensive he will take some very easy, minor steps to make this apartment & the overall experience great, because it truly has a ton of potential.

Room is smaller than expected, the AC in the room is so loud and we were told we cannot open the window in the room.   Also I believe there was some miscommunication during the stay, but unfortunately they weren’t nicely addressed or resolved.   Overall, it’s below my expectation, and the location can get sketchy especially in the evening.
Curtis' place was great.  Super clean and organized when I arrived with plenty of space and 2 full bathrooms it was definitely a steal.  Would 100% recommend to friends!

Awesome place at a great price. Since we flew in, it was a great touch to have shampoo/conditioner/body wash available in the shower. I also really liked the location. It had two MTA lines and it worked great, there's even a bodega around the street. I also liked the restaurants available. My girlfriend and I were able to walk around at night and we never felt unsafe. I really liked this place and I'd love to stay there again.

I really enjoyed staying in this apartment for 5 nights. The bed was especially comfortable with clean sheets and that toothbrush/paste and showergels were provided was a big plus.  I was also allowed to use the fridge to store some stuff for my breakfast which was really convenient. Although in was a woman travelling solo I not once felt uncomfortable or unsafe in the neighborhood even at night. Great food options close to the apartment. Also it only takes a couple of minutes to reach one of the near subway stations into the city.

Don’t book here because if there is a national disaster you won’t be refunded any portion of your reservation. Was offered altered dates for an outrageous increase in price. Extremely upset. It’s not right to rob your guests of their reservation money when you have MONTHS to find a new guests. Wouldn’t risk getting a reservation here.
