Home was poorly supplied and the closest subway was a bit unsafe and a 15 minute walk.    We did not take the subway home from Manhattan after dark.

A lovely stay with an ultimate hospitality. Darko is attentive and very kind. Clean rooms, comfortable bed, cozy. It was great communication throughout. Checking in and out was stress free. 10/10 would recommend.
place was nice but felt unsafe due to someone knocking on the window which made my wife terrified.

Phenomenal host! I highly recommend Sage to anyone! So hospitable and caring. The cats were so adorable and you barely knew they were there. The apartment is super close to the L and M train which leads straight to all of the action of the city. There were good food options and stores for any need within walking distance. I can’t stress enough how perfect this experience was.

One of my staff members was staying here while in NY on business. We chose it because it was advertised as female only and it seemed like a safe option. The room was extremely hot with no way of adjusting the thermostat and when asked the host said to open the window, despite being on the ground floor. Additionally the other guests did have there boyfriends in the space which added to it feeling unsafe.

David was a great communicator. Responded quick and was always willing to help out. Only issue was a door handle was missing on one of the doors leading into the bedroom which made me feel a bit unsafe and there was no central air. The air conditioners didn’t do that great of a job but there was a big fan that helped.
Do not rent from this host, the rooms are not full 4 walled actual dry walls and the places aren't cleanly.  What u see vs the profile is night and day. I qas6 scammed twice.

I had such a great time with my fiancé at Nita and ekas place. First I want to say the location was perfect something happen with our phones and there was a t- mobile store down the street also it was very convenient to be near cvs and ride aid and we had breakfast across the street at denny and there soo much more restaurants and stores and pharmacies walking distance. I loved the decor of there place as well and they had snack and drinks available that was a plus because I didn’t have time to stop anywhere when traveling in town. The backyard was soooo peaceful and well decorated and had a area with shade as well. The only thing theres was only a tv in the bedroom but that was okay for me. Overall an amazing small cozy place to stay and very clean and amazing decor

Did not answer messages about check in. I had to call air bnb myself to determine whether this was a scam. Air bnb cancelled this a few hours before my flight took off. Super disappointed, had to find another place myself last minite
Located in one of the top 3 most dangerous neighborhoods in the Bronx...to the point where I had to take an Uber to the corner store for my safety. Book with caution!

It was a good experience overall. Eynat was super nice with us, always replying real quick , and we had some flexibility in the check-in and check-out times. The location is good, but not the best. It takes around 10-15 minutes walking to any metro station, but we loved the neighborhood and we did not feel unsafe at any time. There is some room to improve in the cooling system and the windows, sometimes the cold wind kind of blows into the house. The heating system worked well and compensated it, though.

I booked two nights and didn’t not stay the second night because I don’t feel safe staying there. I heard very loud noises during midnight In the living room. The apartment is located in a dangerous area. The room is very small and the blanket is dirty. Check in is easy, communication is nice.

The place is adequate, you can rest well. It is steps from the subway and supermarket where you can stock up. There is no kitchen, but there is a microwave. The area is not the best of all, but in the 13 days I was there I did not see anything dangerous. I think I would go there again if I returned to New York.

Great location but that's about it.  had to contend with roaches, drunk and unruly neighbors, loss of heat, and having packages stolen. I've stayed in a lot in the airbnbs in New York and never had this many problems.

Guys, please rethink about it, if you wanna book this place. First of all the host was very rude. She didn’t even let us use the restroom properly, if you are in the restroom she will just come and start knocking on the door, which is very annoying. Also she asked us to leave the place and she never gave our money back for the days, we didn’t lived there. Also the area is very unsafe. And she also lied to Airbnb and refused to give our money back. I will just say one thing, very unprofessional host, will never go back there. I had a really bad experience.

Don’t expect everything that is written in the ad for the room, 43 amenities of which many are not available. No towels, room lock doesn’t work, the room looks similar but is not pictured, the AC is competely moldy and the area is not safe. If you apply the « free parking on premises » filter this house pops up but it doesn’t have free parking on premesis and despite plenty of space for 3 cars inthe driveway and 1 standing there they won’t let you park in the driveway. Most of Rockaway is a shithole, this street is OKish but surrounded by a neighborhood where I wouldn’t walk on the streets at night. If you come after dark don’t expect to have any lights on the porch to read the house number! Even the direct neighbors who I met on the street didn’t know where the house was, that sort of neighborhood! Very rude host, no english communication you have to hit the translate button to fit out what the spanish text she sends you, actually means! Really? Yes! My husband ended up sleeping in our campervan, afraid that someone would steal our surfboards etc. on the roofracks. The shower cold/hot is switched around, btw. in case you intend to stay here. It is not beachfront nor  lake access another mistruth in the ad. Plenty of other nice accommodation for that price in NYC.  The room was Ok the bathroom aswell. I should have scrolled down further in the reviews before booking this place.
They show the location is near to JFk airport, however it was very far. For cancellation they just send 15$ out of 71. Scammers Just cheating the travellers.  Totally unfair

I stayed in Heidi space for 7 days Everything was great. Heidi left a lot of convenience items available (in the kitchen - rice, pasta, seasoning, etc.) and in the bathroom (hygiene stuff), that make my stay more convenient. The place was clean, the bed was confortable and the shower is very good. The pictures of the place are precise, just like the place is shown . The neighborhood is good, I didn't felt unsafe walking around, even when I came back later at night.  In the parallel street, you will find some restaurants, place for breakfast, supermarkets or Dellis, and laundry service. Heidi answered quickly to all my call and concerns about the place, so everything was Amazing.
don't be afraid to come, nice neighborhood near hospital, train station etc..

We consider ourselves lucky to have found Gigi and Daniel’s space. We needed a place to stay quickly as our home was under renovation and the work was put on pause due to the COVID19 outbreak in NYS. As Gigi and Daniel’s FIRST guest, they worked with us and got in quick and smoothly. The stress free and smooth process made me feel safe, which was my top priority as I moved in 7 months pregnant and with a young child. Not only did we have a lovely host but a space with lots of new amenities such as the bathroom, bright lighting, bedding and comfortable furnishings. We would absolutely recommend the space to our friends and family, when they come to visit us again, which we hope is soon!

The stay was overall nice. The owner lived ont he uostairs level and was very responsive. Late at night we could hear the owners upstairs walking around and talking so not great insulation between floors, but it didn't keep us awake. There was no vent for a/c in the back bedroom so we just kept the door open so my son wasn't hot. Beds and linens were clean and water was hot. We never had any issues finding parking nearby. It was close to a lot of things, such as a bagel store and drug store.

The home was very nice. All essentials were provided.  The kitchen was well stocked.  There was plenty of hot water.  The home is in a very nice neighborhood.  Our only complaint would be the noise from upstairs.  We could hear people talking, walking and chairs being drug across the floor.

Vilma was  amazing,she is such a sweetheart 🌺 we had a great time in her place. She took care of every detail so we would feel as if we were at home. The house is located very near to the Subway station and you can find Delis or Bodegas around. The neighborhood isn't dangerous at all, we could return very late and leave very early to get the train to go to Manhattan.
It’s an affordable motel not too far from the airport and at about 15 min walk from the train station.  Can get a little sketchy at night so I wouldn’t advise for long stays.

It was good for me to stay at this apartment. It was very clean and comfortable, I really like its design.   But there were some unpleasant things. It was cold in the apartment. Fireplace is really a good decision but it helped in living room, not in bedroom.  Also I didn’t like the area, it was very far away from Manhattan (more than an hour).  But I understand that it was my mistake, I should check the map before booking.  All the rest was good)

Great spacious place in Brooklyn. Never felt unsafe & was a close walk to the a train. Also had a laundry unit that was a plus. Kinda far from night life. It was about 45-55 hour train ride into manhattan.   Everything was as described and clean. Only concern was that u can’t fully lock your belongings in your space away from other tenants. But other than that was a great stay

I stayed at the location for around two months and a half. I would like to reiterate some of the other points people have made in other reviews.  - I chose to rent because of how close it was located to work but besides that, it was a rip-off. I am originally from NYC and have family in Queens. The payments ended up being $3900 a month with a $160+ for electricity a month. My full-time coworkers clowned me for paying so much for such a small studio (my guess is 300-400 square feet) in a non luxury building. The description does not mention paying additional for electricity but once you book, it states so in the policies.  - The apartment had mice and the exterminators were requested a few times. The mice issue kept persisting and the free exterminator service was not that helpful unfortunately. My roommate and I were awoken by mice scrampering through random bags of just trash with no food at 2-5AM consistently.  - The apartment was not that clean to begin with but I wiped down surfaces and did a deep clean once I moved in with my roommate. There was dust everywhere, stained bathtub, mold in the window AC unit, and more. - I am a really responsible person and I paid rent every single time (on the day it was due). There was an issue where I had scheduled payment with my apple card and on the day of payment around 8AM, it marked the transaction as suspicious. It asked me to verify that I approved and then instructed me to retry payment where this time, it would go through. I did so and it went through the day it was scheduled so I addressed the issue within a couple hours (by noon of the payment due date). Everything on my end on airbnb account, my apple card, and my bank showed that they payment went though and I had receipts to prove it. Yet, the property manager and the airbnb host asked me several times to address the issue. I responded and told both what happened and that it went through and yet, they acted as if it did not and it was my responsibility to repay or speak to airbnb support. I did so and they immediately apologized and stated that I had done everything right and the payment went through before noon the day it was due. They should have simply gone to airbnb and addressed the issue on their end. I work over 75 hours a week and it was stressful for me to find time to sort it out.  - Laundry was expensive and in the basement. There are only like 3 machines for washing and drying each for the whole building. The hallways and elevators are not air conditioned and are surprisingly stuffy during the summer. - Amazing location for being close to bars and restaurants. Also as promised, close to Times Square and Columbus Circle.  - Overall decent living quarters but was more appropriate for a lower price tag given that it wasn't amazing.

I really enjoyed my stay here, easy commute, good amenities, and felt safe. My biggest complaint is about the communication. VERY difficult to book. She had a few other listings posted that were cheaper and bigger,  but she denied me for invalid reasons. One of them being that she wanted a tenet starting at the beginning of the month rather than the middle. The 2nd  was due to dates listed as available, but when I went to book she said the dates were not.  Leaving me with this location as my only option. When I asked if she could offer this location at the same rate. she DID NOT respond at all! I was very disappointed about this especially since the reason for denial was not reasonable. I felt scammed into paying more.  I also extend my stay and, when I asked for a discount she AGAIN DID NOT respond! I hate that this happened because else wise I had a great experience. She would only respond at her own convince. I am not sure if I would recommend renting from her due to this.

A lovely albeit brief stay!! Very tidy and spacious with considerate amenities. And I cannot stress this enough- the most perfect location in the neighborhood. I lived blocks away for a decade and wouldn’t rather be anywhere else. A true gem and value and I look forward to coming back. Mahalo nui loa, Noralyn

We arrived at 11am got lunch in the city and was allowed to check in early! We got to the house at 2 but the incorrect key was there and we weren’t able to get in the room, the host denied it at first until I showed him a video of the key not working and then came by with the correct key 30-45 minutes later (traffic, not his fault there’s traffic) but we ended up checking in about an hour late which was a bit inconvenient. The host told us about a really popular parade that was  happening the weekend we stayed but our bus was leaving right before it began so we missed out on that.  We didn’t drive so we did not utilize parking but you are going to have to look for street parking.  The house is exactly what’s in the pictures, they provided complementary snacks, water bottles, mask and hand sanitizer! There are plenty of rags , towels, & personal toiletries for your use, and it smelled amazing! The shower, toilet and skin were spotless! I did see a roach twice (dead roach now) The neighborhood is safe, however, it’s New York, so be aware of your surroundings at all times. (I am from here so take that with a grain of salt)   We took the metro to Manhattan (43-50) minutes, the metro station was 8-10 minute walk from the house. There’s a guy down there who will open the gate for you, ask for food in return and tell you about his pet snake. (Say thanks, give him some change, and keep your distance)  Our last night the fire alarm battery was chirping but we quickly became use to it and we were also exhausted from going out so nothing could truly disturbed our sleep that night.  Advice: Take the trash out before you leave, place dirty towels in the laundry bag, don’t steal all the mask!   TL:DR Check in was okay, check out was fine. Safe neighborhood, lots to do in the area.  Clean, house smelled good, saw 2 roaches. Host was very kind overall. Fire alarm chirped the last night. Finding street parking may be difficult. Really good Thai food restaurant down the street. I do wish the price was a bit cheaper but we all have to make a living. I would stay here again.   I hope this review helps you make the right decision!

A convenient space.  #1 Train  is 2 blocks away and A train like 4 blocks away, if you are not familiar with NYC, neighborhood could be scary at first  but it is fine. Shops/restaurants nearby. Be aware that there is no elevator so you must climb stairs  up to 3rd floor.

The bad: My husband and I arrived at the house around 6pm. At this point we had been trying to contact Natalia for almost 2 hours. We arrived with no access information. After calling, texting and emailing for hours and still no answer, I finally contacted Airbnb. They simply said all they could do is try to get ahold of the host (which I had been doing). A supervisor was supposed to get back with me in 15- 20 minutes which did not happen. An hour later I called Airbnb again only to be told there’s nothing they can do but try to get ahold of the host. After being on hold for a while with no real help we hung up. A few minutes after that I was notified that my reservation had been canceled!! It’s now around 9pm we had traveled to a Walmart in Brooklyn, NY. We were In NYC at 9pm at night, no knowledge of the city, with no place to stay. We made our way to a Five Guys (who were so nice by the way) and tried to figure out what to do. Airbnb were sending us suggestions (and offering a 10% discount🙄) but we needed a place for 7 people which isn’t easy to find. Finally at 9:30pm Natalia’s husband called to offer our original reservation back. He did apologize but also made excuses and somehow made it our fault by not banging on the basement apartment doors. Long story short, we ended up taking their offer along with the $50 discount they offered (which covered the $50 in tolls we had to pay while driving around in NYC).  The okay: The house itself was nice. The best one on the block. The bus driver, however, didn’t like the idea of letting us off on certain stops. I didn’t necessarily feel unsafe but I wouldn’t choose to stay in this area again. The house is big, the bedrooms are a little awkward and the only view is out of the enclosed porch they currently use as a storage room.

The house was not clean. It looks clean in the pictures because it is tidy. But everything was dirty from the floors, rugs, shower, to the light switches. There was dust on everything from the oven hood to the banister. Overall, the house does not meet covid cleaning standards and needs a thorough cleaning.  Also, the neighborhood is not safe. Multiple people who work or live in this area of Stanton Island advised us to leave and stay in the City because it is safer. They were not wrong. So be cautious/prepared about reserving a stay here.  Overall, we could not recommend a stay here between of the uncleanness of the house and it's unsafe location.

Better off staying at a motel. Do not stay at this place. Literally smelled like gas (not initially there when we checked in) and cat piss (in the bathroom), the  fridge does not work, rooms are small (besides the master) and you can’t keep the fan on in the upstairs  room without turning off the light (have fun with no ventilation).  After checking in and dropping off our belongings my family members and I came back 9 hours later. The fridge doesn’t work so my aunt diabetes medicine went bad. The downstairs bathroom was dirty and smelled like cat piss to which we had to spray it with Lysol.  We ended up leaving the same night at 2AM and stayed at a hotel for the rest of our trip. Requested a refund and because the host says these complaints aren’t true no refund so basically letting them steal my money. Air BnB was not helpful in this situation and literally did not get it taken care of until I was back home. I def won’t ever come back here nor will I be using Air BnB again in the future.

We stayed with 6 people for 7 days  Starting off with the negatives,  The neighborhood was really quite sketchy to put it nicely. Our group understood being in the city meant we ran the risk of encountering some uneasy situations but the area really did not feel very safe or very welcoming to tourists.  The next main issue was one of our party woke up one morning to ants everywhere in their bedroom, it also should be stated that there was absolutely no food in that room during the entire 7 day trip so as to where the ants came from we do not know. That leads into the last main issue we ran into which was mainly just all around cleanliness of the place. The floors desperately needed a deep clean as we all would end up with black feet after walking barefoot for just a few minuets in the BnB. Beyond the floors, the AC units could have used a bit of a cleaning out too though they were manageable.   Now onto the positives.  The home itself was very pretty and the view of Manhattan was amazing and will forever be a fond memory of mine.  Additionally there was more than enough space for everyone in our group of 6 to stay comfortably.  The distance to the Train Line leading to the ferry was really close to the home and getting into Manhattan was hardly an issue. The on site parking, while a bit tight at first, was such a godsend and was so very helpful not having to stress about street parking. Additionally the AC units were quite effective at keeping the place at a comfortable temperature for the entirety of our stay, even with turning them off each day before leaving for our daily plans, the AC units were fast and reliable at cooking us down after getting back.  One final REALLY great thing was Sergey leaving us a binder with PHENOMINAL information about basically anything we would need assistance with. As a host Sergey was outstanding and very helpful with any issues we had while staying as well as being very attentive leading up to our arrival ensuring we had everything we needed to make sure check in was smooth and effortless.

If you expect everything to be just right this is not the place for you. Some things might not work, some of the furniture is pretty tired, but that's not the point here. It's HUGE and quirky. You could pay more for a hotel room the size of the bathroom in Manhattan. You can sit on the balcony in the eve with views over Manhattan. It is brilliant for a game of hide and seek. The street feels safe, but the area beyond may be a bit sketchy. It's a short drive to the ferry terminal making for a lovely journey in and out of the city. There are also nice things to do nearby.

Although touted as a 3.5 bedroom accommodation that sleeps 10, I would consider this to be 2.5 bedroom maximum. The master bedroom is great and the second bedroom with a queen bed would be the only other bedroom that has the space to fit a couple more adults. The third bedroom is solely for kids as the bunk bed could not hold grown adults. The "solarium" is counted as an additional bedroom but was a sauna due to the heat, with no air conditioning. The inside air conditioning is exhausted to the solarium.  Neighbourhood is nice but can be a bit sketchy at night. If walking home from the subway at night, bring a friend.  For the price, the location, communication and backyard was spot on. But paying this amount I'm left wanting a bit more.  P.S. The strong smell of marijuana in the master ensuite and entranceway did not help.

We were 5 guys headed to NYC for a couple of baseball games. We wanted to experience the REAL city. A hotel can not provide the “life in the city” feel. This place does. It’s but a 20 min walk to the Bronx -Yankee Stadium.  We never felt uneasy or unsafe anywhere we walked, and we walked to about every destination.  The accommodations are unique too. There is even a large old sugar maple out back.  Everything worked as it should and we have no regrets whatsoever. Convenient to food and grocery too! Thank you ladies!

The space was open and nice, especially for large groups of people. Owners were responsive to any issues, which was great. Unfortunately, the house was a little grimy (floors and woodwork were very dirty) and reeked of marijuana, which was unpleasant. It would be nice if the basement bathroom had a towel rack (there was nowhere to hang even a hand towel). Small touches like adding a towel rack, cleaning the place more thoroughly in between guests, etc., would go a long way towards making the space feel more pleasant and geared towards the needs of guests. Also, the toaster on the first floor had broken coils, did not function properly, and was definitely a fire hazard. In summary, a lot of small oversights added up and made it less than.

Very clean place and spacious... perfect if your from Newyork... close to the subways which is perfect for going to the city... check in process was quick... only thing is in order to let your self in you have to use a key that opens a gate which was sort of scary because it's very dark outside in the back. If host had better lighting it would only make the  place absolutely perfect!!! Other than that my stay was excellent!

I am so happy we chose this apartment. We arrived to NYC much earlier than expected and the host allowed us to check in early. The apartment is modern and super clean. I can't stress how clean it is (that's important to me) especially the bathroom. The shower head is pretty awesome. Kind of felt like a spa. I felt very comfortable and at home here. I will definitely stay again.
Great location but if you have lots of luggage the stairs are a lot, very steep, not recommended for elderly, afraid of heights or out of condition.

May & Sofia's place was a great home base for our group of 8 to work our way through the city from.  We found the area to be safe with the normal characters in any neighborhood present, but never felt in danger.  The subway access was perfect for travel into the city.  There were no major complaints from our group other than the lack of a few basic amenities (bottled water, extra towels, shampoo/conditioner/soap).  Two of the couples in our group flew in on the red eye and because no one was staying in the apartment they were kind enough to let us arrive early to drop our luggage and sit for a minute before hitting the town and that was so generous.  The parking on the street is great if you can find a spot, otherwise the parking garages we found within any type of walking distance started at $35 for every 24 hours so keep that in mind.  On the whole we were satisfied with the apartment and it worked well for our group.

We enjoyed our time in NYC. There was a small problem getting into the building initially, but Bill was quick to remedy the problem. The apartment is as represented in the ad. Our family of six had plenty of space. There were plenty of closets and hangers, but no drawers.  The cleanliness was an issue when we arrived. I was told that the cleaning lady didn't have time to finish because the group before us had left quite a mess.  The floors were really dirty and the apartment was dusty. Luckily, I had some clorox wipes with me so I could clean a little. I never found a broom or mop, so we had to wear shoes the whole time. There was also a dishwasher full of dirty dishes that we had to clean, but the dishwasher soap was provided.   The apartment is close to Subway access and we were able to get everywhere we needed to go. It is about a 25 minute Subway ride into the city, so keep that in mind. It didn't bother us at all. The neighborhood seems ok, we never really felt unsafe, but I wouldn't walk around alone there.   Overall, it met our needs for our stay and we were grateful for the opportunity to be together as a family!

It’s an attic room. During my stay, it rained and got colder. The room was super cold.  Nadya was out of the town, but tried to respond well and quickly. People in her house are nice. There are tow dogs, they barked  too much so I scared at first. But they are nice.

We spend a weekend (2 nights) at Young's place. There are some pros and cons to the place: Pros:  -easy access to both C and M/J subway lines which is nice with direct access to Manhattan, Brooklyn bridge, etc -very clean.  -young was pretty reactive by text and very accommodating to our late check out  Cons: - pretty sketchy neighborhood, this is not the pretty Brooklyn you think of -there are roach traps all over the place. We did. It see any bug aside fro spiders and fruit flies but that doesn't make you feel good.  -All bed room are SUPER SMALL, barely the size of the bed. You can tell the place is minimal and clearly designed for AirBnB rentals. Not hommy at all.  -we thought this was too pricy for what you get.

Young & Sutton were very accommodating to me and to my  guests. Sutton was around when we needed him..from wash rags to scissors he accommodated us ...he even took our garbage out once! Apartment looks exactly like the pics the beds were super comfortable. Bathroom was clean and overall was the whole apartment. Cleaning supplies were very accommodating for our 3 day stay. Tattoo shop & convenience store across the street lots of quick food spots a few blocks up. The neighborhood is nothing dangerous . Alot of ppl hang out outside the tattoo shop at night drinking n conversing so walking through a crowd of ppl just to get around can be  awkward. I used Uber & lyft for my transportation. A/C in 3 rooms were a perfect add on. I would recommend.

She was very quick to reply and provide us information in time. Rooms were nice and clean but i can easily hear my neighbours. Area was nice but around 20 min walk from metro. Lots of rules inside the house which was bit odd but nothing to be scared off if you are travelling alone.

Overall, our stay was disgusting!   Here is why:  APARTMENT - Overall poor cleanliness, seemed like the apartment was lazily whipped down and not cleaned properly  - Roaches appeared in the apartment multiple times  - Dirty floors throughout the apartment with an accumulation of dirt underneath beds and food crumbs by fridge and garbage. -There were expired baked goods left on the dining room table. - One room did not have an air conditioner and wasn't noted in the house description -Hallway to apartment had a foul, mildew smell. The apartment itself was not properly prepped/cleaned and had a stale odor   SAFETY - Malfunctioning apartment door lock - Concern for safety, landlord hinted to possible floating keys to the apartment from multiple past guests who did not return keys and the landlord has not changed locks -Landlord’s Son appeared and asked to come inside apartment, which came off very suspicious. Luckily, we were leaving within the next hour. -Not the greatest neighborhood in New York

The accommodation is 100 percent according to the description, what we value most is that the communication with Young is 100 percent effective and fast, even though we did not meet him there was always a person who helped us with different things. There are 4 comfortable rooms for a large traveling group. We recommend not walking around the streets of this area too late on weekends as it can be a bit dangerous and the police are always around.

Serra's apartment is neither large nor luxurious but very charming, well appointed and very clean. It is ideal for a stay of 4 - couple and 2 teenagers. The location is great, one subway station from Manhattan, in a very lively neighborhood - shops, restaurants... The street is quiet, no problem falling asleep! Serra was contactable in advance and on the same day of our arrival.  She had planned for us to be welcomed by a friend of hers who waited for us, despite our delay. The only small problem was the lack of hot water one evening, we were afraid that the shower was broken... but it was resolved the next morning. We really enjoyed our stay in Brooklyn and we plan to come back to Serra next time!

We arrived to the apt and saw mold at the bathroom ceiling and the toilet didn’t flash well so we called the host to inform her gently about the problem and her response was that she immediately started yelling at us to leave the apt right away in the middle of the night and didn’t even let us speak. Other attempts to communicate with her got the same response - yelling and screaming at us. It was impossible to communicate with her. She didn’t apologize at all and was extremely aggressive and unpleasant. It is not my first time using Airbnb but it was the first time I encounter such a difference between what was published in the website and what was in reality, especially the fact that the entire place was dirty. There were water stains all over the apt and mold in the bathroom and the behavior and response of the host Totally shocked me. I wouldn’t recommend this apt to anyone. We spent a lot of money on taxis back and forth and on international calls with Airbnb and also we spent a lot of expensive time of our vacation and energy for our calls and for finding another place to stay.

My family and I had to travel to Brooklyn on a very sad, sad note.  My brother's passing. Carmen and Rob help made it a little better by helping us with our accommodation.  We arrive very early that morning and they allowed us to check in early.  Everything was clean, nice and comfortable. It was like a home away from home.  We were able to relax, sit, talk and remember the fun times we had with our brother. The neighborhood was close to grocery stores as well as Kings Plaza shopping mall which helped a lot.  My family really liked it there and we hope in our future visit to Brooklyn (on a happier note) we can stay there again.  Thank you Carmen and Rob, maybe next time we can get to meet you personally.  God bless you.  Nadine Shively and Family

Peggy was great! She responded promptly and solved any issue that came up which wasn’t many as the stay was amazing. She always brought us fresh towels and sheets and the place was always clean and tidy. A great value for its proximity to the subway (a short 5 minute walk) and it’s a short ride into Manhattan with no transfers needed to get to Madison square. There is a Amazing Thai food place on the same block that you can get lunch at (appetizer and all) for about 10$ which is a steal in this city. AND it’s a very classy place which makes for a great evening. It’s also super close to 7-11 and other local quick marts. Don’t pass this one up, it’s the best you’re gonna find for these affordable prices! Thanks for an awesome stay, Peggy!

the cleanliness of the house is not the best, the house in general has an unpleasant smell, the television did not work for me, if you are going to be there for a long time you will not have a closet to organize clothes, anyway , you can not expect much  for the price you paid.

The room wasn’t huge but more than enough for a week! The TV is huge and the toilet was always free.  So close to Gates Ave station and a Walgreens, Bushwick is great and I’d definitely stay again.  The only minor downside is the rats on the street - they are HUGE. You will get this anywhere in NYC but honestly scared me twice so noteworthy. This being said, there is nothing the host can do about this and I will be staying in this property again!
There is an unsafe amount of hair and dust coming down two of the heating pipes in the apartment. It’s not properly insulated, and could cause potential health hazards.

Two friends and I stayed here for 11 weeks during the summer. In terms of location/convenient access to the subway, this was a great place to stay. We were about a 3 minute walk from the B/C lines and a 10 minute walk from the 1. The price was also cheaper than many other long-term properties we looked at on Airbnb.   However, part of the reduced price likely relates to the minimalist set-up in the apartment. This is an ugly apartment, for lack of a better word. The furniture is old and looks like it was picked up from various garage sales. There is a clear plastic shower curtain in the one shower and gaps in the moldings that have been stuffed with steel wool. We had issues with water bugs (supposedly a distinct species but they look a lot like cockroaches) when we first moved in and continued to see other creepy crawlies during our stay. The apartment also didn't appear to have been professionally cleaned before we moved in (i.e. Hairs in the shower, duvet covers did not smell clean, floors were dirty when we Swiffered).   These things are mostly cosmetic. If you don't mind roughing it a bit, you'd likely be fine. For my friends and me, this was mostly a place to sleep and shower and I thought it served that purpose. Also, the free laundry in the building was a nice perk.   Amy, the owner, was responsive when we contacted her with various issues. The issues may not have always been addressed as directly as we may have liked but I never felt like Amy was trying to duck my emails. For instance, my one roommate had an old AC unit in her room that wasn't working. When she contacted Amy about it, they installed another AC unit, which also wasn't new. The replacement unit also had to be repaired once following that but eventually was working.  In sum, our experience here very much felt like the owner was looking for the cheapest way possible to make this place habitable. If you can handle living with the bare essentials and are looking for a relatively cheap place to stay in Manhattan that is centrally located, I'd recommend this property.

the apartment is lovely, full of character and clean. the cat Boone Lou Magoo couldn't be any more friendly. but the door has a very tricky lock and dealing with that forced me to change my plans and gave me unexpected concerns. I would just worry about whether I was going to be able to get in the whole time. they were really nice and responsive, but it was stressful and frustrating. i had to ask for a refund

The accommodation is perfect for spending a few days. It is quite far from the center, but several metro lines are very well located, so you have several options to get to the center. They say the neighborhood is dangerous, but not at all, the people are nice and many speak Spanish, so it's great. The bed is the most comfortable I have ever seen, a 10. It has been an overall pleasant stay. We had problems getting there, because we couldn't find the house, I don't know if because we didn't know the location or what, but Michele waited for us until we arrived. We recommend.

I was verbally attacked and harassed by another guest while Dlb was on the phone with us. Dlb was supposed to have put together a mediation so that we could come to an agreement on the bathroom situation. Instead, I received a call at 12am the night before I had an interview. Dlb put the other guest on 3 way where she cussed me out, and verbally harassed and degraded me. Dlb did not mediate the situation properly and that should have never happened. This guest also stole our wipes.

It's a great experience to stay at Jervia's place. He's very communicative and tells you a lot about places you can visit or things you can do. He also know's a lot about politics and sports and it's nice to listen to him. I slept on a pull-out sofa and was provided with everything I needed. The only thing you have to keep in mind is privacy. The sofa is located in the center of the apartment and there are often some other people sleeping in another room, so you are basically exposed. You also have to prepare the sofa everydad (but that's done within a minute). Also you don't have much space for your luggage, so I basically lived out of my suitcase (altough I was provided a box to put my shirts into). For me it was ok, but if you don't like that, I just tell you. I liked the area and didn't feel unsafe. A supermarket is located around the corner, subway is less than 5 minutes away and it takes you about 30 minutes to get to midtown manhattan (altough I'm not absolutely sure about that, I never checked my watch)

J's place is in the perfect location! It is within walking distance to the bus to Laguardia and the train to Manhattan! The neighborhood is lively and full of energy, I never felt unsafe even late at night...there was always someone out, young and old! It is such a beautiful neighborhood with so much history within view of the balcony and walking distance once you hit the street.   I would strongly recommend and would definitely stay again!

I am very perplexed and dissapointed by my experience this time with the host/hosts. I booked this room coz I ve booked it before, had no major issues and felt it was a safe choice. I was mistaken since the way I was treated was horrendous.  Read full review, although lengthy, for a trip into the Twilight Zone:  Place is super close to the subway, supermarkets and shops. Nice vibe as a neighborhood but one of the dirtiest streets I ve seen in NYC and.I ve stayed around.  The room has no windows so it can get stuffy but the air conditioning helps  Carpet is two different shades *the original, lighter one and patches of a darker colour looking like all the dirt over the years has accumulated there. Btw, it s the same as 5 yrs when I booked this room again. Host said carpet is cleaned but they won t be throwing it our for MINOR stains. I took pics just to show my friends so that I m sure I m not insane. Everyone laughed at the use of the word minor.  Bathroom is clean, common areas could be cleaner, esp since people come in to clean them during your stay.  There s leftover food from previous guests in the apt. in the fridge that noone really seemed to bother take out. So it s just accumulating in the fridge over time *if your guests won t do it, it ultimately is up to you to take care of it*  There is no ONE garbage bin, everyone is made to keep their trash in their own room which I find a bit unsanitary since you basically create small hotbeds for bugs etc to be attracted inside where people sleep and spend most of the time.  The host said that they had to get rid of the bin because noone out of the guests would the trash out. I suggest that whoever comes to clean should do this too.  And now for the horrendous treatment:  At some point during my stay I noticed old, frail spider webs under the cabinet in my room (I can tell fresh from old spider webs as an avid free camper since the age of 4) and mentioned it to the host. Some days later I noticed that they extended all the way to the base of the mirror approximately 10-15cms away, a fact I hadn t noticed before. I started wondering if the room had been swept/cleaned before I got in. Tied with the dirty carpet *which I was telling myself, it s prob old stains that can to go away but I m sure they sweep/clean* I started feeling uncomfortable. I communicated this and let the hosts know that maybe we could discuss some reimbursement since also I thought I was being charged with a cleaning fee.  Next thing I know I get a change in my itinerary which was requested at 1 am to leave by 11 am the same day. Also a message telling me that since we can t really decide how old/new the webs and stains are, the best thing for me would be tonfind something else and I would be refunded the additional nights that I wouldn t spend there. The message also mentioned that a cleaning fee was not charged. I have to note that I had made no mention of possibly wanting to go. This is when the 'minor stains' on the carpet were mentioned. Heather and Nils are charming and available people. They made us feel very welcome and gave us information when we needed it. Regarding accommodation, don't expect great comfort, we are far from it, efforts regarding hygiene and cleanliness would be welcome, but we do not all have the same expectations in this area. Apartment located in a fairly lively area that I would not recommend to people who want to find peace and quiet in the evening after a good day of walking in New York. Located 10 minutes walk from PARKSIDE metro station, a false feeling of insecurity can be felt during the journey but we never had the slightest problem, far from it!!! To conclude, charming and welcoming hosts, apartment with minimum comfort, well located geographically but in a fairly dirty and noisy area, fair price considering what is practiced in New York. Thanks again to Heather and Nils for their availability. Small detail but important

My worst Airbnb experience. Noisy and very unsafe neighbourhood. I was not allowed to go to the basement to do the laundry. There was hair all over the bathroom. Very weird. No restaurants close by. Not enough light in the room. Please avoid at all costs.

Ranny is a fantastic airbnb host who goes above and beyond for his guests. He met  us outside and stopped traffic so he could move his car so we could have his spot. What a guy. He carried our heaviest bag up three flights of stairs to his apartment. He knew we were new to the area so he gave us a VIP tour of Brooklyn in his car, stopping to let us get out and walk down piers  and streets to get the best photos. He checked in with us throughout our stay to make sure we had everything we needed. The room we stayed in had a window AC unit that helped make the room comfortable in the NY heat. He provides towels and coffee in the mornings. On our second day he left us a note saying we were welcome to make breakfast with anything he had in the fridge (eggs, fruit, toast, etc.) The only downfall was the location in Brownsville. We felt safe when we were with Ranny, but by ourselves just walking five minutes to the train station in the daylight was a little sketchy.

Ranny is an excellent host. Transport such as the bus 2 minutes away, the metro 7 minutes away on foot, we were two girls and we never felt unsafe.   The room was clean and with storage and a fridge it was perfect.  The bathroom and toilets are really clean, for the morning everything is perfect coffee and tea orange juice and excellent pecan pies for us. What luck!  Ranny was available and discreet. Despite the language barrier we tried to communicate and they helped us a lot. We recommend this accommodation and this exceptional host. Thank you Ranny for your kindness.

If you're looking into this place you'll notice it's an economical option. There's no compromise in safety, location and ease of access. The main secured hall entry door leads to the bike lanes on 8th street heading uptown and a CitiBike dock is just 5 min walk up the street. Easy place for Uber and Taxi pickup just 10 feet from the door. The roommates were friendly and I didn't have to stress about my own safety nor the surety of my personal belongings. I mostly stayed in the room when at the apartment, had access to a clean bathroom and some space to store food and groceries in the fridge. The kitchen was available for use as well. Jay will def let you know this isn't a 5 star place but you're most welcome to stay if you're aware of that. Other than that it was all gravy, had fun once again in NY. Thanks Jay!

The place was exactly the same as the photos on the listing Juan described. I was amazed by how clean his place was. It takes only 3min to get to the subway stations (A,C and 1). But I rated 4stars because I felt a little bit unsafe in his neighborhood... But overall I enjoyed my trip staying at Juan's place!

Jocelyne’s place was absolutely amazing. My husband and I had to move into an Airbnb on an urgent basis. We had initially gone to a scam Airbnb and Jocelyne was amazing enough to provide her space within 5 hours notice. She was an angel in disguise when it came to helping us out during one of our most troubled times. Her house is absolutely beautiful and has all the amenities required to have an amazing stay. The back deck was amazing for us to go out and have wine on a perfect night. I cannot praise Jocelyne and her hospitality enough. She is amazing. Don’t think twice and book your stay when you visit NY with your family.

Juan is a great host and he made my stay very comfortable. The flat is spotlessly clean and the roon has a large TV. Don't be put off by the landing and stairs in the building. They are not very clean but the flat is spotless. The area can be a bit noisy but I never felt unsafe. It is quite a distance from Midtown but if you get the express A train from 168th st, you can get there quite fast. It is a real New York exprerience far away from the impersonal hotels of Midtown.

The area seems to be a little shady but nothing like unsafe,Juan is a very helpful host. Supermarket around the corner,laundry,gym and subway station. The house very clean and tidy. It’s a good value for money in place like Manhattan.

This host has bedbugs and refuses to acknowledge this. After one night of sleeping here at the end of Oct 2021, I was scratching throughout the night and woke up to a large amount of bites on the back or my upper arms, feet, back of my legs, neck and even my cheek. I told the host the next day and showed her the blood marks on the pillow I was laying and and she said the previous renter did something to the pillow prior to me and the marks came from him. She even suggested that perhaps a spider bit me in the 30+ bite marks that showed up the next day. She also asked me not to report it, which let me know that she was aware that an issue existed. She told me she would get an exterminator in to service and offered me to sleep in her master bedroom (switch with her) to which I declined. She did refund me my entire stay and after 5 days and still being extremely itchy, uncomfortable, scared they may have traveled with me, I reached out to report it to airbnb b/c I simply don’t want anyone else to experience what I did. She then told airbnb that she does NOT have bed bugs and someone else is staying there for a week and hasn’t complained. Renters beware.

I had a very comfortable and great stay here! It was everything i needed during my time in NYC. Nattalia was an amazing host who was nothing but kind during my stay! Don’t be afraid to strike up a conversation if you feel so inclined and if you can go to Katz Deli. 😊

Good location! Dante is very friendly. The room is exactly as shown in the pictures. I ran into some people in the living room a few times but nothing seemed sketchy. Besides, the room can be locked from the inside and I was also provided a key. Overall, a good place to stay and very close to La Guardia Airport.

Juan is such a kind and thoughtful person and was always quick to respond to every question I had. His apartment is lovely and very clean, and he pays attention to every detail.  And it's in an excellent location, which is very important to me when I stay in the city.  It's within just a few blocks of the 1, A, and C trains, which will quickly whisk you to Midtown or the Financial District or wherever you need to go.  It doesn't get any better than that! There are also lots of bodegas, shops, drugs stores, and restaurants in the area, so all your needs should be covered.  I really enjoyed my four days there and highly recommend his place to anyone visiting the city.

This was a rather unpleasant experience and on the whole I am quite unlikely to come back. House rules should be communicated clearly and kindly. I did not feel welcome in the space, and that is a shame.

I wouldn't recommend this listing to others because the host had some unrealistic expectations for visitors. He wanted me to install a window airconditioner by myself (I didn't know how to do that), and the listing didn't suggest that in order to get AC, I would have to do an install. The listing also said there was a hot tub, and there wasn't. Most importantly, the top lock on the door was broken when I got there, and was never fixed during my one month stay. It was very dangerous. The owner tried to be nice but his expectations for guests were unrealistic and I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone else.

We stayed for 4 nights in Kevins place to explore NewYork. The place looks exactly as in the pictures! It was clean and well equipped. The bedroom is in the basement, which means there is not a lot of daylight (apart from 2 narrow light shafts). In summer it means that it is also nice & cool in the bedroom!  Getting the key was easy, even though Kevin wasn’t there when we arrived, it was all taken care off. We never felt unsafe in the area. Although a bit further away from most tourist attractions it is still a great location to explore New York! Two blocks from the subway on 125th street that takes you right to Times Square!

K.Arina's apartment fully met our expectations. Very clean, well located and with all the desired comfort. The bedding is very good and the accommodation well equipped. We were welcomed personally by K.Arina who even left us sweets and cakes for our arrival. We were able to leave the accommodation in the afternoon, which was very convenient and appreciable given our return flight time. We can only recommend this accommodation and will return without any hesitation.

Rob was great. The room was very clean and he was very welcoming. He welcomed me and showed me around the house. He was very careful to give us privacy and gave us clean towels !!!! He also gave us free coffee and tea :) he was simply fantastic and no doubt  i will book there again !

The apartment is great!  It is a really big apartment and the room is large as well, with plenty of room to spread out.  The location is in a great part of Queens, close to restaurants, bars, and the subway.  Rob was very helpful and responded to all of my questions.  I highly recommend staying here!

Rob is a really warm and welcoming guy. He made me feel at home straight away and was happy to help with anything, including local advice about a contract I was unsure about.   The room is as advertised – huge, especially for New York and the apartment is very clean indeed. The location is right on the street where you can get anything you need, bars, restaurants, gyms, laundry, banks etc and it a quick train ride into Manhattan.  Thanks Rob for making me welcome. Cheers
The place is great for the price and location. Rob was extremely helpful and the apartment was clean and tidy.

This was my first experience with AirBnB, and thanks to Rob I am sure it won't be my last.   My stay in Astoria could not have been more perfect.  Rob is gracious and thoughtful so sharing space with him was easy. He is a very considerate host.  We were flexible with each other which made things such as checking in and out very simple.  The private room was spacious and comfortable with plenty of areas to put my things away during my week there.  The kitchen was available to me although I only needed to make tea during this visit.  I found the area very convenient with plenty of services, restaurants,  cafes, etc nearby.  I look forward to returning the next time I visit my grandson in Astoria. :)
This apt is as described and a great price. Rob is lovely and was very accommodating to my check in time.. The room is large and very comfortable.. Thank you rob

Rob was an amazing host! He was super responsive, kind, and helpful. He also went out of his way to ensure I had privacy, and the apartment is quite spacious. I had a difficult schedule, and Rob was super accommodating. Additionally, the apartment is close to the subway and so many amenities/restaurants. The street can be a little noisy, but you get used to it. I would definitely stay again!

I had a pretty long stay in Rob's room in Astoria and for my purposes it was all I needed. I was spending a lot of time on Manhattan, so I would basically just sleep over in the room, get ready for my day and off I am. The room is big and clean, bed is very comfortable, bathroom clean and there's always hot water in the shower. There's also a nice little work desk where I was able to finish off some work. Rob was an awesome host and I could see that he is a really nice guy in the few times we actually ran in to one another. The place is close to both N/Q and R trains, so getting to Manhattan was a breeze. Neighborhood feels very secure (and I was strolling around at very late times in a couple of occasions) with a lot of little shops and bars and restaurants. It can get a little bit loud, but I personally don't mind. Overall a great FIRST AirBnB experience for me! THANKS ROB!

Rob is a fantastic and very nice host, and personally, he has cool and intersting taste. And also, His house is very nice and room is very huge as you see.  Transportation is good. There are two station around his house. Steinway st. and 30th Ave. Both of station make convenient move during your travel.  And if you want adventure to Queens(I recommend this. Queens is very   good and interesting area with numerous diversity), His house in Astoria is perfect place.  House is very nice. Perfectly clean everywhere.  Lastly, if you had any question and curious about NYC, he explains all about what you want.  I recommend this house and perfect host, and my friend, Rob.  Thank you.

The room is very spacious and clean. Rob communicate very well with me. I only saw him during my check and he was friendly.   since the apartment is in a very transited street, it could get a little noise at night, but is not a big issue at all. I recommend his place.

Rob was awesome. Very accommodating down to the last detail. I felt like he was a permanent roommate and not just a host. The room is in fact huge! You're right in the heart of Astoria, prime real estate, and for this price it's a heck of a deal.   The place was very clean. Cleaner in fact than some hotels in NYC.   Rob makes you feel very comfortable. He even had a shelf cleared off in the fridge for me, fresh towels, and was very accepting of my brutal work schedule which included some late nights.

The ad is completely accurate. The room is quite large. Very private and comfortable and has plenty of storage space (closet, shelves, etc.) and a desk and chair. Truly a full-service room. Not only that but the whole apartment is great and Rob's a super nice and easygoing and accommodating host. And of course the location is central Astoria, a great neighborhood in itself with everything you need plus a quick train ride into Midtown Manhattan. An excellent situation all around. Lastly my request was last-minute and Rob responded right away and took great care of me.

Rob's place was awesome. The room was really big and clean. The location is perfect with a lot of restaurants and shops as well as the subway to Manhattan nearby.  Communication and everything else were perfect with Rob. I had a lot of privacy which was very important to me. 10/10. Would book again.
Rob was pleasant enough but the bathroom was a mess, couldn't shower the first two days, few amenities provided, blanket had no sheet on it, room was very noisy all night

I stayed almost a week, everything was very good. The bed is very comfortable, ideal for the long walks you take when you tour all of New York. The most important thing is the location, just around the corner from a subway station, which takes you to the center of Manhattan in a few minutes. I had heating every night, that saved me from the cold of New York nights. The neighborhood is safe, I never felt afraid when I came back at night. It is a clean apartment, with security. I would definitely choose this room again on my next trip to New York.

J answered all our questions and needs, very attentive in that sense. We didn't interact much since we just slept. The room is small, the bed is comfortable and perfect for 2 people. The building in general is old, not similar to the building seen from the outside.  Close to the metro line 2-3, very quick to get everywhere. With very friendly concierges 24/7. In general, recommended to reduce costs for long stays (we stayed 2 weeks) but consider that Harlem is a neighborhood that can be perceived as unsafe at night. Shops, restaurants and services of all kinds very close.

We arrived later than expected due to a delay on our flight and J was very understanding and flexible. Which was very appreciable. He gave us a lot of advice on things to see in the surrounding area... he is a very welcoming and kind person.  Our room was a bit small but the location is ideal 5 minutes walk from the metro. To reach the center of NYC it's great!

Belgin was an awesome host - not only did she arrange for a friend to give us the key when we had flight delays, but she made a super helpful video just for us to introduce her place and explain how things worked! Her place is also really trendy and clean - exactly as advertised. We only needed a place to stay for one night but we thoroughly enjoyed our trip to NYC, thanks to Belgin for making our first night in the city a stress-free one! :)

PHENOMENAL EXPERIENCE!!!!!   so other than the dope ass apartment itself, I loved my "host" much more!  Berlin went from being my hip ass airbnb host to my fabulous lovely new friend/cousin within an hour!!!! This girl si such a blessing and I swear I plan to steal her back with me to Los Angeles, she needs to move to California ASAP!  She is the absolute best and I fkn honestly love her!! She booked a flight to Vegas with us & went out with us to some great club/bar/dance place!!!!  I miss her very much and so blessed I got to experience my first time in New York, if back soon I am def. hitting her up... hopeing she comes to visit me first though!!  See your cute polaroids all around the house ;)

The flat is great, you can find everithing on it what you need for few nights stay. The room was quite, nothing disturbed our sleep. My only problem was the neighbourhood, looks a littlebit dangerous to me.
Not the best location We got stalked by a homeless man at night But everything else was good  Quite big fridge

The Place was s expected. Wifi had some problems here and then, but I want in NYC for streaming. ☺️ Subwaystation was not far away, I just think I wouldn’t go to this neighbourhood alone again. Felt unsafe for the first time in 2 weeks due to catcalling and weird looks nearby.   But The place and checkin was enough and what I needed.

Jamie’s communication prior to and during our stay was excellent and made us feel welcome and at ease. The area itself is a bit gritty, but we felt safe overall. The room is clean but very basic, all you really need if you plan on only going there to sleep. Only complaints were not being able to lock our bedroom door as other rooms get rented out and we didn’t know if our stuff would be safe when we were gone. There was also a window to the bedroom beside us which was creepy. Other than that, everything was good!

This is a super charming apartment very creatively decorated with all kinds of art and fun pieces. It also offers all the functional conveniences: great kitchen and bath facilities, good beds etc. Victor was super hospitable and responsive and quickly solved any issue we met. At first we found the neighborhood a bit sketchy, but everyone we met were super kind and helpful and we felt perfectly safe. Would warmly recommend this nice place to anyone.

Don't be afraid of the situation. The subway is right around the corner and you can get into the city quickly.   Victor is a great host and we were very happy about the gift.   Absolutely recommended!!
Nassim was a gracious and accommodating host. The entire arrangement was stress-free and easy. Wonderful time!

Marco's apartment was perfect for our stay. We didn't meet Marco but we were received by his mother, who made us very welcome. The apartment is really well located, within walking distance of Time's Square or Central Park.  This was really convenient for our stay. The neighborhood is quiet and we never had a feeling of insecurity. The apartment was super clean when we arrived and very practical despite its small size. As Marco says in his description, the disadvantage is the noise from the street (but also sometimes from the neighbors) but it is not too bothersome especially since from 10 p.m. onwards, it is much quieter with some exceptions. We also noticed the presence of some unwanted insects but not very numerous, nor very large and probably very common in New York. The apartment is very well equipped for air conditioning, hygiene products (towels, shampoo, etc.) or for the kitchen. The bed is very comfortable and the BZ is very practical. The WiFi worked very well and we never had a connection problem. In the end, we had a wonderful stay in Marco's apartment, thanks to its location, cleanliness and equipment. It is close to many New York attractions and not far from the main subway lines that take you everywhere. Really practical especially if you, like us, have children. So I highly recommend Marco's apartment.

This place is a classic you get what you pay for scenario.  The location is quick to get to and convenient, but the neighborhood can feel a little sketchy depending on what corner you are on.  Being right by the train saves so much time, so well worth it!  Trevor is very prompt with responding to requests or problems.  But the apartment is very old and dingy.  The hallway is muggy and a little smelly and the bathroom doesn't have any AC, so cold showers are the only choice in the summer.  The room is a nice size with one closet for your things.  Because the whole place is older and a garden unit (under ground) you will want to have slippers or sandals to wear.  Sheets and towels were clean but very old and stained.  As for noise, it's a city and it feels like it.  Since we are from Chicago, it didn't seem so bad.  Communicating with Edda was very nice.  She is sweet and helpful.  It's not the most glamorous stay, but we really only used the place to sleep for a couple of hours and to shower every day.  Otherwise we were out and about.  So it worked well for us.

nice awesome artistic people live here. Very cool art on the wall.  I felt very comfortable here. Very clean bathroom:) very clean room with all the toiletries you could think of.  Nice sized room with closet space. Bed is super comfortable.  Very cute patio area lots of plants.  I loved it.  Traveling alone as a business woman can be very scary And I felt very safe here.  I had the best time here while in new York and I was able to get a lot more work done here at this air bnb.

Margaret and David were very welcoming and accommodating. They regularly stayed in contact with us to make sure we had everything we needed for our stay. The apartment was exactly what we wanted - clean, comfy and 20 metres away from the nearest station with direct 5 minute trains into the city.   Long island is great place to escape after a long day/ night in the city. Public transport runs 24/7 and trains run every 10 to 15 minutes even in the early hours. As a couple we also never felt unsafe getting the train late at night.

Small typically New York apartment perfect for visiting Less than 15 minutes walk from Times Square and the Rockefeller center it is very practical The A/C metro line being quite close it is easy to get everywhere quickly and to come from JFK airport Quiet neighborhood (if the term quiet exists in NYC!!!), shops nearby There were 5 of us (with 3 teenagers) for 1 week and it was perfect Thanks to Marco Ps: a nice little extra you can make the apartment 3 p.m. which is practical when, like us, you have a flight in the early evening. The last day we were able to visit and then return to the apartment to change and return to take the plane... a real comfort that is more complicated to have with a hotel....  Thanks Marco….

The place is well located, one block from the subway station, however, from the entrance it looks very unpleasant. The accommodation does not have good hygiene conditions, neither the bathroom nor the bed.

None of the things that I found unpleasant were Trevor’s fault and my interactions with him were very clear, prompt and pleasant. I understood that this was a bedroom in a shared space without kitchen access, but I still found the description to be missing some important pieces of information.   To his credit, Trevor made a point of saying that this is not a luxury spot and is very basic. One thing that I was still surprised about was the need to bring everything with me to the bathroom (toilet paper, hand soap, hand towel etc) every time. Also, the hallway smelled strongly of air freshener mixed with something indistinguishable, but I would guess was cat pee. I also regretted not bringing earplugs because noises from the street and the hallway were loud and woke me up.  Overall, this did the trick in a pinch. It was very affordable and I really only needed a place to sleep, but really would not have wanted to spend any more time there than necessary. It felt a little like a mix between camping and staying in a college dorm. Not entirely unpleasant, but best to know what you’re getting yourself into.

Jaimes place was perfect.  Haven't been to NY before and must admit as I we approached her street (got in late)... a lot of bad thoughts came to my mind, about NY, crime, bad neighborhoods and so on.  The rest of my trip completely squashed that conception.  Little did I know that she is smack dab in the middle of one of perhaps Manhattans coolest neighborhoods, with great shops, restaurants and friendly people everywhere.  The whole experience left me wanting more of NY. Jaime of course was an excellent host with great communication before arrival including detailed information about all the basics you'd want to know and more.

This location is in a transit accessible area. Take the 2 or 3 line from 125th street to reach downtown in minutes. The 1 train will not return you to this area though, keep that in mind.  Michelle was an excellent host to my family and I  during our stay in New York. The rooms were a welcome home at the end of our jam packed days. Comfortable, well furnished, and well stocked to meet our domestic needs. The kitchen is a mite small but perfectly serviceable for throwing together a simple meal after a long day. The washroom is very clean and comes with hand and bath towels.   A cab driver told us that the area was occasionally unsafe but I feel this was an overstatement. We felt no more threatened than in any other American city. Lennox/Malcom X street is illuminated at night and is lined with respectable businesses.

Neat studio. Exactly as described. Basic but had everything you likely should need for a short stay.   2 blocks from major stop on Subway. Really not too far from anything. The 125th st intersection can be a bit shady at night but at no point was I concerned for my safety.

Very well located, with many restaurants and shops around and the metro stop right next door. The room is spacious although everything is a little old, but everything is clean. The bathroom is very very old, but they are also very clean. You should not worry about the neighborhood, we are two girls and at no time do we feel afraid. It's great!

Hilal and Maryam's place is perfect for a stress-free visit to Brooklyn and The City (as they say). It's comfortable, surprisingly quiet, and features everything you would ever need: including a full kitchen, complete bath, TV with streaming options, and a very comfortable queen bed. The subway (F and G trains) are nearby and we found the "F" to be very convenient to Times Square and nearby Broadway theaters.  Hilal and Maryam are quick to reply to questions and they respond positively to changes in plans. We enjoyed the bakery "WInner" for morning coffee and pastries, located right at the corner of the apartment's block. Also recommended: Couleur and Azul, two nearby restaurants on seventh. It was great to have so many nearby options for dining and shopping!

After combing through hundreds of on line listings for NYC and analyzing each option, I can confidently say I am happy with my decision to stay at Lisa’s place.  This was one of our best home rental experiences and it exceeded our expectations.  Here are My Top Reasons to book this place: 1.	GREAT LOCATION -  Anything and everything we wanted to experience in New York City was at our doorstep with multiple subway lines within a block or two.   2.	SPACIOUS - We were a group of 8 adults and the townhouse offered us plenty of space.  Each of the four bedrooms were a generous size with good closet & drawer space.   3.	LARGE LIVING AREA TO HANG OUT - Comfortable & stylish living/kitchen/dining area where we could relax and catch up in the mornings for breakfast and again at the end of our days after sightseeing.   4.	CLEAN - This was important to us.  Beds with fresh white sheets, towels, and simple subway tiled bathrooms.   5.	GOOD COMMUNICATION - Lisa was very responsive to our questions and responded quickly. 6.	WASHER & DRYER - Yes, there is a laundry room in this apartment.  Almost impossible to find in NYC! 7.	CONVENIENT- anything you might need is no more than a block away: restaurants, bars, wine bars, grocery, drug store, deli, coffee shop, etc. 8.	VALUE- this place offered good bang for the buck.  Large oversized accommodation in best NYC location.

Caroline and her mother are wonderful! Great neighborhood, the culture in Brooklyn and Manhattan is amazing, make sure to eat at the local delis and try out Manny's for breakfast it's an amazing little cafe/restaurant right near the house. We had a car and parking really wasn't to much of an issue. Myself and the two other people I came with all ended up taking the Subway when going to Manhattan. (We traveled from Brooklyn to Manhattan everyday for a week.) Subway is super close and really easy to travel, also saves you a ton of stress trying to park and drive downtown Manhattan. Caroline and her mother also provided us with meals if needed every morning. It was great; the place is super clean too and air worked amazing in our room.

Just don't go, don't risk arriving eager to spend a quiet vacation and being left in the middle of the street with suitcases in hand and exposed to any danger. One is supposed to arrive with the peace of mind of having rented a safe place and when only one message arrives... “I'm sorry, I'm out of NY, I can't be your host”, which LACKS OF RESPECT

Apartment, despite being shared, my friends and I really enjoyed the experience, the place was always impeccably clean, very quiet neighborhood (we always got home late), close to the metro and mini markets, I've used the site several times and without a doubt this was the best. If you go with your family, you can go without fear, they will love it. I recommend!!!
Really nice and cozy. A steal for the price!

The accommodation is well located.  On the other hand, the hospitality is not at all there. We read the comments but we realized that we just want a place to sleep anyway and we won't even notice our presence, um you mean it. The stay in Caroline's house was not at all relaxing because her mother appears every time we come home. They only spoke to us to tell us that we had the right to do nothing because there were too many rules. Even after seeing how patient we were with them. Caroline was not at all able to receive us because she re-varnished her parquet floor and she wanted to install us the same day by asking us to check in after 6pm?! Lol, she realized that it was crazy and made us come back 2 days after placing us in other air bnb. On the other hand, on the 3rd day we checked in at 10pm, waiting in the corridor in the cold because there was a storm, we returned home rather than planned. Our room was not ready, we had to wait in the hallway for an hour with soaked clothes. And our departure was the last straw, she told me to let me know when we were going out, which I did but nothing, no message. They allowed us to leave our suitcases because our flight was at 12:30 a.m., when we collected them they didn't even come out, it was the neighbor who was outside who saw us struggling outside waiting for Caroline or her mother to allow us to enter, without a response he left to tell them, a few moments later he told us that we could go and collect our luggage but Caroline and her mother didn't even come out. We wanted to get our food from the fridge but without a key and authorization we went to buy another one and look for toiletries in the neighborhood Kiosks.  To summarize: TO FLEE

Caroline was very helpful with flexible/late check-in and enabled us to surprise my daughter with a visit from a cousin. The room was as expected, however when we went to use the hairdryer that was provided, it started smoking and sparks coming from it, which could have been very dangerous if it had caught alight. When we reported this to Caroline, she didn't seem at all concerned (and was unable to provide a replacement). In addition, although this was not Caroline's fault, the group of people sharing the airbnb in the next bedroom, were extremely noisy, through until the early hours of each morning, despite us politely asking them to keep quiet so we could get some sleep.

Joyce was the perfect host and the apartment exceeded our expectations. Even though a delay in our intercontinental flight mixed up our travel schedule by almost a day, Joyce still managed to flexibly provide us access to the apartment. And despite our baby daughter struggling with jet lag and being awake and quite loud in the middle of the night, we were never given the feeling this was a problem. Very family friendly! The apartment itself was perfectly clean and included all amenities that are needed. It is located in a quiet neighborhood with a supermarket and drug store within 2-3 minutes walking distance and a subway access nearby as well, through which Manhattan can be reached within 30 minutes. All in all, the perfect experience that we'd love to repeat when we get to NY again.

Incredibly wonderful use of small space. The table had great lighting for a project I was working on. The bed in the loft was very comfortable. Fans and AC and windows with screens that open easily … every bit felt fresh and was spotlessly cleaned. Easy walk from the B 90 stop of the shuttle train from Broad Channel. The board walk and beach was a quick ~ five block walk.  From there you can walk or bike for miles. Really uplifting beach get-away!  Some areas may appear a little seedy, but it never felt unsafe.

I stayed at Jorge and Jornav’s apartment for 5 nights. They were both extremely helpful with details regarding picking up the key. Their apartment is situated very close to the Metro. The position makes accessibility to uptown NY very convenient. Close enough to go Uptown, take in the sights, come back again, rest up and then venture back to vibrant busy NYC. The windows are mostly closed. I suspect this is a necessity of living so close to the city. When the apartment was initially listed, it was listed as 12pm checkout, which was on my itinerary. Small touches like a torch and an umbrella were much appreciated.
Beautiful, clean, and comfortable unit in one of the most unique neighborhoods in Brooklyn. Trista is so friendly, accommodating, and easygoing as a host and made my stay so smooth and stress-free.

Despite her stressful job, Lorainne was flexible and there to provide me the keys. The room looked awesome. Unfortunately, I was meeting friends in Newyork who were scattered all over and had to check out early.

María's apartment is just as you see in the photos. Clean and comfortable. Next door you have a supermarket that has everything and many bars for breakfast, lunch or dinner. Laundry right below the house and metro stops very close. Upon our arrival, no one attended to us, María had left the keys in a kind of padlock with a password that we had a hard time finding.
