Furthermore, the password he had given me was not correct and we had to wait for him to answer us (which didn't take him long). We had also asked for the folding bed that he told us and when we arrived it wasn't there either, the girl who cleans had to come (while we were away) to put it up. The fact that no one welcomes you is quite unpleasant, they don't give you advice on where to buy, how to go places, tricks, etc. I didn't find that good, especially in such a big city. The apartment does not seem comfortable for three people, if there are two it would be better.   The good thing is that our plane left at 8pm and Maria let us check out late.  As for proximity to the city, the truth is that everything is far away. It takes almost an hour to get to all the places no matter how well connected it is. When you're in Manhattan you're too lazy to stay for a drink, for example, because you're thinking about getting back, and you don't go out at night. If you don't mind the latter, I repeat that it is well communicated.

I will start by saying how appreciative I am of Air BnB in regards to the fact I received a FULL refund for my visit at Pierre’s place. We had travelled from the UK on my birthday and arrived at a place that was nothing like what we had expected.  I will not go into detail about how unclean and unsafe everything was- but I did send Pierre multiple photos and received no response. We had no choice but to take our luggage down to Times Square at 2am and ask around hotel to hotel for somewhere that us 4 adults could stay.   It was a real shame as the location is ideal- but that is where the positives stop.   I am so fortunate we had excess pennies to be able to book somewhere else whilst we awaited a refund. I really hope no one else experiences what we did, as it was a nightmare start to a holiday and not what I had expected after using Air BnB for many years.  Big thank you to Air BnB for being so incredible and helpful when we felt so gutted.

My partner & I had an AMAZING time at Yvelisse’s place during our week stay in NY. She was a great host! The pictures of the apartment were literally an exact representation of what we got. She even had towels, wash cloths, shower caps, combs, soap & shower gel for us to use. We didn’t use anything but the towels & wash cloths but she made it feel like a hotel. The shower & bathroom are nice. The bed was comfortable w/ amazing AC. The kitchen has everything we needed to cook breakfast! She even had a small desk for me to get a little work done when it rained.   Yvelisse also did a great job of checking in on us several times throughout our stay. She was quick with communication! The instructions to get into the place are also clear. It was intimidating getting the key from Refried Beans since we didn’t want anyone to think we were trying to do something shady but someone from the restaurant automatically realized what we were there for & helped us right away so just ask an employee wen you get there if you need to. They are more than willing to help.   The A train is literally like a five minute walk & took us everywhere in the city we needed to go. That short walk to the subway was clutch especially since we were walking a lot. The 1 train is about a 10-12 minute walk as well. There was a grocery store right across the street from Yvelisse’s place which was also convenient.   Her place is literally in the perfect location if you’re looking to get exposed to diversity & culture. There were so many ethnic backgrounds & cuisines represented in the neighborhood. Refried Beans was always packed. There’s another Indian spot called Anār that’s on Amsterdam that I’d also highly recommend. Broadway also has a lot of cuisines & is where you see a lot of culture.   I could go on & on but to sum it up, if you’re looking for a place that’s simple but has everything you need you should book Yvelisse’s place. You will not be disappointed! One of the best hosts I’ve ever had! 10 out of 10!

Maham's room is very well located and allowed us to discover New York without stress. I do not recommend renting Maham's room in summer because it was very hot and the fan was not sufficient (and very noisy). Prefer a room with air conditioning. Apart from summer, no worries because it is a very spacious room. We didn't see Maham but she was always at our disposal if needed. The check in and check out went very well. There are plenty of good restaurants, bars and cafes in the area and access to Manatthan is easy via the metro just 15 minutes from the apartment.

Khatia's appartment is a perfect place for some days in NYC or a little stay. A little far from stressful dowtown, it has every commodities and the attention was insuperable. Khatia used to answer really quick to our demands and she waited for us at the appartment. The flat has everything you need. Facilities for cooking are also available. Laundry is easy too.  A really good place to stay in NYC. Khatia is of the utmost trust.

Booking: Communicating with Rob was easy.  He responded quickly to my initial request and clearly answered all my questions about the space.    Check-in: On the day of my reservation , Rob met me right on time to give me the keys and all the details of the property.   The space: Robs property was clean, modern and exactly as pictured.  The space is open and airy with all the necessary comforts. the bathroom and shower are nice is there is a nice outdoor area out back.  Bed was comfy and there were shutters in the bedroom  to block out light during sleep.   Location: The apartment is located just a couple blocks from the S train for moving around the city.  There are some good dining options just up the block for food and drinks. The area is safe, and has a nice local vibe.   Overall, I would recommend the apartment to anyone looking to have a clean modern space in a nice part of Brooklyn.

Rob's basement apartment is a great place to stay in Crown Heights. It has a minimalist look, but various objects and art give it a distinctive character. The appliances and bathroom seem quite new so it has a comfortable polish. The Crown Heights area is full of restaurants, cafes, bars, and shops, and this location is very convenient to get to all of them. It's also close to the excellent Brooklyn Museum and Prospect Park. Rob is very friendly and easy to communicate with.

This apartment was really beautiful and in a great part of Crown Heights. Great consistent communication with Rob. However, would not recommend for those looking to sleep past 7am, as the apartment is below a very active family and there is considerable foot traffic in the morning.

Rob was the most helpful host I've had. I came to him short notice (really short notice) but he and his family took care of me. The home is better than described. Extremely spacious, sunny and quiet. If you're looking for a chill, cultured and bright time, this might be the best place in all of Brooklyn. 5 stars all around.
Rob and Amanda were great hosts, the place was clean and they were very helpful with the check in/ check out process. I would definitely consider staying at their place next time I'm in new York.
Great space in Crown Heights!  Rob was super accommodating and a nice host. The apartment is convenient to multiple train lines, clean and comfortable. We would definitely recommend it.
Very convenient location and Rob was very accessible throughout the stay for questions and requests.

What a beautiful apartment and lots of space, it really is as lovely as the photos and isn't really a basement as has been mentioned, front bedroom is only 1 foot lower than ground level and the kitchen at the back is ground level, the kitchen door opening onto the garden.  Franklin Ave has everything from organic food stores to a great juice place and vegan tacos further up the road, all a fun safe walk from the house.  Rob and family live upstairs so key collection / dropping off is simple. Underground into Manhattan is 45 mins door to door, simple, and the bus straight to Williamsburg. The apartment is finished to a super high standard with love and feels like home, the bedroom has the original ceiling and hardwood floors, I was also super warm, shower is excellent too.  All in all I can't imagine a better stay in Brooklyn, Rob was away for the week but arranged for a smooth key collection.  And kindly allowed me to leave my bags in the hall so I could go into Manhattan on my last day and collect my bags on my way back to JFK. A perfect balance of soul, style, safety and the NY vibe - highly recommended !

we loved our stay in rob's place. garden level but with large windows. very spacious, and artful blend of historical features in the building and new design elements. amazing bathroom, shower, bed. appreciated having our own access to the space through our own entrance. really great area: close to several subway lines and LIRR, really great restaurants and cocktail bars in walking distance. Rob gave us a modest discount for the nightly rate for two guests, which was very appreciated. He was easy to stay in touch with, very responsive. Would gladly stay here again.

Great location! Coffee shops, markets, subway, brunch/lunch/dinner spots are all super easy to get to - walkable!   The apartment itself is great! Very cozy and clean. Has a record player with a few dope jazz records. Really brings the whole vibe of the apartment together.    Rob is a very gracious host! Went out of his way to make sure we were comfortable. Was even going to let us drop off our bags before we were able to check in!   Definitely going to stay here again when I visit NY in the future!
Rob's place was great and very convenient for getting around NYC. Check in was easy and Rob was very helpful with restaurants, etc.

Me and my two sons wanted to experience the "Brooklyn life" after a flurry of a week in Manhattan and Rob's place didn't disappoint.   His place was fantastic!  It was tastefully furnished and very clean.  By and large, it's a very great value for what you're getting.  Rob is always just a message away, just an easy transaction from end to end.

Rob's place was great for a quick weekend visit for my parents, so they could stay in my neighborhood and be within walking distance to all the great restaurants and shops that Crown Heights has to offer. The private entrance was a nice touch, and the apartment features and amenities were as described. My parents really enjoyed their stay and would definitely recommend staying at Rob's place!

Had a brilliant short stay in Rob's large one bed apartment.  It's fantastically situated on a quiet street but a short stroll from Franklin and maybe a ten minute walk from Brooklyn Museum and Prospect Park. The subway is nearby and Rob was an extremely helpful host. Thanks!
Rob's apartment is great. Very roomy. Fantastic and quiet location.

Rob's place is the perfect brooklyn brownstone experience. Located just off of happening franklin Ave in the heart of crown heights, the apartment offers the perfect combination of classic brownstone with original details and recent renovation. Rob was a great host, communication was a breeze and Rob was flexible and accommodating. Will definitely stay again.

My friends and I took a few days to explore ny, ny while staying at Rob's place. Everything was as described and in order, even for my perfectionist standards! We had some qualms about the area (it looked a tad sketchy when we got there late the first night), but it was all good in the end. Worst thing that happened was being stalked for a block by a rather non-decrepit hobo, but that could happen anywhere and everywhere. 4.5 stars for a wonderful/safe experience!

Rob was easy to communicate with! Check in & check out were fast and easy. The area was nice. Rob was super helpful. I went to one of his suggested restaurants and it was amazing :) I loved the place it's super cutely decorated and hidden.. I highly recommend if you were to visit Brooklyn.

Great spot, well stocked, and check in was a breeze. We could Uber most places we wanted to go in Brooklyn for under 10$ but very close to great food and shops. Rob was really accommodating of our group. The space us on the lower level of a brownstone, but still a decent amount of light during the day.

Super clean, super nice home. We were all over Manhattan and we were able to catch the subway everywhere from Rob's home. All amenities were met with the exception of a TV which was perfectly fine. You can hear lots of movement upstairs, but it wasn't an issue for us. Awesome cafe just down the block called Lazy Ibis - great coffee and breakfast! We had a great time and I loved that we weren't around all the tourists. Thanks Rob!
Rob was great - good communication, accommodating, and the space was perfect.

Our stay was too short for such a good find. Really lovely place and location. We talked about all the Airbnbs we've stayed in and truly couldn't have hoped for better accommodations in the city. Thank you Rob!

Rob was easy to communicate with and very responsive. He made the check in process easy. The place is beautiful, very spacious and has everything you may need when away from home. The location is safe, close to transit, close to parks/restaurants/shops, easy to find.
Rob was a great host and very considerate. We had an awesome time at his place! It was very clean and close to a lot of amenities!

The place was excellent and Rob was a great host.  Our visit was very seamless.  The unit is very comfortable and in excellent condition.  The appliances were all very new which is always nice.  It was also nice to have 1 and 1/2 bathrooms.  I would definitely recommend.  There is also and really nice coffee/breakfast place a few doors down called the Lazy Ibis.  We were there every morning.
Rob was a great host. It was easy to communicate with him about check-in and out. Good location, easy to walk to some great restaurants. The best part of Robs home was the fantastic shower!

Everything about the booking went smoothly. Can't think of a better way to experience Crown Heights in Brooklyn than in Rob's classic brownstone! So much to do and see in the area. Great neighborhood. Excellent location and the apartment was perfect for us. Don't miss the Bagel Pub for amazing bagels!
The place is exactly how it looks, clean, and spacious. Rob was quick to answer and a great host. This was an easy stay and I'd definitely book again!
Rob's place is as advertised. I found it to be very comfortable, convenient for being in Crown Heights Brooklyn and,  I hope it is available the next time I come to Brooklyn.

This place was the perfect one on so many levels. Comfortable, well appointed, in a fantastic location close to great food, bars and the subway. In addition to everything else Rob was a fantastic host, even letting us check in early after a red eye flight. Would most definitely stay here again!!
Rob's place is exactly as described! Really well located, with the subway near by and some really good places to eat! Very clean, and communication with Rob was really easy and fast!

One of the best AirBnbs that I’ve ever stayed at - world wide - I felt so at home and so comfortable in Rob’s space. Exactly how the photos describe, if not better in person. So easy to get to, and in such an awesome area. I’m a 20 something year old that truly appreciates a good piece of pizza and glass of wine. Such a trendy area and so easy to be in the city without all the hustle and bustle of Manhattan.

Rob is an outstanding host, who sets the bar very, very high with his communication and his accommodations. Everything was perfect: the location, his apartment and his amenities. We can’t wait to book with Rob again!

Super comfortable, clean and well-located, a beautifully renovated brownstone in historic Crown Heights. Excellent restaurants nearby, subway stations in all directions. One of the best airbnb's I've ever stayed in. Very happy children living upstairs as evidenced by much scurrying around before school. Thanks Rob!
Rob was a wonderful host! He gave us some excellent tips to explore Brooklyn. The house was very well decorated and stylish.

Rob’s place was so well put together and comfortable. It was charming and updated. Close to the subway and near several cool Brooklyn restaurants and coffee shops. Rob was even kind enough to let us keep our bags in the hallway outside of the room for a few hours since our flight was later in the evening. Quick response time and very hospitable. Would definitely stay at this beautiful place again!

Great spacious apartment really close to the Brooklyn Museum and Botanical Garden. Rob was very accommodating and always responded to questions promptly. The apartment was more than we expected or could have hoped for. We loved the neighborhood, there are so many great spots just a few streets away. Can’t wait to come back!

Spacious apartment by NYC standards, and Rob was a responsive, helpful host.  The apartment is very tastefully decorated and impressively clean.  Such a great alternative to staying in a hotel.  Definitely felt like we were part of the neighborhood!   Recommended for couples, but our family of four spent the night quite comfortably too.

Really cool apartment in Crown Heights. Great location, not far from subway stops, with tons of good restaurants and bars within a few blocks. Easy access to Brooklyn Museum, Prospect Park, Bkn Children's Museum, Barclay Center. Rob has done a great job on the space, which has some really cool pieces, spotless, and well equipped for any length stay. Not too difficult to park on the street too. Check-in and out were very easy.

Rob‘s apartment is really nice, spacious and well equipped - we enjoyed the stay a lot! A perfect starting point for a city trip to New York. Rob was very helpful and the apartment exactly as described. Thanks again, Rob!

Overall: Highly recommend, if I am traveling in the area again I will book here first.  Location: Super easy to find, never felt unsafe at night, peaceful street.  Space: MUCH bigger than other airbnb's I've been in  the area. The place is spacious with more than enough room for 2-3 people. It was spotless when we arrived  Amenities: Only things I needed on my persons were a toothbrush and toothpaste and a bottle of water. Towels, linens provided were very clean and comfortable to use and there were even insanely tasty clementines and other snacks provided.  Communication: Super polite and quick to reply. Would be hosted again.  Only criticism we had was the noise traveling through the floor but that was stated on the description page and the noise was pretty minimal to begin with. Though it did make us feel self-conscious about the amount of noise we were possibly making.

It's close enough to the Subway and in a nice quiet neighborhood. There are shops and restaurants close by. The records and record player (and general decor) were just cherries on top of the cake. It's a cool space and Rob is a super responsive and nice host. I'd definitely stay again!

Had a great time at Rob’s place. Super clean and cozy for a few days in Brooklyn. Easy public transportation and cool restaurants near by. Rob also was very easy to communicate with and check in was a breeze.
Rob’s place is the ideal oasis in Crown Heights. Quiet, clean and in close proximity to many nice bars and restaurants. Thank you, Rob!

The apartment is located in a nice residential area and is easily accessible by public transport. It is nicely decorated with a good eye for details, such as the record player with jazz music. The apartment was very clean and communication with Rob was easy. We would come back.

This garden apartment is 100% remodeled and super clean and comfortable. The bathroom and shower are fantastic which can be hard to come by in older homes.  The location in Crown Heights is ideal with great bodegas nearby as well as several excellent restaurants. Almost equidistant between the 4-5 subway stop and the A-C subway stop.  As Rob mentions in his information, his family including small children do live above this unit. Yes, we did hear the children but it was happy children playing sounds and nothing irritating at all. The only caveat is that we are early risers so if you are hoping to sleep in until 9 or 10 am, this may not be the best choice for you.  Rob was answered texts almost immediately the two times we had occasion to contact him. This is an excellent apartment and we would definitely reserve it again.
This is a great space and Rob is an excellent host. A couple of things needed to be taken care of this time (like a thrown breaker) and he took care if them within the hour. Definitely recommend.

I had a nice weekend stay at Rob's place. The location is quite great if you want to explore the Brooklyn area. The apartment is a level below the sidewalk with a family living upstairs. The decor is minimal but tastefully done. This is a nice place if you want somewhere that is reasonable and want a good night's rest.

Excellent stay in Brooklyn in this residential but lively neighborhood full of good addresses. Very close to the subway line that takes you to Manhattan. The accommodation is impeccable, very clean and tastefully decorated. Rob is an attentive host who ensures that everything goes well. To do again without hesitation!

We arrived to an apartment that was just what I expected for New York, old, yucky, smelled like cat pee, run down building with graffiti and many mice   *There were no directions or welcoming book with expectations or rules *Pull out mattress wasn’t usable (I had to buy an air mattress myself) *Didn’t have enough pillows or bedding so I purchase them myself, at my cost *Host got upset we used more than 2 rolls of toilet paper for our 30+ day trip *Heater squeals loudly, air conditioner was disgustingly DIRTY *BEWARE - we received a 30 Day notice to Evict for non payment of rent *Luckily I documented the apartment on my arrival and departure so the hosts baseless claims after my checkout could be negated with video PROOF... waisting hours of my personal time to defend myself... *Hells Kitchen LOCATION was great, except for the non stop sirens, honks, yelling that was heard thru old unsealed windows. The graffiti and homeless living next to the front door of the building was a turn off

Rob, is a great host and will be around to help out.  The place has been renovated to be 5 star. All the soap and towels are 5 star plus.  All the clean products and the coffee is organic!  I'd stay there again and so would you.

This space is so true to the pictures. It is charming, elegant, a great size, clean and tidy. It provides a true Brooklyn neighborhood experience. It is close to restaurants, coffee shops, the park, museum and the subway.   Rob was attentive and responsive, and everything from check in to check out went very smoothly. I would highly recommend!!

Rob and Amanda were the dream hosts, they were so welcoming and helpful and went above-and-beyond to make us feel at home in Crown Heights. The apartment is a short walk away from a great cafe, amazing grocery store and well-connected subway stops and the bed was very comfortable!

Very tidy and lovely AirBnb , equipped with everything you need. EVERYTHING!!   A good bed and nice bathroom. Rob is a great host. Very nice and wants to share all he knows about the area.  The neighborhood is very conveniently located We had a great stay!

Me and my friends enjoyed our stay here while visiting New York. Michelle is amazing and answered all our questions and requests immediately. She even helped us find the closest place to get covid tested which saved us so much stress! Her place was very comfortable to stay as well and definitely worth booking.

Wonderful space with excellent location. Steps away from the subway. We felt safe walking in the neighborhood at night. Guy was amazing and added little touches to ensure we had everything that we needed.  The reviews about noise are accurate. If you are a light sleeper you should keep in mind that people who live above in the building are coming and going so it can get noisy. I am a pretty heavy sleeper and it still woke me up. Overall, this is a steal because with the private entrance, it's like having your own apartment. Definitely recommend!

Super convenient and safe location. Don't let the Harlem location scare you. My friend and I are two southern belles and were nervous about being in New York for the first time but the listing was perfect. They were there to meet us as soon as we arrived. Very good people.

The apartment is cozy and above all very well located! Very close to Times Square. Vincent was accommodating in finding a solution despite our late arrival time due to a flight delay. I will keep the address without hesitation!

We had a pleasant stay with Braydon, he was very responsive to our requests. His studio is good value for a few days exploring NYC  The positives:  - the location +++: metro right next door to get to all the tourist places in Manhattan, lively, young neighborhood. No worries about insecurity.  - calm  - very comfortable bed  - air conditioning   The negative points:  - Clean apartment but in need of renovation  - a little small

Little gem in the city. The apartment is located in a very nice and friendly area close to public transport, shops and restaurants. Why stay in midtown of you can stay in “the village”.   Although the neighbourhood is lively, the apartment offers a quiet place to sleep after a day out exploring the city. Only the airco makes some noise.  The little kitchen and bathroom are a little dates but don’t get scared everything works well. Big plus for the very fluffy towels, good WIFI and the comfortable bed.  Brandon is very easy to communicatie with. The directions to pick-up the keys were clean and easy to follow. I higly recommend the apartment to all travelers who need a small but nice place to stay in NYC.  Don’t forget to drink a coffee at Stumptown Coffee Roasters 30 W 8th Street to get the local vibe.

Charming street in a perfect location. Easy access to subway and walkable to anything you need. Apartment is sufficient and feels bigger than it is.  Next to a delicious French restaurant that you catch wafts of. The entry is a cute step and homeless  sometimes chill and I’m guessing use it as a bathroom. But, it was muggy while I was there so the whole city smelled like piss. Be prepare to pick up and drop off key at location blocks away. I just added a stop on the Lyft trip.

We stayed at Matts for 8 nights. It was super clean and organized and the communication could not have been better, everything went as planned. The place is beautiful and perfect and secure. We never met our hosts unfortunately but they messaged us back really quickly whenever we asked anything. They even suggested events we go to, which we did and loved. I think this place is perfect for anyone with at least 5 days in NYC or who has been to NYC before. If you're only staying a few days and haven't been before, I'd recommend somewhere closer to midtown purely so you spend a little less time walking/on the subway, but for everyone else this place is absolutely perfect. We caught the subway everyday and only waited a few minutes for the train each time. We never felt unsafe in this area (a few encounters elsewhere in NYC but not near home). We walked all the way down to midtown one day which took about 90minutes with a few stops for shopping and food. We'd definitely stay here again, thank you!

I stayed for a month at Matt's beautiful place in Harlem and it was an absolute pleasure.  The apartment is exactly as it appears in the photos: stylish, well-decorated, beautifully furnished (that couch is the single most comfortable couch I've ever sat on in my life) and clean.  It's also in a quiet area, so perfect for chilling out after a frantic day downtown.  The room is very comfortable, with plenty of storage, a desk (plus iMac which guests can use) and AC/heat.  I was working at the Schomburg Centre for much of the time and it was close enough that I walked every morning.  The apartment is also very, very close to a subway stop that can get you to Columbus Circle (via an express train) in around 15 min.   The neighbourhood was great: there's supermarkets, bodegas/delis, a wine shop, good restaurants, fast food, a selection of gyms and a cinema all extremely close by. Best of all was Matt himself - he's an absolutely lovely Airbnb host: friendly, interesting, super kind, considerate, and full of helpful tips on things to do/getting around NYC.  Communication with Matt was very easy and quick, and check-in and check-out were stress-free.  He was the perfect Airbnb host!  When I come back to NYC, I will definitely look up Matt's place again; he made me feel so welcome and at home during my stay.

This host called me while I was in the ER with my 3 year old sick hooked on an IV, after I told her I am in the ER, to tell me to “please leave the apartment” because she has somebody else booked for 4 months and she doesn’t want us staying there to ruin it for the next person.  Then she went on to complain that it’s unfair how I blamed her for the radiators being noisy. I was hearing this while in the ER not knowing if I will be able to get discharged. Staying at this house was the most stressful experience even after my finals this semester. The radiators was so loud they would wake us up.  We ended up homeless for a half a day with a sick child. I have nothing good to say about Airbnb and this host.

I would definitely NOT RECOMEND this place to anybody. He didn´t give us the keys in person, we picked them up from a place where he left them for us. When we got in the house everything was disgustingly dirty. The floor was all covered by dust, the kitchen full of his dirty used dishes and the house all messy with his stuff. My girlfriend had to ask him to change the sheets of the bed and do it herself because they were dirty and there were pieces of paper and trush inside. Besides, the floor, windows, walls and everyhting in that room was dirty. Totally disgusting. The room you see in the picture IS NOT what he really rents. It has NO furnitures and the bed is a inflatable mattress. Although now it specifies it is a inflatable mattress, when we chose and paid for the room it didn´t. We felt truely CHEATTED and SCAMMED as we paid a lot of money for a room which WAS NOT what we finally got. From the first time we got in that flat we asked him for a discount which he didn´t want to provide us, and did all possible not to see us nor talk to us, like locked him inside his room last day we stayed in his place not to get a final agreement which at the end was not even a 15% of what we paid to him, not the total amount we paid to air bnb. To sum up: we will NOT recomend this place as he is a CHEATER and the house is DIRTY AND MESSY. Besides, he didnt even guide us around nor gave us any kind of advise while we stay in NY. HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE.

***OVERALL*** I enjoyed my 2-week stay at Gary's place.  It is a very comfortable, quiet, and a spacious 1 bedroom.  As we got closer to my check-in date, communications from Gary were good.  If I had to do it again, I would come back.    ***PROS*** The biggest perk is that Central Park is less than half a block away.  I really enjoyed walking/running/biking in the park.  Very fast-acting AC helped on those days where it was already muggy at soon as you woke up.  It was a small kitchen, but it has what you need and delivers.  A very powerful gas stove to heat up anything you want.  A big, comfortable bed.  Wifi was pretty strong: 100/100 upload/download speed.  Great restaurants in the Harlem area... I wish I had more time (and money) to spend.  ***CONS*** There were not too many cons to drag down the pros.  Most notable gripe is a narrow shower/tub... perhaps the shower rod was not positioned well, but when showering/lathering, I'd be touching the shower curtain.  I'm not that big of a guy, but I had to stand sideways so I wouldn't be rubbing up against the curtain.  No cable TV, but there was AppleTV and a small collection of DVDs to keep you busy on the nights you say in.  This is not something on Gary, but the socio/economic divide in the city can be seen on the block Gary's building sits on... you walk 50 yards to the right, and you're on the richness of 5th Avenue and Central Park... you walk 50 yards to the left, and you're in public housing with homeless hanging out.  I grew up in a big city, so nothing fazes me, but the differences are stark.

Amazing location - I was able to walk back to the apartment easily from most of mid Manhattan, really convenient! Apartment was a nice size in a safe location, would definitely stay here again. My flight was delayed 3+ hours until very late in the night, the host was able to make alternative arrangements for me to collect the keys so that I wasn't homeless for a night, I really appreciate the help! :)

I am sorry to say this Antonio.. I had a nightmarish experience at your place.  I booked a private room at this apartment for 4 nights and had to quit this place in middle of my trip and move to a hotel. Before confirming this reservation, I read Clement’s review about how he suffered during his stay. With my fingers crossed, however, I proceeded with my booking assuming that Clement’s case could have been an exception because the place has been highly reviewed and the host must have taken appropriate steps to address the problems.That was my huge mistake.  There was no outside lock provided for this private room, and absolutely no way one could have secured one's luggage and himself/herself. During my stay, I also realized that someone mishandled my luggage when I was outside. This was extremely uncomfortable for me especially when I had to use the washroom leaving my stuffs vulnerable while at home.   In the Airbnb posting, Antonio has clearly mentioned about "No Smoking Policy" at his place. However, I could smell heavy cigarette smoke in the living room (opposite to the washroom) at night, an experience similar to mentioned by Clement's in his review comments. I believed someone was watching me all the time during my stay which was spooky and I find hard to explain. With all this, I had to book rooms in a hotel for the remaining days of my trip which was expensive and did impact my trip planning.  Furthermore, the pictures posted for the room are a misrepresentation of the actual size and decor of the room which is small and clumsy.  I really had an uncomfortable and unpleasant stay. I don’t recommend this place to anyone (especially single girls) until AIRBNB and the host take appropriate actions to address these issues.   @Airbnb: Did you guys take these reviews seriously, If yes, why this keeps happening to guests. It’s a rip off. @Clement : Your review is spot on about this place. I regret that I overlooked it. Thank you!

I had the pleasure of staying with Antonio for a couple months when I moved to New York City for an internship. When I arrived, Antonio greeted me with a warm welcome and even helped me move in my boxes into the room. I have stayed at a few Airbnbs in the past, but this one was by far the best one.  Location: The place is located less than a block away from the M and R trains (36 St Station) and only a few extra blocks for the N and W train (39 Ave Station). Taking the M or R one stop, you can transfer to the E at Queens Plaza, which makes this location extremely convenient. Manhattan is only 2 stops away on the R or 3 stops on the M, which made my daily commute only about 10 minutes to Midtown. The location is one of the best reasons to stay here.  Safety: I have never felt unsafe in the area when walking home from the subway. There were two times where I had to walk home from Queens Plaza (~10 min walk) due to MTA service changes and I have not felt unsafe then either. The area is very nice and there are a ton of places to grab something to eat around there.  The apartment is always clean because Antonio cares a lot about making sure everyone has a good stay. The decorations and antiques around the house are absolutely beautiful. The bathroom is always clean and dry, and the shower is nice and hot. Please help keep the house clean by taking off your shoes so that dirt is not brought inside. In addition, Antonio was extremely thoughtful and would check up on me from time to time to make sure that everything is going well and that I was enjoying my stay. It was a very great experience to be able to live in this home, and I would definitely come back here again if I'm ever around in NYC again. I highly recommend this place to anyone who is visiting the city.

We had a great time and Ed's place was in a perfect location- close to the finish of the marathon, as well as the Columbus Circle subway station.  Plenty of restaurants, drug stores, grocery stores, and shopping closeby.  Central Park and many museums are within walking distance.

Although Antonio seems to be a nice person, I did not have as positive experience with this airbnb during my trip as others. Check-in time was really late - 6pm, the apartment smelled like cat piss, the room couldn't be locked, so we felt uncomfortable leaving our luggage unattended. Other house guests were not pleased that we were staying there and were making sarcastic comments about it. The bedroom was very hot, there was no window to let some air in, only a super loud air conditioner. Host was asking to sneak into the house unnoticed and lie that we are his friends and did not book via airbnb which was very fishy and weird... it was quite difficult to reach the host sometimes with any questions we had. The neighborhood is relatively good but seeing rats running near the apartment was quite unpleasant. Maybe this is what 100$ a night in NYC gets you, but in the end we decided to chose another place to stay.

We were very well received by our hosts, very open, generous, attentive and interesting people. The accommodation was spacious and comfortable enough for two adults and a child. We never felt unsafe in the Bedford Stuyvesant neighborhood contrary to what you can read in some travel forums on the Internet. On the contrary, choosing this district of Brooklyn allows you to discover another aspect of NYC and not just Manhattan.

Description of the apartment conforms to reality, perfect for 2 adults and 2 children, quick and easy access to Manhattan by subway (10 minutes to go to Fulton street by the A train). The only downside is the mattresses which are not great! As I admitted to Zaire, our first impression when exiting the subway at Utica station, coming from JFK, was "what did we come to do in this neighborhood?". In France, we live in a detached house in a nice, clean area of ​​a provincial town and the environment in Brooklyn is not at all reassuring for a wife and children....at least at first glance. In the end, we stayed 3 weeks in the apartment with 2 14 year old teenagers and NEVER felt unsafe, even when we returned after midnight.  We have NEVER been solicited or questioned in any way whatsoever.  On the contrary, the residents of the neighborhood are polite, available and even considerate towards us (always ready to help you or provide you with information). We rented a car which we parked on the street without any problem. The nights are super quiet, we were never woken up by outside noises. The daylight took care of it very well! For food, there are a few very small stores in the area but you won't find much there. you have to go to "Nostrand avenue" (6 blocks or 20 minutes on foot) to find a "keyfood" store which looks like a "carrefour market". Certainly the environment is very different from ours in France but we had a wonderful vacation.

Apartment very well located, close to all amenities (grocery stores...on every street corner + close to all transport (in a little less than 10 minutes access to trains+metro and bus). At first glance the neighborhood can be a little scary but we quickly felt in our element and we quickly lost this feeling of insecurity because the neighborhood offers a typical atmosphere which is very appreciable when you take the trouble to take more than a look around. Our hosts were very friendly and the apartment is comfortable, clean and well equipped. Thanks again.. it makes us want to come back to Brooklyn.
Great place to stay for a short or long period of time. My stay was stress- free and enjoyable. Easy check in and out. Would definitely recommend to anyone!

Our stay in Dan's appartment was wonderful. The location was absolutely perfect, you can reach every metro line within 5 minutes walk and there are so many coffee's for brunch and restaurants to chose from nearby. The bed was comfortable and if you're two people it's quite spacious for NY standards. As many have written before, it can get noisy at night/early morning, so bring earplugs and a sleeping shade, there's so much beautiful natural light coming in. Communication with Dan was very easy, he responds very quickly and has always a good tip at hand. Highly recomendable!
Dan was a great host!  Very flexible with our travel times and thoughtful about details that made our stay easy and stress-free.  Great location!

Natalie was a great host and excellent communicator. My husband and I stayed at her place for 10 days. On the practical side we loved: quiet apartment building (plus on top floor so no one was living above us)., quiet street, safe area, comfortable bed, good water pressure, plenty of hot water,  and thermostat we could control. Other nice things: mostly newly renovated bathroom, the common room with kitchen in it was sunny all day and because buildings across stress weren't taller than this apartment we had a good view of the skyline, plenty of grocery stores and restaurants to choose from 1 - 4 blocks away and on. Thank you Natalie for our nice stay in NYC!

The apartment is the top floor of a 5- story walk-up, but you get used to the climb, and it makes for a quiet stay (by NYC standards). The location is nice too: a reasonably quiet street, with lots in walking distance.   The apartment is a decent size for NYC, with a fine NYC sized kitchen set up, and a nice bathroom.  A couple nitpicks: The building’s centralized heat would not shut off during my stay, so I had to keep my windows open most of the time to prevent the place from becoming a sauna. And the kitchen equipment is a bit weak if you do a lot of cooking. But those things aren’t that big a deal: I suspect the heat issue is not normal, and I find most Airbnbs to be weak in the kitchen.  Much more important: Natalie is a great host — super helpful and responsive, which more than makes up for any nitpicking like the above.  I would definitely stay here again.

I love everything about this place. Aesthetic design rooms, good location, and great host. I came here for biz trip and had to go to midtown area on weekdays, the transportation is stress-free. There’s starbucks 3 min. from the place so really an easy access to anywhere any-shop.  Host is so nice as well, she’ll help you with everything if there’s anything. I’d love to come back again! Def will be back here.

Vernon and Dawn may be the perfect airbnb hosts. You get a respons after 5 minutes everytime you have a question. The accomodation was just as good as the pictures look like. Only negative was that it was a 30 minutes subway ride to get to manhattan. But suspect you would have to pay 3 times as much for the same standard of accomodation in manhattan.

Vernon was very communicative leading up to our stay and provided all of the necessary information before our arrival. While we did meet his wonderful wife, my boyfriend and I were never able to meet Vernon but he did check in on us multiples times via texts while we were there. The studio itself is even more beautiful than pictured. It is very clean and well-furnished and the complimentary drinks and snacks were very much appreciated! While a nearby CVS employee warned us about the neighborhood at night, we never felt unsafe and were out walking at all hours of the day and night. It is roughly a 5-10 minute walk to the Subway (depending on which one you're going to) and roughly a 40 minute ride into Manhattan. It was perfect for our needs and we loved being able to get away from the hustle and bustle of the city every night. There are some great shops and restaurants within walking distance and everyone was friendly. I can't thank Vernon enough for such a hospitable and comfortable stay. The portable fireplace was a lovely (and appreciated) touch for the colder mornings! We would gladly come back as well as recommend it to anyone looking for a place to stay in NYC.

Arrival was problem free as Dawn and Vernon emailed us the keyless access code to get into the apartment so there was no worries about late arrivals and such.   The apartment is large and spacious with all the amenities you would expect and they even stocked the fridge with some drinks and basics such as bread and cheese which was a lovely touch.  Dawn and Vernon checked in on us numerous times throughout the stay via email to make sure we didn't have any issues and to check everything was ok.  The street the apartment is located on is very quiet and suburban and the surrounding area has its own charm even if it's is a little rough around the edges in places compared to other areas of Brooklyn but at no point do you ever feel unsafe walking around day or night.  Travel connection are good with numerous subway stations within a 10-15 minute walk away to get you into Manhattan. Getting into Times Square takes about 45 minutes including walking to the station so although a little out of the way it is not a major inconvenience. Plus the trains run all through the night.  All in all this was a great stay and I would definitely recommend that people stay here as the apartment is tremendous value and Dawn and Vernon are great hosts

Ahmed was very welcoming and took the time to make sure we had everything we needed. He was not in town when we arrived, but called and gave us a tour of the place over the phone. He was easy to reach through text and phone and was eager to help us with any questions/problems we had.   The apartment itself is in a quiet area and is a good place to come back to after a long day of exploring the city. It's just a couple of blocks away from the subway and bus lines making getting around fairly easy. Many major tourist spots are walking distance away as well if you want to explore the city on foot. In a 20-30 min walking radius there is the United Nations building, Times Square, Grand Central Station and Central Park just to name a few. The neighborhood is also home to many great spots to eat (bagels, brunch, ramen, etc) and drug stores if you forgot to bring something.  I would not hesitate to stay here again on my next trip to Manhattan.
This place is a steal!! Sawn & Vernon are super accommodating. This is definitely a must rent !

Dawn & Vernon were great. I was traveling during the Covid 19 pandemic as an essential employee. They were very understanding of the continuously changing circumstances and accommodated as needed. They made me literally feel at home. Very private. I believe we only encountered one another accidentally when I was leaving. They were very quick to respond when needed.  The only con I would say was the fact that the area was a tad bit sketchy. That could very well just be my own personal opinion. I did not feel comfortable when out in the area, however, it was very quiet at night etc. It was not many people on the streets, but walking in a uniform, I received lots of glares walking to and fro the bus stop. This was my first time visiting actual neighborhoods in NY so I could have been going with an unrealistic expectation. Also, if you’re a light sleeper, the foot steps may bother you, but it wasn’t a huge deal for me. Nonetheless, they were great.

Big space, comfy bed, and super thoughtful touches from the hosts including a full fridge of drinks & a few grocery basics which we made use of. Note that this is a basement apartment that gets almost no natural light, but it is a very comfortable space with well-designed lighting to make up for that. Very close to Flatbush Ave which has a bunch of restaurants, supermarkets, bodegas & other amenities, and a short (10ish minutes walk) to a subway station where you can catch the 2 or 3 train to downtown Manhattan (approx. 40 mins). There is also a Q station a 15 minute walk or $6 - $8 Uber/Lyft away. If you're not used to big cities/New York in general the neighbourhood might seem a little dangerous or scary especially at night but I did not find this to actually be the case and never have in any of my stays in any of the suburbs of Brooklyn. Highly recommended!

Graham's apartment is a unique offering in Manhattan. A quiet spacious oasis, with every amenity you could wish for. The apartment is full of beautiful art and its design makes it the perfect venue for relaxing from the hustle and bustle of NYC. The bedroom is upstairs and has a large en suite. The bed is huge and incredibly comfortable.  In terms of location, Graham's place could not have been any better. We used Uber taxis and they were always with us within 2 mins. We also walked all over manhattan from our base. There are also 100s of excellent restaurants on either 2nd or 3rd ave, literally mins from the apartment.  We got married in NYC during our stay, and Graham's responsiveness took a lot of the stress out of our busy week. He actually worked check in/out times around our schedule, which I have never experienced before but was hugely appreciated.

Maureen is really sweet, nice, and accommodating! Her place is adorable and very well-decorated; plus, she has everything you'll need there for your stay! The location is amazing and literally everything is at your footsteps.  The famous cocktail bar Death & Co is nearby, too, so definitely check that out if you haven't been.  The apartment is pretty small (but, again, very cute), but chances are you'll mainly be roaming around the city.  It could be pretty noisy inside at night/early mornings, but some of that was caused by temporary construction.  I've lived in other cities and still had to use earplugs the whole time during my stay—you may or may not need to.  All in all, a great place and a great host!  But I cannot stress enough how nice and pleasant Mo was

Check in was easy and communication was prompt. Please be aware that despite the listing not mentioning this, the apartment has many other rooms rented on AirBnb  and other permanent residents than Amaya’s brother (who is quite nice by the way) so you will be bumping into a lot of people during your stay (there are five or six bedrooms in the apartment). The room was nice and the mattress was very comfortable. But one thing that was annoying was that the door to the bedroom is 80% glass instead of a solid wood door. It has curtains, but they don’t do an amazing job of blocking out light. As the bedroom is right next to the kitchen, there is a lot of light leak which kept us up when some of the permanent residents were up cooking onto the early hours of the morning. When this wasn’t happening though it was a comfortable room with a handy desk. The backyard was basically unusable as it was in quite a messy state.   The location is indeed only minutes walk from the train station which was great and it was a pretty quick trip into Manhattan. Our only concern was that it felt a little unsafe walking from the station at night due to the government housing flats across the road from the apartment. I know it’s New York so you have to expect that but we also stayed in some neighbourhoods further out on the same line that felt much safer to be in at night, so just putting it out there in case safety is a major concern for anyone. It was worth it for the convenience of the train station being that close though.   All in all this listing was fine but I wouldn’t recommend it for the price we paid.

Chris gave me a warm welcome & showed me around the apartment that is as comfortable as the listing describes. It was scrupulously clean & Chris has made a super thoughtful effort to provide everything a guest could want/need. The classic shady brownstone-lined block is in walking distance of all kinds of sites, shopping, fantastic restaurants & 3 nearby subways for transport to Manhattan, etc. I felt safe and happy, loved it!

Nice air bnb, comfortable stay. I was worried about a cat being there. Turns out, no cat during my stay :).   Had a  good time and I enjoyed my time and my trip. I think I spooked the brother Steve a few times. My brother and I almost gave him a hear attack when we were doing the laundry downstairs. It was really funny.

AVOID AND BEWARE. Not recommend. the host The apartment is good. However it is up 4 massive flights of stairs situated on the top floor of an old block. The noise,  even by nyc standards is unreal. Thin walls, where you can hear everything from the neighbours and outside in the street. Fire trucks and people make endless noise all night. Fire station is around the corner. Apartment was old and faulty light switches were throughout/ lights not even working. The heating system is centralised and thus you cannot control the timing,  heat or noise it makes at switchin him at 3-4 am. Sounds like it's going to explode! The area is lively with restaurants and bars and close to subways. A positive.  The owner is not to be trusted. We had an agreement re my partner staying and then he double backed on the agreement, after I had left the apartment and tried to claim money via Airbnb. Complete scam. He also tried to make me make private payments to his account which is not Airbnb policy. He also sent strange random texts whilst in the flat asking me to not touch his clothes or umbrell!!  Very awkward. The host did not meet me on arrival and I had to pick the keys up from a stranger down the street at night.  I was constantly asked by the neighbours who I was and where I stayed, which implies that the flat may not be allowed to be rented ( not certain). But it is still annoying being questioned. Furthermore, upon the day of leaving the host changed the check out time only by 30 mins, but still! Overall, a disappointing stay. the flat is in a good area, close to subway and bars and restaurants but I would not recommend anyone to stay because of the deceitful, rude and untrustworthy host;together with an old flat.

I cannot say enough about the location!  One block to the 6 train at Spring St station and only a couple blocks to the B, D, F, M (Broadway-Lafayette) or N, R, W at Prince St.  VERY easy to get around, and as a single woman I never felt unsafe walking in the neighborhood late at night.  5 blocks to Greenwich Village - a super easy walk.   All basic amenities were provided - nice towels and wash cloths. Toilet paper and paper towels as well as basic cooking utensils and pots/pans. I stayed for 5 nights over Thanksgiving week and very much appreciated those little touches. He also has lots of extra travel size shampoo, conditioner, soap and lotions! The water pressure in the shower was fine and I never had a hard time with getting hot water in there. The bed was comfy and blankets were not skimped on. The TV was great and nice to have a couch to sit on after a long day walking the city! Never had an issue with the Wifi. The place is 100% as pictured. The instructions he provided were clear and explained everything. Expect GREAT communication with Raynald.    Things to be aware of, and note NONE of this is due to Raynald's negligence.  It's just things I noticed that I thought future travelers would benefit from knowing:  There is no microwave.  In Raynald's defense, he did not list a microwave in the amenities. I just assumed "full kitchen" meant a microwave in addition to fridge and stove top and oven. That took me by surprise, but it's my own fault for not reading the amenities close enough.  As other reviewers have noted, the unit itself is pretty quiet *considering it's location*.  I am very sensitive to sounds when trying to sleep, that's one of the main reasons i booked this spot was the reviews said it is quiet (a rare gem in Manhattan).  And it is, externally. Inside the apartment there are weird tapping, popping and hissing noises all night long. Tapping and popping seemed to be coming from the walls/ base boards? The hissing came from the heater. Even when I turned it all the way off, the hissing continued at odd intervals all night. It is positioned next to the bed, so the hissing would wake me up. It was not as restful and quiet as I thought it would be.  However - if you are a heavy sleeper you'll probably do just fine. Considering the location, it's probably quieter than most other options. There are no loud bars on the street below - the windows face an interior courtyard.  Also as other reviewers have mentioned - the unit is a 4th floor walk up.   Not horrible, but definitely something to keep in mind if stairs are not your thing or if you'll have a ton of luggage to hump up the stairs (as I did LOLOL).   The week I was there - a jack hammer would start at 8am every morning.  It would go until about noon. I don't know where it was positioned but I could hear it in every corner of the apartment...this is obviously no fault of Raynald's and may not be an issue in a month or even a couple weeks, but it was quite jarring every morning to wake up and start my day to that.  Overall, a good value for your money!  The location really cannot be beat. Raynald is a great host!

This small basement apartment offered us a really cheap place to stay, that was a little way from Manhattan Island.  It is located between two subway lines which offered frequent subway trains in to the city, after either a 9 or 12 minute walk .  The trip from door to Manhattan usually took around 45 minutes.  The area in which it is located, is quiet, friendly and attractive.  With shops not too far away, offering a good range of services.  Most importantly for us it offered good proximity to Riis Beach/Landing from where we went whale watching, and Brighton beach/Coney Island.  The main attraction to this particular AirBnB property was that fact it was cheap.  This then allowed us to have a longer time in NY.  Where if we had stayed in Manhattan itself we would of had a much shorter and more expensive stay.  Therefore it was great valve for money.  However...  The pictures do not offer the close up view of how rough this place is around the edges.  The finish of the apartment, whilst generally clean, was cheaply unkempt with poorly fitted doors, rough plaster work in various places and a gas oven in the kitchen that always had a smell of leaking gas around it when it was not in use.  The refrigerator  motor was incredibly noisy, which kept me awake the first few nights.  The main cupboard in the common area smelt so damp we never put over clothes in it for fear that they would end up smelling to.  The bed was very comfortable and the shower was magnificent, it was like standing under a warm waterfall.  However being in the basement, whoever in the house above got up at around 4am every morning and walked about, you could hear every foot step.  The people in the room above were not noisy per say,  no loud music, talking or banging... but you can hear every footstep, and that happens right above the bed.  This did not make for a pleasant nights sleep.  In the pictures you may have picked up on a small lattice work running across above the bed.  This houses the heating pipes for what I guess is the houses heating system.  Every time the heating came on the pipe would heat rapidly and make a rather loud ticking noises as, I assume, they expanded.  Again, this, combined with the noisy fridge and footstep led to more loss of sleep.  The final and worst issue was COCKROACHES.  We had several moments where we found some scuttling around the floor.  With on one memorable and scary moment where one fell from the aforementioned lattice work on the the floor right by the bed.  Needless to say this scared the wits out of my wife.  I have no major issue with insects, but I did not appreciate having them in accommodation I had paid good money for and expected a certain degree of cleanliness and no pest infestations.  I have given 3 stars, as this apartment offered us a cheap and great base to explore NY from.  Unfortunately it lacked horribly in several areas.  Honestly? I won't be returning or recommending this place to friends.

We stayed for a week and had a great time. It's not luxurious but very comfortable. The price-quality ratio is very, very good. The neighborhood is very safe. Close to the metro (5min walk from the Q line). Independent entrance. It takes about 40 minutes to be in Manhattan center by public transport. As specified in the advert, we are in the basement of a house that provides daycare. Indeed that's understandable but we weren't there to sleep in so it didn't bother us. Very pleasant, accommodating and discreet owner. The lady speaks French which was very pleasant after the stress of arriving in New York.

We had such a wonderful experience at Amy's! We spent the weekend there with another couple to celebrate a 30th birthday and it was wonderful. We felt like it was our own home by the end of the weekend. Amy was so, so accommodating during our time there and we couldn't be more thankful. I definitely recommend the house to anyone who is looking for the experience of a real family home. While a bit out of the way, we never felt unsafe, and could walk to downtown Fort Greene and take a short Uber trip to Williamsburg.

Amy has always been very responsive and very attentive to our needs in her emails. Everything was ready for our arrival: the beds were made, and there were even little welcome gifts! There was also a welcome booklet with how the house works and information about the neighborhood (shops, restaurants, metro, etc.) The house conforms to the description, we felt comfortable there. The neighborhood is "in transition", as Amy had explained to us, but we never felt unsafe, even returning from the metro after midnight.

Lynn is absolutely awesome! And Adam is pretty much the best best cat ever! I got lots of extra snuggles thanks to him. For me it was basically the perfect location since I needed to be a few blocks away on 5th Ave for work. It was my 1st air bnb and experience and it start off rocky (not bc of Lynn but another place cancelled on me and was reported on other sites as a scam) but bc of Lynn and Adam I will be trying this service again. I also I tend to do this trip once or twice and year and Lynn and Adam will always be my 1st choice!

Todd's apartment was even better than illustrated in the pictures. It contained everything you could need. The kitchen was fully equipped, the installations worked perfectly and it was very conveniently located for last minute errands or catching the train to the city or nearby hip strips. At no given point did we feel unsafe roaming the neighborhood at nighttime and whenever an inquiry arose, Todd was highly responsive and eager to cooperate with us. Never did we feel overwhelmed with numerous check ins from the host nor were we expected to meet unrealistic demands. The requirements were Pretty standard such as: cleanliness etc. Would we book this apartment again for a future trip? Absolutely!

Todd's place is perfect! Right near about everything you could want but still on a peaceful strip of road. Upon arriving Todd was already there waiting for me and was incredibly communicative in the days leading to my arrival. Once I got there I was greeted by a down to earth intelligent guy kind enough to put his place on the market for people like myself to stay in. We spoke for about half an hour before he took off and right then I knew I was in good hands. Thanks Todd for making a stressful weekend in the city a lot more livable!!

In general, the neighborhood is not as dangerous or bad because it is Harlem, so that should not lead you to not choose this apartment either. It is located in East Harlem, the largest community is Hispanic, everyone speaks Spanish.  The subway is 5 minutes 116 with Lexington being the subway 6. Which makes you reach Manhattan in about 15 minutes. If you have a problem, Helga will try to solve it for you, she will not be on the floor, it is a 5 without an elevator.  The worst thing about the apartment is undoubtedly the cleanliness, dirty sheets with hair and the kitchen with cockroaches. If you remove or improve that, the overall stay would have been more pleasant, since we only slept on the floor and visited the city during the day.

Eva's charming apartment is in the vibrant SoHo neighborhood.  I truly enjoyed my room.  However, the most challenging part of my stay was Eva herself.    While Eva is a passionate and intelligent lady, her eccentricities made for an unpleasant stay.  For example, during my stay I took a shower.  To my mistake, I had forgot to close the shower curtain and the shower doors became wet.  After my shower, I decided to dry the doors off with a towel hanging on the shower door.  What I had not known, and what Eva had failed to communicate, was that the towel I was using was her face/hand towel.  This minor misunderstanding escalated to Eva repeatedly scolding me for using "her towel," including Eva entering my room to yell at me hours after this event.    While Eva and I eventually hugged our frustrations out, her initial and continued reaction was uncalled for and alarmed me as a guest.  I still recommend this apartment, but I hope future guests do not encounter Eva's untempered reactions.

We stayed at Sophie's place for a week.  We told Sophie and her partner Ariff (sic?) the times that we wanted to check-in and check-out, and they accommodated us without any problems.  The apartment itself was great - clean, bright, and well-stocked; it accommodated four people quite comfortably.  We visited in August and the found the AC unit and fans kept the apartment at a comfortable temperature.  The neighbourhood itself was as advertised - a little rough around the edges but, in our experience, never unsafe.

The apartment was clean, tidy and had all the necessities. The description on the website was accurate and the pictures give a good impression of the place. We picked the place since it has two queen sized beds. To us this was a big plus, since we traveled with two adult couples. Most apartments have at least one double bed.  The apartment is on the 1st floor, so you have to carry your luggage (and shopping) up one flight of stairs.  Sophie is a very friendly and helpful hostess. She was waiting at the apartment when we arrived. During our stay she gave us a lot of useful information about places to go and things to do.  We had to check out at noon and our plane didn't leave till 9 pm. Sophie was kind enough to let us keep our luggage at the apartment so we could enjoy our last day in New York till the end.  The neighborhood took a little time to get used to. It is quite noisy on the weekends with loud music and a fire house a block away. The streets are littered, even though we saw people cleaning the walkways in front of their houses. On the other hand the people were very friendly and said  hello when you walked down the street. Despite the noise we never felt unsafe, even walking back to the apartment late at night.  There is a supermarket about 5 minutes away, and at least 4 deli shops. And there are plenty of restaurants in the area. There is a laundromat a block away if you want to do laundry.  The nearest subway station is about 10 minutes walking away. The train takes your straight to Manhattan in approximately 30 minutes. You can walk an extra 3 blocks to the express train which goes more often and takes 5 to 10 minutes less to get to the city. Once in the city, the round trip time to the apartment and back is to long for a short break at the apartment. We just spend the whole day in the city. If we wanted to do something at night we left later in the day. The one thing that surprised us, was the fact that there was no house phone at the apartment. Sophie helped us out by calling a cab and offering to call take out our first night.

Apartment it's self was nice and cozy.  Sophie was kind enough to install a larger air conditioner which helped a lot when it got really hot, fans were usually enough to keep us comfortable at night.  There was a grocery store really close by which was nice and though the remaining food options are pretty limited (Chinese takeout, Great Caribbean/Jerk, some Indian and Fast Food), at least everything is very cheap!  I would not recommend this location for yuppies which is exactly what I am and I imagine a lot of people on AirBNB are.  I definitely felt out of place walking around this neighborhood in my stereotypical white guy outfit (khaki shorts, polo T, sandals and raybans).  People were mostly all very nice, but this is definitely a neighborhood at the cusp of gentrification and I was an outsider here and got a lot of suspicious stares, though I made a few friends as well (lots of people just hang out on their stoops so you can say hello and chat if you stay long enough).  Research the neighborhood ahead of time, if you're alright with that then you'll find a nice and cozy apartment that is reasonably priced and Sophie and her husband are also very accomadating hosts.  If on the other hand you need to walk outside and expect to find coffee shop, whole foods, yoga studios, etc, keep your search west of Nostrand.

Sophie was a very good, caring host. She always asked via WhatsApp whether we had everything, whether we needed anything else, whether we wanted tips. She organized our departure to the airport and gave precise instructions about various ways to get to the apartment on the day of arrival. The apartment was sufficient for us (4 people), exactly as stated in the description. We felt very comfortable there, but we were only there in the evenings because we were in Manhattan during the day. The area is clean, but takes a bit of getting used to for Europeans. But we never felt unsafe. Two different subway lines are nearby, which can be reached quickly with a short walk. A nice place to stay in New York.

The apartment was just as it looks - big,  bright,  clean,  well-stocked and amazingly quiet. It's really easy for transport - so many options very close by. Not so great for cafes/shops/bars but there's fast food, delis and a supermarket within seconds. Sophie was really helpful, gave us LOADS of recommendations and went out of her way to make our stay as stress-free as possible!!

Very nice apartment, charming and clean. well located to be quickly in the city center with the subway very close. French, we were a little afraid to rent in this area which is actually quiet. Good value for money. Perfect for visiting New York. We had a great time. We recommend.  Appartement  très sympa, avec du charme et propre. bien situé pour être rapidement en centre ville avec le métro très proche. Français, nous avions un peu peur de louer dans ce quartier qui en fait est calme. Bon rapport qualité / prix. Parfait pour visiter New-York. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour. Nous recommandons.

Apartment nestled in the heart of Harlem. Many convenient stores and subway is nearby. Neighborhood is a little sketchy and streets are dirty. But, if you’re only looking for a place to rest while being out all day exploring the city it’s a good spot. Clean, and cozy.

Francesca was there when we arrived. Apartment was not quite ready. Apartment shabby. Far too shabby. Very poor internet. Dirty bed linen. Noisy air conditioning. Out dated kitchen equipment. Only one tv which was in the second bedroom! 14 cockroaches killed in 6 days. Bugs and spiders everywhere. No keys to lock main bedroom door to the garden. This is hugely dangerous. Single bed in second bedroom. Poor security main door. Broken light bulbs all over the apartment

If you get the opportunity to stay in this luxurious apartment on the upper West side don’t miss it! A very spacious and comfortable apartment; well located and well appointed as far as bedding and towels being top notch; great showers and everything you might need was at our fingertips.  We had fun regrouping in the lavish parlor both morning and night.   The lovely private garden is such a rare treat as well.    Groceries, food, spirits, drug stores, subway, museums, restaurants and good live music are within easy walking distance.   This apartment is one of a kind and we thought it was fantastic!    It’s important to note that Francesca is a Superior hostess as well! :-)

Giovani and his family were very responsive and helpful as from the first day.  The appartement was clean and everything was in good order for our arrival. The flat is located near a subway station (5min walking distance) as well as a supermarkt (end of the street). Manhattan (1 av) can be reached in 15 min by subway.  The appartment is roomier but less luxurious than it is in picture (although it is not meant for this). It is a good alternative if you want to avoid the prohibitive prices of Manhattan while having a well connected place to stay.  Bushwick was historically a rough neighborhood but is today a safer place. We never felt unsafe walking down the street at night ( of course I would not recommend to hang out around in the street at 2 AM with flashy stuff but this is true for any large cities).  The last day Giovani was kind enough to arrange the transportation for us back to the airport.  I would recommend Giovani's place.

The apartment is just as in the photographs, the bed is comfortable but the sofa bed is too uncomfortable. There were 4 of us and we had to take turns on the bed. Regarding the cleanliness of the apartment, comment that it was not as we would have liked and with respect to sheets and towels, if you are going to be staying for long periods like us, only leave 1 for each one. Regarding the area, it seemed a little unsafe, but we didn't have any problems with anyone. Regarding the subway, it has a good combination to go to the center of Manhattan.

We stayed for 6 nights on a recent holiday to New York. In general, we were a little disappointed with the room as we felt it wasn't quite as advertised. It was really more like a hostel than a private room and had we have known this we would have booked a hostel or hotel in Manhattan and saved ourselves the travelling.  But first the positives...   DeVika and her family are very nice and communication was always very easy and pleasant. We didn't see them very much because we were always out but the few times we did they seemed very nice. The self check in with the security code was also very nice and easy.  Getting into Manhattan was about a 20 minute subway trip, the subway runs 24/7 so there's never a danger of getting stranded. To get to the subway it's about a 10 minute walk which for us wasn't a problem and the area seems to be quite safe. All the essentials; towels, linen etc. are provided.  On our last day we had an afternoon flight and it also wasn't a problem that we leave our luggage in the apartment so that we could see the city one last time.  There were a few things that we didn't like. The apartment is located directly next to a major, very busy road and the noise at night was very bad. We had to sleep with earplugs but some nights we could still hear the traffic and it goes all night. Also the common areas, in particular the kitchen and bathroom are pretty dirty. The bathroom and kitchen is shared with at least 4 other rooms and while it's obviously not the hosts fault that some of the other guests are not the most hygienic people, we didn't really feel that it was made clear when booking that the apartment would be shared with so many other people. This also resulted in a very long wait in the mornings to use the bathroom, usually we waited at least 1-1.5 hours. There is a second smaller room with just a toilet, however the lock is broken on this room.  The apartment wasn't really what we were expecting and we were a little disappointed that it was more like a hostel but if you are only looking for an affordable place to stay with a decent connection to the city then it would be OK.

Giovani's apartment was exactly what we were looking for and wanted for our 6 night stay in NYC. It's just how it looks in the photos and is in a fantastic location. Neat, tidy, quiet and stylish, the apartment is close to the subway, pharmacies and supermarket. It's close to Manhattan (an easy trip on the subway) but far enough away to escape the hustle and bustle of the city. We came back to the apartment quite late most nights and didn't at all feel unsafe walking from the subway to the apartment. Although we didn't meet Giovani in person, he was always quick to respond to our queries by email and text. We couldn't find Netflix on the television, but we only tried to watch the first night, and didn't ask Giovani about it (we were just too tired each night). Highly recommended Airbnb host. We would definitely stay here again!

Erika and Abhik's place was in a very good location, it was very easy to access Manhattan and was in safe neighborhood. The house was very clean and comfortable. Hosts were easy to access and replied to my messages promptly. The house was not warm enough for me and not having a key at first arrival and having to wait for someone to come in accessing the building was  a bit stressful.

What positive things can I say about Lane's Williamsburg Luxury locale in Brooklyn?  Absolutely everything!  Lane was very understanding before, during and after our visit. We were communicating a lot before our stay and his replies were always quick and exact. We informed him prior to our trip that that we'd arrive late, and he was very understanding and flexible.  Although we did not meet Lane in person (due to our lateness and his own prior engagement) he sent detailed instructions to my AirBNB inbox, and left more instructions with the doorman, including additional tips on how to operate the tech in his place and recommendations on what to do in the Williamsburg area (And how to operate that tricky private elevator switch. :P)  The place was JUST you've all seen in the pictures. Absolutely perfect, spotless, warm and welcoming, and gosh, so spacious!  To quote my own message I sent Lane after our stay:  "Your place was like a page from an urban fairy tale, and just absolutely stunning." It truly was a great place and helped make the experience of our 4 year anniversary even more special. :)  Lane even left us complementary wine and chocolates!  As for the neighborhood, Williamsburg is the new melting pot of NYC. Such an awesome area to roam free and get lost on purpose, where you can discover so many things with just simply turning a random corner. Food, bars, stores, movie theaters, clubs, food trucks, music, people... I can go on and on about how this is the PLACE to be.  Its safe, people are friendly, and its something you can't pass up!  To wrap up this review, Lane is simply just an amazing host and just so awesome.
