To Mark, our best wishes, we thank him so much, his naugthy dogs were really cute haha. - Amigos que gran opción esta ¡ No lo pienses tanto ¡ háganlo y disfrútenlo.

Great hosts. They were so responsive, when My sister and I landed at 5 am and had to get keys before they left for work. They had their dog walker wait on us, which was so nice of them. Overall, comfortable stay, no issues whatsoever with the room or apartment. However, the location was slightly inconvenient for us, being two girls, we had to take Uber’s back at night since we didn’t really feel too safe in the neighborhood. This isn’t the fault of hosts, we should have done the research and obviously we got a great price, so not complaining. But If it’s single girls traveling, just be aware that the neighborhood can be noisy at times at night, and a few homeless people might cat call or harass you during the day on a walk to the metro(5 min walk). But like I mentioned, Hosts were amazing, made us feel at home, just the area was sketchy, that’s all.

Mark and Will’s place is a cozy, welcoming home, full of quirky touches and creatively thought-out decor.   The girlfriend and I booked the property for a week-long stay in New York and were very satisfied with the accommodation provided.   At less than half an hour from Times Square by train, it’s a steal for the price, and is located in an area which, in time, may very well become one of New York’s trendiest neighbourhoods.  Mark and Will are fab hosts and made our stay all the more enjoyable!

The apartment is a little further away, but great value for money. We only had problems at the entrance. It was quite stuffy in the room, and the blinds didn't close the entire window, leaving light coming in early on. When we questioned the host, he told us to look for another place in NYC, but it was too high, and we had no way of leaving, so we stuck it out. We bought a fan and put blankets on the window to try to block out the light. Despite the fear of being left without a place to sleep in NYC, otherwise it was ok.

Jamie's place is a great find. Her and her roommate are both very accomodating, above and beyond really. It was the best I have been treated by a host. The room is very comfortable with a great view of the Manhattan skyline. The neighborhood was fantastic with great restaurants, a big beautiful park, shady streets, laid back coffee shops, and everything else you could need close by. Almost too hip to be as cool and unpretentious as it is

What a great, easy experience. I will definitely pass on Amy & Ali's airbnb info for my family & friends who come to visit NYC. It's a great location, clean, cozy, & has nice, good energy. Plenty of pots & pans for cooking. A great gym located a block away. Groceries across the street. Tons of great restaurants & delivery. Everything right there. Amy & Ali were prompt & excellent communicators. Overall a very easy, low key, stress free experience.  I personally love the twin bed, with the additional twin bed underneath. It's cozy & perfect for the space of the apartment. & yes, it can be rather sweet for couples. My Love Seigo & I actually slept together on the twin one night. I'm usually a person who needs tons of space, so it was surprisingly nice!   It's well lit by the sun, which is wonderful. Also wonderful are the blinds which block out the sun & allow for great sleep!   Down comforter & pillows were much appreciated. Very comfortable!   & obviously, it's Important to keep noise to a minimum & be respectful. Buildings in Chelsea & the west village, sound can travel & we didn't want to disturb the neighbors. We never heard any neighbors at all, no noise, except walking by the lower floor apartment where a dog would briefly bark.   Highly recommend Amy & Ali's place if you want a quiet, cozy, sunny, unpretentious, well located Chelsea apartment!

Dorion's place is exactly as described. Our first impression was how clean it looked and smelled. He even put water in the fridge, which was a very nice gesture. It is well-equiped, though if you plan on cooking for more than two it can be a little challenging. He's got a very cool entrance system, so you don't even have to worry about carrying around keys. The apartment is on basement level, which might be something to consider if you have issues with bugs like me (during our stay we found a huge cockroach inside the apartment and then another one dead outside the apartment, in the porch), considering that New York is not the cleanest city. Beds were super comfy, which is always something to keep in mind in a place where you know you are going to be walking a lot. The apartment in general is very well-equiped, has plenty of furniture and he even provides clean towels and toiletries. There's a train station at about three blocks from the place which takes you to Manhattan in about 30 minutes. The area where the apartment is located is not the greatest. We have stayed before in Long Island City and Queens and it was definetly better. This area is not the cleanest or the safest. We personally did not have an issue, but if you are not used to moving around dark areas and not so touristie this might be an issue, since it does give out a bit of the shady vibe. I would just recommend being alert. Finally, when it comes to parking we did not have issues with it. You just need to be aware of the signs for cleaning hours, and though at some hours it was a bit more difficult to find a spot, we always manage to find one. I would highly recommend staying at Dorion's, especially if you are a large group and plan on renting the whole place.

Sean is a great host and an even better guy. We needed 2 extra people to stay one night on late notice to make it a total of 5 people and he was more than accommodating. We basically took up his entire place and he was happy with it. His place is clean and is easy to get to the subway system, which I suggest you use. You can spend a $100 a day trying to uber/lyft around, or 15 on the subway. The location is in a little sketchy part of Harlem, at least from what we saw, but we didn't have any issues and we walked around a bunch. For the location to Central Park and the city and the for the price, you can't beat it.

Lois is the most lovely, kind hearted air b'n'b host that you are ever likely to have the pleasure of meeting. I can not thank her and her family enough for all they did for myself and my boyfriend. Loid was our saviour in more ways than one. Firstly she accommodated us after a last minute booking, we were staying at a different air b'n'b where we felt unsafe and needed to move ASAP. Lois and Eddie made us feel very welcome. The area is great for visiting NYC and Manhattan but also gives you the opportunity to get away from the hussel and bussel and live like a local. Convenient for public transport and close to lots of restaurants/takeways/coffee shops/pharmacy etc. Secondly, my boyfriend Sam got food poisoning whilst we were visiting (from a hotdog stand in the city not from Lois' delicious breakfast). Lois was so kind and caring and treated Sam like he was family to make sure he got better. She brought him medicine and food and generally went above and beyond what we ever expected from a host. Lois we will miss your stories but will keep in contact as you have now have two friends from across the pond that think you are a very special lady! Thank you so much!

What you should expect is what you see in the photos, a beautiful, super decorated apartment, everything impeccable, in a location, close to the subway which is very important, the area is Brooklyn, you have to be clear about that, at first it may seem somewhat lonely but I assure you that it is very safe, with my 16 year old daughter we returned at 2 am many times and we walked without any problem the 6 blocks that separated us from the subway and always very well, I clarify this because the Argentines We are always afraid of that and at first it can feel dangerous, because it is so lonely, but it is very safe!!! Otherwise the apartment is ideal for two people!! 100% RECOMMENDABLE

Was given the wrong passcode to access the building. Due to flight delays did not get to the unit until 1:30am. Attempted to enter code provided, did not work, took until 3am until Airbnb and Jeniffer responded. Had a leaky toilet, put in a maintenance request, and was locked out because I was not provided all the keys to my door. Had multiple packages stolen, when asked to have them review the camera to ensure they were even delivered, was told they weren't responsible for stolen packages. Security cameras are a ruse, they do not work, laundry has 1 working dryer. Only extending my stay as my current home is under renovation and all my things are here. Would have cancelled my extension otherwise.

We really enjoyed our stay here at Yukis apartment. It really is just as the pictures indicate. Everything is new and looks like it was recently renovated. I honestly can't think of any negatives about the apartment. At the low pricepoint it is really a bargain. The street is really cute with trees and brownstones. In the morning I walked down to nagles bagels for coffe and of course... a bagel. On the walk over I was really happy how almost everyone I walked by was nice and said hello, I even had an extended conversion with one of the neighbors. My whole idea of using Air BnB is to stay in a real neighborhood and get away from sterile hotels. Mission Accomplished. Try to use the G Line train if your going to be walking to avoid a longer walk to the A Train. While we never technically felt unsafe walking back to the place from either line late at night, the walk back from G Line is shorter and seemed to feel less sketchy late at night. We would definitely stay here again if we find our self back in the area. Parking Alert: pay close attention to street parking signs. If you bring a car everyone goes outside and has to move their car over and double park to let the street sweeper through. I missed the time and got $45 fine.

We had a blast! Yuki went above and beyond to make our stay so special like being at home and being so responsive and helpful. What a lovely, clean and modern house situated on a neat, shady tree lined neighborhood. The new bench outside was so relaxing to just sit and enjoy the scenery. Fun park for kids not too far away either. Close enough to walk to the subway! Great corner super markets had all of our amazing vegan, specialty allergy friendly food which made my mouth drop.  Nice surprise. Friendly neighbors too! We will stay here again when in NYC. 😊 Thanks!

Nice host. Nice room. Nice area. If you visit nyc at first time, you can enjoy just as native new yorker. Susan's room is close to the supermarket, restaurant, hall, entertainment, museum, station, all of fun!  And No danger. I truly recommend!

Location Location Location. Susan's little jewel box is right in the middle of everywhere you want to be, only it's somehow on a quiet shady street. Susan is a terrific hostess and she gave us some really good tips about her neighborhood. It was so nice to be out all day and then to come home to peace and quiet in a super clean apartment with a really comfy bed. We had a terrific time and would stay here again in a heartbeat.

Great host, great room and great location. You can either use subway or bus and have easy access to anywhere. This apartment doesn’t have elevators but luckily only 2nd floor. It gets kind of creepy at night but mostly safe place even if you are alone. I would definitely recommend here!

This was a pretty good airbnb stay.   Pros: modern, renovated space with high ceilings, great central AC, good natural night, and, a futon couch for any guests that may stay with you. Also the host and his assistant Pierre were great at communication. Also a great grocery store around the corner with wine, fresh produce, and fun snacks.   Cons: pretty unsafe location that was unfit for two girls in their 20s- requiring that we uber once it was dark and feel anxiety most of the time on our block (crackheads and dealers nearby). Not AT ALL the fault of the hosts -- place itself it wonderful-- but if you decide to stay here, would recommend to men/couples/groups and be aware of your surroundings! <3

Nice apartment in a safe house. Rooms were nice, kitchen had everything you needed and washer and dryer were very useful. We had a major roach problem, which hopefully has now been resolved after two exterminators. Location is very good, but too dangerous for women to go out alone in the evening. Pierre was very friendly and helpful.
If you’re coming for the location it’s in a great spot. Otherwise host made false accusations of objects being stolen/ damaged in the apartment which was completely false.

Good location and nice apartment. Be careful, however, with luggage: no elevator and you will have to vacate the premises at 11 a.m. on the day of departure (not practical if your return flight is in the evening)

I had a great 3 day stay. The hotel is really ideally located. Indeed, the metro is right next door and there are lots of things you can do on foot, including getting to Time Square. It's calm and I never felt unsafe.  The staff is super friendly. I arrived really early (8 a.m.), and I was able to leave my stuff while waiting for check-in and the same for when I left, I was able to leave my stuff for the day while waiting for my bus, which was at 11 p.m.  The room is perfect and clean. We should just provide trash bags, because the small trash can fills up quite quickly.  You should also remember that you need a $50 deposit per key card and tourist taxes to be paid at checkout. Once again I had an excellent stay! :D I really recommend rental!

I would love to say that a have a great time at Jonathan’s but the true is that it wasn’t the case... Pros: nice room and well equipped, easy to access, easy to move around Manhattan, the metro is really close and there were many stores available all the time. Cons: there were roaches in the apartment, the air conditioned was inside the room which means that it didn’t work properly( it colds and heats at the same time) and I would like to let know to any voyager that this should be a one night stay only room.. why? Here is the reason: THIS GOT TO BE THE WORST NEIGHBORHOOD EVER! People are so noise over there that I wasn’t able to sleep or even take a nap in my whole stay. It is located in little Dominican Republic and this people have ZERO respect for the sleep of others, people blast their music 24/7, ride their bikes and cars with the loudest scape tubes that I have ever listen in Mily life; there is a vegetable refrigerated truck that stay up all night running  just in front of the apartment every single night(it was incredibly noisy); also the weekend people party in the streets. And to top it up the homeless and drug addicts take over the streets during the night, crying, yelling and fighting each other.

The location is very convenient and easy to get around town, easy access to the subway and major attractions yet in a bit of a sketchy area. The apartment smells damp, the lighting is not very good. Bedding not great and there is no second sheet on the bed and was not provided as requested. There is one smoke alarm which I am not sure was working (no indication light on), for safety reasons there should be smoke/CO2 alarm in the apartment. Overall ok value, not great and I won't book again.

Frances was so incredible, attentive and accommodating during our entire stay. We went to NY for vacation but had to stay longer due to unforeseen circumstances. Needless to say incredibly stressful situation. It was perfect and so cute and clean! Highly recommend!

Very convenient location, close to all tourist facilities. The rooms are compact in size, but are equipped with a kitchen and a shower with ample hot water. The hosts were very helpful and lent us a spare key for the duration of our stay. Somewhat unsafe at night. 綺麗で便利。日本の方にもお勧めします。

However the apartment was clean and spacious, we experienced terrible noise during the night and morning (starting at 4 pm!) coming from a large air extractor that was placed on the roof of the kitchen.  Not ‘ normal NY city-noise’ , but terrible noise, making sleeping nearly impossible and staying in the kitchen and sitting room very unpleasant. Besides, the host denied the problem and only communicated after we contacted Airbnb support. We left the apartment!
This apartment is a STEAL for the price. Corey was lovely and super helpful. The apartment was very clean and exactly as pictured, probably better. Grab this place before it’s gone!

Had such a great stay here! Exactly like the photos. Moved from out of state for work and booked this place while I explored neighborhoods/apartments for the month. So easy to get everywhere and you have all the essentials nearby. Apartment is very charming and equipped with the essentials. As a young woman staying on my own, I never felt unsafe! Olivia was a fantastic host and communicator. Couldn’t recommend highly enough!

The apartment was super comfortable, clean, and quiet. All of the appliances worked really well, and the bed was cozy. The AC was super effective in the summer.  The neighborhood around the building felt a little unsafe at night, unfortunately, so I avoided walking outside alone. The building itself feels very secure though.

The apartment is very comfortable for 2 people to stay and work from. The standup desk was great for working, kitchen was well equipped (even with some snacks and lots of condiments/seasonings), beautiful deck and balcony, and felt very safe. Overall, it felt and looked better than the pictures.   The only slight downfall is the location because it’s surrounded by multiple projects and a rehab center. We never felt unsafe or had any issues. But the area was always dirty (poop on sidewalks every few feet) and felt more so up and coming. Nevertheless, I’d stay again!

Rob was a gracious host. Checking in and out was a breeze. His apartment was big enough for two people to live comfortably and was in a great location that made it easy to access the rest of the city.

I had an incredible 2 month stay at Robert’s place! Check in process was smooth, and Rob was  very reliable with his responses regarding any questions I had about the apartment.  I enjoyed the location as it was a 30 second walk to the Q and close to many amazing restaurants. The apartment itself was stocked with everything I could need, an amazing TV in the living room, fully updated bathroom, and very comfy bed.   Rob was a great host and I am already looking forward to my next trip to the city.

The area around the accommodation is quiet and there are no homeless people. The host was very nice and kindly explained every time I asked about the questions while living in the apartment. And I love the big TV. I experienced a very comfortable STAY in my life for a month!

The place was amazing and parking wasn't so hard but as soon as I got into to building to use the bathroom that was freshly remodeled  by the way the seat moved and cracked, I lifted the seat up to investigate there was a bult missing from the right side of the seat which caused it to slip; instead of hiding it or replacing it myself I told him as soon as it happened and he told me unbelievable prices, I offered to fix it by buying the seat he needed and put it on but he insisted on over charging me, plus he stated there was a fee of $35 or $38 per additional guest per night given that all my guest accounted for on my airbnb recipe. I called airbnb to verify all this information and they stated the price I paid online was final and the incident can be disputed  with the evidence that I have ONLY DEAL DIRECTLY THRU AIRBNB, this gave me a piece of mind bc I felt like I was about to be robbed. This was my 1st ever airbnb and my last due to this experience I explained this to a cop he even said next time to book a hotel New York was full of people that will take advantage of you. I didn't think it was true until it happened to me this was my 1st visit and I will definitely go back just in a hotel next.
Ariel is very communicative and informative. This stay is in a sketchy area but the airbnb itself was very, very nice and safe. A perfect place to stay for a weekend in NY:)

This apartment has it all! Unbeatable location (cannot stress this enough), well furnished and extremely clean apartment, great amenities, thoughtful notes throughout the house... the hosts thought every single thing a guest might need. I'd love to stay here again during any future trip to NYC.

We loved this cozy little place. It was BEAUTIFUL, even more so than the pictures. The wallpaper was a personal favorite. It was so close to a great pizza place, a great corner store for bagels, and the train (super thankful for that). All instructions were clear. We had one issue and the owners were super quick to respond. I never felt unsafe in the neighborhood and we got home at 12 AM one night!

Questioning other reviews.  I stay at airbnbs all the time & I read every review. Pro - comfortable beds/pillows.  CONS Unsafe area, unclean, rats when you walk in or out of the front door, cockroaches found  in the unit.  Sheets /towels stained, sheets to the point we had to ask for them to be changed.  Dirty sock found in the end of the lower bunk bed when we went to bed.  My family of 5 all said the most disappointing Airbnb we’ve ever stayed we were glad we left at 8am and returned around 11pm every day. Pictures are the best part.  The unit was dirty, it may receive a min surface clean in between guests as you can see at the end of the sofa the vacuum doesn’t go under the sofa.  Every surface was dusty or not thoroughly cleaned.  Hair found in drawers and floor, on linens. The area this is located is extremely dirty, run down and felt unsafe in the day and evening.  The unit had left over food in fridge, left over coffee grinds in coffee maker, a gross sponge & supplies missing.

I wanted a place for our family of 4 to stay in downtown Manhattan, without being squeezed into one small hotel room, or having to pay for 2 separate rooms. This rental fit the bill exactly. The King size in the master is really comfortable, the room is large enough for a family of 4 over packers, and the 2 twins are a day bed with  comfortable mattresses, versus a pull out sofa - which my teen girls appreciated.  The location to walking around Chelsea, the High Line and easy subway access was ideal, even for late night runs to Joe's pizza in the village.  The apartment has big has windows at the front and the back, so it didn't feel dark and we never felt unsafe.  You're not getting a fancy hotel with big windows overlooking the city (which at first my girls were expecting) , but you will get a taste of being in a NYC neighborhood and away from the crowds of times square.

The area where the room is located feels a little unsafe and is about 40 minutes from Manhattan. If you travel to NY, it is preferable to rent something from that side.  The bathroom is shared and there is a wait to use it.   The communication with the hostess was not very assertive, since we had asked her to deliver the room after the check-out time, to which she agreed, but later in the morning she asked us to vacate the room without prior notice since she had not correctly read our request, which had been clearly written.

I would love to share that we really enjoyed our stay at this AirBnb! Roy was extremely prompt in communicating & responding  to us and providing some great suggestions on places/eateries to go to. We would definitely choose to stay at this AirBnb again. The only 2 cons were the ant infestation in the kitchen (he did offer to bring products by to help rid but we opted to just kept it clean. I’m sure he will rectify this asap) and we would’ve liked to have known someone was living beneath us (she scared us when she walked out the back door but no other issues). We did break a house rule (ran the washer after quiet hours) but he was very understanding and we apologized as I completely forgot. Other than those minute things, I would definitely suggest staying here. It was comfortable, in a quiet neighborhood and the host was one of the best we’ve experienced. Highly recommended!

I was a bit scared because it was in a hotel but the process was extremely smooth. I checked in with no issues and was given the keys to my room. The room was beautiful and so was the view. The TV had great options as well. I’d definitely recommend this place

This hotel room was great! I have a phobia of hotels btw. I hate them. They’re usually creepy to me. But upon walking into the building it smells fresh and clean everything was well organized and set. I had no issues checking in and Justin was beyond accommodating and very fast communication. Thank you for your help with the stay! I will definitely come back!

Beautiful apartment, immaculately clean and stocked with everything you need. Lots of towels, kitchen utensils. Garden is great and super well kept. Good WiFI and great communication from the owners.  The area can be a little sketchy at night, especially for a single female. But nothing to worry about as long as you're careful. 5min walk to the subway so it's super convenient.

Great location, you are right in the heart of the city. Clean and seamless easy check in and out. All facilities you need. No stress just walk straight into your room and ready to go.   Would definitely stay here again.

Shamel’s home was in a quiet, beautiful area of Brooklyn! I couldn’t have asked for anything else in an AirBnb for a quick trip into the city. It was super clean, spacious and had everything we needed (& more!) for an enjoyable stay :) Don’t be afraid of the street parking - we were able to find a spot super close to the house and for a Friday night we were a little worried we wouldn’t be able to but everything worked out!! Shamel was a gracious host and super easy to get in contact with - we’ll definitely be coming back in the future!
Perfect stay! Clean and close to subway, grocery, drug stores and food choices. Shamel was a great host and very accommodating. Will definitely use again!

I am not one to write negative reviews, but feel somewhat deceived by the current reviews on this listing, so using this opportunity to set things straight. Hopefully the host can address a couple of points so that future guests have a better experience.  Being completely honest, everything is okay until we get onto the bathroom. The bathroom was not cleaned properly, with hairs everywhere, in the tub and on the floor. It simply hasn’t been cleaned properly. The shower is also barely a shower it trickles out - you can just about wash but the flow is awful and I am so surprised this hasn’t been mentioned more.  The area is okay, not the safest part of Brooklyn. My girlfriend didn’t feel very comfortable walking around at night but we didn’t have any issues in the week we were staying here.  I want to stress that overall everything is okay and I would stay again if the shower was fixed and everything was properly cleaned before our stay.

I was very scared when I arrived due to the comments about the noise, the mattress, etc.  I don't know if the room has been renovated but it perfectly met my expectations. It is more beautiful in real life than in photos, including the bathroom!  Absolutely clean, very comfortable bed, towels, coffee, soaps available. Only small downside: the coffee maker was leaking but putting it back in place was fine. Furthermore, yes there is a lot of noise, so sleeping with earplugs is essential. At the same time we are in the heart of Flatiron, that’s normal!  I almost did Manhattan on foot. The receptionist and the manager via the application were very responsive and kind. Possible to leave your luggage until 9pm upon departure.  I will come back!

Overall I was happy with my stay at Sonder, all things considered. The location was incredibly convenient for me so worth the expense (which itself was relatively reasonable — hashtag en why see).  On the upside, the room is spare but spacious, with tall windows, a modern color palette, new sheets and pillows, a big enough TV that supports Chromecasting, and a desk for working. The internet was sufficiently fast and the lights didn't shine too bright. The shower had many spouts and spigots like a vertical car wash, and I imagine I was able to wash off most of whatever New York tried to infuse into my skin.   All in all, I found contentedness.   Yet, there was no kettle for boiling water with which to make my bougie coffee using my hand grinder and AeroPress. In desperation, I attempted to make do with the apparently environmentally sound K Cup alternative, but merely ended up with hot brown water. I thought these things were idiot-proof, but I guess they didn't user test on someone like me. Word to the wise: don't make my mistake — just do the proper thing and give in a daily pilgrimage to Devoción, the Columbian third wave caffeine dealer a few blocks away.  For the bummers: the bathroom is obscenely small and awkward. If you decide that you'd rather not bring your #2s to Starbucks, make time for some yoga ahead of time so when your knees are pressed into your cheekbones, you won't hold the compression stress in your back. In the winter, or when it's cold, it will also be cold inside the room owning to those large, thin windows I mentioned above. And as if it was bad enough that the windows seemed cut from a single pane of cellophane, the doors might be as well, which is to say that you may hear all about how "Benjamin" was cheating on his girlfriend-but-not-official-girlfriend and while she knows that they're not "official", it still hurts, and of course NOW he says that he loves her because he's drunk and it's 4am, but it's not like he said that he loved her before, and if you do happen to hear more of this story, you can expect it to loop for, say, an hour or so, before you eventually find the helpfully provided traffic-cone orange ear plugs should such a drama arise in the hallway.  But at least over the tall, too-thin windows are near-black-out shades that will keep out most of the sun in the morning that shall inevitably rise in two hours, and hey, it's New York baby in the nearly post-pandemic not yet pre-apocalyptic era, so what's there to complain about? Really?

The room was big and clean. Nice water pressure in the shower. Got an email that we were too noisy (someone complained) on the first night and I chalked it up to the tv being too loud maybe. So the second night I was very careful to keep the tv low (could barely hear it) and used subtitles. Someone came knocking on the door at 2 am or something to say that was also too loud? I really don’t understand. I was consciously trying to be as quiet as possible…didn’t play any music, no partying etc. Kinda scared me having someone knock that late.

It was a hidden gem, finding this AirBNB. The space was roomy enough for a family to be more than cozy. The living room chairs were massage chairs ( nice touch). The beds were firm and cozy, so sleeping was A1. My family and I also appreciated the eclectic style of the upstairs accommodations, as there was a bonus room and bedroom on the second floor, making it a cute hideaway for children and adults alike.  Outside of the house feel, we also found enjoyment looking about our local shopping centers/mall in an area called Rego Park which is only about 10 minutes by car. So many things we needed or just wanted was right there, including a grocery store.   We also found parking our car was never much of a hassle as there was usually a place to park not far away at all. The neighborhood is quiet and peaceful. It’s a pleasure coming to NY and finding a place that was so serene. It made the stress of our move from Ga so much smoother. We will surely stay here again, when and if it’s available.   And lastly, working with Gloria was another area of peace. She was attentive and communicated with us regarding any of our needs.

I really loved staying here and would love to for future visits but there were a few cons that other travelers should know:   Please don’t take this as complaints as I could have reached out during my stay but anytime I noticed something, the time of day was really inappropriate so I just kept it moving. I honestly loved this place. A lot. & would probably stay again.   We had no control over the AC/heater situation. The heater was HOT. Too hot. Only fan in the living room wasn’t sufficient for bedrooms… especially upstairs, but we did open the windows. It was unbearable and one guest left to stay somewhere else one evening. I did tell her the next morning and it was lowered a bit.   The parking was decent but one night we had to park on the side street. Both side mirrors were stolen off the car which made it un-drivable and an added expense to the stay. Not Gloria’s fault and I never felt unsafe in the area but something to be aware of especially with out of state plates.   There were no roku remotes to be found so we couldn’t utilize the tv at all. Having roku myself, I knew I could get it on my phone - but only with the wifi and the wifi never worked. But, I only noticed at odd hours so I didn’t reach out. We made due just fine with conversation like the old days. We were gone most of the day and evening so it wasn’t too much of an inconvenience and probably an easy fix if this is something you need.   Overall, we really loved the location. It’s in perfect proximity to everything I love in Queens/Flushing and close to all my friends. These aren’t awful complaints, I’ve definitely stayed at worse place, just things to maybe make future guests aware of.   Also - the photos don’t do it justice. The layout is SO COOL!!! Hard to tell from photos - but this place is a GEM!   She was very quick to respond anytime I needed her. Like I said, I could have reached out about the other stuff but I try my best to be a good guest. None of this was awful enough to make me leave. Things happen. We were happy overall.

The location is obviously not the safest but it’s literally like 5 steps from the train station which is very ideal. The house is clean but reeks of weed/drugs and felt unsafe. The room itself is very very nice and clean and protected with two passwords. The house is just very sketchy but the room itself is fine.

Asaad was a wonderful host and very available via the app when I had questions! The apartment is super close to the subway, and on a busy enough street that as a woman travelling alone I never felt unsafe! For being in a busy area, the apartment building itself was very quiet, and a good amount of space for NY.

From booking to check-out, I felt informed and welcomed. The communication was timely and adequate. Check-in was simple and our group of five really felt "at home" at this location. The metro is a short walk away and the neighborhood has plenty of dining within walking distance. People were friendly and helpful, even without us having to ask. The place is well-equipped and had everything we needed for the stay. There is a bit of noise transfer between the lower-level apartment. It caught us off-guard the first day, but I didn't experience the same level of sound in other areas of the home. My favorite parts? The skylights (especially the one in the bathtub) and the front seating area. There is a beautiful tree canopy that provides just enough shade and privacy, and I enjoyed people-watching from the stoop in the mornings. I highly recommend this rental.
Chani's place is good but the location isn't ideal, especially if one would like some tranquil time during the night. The area is a bit dirty and sketchy.

Yaw thank you for your hospitality and providing such a great place to rest our heads at night.   Yaw's apartment was just as described! It was a nice walkup apartment in a great neighborhood. The apartment was spacious and gave plenty of room to spread out while enjoying the city. The apartment was clean and had most of the necessities. There are a couple of things to be aware of the apartment only has one air-condition and it cools the living room nicely, but the bedrooms stay pretty warm, especially during the day time. There were only two towels provided and only one bed had a blanket, which didn't matter since it was warm in the bedroom.  Check-in was a breeze! Yaw provided a lockbox and a code for a late checkin. Yaw was very accommodating. Our departure was pushed back several hours and he allowed us to leave our bags in the apartment past the checkout time allowing us more time to explore.   The location is great. The apartment is at a busy intersection and you could hear the traffic in the living room but it was pretty quiet in the bedrooms. I liked the busy intersection when we came back late at night. We never felt unsafe. There are two separate subways within a 15 minute walk which make getting to Manhattan or Coney Island easy. During non-peak time it is about a 35 minute ride to either location. There is a bus stop at the apartment and separate bus a block away which will take you to the heart of Brooklyn in about 30 minutes.   It was about a 40 minute taxi-ride from LGA, roughly $50, at 10:30pm. You can expect at least an hour during the day. I have stayed in the area multiple times and have always travel from LGA via the M60 bus to the Q train and it is at least an hour ride. So either way it is about the same. If you Drive just be aware there is limited parking in the area.

Yaw’s place was in a great location and super close to multiple parking options! If anyone in your group is afraid of spiders, definitely come prepared to deal with those. Lastly, consider bringing your own blankets because only sheets were available!

Guests be aware. This neighborhood is not safe. fights and some drugs action going on around this place. The building is very old and dirty. The flooring was not stable and feels like it is falling when you walk on it. This is not the experience you want to have.

Our stay at Yaw's place was pretty good.  It's a little old with the wooden floors being quite creaky.  Decoration is fairly sparse, but that's not what were interested in.  It provided the basic necessities: comfortable beds, wi-fi, functioning kitchen and refrigerator, comfy couch, simple dining table, a TV, and 2 functioning bathrooms.  There was even an old turntable to play various vinyl records.  The surrounding neighborhood may seem a bit sketchy, but it's overall safe.  We walked around in the evenings and didn't have any troubles whatsoever.  It's about a 10 minute walk to 2 different subway stations and there are plenty of neighborhood grocery stores if you want to cook your own food.  If you prefer takeout, then there are plenty of options in that area too.    I will say that there is 1 major drawback, the noise from the nearby streets.  Coming from the suburbs, it was incredibly hard to get used to the almost incessant sounds of cars and trucks honking at each other or the blaring sirens of ambulances, fire trucks, and police cars.  In addition, it seemed like some cars purposely revved their thunderous engines or blasted their speakers to wake people up.  I personally had to buy silicon earplugs to drown out the noise and take sleeping pills just to get some sleep.  This is definitely not the place for you if you're a light sleeper or you prefer quiet at night.  As a host, Yaw is excellent.  He responded back very quickly when we contacted him and he offered to help us with anything that we needed.  We made the mistake of going to the wrong address from the airport, but Yaw was kind enough to pay for the Lyft ride to the correct location.  That's beyond what we expected and it was much appreciated.

Absolutely loved our stay at Walker Hotel Tribeca. We had a delayed flight that caused us to miss our connection so we decided to stay in NYC for a night. We booked the room last minute and checked in very late that night, but the hotel manager was waiting for us and helped us have a seamless check in experience. He surprised us with a free upgrade from a full size bed to a KING size bed, which made our night! They also provided us toothbrushes and toothpaste since we didn’t have our luggage with us. The room was beautiful, stylish and extremely clean. The shower has great water pressure and the complimentary CO Bigelow products are lovely. After a long stressful day of traveling, it was the best feeling to be able to take a hot shower and jump into an amazingly comfortable king size bed. The pillows were plush and cool. We had a great night’s sleep. The next morning we had a seamless checked out experience and grabbed breakfast at Blue Bottle Coffee in the beautiful and spacious lobby.  Overall, we had an amazing time at Walker Hotel and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

Really stylish, clean, conveniently-located hotel with an awesome view! Room is definitely small, but for NYC, it's a great value. We parked at Edison ParkFast a couple blocks away -- it was really easy and not-sketchy, plus the hotel validates part of your fees. One thing we did wish we had was a mini-fridge for water/leftovers/drinks, but I'd definitely stay here again.
Great for remote workers—there’s a Blue Bottle Coffee downstairs, and a WeWork right around the corner. Rooms are a little small, but clean, well-decorated, and the light/shade controls are awesome.

Genevieve's apartment is an immaculately decorated, beautifully-lit charmer located right in the heart of Crown Heights, nearby to multiple subway lines, the Brooklyn Museum, Brooklyn Public Library, Brooklyn Botanic Garden, amazing restaurants and bars, and so much more. My friend and I loved being able to use the apartment as a home base during our visit, and found communicating with Genevieve to be absolutely delightful. I can't recommend Genevieve's place enough—a steal compared to hotel prices and other Airbnbs in the area, with all the benefits of a fully-appointed apartment. Would gladly stay again!

SharedEasy is quite literally a late capitalist dystopian scam. They are a company that serves wealthy international slum lords who think that these spaces they’re buying up are simply just investments. When you stay here you are the product not the customer, read SharedEasy’s website, they admit it themselves. It’s a service tailored for property investors to squeeze more profits out than a traditional lease. This trashy scammy company is accelerating gentrification without giving anything back to the long time residents of the communities they are invading. It is all driven by greed. The place was disgusting, hadn’t been cleaned in weeks and reeked of body odor and rotting food throughout the house. There wasn’t even the slightest semblance of the community vibe they advertise on their website. No one picks up after themselves nor were they even friendly. Felt like a mix of a frat house and halfway house.

The price of this airbnb was extremely expensive for what it was. I never would have booked this hotel due to it’s price but my initial airbnb cancelled on me just as I was just about to check in so I was stuck in a bind at the last minute. The room I was given was not the room pictured in the photos. The layout was different and it only had a queen bed instead of the advertised king bed. Staff was very friendly and room was clean and fairly quiet except that the room doors slammed. Location was close to a lot of things but the block was really sketchy with homelessness, drug use and needles witnessed daily. After check out, I wanted to store my luggage which I needed to bring myself into the unsupervised baggage room with no security. Where I then had access to everyone's bags. I hoped that my bags would still be there untouched when I returned. Overall the room was ok, but for the price of this room I expected much better.
Spacious Brooklyn Apartment! Sketchy neighborhood, with street parking. Good access to the metro (M Train) straight into Manhattan.

We booked the apartment May 3, 2022 for a stay July 18 to 22  2022. Pros: Host is quick to respond. Check-in instructions are clear and hassle-free. Cons: No A/C in all bedrooms, only ceiling fans that could not give cool with the outside temperature over 35°C.  The rooms were hot and humid. The towels stank of dampness. The surrounding areas is little bit scary for us, graffitis everywhere. The couch in the small room which will be used as bed at night is very hard and uncomfortable. We couldn't watch TV because the wifi internet wasn't fast enough. As the family can not sleep at the first night, we decide to check-out the next day. After check-out  Host said that He just replace the A/C in the living room and A/C will be install in the bedrooms. We can not confirm because we are no more there.

Golden was very accommodating with us and was always prompt in responding. He made it very easy and stress free so we could just relax and enjoy our stay. Also, he goes out of his way to provide updates regarding events with neighbors, additional supplies, and other activities so we know what to expect. We all knocked out after an adventurous day upon arrival despite the street noise because the beds and temperature of the unit was warm, comfortable, and cozy. Thank you Golden for your great service as our Super Host! We enjoyed our stay and will check-in with you again next time.  Sincerely,  Pheakdey

Before you book this AirBnb BEWARE!! My friends and I booked this AirBnb as we were 3 females and we felt more comfortable staying with a woman. If you read Krista's description (or at least before we booked) she mentioned that she  lived there with her boyfriend, Felix, and how they often have parties and love to meet the guests. When we arrived, we had to open the apartment with an app - it was confusing but nothing that was out of the ordinary. When we walked in, we were greeted by Marty (supposedly a roommate although he had the last room left) and we never saw him since that initial convo. Anyways, Marty lead us to our room....which WAS THE WRONG ROOM?? and there were people's bags and possessions inside that room, which made my friends and I feel a little unsafe if anyone can access it at anytime. The following days we met the people staying in the 2nd room which were 4 girls, and they told us that they had booked their airbnb for 4 people and Krista had charged them over 300 for no reason. We kept wondering where Krista was because there were only 3 rooms (2 airbnbs+ Marty's room). In total there were 8 of us there (at one point 9, which I will get to) in a VERYYY small NYC apartment with ONE bathroom. it is obvious that with that many people, the apartment will get dirty. The bathroom was disgusting! The trash was overflowing with toilet paper, the sink was turning brown with all the dirt, there was hair all over the place, THE TOWELS TURNED BROWN WITH DIRT!! At one point, me and the other airbnb girls from the other room got annoyed an decided to switch out the toilet and kitchen towels on our own because we were running out. We had requested Krista to come clean because the house was a disaster. The sink was even turning brown, there were pizza boxes in the kitchen turning mouldy. Krista said she does not clean the place until guests leave... so does Marty just live in the dirt? We think (and I mean think cause we don't even know who lives there) that he permanently lives there or at least rents... but he cant even clean up his own bathroom or kitchen? Krista saying she only cleans after guests leave is a lie too because the 2nd room of girls left a few days before us and she never came to clean their room or the apartment. As I mentioned, one day there were 9 of us there..we arrived late at night and there was a strange man sleeping in the living room. I messaged one of the girls from the other room if she knew who he was, as we decided to share number since we felt very weird about the place, and she said that she had no clue either and how it was all weird. Fortunatly the man was nice, however as foreign girls staying in a new city, already feeling unsafe in this AirBnb, it was not a good feeling to know strangers can walk in and out at anytime, while our possessions lay in the apartment. Instead of having an app for the apartment lock, I suggest Krista adds an apartment for the bathroom line. We would wake up and immediately rush to the bathroom before the was a line. To make it worse, the 2nd room had no mirrors, so the girls constantly had to go to the bathroom to use the mirror (this was understandable since they were nice and didn't have one). Aside from the rats nest that is this place, the area felt relatively safe, and it was a short walk to the metro.

We liked Cassandra's place, the apartment is very spacious and has all the equipment needed for comfortable stay. We loved the starter pack of coffee and lovely tea selection Cassandra left for us as well as the things to do in Brooklyn book we enjoyed so much. It is 5 mins to subway station with direct connection to Manhattan (takes around 20 mins) and you are within one connection to most of the main attractions in NYC. It takes around 45 mins to get to Central Park or Rockefeller center for example. The neighborhood (Bushwick) itself is not the nicest neighborhood as the streets were bit dirty, but you can walk to abundance of local coffee shops, produce markets or grocery stores within minutes and we never felt unsafe in the neighborhood. We would not recommend the location if you have kids in stroller as the subway station does not have elevators so it means you will have to do a lot of lifting while getting on and off subway every day. Overall I think Cassandra is a great host.

Great place, very clean. Had no issues with communication or anything else. The neighborhood was a little bit sketchy, but I was only staying here for one night because it was close to the start of the race at prospect park, so it wasn't an issue for me.

Apartment ideally located, in a quiet street (subways, bakeries, shops and Times Square in the immediate vicinity). Very good WiFi connection. MaVi is pleasant and easily reachable. The cleaning was generally done (even if there was a clump of hair on the shower walls, the sheets were stained and some equipment could do with a deep cleaning, such as the air conditioning, for example). The apartment needs to be refreshed, and that certain finishes are carried out in the sense that one has the impression that the work was carried out a little hastily (plaster applied roughly where there should have been holes, traces of paint still visible where there should have been damp spots, holes in the wall larger than the spots installed, radiators on the floor exploded, etc.). We also had the misfortune of coming across a huge cockroach at the exit of the elevator, near the trash room, when we were on the wrong floor. Being in New York, we were still afraid of having them in the apartment on the second floor. Fortunately this was not the case! So avoid pressing C in the elevator, 1 corresponding to the ground floor 🤣 To summarize, the apartment is good value for money compared to what you can find in New York.

Alejandro was a great host, friendly and helpful. When my flight was delayed, he was very flexible about check in. The room is exactly as it is in the picture, was clean and comfortable, and perfectly adequate for my two-day stay. It was really nice to have in en suite bathroom. The street is a busy one with a lot of trash and there is quite a bit of noise day and night. Nonetheless, I never felt unsafe walking by myself day or night. The train and bus are nearby making this a convenient place to stay if you want to travel around the city. I would definitely stay here again.

The apartment was for the most part as described and suitable for a short stay. The kitchen was well-stocked with basic appliances, flatware, dishes, and utensils for meals. The bed was very comfortable and the shower was great. There are a few things that could have improved my Airbnb experience: 1. I had notified the host that I was arriving very late and they knew I was older and was unfortunately coming without my husband as had originally been planned. I had traveled far on a flight that had been diverted and delayed, was exhausted, thirsty, and starving, and I would have expected at least some kind of welcome basket with bottles of water and a few snacks, but there was absolutely nothing. I have stayed in many Airbnbs and this is standard hospitality protocol. 2. The floors are buckling from the hurricane flooding and they need to be fixed before new guests reserve. It is painful and dangerous, not just annoying, to maneuver in the apartment with floors like that. I managed by wearing flip flops but it would be good if the host could inform guests when they reserve about such a feature rather than shortly before arrival. It may be that younger guests would not mind, but for older guests, it may help to know. I was for the most part comfortable but taking care of these few issues would make this a 5-star Airbnb place.

We had a great stay at Michael's place! It was clean, nice and spacious for an NYC apartment. We had everything we needed, and Michael's communication was great leading up to the trip. Totally stress-free. It was also located on a nice, quiet street which we appreciated when leaving the city. Would definitely recommend staying here.

Justin is an amazing host and took care of us down to every detail! Any time we revisit The City, we will be in touch with Justin for accommodations. He is very knowledgeable of NYC, has excellent and super fast communication and makes sure your stay is stress free. 'Couldn't be a better host!!
Natalie is very responsive. Her place is very near bus route to subway or LGA. Laundry, drug store, food nearby. It was nice to have refrigerator space and cabinet space.

Overall a good place but two problems. The first one is that the subway is far and travelling can be a little bit of an issue. Secondly, there are cameras in the home. I don't like being watched and found it creepy.

This was a perfect room for a quick stay in NYC! Comfy bed, plenty of space, clean room and clean bathroom!! It’s super central to everywhere I wanted to go to in Williamsburg and beyond! And for the price?? A STEAL. Communication with my hosts was easy and consistent and I would absolutely stay here again in the future. (:

Extremely well located place in Williamsburg. I wasn't familiar with the neighbourhood before, but Ploy gave a lot of great recommendations. The room and airbnb were thoughtfully laid out for a stress free stay and I really appreciated the coffee and toiletries provided!

The host responded quickly with my concerns. The outside of the home does look a bit suspicious but there are renovations being made. The inside of the house is exactly as pictured but there is no working wifi as mentioned.

The unit itself is very pleasant, clean, and spacious. House rules state no gatherings of any kind, which was strange because the neighborhood sounds like the party’s never stop. We were kept up until 3:00am due to the loud music and screaming. We didn’t feel safe to walk around the area, and when the Uber driver picked us up he’d mentioned that this was a “crime filled area”. We won’t be back. The unit is great, it’s just on the wrong side of town.

I have never been so disappointed in a stay. Idk why a host would think it’s appropriate to not only conduct construction on site without warning or disclosure but it’s beyond reason to assume anyone would be comfortable sleeping with a nail gun going off outside their window at the crack of dawn. The shower was inoperable and I refuse to take a scalding hot shower because they were too incompetent to install a water mixer in the shower system. The whole place was infested with bugs and the entryway was busted up concrete / unsafe to walk over. There were broken blinds in the back room that blocked zero sunlight and we had to suffer a burning direct blaze while listening to a deck being built on the property 10 feet from the window. We tried to cover our heads with the blankets but couldn’t suffer it more than ten mins. I’ve never contacted Airbnb for anything before. But between being unable to lock the window and feel safe and the bugs everywhere … it all just ruined our experience beyond anything. We killed easily 30 bugs and one even made it home with me in my suitcase. I still can’t believe we had to drive several states home without even bathing.  They can paint and remodel it all they want but if I can’t feel safe, lock the windows, feel comfortable without bugs, or participate in normal everyday hygiene routines especially after attending a massive city all day long and a concert all night… then I can’t be comfortable leaving them a good review. The parking was nice. Ferry was convenient. I like staying in Hoboken better. I’d never come back here. Ever.

Ed’s appartment is very nice and well equipped (apart from the AC, that we were unable to use, thankfully, it was not too hot that night). Ed himself was welcoming, and he treated us with a beer and cider. The only thing is the location… it was our first time on Staten Island, and it was not like we imagined. The ferry is fantastic to ride, as everyone knows, but the neighbourhood is extremely dirty and feels unsafe.

The appartment is in a very good location and clean with all the essential needs  Yvener was a very good host and communicating for any needs to make our stay as comfortable as possible  Their are some troubling issues with the surrounding neighbors which was annoying but Yvener tried his best to solve these issues which made some of our stay under stress but other than that  i would recommend  the Apartment
The place is beautiful but the location is terrible, the super dangerous place

Home is beautiful and definitely worth a visit. The area isn’t the best but if you’re good at using Google maps you’ll be able to get around no problem. Since it’s a basement apartment hearing pipes, banging, and footsteps are expected but are easily drowned out by the huge tv in the living room. Also note a slight spider problem that almost gave me a heart attack , it was only two but I have a weakness :,(

The accommodation had a power failure, which forced us to sleep without heating... unpleasant experience... the cleaning was not completely well done... we had to leave the place... but I recognize that the host did everything possible to accommodate us... that point is very much in his favor...

this place is decent. I had 4 people staying with me and a puppy. We needed it for the weekend, but only stayeda night. There were miscommunications on the site and with the host, so we felt it was best to leave.. If you need a place to just sleep for a night, this is good. Sharing a common area was creepy because we heard foot steps at 3am outside of the door. If you don't mind that as well, then this is perfect for you too!

Good as a spot to crash in NYC on a budget, but I wouldn't choose it for a long stay, especially as a solo girl traveller - the area is kind of sketchy. The room is very basic, although of a good size for the city, but it faces a street with heavy traffic which makes it noisy.   Common areas were nice and clean.

Please book some where else if you can. This man has no sense of privacy will send people to the house unannounced. Will enter the property unannounced multiple times a day. You will not enjoy your vacation I book by the reviews and honestly I wish I haven’t. Man has been a nightmare to my party and I . Don’t believe me I have videos and pictures. House full of flys so if you want to spend your entire vacation killing flys be my guest don’t book here not even worth the headache you’ll experience by booking here . You can find better and will get treated better versus being stalked like a criminal or theft.

Ike’s place is near most attractions in Manhattan. The place is clean and private. It is smaller than expected and the outside of the building has graffiti on it and the street can feel somewhat unsafe if you’re visiting from out of town. Overall Ike’s place gives you a sense of what it’s like to live in a NY apartment. I would recommend it.
beautiful, clean, modern airbnb at such a steal of a price !!

Highly recommend Juan's place if you're ever looking to explore New York beyond just Manhattan! Place is clean and easy to find! Juan is also very quick to respond so don't be afraid to ask questions. would stay again in the future.
Marcos was a great communicator and made our trip to the city that much more stress-free.

Great place to stay. Everything looked exactly as the pictures, and very clean. The only thing I didn't like much was the path walking from Kingston station to the place, it was full of homeless, but they do nothing to you, besides that, everything was ok.

Really nice place, really clean. Calming atmosphere. Nice place to chill and relax. Had a week long stay, brought a friend over , host gave me an issue with that. I’ve stayed at several air bnb’s never had a problem with bringing a friend over. Made the experience a little unpleasant after that. Was excited to share this place with a friend. Wanted to stay longer , but didn’t like that I couldn’t have company. Had to book for 2 guests (extra charge) for an extra 2 days even though my friend isn’t really staying with me, just visiting. Host told me extra guests aren’t allowed due to pandemic and my friend had to leave right now,(literally stopped me at lobby asking about my friend, and again at my door) but said if I pay for extra guest then it’s fine. We told her the reservation was for me and he was just visiting. She then told me she would be checking the cameras and coming by everyday to check if my friend was there. Completely ruined the experience for me. I was planning on making this a long term stay because I really liked the space.

I am hesitant recommending this listing. The self check in process is simple, but the host is very poor at communicating, and all my messages were ignored. Around midnight there was much activity and commotion, either from the other guests or a cleaning service. At one point this said person entered the other guests’ room by accident, suggesting the codes for each room do not differ between guests, which is very alarming and left me feeling unsafe for the reminder of the night. The room is very bare and the wifi is weak. It suffices for a brief stay, but I would be wary booking this room for more than one night.

It's our second time staying at Filiz' place and this time I will make a more thorough review.   1.- This is a GREAT spot to go to the Brooklyn Mirage. It's just a 7 minute walk on a brightly lit, industrial area. 2.- It's really close to the L subway line. We are short people so it took us around 10 minutes to walk to and back from the train. 3.- It's SAFE. The apartment is on an industrial area. It is ugly looking but there's literally no one there to be scared of. No panhandlers, no homeless, just empty, well-lit streets with a ton of grafitti. 4.- Right next to the L subway station there's about 3-4 blocks of endless restaurants and food trucks. We ate there pretty much every day. Delicious and fairly priced.  5.- The apartment has three rooms. My review is for the one right next to the entrance that looks to another buildings (looking to the east-south-east). That being said, the place was QUIET. No street noise, no loud conversations. Anything. We partied all night long for two nights straight and slept like babies during the day.  6.- Water at this AirBNB is HOT. Gotta love that when you need a warm shower after 10+ hours dancing.  7.- The bathroom cabinet is stocked with essentials. That was pretty nice because I forgot shaving cream and used the one stocked there.  8 and Final: This room has A/C and the internet is lightning fast. We will DEFINITELY COME BACK.   Thank you for hosting us, Filiz!

This home is sooooo perfect for a trip to Brooklyn or the city. We LOVED Alejandra’s home!!! It is so beautiful, roomy, and COMFORTABLE beyond anything we have ever rented, also the host is absolutely awesome!! The location is perfect, next to so many restaurants,cafes and shops. We literally could’ve walked to everything we needed including subway stops, parks, drug stores, grocery, Manhattan skyline…and anything else you may need. I would rent this home again and again, we travel to NYC usually once a year and this place is the best! Unfortunately it rained while there, so we couldn’t enjoy the amazing patio….but the home was so nice, the rain didn’t matter. Thanks Alejandra for sharing your beautiful home with us and allowing my daughter’s s sweet 16 to be a place for great memories for our family.

My worst Airbnb experience ever. Unprofessional, biased host.  OFF-SITE host, Filiz, took the side of another guest who harassed me. Many false accusations . There were 3 guests there using the small common area. I got on video the guest threatening she's a gang member and will have them kill me if I sleep there. Filiz would not look at the video. This place is located on busy Flushing Ave, across from a street-long, razor-wire topped wall, that looks scary ugly, like a state penitentiary prison-type look.  Host accused me of having guests/party, not true!! I needed help moving my belongings. GUEST=OVERNIGHT. Was vaccinated mover/helper= VISITOR. Also, grabbing a slice of pizza is not a party. When I told her I would have need help again moving fully out, Host Filiz response thru AirBNB messages? NO TRESSPASSING! NEVER COME BACK! She called me WEIRD!!! All seals were intentionally broken open, AVOID this "mean girls" place, and unprofessional and unhelpful host. There are many nice AIRBNBs to pick from in the Brooklyn/Queens area.

Our stay at Sonder was perfect for our weekend trip! The staff was very helpful and kind. Staying somewhere during a pandemic can be scary, but the room was extremely clean and we had all the amenities we needed, and the fridge even came with complimentary water. The location is a short walk to central park, the MOMA, Rockefeller Center and Times Square. We didn't have to jump on the subway once! There is a Duane Reade pharmacy on the corner so you nedd to pick up any essentials, along with a Starbucks being on the opposite corner if you want to grab a quick coffee. I also highly recommend going to La Pain for breakfast and Pazza Notte (right next to it) for dinner if you like Italian cuisine (both located on the 6th Ave. corner. Overall, I felt very safe in the area and in the hotel and am very happy with the service that they provided!

Location - can walk to Jefferson station in less than 10 min which will get you to Williamsburg or Manhattan quickly. Neighborhood looks a little sketchy at first but I had no problem walking around as a single woman. Also PERFECT location for the Brooklyn mirage. Btw Uber and Lyft and taxi… the city needs to be set as Ridgewood NY   Communication - host was great. She even let me check in early!  Check In - completely hassle free. I love when you don’t have to deal with anyone or get a key. Pad lock on front door and the room. Super easy instructions and access  Place - very clean. Shared space - loud guest on Monday am but not a big deal or hosts fault. Lock on door so stuff is safe. Very simple room but space for hanging clothes and GREAT AC!!! Shower was awesome too!  Value - honestly this place is a steal  Overall great place. Cheap. Easy. Great location. Felt very safe as a single woman. Great vintage shop down the street. Easy to access the rest of NYC. thanks for being a great host!

Bodrul is the sweetest man. He sent me a nice message before checking in & welcomed me to his home as if I were family! He even helped me with my bags when I was leaving. The rooms and bathroom were clean and Bodrul even supplies you with some toiletries (towels, face towels, etc). The house was in the perfect neighborhood. It’s quiet and a 1 minute walk to a beautiful park with benches in the shade. And if you walk a little farther (about 10 minute walk) there’s a bigger park right on the water and you can take ferry’s to the city from there!! I really enjoyed my stay, it was so peaceful and relaxing and I look forward to booking again!

This is a good place to stay specially if you’re not staying too much or if you’re going to take it just to sleep and take showers…   It’s 42 or 45mntw away from New York so if it is your first time going there, you need to speak very good English and have a good management of Google maps in order to not to get lost and avoid being over stressed.   The neighborhood make you feel kind of uncomfortable and unsafe if you’re going by yourself and you’re a woman, but it doesn’t necessarily mean it’s dangerous, just be preventive.

I’ve stayed at one of their places before. Honestly, I just feel that these guys take major shortcuts at the expense of the guest. They don’t properly clean the properties for one and that’s a big deal. They only give you one towel as toiletries. There is literally always sooooo much dirt and hair around their houses that you can literally put it all together and make a little puppy. The host are SUPER lazy not SUPER host. I booked, checked in, checked out and everything never once got any type of response from them. Only thing they do is clean the sheets. They don’t sweep, mop, barely clean the bathroom, and it just makes the stay unpleasant. For your $100 you’ll literally get a bed with a sheet (no cover) pillows and a towel. That’s it. They won’t even say thanks for staying.
The appartement is clean, safe, confortable ! Everything you need for few days to visit New York city and the surrounding without any stress !

I had a good time staying here. The location was cool for me since it's like 30 min from manhattan by subway. Also, it's a great place to stay if you are in NY for some show in Knockdown center because It's literally 7 minute walk from the apartment. I didn't feel unsafe in the neighborhood, this is an industrial area with lots of graffiti all over the place (which was kind of cool though).   Some things I didn't like - there is no lock on the bathroom door (but I guess people just leave the door open when nobody is there so you know if it's closed then somebody is there probably) The temperature in the apartment was pretty low. Not that bad, but I had to wear my hoodie all the time. I saw some rats in front of the building, but... you know. You're in NY so don't act surprised  Overall you get what you pay for. I'd recommend it to people who need a place to sleep and take a shower. The location is convenient, the host was willing to help. Thanks!

Pros: 1. Nice location for transportation.  2. reasonable price for a one bedroom one bathroom and a kitchen. 3. 2 nice cafe nearby 4. Very clean and tidy  Cons: 1.  About 30-40 minutes away from New York  2. Feeling a little unsafe when you walk home from the subway station at night cuz it’s dark and deserted. 3. AC makes noise occasionally and it is kinda loud

Lina’s place was GREAT!! I needed her to watch my bags for me until check-in because I had an early flight and she was very accommodating! The one thing that sucked was that I was traveling by myself and I’m a small female, so I felt very unsafe walking home at night. There were people outside yelling/talking very loudly until like 4am, but that’s not Lina’s fault at all.

The host tries very hard to make you feel at home, he has everything you need and more. The mattress is a little hard but it is a matter of taste, hot water, 2 televisions and a very equipped kitchen in case you have plans to cook. It is 4 minutes walk from the subway and 30 minutes from Times Square. The neighborhood has one or another restaurant nearby although practically only sleeping was possible. At night it is relatively safe although you can feel a little uncomfortable and unsafe so I recommend not arriving after 11-10.

Unfortunately this booking was cancelled because of a "leaking washing machine" just as I landed in JFK. A tiny bit stressful to find a new place to stay on a late Sunday afternoon with such a late notice.

Safe and accessible neighborhood. Very small living conditions. This is not a place for spending your time in. You share a bathroom with other guests who have different rooms in the same apartment.  Cleanliness was okay. There was not a very thorough job done, but it wasn't terrible. The first thing I did when I checked in after my flight was kill a cockroach in the hallway. Natalie will claim it was a waterbug, but it was a definitely a cockroach based its distinctive while collar, antennae, and fast ground movement. The place seems fairly modern, so this may have been a freak occurrence, but I cannot confirm nor deny that. Also, some of the rules and elements become inconveniences such as no showering past 10pm, no hand soap provided, and the only large garbage cans are in the driveway.  It is fairly stressful to communicate with Natalie. I complained about the cockroach immediately after checking-in and asked for a discount/refund. The only way for me to get a refund was to cancel the rest of my reservation. This would leave me paying $200 for the first night, which doesn't make financial sense, so I stayed for the entirety of my reservation. After mentioning my complaint, Natalie told me that I needed to leave at 10am the next morning so the cleaning person and exterminator could come. This text conversation was at around 2am and I had plans the next morning, so this was stressful to deal with at the time. Natalie sends messages in a very sporadic and spontaneous way and makes a problems worse. This communication style is stressful and unprofessional. Unless you have a serious problem, I would refrain from communicating with Natalie.

Right out of gate, the host remedied two user (me) errors. One with getting in, the other with the heat. He was quick to respond, resolved the issue and offered additional support in case I needed him for anything else. The place was cleaner than my big name, 3 star hotel I stayed at during my drive from south Florida. The location is more than ideal. Not only gorgeous, quiet, and safe, but a 5 minute walk to my sisters house was beyond ideal. There is PARKING. Guest spots, and street parking. But designated street parking so its super stress free if you do have a car. I accidentally broke a glass and a bowl when I knocked them out of drainboard. Host was incredibly understanding of human mistakes which made him even more relatable, even cracked a joke at the whoopsie daisy. My ONLY complaints if I absolutely had to find some would be, no strainer or bottle opener and the bathroom while efficient is quite small. The bed is absolutely amazing. Big and comfortable. I slept better on this than my very expensive mattress at home! Plenty of space, super cozy and I'd 100% make sure to book here for any of my staten island trips.

Todd is an excellent host and his place is quite extraordinary!  The apartment is loaded with interesting art, fantastic vinyl records and ways to enjoy them, a washer/dryer, and very effective AC.  Those last two were essential for a week in the city when the temps were quite high. We often returned from a long day pretty worn out, hot and sweaty, and ready for showers and clean clothing! There is a beautiful, albeit rather old, cappuccino machine that cranks out delicious espresso so the mornings were awesome.  There is a also a large, lovely patio (very rare in NYC) in which to enjoy it.  It was a tad steamy after about 10AM, but in the mornings, this was very nice. The only downside about this apartment is its location.  It's not a great neighborhood - you won't want to eat, shop, walk etc. in the immediate vicinity for any reason. It is a good 15 minute walk from any train station in any direction, and with the heat, that was a hardship.  Just outside the apartment is an array of public housing and a proliferation of loose, stinky garbage, dog poop, rats, clothing and furniture strewn about, and homeless people. Walk 4-6 blocks west and it gets better, but you're in the thick of it just outside the door. The only grocery is on the corner of Ave D and 6th St. about 50 feet from the door and I don't recommend going in there after dark. The only positive aspect of its location was the proximity to the East River.  There is a bike rental location right outside the door. We rented bikes, navigated them over the FDR using the pedestrian bridge 1 block away, and cycled all the way to the Battery where we caught the ferry to Liberty Island. That took about 20 minutes - on the train it would have taken an insane amount of time because of the distance to the trains on both ends.  The cycling was also just fantastic. You cycle along the edge of the East River, passing the Williamsburg Bridge, the Brooklyn Bridge, and taking in the sights along the way. It was spectacular and a highlight of our trip! The green-way is also not in NYC traffic so it felt safe and we didn't have to dodge taxis etc.  We didn't feel safe cycling in the traffic with no helmet etc. so we stuck to the bike-only paths like the East River Green-way. Once inside the apartment, it is very lovely. The furnishings are comfortable, the beds are nice, and the appliances are all high end and work well.   Overall, I would say this was one of the nicest apartments I have ever rented in NYC. If it was better situated in a better neighborhood, I suspect it would be a lot more money.  We enjoyed our stay and recommend Todd as a host as he was wonderful.

Todd and Adrián are excellent guests, the house is everything it offers, the photos are very accurate, the environments are spacious and welcoming, the area where it is located initially surprised us a little since it is quite "popular" but we got used to it very quickly and it is very close to many super markets and very well-stocked restaurants. Although it is true that the neighborhood is quite sui generis, we did not find it dangerous or anything like that, we had a great time, thank you very much Todd and Adrián 🙏

Thé place was great just did not provide a key for the building entrance, he gave a code to get the key but the code doesn’t work, I had to wait for people to get out for me to get in. That stop me to go out at night because I was afraid of sleeping outside.

Great location and spot to stay at in Staten Island. The host was excellent. He addressed any concerns we had & was flexible. Easy to talk to & available if you had any questions/issues. Did not have to stress over parking.  Would def book again in the future at this location. Highly recommend.

Emy’s place was perfect for our stay. The place was bright and airy and the perfect size for the two of us. Besides to-and-from the airport, we relied on the MTA for transportation and the nearest station was only 2 blocks away. We were out late several nights during our stay, sometimes arriving home past midnight and never felt unsafe walking around the neighborhood. Would love to stay there again the next time we’re in Brooklyn!
The place needs to improve. The appearance of the entrance is unpleasant. Reception staff were smoking outside. In the room the curtains are torn and the smoke detectors are covered by plastic bags.

APPALLING!! THE WORST I HAVE EXPERIENCED IN AIRBNB!!
