We arrived at midnight, the person who was there told me that I had to pay an additional 117 USD, after discussing we decided to access it and since my card did not appear with my first name, but with the middle name he did not accept me, and they told me to please leave, to talk to AirBnb for a refund, as they had the money; I almost had to call the police, the neighborhood was super dangerous, I had to beg someone to lend me a card and they finally let me in without first charging those additional things they call “taxes”;  For me the worst night in a long time, now the room was freezing and not very clean, the service was terrible and the receptionists were very rude. NEVER go to this place… now I just hope AirBnb does something about it.

Joe is a great host.He is quick to respond if you have questions.The apartment is  exactly as posted. It was very clean and comfortable. The location was great for us. It is very easy to get to grocery stores, restaurants, drug store, and even Dollar Tree. All of the appliances worked great. The television with cable offered many channels to watch if you were in the room. Again, we love this apartment and will definitely be staying here again. Patty

Choose another location. I love Fidi.. but every area has a really dingy scary street.. John street is that for fidi. The rooms are great, clean. WiFi is spotty and even as I was checking in 2 guess had issues with their bathroom, and so did I!!! Lol.

This was my first Sonder rental through AirBnb. I’d been seeing their listings for a while when traveling and just assumed it was some fly-by-night outfit trying to milk money out of people for a minimally decent place to stay. But since the AirBnb scene in New York City has gotten so bleak due to newer laws and sketchy slumlords I decided to take a chance.  Overall:  The process with Sonder is mostly good. Seamless booking through AirBnb as usual, which is expected. They ask you to verify your identity and phone number through their website which is understandable. I have been an AirBnb host before and know the horrors of it, so it’s smart to triple check who is there in case they are going to trash the place. They do make it seem like you have to download their Sonder app but I verified with AirBnb that you absolutely do NOT have to do that, so I didn’t. I don’t need another app on my phone and I always communicate through AirBnb, as the rules state, so no app for me. They also try really hard to talk to you directly through email or their app or texts, but every AIrbnb message literally says “ONLY COMMUNICATE THROUGH AIRBNB TO PROTECT YOURSELF” and Sonder doesn’t want to play ball. It's a little irksome that Sonder rents units on Airbnb but wants to sidestep Airbnb policies. You can't have it both ways, Sonder!    The space:   I’ve stayed in Manhattan hotels before and I am here to tell you that this unit was 4x larger, 10x cleaner and 15x nicer than any hotel room in the city, even 4 star rooms. This space is modern, bright, incredibly clean and has everything you need. It would go for $2500 a night if it was a hotel. The kitchenette is fabulous and even has a dishwasher. The water pressure is great and the hot water is hot. The TV has cable and you can screen share your apps to it. My phone did keep getting notifications for screen shares all over the building, which is kinda annoying. They should fix that because I could seemingly control the TVs in different units. The bedsheets had a little pilling on them so that could be improved but the bed itself was great. The front door has a 1 inch gap under it so sound privacy is not the best, but a weatherstrip on the bottom of  the door would fix that in a jiff. Bathroom vanity had kind of dim lights so if you do precision makeup you might be irritated. Keypads get you into the building and into the unit, but the building keypad is kinda janky and you have to press really hard to make it work. The unit keypad did not work when I arrived but a call to Sonder got it fixed remotely, so the customer service gets a thumbs up despite the situation being pretty annoying after a long flight and slog from Newark.   Sonder does not put individual photos of the units on the listings and instead has generic photos and assigns you a unit right before check in so you will likely get something completely different than what you think you booked. This is annoying as hell and probably against AirBnb policy. If it’s not against policy it’s still lazy and bad. I know hotels do this but AirBnb is not a hotel. We should see exactly what we’re getting. Hire a photographer to shoot all the units and assign the proper photos to the listings!   Location:    The building is so amazingly located that it boggles the mind. You’re just steps from multiple subway stations that will get you anywhere you need to go. Drug store literally next door. Every kind of food you’d want all over the place. 24 hour McDonalds if you roll like that. It’s a truly impeccable location. The building also has a 24 hour front desk person which adds a big air of safety and security.   Overall I think this is a good hybrid business model fusing the convenience and modernity of AirBnb with a more consistent quality and expectation experience that you get with a hotel. And for NYC this is miles above any hotel you can get and better than most AirBnbs I’ve had here. I recommend but Sonder should really decide if they want to be an independent entity or if they want to be an AriBnb host. They’re trying to do both and the two ideas clash harshly in some areas.

This was hard. For 14 days I was charged 4*** plus and had no heat in my bedroom. People were coming in and out trying to figure it out. I even tried to reset the system myself. I only got to speak to the building manager right before I checked out. No resolution as of yet. They try to switch me to other rooms that were “identical” but please know that every room is not the same and might be much smaller. One of them even switched me to another building without consent. So I remained in my studio but got sick because of the cold.   Lady downstairs at the front was quite racist, I thought she was going to attack so I always walked quickly in/out of the building when she’s on duty.   This is also the only luxury serviced apartment in the world that does not provide cleaning service. You have to pay them extra for it. If you are a frequent traveller as I am, you know what I’m talking about. You are better off staying at one that’s linked to a hotel if you are particular about that. Two stars because I really liked the layout and location.   Building managers and maintenance people were nice. Malcolm was the only customer service personnel that was efficient.    I’m too tired to continue this review but hope the other Sonders are better. I believe they are.

Sheets were a bit dirty and was not super smooth to get them changed, having the same password for the building entrance and the room feels unsafe, someone could see the code from the street and then make their way to the room. Otherwise all good.

Very nice cozy and convenient apartment.  It small enough for one person, but definitely large enough for 2 adults (and probably a small child).  It's close to the train, restaurants, drug store, supermarket and small corner stores.  There is also a laundromat a block from the apartment.  The kitchen is fully stock with all appliances (including toaster, coffee maker, blender & microwave),  a place setting for 4 people, pots & pans and silverware.  The WiFi is good.  There is a TV, but I never turned it on (it's NYC, but spend time watching TV).
The building entrance is sketchy but apartment is fine. Not is clean as shown in pictures.

Great overall experience.   Room: Good- The room was clean, well lit and well organized. The kitchenette has everything you need for a short stay including pots, pans, utensils, cups, gas stove top, dish washer, refrigerator and microwave. There was coffee and tea and they had a nice french press. The bed was comfortable for a few nights. A/c worked well despite the higher summer temperatures.  Bad- Large windows but not much of a view. My only real gripe was the shower which was way too small and let out all the water.   Location: Good- The location is a 3 min walk from world trade center and it was very easy to get around the city. We arrived from Newark and took the PATH train to WTC, very easy and convenient. Brooklyn bridge is a short 10min walk. Many restaurants in the area even a Joe's pizza which is a must have when in NY. Fulton station is also nearby (4min walk) with plenty of restaurants and access to the subway.  Bad- There are bags of trash in the street right in front of the entrance and the surrounding area while not a dangerous neighborhood by any means, is not somewhere I would like to be at 2am.   Staff: Check in was a breeze, staff was friendly and accommodating. We arrived an hour earlier than our check-in time, my wife is pregnant and needed to use the restroom. They were nice enough to let us check in earlier.  Check out was also easy and the staff was nice enough to let us store our belongings there so that we could continue exploring the city.   Overall, great stay. highly recommend this location and would definitely stay here again.

Fantastic splurge location.  Settled in the financial district. Very close to the 9/11 memorial, Liberty Park, and a short walk to the ferry. More attractions are a bit more of a walk... and Ubers can get expensive.  The stay itself is pretty darn nice. The building is very well presented and has an earthy theme in conjunction with a modern look. Instructions are pretty clear and you can get into the lobby with your code, and you use the same code for the rooms. This particular stay I had was right on the 8th floor, which was a very quick flight of stairs down to the laundry on the 7th floor. The rooftop terrace isn't as extravagant as I imagined, but it was still very nice to have as an option, and the flora was a very nice touch (although those sensitive to the sun would appreciate a shelter for shade).  The room itself is VERY nice. It is essentially a suite, equipped with pots, pans, plates, cutlery and silverware, coffee pot, French press, everything you would need for a comfortable stay. Everything looks clean, modern, and nice. Most utility items (microwave, trash, dishwasher) are hidden within the cabinetry, which was a clever aesthetic touch. The three windows we had allowed in plenty of natural light, but the view is of the next building... so not fantastic, but that's also what comes with being in NYC. Same with traffic noise from ground level... you WILL hear vehicles honking, but it comes part of the territory... nothing they can control. Open concept for the shower, which was nifty but kind of strange as it let water go EVERYWHERE in the bathroom.  Staff was very friendly and greeted us every time we came and left. Got there a little early and they were kind enough to let us in at 3:40ish instead of the 4PM check in without any extra charge.  I had scheduled a delivery way in advanced and it was delivered to the room for my arrival. Fantastic customer service well in advance!  It is a bit expensive per night, but it was definitely worth the splurge. Nicest hotel suite I've ever stayed in... definitely added to the trip.

Great location in financial district. Only a few minutes away from just about any subway line you could need. Good variety of food around the neighborhood. Never felt unsafe waking the streets at night either.  The building itself is great and the rooms were amazing for the most part. The only weird thing that others have also mentioned was the bathroom and the shower. No shower curtains means water gets everywhere. Literally everywhere. Cant use the toilet without getting wet unless you dry the floor yourself after a shower. We kept a towel on the floor to soak up all the water that got out. The sink also drained really slowly but otherwise the bathroom was great.  The kitchen was fully stocked with any utensils and cooking stuff you could need. Rest of the room was nice and clean as well.  The lockers before/after Checkin are a great perk!  We’ll definitely use Sonder for our next NY visit. Highly recommend this listing to anyone visiting NY. You won’t be disappointed.

The location of the apartment is great and truthfully the apartment itself is too (be aware, however, that unlike what is advertised in the listing,  there is not ac - apparently it was removed for the winter at the beginning of October). It should be noted that there is a major facade renovation taking place on the outside of this building; it’s not mentioned in the listing and I was only notified on the day of check in (and told that there would be no noise or dust - which is laughable). The noise started every day of my 7 day stay before 9 am and ended around 5 pm. This made the living room unusable because it was so loud. The work was being done directly above the front door to the apartment so any time you walked in or out you were being covered by sand, rocks or falling wood. The front path way leading to the door is covered by mud, debris and garbage due to the renovation. Not only was this incredibly disruptive, it was also dangerous. I likely would have been very happy to stay here while this work was not being done, but this place shouldn’t be rented out during this renovation project. Or it should at least be mentioned upon booking as this was a very unwelcome surprise. I was given a “sorry for the inconvenience” when voicing my surprise and concern during my stay.

Probably a scam. Joe was MIA and we couldn’t check in for our 20th anniversary trip to NYC. We lugged our luggage all over the city in the snow until we finally found another spot in Jersey. Terrible.

I've stayed in hotels across NYC, from very sketchy corporate chains in Times Square to the best the city has to offer. This is the first time I've ever been comfortable in a NYC accommodation. The location was perfect, the neighborhood had everything we needed, and it was safe and walkable without too much hassle. The room itself featured possibly the largest bathroom I've ever had in NYC with lots of hot water & high water pressure, fresh towels and a blowdryer at the ready, and large well-lit mirrors above a sink with counters. The closet was smallish, but had enough room for two with drawers built in plus an ironing board and iron. The kitchenette had all we needed--plates, forks, towels,  dish soap, microwave, mini-dishwasher--to eat takeout that can be easily delivered to the lobby. They also have a coffeemaker and electric kettle, but multiple fantastic coffee shops are nearby. And the bed was super comfortable! The room was spotlessly clean and quiet. There was a little bit of street noise, but whaddyawant? Will stay again!

This is a definite steal in terms of value! You have access to nearby Fulton Center to get anywhere in the city, and the rooms were amazing! We did have a little issue when we first checked in, however, as our toilet was not working. Nevertheless, the on-site team accommodated us with a new room quickly! The staff is super friendly, and we will definitely be looking to use Sonder again.

My 3 night stay was an excellent experience.  This is a private room in a shared space but still provided access to a living room area and a clean and comfortable bedroom.  Auset was very kind and accommodating allowing for a stress free stay.  I found the location of the property to be very convenient for traveling around NYC since the space is located a short walk from the M and L train lines, so getting to Manhattan and Brooklyn was very straight forward.  Bathroom area was very clean and secure.  Also, Ziki the dog was a splendid and lovable neighbor.  I would definitely stay here again in a future trip.

Such a great Airbnb! For anyone that’s been to NYC, they know safety is a top priority. We felt very safe as there is a keypad lock to the front doors and your unit and someone is at the front desk most of the time. We didn’t feel unsafe at any point during our whole stay! Great location to the must see things in nyc. Extremely close to Fulton subway station as well as the World Trade Center memorial and museum. One night a neighbor across the street was blasting music, but it was a private apartment with no relation to sonder. We didn’t seem to have any noise issues regarding anyone in the sounder’s building. The unit was clean, looked new, and came with amenities such as shampoo, conditioner, lotion, toilet paper, paper towels, washing pods for dish washer and washing machine, coffee, linens, and a smart tv in the room. If it’s not in your room, you’re sure to find it on the 7th floor in the stock room. We did only have one towel and one rag upon arrival, but we asked the front desk and within minutes we received several more towels and rags. Great responses anytime i needed anything. Would definitely use them again through Airbnb.

Super great AirBNB with great communication from the host! The only downside to this place was the location, there were people pestering you and doing drugs right in front just outside the gate, which was extremely uncomfortable. I would just be sure to never leave alone.
Great place. Exactly as the pictures. Subway mins away.   Only issue was lots of homeless in the area and parking.

I've already stayed with Sonder twice, and both times have been positive. Beautiful space and user-friendly app platform. I will note that the front desk personnel at Sonder is VERY impolite and unpleasant without cause. Please be warned that you may experience disrespect and unpleasant language and attitude from Sonder front desk staff.

We had a great stay at Luux's place! The apartment was absolutely spotless and the location was great for getting around town.  I know some people mentioned that the area did not feel super safe, but we didn't experience that at all (even when arriving at 11:30pm). Yes, there are a lot of homeless in the Times Square area, but that's just the way it is and I had no issues even when walking alone at night as a single female. The apartment is very near the intersection of 8th Ave, which is a bright and busy corner.   The apartment is perfect for 2 people and we appreciated having the table in the kitchen to work from, along with plenty of drawer and closet space, and space in the bathroom cabinet. It's easily accessible and up one small flight of stairs. The building itself felt clean and well-maintained.  Check-in was easy with the lock box.   My only minor notes: I generally prefer a firmer bed and the mattress was extremely soft. An extra pillow or blanket is always appreciated and next time I'd probably remember to bring my little clip-on reading light as the only light in the bedroom is overhead. Again, these are just nit-picky things.  All in all, a great bargain and a solid choice!

Luxx is a fantastic and responsive host who gave clear instructions and description of his apartment. Mind you, this is New York and while this location is super walkable, you're still close to Times Square which means there are quite a few homeless people around. We never felt unsafe though and loved how easily we could access the Theater district and subway.  You definitely want to like the person you're traveling with since this apartment is very small. The bed is comfy, the towels are big, the shower water is hot, and the apartment has everything you need for a nice stay in New York. We would absolutely stay here again.

She was very kind and welcoming, and the room was clean and comfortable, but the noise around the house was bothersome at times, and the area around the station is a bit unsafe, so I thought it would be better to be careful when woman travel alone. However, there were no big problems and I had a pleasant trip. Thank you very much.

The host was responsive to my booking inquiry and questions, and accurately described the check in process. He was friendly and showed me the space, which has many digital benefits (Google TV, wifi, Spotify, etc.). The overall house and space are clean, with ample free on street parking in a safe neighborhood, located not far from a main commercial road that offers many amenities (restaurants, gas stations, drug stores, etc.). Overall, it was an excellent value. Thank you.

We had an amazing stay at Adam’s apartment. The location is perfect: quiet yet not scary; good restaurants especially for breakfast; veeery close to the subway station!  The house was clean and had everything we needed and even more than that. Adam always answered very quickly and we really felt like at home.  :)

This is not in a safe area of town. This is not a place to stay with children. The host didn’t respond when I messaged about needing to cancel our reservations because of our scary experiences walking to the place. The inside is just as advertised and would have been fine in a different part of town.
Very unsafe area on the ground floor. We did not feel safe staying here and had to find accommodations elsewhere on arrival.

Henry’s place was an excellent choice for my needs. I was a bit afraid of the stairs. But once I went up there a couple of times and I got the hang of it. The shower is great. I love all the levels to it. Check in and out was a breeze. I never had a host seen me instructional pictures. It made it so simple. You can’t go wrong with this hidden gem. Just beware of parking. The area has small streets and lots of residences.

Alkhadher’s place May fool you from the outside, but woven in the amazing little garden into the basement is a top class Airbnb. From the most elegant floor in the double bedroom to the multiple USB ports. I cannot stress enough how great the value is.  Couple that with one of the most accommodating hosts I’ve ever had the pleasure of being at and you have a top class, 5-star Airbnb.

While they were prompt to reply when we expressed our concerns. They failed to inform us upon arrival that there was a refrigerator in the kitchen that had residue from rotten food in it. They sent their son to let us in, he was very nice. Unfortunately they told him to tell us that the appliance had broken then very day so we could not use it. This is impossible given the rancid smell that came from it and the abundance of fruit flies that poured out upon opening in. In addition to the ones that were already present on the kitchen. It simply did not add up. I suspect that the refrigerator had been broken for some time and they neglected to move it or take care of the fruit flies before our arrival. Additionally, mold was growing from the ceiling in the kitchen that was substantial. It had to have been there for quite some time for it to spore so much. This was a huge concern for me as it is a health issue. I would have never followed through had I been informed of this or had accurate pictures been posted. Had I know of the fruit flies, the mildew and unkempt bathroom, and the mold on the kitchen ceiling, and that we would be kept up until almost 2am each night because of children or someone stomping upstairs, I would have taken my money elsewhere. I feel incredibly mislead.  We would have gone somewhere else but given the festival and the cost we simply could not use that option. Very unfortunately first experience.

Alkhader was a very prompt communicator. He kindly accepted a request to add and then remove a member of our party from the reservation prior to our arrival. The home is in a great location. The apartment is as other reviewers have described. We were unable to use the outdoor swing that another reviewer talked about due to the tall grass.  The apartment wasn't as clean as we would have liked, but it also was not worth complaining about when we just wanted to rest our feet from a long day of sightseeing with kids. The stairs to get into the apartment are pretty steep. This was not a problem for our party, but could be for someone else. There were a few mosquitos in the apartment and hanging around the door to get in. This wasn't a dealbreaker, but it was an inconvenience and we considered purchasing bug spray. We did not communicate this to the host because we were out late. I suspect (based on other reviews) that he would have offered us bug spray had we complained about it. As I mentioned before, he was prompt to respond to our communications. Overall, the apartment met our needs and allowed us to enjoy our trip.

First time using airbnb and it won’t be my last! Exceptional  hospitality and the location was right in the middle of all of the places I needed to visit during my stay. I’ll definitely add this stay to my top 5. Thank you so much for making this experience a great one being that I was traveling alone I was so scared to do so but you definitely helped me feel at home while I was there!

Even though the apartment is quite far north, it is very well connected by metro and even commuting every day to NYU was not a problem for me. The area is not the nicest, but it is not unsafe. The building is not at all well maintained, but the apartment is really nice. Kitchen and bathroom are modern and big. The small room is indeed very small, but comfortable and clear. I would not recommend it for two people.  As I said, the bathroom, and in particular the shower, are very beautiful. However, the apartment has only one bathroom, so when the second room is also rented out and Vanessa and her husband are at home, it might get a little crowded. We organised and it was never a problem.  There is a supermarket and a pharmacy on the same block. The metro station (1, red line) is just one block away.  I had a hard time finding the lockbox with the keys and the entrance of the building, but this was my fault because I did not realise that Vanessa had sent pictures on the Airbnb app. I managed to get Wi-Fi,  looked again at the message with the instructions and finally noticed that by cklicking the  "Start Check-in" button some pictures would appear. At that point, everything made sense. So make sure to check that out!  I definitely recommend this room for people travelling alone for a short period of time!

The reviews don’t lie! I’m glad I jumped on the opportunity to book Liat & Allan’s place as we wanted to spend time in Brooklyn (and live like the Locals!) after spending a few nights in Manhattan. I love the neighborhood feel which remains quiet at night despite being in the city. The surrounding neighborhoods are filled with families and we never felt unsafe for a second. There are notable bars/restaurants to check out in Brooklyn and all are within walking distance or a short Uber ride away from the apartment: Clover Club, Elsa, Public Record, Bar Bete) I went to Poppy’s twice and also took advantage of Lagree classes at SLT since it’s a 5 min walk away. My kid enjoyed the splash pads at Brooklyn Water Lab and there are tons of smaller parks nearby. The subway is a bit of a walk away (about a 14 min walk coz my kid loves to get out of her stroller ..)    The apartment itself is great! Clean and spacious for 3 adults and a kid. Our friend slept on the sofa bed and she said it was pretty comfy! We cooked a lot as well, the kitchen is equipped with all the basic utensils you need. Having laundry in the unit is a huge plus especially with my kid who always seems to need 2 outfit changes each day coz of the heat and humidity.   Thanks to Liat & Allan who were super responsive and awesome communicators, we felt taken cared of. All in all, we had a fabulous 8 night stay at the apartment and would come back in a heartbeat because nothing beats summer time in NYC!

Great place to stay in Brooklyn! The apartment was spacious, clean, and extremely affordable compared to other places we looked at in the area.  It was a little inconvenient for our trip based on our plans, but the price made up for that. Again it was because of our plans. The place was VERY clean and accommodating. Chantal was very responsive and helpful during the whole booking process. She allowed us to drop our bags prior to check-in which was a huge win for us. If you plan to spend your week or weekend in Manhattan, it may feel far, but if you plan your trip in Brooklyn, it’s a steal and I highly recommend!! 15 minute Uber to Dumbo. If we ever go back to Brooklyn, Chantal’s place will be our top priority to stay. She was fantastic! Thank you again Chantal!

Easy check in, Prompt repone, Hosts' Kindness, and everything else is okay!    As for safety, I didn't feel anything dangerous. And neighbors(I mean store workers) are kind.   예약 마무리하면 주소가 나오지만, 호스트 분께서 체크인 과정 및 교통, 숙소 및 부근 교통 지리 지도 포함한 내용을 종이 2장으로 보내주십니다.   큰 불편같은건 없었는데, 필요한 점 등이 있을 경우, 혹은 불편한 내용이 있을 시 문자로 보내면 바로 답장 및 피드백해주십니다.   맨하탄까지 넉넉잡고 한 시간 미만 거리인데(센트럴파크까지는 약 한시간), 멀다는 생각이 전혀 들지 않았고  지하철 공연이나 기차내에서 가끔씩 벌어지는(?) 서커스 비슷한 퍼포먼스 볼 수 있어서 좋았습니다. 지하철 좌석은 항상 여유있어요.   특히 J 트레인은 퀸즈를 관통하는 주요노선이고 공항철도까지 이어지는거라서 다른 열차노선과 달리 심야나 일요일에도 멈추는 일이 거의 없는걸로 압니다.   또, 안전면에서도, 낯선 곳이니 늦게 다닐 때, 항상 조심해야하겠지만, 위험한 장소는 아니라 생각됩니다. (저는 새벽, 심야에 몇번 다니곤 했는데, 이곳 아니더라도 객지에서는 조심하는게 필요한 것 같습니다만),
Do not book this place if you’re taking your car. There is no street parking after 6 pm. It’s scary!

The apartment is beautiful with nice amenities such as washer and dryer beautiful shower and stainless steel appliances. It is small but it was just me and my daughter so it is perfect for a couple or 2 people. 3 at most. The only downside is it is 6 flights of stairs with no elevator. We got use to that after the 2nd day and the price, and the apartment itself made it worth the climb. Also shawn was amazing he always responded right away. It is a secured building which is nice.    The neighborhood may look a little sketchy at night but no one bothered us and it was close to the subway so we got around really easy. Since it's in Harlem you get authentic New York so some of the best food we had was only blocks from the apartment.

This location was amazing. Less than a bloc off of the line straight into manhattan. Queens street has everything you need within walking distance. The neighborhood was welcoming and not once did we feel unsafe walking down the streets at night. Overall great apartment, and gracious hosts. Would recommend.
This place is a steal! Such a great location 📍

Spacious apartment but very sparsely furnished and appointed.  A dirty coffee cup was in with the rest of the clean (?) dishes.  Good thing I looked inside the cup before I poured my drink.  The apartment appeared clean upon entering but attention to detail was severely lacking.  Walls are dirty, blinds filthy and the towels were old and stiff.  The sheets did smell nice.  No batteries in the smoke detectors, many lights did not work.  Lots of old soap scum on the shampoo rack in the shower.  The overhead light shade in the bedroom was rusty and dirty.  Was close to my daughters place which was the major plus I’m staying here.

Amazing spot! Very nice and cute place with more space than expected. Felt like you were at home.  Was able to accommodate us last minute when our other lodging fell through, made a stressful night so much more enjoyable. Local area is very nice in Little Yemen. Thanks again!

The place is great for a couple to stay in. I was however travelling with a friend of the opposite sex, but Bassam made some changes to accommodate the privacy we required. The place is next to several metro stops which are in walking distance, so very easy to get into Manhattan. The area is close to coffee shops and restaurants (try out Brooklyn Kebab) which is excellent. The neighbourhood was very safe and you can walk around at night without any issues. Bassam kindly held our luggage as our flight was a late flight. This took the stress out from the day. Thank you to the host and his wife.
The place was great and the host was too! the area seemed sketchy at first but it wasn't bad at all !

we stayed in the apartment with a group of five women from the Netherlands. The apartment is very big and you feel at home very immediately. everything you need is right there and the kitchen is well stocked with salt, pepper, oil etc. you don't need to buy any of the basic things and that was very helpful (and aved us a lot if money). the bathroom is also stocked with free shampoo, conditioner etc.  when you arrive at night, the neighbourhood can really feel a bit overwhelming. during daytime you can see better what the street and surroundings look like and then you see that although it might look a little bit unsafe, it really is not. we have met some really nice people in the street. people are friendly, interested and helpful and in the end we were thankful to have chosen this place over anything else. the location and the size of the property gave an extra dimension to our trip. we recommend this place to people who have travelled the world, who are interested in different cultures, who would like to see the New York from a different side and are looking for a lot of space during their stay!

Kaz's place was absolutely amazing! I stayed 3 months and loved every minute of it! The place was really big and had a lot of storage room. Kaz had thought of everything you might need (tons of cleaning supplies, space heaters, paper towels etc). The metro is literally right next door and takes you straight down to midtown in 15 minutes. I never felt unsafe and there were always people in the streets, even late at night.  Thanks again Kaz!

Hosts were great at communicating. Fast and efficient. And very understanding of their guests’ needs. The place has everything you need for a short stay in NYC.  However the neighborhood is not the best place to stay. I wouldn’t say it’s unsafe, I’m sure there are people outside, but I wouldn’t recommend going out alone at night.

Great apartment, great hosts. It was very spacious for one person, decent for two, and comes with a private bathroom and kitchen. There were some issues that came up, but hosts responded quickly and paid for everything that needed fixing. The location is convenient enough (right next to subway station, grocery store, laundry) although the neighborhood is not the greatest. It’s not a terrible place but there’s a lot of noise and occasionally witnessed some drug use outside the building. Still, recommend if you don’t mind the area, I never had any serious problems there.

This property was not what I expected when I made my booking, the pictures were cozy and cute, but when I arrived the decor was more sterile, moreover some of the amenities were missing or in need of replacement before i could use the apartment properly, on a full months stay this was extremely frustrating, the oven not functioning was a major issue, which the host did address during my stay and fixed. The area, however,  was full of disturbances and fraught with danger, quite a rough neighborhood, certainly not safe or welcoming for a solo traveler new to the city. I had people outside at all hours, day and night making noise, causing trouble and an incident involving police.  However, the issues with area are not reflective of Kaz as a host, he and his team were very helpful with the situations, very kind and communicative in dealing with and resolving the problems that came up, even moving me to another place after a major issue AirBnb support was largely unhelpful with these issues

The first time was fine, although he locked us out of the house twice because he put a code on the door that he hadn't given us and the neighborhood is not super safe. But then everything got worse, the cleaning that you pay for through Airbnb is not done in the house and on the contrary, they ask you to do it yourself. Jewell is very rude, disrespectful to the people she rents from, and doesn't know how to deal with people. The WiFi in the house is very bad and even if you tell them about it, they don't solve it. He even made racist comments, raised his tone when speaking and touched the guests' personal belongings without permission. In my case I threw my toothbrush in the trash and in the case of other people I took their food, like bread. The house is good, although 45 minutes from Manhattan, but I don't recommend living with it because of how stressful it becomes. One pays for accommodation to be quiet, comfortable and safe but this is not the case, tranquility does not exist!

This place is good but I would not recommend this for long stays. Writing this review after staying there for 30 days.   Pros:  Place is well connected with all the subways and bus routes are in walkable distance.   Good communication with host.   Patrick was very kind and accommodating.   Kitchen is well equipped.   Grocery stores are in walkable distance.   All the rooms have TVs.  Cons: WiFi- Terrible. There is WiFi booster not a router. It’s getting disconnected every 5 minutes which is really bad when you are in meeting or working. We had to purchase a hotspot to compensate it. Movies doesn’t stream continuously. I had to restart the app every single time.   It’s a small house, we felt bit congested and there is zero ventilation.   We saw centipedes in the bath tub which is scary and disgusting and witnessed it second time in the living room too.   It’s an old house and we had some water leakage issue in the kitchen sink but Patrick resolved it immediately.

After a really bad experience in Boston with another Airbnb, I was so afraid to come here, but Rafael’s place is all what I ask and more! I truly recommend if you are traveling with your family, this place has space for everyone, is a really short walk to the free ferry to NY, and that ride is an adventure very time! Thank you Ivona and Rafael! We love your place.

My family and I (5) stayed here from March 16-21, traveling from California. Can’t say enough great things about this place! The listed description is exactly what you get and more. Great place. All the amenities of home. Clean and comfortable!   Pros- clean and comfortable. 4 bedrooms- huge space for a NY apartment. Lots of stairs but worth it.   -easy least check in. Rafael was great at providing us with the codes for a simple check-in. -kitchen has all the necessary cookware. Big kitchen with a nice window overlooking the backyard. Make sure you open the window when u cook- the fire alarm tends to go off even when it gets too hot in the kitchen.  - neighborhood has many eateries right outside. Grocery store across the street. Liquor store as well. Neighborhood looks a a little sketchy but we felt safe. No issues at all. -wonderful communication with Rafael and his wife. They went above and beyond to make sure the answered our questions immediately and pointed us in the right direction for things we needed. Even was thoughtful enough to put out umbrellas for me and my family! 🙏🏾❤️ - heating and AC worked well. We were there during the cold period and the heat came on instantly. Nice and cozy!  - plenty of towels and extra blankets. Plus complimentary toiletries and some food items. We made sure to try and leave some stuff to pass along to the next guest as well.  -bathrooms are small- only one shower tub combo- but big enough to take care of your personal needs.  -plenty of closet space and dresser space as well. Floors are wood so make sure to bring flip flops or house shoes if you don’t like it.  -walking distance to ferry (about 10-15 minutes) also bus locations are right outside the front door.  -3 televisions in the whole unit. 2 downstairs (main bedroom and living room) one upstairs in the main bedroom. Wi-Fi worked very well. Kids were able to do their homework with no issues.  -nice sized refrigerator and oven. Only issue was no cookware for baking so we bought some tin lined cookware.   Cons- it’s the city- expect a lot of noise outside. Didn’t bother us but may bother some.  -shower doesn’t have a lot of pressure. Even when you adjust the head- sort of a soft spray.  -no washer or dryer so be prepared to go to the laundromat. We found a great one around the corner- at Rafael’s suggestion- took about 22lbs of laundry in- paid $23 for them to wash and fold it! Not bad at all.  -as I said before- lots and lots of stairs. Wasn’t an issue for us at all but might be for some. About 10-12 steps outside. There’s about 15 up to the first floor. Then another 12-15 to the second level. And small  steps and a little steep so be careful if decide to party hard! 🤣🤣 -parking can be an issue but Rafael makes that very clear. We parked on Minthorne at night- but you have to beat people to the spot. It’s usually ok if you get there before midnight or so. But if not- beware! Parking is like almost $5 every two hours during the day until 7pm. And trust me, the police are checking!  Overall, a terrific find on Staten Island! We were very pleased with our stay. We had friends over who stayed at an Airbnb near us who paid way more than us for a much smaller place and uncomfortable furniture. Our friend liked the place and said it “felt cozy and like home”.  Our kiddos -ages 10-13-14- loved it. Rafael had some board games and plenty of books to read. We will definitely return this summer and give Rafael referrals for his place. Thanks again, Rafael and Ivona! A true gem in the heart of Staten Island!!

Christine was a sweet and hospitable hostess. An emergency arose and we needed a place immediately.  We were blessed with the availability of this haven. The space was very clean, beautifully decorated,  and the provided amenities were delightfully unexpected.  We had a slight access issue but her husband's patience and understanding helped during an already stressful situation.

Definitely pay attention to Cando’s notes about Uber/lyft access. Those were helpful! The place was very comfortable and nice. I wished I could live there! I’m afraid that there was some information encouraging guests to put towels in the hamper, but my itinerary/guidebook was never able to load so I had no idea.

This apartment was excellent! The location is great, only two blocks to the 2 Express train, a grocery store and drug store. The space is very comfortable and the rooftop deck is fantastic, with a view of the Empire State Building in the distance.  Lucie was a great host, very responsive and easy to work with. This was by far my smoothest Airbnb experience. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend to anyone looking for a great place to stay.

Cleanliness: Not very clean. The bathroom was especially not clean when I first arrived. I purchased my own cleaning products since there was very little there. If cleanliness is not important for you then you’ll be just fine.  Safety: The area is ok, but I did not always feel safe in the apt with one of the guest. Remember that there will be three others sharing in the space that you will not know and that they may also bring their own guests. I was awakened one of one in the middle of the night by someone’s guest yelling and cursing. It only happened once but it was a bit scary.  Heat: You cannot control the temperature here. It was always very hot in the room. Great for a colder winter, but it wasn’t too cold in nyc for my stay.   Noise: Typical noise from outside, but there is also construction happening right across the street. From about 6am to 5pm you will hear it. Noise inside is very low.  Location: This was the best thing about this place. It’s in Manhattan, Central Harlem. Between two metro stations that are typically running. Restaurants and stores nearby as well.   Space: The space was pretty decent. The place is furnished with some items but not too much.  Host: Communication was virtual. Pretty quick to respond.  Overall: NOT a good place for LADIES. Other guests were mainly men. Great for a guy looking for something short term and not caring much about cleanliness of the place. Best: location and proximity to trains.  Worst: dirty common spaces.

Cons: Old apartment, old appliances too, including the air conditioning is noisy.  If you plug too many appliances into the sockets, the resistance in the house turns off.  We had a problem with the heating on days that were quite cold, we had no hot water for 2 days, but that's why I received a discount on the value.  The house is dirty, it will depend a lot on who is staying at the time you are.  The walls leak a lot of sound from one room to another.  The bathroom faucet does not have hot water, so if you are staying in winter you will have to wash your hands in the shower or kitchen sink.  We cannot receive packages because neighbors steal, there are notices all over the place about package theft and my package was lost but as I complained they returned it.  Pros: The room itself is nice, bright, simple and useful.  It has all the tools you might need.  And everything is organized and divided by the letter of your room, this makes it much easier in the closet, fridge and baskets in the bathroom.  As it is on the fifth floor, I lost weight during my stay.  The service of the owners is excellent, everything I needed they provided and always responded quickly and politely.  The location is wonderful too, close to two subways.  The strong point of this room is definitely the location, easy access to everywhere.

The apartment is Nicel, functional and well maintained. Someone comes to clean every week. The roommates are super calm and sociable.   Close to the center of Manhattan (15 minutes by subway) I find that Harlem is a great neighborhood, not at all dangerous as I have heard.   Self Check in and check out so it’s very good and very flexible on schedules!  The only thing to say is that if you are a light sleeper it is complicated because it is poorly insulated but in general in the USA and particularly in New York it is inevitable!  I highly recommend this accommodation!

Let me start off by saying that you definitely need I have a photo shoot on the rooftop! The view is absolutely amazing.  Now on to more important things; the location was perfect, the room was cute and clean, the feel of the apartment is comfortable, and the host is wonderful. Before booking with Sydney I had an issue with another host and got scammed. I shared this experience with Sydney and she made me feel comfortable and much better about booking with her and had no problem accommodating for myself and my friend.  I would rate this experience 10/10 because of Sydney, the neighborhood, the transit system, and how much I loved NY.  If I decided to stay in Brooklyn for my visit I would definitely stay with Sydney again!

Jeff is truly deserving of being a super host. And his place is amazing. I rented the place for six days for a big group for my wedding. The place was very clean and organized. We had everything that we needed; towels/pillows/bed sheets/extra blankets/utensils/shampoo/conditioner/soap , you name it and it was there. I did not have to run around to buy basic household things and that was very helpful given that I had other important things to do.  The instructions were on point which makes every thing smooth and comfortable.  All of my guests were super happy and comfy and had good things to say about the place. You can catch a train to Manhattan just after a 5 min walk. Super convenient. Talk about Jeff, what a kind and good person he is. When I arrived on my first day here around 8pm, Jeff was kind enough to reserve me a spot right in front of the house so that I dont have to struggle after my tiring flight from cali to NY. He even let me park by blocking his driveway during the day. I just had to be diligent to move my car before 7am when Jeff’s fiancee leaves for work. That is a small inconvenience compared to driving around the block to find a spot. You will be surprised to see how fast Jeff responds and addresses to your questions/concerns or any other help you need. He is super responsive and very understanding and helpful. If I could give him a 100 stars, I would. I would highly recommend renting from Jeff if you are looking for a hassle free, stress free stay. You wont be disappointed. I am for sure renting again from him when I travel back to NY.

The place was great and the host and his wife were very friendly and welcoming. The room was great and everything, but there was no AC. it's a great airbnb for the value and location, but I would suggest  that tourists stay in Brooklyn or Manhattan because it feels much safer; walking through Queens feels a little scary. There were a few nights when neighbors would play loud music which made it difficult to sleep.

We stayed at this Airbnb property over Thanksgiving Weekend 2021.  It was the perfect place for our large group.  Jeff was an outstanding host and the property was exactly as described and pictured. The home was very well-stocked with basic amenities and extremely comfortable.  It was also very close to the subway, which allowed us to take a couple of low stress, low cost trips into Manhattan during our stay.  There are PLENTY of stores within a 5 minute walking distance to pickup any groceries or other items you might need during your stay.  Jeff was very flexible, generous, and professional host!  He was extremely helpful and communicative before and during our stay.  He is easily the best Airbnb host we've had so far!   I HIGHLY RECOMMEND staying at this property if you are heading to New York City, and want all of the conveniences of home and easy transportation access into NYC.

Jordans place is a gem on Manhattan! It is within walking distance of many attractions and with lots of nice restaurants and bars just around the corner.The room has everything you need and Jordan is an excellent host who is very discrete and extremely helpful. The rooftop is absolutely amazing-it beats any fancy and expensive hotel any time! Furthermore my daughter and I never ever felt unsafe  walking down the street og staying in the flat!This is a top place to stay if you go to NY-thanks Jordan😊👍🏻
Linda is a great host. Her place is very clean and all amneties are operational. She's located in a quiet, safe neighborhood.  I wasn't afraid to walk alone at night.

Jose was a wonderful host. He was quick to communicate and very flexible on check in time. Everything was stress free! The apartment is even better in person and it’s so nice to stay in an Airbnb that’s actually lived in rather than a glorified hotel. The bed is very comfy and the location is fantastic. Lots of great neighbourhood gems around and close to the water where there is a great running and cycling trail. This was a great home base for me as I got my footing in Manhattan.

Our trip was like staying with family without the stress of staying with family. We felt very welcomed and at home in their apartment and my little one even went down to play with their son a few times. The apartment is beautiful, and exactly as pictured. Lots of great cafes and restaurants around and easily accessible to public transportation. Check in was easy with no problems. Tala and her husband were always available to answer any questions. It really made for a great trip to NYC.

Vaughn’s home is a perfect place for tourists and visitors alike. When open the door to walk into the home, you must push on a large industrial pipe which makes up the door handle, instantly giving you a rustic and industrial feel. The house is accented with quaint nods to the industrial theme which it had promised in the title. Vaughn only had a few hours to prepare for my arrival, but the house was none the less impeccable. Extremely clean and tidy! Vaughn provides coffee and tea, along with a coffee maker, as well as several fresh water bottles in the miniature fridge. Hair wash was not provided, but body wash is there. Vaughn himself is a helpful and kind individual, so don’t be shy asking him about anything New York related, he seems very knowledgeable, and helped me out whenever I asked about local eateries or popular places. (He is also quick to reply, as there was a wifi issue, which he quickly resolved). Despite only staying for 3 nights, I could have stayed a lot longer, the house is extremely livable! Overall, I highly recommend anyone considering Vaughn’s Industrial Chic.    OVERVIEW   CLEANLINESS AND DECOR: 10/10 -Definite nods to the industrial theme.  -Entire house was clean and organized.  -Liveable for long periods of time.   HOST: 10/10 -Very responsive.  -Has loads of helpful tips for tourists and travellers.  -Kind and professional.    LOCATION: 8/10 -Roughly 30 minute subway ride to Manhattan.  -Local area is very pretty & rustic, but a little scary at night.  -Not many restaurants in direct area, asides from Basic chain fast food joints.

I had a terrible experience at this specific place, very filthy, room smelled so much like cigarettes, I cleaned it myself included the walls, floors, mirror, windows and my rag came out black in color from the amount of filth from this place. The door is falling apart and leaving not personal items felt very unsafe, too many strange people coming in and out of the entire 2 family house and people smoke Mary Jane the entire time. Fridge didn’t completely close, we ran out of toilet paper, person in charge says he cleans bathroom and hallways every Saturday, he never came to clean anything. I don’t mind cleaning, but if you say you are going to come by to clean, we expect someone to come and clean. Overall, I wouldn’t recommend anyone to stay in this specific room. Owner seemed nice through chat but wouldn’t offer a refund although I only stayed for 7 days and rented for 30 days. I preferred renting a hotel room then this place, I lost my money ! Place was also unsafe, the area had people sleeping and drinking in a tiny park next to the apartments. Had very uncomfortable encounters.

I would recommend Jordan's apartment if you are looking for a great value for money place to stay during your visit to NYC. The neighborhood of Bushwick is really unique and awesome and you can get to the city center quite qucikly as both the subway (2 stations) and bus are close. You can also find some good restaurants, cafés and supermarkets nearby.  The only downside was the bad cleanliness of common areas (ie. bathroom, kitchen) which was quite unpleasant. Otherwise a good place to stay in.

If you just need a place to rest your head...this is it! It’s a tiny typical New York apartment. The bathroom is super small. But if there are only two ppl staying at the apartment l, it will work!The location can be sketchy at night but it wasn’t too bad! The place was super close to the 9/11 memorial and the Brooklyn bridge which was great! Elle was helpful and super nice when I met her to get the keys! If I cane back, I would stay again!

Just a horrible place for long stays.  pans and pots were so rusty I couldn't cook anything. I was even scared to boil water.   The bathroom was never cleaned until asked.   The kitchen had one spoon and one fork for 8 rooms. Is that really good for long stays?   No cutlery at all to cook or do anything. By the ending of it it I was boiling water for 2 min ramen in a cup in microwave.   There was no butter knife to even put peanut butter on my bread.   There was no toaster so I can toast.   Just terrible and horrible experience.    I wish airbnb itself would something about it.   The nail.in coffin was my lightbulb went out in my room I asked them to change it, they asked me to get new one rather than changing it themselves. Are you freaking kidding me?   Momoyo never replied to me at all. I had to send 2-3 messages for her to reply.  She always put it to her assistant  on the property. He never cleaned until asked.   The shower curtain is so freaking dirty I didnt want to go in the shower. bare feet.    Ultimately I had to reach to airbnb support team.   Momoyo and hiroki both run lot of properties together. I'm not sure if it's worth it.

Staying with Qusuquzah was amazing. Her attention to detail is scary good. You can just say something in a moment or make a random observation and the next day the situation has improved. Her listening skills are amazing and she excells as a host. One of the best people to host in Brooklyn, you won't regret your stay here. And the bathtub is magical.

This is a great little space for a small family. Perfect for those that need more space and distinct sleep spaces with little ones. Very clean, comfy linens, towels, etc.   Neighborhood is mostly quiet and residential with nearby options for food, etc. David and Naama provided some good recommendations! We easily hopped on the F train nearby to get into Manhattan.   There was ongoing construction while we were there but Naama was excellent about communication (we knew in advance) and it was only a tiny nuisance. She communicated very promptly even though she was on vacation and was attentive to all our concerns.   The only notable thing about the space itself is that there is one inverter AC unit in the main space, and the bedrooms do not cool with doors closed, so we needed to keep them open for sleep. This wasn’t an issue for us.  We were there during unfortunately hot weather (heat indexes >100 degrees) so I suspect this isn’t much of an issue most of the time, but the apartment was definitely warm during this weather and we needed the AC! The unit cooled things well as long as no space was closed off.   The kitchen is well appointed with basics for cooking and some fridge staples too. Basics in the bathroom as well.   We’d definitely stay here again if we were in this area of Brooklyn! Excellent hosts!

Rashmi’s place is truly a hidden gem. Have been traveling to NYC a lot of the past few months and have stayed in many AirBnB’s throughout the city, I would honestly rate this as one of my top 3 places to stay. Great communication, very hospitable, knowledgeable about the area and the city. The room was way better than I expected as well (clean, private bath, fridge). We did request the second bed to be set up prior to our arrival and found that it was. All though it is an air mattress, I slept very comfortably on it for the 2 nights, while my daughter took the bed. (Most may shy away because of the air mattress, but I found no issues with the he one he had.) Loved the room, his place, the neighborhood (especially all the graffiti murals near by, they were absolutely amazing pieces of art). Never once did I feel unsafe. I am looking forward to returning when we have future visits to the city.

Amazing host! Words can’t express how overly hospitable they were been during my stay!  I can’t stress enough that you’re getting a great host and place to stay while in town!  Highly recommended!!!!!!!!! They will go above and beyond to make sure you’re taken care of!

My son and I stayed in the apartment for a month and enjoyed it very much. We were happy to see that the pictures provided in the listing were exactly what greeted us upon arrival. The apartment is immaculate; most of the furniture is new, it is beautifully and functionally decorated, and the building itself is also on the more contemporary side. The kitchen is equipped with standard appliances you would need for meal prep, and the large dining table was a great bonus as it provided a place for me to work remotely and let us eat meals comfortably. The family room and bedroom areas, as well as the bathroom, were all spotless, and everything worked as expected.  The rooftop was an oasis that I used almost every day. It had many places to sit or lounge, and several umbrellas allowed you to be outside comfortably in the shade.  The doormen and maintenance crew were all very attentive and kind. The lower level was filled with one surprise after another. Gym, yoga room, children’s playroom, sizeable shared office area, a lounge with TV and foosball table along with an outdoor courtyard complete with a koi pond.   If Hell’s Kitchen is the location you are looking for, do not hesitate to book this apartment.

Our stay in Michelle’s place was great. The location is good if you don’t want to pay to be in the city but close enough for a daily commute. Stores, coffee shops and restaurants are all walking distance. You have several subway stations within a 10 minute walk. As in every place don’t walk alone too late in the night. But as a group we felt safe going back late. Our main reason to visit was to check out the Frida exhibit at the Brooklyn Museum which was only about 2 stops away. We actually just walked there. Which took less than 20 minutes. The ride into the city is about 30 minutes.  Now, the brownstone will give you the city experience, we stayed in the Grand Suite. The place is exactly as the pictures show. It’s not glamorous at all and could use a little hand. Expect to see a good amount of holes on the walls, unfinished and broken floors, fireplaces and drawers. Expect the bathroom and shower room to be smaller than you think. My wife and teenager were surprised of this. I lived in Manhattan for a few years so I was not at all. It pretty much seems like a small closet turned into a shower on one end and the the closet in the middle then the bathroom in the opposite end equally small. But they are the only rooms that seem updated and clean. At arrival, the carpets could have been vacuumed but weren’t. After arriving at night daily the place was excessively warm even after closing the vents. But the reason we deducted a star was due to the following. No iron or ironing board. We forgot our bath towels and Michelle provides two. I asked her twice if there was any way she could spare two more and both times I didn’t get a response but I mean, we shouldn’t had forgotten our towels. But a response would had been nice. Extension cords laying clear across the rooms. It became a problem with our toddler wanting to play with them, disconnect and connect things. It was really unsafe for him. Also, there is a door that connects the bedroom and Michelle’s living quarters which was unlocked and toddler kept wanting to open the entire time we were there. I sent Michelle a message about it but got no response again so we had to deal with that the entire time. And the last thing was the entry door to the unit. It was sooo difficult to lock and unlock every single time. Definitely needs to be fixed as it’s clear those doors are broken and has been mentioned in previous reviews. My wife suggested giving 3 stars but I’m giving 4 due to the last morning my son got to play with Michelle’s children and he enjoyed that soo much. They are wonderful, sweet children. Michelle’s husband is very nice as well. He is the only one we met because he’s who brought the children out to play with my son. I absolutely love NYC so to me it was all worth it. I do recommend the place as all the things mentioned aside from the extension cords are manageable and the price is great. Hope this helps anyone make a decision.

Antonio’s place is really close to many subway stations. That’s a big help if you are constantly going to Manhattan. The downside is that the place can be really loud at night. Even with earplugs, the noises can be very disturbing when you try to sleep. Antonio was very friendly and he tried to help as much as possible.   The area looks a little sketchy at first, but nothing bad happened to us when we stayed there.

Stay at Rueben’s was nice and comfortable. The room could get a little noisy at nights, but closing the windows helped. The area is east Harlem and could get shady at nights. I would suggest to take the 116th street subway. Lastly the connectivity to the city is nice.

Everything went great at Ruben’s place! We really enjoy the city and felt part of it staying at their home. He give us very helpful instructions about how to arrive at his place and was very communicative. It was a shame that we did not get to know personally each other since he was out that week but we really enjoy and felt very welcome at their department.   The place was very clean and just a blocks away from the subway train so no need to use car really. We did not felt insecure in the neighborhood at night (since some guy told us at the airport that Harlem could be a lil bit dangerous at night), we usually get back at the airbnb by 10 or 11 pm walking from the subway and everything fine. The place has hot water at the shower, and the room has plenty space. I recommend this place. We are looking forward to get back to NYC and would love to stay again at Ruben’s!

Ruben was one of the best hosts ever! He was really friendly, easy-going and open for a chat.  The supermarket was nearby and you have been really quick in the center of manhattan. The neighborhood was a little challenging. We felt a little unsafe. So not to recommend for people who stay alone or for young women.  But never the less we have had such a good time with Ruben and would be more than happy to catch up one day with Ruben again!
cute little apartment decorated with loads of cinematography atmosphere. there were a lot of homeless around the neighborhood that don't bother. good luck climbing 3 flights of stairs with luggage.

If you're traveling to visit NYC look no further. This location is extremely close to public transportation making it easy to navigate and less stressful. Carrie is very prompt when responding to messages. Apartment was clean and tidy ready for our stay. Brownies made by her husband are to die for ! I would have eaten the whole tray if given the chance. The guide book she provides is very detailed and also helpful on navigating the city. Will be staying again if we travel back to NYC.

The reviews to this place are very misleading. First off the street is very unsafe. The security guard in the front is rude and starts arguments with everyone. We had asked him kindly to help us open our door and he had an attitude about it. When he opened it he took it with him and when we asked him if he had took our key by mistake he started being rude wouldn’t even check and started arguing with us. The host didn’t even help us out with anything either and we ended up having to buy a key. The hallways smell disgusting like cigarettes and weed. The shower in the room takes about 10 minutes to heat up. Wifi barely works. Provided us with one roll of toilet paper and was told by the rude security we had to go buy more. At 3am we were woken up to neighbors banging on the walls and doors yelling and saying they were going to shoot up the place. Ended up having to call the cops cause the security guard who is there 24/7 wouldn’t answer any calls and wouldn’t do his job. Overall just take your money elsewhere. Only reason I’m giving this place a two star is because the room inside was overall nice.

While I believe most of my issues with the place did not stem from the host, I think it’s important to highlight the general experience that I had at this Airbnb. I’ll start with the apartment. If you are planning to stay in for an extended period of time, I would recommend finding a different place. The windows let in almost zero light and we were unsure what time of day it was. The floors were very sticky and I don’t know why this couldn’t be just cleaned. The host recommends you wear shoes, but this is a sanitary issue that can be avoided. The general area is also very sketchy. There is a group that is constantly at the front. One person stopped me and offered me drugs. Now the stabbing. On our last night, there was a stabbing on the fourth floor of the apartment. There were many cops at the front, blood on the elevator floor. While I understand this isn’t necessarily something the host can control, I find it important to warn other travelers.

I am extremely grateful to Svitlana for her limitless flexibility and kindness toward my son; she made an extremely stressful moving situation flawless for us. Our new apt was not ready when it was supposed to be and Svitlana kept extending our tenancy with a quick, friendly and understanding demeanor.  Her home is impeccable. Though the residence is small, it has everything one would need for either a short or long term stay.  Clearing, owning a home and renting it through Airbnb is a business and an investment, but Svitlana has shown that humanity and kindness truly adds to the value of her property. The house speaks for itself, but the landlord, too, is second to none.  If you find yourself on Staten Island, Svitlana is the one from whom you want to rent!!!

First of all buyer be ware... it all started weird when we showed up and he acted like his 14 bed two couch person house was too small for our guests of 10 adults and 6 kids . I paid 300 amd assumed i could ise the property as i wamted for 12 hours since we had early flights.... well then Kam accusing us of wanting to party and be loud says he wants another 250$. at from this point im in queens ny scared a shit this guy is going to l do something... well he calls me repeatedly all the way until 1240 am asking for the money. I call air bnb they could care less we told them we were scared for our safety they did nothing...anyway we made it out at 4 am ... thats not even close to the end or worse part... this house was nasty and i mean gross dirty nasty. Towels had spaghetti stains on them, walls had years of grime and dust. Tile was cracked and cringy. The appliances still har stickers on them and they still had so many smudges on them they hadnt been washed on months. There was soap scum in the bathroom along with a heating pipe that heated up to over 100 degrees with no warning or padding running right through the middle. Th worst the exterior, wven the neighbor told me he had asked him to pick it up but the owner refused. See my pics and help me make sure nonone ever goes through this again... BUYER BEWARE

Great location near the LGA airport. Very spacious. 5 queen size beds was a plus. It’s a bit outdated and 1 room had these heater doors that didn’t close and had this bubbly adhesive attempting to close it but it didn’t and stayed opened. That was the only unpleasant thing but overall comfortable stay.

I was eagerly anticpating my stay with Ade and his co-host, who I've learned after this experience is his wife. I booked my time to stay and upon checking in, which I was prepared to do at the scheduled time 3pm, I received a call from Ade, and he requested that I wait 2 hours because his wife, needed to go to a doctor's appointment, which I agreed to. So before I continue, I must disclose that I am presently with my gf who is pregnant, and I had to disclose this to Ade, because he called and tried to force me to cancel, when I had absolutely no issue, after telling him, i'd be willing to wait, I did and when it hit around minutes to 5, he texted me saying we should cancel, I immediately found something sketchy about it and replied to his text telling him to stop contacting me on my personal phone and to contact me via AirBnb's inbox, as to leave a trail of what is discussed, he immediately turned is phone off after this text message, in the last phone call I expressed to him how I didn't have much funds again and that we would be in a tough position to get a place if I don't get my full refund on that day. Unfortunately I had to call Bnb's customer service to get my entire full refund, because apparently Ade is making money from these last minute cancellations, which is an injustice to everyone who is using the app fairly. I really hope this doesn't happen to anyone else, because it was the absolute most horrible experience that I have had. Dont let these host badger you into cancelling when they mess up, you lose the money, and they dont! . Peace to everyone!

Great spot to stay in the city. Clean spot , welcoming host, near transportation. I had a car and found parking without too much stress. Ade and crew were some excellent hosts. I’d be lucky to stay with them again

Ade and his wife were wonderful hosts. Ade made sure we had everything to make our stay comfortable and made himself available if we had any questions. He made our first trip to NY much less stressful!

Place totally consistent with the photos, very clean and with a kitchen completely at your disposal Lloyd and his sister are very good hosts, very caring and always keen to satisfy the guests. But all this while giving us our privacy. The accommodation is close to JFK airport a little less than Manhattan but very secure places you can return late without being afraid of walking in the street.

Where do I even begin!  Of all my many Airbnb experiences this host was the most kind, warm, and motherly of any I’ve ever had.  There was an issue with the surrounding neighborhood being too party-centric and out of my speed… But the host not only went the extra mile metaphorically, she LITERALLY went the extra mile: when I stated that I wasn’t comfortable walking home from work, she walked me home with her son! LIKE WHAT, she must be an angel!  This host is literally a second mother to her guests, introducing them to one another, giving you some of her cooking. I cannot speak highly enough of her, truly an incredible person. I’ve had cold hosts that I’ve never even met in the past, she not only met me at the door but helped me move in, showed me around, gave me a snack and made me feel very welcome.   The neighborhood can be a bit loud with parties, and somewhat unsafe, but that does not reflect on the home itself, which is well insulated from the sound, cute, and VERY well managed.  Thank you, all the best!

I had a great stay at Jon's place! He was very accommodating with check-in and check-out times which helped relieve quite a bit of stress. You really can't beat the location! It is walking distance to everything in Greenwich Village. Within a couple blocks of Subways: Houston St on 1,2 and Spring Street on C,E trains. It is truly a NY experience: fire escape, walk-up, noise, and all! The walk-up is not bad by NY standards. A few short flights. Do not let it deter you. The noise is as other reviewers and Jon describes. Running the AC unit as well as earplugs helped tremendously, and I am sensitive to sound so I don't say that lightly.  I stayed in March when the high was 26* during the day, and I would still run the AC unit, but on fan mode at night. As mentioned in his ad, there was another person staying in the second bedroom, but she was courteous and respectful. There is body wash and shampoo/conditioner provided for guest in the shower which is a nice touch. Overall a great, stay!

This space is great for experiencing the real qualities of NYC. I was warned about the area and to be careful in the by a local when I was walking up. The area is quaint but there some shady characters that hang around at night. It is cute and rustic and I would almost consider it to be vintage in quality. The photos almost make it feel modern, but upon arrival the building is worn and a bit old. The doors are old so the keys can be a bit difficult to use. Rory was very hospitable and left his number in case of any issues. Netflix is set up on the TV and there was sparkling wine in the fridge. All-in-all I thought it was cute and the price point could maybe lowered $10 per night but that’s just a suggestion.

It's small, but functional. Stairs to get in, for me, were small, tall, and scary to get up and down. The mold others have complained about is a small corner next to the toilet you really hardly notice. Fridge came with beer in it, not sure if that was intentional, but my boyfriend appreciated it. My son wasn't able to walk around freely since I felt there was Alot for him to mess up lmao! My service dog loved the backyard, which was mainly concrete 🤷 but he ran around it a few times. And ironically my boyfriend's family lived right next door, which may make my opinion biased but. I'll be staying here again even if only for that reason. My only complaints are 1: you can hear there footsteps above you during the day. 2: their dog barks but I'm used to it since I have a dog and 3: we found 2 or 3 normal litte spiders attatched to one thing or another. Neither of us are afraid of spiders. So if you are, bring  something to kill them with. And a suggestion: they need a light for the backyard. Should you wanna come in at night it'll be easier to have a light on so guests can see where their going. I almost tripped a couple times

Joshua's place was absolutely fantastic for us. Joshua was exceptionally accommodating and always communicated cordially with us. This is in Harlem, 20 minutes walk to central park. We loved the walk to central park. The area is lively both day and night, something to be expected of the big city and of an apartment next to a major road. As it often happens with big cities there are stark differences from block to block. We noticed homeless/begging in the nearby blocks and beautiful pristine places in other nearby blocks. This was a great way to experience both sides that a city, like NYC, has to offer. We would recommend.

Josh has a nice place that's a good value. It's fairly clean and comfortable, and Josh seems very nice and helpful. If you're hesitant to stay so far uptown, don't be. It's a charming neighborhood with brownstones and parks. There are plenty of great restaurants as well as markets, drug stores, etc.. And the express subway trains (anda commuter trains to Connecticut and Westchester) all stop within a few blocks and will get you to Midtown in 15-20 minutes. You'll easily spend double to stay below the park, so this is really a good value. However you will likely want ear plugs (and an eye mask if morning light disrupts your sleep). The windows do not insulate against sound at all, and 125th St. provides a lot of street noise starting early in the morning with buses and trucks (tho it's surprisingly quiet at night). Otherwise it's a fine, affordable, convenient place to stay in Manhattan.

Gail is prompt in responding if you have any questions or needs through Airbnb.  The accommodations are spacious and comfortable. Exactly as the photos.  The location is convenient as well as walking distance from most commodities.  Drug store, eateries, banking, some retail and LA/JFK airports.  For the relatives visiting students at St Johns University Gail’s apartment is a 5 to 10 walk.
Yoo Ml was very quick to respond to anything I needed. It was an awesome location. I never felt unsafe as I traveled alone.

The room is a nice size, comfortable bed, the house has an incredible vibe, clean and fragrant. Location is great, approximately 4 blocks from the G train line. Apparently a safe place, I arrived every day around 00:00 and at no point did I feel unsafe. Naomi is great, quick to respond and always willing to help with your stay! I will definitely stay again
there was a great host. he was really kind and helpful. except that neighborhood is a little scared, it was great place

It was my first time renting an Airbnb, Wendy had no reviews at the time and I was a bit afraid since basically every post giving tips for you to rent an Airbnb recommends to choose someone with lots of comments. However, I saw the pictures, it looked like a new, clear,  clean place with everything we needed. Decided to give it a chance. Couldn't be happier about Wendy's place. Everything is super new, bed is comfortable, the apartment is bigger than what you can tell by the pictures, the kitchen is well equipped, towels and bed sheets are white and clean. We cooked dinner three times in there and found everything we needed, super new and clean. Wendy is a great host, she has lots of cool travel stories and she was very nice in accommodating our early check in requests. There is a very useful "read me" binder in the apartment.
