We only have good memories and compliments to Wendy and her place. Would definitely recommend and definitely stay again.
Location was an hour commute into the city, felt a little unsafe traveling back late at night and the local roommates were loud and unnecessarily confrontational.

I highly recommand staying at Robertina's and Jose's home, both for the place and for the hosts thoughtfulness. The place is really close to subway (5min of walk -to line 7, 15 to line F, JFK easaly reachable ), close to Manhattan (30min), cool places for breakfast to start the day,  supermakets near, safe place AC available in the room, which has been very helpful. The hosts are very kind and available. Once again, a great thank to Jose for his help and time with my luggage delay :)  Je recommande fortement de loger chez Robertina et José, tant pour le lieu que pour la prévenance des hôtes  Leur maison est très proche du métro (5min à pieds de la ligne 7, 15min de la ligne F, JFK accessible facilement), à 30min de Manhattan, des lieux sympas pour démarrer la journée avec un bon et copieux petit déjeuner, des supermarchés/épiceries à proximité, quartier sans danger Climatisation disponible dans la chambre, plus qu'appréciable Les hôtes sont très agréables et disponibles. Je remercie à nouveau Jose pour son aide et son temps dans la gestion de mon bagage égaré :)

She is very honest, friendly and cooperative. Her place is clean, towels are snow white. Her “Read Me” file was very helpfull for first comers to NYC. I found what is promised nothing missing.  Her A/C systems performed excellently during record high temperatures, she send us e mails and warned us about dangers of high temperatures like a mom.🙏🏼

Nice place. Wendy checked in with us and was quick to respond, but we had most everything we needed. Pictures give an accurate feel. Neighborhood was a little louder than we are used to (but that's true of all of New York). Good WiFi. Was 3-4 block from subway (C train), and we used it every day. Neighborhood is okay. Never felt unsafe, but met a few characters. Would stay again.

Wendy was a great host, she place had all the amenities that’s we’re required and were noted. The location is 5-7 minutes away from the subway station. 1 hour from the city which we didn’t mind. Walking to the subway during the day time was no problem but it was dangerous during night time. Besides that Wendy messaged us to make sure everything was going good. We would definitely keep this place in mind whenever we come back.

We traveled to New York last week for seven days and stayed at Ann’s house. Here is our experience:  Pros:  1)The house is centrally located. It’s a few minutes walk to two different subway stations with multiple lines.  2)     The neighborhood is fantastic for food, coffee and shopping. 3)Ann provided a discount for a weeklong stay and our willingness to take a good care of her two cats. 4)There were four of us. It’s nice to stay in a house feeling as if we were at home.   Cons:  1)The main bedroom had a faint smell of cat’s pee.  2)There are twos bars adjacent and across from the house. Unfortunately, you can hear people clearly to the wee hours of the morning if you stay in Red Room or Library.  3)Ann has a lot of stuff everywhere in the house.  Quite cluttered.  There’s no closet space to hang our clothes – we need to use standalone clothes hooks. 4)  When we arrived Newark airport, I called and texted Ann multiple times but she didn’t answer. Eventually she responded to my text. We got to the house, and we had to wait for her for twenty minutes.    Ann told us that a maid would be there at 12 noon to clean the house the day we left, so we left five or six used glasses in the kitchen. The next day I received a message from Ann complaining that it was very unpleasant for her to put them into the dishwasher.   We also had a few faux pas during the stay. One garbage day we put our bag in front of the wrong side of the house – the side of Ann’s neighbor’s.  We didn’t sort our recycles properly.  We also didn’t turn off the coffee machine properly that Ann had to reset it to make it work.  A lesson learned is that we need to be more careful for future stays.

I'm not sure there are enough words to thank Drica for our stay at the apartment. We had a flood in ours and needed to find a place within walking distance that we could stay for a month and a half. It seemed too good to be true when we found Drica's beautiful, warm and cozy place as an option. She accommodated us on short notice and her home was exactly as listed. The neighborhood is fantastic, our favorite in the city as evident by the fact that our apartment is close-by. Lively with amazing food and bars literally right out the door. Our favorite bakery Supermoon is just a couple of blocks away...amazing and dangerous. Her home is a sanctuary, filled with her amazing energy and thoughtfulness. I would not recommend this place to just anyone, only the people that I know would have the same kindness and respect that Drica deserves.  Thank you so much, Drica, for everything!

Things started out well. Harrison was very quick to respond and answer questions. He was traveling but made sure we had his sister's contact information in case of problems. Since we were arriving at 9pmish, he asked us to pick up our keys "next door" at a mini-mart. Totally fine. Expect the store actually ended up being two blocks away down a very sketchy street at night, lugging our bags and two frightened children. Yes, street is very close to Soho. But the section of Canal Street where the apartment is located is very gritty. During the day, a street vendor literally blocked our door with her handbag set up and would aggressively harass us to buy fake Louis Vuitton every time we tried to enter and exit. At night, there were a lot of sketchy people and a drug dealer working the corner across the street. My partner is from Queens, so we are accustomed to NYC. Even so, this still was too rough for us. Our 12 year old was very unsettled and we ended up booking a nearby hotel for 2 nights and double paying for our trip. The apartment itself was cute. Not as cute as the pictures but spacious for NYC. It was a little rough around the edges (eg missing vent covers with open, dust filled holes exposing the air ducts) but reasonably comfortable for the price. On our last day, Harrison texted us at 5:45am asking us to be out by 10am. This hadn't been made clear before and, had we not ended up with other accomodations would have been problematic. Bottom line: Harrison is an amiable host and the apartment is workable for a group of adults willing to sacrafic evening walkability for a good deal. Families, people travelling alone, or people wanting to take late night strolls without being asked if they want to buy drugs should look elsewhere.

Mark has everything you would think you need here. Plenty of towels for the bathroom, shampoo and conditioner just in case you forget, anything you would need in the kitchen if you decide to pick up some snacks to have just in case you get hungry. He has thought of it all for the apartment. It's the perfect size for a couple on a vacation and the location of the apartment is no more than a 5 minute walk to a major subway station and the Long Island rail road. I HIGHLY recommend staying here instead of some over priced hotel. Plus the bed is beyond comfortable as well. If you're afraid Brooklyn may be too far to travel to all of the main things you want to do in New York I promise you it's not. We were a 20-25 minute subway ride from anywhere we wanted to go. Also there is a mall down the street with dining and a target which helped us out a few times as well.

We had a very good stay in Mark's accommodation! As soon as we arrived, it was very warm in the apartment, which is pleasant after a long flight and low outside temperatures. It is very well located with two metro stations nearby, and very well equipped, whether in the kitchen or in the bathroom, nothing is missing. The area is very quiet, even at night we did not feel unsafe for a single second. The autonomous arrival and departure is a real plus, our outbound flight having been delayed, we were able to arrive when we wanted. Mark is also a very attentive and responsive host, he was able to respond quickly to our messages. We highly recommend this accommodation!

A beautiful NY loft. Really big and well decorated. Canal Street is very noisy and crowded with a lot of sketchy people selling knockoff bags on the street, but right around the corner to the north is all of SoHo and right across the street all of Tribeca. The Canal Street part will give you a real life glimpse of crazy NY and the SoHo and Tribeca part will give you all the art galleries and shops and restaurants. We were there five days and had a great time. Thx!

Our family (parents, 2 adult sons and daughter-in-law) spent 5 nights with Harrison and Kira and had a great experience.  The apartment is exactly as described with plenty of room for everyone.  We did a ton of sightseeing (from Yankee Stadium to Battery Park and tons in between) so having the subway stop a short walk was a life-saver.  To respond to some of the negative comments - Yes, you have street vendors on Canal  trying to sell you stuff but no big deal.  We just ignored them and shopped elsewhere.  Some reviews described the location as "sketchy" - not at all.   We never felt unsafe and walked around at all hours including late night trips to the deli and a 24h Walgreens a few blocks away.  The apartment was very clean and was exactly as the photos show.  We did not have any problems with noisy neighbors.  We arrived late so we used the key service at the 24h deli a few blocks away.  Kira gave us clear directions ahead of time and we did not have any problems (just did an add-on with Uber on the drive in).  We used all 3 bedrooms and did not have any problems with street noise including the front room overlooking Canal St.  The apartment had all of the amenities you would expect and the central a/c worked well while we were there.  The welcome info had all of the info that we needed including WiFi access and how to dispose of trash.  The large-screen TV was very nice but we did not use it much given everything else we were doing.  The only things to be aware of are the stairs which can be a bit of a challenge with luggage and the single bathroom for 5 people requires a little coordination :-).  Overall a great experience and we would definitely recommend this location.  Thanks for making this a great trip!!!

Mark's apartment is VERY well located, many subways close by (20 minutes from Manhattan) shopping centers (macys, century 21, target, victoria secret....) The accommodation is semi-basement, so you have to expect to hear all the noises from above and from the street... but in NYC noise is part of life.  A good thing to know is that it is possible to leave luggage if you have a night flight for example on the day of your departure!

Sue has good communication, a nice, typical and charming apartment but it is located on the 5th floor (67 steps), which is not specified in the ad.  it is not very clean, the condition of the dishes and linen (stains on the blankets, big hole on the sofa blanket...), the inside of the cupboards stick to the stoves, not to mention the storage (kitchen, bedroom even fight).  In fact when we arrived in this apartment, we had the feeling that the occupants had just left, everything was in order, the cleaning was done quickly, the fridge was kindly available, but with small leftovers, the bottoms of the trays which were not very appetizing in the end.  It is full like an egg, full of objects, memories, photos which give it its charm but also create a slightly anxiety-inducing atmosphere. Not a shelf, a drawer, a hanger or even a coat hook in the entrance available for visitors, so when you come for a week, you have to leave your coats thrown on the sofa, your things in the suitcase because there is almost no place to store them and you have the unpleasant feeling of having to live among the personal belongings of the residents without being able to take your own out.  a dog lives in the apartment, presence of a cage with a cushion and toys in a basket, watch out for allergies.  The shower handle had failed, the hose was leaking like the radiator, it was very hot or very cold at times, our mattress placed on that of the owners was not very firm but above all we only had a thin gray cotton pique bedspread as sheets and blanket, very insufficient and not very comfortable especially in February.  I am sorry to have to mention all these inconveniences and it has never happened to me to have to do so, but this apartment deserves some repairs, especially more cleanliness and space for its visitors so that, as Sue wishes, they can feel at home.

We stayed at the first floor rear unit for 11 nights and we totally enjoyed living here. We got the small studio apartment, with built in wardrobe, kitchenette, attached bathroom, and a balcony. I was afraid it was going to be too small from the pictures, but it proved to be a comfortable size for a couple. I wouldn't recommend it for more than 2 people, though.  The apartment looked newly renovated - it was crisp, clean, and bright, which isn't always the case with rental apartments; so I was glad. The Murphy bed was comfortable enough and adequate for two people. The mattress is of a good thickness. The bathroom is spacious, with a bathtub. Note that it is going to be further renovated so it will be even better for future guests!  Blanca was a great host. She provided a lot of things for us that we requested for, without complaint. She's also very approachable and easy to contact. She also gave us recommendations on places in the neighborhood to eat and also introduced us to River Plaza Mall at E116th that has a Marshalls : ) Lastly, she was very helpful to me when my Super Shuttle van failed to turn up to take me to the airport (don't use Super Shuttle!!).   The neighbourhood in East Harlem is eclectic, its residents are very diverse. The apartment is three blocks from the E103rd subway, which was a 5min walk. We had no problem walking home at night lugging all our shopping. There is a supermarket one block away, and a few caves and fast food joints. We managed to do our laundry twice at the laundromat across the street.  All in all, a great base for your New York travels. Thanks Blanca!

We had a great stay in Josh's studio. Awesome location, with a bunch of restaurants and bars close by! The bed is super comfortable. We didn't get a chance to meet Josh, but his nice friend Rob was there to hand off the keys. Josh was also really great about answering any questions and provided helpful tips for our trip. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone making a visit to NYC!

Me and my boyfriend had a pleasant stay in Josh's apartment.  We never met him but his friend Rob met up with us for the keyes and was kind to help me with my heavy bag up the stairs.  The neighbourhood is really nice with a lot of restaurants and bars, the subway is 15 mins away but there are bus stops closeby. Josh left a list with tips of restaurants, clubs and bars wich was very helpful..we especially appreciated the breakfasts at 7a. I would recommend it to my friends.

Great stay in this lovely place. Location is fantastic, close to subways, and Williamsburg is a great cafe town which has a hip and safe vibe. Host brother picked us up from the air port which was a great stress relief, he was super friendly and helpful.  The host checked up on us through out our stay. The place is really nice, feels homely and is a nice place to chill out after a day of adventuring in New York.

Had a great stay at Dena's apartment!  Area is very lively, did not one feel unsafe and uncomfortable. Due to our busy schedules, I didn't get a chance to actually meet Dena, but she was very easy to reach via email. I would stay here again and recommend this unit to a friend.

It was a great place to stay with good connection to the city. 2 lovely cats and a great hostess. If we ever go to New York again, we will surely visit this place again.  Harlem was a lively neighbourhood and we did not feel unsafe at anytime.
Dena is very friendly. Timmy and Gizmo are both very cute and it is a really friendly environment. The neighborhood is not sketchy at all. Recommend.

Dena is a very helpful host and always solves any of our problems sufficiently. But the bedroom is a little bit small and lack of some necessary items like bedside tables. Another little problem is the cats. They always feel hungry at nights and may come to the bedroom to ask your for food if the host is not at home. The neighborhood is very safe at daytime, but there might be some homeless people asking you for money at night. But overall, it’s a nice house and good experience in NY.

Dena’s place was a great stay! She communicated fast and gave me and my mom tips on food and how to get around, it’s easy to ride the subway once you get the hang of it. There’s a lot of cool vendors on Lenox ave we bought few things from there. There’s also a grocery store right downstairs, my mom cooked breakfast before we went out everyday which saved us time and money! Dena’s cat is very friendly he came by and said hi couple times. There’s always people out at night and you can hear the ambulance a lot but other than that we were always safe, I never saw anything dangerous going on. Definitely a great stay! Thanks Dena ❤️

Blanca and Ted's apartment is superb! It looks exactly the same as in the photos and is very clean.  Additionally, the apartment is right next to Central Park and the subway and there is a supermarket down the block.  Finally, Blanca and Ted are very nice! Our flight was very late and they waited for us to arrive without any problem. Blanca always responds to messages on Whats'ap whenever we have a question during our stay.  He's the perfect host!

My husband and I were very pleased with the accamodations  at Dani's. We had  a bad experience at another place we chose off the internet( not airbnb) and were a little afraid of what we might get. I am used to staying in NY, my daughter lives here & I visit often. This was one of the nicest and spacious( for NY living) apartments. The kitchen was top notch. The seperate alcove with the queen bed is a luxury in many places in NY. The area has many restaurant choices. Shopping, even Lowes is near by.You could walk 4 blocks to the movies if you like. Dani could not meet us but made great other arrangements and we never skipped a beat in check in or out. I would highly recommend this  apt. for your stay, It could accomadate 4 with the pull out sofa, comfortably. Thanks Dani!!!!!

The description of the ad was very correct. Everything was according to what they said and they were also always around to ask me how I was and if I felt comfortable. Any questions I had or questions I needed to ask, Blanca and Teddy were always there to help me. It was my first experience with AirBNB and I couldn't have asked for better hosts. The neighborhood is nice, not at all dangerous and at no time was I afraid. I would definitely stay with them again without a second thought.

Blanca and her husband Teddy were extremely welcoming and hospitable during our stay! They provided extremely quick communication and plenty of helpful information in our first trip to NYC. The apartment is located within close proximity to many important things: subway entrance, laundry services, grocery/drug stores, and several great restaurants (we recommend La Shuk up the street). The apartment itself is on a safe street opposite a large church and had many nice amenities (oven, tv, full sized refrigerator and tub). Also provided were menus of close restaurants and subway map information that Teddy patiently explained in full detail (it's really actually pretty simple once you get oriented). We definitely look forward to our next visit to NYC and will certainly be booking with Blanca and Teddy again!

We loved staying in this apartment. It is very spacious, very clean and consistent with the photos. Blanca and Teddy are truly great hosts, they welcome you with open arms as if you were family. They are very available and you can count on them at any time of the day. The neighborhood is very good even if at first glance you might be a little doubtful. The metro is 5 minutes away, very easy and quick to get to Time Square (Teddy explained everything to us). There are plenty of small, inexpensive restaurants, we ate in a pizzeria, a Peruvian restaurant and a Mexican one....be careful it's very very very spicy (ask without chili and then make it to your taste). There is also a supermarket 3 minutes away which closes at 9:00 p.m. and a small grocery store which closes very late. We took the metro very late at night and at no time did we feel in danger because even at that time there were a lot of people!!! Thanks to Teddy and Blanca...We will be happy to come back to see you and this time I hope we will find time to drink a good glass of wine together :)

Mihalis is a truly awful  host.  His space is interesting but shower is nonfunctional / gross  and beds are all cheap futons.   He is intrusive, demanding, money-hungry, disorganized, strange  and inappropriate in his requests and communication.   i feel used and scammed by him.

My experience with this apartment was terrible, on the day of my arrival after a 12-hour flight, the cleaning had not yet been done, the smell was disgusting, it made me want to run, I couldn't rest or shower because the owner was there, I had to leave my suitcases in the living room and I couldn't rest at all and I was forced to leave immediately. There was always a constant smell of humidity and confinement since there are no windows to open, in reality there was no desire to be there at any time, there is not even a table to sit at and eat, and everything is bad, dirty and old, the bathtub is covered, even the bicycle is unusable. The owner sent me to repair it on the day of my arrival, giving me directions to the workshops that were nearby. It is a horrible, dark, unwelcoming place, with zero taste for decoration, there is no comfort, I went on a cold day, the heating was bad and there were not even blankets to use, I asked the owner for help by email and only after 24 hours she responded giving me instructions on some blankets that had been stored in a place for years, they were full of dust and torn, then she never spoke to me again and only sent an email. Last day of my stay wondering if the heating was good, when there was never any heating, there are also no towels which makes the stay very unpleasant and very uncomfortable, there is a constant sound in the kitchen, very annoying and unpleasant.  Please DO NOT rent here, it is very expensive for what it offers, a hotel or hostel is better since there is concern for the passenger, and I assure you CLEAN, this apartment is disgusting and all the beautiful memories of New York are spoiled when I remember this horrible place.

Waynes apartment is very cozy and welcoming. The room is just as described and looks exactly as in the pictures. We arrived very early and Wayne arranged for us to get the keys as soon as we arrived the apartment. We didn't see each other very much because we'd leave the house early in the morning and come back at night to sleep, but every time we crossed paths he was very nice with us. He even invited us to a dinner party on our last night in the apartment with the other people that was staying in the other room, and some others from another apartment, and we have so much fun, sharing stories and jokes with people from other countries. All in all there's only good thing that can be said about Wayne and his place. Also, the neighborhood, if you worry about the security, is very safe. Don't believe people who tell you "Harlem is dangerous", of course that doesn't mean that nothing can happen to you, but I mean that it is a very safe neighborhood in general. We arrived home at 1 AM one night, and even used the metro, and everything was fine. So, don't hesitate to rent this room. Best regards.

I was looking for an Airbnb for a friend who was awaiting back surgery.  As you can imagine it's scary looking at the ads and wondering which will work. Well, Wayne went out of his way to accommodate and support my friend. Everything was just as described, but Wayne himself was even better!

This was my first ever experience with Airbnb and I can happily say it was a very positive one. From the outset B. communicated promptly and clearly that gave the confidence to go ahead with the booking. When I met Alan, the in-keeper, at check in, I knew I picked the right place. He was an incredibly nice person and even very kindly let me check in several hours early so I could get a head start with my day. The place itself was fantastic, really cosy, clean and charming thanks to its exposed brick interior, filled with many personal affects that made it feel like a real Manhattan home. The location is perfect if you want to be within walking distance to Central Park, with two nearby subway stations that I used regularly. There are some great local places to grab a bite to eat, including a 24-hour McDonald's, which I found rather handy when getting home really late and I never felt unsafe when doing so. Overall, I had a wonderful stay at B.'s place and really enjoyed my first ever visit to NYC. If you're looking for a comfortable and conveniently located home to use as a base for your own trip to The Big Apple, look no further. :)

Wayne is a very pleasant and charming host, not hesitating to advise, prepare and share a brunch or a drink after dark despite his work day. The apartment is very well located, close to grocery stores, the metro (direct line to Midtown and Brooklyn, a change for Liberty Statue...) and restaurants (excellent pizzeria, soul food, Chinese, Japanese, etc... on site or to take away and enjoy in the kitchen provided) One detail however, the temperature of the room was rather cool (November) despite the heating, but we have lived in the West Indies for more than 20 years, which perhaps explains that. We highly recommend this very quiet apartment with private bathroom, and would certainly return there during another stay in NYC. Chantal and Gerard

The private room that my boyfriend and I stayed in was stunning; high ceilings, spacious, private bathroom, simple but beautiful decor. It's about a 7 minute walk to the metro. The walk from the metro back to the room at night can sometimes be filled with your fair share of people that make you feel uneasy, but no one ever heckled us so overall not any real means of danger. Overall a lovely stay, and a great deal in nyc!

We had a great stay with a private bedroom and attached bathroom that was clean and welcoming.  Wayne made us feel right at home and the location was perfect to walk or take transit everywhere we wanted to go.  This was our first time staying in the city and our stay made for a stress-free and truly enjoyable trip for my daughter and I.  We will certainly stay here again in the future- highly recommended.

Just like staying at home with family! Rob and Gladys are the MOST thoughtful, friendly people you could ever find in NY, they treat me and friends like they've known me for years of just like they treat their family, they made sure i had everything , they had water and food for me,  i went to run the marathon so thye wanted to make sure i had all i need and i had enough food, they even went to cheer me up!! I was so tired they even offered me to stay another night for but i couldnt so they kindly packed a meal for me.  The place is very comfortable, you feel like at home, bed and sofa very comfy and super clean, I could have not asked for anything else. SUPER convenient to get to Manhattan and there's a really great market around the corner  If you look to spend time in NY and this place is available i would not think twice! best place in NY

My friend and I had a lovely stay at Gladys and Rob's place. They took such good care of us and were incredibly accommodating for such short notice.  The location was quiet and convenient, the neighborhood is great and the apartment was clean, spacious and comfortable.  It was an amazing deal for NYC and better and more personal than any hotel. I'd recommend staying with them anytime : )

My boyfriend and I stayed in this apartment in March. We had very nice time staying there. Rob and Gladys are very nice people, and they helped us when we needed them.  Apartment is close to big supermarket, subway station, and small restaurants like chinese, so you can't be hungry. Apartement had eeverything what we needed and it was warm.  We had a great time there and I recommend it.

Mich's apartment is really lovely, one of the bigger apts in the area... and the neighborhood is so fun. It was a bit complicated getting the keys and having to do deposit via Paypal made it a bit more stressful. Also, note that you need to bring your own blanket; this was a surprise to me. Otherwise, a great stay.

Whatever is said in the other 5 stars reviews is 100% true. I highly recommend it. We thanks Rob & Glad a lot for their friendly welcome. From a french point of view, the american welcome is not overrated, and Rob & Glad are  their best ambassadors. Like the other people, we really appreciated the quiet neighbourhood, and the conveniency of the place (subway, shops).

Rob and Glad have a terrific little apartment right near a subway stop in Queens. Very comfortable living room - a great place to kick back after a long day of sight-seeing - and a climate-controlled bedroom not facing the street, so it's very quiet at night. Awesome shower, too!  Rob made check-in and check-out super easy - and left some nice refreshments in the fridge for us, which were really welcome when we arrived late.
We basically just needed somewhere to sleep at night. That's what we got. The Subway was a little scary for me bad that was our main transportation. But all-in-all, we got what we needed.

This apartment was fantastic, a true home away from home. Glays ad Rob were amazing so helpful and friendly.They left us water and breakfast, coffee all the things to get you moving in the morning.We were so grateful. We were very busy seeing all the New york sites therefore it was so good to have a quiet place to come home to. The subway was so close to the apartment and only took 10 mins to get into the city. We loved exploring Queens also , there is so much within walking distance. This was an amazing honeymoon for us and was just the best having the apartment to relax in rather than a soluless hotel (with no room to move)!

I had a great experience while staying at Rob and Glad's apartment. They are both very nice and welcomed me like I was family. The apartment was clean and looked exactly as the pictures show. They stocked the kitchen area with some fresh fruit, cereal, water and gatorade which was really nice when returning from being out in Manhattan all day. The apartment is in a great location in Astoria and the R and M train stop is really only steps away from the front door. I was invited downstairs to their apartment for breakfast in the morning which I was not able to attend since I already had brunch plans. I will be renting this apartment again in the future and will make sure to take them up on the breakfast offer next time. I recommend this place to anyone looking for a great experience while in New York.

I had never used Airbnb.com before and this was a excellent experience.  Rob and Glad were very accommodating.  Communication with them was easy.  They responded to all my emails quickly.  They gave excellent advice with transportation and sightseeing opportunities.  Their home was clean and spacious.  They even had stocked the refrigerator with light breakfast items that was unexpected.  They were kind hosts and available if needed.  The community was quiet and the subway was only a block away.  You easily could get anywhere within 10 minutes.  I would definitely stay at their home again.  Thank you so much Rob and Glad for making our experience flawless and comfortable.

The apartment is perfect, as shown in the photos, and is less than 200m from the metro. In just 10 minutes you can reach downtown Manhattan. Upon arrival they left us breakfast for several days in addition to being at our disposal for any need.  Everything was perfect, without a doubt we would repeat with Gladys and Rob.  Many thanks for everything!

Great place to stay! Besides its excellent situation in a nice neighborhood, the apartment is very bright and airy and nicely decorated. Moreover, there were some fruits and snacks in the kitchen when we arrived. Rob and Glad were lovely hosts and they let us leave our luggage in their house on our last day. Definitely recommend it!

Dani was the ultimate AirBnB hostess-- welcoming, informing, and discreet. We loved the little apartment, which was near any kind of restaurant, shop, drug store, coffee nook, you might want, and so near the subway with easy access to Manhattan.  We would recommend this place for anyone, business or pleasure.  Sophie & Kate

Gladys greeted me upon arrival to give me a key and she was a very warm and friendly person.  I only spoke to Rob on the phone, but he was also very friendly and wanted to be helpful.  I immediately felt comfortable with them  The apartment was in a very convenient location only 10 minutes from midtown Manhattan. The train stop was just down the street  from the apartment which made it very easy to go back and forth into the city.  Along with going into the city, we actually ended up going to several restaurants in the neighborhood near the apartment and it was very enjoyable to walk in the neighborhood at night.     Had a great time and and highly recommend their place.

Had a very nice stay at Gladys and Rob's 1 BR. The apt. didn't have a place to cook but had a microwave and large fridge that had yogurt, bagels, o.j. and other items for us to enjoy. The location was very convenient to the R train so we went into Manhattan everyday and sometimes twice per day. Surprisingly,  Astoria had quite a few restaurants and cafes so we also walked the streets there.  Gladys and Rob were extremely helpful and kind as hosts.

I stayed with Rob and Gladys for 5 days. The welcome was perfect and their availability was complete even though we left early and returned late. The apartment is perfect with a large bedroom, a kitchenette stocked by Glad and a living room with sofa bed. There were 2 of us and it was very suitable. Perfect neighborhood if you want a little peace and quiet but all amenities nearby. At all times we have not been insecure. Midtown about 20 minutes door to door. I recommend and will come back for Rob's pasta

Rob & Glad are wonderful people with the gift of hospitality! The apt was clean and had some yummy snacks & breakfast food ready for us in the kitchenette. They even called a couple of times to make sure we were enjoying our time in NY. So Sweet!! We really enjoyed our stay and hope to return again in the near future. :)
Location was great, bed was comfortable, and Rob was very helpful (though we interacted only briefly). Would definitely stay here again!

I was extremely happy with my stay at Rob and Glady. Glady gave us food (orange juice, milk, bagels, and fruits), blanket, and fresh towels upon arrival. The living room was  very cozy and the bed was very comfortable, with the entire place gave off a home vibe. The first night back, they left the light on in the living room so we could see, which was very helpful actually. Her place is very close to Manhattan either by train or cab (if you can catch one).   When I dropped the key off, glady gave me a kiss on the cheek to cap off our great stay. I wish I could of stayed longer.
Rob and Glad were amazing hosts! Their place is spacious and immaculate. Glad met us upon our arrival, gave us a brief tour of the house, and even left us with some breakfast foods! Highly recommend!

After a long train trip, we arrived in New York exhausted.  Rob had given us clear directions via email on how to use the subway to reach their place in Astoria.  Getting there from Penn Station was easy, even for two very tired, rather oldish, culture-shocked mid-westerners, and when we arrived, Gladys had everything ready for us.  She greeted us, showed us around the apartment, and then left us alone to recover from our trip.  The apartment was everything we had hoped, and more.  Most importantly for me, it had a large comfortable bed and was very quiet.  The bedroom was at the rear of the house (though even the street side was seldom noisy) and downstairs Rob and Glad were so quiet, we barely knew they were there.  Getting a good night's sleep is so important when you're traveling.  Rob and Glad's place is located in a real neighborhood, with all the stores, restaurants, and bakeries you could ask for within a short walk.  The neighborhood is ethnically diverse and immediately felt safe.  The subway (R line) was less than 5 minutes away, making it easy for us to explore this wonderful, fascinating city, which we did, from Flushing to Staten Island, and from The Bronx to Rockaway Beach.  A great 24 hour natural foods-type grocery and deli was located only a few feet from the subway entrance.  We stopped there almost every night to get hot food, green smoothies, and much more.  They even offer free delivery!, as did a number of the restaurants in the neighborhood.  The apartment has a microwave, coffee maker and refrigerator, but no cooking stove.  But why would you need one, with so many restaurants and groceries a few minutes away?  In short, if you are coming to New York and would like a clean, quiet, reasonably-priced place to stay in a safe, diverse neighborhood close to transportation, I don't think you could do better than Rob and Glad's place.  We thoroughly enjoyed our six night stay.  Plus, Gladys is an absolutely delightful person.  You'll love her!

Rob and Glad were amazing hosts and the room was incredible and comfortable. The subway was right down the corner if you wanted to go to other areas, but also Astoria was full of shops and great restaurants in case you do not want to go too far for the day. It was also nice and quiet, which made it easy to rest after a long day of sightseeing. I would definitely go to Rob and Glad's again and I would highly recommend booking to others.

Mich's apartment is clearly not a gem, but has a good location and as a host, Mich was good in answering inquiries. The apartment lacks of care and organization, my friend and I did not have any closet space or apartment space for our things, extra large mattress leaning on walls, there was and absurd amount of pillows, chairs and objects that we had to call in help in order to make space available. We were also indicated to not say we were an Airbnb guest, after we had done our payment. This made the whole transaction sketchy and when running into people, we had to lie about our stay. The lack of care in bathroom and painting of apartment did not justify the price that was asked for the rental. I do not recommend staying here.

Gladys and Rob are wonderful hosts. The apartment itself if lovely, cosy and comfortable, with plenty of space to relax and feel at home while in the city. On top of this, Glad and Rob are close by if you ever need anything, and are wonderfully friendly and welcoming -we were even treated to some home cooked pasta and girl scout cookies! The neighbourhood is fantastic, quiet and safe but super close to the subway for quick access to Manhattan and also Broadway is at the end of the street with a wealth of grocery stores and tasty eating options. I really didn't want to leave this place, it felt like home, in fact better!

We had a great week in at Rob and Glad! The apartment is nice and cosy, it was so warm (important as it was really cold outside). The neighbourhood is perfect - bars, shops, restaurants. At night it's 100% quiet, couldn't believe we were in NYC! And the best thing - there is R subway 2 minutes from the flat that takes you to Times Square in 10 minutes! If we ever come to NYC again, we will stay with Rob and Glad for sure!

Excellent apartment, very comfortable, with everything you need and in perfect condition. The neighborhood is very quiet, and at the same time accessible by subway from Manhattan, since it has a station around the corner. We were very satisfied and happy with our stay at Rob and Gladys', who even waited for us with food and drinks in the refrigerator when we arrived. Totally recommended to spend a vacation in New York!!!

We had a very pleasant stay at Rob and Gladys in New York. Their home is very comfortable and there is everything you need there, we felt like we are at home. We like the neighborhood and the metro is very close. Rob and Gladys are very welcoming and very friendly so we really recommend all to come home. If we go back to New York we hope to stay with them. We love New York, we love Queens, we love Rob and Glad. Gracias por todo. Pat , Sylvie , Léo

THANK YOU Rob & Graldys!  I REALLY enjoyed staying at Rob & Gradys' place! They are friendly, kind, very nice people. I arrived early around 9 am in NY, but they let me stay their place even they had previous guests leaving on that day. (They left earlier.)  The rooms were very comfortable, clean, nice & spacious. I loved their place! They prepared Coffee, Tea, Bottled water, Orange juice, Milk, Eggo, Biscuits, Fresh fruits, etc. They have Towels, Shampoo & Hair Conditioner, Body soap, Hair drier... Everything you need were there, and I felt I was staying at my home.   Their house is located 15 min. metro ride to Manhattan. Very easy. Subway station is just around the corner. NY is not only the Manhattan, but their neighbor Astoria is very interesting. All kinds of shops & restaurants are there, and it's fun to walk around. And safe, too. If you are thinking either staying at hotel or not, I  definitely recommend here! No need searching other places!! Truly. Next time I come to NY, Of course I'll stay here again!

Rob and Glad were perfect hosts. Nothing seemed a bother to either of them.  However we feel they may have had to move out of their apartment to accommodate us. Although we were there a week we had little space to hang our clothes and no drawer space even though the room was big enough to hold a chest of drawers. We had no kitchen except a makeshift table with microwave and toaster, kettle and coffee maker. , In their favor they had left disposable bowls and breakfast cereal and other food and drink items for our convenience. Overall we had a very pleasant experience but next time it may help if we read between the lines as there was no kitchen or washing up facilities or the ability to cook.

Our flight got in very late and Dani was awake to greet us with a smile. She was available as we needed and very helpful with what to do in the Park Slope area. Leading up to the trip she always communicated in a timely manner. Very friendly. The apartment felt like home with all the amenities (even organic coffee stocked in the freezer and organic shampoo and soaps in the shower.) Two minute walk to the best coffee I've had (Cafe Regular) and 5 minute walk to the subway to Manhattan. Park Slope is a very hip place with amazing food and we never felt unsafe. We rented bikes and found the area to be very bike friendly. We explored much of Manhattan and found Park Slope to be right down our alley. We would stay their again if we ever make it back!! Perfect for our anniversary. Thanks again Dani!!

The experience was quite good, although we missed a kitchen because we were hoping to have a house. Still, Glad offered us his. The apartment was really close to the metro stop and had quite a few shops nearby. Rob and Glad were lovely to us. The truth is that we wouldn't mind repeating if we travel to New York again.

Yes! What they said! Dani's place is the perfect New York bolt-hole, and possibly the best accommodation I've stayed in. I highly recommend this choice.  The apartment is spotless – I could instantly begin using the kitchen and bathroom without wincing – warm (January), bright, secure, quiet, and comfortable.   I am finding it difficult to write this review because we seemed to slip into this accommodation with such ease that it feels too familiar – and I think this tells you something.  Dani is the type of person who, I suspect, can do anything. She does everything with grace and competence, and strikes a perfect balance between genuine friendliness and professionalism. From the moment you book or simply make an enquiry with Dani, she makes you feel confident about the arrangement, and continues to provide perfectly timed and relevant information throughout your stay.  Dani and James combine a steadfast commitment to social justice and the environment with an easygoing approach. They’ve carved out a tranquil niche in a big, tough city, and it’s a privilege to experience a little piece of that.  Park Slope is a good area, with a mix of amenities, including excellent restaurants. The apartment is close to the subway station. Manhattan is a short ride away, as is the rest of Brooklyn, which should not be viewed as a second-best to Manhattan!

This was our first time using AirBnb and we were initially a little nervous but after meeting Bob and Gladys, we were immediately put to ease by their warmth, kindness and generosity. Gladys has a great laugh and a twinkle in her eye when she talks and you feel like you're talking to an old friend, while Bob always reassuring and made sure our stay was comfortable.  There is a private entrance into the apartment via the front and we were given a lot of privacy at all times. The area is safe and the neighbours are friendly! We love that the 46th Street subway is literally a 5 minute walk around the corner, allowing us to get into the city in 20 minutes or so.  The outside of the apartment was decorated with Christmas lights and is really pretty in the evening! Inside, it is very spacious and cozy with natural light and is well heated even in the winter.   Some features include a large TV with cable channels, a bath tub with hot/cold water, a large bed, closet with hangers, fresh towels, hair dryer and an ironing board.  The living room has a couch and a couch/bed that is comfortable for one person to sleep in. The kitchenette is compact but well stocked with the necessities such as a full sized fridge, kettle, and cutlery. The hosts were not obliged to provide food but they kindly stocked  water, bread, tea, yoghurt, cream cheese, bananas and chocolates for our enjoyment. On NYE, they were even so kind to share with us the delicious food that Gladys' sister had cooked!   The official checkout time is at noon but the couple graciously allowed us to hang out all day even though they had to prepare for another arrival at night. This had saved us some stress and money and is greatly appreciated!  This truly was a wonderful experience and our only complaint is not being able to stay longer!

I stayed here for the month of February with my boyfriend. The apt is in a great location, the kitchen and bathroom are renovated, however there were a few things that made our stay uncomfortable. First there is a hot water pipe in the bathroom that isn't pictured. I know this is normal for nyc apartments, but it would almost always be boiling making it dangerous since it is right beside the light switch, and made the bathroom feel like a sauna. Second, the heater in the room can only be controlled by the super of the building and would constantly get too hot so we would have to leave the window open. I notified Anna about this and it took two weeks to get fixed. There is no cleaning fee and it seems like the apartment was not cleaned when we arrived. We had to vacuum and wipe down the entire studio as it was very dusty. The couch is covered with blankets to cover stains and would cause me to be itchy if it touched my skin. Overall I would not stay here again and would only recommend if you don't care about having no control over the temperature in your apartment.

Olivia was a great host, really easy to get in touch with and quick to respond to any queries or questions (especially about the shower.  Even after reading previous reviews, I managed to forget.  PULL THE BOTTOM OF THE TAP OUT.)   The flat was absolutely brilliant.  It's in a great location, and there's loads to do/see/eat/drink in the neighbourhood, and it's ten minutes stroll from a couple of subway stops.  The apartment has everything that you might possibly need staying in NYC - cooking facilities, a fridge, MASSIVE bath/shower, comfortable bed and cable TV.  Pretty perfect.  The loft bed isn't ideal for everyone, but we managed it (including a pregnant girl!).   Although you could sleep on the couch, you woudn't have any privacy if there were three people staying, or two who weren't sharing the bed, so best to bear that in mind.   The area looks a bit sketchy on google maps/streetview, but actually isn't, especially if you're already comfortable with cities - there's a lot going on at night, and lots of pedestrians and residents around.  There's some noise from the street, but nothing unusual for a city, and the apartment isn't near anything noisy, just the occasional horn honking or emergency siren that you get all over.    There's wifi, but our iphones struggled to pick it up (although you can get it if you're at the back of the house) - it worked on the laptop everywhere though, so no problem.

Emma was a great host. She even bought some breakfast for us and was very polite and helpful in general. The neighborhood seemed to be a little scary in the first place, but turned out to be absolutely o.k. We could even go for a run right at the Hudson river in the morning. Very good subway connection - just a 2 minutes walk to the line 1 subway. I would definitely come again :)

My boyfriend and I as well as my parents stayed in the smallest house in East Village and we really enjoyed our time. Yes it was very small but we are all very close to each other and Olivia did warn us beforehand that it can get cramped in the house with 4 people staying there but we really managed just fine and you don't come to NYC to stay inside anyway right. The house is located in a convenient location, close to lots of great restaurants, bars, cafes and shops as well as only a short stroll to the bus and subway line that get you quickly downtown.We especially loved the Dominican bakery across the street that served great pastries and sandwiches. During our stay, we did encounter a few dubious people walking around in the neighbourhood and whilst we never felt we were in any danger, we probably wouldn't call this the cleanest and safest of all neighbourhoods but exciting nevertheless. Regardless the convenient location of the place to other small and exciting neighbourhoods such as West Village and Soho was a huge plus. Overall, the place was clean and had everything we needed, including wi-fi. A couple of comments for improvement would be to advise guest how to use the shower. I did read beforehand that you need to pull the tap down to work the shower but by the time I got there I had forgotten so we called Olivia for directions. Olivia was super responsive and assisted straight away but this could have probably been avoided if she simply includes this information in her very detailed house manual. Also, there weren't enough cups/glasses and plates for 4 people so we had to buy plastic cups for our stay. Olivia did highlight the fact that the place has a garden which makes it a unique place and the photos looked amazing, however the actual garden was nothing like the photos. Everything was very overgrown and dirty and the outdoor furniture was old and rusty so not really usable. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and it was sufficient for our needs and length of stay (4 nights).

Emma was great at welcoming us and providing advice/tips on getting around the city since we were first time visitors. The apartment looks much better in person than the pictures in the listing as you cannot really see just how spacious and nice looking the apartment is until you arrive. Emma showed us around the apartment and made herself available if needed, but also gave us as much privacy as we preferred which was nice. We had 3 little children in tow with us and the apartment was great for them.  The apartment is ideal for using the subway to get around the city as there are 2 subway stations within 1/2 mile of the apartment. We drove a vehicle to the apartment and used the subway after that; we got lucky and found parking right in front of the apartment (which is free), but be warned street cleaning comes through frequently which requires you to be on alert to move your vehicle if needed.  Immediately down the street in front of the apartment is Riverbank State Park which I used to run on and I passed by tons of benches, shade, and kids playgrounds.  The only improvement I would suggest is with the WIFI at the apartment, it was a very weak connection throughout our stay.  Thanks again, Emma!
For a 10-day stay with Gladys and Bob, the welcome was excellent. At first glance, we discover a normal apartment, notice the cleanliness is abandoned. We are not used to this indigence.

Emma is the perfect host; she greeted us in a friendly, caring and welcoming way. Emma even provided a few food items and milk and juice to help us settle in when we arrived. We appreciated that Emma sent us a note to check out to see how things were going during our week's stay. The space was clean and had lots of room for the 4 of us (3 Adults and 1 Baby); and the location was excellent- close to a beautiful park (Riverside Park), the Subway and grocery/drug stores. We hope we can return again one day!

I couldn't have asked for a better first experience with Air BnB. Gladys & Bob's place  is a  perfect size for three to four guests. Plenty of space, clean, and comfortable. You really can't beat the location. It is a  20 minute Uber/Taxi ride from LaGuardia and  short train rides to Manhattan, Brooklyn and Flushing. The subway station was right on the corner,  and you are in walking distance to restaurants, shops and a 24 hour drug store. Though within walking distance to a lot of businesses, the apartment itself is located on quiet residential street. No one in my party had difficult sleeping due to noise. Perhaps more than the great accommodations and location, the hospitality of hour hosts is what made Gladys & Bob's place feel like a home away from home. Gladys was very friendly and welcoming. She was interested in getting to know us and how our trip was going. Bob and Gladys had also put out cereal, pound cake, bread, jam and other snacks for us to enjoy during our stay. For three guys from the South, it was refreshing to have hospitable hosts north of the Mason-Dixon line. I would highly recommend Gladys' & Bob's place to anyone visiting NYC. Great price, accommodations, location, and hosts.

The house looks like the pictures and is in a good location. No paper products like toilet paper and tissues but there was a drug store close by.  Most places stayed open until 2am if you wanted to get something to eat late in the evening. The bed was comfy but the ladder was a little challenging to climb. Having the outside garden was nice. There were no personal touches and the keys were just left on the table. We enjoyed our stay and may come back to stay again.

Gladys and Bob's place is excellently located half way between Manhattan and Flushing.  My family enjoyed the easy commute to major sights in manhattan and to asian food in flushing.  Be aware that this home is older than one would expect from the listing.  There are not many outlets in the house and there were issues with the microwave and refrigerator functioning correctly (we suspect wiring issues).     Positive aspects of this stay was Gladys' communication skills.  She was welcoming and let my parents keep their luggage in the airbnb past checkout time which really made their last day in new york very hassle-free.

Quiet street, but close to several places to get food, minutes to subway, large drug store down the street a block. Gladys is wonderful, provided bottled water and snacks,  great space, and amazing water pressure in the shower.

Gladys and Bob's place is AMAZING!  The subway is literally just around the corner from their house and will get you almost anywhere you want to go within a 10-30 min ride.  It's also a short 15 min drive to Laguardia, which was extremely convenient.  The house was very clean and had many extra amenities  that were much appreciated.   Gladys even brought us milk and cookies on our first night.  We loved it and thought that was a great touch!   We walked around the neighborhood late at night and never felt unsafe (including my 66 year old mother).  There are a lot of reasonably priced restaurants within a few blocks of the house and an all night grocery store right by the Subway, which was a nice place to stop and grab a drink or a late night snack after being out touring the city all day.   I highly recommend staying with Gladys and Bob to get a great authentic NY experience.

Arrived at 10:45 pm. No key and locked door at check in. Had to make emergency accommodations in the middle of the night, which was very expensive. Unresponsive host. Called Airbnb and they found a place for us an hour away, east of Brooklyn, which was unacceptable. The next morning, the host butt-dialed me—which made it seem that was the only reason she called me back. We tried to come back the next day, because I have dogs  (one is 18 years old and blind) and you can’t leave the dogs in a hotel without you. It took an hour for the house cleaners wife to show up to unlock the door. It’s 15-20 degrees outside. Max high temp was 27 that day.   The place was filled with leaves and dirt from outside. There was a lot of junk and clutter. Not very tidy. The toilet is stained and the bathroom sink was dusty and had someone’s hair on it.   No heat available. When she was talking to the house cleaner’s wife on speakerphone, we heard the host say she knew the heater was broken and only made a tiny radiator available to warm up the brick home.   She should’ve told us beforehand that the heater was broken. With that tiny heater, it would’ve taken at least three days to warm up the place. The windows were cracked and there was a lot of draft coming from them. I have two 4 lbs dogs. The electric radiator was dangerous for both my dogs, especially the blind one, who bumped against it at times.   It was Thanksgiving, so we had to leave for about three hours for dinner. When we came back, the place was still cold and the dogs were frozen. We had to leave.   We’re from Virginia and have been to NYC many times. This was a horrible, expensive decision to stay here. Ruined my trip and Thanksgiving holiday. Airbnb reimbursed me the cost, which didn’t make up for three hours of sleep, a bunch of frustrated tears, leaving us outside in the frozen weather, no heat, family stressed out for me, my dogs’ well-being and safety, ruining my Thanksgiving holiday and having to pay for an expensive hotel.

My girlfriend and I planned to visit some family in NYC for three days in July, and at the last minute the plans for where we were to stay fell through. At the time, the local hotel prices were staggering. After searching on AirBnB.com (for the first time ever), I was fortunate enough to find Angela’s listing at an unbeatable price.            Angela was very prompt & clear in responding to my initial reservation inquiry, and that didn’t change for the rest of my reservation and trip. After making my reservation, I notified Angela that my girlfriend & I would mostly likely be checking in between 1:45- 2PM; but on the day of the trip, our arrival in NYC was delayed a bit. Being new to AirBnB (and not knowing how check-ins were supposed to work), I contacted Angela to let her know about our delay, and she reassured me everything would be alright and not to worry about formalities. She also gave me directions on how best to get to the apartment. When we reached the apartment, Angela had stepped out for a moment, but had someone there to greet us and show us to our room; several minutes later, Angela arrived & introduced herself. She was very welcoming- turning on the A/C for us, so we’d be cool & comfortable (given the heat wave going on in the city, at the time); talking to us for a little while about herself, her good experiences with AirBnB, and the neighborhood; and then she showed us the apartment. Angela gave us the information for us to access the apartment’s Wi-Fi, and two sets of keys, ensuring we knew how to work the locks on all the doors. She then left us with clean sheets, towels and toiletries, and some suggestions to local restaurants and shops in the neighborhood.          You would definitely get a bang for your buck staying here. We were really lucky because there weren’t any other tenants scheduled to stay on our floor until after we left; so we had the entire apartment to ourselves. The apartment as a whole was very nice and clean. Our room was small, but spacious enough for both my girlfriend and I, and it had a small desk, a TV with cable, and large walk-in closet with plenty of room for our stuff.  	The surrounding neighborhood, at first glance, may seem a bit sketchy (especially if you’re not used to an urban environment), but it’s actually nice and quiet. Across the street there are two corner stores (one of which is open 24 hours) with almost anything you could need. One block away there is a little frozen yogurt shop, and some beautiful brownstones. The A & C-Train stations, which can get you (or connect you to a train that can pretty much get you) anywhere is just a short two-block walk away. The only issue we had with our stay was that the water pressure of the shower in the bathroom was a bit weak. But I let Angela know about it and she said she’d have it fixed. Other than that, it was great. I definitely plan to book with Angela again on my future NYC trips.

My sister and I needed a place in the neighborhood to stay separate from my husband to be, a few days before the wedding. I also needed a photogenic place to get ready. This historical duplex was perfect. Maya was super laid-back and very communicative. I would suggest this to any of our out-of-town guests that need a place to stay. Or just for a change of scenery. It's so unique and amazingly furnished. Although my sister was scared to sleep in the loft, I thought it was adorable. The bathtub was fantastic and the roof/view was too. Book this place now if it's available.

We had a pleasant stay!! The apartment is clean, the neighborhood is not dangerous. Apartment 25 minutes from Manhattan. Angela is a very good owner, we were delighted to meet her. She provides the bath towels and comes to clean the rooms once a week. The apartment is equipped, kitchen equipped with utensils.  Perfect stay we are very satisfied!!!!

Cool flat, nice and safe neighbourhood to be explored - we had good use of a map made by Maya giving her own recommendations. Great vintage shopping and many restaurants, cofee shop and so on.  If not afraid of heights you can climp the ladder to the roof top and enjoy the sun during the day, a great sunset and even Empire State Building with its lights on!  The area was hit by Sandy and public transportation is still a bit onerous at times - few trains, no ferry at Greenpoint.  Maya was a most helpful host during our stay and easy to get hold on.

My sister and I rented this beautiful 2 bedroom apartment in Oct 2012.    The apartment was perfect for the two of us, allowing us to have our own space with each room having an extremely comfortable queen sized bed,  TV with cable and an area to sit and entertain friends who popped by for visits.  The kitchen is well equipted with a fantastic gas stove and oven, microwave, fridge and many other appliences to make your stay feel like a home.  The bathroom had a wonderful old iron clawed bath, just perfect for relaxing a tired body after a day/s of exploring around NYC.  As mentioned by other visitors here, the bathroom is off one bedroom so the other guest needs to walk through to it but this didn't phase us.  The renovations have seen William keep many of the ornate features of the brownstone, the wood work, high ceilings and flooring are all stunning! But it is also the small things like fresh flowers, gorgeous furniture, beautiful artworks, and accessories along with plenty of towels that all make  the stay feel luxurious yet homely.    The location of this apartment was also perfect!  Close to the subway (3 blocks away) and buses, the shopping area of Harlem on 116th or 125th st and local restaurants, cafes, bars and music venues.  Our stay was due to be 7 nights but was extended to 11 due to Hurricane Sandy and in what could have become a stressful situation we felt very safe in this renovated Brownstone.  We found William to be a wonderful host, friendly, quick and very accommodating.   William would always txt message if ever there was a need to communicate with us rather than knock on the door, respecting our space during our stay.  We also really loved the occasional chats in person with him where we were always greeted with a smile.  We loved staying at William's apartment and in Harlem! We would have no hestiation is suggesting this apartment to freinds and family who may vist NY.  In fact we are already planning our next visit and will definitley be sure to contact William again!!!!

This is a hard review to write, the place was so interesting and a great location.  If you are a family of two or three, it's perfect.  Plenty of room and two bathrooms.  We had two couples.  The bedroom was perfect for one couple.  The loft might be good for kids, but even with kids, I'd be afraid to let them climb up and down.  So, our second couple had to split up - one on the couch and one brave one that climbed the ladder with only two rungs instead of four.  Thankfully, he didn't fall. This made it kind of awkward.  Also,  the stairs in the house are terrifying to walk up and down - very steep and no railings.  The decor was fun and different, but the blankets and such had a very musty smell.   Oh, and there is no washer/dryer as mentioned in the post - so if you plan a longer stay, plan on going to the laundry mat.  (This should be changed in the post.  It's misleading.)    Maya, the owner was staying next store and would pop up now and then - she was sweet, but this was a bit odd. All this said, we had a great time in Brooklyn.   Just know what you are getting into.  I think the photos were taken some time ago.

We had a fabulous stay in NYC! William's apartment was the perfect home away from home. He provided everything we needed. The apartment has washer, dryer, air conditioning, dishwasher , wifi and comfortable beds! William provides plenty of towels and linens for one's stay. The apartment is comfortable and spacious. There was only three of us during our 10 day stay (originally there was to be 5) but even with more inhabitants, I believe the space would have been comfortable.  There was a fully stocked kitchen. We didn't cook much but there was everything one would need to cook a home cooked meal. William provided plenty of toilet paper, paper towels, dish soap, laundry detergent, garbage bags, coffee filters! He also provided nice body wash, body milk and body lotion. In fact, I enjoyed them so much, I plan on buying some for myself! The location is perfect, the subway is three blocks walking distance and the bus stops are even closer. There are lots of restaurants, coffee shops, grocery store, drug store and liquor store all within a few blocks. The street parking is fairly easy once one figures out the routine for street cleaning. The neighborhood is eclectic with lots of friendly people. We often had the windows open at night and street noise was minimal (save for one night when there was an argument between two people, but the argument lasted only a few minutes, then it was quiet once again.) I would not hesitate in recommending William's apartment. I look forward to staying there again.

Gladys & Bob's home is an absolute gem. Spacious, clean, comfortable & within walking distance to the best bagels and coffee. Parking is easy, the neighborhood is quiet, and Gladys was kind enough to say hello at the end of our visit. Cannot recommend highly enough if you're looking for a stress-free visit to the city.

We stayed here for two weeks with our 2year old daughter. The apartment is exactly as shown in the pictures, everything was clean and the washer/dryer was very efficient. It took a while to get used to the neighborhood, but we weren't scared. We walked around to different playgrounds, Tompkins park and Fort green park, took the bus to prospect park and the subway to coney island. The a-train takes you to manhattan. People are very friendly here, they say good morning when passing them on the street in the morning. That would never happen in Helsinki where we are living. Overall a very nice apartment to stay at, even with a child.

My father-in-law is senior citizen and needed a place to stay while visiting family in NY. The first night after dropping him off at Wayne's we were hoping that he would not feel afraid or alone being a senior citizen. The next day, my father-in-law had all good things to say. He slept comfortable and well, and said that Wayne treated him very well and even made him coffee in the morning! :)  It was great to hear this and it completely took our cares away for the duration of his stay there. We observed other people that were staying there and they'd gather in the kitchen eating and talking like they're right at home. That was great!  Wayne has a very nice and spacious place.  We found him to be a wonderful host!  One that will go out of his way to ensure your stay at his place is a good one!  We'd like to extend our utmost appreciation and gratitude to Wayne for his absolute politeness and kindness to my father-in-law. My father-in-law says: Thank you and God bless you!

I went to New York on holidays, and found this airbnb on really short notice, so I was glad it worked out that quickly and that easily.  Wayne is a super accomodating host, although I didn't see him much as he he also super busy. However, his team helped me out, whenever I had a question.  The area of this room is a beautiful, family-friendly area in Harlem, about 4 blocks from the next subway, which was very handy. Safety concerns were completely out of place, even at night I never saw any sketchy people around.  The semi-private room is a bed in the general living room that is hidden behind screens in the corner. I didn't find it too loud at all to sleep there, if anything, it was the nearby staircase into the living room that made some noise. I didn't mind that, though, as it was always only early evening and morning, when there was some noise (and obviously I didn't come to NYC to sleep in till noon).  The house itself is a gorgious brick house with lots of floors and rooms, the kitchen is huge (and you can use that, too) and it even has a backyard.  All in all I found it a pleasant stay at Wayne's place, the price is very reasonable for New York standards (don't forget you're in Manhattan!). I can absolutely recommend it!

Wayne made me feel welcome, he met me at Midnight because I missed a connecting flight, on this tree lined street and every Brownstone had a nice little Garden. The apartment was decorated with the true flavor of the Harlem Reniassance. My sheets and the place were immaculate. He was fully booked with guests from Brazil,Germany, Canada and me from California.  Im sure that sometimes scheduling issues arise but Im confident that Wayne will bend over backwards to make sure his guests are satisfied. I highly recommend staying at Wayne s place, look the price is great He makes you welcome into his homes and private lives, and he always had a cheerful approach any situation. The Bathrooms were immaculate and everyone had a nice comfortable stay in NYC. He can tell you how to negotiate the City. And has a cheeful approach to every situation. So if you want stress free NYC living, with someone who can handle any situation positive or negative. then like the movie Wayne World, forParty, then Waynes Place for a nice NYC and Harlem Stay. He right in the hub Harlem activity. Lenox Street, The Apollo, The Schomberg, The Cotton Club and easy access to the Subway System to The JFK airport, Times Square, where ever you need to go. And you know what everyone has a kind word to say about Wayne, me to, I highly recommend him to anyone wanting to stay in NYC.

Renee’s place is awesome - spacious, clean, and welcoming! She was quick and clear with responses and check-in was a snap. There is no mistake that she takes great care of her place and her guests. She went out of her way for me in a stressful moment and which was very appreciated. This is a great part of Brooklyn - a neighborhood feel with lots of trees... and bodegas. :) Highly recommend!

I really enjoyed my stay at Wayne's appartment. It's conviniently located within 5 minutes of the subway in Harlem. I felt very safe, although you'll find some sketchy characters in the neighbourhood. There's lots of police presence, so not a thing to worry about. I felt very welcome, and Wayne is a great host! Definetely a great place to stay.

My boyfriend and I spent 5 nights at Niya's studio and found it nice, spacious,clean, warm and comfortable; the bed is large and the set up practical, simple and cosy. Nice shower and toilet, hot water always available, mini fridge, coffee machine, 1 set of towels and, after we requested it, a hair dryer too! The house is located on a residential road 10 minutes away from Nostrand Ave Underground Station, which is well connected both to Manhattan (A Express Line, 15/20min ride) and to JFK ( via Underground AND Train). To tell the truth the area did look a bit dodgy at first impact but once we got used to it we realized that people simply get on with their lives and we never felt in danger. Niya is a great host, a soulful person willing to give you the first practical leads you might need as you arrive to NYC; the Deposit issue was sorted No Problem on leaving, absolutely no bad surprises there! We indeed recommend Niya's studio to easy-going travellers who are willing to witness the big city suburbs and move around.

Niya was a pleasure to work with- he was always available by cell. Even in a hectic time like New Years in NYC, the check in/out process was smooth. Niya gave lots of great advice about public transportation to use and restaurants/things to do in the area. The house is located in a nice part of Crown Heights and I felt safe around there- the walk to the metro was a little scary late at night, but there were plenty of cabs to take if you were coming home after 10pm or so. There is also a bus stop right in front of the house to Prospect Park area, which was very convenient and helped us connect to other metro lines. Overall, experience was great, apartment was comfortable and Niya had all the essentials for us (toiletries, towels, coffee cups and microwave/fridge). Would definitely stay here again! Thanks Niya! (ps: also a great price for the room!)

Marina and Eli were amazing hosts, who helped make my NY trip stress free and enjoyable. They were quick to suggest places to eat or visit, either in Staten Island or Manhattan, which was much appreciated. The apartment has everything any single traveler could need, for any period of time, and I'm sure multiple guests could comfortably use it as a home base. The kitchen is quite handy, as are the multiple closets. It is exactly as the photographs depict, and the S51 bus stops nearby, to get to the Staten Island ferry. The S78 and S52 buses stop nearby as well. For such a comfortably appointed and convenient apartment, the rate is very, very reasonable. Everything about the apartment exceeded my expectations, and the hosts most certainly didn't disappoint, either :)

I had a great stay at Marina's apartment.  I was there for six weeks.  It is super comfortable, and very close to grocery stores/drug stores/delis/and the bus stop.  The s51 is a 5 minute walk, and takes you directly to the SI ferry in about 15 minutes.  You really can't beat a host who stocks your fridge before you arrive, and is super attentive to details and any small issues that arise.  I would definitely return if I come back to Staten Island!

Great place and VERY attentive host!  To be completely honest, the neighborhood worried us a little when we arrived, but we quickly adopted it and realized that it was completely safe (we returned on average at midnight every evening and we weren't afraid once). As for the space that Niya rented to us, it was perfect... In a large and beautiful traditional building (narrow and long), decorated with taste and finesse, our room had majestic woodwork, and we enjoyed total independence since we had a beautiful private bathroom/wc, in which Niya had provided us with bath towels, shampoo, shower gel, hairdryer, first aid kit and even (a small delicate detail) a moisturizing hand cream dispenser. Furthermore, it should be noted that we never heard anything from our room, nor our host (ultimately wondering if we were not alone in the house), nor the sounds of the city (traffic, sirens or passers-by), the room overlooking the garden. We barely saw Niya during the 10 days of our stay, but each time he was concerned about our well-being and offered us lots of advice for the city and the visits. We will return there for sure.

I can’t think of anything to suggest. Was a great stay!   William was welcoming and made sure we had what we needed while giving us plenty of privacy.  Neighborhood was good, I never felt unsafe.  Subway within a block or 2- easy walk.  Plenty of good restaurants nearby.  Would definitely stay here again!  If you have several people/couples staying together 1 shower can be challenging but our family of 6 made it work.  William had Privacy curtains which helped!  It was super super clean!   Beds comfortable, TV and WiFi worked great!

Staying at Niya's studio was a pleasure ! The apartment is nicely decorated with taste (nice furnitures, beautiful art pieces...), clean, practical and quite. It has everything you need. The studio is well located in a nice neighborhood. What could you ask for more ?  Niya is a perfect host, good energy, good communication. He has good advices about the area. Good advices about medicin care ;-) He even defended ourself in front of a taxidriver who wanted to rob us... I would definatly recomend Niya's place !

My husband & I had a marvelous stay at Lauren's home. It was very clean, comfortable & convenient.  Our daughter & her husband live a block away & we appreciated the fact that they were welcome to spend time with us there.
