Everything else is different. Old and stained furniture. Broken curtain rods. The bed frame in the queen bed is  actually for a king bed and  you trip over it. Side note, not toddler friendly. Also, there’s an awkward “step” in the hall that’s not attached because the full bath isn’t level with the rest of the hall. Also not pictured.   Good news- they refunded me my cleaning fee in a timely manner and the location is accurate. Love Hell Kitchen. Feel bad for any other guests if this is their first Airbnb experience.  Ps- The directions for check in say you absolutely must take the lock box with you inside but then the manager says it should be left outside.

Place is so dated and noisy (street noise from Hookah Bar on street level goes until their 2:30am closing)  I'd not recommend this for anyone looking for a decent nights sleep. There is only a small hallway where 4 occupants can talk and try to eat together - basically useless space. The small bedroom has no windows nor closet to hang clothes etc. The kitchen area so small only one person can be in that space at a time. Floors are all tilted to the west - they drop about 4" from the far east wall to the far west wall and in the main bedroom the floor is coming up by the north east corner of the room. The tenant below says he has the same issue - kind of scary honestly. The place is really only suitable for 2 maximum 3 people. The shower takes 4 minutes and 15 seconds to deliver hot water (sorry,  4 engineers so.....). The good news, the cold water is delicious out of the tap like almost all of NYC., the location is great, and most of the lights and wall plugs work and the internet is a solid 6.
Great place if it's just you or very close friends and you understand what you're in for. The location can be somewhat dangerous because of a nearby homeless shelter.

1st time in New York. Clean, simple enough to access. We we're there for 2 hours, came back to sleep for about 4 hours, showered and left. This is perfect for that kinda trip,, a location to hold your stuff. Heard most the places are small, this unit is TINY lol Other than that its cool. Oh and it's mere moments away from a Homeless shelter but also from Times Square and a buncha good food and cool shit, it's give and take people.

The stay was clean and well renovated, however the location was definitely a lot more dangerous as it was located in Canarsie and I found some large roaches unexpectedly in the studio. There was some trouble getting check-in, and I had to wait fifteen minutes outside before the host could let me in. All in all, the studio itself was very nice and clean.

This hotel has a rude general manger that had treated me and my guests poorly after an altercation that occurred due to an intoxicated guest and poor service from the staff . We were told last midnight after we had booked the room and had got to the hotel that the rooms were all sold out and we were stuck out in the cold for the night after the altercation occurred , had gotten in touch with the general manager and he took it as a joke and didn’t provide me any service . would not want to have other people deal with poor communication skills and stay in an unsafe environment.
Jake’s place was exactly what it says. The bed was quite creaky so getting into the top bunk was a little scary. Amazing location. Easy and convenient

I would stay here again! it is exactly what one is looking for when going to a nice affordable Airbnb. the location is ideal, it's located in a "neighborhood" so you feel like you are really part of the NY lifestyle. there is a bar, wine store, and food stores all in one block from you. PlUS you are right next to TWO major subways. Both are literally an inch away from you.  CONS -the Airbnb is ideal for 5 ppl under 6ft tall/ smaller build. if you're group is bigger then 6ft/ bigger build I see no possible way to sleep here. unless your group is only 3. - there are rats all around the apartment complex but there are rats everywhere in NYC so no big deal. - it can get kind of sketchy at night time but not bad(any where in NYC is sketchy at time though).  during the daytime you feel safe and welcomed.  NOTE: even with the cons I still rate this a 4 stars!! and would stay again in the summer time.

My wife and I stayed here for 3 months and really enjoyed it.   The home is absolutely stunning and is perfectly located near a subway station and the north end of Central Park. It even has a view of the midtown skyline.   The main con was some very frequent and strict communication and check in that made the stay a little bit stressful at times.   Overall this is a great place to stay if you want to be in a quiet part of Manhattan, but still have access to the rest of the city.

Avoid this listing and this host, Jake! The property is misreprented because while the photo of the room shows it is renovated and nice looking, the building the room is in and the street it’s on is super ratchet, decrepit, and grungy! The building looks like low income slums and full of what looks like poor immigrants. There are hoodlums loitering at the entrance of the building.  I had booked a 5 night stay at this place but wanted to check out after one night because I did not feel comfortable nor safe in this building.  I could not sleep on my first night here on a Tuesday. My sleep was constantly disrupted by stereo music outside, neighbors doing normal activities, and elevator beeps right by the room. The walls and windows of this building are super thin and seriously not suitable for a residential dwelling! I could hear people chopping vegetables in the kitchen up stairs, people talking in various foreign languages, coughing, phone notifications going off, people walking by in the hallway, bass music through the walls from what sounded like a distant club, and a guy having sex somewhere a few rooms down. The noises lasted all day from check in until 1am when people finally all went to bed. I finally fell asleep at 2 am but was woken up at 4 am by hoodlums playing the stereo outside! The thin walls really gave me anxiety because when people walked by and when people talked, it felt like they were in the room with me.  The listing also said there would be AC. Warning, it is a window unit! Because the photo did not show a window unit I assume the AC would be central AC and it would be a nice place. I arrived and found there was no AC installed. The host said he didn’t think I would need it in the spring time. The host promised a unit to be delivered at 2 separate times but did not follow through and stopped sending me updates and just ghosted me. He even got defensive and played it off as me being unreasonable for wanting AC in 60s weather. It was listed plainly as an amenity he offered. Hotels always have AC and they are not usually units that stick out the window! No hotel ever decides to remove or make the ac unavailable during cooler seasons either! If I had known from the photos AC was a ghetto window unit that was removed, I would have not booked this place. Don’t even think about opening windows if it ever gets stuffy and hot because noise was coming in with the window closed!  After one extremely uncomfortable night where I could not sleep, I messaged the host asking to check out early. The host, Jake, did not respond to my message for 16 hours and I had to escalate to AirBnB. In response to my noise complaints, he said I should go talk to the neighbors and ask them to quiet down. I am a single woman traveling alone so that would not have been safe late at night or really not appropriate in a hotel like environment. The noise was coming from everywhere, too! The host didn’t care and denied my request to check out early.  Just overall a terrible experience and terrible value. Please do not stay here. I paid $120/night after taxes and fees. For that price you can get a nice 3-4 star hotel in the same vicinity!  Pros: Clean, close proximity to Penn station, bedding was comfortable, wifi worked  Cons: —Probably around 150 sq feet —Window looks into a wall. Feels like a prison. —No hand towels or wash cloths provided. I asked host and was ignored like he didn’t see my message. —Noise everywhere!! Could even hear people’s phones go off next door and above me! —low income immigrants in the building and hoodlums outside making the environment feel unsafe and run down like slums —Misleading representation of AC —No hand soap in bathroom during COVID-19? —threshold between bathroom and bedroom has a ledge which was a trip hazard —Worst, host became unresponsive, was unempathetic and would not let me check out early. He just wanted to keep my money despite me being extremely uncomfortable and could not sleep. Airbnb support could not even reach him for 5 hours.
Place was clean when we arrived, and it fit our group perfectly!  Parking was difficult (near impossible) to find and neighborhood was on the rougher side, but not bad enough that we felt unsafe.

It is a very nice, spacious apartment and the neighborhood is pleasant, it is not unsafe or dangerous despite people's comments, to get to the Times Square station you must take a 5-minute bus or walk 8 blocks, and a 28-minute subway from West Farms to Times Square. In conclusion, it is accessible, spacious, beautiful and the hosts are very friendly.

Honest review. My friend's and I have booked this airbnb (no exaggeration) atleast 6-8 times in the past year (this is the 1st time under my name).  We have booked for bridal shower, birthdays, and more. The host is generally responsive in the times we've stayed, and if we ever need an extra 30 min she is fine with it (unless the cleaning service is scheduled early). We are not big party people, so its a great place. The place comes with long tables and many chairs which is great for having dinner nights.  However, unfortunately, it has progressively gotten worse over time. The door no longer locks the same (so if anyone needs to leave earlier the door will remain unlocked in a very unsafe neighborhood). Literally this time as I struggled to opend the lock box there was a very creepy man staring the entire 3 minutes, I legit almost left. The internet no longer works, despite their being a password on the description page, so you will have to spend your own hotspot/internet. The sink is always backed up (it has been like that for a while. & while there is a cleaning fee (we actually used to bump into the cleaning people when we were on our way out, they are always kind, and one time even helped us bring the garbage downstairs) there seems to have been a change in (obviously not management) but managing. Be prepared to check your Ps and Qs. You can clean up after yourself, throw your garbage away, and all the things, but if you forget a few things be prepared to be charged $100 fee, even if its only a 15minute additional clean up. Basically there is no grace. We have literally never had issues until now.  Overall, in ny this is likely the most affordable place you will find for a big group, and its convenient nonetheless. Just be very careful, very cautious, and keep the above in mind. I would only recommend if you keep the above in mind. Be safe.

Helen is very responsive, communicative, and helpful. Unfortunately, this wasn't enough to overlook an overall bad experience. It isn't clearly listed on the listing that there are 2 possible guests also staying in the rooms downstairs. There were mostly men staying at the place during my stay which wasn't very comfortable for me at all. During my stay, there were roaches in the room (I saw at least 3) so I had to cancel, book another place, and finally get a refund after being on the phone stressed with Airbnb several times. It doesn't seem like this is the first roach problem based on previous reviews that I noticed later. On top of that, she insisted that the other host of the house (a male) enter my room during my stay to take photos of the roaches?... which made me very uncomfortable. Overall this was a very stressful and very uncomfortable stay for me. It might work for a very free-spirited type of person. Also, note that the door only has a little latch to lock from the inside.

Small but convenient and quiet. Host was stress free and attentive.

The place was an amazing steal. It was so close to great restaurants and just a train ride away to the touristy locations in Manhattan. Van was a really nice host and responded promptly and quickly to any message or question. Recommended some good spots to eat. Good place to spend a couple nights!

Do not waste your time here it’s horrible it look like you staying in a basement it’s not clean very uncomfortable inside it’s scary and it don’t not look like nothing on the picture at all

The place is more dingy than is advertised. There’s mice poop in the kitchen, cockroaches, and mice in the walls.   Most disturbingly, there was an electrical outlet that had a broken off plug in it with the metal sticking out. It was located right above the bed. Extremely dangerous fire and electrical hazard.   For what I was paying, the place was not worth these risks and conditions.

If you are looking for the bare necessities, then this place is for you. Pretty basic apartment. Bed quality was okay, like a typical Motel 6. No tv in the unit, but no need, you can clearly hear the tv from the bottom unit. Shower was cold the first day but warm the next day. Heater works well which is needed because the linen was very thin. There is extra blankets which we used. It advertises as 2 bedrooms with 3 beds, but there are only 2 beds in the apartment. One has a door that leads to nowhere. Kinda creepy/odd. Overall, I didn’t spend much time here, just slept and left. The owner was a good communicator.

I noticed the following during my stay: giant rust spot in bathtub concealed by a bath tub mat, peeling wood on bathroom cabinet and bathroom door, lack of shade on bedroom light, dirt on shades, duct taped mirror, missing or broken lightbulbs, opened food and alcohol inside of the fridge, clutter, stained furniture, dust balls. When I turned on the shower, bugs came out from under the bathtub mat. The AC unit is next to the bed letting in cold winter air and smoke from neighbor’s smoke breaks. Radiator is very loud, dead cockroaches and dirt in hallway, construction across the street. I’ve lived in Manhattan for years in older buildings and have never dealt with issues to this extent. Upon bringing these up to the host, she offered to send her cleaning lady. I checked out early due to the uncomfortable stay so I did not get to meet her.

The place is well located, easy access. However, the building has a slightly unpleasant smell since the front room was smoking all day. The cabin is good for 4 people, however any movement makes noise and it moves a lot. As for cleaning, under the bed there was a box where the cabin came from, and I think that was the reason why there was a rat in the room and we didn't realize it. One day after sleeping with the rat inside, we managed to get it out.

Our host, Jeroen was very responsive.  If i asked a question, he responded within 2 or 3 minutes.  The space is very large for NYC.  The owner has done a fabulous job of renovating.  Those are the positives.  The posted rules, however, are so restrictive that it took away a lot of our enjoyment.  My 2 sisters and I are not loud, but we felt like we needed to tiptoe-not enjoyable.  In previous years, I have owned short term rentals and I feel like the space I rent should be mine for the allotted time. This space has the owners clothes throughout and even the refrigerator is so full there is no space for placing a snack.  The work space in one of the sleeping rooms is so cluttered, it is difficult to get to one side of the fold out bed.  We were required to leave our shoes on the 1st floor landing, but it became a bit creepy to have someone rearranging our shoes .  For NYC and location, this space is such a value but there are some negatives.

Don’t do it!!! Even drunk, I was disappointed with the accommodations and amenities. The staff was super helpful but the tech issues and wet bathroom as well as the shady block was too much for me. My partner called about the tv 4 times and still couldn’t get it to function. Save your time, money, and yourself. Don’t do it.

The host was unresponsive and rude. The lock to enter the apartment was spoilt/ jammed and the host refused to have a conversation stating we have to deal with it and they wouldn’t be home for a few hours. Jamie also cut the phone on us causing the experience to be unpleasant. We were standing outside the unit for 2 hours. Would not recommend, very unpleasant experience.

We had a great stay at Alison’s place. The apartment is exactly as described, very clean, comfortable, spacious (we are a family of 5), very quiet too. The air conditioning was very much appreciated as we stayed during the July heatwave. It is conveniently located close to multiple subway stations, we were just not super comfortable walking pass the homeless shelter by Nostrand lines A and C station (better to go through lines 2-3-4-5 from the south). All in all, a very good  place to stay to discover New York!

The host was very very kind than I imagined. Room was cleaner than I thought also. I was a little worried if someone might rob as it is a shared room, but luckily I had good roomates too. The mattress completely sank down in the middle, but it was the only problem. Thinking about its location and price to be honest, this is great.

We had a great stay at Jamie's place. There were 6 of us (4 adults and 2 children). The apartment is very clean and spacious. It contains 3 bedrooms and not 2 as advertised. Jamie is very responsive in communicating. Small points to improve for us French would be a little more dishes for eating. M and R stop more reassuring and easier to access than line 7. Especially if you come home late. Jamie was kind enough for us to leave our luggage on the day of our departure, as our flight was late. Great first Airbnb experience

The apartment is well located, it took less than 10 minutes to walk to a subway station, knowing that 3 lines are available and all go to Manhattan. The neighborhood is quiet and you don't feel unsafe, even at night. It is mainly inhabited by Mexicans and Chinese. Small convenience stores are on the way to the metro, and are open until midnight in summer. The apartment itself is nice. There are 3 real bedrooms with doors, one of which has access to a small bathroom including a toilet and a sink. The other bathroom has an independent entrance and includes a toilet, a bathtub and a sink. There is air conditioning in each room, a little noisy but very effective and very popular in summer. It quickly refreshes the rooms. The TV is huge. The only regret about the apartment is the severe lack of dishes. We don't go on vacation to cook big meals, but there were no glasses, only one knife for 6, 3 teaspoons, no colander to cook pasta or rice, a very small frying pan and not a cloth to dry the dishes, especially on the day of departure. Even on vacation, we appreciate not eating with disposable tableware during our entire stay. Jamie agreed to leave our suitcases on the day of departure, which we really appreciated. We would love to return on our next trip to New York.

We had a wonderful first visit to the East Coast & this apartment was perfect for the three of us. We didn’t realize how far it was for Uber costs but it was a very nice & so very clean.  The area looks a little sketchy but we walked around, ate at a local places nearby & shopped for drinks/munchies. Great price & we would stay here again!  Wonderful host!

The worst place you could ever go to, please dont book. Four people in one room beds on the floor rude and disrespectful roommates. The building is a fire hazard there no were to lock your bags away so anyone can steal from you. The bunk bed are very uncomfortable and the shower was yellow. Airbnb she talk this room down asap.

Convenient to trains, close to Tennis center/Citi field. Neighborhood is not sketchy, this is how the working class live. Small mom and pop restaurants and shops very close to apartment. Air conditioning worked well in late August. Only thing lacking was silverware(not enough) and they need a can opener.

Awesome place to stay for the price!  I will say the bunk bed is very squeaky lol at some points I was afraid it was going to collapse but it held up good. So I would recommend not getting the top bunk unless you’re lightweight and ok with rocking back and forth squeaking in the night.    The location is great, a 22 minute walk to time square and has restaurants close by. The other roommates were great as well 🫶🏻

The bed is very uncomfortable. The structure is broken, every time I move a little it shakes a lot and makes a lot of noise. It has to be fixed. It makes noise and is unbearable. They are not conditions. What is not acceptable is that it cannot be solved without trying. I certainly wouldn't treat anyone like that.  Given his lack of offer to fix it, I suggested sleeping in the bed below, but he denied it saying that it was reserved and it was not true, the entire room was empty and I had to suffer needless inconvenience. I feel very frustrated since he did not try to give me any solution. It is very selfish to offer people something that you are even satisfied with. Kitchen, windows, floor, bathroom, old sheets... The electrical installation is also very dangerous and it is very cold in the house.

My experience with Nicole and Jonathan was terrible. They first off had a set of rules inside their home that were not posted on Airbnb. One of these rules was that there were no  guests allowed. Not even for a minute or else there would be a charge, This is inhumane since I was staying for a month.  On Wednesday I had my girlfriend over. They saw through their cameras and on Thursday asked me to pay for her and sent a request on Aibnb. I replied saying Ok, I was at work in the emergency hospital at brooklyn hospital so requested till the end of the day. they informed me my girlfriend would not be allowed on premises till I paid so I stepped aside and abided by their request. Afterwords I pointed out that It was a little harsh since I was staying a month. Jonathan told me to check my attitude and falsely accused me of causing damage to his property and threatened to throw me out. I said I would leave if given a refund. He contacted airbnb and I was reached out to with accusations of having an unauthorized individual on the property and of causing damage. I denied those allegations as I had paid for my girlfriend well in time and while moving in a picture frame fell but didnt break. The next morning when I left for work someone at Airbnb cancelled my reservation without any warning or advanced notice. The hosts approached my girlfriend and told her that I was trying to sneak her around and that they had cancelled my reservation for it. They told her they would kick her out but then offered to keep her till Monday and told her to leave me as I was a bad man. I had to leave at 6am after coming back from work at 11pm on friday. This is while dealing with airbnb support staffs 1 hour case close notice while at the hospital and booking an alternative accommodation all at the same time. This and the stress of being made homeless was too much to deal with really while seeing patients and so I thought about sharing my experience. Airbnb's own rules don't allow what happened to me to happen.

I had a wonderful stay here, the room and common areas are quite spacious and well lit--a beautiful home all around. Many subway lines nearby made for easy travel and the surrounding neighborhood was very pleasant as well. Check-in and check-out were streamlined and stress-free. I highly recommend.
Edmundo was super helpful and very responsive. Apartment was clean and immaculate! Area was a little sketchy but if you’re looking for a clean nice place to stay I definitely recommend it here!

The site is like the photos. It's clean, the wifi works perfectly, the kitchen/fridge is good. There is air conditioning that cools quickly and a fan in the room.  The only downside is that it is far from the center, almost an hour, and the return journey was very difficult. The area is normal, it's not scary, but we didn't like coming back very late at night to take the subway and walk through the empty streets.

Elliot’s place is fantastic!! It is cozy, full of little details (super fluffy towels, cookies, big tv screen, filtered water…) literally it is perfect!! But the best thing is Elliot himself and his wonderful couple.  Don’t let yourself be scared because the location is not by Times Square, metro is super close and convenient.  Me and my daughter both loved every second there and we already miss it.  Living there makes you feel like newyorkers for some days… and that’s the idea, isn’t it?

Decent, clean, and an accommodating place if you're planning on using it as a base to explore Manhattan. The subway is a couple of blocks away and should get you to midtown in 20 minutes. The place is in Harlem which is very lively in the day and equally sketchy at night. Elliot is very responsive, and the amenities provided in the room and bathroom are thoughtful.

There is a room with a private entrance and a bathroom located between the room and the host's kitchen, the passage to the kitchen  is separated by a curtain. The check-in and contact with the host were very good. The place is clean and cozy. It is located very close to the 116street Subway station. However, the building itself and the surrounding area is a bit unpleasant.

Frances place is such a steal it has everything I wanted plus more! The place looks just like the pictures that are shown and Frances  response time is great and with any concerns or problems I had she handled with the quickness. Do NOT hesitate to buy this place you won’t regret it at all. I would come to their place again whenever I come back in town.

Great night in Rockaway aboard this charming houseboat! Spent the whole day on the top dock in the shade, enjoying the quaint, safe community of cool boat folk who call this marina home. Great sound system onboard; great views; great scene. Perfect for a small gathering of friends for the day, and was a quick drive to the Rockaway Hotel for a concert and nightlife. Owner could not have been easier to communicate with and was a pleasure. Will definitely be back!

* My room was over-priced  - You couldn’t even open the window because there’s NO screen (there’s a cat that lives outside the window who came to the window many times!  - I was wondering why even after I burned hella incense, the room still wasn’t pleasant; somewhere in the room smells like piss  - if you look under the bed and next to the  walls - IT’S SO DISGUSTINGLY DIRTY  - I’m not sure if the sheets were even clean before I came because I stayed for 1 month and with ALL the people who stayed in the house, the shower curtain was NEVER changed!!!  - I had to shower upstairs (my room downstairs) because there is NO WHERE for you to place or hang your products while you’re showering (downstairs)  - SO many people stayed there while I was there and hardly NO ONE would clean the kitchen, which made it very unpleasant or impossible for me to clean my OWN dishes (do not use the dishes there - I saw roaches) or even cook - There’s NO sanitizer anywhere SO many people stay there (& COVID still exists) - I used my OWN towels to open the door knobs or silverware to open the microwaves. *My stay was VERY UNCOMFORTABLE! Tons of unclean guys who smelled really bad - I had to sage  the hallways.  MAKE SURE TO BRING EVERYTHING YOU NEED: there is NOTHING! NO hand soap, NO towels,, no racks to hang up anything in the bathroom, NO shower mats, NO oven holder (BTW the oven DOES NOT WORK and I had to tell her!)  - the refrigerator leeks in the fridge downstairs, my food would have TONS of access water on top or inside my bags - she had a label for food bins but it was SO close to the dirty floor and bin that I never kept my food there.  - my bedroom was suffocating and the closet was also dirty.  Even though the house is old - she could do better - I can see now that SHE IS ONLY TAKING PEOPLE’S MONEY!!! ITS BAD DORM LIFE.   I had a very UNCOMFORTABLE stay!

The home is decent for the price and a place to get out of the cold. Im not going to bash it but it could have definitely been cleaner. Beer cans in trash can, table was soiled, trash under the beds and most unfortunate of all we had to purchase towels from Marshalls to bathe as there were only two very worn/thin towels for an entire home.  Major Issue EXPOSED ELECTRICAL WIRING! Like why? It was high up above the thermostat but could be an unnecessary danger for guest.  He texted me at 11am to reprimand our noise level because we were talking in the living room area. Im 40 and my 3 guest are in their 60's. I texted back and told him were going to talk and this isn't kindergarten and it didnt go any further but that was very irking. We are grown, respectful, and weren't having a party and the text was distasteful.  "Hey! Keep it down a bit!"  This is probably due to him renting a space and he living on the other side of a scotch taped door to separate the two dwellings. It was odd that he was annoyed with our talking when his dogs barked often. We also didnt bargain for our daily return to the place to be filled with the smell of strong cooking odor from his family's meals.  The check-in was ok but scary in an uncomfortable limbo because he gave no instructions until 15 minutes before the checkin time although he messaged the day before at 3am asking what time we would like to check in. I assume this is why communication was very delayed because he appears to be a night owl of some sort.  Check out at 10am was almost absurd to be rushed out that time of morning but we complied because his handbook was clearly threatening of more charges if he saw us leaving on the many cameras around the place after 10am.  The place looks ok. Confusing to find the door where we would live because of the many doors on this building labeled with the same address. The courtyard was sort of an eye sore with a construction area gate that looked to be dangerously barely holding itself together. Plenty of light as we entered and that was good. This place with some work could be really nice. I will say that. I read his other reviews and still chose this place because I was thinking no way it could be that bad, no way he really expects no tissue in the toilet, but I found out for myself how it really was. I have noticed any host with absolutely no refunds tend to have that policy for a reason and I may mean be leery from now on.

I stayed two months. The apartment and pictures reflect what you see in the listing. The location is the main advantage being centrally located in midtown Manhattan. Surprisingly it is not really noisy even at night as there is not so much foot traffic on this street compared to other streets. The fire department very close by doesn’t turn on the sirens for their night calls although you might wake up and see flashing red and white lights at night in the apartment!  If you want a high security building this may not be the place for you. There are vagrants that sit on the building front steps at times and chat. I did see some moderate drug use around the building as well. But this is New York City and not so uncommon. I never felt unsafe really although I did pay attention to my surroundings in the immediate area.  The bed is comfortable. The hot water works very well. I was also able to get packages easily. Ori did not have the air conditioner installed yet upon my arrival but he brought a brand new one the next day and it worked well for me the entire two month stay.   The kitchen is not really equipped for any serious food preparation or cooking. But there is a good grocery and pharmacy near by for prepared foods etc.   All in all, this is a great apartment for this central Manhattan location. It’s a good place especially for young people likely. Not luxurious but basic and comfortable.

Angela’s place is very conveniently located.  I woke up late for my early morning flight but was able to make it to the airport in less than 15 minutes.  I have always been scared to stay in a private room but it was spacious and accommodating.  Angela was very helpful and responsive.  If you just need a place to crash at night or are just in town for a layover this place is perfect and affordable!
Very conveniently located, quaint place with an awesome host! Easy self check-in process and very well organised house for easy stress free stay!
Great area apart from the subway station and its proximity, can be somewhat sketchy at night. Good host who showed everything,not the most luxurious apartment but you get your moneys worth here.

Patrick was exceptionally nice and accommodating. The apartment itself, however, was a little dirty and quite hot (NYC was in general really hot that day).  It was okay to stay there for one night but the location seemed a little sketchy.   Patrick helped us although we checked in late and he explained everything very detailed.
This accommodation is OK for one night, but not longer. There was a funny smell in the room, which was quite unpleasant. The location wasn't the best and the area wasn't exactly the nicest.

Pros  - Patrick is very nice  - very close to the subway  - managed to find parking within a block in the evening, not sure how it ll be in the night.   Cons  - roaches on the bed !!!! -  we don’t know it is a shared space and we woke up scared in the middle of the night to the sound of someone walking outside the room and using the restroom.

Patrick is an amazing host and gave us a great tour of the property. However he is the only good part about staying here. We had a major issue with another guest during our trip. First of all, he repeatedly pounded on my boyfriend and I's door. I'm pregnant and this scared me completely. He pounded it so hard the door actually broke open. Additionally, this guest almost physically fought my boyfriend. He was screaming the f word and threatening him. We filed a police report and contacted the Airbnb safety team. Also, this particular room is in a hallway where the bathroom and kitchen are. Meaning during all hours of the night you will be woken up to guests unlocking the door right outside the bedroom and using the kitchen or toilet. This made us very uncomfortable. Avoid.

The apartment was exactly as described and the communication with the host was amazing - super fast, reliable and helpful. For a short stay it‘s a great option and with the train you can reach the center easily. The neighborhood felt a bit shady at night, but besides that I always felt welcome and ok!

This Appartement is just perfect for travellers who don't need luxury hotels but a cozy spot from where you can cook your own meals, chill out a little or do a little sightseeing.   Appartement: It's small but it's big enough for 3-4 people, and from what i heared it's really good priced for New York Standarts. Everything was cleaned up and Crystal provided fresh towels for each of us. Just to compare - the same Appartement in Manhattan would cost you 4-5x more. The only point I maybe would have to say, is that the only pan is a little nasty, but that's not the world.  Location: In my opinion, New York City is really nice, but to life - brooklyn is the key.  The neighbourhood is crowded with nice pubs and Restaurants, the people are really friendly and it has it's own urban-charme. Also you have a little market exact on the opposite of the road. It takes only 15 mins by foot to the next Metro, then about 20-30 mins to Manhattan - so you can easily go to Manhattan for 3$ in approximately 45 mins. We went to Manhattan in the late morning and back home in the evening without any stress. But i would highly recommend everyone to enjoy the beautiful things brooklyn has to offer.  Crystal answered us directly and there was no stress at checking in, eventhough we weren't able to write her cause we are from europe and had no wifi Connection.  To summerize this: It was a cozy little appartement wich has almost everything you need, in a nice neighbourhood with a lot places to drink, eat or running earands around. definitely would come back.

Pros: There were a lot of nice restaurants nearby, the amount of natural lighting of the place brought a nice ambiance of peace amongst the chaos, fully equipped kitchen, enough space for 3-4 ppl, easy check-in process, TV with roku, bed was comfortable.  Cons: It's far from the train (10 min walking), needs to be deeply cleaned in general, noisy area (though the fire station is mentioned in the listing but aside from that the people around at night), the area can get pretty shady at night too, bed was comfortable but there was like a plastic sheet beneath which made it really hot, the AC in the smaller room didn't work.

Overall a good stay - easy check in process, clean place, decent location.  Some of the stuff here needs fixing. We tried our best to keep quiet especially coming back at late hours, but the doors and floors and very loud and creaky. Some of the bedroom doors can't lock completely either. Not a deal breaker but definitely added some stress when trying to be extra considerate of the neighbors.

Sa was a lovely, accommodating host. Communication was easy, consistent, and made for a low-stress, relaxing stay. The space was clean, comfortable, and the location in lower Manhattan / Chinatown could not have been more accessible and convenient. Highly highly recommend Sa and the apartment—I’m hoping to return the next time I’m in NYC!

In terms of price-performance ratio, it's probably unbeatable. The room isn't the largest and you have to get up to the fifth floor first, but if you mainly want to explore the city, you'll definitely get your money's worth thanks to the great location! Sa and her roommate are super friendly and helpful. The best thing, however, is the view from the roof!! No viewing platform can keep up with that. So if you're not afraid of climbing stairs and want to stay centrally and cheaply, we can definitely recommend it.

Flight canceled at the last minute, I found myself with nothing one evening, this accommodation was accepted for me at the last minute and I am very grateful! Right next to the airport, lots of little touches (toothbrush, shower gel, shampoo, snacks, tea, coffee, hot chocolate, water). Really great, I’m very happy with it!

This is THE perfect place to stay if you're flying in or out of LaGuardia. I booked a room when my flight schedule changed, and was able to walk straight over and check in within the hour. The listing describes everything perfectly, and Angela's communication is prompt and comprehensive. The accommodation is simple but with nice personal touches, and I can confirm that the window AC unit works a charm! The next morning, I was able to walk back over to the terminal (it really does take 12 minutes or less) without any stress or added expense. I would highly recommend staying here, you can't beat the location, cost, or helpful hosting.

Overall, a wonderful experience! The bnb was clean and we never once felt unsafe in the area. Plenty of street parking and easy to check in. It is near JFK so you hear planes fly over, but it is not loud enough that it kept us or our baby awake at night. There are 2 (semi-steep) flights of stairs, one going up to the main floor and another going up to the loft area, maybe something to consider if traveling with older individuals or small children. It gets warm but the place has plenty of AC units to keep it cool. Other than that, it was a great stay - the host is generous with kitchen, household, bathroom items that we felt we didn’t need anything while there. There’s also a well-stocked and clean small market around the corner for groceries. It was about a 30 min drive to Manhattan without traffic but did get up to 1.5 hours with traffic and train also requires 2-3 stops and takes 45min-1hr - just so you’re aware if you’re planning a trip into the city! Again, so happy with our stay and would recommend this location to anyone looking for a clean and nice yet affordable place outside the city!

The apartment is actually creepy and smells like cat pee. I immediately left and canceled after being in there for 5 minutes. Wouldn’t recommend for anyone alone or anyone who needs actual privacy and peace.

I stayed in this Airbnb for 9 weeks in the Summer of 2021. Although I was suspicious at first, because this place didn't have any reviews, my stay was perfect!   Where should I start?  The Airbnb has the perfect location: it's right between Soho, Little Italy & Chinatown. Everything is in walking distance, but in case you need to go somewhere further away, there are 3 subway stations that are a ca. 5min walk away.  Being in Soho/Nolita there are numerous cafés, restaurants and bars right around the corner. When you stay at this place, you truly feel like a local.   The Airbnb itself is modern, spacious and clean, and perfect for a single or a couple - even for a longer stay. It looks just like on the pictures. You have a separate entrance and it feels like your own studio. The only downside is that this Airbnb is on the 5th floor and there's no elevator, but you get used to it after a while.   Caitlin and Duane are amazing hosts. Communication was super easy and whenever I needed something, I just texted them and they were super prompt to reply and organize missing supplies. At the end of my stay they even hosted me for drinks at their apartment (which is next door).   I would  100% book this Airbnb again - highly recommended!

We enjoyed our stay as the apartment was very clean, comfortable, and filled with modern amenities. However, we arrived quite late and went straight to bed, so coffee would have been nicer to have in the kitchen than Prosecco.   The residential neighborhood was peaceful and filled with historic charm. But  the nearby coffeeshops and restaurants were not as inviting as we had anticipated. The best coffee was at Starbucks, several blocks away. The neighborhoods beyond this peaceful street were a bit sketchy. However, the convenience to the subway system was great.  The most challenging aspect for us was the tight, spiral, outdoor staircase leading down to the apartment door. We're in our sixties. That staircase is meant for the young and agile.

This place is lovely and cosy and in a great location.  I was there for three weeks, to work in the archives at the Schomburg Center, which is a 15-minute walk away through the charming park across the street.  It's very well equipped; having laundry facilities inside the unit is a bonus for those who like to travel light like me; the private patio is a great bonus in good weather. The host was prompt in communication and provided a work chair for me; safety and access were great, too.  The only problem I encountered were pests, roaches specifically, which appeared only in the bathroom. When I contacted the host, he introduced measures the next day that helped a bit, but didn't resolve the problem.  As I've asthma, they couldn't use the super-poisonous fumigation. I tried to move to another location, but couldn't find anything suitable, and thus had to struggle with various sprays and potions, and stress related to unwanted visitors (I've a bug phobia) until my departure. Though the host tried to assist me with finding alternative accommodations, he didn't offer me any compensation for this hardship (a refund of a cleaning deposit, for example), neither did he cut the price for a prolonged stay of three weeks -- which has been customary in all the other places I've stayed -- so this was a huge disappointment.

Authentic Brooklyn loft experience. Excellent welcome and communication from Jean Louis who can be completely trusted. I was afraid of taking a risk because air BNBs are often discouraged by travel bloggers who explain how you can sometimes find yourself without accommodation at the last moment even though your reservation has been confirmed. I highly recommend our host!

Marlene's place was great! My boyfriend and I stayed here for over a week and loved it. It's literally 1 block away from the subway, which made transportation super easy and accessible. The neighborhood was super safe too! I'd walk around it at 3am (as a woman) and never felt uneasy or scared. There's a supermarket less than 500 feet from this place along with a bunch of bodegas that are open 24/7! Overall, I had such an amazing experience. Marlene was super attentive whenever my boyfriend and I needed something too. The only negative was the noise from the neighbors. Unfortunately, the neighbor from 2 doors down BLASTS music at 6am every morning. This would wake my boyfriend and I up everyyy morning. That being said, it was definitely still worth it to stay at Marlene's. The place was fantastic :)
Location was great, few steps to the metro, markets, drug store and more. Its pretty much what you see in pictures. The AC is like a portable unit so its not too strong but works for a short stay.

In this apartment was somebody when I was out. Somone know passcode or have a keys. I felt my self very scary inside. the host didnt care. I wrote him, but he didnt let me know what whats happend there. Be very carefull when you will book this room!

Terrific studio apartment exactly as advertised and in the photos. Communication with Jake was great and he was always responsive with instructions, self check-in was super easy. The building is busy and in mid town so that comes with the territory if you are traveling with kids: the lobby and hallways can be a bit shady with lots of random people coming in and out; there was a party upstairs and loud yelling outside at night -- nothing unusual if you've stayed in busy Manhattan before. The upside is that Korea Town is just one block up and has fantastic food and nightlife, and it's an easy walk to lots of tourist attractions. And plenty of parking garages around (impossible to park on the street here).

The unit was as described.  Nicely remodeled and clean.  The beds were great, the kitchen functional and the location fantastic (less than 50 yards from a subway station).  There are many low cost restaurants within less than 100 yards.  The grocery store was easy to access and had all that we needed.  The air conditioners worked very well and were really needed - it was hot in the city.  You are located on the 4th floor, so there are a lot of steps.    The area is a bit sketchy.  I've traveled the world and didn't ever fear for my safety.  However, if you are a first time visitor to NYC, this place may stretch your comfort level quite a bit.  There are many homeless people on the street, open drug use and people sleeping in the subway.  I'd stress again, that I personally didn't feel worried for my personal safety.  My son-in-law on the other hand was very much on edge and worried.    So pay close attention to what is going on around you.  When we departed, I pulled our rental car up to the door and we loaded the car.  Like always, upon entering the car, I locked the doors.  Within just a second or two, four men approached the back of the car and tried to open the tailgate.  Had we not locked the doors, we would have lost all of our luggage.  So pay careful attention to your surroundings.  Even as this happened, I didn't fear for my safety, I just recognized that this could have ruined our trip had they been successful.

The Airbnb is in New York terms pretty large.  We stayed for a total of 10 days. It had two bedrooms, a combined dining room living room kitchen and had all the dishwasher, washer, dryer as listed.  We used the subway 6 (immediately outside to your right) to go to downtown everyday we visited three to four sightseeing locations. It was relaxed.  Right next to the subway entrance was one of the best Mexican restaurants I’ve been to, and it’s called La Chula. Área as mentioned, is at night, slightly sketchy but as long as you’re not spending too long out in the area at night it should have no influence on the Trip at all.    Super communicative and always on trash and restocking paper towels and other items with no issues.  We easily packed light a did our laundry here with the existing units.  Grocery spot next door to Chula and Whole Foods three blocks away. Highly recommend.

Pros: Anthony's place is super-clean, bright, large by NYC standards, well-equipped, and comfortable. The two of us were easily able to work during the week from the apartment, and sightsee during our free time. We did tons and tons of walking, since Central Park is 15 min away on foot, and the Met Museum about 30 min. If you like walking, there is hardly any need to take cabs or even the subway. There are plenty of good coffee shops (try Pabade on E110th St!) and restaurants (Lexington St) nearby, as well as a really excellent grocery store (City Fresh) right across the street. The apartment is also easily accessible from LaGuardia via a 15-min cab/Uber ride. Anthony is a great host - very responsive, and answered all our questions right away.  Cons: We removed one star for the location, since the neighbourhood is quite rough, and noisy. The location is convenient, and great for anyone on a budget, but it is a rough area - though we never felt unsafe during the day.

beautiful apartment, well equipped. and above all very cozy.  It is very well located if you need to get to know the city center. It can be said that the sector is a bit dangerous late at night.   highly recommended stay
Great apartment with all the amenities you need for a short stay. Bit of a sketchy area, but close enough to the subway to not need to walk around

The unit was just as described. Very clean,fairly spacious and extremely comfortable. Previous reviews notate of the area being sketchy,it was not as bad as I anticipated, everyone kept to themselves even late at night. During the night it can be noisy but that is everywhere in a big city. I would be prepared for the three flights of stairs,we definitely were tired as bringing up luggages with us. I also have to say that the parking in the area is not the greatest,we stayed the weekend and we’re out most of the day but we got a ticket due to us sleeping in and not paying the parking meter on time. Sams Pizza right across the street was amazing and cheap! The grocery store a block over was very convenient for snacks and water!  Overall we had a lovely stay and minor inconveniences that happen with every trip,but the apartment was a good rest stop to sleep and have a quick snack before view the city.

The four of us stayed in the apartment for a week. The description of the apartment definitely fits. Everything was clean and the apartment was equipped with a dishwasher, stove, refrigerator, washing machine and dryer. The location is perfect for tourists. The subway line 6, station 116 Straße, is right in front of the door but cannot be heard. From a German perspective, I would describe the location and environment as “rustic”. But no one was intrusive. We were also out and about in the evening and didn't feel unsafe. There are several options for shopping and eating relatively cheaply right next to the apartment, but compared to Germany, NY is very expensive. Anthony made a great effort as host and was very easy to reach, thank you again for that.  If we come back to NY we would like to go to Anthony's apartment again.  Oh well… the entrance is at number 147!

Fantastic property. Spotlessly clean, lovely furniture and well equipped modern kitchen. The two bedrooms are spacious, bedding and linens spotless, really good mattress and pillows. Flat screen with Netflix. But best of all great Air Con which was a blessing. There were a few reviews saying the area is a bit sketchy and at first appearance it looks like that but we had no problem whatever with the area or the people. In fact the people in the shops, takeaways and restaurants were brilliant to us and the people on the street did not pose any bother to us whatsoever. 1 minuteswalk across the road is the Subway which goes Uptown and Downtown. This is really convenient as it brings you right into Manhattan and Brooklyn Bridge. We purchased a weekly Metro ticket for 33 dollars which gives you unlimited usage on the Subway and Local buses. We did not get a taxi at all, we went everywhere on the Subway. Yes we got lost a few times but we had the Metro ticket and it was actually fun getting around. This property is fantastic value for money, its in a good area with the Subway outside your door and any kind of shop you could ever need beside you. You have a great host with Anthony, nothing is too much for him. Will definitely book again next year.

I was visiting New York for a work trip and my housing accommodations changed last minute. Karen responded within 30 minutes of my reservation request, even though it was late around 10pm! She was very communicative and accommodating, even though this reservation was so last minute.   On top of that, I tested positive for Covid during my stay and Karen not only allowed me to stay, but was extremely kind during a very stressful trip for me. I had to quarantine in her apartment and miss all of my work events and social outings I had planned that week. She graciously allowed me to extend my reservation because I couldn’t fly home still having Covid, and was so thoughtful and kind during my stay. She even brought me soup home and gave me tea on several nights. Karen was the sweetest, most generous person ever and I cannot thank her enough!

My girlfriend and I were happy with this place. Excellent location, within walking distance of countless bars, restaurants, theatres, and parks.   The studio was small but comfortable - it was the size we expected, and it was a good place to work remotely. The Internet was excellent for most of time, and the host was very responsive when we needed assistance with the Internet near the end of our stay.  It’s important to note that this Airbnb is a real, legitimate place. This is not one of those places where they try to lock you in to a sort of short term lease or hide all sorts of fees. We feel lucky to have found this actual place that we could happily stay at for the summer.  Check in was not ideal, because one set of instructions gave the incorrect key code for automatic check in. If you book this place, please be sure to review everything on the actual listing as well as any messages from the host, as the correct instructions may be amidst incorrect instructions. We were still able to get in relatively soon, so this was not the end of the world.  The place was not very clean when we arrived. It was very dusty everywhere and the microwave still had food stains in it, for example. However, this was not a huge problem, and we felt fine after some cleaning of our own.  Ultimately, I would recommend this place when staying in the city. It was in a great location, cozy, and most importantly, not a scam!

Location wasn’t bad, just far from train you would need to take a bus. the place was clean, but it was weird there was a camera in a room that was on, the owner sleeps in the garage, and texts and calls you throughout the day. It was creepy i paid for 3 nights and Didint even sleep there for one night. the first day was sketchy, we didint even want to spend the night. Everything is shared space and as much as i thought we were the only ones there, we left and came back our outside door was open when we locked it FOR SURE.  and we didint come back after spending a few hours there and the owner was texting me how she turned the lights off inside and closed our doors. I have been to plenty air bnbs but this one was just sketchy.

This was a really great spot to rest and recharge. The apartment itself is a HUGE studio. The price you pay for the amount of space you get is beyond reasonable. The place is clean and has a great ac and shower. The bathroom is clean, the bed is comfortable, there were plenty of clean towels. I absolutely loved the apartment itself.  The neighborhood was really enjoyable for me as well and all the people I met were nice. There’s a good deli and a good chicken shack within 5 minutes of the place which was nice. The chicken shack is open 24 hours and had some really good food. Overall I loved the air bnb as a place to stay and the neighborhood was great for recharging and relaxing.   The only issue I had with this place was how far it is from the subway. If you want to stay here just know you will have to walk at least a mile home from the L late at night. I didn’t realize this so I had to walk home at 3am. I would have called an Uber but I had a dead phone. It was all good and the neighborhood is safe but it was very stressful not being closer to the subway. Don’t be an idiot like me and let your phone die. The Saratoga station is a little bit closer but it doesn’t run after about 10-11 pm.  Overall a super nice spot. You need to stare here if you want to explore the heart and soul of Brooklyn.

Jasmine and her companion made our trip super easy and stress free. The property itself was located a convenient area surrounded by many shops and restaurants, not too far from times square. Parking was simple and easy as Jasmine provided plenty of options to park on the street and the driveway. Overall, I highly recommend this property for anyone visiting the nyc/nj area.

This apartment was absolutely perfect for us. We were in town for our friends' wedding and the apartment was close enough to walk to it (we didn't but was good to know we could) and it was a close walk to Prospect Park and the restaurants and bars but the street itself was quiet with markets and restaurants right around the corner.  Perfect and stress-free!
This is a STEAL! Such a great location! It actually looks just like the photo. The price was amazing too! Highly recommend!

Not the worst and not the best. The room could use some updates and better cleaning - dirty desk, there was trash and dirt under the bed so you can tell it wasn’t cleaned thoroughly, the soap wasn’t stocked, etc. The best thing about this place is definitely the location and friendliness of the front desk staff. Upon arrival, our hotel room was already opened/unlocked. It was sketchy and we were scared to go in. Notified the host and no response, and the front desk staff didn’t know why it was left opened either. Also, since this is an Airbnb in a hotel, the room isn’t cleaned and restocked every day by the staff. We always double checked our door was shut and locked before we left (especially since we were scared after the first night). However, when we returned after a day of exploring, our front door was left opened/unlocked AGAIN. So so sketchy, but we were safe and none of our belongings were missing.
As expected. Room was warm, suspect the refrigerator as source.

This was a great location and the room was beautiful! Ryan was a very hospitable host and helped us with everything we needed. The only thing that was a bit difficult was finding parking. We had to park a block away both times and the area is a bit scary to walk through at night. Other than that, it was a great stay!!

I booked to stay for a few days. But unfortunately had to leave after a few hours when I got into a huge argument with the host’s mother.   It started when I got to the listing and needed to use the bathroom (listing said the room came with a private bathroom) and I noticed the bathroom was actually across the hall from the room and not connected together. Not a big deal, but when I went to use it, the bathroom had a bunch of stuff in it as if other people were using it which got me a little suspicious that I might of been lied to about the private bathroom.   However when I went to use the toilet I found unflushed urine. I messaged the host and asked for confirmation if I had my own private bathroom or was it shared? Because of the urine in the toilet. He apologized and said it was indeed private and he would speak to the other people in the home about it to make sure it wouldn’t happen again.   I was gonna let the situation go since my stay was only for a few days, until his mother a few hours later woke me up from my nap by banging on my bedroom door. She was extremely hostile and aggressive demanding why I’m posting publicly about my issues with the bathroom, saying I’m Costing her and the listing money, that I’m not allowed to post anything negative. I tried to tell her to calm down and explain that the messages were private between me and her son (not on a public post). She kept yelling at me and Calling me a liar swearing she cleaned the bathroom and that I made the urine thing up (which is ridiculous). Later on tried to say it was bleach (bleach is not bright yellow). I don’t appreciate been disrespected, and yelled at for having a private conversation through the air bnb messages with her son about the bathroom situation. That woman made me feel so uncomfortable and unsafe I grabbed my things and left shortly after.   The host apologized for his mother’s actions which I appreciated ( I never got to meet him since he was at work). But this experience was so traumatic for me I decided to share it on a public post with other potential travelers.

If you're looking for a great place to stay at in Brooklyn for a reasonable price, you won't want to miss out on this opportunity. Renee is a great host that responds quickly and her place is very clean. It is very spacious and if you like to cook, she has everything you need in her kitchen.  The floor is somewhat cold in the mornings so you may want to bring some slippers with you. The apartment heats up during the day, but there's an A/C unit in the living room and the bedroom for use that both work. Plenty of closet and dresser space to use as well. There is free street parking around the neighborhood but it might be hard to find and street cleaners come once a week. Wifi is fast so if you need to work or just Netflix all day inside, the internet speed is reliable and well-equipped to handle all of your needs. In my opinion, I never felt unsafe walking around the neighborhood throughout my time here. However, a single female wandering alone very late at night might disagree, but you can say that anywhere in New York. Also, I can't stress this enough by saying utilize Prospect Park. It is less than a 10 minute walk from the apartment and it is a great place to relax or exercise. I went there almost everyday to unwind by walking, jogging, or biking around the trail that goes around the park. Also, plenty of nice areas to just sit, lay, and relax. If you are booking this place, you should definitely check it out.  There is a train that runs by the building, but I wasn't bothered by the sound during my time studying here while I had noise-cancelling headphones on. If you are very sensitive to noise, this may not be the place for you. Overall, I enjoyed my time spent at Renee's apartment and it was great for my studying. 10/10 and I would definitely book again in the future. Thanks Renee.

This is a total scam. Everything is scared except the rooms. There is no possibility in the house to have a private bathroom and a private kitchen (which we booked). Germaine didn’t think this was an issue and was totally uncommunicative. Also the room was very dirty and smelled of cat pee. This is my first bad review ever. Be careful and do not book this.

Overall it was a good stay here. The apartment was very nice and the building felt safe. The only negatives were that my air conditioner was extremely dirty upon arrival and it actually made me quite sick. Once I realized how dirty it was I cleaned it and almost immediately got better. Also, almost every package I had delivered here was stolen. Otherwise, it was a good experience.

The place was ok, but issues that came up were not properly resolved. When my sister and her pup came to visit, we went to dinner and the pup was left in my room. I know pets are not allowed, he was not staying, just visiting! He was apparently yelping and I said he and my sister were going to leave after we got home, but I started getting threats. We left mid dinner as we were told to drop everything and go take care of it. I had to leave after that instance for a while as I felt emotionally unsafe. Other things: the patio door didn’t lock, the ceiling had leak stains and started leaking after a rain storm, and I could not turn the AC on after they switched over to the heat (which was not accurately mentioned in the post).

Got locked out of airbnb, shortly after checking in. Host was unavailable for 8+ hours, anything could’ve been going on with the property, and host was nowhere to be found. Gave a soft apology when actually replying like there wasn’t 40 missed calls. Asked for a refund for calling a locksmith, host said they would get back. They are clearly in the wrong, or you wouldn’t even consider getting back to me. Good location. People in the area are nosey and all into whatever business you have going on. Second room is like a dungeon, very small, sheets as ceilings, bars as a door, it could be a jail. Property upstairs apparently complained of smoke but was nowhere to be found when we were locked out, so very odd. Not enough linen/towels for the 2 night stay we had, and apartment is in basement so its cool, they have space heaters, but no extra blankets or anything around, not even for the pullout bed. They did have a full kitchen, microwave, and dirty microwave oven that was scared to use. TVs had Netflix and they worked. Didn’t see anything about wifi around also wasn’t in the place that much to care about it. Only one shower, two toilets.

We couldn't get into contact with Josephine upon arrival or hours prior, and found ourselves on a doorstep which didn't indicate her name.  She responded a few hours later, by then we'd found another hotel as it was already late and the neighbourhood felt unsafe.

Do not stay at this AirBnb. It’s dirty with filthy sheets and floors, has mold, and is unsafe. There was a window with its pane fully broken out (with the weather dipping into the 20s!) with just a plastic garbage bag stapled to cover it. Feeling unsafe with the situation, I cancelled my trip and didn’t stay past initial check-in, but the host wouldn’t refund my unused nights. Shout out to the excellent AirBnb customer service reps who righted the wrongs and helped with my refund. Seriously, don’t fall for the price and location. This place is garbage.

We came from the UK and were bit scared to live in a strangers house but we were wrong. Nabil is a great host with excellent communications. We felt like we were at home. The place was clean and worth the money. Once again thank you Nabil for your hospitality.

very clean space and a good bed. there's a big mirror in the room with drawers and a clean bathroom. the bathroom is shared and so is the kitchen. the area is a bit rundown but i would say it wasn't dangerous. pretty great for what you pay! had a safe and comfy stay

Perfect if you’re just looking for a place to stay while exploring new york city. As two girls who were staying here, walking back from the train at night was a little scary but it was only a 3 minute walk. There is only street parking so you may get lucky or not with getting a close spot. And know you are sharing a bathroom and kitchen with other guests! I would suggest staying here if you’re just looking for a place to sleep!

I don't recommend this place to people who are thinking of staying for a long time.  I booked this room for both work and vacation with my husband. This building is a few blocks away from my office, so I am satisfied with the location. The room is new and clean.  However, I asked the landlord to prepare more towels for our long stay before my stay, but we were disappointed that only 2 towels were prepared when we entered the room on the day of check-in. How would my husband and I spend a month with each ONE towel? And there was only one toilet paper. There is NO shampoo. We also cook because we are Japanese. So we  book a room through Airbnb, not a hotel because we could spend my days cooking as usual even during a long stay.  BUT there were no frying pans or any pots, even there is a good kitchen and a knife..lol..  There is no frying pan so if you cook person, you need to bring a frying pan or buy one nearby. Also there is a no cutting board!!  !!!! VERY NOISEY !!!! The walls in the building are very thin, and you can hear the sound of the shower from the person in the upper room or the person in the next room when takes a bath. Of course you can hear the conversation from the next room and the hallway, so you can't sleep well. My husband and I were really exciting to stay in New York in a long time, so we were very disappointed with the amenities in the room which were not nice.  We went to go shopping for towels, toilet papers, cleaning kits, flying pans and pots in a limited amount of time was STRESSFUL!!!  If they don't have one in rooms, they supposed to put a note on it. They DON'T take a responsibility for us.
Great place to stay! Close to the subway. Never felt unsafe. Wonderful experience!

Jay's place was very clean (not a single bug was seen!), had all the usual amenities, and was spacious enough for a NY apartment. The walk to the subway was very short (only a couple blocks) and there were a ton of great food options within walking distance, as well. Our stay was a medium duration (~10 days) so we had to do a load of laundry using the paid laundry machines in the basement which we had no issue with. No complaints about the wi-fi, or noise, although you will be able to hear people walking up and down the stairs. The room stays cool even in the heat thanks to the AC and the trees outside the window providing a natural shade into the room. We definitely enjoyed our stay there! Thanks, Jay!

This flat is in a great position, very close to the Subway station. Be prepared to lose time each day travelling back and forward to Manhattan, but for those wishing to avoid the city, this is a great place to stay. The area looks a bit shady, but we never felt unsafe at all.

really clean and nicely decorated space! though we never met michelle in person, all instructions were clearly communicated over the airbnb app chat. the neighborhood might feel a little scary at night but overall pretty safe and quiet.

The apartment is large for NY standards and conveniently located for bus and subway connections to Manhattan in 15-20 mins. The area looks a bit shady with some broken houses and homeless folks around the subway, but it is safe to walk at any time night and day, and friendly people all around. Food and groceries around the corner, very quiet at night. Michelle has been very helpful, even if we never met in person! The double bed is good, the sofa has seen better days but good enough for a good night sleep. Kitchen has everything needed to prepare snacks, bathroom is in working order. Nice place to stay! Would come again.

The apartment is in a convenient area of Brooklyn in the vicinity of different subway stations. We loved the little cafés all around (Cup of Brooklyn & Chez Alex especially) and different supermarkets were close by as well. The flat is really spacious and has a great bedroom with a comfy bed. It was also quiet at night since the bedroom faces the yard.  We wouldn’t want to use the kitchen really because it had a bit of an unpleasant smell to it, but it was okay for us since we always ate out anyway. The check-in and -out process was super easy and quick. We also felt quite safe in the neighborhood and didn’t have any problems walking around at night.

The accommodation is well located, four blocks from the Nostrand station. If you arrive late, the subway exit can be scary, but people are on their own and they don't bother you at all, they don't even look at anyone; When you walk a block, the feeling is diluted and it is a residential, quiet neighborhood, with very nice blocks (the one with the accommodation is not particularly nice, but it is ok). The apartment is very spacious and comfortable, more normal measurements than those in Manhattan; All three rooms have A/C; The beds in the rooms are very good, although the sofa bed in the living room is rickety and it is necessary to remove the mattress and put it on the floor to sleep well. The kitchen is well equipped. It is, without a doubt, a rental apartment, not the house of someone who rents with their things inside. Separate issue, cleanliness: the bathroom was disgusting, the kitchen was disgusting (sticky furniture, several dead insects inside empty drawers); It was obvious that they had done a superficial facelift, nothing more. When moving the chair 10 cm. To remove the mattress, for example, dust, goop, and beer bottles appeared. Loose. Another thing, towels and sheets: I stayed 13 nights with 4 people and I asked Alex if we were going to have the necessary amount to make a change, he replied that there would be no problem. When the time came, he told me that for long stays, the tenants were responsible for washing the sheets and towels, but that he was going to make an exception. Finally, the host, Alex, was a very unpleasant person; very bad manners, very little willingness to explain how the house works, to offer help, it seemed like he was doing you the favor of staying. I crossed him three times and he always had something to say, accompanied by an almost violent tone and in the most closed English possible. The apartment is very good, the cleaning is not, and the owner is definitely bad

The house is nice, well positioned, functional and with the right space for the 2 of us and our daughter. The host was initially accommodating until we checked in and turned into a different person. We thought everything was going smoothly until we checked in and found that the house wasn’t clean properly, there was quite a lot of dust on all surfaces, on the floor and hair in the shower. We immediately took pictures and sent the owner, we have an apartment that we rent out too so we understand how a clear and prompt communication is necessary to keep things ok with guests. We have spent the first hour in the apartment cleaning to make it comfortable. We have then claimed the cleaning fees back, a whopping $80 for finding dirt on the floor, it was impossible that someone brushed the day before like the owner affirmed, it really is impossible! We have promised to leave a positive review if we could settle that, because we really thought that the house was great but she needed to show a bit of understanding towards us. But she didn’t and she even accused us that we were not fair to her, starting mumbling a number of excuses, she didn’t believe in our pictures etc… During our stay she’s been quick to resolve an issue of a broken bulb, she sent someone as she was away during our stay. The house is well equipped, the only thing we thought was a bit uncomfortable is the sofa bed, but our 18 month old daughter didn’t mind, but for an adult isn’t ideal. On our last day, we packed everything and called a taxi. Locked the front door and left a small bag holding the outside building door open whilst we were loading the taxi (in a bit of a panic moment with my daughter who was crying like crazy as she was feeling sick) and in the rush we accidentally forgot the small bag with important belongings inside like tablet and wallet. You can imagine the desperation when we found out once in JFK, but it was too late to go back so we contacted the owner and she said she would go and check in a couple of hours. We didn’t realise that the bag was left at the building door, until she confirmed. We even thought we may have left it in the taxi! Luckily the bag was still there and the owner started complaining that the building door was left open, we apologise for that and she confirmed that the apartment door was locked correctly. At this stage she accused us to be dangerous guests. As this wasn’t enough, she said she could FedEx our bag back to the UK and on top of the courier charges she was requesting us $110 as ‘her fees’. We have a friend in New York so we offered for him to pick up the bag so she didn’t have the hassle to...

We stayed for 6 nights at this location and overall it was a positive experience.   The flat was clean and tidy throughout. The kitchen and bathroom were well equipped. Good internet and cable TV. Very spacious compared to a lot of places we looked at. After a busy day sightseeing it was great knowing we could come 'home' and relax.  The location was good. Lots of pubs, restaurants, takeaways, and shops nearby. The Strand smokehouse round the corner was very good. It was very easy to get to Manhattan on the subway which has a station 1 minute away. The subway to Coney Island was about 1.5 hours which was fine, and it's all on one line which is good.  The subway was, however, literally right outside the flat, and louder than we expected. The subway noise was the only downside to our stay here and is probably reflected in the price. After we started using earplugs it was fine.  Joanne was a great host. We had to make a very last minute amendment (stayed for an extra two nights due to Hurricane Irma) which, thankfully, Joanne was able to accommodate, and her speed with communications during a stressful time was very much appreciated.

Joanne's place is in a perfect location if you r want  the real New York experience not just a downtown visit. Located in Queens in a perfect location the elevated train is literally right outside or you can take a quick walk to the subway. And yes you can hear the train when it runs by but we really liked it. It reminds you that you are still in NY even when you are in for the evening.  Either way we were only 15 min from Downtown Manhattan.  Our hardest thing to everyday was deciding which incredible place to eat at every morning and evening all within walking distance of Joanne's place.  Now let's talk about the place itself. Joanne was a awesome host always available to answer questions when needed and laid out information to all of the places you might  want to  go on the table for when you arrive.  The futon in the spacious family room made a very comfortable bed.  There also was a equally spacious bedroom and full kitchen with everything you need.  Oh and if you forget to bring something with you don't  panic there is grocery, dollar store and drug store right all right down the street.  It was fun and very safe I cannot think of anything else we could have wanted out our trip. This made my very first trip to NY a great one.

It's hard to beat the convenience to the subway or being near local gems. This location really puts the best of Astoria, and NYC, at your fingertips. Joanne is a responsive and friendly host and accessing the place was a breeze. One thing to note is that the mattress in the main bedroom is a firm futon, so if you need a more traditional mattress, that's something to know. Additionally, the place is right by the subway and it is quite loud if that's not something you're used to. I strugged with it, but popped down to the drug store for earplugs and it was fine. The kitchen and bathroom are well-supplied and clean and it's easy to use.
