This AirBNB is in the perfect location. Just steps away from the train and everything you could need from restaurants to drug stores to little markets right at your fingertips.  The neighborhood felt very safe and petiole in the area were very kind and helpful. If I could give more than 5 stars I would.

Spacious apartment in a good neighborhood, near A and C subway lines to Manhattan (the subway area felt unsafe somehow!). Alex was a great host, he let us check in late (convenient and easy check in). Stayed for two weeks, and I want to point out several issues:  The bed linens and towels were not so clean, Windows could not be opened (fresh air only from the AC, weird smell when entering) The internet connection did not work well (Alex gave us the password for another user which worked best only at the couch in the living room)  Low water pressure in shower  Noticed several cockroaches in the bathroom  Overall, our stay was good. Alex let us do late check out too (paid for 9 hours). This apartment would be great if the above mentioned issues are fixed. However, I would recommend Alex’s apartment for short stays.

Overall our stay was good, however, we did experience a negative incident at the end of our stay so I'm not sure I would recommend this place for the hassle of having to deal with that. In general, Alex's place was very spacious and comfortable. We booked for a 3 week stay while we were working and it's perfect for that. The internet is a little spotty in certain areas of the living room, but is generally fine. The apartment is as pictured and it had lots of light in both the living areas and bedrooms which I really appreciated. (But if you're a light sleeper, bring eye masks). The mattresses are also very firm, so depending on your preferences that might be a good or bad thing. There isn't really any temperature control in the apartment and the windows don't really open so that might be problematic in the warmer months. The apartment is relatively private which is nice, being on the third floor of three story building. The area surrounding the apartment is not exactly unsafe, but it's not exactly safe either (especially around the nearest subway station or at night), but it's generally fine.   The main issue we ran into with our stay happened at check out unfortunately. We left in somewhat of a hurry and there were a few things we didn't get a chance to do prior to leaving (for example, we didn't get a chance to take out the trash and there was a dish and a few cups left in the sink). After we checked out, we received several texts to my personal number from the host in an incredibly nasty and confrontational tone threatening additional cleaning fees. We definitely disagreed with any additional cleaning fees considering we left the apartment in good shape and the hefty cleaning fee we were already paying for, but our main issue was that we thought this communication could have been handled in much more professional way and in a much more professional tone. My friend and I have both stayed at countless AirBnBs and we have never experienced anything like this from a host, especially over a few minor things, and so we were both shocked by this and it definitely soured the whole experience for us.

Don and Evitas cottage is in a great location in rockaway beach, 2 minutes from the boardwalk and its sevices and close to lots of great reataurants and bars. It is also has fast wifi, TVs with cable both upstairs and downstairs, a reasonable kitchen and air conditioning. However, we encountered a few issues including a leak in the ceiling above the stairwell leading downstairs, and a toilet with plumbing that is leas than effective. When we arrived the downstairs bedroom had not been made up for guests, which was a bit of a surprise given the booking specified that we were three adults, and  a substantial fee was charged per additional guest. However, don and evita came by that evening to give us clean sheeta for the downstairs despite the late hour, and offered us a late check out as compensation which we apprciated. We were also there in the middle of a bit of a windstorm which blew down some of the electric wiring around the bungalow. We informed our hosts of this immediately and they advised us that they had notified the police and electric company of the issues. We appreciated their action, but the wires blocked the entrance to the bungalow until we checked out on Sunday at 4 pm, and made for somewhat unsafe conditions.

We stayed with Mark over Christmas (2016) and his place is amazing.  The bed is firm but comfortable, the shower is amazing and the room feels spacious.  Privacy is good, though you can occasionally hear outside noises or Mark's family, it was never enough to disturb us.  From the art, to the plentiful storage, to the amazing shower you can tell that much care was taken to create a pleasant and comfortable place for folks to stay.  Mark was in great communication with us from beginning to end and was even able to accommodate a slightly early check-in, though you should not expect such treatment because his ability to do so is based on whomever is staying with him previous to your arrival.   As for the location, I suppose it depends on your preferences.  If there was any reason what-so-ever why I wouldn't stay with Mark again it would be because of the location.  It's not too far out but it's not close either. Even for many destinations in Brooklyn it's an hour by bus and/or train.  The neighborhood isn't unsafe, but there is quite a bit of trash in the streets and on the sidewalks.  All in all we had a great time in Mark's place and I wouldn't hesitate to stay with him again.  Did I mention how amazing the shower is?

Honestly I have not met anyone as nice to a stranger like Mr Barry. Being my first time in New York, I was worried, scared and knew no one but everything changed when I met him and we started talking. He was nice, helpful and kind enough to even drive me around as I was looking for a permanent apartment and he didn’t rest till when I got a place. I have made a life time friend and I recommend 100% anyone looking for a place to stay in New York.

if you get the chance to book this place pleaseee do it!!! LOCATION IS EVERYTHING as someone whos lived in nyc before this is probably my favorite airbnb of all time. Also Malik is super cool and accommodating to literally anything. The neighborhood is safe, vibrant, new and charming. Don't feel unsafe at all and that's me walking around at like 3 am trying to find a place that has fried chicken still. I had a wonderful stay and I can't thank you enough. Please do book this place.

Mark is a gracious, accommodating and responsive host. The guestroom is private, well-appointed and quiet. As mentioned elsewhere, you are about a 5-10 minute walk from the subway, which will get you to Manhattan in about 20 minutes. You could also just stay in the neighborhood itself, which isn't lacking for restaurants or other things to do. I've stayed in Crown Heights a number of times over the years and have never felt unsafe nor uncomfortable walking around at any time, day or night. Highly recommended!

Stayed here for a few nights with a friend while on a citytrip to New York. Although not in Manhattan, there are several subway stops within walking distance, so it's very easy to get to Manhattan, or anywhere else, in New York relatively quickly. Bedroom was fairly small but clean. The bed is definitely big enough for two people, but the mattress is a little saggy. Bathroom is shared, but we didn't run into Malik once so it felt like a private bathroom, and towels were provided. When we arrived we were surprised by seeing a cat walking through the place, which we weren't told about. As I am slightly allergic to cats, this was a very unpleasant surprise. The cat is very friendly, but it would've been appreciated to have known about it beforehand, as I would've chosen a different place to stay. Also, our bedroom door did not have a lock, so it felt somewhat unsafe to leave valuables in the room during the day when we were gone.

Malik's place is an absolute gem. it's in a great neighborhood, very private and quiet. we found street parking very close easily and everything was as described. this placeis so close to so many restaurants and subway stops. travel between Brooklyn and Manhattan was super easy. everything is spotless. we didn'tsee the host but he was so friendly in messages and we had a great amount of space. he provides hangers for the closet which was so good. shower is fantastic and everything smells really good, towels and the space itself.  we had no issues. I found the bed super comfortable. we slept really well and found the neighborhood to be quieter than people described? we would happily stay here again it was a steal especially for new york in december.

By far the worst Airbnb experience! We booked this apartment for my wife's family of 8 who traveled 16 hours from China to attend our wedding ceremony that weekend. They don't speak English and that's why we preferred to Airbnb so they can be together vs booking 4 separate hotel rooms. My wife and I escorted our family of 8 to the house. First, we confirmed check-in time at 3:00 pm that afternoon. At 3:30 upon arrival, we were told by the manager Tiffany that there was a delay and the house is not yet ready. We completely understand sometimes things happen. So we waited outside in our van in 90-degree weather for almost an hour. At 4:30 when we were finally given the ok to enter but only to drop off our luggage in the living room. Our relatives began to enter, and some wanted to take things out their luggage so we had some luggage open. At this time Tiffany was still finishing up prepping the house, folding towels and bed sheets. she noticed that some didn't take off their shoes. She started yelling and screaming at my family for not taking their shoes off and that there are way too many people in the house. This is absolutely necessary and unprofessional. When I approached her in the attempt to calm her, she was unwilling to listen to me and kept her yelling and screaming. We didn't appreciate how we were treated, how she treated my family, and her unprofessionalism; therefore we asked for Benjamin to come and resolve the situation. Benjamin was a lot more professional and even offered to help my family with their luggage up to the rooms. Great attempt to recover from our negative experience but the damage has been done. Our family members were shocked with how they were treated. I can only imagine future dinner conversations will be reviews of this highly unforgettable experience they had during their trip to the states to attend our wedding. Second, the beds were very uncomfortable after learning about my family's stay. The beds were extremely uncomfortable with beds caving in the center of most beds. My family also noticed that the floors were not clean at all and complained to me that the bottom of their feet turned black simply walking around the house. The complaints also included 1. No shower gel and shampoo provided, 2. floors were sticky and 3. lint and dust around the house. Simply put, this is the worst experience from the start. Tiffany is unprofessional and unwelcoming. Hire someone else who knows how to treat guests right by the first learning how to manage stress. We understand your cleaning crew might have arrived late, or the last guest didn't check out on time that might have attributed to your explosive reaction when your next party arrives with 10 people (8 families whose staying there and my wife and I (we were only escorting them) and 9 pieces of luggage. Thanks...

It was an unpleasant experience.First, our checkin time was supposed at 3pm, and we waited another 40mins outside the house for the check in. Second, I have difficulties communicating with Tiffany. She shouted at my families even after I told her they didn't speak English. I think that was really rude and made my family really uncomfortable. Last, cleanness, floors are sticky and carpet with lots of hair.

Mark’s ground floor guest room is nearly as good as a full apartment if you cook using only a microwave. It has a small refrigerator and all necessities for making instant coffee. If you require coffee first thing, you might check to make sure both regular and decaf are in the drawer, so if your preference is missing you can pick some up at the local grocer.   Mark’s house is located within walking distance of The Brooklyn Museum and Prospect Park, both great to see if you have the time.   We highly recommend calling to arrange for taxis at least an hour before you need one, AND allow twice as much time for your trip if you’re going to Manhattan. Traffic on both sides of the East River is horrendous, especially on the Manhattan side. This will save you some stress, especially if you’re not used to big cities.   I was very impressed with this guest room space. The room itself is huge and has all the beautiful features of the 19th century brownstone. The bathroom is very modern and a good size. Towels are huge, soft and absorbent. Bed is VERY comfortable.   We had a lot of luggage and Mark was very accommodating by letting us drop off our luggage as soon as previous guests had departed. He is a very pleasant and personable young man.   All in all a happy one night experience after a nearly 8 week vacation in Europe. We highly recommend.

This is a hidden gem in Brooklyn, and the price is a steal. The neighborhood is beautiful, and the place is spacious, clean, and a accommodating. I absolutely loved this stay. Mark is quick to answer any questions, and was very generous as a host. 20/10 would stay again.

My group and I were so lucky to have found Benjamin's place at the very last minute. We had initially booked with another Airbnb in the area, but unfortunately the Airbnb that we booked was not the place that was advertised on the listing - a common "bait and switch" situation. After complaining to the host and Airbnb about the fraud listing, they cancelled our reservation and left us stranded. Fortunately enough, we came across Benjamin's listing and his place was close by. We contacted Tiffany and she worked with us to not only book the Airbnb but also gave us a discount willingly after finding out what happened to us! She was so helpful and worked out the discount with Airbnb directly to get us reserved ASAP. When we got to Benjamin's place, it was sparkling clean and the space was many times better than what we originally booked! After checkout, Benjamin and Tiffany reached out to make sure we received the discount. I am so grateful to have found such responsible and accommodating hosts that were willing to help our group at a stressful time. Would definitely book with them again if I get the chance. They are such good people with a beautiful place that save us from what could have been a horrible night!

This was an awesome, first Airbnb experience. Don't hesitate to book! Perfect check-in instructions. All areas super clean, neat, and organized. Surprise refreshments in the room. Shelf in room stocked with all the essential toiletries (no stress if you forget something).  My space in kitchen clearly labeled. Had all the essentials for cooking. No waiting for the bathroom. Zero noise issues. Quiet neighborhood. Stores nearby. Host was virtually invisible, but always accessible. Felt totally at home the whole time. Never felt like I was in someone else's place. I plan to stay here again this month.
The checkin/out process is very convenient and stress free. I would recommend this place to anyone staying in the bronx.

Still the best place to be in nyc hands down, Barry is a great host and his place is just breath taking and the price is a steal of a deal. Would definitely rebooked and refer to my friends and family.

We were two families with two children each an have spent a week in Chelsea's apartment. There was a lot of room available for all of us , and also a good privacy as the flat has multiple bedrooms and bathrooms in different floors.  I would say everything we needed was there for a very comfortable stay.  The kitchen was incredibly well equipped although we have used only for our  breakfast. The location is 3 blocks from the main subway  lines and the  shopping area on 125th. Dowtown is no more than 20 minutes travel by metro and half an hour bus. Also some restaurants in the nearby including our good friend Babbalucci where you can eat a fantastic pizza. The neighbourhood is a coloured experience of Harlem humanity , nothing dangerous but to keep at distance particularly at night.  All in all we had a great stay in this cozy flat that I would definitely recommend.

We enjoyed a 3 night stay at Chelsea's beautiful home earlier this month.  We stayed with our two teenage children and found the home to not only be  warm and welcoming but it also provided us with plenty of room to spread out and relax.  From the two tastefully  decorated living areas to the amazingly quiet, shady backyard patio We had many areas for hanging out and relaxing.  Chelsea's place has all the comforts of a "lived in" home with ample areas (such as empty drawer, refrigerator and bathroom cabinet space) to make the space your own during your stay.  We found that Chelsea thought of everything one could need while staying in a guest house and provided just those things... placing them exactly where you would expect. As far as location, the home is conveniently close to a subway station  a Whole Foods, a Starbucks and many locally owned restaurants. We definitely enjoyed our stay and would return to this home when we visit NYC again!!

Very disappointing... Communicating with the hosts was difficult, the first night I was not able to reach anyone before check-in and had to stay somewhere else. The following night the keys I was given did not work on the door and after calling the hosts several times I had to call and pay a locksmith to let me into the building. Noel was extremely rude to me at both check-in and after the locksmith ordeal and made me feel unsafe staying there, so I did not. Afterwards I received many antagonizing texts from him making up statements about my stay and the host would not process a refund for my stay so I had to cancel the charge via my credit card company. Yes the pictures look cool, but I do NOT recommend staying here at all. Absolutely disrespectful hosts that made my trip to Brooklynn a nightmare.

Marie-line is very kind and helpful. The room is a steal for the price they offer. Top of the line bathroom with newly tiled shower. Comfortable bed with very nice lighting all around room. Also sink and fridge are very nice. This room is its own apartment because of these features

Michelle's place is the perfect Harlem respite, 4 blocks from the 1,2,3 trains and a block from  5th Avenue.  The bedroom and bathroom were SPOTLESS, the bed was comfy and all other amenities were sufficient.  I did not spend much time in her available common areas - the kitchen and the living room where there's a working TV.  Plus its reasonably priced (at least when I stayed it was) because she doesn't rob you blind with exorbitant cleaning fees.  I hope to return the next time she's available and I'm visiting my grand girls who live nearby.

Nothing but great things to say about Michelle and her beautiful Central Harlem Home. She was very communicative about covid safety and all the protocols that she and the building were taking to be safe. After we had that situated, she was very sweet and accommodating to my travel plans. The house was separated into a guest wing so you have a lot of privacy and a lock for your door and a key to lock it when leaving. Bedroom and Bathroom were very clean, and my favorite part was having my own A/C so I was able to get some great sleep during the summer months. She works most of the day and a hard worker at that so she minds her own business and she created a very trustworthy space for me to feel safe during my stay. I did 4 stars on location because it's not the safest of safe areas, not bad by any means but being aware about walking at night. Again, nothing incredibly unsafe, just be aware. The building itself is very high quality and across the street from a cute coffee shop for your morning coffee. Right off the 125 for the 1,2, and 3 so very convenient for traveling downtown by subway. I would definitely stay with Michelle again. She's great.
Gabriel's place and location is good. To the subway station for 5 min. I didn't feel danger. He is great host, very kind,helpful.

This gem is a steal!  Wonderful appointments give it an artsy feel, with fun details igniting the imagination. Our only regret was not having budgeted any time to hang out in our weekend abode, working through the creative opportunities planted there for us. Thank you, Gabe — you’ve made a really special place.

We very much enjoyed our stay in Marie-Line's apt. It was very cozy and comfortable for 2 people and so easily accessible for so many things. We only ate breakfast there so did not miss having a stove. It was nice and quiet and very private. We walked back and forth to our son's home, even at night, about .7 of a mile away and never felt unsafe. I would definitely recommend a stay here if you are planning to be in the area.

Perfect 10 day stay. The apartment is ideally located near the main metro lines. Georges' kindness and responsiveness made things even more pleasant because my questions were answered very quickly. The apartment is a 10-minute walk from Times Square and the main buildings are also easily accessible on foot, as well as Central Park.  Rather quiet area but it's still NY, it's the city that never sleeps so be careful of light sleepers.  Traveling alone, I never felt in danger in the neighborhood so no problem, it's safe.  A nice little bonus: Georges knows a little French. I highly recommend.

This was my second NY Airbnb experience and I really enjoyed it more than my first! This is a big beautiful space especially by NY standards, it's on a very quiet lovely street right near the park and subway so it was never a problem getting anywhere if you needed. I had the pleasure of meeting Ephraim and his beautiful dog and he was truly a great host making sure everything was okay and offering suggestions for my Birthday! The place is totally secured with your own unique code for entrance (which I loved). I've been to NY countless times so I really felt right at home and comfortable in Harlem, especially with his place offering so much natural lightning and snacks. The only thing is, if you're afraid of stairs or have a problem going up them then maybe you should check out one of his other listings, because the place is on the very top floor which I enjoyed, because it truly gave you that penthouse privacy feel. Thanks Ephraim, I will definitely be back!

We had a great time at Ephraim's place. Ephraim gave us a lot of tips about what to do in NYC. While we were there he always responded within minutes if we had any questions. The apartment was very clean. Overall we had an amazing stress free New York experience. Will definitely go back here next time!

I just spent six weeks at Noelky's beautiful apartment and already miss my little hideaway. It is located on the loveliest block of Crown Heights, lush with trees and front gardens overflowing with hydrangea. The apartment itself is full of plants and charm. I had just come off a stressful flight from Argentina, in order to get vaccinated, and I felt a wave of calm when I walked into the large, sweet bedroom. And the back garden! I recommend visiting in May, when the peonies are in bloom.   I loved cooking in the very well equipped kitchen. I've stayed in a lot of airbnbs, but I've never found such an array of spices and (quality) staples like in Noelky's place. It was a joy to cook there, especially while looking out at the garden.   Noelky and Dan are very welcoming, kind, and helpful with anything you might need. The street is also very peaceful and quiet. It is a perfect base for exploring New York. My one word of advice would be for people who will be working there and staying inside a lot. Just be aware that you are living in the lower level of a house, so you will hear noise from upstairs.
Tamika's place is nice, cozy and clean. Only a 2 minute walk to public transportation, drug and grocery stores. Her family is an added bonus. Very sweet and helped me with anything I needed.

At first glance, this apartment is a hidden gem! It's in a great location and the pictures were exactly what I was looking for - sleek, modern and a notch above the rest.   The reality, however, was different furniture with significant wear and tear, a very dark apartment and major issues with cockroaches, mice, and ants.   The host was not quick to attend, putting me and my dog into a dangerous and unhealthy situation that led to me canceling my stay prematurely. I would not recommend staying here. ​

The place is good clean and small room  mostly good for student or long stay not recommended for businessman the reason businessman want much relax after a lot stress there is no open space or any elite class chair or relax sofa but it is budget accommodation host response is good laundry is very nice I recommend for student long stay people.

Sol was amazingly responsive and helped when we had issues finding/using lock box. Bushwick is a bit of a spotty neighborhood - industrial and can feel unsafe at night but that's no fault of Sol's.  Place is great and really close to cool spots in Bushwick. Overall, everyone was comfortable and happy.
Yahaira and her family are very friendly, always very good communication. But the house smelled of food at night, the smell was strong and unpleasant in the room and the room had cockroaches.

The appartment is big enough to accomodate 4 people. We had 2 rooms with 2 double beds. Large living room with lots of room to have breakfast all together at the same table. A kitchen fully furnished, bathroom with towels and everything you should expect from a hotel. The place is nicely decorated, clean, and there are many lights in different places, so you can create a cozy atmosphere and feel like being home. Lawrence is also a very kind and caring person. He's very helpful so you don't have to worry about details during your stay in NYC. The neighborhood is calm, you won't be scared about coming home late at night. There are restaurants, coffe shops and groceries all around. You can easily get there by feet, and also transportation is not far. Visit the original Williamsburg. It's a 15 minutes walk but it's worth all the shopping, restaurants and coffe shops you need. You can also visit the artists area that is very close. Beautiful graffitis decorate the buildings walls, music gear shops, live bars, vintage clothing, tattoo studios, and hand crafted items shops

This was a good choice and I recommend it. It's really, really clean, and so even though it's a basement it doesn't feel creepy. The location is great. It was very quiet but still close to so much. We had tons of options within a 4-5 block radius. Also, Lawrence was more than happy to offer us suggestions. The check-in was very easy and smooth and Lawrence was immediately responsive to all our requests. He had also stocked the kitchen with bottled water and beer for us, which I thought was so nice! He was very concerned that we have a good stay. The only couple of things I might say that I wish were different were that one, we couldn't control the heat ourselves and it made climate control a little challenging sometimes (we had to text or call Lawrence to change it for us), and two, the internet was kind of spotty (probably normal for a basement apartment). But neither of things were major issues and I would definitely stay there again. Thank you Lawrence for being such a lovely host!

Described correctly. The neighborhood is nice and right near a really lovely long walking/running path on the Hudson.  I never felt unsafe, though probably wouldn't walk alone at night. The room is clean and well equip with everything you would need- coffee maker, fridge, microwave. The bathroom is shared, though I didn't see anyone else using it. The building itself is clearly old and uncleaned, but I suppose that is what you get with a NY apt building. Overall, great spot for students/young adults travelling to NY. The best part was a very comfortable bed! Unexpected in any Airbnb. The owner, Yahaira, was great too and very responsive. Overall, would definitely recommend.

Excellent communication. Let me check-in very early. Comfortable bed, clean space, but the cost was a little high. I’ve stayed at comparable AirBnb’s in the same area for significantly cheaper. Her hospitality was wonderful though and she was quick to respond. She helped relieve the stress of finding a place to stay last minute and you can’t put a price on that. If cheaper, I’d stay again.
Anna responds very quickly and is a considerate, professional hostess. Both location and parking were very convenient to my schedule and made for a stress-free visit.

The overall experience was lovely.  The check in was easy... The condo is part of the Wyndham Club so it is operated like a hotel.   Room/condo was pretty big by NYC standard for the price.   I was upgraded to a 2bedroom instead of the 1 bed that I had booked...Everything was neat and clean and orderly.  I didn't use the gym but it is great to know that there is one...   Having grocery/drug/coffee shops and restaurants all within a 2/3 block radius is awesome.   If I had to suggest a change, I would recommend a bit of flexibility with the 10am check out time.   The lobby was packed with luggage and tons of people checking out.  The elevator couldn't handle the load so it took 15 min before an elevator arrived on the 25th floor with space for me and 1 medium roller bag..  Despite that, the stay was lovely and I would highly recommend this condo.

Laura and family are really lovely people, and I enjoyed getting to know them during my monthlong stay.   That said, there are some aspects of this Airbnb that I think it’s important for other guests to be aware of. The most important is that there are up to 5 residents (not including Airbnb guests) in this small 3 bedroom apartment. One of the residents is a two year old child. The entrance and main room is his play area, directly adjacent to the bedroom. The toddler frequently stays up past 11pm. There is also a cat.   Because of the number of inhabitants, it can be very loud and fairly messy. The guest room shares a wall with another bedroom that frequently has a loud television playing past midnight. It smelled of smoke fairly often. The guest bathroom is shared with another bedroom, and that bathroom was often messy and unpleasant. Due to the frequent usage of the kitchen and volume of dishes, it would be very difficult to cook if you wanted to do so. There isn’t really a place outside the bedroom to eat a meal.   I hesitated to write a somewhat negative review, because the hosts are really lovely people. And when I raised issues (a smoke alarm beeped every minute outside my room for the first couple days), they tried their best to address them. But I’m not someone who has high standards for accommodations - and this really pushed my limits.   I definitely think this is a fine option for a place to crash for a night or two, and perhaps more - I just wish that the listing had been more explicit about the child, cat, kitchen situation, etc.

This home is great for families - the apartment is well-equipped with toys and books (even guidebooks for getting around NYC so you don't have to bring your own), linens, and all the necessities (except a coffee maker). Our only complaints were that there was no access to local tv (we like to keep up with news) and the *overwhelming* odor of mothballs in the entire apartment. Days after leaving, friends can still smell it on us (and we've washed all of our clothes). I wouldn't say it ruined our stay, but it made coming back to the apartment each night a little unpleasant. The location is EXCELLENT. We walked to a Central Park and the subway easily with a 7yo and many shops and restaurants are nearby.

Michelle’s place was amazing. We got there a little early and she was just about to leave so we did get a chance to meet her . She was really sweet.  The shower was the best. The automatic window shade was really cool. It’s close to a few restaurants and bars .And not far from the subway. Loved this place we would definitely stay here again.

Michelle’s place is very stylish! Having two full bathrooms, both with rainfall shower heads felt very luxe! Easy check in and out. Would stay again. Only thing to note: the bed in the lofted area sits flush against the railing above the rest of the apartment (not pictured) and the railing is wide and open; someone who moves a lot in their sleep may feel uncomfortable/scared they could fall out while sleeping.

I can't say enough about Viki and her hospitality. As a mom of two kids, traveling is a stressful endeavor. Viki went above and beyond to accommodate us and make sure our kids were happy and taken care of.  The place was beautiful and clean. I've been to a few places and this is by far my favorite. Neighborhood was perfect as well. Close to everything.  I seriously could go on and on but it would be redundant to all the other reviews. Thanks again Viki!!!!

Sweet, clean and very stylish little apartment/room, very friendly and warm host! Easy access to Manhattan & Co. Some sketchy-appealing people around the street but turned out everyone was super friendly! Would definitely recommend staying at Gon’s.

We had a wonderful week at Gretchen's. We arrived around 11 p.m. and our host warmly welcomed us. Throughout our stay she made herself available and at the same time very discreet. She always responded. His house is consistent with the photos and the premises were clean. We were immersed in New York life and the neighborhood is authentic. We appreciated the fact that she lived above us because it provided added security and especially when we needed her, it was easy to contact her. Thank you for allowing us to stay at your place until 7 p.m. when the rental ended at 11 a.m. This allowed us to take a shower before leaving at 8 p.m. because our flight was at 11 p.m. We will come back and definitely not change. See you soon

The house is just as the photos show, only one bathroom but with organization we were 8 people (3 children) comfortably also using the bed in the living room. The house is close to several subway stations and stores where we can shop, we went back and forth to Manhattan by train or bus and without a problem, although it takes time sometimes depending on where you go, almost an hour, but the savings compared to accommodation in Manhattan are very large. The area is safe and quiet, at night the feeling is more insecure but we never had a problem. Gretchen was always super attentive and great with everything we asked for, she even helped us on the day of departure by storing our suitcases for a while.

The accommodation is very well located, with many venues, bars and shops next door, and several Metro stops very close. The neighborhood is on the outskirts but it doesn't take long to get to the center of Manhattan, and we didn't feel in danger at any time (as some may think). The apartment is perfect for young couples or solo travelers. An important point is that the sink is private. The communication with Sara was perfect, although we couldn't see each other, and her roommate only a couple of times, so it's like having the apartment to yourself and it's very comfortable. We recommend it!

This was a really great apartment for our family of two adults and two teenagers.  A gorgeous shady street and a really pleasant walk to a subway stop.  Lots of store and restaurants in the area as well.  AC worked well also and we had fans in each bedroom.

Not having WiFi was a problem. The beds wrapped in thick plastic are noisy and cause sweating... we didn't even want to move because we couldn't hear the platform... the noise was excessive... the neighborhood is not noisy but there is a clock in the living room that started playing music at 6 and that was very unpleasant...

I hate giving negative reviews, especially when the host was really nice.  But, these are the things you should know, good and bad.  I’ll start with the good.  1. The host is super nice.  She communicates well.  She tried to help but there wasn’t much she could do (I’ll explain later). 2. For the price, if you can overlook the bad, it’s very reasonable. 3. the water pressure in the shower is amazing.  Now the bad.  1. I arrived at 1:00am.  The bed was wet.  Yup, wet bed.  Blanket, bed sheet, pillow, all wet.  Not soaking wet, but wetter than just damp.  It was gross beyond belief.  Its not entirely the hosts fault.  Their cleaning service bailed on them and the person they got to clean up did a terrible job.  Didn’t bother drying anything.    2. Went to shower, and the towels were also wet.  I thought I was going to kill someone.  I went to use the bathroom and there was toilet cleaner on the toilet seat, and I sat in it.  So I took a second shower...having to use the wet towel.  3.  The smell throughout the apartment was disgusting.  I finally discovered it came from the fridge.  Again, not the hosts fault, but nonetheless, the entire place smelled like shit.  Like there was a homeless guy covered in feces staying in the apartment.  Again, the cleaning service didn’t bother cleaning the fridge and throwing out the dead carcass stashed away in the fridge.  4. 5 storeys to get to the apartment.  That’s 5 floors that you have to walk up, because there is not elevator.  I don’t think you understand how brutal that is.  Every time you come back to the apartment, you have to climb 5 painful floors.  When you arrive with your bags/luggage, 5 storeys, haha, it was so shite.  That’s the one thing that the host, nor the cleaning service can fix for next time.    Again, most of the shit that went wrong is not the doing of the host, but it made for a god awful trip for me.  Hopefully she gets a MUCH better cleaning service to clean the place.

Good place to stay. About an hour away from Manhattan by metro.  If flying in from JFK, I would recommend taking an Uber or Lyft vs. Public transportation as you will get there faster and a lot less headaches. The metro station is about a 15 minute walk. The metro area looks a little sketchy at night but we were fine.

The stay was great! I traveled and stayed here with a few friends that didn’t like certain elements of the Airbnb, but I’m from NY and know what comes with living in an apartment. Only negative thing I have to say is that while we were staying there, the heat came on at night some nights and the pipes would make this banging noise constantly that scared us cause we weren’t expecting it lol otherwise this was an awesome place to stay. Good location, good area, spacious apartment.

I stayed at Eric’s with my family and it was a great stay. Eric was super helpful with his suggestions and very reachable. All directions regarding the apartment and suggestions for the neighborhood were helpful and accurate -good list of suggested restaurants-.   The apartment is very charming, comfortable and clean. It’s actually better than what it looks in the pictures. Perfect for 4 or less people.   The neighborhood is OK. Not the nicest part of Brooklyn, we we never felt unsafe. It works well if you don’t mind a 30/40 mins Metro ride to Manhattan.

The apartment is simply amazing, just like the area. Perfekt if you wanna relax after a stressful day of sightseeing in manhattan.   Lisa is an amazing host. So friendly and warm. We hung out almost every night.  Highly recommended airbnb!

Amazing Stay.. right next to the bridge . . the host lisa left recommendations on restaurants and other things near by which was great. Nice cozy apartment and the style she uses is cool might steal some of her looks because she gave me plenty of ideas on how to style my house. lol love it. and would recommend this place to anyone staying in bk.

Shani and Emily’s place was the perfect spot for my friend and I to stay over night after a King Princess concert in Brooklyn. The room itself was lovely as was the rest of the apartment although we stayed in our room or ventured out into the city for most of the trip. Communication and check in was a breeze. Price feels very reasonable in comparison to other Brooklyn Airbnb’s where you share the apartment with a billion people and still pay more than 100 a night (no shade). We only met Shani in person but felt warmth and comfort in the entire space, especially with little Beans (z?) close by. Looking forward to another stay!

Awesome place and host. Definitely bigger than it looks in pictures. Great proximity to awesome food and convenience of multiple drug stores nearby.  Highly recommend and good chance we stay here again in the future when visiting friends for weekend or extended period!

We had a really nice stay at Simone's Airbnb.  The apartment is as shown in the pictures, so what you see is what you get. It's simple but cozy. Before you book this Airbnb you should know that there are quite a few homeless people in the neighborhood but they never talked to us and we never felt uncomfortable around them. Simone was there for the Check-In and the Check-Out and we could even bring our luggage before the Check-In. Simone made sure that we had everything we needed and answered quickly to our requests. She really is a superhost!
Alyssa's place and helpfulness exceeded expectations.  She helped to insure that the precious moments of my family vacation were precious and not stress-filled.  I can't recommend enough.  Cheers.

We spent a full week in Simone's apartment and had a good time there. The apartment has a separate entry,so you have enough privacy throughout your stay. Room and bathroom are pretty small but have everything you need. The area is well connected to Midtown and Downtown via the subway line 6 (5 min by foot). At night, a few homeless people are in the neighborhood, but not worse than in other parts of the city...All in all a good experience,especially with Simone being very helpful.

We had a wonderful stay at Simone's. She was there to greet us and give us the key to the place, always responsive to any messages exchanged. The room was clean and tidy, as described. The bathroom was clean too. Simone kept in touch making sure we had everything we needed and acted quickly upon a minor request. Unfortunately we had to cut our trip short, but we managed to fully enjoy the accommodation. We did not find the neighborhood/street unsafe, and the building was generally very quiet so we enjoyed our nights there too.  The subway is easy to use with 2 stops within 10' walk approx. Great value for money for NYC.

This was by far my best airbnb traveling experience....and I slept on a couch! Yes, It is that good. Alex's place is pristinely clean, elegantly warm and entirely welcoming.  It is a dreamy cozy art studio-like space where one gets the feeling that stress is simply not allowed beyond the doorway--only peace and beauty. Alex herself is a gem of a person-open, thoughtful, and kind--a true representative of the best an Airbnb experience can offer.  Thank you Alex.  I will definitely be back. :-)

Nice flat, smaller than it looks like in the pics but we didn't mind. It is in Manhattan and everything is easily reachable, metro st. is close, everybody is really nice and helpful, especially Zoraida. Super clean. Always take the A or B train when going home because if you go by C or D you exit in a rather scary part.

Great place! I've stayed at a bunch of air bnb locations and this was my favorite one in NY so far. Location was a very nice quiet block and the room was tidy. Cleaning staff was friendly and the snacks were my appreciated. I Would definitely stay again. One review says that the area was "scary" but I disagree. The street was very pleasant and their were a few families bbqing in front of their house. Super close to JZG trains.

The house is just as described. Kev welcomed us and was immediately available to redo the bed that did not seem intact to us. The neighborhood at first sight may be suspicious but in the end everything was quiet and you are also quiet in returning late at night. The room was just as described, very comfortable bed and the fridge was very useful. Excellent breakfast. There is everything you need for a good stay. Distance from Manhattan around 25 minutes and subway behind the building.  Thank you!

We were delighted with this nice quiet apartment. Quiet neighborhood in The Bronx. Twenty years ago you probably would not have stayed at this place. But in 2017, it's a great place as a base to visit NYC. We didn't feel unsafe at all. Even not in nighttime when we returned with the subway en walked from the neaerest station back to Rosalia's place. Sometimes we were not sure to walk in witch direction, but the people on the street were very helpful, also in nighttime!! We did not feel ay aggression on the street.  Rosalia is hospitable and she has organised her apartment very well and she keeps it very clean. She lives herselve on the ground floor. She is not just a hostess on the day of arrival, but she stays accessible to her guests all week, including via Whatsapp. For example, you can ask her something, for example an adapter for charging the Iphone. We could borrow that from her. A great deal for anyone who does not want to stay in too expensive and too busy in Manhattan, but who wants to have NYC nearby.

Room was a little hot like the other reviews mentioned. The location is pretty convenient, about a 5 minute walk from the subway, although the area is a little sketchy at night. Bed was comfortable although pillows were very thin.

Wonderful located Airbnb. The price was a steal for the location, and the four of us were able to comfortably stay in the studio. The key situation was a little tricky and we had some trouble opening and locking the apartment, but everything else was fine.

Location and I  can’t stress this enough this place has a great location, the train is only a minute walking and it can take you anywhere in the city. The check in was very easy exactly how it was explained in the email that the Wright’s send before the trip, the room was very clean. The Wright’s were very responsive two times I called them.  Over all I highly recommend this place, id definitely stay here again if I went back to New York

Rosalia’s place is amazing. It is very clean and well maintained. It is located very close to a direct subway to Manhattan, which was very nice. She is a wonderful host and this is a very good deal for the price. The only issue we had was walking back to the apartment at night. Be advised that it is located in a somewhat gritty area and we were not occustomed to that. We always tried to come back at a decent hour to avoid incident, but still were yelled at a few times and witnessed a drug deal right down the street. With that being said, we felt very safe inside the apartment, just maybe not outside at night.

Absolutely marvelous, 	heartfelt, friendly and helpful host. Good advise how to move in the city and where to go. Felt more like friends than lodgers. When we were leaving She let us leave our gear deposit to her before evening flight. Flat was clean and as in pictures, and kitchen equipped with all possible items. To the city by metro some 25min, buses we didn't use, stops thou were close (2-5min). Near was shops and restaurants (2-5min), if need to get food or drink. Or haircut. In the house there is a nice, friendly, bit shy dog. No need to be afraid of, truly.  Aivan mahtava, sydämellinen, ystävällinen ja avulias emäntä. Antoi hyvät neuvot liikkumiseen ja missä kannattaa vierailla yms. Tunsimme ennemmin olevamme ystäviä, kuin vuokralaisia. Poistuessamme saimme jättää matkatavarat hänen luokseen säilytykseen ennen iltalentoa. Asunto on siisti ja kuvausta vastaava, sekä keittiö varusteltu kaikkella mahdollisella. Etäisyys keskustaan on metrolla n. 25min, bussia emme käyttäneet, pysäkkejä oli kuitenkin lähellä (2-5min). Lähistöltä löytyy myös kaupat ja ravintolat (2-5min), jos tarvetta esim. einesten tai juomien hankintaan. Tai parturia. Talossa asuu koira joka on todella kiltti ja ystävällinen, hiukan arka. Ei tarvetta pelkoon, todellakaan.

Everything was wonderful! Bedrooms and shared bathrooms were very clean and comfortable; There were small snacks available in the common room and you could grab a coffee at any time. Very good value for money for New York and more spacious than other rooms/apartments we stayed in. The area is a bit "shady" at night - my sister and I didn't feel unsafe, but we probably wouldn't have walked there alone in the dark. But the subway is not far. Communication worked flawlessly and we were able to store our suitcases on the day we moved out without any problems. We'd love to come back!

We had an incredible stay. Rosalia's place was beautiful. It was really nice to have a parking spot included in New York, this saved us much stress. Rosalia also was so sweet and greeted us when we arrived and gave us tips about public transportation. Highly recommend!

The house is even better than the photos show, very clean, it is also very comfortable and large for a couple. Both the bedroom, the living room and the kitchen are fully equipped to be able to live in the apartment. As for Rosalia and her family, spectacular, very hospitable, always willing to help you and make your stay better (but with enough space) with the desire to make you feel at home, which they do. As for the phenomenal location, in 20 minutes by public transportation you are in the center of Manhattan. Perhaps the only thing that could be an inconvenience is if you arrive at night in the neighborhood, because there is usually no one on the street and you can feel somewhat insecure if you are not used to it. Nothing has happened to us and to be calmer we solved it by taking an Uber from 125 which for 9 dollars is home and safe.

Location is very convenient (30 min from manhattan) with tube around the block and shops close to the house.  What made our stay a bit unpleasant was the noise from the engines ( one in the backyard outside and one in the house) of the air conditioning that in a very hot week were operating almost 24/7. and woke us up few times during the night.  The temperature was very cold for our taste(like everywhere in NY) but the host provide us a way to block the flow at least in our room. The house and the neighbourhood are very nice and so are the hosts, always available for all request.
Great place to stay. Nice 1 bedroom apartment. We will stay here again when we come back. Neighborhood is a little sketchy. We used Uber instead of the subway to get around no problem.

This appartment has some good things and some other really bad. I will explain all pros and cons we found. Localitation: it's far from Manhattan, like 40' by subway, but the station is just 300 m away from the house. So for the price is ok. During night it can be a little dangerous, but nothing use to happens. Some times the subway doesnt work (usually happens in NYC) so you should take an Uber for around 20 $. Room: the bed is comfotable and we fit on it (we wasn't sure), and it's probide with a fridge, an iron and a table. It's not very warm, spetially during night, when the  heating is off.   Noise: our room had a window to an exterior patio, so noise wasn't important. But you could here everything from inside the flat. Steps on the upstairs, people talking, the bathroom,...  Bathroom: here is where we had the problem. The bathroom was very dirty. I know we are 6 people sharing 2 restrooms and it can't be perect, but it's required some daily cleaning to keep it clean. It smeels orine, there was hair everywhere, the bath plate wan't clean,....  We complain about it and Kevin tried to "fix it" but the cleaning wasn't enought. Kitchen: the appartment owns a coffe machine and a toaster, so is it possible to have breakfast (or even dinner) at home. We had a problem because we bought some food and other people from the appartment took it, so i reccomend to keep it on the room. So, to conclude, it can be a good opcion for saving money if you don't mind the noise or the dirtiness. But if you do, maybe is not the best. Is a nice appartment only needs maintenance and a better insonorization from the inside..

Great stay with my daughter. As described, the metro is a 5-minute walk away. A grocery store at the entrance to the metro and other small shops nearby. Pleasant neighborhood. Very comfortable bed which is very important after a day of walking. The shared bathroom was always clean as was the room when we arrived. No feeling of insecurity in the neighborhood. And it's a very good choice of neighborhood to see New York differently. Very responsive and friendly host. We recommend!

Shanam is a delight. Having just moved to New York and knowing nothing about the city, I had a million questions and problems, and she was always right there to help. Needless to say going ABOVE and BEYOND the typical host duties. As far as basics are concerned, she was amazing at keeping everything clean and working. She also has a wonderful attention to the "home" factor of an apartment. From fresh flowers on the counter to home cooked meals and handmade art on the walls, this place could not have been more of a comfort for me.   Above all, Shanam herself expressed her value in communication right from the start. Communication, and respect. As a guest, this is also a comfort that comes with knowing that any problem will always be spoken directly, and any issue can and will be resolved. It really leads to a happy and stress free day to day.   Oh, and the apartment is lovely! Aside from being homey, the rooms are HUGE and literally feel like a house to me rather than an apartment in the city. The windows are giant and there's a ton of storage. Neighbors are mega quiet and the doormen always say hello!  I'll be sad to leave this place behind me!

Our stay went very, very well. Charles is very accommodating and available when needed or even for advice.  Being in Harlem is really an advantage: you are 20 minutes from the center of NY, very close to the north of Central Park... if you are a little "afraid" of this neighborhood, you can go there without problem, there were 2 of us girls coming and going at all hours and we always felt at ease (like in the rest of New York).  A “New York-style” life experience, yes, it’s true!

Stay was okay, but the room wasn't clean at all. There were leftover chocolate packs, chips, napkins in the drawers, kitchen was filled with uncleaned dishes. The host had an issue with AirBNB for which her payment was delayed, and she came to my door and started talking without knocking that I may have to leave next day if AirBNB doesn't pay her out!! I was shocked. She even suggested me to claim a refund from AirBNB so that she can get her paid and I get refund to rip-off AirBNB. Very shady. She also doesn't respect privacy. She came to my room several times in absence of me. Corridors were filled with stuffs and not organized. The whole house was a mess.   Good thing is she is soft spoken, smiles when talk!!! Location is very quiet. Finding parking is hard as there are so many driveways on the road. Food places are nearby.

Craig has a fantastic home and is a perfect host! My parents enjoyed their stay in New York - thanks to Craig it became memorable visit. Back in Berlin, we are all feeling New York today with regard to the terrible attack in Lower Manhattan.
Good stay for a great price and nice location. Some minor cleanliness issues, and the front door did not lock which made me feel a bit unsafe.

Kerry was a great host, super friendly and helped me out as it was my first time in New York. She made me feel welcome to her absolutely beautiful home. The apartment was just what I was hoping for. The bed was amazing and the apartment really clean and nicely decorated, made me feel like home. There was actually a lot of space in the room (more than the pictures showed) and it made it easier for me to go through my luggage. The subway is just few blocks away and the neighborhood is really nice, didn't feel scared even when walking in the neighborhood alone late at night after a long day in the city. I would highly to recommend staying with Kerry, I know I am the next time.

The apartment is very clean. The bed is well maintained and there is a nice air mattress for use. The separate room is a little small but can hold the air mattress relatively comfortably. All shower amenities were provided and there were basic foods such as bread, butter, eggs and bottled water in the fridge. The hosts were very accommodating in meeting us and helping us find our way. The apartment is equipped with a window A/C that can be manually controlled by the guest and includes Wifi. As stated, the neighbourhood is a Caribbean vibe, with late and noisy nights on weekends. It seemed quite busy while we were there and we felt a little out of place but not unsafe. The train is about a 5-10min walk from the apartment that conveniently goes right into Manhattan and is about a 25min ride in. It’s also approx $30-$35 cab from Manhattan. Overall we enjoyed the apartment and the hosts.

no wifi or cable.. it's a full sized bed.. old food in the fridge, but they insist you clean up. the microwave and tub was dirty. the place itself wasn't a catastrophe, but it's definitely in a high crime area, I would never go back

Juan is a fantastic host, very responsible and responsive. Super dedicated to ensuring his guests feel welcome and comfortable. The little touches and NYC recommendations were really appreciated.   Location-wise, easily accessible via several subway trains. As four female travellers, we never felt unsafe walking back late, even after midnight. Close to grocery stores, the laundromat and excellent food places.   Space-wise, very spacious, more than enough room for 4 guests and our 8 luggage. Kitchen with microwave and stove and toaster was great.
Great host, nice place,  the location is not for everyone, it can get sketchy at times, especially taking the subway from this location. Not for everyone

This was the perfect place to stay for a few nights! It was in a great location too. Felt so safe while traveling alone which can be scary, especially in NY. Sue was very helpful with any questions I had and I would definitely stay again if I find myself back in the area!

Overall it was ok , very close to the L train, like 30 seconds walking..  Times Square is about 40 minutes away , keep in mind that if you wanna visit Brooklyn more than Manhattan, you have to go to Manhattan first and switch trains , casue u only have L train by the house.   The place was clean.. at the last day we had a cockroach in the shower but that happens to everyone.. it’s New York guys..  What you pay is what you get, it’s a fair price .. AC , TV , kitchen, you have everything for a nice stay in ny.  I really recommend this place if You’re on a budget, worth the price.  Btw, nice neighborhood. Not that scary.😂  Thank you sue. 🙌🏽
Very clean, quiet, and convenient. Great price, although I suspect that’s partially due to the pandemic, but I’m sure it’s still a good deal even in regular travel times.

Overall as described! For the price this was a good place to stay at. It was conveniently located beside two subway stations that could take you to Manhattan. It would take around 40-50 minutes to get to the main attractions. Bonnie was very great at communicating and checking in on our needs. Unfortunately the AC was not working when we went but Bonnie set up a fan so during the night time it was not too hot. The neighbourhood was not the most upscale but we never felt unsafe. Thank you Bonnie for the stay!
It's a little expensive for what offers, the place is very simple and the smell is unpleasant

Juan is an exceptional host who made us feel very welcome and gave us good advice on the area and how to use the metro. He even gave us free access to the MET and the Natural History Museum! He was lovely to us!  The accommodation is very good for the price paid, for a trip with friends (there were 4 of us) (maybe not ideal for a romantic trip).  THE question everyone is asking (including us): “Is the Bronx dangerous?” ==> Indeed the surrounding area is not heavenly and does not really make you want to visit (lots of poverty, misery etc...), but we never felt in danger, intimidated or otherwise, even when returning at night from the metro: everyone does their own thing.   The metro is a 5-minute walk away and provides access to 2 Express lines which allow you to cross Manhattan from north to south, very practical!  For the transfer from JFK, we took an Uber, because for a similar price (at $10-15 ready), it's really much more convenient and faster.  In summary: if you want a good compromise in terms of money, this place is for you.

In three words, above and beyond. This bnb is an absolute steal! Juan's keeps the place so clean, and absolutely beautiful, with so many small but nice additions, such as white noise machines, extra towels, blankets, TV with Netflix. The location is good for being located in the Bonx, considering there are two downtown subways within a very close walking distance. In addition to very competitive and high value pricing, this place is a MUST BOOK

Beautiful apartment, clean and in a nice neighborhood. The sofa bed mattress is not completely comfortable, but it is perfectly adequate for 2-3 nights and for such a low price.  I didn't have the opportunity to meet the hosts but communication via messages was good.  On the other hand, I find that the level of intimacy is really overestimated: the rest space (= the living room) is delimited by curtains, behind which the guest practices a beautician activity. Understanding that someone is having a massage (or waxing) 3 meters away, while chatting loudly, and from 9 a.m. on a Saturday, was unpleasant for me.

What an amazing host and property! The place is so central there’s shops, food, the park, and so much to do all within less than a 5 minute walk. The brownstone has a charming New York vibe. The pictures don’t do justice for the place. It’s beautifully decorated, the bed and sofa were so comfortable, and compared to a hotel this is just so much better! I really didn’t want to leave but Emiliano was a wonderful host with great check in instructions, follow up questions, and directions of things to use in the apartment. I already shared his place w my friends and family because honestly for the price it’s a steal! If you’re looking for a place to stay look no further because this is the place to be!!!

Emiliano's apartment was amazing and in such a great location. So close to Central Park, literally a block away, and plenty to do close by without being in a busy loud area. The space itself is fantastic, very well decorated and welcoming. I wanted to steal the pillows and bedding because it was so comfortable after such long days walking around the city. My boyfriend and I stayed for a weekend getaway and while we didn't spend much time in the apartment it had everything we needed. Emiliano was so quick to respond and very accommodating with a late check out.

The apartment looks a little sketchy when you first drive up but the inside is the opposite. Eli's place was very small but cozy. It was extremely clean and the furniture was exactly how it was in the pictures. The apartment is not centrally located as described and there were no nearby subway stations. It would take us at least an hour to get to the city.  He provided basic amenities such as pots, pans and silverware. We had an issue with the heater (it was extremely cold that weekend) and Eli had someone come out within minutes but she would not adjust the thermostat to our liking. We spent the first night extremely hot and stuffy and two nights were extremely cold until we figured out how to adjust it ourselves.

Our experience at this location and with the host was very disappointing. It is NOT newly renovated.. The location was very good, near my family's home.  Easy to access upon arrival.  There are high steps leading up to the front door, once inside there is another set of steep steps. Also, it's a split level with 6 steps up to the bedrooms.  I include this because it is not for anyone with mobility issues.  My Dad was going to come there the day of my daughter's wedding to make room for the  girls at his house, but the steps made that impossible.   It is NOT a 2 bathroom as listed, but 1 full bath and a tiny 1/2 bath in one bedroom.   One of the main reasons we chose this apartment was for the supposedly 2 bathrooms.  There were 2 ac units..  one in the living room,  one in bigger bedroom.  That's it.  The other 2 bedrooms had none and it would have been impossible for anyone to sleep in there with the humidity and smell of mold and stale air.  The carpeting was filthy.  The kitchen sink was stained brown.  The oven and microwave were very dirty. Only the refrigerator was clean. Two knobs on the stove were missing, and we found out our 1st night there, after turning one on, we could not turn it off.  I texted and called Ely from 9pm to past 11pm.  No response.  We had to try and sleep with the burner on and kept checking it constantly during the night, going downstairs because if we fell asleep with gas leaking we could not wake up again.  We could not budge the window in the kitchen open. A very dangerous problem.  The next morning, Ely sent a message he would send someone over, but my husband with Ely's permission pulled out the stove and shut the gas valve off. Ely was to credit us $100, but has not done so.  The tiny balcony had sliders nearly stuck closed.  And only a few vertical blinds hanging.  At night with the light on, anyone could see directly into the 1st and 2nd levels.  Very uncomfortable, unsafe and no privacy.   The free street parking described was nonexistent after 8pm.   We had to park blocks away.  One morning when we left, a bag with dog poop was left by the front door, assuming from the other tenant living there who has a dog.  We love dogs, and have our own,  yet this is unacceptable. The entire apartment needs painting and thorough cleaning.  There was patch work on several walls.  I wiped down everything with Lysol disinfectant wipes, which were blackened by every surface I used them on.   Even the king size bed sunk down when I sat on it.  I  weigh 110 lbs.   We couldn't use a different bedroom since there was no AC. One evening, upon our return, we realized someone had been there. Our things were moved, the AC units temperatures were changed and the lights shut off.  We left the AC units on low due to the damp, stale, moldy smelling air.  We left a couple pendant lights on low because we were afraid to go back in at night in the dark.  I tried to contact Ely that night at 9pm.  No response till the next afternoon.  He said the cleaning person had gone in.  But upon seeing my things there, why move them and why touch AC or lights?   Why not turn and immediately leave?  My things in the main bathroom and on the dresser were moved.   This made us very doubtful for our safety. Who had gone through our things?  We were there for our daughter's wedding. If I had the money and the time to find somewhere else to stay, I would have turned around and left that first day we checked in.    The entire time we were in NY,  this was only somewhere used to basically shower (after I cleaned and disinfected the bathrooms)  and sleep.  I would not cook or heat anything in those old, dirty appliances.  The water pressure was not very good either in the bathroom or any of the sinks.  If were we not in the chaos of a wedding, and  under other circumstances,  we would have left immediately.  We were one couple, using only 1 bedroom.   These are the major issues we had with the apartment and the host's unresponsiveness to serious situations only made the situation more stressful.   We would never go back to this apartment or any other hosted by the same person.    I do have pictures documenting all of the above.  I do not write this review without careful consideration of the facts.  I am being as clear as I can, without exaggeration.   I do NOT recommend that anyone else stay at this airbnb.  We paid a lot of money in advance to stay somewhere we were extremely uncomfortable in while we were there.  We did not feel safe and secure.  This is a basic right of any traveler.

William is an All-Star host. The place is always kept clean - this is the cleanest ABnB I've ever been to actually. He always responds quickly to inquiries. This was a smooth, stress-free check-in and stay. On top of the fact that he was extremely helpful with receiving a large package for me, William went above and beyond and I'm so thankful.

This place is exactly as advertised- the location is AMAZING. I never felt unsafe coming home from the bars late at night from most parts of the city because the Grand st L stop is literally across the street from the front door. Also, I locked myself out of my room a few weeks into my stay and called the contact number I had frantic and they had someone come and let me in within 15 minutes of me locking myself out, it was shockingly fast and they were very sweet about the whole situation. The room doesn’t have any natural light, and it is advertised that way so just know it will be harder to wake up in the morning. Overall this place is a 10/10 for location and communication from the hosts. :) would definitely stay here again.

The host is very helpful and easy to connect. The address is convenient to take the subway but for single woman, you would better take a Uber back home since it is dangerous in the subway at night. There are many vintage store in the neighborhood as well.

Very nice apartment, but not very clean, and with disorder. The owner seems new. He has his things in all the rooms, without them being used by the tenants, both in the refrigerator and on the kitchen counter, where he puts an Appel next to the sink, which cannot be used. Or bed linen, towels and rolls of kitchen paper, under the piano, on the floor.  Be careful with the usual questions from tenants, such as if it was dangerous to walk at night, or if the next room was going to be occupied every day, to be able to prepare a romantic dinner. He didn't answer us.

The entire apartment is for the guests, Carmen is not there!! So she doesn't make you breakfasts!! There was no bread!! And a liter of milk for 4 days was scarce, so the breakfasts left a lot to be desired!! The fridge was full of sauce and used food!! It doesn't give you much confidence. The house is dirty!! Full of dust, and the cups with coffee residues It's not really what they offer in the ad. I tried to cancel but they won't let you cancel for more than three days and we had to stay. When you enter you find a sign that Airbnb is prohibited in the building, and it's true that it is handwritten but it doesn't give us much confidence because they can't maintain our security. I'm sorry for the hostess who, by the way, we didn't meet her in person but through messages I try to solve the problems, but this is the reality of the apartment!! Dirty, unsafe apartment, horrible bed, and normal location!! Since you have to walk about 10 minutes to the first metro stop. The apartment would be good if it cost half as much!! No 85 euros per night I don't plan to return

Nhia's place was clean , safe , and very comfortable the ammenities were great the location is great for travel to the city bus to the train E or F  is a stone's throw from her home 50 steps the most , Nhia and her family are very nice people and truly made my stay very comfortable , stress free , and private , I would have liked to stay longer and would  suggest that you book with Nhia if you really want a peaceful cool private space , I really enjoyed the back yard patio and they even had a nice out door seating in the front for just chilling out taking in the evenings quiet and this very nice peaceful neighborhood. SUPERHOST SHE IS  and the family is great too, 100% great stay.*****

A very nice and cozy place to chill. Incredibly clean with almost everything you need for cooking including a stove and oven. The bathroom is very clean as well. Over all the place is a steal if you need to book an airbnb in queens

kicked us out of the place at 4 am. i forgot my wallet and wasnt allowed to get it back. threated to call cops. he "randomly" decided to sleep in the living room our last night. very creepy. wouldnt reccomend this guy at all or ever.
Location was a bit sketchy, but aside from that we had a pleasant stay!

Nicoles place was great. It was super clean which was extremely important for me to have a comfortable stay and she offers a lot of amenities such as her kitchen and utensils, which where super helps when we would buy items at the delis in the corner. She checked up on us without feeling like she was monitoring our stay and the location is about a block and a half away from a bus stop and a subway stop. Even when we came back late, it was a quick walk to the place and we never felt unsafe walking there at night. All in all, it is a great place to stay, with quick walks to transit and a clean location. Thank you!

This is a spacious apartment in lovely old tenament building with a lot of character (tall doors, creaky floors, beautiful crown molding and tiled ceilings). There's a lot of natural light during the day and the space is very tastefully decorated.  The area itself is very lively with loads of cafe's and local restaurants. Bodegas are nearby as well as 24 hour taco stands and a Trader Joe's.  There's a lot of intertesting local history around (so check out walking tours in the area) and Gem Spa is nearby for egg creams. Subway access is good-less than 10 minutes of walking. We never felt unsafe in the neighbourhood, enjoyed the pop up markets in the weekend. Alfredo and Ceasar were very kind, friendly and welcoming I hope our paths cross again!!

i believe  as a host  we should Treat guests with more compassion and be more considerate about their unexpected and emergency situations , this could happen to anyone , these values are still more important than money and cancellation policy. This is called customer service .i rented this place for a month and half, and paid a lot but I lose my money because while i was on my trip heading this place , right at the border, my visa didn’t approve, so i had no choice but to cancel my reservation, and went back all the way home in Canada. I had a very very hard time at the border, but immediately i let the host know and explained to host my  difficult situation, in hope of he cares and understand the situation and begged him for a full or at least Partial refund because that was my last dollars and I really need it back, I was in too much stress, but unfortunately he didn’t care, no response not even a single word ,and Not even a penny back, only strict about the cancelation policy.

I got Room A which is on the ground floor, street-facing.  Commute: Is the great thing about this room. A 5-minute walk from Roosevelt Avenue station, so you can get an express train which reaches midtown Manhattan very quickly. Compared to other AirBnbs, the room is a great deal given the commute.  Located near Little India. Lots of South Asian groceries and restaurants. And it's very multicultural, there are also Chinese, Latin American and other restaurants nearby. Blink Fitness and Target are a short walk away. There are many dollar stores, grocery stores, every kind of store nearby. Roosevelt Avenue is very lively, and yet the street this house is on is pretty residential and quiet. And since there are so many trains, you can get to other parts of Queens pretty quickly.  Cleanliness: It was 99% clean. I once saw a cockroach in the kitchen, but other than that, no bugs.  Noise: Overall not very loud, but since it's in front of the street you can hear passerby's talking, vehicles, train and occasional airplanes (LaGuardia airport is nearby). No street music. But the white noise from the fan and the AC drowns out most of the noise. I would recommend noise-cancelling headphones or earbuds too. I was always able to have a pleasant sleep. There is a curtain for privacy. The way this house is structured, this room does not share a ceiling with the above floor so you don't hear anybody above you. This can be a huge plus!  Internet is pretty decent.  Size: room is small. It is ok for a temporary stay, especially if you spend most of your time outside. I got used to it but it's definitely cramped if you're used to larger spaces. There are two other rooms inside the apartment but you do not share a wall with either of them. Everyone stayed in their rooms, so you barely heard or saw them.  Kitchen: pretty good for cooking basic meals. It has basic pans and pots, cups, glasses, plates, cutlery, microwave, oven, fridge.  There's a lot of basic items that you need to get on your own. You're allocated areas in the bathroom, kitchen, and fridge to keep your stuff.  A lot depends on who your roommates are. I saw things left in common areas, but overall my roommates were good.  I didn't see a fire alarm or CO alarm.  The host is a little slow to respond.  Safety: On my last night, a pedestrian was robbed at around 3 AM in front of the house. Since my room was street-facing, it was a bit disturbing. I could hear the police. However, the neighborhood is pretty safe in the day. In fact, I once had to leave at around 3 AM myself. Nothing ever happened to me.  Also, it can be a bit unnerving with strangers entering and leaving the house at all times. There's two other rooms on your floor, and several other people in the basement who seem to be using the same entrance. I recommend a portable door lock if you're concerned. The room's actual lock can be opened from the outside with a butterknife.  Overall: it has the general inconveniences of being in a shared apartment with strangers. However, it is good enough. Now after moving to my own apartment which I don't share, can't really say I miss it.  PS: I thought having roommates would mean you'd socialize with them. But all of us were so busy with our lives that besides the occasional hi, we never talked or got to know each other. So I wouldn't expect much socialization here, but that also depends on how friendly you want to be :)

The apartment is BEAUTIFUL and the hosts are nice. I was not very happy with the neighborhood though - it's 2 minutes walking from Bed-Stuy and when you go to the closest subway station (it's 10 minutes from the apartment) you pass this truly unpleasant area with the crowd of very poor, often drunk or using people asking for money. The apartment is the classical choice for a family with the car so you could spend time in the house and in the other area but not it's own neighborhood. Actually the only nice direction to walk from there is south - to the Prospect Park. That side of the area looks clean and safe.
