We were two young women and I feel it’s important to mention that there is a homeless shelter and abandoned park/lot before the unit that felt a bit uncomfortable to walk late a night. Overall, the stay was nice, convenient, and located well!

Nice comfy little pad. Decent location. Very good place to go if youre looking to unwind for the night with minimized stress. She was very helpful. Came out to help me get the keys and spoke genuinely. Had a great birthday night.

DON'T BRING FOOD BACK TO THE ROOM UNLESS YOU WANT TO BE ACCUSED OF ATTRACTING ROACHES OVERNIGHT! The listing should be called "the roach studio" instead because there is nothing zen about waking up in the middle of the night to find out it was infested with creepy crawlers! After booking a 4-day stay here, now on my 3rd day at 3 am I woke up to multiple roaches in the kitchenette area. After immediately notifying the host (bad idea)Val the host sounded very concerned and tried to rectify the issue by telling me she would spray around the area and offered a partial refund if I decided to stay or leave. Well, things turned around quickly when I notified Val I would no longer continue my stay at the listing because I feared bringing roaches back home to my family! Let me add this was the first night I ate at the listing and left a foil wrapper out in the kitchenette area, the same area where garbage cans are located underneath the cabinets. The host became upset with my decision to leave and now the partial refund offered became an " I am not sure". I then notify Airbnb of this issue, along with sending pictures and videos of the roaches. Val then began to accuse me of attracting roaches overnight, leaving the room in a dissatisfying condition (food everywhere), and now breaking a shelf! All of which is untrue! Forward to the aftermath of having to find a hotel to stay in for the remaining days in NYC during memorial day wknd and spending the rest of my trip trying to get a refund I am owed! However, the host's main concern was to rebook the room, sending me multiple messages to accept her refund offer of one night to clear her calendar. One night not even enough to cover the additional costs caused by all of the inconvience. A super host turned out to be a horrible host!! Also, something else I would like to point out is the courtyard is filled with no smoking signs everywhere, yet the entrance to the listing is in between a hookah bar, not very logical. Lastly, I would like to add I am already well aware of how condescending Val is so I'm sure she's going to try and validate some false points to cover herself as she already did. However, I am providing the truth so the next person does not have to deal with the nightmare I've dealt with from this host! So please be aware and be sure to document everything if you still decide to stay at this listing!

Annamarie is a wonderful host, with fast replies and an enthusiasm about making your stay as comfortable and relaxing as possible. She is knowledgeable about the area and not stressful to book at all, I appreciated her laid back attitude and helpfulness. Annamaries place is both comfy and cozy as well as stylish with a artistic feel. Enjoy the Mexican restaurant across the street for tasty margaritas and enchiladas! There is a cookie place called Crumb Cookie that delivers quickly and is to die for! Space is clean and tidy, comfortable beds with warm sheets. The water pressure in the bathroom was amazing, however there is no sliding door so be aware u may wet the floor. Also beware of a 3rd floor walk up if that is an issue. The place is 420 friendly which me and my best friend enjoyed for the night as a relaxing home away from home getaway. Thank you :)

This is the worst accommodation experience I have ever had in my life.  1.      Poor arrangement  for check-in  I flew all the way from Asia with my family and my dog for more than 15 hours and got to the host Sophia’s place 2ish in the afternoon to try having some rest earlier. While Sophia mentioned that we could check in at 1pm on the app, we ended up were told that we could not walk in when we were right outside because the last person had a late check out. We should get some update if that was the case. Also, we felt rude about someone shouted through the intercom about it was not 3pm yet and we could not get in, while the keys were already in the lockbox! We felt unfriendly at all and lack of communication. We were holding 10 luggage too and felt helpless where we should carry around meanwhile. Sophia was not proactive until we requested to leave them at the hallway before cleaning was done.  2.      Poor hygiene and surrounding environment for the unit  Although cleaning was just done right before we got in, the place was not clean at all. There were dust and mud on all the carpets (front door, bathroom, living room) and tables. Hairs around the corners. We mobbed the floor 4 times and the water in the bucket was still not clear. Plenty of stains in the kitchen drawer with the broken scissors in there. The microwave was dirty and smelly. The grass was so long up to my knee. It was one of the selling points that perhaps we could let our dog be a bit relaxed running around, but the condition turned us down. All the knobs, lockbox, doors were not smooth at all to operate. We were afraid we could break any of them at any time. Please have some WD 40 spraying on it! I asked Sophia’s phone number from the app and started bringing up the situation, to hope we could come up some immediate resolution. Sadly, besides denying the cleaning condition, she sounded very arrogant and yelled us back that we were the one who made the mess. Next, no shampoo and shower gel were filled in, while the listing said shampoo and soap was included and the rack hung on the wall. Again, after bringing up the issue to Sophia, we felt insulted and rude. She claimed none of these were mentioned in the listing (I am glad that I took a screenshot from her listing as a proof to myself). Having a rack there did not mean it was provided for granted. I had no idea what made Sophia changed her mind and dropped off a bottle of shampoo and shower gel, but it was too late. It became meaningless like we tried begging for it.  The neighborhood environment was not as good as what it described from the listing. Subway station is not close at all. You either have to wait 10 mins for a 20 mins bus route, or spend a 20 mins walk, but you would not feel too safe walking along there even during the day. The smell of weeds was everywhere. It was disgusting!  3.      The bad attitude of the host and even the Airbnb support team who were arrogant, rude and unhelpful  Due to the fact that Sophia was so unhelpful, my whole family including my dog felt physically and mentally unwell living there. Instead of attempting to get assist from Airbnb (as Sophia’s arrogant attitude made us felt hopeless), we decided to move to somewhere else 5 days later. Few days later after we settled down, we started filing a complaint to Airbnb and requested for refund. Unfortunately, another disappointment brought to us. They said as we missed the first 72 hours, they could not proceed any refund, nor gave any warning to Sophia. To be honest, how many of you here can imagine that no support at all if it is beyond their 72-hour window? This is so rigid and inhuman to customers. Besides unhelpful and not supporting customers, no professionalism was seen from customer service as well. ‘whatsoever’ attitude, lack of communication to each other internally, and broke the commitment every time. We made so many calls for escalation just because no one called us back while the last customer said someone would. Besides losing track of my service ticket, they even closed my case when it was not settled yet!  4.      Conclusion  It was my biggest regret to trust Airbnb and Sophia. It ruined my family trip, and we are still suffering at this moment from this experience. Your pay does not return the same. After taking your payment, do not expect you are getting the service and support if you encounter any issues or arguments. You will just receive full of disappointment and canned responses left and right, unless you memorize every single word from Airbnb and follow their game. Airbnb is not doing their job maintaining quality control to the hosts as well!

We stayed with AnnaMarie for a mom/daughter trip. AnnaMarie’s home accommodated us perfectly! Everything was PERFECT! Location, cleanliness, and safety is always number one factors for us, and this home did not disappoint. A few blocks from Grand Central station which made maneuvering the city very easy. Of course, safety is never guaranteed, and you are in a city that does host some sketchy areas, we felt very safe walking to and from Grand Central at night. For those who love a good cup of Joe, you have Perk Kafe just downstairs, and other delicious spots within walking distance. I haven’t been to NYC in over ten years, so I needed a subway refresher. AnnaMarie was beyond helpful with educating the subway system. She also pointed out a lot of great restaurants, bars, and to dos. Communicating with her, you can tell she loves her home and her city. Her love, passion, and excitement to make sure we had a great trip was the Cherry on top.

We spent a week here for work and leisure and booked this unit for affordability. I wish I had taken more time to research travel times via subway prior to booking. Pros: Fast and reliable internet, in-unit laundry, green space for our pup (disclaimer it's not completely fenced), dedicated secure off-street parking Cons: Only a few hiccups but Sophia promptly had these items addressed  The walk to the L station is a half mile (about 10 blocks) and took us roughly 20 minutes, the B6 bus stops closer but it's an additional fare. This is predominantly a Caribbean neighborhood. We never felt unsafe and the neighbors were all very friendly. I will say though that walking back from the L after dark is a bit more...adventurous. Not scary, but potentially overwhelming if not an environment you're used to. We took the subway and walked our dog around the block daily and had zero issues. That being said it takes about an hour to get to Manhattan from here (via car or subway). We had a positive stay and the unit itself provided all the amenities we needed but I regret having spent so much of our leisure time commuting.

Wow what a fantastic location! Right in the heart of Brooklyn, near every bus or train you'll need to get to Manhattan, Brighton Beach, Sheepshead Bay, Manhattan Beach.  I especially liked that it was close to where my Dad lives so I could literally walk over. The neighborhood is quiet and safe.   The apartment itself was super comfortable, clean, welcoming, with A/C in every room and large fridge to store food to do your own cooking. But always make sure to get some genuine NY pizza and Chinese food!   Allen and Andreea were very gracious hosts and responded quickly if I had any questions, my stay was hassle-free. Thank you both!  I will definitely be staying here again next time I'm in NYC, and you should too - you will find it a better value than most hotels.  ---Rob

Place was super cute and quaint! I was a little scared at first, but after speaking with Nataliya, she put me at ease and we never had an issue after. Nataliya is EXTREMELY responsive even at 1am!! 🙈 will definitely be staying at her home again!

Location could not be better! The place was clean and in order, building staff friendly and helpful, and again, i cannot stress  how perfect the location. Transit friendly, park friendly, Whole Foods across the street, and easy o distance to a wide variety of great local bars/restaurants !!

This home is absolutely beautiful. You can tell the owners put in a ton of time and energy to curate a space that looks and feels like a high-end stay. Julia was super flexible with check-in and check-out and was quick to respond to any messages we sent. The location leaves a bit to be desired since we found it to be removed from the hot spots of Brooklyn. It is very close to the A and C train which made getting into Manhattan very easy, but the train stop felt a little dangerous at night, so we ended up using Ubers and Lyfts more than we had anticipated. That said, for the price, it's a stunning spot to spend the weekend with some friends.

Spotlessly clean, beautifully designed, tranquil oasis in Bed-Stuy. The bathroom, especially, is dreamy. It’s a short and lovely walk to Utica, with quick A train access to Manhattan. If that’s your sort of thing. Great coffee shops and restaurants in walking distance. It’s New York, though, so the neighborhood has that energy-it’s not a suburb in Kansas. (No shade whatsoever to Kansas. Well maybe a little.) Excellent, clear, responsive communication and seamless check in and out.
it wasn't a nice experienced I was so scared couldn't sleep and check out 3 am the same night I checked in. I been terrorize by some ppl who disseminate me and sounds like a horror show

We had a great stay during the week here! The place is as cute as it is in photos. There is a bit of noise coming from the road here if you’re a light sleeper, but that’s worth the trade off of having everything you need nearby. The subway is only a block away which was really convenient for us needing to get around town to meet up with friends. There’s plenty of good restaurants nearby and the park is only a few blocks away. Unfortunately for us we had a Covid scare, but luckily the apartment had extra blankets and sheets in the closet for one of us to isolate in the living room. Would come back again in the future if we needed a place to stay in the neighborhood!
5 stars. Great hosts. Clean, cozy and cool room in the summer was really nice. Recommend  for anyone needing a reliable stress free stay.

Pros: - cheapest option with private bathroom.  - bed and mattress are pretty good  - private bathroom for the price - early check-in - could drop off the luggage at 11am before checking in  - clean and fresh linen Cons: - dirty bathroom. The sink has some brown stains - broken hardwood with sharp dangerous wood pieces - water in bathroom only has 2 temperature options: super hot and just hot - check in issues: the key locker code had been sent only by request. My phone was on 3% charge left at the moment I received a code

I’ve stayed here before so I thought I knew what I was getting… a well-lit, “bachelor pad”-feeling penthouse of a 5-floor walk up in a great neighborhood. It has basic amenities/decor, but high ceilings, a spacious living room, and very comfortable beds. However, this stay, it came with a bit of a funky smell and a live mouse. I was afraid to put my things on the floor- the only option in the bedroom. When I messaged Micky at 9:30am (their time), they did not respond until ~5pm. Someone arrived to install traps and they found a ton of mouse droppings near the fridge and under the sink, and *dead mouse* behind the couch— a couch we had been sitting on for hours. Micky said they were sending someone, which wasn’t a convenient time for us… AND they had already arrived and left. So, the place was not hygienic, smelly, and we felt very gross after staying there from the mouse droppings, dead mouse AND live mouse. Plus, communication wasn’t particularly responsive or considerate.

I might be more complimentary of Micky’s place if I wasn’t reviewing it through the lens of terrible or blatant absent communication from the host. The apartment is cool. It’s got great furniture in the living room and the kitchen passes my high standards for cleanliness. The bedrooms were adequate. The bedding had an odor that was unpleasant, specifically the pillows. It’s a 5 story walk up which is annoying for me, but very problematic for my 70 yo mother.  My biggest complaint are the shabby bathrooms, one of which did not have a working toilet. I emailed Micky about this issue with absolutely non response. Post check out I inquired about a partial refund and still no response. The location is ideal if you’re specifically looking to stay in SoHo otherwise, don’t waste your money. The price point does not align with the condition of the property or hospitality of the owner.

Loved Jacob’s place! Felt so much like home and beyond. Astonishing views from different rooms during different time of a day. I skipped our plan to go to the Empire State Building because we all preferred staying home and just relaxed with the views. Jacob is a great host. He is very responsive, friendly, proactive, and helpful. He booked us bowling session so my boys got to experience their 1st bowling session stress-free.  Definitely would love to stay here again when we return.

We stayed from the 21st of October to the 2nd of November. Jules is a busy person, yet he always tries to answer your messages as soon as possible. If you have any requests, he always takes them into consideration and tries to offer a constructive solution. Remember, there are many other rooms booked by other guests, so you all have to accommodate the fact that the bathroom and the kitchen are shared among all of you. My advice is, try to communicate with all other guests that are supposed to use the same bathroom as you and try to arrange the agreeable time for using the bathroom in the morning/ evening to eliminate the stress of someone knocking on your bathroom door while you are in the middle of having a shower.

Stayed here for one night, less than 24 hours, and spent most of the time sleeping. The day after I checked out they sent me photos of major paint damage to a unit that didn’t even look like the same color paint of the one I stayed in, demanding $100 in damages.   When I called and spoke with an associate to let her know that I was not responsible for this damage as I was SLEEPING most of the time in the room, she told me she would have to “get Airbnb involved.”  Very dishonest people, will try to scam you out of your money.   Also, your view out of your window if you stay here will be a dirty courtyard filled with garbage bags and staff from the restaurant next door talking loudly all night.

Definitely not worth the price. Outdated and dirty. The “bed” is just two mattress toppers stacked on top of each other. If you look underneath, the platform that the toppers are on is broken in multiple places. The bathroom is quite dirty and the place overall is way smaller than it looks like. Location is the only somewhat redeeming quality. Oh, and they also aren’t forthcoming with their disclaimer about the potential rat sightings inside the apartment, which is suspect to say the least.

Thanks guys! The place was pretty nice and the hosts were super awesome and informative. Accessing the apartment is strange but I guess the whole city is strange. The “restaurant” in front of the building is sketchy, and they make weird noises at all hours of the night, but other than that 10/10.

This Airbnb is in a great location - close to lots of bars and restaurants, 10 min walk to Broadway theaters, 15 min walk to Central Park, 4 blocks in either direction to subway station. And since the unit is in a building behind the one that faces the street, it was quiet (no street noise, and minimal noise from others in the building). Lots of natural light, it’s nice to have the kitchenette, and the bed was fairly comfortable. And Val was very communicative before and during our stay.   However, this is a very small space - it’s described as such, but I guess we unrealistically thought or hoped it would be bigger and thus a better option for us (my husband, small dog and me) than a hotel room. In retrospect, I think the hotel would’ve given us more space, privacy and comfort, and probably would’ve been cheaper (after factoring in Airbnb fees and cleaning costs).    Also, I should point out that we were hit with an overpowering smell of cleaning products when we entered - had to open the windows to air it out. We also found the laundry detergent scent to be unpleasant.  It was a nice stay in a good location, but not what we were exactly hoping for. May be perfect for others.

The only thing worth 3 star was the location because in all honestly it was a calm area but other than that the experience was terrible. In a thousand years never thought I would have someone interrupting my personal space. Let me start with the entrance. Upon trying to enter Sonia’s home, I had saw someone on the window staring at us and I assumed it was the host. Once entering, there was 2 individuals who have made her home their home. Ok cool, didn’t care but it felt very uncomfortable next time I shall book more privacy. As we settle in the room that only had a tv, a very old desk and 2 beds with very old furniture and hard pillows, a man had started to knock very loudly not even 20 mins into entering the room. We thought it was the police from how hard the knock was. I proceeded to tell the person to give me a second to open and the person continues to knock very hard. After opening the door the man introduces himself as the super and tells us that Sonia would like to speak to us on the phone. HOW CRAZY? startled and afraid at this point due to the lack of privacy I immediately contacted AIRBNB to tell them about what we had just encountered. I also spoke to the host through the app to tell her that it wasn’t necessary to knock on people that are renting doors extremely hard a simple call or a soft knock would’ve done the trick. The place felt a bit unsanitary as well. We immediately left that morning due to Airbnb not wanting to work with us with the refund and to get our moneys worth we just decided to stay. During the entire night the other guests kept making noises around 3am and we woke up several hours that night. If you need a quick stay and need something affordable then this is the place for you but if you value privacy and respectful host and guest then look else where.

Nice place, convenient location. No complaints.  I ate dinner at a noodle shop around the corner and was literally cursed by a homeless man who was angry I wouldn't buy him food, so that was fun. The curse didn't affect how much i enjoyed my room, though!

Clean, comfortable stay in Hells Kitchen which has a wonderful mix of all you need.   The studio is behind the main bldg. There are two black doors in the courtyard- this entrance is on the right. The instructions were a little murky on that. The door was very hard to open when entering as well as leaving which was stressful, esp at night. There are also some very steep winding steps going up to the studio so pack accordingly. Probably not the best if you are disabled or carrying a heavy suitcase or small child.  One of the outlets near the bed is broken which could be hazardous.   Also, it seems this is one of many studios in the city that is not lived in, but getting taken over by companies running AirBnBs which is taking away limited space.

This place is great value for money and we would definitely return.  However, i like to give a full picture to people so a couple of minor negatives first, just so you are prepared for them which then allows you to see all the positives without worry - and there are many positives which is why we gave 5 stars so read beyond the first part below.... The only problem we had was on arrival. We had been through a plane emergency landing, a very uncomfortable overnight in that airport, delays all day for the replacement flight, followed by delays on our connecting and so on. When we arrived we followed the procedures exactly and found there to be no key in the keybox when we opened it. This was in the middle of the night and we were very concerned. Everything was ok in the end though as the conscierge was hanging around and he let us in the main door. We used the passcode to get into the flat and found the key there. So, maybe just make triple sure with the oweners of where you will get your key befofe arrival. The 2nd thing is, the entrance can seem a little daunting - the door is right bewteen two sides of a bar on quite a dark street where there are always lots of folks sitting drinking at the tables outside. You walk down a not very nice corridor and throuh a not very nice courtyard to get to the much nicer entrance to the appartment. Do not be alarmed at this! Once you have been in NYC for a few days, you realise that this is completely normal, walking down scary little alleyways to get to really nice places. They are not scary at all after that and the people outside at the bar didnt say one word (apart from the odd hello) to us as we came and went at all hours. It was absolutely fine. When you get in, the apartment isnt just quite as nice as you imagine from the pics but where is? However, it is still nice, is functional, is well soundproofed (we didn't get any noise from the street or from next door) and, above all, is CLEAN. There was coffee for the filter machine there too, there is a good selection of books and a good tv that you can watch netflix and such on the firestick. The only drawback on functionality is the kitchenette where you need to be the size of Frodo Baggins to do anything at the sink - the apprtment is more the aize of a decent hotel room really. But this is a minor thing. There is everything you need there and the location is excellent. When you come out the main door and turn right - just a few blocks away (lined with some nice bars - our favourite was "Deacon Brodies" - and restaurants) is Times Square and all the Theatres and so on around about. Again, the street looks a little scary at first but don't be scared - it is absolutely fine to walk even very late at night Having also stayed a couple of nights in hotels whilst we were in NYC i would say this. Yes a fancy hotel room will be slightly nicer, but for this location you will pay at the very least a third more, or even double per night what this apartment costs and you wont have a kitchenette or coffee maker either. Great value for money folks!

I had difficulty getting in the building, due to me reading the wrong email for the check in instructions.  The host was very friendly and was responding to my texts immediately.  She made my check in easy and stress free.  Will definitely be staying here again!

The airbnb itself is a beautiful little 2 bedroom with their own bathrooms. Super cute and behind a hookah lounge, which was a plus. However their front door to the airbnb was very unsafe and doesn't lock properly.

I booked Ana’s Airbnb for my family for our holiday trip to the city, two months in advance. When I did, Ana told me that her “personal assistant” would reach out to me with check in instructions a few days prior to our stay. So far, fine.  The day of our check in, I found it weird that I still had not received any check in instructions or even an address. I sent her a few messages multiple hours before check in, but I still received no instructions, leaving my family stranded on the streets of NY (past our check in time).  After multiple messages, she finally answers telling me that “Allan is coordinating with the cleaners.” That’s it. No number to call (the number Ana had listed on her profile wasn’t even her cell phone) no address, no check in instructions. Who’s Allan??! No idea.  The booking was finally canceled and if I had not found a last minute apartment (via a friend) I honestly don’t know what would have happened. This felt like a complete scam.  Ana left us stranded in NYC with no place to stay during the Christmas holidays. Worse Airbnb experience ever!!

Had a very unpleasant experience unfortunately. Biggest complaint was that the radiator leaked 2 days in a row and wet my things. I ended up checking out early and wrote to the host but never heard back from them. You’re better off paying a little more and staying somewhere else.

Communication was great! Easy check in. It was a fun street to be on with restaurants and a jazz/karaoke piano bar. A little sketchy at night but you are in the city and it’s easy walking to some major locations. Pretty quiet. AC worked nicely. Good size.

Generally, this Airbnb was fine. The shower was stained yellow on the bottom and the drain was clogged, causing the shower to flood if we showered longer than 3 minutes. Immediately after booking, they said I would have to pay $80 in fees upon arrival (in addition to what I paid on the Airbnb app). I found this to be odd, but there wasn’t much I could do about it. When we checked in, they had me sign saying they could charge my card $80, which I expected. However, upon check out, the desk person insisted that $80 was an incorrect estimate of the fees we needed to pay and insisted that they were going to charge my card $130 for the previously mentioned fees. I never signed for the $130, and I never gave them my credit card a second time because it was suspicious that the employee was trying to increase the amount of fees. I will be disputing this with the credit card company if they do try to charge more than the $80 I signed for because it seems very suspicious that one of the employees was insisting we pay $130 for the same fees that 2 other employees had said would only be $80.
Great place! Very clean and a great location. The area doesn't feel sketchy and neither does the hotel. The exterior is modest but it's lovely inside. It's a great choice for a couple.
I had a great stay, met all expectations, and was a steal for the price.

Great place , very cute . Beware of the taxes that you have to pay at the hotel.. this hotel room wasn’t as much of a steal as we thought once we realize we pay almost $100 in taxes in order to check in..

This room by JFK airport is great if you’re looking for somewhere comparably affordable to stay the night before catching a flight. Our only small complaints were that the bed was uncomfortable and the experience is all contingent on who is staying in the other room, which for us was a bit unpleasant.

Communication was minimal. It was enough for us to have an easy check in, but that was the last we heard from her. When asked about checking out (where to leave keys) never got a response. As other reviews noted, the tub would not drain properly so you take a shower with water up to you ankles, bed was very creaky and would wake you up when you moved, the heavy footsteps from upstairs didn't stop until after 2am. Camera in the living room was creepy, so didn't use that room much.  Only had one towel for 2 people. you do share the place with another boarder, but that was not a problem. On the plus side room was clean with fresh sheets, toiletries were provided. Location is great.

Save yourself, do not rent this place.  Secondly the steps are so dangerous for the kids my son fell on those steps. Inspite of telling this guy he still went and ignored the whole situation. Secondly, the place was very dirty kept. It was just cleaned for view nothing in details was cleaned. This guy charges for cleaning and does not get a professional cleaning done. So with Covid 19 in place its very dangerous to live here.  The place was so clamped up. If he did not deceive us, we would book another place which is more safe for 2 year old and 7 year old. Inspite of informing him we are coming with kids he still did not keep in mind how unsafe this place is from entering to exiting this place.  He has two units he rents out or does what I do not know. The place is not at all noise proof. The bathrooms leaks. He does not want to fix it. But tells us we need to be careful with kids as the water will leak to downstairs unit.  In the shower area, water is clogged so you spend long time in the shower waiting for the water to drain. He tells us where to leave shoes, Where to leave your suitcases, Do not drag chairs of the dining table.  This man will text you at 2am, to tell you its late go to sleep now as his next door unit guest will be disturbed. Mind you even though we paid for the whole place.  During out stay there he was very rude to us. He would text us and call us saying go to sleep my guest next door is getting disturbed. He would text and call us and say things like do not move the chairs as I hear the sound and so can my neighbour. He would turn on and turn off the damn heat whenever he wanted.  He would come in the morning and knock on the door just repeat the whole thing again. We felt extremely harrassed by this guy. Everytime we would go out in the morning to wait for our uber driver he would come and have long conversation of why we should not take a uber and a RTC bus ride since its expensive. None of his business!!!  He wasnt speaking english properly at all. He said restaurants were available walking distance. To be honest none of the restaurants were walking distance, everything was 15 mins - 20 mins in car. Again wrong information was given just because he wanted to rent the place out. Basic sanitizing was not done in the unit when we reached. Bascially this host deceives people and he really does not show the true picture of what he rents out. He never kept anything like trash bags, tissue paper or anything basic that we would be able to use at the unit. on the day were to check out he left a bag of paper towel on the door as he knows we are very upset with him by then. On the last day when we handed over the key he gave a box of sweets to my hand and said place air bnb will send you an email to review you, I would appreciate if you could leave me a good review. Whenever we left the unit we use to keep the lights on. Everytime back to the unit, we noticed he has entered the unit without our permission while our belongings are there.He knew it because as entered all the lights would be turned off. He enters the unit to check and leaves before people get it. This man is a CON!!! stay away.  We had 6 torture full days with this place and the guy himself.  He always comes in front even though he operates through his wife's account.  And he never allows his wife to talk to us. Super deceiving place!

This was definitely a bad experience, I do not recommend this place to anyone from another country,  specially if you are latin. As I am.  To begin with, the place was on Marshedas name who I never met, I only had contact with Nazmul who from the very begining seemed to me had a predisposed attitude in regards of our behavior because of our origin.  We arrived very tired, (at midnight) and as soon we arrived he entered the apartment and for 15 minutes he gave us very strict and specific rules like to watch out with the floor assuming we don't know how everyday stuff works(very odd). I have to say the place was very clean, and had everything necessary.  We stayed for 8 nights, our only issue was that we only had whtspp and the airbnb app for communication,  even though we didn't need it because we didn't had anything to comunicate.  At the check out time I made a mistake and thought the check out time was at 1 pm, but it was at 11am. At 11:30am Nazmul came shouting my name and knocking the door very violently, I got scared,  my husband opened the door and Nazmul kept a very rude attitud and  he never asked what happened or why we were still there, he was very disrespectful, and basically just kicked us out of the apartment.  And we (after 8 nights, paid in advance, (following every rule) me, my husband and my elderly mom of 66y/o got ready, packed all our things, and in 17 minutes we were on the street.    I dont know what the problem was, but I think it might have been about our origin, because  as I mentioned we spent  8 nights there and I never heard him treat the other guests as he treated us from  the very beginning.

Unfortunately I can’t recommend Carmen’s place. In fact, I must advise you to avoid it altogether. I encourage you to read her other property reviews before you book, I wish I had done so. Other guests’ comments about deceptive pictures and unsanitary conditions ring-true. I frequently noticed and had to deal with insects and other pests about the property throughout my stay. Additionally, the area seemed to be relatively high-crime and even as a born-and-bred New Yorker I, at times, felt unsafe. Furthermore, the host frequently made unusual requests of me that made me uncomfortable. She insisted upon taking a photo of my passport when I arrived at check-in, even though my identity is verified on Airbnb, assuring me that she “wouldn’t do anything bad with it”. For some reason, she refused to communicate through Airbnb chat, and was *constantly* - almost daily - texting and calling me on my cellphone with strange requests and became irritable when I simply stopped responding. Then there’s the unit itself: it is shoddily constructed, probably by some off-the-street contractor or somebody’s cousin; and it shows. It would surprise me to learn if it had ever passed a NYC building code inspection. Nothing in the rental from the counters to the cabinets is built to standard. The shower stall doesn’t close all the way so I had to clean puddles of water up off the floor every morning. Plus, the power to the water heater is constantly going out, and you then have to go reset the circuit breaker yourself to restore functionality. The tv is basically just a prop with an antenna that doesn’t pick up any channels well. Only one lonely pot is provided for guests in which to cook. I’ve never had to leave a bad review before but I was very disappointed and wont be returning.

Cool and hip location in NYC, right near subway. Place is clean, functional, and decent amount of space. There is street noise; didn’t bother me but might bother some. To access apartment you have to go into a gated alley and then into building and walk to third floor. This didn’t bother me at all, but might bother some. I might feel a bit unsafe entering the apartment at 3 am. Gate and alley door don’t always lock easily which could create a security issue. Leslie is an excellent host; always available.
Place is AMAZING!!! Super clean, beautiful touches, great communication with host (Rob) & just overall, EXCELLENT
This place is super nice and Rob is so friendly.

Rob's apartment was a fantastic find! It is so close to a couple of bus stations as well as the LIRR so it is really easy to head into the city or to travel around in the area! His apartment was really clean and spacious and I had a wonderful stay and would love to go back there again!
Rob was super helpful & responsive! Our stay was fantastic, thank you so much again!

Rob’s place was perfect. A very clean apartment, felt right at home and it is in a fantastic location. Rob was also a very responsive host, ensured we had everything we needed. Everything in the apartment was setup well. Would definitely recommend to anyone and I’ll stay again.
Great location and rob is great

A beautiful and clean home! Less than a block from the LIRR and super close to Bell blvd. Ideal location! Even though we couldn’t find the espresso machine, Rob was a wonderful host and the apartment proved to be a fantastic stay! Wonderful amenities and easy check in/out. Would definitely stay again!

I recently had to travel to New York for work and brought my family along for a mini vacation. I couldn’t have picked a better place to stay in. Rob was incredibly nice to all of us (including our pups), provided a clean and calm environment, gave us recommendations on what to do and how to enjoy our time better. Definitely recommended it to anyone coming to the city, I’m for sure coming back on my next trip to New York.

Beautiful nice clean home close to everything! Don’t hesitate to book , rob is a great host will help you with everything you need and you won’t regret there cozy home with driveway and street parking.

This apartment is gorgeous and impeccably clean! We were attending the U.S. Open and it was A perfect location but even beyond attending the U.S. Open it’s close to the city and the area the apartment is in is fabulous! Lots of restaurants with great food and  fun to walk around and explore and if you take the train it’s a two minute walk. Rob was an awesome communicator any questions I had immediately were answered within a very short period of time and he was very helpful with recommendations of restaurants to go to and places to explore! We will definitely be returning to this Airbnb next time we visit New York!

Rob is a great host.  Very responsive and accommodating.  The accommodation is clean and comfortable.  Bed is extremely comfortable. Kitchen fully equipped. Location extremely convenient, close  to Bell Ave for stores and restaurants and LIRR for trips to the city.  Minor issues with upstairs noise, during the day only, quiet at night.  Master bedroom closet was locked and other closets partially stocked with owners stuff.  This could be a problem for longer stays.  There was plenty of drawer space though.  Highly recommend this accommodation.

We enjoyed our stay! You cannot beat this location! Super close to the LIRR which takes you into the heart of Manhattan within 20 minutes. And lots of stores and restaurants within walking distance of the apartment. Rob was super responsive for any of our questions and any issues that came up. We would stay here again.

The place was just what we needed for the short period that we stay there. The apartament has the most comfortable beds where I slept in the last couple of weeks since I traveled around. The place is very clean and warm and the backyard worth every penny. We had a great time in New York and one reason it’s because we had a proper place to recover our batteries every night. I highly recomand Rob’s place, thank you!

Awesome apartment, super clean, it has everything you need to feel at home! Location was great! Rob was a great host! Any questions we had he answered them right away. Can’t say enough good things about this place. I definitely recommend it! And hope we can come back soon

5 ⭐️ experience!!!  Rob was an amazing host! Was available every time I needed him…the place was absolutely beautiful, great and safe location in Queens. Near by restaurants, bars, shopping etc. Extra blankets, extra towels, everything was perfect, wasn’t short of anything. I’d definitely stay here again!

This was an amazing stay. It was a cute little room which fits the entire apartment. Every essentials are provided and a lot of extra things were put in to make it look perfect. Only things I had hard time with is checking in and parking.  Checking in could've been self explanatory if the apartment number listed on the app matched the actual apartment. The host also included parking on premises which caused me a lot of trouble because the parking is the only reason why i rented an airbnb instead of staying at my friends place. Finding street parking in this area wasn't hard at all, but knowing the reputation of thieves in the city, i could not sleep in peace knowing the valuables i have inside my car.

Overall, I enjoyed my stay here. However, if you’re staying long-term I think there’s some things you should be aware of. First, there’s stuff everywhere. Most airbnbs I’ve stayed at have lots of closet space and don’t have personal belongings. It was almost like this place was being used for storage. I could only use half of the closet (after I moved some stuff around) and I also had to move stuff out of the dresser so I could put my clothes in there. It was a bit frustrating to just have so much stuff everywhere all the time. Also, Boerum Hill is a great neighborhood and the apt is close to a lot of things, but just be aware, especially if you’re a woman, that the actual location of the airbnb is a bit unsafe at night. A lot of times I didn’t feel comfortable coming back late at night on the train because my walk from the train to the airbnb was unsafe. Aside from that, everything else was pretty good!

Solid place to stay in NY If you’re trying to get the cheapest option. The room is tiny. I’m like 5 foot 8 and I could touch my head and feet on the wall when I laid in bed, so yeah it’s way small.  The place is kind of sketchy but when you’re inside it’s super clean and nice, felt totally safe. bathroom was way clean and I had no issues with it. Honestly probably the best cheap place you could stay.   Sleeping is kind of rough because you can hear everyone else in the whole apartment snoring/coughing throughout the night. Bring some ear plugs or headphones for sure. Wifi was great too. Has an iron, which is super helpful.

I booked Michael's place for my brother who was coming to the US from another country. His flight had to arrive late at night and I was a little concern for his check in but Michael assured me he will be there waiting for him. As soon as he checked in(after 12 AM), Michael informed me. He made the situation really easy and stress free for a person who is new to the country.  The location was the best part of this place. Every attraction is in walking distance. Penn station and bus routes including Hop on Hop off is only 5 mins walk.  My brother had the best tourist experience of NYC because of the location.

We were so happy we booked Rob’s place as soon as we checked in. I grew up in Bayside so we already knew the location was PERFECT- 2 blocks from the LIRR for our city plans + walking distance to all my fav restaurants(there’s no street quite like Bell Blvd imho). But the apt itself was so clean and spacious. Rob was such a gracious host throughout our whole stay. We’ve already decided we’ll be booking his apt again on our next trip to NYC.
Beautiful place, extremely clean with all the comforts of home and convenient to various restaurants just 2 blocks away.  Rob is a gracious host. Would come back again.

Our stay at this beautiful place in Bayside was wonderful! Truly one of the best AirBnb's I have ever stayed at: spotless, comfortable, well-designed, peaceful. Rob was a great, attentive, courteous host. The neighborhood is great, the proximity to the LIRR was awesome, and it was a wonderful haven to come back to after a full day of activities in the city. Thank you, Rob!

I love the place, a true gem. The pictures are super accurate. Rob place is warm and cozy. The whole apartment is very clean and sanitized. The kitchen is well organized. The bathroom is relaxing. The area is very quiet. The living room TV is Humungous is must be a 85 inch . The bedroom tvs was huge as well. Everything was perfect. A cute luxury apt. My family enjoyed it for Christmas. Thank you Rob :-)

Rob and Brenda's place is located in a great, quiet neighborhood with plenty of authentic Italian and Asian cuisine. It's right off the Clearview expressway which makes it really easy to get to other boroughs by car. Train station is really close too. Rob is a stellar host and all around good guy. The place has plenty of room, really nice TVs, and has lots of updated features and appliances. We highly recommend it.

Rob's place in Bayside was incredibly convenient for us.  The home is peaceful and inviting and very comfortable.  Rob was amazingly quick to respond to all of our needs.  We would definitely stay again!

Host responsiveness - 5/5 Amenities - 5/5 Location - 5/5 Noise levels - 3/5   Overall it was a good stay! Rob, the host was highly responsive to even last-minute queries, the amenities were as pictured, the location was convenient to stores/restaurants and accessible to transportation.   This apartment is a first-floor unit in a multi-family home. While each of the units have their own entry doors, the noise levels (talking/walking) were higher than your average high-rise apartment buildings. If you're not noise-sensitive, this shouldn't be an issue. Otherwise, everything else was smooth and Rob and Brenda were very warm and welcoming to their home.
Great place.  Rob was easy to work with.

Trust me this is the place you need for your stay in new york. Place is very clean. The neiborhood is quite and safe.The location is close to the train station to get in manhattan in less than 20 minutes and here you are surfing the heart of the world. You get answer from Rob within seconds.

We really enjoyed staying at Rob’s place. It’s convenient and very close to the train. There’s also lots of eatery close by, which was really nice. The place was spacious, so comfortable and clean. Rob was also very nice. Thank you so much and we will be back!

My friends and I had a great stay with Rob! The location was close to transit and less than 30 minutes into the city. The neighborhood is a nice and quiet after a day out in NY. The place was clean and had everything we needed!
Wonderful place to stay.  Clean, modern, convenient!  Rob is so accommodating and easy to work with. I highly recommend his place!!

Rob place is definitely a prime home from the location to the house itself.  The house was fully stocked and very modern boho style.  The house was very clean and spacious for our family of 5. Another plus is the railroad was than half block from the house.  Rob was such a good  host and easy to communicate he  gave me so many good restaurants to visit just down the street.  The neighborhood is very safe and quite.  Rob’s place in Bayside is the place to stay while visiting New York City, high recommend it!
Such a great stay! Rob was super accommodating and his place was gorgeous!! Definitely would stay again

I loved Rob & Brenda’s Airbnb! It’s clean, well-equipped, has beautiful boho decor & is in a great location. They were very accommodating, friendly and had a parking space for guests (which is extremely helpful in NYC).   I would 100% stay at their Airbnb again.
We had a great stay at Rob's place.  Excellent location. Bayside, great town. Just steps to good restaurants and LIRR. Would definitely stay there again.

Great place! Easy to access! Just up the street from the LIRR (which is different from the NY Subway), but makes getting into the city very streamlined. Hospitality and responsiveness were top notch. Loved the towels, extra bedding, instruction manual, and the shampoo + shower gel. Don’t forget to check out the plant cafe and the smoothie place right up the street. We had a great time! Thanks Rob!

Great location, a lot of places within walking distance. Rob’s place is super clean and updated, also having an off street parking spot was a plus. Very responsive host. Definitely nice having a full kitchen and 2 bedrooms versus staying in a hotel. Will stay again when visiting family.

Great 2 bedroom apartment with amazing backyard.  Pictures are very accurate.  So close to the train and all the restaurants and bars of Bayside.  Beds are comfortable.  Water pressure was good.  Rob is very responsive.  Would definitely stay here again.

Rob’s place was exactly was the listing and such a lovely home. The kitchen was so well equipped that we regretted not planning more meals in. The bedrooms were large and very comfortable. The area so easy to get around, lots of great restaurants in the neighborhood and the parking spot was convenient. Rob was a great host and very responsive.  We will definitely stay again the next time we are in town! Thanks again!

Wonderful and comfortable house. Very nice neighborhood and also only 30 min by train to Manhattan. The train is 3 min walk from the house.  Rob is very hospitable. Very good place to stay for family vacation in NYC.
Rob was an excellent host. Extremely prompt, beautiful home, and in an amazing and safe location. We will be back again!

Rob’s place was the perfect combination of comfortable and classy. We were impressed with the interior decor and how well stocked the apartment with everything we could have needed, but most of all with how sparkling clean everything was! Rob was so easy to communicate with and very helpful with any questions we had, and we definitely look forward to staying here again!
This place was a very nice stay would 100% come back. Rob was an amazing host and was there whenever we needed to communicate to him.  Very nice neighborhood and exceptionally clean!
Excellent location with good restaurants and LIRR very close by.  Very nice apartment.  Very clean and well stocked kitchen.  Off street parking was a nice feature.  Rob was very quick to respond.

Had to find an Airbnb close to JFK and Manhattan for my cousins who are visiting. This place is immaculately clean and beautifully decorated. The owner Rob is very helpful also. Will definitely stay here again and will recommend this place. Thank you, Rob!

Rob and Brenda, as super hosts ourselves we SO appreciate the effort and thoughtfulness you’ve put into your apartment, it’s fantastic!!!  We hope to stay with you all again in the future!  Thanks very much for hosting!

Great location, less than 5 minutes to Lirr station and all the restaurants and shops on Bell Blvd. Rob was a great host, and responded fast! The apartment is spacious, clean, and cozy. My family enjoyed their stay :)
We had a great stay here. It is a cozy and comfortable apartment in a terrific location. Parking spot was a huge plus. Rob quickly responded to us and was a great host!

The house is located in the perfect location,  literally a block or so from the train station which takes you right to Manhattan in under 30 minutes.  The house itself is very clean and more than spacious enough for a family of four.  There are also several restaurants on Bell Blvd which is about a 5 minutes walk.  Rob was also easy to communicate with and quick to respond to any questions I had.   I'd recommend this place for anyone looking to visit New York.

Wonderful place!!! We were on a family vacation and Rob’s place was the perfect place to stay! The apartment is super well-appointed and spotlessly clean. It’s a block from the train station and an easy ride to Penn Station. Rob immediately responded to questions and was very helpful. I highly recommend staying here - everyone in our family says they would definitely stay here again.

Rob was such a great host. He helped us out of a jam when we locked ourselves out late on a Monday night. The place was super clean, cozy, in a great neighborhood and close to LIRR to take the train into Manhattan. The kitchen was extremely well-stocked with great cookware. We really had an awesome stay and we would definitely love to return.

The place was beautiful and exactly as pictured. Beds were comfortable, the couch was too and the tv is huge! So close to the train station making it super easy to get to Manhattan. A lot of nice places around, like Martha’s country bakery! We stayed over the weekend of New Year’s Eve, the weather was really nice so we were very hot in the house and for some reason we were unable to turn off the baseboard heaters, since Rob was unresponsive during our stay, we had to open all the windows and AC to be able to sleep comfortably. Despite that, I have no complaints and would 100% book again.

This place is actually  way above just  5 stars.  It made me fall in love with NY all over again. Such a cozy place in one of the best neighborhoods in Queens. The house had everything you can think of in excellent condition. This was by far one of the best airbnbs I’ve stayed at in NY. Rob is really a super host.  I can’t wait to rebook his place again when in NY next time.

We had a great stay in Bayside. We needed a place close to family and this worked great. Great size, nice decor, and comfortable space.  Rob was friendly and accommodating, and helped get us the pack ‘n play we requested at the last minute.   The only downside of the place for us was noise. We have lived in NYC apartments and know they can be noisy. That said, we could hear the music/gathering downstairs until 10 pm on Friday night. We appreciated the adherence to the 10 pm quiet hours. For a group that is going out and doesn’t need to go to bed before 10 this shouldn’t be an issue.   Overall, we had a great stay and enjoyed the comfortable apartment and location.

The host did communicate where the lock box with the key would be placed, the only thing i didnt notice when booking is no tvs in the rooms, it would have been better if thats how you fall to sleep, also the bieghbors party bery loudly, so if your a light sleeper that may bother you, one thing that was a little annoying was the BNB was not well lit when i arrived at night, its a ceouded block so i pulled up to the house based on picture provided from bnb and pulled into thier drive way to unload and shine my light to be sure the address was correct, well once i stepped into the apt the host came thru a door in the common room are where the cameras are and said you cant park  there my husband and don are coming home. Yhey need to park. To me it seemed kind or rude and intrusive, a trxt message would have sufficed being how that was how we communicated, instead she watched me park. Then waited to come to me in the apt. It felt creepy and intrusive and bordet linr rude, because of how she said it. I assured her it was a temporary park to unload then to proceed to find parking along the street. Other than the though of being watched like reality tv. The place was clean, other room mates were quiet, parking wasnt hard to find, if you just need some placr to sleep, this will do fine

Look, the pictures were accurate, but the area was super sketchy. Its East Harlem, not Manhattan. They advertised street parking, but I definitely would not leave my car out at night. We had to pay $40 a day for a garage, which sucked. Would not walk around the area after sunset, either.   Minor issues include: apartment was on the sixth floor, no elevator; the AC shut off automatically all the time, so we always woke up sweaty and gross; the blinds sucked, so the room was really bright at night; and there were a lot of intense rules about keeping the place spotless with the threat of a $500 fine. If you are messy, prone to accidents or are traveling with children—this is not the place for you.   For the price, we would have been better off at a hotel. This was “not the place to be” in my humble opinion.

Although we really enjoyed our short time in NYC, a couple notes about this cute tiny Airbnb:  - It is in East Harlem so you either have to take a Lyft/Cab or take the metro to get to Time Square.  - there is a metro station about 9 blocks away, 96th street about a 15 minute walk. - Central Park is also about a 15 minute walk. - If you’re from out of state/country the walk could be scary especially after sunset since the surrounding area is very dirty and not the ‘NYC high end area’ . (We’re from the Bay Area so we took the metro everywhere & didn’t mind the location)  - the unit is on the 6th floor so you would have to go up and down flights of stairs since there’s no elevator so keep this in mind if you have luggages. - the unit is accurate from the listing but like every other review we did have issues with the AC unit that we completely just stopped using it and cracked the window open instead, for some reason it can get really hot in the unit at night even though it’s cold outside. - the unit is in a corner so the cars in the morning can be really loud. I was woken up with cars beeping every morning we stayed here.  - in the listing they want you to clean the apt & throw away the trash on your own upon checking out, imagine this with your luggages &  6 flights of stairs? also what is the point of the cleaning fee?   not sure if this unit is owned by a woman but there is just no feminine touch to this unit at all… i wanted to heat up our pizza in the oven but they didn’t have anything that I could use to do that, not even those pans to throw into the oven. i’d definitely rather cash out on a better unit somewhere closer in the downtown. thank you for having us! the unit has a TON of potential.

Second stay at this apartment. I LOVE IT!!!! Don’t let the 6 floors scared you away from this jewel. It comes in handy after eating everything you can find that’s delicious 😋. Apartment was actually as last year. Very happy with my stay.   This apartment is definitely in the neighborhood so you won’t feel like a tourist.

I really enjoyed my stay here! This place was just as described and pictured. It was perfect for one person and any issues I had didn’t have anything to do with the host or space. It was very clean when I arrived and the check in process was smooth and easy. Having only a staircase to go up 6 flights really wasn’t bad except for trying to get my luggage up and down the stairs, but besides that I didn’t mind walking up them everyday. The neighborhood was not sketchy at all in my opinion, but I guess it just depends on where you’re from and what you’re used to.  No one bothered me whether I was walking around in daylight or coming back late at night so walking by myself was no issue at all. The 6 and Q trains made it easy to get around the city, but weren’t always close to the major sites so just do your research before you book to see if it’s close to where you plan to be the most. I would absolutely stay here again the next time I come to NYC.

It was a nice place to stay! Everything was clean and it had everything we might have needed. The neighborhood was a little sketchy but didn’t have any problems. We felt comfortable walking at night from the subway. There were places to eat nearby and the subway was just a few blocks away. It was a little far from downtown destinations but you can get there pretty fast if you are comfortable riding the subway.

We had a good stay here! The place was brilliant and was located not too far from the subway. It was also super easy to get a cab home at night. Only dropped one star due to the neighbourhood being a little sketchy at night, nobody did bother us though. Also although it is stated in the description it was a little nerve racking to be staying in an Airbnb because of the New York rules. Thankfully nothing came of it and the host did clearly communicate this before booking. Overall great value and a good spot to explore Manhattan! Thanks for having us.

Very comfortable set up. Everything was set up great. Airy and open. Very nice bathroom, spacious kitchen, and very comfortable bedroom.  Washer and dryer very good. Whether a short weekend or longer, you won't be disappointed!! Close to public transportation,  and you can get to the ferry for a quick stress free ferry ride to Manhattan.  No fuss no muss. Silver Lake Park is just up the street. Great for walks or runs 🏃‍♀️

This apartment is great! It does indeed have access to a multitude of trains, each about a 10-15 minute walk away (Kingston Throop & Nostrand A/C, Kingston 3, Nostrand LIRR). There are multiple well stocked markets (with organic food and otherwise) within a 10-15 minute walk as well.   The kitchen in this unit is fabulous, and allowed us to save money by stocking up for our week's worth of breakfasts as well as lunch foods. It has pretty much everything you need, gas stove, Keurig style coffee maker,  toaster, blender, microwave, huge fridge and granite countertops.   This also has a washer and dryer right IN UNIT. This was incredibly helpful, and as someone like me who used to live in Brooklyn can attest: very rare.  Ainsley responded very quickly regarding communication, however our only struggle was regarding check in and check out. We didn't get instructions sent to us, we had to request them.  We didn't get the actual code for the lock box until the day of, or any other instructions at all. I used to live down the street, so I'm very familiar with the NYC subway system and how parking works. If I had never been to Brooklyn before, this would have been significantly more stressful.   Lastly, Parking: If you've never been to NYC before, look up "alternate side parking" so you understand how it works. Yes, there is free parking all around this unit. However, I had to move my car every other day so as not to get ticked. This is very normal for NYC, so just familiarize yourself with it before arriving.   I would 100% stay in this unit again, and plan to keep it saved for our next trip to the city. All in all, we had a phenomenal stay! thanks Ainsley :)
Good central location for our trip. The host was easy to deal with & unobtrusive. It made for a stress free stay.

Had multiple sets of keys which is great for multiple guests. Provided lots of snacks and beverages! Everything was clean. I think they put in a brand new shower liner every time, or it was very new which was reassuring. Lots of towels and toiletries provided. Had curtains where the sleeper couch is which provided extra privacy. Only downside was that I wish the location was better or closer to the subways. It was kind of a scary 15 minutes walk that I don’t recommend doing alone…

Incredible location!!! Can’t stress this enough. The place was clean and the communication incredible making our check in and check out do easy. The apartment was clean and the host thought if details for us like eat buds, toothpaste and toiletries. Thank you!!!

The photos are accurate. The place is really charming and the host seemed like a wonderful, attentive person at first meeting. I was excited to stay there with my baby who was turning two that week, and her two grandmothers. My mum is blind so we planned to leave her in the Airbnb during the day (with accessible food) while the three of us explored the city/celebrated the baby’s birthday.   On our second night, the electricity went out and I contacted our host and asked he come help the next day. Of note, he offered to come right away but I declined as it was bedtime and I didn’t expect us to need lights or electricity while we were sleeping. At check in he had warned us not to use a certain switch in the bathroom as it may trip the fuse. We didn’t, but I suspect that using the two provided space heaters tripped the fuse. Nevertheless he came first thing the next morning and fixed it for us. Really excellent service I would say and I did feel bad for having to call him the evening before. While he was there I mentioned it was v cold in all the rooms and we discovered that one bedroom had the window open a crack. He helped us close that. Unfortunately it didn’t warm up after he left and we discovered that it was just REALLY cold. The lights went out a couple more times that day and he stuck around to help reset the fuse (which was outside of the apt and not accessible to us). At that point, we realized that there was no heat. He immediately got on the phone w the building super and the management’s lawyer and requested that it be fixed. Unfortunately it took a while and we spent my daughter’s birthday bundled up in the couch as I didn’t want to leave my mom home alone in the cold. It got so terrible that I started looking for other places for us to go that evening and I contacted the host and told him we would have to leave and go to a hotel etc if it wasn’t fixed shortly as it was unbearably cold (as in feels like 7 degrees cold). It did get fixed after 7pm so we were without heat on a v cold day for a full 24 hrs plus.  Of note, we broke the soap dispenser as the first time the lights went out, one grandmother was in the shower and was startled and slipped and fell and in her panic grabbed the dispenser to break her fall. I offered to pay for a replacement and repair and our host declined.   The next couple of days of our 5 night stay were uneventful. The area is my fave in NYC and it was amazing being steps away from Tomino which has been my fave restaurant since it’s inception. The heat and electricity stayed intact for the remainder of our stay and we have a good time. I do think it is a great place and it feels like real NYC. I can’t blame our host for the issues that were beyond his control and I think it was just bad luck. That being said, I did request a refund for that day and he said we would go through Airbnb for that so we will see.   The host offered us two nights free at the end of our trip. I could not take it as I had to return to go to a funeral of a friend who died unexpectedly during our stay. I also wanted to go home at that point as my baby didn’t like the cold much. I do think he is a great host and I appreciated the offer. While the place won’t be for everyone as it is small I think it’s a good deal given the location. I appreciated that he provided new toothbrushes, toothpaste, soap, shampoo, linen, towels, and even gave me extra garbage bags per my request (to take out the trash everyday). There is Netflix and Disney plus and a microwave for people who need to warm up food. I would recommend this place for future stays, though if I had to go back to nyc with my family, I would likely opt for a larger place with an elevator. The location and the responsiveness of the host can’t be beat though.
Great place for an affordable night Uptown. Whole process was easy and stress-free. Thank you!

This place was perfect for what we needed, just a place to crash after long day in the city. It’s close to the Subway and 7-11 for snacks. Andrea text me the day we checked in to make sure all was well and responded quickly when I messaged her. We didn’t feel unsafe in the area of the Airbnb. The sink in the bathroom had a drainage issue but there’s a large sink in the kitchen so it wasn’t a huge issue. The radiator was a bit noisy at night but not any big deal. Overall, good for the price!

I am going to be 100% honest with y’all. This was a tough experience.    Pros : 1)  Host communication was right on. We had issues with the internet and she was super helpful.  2) The location is great.   Cons: 1)  The house could of been more clean. There was bloodstain on the bedroom comforter, which really grossed us out. The pillow cases did not smell clean. There were no extra blankets anywhere.  The kitchen was also dirty. We had to rewash any plates or pots we wanted to use.  The oven looked like it hadn’t been cleaned in months.   2) Due to health reasons I must cook all my meals. The kitchen is not equipped for cooking. No microwave, no tea kettle. Barely any plates, bowls, etc.   3) The TV in the front room does not work.   4) it took us 20-30 minute (no exaggeration) to get the shower to run hot water. And even then it never fully got hot.    5) Nothing warm and cozy about this unit. If it wasn’t for their tiny portable heater we would have been too cold to sleep there.   6)  At the head of the bead there is a window. They installed an air conditioner incorrectly, which led to a constant draft of cold air coming in right on our heads as we tried to sleep. Very unpleasant.   7) Pay attention folks, this is a five floor walk up with no elevator.   8) Lastly, there is a small room that is just empty. There are two windows there one being the fire escape stairs.  Now I was born and raised in Washington Heights and I have never seen a fire escape window without a gate. Not even sure if that’s legal or not. Nevertheless, it left me feeling exposed and unsafe.  While the chances of this happening is low, there is nothing stopping a crazy person from climbing these stairs, breaking the window and having access to our belongs and ourselves. There should be a gate in this window from the inside for more security.   All and all this experience was horrible. The apartment would be great if they would just put a little effort into this place.    I know it’s cheap, but I still found it over priced for the experience we had.  We ended up moving to my moms place a day early.

What a terrific place! It is nearly impossible to find an entire rental unit in the Inwood area of New York, but Jannice place was perfectly located. Right by the subway for easy access, right in the center of the Inwood neighborhood. Contactless check-in was easy, the apartment well-equipped, and my stay was stress-free.

Was pretty disappointed with our stay here. It’s on the outskirts of a nice neighborhood, so the location is okay (you can easily walk to tons of bars, restaurants, & shops), but there were groups of people hanging out in front of the building at all hours, which was a little sketchy. That wouldn’t have bothered me much except the window unit ACs weren’t properly installed and the windows were completely open. I wish I could post a picture. Bugs could fly in, dirt from outside, rats could have crawled in, anything, someone could just open the window fully and climb right in... the bedroom unit is in a window off of the fire escape, so anyone who could access the fire escape could have just climbed right in the open window. The security grate on it didn’t even lock. There was also only one towel, even though my reservation was for 2 people for 2 nights. I contacted the host about it, but didn’t hear anything back about it until the next day and we never got any more towels anyway. We spent our first night trying to find a hotel in the area instead, and when that didn’t work out, we had to go out and buy our own towels. You also can’t flush toilet paper in the toilet, which is pretty gross. The furniture is old and feels like it’s covered in some kind of film. When I picked my purse up off the kitchenette table, it peeled off as if the table were covered in some kind of sticky film. Overall, I was just skeeved out here. Would never stay here again and definitely would not recommend.

The bed, couch, towels, bath mat, etc. did not seem to be cleaned recently There were some unpleasant smells on some of the linens. It was also concerning to see a very hot, steel radiator in middle of the kitchen. We weren't aware of what this was and it gave off a lot of heat. The temperature in the apartment was very hot and could not be controlled. She did provide a fan, though.

The place is very comfortable and Shane was an excellent host who gave tips, recommendations, conversation and always offered help. I felt very relaxed to have Shane as a housemate during my stay.   One thing I would add is that due to the host, Torris, not being present during my stay, there was a little miscommunication on the layout of the place and I opened the wrong door when looking for towels for a shower late at night. After spending 36 hours awake and being out of it from low blood sugar late at night & all of the joys of a long flight, I would have preferred that there was a more respectful conversation about why I accidentally entered another room that was not explained to me.   For example, being from out of town, I didn’t know if the photo in the listing of the garden was immediately behind the building on ground level or not, so I wasn’t aware of where all of the rooms led. The only thing that kept me from giving my stay a 5-star review was this lack of communication and understanding about why I was confused about the house layout on my first night, and it added some significant stress to my morning routine receiving strong and accusatory messages from the host about entering a wrong room for a mere few seconds and then politely leaving. I understand why this happened, and I still felt bad and apologized for making the host feel uncomfortable, but a more detailed explanation of the building layout would have been appreciated on my first night.   There were also some issues with not having workable lighters to use in order to properly cook on the stovetops and this would have helped me use up the groceries I purchased throughout the week, a lot of which I had to leave behind without using (such as eggs).   Other than that my stay was very pleasant, great air conditioning for the humid and hot few days I was there, great hosting from Shane, clean rooms, comfortable bed, and a lovely dog to keep you company.   Thank you Shane and Torris for having me!

The residence offered is very good, containing everything necessary in terms of comfort. Location is good close to subways but after 10pm it gets a little dangerous due to indigents who are usually drunk.

The room was very clean, nice, private, feels very secure. Some really great amenities, like a super comfy chair in the room, some candy, hot chocolate, tea, coffee...microwave and mini fridge in the room. Great location, easy to find and easy to park. I had to book last minute when my travel plans got changed, he was EXTREMELY accommodating, let me check in early (then he messaged me to let me know my room was ready for me even earlier than he'd said), and as I was about to leave he realized I had too much time before I could check into my accommodations for tonight, so he let me stay much much later than we'd originally agreed upon. Really helped take some stress out of the past 2 days. Also, very prompt and thorough with communication, available in case anything was needed...I will be staying here again for future trips if possible.

My second time staying here, well worth the money. Definitely recommend this place! Clean, private, great location, friendly host...only reason I wouldn't recommend it more highly is bc I don't want it to be booked when I want to stay there...😂 Seriously though, Angel truly goes above and beyond. Because of the nature of my trips to NYC it's always extremely stressful for me, to say the least, but being able to stay at a great place with a kind host definitely helps.

Very dirty place. I checked in and there are hairs on the pillow and stains on the furniture God knows what. I sent Michelle the pictures and I respectfully told her I’m not comfortable with the cleanness of this place and I’ll look for another place. She at first agreed then she told me she will contact Airbnb. However, the most shocking part here that when she contacted Airbnb she told them I’m being problematic and didn’t not mentioned the main issue and was direct. Very unpleasant to deal with her disrespectful behavior and I would never wish the same for anyone. It took a long process to get the refund because of her misleading information to Airbnb. Good thing I provided the pictures of the actual unclean place in my report.

Worst experience EVER! Filthy! Ants everywhere! NO wash rags! Sour towels! No light in shower. Floor falling in! Unsafe front door, missing lock. No front light! Homeless crack heads out front. Host was SO rude! Mattress had soiled stains on it. The lights goes on! DO NOT lease from here!

Amazing views and very nice apartment.  Fast communication with host.  But my praise ends there.  Apparently this apt is being rented illegally. The building management knows about it.  I know this because the management locked us (myself and my son)  out. Not even the hosts (one of which lives a few floors above in the same building) could get into the unit.  The host contacted me via text and told me the only way for me to get my stuff was to call the police and the police could force the building management to allow us in to get our things.  We waited in the building lobby until 3am (no food, water or bathrooms) for the police to show up.  The building doorman then let us into the unit to get our belongings. We had a short time to gather everything up and leave.  We then had to rent a hotel and take an uber to get to the hotel at 3:45 am  I'm not faulting the building management, they apparently warned the host multiple times to stop renting the until via AirBNB.  I learned all of this from the doorman. Doormen know a lot about what goes on in their building!   My advice is to not rent any of the apartments these hosts rent out in NYC otherwise you might find yourselves locked out.   Apparently all AirBNB rentals are illegal in NYC and the city is working hard to crack down on them.   I hate having to give someone a bad review. I'm only posting this because I am concerned for peoples safety.
