The bed was super comfortable, but a bit too small for me and my 6’6 husband haha ( full size).   Lauren was sweet and very attentive to my questions!

Brigida is a very good, kind and attentive person.  The house is prettier than the photographs, everything is very comfortable, I didn't struggle with anything.  The location is very good because it is very close to the metro, it has many shops around it, while I was there it was quiet, nothing dangerous.  Totally recommended.

Excellent!  Come without any fear and with the certainty that you will be in the best place in NY! A quiet, residential location and very close to the subway, which takes you to Manhattan's main station in one stop!  The apartment is cute! Very tidy and prepared to receive guests... Communication with Steve was excellent and he was very attentive to all our requests!   We'll be back soon!

The location is excellent for getting on the subway.  The plethora of restaurants within 2 blocks made for stress-free dining; other than having some many choices.  We went on morning walks and having the East River so close made it even more inviting.  We had a great time in NYC and our lodging added to our experience.

Brigida's home is located in Washington Heights. I used to live in Washington Heights so I knew exactly what to expect. Some folks have mentioned that they felt unsafe while walking to/from her place but I felt completely fine and I traveled alone for this particular trip. I came back to the room late at night and managed to walk down the street without any issues. My tip? Walk confidently and without hesitation.   The apartment is on the fourth floor so you'll be in for a bit of exercise. Don't worry, you'll survive! The apartment is welcoming and tidy. The bathroom remained spotless during the three nights I was there and the room was exactly as pictured. It was clean and very spacious! It did get warm at night but the windows open and there's a fan available for use.   I'd happily stay here again. Brigida was very responsive. Even though she only speaks Spanish, when I met her on the morning I was checking out, she was pleasant and helpful. Thank you, Brigida!

Chris made our first time being in New York fun, stress-free & overall beyond our expectations. We arrived to a well kept apartment with all the essential amenities. The bedroom was tidy & a comfortable bed. The restroom was stocked with complimentary toilet paper with toilet & tub cleaned. The kitchen was also in order with basic kitchen utensils such as cutting board, strainers, cooking pots etc. We didnt have time to cook, but often cut mangos & prepared fruit snacks for travelling. The living room was very informative with subway maps, city & even bike maps framed for info purposes. The location itself was great since its steps away from the A-train which takes you almost about anywhere downtown. Noise was very minimal with exception of footsteps that's coming from upstairs but it comes with the territory of living underneath somebody. My wife & I are very pleased with our stay & absolutely will be coming back if ever we visit New York in the near future with our kids. Thanks Chris!

DO NOT STAY HERE!! Very sketchy hosts who will scam you. My friends and I were in NYC and had overnight plans that got cancelled. We requested a late last minute check in if possible and it was the only place available on a Saturday night. We only needed a couple hours of sleep. They never replied all night so we decided to take the 2 hour drive back home. I woke up to a charge on my card and no confirmation or instructions about the key. I called the host and they didnt pick up. I called again a few hours later and they HUNG UP on the ringer. VERY UNRESPONSIVE AND DISGUSTING!!

Great place, South of Harlem. Two beds, lots of space. What i didnt like was that we were told upon arrival by the owner that we were supposed to pay 50 dollar to the caretaker. and then caretaker demanded it immediately. For our protection he said. Strange experience. So what if we wouldnt want to pay it, then we would not be protected? made us feel unsafe. Even if money was for cleaning, i assume this is supposed to be paid by owner to caretaker, not by client!
The place is convenient. A quick subway ride to the city. The neighborhood is a tiny bit sketchy but the price is appropriate for the neighborhood.

Before this particular experience, I was a great sceptic renting an Airbnb room.   First of all- I'm almost OCD like when it comes to cleanliness; secondly- have a major problems sleeping in strangers house (usually don't sleep at all cuz I'm pretty scared and paranoid 😄) and thirdly- just the energy is usually sketchy.  So, if every Airbnb host was like Diana & Elijah and every place clean (perfectly clean private bathroom, crisp clean bed sheets, etc), warm and safe like Diana's is- I'd completely forget about staying at hotels, forever.   Unfortunately, in my opinion, this place is a true hidden gem among the myriad of not so great places, to say the least.  I highly recommend Diana's place for both short or long stay. Had a blast meeting amazing people there, truly felt like home (loved spending time just sitting in a living room and drinking an amazing complimentary coffee from such a cute designed cups (they really paid attention to all details, I could write an essay :P ).  10***

Ana’s Place is incredible for the price you pay. The space itself is clean, comfortable, and easy to sleep/live in. A very, very short walk to the seven train makes the city incredibly accessible. There was a shared bathroom, but I never had to wait for it, even with a full house. Ana herself is a sweetheart and ever keen to make her guests comfortable, from answering questions or calls to telling intriguing (if lengthy 😂) stories. For the price, it’s truly a steal. I was happy to return to it after long days.

I stayed at John's while traveling for a conference, and was immediately impressed right after booking. John provides super detailed instructions for check-in and the duration of your stay, since he was out of town while I was staying at his place. The room is clean & tidy, as is the bathroom, & I was able to use dishes & silverware during my stay. The apartment is very close to the J train, which was super convenient. I had to stay out late several of the nights I was in NYC, and I never felt unsafe walking back from the train to the apartment by myself. Even though John wasn't physically at the apartment while I was there, his thorough communication & hospitality made the stay extremely low-stress, allowing me to focus on the work I needed to do! I'd highly recommend staying with John!!

Had a great time here. Justin is a really friendly and nice guy and the same goes for his two roommates, Dennis and Brian. The apartment was clean, quiet and the view from the patio relieves pretty much all your stress. Will definitely stay here again without a doubt.

First of all: Kaz and his team are one of the kindest hosts I have every stayed with. They are always there for you and if there are any problems, they will fix them within hours.  The room itself is very spacious for NYC, you have a lot of room to store your things and the location is really nice as well. The 6-train runs 3-4 minutes away from the place and it brings you to Grand Central in about 18 minutes and goes all the way down to the Brooklyn Bridge. There are plenty of Bus-stations around the area as well. Also the Central Park is just a couple of minutes away by walking. The people living in the house were really friendly. Its a latino neighborhood, the people were super friendly in general and nice to me and welcomed me everywhere I was. Of course it is helpful to speak a little Spanish in Spanish Harlem. You have a great little mexican restaurant with really nice owners just next to your house and plenty of other restaurants/bars to discover. I lived there in February which is why it still was a little sleepy (and of course cold).  Of course, be aware that you are living in nyc, which is in general not the safest place to be. But this part of east-harlem is very safe, I never felt uncomfortable or unsafe, even coming home very late in the night.  The only negative thing was, that you will stay with two other guys, who seem to live there long-term. Basically there is no problem with them, they are not very communicative which is kind of normal for shared flats in New York. But they are not very clean, especially in the bathroom. I have talked to the team about that problem and they have talked to them to solve this issue. Besides that, I had a great stay and highly recommend the place. Thank you again Kaz for making my stay as easy as possible!

To say that Cherrise and Patricia made my stay pleasant is an understatement! I had such an amazing time staying at their home.  Below is a review of my overall stay:  Greeting:  Upon entering Cherrise and Patricia's home, I was greeted by Cherrise with a pleasant and welcoming demeanor. We immediately hit it off and I felt as though I was speaking with a family member! I later met Patricia and she was just as friendly as Cherrise. The apartment also offers its own "greeting" with both Cherrise and Patricia's beautiful and stylish artworks. It was very clear that great thought and care went into the design of the entire home including each room that has its own separate artworks.  Cleanliness: The entire home was always clean. The cats are the cleanest and most well-behaved cats that I've ever come across and there's 5 of them! There were also fresh flowers throughout the home.   Cats:  You can absolutely tell that the cats are not only well taken care of, but they are also unconditionally loved! The cats each have their own little personalities and it was great getting to know each individually as the days went by. You absolutely do not notice their presence as they do not make noise nor are they always running around. I had an amazing stay with Patricia and Cherisse. The whole flat is extremely clean, and it is in a great location - close to many restaurants and the subway. I have never felt unsafe in the neighborhood. I really enjoyed getting to know Cherisse - and she makes delicious breakfasts too! I will be booking here again if I visit New York again. Just one small thing to note, since the room is close to the Avenue there are some traffic noises during the night; so if you are a light sleeper I would recommend bringing some ear plugs!

Check-in was seamless, and Taylor was so kind and welcoming, we felt very comfortable during our stay. It was my birthday weekend, and she made me feel at home, and gave me tips on how to get the most out of my experience in NY. We couldn’t have asked for a better host. The location was unbelievably convenient, we were never too far from where we needed to go. The neighborhood was surprisingly safe, we wandered in and out at different times of the night and never felt unsafe. Taylor’s home was very aesthetically pleasing, and comfortable, the room suited our needs in every way, and the WiFi was excellent, which isn’t always the case with some Air BnBs. It was all around a great experience.

We loved staying at Alexandra's place. She was there to meet us when we arrived and checked in with us to make sure all was well during our stay. Her place is centrally located and very easy to get around to all the best places NYC has to offer. The place its self is very stylish and has everything we needed to feel right at home. One thing to note is that you have to take stairs up to the fourth floor, so if you have trouble going up and down maybe not the best place for you, but if stairs don't scare you, then we highly recommend it!

If you are ever staying in the bronx or near this area make sure to stop by. This house is a hidden gem. Comfy, spacious, clean, beautiful but most importantly it has Edwin as a host. Can’t stress this enough Edwin is so welcoming, attentive and super nice.  Thank you for letting me into your house!!!

Great place to stay for the price good for big groups of people that aren’t trying to break the bank. Edwin let us check in a couple of hours which was great because we were all jet lagged from the plane from California. The area is quite and a nice neighborhood, no sketchy people walking around. He checked up on us on the daily seeing if everything was okay. There’s a couple of markets and a Walgreens 3 mins walking distance from the place just Incase you forgot anything. Over all great stay and will definitely stay here again if I come back to New York.

We haven't expected but Billy's hospitality is remarkable. He's interesting companion and our stay in his house deepened our NYC impressions. We loved Billy, his house and NYC :) He has so many good feedbacks so I'm afraid the next time we decide to visit NYC he will be sold out.

I had a pleasant stay at Ana's place. She and her husband managed to make my stay very enjoyable. Overall a comfortable room just as indicated in the explanation in a quiet neighborhood. Besides Astoria is a really nice area to stay. Everything is close by; subway, supermarket, drug store and restaurants.

Well, I think I thought about making this extensive comment for several reasons: firstly, so that it is intended for everyone who reads it, but particularly for Argentinians, who are a little afraid of staying on Airbnb in NYC or at least outside of MhT because the prices are crazy.  I want to tell you about my experience, this year is the fourth time I went to NYC, but the first time I went alone, which is why paying for the usual hotel cost me an average of 250 dol a night and I started looking for cheaper options, so I arrived at Ana's apartment, and guided by the good recommendations of other guests I decided to stay there for a week!  First of all, I want to tell you that I am traveling alone, and that to encourage anyone who travels alone to go to Ana's place since it is super safe, (whether you are a man or a woman), both the neighborhood, the accommodation, and the proximity of the subway, all the conditions are in place to accommodate you comfortably.  Now let's move on to the house, it is a house that has three bedrooms, a shared kitchen and a shared bathroom. Ana's two super friendly children live there and speak perfect Spanish.  They live in the basement of the house so you hardly ever come across them, the three rooms I mentioned are rented, and as a result you can come across guests like you.  My room (which was number 3 and from what I could see was number 2) has a double bed, a chest of drawers and a closet. (Not from room 1 but I think it was bigger) The bedding was super clean, as was the padding and the towel.  The perfect heating, I have to go in the cold season.  Now, in the kitchen there is a refrigerator, in which each shelf has the room number, and everything is perfect because no one touches other people's things.  It has an oven, stove, large pot, small pot, frying pan, plastic plates, cups, and spoon, fork and knife to cook the basics! Personally I cooked all week from chicken to pasta and everything was perfect!  The bathroom has a very good shower, with super hot water. The truth is that the bathroom floor should be cleaned once or twice a day, because it is white and hair or water accumulates, but the problem is also with the guests who do not take care of the common spaces.  Now let's get to a super important thing and that is the location, on the corner is the 46st station of the R/M subway that really leaves you in Manhattan in 20 minutes!! This was spectacular, the R line for those who didn't go is super central and very frequent!  Not only that, but in 45 minutes you arrive at the airport without having to use more stairs than the 30' steps to go up at the DPTP station, because both to go and come there are elevators on all the other lines, a great point in favor of the location, because for 7.50 (or less if you have a metrocard pass) you get to JFK and the guard for about 15 dollars in UBER.  So, to my fear that it is far away or that the neighborhood is dangerous, nothing could be further from it. He confirmed that in 15 minutes you are in Manhattan and that the subway is super useful! GREAT LOCATION!   Another positive point of the department is that you can receive packages from Amazon, companies like hym, carters, etc. at no cost because just by entering the address, they leave it in a kind of hall that is open, but that belongs to the house (little secrets of the mail deliverers) and everything arrives perfectly! That is a very good point for you to be calm, because I sent hym and I was afraid, I thought things like for example "what if there is no one to receive it", but don't worry, this is resolved, everything arrived perfectly!  What else? I think I talked about the location, the amenities and the super pleasant treatment of its references, both Ana and her partner Hugo and their two children! I want to thank you for letting me enter before check-in, that is essential to be able to leave my suitcase and use the bathroom.  Criticisms: only if we are very strict, that there was no black out so when the light began to dawn, it passed despite having curtains and that due to the layout of the rooms, if a noisy neighbor knocks, you will have to call him to silence.  But, the purpose of this message is to say that it has the best quality-price ratio, that really being a little on the outskirts of MhT means that you can experience the daily life of the locals a little more and get a global impression of NYC and that I would repeat again because it is not easy to find accommodation that meets three requirements that are fundamental for me: cheap, safe and well connected.  Thank you for hosting me, we will surely see you next year!

Billy was literally the most amazing Airbnb hose we have ever had and I can’t stress this enough. I took my fiancé on this trip to celebrate his birthday and Billy made everything super awesome and easy for us. We didn’t get in till late, close to midnight, and not only did he wait up for us with his kids but he had pizza for us when we got there!  AND he got my fiancé a very thoughtful gift to go right along with the NYC vibe. He was also super flexible with our checkout time because we had a late flight! He was probably the nicest person I have ever met too, overall just a really great guy and family. The communication was amazing and the space itself felt like home. The private room and bathroom were huge and felt like their own wing of the house. I loved the feel of the whole place and we can’t imagine coming back to the city and not staying here. Thank you so much Billy for making our stay really special and memorable!! We only wish we got to spend more time talking with you! :)
Great location, and I basically had the place to myself. An absolute steal for this part of the UWS!

Stayed for a little over a week. Here’s what you can expect.  The place is located in south Harlem. If you’re not sure what to expect, it’s a diverse neighborhood, lotta people on the street chilling, a good amount of homelessness. None of that bothers me but that’s the neighborhood. The apartment is between two good subway lines, the 2/3 and B/C. Look up a subway map to see how accessible most of the city will be for you.  I was working during the day and in calls with no internet issues, WiFi was strong, consistent, and fast.  The room has an in window ac unit and is facing the rear with no real view. I appreciated having ac and being in control of the climate of the room. The bed was alright and the desk was good enough.  The bathroom was great. I’m a big guy and I had no issues with the size of the bathroom which has been an issue for me in the past.  Checkin was easy, I had no issues that required communication. For the price, this was a great stay!
It’s a good place to stay, easy to get to the subway, next to Central Park. I just felt it was a little unsafe the area; but the hosts are the best, and its a really comfortable bedroom
The most nasty, ugly and unsafe place ,please I hope they don't let anybody else rent this place.
The location of the place is great, about 30min to lower Manhattan. The neighborhood might seem sketchy during night time, but it was pretty safe to walk from station to the home.

Advantages: 1.The house is between brooklyn and queens. There is very convenient transportation nearby, 3 minutes walk to the subway station, very convenient. 2. Check in is very convenient, password lock check in, we arrived late, but everything is ok. Disadvantages: 1. The neighborhood of this house makes people feel unsafe. It is advisable not to go out alone at night. Because we were intimidated into going out to buy food the night we arrived. 2. The sound insulation effect of the house is not good. You can still hear the sound of the locomotive or walking the dog outside in the middle of the night. 3. The space of the house is long and narrow, which may be a little different from the photo display, but I think it is acceptable. 4.Washing machines and dryers are not provided in this house. This makes me feel very inconvenient, resulting in my clothes can not be changed. 5.The house is half basement, which makes me very unhappy, because I haven't seen the landlord show this situation. 6.The house has very poor ventilation because there are few Windows. 7. Maybe I won't choose this house next time I come to New York, but I agree with the landlord's friendly attitude. I hope my real experience can give some help to you who are browsing this suite.

Akem and Terry have thought of everything little detail in their cozy yet comfortable basement apartment in Brooklyn.  Communication is excellent and the amenities and supplies are very generous. They even have a washer and drier which is a bonus especially in winter.  The J train is a quick walk and takes about 50-60 mins ( the singer Jay Z is named after the J and Z train from Brooklyn)  The neighbourhood is slightly scary and run down but the people are friendly we didn’t have any problems.  The only issue is the neighbours which like to party and get rather loud but good earplugs  can solve the issue.   This is a small basement apartment but extremely well presented and supplied ... I would recommend this apartment to others.

So to start on a positive note, Laurence has great communication and is very attentive.   Without going into too much detail, the issues for us lie in the privacy of the space.  Upon check-in, we found there is no way to lock yourself in, meaning the downstairs unit, occupied by the Landlord, has total access to the space.  We were using the space for a work trip of all women, so obviously safely is of a concern.    We believe that the top floor shower, inside of our unit, had been used while we were out, without a logical explanation as to who used it. Therefore, we left the unit and had to find lodging elsewhere since we felt unsafe.  The space is 'fine' and if marketed as a shared space, would make total sense. We don't consider a space to be an entire home if you cannot lock yourself in, and lock others out.

Really lovely stay while I was looking for an apartment. A friend of Ashley welcomed me and was really helpful and open.  Location is really great (close to everything cool about the neighborhood and the Williamsburg bridge is a cool walk!), the apartment is cosy and arty (the walk-up really is OK and not that scary), the kitty is cute and playful... I had a great time there and really recommend.

Exactly 150m from the subway station which takes you in 10 minutes to the East of Manhattan and in 15 to 20 elsewhere, this small accommodation, very small bathroom, is a peaceful, quiet haven (no TV and therefore no lousy American channels!). I was afraid for the 5th floor without an elevator but already, in the USA, that corresponds to our 4th, and it's not too difficult. And above all, Rowan, who welcomes you, knows how to be discreet but available if necessary. I highly recommend if you're looking for simplicity. Excellent bedding!
Place was spotless. Great neighborhood with lots of amazing unique ethnic restaurants. Never felt unsafe I’m walking the neighborhood at all. Right next to the subway also.

City Island is a jewel of a place that is convenient to NYC proper but relaxed and safe from disease (COVID) and danger. Parking is very easy and you can also easily get to Manhattan or other boroughs by express bus, and now even by water ferry. you should come experience New York's best kept secret!

Overall had a decent stay. He accidentally booked us into a room that wasn’t cleaned and we accidentally went into the wrong room and had to wait for a cleaning lady to come and clean and didn’t even get into the room for a while but Oscar took care of it well and made it up to us. bathroom cleanliness was 5/10. the tv was nice. but due to the codes being wrong and the movement around of our stuff it was the most stressful airbnb check in experience i’ve ever had. but i’m sure it was a one time incident. unsure what would’ve happened to our stuff if we left after we accidentally went to the wrong room.

Wilson's place is so great I am almost afraid to write a review. I want to keep it private so only I get to book it lol. It's inexpensive, a one train trip for me (I live in the Bronx near Yankee stadium) and I like to come here for "stay cations" with my partner. The neighborhood is quiet and the eateries are diverse. Wilson himself is a great host and also very professional. Be on your best behavior and respect the space and he will treat you very well!
Wilson is a wonderful host and this place is a steal for the value it gives. It’s a relatively short (40 mins via train) ride from the D train, and about a five min walk from there to the space.

Dara's place is a comfy studio in Hell's Kitchen, but you wouldn't be able to tell with how quiet it was on the 15th floor. This was perfect for me as I was there during the stressful time of taking the New York Bar Exam. The hosts were also very responsive, so moving in and out of the studio was seamless.

Leaving my family behind to travel to NYC, as a healthcare worker during COVID 19, was a scary thought.  Richard and Sue helped alleviate some of that fear with their kind and welcoming hearts!  From supplying N95 masks on arrival to upgrading me to the fourth floor suite, they were always checking in on me and I never felt truly alone!  They promptly responded to every outreach and even checked in to make sure I was doing okay.  While some of my co-workers struggled with staying in hotels with no kitchens, I was lucky enough to have my own fully furnished and stocked apartment, making it easy to cook meals and not worry about cookware or a refrigerator.  I could not have asked for a cleaner, more easily accessible home during my three month stay!
The apartment has a great location and Vlad is a very good host. However, the furnitures and kitchen tools really need upgrades!  They are very old and somehow unpleasant.

PJ is a nice host. He would do anything to make your stay great. His place has great access to any place you want to go to. His apartment is 2 minutes from a metro station. Though the neighborhood looks a bit unsafe I did not face any safety issues. There are many eating options around.

This place was disgusting. Almost no windows so it smelled horrible. It was extremely dirty with trash everywhere. The ground was sticky. Then I found a camera pointing directly towards my bedroom door when I was in underwear, heading to the shower.  Beware. This is an unsafe place.

A fantastic option if staying in The Bronx is your preference.  This is a clean and comfortable basement apartment in a Private Home, where the host, Cynthia, is most gracious.  A very clean and tidy space, which is in a predominately West Indian neighborhood.  That means the vibe is DOPE and the food is DEELISH!!!  The #5 Subway and #16 Bus are both  four short blocks away, if you want to steal away to another borough for the day.  Such a fun experience staying in the area of The Bronx where I was raised.  My Man and I are both Bronxites - we were quite comfortable here!!!

Its an older place that may need a little TLC out front from inside nice and open. The AC are units in each room but they do the job. The beds are crazy comfy so are the comforters. There are more then enough sheets and towels which was really nice. Its an older neighborhood but a safe one with kids which was great for my grandkids. Super easy check out there were no special instruction so I do feel bad for the hosts since they had to strip the beds and stuff themselves. They were laxed on the checkout time which was nice and non-stressful. Super quick to respond to text or calls also which was great. Over all I would recommend to a family.

Our stay at Jesse’s places was very nice and comfortable. The place is very clean and nice, and there is a great kitchen if you want to make your own breakfast or a cup of coffee. There are also a lot of nice and affordable grocery stores nearby. The place is very close to 125st where there are a lot of great connections to the subway system so you can get to downtown Manhattan in 20 min. or faster. The area can appear a little sketchy at first glance but it is actually really safe and quite. We stayed for 12 days and never felt unsafe returning to the place after dark.

The room has bed bugs. I had to leave much earlier than expected, because I could no longer force myself to stay in a room literally crawling with bugs. In a rough part of town, there were at least 4 times it felt as if I was about to be robbed just walking from my uber to the front door.

Excellent communication with the Host, the only “but” I would say is the location, since it is the Harlem neighborhood, nothing bad happened to us, but the area seems a little dangerous, especially at night.   Other than that it is a great place and 4 blocks from the subway, the host is very attentive and available for any questions.

Jesse is an amazing guest and was super convenient with us (let our bags before the check in). The room was super clean and bigger that we expected. 5min from the subway but the neighborhood can seem sketchy at night even though nothing happened during our stay.

Jesse’s place is located 2 blocks over and 3 blocks down from a central subway station. We felt very Safe, place was clean. We came back on the subway as early as 4 and as late as 11 pm! We felt safe. As with all big cities, there are street people, people on drugs, etc.  Be aware that there are people around Times Square selling and smoking marijuana openly. Be careful if traveling with children. Also-no public bathrooms except in the parks and some grocery stores and a FEW large build. Plan ahead.
Jesse is a great host and very helpful.  East Harlem has a reputation for being a rough place but we didn’t feel unsafe in the least.
A nice stay., the accommodation itself was great and comfy. The only issue was the location was far from the main areas of Manhattan and it felt a little unsafe at night

Female travelers please be careful!   While arriving to our Airbnb, in the early afternoon, we had a scary encounter while unloading our bags in front of the building involving two men harassing us while watching us get into the building. On our short walk to the subway, we experienced cat calls and a fist fight. We ended up canceling our dinner reservations because we didn’t even feel safe during the daylight and couldn’t imagine being out at night.  Our two night stay, was cut short to only one night. The AC did not work and we told the host but nothing could be done about it until sometime the following day. Don’t know if that was resolved as we left first thing in the morning.   Please note that Airbnb does not handle neighborhood safety concerns.  The top reviews on this listing do not show any negative reviews about the location. It wasn’t until I scrolled further down that I saw some guest mentioning it. And the reviews that mentioned anything bad about the location were not in chronological order - which seems deceiving to have those reviews pushed down to the bottom regardless of the date it was published.

Extremely clean accommodation, where you feel good, extremely clear and precise instructions, friendly and responsive host.  We returned home every evening by metro, without feeling any particular insecurity, but everyone must do as they feel, the metro is a 7-minute walk away. Delighted with the stay and accommodation, I would recommend this one and I would happily return. New York, unique experience!

Alright. The apartment is very clean & comfortable. The immediate neighborhood is not great (notably close to the skytrain). But no feeling of insecurity. A few crack smokers near 125th Street when you take line 4. Prefer lines 2 & 3. The exchanges with Jesse were courteous even if we never met. Good value for money.

My sister and I planned a trip to NYC to see Michael Jackson musical. We looked at a few dozen Airbnb’s, knowing that photos can be deceptive. We relied heavily on comments from those who had stayed at the venues. True to the reviews for the Flushing place, Tony was very attention/responsive, checking in several times over the weekend to make sure everything was OK. The apartment was clean and uncluttered. Our host provided us with a helpful list of area restaurants and shopping malls. While exploring the neighborhood, we came across Alley 41 which was not on the list and that we would strongly recommend be added. The staff were friendly, and patrons helped us select the most delicious entrees of Chinese cuisine. We also checked out the new mall and stumbled into an intergenerational, interracial Zumba class of over 100 people. We joined in—of course! MJ the Musical was fantastic. Our trip to NYC was memorable and stress-free based upon our housing accommodations.

I had a great stay at Annika's place, the location was a steal since it was 20 mins walk to Time square. Annika was very responsive to messages and provided us with honest answers to our queries. The place is a very cozy, comfy bed, we also used the umbrella during the light rains. I would definitely love to revisit the place.

We really enjoyed our stay. Both Han and Carles were Incredibly helpful with communication; thus, making our traveling experience less stressful. Can’t think of any negatives granted the place was clean, true to picture, and located in a cool spot in town. Definitely wouldn’t mind staying here the next time I am in Brooklyn. :D

GREAT LOCATION!  Just a block from the subway!  Quiet neighborhood.  Resident who shares the place is very nice and pleasant. Place is clean and bed was very comfortable. Our internet was almost non existent in the room.  We did have a very large cockroach come into our room, but probably not a lot they can do about that because all the houses are connected to each other, and it was only one.  And, there are some "sketchy" pictures of men and women on the walls.  But, all in all, a decent place to stay while visiting NY.

Carles’ place was perfect! Everything was as described and was great for coming back to after spending all day in the city. The space was very clean and had everything we needed. As two females, we never felt unsafe even when we came back late and is very close to the subway station! Would definitely recommend!

The check in process was super easy and the space is decorated very well. It’s close to J train so just about a 30 minute commute to Manhattan. I didn’t spend much time in the neighborhood but it seemed nice. I didn’t feel unsafe at all. I’ll definitely book this place again if I come back to the city!
Nice man, communicates clearly. Provides a stress-free stay

This apartment is a gem! It is so close to the Q train which made getting into Manhattan very accessible and stress-free. Olivia was quick to respond and provide details for a seamless trip and access to her apartment. We were there during corona virus panic and Olivia was so kind to drop off sanitizing wipes and plastic gloves to make our commutes worry-free. The apartment was so spacious and had beautiful touches. I would definitely stay here again!
I was worried it might be dangerous because of the Harlem area, but it was not dangerous. And the host is so kind, and her puppy is cute enough to be unforgettable.

IN BRIEF - You should think thrice before booking this apartment. This is not as it is shown(very small 1 room), Shady area, long way to the subway metro, very bad hospitality by a Host. She asked us for more money(cash) for guest to stay for just one night! (this is not an issue at other Airbnb's) IN DETAIL - We booked this apartment from Airbnb on the long weekend of 4th of July. This was the average one and *From pictures* it was looking decent. After getting there, we did not find the apartment lock. The host was not at all happy to see us. The apartment is so small to accommodate 3 people. The bed was not clean, towels were not clean, no breakfast items, no working Hair dryer, No AC in the bedroom, No water purifier. The house is just about one room with no amenities. -> 0/5 rating points to be noted- this is just one room which can accommodate only 1 person. The bathroom is shared between you and Host(She takes 1 hr to get out of the shower) THE ONLY THING YOU'LL LIKE - She has a female dog(Yorkshire Terrier) who will always welcome you with her cute face! Don't book this! -Aniket and group

Vera is a super friendly girl and always attentive to your needs, her apartment is in a good location from Subway and stores to buy food. Her dog, Nola, is super loving and beautiful, I wanted to steal her.

The listing didn’t explicitly state pet policy.  We were asked for a $350 cleaning fee by the host.  I would have paid for this amount if not for the following reasons:  we were under observation the entire time.  It is creepy, not neighborly!  The teenage girls in our party have to make DIY blinds to protect their privacy from broken blinds in the bathroom.  The toilet was not installed properly.  The toilet was on a raised platform with no place to place your feet.  You are at risk of falling off the toilet.  One of us did and was hurt.   If you move too much, you may break the toilet off the base.  Toilet doesn’t flush cleanly either.  Improper bathroom installation is the main reason we decided to leave early.  The host should also double-check fire code compliance due to the size of the windows, and the number of beds/people allowed in a such cramped attic environment.  Also, watch out for Cockroach.  We killed one on the fridge.  This place was never professionally cleaned.  Don’t wear white socks!  Hair of different colors and lengths on bedsheets in the sunroom.  Disgusting.   Finally don’t book this place in the summer as there is no air conditioning.  Air circulation is impossible, and you will suffocate in the summer.   Did I mention chicken in the neighbors’ backyard and a mean and loud human neighbor in the front?

Our stay was amazing! The entry is tucked away behind the house, making a nice private entry. The whole place was super clean with many extra towels and blankets readily available. The floor plan of the space includes a narrow walkway to the back bedroom, but the rest of the floor plan is more spacious than I anticipated. It truly was a 15 min walk to the Staten Island Ferry. Doing to the ferry is a bit downhill and returning to the Airbnb was a bit uphill, but it was not strenuous. There is also a convenient store right next to Tim's, great to grab anything you forgot! The worst part about the trip was that we slept in late each morning because the beds were SO FREAKING COMFORTABLE. Seriously, I slept so soundly and cozy!!! I totally recommend this location for the mattresses alone--they were outstanding. Tim & Denise were so accommodating too! We arrived much before the check in time, but they were flexible with our luggage drop off and we were even able to leave our luggage until nearly 11pm the day we left--much later than our scheduled check out. That gave us such peace of mind during our last day; it was a stress free stay. One item to note, there wasn't a lot of body wash, shampoo etc. There were only a few travel sized items, which did the trick for a short stay. If you're staying longer than a few nights, be sure to pack some extra body wash of your own or pick some up at the convenient store literally 20 steps from their property!

We had an amazing 5 night stay at Tim's place with our two boys. Fantastic welcome on arrival and great hosts throughout our stay. Great location for getting around New York. Travel into Manahatten easy and an experience in itself. Bus stop across the road  takes you straight to the free ferry. Area is a bit 'gritty' but we never felt unsafe and people in the neighborhood were friendly. Beds super comfy and apartment was cosy even with it being really cold outside. We had a late flight out on the last day and Tim was able to accomodate a late check out as there was a break before the next guests. This was a life saver with kids and bags. We were able to really make the most of our last day in NY. Thanks for an amazing stay!

This is a perfect apartment to live in while you stay in NYC. Enough space and privacy for a family of four with full kitchen and parking slot. The owners Will warmly welcome you. It is located just 15min away from the Staten Island ferry in a quiet neighborhood. Perfect to forget about practical things and have a rest from city stress to focus all your energies in visiting NYC next morning. Just perfect!

Great Time, my teenagers loved it.   Hosts are adorable couple . Few minutes bus ride to the Ferry (schedule of bus and ferry are aligned) or you can walk (few more minutes) the small streets of the neighbourhood !  Cool patio and garden (where you are allowed to steal few fresh vegetables for a home made salad) Alain from MTL, QC

A warm and kind welcome. Isabel is really nice. We greatly enjoyed our stay with her. The room and bed are very large and we had coffee, TV, fridge and microwave. The metro is nearby (5-10 minutes walk), and is very well served.  If the idea of ​​staying in the Bronx scares you because of the reputation, we assure you that you can go there with your eyes closed. We never felt unsafe in the neighborhood. On the contrary, on the first day, despite arriving very late, locals offered us help and showed us the way (without us asking anything).

Great experience under every aspect! I spent a week with two friends at Mansura's and Rafael's place and I can safely say that booking there was the best choice we could possibly make. Not only the apartment is one of the most beautiful and taken care of I have ever encountered through Airbnb, but what made our stay was the hosts' warm welcome and their helpfulness.  I would definitely recommend (and encourage) staying at Mansura's and Rafael's and here are the reasons why: - LOCATION. The apartment is in Bushwick, a young and vibrant neighborhood in Brooklyn and a must visit if you want to experience New York outside the too well-known touristy spots in Manhattan (In general, I would advise to take the time to walk around the whole of Brooklyn when visiting the City).  Also, it is very well-connected thanks to Subway and Bus stations at walking distance. - THE APARTMENT. It is spacious, it is clean, it is well furnished. It has everything you need (and more) to make you feel home away from home.  - THE HOSTS. Last but definitely not least! They have been welcoming and available from the very moment we booked months ago and even more so since we arrived at their place. They gave us numerous suggestions and tips on what to visit, where to go and how to get there, where to eat... We kept in touch throughout the whole journey and I cannot stress enough how helpful it was to have them there. They really made our stay!  If you're looking to visit New York and surroundings stay at Mansura's and Rafael's. I assure you won't regret it!

This AirBnB is a hidden gem! It’s conveniently located close to two Metro stops that take you downtown in about 30 minutes. The Yankee stadium is also just around the corner. Don’t worry about choosing an accommodation in the Bronx - the neighbourhood is absolutely ok - we have never felt unsafe returning to this AirBnB- not even at night. Even though it’s in New York -  it was pretty quiet at night so we slept really well. The room was spacious and clean-as was the bathroom. We loved the free coffee in the room which was a great way for us to start the day. Isabel is the most lovely host you can imagine: she was welcoming, absolutely nice and very helpful with tips and information throughout our stay. We couldn’t imagine a better place to stay in New York and would definitely stay here again.

Ms. Isabel is an amazing host! I felt so at home and comfortable when staying with her during my quick trip to the city. For those checking out a Yanks game she is super convenient to the stadium, less than a 10 minute walk and she is close to two major subway lines so getting around the city is a breeze. The room I stayed in was very spacious and clean and as a solo female traveler I did not feel unsafe in the neighborhood when walking about. If you're traveling to the area booking with Ms. Isabel is the way to go! I'll definitely be booking with her again for any future trips I make in the area

Isabel is a great host who takes loving care of her guests! I felt very comfortable with her and really enjoyed the conversations with her! The whole apartment is very clean, the room is very large and cozy!  There is a refrigerator, coffee maker and microwave in the room, which is really convenient! Thank you for the free coffee - a coffee in bed in the morning is a wonderful start to the day!  Isabel's apartment is just a few minutes' walk from a subway stop - so you can be in Manhattan in about 30 minutes.  The neighborhood is completely fine, I never felt unsafe as a woman traveling alone!  Absolutely recommended!

We loved staying here. Hilary’s place is very close to the Q train which will take you right into Manhattan and was very easy to get anywhere in the city. We were traveling with two young children (two adults and two kids) and felt very safe the entire time - even one night when we came back at midnight.   It was so nice to come back to a large, clean and comfy apartment as opposed to a tiny hotel room in the city.   There is a Walgreens (drug store), small grocery store, a great bagel place (Catskills bagels), and a pretty good (but not the best) pizza place (San Remo) within a 5 minute walk of the apartment.   The bed was really comfy and the pullout couch for the kids was way better than we expected. Hillary was a great communicator and worked with our special requests and accommodated our schedule very well.   We would definitely book here again and will recommend it to friends and family who are looking for a great place to stay when visiting NYC.

WHAT A SCAMMER! Didn’t approve my request till the next day an hour BEFORE CHECK OUT TIME AND CHARGED ME! Had to call Airbnb to get it refunded and filed a report against host. DO NOT STAY OR BOOK HERE!

The place is really nice! It's about 7-10 min walk from the 36th Ave and 36th street subway stations which made it easy to get around. Georgina was very helpful and quick to help with any issues. The area is pretty good and we didn't feel unsafe walking around. I highly recommend this place!

It is a comfortable apartment to spend a few days near the Big Apple. The apartment is close to metro stops that take you to the center in a very short time. The neighborhood is safe, even when we arrived at night. The apartment has a kitchen and basic accessories to prepare breakfast and some light food. The only drawback I would say is that it has a musty smell and when you arrive from the street it is a bit unpleasant. Otherwise everything is very good.

The room is awesome! Especially the cleanness. And the location is quite safe, I had checked the criminal map before booking it. There r three police cars just near the building. Walk 8 mins to subway. Sum up, great place. 房东会说中文

This was a great place to stay! Super close to the subway and it was near a lot of good restaurants and cafes. Good area and never felt unsafe. The room was exactly what we needed, the whole space was very clean and tidy.

Yerddy was a fabulous host. Being a travel nurse during this very stressful time and having a reliable place to stay was so important. She set quiet hours based around my schedule which was so appreciated. Anything I had a question about or issue with was taken care of at lightening speed. This place was the perfect location and I had a short commute to work. Street parking was easy to find. Will definitely be staying here again if I am able too.

Good afternoon, I liked the apartment, very similar to the photos. I just thought that in his description it could be said that the entrance is next to and underneath another house as this makes a difference whether the person wants to rent or not. There were a lot of ants in the kitchen and I found a live tick in the bathroom. Two days when it rained, water was dripping inside the hood above the stove. It was very noisy and I couldn't sleep. Yacine was very attentive, she gave me all the steps to enter the apartment and she answered anything I had questions about. I found the neighborhood dangerous and very dark at night. Many people frowned at night, but during the day it was very peaceful.

Warning! Ensure to take videos and pics and screenshot of conversation with the host when you stay at this basement. It’s infested with insects such as centipede and the outdoor needs cleaning. I had to cancel my reservation because I was afraid of the centipedes, I even had the host killed a huge one that was in the kitchen sink. My daughter was also here with me and she was terrified. We couldn’t sleep without thinking centipedes will be crawling in our bed and food stuffs. The host Yanice is helpful, but she will lie and plot against you if cancel on her. Airbnb support won’t refund you unless you have lots of evidence and the host is a notorious liar. The location is close to stores etc, however on the street where I was staying is very dark at night, seem like a dangerous place. The host live upstairs so you can hear footsteps and noises.

Overall, the trip was a really great experience.  Idan was proactive and helpful and good at communicating.  He was out of town when I arrived but left the keys with a friend who met me minutes after I got there which all went very smoothly.  Idan left helpful details on how to work the tv, internet passwords, and simple rules for the home, like where to toss the trash and where the extra linens were.  The apartment was comfy, and I felt safe staying there.  It has a locked building entrance to the lobby, and a double locked door.  The bed was really comfy, there was a nice big tv, full size fridge, large microwave, dishwasher, and oven.  Idan was nice enough to offer me anything I'd like from the fridge, which had some tasty beer that I hope I can find here at home.  There's two ACs that are window units but are temperature controlled so it was easy to dial in my desired comfort level.  They even came with remotes so you didn't have to get out of bed to change it.  The ac was a bit noisy, but I became used to it pretty quickly.  Most people might not notice as Im spoiled by a very quiet home in the burbs.  Knowing this, i asked Idan before I agreed to rent the apartment if it was the apartment was noisy being well aware that in NYC you should not expect silence.  However, just as he said, if the windows are closed it was surprisingly quiet. I often had the windows open to enjoy the vibrant sounds of the city.  The area was near perfect.  Grenich, shopping on 5th ave, amazing rooftop bars in the meat packing district, flat iron building, empire state, and one world trade are all just blocks away.  An amazing Italian restaurant is one block away, and the great french restaurant is in the same building.  Grocery and drug stores are right on the same block.  Just loved the location!  The only issues I had about the place was when the sun came up it wasn't possible to darken the bedroom as the blinds, though good for privacy were completely translucent, so I struggled to sleep in such a bright bedroom.  One smaller concern is the apartment is very "lived in" and stuffed with personal items, so i wasn't able to unpack.  There was enough room to hang about five shirts and a sport coat in the closet, but that was it.  No drawers or shelves were available, so be prepared to live out of your suitcase.  Even with these fairly minor issues, I would still gladly rent Idan's apartment again.  Nice and quiet, awesome area, nicely laid out space, and a very helpful owner helped to make my trip to NYC an amazing vacation!

Patrick was such an accommodating host and we loved the location of the place. Everything on the listing was accurately listed and we were very pleased with our visit here. I’ve visited NY many times and the price and location is just such a steal!  While this is a shared space, we had a private room. It was a quiet and private space overall, which was great. We felt like we were the only guests there and had the space to our own.  We didn’t get to meet Patrick during our stay but he was always available and responded quickly whenever we had any questions. Would definitely stay here again!  The location is awesome! Multiple subway stations nearby, and food places, etc. Times Square is a 5-10 min walk away too. Thanks so much Patrick for letting us stay in your home :)

We stayed at Suzettes Apartement in October 14 for 11 Days.  Suzette was a perfect host. We had a late check-in, which furthermore got delayed because of traffic and she waited for us at the flat, greeted us personally and showed us arround. She also responded to every mail and question i had and helped us a lot!  The flat is nice, clean and comfy. The kitchen looked brand new and was fully equipped with everything you need. There also was a bottle of wine as a welcome gift (we don´t drink wine, but thanks again for the nice gesture). TV, Wifi, Heater and Air-Conditioning, everything worked perfect.   Just to be fair, yes, the walls are a little bit thin, but not more than anywhere else in the world. Everybody who lives in a multi-family home knows that kind of noises, so it was really ok. No Biggie :-) There is somebody living in the basement, so don´t get scared when you hear sounds from behind the basement door ;-)  It is really just a 5 min. walk to the metro. It was a 20/25min train ride to manhattan. We preferred the M train, because it is less crowded and runs over ground, so you can see a lot from the neighbourhood.  There is a big supermarket right arround the corner. Several fast food restaurants, shops and delis are also available. Check out the neighbourhood and see where the real new yorkers with normal jobs live! We felt save everywhere in the neighbourhood, at day and night.  We would come back any time :-)

Suzette's apartment was really nice - it was a decent size, and really well located (only five minutes from a subway station, less than half an hour by subway into Manhattan on the L line, and within walking distance of a large supermarket and a couple of nice places for breakfast/coffee). I walked back from the subway on my own quite late at night a few times, and did not feel unsafe.   We only briefly met Suzette on the last day of our stay, but she was always accessible by email and prompt at responding to our queries. The apartment is on the ground floor, and you could sometimes hear the neighbours next door having a family argument, but it wasn't really an issue at night.   Overall, we really enjoyed staying here, and would do so again!

My boyfriend and I stayed at Veronique’s place for 7 nights  To sum it up: it was a good stay with an unhappy ending   Veronique agreed to us leaving our luggage in her living room before check-in time, which we were very happy about. When we finally arrived (we had to walk more than 20 mins with our luggage from another subway station because the subway station near her house was under construction that weekend), we couldn’t find the doorbell. So we tried to call her numerous times, but she didn’t pick up for an hour! We started panicking a little. When she finally called back, she said we were at the wrong place. Apparently we were provided with the wrong address! And we had to walk another 15 mins with our heavy luggage to her house.  Veronique’s house is situated at the 5th floor, so make sure you are not afraid to walk some stairs. Her apartment is at a very good location, the subway station is just under 5 mins walking and it’s a lively neighborhood. Also Chinatown is within walking distance.   The room is just on the other side of the apartment of Veronique’s room. It’s as pictured as in the photos. It’s small but fits 2 people perfectly. The bed is comfortable.  The fans were a little dusty though. The kitchen is well equipped and there’s always filtered water in the fridge.  The bathroom is really small; you can’t turn around or wash your face properly in the sink. Also the bathroom is not very clean, she puts the cat litter box in the bathtub that you have to temporarily remove when you take a shower. And the bathroom door can’t be locked which does feel a tad insecure.   Because temperatures were hitting 35 degrees, on the last night, we asked whether we could use the airco. While I was away, Veronique had a casual conversation with my boyfriend in which she only briefly mentioned about putting the airco on low to avoid power shortage. When later that night I turned on the airco, all the power of the house was suddenly cut down. Without electricity, it was a really unpleasant night since the room is quite muggy. Afterwards Veronique blamed us for not listening to her, while she has never told us both explicitly not to put the airco on high or warned us in a clear way. She claimed that she also sent a text with the instructions for the airco, which I have never seen or received. When we checked out, we told her we are sorry but she said she would complain to Airbnb about us and was constantly suggesting that we should pay for the financial damage (because of her lost food in her fridge and the tip she paid the repairman), which we thought was really unfair to us. I told her we had no more cash and it was also against AirBnB’s violations to pay without their mediation.

I can only agree with all good references. Suzette is very welcoming host, reliable and always responds immediately. Apartment is compact, clean and it has everything you need - the kitchen is fully equipped, the bed is comfortable. Proximity to subway station - 3 min. to line M or L. Grocery stores and pharmacies are just around the corner. The neighborhood seems a little bit shady at first but it is not so - actually we felt safe at any time, also when returning late. Local inhabitants are mostly families with children.

Suzette's apartment was adorable, and the perfect size for my mom and I. It's very close to the subway, cvs, delis, etc. The only drawback was the neighborhood, which seemed a bit sketchy at times. Our walks to the train during the day were completely safe, but if we had to arrive home late at night, we always took an uber. Otherwise, great place and great host!

Loved the apartment and Greenpoint is a lovely neighborhood. Great view of Manhattan and I had a beautiful sunset view every night.   There were very specific instructions for using the bathroom and kitchen that are understandable due to the age of the building.   The host himself was a nightmare. His mood swung wildly, especially at one point when I wanted to use the microwave the same time he was in the kitchen and he accused me of “ruining his flow” and “hogging the kitchen.”  It got to the point where I started locking the bedroom door whenever I came back the apartment, actively getting out earlier and staying out later to avoid seeing him, and not leaving the bedroom when I knew he was out in the common areas.   The host was also super condescending during checkout when I couldn’t immediately take everything with me due to circumstances out of my control, saying I was “always bad with scheduling.”  The apartment is great but the host isn’t worth the extra stress you’ll get.

We almost felt like home for 6 nights in this nice decorated apartment. The bed and the futon bed were comfortable to sleep in. We loved the kitchen, unfortunately we were always out every day so we didn't use it much.  On our day of arrival both introduced themselves to us. Carsten gave us a great tip for eating All-you-can-eat mussels at a nice bar/restaurant in the neighborhood.  On one day it was raining heavy, but we were lucky because they had a couple of umbrellas for us in the apartment. The neighborhood and nearby streets have beautiful brownstone buildings and other old architecture. There are several Delis nearby to buy groceries and food, which we found great. The walking time to the A/C train took us around 10 minutes. We were walking a lot on our vacation, especially in Manhattan. Believe me, you get used to it. It's a big city. We never felt unsafe on our way to the subway and back, even in the middle of the night. Though there are probably different parts of Brooklyn which you should better avoid as a simple tourist.  On our day of departure, we were running a little late to get to the airport. But thankfully Carsten was there to help us and he was calling a special cab for us to get there in time. Please don't make the same mistake, if you want to go to the airport by the AirTrain, arrange enough time. It's best to leave at least 3 hours before your flight. We would likte to stay at Joni & Carsten again if we to travel to NYC in the future.

Suzette's apartment was a great stay for the more budget-conscious New York explorer. It can comfortably sleep four and was equipped with everything you need to feel at home, cook, relax, etc. The area is not the best, probably best described as an "up and coming" neighbourhood but we never felt unsafe, even coming home at night with our little toddler.  The apartment is very close to the L so you're downtown reasonably fast. Likewise to anywhere in Brooklyn or the JFK airport.

Joni and Carsten were incredibly helpful from the very start of the booking process. They responded really fast to all queries and were very professional. When I arrived, they were dealing with the very end if s problem with a burst pipe but had fixed it really quickly and there was barely an issue. I was more than happy to stay because they were so sweet and had made such an effort to fix it before my arrival. The apartment was incredibly clean, looked just like the photos and had everything I needed. The area was safe and had easy subway access in three directions.   Joni and Carsten went out of their way to make sure I had a great stay and regularly checked in with me via the app to make sure I was completely comfortable. They even ordered my Mexican take out for me when I couldn't use my English phone!   I would 100% recommend their apartment to anyone wanting an easy and stress free Brooklyn experience. What a charming and switched on couple. Great hosts.

This Brooklyn charm was one hell of a place. Super cute and quaint with all the amenities for life. Greatly located with so much to do around you. Easy access to transportation and quick eats for them late night munchies. The place itself was suuuuper clean and very well decorated. I myself was so inspired by the decor and am stealing many ideas. I'd highly recommend staying here for anyone who visits Brooklyn. Whether you're a single bachelor or a small family. It accommodates all.

We had a great time in Joni and Carsten's rental.  It was in a great location, in a quiet neighborhood.  We fell in love with Bed Stuy as we walked around.  It was close to the train stations and there was a market on every corner.  People were out and about at night, so it never felt unsafe.  The garden was great to enjoy in the morning before heading out for a day in the city.  The bed was an absolute dream, it was hard to leave it every morning.  We saw Joni and Carsten every couple of days, as we crossed paths coming and going.  They were great hosts, responded promptly, but also gave us lots of privacy.  I would definitely rent from them again the future!

The apartment conforms to the photos. It is super comfortable and has everything we needed. The location is good, but not ideal, and yet I love Brooklyn.  Joni responds very quickly to messages and Lucas is super nice, don't hesitate to ask them for advice. On the other hand, perhaps a few too many post-it notes of instructions which take away the desire to use certain things or which make us a little afraid about using them.

We loved Suzette's place. The location is great, only a few minutes from the subway station. The neighborhood is quiet and safe; my wife and I enjoyed walking to our daughter's apartment nearby and never felt unsafe. The apartment was clean, spacious, warm and comfy, and well stocked with all the accessories you may need during your stay. Suzette was very responsive and accommodative to our needs. She was a wonderful host. We highly recommend it.

We had a great stay at Suzette's place and she was a great host! The apartment was very clean and comfortable, no complaints! Less than a 5 minute walk to the L and M metro lines (though be sure to research the L line maintenance... it is not running on weekends for the next year or so I think). When we booked, we knew nothing about Brooklyn neighborhoods or about Bushwick specifically. Once there, we did a little research and found several great bars, restaurants, and coffee shops within walking distance of the apartment. But I wouldn't describe Bushwick as a great neighborhood to just wander around in because the good spots seemed to be spread out, with blocks of residences or discount-stores in between. We enjoyed the unique spots we found, it never felt unsafe, and was a great home-base for us.

Joni and her husband are great with communication and being responsive especially during thr stay.  the place is great in terms of price for NYC but the megstives were thr cleanliness inside (kitchen had mold and odor and overall space had lot of dust/dirt).  the neighborhood was also quite sketchy wirh lot of police acrivity and shooting and drug bust during our walk back from thr subway to the place.  the crimes may nit affext thr tourists but it may make you uncomfortable.
Happy this worked out for my needs. Great if you like a hands off, hotel style arrangement. Would stay again. Some corners nearby are sketchy but I felt safe coming home here at all times of night.

Joni and Carsten are very nice hosts. Their place looks better than the pictures and has every essential facility in it. We were a couple and stayed for 7 days in September ‘18. Here are my observations:  Space: It is a very spacious basement apartment with an open kitchen. The decor keeps you happy :-)  Location: A lot of bus stops around to get buses for every part of the city. Simply Google Map your destination and should work fine. The nearest Subway station is 15min away by walk, though. There are a lot of mini-marts and cafes around which make the stay hassle-free. The neighbourhood looked safe all the while even when we used to come late at night.  Facilities: Kitchen is good. Wifi works. Place is neat & clean.   Things that could be better: 1. Although the TV has Netflix connection and other apps like YouTube, it restarts sometimes when you watch a movie or a long video. 2. There are way too many instruction notes all around the home. You feel afraid at times wondering if you have broken any “house-rule”.  Overall, a very beautiful & comfortable place in the heart of Brooklyn. I found it worth the money!  Joni & Carsten were accommodating when we wanted to keep our luggage for longer than our checkout hours. They even helped us with the taxi.   Thank you so much.   P.

We loved staying at Joni’s! She was great and communicating and made the whole experience very easy and stress free. The place was super clean and in a convenient location. You can get just about anywhere within 30 minutes! The area was very safe. We definitely recommend her place to anyone going to New York!

Joni's place is sweet, stylish, clean and comfortable.   Expect good communication and flexibility from your hosts.  This particular area of Brooklyn is still up and coming; I didn't feel unsafe at any time but know that it has a grittier feel than some other Brooklyn neighborhoods. In exchange, the cost is very reasonable, you get more space than in a typical NYC apartment and easy (free!) on-street parking.

Everything was perfect about my stay at Joni's place. The check-in was simple, parking nearby was amazingly easy to find, and the space was great. All the needed amenities were there, and it was very clean and comfortable. The location and value also were major factors in selecting this space.  I would highly recommend staying at this place if you are looking for a stress-free stay in NYC. You are close enough to Manhattan but also get to enjoy staying in a little more laid back neighborhood in Brooklyn.

The place was comfortable but dirty. The walls were stained, there was cat hair around, except for the sheets. The bathroom was moderately clean. I don't think they have done a deep cleaning in months. The cat was also very unpleasant to deal with. The cat wanted to enter the room and when we tried to get it out it scratched you, I have wounds on my hands. Also one day he got into the refrigerator, dirtying the food with his hair. He climbed on the table and wouldn't let us eat.   You have to be careful in the area because it can be dangerous. Especially to walk to the subway.

Perfect location in Brooklyn with the Metro only a few short blocks away. The check in and out process was a breeze. Suzzette was incredibly fast with her replies, which made for a stress free experience. Her place is perfect for 4 people looking to explore Brooklyn and beyond. Overall, a must stay for anyone wanting a quiet, clean, and lovely experience in Brooklyn.

In John's absence we were warmly welcomed by his assistant Alexandra. The apartment corresponded to the description, there were two bedrooms, the whole thing was clean despite numerous damages and a "pocket" bathroom. We appreciated the calm for New York In addition to a neighborhood in the making, the first impression is very negative given the deterioration of the common areas (dangerous and harmful stairs) and the exterior appearance of the building

First off let me just say what a terrific host Alice is. Absolutely no hassle with getting in touch, getting the keys to her flat or enjoying the day to day of the apartment. Check out was a breeze and I honestly couldn't imagine a more stress free experience.      The flat itself is basic but nicely decorated and has everything that someone visiting the city could need. The bed is super comfortable, nice big kitchen, air conditioning, decent bathroom and maybe most importantly of all, quiet...very quiet.      The area is good, very safe and close to lots of places to eat and drink (as evidenced by my holiday weight gain).       I would definitely come back and I can advise this apartment for anyone that loves New York but doesn't want the hassle of midtown or dull hotels  Cheers

Alice's place was the perfect spot for a quick weekend getaway to NYC. It's wonderfully quiet and tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the city, especially during the winter holidays. The space was equipped with anything and everything I needed, including a well-stocked Keurig, bathroom amenities, a super comfy + soft bed, and fast wi-fi/entertainment. It was such a warm and homey place to come back to after a long day of walking around in the cold! I went on a solo trip and never felt unsafe around the neighborhood, which was a major plus. It's a short 5 minute walk to the 4/5/6 Subway lines and maybe a 15 minute walk to Central Park and Museum Mile. I highly recommend staying here if you find yourself looking for a cozy, well-kept Airbnb in a safe area. Alice was always very responsive when I had questions and definitely went the extra mile to be accommodating. I can't say it enough- thanks so much, Alice!

We set out to explore NY and we got to stay at this place for 3 days. This has a very good neighborhood where I think many retired people leave- leaving the place quite and calm. We were sharing the house with a few other people which really turned out to be fun during the evenings where we had a lot of chit chats.  Pros - Good Ambiance, class looks (little Scary..lol), Silent neighborhood, S44 runs to Ferry in fixed intervals. Not sure about the frequency, since we decided to walk to the Ferry  Cons - Pretty Far from Manhattan. So you need to plan accordingly. 20 mins of Ferry and time to ferry to walk is 20 mins. No restaurants near. Nearest ones are closer the Ferry area.  Over All, I would recommend this place to any gang of 3-4 who wants to sleep outside the city life during their vacation and do things in a slow manner.

Every summer, my husband, eight-year-old son, and I stop in New York City for a few days to break up the long drive from North Carolina to Maine. This time, we decided to take a chance on Staten Island, and we booked two nights in the Dreamer's Suite in Alissa's Victorian Mansion, lured by the gorgeous photos, low rates, and promises of free parking (!!!). Our main concern was that it looked too good to be true--surely there would be hidden costs, black mold, bedbugs, criminal activities, *something*?   I'm happy to report that there was no cause for concern. The Victorian Mansion is a real delight. It's not a typical AirBNB listing, nor is it a commercial bed and breakfast; it's the kind of guesthouse you encounter more frequently in Europe, with private bedrooms, shared living spaces, kitchen, and (sometimes) bathrooms, and other travelers going in and out. When it's done right, it can be a wonderful experience, and Alissa's place definitely does it right. The house is worth a visit in itself; it's a lovely, funky old structure with lots of charm and detail, decorated very simply in a way that suggests Victorian richness but keeps the rooms feeling bright and open. The necessities were all there, and they were just right: everything was clean, there were buttery sheets, amazing mattresses, thick towels, air conditioning. Some of the rooms have private baths, while others share. We shared, but it was never an issue for us, even traveling with a child. And we never ran out of hot water! And it's true: you can park on the street, right outside the house, for free!  Along those lines: the house was nearly full during our stay, but we never had problems with the other guests, privacy, or the common spaces (well-stocked, sweet little kitchen, living/dining rooms, sitting porch). In fact, meeting some of the other guests (all international) was one of the great unexpected pleasures of our stay. I can't speak for everyone's experience, but while we were there, all the guests were clean, respectful, friendly, and quiet. And having to take the (free) ferry to Manhattan and back was a bonus, not a drawback. We drove down and parked at the station, no trouble finding a spot, but a bus stops across the street that will get you there almost as quickly. And the ferry is a required experience--classic views, great fun.  If you are comfortable with this type of lodging and the minor quirks of older homes, you will fall in love with the Victorian Mansion. I never met Alissa personally, but her communication was prompt, always helpful and informative, and friendly, and she was there to answer questions when I needed her. I hope this place will be around to host my family's New York trips for years to come, and I cannot recommend it highly enough.

The listing description was very accurate. We had an enjoyable, stress-free visit. The area was close to the ferry port for convenience, yet far enough away that it was situated it a quiet area to aid a good night's sleep.

The host give a lot of good information about where to go and how to get there. The neighborhood was quite and convent to the ferry.  However, the host was not on premises. We ended up have items taken from our room. When I let the host know I received no answer. This is disturbing. The beds were very uncomfortable, you could feel the springs. There were exposed wires in parts of the house, which is dangerous. The house itself is very old and needs some cosmetic repairs.

We absolutely loved staying at Lamee's.  The apartment was very clean, and had everything we needed for our 4 night stay. I stayed with my 12yr old son and never felt unsafe, even walking from the subway at 12:30 in the morning on a Saturday night. Everyone was very nice and friendly. The subway is very close and easy to use. CityBike is just around the corner. I will definitely stay with Lamee the next time I visit New York. It was an over all wonderful trip. Thank You for having us Lamee..!

We spent 12 nights here in Jamaica. We were very comfortable throughout our stay. Claudius is very professional and contacted me every couple of days to make sure we were having a pleasant experience. We had a car with us and loved the fact that we could easily park it every night with no stress outside the apartment. Everything was clean and perfect for us. The apartment is fully stocked with all the essentials that you will need. There are plenty of dishes and eating utensils in the full kitchen. We would definitely do it again.

The apartment is beautiful, large and sunny. It is very well equipped. The owners are easy to communicate with and very welcoming. We love the location - one subway stop from Grand Central but out of the hustle-bustle of Manhattan. Great parks and views of Manhattan. Close to grocery stores, drug stores and cafes. We will be back again.
Great location, Michael super easy to deal with, no stress. Place was really quiet even given location.

Denise is a great host. Everything worked wonderfully (check-in, communication, etc.). The room is not large, but enough for two people. Since it has a kind of closet, you can also store your suitcases well to give yourself additional space. We were also pleasantly surprised by the neighborhood; the people (mainly Latinos) are very friendly and accommodating. It's not unsafe even at night. As “tourists” we were sometimes treated more friendly here than in Manhattan! Denise's apartment is around the corner from two subway stations, the train connection to Manhattan is great (even at night), it takes about 20-30 minutes depending on where you want to go. All in all, we would definitely stay with Denise again on our next trip to New York!

The host wasn’t too attentive that our check in was after 3PM. We arrived at 4PM. To be fair, he sent us a message around 8AM in the morning to ask when we would arrive. I missed this message, due to notification settings on the app. This is definitely my fault.
