But I was hoping to get a phone call if he had a sense of urgency, I was not expecting him to let his friend stay in the space we paid for already. He was also not even at the location. I’d presume you’d be at the location you’re renting out around the time of check in... In general he seemed to have a decent attitude though! So I appreciate it.  Responses were not too urgent at first, which can be understandable! However, he then told me because I didn’t respond to his earlier 8 AM message that he was going to let his friend stay the night. This is when it became a BIG problem to us. I was willing to wait for him to come back and only wanted an estimate of when that would be. But he didn’t let us know, out of the blue he told us he let a friend stay instead. If this was the case, I was hoping he’d cancel our reservation in a timely manner. Or call me to get ahold of me ASAP. Why let your friend stay in the room we had already paid for? To be fair, he later offered to let us stay in the room still, but with his friend there (not in the room with us). It would have been an uncomfortable situation for us still. We don’t know him or his friend and it’s not terms we had agreed to beforehand. Luckily we had gotten a full refund. Considering he knew he had a reservation, I was hoping he’d set time aside or have someone greet us maybe. It’s my first time using AirBnB and it was kind of a mixed experience, but I appreciate the AirBnB customer service ! They even paid half of our awesome hotel that night. My only advice is, if you want to get in touch with future visitors - please call them if it’s urgent. Don’t just let a friend stay in the space without properly informing people who paid for the space in advance. It’s asking for trouble and it was kind of suspicious for us. He has a convenient location. I can’t comment on the cleanliness or anything else because we never got in the space. He asked also what the gender of my friend would be - which also didn’t make sense to me. We are paying for the room, I don’t think it matters. We just wanted somewhere safe to retreat after celebrating the New Year, but we probably dodged a bullet. We still had a good time in NY irregardless! He may definitely have good intentions, but this was really crazy for us lol.
It was a good place. Very spacious and clean, just in an incredibly sketchy neighborhood.

The apartment is situated in a very interesting part of Brooklyn. One of the other reviews described it as "sketchy"  We liked it and thought it perfectly safe. The original features make the apartment very interesting and it's very spacious. It's obviously old, but it's very clean. You can hear the footsteps from upstairs, but they start at 7.00 am, not during the night.  We really enjoyed staying here and would definitely recommend it.

Great place. Apartment is excellent and clean. The neighbourhood can seem to some to be a little intimidating at first but I really grew to love it and wish I'd done more locally. The local restaurant Basil is great and recommended but expensive. Always check your bill no matter where you go. The 3 train on Kingston avenue will take you everywhere in manhatton and get the metro card....its the best way to travel...don't be afraid of the subway...it's safe and cheap. Me, my wife, and 15 yr old came and stayed for a week. We travelled the neighbourhood and subway as late as past midnight no problem. I highly recommend Andre's apartment. If you arrive late make sure you know where to eat or eat before hand as we struggled first night and the takeaway delivery places did not understand a word I was saying when ordering pizza or Chinese.  None of these are negatives though, just advice to make your stay more enjoyable.

We had a really good time in the apartment. Located in a second floor, it is a lot bigger than it appears in pictures. It's quite comfy and warm, and has everything one might need: from toilet paper, towels and kleenex to salt and umbrellas. There's also a very cute cat that visits from time to time, and Grace is  a really attentive host. The neighborhood is quite nice, secure and quiet as well. Some nights we arrived really late and we didn't feel unsafe at all. The place is also located near two subway lines, so you can go to Manhattan in about ~30 minutes.  Even though one day we had issues with the warming system (yes, in winter), we'd gladly stay over again!

We stayed at Edmund's place for 4 nights and coming back from a long day of walking in Manhattan every day we stayed really felt like coming home. The place was very clean, comfortable and Edmund took the time to provide everything we needed and more! Details is what makes a difference, and he made sure everything was available. There is a drug store in the corner (about half a block from his place) which was great to get the basics to a quick meal. The neighborhood was OK, we didn't really get to know anybody because we were out most of the time. The only thing is that it is a little far (about 6-8 blocks) from the subway stations. There is a shuttle stop close by, but we didn't ride it, so I don't know how convenient it was. If you don't mind walking, then it shouldn't be a problem.

We found our lovely accommodations exactly as they were described. Upon our arrival, the hosts made it easy to access the apartment while supplying us with contact information if we needed anything.  The apartment was clean and well equipped with all that we needed.    In addition, this cozy location was 1 block from a deli and 2 blocks from a subway train access.  Also, an easy walk to Prospect Park and anything else we might be interested in seeing.  Next year if we are lucky, we hope to stay again.  Thank you JoYin and Richard!  Sally and Rob

We stayed with Yin while our house was being renovated a few blocks away. We knew the neighborhood and Yin's place was the perfect home away from home for us.  It's very clean, not cluttered at all, and offers a little kitchenette with a microwave and a mini fridge. The bed was comfortable and the towels, etc. were clean. Basically, it was a very easy, breezy experience for us, and we appreciated that so much during a stressful renovation project at our own home! We will definitely be booking Yin's place in the future for visiting relatives!
The house is a bit creepy, but overall great stay clean house.

Our first week-long stay in NYC as a family (with 2 teenagers) went well. The house is in reality much more dated and rather poorly maintained than it appears in the photos, but remains atypical, cheaper than average and well located. Quite disappointed when we arrived because the room was not really suitable for 4 people. : Alissa offered us (via text message) the suite with private bathroom at no extra cost. Important to note: the house is not inhabited by its owners (whom we did not see during the week) and is only intended for the rental business, we were not welcomed, only a cleaning lady was present on the day of our arrival. In addition, some tenants are sometimes very noisy until 3 a.m. Even though we have not noticed any intrusion or theft, the locking systems for the rooms and the front door are not very secure. Another unpleasant detail: the sheets are not cotton, and synthetic is not at all pleasant on the skin. For transport: S44 bus in front of the house (included in the metrocard - 1 week = $32/pers.) + ferry (free) to Manhattan: about 1 hour journey, the view of Manhattan and the Statue of Liberty are great from the boat. There you go, the price is affordable, all these little points spoiled our stay in the house a little. Otherwise, NY is truly magical and our first experience in the USA will remain forever marked in our minds. we really have the impression of having experienced a week-long American film!

The host was not present at the location which was slightly troubling to us, made the property feel less secure. There were multiple rooms that were rented out to different parties with people coming and going even late into the night which woke us up.  There was also no way to lock our rooms when we left for the day leaving us feeling quite vulnerable. The host did provide a locking case for valuables which was of no value because it wasn't secured to the floor. It was a locking briefcase that any other of the multiple tenants could have simply stolen.  Our bathroom was also supposed to be private to us, which proved not accurate as other tenants were using it at will. With no host onsite it made the policing of this bathroom impossible.

The place is nice but not for everyone, i had 3 kids with me who were really scared and wouldn't go outside the room by themselves. You might like it if you are into rustic living style. Beds were extremely comfortable and host is readily available to takecare of any issues. If you are in newyork to explore uptown and downtown it will take you over an hr to get there and same back. We wasted too much time communicating back and forth. Worth to spend the transit money at a place closer to the city.

Edmunds place is fantastic for a short or long stay in New York City. If you’re looking more for long term it would literally be perfect, especially if you have multiple travelers. The area is good, we never felt unsafe walking to or from the subway or just around. There are a few restaurants close by that take no more than a few minutes to get to walking. The subway is a 10-20 min walk depending on your pace and we made the walk at all hours (late at night) and one of our female travelers actually made it once on her own at dark with no problems. The space has everything you could need for a short or long stay, and we especially loved the shower. The TVs available in each bedroom were a fantastic touch especially for large groups. Very clean and Edmund had any amenities you could want. We really appreciated the bottle of wine after a very long travel day! Check in/out was a breeze and Edmund was very easily reached. I never waited more than a few minutes for a response to anything. Overall, a great space in a good location with a super host for a great price.  Thanks Edmund!!

Wonderful location on a friendly, shady street right off beautiful Prospect Park. It was a quick and lovely walk to visit our new baby granddaughters,  and we hope to return again and again. Richard was extremely accommodating and welcoming.

The studio was conveniently located, very close to train station , even it was not close to downtown we could easily get there anytime. Don´t be afraid of the neighborhood, it is safe.   The studio was comfortable and enough for  our family of 4 (but just for 4).  We needed a place to sleep and have breakfast because we were visiting all day.  Very clean and with everything you need, the fridge had plenty of water bottles and orange juice (excellent if you have a late check in as in our case).  The bathroom was big! Both Patricia and Patrick were very kind and helpful and answered quickly to our needs.  We had a great time during our visit to NY and if we plan to go again I am sure we will rent the studio again!  Thanks Patricia and Patrick for all your help.

Patricia's place receives 5 stars. 1st star for reponsivness and communication about reservation and arrival.  Perfect and seemless. 2nd star for AWESOME location. Literally steps away from the red 2 and 3 trains, and we got every where we needed to go with complete ease.  We also utilized the grocery around the corner, which was super convenient.  We came and went at all hours of the day and night, and never felt unsafe.  3rd star for affordability.  Not spending our entire vacation budget on a place to basically sleep for a few hours a night was a huge priority. 4th star for having a little kitchen to eat in, a really decent sized bathroom, and just enough more space to cram enough beds in for four people to sleep.  (My husband and I, and two teens.)  5th star for the water bottles in the fridge, which saved my daughter's bacon, as she lost her water bottle the first day.   You won't find anything beyond this in this no frills apartment, but it suited our needs perfectly.  PS I brought my own pillow, and I'm so glad I did...

Very nice place. I went with two friends and we settled well. The area seems a bit dangerous at first but nothing happens, the place is beautiful and the Subway is close to line 3. I recommend it to friends

Apartment very well located in Harlem. Metro station 135th(2-3) at 300m and 135th(B,C) at 600m. With the 2-3 you are 20' from Times Square, 10' from Yankee Stadium (Baseball). 30' walk to Central Park. Small, very clean 3-story brownstone on a very quiet tree-lined street near the Schomburg Center and Harlem Hospital. Quiet apartment on the 2nd garden side. 2 weeks for 4 (2 adults + 2 teenagers) you will however live out of your suitcases, little storage possible, perhaps small for those who need space and comfort approx. 20m2 + kitchen + large bathroom, large bed + sofa bed, large enough for our needs. Look at Patricia's other ads if necessary, same building. Fridge and air conditioning a little noisy but very appreciable during this period (end of June beginning of July). WiFi connection OK. We returned every evening around 11 p.m.-midnight, no feeling of insecurity in the neighborhood. All amenities nearby (shops, small restaurant, laundry, etc.) Patricia is really very responsive before and during the trip. Do not hesitate to ask him all your questions before booking. Code box system for keys, allowing you to arrive at any time. We only communicated by email but sufficient. Patricia gave us access to another apartment to put our bags down on the day of departure, allowing us to fully enjoy our last day. Very good value for money, we highly recommend
We canceled our accommodation following a canceled flight. Patricia refunded us half the amount. Good responsiveness. Easy exchange.

First, the negative aspects: on the fifth night of our stay a man tried to enter the apartment by the windows (from the fire escape stairs). Luckily, the iron protection was on, so the thief couldn't enter: i woke up in the middle of the night, I saw him and I yelled: "Hei, go away!!!!" ....and he finally left. Except this unspleasant episode, John's studio is well located in Manhattan: the subway is close and it doesn't take long to reach midtown and downtown. John have always been helpful and kind with us (even if we've never met him) and he's explained us everything about the house and the subway by email. The studio is perfect for (at most two) person who don't need to spend there a lot of time and are only looking for a comfortable place to sleep and rest while visiting New York.

First experience with Airbnb.  My friend and I enjoyed a business weekend in New York that was made easier because we had a clean, safe space to rest,  privacy, and gracious hosts.  The value and price was great!!! ... just loved the beautiful entrance area and the old fashioned tub made it bath friendly!  They supplied towels , a comfortable queen-size bed, fresh fruit and water, as well as, suggestions and tips on how to get around the city.    Our arrival date was hectic, unpredictable and busy but less stressful; The entire busy weekend was a success because we had quick interactive communication from beginning to the end with the hosts.  Note: Guests at end of your stay don’t forget to sign the “welcome wall” – nice to see who passed through. Thank you Anthony and Brittany! I hope to meet again. Debbie and Barbara from Boston.

John did a great job communicating with us and was always prompt in answering questions.  The apartment was as described in the text of his listing.  The apartment is in a urban neighborhood, and while we did not feel unsafe, it is quite a departure for anyone coming from a suburban experience.

John's place was exactly as it was advertised and was the perfect choice for our three night trip into the city. Subways, groceries, restaurants, and bars are all within steps of the from door.  The inclusion of a fridge full of breakfast fixings was a sweet touch and really took off some of the stress of traveling. I hope to have the opportunity to visit the city and John's place again soon.

John's apartment is in a great location. There is a subway station right around the corner, which takes you to all the sights relatively quickly. The check-in/out was very uncomplicated. The apartment was super clean. Even the fridge was full when we arrived. The area is also completely unproblematic, we never felt unsafe. All in all, John's apartment is highly recommended.

As a couple, we lived for ten days in the apartment in Brooklyn that Darwin and Nicole rented. It is a clean and cozy basement apartment, equipped with everything you need. The bathroom is really small but clean and everything worked. There was a large room with a kitchenette, stove, large refrigerator, a sofa and dining table and a bedroom with a bed about 1.40 m wide. Unfortunately, the TV in the bedroom didn't really work for us. But that’s not why you travel to NYC. The apartment was nice and cool thanks to the basement location and the air conditioning. The residential area is certainly not the fanciest, but all the neighbors are friendly and helpful. Even late at night, we were never afraid to walk home from the subway. However, you should be prepared for the fact that it can be a little louder on weekends because there are a lot of people out and about. It only takes about 5 minutes to get to the subway and it takes about 20-30 minutes to get to Manhattan. We only met Nicole on the day of our departure. It never really worked before, even though we communicated via email. If we had really urgently needed help, the two hosts would have been there.  All in all, I was glad we slept there and not in a hotel. This way you get to know the city and the people much better, and we also had a lot more space for the money than in a hotel room.  Thank you Darwin and Nicole - it was a pleasure to meet you! Our holiday couldn't have been better!! Kind regards from Germany, Tina and Karsten

The neighborhood is shocking at first, as it seems unsafe. But nothing could be further from the truth, it is a quiet neighborhood in Brooklyn. The apartment is perfect for 4 and the kitchen offers all the necessary utensils for cooking.  The apartment is very clean and modern, but the natural light that reaches the interior is limited, as it is located in a semi-basement, although it does have large windows to the outside. It has a huge patio that I don't know if it will be private or shared with the rest of the neighbors, but it is sure to be a joy on summer nights.  The only "but" I have is the location, because although there are buses nearby, it is a 10-minute walk to either of the two closest metro stations.  In short, I totally recommend this apartment.

The place is well located, even tho the neighborhood is not the best (police and drunk people were running out during the night). The communication with them was very poor and I had to solve by myself some issues like bad odors that made my staying there unpleasant for a couple of days. The thing that I really didn’t like was their unprofessional way to communicate to me: the day before checking in, Nicole called me to tell me they are going to sell the apt and that there were people going during my staying to take pictures to the apt. Of course I couldn’t find anything else the day before my check in, and I’m pretty sure they knew about the pictures and selling their house weeks before: they wanted to make some money without considering their hosts! My feedback is 2 stars (on 5). The only good thing is the J train close to the apt, that gets you downtown Manhattan in about 20 minutes.

First the apartment was just as in the photos but most important it was quite and the mattress was a very, very good one, I wish I could rest so well in my home. In the morning I could hear the birds and a beautiful smell from the flowers and the trees: I was sleeping with my window opened. Vashti was really nice with me, she is a quite person but at the same time very helpful.  I thought the neiborhood could be a problem but I simply loved it! The people was so nice and helpful, I miss them. The metro station so close, it was so perfect. Because I had a long stay, Vashti let me use her refrigerator and I could cook my food, I am very grateful for that. Really I could not ask for anything more. I will be her guest again as soon as I will go back to New York City where it is really difficult to find people you can trust and good prices. Last time I was in Brooklyn, before I knew Airbnb and Vashti the people who hosted me stolen my staff! I am glad because I felt safe, cherished and indipendent at the same time. Caraibi people are so nice! Thank you again Vashti and greetings from Rome, Italy. I hope to see you in one year.

If you are looking to go into Manhattan to explore the city, be aware that you are 8 blocks from the subway.  You can take the bus for $2.75 to the subway, but have to pay $2.75 for subway.  $11.00 per person round trip.  The streets are not lit up well at night and was a scary walk back to apartment if not taking the bus.  Neighborhood was not very nice.

Spacious basement in Brooklyn, 30 min away from Manhattan. Comfortable 2 bedrooms + 1 sofa bed. A bit noisy as people are also renting upstairs and flooring is very thin. Overall very clean and communication with host is easy. Check in and out is made with a locker, which makes it fast and easy. The neighbourhood is okay, but not a favourite spot - some areas can be sketchy, especially at night.

Besides my bike being stolen out the gate 😩 I Had A Greatttt Time. Space Is Huge & Clean Vinneth Is Great at responding & Communicates With you when something is going on Or about to happen. The area has great food & Is very Quite. I wanted to add more days that’s how great it was. 💕💕💕💕

Great little spot!  Stick to Bedford as the other main block off of Gates is a bit sketchy.  It was totally comfortable for my son and myself.  The kitchen had everything we needed.  It was super easy to get to the subway and get to Manhattan.  Loved it!

great gost, with a beautiful and chilling appartment. very clean, some fruits and water bottles in the fridge...  be careful if you want something without noise (some unpleasant noises during the night) and a basic bedding. perfect if you want to enjoy a good flat low budget!

Gregory was very welcoming. The space is large, clean, and comfortable. He provided towels, a wifi password, and a key when I arrived so I was able to come and go as desired. The AC in the room kept it nice and cool. Location is great, right by the 125th St station and easy to get on the M60 to LGA. There's a cat who is super sweet and will come for petting. Overall a great, low-stress, easy stay!

Very clean, comfortable - and affordable! - place in NYC. Easy to get to subways, although if you are traveling these days I would check on subway repairs - there were lines closed the weekend we visited that didn't effect us, but could really reek havoc if you were staying in those areas - just check ahead - they post all construction times and lines. Better like cats because Cody (the cat) very much likes visitors...we enjoyed him and he spent a good deal of time with us. Greg is a great host - helped us out, was flexible and responded quickly. I didn't love the neighborhood - there was some late night (and early morning) angst that made me uncomfortable....but I'm not a big city person.

I was received by Gregory's wife,  Irene upon arrival. She gave us a tour of her home and gave us a quick briefing of expectations (don't slam doors, no shoes in the home and color coordinated towels for guests...). I have absolutely no complaints of the house; it's beautiful. It even has a yard which is very rare in the city I hear.  There was an info sheet in my room with my name on it, welcoming me and it provided details on local restaurants. I don't drink coffee,  but there's coffee for guests made in the mornings. The first floor is living,  kitchen,  dining. 2nd floor is 3 rooms (Air bnb), top floor is home owners space. They do have a friendly cat,  fyi. The booking price was reasonable, but I did find myself traveling downtown a lot. It's easy to take the subway though (only 3 blocks away). I'm not familiar with Harlem,  but I'd say my only real downfall is... it did feel a little unsafe walking back to the house at night. There are people that congregate outside on the street and listen to loud music (I read it on one of their reviews and brought earplugs). They were very kind to allow me to leave my luggage after checkout because I had a late flight out and was able explore the city without having to worry about what to do with my luggage.

Doug’s place is an absolute steal. A true East Village gem that will instantly charm you and make you feel at home. Absolutely spotless and convenient. Exceptional checkin process and communication. I will make this my first choice in NYC always.

Just finished up the last part of our trip which was more stressful than the first. But super happy that the first part was spent here in Sausan's place. It was the perfect place for us to relax and rest up while enjoying the city prior to that second half. The space was very clean and definitely our favorite airbnb place in NY to date. Sausan had to be away so her boyfriend Steve took care of us and was super attentive. Even with one minor timing mess up, everything worked out fine. Thanks much for the hospitality!!

We have just stayed at Sausan's adorable studio and are absolutely delighted. Everything was absolutely perfect! The studio is very pleasant and perfectly appointed, including the very comfortable bed. It is perfectly located on several subway lines for navigating New York and in a very friendly and lively neighborhood with many restaurants. A very successful stay! Sausan had planned a little attention for my partner's birthday and a pretty bouquet of flowers. In addition, we were able to leave our luggage there on the last day during the day as our flight was late in the evening. A perfect stay!

What a beautiful studio in the perfect location! We arrived a little later than anticipated (11pm) but Steve and Sausan had pre-organised for us to pick the keys up from the bar downstairs, which made our journey a lot less rushed and stressful. Upon opening the door we were greeted with beautiful flowers, a chilled bottle of Prosecco in the fridge, along with the welcoming breeze of air conditioning!! The bed is comfortable, a perfect size for two people, with a wonderful television at the foot of the bed which made it hard to get out of bed in the morning! The Kitchen is perfectly equipped to cook anything you would need to, and the shower was surprisingly powerful and worked beautifully. The location was so perfect, with several Subway stations on the main lines situated just a short 5-10 minute walk away. The convenience stores were plenty, along with a gigantic Wholefoods a short walk away, along with Essex Market with wonderful fruit and vegetables. I will be the first person to recommend this wonderful studio to anyone looking for a cozy sanctuary in the heart of the City

I had a wonderful stay at this apartment! Firstly, the pictures do not to it justice - the place is much larger than it looks, and incredibly comfortable (two good sized bedrooms, a large comfy couch, TV with cable, AC, etc.). Also, the location is to-die-for; it's literally a 2 minute walk to the beach! It's also right around the corner from a number of fun bars and restaurants, a grocery story, a drug store, etc. Everything we could've needed was right at our finger tips. Jessica was a wonderful host -- very responsive to all my questions. Only difficultly was coordinating the key pick up (we needed to pick up the keys before 5pm on a Thursday, however as I work full days in Manhattan, this was tricky). Luckily I was able to escape work early, however, so this turned out not to be a huge issue. Overall, I strongly recommend staying here! Thank you Jessica!

Very good stay at Sausan. Arriving ahead of schedule, Sausan had left the keys in a shop downstairs. The apartment is cozy, pleasant and decorated with great taste. Small but sufficient for 2 people, the kitchen was equipped but still limited (very little storage or space for dishes). Not having a toaster, Sausan managed to get us one for our stay: very nice. Very close to several metro lines, it is easy to get to the center of Manhattan to all the tourist places. The area is not really dreamy (but very lively on weekends) but is not dangerous, the building is not very quiet (noisy neighbors at night) and the door lets in all the noise from the stairwell. The +: proximity to the metro and shops, the cozy apartment, Sausan and Steve responsive and kind, equipment of the apartment. The -: the neighborhood, the air conditioning at the head of the bed, the noise from the building.

Sausan's place is perfect for a weekend stay in the Big Apple. The girlfriend and I felt right at home -- within walking distance of great bars, entertainment, and shopping. Before, during, and after the trip, Sausan was quick to respond to questions, making the experience stress-free.

We felt very comfortable with Frances. Communication before and during our trip was excellent. She gave us lots of helpful tips, for example where to eat in the neighborhood or where the nearest supermarket is. During our stay she asked several times whether we had everything we needed (we did).    The welcome was warm, Frances came home early to greet us. The apartment is very good and newly furnished, especially since you can't always expect that in New York. The kitchen has everything you could possibly need, from the toaster to the kettle.  The bed and sofa were comfortable to sleep on and the bathroom was clean and pleasant.   The neighborhood is a nice residential area where we didn't feel unsafe even when coming home at night. There is a supermarket and some nice bars and restaurants in the area. You should also definitely try the donuts at Dough. The two subway stations, which are easily accessible on foot, can take you anywhere quickly.   I would definitely stay here again if I'm in New York.

My first experience with AirBnB and it was wonderful.  This is a really nice house. It is bright, sunny,  clean and spacious and is located in a friendly neighborhood. Our group of 6  came for the People's Climate March & had bottom unit - we could have had a couple more people comfortably.  You need to climb about 12 stairs to get into unit. That floor has nicely equipped kitchen and living/sitting areas and large windows.  One floor below (long staircase) is bathroom and two bedrooms (the queen room and the bunk bed room). The level below that has another bedroom with two full beds.  It makes the sleeping areas very private but be warned that there are steps.  The whole space is adorned with colorful walls with beautiful artwork from local artists that can be purchased.  Grover /Lydon are GREAT communicators (phone, text, email). I had a lot of questions and people got back to me very fast (usually within the hour).    In a great area near METRO and lots of restaurants and stores. We didn't feel unsafe walking through the neighborhood at night (we are  folks from the suburbs  between the ages of 45 and 70).   There are Air conditioners in the living room area, and in both rooms on lower floor, i'm not sure about lower level. I read a review that there wasn't  AC but they are wall units now.  For parking we went on parking hero and pre-booked a spot in a garage so we didn't have to worry about finding street parking. Was so close - about 3/10ths of a mile.  The Unit had Direct tv (one good sized tv) and WIFI . The internet is slow - wasn't a big deal for us so I didn't ask our host to fix it. Tv signal was a choppy. Again, we weren't there to watch TV so we didn't bother host.  I hope we will be able to stay here again as we had a wonderful experience. WAY better than being in a cramped hotel room having to eat out all your meals.

This was our first trip to NYC for me and my daughter(11yrs). Frances answered all my questions and concerns prior to our trip. She checked in regularly while on our stay,  checking to see if we needed anything or if she could help in any way. Her kindness and thoughtfulness was very appreciated.  The studio apartment was delightful. We felt at home from the first steps inside. The neighborhood restaurants were amazing. The coffee shop, Bedford Hill,  just around the corner,  is my new favorite coffee shop. It's a fun neighborhood to explore.  As promoted,  the subway was easy to walk to and get to Manhattan.  Frances went out of her way on our final day to help us have an easy departure which was not "required" on her part but done out of kindness and hospitality. It was truly appreciated and helped to have a less stressful final day.  The only thing I would suggest was more wash cloths, we only had 1. There was plenty of full size,  nice,  cozy towels though. Nice snuggly blankets were also available for relaxing ( my daughters new favorite blanket!). Nice finishing touches to feel comfortable! I would absolutely recommend this place to my friends and family.  My daughter and I will definitely be back!

Grover made me feel welcomed as soon as I made the reservation. However he was traveling during the time of my stay so Stephanie was available to be of assistance to me during my stay. She was great, very prompt, efficient, and most importantly understanding, the apartment was acvurate as far as the size but I was a little disappointed to walk in and see the leather couch with no leather on the arms. The couch was very old, secondly the cable acted a little funny with only like a few channels available. This was fine since my guests and I spent most of our time out anyway. There was rust around the apartment and thr bedroom I stayed in had stained comforters, and the pillow cases were also stained as well. It was a little disappointing and uncomfortable. Walking into the apartment there were a bunch of supplies in the doorway, which was dangerous. It just looked like the house was prepped halfway for my stay. Other than that it met all of my needs and was big enough to accommodate my guests and I. I'm not sure if I would go back unless promised that I can expect a little better for my next stay. But I really appreciated Srephanie's help she made my stay a great experience despite the little things that were a little disappointing.

There were 5 of us staying and the apartment is really very spacious and located very close to metro stations 2&3 (2-3 minutes on foot) and less than 10 minutes from lines B&D and 4&5.  Lively, picturesque area, where we did not feel unsafe.  You can hear a little noise from the front (especially the room facing the front) but for New York, this area can be considered very quiet. We had easy contact with Grover who responded quickly to our questions. We were able to keep access for 2 more hours when checking out, which allowed us to enjoy NY the morning of our departure without worrying about our suitcases.  The little "minuses": a bathroom with WC which requires a little organization. The dining room table for 5, max 6 people, the bedding which deserves to be replaced and the garden left abandoned

We enjoyed the stay at the appartment. It looks nice, was very clean and has evetything you need. Frances was very helpful. With the Subway it's just a short ride to Downtown, but keep in mind that it takes a bit more time to get to Uptown. 2 Subway stations are located in walking distance. The neighbourhood needs getting used to (at least for us 2 central europeans) but we didn't feel unsafe and got to see another view from NYC which you probably don't get by staying in Manhattan.

It was our first AirBNB experience and it could not get any better! :) Frances thought about everything we needed! The neighbourhood was very different from our little village in the Netherlands, but we did not feel unsafe and we getting used to it very quickly. The apartement looks bigger in real life, the bed and shower were perfect after a long day of sightseeing. And in our opinion the most important thing.. it was so clean, you could almost eat from the floor! :D  Frances thank you so much for your hospitality and tips! :)

It's very difficult to evaluate a place when you don't see any flaws! This place has no flaws. The subway is a 5-minute walk away, not to mention that the buses run around the corner and they are all great and easy to use. There are several markets and cheap stores in the area. As well as there are great restaurants close by. The region is extremely safe, not one day when we return early in the morning do we feel scared. The place is spacious and bright! The kitchen is complete, the bathroom is complete. Contrary to reports, there is a window and it is enough to let in fresh air. Everything is well thought out. The doors are secure and the residence is very calm! The apartment has a fire extinguisher and carbon dioxide detectors, which adds even more security. Frances helped us with everything we needed. Even when I made a mistake at check-in and ended up arriving earlier than I expected, disturbing previous guests, Frances was amazing, helping us with all the favors we asked for. There's no way not to like this place, it's amazing! I would live the rest of my life in this place without any problems! We returned home with a sore heart because we enjoyed it so much. This stadium is excellent!

Travel Nurse here and I came to NYC to help with the covid crisis! Frances gave me an amazing place to come home to after a long day of work. She is great at responding back quick! The place is beautiful and much more than I expected. Coming to NYC I was a little scared not knowing what I got myself into. But I gained a friend instantly! This will always be my home when I come to NYC! Thanks Frances for all you've done for me. Until next time!

I am really surprised that this place has such high reviews. Maybe NYC can get away with anything, but I really think they could do better here.   1) For check-in, you are asked to meet with a “greeter” upon arrival. Trying to coordinate this meeting added unnecessary level of stress to travel. Her availability was complicated and in the end she wasn’t even there when we arrived even though we had given her frequent updates of our ETA and she hadn’t told us she wouldn’t be meeting us as planned. When we arrived we were knocking on the door in the rain with no answer. I finally texted saying we are here and she called and told me the code to the lock box on the door so we could let ourselves in. Would have decreased stress a lot if we had known this was going to happen in the first place.   2) There is plenty of space as described and we all had the room we needed for a big family. The furnishings are very uncomfortable, however. Couches covered with very poorly fitting slip covers that slid around and hung loosely. The beds were not fully made - no top sheets or mattress pads on several of them and the sheets were very low quality and scratchy. There was NO toilet paper in the place upon arrival (not good after a long car trip with 5 kids!).   3) the internet sucks. Luckily we were out and about most of the time, but we did try to steam a show twice and it was constantly cutting out. I messaged Grover to ask for suggestions and he did not reply.   4) The location is so-so. Yes, it is close to the subway (easy walk to two different lines to lower Manhattan), and the part of the street where the house is was quiet and nice. The corner to get to the subway station was quite rowdy each night when we were coming back at 10-11pm, though. Definitely felt like we needed to hustle past and didn’t feel too safe.   I’m sorry to say that while we highly enjoyed our trip to NYC, we just weren’t too comfortable in this apartment.

We stayed as a group of 5 people for 3 days on New Year's Eve this year. The place gave us rather mixed feelings about it.  First of all, in my initial message,  I've asked whether it's possible to push check-out time from 10 AM to (world standard) 11 AM as it was 1st of Jan as, obviously, we would have been gone to sleep in the early morning. No response from the host there.  Next, tedious rules on cleaning the rooms and taking out the garbage and a lot of rules around the house.   Third, I do not really understand, why the most of the US places still have problems with the internet connectivity, but here as well Wi-Fi was a) non-existent, did not work well for most of the time, e.g. unable to cast YouTube, b) management interface of the router has default login/password, which could be used by scammers. Also, had to plug-in TV and connect it as it was unplugged for some reason.  Continuing, regarding facilities: the host asks to make the dishes, but no dishwasher is provided. Beware.  Finally, remember to ask for more keys as this listing has electronic locks tied to your mobile device, which cannot be shared.  On the bright side: the facility is as on the photos, close to blue subway lines (7-10 mins walk), somewhat close to red ones (25 mins walk), 24/7 stores around, washer and dryer are great.

Communication with Bee was great, she provided so much info that I didnt need to ask for anything!   After a long trip to the apartment, arrived to pick up the keys from the laundrette across the road ( they initially thought I was picking up laundry lol)  Used one key to open the two front doors, went upstairs to the apartment and tried to use the other key for front door, which wasnt opening, there was a top lock which the key didnt fit in to. After a bit of panicking, I realised I just wasnt turning the key properly, so that is a tip for those who stay here, no need to stress!!  The apartment is exactly as the pictures show, although a bit darker, as there is some netting i think due to building works perhaps covering the windows. Everything seemed to be in working order, although we didnt use the kitchen so cant really comment on that.  Area is great, feels safe, and there are loads of little restaurants and bars nearby. Its close to central park, and the subway, but not so central that it feels horribly touristy, we really felt as if we were living there!  Shower pressure is good, which is a very important thing for me when I go away. Also the mirror in the bathroom, weirdly never steamed up, even though it was not a heated mirror, amazing!  One thing to note, which totally was not a problem for me, but my boyfriend would rather not, we had to live out of our suitcases, as there was no wardrobe space to hang anything up. However I do appreciate that this is her home, but just a heads up incase you are perhaps staying for much longer or that will bother you.  Overall had such an amazing time, would definitely recommend Bee and her wonderful studio, thanks so much!!

This is a great little place located very close to the subway station and near some great coffee shops, restaurants and bars. I never felt unsafe in the area and the apartment is as described. Thank you Aspen!

The perfect accommodation for a perfect week in New York! The apartment was great, big, bright, cozy! We had our own entrance, everything was clean, well-kept and lovingly furnished. The kitchen had everything you needed, including coffee, tea and basic cooking equipment such as oils, spices, etc. The heating/air conditioning always ensured pleasant temperatures, and there is even an extra heater in the bathroom for chilblains like me :) Seth was pleasantly reserved and was always available to answer any questions or requests. Our late arrival wasn't a problem at all - a friend was there with the keys. We were also able to leave our luggage in his apartment until we left in the late afternoon, which we found very pleasant. Getting there by train/subway from JFK is the cheapest and is quick. From Newark it was a bit more strenuous, so a taxi is worth it for 3 people or more. The living environment is colorful and quiet (you can hear the train a little, but you can get to the S-Bahn station in 5 minutes). We never felt unsafe at any time. Supermarkets and options for eating are in the immediate vicinity. The train goes directly to Manhattan (Lower East Side) in about 10-15 minutes (Z-Train is faster, doesn't stop at every stop in Brooklyn), transfer options to trains to other areas are great. If we go to New York again we will stay with Seth again!

I stayed here for over a year. The place is a gem and a total steal for the price and value! I got really lucky to have found this room just as it opened up.   The apartment and bedroom are just as described in the listing. Immaculately clean, organized, efficient with an artistic and welcoming touch.   The place has an unbeatable location at the foot of everything you need: dozens of trains and buses, supermarkets, restaurants, bars, libraries, major shopping center, parks and tourist attractions.  Yet in addition to having everything you need, the apartment is in a gorgeously quaint/historic tree lined street. So you get both the good parts of a city but also a peaceful escape from it at the same time.  The apartment itself has great lighting and peaceful, clean, tranquil vibes.    Super helpful, accommodating and warm host. Thank you for all your attention and help during my year in Brooklyn.

The place was nice, spacious and had air conditioning. I worked from the office and had two cats beside me most of the day. The street outside is a little sketchy at night but fine during the day. There are 5 roommates but they didn't talk to me at all, not even to say hello. So I wouldn't recommend staying here if you're looking for friendly city guides, but totally fine for a solo trip. They hosted a dance/modeling video in the living room so be aware you might walk into live art.

It was a great stay overall! Especially the first two months until Christmas time. It was communal and we shared time together cooking and watching movies in the lovely big living room area. The way the Corona situation was handled (when the infection peak was very high throughout the city), I can unfortunately not remember as constructive. Guests tested Corona positive were subjected to strict hygiene rules. When Mark tested positive a few days later, he did not wear a mask in public areas until asked. This situation made me feel unsafe.  Anyway, not all acts comply with the same principles. Thank you!  I wish all the best, Katharina

Seth is just extraordinary with his hosts. The apartment fully conforms to the description. The equipment is of good quality and abundant. Very good bedding.  The metro is close and easy to access. There are places to eat near the apartment, both restaurants, pizzerias... and shops to prepare food at the apartment. To recommend without hesitation. You shouldn't be afraid of stairs.

Ronnie is very kind and helpful. She gave me all the details to reach her home easily and accepted that I do my check-in really early in the morning and my check-out late in the day. Her place is close to the subway and it's easy to go in the heart of Manhattan. It is very confortable to be in a private room and I appreciate the air-conditionned in the bedroom as the weather was really hot. I've been a bit scared by a cockroach living in the bathroom but I've get used to it and he finally became my friend. The place is clean but  not well isolated. To sum up, the experience at Ronnie's place was very pleasant. Thank you Ronnie.

This space is an absolute steal for Manhattan and Ronnie was quite pleasant.  The apartment is located 2 minutes from Central Park and 3 minutes from a Metro stop that will take you downtown in about 30 minutes in the morning. Ronnie was so kind and accommodating in making me feel that I was a local as much as is possible in a week. This space is perfect for one person, but it can work for a couple or 2 friends if folks are quite cozy. The mattress is firm memory foam, just the way that I personally like them. Finally, I felt safe in this space as the apartment has a separate, dedicated entrance that includes a locked gate. Would recommend this space to others.

I was visiting New York to seek medical treatment and Ronnie was very accommodating to me and naturally made it a healing environment for me. She was very helpful and made sure to be there for check in and check out and made me super comfortable when I was feeling very afraid and alone. I can’t thank her enough and looking forward to staying there again next time I visit the city !!!

I had a wonderful time staying at Ronnie’s place! The room looks exactly like the pictures, and it’s actually a little bit bigger in person too. The door to the apartment is right outside the room, so it was almost like having your own private entrance. Ronnie was very accommodating for my check in/check out times, and allowed me to leave my luggage in the apartment when I had a later flight. She also has lots of fun stories to tell and is nice to talk to! Otherwise, I was left to do my own thing  while during the week and never had any problems. The location was perfect as well - the apartment is just right up the block from the 103rd Street subway station, making it super easy to get around. Ronnie’s place is a steal, so I highly recommend to anyone coming to New York!

Ronnie was an amazing host! She communicated very well and immediately worked to fix any issues. She’s pleasant to talk to and gave me easy instructions for the cheapest way to get to her place from the airport. The location was absolutely perfect. I was away from the noise of the busier parts of the city and just a couple blocks to the subway and so many restaurants, coffee shops, drug store, etc. Also just a 10 minute walk to Central Park! Every morning of my stay I’d grab a coffee and a pastry from a shop on my way and would enjoy the park for a while before starting my day. I recommend Ronnie’s place!

As a former Upper West Sider for 24 years, being in this neighborhood was like coming home again. The location is perfect: close to buses, subways, cabs and totally walkable. The grocery stores, drug stores, restaurants, and playgrounds are all at your fingertips.  Ronnie was engaging and most helpful. Due to the winter blizzard my flight was 2 days late. Ronnie and l were communicating constantly to make connections.  I highly recommend Ronnie for a NYC Upper West Side experience.

This place is a gem! The location is truly perfect. Close to anything you might need  and easy access for everything you might want while in the city. The shopping and the galleries are a huge plus and the High Line is a close walk from the front door. Chelsea is one of my favorite neighborhoods in NYC and this apartment is central to it all!  Beyond location, the space is wonderful. It's safe and QUIET, which is not so easy to find in the more centrally located neighborhoods of NYC. The apartment feels great, it's been updated and maintained very well. There's plenty of space (and storage for luggage and longer stays) and it doesn't feel claustrophobic. Everything one (or two people in our case) might need, from internet and cable to new cookware and utensils. The building was quiet and in 8 days I only saw 1 neighbor! It was as if we had the whole building to ourselves. Clean laundry room in the basement...AND MOST IMPORTANTLY FOR ME, plenty of natural light. Both the front living area and back bedroom get great light.  And if you don't want light, the drapes and blinds do a great job of keeping the space dark. The hosts and their helpers have done a great a job and clearly given it plenty of thought! We were more than pleased. Lastly, I did not have communication with Jim, but Rob was AMAZING. He was completely available for all communications and questions, as well as a true pleasure to communicate with at all times. The check-in and check-out were super quick and easy. There was fruit and fresh flowers...coconut water and snack bars for our arrival. Rob (and his property assistants) thought of everything. They were kind and gracious, thoughtful and available.  If you rent this place, you wont be disappointed. I can only hope it will be available for my upcoming trips to NYC. Thank you, thank you, thank you for a great stay!

I work for an artist agency and a client of mine was going to be in New York City for about 10 days. She hates staying in hotels, so we found this great option via AirBnB. Rob and Jim were SO helpful with all of my questions and with all of the instructions, etc. They also went out of their way to purchase extra cooking supplies for my client before she arrived. They were also so quick to respond to any concerns or questions I had. My client said the apartment was nice, clean, and in a perfect location. She mentioned how comfortable the bed was, too. The only complaint she had was that it was a little hot in the apartment (due to old radiators that pretty much every apartment in NYC has), but that with the window opened a little bit it was totally fine. All in all a good experience and I will definitely keep Rob and Jim in mind if I ever need a place in NYC or West Hollywood!

Rob is an incredible host and made my stay in this lovely apartment the most memorable ever!  The apartment is just perfect.  Cozy, quiet, comfortable and in a great location, but the best part of my stay was getting to know Rob.  He is the most attentive, and considerate host ever...and I mean that.  After our first email exchange we discovered we shared many things in common, and by the time I arrived I felt as if I was being welcomed by a true friend.... and indeed I was.  We shared life views and experiences over a few cups of tea, and I returned home with the enrichment of a new friendship.

This place was amazing! The host (Rob) was amazing! Everything about this trip was amazing!  First off, our gracious host met us in the middle of the night at 2am, because our train got incredibly late and was still in good spirits when we finally showed up. He helped us with our bags and gave us a tour of the apartment before bidding us adieu. Leading up to the trip,  he was very good about replying to emails and gave us tons of suggestions for places to visit/shows to see.   I can't sing enough praises about this apartment! The place is huge compared to NYC hotels and beautifully decorated (yes, that's a real fireplace). You could easily fit 3 people comfortably (2 in the bed, 1 on the couch). Towels, hair dryer, and some basic toiletries are provided, which is a huge plus when you realize you've forgotten some necessities.  This place has significantly increased my standards of living if/when I ever move to NY!  The apartment is located in a quiet/safe area of Chelsea, but still super close to midtown (5-10 min subway ride). It's about 2 streets away from the 1, E, and C trains. If you're looking for breakfast, Brooklyn Bagel Co. is about a 5 minute walk and Murphy's is closer. There a nice artisan coffee shop right around the corner too!  You won't be disappointed staying here! The apartment and host are phenomenal!! I hope I'll get a chance to stay again soon :)

First time using AirBnB and was nervous but everything was fantastic. Rob & Rod worked with our random travel schedule and met us when we got there and immediately felt like home. Everything is EXACTLY like the photos and QUIET! Best sleep I've had on a trip to NYC. Just blocks from the 3 major subway lines, and if you jump on the E train you can get to the AirTrain in Jamaica to JFK in 30-45 min! Everything was super clean and everything you would want. The rate is a a steal, you would easily pay twice for this quality. My only wish was I could have booked the entire week while I was there on business... because it felt like I was in my own home and was living in NYC. Thank you Rob & Rod!

Staying at this beautiful Chelsea apartment was a lovely experience. We had never used Airbnb before but our host Rob was so helpful and the place was everything we hoped for. It was a great location for our theatre trip as the nearby subway took us right there. A big thanks to Rob.

Rob and Rod are the perfect hosts in NYC, they gave us upfront plenty of information about restaurants, shows and what’s going on in the city. Their apartment is lovely and in real even better than the pictures. The place is in Chelsea, the surrounding infrastructure is perfect and we loved to be in the apartment. It is quite, but close to all the hot spots in Chelsea. We would always recommend this place and have enjoyed our stay and meeting Rob.

First of all I want to say that Rob was excellent! He made the whole experience feel trustworthy and friendly. When travelers hire services online we always fear that something will not turn out as expected... but Rob was in constant contact during the months of waiting between the payment of the apartment and the time of the trip itself, this gave us a lot of security and confidence. The apartment is exactly as in the photos and more! It is fully equipped, spotless in terms of cleanliness and as if that were not enough, it is very well located! meters from the subways, restaurants, markets, etc! It is also very safe. On several occasions I returned late at night alone and I never felt unsafe. As if this wasn't enough Rod (who was at our disposal while we were in NY) was absolutely attentive, willing and polite. They are both excellent! I recommend it to anyone who travels (especially if it is the first time they hire a service of this style) since they both express confidence and are attentive to all the details... they turn your trip into a pleasant and safe experience. They are in the flesh the meaning of the word hospitality! Not only will I return but I will also recommend it!

Excellent apartment and an excellent location to enjoy NYC! Close to all the most important spots. The main subway lines are one block away. Rob and Rod were very attentive and friendly, we didn't need to ask for anything, everything was very clean, quiet and safe street. Very well equipped apartment, Nespresso coffee maker, dishwasher, washing machine, excellent water pressure in the bathroom, bright, great audio and TV equipment, very comfortable bed. Without a doubt we would return to the same place! Thanks Rob and Rod!!!

We could not have asked for nicer accommodations or more gracious hosts! This apartment in Chelsea is gorgeous and was described accurately with words and pictures on the website. This was my first trip to NYC and the location was convenient to many places of interest. Rob and Rod were very prompt in answering all emails and provided fantastic recommendations for places to eat nearby. Rod coordinated for us to drop off our bags early without any difficulties. We had a lovely time and would most definitely stay at their apartment again in the future!

We had a wonderful time in Rod and Rob's beautiful apartment.  They were the best AirBNB hosts we have ever stayed with; very accommodating, personable and flexible.  Perfect location and perfect hosts!

This listing was fantastic!  The location was amazing and Rob and Rod were wonderful hosts.  The apartment was clean and comfortable and QUIET-- which was so surprising being in the heart of NYC.  The bed was super comfortable and having such a large space and a kitchen was a real treat when out touring all day.  The apartment really gives you an opportunity to feel like a local-- which is pretty amazing.  Rob and Rod made us feel welcome from the very start and had us fully taken care of--  allowing us to check out late for our later flight, which was so helpful.  This place is a real find!

Before we arrived Rob couldnt be more helpful - giving me political and historical insights as well as info about our vacation. Rod was an excellent, knowledgeable host. We arrived late but Rod was there to meet up and show us round the apartment. As the next guests were not due to arrive until the evening we had a very flexible check-out. We were even able to do some last-minute drying in the washer-dryer after an unexpected downpour. Chelsea is a superb base to explore New York - it's well-connected and has excellent small bistros, cafes, coffee shops and restaurants. The High Line is unmissable. The apartment is thoughtfully-designed, has plenty of charm, a super-comfy bed, 25Mb broadband. The bathroom is perhaps a little cluttered but the shower is reliable and decent. Overall the listing is accurate and the premises tick all the boxes. I'd certainly be keen to come back next time we visit NYC.

Great welcome from Rob who was waiting for us on arrival. Showed us around the apartment, told us the essentials then left us to it. Apartment was as lovely as described on the listing. We were impressed by the level of thought that had obviously gone into everything that was provided. Everything we could possibly want was there (kettle,hairdryer and iron/ironing board for instance). quiet location but near subways and some fantastic eateries. We found The Dish (round the corner on 8th) great for breakfast And the Bathtub Gin Speakeasy on 9th fantastic for atmosphere, food and gin! (Booking essential). Overall a great experience and would recommend this apartment to anyone visiting NYC.

Fantastic apartment, location and welcome.  My hubby and I loved everything about our stay and we were made to feel very welcome by Rod.  He gave us great ideas about what to do to see Manhattan and his suggestions worked out perfectly for us.   This lovely apartment is on a quiet street in a great location, close to everything and we will definitely stay there again.    Thanks Rod & Rob  <3

Lovely space!  The apartment is clean, well-appointed, and contained everything we needed.  The location was ideal: close to great restaurants, bars, and landmarks--while retaining a quiet neighborhood feel.  Rod and Rob were outstanding hosts.  Rod met us at the apartment and prepared us for our stay.  While the internet and cable were out when we arrived (for reasons entirely beyond our hosts control; TWC, dontcha know??), our hosts were tireless in remedying the matter.  And, indeed, the matter was corrected in a few hours.  All in all, highly recommended!  We look forward to returning to Rob and Rod's abode soon!

I cannot speak highly enough of this apartment and the helpfulness of both Rod and Rob. We were able to drop our bags at the house early and start our adventures in New York while the apartment was cleaned. We got fantastic tips from the guys as to where to go for great food and must see things around the city. It really is such a lovely apartment in an ideal location and it has everything you will need for your stay in New York. We arrived and there was chocolate on the counter and coffee in the cupboard...what more could a girl ask for?! Thanks guys! If we're ever in town again we shall definitely be looking you up.

WOW!!! This apartment was perfect! It was clean, well-kept, close to the subway and High line.  What really made our experience perfect was the hospitality that Rob and Rod displayed to us. I felt an immediate connection.  Instant friendship! My husband and I have decided that this will be our place to stay for our future trips to the city.
Rob was a great communicator, love the apartment, ideal location would be happy to stay again.

As it was our second visit it was the peefect apartment to experience life in NY. The brownstone is well located and appointed and extremely comfortable. Rod was very welcoming and was a wealth of knowledge and insights to getting the best out of our visit. Thanks Rod and Rob.

Rob's prompt, funny and insightful communications from the initial booking phase added to the anticipation and experience of staying in the apartment. We were further made welcome by Rod, who has no doubt provided endless guests with the same information, but who welcomed us warmly and provided answers to all our questions about Chelsea and NYC. And Andre also made us welcome and gave us great advice about getting to the airport from the apartment. I was grateful at their willingness to accommodate early arrivals and late departures.

Rob's brown stone apartment is conveniently located in this  trendy Chelsea area. It's close to the Meat Packing district, Chelsea Market within walking distance. Walking towards uptown, it's our favorite ABC home furnishing store. The apt is spacious with brick wall, working fireplace. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel oven, huge refrigerator, dish washer, washer/dryer. The bedroom is in the back of the flat. I can ensure you will enjoy quiet rest in this busy energetic city. And most importantly, the place is very clean.   I, in fact is planning to come back early June, but the apt is fully booked. I highly recommend this place to all my friends.

From the outset, communication with Rob and Rod was easy and prompt. They were very attentive to our every request when booking and while we were there. The  hospitality was always excellent. The location of the apartment was fantastic. Multitudes of cafes, restaurants, grocery shops etc etc, transport (at least 3 subway stations close by) and shopping on 5th Avenue was only 3 blocks away. Yet it was quiet (for New York). The bed was very comfortable, with good linen. A few small things in the apartment need a refresh and maybe a bit of maintenance, but all in all we were very happy with our stay.

Craig was a great host!  He helped us get there via transportation information, and he was really a friendly host.  We stayed for 5 nights and it was perfect for us as first-timers NYC visitors to be in this location.   1. The feather bed... After a fun day of city tripping...We slept very very well.  2. The apartment is in the middle of EVERYTHING.  We had no lack of food, transportation, drug store, bars etc.  we walked or subway-ed ALL over the city and it was EASY. 3. The Kitchen.  It has absolutely everything.  4. It is all clean. I mean really.  4. The NYC vibe... If you want to be where the young people are and where you can get to all points on the map. This is the place.  5. The stairs... we loved getting our exercise at the end of the day.  If you can't do stairs you will need to do something else...  If you can .. this is a great place to stay.  6. We will be back.

Great place and hospitality! The Chelsea Airbnb, Mark and Paddington made my first trip to NYC an unforgettable one!  Super quiet neighborhood close to everything. In the short 3 full days I was there it was a quick walk or subway ride to some places on my bucket list such as: Central Park, St. Patrick's Cathedral, WTC Memorial, Clubs in the Meatpacking District, Times Square, Broadway, the Highline and Chelsea Piers. I never felt unsafe in the neighborhood (and trust me there were a few late nights of enjoying NYC nightlife) or in NYC altogether to be honest. The place was super clean and felt just like home from the moment I walked in. The window in the living room was great way to look out into daily NYC/Chelsea life while having my morning coffee and bagel (try the Brooklyn Bagel Company) just down the straight from the Airbnb. I wasn't 100% of where to eat, where to go and how to get there but Mark and Paddington were very helpful and gave plenty of advice and suggestions (try Elephant & Castle in Greenwich Village felt just like NYC and great food). Everything I wanted to do was a short 10-15 subway ride away. Once again I loved the place and my hosts with this being my first Airbnb experience they set the bar really high!

This is a lovely and spacious home.  It's rare in NYC to find a dining table that a whole family can sit around.  Carroll Gardens is a quiet and safe neighborhood, but still has plenty of shops and restaurants for your needs.  Immediate access to the F/G trains.    The home is a very nice brownstone, representative of the neighborhood.  Linda was very organized and on top of everything.  She demonstrated excellent communication.  It was a very low stress, high reward stay.  I'll definitely keep this home in mind for when family comes to visit.

Rob was just the perfect host. He was very caring, was very interested in my plans for NY and offered help wherever possible. The neighbourhood is just awesome. A 10min walk from Greenwich and the Meatpacking district and 20min by feet to SoHo. Everything you ever wanted to see in Manhattan is almost closeby and if you are stressed out by the city in the evening, Rob's apartment is just the perfect close to relax and chill out. More than a recommendation!

Lisa is really nice and accommodating. She's so easy to get along with! She helped us out a lot by allowing us to leave our bags in the apartment for a few extra hours before heading to the airport.   The room is nice, with lots of closet space which my husband and I took advantage of during our 7 night stay. (Well, it was mostly me taking up the space...) The air conditioning was a luxury during our early August stay! It made sleeping so very nice. Nice kitchen too- the apartment is nicely updated (or new?) compared to places I've lived in Brooklyn myself.   The location is ideal. We could see shows, grocery shop, dine, jog, and travel easily to/ from there. It is in the heart of it all, but somehow it's a shady quiet street with a very residential feel. The new waterfront parks in Williamsburg were a nice change from the time I lived there, and are easily accessible from her apartment.   Lisa is very easy going and we fell in love with Googie the dog! He's soooo cute and he doesn't bother your shoes or things at all. He has his adorable heart pillow, and that's that.  I highly recommend Lisa's place!

I stayed with Lisa while working around the corner - she's an excellent host, meticulous communicator which made my stay stress free.  Nice clean room and big for NYC with enough room to roll out my yoga mat, comfortable bed, clean bathroom.  And killer location.

We had a great experience at Lisa's home. She is really helpful and her home is in a great spot. Close to a metro station in a zone full of things to do an amazing food to taste.   Her place is in a sweet spot close to Manhattan but without it stressful energy.   I recommend this place to anyone wanting to have a great experience in New York.

This is my first negative Airbnb review but to be honest this place freaked me out and I think it’s important to be honest about an experience when it’s negative so that you know what you’re getting into. The security camera faces the living room (the entire common area) and not the front door. And I felt very controlled and watched here, and smelled a gas leak the whole time. And I wanted to make sure I wasn’t being paranoid, so I left a lamp on in my room, one whose light can’t be seen from the bottom of the door. Sure enough, when I returned the lamp had been turned off, which meant the host had been in my room, which is against Airbnb policy. That really creeped me out. It’s just not right. I’ve been lucky with my airbnbs. I’ve had gracious and welcoming and kind hosts when both traveling solo and when I’ve shared a place with friends under their accounts, and this is a stark contrast, where I felt unsafe and watched.

Lisa’s place is well appointed, clean and easy to get to. It is located right next to the beating heart of Williamsburg, right off of Bedford, close to all the fabulous brunch places and cafes and an easy couple block’s walk to the Domino Park waterfront. Lisa was a very responsive host - I transposed the numbers of her address and she responded quickly and even came out of her place to see where I was. She was very welcoming and Googie is the cutest! The place was very clean and she had easy guidelines that made staying there stress free.

Ruth is a very nice and sweet lady and very adorable She is very caring she stayed til 3am and called and check on me during my drive from Mississippi to New York but upon my arrival I didn’t know that there wasn’t any real rooms and that she used like what people use to change behind in plays as like walls it felt like I was trapped in a box and after a certain time she lock door so there was no access to the fridge. She also gave us a min fridge a very small on that’s used for like drinks that 3 ppl had to share and it was cold asf down there and I was afraid I was going to get sick. And she gave me a heater that was the size of a block tile that’s on the floor probably not even that big and I had to ask for her to go buy a bigger one so for a night I had to sleep in my hoodie and sweat pants.

The Hosts: Communication with Dai & Shanti was always prompt and reliable. Our bus arrived in town a few hours behind schedule, nonetheless we were  accommodated immediately and without any hassle. Any extra requests, odd or otherwise were received well which was greatly appreciated.   The Space: Actually bigger than expected and very beautifully kept and well maintained throughout.  A massive living room. The 2 bedrooms are on opposite ends of the unit which was great for privacy. The kitchen is modern and very well equipped.  The bathroom was spa-like. Simply amazing. Exceptional lighting throughout the space. The backyard was a wonderful feature as well. The space felt safe and secure from the multiple door entrance in the front to the fenced in yard in the back, and with the peace of mind knowing that the hosts were always a phone call or text away.  The Hood: Quiet, friendly neighbors; and a 10 minute walking commute to the nearest subway, liquor store and grocery/drug store made for a pleasant overall experience.    In sum, Shanti & Dai are truly world class hosts! This was my fav NYC stay thus far!

We spend a few great days at Shantis place in Brooklyn. The appartment is very nice, just like in the pictures. The area appeared a bit sketchy at first, but was really no problem at all.   Shanti and her sisters were really friendly and helpful. I can fully recommend staying at their place.

The contact went smoothly at all times and was always warm and helpful. In the apartment there are a lot of brochures and tips from the hosts to help you explore the surrounding area. We always received a prompt and helpful answer to our questions. A visit to Shanti is recommended to anyone who wants to visit NY.   The location of the apartment is close to a subway station and you can quickly get to the heart of New York. The situation in Brooklyn is perhaps. It takes some getting used to at the beginning and is a culture shock for some, as the streets seem dirty and "dangerous" at first glance - however, during our 7 day stay we had all positive encounters with friendly people.

I will definitely recommend Shanti's place! We thought the route to the subway station was a bit shady at first, but the neighborhood seemed to be fine after all. The apartment was perfect. Spacious clean rooms, a nice kitchen and comfortable beds. It's a great place to stay when you're planning to visit Manhattan and parts of Brooklyn. We had a great time in New York, thank you, Shanti!

My wife and I spent a glorious month in Elle's apartment in June. While we were a little nervous about spending a month in a studio apartment, this ended up not being a concern at all. The high ceilings, king-sized bed and extra-large sofa made the space seem much larger than its actual size. While it would probably require some real culinary expertise and acrobatic skills to prepare a formal dinner in the small kitchen, why would you want to do this anyway given all the incredible dining options at your doorstep? The kitchen is perfect for preparing breakfast and lunch but my advise would be to forego cooking dinner and simply avail yourself to all the wonderful eating options in the West (and East) Village. Elle has decorated the apartment with an eclectic vision and casual elegance that makes it feel like home. All the decorations in the apartment clearly have a personal story behind them and create a funky charm that fits right in with the vibe of the neighborhood. The apartment is located on an extremely vibrant and active street and is within a couple of minutes walk to two subway stations which made navigating the city a breeze. While the street can get noisy, this noise was primarily the lovely sounds of people eating, drinking and enjoying life (not the sound of cars, sirens and drunken brawls) and it was exceptionally quiet by 11:00 every night. I particularly liked the fact that I could walk just a few blocks from the apartment and be able to access the Hudson River Greenway, where I could run with hundreds of other New Yorkers up to Hell's Kitchen or down to Battery Park. We also spent some great Sunday mornings in Washington Square Park leisurely reading the New York Times while listening to great jazz combos and enjoying exceptional bagels. It was like scene out of a Woody Allen movie (but without the existential angst and psychological neuroses)! Elle, in short, was a perfect host and the apartment was an exceptional value. Thanks for sharing your home with us, we will never forget it.

Ok, everything is great about this place..  First, Lauren is a great host. She's as available as you'd like, knows her neighborhood really well, is super flexible, and very responsive. You won't have a question unanswered or any problems getting keys, leaving keys, etc.  Second, the location is just wonderful. You're in a real neighborhood in Manhattan. Anything and everything you could want is right nearby: restaurants, boutiques, outdoor features like the High Line and Hudson River Greenway. To have a wonderful stay in Manhattan, you'd hardly have to leave the 10 block radius around her place. But, if you do, it's also easy to hop on subways to get wherever you're going.  Lastly, Lauren's place is really well appointed, comfortable, and stylish.  The only danger is that I wanted to stay, indefinitely! I would LOVE to return to Lauren's place. Thanks Lauren.

Thanks so much Lauren, your apartment is truly gorgeous & perfect for a single traveller looking to get to know the West Village. The stair case was a little scary (but manageable) & Lauren couldn't be more helpful or lovely.

I stayed at Thalia's place for a whole month, and I loved every single minute of it! I can honestly say you'll be hard pressed to find a host as warm, communicative, and accommodating as Thalia, or a place as comfortable and clean as her home. From the very beginning, Thalia responded almost immediately to any questions I had about her place, and made sure that there was clear communication on the date/time I'd be arriving so she'd be there to meet me. You immediately feel at home in her place, from her warm demeanor and her welcome snacks in the room to her adorable Maine Coon.   The apartment is a 3-bedroom apartment, two of which Thalia rents out. The room itself is spacious, with a bed (SO incredibly comfy!), closet, desk, bureau, and an additional rack. There's an AC in the room. You share the kitchen, bathroom, and living room.   You also will probably have a very hard time finding such a clean and well-cared-for apartment elsewhere. Especially in New York, it felt like coming home to an oasis each day, both in terms of cleanliness and comfort.
