Jose townhouse was spacious and well equipped for our stay. Don’t be scared about the location as that part of Harlem is safe. Very responsive and friendly. Thank you.

Thank you very much Alice for letting me stay at your house. The room is comfortable and enough for one person. The house is shared with the family, I didn't see any inconvenience but to take it into account. The neighborhood is not dangerous and it takes about 30 minutes by train to get to the most popular part of NY. Thank you Alice for your hospitality.
Nice, very comfortable apartment, I lack attention to details with guests, the location has all the connections nearby but the area at night can be unsafe.

We had a pleasant stay. The location was great for our needs, close to 2 different subway stations and bus stops with quick and direct access to downtown within 30 mins. The apartment was historic and clean however, a few things were broken when were arrived making it appear a little shabby, and though the kitchen has a big range cooker and microwave, it lacked basic equipment like any baking trays, and only had seats for 3 at a breakfast bar. The washing machine takes 8 quarters; be careful how you load it.  Simple homely touches such as wine glasses, tea towels and maybe softer lighting in the bedrooms, would have been appreciated and made the stay more comfortable, but Orit was quick to respond and fix a dangerous light fitting, and drop round a toaster. Overall we had a great holiday, thanks.

The flat was clean and well furnished and in most ways just as described. Orit was available and responsive and allowed a late check out which was helpful . However we received this message from them the day we were leaving the uk and this caused us a great deal of stress:  it seems the flat is not allowed to be sublet so not sure why it is available on Airbnb   “Please very important !!!!  We would like to thank you again for staying with us.  We are sure that you will have a great time.  Because of a local law, we would like to ask you to please make sure if anyone; City inspectors, (they look like police sometimes, but they are not), other guests, anyone you don't know at or near the building asks about your stay. Please do not talk to them.  You are not required to answer questions, talk to anyone or let them in, unless they have a warrant, (they will not).  Please respectably just reply, you can contact the owner that is staying with us, but currently is not here. Do not let them in.  Please do not open the building door or the apartment door to anyone you are not excepting.  If we or our supper need to come in to fix anything, we will always contact you in advance.  They especially like to ask about the length of stay as per local law you suppose to stay a min of 30 days or you are renting rooms in an apartment that the owner stay in one of the rooms at the same time. Just please say nothing, no need to engage in conversation, except saying “We are only guests, please contact the owner”. If they ask for details about your booking, booking number, booking agency; Same thing, tell them to contact the owner, you are just guests at the owner apartment.  This local law, do not affect you as guests or your stay with us.  It is only effecting us and the ability to future rent.  The likelihood of someone come and ask are low, but could happened.  ***This is important***  Thanks in advance.  We hope you will have a great stay and enjoy NYC.  Orit and Eva”

Apartment is great. No issues with that.  All the amenities worked beds were comfortable.  It was clean and all the furniture was in good condition. It was only a short walk to subway for convenient travel.  Unfortunately the area it is in is very low class. The streets are dirty. There are lots of homeless.  The street noise of a night is terrible. Loud music playing people yelling and screaming all night and sirens going past. We returned late one night from Times Square and felt very unsafe walking the streets back to the apartment. After this we took Ubers to take us straight to our door.
MY STUFF WERE STOLEN. Do not recommend.

Nice host, clear communication. The location is good when you look at the distance to the subway. The street of the subway however, is a bit shady, but it is not too bad. If you are tall, the bed might be too short for you.

pleasant, clean, quite yet centrally located place in northern chelsea area. great views from roof deck.  appearance accurately depicted on airbnb site. only issues we had were the address and lockbox combination provided by airbnb site were wrong which resulted in a bit of extra walking as well as having car parked far from place in more expensive lot.  host responded timely with correct info.  i am not a veteran with airbnb, however, i suspect these mistakes were made by airbnb and not the host as we had the same issue the previous night at a different airbnb location.

This place is dirty they let drug attic’s that they know personally stay in the house and argue they were doing drugs smoking cigarettes in the apartment and knocking on our door saying sorry for the noise

Well located accommodation (Very close to the metro, near supermarket, McDonald's, quick arrival in the city center, well signposted). Slightly hectic neighborhood (noisy, insecurity) The accommodation is very functional but there is no shutter and a secure curtain only one of the 2 windows.  A washing machine and dryer are available free of charge, we washed the sheets and towels upon arrival... The accommodation has cleaning products and cleaning supplies. The host responds to messages quickly and accurately.

Tamara’s home was comfortable, clean, and perfect for my family of 4. My toddler loved all of the toys Tamara had on hand- a very nice touch as traveling with toys is not always my first priority. A pack n play, high chair, and stroller were readily available-making our travel experience less stressful. The washer/dryer was a nice luxury. I appreciate not having to travel with dirty clothes. It was an overall pleasant and enjoyable experience. If we are ever in Brooklyn with our children again, Tamara’s apartment will be on the top of our list of places to stay.

Great location!  Close to the subway, lots of restaurants, Central Park, etc.  As others have mentioned, Chester the cat also steals the show.  We enjoyed exploring NYC and coming back to a place that felt like home.

The apartment itself was fine & comfortable for the short stay. However, it was situated right in front of a train, so after 6am be ready to be woken by the sound of it. Plus 1 block away it’s not the safest part of NY (sketchy for sure).

First and foremost I want to thank Sophia again for an amazing stay. She was very pleasant and her and her lovely daughter showed us around and made us feel welcomed. Everything from beginning to end was amazing and she went out of her way to make sure we had everything we needed for a great stay. My guest and I booked at the very last minute and Sophia's flexibility helped to ease the stress. Her communication from the booking process to us arriving to the property was amazing. The actual house/space is flawless! The space is much bigger than the pictures shown. There's plenty of space for a family or group of friends. Everything inside of the home is new, the exterior as well is clean and well kept. Everything was spotless and it really felt like a home away from home. The location was great too, about 35-40 mins to Manhattan by car but I believe there are numerous trains around the area. The general area had plenty of drugstores and even a plaza with a few clothing stores and some eateries. Zero complaints. Overall, if you book a night with Sophia you are truly getting a gem, it was such a cute place and we are already planning to come back knowing that we've found the perfect place and the perfect host! Thanks again!

I traveled with one of my best friends to NYC. Since we've already been to the city a few times before we wanted to ckeck out Brooklyn this time. Mateo's place was perfect for that. Communication was really quick and easy at all times. The neighborhood was authentic and alive. It was not touristic, which we loved. Nevertheless it was not scary or unsafe. We felt really comfortable. The subway station (going to Manhattan) and bus stations (going to Williamsburg) are just down the street and you'll find rentable citibikes within walking distance. We loved our favorite breakfast place "Stonefruit" one block away. After fun days in the city we loved coming back to the aprtment and felt right at home. It's nicely decorated, bright because of the large windows and well equipped. The bed was comfortable too. We would come back again and would recommend Mateo as a host too future guests.

Great place, and Sophia went above and beyond to work with our tight schedule. We were in the neighborhood for only one night (wedding) and but for her flexibility and helpfulness, it would have been a much more stressful trip.

Mateo was a wonderful host and the location of the apartment was perfect. Super close to good coffee, food and the Subway. It made our first stay in New York a lot less stressful and was a nice place to come back and recharge after exploring Manhattan & Brooklyn. The neighborhood felt safe as well as the apartment building. Would recommend to anyone staying in NYC for the first time.

Amazing! I don’t normally give reviews only because I get busy and forget. However I had to make sure I did one for this time. This was my first Airbnb experience and at this point I don’t think I would want to try another location when staying in NY. I guess I would have to if it is already booked lol. I like everything about it. I felt safe which was important. It was very clean spacious and up to date. There were coffee, tea, oatmeal and snacks. I thought those were great additions to the stay. The host was wonderful and quick with responding. I wish I had the opportunity to meet her and thank her in person. The price was affordable and that is important. Every time there is travel doesn’t mean you have a lot funds to work with . With that being said you don’t want to feel like you have to stay a motel or some unclean unsafe place. So again I enjoyed my stay and would come again.

My experience has been the worst since I used this page, a real dump of a room, I arrived and the host barely received me and showed me the room where I was going to sleep, my surprise is that there is no bed, it is a mattress on the floor, the worst of all is not that, but that the bed was unmade as if someone had been sleeping, with the very dirty sheets full of hair, the pillows torn and without covers, in short the worst thing I have seen in my life, I was I was about to leave but I didn't because it was late, and to make matters worse, at around 10 at night the host turned on the music at full volume and started singing and having a party with other guests, not letting me sleep, a very very unpleasant experience.

Viviana was extremely helpful, I was an AirBnB novice which was a bit stressful for me and she helped me navigate the process. She welcomed us very warmly and the flat, which was immaculately clean, was absolutely perfect for our needs. We much enjoyed Brooklyn and the subway, shops and park were all within easy reach.

Cannot say enough nice things about Viviana and her apartment. We came into town to run the NYC marathon and found this place to be a very comfortable and convenient for everything we needed. Very close to the subway and great restaurants and bars. The apartment was clean and had the necessary items (clean sheets, towels, toilet paper, etc) needed for a stress free and comfortable stay. To top it all off, we came back from the race on Sunday night to flowers and bottled water left for us as a congratulations for our completion of the race. Viviana went above and beyond and I could not recommend her and her apartment enough.

A great place in a great neighborhood ! The apartment is very cozy and newly renovated, with everything you need to make the perfect in NY. I didn't meet Brinton but everything was extremely easy. I love the fact that there was absolutely no stress regarding check-in and check-out. Brinton was always very helpful. Will definitely stay there again !

very cute little place! bed was small for two people but comfortable. great value for what you get but surrounding area can be loud and at times felt unsafe. short subway ride or uber from most NYC hot spots.

Nice apartment, small but clean and with all the necessary equipment for a short stay. Be careful, however, the area is very noisy (doorbells ring at 4 a.m. on two occasions) - sleeping with the windows open is impossible. In the event of a theft at the end of the day, it is also not possible to leave the suitcases in the apartment: you must therefore find a locker nearby.

Brinton was a fantastic host. Who did not miss a beat with all the necessities amenities to make you feel welcomed + he’s friendly and responsive.   This is the second time, I’ve stayed and the experience was no different from the first.  The accommodations were impeccably clean, modern and sleek.    The apartment is in a central & safe location that allows quick access to the subway, local eateries/drug stores, a block away from major stores + a blustery of nightlife.    If your looking for a place to feel right at home and want to enjoy a space with designer flare this is the spot for you!!!  I will definitely return.   Thanks Brinton for hosting us😀

Jackie's place is super cozy and comfortable, furnishings and fixtures of very high quality (shower was very nice!). The sofa bed was very comfortable, although when opened is quite tight in the space, so be prepared to slide over your partner to get out if you are on the far side. As Jackie had let me know, there was some street construction weekdays only starting at 7:00am, but I suspect this will end soon and result in a much nicer street-scape.

This is a beautiful apartment in a great location in Harlem! It looks exactly like the pictures and is even a bit larger than I thought it would be. Brinton is a very accomodating host and is quick to respond to any inquiries whatsoever. The place is brand newly renovated including an updated kitchen and bathroom, hardwood floors, and a high-end design. All the appliances in the kitchen work well and it comes with everything you need to cook. It's also great to have your own AC unit in the summer months. The location is near some great restaurants (you have to get a burger at Harlem Shake!), a historic church, less than a 15 minute walk to Central Park, 3 minutes to Marcus Garvey Park, and a beautiful 25 minute walk to Columbia/Barnard. The space is on the 2nd floor of a 3 story walk-up and faces east on the avenue-- so there is a lot of natural light and good views of the neighborhood, but some people think it can be noisy at times if you aren't used to living in the city. All in all, I would definitely stay here again!  There is no laundry in the building or any place to deposit trash, so you have to use the public bins at the end of the block and try to avoid fines. The TV didn't work at all for the duration of my 3.5 month stay, including for Netflix or Hulu. I think this is partly because the WiFi wasn't strong enough for streaming, and in general was unreliable for work/school from home. There was also more than 1 occasion where I came home to the building to find people sitting on the stairs using intravenous drugs, so be aware if you have children.

Everything was great overall - it’s modern and had everything I needed. The bed is a bit uncomfortable.   Brinton was great at communicating - he even invited me to a BBQ on his balcony one weekend!   Very near to a Whole Foods, CVS and metro station. It’s definitely in a busy part of Harlem so if you’re sensitive to noise (which I’m not), maybe not the best place. It’s overall very safe, even though the area can seem a bit sketchy due to the many homeless in the streets in that area.

We had a great experience at Rob's house. He made things easy and was very attentive.  The house is near everything you may need and only 5 minutes walk from the metro. It's a beautiful big house in a safe neighborhood in Brooklyn.  Without any doubt I would recommend you Rob's apartment!  Pasamos unas vacaciones geniales en la casa de Rob. Fue muy atento con nosotros y nos hizo las cosas muy fáciles.  La casa está cerca de todo lo que puedas necesitar y a sólo 5 minutos andando del metro. Es una casa preciosa en un barrio muy seguro en Brooklyn.  Sin duda te recomiendo la casa de Rob durante tu viaje a NY!

Super Airbnb which has not stolen its rare pearl status! Robert was welcoming, responsive and concerned about our comfort. The apartment located on the ground floor of this beautiful 2-story building (Brownstone) is really spacious - this is quite rare in NYC to point out - pleasant, well equipped (washing machine in the building, dishwasher, etc.) and... quiet. The street is very quiet, no heavy traffic. After a good day out and about, it’s not insignificant to be able to enjoy a good beer in peace. We also liked the neat decor, the very original shower and the very comfortable furniture. Just a stone's throw away, we find all the local shops, some cafes and restaurants. But above all, the apartment is close to the metro (10 minutes on foot) to reach Manhattan in 30 minutes. There are also buses to get around north and south Brooklyn: from Williamsburg to Park Slope. For us, it was a real favorite!

Nostalgia. Community. Diversity. Rob's place is a beautifully restored brownstone. We had more space than I imagined. Upon arrival, Rob's place was a zen haven from all the bustle and noise in NYC. Though are room was not ready, we were able to drop our bags and explore the city. We stayed from Saturday to the following Sunday (a week and 1 day). We were able to be immersed in his community. I loved seeing the kid on the bike with his old school boom box listening to hip hop or passing a neighbor's house and hearing them practice the drums and guitar. We established a morning routine at Meme's for our ginger shots then Lula's for bagel and cream cheese. They have the best iced tea as well. The train is about a block from Lula's. At night, we would go back to Meme's for ice cream or other treats. Everyone in his neighborhood is super nice. Rob was very resourceful. My daughter is vegan and he was accommodating. He let us know places to go around Crown Heights. I wished that we were able to hangout with our host but my daughter had her agenda for this trip. The only drawback to this place is what I also love about Rob's place. On both Saturdays, there was a house party in the neighborhood that didn't end until late. Back in the day, I would hunt this house down and join the fun. But, when you have to catch a plane at 7am, all you want is sleep. Thank goodness, they were playing my jam. Earth, Wind, and Fire. Yes. I am that old. I would totally recommend this place.

We had a fantastic time in Rob's appartment. He is a very caring host and had everything we needed. The appartment is big and light and has a very special atmosphere with all the woodwork. Bed and sofabed are very comfortable , shower is great.  After visiting Manhatten during the day it is lovely to return to this nice quiet place. Thanks again for everything!
Beautiful apartment in Brooklyn. Rob was very helpful with local recommendations of restaurants, public transport links, etc.

My two daughters and I had a great stay in Robert's apartment. The apartment, located in a beautiful typical Brooklyn house, is rather spacious and full of charm (period woodwork in particular). The subway is close (lines 2-3-5) and allows you to reach Manhattan and southern Brooklyn (Coney Island) in just 20-30 minutes. The car can be parked for free on the street. However, you should remember to change sides from time to time to allow cleaning of the streets. It is also possible to do your shopping nearby. Last but not least, several bars and restaurants are located in the neighborhood. In short, a good place to visit New York without stress!

Rob’s place was perfect for our holiday. Spacious apartment in a quiet street that was awesome to come back to after big days exploring New York. Rob was easy to communicate with and offered some great recommendations for food and drink options around the area. Thanks for the great stay!

The quality of a Host makes such a difference.  In 5 plus years of Airbnb accommodations in every corner of the world, Rob was in the top 3 of any we've encountered.  Kind, super-responsive, very guest-oriented, but not intrusive in any way, he made our stay very enjoyable.  As seen in the pictures, the unit is beautiful and functions very well and comfortably for 2 to 3 guests.  Master Bedroom is in the back, away from the street, so sleep was easy to come by.  The dishwasher,  washer/dryer (in basement), and full-sized fridge made it easy to feel at home.  This unit is also on the First floor of a quiet block, which is rare in the NYC area - and much appreciated.  One small downside is that the neighborhood is a bit inconsistent, but has a lot of vitality in terms of restaurants (Lula Bagels) for great coffee, families, and nearby transportation options.  All in all, very highly recommended.
Stunning apartment! So much space and super clean. Loved the area. Rob was very helpful throughout our stay. Would definitely stay again :)

This place is beautiful, comfortable, and quiet, and was perfect for our trip to visit family, who lives close-by.   Rob was accessible, helpful, and communicative. It was quite cold while we were there and it was appreciated that a nice humidifier was made available. The kitchenette was lovely for making tea and sparkling water in the fridge. Thank you for a delightful stay in Brooklyn!

Super cool place to stay! This was our first time in NYC so we preferred the Brooklyn vibe for this stay. But traveling into the city was super easy. Walk to the subway was like 10 mins, not bad at all, and it took like 40-45 mins to get into Manhattan, depending on where you’re getting off. There’s a lot of little markets to get food and our favorite was the bagel pub, you gotta go there if you stay here! Rob had a lot of food suggestions that made our lives way easier. Over all the place is just as if not better than described, super cute decor and vibe!
Rob's place was comfortable for us during our stay. He was very communicative, it's in a great location and the kitchen was well-stocked. Really nice shower too.

The room Alan was a bit small than it seemed on the photo. The walls are very thin and the neighbors are audible. We had a problem with a neighbor who did not clean up the toilet and so we never washed in the bathroom. The area is normal but we were afraid of the evening. But in general the owner was kind and friendly.
The Kostas made my stay very comfortable and stress free, everything was on point and the service was provided to great standards. Will book again if in the area.

The days I actually spent in the apartment were good. The kitchen is really well equipped  and the room is nice. Unfortunately I had a personal problem which led me to cancel the last 4 days of my stay (as her cancellation policy allows). This was met with yelling on Lauras behalf when I went to get my things and angry messages afterward ,which was quite unpleasant. In conclusion, you should stay here as long as you know you won't have any issues that lead you to change your plans, because the apartment itself was good.

Laura's place for the price and location is a steal BUT YOU MUST be a cat person. Isabelle and Ellie (the cats) are no trouble but it is very much their home so if you're not comfortable with their toys everywhere and the litterbox in the bathroom then the apartment might not be for you.  In my time staying with Laura I had absolutely no issues. She was very gracious with dealing with my flight complications which resulted in my late arrival (she sleeps in the lounge so me coming in with a suitcase at 1am isn't exactly an ideal situation). As a host Laura is there to offer you any information you might need or for a chat about most things entirely dependent on you. The foundation of all her rules for her place are entirely built on mutual respect. As mentioned above she sleeps in the lounge so if you like a late night (as I do on occasion) taking care is key. During the  week Laura is at work all day so we only crossed path of an evening or on the weekends.  The bedroom was a decent size with a comfortable Queen size bed and ample storage space. As is customary for New York City there is functioning air conditioning unit, which was a blessing on those days the weather was in the high 90s! There are nice touches too, a little basket of all possible toiletries and you'll find a small selection of books on the city. The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you might need if you're going to cook at home, although this doesn't seem to be done too often in New York. There are several grocery stores within easy walking distance so picking up any food stuffs you might need is no chore. The bathroom though dominated by the cats litter box, which can at times be a little pungent, is kept usually clean and the shower is decent.  I didn't really spend much time in the lounge as the majority of my days were spent out exploring the city. Having a washer and dryer in the apartment is also a huge help. The small gym downstairs in the building is also available for your use as are the roof terraces which offer a great view of the Hudson and George Washington Bridge.  The area is great, taking the 1 train downtown can get you to Times Square in about 40 minutes but Hamilton Heights itself is full of character and has some quality local restaurants a little further up Broadway or on Hamilton Place, (Fumo is a recommendation if you like Italian).  Overall my stay with Laura was a great experience, so my thanks go to her.

It's a lovely apartment, in a great location. Unfortunately, almost nothing worked in the apartment - pans not usable, pot not there, air conditioning broken, sliding door between living room and bedroom broken, chairs wobble so much that you're afraid they'll break in half, etc. I hope that the host eliminates these deficiencies, then it really is a great place to stay.

Everything was perfect here, when you stay in Casey's room she's out of town so her roommates greet you and help you around the house as needed without hesitation and always checked in to make sure we were doing well. The room is wonderful with amazing views (Empire State building included) and the bed was very comfy! There are 5 people living here but never did it seem cramped or crowded the roommates are all very nice and accommodating and quiet. Stunning views throughout the apartment, clean and tidy (especially for 5 roommates) and we didn't feel unsafe at all in the area. It was quite and clean in the streets below the apt as well(: Thanks again guys!

This was a third-story walk-up apartment with the guest room toward the rear of the apartment, NOT overlooking the noisy street. It was quiet except for kids playing below in the courtyard. The view is to the east, which means waking up to the sunrise. The window could use a pull-down shade, but that is a minor issue to an overall satisfying stay. The room has a large table, ideal for setting up a laptop and doing work. The airbnb is located in a working-class neighborhood of all ethnicities --- a real melting pot. I enjoyed blending in with the locals rather than being a tourist. The front door to the building is next to a boarded-up storefront. Don't let that dissuade you. Inside is a quiet, clean place to rest your head and to enjoy Brooklyn and Manhattan.

The host was really welcoming and helpful. We stayed there for 2 days and everything was fine. The house is 5-10 mins walk to the nearest metro station. Cleaning was done every morning. The neighborhood might seem a little bit unsafe but it was okey.

Amir is a wonderful host, I mean, really amazing.  His home is warm, modern, clean and comfortable. The balcony, even in winter,  was such a nice treat!  he made sure everything was in order so there was no stress. Bravo Amir!!! Thank you!

Barbara is very kind and helpful. Her place is perfectly clean and quiet, which is a very good point in New-York. We also could let our luggage on the last day before our flight. We higly recommend, thank you Barbara !  Barbara est très gentille et aux petits soins avec ses invités. La chambre parfaitement propre et silencieuse, ce qui est un luxe à New-York. Nous avons aussi pu laisser nos valises afin de profiter au mieux du dernier jour avant notre vol. Nous recommandons fortement, merci Barbara !

The location was absolutely great! It was very easy to find and right near the C Train (MTA's), which was such a convenience for me. The residence was also VERY clean, updated and cozy! It was very quiet at night in the neighborhood and never once did I feel unsafe coming in late by myself. If you're traveling and looking for a convenient location that's also easy to get to from Manhattan then this is a location I highly recommend!

We have spent 11 days at Chris & Rob's house. It is very pretty and has everything you need to rest, cook, shower, etc.    We loved the neighborhood and the surroundings, it has many options to eat (restaurants, supermarkets and food trucks). The metro is a short walk away (N and W lines), we found the area quiet and safe.   It is true that it is not in the center of everything touristy but it is great, it was worth staying in Astoria since you live and feel the diverse lifestyles of all the residents of such a multicultural neighborhood. And that opportunity is unique.   Thank you very much Chris and Rob.

The “Cozy Cave” is ideal for a trip to New York. We were there for 5 days and can't say anything negative about the accommodation. The only drawback would be a missing door in the bathroom. The accommodation is about 20 minutes from Time Square, which means you can get to the center of New York relatively quickly by subway. We never experienced the area as unsafe; we had encountered worse places. There are supermarkets, bars and restaurants in the area, as well as a McDonalds and a Subway. However, you should note that the airport in Newark is a good two hours away from the accommodation, so La Guardia Airport, which is located nearby, would be more worthwhile.

We had a great stay in a quiet and well-equipped accommodation. We were 5 minutes from a major metro line (N and W) which allowed us to visit everything!! We were in Times Square in 20-25 minutes without change! Chris and Rob are very discreet but always very available and responsive to help us with our visits! We highly recommend it for a young couple wishing to visit New York!

Very nice place to stay ! Chris and Rob are very helpful and the cave has everything you need. Astoria is very Nice and the subway close to the apartment takes anywhere you need! We do not regret our choice for a first Time in NYC :)

base of a small house, Chris' cellar allows you to stay in peace and quiet in Queens. the kitchen and bathroom are very clean, as are the linens. only the living room carpet and the bathroom wall deserve a refresh (as well as the shower curtain). not suitable for people who are too tall, the ceiling is 1m85. the area is very quiet in the evening and safe. accessibility to Manhattan by the N (or W) line is perfect. a haven of peace.

Just as described.. clean, updated, stocked full of amenities. Super neighborhood, everything was close by...Subway was 2 blocks and 15 minutes to midtown. Street parking wasn’t a hassle.. I will look to stay at Passang’s place when I’m in the city again. Thanks for a great, stress free stay!
Chris and Rob’s place is exactly as described. It’s a 15-minute walk to the N/W subway line which takes you straight through the entirety of Midtown and Lower Manhattan. It’s a nice comfy space.

Great, comfortable space for a trip to NYC! We got rained in on our last day so we spent it playing NES games and watching tv. We ordered takeout from a variety of local restaurants. Parking was really convenient which took off a lot of stress. Very cozy, as the name suggests!

Good: - the space is very clean  - is well decorated  - the kitchen is very complete  - wifii works very well - metro is close  - neighbor is so good  Bad things : - is so far from the most of NY atractions, it takes around 1hr in metro goes to any place  - is a basement so you hear everything of the above floor , this is so bad and uncomfortable   - the entrance is so bad, they need to improve that   - you have inside the house a big gas heater. This seems dangerous

The stay was perfect, Passang is a very available host and also very discreet. Despite a big delay in our flight, Passang waited for us very late at night to show us the apartment. He was very responsive for our baby's bed, changing towels, trash cans, luggage... The only negative point is the noise from the family upstairs, early in the morning and early evening but nothing serious. The apartment is very well located, the metro line takes you directly to Times Square, perfect.

This was my second time being hosted by Michael and Arlene. The room is very clean and comfortable with a spacious closet full of hangers.  This time I came in winter and the heating system was excellent. The room has a minibar, microwave, plate, mug, cutlery, dishcloth, tray, coffee, sugar, TV with Netflix and fast internet. The bathroom is extremely clean and well maintained.  I stayed for 7 days and had 3 changes of towels and 2 changes of sheets and pillowcase... Everything was perfect! The neighborhood is peaceful and quiet, with a lot of people walking in the streets, but it is not dangerous. There are 3 train stations nearby, the closest being 2 blocks away. I will come back here whenever I come to New York.

Excellent room. Sparkling clean. All amenities of a hotel. Accurate description. Very close to subway. Smells really nice. Only drawback is the neighborhood- which gives a shady feeling. Host was good.

We stayed as a couple for 10 days at the end of November. Pros: The location of the apartment is superb - just 2 blocks from the 7 line subway station and around 15 minutes into Grand Central.  There are supermarkets, banks and a wide variety of restaurants within easy walking distance of the apartment. The neighbourhood feels safe and the apartment seemed secure. The bed is comfortable and the apartment is a good size. Cons The family noise is intolerable! Passang, his wife, baby, 2 small sons and teenaged daughter all live above the Airbnb. Their apartment has wooden floors throughout and it appears, little or no acoustic insulation. The boys are permitted to run around from 7am (or earlier) every day and this continues well into the evening. The worst thing however is that the daughters room is immediately above the Airbnb bedroom. The floors creak constantly and on 2 nights of the 10 we stayed, we got literally no sleep as she was up (with a friend on at least one night), walking around, dropping things, opening drawers and it seemed, moving furniture! She also gets up at 5.30 every morning so don't expect much sleep! This had a major impact on our ability to enjoy our holiday. The WiFi is poor and is very unreliable. Due to a large wooden extension being built on the family floor, phone signal (including mobile data) to the Airbnb is nonexistent (AT&T) and I could only make calls by going out in the garden area (in December!) The TV shows Netflix only.  This was very disappointing to us as we like to experience the culture of the place we're visiting and local TV is one way to get a feel for this.  Passang did bring us an indoor aerial which gave us three channels but this worked only intermittently and was not reliable. The apartment is very dark (due to the family's extension) and has only 2 windows and a door so there is no through draught. I feel that ventilation in the summer would be an issue and the air conditioning in the description is a single portable column unit. The family had cleared out most of the cutlery (we had to ask for dinner knives) and there is limited glassware and mugs. No 'basics' were provided for our arrival (milk, a little coffee, oil etc) and we even had to ask for toilet roll! Despite showing a bath on the apartments description, this could not be used as no plug is provided. We didn't find Passang very hospitable. He did ask us upstairs on thanksgiving day but I suspect that was due to him having lots of friends over and we'd already complained about the noise! We asked for restaurant recommendations and his response was 'we don't really go out to eat'. When you're hosting, isnt it your job to know what the local area has to offer? Communication was not great with several messages unanswered and we felt we were considered a nuisance if we asked him for anything. We have stayed in Airbnb (or equivalent) all over the world for many years and without doubt, this was our worst experience.

I had a nice and comfy stay at Michael's. But some people told me that the neighborhood isn't that safe and is a little dangerous for woman that are travelling alone. So be careful and don't go outside at night when you're alone! I was a little sad that the host didn't tell me anything about this but the room itself was perfect!

Very close to public transportation, restaurant, stores, parks and supermarket. Apartment has every amenity you can think of. Passang made sure even disinfectants were available at a scary time like now.

Two friends and I went to Matias’ place for 1 week and we spent a great time there. The apartment is cozy, big enough for three people and the location is perfect if you don’t want to feel the stress of the city 24-7. It is placed in the heart of Williamsburg, a nice lively hood with cafes, shops and clubs and only 1 stop away from manhattan by subway. Besides, Matias is really cool and helpful with us, so if we get back ti NY, we will go to Matias’ place again with no doubt.

I was a bit nervous about the check in procedure, but it was easy as pie. Great location. The outside and the stair well seemed sketchy at first, but it was fine and the apartment is great.  The location is also great - easy walk to theaters and pretty much everything else needed. I had a few questions leading up to the stay and Trevor was very responsive and informative. I highly recommend booking with him and will definitely stay here again.

An absolutely great place to stay in Brooklyn! Very close to the G and C, around the corner from all kinds of yummy restaurants and cute bars. Eric was the ideal host, he had everything set up perfectly when we arrived—clean, accessible, fridge stocked with eggs and non-dairy options, a map of favorite places in the neighborhood. It felt very comfortable and quickly became our home for the week. I visit NYC often and am usually hesitant about trusting places to stay (there are so many scams out there!) but this was truly one of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve ever had.

Great room, great host, great location. You can easily find several subways good restaurants, banks, and Starbucks nearby. I can't say how much I like this period in Rocky's place. It's a very cozy and clean room with suspicious closet, and a comfortable big bed. Rocky always keeps her house very clean with a nice smell. She's very hospitable, and gives you enough privacy. She let me use all the equipment in the kitchen, and when I found out I forgot to pack my shampoo she kindly offered hers to me. She treats me like family, which is very touching. She doesn't have coffee machine in her house (she offered to buy one but I refused because I don't really need it) so she texted me all the good coffee places in the neighborhood, and you can definitely trust a local New Yorker's recommendation. And she has a cute little girl who is a real doll, she is quiet and polite. You can never see child screaming and running around like other families. BTW I really like the picture of that little girl in a blue dress, I saw it everyday and I have to say, it's really adorable,like an angel. To sum up, i highly recommend this place! Five stars!

Had the best stay at Ruben’s! It was the best air bnb I’ve stayed in the US so far, not only because of where it was located but also because of how clean the space was, how wonderfully sunny my bedroom was and for Tora the cat who has stolen my heart. Honestly would love to stay again in the future!

Ruben cancelled the booking whilst I was on the plane, and did not inform me prior to this so I realised when I logged back in at the airport via Airbnb customer service.  This is quite an unsafe behaviour for a solo woman traveler.

Very cool appartement. The bedroom is big and stylish. The building is very close to the subway which makes it easy to go anywhere in NYC. I didn’t feel unsafe in the neighborhood at all. Rocky and her daughter are lovely. I definitively recommend staying there when in New York.

Great room! Chips apartment is a great deal! The room is perfectly furnished.  Chip and Kathy even provided a desk for me, as I am a student I requested them to put a desk in the room so I could study and they did that before I arrived! The bed was a little bit to hard for me, but I put a sleeping bag on top of it and then it was good. Furthermore, the kitchen has everything you could wish for and the bathroom is as you need it. The only thing that was a bit disturbing to me is that I could not lock the bedroom door itself. Only the apartment door could be locked, but Chip and Kathy keep that door open often so I felt a little bit unsafe that my stuff would not be stolen. Nothing happened, but I would recommend that a lock is put on the bedroom door.

A superb stay. This home is a bohemian paradise with local art covering the walls, bookshelves of art tomes in the room and old exposed brick lining the halls. The home is old and eclectic which is part of the charm. Chip and his family are a delight and wonderfully welcoming. They respond positively and accommodated all my requests My favorite thing about the home is how quiet it is. Some single-rooms in the city are noisy and chaotic. The minute you step into this unit you get stability and calm. There are several other guests living here. Some are long term. Everyone was very friendly and considerate. You are sharing the bathrooms and shower with many people but I was pleased how well it functioned. It’s hard to believe their are multiple tenants considering how calm and quiet it is. The only thing I didn’t love were the door closures. The front door is never locked and the bathrooms only close with lightweight hooks. Their family has lived their for decades and have never had a problem. I love that. And to be clear, I had no problems during this stay. My discomfort is that in other cities, with other renters, I’ve had unsafe experiences that have left me with anxiety. If you have a safety/security anxiety, this is something you’ll want to know before your visit. It was the initial period before I trusted my surroundings that was uncomfortable. That being said, after living there for two months and experiencing the neighbors in the unit and building, I would be comfortable (and happy) going back. They are certainly at super host level.

I highly recommend that you stay at this place. I say this for 3 key reasons:  1. The space is great. I've rented entire homes in NYC through Airbnb that were only a bit bigger than this room. Everything is clean and well taken care of.  2. The location is great. It's about a 5 min walk to the subway, which provides cheap and easy access to anywhere else you want to go in the city.  3. Ruth is a wonderful host. I only briefly interacted with her and her son Jeremy, but they both provided excellent communication, which made my stay easy and stress-free. They're both very nice as well

Paulette and her husband were fantastic hosts!! I cannot say enough amazing things about Paulette and how she exceeded my expectations!! She quickly made me feel like I was literally a part of her family and made me feel at ease and at home. She could feel my stress upon arrival and took great care of me, making me coffee and toast... took me where I needed during my stay and took such amazing care of me as if I was truly truly one of her own! I am so grateful that Paulette's place was available for me so close to the airport, easily accessible, quick check in, clean and comfortable, more than outstanding! If I ever need to stay in New York again, I will stay with Paulette and I recommend her place to everyone. Thank you so much Paulette for being my Godsend those 4 days!! You are truly a gem and are a piece of my heart now forever!! 💗

I made a last-minute reservation with Paulette due to a cancelled flight. She was a thoughtful host, who waited for me despite my late arrival. The room itself is spacious, comfortable, and clean. It's close to the airport, though I must stress this: take an Uber there. I was unfortunate enough to naively believe in the honesty and directional sense of a yellow cab driver who "got lost" - it took me an hour to get to Paulette's place and cost me $40. An Uber would get you there in 7mins or less, and it's $13.

Ruth was an incredibly gracious host. She is an amazing person (and very interesting, so if you have a couple of minutes I would definitely recommend talking to her about her amazing career). She is very nice, friendly, and had tons of tips for us. She was very honest and told me right away that her there were many stairs and that it might be a little hard to carry the bag upstairs. But honestly the stairs are worth it because the house is beautifully decorated and the bedroom and bathroom were pretty spacious. The subway is 2 blocks away and takes you anywhere in 40 minutes. It’s really well connected. The area is extremely safe (trust me, I checked each and every crime map there is of NYC) and there are a couple of cute venues to eat and have a good time. I would definitely recommend staying at Ruth’s house.
It's a nice place. It appears to be unsafe but it was safe. I liked the room. It was really nice and quite

As an actor my day and night is filled with constant work, running around and tiredness. All i want after a gig is to come home to a clean bed and some good grub to eat. As i stepped foot into the home, from first glance the place looked alright till i went towards the fridge for some leftover grub i had stored in the fridge earlier. I was greeted with ants crawling over the food. As i killed the ants and threw out the food i decided to call it a night but was greeted with a centipede crawling on the bed besides me, causing me to have an anxiety attack. I decided to disregard it until morning time as i was prepared to shower before my next gig i see the water from the shower i had the day before still lingering in the bathtub. I was nauseous afterwards. To end my trip i proceeded to the kitchen once again after work with a fresh box of food and within 5 minutes ants crawled all over it and at this point i decided to sleep on the chair, as it seemed like the only item that hadn’t been touched by a bug or overflowed with water. My experience was unpleasant.

This AirBnb is a great location and spacious place for you to come home to after an extended long day out in the NYC area. Walking distance to the Subway and close enough to a short walk to restaurants and a grocery store. Never felt unsafe in the neighborhood and the host was always welcoming and able to be reached via communication.       2 bedrooms high ceilings stove fridge and common space are all a plus. Would defiantly recommend and stay here again.

I liked Jorge’s place and would stay there again. Jorge himself was extremely communicative, and took extra steps to be accommodating and helpful. When the toilet got clogged, he came all the way out as soon as he could to bring a plunger. The place itself was quite clean and spacious.  A few issues: - the second bed in the room doesn’t have an AC vent dedicated to it, so that one gets quite hot (while the other bed has an AC vent right in front of it, which is nice) - I couldn’t figure out how to get the TV to work, and I consider myself quite tech savvy. It was a bit late, so I chose not to disturb Jorge, although I’m sure he would’ve been very helpful in helping me figure it out - Most Airbnb’s I stay at offer shampoo, body wash, etc., but it was conspicuously absent here  - The elevator in the building sometimes randomly gets stuck for a few minutes. You just have to wait till it settles itself. Not scary, just kinda annoying - The WiFi wasn’t as fast as I would’ve liked, video streaming would cut out sometimes and you’d have to wait a few minutes for it to speed up again.  All that being said, I like the location, it was clean and comfortable, and Jorge was friendly, so I’d probably stay again.
I didn't sleep there !!!!! House around there look great but this house look nobody live inside :(  I'm scared and find another hotel

In my experience Airbnb can be very hit and miss... But Laura's pad was definitely a BIG hit! Mine was a very last minute booking but she accommodated me quickly and kindly. The apartment is surprisingly spacious- high ceilings, independent air con and heat, heaps of light and you get use of the garden from your own door, which is fab for after a day's exploring. It's a garden apartment - I've stayed in smaller studios to be honest! The layout is superb too so that lounge, kitchen and bathroom are situated in-between the two bedrooms- honestly I thought Laura had moved out twice ;-) Kindly she'll share her work schedule with you, which is mostly evening shifts so more often than not you can cook your own meal in the swanky kitchen, have a leisurely bath in luxury and retire to your room to give Laura space later when she likes to cook after work. The only negative is there can be noise - it is Brooklyn which is New York's renovation nabe, but it's nothing ear plugs won't shut out and you'll get that anywhere in the area. For me a real plus was the proximity to three subway lines: the J is 2 blocks away with good grocery stores nearby (even some organic) and a great launderette (Laura will advise you happily). The M is about the same distance in the other direction with a good deli and pizza plus a couple of nice bars for when you get back from Manhattan (the Bushwick Public House - great Wifi, cocktails and alternative music, or Juno - a stylish Brooklyn bar/restaurant). My 'find' was to use the B38 bus on Dekalb (1 block L/R and use your Metrocard like on the subway) to get to the L train. Honestly I'd recommend taking more than just a few days at Laura's if you can - you'll be into Manhattan fast and easily and in a choice of ways, then feel super homey and relaxed when you return. Don't miss out on this place if you're looking for a quality apartment - I suspect it's a rare find for NYC shared accommodation and it nails the spirit of Airbnb in my opinion. Thank you Laura for a lovely time.

Sidney is probably the best host we ever had. We had very interesting talks, he's allways helpful if we had a question and when he says "Feel like home" than he means it. We stayed for two weeks and his house was perfect for our trip. It lies in a very beautiful area and is a good contrast to busy, loud and sometimes stressful Manhattan. When we are in New York the next time, we already know where we want to stay!

Sid was a very hospitable person, I  just feel his place needs a bit of work, beginning with the exterior of the house, a little paint job would work wonders. The holes in the front porch floor is very dangerous especially at night when there is no outside lighting. The lack of faucet knobs in the shower seem like it could be an easy fix but has been mentioned in previous reviews as well. We were allowed to check in early,  and for that we were very grateful. I think, with some work the place could be acceptable for Airbnb I don't think it is now. Great guy but I wouldn't return or recommend it.
Richard saved me! If it wasn't for him I would've been homeless! The place is beautiful and it's all anyone could ask for! Stay here!

I was very disappointed with my experience which I was highly anticipating with my 13 year old daughter. In accordance with the homeowner's photos and "reviews", I was expecting a nice clean apartment in a good neighborhood.  Upon arriving, I was appalled and distraught by the lousy neighborhood. In fact, our Uber driver recommended that we do not walk around our neighborhood past nightfall. Drug dealers were not abashed to be selling drugs within eyesight of the police station during the day. I did not feel safe with my daughter. Upon entering the apartment, I observed that the accommodation wasn't in tune with the pictures taken to represent it. Furthermore, the tub was filthy, had mold all around the edge, and was semi clogged leaving me standing in two inches of bath water which I'm sure isn't hygienic. The shower curtain was dingy and there were only two bath towels to use the whole stay. Which brings me to the mold on the kitchen sink and the lack of paper towels and dish soap. The "courtyard" was disheveled, dilapidated and dirty. The rotten cherry on top? There was no relief from the insufferable heat inside. In knowing that we were going to stay eight days, I expected much more based on the cost and extra fees he charged us. In a nutshell, this place is abominable and needs much improvement.

Unfortunately, I felt very unwelcome during my stay. As one reviewer pointed out, Zach and Orlando frequently play music and talk throughout the night. I should've called it quits within the first hour I checked in as Orlando was blasting The Pussycat Dolls and Madonna for hours on end (so loud you could actually hear it from outside the building) while I was trying to sleep. Thankfully I am a deep sleeper, but who wants to hear garbage music and cackling at all times of the day? Not me. (P.S. Some people in the reviews have complained that the neighborhood is loud. Literally everywhere in New York is loud; in fact in comparison to prior experiences in NYC, this is one of the quietest neighborhoods I've been in... But saying the street is loud is an invalid complaint. You'd have the same issues, if not more, if you stayed at The Plaza. If you really need a quiet neighborhood and want a similar value, I recommend you look at Staten Island instead).  I also saw way too much of these guys' bodies... Orlando especially walks around near naked often and I really don't think that's appropriate. :-)  As of July 2019, the photos are inaccurate: instead of a mirrored fireplace and a lounge chair, there's an office desk, a plant, and a foldout chair. In fact, there are no usable mirrors in the apartment so if you need to check out your outfit, you'll have to take photos of yourself. (Literally the main reason I booked this place was because unlike many other listings, it showed that it had a mirror).  Other things of note: they never refilled their hand soap in the main bathroom during the week I was there that I just ended up buying my own.   Extremely impersonable, isolating experience and I constantly felt some passive aggressiveness and hostility throughout my stay. I wanted to vibe with them, but they were completely closed off and disinterested. I felt as if I had to walk on eggshells as there was this vibe that I was intruding whenever they were in the apartment. In short, I never felt like I could fully relax or be at home.   The only redeeming qualities about this trip were that the bed was comfortable and that they had cute dogs (but I will point out that the bed is short; I fit fine because I'm 4'11", but from the tippy-top of the bed, there's only about 5 more inches of space before your ankles are hanging off).  This obviously wasn't an Airbnb nightmare, but a lot of things were off and it was an added amount of stress staying here. Moral of the story is that it seemed like a good deal at time of booking, but honestly, it wasn't worth it. I wouldn't come back and if any of things I mentioned above irk you, I wouldn't recommend that you stay either.

The overall stay was mediocre this wasn't my first experience staying in an Airbnb, the neighborhood was ideal but the maintenance of the actually apartment needs to be improved. She should also advise that there is a shifty landing spot on the steps and that the apartment is in the basement. The "private' entrance is the back ally which isn't well lit, it was quite dark I was a little scared even though I was with my boyfriend. The place was poorly described and she omitted a lot. If I had another option I definitely would have stayed elsewhere.

Loved my stay at Zach’s well located and absolutely stylish digs! Bedroom was clean with lots of natural light, beautiful decor. I felt comfortable and safe. I came and went as often as I pleased, encountering Zach here and there. The house dogs are so sweet and the perfect cuddlers, if you’re open to that! Zach had great recommendations for local eateries and shopping. He does in fact have an amazing record collection, don’t be afraid put some on! Would definitely book again for an NYC trip :)

Kaitlyn was a great host, always very welcoming and attentive to any questions I had. Everything was laid out perfectly, and there was never any confusion or hassle. The apartment is cutely decorated, the bed and room were comfortable, and everything was very clean. The subway was located very close, and I never felt unsafe walking between there and the apartment building. I would highly recommend staying!

Kaitlyn’s place is exactly as shown in the pictures, very tidy and clean overall. She provides a very comprehensive arrival guide to the apartment and plenty of recommendations and directions. Even though the bed looks small in the pictures, I found it was super comfortable, very soft and cozy. The room is small but large enough for solo travelers. It is true that the area around the apartment is quite loud, with airplanes flying overhead and ambulances from the nearby hospital blaring almost 24/7. A set of earplugs and eyeshades were ready in the room for that purpose, along a complete set of toiletries. There are no interesting eateries or bars right at the doorstep, but many can be found in the area in about 10-15 minutes walk. Be aware that the Brooklyn Broadway throughfare can get quite sketchy at night though. The proximity to the M and G subway lines is a great plus, travel to Manhattan or downtown Brooklyn is very convenient. All in all a very good price/quality ratio for an expensive city and no complaints about the apartment!

Mike is a very friendly, welcoming and respectful person. He is there when you need him and will help you to get around in Williamsburg and New York. But he also respects your privacy and you won’t even notice if he is there ;). The appartment  is clean, nice, comfortable and perfectly located in a really nice neighborhood. The appartment is in a quiet area so you won’t have problems with unpleasant noises during the night. It was a great stay. We would definitely recommend this to anyone who want to visit New York.

Mike should be more honest about the place on his profile, especially about the privacy as I felt unsafe.  The room for his guests does not have a proper door.  It is glass with a curtain. Also there is no lock  on the outside or inside doors.   When I was there, he was inviting people over to his place without a heads up to me.  I had no awareness when he invited someone over which he states is his girlfriend, to spend the night.  They were making very loud noises and he tried to mask it by turning up the TV, which did not help, as I was in the next room.  The next morning we grabbed a coffee together, and I was hoping that he would be honest or mention something to me about the girl he brought home the previous night.  Needless to say,  he did not say anything to me until I sent him a text to ask who was the other person in the apartment. He tried to play it off by saying it was his girlfriend and she did not want to stay at her own place the night before, but this is very unprofessional, especially if you are housing an airbnb guest. I should not have to be concerned about his personal life as an occupant in his residence that he uses for Airbnb.  A host should not be telling his guest his personal life and problems.  If I would have known that there was going to be another person sharing the common area, I would have chosen another option such as a hostel.  Hostels even provide lockers or a place for safekeeping, which was not offered at Mike’s rental.  I am a woman that is traveling internationally alone and have expensive work equipment with confidential information.  There was NO lock on the door, and I did NOT feel safe the whole time I was there.  He was with his girl next room with the tv loud midnight to almost 3am What a nightmare.

Andria is the perfect host and really goes above and beyond. The place is spotless and comfortable.  The location isn't the greatest. It does take a while to get into Manhattan and although it's fine during the day to walk back, it was a bit scary at night (although literally a one minute walk back. The flat is very very secure, but there was a big party one night and did hear some shots on others.

This was a great place to stay! The apartment was so cute and clean! The room was cozy and the bed was comfortable after a long day of walking.   The neighborhood was safe and the apartment was close to the subway. As a single woman I never felt unsafe walking home at night.   Kaitlyn was so accommodating and was available to answer any questions I had or just welcome me home.   I am heading back to the city in March and hope to stay again!

Everything was exactly as I expected it to be. I was fortunate to meet Sara and Nacho (the cat) upon my arrival because Monday was a holiday and Sara was home from work. We had a nice conversation. I love cats and was missing mine so Nacho made me feel quite at home.   My stay was only two nights and I was able to come and go without ever feeling uncomfortable or unsafe.  It was a wonderful experience and I am 100% satisfied.

Had a nice stay at Melissa's place. Would stay there again.   Pros... Studio was clean, as pictured. Easy check-in.  Comfortable bed. Close to transportation and the beach.  Good wifi.   Cons... Shower water got cold very quickly. Area was a bit sketchy at times.  Loud band rehearsed at night below.

Good room.  Look a little bit sketchy at first ,  if im honest but mostly cause it's an old house.  BUT you will change your mind very quickly ! You have the essentials . A clean room, clean environment ( they clean everyday the shared bathroom ) a quiet place .  And George and team are super nice : helped with my luggage ,  offer plenty options to hang out,  always checking if you need something ,  so if you are alone and visiting ,  it's a really good options to be surrounded by George and his team .  Communication was perfect . The area : Clinton Hill is beautiful . The place is super quiet and safe ! Well I recommend to say at this place ! Thank you George and team !

It's 20 minutes walk from Mets-Willet point station via Queens Park (Kinda scary at night when you walk alone but the park police patrols all the time.  The room was good, the house was clean, and the hosts were really friendly. We even didn't notice when the heater wasn't turned on and they offered us heater.  It's kinda difficult to talk with the father since he is not very good in english, but he was really helpful. If he doesn't understand what we want to say, he will call his son to communicate with us.  Thank you very much for hosting us.
Hidden cameras everywhere and Jimmy is a creep. Don’t stay here.

Having lived at the Manhattan School of Music residence hall a couple of blocks away, I am familiar with the area...  That being said, if you're not scared of Morningside Heights, nor afraid of exploring Harlem, Ali's spot is prime-time location!  The apartment is also conveniently located to both the 1 Train + A,B,C,D stops = great access for any tourist(s).   Check out the COLUMBIA CONSIGNMENT shop that's right around the corner for great deals too!

The toilet is too small and low, I couldn't reach my rear end to cleaning up.  I used the shower to clean up.  The mildew in the shower is disgusting, the bathroom floor was dirty.  My husband had to pull me up from toilet every time.  The bar stools are dangerous   I slipped and fell backward, i managed to keep my head from hitting the floor.  The pads in the kitchen were full of mildew.  We would not spend another moment even is for free in the apt.

The apartment is just as we can see in the photographs, with an interior that takes care of the details and is very clean. The bathroom is well equipped and the owners left us enough towels for the whole week. The apartment is on the ground floor in Harlem, an area known for its diversity of churches. The area is a residential area but personally it is not a good place to move. On some occasions we had the feeling of fear, since there are many homeless or drunk people on the street and we are not used to all this. Personally, we think that it is an inappropriate place to visit with the family. In the mornings we left early in the morning, took the subway and when we returned due to the movement of the area we always took an Uber (approximately 15 dollars).  It is close to Outlets and a large hypermarket where you can buy food.  We would return to the apartment if it weren't for the area since the walks have been uncomfortable.  We are still waiting for the owner to respond to our Airbnb messages for our departure since we asked him questions and he did not respond.

This place is ok. It's very affordable. The host is really great. Don't miss that there is no a/c ( like I did). But the building is in need of some TLC. It's an old house and I understand that but the porch is a little sketchy and the bedroom door is nearly impossible to open. But again, it's very affordable and we didn't have super high expectations for what we paid anyway. It's right by the train and everything you could need in this area. The room is spacious. The bathroom was easy to share. It is very quiet when the dog isn't barking.

This apartment is so clean and conveniently located!! Spent a week here and found that I was able to get to anywhere I wanted to visit easily since Chikie's place is so near to the subway! There's a bunch of restaurants of varying cuisines, delis, supermarkets and pharmacies nearby- which are added bonuses.  Can't stress enough how good Chikie and Manuela are as hosts - they are chill, friendly, super responsive and mega helpful, and really made my stay in NYC that much better. I highly recommend staying here, you won't regret it! :)

Mia was a responsive host, and the apartment has a wonderful, well-appointed kitchen. It has everything you need to cook up a meal—pots, pans, dishes, silverware, microwave, stove and refrigerator! The living room, bedroom and bath are very clean and neat. The queen bed was wonderful! The mattress was the best! Mia provided plenty of towels, and replaced them as we needed.   There are some cons, though, if your are an older traveler: The furniture is for young people—all the seating is high: high stools and a small bar in the living room, high chairs and a high kitchen table in the kitchen. The beautiful couch in the living room is perfect for a dorm or rec room, but not for anyone who needs back support. There is no desk and chair for computer work. The bed was up against a wall. Be prepared to wake the person next to you so they can get up to let you out. The long walkway to the entrance at the back of the house is canted and uneven; the three stairs up to the kitchen door are very uneven old cement. And the outdoor furniture pictured in the listing were old and worn out.   Finally, if you are afraid of dogs, this is not the place for you! My first night, I came "home" to the place and was suddenly assaulted by ferocious snarling and barking from what felt like a BIG dog maybe 3 feet from me. I couldn't see it in the dark. It turns out there's a dog in the backyard—I learned it can't reach you (good!). The dog would snarl and bark about half the time we approached the door to the kitchen.

Great apartment, clean, everything is new. Very good neighborhood, with supermarket, and everything you need nearby. The nearest subway station is about four blocks away, very quiet, only at night when I got back I was a little scared because the street near the station is dark. But I changed the route to another street and everything was ok. You need to have the metro app that the host kindly advised me to download and it was what helped me the most on the trip (Citymapper) without it it is much more difficult. It takes 40 minutes to Manhattan. I recommend.

The host is top notch, very quick to respond and very friendly! We were in town for the US Open, about a 35 minute walk (just under 2 miles). It's hard to find reasonable places any closer, so location was good. I agree with a previous review about having a sheet issue. I didn't have any cleanliness issues, however there was only one sheet on each of the beds and it was a flat sheet, so we took a sheet from another bed to cover up with, but as we slept at night, the sheet under us would get all messed up and you"d wake up sleeping on the bare mattress. We spent very little time in the home outside of sleeping, so it fit its purpose, but the amenities are definitely basic which is all we needed. If you plan to cook, have meals, or stay with more than 2 people, your kitchen supplies are meager.  The listing said there was cable, I'm not sure if we missed something, but it appeared to be operated by an antenna, so the reception was sketchy and channels limited. I don't really have much in the line of complaints, we just needed a place to sleep as we spent almost every waking moment out of the house, this is more informative for future visitors. Perfect if you plan to do the sane as we did, not so much if you're with a larger group and plan to spend time in the home. Last thing that has to be mentioned were bug sitings... We found one on the kitchen each night.. same bug each time perhaps?? Same with the bathroom, I'd see a bug come out from behind a tile behind the toilet every night. They looked like overgrown roaches.. I think someone told me once upon a time that they were palmetto bugs?? I don't know, but while creepy as all get out, seemed to be only in those two places, and never more than one bug seen in those spots. Make of it what you will...  I'd give it 3 stars out of 5 since we only needed a place to sleep. Would probably give it a 4.5 if not for the sheets and bugs
Nice cheap stay in NYC close to the subway. A bit of a sketchy neighbourhood (what do you expect for the price).
Our flight arrived late, which further delayed our arrival at Tanya's house, but she waited for us. She is a very discreet hostess and respectful of her guests.

Had a terrible last few days at this place. Had 2 good weeks before.   Pro’s : Huge, studio size bedroom - nicely furnished . Clean room & nice, safe neighborhood  Close to subways  Attentive communication with host   Cons : Roaches in the kitchen and bathroom  Host was unclear / didn’t know exterminator schedule  Host rented out other bedroom to a couple with enormous, barking dogs  Shared living situation felt extremely unsafe - dogs barking every time we went to the bathroom or used the kitchen  I was traveling with my 5 year old & it scared her. Terrible judgment from host  with having pit bull / mastiff like dogs with my 5 year old in same apartment

Me and my boyfriend went to NYC for xmas holidays. The street is a little bit creepy but the East Village area is nice, full of cafes , restaurants, very lively. The closest metro station is 10 min walking.  The flat is in a old bare building, the room is very small, but the bed is comfortable. The worst part was the bathroom, old and dirty. Good flat mates. For a young couple it's ok if you intend to spend most of the time out visiting the city and you just need a place to stay. I've heard in NYC places are very expensive and often very old, so this one for that budget it's ok.

This apartment was exactly what I was expecting which says a lot on the accuracy of the photos and description listed. I had one-off questions for Melissa as things came up during my stay, "Is there a close drug-store?", "Where should I get coffee in the morning?" and she always responded immediately which was really helpful. I would completely come back in the summer to stay and be close to the beach.

Great apartment very close to the M and G trains, very convenient to get into Manhattan or further afield via Penn Station. Bed Stuy is an interesting area, though we never really felt unsafe. The blinds in the bedroom do not block out any day light, meaning you're awake very early. The apartment has little sound proofing, so it gets fairly noisy in the mornings and evenings, though people who are used to urban living may not notice this like us hillbillies! Had a problem with the black gate (which needs fixing), but Angelika was straight down to lend a hand.

The apartment looked as described. Arrival was a bit sketchy--I had told Caroline when we'd arrive and she said she'd inform the housekeeper, but upon meeting him he said we were lucky to have arrived when we did since he was on his way out b/c he hadn't hear when we'd arrive....  Bottom line: my travel companion was bit by BED BUGS. We had to have all of our personal belongings sprayed with chemicals by the housekeeper (sort of humiliating to have to lay out your underwear for a man you don't know to douse with bug spray) then follow precautionary measures at home (leave bags outside, wash all clothes in hot water, etc.). Thankfully we didn't bring any bugs home and I wasn't bit, but my friend has bites on her ankles and feet. Beware.

I loved this brownstone! It could comfortably fit a couple and also has a room divider where friends can have private time separate from whoever is in the bedroom. Great location, very safe, clean, and lively. Has tons of dishes, pots, and utensils for your use. Didn't have any issues with privacy whatsoever. Definitely a steal for anyone visiting New York

I had arrived to the location with my mother all the way from NZ. Was disappointing to find a difficult entry into premise due to 3 unmarked keys which open three separate doors. Having big bags and standing outside building trying to figure out the way in made us feel very unsafe. When arriving into the building we found the floor had not been cleaned properly, the couch/extra bed did not match the pictures as it is heavily stained from previous guests. The linen had stains on it, despite the host saying it had been cleaned it still felt unpleasant to see. When communicating with the host, they became very defensive and did not have any real solution to make us feel any better. Also, host lives upstairs and seems to make a lot of noise throughout the day. On several occasions we were rudely awoken due to maintenance being done in the building at early hours of the day (8am-9am), no notification of this was given. Basically just disappointed in the lack of detail to make us feel welcome in the apartment. Would not recommend.

This home was even better than I expected. The location is great, never felt unsafe. The home was VERY clean and had everything I needed. The host allowed us to leave our luggage before check in and after, which was so kind and helpful. I would recommend this place to anybody.

Very clean place! The location is not the best but not too bad either. Train station is 9 mins walking distance and once you get onto train, main attractions (central park, Brooklyn bridge, times sq etc.) are about 45 minutes away. The neighborhood especially where train station is located seems sketchy but me and my family walked from station to home multiple times and didn’t feel unsafe. Ingrid responds your questions/messages very quickly, great host!

I appreciate Maya was very flexible about the time. She was nice and allowed us check in slightly early and let us store the luggage after check out. That saves us a lot of stress no need to carry heavy bags in the city. The place is clean except her neighbors (the staircase is kind of messy but it's not her false). The room is simple and the mattress was comfortable. Overall is good for the value.

Staying here is a true delight. The space is large and comfortable and extremely clean. I was under stress due to having a family member in a local hospital. Jo went above and beyond for us to make sure we were comfortable and our needs were met. She was in constant communication with us and concerned about our comfort and the health of our family member. We will definitely return for a more fun occasion next trip.   The furnishings are very comfortable too. Just loved it.

I loved how easy it was to get to the city from here! There is a bus stop right next to here and a twenty minute walk to the subway! It was so clean, and quiet and the bed was incredibly comfortable. I traveled alone, and never felt unsafe. I do recommend parking your car early, and just leaving it there and using public transportation as parking after five was difficult. Overall, would recommend staying here, and would love to stay again when I’m back in the area!

So I was a little scared to get another Airbnb in New York because of my experience last year but this Airbnb is so clean and nice, I was so relieved and happy when I walked in everything was so perfect that I booked again for my next trip to New York before I checked out. Nicole responded in a fast and timely manner no matter the time thank you  having a nice Airbnb I really appreciate it.
Not even a full block away from transportation  Rite aid drug store on the corner  Plenty of places to buy food  Even a few supper markets  Great location

CJ and Raissa were amazing hosts (amazing is literally an understatement). I was on the verge of being homeless two days before moving out of state and they literally saved me from sleeping in the streets with my Dog.    I am forever grateful.

Both CJ and Raissa are the best of people. They were communicative and helpful with everything for me. Can’t stress how great these hosts are. Staying at their place was comfortable and convenient  for a short trip to New York. Happy camper!

this place was so nice I had to book twice. for the price and location Charlene's place is a steal. the neighborhood is very culturally diverse with many different ethnic restaurants and shops. less than a five-minute walk to the bus that can take you to 4 or 3 train that will get you in to the city. the place was exactly what you see on the photos. you get complete privacy which can be very serene. my stay was very comfortable and would highly recommend for anybody to book this place.

I don't like to write a bad review but I just don't understand how the host thought it was ok to enter the apartment without telling us while we were out!
