If you’re not there in winter or you care less about the hot tub, the place really is great! And Mike’s just the kindest and most generous host.

Perfect location for us visiting family and old stomping grounds. Quiet neighborhood and wonderful apartment. We in extremely late and Mrs Shully had made sure we had everything we needed for breakfast, no worries, no stress, perfect little vacay for us. We would definitely recommend and plan to return again soon!

SCAM ALERT: Be aware that a lot of the things used to furnish the apt (like the bunk bed, sink etc) are very cheap and unsupported. The host tried to flip it on me and my guests and wants us to pay $650...$650 during a pandemic. Could you be any more evil? literally the bed was so unsafe from the moment we checked in and would not stop creaking and wobbling for the life of us. And the things that he’s trying to charge us for WERE ALREADY FAULTY BEFORE OUR STAY. The building is very old and lackluster inside. Also, there was a drunk man staying next to us and was trying to fight me and my guest and PULLED OUT A TASER. Also there was a couple fighting very loudly across from us so basically the walls are like paper. I have never ever had a problem with any air bnb host and I always make sure to leave the place nice. I don’t want to say he’s a typical New York scammer, but if the shoe fits...also my closet is bigger than this sad apartment. The pictures are misleading because cozy= tiny. To top it off I have video proof supporting my statements. And to be honest I never leave reviews but after we left, Roger came at me so rude instead of trying to have a conversation about what REALLY happened.

This place is not as advertised. It is not in LES. It is in deep two bridges. I’ve lived in New York for years without worries about neighborhood but this was an unsafe area. There was a murder on the front steps. It is a 10 minute walk to restaurants and bars etc. The place is clean and they are communicative and try to be helpful but it doesn’t make up for the price vs reality.  The SUBWAY IS SO LOUD, don’t think otherwise. I was told otherwise and had a lot of trouble sleeping. Not a bad place but not worth its price at all.

Lights and shadows.  To begin with, it is not a conventional AirBNB like any of the ones you find, but rather it is managed by a real estate agency.  It is a very small room, but if you only want it to take a shower and sleep, it is enough. Even so, there are things that could very well be improved, such as the furniture, which falls apart, or especially the air conditioning, which is super noisy and is right above the head of one of the beds, about 15cm... You have to choose between sleeping or being cool.  It has a 24-hour doorman. Although we arrived at night and we had the most unpleasant experience of all upon arrival... There was a moment when I thought we were sleeping on the street and we couldn't even connect to the WiFi in the lobby without paying to be able to notify someone. The rest of the days there were other nicer people but the truth is that the arrival was terrible.  The location is incredible, you are right behind the Empire State, 3 minutes from the Flatiron, with main stops like 34th Street practically at the door. If location is important to you, this apartment may be the right one.  Being a real estate agency, they have a locker service for your luggage, but it is paid (like everything in NY) so forget that you are going to a private apartment and think more that you are going to a cheap conventional aparthotel. It is important to keep in mind that real estate people worked in the office a little when they felt like it. We only saw a girl by chance who told us that a certain Fernando was there from 8AM to 5PM (although it was 10AM and no one was there), we didn't get to meet him even during his time.  Through the chat, Roger was always very friendly and responded quite quickly to resolve any questions.
Space was great, accessible to two train stations, area may look unsafe however, it was safe to walk at night.  Building was clean, not a lot of traffic.  Apartment was spacious and comfortable.

Pro's:  1.) Affordable  2.) Host is nice, if a bit strict.  3.) Complimentary tea & coffee.  4.) Wifi is fast.  Con's:  The bed was cheap and unstable. Host tried to help, but just created a different problem.  2.) Too many house rules. Makes you feel like a child spending a few nights at a friend's house who has strict parents. I was berated for using extra towels and sheets.  3.) Host did not inform us the number of people who will come in and out on a regular basis to clean. They don't announce themselves. One scared my fiancé and almost saw her in an awkward situation.  4.) Host let herself in too often. She lives next door, but our peace was disturbed on a regular basis.  5.) Location is on the ass-end of Brooklyn. Had to take a bus and train just to get to Manhattan. Took over an hour each way.

The room is exactly as it shows,it was clean. Close to Time Square. The building security may as well be nonexistent. They are supposed to check IDs as ppl enter,they do not. Instead anyone was allowed access. The entrance had groups of ppl getting high, drinking and making passes and offering drugs to my teenage daughters. They were directly outside of the entrance.  And were not asked to move along by security.  The hallways smelled of weed . They have 1 working elevator and unsafe stairways. Seemed to be alot of drug use and sales . Not a safe environment.

When staying here I was a bit scared on what to expect looking at the reviews! I will have to say it was clean and amazing! It was close to the subway and a few minutes to Times Square but it was amazing! I would stay here again when I return.

The room is very neat and as per what you see in the pictures. However there were other tenants next doors smoking marijuana. The unpleasant odor on the second floor. Apart from that it was an excellent bnb

Sarah is an amazing host that went above and beyond to make sure I had an a great experience in NY. She gave us very fast responses, a clean/beautiful place to stay-in the perfect location. This one here is a steal!

not suitable if u care about details.   the kettle handle was broken, making it dangerous to hold hot water in; the toilet and fridge never stops hissing; the kitchen stools were wobbly and not fastened. the ac unit meant that there was an air vent that captured all the sound from the street - chatter, car noises, etc.   the beds were comfortable; the books were nice. the hosts seem well meaning.

Great stay and highly recommend! Sarah is a great host, responded quickly and actually messaged me to make sure we were able to settle in okay. It’s a great location right by central part and wasn’t on a sketchy street or anything. Probably the safest I felt sleeping outside of my own home. Key fob to enter the building and key to enter the apartment. Very convenient market just a few doors down that sold great food and literally a little of everything. Highly recommend if you need a place to stay in that area
Overall my stay here was great but Annie had illegal drugs laying around the apartment.

Annie’s place was nice and clean. Thoughtful things like tea and stuff ! So nicely taken care of . Only thing is the walls are super thin you can hear everything in the building, you hear ppl in the hallway and if you’re sleeping it can be startling and kinda creepy. Only downside is there is no tv but a cute little radio. But if you don’t really watch tv or have an iPad or laptop you will be just fine! Somehow the neighbors kept complaining about noise issue from my unit which was impossible bc there isn’t even a tv in the unit to turn up loud. The place was nice and Annie was super helpful and very responsive! Thanks Annie !

The place was nice and comfy, everything was clean. Walking distance to Ferry, but the area seemed little unsafe in the evening, especially for lonely traveling women. Despite this moment everything was great!
Nice place in an interesting part of NYC.  Do not let this location being in Harlem scare you off - we felt very safe.

This room is right next to a bar and you will be hearing music all night. We had a hard time sleeping both nights we stayed there and the music didn’t stop until around 1-2 am. The location is dangerous and unsafe. The apartment also does not look like the photos. The blinds do not cover the windows all the way so for privacy we used our coats to cover up the part of the window people could see into. On the other hand Gabrielle did communicate well and was helpful when we needed support.

I stayed here for almost 3 months while I did an internship in NY but it was very different than expected. The apartment is about 200 sq ft and there’s not much room to move around. One night the apartment got broken into while I was asleep as well, and there are residents who put tissues in the door so anyone can get in. There is a club underneath the apartment that plays music till 4am which can have the floor vibrate most of the night. I had to buy containers for my food because there was a rat problem that I experienced multiple times. I am a young female so I am always cautious of my surroundings but this area is not safe to go out by yourself when it’s dark outside. There is also no A/C so the apartment stayed around 85 degrees the whole summer which resulted in heat rashes. I was also locked out of the apartment for hours because the door lock was messed up. There is no room to wash dishes and the oven/stove smells like gas when you turn it on so you can’t cook here either. The host does not want her landlord to know she’s renting the apartment for airbnb, so whenever I had issues, I was not able to resolve them quickly which was a little sketchy. This is definitely an apartment for only 1 person. Although the airbnb host was nice, I would not recommend this place.

The worst experience of my life, the apartment completely dirty, the air conditioning with the filters completely dirty, the oven dirty, the terrace neglected with traces of tobacco on the floor, the sofa completely broken, to complete the situation there was no hot water, We had to heat in the microwave and take a shower like in Africa, the door of the room was broken, any person could enter the house and steal our belongings, the repair of the door was done the next day, but we continued the 5 days without hot water, to complete without internet. pay such a high price of 1200 dollars for a week, and receive a service worthy of Africa, the disgust is so great we are going to proceed to a legal action for damages and prejudices, I do not recommend this apartment to my worst friend.

As a pedant, I can say it is the most cleanest room I ever rented. No dust, no dirt, very good smell in the room and whole apartment. Location is satisfying, but if you are traveling alone it's not a good place to stay, as after 8pm walking on the street people kept saying to me "girl, don't walk here it's dangerous". But if you have a companion and you are ready to spend 35-45 min to get to city centre every day, it's a pefrect option for you.

Pauriany was attentive to my questions before arriving, welcomed me and explained everything! It was a wonderful stay, the neighborhood is super quiet and the people are friendly, believe me, I have returned at different times and I was never afraid!  It has the subway one block away which takes you to Manhattan in 20 minutes! I will definitely return!

I would stay here again! Great location & got it for a steal price. Walking distance from just about everything and Chelsea Market is super close as well. It was so so spacious for the two of us. Morgan was also able to accommodate us for a later check-out since our departing flight was at 3pm. Highly recommend to anyone!

I was unable to check in due to severe storms and all flights were canceled out of Nashville and most other cities in the US. I contacted Melissa and she offered no refund/partial refund nor any credit due to unforeseen unprecedented severe winter storms. I even tried the Airbnb resolution and was told it's up to the host, and she did not even reply to the Airbnb request to consider this. I am a student with student loans and having saved a whole year for this, I was deeply disappointed as I did not choose to cancel the booking but the dangerous weather was responsible for all flights being canceled. I would have expected some partial refund or credit at least. But none was given nor was proper communication to my request. I do not recommend this listing and host. Heartless and greedy.

I stayed in Conor's apartment with a friend, when we arrived we didn't love the neighborhood because it was far from the center but the truth is that everything was VERY good. We were 3 blocks from the subway, you got everywhere very quickly, we returned at any time of night and nothing happened to us nor did it scare us (we are Argentinian where there is a lot of insecurity) the apartment was super clean, super equipped. And if we had any questions, Conor answered us very quickly! When we arrived at the building we thought "it's very old" but when we go up to the apartment everything changes! RECOMMEND!

We had a great stay at Michael’s. We’re from the neighborhood and have been out of town for work for the past year, so a visit back was just what we needed. The place was just what we needed — clean, easy check in, stocked with necessities, and a really comfortable (firm) bed. Michael was easy to communicate with and made our stay stress free. We would definitely return.

Wow!! I was blown away by this apartment. It is in such a nice part of the city, I never once felt unsafe walking alone or at night. The views from the apartment were AMAZING! There are several subway stations within a short 10 min walk (if not closer),  grocery stores, coffee shops, a food court, it was everything and more! Was able to finding parking fairly easy as well. Highly highly recommend for long term stays as it had everything needed for cooking. Had such an amazing time here! Cannot recommend enough
The place is nice. We wished we had received correct instructions to enter in the apartment and for the Wi-Fi. This caused some stress.
There was mold all over the downstairs bathroom it’s unsafe and scary

This place was great! Super quiet very clean and nicely furnished, the host was very sweet and the responses were fast as I booked this the night prior to the arrival date and was afraid it would be too late, Despite this she accommodated and allowed my stay which was very pleasant, would definitely stay here again!

The place is actually bigger than it seems in the pictures. There is a large dresser for storing clothes and clean towels provided. The bathroom is very tiny, but it gets the job done. Shampoo and conditioner provided but not body wash (I always bring my own anyway, but just a heads up).   Overall it is a pretty good place to stay. It is only a 2 min walk to the A train which can get you where you need to go, but the ride back from the city can be pretty long the later you return. You can hear every footstep above and one morning we were woken up at 8am because of stomping heard above us. It was suddenly an hour of back and forth stomping all around our ceiling. That was definitely the most unpleasant part of our stay.

Small, comfortable apartment as advertised. Small inconvenience we did not have hot water for 2 days and then only in the morning.  Well located accommodation but noisy neighborhood with a lot of homeless people (like in many neighborhoods in NY). Nino is available quickly via WhatsApp.

Very well located and very functional apartment just a few minutes walk from Times Square and two blocks from the metro.  A few small inconveniences nevertheless during our stay: the heating in the room did not work…many homeless people in the street. We had to wait around twenty minutes despite the time indicated to get the keys but it was quickly forgotten because Nino arranged the suitcases for us for the last day 😉

Let me start by saying that Stephanie’s space is a STEAL. A yard in NYC? With a fully furnished basement apartment? Could notQ have asked for a better experience.  While the subway into town is only a 5 minute walk away, I implore you to walk the area as well. There are many small businesses that Stephanie has packed into her guide that are well worth checking out. My personal favorite is the grocery store a block away. Being from Houston, seeing a mom and pop grocery store is a very unique experience.  Throughout our entire time, the Queens community was very kind and welcoming.  As far as Stephanie goes, she was very communicative and nice in the few times that we encountered each other. The living space is more than comfortable. They also provided us with two high quality fans that kept us very cool.  I don’t want to hype this place too much, because I’m worried you guys will book it too quickly and I won’t get the chance to stay here again.  -I jest, but overall this place is a 10/10 and I would absolutely stay here again or recommend it to friends in the future.

Bad Feeling. As soon as we entered the door, there was a heavy smell of drug from the next room b. The soundproofing of the room was very poor. There were people having parties all night, which seriously affected our physical and mental health. But Daniel pantiently handled it after we moving out

I dont recommend this place at all, The host is not responsive at all,  I sent a request 4 pm on the day of check in ,I didn’t get a confirmation until 8 pm stating that previous guest checked out late, but I was excepted to pay for the full price. Also dont let the price fool you because she will charge you double with the cleaning fee, This is almost like a scam, I really don’t recommend it at all, I hope they improve after this review and not scam more people

BEWARE! This is a BASEMENT and not an apartment! It is dark and no windows! There is no indication or description mentioning about the place being underground and it is not right. The host should be honest and clear about this. If not, it is a scam! Listing as an apartment when in reality it is a basement! And they think it is just an inconvenience for the customers… Are you kidding me? We are not talking about dirty sheets, not having a tv or any other little amenities. We are talking about an inaccurate listing and trying to scam people by having them book the place as an apartment and enforcing ‘no refunds’ policy. The cleaning fee is ridiculously high.  The bathroom is too small you can barely move!   There is a constant and loud foot stomping noises from the above. People who live above are not mindful at all and walks in their heels.   There is no clothing rack.   Other than the above, the place is cute. But who cares about cuteness when you cant see nature light and cant breath with air because there is no windows!   The host seems like a fine host, she was nice to begin with. But I genuinely don’t like the fact that she is not honest and transparent about her place being underground and then enforces this no refund strict policy.   I personally went through a hell and wasted 2 days of my trip being uncomfortable and having to deal with this unfair situation, which I didn’t have to go through if the listing was accurate.   I hope the host adds BASEMENT in her listing and not trick people again.

My partner and I did not like our experience at this listing at all. Although the host was very kind and accommodating when we communicated over the air bnb messenger app, when we arrived at the air bnb for check in, it was an uncomfortable interaction, and the code given to us to the door was incorrect. It was extremely loud overnight to the point that we could not sleep, and there was a door in the bedroom that opened directly to outside with a window that made us feel unsafe and anxious. Like I said, the host was very communicative and accommodating over the app, but overall we did not like our stay and would not come back.

I lived in the place for 6 weeks due to my job. I regret it to my soul, I would not recommend anyone to book this place. The sink is always filled with dishes, we got trapped inside due to tape being on the door. We also got trapped outside because the batteries died on the door. Also a man walks around with his shirt off, pee's on the floor and the toilet seat. Some one steals food as well. I took pictures as well as other guest and sent them to KDN, they did nothing at all. Also the power went out twice because the fuse blew and they had too many excuse. They over charge you for this crap. Food was left in the fridge from other guest that had mold on it. DO NOT BOOK THIS PLACE. You will NOT be happy. I wish I would have filed a report to AIR BNB, I have a friend currently staying here. She is so unhappy and they are so heartless to what's going on. Book anywhere else NOT HERE. Angela was nice though.

If you decide to book. Its a great deal for your money. Park on the street weekends u won't have to move your car. Be prepared to climb 5 flights of stairs. Don't be afraid to take the subway. Check which shuttles in advance because the people at the station are rude. Go walk across the Brooklyn Bridge because its free and beautiful 😍.  Also make sure to catch a shuttle to times Square. The heaters are boilers and make a breathing sound so don't get freaked out when u hear them lol

very reasonably priced for the amenities and convenience, only flaw I would really even say is maybe noisy upstairs neighbors at late hours of the night at times but it’s still a steal nonetheless, would definitely stay again!?!
I was scammed into paying for an extra night. Nice place but shady management.

My stay at Sonder was amazing! I enjoyed everyday I stayed. (I stayed for a month). There were a couple of problems here and there but they were quick to solve the issue. The little touches made the thé price worth it (though it’s on the higher price point). They had condiments ready, paper towels, dish soap, and even wine opener and measuring cups!   The best part was the bed. The bed was incredible! Loved those pillows. I honestly wanted to steal them but obviously didn’t :). I did get the brand though so will be purchasing them for myself   HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

What an absolute gem. I came in to help family with a move down in Jackson Heights and needed to be close for drop offs. This place was perfection. It was a quick walk from LGA (took me only 15 minutes, but could take up to 25-30 min if you wanted to take your time). In addition I was traveling as a solo female and never felt in any danger or risk walking around or grabbing a Lyft during the day. Not to mention the space itself is adorable. Looks just like the pictures and had decent hot water. Directions to get in were super clear and easy to follow. And the parking space was a bonus I never expected. I didn’t end up using but wow. How nice to have that feature in a city space stay. My only concern which was super minor was a knocking noise that would happen at night. I think it was due to the heating system. Thankfully I always travel with a pair of ear plugs just in case of unexpected noises in stays. Once in, the noise was so faint that I could not hear through the plugs. Slept like a baby. Would definitely stay here again if I needed to be in this area.

Thanks so much for a great stay, Curtis. It was perfect for our needs, and we were all very comfortable in your condo and in the neighborhood. We certainly all appreciated being able to enjoy my daughter's big graduation day (NYU Tandon) without any extra added stress. The building was very conveniently located and was safe and secure. We found parking at all hours within a couple of blocks. There were at least four coffee shops within walking distance, as well as many restaurants and delis, two grocery stores, several pharmacies, a huge variety store, an art store, beverage stores, and a multitude of other specialty stores and businesses. The rooftop view was stunning. The condo itself was clean, had comfortable beds, ample closet space with hangers, a second half bath (very convenient!), a decently-stocked kitchen, and a comfy couch. Smart TVs in every room, plus a huge 60" TV in the living room enabled our group of six to keep up on our fav series. We also took advantage of the fast wifi to check in at the office. We all were able to jump on our respective Zoom calls without any issues with bandwidth and without any distracting noise from the street or from other apartments. Very easy socially-distanced check-in and check-out. All-in-all a great choice for a stay in Brooklyn. We will definitely be looking to book Curtis' awesome place on our next trip!  His kind hospitality and quick response time  were much appreciated!

Have stayed here several times in the past and besides shady looking characters at the front door smoking pot and a door man who doesn’t open the door had never encountered any real issues. This past visit though was terrible. First I had to submit and resubmit travel forms 3 times. Than I was told I could check in early and then told I couldn’t then told I could. The dishwasher, microwave, and dryer weren’t working properly and the bed was broken. I advised management so they would know but asked not to be bothered until the next day yet they still went ahead and sent someone the same day. Then to add insult to injury they offer me an $80 credit for a $600+ stay.

Do not expect much. You get what you pay for, pretty much. The location is not bad at all, and the room was pretty decent. Some of the issues we've had were: - During Check In, nobody was a the lobby for a good amount of time. I was so confused on what to do and where to go that I had to go in and out a couple of times. Also, during check out, we had a lot of stuff to carry out so we had to use the luggage cart. The lobby person seemed lazy and not really in the mood to assist us at all. - Another, the weed. Right before checking in, there were "no smoking" signs everywhere outside and one guy in an empty hallway was smoking weed right in front of the building's entrance. It looked like a sketchy alley where you get stabbed or robbed. Also, we stayed there for good 4 days, and every single day throughout the day there was very strong scent of weed going in to our unit. It was much worse in the hallway. Nobody was doing rounds on the floor at all. - Communication. Sonder, unlike most Airbnb hosts that you'd expect, seems like a (for the lack of better words) big organization. They have multiple buildings that they are renting around the City, and they're more like hotels minus daily room cleaning, room service, less staff, no security. The issue was that every time we message them, a different person answers whether it was email or Airbnb messenger and that seemed repetitive since they repeat the same answer sometimes or they don't pay attention to what they're reading so we'd have to go over the same inquiry again.

First walking into my room I thought it was very stylish then I walked into the bathroom where there was poop streaks in the toilet at that moment I wasn’t sure how clean the rest of the room was. I reached out and they did change my room with no problem so I did appreciate that. I will say if you are driving this wouldn’t be a good place to stay because the parking is very bad. And the parking lot is a scam on pricing. Other then some flaws the stay did end very well I was very pleased with my stay.

felt unsafe. except the room you staying in everything else is filled with objects and things. The living room is full of messy clutter. there's only space to walk. there are no photos of clutter on Airbnb.

I would like to thank the team at Sonder my stay was amazing everything from the location to the space.   I can offer no suggestions you guys are on point ❤️ you take the stress out of relocating to a new City by making my stay feel like a Home   Can’t thank you enough  Semonia Jackson West

They need to keep batteries in the fire alarms. There were 5 fire alarms and not one had a battery in it, VERY dangerous. Also, if you need full cooking arrangements this is not for you. The living quarters were decent and comfortable.

Loved the room and building. Everything was perfect except one woman at the front desk in the mornings--so rude and made me afraid to even ask her questions when I needed assistance. Stayed for more than a month so used their mail delivery and it was lost.

I was in need of an emergency stay due to a passing in my family. Susanna was prompt in ALL of her responses and over-accommodated me if that’s even possible! I was left cold refreshments and even a bottle of wine! There was an outside patio with lights, music and a fire pit to enjoy which was amazing. Susanna’s unit felt so homey and comfortable. I never felt unsafe. This is a quiet neighborhood which is unlike MOST parts of nyc. The parking, the parking, the parking!!!! Not only did I get my own space, there was ample amount of parking available at all times of the day. Even at 3am. I am a frequent visitor of NY, specifically Brooklyn and I usually stay in Bedstuy but this will be my new spot going forward. Susanna is the best!!!

I have never stayed in air bnb like this before but it was very comfortable, charming, and conveniently located. This appears to the owners dream house.  The space is incredibly peaceful and the energy in the home is great. The  bed is super comfortable and the half bath in bedroom area is convenient.  Heads up, there is no iron. I never iron so I didn't mind but my companion does not leave the home without ironing, luckily a friend has a similar companion, so we borrowed their travel iron lol. I am plus sized I will admit the stairs were a little scary at first. I recommend going sideways, they are sturdier than you think.

I was really looking forward to this stay. Had a little issue during the check in but it was resolved. The stay proceeded to being pleasant. The apartment is nice and the amenities were great. I was able to spend time writing and thinking by the window.  Last night I changed rooms and was locked out for about an hour which was very unpleasant. Sonder was very reactive but it was a detail that soured the experience.  I’d stay at a sonder again in New York or other cities. I like the design. In this booking I had a lot of space which was great.

I loved our stay here, it was very easy to check our luggage the lobby, although the locked cubbies were all used up so we had to just hope nothing gets stolen being stored behind the desk. If you are fine with this or if you are not planning on storing your luggage at the Airbnb then you should be fine.  The room was very clean, and had lots of cleaning tools like a dust pan/broom dish soap, lots of dishes to use which was helpful when needing to clean up.   There was also a dishwasher, stove top, microwave/oven, and fridge/ freezer which alll came very much in handy for my partner and I.   Anyway we had a great stay!! Would recommend and stay there again!!  We got to get a late check in too!!  Wohoo

Overall the place was nice, clean, easy to get to and easy to check in.  But we did experience some annoyances that we should not have experienced for the money paid.  Our internet/ TV situation was  not working initially and we had to troubleshoot it ourselves.  I am horrible with technology! But  when Sonder did reach out about the problems, the staff was polite and courteous.    Also, we could not use any of the plugs over the kitchen counter and had to make out coffee on the floor 😂😬.    Lastly, they boast a great view: We we’re on the 3rd floor overlooking a creepy old playground maybe? Definitely not what we expected.

Bruce’s place was perfect for our family as we celebrated the new year at Times Square!  We had a setback waiting for Covid tests to return to Canada but Bruce was very accommodating which caused less stress for us. We appreciated it so much. Communication was awesome!!

This apartment uses a high level of technology including the use of an app to communicate with management. I was not comfortable with this and it created a level of stress not normally associated with being on holiday. I would suggest that persons who are not up to date with digital technology avoid this listing.

The room is about 100 SQ ft. The beds are comfortable. The bathroom is adequate but tight. It was nice to have a fridge in the room. The A/C kept the room very cool. It's a very practical room, no frills. I used pillowcases and towels to block the window at night - there is a street light that stays on all night and brightly illuminates the room. The building it is in (hallways, elevators, etc.) had several different, unpleasant smells throughout our stay. The location is really convenient to restaurants, subway, convenience stores, and shopping. I know that the market is different in NYC, but after getting to the room and seeing its simplicity, how I judged the value of the rental definitely changed, i.e., I probably wouldn't pay the same rates for what I got again.

A fully equipped apartment in a prime location for a very reasonable price. Sonder was convenient, clean, and accommodating of my early check in and late check out requests. Thank you for making my work stay that much less stressful.

This unit is in need of MASSIVE Renos. Could be a very nice unit if someone painted and filled holes. TV was an issue - wouldn't get channels and although NOMAD was responsive and told us to unplug and plug router back in - that didn't work.  The room was not that clean. It was okay. Again, I can't stress enough that some renos need to be done. The bathroom is way TOO small especially for a family of 4.
I liked everything except that the fire alarm went on every single day. Scary experience.
Perfect for a week long stay. The place us equipped with all basic essentials. The view was amazing and the price was a steal!

We’ll, the place is Ok. The room is confortable for you or with your partner. Clean. Albert always was there when needed. Very easy going person and absolutely a person to talk.   The neighborhood is loud, we stayed 6 nights and well I can tell it’s loud, the distance is far from Manhattan, around 40 mins. A lot, but a lot homeless asking for money, Felt dangerous for me and my wife. The street was always dirty a lot of trash everywhere.  But for the price that’s what you get.  General speaking it was ok. Just that, ok. Not far from metro station, easy to get.

It was a good community and you get to live with the host, which could be a good thing as well as bad. Faith is really nice and her house is really clean, she don’t allow anyone to stay in there pass 10pm or sleep over EVER! The room was clean only underneath the bed was dirty and the floor but beside that it had a tv that has no connection to anything which u need to connect to watch something. Around Tuesday’s she does babysit which is okay for me but those who sleep in during around that time it might get stressful. She also provides u tea in the kittens let’s you use all her kitchen pots. There is the q111 bus near by and also camera in the entrance!

Danie is a warm, open and friendly person. Check-in was straightforward, as was check-out. Several metro stations are within a 10 minute walk. Although Danie warned us about noise starting at 8 a.m., we really found it extremely quiet by 'NYC standards'. Danie has a few local-tips in store, don't be afraid to have a nice conversation with him!

No windows . Bed is not good for two people. It’s a double bed with a loose frame . Mirror is sitting on the sink . I sat on a chair to shave. Shower is ok with rain shower snd it’s a walk in .  It feels a little unsafe , but is ok if you only want to have a place to sleep. Very cheap

I felt unsafe in this neighborhood and the apartment/room did not meet my expectations in terms of cleanliness. I ended up checking out the very day I checked in. Thankfully Airbnb was more than happy to help with issuing a full refund.
I do not recommend this room at all, better to sleep on the floor than on the mattress. First and last time using AIRBNB. A complete scam.

Hey guys! Chadanuts place was alright. She was super responsive and wanted to fix anything before it became an issue. The space needed a large artwork or mirror to make it feel bigger and more welcoming.  The bathroom was lovely. One of the older male tenants was being creepy. I messaged Chadanut about it and told her I was canceling the rest of my stay. I was really appreciative when she told me that he was being evicted. Thankyou for doing something. Chadanut has your back. This place of great if you need a quick stay over in Brooklyn.

Leslie and Joel thought of everything! Upscale-clean, this sweet getaway is so well appointed, and even more spacious than the photos show - you’ll have plenty of room to stretch out. Private deck is great any time, for shady early coffee or sun-warmed afternoon drinks. Literally steps from the beach and all the fun places to eat in the heart of the Rockaways. Enjoy!

So, first I'd like to start off by highlighting some of the pros of this listing. I feel that it would be unfair to start right off the bat with criticisms, and there were a lot of things that this place got right.   Host is very communicative, made sure that I was familiar with how to check in before I arrived, and asked if the place was okay when he saw me the next day. Props to him for that!  The room is spacious with a huge, comfy king sized bed. It's clean and well kept with fluffy pillows and a comforter, and the room has a portable AC which was definitely my favorite part of the trip.  The place in general is clean, well decorated, and stocked with some pretty sweet, basic amenities such as toiletries (which I did not need because I had my own, but still awesome!) and a well-stocked coffee station.  The neighborhood is very quiet at night and there are delis open pretty late in case you get hungry or need to run out for something at a late hour.   Unfortunately, there are a couple of things that I was a little less than satisfied with and that I think other travelers should consider when booking this listing:  The monitor in the bedroom is only for hooking up a laptop or similar device. I have a Chromecast so that isn't a big deal for me, and there is a functioning television in the living room so you probably won't miss it, but this is just a heads up to anyone else looking at this listing.  I expected the host to be up and working at an early hour, because the listing itself alerts the person booking that this would happen. What I didn't expect was that the host would be working rather loudly. I was awoken with a start to a loud bang (could have been them entering the residence), and then kept awake by the host whistling periodically and talking loudly on the phone in the next room. If you're fine with being woken up, then by all means, book this listing, but I personally like a quieter space and this was kind of a deal breaker for me. It was up until this point that I was actually enjoying the listing very much.  Smoking is allowed in the apartment, which is fine with me, as I am a smoker. I don't usually smoke indoors, because the smell of smoke in an enclosed space bothers me. It is only permitted in the living room under the vent fan, which I was hoping would keep the smell of smoke to a minimum. But when the host was smoking in the living room per his own instructions, the fan didn't do much to clear out the smell, and when I left my room the first morning after getting out of bed, I could smell the thick aroma of freshly smoked cigarettes throughout the space. I have friends who smoke in their own homes that I visit so this wasn't make or break for me, but it was a bit of a turn-off for me and deterred me from attempting to light up in the house. If you do not smoke at all, I wouldn't book this listing.   I parked my bike on the same block as the apartment, not knowing what the host's policy would be on bringing my bike into the apartment. The good news is we spoke about it after the fact, and he said that I was allowed to bring my bike in the apartment, so if you're traveling with your wheels, be aware of this perk! Trust me, it's more helpful than you know. The bad news is, the morning after my first night there, my Specialized Body Geometry grips had been stolen right off my bike. They aren't cheap! But since the neighborhood was quiet and seemed safe enough to lock my bike outside, I thought it would be safe. Word to the wise: keep your valuables close should you book this listing. The neighborhood appears innocuous at first glance, but do not be fooled. Of all things I thought I would lose on this trip, my bike grips were at the bottom of the list. Thankfully, Roy's Sheepshead Bay bike shop was a mile and a half away and ready to assist my needs, but I had to spend $25 to replace them.

Elhajd and his wife has a lovely home. They were very welcoming hosts. They made sure I have a nice stay. Everything was spotless. I could have my bathroom which was the cleanest I have seen at an Airbnb. The B, D and 4 trains are just a short walk away. The neighbourhood is very bustling, there were people on the streets every time. I never felt unsafe. I would definitely stay here again.

AMAZING location and the most gracias and easy going, warm hosts you could possibly imagine. I loved that there is a private entrance which I hadn’t expected upon booking. The kitchen was comfortable enough for me to cook more than one meal and never feel like I was in the way of anyone else or bothering them. I also woke up EXTREMELY late and Aida hadn’t even messaged me, she was so kind and understanding about my very late checkout and it made the stress levels I woke up with instantly go down and become relatively manageable. I would stay here again and again if they would have me.

my experience was not good, the blankets on the bed had women's hair, from the first night we saw cockroaches it was horrible the next day we had cockroaches in the bed, and on the walls, we also saw cockroaches in the bathroom, in short a very dirty I do not recommend it, the lady takes a long time to answer questions on the cell phone.  mi experiencia no fue buena, las cobijas de la cama tenían cabello de mujer, desde la primera noche vimos cucarachas fue desagradable, al siguiente día teníamos cucarachas en la cama, y en las paredes, también vimos cucarachas en el baño, en definitiva una habitación muy sucia no la recomiendo, la señora se demora mucho en responder las preguntas al celularj.

Stayed for two nights and it was dope. When contacting customer service they were super fast to respond and gave recommendations for nearby grocery locations, even at 10PM. Walking the neighborhood that night was super fun, and felt pretty safe. Getting to the subway to venture uptown was quick and easy too. Sonder is a steal, very very worth.

I stayed here earlier this month and it was a pleasant experience for the most part so I DO recommend staying here overall. However for the sake of transparency, I will share my pros and cons.   PROS:   - The airbnb was spacious enough for two, which I was worried about initially but it was the perfect size for my best friend and I - A very short walk to the train (under 10 mins) - The decorations made for some cute pictures - Great kitchen/dining space   - The backyard is adorable however we didn’t get to enjoy it due to the rainy weather  - The temperature in the airbnb was perfect throughout the whole trip - The shower was really easy to use (thank god, nothing worse than trying to figure out how to use someone else’s shower) -  The area is very, very quiet. I didn’t hear a peep almost the entirety of the trip  - Ultimately, we felt very safe in this area    CONS   - Upon entering the airbnb, the smell of cigarettes was INTENSE. Now this could have very well been the people that stayed prior to us but it was still really unpleasant to walk in to - The sink in the bathroom doesn’t drain properly which sucks if you get grossed out by yucky water like me  - The left window in the kitchen and the left window in the room don’t lock which was worrisome but clearly we made it home safely so just adding it to this list for precaution - Although we traveled to NY to explore, we did have some time at the airbnb to rest, and times like this we would have liked to watch the TV (netflix). However we could not figure out how to add the Wifi to the TV. We tried multiple times and ended up giving up and watching on my bestie’s laptop. I did mention this to the host and they said we could call and they would walk us through it. We chose not to. This is on the list because I feel like this is something that should be done already - Before our trip, I messaged and specifically asked if there was a hairdryer and was told yes. However, upon my arrival, I noticed right away and there wasn’t one. I will say though that I messaged the host about this and they were able to get one to me almost immediately (I suppose the housekeeper stays upstairs so she brought one down) but again this was something that should have been double checked since I went out of my way to ask about specifically - Last con is that the host(s) isn’t great with responding. At one point, I messaged 3 times about the same thing before I got a response. I am incredibly patient so this wasn’t the worst however in a middle of a pandemic, I was worried this meant they weren’t a reliable host  If you’ve made it this far, thank you for reading. Again, despite the cons, I do recommend staying here as everything ended up working out in the end.

Unfortunately our first negative Airbnb review,  and would not recommend this stay in its current setup.  Communication was essentially non existent and the key pickup and drop off was not ideal.  The dwelling needs a fair amount of maintenance.  Basic household items that are typically provided by hosts were not there, and caused a fair amount of inconvenience.  Privacy and safety were the biggest issues that led to this poor review.   Blinds were missing in the Kitchen area windows that has direct line of sight into the living/bedroom.  We had to cover with towels to block the view of neighboring buildings.  There was a set of double doors in the bedroom that led out to the public hallway.  Between those doors was a very large opening that you could peer into the bedroom/living room.  You can also hear everything.  Lastly, the doors locks/bolts were removed/flimsy, and could have been easily broken into and we felt very unsafe as a result.  Safety, privacy, and communication is why I would encourage viewers to find other accommodations.

Ming was a very nice and courteous person. He had some trouble with English but he tried to accommodate all our requests to the best of his abilities. The bed was slightly uncomfortable. The neighborhood was a bit sketchy but we got used to it. No complaints about cleanliness and amenities.

The building and unit is quite nice.  Inside of the Unit is also well kept. My 5 stars for that.   It was very hard to find street parking daily and also have to move the vehicle if planning to stay multiple week days per street sign.  The closest Main Street intersection, Broadway is not that clean with litter flying around.  Felt little unsafe walking during off hours.
Would def recommend steal of a stay great location & host everything you need will be taken care of

Had a wonderful stay at Sonder Battery Park! Staf was always friendly and the apartment was clean and very big.  Wanted to publicly thank the night security for making me feel super safe after a scary encounter on a night out. A huge thanks to the team!

Sarah's place knocked our socks off! The camper is spacious yet cozy and is stocked with everything you might need for a few days away. The outdoor space is massive- lots of room to hang out in both the sun and the shade. The town feels small while still having everything you need, including a grocery store, brewery, coffee shop, and restaurants. All of that is in walking distance, as is the beach. It's a simple train ride from the city and a short walk to Sarah's from the train stop. We are already excited to go back!

I so appreciate this camper and the surrounding gardens. It was relaxing to rest in the sun or the shade and gaze at the green vines and flowers. I bought a cast iron grilling skillet at the nearby stop and shop and was able to cook meals on the two burner setup. This is a wonderful place to relax between trips to the beach.

Extremely clean place. She even had the kitchen stocked with Ramen and different drinks which was very kind. Even left me a bottle of wine for my birthday.   Was for the most part a pleasant stay. Only issue was I was locked outside of the apartment building and did not get a response for three hours and when I did, she told me to go to check the initial directions. Upon checking some info was missing so hopefully that has been added now :)  Also I know that this might be due to having experience with unpleasant guests in the past but the detailed instructions pretty much threatening being fined if one did not follow very specific rules about cleanup was a little offputting and made staying at the place feel a little less relaxed as a vacation.

it was a lovely weekend spent here in the Bronx. i had no issues staying here and it was quite quiet in the airbnb. i appreciated the fact that the hosts helped us with parking not once but twice! they didn’t have to do that but it definitely made the trip less stressful! this place was so cute and spacious. i would definitely come back :)

Such a great apartment for such a great price. Can not believe how reasonable it was. The location is close to subways, but you're in lower manhattan so not as central. Pictures perfectly matched what you got. Definitely recommend. Not a scam.

For a nice place to stay in the city right off the metro. I can’t really complain about anything. More space than a hotel for way less cost & it’s cute inside. It’s the city so of course there’s going to be city noise but I love that about the city. No trouble sleeping as the bed is large and comfortable. I do wish she had extra blankets since it’s pretty chilly in the city during winter months but I just threw on some sweat pants and was fine!! I would for sure stay here again she is a helpful host but not overbearing. She communicates through clear concise instructions and is quick to respond to questions. She has a good place and I never felt unsafe walking to and from the Parkchester subway stop.  It only took about 30 mins to get to time square via the 6 for a reference on location. I was able to find free street parking on the weekend so I left my car parked the whole time and used the metro instead.

If you’re into dirty small rooms and moldy bathroom, then this is your place. Thugs hanging around outside, corner room with NO bars on the windows, and that’s unsafe to say the least. The rooms are labeled like I’m in the Squid Games! Me and my sister didn’t even sit down the 40 minutes we were in there , finding a new place to sleep. The beds were hard, the pillows and sheets smell like saliva, and it was a strange man hanging out the window above, and don’t let me get on that work out iron fence that has no real lock. This place was a disgrace for me and mine, and now more mad the host is not refunding us, but it’s okay, she may not, but my bank will!

The staff are great (at the hotel) so friendly, so helpful - great people!   The room was good value for money, and in a good location. I had a great week here.   However, I’m not sure what’s happening with their head office… they say that they can help you 24/7 but that’s not true, they don’t reply for days … which adds a lot of stress onto a trip. We had problems checking in and it took them 3 days to then ask … is it sorted? Overall terrible communication, so I would not recommend staying - as if you have any problem, they won’t reply.   Again, staff at the hotel SO good! But I would not recommend - plenty of other places just as good with great communication!

Thank you 🙏🏻. Son-ya is very friendly, prepared a clean room, showed herself well.  despite the fact that according to rumors this is a “dangerous area”, I didn’t notice anything like that, the neighbors are kind, the area is clean, everything is fine!  I recommend.

Bibi's place is exactly like the photo, very clean, spacious. She was so considerate to even provide things like sleep eye mask, phone charger etc. The only unpleasant experience we had was that the air vent plastic flap making tapping noise the whole night during our first night there. We told Bibi this and she had someone fix this the same day. Things like this happen, but we really appreciated how fast Bibi responded to our ask.   Highly recommend Bibi's place!

Really nice appartment from a kind and helpfull host. We enjoyed our stay very much. Access to Manhattan is easy by subway at 300m.  The neighboroud is fine, we never felt unsafe and there are good grocery shops close by.  I certainly recommend it!
Dangerous area and no parking available ! Airbnb did not refund! they take no responsibility. Typical large company.

Very nice and comfortable little home. She could do better on the cleanliness of the place but it’s not too bad. She’s super nice, and reachable, easy check in. At first when we got off the train we got scared because the area is pretty bad but we were shocked to see the difference a few blocks can make. The street the house is on is pretty safe and calm.

Home is a 4-5min walk to the J train. Didnt feel unsafe at all. Residential area. No AC in one of the bedrooms but owner gave us a good tip abt leaving windows open for air circulation. Pretty decoration and homey. Yard is a plus! There was no toilet paper and Im certain she would’ve brought us some had I asked (owner was great at responding). Convenient store right by the subway station. Bathroom could have been a little more clean but it was not at all gross.

My friends and I had such a wonderful time here! The space is clean and roomy and homey. Kam was very responsive and helpful to any of our needs from her, and we messaged her throughout our stay. The area is nice and we never felt like we were unsafe. The heater kept us warm and cozy and the lock to get into the house is very easy and simple. At night we used a deadbolt from inside for extra protection. We were just a short walk from the subway station and had no issues there. Overall, a really great experience, and we would totally come back to the city and book this space again.

Found after a last minute cancellation of a classic Airbnb, we were a little afraid of the “hotel” side. In the end, an excellent stay: super clean, well located with a small view of Battery Park. Excellent base camp for visiting Manhattan. Very well equipped and reception staff available. The only regret is the closed swimming pool which only opened at the end of March, despite the high temperature...

Amal's place was perfect for our large group of 13! Plenty of sleeping room and bathrooms and kitchen were well stocked. Amal was very accommodating and responsive to my requests!  Only concern was that the walk to/from the subway station can be sketchy, especially at night. We travelled in a large group of 13 at all times, but I would not have been comfortable walking by myself or with a smaller group in this location. All around a great experience and a fantastic host!
It’s a little distance by subway to see downtown. The walk from the subway was a little sketchy late at night. The place was very clean.

First of all I would like to say that this was my first experience using Airbnb which scared me a little because it was my vacation and I wanted to enjoy it to the fullest. But here I will narrate what happened. From before arriving at John and Ainslie's house they were always in contact with me, answering all my messages quickly so that all my doubts were clarified and I would arrive from the airport to their house. My flight was delayed and I arrived in the early morning and they welcomed me with pleasure and from there I felt how good people these people were. Ainslie and John and his son are the best, I have nothing negative to say, they were always attentive to making me feel at home, asking what I needed and giving me directions and recommendations on how to get to my destination, Ainslie even invited me to a New York Red Bulls soccer game which was amazing. As the days went by, I felt better about Ainslie and her family, it seemed like they were my family. The house is the same as in the photos, everything is told in order such as the cleanliness, the super cozy room, the air conditioning works perfectly and the common areas are super nice and clean. He even gave me some things to cook me a delicious dinner. It also has a washing machine which she provided me, Ainslie is the best, I grew to love her very much and I am going to miss her a lot. I definitely recommend this place to stay since it is in a very nice area in Brooklyn and is very close to the Subway to go to Manhattan, there is a beautiful park three blocks away and places to eat around. Don't hesitate to stay in this house, it was the best experience I could have on Airbnb. It is also worth mentioning that if you need or like video games, it is the ideal place to play against Ian, the son of Ainslie and John, since you can always beat him as I did it Hahahaha. Don't hesitate to use this highly recommended house. I love you john, ainslie and ian, never change.

Teddy and Troy were great and did everything in their power to make sure I could come check in slightly early.  The apartment was super nice, the pictures don't do it justice. I was very comfortable and the location was great, the nightly rate they are offering is SERIOUSLY undervalued for the quality of the property. If this listing is available for you, you should take it, it is really a steal!

This apartment is quiet and very comfortable. I felt very safe. Good neighborhood. You can't beat the location. There is a gym, a grocery store, a drug store, multiple restaurants and pubs a block or less away. The laundry in the basement is very convenient if you are staying longer than a week. Gordon is a very good host. Just call him if you have questions. Very personable. I highly recommend this apartment.

A lovely place to stay, the hosts were prompt in their responses, they were especially accomodatiing to the needs of our little one. Also did a really nice job cleaning up the place on a daily basis. The place is situated very close to the major highways in queens, which is quite convenient.  The neighborhood itself is decent, i never felt unsafe. Although they have a tendency to leave the front door unlocked after they leave the place, closing only the main door which acts as a sort of screen. But maybe that's just me being picky, i want to feel as secure as possible, especially since i don't know the neighborhood as well as they do. Overall a nice experience which i highly recommend.

J is a great guy and made me feel welcomed. The two story townhouse was clean and well decorated. I appreciated the fact that he has no-shoes policy in the house, which keeps it clean. The room I stayed in was also very neat. It had a working AC, big closet, queen size comfortable bed, and everything to get a great night sleep. The house has 3 bedrooms and J shares it with a roommate, who I haven't seen.   My only area of concern was the location. It's a rough neighborhood. In my 4 days of stay nothing happened. But coming back from subway, I didn't feel completely relaxed. And I've been to many unsafe places around the world, and I'm rarely concerned about my safety. It's also a long walk to the nearest subway (15 minutes) and there are no restaurants or grocery stores around at all. Some convenient stores. But those pretty much just had chips and water.  Anyway, aside from the location the place was great. And J is a wonderful host!

J. is a great host who is responsive, friendly and empathetic. Although I stayed just for a night, I felt at home, relaxed and managed to wash my clothes quickly with his great help. Thank you so much!  I just felt a bit uneasy when I was walking around the area especially when I had to do so at night and very early in the morning with big luggage to move to another city. I may have heard the sound of a gun at night, and some cars passing with large volume of music interrupted good night sleep. I didn't get into any actual danger, and my perception might have been just a bit affected by the environment that I was not used to.

This is my first to visit NYC and first time to use airbnb to booking the house ,im very very happy to meet J,he is very nice man and very kindly to tell u all of that, He is a famous photograhper ,J house is in Brooklyn the C train station near by J house ,because im going on bussiness so i stay in there 7 days ,everyday i was walk to the C train station  it need 10~15minutes ,and C train can go to the Mangatton (need 30-40minutes) because i like walking so this distance is very good and the place are very safety ,when i lose the way so many peoples help me and J was everyday check u how about today he want to help u ,my living room is very beatuful and bed is so comfortable,even thouth our country with NYC has time diffirence ,i also sleep very well, i want to say if u are a girl or only one person to booking the house u dont need afraid or worry about the place ,J will let u know what is the great gost in NewYork ,the price is so cheap and amazing ,so If u live NewYork J house will be let u have a great trip or working ,i hope u  choose J house !! Next time i will also book that !!!

I hate writing bad reviews. Most Airbnb folks are private owners and operators that run a small business, I do so as well and understand the constant stress. We attempted to communicate with Chantelle on the date of check-in but did not hear from her until up to 8 hours later. Upon arrival at the location to get the keys to our stay, the key box wasn't working and Chantelle wasn't answering. We waited 30 minutes, constantly attempting to contact Chantelle, before contacting Airbnb, but were eventually forced to. Airbnb also could not get into contact with Chantelle. Airbnb refunded us in full and provided a 10% credit. Chantelle didn't contact us until 8 hours after check-in. I do not trust Chantelle as a host and would not stay with her in the future.

The place looks exactly like the pictures. Very spacious and comfortable for 2 people. The location is great; close to delis, restaurants, convenience shops, etc. Messaging with Chantelle was brief but responses were almost immediate which was appreciated. Finding the place was very low stress. Upon arrival, the place looked and smelled clean. Plenty of towels to use. The bed was comfortable and the bedside lamp has a dimmer which was just a little added bonus when you don't want to get up to turn the light off after a long day of walking. We planned on walking a lot and we did. The walks FROM the airbnb to Chinatown (south) is about 55 minutes, Times Square (west), maybe about 20, Hells Kitchen 3-5 min beyond that, and Central Park (NW) also probably 25 minutes. Taxis are also easy to grab if you walk outside and either to the left or right being the street it's on is relatively not very trafficky. The airbnb felt safe and was surprisingly very quiet. The kitchen has everything from wine glasses, pans, silverware, paper towels, etc. The refrigerator is definitely good size. The microwave works excellent. We did not use the stove or oven. The closet has 15-20 hangers to use. The backyard area was also a good size to hang out. My friend said she would definitely live there. Pretty much zero issues and all smiles on our end! Would stay again!
We loved staying in your well -appointed AirBnB. thank you for making it such a stress free and enjoyable stay!

My boyfriend and I stayed at Jay's for the weekend and our experience was seamless. His space is very welcoming and comforting and Jay was a very accomadating host! The neighborhood was very nice and we didn't feel unsafe walking to and from the subway at all hours of the night. Highly recommend and would definitely try to stay here again!

Apartment well located at the level of amenities in a lively neighborhood, no problem, bring good shoes because it is far from touristy New York... Apartment as in the photos, no unpleasant surprises except perhaps the ambient humidity.

If you want to hangout in cute coffee shops, go for strolls in a nice scenic area, etc spend the bit of extra money and stay somewhere nicer like Dumbo, Cobble Hill, Brooklyn Heights, etc. The amount of money we spent lyfting to these places would have paid the difference we saved staying in this part of Bushwick. The pharmacy and grocery store around the corner was very convenient though. The best part was the self check in. No need to stress about timing your arrival just right. We easily found parking right outside of the house too. My main complaints were the stained furniture, yellow smelly pillows(really strong body odor smell), and old mattress. You can noticeably feel the difference between the left and right side of the mattress as though someone significantly heavier routinely slept on the left side. Cooking in the kitchen at night was nice, but would have been stellar if a basic spice set, napkins, and paper towels were available. With a few tweaks this place could easily be 5 stars, and then the extra money you pay to lyft to nicer places would be worth it. This place did the trick, but I wouldn’t stay again.

Martin’s place is great, exactly what it looks like in the ad. Everything crystal clear when we arrived (me and my husband), with everything we needed to spend the two weeks we were in NYC. The place is great for couples, specially for those wanting to keep the trip cheaper: it has a great kitchen, with everything you need to cook. The neighborhood is nice also, very quiet but nit at all sketchy. The apartment is 1 block away from the M and J lines, but still you won’t hear a thing when you go to sleep. Also, it’s 1 metro station away from a big junction, where you have access to subway lines going to Williamsburg, Coney Island, Queens and the JFK airport. To Manhattan is a 30 minute or less trip by the subway and you’ll be off right in the middle of Soho, one of the most hips and beautiful parts of Manhattan. Near the apartment are a handful of supermarkets and stores, which is great too.   Martin and Sofia are great hosts. They were always fast to respond to our messages and requests, and were always available to any questions we had. Also, our flight was late in the night and they let us leave our luggage with them even after our checkout, so we could enjoy our last day in town without carrying everything around.   Great place, great hosts!

We stayed at Martin's place for 2 nights, and it was great. You can get to Williamsburg in about 20 minutes via the subway and it's only a couple of minutes extra to Manhattan. The place was very clean, and Martin was very easy to reach. The neighbourhood is a little sketchy, so we ubered back at night, but totally fine during the day. Would absolutely recommend for anyone looking for a budget option in NYC.

The ceilings are very thin, so unfortunately you can hear every single step from above. The host didn’t seem to care about that, so even at midnight you could hear them walking or a child crying. Besides that, Martin seemed to be nice, even if I had the feeling that he’s not really trustworthy. The surveillance camera is a scam and the place smelled very strange. So when you’re into IKEA furniture and don’t need anything from your host it should be okay.

Jay was amazing! Incredible room, great location, energy was truly exactly what me and my boyfriend needed. Everything was clean, stylish and felt like a home away from home. I cannot stress enough how this was definitely my best Airbnb experience ever (and I travel A LOT). A must stay for sure!

WARNING: DO NOT STAY HERE!!!!! Worst experience I’ve ever had! Upon coming to the Airbnb the password to the key box and WiFi were wrong (which was totally fine!!) except that after politely explaining the passwords were incorrect I was accused of lying. When we got in we discovered there were also bugs everywhere and the air conditioner was broken. Then when we got home from dinner we realized there was no hot water and the bed was broken (middle of the bed sinking almost the floor). The wife of the host came down the next day to check out the hot water and bed. She immediately accused me of lying about the bed even after I showed her the damage. Then she hostilely told us the hot water heater had to be turned on and that “we should have know that” (it was no where on the instructions).  When I told her I didn’t appreciate how she was talking to me and that this was disrespectful she began yelling at me. She would not leave the space and was yelling in my face and telling me to find somewhere else to stay because asking for hot water and a bed was apparently too much to ask for what I paid. She said “Um HELLO this is New York”. She even confronted my friend to ask if she was yelling to which my friend responded “yes” and then began yelling at my friend. Then the other host came in and started yelling at me as well, accused me of yelling at his wife, and called me crazy. He would not let me finish a single sentence and just continued to scream over me telling me he wouldn’t listen to what I had to say. (For context I work as a case worker at a homeless shelter/rehab facility in Chicago and am trained in de-escalation and remaining calm at all times, so I refused to react to this couples unexplained level of hostility). They then proceeded to kick us out of the Airbnb. Thank god my friend video tapped the entire thing to send to Airbnb (the video consisted of me calmly trying to express my concerns and both hosts screaming at me). The host promised a full refund (which we have on video) and then attempted to only give us half upon leaving. We left immediately feeling unsafe and extremely stressed with no where to stay. This was a deeply uncomfortable and uncalled for experience. After living in New York for years, visiting many times, and never having an experience like this I would recommend staying literally anywhere else.

From start to finish before and during our stay Negra was always available to answer any questions and help if possible. I had a few questions before and during and Negra was always prompt in responding (Even one night where we got home late and needed a take away, she let us know the food had arrived 12am!!)   The home itself was exactly what we wanted for the 4 of us it was the perfect size with a lovely kitchen with all things needed to cook a meal if you really wanted to, we cooked breakfast most mornings. Close to a shop the eggs are much nicer than the uk and a 30 second walk from the house to 46th street subway it was a perfect location to get to New York Times Square which was 20 minutes one subway ride.   The subway is relatively easy to use, I found it very easy but I work on London Underground customer service however my mum and aunt found it ok to get around on.   We arrived 2 hours early and Negra being a good host allowed us to leave our cases in her apartment until it was ready which was very nice of her as it was last minute as we messaged as we was outside the apartment, also being late to inform her that we needed a late check out she was able to get the cleaner to come an hour later.  The steps are not as steep as you would normally think steep. This was not a problem with my aunt who has arthritis in her knees. Coming into the apartment there was milk left for us with some other bits and the tv was large but we didn't use it so often.   We didn't bump into Negra again the whole holiday which showed she left us to our own devices which was very reassuring. Unfortunately I didnt get to meet the husband however my auntie said he was a lovely man who was also quick to offer help if needed before he headed off to work.  If we return we would stay here again and we would recommend this apartment to anybody who wants to save money for more spends in New York, for the sake of 20 minutes on the subway which we did not once find Intimidating or dangerous and we were coming home from 9pm-1am every night we barely had a minute to rest in NYC. as it was our first time we wanted to do as much as we could in the 8 days we was there.   The area itself was also safe no problem walking down the street late at night.  5* ideal for what you want.   Thanks again.

This unit is in on the third (top) floor and is very quiet. It is charmingly decorated and spacious. We were there for four nights with our 22 year old daughter and we were very comfortable. Negra and her husband were extremely gracious and while the only thing we asked for was to extend our time, she was very quick to respond. The neighborhood is multi cultural and generational wth lots of amazing restaurants and very easy access to the subway. Manhattan is only 15-20 minutes away. My husband and I took several late evening strolls and never once felt unsafe. Definitely a nice neighborhood close in to the City. Highly recommend.

BOOK THIS PLACE!  We (family of 4) stayed here for a week during fall break.  It was a perfect home base for exploring New York City.  It was only a $15 taxi ride from LaGuardia.  The house is on a nice quiet street that is still close to local shopping and dining.  It is literally less than a block to the 46th Street subway station.  The R & M trains run every few minutes, and it’s a quick 20-30 minutes downtown depending on where you are going.  (Highly recommend getting an unlimited metro pass...). We took the subway EVERY where.  It was even easy to get to Brooklyn. The place is just the perfect size that you don’t feel like you are on top of each other.  Which was a nice surprise for NYC.  Very clean and nicely decorated.  Also the shower is amazing!  It felt like a spa shower.  The bathroom also had nice lighting for doing hair and make-up, something my 18 yr. old daughter was very happy about.  We found the neighborhood around the house to be nice and clean and we never felt unsafe, which was something my mother was worried about.   Our host was also thoughtful, leaving us some OJ, water and a few sodas.  We bought some water, but didn’t really need it because the tap water tasted fine.  She also provided shampoo, conditioner, a bar of soap, plenty of toilet paper and Kleenex.  In the kitchen there was dish soap and paper towels too.  The bath towels were plentiful and very high end.  The bedding was very comfortable too, with extra blankets if we needed them.   She also allowed us to drop our luggage off before our check in time of 2 pm.  We didn’t need to leave our luggage past 11 on check-out day, but I understand that was a possible option too if we needed it.  The Wi-Fi was pretty quick, and the electronic door lock was nice, so need to worry about losing a key.   She was great about communicating too, even texting us when it was raining to let us know there were umbrellas in the closet we could use.  Overall it was a great stay with a great host!  We’ll definitely book again if we return!

The 4 of us spent 7D6N at Shirley's room #5. Appreciate how the host allows us to leave our luggage at the kitchen till 5pm on the day of departure. Location is quite convenient, only 15 min walk to 7 train.   Things to note though. 1. Lock - The lock of the room is a mess with a latch on both inside and outside the room. We felt very uncomfortable and unsafe sleeping in the room for the first 4 nights as we couldn't lock the door from inside and at the same time worried about being locked inside the room by the outside latch (which it did once). It was scary to be locked inside. Luckily there was a tenant who passed by and helped us to unlatch the door. When we gave our feedback to the host on the difficult lock on the 1st day and g!ot her response on the 4th day, she came by when the 4 of us were having a bite in the kitchen and turned the lock and locked us out. God did she make a big wooha about the whole saga as our only key was left inside the room.   2. Cleanliness - The common area was cleaned for the first 3 days but was left unattended for the next 4 days we were there. It can be quite dirty with tenants from 10 occupied rooms.  3. Responsiveness of the host - Host will sms you the address on the day of your arrival but she never checked her text messages so do not expect any reply from her via phone text message. As told by host later, she would only reply to Airbnb message as she has 10 rooms to manage but her response was slow.  4. Bed and pillows - bed is hard and pillows were too soft that it gave us back and neck aches. Luckily the host changed the pillow for us on the 4th night but the pillows were still soft and couldn't give support to the neck.

Good for a quick overnight stay. Room is spacious and has a nice bed for a solo traveler. Clean spaces, quick access to bathroom, etc. Host was friendly and had quick communication. Family of at least 2 to 3 lives here, including a child. Home was kind of messy and very noisy when I first arrived, as it was essentially a normal functioning home with a child I was walking into. However, eventually things settled down and it was quiet at night and I had more privacy.  2 main grips were:  1) Parking - this is more of a NY thing than specific to this property, but be advised that it is very difficult to get parking in front of this property. I got lucky when I first arrived, but then had to circle around and park decently far away the next time I tried to park. 2) The cat - Be advised there is a cat at this property, and I wasn't the most fond of it (and I'm normally an animal lover). Most reviewers seemed to say the cat at this home is friendly, which it was at least at first, but this cat was honestly VERY annoying and also sometimes MEAN. Literally EVERY time I tried to walk to/from my room to the bathroom and/or front door, the cat would run in front of you and essentially block your feet each time you took a step. I think this was a way of it "playing" with you, but there was no way to stop it and after a while it got both very annoying but also dangerous. I tried to traverse the place in the dark at night and almost tripped badly multiple times because of this cat. It just won't leave you alone. During the morning I left, the cat also attacked me unprovoked. It may have had to do with me not humoring it "playing" with me, but I didn't appreciate having to deal with a cat who wouldn't leave you alone and hurt you if you didn't pay attention to it (it jumped up and clawed at my leg, scratching it pretty bad). People should just be aware of this.  Overall, aside from the above, I enjoyed my stay for what it was, and for the value you can't do much better in this area.

I stayed at Lucilu's place for 7 days, which was not a good choice. Lucilu and her mom were so kind, though. I was scared of coming into the house because of the cat.
