I realized that I didn't like it. Plus, the room was not that clean. I felt very uncomfortable when I stayed there even though I wasn't that sensitive. Long stays don't be recommended.

Eduardo was a great host and made my first air b&b trip one to remember. The place was super attractive, exactly how he described. Yes, it is Harlem, but I never felt unsafe, even walking there from the subway at 2am, although I did have my boyfriend with me and never ventured out by myself. I do recommend to not walk by yourself if you're female, just a tip I heard many times from locals. The place is a little ways from the heart of Manhattan and Brooklyn, which is where I spent most of my time but Eduardo left us a subway map which worked out perfectly for us. He was there already to hand the key over, for he lives on the bottom floor, so he was there by phone or in person if we ever needed help! I'm definitely seeing him again on my next trip, I saved his number! I recommend for first timers to New York and air b&b. Thank you Edaurdo!!

Hey guys, so I this was my first booking and experience with Airbnb and this host. The host provided detailed  instruction in regards to access the apartment. She communicated and answered any questions we had upon arrival. We arrived at the property at 6:00pm. We didn’t gain access into the apartment until 9:30pm. It’s like someone tampered with the Master Lock that hold the building & apartment key. After 5th attempt to try to unlock the master lock we called the host and texted her. She ignored the calls and text message. So, we stood outside of the apartment for about 30mins-1hour before she texted or called us back. Once she answered she tried to walk us through the process of opening the lock. At this point, it was like7:30pm. She never came to help us. She sent her Mother a few mins later, which was very helpful. The mom was able to gain access to the master Key from the Neighbor. At this point it’s, 8pm-ish and we are inside of the building. Now the key to the apartment door wasn’t working, her mom couldn’t get into the apartment. After a few tryings and over 30mins if waiting, the door finally opened. Once inside we tried to put our phone on the Charger and the outlets didn’t work. The apartment was clean from the looks of it. We really didn’t look around. We was still dealing with the door. The safety of this apartment is very questionable. It is located in a nice neighborhood but the key situation made this unsafe. Once, I presented my feelings about being uncomfortable due the safety of the apartment. The host became very rude, and couldn’t even give us five minutes to try to find somewhere else to go. She kicked us out at 9:45pm-ish and was very rude on the phone. She made sure to go back into Airbnb to act like she cared. Our refund was processed but she never apologized for the inconvenience. If you’ll like more details about this place feel free to DM me. The host Attitude and behavior at the end of this frustrating situation would not

Very easy access to subway! Right around the corner. Other than that, pretty average apartment that was pretty cold and not very comfortable. If you are just looking for a place to briefly sleep, semi uncomfortably, this is a good spot. Parking was also a bit sketchy. Had to fight for it on the street

Eduardo and Matt were incredible hosts.  They were very gracious and accommodating when our flights arrived later than expected and were generous in letting me check out late when once again I had to deal with delayed flights.  They were great communicators - always available and quick to respond.  They are lovely people and wonderfully friendly.  The bottle of wine waiting for us was a nice touch.  The place is a short walk to a few different subway lines and conveniently located within Harlem.  I walked through the neighbourhood at all hours and never felt unsafe.  It is lively and there are many great bars and restaurants in the area.  The apartment is on the top floor, so there is no one staying above you.  Having stayed in other places where this was not the case, it appreciate this feature.    Thank you for a great stay.

Patrick's apartment is a good value way to get great access to some super interesting parts of New York. The area is lively and feels safe. It's very easy and relatively quick to get into Manhattan (about 30mins on the subway). The apartment was pleasant and has everything you'll need for a long stay. I was there during coronavirus lockdown so it's a little tricky to comment too much on what goes on in the area as everything was shut. I would say though that during a fairly stressful time Patrick and his lady Diana were terrific at keeping in touch and making sure I was ok. It was much appreciated and shows what kind and caring hosts they are. Would definitely look them up again if/when I can return to NY.

Everything was perfect! Address ideally located near metro public transport (express & local line) or bus. We were extremely well received, despite our very late arrival, our flight was 3 hours late.  The Harlem neighborhood is warm and pleasant, far from the hustle and bustle of downtown.  Thank you for the good local addresses: the surprising and unique jazz club, mass at the Salem church right next door on Sundays.  The house is unique, decorated like a museum, each room is an invitation to travel. Each of the bedrooms has its own bathroom, the beds are very comfortable and cozy, we have never had such soft sheets.  On our next trip we will definitely return to Caroll Ann and George.

I was very disappointed with Airbnb's services after this experience. I will probably not stay in any Airbnb houses. This was my worst experience. First, I had to wait a long to get into the house. The check-in instructions said they would open the door if use the doorbell. However, I had to wait for some time as they were not at the house. Second, they have a cat and it is not properly maintained. When I went to the bathroom at midnight, the cat attacked me. Every time you open the door, the cat will come. Third, I found the host very unwelcoming. The first thing she told me: you have to take off your shoes even if I did not enter the house and I always take off my shoes when I enter a new house. Fourth, the house needs renovation. It is hard to feel good when you use the bathroom. It is old and always remains dirty. I found the whole house very dirty. The only good thing is the location. The property is very close to restaurants including Berger King and MacDonald's and to subway

Usa Stay was a great and responsive host. I would recommend communicating through the airbnb app if you need anything or have questions. I was amazed by their response times. Stayed over a month with them for an extended business trip. As someone with some experience staying in hotels and airbnb for long terms trips to New York, I would highly recommend going with Usa Stay as opposed to individual airbnb property 'owners', since they can be super shady in the Manhattan area and you could find yourself stuck in a really bad situation. I'm moving onto another unit at a different property because they make it easy to get the keys, instructions are clear, I can trust them, etc.  This is out of Usa Stay's control, but immediate area of Kips Bay can be a little rough. If you aren't used to a tougher neighborhood you might not enjoy the immediate area. Once you get to Park and Lex, there's great restaurants etc, but the unit itself is right in the middle of some pretty real moments. The building feels safe and is nice, but I wouldn't recommend hanging outside the building after dark if you're skittish.   However, sometimes felt like old SF mission/tenderloin areas, so if that's your thing you might like it. Pretty young crowd hanging around - close to bars/restaurants like Cannibal, the 6 station. I would stay there again. It was really comfortable and started to feel homey.

DO NOT BOOK THIS BNB, let me start with Carol and George are the sweetest old couple you could ever meet.They were kind welcoming and even let me check in a few hours early, this should be listed under a shared space due to the fact that they have complete access to come and go in the 3 floor you will be renting and they definitely do so, this house was FILTHY there was dust and spider webs everywhere and I do mean everywhere the freezer refrigerator and stove was dirty as well which made it extremely uncomfortable for myself and my family to even consider cooking as we had planned. Carol refunded most of the cleaning fee via check with an attached note to it that was a bit rude however Carol did try and do some of the cleaning herself but was not very successful. We had planned to spend most of our time in the house because this was my anniversary and I had so many intimate things on the agenda for the weekend but do to the condition of the home we was barely at the bnb. The beds and all furniture are very old so please know that the pictures are photo shopped and this place looks nothing like it does on here.This is the first bad review I’ve ever had to give at a bnb but this has also been the worst exp I’ve ever had a bnb, please know that it’s all types of voodoo looking dolls and budas all over the home it’s pretty scary, also the master bedroom sink is stopped up and George said we have to keep in mind that the house has its original piping still in place, as if that was pose to make it better. So take that that as you brush your teeth the sink is filling up with dirty water which was very disgusting.Staying here has made me and all my family members think about never renting via air bnb again. I hope this was helpful to anyone considering staying here in the future.

1) Jennifer is not a host, she works for a corporate leasing company where this apartment is located.  2) While in a convenient part of town. This apartment's location is somewhat shady. There is a gay strip club across the street and there are constantly street people just hanging out in front of the building smoking cigs. Was fine, just uncomfortable.  3) The apartment is very noisy. From every footstep in the apartment above (wood floors and no carpet), to the the elevator (I was in the corner apartment and it would wake me up nightly).  The couple arguing across the hall.  After a couple of complaints with mgmt doing nothing, I just moved out and considered it a sunk cost.  4) There is no cable TV, just a heads up. Internet service sucked and was even out for a few days. In addition to a very generous service fee ~$200. The host tried to hit me up for another $150 for "utilities" over a week after I moved out.  Its like a slum lord found airbnb, seriously.

Scott's place was clean, comfortable, pretty quiet, and in a nice Brooklyn location. If you want to explore Brooklyn, this place is perfect. The neighborhood has great breweries and restaurants, and is close to a bunch of other great Brooklyn spots as well. The distance to Manhattan isn't exactly far, but not exactly close, either. But, whatever, the space is a steal for the access to trains and local spots.  The public area of Scott's building isn't exactly confidence inspiring - the stairwell is a bit crooked and the walls are in need of repair. However, Scott's apartment is great. The room was cozy but not cramped at all, and was quite clean. The apartment itself was in nice shape and the bathroom was clean and easy to use.  Scott was an invisible host! I honestly wasn't sure if he was staying in the apartment or not. He really went out of his way to make it feel like our apartment while we were there. He was very easy to communicate with on the Airbnb app, and let us leave our bags there a little extra after official check-out as well.  Great stay. I'd definitely stay at Scott's place again if I was coming to NYC. Thanks, Scott!

I stayed with Scott for 3 weeks, and I enjoyed every minute of it.   The location is perfect, close to the subways, delis, restaurants, bars, and all sorts of necessities and activities.   The apartment is nice and clean, and always well maintained. And the vibes in general is super relaxing and stress free.   The room is spacious and the bed is super comfy. It’s full of the necessary amenities, such as a big closet for your clothes, and towels for your daily showers.   Most importantly, Scott is an amazing host, his schedule is busy but we usually catch up in the morning, and sometimes in the evening. He’s super cool and all he asks from his guests is communication and cleanliness. He’s a roommate i’d def like to have if i happened to live in NYC.   I cannot recommend this place enough. If I visit New York in the future, i know i’m gonna be staying at his place.   Thank you Scott for an amazing stay, and hope to see you soon!

Edgar's apartment was truly a great find! It was very affordable, and the room had space and was clean. Apartment is a bit of walk away from the subway, but not too far, and some busses pass the apartment closer by. Furthermore, as a female solo traveler, I never felt unsafe, both in the apartment or neighborhood. Edgar himself was a fantastic, friendly host, and he had the loveliest cat Digi, whom I miss already.  I will definitely consider staying here, should I ever come back to NYC!

We had a great time at Alina's apartment, staying for 3 weeks for our first visit to New York. It is modern, extremely well appointed and very clean with all the home comforts to make a very enjoyable stay. The beds were super comfortable to the point where I actually slept in to mid morning for the first time in years. It is 2.5 blocks from the closest subway station (the G train), there is a food market, laundromats, excellent coffee shops, liquor stores and take out places just around the corner, plus a couple of very good restaurants a few blocks away, about a 10 minute walk.   The neighbourhood (Bed-Stuy) is up and coming. It's a great area to base yourself for an extended stay in New York. The people are friendly, there are many small churches where you can hear beautiful gospel singing on Sundays and I never felt unsafe.   Alina and her husband were lovely hosts, very helpful and communication was excellent. I would highly recommend staying at Alina's. To be quite honest, we felt like we were coming home to a warm hug each day after our travels. Loved it. Thank you so much Alina and Ahmad.

He was a great host! I was a little skeptical at first to rent a room rather than a whole place on airbnb, being someone who values my privacy and alone time. but he made it very comfortable, kept to his own on the most part, offered some suggestions as needed and I felt free to come and go as I pleased. oh and the bed is SUPER cozy! It had me in a coma sleeping well past noon each day (who says New York never sleeps) hehe.  The location was perfection! Easily accessible from the airport by airtrain and subway and close to central park and times square. Plenty to do and see in the area. I did most my traveling in Manhattan by foot, as i love to walk and explore the city. But, there are several subways nearby and uber is always available.  i never felt unsafe walking in the area at all hours of the night either.   Thank you Gerald for your hospitality (even though my darned red hair spotted your towel ...so so sorry) you were an excellent, gracious and very clean host.   Much appreciated! =)

The accommodation is very modern and quiet. You can reach the center very easily and quickly by subway and bus. The environment is neither dangerous nor dirty, the location is great. Alina is very nice and helpful. We would come back at any time.

The location of this Airbnb is amazing! It is a very safe area and it is two blocks away from the subway station (5 min walk at most) that can take you anywhere in the city. Getting to Gerald’s place was super easy as I flew into JFK I thought it was going to be difficult. Once I arrived at the apartment I was welcomed with some nice salsa music playing softly in the background. The bedroom is spacious with enough room to store your clothes. The bed is perfect as well. It was the most comfortable bed I’ve ever slept on. Especially the pillows. Everything in the apartment is clean and Gerald is also a very clean person which is great.  I met Gerald shortly after I arrived at the apartment. He was very kind and generous and left some goodies for me in the room since it was Halloween. He is a very easy going guy and him and I spent hours talking all things music, food and traveling. He is very knowledgeable and taught me a lot about NYC. This was my first solo trip and he definitely made me feel comfortable and confident in traveling solo again! I checked out very very early in the morning (3 AM) and I asked Gerald if it was safe to walk at that time to the subway station as I was a bit concerned and he assured me it was safe. He was so kind as to walk me to the subway station! Again, another reason why I think Gerald is a great host and a great human being for his act of kindness. I would NOT hesitate to book this place again. If you are a woman solo traveler and afraid of running into danger I assure you that you are safe in Gerald’s place!

I booked to stay here on 11th june 2018. Upon booking this apartment i was very very excited to come to nyc & to stay here. The apartment is how it is on the pictures in the outside the neihhbourhood outside is a lil rough but i had no troubles from other people. I wasn't greeted by my host which was saddening as i read another review stating alina was warm and welcoming and shared cool spots to visit etc prior to booking which is half the reason i booked this place. This wasnt my experience. The wifi didn't work properly the ENTIRE time i was there and i mentioned it twice and nothing was really done about it. Upon booking i had an error on air bnbs site stating the tuesday was fully booked and reached out on 31st december to ask my host alina if iy becomes available to let me know.. this never happened! I therefore checked out on the tuesday 12th june and went to stay with a friend and it cost me an extra $120 i didnt have! As the eifi wasnt working and communication was poor anyways i didnt get messages from her until i reached the other side of nyc 2 trains and 2 taxis away telling me i didnt have to check out. FRUSTRATING! Alina stated i could have the day i lost refunded on the wed 13th... however... she later declined to refund when i got home to the u.k and had wifi. I suffer from anxiety and i came down with a bug i caught on the plane there... i was fevered, achy all over, vomitting (into the toilet) and had a migraine.... i was bombarded whilst being ill with pictures from alina after i checked out at 6:50am as i was headed to a graduation despite feelimg like death warmed up i put wash off tan on for the occassion and so not to scare the guests as i looked sick. A small stain was left on 1 bed. All dishes were done, trash was taken out and in general i respected the place as i didnt exactly have any mad parties etc but yet was bombarded with texts saying the place was left in a quote on quote "HORRID" state which triggered anxiety attacks and ruined my trip. It was also innacurate to say the least and wasn't seen by alina herself only the word of a house keeper. It really was pedantic! There was a £95.42 cleaning fee included in the room surely that covers the house keeper to wash a bed sheet?! And make a bed. I am in the uk and STILL sick so sorry i didn't have the energy to make the beds but it really wasn't a huge deal to me i wear tan in my own house and i just throw the sheet in the wash & it comes out!! We don't get much sun in scotland so i often have to...

Alina’s place had everything we needed to enjoy a relaxing weekend. Our flight got in before our check-in time, so it was super nice of Alina to offer to let us drop off our luggages early. We appreciated how clean, beautiful, and spacious Alina’s place was, and there was even Apple TV to enjoy at the end of each day, to unwind after a lot of walking and exploring Manhattan. We took the subway at Bedford-Nostrand Avenues station every day, about a 7-minute walk. It felt a little scary walking around after dark, so we either got back before 7pm or took an Uber from the subway station back home (about $10). For nearby delicious eats, be sure to check out BKLN Blend—their fresh juices and food were delicious. We were there for breakfast each day of our stay—only a two-minute walk away, super convenient!

This is the first place we stayed after relocating to NYC from Australia and we liked the area so much that we decided to rent an apartment a few blocks away. The studio is clean, tidy and has everything you will need (TV, WiFi etc) plus the cats loved being able to stretch their legs in the outdoor space!  Alon is great, very timely with his responses whenever we messaged him (even over the holidays) which made our relocation less stressful.  The area is close to good restaurants, bars, grocery stores and also within walking distance from a lot of tourist attractions too.

Had such a wonderful time staying at Aleksandra's place. I was here for a month for work. The place was very clean, and she cleaned the bathroom and common areas daily. My room was spacious with a big closet. Really close to the Q train that is 20 minutes into Manhattan. Also close to 2, 5. And very close to Prospect Park, where I would go running. Would definitely stay here again.  Some things to consider: During the summer months, the second bedroom may be rented out as well, so there may be other guests. The neighborhood is Afro-Carribean, and you will have a lot of authentic places to eat, but it is more of a low income type of neighborhood. However, I never felt unsafe.

I didn’t regret the decision to stay at Alicias place. It is very well located and they Bushwick neighborhood is a good choice if you want to get away from busy manhattan. The room has everything you need, ac a bed and even closets. Alicia herself gives you a lot of space, we had her place kind of for us alone even though she was at home, but if you need help with something she will answer all your questions. The pictures show what expects you when you arrive so don’t be afraid of any bad surprises.

We had a great time in New York and Alicias apartement definitely was a part of it. We had a nice and clean room and she cared a lot for us feeling at home. We were allowed to use everything in the shared areas: the tv, the kitchen, the hairdryer, shampoo and so on. The cat thats living there was scared of us most of the time and didn't bother us at all.  In the beginning she answered all our questions and was very spontaneous because we arrived later than we planned.  Our flight back was leaving very late in the night so actually we had have to carry our backpacks with us the whole day. But we didn't had to do it because we could leave them in the flat and get them in the evening, even though Alicia had a new guest arriving already. All in all: thanks for the awesome stay at your place.

Pretty good location. subway station is just in front of house, good communication with host and convenient but pretty dirty place also. Smell was pretty bad so me and my friend were afraid of going out of room. Except cleanliness everything is perfect for travel.

My stay in Aleksandra’s place was AMAZING. Aleksandra was one of the nicest people I’ve ever met. She was super helpful with tips on getting around the city and what to do.  The location is right by the Q which was convenient for getting into Manhattan. The surrounding neighborhood isn’t super nice BUT I never once felt unsafe. There are also cute coffee shops scattered throughout if you keep going down Flatbush. The bedroom and bathroom were VERY clean. The bed was comfy and the entire apartment was cozy. It completely exceeded my expectations. I’ll definitely be staying here again.

The pictures and description of this listing are definitely accurate. The place was clean and looked brand new in a sense of speaking.   I had 2 problems with my host;  1. Days before my arrival I spoke to Kimberly giving her my flight information including the times I would be arriving so she knew and understood. The day of arrival I couldn't reach her after several attempts, then when I finally did she wasn't coming to the apartment till 4pm despite knowing I would arrive at 11am. So I had to wait outside in the cold for 5 hours!!!  2. I told Kimberly beforehand once again that I was shipping items to the apartment and it was ok with her. Some items were delivered and others were left in the mailbox. Although I explained to Kimberly that the mailman isn't ringing the doorbell and placing our items in the mailbox. Kimberly did not give us the keys to the mailbox despite the issue we were having but instead we had to wait for whenever was convenient for her to drive down from NJ just to open the mailbox.   We are already renting her home, but i guess she thought we were going to steal her mail!!!

The apartment is beautiful just as in the photos- it was bigger than I expected. Everything from free wifi, in-house heating and a comfy bed. Everything you would want. It was a bit of a travel into the city though. As a newbie to New York (and the States) it meant long  commutes in th train. If you are looking at spending most of your time in Manhattan then just expect to take two train lines into Midtown.  There isn't anything to eat that's close by, so is a good place if you're looking for a good nights rest and plenty space to chill.  We did have a safety concern when a party turned into a fight in one of the neighbours apartments, but that's something outside of anyone's control. it was a bit scary though as I'm from a small country and city so I wasn't used to hearing that.  But overall we were happy with the apartment and couldn't wait to rest after long days in the city (and on the train lol)  Thanks!

It is like in the photos very comfortable mattress but the apartment is on the street side too much noise the neighborhood is infested with rats and dirty. Dangerous for girls, don't come home late. No curtains on the windows so we didn't take advantage of the light. Neighbor on the landing with baby. Secure building, correct location, close to metro, lots of things, cheap and very good to eat nearby

Kimberly’s place was exactly how it was described. Perfect spot for a getaway and to rest your head. An amazing comfy couch, nice kitchen and also a dishwasher and washing machine that game in super handy! She has a fire stick so you can login to your personal accounts and entertain yourself or plug in your gaming console if you like. Lots of towels and bedsheets and also hair dryers and more if you need. The kitchen cupboards are stocked with spices, seasonings and food if needed as well as the fridge. There are a few stairs to get to the apt, but you get the hang of it. Lots of food spots and a supermarket nearby, and a 24/7 deli on the corner was great for quick bites and if you were low on drinks. Overall the experience was a great one and I definitely will be staying there again next time! I’m scared to even recommend it for the fear it might not be available the next time I’m in town lol!

As a family, the three of us felt very comfortable in the apartment. The beds (including the sofa bed) are very comfortable. Communication and check-in were perfect.  It's a 3-minute walk to the metro and it takes about 30 to 40 minutes to get to Manhattan, so the apartment is well suited for exploring New York. However, the environment is noisy (street noise, ambulance sirens, metro), so you can only sleep with the window closed, and as a young woman it can be uncomfortable coming back alone in the evening.

Shirly was very polite, nice and supportive of  me from the beginning. However i was forced to changed my mind and choose different place to stay, since it was unpleasant, unclean and unsafe area to stay in, especially if your are traveling with your family and children.  Besides it is flipping far far away from Manhattan, mid and downtown especially if you decided to come to NY for sightseeing.  Rooms were OK, although they lacked AC and nets had wholes in them. My family was so frighten and upset so i was forced to cancel the reservation. I ve explained her everything and apologized for inconveniences.  However I ve  heard nothing from Shirley from the monent I asked for refund (254$)  I ve tried to contact her via Airbnb, email and even whatsapp but she never replied. If she replied I would ask for 50% refund. However she neither contacted me back nor was as kind and supportive of me as she was from the beginning and from moment i wired her money.  I have never been in Brooklyn before. If all Brooklyn is like the Crown Heights, then I would forget about this area. Its Dangerous, dirty, scary and unpleasant place.

Although the host was super nice, the house wasn't. I read the comments and looked at the pics before and I assumed that it would be a great place to stay. I was so wrong. I was visiting NYC for my bday. I brought my fur baby with me. There was rodent droppings EVERYWHERE!!!! They were on kitchen counters and shelves, oven, in the garbage cans, on back of the couch, in  and behind the dog bed, Windows, on the floor, the the bathroom, hallway, bedroom. There  was so many droppings that I wasn't sure if it was a herd of rodents living there or if no one had cleaned up in a long time. I took pics of the dropping and sent them to the host. I asked the host about it and he told me the exterminator killed the mice 2 days prior and I had nothing to worry about but each night I was there I saw a mice in the living room. I was so afraid of the rodents and the fact that the droppings was everywhere and I had brought my puppy that we confined ourselves like prisoners on the bedroom. The first night I laid on top of the bed but the 2nd night I decided to get under the covers and there was droppings on the fitted sheets. I was so disgusted!!!!

Matt & Crutch are great & experienced hosts, who put much effort in making our stay as pleasant as possible. The bedroom as well as the bathroom are really good equiped (fridge, coffee machine, robes, table, towels ...) and were both *really* clean. The apartment is less than a five minute walk away from the subway station (along the A/C line) that brings you directly to Manhattan (I would say it's 45 minutes approx.) This part of Brooklyn is probably not the best but we didn't feel unsafe. Also there are some nice restaurants nearby. You can always reach the hosts via Airbnb or Whatsapp and they really tried to make our stay as smooth as possible. Keep in mind that checkout will be at 8 am in the morning. Would totally go there again! Thanks for your hospitality!

Lovely place. Lovely hosts. Lovely neighborhood. We actually did not stay here for leisure; we stayed for a few days while our apartment down the street was being renovated. What should have been simply a place to stay during a stressful time far exceeded our expectation. Fresh muffins greeted us. Our hosts checked in with us via email throughout the week asking what more they could do to make our stay more enjoyable. Among the many things we appreciated was they allow pets. Even our cats were relaxed and well adjusted here. The apartment itself is modern and renovated with plenty of space. It's right in the heart of Park Slope, one of the best neighborhoods in all of New York City. Train access to Manhattan was a breeze. Highly recommend this place to anyone!!

Our stay with Brian and Rachel was perfect and top notch on every level! Brian was always quick to communicate and went above and beyond to accommodate our party from the very first inquiry message to our check out. This was my first AirBnb booking, so was a little nervous but I couldn't have asked for a better experience.  My family of 5 came out for a quick visit, they are not used to walking very much and are from the suburbs so the Prospect Park neighborhood was perfect! Very close to the subway, so close to places to eat, groceries, and attractions. It felt very safe, lots of families in the neighborhood, and pretty quiet. We visited the Botanical Garden and the zoo during our stay. It was so convenient.   They came in on a red eye and Brian was so nice to let us store our bags with them until our check in. He even  let us check in a couple of hours early once the apartment was cleaned. To have a host anticipate that my family would have been very tired after a red eye flight, and offer to let us come and relax before our check in made us feel very taken care of and exhibited the attention for detail and hospitality our hosts had. They communicated all instructions with clarity and warmth. I always felt like Brian would answer any questions I might have during our stay quickly and do whatever he could to accommodate any of our requests.  The apartment itself was very spacious. We never felt overcrowded. Everyone had a comfortable bed to sleep in. The bathroom was amazing, it felt like a spa. We were welcomed with fresh muffins. They provided a lot of little things (toiletries, plates, cups, utensils, etc.) that made our stay feel like home.    We didn't get a chance to take advantage of the yard, but we did all take a peek and found it lovely. If we had been around during the day or were there for a few days longer, we would have definitely taken advantage of the outdoor space.   Brian and Rachel's apartment was perfect for our stay. It's pretty tough to find a place for a large party that is comfortable and a good value but this little gem was more than I could have hoped for. Thank you Brian and Rachel for hosting us. Staying at your apartment made my family's visit virtually stress free. We will definitely stay again the next time they come out.

We stayed at Brian's on short notice since our building suffered a fire. He responded quickly and was extremely accomodating at a very stressful time for me and my family. The place is huge and completely upgraded. Once he installs a full kitchen it will be amazing.

I have used Airbnb over 15 times over the past two years, and this is was my first bad experience.  The main issue was that the communication and the relationship with the hosts, Brian and Rachel who live upstairs, was not good and at several points we had unpleasant situations. This was in part my fault because I had a last minute request for extra guests that was not clear. Brian and Rachel kindly agreed to allow the extra guests for an additional fee, which was very kind, but then became very anxious about the money and sent a series of strongly worded messages that made me feel very uncomfortable. Similarly, shortly before checkout on the last day it started to rain and I asked if it was at all possible to delay check-out a few hours, and then received a reply saying that the fact that I couldn't bother to ask this earlier was unacceptable and that they needed me out of the property at 12h00 sharp. There were other situations like this during the say.  Minor issues: the fridge was not cleaned properly and there were traces of food from the previous guests. There is no kitchen and this was uncomfortable because I could not cook and had to use disposable silverware. Also, the wifi connection does not work properly.

The check in and check out went smoothly. The place is as in pictures. There is a good AC, vacuum cleaner, fast wi-fi, a washing machine and a dryer. Also, the kitchen is fully equipped for cooking. I really enjoyed staying at this place and would recommend it.  There are delis, fast food restaurants and supermarkets nearby. Commuting is nice. 1, A and C lines are really close. The neighbourhood seems slightly shady sometimes, but it isn't bad or anything.

We loved our stay here. The room was clean, private and big! The bed was very comfortable and had an abundance of pillows. The bathroom was big and the host provided basic toiletries. The tub was clean. Overall a great room. The only thing to keep in mind, if you're it's your first time in NY, is how long it takes to get into Manhattan. The host does an excellent job of providing you with information about public transit, and the location is literally a block away from the bus stop. The thing is that you are looking at about a 70-90 minute commute if you want to get to Manhattan, that means that you must be very mindful of your curfews because you don't want to be taking buses or subways in shady parts of town too late at night. Lyft and Uber are an option, but it isn't cheap. At night when we wanted to get back to our room we typically took a Subway all the way to the Jamiaca station, and from there requested a Lyft line which was between 16-18 dollars for my spouse and I. This method was more expensive than taking the subway and then the bus, but we felt a lot safer considering it was midnight. Just wanted to throw that information out there. But as far as the room and the host, definitely A+!
Fabulous location in Park Slope. Quiet shady street with a nice backyard for the apartment. Some really nice welcoming touches and very responsive hosts. Would stay again.

If you love a clean, cozy and stress free place to stay in NY Carolyn’s place is what you want. It also in the center as in, Quick access to everything and everywhere in New York. Nice, quiet and clean neighborhood to park your car. Now I a place in NY 😀👍🏽

I must admit when I first saw Jason's accommodation I was suspicious, for the price of a room getting an entire apartment, plus the photos looked too pretty to be true, and finally the location seems magnificent. Everything seemed too good for the price. I only booked because I saw that Jason is a Superhost. And when I arrive expecting to be surprised below expectations, I see that the apartment is better than in the pictures, very clean and huge and Jason is very receptive. I hope to come back soon.

The apartment is exactly as shown in the photos. There are 3 subway stations, one very close, another a little further away and the other which is also not far but which we ended up not using because the others served us very well on our trips to and from NY.  For those who prefer buses, there are lines around the apartment, but we didn't use them. At first glance, the surroundings aroused some fear in us, but we didn't have any problems. Every day we stayed we always arrived close to midnight. There are markets, pizzerias, Dunkin Donuts, Starbucks Coffee, KFC and others nearby.  We recommend the space.

Beware of this host and this apartment, we made a mistake and booked this place for 3 months because of the good reviews and ignored the review about the dead roaches and the exchange of words between this host and that guest. The apartment has several problems, the biggest one is the mice problem (photos were sent to Airbnb) which made our stay extremely unpleasant and we also had to throw out many of our belongings to the garbage because of mice droppings and urine. After our checkout, the host sent us several requests for money ($270 to be exact) based on false made-up stories using his friend and the Airbnb resolution center rejected all his claims because we were smart enough to document everything before we left. Other problems are the unregulated heat which can be sometimes off and make the apartment very cold during the night in the winter. The building also had a theft problem and several of our packages were stolen. The host was very condescending and unkind, not to mention untruthful, he is very good with words and will try to contradict us, but we've been to many Airbnbs and what is definitive is that we have no reason to lie and will not recommend this apartment to anyone.

The room was as described but it wasn't stated that I'd be living with two other roommates who weren't Felicia.  It was listed as not being kid friendly, yet there was a 2-3 year old crying and screaming all the time.  It is listed as "drug-free" yet it always smelled of pot and cigarettes whenever one of the roommates had people over.  The building itself is complete trash.  There was always a smell when you came in and on several occasions, there was dog feces and urine in the stair wells.  The roommates weren't very respectful of shared space.  They would leave underwear and other dirty laundry in the bathroom.  Three of the four weeks I stayed, I had issues with internet.  Even after it was "fixed" it was terrible. The kitchen was disgusting.  If that kitchen had to undergo inspection, it would fail.  There was a bed and dress, but there was no closet space and when you have to wear business attire everyday its inconvenient.  The neighborhood is very busy and the room faces the street.  Don't expect to sleep when the yankees are in town.  The only good thing was it is extremely close to the 4 and D trains.

Staying at this Catalina’s place was the worst Airbnb experience for over 5 years. I’ll explain why: 1. You don’t get what you see on photos. The couch is different, looking and smelling like it was takes from the street after a homeless person lived on it for a week. Also a small table with a tv/monitor was missing. And other decorative things weren’t there. 2. Cleanness: as I mentioned above, the apartment smells very bad. We stayed there for 1 month and all this time a could sit on the very right corner of the coach.  Also all cleaning supplies were only leftovers on the very bottom of a bottle. We had to buy a lot of staff ourselves. The dishwashing sponge for dirty! Eww 3. We haven’t used the master bedroom at all! There are no lights, window is pointing to a ventilation tube. Also the mattress is super firm. Maybe that’s ok for you… but me and my husband spent a month on the smaller beds. 4. When we asked for sheets for the smaller beds the host said OK and then filed a complaint to Airbnb the same day!! because she thought (!) there are 4 of us staying there. This is unacceptable! 5. Overall the place felt inhospitable. Random smelled furniture, no decorations, empty walls. This place is usually rent for a long term and for Airbnb they put just a few “leftover” things. Last: this apartment totally ruined my NYC experience. When I unpacked my suitcase in my current Airbnb, I still can smell that smelly apartment :(   Good things: - the neighborhood is nice, a lot of food around  - the place is mostly quiet (except for 1 party this 1.30 Am)

Gladys was absolutely wonderful. She was very sweet and great at immediately getting back to us. Overall, the Airbnb served its purpose as most of the time we were only there to sleep. If you are planning to go into Manhattan, the metro is only about a 10 minute walk and there are several restaurants nearby.  It will however take a little while to get to downtown if you decide to take the subway. During the day, we felt pretty safe and there are people walking around, however there were a few times at night where people got a bit sketchy. Again, great host and if you are looking for just a place to sleep, this does the job.

Fernando and his wife are such amazing, hospitable hosts!  Their basement apartment was extremely clean and homey; I was also very impressed with all the amenities they had to offer, such as a coffee maker, microwave, full-sized fridge, cable TV and netflix, heating in both bedrooms and the living room, and even a record player!!  They were also kind enough to provide sodas, water bottles, snacks, and candies.  The walk from the #7 subway might seem a tiny bit sketchy to a young woman alone at night, but I made it to my destination safely every night (and Carmen was even willing to pick me up if I needed her to).  It was about a 5 minute walk to the subway station and a ~40 min trip to midtown Manhattan (which was expected from reading other reviews); even if it might seem a bit far, the value for this airbnb is unbeatable!  I hope I get a chance to stay with them again in the future!

You are only half a block, (right at the end of Fernando's street), for a small Family run Deli and grocery store. Milk, juice, fruit, veggies, home made sandwiches and other food to go.  Even cereal, all the basics. A couple of blocks to a full sized grocery, with meats, fish, and everything you get at your home markets. Holiday Inn three blocks away, ( and near Citi Field), has a very good Happy Hour, ( noon to 7:00 P.M., ), with a super duper food menu....you need to try there at least once. Across the street from the Holiday Inn, is a BIG PARK, with big old shade trees. Hang out there. Kid's playground, basketball courts, a soccer field, but plenty of benches to just sit and watch people, in a quiet oases.....after Manhattan. Subway to Manhattan is 4 blocks away.......what else do you need? The place was, clean, clean , clean....so worry not that it's listed as a basement...LOL When I go back to NYC, and I will, (there is far too much to see in only a week).....I will stay there again. ( 30 to 40 minutes to various places in Manhattan.) I got " lost" a couple times...."local" subways/trains.....and "express" subway / trains.  But that was fun too ,as I saw places I would not have visited.....just ask folks, you won't be "lost" for long.....it's an ADVENTURE remember...LOL I walked to Citi Field for a concert, it is home of the Met's, but other events are put on there. Fernando picked me up, and returned me to the airport. Why pay $300.00 a NIGHT, in Manhattan....stay here.

So I'm going to do it in my language and also in English. Ellen is an exceptional and extraordinary host, really from the moment of booking there was contact. On arrival at the apartment she had a smile, we had communicated our information (arrival time and presentation) by message (in fact the day before my departure she wrote to us to wish us a good flight (small attention that I really appreciated). The apartment was cozy with separate rooms and also a bed. No really I recommend this address without hesitation, it's clean, 40-50 minutes from Manhattan by metro. And above all Ellen is there if you need anything or advice. Really Ellen you were perfect thank you for you my Brother and I are in heaven thanks to you So I will do it in my language and also in English. Ellen is an exceptional and extraordinary host, really from the booking there was a contact, we had communicated our information (time of arrival and presentation) by message interposed (moreover, the day before my entrance we got to write to you a good flying (little attention I really appreciate). not admire Admission to me, this is clean, 40-50 min from Manhattan by metro, and especially Ellen is there if necessary or advice. Really Ellen You were perfect my murice Thank you for my brother and I are to angel thanks to you.

The apartment is very good, functional, very clean located in a great area where you will find everything you need. The host allowed us to stay later than the scheduled time because our flight was late at the end of the day. The only downside was the very noisy air conditioning. We bought a fan for $20 and our nights were more peaceful. Thank you for everything. I recommend!

Please note I am writing this from a very frustrated perspective. Upon arrival the host greeted me and gave me a small tour. At first the place seemed nice enough. But as my stay progressed I noticed things were not as nice as I thought they were. I found a dirty used fork under my bed. The sink was very gross. The snacks he left out were stale and old. The water bottles in the fridge felt sticky to the touch. The towels in the bathroom had holes in them. And there was a creepy crawl space that had a very flimsy piece of plastic over it. This all can be easily forgiven in my eyes. I am not a complainer so I took a Clorox wipe to things and made the best of the experience… but the day before I was supposed to leave my flight got cancelled due to a snow storm I wasn’t anticipating. When I told the host he said he would see if he could accommodate me and that we would have a discussion later about it. For some reason we never had that discussion and I had no other choice but to leave. Which is fine. At least I could stay at the airport. So at checkout I ordered an Uber and went outside… turns out I was snowed in. Snowed in so much that the gate wouldn’t even budge. My Uber driver and I had to dig me out of the house. I messaged my host over and over telling him I was trapped. He never responded. He has the ability to message me even after check out and he NEVER attempted to. For all he knows I could still be trapped in the Airbnb. Yes this is a cheap place to stay, but it wasn’t worth the money I paid for it. I have stayed at cheaper places that were MUCH nicer. This host knew I was a single woman traveling alone and he couldn’t have cared less that I was trapped in his Airbnb. I even cut up my arms digging my way out. I had to get medical attention at the airport because the fence dug into my arms pretty badly, I might end up having scars.

Anna's place was centrally located with easy access to transportation. The place is very quiet and relaxing. The coffee was amazing and we enjoyed having it every morning.  My mother and I were in town for a funeral, Anna's place and service helped reduce our stress and anxiety. We were able to relax once we arrived at her place.   Thank you Anna, if I ever come back to NY I will stay with you!

John is a good host but I had some concerns hence I left the property a day before check out.   We couldnt sleep at night because of  a very noisy air conditioner in the room.  There was no private bathroom although we paid for one. We could not lock the room while sleeping and that made me so uncomfortable and unsafe.

Brooke's place is in amazing area and has a wonderful layout. However, it was quite shocking for us to find the house full of their stuff, baby clothes piled up everywhere. things under the bed, a baby cot (clearly in use) in the bedroom, not even a little empty cabinet where to put our stuff. Rubbish bins not even emptied and bed linen stained of humidity and not having an unpleasant smell. I do believe Brooke is a nice person and a very busy mum. However, if she wants to rent her flat, she should clearly state what the guests are going to find, maybe store all their belongings/clothes in plastic boxes and make sure the house is spick and span.

Joseph's apartment is perfect for visiting New York. The location is very good, close to the bus and subway stops that connect you 25 minutes from Midtown Manhattan, and very close walking distance to the museum mile and Central Park. In addition, various restaurants and shops in the neighborhood.   The apartment is nice and comfortable, reflects what Joseph advertises, well equipped with a small kitchen but enough to prepare a simple breakfast or dinner after a day of sightseeing. The bed is perfect for rest.   We did not have the opportunity to meet Joseph, Esther greeted us kindly and was very flexible with arrival and departure times. The drawback was the cleanliness. Upon arrival, kitchen, bathroom and floor were dirty. It was unpleasant to just arrive at the apartment and see dirt, considering that cleaning is included in the payment. We complained and the next day our host apologized to us and returned to the apartment to clean, but we did not notice much improvement.   In general, the experience has been very good and if this basic aspect of cleanliness is improved, the apartment is ideal to enjoy the New York experience.

Very nice place,with great location,near many conveniences ie supermarkets,restaurants,transportation,museum,central park and safe Lenora and Joseph are excellent hosts  providing many amenities  making the stay very comfortable and stress free.Great place to stay when vising Ny

The perfect place to stay in NYC ! I didn't know Queens before (and I must admit I was afraid it wouldn't be as convenient as staying in Manhattan) but we were surprised and enthusiastic : the subway is less than 1 minutes walking from the loft, plenty of supermarkets in the area, splendid view of Manhattan from the street (5 minutes walking), safe area, 1 subway station from Grand Central. Last time we went to NYC we stayed at Times Square and I prefer staying in Queens where you can rest after a crazy day in Manhattan. Next time we go to NYC we shall return to this loft. As for the loft, it was perfect : very clean (very important and not so easy to find in NYC), fully equipped, nicely decorated, large room and living room. The owners take care of the spot and you feel just like at home. Communication with David was perfect : we were in touch with him before the arrival and he gave us all the informations for check in and we appreciated a late check out. You have at your disposal plenty of informations about the area and NYC. Any kind of information you need, David will immediately and friendly answer to your demand. I highly recommend without any hesitation. Thanks David !

I absolutely loved this little place! The location at night is a little scary but as long as you don’t mess with anyone! I recommend downloading the citizens app for live updates of what’s going on around you especially in Harlem and the train stations! Other wise during the day it was pretty and easy to travel through transit! It’s such a beautiful place and rich in history! The hosts are so kind and always responsive! I felt like a true New Yorker / Local! My favorite restaurant was Sylvia’s and Harlem shake Just a few blocks away. 10/10 recommend saying here! I hope to come back someday!! Thank you for everything!

Michael and Jason were absolutely lovely! We would definitely recommend their place for our friends anytime. They were really helpful and had good tips for Manhattan. The room was clean, we received clean sheets and towels. They were really considerate and tried to make our stay as comfortable as it could be. The apartment is very close to the subway and you're in about 20 minutes in time square. The neighborhood is not sketchy or dangerous, we never had any problems. Shout out to their two cats Chester & Josy! They were very sweet and made our stay even more pleasant. We really hope to meet you again someday! Until then, thank you very much and farewell. Marina & Sascha

I really enjoyed spending my summer break at Demetria's. This woman is a wonderful woman who lives with her two kids in a lovely traditionnal house in Brooklyn next to Utica Sub station. Her house is not huge but clean. That's the most important thing. Feeling good in a house without being scared about something happens to us.  She knows what the word or verb "welcome/welcoming" means. She is smiling, polite, open and friendly like her kids. She always does things with passion so that guest feel great during their trip. She did a lot for my sister and I, so that we spend a good time in NYC. One of my best memory of NYC would be definitely my meeting with that family. People can think I exagerate but nope at all. She is a real HOST and the nicest Newyorker I have met during my trip.

Rob went above and beyond to aid me, from helping me carry up my very heavy bags to even finding me a cab when departing he ensured my transition to New York was as smooth as possible, would most definitely recommend!
I'm glad to have Rob as one of my host in my trip to NY. He was very welcoming, the room is spacious, and the bathroom is clean. Glad to have stayed there.

This place is really comfortable and neat. The room is nice and clean everywhere. The size of room is enough for stay.  Especially the host, Mr.Rob, is really nice person and he was always kind to me. He carried heavy baggage to 4th floor for me.  This stay was my first using airbnb, and I am really glad it was here!

It was my first time to share an apartment via Airbnb and Rob is wonderful, discrete, helpful, and interesting person, just really great. I felt from the start relaxed and supported and the apartment is beautiful and comfortable.

If u choose stay here you will see so many benefits，subway only walk 2mins，A will bring you to downtown，very safe back home late night.the breakfast place called park view is great！and another the Met museum called cloister just 5mins walk.Rob's place in a very munificent yard.inside the place every where is art work and books，you could enjoy your room as a studio.the most amazing thing is that our host Rob，very kind，full of enthusiastic to life，he has great lifestyle：yoga ，meditation，organic…I all most love him，haha，if we have a friend like Rob，what a lucky thing！wish u also will enjoy here like me.

Kate is such a great person! Very easy to communicate and so helpful.  The apartment is walking distance to many great places. We had enough room for 3 friends and everything was at our disposal.  The building might seem a bit creepy but is actually very quiet, at day and at night, so is the neighborhood.  Good times.

Michelle’s place is great.  Everything you need is provided and more.  Plenty enough space for the 3 of us.  Both the bed and the couch bed were comfortable.  The couch bed is fairly hard but I like that.  The shower was wonderful.  High pressure and hot.  It was clean and they even made up the couch bed for me knowing that I asked about where the blankets and pillows were for it.  That was a nice bonus not to have to make it up myself.  The neighborhood seemed safe.  I had to walk back from the Metro at midnight and did not feel unsafe.  A 10 minute walk.  Plenty of nearby restaurants to walk to.  We had no complaints whatsoever and would gladly stay there again!

Renata‘s apartment saved my week in NYC!  After realizing two days before traveling, that my first reservation with Airbnb was a scam, and having to rebook a second reservation, which canceled on me at the time I was supposed to be checking in…Renata‘s quick and concise communication reassured me that that would not happen with her.  She responded to my messages within seconds of asking if she could accommodate me on short notice. And everything turned out perfectly with her apt. The location, the decor, the amenities offered- all very comfortable and clean.  We did not use the balcony, but it is readily accessible.   Her building is  4 blocks from Trader Joe’s,  and Roosevelt Island tram. As well as only a few blocks from multiple subway stations, and fantastic shopping. Cute restaurants & shops on avenues, pharmacy across the street, and in a very SAFE part of Manhattan.

We were 6 in the group and only booked for an overnight stay. Told the host that we would be arriving around midnight and he was very accommodating and easy to communicate with. We had to circle a couple of times for a street parking.   Apartment was tidy however there was a strong smell upon entering. It stayed all night long and worst in the bathroom. We turned on the vents but it didn’t go away, windows were not an option since it was super cold outside. It stuck to our clothes and stuff also even after leaving. There was no air freshener/spray available in the apt. The free cup of noodles were a life saver!  There were 6 of us and toiletries were only good for 1 person (shampoo, conditioner and bar soap). Not a big fan of bar soap for hygienic purposes. No extra blanket ready for the sofa bed. We didn’t bother to ask for extra anymore since it was already very late and we would be leaving in a couple of  hours.  Overall stay was okay, just the unpleasant smell that wouldn’t go away.

Very sweet hosts! We appreciated the open communication and how close the bus stops were that allowed us to easily catch our next ride, etc. We never felt unsafe, even when we had to run to the convenience store nearby after 10 pm. Thank you for your hospitality, Mr. Muhammad and Mrs. Minu.

We really enjoyed our stay at Mohammad & Minu’s place! They were very communicative and willing to help with any of our needs. The place is as described and photographed. Location is excellent and very safe. On many nights, we arrived late into the night and never felt unsafe in the neighbourhood. We were able to get to any part of NYC from the Jackson Heights Roosevelt station which was just a short bus ride away. Overall, I recommend Mohammad and Minu’s place and would definitely stay again!

NOT SAFE - I stayed here for a month and could not wait until i left!    Area: This place is located in a very dangerous area in Brooklyn. It's literally one avenue away from Brownsville. The citizens app is always notifying me about robberies 600 feet away. Or shots fired 0.2 miles away. The house itself is beautiful and sticks out like a sore thumb in the neighborhood. You are walking distance to many stores but I rarely went out as it is not safe. You end up spending money on takeout and ubers. While the house has a really good security system, I have seen the main door and the door to the apartment left open.    Room: I had requested a room away from the kitchen area and I got the room closest to the kitchen. Make sure you ask first if you care about this stuff. The first room also does not have a window which was hard to breathe. It has a balcony door that we can't leave open otherwise mosquitos will fly in. But that didn't stop the insects from getting in, we had spiders, other insects and mice. (MICE in our room!) I saw the mouse and it saw me. The place looks renovated and beautiful inside however, the common spaces are not cleaned as often as they should for a packed house. The fridge smelled like things were rotten. There are no labels on the fridge indicating a shelf for each room (this would help, so that people dont plop their food on top of others). The airbandb ad mentioned a "sunlit room" I swear I never saw the sun in my room (as there is no window).    While this place may look tempting due to the pictures (which are true) it is a beautiful place but the money is not worth it for the location. It felt awful to not be able to go outside due to the area not being safe. The backyard is lovely but the side walls are very low meaning people can climb through it which made me not feel safe either. The laundry is amazing (free laundry) this was my only favorite thing about this place.

This space just as expected - warm and cozy!  Very spacious and the deck absolutely steals the show here!  What a gem to have such a spacious outside area all to yourself in Williamsburg (with great views of the Williamsburg bridge). Loved spending mornings and evenings on the deck. Perfect location, clean apartment building, and Roman was incredibly communicative and kind!  Would definitely stay again.

Paul had wonderful communication before, during and after my stay.  When he says he is available to you for assistance 24/7 - he really is! He even FaceTimed me to assist with check-in when I was having an operator error.    The styling of the unit is lovely, modern and minimalist.  It has all the essentials to make for a great stay in the heart of Manhattan.  Grocery, bars, restaurants, post office and drug stores are all within a 5 minute walk.  The M15 bus line stops are just 1 block away which makes for convenient travel to LES and UES.    I stayed for 3 days and worked from home on two of them.  You never hear neighbors - if you do, it's only when they are passing thru the hallway.  Although there was some intermittent banging coming through the pipes/vent 1-3 times a day.  It would last a couple minutes and then go away.  I suspect it had something to do with being an older building and the heat system.  I never heard any disturbance at night. There were no hangers in the closet - so you might want to bring a couple of your own. We spent two nights in the Airbnb. Communication worked well: Madelene always responded reliably and quickly. DO NOT STAY HERE  I stayed here for one month, from October 1st, 2022 through November 1st. The stay was EXTREMELY unpleasant, for reasons that I will outline below.  The problems:  — Strong mold smell. 	This is self-explanatory. You walk into the space and you are punched in the face by an extremely strong mildew smell. I was never able to actually spot the mold, but the smell is extremely strong, particularly in the common areas and bathroom.  — Almost no furnishings. 	Your room will be furnished with a desk, one chair, and a bed, but there will be zero (and I mean *zero*) furnishings in the common areas aside from one table, which is shoved into a corner and does not have any chairs (!) Thus, I was forced to either eat in my room at my desk, or to carry my chair out into the common area and eat in a windowless room with a gag-inducing mold stench. 	This also extends somewhat to kitchen equipment. While there are basic pots and pans plus a cutting board and knife, there are, for example, only two forks. I found myself literally knocking on the other guests' doors at one point to ask if they had one of the forks, because I needed one to eat my meal and they were nowhere to be found.  — Host doesn't keep things stocked 	I was forced to purchase, for example, toilet paper and hand soap when they ran out, because they were not replaced by the host.  — Bad commute into the city 	If you're trying to get into Manhattan (or, for that matter, Brooklyn), be ready for a long commute. To get into the East Village, for instance, I had a one hour commute taking the 7 to Grand Central then transferring to the 4/5/6.  	To get into Brooklyn, be ready for an hour-long bus ride or equivalent train ride.  — Very little to do in the area 	If you're looking for any kind of night life, cafes to hang out at, interesting attractions, etc., this is not the area for you. The area is essentially where a lot of workers live who commute into the city early in the morning to work, then come home at night to sleep. Also, it is extremely Spanish-speaking, so if you don't speak Spanish, you will likely feel out of place.  — You're living in an impound lot 	There is a police precinct less than a block away as well as a number of auto shops next door, and the street out front is constantly packed to the gills with busted and impounded cars.  — Street noise 	If your room is at the front of the building, you will get substantial street noise (this was a constant complaint of one of the other guests while I was staying there). If your room is at the back of the building (like mine was), you have a subway track running directly behind the building. This wasn't too problematic when I could keep the windows shut (it didn't wake me up), but if it's nice out and you want the window open, it will be quite loud.   ... And for all that, you're paying quite a lot of money. I was paying almost $1500 for the month.    Here are the few good things I can say about the property: — The host, Shogo, was very responsive to messages sent through AirBnB — The bed was comfortable — The amenities all worked well (stove, fridge, shower, etc.) - There is a convenience store directly downstairs with basic supplies and a very friendly owner   Oh, and there's also cockroaches, albeit small ones and not too many of them.

I had an amazing time staying at Elene’s air bnb. The apartment was in an amazing location in Bushwick. It was only a block away from the subway making it very convenient to get around the city. There are a lot of great restaurants and bodegas within walking distance as well. The area is very pleasant, safe, with low car and foot traffic.   The apartment was clean, and very aesthetically pleasing. Elene has an artistic, eclectic style. It was cute and cozy, I really felt at home there. Our room was located in the basement and was just perfect for our needs. It was a nice, comfortable 68 F in the room during the day, but when night came around and it started to get cold, the heat kicked on and had the room perfectly toasty for us. The king bed was so comfortable, with equally comfortable pillows and bedding. There were additional blankets provided on a rack outside of our room in case we needed them. There was a small bathroom downstairs to use, and a bathroom upstairs to use with a shower. Both bathrooms were very neat and clean. I never had any issues needing to wait for the bathroom. Towels and amenities such as shampoo and body wash were generously provided if needed.   Elene and the other air bnb guests down the hall were very friendly, laid-back and quiet. The only thing that might be worth mentioning is that you could hear the upstairs neighbors playing music when we came back Saturday night around 2 AM, but I personally had no issue with it. I lived in NY for 2 years, it’s the city that never sleeps and city noises are to be expected 24/7 haha! It wasn’t egregiously loud or anything, and since the room is in the basement it wasn’t that bad. If you are a light sleeper, just make sure to bring some earplugs; preferably headphones so you can play some music or nature sounds to offset any background noise going on.   Elene was also so kind as to allow us to keep our suitcases at the Airbnb for a few hours after check-out since our bus back home didn’t leave until 5 hours past check-out. That was a huge help and took a lot of stress off our minds, knowing we didn’t have to lug all of our possessions around for hours.   A small thing that might be worth remembering is that there isn’t a microwave in the kitchen, but a small toaster oven. So if you choose to reheat leftovers, that is what you will have to use. It was really easy and convenient, but we could only heat smaller portions of food in it at one time. There is an oven you could use if you need to heat up more food at once, though!   All in all, I had an amazing stay here and I truly look forward to being able to stay with Elene again when I come back to NYC!
