Upon arriving on our first night of our stay, we found the place to be utterly dirty and unkept. We walked in to the rooms and there were MANY bugs coming from one of the doors that lead to the private backyard. We hadn’t even opened the private backyard door and bugs were already in the room. They were crawling everywhere and even landed on the bedsheets. We notified the owner of the place and their excuse was their cleaner left the backyard door open. Unacceptable, truly. We were able to get bug spray from the kitchen but this should not have been a problem in the first place. Now staying here, dead bugs everywhere on the ground. Along with the floor bugs, two flies were already in the room and kept buzzing throughout the night bothering our sleep.  Let’s talk about the floors and corners. Floors were not cleaned at all. The first night of our stay after working around the rooms for an hour, our socks were already full of dust and colored black on the bottoms. The corners of the rooms have dust everywhere and several spots have cobwebs forming around. Host stated there was a cleaner before checking in however, it seems they didn’t finish their job/do a good one.   Overall, I’d like a partial refund for this unpleasant stay as I was not satisfied with the quality of our Airbnb. The space was not clean, key amenities did not work, and the place was just not as described as it said it was. “Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space” is far from accurate with this Airbnb.

Our stay here was awesome. There are plenty of shops close by, a deli, a drugstore, and other spots. Check in was super easy and the place was really clean. We enjoyed sitting on the stoop and in the little backyard area. Aaron was extremely helpful and made our stay stress-free. Would definitely recommend.

It was very nice! My partner and I stayed in one of the rooms for a week and both the room and the people we shared the apartment with were nice.   The neighborhood is calmed and clean, just the perfect compromise between being near Manhattan and outside the city.  The room is small but is enough. The door is a little bit thin, so if you have noisy flatmates you’ll notice. Also, be sure you don’t lose the key or lock the door with the key inside!  The laundry is also great. A little scary to go back there, but only for the first time!  In general, it was a nice stay! If we come around, we’ll repeat for sure!

First time booking on my own with Airbnb, this was a clean simple stay. Initially I was nervous staying as I realized the space was shared. With that said, I had nothing to worry about the room and shared spaces (bathroom & kitchen)  was very clean and tidy.   My favorite part of the stay may have been the coffee maker to be honest.  The understanding host made this  stay less stressful, I planned to checkout for 5am the next day but had to ask for a later checkout. They approved an 9 am checkout which really helped me out, I'm truly grateful for it. Will return!

Stop searching and just stay here! Michael and Sandy were great hosts. The communication was excellent! The place is just as you see it on the pics! Clean, fully stocked, GREAT LOCATION. Loved being able to walk to different stores, brunch, dinner and Barclays from this home. Drive to Time Square was short. We even drove to Central Park and Harlem to explore.   Parking was not as crazy as I’d anticipated, we didn’t have issues finding somewhere close, if not on the same street. I’m 8 months pregnant and left my body pillow, however, this home had so much extra linen and pillows, I made it work and slept amazingly. They provided a play pen, bath tub and high chair for my 2 y/o, made traveling with a baby less stressful. I’ve already sent this place to people visiting this summer. Highly recommend !!

This spot is fantastic! I loved every second of my stay here. The bed is cozy, the apartment is roomy, and the location in the city is perfect. I will definitely be booking again when I’m back in the city. Don’t sleep on this place because for the price It’s a steal! The host is also super kind and helpful!!

First thing that went wrong is incorrect address we struggled about an hour. This Airbnb is located in a shady neighborhood. It does not feel safe and was very noisy the entire night. The room does not have a temperature control, we got extremely hot in the night and had to open the windows and then it started raining so we had to close the windows again. The curtains of the house kept falling down. The address that shows up in Airbnb is incorrect.

Don’t judge a book by its cover! I must admit when I arrived to the neighborhood, before I checked in the home and before I met the host, I told Airbnb support I felt “unsafe”. (Fyi there was NOTHING unsafe about the location I just was not used to the New York culture YET). But almost shortly there after I looked up from my car and say a woman waving at me. It was my host! I was greeted at the gate by welcoming arms. My host was even nice enough to carry my luggage upstairs:) . The Airbnb was BEAUTIFUL! My top stay so far! Any issues I had were quickly addressed and communication was quick! I would definitely book again! Even though I rented a car I did try the subway and it was convenient to use, not far away! I can’t find a thing to complain about this Airbnb was great!

Well Fabiola came to our rescue after two city apartments let us down in an unsafe apartment on our first night that left next day lots of safety features on Jersey city apt we had. Booked. With a host who was not interested in helping as ha newly furnished apartment in jersey was clearly not newly refurbished nor safe. The owner was a lier and not prepared to refund monies despite exposed wiring, no carbon monoxide and finally    But so FabiolA came to our pur superhero who made our holiday come back from brink and rescued and we stayed in stayed in her Beautiful apartment all you need and apartment spotless .  We  cxxx recommend the apartment and don’t judge the area as people are so w Rlcoming and friendly. Thank you so so much xxxxxxx
unit was filthy, mice poop on shelves and counter, shower was unfinished, roof was collapsing and owner made us feel unsafe once we voiced these concerns

I was going to report this as unsafe but that leaves me with no review to leave for others to see, I had paid for my room week before my plain was late till the next day I got there early as in 7 am feeling Secured that I have a room to go to as soon as I got off the plane that did not work out that way so the man rents out that room that I had already paid for to someone else. So now I’m locked out no we’re to go tried and in pain cause of my crippled arm. Texted & called no answer not till later that afternoon telling me check in is not till 3 and that there’s guest there (like I am that guess cause I paid for both days already) caused me to have to search for another place. Beware of this place and be careful have a safe travel. Keep your location on with family you will never know what will happen.

Not sure WHERE to start.  I was told the keys were in the lockbox, but not WHERE lockbox was, after finding lockbox, it would not open. I waited 25 mins in the cold for the "host" to come unlock the box.    While waiting, several people exited & entered the (old delapidated, sketchy) buildng, openly smoking pot; some talking to themselves.   Once I in, I went to hang my jacket in the closet, opened the closet door  & it was full of clothes, jackets, shoes and childrens toys!  That got me wondering, so I took a look around, there was food in the fridge & freezer, not food for guests, like leftovers, etc. Trash can  half full of trash and cans in the recycling bin. Then it hit me. . . THE HOST LIVES FULL TIME IN THIS RENTAL!!! Which means, he could come back day or night and go in.  NIGHT...when me a solo female traveler could have been sleeping..how creepy is that, not to mention dangerous?  Floor was missing sections, holes in walls, water stained & cracking ceilings, too much to list.

This private room at Ellie's is in a PRIME location and is very spacious considering the NYC standard. I lived in this neighborhood for 6 years prior to renting out her space, so trust me on this! The other nice thing was that the shared bathroom is directly outside of this door and I never had any issues of feeling like I was waiting to use it or even crossing paths with others using it. That being said, it is a shared bathroom after all and was not the most clean, plus ran out of toilet paper. However, this is a GREAT place for the price. A steal. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a no-frills yet comfortable stay in one of the coolest neighborhoods in Brooklyn directly next to the L train for easy access to all of NYC.

Desiree was a great host. She was very accommodating. She checked to make sure i needed anything. It was stress-free and overall a great place to rest. Did i mention it was clean and comfortable. I shouldve asked for another blanket but thats me. The listing was accurate. i always have toiletries with me. Be sure to bring a towel. Dollar store 2 blocks away helped lol.

Some investments are really needed. Desiree was very kind, though the apartment needs to improve certain aspects that are really important to make a pleasant stay. First, replacing the toiled (lavatory) is needed. The children-size toiled makes very uncomfortable for adults to use it. Second, the light in my room was connected using a long cord that make unsafe turning it on. Third, while the heating was working properly in the apartment, the windows were not properly sealed, and therefore I felt cold the two nights that I was there. In summary, Desiree was very kind host, but she needs to make some improvements in the apartment for guests to have a comfortable stay.

The apartment is very far from the city center. This requires very long travel times. The apartment is not very clean and has no air conditioning, which made staying overnight in the summer very uncomfortable.

Loved this stay! Abdo was an excellent host. He responded quickly and made us feel very welcomed. The room was exactly as pictured. The house is conveniently located near the metro and by many great food places. All the rooms have air conditions so you can control the temperature of your room which was a nice touch. My group also drove into the city so having a parking spot available when I arrived took away a lot of stress. Overall, I really enjoyed this stay and would definitely come back.

Me and my friend rent this unit for 3 days 2 nights. This was absolutely BEAUTIFUL. 1/ It’s spotless clean, very neat and beautifully decorated which is a nice touch. There were enough supplies for us for 3 days and more (towels, toilet paper, handsoap…). There are dishes, utensils, cups if you needed. Huge fridge and microwave works great. We specifically love the bathroom, so clean and beautiful! 2/The place is super quiet (you can tell the other tenants are also very respectful, probably thanks to the great host) 3/Clear and very quick communication. They answer my questions almost right away. Give very clear instructions and easy to follow.  4/Price are very reasonable. You can’t bargain with quality!  We really appreciate the stays. After long working stressful day, we can have a nice clean quiet place to rest, that’s all we need. Will definitely stay with them again if we come to NY again.  Fantastic jobs, highly recommend!

Great place to stay, the neighborhood looks a bit sketchy but don’t judge a book by its cover.  It’s a bit of a walk to the nearest train station which is the 7 train. But overall a very pleasant place to stay. And Bobby responds immediately if you have an issue.

Enjoy your stay with Bobby, he is responsive and the accommodation matches the photos.  Big enough and clean enough for a few days in New York City.  The bed is comfortable and my 2 daughters slept well on the sofa bed.  The auxiliary heating is very practical.  On the other hand, the garage right next door is quite noisy until late in the evening. There is a 15-minute walk to line 7 but no worries about insecurity in the neighborhood. Then, about a 10-minute journey to get to Manhattan. On the other hand, remember to take cutlery if you eat there because nothing is provided, no cutlery, no plate, no cup or glasses... Overall, the value for money is exceptional, for less than $120 per night for 4, I agree with 100% Thanks Bobby

Blu excepted my last minute booking during a poorly planned tip to NY.  He turned a stressful situation for me into a much better one with his fast response time and great communication.   The 3 things I was most appreciative of is the unit was clean, no findings of past pets (I am allergic) and there was parking provided.   I would definitely book another stay at Blu’s AirBNB again. Thank you!

The property felt unsafe. The neighbors park the car at your place. There was bugs at few places in the house. There was a full size cockroach on the pillow, my daughter was sleeping on and it was hard and dead as if the pillow cover was put on a dead cockroach. Some small cockroaches can be seen intermittently as well.
Room is connected to another room, so smell and sound from another room leaks in. We also didn’t know carpet is very old and had lots of suspicious stains.

This is (and I'm not exaggerating) the worst Airbnb or property that I've ever experienced. Everything about the property was bad. It was inaccurate, unsafe, and unclean. I truly do not understand how this property received any of the positive reviews that it has. My friends and I trusted those reviews and were burned. This is the first negative review I've ever written, so please take my word for it and don't book this place.  The check-in process: the front door was wide open when we checked in. The front was just wide open. Why? No idea but it was a safety red flag.  The location: literally right next to a major, 4 lane road. Super loud and feels generally unsafe to be out and about at night. Not many people out. Not within walking distance of anything. The building looks rickety and broken down. Oh and there were just giant piles of trash outside the front door area.  The accuracy of the property: the living area and bedrooms did not match the photos posted online. None of the furniture matched the photos; everything was rickety, old, and generally shoddy. The blinds were broken; the walls had patches of unfinished paint. The "essentials" that were promised included 2 bottles of hand soap and 2 half-rolls of toilet paper, that's it.   Cleanliness: the property was absolutely disgusting. It had clearly not been cleaned. The floors were dirty; there was trash scattered throughout the property; there was cutlery with food stains/remnants in drawers; the towels were dirty and stained; there were ants all over the place. And here's the most disgusting part: all of the sheets were stained and covered in human hair. And I don't mean small, tiny stains. I am talking giant stains, some of which was clearly stained from someone throwing up. I wish I could post photos.  Communication: non-existent. The host (Anthony) would respond hours late to everything and only via text. They completely ignored Airbnb messages, claiming that they lost access to their Airbnb account. This was clearly untrue since the initial messages (and some of the subsequent messages) I received from Anthony was via the Airbnb messenger. When I messaged Anthony about the stains on the sheets, the lack of towels, and essentials, he blamed the cleaning crew and said that he would send someone over to fix the situation immediately. 2.5 hours later (in the middle of the night), a woman showed up with one item of crumpled up sheets (for 3 beds) and a pillowcase hugged against her body (not folded, not wrapped). This was unsanitary and just plain gross.  We were forced to go to grocery store to buy towels and basic essentials (toiletries, shampoo, etc.) in the middle of the night. We would have been forced to buy sheets as well but our friends came to the rescue and drove over some clean sheets for us.  And to top it off, one of the nights there was a massive party in the property below us and backyard that lasted from 11pm to 8am. When I say massive I mean 35-40 people (some of them completely naked and clearly on drugs) with a DJ and a bouncer at the door. Anthony did not notify us of this party at all. In fact, when we spoke to the hosts of the party and several attendees, they informed us that they notified Anthony about the party and were told by Anthony that it was no problem. The music was ground-shakingly loud and kept us up until 4-5am. It was the last straw when party guests kept ringing our doorbell and knocking on the door throughout the night/morning. We felt unsafe and ended up leaving the property and crashed at our friends' apartment due to safety concerns.   The worst part of all of this is that when I reached out to Airbnb for support, they did next to nothing to address the concerns I raised. I provided documentation (photos, messages, etc.) and I've had to talk to 6 people just to get some semblance of support. I am on hold with a support person as I write this review.  This property, as it currently stands, should not be allowed on the platform. It gives Airbnb hosts a bad name and enables the exploitation of future guests. If Airbnb won't take any action to remedy this posting, please take my advice and don't book this property. Please don't regret it like I did.

Honestly cannot stress how amazing this apartment is. Yiselle has styled it so beautifully too that it tops any hotel stay. The bathtub is deep and relaxing, the views on both sides of the apartment (manhattan skyline and brooklyn skyline) are beautiful and aren't easy to top. Yiselle also accommodated me and my partner's delayed check in due to our bus arriving later into the city than expected. I have never been so excited to write an Airbnb review as I was to write this one.

Friendly host and quick to answer but we spent 3 very complicated and tiering nights. It was 50 degrees in the room and the air conditioning inside was making a huge racket, it was Impossible to sleep in these conditions.. When we tried to turn on the ceiling fan, il was shaking so much after just a few seconds that we were afraid it would fall on us during the night. No mirrors, only one chair... difficult to feel comfortable there. We found a cockroach in the room. The bathroom was functional but very unsanitary and quite dirty, which did not inspire confidence in us.

You get what you pay for. Its a place to sleep. Getting to sights in the city will take at least 45 minutes. The air in the flat is musty and stale, the bathroom has some mold on the walls and hair from other guests. But for NYC prices, this place is a steal! I would recommend coming here, but be prepared: it wont be fancy.

As a hostess and superhost that I am in Barcelona, ​​I would recommend that you improve the issue of cleanliness. The bathroom is really very dirty, all the time, to the point of being unpleasant.  And enabling a room in the dining room, which represents the hall of the house, makes access very uncomfortable for everyone. The smell at the entrance also has to improve, the bad smell must be removed, so that people enter comfortably.

The apartment matched the info in the listing and the location is great. But check in and the situation was a little sketchy. This wasn't mentioned in any other reviews. It is very clear that this is not supposed to be an airbnb and we felt a little uncomfortable with some of the procedures like check in. After a very long day, the process was not simple-- I won't describe it in detail here, but the key was in a location not at the apartment and although it wasn't hard to find, it was weird and an extra step. This apartment was a better deal than other nearby options but we didn't enjoy feeling like we were doing something wrong every time we went in and out of the building.

Everything has been said in the previous comments. It’s a perfect address for a stay in New York. Manhattan is easily accessible by subway. All comfort is provided in the studio. You can buy Jamaican food in the neighborhood, it’s very good! Damien is very welcoming, we appreciated that he came to pick us up from the airport. The neighborhood is quiet, we don't feel unsafe. Don’t hesitate, choose this address.

Pretty happy with the hotel and location ! Staff was welcoming and helpful !   Only bad surprise was the final invoice once we checked out : they took 200€ deposit when we checked in and then without telling us the invoiced us 183,60€ fees out of nowhere at checkout! I had to ask an invoice to be sure I won’t have extra fees as I saw the deposit on my bank account and that is only when they showed me this final invoice and informed me ! I had to insist to get this invoice  This is tricky cause they say that those fees are for airbnb booking only but in the end the total invoice exceeded the cost of other hotels that were way better …   So careful here, they hide that info and I felt like money was stolen from me just because I booked on airbnb ! So I won’t so it again !!

We had a wonderful stay at Marina's. The area is very lively and untouched, a very authentic Astoria experience and I never felt unsafe. A real sense of community. And tons of great food and drink and coffee places on offer. And supermarkets, fruit and veg grocers etc nearby for all your grocery needs. We stayed in the hottest week of the year, late July, and also had the Astoria pool nearby to cool off.  And the apartment is quiet as it's at the back of the building and high off the street, no problems with street noise etc. The apartment is furnished charmingly, with lots of plants etc.   The subway is a bit of a walk (10 mins or so) but was never a problem, and there are connecting buses you can take.   Lastly, Marina was absolutely fantastic to deal with, always responsive and kind and helpful. Thank you Marina!  I would recommend the apartment wholeheartedly.

The location and view are amazing!   The room itself was a let down. The hallways are dirty and damaged. The room was damp and musty feeling/smelling. The minibars in the rooms have been retired, but a previous guest clearly did not know that because there was rancid food in the warm fridge that had grown WELL outside its original container. Once we opened the fridge, the odor overtook the room and we immediately had to vacate.   We were given another room. It became evident that room reserved for AirBnB was inferior. Overall it was darker, dirtier and smellier. Also, the television was much older and had poor picture quality. The new room was no peach, though. There were Strange black fingerprints around the window, long stains down the curtains, stains throughout the carpet and a very gross and suspicious circular stain in the the center of the cushion of the chair. The hallway had drip stains all along the corridor. Overall, the place is also in desperate need of updating.   We loved the view and location but we would not stay again and the price wasn’t more compatible than other options in good locations.

Another Airbnb Scam, they advertise one price but deep in the description mention extra fees that you pay directly to them during check in. For someone booking quickly, you don’t have time to read every detail. Why don’t they add this into the advertised price? Simple, they want to appear to be a good deal.   About the facility, it’s outdated badly. They outlets in the room are so old that they even have the old school telephone ports. No UBS ports anywhere in the room. You can tell everything is dated and no effort to update has been made. It has good views and the staff was friendly. Overall, it’s seems like a “has been” place.

Compact place in a really cool area. Was a bit scary turning up after midnight (which was ok with Ronald even after only getting in touch after midnight! Thank you!), but by morning it was clear it's quite a nice area.  There's a TV in the room, and towel, toiletries etc were all provided which was useful!  The main flat is shared with some permanent residents, but it was fine!

the place is exactly the one in the photo, the bathroom is small but very clean, you can use the kitchen and you have the basics such as salt, olive oil, sugar and cooking implements.  the room is beautiful, cozy and you can rest very well.  the neighborhood is very quiet and we don't hear any noise from the city or neighbors.  The neighborhood is very cultural and it may not be the safest or cleanest but the time we were there we didn't see anything strange or dangerous, the subway is very close and gave us the possibility to visit all of NYC, there are restaurants near the place.  Semo and the guy who lives in the apartment are very friendly and willing to help you.

All staff were incredibly friendly and helpful.   The bed was comfortable and we loved our view.   The carpets in our room had multiple noticeable stains and to not have a fridge included with a room is absurd yet to charge $35 a day is criminal.

Location is good and view was nice on the 35th floor. Mattress was comfy but the pillows were incredibly lumpy and uneven.  Not sure if this is an American thing but there was no duvet cover, just a plain sheet on either side of the duvet and unattached to it. This meant if I moved much during the night the loose sheets became untangled and moved away from the duvet so I was touching an uncovered duvet that i imagine isnt washed often - rather unpleasant.  I raised this and the pillows with the hotel staff but they didnt do anything.  Several of the lights were also not working.
Great location. The atmosphere was strange, it felt quite snooty despite the hotel being past its best and having to sell rooms on air bnb. The facilities fee is also a total scam.

Lexia's apartment is in the middle of Brooklyn. And not in touristy, hip Williamsburg, but in Crown Hights. It's real and loud, with barbecue on the street and a bit dingy. But one experience and we didn't feel unsafe for a second.  You can get to downtown Manhattan in about 40 minutes by subway. So if you're only in NYC for a few days, the apartment might be a bit far away. But I think it's worth it for a trip of 5 days or more.  You probably won't get a similarly sized, clean and well-equipped apartment in the city for this price.  Lexia's apartment is apparently newly renovated and the bathroom is particularly great.  Everything actually looks like it does in the pictures. The apartment is on a busy street, but since the bedroom is at the back on a small terrace, it is relatively quiet.  By the way, the balcony door is equipped with a fly screen. This is very valuable against mosquitoes given the sometimes high humidity.  It takes about 12 minutes to walk slightly uphill to the subway. There is also a bus and we were usually lucky and were able to take it to the subway station. You can use the bus with the metro card.  Lexia gave us wonderful tips - for example, a bakery that offers really good sourdough bread. And of course great pastries.  When I asked for a second duvet, we got it straight away.  All in all, I can highly recommend this great apartment.

First of all :  I have to give 5/5 stars for this Appartement as you 100% get what was promised ! The apartment looks just like on the photos. And what we most liked : everything ist SUPER clean ! You don’t get that often.  Additionally to that : Lexia was a super host. Took car of all requests , super friendly and fast. Gave tips and was overall very helpful. Clear 10/10 super host !  The apartment downside : to me it did not feel very Cosy or comfortable. I was missing some decoration , plants , pictures , or a tv. The couch itself is only to sit and not to relax and also not very comfortable. So you most of the time stay in bed. Also the mattress was layed through and should be replaced asap with a new one. We really had back pain as we rolled together in the middle every night.  The neighborhood : personally we ( 2 white 30 year old fit couple) did not feel save. The direct neighbors seems to be ok but the way from the train to the apartment was very shady and to us a BIG downer.

Michele’s AirBnb has everything we need! It is conveniently located near the major highway LIE where we can get on exit to get to places. Yet, it is distant enough for a quiet neighborhood and safety. The place is very cozy and lovely decorated. Despite a small space, it is reasonably priced and has everything we need. Situated at a convenient location where parking can be challenging, the Airbnb provides one parking spot in front of the house in the driveway really relieves our stress after a long day traveling outside. Michele is a great host. She is very accommodating and responsive in communication.

Great location, SUPER clean, and has the essentials. The home was great for a quick stay we had for a wedding. There's an iron and ironing board, a nice bathroom, and the beds were really comfy. Located above a bakery that has some great breads, just okay coffee.  Luis is also super communicative when we couldn't figure out the HVAC but it worked from then on.   As per the location, it's right next to the heart of Jackson Heights where there is an overwhelming amount of food options. Never felt unsafe, despite walking around late at night.  Cons: there is loud music playing from downstairs, and the neighbor smokes a lot - you can smell it inside of the apartment so those with asthma/respiratory issues may want to watch out.

We had a wonderful stay at Luis' place in Queens. It was very convenient to take either the 7 or the E/F subway to Manhattan. Luis was very responsive, and we appreciated his initiative to continue to ask if we were enjoying our stay. The bakery downstairs was a great option for a quick breakfast, but don't be afraid to explore local restaurant options. Seek out UFC for Korean fried chicken and beer!  Thanks again Luis!

Myself and my guests’ AirBNB experience was great! The location was nice and spacious and very clean. The host was very accommodating and her communication was superb. We had an emergency and Kerlly was extremely accommodating and made a stressful situation more bearable. I would definitely recommend this location!

The door knob was hanging by a thread almost failing down. The door itself have a massive crack in the middle (looking at the side of the door and this why the lock won't stay in place). The place wasn't very clean and there were previous guests candy wrappers left under the bed. The door handle on one of the cabinets was removed (exposing two ugly looking holes) and we were told that this was done during covid to remove refrigerator (not clear at all how these two are connected). When we asked about small guest size refrigerator we were told that they are available for rent at $35 per day...this is the first in my years of traveling that small fridge is offered at an additional charge.  The paint, the trim on the floors, everything just had it's better days and appeared to be neglected. The TV had very bad reception and when we mentioned it to the hotel administration they said that someone would look into it, it's hard to say if they have as for 5 days us being there the issue wasn't fixed. The toilet flashing is very slow and every time I was afraid that it just wouldn't flash down.  Overall the room we were is in need of some very serious updating, it was not a pleasant stay considering almost $500 per night price.
this location was accessible to subways and transportation, it's also not a dangerous location at all. the room is nice sized for 1 person, bugs were the only things I had to watch out for.

The host is easy to communicate with and very easy going. It’s just you and her during your stay and the rooms are on opposite ends of apartment. I was there for 10 days. Would recommend for maybe a 1-2 night stay.   PROS •the host is very nice and personable. •elevator in bldg if you have luggage •tp & wipes in bathroom. Place to hang towel.  •the place is very neat and you also get a little living room area attached to your room to yourself.  •full length mirror •1 block from a bus that takes you to broadway junction/ 5 min walk to J. •Scented candles in bathroom, bedroom, living room •light dimmer •little tub of toiletries if you don’t have your own ACQUIRED TASTES  •Can’t bathe without shower curtain touching your body. •Unflushed urine always, unflushed turd once.  CONS •There’s a lock on room door, but was told there’s no key.  •TV didn’t work. WiFi not so great for playing music/browsing internet on phone only at night and in the am •bedroom window right above building entrance. Non-stop noise right outside window.  •building feels very unsafe (I was followed into building by men without keys majority of stay because they had no key. This happened every time I came in at night.  •inconsistent hot water and heat in apt. At least 4 nights I was cold.  •no place for clothes. Had to hang jacket on nail sticking out next to window sill. The cabinet  I thought was for my things actually had stuff already in it. I had to move everything down to the bottom and clean out the dust just to place my folded clothes on something.  •most uncomfortable mattress/bed ever. Can actually feel rods of bed frame when laying down. Not one good night’s sleep. •keeps full garbage in kitchen for days, recyclables actually had an odor for days before being removed.  •sink is always full of dirty dishes so not suitable for kitchen use.

This was an amazing experience.  We were blessed to have such a spacious and family friendly bnb to stay in.  Great for short or long stays. Individuals and small groups of five can also enjoy. Street parking was actually easily available every night of our stay. The best sleep I've had in a while due to the luxury mattresses and garden level peacefulness.  The garden space was really special and a delight to be outside in the sun or shade. The amenities provided are rare for Brooklyn. I suggest you select this one before it gets booked up.  Samara is a proficient and helpful host.

Worth the read:   Overall, the host seemed helpful and nice (idk if it makes a difference between having a picture say superhost and not having the super host badge), but the location is great. Phenomenal food all throughout the strip!   What I didn't like was the shady feeling of it not being described as a shared apartment with other guests or himself upon booking, only until after I paid/another person made the same comment weeks after. I can only assume the other listings are similar. "Max guest" means only to one room, not the entire place, so just a heads up there. It just would've been nice to know beforehand. I would be lying if that didn't dampen my vacation a little, thinking it would just be me and my husband in the space. Instead, we were shockingly surprised to see other people when walking in. Luckily, others there were super nice, and we all stayed to ourselves. Again, great location, I'm originally from New York so it's nice to see Astoria and its restaurants improving.

The place was neat and had everything we needed for a week long stay. Very affordable too. Location wise, it was a 12 min walk to the nearest subway and 5-8 min walk to the bust stop although the area seemed pretty sketchy at night. We took a lyft or uber during late hours just to be safe. Overall, would highly recommend this place. Thank you for hosting us!

A great place to stay while in the City. Never once felt unsafe in the neighborhood, enjoyed the views from the windows and the beautiful interior of the 1923 build, and was pleased with the subway entrance being just steps away! Thanks for making this wonderful place available!!!

Place was as advertised.  Clean, and cozy.  Very safe and Secure.  As a native New Yorker i knew the neighborhood wasn't the greatest but i never once felt unsafe staying at Eugenia's place.  She even let us check in early and leave a tad after checkout.  Great communicators and their cats were adorable.

This place is FAR from the city!! It was very scary since it’s located in a basement and felt a bit like a horror film getting inside. We couldn’t sleep since the room was FREEZING!!! Bathroom is shared and very messy. Common area kitchen is nice. Know that this is a shared apartment and it is very small!! William is a nice man and communicates well!
The place is cozy but unfortunately the location makes it really Scary to visit at Night!
This is a scam Beware !

The apartment was very clean, well-decorated and we loved the gummy bears and waters Mary Ann left for us in the fridge. Unfortunately, the area that it is located in is very dangerous with frequent fights breaking out, an interesting crowd and loud noises on the stoop of the apartment. Additionally, we heard several gunshots and would not recommend this area for young women or people with small children. Overall, this is a well priced option for people that are in new york for a couple of days but the safety of the area was a big concern for us.

The apartment was just as described and was clean.The hosts were very kind, accommodating and quiet. I almost didn't even know they were there while I was there. The apartment is a gated community with a nice shady court yard.

Staying in Mathews's place is like you would live in NYC. Good spot to travel out, the room was small but clean. Subway approx. 7 min by walk. Just at the night time, a little bit dangerous. But that is NYC!

If you want a good place to stay at a good price, clean and pleasant, this is your option.  We never felt unsafe in the area, there is food nearby until late at night, there are two train stations very close.  The apartment offers everything it says and is very comfortable to sleep.  The host is very friendly and always attentive to what we needed.  Great experience!

This is definitely the place to be in New York. We felt during this 5 days like being home.  When I arrived at the airport I WhatsApp ligel to know how to get to his flat and he directly expalained me everything. He was there waiting for me when I arrived at the apartment.  The place is really clean (ex marine haha). And really modern. Ligel provided us everything : towels, soap... And we were able to use his kitchen where you can get everything (coffee machine, toaster, friepan, pot...) He even provided us breakfast with cereales, milk and eggs.  The flat is very well located. The train( line 4), brings you directly to Manhattan at all times. And the flat is located 5 minutes walking from the stop 176th steet. The place is in a really safe area, more than once we went home after midnight and didn't feel unsafe at all. Ligel is an artist and has his studio in his flat, where he showed his works to us. That was really interesting to see first hand.  On the day of the check out, our plane was in late evening. So he kept the luggages for us during the day. HIGLY RECOMMANDABLE

Would not recommend to someone trying to enjoy their trip to new york. There was a last minute time change to when we could drop off our luggage even though she told us at the beginning we could drop off at 7am. The night before our trip we were then told we could not drop off till 9am, but our bus trip was already planned and paid for. Our plans for the day were all ruined because we had to sit at some random bus station for almost 2 hours. The commute was a MUCH longer metro, bus and walk than stated. Not to mention the fact that she wanted to waste our time to search our bags for no reason at all. The area seems very unsafe and hostile towards tourists (we got many looks, called names, etc). It says lockbox stay but there was no lockbox. The area was so bad we had to change airbnb stay to about hour away of what we planned. Fortunately airbnb customer support assisted us asap and we were in a safe place. Although we were accommodated to a better place it still took an entire day away from our trip. 0/10 would not recommend

I can’t stress enough how comfortable my stay was. Check in was a breeze. My flight arrived early in NYC and I was still able to be accommodated at Ligel’s place. Upon arriving, the first thing I noticed was cleanliness of the unit. The nights was very comfortable and you definitely feel right at home. Transit was very convenient with the 4 train just a few blocks away. I was able to easily get snacks and little things I might need for my stay with the many stores all in walking distance. There is not a washer and dryer on site, but conveniently there is a laundromat right around the corner. Just a 3 min walk. Ligel is very polite and I would say an amazing host. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable stay in New York City.

Ligel is very kind and attentive, always answering our messages and questions and also received us without problems when we arrived after midnight. The room is clean and spacious and the floor is always very clean. We were very comfortable because although we spent more time outside than inside, he was always there to assist us.  As for the neighborhood, if you come from outside, you might think that it could be dangerous, but that's not the case at all, we arrived quite late one night and we didn't have any problems, people go about their lives without bothering anyone and it is VERY well connected since the subway is less than 5 minutes away and is the line that takes you to the most touristic spots in NY.  Definitely if we return to NY we would stay with Nigel again

My stay was a NIGHTMARE. I reserved the unit for two nights for business. The first night there, I messaged the host about the tvs not working and no response at all. And the internet kept losing signal. If you go on a business trip you won’t be able to use the internet.  My second night there, the tenants in the attached unit was fighting and arguing  for hours in one of her units. The fight got so bad that it escalated to the yard. Then one of the men pushed the other man into the window of the bedroom that I was staying in which is attached to the yard. I was so scared, I wasn’t sure if they were going to break the window or if the fighting was going to escalate further. There isn’t a peep hole for to see if the hallway is clear for safety and the hallway is dark. I messaged the host for hours and she didn’t respond back for hours. When finally she did, She tried to blame it on the neighbors. And also stated that maybe it’s just some teenagers having fun.  Which was not true, her neighbors would have to climb the gate to gain access to her yard and the men were grown and from her premises. I messaged her back and told her that the hollaring, cussing, arguing and fighting started from within her premises. No response at All. The unit is in the rear and has two apartments right next to unit that is rented to men. I’ve never been so scared in my life. The arguing, cussing and hollaring continued all night. Traveling on business alone and being in a unit that this type of behavior is acceptable to the host was very scary. She never called back to see if I was okay or offered no assistance. She showed no concern which leaves me to believe that this type of behavior is acceptable and happens often. I contacted Airbnb for assistance because I received none from the Host. This place is VERYYYY UNSAFE and not QUIET. Jacqueline is far from a Superhost.

Overall this place is a steal. A quiet area of the Bronx that was enjoyable. Waking up to the white sheets were nice and no traffic noise was perfect. Everything was perfect about my stay here except the power went out twice on my six day stay and I was unable to charge my phone or use the restroom for 12 hours on the first day and 16 hours on the second day. If you've reached the bottom of this review then I'll also mention that I saw a baby mouse in there lobby. Everything else was great though. Great host! wont refun you though if problems arise.

Our stay in New York was great. Ligel is very welcoming and friendly. The explanations for arrival were very clear, which allowed us to arrive peacefully. The room is spacious and pleasant. We spent 8 days with Ligel who was very discreet in the morning and evening. The kitchen is functional and accessible at all times. The apartment is located close to subway line 4 which crosses all of Manhattan, allow an average journey time of 35/40 minutes. In terms of security, don't trust the reputation of the Bronx, we never came home late but at no time did we feel unsafe, on the contrary the people in the metro and in the neighborhood are friendly. The bonus: a grocery store on the corner with everything you need!  Thank you Ligel for this great stay! 😁

I stayed here for over a week and had a great time and got all my shopping done due to the apartments location and amenities (including maid service). I would definitely stay there again. This fully equipped one bedroom apartment has a great location just off Park Avenue very near for example to Central Park, the Museum of Modern Art,  St. Patrick’s Cathedral, the Central Synagogue, Bloomingdales, Rockefeller Center, Carnegie Hall, Roosevelt Island Tramway and the large number of corporate offices, shopping and restaurants of Midtown Manhattan. There are crosstown buses on 57th street and the Lexington Subway stop that takes you downtown is only a few blocks away. Also nearby are convenient food shopping (including Whole Foods), drug stores and “reasonably priced” restaurants on Lexington, 3rd, and 2nd Aves. There is a fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher, stove and refrigerator,  and a full bath in the bathroom. Internet provided by the building is fine. The bed big enough for two adults was extremely comfortable. The unit owner was quickly responsive to any inquiry and the building management very friendly and helpful. The apartment has windows on two sides but not much of a view as it is near the ground and in the back of the building but that does keep it quiet. I really enjoyed my stay. Thank you.

It’s my first time to be New York, this room is clean and it has really reasonable price, host is also friendly. But the neighborhood( community) is awful, lots of homeless and looks like a slum neighborhood(google Brooklyn safety map, you know what I’m talking about) . I talked with the people in the restaurant here, he told me don’t show up at night, robbery happens. Besides, the room is frozen even though Aminul said he has opened the heater. So for people who are the first time be NYC, I don’t recommend this place, go live in Manhattan. But if you think you don’t care this issue, this place can help you save lots money and offer you a good experience.

my room #7 overlooked a cemetery. i did not expect this and it was kinda creepy. something to expect in room #7. overall it was a good place to stay for the price. if there are people staying with you on the floor, maybe there should be a bigger sign that someones is in the bathroom that way hopefully they would read it and wait. i recommend to all.

Pros: This place was great. It was clean, cozy, and at-home feeling. The neighborhood is safe and quiet. The cons: the shade was broken and I had to use an object to hold it down, the bed was very squeaky, there was no way to regulate heat, and the other occupants were a bit noisy However, it was a great price point. The kitchen and bathroom were cleaned daily.

First off- the place was super clean, smelled amazing! Also it’s in a super safe building/area. I walked day and night and never felt unsafe. The location is prime, you can walk to Times Square and other great NY attractions! Now here comes the crazy experience- I unfortunately misplaced my wallet the second night there. With it- Gia’s keys, my phone, credit cards and ID. I texted Gia at 2am and at 2am from all the way in Florida she responded. She was the most understanding, supporting and helpful person. Due to me not having an ID I was unable to fly back when I was supposed to and Gia amazingly offered me to stay with her another night. I am so glad I got to meet her in person because she’s one of the best human beings I’ve known. I am so happy to say that in this trip I gained a friend! I truly don’t know what I would’ve done in this situation without her.  Do not hesitate to stay at Gia’s if you’re in NY. Not only the place is amazing, clean, great location, safe and super close to the subway but also the host will communicate with you and help with whatever’s needed at any time. I can’t thank Gia enough for everything she did for me during that panicking time! I will be back to truly enjoy NY soon and will be staying here again! Tip- don’t bring all your IDs out when you travel!
Was better than I expected, the place was super nice and had all the amenities we needed, very clean and comfortable living space. It was in a good area too never felt unsafe at any times.

We arrived to JFK and were picked up by an Uber driver who immediately began telling me and my travel companion how dangerous the area we were staying in was, how we shouldn’t be staying there and that he didn’t even feel comfortable driving to the Bronx to drop us off. Immediately we were terrified of what we had gotten ourselves into, and arriving to the accomodation was the most pleasant surprise. Multiple door locks and a nice homely feel had us at ease. We had no issues walking the 10 minutes from the Subway station, or 5 minutes to the bus stop as described in the listing, often times after dark. Our room was tidy, very spacious and we were able to make ourselves at home for the stay. The common area was tidy, bathroom kept clean and had fresh towels for use of guests. Sound travels through the walls, windows and doors which we learnt quickly with the roadworks outside and when other guests partied outside our door. The roadworks didn’t start painfully early and was a good incentive to get out of bed and start the day. Overall a good stay! Hosts were easy to contact and responsive.

Overall, it was great staying there. The host was very responsive and no stress at all for checking in. Location was very convenient to commute with either 6 line or Q line. Whole Foods and the other groceries are located within a few blocks. Many dining options around the accommodation. High speed Wi-Fi allowed me to have video conferences without any stress.   Although it was great for me, there are some thoughts. One, noise from the street. It is located 2nd floor and noise from the street comes in without much surprise. It is NYC. Two, oil heating system. Although I believe I don’t have to explain about it too much, it might not be easy to manage room temperature as you feel good.  Any options have pros and cons. For my case, it was good decision.

Sam's place is beautiful! Every single touch makes it feel like a home. A perfect place to stay and hang out for a long vacation. I stayed with a group of 6 other girls and we loved every second of our stay. It is sparkling clean, smells great (there are scented plug ins in every room of the house); the kitchen is full of cute gadgets for the coffee and tea drinkers and even a bottle of wine welcomed our stay. There is a washer and dryer in the unit and iron with ironing board. We all felt like they really put their thought and effort into hosting their guests and we found Sam's place to be the perfect cozy place to spend our girls weekend getaway ❤️ The only thing I would say, is that the neighborhood does not look or feel like the safest of them all and it is a 15 min walk to the closest subway - so if you are traveling in a group of just girls have this in mind. However, nothing happened to us and we did not notice any suspicious activity 😂. The neighborhood, however, might keep you on your toes haha!!  With that said, I highly recommend Sam's place for any prolonged and comfy stay. Safe travels!!

I suspect people who have complained that the apartment is dirty haven’t spent much time in old buildings ;) This studio might not be for everybody, but it definitely has character. It’s about what one might expect from a NYC motel. In fact, it seems to be a converted motel, which is part of the charm. The place was clean, the bed was comfortable. It’s a little loud and bright, but I always travel with a face mask and ear plugs. Checking in was a bit of a challenge, but that made it an adventure more than anything. Importantly, the location is wonderful. I was right next to the theater where I had tickets and only a couple of blocks from the subway. I recommend this listing for younger travelers who want to get off the beaten path.

This is perfect for one person! There is no free parking however, you have to download an app and then drive around the city trying to find free parking according to what the app is telling you. I did this and still got a parking ticket so just be extra cautious. Also this is sort of a tenant housing situation where the room is amazing you literally can see Times Square and it’s really cute, but you have to leave the room and go down the hall to use a bathroom and shower that is shared among people in the hall, so that to me is a little sketchy during Covid times. Otherwise this place is super charming and I was really communicative and it has everything you need to lay your head down And wash up between exploring the city!

Everything about our stay at Lauren's home was easy and low-stress — exactly what we were looking for on our getaway weekend! The bungalow is clean, comfortable and well-appointed, with a lovely backyard. The neighborhood is quiet and super easy to get to beaches and great spots to eat. Really enjoyed our stay!

We love staying at Yoselyn's!  So many nice features, but especially the quiet neighborhood, having dedicated parking, and the proximity to the NYC Ferry at Soundview. Lots of space in the upstairs apartment too!! Yoselyn is very responsive, and accommodating. I almost am afraid to say so many nice things for fear it will be booked when we want to return, but out of fairness to Yoselyn, she has invested in much to make the apartment comfortable.

What they offer you is what you can find, a fairly comfortable, clean room, for 2 people with a television and outside there is a kitchen equipped to make a meal and save you a lot if you plan to visit, if you take the metro 2 Uptown Red line it leaves you at station 233 and the house is approximately 1 and a half blocks away, we were 2 girls and the truth is that in terms of that everything was excellent because we arrived late 11:30pm-12:00am and although this lone one was close to us and we do not feel afraid in the area. (From Manhattan it is about 1 hour by subway) but it was worth it, you just have to get up a little earlier than usual and the day pays off. Cookie was quite attentive to the heather and hair dryer requests and all in all it was a fairly comfortable stay. Currently, due to the schedule changes for the holidays, Metro 2 did not work the same after 8pm so do your research on how to return and take that into account (a man did not tell you that when he saw us confused by not knowing which meters to take) hahaha so it's just a tip, thanks Ronald and Cookie, excellent stay. 😁😁😁

We had an amazing stay! The flat is super clean, and the cleaning lady comes in regularly. The common areas were always super clean. You can get fresh towels and sheets with just a quick message to Ronald, and as a matter of fact he provided those before I even got to ask! :D The street is quiet aside from the train track that goes through the neighborhood. People in the area are very nice, and not once did I feel unsafe or anything. You have restaurants, convenience stores and other shops all around you. Finding a parking spot can sometimes take a bit of time, but we always found one on the same street. All the other people staying there were very nice and clean as well, so my initial preconceptions about a shared space were totally unfounded. The room was nice and the bed comfortable. We will definitely stay there again if we are in need of accommodation in the future. I definitely recommend, a great find at a good price/quality standpoint. Hope you have a great year ahead Ronald and Cookie!

Ronald and Cookie were quick at responding at our messages. We appreciated the fact that they cleaned the place everyday.  The location is very close to the subway station but it's a little bit scary to walk at night. If you're traveling especially alone I would consider staying in a more popular area.  It's a quiet neighborhood but you can hear the subway all the time and we were also bothered by some loud noises coming from the pipes. Even though Cookie explained to us that is a temporary issue we heard the noise through out the entire staying.  Overall we didn't pay that much for our staying and the final conclusion is you get what you pay.  Thank you for hosting us!
Good value but although he’s on a nice block, it’s in the middle of a relatively sketchy area. Everything else was great, just don’t walk to the subway after dark

The apartment is really cute and was very clean. Ty was a very hospitable host and answered all questions very promptly. The apartment was just as described, however, the location of this apartment is not very tourist-friendly I would say. I felt unsafe walking around the area at night.

My stay at Ty's was stress-free. He was there to greet me and carry my luggage up the steps to his place on 3rd fl. after I did some sight-seeing in Manhattan and got there at 8:00 p.m.  You can take the C subway train from Manhattan-Penn Station or Times Square and it's a straight shot to the Ralph Ave stop that's only a few blocks away from Ty's place. The next day I walked around the neighborhood quite a bit with no issues, however I only stayed out until 8:00 p.m.  There is a Natural Valley Market close by where I bought a freshly-made breakfast sandwich and coffee. Both were good and the workers there were friendly. The bedroom was tidy and clean, and the bed was very comfortable. The bathroom and its shower was very clean. The hot water worked fine. The kitchen was clean too. I used the fridge to store some leftovers and the oven to heat them up with no problems. At night it was quiet. I stayed at Ty's mainly to see a show that was in Bushwick. Thanks for a stress-free stay, Ty.

The apartment looks exactly like the photos. Very “NY style”. Cozy. You have plenty of space and everything you need. We felt very comfortable. The subway is easy to reach. The street the house is on is very beautiful - like something out of a NY movie.  But once you leave that street, the area is so semi-great. I was there with my 18 year old daughter and she was afraid to walk home from the subway in the evening. That's why we took an Uber 2-3 times, but it was very expensive. Our idea was that we would no longer always drive to Manhattan in the evening, but could instead go out for a chic and stylish meal in the neighborhood. But that wasn't the case. You always have to drive for chick. We were there in December, so it was dark early and there wasn't much going on on the street. I would imagine it's much better in the summer. Shelley was awesome! Very quick, nice, accommodating. A duvet was missing on the day of arrival, but it was brought very quickly.

Room is simple, with comfortable double bed, has TV, Netflix and a small closet to store clothes, overall a pleasant room.  Regarding the bathroom, it is shared with the other guests. It is simple and has very pleasant water, but there is no ventilation window.  Regarding distance, it is a little far from the city's main tourist attractions, it takes approximately an hour on average by subway and approximately an hour and a half to JFK airport. Regarding safety, during my stay, I didn't think it was dangerous, some days I arrived late, but it was calm. Nearby, there are several shops and small markets that can help you.  In short, a simple place, but clean and comfortable, but when I made the reservation I thought it would be a private bathroom and it wasn't, it's very far from the tourist attractions, but the metro is very close to the house, approximately 3 minutes on foot.

I chose to stay in this bnb because I saw many good reviews about this property. However, the host’s attitude when handling my situation does not match with the satisfactions of other people have on this place.       On one of the nights, I heard someone kept knocking the window of the room that I stayed and humming some kind of music. I was really worried and scared because I did not know what person would do next. I texted the host to see if there’s anything he could do since I concern about my personal safety. However, the host called me and said that I was accusing someone just because of hearing some noises. He kept bragging how many positive reviews he received from the people and how safe the community is. I do agree that positive reviews will tell us information about the property but situations also do happen. He even accused me for having anxiety when I was panicking.      I really appreciate his father in law coming over to check on everything but the host’s attitude is total unacceptable.   ******When I told him that I need to call 911 or people to help, he threatened me that he would leave a bad review on my Airbnb account that “she’s nice but hosts shouldn’t let her stay because she’s delusional…” I was so scared and couldn’t sleep even though I was hiding under the blanket and holding a pepper spray.       I decided to checkout the next day and file an official complaint with Airbnb.      Thanks to the Airbnb safety team, I was able to get out of there safely. I am grateful for Airbnb that keeps me safe.

Ronald and Cookie are absolutely lovely! The room is located within a basement apartment that's seperate from the main house, along with it's own secure entrance, so you'll have a lot of privacy. There's a kitchen and a bathroom aswell, which Cookie keeps super clean. We had no issues checking in and out, and the location is great! The 2 train is less than a five minute walk from the house, and can take you down to Manhattan in an hour, Brooklyn in an hour and half. There's a lot of really good carribean/jerk restaurants right around the corner aswell, and Yonkers is only a 15 minute walk away. There's also a really nice park located 10 minutes away, overall, I highly recommend their rentals! The price, location, and service really make it a steal
I had to book again. Its so welcoming, also close by to shopping areas busses. And once again the host to this airbnb are amazing cant stress that enough

I was nervous about my 18 year old daughter staying in her first AirBnb on her by own but Arnol and Ruben made it so easy and stress free, especially when her flight was delayed until late on a Friday night. They kept in touch with me throughout the night and confirmed when she arrived.   Her review: Arnol and Ruben are great hosts that make you feel so welcome as soon as you arrive! The environment feels like you have your own home in the Bronx and it was such a pleasure getting to know the amazing hosts. My stay here overall an amazing experience and I can’t recommend it enough!

I am very sad to write this review because I have NEVER written a negative Airbnb review, and we have stayed in so many all over the country. My 11yo son and I were driving from LA to NY, in a 7 day span, stopping in our home town of Chicago for a couple nights in between. After a very long week, we were so excited to get there and relax, and I chose this place strictly based on the reviews and how clean and equipped everyone said it was. We had to be in NY for a week (for filming, my son is an actor) so I wanted a clean, functional space for us outside of the city. I had texted Arkady the night before letting him know that we would be arriving around noon and that if the place was ready before 3pm (our listed check-in time on reservation) to text us because it was raining pretty bad and we had nowhere else to go. He said early would not work due to the previous tenants and that it needed to be cleaned. I expected that, no big deal. At 2:30pm, I received a text saying, “should be ready by 4pm.” I responded letting him know that our reservation said 3pm, but that I would rather have a fully cleaned house, If that is why it was taking longer. I found out that students had been living there for at least the last 6 months, and that there were supposed to be 2 tenants, but that he thought there were 4…AND they had just moved out at around noon that same day! In my head, thats a 1-2 day cleaning project but we decided to wait the extra hour, even though we were exhausted and desperately wanting to have moved in at the time promised. At 4pm we were able to move in and I was APPALLED. I had to spend the next 2 hours cleaning! Many surfaces had not been wiped down; crumbs on the counters, ants all over the kitchen, all tabletops and desktops were very dirty, fridge/freezer had not been touched and there was all kinds of food left in them and very dirty shelves! The microwave had sauce splatters and food all over it - SO GROSS. I asked beforehand if I needed to bring any cookware, and he said no, they had everything. There were barely any pots/pans and the ones that were there were so scraped up and peeling they were not useable. The shower curtain was full of mold and all torn. Once I finally cleaned everything, I texted Arkady and he told me he would bring a new set of pots and a new shower curtain. I was impressed with his response but it didn’t take away from the fact that we had to wait and then still come into a house this dirty, spending my time and using my cleaning products to create a clean space for us. While I was waiting for the items, I took a shower and went downstairs to find a puddle of water on the floor by the downstairs bathroom/dining area and a leaking ceiling. At 7pm, when I just wanted to be relaxing with my son, Arkady came in and out multiple times to try and fix issue, which apparently was not a new issue. He did bring over the cookware set and shower curtain. However, I still had to wash the new set and tear down the moldy shower curtain and put up the new one myself – I felt like all I was doing was working. It was a horrible move-in experience!!! Day 2: I ran the shower to make sure the problem was fixed. I came downstairs to find the ceiling leaking again. This time it had also started leaking in another area and I didn’t notice until I heard my son hit the ground! He slipped on a huge puddle that had formed and fell pretty hard - other than being scared and having a bruised elbow, he was ok but I was furious. Arkady said he would call a plumber but that last time they told him they might have to tear open the ceiling. Not sure why it wasn’t fixed then. It was overall a very stressful experience when we originally booked this place to be outside the city for a nice, relaxing week. We opted out of a plumber and decided not to use the main bathroom/shower, which sucked but it was better than having more people in and out all week working on a place we wanted to relax in.  All this being said….Arkady himself is a very nice man and remedied what he could. The place should have been taken off for a few days to turn it over properly and fix all of its issues! Important to note, this is Arkady’s friends house who lives OUT of the country, so he just helps maintain it. The house itself is very nice IF it can be cleaned properly and maintained better! It does look like the pictures and has great views. Without all of these horrible circumstances, I think we would have really loved staying here. I was told I would get reimbursed for this horrible overall experience but have yet to see any funds in my account. Disappointing.

I was hesitant at first simply because the price was much cheaper than alternative properties,  dark pictures and flat seemed too good to be true at the price!  However, I was wrong ha!   Real pleasure being able to stay here for half my stay in NYC, Manhattan.   Great access to the tube, around 5 minutes walk away from I believe 125/4 st subway.  Kitchen has pretty much everything you could want, blender, pots, decent size fridge, felt like I was in my own place!  Washing machine, clothes washer and drier..  TV is great: really good quality and excellent soundbar. Gym access  Many more pros and not a single con.   Yes, if your coming home, you'll stumble across some homeless people on streets, but their harmless and same for anywhere on the island.   Guillermo the host was a really nice chap also when briefly met and interesting to have a quick chat.   100% this will be my 1st point of call if I stay in Manhattan again, cant bet it for value and quality.   A +++

Just two blocks to 3 train, five blocks to L train and four blocks to C train, what it's really nice. There are supermarkets, delis and laundries really close to the apartment. There are two things that were not clear to me before booking, that are important to note: it's an apartment that you share with other hosts: there are 5 bedroom in this floor, two bathrooms and 1 kitchen. And it's located in Brownsville, in Brooklyn. It's not a gentrified borough as other places in Brooklyn. I didn't feel unsafe around there, though.

You can cook there if you like or leave food on the fridge. Although you share the apartment with other people everyone is nice and quite private. I’d highly recommend staying at Aminul’s place.

Location was perfect for me & my friend! I didn’t want to stress about getting from the airport to a far Airbnb and this was perfect! Traveling too and from the city wasn’t even bad too once you get the hang of transportation. Totally recommend this spot if you’re considering it :)
Great place to stay when you have a layover at JFK. Super easy check in, private space, low stress. Loved being able to catch up on sleep before my next flight.

This is a cute studio that can comfortably house three girls. We commutes into the city everyday and slept quietly and soundly through the night. Great location close to transit and a cute cafe called Goulda is just a few blocks away. The first night we were scared because our room was wide open but that’s how they do it when you arrive past 12am.  We had the top floor with a great view of the street and surrounding neighborhood / rooftops. Highly recommend for a group of three. We didn’t get too cold or hot and there was a space heater in the hallway if it got too cold for us. James & Laureta were very cool. We hope them the very best!

Amazing accommodations! Close proximity to major highways and airports. Beach is practically in the backyard! A simple cross of the roadway and you’re right at the entrance of the beach walk and parks. Plenty of delis and nearby restaurants. Host was kind enough to provide all needs for breakfast, lunch, and toiletries. This made my trip that much more enjoyable as I did not have to run to the store for my stay! If you’re looking for fine dining, a short 5 minute drive to Atlantic Beach over the drawbridge is highly recommended!  Top two fave restaurants/ eateries- Beginnings (Gastropub in Atlantic Beach) and Yumze Foods (breakfast, lunch, dinner with quick eats that are FRESH and delicious. Delivers through DoorDash directly to the house.)  Also, the apartment was IMPECCABLY clean! I can’t stress this enough. It’s my most important thing when traveling nowadays and this rental didn’t even have a spec of dust.  We plan to stay again in the future.
The location is perfect and the host was very responsive. A great place for a small family to stay without the stress of city traffic.

I enjoyed my stay stay in this spacious apartment. It was very close to public transport and was only about a 2-3 minute walk to a subway station. I never felt unsafe walking even pretty late a night. I feel like i got a great value out of this place and would definitely stay here again!

Nice, private, clean, great water pressure (lol) even easy to park for free. Stress and hassle free. It was definitely good for a 2 night stay but we wouldn’t have been able to stay more than that. The sofa bed is acceptable, not the most comfortable and there is no AC which they are upfront about but it got verrrry hot when we stayed which was the end of august. They provided fans which made it bearable. Regardless, it was a comfortable stay for the most part :)

James and Laureta’s place was even brighter and more spacious than in the photos! Perfect spot for two people, and it is conveniently located to go into Manhattan. The neighbourhood can feel a bit sketchy at night for those walking by themselves, but we had no issues during our stay. The hosts were responsive and friendly, would definitely recommend a stay here!

Had a really nice time staying at this studio. It's a cozy place to come back to after a busy day in the city - it's sunny, warm, and pretty well connected. It's not the fanciest of places, but it's a really good value for money and I would definitely recommend it!   The neighborhood felt generally safe too, but we did have a couple of encounters at Nostrand av. that felt a little bit stressful. Luckily there are a few other stations around, which felt safe!   Long story short - book this!

Dayne's place was very nice, clean and spacious. Our family had a great time. The apartment is close to the subway. Parking is sketchy, however there are parking garages a few blocks away (in walking distance) and they are reasonably priced.  The neighborhood was quiet, clean and we felt safe. There are many choices for dining, groceries or just a nice cup of coffee. We enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend this apartment.

Fiona and Deran are just the best hosts. Everything about my stay was immaculate. Let me explain in bulleted points:  - I checked in after sunset and Fiona came outside to greet me at my car. There was no street parking so I handed her all 5 of my bags and she took them inside for me. I really appreciated that, given how stressful double parking is for a newbie to NYC driving! - After I settled in on the first night, Fiona and Deran stayed up with me and we had a great chat, which I also really appreciated and enjoyed. - They cleared a whole fridge shelf for me and also made space in one of their kitchen cabinets for me since I stayed longer than a few days! - I love that their home is pet-friendly! My dog Zoe loved them both. Butters is the cutest dog with a huge personality and I had a blast getting to know him. I also really appreciated knowing that Zoe was safe at home while I went out and viewed apartments. - They made AWESOME breakfasts on the weekends. - Prospect Park is literally 30 seconds from their home. The Q train is barely a minute from their door to the subway platform. Amazing!!! - The room I stayed in was absolutely immaculate and featured incredible interior design. Their entire apartment featured incredible interior design. I literally took inspiration notes to use while decorating the apartment I moved into. It was so clear how much time, effort, and planning Fiona and Deran put into the place. They even sat down with me on my last night and gave me an entire list of tips and tricks on how to spruce up my future apartment, which I’ll be using. - The bathroom was always spotless and beautiful.  Anyway, look no further. Just book this place already. And thanks so much to Fiona and Deran for your amazing hospitality - I won’t ever forget it.

Fionas place was great. I took a solo trip to NY. They are very warm and inviting and I did not feel unsafe. I could come in as late as I needed to without feeling like I was bothering them. Breakfast was amazing and the bed was EXTREMELY comfortable after a day of walking all over NY. I would highly recommend booking with Fiona.

I was exhausted and had just gotten to the US from Switzerland, so waiting for almost an hour in the evening sucked. The front desk apologized and offered me a complimentary drink from the bar, but I was so exhausted all I genuinely wanted was a bed. Finally, after being checked in and upgraded, which i appreciated after how long I had to wait for a room. The second issue from my one night stay is something scary that occurred. I frantically called the front desk and told them what had occurred. This hotel is in a perfect location and is a charming hotel. I think they need better communication and the reminder that guests should always come first.

The least they could do was provide ear plugs. You can hear music and conversations so clearly it feel like you’re in the room. Also, I don’t know how well the other room was following covid guidelines because they were clearly having a party. I would have gone and knocked on the door myself, but because of covid, I decided not to. Owners are very nice but giving low rating mainly because of the room. They gave me a very small refund because of the party next door but definitely did not justify given how loud it was next door. This thin wall problem should be mentioned in the description because I felt like I was being scammed my entire stay. Also, Definitely not a studio and more like a large room.
Clean, friendly and helpful host and family.  Supermarket up the street.  Shopping stores up the street. Train and local bus close by. We didn’t feel threatened or unsafe.

Place is what you expect for the price. Decent but pretty small, check out is a lot earlier than most places. Location wise- it’s pretty far from the city, about 45 mins to get in. If you’re okay with the longer commute should be a good stay!
The space is good! Seems like a place to crash, not a place to really stay and enjoy. Be careful of the areas around here because some are unsafe!

The room and the furnishings corresponded to the description. The beds are comfortable, the room was quiet.  A kettle and a better range of cutlery would have been helpful. Subway nearby. However, you should choose Franklin station, not Norstrand, as the area there seemed rather unsafe.

We loved the Brownstonehouse and the way to subway is not far. All in all we can  recommend the condo for your NYC trip. Elias and Caro
