Building is old, so there were things that go with that, sloping floor, narrow stairwells, etc. but those things happen in most older buildings. You are mainly paying for the, and I cannot stress this enough, outstanding location. The kitchen is great and new. Great WiFi, tv, etc. The bed was a little lower to the floor than my knees prefer, but clean and nice. The sofa had a tendency to shed, but access to all cleaning supplies  Laundry service one door away:) A wonderful stay. I would do it again in a heartbeat.

The room was great! it was clean and spacious, and Jaclyn and Alicia were super nice to us. It is located just a few minutes walk from central park, and right across the apartment there is a small coffee/bakery with tasty bagels. At first me and my husband were a little afraid to share the apartment and not getting enough privacy, but it turned up to me a very quiet and peaceful room  (and private bathroom). Bottom line, amazing place! Very recommended!

This was the first use of Airbnb for me, and I had a bit worried, but in fact, Vinny's house is much better than I had expected, so I could make this trip so nice. Vinny's house is cozy, and clean, and in this Astoria, you can walk around safely and do what you wanna do because of its convenience. Furthermore, Vinny is friendly and kind to me, so you can have fun talking and feel no stress during your stay. To sum up, I would highly recommend you to stay Vinny's house!

I agree with a reviewer who said Tricia’s place was by far the best AirBnB rental. It is super clean, super spacious by NY standard, very well equipped and maintained. I enjoyed breakfast in the porch by her charming little garden. The apartment is close to Brooklyn Museum, Botanic Garden and a metro station, all of which made my trip enjoyable and stress-free.  I would give six points if I could.

The apartment is a short walk away from the subway, in a good neighborhood, and is a true steal in terms of housing prices in the City. Krista is accommodating, responsive, and an overall wonderful host! Definitely chose this place if you come to New York on a budget

First off let me just say this place is amazing for large groups plenty of room for everyone. The space was clean and convenient. Edwin was an exceptional host who communicated quickly and made us feel at home. This was a stressful wedding weekend with lots going on. It was so great to not have to worry about our accommodations. Everything was as described. Planing  to stay again soon and would definitely recommend this home !

My group had an excellent stay at this residence. The location is very close to LaGuardia airport and a subway stop, which made transportation relatively easy.   The rooms conveyed by the uploaded images are all accurate, and they are lovely and very clean in person. The kitchen was also very clean and well-equipped with all the necessary appliances and silverware/glassware. The living room is a bit small so it was difficult for all of us to sit together, but again, accurately conveyed by the pictures.  Oscar was very flexible and welcoming, especially during check-in. He made the check-in process very smooth and stress-free, provided us food and drink, and showed me exactly how to park in the provided lot. I felt very comfortable asking Oscar questions, although the response time was not always consistent.  The residence has wifi and apple tv, although the wifi became very slow with more than 3 connected devices and it was sometimes difficult to operate the tv (tech issues).  Street parking is difficult to find so I would recommend taking the provided parking. There are many, many places to eat around the house, which was great. Overall had a really good experience and would definitely recommend.

Great location but feels like you get what you pay for. Great amenities but that’s about it. Can’t easily get into the building because the outside master box with front door key doesn’t work. Definitely slightly creepy basement area to get to the apartment. Extremely noisy space that doesn’t allow for restful sleep.

For the price payed and pictures advertised, I would have expected way more quality for the apartment as well as the building. The odors from next door's restaurant get inside and it is an unpleasant experience, limiting opening any windows or terrace door. There is no place for storage with wardrobes filled with owner's stuff. The building and block are really dirty, and right by the front door of the apartment (inside the building) there are several open trash bins where the rest of the floor deposits garbage, and these odors also get inside the apartment's kitchen and living room. The bed is very soft for a month's stay, and with a healthy back I got pain every morning. The terrace had garbage that is not shown in the picture, and along with restaurant odor, was not usable for me.

It is a place well located with respect to the subway which is essential for a tourist, although the area is not visually very attractive it is not unsafe, we arrived very late each day and we did not have any security problems, William gives an exact explanation of what you are going to find when renting there, so read carefully about the location, it is not the host's fault but the area is quite noisy and makes it a bit difficult to rest, however we only suffered it at night since we stayed outside most of the time enjoying New York. I appreciate the timely help and communication with William and for welcoming us into your home.
Host is very slow with responding and coordinating any info. Place looked unsafe and the door is broken. Lock box had no key and waited an hour to get my refund back. Would not recommend

Beautiful accommodations !   Perfect for a large group, with nice bedrooms, bathroom facilities to match up, and large, comfortable living/kitchen area all in one space.  Small private balconies on each floor. Super clean with beautiful wood floors a throughout.  This was the nicest ABNB I have stayed in.  Pricey, yes, but I suspect a better deal for any equivalent place.  Nice location with good French bakeries near by for coffee and baguettes !

Steven is a wonderful and very responsive host who easily accomodated my last minute changes. The apartment is very cute, well maintained, and spacious - ideally for a long-term stay. It is located in a nicely renovated residential street. The quick 5 minute walk to the subway that brings you fast to Manhattan makes this place - as it is advertised in the listing - great for commuters who leave in the morning and come back in the evening. The neighborhood around, however, is rather sketchy with limited food and coffee options, and it feels sometimes a bit unsafe. If you plan to spend more time at home and want to explore the neighborhood, make sure to ask Steven for recommendations.

Ya'll,  this place was more than we expected! Prior to getting there,  we inquired about early check in since our flight came in so early.  Gannell was not able to do that since there were still other visitors in the unit, but did offer up home for our luggage.  Upon arriving at her place,  we asked about suggestions for breakfast. She mentioned a diner down the street and even drove us there! Lindenwood Diner was REALLY good and we went there twice! While we were out for the day,  she contacted us to let us know that the unit was ready and she even took our luggage into the unit! She kept in contact throughout the trip to ensure we were doing ok and give us suggestions on transportation.  Walking distance from the subway to take us into the city. Now don't be detoured by the walk,  the unit is in a rough looking neighborhood but never once did we feel unsafe. We walked the streets of the neighborhood SEVERAL times during our stay,  day and night. We would definitely stay here again!
Nice quiet place to stay, does have cockroaches wish was unpleasant. But the place is next to a plaza with store which was cool.

Awesome place to stay. Nice complementaries. Very nice host. All around nice place. But not in the best area. If your not made of money, it might be difficult getting around. Subways are super confusing. Buses are as well. So there’s Uber. Which sure it’s nice to have someone pick you up but it gets pretty pricey. Couldn’t really walk around the neighborhood at night cause it was sketchy. So if your trying to be a tourist of NYC and go to time square and stuff like that, and don’t have a high budget, then I wouldn’t suggest this place. Try to be closer I would suggest. The bnb and host was amazing just the distance and getting around was ruff.
The area on the internet has a reputation for being dangerous, I was very comfortable and everything was extremely calm, the Metro was super close to the house. Recommended 🫶🏼

Richards place is by far one of the best Airbnb’s ever. #1 important item to us was cleanliness and the place was spotless. The location was perfect too, centrally located and felt totally safe. Some places in the city can be sketchy but didn’t feel that all all. Richard was an amazing host. The snacks he had at the place for a Welcome was perfect after a long day of traveling. The toilet was the best touch. Nice updated modern furnishings too. We’ll definitely book again when in the city

The place was absolutely amazing, very organized and clean.  The neighborhood was okay, I didn’t have any bad experience but it felt shady.  The host were also very easy to contact, they reply almost immediately.  I took subways, so it was only about 3-5 minutes walk to the closest one.  They provide towels, body shampoo, and hangers.  The room also has AC which saved my life cause I did not know NY would be so hot.  I don’t think the place was overpriced,  it’s not near NYC or anything, but it doesn’t take a long time to ride the sub.

Sergo was always friendly and attended to our requests such as raising the temperature of the heater and giving us more blankets Advantages There is a bus and subway stop nearby 2 blocks away. There is a market nearby. Spacious clean comfortable apartment. It had hot water 24 hours a day. The appliances worked properly except the kettle.  Disadvantages. The apartment is located on the fourth level and has narrow stairs more than 2.5 meters high. Unloading the suitcases was very complicated because we were 5 people, 3 of which were older adults. It was really exhausting. I didn't know NY, but the area seemed uncomplicated to me, the atmosphere not dangerous, especially at night.

I booked this property a month before my group of 10 was set to arrive to NYC. 24 hours before we were set to arrive to the airbnb, I received a call from the host Joe. He blamed Airbnb for double booking one story of the two story duplex we rented. We had rented the two floors, but apparently someone else rented one of the stories after us and had already checked in. Within 24 hours before everyone’s arrival, I called Airbnb to see our options and how much they would help. Joe offered two remedies: put a few air mattresses in the one story for the first night and refund a portion of the first night or put half our group up into the hotel downtown. He also offered access to the roof for my friends to hang out on during the trip. We opted to keep our group together and so I asked him to put air mattresses in the unit.   I arrived shortly before the rest of my group to make sure everything was ok. When I arrived, the air mattresses were not made up and the sheets hadn’t been delivered yet. Juancito, a super patient, kind man who helped me check in, showed me the roof, and ran up and down the four flights of stairs to bring the sheets and everything needed to make up the beds.   This review has any stars at all because of Juancito. He made what was a stressful situation less, and here are where things take a turn.   When Juancito took me to the roof, we encountered party trash that had been left. I wanted to affirm those were not from my group so we wouldn’t have a problem. I also messaged Joe to share that the air mattresses weren’t blown up, and that one of the mattresses had what appeared to be blood stains. Image attached for your review and conclusion. After a stressful arrival and set up, I was disturbed by this and didn’t want to have one of my friends sleeping on a mattress with blood. When I messaged Joe on Airbnb, he messaged back “it’s not blood” before calling me and saying blood on a mattress doesn’t matter because it’ll be covered by sheets.   While calling Joe, I showed Juancito the blood on the mattress for which he expressed his mutual disgust and told me he would get a new mattress.   When I informed Joe about this issue, he told me “If I hear another peep from you, I will cancel your reservation. I deal with customers like you all the time.” He continued to tell me he would cancel my reservation as I didn’t have any other Airbnb reviews from past stays.   While I’ve used this Airbnb account prior, I’ve also had other friends help coordinate for past trips on their accounts and we have NEVER had any issues. I was beyond shaken by the gaslighting and reversal of blame he was putting on me for flagging for his awareness the lack of cleanliness and blood-spattered mattress. I was also unnerved as my friends were arriving in town in mere hours and I wanted to make sure we had a roof over our heads for the weekend.  On the second night of our stay, I received word we had been given access to the second floor. When asked for the key pad code to access it, Joe told me via Airbnb Chat to use the stairs from within the unit. Fortunately separately, Jonatan (the other host) gave me the code via text because there was a pad lock still attached making the floors unable to be opened from within the unit. Our original booking had entailed us having both floors as a joint booking, so this experience was a bit disillusioning. Image attached for your reference.   If we wouldn’t have had the double booking fiasco, I wouldn’t have needed to interact with Joe and the dirty air mattress, which meant I likely wouldn’t have had all those issues with him. The space itself was fine (after the bloody air mattress was removed).   I am NEVER staying here again nor with any of his other properties, and will be cautious moving forward for future bookings. All I can say is my trip was a success because of my friends, but next NY trip will be somewhere else.

The apartment and the reception system are particularly well designed and practical. The location near the subway (Cypress Avenue) is particularly convenient for getting to Manhattan. Only the neighborhood can surprise you, it's the Bronx: we don't really feel insecurity but rather neglect in terms of maintenance, urban services... but this is a point of detail and things can change quickly...

Rough start, couldn't get into the apartment as there were typos of the check in instruction and lock pin was inaccurate. The place was nice and clean which was appreciated. Decent stay, beware of the location as it can get shady.

Bronx Beauty is a spacious and confortable place, easy to get to with the direct subway train number 6 from Manattan. The appartement is quiet and perfectly clean, cozy and certainly contributed to our wonderful week in New York City. Hamza is reactive, helpful and knowledgeable! We had a vague apprehension about the Bronx, but we never felt unsafe and even let our children walk alone to the subway station.

This was my second stay at Lucy's place and I enjoyed it every bit as much as the first. Lucy is very easy to communicate with and is very responsive. This is very helpful when you are in town for a stressful reason as I tend to be. She is also nice to be around when we're both in the apartment at the same time. I will return again.

Our stay at Janelle's house was comfortable. We had an issue where the WiFi was down for a day but Janelle helped us out by providing her hotspot. The house had a lot of amenities so we had no issues there. While we had no issues with the house itself, the location of the house is a bit sketchy. Our walks from the subway station to the house during the night were a little scary for us(especially as we are not from New York) as we encountered drunk people screaming, loud parties into the night etc.

Both Devon and her apartment are wonderful. Two of my friends and I were visiting NYC for the 2015 NYC Marathon and I'm glad we were able to stay here. Before arriving in NYC, Devon was easy to communicate with and was very responsive to my questions. Key pickup was simple - she met us at the apartment and handed the keys over for the weekend. The apartment looks just as like the photos - there's a bed for two and a couch (not pullout) for a third guest. Devon left us with a list of nearby restaurants that she recommended. We ate at two of those on her list and the food was FANTASTIC. There is a lovely market/grocery store about 5 minutes walk from the apartment that I would recommend visiting if you need a few snacks for your stay. The subway is only a 5 minute walk from the apartment as well. We easily made our way to Times Square, Manhattan, the Staten Island Ferry, etc. on the subway. The location of this apartment and the proximity of it to great food, drug stores, a grocery store, and the subway make it a wonderful place to stay. I would recommend this apartment for two guests, but it definitely fits three if the third is willing to sleep on the couch. Wonderful place/visit!

This is a typical New York apartment, in an oldish building, at the 3rd floor with no elevator. Devon has been a great and welcoming host, and communication has been very easy. The apartment was below our expectations (I live in the area and I have booked other apartments nearby for friends or family visiting before).  The entrance of the building is a bit sketchy, especially late in the night -a narrow glass door in-between two store facades with posters stuck on it. The old staircase does not give a nice feeling either. On the other hand, the apartment is very nicely decorated. However, it has a subtle but non-pleasant smell, and we felt a bit like we entered in one's private place, a bit dirty and with things in the fridge and in the closets. Being a great host, I am sure Devon will take care of these things for the next stays.

This place was good for what I needed. I don’t have any complaints with location, privacy, price and amenities. You have everything you need. The only issue I had was with cleanliness. I am really sensitive to smells and dust (I have asthma so I notice dust a lot), so that was what made the place 4 stars for me.  One of the pillows smelled like sweat, which was really unpleasant. I am certain everything (the pillow covers and the sheets) was clean but the smell from the pillow just made me really uncomfortable. I ended up just using the other pillow.  The bathroom smelled of urine when I first checked in. It was fine for the first night but then I went and got clorox wipes and cleaned the whole bathroom. To be honest it didn’t seem like it had been deep cleaned in a long time. I cleaned the shelves and the floors and they were seriously dirty. I felt frustrated that I had to clean the bathroom myself after traveling.  I feel sad about leaving these comments but I want to make sure this doesn’t happen to future guests. I think that if we are being charged a cleaning fee, it should be for good use.

Sheying was great with communication and allowing early checkin. I saw Sheying's mother much more than Sheying and she was very nice and helpful. I suspect with Sheying just beginning to host, it will get even better with time as she seemed very interested in how to be a good Airbnb host. The cooking in the house smelled great - and she made available milk, eggs and a freezer full of dumplings. The room is a bit small, if you need space. But the price is great - do make sure it's an area you want to be in. As a New Yorker needing a place to stay for a few nights, I like seeing her neighbors make great use of the stoop to spend time with friends at night - and they were always very polite and even too apologetic about giving me space to get to the door.

Sheying and her family were nice to talk to. Apartment was easy to get from off of the F train and was close to transit. Lots of good food places in the area. Area felt unsafe to walk around at night but during the day it was fine. Heard gunshots walking home one night so just be vigilant. We stayed for a week and almost everyday we heard our host reprimanding and yelling very loudly at her young daughter. It felt inappropriate and It made me and my partner really uncomfortable to walk around the house and use the bathroom. Apartment was cute but not too clean. The host told us ahead of time there would be a big dog. We’re ok with pets and the dog was sweet but he kept jumping on us and chewing on our clothes. He also didn’t smell the best. The room was cozy, the AC was great, and the bed was comfy. Pretty quiet aside from yelling. Only downside was our room door being difficult to open, you had to literally tug hard on it to open. It was an ok stay, I honestly wouldn’t stay again though.

We had a very good time. We were there for 3 weeks! The mother of Sheying was very nice and helpfull. The location was okay, near the subway. You can go anywhere very easely. Every morning we could make a very good coffee in the kitchen, so we had breakfast in our room. This was very nice because restaurants are very expensive in New York. The neighboorhood maybe looks a little dangerous  , because many people hanged out in the street at night, but it was not. We did have any incident.

My stay in Debs apartment was an unpleasant one. I will begin with the pros. Deb did allow us to check in a few hours early. Check out was also quick and easy and we were given an extra hour at no cost. Now for the cons. I have stayed in several Air BNB's, and have had much more pleasant, warm and friendly hosts. When my group and I first arrived to the apartment, we brought an extra air mattress for backup that we had placed by the doorway in the bedroom.   About twenty minutes later, the air mattress had disappeared. I messaged Deb to ask if she had seen it and a few minutes later she brought it upstairs saying she had mistakenly taken it because she thought it was hers. This means she had come into the apartment without us knowing. She had also rudely invaded our privacy a second time later in the night when she again came  into the apartment without knocking or any forewarning to let my group and I know that we were being too noisy. She had zero respect for our privacy and accused us of having more guests than we had reserved for when that was not the case. The apartment is also extremely old. The shower pipe was falling off and if it did manage to stay on there was only one hot water setting. The bathroom was subpar in terms of clean. Although she did not allow us to wear any shoes in the apartment. We still left with dirty brown and black bottomed socks. The mattresses were very old hard and uncomfortable. Two from my group had bug bite marks on their skin the next morning.  Overall the most upsetting part of the stay was when Deb barged in on us. She was extremely rude and intrusive and spoke down to us as if we were children. She had sent us message  claiming we were too noisy and I said we would keep it down. If she felt we were still noisy she could have sent another message rather than inappropriately barging in. I would NEVER stay here again, not even for free.

I’ve stayed in many Airbnbs over the years but was never moved to write a review like this.  The only positive aspect of this airbnb is that it is clean.  Three family members and I visited NYC for a family holiday gathering and stayed over the weekend. The caretaker (we suppose) stays on the first level of the limestone row home (creepy) which the profile never shared. He came into our level of the home to help with the hot water - then he told me that “there has been alot of movement” upstairs. I was confused. The house says it sleeps 9 - are we suppose to sit still the entire time in the house? This house also doesn’t have ONE private bedroom.   Then he shared that we could not have any guests. I have a large family that lives in New York. One of the family members walked me home and according to his rules were not allowed to come in.  Lastly, I understand this is not a hotel but how do you sleep 9 but only have enough wash clothes and towels for 3 people.  This was by far the worst experience I have ever had with Airbnb. I would not use this house again.  If you are looking for a quick cheap place to sleep then this may be the place for you. But it is certainly is not a home away from home where you can relax and enjoy the city without being monitored 24 / 7. If I were you I would not book this place.

I was in NYC visiting on my birthday weekend, and I'm glad my gal pal and I decided to stay at Jason's place! We got in late for check-in, but Jason was super understanding and so sweet about the situation--especially since getting around New York isn't the easiest thing to do. He also would check in on us occasionally to see how we were doing, and was very approachable, but wasn't overbearing--we only saw him once during our entire stay--and that was for the tour. It's a great approach for people who err on the independent side, but still want the opportunity to ask questions.   The place is adorably decorated and so cozy, and just made us feel right at home. Because we arrived late in the evening, we immediately settled in. The space is a whole apartment, complete with a kitchen, bathroom, living room, and bedroom area which is basically a steal compared to some of the other AirBnBs we considered. It was like we were true New Yorkers, and not just tourists staying in a tiny hotel room. There was bottled water and suggestions for activities sitting on the coffee table when we arrived, which I also appreciated--it was very thoughtful. There is also free wi-fi for guests, and cable TV, so if you have time during your stay to relax, you still have the comforts you would at home. I would highly recommend staying at this AirBnB to other travelers coming through New York, you just can't beat the perks.
Quiet neighborhood, typical Queens house, Lolita allowed me to leave my luggage while waiting for my flight

I stayed with my sister in one of Lolita's rooms while we visited NYC for the BTS concert at Citi Field. We drove from NC, which wound up taking 14 hours and was very stressful, so we were so grateful to arrive at a clean, safe, and comfortable place to stay.  Our room was on the second floor and had a nice bay window. The bed is big and we each had two pillows. The bathroom is communal, but it was clean and we didn't have any problems sharing with other guests. We each received a towel, though there weren't any washcloths, so bring your own if you need it. There is a kitchen, as well, which we didn't wind up needing, but we could see it was tidy. The house and neighborhood seemed safe and we didn't have any concerns about leaving our belongings behind during the day. Parking is scarce, but I managed to find a space less than a block away and no one bothered my car over the weekend. There are lots of restaurants and such nearby if you need anything.  Overall, this was a great stay and we will look for Lolita again when we next visit NYC.

Lolita's place was perfect. Absolutely loved the area never felt afraid no matter what time I was walking home. The train is so close which was also nice! Lolita always responded to my messages and allowed me to keep my luggage at the place before I could check in. Couldn't have had a better stay! Thank you!
The room at Lolita's place was clean and well organized. Wifi was included as well as an air conditioner which is a must during some of NY's hotter days. I never felt unsafe in the neighborhood.

I had a great stay. The room was very clean and quiet (it is facing away from the street). The bed was very comfortable. The curtains provide good enough shade, so that one can sleep in even after there is light outside.  The location was very convenient too, only a short walk from the train station to Manhattan.

Warning: BED BUG!  In the next days after my arrival to this place I have noticed bites on my hands, wrist, ankle, neck and face. I was not sure what was biting me until I saw a bed bug on my bed sheet in Lolita’s place. It was around 9:30 pm and I took a picture of the bug and I reported this to Airbnb. I wrote to Airbnb that I want to cancel my stay in the next days because of this.  I also wrote to Lolita to inform her about the situation, she sent two of her workers(one woman and one man) one hour later to the room to check it.   They checked the bedsheet of one of the mattresses which was top of other two mattresses(the bottom mattress was looking very old) and told me that there was no infestation. They were so nervous and impolite and kept asking me to show them where the bugs are. I showed them the bites and wanted to show them the picture of the bug as I already threw the bug away (that was a mistake, please record everything correctly, even store the bug as an evidence!). I wanted to show the date and the time of the photo of bug. They didn’t even look at it and started to accuse me that I am making up a story. The woman even asked me if there were bugs why I was still staying at their place. I told her that indeed I didn’t want to stay but I had no reservation in any other place and it was too late to find a new accommodation for me for that night. It was around 11 pm. Because I was asking for a refund, she became very aggressive and accused me again that I was trying to stay at their place for free.   There was almost no way to communicate with them as they were not listening to me. I was very upset that they didn’t even try to understand my situation and treated me like I was lying. Since I also kept telling them that I saw a bed bug, they told me that I should leave their place that night otherwise they will call the police.  As a long term airbnb user (guest and host) I have never experienced such an unpleasant situation. Almost midnight I was asked to leave just because I told them that they have bed bugs. The man even told me that they want me to leave as soon as possible because they were not happy that I reported it to airbnb!  At around 11:30 pm I had to search and book a hotel in the neighborhood and leave Lolita’s place. It was just a terrible experience in the middle of the night.  Afterwards the bites caused an allergic reaction and I visited a doctor and got a medical report which confirmed that it was because of bed bugs bites. I have sent all this information to Airbnb and waiting for them to take further steps for this listing.   As a summary I don’t recommend you this place as you might have trouble with the bed bugs and ruin your trip!

We loved Cathys apartment and it made our stay in New York perfect. It was very clean, comfortable, cozy and calm + the kitchen was well equipped with everything we needed. We also liked the neighboorhood around the house bc it is not that stressful as Manhattan can be. The ride from JFK was very easy and fast and to Manhattan it took us 20-30 minutes with express train. To us it was the perfect home to explore New York!

Cathy’s spot is definitely a gem in the selection of Brooklyn airbnbs. It’s just big enough to make it feel like you’ve got a good amount of space for NY, and cozy enough to provide a sense of homeyness. It was clean, came with a very well equipped kitchen, and had all essentials one could need, including plenty of linen sheets and bath towels. Because it’s a ground level apt, the living room is pretty close to the street and picks up on a decent amount of noise— but it was never that big of an issue, and the living room itself is also quite cozy with plenty of warm lighting and a big tv with plenty of streaming channels already set up. The apartment is also in a great spot, just a little less than a 5 min walk from A & C lines on Utica ave. Getting into Manhattan takes only 20/25 mins. Although there’s no laundry on site, there are laundromats close enough where it never feels like too big of a chore to get it done. There’s also an abundance of GREAT restaurants nearby.  On top of comfort and convenience provided, Cathy is a superb host and great conversationalist. She’ll definitely make you feel welcomed and knows aaaaaall the cool spots to check out. Overall, this place is a steal and I definitely recommend booking in advance, otherwise you’ll be left with far less great options around the same price mark.

Apartment very well located! Good welcome from Peter who even kindly allowed us to leave our luggage on the last day all day even though we had a late flight.  On the other hand, a little noisy: work right opposite which started very early and noisy and excessive heating.

Peter and his place are great. He was very friendly, accommodating and quite easy going which made the whole process very low stress . The trashcans were all empty and clean towels were ready to go, the place was very clean. The apartment is a short walk from time square and the subway, and there were some nice local restaurants: "Mom's" was a fun breakfast. It was really nice to be in a lived in space, compared to a hotel, over all this was a great value.

Patricia was absolutely amazing! My husband and I booked another air b n b which was very noisy, unsafe and uncomfortable. We found Patricia's place and it was a God send. It was incredibly clean, smelled great, comfortable, safe--just overall awesome!! Patricia is very attentive and wasn't bothered when I inconvenienced her by locking myself out late night. She even left us a bag of apples and several bottles of water. She was a very attentive host and would def stay here again. No complaints and that's saying a lot!

Sandys apartment was spotlessly clean and very roomy for our group of four. Conveniently located not far from subway Q train that takes you right into the city. Also very nice and quiet neighborhood never felt unsafe. Could not ask for a better host than Sandy! She was very accommodating and made sure we were having a pleasant stay. Highly recommend and would definitely stay again!
Really nice cozy spot in Carroll Gardens. Matches the description well, and Stephanie is an outstanding host. Quite, stress-free stay.

The decor in the apartment is amazing. With curated style and the feel of a set for a Brooklyn based movie that I would watch on repeat the space radiates cool. This place would be a steal at twice the price. We were greeted on our arrival with a couple lights strategically left on warming the atmosphere and making us feel welcome. On each of our pillows a toothbrush and travel toothpaste. Quite possibly one of my favorite airbnb experiences to date.

This place did not have good vibes and I did not stay. The loft is open,  there is no privacy and the bathroom door didn't shut properly. It was cluttered and untidy. One of the beds is positioned on the edge of the loft and very unsafe.  The old ladder was quite unsteady and did not feel safe. I do not recommend this place to anybody and Karen was unwilling to refund my money.

Laura and her apt were so great! We got into the city much later than expected and Laura went out of her way to prepare everything for us. She responds very quickly to emails and texts and she's always super sweet. The apt was definitely a steal and her adorable cat really made our stay comfortable.

For anyone looking for a stellar apartment in an extremely convenient location this is the place! There is relatively cheap parking under the building and safely off the street for those who drove into the city. My only hesitation was that you have to pretend to be related to the owner in order to get the key and I think the front desk was catching on a little bit but everything went smoothly. Also she does own a cat who was okay with having strangers in the room as long as you feed it and left it alone. I scared it once and it swatted at me but that was my fault. Besides those two things this place was perfect.

I had terrible experience here, the worst airbnb I have ever lived.  The house itself is tilted - you can feel that you're climbing mountain when you walk. Sometimes it's dangerous because chairs are tilted, too and children can get fall.  Furniture was too old. Some drawers lost their handles, bed matress was so old that you can feel the gravity exists,  window blind was broken, etc.  The cleaner cleaned thoroughly, but I found hugh roach in the midnight. My wife stepped on it unconsciously and found it was dead in the morning.  Parking? Don't expect to park near the house. It's very difficult to find a spot.  One day, she asked me to use dryer in my house because a dryer in the basement was out of order. I told her to ask my wife because I was out. But the cleaner came without talking to my wife. Anyway we let her use it.  The most upsetting thing is Sandy's attitude. She was very quick to respond in general questions. By the way, when I asked to change my schedule shorter, she did not responded. So I called her and she said she hasn't seen the message but she agreed to confiem my schedule change, but she didn't. I asked her again with message, no answer again. And the last day of my original schedule, she sent me a copied message to remind me of checkout time. What???  If she didn't want to confirm my modified schedule, she should've told me not to do so. But she said yes, and no response.  I hope everybody not to be fooled with good-looking pictures here and never expect she will refund your money.

Samuel made communication and arriving at his place stress free even at the last minute. The apartment is very comfortable and a haven after a long day in the stimulus of New York City. The Christmas lights on the bed were a nice touch! It made the room so warm. We met Daniella during our stay, who was kind and helpful while also giving us space to use the apartment as if it were our own. We were only in the city for two nights and get to explore the local neighborhood much and can't really speak to it, but it's located close to several metro lines that made it a great base to Manhattan for our more touristy needs! I'll definitely stay again if I'm back in the city.

I absolutely loved staying in this lovely, comfortable apartment. Samuel and his wife are such great hosts — laid back, but warm and friendly (they also seem like very cool people). The bed is quite comfortable, which was welcome after long days of walking all over Manhattan and Brooklyn. And without question, theirs is my favorite Airbnb bathroom to date: clean and bright with a GREAT shower. You're very close to at least five different subway lines, mostly notably the L, so getting around is a piece of cake. I would stay here again in a minute — and in fact I suspect I will.

The Room was very clean, bright and nice. Everything was great. Sam and his wife were very friendly and helpful. The only thing is the surrounding and the way to the subway at night. It was a bit scary through that dark streets, did´t feel very comfortable.

Samuel was a great host. The place is cozy, subways are close and you need around 30min to downtown. When it was dark, the neighborhood was a little scary for two young girls. Nevertheless great stay. Would recommend!

The apartment is in a very quiet and safe neighborhood.  It takes just a few minutes to walk to Central Park, which is ideal if you want to go for a walk or jog during your stay.  It is also conveniently located to a couple subway stops, which makes exploring the city easy.  David was a very responsive host - I felt I could get any question answered almost immediately.  He was unable to meet us at the apartment the day we arrived - we picked up the keys at his apartment, which was not too far away.  The apartment is as pictured - open, simple, clean.  Overall, we had a nice, stress-free stay.

Really super nice apartment, clean and brand new.... Lots of attention from Charlotte with a short guide on using the apartment's amenities and the neighborhood's restaurants, with some fruit in a bowl and something to quench your thirst after a flight, which is nice. In addition, you can have a small garden for sunny days. The J train is less than 10 minutes away on foot with a frequency of 10 to 15 minutes. Great stay.

We arrived at Sandy's place on 2nd of October. After long flight 9 hours we would like to rest a bit but we got so much stress and dissapointment...   The code we got was wrong so we had to call host and ask for help. She gave us new code and we could get in.   The apartment was very dirty - sticky and dusty floors all-around. Broken furniture - all 2 beds, closet, even the light fell down in the bathroom.   We were traveling with baby,  so I have asked a baby bed. We got a packnpay bed but it was so dirty, stucked in tiny dirty and dusty laundry room that we couldn't let baby to sleep inside.   The dubbel bed is sinking in the middle because all 2 bed feet under it are broken and there is a big chance that the bed will fall apart.   Other 2 separate beds have same issues. They are falling apart.   Bed linens were smelly and had lots of stain on it.   The kitchen table was so dirty couldn't eat on it!   There are also mosquitoes in the apartment.  We informed Sandy about all this. She told us that she would send someone next day till 2am to clean but we haven't seen anyone.  We explained that beds were falling apart that it's not safe to sleep on it  the baby but she denied to have any issues with bed ever.   I made photos and videos from all these to prove and sent to airbnb.   Next day they helped us to find another place and we removed directly.   This is shame to rent an apartment for that price when everything is broken and dirty!!! This shows no respect to your guests.   From the photos everything looks nice and clean but believe me we got totally different.   I can't believe how other people liked to stay there.   I definitely wouldn't recommend this place to anyone.

The only accurate description of this apt is the kitchen which is very nice.   Everything else was awful. Broken furniture, broken blinds, broken curtain rod ready to fall, terrible unusable mattress in master, filthy floor boards and corners in common area full of black dirt and gunk. Broken dangling dangerous light and exhaust fan hanging from the ceiling by one cord in bathroom. Host was unresponsive once I brought the fan to her attention. We felt it could fall on us at anytime   Host never made anything right. Slow or no response.   Location is good and the place has potential but I would not recommend anyone stay here in its current condition.

Overall, our stay in NYC was great, but we would definitely spend a little more money and book somewhere else next time we visit. In terms of location and just sleeping there, the room was ok but to be honest it just wasn't clean enough for us. Sonam is very nice and always available, but we didn't really feel welcome when we arrived (probably because she had just gotten home from work). The room itself is large by NYC standards with an en-suite bathroom, which unfortunately wasn't really clean in our case - the mirrors in both the bathroom and the room definitely hadn't been cleaned in a while and there was hair from the "previous tenant" and mold everywhere on the joints in the bathroom (which also smelled unpleasant). As far as we have noticed, there is always a constant change in the room and the cleaning can sometimes be a little neglected. We hope that our review can change something about this for future Airbnbers. As some have written before, the bed was very loud (apparently the slatted frame doesn't fit properly into the frame and slips as soon as you sit on the bed) and the mattress was very uncomfortable. Sonam writes in her statement that it is a high-quality memory foam mattress... We have such a mattress at home and it is worlds better to sleep on! One last note for the security-conscious among you: We found it a bit strange that the apartment door was unlocked most of the time (it could easily be opened from the outside at any time)... But at least the front door was usually locked and you had your own key for the room.

This apartment is located less than a 5 minute walk from a train station that takes you straight into the city; the location is wonderful! The apartment is extremely comfortable, quiet and clean plus it has its own en suite full bathroom. The bed was super comfortable and the room itself is very spacious. Sonam was extremely accommodating and very helpful; she made my trip much less stressful and for that I'm thankful. I'll definitely be staying at her apartment the next time I'm in the city!
Me and my daughter had a very pleasant stay at Sonams appartement. The room was nice and clean. The location convenient with good access to the Subway station. Rob & Fleur

We could not have been happier at Diane's wonderful home, more impressed with her timely correspondence or more charmed by her gracious demeanor.  The location is perfect for a City Island getaway and we felt like we'd gone across the world instead of across the city.  The one negative is that this was our first Airbnb experience and I'm afraid that Diane and her home has spoiled us.  But we will be back.  Thanks Diane!!!

This accommodation was not at all as I expected. It was not as clean as I hoped, there were loads of forgotten things everywhere, in the bathroom cabinet, lots of things under the bed...  Sonam was not at all welcoming as well and was also very unpleasant towards us towards the end of our stay.  We did not even get to store our bags at home the last day, so we had to spend our travel day looking for a place to store our bags on.  This was because one of the days I borrowed one of the shoes that stood in the stairwell, which me and my friend thought was forgotten from someone who lived there before, the shoes were quite dusty and stood in a lot of dirt and other gadgets, The towels were also dirty and stained so I had to buy my own, so me and my friend would not recomend it for others  Best Regards Cecilia

Maribel's home was everything we wished it to be and more.  Walking through the beautiful front doors, up the pristine stairway and into the home, we were thrilled to find a bottle of wine, bananas, tangerines, bagels, jelly, lactose free milk, eggs, butter, water, cookies, peanut butter, etc., all left for our enjoyment.  Never have we ever received such a gracious welcoming. The kitchen itself was thoughtfully stocked and perfectly kept. I was especially fond of the gray glass countertops. We practically flitted about the home as we marveled at all the lovely decor. I'm so curious about what the four story brownstone must have looked like prior to their renovation, although some neighboring properties give indication of what it must have been like.  I'm very picky about cleanliness and am easily grossed out; so, to say that I could have eaten out of their trashcans is truly a profound sentiment!  The home is impeccably clean. The bed was glorious and the sheets were the softest we have experienced thus far.  There were extra towels left for our use, making our stay ever so much more comfortable.  It was hot, hot, hot in NYC during our stay; so, the central air in the apartment felt luxurious. We took advantage of the local tips Maribel offered, and would say that two of our favorites were Sugar Hill Creamery and The Harlem Coffee Shop. You truly experience the cultural vibe of the area when stepping foot in these wonderful establishments.  The neighborhood itself is still going through gentrification, but never did we feel threatened or afraid when walking the sidewalks, even at night.  On only one occasion were we approached by a homeless person. We politely refused their requests and they ultimately left us alone.  Due to its proximity to Central Park, being a straight shot to Columbia's campus (albeit through Morningside Park), being just a few blocks from a subway, and being in the midst of such a culturally vibrant community, combined with Maribel's gorgeous amenities and wonderful hospitality, we would definitely like to stay in her home when we return to NYC the next time.

Diego's, apartment is as advertised. A few blocks from the subway and bus station. It is clean. We noticed that Diego, or someone else with access to the apartment, was using the apartment during the day while we were out. Each day trash was added in the kitchen, kitchen window was left open, then closed upon our return in the evening, his personal items (Dr. Bronner's shaving cream) was in the bathroom when we arrived and then gone that evening. Dishes were added to the drying rack, and then put away the next day. We did not use any of the kitchen dishes, nor did we cook any meals or open or close the kitchen window. Diego said in his first response that he would not be around, but we are fairly certain he was in a room, behind a curtain in the hallway. His visits to the apartment was not communicated to us, and felt very creepy and not standard for previous Airbnb experiences. For this reason, I would not recommend Diego's place.

When we arrived at the apartment late evening there was a strange smell. When the owner Diego came up the next day, it appeared to be gas emissions from the gas stove. Therefore the strange smell. Really bad start of our holiday and dangerous to be in gas spill. It surprised us that the owner took it so relaxed and did not seem badly affected by it. We were very affected by it and a bit “shaky” several days after thinking about what could have happened. So be aware of the stove when you get in and out of the apartment. If we have to say something positive. It was an ok decorated apartment with everything we needed. However, a kettle would be nice so you quickly can make a cup of instant coffee. Fine shopping nearby. We did not use the neighborhood and surrounding area, but we took the subway down to Soho and Brooklyn, where we would rather hang out.

This was a great place to stay! The location was perfect, the apartment was clean with all of the necessary amenities, and Rob was a wonderful host. He accommodated our arrival time, was quick to respond when we had questions, and provided a great list of recommendations for the city. I would return and recommend for others.

The location is sensational.   My wife and I stayed 30 days.   A little bigger than a studio, it was fine for a couple.  The apartment is on the third level so up two levels of stairs.   The apartment is at the rear so there is no street noise at all.     The bed was comfy.   I am very tall, but I had no problems with the shower which was really good (The hot water takes a while to come through).   The furnishings are basic and if you are intending to spend time in the apartment they become uncomfortable after about half an hour, this includes the couch.   Wi-Fi is good and the cable TV has some sports and a good selection of channels.  Eran pretty much answered any questions quickly and as he did not have another booking the day we left, he agreed to a late checkout.  Again, the location was exceptional, great neighborhood.   The area south-west of Seventh Ave can be a little sketchy and the local cops said the crime rate in the area had gone up a little.   Overall we felt pretty safe.

My stay with Jared was cordial, well located to access the Subway, it is about 15 minutes from the big city. The room is as seen in the photo, The neighborhood is good, walk at night without danger, I recommend staying with Jared

The place is in a great location with multiple subway lines and stops nearby. There are restaurants, small coffee shops, grocery stores, and drug stores a short walk away, so that was convenient too. Jared was a welcoming and friendly host. He gave us suggestions on places to eat and was respectful of our space. I had a good experience staying here.

Jared’s place is an ideal for those who are using the space to freshen up & out head out for the day. This area had a few convenience stores and short walks to 4 train lines! This listing is a steal for anyone trying to save a little but still accomplish a lot during their stay in NYC. Thank you for the hospitality Jared!

As a first time AirBnb user, Lorena took a chance on us.  Everything about the stay has converted me to a loyal user.  The hoe was beautiful, the location was amazing being so close to the park and get f&b is a great neighborhood and the space we had with 2 kids made the trip a lot less stressful.  A tremendous experience in every way.
Short walk from the metro! very clean spaces and we often felt almost living alone in the apartment. Sometimes there is a light unpleasant odor emitted by the building.

Maya was really sweet,really helpful,super friendly and easy to communicate..the place was nicely clean,good amenities with a easy to find location..absolutely a steal for the price...diffinetly will stay here again..

This place is such a steal for its price! It is extremely close to subway stations. There are also a lot of dining options nearby. Overall it was quite a safe neighborhood.  Maya was a great host. She was very communicative and her place was very clean. It was a lovely stay. Perfect for one or two people when visiting NYC only for couple of days!

Maya is not just running a rent, but rather a generous host in the traditional sense. She waited us very patiently until midnight the first night of checking-in and kindly allows us to check out late. Thanks to that, my loved one and I had a wonderful and flexible schedule in NYC.  Also, Maya prepares tea and coffee for the guests. The kitchen is clean and ready to use, which helps us to save money of dining out. Most importantly, Maya is always available on messages. Travelling in a metropolis can be stressful but her place provides a sense of surety and safety. Strongly recommend this place and the superhost!

For Astoria, this room is huge! I use to live in Astoria, just unfortunate that it was raining and 50 degrees in May for our visit but definitely recommend to book her airbnb if you can.  It was cold and we were just afraid to change the thermostat but definitely just ask her at an appropriate time of the day and she'll respond.  Would book again for sure!

We had a private room at Carlos' Brooklyn house. It was just as described. Spacious, clean and affordable (and we even found free parking on his street). Location is unbeatable, only a 3 minute walk to subway station on the J/Z line and there are a number of convenience stores, drug stores and supermarkets around the house. Would definitely stay again at his place when back in NYC.

Carlos and his family were very welcoming and accommodating. The room is a good size with plenty of space for our suitcases and us. There is a well-equipped kitchen you can use with free tea and coffee (thanks Carlos!). Bedroom, kitchen and shared bathroom were all kept very clean during our stay. The house is well located, only steps from the Gates Av. subway, which got us into Manhattan in 30 minutes, and to JFK in under an hour. The neighbourhood is cool, with cafes and stores for breakfast, we never felt unsafe coming back late at night.   The only negative for our stay is there is some building work going on behind the house (where the bedroom looks onto). They start at 8am weekdays it appears - this didn't really bother us as we were up early most days, but if you want to sleep in just bring some earplugs.

Don’t really have anything negative to say about our stay here. The host made everything stress free with quick responses, easy check In and out and warm welcome. The apartment was very clean, well presented and has a real cosy feel. If I was to be picky, an iron would be a nice added extra.  Thank you for a lovely stay :)

Loved my stay here! First and foremost, my cab driver who dropped me off was ranting about how worried he was for me to stay in this neighborhood, and it freaked me out. That said, as a single woman traveler who walked about half a mile to and from the subway station at all hours of the day, nobody ever bothered me and I never felt unsafe. Even better, having the 6 so close was a blessing; there was a direct route pretty much everywhere I went. The actual place was nice and clean, and the bed was comfortable. The one thing I will say is not to underestimate the three flights of stairs. I thought it wouldn’t be a struggle, but I was seriously dreading them every day after walking around ten miles every day.   Host wise, Jillian was great! I had to come a day after I booked because of a family emergency and she was very understanding. Also, I had to give her a call at one point, and she answered quickly. No concerns with her leaving you hanging!   Overall, I’d definitely stay here again. Jillian was a great host, and it was a great location.

This apartment home at NY is placed in a semi-good neighborhood. There is a public soccer field/track right next to the apartment complex where there was a birthday party and cookout almost every day of our stay. The rest of the blocks are safe but there are some homeless people and I even encountered someone who was on drugs. The walk to the main subway I used is about a 10-15 minute walk which can get a little annoying after a couple of days. The location is also a little far away from all of the main attractions like Times Square and the Statue of Liberty so I was on the subway for at least 20 minutes before I reached my destination. The subway ride to and from the JFK airport is also quite long; about 40 minutes to an hour. Overall, I enjoyed my stay and Jillian even allowed me to check out a couple of hours later so I wouldn’t have to carry my luggage around the city. The negatives are not Jillian’s fault at all and everything that was in her control was satisfactory. The apartment was really nice, clean, comfortable, and felt like home. I would highly recommend this AirBnB to anyone who is looking to stay in NY.

Arriving in the rain and very late, Michael came to meet us with a big umbrella and a big smile. His apartment was exactly as described. Very easy to access by metro, it is perfect for a stay in New York. It has all the necessary amenities. Michael had even stocked the fridge for us: fruit juice, apples, donuts... and the cupboards: cereals, Nutella, canned goods... Despite our rather poor English, Michael was patient, open and always available. He even allowed us to enjoy the apartment until our flight time which was in the evening. Not only were we able to enjoy New York one last time without our suitcases but we were also able to stay warm because it started to rain. We really had a great stay and we thank Michael again for his kindness and welcome.

Michael is a great host and his place is in a trendy Harlem neighborhood. Close to coffee, restaurants, subway and grocery stores. The apartment is literally stocked with everything you could need from extra towels to tooth paste! Fresh fruit and bottled  water already in the fridge when we arrived and the cabinets full with a variety of coffee, tea and snacks. The queen bed is in a loft with only ladder access so it might be a challenge if afraid of heights! Would definitely stay again!

Our group of three had an excellent stay in NYC a couple of weeks ago, and we have Michal to thank for our stress-free weekend.   Michael was readily accessible before our trip down from eastern Canada, and during our stay (he gave us his contact info in the event we had any questions about the city).   When we arrived on Thursday morning to check-in, the apartment had just been cleaned, there were enough clean towels to last us the weekend, there were enough toiletries in the washroom that we could have forgotten all of ours at home, and Michael even had the place stocked with food, drinks, and snacks to keep us fueled up! He had also left us enough bottled water that none of the three of us had to buy any for the entire weekend.   On top of that, Michael gave us a run-down on how to best navigate the city, and what some of the must-see attractions were.  Overall, we had an excellent stay with Michael, and if space isn't a huge priority for the next potential guests, we would absolutely recommend this spot!

Michael was an outstanding host! He welcomed me to the apartment with charm and courtesy. The apartment is very well located in Harlem, near the 2 and 3 subways and the M60 bus line which leads directly to LaGuardia Airport. The layout of the apartment was unusual and very well optimized. The loft style bed was very comfortable. Michael had taken the time to provide apples, juice, water, treats and everything needed for a comfortable stay. In addition, my flight having been canceled last minute, Michael allowed me to leave my suitcases at the apartment beyond check-out. A+!

This apartment is perfect for those not wanting to stay in the "touristy" part of New York and want to really experience NY apartment living. My daughter and I stayed here for 6 days, and even though we were rarely in the apartment, it was a great, convenient location for visiting the city.  It is a short walk to the subway and has the cutest coffee shop on the corner along the way.  The bed was very comfortable and we were provided plenty of linens.  Michael is always quick to respond to any questions you may have.  He accommodated our early check in and was even able to hold our luggage on the last day due to a late flight.  The place was kept plenty warm during our "snowy" visit.  He provided all kinds of toiletries as well as snacks, water and juice during our stay. The neighborhood is great and my daughter and I never felt unsafe, even walking to and from the subway late at night. Would recommend!

Michael, originally from Harlem owns the entire brownstone.  He takes great pride in what he does and will take time with you to be certain you are comfortable in the neighborhood.  He makes certain you understand transportation options to go where ever you want to visit.  The clean affordable apartment is well equipped with snacks, beverages and toiletries. A few blocks from the subway station, this apartment is great for cheap transportation to the many attractions in the city. Good restaurants, fast food chains, grocery stores, drug stores, dress shops and food trucks are all within a few blocks.  I highly recommend Michael's places and Michael, too.

Nice little pad- some areas around the neighborhood can be a little sketchy, stay  more on the west side and avoid Lexington and E129th area   Other than that was quick shot to subway system,  good coffee shops and local eats around  - worth the money

Yes, New York is great, but let me tell ya, Michael was a highlight of our trip! First off, he himself is authentic New York in the best of ways, extremely helpful, full of energy and ready to get you off on the right foot. He lets you know what are good and bad areas, where to go and what you may want to do. We were afraid about it being cold (it was in the 20's), but honestly we were maybe too hot! Very communicative! The place was perfect size for the two of us. The location was great - near subway, not toooo far of a walk from the park. Nice little coffee shop on the same block and a grocery store as well. Overall - 5 stars for sure!

Be aware! Don't rent with this guy. Shawn plays the nice but didn't have the decency of changing sheets! It was so dirty that we had to buy new ones to be able to sleep. Besides there wasn't any kitchen hardware to cook, none! And to end up he received a notice payment while we were there. We got so scared of being throw out! A total horror show.

Everything Ok, the biggest fear we had was the cold, but in addition to the heating it has 2 additional electric heaters, very kind to receive us before the arrival time due to the fact that our flight arrived too early.

Excellent host and place, close to subway line A and C. The neighborhood it’s kind a unsafe in late night but we returned many times late and nothing happened. Joel always answer so quickly and help me with any trouble that we had.

We very much enjoyed our stay at B&B in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn: comfortable, roomy en clean apartment, great service and direct communication with Sebastian.  We can recommend everyone to chose this location to explore New York. Subway's, busses and Citibikes in the neighborhood.   Rob

The property is not accurately represented in the listing. TLDR: Avoid for families - better off in a hotel.  The whole house was smelling and there was a pervasive stink especially in the living area. We specifically asked Chris whether it was non-smoking but he had guests over late night and we could smell smoke of some sort throughout. The linen and towels provided were not very clean.  The listing described that it was suitable for 4 people. However, there was one double bed and 1 tiny bed. For the fourth person, a mattress was provided to be put on a sideboard / sofa of some sort. Definitely not suitable for 4 people. Also, the listing mentions private room and private bathroom. However, bathroom is not accessible from the room. and there is no lock on the room. The room itself is tiny and definitely not suitable for families. Moreover, Chris stays in the living room and therefore accessing the bathroom while Chris is in the living room is awkward. Moreover, having Chris watch TV till late night or have guests over till late night does not help getting sleep. The listing mentions breakfast, and Chris did make some toast, eggs, peanut butter and jelly. However, this was not specifically bought for guests - much better to get a hot breakfast at a hotel.   We had to wait for over 30 minutes to check in. The door is locked and there is no information on how to check in. We tried calling Chris but his phone was unreachable. He told us that his minutes had exhausted but saw him having long conversations on the phone just after that. However, Chris helped us carry our bags to the 5th floor via elevators once he came down and also when we were checking out.  For this price - you are much better off booking a hotel. We did not want to stay in the room a minute longer than absolutely necessary. Chris also charged us $20 for holding our bags till afternoon. Overall we felt that this was a big mistake and has pushed us to rethink using Airbnb in future.   The location is the factor that we had in mind when we booked. This place is 2 minutes from the subway. However, the neighbourhood is not very safe with many homeless people loitering around till late at night. Moreover the subway station close to the apartment is probably the most horrible smelling station in New York with an over-powering smell of urine. Also beware of random people who might approach you and be friendly and offer metrocards, etc. We did not feel safe coming back late at night.   We had booked this instead of hotel to stay in the city and make the most of 2 days sightseeing. However, we had a terrible experience and this ruined the New York section of our trip and we left with a very poor experience and impression of New York.

The accommodation is located right next to the metro which makes traveling much easier. We had a lot of trouble finding an apartment, the directions were not clear. The photos are not consistent, there were 4 of us, there was a correct double bed, but the other bed was in fact an inflatable mattress placed on a piece of furniture and a bed, so the mattress was sloping. The room was dusty, the apartment is located in a bad area, there is even drug trafficking in the common areas of the apartment. There were also very strong smells of cannabis in the common areas as well as in the apartment.

Thanks to Claude, a very successful New York trip! The accommodation was in a very pleasant location, just a 10-minute walk from the nearest subway and Central Park. There was a wide selection of restaurants and small shops in the area for daily supplies.  The apartment was very artfully decorated, as can be seen in the photos. Sometimes you were a little afraid of breaking something, but luckily everything stayed intact! What you don't have in your head, you have in your legs... with 4 floors you only forget something in the apartment once!   WiFi and a large TV for entertainment were available and ran without any problems.  After a short time we felt like we were at home!  Price/performance for New York standards was right here...  We will stop by again next time we visit New York! Kind regards Anna and Luke

Had a great time in NYC. The unit is clean, comfortable & just as photos show. The area is a little scary. I would definitely not go out alone at night but we felt safe going straight to the subway & home during the day time. As the building is older with wooden floor you can hear people in the unit above walking so if your a light sleeper maybe keep that in mind. Otherwise it's a great airbnb & you can get into the city within 30mins - 1 hour. Ben is also helpful for any questions you may have.

Chris was really nice its a great location at first we felt a little unsafe in the area but it turned out to be a very friendly family neighborhood ;) people were helping us and also chris made us coffe in the morning, well come back if ever in new york

We have just had a great week at Babajide. Communication was very easy before our departure and then on site. We were delayed by more than 3 hours and arrived at 11 p.m., Babajide received us very warmly and took the time to explain everything to us. The apartment is at the foot of the direct metro to Manhattan, there is also everything you need for shopping 5 minutes away on foot. The apartment fully conforms to the description. The beds are very good (very appreciated after days of walking...). The only downside is the noise from the avenue in one of the rooms (earplugs are welcome), at the same time it's part of the change of scenery. and a big plus, the possibility of leaving luggage in the office next to the apartment on the day of your departure if your flight is scheduled for the evening and you want to enjoy your last day. Super practical!!!!

Look no further! This place is the perfect spot for your upcoming NYC adventure! Carlos and his wife are absolutely amazing and sooo helpful - they provide everything you need for your stay, be it toilet paper, towels, shower essentials, a hair dryer, wifi and an incredible place to stay at. The room itself is huge and was superb with an impeccable, comfy bed and everything you might need to feel home. The kitchen and bathroom are newly renovated and come with everything essential for your daily life and routines. The house itself is located in a  quite street in an interesting, safe and convenient neighborhood. The subway stations are only a few minutes away and we never felt unsafe. A lot of stores and delicious restaurants are also nearby. Furthermore Carlos will take care of you and your wellbeing - he knows all the good stuff, good places to eat and where to go (plus what to avoid). His tips and recommendations made our trip even better and took us to places that we as tourists would never find! We will definitely come again and will stay at Carlos‘ again! This is the best place to stay in NYC, Manhattan is only 20 min away and Queens is cool to see! Thank you for the amazing time!!!

This room was just what we were looking for and the host and his family were nothing but super hospitable and we felt very welcomed. The family is really sweet and staying with them felt very homely and safe. The area is also very safe and as two girls in our 20's we could easily walk around without feeling scared whatsoever. The place is near stores and restaurants and I would definately come back and stay with Sergey if I come back and visit New York!

Tanya's house is a gem in the heart of Harlem. This four story house was stunning, cozy and spacious. It is a 2 minute walk away from the train station and close to many restaurants. The train station has express trains that stop in nearly every tourist destination. Additionally, my family of 12 came up for my wedding. She completely took care of them and allowed me to feel stress free while I had to finish wedding planning. I would highly recommend her place to anyone!  Thank you so much Tanya!

Carolina's place was truly a dream. A train-hop away from the anywhere in the city. It was so clean, cozy, and colorful. Not to mention, Carolina checked up on us to make sure we were comfortable. I cannot recommend her place enough. It is a steal and my husband I kept saying we wished we lived there!!!! So magical! Thanks Carolina! (Also she has impeccable taste and the design in the place is amazing)

Babajide was very helpful and even let us check in early when we showed up too early after some miscommunication. The place was very close to the subway, and this made traveling NYC easy and simple. The area and the station was a bit sketchy compare to all the other stations we visited, but we never encountered any trouble. I would recommend this place because of the ease, the cleanliness, and the helpful nature of Babajide.

The communication with Christopher (the host) before our check in was not the way we hoped for. It made our trip to the city super stressful. I understand that this special app "August" is convenient tool but we were  not really impressed because that's another extra app on our phone . I think simple check in is a must.  Plus the cleaning person was still there till 3:30pm, and the apartment was not ready. The bathroom was filthy with dusts, hairs and made me nauseous .  The host sent the cleaning person the next day after I sent him the pictures of the bathroom.  The host seemed to care more about his 5 star rating than our comfortable stay and that didn't help us to feel "at home".  The apartment is in the cool neighborhood.  Going into Manhattan takes about 35 -40 minutes or more.    I would not recommend this place.

I recommend staying with Ashley if you're going to be in New York. Her place looks exactly how the pictures in her posting ad looks like. She and her dad were very prompt in responding whether it be an issue we had, to any questions we had or recommendations. The snacks and water she left were very nice of her considering the long haul for me and my kids. The washer and dryer were a big plus because I hate traveling back home with a lot of dirty clothes. The apartment was very spacious. Better than a hotel! She provides almost anything you'd need as if you were at home! The area seemed shady when I pulled up but very safe to walk, even at night with my kids. The subway train is literally right around the block from the apartment. The train closest to the apartment was just a short ride to any of the touristy spots you'd want to go to in NYC. I drove and parking was very easy to find. At night though, you might have to drive around a bit or park a block or two away. Your car is safe. Any questions or concerns - Ashley responds w/in seconds. You will not be disappointed. Ashley is awesome!

Babajide claims to have a very clean place. That is not entirely true. it is surface clean. But Vents and areas like next to the stove where there is a 4 inch gap were filled with dirt/dust and I have the pictures to prove it.  The apt had just been cleaned with something so strong smelling that it lasted for the 3 days we were there and gave us raw feeling throats. Also the sponges that were left for us to clean dishes with smelled  very strong like mildew. The unit is heated by radiators, but the radiators have electric cords and curtains hanging on them getting hot. We felt very unsafe because of this.  And there were no CO detectors or smoke alarms. Also the post said there was free street parking so we kept our rental car. But little did it say that the free street parking was down the street and around the corner. Not very convenient for a family of 5 who needed the car close to unload and reload tons of luggage. He was very helpful in showing us how to use the remote for the t.v. and showing us where the street parking was. But other than that we didn't have much contact with him.  The other thing the apt could have used was some kitchen towels so we could have actually used the kitchen and washed the dished, and some wash rags for the bathrooms. we had 2 hand towels and 5 bath towels and no other linens or towels.  But the location was great!

Ashley responds consistently and promptly. The place is nice and neat, the process of checking in and out is smooth. Ashley does not interfere with your stay at all. The only issue is during my stay a window was broken and she tried charging us double what it cost to fix. For future reference, get your own contractor and avoid being scammed if you encounter any problems.

We were looking for a place with a parking spot and close to public transit since we drove down to New York and had no intention of trying to fight traffic to visit downtown.  Ashley's place fit the bill perfectly.  Located just a 5 mins walk to several subway lines, it was super convenient and at no point did we feel unsafe walking through the neighbourhoods after a late night in Manhattan.  Street parking was plentiful and easy to find right in front of her place.  Check in and check out were very easy, and Ashley is a very responsive host.  We had a small leak coming from the ceiling in the bathroom and she was quick to resolve the problem.  The apartment itself was clean and comfortable, with plenty of space, and stayed nice and cool through some hot humid days in the city.

Mark is an excellent host, very generous and helpful. The only thing I would say is that the area can be a little sketchy at times, but I never had any problems. Overall I would definitely recommend Mark's place.

We all had an amazing stay at the hidden treasure I would 100% recommend Yemi as he is an amazing host right from booking to during our stay to us leaving . His attention to detail is one of a kind and how he goes above in beyond to mee your needs. The place was warm and toasty and comfortable defiantly a home away from home.  Yemi puta every effort in to making you feel welcome and at home ensuring your stay is stress free. We staying for nearly two weeks in which he topped up On essential even wrote us are own itinerary for bars restaurants in the area. The location is perfect the 3 train runs 20 mins into Manhattan and runs all night local shops make it easy to pick up home made dinner . I would defiantly stay here again planning my next trip see you soon Yemi and thank you for such a fantastic trip !

Both Yemi and Reyanna are friendly and friendly. I felt comfortable during my stay. It takes a little walk to the subway and the room is underground, but the room is clean enough to recommend and everything is great. If I go to New York, I want to stay again.  And it's a very quiet neighborhood. I was a little scared because it was quiet.  But this place is better than what you see in the picture!

Yemi deserves the best airbnb host award. The house was pristine clean, the fridge had some awesome goodies that truly made all the difference since grocery shopping was the last thing I wanted to do, what a nice surprise.
