The cabinets are also fully stocked even tons of spices, oil, anything you may need if you like to cook. Keyless entry at the back of the house so very private and safe. The washer and drier were so convenient since I rented the place while rotating at a nearby hospital so I could wash my scrubs often. Walk to Brookdale Hospital was about 15 minutes and uber <5 minutes (not the best neighborhood but I never felt unsafe as I just made sure to uber if it was too late at night).  Overall loved the place and the host(although I never met him in person). Truly appreciate all the nice touches, it felt like home for the month was there.

The host is fantastic and super responsive and helpful, the location is great, and the subway station is like a four minute walk and the 2 gets you just about everywhere you need to go and takes you about 35-45 minutes or so to get most places in the city It’s in a good area and lots of good food nearby. We went to Daughters coffee a few mornings which is like a ten minute walk from the air bnb.  There were lots of spices for cooking and pans but not baking pans. Also the oven ended up smoking so we didn’t use it, I texted her about it so this may not be an issue for your trip. When we came some of the dishes were dirty and just not washed well so we just washed them but it still made us go :/  We traveled with 8 people so we had to use some of the air mattresses and they deflated every night which was really rough. The pullout couches were okay and there were sheets and extra pillows although we had to wash them because they smelled like basement.  The toilet seat is janky. Whenever you sit the toilet seat shifts to the left and it’s a little scary lol. It’s not the end of the world but definitely annoying although we got some good laughs the first few days from hearing people panic when the seat shifted in the bathroom. Also the tank lid of the toilet is cracked, once again not a big deal but not great.  Laundry was great and she provided detergent and such.  It has a slight mildew basement smell. Some of my friends couldn’t smell it but if you’re sensitive to that like me, it’s rough.  Also if you’re over like 6’0” you’re in head bonking territory. Stay safe tall people <3 you’ve entered the bonk zone 0.0  Over all the place worked for us and the host is fantastic. The backyard was nice too :)

Roxanne is an amazing host! This place is gorgeous and almost a mini-arcade with a very warm, homely feel. She provides a lot of services and items such as snacks, milk, coffee, chocolates, basic toiletries (all included in the price) so this is essentially better than staying at a hotel.  This place is a steal for medium to large groups of people and the host has a well-oiled system in place to maintain and support the place before and after each stay.  Thanks Roxanne!

The views from this place are STUNNING! The rooftop with 360° views of NYC was the highlight of our stay. Spacious and modern apartment with beautiful marble kitchen and bathroom. Great location in Alphabet City, 10 minute walk from subway. Lisa was a wonderful host- very friendly and accommodating. Our only downside was the slightly stressful check-in process as the host was unable to meet us in-person and we had a late-night arrival, but Lisa went above and beyond to make sure we were able to access the apartment. I highly recommend this place and would definitely stay here again!

I would not return to this spot unfortunately. We did enjoy the location and ease of access to the city. I really wanted to like this spot and appreciated the creativity and use of space. The things that made it unpleasant might be specific to me and my daughter but we found it hard to stay here because of the overwhelming air freshener smell, the lack of privacy with a see-thru shade and window at the top of the shower and the flies when we arrived. In addition the spotty wifi kept kicking me off and the room's TV did not have any access to Netflix or Hulu as was advertised. Hopefully these things can be changed to make it a more pleasant place to stay.

Beautiful apartment, a stone's throw from Central Park, very nice area, chic, quiet, pleasant.  On the other hand, bad surprise: we waited half an hour before the host was available, the address was not the right one, 3rd floor without elevator not specified in the ad, what do you do with children, big suitcases... the apartment had just been repainted so it smelled a lot of paint, headaches... the windows that don't stay open, the toilets that get clogged from the first day, the sheets on the sofa bed are too small, no washing machine in the building as notified in the ad, microwave installed during the stay, the icing on the cake: work in the stairwell from 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. every day, replacement of the parquet floor, nails everywhere, noise, dust, and we had to walk on beams to get home, dangerous for the children!!!! we paid more than 1250 euros for 4 nights to have work done, we complained to the host who only gave us 90 euros back, it's still a shame!  1st experience with rbnb, the neighborhood is great but the rest is a bit of a cold shower, and when you ask rbnb for help, they tell you it's too late!  well done and thank you

DO NOT BOOK ANYTHING HOSTED BY THIS MAN. He is renting out spaces that are NOT authorized to be AIRBNBs. SHADY staff that does not speak whatsoever, no control of temperature, took our bags and locked us out, LIES after LIES!!! THANK GOD for the housekeeper who spoke Spanish and told us the truth. AIRBNB is refunding me due to such an awful trip and hopefully this man's account gets shut down ASAP.

Anna was a fantastic host!!! Her place was in perfect condition it was super cozy and just perfect for something affordable, location had busses nearby and not too far from downtown which was great. There were lots of privacy in the back and was never bothered by anyone who lived in the main house. Anna was super responsive and helpful, I had locked my keys in and she was very quick to go and open it for me. I had left a ring in the bnb the day I checked out and she went above and beyond to get it for me and I can’t stress more how lucky I felt that she’s my host. 20/10 definitely recommend
Could not have asked for a better airbnb for my trip. Beautiful lobby, great service, clean rooms, good location. A little walk from the subway but never felt in danger.

Studio as decsribed. Clean enough and bed okay. Location great and host easily contacted and flexible.   Just be aware that the studio is in the basement of a house and a living area upstairs is highly audible. There were arguments one morning that were unpleasant to overhear. Not much thought for guests downstairs which was disappointing.

Here's a bit of pros-apartment is new and exactly as pictured.  I did not see any bugs/roaches/rats etc.  Neighbors were quiet. it is about 6 min walking distance from F train-~45 min to Manhattan.  Covered designated parking was a huge plus. the host brought freshly washed sheets and towels from the laundromat which we really appreciated.   CONS-apt was a bit dusty and could tell the floors hasn't been swept for some time. in-term of furnishing-I think they could do better if they can add a couch for anyone who wish to lounge instead of jumping to bed to relax as it was not fun sitting in barstool chairs for many hours. kitchen does not have a coffee maker and a toaster, I mean its Airbnb-at a minimum should have these two items. mattress was sagging and very old, we were getting back pain.   location wise area might appear sketchy, we didn't stay out late therefore can't attest to the area safety at night. we sort of always headed to Manhattan therefore not sure if any good restaurant to eat in the area.

Very nice place for a NYC visit, close to a subway but the area is slightly sketchy so we uber-ed there during the stay. Cozy and has everything you need, would definitely stay again. Host is great and responses are prompt.

Do not rent!!! First I must say I do not usually give a negative review but I think it’s only fair  for other renters to know about this rental. The location is close to transportation that is the only positive about this place. The area is rat infested rats the size of squirrels running all over the place. The floors were extremely dirty, we all had to throw out our socks that was worn on the floors of this rental. There were no privacy no blinds or curtains at the windows, people were coming n peeping through the window at us. The place also had a very unpleasant smell when we entered which was tried to cover up with air freshener. The worse thing about renting this place was the owner refused to give us our $500.00 deposit with no legitimate explanation. We only spent one night at this place. They also advertised 2 bedrooms but only one room had a bed the other room had two couches that were not pull out beds just two hard leather couch. Also this rental is in a basement. Seems the owner expected us to make the one bed n mop their floors though we were charged a fee for this. We were told to bring all garbage to the front which we did. There were no alcohol served we only had Capri sun juices n snacks and the owner claimed there were stains on the couch which is not true. Please beware when renting this bnb they find reasons not to refund your deposit. Very dishonest renter.

The perfect! it's localisation is perfect really close to the metro to the Manhattan and other most important parts of the city.   Jarol is very nice trust worthy man. He is very flexible regarding the check in if needed! He is also helpful with every other aspect such as advices ect. He is so helpful that words won't describe it.   We were first time in NY (as Europeans) and we were not afraid at all. The neighborhood is calm and there is nothing to be worried about.

I really wanted to give no stars but I had to put at least one. Firstly, during check in time the home was not prepared for us. The host was physically cleaning and was there until 6PM which is 3 hours after the check in time. We were also unaware that the host would being staying at the same property during our stay. Many of the listed amenities were either not ready or broken. It was extremely hot and the temperature was in the 90’s the weekend of our stay. I messaged the host about this, she offered one a/c that was on her side of the property but we declined because that should have already been there since it said it was included. The yard was being worked on while we were there which was also uncomfortable since that should have already been done before we got there as well. We noticed an extension cord coming out of the downstairs bedroom window to the outside. The screen was open slightly enough for someone to easily get through if they wanted to, which made us feel unsafe. The water in the bathroom upstairs was extremely hot which burnt two of our guests, we ended up having to brush our teeth and wash our hands with the bathtub water. The screens in the windows were messed up to the point we couldn’t use the windows during the night because of the mosquitoes that were coming in and some windows had no screens at all. Also throughout our stay the toilet downstairs stopped working which we ended up having to fix. The shower downstairs was squirting out water from the actual wall and going everywhere. That bathroom window couldn’t be opened at all and the bathroom would get very hot with no air vents. The home did not look or feel very clean, we didn’t even feel comfortable to fully sleep or put our feet on the ground because it was not properly swept. There was also a ton of spiders and centipedes. We feel as though the price we paid and the stay we had was not fair. To be honest if there were less of us, we would’ve found another place to stay but because there was so many of us we didn’t have any other options. The host was responsive at first but stopped responding after we tried to get a refund. All I can say is don’t bother booking this place unless you’re willing to have a terrible experience. The price is not worth it and a lot of things are falsely advertised.

This place is old and well worn.  It is clean and accessible to where I wanted to be near my daughter in Windsor Terrace.  A nice walk to Prospect Park.  While it will sleep 4 the space allows for minimal privacy for one bed from the other.  The pull-out sofa is old and I believe the cause of my grandson's allergic attack (he is allergic to dust mites).   I had to take him home to mom and dad's in the middle of the night and he would not return for the second sleepover with grandpa. The mattress in the main bed was adequate.  Sarah does accommodate and is very nice to deal with.  The bathroom has not been updated in many years and as is common in NYC the shower is in an old bathtub and too small for easy access.  The kitchen is probably the most recently updated but I did not use it. It's just an old apartment in an old building with no recent updates.  My next trip to Brooklyn will not be here. :-(

Great place in an excellent location with a low crime-rate.  Sarah was very communicative the whole time and she's a great host. She has thought of everything you may need during your stay, and is available to provide help or advice even on short notice.  The WiFi and TV worked fine and the kitchen is well equipped.  The sheets and towels were very clean and fresh and the bed was comfortable.  The apartment was basically clean (free of dust or dirt), but could have used some fresh paint here or there, like on the bathroom ceiling.  (We don't know, however, if that's the responsibility of the building where the apartment is, so it may not even be something that Sarah or Samuel can do on their own.)  All things considered, this was a great place at a fair price (for New York City) with excellent hosts, and we will definitely use it again if we go to Brooklyn to visit our friends.

Very clean, beautiful and comfortable apartment. Close to the metro and several places nearby where you can buy what you need. I didn't like the neighborhood very much. I had been to Harlem before, but this area seemed a little unsafe for me to arrive late at night. There were people sitting on the access stairs almost all the time.

Massara was very pleasant, communicative and accommodating. Location was convenient with plenty of nearby restaurants, groceries (real groceries not just little NYC bodegas, though plenty of those too obviously) cafes and public transit options. By NYC space standards, this apartment is basically a palace. The apartment itself is very clean. As has been said by some other reviewers there will occasionally be people standing outside the door of the building but that’s kinda standard New York stuff and they were all cool, just say hi and don’t be weird about it. At no point were we made to feel unsafe. The one knock is that the listing said free parking on premises, which isn’t really accurate. There is potential for street parking and nearby garages at relatively affordable rates though.  Overall would definitely stay here again.

It was an absolute pleasure to stay here with me and my friends! It’s in a fantastic location and yes, as other reviews have mentioned, it is a little noisy however this is the BEST spot to be in (especially if you’re in your 20-30’s) because of how short a walk to everything is! So thankful for Tal and his easy check in - it made things less stressful changing from one Airbnb to another. 10/10 would recommend! Thank you Tal!

There was much to like about our stay, and a couple of things that could easily be fixed.  The host was great! Frequent, clear communication. He took a lot of time to show us around and didn't simply let us in.  The fixable items: There was only one beverage glass. A little hard for a party with more than one person. Next, the two front door locks were very hard to open. The host warned us, and tried to teach us how to use them properly, but it took almost 15 minutes the first couple times we returned to the unit. Because of the neighborhood (see below), this was a bit sketchy, as the front door usually had people camped out in front. Fixing the lock would be great!  Location: The unit was close to the bus station and reasonably close to Times Square. Yay! Tons of great food and groceries around; easy to get to the subway or use a bus. The large quantities of homeless on the front steps are of course totally allowed to be there, but we repeatedly had to ask them to move (which they readily did), and you have to be confident enough to do so. I was fine personally but it made things harder for my teen-age daughter.   The unit had stairs-no surprise, but be aware (for those with disabilities or lots of luggage). The owner did offer to help with the latter! It was easily comfortable for two people, and the quality of the couch allowed the second person (or maybe a third) to sleep outside the bedroom. Good TV apps. Good air conditioner in the bedroom.  My daughter and I would stay there again. 4 stars for the unit, and 5 for the host.
Really good bang for your buck on this one. My buddy & I had our own sleeping rooms. Clean, secure, close to A Lot of places. Compared to hotels, this was a steal.

What a pleasure! I had an absolutely great time, the appt. was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for my stay. Check-in was easy and stress free. Takes only 5/10 minutes to walk to the subway. Plenty of food and small stores along the way for a quick snack. Really a great stay !

We got stuck on Christmas Eve our flight was canceled. After a long day at the airport with no place to stay and people trying to scam us Jimmy came to our rescue, with a warm safe place to stay at the very last min. Thank you so much Jimmy my family and I really appreciate your hospitality!
This a SCAM

VERY BAD EXPERIENCE I absolutely do not recommend Nancy and her house and I do not understand the laudatory comments that have been made because this does not at all correspond to the bad experience that we had.   We couldn't sleep for 9 nights due to an invasion of crickets in the house who make noise from 9 p.m. to 7 a.m. They hide in pipes and are found in every room. When you take out several, more will come. This is due to the fact that the house is very poorly insulated and unsanitary. We had to dismantle the pipes ourselves to get them out. You can see a cricket photo on my profile. We also saw a huge caterpillar, dust, unwashed sheets and towels and no soap to wash our hands.   We called Nancy and at first she acted like she didn't know us and then told us twice that she would come by. In the end, she never came through. Nancy is therefore not as available as she claims.   Also note that planes pass over the house every two minutes from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. You will be 1 hour by transport from Central Park. The wifi hardly works. The TV remote control is out of order. The keys are outside the house so anyone can take them and open the door. The neighborhood sucks. There are drug addicts and tramps hanging around the streets.   Nancy also monitored our every move with the multitude of cameras installed. She asked us why we were talking to the tenants, why we were going to a certain room etc... Some tenants also smoked drugs and we could smell it from our room. Every night, some tenants slammed the front door, turned on the lights and started washing machines which woke us up every time because our room was next to the front door and the bedroom door was transparent.   Finally, she ordered us to leave before the 11 a.m. time indicated on the announcement.   We have requested a partial refund and if we don't get it, we will no longer use Airbnb.

Debated whether to write a post since I’m sort of jaded due to not wanting to stay there in the first place. Was browsing many places, clicked on this one like many others to see more about fees and turns out it was an instant book (didn’t realize my credit card was stored). Tried writing host and Airbnv within 3 minutes to explain the mistake and due to it being within 2 weeks, couldn’t get a full refund. They offered to give me credit for another time which is not helpful on a single mom budget.  So basically was stuck going with my twin teenage girls or out over $800. I personally would’ve been more fine here on my own but did not enjoy it with the kids. The noise due to it being on floor level sounded like the windows were open all night (may be due to A/C unit in the window). Kids got scared when hearing people yelling throughout the night, we could smell marijuana come in through window and they were freaked from a couple of cockroaches. They definitely did not sleep well.  Was our first time to NYC so maybe should have expected much more of this, but just wasn’t very pleasant or what I expected in a vacation. I would’ve been okay solo riding the subway for 35-50 minutes to get to Manhattan but was challenging at night with teens and further than I thought. Again wish Airbnb would’ve helped since I really would have preferred to stay somewhere else that was closer, not in converted basement.  On a positive, they did offer to let me drop off luggage 3 hours early, there were restaurants and a market nearby, and host did communicate via text a couple times during the stay.

The accommodation met our expectations. In fact it was a lot larger than the photographs suggested.  The good sized  kitchen  made up for the lack of a lounge.  The apartment was spotlessly  clean and comfortable.  As you would expect in NY there is noise. Saturday night was  particularly loud, but it was much quieter during the rest of the week. It is a ground floor apartment so noise is to be expected ,but it benefits from not being on a main thoroughfare.  It is a great location being so close to everything you could need in terms of shops and transportation.  If I need accommodation in NY  in the future I would certainly  come here again.  Communication with the host was excellent and our stay was totally stress  and problem free.  Many thanks to our hosts.

I checked out of this place this morning 12/21/22, Leidis' cleaning lady confirmed that everything was okay and we can leave. 7+ hours later I received a message stating that I supposedly smoked a hookah and damaged her dresser. The funny thing is I do not even smoke, no tobacco no marijuana. So unfortunately her scam won't work on me. If I "smoked" her cleaning lady would have mentioned a smell and the fire alarm would have gone off. She was trying to scam me out of $1,200 for a dresser? If you plan on staying here I highly recommend you get a recording of the place when you check in and when you check out so she can't try to scam you. She probably damaged the dresser herself or a previous guest and wants me to pay for it which is not okay and very unprofessional behavior.

Hi!  Pros: - The metro station location so close was a major plus. - The house was decent and met the purpose. - Everyone liked their beds. - Was a good price all-in-all.  Cons: - Grill was in horrid condition (we didn't use it at all). - Backdoor security was poor at best. - Neighborhood was surprisingly rough. Our youngsters were scared every evening we came back to the house. This was our fault for not checking beforehand what Brownsville's like. Not your or the neighborhood's fault. Just surprised us and we would not have reserved the place had we known what it's like. - Wifi was disconnecting a lot .

The stay at Nis's house was quite good. Next to two subway stops on different lines to reach Manhattan in about 30 minutes, very close to several supermarkets, with a bus a 2-minute walk away that takes you directly to JFK... The neighborhood looks a bit run down, and from time to time you see gangs on some streets, but it is true that we did not see any complicated situation. Of course, now that marijuana has been legalized in NYC, it is very unpleasant how much it reeks of weed everywhere.   The house is very good, it has everything you need, the beds are very comfortable, the two bathrooms work very well, and there is plenty of space for 6-7 people. Nis was also very kind, letting us access the apartment before check-in time, and leave our suitcases on the day of departure until the time of our flight, which was great for us to make the most of our days in NY. Thank you very much, Nis!

An absolutely wonderful stay. The pictures accurately represent the apartment which feels very clean-even down to the carpet- and is a pleasure to hang out in with all of the design details. The bedroom also overlooks the street and gets nice sunlight. The hosts were very responsive when I reached out (within minutes) and quickly answered any questions.  Coffee, fresh flowers, and a nice selection of fresh fruit were also provided, which was a nice touch. Perfect location. I can’t stress this enough. So many nice restaurants in walking distance, close to Penn station, and charming neighborhoods to explore. I’d love to stay here again.

The accomodation is as described. It's very clean and tidy. The neighborhood is safe and you can get easily to Manhattan from Northern Boulevard (lines R, M and E) or Woodside (line 7).  As the access works with a code, it makes it very easy to check in.  I was afraid that La Guardia airport noise would be a problem, but there is no noise during the evening and night.

The place was clean and presentable. It’s a little sketchy having to share the house with someone else, but everything was okay. The host responded to me when I needed something. Also if you plan to take the sub for the most part you’ll have to do some walking everyday. Over all we enjoyed our stay.

Very good host, responsive and attentive.   Good value for money accommodation.  ~45 minutes from Manhattan by metro (really a stone's throw from the metro) As girls, some feelings of insecurity in the evening...but as much in the Airbnb area as in Manhattan.   In short, good stay, we recommend.

Chemaly listens to its travelers.  The room was clean, smelled good, just like in the pictures.  The place was very accessible, the station for taking the metro is 2 minutes away on foot. There are people who live downstairs, this was not specified, because it scared me very much, but they are very nice.  A towel is provided on arrival.  However, I didn't use the shower because it wasn't clean at all, really filthy.  Everything else was good, thank you very much

We were left on a busy street with no communication from you or smart lock instructions!  Very dodgy and suspicious especially for someone who “manages” multiple units. Had to scramble and settle for last minute prices and market rates. Stay away!

The stay was great however, it wasn't mentioned the area where the house is located is not very pleasing at all. Lots of homeless, loud restaurant next to the window, very dirty, people stare at you all the time when you pass by.  Even a border officer at JFK airport asked us to think about re-booking it.   In overall, the room was ok. The bathroom wasn't tidy and full of hair, but its ok base on the price.
The room by itself is great, but be aware of the location. The neighborhood is pretty dangerous at night, and very noisy

This was a great find in Brooklyn. Close to the subway, grocery store, etc. I actually live in Brooklyn but was trying to avoid a covid scare in my own apartment  so I stayed at Sharon's for two days. Very clean and excellent communication. Definitely would point out of town friends and family to this place.

Our stay in Brooklyn was perfect! The apartment is lovely and modern, clean and comfortable. It had everything we needed and more.  Everything was as described and Manhattan, Brooklyn and Queens are all super accessible from this location!  The neighbourhood is quiet enough but not too quiet that you feel unsafe. Hosts were very accommodating and quick to respond to any queries ahead of and during our stay. We would be more than happy to return here on our next trip! High recommend A+++

Beautiful place, clean, and the host was very easy to communicate with and responded in a timely manor! The flushing area is very rich in Asian culture and it was difficult to speak with anyone in the community to get directions or restaurant locations. I can't speak high enough regarding the host and this home! However I went with my boyfriend as well as another couple (black and white) and twice we were standing out front of the apartment complex and had the police called on us saying there was suspected drug activity. The police gave us no problems and kind of laughed it off when they realized that someone had called on us . Other than that it was a lovely stay and the host and apartment were wonderful and I would recommend it for anyone looking to stay in the Flushing area!!

Rudolph is a nice, helpful person, who does not live in the property. When I requested to borrow an iron and an ironing board, he showed up later with a new iron and new ironing board and paper plates and paper cups.  When the keys didn’t open the door and the other tenant let me in, Rudolph brought me another set of keys.  I appreciate that he allowed me to book the room after I asked permission to bring my small dog and two cats.  The room is spacious with a king-size bed, a TV, a small refrigerator with freezer, and a table with a chair that you can use as a workspace or to eat, and a drawer chest.  The area is sketchy, but it is Gun Hill Road in the Bronx.  There is a Popeyes, Dollar Tree, Dollar General, Pizzeria, Supermarket etc.  The 2 and 5 train is about a 8 to 10 minute walk and is an accessible train station.  The issue I have is with the kitchen, which I did not use. When I opened the microwave door, there was a roach walking inside.  Next to the stove, there was rat/mouse bait.  Also, on the bottom shelves of the kitchen, there was a lot of rat/mouse and roach bait as well as boric acid powder to kill roaches.

The door to the building doesn't lock. I came home one night to a homeless man sleeping in a chair on the first floor near the entryway that I had to step over to go up the stairs.   The landlady would come in frequently at all hours, sometimes with other people (both for showing one of the rooms to renters and for moving stuff in and out of that room) during the time I was there and didn't fully close or lock the door to the apartment when she left. I would come home at night or wake up in the morning to the door not fully closed and not locked due to this. The host claimed there was nothing she could do about this, but it is a safety issue.   The fridge and freezer were full of food that was going bad and smelled every time you opened it. The host "cleaned" the fridge, but she left rotting food, including ham that expired a year ago and other moldy meat and vegetables.   One night, I woke up to a giant roach crawling on my leg in bed. I found more large roaches after that and a few small ones. The host said she's never seen roaches there, but there was already boric acid tablets placed around the apartment, a box of boric acid tablets under the sink, and a bottle of Raid with essential oils on the kitchen counter.
He was an amazing host, clean bathrooms, trash always taken out, texted back immediately at almost any hour , it was a steal to visit new york thank you

Perfect place for travelers who want to explore the city and just need a place to sleep at a reasonable price.  I was little scared at first when I read a review saying the room was too cold and they didn't have heater in there, but I had heaters in both the small rooms that we booked. We also had 2 small TVs so me and my sister didn't have to fight over what to watch when we got back to our rooms. The rooms were clean and had all the basic necessities. Thumbs up from me :)

Very nice and helpful. Provided drinks and snacks which was very thoughtful. My only complaint was the bed moves a little too easily and the noises i assume from the heat and water were very loud and scared me a few times. Nothing the host can help with but would be nice to have that listed. Definitely would stay again

Pros- fair price, well connected with rest of the city. Surroundings have all necessities. Very responsive and accommodating jost.  Cons- kitchen cud have been cleaner and better equipped, no microwave or coffee maker.    Walk to subway can feel unsafe later in the nite.

Enjoy your stay in Charm’s apartment. We had no difficulties with the arrival procedure.  The apartment conforms to the description and comfortable for 3 people. It is located not far from the subway (20 minutes by express from Lower Manhattan), food stores and a laundromat.  The main living room/kitchen is pleasant. The bedding is of good quality. Only the air conditioning is very noisy, bring your earplugs. The single bed room only has a fan.  The building itself is quiet.  The area is rather popular but we did not feel unsafe.  A good address!

The home was not cleaned appropriately. There were stains and crumbs of food in various places. Several of the electronic appliances didn’t work either including the tvs, clocks etc. The walls were thin and we could hear people upstairs and in other homes. When we contacted the host, she was responsive but didn’t follow through with obligations such as fixing the Tvs. Lastly, the home was entered into without our permission, violating our privacy and this made us feel unsafe.

this apartment is great-located and clean. a kitchen is well stocked. unfortunately our window was broken and we couldn’t have opened it while it was very hot inside. bathrooms are shared with whole floor, a bit dirty frankly speaking. the staircase is quite damaged and dirty, needs a renovation, we were afraid that the stairs would break and even fall. even though, Koichi is very very kind and helpful, thank you for your hospitality.

Wonderful place to stay me and my partner greatly enjoyed the atmosphere of the Airbnb we rented in addition to the wonderful Manhattan area. If you’re renting this one make sure to take advantage of Central Park being such a short walk away, honestly I can’t stress enough how lovely the location was; both inside and out!

The unit did not have adequate heat and was uncomfortably cold, so much so that I was unable to fall asleep as I was shivering in the bed with an extra blanket and my winter jacket draped over me and wearing winter gloves.  The host was repeatedly notified of this problem and none of their responses detailed below adequately addressed the issue.  These included telling me that the problem had been addressed when it hadn't been as the temperature in the unit remained quite cold, offering to take out an air conditioner and bring an additional blanket and space heater the following day when it's dangerous to sleep with space heaters on and I needed the problem fixed the day I checked in.  Because it was too cold to fall asleep I got out of bed at 3:00 am and left the unit.  Following this the hosts issued a refund for the remaining days of my stay but refused to issue a refund to the one night I was there despite the unit not being habitable.

The place is perfect for a couple of friends who look to crash for a few nights and don’t mind the tight space. We didn’t drive here but I can imagine parking to be really tricky. The neighborhood is a little shady at night. Other than that, it is a really good place for small groups on a budget!

This was by far the worst AirBnB experience I have ever had in my years of using AirBnB in various countries. I felt unsafe and I felt unwelcome and I will never return to any property that is managed by these hosts, ever. I am in a wheelchair and I would not recommend this place to anybody.  This is the first and only negative review I have ever written on AirBnB. I do not recommend this property to anybody and I, personally, would highly advise other guests not to book here. The best part of my stay was how helpful and understanding AirBnB customer service was with the issues that I had during my stay.

One of the best places I’ve stayed in New York, if it’s not the best. I felt at home. Rise makes us feel that way. At first I was afraid to rent because it was a new ad but it surprised me. I don’t regret it at any time. If you have this doubt, don’t think twice. You can rent without fear of being happy!  Several metro stations nearby. Easy access. Flexible check-in. Elevator... 🙌🏽  The stay was more than I expected. I felt very welcomed! Thank you for everything, Rise. I can’t wait to stay at your house again.  Note: she didn’t know that I’m in love with cold water and to my surprise, she had unlimited bottles of water for me to take at any time. That point won me! Oh, and what a wonderful shower, see?! I couldn’t forget to mention that. 😂

This was the best airbnb experience I have ever had. Manuela and her husband are the perfect hosts. They are very thoughtful, thorough, responsive and put a lot of effort into ensuring that they are anticipating and meeting the needs of their guests. The accommodations are very clean and properly maintained - easily the cleanest Airbnb I have ever stayed in. I found the listing to be very accurate, the location very accessible with easy commute to Manhattan and the guest experience to be a really great value for the money I spent. I stayed for two weeks and felt at home throughout. All the amenities and thoughtful items that Manuela provides during your stay (food for a quick breakfast, travel size toothbrush, lotion etc. in case you forgot your own) made my stay even more comfortable and stress free. I would definitely book again.

Cheap, Comfortable, super close to LGA. If you don’t mind taking the 20+ min subway to Manhattan, this place is perfect. Subway is like a 10-15 min walk. Its not clarified on listing, host does not live in the second room, other guests stay in the other room. While there was no sketchy people I saw during my 4 day stay near the house, to be on the even safer side, at night def be on the phone with someone because not many street lights but that’s my personal preference. Will def stay again if I ever need to go to New York again! Host is super nice and the welcoming message to get into home/room was super helpful!

We ran into ZERO issues. The listing showed exactly what we got and that was perfect. I’d definitely book here again and suggest it to anyone traveling to the city and looking for a nice, comfortable, stress free stay!!
Awesome place to stay .. clean communicative and well informative , didn’t have stress staying here

honestly for new york this is an excellent price/value payoff. my room was clean and had an air-conditioning unit, the common bathroom seemed to be kept tidy. i didn't really use the kitchen or common areas so i cannot attest to that.  now, it is in the bronx and while i never personally felt unsafe even as a solo traveler, every new yorker i've told the address to seemed very concerned for my safety and well-being. make of that what you will. i took the subway (only a couple blocks away) into manhattan every day and stopped at the market near the station in the evening to buy food and honestly found the area generally pleasant.

Lucy’s place is amazing. It’s spacious and and has everything you need. The location is perfect, a block or two from everything, grocery, drug store, cafe, restaurants etc but on a quiet block. I would definitely recommend staying here.

Extraordinary stay!!! Metro and beach just a stone's throw away... We are French so the hour that separated us from Manhattan by metro didn't scare us 😆and what a joy to return to Veronica's around 4 p.m. and enjoy the almost deserted and supervised beach! Veronica totally deserves her Superhost status, discreet but always available to respond to our requests. If we were to come back to New York, we would choose his apartment again without hesitation!

Okay, when I saw this listing I will admit I was suspicious. BUT when I got there my fears completely disappeared. My stay started off being greeted by Frank. He works the front desk and he really set the tone for my entire stay. He was so kind and accommodating. HE WAS ON IT. I mean he is WORKING that hotel! His energy was so peaceful and truly so genuine. I felt completely taken care of. Next, the room: Be mindful, the room is small. I think if you get the full size room (the one I had) you should definitely stay in there alone. Although small, compared to your typical hotel room, it was PERFECT for me. I was traveling alone and I was completely comfortable. The room and bathroom were SPOTLESS. I checked the mattress and sheets and they were spotless as well! Housekeeping came by everyday to check on my needs. The entire staff was so attentive and diligent so kudos to Shocard for that! Also the location! Transportation and everything I needed were literally one block away.

Very happy with my stay. Upon check-in they upgraded be to one of the two pent house suites. I asked why and the front desk employee said they like to upgrade their Airbnb guests when they can. I was afraid of booking this thinking it could be scam but my stay was better than expected. Carpet could be updated in the suites but really that’s it!

William is super friendly and answers messages quite quickly. But: I think the room is practical and well located for a quick trip where you are just looking for a space to rest.   The reality is that in terms of cleanliness it was not good, there was always food on the kitchen counter or on the oven and this attracted more cockroaches than there already were. To cook, you had to pay attention to everything so that you were not at the mercy of the cockroaches that were both on the counter and in the kitchen sink.  The same with the little dog, he is super calm and friendly but he poops and pees on the bathroom rug that we guests use and it is unpleasant.    The issue of the entrance key is a big problem. The lock in the entrance hall is broken, works poorly and the key does not turn to open. He never explained to me in a practical way how it worked. I always arrived in a hurry, wanting to rest to finish the day and I had to fight with the lock.  The first day I used the shower it broke. Not only did he make me pay for the replacement, but I also had to go buy it, wasting the entire first morning of my stay. I clarify that what broke was not due to my carelessness but because it was in poor condition.

My friends and I enjoyed our week stay t Luisa’s. Check in was super easy and stress free and when we needed her she was just a quick text away.  The area was lively and in walking distance from so many amazing shops and restaurants.

Daniels place was great! Very cute, clean & cozy. 15 minute walk from the train into the city. Only thing I’d say is the neighborhood seems a little sketchy after 9/10PM so I wouldn’t advise walking anywhere late at night. And on a personal note, I’m 6’3” and everything was pretty small and low to the ground so I hit my head like 5 times 😅 Other than that everything was great!!

Booked this trip for a girl’s getaway with some friends. Luisa was very communicative and accommodated all of our needs. I would just warn any female travelers that there was a lot of cat calling within the neighborhood but nothing unsafe just a little uncomfortable. Luisa replies very fast and had a friend named Ben let us in. Ben was also very kind and showed us around the whole property and even gave us some tips. It smelled so clean and the whole place was just so beautiful. There was plenty of room for all 4 of us and the extra bathroom was nice too! Its very close to the metro station and many shops and restaurants. We ended up cooking one of the nights and the kitchen had everything we needed. We had a great time and Luisa was even kind enough to hold our luggage. Would absolutely stay again.
Ella’s place is cozy! The building is a bit sketchy but the apartment is super nice!

This place is a steal of a deal. Robert is a super host, and is very responsive. He was waiting outside the place to get us and even had a special gift for us inside. The place is modern, very spacious and clean. It's just a 7 min walk to the train station too. I highly recommend this Airbnb, you can't go wrong.
Rob was very responsive and clearly cares about the experience people have that stay there. A nice apartment and a well equip kitchen.

Absolute best Airbnb I've stayed in in last 5 years, great location, great apartment, clean with most any amenity you could need, host is super attentive and chill, price was excellent, communication was excellent but above all else, and believe me I cannot stress this enough.....he has Hulu with no ads!  *Mic drop*  Absolute game changer lol  Honestly would definitely stay here again, highly recommended!

He cancelled our 8-day reservation while we were in the plane on the way to NY. Family of 4. Said a window was broken and impossible to find someone to fix it - in New York! Left us with nowhere to stay and offered zero help - told us to look on Airbnb for a place to stay.  Unpleasant, untrustworthy, unsympathetic. One of the most stressful experiences and a terrible way to start a holiday. If this is how he treats guests - stay well away.

Gerwin's apartment was as described/pictured. As many reviewers noted, it is small: 90% of the bedroom space is occupied by the bed. I rated check-in and communication 1 star. Check-in: Check-in requires a meet-up with Gerwin's "associate" upon arrival to the city. Because we landed during rush hour, both of us were way off on our estimations of when we'd arrive in the area. Essentially, my family and I had to wait at a nearby cafe for ~ hour to be let in. A lockbox would be an easy fix for this.  Communication: Gerwin was very responsive and when we notified him of some issues in the apartment, he answered quickly and coordinated to have someone come fix it. However, the dishwasher was broken and needed maintenance from the building super. The super entered the apartment one day without notice or permission. I told Gerwin that I felt this to be unsafe and invasive and he apologized.   Overall, Gerwin's apartment is good value for the # bedrooms and the location. Assuming he does not allow a stranger into the apartment again without permission of the guests, I would recommend his space.

This place was ideal. A quiet, residential street in a securely locked setting. Being alone,  I was not at all afraid to stay there.  It was also very  clean and comfortable.  Silvana went above and beyond the call of duty by answering all my questions and even helping me to call an Uber.  I would not hesitate to stay there again if I am in New York City.

Worst Airbnb experience we've ever had.  Hosts advertised an outdoor space and courtyard/garden views.  Instead built a monstrosity of an outdoor bar that blocked all outdoor light, and informed us the backyard was off limits, despite listing it as open to guest access.  Unit is more than 50% in a basement, with cheap furniture and sparse amenities.  Location is sketchy, and male host is extremely aggressive and rude, and made us feel unsafe.  Stay away!!!!

It was my worst accommodation experience, after several trips around the world. The hosts knew they had an aggressive and violent guest in the house and still accepted new guests. The moment I checked in, one of the hosts told me not to leave the room because one of the guests was violent and crazy. I know that hosts are not to blame for their guests' actions, but they must ensure their safety. in that case, they should have called the police or not accepted new guests.  during my first night, the aggressive guest tried to break down my door and tried to destroy the house. It was a night of pure terror and I only managed to escape in the morning, and I had to flee without my luggage.  I sent messages to the host during the night, communicating what was happening, and only received a response the next morning. and she only called the police to the scene the following night.  Furthermore, the room had cockroaches and a bad smell.  Airbnb's monitoring of the case left a lot to be desired, as they only wanted to give me a partial refund, even though I was the victim of an attack on the first night. It is worth noting that I had a reservation for 30 days.  It was a very traumatic experience, so my review couldn't be any different: I don't recommend everything I report here is documented with evidence.

Neighborhood is a little sketchy.  Decor was very worn and not very nice.  Well stocked kitchen.  Heat did not work on lower level which made it unusable.   About two blocks from Central Park.  Beds were comfortable and clean.

This was a lovely space & had everything I needed for my long-term stay! I stayed at this airbnb for 6 weeks and felt right at home. The kitchen has everything you might need to cook & the common area has a delightfully cozy couch with a lot of plants, making for a very home-y feel. Alexandra was very responsive, too. Laundry in-building was a plus. The building felt very safe and secure, as well as the surrounding neighborhood. I walked home many nights by myself and never felt in danger. The one thing that was really difficult for me was sleeping with the air conditioning/heater on. It is indeed very noisy and fortunately I stayed during a time of year where it wasn’t totally necessary at night, but any other time of the year I’d imagine it would need to be used. The person in the second bedroom was a great flatmate; I never had any issues there. Wonderful location too!

The Good: spacious & characterful, ideal for a large group. Near a subway,  easy access to Mid-Town and beyond. Central Park is a short walk.  Restaurants are within easy reach as well as grocery stores, from a corner shop to Wholefoods. Not so good:  If you like fresh air don’t book this property, all the windows are sealed, and you are asked not to open them.  The staircase is steep, not ideal for the young/old. The lights on the stairs were not working which made it dangerous. We did report this. We had no heating in the front top floor bedroom, also reported but told to press the button on the thermostat harder. It made no difference.   Good luck with the dishwasher, the bottom tray does not come out smoothly hence all the chipped crockery.  If you use the kettle, take it off the gas with a cloth as the handle gets red hot .  Not all the gas rings work.   A house manual would be a good idea. Basic maintenance needed.  Would we book it again?  No, too expensive for what we got!

A DUMP. Unsafe. Mattress fell to floor in middle of the night with an adult and a five year old in it. Shower and bathtub didn't work. Electric cord octopus UNSAFE. Two story uneven stairs risky. A horror show. We left and Air B&B immediately refunded. Think remote India and then lower your standards....air B and B won’t let pictures upload to reviews but I have ample evidence air B and B immediately refunded and gave me a $200 credit  Embarrassing for them a. Nightmare for you
Nothing was accurate about the description. Nothing was luxurious. Dirty. Worn furniture. I feel scammed

The apartment is way different from the picture. Apartment is down bad. I had to leave right after checked in and spent $1500 for 3 nights. It was really dirty, ceiling fans has a lot of stuff on it also bed room ceiling, floor is really sticky no one has mopped or cleaned them. Not only that the neighborhood is dangerous and absolutely NO PARKING!!! What a nightmare for us and now we are bringing host to lawsuits for not refunding
This was a good place. A bit expensive but close to the subways. The surrounding neighbourhood was a bit sketchy.

This was a amazing space for my family and friends who were visiting NY for the first time. It was close by to the places in Manhattan my family wanted to check out. The space worked really well for a group of 8 guests. The kids loved the snacks provided. Niamh was really responsive and also accommodating with luggage drop off before our check in time and after our check out time which made it all less stressful. After we left, one of my guests left something behind and Niamh was kind enough to let me know and set it aside it for me pick up. Would definitely recommend!

We needed a place to stay last minute after another Airbnb canceled last minute and this was  the closest to the location we needed. If you’re just looking for a place to sleep it’s fine, but it is small, and it wasn’t cleaned well. We ran out of toilet paper, and there was something definitely going bad in the fridge. It wasn’t terrible or unsafe, it just wasn’t very nice.

The place feels like (and probably is) an apartment being rented by some college students and turned into a bunch of Airbnb rooms. It’s supplied with the absolute bare minimum - no silverware, two bowls and a plate, barely any cookware. Dirty stove, musty bathroom with random hairs, suspicious stains on comforter and curtain, pillows that are so flat they aren’t really pillows, hard mattress… minimal effort has been put into the space and it’s fine if you just need a place to crash but there are plenty of spaces that are around the same price or less, that are a lot cozier and more livable. There was also some unexpected maintenance on one of the days that included a lot of loud noise and a request to let someone in my room. I recognize that sometimes things happen last minute, but the hosts should be doing whatever they can to make sure there is no one in the house when repairs need to be made.  Overall it seems like a lack of effort from the hosts to give the space any character at all, and that is a shame.

Good place for a short stay, 2 month maximum. The managers are rude and careless. Had a situation during my stay and they couldn’t be bothered, when i asked for camera footage they told me the system was off the air for 3 days, and tried to say that the responsibility to take care of the security system was ours. This whole company feels sketchy. But on the bright side, my neighbors were pretty cool, and the cleaning system works.

The rooms in real life look nothing like in the pictures. I felt like getting scammed. There was no privacy in the room, and the rooms neither the apartment was never locked. The cleaniness wasn't on top; I even found pubic hair on the sheets my first night there. I felt unsafe and unsatisfied during the whole trip. I paid for a whole month but left in a week. When I asked for my money back, the host never replied, neither met me in a common ground. I don't recommend this place at all. Keep your money for a better experience and a good place.

Conforms to the description, but very noisy neighborhood and afraid to venture out at night. You can't turn on the air conditioning at night because of its infernal noise. Wake up often at night by shouts in the neighborhood or music.

The stay was over all average. It's a nice building, but not a place I'd stay again. Seven was not very clear with his check in instructions, (honestly kind of sketchy), as the building does not allow airbnb's. Seven also promised me an air mattress that was never followed through on, along with having another key, which was never dropped off. The facilities of the building are nice, but not included, which is also ridiculous. Over all stay wasn't bad, but  it would definitely not be my first or even second choice  the next time I book.

This apartment does not comply with what was stated in the advertisement, it is a dirty place with very strong and disgusting smells, the internet does not work, and they have problems with electricity, the area is dangerous even to walk to the subway station, the apartment is next to a fire station and there is noise all night, I do not recommend it to anyone who wants to book this place, if your purpose is to enjoy your stay in New York, look for another place.

I will list Pros and Cons of this place.   1. The sew is good lots to do and transportation with in Ealing distance.  2. East to check in and check out. 3. Very clean shared bath and shower.   CONS.  1. The internet “DOES NOT” reach the rooms and they charge you $5 CASH for every day you want to use it. The receptionist know that it doesn’t reach but still sell the code. Very disgusting way of stealing ppl.  2. They charge high rate for cleaning fee but yet they expect the room to be clean after you check out or they will come you $100. The poster in the room ask that when you check out to take the trash out and leave the room clean.  3. They charge for storing luggage $7 CASH per each bag.  4. Bed has has only thin sheet and disgusting cover that had lots of hair in my room and I recommend you bring your own tower or buy one for $10 before you go to this place  their towels dirty.   Other than that it’s ok for the price and they change the prices daily.

Fake listing. They make you book before you can view photos and promise you can cancel risk free. Well, then they’ll tell  Airbnb they don’t want to give you a refund. And Airbnb will not side with you. Scammers.

A few pros and cons about the place.  CONS: • You can hear everything (including when you’re in the hallway), bc the walls are thin and the building itself is a bit older. • One of the windows came off when a gust of wind hit the windows, we managed to place it back on again. • The heater is building regulated so you can’t turn it off or on. You have to just crack open a window, but then it gets too cold. • The instructions to find the room was a bit confusing. The room number in the instructions were incorrect, so it took my husband and I a while to find it. The key to get into the building is also in another building located down the street, so keep that in mind. We also arrived later so we couldn’t get a hold of Maria as we got there at midnight. • There were weird things happening in the building, such as a creepy man who was inhabiting the building (we came across him the night before he was kicked out and he was extremely creepy — just stood in the corner and didn’t help us open the door as we were struggling to open it). The next day a man told us and a fee others that he was being kicked out and “not to worry any longer” (strange).  • The building had postings of “no AirBnB”, so I thought that was weird, since we were staying in one. • The bed wasn’t very comfy, so keep that in mind if you have back and neck issues like myself. The bed is too soft.  PROS: • Fairly clean.  • The sheets and details in the apartment are luxurious. • Spacious room for a studio and for 2 people. • There are pots, pans, plates available for use. • Very close to time square, great restaurants, and walk to many places — you can’t beat the location.  Overall it was a good stay, but I think I would have rather stayed at a hotel in the nearby area for the price and considering we had to pay for parking.

Stayed at Muhammed's place for a weekend trip with friends after another host cancelled our reservation the night before our flight and left us with no place to stay. He was nice enough to host us last minute, LITERALLY I booked this within hours of arrival to the BNB. There were 9 people total in our party, including 3 couples. The house is exactly as advertised and was the perfect size to accommodate everyone and literally only about 25 minutes to downtown area/times square. There are plenty of stores and plenty good food places if you go up one block but be aware for some the area may feel a little sketchy if it isnt something you are used to(keep in mind this is Harlem), but do not be so quick to pre judge it bc at NO TIME did me or anyone in my group feel unsafe in anyway. There were minor issues which is not uncommon with any BNB but the host was outstanding at resolving them quickly which I feel is what matters the most. I appreciate a host that I can always reach directly and they are on top of things and Muhammed was definitely that host. When I called he answered EVERYTIME and when there was a problem he fixed it EVERYTIME in a timely matter! He was even nice enough to let 2 of our guests who had a late flight do a late check out.  He definitely turned what could have been a nightmare into a very good and fun trip for us. Thank you for having us!!

There was a rat inside the room. Totally unacceptable. Bed linens were poor and dirty, the blankets were extremely low quality, we couldn't use them. The kitchen furniture was falling out. The room was very noisy all night long, some guests would run along the corridor in the middle of the night and others kept screaming violently. Pretty scary. Wifi was not included in the room rate which was way too high for this horrific place. Our stay was a nightmare. Never ever again.

I had a bad experience with the shared bathroom. It felt pretty scary.  The light was sound-sensitive. It would turn off soon after I started showering, and it would not turn back on even if I made loud noises in the showering cell...... I had to either finish showering in the dark, bring my phone to use as a torch, or step into the center of the bathroom to turn on the sound-sensitive light in the middle of showering...... while anyone could come into the bathroom anytime from the hallway.

Clinton and Monica’s place was exactly what I was looking for. It’s what you can expect from a typical New York apartment, snug and a little wonky, but it was a great deal for what you pay for. The floors were creaky and the shower temp was a little tricky to control, but I had no complaints. The area was surprisingly quiet and I didn’t really hear the neighbors at all. I loved that the neighborhood was close to everything-subway station, cvs, frozen yogurt shop, and a ton of good restaurants. It was also really active and always people out which never made me feel unsafe. Thank you to the hosts for being so accommodating!!

This spot is awesome. It's in a quiet neighborhood, the apartment itself has lots of space and character, is well decorated and cozy, and has everything one would need and more for a comfortable stay. Nigel greeted us when we arrived and was very warm and welcoming. He and Michelle went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of and to make our stay enjoyable and stress-free. Parking wasn't too hard to find, the locks were new and easy to use, and the communication was fast. My friends and I really loved this spot and would definitely stay again. Highly recommend!

Summary: Nice apartment in a just ok area, but beware this is a big risk staying here  Pros: Apartment was clean, with nice furniture and big TVs. You can find street parking if you're strategic about it. Value would have been solid if not for all of the issues we dealt with over the stay.  Cons: HVAC system was broken and Alex didn't fix it the entire month we were there, even though it was the middle of winter and freezing out. He claimed that he couldn't get anyone in time but I'm pretty sure he just didn't want to pay extra to get it faster. Even after the repair people showed up to see what was wrong, they spoke to him on the phone and then told me he was going to have it fixed later. There also said it was leaking freon and couldn't guarantee that it was even safe. Instead of dealing with this serious issue quickly, Alex just sent us two small space heaters after a few days of it being 50-60 degrees, and he asked us to keep the boxes for so he could return them after. The space heaters made it livable but it still often ended up really cold at times and was a huge pain to deal with. Alex didn't really seem to care and when we asked for some discount on the rate because of this he offered a 3% discount which was insulting.   For the last few nights of the stay we also lost hot water and then the water started coming out brown from the sink, which was gross. We left early at that point and stayed at a friend's place so we could at least shower. Again, Alex didn't want to do anything to help and didn't seem sympathetic at all.  Finally, the area is ok, but can also get sketchy at night going onto Fulton, especially as you go east.

Amanis place looked just as described in the photos. She was a very responsive when I had issues getting in the apartment. Me and my mum stayed here for 3 nights .The place is very clean, but with that said there are roaches in the building that have found they're way into her apartment. We kept seeing small and medium sized roaches mainly around the bathroom, shower, and kitchen sink areas. We were paranoid about attracting them so we put our snacks and all food in the fridge. We slept with the light on because anytime we shut it off we would see them scurrying around. I deep cleaned all my belongings when I got home cause I was scared to bring them back home with me. I let Amani know of what was going on she said  she had a new neighbor bring them when they moved in but they had the building fumigated twice so she thought they were gone. She did offer to bring us raid and breakfast our last day which we had to decline due to plans. It's a nice place just need to be rid of the roaches

The price is reasonable and there is no serious problem. And there is a metro station nearby. But there are a few weaknesses, too. First, the neighborhood is messy and a little dangerous, this house is not clean too. And there is only one restroom. you have to remember it.

Check in was super stressful. They tell you about a city tax that you must pay up front but don't mention it is CASH ONLY. Also they won't give you the key before paying the fee so it was a struggle. While there is an ATM in the lobby (with a $4 fee btw) who carries around their debit card!?!  Also, they charge $5 a day for wifi (in cash) and that wasn't mentioned anywhere. This place is a total cashgrab just trying to get as much money out of tourists as possible. You're better off in a hotel where you'd be treated much better as a guest.  The showers are dorm style, but with zero storage for anything, it is just a stall like any other toilet stalls. Which means unless you travel with a shower caddy, you're putting soap and everything on the floor and risking getting clothes all wet.  Location was very good though. Would have been a good value find if there was an easier check-in process and free wifi (as is common expectation now).

Buyer beware with this place and host.  I’ve stayed in 20+ different AirBNB’s over the last couple of years and this was easily the worst one.  The bedsheets had cigarette burns in them.  The floor in the room was dirty.  The host was rude and tried to scam me for more money.  She stated that I left the room “…in a disastrous” condition and attempted to have AirBNB charge me for that.  This was a completely inaccurate accusation (I left the room in great condition) and I called AirBNB and they agreed with me and did not charge me anything.    The community bathroom was always dirty and had ZERO paper towels or any way to dry your hands after washing.  There were ZERO hangers in the bathroom to put your towel or things up while showering.  The shower drain was clogged and the shower filled up with 3 inches of water as I showered.    Looking at prior reviews for this unit and Eliza’s replies to them, I am confident that she will post a rebuttal below that is not factual.  Buyer beware!

The guys in charge of check-in were very nice and helpful, and the location is simply excellent. Very close to the subway and to great restaurants. The apartment provided bathroom items like shampoo and toothpaste & there was coffee and a coffee maker, toaster, utensils and plates/cups, full size fridge and a small stove.   There were some technical things that needed to be ironed out as this is a new rental space. Small things which forced us to have to keep communicating with the host. Also, check in and check out was a little stressful bc the address listed in Airbnb is not correct.  And, the other tenants in the building were surprised that we were renting there. Multiple people asked who we were which was a little uncomfortable - probably bc it’s such a nice neighborhood and maybe they’re protective? But, the apartment was beautiful and, again, great location. I’d recommend it even though there were minor inconveniences.

everything was great, AC work perfect, shower, the toillete, warm water, everything is great. very clean, very close to train station,  the floor in fact is 3 not 4(for europeans - the americans don't have ground floor), all you need is around, 2 supermarket, Coffee shops, laundry,  restaurants, the room are very quiet, the neighborhood îs very safety, come back by walk at midnight with my from queensboro and don't feel scared. the host answered very prompt at a minor doorlock problem, was solved in less than 5 minute - thank you Vicky for everything. i am romanian and if some romanian wants more details text me at okinciuc@gmail.com!

Lola seems like a great host and was very accommodating. Unfortunately, we found out that the area that the Airbnb was located was among the worst in NYC for crime rates and was very rundown, a common area for tourists to be targeted. This was sugar coated in the listing and gave us a false sense of security until just before check in, when we opted to book elsewhere after researching more.

My son was going to new york by himself, and i was a little bit scared because that’s my baby regardless of how old he is. booking a place to stay in new york was a little intimidating at first with all the places and all the things to look at as well as the reviews. However with the quick communication that Lola provided to me and my son and the attention to detail that she gave to us, i felt a lot more comfortable and relieved to let him stay there. My son arrived and found a very amazing place that looks even better than it does in the pictures. The place is extremely nice and very clean and our host Lola added in some complimentary things on the side that made everything all the better. Staying in this place was like staying in a second home, checking in was extremely simple and my son had tons of fun staying there. He says that the neighborhood was very quiet and was really nice to stay around because of all the places. it was so quiet my son actually said something along the lines of “sounds like the suburbs”. the place was also very safe and honestly just an amazing place to stay. Lola has done such an amazing job utilizing the space and it makes the place feel huge and yet still cozy. perfect for couples or singles, will definitely visit again.

Had a great stay at Kate apartment. If you are looking for a place which is central than take this one. Everything in the apartment was as described. We lived together with the cat called  princess. Although I am scared of cats, I did not have any problems with princess. She is very calm and you even do not recognize that there is a cat. Thanks a lot Kate.
The place is very quiet and cozy. But my stay would have been very good if the other guest hadn't smoked drugs or made so many annoying noises throughout the night.

Simple checking via lock box, clean location, and quiet. I can't stress enough how those three things can be hard to find. That was not the case this this cottage. Checking in via lock box made things convenient to my busy schedule. The cottage looks just as it appears in the photos. The cottage was clean as a whistle and well maintained. I had no trouble finding the location or parking my car on the street. The neighborhood was quiet and located next to some shops to help keep you from having to drive around or use mass transit. I loved everything about the cottage and the location. I definitely would stay again when I come back to NYC in the future!

Staying at Win's place for a weekend was efficient. The walk from the place to the train station isn't bad during the day, but at night can be scary. Place was clean and was nice inside, offers breakfast in the morning. The walls seemed extremely thin and you could hear every noise possible in the complex. Trouble falling asleep with bed being extremely hard and pillows were not good.

The flat was lovely and cosy and clean. Had everything we needed and the little guidance notes around the flat were a lovely touch.  Never felt unsafe in the area and only a little walk to main subway Station that takes you straight to many of the key attraction locations.  Queries were always answered very promptly and positively. Linda was fantastic.

The accommodation corresponds exactly to the photos and the description. Linda is a super nice host, she answers every question very quickly and was very hospitable. She has also equipped the apartment with many practical things (bathroom utensils such as toothpaste, shampoo, etc.; drinks). The connection is ok for New York, it takes about 8-10 minutes to get to the train station and from there you can get to NYC in about 15-30 minutes, depending on where you want to go. For us it was pleasant not to live in the city center because it is much quieter. The WiFi is super fast and there is a TV in every bedroom and living room.  The area is ok, but unfortunately we didn't feel 100% safe in the area. As a couple it was ok but I wouldn't recommend it just for girls: if you go towards Marcus Garvey Blvd the people are unfortunately a bit unpleasant (e.g. Kennedy Fried Chicken, Associated Supermarkets), but if you go towards Throop Ave (where you walk to the train) it's completely ok!

Very friendly host that even offered a ride to the airport after checkout. Consists of 4 rooms with code lock for each room. So you share a bathroom and kitchen with others. Win often came by to clean the bathroom and (of course) after someone checked out. The bed is a bit more narrow so for 2 big male adults it might be a bit tight. The location is only 15 minutes from metro, however the neighbourhood felt a bit sketchy to us so we took a lyft from the station home every night. Within 40 minutes you are basically anywhere in NYC and it was one of the cheapest options we could find. Price quality is in that regard perfect. The front door has code lock so coming later than check in time is not a problem.

My group booked both of Linda's apartments - Oasis and Oasis 2 - for 5 nights in Sep. We were very happy overall with both places, which are very similar in design and directly below each other. They're good value for money. Both have one full bedroom with a large queen bed and a smaller bedroom with a single bed. The kitchens are small but fully equipped - we cooked a few breakfasts here and it was easily managed with the pots and pans and utensils provided. Each unit has one bathroom, which is spacious and fully functional. The apartments give one a good feel for the Bed-Stuy neighborhood in Brooklyn. Plenty of good bars, restaurants, and grocery stores near by, including one newish convenience store right on the corner. The Subway is a 10-13 min walk and we used that to get into and back from from Manhattan daily. Lots of people on the street during the day and evenings too, so it felt safe and we walked back from the Subway most nights between 7-9 pm without feeling unsafe (I'm from Oakland and wouldn't do this in my neighborhood there). On the whole, I'd highly recommend both apartments and especially for anyone visiting NYC on a budget.

This location was wonderful. Hosts were gracious and even provided complementary snacks. But be mindful of somethings. The bed is a queen size so you will have plenty of room. Room itself was honestly really nice and spacious.  When we planned on staying in this location, we saw it was behind the host’s house. At first, we were somewhat scared of privacy, but the room offered us our own space and was extremely private. Now, some small negatives. The shower is small. Like small small, but still usable. The bathroom is also cramped, so be careful or you’ll knock things over. Not to mention a weird mildew smell coming from it, but once the door is shut, you’ll be fine. If you’re staying here and planning on going to Time Square and around, this is pretty out of the way. Using the bus plus train, if you don’t want to do express bus, is about an hour and a half. Even express bus is about 45 minutes. Other than that, we really enjoyed our stay.

Andom is a phenomenal host! He always made sure we had what we needed. He was always available if I needed something fixed. He made the stay very enjoyable in such a stressful time! I recommend his place whole heartedly. He is great!

Alena’s place was spotless which is the most important thing for me. I used to live in NYC so I appreciate the location—close to all trains, drug stores, little markets. Also, Alena is there to check you in and explain all the little details of the apartment. She cares about you being happy. I will stay there again for sure.

Heather's place is exactly as advertised and then some. She and her husband are very hospitable, friendly, and responsive. The house is quiet and comfortable and your room is an oasis in an otherwise loud, crowded, and gritty city. The place is a short walk to and from the J and Z trains which connect conveniently at Broadway Junction to Manhattan and beyond (I think there's even a connection to the Long Island Railroad at B'way Jct). I walked around quite a bit at all times of the day and night and never once felt unsafe. It's an ethnic neighborhood with interesting foods, a classic diner not too far away, and groceries nearby. The kitchen space is very convenient and the complimentary cereal milk oftentimes hits the spot. Be sure to read Heather's listing fully — she has dogs. If you're a dog lover, you'll appreciate coming home to welcoming sniffs and tail wags every day in Cypress Hills. I would definitely recommend this place and I hope to stay there again if my travels bring me to Brooklyn again.
Nice little place— private and the snacks were appreciated after a stressful day teaching

I’ve stayed a few times and it’s a really nice place during spring- fall. I just stayed a few days in December and it was freezing. There is a space heater but it’s unsafe to leave on all the time including overnight.  I got by because I brought lots of heavy blankets from home but people flying in won’t necessarily have that option: it’s a great place to stay most of the time but I’m worried about my stay coming up in January now that I’ve felt how cold it is when it’s only 40 outside, and it will be even colder soon.  Love the place just not sure what to do since I can’t be in the room 24/7 to run the heater and I’m worried about my dog when I have to go to work

The Neighborhood: The house is in the Latin neighborhood in Brooklyn, it looks dangerous and all the people we have told who stayed there all confirm that it is indeed dangerous. So it is better that they arrive during the day. There are many corners that smell of marijuana. People on the street are not friendly when you ask them something. The house: it has many things accumulated in the patio and in the living room. The stair carpet is full of cat and dog hair and the house has a very strong dog smell. From what the host told us, there are 5 cats and 3 dogs in the house. So if you are allergic, you better be careful. The house is old, a 115-year-old wooden house according to the hosts, the floors make a sound when you walk, especially when you climb the stairs. When we arrived, the house smelled of cigarettes but Heather told us that smoking was not allowed, which confused us a little because it contradicted herself.
