She also received us with the smell of alcohol. Actually that day we were thinking about going anywhere but there, but we decided to stay as we had no other option, since everything is expensive in New York and we also didn't know the city. The room: It is spacious, as seen in the photos, but there were 2 single beds and a sofa, it has a key to close and it is very bright. We were a little cold and Heather lent us some quilts, that was nice. The bathroom: very spacious, with hot water, 2 showers that can be used simultaneously and was clean. The kitchen: we don't use it much but it is enough. There is a refrigerator, kitchen, table, etc. There was cereal and orange juice for our breakfast. What happened to us: When we arrived, Heather told us not to eat in the room, that we should use the kitchen for that. One night my husband and I woke up to the sound of a rodent. When we realized it, the mouse was inside my suitcase eating a chocolate (unopened) that I bought as a gift. The mouse jumped out of the suitcase and ran across the floor, I tried to hit it with a shoe (it was a spontaneous reaction when seeing the mouse), I didn't hit it and the mouse went under the sofa. My husband lifted the sofa to get it out of there and the sofa fell with a hard hit to the floor. In 10 seconds a man (Heather's husband) arrived knocking very loudly on the door, we opened it and he started yelling at us: Are we going to have problems? Are we going to have problems? We were scared and told him: sorry, but we have a mouse in the room! To which he responded by shouting: It's because they are eating in the room!!! We calmly told him no. And he repeated that we were eating in the room. Then he went and brought some suet, a mouse trap and put it in the slot in the wall and told us that...

Nancy is an amazing host! This place is outstanding and in such a prime location. Being a nurse during this time was scary but Nancy was able to help settle any fears I had and provided me with a safe place to stay during this time! I couldn’t have asked for a better spot or host. I never want to leave!

Marlon and OG are friendly and bubbly hosts, who gave us a very warm welcome, then showed us the surrounding area on the day we arrived. How nice 👍   However, there are a few things regarding to the room that I would like to share: 1. The room is so hot in summer regardless day or night, a small fan can't help sadly. 2. We had to leave the window open and as a result, we got bitten by mosquito, it was quite unpleasant feeling. 3. The room wasn't the one I saw in the photo. This really isn't a big problem but I was a bit disappointed when I didn't see what I expected to.  Just a few constructive feedbacks for you to take note.

Marlon is the best host I encountered by far. Whenever you need something just call or text him. He'll do anything within his power to help you out and make your stay comfortable. Our AC was broke the first night. Upon sending a text (don't be shy) to Marlon, it was fixed immediately. World class mentality! I've gone through some reviews which talk about the neighbourhood being unsafe and I would like to say something about that. As a guy with a master's degree in Safety Science, I found the neighbourhood safe. This all comes down to perception. Marlon wanted to show me around and we had a 1 hour walk around midnight. We had no problems at all. If you ask me, it's just a matter of having an open mentality. Really enjoyable stay.

One of the best Airbnbs I've had been so far! I chose Modesta's accommodation as a single traveller because all the reviews convinced me and now I can write also a good one to confirm them! The flat is very nice and everything is SUPER clean, there is everything you need and the bed and bed linen provided the promised comfort. Modesta herself was super nice, the check in and out was totally stress-free and you were asked if you needed anything, but otherwise had the one corner of the flat completely to yourself. The way downtown to Manhattan is easy to reach by metro and in the evening/at night I used an Uber that could use the fast street in the west of Manhattan. Definitely a great stay and if I'm ever there again, I'll choose Modesta's accommodation again! :)

I felt like I was in a hotel! If you have any questions, you can rent without fear! Perfect place!!! Very spacious room. The bed then? It goes without saying, how delicious!!! I really want to return!

This place is so cute and worth staying! Biggest negative was this insanely large biker gang that would drive past on weekdays for about 30 minutes. It was actually so crazy but kind of hilarious.  There’s no storage for your clothes, but the place is filled with amenities in the kitchen and bathroom!  Comfortable bed and clean space. The area is a little sketchy to walk to the subway if you’re alone.

Great location, beautiful Airbnb! Don’t expect any wifi other than maybe the hotspot from your phone here though. Had issues with the bodega handing over the keys that were left there for me but after dealing with that, the unit is lovely! Loud neighbors though so don’t be afraid to bang the wall to get them to quiet down.

We really enjoyed our stay at Jen & Paul’s place. They made the room feel very homely and comfortable, and we loved all the thoughtful touches such as the snacks and the fan. The bathroom was always very clean and communication with bathroom schedules was also very good.   We would definitely recommend staying here if visiting New York City, the subway is just around the corner so it’s easy to get to the sights etc. Although we didn’t get to meet Jen and only saw Paul briefly, they were very good at communicating throughout our stay which was really helpful and made for a stress free trip.

The apartment is as represented in image. However the apartment was adequately prepared for occupation. It was very uncomfortable having to live out of my suitcase for 3 weeks, all of the closet space in the apartment was occupied. The only alternative was having someone enter the space after my stay had already began, which was not ideal. The check in was also a very stressful experience for me, having been provided with incorrect check in details before my arrival. I was traveling internationally and did not have access to the internet, which made communication difficult. The door access is via an app on your phone, which is precarious because if anything happens to your phone you will be locked out of the apartment with no way of communicating.

We spent 6 nights with Joseph. When we arrived, his mother was there to do the check-in.  The room is upstairs and there is NO door.  The first night was very uncomfortable. There was noise until 2am. (TV, Facetime etc). It was impossible to sleep.  The day after we wrote to Joseph about the noise. But apparently no one made any noise. They said it was the neighbors, but we are sure it came from our apartment.  On the second evening we came home at 9 p.m. There was loud music and there were people visiting. It was a “party”. An hour later there was still noise. We went downstairs and told Joseph’s mother that we were going to a hotel that night because of the noise. We said we couldn't enjoy our stay because we were very tired during the day.  His mother didn't say much about it and didn't try to get us to stay there. The music stayed on too. We went to the hotel. ($90 for one night) The following nights were better, but since there was no door, the room smelled like food and we had to fall asleep.  It was also very cold in the room, as if a window was constantly open. Very uncomfortable because it was already very cold outside and you longed for warmth.  We didn't see Joseph until the second to last day. We said we wanted the money back for the night in the hotel. He said it's no problem. He transferred the money to us immediately, but only €40.  He also gave us tips that day.  But it's a shame we didn't see him until late. We think the stay could have been a lot better if he had been there from the start. (he had to work) The room has 2 balconies with a very nice view.  In general we think the Airbnb was too expensive for what we got. We had hoped for more.

Uly is an amazing host.  She had everything from a welcoming sign with my name (so I know would know where the bedroom was lol), travel bathroom accessories in case I forgot anything, and a convienient digital key pickup box.  The place is large and spacious, especially for nyc, very clean and located in a nice classy neighborhood and safe part of manhattan.  The tv in the bedroom has an embedded roku, so it has netflix etc and you can pair your phone to it too for streaming.  Uly is very sweet, intelligent, kind and offered coffee and breakfast in the morning.  I can't stress enough how welcomed Uly (and her cat!) make you feel at home.  Prob my fav airbnb so far, highly recommend.  I have already saved this and hope to stay again here for future trips to the city!
very nice place close to public transit, a steal for its price, highly recommended
The accommodation is just as seen in the photos. But the neighborhood is not quiet, rather it makes you feel insecure, Jade is a good host but the apartment is not worth what she asks for

Great location, close to metro. Clean, and comfortable room. Lot of space. Safe, even around midnight by metro and on foot. I was a bit afraid that it is in Bronx, but it was completely safe. Great wifi connection (could watch HD netflix). Could experience new york easily.

Daniel is extremely accomodating. Check in isn't typically until 11 am, however we contacted him and asked since our flight got in at 6 am if we could drop our bags off at his place. He very quickly agreed.  Not only was he very accomodating and quick to respond, but he also had tips of places to go in Queens to see a beautiful view of Manhattan. Everything was kept tidy and nice. Not once while I stayed at Daniel's did I feel unsafe. I would definitely stay here again!

A place very close to two metro stations on different lines, which allowed excellent transportation, the house was always heated inside due to the cold, the water could be regulated without problems, the refrigerator maintained the condition of the food we bought very well, the bedroom was large and the bed was very comfortable, a view towards the storage patio was very beautiful and very bright, we did not have any security or theft problems, our things were left in the living room the last day and absolutely nothing happened to them. The instructions that Adeyemi gives are clear and precise, impossible to get lost. Adeyemi has been one of the best hosts we have ever met.

Better off staying at a YMCA or in a train station!!  Horrible experience!! Filthy place, 2 bedrooms, 10 people!! Covid-19 VIOLATION and Airbnb did NOTHING!!  Terrible drug infested neighborhood. My husband and I fled within 1 hour of arrival and I was forced to stay in a hotel!! By far my WORST experience dealing with Airbnb NEVER AGAIN!! AVOID AT ALL COST!!

This place is just a few minutes from the C and J trains which is a huge plus. The neighborhood is a little rough on the edges but I did not feel unsafe at all. There are a few bars and coffee shops nearby, as well as a few grocers/delis (don’t underestimate the food prepared there!). The apartment itself is very sparsely decorated but it is very pretty and very clean. The bed was comfortable, the AC was at a good temperature; also, if anyone intends to use the kitchen, it has a lot of the basic utensils you may need.  The host was very quick to respond to questions which I appreciated greatly. I recommend this place! And I would stay here again in a heartbeat.
The place is nice and cozy, but very far from Manhattan, at night the neighborhood feels a little dangerous

Our stay at Adeyemis apartment was overall nice :) Within this apartment are 3 rooms, therefore you will have 2-4 other guests living with you. This room is quite a bit smaller than the others that even have a small desk with a TV, so keep that in mind while deciding between the different rooms. In general the appartment is quite squeaky and thin walled, so light sleepers should probabaly bring earplugs. Another remark is the small selection of dishes. We even had to buy two bowls for breakfast (we left them there, so don't worry about that haha). The bathroom was a little dirty and more frequent cleaning would have been appreciated in general. The neighborhood seems a little sketchy at night but we were never approached by anyone, though I wouldn't walk around at night with no proper goal. Conveniently, the appartment is located right next to the J train that will take you to Manhattan in about 25 minutes. Check in and check out went smoothly and Adeyemi was very friendly.
The neighborhood seemed a bit sketchy at first but it was fine. Close to the train station. Toufik is really nice. Local shops to eat. Good value.
Great location, great steal for the price. Adequate bedroom, cute and clean, but the bathroom was tiny. That's just williamsburg. Worth it for the central location.

Inna's place is very beautiful and feels like a home. The room is very light and open, the bed is super comfortable. The neighbourhood is very safe at any time of day or night, I never felt insecure or unsafe. There is a subway station for the Q train just two blocks down on 72nd that gets you to Manhattan super quickly. The kitchen is very well equipped and the fridge holds a generous amount of food. All in all, it was simply lovely, I would highly recommend it!

I had a great time at this place. The self check-in process was extremely easy with well-written instructions, and made it comfortable for my friend and I to enter the residence at our convenience. our room was spotless, and the bed was comfortable. The whole place is very clean, but keep in mind that there are other guests that might be staying in the same unit as well. In my case, the guests were really messy and the kitchen had unwashed dishes and dirty counters. The bathrooms were similar where the guests didn’t really clean up after themselves but this is not the host’s issue. Regardless this place is such a steal for the price. We booked last minute for a night out in the city and I’m so glad to have found this place. Thank you for a relaxing stay!

The place is exactly as advertised. It’s a great location near the subway.  The apartment is very quiet.   Other than one of the blinds not closing (there was a shade which did the trick), no issues with the apartment.  Inna and Di were quick to respond.  I would definitely stay again. Great hostesses. Thanks for everything.

Very kind and discreet host, we had an excellent stay with her.  Public transport (bus and metro) is only a few minutes' walk away, which is really pleasant.  We don't feel unsafe in the neighborhood but I don't think I'll venture there very late (being a young woman).

I stayed at David's for a month. We experience. David was very responsive to texts and any needs to make my experience the best. He replaced the door knob (without me asking) because he had noticed that I had trouble closing my door fully. He even asked for an opera ticket for me when he learned that I didn't have anything to do on my day off. Very clean and respectful person. He loves to share and has a warm heart. Can't say enough good things about David in this review. Definitely recommend his place and will stay at his place again if I'm back to NYC. Of note, it is an easy 7 min walk to the 4 train, 12 min to the D train. The closest bus stop is at Kingsbridge and University which is about 5 min away. Grocery and school/college nearby. Safe neighborhood (never felt unsafe for the entire month I was there).

Starting with the neighborhood, which is the most picturesque, the area around David's house is super quiet. I didn't stop walking around the streets, but getting to that haven of peace that is his house and lying down in that wonderful bed to rest, read and watch TV for a little while was glory for me. The room is as it appears. Bright, very clean, very comfortable bed, quiet (city noises but very little). You have your big TV, your dining table, your work table. It doesn't lack detail. It's genuine. Everything very clean. David, super respectful of your times and your moments of rest. Impeccable bathroom and kitchen too. The neighborhood is picturesque, for me what I write is really interesting because of the characters who live there. Zero dangerous, I have moved alone without problems. Subway 5-10 minutes away that takes you to Manhattan. Two huge supermarkets next to the subway and several places to have a good coffee with your bagel for breakfast. Also the Brothers pizzeria (they are wonderful and the pizzas are huge and delicious). With a little luck you'll even meet George, the Greek who sells coffee from his van on 195 and has a fantastic conversation. I hope to return soon. Thanks David, good luck with your events!

This was our second time staying with Lena in Chelsea.  Lena is a true gem, and she has made both of our trips to NYC outstanding.  All amenities are thought of - snacks and water available upon arrival, a great shower, washer/dryer so we don’t have to pack as much for our trip, fresh flowers, exceptionally comfortable bed.  Location cannot be beat - we love Chelsea! Super close to the high line, all night drug stores and markets, restaurants, and subway stop only 2 blocks away.  Lena really went far and above what would be expected this trip and was SO appreciated.  We plan to return again and will stay with Lena next time!

Adorable apartment. Loved every bit of it and Ayinde was amazing. She checked in with me a few times to make sure everything was ok and if ever I did have a question she replied almost instantly. Apartment is located only 2.5 blocks away from the subway which was very convenient. Only issue was that the area in which the apartment was in was a little sketchy. We walked to the train station during the day but at night we caught Uber or Lyft from the train station because it just didn't seem safe to walk. I would stay here again though, for sure!

Very comfortable stay. Hosts greet you on your day of arrival and give you a tour. You will be given a binder guide of New York so you get a good idea of where you are and the different areas you can visit. I was not able to find a closet but next to the bed are a couple of hangers for your immediate clothing selections. The house has a screen and projector and a backyard that will melt your stress away. Lighting can be adjusted to your desire and Uber orders range between 25 to 60min of ETA. Our stay was amazing and can’t wait to repeat it.

Ivanna was easy to communicate with from the beginning. The dog was not mentioned on the listing, but besides being a bit scared of people/ the occasional barking, we did not have issues with that. The set up of the apartment was a bit strange in that we had to open their apartment door to use the bathroom at night, as our room was separate from the rest of the apartment, which inevitably disturbed the host. Overall, the room was suitable and the experience was smooth.

The location is pretty decent and easy to get to Manhattan where everything is, it just feels a little sketchy at night at first. We felt communication could’ve been a little better as we ended up standing outside for 20 minutes at check in because the housekeeper forgot to put the keys back and we couldn’t get ahold of the host until we called Airbnb support. The apartment itself was nice, but you are sharing one bathroom between up to 6 people (There are 3 different rooms). That got a little frustrating because some wouldn’t clean up after themselves and it was frustrating in the mornings and night waiting for the bathroom. We ended up being able to talk with one couple a little bit the first night which made us feel more comfortable with the stay. Walls are thin and the beds are loud. Every time we sat down on the bed or rolled over in our sleep the whole apartment could probably hear it and vise versa. It definitely wasn’t bad for the price, but there are some things I feel could make it a lot better.
Joy was a unique host; she was kind, helpful, knowledgeable, and available to help make the stay of my Aunt easy and stress free. She is really an amazing host.

Kate is one of the best Airbnb hosts I've ever had. The room is very spacious by New York City standards and has everything you could ever dream of. The apartment lacks a living room but the size of your room makes up for it. The neighborhood is quiet and very residential. Supermarkets, restaurants, banks, etc are one block away at 18th Ave. The only downside of this place is the distance from Manhattan. It takes 40-45 minutes to get to the city by train. At nights, this is even worse. However, the neighborhood is very safe at nights and you don't feel scared at all. I would recommend Kate and her place to everyone!

Kate & Max's home is lovely! I was looking for a room for a few weeks to transition my boyfriend and myself to the city, as we were making a move from Boston. This apartment was perfect for us. The room is incredibly private, so it really feels like you have your own apartment within the space. I was expecting a super long commute to Manhattan, but it was surprisingly easy - it only took me about 40 mins to get to Union Square. Our room was spotless, and Kate's personal touches were much appreciated. An added bonus was the elliptical in the space - I was stressed about finding a temporary gym, and this totally eliminated that stress! Bensonhurst is quiet, not much nightlife, which I appreciated.

I had an absolutely wonderful stay at this place. I was there for a few months and can confidently say that it was well worth the price.  The room has everything you need: plenty of space, nice bed, sofa, desk, AC/fan, power bar, towels, shampoo and soap, and a coat rack with hangers. It also has big windows that let plenty of natural light in. Even though I didn't use it much, it was nice to have access to the kitchen and the fridge. There were also laundry machines in the building (only accepted cards).  The host, Kate, was always available to respond to questions through the app, and she was also willing to provide things like an iron when requested. The check-in and check-out were quick and easy as well; Kate was very flexible about timing.  The highlight of this home is the neighborhood, Bensonhurst, which is both charming and convenient. There were lots of families in the area and I never felt unsafe. The main street right next to the apartment has loads of restaurants and grocery stores, as well as quick (8min walk) access to the N train. I was even lucky enough to see the annual Feast of Santa Rosalia street fair, which takes place there on the last eleven days of August. Not to be missed if you're in the area!  I have virtually no complaints about this home. Just note that the building has no elevator, so be prepared to climb two flights of stairs with your bags. If you're looking for a place to stay in Brooklyn, I would highly recommend Kate's place.

I can’t say enough about Joy’s place. It was exactly what we needed during a stressful week. It was our heaven and place of rest. Joy is a great communicator and her photos are on point. Her house is very charming and looks exactly like the photos. I’m “Mr. Security”, as my wife calls me, and I felt very safe any hour we may have come back to the house. It’s perfectly located and very close to Midwood HS, PS 152 and Brooklyn College. It’s also close to the transportation hub of the area the Brooklyn Junction (Flatbush Ave and Nostrand Ave) where you can catch a train to NYC or a bus to other areas in the borough. Anyway, I would highly recommend this place. You will not be disappointed.

Very nice small room. It is close to Central park and subway station (sadly only number 6 stops there, so you need to be careful about which green number you take). Fast food and nice coffee place just one minute away from the building. Its just opposite to police station, so the street itself is calm, but the streets around could be a bit "scary" later at night (still we have never felt unsafe). Communication with our host was always very fast, no problems with the arrival, he let us leave our bags after checking out.

Thanks to Domingo for his welcome!   I had some problems when arriving at the airport causing me to arrive 4 hours after the indicated time. Domingo was welcoming and knew how to give me basic information. In addition, he is discreet, respectful and it was a pleasure to share this accommodation!   The apartment is very clean, well located (2 minutes from the metro on foot, it's a luxury), distributed by line 6 which allowed me to visit New York in the best possible way. It is located in a fairly quiet area, just opposite a police station. I didn't feel unsafe, even late in the evening!   The bed was very comfortable, the room has storage… it feels like home.   However, it is necessary to take into account the surrounding noise outside which is part of the beauty of the city but which can prevent sleep for those less accustomed to it.   Thanks Domingo, Jolly! You made my stay in New York more beautiful than I imagined.

This was my first time booking with Airbnb. Prior to booking the host was very polite and compliant. I asked the host the process of the check in because I was new to it. She disregarded my questions and asked my approximate arrival time. It was given to her and she said I'll see you then. Upon my arrival I was texting the host because I was running late, it was then that I was informed that her girlfriend would be meeting me at the apartment. I had to ask the hosts girlfriend to show me the place and which apartment because she was just handing me the keys and walking off. After I requested to be shown the apartment, the host girlfriend told me there was a set of spare keys accessible in case I got locked out. Which in fact wasn't accessible because before the check out time I got locked out removing my things from the apartment due to the slam lock that I wasn't aware of. As for the apartment it's self, I requested to see pictures of the space but some how couldn't receive them through the airbnb app, email, nor text. There was no window shades nor curtains in the window, it was the last floor so people outside had a clear view inside the apartment. I had to kill multiple water bugs, I had to clean the kitchen before I settled in to make cook dinner for myself and guest to celebrate my birthday. I should have thought something was odd when I noticed there was no reviews and the host have been with Airbnb for quite some time, but I was optimistic about it. In the end the host and girlfriend was very disrespectful and unpleasant.

This is first time to airbnb for myself so I was little afraid. Because of size of room, bathroom, wifi and ect. But I really am satisfied everything like host’s kindness, room and bathroom was clean, wifi was working good , close to the subwaystaion and cozy room. I loved staying this place

Michele's location is a great Brooklyn location; we never felt unsafe.  The check in was simple and smooth.  The apartment is beautifully renovated and was very clean.  We had everything that we needed.  Michele had great communication yet gave us our privacy; we felt like we were in our own private apartment.  The kitchen had everything that you would need.  The bed was comfortable and the temperature of the apartment was perfect (We were there in November when it was 20°F outside!) The free street parking was manageable; we never had to park more than 1 block from the apartment.

Piya's place was conveniently located in Brooklyn allowing me to explore everything Brooklyn had to offer. It's close to public transport but I would avoid walking in this area alone late in the night as it is a little shady. But all in all had a good stay and check in, check out and communication with Piya was easy.

Piya’s loft is PERFECT for someone who wants to experience Brooklyn as a local would.  The space is funky-charming, but is very comfortable and we were there during a typical hot and humid August. The  neighborhood, Bushwick, is very cool - not yet gentrified but nicely kept and neither my wife nor I felt a bit unsafe. Within walking distance of numerous restaurants and bars and less than a block from a subway station if we needed to travel further. Finally, Piya was a wonderful host. Promptly responded to any question and she comes across as very kind, caring and intelligent. We loved it and would hope to stay there again when we return to NYC.  So much more character than sterile and pricy Manhattan hotels.

it was a really awful house, there were people making noise all day long in the common area, people snoring in the common area until the morning. In addition, it was not specified that there was a common sharing area. The housekeeper, on the other hand, was a very rude person, asked us for a $25 tip because we were a little late at check-out, he said threatening words to us. In addition, the people in the neighborhood are quite dangerous, in short, I do not recommend this house to anyone.

Located in a safe and clean residential neighborhood surrounded by great eats, this airbnb is a gem in greenpoint. While staying here, we enjoyed our frequent walks to McGolrick park and McCaren Park, as well as convenience transit to Manhattan via the G train and the L train. The studio itself is huge. The high ceiling makes the space very bright and open. The room gets a ton of natural light from the window facing the backyard and window facing the street. The room was clean and well stocked when we arrived, with sanitary products, cooking necessities, snacks, and personal hygiene products. One thoughtful furnishing detail to note is the studio is full of outlets, so there is no problem finding a place to charge your electronics anywhere in the studio. The kitchen is tight yet well laid out, with huge full size kitchen and lovely gas stoves.  We didn’t use the backyard so much because of bugs (we stayed at the tail of summer) and wifi didn’t reach out there. But it’s a nice little private outdoor space to take a call or just enjoy some squirrel watching. In terms of parking, we had no problem finding parking within 15 min walking distance from the apartment. There are street sweeping times when we need to move the car every so often but we have been able to manage the parking with medium low stress.  Overall, we are very happy with Evelyn’s space! The location and the amount of space to live in is really a luxury to find in NYC.

Inside of apartment itself is clean and cute. Bedrooms are noisy at night with the street noises and pigeons, making it hard to sleep even with windows closed.  The location and apartment complex seemed sketchy to our group, making it difficult to relax and feel safe and comfortable at night. With that being said, our group did have more cautious people so take that with a grain of salt. I also tried messaging the host asking a question and never received a response. However, when we decided to leave two nights early to find a new place to stay, the host was quick to respond to my call and also quickly accepted my request for a refund for the two nights we did not stay, which we were very appreciative of.

Our stay was amazing!! All three hosts were so kind and open, and were always willing to help in any way. They were extremely flexible as well, which made the stay hassle and stress free. The location was perfect too! While it is a bit farther uptown, it is literally a 30 second walk to the subway which will take you downtown in like 15-20 minutes. There were many personal and cute touches around the apartment as well, along with a personal bathroom with shower, so you will feel very at home! We 100% recommend staying here, and can’t wait for our next visit! ☺️

Steven's place is well stocked with your basic amenities (loved how there were so many towels and blankets there for us) and is spacious enough for a group of 4, even 6. Note that there are no elevators, so coming up with luggage is tricky, however, Yolanda was a sweetheart as she helped me lug my things upstairs. We really liked how there was a lockbox outside of the building, as it made traveling easy when we would all come back at different times.   However, I will say that our stay was unfortunately cut short due to some safety concerns. I would recommend this place as a short stay, max of 2 days or so, but as a group of 4 young women who were planning to stay 2.5 weeks and work from home while we were there, it was less than ideal. The street noise is ridiculous with sirens and firetrucks running by every 15 minutes and every night, there was always someone screaming on the street beneath our window.  I'm not sure why all the other reviews are so positive about the location – I assume that these other guests were not staying for as long.    We were awakened at 3 am by a fight beneath our window where a man's windshield was smashed and he was left beaten unconscious until the police came. Sure this didn't happen in the property itself, but if you're traveling alone, stay away if you're paranoid. It's about a 5-minute walk from the closest subway, which isn't bad, but felt like forever since we were scared of walking around alone late at night. Spent a lot of money on uber that week. The location itself made us feel like we had a curfew when coming back from a late dinner.
Baden definitely made my stay stress free. I felt like the space he provided was home away from home.If you are visiting NY his place is a must since it's Central to everything.

The apartment is very comfortable and clean, however you should include photos of the stairs in your gallery since they are very steep and are not recommended for children or older adults, much less for carrying large and heavy suitcases.  Access to transportation is excellent, however at night if you arrive very late the atmosphere is tense, you feel exposed and it could be dangerous for children and family.

The apartment’s really comfortable and spacious! Perfect for a family of 4 or 5. The area isn’t the best, the subway entrance is close, but the first couple of days, there were homeless people blocking the entrance. The stairs could also be an issue for some.

This place was very nice and comfortable. 5 of us stayed there comfortably. What we weren’t expecting was 4 flights of stairs! Which is very tiring for luggage and for after all day of walking! Also the area at night isn’t the best to be walking. We had no issues walking the day and taking the sub but to get back we had to Uber there because the one night we walked it felt very unsafe. The place can get pretty cold because the weather was in the 30s-40s but i don’t blame this on the place. Just having a small heater would be a huge plus. I had no issues communicating with the owner.

Everything was great. Gabe’s place is was spacious, clean, and comfortable. Check in and communication were a breeze and he was very responsive with answering questions. I would recommend to others and book again for a convenient and stress free free stay!

Do not stay in this location. This is east harlem one of the most dangerous neighborhoods in Manhattan, a week ago there was a shooting near the apartment, when we went out that night I saw people standing on the corner and exchanging large dollar bills, the buildings have bars on the windows and there is housing project buildings everywhere. I was with kids and I felt very unsafe. I had reserved the apartment for 4 nights and we stayed one night only. It wasn’t worth the extra money. The apartment is expensive for what it offers and your money is non refundable. It’s is also in the 4rth floor and no elevator. So I would think twice booking here. I asked for a refund and neither the owner nor Airbnb helped. I was disappointed in Airbnb because I booked this dangerous location through their platform and they held zero responsibility in supporting me. I am switching to using hotels from now on because Airbnb does not offer support for unsafe locations and it’s not always guaranteed that you will be in a safe location through Airbnb platform.

We came to spend 4 days as a family in NYC (2 teenagers and 4 adults). The accommodation is adequate, communication with Steven easy and the rooms adequate. As others have written, the front rooms are noisy, but it's NYC. Parking was more complicated than expected, but we had 2 cars. The major problem is transport in the evening. We have come to NYC several times and have never had an experience like this. We got back by metro around 11 p.m. and at the station near the apartment there were a lot of homeless people and drug addicts who were aggressive. My partner was harassed and we ended up taking an Uber from the metro to the apartment. The experience was so unpleasant that we didn't stay the next two nights and had to book a hotel room in a quieter area for the end of the stay.  It ended with an additional expense of $2500!!! I would have liked to know in advance that the metro should be avoided at this time in this area.

Ms. Viviana was a great communicator. However, I reserved this room for 3 nights & didn’t stay. I was okay with being charged for my 1st night because i did use the bathroom and kept my bags there while shorting everything out. (Read below)   I must say I HAPPILY GOT APPROVED FOR A REFUND even though Ms. Viviana denied my request. I am so thankful for Airbnb being understanding to my situation and upholding a great standard and caring about their customers.   Here are a few things to be mindful of: 1.You have to walk down an alley to the the side door (your entrance).  2. There are two huge photos of family members/friends on the wall of the home that might be a little creepy or make strangers uncomfortable. You must pass them in the living room to go up to your part of the house. Although it is someone’s home, I think host should be mindful when opening their home and also those photos aren’t shown in the images showcased on the profile images. I honestly wouldn’t have reserved the room if i saw them because I like Airbnb spaces are very neutral ex: landmarks, flowers, clocks or nothing)   3. My room bedding looked nothing as pictured. In the photos it shows a lovely blue bed set with multiple pillows and white towels. When i arrived, nothing of the sort. The sheets were mix-matched, two pillows and a different blanket.   4. My brother helped me bring my bags in and I believe since Ms. Viviana had bad experiences with other guest abusing her “no visitors” rule she is very cautious. (From reading the convos in her prior reviews) She inquired if I was breaking the rule via text (she is seeing my brother and I on her cameras) and I said no it’s just my brother. She did apologize.   5. There are a lot of people in this space. That reflected in the noise and cleanliness of the bathroom.  (Hairs in the drain)   6. I could not find parking. I understand it’s Queens N.Y. Hence why I didn’t stay. I ended up going to my family’s home. When I told Ms. Viviana that i wouldn’t stay due the other two days due to the parking issue she said to contact Airbnb. Her concern was she would not be able to book her space due to my cancelation. Although I was okay with being charged for the first night although I didn’t stay.   7. My charge was 180 and I requested 100 refund for the two days. Ms.Viviana denied it but Airbnb refunded me. I was hesitant to write this review because I DON’T LIKE MESSING WITH PEOPLE’s money and leaving negativity but I just wanted to be honest about my experience since reviews are so important on this platform. God bless everyone reading this. xoxo

Great little place! We came and stayed for a few weeks in July while we looked for an apartment. It was a perfect place to come back and relax after running around doing stressful things all day. We loved the shower and the kitchen!  The neighborhood is very quiet and clean. We did happen to come during some little league tournaments that were happening at the baseball field across the street but the noise wasn’t bothersome at all. The ice cream truck would also come by in the evenings. :) Even though it is a half hour drive to the ferry, the airbnb is 3 min away from the laundromat, and a 10 min drive to Trader Joe’s, Target, and the mall for anything you might need during your stay which was so convenient for us.   Nick and Maria were great hosts and were quick to respond to any questions or problems that came up. We set off the fire alarm at one point while frying some noodles and they were very understanding about it. We really appreciate their great hospitality!!! :)

Sarah is a very communicative and reactive host. She always try to make you feel at home. Her flat is very well located: nearby the subway and in a nice neighborhood with a lot of nice restaurants. It's calm as well. However the equipments in the flat are a bit sketchy... The bathroom is old and not working that well, the small beds are okay but not super comfortables, etc.  It's an old and living house so that's come with it!

Location: Just on the edge of Williamsburg a short walk from local bars and amenities   Apartment: A fantastic place, sparkling clean with ample space and a perfect little roof terrace which is an absolute hidden gem. Stunning view of Manhattan skyline at night time and great for breakfast coffees in the morning.  Host: Abby was an amazing host answered all our questions very quick responses and made sure our stay was as comfortable as possible.   Cannot stress how great this apartment was and would love to stay again. Thank you Abby.

The place is amazing, very stylish and spacious. We were at first afraid of the neighborhood but in the end it proved us wrong as multiple times we came back very late and everything was fine. Everything was as in the description and even more than we expected! The only thing to remember is a heating which is not controlled from ones side and one needs to mention to the hosts to turn it off or on but it was on minute after we asked for it :) Thank You once again Rebeccah & Daniel!
Awful dirty bugs every were smelled bathroom was gross not mear shoping or anything in an unsafe nieghborhood.lillian  was a sweet innocent girl

This place is only good for the location. Which is weird because the host switched units on me at last minute from one on N7 to N10 (closer to McCarren park).  Overall, the place is fine but… Pictures are 5 years older than how it actually looks. I wouldn’t stay here for long term stays or by myself (which I did so hence the advice). The cleaning lady  who lets you in did a very light cleaning job - I actually cleaned the place better when I left it vs how I entered it. The counters felt sticky like it hasn’t been deep cleaned in a while. There’s stuff in the freezer, frig, & counters which I didn’t touch but it looked really old. The bathroom is tiny & in the worst shape out of all the rooms. For example, broken toilet paper holder, paint peeling, etc.  The building is a much older building & looks like a poorly remodeled school. The doors have glass on them even though they are indoors. The hallways are not properly lit & very dark about 70% of the time.   The unit is not a true 1-bedroom. It’s a railroad style unit that’s much larger. So someone “could” access the unit you’re airbnbing through the bedroom since the door w/ access locks on the other side (not the side you’re on) which is a little creepy. I purchased an under the door alarm & placed it there during the entire time I stayed there.  I work a lot & I’m pretty much low maintenance since I generally barely talk to the host after checking in. I usually only reach out if there is an urgent matter. So besides updating him on inconsistencies for his separate rules he messaged (e.g., don’t open bathroom window but it was already open, dining chairs are broken, etc), I haven’t talked to him since I moved in. But, the host messaged me a couple days before I had to move out & said I had to be out by 9am instead of 12pm as listed. I asked him if I could stay till 12pm since I have 3 suitcases w/ me he said no. So I reached out to airbnb in a panic. The host gaslighted me & asked that I should try to deal w/ matters w/ him first before reaching out to Airbnb (which I did but he said no!). Then he reminded me that he let me move in a couple hours early 2pm-ish (instead of 3/4pm) so he’s keeping track to justify anything in his favor. Then the next day after these exchanges, he wanted to meet in-person because he said he was stopping by the building. I told him I would be at work so I would miss him. I got back to the airbnb after 830pm-ish. He messaged around 10pm saying he was there, sorry for being loud on the other side of the unit but he would like to meet. 1) I was exhausted from a long day 2) I was decompressing & I did not see the messages until much later but how weird especially late at night.  All in all. Location is great so I would only stay for short term stays (if nothing is available) & if I’m traveling w/ someone else.

Paulina's hospitality is amazing! She was very patient and was willing to wait all night for us to check in (we were late getting into the room).   Clean towels, glass of water and bed linens were provided! Wifi was also available for guests!  Although room was small, it was cozy and comfortable! It was also super clean and tidy!The only problems i could think of was that there was no AC so room was a bit hot and humid (although there was a fan we can use). Some people might also find the location of the place to be scary and unsafe but honestly, it wasn't bad at all. We managed to walk in the middle of the night around the neighborhood to get amazing late night food (Peppa Jerk Chicken around the corner) and we felt safe!   Besides being close to food, markets and convenience stores, the place is also close to the metro (a block and a half away) and prospect park!

The beds in this place are huge and very comfortable. The neighbourhood may appear to be a little unsafe however we didn't experience any problems. Local subway is an easy walk and car park space provided by the host was also greatly appreciated. This is a nice three bedroom place.

Giovanni was very quick to respond and very nice, he offered suggestions and found him to be a good host. The apartment is 10 minutes walk away from the subway and we found the area pretty safe to walk even after dark. The apartment looks exactly like in the photos, but what the rather unpleasant surprise was it has two doors communicating with a common hallway. While one is a normal door, the other one (which goes directly into the bedroom) is a double glass door. There are curtains for privacy, but still it didn’t feel very safe. The beds were comfortable, the kitchen and bathroom were ok, but the whole place was dusty and needed cleaning. The other issue was noise from upstairs at night, but we texted the host one evening about it and that seemed to improve things.

The room is decent size, and the air conditioner is great.  The whole apartment had some sort of smell, and without the air conditioner, the smell in the room would've been too disturbing for me to sleep.  The bathroom doesn't seem sanitary.  There was always some unpleasant smell.  And there's a sign to not flush toilet paper.  When it's a tiny bathroom, shared with other people, I can't imagine how that rule is even sanitary enough for the place to be advertised on airbnb.

Roger is a nice host. Seemed a bit disorganized when we arrived as our room wasn’t ready when we got there. We weren’t able to use the kitchen and the bathroom was dirty. Our room overall was clean and had good air conditioning. It was nice that he let us keep our luggage at his place because we had a late departure flight so could tour Harlem. Area is a bit sketchy at night and far from lower Manhattan, however it is close to lines 2, 3 and easy to catch M60 to LGA airport.

My boyfriend and I had a wonderful time at Leidy's apartment. I'd had another host cancel on me just a few days before the trip, so I was scrambling to find a place to stay. Leidy responded immediately to all my questions so I was able to book with her right away, which helped me resolve a stressful situation. Throughout the trip, she was so incredibly responsive. Made a big difference.   The apartment is spacious (especially compared to other places I've stayed in NYC). The place was bright, clean, well-appointed, and cutely decorated. It was nice to have a couple of comfy spaces to spread out. Also great to have that extra half bath. The building was quiet and the bedroom was wonderfully dark and cool. Great for sleeping. It was easy getting keys from the lockbox, and the building had good lighting out front, which felt like a nice added bit of security in a neiborhood that already seems quite safe.  The neighborhood feels pretty peaceful and quiet, but it's just a few blocks to a number of cool-looking restaurants and Smorgasburg down at the riverfront.   And again, can't say enough about how nice it was to interact with Leidy. Even after the trip, she let us know about an item we left and got it shipped back to us in no time.   Would definitely stay in this apartment again!

Thank you for being a nice host and accommodating to  our varying check-in times. The common places in the apartment could have been little better. The bathroom was a little claustrophobic. Neighborhood was a little sketchy. Overall I think it was decent, but I don't really know how apartments are in New York.
Rob and Debbie’s place was not only very clean, but super spacious!  They are a very nice couple!  We had an amazing stay, and will return again very soon!

Book this place it’s great!! I booked this place for the Labor Day weekend and it met all my expectations. Very nicely laid out very modern style. I met rob and spoke to him one on one and he was very polite and respectful. Respect quiet hours is important. I enjoyed my stay here. The bed was lovely, put me to sleep in a matter of 5 min laying down. If you looking to just come in for a weekend to party shop or visit stay here. Thank you guys once again.
Rob and Debbie are wonderful host. Welcoming, helpful and diligent about cleanliness and safety, I couldn’t have felt more comfortable. Highly recommend!

Scott’s place is a convenient place to stay in Brooklyn. There is a subway station just around the corner, as well as stores that open late. The train station runs from JFK to downtown Manhattan. Getting off the Subway station at night on Broadway seemed sketchy but turning into pilling street seemed like a calm and quiet neighborhood.   The beds are comfortable and my friend liked that the host had her favorite shampoo and body wash in the shower. It was a nice touch as well as other details that made the stay enjoyable.

Pros: 1 minute from metro line 1, which takes you to practically anywhere. There are pharmacies, places to eat, during our stay we did not have any mishaps with a homeless person, Netflix service, it has a mini kitchen, There is air conditioning in the living room and a fan in the bedroom.   Cons: the bathroom lacked cleanliness, as did the bathroom and the bed. The water also leaks out of the shower.

The communication and check-in was very easy and Steven came across as a very nice person. The location is great and the apartement much as described -  but compared to other Airbnb-places I have stayed at in mid-town Manhattan, I didn't find that Steven's place offered good value for money as I found the place to be dark, not so clean and with a creepy entrance/walk-up.

Edgar is super accommodated and considerate about my request during my stay there. He allowed me to save the luggage in his dinning room and keep the key till I picked up my luggage. And I was able to have a meeting in the morning after the check out time.   The place is neat and clean, minimalist style but super cozy. The mattress is  very nice! Everything is not the brand new but very clean. Though the location on the street is kind of mess and feel dangerous, it’s close to couple nice cafe and restaurants.

I had a great experience with Jaimie's place! She was not there but gave me her roommates number to get in contact with and she also kept in touch to see how things were going. The loft was beautiful and her roommates were so friendly! They gave us places to go too and invited us to places with them. The area I didn't mind at all some might fight sketchy but I enjoyed where we stayed and it was very easy to get to Manhattan and all subway areas! Again I am more then happy with my experience and would definitely message Jaimie again to use her space if I decided to come back in the future! Thank you :)

The space and our host Brady were terrific. The house was clean and quiet, and we were happy with the privacy of the 3rd floor sunshine room. The air conditioner in our room worked extremely well. While we didn't meet Brady in person, his communications were excellent. Everything was explained clearly, and it was nice and easy using this as home base for our vacation. Using the common areas (bathrooms, kitchen, living room, patio, etc.) was never an issue, and the other guests were friendly and polite. Loved the vibe of the home and the neighborhood. I definitely recommend Bedhaus to others looking for an affordable, stress-free place to stay in Bed-Stuy.

It was a pleasure to stay with Edgar. For me it was well located, the room was immaculate when I arrived, great price, and Digi the cat was super chill. Check in was really easy and Edgar gave me a couple extra hours to check out, which made my day so much less stressful. I'd definitely recommend staying here.

Amy's place was fantastic. It's just as advertised and we were delighted with the location which made it very easy to cover a lot of ground during our short stay. The bar downstairs is a gem too, and Amy's guidebook is a great snapshot of the area so we made the most of her suggestions.  The next time I'm fortunate to have another pass at New York I'll be looking forward to returning to the East Village because I had so many happy attacks.  In short, great location, lovely host (excellent communication), delicious sake & food downstairs. You just can't go wrong with this place.  Thanks so much, Amy!

Amazing week in New York! We stayed 6 days in and everything was great.  Keep in mind that the house has multiple rooms and you won't be the only guest. The bathroom and other amenities are shared among guests but it was nice to talk to people from other places and get to know other cultures. Brady has some set rules regarding times so that other guests are not disturbed late at night or early in the morning. We found that everyone complied with the rules. If you're staying in a room facing the street, it can get a little loud late at night because people in the street are talking or playing music. Can't control that but it's something to keep into consideration if you're looking for a restful night.  Street parking is available for free. We parked without issues our entire stay in front of the house but also keep in mind the times of trash pick up. You might have to move your car depending on the day of the week but there's always parking available early.  The neighborhood might seem shady sometimes but that street felt safe. Clearly don't go roaming around late at night but day time is perfectly fine. We even walked from the subway station at 11pm and didn't have issues. The closest subway station is less than 10 min walking! Be advised that it does take approximately 30-45 min to get to Manhattan depending on where you're going but it's convenient and doable. Overall, we recommend this place. Thanks Brady!

I cannot stress how amazing it was to stay in the East Village, it was actually the perfect area and really made our NYC experience.  Amy was a great host, super responsive to any issues we had!  Theyre not kidding about the music in the front bedroom, bring earplugs, but I would absolutely stay here again!

This experiment could not have been any better! I live in NYC but decided to book a place while my mom was in town visiting for the holidays. After staying here, I didn't want to go back to my own apartment! The apartment is even more exquisite in person (the pictures don't do it justice). Beautiful space and decorated well. Not only was it gorgeous, but a quiet oasis after a day among the hustle and bustle. Everything was clean and fresh, and the location was centrally located near 6 subways lines. The hosts were continually available, knowledgable, incredibly kind and hospitable.   This gem is a steal!!! Enjoy your stay, I will only book here from now on!

Warm welcome on our arrival, our host received us in his apartment and offered to chat over coffee or tea. After describing the neighborhood and its surroundings, giving valuable addresses, the apartment was presented to us with the same attention. About 15 minutes walk from Central Park, the rental is very well located in the Harlem district which remains popular without any perceived insecurity. We thank Ale again for his welcome, and highly recommend this address. New York, which we were able to discover, remains an extraordinary city!!
Great room, in a fun house. Feels a bit like a hostel I liked it. The neighborhood is a little sketchy at night. But it’s fair for the price. Would stay here again.

Brady was not around the weekend of our visit, but it was a super simple check-in process so his absence was no bother. The BedHaus is also a super cool place that I would encourage all to checkout. It was clean, well decorated, and cheaper than all other Brooklyn air bnb's from what I have seen. It is in a somewhat sketchy neighborhood so I would just be cautious if you plan on being out late. But all in all a simple and comfortable stay!

I scared to tell the AirBnB community how much I love staying in this loft -- because if it's available for rent, I want to be the one renting it! The apartment is gorgeous -- full of the host's beautiful art. She thoughtfully left us plenty of empty space in the closets and we loved exploring the neighborhood with her personalized recommendations of where to eat, shop, etc. The neighborhood is full of great restaurants and a mere few blocks from the entrance to the High Line, where we strolled every day during our stay here. I can't recommend this place highly enough.

We had a very nice stay at Brady's place! At first we thought the neighborhood was a bit shady but when we went of the train at Gates Avenue we felt safer. The home feels very cozy, and it was nice to have a kitchen.

Oran’s place is beautifully designed. Minimalist interiors with a cozy vibe make your stay really comfortable.  The place comes with a huge backyard with ample seating to sit down and read or have your morning coffee in the sun (in the summer’s, of course!).   It was a steal given that you can commute to soho in two stops. The host is friendly and communicative. I’d highly recommend staying here!

The house is as seen in the photos. The neighborhood is good, 4/5 blocks from the subway that takes you without problems in Manhattan (remember that Brooklyn is very nice to visit too). It is not dangerous, you can walk at any time. We stayed 9 days without any problem, all the guests were super friendly. One detail: for those who need to weigh their suitcase, there is a scale available in the house! :)

The place is exactly as described, and the location was perfect. Michael was a great host, he was quick in answering all of our questions. Especially when we thought there was something wrong with the door because it won't open. Apparently you must turn the keys to the left and push the door to open.   The apartment is located on the 3rd floor, so you have to be fit and strong enough to carry all your suitcases all the way up, and the stairs are quite narrow and rather steep (think of Cinderella the classic cartoon, where her evil stepmother locked up in the attic, and the mice managed to steal the key and they had to climb up the stairs to deliver the key to her). This should not stop you from staying here, tho. It didn't stop us, we had 5 heavy suitcases, and we managed to drag 'em all the way up, and all the way down.   There are lots of restaurants around the apartment. The coffee shop downstairs served really good coffee - ask for a stamp card so you can get your 6th coffee for free. We love the Mud on 9th street, they got fantastic breakfast.   All and all, the place and the location is a gem, I would defo stay here again.

We have never stayed in an AirBB or in Harlem before,,,, this was an exceptional experience all around.   The apartment was cozy (yet roomy) and had everything we needed.  Responses in my questions were quick and the Calatayud family was very reassuring that our stay would be hassle and stress free.  The little perks, especially coffee, was much appreciated.  Street parking was a bonus.   I would stay at this apartment again and will surely recommend it to others.

This room is just clean and well decorated as picture. Brady is friendly, who answers all our questions and is really helpful. Location is good. 8-mins-walk from Subway. Neighboring area is safe, not dangerous to walk on the streets at night. Thank you. It was such a wonderful time staying at your place !

This was our first stay with AirBnB, so I was a bit scared since we were not really sure what to expect, especially since there was quite a bit of disparity in price range for the area. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at your place. House was clean and cozy. House had convenient access to transportation, which what I was mostly looking for.   Thanks again for hosting us.

I really enjoyed my time at Brady and Jeffrey's Airbnb! They were awesome hosts. Brady is also super quick to answer any questions. Omar, the house manager, is also really great. I stayed here for two weeks. As a woman staying by myself, I never felt unsafe -- the vibe in the house is very calm and friendly. The other guests were all really cool. If you're staying for longer than a day or two, the kitchen is very useful as you can store your food in the fridge and cook some meals there. There's several laundromats nearby, so that's convenient as well. The internet is fast and I was able to work remotely. I definitely highly recommend staying here overall if you're looking for someplace that has a communal, hostel-like vibe with friendly people and all the standard amenities you'd need, even for a longer stay.

I stayed in the Autumn Room for two nights. The room was in good shape, and the apartment was very colorful and homey. It was our first time in Brooklyn and we had been a little concerned beforehand about the neighborhood, but I did not feel unsafe at any point. Brady was traveling at the time so we never met him, but he was very good with communicating and leaving notes, and the check-in process went smoothly. It was a great opportunity to see a new part of the city, and the price was certainly also a plus!

Bedford-Stuyvesant is a quiet residential area. The subway station (Kosciuszko Street) is only a 7-minute walk from the place. It takes about 30 minutes to go to Manhattan. Joakim welcomed us very friendly and helped whenever needed. Thank you! We had a clean and quiet bedroom with a queen size bed. Unfortunately, the mattress was a bit too soft but we had an extra airbed to switch beds. Fresh towels are provided. It was pleasant to have a bathroom next door and another one downstairs which was a bit bigger. Next to it is a fully-equipped kitchen and a living-area. Every morning you'll find snacks and fruits on the kitchen table plus fresh coffee. Don't be scared of the house cat. It was always cuddly and friendly but maybe it's good for others to know who are allergic to cats. Wifi was always available. The neighbourhood has a fresh food supermarket where you are able to find everything you dream of. Plus, there is a drug store a bit further down (at Gates Avenue). All in all, it was a great deal to stay at Brady's. We definitely had a pleasant stay and are happy with our choice.

My boyfriend and I stayed in the autumn room, and it had everything we needed! Very clean and cute, with a nice view from the windows. The bathroom and kitchen area on our floor were very clean too, and we never had a problem sharing with the other people we were sharing with on our floor. It is a large group house dynamic, which is something to be aware of it is not your thing. The house was very close to subway which made getting to the city very easy. The neighborhood was a little sketchy, and I personally would not have felt safe walking by myself at night (but that's just me!). The house felt very safe though with a secure lock system for the front door, and I was never concerned while inside. Overall a great little group home! :)

I stayed in the Autumn room. It was a clean and cozy room, with very nice and bright, colorful common spaces. It's exactly what you see in the pictures. The host wasn't there during my stay, so I basically had no contacts with anyone for the 2 nights I spent there. Brady provided me with all the informations I needed beforehand, including the access code to the door. The neighborhood was supposed to be a little sketchy, but I had no problems at all even when walking alone at night. The subway is conveniently located at a 7 minutes walk from the house.

Brady's place was very clean and stocked with helpful things like granola bars, a water filter, and shower stuff. Even though traveling in and out of Brooklyn can be a bit of a trek, it was definitely a steal and worth the extra rides into the city. We never felt unsafe in the neighborhood but liked that we could take the bus practically to the front door. Our only complaint would be having to deal with other renters who would smoke in the hallways and were loud at night, but we understood that was not necessarily in Brady's control. Overall a very positive experience!

Brady was a wonderful host and his townhome is a great find if you're looking to visit locally in Brooklyn, or commute to Manhattan.  Our room was clean and ready for us--bonus points to Brady for getting it ready for us a couple hours earlier!  The AC unit kept us comfortable at night, and there was adequate lighting in the bedroom.  Everything was clean--the room, common areas, and bathroom.  It was nice to be able to grab a breakfast bar on our way out the door.  The price of the room was also a steal compared to other places in the area.  We'd definitely stay again!  Thanks, Brady!

Paul was an excellent host.  He responded in a timely manner to messages.  He graciously handled our late arrival due to a missed flight.  The apartment was super clean, especially the bathroom.  The apartment itself is older and a little run-down but this doesn't affect it's function.  The subway passes out front of the apartment which seems like it would be loud, but the bedroom is toward the back of the apt and we did not find the noise disruptive.  It was amazing to have two functioning AC units in the apt as it was super hot the whole time we visited.  No problem operating them and no glitches.  The neighbourhood looked a little scary at first to my tourist eyes but I found it to be very safe, and friendly actually.  The building felt very secure.  The subway stop is just across the street and so is a full grocery store.  There is a beautiful coffee shop, Dillinger's, just a few blocks away.  Also within walking distance (less than 10 min) is Roberta's - a Michelin-starred pizza joint with amazing food and atmosphere.

Absolutely amazing. You are a fool if you don't chose to stay here.  Brady and Jeffrey's place is the closest you can get to a hotel  experience while living at a beautiful house, being surrounded by great people, and saving so much money.  The atmosphere in their townhouse was beyond positive, rooms where nicely decorated and spotless. Every square inch in the house has been touched by their creative minds, making the place unique and simply beautiful.  What I loved the most is their easy-going approach to guests, desire to be helpful and suggest interesting places to explore, as well as making sure that my every single need has been met.   I also cannot complain about waking up to a fresh pot of coffee, sweet garden view and a new person to chat with every morning! However, even though there were other people staying here I saw them only once or twice throughout the day, and always had tons of personal space.   It is located just a few blocks away from a subway station, so I had no problems with transportation as well as taking Uber from here down to Manhattan costs very little.   I was scared and did not know what to expect when I was arriving to this place as it was my first time using this website. I am happy to say that I was beyond happy with my choice, as I truly felt at home at this Brooklyn townhouse. It is everything a traveller needs thanks to Brady and Jeffrey. I hope these guys will continue on being great hosts and allow people experience the city while staying at such a great place.   Enjoy New York.

The room was very nice, super accurate to the pictures. We did not meet Brady since he was away when we came but there was no issues of communication in case we needed something! The apartment is also very clean. The only downside is the neighborhood, we sometimes got a little scared with my friend in the area. It's not that bad, but at night it was not too reassuring, especially next to the subway station.

I can't say enough positive things about my stay! Long was an amazing host!! The place was immaculate! Super clean! Great location! At no time did I ever feel unsafe... Long helped me with directions and communicated brilliantly... I don't have one negative thing to say! If I'm ever back in NY I will DEFINITELY stay here again!!! Thanks for your amazing hospitality Long!!

Wow! First off, I just want to say that if you are going to stay in NYC then stay with Long! This is an unbeatable steal of a deal...super safe location (one of the safest neighborhoods in NYC actually, even though it is in the Bronx)...easy subway access...massive room...nice host...clean...tidy...quality. Long is a wonderful guy who will take time with you to give you some insights and leave you alone when you need it. There is hands down no better place to stay in NYC.

Immediately the house creates a very welcoming vibe- with cool decor, nice lighting and a warm atmosphere. There were plenty of ammenities (ear plugs,  toiletries for the shower), a very easy and stress free check in procedure.

While I was unable to meet Brady during my stay, I had absolutely no trouble finding his place or checking in. The room was exactly as described-comfortable, clean, and a steal for the price. My only qualm was that the bed creaked a little. But other than that, my stay was exceptionally comfortable. Will definitely book again next time I'm in the city.

Brady's place is convenient for a short stay in NYC.   The neighborhood is considered as 'red' in terms of safety by the vast majority of information sources on the internet. Although you can feel somewhat unsafe in the evening while walking around, we didn't have any problem during our stay.   The house was beautiful, everybody was nice and Brady was really welcoming and understanding. It takes approximately 50 minutes to get to Midtown by underground.
Paul is very responsive and accommodating. Was a simple and stress free experience.

There is only on-street parking.  I was told there was 'free parking on premises'....there isn't.  After circling around in sweltering heat ---and then a thunderstorm--- I finally gave up on parking there and went to a nearby garage.  I then had to walk a half-mile back.  I was very unhappy with this.  I have had two cars stolen on the streets of the Bronx in the past, and I feel it's unfair to say you have 'free parking on premises', when you mean the street. Long seemed nice via email, though I didn't actually meet him.  I did meet his girlfriend, who was very nice, but I decided to leave rather than deal with the parking hassles for another night.
Great stay!! I was a little afraid of just booking a room rather than the entire place, but Long and Fiona made it a great experience. The private bathroom helped alot.

Long is a perfect host. The room is comfortable, very clean, and has everything you need. The cooling/heating system is quiet and easily adjusted. Long and his wife are quite hospitable and thoughtful and their place is the only place I like to stay when I visit the area. Just a block from a small shopping area with grocery and drug stores as well as restaurants and about 3 blocks from another area with bars, restaurants, and small businesses makes the neighborhood very walkable.

When I arrived, Keith was not home, and the key was not available.  This was pretty stressful.  Keith says in his description that there is no air conditioning:  it was, unfortunately, very hot in the bedroom.  In the living room, the two chairs cannot be sat on, and Keith was usually occupying the love seat.  There is a small breakfast bar, but no stools.  Keith says in the description: "The home also serves as an office and the living area is limited and often unaccessible." - he's serious.  The pictures of the bedroom are inaccurate:  the only light is a small one next to the bed; unlike in the pictures, there were no amenities on the desk or bedside table.  There was only one bath; the second one was out of commission.  Keith was a nice guy; I wish we had had an opportunity to talk about his travels.

We had a great stay with no hitches. Check in was ideal with no stress and the night was quiet. My girlfriend felt the area was safe and comfortable, even when arriving late the first night. This is my first choice next time I come to BKYN.

I stayed at Bedhaus for a week working remotely (so I was pretty much on site 24/7). I love the concept; it’s a cross between a private home and a hostel where you share common spaces with several other guests (and that same nice community vibe of one). It feels homey without being intrusive of someone else’s private quarters so I felt more comfortable using the kitchen and living room. The only downside is the bathroom can get busy. In addition to Brady who lives on the first floor, the house manager Omar drops in regularly to tidy up and is super helpful if you need anything. Also lots of amenities. The brownstone’s location is on a quiet block and even though I had a back-facing room, I think the front rooms might be just as quiet. The area is very residential and home to working class folks — it’s a bit shabby chic but definitely safe and I surprisingly didn’t encounter any homeless. There are some markets and restaurants within walking distance but the trendier areas like Bushwick and Williamsburg are a bus ride away.

Amanda is very friendly and really accommodating. Our flight was more than 10 hours late and she welcomed us in the middle of the night without any problem. Don't hesitate to ask her questions, she gives very good advice and is always ready to discuss and help. We felt comfortable straight away. And thank you again for lending me a green scarf for St. Patrick’s Day! The apartment is very comfortable and clean and the view from the roof is superb.  Thanks again to Amanda!

Absolutely loved this place and would definitely come back if staying in New York again. It's super cozy and looks exactly like the pictures. We checked in with no problems; didn't see Brady because he was out of town or even see anyone else staying there, which was totally fine for a couple of introverts. Bedhaus is naturally welcoming! When we left in the morning we almost walked into a crime scene because there had been a shooting on the next block overnight, so maybe not 100% a welcoming area--but would still stay here again.

I was a little afraid of the neighbourhood before my arrival, but that part is reportedly becoming better, although a friend of mine recommended me not to walk alone after sunset and walked me home every evening.  The room was cozy, warm, the house is quiet - my bedroom was right next to the living room / common space, but people were not loud, so I really had a good place to sleep. The house is clean and even though Brady was not in, Joakim, the house manager, always helped me with anything I needed. I appreciated the soap and shampoo in the shower a lot. The check-in and check-out were very easy and I received all needed information from Brady before my arrival. People were nice and considerate around me in the bedhaus.  I felt welcome and comfortable, thanks a lot!

Luis and Melanie were great hosts, always willing to help us in anything we could need. The apartment was clean and brand new renovations have been done recently. It is located in a working class neighborhood. Some houses and streets looked a bit dirty and messy but you didn't feel unsafe. At only 30 min by metro from south Manhattan, it was a convenient location. Overall a very good experience.

This place is truly like a bed and breakfast! There are at least 6 rooms in this place.  I never had a problem getting into the bathroom or using the kitchen space.  The cat was friendly :)  Brady was out of town during my visit, but he made sure my friend and I had everything we needed during our stay.  The neighborhood is a little on the rough side compared to Williamsburg or Manhatten, but everyone was friendly and we never felt unsafe.

Very professionally organized bnb. Nice interior decoration and clean house. All rooms are private with nice living space and kitchen. We liked the travel book collection very much. 5 min walk to subway and great value for money. Only con is the location feels little unsafe in the night.

Brady arranged everything very well for my visit. The instructions to get here, opening the door and getting the key were very clear. The house was spacious and clean. All amenities are as described and the other guests were really quiet. After walking around in Brooklyn, mostly Greenpoint, Park Slope and Williamsburg, I can say that this neighborhood is maybe less gentrified, so if you are looking for something more authentic, then I guess this is the right place. I must say that the people I have met in Manhattan advised me against walking alone home between at night because it was, in their knowledge, unsafe to do so. I don't know if this is a misconception or if it's the truth, but if you are a solo female traveller, you might want to consider adding some Uber fees to your budget. The houses on the street are beautiful and I enjoyed walking around Bushwick during the day.  If you don't mind spending 20-30 mins minimum in transit to get to Manhattan then this is a really great deal!

We chose Barbara's place because of the location and reviews. It's a block away from Prospect Park and the subway is around the corner, so coming and going from Manhattan was easy. That said, people who do not like noise are going to find it unpleasant as it is a busy neighborhood with constant traffic. However, Barbara is such a lovely host, we felt like visiting relatives, leaving us coffee and bites for breakfast and basically letting us be.
