I ended up having no place to stay in nyc and had to call family in New Jersey to come and pick me up. Meanwhile, cesca stayed in a hotel near by and then opted to sleep in the air bnb when I left, while she was supposed to solve the rodent issue and refund me for the nights I did not stay there. Because I made the mistake of personally messaging with her instead of talking about it through air bnb messaging, I was screwed out of a refund and spent 350$ on cleaning the apartment (that was clearly never cleaned before I got there). Had I been refunded the way it was promised and discussed, I would have had respect for the situation and said although the apartment is old, clearly in need of better management (packages will get stolen if you order any by the way so you need to re route all of them), and clearly rat prone due to being an old building… it’s in a convenient location. With that said, as a single female… I was constantly apologizing for not wanting to stay in an apartment with rat sightings (multiple sightings in the UNIT) because apparently that’s the norm in New York. I can now confirm, now that I have a place of my own in nyc, that was absolutely disgusting and disrespectful. No one should have to tolerate that when your OVERpaying for a place to stay in the city. Also, good luck with the bedding made available. It hasn’t been washed. And from what I gathered, she won’t help you to wash them. Lastly, while she communicates well, it doesn’t add up to the misplacement I faced while in a city I just moved to.   Also, before the rats even occurred, the toilet randomly started flooding while I was out one morning, and when I came back the bathroom had flooded into the kitchen.. and guess what? No one could help me. The super doesn’t help and cesca simply puts the blame on the renter. Even though I wasn’t even in the apartment when it occurred. Again, I overlooked this, because I thought it was a one time situation. Nope. The friendly neighbors told me they were moving out of the building asap because they have experienced leaks/plumbing issues/moldy floors and the building management does nothing to help. So there’s that to look forward to too if you make the mistake of staying here like I did.   Lastly, the sketchiest thing about it all, you’re not allowed to say you’re staying in an air bnb to anyone who asks. She asks that you say you’re a friend of hers staying there for a bit. Yeah. And she only informs you of this after you booked the place. Pretty sure that’s against policy and I also paid for an Airbnb…. Not to be “a friend staying there.” Maybe that’s why management sucked. Not my responsibility to lie to your neighbors and building management so you can make money off of people shamelessly.  Oh and be ready to ask her to buzz your food orders/friends in every time you’re there. Communication isn’t the issue here, it’s the value of the communication and the integrity to stand by agreements made. Huge waste of time. Huge waste of stress. Never again. Don’t waste your money. But do enjoy Chinatown if you do… not every building/air bnb is like this one… but this one was my worst experience and definitely had made me hesitant. Also.. never text privately! Only use air bnb. She’ll use that against you when you run into issues like I did. Thanks but no thanks. Hire a cleaner for your next tenant please. And wash the bedding. That’s basic necessities.   Also, when there’s been feces that are clearly dried up from months ago in the kitchen, in addition to very fresh droppings…. I’m pretty sure she knew there was a rodent issue in the building. Good luck.

The apartment was perfect for our group of 8. There was a store across the corner that had amazing breakfast. It was within walking distance to the main area and bus/subway stops. Check in and out was easy. The apartment was sufficient and clean. We each had our own bedroom and we shared the two bathrooms. The stairway to the apartment has a weird dingy smell but the apartment didn’t. Might need a coffee maker but we made do with instant coffee. The shop across the corner has coffee too. We never felt unsafe in the location. It was easy for our Uber to find us to get us there and to the airport. Staying here was more affordable than 4 different hotel rooms and we enjoyed all being able to stay in the same place with the same common area. Would definitely recommend it and appreciate the place to stay.

I had an incredibly comfortable stay - probably the most comfortable I’ve ever had at an airbnb due to the countless thoughtful touches that made me feel right at home. The space was very cozy well designed, and the perfect size for 1 or 2. There are designated spaces to work (desk in the room), eat (very cute table in the kitchen/living area, and relax with nice ambient lighting - wifi was great, and bathroom has plenty of space to store your things and was very spotless. Also, plenty of storage space in the closet as well! The area was a bit too far from where I needed to be, and walking outside alone felt a bit unsafe for me after sunset (though I acknowledge this is subjective and I’m not very familiar with nyc). Jonathan was very responsive and helpful! Overall, I really loved staying here and definitely would stay again.

I'm a New Yorker who now lives in another state and returned to NYC for a mostly theater-themed trip (film, Broadway, opera) with a couple companions. Staying anywhere in Manhattan for 6 days is insanely expensive, so I looked for places we could stay where we could still easily access the places we wanted to go and found this! The room looked exactly like it did in the pictures, the beds are comfortable, great pillows, excellent shower, lots of privacy, clean, and access to various spaces - all for a reasonable cost. It's a very short walk to the 4 & 5 trains, which allowed us to get anywhere in Manhattan with relative ease, plus easy road access for driving. We were literally just across the bridge from Manhattan.  There wasn't really any verbal communication of any kind during our stay, it was all digital or in print, which I actually preferred, though I suspect we might've had trouble getting assistance of some kind if we'd needed it. There are a few convenience type stores nearby and a good bagel place called Bagel & Barista Cafe or something like that that had good food. There are also some decent restaurants within delivery distance, and as I said, it's not hard at all to get to Manhattan (or elsewhere).   The only heads up I'd give is that the toilet paper is very thin and not the greatest, so you may want to purchase some extra if you're staying for more than a few days. Other than that, no complaints! It's a cool property and area, and I'm glad we found it and stayed there.

The apartment was fantastic, exactly as advertised, clean, well appointed, etc. Based upon the unit alone, I would give this place five stars. However, there were MAJOR problems with the checkin procedure, and I think people need to be aware.   So as part of the normal rental procedure, the company sends you a couple emails, one requesting some additional details about your stay, and another with details about the unit, including an access code for the building and apartment locks. We arrived at about 11PM, and the provided code did not work. We tried it dozens of times, verifying that we were following the instructions precisely, and it just didn't work. Signage on the building included a "front desk" phone number, the website had some phone numbers we found, as did the email, and we couldn't get anyone to pick up on any phone number we tried.   After about half an hour of trying phone numbers, a second couple showed up trying to check into their unit, and had the same issue. The provided code was not properly set up. I continued trying and re-trying numbers, leaving messages, etc., and finally got someone to answer on the emergency line. Unfortunately, the were unable to help, as that line is for other purposes.  Eventually we just followed someone else into the building, and found our unit had been left unlocked, and were able to get in for the night. We did finally get a call back from someone, who again was unable to directly reset the access code. It wasn't until the following afternoon, after several hours of back-and-forth calls that someone was able to provide us with a new, working access code.  I suspect if we had arrived during business hours, we would have had an easier time getting a timely resolution, but checking in late like we did is not uncommon. I have had similar issues in the past with door codes not working, but in every case I've been able to get someone one the phone within a few minutes and get the issue resolved.  Anyway, once we were able to get in, the unit was great, the location was great, the value for the price was excellent, and we had a good stay.

The view was absolutely Amazing! Oscars place was nice. The only issue I had was that the sliding shower door  is broken I was afraid to move it and there was a weird sound coming from behind the big mirror in the living room . Other then that everything was great I would stay again.

Just finished a wonderful stay.  Three bedrooms, three queen beds and 1 1/2 baths made this a stress free stay.  Easy free on street parking.  Great location.  Eli was a great host.  Promptly answered any questions I had.  Would definitely stay at his place in the future.

Great stay! The room was very clean and had everything we needed. The kitchenette was very convenient and made our stay even more homey. The neighbourhood felt a little unsafe to walk at night, but close to the subway which was very convenient. The underground parking garage was a great amenity to have if you're driving into NYC. We had a bit of a leak in the bathroom and the main part of the room from the ceiling but nothing major that impacted our trip too much, other than some clothes getting wet.

Terrible stay host lies about prices/ scams people and overcharges and room was no where near clean and the code downstairs does NOT WORK you can call a million times and still don’t get a correct code and at night they don’t answer at all the costumer service line and billing team are very rude and disrespectful worst experience ever the host told me I could extend my stay charged me triple lied to me and then switch it around and said it was only for 2 nights not the 3 we agreed on in our email please do me a favor save your money AND RUN AWAY
Very clean and communication was perfect. Location was close to a subway, but a little sketchy at night to walk late at night in my opinion. The host was great!

We stayed two weeks in the accommodation. It is located in the heart of Harlem, close to a subway station and bus lines, which allow you to get to downtown quickly and efficiently. Nearby, where to eat, do your shopping and shopping on the 125th. The environment is generally calm (we are in NY!). Positive: spacious, clean, generally well equipped to live there as tourists. The rooftop is nice, and the washing machines practical (as long as you can upgrade your app store to the US version). The dishwasher! :) Negative: there is a lack of storage and "surfaces" (a real coffee table, a slightly larger dining table...). The pink foam "mattress topper" is unpleasant, we removed it the 3rd night and slept much better, on a firm bed. The proximity to the street means that you can hear EVERYTHING if you are sensitive. Communication: Elite by G&G does not track messages and some are unhelpful!

Terry is a GEM! Communicating was a breeze and made our stay stress free. Terry is so accommodating- she had a pizza delivered for us, let us check in early and check out late as well. We had a heat wave while we were staying and she had a huge fan that cooled us all off. Plenty of room, pillows, towels, coffee you name it, Terry has it! This place is centrally located to Church Avenue Station (7 min walk). Thank for having us and we hope to be back in the future.

Great place to stay - a short 7-minute walk from the Astoria ferry station, which takes you to the Upper East Side in like 4 minutes.  The apartment itself is cozy and clean, and there is the doggo who is cute and quiet. I am usually afraid of dogs, but their dog is very nice! Martin and Soledad helped me out with an adapter to the US plug, with my luggage, and overall accommodated me in a very good way. I am grateful for the atmosphere in the place. They even helped me find a place to take an antigen testing. I am coming back there soon, booked the place twice! Thank you!

This was only an okay stay.  Our biggest con is that the bed is extremely uncomfortable. We woke up with aches and pains every morning (we're in our mid-20s). And if you are sleeping two people, you can feel every little movement as the entire frame shakes.  Cleanliness was... hit or miss. Everything seemed okay at first glance, but then we noticed there were pubic hairs all over the bed, sheets, and even the bathroom. We spent a decent amount of time trying to get rid of them all that first night before we could sleep, and still found more while laying in bed.  Also, we were not given any way to access the Wi-Fi on our own. We did not have any internet our first night/morning until Rosa's son came the next afternoon to tell us the password in person. This was actually quite unpleasant as he was a bit rude and clearly did not want to be helping us in that moment. I'm not sure why this information was not just included with our check-in.  The location is quite far from the main city (1.5 hours), but we knew that from the listing and were happy with how nice the neighborhood was for the price.  Side note: Not a problem, but be aware that the toilet is extremely tilted before you sit down on it (more so than it looks). It took us by surprise the first time.

I stayed here for a month with my wife and we could not have been happier with our experience. Lisa was such a wonderful host. She was kind, fun, communicative, and FAST with anything that came up. Having her upstairs made us feel so much more comfortable than other places we've stayed which were managed by companies.  The apartment is exactly how it looks in the photos and even more comfortable. The whole apartment is new and felt well cared for. It's very clean. The linens and towels were much better than I'd expect in an AirBnB. The kitchen was fully-stocked with nice new pots and pans which were great for cooking. We didn't cook every night but it wouldn't have been any trouble if we did. There was coffee, tea, and a kettle already there when we arrived which was pleasant to see after a long journey.  I was working remotely during our stay and using the internet pretty much constantly and didn't have a single interruption the whole month. There is a router inside the apartment and the wifi speed is very fast. There's a TV with a fire stick already set up with Netflix and HBO Max which was also nice. We never had an issue with noise whether coming from outside or neighbors.  The location of the apartment was very convenient. It's a 2-minute walk to one express subway line and maybe a 4-minute walk to another one. Between the two of them, they'll get you pretty much anywhere in Manhattan. The neighborhood itself is a bit dirty and might not be for everyone but with the subway lines being so close it's super easy to get in and out if that's what you choose. It wasn't a problem for us.  All in all, Lisa and this apartment made our trip such an enjoyable one. The apartment was our little, stress-free home away from home to relax in after a long day (or night) doing stuff all over NYC.

We stayed at this location for one night. It wasn’t what I expected at all. It seems like the host lives in the unit, there were personal items in all of the rooms and the bathrooms. There was no air conditioning in the unit in the middle of the summer. As hot as it was, there is no reason for air conditioning to not be available. In one of the rooms the light wasn’t working. I’m the kitchen the ice/water machine of the fridge was not working and the freezer door was broken. Also when going into the kitchen cabinet to get a glass to have a drink, I saw a roach. Then to top it all off the host accused us of stealing face cloths “that she bought at Costco the day before”! Definitely won’t be staying here again.

So when we got there the key didn’t work we had to wait 20 minutes for her to come let us back in because she said she only gave us the key for downstairs because she never locks the top because her family comes in and out. I told her this is an air bnb I don’t want the door unlocked and anybody can steal our belongings. The microwave was dirty and had a dead baby roach in it. I asked her do I have to clean it being that she left Clorox wipes she said no she forgot and roaches are common from the neighbors. Upstairs was VERY HOT. She only had fans and the one air conditioner in the master bedroom. You can tell she lived there because it was clothes and personally belongings all through the house. The couches were white and dirty. Overpriced in my opinion because of the location and family pictures, car seats and clothes everywhere. My son found a weed bag and grinder on the dresser in the room he stayed in.
Be careful going here if you leave anything you will never see it again because the cleaners steal

Very disappointing stay. On arrival we discovered that the apartment  we checked in and were taken to our room. It was definitely not the one  we had booked online so  we returned to reception and we’re told our original booking was not available due to supposed ‘ water damage’ from a leak. Nobody seemed to know what was going on and after about an hour it was suggested we would have to party of three into two alternative rooms. My companions settled into their room but had major problem trying to sort out the radiator.  When I was finally assigned I room I went to my new room only to find it had not been cleaned- it looked like some guests had just checked out. I was eventually assigned a room which I just settled for because I was so tired but the toilet in the room continually kept making a sound of a filling tank so I had to turn off the fawcett from time to time to stop the annoying sound.   Rob and his team were truly splendid in all their efforts to try to work around the hiccup of us not ending in the property we had booked through Airbnb but this was truly a diabolical situation, they just seemed overwhelmed most of the time and in a constant state of putting out fires and trouble shooting. They seem to need more support to correct the many glaring operational issues. It’s a shame because it really is a great hotel in a great location in the NewYork financial district. Would not recommend or book again.

This stay is such a gem! Nyla is AMAZING!!! Not only is her apartment super clean and comfy, the location was unbeatable (seriously so easy to get to anywhere in BK or Manhattan from this spot), and she gave us so many incredible recommendations! All in all it made for one of the best and least stressful trips I’ve ever had to New York, I highly recommend!

Please be careful here. SharedEasy is a total rip-off and absolutely not recommended!  Why?  First of all, the description says 4-6 bedrooms, but it should be noted that up to two people live in the other bedrooms. That means in the end I had 9 roommates.  With two mini bathrooms and a kitchen you can imagine how unpleasant that is. There were a lot of flies and small animals in the kitchen, which made the stay extremely disgusting.  There is mold everywhere in the corners, even in the bathroom on the ceiling and in the washing machine.  Communication with the team is extremely unpleasant, after my complaint I was sent an aggressive older gentleman who shouted in my face that they had cleaned everything.  Speaking of cleaning, weekly cleaning is a joke. Only the dustbins are emptied and the kitchen surfaces are wiped a bit. I cleaned my room myself and when I arrived I found hairballs from the previous tenants all over the floor. The napkin I used to wipe the floor was completely black.  Oh and the gym and co-working space memberships aren't really available.  Please be careful before I book here. SharedEasy has entire houses with many, many rooms, which is why there are so few reviews here. Google and look for other advertisements that contain exactly such testimonials. I wish I had analyzed more carefully before booking. That was totally my mistake. That's why I hope you don't fall for this trap in the future!

This place was very nice and cute, had easy walking distance to the subway. While it was not the best neighborhood,  we never felt unsafe, even walking around at night. Loved the fireplace and snacks she provided. Also, place had thin walls but everyone obeys the quiet hours which was nice! Overall, Gail was so fantastic and we would definitely stay here again! Especially as a couple it was perfect!

We have spent almost 10 days in this accommodation and the truth is that everything was perfect.  The arrival was super easy and the communication with Meng was quick and without problems.  The room is very good, very clean and comfortable. Very comfortable bed!  And the shower is better than the one at home haha! They left us soaps (conditioner too), towels and toothpaste.  Meng's parents are adorable, although they don't speak any English, but through signs we understood each other wonderfully.  The area is good, there are two metro lines next door and we have not had any problems even at night. To add a drawback, there is a lot of homeless but like in all of New York, being a totally commercial area with a lot of life during the day, at night it is lonelier. Line F is busier because there are several bars and restaurants at night, but the metro D area is lonelier because it is where all the fruit and vegetable stores are located, which are closed at night.  We would repeat without a doubt. We had Soho, Little Italy, West Village nearby, the Brooklyn Bridge, Williamsburg (an incredible neighborhood)... We think this accommodation has it all and we are super happy we chose it.  Thank you so much Meng!

I cannot stress how perfect this location is. Close to absolutely everything including the subway. Adorable apartment with a wonderful view and great amenities. Earplugs were provided but we slept great and didn’t experience a lot of noise on a Monday night. Incredibly affordable price for what you get in NYC. Next time I hope we can stay longer.

Great bang-for-your-buck stay! Sheila was an excellent host! She got back with us very quickly and accommodated us beyond our expectations. Located only 5 minutes from the train station, which was very convenient. Apartment was very clean upon our arrival.   Only complaint: as 2 women traveling in the city, walking from the station felt a bit unsafe late at night, but that was easily fixed with a quick uber. It also got very hot with the heater on without the windows open, but you get what you pay for! Alas, this place still receives 5 stars. Very thankful to have found this place last minute!

We found Sheila’s place to be very clean and comfortable.  It had everything we needed to prepare our own meals and feel at home.  We had a few questions/concerns when we first arrived but Sheila responded promptly and helped to quickly resolve them.  Although the neighborhood appears to be a bit sketchy, we found it to be safe and quiet and Sheila’s apartment is like a little haven.   A good supermarket and laundromat are located just up the road.  We would gladly stay here again the next time we’re in Brooklyn.

Place is small, but all we asked for. It is also nice and newly renovated. The building is rather old and the stairs narrow so better if you travel light. Sheila is very polite and quickly answered all our questions. We were worried that the neighborhood is dodgy and dangerous especially during the night, but in the end we felt super safe and haven't experienced any issues, even when we arrived to the place at 3am one night.

Very convenient that the subway transit is 5 min away supper close also many little stores and shops to purchase goodies and groceries. The location seems a little sketchy but it turned out to be safe.

We loved staying at Sheila’s place! It looked renovated because all of the appliances, floors, and restroom utilities were perfect. Convenient walk to the C/A/E train, and about 15 mins from the J. About 30-50 mins from Manhattan. The area seems a bit sketchy, but it’s really quiet at night for the most part, and it’s across from a school. Would book again!
Nice studio.  A little sketchy at night  Won’t come back just because Of the area.

The PROs:: This listing is in one of my favorite neighborhoods in Brooklyn. There's a chill, neighborly vibe and it offers easy train connections and plenty of smaller corner shops for your shopping convenience. The mini flats/room I stayed in had a kitchenette and everything there and in the bathroom was brand new and very well appointed. The room I stayed in also had a window air conditioning unit that kept the room cool and refreshing. The CONs: The building is pretty much all short term rental units, giving it a slightly creepy, abandoned vibe. No actual neighbors or life in the building at all, but if you like peace and quiet and to be left alone, that could also be an advantage.

Lincie was a lovely host , she helped us in all ways possible. She accommodated our flexible check in and check out timings , kept the place clean and was very responsive. The place is convenient from a location standpoint as it is just two minutes walk away from the closest subway, so it was very easy to manage commute. The streets are not that great and visibly and run noisy, there are some cases of drunk and homeless walk-in around, so need to be a little watchful there. Once you get inside the house, it is safe and clean. All in all good value for price and commute convenience.

Qing's airbnb was everything we were hoping for, for a nice staycation. Check in was extremely easy as instructions were given right before, and the parking on premises was the best part of it. Definitely book if you want a stress free stay.

Acceptable stay. It seemed a little expensive to us, although knowing that it is New York we understand the price. The house was very clean although we didn't have a WiFi connection until after a few days Maria fixed it and it was working well.   We didn't have any problems in the neighborhood where it is located, although we were afraid at some point. According to citizens, we had to be careful in Jamaica, especially at night.    Something we missed in the stay was a washing machine. Although we went to a laundromat very close to home that was very good.   Despite certain details, we are generally happy with our stay.

We had a good time during our stay. The location was perfect and the price was cheap for the type of room you get. Getting in and out of the city is possible with both metro card using the bus or paying tickets for LIRR.  Communication with the hosts were quick and clear, we were provided clear instructions as to how we can access the keys and enter our room.   The place is spacious and the beds were clean and comfortable.  We were also provided a good amount of towels and toilet paper. There were also body wash soap, shampoo, and conditioner available.  It was great, few things I could point out was the lack of mirrors as there is only one available in the bathroom. Lastly, the bath tub was pretty slippery, I hit my leg on my last day because of the tub, hopefully this gets resolved to avoid dangerous incidents. For the rest, I still think this was a good first experience for me using Airbnb.  Thank you for having us.

This place is awesome! While it boasts being close to LGA- it lacks to mention that it’s in a quintessential Astoria neighborhood. You are seconds away from great coffee, food and parks. Easy, stress free access and communication made our stay that much better. Couldn’t have gotten luckier with this place.

Lovely stay! warm and welcoming host! the location may seem unsafe to some but we commuted late night too and it was fine! Definitely recommend, tough to find such good living spaces in NY at that price rate!

Rob’s place was great!!! Decor was extremely beautiful. It’s everything you see in the pictures above. He was real quick with help opening the keyless entry. All bedrooms were a great size & beds were comfortable!! Nice game room with a game table. (pool, foosball & ping pong) 10/10 would definitely stay again!!! Thanks Rob.

I had a great time at Rob's airbnb! He was super helpful with directions and suggestions for places to go in the area. The airbnb was beautiful, so well decorated! The game room and selfie wall was definitely the best spot to hangout in the house. I also loved the welcome note and the espresso machine. Definitely would book again!

Rob Is very attentive and responds instantly to all of your needs.  The apartment was very cozy and clean.  Tastefully decorated and in a central location.  There  are plenty of food choices near by and the neiborhood is very quiet.  We thouroughly enjoyed our stay.
Excellent cozy and comfortable space. The owner, Rob, was responsive to our questions and checked in to make sure all was up to our expectations.   It was perfect for our family!

Rob was a great host - super quick to reply to messages. The place itself is super clean and all of us loved the interior decor, which is the main reason why I chose to book this listing. It is as simplistic yet stylish as pictured. We also enjoy the fact that there were many board games available in the game room.  The blankets and comforters supplied were extremely comfortable and cozy. Needless to say, I would 100% recommend this place to a friend and will consider restaying in the future.

Great place. Close to the train, very clean, and Rob is extremely easy to communicate with. You can clear tell Rob has gone above and beyond to make his place comfortable and welcoming to guests.    Would definitely stay again and recommend to friends and family.

The Airbnb is quite conveniently placed. It took around 40mins to get to Manhattan by subway. However, the room was tiny. For 30 pounds a night, it feels like a bit of a rip-off. The cold, bright lighting was unpleasant and could have been easily helped by placing a lamp in the bedroom. The toilet in the bathroom was also clogged for one of the days we were there, which was gross. Another detail which would have improved our stay would be to replace the pillows. They were so flat and uncomfortable, which I think is something so simple yet important to fix.  I understand that New York is expensive, but at least try and help your guests be comfortable by making small adjustments. It felt like the host didn't care enough to make the space nice to be in.

Robs place is a must!!  My family and I stayed here for 3 nights this December from Buffalo to celebrate Christmas and visit the city! First, location is on point! Walking distance to restaurants bars bakeries groceries you name it! I was so happy to get the queens experience and really enjoyed the whole area. Not to mention train station is nice and close.  Second, the decor is very fresh clean and cozy. The house is immaculately clean- and I can’t say enough about the linens. From the couch throws to the towels and bed sheets and duvets. It most definitely made for a comfortable stay and I slept like a baby every night!  Third, their was not only a keurig but a little instant espresso machine which I thought was great and most definitely got use out of. All the appliances are like brand new! The game room is a cute added addition which my whole family utilized, it really was a lot of fun and I can’t express how much we enjoyed our stay here!  Rob is extremely fast at responding to any questions and suggestions. Great host! Also had a sign board personalizing my welcome:)   It was awesome having a drive way to park in and not have to look for parking..(The only thing I’d be careful of is the driveway is tight so be cautious of the house's and your vehicle)  Overall two thumbs up and a definite recommendation
Very clean and cheerful unit!  Perfect for our needs.  Rob is an exceptional host who is extremely quick to respond.  Would highly recommend!

My family was satisfied with our clean and convenient stay here. Rob was responsive and accommodating. The flat is a bit short on natural light but still very comfortable. It was also one of the quietest places I’ve stayed this year. Worked well for us.

It was a pleasure staying at Rob's place. The place is very clean and well kept. It is very spacious with three bedrooms and a TV in each room, which I found to be very convenient. Having your own parking spot instead of having to park on the street was also a big plus. Rob was very easy to communicate with from beginning to end and answered all of my inquiries promptly. I recommend to anyone travelling and looking to stay in the Bayside area!

Rob’s Bayside apt is absolutely beautiful! We stayed here for a short girls weekend. The space is huge, definitely enough space for our group of 4! Beds, linens and towels were all so comfy, and the TV in each room was a really great touch. There is 1 parking spot available (priceless when visiting NY!!) but we were easily able to find street parking for extra cars we drove. The neighborhood itself is super quiet but easily walkable to the nearby restaurant and bar scene. The apartment is fun, welcoming and cozy. Rob was super responsive, helpful, and so easy to get in touch with. I would absolutely recommend this apartment to anyone visiting NYC!

Stay was great. Rob is super on top of the communication and wants to ensure that everyone has a great stay. The only thing we found a bit annoying is that this apartment is the ground level of a house and you can hear the neighbors upstairs. The outside noises also startled our baby. We got a noise machine and that resolved all our issues.

Very clean and nice place. We had plenty of room for our family of 5. Rob answered all questions very promptly. He provides plenty of towels for us to use. Location is very central and easy walking distance to LIRR.

Rob’s place was absolutely perfect for our family, including my 1.5-year-old nephew. It had everything we could possibly need, so much so that we actually wound up going out less because we didn’t want to leave. It’s beautifully decorated and we also got a lot of mileage out of the pool / foosball table! It’s such a blessing to find places like this to gather safely with loved ones after two years of the pandemic. We would love to come back and highly recommend it.

Rob’s place was amazing and the comfort and decor was only matched by his hospitality! We couldn’t have picked a better place to stay or have enjoyed it more. We wanted to spend a few days in Manhattan, but didn’t want to stay there. Bayside was perfect. Rob’s place was a short walk from the train and the awesome Bell Blvd. we will definitely be back!

Nice clean and well decorated place  Great stay for my family. Nearby playground for the kids. Walking distance to stores and restaurants. Quick commuter train to Penn Station. Rob was very easy to reach and helpful.

This 3bd 2ba place is a gem, rooms are large, with closet space and dressers to store clothing. The entire home is clean and the area is quiet.  Rob is responsive and kind, checked in if we needed anything throughout our stay. No detail was missed, from hand and dish soap, shampoo and shower gel, towels and a full kitchen with tea and coffee maker, toaster; microwave to comfortable throws and a game room.  We’re glad to have found this home when most accommodations were booked because of graduation. The home is also well maintained and clean. And we had parking!  If you’re looking for a CLEAN stay with ample room in a peaceful area, stay here. You won’t regret it! Thank you Rob & Brenda

Rob is one of the best host I ever had. He was very easy to communicate and fast with the response. We were struggling with the unexpected hot weather in May, and Rob brought in the brand new AC’s and installed them for us the right next day. He went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable.   The location was great. It’s a 15 minute walk to the Bayside LIIR station and short drive to many korean restaurants and Hmart. The neighborhood felt safe.   Rob’s place is very clean and lovely and has everything you could need. I️ would 100% recommend a stay here.

Never will I go back! Probably the worse bnb I been in smH . The house is old n smelly and the room has unsafe mold n rot from the ceiling (health hazard)  caution !!! The host Is ok he try’s to work wit u somehow

Rob's place is exactly as described in the listing.  Although it is way out in Queens, a Long Island Railroad station is nearby and it only takes 30 minutes to get to Penn Station in the heart of Manhattan.  The immediate neighborhood has a wide range of stores, good restaurants and exceptional bakeries.

Rob was a communicative host and even drove out to help us get into the house. Turns out it was my mistake that caused the issue but helpful nonetheless! Place was very clean, beds were very comfy, internet was great, and having the Roku TVs in each room was super convenient. Good amount of room for parking a vehicle in the back too. All in all very accommodating for a comfortable NYC stay.
Great spot! Very clean, Rob was amazing to deal with. Very accommodating. Had a wonderful stay!
Rob is a great host and his place is fantastic!
Rob was a great host. His communication was very prompt . House is located in good neighborhood and reachable to nearby shops and restaurants. We enjoyed our stay and will hope to come back again.
Rob’s place it’s a good place in Queens, clean, near of restaurants and in a very quiet neighborhood. You can stay comfortable on it

Rob is an excellent host and a great communicator. We had a major hiccup and our front door lock was broken at the beginning of the trip. Rob was on his toes 1st thing morning and he went ahead and replaced entire door. He even gave us courteous money back for the inconvenience. We have stayed in lot of airbnbs before but never met someone personally who actually owns the property and goes to such an extent to get it taken care of. Rob went above n beyond. In regards to property it’s nicely decorated, well equipped and good size per New York standard. Personal parking space was very useful as well. I would hardly recommend staying in properties by Rob.
This place is good. Included Parking was a big relief. Well maintained.  Communication was good. Rob replied promptly for any questions we had.

We stayed at Rob and Brenda’s place while here for a wedding. The place is,  absolutely beautifully decorated and gives off such a homey vibe. It was very comfortable,  clean and is well equipped.  They were very attentive and quick to communicate when needed to have any question answered. Instructions were also very easy and clear on how to get into the place.  The place is at such an amazing location to get around to almost anywhere and anything. Bell blvd is the main attraction street and is within walkable distance and has so many eateries and shops. If wanting to go into the city by public transport, the rail station is even walkable and the train will take you into the city,  if that is a destination on your stay.  We would highly recommend Rob and Brenda’s place and we are already talking about booking again when we make our next visit.   Thank you again Rob and Brenda for a great Airbnb experience! 😊
Rob ensured that we were well taken care of. The place was amazing and very clean. I would recommend this spot to anyone.
Rob was so accommodating! The place was immaculate and we had everything we needed. Thank you for a beautiful stay!

My family and I had everything we needed during our stay in NY. This place was conveniently located near public transit,  bars, a grocery store, and delicious restaurants. My favorite: Maria’s Mediterranean. The neighborhood was very safe and quiet. Rob was very accommodating and quick to respond.

The house is at a great location. You’re 3 mins away from the shopping centers in bayside and 20mins away down downtown flushing. Being able to park on-site in front of the house entrance made unloading convenient.   The house inside is clean and roomy. Each room was spacious.   Rob was great. Very detailed on instructions and responsive. We would definitely book again.
Absolutely amazing little getaway! Rob was really accommodating and very responsive! I loved the neighborhood. Definitely recommended!

We had a great stay at Rob’s place. It’s very walkable and there are many restaurants nearby. The unit looks just like the pictures and the beds were comfy. It’s an easy walk to the LIRR station that takes you in to Manhattan in less than 30 minutes. We would stay here again if we come back to the area!

My friends and I had a great stay together at Rob’s place. I personally enjoyed my stay the most. I know my friends only had one complaint which was that there weren’t enough hangers for them to use. Otherwise, our vacation overall was great and I would definitely love to book at Rob’s place again!!

Great stay. Roomy and as described. Beds extremely comfortable and Rob very available. The outside of the apartment had no pics. It’s not as nice as the inside, but the neighborhood is safe and w/in walking distance to amenities. I great value. Highly recommend.

Amazing cozy space with hall ways that smell to die for.   I met Omar; one of the co - host who happened to be out. Seemed like a very good person and I’m sure PetaGay is too!  The place was freshly renovated and I wish I had stayed longer considering how cozy the bed was.   The host was prompt in response and was super welcoming.  I CAN NOT stress how warm and welcoming their place was  This was one of my favorite Airbnb’s I’ve stayed in so far.   Parking was also fairly easy around here as there was ample street parking!  10/10 in everything.

Alberto is prompt in communication and the place is managed very well. You can relax, eat and sleep well in the room with little to no disturbances at night. The room, sheets, utensils and Bathroom were all spotless. You get well equiped kitchenette and also towels and toileteries. There were a lot of additional nick nacks in the room e.g. a large umbrella, humorous decor etc. The room doesn't have a view, the ome window it has also doesn't let a lot of sunshine in; so it is a little damp and dingy. Also, the AC is a small and old window AC (like in most NYC rooms) which makes a lot of noise which is helpful to fall asleep as white noise but is at times irritating when you can't hear the TV over the AC's noise. Location- Be careful when you put the address in Google maps, make sure it is 'West' 31st St and not 'East'. Lastly, I wouldn't recommend the location for first time NY tourists. The dirt, homeless crowd and under construction sidewalks make a scary impression of the neighborhood on you (which it is really not; except at night - like all other NYC neighborhoods).  Overall it is a nice stay for couples, and solo travelers.  Thanks to Alberto for a clean space!

Dominique’s place is very cozy and clean she did an amazing job for my special request I had for a valentines setup made my trip less stressful when I got there everything is setup already  will definitely booked again

Apartment conforms to the description. Femala was very responsive when we had a question or additional request for tableware. There were 5 of us in the apartment for 10 days, the beds were comfortable. The street is noisy (but like all streets in NYC), so it is best to bring earplugs. The neighborhood is popular but we never felt unsafe. Nearby transportation is very convenient to reach other areas of Manhattan. There is also a very good supermarket right next to the apartment.

The wonderful apartment, very clean. The only thing that there were no closets, the closet they have behind a door is for cleaning and a storage room for them that is locked with keys. It should be for guests since there is no space to leave clothes and it is uncomfortable. Otherwise, great. The apartment is very nice. The area is also a little unsafe, especially at night since we have even seen a fight, the neighborhood is low. But well, it can be overcome.

the apartment is as indicated in the ad, located 5 minutes walk from 2 metro stations which is rather practical for journeys, which are already quite long since the area is quite far, allow around 40 minutes by metro to access downtown Manhattan.  moreover, being 2 girls, we were not very reassured in the evening when entering the metro, many alcoholic or drugged people were present in the metro and when leaving it.  Good point: Terrence was able to accommodate us for the arrival and departure time since our return flight was in the evening and he left the keys for us all afternoon so that we could leave our suitcases in the apartment without being cluttered all day.  However, a rather strange event happened after our arrival, one of our computers magically disappeared from the apartment (perhaps due to a mistake on our part in having closed the apartment incorrectly (we don't remember)), we went to see Terrence who didn't seem to take seriously the fact that we had our computer stolen, he told us that he would watch the videos, we had to restart it so that he could tell us if people other than the residents had returned or not, however we were never able to access the videos, so we will never know what really happened during our absence...

what i didnt like is that you can go out when is dark and can go out when is to early the área is hot very dangerous and the host gave me a bucket thats if i get to drunk to threw up there i am Just looking for a place to rest in peace

So we def booked for the 4/20 deal but I’m sorry this place was so dirty, I could never recommend someone to stay. James is making too much money for his pillowcases to be stained as well as sheets. The bathroom tub had a ring around It, I could not shower in there. The microwave is dirty and has no plate inside, as well as it’s in a make shift kitchen in the front of the house where it’s freezing. Mouse traps all over the “kitchen” as well. Our tv didn’t work and James def took his time to get It to work (finally provided a fire stick) said the last remote was stolen.  All the doors slam, so everyone is slamming doors between there rooms and bathroom, annoying when you trying to sleep. Someone weird lives on the first floor, he saw us coming in one night and slammed the door like he was afraid. Overall bed was soft, so If you need a place to crash not big on cleanliness and  into 4/20 then book him

Daniel and Melissa’s place was the perfect home base for our weekend in Manhattan and Brooklyn. It was beautiful, well decorated, and cozy yet spacious at the same time. Daniel and Melissa were very communicative and helpful, which made our stay stress-free! We recommend this spot and hope to return as well!

Are you looking for a home away from home while you're visiting New York? If yes, this is the AirBNB for you.   Ivan, Marcia, and the rest of the family are genuinely some of the kindest, most welcoming people I've ever had the pleasure to stay with and I've traveled all over the globe. I legitimately felt so welcome in their home and never felt like I was intruding.   Marcia was super easy to communicate with and very flexible with my arrival. As soon as I walked into the apartment she warmly greeted me, made me coffee, and fed me cookies. She's the kind of woman that could easily become a second mother figure after a long enough time.  The apartment itself was immaculately clean, spacious, and comfortable. My room during the stay was clean and comfortable.   While the room was on street level and there was some noise, it wasn't excessive. Honestly, street noise is to be expected in New York. If you're looking for total silence you're in the wrong city!   The bathroom was modern and had a large tub and shower and was cleaned daily. The kitchen had a snack and coffee station and plenty of room for dining in.   The location is convenient and within 0.2 miles of a subway line that takes you down town quickly. I should also note that I am a single female and I never felt unsafe in the area. Obviously you need to be smart and stay aware, as with traveling anywhere, but I never felt like I was at risk.   I travel to NY often and will 100% be staying in this apartment again!

Was a wonderful air bnb. Such a welcoming and lovely family to be around. Train station was super close and made it very easy to get around. Area felt safe and I personally never felt in danger. I would return pretty late and always felt safe coming back to the air bnb. House was very clean and lots of accommodations. Bed was super comfy and the space as whole was spacious. Definitely would come back!

I can’t say enough good things about my stay. I was staying there in transit to my new apt and Ivan was super accommodating. The communication was fast and clear.    I wasn’t feeling the best most of the time because I was tired and had to go to work but knowing I was coming back to a clean, safe and secure place was extremely comforting during my stressful move.  The bathroom stayed spotless. There was minimum noise. And the building was secure. The bed was a dream too. Got some real good sleep there.  The bedroom was small but cozy and gave me what I needed. I didn’t turn on the tv once but I did use the wifi with no problem.  The only thing I could say that may need to be checked are the sockets because I had a hard time getting my devices to charge.  Other than that, beautiful cats, friendly people and warm and clean place to stay in an extremely central location. I work in Midtown so the commute was easy breezy. I would definitely recommend them and book again!

Ivan is a pleasant host, however as soon as we arrive at the accommodation we are attacked by a violent mixture of cat urine and kitchen smells. The accommodation is never ventilated. We left early in the morning and returned late in the evening. I do not recommend Ivan's accommodation for this reason.

Maria’s attitude did not make me comfortable because i was reprimanded for things the other guests did.  I felt as if i was homeless being allowed to stay at a strangers home.  I kept TV volume low, wipe the labatory and shower after use.   Be prepared and bring a heavy coat because specially at night the Air Conditioner thermostat is set to very cold temperatures.  I was saved cause Maria provided me with a warm blanket.

The PERFECT Airbnb. Don’t be fooled by the low review count.  The unit is spacious, incredibly clean, beautifully decorated, and very well stocked with supplies and a few snacks. I personally would use this Airbnb every time I fly into NYC. Also, the hosts are wonderful individuals.  There’s so much good about this Airbnb, I have to mention what you may not like, because you can just assume that everything else is perfect.  The Airbnb is located in east Brooklyn, which means two things: you’re about an hour subway ride from Manhattan, and the area is a bit more sketchy than other locations in west Brooklyn. However, the only time you actually have to spend in east BK is about an 8 minute walk to the subway. That being said, the street the Airbnb is actually on is nice, — i saw quite a few luxury vehicles (Mercedes’, bmw, Audi, a corvette) parked on what would seem like a sketchy street at first glance.  That being said, if what I mentioned doesn’t bother you or only bothers you slightly, than you should 100% book this unit without looking back, you won’t regret it.

Luke was super nice and let us check in much earlier, but the bed ocupies the whole room, which is very uncomfortable, and the area where the apartment is located is not very nice, there were homeless people living at the building door who were a bit aggressive when trying to get in at night. Luke was super sweet and considerate, but I don’t think it’s worth the money. We could’ve gotten a pretty decent hotel for the same price.

I loved my stay, it was perfect, the room was very clean and tidy, the bathroom was wonderful, I loved the location, I was afraid to go back alone at night, but then I was calm with the neighborhood, as it is a very family neighborhood with respectful people , I felt safe at all momentl, many restaurants close by and the subway station is 10 minutes walk away. I highly recommend and would go back.

I really enjoyed my stay in your apartment. The apartment was nice, cozy, clean and tidy. The area where it is located in Queens is beautiful, quiet and with a flow of people (which made me feel safe walking), there are shops nearby, places to eat, a large square with many shops and the subway (these last two are about a 10-minute walk from the apartment). The subway from the location of the apartment to Times Square has 15 stations, which go quickly, and it is a direct line without changing stations.    I am a very lazy person, so I left the apartment at 8am and returned around 10-11pm and I never felt unsafe walking alone so late at night in the area.  It was 2 degrees (even down to 0) and the apartment always felt warm, you didn't even remember that it was freezing with snow outside.   The hosts are very friendly, respond quickly to messages and are always available for anything you need. I liked that about them, their attention.

Check in and out same day; first the key has to be taken from a place "in the street" which makes me feel unsafe since there were a lot of people around; apartment is in the 4th floor and there is no elevator on the unit. It take me a lot of effort to take my luggage through the stairs; entire place full of dust, bedsheets  smell like someone else was sleeping there and did not clean the place after they live. Neighborhood it is exactly safe: there are people around using drogs and restaurant options are very bad. Pros: the host is very responsive and agree immediately to cancel the reservation and refund the money.

The apartment is beautiful- from the huge & very cute outside area to the inside space which is also very cute & well accommodating. I love the neighborhood with it’s tree lined streets and close proximity to everything. Anyone that says they feel unsafe there or it’s loud (it’s not) has either never been to NYC/BK or didn’t step outside if they have. Would definitely stay here again.

The apartment was great for me, and completely met my needs for a satisfying  visit to New York.  The size is ideal for up to two, and is equipped with all practical supplies, i.e. kitchen, bedroom, living room and bathroom.  Lots of storage, great shower and comfortable bed.   A highlight for me was the furnished private patio.  Even when the temperature was very high, there are trees providing shade enough keep it cool enough to use.  The neighborhood is clean, friendly and convenient.  A plus to be across the street from Charles Schurz Park.  There are not only many green areas but also a beautiful promenade for walks along the East River.  Getting around the city is very convenient with a mix of city busses and the Q train only a couple blocks away.  The host Natasha is very responsive, check in and check out was seamless.

We were in room 3 of the accommodation, the room faces the street and is a bit noisy. The room is a little small for two, but the accommodation has everything we needed. Even the laundry service helped us a lot. Bill always gave us clear instructions and responded every time we needed him. The area is a little far from downtown and at night it seems a little unsafe.  It is two blocks from the subway, which was very helpful for us, and two blocks from Central Park.  Something to highlight is the cleanliness of the place and Bill's attention. They always renewed the towels and anything we left to wash in the accommodation. We definitely recommend it and we would return.

My bedroom was very comfortable and the bathroom was clean and functional.  It did not occur to me to pack a washcloth, but this was not an insurmountable problem.  Maria was very helpful.  The property is conveniently located to the 90th Street-Elmhurst Ave. stop on the 7 train.  I'm an older woman, and I walked back from the subway twice fairly late at night--it didn't feel creepy.  The stay worked out great for me.

This is an unsafe place, as he asked us not to luck the main unit door . Very dirty, full of bugs everywhere. Last day, after a thunderstorm, the ceiling was leaking and our stuff was full of water.  Free parking on the street is a big lie , there is only for weekends.  He said he will refund us but he didn’t even refund a night , he decided to refund us 75 usd although we piad 200 per night  Even Airbnb didn’t help us . We never come back to this platform. All are liers to take our money. When we complained Airbnb said we had to send them an email during the days while we were there not after checkout not to refund us. They never mentioned this policy anywhere

Amazing stay in Upper West Side! The room and common spaces such as the kitchen/bathroom were very tidy. If you are lucky, your fellow guests will be cool and you can have wonderful conversations as the ambience is neat in this apartment. The kitchen is equipped with many utensils and the fridge is pretty large. You can use the powerful washing machine and drier which are inside the unit, which is a luxury in New York. I left a phone when leaving and Bill was so kind to safeguard it till I could return to pick this up. The safety is supreme in this apartment with two locks at the entrance and two more on way to your room, which is amazing for tourists in these days who are very scared  Location: As this is close to Columbia University, you see students living in the same building of this Airbnb. This is a lively neighbourhood too, close to many hangout spots in the Amsterdam Avenue. Tourists staying here told that the travel is comfortable to the main attractions of Manhattan such as the Times Square and museums

A great place to stay while on a trip to NYC. Although Bill does not reside on site, he was very communicative and responsive. A small mixup during check in was quickly and easily resolved. Bill has also provided amenities beyond anything I've ever been offered during a AirBnb stay. Umbrellas, slippers, first aid, and care for your feet after a day of walking in the city. Since it is a 4 bedroom apartment, and NYC apartment walls are notoriously thin, a sound machine is included in the bedroom. While I was staying, each bedroom was occupied and there was plenty of room and privacy for everyone. During my stay I never felt unsafe in the apartment or in the neighborhood. Bill is a very understanding host. I injured myself during my stay and Bill checked in on me to ensure I was doing ok. I highly recommend booking Bill's location for your next stay in NYC!
This must be a scam.

I would not recommend it if you go with children, the staircase to go is very small and the stroller almost does not fit. There are broken tiles in the bedroom where my son could have hurt himself and the toilet seat is broken! There is no light at the entrance, it seems like you are breaking in to steal! We only went to the house to rest but those upstairs made noise and you can hear everything until 11 or 12 at night every day. We haven't rested well because of the noise. I do not recommend this stay at all.

The apartment fit our needs perfectly. We used to live a 10 minute walk away, so to visit, it was the perfect location. It's only a 3 minute walk to the subway and bus, groceries, bank, drug store on Allerton Ave or on White Plains Rd. It's also a 10 minute walk to the hidden entrance to the Botanical Garden at the end of Waring Ave. Josh was quick to answer any questions or concerns. The suggestions of restaurants and activities they provided was helpful in discovering new places to explore. We would happily stay again!

Hershey was genuinely an excellent host who was very proactive about making sure my stay was as smooth as possible. I very much appreciated how clean and detailed the space was. Would stay here again!  Notes to quell any concerns for future guests:    - If you are driving to NYC, you can easily park in front of the Hershey's apartment building and unload your car. I had to make multiple trips and did not feel like I had to rush because of traffic or any other concern.  - I kept my car at a local parking garage using a separate parking app. It was very easy to do. I recommend using a ride share or public transportation to get to and from your car wherever you choose to leave it.   - The proximity to the C train can not be overstated on much of a plus it is to Hershey's space. The apartment alone is great, but being able to walk outside and immediately get on the train was spectacular. Made the trip much less stressful to plan.  I highly recommend staying at one of Hershey's properties!

Room: The pictures looked great and the room looks similar to the pictures. There are 3 other long term tenants here. The room is really small and all guests and tenants share amenities.  Location: Very sketchy location, not centrally located. However, it is close to the train station but many stops and transfers to Times Square.  Communication: Initially, great !! I communicated to the host that I would have a visitor just as her house rules requested. She said it was fine. When I invited my visitor over moments later a guy came knocking on the door requesting that I and my visitor leave since we broke house rules. I was really confused and asked that he speak to the host that I made reservations with. He told me the host was his wife and that there was no need because she wouldn’t allow such a thing. I tried showing the messages between his wife and I and he refused to look and suggested that I may have manipulated her to allow me to have a visitor. At this point I asked my visitor to leave and I left the next morning after I made other accommodations.  Amenities: Bathroom is good size and kitchen is too. Elevator was out when I was there and the security door that allowed access to the building was also broken. TV does not work.. funny story about that 😅 I ended up finding accommodation here: The Elite Suite and it was an AMAZING property, was close to everything and was affordable. search Google for it

The space is super nice, cozy and charming. But unfortunetely I had problems the last 2 days, I couldn't shower, there was a problem with the hot water, that I couldn't shower for 2 days! Imagine, it was very cold weather I spent all day outdoor in Storm King Art Center, walking, when I got to the Airbnb in the night, ready and naked to shower: cold water! I should have been told about. I knew because I asked. I had to sleep dirty. Day after I waited all morning but NO hot water, I had to leave and fly for 18 hours (to Copenhague) dirty! It was very bad feelings for these 2 days. I had no assistence about, only "sorry". Another problem is, if you have sleeping troubles there is an anoying sound from the heating pipes that wakes you up in the middle of the night, it is scaring, I should have known about that also. The building is from the last century, that is umderstandable, but information is very important, that give us the possibility to choose if we are ok and tolerance or choose another place that fit us better.

Vanessa’s place is an affordable and pretty nice location in NYC. It was my first time to share an apartment with AirBnb, but everything was OK. My room had a super size flat screen TV. The neighborhood was a little bit shady for me, but probably because of my first experience in NYC. I had an amazing time. There are plenty of shops, pizza places and nice restaurants near Columbia Uni which is a 15 min. walk. Apartment is very close to Number 1 Subway Line and you can get easy to all sightseeing. Communication with Vanessa was very smooth. Price is unbeatable and I definitely recommend.

We were looking for an affordable air bnb for a weekend stay in the city and we found it with Naa-Sakle’s space! Located near a Brooklyn subway stop, it was easy and convenient to get around the city. The space is exactly as she describes, and there were no unpleasant surprises. The place was clean, and the day bed is extremely comfortable. We will definitely stay again in the future!

This was an excellent stay! I surprised my wife for her 30th Birthday here and it was superb from start to end. Rob & Tiffany were both very helpful, polite, and responsive for every need and all questions. I highly recommend this place and hope to return in the future! Very chic environment and awesome amenities throughout the premises.

We arrived as a group of 6. The airbnb had given our 3 bedroom away. Because they had given our room away that was booked in March, we had to split into two groups in two separate rooms. The wait was over an hour for our room. The doors/locks were broken, so we always had to wait for someone to let us in, even after going out at night.  This is my 2nd time booking this place and my 1st time experiencing this. I'll never book again, the stress the place caused made our trip really stressful

We stayed at the Placemakr for a week-long family holiday/college tour visit to NYC. It was in an awesome location, close to all the subway lines and across the street from NYC ferry pier. Deli’s and drug stores nearby, and so many restaurants to choose from in the area. The space was super clean, and the amenities just perfect. We would definitely choose to stay here again in our next visit.

Hotel that feels like a home; you get all the conveniences of being in a hotel while still feeling comfortable during your stay. The place was clean, the staff was exceptional, and the process was stress free.

This studio is not a scam, it’s exactly how it is shown in the pictures. It’s very cute and it’s close to everything. We enjoyed  our time. However the first night was messed up. It’s not Jens fault it’s her cleaning lady’s fault. When we first arrived  the key was not located in the box, we waited 3 hrs outside in the cold which made me think maybe it was a scam.  The lady that was monitoring and cleaning the place finally got a hold of me and mention she thought we were coming in the next day. She didn’t meet up with us , she dropped the keys in the key box and left. After we got the keys and walked in the apartment we first noticed the place was dirty. Jen is out of the country but I was able to message her  and let her know how dirty it was. Jen apologize and was nice to come up with an agreement. Her cleaning lady ruined our plans for our first night. I hope she finds someone else that will be more professional managing her place.  Other then that we decided to stay and we had a blast!! I would definitely come back

This rental was a mixed bag. I wouldn't stay again & wouldn't recommend it to a friend, but it might fit some people's needs perfectly. Positives: Location- short walk to Central Park, close to a local subway stop (i.e. not an express stop), & plenty of stores, restaurants, & bars nearby. The host was also very timely & clear with communications, so check-in was easy. My room, the floors, & the kitchen were clean. Negatives: This is basically an adult hostel with 4 numbered rooms. I met people in 2 of the other rooms (all seemed to be other guests), not sure if the remaining belongs to the host. Both showers were gross (so much hair & the grout lines were orange). My room (but not the apartment) was so warm I wore my lightest clothes & opened the window (despite it being winter) & I was still sweating. My mattress was very uncomfortable.  Lastly, the apt rules said we weren't allowed to talk to anyone in the apartment stairwell (i.e. the building's tenants). Why? This felt very sketchy

Luke was a very nice host!  I had a very warm welcome at his place. It’s good to have someone who you can talk to if you have questions, but also let you live your own life.  Price quality is amazing! The couch was very soft & comfy; and the stay was amazing!  The neighborhood can feel a bit sketchy being a girl alone, but it’s not unsafe :)).  Would recommend for sure :)

My birthday was ruined cause I decided to book this location to celebrate. I booked 2 months in advance. I arrived at the townhouse for check in & upon my arrival there were other guest there decorating for their party.. I was so confused I contacted the host (peter) immediately. I was told that there was a double booking & they would have to cancel my reservation. Keep in mind I booked 2 months prior. The other person told me they booked a week ago. In all fairness I felt that being that I booked sooner. I should be able to keep my reservation.  I was told being that they paid more money than me. They have to be accommodated. I did some research on this host & I found out they’re a group of guys that scam ppl & also take side deals outside of air bnb If the side deal is more than your air bnb booking they will cancel your reservation the day of check in. Please be aware!

Very nice and clean home ! Nice decor, I only stayed for one night so it was a good stay , if I were staying longer I would not be pleased. We had to leave our doors unlocked all night because the key didn’t even work to lock the downstairs door. There weren’t anything to clean with after ourselves and the toilet clogged after the first use, the ceiling in the bathroom started to drip brown water ? And the heating was very complicated because I did not know the electrical equipment but the host sent someone to help with that.  Other than that the home was very clean, and comfortable beds and couch! The host said no drugs but the entire building smelled like marijuana… no loudness or music but others in the building played music and were very loud. You could hear loud talking and laughing . I wouldn’t recommend for a long stay but a short two day trip sure. I did leave some things in there due to the fact I had to hurry and catch my train. I did not meet the host just met some guy she kept sending.

The host is great and the apartment was clean and well furnished. The only drawback was the location; it was not the safest location and was very loud outside. We felt scared walking back from the subway at night time.

Nice and cozy apartment. Good host. The neighborhood seemed a bit sketchy at night but it was close to the subway and it was interesting to see a different side of NY. We enjoyed our stay in the apartment.

The room itself it’s good if you just want a place to crash at night.. the neighborhood is a bit scary at night so I don’t recommend coming too late via public transportation… however Gordon is a great host, very responsive and helpful

Emily's place is really a steal for a nice stay in NYC. The apartment is indeed very cosy and the neighbourhood is calm but still very close to the subway and the shops. You will reach Union Square in less than 15 minutes and be able to explore Brooklyn quite conveniently. The bedroom is quiet as it's in the back of the building and the kitchen has everything you need to cook or enjoy a quick meal. I would definitely stay here again.

Overall it was a great experience. You get what you paid for but I think it’s well worth the price especially if you’re only visiting. Would recommend as the neighborhood is safe there is a jewish community so walking home at night wasn’t scary at all. It lacked a bit of cleanliness but you can bring your own wipes if you like things to be super clean. Great communication and super friendly!

I expressed that I wasn’t safe because I was treated with a pistol by her other guest and her only concern that I bought another guest the only reason I did so because I was unsafe. No sympathy or empathy for my sake just her pockets. DISGUSTING!

Travelling alone as a young female can be scary. Jose was an excellent communicator. Answered all of question immediately. The place was very clean and private so I felt safe. Location was close to everything I needed in easy walking distance. Would stay again!
Very good location, close to the subways and the host is very friendly and it is not a dangerous area

Sometimes it's hit and miss with Air BnB. Unfortunately this was a huge miss mainly due to disrespectful guests staying in the adjacent room. After my first night l could smell marijuana creeping into my room. It stinked and gave me a bit of a headache. I reported it to my host and he confronted the other guests who admitted to smoking pot and getting high. Host promised it would stop or the guests would be kicked out. However, the smell of pot continued into the next day and I reported for a second time to my host. The option for me to leave and get refund my final two nights of my reservation was presented but l chose not to take it but instead stuck it out even though l was not happy. In the end, the potheads stayed in the next room and l was forced to suck it up because l unfortunately chose to stay. Honestly, I felt l was placed into an awkward position of reporting recreational drug use by other guests which only continued and was never properly dealt with. Very disappointed.

The place seemed great as described, but Chris said nothing about the fresh coat of polyurethane on the floors. Looked great but the fumes made the entire place dangerous to stay. We got headaches within minutes or arriving and had to immediately leave and find a hotel. It was a shame and a terrible mistake to rent it out before the fumes cleared. No one could stay in that. Otherwise it seemed great.

This shit was terrible, the host didn’t say there was gonna be other guess that I would be staying with, didn’t mention anything about cameras being inside which is mad creepy, the said smoking not allowed but hookah does not even count as smoking cus it’s not weed… this whole shit was terrible and i wouldn’t wanna experience it again I would not recommend this place. It’s 1/10

Space is a described. Koichi communicated well and the room was in good condition. The bathrooms are shared on the floor, but aren’t very clean. The hallway had an unpleasant smell. Staying in the room was fine though

I stayed at this Airbnb for 1 night. First, there was no communication at all with the host. I struggled with all 3 locks on 3 different doors to get into my actual room. I understand security but I don’t believe it was for my safety more so the apartments safety. Plus the creepy camera. It took 10 mins at the main entrance outside in the cold at night to get in because the instructions weren’t clear. Too many locks that are too high tech and confusing. But I did figure all of them out on my own because I reached out for help and the entire stay there was no communication whatsoever. Thanks 🤦🏽‍♀️ Room looked simple and had the basics. And I did actually see a 🪳! crawling on the refrigerator. I felt like I wasn’t in a clean space.  There was a black footprint on the wall.. which is a clear sign that the room needs to be cleaned more thoroughly. And the bathroom needs to be cleaned as well especially under the sink. I hope I helped give some beneficial advice. Thank you 🙏🏽

It is a 3-story house in which the first floor belongs to the owner and you go up some stairs to the house with a basic door with a key.  We found the house quite dirty, in some beds the pillows were directly on the floor, the beds were as if unmade, as if before we entered someone had taken a nap on them.  The sofa cushions thrown in a corner and under a small table next to the sofa.   Upon entering the house there was a strong and unpleasant smell.   They left us towels but face size. We had to order more because there wasn't enough for everyone.  In general the cleaning was quite bad.   The iron was from the 60's and there was no dryer.   On the other hand, the house is very well located, with bars and an area of ​​delicious restaurants nearby. It takes a fairly short time to Manhattan and is easy to get to.  The landlord is quite attentive and if you need anything he helps you.   It has heating that works very well.   I would return to the same house if they took more care of the cleanliness because in general it was not bad, but cleanliness is essential.

Unfortunately I have to say that it was the worst accommodation experience I have ever had. First of all, Gilbert was not at all attentive to us. But the worst thing was that the house was extremely dirty and messy. All common areas were full of dirt and debris on the floor. The room has a very bad smell and the sheets were not clean. Despite everything, we would have slept if at least the bathroom had been in good condition. But this was far from being a bathroom, the host did not inform us not to use the bathroom. We didn't even shower, there were traces of dirt everywhere, wet towels on the floor with stains, all kinds of used hygiene utensils, really vomiting.  I will never forget the unpleasant night we spent there. The next day we were able to find another accommodation and we canceled this one.

The Airbnb itself was cute and although the room was small, we knew it was going to be a small space. The best thing about this place is definitely its convenient location. Some reviewers mentioned that the alley that the entrance is in is creepy at night, but we never felt creeped out by it. It’s also worth noting that there are no public restrooms available since they’re undergoing construction.  That said, there were a few things that could have been better:  The duvet covers on both beds smelled musty.  When booking, it looked like there were units available at various locations near 3 Freeman Alley, including on a completely separate intersection on the other side of the block. I spent a while picking out the best location, only to find out that all units are in the same building on 3 Freeman Alley, where you are instructed to check in. When I asked for clarification on this so I could make sure we knew where we were supposed to be staying vs. just checking in, the contact was not very helpful, and I was left wondering until we checked in.  Throughout our stay, front desk was always friendly and helpful. However, the day we checked out, we went to check our bags at the front desk, and the person working that day was extremely rude and condescending. He was helping someone else when we got there, so we stayed back and were going to wait, but he immediately asked if we needed help. We explained what we needed and he seemed annoyed and told us that we needed to wait because he was helping someone else, as if we had demanded he help us first. When he got to us, he kept asking questions but then interrupting as we tried to answer. He’d end up asking for the information we tried to give him to begin with, explaining in a condescending way why he needed it, not understanding that we tried telling him just a moment ago. When we came back to pick up our luggage, he asked us with a straight face where he stored it, and we didn’t know what to say.. he then asked us to come back and identify our luggage, which we felt was inappropriate. We could’ve easily said someone else’s luggage was ours, and it didn’t seem like he would’ve known otherwise.
