We’re generally pretty understanding people, but we were all shocked by how rude and incompetent he was. This experience left a really bad taste in our mouths, after what was otherwise a fine experience.

Great location and communication. Quick check-in and checkout. The alley did not seem sketchy at all. The room was pretty clean though I will say the room trash must not have been emptied between guests because there were q-tips and stuff. I would have also preferred for there to be top sheets; the beds just had a comforter and because the setup is more hotel than Airbnb it would have made me feel more comfortable to have top sheets. Great bang for your value overall.

First of all, it’s an Alley, but not scared at all! Even if you’re a girl by yourself, it feels safe. The place was exactly as in the pictures and description. Employees were super friendly and always helpful. The room is small and the only part that wasn’t comfortable was the bench to watch tv, but it was a minor problem. They have filtered water stations to fill up bottles in every floor and free replacements of K-cups coffee. Overall, a really good room in a really good location. We were basically 10-20 min from everywhere we wanted to go. Really recommend.

Jc's room was clean and tidy, a steal for the price! He was also very responsive and was able to answer any questions I had in a timely manner. The area is also quiet, so if you don't mind walking a bit to the nearest subway stop, this room is a great deal.

Huge space with so many sleeping options available for a large group. Incredibly convenient for the Subway line that takes you directly into Manhattan. Food and Drug stores all in walking distance along with restaurants and delis.   Incredibly clean, newly renovated and well stocked with household items for a stay.   Hosts would answer all questions in minutes.   10/10

We were visiting with friends and found the appartment really great for our needs. We booked it since it had separate bedrooms, a nice sitting area where to have breakfast all together and also in the evening just sit, relax and  discuss what we had seen and done during the day. Also the kitchen had everything we needed when we used it a few times for cooking some meals. Distance to the metro stop was like 5 minutes and there was also a shop at the corner with friendly staff. It suited us really well that there was a keybox so when we did not all spend our day together at the city then we could just leave the key there and did not have to worrie about how to time our arrival back in the evening. Ofcourse we all are experienced travellers so I must say that some people could find this neighberhood a bit scary and with a lot different vibe then what you experience on the 5th Av for example. However the appartment itself really is perfect, with comfortable beds, lots of space and was super clean. I would deffinately stay there again and therefore can really reccommend it!

This is a very basic, not a wonderful listing, as advertised. The beds sag, badly. The shower smells musty and appears unsanitary. The building, though close to Empire State, etc., exudes a creepy vibe. Fernando was prompt. Checkin was smooth. I would only stay here if nothing else was available. I felt misled by the listing. Again, it is not wonderful as described. We canceled after 30 minutes and opted for a hotel.

Great location, super close to Hudson yards, subway and Friedman’s which is a great place for breakfast/brunch and it’s less than a block away. Be aware that they are renovating so the front is kinda sketchy looking, but inside it’s nice, clean and the staff is very cordial. We needed a fridge for health reasons and they went out of their way to provide it. Also, in case you’re a tall person, I’m 5’10” (1.78cm) and the bed was really short for me, I had to sleep diagonal in order to fit in the queen size bed, so it wouldn’t be able to fit 2 tall people comfortably.

Very clean, small space but most of NYC lodging is small. Construction in the areas so its a little challenging to find. Plenty of good security to make you feel safe. A little further from Times Square than expected.  We had a great stay. My only complaint is getting a call from a front desk employees personal cell phone, after we checked out, asking for my credit card info over the phone so they refund my deposit. When i said I would call back at the hotel number i got a text from him that he figured it out and I didnt need to call. Seemed sketchy and made me uncomfortable

Great place to stay with a friend. Good value, location and accommodations. Friendly staff and it was easy to find (there is no longer be construction like we saw in other reviews). Communication could be better. The instructions say to check in before 6pm and plan accordingly, we were going to be there close to 6pm and perhaps a few minutes after so I messaged the host when we landed but never heard back. It just was a little stressful with NY traffic to not know if we wouldn’t be able to check in. We got there right at 6pm and the check in was great! The front desk person was also there for a while after 6pm so I’m not sure what it says that. A simple reply back would have made this experience 5 stars. Really great place to stay.

You get what you pay for at this location. Building is nothing special.  Location is convenient although a little scary.  Apartment was just like pictured.  Mattresses are minimal but OK.  Linens are cheap and well worn but clean. Staff was helpful.  We never had a problem walking to the apartment  even at night. I would stay again.
the apartment is very near of many attractives places. But the Corea town street has many homeless and drugs

The studio itself is great! Just like in the pictures - it's very clean and has everything you need. The building is a little sketchy and the front desk staff was not very helpful or nice. It seems like they treat anyone entering the building as suspicious.  Otherwise, great stay! Now that I know what to expect, I would book it again.

It's a good place.    The place perfectly accommodated three adults each with their own bed, there are three double beds, a family of 6 could fit in with 2 people sharing each bed, the place is a single private room on the seventh floor of a building, spacious, clean, pleasant, with private bathroom, kitchen, refrigerator, very central, located in midtown by the Empire State building, Macys Herald Square, 4 blocks from Times Square, it is close to many things, really very good location, subway stations two blocks away, I read some comments about why the area did not feel safe, when leaving the building, like in many other places, you meet some homeless people who come to ask you for money but that's all, I didn't feel unsafe, there are such homeless people all over Manhattan. Good price for what the place gives you, a hotel in the area of the Empire State building would have been perhaps the same price or a little more but only with two beds and without the possibility of having an equipped kitchen and refrigerator at your disposal to save a little on breakfasts and dinners by preparing them in the apartment, there are grocery stores in the area, I highly recommend it for families of 3 to 6 people, unfortunately for us Latin Americans the prices are very high in the USA compared to what the services cost in our countries, and it is always good to try to save something on the trip on lodging and food, don't think about it, this is a good option, a good price for Manhattan and the possibility of saving on food by preparing it in the apartment.  Something important is also that the building has two places to pay $7 USD per day per suitcase to leave ordered suitcases and it has a laundry room.    We visited New York at the end of January, temperatures between zero degrees and -10 degrees Celsius, I recommend coming wrapped up warm, nothing out of this world, I thought it would be colder. Good luck travelers! Enjoy New York!!!

Was in town for a few nights to see some shows, and I'm easy so I went with something relatively inexpensive.   Checkin was easy, and they even let me into my room a half hour earlier than scheduled.  Staff was very friendly and responsive at all times.    The room was very basic, but had a fridge and microwave.  Bed was comfortable.  Bathroom could have been a bit cleaner/in better condition, but nothing outrageous.   The area isn't the best.  I'm a large man, so I didn't feel unsafe, but I could see other folks having a different experience.   But it is *very* convenient to Times Square, Madison Square Garden, and any Broadway or off Broadway show you'd want to see.  I walked everywhere, only hopping in a cab when my feet hurt or I was in a rush.   Definitely a 'get what you pay for' situation, but I got more than my money's worth.  Would stay again.

The apartment is very well located, we have been able to make many trips on foot, and when we felt like it we had good metro connections.  Vanessa and Rob are good hosts, they made it easy for us to arrive and leave, which was not easy due to schedules.  The apartment is clean, and has all the essentials we needed.  It is a quiet area.  We would definitely repeat.
My friends and I had a great stay here. Aleks was responsive and this Airbnb is a steal! Great location and I felt safe. Very spacious and I would stay here again :-)

This was just as advertised except for the deck space....which is even better and upgraded with a newer and more stylish feel!  This is in Gramercy and that speaks for itself as far as location and access to places in Manhattan. The space itself held us three travelers and never felt claustrophobic. Everything was in working order and clean. Communication with the host was quick and concise! As a first time traveler to NYC, this space and host took away any stress/anxiety I had about lodging. You see what you get and as with any vacation rental, not having issues let us focus on the other aspects of our trip. Would rent again.

Overall, I had a decent stay, and the rooftop was my absolute favorite amenity. There were a couple issues I encountered, like not getting the check-in instructions until after the check-in time or dirty dishes being left in the oven from the previous guest. However, after I checked in, Vanessa was very quick to respond regarding any issues. I will say that the beds were very comfy and Vanessa even leaves food/tea/coffee and a good selection of random pantry items in the cabinets, if you need a snack. Also, bring quarters if you end up needing to do laundry. I don’t know if I would stay again mainly because of how stressful if was getting on a plane and not knowing if I would need to find somewhere else to stay while traveling alone and arriving in NYC at 11pm at night, but the apartment is decent once you’re all checked in.

This is the perfect location! Small things:  -The outside door is creepy looking (but don't be alarmed, the inside is nice.  -There's a rooftop that's beautiful to venture to and relax during the cool nights. -The mattresses could be better. Our backs were stiff after 3 days of stay -The large bedroom doesn't allow the door to close because the bed was in the way -Front door is 3 min walk to the L line. Very convenient into Manhattan

Kim's apartment is exceptional, it totally exceeded our expectations. It has a more than ideal location in the Williamsburg district close to stores and coffee shops. The subway is about a 10-minute walk away and the ferry dock (I highly recommend it, less stressful than the subway and a superb view of Manhattan) is a 5-minute walk away.  The apartment is located in a secure high standard building with swimming pool, gym and shared terrace upstairs.  In addition, Kim is a pleasant person to interact with, it is not impossible that we come back to this apartment in the future :)

We checked out after the first night, location was sketchy. The place made us very uncomfortable, there was a lot of hidden damage covered with area rugs. The smell was foul every time the AC turned off. Very disappointed.

Honestly, my best airbnb experience so far. Everything was clean and pristine, the rooms were comfy and stylish and quite spacious - especially when considering this was a basement suite. Check in  was super simple and the private door entrance was great. Jonathan was very quick with replies to any questions that I had (not that I had any). Overall, it truly felt like a home-away-from-home and I already miss it. The shower was absolutely fantastic and there were plenty of extra items to help make the stay more comfortable. The AC was absolutely incredible, especially as I visited NY during a brutal heat wave. Parking was difficult to find and the farther away you parked from the actual address/street the more sketchy and shady the areas became however, so that is something to keep in mind.

The apartment is exactly as it appears in the photographs, it is in good condition, it is close to the subway station, the stop is 174 175, the area is not dangerous at all and we arrived at dawn, on the same block there are supermarkets and deli. The very friendly neighbors on Thursdays gave us living quarters in the church that is next to the apartment, it helped us a lot since we could prepare our food because there were all the necessary implements in the kitchen, (the only thing missing is a blender), The washer and dryer service helped us a lot. It has all the implements to clean the apartment. Friendly hosts, I would return without thinking, the bathroom and shower were excellent.  Just getting used to the smell of cannabis all over NY.

Very nice place. The place,  as you can see in the pictures is beautiful and clean. The hosts were very nice and responded quickly to any questions including coming by the apartment when the tv wasn’t connecting when I first arrived and being very forgiving when I accidentally broke a coffee mug.   It has two separate coded locks to get to the apartment and lots of security cameras, so it never felt unsafe.  The neighborhood can be a bit loud on weekends, but the apartment is mostly underground so sounds from outside are pretty muffled and I never had any trouble sleeping. Parking, like anywhere in the city can be tricky, but was never terrible.   Overall had a great stay and would be happy to stay there again if I’m in the area.

Amazing place!  3 blocks from the Kingston-Throops station, very easy to get to Manhattan and coming back home and above the station is a McDonalds that opens all 24-hours. Around Atlantic Avenue is dark and it was a little bit scary to walk through it but nothing happened when we were there, maybe it was just our imagination.  The inside of the place was beautiful, everything we needed was in there and everything worked great. The street had a lot of trash but it’s New York so it was not a big deal.  Lo was an amazing host, responded very quick as soon as I needed any help.  I really recommend the place, specially for families and groups that have no problem sharing 1 bathroom and going on the subway.

Airbnb   This place is great! Ideal for a couple. The sun roofs in the bathroom and foyer, plus the big living room and bedroom windows make the whole place bright and sunny, making turning on lights during the day completely unnecessary. Beautiful hardwood floors. The place is completely remodeled, tastefully furnished and decorated. Simple but very homely. It feels like you’re staying in someone’s home that is expecting a favorite relative. Everything is neat, clean and thoughtfully placed. Even the hangers are all wood, and more than you would ever need. They even have a rum bar. I suspect you may have to pay for consumption, but it was a nice touch for a weary  traveler. Finally, Lo was ultra responsive and extremely  considerate of my requests. Check-in and check-out were smooth. Basically, I really like this cute place. Just be prepared, if you have suitcases, to climb a long set of stairs because it’s on the top floor of a Brooklyn brownstone.

Akram's quick responses saved our trip! We had booked a different Airbnb but when we arrived onsite it proved to be an unsafe arrangement and we had to find different accommodations. Akram responded to my requests (around 5:30pm for a same night stay) immediately and with great detail about the check in process.   The location is great, the apartment is spacious, highly recommend.
Clean and professional. Though no place to park, only had a 1/2 roll of toilet paper (had to go out and buy more). Steps were extremely dangerous in the winter time, no salting or snow removal.

It was a okay stay the sunlight throughout the house is amazing and the house is nice only thing i didn’t like is that the door doesn’t have a lock on it so it was kinda scary i didn’t know if someone would walk in or not also the toilet got clogged so much it was very annoying and the balcony in the back room it felt like it was leaning so i really didn’t go out there there isn’t very much to see back there anyway cuz the back yard had a lot of stuff in it other than that it is a really nice place restaurants are everywhere a block away from transportation so i really didn’t have to Uber everywhere but all around nice place

HORRIBLE DO NOT RENT!!! I rented this apt for a week and when I came to check in the door had NO lock completely unsafe and no privacy and scary to be there I wanted to cancel because I don’t feel safe and he wouldn’t give me my money back. DO NOT RENT if you are worried about privacy and safety. also has 1 small unit AC all way in back of the house and the house very very hot.

Rob's place is indeed on one of the best blocks in New York. I lived in both Manhattan and Brooklyn for the better part of 8 years and think his block is tops! First of all, it looks like it is straight out of a movie set in Brooklyn including gorgeous well-maintained brownstowns, stunning trees, and diverse, friendly neighbors. There's such great energy there and access to places to eat, shop and be entertained. It's so incredibly convenient to excellent restaurants, cafes, and culture (BAM is just down a  few blocks) and subway/easy transport into Manhattan (one at the end of the same half-block). I miss being there already!  Rob is so friendly and responsive. He was a delight to coordinate our visit with and super helpful with recommendations for restaurants and other local places to enjoy during our visit. I would definitely stay there again when next in New York.

This apartment is in a gem of a location, right in the heart of Fort Greene. It was clean and tidy and was the perfect place for us to base ourselves for 4 days. Rob was a fantastic host and responded super quickly to any questions, check in was easy and he also sent lots of helpful suggestions and tips before we arrived. Overall a great stay.

This was one of the best Airbnb experiences I have ever had. The room was spacious, clean, and well equipped. I felt so comfortable and at home. This Brooklyn neighborhood offers just about everything you're probably looking for in Manhattan, great food, great bars, unique shops, and unbeatable New York culture. If you are compelled to spend time in Manhattan (as I was), the C train is a 3 min walk away and can have you at  the W 42nd St. station in less than 30 min.  As far as the host goes, you will not find one more courteous, charming, or accommodating than Rob.  If you have the chance, chat him up.

Excellent host, sparkling and cozy apartment, plus a great neighborhood! We had an amazing time. The apartment had everything we needed to make us feel comfortable. A quick walk to the subway is a bonus! Rob is so friendly and responded quickly to any questions or needs we had. You can tell he takes pride in his listing. It definitely beats staying at a hotel! *****!

If you want to be in the Clinton Hill, Ft Green area which we love then Rob’s place on the beautiful S Portland can’t be beat. The park, restaurants, laundry, food markets, subways to all parts of NYC are just steps away. We love the area! Rob’s is now our first choice when we visit, which is often. The apartment is very well equipped and clean. Lots of space and light inside with private on street entrance. Loved the place! Rob is quick to respond to any communication.

This location truly couldn't be better. I have now spent half of the year staying in different airbnbs around Brooklyn and without a doubt this was my favorite location. The street is beautiful and quiet and it's proximity to the park and to restaurants and subways is unmatched. Rob is also an excellent host, she was easy going and communicative and really just wants to create a great experience for guests. I truly could not recommend the location and Rob as a pairing enough.

I loved staying here - it's spacious, unbelievably quiet and had everything I needed for a 10 day working vacation.  Rob is great - I enjoyed him as a person, and he was a proactive and responsive host.   Highly recommended for your NYC trip.

Rob’s place is just perfect. Perfect location, on THE perfect block in Ft Greene bordering the park. Perfect flat that’s super clean, spacious and tastefully decorated. And importantly, a perfect host in Rob who is warm, friendly, communicative and flexible. Would highly recommend and we plan to come back!

Let me just start off with coming to this place it looked Nice but definitely could use a better cleaner on their team. Dishes had crusted food still on them, floors & appliances were dusty, there was only a half roll of toilet paper, the towels had stains on them, & there was bugs... The second night of staying here my friend & i watch a huge cockroach crawl up the wall while watching tv in bed.... When i spoke to Dwayne about it i first explained my health issues & told him that cockroaches are terrible for people with respiratory issues.. i spent almost 600$ & asked for a partial refund of 200$, well when Dwayne saw that offer he began to tell me "I'm an Unreasonable PERSON" i told him that i had to kill the bug because it was after hours & i knew he wasnt going to  be able to come do it. The next day i tried contacting airbnb's Help center they gave me a 10% discount for the 1 night i was complaining about not to mention the day of check out Dwayne Blatantly Threatened me & my friend due to his past experiences with his customers "stealing & destroying his apartment " we were trying to get a partial refund & instead got Threatened. They gave me 11.10$ for my total partial Refund. Do yourself a favor & keep looking this place is a joke.

Second time at Rob’s place. Beautiful tree lined street in terrific neighborhood in Brooklyn. So many easy places within a short walk. In our case,  kids and grandkids a 12 minute walk. You feel like you live in Brooklyn, not a tourist.  Rob is very responsive to guest’s needs. Will stay again.

This was my second stay at Rob's place, and I still highly recommend it.  A beautiful, clean apartment in one of the best spots in Brooklyn.  Rob was a delightful host.  I'm looking forward to returning again.
The apartment is bigger than it looks in the pictures.  Very comfortable throughout.  Rob is a great host who communicates well and made us feel welcome.

This was an exceptional AirB&B rental.  The place was very neat, well organized, and Rob was as nice as could be.  We heartily recommend this listing if you want to visit NYC but don't want the hassle of finding a nice place to stay!
Rob is an INCREDIBLE host and the place is beautiful! Amazing location, spacious, and clean. Highly recommend on all fronts!

What a find- a beautifully furnished spacious apartment ( complete with yoga room) in the best street and neighbourhood in Brooklyn. Rob communicated promptly and was super helpful with local advice. So close to so many great restaurants and bars  and Ft Greene Park. I have already booked my return stay! Thanks Rob

This was my second stay at Robert’s place. It feels like my Brooklyn home when visiting from Australia ! So quiet, comfortable, well designed and spacious and the location couldn’t be better - so close to our favourite restaurants and Ft Greene Park and Saturday markets. Rob is a fantastic host and such a lovely guy! Looking forward to our next stay. Thank you so much Rob for your amazing warmth and hospitality

Great rental on a BEAUTIFUL street. Close to parks, a wide variety of restaurants and bars, great entertainment options, and easy access to the subway to get to Manhattan. Rob was so kind and welcoming and went out of his way to ensure we had a nice stay. We took a number of his local restaurant suggestions and they were spot on!  So much to see and do… wishing we could’ve stayed longer!

This was our second stay in Rob's Brooklyn apartment.  It was just good as our initial visit.  Great location, tastefully furnished, and very clean.  Rob is a superb host.  He is responsive and attentive.  Highly recommend this five-star apartment.

Rob's place is spacious and pleasant, and located in one of the most beautiful parts of Brooklyn. My parents stayed here while they were visiting me, and they had a wonderful stay.   Rob is a wonderful host, very helpful and thoughtful. He was also extremely flexible and kind when we had to change our travel plans at the last minute due to unforeseen circumstances.  We would stay here again without question, and are so grateful to Rob for hosting us.

If you want a great apartment in a fantastic location with a wonderful host this is it!! Rob was quick to respond, and made check in/out super easy. This place has a super comfy bed, nice relaxing living area and a big bathroom! I highly recommend!!!

We had an awesome stay at Rob’s place. The neighborhood is beautiful, so close to Fort Greene park, a bunch of restaurants and subway stations.  The place is spacious and Rob made the stay very easy for us. Would love to stay here again!

Robert’s place is wonderful!  It’s spacious, well equipped, tastefully decorated, clean, and the bed is really comfortable. It’s in a great neighborhood with lots of fun cafes, restaurants and shops. Communications with Rob were clear, helpful an prompt. An excellent stay!

We stayed for a week in this lovely apartment. Central location in Fort Greene on a quiet street but very close to the park and subway stations direct to Manhattan. There are lots of good local restaurants but our favourites were Evelinas and Cafe Paulette. Couldn't get into Romans which was another recommendation so worth booking ahead as they do get busy. Also loved Mo's Bar at the end of the street. Apartment had everything you needed and felt home from home.  Rob was a great host and would definitely stay there again.
Great location on a lovely street with lots of restaurants and transportation options close by. Rob was very responsive to questions and requests. It was a good stay!

Rockaway is quiet in the winter, and this was the perfect place to hole up and watch the stormy waves from the master bedroom. The house is cozy and snug, immaculately well designed, with thoughtful touches everywhere. I felt immediately at home. No laundry in the house, but affordable drop service (as well as grocery, drug store, bakery, coffeeshop, and subway station) within a few blocks. Communication was great about the few things that arose during my month-long stay. Would highly recommend and hope to stay again!

This place was perfect for our group of 4 for the weekend. The place was immaculate and decorated very nice. The beds were both very comfy, and overall the place was just spotless.   Diego the owner was so easy to communicate with and readily available. I actually left my laptop (ugh) at his place. I live in VA, Diego took it eight away and overnighted it to me. That’s above and beyond and saved me a lot of stress. I couldn’t recommend Diego or his property highly enough. Would definitely come back.

If you want to enjoy NY for long stay,  Idelsa's apartment is one of the best option to stay.  It is not for executive, but for us(Japanese usually family with 4age child.), so confortable, and there are everything what we need. Around apartment, it seems not so safety, but neighbors are so kind and have helpful mind. Finally, we feel no danger during one week stay with take care. If you expect sweet hotel, I don't recommend, but if you want to enjoy usually life, we recommend you to stay)
Sam & Charlie's Beach Bungalow is the perfect recipe for having a no stress relaxing vacation.  Everything is as you see in the pictures and more.  Can't wait to come back.

This was our perfect week. Literally across the street from the beach and everything you can want once you've had enough sun. Comfortable living area and beds. Stocked kitchen, patio, outdoor shower etc.   Charlie and Sam were thoughtful hosts and gave us some great recommendations for our time there. Communication was stress free. We even got to meet their new puppy on the beach.   Can't recommend highly enough.

Very noisy adapted basement, if you are not a heavy sleeper, you will not be able to rest. As it is a basement, you can hear every step taken by the guests who live upstairs permanently. The noises are footsteps and start at 5am. Then they are there until 12-12:30 at night. I complained to leave but they force you to take at least 5 days. On the other hand, if not that noise, the noise of the water pump or some pipe sounds terrible a couple of times while you are sleeping. Be sure to ask for hand towels and 2 shower towels. Well, they only left me 1 for 8 days and I had to use it for both things. The entrance is super dangerous. Cement stairs that do not have a railing and do not appear in the photos.  Otherwise the apartment is furnished and equipped very well and the location is good. But unfortunately you stop appreciating these things mentioned when you realize that there is no way to rest with that noise.

Mark was a great host. It was easy to check in and find, the apartment was super clean and smelt nice and had everything we needed.   This is a basement apartment so understandably you can hear noises from upstairs, however you can hear EVERYTHING, the residents are up all hours of the day and night so there is constant noise. You can hear conversations and footsteps everywhere they go. This made us feel a little weary of our noise levels too.     On a positive note, the location was great to get to central- just 2 trains and you were there. At night walking back from the station was a little sketchy after 11pm but we didn’t feel unsafe.   I would recommend this apartment if you’re a heavy sleeper like us, otherwise I don’t think you’ll have a great night sleep.   The other thing was the duvet didn’t have a duvet cover on, just a sheet underneath- not sure if this is common in America however, we felt this was a bit unhygienic.  If we returned to NYC we would happily stay here again.

Kaz, Kayo and his team are so responsive and helpful in helping me find this all female shared house.  The place is great. Clean and organized with spaces designated for each room of the house. The room has two windows and faces East with lots of sunlight. Warm with auto-operated heater. Didn’t have any issue with only one bathroom. Very clean regardless of 4 members sharing.  The location is generally safe and in residential area and convenient to get to manhattan with subway (express train get you to manhattan in 2 stops (one easy connection) or 15mins) or bus.  Easy transportation to JFK airport with LIRR station in walkable distance (even with luggage). There’s also airport bus service for LGA stop near the house (didn’t use it).  Lots of nearby grocery stores with good price and convenient/drug stores nearby. Very near to big laundromat.  It was a nice and feel-like-home one-month stay with nice housemates :)  Great find for female traveler looking for all-female place.

Natalia's place is clean, updated, and very functional. Both the couch and bed are comfortable, the full kitchen is well-stocked, and the bathroom is a good size. Natalia was easy to communicate with and I would definitely stay here again. The neighborhood can be lively, but not unusually so for NYC, and I never felt unsafe as a woman traveling alone. It's a great homey base away from home.
***BEWARE DO NOT BOOK, this guy is a scammer for sure.  Needs to be removed as a host.  Has to book a hotel last Minute

I had a wonderful experience booking and staying here! Patricia was extremely accommodating and flexible with my check-in time which was a big stress reliever. The space was really nice and very clean. Great location, too👌🏼

Daniels place is awesome. The place is immaculate and comfy.  The neighborhood is a true NY experience which I loved. Super close to the train to get you everywhere.  Check- in was a breeze and Daniel is great with communication, detail instructions and super fast response to any questions you have.  This place for the space and vibe is a steal. Will def stay again.

The room is good,clean and quiet. Daniel is very thoughtful. And the place is quite close to the subway , very convenient.Just homeless people quite a lot at night, may a little worry walking alone at night.

The hosts are pretty easy to contact with. The neighborhood is pretty dirty and ugly.  It does not look be in manhantan. The neighborhood looks dangerous, but I didn’t have any issue.  Safety sensation is less than it really is.  The apartment is small than my expectations from the photos. The photos show it bigger than it really is. They charged USD 80,00 just for do a later checkout. In my opinion is not a fair price.

Fantastic location!  The condo was as advertised and very clean. We had some minor issues with the hot water for the shower and fridge, both just needed resetting, and Daniel was very fast to answer and to follow up if the problems were resolved.  You cannot beat the location, one block to the number 6 subway line, which easily connects to everything else at other stations. We had gotten one week unlimited Metro cards and it worked out perfectly, we were zipping all over Manhattan, Brooklyn and Queens. Some of us arrived at LaGuardia and the other two at Newark Airport and it was super easy to get to the condo from either by subway (well, and the NJTrain for Newark) - no need to pay for an expensive taxi or Uber. Yes, the apartment is a bit tight for kitchen and living room but having 3 bedrooms and 1-1/2 baths was perfect. Beds are super comfortable and even I, having back issues, had a great sleep all week long. Also, we had breakfast in the condo and then were out all day, returning mostly around 11pm to midnight, too tired to spend much time in the living room. We never felt unsafe in East Harlem! Yes, the streets look a bit messy but once in the building, things are very nice. There are 2 super markets close by (1 block) and we mostly picked up groceries when we returned to the condo and had gotten off the subway.  For food, Las Delicias Mexicanas was great being just around the corner from the condo, we ate there the first and last night.  The only thing that I would comment on are the air conditioning units in the rooms. There are no tight seals on the sides to the window frames and since it was rather cold outside, the condo got quite cold and we were forced to turn up the heat quite a bit to offset the draft from the windows. Also, a new shower head would be great to allow more water to flow through. Otherwise, I would definitely stay at Daniels again!
Clean comfortable noisy at night at times area a felt slight unsafe at night

Everything stated about this listing is accurate and then some. Everyone knows NYC is expensive, but this is a place where affordability meets comfort.  My host was so fabulous.  She greeted me warmly and explained everything to me. The fact that breakfast was readily available and included truly made this place so fantastic. She was willing to accommodate me as well whenever feasible.  And I never felt unsafe. Very secure place. And it is just a short walk to the subway--highly recommend that everyone check that out. Everything was clean and comfortable.  I cannot say just how wonderful and convenient this space was. If I could give it 10 stars, I would! While you're not going to feel like you're in a 5-star hotel, you are going to feel like you are at a homey room with a warm feeling that almost makes it feel like home away from home! If you are looking for a nice, comfortable, safe, inexpensive place to stay in NYC, this should be at the top of your list!

First time in New York was a little scared however this place is so safe very nice neighborhood. The host Carlo is super friendly, the place is clean and cozy and very nice gestures like entering the room to find a pillow with your name on it. All in all great experience and will definitely be my go to place in NYC and it’s very close to the subway and easy to commute to anywhere from there. Oh and the street view to George Washington bridge is EVERYTHING!!

It was a pleasure staying at Rick’s Brownstone while working at the Navy Yard for a month. The convenience of the neighborhood by walking and bicycling, while leaving you’re vehicle parked saved me a lot of stress, & money! So did the kitchen.   One thing me & my wife were surprised of was how quiet it is on St. Felix Street…. Working nightshift from 5:30-3:30 I was able to sleep through the day and get 8+ hours every single day. Very important for me. It felt like home, and if I ever come back. I will rent again!

Absolutely amazing. Not only was the price an absolute steal, our host was unbelievably amazing! Snacks and wine were included complimentary which was unbelievably sweet. The room was very private and felt so homey.

Definitely recommending this place and location to anyone, what a fab host, Okhela's mom was so supportive and calling cabs for us to get around, Her B/F video call so he can guide me through to get the TV working again - not sure what button I press but there you go lol. Okhela's has been so responsive on whatsapp.    Our room had a very nice bottle of Wine for us which was a surprise, the property is very clean, everything you need was there. safely was top of the list. location was great, there was bus stop about 2 min. walk from the house, also there is a Caribbean restaurant 2 min walk very friendly owner, corner stores etc.  On this street its very quiet so you wouldn't be disturb by noise/music if you are trying to sleep.  In a nutshell I have never book  vie AirBnB so seen this was  my first  i am so happy i did give it a try and went with an open mind - beyond my expectation.   so fellow travellers book book book dont be afraid.

You can expect to be pleased above your expectations in every way possible and feel content that there will be no unpleasant surprises from booking to check-in and during your stay. This host is an amazing lady that will make it her point to see that you are satisfied.

I stayed at Carolyn's place for a week while I was going through cancer treatment and had to isolate from my family.  She did everything she could to make me feel comfortable and safe in her home.  She brought me fresh mint when I was sick, checked in on me to see if there was anything I needed, and even gave me homemade strawberry crumble on my last night (yum!).   Carolyn took so much stress away during such a difficult time for me and I would recommend her suite over and over again.  I will even reach out again if we need a staycation.

This airbnb is very well placed. There's a bagel shop next door and plenty of restaurants nearby. Central Park is within walking distance (if you're fit). And the conference I was attending at the Marriott Marquis was very easy to get to (ten minute walk). If you're driving in, there's a relatively cheap ($50/day after tax) parking garage on 45th that's maybe a seven minute walk away. The neighborhood also felt quite safe, despite quite a few homeless people.  Things to be aware of --- the two bedrooms run one into another with no hallway, so the person in the far bedroom has to pass through to go out or to visit the bathroom. There is also only one set of keys.  Minor inconveniences aside, this is a great place to stay while in New York.
I would not recommend this place due to the safety issues and stress that we’ve been through. We moved out in the middle of contract and got refunded thanks to great Airbnb customer service.

We came to Oscar’s listing after leaving another location due to feeling unsafe in the area.    This listing was our solution and made our last night in NYC very comforting and perfect. It’s perfect for mid-sized groups who wish to have a close location to Times Square and other attractions. The largest room provides for privacy, not to mention space for the group to hang out in, as there’s a TV and sofa in there. The apartment was very clean, water is hot, check in process is easy. One thing to be mindful of is the noise that comes in through the windows at night, however, I feel this gives you a true NYC feel.   Oscar was very responsive and polite, provided details on everything. I would definitely stay here again if I return to NYC.

Claudia's space is great. It is an excellent value and really convenient location. Plan ahead for check-in information. You will need to request it and wait for a response, so don't do it while you're already at the apartment. This is an issue I've never had before and definitely made my arrival somewhat stressful.

Don't stay here! This is not a clean or comfortable place to stay. We ended up having to check out and find another place to stay on a whim because our one-night stay was such a disaster.   First of all, the toilet would not flush and worse, it leaked and smelled. When we first arrived and realized this,  we were told they would fix it, but when we came back later that night it still wasn't working. As if this wasn't enough, the wifi didn't work so I had to cancel a work interview, and unknown unpleasant smells from the floor below kept wafting in.   In addition, the room is much more well lit in the photos than in real life-- it is very dim and actually a little creepy. The rooms had two weird busts of creepy men hanging from the walls staring at me while I was trying to sleep. To add to my discomfort, you also can't lock the bedroom door so my child felt insecure all night. This is not the experience I wanted for my vacation in New York.

The host was extremely responsive, kind and helpful. The place was a bit quirky. The shower didn't drain quickly, so I found myself standing in a pretty deep puddle of water which was kind of unpleasant. Certain aspects of the place needed better maintenance, and cleanliness was a bit suspect in various areas of the rooms.

Please be aware that these issues may have been updated since I last wrote these (hopefully). So please double check these points with the owner before booking.  The stay was interesting. The manager was very friendly, helpful and fast to respond. However: 1. The bedroom door didn't lock or close despite past reviews mentioning this same problem. This made us feel a little unsafe (being in a foreign home in a foreign area). It was fixed the next day though. 2. Lots of random items being left around the place. 3. No light in the common area. 4. Shower has mold. 5. Toilet doesn't flush too great (make sure to hold it down a little longer so you don't get a surprise when you open the lid again). 6. Lots of artworks and sculptures with faces on them. Looking at you when you're sleeping. The owner his a passionate artist. This is a great thing. However it can be a little strange to someone who isn't used to this type of stuff. Be sure you're ok with it.  Enjoyed the experience after the door was fixed the following day and we were used to the stuff lying around and faces looking at us (it gets very dark when the lights are off, so you can't see them lol).   We still enjoyed the stay overall, but definitely consider the points above before booking.

Amazing!! From day 1 till the last day, i had an amazing time and hope i can come back in the future. It was so clean and modern and check in was so fast and easy. I already had a good impression when booking, and my feelings were right!!!  Everything you need in a house you find there, everything has been taught off and it was so easy to go to manhattan just a J train away😃!! Even before in the Netherlands i asked if i can let something be delivered there at the address for me already and it was totally fine, so sweet because i was in stress with the package and they helped me. I can’t thank them enough.   Thank you!

The apartment was very clean and cute, and the owners provided clear and easy directions for gaining entry. However, if you’re planning to go into Manhattan more than once or twice, this is really too far to serve as a base. And it would have been nice to provide some suggestions for restaurants and nearby grocery stores, but there was no information whatsoever. This was even more inconvenient when coupled with the fact that we did not feel at all safe in the neighborhood, and some navigating instructions might have gone a long way toward making things feel safer. In fact, we felt so unsafe that we opted not to stay. In the short amount of time that we were there, we witnessed drug activity, and the neighborhood was loud and very rowdy. I was there with my kids and mother, and it was just not at all the experience we expected to have. No refund, even partial, so buyer beware. It’s a cute apartment, but  not a safe neighborhood and you should be aware of that. I wouldn’t book this again.

Timothy or Sergio hosted a very misleading stay we did not know it was a basement suite until after we paid and the details were revealed. there was pounding and banging throughout the night that will wake you up. The small spare bedroom is very cold and poor ventilation and that room has huge spider webs all over, the bathroom caulking was terrible, black mold is growing and and you can visually see it. the toilet is deteriorating in the inside bowl which is disgusting. The main bedroom has a headboard that is stained with black residue and is just very gross and unsanitary. The fireplace mantle was very dirty and sticky. I am not sure why there is a cleaning fee when I have to clean and do the dishes and take out the garbage. I would not recommend this place to anyone, yes it has a aesthetic nostalgic feel about it but it shouldn’t be unsafe and and dirty when you are paying good money.

This flat has a fantastic location which has a 'neighbourhood' feel but just happens to be five minutes walk from Times Square. The street is not full of tourists and has plenty of amenities very close by.  Our six-year old loved the playground which happens to be next door and which includes a fountain to run in. It was also a shady place to sip the fantastic coffee and chai latte from across the road.  It is a great base from which to explore Midtown Manhattan and Central Park. The restaurants of Hells Kitchen are a stones throw away.  If you like theatre then you can be at anyone of 40 or more theatres within 5 or 10 minutes...

Do not get scammed!! It is totally different from the pictures. It is stinky, dusty, rotten and the ceiling needs repairs because could fall any moment. It makes me believe that this is a subsidized apt for the people with low income that need some help.  From the first floor to the third floor, it smells marijuana, it is dirty stairs and people spit everywhere.  I had to decline to live in this apt even for 5 min. And bty,  I am a guy who does not sleep in 5-star hotels.

The place looks just like the pictures!  Great safe neighborhood: had these little ethnic and chain restaurants and drug stores close by.  Easy access to subways and buses. I was able to easily walk to a few museums located near Central Park.

Don’t stay here!! Save your money and lots of stress!  On my arrival they were rude on the messages because I requested early check in (days before). My husband, baby and I were left waiting for 20 min in the cold outside.  The apartment floor was filthy, full of hair, but full!!! I have to mop 4 times to be possible spend the night.  We were 3 so wanna use the sofa bed, they wanna charge for extra sheets, didn’t bring on the first night. Can you imagine all this having a baby with you?  Well, I let them know the place was terrible, they offered a cleaning lady for next day, but I have cleaned everything already (which cost me 3 hrs of my day). The blankets were smelling, need to go down to wash them before time bed.  We tried to use the sofa bed using the comforter (since we didn’t have sheets). It was not possible, very noisy (every time you move), tilted, well... impossible. I even tried one more night... but no.  Ok, we headed to a hotel, need to spend 1,500 on top of the 2,400 that I have payed for the apartment.  I was in NY for a very serious and important week, work related, needing to deal with this kind of stress, I just left because I couldn’t handle that anymore.  Now I’m trying to have part of the refund and they refuse!!! Believe it or not!  So, save your time and go somewhere else.

This was my second night stay.  This time I stayed in a private room with shared bath.  The shared bath was still clean.  The people I stayed with were very chill so I can’t complain of bumping into so many people going to the bathroom.  I left so early and only stayed one day so it felt like the bathroom was all mine.  I stayed in the room right next to the bathroom.    Smell good oils are kept through the house so it always smells amazing.  The checkin process a breeze.  I love that you take shoes off at the door.  The place is immaculate.  Dust is cleaned high and low.  Small touches like having plenty of hooks in the room and the bathroom.  There’s a blow dryer and toothpaste in the bathroom.  I even got a little gift with a disposable toothbrush and mini toothpaste.  Water and snacks left for me.  It’s so close to transportation the Q58 that takes you to trains in both direction.  WiFi is fast.  Responses are quick.  Booking is stress free.  My only complaint I didn’t get to meet Vicky!  She really gives you privacy.  She truly deserves her Superhost badge.

Brent’s place was in a great area, close to the 2/3 subway stop, had a nice balcony to sit on, and was large/spacious given its amazing location. Brent was very nice and communicative and made the trip easy and stress-free.

Great apartment in Brooklyn. About a 7minute walk from a few subway lines which offers great connectivity to Manhattan. The apartment is small but full of all the necessary amenities including a fully equipped kitchen and washer + dryer. The rooms are cozy and the beds are great! We came as a group of 5 and it was perfect for us.  The host is very friendly and greatly helped us with our irregular flight schedule. Check in and out process was smooth as it can be with a lockbox at the front gate. My only complain is that the neighbourhood might seem a little shady at first but it was fine after a while.   Overall definitely a recommendation for an affordable apartment in Brooklyn!
The neighborhood was a little sketchy, but the room itself was perfectly fine.

This apartment is very spacious and comfortable.  It is an easy walk to the subway, as well as to restaurants, corner stores, and good coffee.   The kitchen is small, but functional.  The bathroom is palacial.  Everything was sparkling clean.   If you are traveling with  kids who need their own room, know that the second bedroom is not attached to the living area and other bedroom, but has its own locking door from the hallway.   We did not use that room because we weren't confident that  our kid could lock and unlock the door on her own if she had to use the bathroom during the night and she was not comfortable being separated from us while sleeping.  However,  the futon in the living room is super comfy and  that worked  just fine as her bedroom.  The kitchen and bathroom are also not attached  to the main living area, but are accessible from the hallway.  There are no other apartments on the floor and the building is secure, so this did not feel at all unsafe or weird once we got used to it.   Just something to be aware of if you have smaller kids.    I would 100% stay here again.

Definitely a great place for the price! The apartment itself is super simple but nice and clean. The street was extremely quiet at night. The only downside is the walk to the train. One stop is about a 15 minute walk and the other is about 10 minutes. Which aren’t too bad during the daytime but at nighttime it was a little sketchy. We started taking lyfts back and forth from Manhattan and it was affordable and convenient. There are some really good coffee shops and restaurants around the area. Overall, it was a great experience and I would recommend this Airbnb!

Ran's place is centrally located. Paul is the host  and he was amazing from letting me early check in and late check out as my transportation schedule was a bit funky. Internet works great, the view is really nice, the place was super clean. You get to see empire state building from all rooms. :) I think their value is great too, just dont expect that you will walk into a 5 star hotel for what you pay. As long as your expectation is set around the price, this place is a steal. :) thank you again Paul for being a wonderful host!!!

Our stay at Paul’s place was much more than we could have expected!! From being super accommodating to our early arrival in the city with a slightly early check-in, to making sure at more than one point during our stay that we had everything we needed, Paul was a perfect host! The building is keyed and is very clean and well kept. The apartment was exactly as described, only it was much larger than the pictures show. There were 3 of us staying and we all had sufficient sleeping space and never found ourselves feeling crowded. And the views were breathtaking...light shows from the Empire State Building as we relaxed in the front room each night! We were within walking distance of all the major attractions: Times Square, Rockefeller Center, Greenwich Village, the Highline, and the new Hudson Yards. We never felt unsafe in the neighborhood and there were plenty of bars, restaurants, and groceries within a couple blocks. We had all the necessary amenities and didn’t find ourselves running out of anything before the end of our 5 day stay. I would most definitely book with Paul again. This place was very cozy and accommodating!
Perfect location outside of the city. Low crime area and lot's to do in Staten Island. Leon is very responsive and communicated with me the entire time to ensure our stay was comfortable.

The stay was reality nice, spacious, relaxing and stress free. The apt is very clean with all the amenities needed for your stay, a bit antique but is very pleasant, Vena was very helpful with answering questions and anything that you need. Checking in and out was easy and contacting Vena she answered every time. The location is close to all your shopping needs, parking is difficult especially at night but i would stay there again.

I enjoyed my stay while visiting my Mom, Vena was responsive from the beginning. The entire place was clean and nearby restaurants for a food on the go.  Part of the sliding shower door didn’t work, but I just used the other side. Overall it was a stress-free stay which is what I needed considering what I was going for. Vena was kind and gave clear instructions. I would love to stay there again.  -Arlene

The Good, The Bad, The Facts… GOOD: *Lots of space. *Near subways. *Good WiFi. *Close to Whole Foods, Red Rooster, Sylvia’s, and lots of shopping. *New A/C in main room. *Decent food delivery options.  BAD: *Apt is between THREE LOUD, ACTIVE CONSTRUCTION SITES. *Apt is steps away from 125th St Metro-North Station, with trains LOUDLY rolling in from FIVE AM to MIDNIGHT. *Lots of LOUD YELLING & FIGHTS directly outside window. *Apt has faint odor of MILDEW & MOLD. *The ROACHES are GIGANTIC. *Kitchen range only has 2 working burners and Oven DOESN’T WORK. *TV won’t work b/c there’s no Roku remote. (I used my Xbox to connect). *Living room futon is stained, lumpy, smelly, and the support slats break often. *Apt is generally unclean. I spent my first 2 days cleaning and de-sanitizing. *I found empty drugs vials (w/dusty, white residue) hidden in the apartment from previous tenants.   FACTS: *No microwave. *No coffeemaker. *No toaster. *No kettle. *No A/C in bedroom. *No lamps. *No blinds or drapes in living room, so everyone can see inside at all times (including when you exit the shower). *No (true) blackout drapes in bedroom. *Neighbors’ cigarette smoke PERMEATES the walls and smells up the apartment. *Amir is busy, so he responds only when hounded. *No access to mailbox. *No Washer/Dryer in unit. You have to hound Amir for access. (I used a laundry service.) *Experience was so rocky, Airbnb refunded nearly 1/3 of my initial “rent” payment.   If you’re NOT going to be in the apartment much and want to save money, go for it. If you want any rest or comfort, keep looking.

Had a good time at Bryan's place! Would come back for a short stay for sure! I stayed there for 2 months, the room is just as advertised, his transparency about it is very appreciated by the way: it's very small (queen size bed, small desk, space for suitcases, and no windows so it can get a little hot sometimes), but you have all you need to live and the apartment is big anyway. Best advantage is definitely the price though, I think it's hard to find a better deal in NYC no kidding.  Bronx is what you can expect from Bronx, populated, noisy and a little wacky but I never felt unsafe (have to say i am a 25 yrs hispanic looking men though). Everything you need (Grocery, bank, gyms) is a minute away. Finally, Bryan is nice, responsive, keep the apartment organised and respects privacy. Current roommates are very nice as well. You get what you get in terms of room size for the price but again, best deal ever! Thank Bryan!
BEWARE! PLEASE DO NOT STAY IN THIS AIRBNB. IT’S A SCAM. THE HOST GHOSTED ME BEFORE CHECK IN. I TRIED TO CALL THE HOST MULTIPLE TIMES BUT HE NEVER ANSWERED!!!

this place is for inmates🥴 I'm not sorry for saying that her house rules was so intense I swear I felt like if I breath a little to hard my reservation would be canceled I personally don't think this  should be your side hustle because YOU DO NOT want anyone in your home but you want their money🥴, I would NEVER   stay here AGAIN  or recommend anyone too. Honestly it just felt  like her ears where by the door waiting for you to do something so she could cancel it im not saying you cant have house rules but she went to the extreme. Ididnt feel comfortable i was literally  on my tippy toes walking in her house thissssssssssssssss was  MADNESS😭😭 I CANT NOT STRESS THIS ENOUGH LADY PLEASE STOP!  TAKE  YOUR HOUSE  OFF AIR BNB

I experienced issues with the room and with the host - the room was unclean, and also felt unsafe because of a connecting door right next to the bed that had strangers staying on the other side. There was a crack in the door and the hinges on the lock were partially unattached. The locks had been duct taped and painted over. I was hoping to figure things out with the help of the host, but he was slow to reply, didn't come over to help after work as promised, and then got really mad and unpleasant when I finally (after waiting for many hours) filing a refund claim.  All in all a frustrating experience. Sketchy place. The location next to a park is nice, but the room was dusty and had garbage in it, the bathroom smelled, it was in a cellar and like described over, the host was unpleasant.  If location near JFK and park is all that matters to you it's an okay place for a night or two - I hope you have a better experience than I did.

Place is nice. The entrance was kind of annoying, with there being ice and snow on the ground. It’s a little dangerous if you don’t pay attention. They do let you know that they have children so you’ll hear them upstairs, but I was expecting that much feet thumping. Definitely at 7 am. But overall, the place is really nice and the hosts were friendly and accommodating.
Easy check in, place could’ve been cleaner, the location can be a little sketchy at night but overall okay place.

Chains place was great! Exceptionally convenient location right off the 3,4 A and C lines. The place itself is spacious, clean and has the basic amenities you need to take a bite out of the big apple!   Only two downsides though, there are children in the apartment directly above you and the wooden floors are thin. Their running around begins at 7am-ish, so if you have too many cocktails one night, I’d recommend bringing a white noise machine (really helped us). Additionally, there is quite a bit of mold in the shower and wall, the fan wasn’t working on our stay and maybe this is why. It produces a strong odor and makes it somewhat unpleasant to be in the (very small) bathroom.   All in all, their place was a great value in a vibrant location that would be perfect for someone who doesn’t mind getting up early and won’t spend a lot of time there.
the neighborhood isa little sketchy but other than that it was fine. Pro tip if your going to Manhattan take the #4 train there and back!
neighborhood is a little bit sketchy, other than that the place was nice and one block away from the subway

Walking into this beautiful home was not as expected. It was dark and had a dangerous stair way. Immediately when walking in, the front rug was ripped and the house was very dim and gray. The bathroom is very unlike the picture and is a crammed space with no storage. The master bedroom was simple but comfortable while the room with the trundle bed was cold. My friends found mold under the bed and took photos. But I immediately contacted our host and they came to resolve the problem. Another problem we ran into was the shower curtain and rod. It kept falling and hitting us on the head. Chaim came to resolve this issue respectfully and I appreciated the fast support. Lastly the kitchen was very small and we experienced problems opening cabinets and there was minimal kitchen supplies. We had to buy a lot of essentials. The neighborhood is loud and ghetto as well. We got robbed by Utica station. Stay safe

Our stay was acceptable and convenient. Good space for 4 people or less, we had 6 and it was quite cramped. This was particularly because for the majority of our stay, the aircon was not functioning properly, making the place humid, hot and sweaty. The host did try fix this issue and the temperature did drop slightly but it was still very hot in the summer weather. Communication was good and quick.  However, the street this place is located on is not the safest. There is the same group of people that play very loud music right outside the apartment every night causing difficulties in regards to our comfortability and sleep. In addition, we witnessed an assault right outside the door upon our check-out of the apartment around 5am.  We want to say for future guests that this place is not the safest and while Brooklyn is typically a safe place, this street was dangerous and we’d like to reiterate to potential future guests that heavy consideration should be taken before booking this place if safety is a priority.

Great host, excellent communication and very clean and comfortable living space. In a decent enough area however it did feel a little unsafe as there were usually people hanging around outside the Airbnb. That being said we never had any issues and were happy with everything. Akram is an excellent host and was always on hand if we needed anything.

Overall the unit itself was great, it was however super unfortunate that the door is on such a scary location during the evening.   I was surprised that none of the pervious reviews talked about how loud the unit is at night. We were woken up multiple times each night we slept there do to it. (we were there 3 nights) One of the evenings was so scary we almost called the police. Noise consists of mostly yelling homeless people/mentally ill people and men fighting directly in front of the unit entrance.
This is a great place, a steal for the location. It’s the perfect place for any tourist. And it’s also very convenient.

Spotlessly clean, spacious yet still cosy apartment. Has everything you could need - powerful shower, comfy bed, quality coffee machine, TV and DVD player (with a good selection of disks provided), Dishwasher, huge washing machine and tumble drier . . .  The location isn’t as upmarket as some of the areas towards the centre of the city, but we had no problems. We never felt unsafe whilst walking the streets, and with 2 “G” line stations just minutes away we were able to travel into Manhattan in 20 minutes. The house manual is very informative, and includes a useful list of local shops, eateries, coffee houses etc - We’d recommend Ctown Supermarket (that place is like a TARDIS - one door leading into a huge store) for groceries and top notch locally produced coffees, and Tony’s Pizza spot for delicious slices. We would not hesitate to stay here again in the future. Many thanks to Daniel for hosting ! !

Shully's place is very clean and comfortable.   The expectation was more than I could have imagined.   The hospitality was exceptional.   Shully's showed us that some people care more than just about making money.  We unfortunately, were introduced under unpleasant circumstances  (death of a family member).  We drove 14 hours in a 15 passenger van to get there.  As we arrived,  we were graciously greeted and directed to our extraordinary suite.  It was amazingly clean and beautifully adorned.  We ran into some challenges with driving such a large vehicle, but they took time out of their schedule (this is not in the contract) to hold our parking space.  We arrived at the house after 1:00 a.m. after traveling to a "wake" and having to wake up Mr. Shully's so that we could acquire the space.  I would say, that was going above and beyond what most people would do.  I hated to put him in that position, and even tried to compensate him for it, but he refused to take the money, but instead offered his condolences and heartfelt prayers.   Shully's you all are truly amazingly God sent people.  You made an unbearable situation bearable.   I would definitely visit again under more pleasant circumstances.

I have to say, Farouk is unequivacally one of my favorite Airbnb hosts. If I had known of the pleasant experiece I was to have I would have booked a longer stay. Farouk is friendly, kind and very accomodating. The apartment itself is very clean, spacious and comfortable; and in a city as loud as NYC, noise in this apartment was surprisingly nonexixstent. There is ample closet space, and a desk with which to study or eat, and laundry steps away.  The location is superb. There are plenty of restaurants and supermarkets and mom and pop shops lining the street. The subway is about 3 blocks away and the bus stop even closer.  If you stay with Farouk you'll feel very welcome and for the price he's charging it's a steal.

My wife and I recently stayed here for 15 nights.  There are two big negatives to this space; firstly, there is a total remodel/rebuild of the brownstone immediately adjacent to this building happening M-F from 8:00 until at least 4:00 PM.  It is incredibly noisy and disruptive most of the day.  The vibrations from the construction and the constant banging make for a very unpleasant environment.  No matter what the owners may say, the construction will not be ending anytime soon.  We were not notified in advance by the owners of the construction project or its scale.  Secondly, the bathroom is beyond remarkably small.  The sink is the size of a napkin and you can't lean over it without banging your head on the wall.  The shower is smaller than a phone booth.  A normal size person can barely fit inside and be able to turn around.  It's impossible to not bang your elbow on the hot/cold water knobs when attempting to turn around.  The water is either super hot or cold and finding a proper temp takes time and patience and will change the moment you smack your elbow into it.  The owners also fail to disclose this dysfunctional bathroom dynamic.  There is also only an Apple TV with limited options.  No cable or other TV is available.  There are two flights of steep and narrow stairs to walk up which is a challenge with heavy bags.  In addition to the construction noise, there are small kids and barking dogs aplenty in close proximity.  While the owners are frequently apologetic for the obvious challenges and disclosure omissions,  this is not a place for anyone with even slight mobility issues.  The bathroom and shower are glaring shortcomings.  The construction noise level renders the place uninhabitable at times.  Caution is advised to anyone who is seeking a reasonably quiet space after 8:00am.  You will not need an alarm clock to wake up.  On the positive side, the kitchen is entirely adequate and functional.  The space has been nicely decorated with shabby chic.  The location is central and walkable to some nice restaurants, bars, etc. Young families abound.  The owner has indicated we would be getting an undefined refund but we have not received anything as of the time of this review.  The owners are personally pleasant and articulate but they have not fairly represented the condition of certain elements and nuisances that are present.
Don’t be afraid to wonder off near the house. Tons of restaurants, markets & shops.

Good location, house was very clean and Edna was really nice.   The room unfortunately was extremely small - smaller than it appears in the pictures. I barely had room to keep my suitcase open on the floor. The lighting in the room was also quite harsh which made it unpleasant to stay in the room for long periods of time. The room works well as a place to sleep after spending a day out but not more than that.

I had a wonderful time with my kids — excellent location close to the train station, surrounded by restaurants and convenient stores. The building is secured all the time, which is a plus for me. Parking on the street can be stressful but manageable. I would recommend this property, and most importantly, I will come back.  Thank you. We had a fantastic spring break.

The apartment is quite cozy and clean.  The accessibility to the 2 train is awesome. We were able to get anywhere in Manhattan easily! The sandwiches across the street were very tasty. Also, the price of the rental was fantastic!  I wish that the host was more flexible about check-in/check-out. She made situations more stressful and unfortunately dampened our experience a bit. We asked for a later check-in time, since our flight arrived late, and she was not able to accommodate us. She was also worried about towel stains that were easily washable.  Please also be aware that the furnace is constantly pumping heat into the apartment and is controlled by the building. Luckily, there are two air conditioners in the unit that can help counteract this.

The location is quite far from downtown, but it’s alright. The chair of the dining table is wobbly and not easy to sit on, kinda dangerous. There’s no remote control of the heater, so we cannot close it while we’re out.

The apartment is better than I expected. The pictures do not do the space justice. Everything was spotless and I especially liked that I was in a very quiet neighborhood. I was staying at the property while I had work done on my home and being displaced can definitely be stressful, but I truly felt at home. I would definitely stay again!

Staten Island Gem! Everything about this rental was easy and stress free.  Parking was very convenient, always had a spot right in front of apt. Safe and quiet neighborhood. Clean, well decorated, inviting. Stocked full kitchen. Even had things like laundry detergent, hand soap, and shampoo/conditioner. Huge smart TV and 2 pull out sofas. Laundry inside the unit was awesome. Large bedroom that is dark and cozy.  Close to public transit. Owners weee great. Loved this place! Thanks for making our stay so comfortable and stress free!

Great neighborhood I never felt any danger walking around. It is 10 minutes from Target, Best Buy, DSW and about 14 minutes from the mall. Since it is getting colder I believe the comforter should be changed to a thicker one especially since the room has windows and the balcony. The wall is literally paper thin...you can hear everything in the other room. The other guests left their hair EVERYWHEREEEEE; one time I found a clump of hair on the stove. Other than the hair issue everyone else pretty much kept to themselves. I would stay again because of the neighborhood and location to the stores and grocery stores.

Luz and her family were very responsive and responsible hosts. They dealt with a smoke alarm issue quickly. The host's family member who lives there was not present, so I had the place to myself. Accommodations were straightforward and simple, nothing fancy. It was a place for me to sleep and shower. It was a surprisingly quiet place, considering the area and the neighbors. The proximity to the subway could not be beat, although Roosevelt Ave in that location is a little rough, although I didn't feel particularly unsafe walking alone (Jackson Hts is hopping with people at all hours). The cost absolutely cannot be beat for NYC.

Akram was simply amazing. His Airbnb was also amazing. The Airbnb itself is situation in the neighborhood of fort greene and close to so many shops. The train is a bit of a walk but there are many buses close to it. I booked this Airbnb to stay two nights before my wedding day and Akram was so lovely and communicative it was one less thing for the bride to stress about! Definitely recommend staying here :)

Good things:  - near fort greene park, which is really nice - not too far from restaurants/cafes, local fast food options and liquor store on the same block - full kitchen - comfy/clean beds  Surprising things - you have to type a 6 digit code into two separate lock boxes each time you want to enter your apartment from the outside, they don't give you a key for your stay.  - kinda unsafe street, nicknamed "murder ave". For reference, the chicken restaurant and liquor store on the block have bulletproof glass at the checkout counter.    - shower was cold/lukewarm - No shampoo/conditioner  -  pizzeria downstairs means you smell pizza nearly 24/7

This place was fine for the price. My friend and I Ubered from the Airbnb to Manhattan and it cost us around $7 each, so it was good it was so close to the city. The area feels sketchy to walk in at night... I didn’t know we were staying in a basement.

We stayed here for about 5 nights and overall had a great experience. The apartment has a kitchen and living area which was nice but it did feel a bit like a basement - there are no real windows and in the winter it was hard to tell if it was morning or not. The hall light also flickers and there are strange noises at night (plus being right underneath the stairs) which resulted in some late night scares. Overall, however, it was a good price for the location and size and we had a nice stay!

Ok what can I say. The owner was nice enough to let me checked in early and checked out an 1 hr late and I’m thankful  for that. This place is bigger than the picture and spacious.  The area look scary and very dirty. I’ve never live in the  ghetto before and this place is located in a ghetto according to a friend who lives in NY for the last 20 yrs.  He was shock that I picked this place to stay. But I didn’t know better. If I knew that I wouldn’t stay there. My  whole stay I was praying for safety. This place was only for sleepy, we pretty much spend the day out everyday for the 5 days we were there. At night you would hear a lot of cops siren going around non stop.  This is y second time using Airbnb and hopefully next time… I’ll  look for better Neighborhood. Also this one lace On Airbnb this place is view as  newly renovated and in my opinion it’s not.  They were still issues with draining problem in the shower.    The stubs  and the shower were not as clean you can still see mold in the tiles area. The  stairs handled is broke going in the house.  And we were left with half toilet paper in each bathroom and they didn’t have any in the house. I had to buy my own which  I contacted the owner about and  I supposedly getting a refund for that.
The apartment was very comfortable. Very comfortable beds, very good hot water and very complete kitchen.  The neighborhood at night seemed dangerous to us.

When I first got there, I’ll admit it seemed a little bit sketchy however there were secure locks on each door which made me feel safe. The actual apartment was very clean, nicely decorated, and spacious. The owner made sure there were several amenities to use such as: shampoo, conditioner, body wash, towels, mints, candy & even fire stick tv. I appreciated that the WiFi password was also available and fast. The room was cozy and spotless. I would definitely stay here again if given the chance.

We had some unfortunate events that made our stay less than pleasant.   Pros:  —The place is spacious  —The beds are comfortable —check in very easy —bathrooms are updated  Cons: —We had a cleanliness issue in the bathroom upon check-in that was very unpleasant. —The house is 50ft from Grand  Central Expressway. People who aren’t accustomed to this noise will have a very difficult time sleeping.  —Many fixtures loose, curtain rods nearly falling off the wall, many old wires trailing along the walls.  —The basement is cold and dark. No one in our party wanted to sleep there. My kids especially.  —Their is a outside patio with no table or chairs. No outdoor furniture.  —We’ve stayed at many Airbnb properties, but won’t be staying here again.

Misleading instructions. Terrible check-in experience. Disrespectful staff.  I'm out $6,200 because of this host. Hoping to share this so it doesn't happen to you.  Misleading instructions. I had a reservation for 3 people. During registration, I just had my name, one of my friend's name and the third name was left blank. Their check-in instructions never specified I needed to list all names and Airbnb platform doesn’t require it. I’ve also never had this challenged by past hosts. This sets the stage for what came next.  Terrible check-in experience. My friend arrives ahead of me and is refused entry despite having the confirmation code, my name and all necessary check-in information from Airbnb. When he said he's here to check-in, the doorman said rudely "oh ya, YOU are checking in?". My friend claims this was racially motivated. I'm not going to conclude that but it certainly isn't how you want to be greeted. The concierge was out for one hour so the doorman allowed him to sit in the lobby. During that whole time, the doorman was suspicious of my friend. Again, my friend had the necessary check-in information from Airbnb (confirmation code, my name and length of stay). At some point, he lays down on the couch and the doorman runs at him yelling "who taught you to do that". Is it rude to put your feet on the couch? Sure but the context is ridiculous: a one hour wait for a concierge not available and a suspicious doorman with racist overtones.
