Convenient location close to the trains, quiet, shady street, close to grocery stores/delis and restaurants/bars. John was super responsive and helpful throughout my stay. Would definitely highly recommend this place to others!

The location was scary as a first timer to DC,  a  number of people congregated by the door late at night made me a little unsettled.  You get what you pay for, the room was nothing to complain about- clean and comfy.  But if you, like me,  can't sleep in a hot room,  then this just might not be the place for you during the heat of the summer.  If the heat and a little grit in the bathroom doesn't bother you, then for the price there is nothing wrong with this place.  The hosts truly were hospitable and accommodating,  and quite simply good-hearted.

I cannot say enough good things about this rental, these hosts and their awesome neighborhood.    The pictures are very accurate.  The apartment is  spacious and spotlessly clean.  EVERYTHING you could possibly need is there.  Tatiana has provided so many extra touches to the apartment-bathrobes, slippers,  coffee, tea, spices, and a very nice cooking setup .  You will absolutely not be disappointed in the apartment.  Max was there to greet us when we arrived.  He is very friendly and informative with regard to the workings of the apartment systems.   He was also helpful with information about navigating the neighborhood and the subway.  There are two trains that are very easy walking distance from the apartment.   We had zero problems during our visit but if we had these hosts were only a few steps away with help.  The neighborhood is diverse with lots of friendly people going about their daily lives.  That was a huge part of the charm for us.  There is a church a couple of blocks away where the children were outside selling candy for a fundraiser that we loved talking to.  We even took advantage of the few early nights we came in (and were not too exhausted) and sat outside on the stoop to listen to the sounds of the street life going on.  We came home at all hours of the night and never felt unsafe.   Also, Brooklyn has so many beautiful sights to offer and it was nice to be in such close proximity to everything.  When we schedule another trip to NYC we will positively contact these hosts again and book this apartment.  Thank you, Tatiana and Max, for sharing your beautiful space with us.
Great apartment in one of my most favourite neighbourhoods.  Too close to Emily - always dangerous :)  Communication, cleanliness, space, all really very good! Would definitely stay again soon.

Tatiana's place is really nice, cozy and clean. The apartment is spacious, has a nice vintage design and deco and it includes all the commodities you need for 4 people. It is well located (10 min walk to the subways L and J, which take you quickly to Manhattan or Coney Island). It was an amazing stay and Tatiana was really responsive.  Only observations would be that the air conditioner is only in the living room so we had to use fans in the bedrooms. Since we had a heat wave, some nights were really warm, but then most of the nights it was fine. Also, some of our devices weren't working with the WiFi network. And finally, the neighborhood can seem a bit dangerous (specially in the late nights) because of the dark streets, but overall nothing happened to us even coming back home really late and the area is really quiet, which was great.  Overall, the stay was really good, thank you Tatiana for everything and for receiving us with great details :) I would definately recommend!

We had a great experience staying with Carla.  The location of the rental is amazing -- right by major subway lines, easy to get to if you're driving, and enough street parking to avoid stressful hunts for a parking spot.  The neighborhood is great, with tons of restaurants, parks, and activities.  The rental itself is perfect for a stay in the city -- spacious bedroom, a great kitchen and living room, all nicely furnished and comfortable.  We hope to stay here again in the future!

This is a very nice and suitable place for anyone coming to NY with limited budget. It's close to Church Ave station which has F and G train. F trains can bring you to Time Square directly. To Manhattan around 20 mins and to time square around 40 mins. F train runs quite often.   Jason and his mom were really nice to me during my stay. They always asked what else do I need and tried to provided it for me. His house is also in a safe and quiet area. I came back late (11pm-1:30am) everyday and felt no danger in that area. People still walked around the station at that time as well.  I would recommend this place to anyone who gonna visit NY :)

Carla’s place is beautiful, stylish, and extremely clean. If you are looking to explore more of Brooklyn and know how to use the subway, it’s a perfect place. We were in New York a little more than I expected, so the Uber/Lyft rides were a little expensive especially during prime time, but if you and your group use the subway, there’s no worries. Carla was also very hospitable and let us check our bags in early while she was still cleaning, so we didn’t have to carry them around for hours. It’s cleaner than some hotels I’ve stayed in and is much quieter than staying in the middle of the city! It’s a steal! Thanks again, Carla!

This was my first time staying in an Air Bnb and I had a great experience. I was a little afraid to stay in an air bnb by myself but this exceeded my expectations. Carla is an amazing host. My flight came in earlier than expected and Carla was able to accommodate me with an early check in. Place is very clean and I felt safe there. It’s so comfy and cozy and much better than a hotel. If I come back to New York again, I definitely will be staying here.

Very nice little apartment that was ideal for our 4 day trip!  The kitchen has everything you need to prepare a quick breakfast in the morning and the bed was super comfortable. The walk to the next metro station takes about 10 minutes, and there are plenty of delis along the way that offer snacks and fresh food. There is a lot of police presence in the area, so you don't have to be afraid on the way home at night! The host is super friendly and gets back to you straight away if you have any questions. Conclusion: we would definitely come back! Important for people who are sensitive to noise: the refrigerator makes noises (it is only 2-3 meters away from the bed) and what is happening outside can also be heard. However, if you also spend 14 hours strolling through the streets of New York, you will still be able to sleep without any problems ;)

Stayed here for 4days. Cute, cozy, little and nice space. 10 mins walk to the nearest subway station, quick and easy connection to Manhattan downtown. Neighborhood seemed somewhat safe, not sketchy or noisy.

Foster was an exceptional host and gave us a comprehensive pack at the beginning of our stay to make sure me made the most of the spare and the local area. The location is perfect for being far enough out from the hectic city to have an escape but close enough to transport links for stress free commutes into Manhattan and the more buzzy parts of Brooklyn. The apartment had great amenities and was very modern with a very comfortable bed (something that isn’t always easy to find on Airbnb). Foster gave us some great recommendations for spots nearby for food and drinks and we would definitely stay again. Couldn’t recommend it more for your trip to New York!

The hosts are really really nice but really busy people so don't expect the house to be always spotless, or not to have dishes on the sink. We didn't like the location a lot at night, since we saw a lot of drug addicts on the Street and at the exit of the subway at night. The subway was really close though and it had great connections to the center of the city. 15 min walk from the North of Central Park. There was a supermarket nearby open till very late and an amazing bakery nearby. It is on top of a jazz bar but the noise was very soft, it didn't bother us. The house was warm and the room good enough for two people.

Mercedes was a great host - she got many points right away for helping set me up to have breakfast smoothies, and from then on was always helpful and fun to talk to. Her cat Neo was also very friendly =).  The room was comfy and warm and everything felt very convenient. I was in town to take a big exam nearby, so needed a place that felt reliable to de-stress and this was perfect - including that I felt like Mercedes genuinely cared about me doing well despite having just met me. I'd definitely recommend a stay with Mercedes!

Hi guy’s I will like to keep this very short and truthful as possible. This place is not suitable for people who have children. For the high price’s that you are paying to stay here is not even worth it. Don’t believe the pictures, I would advise you guys to read the reviews which in this case I did not do . Majority of the reviews are definitely on point after my stay this weekend. When I arrived downstairs near the door it smelled like cigarettes. Also I didn’t know it was on the second floor. And Where the stairs were is very dangerous to people who have young kids. My first night I couldn’t really sleep because I was so afraid of my toddler fallen down the stairs. Next was how badly the furniture was.Everything in there needs to be renovated with new furniture. The pots and pans were dirty  ,down to the toilet seat were dirty..The only good thing was the backyard and the lil five minutes walk to the beach. I think Airbnb needs to start cracking down and sending there workers to inspect these    Units because they are ripping people off with these high prices and we the renters/people are not satisfied and not getting our moneys worth it’s really unfair.  Book at your own risk because you wouldn’t be satisfied. I wouldn’t rent here again.

Don't be mistaken about not staying in Harlem, for fear that it is a distant and dangerous neighborhood according to what we have been told. Alfred and Lou's apartment is in a beautiful and quiet place in Harlem, close to the subway, many businesses, restaurants, although there is a jazz bar downstairs from the building, they close very early and open late, which does not disturb sleep. Harlem is a great place to stay, very quiet, beautiful, full of churches with masses and gospel. The owners of the apartment are very warm and respectful and you hardly see them, they follow the minimum rules of coexistence. I would repeat my stay in New York in their apartment or in Harlem. Thank you very much guys

Mercedes was incredible from start to finish, communication before and after was superb. The room is enough for 2 people slightly small but it's perfect if you want to enjoy New York and come only to sleep. The bed is large and comfortable. The welcome was great. The common areas are clean and pleasant. You shouldn't be afraid of cats but he stayed in his space and didn't bother us too much. In the end I recommend this air bnb, it’s good value for money.

Like a secret storefront at ground level in the Seaport neighborhood, we loved the look and feel of this generous space.  The home is well equipped, Rachel is easy to communicate with and very helpful, and we liked the sounds of the neighborhood.  We weren’t expecting a zen retreat at ground level anywhere on Manhattan!  The location is lovely, with easy access to the rest of the city.  There’s a great grocer just a few minutes’ walk away, between home and Fulton Station.  There are plenty of restaurants and and shops around.  Though not the most exquisite meals, we felt welcomed to the neighborhood in the bar at TJ’s behind the grocery (thanks, Tommy!)  Know going in that the shower is open to the main living area, so go with people who you’re okay sharing open space with.  It’s easy enough to sit out of sight lines to offer some space and privacy, but might be stressful for some travelers.  We thought the steam-shower was fantastic, the bed was comfy, the decor engaging.  Also, best blow-dryer ever.  We would absolutely stay here again.

Stay at megan´s home was very nice. It was my first experience with Airbnb and that's why I was a little afraid to do that. Everything went well, Megan responded very quickly and explained everything about our arrival in the city and her home. Her room was cozy, clean and secured privacy. The description of the accommodation corresponded to the reality.  A nice bonus of the stay were two beautiful cats. I also have a cat, so our stay at Megan made me more pleasant. I recommend and thank you.

Pros: -Very convenient location, subway stop on the same block. Lots of restaurants within a few minute walk. -Dish washer, laundry in unit -Dog friendly  Cons: -Construction right next door, very loud. One of the windows does not close properly so the construction noise bleeds in. -Radiator is EXTREMELY loud. Sounds like someone taking a hammer to a pipe. Turns on early mornings. I'm a heavy sleeper and it woke me up regularly. This is a deal breaker 100%.  -Very little space to store your belongings if you're here long term. Closet, cabinets, etc. are occupied with owner's things.  -Seedy people on the stairs leading up to the building on a regular basis. I would estimate at least once every 1-2 weeks. -Sketchy situation. Was told by owner on multiple occasions to not talk to neighbors since I don't think this unit is allowed to be rented on Airbnb.  I would not recommend staying here long term, a weekend or a week would be fine if you don't mind the noise.

Dave was really responsive to all my text messages but The room is really small and dusty. There is no privacy in the bathroom because is separated from the kitchen by a cotton curtain and it is not clean. The building is a little bit scary but is really convenient if you are planning a party night in a Bushwick.
Michael's place is super nice and stylish and perfect for our family of 6 plus a few friends!  It had absolutely everything we needed for a stress free beach vacation.

This is a great, no-frills spot to stay if you're visiting NYC! There are a few places nearby to get provisions and it's a short jaunt to the L. If you just need a place to sleep in the city that never sleeps, this is a steal.

Our top three words to describe JP's place: Clean, Private, and Conveniently Located.  JP's apartment is extremely clean, organized, and peaceful. It was always nice to come home to that after a long day. The bedroom is enough space for 2 people, and the bed itself was comfy!  It felt like we had the place to ourselves most of the day since JP was at work. Regardless, he's always responded to our text messages to answer any and all questions.  The location had a few ups and downs: The *greatest* advantage was being able to walk 2 blocks to take the metro to Manhattan (downtown NYC)!! Also, within the area, there are many small markets to purchase groceries and fresh fruit/vegetables or fast food restaurants. JP has a regular sized refrigerator incase you need to leave groceries or leftovers.   The smaller downside is that we had to practice extra caution and common sense when returning home at night, simply because we are tourists and we stood out. We never got threatened nor attacked in anyway, and there are cops right outside the metro station to keep the community safe. Just practice common sense. The walk home is short anyways and it's well lit at night. We would recommend this place since it's an opportunity to step out of the tourist zone (since we were in the tourist zone all day in Manhattan).  Overall, we had a great time at JP's place! We would visit again.
Great location for JFK airport , nice beach , good choice of restaurants but the neighborhood a bit scary!

This place was perfect for our stay. The room was also perfect it wasnt too small or too big. There was aircon in the room, which we used till we figured out that we could open the window! Dario provided towels and the bedding. The room had a great view of Manhattan and its surroundings. We were very satisfied with our room.  The building is along a main drag, it was also in a secured area, to get into the building you have to walk past security, Dario will provide you with a key and security pass to get through the security gate and then through the security door at the entrance of the building. The building is very secure - Safety is not an issue there. The area looks rough but its not. My partner and I did not feel unsafe at all. There are Deli's all along 1st Ave, bus stops are close, everythings walking distance. Was a great stay for us, we would def return if in the area.   Dario and Michael were very helpful, really good hosts. Theyve made a beautiful home and the view from the lounge is amazing. Thank you Dario and Michael for a great stay:)

Charle's place is what exactly look like the pictures. Charles is a funny and humble person, such a shame we didn't have chance to get him know more because our busy schedule.  Location is not the best. This is 45m to Manhattan but it worth for the price you pay compering to the crazy prices of staying in Manhattan! In terms of safety, I wouldn't say is dangerous but we didn't feel very safe walking around during night time.  Apart of that we had a nice experience and we might repeat again if we came back to NY.

For me, who has never rent a house from AIRBNB in another country i was kind of scared of the outcome and if i will be safe etc... LET ME TELL YOU, this is and AMAZING house; Charles was so kind , the house was on point , clean and just as he described; He makes you feel comfortable in there, all the things you will need (body soap, hands soap , listerin , paper, towels, body lotion) EVERYTHING is in there.... you will not regret staying in charles house 100% recommended; The subways/metro is 8 min walking, the bus is literally around the corner, you have a pharmacy nearby , food and all kind of restaurants near in gun hill avenue... TRUST ME , the best experience!

It's a great apartment, with a convenient location, a wonderful bed, and a helpful host. Lauren was excellent with communication and made the whole process stress-free. I would definitely recommend it and would be likely to stay again in the future.

I loved it, the place was clean and so homey and had a great smell to it!! The Netflix was a bonus and we used it a lot during our stay and there was also snacks and other small amenities supplied I didn't even have to run to the drug store to buy any of it. And Tony has so much hospitality, I had a great stay. Definitely recommend :)

Dear kat!! Thank you for your kindness and care. ... also Thank you for the wine you prepared.... I would recommend you to be in a really great location recommend this place if you want to go sightseeing in Manhattan. There are many restaurants, supermarkets, and so on around here. The subway is very close and it is not dangerous. Every morning, I loved the bread and coffee of Paribaguette.

Kat super host, very kind and sincere. We had to live through an unprecedented event like Covid 19, and he did everything in his power to make us feel good and cared for, he even gave us a wine for stress!  The location is excellent close to all subways. The apartment is in an old building that has access only by stairs but the apartment is well maintained. The kitchen is very small but it is enough to cook a different and healthier meal than what you can eat on the street. There is a supermarket very close and that helps.  The noises from the heating pipe that they say in the other comments are true but it didn't bother us at all and we have to take into account the way New York is built, which seems to me that the same thing is going to happen everywhere. The house is fully equipped with shampoo, conditioner, cream, soap, detergent, hair dryer! Everything you need for personal and home hygiene. It is the home with the true spirit of Airbnb. Good value for money. In short, I would return!

Kat was an amazing host! She was so accommodating and it was greatly appreciated after a long flight. In addition to this she gave wonderful suggestions and walked us through the house to make sure we knew how things functioned.  You will definitely get your steps in walking up the flights of stairs, which was needed after all the good food in NYC. There is a strong unpleasant odor in the hallways but it does not linger into the apartment which is nice. It can get a bit hot in there so bring some layers.   The pictures were accurate to the stay. I would say to bring house shoes to walk around in.   Overall, it was a good experience staying at Kats place.

Ronnie has been by far the best host I've had since using Airbnb. He was very understanding when we were running late for check in , and made my trip less stressful between driving us to a nearby store, and answering each annoying text or call, he made my stay amazing! The house is such a cute small space with a amazing view from the porch.

My stay at Ron’s place was okay check in and check out went really smooth, and  Ron was very good with communication. By the pictures I expected the place to be somewhat bigger but it was very small   Not as bad for me but if your someone who needs a good amount of space this is not a good place for you. The neighborhood was really nice and quiet it’s just hard to get around if you don’t have a car. The bed wasn’t comfy at all, and when I was in the shower for about five minutes or less the water started to turn very cold and this happened throughout my entire stay. The amenities might say Tv but just know it’s no cable and the WiFi doesn’t work. The apartment is on the 1st floor which was kinda scary.

Richard was an awesome host - he was very accommodating and allowed my friend and I to check in early when our flight arrived early, and also allowed us to leave our bags with him after check out so that we didn't have to carry them around the city until our flight. The apartment itself is located between two very close subway stations that service the D and B trains, so you can walk less than 5 minutes to the subway to hop on the train downtown. The area is very residential and my friend and I never felt unsafe walking home at night. I would definitely stay with Richard again.

I needed a comfortable place to crash while visiting with friends in Brooklyn and Queens, and this place was perfect for that. Tony was very helpful and quick to answer all my questions. It was an easy and stress-free stay!

The Hacienda is a perfect place to stay in lower Manhattan- quiet, private, cozy, tidy, and clean. Frankie responds quickly to any questions easing the stress of travel related issues. We would definitely like to visit again soon!

All and all, I enjoyed my stay. The location is a little far from Manhattan, but this is somewhat offset by the fact that the apartment is a very short walk from the subway. The neighbourhood would not have been my first choice in terms of amenities and had a few sketchy areas, but i still always felt safe.
Great location, clean and quick responses. Check in was extremely easy, which helped make the trip stress free.

We stayed at Tony's place for two weeks while on vacation in NYC. It's a pretty decent base for visitors. It's a small basement studio apartment but had everything my husband and I needed. Lots of closet space, good heat, hot water, high water pressure, extras like an iron, hair dryer, towels, body wash etc. There were a couple pans for cooking but no dishes or cups but we didn't do any cooking so didn't really need it. The bed was really soft but you can remove the top foam to make it a bit more comfy. A couple small questions came up during our stay and Tony was very responsive and had a great attitude of trying to accommodate and address any potential issues. Everything was described in great detail before we arrived so we had no issues with check in or settling in. The #3 train is just a couple minutes walk away and service is very regular so it was easy to get around. There some buses and other trains a bit further away as well. In terms of general safety in NY, a lot of people don't advise that you take the subway if it's too late so we got an Uber when we had very late nights. I was a bit worried about how the neighborhood was going to be since there are some notorious unsafe neighborhoods adjacent to it but actually the street and general area are just full of normal working class folks and everyone we met was warm and friendly to us. There is a corner store at the end of the block that closes at 9 pm in case you need anything, a laundromat on the street, and lots of restaurants on Uber Eats that will deliver to the apartment. I tried to give as many details as possible in case it is helpful to others. Overall, can't really fault anything about this place.

Jeff was super accommodating and helpful! He let us drop our bags off before and after our reservation while we ran around the city for Comic Con. We didn’t get to spend much time in the apartment but it was perfect size for two people with a bunch of stuff and a great place to lay out head down at night. He has a sweet cat that we loved petting and is in the BEST location in manhattan. There’s a lot of trendy and popular places near by and the train stations make life so convenient. This is one of the best spots to stay in manhattan, so this was a steal to find. Thanks Jeff!

We really enjoyed our stay at Jeff's apartment. He was extremely accommodating and helpful when we asked for advice. His apartment is very well located if you're wanting to visit the Chelsea Market area. Expect a typical NYC apartment and you'll be pleasantly surprised that the bed is comfortable, the shower isn't too small and he has a great living room space. Enjoyed petting his cat and getting to chat with him. He also really knows the city, so don't be afraid to ask. Definitely would recommend.

Giampiero was a wonderful host. Excellent communication, and very accommodating, offering us late checkout so that we could visit with our son before leaving town. He also offers to hold your bags for you before checkin or after checkout, which is a rare amenity.  The apartment is small but cozy, very clean, with a ton of closet space and a good sized bathroom with walk-in shower.  The location is excellent, with many good restaurants, delis, drug stores, etc nearby, and of course it’s close to Central Park. We plan on staying there again.

I was there for 2 weeks. Overall it was perfectly fine. Viviana is a good host! But it totally depends on the roommates who live in the apartment with you. The room doesn't have a window, which unfortunately wasn't clear to me beforehand! The air conditioning brought smoke from the cigarettes of the apartment's roommates in, which was unpleasant for me as a non-smoker. Otherwise the neighborhood is perfectly fine. Supermarkets are nearby and towels and bed linen are changed if necessary :)

In short, Jeff’s place is safe, comfortable, and convenient. He goes out of his way to make sure you have everything you need.   In long, Jeff’s place in Manhattan is the perfect place to stay while exploring NYC. I was traveling solo as a female, and I never felt unsafe. As other reviewers have said, you pretty much have your own wing in the apartment to yourself. The bathroom is particularly nice because of the lighting and the shower head. Before my trip, I wondered if Jeff would have some sort of curfew because it is a shared space. He is very laid back, and it’s totally fine to come and go. I went to bed at 9:00 pm most nights, so I don’t know why I even wondered about it! The area has everything you need, even a raccoon who serves you boba tea. (That was a need for me.) Jeff truly wants to make sure you have a perfect stay. He is very knowledgeable about lots of things, so he can help you find things to do/places to shop/places to eat that fit your interests. It is very easy to get along with him, and I loved talking with him every day!

Jeff's house was fantastic. Best location, great view, friendly host. Jeff accepted all our requests and made us feel comfortable. The house is in a safe neighborhood and it's not dangerous to walk around late at night. There is a nice jazz bar nearby. If I come to New York next time, I want to stay again!

Jody’s place was nice and well taken care of. It was clean and free of clutter. It was very close to the subway, which was very nice. We didn’t feel particularly safe in the neighborhood. There was drug use in the streets, lots of loitering, people begging for money, and the streets were very dirty.   If it weren’t for the neighborhood we would stay here again. Everything within Jody’s control was very good, but sadly the neighborhood wasn’t and would keep us from returning.

Jody's apartment is really great. Very comfortable and very clean.   Communication with Jody was perfect.  The neighborhood can seem a little creepy when we first arrive there but we have always been safe. The walking distance from the apartment to the metro is really quick. That's a big plus.  A bit long to get to Manhattan but we knew that when we rented the apartment.   Thank you for the lovely stay.

Great place to stay if you are looking for easy access into the city! The neighborhood is a little bit sketchy at night but wasn’t too bad. Jody had everything that we needed and the place was very comfortable!

All around not what pics show or detail. No TV holes in wall it’s a basement room so was scared of rodents. The sheets had stains on it with it being white.. the kitchen smelled like food and sooo close to bathroom very tight and small walls dirty and things that was hanging holes in walls as well. Very cold because it was a basement no heat . Will not stay again... Host does not reply to messages quick u have to message multiple times or get reply late not good.

As soon as you walk in, the studio feels like a home away from home! It's clean, spacious, comfortable, and has good indoor lighting and wifi. It's a basement unit so not much natural lighting, but offers privacy, having its own separate entrance.  It was nice to have a desk to get some work done. We also used the on-site parking option, which saved us a lot of hassle from looking for parking. The air conditioning was key for a stay in the summer, and proximity to a subway station (on the 2 and 5 lines) and to carryout restaurants, drug store and fruit markets was very convenient. We wanted to stay in the Flatbush area, and as soon as we arrived, we felt welcome. Jody is a great host, responding promptly to any questions. I highly recommend!

Basement apartment was exactly how described. Despite the listing saying potential noise on the streets, I slept better here than I do in rural Michigan. Street parking is nearly impossible but with Jody’s recommendation I was able to park 0.2 miles away in a garage for $30/day. A STEAL in New York. In a few months when I return I’ll definitely be booking here again !

Jason and Helen are great hosts. The communication was excellent from the beginning. The place is very clean, tidy and cozy. They always helped me with anything I needed. Helen made me very good breakfasts whenever she could and Jason gave me really good recommendations about different places to go in NYC and nice restaurants. I really felt very comfortable with them from day one. If I’d come back to NY I would go with them for sure. The neighborhood is quiet and safe (even in the late night, I always went back between 11pm and 2am and I never had a problem or felt unsafe). The locations is relatively near to Prospect Park and Greenwood Cemetery, F and G trains (Church Avenue), which is very convenient as you can get to Manhattan in approx. 20 or 30min. depending on where you go. If you’re looking for a good place and reliable people to stay with in Brooklyn, don’t waste more time, go with them.

Carmelo was kind and helpful.  He was concerned about COVID as expected.  So he has a temperature scanner that welcomes you in.  He lives in the apartment but doesn’t like you cooking anything there.  Place is clean and on the 24th floor.  Streets surrounding the building is a little dirty and with an unsafe feel to it.   Apart from that it is close to buses, trains, local Dominican restaurants and shops.  40 minutes in train from lower Manhattan.

After a terrible mix up with a previous booking (aka I got scammed), Paul was able to provide us a wonderful place to stay for our one night trip to NYC. This place fits 10, so the four of us had a bunch or room to spread out and relax. The bathroom is lovely with heated floors and a Jacuzzi tub and this place is in a great neighborhood with plenty of delicious restaurants to choose from plus a bodega right on the corner! One thing to keep in mind is that there is no living room/ common area where you can sit, but we just hung out in one of the bedrooms. There is also a mini fridge and a microwave, both of which were very useful. Thank you for your hospitality Paul!
Cozy place, a bit unsafe area, uncomfortable bedding since it has a plastic fiber texture. but the rest all good for a short stay in New York

This place is good, and we're glad we stayed here. There are pros and cons though - I suggest reading both (the pros probably win!)   If you're looking for reasons not to stay here, they're fairly minor:  - the shower was a bit odd, and never quite hot enough/enough water pressure  - there's only 2 mirrors (although the apartment technically sleeps 10 people), one in the bathroom and a skinny full length mirror in one bedroom - there's literally nowhere to sit, except on a bed or the floor in the hallway   On the upside, if you're looking for reasons to stay here:  - the location is great, it's 3 min walk to the 145 station and express trains go into downtown in like 15 mins, and come really often  - the sheets are SO SOFT! Seriously the best sheets I have ever slept on, and I've stayed in a lot of hotels!  - there's a guy selling fruit on the corner 24/7 (you can buy berries, grapes, everything, at 3am!)  - hairdryer and straightener provided  - fairly quiet neighbourhood, we didn't hear much from neighbours etc    We were initially concerned about it being a bit of a sketchy neighbourhood but it's really fine. Some really beautiful houses nearby too.  I wouldn't necessarily stay here again (because I like to explore different areas) but we're really glad we stayed here and would probably recommend it to friends (noting the negatives above). All up though, it's a good stay for the price, particularly if you have more than 2 people staying here :)

This was my worst Airbnb experience. Paul, the owner ruined our stay. We were told our reservation was wrong even though I confirmed multiple time via Airbnb messenger.  The super Edgar was very pleasant to work with but seemed to have to compensate for Pauls personality.  Paul was upset at the times and frequency that our 9 guests came in and out of the apt. We were quiet and he even said himself that we weren't loud. He complained about noise and in the same sentence said we weren't loud!   He also shared with me that he could hear everything we were saying and was listening from his downstairs apt. CREEPY!   He accused us of breaking a lock on the bedroom door that was never locked to begin with.  He accused us of smoking when when the smoke alarm detected " a small amount of smoke" ...we were reheating food in the microwave and were taking  showers. I'm not sure what tripped the warning to go off but it wasn't us smoking.   He was texting me nonstop throughout the weekend obsessively and really put a damper on things! Airbnb representatives recommended I block him bc he continued to text me even after we checked out!  I do NOT recommend this Airbnb
Great location for the price. The place is close to the train, the bank and a drug store. Get pizza and fresh fruit stand on the corner.

Paul was a great host in terms of communicating and responsiveness before and during the trip. The low review is because of 2 key factors: - None of my friends and I were able to connect to the wi-fi at the AirBnB. We were in constant communication with Paul throughout the trip to figure it out but we were never able to connect so we were unable to freely use our computers to do work at night and ended up incurring data overage costs using our phones as hotspots. - One of the bunk beds in one of the rooms was a bit shaky/not sturdy. My friends staying there were afraid that the top bunk would collapse during the middle of the night or weren't able to fall asleep because of the noise and squeaks the unstable bunk beds caused.

Exactly as seen in the photos, quite comfortable. I found it clean, although my travel companion said his bed was not so clean.   It should also be taken into account that it is not a complete house that is offered, it is only one floor with bedrooms and a bathroom, although there is a refrigerator and a microwave.   Edgar is a calm and pleasant person, and it is very easy to get along with him, he is very willing to help and makes everything easy. A bathtub broke down and left us access to another bathroom in the house, and he was very generous with the bedrooms, he didn't give us any trouble choosing, etc. The house is a little run down in some ways, and for some people used to European standards of accommodation it may seem insufficient, but if you are visiting New York and need a good place to sleep and shower and such... well, it's not bad. It has a subway stop very close, with an express line that takes you to the center of Manhattan in 10 minutes. The area may seem dangerous at certain times, but it is not at all. Harlem is a neighborhood with its own culture, and a very particular and interesting atmosphere, it is worth stopping to get to know it and enjoy it.  It is possible that if I returned to New York I would stay here again, I have been comfortable in general.

Regina is genuinely the best host ever. She is incredibly kind and helpful and provides a complete range of amenities to make your stay in NYC stress free. Regina goes the extra mile for her guests; everything is kept spotless at all times, clean sheets and towels provided often, and sometimes a delicious dinner or breakfast will be made for you. The room is well-equipped and comfortable. There’s always hot water and the WiFi works perfectly. This location is safe and quiet and is conveniently located by two metro stops so you can get where you need to go easily. Perfect location for anyone, especially if you’re a student or professional. If I could give 6 stars, I would. Highly, highly recommend Regina.

Lovely apartment in a nice neighborhood that's conveniently located relatively to Manhattan and other parts of Brooklyn.  Only issue we had was with the heating, which went a bit haywire during our stay, causing the apartment to become a sauna on what was already a warm fall day.  (The apartment does not have air conditioning.)  The hosts were nice enough to jump out of work to address the issue by turning off the thermostat, which is only accessible in the building's basement.  This was still a rather unpleasant experience, but assuming it's not a recurring one, I'd recommend the lodging.

This was our first air bnb experience and I suspect future trips may struggle to match it! The apartment is even lovelier than it looks in the photos.  Four adults spent 15 days here (one sleeping on the sofa bed) and we were really comfortable.   There were many thoughtful touches we really appreciated after a long flight - fresh coffee, tea, biscuits and dairy produce in the fridge.  There were tasteful Christmas decorations and lights which were especially welcoming. Bob responded immediately to all of our requests.  Access to Manhattan was easy and quick via the A train, a real bonus.  I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Robin and Bob and their lovely home to others.
Lovely, spacious apartment in a perfect location. Excellent, easy communication with host Ben makes for a relaxing, stress- free visit to New York.

This place is a gem! The apartment is very comfortable and well equiped. Robin and Bob are very prompt in responding to inquiries. We asked for more towels and advice on getting back to the airport and it took just minutes for them to respond. Leaving our luggage past the check out time was no problem. Bed-Stuy is just wonderful. The subway is nearby and we didn't feel unsafe for one minute. Be sure to go to Manny's, just around the corner and excellent food. Nana Ramen on Malcolm X Boulevard is a great place to eat. Be sure to visit Brooklyn Bridge Park. Gorgeous views on the Manhattan skyline and the bridges. We walked to Manhattan over the Brooklyn Bridge on our first day. No better way to start off your visit to NYC!!! We fell in love with this city and had a GREAT time. Robin and Bob and their lovely house surely contributed to our unforgetable experience!!!

Very friendly host. Very clean quarters. I probably didn't read well, but be warned that there is no AC. The neighborhood appeared a little shady at first, but was truly nice with a very young crowd and great places to eat. I suggest Luke's lobster for the maine lobster rolls within walking distance.

Jennie was very courteous and made contact with me as soon as possible. I never met her, but I did meet her roommate who was really pleasant and helpful. To those who have never been to the North East part of US, be warned that many places do not have centralized AC. This was the case, but the place was clean, and the bedroom was tidy.   The rooftop view was absolutely stunning, and I would be more than happy to come back at a cooler season just to see the view again. The neighborhood seemed rough and sketchy, but after venturing out NY, the neighborhood was actually just fine.   Jennie was super flexible and understanding about check in and check out time. I had a very enjoyable experience overall.

I know choosing an Air bnb can be pretty scary but rest assure you have nothing to worry about in this choice. Everything (from the images to the description) was accurate. Akini's co host was super nice. She really made me feel like I'm at home. Words can't describe how clean the place was.   I definitely would return.
Lovely property and great location. Definitely check out Rob & Bobs recomendations - we tried one of the local restaurants they tipped us off in their guest book and it was amazing.

The flat is a delight to spend your time in NYC. It’s very well located and close to the subway, so it is a perfect location to enjoy Manhattan without the hustle and bustle of the big city.   The hosts are really understandable and they are available at all times, if you need any help, Rob and Robin will be there to help you!   Overall we had such a great experience and I really recommend everyone who decides to visit NYC to stay in this apartment: it’s clean, well-located, with lovely places nearby to have breakfast or enjoy a nice dinner !!   Thank you !!

Robin and Bob’s apartment makes a great base for exploring all that the big Apple has to offer.  It’s an easy 8 minute walk to the Express ‘A’ subway train that has you in downtown Manhattan in about 20 minutes. Midtown in half an hour. An unlimited 7 day subway pass is 33 dollars. Great value.  There’s a handy folder in the apartment of local cafes, bars and restaurants that we found very useful and accurate. Saraghina is worthy of special mention. Ate there twice and it was excellent.  The apartment itself was super clean on our arrival and they kindly let us check in early as we were on the early am flight out of London that put us into JFK at lunchtime.  My wife and I travelled with our two teenage sons - 1 was very comfortable in the small bedroom off the master bedroom and my older son was quite comfy on the easy pullout sofa bed.  Note that the TV has only Netflix, YouTube and Hulu - no broadcast TV - this is accurately described in the listing I should stress - but it would be nice to have access to local news. I always enjoy that when in the US.  My only word of caution - and it’s a very mild one - is that the general area of Bed Stuy might be a tiny bit gnarly for some. It’s a very mixed area, income wise. Young professionals and hipsters co-existing with other locals who are clearly struggling. This can lead to the odd tension being expressed on the street. I had to deal with a very persistent and aggressive beggar in the subway station the first time we went down there to buy our passes.  But of course and after that no problems on the subway at all.  Robin and Bob responded to any questions almost instantly and were great hosts. I’d recommend their apartment to anyone and stay there again in a heartbeat. Thanks for having us..!

The apartment was wonderful. Its design is neat and cozy, with nice little details. The location is really good, a 10 mins walk to the metro. Communication with Rob and Robin was very smooth. The offered good tips for in the neighbourhood. I would really recommend staying in this apartment!

We stayed in Rob & Bob's great apartment for 10 days on our way to Florida. We immediately felt at home. The apartment is as described in the pictures and really incredibly cozy. It is well located, close to the subway, well equipped with every conceivable item for everyday use and lovingly furnished. However, the friendly hosts deserve special mention. Contact was possible at any time and all questions/concerns were resolved immediately.  We'd love to come back any time!!!
Loved this place. Check in was super easy, Robin & Rob communicated with us in a timely manner. The place was so comfortable for 3 of us. Would definitely stay here again!

Spotlessly clean and cheerfully decorated apartment in a beautiful old building. Robin and Rob provide lots of tips on neighborhood restaurants, and helpful subway information.  The kitchen had everything we needed for simple breakfasts and dinner. It was extremely comfortable for our family of three. Just be aware that the only entrance to the small bedroom is through the master bedroom.

Amazing hidden little gem in Bedstuy! The beds are amazing and comfy. The space is beautifully decorated.  Robin and Rob are lovely hosts.  They gave us many recommendations for places to eat in the area and fun things to do. They also left umbrellas out for us to use when it rained, they were exceptionally kind!

A most rejuvenating stay in this haven of peace in the heart of Brooklyn. Extremely accommodating hosts and excellent communicators.  A place that welcomes you like a real home. Comfortable beds, impeccable cleanliness despite a model in the rooms. A bright and extremely well equipped place. Towels, shampoo, soap, tea, coffee. Reading lights everywhere.  Located on a quiet street in the residential area a few minutes from the metro.   To go to Manhattan you take the A or C trains and you are in the Theater District in 30 minutes! We ended up never taking a taxi to get home, the metro is so efficient and close. I was afraid of being too far from Manhattan, but in the end I didn't regret choosing this neighborhood at all, which is also a real favorite.  The hosts’ restaurant guide is great! We followed all their advice and we are delighted. Looking forward to going back.  Enjoy your stay until next time! You will love it! And thanks again to Robin&Bob! You are simply the best!

The house is as it appears in the publication, which is ideal for 6 people.  The kitchen, bathroom and rooms were very clean upon arrival, our flight arrived earlier than expected and we were able to check in earlier.  Jon was very kind, he received us and was always attentive to what we needed.  The residence has several subways nearby, 2 police stations, a school, a church and many places to shop for supermarkets.  I highly recommend it for those who speak Spanish since it is a Latin neighborhood, and if you like Mexican food there is a good and cheap food place very close.  The house has a heating system that works well in general, but it generates a lot of noise at night and sometimes it was not enough to keep the house warm.  You must consider that you cannot enter the house with shoes, so it is advisable to wear slippers, it also has stairs, which makes it a bit difficult to use the suitcases.  Everything else was fine, at first we were a little afraid to go out late but later we discovered that it was very quiet.  We stayed 15 days and it was ideal for us, I hope more people enjoy their stay here.

I had a very lovely experience staying here! Even though I never met Brady he was very helpful and gave me all the info I needed before I showed up and everything was exactly how he said. It is conviently located close to the metro. The place itself is absolutely adorable!! Also very clean and comfortable. I would definitely recommend people stay here (:  Although I do feel the need to mention that the neighborhood itself is a little bit sketchy. I came as a single female and I would not recommend anyone walk alone through the neighborhood at night. I left in the early afternoon and witnessed a scary looking altercation just down the street a bit. However it is NYC so I would warn anyone to exercise good judgement and caution.  Other than that I loved my stay here!

Brady is honestly the nicest host I could ever ask for. Bedhaus is an awesome, decorated 3 floors house with a lot of rooms and great common space. The kitchen is always organized, the bathrooms are really clean all the time. Everything is colorful and happy out there :)  There are two Subways stations very close which makes it exciting to go explore the city. Bedford-Stuyvesant is a neighborhood so there's nothing to be afraid of. There's supermarket around, as much as Delis, pharmacy and a lot of bars around.  Also, I wasn't feeling very good one of the days I was there and Brady was super nice about it. He made me ginger tea and was worried about my health. Everything related to Bedhaus is a plus. Great hot shower, great Wi-Fi sinal, great foreign people that uses the other rooms.  I can't wait to be back to NYC, to Brooklyn and mostly to Bedhaus!!! Great experience.

Brady and Jeff's place was nothing short of cozy, quirky, and warm. I can't stress enough how much I loved the entire house. The room is clean and tidy, and comes with a standard twin bed (very comfy!), a vanity area, floating closet space with hangers, and A/C. Though it didn't offer much natural lighting, the living room is the perfect place for it. I actually enjoyed doing my makeup in the living room since I got to meet a few of the other guests as well. And even though I wasn't able to meet my lovely hosts since our schedules were not in sync, Brady was very responsive via text and Airbnb. The only thing I can think of that may be a downside for some would be the sloped ceiling. I'm pretty short so that was not an issue at all but it could be for taller folks. The water temp also changes from time to time but nothing too drastic where it'll make you scream or jump up. As for the location, there wasn't a moment where I felt unsafe since it is fairly quiet and neighbors are friendly. Overall, I really enjoyed my stay here and I'm already looking forward to booking the same space again on my next visit :)

The bronx may sounds dangerous but Kim’s place was safe and pleasant.  The neighbourhood is packed with the laughter of Childrens, friendly greetings of residents and stray cats! There were 2 deli nearby which is perfect for my morning breakfast, and a 5min wall to the groceries. To the city, it took an hour to reach.   There was a weird smell in the house when i first step in however it dissipated when i got to my room. My room had the biggest bed and sofa. I felt that the photo posted didn’t do justice, the actual room was way way BETTER than expected.     On the other note, the shower knob come off when i first started using it, but just a simple twist back in the slot & it was fixed. i don’t know if that’s how it is suppose to work but just bear in mind. Aside from that, the house was well-maintained and cleaned every late afternoon.   I enjoyed my stay over there and would definitely head back again! :)

Well, this definitely has been the most challenging place to stay that i have found thru airbnb.  First, the apartment is small but enough to fit 2 or 3 people. Small kitchenette, one sofa at the living room, and one air mattress that we could never set up to work right. No space to hang anything, and actually, looked like they didn't expect to receive anybody even though we confirmed booking since first week of the month. The place looked messy, with stuff lying around everywhere, but the worst part is, beneath the messines, it was dirty.  Even though i priorly asked for a set of clean sheets and clean towels, i got them, but definetely not clean. Had to bought new towels, because the ones we got smelled funny. Every space of the house was at best dusty, at worst filled with women hair. By the second day we had to sweep and mop the entire place to feel a little comfortable, but really didn't help. We left by the 4th day. I know the price wasn't high, but to pay 25US for the cleanliness was a bad joke.  On the bright side location is awesome. Harlem is a really nice place to stay. You will find a store or bodega in every corner, the 16th st subway is a couple blocks away, and around on Frederick douglas Av. you can find a bunch of restaurants, bars, cafes and some stores, great place to hang around at night. Central park is 10 min. walking distance. You see a lot of locals hanging around on the streets all day and night, but nobody messes with you, i never felt unsafe or threatened. If you want to meet the real harlem, walk up north some 5 minutes to 125th avenue where you can find cinemas, stores and chain restaurants, and mostly the local harlem flavor.

A lovely house in a really interesting part of Brooklyn. Close to two subway lines and with some great bars, cafes and places to eat in the vicinity. Unfortunately Brady wasn't there during my stay but sent very helpful instructions and Joakim, who was looking after the house, was extremely helpful with one small issue I had. Do be aware that the room is small, which was fine for me as one person and does get very warm if it's hot out. There is only one small window. Nonetheless would recommend if you are looking for somewhere to crash in Brooklyn with good connections into Manhattan, stress free check in and out and with great value for money. Thanks!

I loved it. Many Koreans might think Harlem is dangerous. So did I. But it's not true. At least around Mimi's house is Ok. Mirlande was so sweet and nice. I did't feel any inconvenience. I wanna stay there again.

Seamless and comfortable Air Bnb experience. The hosts were very respectful of my privacy and any interactions we did have, I felt that they genuinely cared about my comfort and well being during my stay. It definitely made for a stress-free lodging experience during my NYC visit!

The place in Brooklyn was amazing! As a former New Yorker believe me I know and respect the benefit of on sight parking! The actual apartment was very clean aswell. When we came in the fridge was stocked with about a 3 day supply of water bottles which was great because we didn’t have to go grocery shopping the day we got there. Frankly if your going to stay in Brooklyn I would highly recommend this place. The neighborhood was quiet and safe. (Even when we were sitting on the Porch at 2 am we didn’t here any unpleasant sounds! Their father is also very sweet and kind and honestly you’ll forget he’s even there!

The check-in process was super easy and having the option to drop my luggage off ahead of time made my trip much less stressful. The place was up to standard and exactly what it was said to be. No unexpected surprises.

Y'all. Need. To stay. Here!! The hosts are super inviting and accommodating. The atmosphere in the space is calm, comforting, and comes with plenty of amenities as well. The neighborhood has so much to offer at any time of day, and for the price it's honestly a steal. The experience I had here I could not put a price on. You'll just have to see for yourself :)

Very nice room and house. The check in and out was excellent. The area can be a bit scary at first but there wasn't any problem even at late night. The metro line J is very close but there was a few service outage when I was there, but the buses are good.

I stayed with Chris and Elizabeth for 3 months. There wasn't a day, hour, or minute I felt uncomfortable in their home. My first night there I forgot my toothbrush, and later on I managed to catch the flu and then strep throat right after. Whatever situation i found myself in, Chris and Elizabeth went above and beyond as my hosts. I can't stress enough that they are super nice and caring people. All the details were as described in the listing, and the apartment is central to everything and anything you would want to do in Williamsburg. You will not be disappointed if you stay here, it will be a great experience.

CESAR welcomed us by leaving the keys in a locker on the street. The apartment is located on a busy street, it has a narrow, quite dirty doorway, very steep stairs, close to the subway and small restaurants, a noisy street, although inside it faces a patio and only has one window, the noise does not reach, except on the weekend, when there is a lot of noise and you can hear the neighbors.... The bed was used and when we changed the sheets, what we found below.....it was very unpleasant. There were remains of food in the refrigerator, also on the counter, in the fruit bowl there was spoiled fruit, which we had to throw away. The apartment as it appears in the photos, small, but we think that some hangers to hang clothes, a "burrito" or something similar, in the apartment, would be good. Our host forgot to leave us soap and shower gel.

Great place, my first expirience with airbnb was amazing with faigie and her husband, at first i was a little afraid bcause i thought i was gonna be in a extrange house, but this family was very very veeeeery great hosts they are always ready to help you, they even gave to me eggs for cooking the breakfast, water, and even faigie lend me her phone, bathroom amenitties where more than enough, dont think it more if you want a great place for a great price! Close to the subway  Belive me, this is the place to go!

Not that clean, moldy shower curtains, the futon comes undone and falls apart because it has unsecured middle legs, barely clean floors no vacuumed carpets, broken little red table, scared to touch anything, black futon pillow had dried up drool marks, very unpleasant stay, we looked for a nearby place and couldn't afford it so we where stuck there. reached out to Cesar to offer fixes and he just said use the little space heater after writing a thorough email about the issues. only has little throw blankets on bed, to small and light to stay warm, if you use the space heater the furnace turns on randomly and you will wake up sweating feeling like your in an oven, absolutely not what we expected.

The positive reviews reflect much of our own experience: excellent host; excellent location (Chelsea Market around the corner); spacious apartment; close to subway (blue line around the corner).  Customers with disabilities should be made aware that the apartment is not at street level. You need to go down three steps. If you have access to clothes washing facilities there is a 15 step stairwell you have to go down. Light levels are also an issue because the apartment is lower than street level. It remains dark well into the daylight hours so you should set your alarms because you might sleep in a lot. There were some issues with the (mostly halogen) ceiling lighting, which you may have to keep on through much of the day. I suspect the lighting transformers might not be working so well since  some of the lighting arrays would be strong one day and very low the next. The two main bedrooms are at the front of the apartment, facing the street. They are bed width rooms (a little more than twice the length). You cant really open the windows to the bedroom because the disposal bins are next to or near the windows, so you have to use the air conditioners (split system in every room) to get airflow.  If you are not staying there for more than a week dont forget that you may not have access to the clothes washers and dryers, so you need to have enough clothing packed.  Chelsea/Meatpacking is a great location. Multicultural; a relaxed atmosphere; a mixture of people from all social classes and identities. In my view it is better than the oversanitised blocks around Central Park. Chelsea/ Meatpacking close to lots of places tourists want to go. Its a good area for first time visitors to Manhattan. When you get to the apartment go round the corner to Chelsea markets for a feed and nice bottle of wine to take home. Immediate groceries: Walgreens around the corner going east. Big food and beverage shopping- I suggest the really excellent Westside Market on 7th Avenue and 15th street. Bread and pizza square: Try Sullivan Street Bakery on 9th and 24th or Amys at the Chelsea Markets.  NYC first timers: you need Google Maps; Subway Map and compass on your smartphone to minimize disorientation when you come out of subways. Enjoy. Its a great place to be.

We have stayed in this basement studio-flat for 4 nights recently. In the contrary to other reviewers we did not have a chance to meet Fay due to our itinerary, as we were leaving quite early or coming back rather late.  Arrival and departure.  Our flight was arriving at JFK after 10pm, hence we had to “check-in” after midnight. We have pre-agreed it with our host and she made sure that we can have an easy access to the basement upon our arrival.  Similar situation was with our departure. We had to leave quite early for the airport, but again, we have pre-agreed it with Fay and there were again no problems with that.  Apartment   As I have already mentioned, this is a basement studio flat located in one of the typical houses in Brooklyn. To get in, one has to go through the back door via one set of stairs. Good access and separate entrance make it very convenient for tourists who needs to have a privacy and also easy, uninterrupted access to the flat.  Flat itself is a medium size room with sink, cooker/oven, fridge and freezer. There is also big dinning table with some chairs, three beds, arm chair, two storage cupboards and of course microwave. There was also a big TV with access to Netflix and YouTube. So, in general all what one might need during the stay. There was also a separate bathroom/ toilet with shower. I have to add that our host made sure that bathroom was fully stocked with toiletries. However, we have used only soap as we had our own items. As it is in the basement, despite few small windows, it is rather dark there, even when lights are one. I would guess that few extra lights feature up the celling would do.   Flat itself was quite clean. Of course, carpet probably could be washed more often, but it was not the end of the word in fact. However, in our opinion it was little bit outdated. All items, except TV seen already theirs glory days, which makes apartment to look rather “tired”. I would say that little bit of refreshment would do to make flat to look cosier.   Location  This is a biggest advantage of this property. It is just 5 minutes’ walk from Kings Hwy Subway station, where you can take a line Q directly to Manhattan. And as a Subway runs 24/7, this make a good starting point for everyone who likes to see the city.  There are also few convenience stores around some food carts and small stores selling bagels, etc. so, again, good location.   Biggest Problem  Unfortunately, this flat has one big problem, which we have found out upon our arrival – cockroaches. We could see them everywhere during duration of our stay. On the dining table, bathroom, corridor, near the sink. In fairness numbers weren’t big, but just the fact that there were visible and that despite us killing few, there were still new one coming, made it rather unpleasant experience. We know that our host was aware about the problem as we could see the bug trap at the floor near to cooker. Fay also confirmed that to us when we have asked her about it after our departure, but except small apology no suggestion of any case of compensation has been made. Apparently, this was a due to building site couple of hundreds of meters away. As the building site is quite far away, one would expect that this problem will be taken care of (also considering that it is dragging for a while).  What we really do not appreciate is that fact that we have not been notified about this issue before booking our stay. Of course, I do not expect to see it in the description of the property itself, but at least in one of the messages we have exchanged, so we do feel strongly mislead. In fairness, we would not book our stay there if we knew about this problem. Also, this will be main reason why I will have to reduce rating significantly.   Summary:  Due to close proximity of the Subway station this place can be a good “base” for travel makers in NY. It is not the most modern or cosiest place one can think of, but it is sufficient. However, cockroaches are rather significant issue and lack of notification about this, make it even worse. What would happen if someone would have a fear of cockroaches or been allergic to them? So just due to this fact alone, unfortunately, I would not recommend this place to stay for as long as bugs issue is sorted.

Our stay in this lovely basement apartment was an emergency and eased some of the stress related to our visit. The hosts were very accommodating and went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable. It is the perfect set-up for people who want privacy, but know that friendly people are upstairs. Thank you!

This was my first experience using airbnb, and I could not have picked a better host. I was scared but Gram was very communicative to my needs and wants. I did not meet Gram himself but the person that he had set up to meet us was very kind and informative of the area and places to eat. She also gave us excellent advise on how to save money wile traveling. The house was everything I expected and the location could not have been better for us.

He sent me a message in the morning describing where he has left the key and incase if I have any trouble finding the key in the described location, I was give a number to call. When I reached the place, I wasn't easy to find the key, so I had to call the number given to me and it wasn't easy experience even when the other person explained me over the phone. I did mention to me the host that I will reaching the place in night. The neighborhood was safe, but in night when I reached the place it was an uncomfortable experience to search for the keys and I was quite scared about the neighborhood.

Graham was very receptive and attentive since we made the reservation. The appartment is cozy as in the photos. Everything went well. My family just did not like the suite bathroom, it seems improvisated and dangerous to use. But everything else was perfect. I recomendo!

I'm sorry to say that this, but I didn't have the greatest experience. I've stayed in many AirBnBs around the world and this by far was the most disappointing. The other review were somewhat positive, so I expected more. Other reviews mentioned the loft bed being an inconvenience and I agree. The ladder is not the most stable. If you needed a space for children then I think they would really enjoy it but for adults it's just not suitable. My sister in law was very scared to sleep on top. I noticed in the comments section that Lisa had provided an air mattress for a guest who was unable to sleep in the loft bed. When I made this request, she stated that she would have to have to charge me extra. The listing states that there are 6 beds available for up to 8 people but that was not the case. Maybe there was another added space but this space in particular had a queen bed in an adjacent room, a queen loft bed, and a twin bed below. You can tell that the rooms where the beds are located are in a space that is an add on to the home. Honestly it just looks like bad contracting. The bath in the room with the queen bed is not usable. I didn't mind so much because the first bathroom in the common area was just fine. My only issue was that on my final day there wasn't any hot water. Graham did his best to fix it. He was very kind and offered me a partial refund. The bathroom also has a few quirks. For example there's a note to not lean on the sink as it could fall off the wall. There are also instructions for you to turn the left knob of the shower to 10 o clock for hot water and then only adjust the cold. Lisa was unavailable to meet me upon my arrival. I didn't mind. I live in the city and can navigate it just fine. She gave me instructions on how to retrieve the key and on how to heat the apartment. Since the brownstone is older is does not have central air or heating. It instead has space heaters and wall units. The apartment was very cold at first but eventually warmed up. I hate to say this but Lisa wasn't the nicest. One of my guest noticed a stain on her sheets and when I inquired about it, Lisa said the airbnb was used like a hotel every day so there would naturally be wear and tear. I've stayed in many hotels and have never had an issue. I also noticed residue on the toilet and informed Lisa about this. She stated that the toilet was her fault because it was newly installed and she forgot to wipe it down. The next morning she came and changed the sheets and cleaned the toilet. She also lent me the...

We loved staying at Lisa and Graham's place! It was extremely comfortable, beautifully decorated, clean, and stocked with items to get you going in the morning, like milk, tea and coffee. Lisa and Graham's place is a very short walk from the 2+3 subway lines, which allows you to access many tourist attractions directly, or with 1 transfer. This is my second time staying in the area where Lisa and Graham's place is located; I've never felt unsafe, even while returning quite late at night.   As Graham and Lisa have pointed out in their listing, one of the showers is in a deep soaking tub. The tub has a high wall and requires a bit of a stretch. I didn't have any problems with the climb, but was traveling with some people over 60, who found it more difficult. However, if you're able to make the climb, the tub is very comfortable and in fact, I preferred it over the regular shower!  Lisa and Graham were both quick to respond to messages and it was evident they wanted to ensure that we were comfortable while staying at their place. Lisa generously stayed up to let us check-in late, and even took the time to give us a quick tour at that late hour.   All in all, we couldn't have asked for better hosts. Thanks again, Lisa and Graham!

The host was great. He was very flexible with timing. The house owner was on vacation, so we had the whole house to ourselves. It was a really interesting set up. The rooms were filled with art from around the world. The sheets did not seem clean, the floors were really dusty and the toilet was clogged when we arrived. The area can be a little sketchy at night, but it is safe. If you're looking for a cheap place, and don't care if you're close to manhattan or if the place is clean. But for the price, you get what you pay for, and in this case, it was more.

The apartment is really very clean, functional and completely renovated. There is everything you need for a great vacation! It is ideally located, 5/10 minutes from the metro in a quiet area.  Paul answered all our questions with great professionalism and responsiveness. He agreed to let us leave the apartment in the afternoon to accommodate us (our flight was scheduled for late afternoon) while the exit was scheduled for noon. We highly recommend this apartment!

Our first Airbnb fell through and so more or less we were homeless in NY. We reached out to several other Airbnb hosts and Paul was the one to come through.  We were not able to get the space immediately, but he prepped us for being able to use the space in the next couple of days. We were able to get in when he promised and the place was a  bit smaller than expected, but Paul prepared me for that, as we were a group of 4 sharing the space.

This apartment has everything––kitchen, bathroom, closet, fridge, air conditioning, wifi, and on top of that, it's in an amazing location. The AC is just a couple minutes away, and so are the G, the 2 3, the B D, the F, the Q, and the R. I worked in the Meatpacking District, and my commute was shorter than people who lived in Manhattan!   Some things non-New Yorkers should be aware of:  - Though the building is in great shape, it's a typical old New York building, so there are clear signs of aging. This doesn't mean the apartment isn't clean or functional (it is both those things!) it's just not brand-new. - Because it's old, there might be a small utility issue here and there, but this is where Benjamin's great communication comes in. Any time there was an issue (I had a small plumbing problem and an air conditioning issue) Benjamin had it fixed within 12 hours, if not less. Incredible!!! - Though the location is fantastic, there are some sketchier streets in the area. Try to stay west if you can, and if you need to go east, take big streets like Atlantic Ave. Again, if you're from New York or another big city you know this is par for the course, but if you're not used to city life it's something to be aware of.  A few more positives I haven't yet mentioned: - The apartment is well-stocked, so no need to bring towels, toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, dish soap, cleaning supplies, or anything like that. - You'll be right by a Target, a Whole Foods, a Trader Joe's... Plus there's a grocery store right around the corner, and tons of cool thrift stores and bars all around you. Even though it's a lively area, this particular street is pretty quiet, so no need to worry about noise at night!  All in all, I want to thank Benjamin, Christine, Aileen, and Eena for an incredible stay! This is a great apartment in an excellent location with accomodating hosts. I hesitate to even recommend it, because I want it to be available for my future stays :) Five stars!!!!
Great, ultra comfy place in the heart of the city.  My wife and I had a wonderful time and if you're not a afraid of a couple of stairs this is your spot.

It was our first unpleasant experience with Airbnb apartment. After arrival we've learned that there are plenty of mice running around our bed which eventually led us to moving out of this place immediately during the night. Even though the host was very friendly and tried to fix this issue as soon as possible we wouldn't consider this standard as something worth paying for.

My husband, 13 year old granddaughter, and I, stayed at Joyce's lovely apartment in Brooklyn for a week.  The apartment is very comfortable, and in a great location.  It was close to markets, drug stores, and many places to eat.  Joyce was very helpful and was available for any questions we had.  The apartment is decorated with beautiful art work, and was very clean.  Coming home to the apartment after a long day of sightseeing and walking helped make our visit so much more enjoyable.  We highly recommend Joyce and her colorful apartment in Brooklyn.

This place is awsome! We really enjoyed our time there. Jurmain and his dad are great hosts and they made us feel like at home. The location is safe, I felt a little bit scared at the beginnig but never felt uncomfortable walking back during night. We will stay there again when we come back to NYC.

We arrived at Jurmain's house and he never opened the door for us, then we called him on his cell phone many times and he never answered, apart from this the place seems unsafe, many people smoking marijuana in the corners and looking bad. The days passed and we had to find a hotel somewhere else with high prices, Jurmain never appeared again and we were left owing the money we paid for this application.

This place is awesome!  Although it's in Bronx and the train ride to Times Square is about 30min, its worth it.  Jurmain, his brother and dad were super helpful and welcoming.  The room was so cute and the walk to the subway is less than 5min plus my boyfriend really wants to go back there lol!  Before the stay I read the comments of some ppl saying that the neighborhood can seem a bit sketchy (and it can seem like that especially for someone like me - a Scandinavian first time in NY) but my boyfriend and I thought that there's really nothing to worry about.  All in all -  i totally recommend it!

Jurmain is a very nice host. We felt very welcome at his house and the room was very clean (just sometimes a bit too hot in it haha).  If we needed help with anything he was here to help us. He showed us everything we wanted to know on a map and was very kind. When the Phone of my friend was stolen, he helped a lot even after we left New York. He even drove us to the Newyark Airport for only 50$ (a taxi would have been 100$ or even more). Just start early enough - I nearly missed my flight :P  Thanks for this great accomodation. We would definitely recommend to stay there.

We had a wounderful stay at the Wielingen. I strongly recommend this place for any stay in NYC. You won't get a better value for your money! The place is nice, neat and spacious and Jurmain and his dad are great people to meet. Walking through the Bronx ain't a problem since the metro station is close by - the way takes only five minutes on two main streets. Been here with my girlfriend after living for three months on the upper eastside and, sure, it is different - but i didn't feel afraid aboy my girlfriend and me at any time. Jurmain is a superb host - always nice, friendly, calm and super-responsive prebooking AND during your stay. You can ask him or his dad about anything you like and they will always make your stay even more comfortable than it already is. This includes tips for your stay, but also the possibility to use their personal pc and printer; his Dad even offeres me to borrow his car and, for a low wage, Jurmain would even bring you to the airport when your stay ends. All in all i can state: i had a lot of doubts about staying in the bronx with my gf. but they all turned out to be unreasonable and i am more than glad that i stayed with my decision to spend my vacation at The Wielingens - great place, great people!

Jurmain makes you feel right at home when you arrive. He was very kind and attentive to any needs you may request. Even though the area around his apartment is a little sketchy, I still rate my overall stay a five-star rating!!!

Clean place room as in picture but no tolietries drugs sold down stairs in the building and didn’t give me no keys had to wait outside with my daughter was ask to remove my shoes and felt so uncomfortable ended up leaving and getting a hotel my daughter felt safer

The host responded very quickly and attentively and helped us resolve any questions we had. The house itself can be defined as curious, with a very personal decoration.
