It is well equipped and the appliances work and are of quality. Towels and sheets are also OK and plentiful.  It is located in a neighborhood that, without being Fifth Avenue, is not dangerous. To get to Manhattan there are several subway lines, but it takes about an hour. There is a supermarket in the area that is enough to stock up.  The house is comfortable for groups of up to 8 people sharing a bed, 9 if there is a child who fits in a slightly smaller bed.  Without being a luxury house, it is a good option to stay in NY with a good quality-price ratio. Suitable for travelers who do not intend to stay like kings in the houses/hotels around Central Park and have their dogs walked for a third of the cost it would cost in Manhattan. Refrain posh.

The space is simple yet very comfy and clean. I only needed a place to sleep and shower for a week or so and this one was perfect for that. The bed was super comfortable and the in-room air conditioning was great to have during the summer. Ikkyu was a great host and helped me with eveything I needed, including toting my luggage up the stairway. The 15 minute walking commute to the 6 train was a bit far but nothing bad enough to stress over. Overall, I would definitely recommend this space for anyone looking for simple and comfortable accommodations.

Clean, affordable and spacious. Great place to stay for single people. Ikkyukim was extremely resourceful and helpful. The neighborhood is a bit sketchy. However, the connectivity to Manhattan is quite good. The Hunt’s Point subway is just a 10-min walk. The MTA bus stop is also close by.

Buyer beware.  This apartment appears to be clean and simple but that is not the case.  The air conditioner and the blinds were very dirty and dusty.  The apartment building smelled as you entered and people were hanging outside under the overhang as it was raining and it served as a refuge for some. The kitchen is basically all locked up with the exception of one high up cabinet that I could not reach with used plastic utensils.  The two umbrellas left at the door were broken and one of them the handle was taped with scotch tape, which fell off the minute you picked it up.  The heat was unbearable and not mention of New York radiators was mentioned in the listing.  The flat screen TV as seen in the photos did not have any cable or TV hook up.  You had to use a PC and it was written on a post-it note on the table in front of the TV and not in the listing.  The information sheets were dirty with dried on wine or food, which was quite disgusting.  The host was not at all accommodating or concerned with my concerns when I arrived and I was promptly told that he was just about to get on a 12 hour flight to Japan.  Needless to say, I never heard from him again.  The host claimed the price of the room was much less that local hotels, and this turned out to not be the case at all.  I was able to get a hotel room my first night and it was just around the corner and amazing for a lot less that what I was being charged.  If you don't mind funky dirty, this place is for you.  I will say the bathroom looked clean but I did not stay to find out how it functioned.  The accommodations were not at all comfortable and it was a health risk to me so I was unable to stay.  Host did not accommodate me to my fullest request and I can not give him a positive review.  In fact, I am afraid to use Airbnb in New York in the future.  I was told by a friend that they were given a bed in the laundry room, so I suppose this host has one thing going for it.  It is not the laundry room.  Dirty, stinky, no TV, no decent utensils to eat with and well I think you get the picture.  Do not recommend.  But the hotel I found was Amazing!!!!! at an amazing price.  Like I said, Buyer beware.  Not worth your hard earned money!!!!!1

George provided very comprehensive instructions to enable a stress-free arrival at his apartment. The room is spacious, more than ample for a solo-traveler or couple to stay. The room was in a different layout to what is pictured, but that wouldn't affect the stay here. The furnishings all appear well-used, but clean. The location is a stones through away from all the attractions a first time visitor will want to see. There is a fair bit of traffic that passes through the street; that said, I am usually a light sleeper and had no issues on the (weekday) nights that I was there. Thank you George for a smooth and convenient stay here.

George's place is a keeper! It is located right in Midtown and is very central to the subways and there are many activities nearby. Getting from JFK to George's place was super simple and affordable. For the price and location of this place, ITS A STEAL! George is also very quick to communicate any questions we had. The only reason this place was given four out of five stars was because of the pillow, fitted sheet for the bed and door. There are two pillows, but one of them is very hard and was lacking a pillow case. Another pillow and pillow case would have been preferred. The fitted sheet had no elastic left so it would come off every time you laid on the bed. Finally, the door handle to get into the apartment was duct taped and very loose, this was our main concern. Besides those issues, we had a great time and would highly recommend this place!!!

Me and my son stayed in Janet’s and David’s airbnb for 7 nights. We slept in the small bedroom that is partly situated under the surface, there is a small window though. The room/house may seem a bit chaotic, as can be noticed on the pictures. However, the room and private bathroom were both very clean. In the bathroom there is a toilet, a shower and a sink. In the room itself are 2 beds. One of them has a good matrass, the other one is a sofa bed. The problem with the sofa bed is that there is a considerable gap in between both ‘parts’ of the sofa bed, giving me (55 years) a backage when sleeping on the sofa bed. My son (22) slept on it crosswise (to avoid the gap) the second and further nights. He had no problems sleeping. The airco works well, but is quite loud (you’ll need earplugs when you use it at night). The subway is a 2 minute walk. The neighbourhood (Williamsburg) is quiet during the night and we never felt unsafe. David and Janet are very friendly, welcoming and generous. We liked this airbnb and would recommend it.

Good location- a short walk to Rockefeller Center, lots of nearby restaurants and shopping. Check-in instructions were clear and the apartment was clean. But we encountered the same issue with duct tape holding a doorknob together. And we were afraid to use the shower after reading a note that it doesn't drain properly. Look out for extra fees! This place is far too expensive for what you get.

I really appreciated the reactivity of George. Great communication even if he’s not in the same country!  The location of the appartement is great, several metros around.  We didn’t use the kitchen, so I can’t talk about it.  There was enough space for two.  I was afraid before our arrival that the place would be a bit cold, but in fact it was too hot haha  Also be prepared to hear some noise from the street (take your best « boule quies ») Thanks again :)

This is an amazing place. The house is very unique in a good way. There are multiple levels to the house meaning that you will have privacy on your level. The place was clean, there were high quality amenities and the checking in process was efficient and stress free. Janet and David were kind, hospitable hosts who were attentive to our needs and gave us great tips into local spots to check out. David and Janet were also gracious enough to give us a tour of the house, including the roof, which provided an amazing view. The place itself is located near multiple high quality restaurants, a nice coffee and breakfast place which I visited multiple times during my stay, and multiple subway stops servicing multiple lines all within short walking distance allowing you to get to travel throughout the city very efficiently. They also allowed us to keep our bags in their office on the day of our check out before we left later that night, which effectively allowed us to have an extra day in the city without having to worry about our luggage. The community garden and their dog Mormon, who is a very sweet amazing dog, were great additions that further enhanced the quality of our visiting experience. It was an amazing experience and I definitely intend on booking this place again. I highly recommend it.

George’s neighborhood lies in a cozy little block in Midtown. We were no less than a 20 minute walk from any necessities, had easy access to Times Square, Central Park, and of course subways. With no homeless and a busy night scene I felt safe in this neighborhood.  What you see in the pictures is what you will get, but you will find the place appears bigger in person. George was kind enough to provide hygiene materials and other small necessities, and communication was great!   Overall an amazing stay, would definitely book again!

Me and my friends stayed in one of Rachels apartment for two months, and it was a real pleasure. The apartment was really nice, newly renovated and had everything we were in the need for. Since we stayed there for two months we wanted to see more of Manhattan and the area around the apartment than just the touristy places, and Rachel gave us great tips on what to see, where to go and where to eat.   The area is really nice, both during day time and night time. Colombia University with it's beautiful buildings is a couple of blocks away, West Side Market (Grocery store at 110th) offer great fresh food, nice bread and already-cooked food. Riverside Park is a park one block from the apartment, next to Hudson River and is beautiful both for walking or running. The Mexican restaurant just at the corner of 108th and Broadway have great food and good drinks, it soon became our favorit place. Me and my friends often arrived home late at night, both with cab and with the subway, and we never had any problems or felt unsafe.   I would recommend Rachel and this apartment to anyone and if I ever go back to New York, I will surely rent an apartment with Rachel again.

Michelle's place is great! We were welcomed with a nice gift basket and so we didn't need to get the extra toiletries we needed from the drug store. The apartment is intimate and gives a great reflection of New York life. I would definitely stay here again

I cannot stress enough how great, relaxing and warm stay I experienced at this place. Esteban and his family were very friendly and tending to all our needs.   Room: The room was extra clean, along with the bedding.   Bathroom: The BR was cleaned up everyday!  Internet: High-speed connection was available.   Food: Breakfast was always on time, along with great conversations over fresh brewed coffee.   Location: Less than 10 minute walk to the 7 train. Easy ride to Manhattan.   In overall, I highly rate and recommend this place for anyone looking   to stay in Queens area. 10/10 will come back!

We came for a short weekend vacation to hangout in Brooklyn, and enjoyed having Janet and David's place as our "home base" for that time. Shipping container homes are fascinating and honestly the way of the future! The unit is in the basement area so it was much more cool than the sweltering heat out on the sidewalk. We had plenty of blankets and pillows, and towels/washcloths for showering; there is also a medicine cabinet full of random items in case you forgot something. There is also a TV, AC, and a white noise machine if you have trouble falling asleep.  The neighborhood is fun and lively and it was so easy to walk or take the subway to any destination- we walked over ten miles each day just looking at things! It's certainly a steal for the location and a great place for a weekend getaway. Thanks again!

I couldn't have asked for a better first time AirBnB experience! Keenan made me feel welcome in his home from the first message. It was super easy and stress free to pick up the keys to his awesome apartment, in the heart of super cool Clinton Hill. The apartment felt like home, from the decor to the cleanliness to the awesome roommate. Having never booked a share like this before, I expected a certain amount of uncomfortable-ness; and there was none of that at all.  Keenan went above and beyond, making sure I had fresh, locally roasted coffee, and pointed out a number of cool things to do in the neighborhood. I hope to return to the city soon, and I'll absolutely stay with them again!

Dolores and Michael were wonderful! They are truly concerned and care about their guests. The apartment was exactly as described. I forgot my hair dryer, no problem, there was one under the bathroom sink. In fact there was everything that we needed in the apartment from kitchen dishes, storage containers, cookware, utensils, teas, coffee, sugar, starter spices, paper products, iron and ironing board even reusable cloth grocery bags to take with you to the store. The bathroom was stocked with toiletries, from shower caps to body wash all you need to bring is your tooth paste and brush. If you cut your finger no worries there is a first aid kit under the sink. They thought of everything a guest would need. If you do not find it, just ask. The area is safe. We walked the neighborhood at night and felt comfortable. The distance between the bus stop is about 300 steps, 2 minutes per google maps. You can take the 57 bus and get off at Metro Tech Jay St Station a couple of steps from the bus stop and take various trains there . Or you can use Uber to Metro Tech Jay St Station and the rate is 11.00. The York street station is short distance away, you can even walk to this station if you enjoy walking, about 15 minutes, or take the 57 and walk, about less than a block down. If you are confused just ask Dolores and Michael and they will explain it to you. Be sure to ask them about all the attractions in Brooklyn as well as Manhattan. You can walk a couple of blocks and do your shopping.   If you are a walker, we are not however we did, you can walk to the mall and to the famous restaurant Junior's featured on The Cooking Chanel famous for their Cheese cake. There is a beautiful park where you can sit, eat a lunch and enjoy the scenery. When you arrive Dolores and Michael will be waiting and probably making sure the place is remarkably clean and comfortable for their guests. When I say clean I do mean clean. I am germophobic and afraid to take showers in hotel rooms unless I clean it myself. No worries, the bathroom is so clean there was no need to.   Dolores and Michael are the type of people that when you meet them it is as if you have known them for years. Dolores did not hear from us for a couple of days and was so concern that she text to see if things were OK. However, they respect your privacy. They are so accommodating and always a phone call or text away, no matter the time. When it is time to depart Michael will arrange for a taxi. if you like. With a hug and good bye we were sad to leave our little apartment, for nine days it was our home, in every sense of the word.

Dolores is a wonderful host, incredibly attentive and helpful. The house is an easy walk to Fort Greene and Dumbo, and way more spacious than we expected. The kitchen is fully equipped, and Dolores had sweet touches like providing water bottles for us in the fridge and tea and coffee for the morning. When traveling with more than two people. this place is a total steal for the city, I'd definitely come back!

My two friends and I lived in this house for the Christmas holiday this year~  Me (Jinwen) : Firstly, Dolores and her family they are very responsible for everything. That’s very good. And house is very clean. And there is a super good grocery market besides the house.  But Dolores want me to contact her via WhatsApp rather than Airbnb and it’s hard to fall asleep because I can always hear the water ticking when I sleep at night. In addition, the last day we forgot about the check out time. Dolores texted me about that we should check out immediately because the cleaning lady is here.We felt very sorry about that. One of my friend she had a stomachache so she was at the house. She said she didn’t see the cleaning lady. And we plan to texted Dolores and wanted to tell her my friend Ying will take our luggage out immediately and will check out now. She texted me the cleaning lady is leaving. We have to pay 50 dollars for her. Finally we paid 75 dollars for the late check out. I think it will be better if we have a better communication on this issue. And we are always following the very long rules on the dining-table. It let me feel so tired.  Ying:Firstly, NOT RECOMMENDED ! The room is a half basement house, which means there’s no sunlight in the daytime, so you can smell musty when you get into the house. Also it’s not so warm at night that we need to cover ourselves with our jackets.  And we can hardly fall asleep at night cause there were too much noise ( such as the noise of footsteps, water drops,which kinda horrifying in the midnight and the screaming and singing ) from upstairs where the the owner family lives.That’s to say, the soundproof is really bad. Besides, the house is really far from subway station(15 min walk), the schedule of bus is really unstable, so sometimes you need to walk home from subway station in the midnight, which is really not safe in Brooklyn.  I will never choose this house again. It’s NO good.  Julie: As Dolores' s house is a half basement house, it was too cold to fall asleep at night. I had to cover my down jacket over the thin quilt. She is a responsible host in the Airbnb, her family live upstairs and helped us to solve this problem three days later. Besides, maybe it's the holiday time, we can hear the sound of steps and water drops every night. And in the new year eve, the noise of scream and loudly shout was so annoying that I was hard to sleep even it was already 12:30AM. Besides I don't know why, staying in the house is hard to keep warm. The heater seems not work well. And the neighbor is not safe enough. One day night around 9PM when we came back during the days we lived here, we saw a strange homeless man wearing different shoes with bizzar walking posture walking towards us at the corner of the house outside. That was terrifying! I don't know if it's normal in Brooklyn or in NY, as this is my first time in NY. But we were SOO scared!!! In a word, this is a clean, hot-water provided, carbage bag not enough provided, a little cold house. I am sure that I will be back in NYC, but I will not live back here next time .

Woke up to a sound of a honking horn while driving through the dark raining streets of New York, looking for my airBnB. All the coffee in the world couldn’t keep me awake but alas! Found the majestic Apt. Soon as I got out I smelled the aroma of relief. A castle of rest lay before me, a promised land that would carry my unrested soul through the rest of my journey. I was greeted at the front door by a All Knowing soul, Maria. She gave me delightful tour with an accent that took me away to a different time period... I knew my time traveling journey had begun. Soon as the tour was over I heard big massive footsteps followed by a large shadow of a man, his shadow darkened the house. It was Sir Esteban. At first I shook with fear but then he spoke... I recognized the voice, it was an Angels voice and it had disarmed my fears. He gave me keys and told me the 10 commandments that should be obeyed in this kingdom of heaven. I gladly obeyed.  I went to sleep and the bed soaked up my restless soul and re energized it for the morning. Breakfast was ready. I was served a fine hearty breakfast by chef Esteban , While Maria told old war stories and how she bonded with the cat that tried to kill her.  I can go on and on about my journey but some adventures should be kept private. There was many twists and turns, many revelations , Squirrel Attacks, and many unanswered questions like “who really was Maria?”  ... I don’t know how it all ends but I am glad for the experience. -Kamran

Neil was very accommodating. All his instructions were very clear and easy to follow.  The apartment was very nice with AC units in almost all of the rooms. It was very clean and Neil went the extra step and provided basic cleaning and cooking stuff such as soap, tooth paste and tea.  Parking was really easy to find. The subway was less than a 10-minute walk and is direct to Manhattan.   It is probably not the greatest part of Brooklyn but nothing happened to us. We preferred taking a cab back to the apartment at night though. The subway stop area appeared to be a little sketchy.   Overall, very good stay!

Neil's place is really nice and cozy. Great for a couple to take some time off from the hectic day to day routine. Very quiet area and the grocery stores are close by. Subway is a bit far but not an issue if you dont mind walking. Lots of good inexpensive shopping in stores near the subway stop. Didn't find any nice restaurants near by but getting to Caroll garden in brooklyn very easy on the subway where you will find tons of trendy places to eat. Neil was a very good and responsive host and understood when I had to cut my trip short for personal reasons. Refunded me the remaining unused days payment promptly. Was a very helpful host and a stress free experience over all.

This home was our home away from home. We had the best time riding the close by subway and exploring the neighborhood. We cannot stress how enjoyable our stay was. Thanks for the tips. Hope to see you again soon.

felt like home, roommates kept to themselves so provided a lot of privacy, TV with the an hdmi cord kept me entertained when I wasn't out and about, host was friendly and communicated promptly. it is in a sketchy area but overall my experience here was very relaxing and close by to everything you need.

Nicole & Thomas were communicative hosts that made our stay in New York quite easy. There were, however, a couple of issues with our stay that I have to be honest about; Upon arrival late at night we had found the apartment to be in the state that the previous guests had left it in which was quite an unpleasant surprise. After I had informed Nicole & Thomas they did promptly make an effort to go down and clean the apartment on their own while we were out for some food and left us a 6-pack for our trouble. On another occasion myself and my friends were woken up one morning at about 9:30am because our host needed to et into the apartment to retrieve something from storage. Again, another small inconvenience. The location of the place is situated between three different subway lines, all of which are within walking distance, however, we did find that the subway took a little bit longer to get into Manhattan than expected. The positives were that the place did have a killer sound system and managed to keep cool during the heat.

Wonderful, cozy basement in Bushwick.  Was able to store our bags before checkin which was much appreciated. Host was friendly and quick to respond. The place: Short walk to the M train, not the most interesting desirable area immediately surrounding but never felt unsafe. Easy to get to other parts of the city. Thoughtful touches like art supplies on the desk, speakers, etc. and a friendly and helpful host make this place great’

The Airbnb is just as it is seen in the photos, except that the entrance through the stairs is very narrow, and makes going up and down uncomfortable, especially when you are carrying large suitcases, it is in the basement of the house, the neighborhood really did not look safe, but I never had any type of inconvenience, it is a neighborhood of African Americans and Latinos (Cubans) for the most part, it is 4 blocks from the subway, at night it is very lonely, which can generate a bit of anguish and insecurity when arriving at the house, but as I said, I never had a problem, recommendation, always go out and get to the Knickerbocker station on the M line, which is the closest, if it sends you to the L line, don't go, it looks quite dangerous, fights, etc., they charge a cleaning fee and this was not seen when we arrived at the apartment, the air conditioning does not go below 80, which on hot days the heat is a bit desperate. Thom, always very ready for what we needed him to do, even though we never crossed paths

My family and I stayed in Tom's basement apartment for a weekend for my sister's birthday. We enjoyed the location, as it was easy to find food/coffee within the neighborhood and close to Subway stations.   The only unpleasant thing about Tom's place is that it can get really cold in the apartment. There's a heater between both beds, but it only warms that section of the apartment. So, bring cozy items that you can wear when you're inside.   However, Tom was super cool and easy to communicate with. I would recommend this place for a quick weekend in New York.

- Neighborhood a bit creepy at night - Do not expect a lot of comfort but good for 2-3 nights - There is only a curtain between the bathroom and the kitchen but it works well  - Different metro possibilities from 6 to 12  minutes by walk - Enough things to cook  - The place is clean  Thomas is a very good host. He gives a lot of explanations and answers very fast to every question

Will's place is great. It's close to the subway and you'll be in times square in 15-20min. The photos match the place. The neighborhood is not the nicest looking or cleanest but we never felt unsafe and the were groceries and restaurants close by. The bathroom is clean, spaciosus and the shower works great. The kitchen is complete. The rooms are very confortable and the beds are big. One of the rooms is smaller than the other so it's something to note when travelling in group. Also, the apartment above is also an airbnb apartment and in one of the days we had to ask our friends upstairs to make less noise but they were very friendly in that point. We did not hear noise from the streets. Will was helpful through text messages too.

The farmhouse is nicely equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay, including many extras.  It is only a short walk to the subway, grocery, drug store, and a few restaurants. Angele is a very attentive host. This was our 2nd stay at the farmhouse.  We would definitely stay again!

This was a very nice place to stay. The neighborhood was very nice. The place is right across from the beach, on Rockaway Beach  . The only downfall is that is there is only room to park one car. This didn't bother us, as it was only my husband and myself, but it may not be good for others, as it is a 2 bedroom place. It has great proximity to the beach and shopping, like a grocery store .It is well stocked with essentials, and well provisioned for a family, with a crib, electrical outlet covers, etc. If you go there in the summer, you need to bring beach items, like chairs, boogie boards, etc .The walls are a little thin, and you can hear the neighbor's music through at the walls at night, but when we heard it, they stopped it fairly early. I was afraid it was going to last late into the evening. I would recommend staying here, and would stay here again since it was close to my son's in-law's apartment.

Caroline was responsive and the room was big and clean. Malosa (the housekeeper) was very friendly. The bathroom was shared by 2 other monthly residents. The neighborhood was not he best but I didn't feel unsafe, and the subway was only 3 blocks away. Overall, a great experience

Very nice apartment, very clean, comfortable bed.  A very kind welcome, despite our delay due to our flight... Something to eat on the evening of our arrival, very kind attention and very practical. 20 minutes from the metro on foot, through residential areas, you feel safe. There must be a bus that shortens the travel time. We loved walking! We felt like we were at home! We recommend 100%!

Caroline and her representative were very communicative and responsive when I had a few issues (TV malfunctioning, no coffee maker initially), but the room I was in was right on the street & sidewalk, and the windows wouldn't close, so was extremely noisy all night long, with people yelling, playing loud music, motorcycles roaring by, etc. Even my earplugs didn't suffice! But the place is very clean (although perhaps bring socks/slippers), although the neighborhood is rather sketchy and dirty. The subway is only a few blocks away, with lots of people out and about, so I felt pretty safe, even at night. There's no bedside lamp or sofa, even though they're pictured in the photos. But there is a room refrigerator, which is good, since there's very little room in the kitchen for your food.

The place is pleasant and complete: kitchen with all the equipment (except the microwave), private access, small terrace, air conditioning. Anna was available in case of questions, and made us feel very welcome.  The disadvantages: at least an hour's journey can sometimes be burdensome, but the price being attractive, it is difficult to expect a shorter journey.  The bed, although comfortable, is small in width.  I recommend, in all cases, this place, which is in a quiet area, you don't feel insecure at all.

I very much enjoyed my stay. The studio is very clean and tidy, and has a fully equipped kitchen, and its own private entrance. Anna and Greg were great hosts, and the bagels and cream cheese on arrival was a nice touch.   It's a nice, quiet neighbourhood, and there are frequent buses (Q38) to both nearby subway stations. If you enjoy walking, it's only 20-25 minutes to either station. There are a couple of food stores within walking distance, and a great bakery, Chinese takeaway, etc., all in easy reach.  There are maps and other information to hand, and an Xbox and Wii in addition to the TV if they're your thing.  I recommend getting the weekly Metrocard ($34) if you want to hop on and off the subway and buses.  Thanks again; I had a great stay! Rob

We are live in fine house from Galins she is everytine friendly and we can call everytime for quastion. House is in brooklyn maybe 45 min to city but near from brighton beach and i think secure corner. Room is clean and u can find all stuff what u need. I think for young girls like us was not the best because in other room live a men who has visit sonetime from friend and drink together. And we scared little bit.stay with them in a home in other country. But they do nothing! Only was nothing for us. But galina is very friendly and helpful  and has good house for good price. Thank you for new york gift :)

Very responsive and accommodating host. The room is very spacious and contains TV, fridge, and couch. The price for the room is a steal. However, the cleaning fee is NOT. I expected a very tidy cleaned place for 60$ and the bathroom was not. No bags in the trash bin.  Pet hair all over couch that is inside the room. Dust everywhere in the room. I even had a spider crawling on the shower curtains that I had to run out of the shower with soap on my body to avoid it from crawling on my head. I was terrified. Blonde hair all over the tub. The shower head leaks and water pressure is non existent. Bathroom almost always occupied. I stayed in the room the entire time, did not use any of the common areas except for the bathroom which was unfortunate. Finding parking was a hassle even during the day.The location is great for tourist. Overall, it's a very quiet home with a very spacious room and a very responsive host. Honestly for $160-165 in total, it would have been ideal for me to book a hotel which would have been $10-20 more with a private bathroom and definitely no spider.

Great location and place.  It seems highly demanded so I recommend checking your dates in advance. I had to move and messages arrived of a possible delay or had to checkout earlier. Which was a bit stressful. But Dipak managed to make things work and overall it was a very good experience.

Momo's apartment is located in an amazing area in East Williamsburg, 100 meters away from the subway that takes you to Manhattan in 20 minutes. There are fantastic restaurants and pubs/breweries within a 5-10 minute walk, although there are some construction works going on outside her building right now. The area surrounding the apartment & the building are fairly noisy, but that is a part of what you get living in this lively neighborhood. The apartment is as pictured, although the bed felt quite scary, since it is not attached to the wall and it moves a lot. The bathroom & shower, however, were very good. I was supposed to stay here for 2.5 months, but the day after checking in there was a misunderstanding with the host regarding the terms of my booking.  I contacted AirBnB for some help, and after AirBnb contacted the host they told me they were cancelling my booking and allowed me to book another apartment.

A number of reviewers have deemed the neighborhood 'unsafe'. I think this is more subtle racism than anything else – it's no more 'unsafe' than most of Brooklyn. 'Unsafe' is just code for 'I didn't see any white people'.   The reviewers are, however, right about the area being barren of restaurants. It's also a bit of a hike from Manhattan. But what a great deal and what a great space! It's a lovely and clean apartment – the bathroom even has a skylight! I think there are two other apartments in the house, but it was quiet and calm. Wasn't woken by any neighbors either. The bed isn't great (you can feel the springs) but the shower is.

Katja was a very nice and friendly host, and her husband and three children were also very nice. The apartment was neatly prepared for us and there was enough space for all our things.  The pictures correspond exactly to the apartment.  At first we felt a bit strange in the neighborhood, but after 2-3 days that subsided and we were able to move around freely. However, I would advise against visiting a snack bar after 10 p.m., as there are mostly men and women begging for some money or dealing drugs.  The price of the accommodation is really unbeatable and in return you are happy to take a further journey towards Manhattan. The L-Train runs every 5 minutes and takes about 30-40 minutes. There is also a bus from JFK airport almost to the apartment. There is also a small “BRAVO” supermarket on the main street. I would recommend everyone to go shopping there as the food is comparatively cheap.  All in all it was a good decision, but unfortunately we weren't completely satisfied.

My stay at Fatou's place happened to be my first Airbnb experience. Fatou warmly greeted me upon arrival, was quick with communication and always met me with a smile. Being an international student in the process of looking for permanent accommodation could be really stressful. However, Fatou and her family's hospitality, and the comfort of her place let me relax after tiring days of roaming around the city. The location is very convenient; a decent walk from the subway stations and I faced no issue with my frequent commute. The gorgeous, tree-lined street is quiet and has a homey feel, with supermarkets, deli and various restaurants close by. I highly recommend Fatou's place to anyone visiting NYC.

Very nice accommodation and easy to access with 2/3 metro lines 5/7 minutes away on foot. Supermarket about ten minutes walk away. Kadja has written a very useful note to help you find your way around the neighborhood from the start of your stay. The area can be a little scary at first but in the end everything went well during our stay, even when we returned late at night. Not necessarily if it is 2 single women... to see! Small downside: no shutters in the accommodation only curtains and in summer waking up at 6 a.m. can be practical or disturbing!! The accommodation is very well equipped, we lacked nothing during our 15-day stay. Comfortable bedding, the Queen Size Bed is great!!

The place is really cute and quiet . It's the upstairs unit so we always tried not making noise for the downstairs unit to not make the host uncomfortable and I think it worked . The Subway Utica Station is literally a block away and we felt safe towards the end of our 7 day stay but of course the first 3 days we felt a little afraid of the unknown when it came to walking from the station to the apartment at night but know that there's several tourists that stay in the same area and lots of locals walking to and back from the station . The local Dry Cleaners is a little longer walk but super friendly . Kristian was always  attentive to our needs and very welcoming . The outside environment on that block could be a little noisy at night and early morning ( lots of street chatter) but nothing you can't sleep right through . The street is clean and lots of friendly squirrels . Also note there are no closets and that's original to the building . But there is an ironing board and iron :)

It was absolutely perfect. I traveled with my 3 kids (aged 10,12,17) and Katja and her husband were very helpful and always available if needed. The neighborhood is improving and we never felt unsafe. The L train is just 5 min away and within 30 minutes you are at union square. The apartment easily fits 4 and is typical newyorkain. We will definitely come again.

Very nice and clean place. It has a full kitchen with all the amenities you need.  However, it was a bit too far of a commute, if you're trying to explore the city and/ or trying to stay out late. It was about a little over an hour each way(time I just didn't have to waste) it would have been the perfect place, if the location was closer. The neighborhood is residential, but very dark and kinda sketchy.

Katja's apartment is in a great location. It's about a minute's walk to both metro connections. The neighborhood is safe and the neighbors are very friendly. Katja had replied to our messages a little late, so we were afraid that we would have to look for new accommodation. But Katja answered us, answered every question and check-in and check-out were very flexible. The apartment is clean, spacious and equipped with everything you need. However, the bed could have been a little better. But that's a matter of taste. Ultimately, we would book with Katja again at any time. Thank you for the wonderful stay!

We had a good stay at this apartment and it was a great value for the price. The subway ride took longer than expected, about 30 to 40 minutes and took even longer after midnight. The subway may run slower at that time. The ride to most locations is simple mostly direct or with a transfert on the 14th street station. The neighbourhood made us fell unsafe at night, but buring our one week stay we saw no incidents. The neighbors were friendly.

To escape a horror fortunately the next day I booked a hotel so as not to spoil our vacation The hosts are not correct Frankly I am still shocked by this experience of not responding to the messages when two minutes before they had promised to answer them. Turning up the volume on the television when my sister and I had been knocking on the door for 20 minutes to give them back the keys, shouting their names and calling their phone with no answer. Frankly, avoiding responsibilities, I don’t call them hosts but cowards. We had a horrible night with the music blaring non-stop. He dared to tell the Airbnb advisor that it was a marriage; he dared to lie when it wasn’t a marriage. The door doesn't close all the way down, it's not isolated, the neighborhood is scary. We were two girls, we were really scared, even though we live in the suburbs of France.  It took us more than an hour to get to Times Square, which is huge, it's far from everything. He dared to reimburse us 90 euros out of 400 euros even though we only stayed one night over a week.  And lie to the advisor saying that we didn't give you time to explain when we sent you a message on airb'b for the translation. We came down the next morning at 8 a.m. to explain to you why we wanted to leave, you told us ok and limit if you didn't close the door until we told you wait, we have to talk. You told us “send by Airbnb for the translation” we trusted you and I am still waiting for this famous response after two weeks. We came back down 40 minutes later, we knocked for 20 minutes, shouted your name, called on the phone, I sent you a message on Airbnb to tell you I'm in front of the door, I even rang the intercom. The only reaction was that you had turned up the sound on the television so as not to open the door. I find that attitude completely scandalous. And yet I am a fan of Airbnb I have never had a problem and even less of this kind Fortunately I have the means to pay for a hotel you are dishonest Never again

Katja was very nice and it was very easy to communicate with her. She also let us check in earlier kindly and gave us directions on how to get to her place from the airport! However, we felt very unsafe getting off the train and walking home at night, so I would definitely not recommend this place for someone travelling alone or ladies travelling together. Otherwise, good value and very nice hosts!

The apartment is located in Brooklyn and has a really great connection to Manhattan. We were at the Utica Ave subway station within a few minutes and were in Manhattan in 20-30 minutes (depending on the location). We got in without any problems when we arrived. The apartment itself was really nicely decorated and, above all, clean. The three of us had plenty of space and felt very comfortable. There are two large beds in separate rooms and in the living room there is a couch that also functions as a sofa bed. The kitchen was well equipped, there was even pasta and tomato sauce that could have been used - we also cooked on a few evenings and everything went well. Jeremie is a really great host, he responded to all of our requests in a very short time and we could approach him at any time. He gave us really good local tips, which is really valuable - in addition to the typical sightseeing, you're really happy when you get recommended a great café or something that isn't overrun with tourists. We never felt unsafe in the area and were always happy to return home after a long day in the city. The price-performance ratio is very good for New York, we would come back at any time.

Great hosts. Jonathan is a lightning bolt at answering and Cynthia was lovely to welcome us. I must return to NY and I will surely return. The place as the photos indicate. Perfect for two couples. The neighborhood is very nice and familiar. Zero fear. Thanks to both of you!

Beautiful apartment, close to express train to Manhattan. Smooth communication and check-in. Good cafes and restaurants nearby. I personally found that the neighborhood can feel a little unsafe at night.

Kristian and his wife were one of the best hosts we had in Airbnb. My son was moving to his new apartment and didn’t have it at the time we had to leave Kristian place. Kristian let my son stay some extra hours to make the moving less stressful.  We are very grateful. Great hosts!

Wilson's place being my very first Airbnb experience has raised the bar so high that I don't think I can stay anywhere else. The large space was well equipped with the basic household amenities making it family friendly. And of course, the magnificent bathroom thats second to none. Check-in and check-out was easy and stress free. A true definition of 'Home away from Home'.

The place was nice, lovely shower! But just to get into downtown Manhattan was an hour to an hour and a half subway ride. Or to get to the dumbo area of Brooklyn it was almost an hour. You really need to know the subway to get around and it makes being out later difficult. Wilson communicated well up until our visit and then didn’t answer my messages. Also, someone came into our locked room one day, which was a little sketchy. The place itself was nice. And like I said the shower is amazing!

Very nice place that’s just a few blocks from the subway and many restaurants close-by. Parking was also a breeze with many options so if you’re driving don’t be afraid. Easy check-in and out! Thanks again Wilson!

The place is 10 mins from Jackson Heights. The few problems I had was the loud airplane sound in the morning. Didn’t let me sleep around 6 am and it was everyday while I stayed there. Second was the DoOr. You can lock the door to your room but if someone pushes it you can open the room. So there is no point of locking the room. Anyone can just open the door and take your belongs so that made me feel unsafe. The last issue we faced was the think wall and the floors. If you walk around the first floor and your host in the other room can hear you and so if you planning to go out and come back late around 11 pm. You might hear complains the host. So you need to walk around the house like you walking on a cloud. The first night we stayed we came in at 11 pm and we went to bed at 11:30 pm. The host send me a message saying we were loud and they don’t feel comfortable sharing his space with us. He said “ it felt like there was an earthquake and my lamp was moving”. Me and my bf felt like they were body shaming us cause we just came from the airport and they didn’t specify a  curfew time and we talked to the Airbnb support team and we had no choice but to stay cause we were not getting the refund and there was no other place to stay cause it was last minute.  I think our biggest issue was the plane noise in the morning which woke us up and the door that didn’t lock.  I don’t think I would stay here again even though it is close to Jackson heights and the train station. They need to get a lock that doesn’t open when you push the door.

Andres and Salina were so kind and helpful, giving us instructions to get around the city and welcoming us into their home. The room is just what we needed for an inexpensive place to crash for a few nights. The location is pretty good, can be a tiny bit sketchy walking around the area by the closest subway stop (12 min walk away) for two girls but we made do. There are lots of good restaurants right by the airbnb and even a diner that’s open 24/7 which was helpful. Overall good value for the price!

Adam & Trista were great hosts!  I met them upon arrival and they were helpful with entry, key exchange, directions and parking.  The house was clean and there was extra linen for the couch.  They allowed us to use the kitchen which was equipped with utensils and healthy foods.  The bed was extremely comfortable!  The shower had great water pressure.  Although the apartment is smoke-free, the tenant below does smoke.  Thank goodness the person wasn't a chain smoker.  We could only smell it in the bedroom.  I used an incense to counteract the smell.  The neighborhood was very safe.  We were at the US Open and had to walk after midnight but it felt comfortable.  Everything is available.  There are drug stores, grocery stores, a cute cafe and minor shopping, if needed.    The train was very, very close.  Leaving Adam's house, the R/M was one block to the right followed by one block to the left.  Simple.  For drivers, there is no designated parking space.  There is ample street parking but pay attention to the street cleaning signs or you could get towed.  Overall, we had a great stay!  Since we were out of the house all day, the smoke was a minor issue.  If it was a big deal, the whole apartment would smell like smoke and that is NOT the case.  Adam has a wall of alphabetically organized movies, internet and cable.  Thank you Adam & Trista for sharing your space!  I would definitely stay again and recommend your place to other airbnb travelers.

I liked that the location is quite close to the subway, personally I always opted for the Cathedral station, it is much closer and safer, the building has a strange smell when entering but nothing unpleasant, Mei was very clear in the instructions and it is a good, clean and comfortable place to get to rest after walking around the city

Rosario is really considerate and friendly!! I mistakenly took the wrong cab to get to Rosario's house, which was a really horrible experience, because the driver not only charged me three time the regular fee, but also cheated me another $200 bucks. After that, I felt really frustrated and unsafe. It's Rosario's accompany that makes me feel better.  The place is really near W157th station, which takes you about 3 mins to get there. Though the W157 th is a little far from midtown and downtown, the rent of this apartment is really cheap! So I think is quite acceptable! The room is very spacious, too, compared to most apartment in downtown and midtown lol. And the neighborhood is quite safe and quiet. Therefore, her place is an absolute bargain!

Simply perfect. Ideal for 7 people as in our case. It lacks nothing, a perfectly equipped apartment, clean and with a simple but functional decoration. The neighborhood seems dangerous and abandoned, but it is not like that at all, even both neighbors and merchants were very kind to all of us. Despite the distance to Manhattan, the train is just 5 minutes from the apartment and it didn't take us more than 40-45 minutes to be in the heart of the city. recommend it? Without a doubt. Finally, add that we had a small problem with the hot water and Donavan quickly solved it within a few hours, turning it into a simple anecdote.

Great place, super comfortable and well put together. Very private. The two bedrooms aside from the master bedroom are very small, basically fitting a small bed. Master bedroom is gorgeous. Kitchen is really well appointed you can cook up a storm. And it's an older home so the ceilings are high and the walls are thick. Greg is a cool and very helpful host. The only caveat is the neighborhood. You could say it's in "transition" from being a dangerous neighborhood but it's still a bit dicey tbh. But I knew that going in, so.

Donovan's place is just like in the pictures....very spacious, plenty of amenities,  and overall clean! Donovan met us at check in and check out was a breeze. We loved having 3 restrooms!  Every room has a mirror which is also convenient. The house is very close to the L line which is the quickest way of transportation around NYC. The neighborhood is a little sketchy and I wouldn't wander around in the night by myself or without a large group. We were a group of 6 so we didn't have any issues. There are 3 little grocery delis within a 2 min walk, so that's also very convenient. Overall we were happy with our stay :)

I chose C-S’s Airbnb because it is close to my school and it has 5 star reviews. I considered to moved out right after a couple of days. I found I need a lot effort to adjust myself to live there. 1, I need to learn how to use match to light the stove; 2, I need to be super gentle and quiet to walking, to open/close doors, to wash dishes...all the time, because C-S is very sensitive to sound and works in the midnights and sleep at anytime; 3, also I feel uncomfortable to see her standing in the kitchen without any clothes...I guess it is normal in some cultures, but grew up in a conservative culture; 4, She also does not allow me to open the window in my room and etc. When we have differences and conflicts, she looks scary...and very angry...5, maybe because I was nervous, even though I used earplugs in the evening, I still could hear the noise outside and couldn’t have a good sleep...

C-S is really adorable! Indeed the rules can be a little scary at first but they are ultimately easy to live with! We talked and laughed a lot! She was very attentive to my needs and everything went smoothly! For a single girl in this big city it’s rather reassuring! I highly recommend it because so inexpensive for such a good location is quite rare!

Rachel was wonderful! She met me at the location and gave a great introduction/tour of the place. The studio was really spacious and well lit. Accommodations were plentiful, better than a hotel. The private garden area was huge and the plants were well maintained. The location is perfect. It is very close to Riverside Park (with an active dog run), Morningside Park, and Central Park. Rachel provided many lovely food recommendations, too! It is extremely close to subway stations and bus stops ..also many taxis drive along Broadway if preferred. Absolute Bagels, the number one bagel spot according to Time Out, is across the street. Drug store, bank, grocery store, wine shop, etc. all less than a block away. Beautiful buildings and trees all around. Incredible value. Highly recommend!!

Clean, updated, tastefully decorated, lots of room for our family of 6, washer/dryer, close to the subway and a few convenient stores. Easy and convenient to get to wherever we wanted to go in NYC. Surrounding area a little run down but we never felt unsafe coz we were a big group.

The apartment is very spacious and had great accommodations for our large group. We traveled with 7 adults (us plus our adult children and their significant others) and 1 toddler (our grandson). The home had a great amount of room for him to play, and he loved the rooftop. We took the subway into Manhattan daily and the station is very close, about 2 blocks from the apartment. The neighborhood did not feel unsafe or unwelcoming, we walked at all times of day and had no issues. The neighbors are very quiet, our grandson was lonely the nosiest guy in the building! The bathrooms were nice and in perfect working order, the showers were hot with good water pressure. The laundry facility came in very handy. There were tools and products available to clean up after yourself with ease. A great value for a stay in NYC, especially if you have a large group or family! Highly recommend!
Perfect location with a perfect vibe. Working with John was fun and easy, too, which made organizing my stay stress-free. Thanks again, Johnny!

This was a great place to stay in the UWS, with two exceptions: first, the key to the apartment was not left for me in the place arranged beforehand, which caused unnecessary stress upon arrival, and secondly, the air conditioning is an old unit and does not adequately cool the apartment during hot weather. Other than this (and the occasional party by upstairs neighbors into the late hours) the apartment itself was great, and had everything necessary for an extended stay.

This apartment is a gem! My first time using Airbnb, I stayed for 7 days while attending a workshop at Columbia. It was a short walk to campus (5-15 minutes, depending on where you’re going), and I highly recommend it for anyone else who needs to be there; not having to commute each day was a relief, and this was a better deal and a nicer setup than either the Columbia guest house or a hotel. You have the ground floor studio apartment to yourself. It’s spacious with simple but stylish decor, modern appliances, and a private patio. I was impressed by how clean and well-kept the place is (and I’m very picky about cleanliness!). The bed is a pullout couch that I found very comfortable. Thankfully there’s an A/C unit that you have full control of; it’s quite loud, but I’ve never known an A/C unit that wasn’t, and I actually liked that because it blocked out noise from the building and neighborhood. Half a block to the west is Riverside Park, which is nice for runs or walks, and Central Park is a few blocks to the east. Pretty much anything you might need is right nearby: pharmacies, groceries, restaurants, cafes, etc. The subway stop for the #1 line is just two blocks up the street, so it’s very easy to get downtown. I came home late most nights and never felt unsafe. With two days’ notice, one of my friends asked to join me for the weekend, and Rachel was very accommodating; her housekeeper set up a twin air mattress with bedding and an extra towel. Know that there is only one set of keys for guests, so you will have to coordinate schedules if there is more than one of you staying in the apartment (and as the listing says, there is an additional nightly fee for extra guests). Also know that the checkout time is strict, so be ready to leave by 11am (the housekeeper actually came in without knocking 5 minutes before, but was friendly and apologetic and left us to finish gathering our things and go). I never met Rachel and communication was kept to a minimum, which could be either frustrating or perfect depending on what you like. The only cons are that the housekeeper let me in when I first arrived and then left immediately without showing me around so I felt kind of thrown in, the building has very thin walls so you can hear every sound in the hallway and from neighbors on one side and upstairs, there wasn’t enough toilet paper to last the week so I had to buy more, and the WiFi router flashes a bright blue light all night. Overall a very positive experience.

Toni did an excellent job greeting us even with many changes to our arrival time due to weather. During our stay, he sent us multiple messages to make sure that everything was okay. The room was cozy and relatively clean. The bed was comfortable, and Netflix on the TV was a plus. The bathroom was good and clean. The only thing that we noticed was the unpleasant mildew smell from the hallway outside the room. Toni provided Lysol air freshener to reduce the smell, but the smell was still noticeable. I would say, if you are sensitive to smell, this might not be a comfortable place for you.

This was our very first time in New York, it felt a bit weird showing up and seeing the place, but we got  comfortable real quick. The directions to the recieve the keys were simple. The bed was super comfortable, perfect for my boyfriend and me. We spent a lot of good sleep and naps during the day. There was a little pantry that had stuff for coffee, the basic salt and pepper, dishes and utensils, which was awesome because we actually put it to use. We walked most of the time in our area to get some yummy food. Pronto Pizzeria is recommended! We didn't know how to work the TV, so we just used our phones for entertainment. It turned on, just didnt have cable connected or something. It wasn't an issue worth worrying about because with modern technology, you can do anything on your phone nowadays. Haha. For the most part the room was clean, the bathroom was a bit smelly, but come on, it's a bathroom. 😆 The shower got really hot, so I'm glad I got to enjoy my showers there. My boyfriend is 6'2 and it's nice to have a shower head that's actually high enough for him. Hahaha. The pressure of the water was perfect. We had brought our own toiletries, shampoo etc. But he did have some provided for you if you needed it. We were too scared to use the subway because again, first time in New York, so our Uber/Lyft drives were pricey to get into Manhanttan. Once we got into the city, we walked all over the place. It was actually nice to be away from all the city noise, very quiet and calm to walk in this neighborhood. They have a Sunday farmer's market down on steinway st which was pretty cool and not far of a walk at all. Tony was a wonderful host,  anything we needed help with, he was there to help. Fast responses, very nice and genuine. Overall, I would probably come back to stay here again.   Thank you for your hospitality, Tony. It was a great stay.

Lovelynn's place was exactly as described and more than met our needs for being close to our daughter's apartment and graduation at Columbia University. It was very clean and was supplied with lots of towels and kitchen needs, plus the refrigerator was stocked with a few things to get us started for the mornings, without having to shop on the day that we checked in. The beds were very comfortable and the neighbors were quiet. Lovelynn was always very quick to respond to questions when we had any. It's a second floor unit, so it was easy to get to it after a long day of touristing! The subway station is a very short walk away and the Riverside Park is even closer--a nice place to walk or sit in the shade to relax. My husband and I stayed there for a week and my 82 year old mother was with us for three days and nights. We did not feel crowded at all. It is very spacious. We would stay there again and we recommend it.

We were visiting family and planning to enjoy theater and dining out. My priority was to find an apartment in the Hamilton Heights area that could accommodate a group of 3 to 4 persons in two separate bedrooms. This listing met all my expectations, and more. It is easy to find, one block from Broadway - where you can find drug stores, delis, restaurants, groceries. It is one block from subway and bus stop, two blocks from Riverside Park which is great for strolling and biking. By Manhattan standards, it is spacious, comfortable, clean and what is more, the host went out of her way to give us travel advice in advance, to welcome us in person, to stock the larders with get-up-and-go goodies.

Host As this was our first Air BnB experience we were nervous and did our research. Our price bracket was low so our search criteria was limited. After reviewing various locations, we found Jarad’s page with one great review after another. The words are true, he is a magnificent host. On our arrival he met us in Manhattan and helped with our luggage to the apartment in Brooklyn. Jarad provided a fridge which he filled with water, coffee and beer, had teas, coffee and cereal in the kitchen for breakfast, and offered us his tablet to use during our 2 week stay. We felt at home instantly. Always available to provide help, and was great conversation. He truly went above and beyond as a host for this price. As it was the holiday period his family and kids were around often, which was really sweet. So polite and full of character, just like Jarad!  Space An adequate amount of space similar to a hostel. Clean and comfortable bunk beds. Rack for luggage. Small fridge and bathroom beside. Hostel conditions in someone’s house, partially separated by fabric. It’s a shared area, beside main entrance. TV/games console noise does travel, but an eye mask and ear plugs fixed this. Heating was constant and warm during our winter stay. Bathroom had a hot shower with great pressure.  Location Having previously stayed 10 minutes from this location, and done very little exploring, the apartments location is wonderful for the price. A stone’s throw from the station, a quick 5 minute walk (or 10 minutes to another station if you wish for lift access. Great for heavy suitcases), with a quick 20 minute ride into Manhattan taking in the stunning views from the Williamsburg bridge. A real NYC moment on every journey. There are convenience stores selling juice and deli food close by, fast food chains, a fresh fruit and veg store, and a more commercial supermarket. All food bases are covered in walking distance. The area is busy around the station and shops, but we at no point felt in danger even at night. Street where apartment is on is quiet.  Overall Excellent value for money if you are on a budget and a great way to make your NYC dreams come true! Much more than you would get at a hostel for a lesser price. Would definitely recommend to any backpacker or someone who needs a place to crash when exploring the city that doesn't sleep. If you are looking for more privacy, definitely look at the other options in this apartment. The location is fantastic and Jarad is a wonderful host.

Hello, I am writing this review because I know its importance. This was the first time my family have tried Airbnb and I was so scared that it wouldn't be to their liking but as we went in they loved it, the apartment was super clean and smelled great, the hostess was amazing, she had bought us a bottle of wine as a treat and stacked the apartment with tea, coffee and milk, which was helpful for the next morning. We got to the apartment late, regardless of that the hostess stayed and made sure that she welcomes us and show us around, she explained that she will be available for any question we had (and she was, she responded to all my texts almost immediately). The catch was with parking, Fma will explain it to you but one thing I will say is when there is a sign saying from a certain time to a certain time you have to move your car (move it awhile in advance, about a day before, because a lot of people will have taken the other spots), once you get there you'll know what I mean and I'm sure Fma will explain it to you.  The hostess was amazing, I've gone through Airbnb before but have never felt like I was home, the beds were comfy and the house was super clean. I absolutely loved it, and loved the hostess as well, she was amazing and extremely helpful. Especially that her house was right next to a market and the subway and the bus stop, we didn't have to walk far at all, it was great. If you decide to go to her place, I can assure you, you won't regret it.

We loved this airbnb! Andrew was an excellent host, he is really kind, also in regards of the area, the amount of homeless it is not much different from the rest of the city, the subway station is a five minute walk which is great, the bus is also really close, we had no issue whatsoever with the area, also there was never a problem with the shared bathroom, it was really clean and the space for both bedroom and bathroom was great, if you have the opportunity, I consider this airbnb to be an excellent choice, the space, and attention that you get for the price it is awesome, this place totally exceed our expectations, will definitely stay here again

What a steal! My wife and I stayed at Konni's place for a week. It felt just like home. Konni made everything really easy from check-in all the way through check-out. Neighborhood was great as well, and super quick access to 7 train.  If you can manage to sync up your schedule with Konni's, highly recommend you stay with her.

DREADFUL.  Undisclosed theft, safety concerns, others living in household,  illegality of hosting.  Host asked me to lock myself in room and not disclose any personal information to other tenant in fear of safety.  I reported this to AirBnB and was told to continue to stay in unsafe location or lose the money for unused nights.  It has been two weeks and I have yet to hear from resolution center.  Entirely unprofessional.

This property is not real… Scammer. I reported this to airbnb. Don’t ever book in this place. I booked here for 1 month and no one in this place to check me in. 😡   Thank you to AirBnb management  for returning my money.

Good basic option for people going to the airport.  The bed was very comfortable. Lakshmee’s clear instructions made check in easy. The street the house was on seemed nice and peaceful but the public transit route to get there from Manhattan went through a sketchy area (someone was making threats of violence near a bus stop where I waited). I think buses arrive less frequently at night, so I recommend getting there earlier in the day if going by bus.

it's a very cool apartment in a very cool block.  We had one or two issues, but Mike was quick to find solutions. one was the bathroom light going on and off. Mike got someone to fix it, but it probably needs replacing really as stream is getting to it.  we found it hard to get the temperature right as the heating made the upper level heat up very fast but not so much the lower level.  The walls are thin but the neighbours' noise didn't continue too late. the kitchen could be better equipped, for eg there's no kettle and no toaster or grill (British requirements, I suspect!)  Mike very kindly lent us a cot for our baby.

Flyn was amazing and the space was gorgeous! The entrance was in the alley way but never once felt unsafe. Flyn was super accommodating and communicated quickly with any question or concern we had. Would stay again and highly recommend!!

My friends and I booked this airbnb for a weekend and we were extremely disappointed. Here's why:  1. The "apartment" is in someone's basement, which is not mentioned in the description. There is a door at the top of some stairs that leads to the main house and the door has a crack in it. Basically whoever was above up could have easily gone into the basement we were staying at, even in the middle of the night.  2. Exposed pipes in the bedroom made the LOUDEST noise whenever someone flushed the toilet upstairs (we think). It woke us up in the most unpleasant way possible several times each night.  3. The sofa bed is the most uncomfortable piece of furniture on the planet. It has metal springs that jab you in the neck, back and legs all night.   Sunshine (the owner) was nice and checked up on us, but i honestly would not recommend this airbnb.

We had a lot of issues with the property. The floor boards were broken which was pretty dangerous so we couldn’t be barefoot and tripped multiple times. There was garbage left under the bed in one of the bedrooms. A lot of the sheets, beds and towels were dirty and stained. The air conditioning in the main living room would leak water onto the floor (probably why the floor boards are broken). We had a lot of back and forth to find a new place but at such short notice In NYC, everything was at least double the price and out of our budget. The one compliment I would give was Chad’s communication. He was responsive but in the end we felt very mislead by the whole offering and didn’t get any support to fix the issues except for asking us to go buy new sheets.

Zeta’s place is a perfect location to discover Bushwick and NYC. Very close walk to the subway, nearby restaurants and shops. The apartment was very clean, and reflective of the pictures in the listing. Zeta was a great host, super quick on communication and did everything possible to make our stay stress free. Would come back again! Thanks Zeta

Lakshmee is so kind! She was really helpful and replied to us so quickly. The place has just what you need for an overnight stay near the airport. One thing to note: so the listing mentions that you can hear water running through the pipes, but that's a bit of an understatement. When we were there, someone decided to take a shower in the middle of the night and the water rushing through the pipes scared us awake and kept us up. It was really startling. It's unlikely that mid-night showers happen often, but if you're not a really heavy sleeper, this could be an issue. Other than that, it was great!

Great space for a large group with a mix of kids, adults, and older adults. Large kitchen/dining area with more than enough seating for our party of 11 people made Christmas dinner mostly stress-free. Plenty of space/comfy couches for people to spread out as well. Plus a great location in Prospect Heights, walkable to Park Slope and Ft. Greene.

The small bed was comfortable & the room came with a actually functional tv . So basically i showed her proof that she was lying  and she didn’t want to talk anymore . Excellent choice for JFK layovers. Host Lakshmee is very friendly and provided alot of help with big welcoming smiles. Place was very clean and well organized. The area maybe little dangerous at night; but inside the house definitely felt safe. I will visit again if got other opportunities.

Yamid's apartment is very clean and nicely decorated. Yamid was very attentive while being very discreet. There were three of us, with my husband and our 11 month old baby who was able to walk around the apartment without danger. We had access to the kitchen and bathroom whenever needed. In short, we felt like home! The price is very good and it is our best Airbnb experience.

Lakshmee was kind, easy to reach, & quick to respond to any questions. The room is pretty much as described & very clean; it is an easy stop over for JFK. I arrived in the early evening & left very early, so I didn’t explore the area much, but I never felt unsafe despite traveling alone. I recommend staying here for JFK layovers/early flights & will stay here again if I have another early flight!

Lakshmee is very nice, and her place is very clean. However, as she mentioned in the description there is a very loud noise that happens at least once every hour in your room. It’s so loud that it scared and woke me and my pets up every time. Also there are plenty of other noises in the place, as the walls are paper thin. So if you sleep like a rock, you’ll have no issues. If you’re a light sleeper like me, you’ll get no quality sleep at all. Lastly, beware that the pet fee is per pet. I got that insight only after I called her to get code access. So overall the place is nice and easy enough to find, but I paid a lot to get no sleep.

Decidels apartment was very clean and spacious . I traveled with my toddler so that was a big deal for me. She had enough space to play and I didn’t have to worry about her picking up anything dangerous. He responds to you very fast , and messaged me every morning to make sure I was ok and comfortable. There is cable tv and fast WiFi so I was able to get some work done on my laptop . I definitely recommend his apartment if you’re staying in nyc & also want to be close to the airport  . It’s in a good area with lots of food choices as well as delis. Thanks again I will definitely stay here again .

Very comfy, great location an very clean. Traveled from florida for a wkend of sight seeing for my fiance who has longed to see NYC an staying here really keep our stay comfortable after long days of subways an walking. An a bonus to have had a driveway for our vehicle since everyone knows NYC parking is stressful. Thank you for having us definitly look you up next trip.
Lakshmee, went out of her way to assist me. She made a stressful trip easier. Perfectly situated for layover at JFK. Thank you

Place was exactly how he showed and described. Nice size, very quiet neighborhood, everyone in the neighborhood was kind and polite. I had everything I needed to make the work trip stress free. Would def book with him if I’m in that area again!

Oda's place is perfectly located in a hot area, lots of restaurants, bars, parks and so many options for local cafes. The place is very new yorker, and for that, I mean small space but very stylish. You have everything you need, in a well-organized and functional minimalist (clean) space. The common area is not for a long hang out, we used it to grab our first coffee before going out and explore. Internet works great. Check-in and out was smooth, Oda was very responsive and kind. Her unit is on the third floor, this an important heads-up for people with diverse mobility. I was a bit afraid because her account did not have many reviews since she is new on Airbnb, but I totally recommend her space.

I booked two months before traveling. And two days before, I receive a message from the host asking me to deposit 200 dollars more for a New York hotel fee. If I didn't pay it, the reservation would fall. That was unpleasant. The apartment is in a privileged location. It is very good for two people. We had a problem in the bathroom that luckily did not happen again. Likewise, he responded quickly to that bathroom question. I recommend it, but it was unfortunate to have asked for more money two days before.

The place is genuinely a steal. Nearby literally everything that is good in Williamsburg (Bolsario, looking at you), has great wifi, an expandable round table, and feels like JUST the right amount of space you need for two people to comfortably live inside of (at least for a week or two). Would 100% stay again.

I spent double my money trying to find a place to stay and traveling to the other side of Brooklyn because that’s all that was available so last minute.
Best host I’ve had. Excellent communication including looking out for me as I dealt with shady ground transportation. Very friendly and helpful. Thanks
Nice hotel, just really small. convenient location but it gets shady at night

I would definitely stay here again!
