Luz frequently cleaned the place, to maintain its "picture perfect" condition. The bathroom and kitchen were always constantly cleaned. Everything was just so white and pretty! The BED was the BEST. It was so comfortable I wanted to bring it home. You also have access to Netflix and Youtube and etc on your private TV in your room. The internet's good and fast. The heater and AC also worked fine even with the crazy NY weather this spring. One of the best things, though, was the location. It was literally 1 block from the 7 train station. I mean, as soon as you exit the building, you could see the station right there. How much better can it get? And, the 7 train line is super convenient for both going into Manhattan (20-30 min) and Flushing (10 min), where the Citi Field stadium--the home of all main events and concerts--is. As a tourist, at the end of the day being tired from walking all day in the city, staying close to the train station REALLY helps. The neighborhood was also very vibrant and diverse. For the whole time I was there, even when coming back as late as almost midnight, there were still a lot of people on the train and streets, so I never felt scared at all. There were tons of restaurants and shops around the area--super convenient! There's also a 24-hour supermarket right across the street and dozens more less than 10 min away. I feel like I've written too long but this place truly deserves it. I know that there's still not many reviews on this place (because of me staying for so long, blocking all other guests to book), but I can guarantee you that this place is absolutely perfect. And, even though there were some house rules (as stated in the room description), but they were very typical and basic rules that we as guests should have the courtesy to follow...

Daniel’s home is beautiful, and the room was very comfortable.  Daniel was kind in providing an extra single mattress so I could sleep on the floor and allow my older mother use of the bed.  We checked in and then went out for a family holiday celebration for the evening, collecting the front door keys in advance of an expected late-night return, when we were encouraged to be as quiet as possible so as not to wake the host or his wife or teenage daughter.   We faced a frustrating challenge in coming in late at night because we couldn’t get the keys to open the front door. After standing out in the cold and trying the keys for 15 minutes, and after trying to reach Daniel by email and text, all to no avail, we finally rang the bell, waking Daniel and his family. I felt terrible about this, and even with repeated apologies, it was an unpleasant moment.  I have learned from this to try the keys at any home I will be staying in in the presence of the owner to make sure I know how to get a door to open — and also to agree together about what to do and how to reach the host in case there is an issue.

Staying with Luz you feel more like you’re staying with an old friend.  She and her little daughter are wonderful people.  Luz is super easy and responsive to communicate with and was incredibly accommodating.  She really wants to make sure you have everything you need.  We had to do a lot of traveling to get to NYC and then were leaving from NYC for a lot of traveling and she made our trip so stress-free.  We really appreciated our time there.  Also, I would note, we had even more space in the room than we thought!

I loved staying at Luz’s place! I read most of the reviews before booking and so I had a really high expectation staying here. And well, those expectations were meant! The room (& rest of house) was very clean. The sheets smelled clean and were folded nicely. When Luz gave me the tour (it was over the phone because she had to deal with an emergency elsewhere), everything was in the exact spot she mentioned - so there was no confusion on my end. We did see each other in person a few times, but I was mostly left alone during my stay. The location is in a great spot too! A bunch of restaurants & corner stores are nearby. I had to walk to meet my sister at the train station (literally 3 minutes away if that) at 2am in the morning on a Saturday and there was a lot of people still walking around so I didn’t feel unsafe (I’m from a big city in Midwest so I’m not completely naive!). I would totally stay here again!

This was my first experience with Airbnb. Natasha responded very quickly. Also, the host's Debra was very kind and always cared for me. The apartment is convenient to go anywhere. There are convenience stores, restaurants, drug stores, supermarkets, etc. in the neighborhood. Also the room is very beautiful and the bathroom has many amenities and towels. The neighborhood is very quiet and you can spend comfortably. You shoul stay here.

We had a wonderful stay at Allison’s place. The room was clean and comfortable. Metro was few meters from the apartment. The only downside was the neighborhood which seemed little dangerous during the late hours.

The location seems sketchy, and I do think you should be aware of that.   However, when you get on the street that the Airbnb is on, it’s actually really nice.  It gives you the true Brooklyn experience. You’re super close to the subway which is a HUUUGGE PLUS!   Allison is a great host! She was really great at communicating and did her best to make sure we had a great experience.

I had a terrible experience staying here.  Said there was a free street parking my car was towed away. I pay US$185for towing and US$115 for the ticket. The shower water sometimes hot sometimes cold. Outside of the house has rat running through. And there were some insane homeless chasing people in the traffic light area. There were people smoking weed at entrance of subway station. The free street parking depends on luck. First day we got there there was a spot. In order to keep the spot we did not move our car for three days. on Tuesday host said we have to move car from one side to another side because they need to wash the stree. Otherwise we’ll get a ticket. but the other side it was a full with cars. We had nowhere to park the car. We struggled and found one spot we thought we were lucky didn’t see there was a hydrant next to it, that was a reason why nobody park there. When we woke up. Our car disappeared, we freaked out. Host told us it was towed.  We need paid on our pocket.

Suzi and her flat mates are very nice. The apartment is as seen in photographs. This is an ok place to stay for the money you are paying.  However, I would not stay here again and would not recommend to my friends. As two young girls we felt this neighborhood was not very safe. It was quite scary walking between the subway and the apartment. Also, the flat mates at this apartment were extremely loud on our first night keeping us awake till about 4am. Therefore we got little sleep. Overall we did not enjoy our stay.

Good place for it's value, a very friendly host, and good energy in the apartment. The room you stay in is a bit plain. If that doesn't effect you then great! Small room, white walls, can make you feel claustrophobic if not ready for it. The location is close to the train which is GREAT! the buses are inconsistent, not once were we able to catch one due to delays, or the bus blindly not stopping for us at the bus stop (we then checked the schedule, and it should have stopped.) There is some stuff around here for food, not a big variety of choices though. Deli's at almost every street corner, which is nice. We were here during June while it was getting hot, the a/c unit was trying but coming up short, leaving the room warm but not hot (or cool). Everyone in the neighborhood was out on their stoops. Which is a really great taste of the culture in the area, a look into their lives. Not once did we feel unsafe (and I'm a small white girl). The neighborhood is very dirty, but it's NYC.

Gary's place was very nice inside, super clean, and just as described.  Easy access to manhattan with two lines close by.  While there are not any attractions in the neighborhood, if you're looking for a steal, this is your spot.  Gary was very responsive and helped us with parking!

This place was great! The pull-out sofa wasn't great, but I slept ok, and we loved that they provided snacks, coffee, and other little goodies. The area felt a little sketchy at night but nothing terrible.

The place as a whole was pretty decent. Living room space and kitchen was roomy and the main bedroom was decent seeing that the bathroom was right there next to the room, but there are some faults.  The electrical sockets were broken up making it a bit unsafe to use. There was no dust pan, which made it a bit harder to tidy up. When the place was swept, there was still alot of dust lingering around. In the bedroom, the AC, when running, circulated air that left a wet and moldy smell that is unpleasant to inhale.    The WiFi reception was terrible. There were times when I had virtual meetings and online classes and the WiFi signal would drop in the middle of my meetings. I had to use my hotspot instead.  One of the buttons on the Roku tv remote was not working  and the HDMI cord was missing from the TV, so we had to use our own.

Let's start off by saying the hosts were very friendly and welcoming to us when we entered their home. After an unfortunate and suspicious reservation with another listing around Bushwick area (which I do not recommend to any traveler to stay at), Umutcan was able to offer their home to us for immediate check in. My roommate and I are really grateful for their assistance.  Location:  Location is definitely convenient and safe. The train stop is on the street behind us and a train that comes by every 3-5 mins. Despite this with windows closed, it is relatively VERY quiet. The train to time square manhattan is ONLY about 15-20 mins ride. Don't expect anything faster through public transportation in NYC.   Community:  There are quite a few food places around. If you want a quick meal around your area, look no further than half a block radius. The museum of moving image is also a spectacular location that's about 25 min walking distance. Great attraction to go if visiting NYC. Rite Aid and laundromat right around the corner for your convenience.  Room:  The room was very big and spacious with your own in room private bathroom as describe. There is a closet for storage and hanging clothing. Cable TV for entertainment and hdmi hook up, along with a sofa to watch a movie in or sleep on for the additional guests. Bed was super soft and large (Full/Queen). Pillows and and extra blanket provided if requested. Bathroom essentials such as body wash and shampoo were provided surprising.  Service:  Service was wonderful (5/5). They mind their own business, we do our thing. You need advice and help around the city, the hosts got you. Great relationship between hosts and guests. Any special requests, the hosts will accommodate you to the best of their abilities. Although I do not have a pet, but apparently it is PET-FRIENDLY.  Thanks for the stay :). I really enjoy staying at this listing and would highly recommend it to those who stumble upon my review.

Love Love!  This place was everything and more. My family and I asked for an early check-in​ and Gary was very supportive. Once my sister entered. He gave her a tour around the house. The house was even more accomodating then we expected. EVERYTHING is walking distance from food to nail salon to transportation.     Gary and Silvia were very welcoming. I have always been sketchy with owners living in the same complex but these owners were very welcoming from beginning to end literally. They gave us 100% privacy. I can't thank them more. The place was clean, tidy, every one had ample space. The house is designed beautifully. Large living room with pull out couch, two air mattresses, two large bedrooms, dishwasher. By far one of the best AIRBNBs with GREAT owners. Felt like a home away from home! Thanks again

The room is comfortable, with open wiew and much light, a rarity in NYC.  Close to metro station, 10 min walk or 2 min by free shuttle bus.  Very easy to hang out in the city, don't be afraid even it's not in Manhattan is really close to the centre (3 metro stop to rockfeller centre). The host was kind ad always replied fast to my messages.  House is basic, you will find what you need for a short stay.  Not so furnished kitchen, but no one would cook at home in NYC.

Nothing is overlooked or missing from this outstanding rental.  Truly the description fully fits the experience I had staying at Melissa and Cary's Air bnb.  The apartment is sparkling clean, everything is labeled or includes instructions and the thoughtful amenities make for an easy and less stressful stay.  Melissa and Cary's apartment felt like a safe and clean oasis, especially during this trying time we are currently experiencing with travel. I hope to be back!!

This is such a cozy and comfortable studio with lots of light. I loved all of the plants and books in the apartment and it was very clean.  Self-check-in alleviates the stress of needing to meet someone at a particular time and Andrew was very communicative and gave clear and easy-to-follow instructions.  The area was also very nice and had lots of shops, restaurants, cafes, etc. The apartment is extremely close to Barclays Center, but also just a ~30 minute walk from the Brooklyn Bridge and Gowanus.  There is also (paid) parking right in front of the building. There are 24-hour parking garages in the area as well.  I would definitely consider staying here again!

We had a great stay here. It's close to our family's place, close to groceries and restaurants and shops and all the transport, clean and well kept. Check-in and communication w Andrew was stress-less and friendly. I really appreciated being in a real NY apartment! It's a really pleasant cozy space. We'll look forward to staying again. Thanks again, Andrew!

Great location with easy access to Lafayette Metro station just around the corner, literally! It was clean and just as described. Andrew was very easy to communicate with. Would stay here again. We brought a car and was able to find street parking a few blocks away for several days. Just be mindful of signs and don’t park on streets that are due for cleaning. Took us about 20 minutes of driving aroundto find a good spot. The door to the apartment itself is really hard to open so don’t be afraid to have to put some strength into it when opening.

This is a fantastic little two- bedroom apartment. Simple, clean and well-tended. It has a nice scale. The kitchen is spacious with a tall refrigerator and plenty of counter space. The bathroom also has shelves for toiletry - an unusual find in other Brooklyn Airbnb’s we’ve visited. The living room is spacious with a big dining/work table, comfortable seating for a TV that offers guests Netflix and other viewing options that must not come cheaply to the landlord. The master bedroom is a good size with two clothes closets, plenty of drawer space and a good reading light for each side of the bed. Our host was readily available for text messaging, which made our arrival stress free. We were very happy staying in this lovely apartment and hope to return in the future.

Since it was my first experience with Airbnb I was a little bit scared, Nancy dismissed all my scruples and make me feel confident for my decision to choose her apartment!  I definitely recommend Nancy's apartment for everyone who wants a nice-warm-clean-fully equipment place near to the MTA metro lines (J - A - C). Nancy was extremely friendly and provide us all the information that we may need!!  Also give us hints with nice places to eat or buy supplies for the apartment!!

We stayed at Nancy's place for 4 nights.  The apartment was very clean and comfortable.  We had a dedicated parking spot in the driveway of the building.  The closest subway was about 10 mins walk, which was a constraint for us having elders.  One of the days, we got street parking close to the station and it worked well.  Nancy provided the instructions ahead of our arrival and also called us the minute we checked in.  She answered her phone all the time when we had questions and followed up.  She is very serious in providing a good service to her clients and is open for feedback to improve.  Since we were new to Brooklyn, we initially felt unsafe, but, got used to it.   We were able to get in and out of Manhattan using the J line subway.  There are shops/supermarkets nearby for groceries.  There is no washer/dryer in the apartment.  Having that would be nice.

Nancy is a very welcoming host whose apartment is perfect for a family stay (4 adults and 4 children). We spent 5 days in his cozy apartment, very clean and equipped with very complete equipment and in very good condition. We did not have to complain about the noise from the neighbor downstairs (see previous comments) but rather the noisy footsteps of the neighbors above (the floors are visibly poorly insulated in this recently renovated building). The nighttime trip to the Myrtle Av subway station may make this cosmopolitan neighborhood seem unsafe, but in the end we didn't feel unsafe. A metro station further south (Utica Av, about 15 minutes on foot) allows you to quickly reach the trendier neighborhoods of Brooklyn and Downtown Manhattan.  A good address to be far from the hustle and bustle of Manhattan while still being able to get there quickly.

Shirley's flat was exactly what I was looking for. Close to Columbia univ, 10 min walk only. All facilities around. The room was very quiet I slept very well. Typical NYC appartment, old but  charming. I did not met Shirley but the instructions to get to the flat were good and the key was exactly at its place in the locker box on the fence. Note however that you really  need to align the 4 numbers otherwise it does not open... I arrived at the adress at 10:45 pm and I only suceed to open after almost 5 min of trying. A bit of stress at this late time, being tired after the journey. I would recommend this apartment anyway. To

My daughter stayed her from mid-april until 3 may. According to her, the room is large and bright with a comfortable bed. The apartment has a great kitchen and bathroom, although she didn't make a lot of use of the kitchen. The apartment is centrally located in the UWS, with all conveniences located closeby, like a Duane Reade and a number of grocery stores. Subway is located only a couple of blocks from the apartment! Furthermore, the apartment is located in a safe area and the apartment overall is really clean. Note that when trying to get the keys from the lockbox, you really need to aline the numbers carefully (it won't open otherwise, which can be rather stressful). In my opinion, Shirley is a really easy-going and considerate young woman, and if not my daughter, I would love to stay here sometime myself! Thanks Shirley :)

Had a bit of issues in the beginning but it was resolved. Although, I did not meet her she is a great host, very quick with communication, which is a plus. Cute and stylish room. Nice and convenient area. The house looks a bit sketchy when you first look at it, but inside is a beautiful home.  I stayed here for about 2 months and enjoyed my stay here. I am not a fan of cats but they didn't bother me so much! I would stay here again.

I had to leave after checking in due to construction going on in the house. It would have been helpful to have been informed before my arrival, even if it was 1 day before, so I could have planned accordingly. As for the room itself, it's as described, be aware however the bed mattress is in fact very hard. Like book cover hard. It's also a twin/double sized, not a queen sized, incase you were wondering. It's smaller than the photos seem. The room is located at the front of the house, therefore your door to the room is in the main entrance hall way of the house. This means everyone who lives upstairs keeps their bikes, and enters and exits at your door. The half bathroom across the hall is quaint however for the 1 day I was there while trying to find a new location and refund, this toilet and skin are often used by others in the house coming and going. It's not just for your use. The kitchen at the end of the hall and full bathroom is where the other tenant lives, and you have to keep the main doors closed there for the cats inside that space. There are many cats around the house incase you are allergic. I found the fridge to be very full, even though I didn't stay, my original booking was for 3 weeks. Would have been nice to have some space set aside in a clean part of the fridge for groceries.  Due to the construction happening I opted for a full refund through AirBnB and relocated. The host was apologetic. I would have stayed and bought a mattress topper to soften the bed, as the purpose of my stay was to focus on job prospects. Since having to relocate I've not been able to get much work done, this process has caused some stress for me, and unessesary  wasted time looking for other places to stay. Not fun all round trying to relocate using the NZ metro with a suitcase during rush hour, because I already spent $50 US taking a taxi from the airport to the rental. Hence clarity and honesty even if it is upon arrival, is best to save everyone hassle.

I really liked living in the area, super calm and stress free. You can't hear loud noises, you can have a quiet life. The scenery is completely Brooklyn vibes. The room is small, but that was never omitted. The host is very cooperative!

Our family of six had a great stay at Nancy's space!!  Three bedrooms and two bathrooms feels like luxury in New York City.  The location to the subway while a bit of a walk made the city practically at our fingertips.  The neighborhood was very diverse and although we choose to only walk in groups or use Lyft we never felt unsafe.  Nancy's place was spotless and the beds were great!! We would definitely stay there again!!

Apartment consistent with the photos, clean and well appointed Nancy is at the top, very good communication, available by email during the stay and very responsive The neighborhood is popular, past the first impression of "insecurity", we had no problems (even when returning after dark) We recommend this accommodation

Very clean and perfectly furnished apartment. The 6 beds (4 beds) are very very comfortable, the sofa bed is less so.  Very good communication; Nancy, contactable during the stay, is very responsive and attentive.  Very decent neighborhood despite a first impression of insecurity, particularly in the evening at the Myrtle metro station.  We are delighted with our stay!

Vladimir was a wonderful host! Very attentive when needed but allowed us our space. The unit is huge and perfectly close to the beach in a quiet area. Just be prepared to bring supplies with you for cooking as there are only pots and pans, some silverware, and a few plates and glassware. Parking was plentiful, which diminished the stress level.  Would stay agin!

First let me say that the apartment is as large as described and was clean. Unfortunately we felt that it was not quite ready for guests. It looks like it might still be under repair. We could only use one of the bathrooms since the master bath had no shower head and leaked downstairs when we tried to use it.  The one bedroom has no windows and there is no air conditioning at all in the apartment. The apartment is not in the newly built neighborhood, it's in an older structure/building a few blocks away. I did not feel unsafe at all. The host did answer promptly when we contacted him and the apartment has great potentials once the kinks are worked out.

We really enjoyed our stay with John, whose apartment fully corresponds to the description in his ad. John was very welcoming and accommodating for our late arrival due to our flight delay. He also has good advice on places to visit in New York.

Great apartment that accommodates 8 people.  We were 2 families (4 adults & 4 kids). 15 min walk to the Subway; an easy and direct commute to Manhattan (Financial District). Neighborhood is okay, however, a little sketchy to walk at night.  Nancy is great host. She offers tips and communicates super well. She's always available if any questions do arise.

Our stay at John's place was fantastic. Right from the start communication was good and John was always available to answer any questions we had even before the trip. Getting to the apartment by shuttle was easy and check in was a breeze. The apartment is conveniently located near the subway and it's an easy ride on the 1 train to most of the sights in NYC making it a convenient base to get around NYC. there is a great cafe, Taszo for good coffee and delicious breakfast nearby. John gave lots of great suggestions and was always checking in with us during our stay. Quite a safe neighbourhood and we didn't feel the least bit unsafe when returning late at night. Also a short stroll to great views of the Hudson River. I recommend John's place!

This place is a literal scam. The pictures and description lead you to believe you are going to some relaxing beach haven. It's a dump, and the neighbors are up all night making a crazy racket. Check out the strict cancellation policy. That is clue #1 you shouldn't go here. Definitely not family friendly.  I guess if you are ok living in strangers' filth, this is the place for you.

Nash was a great host, although we did not meet in person the contact was great! super friendly and helpful. We where able to checkin early & have a late check out due to the availability which was amazing! The apartment is big for New York with a lot of light! Although it is old and has a student feel it suited our needs for 4 people for 1 week perfectly fine. The roof terrace is not really accessible, as it is a dangerous walkway. But the view from the bedroom makes up for it.  Neighborhood is amazing, chilled, close to the water front and all the hip shops and restaurants + an easy commute to manhattan.

Very pleasant stay with John and Kelsey! the accommodation is very well located (barely 500m from a metro station). John and Kelsey were very welcoming (despite a late arrival due to a delay in our flight) and very accommodating! We warmly recommend this accommodation for a stay in New York!

If you are seeking an authentic NYC experience look no further. John and Kelsey have a superbly located home decorated with their talented artist flair. The apartment was nice and toasty in the winter weather, the bed was incredibly comfortable, and they both offered great advice on touring the city. Easy walking distance to trains and buses it was quick to feel like a local between the hospitality and location. And their dog Disco will steal your heart along with the walls of books. Felt like living in my daydreams of being an artist in the City! I would absolutely stay here again on future visits to the Big Apple. Thank you John and Kelsey!

Room was small but comfortable. We were a little unsure about the area as it seemed a but scary and dodgy when we first got there but we had no bad experiences. Ben was a good host and arranged for us to pick up the key from a place nearby which meant we could check in when we wanted. The place was clean and the roommates friendly. Recommended

First off I just want to say that this was the most amazing first Airbnb experience.  Our hosts (even though we never met them, due to them being on vacation) were super sweet, helpful, responsive, and overall amazing. If I ever come back to NY there's probably no other place that I would look besides this cute little apartment!  I was scared that it wasn't going to look as advertised but it was exactly that!  The subway was literally right up the steet and food places were right around the corner (: A+

It was such a privilege to stay in Miriam's lovely home. My room was huge and looked over a peaceful, leafy courtyard - a real retreat from the city, but so close to restaurants and numerous subway lines. I arrived after a stressful cab ride with not enough cash to pay the driver. She loaned me the money, and was so warm and kind I instantly relaxed. A very generous host, she laid out copies of the New Yorker for guests to read and urged us to share her food. It felt completely natural to sit down at her kitchen table at the end of each day and chat with her about what I'd seen. I feel very lucky to have stayed here.

Beautiful, quiet and private! Bright large room and bathroom, with enough space for two roomies to spread out in. The area is beautiful, and it’s just a subway ride into Manhattan. I never felt unsafe coming home at night after seeing theatre, as two young females who’ve never been to NYC before.   Miriam and her son were lovely and welcoming, but also gave us privacy to do our own thing and come and go as we pleased. I would absolutely stay here again; and thank you Miriam for hosting us!

Amazing place to stay! Located near a bunch of subway stations, shops, and restaurants. Miriam was incredibly kind and allowed us to check in early, which saved us a lot of stress! Her friendly dog May was also an unexpected highlight of our trip. Thank you again for a lovely stay, Miriam!

Svetlana and her son Marko are very accommodating especially for the key hand off.   The apartment is in the perfect location.  A subway or tram is less than a 10 minute walk from the gorgeous and comfortable bedroom. Our whole time was very private, but if we needed help with plans, directions or just some fabulous off the wall ideas that are brilliant. I can't stress how much my wife and I enjoyed having coffee with Svetlana in the morning. The stay was just fabulous and allowed for a carefree time in one of the largest cities.  If we ever go back than Svetlana's apartment is where we'll be staying.

Everything about our stay at the property was perfect! The location was amazing, very safe and close to the subway. The property was lovely, spacious, clean and secure. Bobinni, the host made this a very smooth/stress free experience. I would highly recommend staying here.

It was a great time for me and my mom in New York (Williamsburg). Personally, we actually liked this part of town best, with great cafes, restaurants and shopping opportunities. Everything is a little smaller and clearer and not quite as stressful. Everything can be reached quickly by ferry and subway.  Many thanks again to Nash, he was a great host :) Kind regards from Hamburg :)

I booked Nash’s apartment for my first trip back to my home city in nearly two decades. Nash’s place is an island of authenticity in an already developed Brooklyn that’s becoming increasingly homogeneous. The tastefully decorated apartment and the communal nature of the apartment building with it’s fun, sincere and respectful tenants really reminds of the environment that fostered the creative energies that brought cool people to the Brooklyn of my youth. In regards to the stay, everything was as described—the location is ideal, sheets were clean, towels were laid out, the view was to die for, and the amenities were clean and good to go. During my stay Nash and neighbours were very considerate, patient, and helpful when I’d created a situation of my own making. Don’t be afraid to book a stay here—it’s truly one of a kind.

Lana  is amazing, kind, selfless, and beautiful.  The apartment is super clean also. We enjoyed the location and felt safe and warm. I would highly recommend her place to anyone who has never used AIRBNB because she makes it easy and hassle free. Lana and her son Marko are just beautiful souls. Easy to get to the heart of the city in 10 mins! !...don't be afraid to book here. ..it's all you could ask for. ..and more!

We really enjoyed our stay with Svetlana. We received valuable tips and great information. The apartment is very nicely furnished, totally clean, you just immediately feel at home. We have taken Svetlana to our hearts - hospitality is very important to her! The location is also perfect. Gladly again! We can only recommend it if you want to get away from the stress of the city for a bit in the evening.

Recently renovated third floor walk up apartment in an older building in interesting diverse neighborhood. Other residents and the friend who greeted me were outgoing, intelligent, educated, and international. Room appeared to not have been recently cleaned despite the fee, which was described as paying for cleaning up after I left according to the host, but was adequate, with TV that required set up upon first power on, air conditioning unit in the window, and Spartan with no bureau or table other than the tiny surface upon which the TVequipment was placed. Plus bathroom jad cracked toilet seat somewhat dangerous. Be sure to get specific instructions and practice on unlocking the door. No reception for cell phone AT&T in the hallway. Decent reception in the room. Very quiet. Appeared to be quite safe. Post answered a few questions and concerns such as a slow draining sink quickly and politely. One half of my cleaning fee was promised to be refunded. Overall a very decent experience the price.
Annie was really helpful, and her instructions helped to make our stay stress free. The flat is good value for the area and very well located.

I wouldn't recommend staying here.  the host watches every move you make and is waiting for you constantly to walk in (in the dark) and is constantly looking for more ways to get money out of you. Being outside of the room felt very uncomfortable.  Overall it was an unpleasant experience.

I don’t know where to start. This was the absolute worst experience I have had with an Airbnb. With no warning, we arrived to the apartment as a complete renovation of the outside wall of the building was taking place. We were woken up daily by the sound of electric saws and hammers. To make things worse, the construction workers would block our doorway with all kinds of unsafe obstacles. There were power chords sitting in puddles of water, plugged in electric saws, ladders on our stairs, wooden planks and many other issues that made getting in and out completely dangerous. On day one the host wanted to bring down some furniture and, even though I did offer to help, they had me take the furniture down for them. They also were very noisy walking and moving things around on the floor above us. There was no shampoo or other toiletries so we were forced to buy all of our own. I am extremely upset with my experience and ask that a refund can be issued. The living conditions were completely unacceptable.

At first we were skeptical considering the fact we were three young girls, but don't be scared because Jay is extremely friendly, nice, and accommodating. He always makes sure everything is all right and there are no problems. He also got jokes. Five out of five perfect host especially for our first airbnb experience. He is very open to any questions. Ask away and don't be shy. He has his rules so as long as you follow them everything should be all right. Have common sense and be respectful of his home because he lives there as well. Pretty clean and nothing to complain about. Oh and if you buy him fresh opened popcorn be sure to tell him it's opened or he'll spill it all over the floor. Great first time experience especially for New York. Thanks Jay don't spill anymore popcorn! 🙂🙂

Hello! Host was very nice. The appartment was just as good as pics shows. Very nice view from the roof top! The neighbours may look scary like some comments says..but everyone there was just awsome. I would recommand this Hart House anytime GG.

Shira was very communicative and responsive from the beginning of my stay until the end of my stay. Her studio has a nice layout and it was comfortable.    A few little details to consider: upon arriving the bed wasn't made but there were instructions for me to remove sheets and bedding. There were only two towels left for us. I wouldn't mind that so much but my stay was for 10 days. I found the check-in/check-out process a bit stressful. There were a lot of arrangements made for picking up keys, returning them, etc. I much prefer minimal contact with hosts upon checking in and checking out. Shira was out of town at the time of my check-out. She gave me her friend's contact to arrange dropping the keys. I think it's a lot easier for a guest not to be coordinating times with another person. I would have preferred to have a set check-out time and a spot to leave the keys.  Lastly, it was the middle of summer and Shira discussed the use of the air conditioning with me. Im fine with using A/C as minimally as possible but there seemed to be a lot of concerns around the use.   Overall, I enjoyed my stay. The location was perfect for us and I found the studio quaint. I especially enjoyed the quick walk to Prospect Park!

Overall, it wasn't bad but wasn't  great either. The room itself was fine but there is only one bathroom for 5 rooms and it is a little bit dangerous neighborhood at night for girls. It was really noisy in the morning because of traffic. And there is no lift so you need to bring your luggage to fifth floor.

Reasonably priced and clean.  I’m a young female and I arrived late at night on Saturday, the location was a bit scary for me to walk alone at night. Otherwise it should be safe when you have company. The location is quiet during the day.

I am still seething from an overall negative experience with both the host and AirBnB but I will do my best to give an objective and constructive review of Besinfe's place. A) I will start with the good: The location is nice. The neighborhood is vibrant. For drivers, it appears that parking is not too bad by New York standards. We were able to find street parking though it was a holiday so I think YMMV. B) The bad: 1) Lack of communication. a) No reply at the time of original booking despite mentioning that I was bringing a dog. The listing mentions a dog fee and the host requiring dog approval. One would think that this would warrant some reply from the host. b) No reply two weeks from arrival when I sent a message with a reminder about the dog. At this stage we were past the strict cancelation period with no indication about what the fees would be. c) No reply for several hours to a message that I sent the morning of the day before arrival - also no email with check-in instructions. I only got a call several hours later in the evening. Mind you, I am in a national park with spotty service and it is not always easy to take a call. This is unacceptable and also it is good to have a paper trail of correspondences. d) Again, the host did not communicate at any time prior to the day before. The day of arrival my wife had an accident that required a trip to the ER and late arrival. That was when Besinfe told me about the dollar amount ($40) that he charges for people arriving between 8 and 10PM. Fees like this should be communicated clearly in the profile or at the very least known before the end of the cancelation period. It was too late to make alternative plans and we had no choice but to go along with the fees. 2) Cleanliness - The room was in the bottom quartile of the places I have stayed through AirBnB. When factoring the size of the cleaning fee in, it is most likely the worst I have experienced in terms of cleanliness/value ratio. The floor was dirty which you would very clearly notice upon taking off shoes as we did. Bending down, the dust and grit were noticeable to me. My wife who has lasik-corrected vision could see that the floor was dirty without bending over. The bedsheets and the pillow case were obviously not laundered. We found blond hairs from presumably a prior female guest. There was no scent that suggested laundering. The host claimed that the place was cleaned and the sheets were laundered. Maybe he had an off day and the accommodations are usually better. I don't know, however, for a $50 cleaning fee for a space of under 100 sq ft I expect the A game and not a C-. 3) House rules These should be communicated prior to arrival. Notably, the fact that he doesn't allow guests to leave things like chargers or the air conditioning unit plugged in while not in. The host told us that this was due to a fire caused by a guy having his phone charger plugged in. I don't see how that would be an issue for the AC unit in the room. For us this was a problem as the primary reason be found Besinfe was due to the fact that the listing allowed dogs. We wanted to leave our dog in the room at times while out at places where we could not bring her. Without temperature control, we had no guarantee of my dog's safety. 4) Comfort - The mattress is of very low quality, which is fine for a budget accommodation. It is noticeable for couples because of how the sides sag. The two of us are not heavy people. We are average-height people of normal-weight BMI and the mattress was not supportive of us. C) The Ugly: 1)) Under the table fees - Remember those fees that I mentioned? He demanded cash payment under the laughable the pretense that it "saves the guests money." The fees are made-up by the host and if he wanted to save the guest money he wouldn't charge them. We were not told the dollar amount of the fees until right before arrival when we had no real chance to make alternative accommodations. Additionally, it was weeks after the end of the cancelation period. The mistake I made was in paying him - this situation had never occurred in my previous AirBnB experiences and I did not know that I was supposed to phone AirBnB and not pay such fees. If it were not 10PM and I were not exhausted and frankly afraid of not having accommodations for the night I would have done so. I refused to pay him in cash for these fees and instead sent him a payment through a widely-used social payment service that gets censored. He told me not to write airbnb in the tag line for the payment but I did anyways. Upon finding out that I did, he knocked on the door of our room and was visibly upset with me for doing so, saying it could get him in trouble with AirBnB. He did not threaten us, I want to be clear about that, but I found that to be extremely annoying as we were getting ready to sleep after a 9 hour drive following a four hour hospital visit. 2) Take a look at Basinfe's reviews. There are no doubt many good ones but there are many many poor reviews that are consistent with what I have said in this review. Take a look at his personal replies to each of the reviews and complete inability to take responsibility. That is not the mark of a good host. 3) We were exhausted and stayed the first night but left early...

The neighborhood was a little sketchy, but no problems with anyone. We found parking not to far from the apartment. It took Moe little while to come and unlock the apartment for us, he thought it was unlocked for us when we got there.  Moe seemed like a very nice guy and told is to call if there were any problems. The inside was decent, we did have to kill some roaches while there. I'm sure they were from the other tenets that are in the building. We only stayed 2 days so we delt with the bugs. There was one air condition in the window and it kept the entire apartment nice and very cool❄.  Warning! There is  street clean up on Friday @11, so you have to move your car if you parked on the right side of the street, so that made it a little difficult when trying to pack our stuff in the car. Also, when we were packing up ready to get our stuff out the clean up ladies showed up ready to clean the place @11:30! The lady was reminding me that check out was at 12! It seemed like she wanted us to hurry up and leave! They waited outside the door until we got our stuff out after I closed the door. We felt rushed! But anyway....this was my first time using this sight. OK experience.

Moe was super prompt when I contact him. He always got back to me quickly and was very kind. Though I've never  him when checking in but everything was organized and ready for my stay. The beddings are still somewhat summery thin but I bet you can ask Moe for comforters if you feel chilly. Of course it is not 4 or 5 star hotel so don't expect impeccable condition of anything. Bathtub might look dirty but it is just old one not dirty. The neighborhood might look dangerous but it is very safe although it can be noisy sometimes. But if you just need a place to sleep and get on the train in 1 min this is the place! Come in with expectation of what you get for the price and space, I believe you will enjoy your stay! Thanks Moe :)

Checking in and out of Moe's place was a breeze. He is prompt to communicate, which I appreciate. The place was tidy, with enough space for our group. We all really loved how close the apartment is to public transit, and were able to get to and from the apartment late at night after spending all day in the city, without feeling unsafe. The overall value is fantastic. A simple, comfortable place to sleep, with enough space, and all basic ammenities. Also, the a/c unit kept the whole place cool. Thumbs up for that! If you are interested in visiting Coney Island, which we did, this location is a short drive or 10 min subway commute. I would stay here again!

The place is honestly a breath of fresh air - it is modern and artistic at the same time. It's close to the subway, and about 30 minutes away from Manhattan via the subway.   The only three issues we faced during our stay was that (1) a pair of our shoes were stolen (the shoes are to be placed outside the house, however, inside an enclosed entrance to the apartments), and (2) we always received responses that were delayed (at least 3-4 hours).  Lastly, (3), the location isn't the greatest - the neighborhood is often quiet and doesn't seem safe to walk about post unset, especially if it is a solo woman traveler. I was with my Partner, and I was still unable to get accustomed to the locality.

Our hosts had great communication. They always replied back within one hour. Usually faster than that.  Apartment was exactly the way it was described. Safe neighborhood. Never felt unsafe.  Great location. Close to subways. Shops and restaurants were all within walking distance.  Overall, we had a great experience here at this apartment. If we ever come back, we would gladly stay here again.

It is important that future guests know that the accommodation is located on a lower floor, without an elevator, on the last step. When we looked at the roof we realized that a piece of metal was rusted and about to fall from the stairs that lead to the terrace, scary! (You should fix it because it is quite dangerous) When we stayed, there were 13 people in total in the apartment and only one shower for everyone, "you always have to be careful not to wait two hours to shower." The room was not particularly clean, we missed mopping the floor, the noise in the house is quite a bit, it occurred to us to go one day in the afternoon to rest a little and be able to go out at night and it is impossible, the music was at full volume and with a terrible "grass" smell. Kristy never showed up with us, but I guess she's a blonde who showed up at the apartment one day, so I don't have any positive or negative comments for her, because I didn't speak a word to her, the only one who helped us was Diego, he's a very kind guy.  By mistake we didn't see that there was a cat in the house, a mistake on our part since a roommate is allergic.  In relation to the location, it is neither bad nor good, although taking into account that for an affordable price it is practically staying in Manhattan, the subway lines that are near the apartment connect very well with the main destinations of the city. The good thing about the location is that for breakfast, all the Mexican food places have a delicious breakfast for a low price. The place is not bad, if you take all these points into account. And as a recommendation for the managers is that you clean the hallways, at least those that lead to the fifth floor, arriving and seeing a place like this so "left behind" is very scary when you arrive for the first time. In short, it is a place to only sleep, and in relation to arrival at the site it is quite convenient since those who run the site are there all day and it is not difficult to locate.

Cleanliness The linens and the place overall were very cleanly maintained. There are many people staying in the apartment, so a bit of messiness may be left behind . Nonetheless, the place felt more like home than other Airbnb places I have been to. Thank you for an amazing maintenance work!  Location It's not a scary neighborhood. When we were here(new year's eve), it was pretty quiet. The place is close to a subway station. The only downside is that you need to carry luggage up to the 5th floor. But it is good to he away from the street noises.   People at the Hart house were all friendly and helpful. Kristy was away for the weekend we were staying, but her replies to our messages were prompt and kind. Orion the cat is perhaps the sweetest cat I've seen. Thank you for being an amazing home for us for our stay in the New York city!

This experience was very excellent for many reasons. The room was very clean and comfortable. Thank you so much for the air conditioning on my very hot evenings in nyc. Even though the 1 shower is shared with others, the best time for me to use it was early (I’m an early bird), followed by a cup of coffee or tea in this very interesting and eclectic household. The art on the walls are so cool, left by many whom have been here before. I met some very wonderful people traveling from many places.  The area may seem rowdy and scary but we felt very safe and not a soul bothers us once. This was an icing on the cake for experiences as you will see another side of NYC other than the picture perfect we all know. Warning ⚠️, come prepared to climb 4 flights of stairs and do lots of walking. This is a very well organized place and the response time from Kristy and Chris was great. Can’t wait to visit and stay here again!!!

I was really surprised by the hospitality of Greg and his uncle. They were great hosts!!!! The room was perfect, very clean, fresh and fragrant. Sheets and towels were clean and available. From the air conditioner kept the room cool. The apartment is in an excellent location, close to 3 metro lines and many buses. Also nearby are: grocerys, MC Donald's and a library. Is a safe place, often I came back late at night and there was nothing suspicious. The kitchen is ideal and I could prepare my meals there. Greg was very kind and was attentive in everything we asked. Surely I come back to New York and stay at Greg's house.   Eu realmente fiquei surpresa com a hospitalidade do Greg e seu tio. Eles foram ótimos anfitriões!!! O quarto estava perfeito, muito limpo, fresco, cheiroso e a cama era extremamente confortável. Os lençóis e toalhas estavam limpos e disponíveis. O condicionador de ar manteve o quarto fresco e agradável. A localização é excelente, perto de 3 linhas de metro e muitos ônibus. Também ficam perto: diversos mini mercados, um MC Donald's e uma biblioteca. É um local seguro, muitas vezes voltei tarde da noite e não houve nada suspeito. A cozinha é ideal e lá pude preparar minhas refeições. O Greg foi muito amável e atencioso em tudo que pedi. Com certeza voltarei a Nova York e ficarei na casa do Greg.

Living at Roberta’s was the best! Her apartment was so lovely and the neighborhood was perfect for us! 15 minutes walk to the subway and then 15 minutes to midtown Manhattan. The apartment was exactly like the pictures, warm, cozy and clean. We really felt like home and we liked it some much there. We stayed for one week and it was perfect :)  Roberta was so kind and followed us up before and during the stay. She was so understanding with our arrival and departing and made sure that we had a nice time.    We would really recommend Roberta's place if you ever going to New York. And living in Brooklyn was really great, we loved it there. We also loved Roberta’s recommendations for bars and restaurants in the neighbourhood.   Hope to stay at Roberta’s next time we are in NY and if you and Rob ever comes to Norway, let us now :)

We stayed at Roberta & Rob's place for almost a week on our first trip to NYC and actually on our very first few days in America, and it was PERFECT.   The apartment looks just as good as the pictures, is extremely cosy and nice, with a huge and beautiful bedroom. The kitchen had everything we needed for a full breakfast every day. The apartment was clean, warm and had fresh towels ready. :)  If you are looking to explore Brooklyn, Bed-Stuy is a great place to start. The area is full of lovely cafes, small restos and bars. It feels dynamic, artsy and vibrant.   If you're planning your time in Manhattan, there's a few metro stations within 15-20 min walk, and an express line that'll take you there in less then 20 mins. And if you're not afraid of walking, you can take a nice walk through Brooklyn, that'll take you an hour.  Roberta was always very clear about every detail and provided us with all the information we needed. Even though we had a little difficulty getting in the apartment once we arrived, we solved it in 5 mins over the phone. They left clear.  notes around the apartment and a few tips on places to eat and drink around the area.  All in all it felt like home away from home, and if we ever come back to New York, we would definitely come back here! Recommend by all means.  Thank you!

Indeed a lovely and cozy place to stay. Roberta &  Rob were all the way very kind giving very useful suggestions for us to move around. The apartment is very well equipped and the heating system is very efficient giving us a warm welcome after long days exploring the city. Smart TV set and very good WiFi. Kitchen very well equipped allowing us to cook a quick meal mainly when the outside temperature was not inviting to go outside. Another aspect that we have appreciated is the silence allowing us to stay in bed in the morning a little bit longer before starting our daily adventures.  Good supermarkets at 5 minutes walking distance from the apartment. Roberta &  Rob they were very kind leaving us with a list of recommended restaurants, supermarkets,  bars,  etc.  In summary a very pleasant stay that certainly recommend to any traveller. Thanks Roberta &  Rob.

Great apartment with lovely light rooms in a quiet but convenient location for subway, shops and restaurants - we would have liked to stay longer. Roberta and Rob have made it into a really comfortable and pleasant space with lots of plants and their beautiful artwork. The bedroom is large which makes it both good to sleep in and handy for accommodating travel bags.

We had a great stay in Rob and Roberts's apartment; they are really welcoming and helpful hosts and their home has a real warmth that reflects this. We tried several of their recommended places to eat locally and all were great. It's location was good too for getting the subway into Manhatten. All in all, a great experience- thank you!

Myself and my boyfriend had a great stay at Roberta and Rob's place. The apartment is spacious, clean and had everything we needed. The location is perfect with plenty of public transport and nice bars/restaurants. Roberta and Rob were amazing hosts and were always so quick to reach out if we had any questions. All in all a wonderful experience and we'd highly recommend staying here!

Do not let the entrance scare you away from this gloriously fun, taste of a Brooklyn loft. The neighborhood is safe to walk in with easy access to everything you may need. We spent only one night of a girls weekend in Brooklyn but thought we should have booked a longer stay. Everything was easily arranged for our stay and we will definitely stay here again. Thank you for everything.
Honestly it looks a little sketch from the outside at first but I never felt unsafe and the inside was BEAUTIFUL.

Mike's Airbnb was amazing and was in a prime location. So convenient and close to the subway. Check in and check out were easy and communication with Mike was great! The space was very cool inside and was overall a comfortable stay. The restrooms are split- one with a toilet and sink and the other with a shower, sink, and washer/dryer. Our party was hoping to do laundry, but were informed the day before that the dryer wasn't working. Also, the space was somewhat dusty throughout, but nothing too bad. FYI- the outside of the place looks a bit off putting, but we never felt unsafe! We walked during the day and at night too. Also, note there are 23 steps (they are numbered lol) up to the loft. Overall, great place that's close to lots of the tourist spots! Would definitely recommend!

Andrew and Talia are wonderful hosts! They will do everything they can to make your stay as nice as possible. The apartment perfectly matches the description and is very clean and orderly - you will feel at home immediately. The building is on a busy intersection, but that was never really a problem. The neighborhood provides many interesting places and excellent food at a good price. We never felt unsafe walking around or in the subway, even at night. The next subway station is only a minute away and it takes you to Penn Station in less than 45 min. We wouldn't hesitate a second to stay with Andrew and Talia again!

My boyfriend and I were visiting New York with the specific goal of finding our future apartment, but it was our first time in the area dealing with the real estate in New York City and had no idea what to expect.  Andrew and Talia were EXTREMELY helpful and accommodating - they let us know what the neighborhoods were like and offered us advice every time we told them we were visiting a new place. They made our stressful visit comfortable and shared their beautiful home with us! The easy access to the subway system was great, especially when you're in a city that never sleeps. They left a neighborhood guide for us to view with restaurants and special spots to check-out. Andrew and Talia are great when visiting New York for the first time...or any time!

Tina was an awesome host ! From the beginning her response time to us from pre booking to the end of our stay she was very quick to respond to our questions and concerns. I loved she sent reminders leading up to our stay with different information about our stay and things to expect and explore. For a family who had never been to New York this made our preparing for our trip easier and less stressful. We was enjoying our stay so much when we requested another night she graciously let us stay. We felt at home in our house ! It was located in Harlem but we felt safe the all stay and the people were so very friendly. We will be back again and we will recommend Tina and her beautiful with no reservations.

Tina's place is located in a nice area. Always felt safe with no issues. There were plenty of flatware for dinner and cooking. There was plenty of room for the family. Tina even allowed us to leave bags longer before headed to the airport since flight was later than check out. Awesome hospitality. We did encounter a non working dryer, which became a bit of a hassle because it rained during our stay. Also, we did not expect to be greeted by anyone and it scared us just a bit, but as I was opening the door, the downstairs neighbor answered the door. Seems he was watching tv and relaxing there. Other than those little nuances, the place was absolutely perfect.

This is a wonderful space for a large family and for people wanting their own rooms. Tina was a fantastic host and made it possible for us to enjoy Central Park on our son’s 10th birthday by allowing us to store our bags after check out. We discovered most of what we wanted to do was in Midtown and we had some in our party who weren’t comfortable with the subway so the Uber and Lyft fees added up.  That was totally on us though as there is a lot of public transport very close by. This is more just a heads up to others who may want to do more near Broadway and Times Square than in Harlem and North Park and who may not want to take the subway. For all other travelers this is a steal - so much space and a lovely host.

I have to mention it was inappropriate for the tenets in garden level to open the inside door yelling to keep it down at approximately 8:50 pm. I thought someone was in the home. My family was caught off guard. It seemed as if someone was inside the home as we heard the yelling very clear. Very unsafe for garden level tenets to have access inside the home, as it was proven in this instance. This was very traumatizing for my family.

This is a one-bedroom apartment. Ming--a perfectly gracious host--rents out the one bedroom. She sleeps in the living room, in a day bed cordoned off with shower curtains. You go through the living room when you enter and exit, use the bathroom, most anything. I found the arrangement to be . . . awkward. Uncomfortable. Even a little creepy.

Even if we never met Jason he was a brilliant host. The apartment was super tidy, light and fresh. The air condition was efficient and the bed was perfect.  The kitchen is a bit small, but if you are not planning to use it, there is no problem. The bathroom was clean and very nice. The only thing missing is a big mirror (if you need somewhere to put on your makeup). The neighbourhood is very calm and quiet, but during the weekend there might be some people in the local store/deli that can feel a bit scary (drunk/high). There are not much of a nightlife nearby so if you are interested in that kind of living you should go elsewhere. Although there are some pretty decent (above average) restaurants, 7-8 minutes walk away. Jason was a great communicator, and offered us to move in one day in beforehand (without any charge) and we got to leave our suitcases in the house after our checkout time since our flight was leaving late in the evening. This way we could use the full day and swing by ang grab the suitcases on our way to the airport. Great stuff!!! We would recommend this apartment to anyone that wants to stay in Brooklyn.

Even though our English was limited, Ming made a lot of effort to communicate with us and was very friendly. Even though the apartment is not huge, sharing was extremely easy and we never felt like we were too much. The best for a first real immersion with a local. Transport is simple and relatively close even if it takes 30 to 40 minutes to return in the evening by transport from Manhattan. The neighborhood is residential and we never felt unsafe. We highly recommend this very good address. See you Ming and thank a lot for your hospitality. Elodie & Florian

Klara is a very accommodating and approachable. Thanks to her I had a great stay in New York City! She was always quick to answer and help me with any questions or problems I had, which I really appreciated and made my two weeks stress-free. Her neighborhood is also very lively and seemed very close-knit. Seeing neighbors chatting on their front stoop or throwing parties in the street as I walked home every day was a lot of fun! I would definitely stay again if I get the chance! Thank you so much Klara for all your help during my stay! I wish you all the best~ :)

This place is the perfect crash pad.  Andrew is amazing.  Everything was quick, easy and hassle free.    If you're afraid of a "private room" booking, don't be afraid of this one.    You'll be happy you booked here

I cannot even being to explain how wonderful of a time I had during my stay! This was my first time ever staying in New York and Ming made it an unforgettable experience!!   My first morning there, ming made me breakfast when I woke up and we wwnt out and explored New York together! She showed me around the neighborhood and taught me how to use the subway! The next day was my birthday and Ming was thoughtful enough to get me a cake! Staying with Ming felt like visiting an old friend! I have never ever met someone as kind and generous as her!  The check in process is convenient and stress free! Ming left a set of keys for me on the day of my arrival and was super flexible on check in/ out times!  Her place is absolutely beautiful and you can tell she takes pride in her home. The room had the most comfortable bed Ive ever slept in. There are huge windows that get lots of light and give a beautiful view of the neighborhood! You also get your own closet stocked with any extras you may need: hairdryer, slippers, pillows, etc, etc!   She has two beautiful birds, George and Michael (like the singer haha) who made my stay that much more amazing! hearing their light chirping in the morning filled me with so much joy!!!!  The location was also perfect! I felt extremely safe while wandering around the neighborhood and there are tons of things close by! Theres a subway station right up the street which will take you into the city in under 10 minutes ! Beautiful coffee and bagel shops nearby also! At night it was peaceful and quiet and served as the perfect place to get some rest after a long day of exploring the city!  I cannot recommend Mings place enough!Already planning my next trip to Brooklyn so I can stay again! Everything about my trip was perfect and Im so grateful that I got to stay at Mings place!

I’m afraid to say how great it was because it’ll always be booked if i do! Such a great location, stylish and clean apartment. The bed was so comfortable, i slept like an angel.  I never wanted to leave the apartment. Felt like i was home. Would definitely recommend!

This is a wonderful place to stay. Robin’s home is quiet, clean and cozy, and she’s a generous and attendant host. It’s a spacious apartment, too, with lots of natural light. I rented this place for my parents when they came to visit over the holidays. They’d never used Airbnb before, and they left chiding themselves for not having tried it sooner, so great was their experience here.  Robin’s home is located in an excellent neighborhood, too. South Slope has charm and personality. It’s quiet (not creepy quiet, good quiet), it’s safe, and there’s a palpable ‘family feel’ in the airS Spend some time out and about, and you’ll quickly feel like a local. There are three trains nearby (f/g/r), three grocery stores within a ten minute walk, and myriad restaraunts and boutiques. I can’t recommend this place enough. Thanks Robin!

I had the most amazing service from Caroline.  She runs the place with professionalism, I was not expecting good housekeeping but her housekeeper was helpful and around everyday.  There was tea and coffee supplies and overall, clean and efficient.  Caroline was flexible and tried to accommodate my wavering schedule, for this I am very thankful.  I would recommend her to others.  The neighborhood adds to the Brooklyn ambience, it is a bit edgy but the security is around and I never felt unsafe walking back late at night from the subway.  Affordable stores nearby.  Exceeded expectations!

Bad smell of sewage in the home. Poor plumbing. Backyard is a dumpster. Signs of caution on the door to not open it because unsafe neighborhood. House rules require windows cannot be opened or backyard door. film 🎥 lightings in three corners in the front room that makes it look like it’s used a studio for making movies of some sort.

Excellent place. Well located a few blocks from the train, bus lines that pass in front or very close to reach Manhattan in 30 minutes. Businesses of all kinds nearby that give a very good feeling of security. The area might seem complicated, but I went in and out at different times of the day and night and never had any incidents or anything that made me feel unsafe. The place is very clean, always impeccable, common entrance that gives you the experience of living in Brooklyn! There are stairs that are a bit narrow but they are not a problem. Malose always gave me a lot of guidance and was always in communication for whatever was needed. Definitely a great place at a great price, I will definitely go back there.

This is very much a budget stay. The bedroom window is open directly onto the street (but reminder, this is New York, so loud noise to be expected). The apt is on the second floor. I felt very safe in the building itself. The building smelled pretty weird, but the apartment was so so clean and smelled nice. The housekeeper is super attentive. The door knob fell off of my door. You also have to dry your dishes with a towel right after washing them as there is no drying rack, which is not a big deal but kind of weird. The surrounding neighborhood is sketchy, and I heard a great deal of yelling about violent actions late at night on a couple occasions. The mattress is incredibly uncomfortable. But this is all manageable if you cannot afford anything else and want to be in this area specifically. Also, it's really really close to the subway. The internet is really fast, too.
Joan has been great to work with.  She was always willing to do whatever necessary to make my mom's stay stress free.

I can't even begin to say how nice my stay at Laura's place was. This was my very first experience with Airbnb and it was a great one.  Laura was very helpful and patient throughout the booking process and very accommodating once my friend and I got to her place.  Take the time to walk through her neighborhood during the day..It is beautiful and rather peaceful. Everything is within walking distance and there's a ton of things to see.  The room itself was just what we need it and large enough for to people to move around comfortably.   I would recommend Laura's place to anyone looking for a stress-free stay in Queens!  Thank you Laura!

Good place to go rest after walking throughout NYC. AC is a bit loud, though. Safe residential neighborhood. If you plan to rent a car, looking for a parking spot at night is a hassle. You must like or at least not be afraid of dogs...the little guy in Laura's profile pic likes to welcome visitors with effusive small-dog loud barking.

Room was the smelliest dirtiest smallest piece of shit I've ever resided in I regret every minute I spent in there, I will never return to queens as long as I live thanks to Laura, we slept on practically a piece of slate with no pillows and hardly enough blankets, we feared for our safety as well as the security of our things, multiple occasions where we assumed our things had been stolen, we were practically treated like refugees and our stay ended with the hosts waking us up abruptly out of our sleep.

Louis' apartment is welcoming, extremely well located (small, quiet street, close to everything) and ideal for our family (2 adults and 1 teenager). The bedrooms are bright, the rooms are well proportioned, the 2 bathrooms are super practical. Louis gave us all the necessary details for our arrival. The key exchange took place in his absence and went very well, on arrival and departure. Louis allowed us to do a late check-out, welcome since our flight took off in the evening. Thank you for making our stay in New York so pleasant and for allowing us to discover this nice neighborhood of Williamsburg!

The entrance is in the shady alley behind the house. You sleep in the basement room that has no windows. Everything smells link a detergent. The only good thing is the location if you are going from La Guardia the day after.

Our host was absolutely fantastic, we were made to feel at home at the apartment and able to treat it like our own.  She was really contactable and knowledgeable of the area for any extra information. Further to that she went the extra mile to make sure that any stress of travelling was minimised. The apartment itself was lovely and clean.

Susi's place is a steal for NYC. Very comfortable, quiet, and tasteful. Super comfy beds- the one we slept in had memory foam mattress and pillows and soft sheets. Kitchen skylight and little balcony keep you from feeling boxed in. Susi got back to me practically instantly every time we texted! Detailed check in info made everything easy. Tree-lined street was quiet and pretty. Overall a great stay.

Great stay! Awesome location, the parking space was really helpful, super close to subway, and great recommendations for food/drinks. We loved a night of trivia and board games at Skylark and dinner and drinks at Table 87 and Lucey's. Drug store down the street was also helpful. The space was really clean and quiet. It was nice to wake up to birds chirping even though we were in a larger city. Wish we had a longer stay, but the two days we were there were wonderful!

Our host politely accommodated us as our checkin plans changed. The fact there was an air conditioner in the room had a large impact on our comfort. It would have been preferable to have a shade or something to block the light above the air conditioner. The bed was comfortable and the room was clean.  The bathroom could have been cleaner.

Igors room was lovely. The furniture was tasteful and the room has more than enough space for two or an individual traveller. We came in at 2am due to our transportation but Igor provided accurate prompts on how to let ourselves in. The subway is a 5-7 minute walk away and that line is a great segway to major NYC locations. It only takes 20minutes on the subway to be right in the core of NYC. The only con I'd say is when you have to shower you have to cross through the living room to get back to your room. This isn't anything Igor can control or change for, but a bit of a heads up. Not to worry Igor is a busy artist so the space is mostly yours for the most part. We loved the location for the price it's a steal for NYC lodging.

The apartment is a delight and just as shown. I had a wonderful stay here for a month while on business. Dumbo is great and the F-train subway is close and not too busy during rush hour.   The terrace is the real winner here. It gets direct sunlight until late in the day perfect for dinner or a drink with friends.  It's such a nice place that I'd rather not leave a good review, so I can comeback on my return! But that would be criminal.  Stay and enjoy.

I have mixed feeling on our stay at at Lila's place and I must stress, based on the numerous reviews, it sounds like we just had a very rare slightly negative experience. The good far outweighs the bad, and the good is: The location (it's literally a 30 second walk to Parkside Metro which gives you links to Coney Island, and 25 mins into downtown Manhattan) Local amenities (a bunch of local cafes, bars, restaurants, and takeaways exist on Flatbush Avenue, all of great quality - I recommend Blessings Cafe for breakfast!) Decor (the apartment is really nicely decorated and homey, lots of pictures and rugs and the bedrooms have loads of books) Lila (she is a great host, provided clear instructions on how to get into flat and although we didn't see her much, she made sure that a leak in bathroom due to bad weather was fixed almost immediately) The bad, and again, based on the reviews I think were one offs were: Cleanliness (I really hope it was a one off, but the bedroom was really dusty and the underneath of the bed was so dusty and filled with cat hair, it didn't look like it'd been cleaned in the bedroom for quite a while. The rest of the apartment also suffered from dusty surfaces) The cats (I absolutely loved the cats themselves, they are so friendly and cute - but I think they have too much freedom in the place - at least 3 or 4 times in the stay, we saw the cats jumping up onto kitchen surfaces and licking water from the water tap, which was incredibly unhygienic and made get bottled water each day. Also, one of the cats loved our bedroom a little too much, and literally waits outside the bedroom - as soon as you open the door, they'll run in and one will always hide under the bed and doesn't come out. It's really frustrating having to spend 10-15 mins trying to coax them out) Linen (again, I hope this was a one off but the linen on our bed was really old and had clearly been attacked by the pets. The towels for bathroom had tons of holes in them and were quite old and not very nice) Noise (a review below mentioned this, but even we all doors and windows closed, the outside noise in mornings around 7-9am is horrendous, you won't be able to sleep in unless you have earplugs - it's not a bad thing for us, as we were up ready to explore around that time anyway and it was a good alarm clock, this is nothing to do with Lila or the apartment, but it should be noted if you're thinking of lying in!) Untrained dog (the dog was amazingly cute, but when we first arrived the dog had weed everywhere, and had done a poo on the floor - I don't think it was very well trained) As I said at the beginning,...

Eli’s place is the perfect base for Brooklyn/Manhattan and great value for money. Super convenient to a central subway line, and we found a parking station almost across the road- which meant no stressful situations finding parking.  The room is exactly as advertised, and Eli is a pro with clear check in instructions and local tips of the area. As advertised- the apartment is shared with pets. So I wouldn’t recommend it for anyone with allergies or not custom to apartments/living with pets indoors. But for us that was a bonus- super friendly and gorgeous animals that loved pats!  I would happily book again!

The location to public transportation is great. The pets were fine. Eli was pleasant. Although it is inexpensive the level of cleanliness in the bathroom was very bad.  This is a crash pad, however the bathtub/bathroom made it  unpleasant.

We were lucky to book this amazing apt. Great host was very responsive and able to host us in less than 24 hours when our accommodations were canceled last minute! The apt was very clean and very luxurious (almost too nice for us with a toddler and newborn - too scared to mess up nice furniture). Other than that it was great to have 2bds 2baths and a patio and a washer dryer in the city! We truly lived the NYC life with 2 under 2. It was in the perfect location for our wedding events! A great and better alternative to a cramped hotel rooms. One thing that got tricky with car transportation is that the location is right where the Holland Tunnel traffic builds up but just need to cross the street and you’ll have no problem. Also because we were so last minute we missed out on some check-in perks and had to retrieve keys elsewhere.  Other than the expected city sounds, my family truly enjoyed.

We stayed at J & Lana for two nights, it was really good experience  . We took a metro from Manhattan  to Avenue H which took us around 30 mins to reach and  5 mins walk from there. Neighborhood is very calm with nice houses.  Lana and their 8 years old kid  Louis welcomed us , He is so cute with nice attire with tie and offered drinks. we felt very cute , comfortable and happy.  My wife is scared of dogs and we informed them and they took care of their dog . There are two more shy cats and  turtle in their home.  Room is very good with antique tables which reminded me my grandfather house.  Next morning i met J , very nice person we had  some conversation.  There is one more near by metro Newkirk plaza.  I personally recommend to take Newkirk plaza than avenu h , both are same distance. Newkirk plaza has many food retailers like dunkin donuts, gyro King, subway , Chinese restro .....
